Ukwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthenga sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba izimpilo zethu ziba zisheshayo, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu ziyaqhubeka nokwanda, zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni indlela esithenga ngayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izizathu ezibangela lokhu kukhula, izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezinyathelo zokuthi sikwazi ukuthola okuhle kakhulu kulezi zindawo. Izizathu Zokwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isizathu sokuqala sokwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu sitholakala ekukhuleni komnotho. Njengoba imakethe yama-ejensi ibonisa ukukhula, abantu banemali eningi yokuthenga. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukugcina abasebenzisi bazo behleli behlelekile, behlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi ngaphakathi kwebhizinisi elilodwa. Okwesibili, izifiso zabathengi ziye zashintsha. Abantu baphakathi kwezimo ezisheshayo, futhi bayakufuna ukuhamba nge-‘one-stop shop’ — indawo lapho bengathola khona konke abakudingayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, izingubo, izinto zokubhala, nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinikeza lezi zinsizakalo, ngaleyo ndlela zikhulisa ukuthengiswa kwazo. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga Ezindaweni Ezinkulu Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhulisa umbono wabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bangakhetha izinto eziningi, beqhathanisa amanani futhi benze izinqumo ezicacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okuyinto ephumelela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. Okwesibili, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zivame ukuhlinzeka ngezaphulelo ezithile. Lokhu kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathole izimpahla ezinhle ngamanani aphansi. Izitolo ezinzima zihlala zikhanga abathengi ngama-promotions, okuyinto edala umuzwa omuhle wokuthi abathengi benza okungcono uma bethenga. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nokwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Naphezu kwezinzuzo, kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nokwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuncipha kwemakethe yama-smes (small and medium enterprises). Njengoba izindawo ezinkulu ziqhuba, izitolo ezincane ziyaqhamuka, ziphumelele. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephuma emisebenzini. Okwesibili, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zingaphazamisa imvelo. Ukwakha izitolo ezinkulu kudinga indawo enkulu, futhi lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemvelo okuhlobene nezilwane nezitshalo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, njengoba umphakathi kufanele uqaphele imiphumela yezenzo zawo. Izinyathelo Zokusebenzisa Ngempumelelo Izindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Ukuze sithole okuhle kakhulu ezindaweni zokuthenga ezinkulu, kunezinyathelo ezithile okufanele ziqhutshelwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi babheke kahle izintengo. Ukuqhathanisa amanani ezitolo ezahlukene kungasiza ukuthola izaphulelo ezinhle. Okwesibili, abathengi kufanele bahlale behlola izikhangiso nemikhankaso yokuthengisa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde ukuthi yiziphi izitolo ezibeka izaphulelo ezinhle, futhi bagweme ukuhamba ezitolo ezithengisa ngamanani aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi kufanele basebenzise izinhlelo zokunxenxa. Izinhlelo zokunxenxa ziyindlela enhle yokuthola izinzuzo ezengeziwe, njengokuthola ezinye iziphakamiso noma amanani aphansi, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa omuhle wokuthenga. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu kudala izinketho eziningi kubathengi, kodwa kudinga ukuqashelwa izinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuthenga ngokucophelela. Imiphumela yokuthenga ezindaweni ezinkulu ingathinta kakhulu impilo yempilo yethu, ngakho-ke kufanele sibe nokuqonda okuhle nokuqaphela indlela esithenga ngayo. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo eziningi ezivela kulokhu kukhula, siphephe nemiphumela emibi.
Amahathi - Ukubaluleka Kwabo Empilweni Yethu Umhumushi: Sanibonani, nonke. Namuhla sikhuluma ngamaHlathi, indawo ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Nansi ingxoxo esiyihlelile noMnu. Dlamini, ongumsebenzi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuhlala, ukuze sihlolisise kabanzi ngalezi zindawo ezinkulu. Mnu. Dlamini, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngihlanganyele nawe namuhla. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyakujabulela ukukhuluma ngalolu daba. Amahathi ayindawo ebalulekile, futhi kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi awafaneleki kuphela njengendawo yokuphumula, kodwa anenhloso enkulu empilweni yethu. Umhumushi: Kulungile, ngiyacela uchaze kabanzi mayelana nokubaluleka kwamaHlathi. Mnu. Dlamini: Amahathi ayisitshalo esiyingqayizivele. Avikela umoya esiwuphefumulayo, angamakhaya ezilwane nezitshalo eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaHlathi adlala indima enkulu ekugcinweni kwamanzi. Amathafa ahlanzekile futhi anomoya opholile, athuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Umhumushi: Lokhu kuphinde kudinge ukuvikelwa. Iziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo kumahathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ziningi izinselelo. Okokuqala, ukucutshungulwa kwezinkuni, okuholela ekuncipheni kwamaHlathi. Emiphakathini eminingi, ukuntshontsha izinkuni kubangela ukuhlaselwa kwezindawo zethu ezisemvelo. Okunye, izinguquko zezulu, ezihlanganisa ukushisa okwandayo kanye nokushoda kwemvula, kukhathaza kakhulu amaHlathi. Umhumushi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela amaHlathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, ziningi izinyathelo. Imizi ethile isungule imikhankaso yokuvikela amaHlathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini esebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo. Kunemizamo yokulima ngendlela ehlanzekile ezama ukunciphisa umthelela omubi kumahathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuvikela kwabantu zikhuthazwa, kufanele simise ukungcoliswa kwamaHlathi. Umhumushi: Ngabe ubona kanjani ikusasa lamaHlathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngicabanga ukuthi sinesikhathi sokulungisa izinto. Uma sithokozisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kwamaHlathi, sizoba nokuthi ngabe sikhulisa imizamo yethu yokuvikela. Ukwazisa abantu ngamalungelo nemisebenzi yabo, kuzobasiza ukuba bahlanganyele ekulondolozeni lezi zindawo ezibalulekile. Umhumushi: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa izingane nokuqala lapho? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngempela. Izifundo ezitholakala ezikoleni mayelana nemvelo, amaHlathi, nezilwane ezifuywayo zibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwakha umqondo wokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo phakathi kwezingane. Uthando nemfundo kudlula emaphakathini, eso kuzogcina sekuwumgomo ophumelelayo. Umhumushi: Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi sinesibopho sokuqinisekisa umhlaba osuhlukahlukene nesinjalo? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, wonke umuntu ubalulekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezifundazwe, amabhizinisi, nemiphakathi kungaba nomthelela omuhle ekulondolozeni amaHlathi. Imizamo yethu akufanele ibhalwe emithonjeni ephambili kuphela; kufanele ikwenze ifinyelele kumphakathi ngokuphelele. Umhumushi: Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukwabelana nakho mayelana namahathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalokhu. Nginesifiso sokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi amaHlathi awasizi thina kuphela, kodwa anomthelela emhlabeni wonke. Omoya, amanzi, nezinto eziphilayo, konke kuhlangene. Futhi ukuzinda kwethu phakathi kwazo, kufanele sikuphinde sikwazi ukwenza lokho, okubekwe phezulu. Umhumushi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile nalesi sihloko esibucayi. Ngithemba lokuthi sizobona umnotho kulobu bukhona bamaHlathi. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngijabule kakhulu. Ngiyaphinda ngiyavuma – amaHlathi awawusizo, kanti umsebenzi wethu udinga ukubambisana. Ngiyabonga! Umhumushi: Ngiyabonga, futhi sikhumbule ukuhlonipha nokuveza izinsiza ezisemhlabeni. Kuhle kudlula konke. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukubaluleka kokugcina amaHlathi. Akukhona ukudla noma kuphela ukulondoloza izinkuni, kodwa kunokuhilonza impilo yethu. Ake sethule izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amaHlathi azothela emaphethelweni ethu nabazokhulisa lezi zinyathelo. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokuhlala seduze.
UMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umlando Nempumelelo Yomholi Wokuhola UMangosuthu Buthelezi, owazalwa ngo-27 kuMfumfu 1928 eBabanango, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabaholi ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe zalesi sizwe. UButhelezi ubenomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni nasekuqondiseni izinqubo ezithinta ubuhlanga, isizwe, kanye nezepolitiki, ikakhulukazi ngenkathi ye-Apartheid. Ngaphezu kokuba ngumholi, uButhelezi ungumculi, umbhali, nomfundisi, futhi ungena kubalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu. Ngemva kokuthola imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, uButhelezi waqala umsebenzi wakhe wezombusazwe njengomfana ophakeme, lapho aqala khona ukuqonda izinselelo nobunzima obuhambisana nezombusazwe ezweni lakhe. Waqala ukusebenza nezikhungo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ne-ANC (African National Congress), kodwa wathola ukuthi izindlela zabo zokulwa ne-Apartheid zazihambisana nezinhlelo zakhe zamasiko nezokuphatha. Ngonyaka ka-1975, uButhelezi waba nguSihlalo we-Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP), iphathi eyasungulwa ukuze ik representing izidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaZulu. UButhelezi waphakanyiswa njengomholi ohloniphekile, ophikisana nezinqubomgomo ze-Apartheid, kodwa owazisa kakhulu izimiso zokuzimela kwamaZulu. Ukuphikisana nobuholi be-ANC, okwakuhambisana nezinqubomgomo ezazithathwa ngaleso sikhathi, kwaholela ekubeni kube neziyaluyalu phakathi kweIFP ne-ANC. Ngaphezu kwezombusazwe, uButhelezi uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ezokwakha, nezokuhlalisana. Ubuye waqhakambisa izinsiza zomphakathi, njengokwakha ezemfundo nezempilo, okuhlangene nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uButhelezi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emiphakathini ethile, ikakhulukazi kwabaseZulwini, lapho abanye bemthanda kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe, kanti abanye bembona njengomholi ophikisana nezinhlelo eziningi zokulwa ne-Apartheid. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni yama-1980s, lapho izimpi zomphakathi zashintsha izimo zezimali nezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uButhelezi waba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezokuthula eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze kube nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezazikhona phakathi kwamaZulu, amaXhosa, nabanye abantu. Uhlanganyele ezinkulumweni eziningi zokuthula, lapho wahola khona izinkulumo ezibalulekile, esebenzisa amandla akhe njengomholi wezombusazwe ukuze axazulule izinkinga ezazikhona. Naphezu kwezinkinga nezithiyo, uButhelezi ugcinile isikhundla sakhe njengephini lempilo yomphakathi, ebonisa ukuthi ubuholi buphathelene nokusebenza ngentshisekelo yomphakathi. Uthembisa ukubuyisela emuva izinsiza, ukwakha i-inkonzo efinyelela kubantu abaningi, futhi agqugquzele ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uButhelezi ubenesithakazelo esikhulu emfundweni, ethinta kakhulu izifundo zabantu abasha, enza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni ethuthukile. Umsebenzi kaButhelezi ubalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba ebonisa ukuthi ubuholi buhlobene nezindlela eziningi zokuphila kwabantu. Uthi umholi kumele azinikele emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa umphakathi, futhi ahloniphe izimiso zokuhlukana kwamasiko. Ngesikhathi sokuphela kwe-Apartheid, uButhelezi waba yisibonelo sokuqonda ukuthi iziphakamiso nezinhlelo zidinga ukubhekwa ngendlela ebanzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ekugcineni, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ungomunye wabaholi ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, onomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi amaZulu. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi wezombusazwe, uButhelezi ungumfuziselo wokuthi ubuholi buphathelene nokuhlonipha, ukuxhumana, nokusebenza ngokubambisana nabanye, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa futhi zifezekiswa. Njengoba uhamba phambili, uButhelezi usazoba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo.
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Ngiyavuma ukuthi ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu namuhla. Abanye baphikisa, besho ukuthi lokhu akuhambisani nezinto ezinhle, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kunezinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Kubalulekile ukuhlaziya indlela ama-social media aguqule ngayo impilo yethu, ikakhulukazi entsheni. Uma sikhuluma ngentsha, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zimo zihluke kakhulu ezikhathini ezedlule. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abantwana bethu bahlala kuphi? Kanjani baphila? Abantu abasha, ngesikhathi beqala ukukhumbula impilo yabo, bahlala behlanganyela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bezithokozisa futhi bebonisa impumelelo, kodwa futhi bahlola imizwa yabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi basebenzisa ama-social media ukuze babelane ngezinto ezithile, imicabango, nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi omkhulu, kodwa akukhona konke okuhle. Cishe sithola ukuthi ama-social media angathinta imizwa yentsha ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kunezikhathi lapho abantu baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo, nezinye lapho bezizwa benomona. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni umphakathi ungabi nempilo, lapho abanye befuna ukuphumelela ukuze bahlale behlaba umxhwele. Lokhu kubuhlungu, ngoba abanye bahlala bephila impilo yomfanekiso kuphela, okungaholela ekuboniseni ukuthi abaphumelelanga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi ama-social media angaba yinsiza enkulu ezindaweni eziningi. Ngokwesibonelo, abantwana bangathola ulwazi olusha ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ezokuzivocavoca, kanye nezindlela zokudla. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abanye bethu sikhule ezindaweni lapho ulwazi lungatholakali kalula. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele siwasebenzise ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi ama-social media ahamba nezinye izinkinga. Abantu abasha bahlala bejoliswe ezithombeni ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi impilo ayilona nje umfanekiso omuhle. Kukhona umsebenzi, ukukhathazeka, nezinkinga zokuphila ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kubangela ukucindezeleka, futhi abanye bethu bahlala befuna ukwenqaba lezi zinkinga, besebenzisa ama-social media njengendlela yokuphila. Abanye abantwana bahlala bephila impilo yokudlala kwezokuxhumana, bejabulela imidlalo, izinhlelo zokukhuluma, kanye nokuhlanganyela kwezithombe. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, kodwa kuphinde kudale umphakathi ocasulayo. Abanye bahlala bephila impilo ehlukile, bagwema ukuxhumana nabanye, kanti abanye bahlala bezama ukuphila ngendlela yokuphila. Lokhu kudinga ukunakekelwa, ngoba umphakathi uthola umbono wokuthi ukuphumelela kubalulekile, futhi lokho kungaholela ekuguleni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ama-social media angaholela ekutheni abantu baphile impilo engcono. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukona konke okunqoba. Umsebenzi wethu, njengezizukulwane ezikhulayo, ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ama-social media kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa abantu abasha ukuthi izithombe ezinhle azisho ukuthi impilo iyinhle. Kufanele benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bazame ukungena emhlabeni omusha ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kuphela. Ngokuphelele, umthelela wama-social media entsheni awukwazi ukubalulwa. Ukukhula kwemibono, ukusabalala kolwazi, nokuxhumana nabanye kuyinto engathuthuka empilweni yethu. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kokubukeka nokweqiniso. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi siphile impilo engcono, enempilo, futhi sifunde indlela yokuphila efanele. Ekugcineni, uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele sihlose ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, sikhulume ngempilo, futhi sigcine umphakathi uphila kahle. Lokhu akusikhuthazi kuphela ukuba siphumelele, kodwa futhi kusenza sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi ophelele. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele sibe nezindlela zokuthola ulwazi, sikhuluma ngezinto ezithakazelisayo, futhi sifunde ukuhamba nalesi sikhathi esisha. Ngakho, thina njengentsha, kufanele sibe nokuqonda okuhle mayelana nama-social media, siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele, bese sikhuluma ngezinto ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ekwakheni ikusasa elihle.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala KweSamsung Galaxy Ngonyaka ka-2009, umhlaba wezobuchwepheshe wathola umkhiqizo omusha owaqala ukuhamba phambili, iSamsung Galaxy. Le mveliso yabe iyingxenye yeSamsung Electronics, inkampani eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngama-smartphones, amakhompyutha, nezinto eziningi zobuchwepheshe. IGalaxy yabe iyisixazululo esisha sokuxhumana, esihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili nezici ezithokozisayo, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka abasebenzisi ngolwazi olungcono lokuxhumana. Isahluko 2: Ukukhula KweGalaxy Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwayo, iSamsung Galaxy yathola impendulo enhle emakethe. Ngonyaka ka-2010, iSamsung Galaxy S yethulwa, yenza umhlaba waba nentshisekelo enkulu. Le foni yayinezinzuzo eziningi, ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye ne-Android OS, eyayihlinzeka ngohlelo lokusebenza oluningi. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Isahluko 3: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlobo Ngonyaka ka-2011, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S II, eyayinezinzuzo ezithuthukisiwe ezifana nekhono lokusebenza okusheshayo, isikhumbuzo esikhulu, kanye nekhono lokuxhumana nge-Wi-Fi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuxhumana. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung Galaxy yabe isiqhubeka nokukhula, ithola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi emhlabeni jikelele. Isahluko 4: Ukuqhamuka KweGalaxy Note Ngonyaka ka-2011, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Note, okuyifoni eyayihlanganisa izici ze-smartphone ne-tablet. Le mveliso yabe yenza umhlaba waba nentshisekelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzisi abathanda ukubhala noma ukudweba. I-Galaxy Note yathuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokuthinta, yenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthi basebenzise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Isahluko 5: Ukukhula Kwezinhlobo Zokugcina Ngonyaka ka-2013, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S4, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S4 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung yabe isiqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izici ezithokozisayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezithombe, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezici zokuxhumana. Isahluko 6: Ukuqhubeka KweGalaxy Ngonyaka ka-2015, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S6, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S6 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung yabe isiqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izici ezithokozisayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezithombe, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezici zokuxhumana. Isahluko 7: I-Galaxy S8 ne-Galaxy S9 Ngonyaka ka-2017, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S8, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S8 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngonyaka ka-2018, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S9, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Isahluko 8: I-Galaxy Z Fold ne-Galaxy Z Flip Ngonyaka ka-2019, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Z Fold, okuyifoni eyayihlanganisa izici ze-smartphone ne-tablet. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Z Flip, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Isahluko 9: Ukubheka Phambili Namuhla, iSamsung Galaxy isiqhubeka nokuba yinsika yokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe. Izici ezintsha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo zenza iGalaxy ibe yinsika yokuxhumana emhlabeni jikelele. I-Samsung Galaxy isiqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olungcono kubasebenzisi, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sizobona izinguquko eziningi ezizayo, futhi iSamsung Galaxy izohlala ibalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe.
uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, olungamandla amakhulu, luhamba phambili njengomthombo wezimpilo, amasiko, nezinkumbulo eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Njengomuntu ohlala eduze kwalolu lwandle, ngiyazizwa ngithinteka kakhulu yizinto eziningi ezihambisana nalo. ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean akukhona nje kuphela umkhakha wezomnotho, kodwa futhi ubonisa ubuhle bemvelo, ubudlelwano bethu nemvelo, kanye namasiko ahlukene ahlanganiswa yizimpawu zempilo ezikhalweni ezihlukene. Ngokwengqondo yami, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumhlaba ogcwele izimanga. Uthando lwami nolwazi enginalo ngalo lwalungaqhamukanga nje kuphela ezimpilweni zethu, kodwa futhi lukhombisa indlela esihlangana ngayo nemvelo. Uma ubuka amanzi aluhlaza, ubona izinkanyezi ezikhazimulayo, futhi uthokozisa umoya opholile, uzwa umuzwa wokuthula okungapheli. Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba siphila ezikhathini ezinzima, uLwandlekazi uhlala unikeza indawo yokuphumula nokucabanga. Ngokubuka umhlaba, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungomunye wezindawo ezibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni. Uhlanganisa amazwe amaningi, kusukela e-Afrika, e-Asia, nase-Australasia. Lezi zindawo zihlala zihlangene ngezindlela eziningi, kusukela ezokuhamba, ezokuxhumana, nokuhweba. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yendawo, asikwazi ukuhamba sihlukanisa lezi zindawo. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi uLwandlekazi uhlanganisa abantu, izinkolo, namasiko ahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ube yindawo yokuhweba, lapho izimpahla nezinsiza zidluliselwa khona phakathi kwamazwe. Lokhu kuhweba akukhona nje kuphela okwenziwa ngezimpahla, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwabelana ngamasiko, izinkolelo, nezindlela zokuphila. Ngikhumbula izinsuku engangihamba ngolwandle, ngibona izikebhe ezihamba phambili, futhi ngikhumbula ukuthi lezi zikebhe zikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Uhlanga lwezimpahla luhamba, kodwa futhi luhamba nemicabango, izinkolelo, nezifundo ezibalulekile. Nokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean awuphelelanga ekuboniseni ubuhle nemisebenzi. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nalolu lwandle. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, ukuwohloka kwemvelo, nokwanda kwezimboni eziphula imithetho yokuvikela imvelo kuyizinkinga ezinkulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe isinyathelo ukuze sivikele leli lwandle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamazwe, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ngabanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean uyahlala unempilo futhi unothile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumthombo wezinsiza eziningi, njengezinkanyezi, amafutha, nezinsiza zemvelo. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinsiza azikhona kuphela ukuze zisetshenziswe. Kumele sibe nomqondo wokuphila ngendlela ehlonipha imvelo. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza ziyahlala zikhona, kudingeka sibe necebo eliqinile lokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela ehlonipha imvelo. Ngokuphetha, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumthombo omkhulu wezimpilo, amasiko, nezinkumbulo. Njengomuntu okhulele eduze kwalolu lwandle, ngiyaziqhenya ngalesi sikhumbuzo sokuthi uLwandlekazi awukwazi nje ukusinika izinto, kodwa futhi usinika ithuba lokuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula. Kumele sithathe isinyathelo sokuvikela leli lwandle, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo nazo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean uyindawo efanele yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokukhumbula ukuthi sikhona ngenxa yalo. Ngakho, asithathe isinyathelo, sizivikele, futhi sigcine ubuhle bethu obuhlala kuLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean.
Izinsiza Zesayensi: Uhlolojikelele Ngezinto Ezihamba Phambili Emkhakheni Wezesayensi Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nezesayensi kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi sithola ulwazi ngezinto ezintsha, okwenza umhlaba uqhubeke, uthuthuke, futhi uthole amandla okuphendula izinselele ezinkulu ezifana nokufuya, ezempilo, nezemvelo. Ngalesi simo, kubalulekile ukwaziwa kwezinsiza nemithelela yazo ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile. Ukwakhiwa Kwezazi: Ucwaningo Olubalulekile Njengoba sikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde izindlela ezahlukene ezitholakala kubantu abaphakanyisiwe ezemfundo. Izazi zesayensi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi olusha, oluphenywa ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kudingeka ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo emikhakheni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo eziphakeme, ikakhulukazi, ziba izikhungo zokucwaninga, lapho abathweswe iziqu benza khona izifundo ezijulile, beqala kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuholela emiphumeleni engcono ekwelapheni izifo, ekuthuthukiseni izinto zokusebenza, nasemikhakheni yokugcina imvelo. Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Abalingisi Abajabulisayo Ngasikhathi sinye, ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile yeziqu zezesayensi. I-automation, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), nezinye izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe bokuqonda zishintsha indlela esisebenza ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha emhlabeni wethu, kusiza ukuthuthukisa imiphumela emisha emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ezinhlelweni zokulima, nezokuthutha. Ngokuthuthukiswa kwemishini, izazi zivula amathuba amasha, ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ehambisana nezicwangciso zayo ibangelwa ukucwaninga okujulile nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Izinkinga Zezemvelo: Ukubhekelela Isikhathi Esizayo Nokho, izinsiza zesayensi azigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, kodwa zibuye zihlola nezinkinga ezibhekene nomhlaba. Ukushintsha kwesimo seplanethi, imuvuzo yokungcoliswa komoya, nokwehla kwemithombo yemvelo kuzoba nemiphumela emikhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Izazi zesayensi zihlola ngendlela eqondile indlela lezi zinkinga ezingaxazululwa ngayo, zihlinzeka ngamasu nezixazululo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokuvikela imvelo, ukuphucula izinqubo zokwenza izinto, kanye nokwenziwa kwezinto zokuqwashisa umphakathi mayelana nezimo zemvelo. Ubuchwepheshe Belwazi: Ukuxhumana Komphakathi Ukuze umphakathi uthole indlela efanele yokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe belwazi, obuhlanganisa i-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemithombo yabezindaba, bunika umphakathi ithuba lokuhlaziya, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuqonda kwezesayensi, kuvula amathuba amasha okuxoxa ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ezinye izinkampani sezisebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze ziqhube izinkampani zazo, zikhuthaze ukuhweba, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izeluleko Eziyinhloko: Qhubekani Nokuqonda Kubalulekile ukuthi siyazi ukuthi yonke lezi zinsizakusebenza, ezithandwa kakhulu, zidinga ukusizwa ngabantu. Ukugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemicabango, kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Okwamanje, izazi zesayensi zikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuthi abambe iqhaza, athuthukise ulwazi lwakhe, futhi azibandakanye ezenzakalweni ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela kule migudu, asize ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho: Ukukhanya Kwezenzakalo Zesayensi Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinsiza, kucacile ukuthi izesayensi zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuze umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphendula izinselele ezenzakalweni ezinzima, kudingeka ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ngokugcwele ukufunda, ukwenza, futhi azizise izinsiza zesayensi ezintsha. Lokhu kudinga isimo sokubambisana, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene, nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqhubeke nokufunda. Izesezizukulwane ezithuthukayo zidinga ukucabangela izimo ezinzima zomhlaba, ukuze zifake emathubeni amasha okwenyusa umphakathi. Empeleni, ukuqonda ubuqotho bemikhakha ehlukene yezenzakalo zesayensi kuyafaneleka, futhi kuyasiza ukuze siqonde ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhamba nezinselele ezizayo ezihambisana nezinsiza zokugcina izwe lethu liphila ngempumelelo.
Umlando weSoweto Uprising Ngomhlaka 16 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1976, umphakathi waseSoweto, ophakathi kweGauteng, waba yisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuphikiswa kwemigomo yobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika. Le ndaba yenzeka ngesikhathi sokuphila okunzima, lapho abantu abamnyama bephila ngaphansi kwemithetho eqinile yokuhlukaniswa, eyayibizwa ngokuthi uBandlululo. Izinyathelo ezithathwe nguhulumeni zashiya umphakathi ubuhlungu, futhi izifundo ezazifundiswa ezikoleni zashintshwa zaba ngesiBhunu, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa isiZulu nezilimi zabantu abamnyama. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto, ikakhulukazi abaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi neshumi nanye, baqala ukucela izinguquko. Bafuna ukufunda ngolimi lwabo, isiZulu, isiXhosa, nezinye izilimi zomdabu. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kube nezinhlelo zokuhlangana, lapho abantwana bephakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa izinqubomgomo ezazibabeka phansi. Umoya wokuphikiswa wawukhula, futhi izifundo zaba yisikhumbuzo sokungavumelani nokuhlukumezeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukuhlela imibhikisho, futhi kwavela izinsuku zokuhlangana ukuze kubonakale ukungavumelani. Ngaleso sikhathi, umholi weSoweto, uHector Pieterson, waba yisithonjana sokuphikiswa. U-Hector, owayeneminyaka eyishumi nanye, wabulawa ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa, futhi lesi senzo saphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuhlupheka kwabantu abamnyama. Ngomhlaka 16 kuNhlangulana, abantwana bahlangana emgwaqweni, bephakamisela izikhumbuzo zabo. Umphakathi wawubhalela izimpawu ezikhumbuza abantu ukuthi baphike izinqubomgomo ezazibabazisayo. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni, owawungavumi ukwamukela izikhalazo, wathumela amaphoyisa ukuze abavimbe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho amaphoyisa aphosa izibhamu, kwavela udlame olukhulu. Abantwana baphendula, bephikisana nempilo yabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulungwane zabantu abathintekayo. Umlando weSoweto Uprising akukhona nje kuphela ngempilo yalesi sikhathi, kodwa ubonisa amandla abantu abamnyama. U-Hector Pieterson, owayengumfana ophumelele, waba yisithonjana sokuphikiswa, futhi izithombe zakhe zashintsha umqondo wabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Uhlanga lwabantu abamnyama lwaphakamisa izwi labo, lwazisa umhlaba ngezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Ngemuva kokuphikiswa, uhulumeni wathola ukuthi akasakwazi ukugcina izinqubomgomo zakhe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezweni. Izifundo zashintshwa, futhi abantu abamnyama baqala ukuthola ithuba lokufunda ngolimi lwabo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawuhlangene. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ungumfanekiso wezinselelo abantu abamnyama abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa futhi uyafundisa ukuthi amandla okuhlangana nokuphikisa angaguqula umhlaba. U-Hector Pieterson nozakwabo bahlala bephila ezinkumbulweni zabantu, futhi lesi sikhathi sikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukulwa namalungelo akho akumele kube yinto engapheli. Umphakathi uhlala ukhumbula lezi zinsuku, futhi izifundo zalesi sikhathi ziqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphike izinhlelo ezimbi. Ngakho, umlando weSoweto Uprising awuwona nje umcimbi ophakathi kokuphila kwabantu, kodwa ubonisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze bafeze izinguquko ezibalulekile. Izinsuku zikaJuni zihlala zikhumbuleka, futhi umphakathi uhlala uqhubeka nokukhumbula izifundo ezitholakele. U-Soweto waba yisibonelo sokuthi amandla abantu abamnyama angashintsha umhlaba, futhi lokhu kuhlala kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi akufanele silahlekelwe ithemba.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Inkinga Ethinta Ikusasa Lemiphakathi Emhlabeni wethu wamanje, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni sekuyindaba ebucayi. Njengomuntu onomuzwa oqinile mayelana nezindaba zemfundo, ngibona le nkinga iyingozi kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumiphakathi yethu yonke. Ukufunda kuyisisekelo sokukhula komuntu, futhi abathisha bamele izikhumbuzo zokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi ukushoda kwabo kungenza kube nzima ukufezekisa le njongo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukushoda kothisha akukhona nje ukungabi nabantu abaningi emsebenzini. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezibangela le nkinga, kuhlanganise nezimo zokusebenza ezimbi, izinkokhelo ezingezinhle, kanye nezidingo ezinkulu zokufunda okukhona. Abathisha abaningi bahlushwa yizimo zempilo ezingezinhle, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nempilo yabo yomuntu siqu. Uma abathisha bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kuba nzima ukuthi bakwazi ukunikeza abafundi ubuholi obufanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise isimo sabo. Ngokuthola abathisha abaningana ezikoleni, sizobona ukuthi abafundi bahlushwa yizifundo eziphansi. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho kunabathisha abaningi, abafundi bathola amathuba angcono okuthola izifundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abathisha abaneziqu eziphakeme, abanamava, nezifundo eziphumelelayo bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekufundeni kwethu. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo, kufanele sigxile ekutholeni abathisha abafanele, futhi sikwenze lokhu kube yinto ebalulekile esizayo. Esikhathini esedlule, izikhungo zemfundo zazibhekelele kakhulu ukwakha uhlelo oluqinile lokuqhuba imfundo. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube nomthelela omkhulu, futhi izikhungo zethu zihlala zikhonza izidingo ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kufanele silungiselele abathisha bethu ukuze baphumelele, futhi uma bengenakuthola izinsiza ezifanele, sizobona ukushoda okwandayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele siqonde ukuthi imfundo ayiyona nje into yokufundisa abafundi. Imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esiqinile, esinobuchule, futhi esizithokozisayo. Ngokwesibonelo, abathisha baveza amakhono ahlukahlukene kubafundi, okuvumela abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokucabanga, lokukhiqiza, nokuqonda okujulile. Uma kuncishiswa inani labathisha, lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye abafundi bahluleke ukujwayela lezi zifundo. Esikhathini esizayo, ngibona kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zifake izinhlelo ezinzima zokuthuthukisa imfundo. Lokhu kungakwenza kube lula ukuthola abathisha abaphethe iziqu eziphakeme, futhi kunciphise ukuhamba kwabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abafundi abakhethiweyo ukuba babe abathisha, ukuze bakwazi ukwakha isizukulwane esisha sabafundisi abaqinile. Ngokufingqa, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akukhona nje okuphazamisayo emfundweni, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta ikusasa lempucuko yethu. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise isimo sabathisha, sikhuthaze imfundo, futhi sifake izinhlelo ezizohlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ukukhumbula ukuthi abathisha bethu bamele ikusasa lempucuko, kumele sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, sizokwenza imiphakathi yethu ibe nezinselelo ezinzima ezizobangela ukungaphumeleli kwabafundi bethu. Ngakho, asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala namuhla ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle, futhi sithuthukise imfundo ezikoleni zethu.
AmaSotho: Uhlanga Olukhulu Nempilo Yabo Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngifuna ukuxoxa nawe ngamaSotho, lezi zizwe ezinhle ezitholakala eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eLesotho naseMpumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho anemvelaphi ehlukile, futhi bahlala ezindaweni ezithile ezimangalisayo? Ngithanda ukuhamba ngalezi zindawo, ngibona izintaba eziphakeme nezindawo ezinhle ezihlotshiswe ngamaSotho. AmaSotho, mngani, abavela ezweni elibizwa ngeLesotho, elingaphansi kweNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sikhathi esidlule, amaSotho ayengabantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, futhi lokhu kwawenza babe nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zezulu. Kodwa, ngiyavuma, ubuhle bempilo yabo bukhona. Bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo, futhi bahlonipha izinkolelo zabo zendabuko. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho anamasiko amaningi? Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko abo. Isibonelo, umkhosi wabo obizwa ngeMokhotlong, lapho behlangana khona ukuze bagubhe izithelo zomsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomphakathi wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaSotho akhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi ngihamba eLesotho, ngihlangana nomuntu omuhle owayengumSotho. Wakhuluma ngempilo yakhe, wathi: "Siyaziqhenya ngamasiko ethu, futhi sizama ukuwugcina." Lokhu kwangijabulisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi amaSotho abahlala bephila ngamasiko abo, futhi bahlonipha izinkolelo zabo. Ngabe nawe uyavuma ukuthi amasiko abalulekile empilweni yethu? Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaSotho anokudla okumnandi! Ngabe uke wazama 'pap' ne 'samp'? Lokhu kudla kwabo kudla okwenziwe ngempela, futhi kubalulekile emindenini yabo. Ngiyakhumbula lapho ngidla khona, ngizwa umoya omuhle, futhi ngathokozisa umndeni owangemukela. Lokhu kwangikhumbuza ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho banokuthanda okukhulu kwezobuciko? Bakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, futhi bahlala bephila ngezinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba baqonde izimo zezulu, futhi bahlale bejolisa emhlabeni wabo. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukubona abantu bejabulile, futhi amaSotho bahlala bejabulile. Ngokuphathelene nezilimi, amaSotho akhuluma isiSotho, okuyilimi elihle kakhulu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi isiSotho sinezincazelo eziningi ezinhle? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi bahlale bejabulile. Ngiyakhumbula lapho ngizama ukukhuluma isiSotho, ngazama ukufunda amagama ambalwa, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kwangijabulisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu bayakwamukela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaSotho bahlala bephila impilo enobuhlakani. Bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo, futhi bahlala bephila ngezinkolelo zabo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho bahlala bephila ngezinkanyezi? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile, futhi bahlale bejolisa emhlabeni wabo. Ngokuphetha, amaSotho abantu abahle kakhulu, futhi bahlala bejabulile. Bahlonipha amasiko abo, futhi bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukuhamba ezindaweni zabo, futhi ngithanda ukuhlangana nabo. Ngabe nawe uyavuma ukuthi amaSotho bahlala bejabulile? Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, mngani! Ngithemba sizohlangana futhi ukuze sikhulume ngamasiko amahle amaSotho.
Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi Umbuzo 1: Yini ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kusho umuzwa wokukhathazeka, ukudangala, noma ukuncipha kwamandla okubangelwa ukucindezeleka emsebenzini. Abahlengikazi bavame ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwabantu abagulayo, ukunakekela izimo eziphuthumayo, nokusebenza ngezikhathi ezinde, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlala bephapheme futhi benethemba. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela zokukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Izimbangela zokukhathala zibandakanya ukungabi namkhawulo wezinsiza, imfanelo emikhulu yokusebenza, izinsuku ezinde, nokungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula. Abahlengikazi bahlala besebenzisa amandla abo ukuze banakekele iziguli, kodwa lokhu kubangela ukuncipha kwemizwa yokwaneliseka emsebenzini. Ukungabikhona kweziguli eziphilayo, izinkinga zomsebenzi, kanye nezimo ezinzima zokusebenza nazo zenza kube nzima kubahlengikazi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Izimpawu zokukhathala zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zifaka phakathi ukungabi namandla, ukushaywa yikhanda, ukuncipha kokugxila, ukudangala, kanye nokukhathazeka. Abahlengikazi bangase babe nezinselele ezinkulu zokuphatha imizwa yabo, okungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile emsebenzini. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuhlobene nezinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo? Impendulo: Yebo, ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuhambisana kakhulu nezinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Uma abahlengikazi bekhathala, bangezwa sengathi akakwazi ukunikeza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela iziguli. Lokhu kungenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ekwelashweni, okungadala ukuncipha kokwaneliseka kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Umbuzo 5: Yini okungakwenziwa ukunqanda ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqedwe ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuvumela abahlengikazi ukuba bathole izikhala zokuphumula, nokwakha imvelo yokusebenza efaka ukweseka. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo nezifundo zokuphatha ingcindezi kungasiza abahlengikazi ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuze baxhumane kahle, abahlengikazi kufanele bazi ukuthi bakhuluma kanjani ngezinkinga zabo, babonise izifiso zabo, futhi bahlale bexhumana nabaphathi ukuze kudaleke izixazululo. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe izinkinga zokukhathala zingathinta kahle ubudlelwane phakathi kwabahlengikazi nabanye osomabhizinisi? Impendulo: Yebo, izinkinga zokukhathala zingathinta ubudlelwane phakathi kwabahlengikazi nabanye osomabhizinisi. Uma abahlengikazi bekhathala, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuxhumana, ukungaboni ngamehlo, noma ukungaboni kahle izindleko. Lokhu kungaholela kuzo zonke izinkinga emsebenzini, okungathinta kahle ukuphawula kwabahlengikazi neziguli zabo. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungawusekela kanjani abahlengikazi abakhathalayo? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungawusekela abahlengikazi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuphila kahle, nokwakha imikhankaso yokukhuthaza umphakathi mayelana nezinkinga abahlengikazi ababhekana nazo. Ukuphakamisa isithunzi sabahlengikazi nokubadlulisa izwi kungabavikela ekukhathaleni kakhulu. Umbuzo 8: Uyini umthelela wokukhathala kwabahlengikazi empilweni yabo siqu? Impendulo: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo siqu. Lokhu kubandakanya izinkinga zempilo ezibonakaliswa ngokweqile, ezinjengokucindezeleka, ukukhuluphala, nokuncipha kokuzivocavoca. Abahlengikazi abakhathalayo bangase babe nezinkinga emndenini nasemiphakathini yabo, okungabakhathaza kakhulu. Umbuzo 9: Zingaki izinzuzo zokunakekela abahlengikazi ukuze bagweme ukukhathala? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokunakekela abahlengikazi ziningi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwandisa umuzwa wokwaneliseka emsebenzini, nokwandisa umphumela wokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ekugcineni abahlengikazi bephila impilo enempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuthi benze imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Yini okumele ubenze uma ubona abahlengikazi bekhathala? Impendulo: Uma ubona abahlengikazi bekhathala, kubalulekile ukuzama ukubakhuthaza nokubasiza. Ungabakhuthaza ukuba bathathe izikhathi zokuphumula, uqinisekise ukuthi banokuxhumana nabanye, futhi unikeze ukweseka kwengqondo. Ukwenza imikhankaso yokuvuselela imizwa emihle nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enobungane kungasiza kakhulu. Isiphetho: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze siqede lesi simo esinzima, kudingeka ukuba sibe nomoya wokuxhumana, ukusekela, nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enobungani. Abahlengikazi bahlala besebenzisa amandla abo ukuze banakekele abanye, kodwa kumele futhi bazi ukuthi badinga ukunakekelwa nabo ukuze baqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi wabo ophumelelayo.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Isizathu Sokukhathazeka Nokufuna Izixazululo Emphakathini wethu wanamuhla, ukungasebenzi kwentsha sekuba yinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sithokozisa izinsuku zethu, sithola ukuthi inani labantu abasha abathola imisebenzi linciphisa ngokushesha. Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ukungabi namathuba, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wokuphelelwa ithemba phakathi kwentsha yethu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sihlole izimbangela zalokhu, imiphumela yalo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze siphumelele. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde izimbangela eziholela ekungasebenzi kwentsha. Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko ukungabi khona kwemisebenzi eminingi ethokozisayo. Imboni ezithile, ezifana nezobuchwepheshe, ithola ukuthuthuka okukhulu, kodwa imikhakha eminingi iyahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eyanele. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abasha baphenduke bengenamathuba, futhi lokho kudala umuzwa wokuthi baphuma emhlabeni wezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo ezitholakalayo azihlali zifaneleka nezidingo zemakethe. Abantu abasha bahlala besebenzisa isikhathi sabo besenza izifundo, kodwa uma behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi, kubonakala sengathi lezi zifundo azinasidingo. Imiphumela yokungasebenzi kwentsha ibalulekile. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Abantu abasha abangenamsebenzi bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu zempilo yengqondo, okubandakanya ukudangala nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphumelele kancane ezimpilweni zabo, futhi imiphumela ingaba yinde kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungasebenzi kwentsha kudala umphakathi ongenankuthalo. Uma abantu bephila ngaphandle kokusebenza, bahlala bezizwa bengenamandla, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zomphakathi, njengokwehla kwemali engenayo, izinga eliphakeme lokuhlukunyezwa, kanye nokwehla kokwethembeka emiphakathini. Kodwa-ke, akumele siphumelele kuphela ekukhathazekeni ngalezi zinkinga, kodwa kufanele futhi sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa isimo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, nezikhungo zemfundo basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha amakhono ezokuxhumana nezobuchwepheshe zingasiza kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okusebenza. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abasha bathole amathuba okuzithuthukisa. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwenhlalakahle lungasiza ekwakheni amathuba okusebenza, futhi ukuhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuzithuthukisa kungasiza ekwakheni izikhala ezintsha. Abantu abasha bangenza imisebenzi emincane, njengokwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, ukuze bakhe amakhono nezixhumanisi ezidingekayo ukuze bathole imisebenzi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onamandla futhi onokuthula. Ekugcineni, ukungasebenzi kwentsha akuyona nje inkinga yomphakathi, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izixazululo zidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabaholi, izinkampani, nezikhungo zemfundo. Ukuthuthukisa amathuba okusebenza, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezidingo, nokwakha isimo esivumelanayo, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abasha. Ngakho-ke, akumele sithule, kodwa kufanele sibe nomoya ophakeme wokusebenza ndawonye ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sihamba ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelinokuthuthukiswa kwentsha yethu. Lokhu kuzodinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, nokubambisana, kodwa sizokwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngakho-ke, masiqale manje, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu.
Impilo Yengqondo Entsha: Ukubaluleka Kokukhuluma Ngempilo Yengqondo Kwentsha Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile, impilo yengqondo entsheni. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu? Yebo, ngempela! Ngakho, ake siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi yini impilo yengqondo. Impilo yengqondo ibhekisela esimweni sokuba nekhono lokuphila kahle, ukucabanga kahle, nokubhekana nezinselelo zansuku zonke. Kulabo abasha, lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngoba, uma ungaphilile kahle engqondweni, konke okunye kuyoba nzima. Ucabanga kanjani uma uhlala ucindezelekile? Lokhu kungenza ungakwazi ukufunda kahle, ungabi namandla okwenza izinto, futhi ungazizwa ungathokozile. Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kodwa akukhona okukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinto ethinta abantu abadala kuphela, kodwa akunjalo. Izingane, intsha, nabantu abasha badinga ukwazi ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkinga zengqondo zingaqala kusenesikhathi? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ibhekana nezimo eziningi ezinzima, ezifana nokucindezeleka, ukungabi nempumelelo, noma ukungafuni ukujabulisa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto. Uma ungazizwa kahle, ungakhuluma nomngane, umndeni, noma udokotela. Akukhona okubi ekutheni ubonise ukuthi udinga usizo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza kanjani? Lokhu kungenza uzizwe ungcono, futhi ungathola izixazululo ezithile ezinkingeni zakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha kufanele ifunde ukuthi izindlela zokuphila ezinhle zingasiza kakhulu empilweni yengqondo. Ukudla kahle, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphumula kahle kubalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma umzimba wakho uphilile, ingqondo yakho nayo izoba phakeme. Ngakho, zama ukuthola isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, noma ngabe uhamba nje, noma udlala umdlalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ungcono. Futhi, akufanele sikhohlwe ukubaluleka kokuphumula. Ukuphumula akusho ukuthi kufanele uhlale ungasebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula, sokwenza izinto ozithandayo, noma sokuchitha isikhathi nomndeni nabangani. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ujabule, futhi kuzokwenza ingqondo yakho ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukucabanga kahle kungasiza kanjani? Uma ungena ezinkingeni, zama ukucabanga ngezixazululo. Ungazama ukwenza uhlu lwezinto okufanele uzithathe. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe unamandla, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo ezikoleni. Abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele babe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo uma bedinga usizo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu abasha badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkampani zikhathalela impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, impilo yengqondo izoba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto, futhi sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibonise izinkinga zayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Ngokuphetha, impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwentsha. Ngakho, khumbula, akukhona okubi ekutheni ubonise ukuthi udinga usizo. Khuluma nabangani, umndeni, noma udokotela uma uzizwa ungathokozile. Futhi, zama ukuthola izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, ukuze ingqondo yakho ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto zizokwenza ube nempilo yengqondo engcono.
Imililo Yasendle: Umthelela Nezizathu Zokuyivuma Noma Ukuvusa Ukukhathazeka Imililo yasendle iyinselele enkulu emvelweni, futhi ibalulekile ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba, siqonde ukuthi imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emihle nemibi, futhi sithole izindlela zokuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Ukwakhiwa Kwemvelo NokuPhefumla Imililo yasendle ingaqala ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene, njengokushisa kwelanga, imvula encane, noma kwenzeke ngesiphithiphithi somuntu. Nokho, ukuvuma imililo yasendle kungaba nezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, imililo iyasiza ekwakheni isimo esisha somhlaba. Izitshalo ezithile zidinga ukushiswa ukuze zikhule. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukudlula," okwenza izitshalo zibe namandla futhi zibe nekhono lokumelana nezimo eziyingozi. Imililo yasendle futhi ikhulisa ukuhamba komhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezivulekile, lapho izitshalo zishiswa khona. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okukhula kwezinye izitshalo, okwenza kube nezilwane eziningi ezifuna ukudla nemihlambi eyahlukahlukene. Ikakhulukazi, imililo iyasiza ekwandiseni ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane nezitshalo, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisa umphakathi wesimanje. Izingozi Zokunyuka Kwezimililo Noma kunjalo, imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emibi. Ukushiswa kwezindawo eziningi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezilwane eziningi nezitshalo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi umphakathi ophilayo uqhubeke. Njengoba imililo ibalulekile ekwakheni umhlaba, ingabangela ukulahleka kwezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala endaweni ethile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izilwane ezithile zibe sengozini yokulahleka, futhi kungabangela ukuzinza kwezimo ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imililo yasendle ingaphazamisa abantu. Njengoba imililo iqhubeka, ingasiphazamisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala eduze kwemifula noma ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ukushisa okukhulu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemizi, futhi izinkanyezi zomlilo zingaba nezingozi ezinkulu ezinokubangela izikhala ezimbi. Ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokulawula imililo, ezihlanganisa izinyathelo zokubhekelela imvelo nezinqubomgomo zokuphatha izindawo. Ukwamukela Imililo Yasendle NgeZindlela Zokulawula Kunezindlela eziningi zokuphatha imililo yasendle ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Abantu bangaqonda ukuthi imililo iyinsiza elungile futhi ingaba yinsiza ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izindlela zokubhekana nemililo, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokuthola imililo, ukufundisa abantu ngezinzuzo nezingozi, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokulawula imvelo. Ukwamukela imililo yasendle akusho ukuthi kufanele sivumele imililo iqhubeke ngaphandle kokubhekelela. Kunalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokulawula imililo, okuhlanganisa ukulawula izindawo ezithinta kakhulu izilwane nezitshalo. Abantu kumele baqonde ukuthi imililo ingaba yinsiza emvelweni, kodwa kufanele sibe nokubheka okuhlakaniphile ukuze sikwazi ukuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokuhlola Ngokubheka konke lokhu, imililo yasendle iyinselele enkulu esivumelayo ukwakha nokuphila. Kumele sizame ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezihlanganisa izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi, ukuze sithole ukuthi imililo ingaba insiza emvelweni. Ngokufunda, sikwazi ukuthuthukisa ulwazi lwethu nolwazi lwemvelo, siqonde ukuthi imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sivimbele izingozi. Ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle ekuphathweni kwemvelo, sizodinga ukuhlola izindlela ezithile zokuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imililo yasendle ithathwa ngendlela efanele.
Ukudla Kwesintu: Ukuvuselela Isiko Nokuqinisa Ubudlelwano Ezimweni zansuku zonke, ukudla kwesintu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukudla akusikho kuphela ukudla; kuyisiko, indlela yokuphila, futhi kuyindlela yokuxhumana. Ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, ukudla kwesintu kuhlanganisa izithako ezivela emvelweni, izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokupheka, kanye nemikhuba ethile ethinta izikhathi ezithile zonyaka. Izithako Zokudla Kwasendulo Izithako ezisetshenziswa ekudleni kwesintu zihluke kakhulu, zixhomeke endaweni, isimo sezulu, kanye namasiko abantu. Ezinye zezithako ezivamile zifaka ufulawa, imifino, inyama, nezithelo. Ngokwesibonelo, eNingizimu Afrika, amafutha e-olive, u-anyanisi, ne-garlic zisetshenziswa kakhulu, kanti imifino efana ne-spinach, u-cabbage, kanye ne-butternut ibalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Izindlela Zokupheka Izindlela zokupheka zihluke kakhulu phakathi kwezizwe nezindawo. Abantu abaningi basakaza izindlela zokupheka ezivela kumagugu abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezizukulwane. Ukupheka okuthandwayo kufaka phakathi ukujova, ukuvuthela, nokupheka emlilweni. Lokhu kudala ukudla okunempilo, okuthokozisayo, futhi okukhumbulekayo. Isibonelo, ukujova inyama, okwaziwa ngokuthi "braai," akusizi nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kudala ithuba lokuhlangana, ukuhlekisa, nokuxoxa. Ukudla Njengomgogodla Wesiko Ukudla kwesintu akugcini nje ngokuba ukudla; kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isiko. Izikhathi ezithile zonyaka, njengezinkanyezi, imishado, kanye nemikhosi, zihlala zixhumene nokudla. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuhlangana, lapho imindeni ihlanganyela khona ukudla, izinkumbulo, kanye nezindaba. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkumbulo zihlala zikhona. Ukudla Kwasendulo Nezinguquko Zamanje Nokho, ukudla kwesintu kuhamba phambili nezinguquko zamanje. Njengoba abantu behamba phambili, izindlela zokupheka nezithako ziyaqhubeka nokuguquka. Abantu abaningi baphendukela ekudleni okunempilo, okwenziwe ngezithako ezivela emvelweni, okukhuthaza impilo enhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izitolo zokudla ziqhakambise izithako ezivela ezindaweni zasendulo, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ekudleni kwesintu. Ukubaluleka Kokugcina Isiko Kubantu abaningi, ukudla kwesintu kubalulekile ekugcineni isiko. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo ziyaqhubeka nokuhlonipha imikhuba yethu, kubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zethu ngezindlela zokupheka, izithako, kanye nezikhathi ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, kanti futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izinkumbulo zethu zihlala zikhona. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukudla kwesintu kuqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, isiko, kanye nendlela yokuxhumana. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlangana, sabelana ngezinkumbulo, futhi sikhumbula izimpilo zethu, kudinga ukuthi sihloniphe futhi sigcine ukudla kwesintu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu. Ukudla kwesintu akusizi nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi.
Imali Yokufunda: Ukubhekisisa Kwethu Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Ngicela sikhulume ngendaba emqoka, okuyi-imali yokufunda, noma ngezinye izikhathi sithi "tuition fees." Njengoba sikhuluma, sithola ukuthi le mali ingaba yinkinga enkulu kubafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela emindenini engatholi kahle. Kukhona umqondo ophawulekayo lapha: uma uthanda ukufunda, kufanele ube nezezimali ezithile. Kodwa ke, asikufuni ukukhalaza, ngoba sinesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Ngicela ukucacisa kancane: imali yokufunda iyinqubo yokukhokha ukuze ufinyelele ezikhungweni zemfundo, izikhungo zesayensi, nezinye izindawo zokufunda. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuzosiza abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olufanele, balungiselele ikusasa labo. Manje, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi, empeleni, imali yokufunda ingahluka kakhulu. Kunezikhungo ezihlukahlukene eziphethe izimali ezahlukene. Uma sithanda ukukhuluma ngama-universities, imvamisa, izikhungo eziphezulu zinezindleko eziphezulu. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubafundi abavela emindenini engenamali. Ngabe ubona kahle? Ukuze uthole iziqu, udinga ukukhokha le mali, kodwa uma ungakukwazi, kanjani? Ngalesi sikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngenketho yokuxhaswa. Kukho izinhlelo eziningi zokweseka abafundi, ezifana neziqinisekiso, ama-bursaries, nezinhlelo zokubolekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abanye abafundi bakwazi ukuthola izikhwama zokufunda ezikhokhelwa uhulumeni? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kuphonsa umphakathi emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izinga lemfundo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bangenza izinqumo ezinhle, baqhubeke nezifundo zabo, futhi baqonde ukuphila kwabo. Ngabe uhambisani nami? Lokhu kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemfundo. Uma sikhuluma ngama-universities, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo ayiyona nje imali yokufunda kuphela. Iphinde ibandakanye izindleko zempilo, ukudla, nezindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ubheka imali yokufunda, kufanele ubala konke okunye okuthinta impilo yakho esikhathini eside. Futhi, akusizi noma ubani osola ukuthi lezi zindleko zikhuphuka kakhulu. Ngabe ubona lokho? Njengoba iminyaka idlula, izindleko ziya zikhula, futhi lokhu kudinga abantu ukuba babe necebo elihle. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi kubafundi abasha, abavela ezindaweni eziphansi. Kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi imfundo iyigugu, kodwa kufanele sibe nesikhathi sokuhlola izinketho zethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi kunezikhungo ezithile eziphakela izifundo ezibiza kancane. Lokhu kuyathandeka uma ungathanda ukufunda, kodwa ungafuni ukuchitha imali eningi. Unendawo yokufuna, futhi ngicela ungakhalazi kakhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zithi uma ungenayo imali yokufunda, ungase uthole izinketho ezinhle. Kukhona imithombo eminingi yokuxhaswa, kufaka phakathi abaxhasi bezemfundo, abezimali, nabanye. Ngakho, mngani, uma uhambisana nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ungavula amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nezifundo zakho. Ngabe ubona izinto zishintsha? Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukusebenzisana nezinye izikhungo, kubalulekile. Uma ufisa ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi, ungathola izindlela zokuthola imali yokufunda ngendlela ewusizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akusikho konke okungabizwa ngempumelelo. Ukufunda akusikhona nje ukuthola iziqu, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuthola ulwazi. Ngabe ubona? Ukuze uthole ulwazi olufanele, kufanele udinge izindlela zokuxhaswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nezifundo zakho. Ngokugcina, mngani, ngiyakholwa ukuthi kufanele sibe nomqondo omuhle mayelana nemali yokufunda. Lokhu akusikhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuhlobene kakhulu nezifundo. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imfundo ingatholakali, sizokwehla. Ngakho, kufanele sikhulume, sabelane ngolwazi, futhi sibe nomoya wokuxhasana. Umphakathi kufanele uvule izindlela ukuze abafundi baphumelele. Ngakho, sikhuluma ngezindleko, izinketho, nezindlela zokuxhaswa. Ngabe ubona ukuthi kunokukhanya ekugcineni? Kukhona umphakathi ogxile ekuhleleni, futhi uma sihlanganyela, singaba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha, mngani, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi sizophumelela ndawonye. Uhlungwini, qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungavumi!
Ezokwakhiwa Kwengqalasizinda: Umgomo Wokuthuthukisa Izwe Ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda ziwumgomo obalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Zihlanganisa zonke izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuphucula, nokugcina izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezindlela, izibhedlela, izikole, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ukuze izwe lithuthuke, kubalulekile ukuba nezingqalasizinda ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, okukhula komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Ngokokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izinga lokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda lincike kakhulu ekubeni khona kwemithombo yezimali. Izwe elinokuphila kahle, elinokuthuthukiswa kwezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda, kudinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuhlelekile. Lokhu kuxhaswa kungavela kuhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, noma ngisho nezikhungo zamazwe ngamazwe. Ukuze sithuthukise izinsiza, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zimali, ukuze zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Okwesibili, ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Izindlela ezinhle, izikhungo zemfundo, nezibhedlela zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uma abantu bekhululekile ukuhamba, benza izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezincane, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo ezithuthukisiwe zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, zifundisa abantu amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Okwesithathu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda kufanele zibe nezinhloso eziphusile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele kube khona ukwakhiwa okungahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele ziqhutshekwe ngemibono yokuthuthukisa izindawo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda kufanele zibe nezindlela eziphusile zokuphatha imvelo. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinsiza, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo yethu iyagcinwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela izinsiza zethu zemvelo, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, izinhlelo zokwakhiwa kumele zibe nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela wazo emvelweni, ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ekugcineni, ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukuze sithuthukise izwe, kufanele sigxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu, zikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha ziqhutshekwe ngendlela ehloniphekile, ngokuhlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi zibe nezinhloso eziphusile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wezwe. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni nokwakha ingqalasizinda ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo, ukuze sibe nezwe eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuthi sonke sithole impilo engcono, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokwakha ingqalasizinda alupheli nje emsebenzini, kodwa luhlanganisa izifiso, amaphupho, nezidingo zethu njengabantu. Ngakho-ke, asibambeni ndawonye, sithuthukise izwe lethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nenkinga enkulu yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlobene nezimo eziningi ezithinta umnotho, okuhlanganisa ukwanda kwentengo yezimpahla, izindleko zokuthutha, kanye nezindleko zokuhlala. Lokhu kukhuphuka kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yansuku zonke yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izindleko zokuphila zikhuphuka kanjani. Izinto ezilula ezifana nokudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza zansuku zonke zikhuphuke kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokukhiqiza, okukhuluma ngezindleko zokuthola izinto ezisemqoka, kanye nezindleko zokuhamba. Izinkampani eziningi zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhokha kakhulu ukuze zithole izinto ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kudlulisela kumakhasimende, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhlala nazo zikhuphuke. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala ezindlini, kufanele bakhokhe imali eningi, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abangenamali eningi. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba abantu abaningi bephoqwa ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezingezinhle noma bahlale emakhaya amakhulu, okungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Ngokubheka izimo zomnotho, izinkampani zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhathazekile ngalesi simo. Abantu abaningi baphendula ngokunciphisa izindleko zabo, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuthengwa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba zidinga ukuthola izindlela zokugcina izindleko ziphansi, kodwa futhi zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhathazekile ngalesi simo. Abantu abaningi baphendula ngokunciphisa izindleko zabo, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuthengwa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba zidinga ukuthola izindlela zokugcina izindleko ziphansi, kodwa futhi zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle kumakhasimende. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqala ukujwayela lezi zinguquko, kodwa lokhu akukwenzi kube lula. Abantu badinga ukucabanga ngamasu amasha ukuze baphile kahle. Lokhu kuhilela ukufunda ukuhlela kahle izimali, ukunciphisa izindleko ezingadingekile, nokufuna izindlela zokuthola imali eyengeziwe. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuphatha izimali, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukulawula izindleko zabo. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole usizo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo zikhona, futhi abantu kufanele bazisebenzise ukuze bathole usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokudla, izinhlelo zokuhlala, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokuxhasa abanye, ukuze bonke bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinselele enkulu, kodwa akumele kube yinto engapheli. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokubambisana, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukucabanga, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi singenza umehluko uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho-ke, masibambisane ukuze sithole izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, futhi sithuthukise impilo yethu sonke.
Ifilimu - Ihlanganyela Emhlabeni Wethu Okwamanje, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, akufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ifilimu yindawo ethokozisayo lapho imicabango, imizwa, nemibono ihlangana khona. Ngiyakhumbula ngesikhathi ngibona ifilimu yami yokuqala, ngabe sengizizwa ngizungezwe yizwe elisha, imisebenzi, nemigudu ethokozisayo. Lokhu kunika umuntu ithuba lokuphuma empilweni yabo yansuku zonke, kube ukufaka incwadi embhalweni ebhalwe ngefoni. Kukhona okuthile ngefilimu eyenza kube lula ukuyithanda. Kukhona labo abahamba beyiseka, benza izibopho nemicabango mayelana nezindaba ezahlukene. Ukukwazi ukufaka izinga lesimo sokukhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ifilimu ayigcini nje ngokuba yinto yokubhiyozela, kodwa iyinqwaba yezimvo ezenzakalayo. Kungaba ukuthi ibonisa imizwelo, izinselelo, noma izifundo ezibalulekile empilweni yethu. Kunezikhathi lapho ifilimu ibamba izimpilo zethu, ikakhulukazi uma ifilimu ithinta izihloko esizijabulele. Njengomuntu ofisa ukufunda ngemikhiqizo emihle yokubhala, ngizwa ukuthi ifilimu iyindlela enhle yokucubungula izindaba. Ithokozisa futhi imnandi, ifaka umqondo wokwazisa ngobumu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ifilimu ivumela abaculi ukuthi babelane namakhono abo, eqondise emphakathini, lapho kwenziwa khona ukuxoxa izindaba ezithinta njengezothando, ubudlelwano, nobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Akukaze kube nzima ukuxoxa ngezinto ezibuhlungu kodwa zibalulekile empilweni. Ubadlali bethu, noma amaqhawe ethu, baveza izimfundiso ezinkulu, kanti lokho kuhlobene nangendlela abahamba ngayo kulezi zinsuku. Abadlalayo banika ubuchwepheshe obujulile kwazulu ukuze sikwazi ukuzwisisa imizwa, izinselelo nezincwadi ezihlobene. Umdlalo ungase ube nzima, kodwa ukuhamba phakathi kwenhlekelele kuyasithokozisa, kusikhumbuza ukusinda. Ngokuqinisekile, uma senza umqondo wokuhlaziya ifilimu, sizobona izindima ezihlukene zokuphila. Okwanda kwandi, izindawo ezisobala, nezimo zomphakathi – konke kuveza uhlobo oluthile lokuphila, okuyinto edingekayo ukuze sikhulume. Abalandi bembula izimo, kanti ifilimu iyakwazi ukuveza umbono othokozisayo, umnco, nomcabango ophosisiwe. Kodwa, asikhumbuli ukuthi ifilimu akukhona kuphela okwenzeka esikrinini; kusukela kuqhamuka ucingo oludingekayo kokuthile okufanayo, kuveza ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi komphakathi. Ngenhliziyo, imizwa ixhumana, nobudlelwano bukhazimulisa. Abadingi bethu bangavela ezimweni ezahlukene, kodwa nabaphi emhlabeni bahlala behlaselwa yizimo zempilo. Kubantu abakhumbulayo, ifilimu iyindlela yokuzihlanganisa. Ngaphandle kokukhumbula, sikhumbula ukuthinta kwethu. Imininingwane ibonakala, izinhlelo zingavela uma abanye bephila. Njengoba sikhuluma ngabo, sizoba nabantu abanokukhumbula, abahlangene empilweni ezinzima. Lokhu kugcizelela umbono wokuhlobisa umkhawulo, sidinga ukuqonda lokhu. Ngaphambi kokuba sihambe, khona-ke, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi uma ifilimu iboniswa, impilo iphenduka, icacile futhi ibonisa umbono. Uma sizama ukudlula, sizobona ukuthi uma sikhuluma, sizoba nokudlula kumimbo. Ngaphandle kwezinsuku eziminabili ukuze ungayibonisi ifilimu, somlomo, ibalulekile, iyafundwa, ikhuthaza futhi ibalulekile ukuze sifeze umphakathi. Ngakho, ngizokhuluma kuphela ngendlela ifilimu ibonisa ngayo. Njengoba sisiba nefula, sithola izibonelo ezilula ezidingekayo ukuze sakhe izinyathelo ezinzima. Ngisho, ukuhambahamba kubalulekile, okwenza ifilimu iyinqaba yokwazi. Iqala ngezinyathelo eziphakeme, ikhathele, ithule, kodwa ayifuni ukukhumbuza. Ngemali, zingaba ukushaya izinyathelo, nakuhtse, sizokwazi ukuqonda nezinto ezilungile. Ngalokhu, ngiyabonga, futhi umhlaba wethu unendlela ehluke ngendlela ifilimu iba khona. Ngempela, ifilimu iyisikhumbuzo esiwusizo sokuhamba phambili, ngemibono, izimoto, nemicabango ehambelanayo. Ngakho, abantu, bazi ukuthi uma ufisa ukusizakala, ukuqonda ifilimu kuyaphumelela, sidlule lapho ukwazi ukuhlola. Lokhu kuzokwenza ezinye izinyathelo, ukuze sikhumbule kabusha, sithathe imikhiqizo emisha yokukhumbula. Kuzocacisa kwesikhashana, ifilimu ibalulekile ukudlulisa umlayezo, ikhethiwe phakathi kwalesi sikhathi eside. Hamba uyodlula, uphinde ube ngumuntu ophumelelayo. Futhi kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi ifilimu ingathokozisa noma ikhulume ngemizwa eyahluka phakathi kwezikhathi. Ibhizinisi lidinga izinyathelo, kuningi okuthokozisayo okubhalwe – ifilimu isiyindawo yokwakha, okwenza kube nomuzwa endabeni yokukhuluma. Ngakho-ke, baphila, amakhono kufuneka ahanjiswe phambili, nefilimu ibonise umncintiswano ophumile. Kukhona ukuvusa emhlabeni wakho. Ngithanda ifilimu. Wena?
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi edlule, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Enye yezinguquko ezibaluleke kakhulu kube ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, okwenze izimpilo zabantu zashintsha kakhulu. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikagesi, kuze kube sekutholakaleni kagesi emakhaya. Ekuqaleni, emakhaya amaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuntuleka kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhekene nezindlela zendabuko zokukhanyisa, njengezibani ezisebenzisa amafutha, okwakwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokukhanya. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale besebenzisa izindlela ezithile zokuphila, ezazivame ukuba nzima futhi zidinga isikhathi esiningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eminyakeni yama-1900, izinkampani zokuqala zikagesi zaqala ukuvela, ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, kodwa kwaba nezithiyo eziningi. Izindleko zokufaka ugesi emakhaya zaziphezulu, futhi abantu abaningi babengenakukwazi ukukhokhela lezi zindleko. Ngaleso sikhathi, ugesi wawungatholakali kalula, futhi abantu abaningi babengakaze bakwazi ukuwusebenzisa. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zikagesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavula amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, njengokuhweba, ezemfundo, nezokwelapha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze bakhe izindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, futhi izimpilo zabo zashintsha kakhulu. Izibani zikagesi zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinto eziningi ezisebenzisa ugesi, njengezinto zokupheka, izinsiza zokuhlala, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokutholakala kwemisebenzi, njengoba abantu beqala ukwakha amabhizinisi amancane asebenzisa ugesi. Nokho, nakuba ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kwaba nezinzuzo eziningi, kwavela nezinselelo. Izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zashintsha, futhi abantu abaninzi babebhekene nezinkinga zokukhokha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokunciphisa lezi zindleko, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kagesi kalula. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude. Namuhla, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekuyinto ejwayelekile, futhi abantu abaningi baphila impilo engcono ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izimpilo zabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akukona nje kuphela ukwakha izindawo ezinhle, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngakho-ke, le ndaba yokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya ibalulekile, njengoba ibonisa indlela abantu abashintshile ngayo impilo yabo ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokwakha izimpilo ezinhle, bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Uhlanga lwethu lwenziwa ngezindlela eziningi zokufunda, futhi namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile – ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Ukuze sithole umbono ophusile, sithintane noMnu. Thabo Mthethwa, ongumfundisi ophumelele, futhi usebenzisa izinkundla ze-inthanethi ukuze afundise abafundi bakhe. Ingxenye 2: Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi Mnu. Mthethwa, ngingathanda ukwazi ukuthi yini eyenza ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube yindlela efanele yokufunda? “Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza abafundi ithuba lokufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezincwadi, amavidiyo, nezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufunda, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezibopho eziningi.” Ingxenye 3: Izinsiza Zokufunda Ngabe ungabelana ngezinsiza ezithile ozisebenzisayo ukuze uthuthukise ukufunda kwe-inthanethi? “Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo. Ngithanda ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-Khan Academy, Coursera, ne-EdX. Lezi zinkundla ziqukethe izifundo ezilungiselelwe kahle, ezivela ezikhungweni ezihlonishwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-YouTube, lapho ngithola khona amavidiyo ahlukahlukene anikeza izifundo ezithile.” Ingxenye 4: Izinselelo Zokufunda Nge-Inthanethi Kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokufunda nge-inthanethi, akunjalo? “Yebo, kunjalo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuzibophezela. Abafundi bangathola kube nzima ukuzigcina bephokophele ekufundeni, ngoba akukho msebenzi ophathekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuxhumana, njengokungabi ne-inthanethi esheshayo noma izinsiza ezikude, zingaba yinkinga enkulu.” Ingxenye 5: Ukubaluleka Kwezifundo Ezihlanganayo Ngabe ucabangani ngokuqhathanisa ukufunda nge-inthanethi nezifundo zendabuko? “Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela ehlukile, kodwa akukwazi ukwehlisa ukubaluleka kwezifundo zendabuko.
