Zombili zinezinzuzo zazo. Izifundo zendabuko zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nothisha, kuyilapho ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa lezi zindlela ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubhekisisa Ikusasa Lokufunda Nge-Inthanethi Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda nge-inthanethi liza kanjani? “Ngikholelwa ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda nge-inthanethi lizoba nempumelelo enkulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokufunda ezitholakala. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda kube lula nakakhulu, futhi kuzokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi emhlabeni jikelele.” Ingxenye 7: Isiphetho Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngombono wakho ngale ndaba ebalulekile. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela eguquguqukayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokufunda ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kufanele siqhubeke sithuthukisa izindlela zethu zokufunda, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akusiyo nje indlela yokufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okukhula kwabafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithuthukisa lezi zindlela, ukuze siphumelele emhlabeni osashintsha njalo.
Ukubhukuda: Umsebenzi Wokuzijabulisa Nempilo Ukubhukuda, njengomsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, ungomunye wemisebenzi ethokozisayo kakhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kokuba yindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, kuyindlela yokugcina impilo kanye nokuthola injabulo emanzini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo zokubhukuda, izindlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe uma uhamba emanzini. Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ukubhukuda kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi empilweni. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomzimba. Ukubhukuda kusebenzelana nawo wonke amathambo nemisipha, okwenza kube umthombo omuhle wokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni amandla, kuthuthukise ukuhamba, futhi kunciphise ubungozi bezifo ezihlobene nomzimba, njengezinkinga zokukhuluphala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubhukuda kuyindlela ethokozisa yokwehlisa ingcindezi. Ukubhukuda emanzini kukhuthaza umuzwa wokukhululeka, njengoba amanzi enza kube lula ukuhamba. Lokhu kunciphisa ingcindezi engokwengqondo, kukhulisa imizwa yokujabula, futhi kunceda ekuthuthukiseni isimo sengqondo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezwa ukuthi ukubhukuda kubasiza ukuba baphumule futhi bakhumbule izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izindlela Zokubhukuda Kunezindlela eziningi zokubhukuda, futhi ngayinye inezinzuzo zayo. Isitayela sokuqala esidumile yisigubhu (freestyle), esivame ukusetshenziswa emiqhudelwaneni. Lesi sitayela sithathwa njengokubhukuda okusheshayo, futhi sithuthukisa amandla okukhuphuka. Ababukeli baziwa ngokuthi balungiselela izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Okwesibili, sinesigubhu se-backstroke, lapho umgibeli ebhukuda ngemuva. Lokhu kuvumela umgibeli ukuba abheke phezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuphefumula. Lesi sitayela sithuthukisa amandla emuva, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu abathandi bokubhukuda. Isigubhu se-breaststroke, esithathwa njengokubhukuda okuphakathi, sithokozisa kakhulu abaqalayo. Lesi sitayela sikhuthaza ukugxila ekuphefumleni nasekugcineni umgibeli eqinile. Okokugcina, sinesigubhu se-butterfly, esiyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Lesi sitayela sidinga amandla amakhulu, futhi sithuthukisa ukuhamba komzimba. Ababukeli abavame ukukhetha lesi sitayela uma befuna ukwakha amandla nokuphumelela emiqhudelwaneni. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokucabangela Noma ngabe ubhukuda emanzini, kunezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufunda izisekelo zokubhukuda ngaphambi kokungena emanzini. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda izindlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda. Abafundisi bebhukuda bahlala bekhona ukuze banikeze usizo, futhi kubalulekile ukulandela imiyalelo yabo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukwazi izimo zamanzi. Ukuze ubhukude ngokuphepha, kufanele uqonde izimo zamanzi, njengezikhukhula, izigameko ezimbi, noma izindawo ezinzima. Ukubhukuda endaweni ephephile kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokugcina impilo yakho. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa impahla efanele. Ukugqoka izingubo zokubhukuda ezifanele kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba emanzini. Futhi, ukusebenzisa izibuko zokubhukuda kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona, ikakhulukazi uma ubhukuda emanzini anokukhanya okukhulu. Isiphetho Ukubhukuda akuwona nje umsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo. Izinzuzo zokubhukuda zikhuluma ngokwakha impilo engcono, ukunciphisa ingcindezi, nokuthuthukisa isimo sengqondo. Ngendlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda, wonke umuntu angathola isitayela esihambelana nezidingo zabo. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze uzame ukubhukuda, thola isikhathi sokwenza lokho. Hamba emanzini, ujabulele, futhi uthole izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukubhukuda akuyona nje indlela yokuzivocavoca, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo, ethokozisayo, futhi egcwele injabulo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvela Kwephupho Kwaze kwava emhlabeni, uSteve Jobs, indoda enezifiso ezinkulu, wayehamba ngezinyathelo zokwakha okuthile okwakuzoshintsha impilo yabantu. Ngemva kokuchitha izinyanga eziningi nocwaningo, kudalwe umkhiqizo owaziwa kakhulu — i-iPhone. Isizathu sokuba sithakazelise kangaka besingekho nje kuphela ukuthi sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi sisenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Isahluko 2: Ukuhlangana Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngesikhathi umkhiqizo uphume, abantu babeyithokozisa ngendlela eyahlukene. Ngaphambi kokuba i-iPhone ivele, abantu babejwayele ukusebenzisa amafoni ahlakaniphile, kodwa ayenokuthile okungahambisani nezinselelo zansuku zonke. I-iPhone yathi ithokozisa, ikhulisa umqondo wokuqhubeka nokuxhumana. Ngengxenye yayo enhle, umuntu wayengathola imiyalezo, izithombe, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezahlukene, konke okukhuluma ngale foni. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlola Izici Njengoba abantu bezama le foni, kweza nabantu abaninzi ababephikisa umbono wokuthi lokhu kuzoba umphumela omuhle empilweni yabo. Kodwa abanye babebona ukuthi le foni inikela ngezinto ezinhle — ukusakaza izithombe, ukuhambisa imiyalezo, nokuxhumanisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Kukhona owabevele esebenzisa i-iPhone yakhe njengephephandaba, abanye bebukele amafilimu, kanti abanye besebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze bazithuthukise. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga Lwenkululeko Ngonyaka wesibili, i-iPhone yathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Kwavela amafoni anemibala ehlukene, izinqubo ezithuthukisiwe, nezinhlobonhlobo zezici ezazenza kube lula kubantu. Kwaba nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezazizama ukuhlola umhlaba, ukusiza abantu ukuba babe nolwazi olukhululekile. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenzisa le foni, baqala ukuthola ukuthi i-iPhone ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yabo, yaze yabavumela ukuba bahlale bexhumene nezinye izwe. Isahluko 5: Imiphumela Emihle Eminyakeni eyalandela, i-iPhone yahlanganisa abantu emhlabeni wonke. Ngaphakathi kwamashumi eminyaka, kwasungulwa amaqembu oxhumana nabo, izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-iPhone ukwenza umsebenzi wazo, nezinhlelo ezahlukene ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu. Kwavela umqondo ophusile wokuthi abantu bangenza izinto ezinkulu uma bexhumene, futhi i-iPhone yayingumgogodla walokho. Isahluko 6: Izinkinga Nezinselelo Nokho, njengoba konke kusebenza kahle, kwavela nezinselelo. Abanye abantu baqala ukujwayela ukusebenzisa i-iPhone ukuba kube yinto ebonakalayo, okwadala izinkinga zokuxhumana. Ukuphila kwaba sesimeni sokukhathazeka, abantu bephuma endleleni ngenxa yokugxila kakhulu kumafoni. Lokhu kwaveza imiphumela engafanele, futhi kwaba nesidingo sokubiza abantu ukuthi baphinde bacabangele umqondo wokubambisana. Isahluko 7: Ukubhekisela Esikhathini Esizayo Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, i-iPhone yahamba ngaphesheya kokulindelwe. Izinqumo eziningi zenzeka, kodwa i-iPhone iyahlala ibalulekile. Ubuza abantu abaningi, "Ucabanga ukuthi i-iPhone izokwenza ini esikhathini esizayo?" Impendulo ibonisa ukuthi abantu bakholwa ukuthi i-iPhone izoba nezici ezintsha ezizoshintsha impilo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, kanti ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Isahluko 8: Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-iPhone ithole izimfanelo eziningi, kodwa okwakubaluleke kakhulu wukuthi yenza abantu baxhumane. Yashintsha indlela yokuphila, futhi izothinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Yize izinselelo zikhona, abantu bahlala bejabule ngalokho i-iPhone abakutholile. Le foni ayisiyona nje into yokuxhumana, kodwa iyinsika yokuphila, ithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwenza i-iPhone ibe yisimanga esibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ngalesi sikhathi, sinethemba lokuthi i-iPhone izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi igcine ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Ngakho-ke, silindele ukuthola okuthile okusha, okwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho i-iPhone izoba khona, isiza abantu baphile impilo engcono.
Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhukhula? Izikhukhula zenzeka lapho izinga lamanzi emifuleni, ezilwandle, noma emathafeni liphakama kakhulu, kudala ukuwa kwamanzi emhlabeni. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukuna kwemvula, ukuncipha kwemvelo, noma izimo zezulu ezinzima. KwaZulu-Natal, izikhukhula zenzeka kaningi ngenxa yemvula enkulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala zonyaka. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu ezibangela izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal zidalwa yizimo eziningi. Okokuqala, imvula enkulu engapheli, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, ibalulekile. Okwesibili, izindawo ezinamathafa amakhulu nezintaba zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwamanzi, okungaholela ekwakhekeni kwezikhukhula. Okwesithathu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, njengokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo nezakhiwo, kunciphisa amandla emvelo okuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 3: Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinjani? Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinzima. Zingenza umonakalo omkhulu emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini. Abantu bangaphila engozini, futhi izimpahla zabo zingonakaliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zingaholela ekupheleni kwemithombo yokuphila, njengamanzi nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinzima zomnotho, njengoba imisebenzi ithinteka kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni? Ukuze kuvikwe abantu ezikhukhuleni, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezikhukhuleni, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu kufanele baqeqeshelwe izindlela zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa umphakathi ngezikhathi zokukhukhula. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni? Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu babe nolwazi ngezingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza imihlangano yokwazisa, ukwakha amaqembu okusebenza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqubomgomo zokuphila eziphephile, futhi uthumele izixwayiso uma kunemvula enkulu. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuhlale kuqinisekiswa ukuvikeleka kwabantu? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele kubalulekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezimo zezulu, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphendula, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela umonakalo omkhulu. Umbuzo 7: Yini engakwenziwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula? Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinqwaba zamanzi, ukulawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulawulwa kwemvula. Ukuthuthukisa imvelo, njengokutshala izihlahla, kubalulekile, njengoba izihlahla zinciphisa ukuhamba kwamanzi. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu abavame ukuhamba emikhakheni ethile, futhi izikhukhula zingabavimbela ekutholeni izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, okuthinta umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishintsha umqondo wabantu mayelana nezindawo abahlala kuzo, njengoba bezokwenza izinqumo ezinzima uma kuziwa ekukhetheni izindawo zokuhlala. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa nguhulumeni? Uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze avikele abantu ezikhukhuleni. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Umphakathi kufanele ubambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal? Ngokubona kwami, ikusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal linokukhanya. Uma abantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele bamba iqhaza, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezikhukhula. Ukukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokwakha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni ezizayo. Ubufakazi bokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nabaholi bukhombisa ukuthi singakwazi ukwakha indawo ephephile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhukhula zingathinti impilo yethu ngendlela engafanele. Ngale ndlela, singenza kube lula ukuhlala kahle KwaZulu-Natal.
U-Elon Musk: Umholi Wezobuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Zomhlaba U-Elon Musk ungomunye wabantu abavelele emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe namuhla. Uzalelwe ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika, ngo-28 kuNhlangulana 1971. Wakhula enothando lwezifundo, ikakhulukazi ezimayini, ubuchwepheshe, nezincwadi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePretoria, wathuthela e-United States ukuze aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePennsylvania, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBSc kwi-Physics kanye neBSc kwi-Economics. Ngemva kokuphothula, u-Elon Musk waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngo-1995, waqala inkampani yakhe yokuqala, i-Zip2, eyasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi akhe amawebhusayithi. Le nkampani yakhula ngokushesha, futhi ngo-1999, u-Musk wayesekwazi ukuyithengisa ngo-$307 million, okuyimpumelelo yokuqala yakhe. Ngemva kokuphumelela ku-Zip2, u-Elon Musk waqhubeka nesinyathelo esikhulu sokwakha i-PayPal, eyaziwa ngaphambilini njenge-Confinity. I-PayPal yathuthukisa indlela yokukhokha ku-inthanethi, yenza kube lula ukuhweba online. Ngo-2002, i-eBay ithenge i-PayPal ngo-$1.5 billion, futhi u-Musk wathola ingxenye enkulu yale mali. U-Elon Musk akazange ame lapho; waqala izinkampani eziningi ezinomthelela emhlabeni. Enye yezinkampani zakhe ezaziwayo yi-SpaceX, eyasungulwa ngo-2002, enhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo zokuhamba emkhathini. I-SpaceX yaphumelela ekwakheni imikhumbi emisha, efana ne-Falcon 1, i-Falcon 9, kanye ne-Dragon, eyasiza ekuthumeleni abantu nezimpahla emkhathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-Elon Musk waqala i-Tesla Motors ngo-2003, enhloso yokwakha izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla elanga. I-Tesla yaphumelela ekwakheni izimoto eziphakeme, ezifana ne-Tesla Model S, Model 3, Model X, kanye ne-Model Y. U-Musk uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bezimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, futhi i-Tesla yaba yinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni. U-Elon Musk unomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ngonyaka ka-2016, waqala i-Neuralink, inkampani ehlose ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe be-computer nekhanda lomuntu, ukuze kusizwe abantu abanezinkinga zempilo. Uphinde wathuthukisa i-SolarCity, eyasungulwa ngo-2006, enhloso yokwakha izixazululo zamandla elanga. U-Musk ukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise amandla avuselelekayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa kwamandla angavuseleleki. U-Elon Musk ungumuntu ophokophele phambili, okhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngale kokukhona, futhi uhlosile ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu zomhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu, ukuntuleka kwamandla, nokungcoliswa komoya. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi yakhe, u-Elon Musk ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphila. Ubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma abantu benza izinqumo ezinhle. U-Elon Musk ubonakale engumholi onomthelela, futhi izinkampani zakhe zibe nemiphumela emihle emhlabeni. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngothando, ukuzinikela, kanye nokukholelwa ekubeni khona kwezinto ezinhle. U-Elon Musk ungumfanekiso wokukhuthazela, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, ungashintsha umhlaba. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akufanele kube kuphela ngempumelelo yezimali, kodwa kufanele kube nokuhlomula komphakathi. Lokhu kwenza u-Elon Musk abe ngumholi ophakeme, owaziwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi ohlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Osomabhizinisi: Umsebenzi Ohlukile Olwenziwa Ngonembeza Osomabhizinisi, noma abakwa-entrepreneurs, bahlala beziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo kanye nomsebenzi abakwenza. Lezi zikhala zikhomba abantu abanolwazi oluthile, abanamandla okwenza izinqumo ezinkulu, futhi abakhathazeki ngemiphumela. Kulezi zinsuku, osomabhizinisi baphinde baba nezibopho eziningi, njengoba besebenza emhlabeni obalulekile kakhulu, lokhu kudinga ubuchule, ukuzinikela, nokuhlakanipha. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngalesi sikhala, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ubani osomabhizinisi. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi osomabhizinisi bayabhalisela imisebenzi ethile yokwenza imali, kodwa empeleni, lo msebenzi uhamba phambili. Abantu abanjengoSteve Jobs no-Elon Musk baveza ukuthi osomabhizinisi akukhona nje ukuvula ibhizinisi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukusebenza njengosomabhizinisi kudinga ubuhlakani bokukhiqiza amasu amasha, ukwakha izixazululo ezintsha, nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezingezinhle. Ngokwesiko, osomabhizinisi bahlala benendawo enkulu ezimpilweni zethu. Bahamba phambili ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, baphinde baphumelele ekwakheni izitolo ezithokozisayo, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe, nezinsizakalo ezinjalo. Lokhu kudala umnotho ozinzile, kuholele ekwenzeni izimpumelelo ezinkulu kulezi zindawo. Ubusuku obubi bomnotho buzokhuphula umoya ophakathi kwabantu, kepha osomabhizinisi bafaka imali eningi ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zabo, bacela osomabhizinisi baphumelele. Njengoba sikhuluma ngosomabhizinisi, akukhona nje ukuzithokozisa kwabo, kodwa nokuphila kwezinye izindawo. Ubuhlakani babo bokusungula buphumela ngaphandle kokuba nezizathu eziningi. Uma ubheka izinkanyezi ezinezimpumelelo, u-Jeff Bezos, owaziwa ngokwakha i-Amazon, ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangakha izimakethe ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephusha umkhakha wezokuthengisa, bejabulisa abantu futhi benza kube lula ukuthenga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, osomabhizinisi baye baqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungumngane wabo. Izinkampani eziningi ziye zathuthuka ngenxa yokusebenzisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. U-Instagram, isibonelo, ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangakha imiphakathi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, benza ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo itholakale kalula. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, osomabhizinisi baphakamisa imikhiqizo yabo emhlabeni wonke, benza kube lula ukuthola izimakethe ezintsha. Nokho, ukuhamba phambili kwezimali nokudinga izinsiza ezithile kudinga umoya obalulekile wokubambisana. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bejabula ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende, abahlinzeki, nabanye osomabhizinisi. Lokhu kudala ikhono lokusebenza njengeqembu elihlangene, lapho wonke umuntu enza umsebenzi wabo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola umgomo omkhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo akugcini nje ekwenzeni imali, kepha kuphinde kuthuthukise izimpilo zabantu. Osomabhizinisi abavumi ukuhamba bodwa, kodwa badinga abantu abazokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela phezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, osomabhizinisi baye baqonda ukuthi izinkinga zikhona. Ukuphumelela akufani nempumelelo. Abantu abaningi bahluleka, kodwa lokhu akubavimbi ekubeni neqhaza. Osomabhizinisi bahlala besebenzisa izifundo ezifundwa ezinkingeni, bezama ukuhamba phambili. Izinselelo ziyisifundo esiwusizo, futhi osomabhizinisi bahlala beqonda ukuthi ukuzama nokuphumelela kudinga isikhathi. Ukuphila kwemali akuyona kuphela, kepha kumane kuyindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, osomabhizinisi bahlala benza umhlaba ube ngcono. Bakha imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, baphumelele emisebenzini yabo, futhi baveza izimfuno ezihlukahlukene. Ngokuqhubeka bezama, bahlala benza umthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ubuchwepheshe, ubudlelwano, nezifundo ezivela ezinkingeni kulokhu kubalulekile. Osomabhizinisi bahlala behlola ulimi lwemakethe, bephendula ezidingweni zabantu, futhi benza ukuthi imiphakathi ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uma ubheka osomabhizinisi, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje ukuthola imali, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umhlaba ongcono.
Amalungelo Abasebenzi Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elibizwa ngeKhaya Labasebenzi, lapho abathakathi benza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela ethile. Abantu bahlala behlupheka, benza imisebenzi enzima ngaphandle kokukwazi ukuncintisana ngemali eholeka kahle. Abasebenzi bebekhumbula ihlaya elithi, "Umsebenzi awupheli, kodwa amalungelo awanqamuki." Lezi zinkulumo zazithokozisa, kodwa zaziqhubele izinkumbulo ezinzima. UThandi, umphakathi ophuma ezindaweni ezinzima zokwakha, ungena emkhakheni wezokwakha ngemuva kokuphothula isikole. Ubaba wakhe wayengumakhi, futhi wayefisa ukuba nezehlo ezimnandi kwezokwakha. Kodwa, njengoba edlula ezindleleni ezicindezelayo zomsebenzi, wathola ukuthi izinto zenzeka ngandlela thize. Kanjalo, nakanjani, akazange azizwe ephephile. Kwakukhona uMgijimi, obengumholi weqembu abawusebenza neThandi. UMgijimi wayehamba phambili, efundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokulwela amalungelo abo. Wavuleka, wathi, "Abasebenzi, asiyiva imisebenzi yethu just ukuze kube nzima. Sinesikhala sokukhalipha, kufanele sazi ngalokho esikufanele khona." Kwakuyisikhathi sokuphakanyiswa, futhi uThandi waba nesifiso sokufunda. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThandi wathola izinkampani zinezinyathelo eziphusile ukuxhashazela abasebenzi. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima lapho bebebhapathizwa izikhwama ezinzima ngokuyisimanga, abanye beqhelelaniswa nezinye izinsiza. UThandi uthole ukuthi akukho sicelo sokuqashwa esihlala phezulu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezenziwayo kodwa izici eziyinkimbinkimbi zikhona. Umgijimi wacela ukuthi uThandi ahlangane nabo bonke abasebenzi, ukuze baxoxe ngalesi simo. Bahlala bephahlazekile, behlakanipha, bezama ukuqonda ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngenhloso yokulwa. Babekhuluma ngamalungelo abashadile, ukuhamba phambili, nemali abangaka. Okwamukeleka uThandi, wayengafuni ukuphikelela ekutheni akwaphephi. Wenzele abanye abangane ababili, uSbusiso noNobuhle, abamtshela izindaba zabo. USbusiso washaywa ihlaya elingalindelekile: "Ngabe abafana banakwe loan? Bafaka amakhulelo emanzini." Ngenkathi njengoba bebe sephula amahlathi, uNobuhle wathi: "Ngabe sinendawo yokusizakala okufanele sibuyele kuyo?" Abangane baqinisekisa ukuthi baqonde ukuthi badinga ukukhanya ekubeni negalelo. Ngokukhuthazeka, uThandi wahamba naye uMgijimi, ebheka imigoqo ethile yamalungelo abasebenzi. Bafuna ukufaka izicathulo zomphakathi, begubha amalungelo okukhula. Umoya wabe usushisa, kanti baphila izivakashi zikhumbuzo zesiko lokulwa. Emva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi imizamo yabo yenza umehluko. Izinkampani zaphuma zifuna izivumelwano ezinhle. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabulile, futhi babesebenzisa izinhlelo zomphakathi ukuxhumana nezinkampani. Iqhaza labangabezi kwezamabhizinisi lathola ukukhethwa ngezinga eliphezulu. UThandi wabona ukuhlangabezana nemigomo ethokozisayo. Umphakathi wakha imiphakathi. Ngenkathi uThandi efuna ukujoyina imisebenzi yezezimali, wabona umuntu omusha owayefuna ukwakha abadlali abahlukunyezwayo. USharon, uMphathi wezeMali, wasiza ekuhwebeni okuhle. Wathi, "Ningathanda ukuba nikhumbule, amalungelo abashadile akukhathazi? Qhubekani." Ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa unjalo, indlela yokwenza amalungelo. Ngokukhuthazeka, uThandi noMgijimi bahlola izimiso zendawo zokuhlala zabantu. Lokhu kwadlalela indima enkulu ekwakhiweni kokuhweba. Amakhono abefike ezandleni ezizimele, okwenza abavakashi bahlale bezisa bonke. Baphakanyiswa izinxenye njengomphakathi, behamba phambili ekukhuliseni abantu. Ngemva kokuhamba phambili, ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ubuhlakani bokuthi, ukushaywa kwezimali akuyona indlela yokuhlola ukusebenza okuhle. Waqonda ukuthi imizamo yokudlula kumalungelo eqiniso kuncike kubakaki bakhe. Umoya waba mncane, waphefumula enhliziyweni. UMgijimi, noSbusiso noNobuhle, banyathela emkhakheni wezokwakha, besincoma abanye basebenzi, besebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ezinakekelwayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi amalungelo avalela lokho ababhakanayo, wenza umphakathi wonke umangalise. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abasebenzi akhunjuzwa, njengoba esehlisayo kubantu abazahlala isikhathi eside. Lokhu kwavuleka emandleni okwakha imiphakathi eshisayo, efuna ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho, ngokukhanya okukhanyayo, uThandi noMgijimi nesiqephu sabo babezongena ezintweni ezintsha ababewenza ukuze amalungelo abashadile akwazi ukuphakanyiswa. IKhaya Labasebenzi laqala ukuba nomqondo omuhle, futhi izinyathelo zaba phakathi kwezicathulo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokukhumbula, isikhathi sokuhamba phambili - isikhathi sokubhekana nalolu hlangano.
I-Load Shedding Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwakhiwa kwezimoto, kube nezinguquko eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu. Okwamanje, umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziyinqaba eziholela ekwandeni kwemfuneko yamanzi kagesi, kodwa naphezu kwalokho, kukhona izinsizakalo zokulawula umoya: i-load shedding. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka, futhi kuthinta kabi izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke. Ugesi ususizwa kakhulu empilweni yethu, usuhlelwa ukuba ube umkhiqizo obalulekile emphakathini wanamuhla. Ukukhanyisa, ukufudumeza, ukudla, kanye namathoyizi abantwana, konke lokhu kuncike ekutholeni ugesi. Ngakho-ke, uma kunenkinga yokuhlinzekwa, kuvela ukukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu. Uhlelo lokuthi kuhlale kusebenza ugesi luholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi yokuphila. KwaZulu, i-load shedding ibonakala njengezinga elikhulu lokuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kokuphazamiseka komnotho, lokhu kuthinta amathuba okukhula nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Uhulumeni usebenzisa le ndlela ukuze avimbele ukuxhatshazwa kwenhlalakahle, kodwa abantu baphinde bakhathazeke ngokuntuleka kwezinye izinsiza. Kukhona izinga eliphakeme lokuphazamiseka, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ibangela ukuvinjelwa kwemisebenzi nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Izimboni ziningi seziqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokukhanyisa eziphukhile, okuvumela umphakathi ukuba namathuba okukhula, kodwa lokhu akuhambisani nosuku nosuku. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma imisebenzi iphazamiseka, kuzoba nemiphumela emibi kumabhizinisi. Abanye baveza ukuthi i-load shedding ikhuluma ngezinga eliphakeme neliphansi lokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi ethile iyakhishwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola ukukhanya okwanele. Nokho, abanye bakhathazekile ngezithako ezithinta ukwakheka kokuhlanga okuhle. Ukwanda kwe-load shedding kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bavule amakhasimende amasha, balungiselele ukukhanya kumakhaya ngesikhathi se-peak hours. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela empilweni yansuku zonke. Imikhiqizo emisha iyatholakala, ikakhulukazi ezithengiswa ku-Intanethi. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela abantu abavuma ngayo ukujolisa kwizixazululo ezinzima ekwakheni ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Noma zikhona izinkinga ezibangelwa i-load shedding, kudingeka ukuthi siphendule ngempumelelo. Lokhu kudinga abantu abaqeqeshiwe, okungaholela ekutheni babe nomthelela omuhle ezisekelweni ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuze sinqobe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezizinzile ezizovumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezingcono. Izindlela ezibalulekile zidingeka ukuze zibuyekeze indlela abantu abahlangana ngayo nomphakathi. Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwelapha eziphathelene ne-load shedding, ukwaneliseka kwezidingo zansuku zonke kuncike ekucwaningweni. Njengoba sisebenza ndawonye, izinkampani zomphakathi nezahulumeni kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi unika izibopho ezisemqoka, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Ekugcineni, i-load shedding iyinselele eqhubekayo, kodwa ngaphandle kokubambisana, ukungaboni kahle ngeke kube yisixazululo. Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uhlela izinhlelo ezintsha, aqhubeke nemihlahlandlela yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ugesi uyatholakala kubantu bonke. Ukusebenza kwethu kufanele kuthokoziswe futhi kukhuthazwe, ukuze kuvikela umphakathi kuzingozi ezihambisana ne-load shedding. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi, ngaphandle kokwehluleka, kumele siqhubeke siphezu kwezinselele ukuze siwusebenzise kahle umthamo wethu wokubambisana. Isinyathelo sokusebenza ngesizotha sizokwenza umphakathi uthokozise, ube nomthelela omuhle ezinsizweni ezitholakala. I-load shedding ingaba inselele, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha nokuhlanganyela ukuze umphakathi unelungelo lokuphila kahle.
Ukwazi Ukungondleki: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyinzima yokuphila kwabantu, ukungondleki (malnutrition) kube yinkinga enkulu ebonakalayo ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Njengoba sihamba emlandweni, sizobona ukuthi ukungondleki akukhona nje kuphela ukungabi nokudla okukhulayo, kodwa kuhambisana nezimo zomnotho, zendawo, nezemvelo. Le ndaba ithinta abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi izingane, abakhubazekile, nesizukulwane esisha esiphila emiphakathini ehluphekayo. Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abantu bebebhekene nenkinga yokungondleki. Ezindaweni ezithile, izinkanyezi zazingekho, izivunguvungu zazingasiza ekuphumeleleni kokufuya. Kanjalo, izivunguvungu zafaka udaba lokungondleki. Uhlelo lokufuya izilimo nemfuyo lwaluyinsiza yokukhulisa imfuyo, kodwa uma kwaba nezinkinga ezinjengokushoda kwamanzi noma ukungahambi kahle kwezulu, abantu bahlupheka kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba yaveza izinselele ezinkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani zashiya imiphakathi eminingi ibhunuza impilo. Ukushoda kokudla, ikakhulu ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu yempi, kwaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi kwavela izigameko zokungondleki ezibucayi. Abantu abanjengoLwandle, ophila ebheke ebhakabhakeni bakhumbula ubunzima bokuba nezidingo ezisisekelo ezinjengokudla, futhi lezi zimo ezinzima zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni wabantu nabantu abavela ezizweni ezihlukene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yomhlaba, iMelika yenza imizamo emikhulu yokugcina abantu bephila. Uhlelo lweNkosi weMali lwezokudla lwaluhlose ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ukudla ezindaweni ezithintekile. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokunciphisa ukungondleki, kepha iMpi yakhumbuza abaninimakhaya ukuthi inkinga yokungondleki ayipheli kalula. Abantu baye basala benethemba, kodwa izimo zomnotho ziqhubekile nokubahlupha. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuhamba phambili, besebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze bagweme ukuphila ezimo ezinzima. Njengoba umhlaba usuqubuka, imizamo yokuxazulula ukungondleki ibilokhu iqhubekela phambili. Ezindaweni ezifana neNyakatho ye-Afrika, abanishi bezinto bathumele izixazululo zokwakha izinhlelo zokulima ezihlonipha umkhathi. Ukwethula izinkambo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokulima ngomhlaba njengezinyathelo ezivumela ukuvuna okuhle. Lokhu kwenze abantu babe nezinketho eziningi, kanti ukungondleki kuncipha kancane kancane. Naphezu kwalezi zinyathelo, ukungondleki kusemqoka emhlabeni. Uthando nokuhlonipha izidingo zabanye konga izimoto ezitshaliwe. Izinhlelo ezisizayo kumele ziqhubeke, futhi ukubamba iqhaza okuhle kuzobonisa ukuthi sibhakabhakela phambili. Umphakathi kumele uthole ukudla okunempilo, kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo. Okwamanje, sithola izinkambo zokwazisa ulwazi nolwazi lwesayensi ezikhanyisela abantu abaningi ngobungozi bokungondleki. Imikhankaso yokwakha umphakathi uqobo isiza ukusiza abantu bazi ngempilo, bese besiza ukudla okunempilo nemikhankaso yokuphila kwabadlula kancane. Lezi zinyathelo, njengoba zigcinwa ziqhubeka, zibonisa umoya wokujula nokhuthaza. Ngokubheka emuva, kubalulekile ukufunda emlandweni. Ukuze silwe nokungondleki, kudinga isibopho sezinhlaka ezahlukene - osomabhizinisi, abakhiqizi bokudla, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lezi zinyathelo zingasiza ukudala umhlaba onempilo, unokudla okunempilo, umphakathi ophumelelayo. Siyacela, asibheke phambili nokwakha umhlaba ophilayo kuye phezulu komuntu, emtholampilo owanelisayo nangempilo, ombuschisayo. Ukungondleki akufanele kube yinsolo yomunye umuntu, kodwa umphakathi wonke. Qhubekela phambili, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi sinikeze indlela yokuphila ezolile. Ihlathi lokuphila liphila kumphakathi ophilayo, futhi abantu abakhula ngezindlela ezilungisile bayokwanisa ukufika lapho beyofinyelela ngokusebenza kanzima, bethembisa umphakathi onempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sithi: "Ngokuhlanganyela, sikwazi!" Ukungondleki kusemqoka, kepha siyakwazi ukukwenza kube yinto eyadlula emhlabeni uma sizohlanganyela. Umhlaba unethuba lokwakha ikusasa elikahle, kodwa lokho kudinga imizamo yethu kuqala. Khetha ukwakha!
Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Umfanekiso Wokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Ezweni Lethu Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, zikhonza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali yokukhokhela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezizimele. Lezi zibhedlela zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle futhi bathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yazo, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziqala emakhulwini eminyaka edlule, lapho uhulumeni aqala khona ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izibhedlela zazikhona, kodwa zazikhiqiza izinsizakalo ezincane, futhi zazingatholakali kalula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uhulumeni uqhubekile nokwakha izibhedlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa izikhungo zokwelapha, izibhedlela ezinkulu, nezikhungo zokuhlola. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola usizo lwezempilo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Izinsiza Nezinsizakalo Ezinikezwa Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinezinsiza eziningi ezihlanganisa iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, iziguli ezidinga ukuhlinzwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezijwayelekile. Abahlali bangathola imishanguzo, ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezithile, njengokwelashwa kwezifo ezithile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi kunciphisa izingozi zokugula okukhulu. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Noma izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibalulekile, zibhakabhile ezinselelweni eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yisixazululo sokushoda kwezinsiza, okungaholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthola usizo. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwabantu, kanye nokuntuleka kwemali yokuxhasa izibhedlela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abahlali abaninzi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokungabi nalwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukufinyelela usizo lwezempilo. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuze uthuthukise izibhedlela zikahulumeni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuqasha abasebenzi abanekhono, kanye nokwakha izikhungo ezintsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezempilo ziqhubeka zikhula, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwezempilo kubantu bonke. Umthelela Wokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinemithelela emikhulu empilweni yabantu. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi zinciphisa izinga lokugula. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokukhula komnotho, njengoba abantu abaphilayo kahle benza imisebenzi eminingi, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abantu behlangana ukuze bathole usizo lwezempilo. Isiphetho Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Noma zikhona izinselelo eziningi, uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ukuze ziwusizo, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangazithola kanjani lezi zinsizakalo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula.
Isahluko 1: Imvelaphi KaNapoleon Bonaparte U-Napoleon Bonaparte wazalwa ngo-15 kuJulayi 1769 e-Ajaccio, edolobheni laseCorsica. Ngomzala owaziwayo, u-Napoleon wakhulela emndenini ophuma ezizweni ezincane, okwenza ukuthi akhule enokukhathazeka ngezombusazwe. Umdabuko wakhe omkhulu wawuhambisana nezinkinga ezazikhona eCorsica, ezaholela ekutheni angene ezinkampanini zempi ukuze athole izikhundla. Isahluko 2: Ukuqala Kwezempi Ukuze uqale impilo yakhe yokuba uNobhala, u-Napoleon wangena eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela eFrance. Lapha, wathola imfundo ephakeme ezimpini, lapho afunda khona amasu okuphumelela. Kanti, ngenxa yokusebenza kahle kwakhe, wakhushulelwa esikhundleni somholi, ophumelele kakhulu empini ye-Italya ngo-1796. Lokhu kwenza uNapoleon waba yisithombe esidumile eFrance. Isahluko 3: Iziphumo Zokuphumelela Ngemva kokuphumelela empini, uNapoleon waba umholi wezwe, wathola umthelela omkhulu ezombusazwe zeseFrance. Waqala ukuhlela izinguquko ezinkulu ezinqubweni zomnotho, izokuhlaliswa, nezomthetho. Okwesikhathi eside, uNapoleon wageza emndenini ezwekazini, wamisa umthetho owaziwa njengemithetho yeNapoleonic Code, ewusizo oluningi kulolu hlangothi lwezomthetho. Isahluko 4: Ukukhula Kwamandla U-Napoleon waqhubeka nokwandisa amandla akhe, wagcina engumholi wezihlangano eziningi, ezibandakanya i-Germany ne-Italy. Umgomo wakhe waba ukufaka ukufika kwamakhamanda aseFrance kulezi zindawo. Nokho, umgoqo abawubona ngezikhali, ukusolwa, akuthokozisi kwaze kube sekupheleni. U-Napoleon waqala ukumanzisa amaqembu omphakathi kanye nemigudu yokuthula, ukuze akhulise ubudlelwano beFrance namazwe aphesheya. Isahluko 5: Izinsuku zokugcina Ngemva kwempumelelo ye-Europian, uNapoleon wabhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu eRussia ngo-1812. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehlulekeni okukhulu, kokukhumbula amaqhawe akhe. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uNapoleon wanqotshwa ngamaNgisi, wathunyelwa esiqhingini se-Elba. Kule ndawo, wakwazi ukufika empini ye-Waterloo, lapho khona wabulawa khona. Isahluko 6: Ubufakazi beMihlola Ubuya kahle kulezi zikhathi ezinzima, u-Napoleon wakhombisa ukutholwa kokuhlanganiswa. Ngaphandle kweziphumu zokuwohloka, kubukeka sengathi izikhumbuzo zikaNapoleon ziqhubeka, ngoba izinguquko zakhe zaluqhuba kuze kube namuhla. Njengomholi ophumelelako kakhulu, ubufakazi bamakhono akhe, umqondo, nobuhlakani budlulile esikhathini. Uhlobo lwakhe lokuphatha nolwakhe olwaluma luhlonishwa eFrance nasezindaweni eziningi emhlabeni jikelele. Isahluko 7: Ukuhlonishwa Nokwandiswa Kwefa Ngemva kokushona kwakhe ngo-1821, izimfundiso zikaNapoleon zaba yingxenye yomlando owaziwa kahle. Ngokuhlonishwa kwamandla akhe, kubonakala ukuthi izifundo ezitholakele zikhona ezincwadini ezivela ezikhathini eziphakeme. U-Napoleon Bonaparte uyisibonelo esihle sokuphila komholi, nakuba ezuke eziningi ezinhle, dasishiwo ekuhlonipheni umphakathi. Isiphetho U-Napoleon Bonaparte, umholi wetheku, ubonisa izifundo eziningi ngezinto ezithathwa efayeleni futhi kuncike emandleni akhe. Ukubhekana nezinselelo eziqine, indawo eshibhile emqondweni, kudlalwa kahle emlandweni. Abaningi bahlala bekhumbula divayidi naka izinganekwane, kodwa umsebenzi wakhe kuhambisana nohlanga lwezombangazwe. U-Napoleon, njengoba ibhuku lemaphoyisa lithi, ungomunye wezinto eziphakeme kumphakathi danzela erhokelweni ezizayo. Lo mbhalo akukhuthaza ukuqhubeka kokucwaninga ngezimpilo zendaba ezivusa imizwa njengezifenqo zomlando ezaziyo. Kuze kube khona imithombo, umoya wephothikizelo uyakwenza kube sobala ukuthi empeleni, umhlaba ugcina unendaba enhle ezihlukahlukene. U-Napoleon uzalwe, waba semhlabeni, ukudlulisa isimo esikhulu nezifundo ezikhazimulayo.
Impi yaseSandlwana Impi yaseSandlwana yabakhona ngomhla wesithathu kuJanuwari ngonyaka ka-1879, ngesikhathi seMpi enkulu phakathi kwamaNgisi namaZulu. Le mpi yenzeka edolobheni laseSandlwana eliseNingizimu Afrika, ngenhloso yokuthola ubukhosi nokulawula izwe lamaZulu. Iziphathimandla zaseBrithani zazibuye zenze uhlelo lokukhulisa ububanzi bomhlaba ezinhlakeni ezisemngceleni, okwaholela ekwakheni impi phakathi kwalezi zizwe ezimbili ezahlukahlukene. Ibandla laseBrithani lenza uhlu lwezinhlelo zokuthumba umhlaba wamaZulu, okwakuholwa nguGenerali Lord Chelmsford. Ukungezelela, uLord Chelmsford wayephethe amabutho amakhulu, efuna ukuhlela ukufika kwawo eMashonaland. Kodwa, lokhu kwaholela ekwehlukaneni kwemibono phakathi kwamaZulu kanye neNhlangano yeNgilandi. Phambi kokuthi impi iqale, amaZulu ahleleke kahle, ahlela isu lokuvukela izitha. Umholi wamaZulu, uCetshwayo, wahlela izinhlelo zokulwa ezifanele ukuvikela izwe lakubo. Abangani, ubudlelwano phakathi kwezigaba zezenhlalo zamazwe bobabili bubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu zezimpi. AmaZulu akubona ubudlelwano obunzima, okwakuholela ekuphikisaneni phakathi kwezizwe. Ngonyaka ka-1877, uLord Chelmsford weza nezinhlelo eziphathelene nezombangazwe, ethubela iMpi yaseSandlwana. Yize kwaba nezinhlelo ezihlukene, abanye abantu bakubona njengezithiyo ezinkulu phakathi kweNgilandi namaZulu. Ubuqili, ubuhlakani, kanye nohlaka lwezinhlelo zamabutho kwaba yizinto ezibalulekile ezadonsela phansi isizwe samaZulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sekuvele kudingeka ukuba amaZulu ahlakaniphe, abhekane nempi nokusungula isu lokuvikela. Noma kungekho imishini ephakeme, amaZulu abephethe izikhali ezilula, kodwa kuphinde kwaba nesimo esinzima samaNgisi, abephethe izikhali zokugcina, izibhamu ezinzima, nokunye. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kumaNgisi ukuthola amandla asemhlabeni. Ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi, impi yaqala. AmaZulu, animazi kahle ukuthatha izikhali, asebenzisa ukukhombisa ukuvukela izitha zawo. Impi yaseSandlwana yahlaba umxhwele ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo avela ezaze zihlukanisiwe. Kwakukhona abafana abanjengo- uNokuthula ongumholi wezempilo, obehola impi yokuhlobisa. Ngesehlo esikhethekile, impi yathatha umjikelezo ofanele; qhubeka inhlonipho yamaZulu yaba yimpumelelo enkulu engaziwa. Klunga, izinyathelo zikaNokuthula naseziphathimendeni zaba nzima ngesikhathi sokulwa. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezinzima ezingafanelekile phakathi kwamaNgisi, kuze kube sekupheleni, uma uLord Chelmsford ebona umgibeli wempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kokulawulwa, amaZulu akhuthaza okubili, ukumelana kwamadlozi. Ukuqeqeshwa bekwaziwa ngenkani zaba umphumela omuhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenziweni okukhulu, iMpi yaseSandlwana yabonakala futhi yahlaba umxhwele ezinkundleni. Ngokuhamba isikhathi, impi yaphinde yathinta umoya wabantu. Uhlelo lwezombangazwe lwashintsha, futhi le mpi yabonakala iyisibonelo esicacile sokuphikisana phakathi kwesiyingi esiyalwayo. Kwakukhona ubuhlakani obusha phakathi kweNgilandi namaZulu, futhi lokho kuzozibambezela umoya wezimpi. Lokhu kwazisa ukuthi isizwe samaZulu sasingathanda ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo ezinkulu ukukwazi ukuphoqelela izinqumo. Ngemuva kokulwa, izimpilo zabantu zashintsha ngokuphawulekayo. Ekugcineni, abantu baseSandlwana bahlala bebanjwa ukukhalipha ngempilo yabo. Noma injabulo yayiqhubekela phambili, impi yaseSandlwana yahloniphekayo emlandweni wamaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela emlandweni wamaZulu neNgilandi, nakuba bobabili bephikisana. Ubuqili bamaZulu bukhombisa uthando lwabo lwezwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kusemkhathini omusha owawusarandi imiphumela ebalulekile emakhaya. Iziphathimandla zaseBrithani zaba nemisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi yokulawula izwe lamaZulu, kwazungezile izinsuku ezinzima zokwenza. Ubusuku bube nzima, bevarasimanga ekuphikisaneni kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuncintisana kodwa, izinkulungwane zabantu zafunda kulesi sidvwa esiyimpumelelo. Ekupheleni, impi yaseSandlwana ingomunye wempi ezithandwayo emlandweni wabantu base-Afrika. Ihlonishwa emlandweni wamaZulu, futhi iyisibonelo sokukhumbula igama lempi, lokho kuholela ekwakheni ukukhumbula ngobuhle bamasiko. Ngesikhathi esifanele, le mpi iyinkumbudzo yokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukahlukene, nokuqonda isimo sobuhlanga. Kumele sikhumbule impi yaseSandlwana njengemfundo enkulu emlandweni, ukuze sihloniphe imvelaphi yethu.
iNyuvesi yasePitoli Umbuzo 1: Iyini iNyuvesi yasePitoli? INyuvesi yasePitoli, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-University of Pretoria (UP), iyinhlangano yokhigher education eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa ngonyaka we-1908, le nyuvesi iyinhloko-dolobha yalesi sikhathi, futhi ibhekwa njengenye yezikhungo eziphezulu zokufunda e-Afrika. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibaluleke kangaka? INyuvesi yasePitoli ibalulekile ngenxa yokuthi inikeza imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu ezindaweni ezihlukene, kuhlanganise nezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, ezomthetho, nezobuciko. Iphinde ibe nezinhlelo eziningi zokucwaninga ezithuthukisa ulwazi nolwazi lwezokwelapha, ezempilo, nezokwakha. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakala eNyuvesi yasePitoli? E-Nyuvesi yasePitoli, abafundi bangakhetha eziningi izifundo ezivela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zezeMali, ezobuciko, ezobunjiniyela, ezokwelapha, kanye nezifundo zezenhlalakahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi inezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokufundisa abaphambili emikhakheni ethile. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezikhungo zokucwaninga? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezikhungo zokucwaninga eziningi ezithuthukisa ucwaningo ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zikhungo ziqhuba ucwaningo olujulile emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ubuchwepheshe, nezokuphila. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola ithuba lokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezithuthukile. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli itholakala kalula? INyuvesi yasePitoli itholakala kalula, ikakhulukazi kubafundi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Itholakala edolobheni lasePitoli, elinokutholakala okuhle kwezokuthutha. Abafundi bangafinyelela iNyuvesi ngezithuthi zomphakathi, izimoto, noma ngezinyawo uma bephuma edolobheni. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibe yindawo enhle yokufunda? INyuvesi yasePitoli inezinsiza eziningi ezithuthukile, kuhlanganise nezincwadi, ama-laboratories, nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Abafundi banethuba lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi nabafundisi, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bejabulisa ukufunda. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abafundi, kuhlanganise nezibonelelo, imalimboleko, nezinhlelo zokufunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bangenza kahle ezikoleni zabo, noma ngabe bahluphekile ngezinsiza. Abafundi bangathola usizo lwemali ukuze bakwazi ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda eNyuvesi yasePitoli? Izifundo eNyuvesi yasePitoli zikhanga abafundi abaningi ngenxa yezinzuzo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda ezingeni eliphakeme, ukuthola iziqu ezihlonishwayo, kanye namathuba okusebenza ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo. Abafundi bayakwazi ukujoyina izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukene ukuze bathole ulwazi olungaphezulu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo zamasiko? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo eziningi zamasiko nezokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi, amakilabhu, nemihlangano ehlobene nezifundo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwamasiko kukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enhle. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ngiyazi ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo eNyuvesi yasePitoli? Ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo eNyuvesi yasePitoli, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zokufaka isicelo, izinqubo, nezinsuku zokugcina. Abafundi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banelungelo lokufunda futhi bahlola izifundo abazithakaselayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufunda ngamasiko nezinhloso zeNyuvesi ukuze baqonde kahle indawo abazofunda kuyo. Isiphetho INyuvesi yasePitoli iyinhlangano ebalulekile yokufunda eNingizimu Afrika, enikeza abafundi amathuba amaningi okukhula, ukufunda, nokucwaninga. Ngemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, izinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyindawo efanelekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enempilo, behlanganyela nabanye ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo.
UJacob Zuma: Uhlanga Oludlula Ividiyo UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli wezwe lethu, ungumuntu ohlale ekhuthaza izingxoxo ezinzima phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezehlakalo zobuholi bakhe, akunakuphikwa ukuthi uZuma ungomunye wabadlali ababalulekile emlandweni waleli lizwe. Ubaba wakhe uqobo, osikhumbuza ukuthi uJohannesburg akukhona nje kuphela okuhlangenwe nakho okungenamkhawulo, kodwa kuyinhliziyo yendlela eqhuba ukuthuthukiswa kwezwe. Ngokubuka kwami, uJacob Zuma usezingeni eliphakeme kakhulu njengoba enza izinqumo ezinkulu, eziva izwe. Ukuphakama kwakhe kwezombusazwe akudluli nje ekubeni umengameli; kuholela ekutheni abe nezithakazelo eziningi emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Kodwa kumelwe sikhumbule ukuthi, njengomholi, uZuma ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Amaqiniso amahle nezimbi ezithinta impilo yakhe zihlanganisa izehlakalo ezithinta ubumbano lwezombusazwe, ubukhazikhazi, kanye nezehlakalo zenkantolo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uZuma wathola ukudumisa, kodwa futhi waphinde wabhekana nokuhluleka okukhulu. Munye wezinto ezijulile engizikhalela ngazo nguZuma wukuthi wayengomunye wabaholi abashayelwa phansi yizinkinga ezikhona kakhulu. Njengoba ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, umphakathi wawukhula ngezindlela ezahlukene, ibhizinisi, kanye nezehlakalo ezenzeka emiphakathini. Ukuphuthuma kokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi, kuhlanganiswa neziqu zenkantolo, kwabonisa ukuthi abanye banikeza uZuma ividiyo futhi abanye bamhla ngenkani. Nokho, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi uZuma akazange alokhu engumholi omuhle, noma umbono omuhle, ngesikhathi sane ezifundazweni zakhe nomsebenzi wobuholi. Abanye babonakalisa imizwa yokukhathazeka mayelana nezinqumo zenkantolo azizange zixazululwe. Lokhu kwathi, ngemva kokusebenzisa izinkishwa eziyinqaba, uZuma wagcwalisa imicabango ethile futhi waba yisithombeni esibalulekile ezinkundleni. Ubuye ubone izikhangiso zomphakathi eziphethe izinkanyezi ezikhombisa ubukhazikhazi bakhe ngesikhathi esifanayo. Okwamanje, noma kungeke kuphumelele ukukhipha umphakathi ezinsukwini zekhulu leshumi nanye, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole indlela uZuma obuqhubeka ngayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuqonda ukuthi uZuma uyinqaba, uyinkanyezi, noma ungumholi osenkingeni. Lokhu kuzodlula ezindabeni kanye nezinqumo zakhe ezinkulu. UZuma ubonakala engumholi onamandla, owenze izinqubo ezinhle nokuhlasela okukhulu. Kodwa ngesimo esidlangile, uJacob Zuma uyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ukumeleka kwakhe kudinga ukubhekwa njengezizathu ezahlukahlukene zempilo yomphakathi, ukunciphisa ububanzi benkohlakalo, kanye nezithombe ezifakazela izinqumo zenkantolo. UZuma kufanele ahlale esikhumbuzo seqiniso lokuthi impilo yakhe ingenye yezinto ezinkulu ezazingavela njengobuholi bovivinyo. Ekugcineni, uJacob Zuma umbono owenziwe ngamaphutha nezinto ezimfakazela izimpilo zabantu. Akukho futhi akaze kube khona ukuhamba kokuhlangana, okuwubufakazi bokuthi umbuso wezomthetho ubalulekile, futhi lezi zinjongo zidinga ukuqonda. Kwelokhu, kungenzeka dube ukunciphisa izinkinga, ngenkathi uthathwa njengomholi owayengowesithathu, kanye nesibonelo esinembile sokuqhubeka nohambo lwakhe lwezombusazwe. Uhlanga olukhula, lokho okukhumbuzayo uJacob Zuma, luhlala lunokhalakhanya nolwazi olunamandla, olukhumbuza ngezizathu zothando nosizo emsebenzini. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokusebenza, kodwa ziyaphinde zikhumbuze ukuthi ukuzibophezela kulandela izinqumo eziphusile nemiphako ezibanjwa umkhawulo ekwakheni izimanga ezizoletha impumelelo emiphakathini yethu. Ngendlela ethile, uJacob Zuma uyinsika yokuphila kwethu, futhi kanye nesigaba somphakathi, uyindodakazi yempumelelo ekhulayo.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimo Zamanje Njengoba uhamba phambili, umphakathi ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kukhuphuka, okukhuluma ngakho, akukhona nje kuphela okuthinta abantu abajwayelekile, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphumela yalo kumphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko, imiphumela yazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Izizathu Zokukhuphuka Kwezindleko Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izizathu eziyinqaba eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko zokuphila. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu ibangelwa ukwanda kwezindleko zokukhiqiza. Njengoba izindleko zokuthenga izinto zokwakha, izinsiza, nezinsiza zokusebenza zikhuphuka, abenzi bezimpahla baphinde baphakamise amanani. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke kakhulu uma bephokophela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo eyisisekelo, njengokudla, izimpahla zokugqoka, nezinsiza zokuhlala. Okwesibili, ukwanda kokungasebenzi kahle emnothweni nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Njengoba abantu bengatholi imisebenzi, umnotho uyabola, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila. Abantu abangenamali yokwengeza, bahlala bejolise ekuthengeni izinto ezisemqoka kuphela, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Imiphumela Yokukhuphuka Kwezindleko Imiphumela yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila ibonakala ngokucacile. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezifo zengqondo. Abantu bahlala bejolise ekunciphiseni izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulisa imindeni yabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophukile, lapho abantu behluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kudala ukungalingani emnothweni. Abantu abathola imali encane bahlushwa kakhulu, kuyilapho abathola imali eningi beqhubeka nokuphila kahle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onobandlululo, lapho abanye bejabulile kanti abanye behlupheka. Lokhu akuhambisani nemigomo yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Izixazululo Zokubhekana Nezindleko Zokuphila Ukuze siqonde lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele enze izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwandisa izinhlelo zokuphakela ukudla, ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokusebenza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokungakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zabo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazitholele izindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezindlela zokonga, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, kanye nokuthenga izinto ezisemqoka kuphela. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle, kufanele bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuhlola izizathu eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko, imiphumela yazo, kanye nezixazululo ezithile, kubalulekile ukuze sithole indlela yokubhekana nale nkinga. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqumo eziphusile, futhi uhulumeni kufanele enze izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukuphila kahle.
Umbiko: Ukulahlwa KweMfucuza Isingeniso Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela efanele yokuphatha imfucuza ukuze kugwenywe umonakalo emvelweni. Imfucuza, uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezindaweni zokuhlala, empilweni yabantu, nasemvelweni jikelele. Kulokhu, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe le nqubo. Izindlela Zokulahlwa KweMfucuza Kunezindlela eziningi zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphinda Kusetshenziswe (Recycling): Le ndlela ibandakanya ukuhlanganiswa kwemfucuza ukuze kudalwe izinto ezintsha. Lokhu kunciphisa inani lemfucuza elingena ezindaweni zokugcina imfucuza, futhi kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo. Izinto ezifana nephepha, ipulasitiki, nezinsimbi zingaphinda zisetshenziswe, zinciphisa umthelela emvelweni. 2. Ukugaya (Composting): Lokhu kuyinqubo yokuguqula imfucuza yemvelo, efana nezitshalo nezinsalela zokudla, ibe umquba. Lokhu kunciphisa imfucuza ethunyelwa ezindaweni zokugcina imfucuza futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula kwezitshalo. 3. Ukushiswa (Incineration): Le ndlela ibandakanya ukushiswa kwemfucuza ukuze kukhiqizwe amandla. Nakuba lokhu kunciphisa inani lemfucuza, kudinga ukuqashelwa izingozi ezihambisana nokukhishwa kwemikhuhlane emoyeni. 4. Ukugcina (Landfilling): Lokhu kuyindlela evamile yokulahlwa kwemfucuza, lapho imfucuza igcinwa ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Nokho, le ndlela ibangelwa ukukhathazeka ngenxa yokungcoliswa komhlaba, amanzi, nomoya. Izinselelo Zokulahlwa KweMfucuza Naphezu kwezindlela ezikhona, kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Okokuqala, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele kubantu abaningi mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha imfucuza kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi basathanda ukulahla imfucuza ngendlela engafanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuphatha kahle imfucuza. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe lezi zindlela zihlala zikhona, kodwa zihlala zikhawulelwe. Izikhungo zokuphinda zisetshenziswe, izindawo zokugaya, nezikhungo zokushisa zidinga ukuxhaswa ngokwanele ukuze zisebenze kahle. Okwesithathu, izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, zidinga ukulandela imithetho eqinile yokuphatha imfucuza. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Izixazululo Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokubaluleka kokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni, emiphakathini, nasemiphakathini zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi imfucuza ingaphathwa kanjani kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele zokuphatha imfucuza, kuhlanganise nezikhungo zokuphinda zisetshenziswe nezindawo zokugaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthi baphathe imfucuza yabo ngendlela efanele. Izinkampani nazo zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imfucuza, futhi zidinga ukulandela imithetho yokuphatha imfucuza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imvelo nokunciphisa umthelela omubi wemfucuza. Isiphetho Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Noma kunezindlela eziningi zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ngokufundisa umphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, nokwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile, singathuthukisa indlela esiphatha ngayo imfucuza, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sigcine imvelo yethu iphilile.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Ingxoxo Ngobuchwepheshe Isingeniso Sanibonani, nonke abathandi bezindaba. Namuhla sizobe sikhuluma ngesimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, esibucayi kakhulu kulezi zinsuku. Ngikhuluma noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumcwaningi wezomnotho, ukuze sihlole izinselelo nezinkinga ezibhekene nomnotho wethu. Mnu. Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokusivumela ukuba sikhulume nawe. Isimo Sokukhula Komnotho Mnu. Mthembu, ngicela uqale ngokuchaza isimo sokukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthi sikhona yini ukukhula okuhle okukhona? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Yebo, isimo sokukhula komnotho wethu sikhombisa izimpawu ezithile ezikhathazayo. Ngonyaka owedlule, sathola ukukhula okuncane, okungama-1.2%. Lokhu kuncane kakhulu uma sikhumbula izinga lokukhula elidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu bethu. Izinkinga ezinjengokungasebenzi, ukungabi khona kwemisebenzi, kanye nezindleko eziphakeme zokuphila, zenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Izinkinga Zokungasebenzi Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela. Isinga sokungasebenzi phakathi kwentsha sifinyelela ku-60%, okuyinombolo ephakeme kakhulu. Lokhu kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kwemfundo efanele, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona ezingahlangabezani nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zemfundo nezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Izimakethe Nezomnotho Kukhona izimakethe ezithile ezithuthuka, noma izimboni ezithola impumelelo, noma izimboni ezibhekene nezinkinga? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezimboni ezithile ezifana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, kanye nezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme ezikhombisa ukukhula okuhle. Kodwa-ke, sizithola sithwele kanzima emkhakheni wezolimo nezimboni ezindala, ezinjengokukhiqiza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zokuxhasa lezi zimboni ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Umnotho Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Kudingeka izinyathelo eziningi. Okokuqala, kumele sithuthukise imfundo ukuze sithole abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe. Okwesibili, kumele sikhuthaze ukutshalwa kwezimali, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Okwesithathu, kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, ngoba lawa mabhizinisi angaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana Nezizwe Ngabe ukubambisana namanye amazwe kubalulekile emnothweni wethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, ukubambisana namazwe angaphandle kubalulekile. Lokhu kusivumela ukuthi sithole ukufinyelela ezimakethe ezinkulu, sithole ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano bezohwebo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izivumelwano zokuhweba zingasiza ekunciphiseni izithiyo zokuhweba, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhula. Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Kukhona yini izinselelo ezithinta ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomnotho? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomnotho, njengezimali, izinsiza zemvelo, kanye nezinsiza zabantu, kudinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Ukungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukungasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Kumele sibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Ngabe unayo imiyalo yokugcina kubabukeli bethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi, umnotho wethu ungathuthuka uma sonke sizibophezela ekwakheni ikusasa el better. Kumele sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, sikhuthaze ubumbano, futhi sithuthukise imfundo. Ngiyabonga nonke. Isiphetho Sezingxoxo Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngokuba lapha namuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzosisiza ukuba sithole ukuqonda okungcono ngesimo somnotho wethu. Ngiyethemba sizobona izinguquko ezinhle esikhathini esizayo. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokulandela, futhi sizobonana kwenye ingxoxo.
Ubudlelwano: Umgogodla Wokuphila Kwethu Ubudlelwano bukhona phakathi kwabantu bonke, kungaba phakathi komndeni, abangane, noma othandweni. Lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yethu, njengoba ubudlelwano buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano buphathelene nokuxhumana, ukwethembana, nokuhloniphana. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bokuqala obubalulekile empilweni yami bukhona phakathi kwami nomndeni wami. Umndeni ungumgogodla wethu, lapho sithola khona uthando, ukwesekwa, kanye nokuqonda. Ngaphandle komndeni, ubudlelwano bethu nabangane bukhombisa indlela esithanda ngayo ukujabulisa, sabelane ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi sikhulume ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ubudlelwano bethu nabangane bukhuthaza ukuvuleka, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Ukwethembana Njengesisekelo Sobudlelwano Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo busekelwe ekwethembaneni. Uma abantu bephila ngokwethembana, bakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emshadweni, lapho ukwethembana kudinga ukuba kube phezulu. Ukungathembeki kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ebudlelwaneni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sikhulume ngokuqondile, sabelane ngezinkinga zethu, futhi sithole izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Ukwamukela Umehluko Ubudlelwano buphinde buhlangane nezimo ezahlukene. Abantu bahluka ngezindlela eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinkolelo, izizinda, nezifiso. Ukwamukela umehluko phakathi kwabantu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe konke okukhuluma abanye, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlonipha imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imicabango yabo. Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Ukuxhumana kuyisihluthulelo sobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, abantu kufanele bakwazi ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka, bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, futhi baphendule ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchule bokulalela, lapho umuntu engalalela ngempela okukhuluma omunye, ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala umoya wokwethembana, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ezinkingeni. Izinkinga Ezingavela Ebuhlotsheni Noma ubudlelwano bukhona, akukhona njalo kube lula. Izinkinga zingavela, futhi kubalulekile ukuzibhekisisa. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungathembeki, noma izimo eziphazamisayo zingaholela ekuphuleni ubudlelwano. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izinkinga ziyingxenye yempilo, futhi kufanele bazame ukuzixazulula ngokukhuluma. Ukuxhumana okuhle nokuhloniphana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Obuqinile Ubudlelwano obuqinile busekelwe ekuzinikeleni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele bazibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlela isikhathi sokuchitha ndawonye, ukwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, noma ukusiza omunye uma edinga usizo. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvame ukuhlala isikhathi eside, futhi buvumela abantu ukuba bakhule ndawonye. Isiphetho: Ubudlelwano Njengomgogodla Wokuphila Ubudlelwano buphila, bukhula, futhi buguquka. Kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu buphathelene nokuxhumana, ukwethembana, nokuhloniphana. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele siqhubeke sifunda, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sithole izindlela zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Ubudlelwano bethu bukhona ukuze busisize, bukhuthaze, futhi bube umgogodla wempilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithanda, sikhuluma, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, ukuze sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga zempilo. Ubudlelwano bethu buphathelene nokuphila kwethu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle.
Isingeniso Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile emkhakheni wezok教育. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngenxa yokuthi ukufunda kuyisisekelo sokuthola ulwazi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okucabanga, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka izici ezithinta izinga lokufunda kwabafundi, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinga. Izici Ezithinta Izinga Lokufunda Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lincike ezintweni eziningi. Okokuqala, umqondo wokufunda uqala ekhaya. Abafundi abakhuliswa ezindaweni ezinomoya opholile, lapho imfundo ibalulekile, bavame ukuba neziqu eziphakeme. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umndeni unendima enkulu ekwakheni isisekelo sokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila, ezifana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, zidlala indima ebalulekile. Abafundi abathola izincwadi, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe, bahlala bephumelela kakhulu. Okwesibili, izinga lokufunda lincike kumfundisi. Umfundisi onolwazi, onothando, futhi ophumelelayo ungashintsha impilo yomfundi. Umfundisi kufanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda ekhuthazayo, enezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, izindlela zokufunda ezihlukahlukene, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Uma umfundisi engakwazi ukuheha abafundi, izinga lokufunda lizoba phansi. Izinselelo Ezinzima Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezithinta izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yindlela yokufunda. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi nentshisekelo, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda. Lokhu kungavela ngenxa yokungabi nezinsiza ezanele, noma ngenxa yokuthi abafundi bahlala ezindaweni ezikude nezikole. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo, ezifana nokukhathazeka noma ukungabi namandla, zingathinta kakhulu izinga lokufunda. Okwesibili, ukungabi nokuqonda kahle kwezifundo kungaba yinkinga. Abafundi abaqondi kahle izifundo, noma abathola usizo oluncane, bahlala behluleka. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izifundo zikhuluma ngolimi olungajwayelekile kubafundi. Ukungabi nokuqonda kahle kungaholela ekutheni abafundi baphumelele kancane, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Izinga Lokufunda Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokufunda, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izincwadi, izikhala zokufunda, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, kungasiza abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi ngendlela ethokozisayo. Okwesibili, umfundisi kufanele abe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa, ezifana nezifundo ezisebenzisanayo, izifundo ezisebenzayo, kanye nezifundo ezikhethekile. Umfundisi kufanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, ukuze abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bejabule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kumfundisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephuma phambili ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabafundi babo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kuzokwenza umfundisi akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, okuzothuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Isiphetho Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile empilweni yabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zinga, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda. Ngokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, izinsiza ezanele, kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kumfundisi, singathuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abafundi baphumelele, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempumelelo, nelizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
Amabhayisikili Nezithuthuthu: Ukukhetha Okufanele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukufudukela kokukhula komnotho kanye nezidingo zokuhamba kwabantu kudala ukwakheka kwezindlela ezintsha zokuhamba. Amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu bahlala phambili ezinkundleni zokuhamba, kanti owokuthi yikuphi okungcono, amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu, kuhlale kuyisihloko esijuleka emiphakathini eminingi. Le ngxoxo izobheka izinzuzo nokubi kokuhamba ngethuluzi ngalunye, iqhaza lazo nezimo ezingabandakanywa ekukhetheni. Okokuqala, kudingeka sithathe umqondo wokuhamba ngethuluzi ngalinye. Amabhayisikili, njengezithuthuthu, ahlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba engabizi kakhulu futhi ephephile. Akukhulumi nje ngentengo yokuthenga, kodwa futhi nesimo sokugcina, ngoba amabhayisikili adinga ukugcinwa okuncane uma kuqhathaniswa nezithuthuthu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili akhipha umoya opholile, okwenza kube lula ukufaka imizamo emzimbeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abahamba ngebhayisikili benza umsebenzi wokuqina, okungasiza ekunciphiseni isisindo nasekuthuthukiseni impilo jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhangisa ngaphezu kokuhamba. Zikhawulela isikhathi sokuhamba, ziqhuba ngesivinini esikhulu, futhi zingafinyelela ezindaweni ezikude ngokushesha. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu kubantwana nabantu abadala abahamba emsebenzini, ngenxa yokuthi bakwazi ukufika endaweni yabo ngemizuzu embalwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithuthuthu zikhanga abafuna ukuzijabulisa, ngoba ukuhamba ngebhayisikili kungase kube nzima kwabaningi, kanti izithuthuthu zenza kube lula ukuhamba. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhamba ngezithuthuthu kuhilela izingozi eziningi, njengoba ubungozi bokushayisana bukhona kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga abanikazi bezithuthuthu ukuba babe neziqu eziphezulu zokuphepha, ezifana nezibuko kanye nemaski yokuphepha. Ngaphandle kokubheka izinzuzo, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo. Amabhayisikili aphumelele kakhulu ekuvikeleni imvelo. Awathathi amanzi amaningi, awakhiphi imikhaza engcolisa umoya, futhi akhuthaza umoya opholile. Lokhu kwenza amabhayisikili kube yindlela ephumelelayo yokuhamba endaweni ezinezinkinga zokungcoliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhangisa ekongeni isikhathi, kodwa zikhumbula ukuthi zikhupha imikhaza eminingi emoyeni, okwenza kube nzima ukubaluleka kokuhamba kwezithuthuthu. Uma sikhuluma ngensizakalo, amabhayisikili angatholakala kalula. Abantu bangawathola kalula ezitolo noma online, futhi akudingeki ukuthi babe nemali eningi. Lokhu kuveza ithuba elikhulu lokuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-townships bangabathola kalula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zidinga ukugcinwa okuhle, okusho ukuthi abanikazi bazo kufanele babe nezezimali ezinzima ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili awadlalisi kuphela indima yokuhamba kodwa futhi ahlanganisa imiphakathi. Izindawo zokuhamba ngebhayisikili zikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlangane, bahlale bejabulile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Lokhu kuhlekelela ekukhuleni kwemiphakathi, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Izithuthuthu, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, kodwa azikhiqizi ubudlelwano obufanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abahamba ngebhayisikili bahlala bezithokozisa ngendlela yokwenza okuthile, okubangela umoya opholile phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, ukukhetha phakathi kwamabhayisikili nezithuthuthu kuncike ezidingweni zomuntu ngamunye. Ukuthi uzofuna ukukhetha amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu kuncike kakhulu ezicini ezinjengokuthi izinto zikhona, izidingo zempilo, kanye nezinqumo zokudla. Amabhayisikili ahlanzekile, aphumelelayo, futhi akhululekile, kwazise izithuthuthu zinika amandla, isikhathi, nokugxila. Ngakho, ukuhlola lezi zindlela zokuhamba kuyisinyathelo esihle sokuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela efanele kakhulu kuwe. Ngakho, ngabe amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu? Impendulo ingahluka kumuntu nomuntu, kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokucabanga ngokwazisa kwethu kwempilo, umoya, nezimo. Ngaphakathi kohlanga lwezokuhamba, inhloso yethu yokuhamba ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi udinga ukukhetha okuzokwenza ube nekhono, ukhululekile, futhi ufinyelele izinjongo zakho.
Usain Bolt: Iqhawe Lezemidlalo UUsain Bolt, owazalwa ngo-21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayika, ungomunye wabagibeli abavelele emlandweni wezokugijima. Ubulili bakhe, obuqhakambisa ubuhlakani nobuchule, buveza impumelelo emkhakheni wezokugijima. Uthole udumo olukhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yokuphumelela kwakhe emqhudelwaneni, ikakhulukazi emijikeni emide, lapho abebonakala khona eshaya izikhathi ezinhle kakhulu. UUsain wakhula emndenini ophilayo, lapho ababejwayele khona ukuzijwayeza imidlalo. Uthando lwakhe lokugijima lwaqala ngenkathi esencane, lapho athola khona ithuba lokugijima ezindaweni zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uBolt wabonisa amakhono akhe, okwaholela ekutheni aqashelwe njengomgibeli onamandla. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, uBolt waqala ukuqeqeshwa ngokusemthethweni, waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu kumphakathi wezokugijima. Uqala ukuthola udumo olukhulu emqhudelwaneni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emqhudelwaneni we-World Championships, lapho ahlula khona abanye abagibeli abaziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Ngonyaka ka-2008, uBolt waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokugijima, ewina izindondo ezintathu ze-gold emqhudelwaneni we-Olympic eBeijing. Ukwenza kahle kukaBolt akugcinanga lapho; wathola izindondo eziningi emqhudelwaneni we-World Championships, waphinde wahlula irekhodi lesikhathi emijikeni emide. Ubulungisa bakhe, obubhalwe ngempumelelo, bahlonishwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi waba isibonelo esihle kwabanye abathanda ezemidlalo. Ngonyaka ka-2012, uBolt waphinda wathola izindondo ezintathu ze-gold emqhudelwaneni we-Olympic eLondon, lapho abebonakala khona eshaya izikhathi eziphakeme kakhulu. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uBolt waba yisithombe esidumile, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukumlandela, befunda ezifundweni ezitholakala emsebenzini wakhe. Ubuye wathola izikhumbuzo eziningi, ezihlanganisa izinkanyezi zomhlaba, izikhumbuzo zezimali, nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abasha emkhakheni wezokugijima. UUsain waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, kufanele azinikele, aqhubeke eqeqesha, futhi angayeki, noma ngabe ubunzima bukhona. UUsain Bolt akagcinanga nje ngokuba umgibeli ophumelelayo; ubephinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eJamayika, lapho abanye behlonipha khona imizamo yakhe yokuphakela izifundo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBolt wagcina esehla emsebenzini wakhe, kodwa impumelelo yakhe izohlala ikhumbuleka. Uhlonishwa njengomgibeli ophakeme, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabantu abaziwayo emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. Ngempela, uBolt uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, kufanele azinikele, aqhubeke eqeqesha, futhi angayeki, noma ngabe ubunzima bukhona.
U-Novak Djokovic: Umphenyi Wezempilo Nezimpumelelo Emhlabeni Wamathenisi UNovak Djokovic ungomunye wabadlali abavelele kakhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wamathenisi. Ubulili bakhe, ubunzima ayebhekana nabo, kanye nezimpumelelo zakhe, kubonisa ukuthi ungubani ngempela, kanye nendlela akhethile ngayo ukuphila kwakhe ukuze abuyele ekulweni kobuhlungu bezenhlalakahle, ezempilo, kanye nokuphumelela. U-Djokovic wazalelwa eBelgrade, eSerbia, ngomhla ziyi-22 kuNdasa ngonyaka we-1987. Umdlalo wakhe wamathenisi waqala ngesikhathi esencane, waphoqeleka ukufunda amathalente akhe ngemuva kokuhlangana nomphakathi wokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqala ukubonisa ubuchule obuphakeme, kwazise ngaphambi kokuba abe yilungu elisemthethweni leqembu lezemidlalo leSerbia. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNovak wathola izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthuka ukuze akwazi ukufinyelela izinjongo zakhe. Umdlalo wakhe umuhle, unokungajabuli, futhi ubonisa ubunzima obuphakeme, okuyizici ezimqoka ekudlalweni kwamathenisi. U-Djokovic uphinde waba ngumgayisani wezifundo ezithinta impilo nokudla okunempilo, okuholela ekudlaleni kwakhe okukhuluma phansi ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa izinto ezinhle nezimpumelelo ekuphileni. Nakuba uNovak Djokovic engomunye wabantu abaphethe umhlaba, udlale kakhulu emiphefumulo yokuhlonipha nezimfanelo zomphakathi. Ukuhlawulwa okuningi kwezinkanyezi, ukudela izikole okufanele zishintshwe, kanye nezimindeni ezihloniphekile, uDjokovic ubonisa ukuthi unombono ofanele wokukhula, umphakathi, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Uhlobo lwakhe lokudlala lukhombisa uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo, ubunzima obumhlupha, nokuthi unomlande owakhe afuna ukuzenza ngemuva. U-Djokovic unakekela impilo yakhe futhi ubonisa isithakazelo esijulile esidlangalaleni nasezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubandakanywa kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kumathenisi, kodwa nasemphakathini. U-Djokovic uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ngaphandle kwezikhumbuzo zokuphumelela kwakhe kwi-Grand Slam, lapho efinyelela khona phambili kumakhono akhe okwenza izimbangi zikhathazeke.
