Kukhuthaza impilo enempilo, kunciphisa ingcindezi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baphume, bazijabulele, futhi bakhuthaze ukubhukuda. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ukubhukuda akusizi kuphela emzimbeni, kodwa futhi emoyeni, futhi kuyindlela yokuphila engcono. Ngakho, masiphume, sihamba emanzini, sizijabulise, futhi sithokozise impilo yethu. Ukubhukuda akusizi kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuxhumana, nokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Hamba phambili, bhukuda, futhi ujabulele ubuhle bemvelo!
uHuawei - Umcimbi Omkhulu Wokwaziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, idolobha leBeijing labanjelwa umcimbi obalulekileyo wokwaziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, owaziwa ngokuthi "uHuawei Connect 2023". Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa osomabhizinisi, abakhiqizi, ochwepheshe, kanye nabanye abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, bonke bejolise ekukhuleni kwezobuchwepheshe. UHuawei, inkampani edume ngezixazululo zayo ezithuthukile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ibonise izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe namabhizinisi. Umsakazo omuhle wavela eBeijing, lapho abavakashi behlangana ukuze bazohlanganyela ulwazi, ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nokuxoxisana ngezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zomhlaba wamanje. Umcimbi uhlanganise izethulo ezimnandi, ama-workshops, nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abaziwayo, bonke bejolise ezintweni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe obuvela kuyo yonke imikhakha. Phakathi kwalesi sikhathi, uHuawei wakhombisa ubuchwepheshe bayo obukhulu, ikakhulu emkhakheni wezixazululo ze-5G, ama-robots ahlakaniphile, kanye nezixazululo ze-Cloud. I-5G, eyanelisa umhlaba wakhe, iyisihluthulelo sokuqhubeka komnotho, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokuxhumana, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha. Umbono kaHuawei uwukuthi, ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, bangasiza amabhizinisi ukuba akhule futhi abe namandla. Umlando walesi sikhungo, esinqumweni sawo sezobuchwepheshe, ukukhombisa ukuthi uHuawei uyinselelo eqhubekayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ezinye izinkampani zingase zimise imikhakha emisha, kodwa uHuawei usebenza ngokuguqula indlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokwakha izixazululo ezizokusiza ukuthi uphumelele emhlabeni ophuthumayo, ngokusebenzisa amandla wobuchwepheshe namathuba amasha. Ngaphandle kwezethulo zomkhiqizo, umcimbi uphinde uvulwe ngenhlonipho yokucela iziqondiso ezivela kubaholi bezobuchwepheshe. Lezi ziqondiso zibaluleke kakhulu eqhulwini njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga eziphuthumayo, njengezinguquko zezimali, izinguquko zesimo sezulu, kanye nezithiyo zentuthuko. UHuawei ushilo ukuthi, ngezinqubomgomo eziqondiswe kahle, kungenzeka ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili ezizosiza umphakathi. Umlayezo ophumelelayo wombhoxo ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi kanye neziqu zabaqhudelana. UHuawei uphinde wavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabathengisi bezezimali, abacwaningi, nabakhiqizi, bonke behlangene ukuze baphumelele. Umsebenzi wokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuzuzwe impumelelo udinga ukubambisana okuqinile, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababambiqhaza. Ngaphezu kokugxila kumkhiqizo, futhi, uHuawei ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokwazi ngokuqonda izidingo zamakhasimende. Abakhiqizi bahlala besebenzisana nabathengi ukuze baqonde kahle izimfuno zabo. Le nqubo yokuxhumana ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izidingo zabathengi zikhula ngokushesha, futhi uHuawei uphinde uzinikeze ithuba lokwazisa izixazululo ezihlukile, ezithokozisayo nezisebenzayo. Umsakazo wezobuchwepheshe ucacisiwe umbono omuhle kokubili abaphakanyisi nabathengi. Bhala izinhlelo ezizayo ezifanele ukuthi zisize umphakathi, uthola indlela yokuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Abantu banezinkinga ezithile, futhi uHuawei uthola ithuba lokwenza izinto zibe lula nokuhlangabezana nawe. Ekugcineni, uHuawei unikeze umbono othembisayo, oholayo ngempumelelo emnothweni owandile. Ngamaqhinga amasha ahlakaniphile kanye nobuchwepheshe, ukumisa izixazululo ezintsha ziyindlela enkulu yokuphumelela. Imicimbi efana nalena ihlinzeka indlela yokuba nebhande eliqinile elihlanganya abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ngenhloso yokuthola izixazululo ezikhula kulokhu phambili. Umlayezo wokugcina ubonisa ukuthi lokho kuhlanganyela kuzothuthukisa ikakhulukazi umnotho wabantu. Uma zonke izisebenzi ziqhuba phambili, sizokwazi ukuthola umphumela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele. UHuawei uqhubeka phambili, ushowa indlela eqondile yokuhamba phambili ukuze sakhe ikusasa elithembisayo. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa izifiso zomphakathi, kanye nomgomo wokwakha ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili, okuqinisekisa ukuthi sizokwazi ukuthola isixazululo esiqondile emhlabeni onobuhlakani.
Ukudala Okuqukethwe: Umsebenzi Wokwakha Nokwabelana Ngemibono Emisha Ngomhla ziyi-15 kuNhlaba 2023, izwe liqhubeka nokuhamba phambili kwezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wokudala okuqukethwe. Lokhu kudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile, hhayi kuphela emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, kodwa nasezindaweni eziningi ezifana nezohwebo, ezokungcebeleka, kanye nezokufundisa. Kubantu abaningi, ukudala okuqukethwe kusho ukuveza imibono, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwandisa ubukhona babo kwi-inthanethi. Izingcweti zikhomba ukuthi intuthuko kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi izinsiza ezinjengezinkundla zokuxhumana, kuveze amathuba amasha okwakha okuqukethwe. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenzisa amafoni, amakhompyutha, kanye nezinye izinsiza, kudingeka ukuba babe nekhono lokudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo, okukhanga, futhi okuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqhubeke nokukhula, befinyelela ezithameli ezinkulu, futhi bahlale bephambili emncintiswaneni. Ubuciko Bokudala Ukwakha okuqukethwe akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyinkonzo yokudala. Abaculi, ababhali, nabachwepheshe bokumaketha bahlala befuna izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nezithameli zabo. Ukudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo kudinga ubuciko, ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo, kanye nekhono lokuhumusha imizwa nezifiso zabantu. Isibonelo, ababhali bama-blog, abakhiqizi bevidiyo, nabaculi bezithombe badinga ukuqonda kahle izithameli zabo ukuze bakhe okuqukethwe okufanele. Kulezi zinsuku, ukwakha okuqukethwe kuhilela ukuthola umqondo ophusile. Abadala bokuqukethwe bahlala beqhuba ucwaningo, befunda izitayela ezihamba phambili, futhi bezama ukuhamba phambili nezitayela ezisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kuyavumelana nezinguquko, kuphendula izidingo nezifiso zababukeli, futhi kubavumele ukuthi bahlale bephambili emncintiswaneni. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinsiza Ubuchwepheshe buguqule kakhulu indlela esikhiqiza ngayo okuqukethwe. Ama-algorithms, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezikhulayo zenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kokudala. Izinsiza ezifana ne-Canva, Adobe Spark, kanye ne-WordPress zenza kube lula kubantu abangaqeqeshelwa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlangenwe nakho kokudala, lapho abantu abaningi bengakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izindaba, nezithombe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, kanye ne-Twitter zisebenza njengama-portal okuxhumana. Lokhu kudala isiko lokwabelana, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bechaza imibono yabo. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zisheshisa inqubo yokukhiqiza, zivumela abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi ziqhubekisela phambili izifiso zabo zokwabelana. Izinsiza Zokwakha Okuqukethwe Abadala bokuqukethwe badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene ukuze bakhe okuqukethwe okuhle. Lokhu kuhilela izinhlelo zokuhlela, izinsiza zokusebenza, nezinsiza zokuhlola imiphumela. Uhlelo lokusebenza olufana ne-Google Analytics lwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi yini esebenza kahle nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Abadala bokuqukethwe badinga ukuqwashisa ngokuqhubekayo ngezinguquko ezimakethe nasemkhakheni we-inthanethi. Ukwazi izitayela ezisha, imikhuba yokubukela, kanye nezifiso zezitshalo kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okunempilo, okukhanga, nokwanelisayo. Izitayela Zokudala Izitayela zokudala okuqukethwe zihluke kakhulu, kusukela kokubhaliwe kuya kokubonwayo. Ababhali bama-blog bahlala beqhakambisa izindaba ezithokozisayo, bekhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabule. Abakhiqizi bevidiyo, ngakolunye uhlangothi, benza okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo nokuqondisayo, okuhlinzeka ngezifundo noma izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo. Izithombe, imidwebo, kanye nomculo kubalulekile ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuhlangene, okuthokozisayo. Ukwakha okuqukethwe kuhilela ukucabanga ngamasu ahlukahlukene. Ukuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle, ukwakha izindaba ezithokozisayo, kanye nokuhlola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwane nezithameli kuyasiza ekuqhakambiseni okuqukethwe. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kweqoqo elihlangene, elibandakanya zonke lezi zici, ngoba okuqukethwe okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto eziningi. Isiphetho Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi abadala bokuqukethwe baqhubeke nokuba nomthelela emhlabeni jikelele. Ukudala okuqukethwe akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni izixhumanisi, ukuvusa intshiseko, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuhlobo. Emhlabeni osakhula ngokuqhubekayo, abantu badinga izindlela zokwakha, ukwabelana, nokuhlanganyela ukuze baphumelele. Ukudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile, futhi kumele kuhlale kubuyekezwa ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zababukeli, kuthuthukiswe ubuhlakani, futhi kugcinwe umoya wokuhlangenwe nakho.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini Ngaphakathi komhlaba osezingeni eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe, ukukhiqizwa kwemisebenzi kwashintsha kakhulu. Lokhu kuqala kwaziswa uThando, owayengumqondisi wezobuchwepheshe enkampanini enkulu yokukhiqiza. UThando wayenamaphupho amakhulu ngomsebenzi wakhe, kodwa wayefuna ukuthola izindlela zokwenza izinto zibe lula futhi zisebenze kahle. Ngemva kokufunda ngempumelelo ye-AI emikhakheni ehlukene, wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame ukuyisebenzisa ukuze athuthukise ukusebenza kwenkampani yakhe. UThando wanxusa umhlangano nabaphathi abaphezulu enkampanini, lapho echaza khona izinzuzo ezinkulu ze-AI. “Uma sithatha leli thuba,” kusho yena, “singakwazi ukuhlela imisebenzi yethu ngezindlela ezingakaze zenzeke phambilini. I-AI ingasiza ekutholeni izinkinga ezingase zibe khona, ithuthukise ikhwalithi yokukhiqiza, futhi ikhulise imali engenayo.” Abaphathi bahlala behlola uThando, bejabulile ngenkathi ethokozisa isithakazelo sabo. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-AI, uThando wanikela ngephrojekthi yokuhlola. Yena nabantu bakhe basebenzisana nezingcweti ze-AI ukuze bathole uhlelo olwakhelwe ukuba luthuthukise izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Uhlelo lwalufaneleka ngokukhethekile ezinqubweni zokuhlola, lapho ubuchwepheshe be-AI bengingaya khona ukususa imiphumela engalungile. Ngesikhathi uThando esebenzisa lezi zinhlelo, waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Imishini yokuqala iboniswa iidatha ezinkulu ezazitholakala ngempela, futhi lokho kwavula ithuba lokuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. UThando wabona ukuthi izinkampani ezahlukahlukene seziqalile ukufaka izinhlelo ezifanayo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi badinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze bangashiywa ngemuva. Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, uThando waqala ukuhlela ama-workshop ukuze afundise abasebenzi bakhe ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani i-AI. Abasebenzi baye bakhombisa ukulangazelela, bekubona lokhu njengendlela yokuthola amakhono amasha. UThando wathola ukuthi abantu abavame ukudideka nge-AI, benza ukungaqondi kahle. Kwaqhubeka isikhathi, waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinhle emsebenzini. Uhlelo lwe-AI lwaluhamba phambili, futhi imiphumela yalo yayiqhakaza. UThando wathola ukuthi izinkampani ezincane ziyaqhakaza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi lokho kwazisa uThando. “Siyaphila!” wakhuluma uzithokozisa. “I-AI iyasiza, kodwa kudingeka sibe nezinselelo ezithile. Kumele sithole indlela yokusebenza ndawonye nezinkampani ezincane.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThando wanquma ukwakha ubudlelwano nezinkampani ezincane ezisebenzisa i-AI, ukuze bathuthukise imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kwathokozisa izinkampani, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuxhumana. UThando wathola ukuthi ngempela, i-AI iyithuluzi elihle, kodwa abantu badinga ukuqonda imiphumela yalo. UThando waqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi i-AI ingabathinta kanjani. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThando waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukusebenza kwenkampani kwakukhula, futhi izinto zaziqhubeka kahle. Abasebenzi babejabule, futhi ukwanda kwemali kwaba yinto ejabulisayo. UThando wabona ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI zazingaphezu kokulindelekile. Yena nabanye abaphethe bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokusebenzisana, kodwa kudinga abantu abaqondayo. Ngesikhathi uqhubeka nesikhathi, uThando wathola ukuthi i-AI iyakwazi ukwakha amathuba amasha emsebenzini. Kwadingeka ukucatshangelwa okuphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bakhuliswa, futhi lokhu kwaba umgomo wakhe. UThando wathola ukuthi i-AI iyathinta wonke umuntu, inikeza amathuba awamukelwe kangcono. Ekugcineni, uThando wanquma ukuthi kufanele anakekele umphakathi, akhulume ngezinguquko ezenzakalayo. Waqala ukubamba izinkulumo eziningi ezikhuthaza abanye ukuba basebenzise i-AI, wabelana ngezinto ezinhle ezitholakele. Ukuze abanye bakwazi ukuphila kahle, uThando uvula iminyango yokufunda ezikhungweni zokufundisa. Kwakungasasekelwa uThando kuphela, kodwa izinkampani zabe seziqala ukwakha ubudlelwano. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudala izinhlelo ezichwepheshile, ezazithuthukisa imisebenzi emisha. UThando wabona ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI azizange zibe kuphela ezingxenyeni zomsebenzi, kodwa zafaka isandla ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezithinta umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, uThando wakhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa i-AI emsebenzini akukhona nje ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle, kodwa kuhlanganisa abantu, ubuchwepheshe, nezixazululo ezilungile. Umhlaba kaThando waba umhlaba omusha, lapho zonke izidingo zifinyeleleka, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba, umhlaba waba neziqu, ezazihamba phambili, ezazibhekwa nguThando nozakwabo. UThando waba yisibonelo sokuthi i-AI ingaguqula kanjani izimpilo zethu, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ubunyangamali bethu njengabantu.
Incazelo Yomcimbi: Umcimbi Wezokuthengisa – "Imisebenzi Nezinhlelo Zokuthengisa Ezintsha" Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wezokuthengisa uzobanjwa umcimbi omkhulu ozoqa umgudu wokuhlanganisa abathengisi, abacwaningi, nezimboni ezahlukahlukene ukuze baxoxe ngezindlela ezintsha, imikhuba, nezinsizakusebenza ezithinta ezokuthengisa. Lo mcimbi, ozoqala ngosuku lwesi-15 kuJanuwari 2024, uzoba seHhotela Lezokuphila eGoli, uhlanganisa abaholi abavela ezinkampanini ezinkulu, abathuthukisi bezobuchwepheshe, kanye nabathengisi abakha izixazululo ezisheshayo nezisemqoka ukuze bathole impumelelo. Umcimbi uzokwenza isikhala sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli nabakhangisi, uvula amathuba okudala ubudlelwane obusendabuko nolwakhiwo lwezinhlelo zokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo ezihlukahlukene zizoqhutshwa ngochwepheshe abanolwazi, behlola izindaba ezithinta izokuthengisa, njengokuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, indlela yokwakha umkhiqizo, nokubaluleka kokuxhumana nabathengi. Izingxenye zomcimbi zifaka izingxoxo, izifundo ezibukhoma, kanye nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abaphambili emhlabeni wezokuthengisa. Izingxoxo ezizokwenziwa zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimbonini ezahlukene bazokwazi ukuthola imibono emisha, befa iziqondisi nezindlela zokuphumelela ezinobuhlakani. NgoMgqibelo, lo mcimbi uzodlulisa ikhethini lokugcina lapho abathengisi bazoba nekhono lokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izimpendulo ezicacile nemibono emisha ukuze kuxhunywe nemikhiqizo yezinkampani ezihlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amathuba okuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani azokwakha ibhizinisi eligqugquzelayo emhlabeni okukhuluma ngempumelelo. Ngaphakathi kokuhlangana, umcimbi uzolalela izihloniphekile ezikhuluma ngezinto ezibucayi ezithinta izokuthengisa, ukujula kokuqonda okuhlobene nokuthengisa, nezindlela zokuhamba phambili kwakamuva. Uhlelo luzokwakhiwa ukuze lunikeze abahlanganyeli izinzuzo ezisheshwayo, ezingafaka izindlela ezingabo, izibonelo ezihamba phambili, nezindlela zokwengamela emhlabeni obunjwe ngabathengi abashintsha. Abalaleli bazoba nethuba lokukhetha izifundo ezithile ezifunekayo ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi futhi bakhe amasu aqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bazoba nokuheha ezimakethe zabo, okukhuthaza ukuhamba phambili komkhiqizo kanye nokusebenza kohlelo lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kokuphumelela komcimbi, kuzophinde kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa ezithinta abathengisi abasha, kube yithuba lokubakhuthaza ukuba babe ngabathengisi abaqavile esizweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsizwa ezintsha kanye nomoya wokuthuthukisa. Umcimbi uzokwazisa abathengisi mayelana nezinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze benze ukuthengisa kwabo kube nokusebenza okuhle kakhulu, bobuqu nemikhawulo abayithola emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwandiseni ibhizinisi, kudale umbono wokwakha okwamanje. Umgomo wethu ukwakha indawo yokuxhumana ezokuthengisa, ukuxhumanisa ulwazi nemibhikisho, okugqugquzela ukusebenzisana nokuqonda okukhulayo. Sinethemba lokuthi lo mcimbi uzoba nempumela ejabulisayo, okuhloswe ngayo ukwakha izimpendulo ezinemisebenzi emisha nokwenza ngcono amasu okuthengisa. Ababamba iqhaza bayamenywa, kanye nalabo abakhathazekile ngokuthengisa, ukuze basebenzise ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye abathengisi ezingakabalungeli. Ukuze uqophele imicimbi, sikhuthaza bonke ukuthumela izicelo zabo zokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhala sokukhuluma ezimeni ezithinta intuthuko yezokuthengisa, kanti ukuthola izixazululo ezinqala kuzoba yindlela eyodwa yokukhweza izinyathelo zokuthengisa ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Umcimbi uzobe ubukeka njengethuba lokubambisana okukhuthazayo, sibambisene ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wezezimali nezokuthengisa. Thina, kulindeleke ukuba sibe maphakathi nokuhlangenwe nakho kwemisebenzi emisha, bekhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obutsha nezinkulumo eziphumelela ngemibono ehluke ngokuphelele nezindlela ezithinta izokuthengisa. Sibheke phambili ekuthokoziseni abaphumelelayo futhi sizobona impumelelo aleli thuba. Kuhle kakhulu ukuba khona. Hamba nathi ukuze sikhule, sithuthuke, futhi sikhulume ngezinto ezithinta ubuhlakani bezokuthengisa ezikhanya. Izinhlelo, izixazululo, kanye nosizo olukhulu kufanele kuhlangane okukhuthazayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa elihle, eliphumelelayo ekuthengiseni.
Ukubhujiswa Kwendalo Ngenxa Kwezimpawu Zokumba Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngeNkanyezi, elaliseNingizimu Afrika, phakathi kwezintaba eziphakeme nezizungezile ezazivulekile emhlabeni. Abantu bahlala ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu, bezithokozisa ngezinsuku zabo zokusebenza emasimini nasemizimbeni yabo. Kwakukhanya ilanga, futhi imvula yayivame ukuhamba ngokwejwayelekile, izihlahla zikhula zikhazimula. Kodwa, kancane kancane, izimpawu zokuthuthukiswa zeqala ukuvela; izinkampani ezinkulu zezokumbwa zemali zafika, zifuna ukwakha izimayini ezinkulu ezizoholela emlandweni omubi. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthethwa, owayengumholi wesifunda. Wayenethemba lokuthi lezi zimayini zizoletha umnotho, zandise amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zikhulise izinga lempilo labantu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, waphakamisa izandla zakhe, wakhuluma emhlanganweni omkhulu, "Hamba, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile!" Abantu babemdumisa, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinzima bezama ukuthola imisebenzi. Kodwa, akuzange kube lula. UThandi, owayenothando lwemvelo, waba nezinselelo ezinzima. Wayebona izithiyo ezithile ezingaqondakali, ezazihamba phambili njengemibhalo emincane edlalayo. Waziqonda kahle ukuthi izimayini zabeziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuhlola umhlaba, kodwa wayezibuza ngokwengeziwe. "Ngabe lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo, noma kuyoba yisithiyo esizobangela ukubhujiswa kwemvelo?" Wayengaboni kahle, kodwa wayezwa umoya ungena ezindlebeni zakhe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umhlaba waqala ukuguquka. Kukhona njalo ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu, nakuba uMnumzane Mthethwa eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqinile. Izihlahla ezazimile ngesikhathi eside zaqala ukushabalala, amakhaza abamba izandla zawo emanzini ahlanzekile. Abantu abavunyelwe ukuhamba emathafeni, ngoba izinsuku zashintsha, izimayini zathinta nezindawo ezazikhula kahle. UThandi waba nesithukuthezi, futhi wathola ukuthi uzama ukuxhumana nabanye. UThandi wakhuluma noMnumzane Mthethwa, wathi, "Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane, kodwa kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo. Lokhu okwenziwayo kuzoziphendulela, kubalulekile uthando lokuthola izimali, kodwa akufanele sigcine ukuphila kwethu." Ubuze, "Ngabe uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu uma sishiya imvelo yethu ibhujiswe?" UMnumzane Mthethwa wagxila, kodwa wayezwa imizwa kaThandi. Wabona ukuthi abantu benza izinqumo eziphusile, kudinga ukuthi babe nezinqumo eziphusile. Ngakho, wathi, "Ngithanda ukuthola izimpendulo ezithile. Ngizokwenza ucwaningo, sizohamba, sizobona." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wahlangana nezinye izakhamuzi, bahlanganyela amehlo abo emhlabeni, behlanganyela ngezinkumbulo zabo. Bakha umphakathi ophusile, owabe ubopha izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Bahlela imihlangano, benza izimemezelo, bexoxisana ngezinkinga ezinzima ezibhekene nabo. Bafunda ngobuhlungu obuphuma ezinsukwini ezedlule, baphendula izinqumo ezinzima. Izinyanga zashintsha, izimayini zaqhubeka nokumba, kodwa abantu baqhubeka nokushumayela. UThandi wagcina enza umkhankaso ophumelelayo, wagcina edume njengomholi ophakeme. Abantu bayeza begijima, bevuma ukuvikela umhlaba, bezama ukuhlanganyela izimfuno zabo. Ngenkathi izimayini ziqhubeka, indawo eyaziwa ngothando nolwazi, ikhululeke, yaphila. UMnumzane Mthethwa wathola ukuthi imiphumela yayinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu babezolile, behamba phambili, beqonda ukuthi imvelo iyinhliziyo. UThandi waphakanyiswa njengezwi, efuna ukusindisa izwe lakhe. Njengoba izimayini ziqhubeka, kwaba nezinkinga ezinzima, kodwa abantu babemangaliseka, becela ukusiza, bephakamisa izwi labo. Ekugcineni, uThandi wakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawubophele izinkumbulo. Abantu babefunda, bephila ngempilo emnandi, behlonipha imvelo yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi imiphumela yokukhuthaza izimayini ibiyinqaba, kodwa ubudlelwane obuqinile nesimo sokubambisana bahlala bukhona. Izimayini zazingenza abantu bakhumbule ukuthi ukugcina imvelo kuyisimo esibalulekile, kunikeza impilo esikhathini esizayo. Ngaleyo ndlela, uThandi waba umholi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokuxhumana nezwe labo. Izimayini zaba yindaba yokufunda, bahamba phambili, futhi le ndaba ibalulekileyo yatholwa phakathi kwesigaba sabantu, ihlanganisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokugcina imvelo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi izwi elivulekile lingaguqula umhlaba, futhi umphakathi ungalweba amandla awo ukuze uvikele umhlaba eminyakeni ezayo.
Izindatshana Zokubuyekezwa: Ezokusakaza Ezokusakaza, okuyindlela yokuhambisa ulwazi, ubuciko nemidlalo emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, zidlale indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi osahlangene. Lokhu akukhulu nje kuphela mayelana nemithombo yezokuxhumana, kodwa kuwukuxhumana okusemqoka okuhlanganyela abantu, kugqugquzela ukuhlonipha ukuphila kwabanye, nokuqonda izimo ezihlukene. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha kwemithombo, sizobheka izici ezibalulekile zezakhiwo zokubuyekezwa, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nazo. Ukwakheka Kwezakhiwo Ezokusakaza ziqala ngezinhlelo ezilawulwa ngendlela ethile, kuhlinzekwa ngezinhlelo ezithile ezitholwa eziteshini zozimele, iziteshi zikamabonakude, nezinye izithombe zedijithali. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bezwi, obuhlanganisa izikhangiso, izinhlelo zokuhlola umphakathi, nezinhlelo zokucobelela izindaba. Izinhloso zalesi sici zisekelwe ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuphawula izinkinga ezikhona nesixazululo esinokwenzeka. Izinhlelo Nezithombe Ezitholakala Ngendlela Ehlukile Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa zigcizelela umqondo wokudlulisela ulwazi ngendlela ehlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxoxisana, ezithinta ezombusazwe, ezokwelapha, nezemidlalo. Uhlelo lwezindaba lungaba nezingxenye eziphawulekayo ezikhiqizwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezifana nezithombe ezigcwele, izinhlelo zokuphila, neziqubu ezibhalwe kahle. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa zidinga ukugxila ezinhlekweni zamhlanje, ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zababukeli, nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwezinhloso eziphakanyisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Ngenkathi ezokusakaza zikhula, ubuchwepheshe b balahlekelwa kubangelwa ukuguquka kwezindlela zokuxhumana. Izinhlelo ezidumile zemithombo yedijithali, njengezinhlelo zokwakha izithombe, zikhulisa ukuzibandakanya kwabantu. Izinhlelo ezingekho kumabonakude ziba nezici ezigxile kumaphrojekthi ahluke, abafuna ukufinyelela emishinini yokukhishwa. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokusakaza, kakhulukazi emiphakathini engashintshashintshi, iyefana neziteshi ezihlukene, i-podcasting, namahlelo edijithali. Izinzuzo Zokubuyekezwa Izinzuzo zezakhiwo zokubuyekezwa azilandelwa kuphela imiphumela emihle, kodwa ziba yinzuzo eminingi kumphakathi. Zisiza ekwakhiweni kwemibono, njengoba kuboniswa ngamandla nezinhlelo ezihlukene. Ukuhlola kwabaphromothi kudala isimo sokucabanga kakhulu okuyisidingo samasiko akhona. Ukwazi okuphelele kuhlinzekwa kumphakathi ngokuba nemithombo emisha, ekhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka indawo yokuhambelana kwezinhlaka ezihambisanayo, kusekela izehlo zomphakathi, kanye nezimpumelelo emkhakheni wezamasiko. Izingozi Ezihambisana Nezokusakaza Nokho, akukuphiki ukuthi siziphatha njengokusemthethweni, sicabanga ngezingozini ezithile ezihambisana nezokusakaza. Ukuhweba ngolwazi olungelona iqiniso, izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa komphakathi, kanye nokusabalalisa izikhumbuzo ezingcolile kukhulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzoba nephakathi kokwenza izinqumo ezinzima kulowomkhakha olwakhiwe ngesezindleleni zokubambisana. Kubakhona ukukhathazeka kokuthi ukudluliswa kolwazi kungaphazanyiswa, kudale ukuphazamiseka kokuphila komphakathi uma kungalawulwa kahle. Isiphetho Nendlela Phambili Ngokubheka ensukwini ezinzima, ezokusakaza zifanele ukubhekwa njengomkhakha ohloniphekile ogqugquzela umphakathi. Izidingo zihlala zivaleka, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abawazi ukuthi bahlale beziqhuba. Ukuvika ukuphazamiseka, umphakathi kufanele ubenze bonke abantu kube nomthelela osemqoka, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi kube nezingxoxo ezinemibono enkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezinokwenzeka, kubaluleke okwandayo, ukuze kuthi ekugcineni, ulwazi ludlule kweziphakamiso ezinhle zomphakathi. Ezokusakaza, uma kusebenza kahle, kungaba yinsika eqinile yokuxhumanisa abantu abahlukene, kulandela umkhondo osbingazile, oda emhlabeni wonke. Kumele siqhubeke nayo le ndlela, siphile ezingeni elilungile, siphanculela ikusasa eliqhakazile nesithombe esihle sempilo yomphakathi.
uMark Zuckerberg Ngasekuqaleni kwenkulungwane ye-21, emakhaya ase-United States, kwavela umntwana obizwa ngoMark Zuckerberg. UMark wazalwa ngonyaka ka-1984 eWhite Plains, eNew York. Ubephila nomndeni oshukumisayo, unina noBaba bembamba njengezikhungo zempilo, bekhuthaza uMark ukuba azifundele kahle. Esemncane, uMark waba nesiphiwo esikhethekile ekubhaleni izinhlelo. Wazifundela ukubhala ama-computer programs, ethandwa kakhulu ukuqonda ngokujulile indlela i-Intanethi esebenza ngayo. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole samabanga aphansi, uMark wajoyina i-Harvard University, eyaziwa njengenye yeziqu eziphezulu emhlabeni. EHarvard, uthole ubungcweti ngemfundo yezobuchwepheshe, kodwa akakaze athathe kuqala ukuzinza nesikole, ngoba iphupho lakhe kwakuwukwakha into ethile ezojabulisa abantu ezehlukeneyo. Ngenxa yalesi siphiwo, uMark wawujabulela kakhulu umoya wezobuchwepheshe nokuqhamuka nezinselele ezintsha. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uMark pawina umcabango owawujulile; yaqhamuka ipulatifomu yokuxhumana ebizwa ngeFacebook. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babengakatholi kahle umqondo wezokuxhumana ngempela, kungekho okwakufana neFacebook. UMark wahlanganisa izinqubo ezithile nezindlela zokwakha ukuthi abantu baxhumane kalula, bekhuluma, futhi babelane ngempilo yabo. Ngamaphepha avuma, iFacebook yathandwa ngokushesha, yakhula yaba yinsiza enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. I-Facebook yayingenakuchazwa nje ngaphezulu kokuxhumana okwenziwa phakathi kwabantu; yayivumela ukuqanjwa kwesiko yokuxhumana. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, abantu baanjengomama, abantu abasha, nabantu abadala babebamba iqhaza ekuhlanganyeleni. UMark wayengeyena uMongameli kuphela weFacebook, kodwa waba ngumholi ozinikele ekuqhubekeni kwezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba uFacebook usuthola impumelelo, uMark waze wahamba phambili emkhakheni wezindaba zenjini yokusesha, ekwazi ukwakha ibhizinisi elikhulayo. Ngenxa yokwandiswa kweFacebook, uMark waba nempumelelo ethokozisayo. Kodwa, ngemuva kokuba sephumelele, waqala ukuqhamuka nezinkinga. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bephikisa izinto ezithile ezenzakalayo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlasela ebudlelwaneni bomuntu siqu. UMark waba nesihloko esinzima sokuthi uqhubeke nokwakha iFacebook, abhekane nezinkinga ezinzima zokuvikela ubumfihlo babantu. Lezi zinkinga zaba yizimpikiswano ezimnyama phakathi kokukhula kweFacebook kubantu. Kodwa uMark akazange ayeke. Uhlale ebheke phambili, enganqikazi, athi "Sizofunda futhi sithuthukise." Noma izinkinga ezazivukile, uMark wabonisa ukuzimisela okuqinile nokulangazelela ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ubumfihlo, futhi wagedla isikhathi esiningi efunda indlela yokuphatha umphakathi ukuze uFacebook uhlale uthokozisa abantu. Njengoba izindlela zoxhumano zithuthuka, uMark waphinde waqala ukuzama izinto ezintsha. Waqhubeka ehamba phambili, ehamba phambili nezobuchwepheshe, futhi wahamba phambili ngokuqhubekayo nezinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi. Wazibandakanya nezinye izinto ezinzima ezifana nezokuhlola imvelo, ukuhlola izixazululo zokwakha umphakathi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhulisa ubudlelwano bokuqala. UMark Zuckerberg akakaze abekezelele impumelelo yakhe, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, wagxila emiphumeleni engena kuFacebook. Ngalesi sikhathi, wavula umnyango wezinhlelo ezinkulu zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi embalwa ngemali ethile eyayiphuma emithonjeni emazwe, ezama ukusiza abantu abangaphandle kukaFacebook. UMark wayekholwa kakhulu ekuboleni kwansuku zonke, futhi wathambisa ukucabanga ukuthi ubumfihlo, ubulungiswa, nokuxhumana kufanele kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngemuva konyaka ka-2020, lapho umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, uMark wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iFacebook ifaka umoya omusha wokwakha ubudlelwano. Lokhu kwadlalwa kuze kube yimali yenzuzo ewusizo kubantu. UMark wakwazi ukugqugquzela umoya wokuhlala phansi, enza abavakashi abanezimpendulo ezizwakalayo, befunda nezinkinga ezinkude. Lokhu waholela ekwakheni imoya yokuxhumana kwangempela phakathi kwabantu, evumelana nokuxhumana okwenziwe nge-intanethi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMark Zuckerberg waba isithombe esiphilayo sokuhola okuzinzile nobuchwepheshe, wenza ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu, imiphakathi, nezinkampani. Kube sengathi uMark usubeke isibonelo somuntu ophumelelayo, okhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhe imiphakathi emisha, bamemezele izinqubo ezintsha nenzuzo ngenjongo yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba uMark eqhubeka nokusebenza, sikubona kahle ukuthi, semncane okhalela wakhe, kuhlezi kumina kahle. Ngeke simphule umoya, kodwa ukuqhubeka kokusebenza kwakhe kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungashintsha uma sizaqhubeka sizicabangela, sihlanganise izindaba ezithokozisayo nezinsiza zokwakha. Ngakho-ke, lokhu akukhona kuphela okunomthelela emaqinisweni omphakathi, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ubunkulunkulu bokuxhumana kwabantu. UMark Zuckerberg, umholi ongaguquki, ungakaze akholwe ukuthi ukuphumelela kwakhe kuzokhanya empilweni yabantu. Ufundisa imihla ngemihla ukuthi uma sithanda ukuxhumana, kufanele sibe nokuqonda kokuhlanganyela. Yikho okuhloswe ngakho ekuphileni, ukwakha ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganisa umhlaba. Njengoba uhamba phambili, uMark usenalo umqondo owenza abanye baphokophele ukukhula, baneliseke ngezinga lokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi, enkulu kangakanani imbangi, uma izinto zenziwa ngezinhloso ezihle, umphakathi ungashintsha futhi uphumelele. UMark Zuckerberg, empeleni, umbono wokwakha umhlaba onobuchule obuhlukahlukene.
Umbiko: Ubugebengu Emiphakathini Isingeniso Ubugebengu emiphakathini buye baba yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinga lobugebengu lihlala liphezulu. Le nkinga ithinta wonke umuntu, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ungubani, futhi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuba sihlole izimbangela, izindlela zokuqeda ubugebengu, kanye nezinyathelo zokubuyisela umphakathi ophilayo. Izimbangela Zobugebengu Emiphakathini Ubugebengu buvame ukuba nemvelaphi ehlukahlukene. Okwokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele kubangela abantu abaningi ukuba baphenduke ezindleleni eziphikisana nomthetho ukuze bazuze. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, ezifana nokungabi nalutho, ukungathembeki kwabantu, kanye nokungabi nokuhlala kahle, kukhuthaza ubugebengu. Okwesibili, imiphakathi enokungabi nalwazi nokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifanele yokuphila kahle ivamise ukuba nenkinga yokukhula kobugebengu. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, imithetho, kanye nemiphumela yokuphula umthetho. Ukwanda Kwezindlela Zobugebengu Ngokuphambene, ubugebengu emiphakathini buyanda. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ububi bukhula ngezinga elikhulayo, kanti izigameko ezifana nokweba, ukuhlasela, nezidakamizwa zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuthinta imindeni, abantwana, nabantu abadala, futhi kuholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga ezengeziwe ezifana nokungabi nempilo, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokukhathazeka. Izindlela zokuphila eziholela ekwandeni kobugebengu ziqukethe nezindlela zokuphathwa kwemali, izinhlelo zokuphila, nokutholakala kwezinsiza. Izikhungo zokuhlala eziphucuzekile, izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi zidingeka ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobugebengu. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Umphakathi Ukuze kuphumelele ekulweni nobugebengu, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlobene nezimfuno zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabahlali. Izinhlelo ezifana nezifundo zokuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela izingane zingasiza kakhulu. Imiphakathi kufanele ibambisane neziphathimandla ukuze kwakhiwe izinhlelo zokuphepha ezihlukile ezifanele izidingo zabo. Imithetho kufanele ibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayazi kahle imithetho nemiphumela yokuphula le mithetho. Ukubuyisela Umphakathi Ophilayo Ukubuyisela umphakathi ophilayo kudinga ukuzimisela kwabantu bonke. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukwakha isithunzi somphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abangelwe ubugebengu. Izikhungo zokuxhaswa, ezokwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlala kahle kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kuphumelelwe ekubuyiseni impilo emiphakathini ethintekayo. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngendawo abahlala kuyo, futhi kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi nezikhungo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukulwa nobugebengu. Isiphetho Ubugebengu emiphakathini buye baba yinkinga enkulu, kodwa ngezinqumo eziphusile nezinqubo ezinhle, singenza umehluko. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kusukela kubahlali kuya eziphathimandleni, abambisane ukuze kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokulwa nobugebengu. Ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Umphakathi onjalo ungaba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, ukuhlangana nokusebenza ndawonye kungaholela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siphakamise izwi lethu, siphakamise imiphakathi yethu, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlale bephila ngokuhambisana nemithetho yezwe. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sibe nomoya wokubambisana, uthando, nokwazisa omunye nomunye. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi obumbene, ophilayo futhi ophumelelayo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezinselelo Ezimfundisweni eziningi, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kube yinkinga esikhathini eside. Izinkanyezi zempilo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane zihlala zihluphekile, zishaywa, noma zihlukunyezwa. Lokhu akukhona nje ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kuyinkinga ebanzi ethinta izindawo eziningi emhlabeni. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akugcini ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, kodwa kuhlanganisa futhi ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomoya, ngokwengqondo, nangokwezimali. Isahluko 2: Izizathu Zokuhlukunyezwa Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka ubunzima bezomnotho, izinkinga zempilo, kanye nezinkinga zomndeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolelo zamasiko nezinkolo zineqhaza elikhulu ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa. Ezinye izindawo zikholelwa ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyindlela yokufundisa, kanti abanye bacabanga ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe nezibopho ezinzima ukuze zifunde. Isahluko 3: Izimpawu Zokuhlukunyezwa Izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu, futhi zidinga ukuba zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zikhombisa izimpawu ezifana nokukhathazeka, ukungabi nendaba, noma ukungathandi ukuhamba nabantu. Ezinye zikhombisa izimpawu zomzimba, njengezibazi noma izilonda, kanti ezinye zikhombisa izimpawu zokuhlukumezeka ngokomoya, njengezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuqaphela lezi zimpawu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola usizo oludingekayo. Isahluko 4: Umthelela Wokuhlukunyezwa Umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ungaba mkhulu. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo ziba nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni yazo, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, ukungabi nempilo, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana nabanye. Umthelela ungadlulela ezizukulwaneni, njengoba izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingaba nabazali abahlukunyezayo, okuholela kumjikelezo ongenamkhawulo. Isahluko 5: Ukulwa Nokuhlukunyezwa Kubuhlungu umphakathi ukuba uqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akwamukelekile. Ukuze silwe nalolu daba, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubazali, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kumele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola usizo oludingekayo. Isahluko 6: Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokukhuluma ngale nkinga. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kudingeka sibe nezingxoxo ezivulekile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baveze izinkinga zabo, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Izingane zidinga ukuba zizwe ziphephile, zikhululekile, futhi zihlale zikhuluma ngezinto ezibakhathazayo. Isahluko 7: Isiphetho Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu, futhi kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo ophusile. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuvikela izingane zethu, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizoba nesikhathi esinzima sokulwa nale nkinga. Izingane zethu zifanele ukuphila impilo enempilo, enothando, futhi ephephile. Ngakho-ke, masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lezingane zethu, sikhuthaze uthando, nokuhlonipha.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Uhlanga Lokuthuthukiswa Nezimphetho Zokufundisa Ukwazi umhlaba wemidlalo yevidiyo kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, njengoba lezi zinhlelo zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yosuku nosuku. Imidlalo yevidiyo yemukelwa kakhulu, futhi isakaza umqondo wezokuxhumana, ukuzijabulisa, kanye nezifundo kumalungu omphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuhle nemiphumela emibi yemidlalo yevidiyo, kubalulekile ukuqonda umlando wazo, izakhiwo zabo, kanye nendlela ezisiza ngayo ekwakheni amakhono ahlukene kubadlalayo. Imidlalo yevidiyo iqale ukuvela emashumini eminyaka edlule, igxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezikwi-computer ezisebenza ngezithombe ezihambelayo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinhlelo zaziwe ngekhwalithi yayo yokusebenza, ukudala umoya wokudlala, nokusebenza kube yinto ephawulekayo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo yanwetshwa yaba nezinhlobo eziningi, okuhlanganisa imidlalo yezenzakalo, imidlalo yokudlala ngempumelelo, imidlalo yokuhlola, kanye nezinhlobo ezivamile ezisebenziyo, okwenza kumenyezelwe izithombe ezihlukahlukene. Kubalulekile futhi ukufaka izici zamakhono ekudlaleni kwemidlalo yevidiyo. Imidlalo ethuthukisa amakhono kufanele ihlukaniswe phakathi kwemidlalo ethuthukisa umcabango, efana nemidlalo yokuhlola, nokuthi imidlalo ethokozisayo, efana nemidlalo yokulwa. Imidlalo ethuthukisa umcabango ifaka phakathi izinhlelo ezicacile zokusebenzisa izinqumo ezithuthukile, izixazululo zezinkinga, nokwenza ngcono ukucabanga okulungile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukufana nezindlela ezivamile zokufundisa, okusho ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokufundisa ehloniphekile nempumelelo. Ikakhulukazi, imidlalo yevidiyo idlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubandakanya abantu emidlalweni, kudaleka ithuba lokuxhumana, ukubambisana, nokwakha imiphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza ngokujulile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho imidlalo yevidiyo ingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokuxhumana okwakha ubuhlobo obujulile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Izinkundla zokuxhumana nezingosi zokuxhumana, ezikhiqiza imiphakathi, zakhayo ukukhulisa ukuthi abantu bangaba sezinhlakeni ezahlukene. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanyayo. Imidlalo yevidiyo, lapho ibonakala njengewumbuso wokuzijabulisa, ibuye ibe nezingcuphe nemiphumela emibi. Ukuze kube neqhaza lokukhula, kunemithetho ethile okufanele ilandelwe. Ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ekukhubazeni, ukwenza abantu baxhamaze kakhulu, futhi kuphazamise imikhuba yokuziphatha. Ngaphakathi kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuba nemikhawulo ethile yokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola izimo zomphakathi nabantu abadlalayo kuye kwakhomba ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingaba nomthelela ongemuhle ekuziphatheni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziqathaniswa nezimo ezithile ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola ngokucophelela, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuthi izici zokuhluka zihlala zikhona phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yevidiyo ifaka izifundo ezibucayi empilweni yethu, futhi kubalulekile ukunakekela izici ezintathu eziyinhloko: ukwakhiwa kwezimo zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, nokuhlola imiphumela emibi. Ubulungiswa bokusebenzisa imidlalo yevidiyo njengendlela yokufundisa, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, kudinga ubuqotho, ukuqonda, kanye nomcabango ophusile. Ngokufaka imidlalo yevidiyo ezinhlelweni zethu zokufunda, sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nokuqonda nobuchwepheshe obuxhumene nempilo yansuku zonke ngokwenza isinqumo esifanele ngaphambi kokudlula emhlabeni ongokwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsika ebalulekile yokubambisana, ukufunda, nokwakha ubudlelwane. Ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule, bheka iziko lemidlalelo njengendlela eyodwa yokwakha ikusasa elihloniphekile, elinemibono, kanye nezeluleko ezihle. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuhamba phambili ngengqondo yokufanisa, ukukhathalela, nokuhlonipha imiphakathi elokhu ibhalwa njalo. Imidlalo yevidiyo akuyona nje umculo wokuphila, kodwa iyinsika esiza ekwakheni umhlaba onobuchwepheshe nemigomo ecacile.
Ibhola Lombhoxo: Uhlanga Oluhlukile Lokudlalwa Kwezemidlalo Ibhola lombhoxo, noma i-rugby, luhlobo lwezemidlalo oluthokozisa inhliziyo nezithakazelo zabantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Njengoba uhamba emazweni ahlukahlukene, uzothola iziteshi ezilungiselelwe umphakathi, izinkundla zokudlalela, nezinhlangano ezikhandlayo zokuqhakambisa lesi sikhathi esithe xaxa. Nokho, ukuzibandakanya kwebhola lombhoxo kuwukuhluka okukhulu uma siqhathanisa neminye imidlalo, njengoba kudinga isimo esikhethekile sokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuqina. Kuyinto ejwayelekile ukusho ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo linyusa umoya wokubambisana. Esikhathini esithile, imidlalo ibonisa ukuthi kusemthethweni ukuhamba phambili, ukulwa, nokufinyelela emaphusheni. Kulabo abakhuthele emkhakheni wezokudlalela, kuyinto yokwakha futhi yokuxhumana, njengoba abadlali bahlala behlangene, bejolise ethimbeni. Okwamanje, abaphakanyisi bemidlalo benza imizamo eqhubekayo yokuthuthukisa isithakazelo kulaba abancane. Lokhu kusebenza kwenziwa ngokubandakanya izikole, izikhungo, kanye nemithombo yabantu, okwenza umphakathi uzizwe unozwelo nolwaziyo. Ngizokubona kuhle ukufundisa izingane ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo akusekho nje ukukhangwa kwelukuluku, kodwa kuyinsiza eqhubekayo yokwakha izimiso zempilo. Ubuqu, ngithanda ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo linomqondo ohlukile wokuhlala kude nemiphumela engase ibe yingozi yokuphikisana kwezinsiza noma ukungqubuzana okuholela emiphumeleni emibi. Kukhona amathuba okuba imidlalo ihlukaniswe phakathi kwezinsizi, emathubeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Abadlali badinga ukuhlela, balandele imithetho, futhi bahlale bejolise emiphumeleni yabo, ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela. Singenza kumodi eyinhloko yokuhlalisana kwempilo, esebenza kahle kanjalo, nokuhloniphana kwamabhola. Mina, ngizizwa ngithokoziswa kakhulu ngezakhiwo ezitholakala kubadlali abasha, ikakhulukazi ngaholo ngosuku lokugcina lwezilingo. Kuhlukile ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo liziphendukela kanjani uma lihlala lidlalwa ngokuzikhandla neqiniso. Abafana nabesifazane bahlala bejabulile, bezama ukuveza amakhono abo phambi kwabathandi, bahlala bejolise ekhanda emiphumeleni. Izici zokubambisana, ukuhlanganiswa, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabo zikhona lusizo lokwazi umphumela wezokugcina. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yamandla, ibhola lombhoxo linethezekile kakhudlwana phakathi kwelanga lokuhlukunyezwa. Abadlali benza umkhankaso wokuvikela impilo yabo ngokuzikhandla, bawela ukhayanda kuzona zonke izimfuno zokuphila. Lokhu akubalulekile kuphela emiphakathini yamahlaya, kodwa futhi kuhlomula kuwo wonke umuntu odlalayo, ngaleso sikhathi besebenzisa imizamo yabo ibe nomthelela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ibhola lombhoxo liwumnotho obalulekile, ugqozi lokusungula ukwaziswa nokulungele, kanti lesi sikhala singase sibe yindlela yokukhuthaza nokuqinisa imiphakathi. Abaphathiswa bezemidlalo bagxile ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa umphakathi, bakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izifundo, kanye nokuqinisa ukuzimela kumphakathi. Ngakho, ibhola lombhoxo akukhona ukuthokozisa alone, kodwa kuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza izinzuzo eziningi emiphakathini. Ngokuqhubekayo, uma sifuna ukuhlola ibhola lombhoxo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi yizingcweti zabantu, ikakhulukazi abasafufusa, ezenza sikwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizayo. Uhlanga okukholwa yinsakavukela, futhi lokho kuyisithako esingafeni njengoko belingakhononda. Ngakho, ibhola lombhoxo alikhumbuli, kodwa likhulisa imbiza yama-spirits, livenza sithokoze. Ekupheleni, ibhola lombhoxo liphila phakathi kwezinkunzi ezinamandla, nokuveza imiphumela eyindlala kumphakathi. Kuhle ngesikhathi sethu, ukuba sizigcine sonke, sizihlanganyele, futhi sikhankase ngabobonke. Abadlali, abathandi, nabaphakanyisi badinga ukukhuthaza umoya wokudlalela, ukunqa izinselelo, nokuqhubeka ngekapa lesi sikhathi. Ibhola lombhoxo iyinsika eyingqayizivele yokuhlangana komphakathi, ubudlelwano, kanye namakhono avusa umoya, kanti iqhubeka nokuhola kuzo zonke izindawo ezinhle zokuphila.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni: Isimo Esididayo Ezweni Lethu Isingeniso Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi eNingizimu Afrika, enezinhlobonhlobo zemiphumela emphakathini nasemnotho. Kulolu cwaningo, sizobheka umlando, izimbangela, izimpawu, nemiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo zokulwa nalolu hlobo lwesimo. Umlando Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni eNingizimu Afrika ayisiyona into entsha. Ibangelwa yizimo zomlando ezahlukene, okubandakanya ubuhlanga, ukuhwebelana kwemali, kanye nokungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinamandla. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuzimela ngo-1994, ubuholi bokuqala babhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isithombe sibe sibi ngenxa yokungathembeki kwabaphathi. Izimbangela Zenkohlakalo Izimbangela zenkohlakalo ziningi futhi zihluke. Okokuqala, izikhala ezivumela ukuziphatha kabi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Imihola ephakeme, ukuntuleka kokubekwa kwentela, kanye nezinsongo zokungabi nezimo ezihle, kudala amathuba okwenza okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukungabikho kokubeka obala nokuqapha kwemisebenzi yomphakathi kuholela ekubeni kube lula ukwenza inkohlakalo. Izimpawu Zenkohlakalo Izimpawu zenkohlakalo kuhulumeni zibonakala ezindleleni eziningi. Isibonelo, ukusungulwa kwezinkampani zomphakathi ezithola izinkontileka ezinkulu, noma ukungena ezikhungweni ezizimele ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezithinta izinjongo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphathe amaholo aphezulu ngokubambisana nezinyunyana, kanti abanye abantu bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Izimpawu zingabonakaliswa nasekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezingafanele, lapho abanye bephatha izinqumo ngendlela engalungile. Imiphumela Yenkohlakalo Imiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni ibonakala ekuthuthukisweni kwezobuchwepheshe, emnotweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ukwanda kwenkohlakalo kuholela ekuncipheni kokufaka imali ezweni, okubangela umphakathi uthole imiphumela engalindelekile. Lokhu kubangela ukudumazeka phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaholi bembula ukuthi izinqumo zabo zenzelwe izinzuzo zabo kuphela. Ukuqashwa okuphakeme nokunganelisekile kuholela ekubeni abantu bacabange kabusha ngezinto abazifunayo empilweni. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkohlakalo Ukuze sihlule inkohlakalo, kudingeka izinyathelo ezicacile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezisekela ukuphepha komphakathi zikhona, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubika, kanye nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokulwa nenkohlakalo kubalulekile. Uhlelo lokuhlola izinqumo zomphakathi kanye nokubandakanya imiphakathi ezinqumweni kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukwakha imithombo enomthelela emiphakathini kungasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Isiphetho Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eqhubekayo eNingizimu Afrika, ethinta bonke futhi ichaphazela impilo yansuku zonke. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuqiniswa kwemithetho ukuze sithole uhulumeni onokholo. Ngalendlela, singakha izifunda ezinzima ezisiza bonke abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu. Ukuhlola impumelelo yokulwa nenkohlakalo kuzobe kuhlale kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi uzithokozise empilweni yabo.
Uphuthu: Iphrofayela kaMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa Uphuthu, igama elihloniphekile elihambisana nezimpilo zabantu abaninzi, lihlala lishaya emqondweni wethu uma sikhuluma ngamasiko nezinkolelo zethu. Kulesi sihloko, sizogxila kumuntu ophawulekayo, uMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa, owayengumholi emphakathini, umfundisi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukwakhiwa Komuntu UMnumzane Thulani wazalelwa edolobheni elincane laseMpumalanga, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ophilayo ngezindlela zendabuko. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo zamasiko lwasungulwa esebancane, lapho ababephila khona imikhuba yamaZulu, efaka phakathi imicimbi yokugubha izinkanyezi, izinkanyezi zamasiko, nezinkolelo ezijulile. UThulani wayehlala ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezindaba ezithokozisayo ezazihambisana nezimpilo zabantu bakubo. Imfundo Nezimpumelelo Ngemva kokuphothula isikole samabanga aphansi, uThulani waqhubeka nemfundo yakhe esikoleni samabanga aphezulu, lapho athola khona iziqu zezemfundo eziphakeme. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe ezikoleni eziphezulu, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts. UThulani wayengumfundi ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni athole izikhundla ezihloniphekile emkhakheni wezokuphatha. Umsebenzi Wokukhonza Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThulani waqala umsebenzi wakhe wokukhonza emphakathini. Waqala njengomfundisi, lapho afundisa khona izingane ezincane ngamasiko nezinkolelo zethu. UThulani wayengumfundisi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokuzinikela kwakhe ekufundiseni. Uthando lwakhe lokufundisa lwamkhuthaza ukuba abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, lapho ahola khona imikhankaso yokukhuthaza imfundo, impilo, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Uphakathi Nezinkolelo Uphuthu, njengomholi, wayengumuntu ophawulekayo emiphakathini. UThulani wayehlala ebamba imicimbi yokuhlanganyela, efaka phakathi imikhosi yokugubha izinkanyezi, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bahloniphe izinkolelo zabo. UThulani wayephinde abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokuphila, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ukwamukela Izinguquko Ngesikhathi sokushintsha kwezikhathi, uThulani wayehlale elungele ukwamukela izinguquko. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi wathatha izinyathelo zokufundisa umphakathi wakhe ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Waqala izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu abadala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi wakhe ube nekhono lokuxhumana, nokwandisa amathuba okuthola imfundo. Uphuthu Njengomholi Uphuthu, njengomholi, wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, onobuhlakani bokuhola abantu. UThulani wayehlala ethokozisa abanye, futhi wayengumuntu onothando, owayezama ukusiza abanye. Uthando lwakhe lokukhonza lwamkhuthaza ukuba abe nesandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. Isiphetho Uphuthu, uMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa, ungumuntu ophawulekayo emiphakathini, owayengumholi, umfundisi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo zamasiko, imfundo, nokukhonza kwenze waba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. UThulani uhlala esikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngothando, ukuzinikela, nokuhola, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo luhlala lukhanya, futhi luhlala lukhumbuleka emiphakathini, njengomholi ophumelelayo.
Izinsiza Zamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka: Indaba Yomlando Emikhakheni eminingi yempilo, amanzi abe yinsika ebalulekile, evula amathuba okuphila. Abantu bokuqala bahlala eduze kwemithombo yamanzi efana nemifula, izigodi, nezilwandle, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulokho okwakubalulekile empilweni. Ukuphila eduzane namanzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga eziphathelene nokungahlanzeki. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, izinkinga zokuhlanzeka zaba yisithiyo esikhulu emadolobheni asathuthuka. Izindawo eziningi zazingenazo izinhlelo ezilungile zokuphatha amanzi, futhi abantu babesahlala ezindaweni ezihlala khona izinkanyezi, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezifana necholera ne-typhoid, okwadala ukufa kwabantu abaningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi nabaphathi baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. UJohn Snow, udokotela waseNgilandi, waba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqondeni ukuthi izifo ezithile zixhumene nokungcola kwamanzi. Ngemva kokuhlola izimo ezahlukene, wathola ukuthi umthombo wamanzi owawusetshenziswa abantu bendawo waba yindlela yokudlulisela izifo, futhi lapho umthombo uhlanzekile, izifo zancipha. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile angasiza ekuvikeleni izifo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka zathuthuka. Emadolobheni amaningi, kwasungulwa izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi ahlanzekile kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha udoti. Izindlu zakhuliswa, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Izikhungo zempilo zaba nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ngalezi zindaba, zikhuthaza imikhuba emihle yokuhlanzeka. Ngemva kweminyaka, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili yabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka. Amazwe amaningi aqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esiyinhloko, hhayi kuphela empilweni yabantu, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Izinhlelo ezinkulu zokuhambisa amanzi zathuthukiswa, futhi izikhungo zempilo zathola uxhaso olukhulu ukuze ziqhubeke nokwakha imikhuba emihle yokuhlanzeka. Namuhla, sikhumbula ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile sokuphila, hhayi kuphela emadolobheni nakumakhaya, kodwa nasezindaweni zokuhlala, zomphakathi, nezokusebenza. Nokho, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Kunezindawo eziningi emhlabeni ezisathola ubunzima ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka azikafinyeleli kubo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphila kwethu kuxhumene kakhulu nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sifundisa, siphakamise izinga lokuhlanzeka, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Izifundo emlandweni zifundisa ukuthi ukuhlanzeka akukona nje umkhuba, kodwa kuyinselelo esidinga ukuxazululwa. Uhlelo lokuhlanzeka aluhambisani kuphela nezinsiza, kodwa luhambisana nempilo, umnotho, nezimo zokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza imikhuba emihle, siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala kubo bonke, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimpilo zabantu zihlala ziphila kahle. Ngokubheka emlandweni, sithola ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka lapho abantu beqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezinhle, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sikhumbula lezi zifundo, siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala, futhi siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Njengoba sithokozisa izinkanyezi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esiyinhloko, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sigcine impilo yethu.
UJacob Zuma: Uhlobo Oluphikisanayo lokuKhokhela Kukhona abanye abantu abahlukene emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi uJacob Zuma ungomunye owanikeza abantu izinkulumo ezinzima. UJacob ungumuntu wezinhlobonhlobo zezinto, futhi abantu banemibono ehlukene ngaye. Lokhu kuyiqiniso kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngezinsuku yakhe njengomengameli wezwe. Sizokwakha izigaba ezahlukene zempilo kaZuma, sihloko ngezinto ezithile ezimhlobene, sihamba kancane. UZuma wazalelwa eNkandla, eKwaZulu-Natal, emndenini ojwayelekile. Kwakuyisikhathi esinzima, kodwa waba nomdlandla futhi wachuma. Ubuyele emuva, ezithola ezimbalwa njengoba efundile, kukhulu lapho enza imizamo yokuziphatha kahle, kodwa futhi enza amaphutha athile. Izinsuku zakhe zokuqala ezintsha emlandweni zakhombisa ukuthi baningi abangasaphila befundile, kodwa iZuma yahamba phambili. Ube ngumholi wenhlangano ye-ANC, obhekiwe futhi uphethe umthwalo omkhulu. Umphakathi wahamba naye lapho azama ukuthola izikhali ezizodingekile para intando yeningi. Uyingxenye ye-ANC, abanye babekholelwa kuwo, abanye bephikisana naye. Indaba yakhe iqala ukuba nzima kakhulu njengoba iminyaka yezenhlalo yayidlula. Izikhathi ezinzima zaqala lapho ethola ukuthi izinsuku zomhlangano zibuhlungu. UZuma waba neholo, kodwa kakhulu isikhathi esiningi ukukhokha uhlelo lwezombangazwe. Abantu bamenza izigebengu, beze baqagela izimpendulo zalo mholi obhujiswa ukwenza noma okungaziwa, kepha akavumeli ukuthola ingxoxo echwepheshile. Ngexesha elithile, uJacob Zuma waba nesimo esinzima emndenini, okukhuluma ngasikhathi. Ukuze athole izimiso ezibalulekile, uZuma wanquma ukuba noxolo. Uhlangane nezinselelo ezinkulu ezimphikelela, okujoyina ukuxhashazwa kwezimali zezombusazwe. Amathuba akhe wokuba uMongameli awazange adlulela emuva. Kodwa-ke, izizathu ezintsha zavela phakathi kokukhuluma, zabuza impilo yakhe yokuhola. Kwakukhona abahlali abaningi abethiyayo ngempilo kaZuma, kodwa abanye kwakungabavumelani. Kususelwa ezenzakalweni ezithile, ukheshe efuna ukunciphisa imiphumela yezezimali nezombusazwe. Umsuka wezinkantolo bamfaka ezinsizeni eziningi, okwandisa izinkinga nemiphumela emibi. Ubuye wahlangabezana nezinye izinhlelo, uZuma wava phansi kwezinkanyezi zethuba lesibili. Kodwa akayi phansi ngashonywa kwavela umbono omkhulu. UZuma ube ngabantu abuningi abakhethiwe kodwa abasaphila. Umphakathi wawungaphesheya kwezilwandle, kuvela nezinto ezithile ezimthokozisayo. UZuma waba yinduna, kodwa ezindabeni zaziningi izinkanyezi ezigxikayo. Imiphumela yobuholi bakhe ikhuluma ngempilo yakhe. Imiphumela yezenhlalakahle ibingcono, kodwa izinkinga zokubuyisa bekusobala. Ukudlula kwakhe kokusebenza kukholwa kukhula, uncanny, isiZulu se-angle sikhetha kulezi zigele. UZuma waba nomfanekiso wobuholi, kodwa akagcini nje ngale. Umphakathi wathola imiqondo ehlukene yokumba. Umbhalo kaZuma uveza izimo ezilula, ezinhle, noma ezimbi. UZuma uthanda ukuxoxisana, futhi lokho kuyahambisana nemibono ehlukene ekhanyisela isimo. Uhlelo lwakhe lungaphakanyiswa, kodwa khehlisa ukuze uqonde izici ezinzima zono. UZuma, umholi wezwe, uthinta izizathu ezixakile, izimpendulo, nezinye izinto ezithinta noma ubani. Okokugcina, uJacob Zuma ubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nabazi ngendlela abaphila ngayo. Manje ngabe imithetho yahluleka enhliziyweni zomphakathi, kukhona okumbalwa okukhombisa abanye abantu. Ukwaziswa ngokulangazelela kukaZuma usakazekile. Abantu baphila, baphumula ezindabeni zakhe. UZuma ungadalula izinkumbulo eziningana emhlabeni, zihlanganisa ubusuku bezimosh, izigcawu zokuhlala. Kwakuma bezekhamuzi ezingaziwayo, ubungcweti bakhe kugxila ezingeni lokuhlola. Ngakho-ke, indaba kaJacob Zuma ayigcini nje ngakho, kodwa ithinta lezi zinkanyezi eziningi ezivusa isithakazelo. Unamalungelo namathuba okulandisa ngale, umyeni endabeni ezinzima zeNingizimu Afrika. UJoseph Zuma, omuntu obhekelwe ngazo zonke izikhathi, kuhlala kukhona okuthusayo ezimpilweni zethu. Izigaba zethuba lethu zokwakha umphakathi, buza manje, uZuma udinga ukuqonda ukuthi uma izinkanyezi zikhanya, ungathola ukuthula kwephupho.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo: Indaba Yomlando Kudala, emhlabeni wonke, izilimi zabeziwumgogodla wezokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphandle kokuxhumana, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bube nobunzima. Izilimi zabeziwusizo ekwakheni ubudlelwano, futhi zabeziwumthombo wokwabelana ngemicabango, izinkolelo, nezinkumbulo. Njengoba abantu behamba behamba, izilimi zashintsha, zaba nezinhlobonhlobo, zafaka izici ezahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ezikhathini zokuqala, abantu babekhuluma izilimi ezilula, ezazilula ukufunda nokuzizwa. Lezi zilimi zazingaqondakali kahle phakathi kwemiphakathi eminingi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, kwavela isidingo sokuhumusha, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvumelana. Abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile, behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene ukuze kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zashintsha, zathuthuka, futhi zaba nezinhlobonhlobo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zaba yizinsika ezinkulu zokwakha izilimi ezintsha. Ngalesi sikhathi, izilimi zazingekho kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa zaziqala ukwandiswa emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezilimi eziningi ezikhona, ezazihlanganisa izimpande ezahlukene, izincazelo, nezindlela zokukhuluma. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ukuhweba phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene kwadinga ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuqonda izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezikhungo ezikhethekile zokuhumusha, lapho abahumushi bebenza khona umsebenzi omkhulu. Abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile, behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene ukuze kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba nezinselelo zazo. Izilimi eziningi zathola ukungabi nendima emhlabeni, ngenxa yokuthi ezinye izilimi zaba namandla kakhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izilimi ezithile zishabalale, kanti ezinye zaba namandla. Lokhu kwaholele ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wezilimi. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izilimi zidinga ukuvikelwa, ukuze zingashabalali. Ngalesi sikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezamasiko. Ukuze abantu baziqonde, kudingeka ukuthi bazi izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba, ukuhlangana, nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezifundo ezikhethekile zokufundisa izilimi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Izikhungo zokufunda zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile ekufundiseni izilimi, futhi zathola ukwamukelwa emhlabeni wonke. Ngesikhathi sokuhumusha, abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile. Umsebenzi wabo ubalulekile, njengoba behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene. Abahumushi bahlala bebanjwa kakhulu, njengoba behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguqulo eziningi ezikhona, ezazihlanganisa izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni. Ukuze abantu baziqonde, kudingeka ukuthi bazi izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba, ukuhlangana, nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezifundo ezikhethekile zokufundisa izilimi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Izikhungo zokufunda zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile ekufundiseni izilimi, futhi zathola ukwamukelwa emhlabeni wonke. Namuhla, izilimi zihlala zibalulekile. Zenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Izilimi zikhombisa ubuhlakani bomuntu, futhi zihlala zibalulekile emhlabeni wezamasiko. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni. Ukwazi izilimi ezahlukene kuyasiza ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bengahlangana khona, behlakaniphile, futhi bexhumana. Izilimi nezinguqulo zihlala zibalulekile, futhi zidinga ukuvikelwa ukuze zihlale zikhona. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sikhuthaze ukufunda izilimi, ukuze sikwazi ukuxhumana, ukuhweba, nokuphila kahle emhlabeni.
Amalungelo Abasebenzi: Ukubaluleka Nokuvikela Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amalungelo abasebenzi abe yinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo. Abasebenzi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yomnotho, badinga ukuvikelwa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baphila kahle, benza imisebenzi yabo ngokuzikhandla, futhi bahlala bejabulile emsebenzini. Emazweni amaningi, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa izici eziningi, njengokuhola kahle, izinsuku zokuphumula, nezinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, futhi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa ekuxhashazweni, okungukuthi, abasebenzi kufanele bavikelwe ezimeni zokusebenza ezinzima, ezingenza kube nzima kubo ukuzenzela impilo engcono. NgokweMithetho Yezabasebenzi, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlukaniswe ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okuba nezinhlaka zokwakha, amalungelo okukhuluma, kanye namalungelo okukhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, baphinde baphakamise izinkinga ezithinta imisebenzi yabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezivulekile zokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa kwezisebenzi ezincane, ezinjengokuthi abantwana badinga ukuvikelwa ekusebenzeni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bahlala besesikoleni, befundiswa kahle, futhi baphila impilo engcono. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izwe kufanele libe nemithetho eqinile evikela abantwana ekusebenzeni ngaphansi kweminyaka ethile. Ezinye izinkinga ezithinta amalungelo abasebenzi zifaka phakathi ukungalingani emiholweni, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama nabamhlophe, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kudingeka kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba elifanele emsebenzini. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinqubo ezivulekile nezifanele zokuhola abasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bathola imiholo efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe amalungelo abasebenzi ziye zanda. Izinyathelo ezifana nokwakhiwa kwezinyunyana zabasebenzi, ezihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Lezi zinyunyana zenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuveza izinkinga zabo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani ziyaqonda ukuthi zidinga ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinyathelo ezithile zikhona, kusekhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene namalungelo abasebenzi. Ezinye izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwephula amalungelo abasebenzi, zenza kube nzima kubo ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezinqala ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi avikelwa ngempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izwe kufanele libe nezinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa abasebenzi ngamalungelo abo. Lokhu kuzosiza abasebenzi ukuba baqonde ukuthi banelungelo lokuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bazokwazi ukuveza izinkinga zabo uma kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezithile ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abasebenzi ayisici esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi avikelwa, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo, futhi izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinqubo ezivulekile nezifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuveza izinkinga zabo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi baphila impilo engcono. Amalungelo abasebenzi awavikela kuphela abasebenzi, kodwa futhi avikela umphakathi wonke, uqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono.
Idolobha LaseGoli: Ngaphakathi Kwezingxoxo Zokuphila Kwesimanje Idolobha laseGoli, elaziwa nangokuthi iJohannesburg, liyinqaba yokuthuthukiswa komnotho eNingizimu Afrika. Le ndawo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yobungcweti bayo bezomnotho, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlukahluka kwempilo kanye nezinselelo ezifanele ukucatshangelwa. Kulokhu, sizophawula ngokubaluleka kwaleli dolobha, izinzuzo zalo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Okokuqala, kudingeka sikhulume ngempilo yansuku zonke eGoli. Idolobha linabantu bamaSuthu, amaHosa, amaZulu, kanye nabanye abantu abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iGoli iyindawo yokunethezeka nolwazi, lapho iz cultures ezahlukene zenza ubuhlobo, zifundisana futhi zabelana ngezindlela zokuphila. Kubalulekile ukufaka isigqi sokuhlukahluka kwamasiko, njengoba lokhu kuhlelwe kahle ekwakhekeni komphakathi onobungani. Nokho, leli dolobha liphinde libe nezinselelo ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezinga lokuphila nokuhlaliswa kwabantu. Ngokwezemisebenzi, iGoli iyikhaya lemisebenzi eminingi. Iqukethe izinkampani ezinkulu, abahwebi, nabathuthukisi, okwenza kube lula ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lezi zinkampani zithuthukisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ngaleyondlela zidlalayo indima ebalulekile ekwakheni amathuba kubantu abaningi. Nokho, kufanele sicabangele ukuthi indlela yokuphila eGoli ibuye ibize, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezindlekweni zokuhlala. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abahlala ezindaweni eziphoqelelwe, bayathola kunzima ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele ukuzinakekela. Ezinye zezinkinga ezikhona eGoli zifaka phakathi ubuphofu obukhulu, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lobugebengu. Lezi zinkinga zifanele ukubhekelwa ngeso elibukhali, njengoba zikhomba ukufaneleka kokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga eliphakeme lokuhlala livame ukuveza ukungabi bikho kokusizakala kwiSocial Welfare, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ophumelelayo wokuxazulula, uma sikhuluma ngophetho oluzodingeka ukuthi lwenziwe ukuze kwandiswe izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona umbono ongapheli mayelana neGoli njengendawo yokuhweba. Abanye bathi iGoli iyindawo ehloniphekile yokwakha amabhizinisi, njengoba izinzuzo ezitholakele zikhulisa umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo eziningi zamaholo, izitolo ezinkulu, kanye nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezifana nezokwelapha namathuluzi obuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhweba, okulindeleke ukuthi kuzuze umphakathi jikelele. Kodwa-ke, umbono ophikisanayo uthi lezi zinzuzo ziyashubisa uma siqhathanisa nezindleko zokuphila ezikhula kakhulu. Kukhona izikhalazo eziningi ezikhuluma ngokuswabela kwemisebenzi, ukungabikho kwemali, nokuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukile. Lokhu kucacisa ukuntuleka kokufinyelela emisebenzini ethile, okuholela ekuzimiseleni kwezingqinamba ezikhona eGoli. Enye indlela yokubhekana nalokhu kube ukusiza izikhungo zentuthuko ngokwandisa amathuba ezemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokujabulela. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iGoli ibonakala ithuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokwenza ngokufanisa izinselelo ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezemfundo, izikhungo zokuhweba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphepha ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zazo, zigxile ekwenzeni impilo ibaluleke kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi, naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona, izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekwakheni umphumela omuhle. Umphakathi obonisa ukufaka imali ezindaweni ezinokuthula kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile. Ngaphandle kokuxhasa abaqashi, kubalulekile futhi ukukhuthaza uchwepheshe abasha. Lokhu kuzonciphisa izinkinga eziphathelene nobuphofu, kuvule amathuba okwandisa izinga lempilo. I-Goli, njengezikhungo zomnotho, kufanele iconywe ukuqonda abafuni bait ebandakanya abahola izinxephezelo. Ngokugcinwa kwamaqhinga athile, iGoli ingaba yindawo yokuhweba ewusizo kubantu bonke. Ukuphendula izinkinga ezikhona, kubalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, nezinkampani. Lezi zinyathelo zizoqinisekisa ukuthi iGoli isasebenza njengenhloko-dolobha yeNingizimu Afrika, futhi iyindawo yokubaluleka emhlabeni wonke. Umphakathi unemisebenzi eminingi, izinkinga eziningi, kodwa lonke leli theku ligxilile ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudingeka ukuthi iGoli ibhekane nezinkinga zayo, iqhubeke nokukhula, futhi iqhakambisa izindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Njengoba sizama ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, umbono wamathuba aqina uboniswa ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlonipha, ukuxhumana, kanye nezimanga zempilo ezihamba phambili. Idolobha laseGoli linethuba elihle lokushintsha, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufinyelela izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ahlale kahle.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Isibuyekezo Esibalulekile Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisikhathi esibalulekile emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izakhamizi zifaka khona izinketho zazo ukuze kukhethwe abaholi abazobhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezifiso, izimvo, nezidingo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Njengoba sihamba kule ndaba, sizodingida izici ezihlukahlukene, izinselelo, nemiphumela ethinta umphakathi ngokujwayelekile. Ukuhlaziywa Kwezenzo Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, okuhlanganisa imikhankaso, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani. Imikhankaso igxile ezinselelweni ezithinta umphakathi, njengezisebenzi, imfundo, nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bethu baqonde izidingo zabantu futhi basize ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngesikhathi sokhetho, umphakathi uhlanganyela emicimbini ehlukene, njengemihlangano nezinkulumo, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphatheke ndawonye futhi bahlale behlanganyela emibonweni ehlukene. Ukwaziswa kwabantu ngamalungelo abo kanye nezinyathelo zokubamba iqhaza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokukhuluma. Izinhlelo Zokuvota Nezobuchwepheshe Ngesikhathi sokhetho, izinhlelo zokuvota zidlala indima ebalulekile. Ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula, futhi izinhlelo zokuvota ezisheshayo nezilula zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuthi bavote. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvota okuphephile, izikhumbuzo zokuvota zisetshenziswa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangavota kanjani, bazi isikhathi, kanye nezindawo zokuvota. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo, njengoba ukuvota kwezobuchwepheshe kudinga ukuqapha okukhulu ukuze kuvinjwe ubugebengu. Izinhlangano ezizimele nezokubambisana zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyavikelwa ukuze kube nokwethembeka emiphumeleni yokhetho. Imiphumela Yokhetho Imiphumela yokhetho ibonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kukhona abaholi abasha abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, okukhombisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zifuna ushintsho. Lokhu kuholela ezinguqulweni ezibalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu, ezifana nokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nokwabelana ngezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukhetho lukazwelonke kudinga ukuqonda okujulile phakathi kwabantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinqumo ezithathiwe zinezimpempe ezinzima emiphakathini yabo. Abaholi kufanele bahlale bexhumene nezakhamuzi zabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso zabo zisebenza futhi zikhuthaza umphakathi. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokubamba Iqhaza Ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona nje ukubalwa kwezikhumbuzo, kodwa kuyisikhathi esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza. Ukuvota kuwumsebenzi ongenzeka kuphela uma abantu bejula izizathu ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bavote, bahlale bexhumene nabaholi, futhi bazi kahle amalungelo abo, kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke luhamba phambili ngokubambisana. Umphakathi, abaholi, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ezithathiwe zikhuthaza ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwabo bonke. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwakha isisekelo sambusazwe esiqinile, esizogcina sihamba phambili ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngakho-ke, masibambe iqhaza, sizibophezela ekuthuthukiseni izwe lethu, ngoba ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumsebenzi wethu sonke. Izenzo zethu namuhla zinezimpempe ezinzima kusasa, futhi lokhu kudinga umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, kanye nezifiso ezithinta wonke umuntu.
Ezemisebenzi: Indaba kaThandiwe Kwakukhanya kahle emini, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu zikhuluma ngezindaba zazo. UThandiwe, intombazane encane eyaphila edolobheni elincane, wayenokubona okuhle ngempilo yakhe. Wayefisa ukuba ngumsebenzi ophumelelayo, kodwa wayazi kahle ukuthi ukufinyelela kulokho kwakunzima. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza endaweni yokudlela eyaziwa kakhulu edolobheni. Lokhu kwamjabulisa kakhulu, ngoba wayekwazi ukuthi kuzomnika ithuba lokufunda nokukhula. Njengoba eqala ukusebenza, wathola ukuthi akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kudingeka azikhandle, afunde, futhi akhulise amakhono akhe. UThandiwe wayenobungane futhi wayehlonipha wonke umuntu, okwenza abaphathi bakhe bamthande. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenza kahle akukhona kuphela ukugcina izinga, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuxhumana nabanye. Waqala ukufunda ngezifundo zokuphatha abantu, futhi lokhu kumenze waba ngumsebenzi ophumelelayo. Ngesikhathi esebenza, uThandiwe wathola izinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuqhubeka. Kodwa wayazi ukuthi umndeni wakhe ubelokhu umkhuthaza, futhi lokhu kumenze waba namandla. Wafunda ukuthi uma ebhekene nezinkinga, kufanele abheke izixazululo, hhayi izithiyo. Ngemuva kokusebenza unyaka, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokukhuphuka esikhundleni. Lokhu kwamjabulisa kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi wakhe wawumjabulisa. UThandiwe waqala ukufundisa abanye abasebenzi, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu bayamthanda. Ngesikhathi esehola, waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphatha ezahlukene, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphatha abantu akukhona nje ukulawula, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izifundo ezahlukahlukene ezimfundisayo, futhi lokhu kwamnika amandla okuba ngumholi omuhle. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi, uThandiwe waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuhamba phambili.
