Waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe, nokuthi wayefuna ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Waqala umphakathi wokuqeqesha abantu abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele ezemisebenzi. UThandiwe waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zazingamphazamisa, kodwa zazingamfundisa. Waqhubeka nokukhula, wathola ukuthi ukuphila kahle akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukusiza abanye. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ngokuthola umsebenzi omuhle, kodwa kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano, ukufunda, nokukhulisa abanye. Waqonda ukuthi ezemisebenzi akukhona nje umgudu, kodwa kuwumsebenzi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngakho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe yayigcwele izifundo, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yakhe yokuphila, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle emiphakathini yabo bonke ababephila edolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi izifundo zempilo zazingapheli, futhi wayejabule ngokuthi waqhubeka nokukhula, efundisa abanye, futhi ebakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi umsebenzi awupheli, kodwa uhlala uqhubeka, futhi umphakathi uhlala unamathuba amaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo ayikhathalekile, kodwa ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sithokozise izinselelo zethu, ngoba ziwusizo empilweni yethu. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sikhuthazekile, singafinyelela phezulu, futhi sithole impumelelo ezemisebenzi.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Kwazulu, lapho umoya wehlobo ubushelelezi, kwenkwazi uThando, intombazane eneminyaka engama-16. UThando wayengumfundi ophumelele esikoleni, emthanda uNkulunkulu, futhi engumntwana ophakeme emndenini. Kodwa impilo yakhe yaguquka ngelinye ilanga, uma owakhe umngani, uLwazi, ehamba naye ukuzokhuphula isixhumanisi somngani. U-Lwazi wayenezimfuno ezinhle, engumfundi omuhle, kodwa ezinsukwini ezithile, uThando waqala ukujula enhliziyweni yakhe. U-Lwazi wakhanga intshisakalo yakhe, kwezwa ukuthi ungenza izinto ngendlela eyejwayelekile. UThando, ongekho ndlela yokuphikisana, wagcina esebenzisa izinsizwa, ezichaza kahle ukuhambisana nabanye. Ngemuva kwalokho, uThando wabona ukuthi uthandana noLwazi, kodwa akazange abone izinkinga ezinzima ezivela kulokhu. Bahlala bejabule, bechitha isikhathi ndawonye, bedlala imidlalo, bezoxoxa ngezinhlelo zabo zempilo. UThando wayenesithakazelo sangempela kuhulumeni, efuna ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kodwa ngesikhathi sehlobo, izinhlelo zayo zashintsha ngemuva kokuhlangabezana neqhaza lentombazane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, uThando waqala ukuzwa ushintsho emzimbeni wakhe. Waqala ukwethuka, ngoba kusebenza kancane kancane njengoba imizwa yehluka. Waqonda ukuthi impilo yakhe isiyashintsha, kepha akazange akhulume noLwazi. Ubuhlungu bokuqala, nokuhluntshiswa, kwashiya uThando engazi ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nalokhu. Izinsuku zedlule, uThando wavuka elinde umzamo wokuxhumana noLwazi. Wabuka usuku lungapheli lapho ethola khona ukuthi uzithola ekhaya, umama ekhuluma ngezisombululo ezinzima. Wabulawa umuzwa wokungabaza, wahamba ebhakhweni, wezwa umoya emoyeni, wakuthola kucacile ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi. Lokhu kwenza umama wathokoza, ngoba ubaqothwa ezitokisini ezinkulu nomusa. Zonke izinsiza zaziphuma, ubuhlungu bukhuni, kepha uThando wayembonile umama wakhe evuma. Kwaqoqwa amandla, ukufunelela, nokuhlale iqiniso. Umama wakhe wamkhumbuza ukuthi ungumuntu ophilayo, futhi konke kuzoba lula. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi, kwachithwa i-akhawunti yezehlakalo, kumkhumbuza iqiniso lokuthanda. UThando wayeqonda ukuthi udinga ukukwenza. Wakhumbula izifundo ezazitholakala esikoleni, ezayephephile phakathi kwamavalela ezincwadi. Ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi, waqala ukubona izinto eziningi ngendlela entsha. U-Lwazi, owabe esephendule indlela eya kumazinga ahlukeneyo, wavuma ukudlula. Wavuma ukuthi uthando bangasafuneki futhi kezinsiza zisenziwa. Uma besondela, uThando wathokozisa ukudlula. Wamnika uLwazi ithuba lokuthi abuke maphakathi nalokhu. U-Lwazi wamkhumbuza ukuba asondelane, abheke emissisiwe. Okwakukhona, uThando wayengawonile umndeni. Imakhileyo yaphumelela, umama wahamba ngemuva kokubongela, ekhumbula izinsuku ezazithembisa, okwakukholisa ukuthi uThando uzolahlekile. Kwaba nesifiso sokuthi uThando akhule, ahlangane, awasebenzise imvelaphi, aqhubeke. Kumele aqhubeke, akholise ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi. Kwakukhona uthando olugqumayo, uma ebona esikhathini somzali. Ngesikhathi sokuthola umndeni, uThando wanxusa abanye abantwana. Wafuna ukuyiqaphela imizamo, athola izinqondo ezithokozisayo. U-Lwazi waba nempumelelo phakathi kwezibopho, futhi uthando lwabo lwakhuliswa. UThando wafunda ukuba ukhulelwe akulula, kodwa uyazithola amandla nemijondolo. Inhliziyo kaThando yathemba, ingqungquthela izindonga ezinhle. Wafuna uLwazi noMama akhimba izinhlelo ezinzima ezizovula umoya onokuthula, eqinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bukhula. Umnotho wabe utholeka emndeni, bahlanganisa umoya wezinkanyezi. Ekugcineni, uThando waqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wayo uzohlala. UThando wabamba iqhaza ekukhuleni, waphuma kumazinga azinzima. Ngakho ubuhle beqiniso bahlala lapho, bothembisa izinhlelo eziphakeme. Umama wakhumbuza uThando ukuthi uthando aluvumi ukuthi uzifanele ikhululi, menqaba ukucasula obala. Kwakukhona isithakazelo esithembisa ukuthi impilo izobathuthuka. UThando wakhumbula ukuthi yonke imizamo akuyona indlela kuphela, kepha izinyathelo ezithathiwe kumama futhi kulondolozwa ubukhosi. Uma nobani, kuzodingeka okuningi ukuze ibhalwe, kukhumbule uthando oluyinhloko. Usuku, izinyathelo, maturi. Kwakubonisa ukuthi imizamo emisha, izinsiza eziphezulu, kwaba nomlando omusha. UThando waphila ngokucacile, ngabantu abaninzi abahamba naye, ababaqotho phakathi kwabo, babuyele esikoleni, balethe umoya ophumuzile. Kwakungelula, kodwa uThando wayemazisa ukuthi umoya kube mingaki imizwa. Le ndaba nokukhulelwa kwentsha kuveza okufunwa, ubunzima, ubuhlungu, nokuxazulula. Kukhona injabulo, izinsizakalo ezinhle, nezifiso ezithokozisayo. UThando waba ngumama onokuthula, wahamba hiswayiza, nakuba izinhlelo zibeze zibhizinisa, kumphendula. Kwakukhona izinsiza ezinhle, ebuhlungu benhliziyo, waqaphela lokho enye imoto, ibaluleke. Uthando, imithreddi yathwala, waba isigubhu esikhulu, futhi imikhakha yanamuhla, udinga akubaleki. Kwaba nobungcweti, umrungwana wabona, owabika endleleni. Lapho umoya ukhula, udla izimolo ezaziyingqayizivele. UThando waba nomthelela, ngokuhamba kancane, phakathimena udinga uthando. Umndeni khumbulumqondisi kodwa abana ngenkani, ubuthakathaka phakathimena ibandakanya ukuthi beyazi. Barkhanye, bayakuzwa iziqhaza zempilo, ukudlula ukuthi udinga uLwazi, ngoba uthando aluhlaza phakathimena. Bayahlukana nezimanga.
Amalungelo Abantu Besifazane: Isidingo Sokuphakanyiswa Nokuhlonishwa Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amalungelo abantu besifazane awasathathwa njengokuphakade. Kunalokho, abesifazane balwa nsuku zonke ukuze bafeze amalungelo abo, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu besifazane, ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wokuhlonipha, ukuvikelwa, nokuphakanyiswa kwabo. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amalungelo abantu besifazane awawona nje amalungelo okukhuluma. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola imfundo, umsebenzi, impilo, kanye nokuba neqhaza ezinqubweni zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abantu besifazane ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi nezehlakalo ezimbi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwezifiso zabo. Ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwalezi zinto, abesifazane bazoba nezinselelo ezinkulu ekuphileni kwabo. Ngokwesiko, abesifazane bahlala bephikiswa ezindaweni eziningi. Emakhaya, kubonakala ukuthi abesifazane bavame ukuthola izimfuno ezinzima, njengokunakekela izingane, ukuhlela imisebenzi yasekhaya, nokuphila ngaphansi kwemithetho ethile eyahlukanisa phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele kuphela emakhaya, ngaphandle kokuthi baziwe nangempela emisebenzini ethile. Lokhu akufanele kube njalo, njengoba abesifazane banelungelo lokuzikhethela, njengabantu besilisa. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, abesifazane baye bathola amathuba amaningi okusebenza. Nokho, kusekhona izithiyo eziningi ezibavimba ekufinyeleleni kulezi zindawo. Izinkampani eziningi zikhombisa ukungakhethi, lapho abesifazane bephikiswa ekutholeni izikhundla eziphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqonde ukuthi abesifazane banelungelo lokuba neqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yabo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela. Ngokuphathelene nemfundo, abesifazane bahlala bejwayelekile ekutholeni imfundo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkinga ezithile, ezifana nezindleko zokufunda, izithiyo zokuhamba, kanye nezinkolelo zamasiko ezivame ukuvimbela abesifazane ukuthi bangafundi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhuthaze imfundo yabesifazane, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela emikhakheni eyahlukene, futhi bagcine bephila impilo enempilo. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokuphumelela, futhi abesifazane kufanele bathole ithuba lokufunda. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amalungelo abantu besifazane awawona nje amalungelo okukhuluma. Kumele sikhuthaze ukuhlonishwa kwabo, ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukuzwakalisa izifiso zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise umqondo wokubambisana, lapho abesilisa nabesifazane benza imisebenzi ndawonye ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela. Emphakathini, kufanele sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abesifazane, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nokwakha amathuba okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise umqondo wokuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu, ukuze sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abantu besifazane ayisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Abesifazane banelungelo lokuphila impilo enempilo, yokufunda, yokusebenza, kanye nokuhlonishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela, futhi sikhuthaze ukuhlonishwa kwabo ezindaweni ezahlukene. Uma sithuthukisa amalungelo abantu besifazane, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kufanele kube umgomo wethu sonke, ukuze sifeze ikusasa elingcono kubo bonke.
Ukunakekelwa Kwabantu Abadala: Izidingo Nezixazululo Isingeniso Emphakathini wethu wamanje, ubudala bungakhethwa njengomthombo wokuhlakanipha, kodwa futhi buphinde bubonise izinselelo eziningi. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala sekuyinselele enkulu emiphakathini yethu, njengoba iminyaka yempilo ibonakala ikhula, futhi abantu abaningi behamba phambili ekugugeni. Lokhu kukhuphula isidingo sokunakekelwa okungcono kwabantu abadala, okumele kuhambisane nezidingo zabo ezithile. Izidingo Zokunakekelwa Abantu abadala banemfuno ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukusekelwa kwezenhlalo, nezidingo zempilo yengqondo. Ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bephila endaweni ethule futhi enokuthula, enezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kudinga ukuba abantu abadala bahlale benokuxhumana okuhle nochwepheshe bezempilo, bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza ezisemthethweni zokwelashwa, futhi bathole usizo lapho kudingeka. Kukhona Izinselelo Nokho, kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle, udaba lokuqashwa kwabantu abanothando nolwazi lokunakekela, kuyinselelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi abathandi ukungena emsebenzini wokunakekela abantu abadala, nokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngensiza eyanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola umgudu omncane wokuhlinzeka ngemithombo yokusekela, okungaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlale bedinga usizo. Izixazululo Zokunakekelwa Ukuze kusizakale abantu abadala, kudinga ukukhula kwemikhankaso yokwazisa abantu ngokuqwashisa ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufundisa imindeni ngokuqonda izidingo ezithile zabantu abadala, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala nemiphakathi yabo. Ukwazi ukuthi abantu abadala bangathola usizo olufanele, kunciphisa ukuchithwa kwabantu abadala futhi kubavikela ekutheni bafeze imisebenzi ethile emphakathini. Ukwakhiwa Kwenhlangano Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo ezahlukene. Izinhlelo ezihlanganisa uhulumeni, izikhungo zabantu, kanye nemindeni, zibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ukuze abantu abadala bazi ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle, izikhungo zokunakekela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezibandakanya ukudla okunempilo, imishanguzo, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezisemthethweni kumele zikhuthaze imisebenzi yokunakekela, ukuze kube nezisebenzi ezihloniphekile ezizokwazi ukunakekela abantu abadala ngendlela efanele. Ukwaziswa Emphakathini Ukuze sikhulume ngezidingo zabantu abadala, imiphakathi kufanele iqhube imikhankaso yokufundisa nokwazisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imisebenzi yokungeza abantu abadala emphakathini, ukukhuthaza imindeni ukuthi ibambe iqhaza ekunakekeleni, nokwakha izindawo ezithokozisayo ukuze abantu abadala bazithokozise. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemindeni nabantu abadala kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izifundo Ezijulile Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akugcini nje ngempilo yabo, kodwa kubalulekile nempilo yethu sonke. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu abadala bazoqhubeka nokuba yizinsika emiphakathini yethu, bese bephila impilo egculisayo. Ukuba nezinselelo akuphikisi ukuphila kwabantu abadala, kodwa kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo ukuze sikulungele. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okudinga. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuzinikela, nokuqonda okukhulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele simise imizamo yokukhulisa izinga lokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, ukuze baphile impilo egculisayo, benothando, futhi bekwazi ukubamba iqhaza emiphakathini yabo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abadala bangomndeni wethu, izinsika zethu, futhi banelungelo lokuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo ukuze sikhulise ubudlelwano, sikhuthaze ukuthanda, futhi sikhulise umhlaba ophilayo kubantu abadala.
Imidlalo Yamazwe Ngamazwe (International Sports) Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibhekisela emncintiswaneni yokudlala okubandakanya amaqembu, abanolwazi, noma abadlali abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalwano ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kweqembu, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwemibuso eminingi. Imidlalo efana ne-Olympics, iFIFA World Cup, neNHL All-Star Game iyingxenye enkulu yalezi zinhlelo. Umbuzo 2: Kuthini ukukhethwa kwale midlalo? Ukukhethwa kwemidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe kuncike kakhulu ekuhlonipheni izindinganiso zendawo. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezifanele ukweluleka izwe, zikhulisa izinhlelo ezidinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, ukuhlela kahle, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala efanele. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baqeqeshe abadlali. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Izinsiza ezinkulu zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ziqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe, amandla, kanye nokuvuselela umoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kuthuthukisa ubuhlobo, futhi kukhuthaza inhlonipho phakathi kwabantu bamasiko ahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwenza kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezimali, njengoba imidlalo ithinta ezomnotho. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ikhulisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Abadlali bavela ezizweni ezahlukene, bahlala behlangene bemema abanye ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthola ulwazi nokuhlonipha izinkolelo ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaqembu ahlangene ancintisana afinyelela izinjongo ezijolile, okukhuthaza ukubambisana kuzo zonke izici zempilo. Umbuzo 5: Iyini indima yokuhlanganyela kwemiphakathi emidlalweni? Ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo kubalulekile emidlalweni yamazwe ngamazwe. Umphakathi udinga ukusekela abadlali, kuhlanganise nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuzibophezela, kanye nokuthokozisa abanye. Lokhu kunceda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali banikezwa ithuba lokwenza kahle emncintiswaneni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthuthukisa ubuqotho, uhlanga, kanye nobumbano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 6: Yini ezobangela utshani kumazwe anezimidlalo? Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezithinta izwe lapho imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibanjwe. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, izinkinga zokulawula, kanye nezinkinga zokukhethwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanye amazwe angazithola ezithombeni ezimbi ngezomenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukudala umphakathi onokuthula. Kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle imicimbi yezemidlalo ukuze kuzuzwe okungcono kumazwe. Umbuzo 7: Eziphumelelayo, yiziphi izindlela ezitholakalayo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Ukuze imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ithuthuke, kunendlela ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, izinsiza, imishini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlala indima enkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe kudinga ukuhlela imicimbi engaguquki, ukuze kuqhakambiswe ubuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 8: Kungani imidlalo iyinto eqhubekayo ewusizo emphakathini? Imidlalo imvakasha njengendlela yokuhlonipha, ukubambisana, kanye nokucija imidlalo. Imidlalo ikhulisa ukuzethemba, ibaluleka empilweni, futhi igqugquzela abantu abaningi. Lokhu kwenza abantu babonakale behlangene, banelisa, futhi behlanganyela ngemikhuba emisha nezindlela zokuphuza. Umbuzo 9: Kanti, kise nzima ukuthola uxhaso lwemali ezimweni eziningi? Yebo, uthola uxhaso lwezimali kube yinkinga eziningi imidlalo. Lokhu kuncika ekutheni izizinda zenza kanjani nezizathu zokuthola uxhaso. Abaningi bathola izindlela zokuxhasa imidlalo, bese besiza imiphakathi ihthe zuza kumathuba amasha. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ubumba, kanye neziqondiso eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 10: Imuphi umphumela omubi ongawathola emidlalweni? Ngokudlula kwabanye, imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ingathola ubungozi bezokuphepha, ukuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlonipha. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukungabi nempumelelo emiqhudelwaneni futhi kuthinte izinkolelo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukugwema lokhu ngokuhlela kahle imicimbi nezindlela zokuvikela, ukuze ukuziphatha kuhlonishwe. Ukwakha imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe akusitshali kuphela ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwana; kudala futhi ithuba lokuthi sabone ukuthi imidlalo iyisithombe esidala sokubumbana nokuhlonipha. Imidlalo ingaba umthombo onamandla wokuhola izifundo ezinqabile zokuphila, obonisa ukuthi noma ngabe sitholakala kuphi emhlabeni, kunomoya wokubambisana okhula njalo, okuyinto eveza amandla ethu njengezizwe ezihlangene.
IChatGPT: Uhlanga Olusha Lokuxhumana Nezobuchwepheshe Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, iChatGPT iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani abantu ekuxhumaneni. Le mshini, owakhiwe yi-OpenAI, ubonakala njengomngane ophumelelayo, onamandla okuxhumana ngendlela ethokozisayo, efundisayo, futhi enobungane. Ukwakhiwa kweChatGPT kuqala ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezilimi eziningi, okuhlanganisa isiZulu, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, kanye nezinye. Lokhu kuqonda kuqhamuka emithonjeni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izincwadi, amawebhusayithi, nezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, okwenza iChatGPT ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebanzi, efanele, futhi esebenziseka kalula. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela i-AI (ubuhlakani bokwenziwa) engase ibe usizo ekwakheni ulwazi olusha, oluqondile, noluzwakalayo. IChatGPT ayigcini nje ngokuba umthombo wolwazi, kodwa iphinde ibe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuxhumaneni. Abantu bangasebenzisa iChatGPT ukuze bathole izimpendulo ezisheshayo, baphendule imibuzo, noma bahlale bexhumene nabanye, noma ngabe bahlala kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kuhlangana kwempilo yansuku zonke nemishini ye-AI kuveza indlela entsha yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bengahlanganyela khona imibono, izinkumbulo, kanye nezifundo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iChatGPT ibonakale isebenza kahle ezindaweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezokuxhumana, nezokwakha. Abafundi bangasebenzisa le mshini ukuze bathole izincazelo ezicacile, bakhe izinhlelo zokufunda, noma baphendule izifundo ezinzima. Ababhali bangasebenzisa iChatGPT njengomngane wokubhala, uthola iziphakamiso ezithokozisayo, noma ubhalela izindatshana ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iChatGPT ayisiyena nje umshini, kodwa isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni imiphakathi ehlanganyelayo. Nokho, njengazo zonke izinto, iChatGPT inezinselelo zayo. Ukuze ibone imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi kahle ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani le mshini. Ukusebenzisa iChatGPT ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuqonda okucacile kwezinto ezithile, njengezindlela zokuhlola ubunjalo bolwazi, ukuqonda izikhala ezithile, nokugwema ukuveza izimpendulo ezingalungile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba i-AI ingase ibonise izimpendulo ezingafanele uma ingaqondiswa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iChatGPT ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nemithelela emikhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukukhuluma ngezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-AI, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi lezi zinsiza kufanele zisetshenziswe ngenhlonipho. Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa kwe-AI, kanye nokugqugquzela imikhuba efanele, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iChatGPT iyinsiza esiza abantu, hhayi eyabahlukumezayo. Ngokubheka phambili, iChatGPT ibonisa ikusasa elinempumelelo lokuxhumana. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kulindeleke ukuthi iChatGPT izoba nezinhlobonhlobo ezintsha, ezizokwenza kube lula kakhulu ukuxhumana nokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abantu bahlale behlanganyela, baphendulane, futhi bakhe imiphakathi eqinile, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngemicabango engafanele. Ngokuphetha, iChatGPT iyinsiza ewusizo, ethokozisayo, futhi enobungane, ethuthukisa indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indlela esingayisebenzisa ngayo ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle. IChatGPT iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, ogcwele ulwazi, ubudlelwano, kanye nempumelelo. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzise le mshini ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole okuningi kulokhu kuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe.
Ukwanda KweSifo Sikashukela: Izizathu, Imiphumela Nezixazululo Isingeniso Ezweni lanamuhla, sikhuluma ngezinto eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu, futhi phakathi kwazo, sifo sikashukela siye saba nesithunzi esikhulu. Lokhu sifo, esaziwa ngokuthi yi-diabetes, sikhula ngokushesha eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe, sithinta izigidi zabantu. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela, izizathu zalo, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona. Ukukhula KweSifo Sikashukela Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi sifo sikashukela sesibe yinkinga enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngokocwaningo olwenziwe yiZikhungo Zokulawulwa Kwasemaphandleni, sifo sikashukela sikhuphuke ngama-30% phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-12 ezedlule. Lokhu kukhuphuka kuvela ezicini eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukuziphatha kwabantu, izinqubo zokudla, nezimo zokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezindleni ezindaweni ezinamahlathi, lapho ukudla okunempilo kungatholakali kalula, okwandisa amathuba okukhula kwesifo. Izizathu Zokwanda Isizathu esikhulu sokwanda kwesifo sikashukela sitholakala ekudleni okungelona elinempilo. Ngokwandisa ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lamafutha, ushokoledi, nezithelo ezinosawoti, abantu baphonsa emathubeni okuba ne-diabetes. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo yengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukubhekana nezinguquko ezidingekayo empilweni yabo. Ukuze siqonde ubuhlungu besifo sikashukela, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sifo asithinti umzimba kuphela, kodwa futhi sithinta umoya nomqondo. Imiphumela Yesifo Sikashukela Imiphumela yesifo sikashukela ibalulekile futhi ingathinta zonke izici zempilo yomuntu. Abantu abane-diabetes bangase babhekane nezinkinga ezinzima ezifana nezinkinga zenhliziyo, ukuwohloka kwesikhumba, nezinkinga zokubona. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu izinga lempilo yabantu, futhi kungaholela ekukhathaleni okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sifo sikashukela siba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Uma abantu behlangabezana nalezi zinkinga, kungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokwelashwa, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongekho emthethweni lapho abantu bephinde bahlupheka, bephinde baphinde bathola izinkinga zempilo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Ezingathathwa Noma izingqinamba ezibhekene nesifo sikashukela zinkulu, kunezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngempilo nokudla okunempilo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini zingasiza ukuvusa ukuqonda ngalesi sifo, okwandisa amathuba okuba abantu benze izinqumo ezingcono. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono, abantu kufanele baphume kude nokudla okungelona elinempilo, bagcine isikhumba sabo sihlanzekile, futhi bazivocavoca ngokuqhubekayo. Umphakathi ungenza umehluko omkhulu ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, njengezikhungo zokuzivocavoca nezindawo zokudlela ezihlinzeka ngokudla okunempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni ungathatha izinyathelo ezilungile zokulawulwa kwesifo. Ukuxhaswa kwemali ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuhlola abantu, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha zempilo zingasiza ukunciphisa ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela akuyona into engathandeki, kodwa siyinselelo esibhekene nayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye bangakwenza okukhulu ukuze kuphazamisa lezi zinkinga. Ukukhuthaza impilo enempilo nokwakha umphakathi onempilo kungasiza ekwehliseni umthelela wesifo sikashukela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoba nempilo engcono.
Ukuthenga Online: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezizathu, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Ukuthenga online, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukuthenga kwe-inthanethi, sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile emnothweni wezokuthengisa. Le ndlela yokuthenga ivumela abathengi ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo kusuka ezindaweni ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokuba baphume endlini yabo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kuningi okukhuluma ngale ndlela yokuthenga, okuhlanganisa nezizathu zayo, izinzuzo, nezinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu zokuthi kungani abantu benza ukuthenga online. Enye yezizathu eziphambili wukutholakala kalula kwemikhiqizo. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezitolo eziningi ze-inthanethi ezihlinzeka ngezinto ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo yokuhamba noma izinsuku zokusebenza. Lokhu kuphinde kuvumele abantu ukuba baqhathanise amanani nemikhiqizo kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuthola okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, njengoba bekwazi ukufunda izibuyekezo zemikhiqizo nezincomo zabanye abathengi. Izinzuzo zokuthenga online zikhulu. Okokuqala, kunezindleko eziphansi. Ukuze abathengi bathenge online, akudingekile ukuthi bakhokhe izindleko zokuqasha izitolo, izisebenzi, noma izindleko zokugcina impahla. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni eziphansi zemikhiqizo, okwenza kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo ngamanani aphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathenge noma nini, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abanokusebenza okuningi. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini enomsebenzi ongapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kulula futhi kusebenza kahle. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba wonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ethile engatholakali ezindaweni zabo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho, njengoba kudala amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi nabathengisi. Izinjini zokusesha zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezinketho ezahlukene, futhi amapulatifomu amaningi anikeza izinhlelo zokuhamba ezizwakalayo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo efanele. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthenga online. Enye yeziqhamuka ezinkulu yokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Abathengi bavame ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali nemininingwane yabo siqu. Ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuphepha ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali noma ekubeni abathengi babhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abathengi babe nekhono lokuhlola izimakethe ezahlukeneyo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bazithola ezitolo ezithembekile. Enye inkinga ethinta ukuthenga online ukufana nokwakhiwa komkhiqizo. Abathengi abakwazi ukubona, ukuthinta noma ukuhlole umkhiqizo ngaphambi kokuwuthenga, okungaholela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo engahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukwakha ukholo phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba abathengi bezithola besebenzisa izithombe ezithile neziqubulo ezingase zingakhombisi kahle imikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kwenza kube nzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengoba abathengi bengenakho ukubona umkhiqizo ngokwakhe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukujabulisa abathengi, ikakhulukazi uma imikhiqizo ingafiki ngesikhathi noma ingahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Ukuze kuphumelele ukuthenga online, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ukufunda izibuyekezo, ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nokubheka izitolo eziyaziwayo kuyasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abathengi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Ekugcineni, ukuthenga online sekuphenduke indlela ebalulekile yokuthenga emhlabeni wanamuhla. Noma kungezona zonke izinzuzo ezithathwayo, izinselelo zikhona, futhi abathengi kufanele babe nekhono lokuhamba phakathi kwemithombo ehlukene ukuze benze izinqumo eziphusile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukuthenga online kuzoba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni, futhi sizobona izinguquko eziningi ezizayo kulolu hlelo lokuthenga.
Ukufunda Ngobuchwepheshe: Umpheki wempumelelo UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumfundisi wezobuchwepheshe odume kakhulu esifundazweni saseGauteng. Ukukhula kukaThandiwe kwahluka kakhulu kulokho okunembile ezimpilweni zabanye. Uhlanga lwakhe lwasekhaya lungamakhaya anemithetho elula, kodwa ngezimfanelo ezihlukile, uThandiwe uthole amandla okwenza ushintsho olukhulu empilweni yakhe. Ekhula emzini omncane, wathembeka esikhathini esinengqondo, lapho izifundo zobuchwepheshe zazifaka isandla sokujabulisa, ukubona ushintsho nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe esikoleni, uThandiwe wagxila ezinhlelweni zobuchwepheshe eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, lapho afundela ubunjiniyela bemishini. Ubulungiswa bukaThandiwe buvame ukusitshela ngempumelelo yakhe ethokozisayo yokuhlangana nezifundo ezinzima. Khona lapho, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhawulelwe nje kuhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe; ngaphakathi kokuhlaziya, wakwazi ukubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlose ukufezekisa okuningi kokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. UThandiwe ukholelwa ekutheni ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akukhona nje ukufunda ukuzenzela, kodwa nokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abe nomfaniswano ophakeme nabafundi, abamfakeli oxhasayo abathembela kuye emnothweni wobuchwepheshe. Ukukhuthaza, uthanda ukufundisa abafundi ngendawo yabo emphakathini nasebenziseni ubuchwepheshe kanye nezinsiza zendawo ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. Njengoba ethuthuka emsebenzini wakhe, uThandiwe waphendukela kumkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. Waqala ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambelana nezidingo zabafundi nezindawo eziphakanyiswa uMnyango wezeMfundo. Lokhu kusebenzelana kwakha isikhala sezakhamuzi ukusebenzisana. UThandiwe ubelokhu eqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokufunda ezihlanganisa imfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemikhakha ehlukene yezezimali. Lokhu kuthuthukisa indlela yokubuka imisebenzi eyenzekayo emphakathini. UThandiwe ungumfundisi ophumelelayo, okhuthaza abafundi abakhe umbono omuhle. Uqhuba imikhankaso yokubambisana ezitholakala emhlabeni wonke, equkethe amaphrojekthi akhe okuyisibonelo esihle sokuxhumanisa imiphakathi. UThandiwe unethuba lokuba nomthelela ohlelweni lomphakathi, eqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwazulu, umculi, imbongi, nomfundisi, uThandiwe ungaphezu komkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. Uqedela ubuchwepheshe nezindlela zokwakha abafundi ezitsheni zokuhlola, edala indlela yokuthi imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu emakethe yanamuhla. UThandiwe usebenzisa amakhono akhe akhe eziphathimandla ukuze kube nohlelo oluqinile lokufunda, lunikeza ithuba lokuthi abanye bakhule uze beqonde izidingo zomphakathi namanje kuzoyingxenye yempumelelo yabo esikhathini esizayo. Ubufakazi bokuphumelela kukaThandiwe ukukholwa ukuthi umphakathi ungathola uthando olukhona emfundweni, futhi ukwazi ukukhiqiza izithombe ezimbili ezibukekayo ukuze kuqondwe ukwehluka komkhakha. Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezincane, eziphakeme, kanye nezinhlelo zezezimali, uThandiwe wathola indlela yokunxenxa ubuchwepheshe, aphinde alwelwe imfundo eyakhayo. Emuva kwezinyanga eziningana zokwenza izinhlelo ezisemqoka, uThandiwe ugcizelela ukuthi umphakathi ungasiza ukufundisa kusebenze, ezikhathini ezinzima ziyashintsha. Umsebenzi wakhe uba isizathu sempumelelo, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buyinhloso ethokozisayo yokuthi ugcine imizwa emihle yangokwezifiso. Kuzoba nomphumela wokwakha izinhlelo ezizobasiza abafundi ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile nelimnandi ngemodi ethokozisayo. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, ulwela ukudlulisa izifundo zakhe kuzakwethu, echazela ukuthi izifundo zobuchwepheshe zingakhulisa injabulo nokuphila kwempilo okujabulisayo. Unomsebenzi omkhulu phambili, uvula amathuba amaningi, futhi uyacela kufanele ukwehlisa umkhankaso wakhe wokuthi ubuchwepheshe buphakwe kwaziwa esizukulwaneni esizayo. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumholi omeleke, ubonisa ukuthi ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka njalo emoyeni wokufunda nokuzitholela.
Ithelevishini: Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Nezindaba Ithelevishini, njengomkhiqizo wezobuchwepheshe, ibalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Iqala ukuvela emhlabeni ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1920, kodwa yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu kuphela ngasekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1950. Ngalesi sikhathi, ithelevishini yaguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo ulwazi, behlola izindaba, nezokungcebeleka. Namuhla, ithelevishini isiyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-thelevishini ungumcimbi obalulekile, owawuhlelwe ngonyaka odlule eGoli. Kwakukhona izinkampani eziningi ezazihlanganyela, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo ezintsha, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile, lapho abaphathi bephakamisa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ithelevishini, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Baphinde bagcizelele ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje indlela yokubuka, kodwa iyinsiza yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezethulo ezahlukene ezazihlanganisa izinhlelo ezahlukene, kusukela ezinhlelweni zezingane, ezokungcebeleka, nezokuhlola izindaba. Abadlalayo, ababhali, nabakhiqizi baveze izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezifundisayo. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Abathuthukisi baveze izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, ezifana ne-4K ne-8K, ezithuthukisa ikhwalithi yokubuka. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphendule ngempela, bephakamisa imibuzo mayelana nezindleko, ukufinyelela, kanye nezidingo zokubuka ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, njengokufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezinkulu ezikhiqiza ithelevishini, ezazikhombisa izindlela ezintsha zokukhangisa. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi, ababhali, nabadlalayo, njengoba izinkampani zifuna izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphinde babuke. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezihlanganisa izindaba, ubuciko, nezokungcebeleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi. Abantu baphakamisa izinkinga ezithinta izinhlelo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo enkulu, lapho abantu bephakamisa imibono yabo, bephinde bahlola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezahlukene, abaculi, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezihlanganisa izindaba, ubuciko, nezokungcebeleka. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngokuphetha, ithelevishini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-thelevishini ubonisa ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje indlela yokubuka, kodwa iyinsiza yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sikhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yethu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ithelevishini iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
### Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu #### Isingeniso Bubugebengu, noma imisebenzi engahambisani nomthetho, isimo esibucayi emiphakathini eminingi emhlabeni. Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu libonisa ubunzima obukhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwabantu, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubukhulu balesi simo, kudingeka sihlole imikhuba, izizathu, nemiphumela ehlobene nodlame, ubugebengu obubhalwa kumaphoyisa nemiphakathi, kanye nemiqondo ethile esiyithathayo. #### Ukubheka Izinga Lobugebengu Izinga lobugebengu lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ithinta impilo ngokukhula kokuthuthukiswa nezimo zomphakathi. Ezinye izindawo zibonisa ubugebengu obukhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ubuphofu, kanye nezinye izimo ezingezinhle empilweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindawo ezithuthukile zihlala zinezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa akukwazi ukususa zonke izici ezibanga ubugebengu. #### Izizathu Zokwanda Kwebugebengu Izizathu ezijwayelekile zokwanda kwebugebengu zifaka phakathi izimo zomnotho, ukungabi nemisebenzi, kanye nezimo zenhlalo. Umnotho ongenampilo uvame ukuheha abantu ukuba bazitholele izindlela zokuphila ngezenzo eziphula umthetho. Isimo sokuphila esinzima, lapho abantu bengatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo, sishiya abaningi besebenzisa ubugebengu ukuze baphile. Futhi, izizathu zengqondo nezempilo zikhona. Lokhu kubandakanya umuzwa wokuphoxeka, ukungaboni kahle kwemiphumela yokuziphatha, kanye nobudlelwano obungafanele phakathi kwabantu. Ubufakazi bokuthi abantu baphenduka ubugebengu ngenxa yezizathu zengqondo bukhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo zengqondo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezingqondweni zabantu, okwenza kube nezimo ezithinta impilo. #### Imiphumela Yobugebengu Emaphakathi eminingi, ubugebengu bunomthelela omkhulu. Ukukhula kwezinga lobugebengu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu kuhulumeni nasemiphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko zokugcina izinhlelo zokuphepha, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo ukuze abantu baqonde imithetho, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa labo abaphule imithetho. Ngaphezu kwemali, ubugebengu buye buholele ezinhlekweni zokuhlukumeza, okungabangela ukungahleleki emiphakathini. Izinga lobugebengu libalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi emphakathini, okungaholela ekwehleni kobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphula umthetho. #### Izixazululo Zokulwa Nobugebengu Ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobugebengu, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziqinile zokwakha umphakathi ozinzile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola izimiso ezahlukene, okubandakanya ukukhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni. Izinhlangano zomphakathi, imibutho, kanye nezinhlaka zentuthuko zidinga ukusebenzisana nohulumeni ukuze zisebenzise izinhlelo ezihlobene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwelapha izinzwa zengqondo, ukuvikela, nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi zibalulekile. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzisane, kuhlanganisa nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivimbela ubugebengu. #### Isiphetho Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu liyinkinga enkulu edinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela. Ukuziqhenya kwezenhlalakahle, imfuneko yokubambisana, kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze kutholwe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuqonda izizathu ezihlobene nobugebengu nempilo yomphakathi kungasiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abe nesandla ekulweni nale nkinga ukuze kwakhiwe umphakathi oqinile, onobumbano, nohloniphekile.
Ukufunda Online: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini ukufunda online? Ukufunda online, noma ukufunda nge-inthanethi, kuwumqondo ohlanganisa izindlela zokufunda ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, izifundo ezivela ezikoleni, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala kumapulatifomu ahlukene. Abafundi bangafunda ngezikhathi zabo, besebenzisa amakhompyutha, amaphilisi, noma ama-smartphones. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda online? Izinsiza zokufunda online zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zenza ukufunda kube lula, ngoba abafundi bangafunda noma kuphi, noma kunini. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba balungise izifundo zabo nezikhathi zabo zokufunda. Okwesibili, ukufunda online kuvame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo ezisemakhaya, njengoba abanye abafundi bangagwema izindleko zokuhamba noma zokuhlala. Okwesithathu, kunezinketho eziningi zokufunda, okuvumela abafundi ukuba bakhethe izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo zokufunda online? Noma kunjalo, ukufunda online akukhululekile ezinselelweni. Abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo zokuzikhandla, njengoba kungase kube nzima ukuzigcina bephapheme futhi beqotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, njengoba ukufunda online kudinga ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ezindaweni ezingenayo inethiwekhi esheshayo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela zokufunda online ezitholakalayo? Kunezindlela eziningi zokufunda online. Izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi zingaba zifushane noma zide, futhi zingahlanganisa izifundo ezivela ezikoleni, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, noma izikhungo ezikhethekile. Abafundi bangasebenzisa amavidiyo, izincwadi, izifundo ezibukhoma, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana ukuze bathole ulwazi. Amathuluzi afana ne-Zoom, Google Classroom, kanye ne-Moodle ayasiza ekufundeni. Umbuzo 5: Kungani ukufunda online kubalulekile? Ukufunda online kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abantu badinga ukufunda amakhono amasha ukuze bahlale bephambili emsebenzini. Ukufunda online kuvumela abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokufunda, noma ngabe baphila kanjani. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezobuchwepheshe, ezempilo, kanye nezokuxhumana. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izeluleko zokuphumelela ekufundeni online? Ukuze uphumelele ekufundeni online, kubalulekile ukuba necebo. Qala ngokwakha isheduli yokufunda, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola isikhathi esanele sokufunda. Futhi, zama ukwakha indawo ethule nekhululekile yokufunda, ukuze ugweme ukuphazamiseka. Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi nabafundisi kungasiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokubambisana, okungaba usizo ekufundeni. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela yokufunda esikhathini esizayo? Ngokubheka izitayela zokufunda ezikhulayo, kubonakala sengathi ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela yokufunda esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo zemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokwandisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, futhi abantu abaningi baye bahlola lezi zindlela zokufunda. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukufunda online kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu, izinketho eziningi, kanye nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele ngaphambi kokukhetha ukufunda online? Ngaphambi kokukhetha ukufunda online, kubalulekile ukuthi ucabangele izidingo zakho. Qonda ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezithakazelisayo, futhi uhlole izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zifundo. Futhi, cabanga ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhumana nabafundisi, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha uhlelo olufanele. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe ukufunda online kuyahambisana nezifundo ezisemakhaya? Yebo, ukufunda online kungahambisana nezifundo ezisemakhaya. Abafundi bangasebenzisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze baqedele izifundo zabo, noma bangezelela ulwazi lwabo. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba baqhubeke nokufunda, noma ngabe baphila kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda online kungaba yindlela yokufunda eyengeziwe, evumela abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyifunda ekufundeni online? Ekufundeni online, ungafunda amakhono amasha, izifundo ezithakazelisayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, futhi kukusize ube nolwazi olunzulu. Ukufunda online akugcini nje ngokufunda izifundo, kodwa futhi kukuvumela ukuba ube nekhono lokuzikhandla, ukuzimela, nokuphumelela. Isiphetho Ukufunda online kuyindlela eyinqaba yokufunda, enezinzuzo eziningi nezinselelo. Kubalulekile ukuba abafundi baqonde lezi zinto ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela ebalulekile yokufunda esikhathini esizayo. Ngakho, thina sonke kufanele sizame ukufunda ngendlela efanele, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphumelela.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano Ngesikhathi ilanga likhanya kakhulu eGoli, umphakathi wahlangana emkhakheni omkhulu wezokungcebeleka. Kwakukhona umncintiswano omkhulu we-basketball obizwa ngokuthi "Ibhola Lethu." Abantu babejabulile, bejolise emkhakheni, bekhuluma ngabadlali abavelele, abanye bezijabulisa ngeziphuzo, kanti abanye bejolise ezindaweni ezikhethekile ukuze babone kahle. UThabo, umgibeli ophumelele emidlalweni edlule, wayezimisele ukujabulisa abalandeli bakhe. Yize uThabo engumfana ophuma emndenini ophakathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano babubanga umdlandla. Wazi ukuthi umphakathi ubheke kuye, futhi wayefuna ukukhombisa ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Ngesikhathi umncintiswano uqala, izinkanyezi ziqala ukuvela. UThabo noSipho, umngani wakhe, babejabulile, bejolise emkhakheni. UThabo wayezama ukugcina ukugxila, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana wawumkhumbuza ukuthi akufanele aphumele ngaphandle. Umphakathi wawumkhumbula, futhi uyafuna ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Umdlalo uqala, umoya wawugcwele. UThabo wathola ibhola, wakhuphuka, waphosa, waphosa ibhola elibhalwe kahle. Kwakungathi ibhola lalingena emoyeni, laphuma phansi, umphakathi wawujabule, uThabo waba yinkanyezi emkhakheni. Kodwa umphakathi wawungazi ukuthi uThabo wayenobuhlungu obukhulu. Ngemuva kokuphosa ibhola, wathola ukuthi umgibeli ophikisanayo, uMandla, wayemkhumbuza ngezinkumbulo ezinzima. UThabo wayekade edlala ibhola, kodwa kwenzeka ingozi eminyakeni edlule, wathola ukulimala okukhulu. Lokhu kwashiya umoya wakhe uphansi, kodwa wayezimisele ukulwa. Umdlalo uqhubeka, futhi uThabo wayezama ukugcina umoya wakhe uphansi. Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, kodwa uMandla wayephikisana naye, efuna ukumnqanda. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, umphakathi wawujabule, kodwa uThabo wayezwa ubuhlungu. Wazi ukuthi kufanele akhumbule ukuthi umphakathi ubheke kuye, futhi wayefuna ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wawujabule, uThabo waba yinkanyezi emkhakheni. UThabo noSipho baphuma emkhakheni, bejabulile, umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uThabo wayezimisele ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni - Ingxoxo Nengcweti Isingeniso Ngiyakwemukela, Mnu. Dlamini, uhlobo lwakho lwezinto ezithinta inkohlakalo kuhulumeni. Njengomphakathi, sizama ukuqonda kahle lesi sifo esingcolisa umphakathi wethu. Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi yisiphi isimo esikhona manje? Umlando Wenkohlakalo Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni ayikubona obala kuphela, kodwa ibonakala ezindaweni eziningi. Kukhona izigameko ezithinta izinkontileka, ukusetyenziswa kabi kwemali, kanye nokushintsha kwemithetho ukuze kube nezinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kudala umonakalo omkhulu, hhayi kuphela kuhulumeni kodwa nakumphakathi wonke. Izimbangela Zenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Kukhona izimbangela eziningi eziyimbangela yalesi sifo. Kuthinta izimo zomnotho, umoya wokuncintisana, kanye nokungabi bikho kokubhekelela. Ungakuchaza lokhu ngokuningiliziwe? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, izimo zomnotho eziyingozi zithinta abantu ukuthi babheke izindlela ezithile zokuthola inzuzo ngokushesha. Ngaphandle kokubhekisisa, abanye bahamba phambili, behluleka ukuqonda ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima emaphakathini. Umoya wokuncintisana uvame ukuholela ekutheni abantu basebenzise izindlela ezingekho emthethweni ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. Imiphumela Yenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Lokhu kubuhlungu. Ngabe singakhuluma ngemiphumela ethile yokukhula kwenkohlakalo emiphakathini yethu? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela. Uma inkohlakalo ikhulile, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zomphakathi zincipha. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nakho kwabantu ukuthola imfundo, ezempilo, noma ezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemiphakathi emisha engase ibonakale njengoba izinsiza zingatholakali. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Ngabe yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulwiswe le nkinga? Mnu. Dlamini: Ukugcina izinga lokuphila eliphezulu kubalulekile. Kukho imizamo eminingi yokwakha amakhomishini ezokuhlola kanye nemithetho yokubopha abaphathiswa. Kodwa, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezingokwenhlalo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukubona ubungozi benkohlakalo. Indlela Yokwakha Ukuziphatha Okuhle Umphenyi: Ngabe abantu bangakwenza njani ukuze bakhe ukuziphatha okuhle? Mnu. Dlamini: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baxhumane, bahlanganyele, futhi bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo. Umphakathi udinga ukwakha ubumbano ukuze uvikele izinqubo zokwenza izinto ezingekho emthethweni. Ukuhlonipha, ukusiza abanye, nokuphila ngokuhlonipha imithetho kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi owaziwayo. Isiphetho Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ingabe unokuthumeleka okuqondile komphakathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuveza ukuthi abantu kumele bakhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi ithembele kubo. Kufanele basebenzisane ukuze baphumelele. Inkohlakalo ayiyona indlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kuhlangene nabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kumele kuqhubeke ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uthola konke okudingayo. Ngiyabonga.
Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Kwakukwaziwa edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngokuthi uMthatha, elalikhanya ngempumelelo yokukhula kwalo. Nokho, phakathi kwalezi zinsuku, umoya wephithizela wawuhamba edolobheni, ulethe izindaba ezinzima zokwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Abantu babekhuluma ngalesi sifo esishisayo, njengoba izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zavesa zikhula njengemithi emhlabathini. Ekuqaleni, izinsuku zaziphephile, abantu besebenzisa izindawo ezisemthethweni, kodwa njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zabantu zakhula, umnotho wendawo waphazamiseka, kwavela izinselelo ezintsha. Abahlala emakhaya, bedinga izindawo zokuhlala, baqala ukwakha izindlu ezincane ezingenamthetho. Ngenxa yokuntuleka komthetho, lokhu kwadala umndeni omkhulu wabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, baphuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni befuna ukuphila okuhle. Kwakukhona uThandi, intombazane encane eyayikhula edolobheni, eyaziwa ngothando lwezithombe. UThandi wayehlala noMama wakhe, uNandi, owayesebenza njengefektri ye-‘sewing’ ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo. Njengoba uThandi eseyinkosikazi, wayevame ukuhamba nabangani bakhe endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi iMshayazafe, lapho kwakhiwa khona izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Lezi zindawo zazihlanganisa amakhaya ashukumisayo, izitolo ezincane, nezindawo zokudlela ezinhle, kodwa kwakukhona nemiphumela engalungile. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola izindlela zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo. UThandi wayezisola, ebona ukuthi umoya ubuhlungu, kodwa imiphefumulo yabo yayiqhubeka nokukhula. Uxhosa, umngani kaThandi, wayenombono othi, “Siyashoda, kwaziwa ukuthi akusikho konke okungoka, kodwa izimpilo zethu zidinga ukwakhiwa.” Lokhu kwakubeka umoya wengcindezi kubo, njengoba bephokophele ekutholeni izindlela zokuphila. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, izigameko zanda. Iziphathimandla zathola ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zikhula ngokushesha, ziqinisa imithetho yazo, kodwa izinyathelo ezazithathwa azizange zisebenze. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemthethweni baqala ukucasuka, besaba ukuthi izindawo ezinjalo zizobenza baphule imithetho yabo. Ubaba kaThandi, uMnumzana Nkosi, wayephakathi kwezikhulu zomphakathi. Wayefuna ukusiza, kodwa wayezwa umuzwa wokuthi ukungena ezinkingeni ezinjengalezi kungaba yingozi. Wayengathanda ukusiza abanye, kodwa ukucabanga ukumisa lezi zindawo ezisemthethweni kwenza abe nokungabaza. Ngenkathi uThandi ebona ubaba esebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuthola izixazululo, wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nokuba nomusa kubalulekile. Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaziqala ukuba nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene. Izinyathelo zeziphathimandla zazinamandla, kodwa kubantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kwaba nenkinga enkulu. UThandi waphakama, wathola ukuthi izinsizakusebenza nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemthethweni kufanele baqaphele futhi benzise amandla abo ukuze bakhe uxolo. Wakhumbula umyalezo kaMama wakhe, owawukhumbuza ukuthi umphakathi ubalulekile, nokuthi uma benza izinqumo, kufanele babheke phambili. Ngesikhathi uThandi esaqhubeka nokusebenza nabangani bakhe, bahlangana nabanye abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu behlanganyela izinsiza, bejolisa ekwakheni amathuba. Kancane kancane, uThandi waqala ukubona izinguquko. Izindawo ezazingekho emthethweni zashintsha zaba izindawo eziphephile, abantu baqala ukubambisana ukuze bakhe umphakathi ongcono. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola indlela yokuhlanganyela imicabango, ecabanga ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zingaba neqhaza elihle. Ngalesi sikhathi, iziphathimandla zathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo kwaba yisinyathelo esihle. Umphakathi wathola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano, kwaba nesivumelwano sokudala izindawo ezisemthethweni ezinhle. Ekugcineni, uThandi wabona ukuthi izinselelo ezazikhona zingashintsha uma abantu benza isinyathelo sokubambisana. Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaba yizikhala zokukhula, zaba izindawo zokuhlangana, futhi umoya wengcindezi waphumela emoyeni. UThandi wayejabule, ebona ukukhanya empilweni, futhi umphakathi waqala ukuvuka. Kwakukhona umuzwa ophumile, umphakathi wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kwakungekho ngaphansi komoya wokukhungathekisa, kodwa kwakuphephile. Umoya wephithizela wajabula, abantu behlangana, futhi uThandi wayekwazi ukujabulisa, eqhubeka nokuthatha izithombe zamazwi abo, ezithokozisa izinsuku ezilandelayo. Ngenxa yokubambisana, uMthatha waba yidolobha elihambisana nezinto ezinhle, futhi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaba yizikhala zokukhula, zashintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi.

USipho wathola lawo magama enza umoya wakhe uphaphame. Wayefisa ukuthi abanye bakwazi ukujwayela lezi zinto ezintsha futhi bazifunde, kodwa wayezwa engakhululekile ukusho izimvo zakhe. UChatGPT, kunoma yisiphi isikhathi, wamfaka ekubambeni izinkulumo ezimnandi, eqonda kahle ukuxhumana, kodwa siphakamisa umqondo wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungalimaza ubudlelwano bomuntu nomuntu uma engahloniphi. Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wamemezela umkhosi omncane emzaneni. Wafuna ukuthi umphakathi wakhe we-Digital Youth ube yindawo yokuxhumana lapho bengahlanganyela khona ulwazi lwabo, bezihlanganisa neChatGPT. Uthando lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe lwagqugquzela nomphakathi, ngezinsizakalo ezihlangene nezokuxhumana. Kwakuyisikhathi sokuhlangana, sokufunda, nokuxhumana. Uthando lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe lwabuyisela umoya omusha emzaneni. Ngesikhathi somkhosi, uSipho wanikeza okuthile, izifundo ngendlela yokusebenzisa iChatGPT. Abantu bejabulile, behlakaniphile, begculisekile ngaphezu kwengxoxo. UChantelle, intombaziyingane, wakhumbula izimpendulo ezahlukahlukene ezitholakele, wafunda ukuthi ngezizathu ezikhethekile, ubuchwepheshe abuhlali buhle. Indlela uZipho abelapha ngayo iChatGPT ikanye nomoya wokuphila, uChantelle waquba. Abantu bathokoza kakhulu, futhi ngemva kokuba sebudlamlilo, uSipho waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe. Wazama ukuthola izindlela ezihluke, eqonda ukuthi indlela yokukhuluma nemishini icela umoya wokuhloniphana. Kayesabi unyaka, akasesabi ukubonisa abanye indlela ebhalwe yizinsuku ezedlule. UChatGPT waba umngane, umfundisi, nomthombo wezihluku. Isikhathi sihamba, kodwa imiqondo emisha iqhubeka. UChatGPT wawubona ubudlelwano obuphakeme phakathi kwabantu. USipho, enokufudumele, wafunda ukuthi izithombe ezithintekayo kwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Wayezwa ukwaneliseka kokuhlanganyela izimpendulo ezithokozisayo futhi efuna ukuba nxazonke ezimweni ezahlukahlukene. Ngemuva kokuhlola uhambo lweminyaka eyishumi, uSipho wagcina ekwazi kahle lokhu, wathi, “Ubuchwepheshe buyehlisa umqondo wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kumele sikhumbule ukuhamba phambili, sizwakalise izwi lethu.” Uhlanga lwakhe lwade lwaba yinsiza yokufunda. Ukuhlekisa, ukufunda, nokuhlanganisa kwavuma ngokuzenzakalelayo emoyeni, kanti umphakathi wathuthuka ngemibono emisha. Ekugcineni, uSipho waphinta unyaka, ephinde abayeke abantu bejabulile. Wayezazi ukuthi imiqondo yakhe yempilo yayiyinsiza ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngakho, umphakathi uBumbene waba yindawo yokuhlanganyela izimpumelelo, engashintsha izindlela zokuphila. Uthando lwenhlonipho, ubugagu, izinsizakalo, kanye neChatGPT kwaba yinsiza yokwehlisa ubuhlobo. Uthando lwezobuchwepheshe hlangana neChatGPT, kwaba umqondo ohlangene, ohlanganisa ubuchwepheshe nezikhala zokuhlanganyela, okwakungazange kwandiswa koSipho. Waba yindawo yokuxhumana, nokuhlobisa izimpumelelo ezithokozisayo. Umsakazo ohloniphekile waba umholi, owavula amehlo omphakathi kuzo zonke ezithile. Lokhu kwaba yokuqala kwesizukulwane esisha esaziwa ngoSipho, nesizolalelana eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane ezizayo. Phakade uSipho noChatGPT bahlala bobabili, bahlala bezama ukuthola izimpendulo ezimnandi.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwamalungelo Abantu: Umcimbi Wokukhumbula Nezinyathelo Zokuzivikela Ngomhla ka-10 kuNhlangulana, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlangana eGoli emcimbini obalulekile, ukuze bakhumbule futhi baphakamise izwi labo ngokumelene nokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu. Lo mcimbi, owenziwa ngamaqembu ahlukene ezokuhlalisana, ubandakanya izinkulumo ezivela kubaholi bendawo, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo ezilwela amalungelo abantu, bonke bejolise ekuthuthukiseni isimo samalungelo abantu eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evula umcimbi, egcizelela ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokuphila kahle futhi kufanele avikelwe ngokuqinile. Umgqugquzeli, uNksz. Thandiwe Mkhize, uthe: “Siyazi ukuthi kuningi okwenziwa ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, kodwa kusenezinto eziningi ezidinga ukulungiswa.” Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule futhi bathumele iziphakamiso zabo. Ngemuva kwalokho, izinkulumo ezivela kubaholi bamazwe ahlukene zaphakamisa izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abahlukunyezwayo. Uthishanhloko, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ezindaweni ezikude, kodwa nakulezi zindawo esiphila kuzo.” Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu abahlukahlukene, abakhuluma ngezinto abazibona zenzeka ezimpilweni zabo. Uhlelo lwemcimbi lwagcizelela izifundo ezivela ezincwadini ezibhalwe ngamalungelo abantu, lapho ababhali baphawula khona izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abahlukunyezwayo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ziningi izithiyo ezivela ezinhlelweni ezikhona, ezifana nokungabi bikho kokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ukungabikhona kwemali yokwenza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthathe ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Abantu baphakamisa iziphakamiso ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasemakhaya, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezilwela amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bebonisa isifiso sokusebenza ndawonye ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. Umcimbi uphinde waphakanyiswa ngemicabango yokuthi ukufundiswa nokwaziswa kwabaqeqeshiwe kufanele kube yinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lubonisa ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi kahle amalungelo abo, okuholela ekutheni bahlukunyezwe kalula. Ukufundiswa kwalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabavikela kanjani abanye. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isikhala sokuxoxa, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Abantu baphuma bematasa, bejabule futhi bephakamisela izwi labo, beqonda ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukona okungathathwa kancane. Umphakathi ubonisa isifiso sokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi umoya wokuzimisela ubonakala phakathi kwabo bonke ababe khona. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene namalungelo abantu, umphakathi unamandla okwenza ushintsho. Ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuzimisela kuyizinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa khona. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wawungesiyo nje indawo yokukhumbula, kodwa futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sizokwenza kanjani ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi asavikelwe.
Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Ngiyavuma, ukusebenza kwePhalamende kuyinto eyisithokozisayo. Ukuphila kwethu kwansuku zonke kuningi okuxhomeke kokuqukethwe kwalo msebenzi. Phalamende, njengoba sazi, iyinhlangano yesithathu efana nezinye, kodwa ibaluleke kakhulu njengoba iyingxenye yohulumeni. Ngizokhuluma kancane ngalesi sikhungo, okwenza umsebenzi wayo ube neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabantu. Kwaqala ngokuqonda ukuthi iPhalamende inezigaba ezimbili: iNdlu Yabantu neNdlu Yezinduna. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kubalulekile ngoba kunceda ukuhlela izinto. INdlu Yabantu iyinhlangano lapho abantu bekhulumela izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, kanti iNdlu Yezinduna igcwele abantu abanolwazi olujulile kwezepolitiki, abahlala beqondisa izinqumo. Lokhu kwenza kube nokusebenza okuhamba phambili, njengoba izindleko nezidingo zomphakathi zihlala zibonwa. Uma ubheka kuqala, khona khona izinsuku ezithile, iPhalamende ihlangana ukuze ibhekele izindaba ezisemqoka. Kumane kuyinkulumo, kodwa ngokuyisisekelo, kungamaphuzu ayisithupha aqhubekayo. Lokhu kuvumela ukuxoxisana ngezindaba ezithinta izwe, izimiso, nezinhlelo ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungathola ithuba lokuhlola nokuphendula lapho izinqumo zithathwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu badinga ukuba nezwi, futhi iPhalamende iyindawo lapho izwi lethu litholakala khona. Ngokubambisana, iPhalamende ibuye ibe nethuba lokubona izifiso zabantu. Ukuhamba phambili kulezi zinsuku, kunemihlangano eminingi, okukhona kuyo izinkulumo ezibucayi mayelana nezindaba ezithinta umnotho, ezempilo, nemfundo. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izinqumo zibe nesisekelo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhangela izidingo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela okuthandwa ngababusi. Kukhona futhi izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwePhalamende. Izinhlelo zokuqhuba izinqumo zisebenza ngokuhlanganyela, futhi izinkokheli zidinga ukuba ziqonde kahle ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa kanjani. Lokhu kusiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho osomqulu abaphumelele kakhulu, nokuthi izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi zixoxwa ngendlela efanele nesekela umphakathi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba sikhuluma, kukhona izikhathi zokungaboni ngaso linye. Abantu bavame ukungaboni kahle ngezinto ezithinta izinqumo ezithathwa ePhalamende. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani, futhi kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abanesizotha ukuze basebenze ngokuqinile. Ukuqonda izinqumo ezithathwayo, abantu badinga ukuhamba phambili, baziqhenye ngalesi sikhungo, futhi benze kube sobala ukuthi izinqumo zenzelwa ukuthuthukisa umphakathi. Olunye uhlelo lokusebenza lwePhalamende lubandakanya ukuxhumana. Noma ngabe abantu bangase babe namahloni, iPhalamende ibalulekile ukuze izwi labo litholakale. Ngalokhu, izithangami neziqondiso zidinga ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu. Kufanele kube nezinkulumo ezibucayi, futhi abantu badinga ukuveza imicabango yabo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinkinga ezikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufaka isandla kwabaningi. Umphakathi kufanele uthole ithuba lokuba nomthelela. Njengoba sikhuluma, izinhlelo zokubambisana zidinga ukuba zihlale zikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezithinta abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuhle kakhulu ukuba nabantu abavela ezimbonini ezahlukene ukuze babe nesithakazelo esifanele. Ngokuphetha, iPhalamende iyisithangami esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukusebenza kwayo kudinga ukuba kube nokukhulumisana okuhle, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Abantu badinga ukuzizwa bebandakanyekile, futhi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke imicabango, izicelo, nezidingo zabantu. Ngaleyo ndlela, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, noyinsakavukela. IPhalamende kumele iqhubekele phambili ngale ndlela, ukuze ihlale ibheke ikusasa eliqhakazile kubo bonke abantu.
Ukuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe (Digital Communication) Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuxhumana ezisetshenziswa abantu ukuze baxhumane, sebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, ama-imeyili, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ngama-video. Ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane kalula, noma ngabe bakuphi emhlabeni. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Izinsiza ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe zenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Abantu bangathumela imiyalezo ngokushesha, futhi bangaxhumana ngezikhathi ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu, futhi kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuvumela ukuxhumana okuqondile, okungathuthukisa ubudlelwano. Umbuzo 3: Ziyini izinkinga ezihambisana nokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Noma kukhona izinzuzo, kukhona nezinkinga. Ukuze abantu baxhumane ngobuchwepheshe, kudinga ukufinyelela kumadivayisi afanele nezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi. Lokhu akusiyo njalo okulula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwamakhono okuxhumana, njengoba abanye abantu bengathandi ukuveza imizwa yabo ngokuqondile. Umbuzo 4: Kungani ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla? Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bubalulekile ngoba bunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kolwazi, ukumelwa kwezwi kwabantu, nokuhlanganyela imicabango. Ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba babe yingxenye yomphakathi omkhulu, futhi babezwa izindaba ezivela kwezinye izindawo, okwandisa umbono wabo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuguqula izindlela zokuxhumana? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuguqule izindlela zokuxhumana ngokwenza kube lula. Okwakudala, abantu babengakholwa ukuthi bangaxhumana nabanye abantu ngaleso sikhathi. Kodwa manje, imiyalezo ingathunyelwa kalula, nokuxhumana kumavidiyo kuyatholakala. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezixhumanisi ezijulile phakathi kwabantu, kanti abantu bangaba nokuhlangenwe nakho okusha. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe? Kunezindlela eziningi zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana noFacebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram; izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo efana noWhatsApp noTelegram; kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhlanganyela ezinjengeZoom neSkype. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukuxhumana, futhi zenza kube nokwaziswa okuncane. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuhlobene nezobuchwepheshe? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuhlobene nezobuchwepheshe ngoba kudinga izinhlelo, ama-apps, kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi ukuze kwenziwe. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana buveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bunomthelela omkhulu ekuxhumaneni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kuyasobala ukuthi nezindlela zokuxhumana zizoshintsha futhi zibe ngcono. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubalulekile emsebenzini? Emsebenzini, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ngoba kuvumela abasebenzi ukuthi baxhumane kalula, bahlanganyele izimvo, futhi benze izinqumo ngokushesha. Izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokusebenza kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda, futhi zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenza ngempumelelo nangokubambisana. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kunciphisa umkhawulo wezakhiwo? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kunciphisa umkhawulo wezakhiwo ngendlela yokuthi abantu bangaxhumana, noma bahlala ezindaweni ezihlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wokusebenza, njengoba abantu bangasebenza ngokubambisana, noma ngabe bangaphakathi kwezitolo ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala imikhakha emisha yokusebenza futhi kuvala izikhala phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Umbuzo 10: Yini engase ibaluleke kakhulu kwabanye uma kukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Uma kukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kufanele siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nakho, njengezokuphepha nokuvikeleka kolwazi. Kubalulekile ukufunda ukusebenza kahle ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze ukuxhumana kube kuphephile futhi kube nezinzuzo. Ukubambisana nokuhlonipha izifundo ezivela kwabanye kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuzoba phakathi kwezinto ezizaqhubeka zikhula, futhi kufanele siqhubeke siyazisa izinzuzo zakhona, siphinde sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Uhambo Lwabo Lokudala Nokwabelana Ekuqaleni, emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho izikhala zabantu ziqhamuka khona, kwavela isigaba esisha somphakathi. Abadali bokuqukethwe, noma "content creators," babezobambisana nemibono yabo, bezama ukwabelana ngezinto ezithokozisayo, ezixakile, nezifundisayo. Babengabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, bejolise ezinhlakeni ezahlukene zokuphila. Lokhu kwakubanjwe nokukhuthazwa kokuxhumana, okwakwenziwa ngamasiko ahlukahlukene. UThandi, ungumfana ophuma eThekwini, wayehlala ethanda ukudweba. Ngokuvamile, wayebhala izinkanyezi ezinhle emaphepheni, kodwa wazibuza: "Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi ngabelane ngalokho engikudalayo?" Ngemuva kokuthi abona amavidiyo abanye abantu abawabelana ngawo ku-inthanethi, wathola umdlandla. Waqala ukudala amavidiyo akhe, edweba izithombe ezithokozisayo, ezihambisana nomculo, futhi wabelane ngazo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukudala akuphumelelanga kuphela, kodwa kwaba yindlela yokuxhumana nabantu abaningi. Abantu abazungezile, abaphuma emhlabeni wonke, baqala ukuveza izimvo zabo. UThandi wathola umphakathi omkhulu, lapho abalandeli bakhe bejabulisa lapho bebona imisebenzi yakhe. Lokhu kwazisa uThandi ngawe, futhi wathola ukuthi akagculiseki kuphela ngamakhono akhe, kodwa futhi nabanye abantu abavuma ukubuka nokuxoxa naye. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNandi, intokazi ephuma eGoli, naye wayebona indlela abantu ababelana ngayo bokuqukethwe. Wabona abanye bephuma ezindaweni ezinzima, kodwa baphumelela ngenxa yokwakha imiphakathi eyakhiwe ngezinhloso ezifanayo. U-Nandi wayelithanda ukucula, futhi wathola ukuthi uyakwazi ukudala izinkanyezi ezimnandi. Waqala ukucula amaculo akhe, futhi wahamba phambili wabelana ngazo ku-YouTube. Izinto zokuqala zaze zikhona, izithombe ziqhubeka zikhula, futhi uNandi waqala ukuthola ukwaziwa. Abantu bejabuliswa yizwi lakhe, futhi umphakathi wakhe wakhula. Wazithola esebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abheke izimvo, axoxe nabalandeli, futhi abhalise izifundo ezithile zokucula. Lokhu kwafaka uNandi endaweni ephakeme, evumela ukuba abone ukuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe kungaba nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela empilweni yakhe, kodwa nasempilweni yabanye. Njengoba ababili, uThandi noNandi, beqhubeka nezifundo zabo, baqonda ukuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe akukhona kuphela ukucula noma ukudweba. Kukhona namanye amafomu, njengokubhala, ukudala imifanekiso, nemidlalo yokudlala. UThandi wathola ukuthi ungumbhali omuhle, evula iminyango emisha yokuxhumana. Abantu bacela izindaba, izinkanyezi zempilo, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wabantu abathanda ukudala bokuqukethwe waqala ukuvuthwa. Abanye babantu baqala ukuba nezinhloso eziningi, behlola izindlela zokuthola imali ngale ndlela. Abadali baqala ukufunda ukuthi bangathola kanjani ukuhweba ngezinto abazidalayo, bephuma ngaphakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. UThandi noNandi, njengabanye abaninzi, baqala ukufunda ukubaluleka kokubambisana. UThandi noNandi, behlanganisa amakhono abo, benza umkhiqizo owodwa. Bahamba ndawonye, beqhamuka nemicabango emisha, benza ukufana kumavidiyo, izithombe, nemicimbi. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuthola amakhono amaningi, futhi abantu babenqaba ukuzithokozisa. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuguquka, abaphakathi bokuqukethwe baqonda ukuthi kufanele balandele izitayela ezintsha. UThandi noNandi babekwazi ukufunda njalo, bejolise ezintweni ezintsha, bephendukela ezinkundleni ezihlukahlukene, nezindlela ezintsha zokukhuluma. Babengazi nje kuphela ukuthi babezokwakha imiphakathi, kodwa futhi babezokwakha izinkumbulo ezizohlala njalo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziba nezinto eziningi ezintsha, futhi abadali bokuqukethwe baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha. UThandi noNandi baqonda ukuthi imiphakathi yabo ayizange ibaluleke kakhulu. Ukuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuhlanganisa imicabango zabo kwaba yindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, abanikazi bokuqukethwe, njengabanye, baqonda ukuthi umhlaba wabo ungcono uma bekhuthazana, behlanganyela, futhi bephumelela bonke. UThandi noNandi bahlala bematasa, besebenzisana, bequbuka, futhi bephinde bahlanganyela imisebenzi yabo emisha, bejabulisa abantu abaningi. Ubuqotho, uthando, nokubambisana kwaba yizinto ezijulile emphakathini wabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe akusona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngakho, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala behamba phambili, beqhubeka nokwakha, bahlola, futhi behlanganyela izindaba zabo emhlabeni wonke. Uthando lwabo lokudala luhamba phambili, futhi imiphakathi yabo ikhula, ithokozisa, futhi ibalulekile njengokuthi izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu kwezulu.
ISIHLOKO: iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand – Ukuvuselela Ezemfundo Nokuqonda Komphakathi iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, eyaziwa kakhulu ngenxa yokukhula kwayo okuhle emkhakheni wezokufunda eNingizimu Afrika, ibonakala njengendawo efanele abafundi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Le nyuvesi, esungulwe ngonyaka ka-1922, inezinhlelo eziqinile kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokusungula ezobuchwepheshe, futhi ihlale ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izifundo ezihambelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuvuselelwa kwezemfundo ku-Nyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand kubhekwa njengesisekelo esibalulekile sokukhulisa umnotho wezwe. Abafundi bangakhetha eziningi ezahlukene kwezifundo, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezobuchwepheshe, ezempilo, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomhlaba, le nyuvesi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikhiqizayo, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini lapho ubuchwepheshe buhlale buguquka. Izinsiza zeNyuvesi zisebenza kahle, zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokucwaninga ezisezingeni eliphakeme, izinkundla zokuzijabulisa, nemishini yesimanje. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola amathuba amaningi okuhlola, ukucwaninga, nokuzifundela. Ukwaziswa kokwenza ucwaningo kukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bangabi abatholi kuphela imfundo, kodwa babe ngababalulekile emiphakathini yabo. Ngaphezu kwemfundo, iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand ibheka izinga lempilo yabafundi, ikwakha izinhlelo zokwesekwa ezihlanganisa izifundo zokugcina ukhululekile, amaphrojekthi okuhlanganyela emiphakathini, kanye noqeqesho olwakha amakhono omsebenzi. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iphinde ibambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa nokuxhaswa okubhaliwe, okuqinisekisa imiphumela emihle yokuhlala kabusha kwabafundi. Imikhosi eyahlukene, efana neNyuvesi Yezakhamuzi, ibonisa indlela iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand esebenza ngayo ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphezulu nezinhlelo ezikhiqizayo. Ngenxa yemikhosi eyenzeka njalo, abafundi bukhuthazwa ukuba babonise ubuqotho, uthando, kanye nezinto zokuzibandakanya, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi namanye amakholwa. I-Nyuvesi isevele ibhekelele izinhlelo zayo zokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi abaningi, isebenzisa imithombo yamaphrojekthi nezinhlelo zezimali ukuze ithole izifundo ezithile zokweseka abafundi abavela ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuthuthuka kwezinga lokufundiswa, okwenyusa amathuba abafundi abathola izifundo. Ngokubambisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nezikhungo zezimali, iNyuvesi ithuthukisa imisebenzi yabantu abasebenzelana nemfundo, ibheke phambili ekunciphiseni izikhalazo nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinga lezemfundo. I-Nyuvesi ibambisana nezinye izikhungo zamazwe ngamazwe, ukudala amathuba okusungula nokugcina imikhakha eminingi ihlanzekile, futhi izinhlelo ezikhuthaza iNyuvesi ukuba ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izifundo ezinhle. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iNyuvesi ibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, ibona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwayo nabafundi, idizayina izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imizamo yempilo emphakathini. Izifundo zokuhlola ezibanjwa ngesikhathi esifanele ziye zatholakala kalula, uqhubekela phambili ekwakheni impumelelo yezenhlalakahle kanye nemfundo. Ekugcineni, iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, ngezifundo ezihloniphekile nezindlela zokwakha umphakathi, ibonakala ingeze izinguquko ezinhle emhlabeni wezokufundisa, ivumela abafundi bayo ukuba babe nesimo esihle sokwenza imisebenzi emisha. Izifundo eziqinile, amakhono aqinile, nezinhlelo ezinconyiwe, zenza le nyuvesi ibe impumelelo enkulu ezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kubafundi abasha abafuna ukufunda nokuhola.
