Ngo-1948, ubumbano lwezombusazwe lwabaphikisi lwavela, luxhaphaziwe, lunikeza amandla amakhulu kubantu abahluphekayo kulowo nyaka. Ubuhlanga, obubulalayo, buphika ubumkhulu bolimi lwezizukulwane, kwaholela ekwaziseni ukuphikisana kwamasiko kanye nemibono eyohlukeneyo, kusigcizelela umphakathi ongenaphelele. Ipolitiki yokuhlukanisa ibilokhu ifakazela ukuba yingozi ngokuphelele, futhi kufanele ngempela kuboniswe emlandweni ukuthi uNingizimu Afrika ugcwele ubunzima nobunzima obukhulu, okuhlanganisa izimo zokuphila nezimbenge. Izinguquko Zamasiko Nezihlahla Zomlando Umlando wobumbano nezehlakalo ezihlala phansi, kwaholela ekwakheni ibhande elisha. Izikole, izikhumbuzo, namaSonto aveza isithombe esiqinile sokubumba umphakathi, futhi abathintekayo basondelana nemicabango emisha. Ukuwina ubumbano, uNingizimu Afrika wathathwa njengeqembu elisha loshintsho, ubuqotho nezimfuno zamalungelo abantwana, okwakuhulumeni okwandile nokukhula. Iziphakamiso ezazilandelayo zayiwo, ukuphikisana kwamalungelo obuntu, ukuthuthukiswa kwemvume, nokwakha ibhande lokuhlala ngaphandle kwemingcele. Kunemizamo emikhulu yokwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ngokuhlonipha amasiko ahlukeneyo, kuthuthukisa ukwaziwa kwezimfanelo zomphakathi. Imiphumela Yokugcina Nezindlela Zomphakathi Emasontweni aphelile, umzamo ophelele waphokophela kubantu ukuba bakwazi ukuphila impilo ngaphandle kwamaphuzu ethuswa. UBushmen bezwa kahle. Ububha, ukuhlupheka, nomkhuba wobuhlanga buwubufakazi bezimo ezinzima zempilo. Lokhu kuveza ukuphuphutheka kwemizamo yokuqinisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Ngo-1994, uNelson Mandela wabalelwa esikhathini esisha, wazinika umuzwa wokubulala ukumemezela ubukhona bezingane ezinyamalalayo ezisondela ukuze zihlomule. Lokhu kwavula imigqa emisha yokwakha, ukufunde ngempilo entsha, ukunqoba ukungaboni ngaso linye, nokuqinisa ubumiselo. Isiphetho Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika usikhumbuza ngokuqinile ukuthi, nakuba inhlupho zikhona, ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhloniphana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene kuhlangene nokubambisana kuhloswe. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, izinguquko nezinselelo, uNingizimu Afrika uthola ithuba lokubuyisa, uqinisekisa isizinda esikhulu sabantu bayo. Uhlanga lwesizwe lisathuthuka, luguqula izimo zokuhlala, olwezezimali nolwenhlalo, ngakhoke luveza ukuze konke kuhambe phambili.
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Impilo, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Kumhlaba wamanje Abathengisi basemgwaqeni badlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhulayo. Nakuba bejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, bavame ukufaka phakathi izinkinga ezihlobene nezezimali, imicimbi, kanye nokwaneliseka kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bathinta kanjani umphakathi nempilo yabantu, futhi kufanele sihlaziye izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nabo. Okokuqala, abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikela ngezinsizakalo eziphilayo emphakathini. Bahlala bejolise ekudleni, ezimakethe, nasezindaweni zokuhweba, bahlala eduze kwezakhamuzi. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi benze imali ngenkathi behlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, izitsha ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kanye nezinsiza ezincane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni imisebenzi, kuhlanganise nabathengisi abakhethiwe, futhi kukhulisa umnotho wendawo. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikeza ukudla okusheshayo okutholakala kalula, okubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, banomthelela omuhle ekukhuthazeni umoya wokuhweba phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlupheka ngezinkinga eziningi. Bahlala bephikisana nemithetho nezinhlinzeko zikahulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi benze imisebenzi yabo. Imithetho ethile ingavimbela ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zokuhweba, okwenza bahlale bezama ukuthola izindawo ezizimele, lapho bengahambisani nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi abanye baphinde babe sengozini yokuthunjwa noma ukuxhaphazwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba sengozini yokulahlekelwa impilo ngenxa yokusebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile. Izimo zokuhweba zingaba yingozi, futhi uma kwenzeka izenzakalo ezimbi, abathengisi bangase bahlushwe yizingozi eziningi, okudingeka ukuba kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesandla ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile zokuvikela abathengisi basemgwaqeni. Ngokuvamile, banamandla okwenza umphakathi ube ngcono, behlisa izindleko zokuphila futhi bekhuthaza ukusabalalisa ukudla okunesithako esihle. Izitsha zabo zihlala ziqhakambisa amasiko ahlukahlukene, zikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zifunde ngempilo yasezindaweni. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kumphakathi wonke. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bamele izidingo zabantu. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sithuthukise izisombululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo zokuvikela ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokusebenza. Sidinga ukusiza abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuba baqhubeke phambili, ngenkathi sikhuthaza amandla abathengisi nezinhlelo ezizovumela ukuba bahlanganyele nemithetho yendawo. Umphakathi, ohulumeni, nabathengisi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe indawo ehlanzekile, ekhuthazayo, nephephile kubo bonke. Ngakho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Bazimisele, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umqondo wobudlelwano obunempilo. Sidinga ukubabukela ngeso lokhozi ukuze sithuthukise izindlela zokusiza nokubasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokuhweba, bahlale befika emiphakathini yabo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, akufanele sikhumbule lezi zinkampani ezisemqoka ezihlanganyela emnothweni wethu. Ukubavikela, ukubasiza, nokubahlonipha kuyoba umculo ophumayo emiphelandaba yethu.
Ukuntuleka KweMisebenzi (Unemployment) Isingeniso Kulolu suku, sithokozile ukuzoxoxa noMnu. Zulu, ongumsebenzi wezemfundo ophothule izifundo zakhe emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwamasistimu, kodwa okwamanje ubhekene nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Sizodlulela emibuzweni ukuze sihlolisise izimbangela, izinkinga, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona kulolu daba olubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini wethu. Umbuzo 1: Mnu. Zulu, singakwadala ukufaka khona umbono wakho mayelana nezimbangela zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi? Impendulo: Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esiyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kubangelwa izinto ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kukhona ukuncipha kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethile efana nokwakha nokuthuthukiswa. Ngesikhathi sokuphola kwezomnotho, abantu abaningi bakhuthazwa ukuthi baqashe, kodwa uma umnotho ushoda, izinkampani zivalela emnyango, eziholela ekuntulekeni kwemisebenzi. Okwesibili, ukungalingani emfundweni kanye nemfundo ephakeme kudala inkinga; abantu baningi abanenqubo zokufunda eziphakeme, kodwa badinga amakhono athile ukuze baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Lokhu kuthinta kanjani abantu empilweni yabo yansuku zonke? Impendulo: Lokhu kuthinta abantu ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekuwohlokeni kwezimali, okwenza kube nzima abantu ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Lokhu kubangela ukucindezeleka, ukuhamba phambili kwezimali, nokungabi nokuqinisekiswa kokuphila. Abantu abaningi balahlekelwa ukuzethemba, Fansu leso simo singaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo. Izindaba ezimbi zithinta njalo izifunda ezithintekayo; izinga lokuphila lenyuka, abantu bajolise emithonjeni engafanele, okukhona kukhulu ezinkingeni zalolu hlobo. Umbuzo 3: Kukhona yini izixazululo ezitholakalayo kule nkinga? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezixazululo ezithile ezikhona zokubhekana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele enze imizamo eyengeziwe yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi kumakholwa amancane naphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlinzekwa ngenkxaso kubafundi, ukwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngama-programs afanele, kanye nokukhuthaza ukufundwa kwemikhakha ethile. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi kumele awezise izinhlelo zabantu ukukwazi ukuvuselela amathuba okusebenza, futhi kumele bakhuthaze ukubuyiselwa ezindleleni zomsebenzi. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi kufanele lisenze izinhlelo zokuxhasa umphakathi, okuzosiza ekuphatheni lo msebenzi oyingozi. Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthatha kanjani umthwalo wokulawula le nkinga? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekulawuleni ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngobuchule futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, bahlale bejolisa emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yokuthuthukisa amakhono. Umphakathi ungasebenzisa izikhungo zendawo ezitholakalayo, ezibalulekile ukuze uthole izinsiza ezithuthukisayo. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esempumelelweni, kufanele kuhlangane izigaba zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nomsebenzi ozimele ukuze sikhulise amathuba. Izinhlangano zomphakathi zingaba nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuthuthukisa amakhono, zonke zisebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqashelwe le nkinga. Umbuzo 5: Ngingakubona yini ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi okukodwa, futhi ubani okufanele abe neqhaza kulokhu? Impendulo: Yebo, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukodwa; kunezimo ezahlukene ezithinta abantu, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezilungile. Kuba nethuba lapho siphila khona ukungatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube khona ukuhlinzeka ngezinye izikhuthazo ukuze kube namathuba amaningi okuthi ukuthola imisebenzi kube nokwenzeka. Uhlelo lwezempilo, izinhlelo zokuphatha, nebhizinisi elincane yizinto eziyinhloko ezidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Ukuba neqhaza likamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nemboni yezenhlalakahle kubalulekile ukuze kuqondiswe izinqumo ezizothuthukisa umphakathi nokuveza amathuba emisebenzi. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi yinkinga ebanzi, ethinta abantu abaningi ezimpilweni zabo, kudinga ukugxila, ubuchule, kanye nobumbano phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithumele umyalezo wokubambisana, sithole izixazululo ezinhle, ukuze siphinde sithuthukise amathuba okusebenza. Ngikholwa ukuthi uma sithanda, sizokwakha umphakathi onempumelelo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphumelela. Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi esithokozisayo sokuxoxisana.
Umbiko: Ukunakekelwa Kwamadoda Nabesifazane Abadala Isingeniso Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuyinsika ebalulekile emphakathini wethu. Njengoba abantu befinyelela ezinyangeni zabo ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi bathole ukunakekelwa okulungile ukuze bagcine impilo enhle, umoya ophilayo, kanye nokwaneliseka empilweni. Lokhu akubalulekile kuphela kubantu abadala, kodwa futhi nakubantu abaseduze kwabo, njengezihlobo nabangane. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezindleleni ezahlukene zokunakekela abantu abadala, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona. Izidingo Zokunakekelwa Abantu abadala bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, ukungabi namandla, kanye nokwehla kokusebenza kwemizwa. Lokhu kudinga ukunakekelwa okuhle, okungahlanganisa izidingo zomzimba, ezokwelapha, kanye nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akugcini nje ngokubagcina bephila, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umuzwa wokuxhumana, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Izindlela Zokunakekelwa Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa ekhaya, ezikhungweni zokunakekela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ukunakekelwa ekhaya kuvumela abantu abadala ukuba bahlale endaweni abayithandayo, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo ejwayelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imindeni ibekezelele futhi ibanikeze usizo oludingekayo. Ezikhungweni zokunakekela, abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa, ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa. Lezi zikhungo zihlala ziqashwa ngochwepheshe abanolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Izinselelo Zokunakekelwa Nokho, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuza nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, izinsiza zokunakekela zihlala zikhawulelwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Imindeni eminingi ibhekana nezindleko eziphezulu zokunakekela, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abadala bangase babe nezinselelo zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekuzizweni bephucukile. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze sithuthukise ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi baphathe izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni, ukuze kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zokunakekela. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokunakekela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abanakekela, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokunakekela ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi ingadlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu abadala bazizwe behloniphekile futhi bejabulile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imicimbi yokuxhumana, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa ezihloselwe abantu abadala. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuyisici esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bahlala bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo, futhi behloniphekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungele wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubudala bawo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni isizukulwane esizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbula ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke.
IFIFA World Cup: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Ngomthelela Nempumelelo Yayo I-FIFA World Cup iyinhlangano yeziqhamo zomhlaba jikelele, eyenzeka njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ukuzethemba nokuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwamazwe. Abaningi bathi le midlalwano ibalulekile, kodwa kukhona abaphikisa, bephakamisa izinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka imiphumela yeFIFA World Cup, imithelela yayo kwezomnotho, ezamasiko, nakwezempilo. Okokuqala, sizoqala ngokubheka umthelela wezomnotho. I-FIFA World Cup iyinsiza enkulu yokukhuthaza umnotho wezindawo ezibamba umcimbi. Ngokwesibonelo, eminyakeni edlule, izixhumanisi eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi izindawo ezibamba umcimbi zithola inzuzo enkulu ngenxa yokwanda kwabavakashi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokuthutha, ezokungcebeleka, nezokudla. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa, bethi lezi zinzuzo zihlala zihlukaniswe phakathi kwabantu abambalwa, kanti abanye bahlupheka ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe. Umcimbi lo uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlangana kwezizwe kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngamasiko. Nokho, abanye baphikisa, bethi le midlalwano ibonisa umphakathi omubi, lapho abanye abantu bephikisana khona ngenxa yezinkolelo ezihlukene nemibono ehlukene. Lokhu kungaholela ekungaboni ngaso linye, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emiphakathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni impilo yomphakathi. Imidlalo ibonisa izindinganiso eziphezulu zokusebenza, kuthuthukiswe imiphakathi yokukhuthaza impilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugijima, ukudlala, nokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ethile. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa, bephakamisa ukuthi imidlalo ibeka ingcindezi enkulu kubadlali, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, ikakhulukazi ezokuphila kwengqondo. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngokubheka izinkinga ezihambisana neFIFA World Cup, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi imicimbi efana nale ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yeFIFA World Cup iyathuthukisa, hhayi ukuhlela izinkinga. Ngokuphetha, i-FIFA World Cup iyinsiza enkulu, kodwa imiphumela yayo iyinkimbinkimbi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi imidlalo ayigcini nje ngokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa umnotho, nokukhuthaza impilo. Nokho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuxazulula izinkinga ezihambisana nayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuzuza. I-FIFA World Cup ingaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.
Impilo Yabantu Abasebenzayo: Umqondo Wami Impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mpilo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inezinzuzo ezithile ezithokozisayo. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo, ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu hlobo lwezimpilo, ukuze sithole ukuqonda okungcono ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ekuqaleni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila zihlala zikhona. Ngicabanga ukuthi lezi zinto zenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuba baphile impilo efanele. Abantu abaningi bahlala emakhaya amancane, lapho imithombo yokuphila ingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba abantu bephoqeleka ukuba basebenze kakhulu ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonisa amandla okuphila. Ngiyabazi abantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa bonke banomoya ophakeme. Noma ngabe bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kubonakala ekusebenzeni kwabo, lapho bephokophela phambili ukuze bathole amathuba angcono. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla okukhulu, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephila phakathi kwezinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngikhumbula izinsuku engangihamba ngazo emsebenzini, lapho sabelana khona ngezindaba, sikhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi sikhumbula izikhathi ezinzima esihlangabezane nazo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yethu. Ubudlelwano obuhle bukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila, bahlale bejabule, futhi bahlale bephokophela phambili. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ayigcini nje ngokusebenza. Iphinde ibandakanye izinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, izinkinga zokufunda, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu akulula, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyabona ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephokophela phambili. Noma ngabe bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bahlala bephila impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu banganqoba izinselelo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngokuphetha, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Noma bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, bahlala bephokophela phambili. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu bukhuthaza impilo enempilo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole impilo engcono. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mpilo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa ngikholelwa ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphile impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile kithi sonke, njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu abasebenzayo.
Umbiko Ngama-Cryptocurrency Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izimali zedijithali, ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-cryptocurrency, seziye zaba yinsakavukela. Izimali ezinjengokuthi i-Bitcoin, i-Ethereum, nezinye, zisiza ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezisheshayo, zisebenza ngaphandle kokulawulwa nguhulumeni noma izikhungo zezimali. Kulesi siphetho, sizobheka ukuthi ama-cryptocurrency ayini, indlela asebenza ngayo, kanye nezinselelo nezinsiza ezihambisana nalokhu. Incazelo Yama-Cryptocurrency Ama-cryptocurrency azimele ngokwawo, atholakala kuphela emhlabeni wedijithali. I-Bitcoin, eyasungulwa ngu-Satoshi Nakamoto ngo-2009, ibhekwa njengesisekelo semali yedijithali. Lezi zimali zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obubizwa nge-blockchain, lapho ulwazi lwemininingwane luhlala kuxhumene ngamaqoqo (blocks) ahlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke ama-transaction avikeleke futhi awalungiswa kalula. Indlela Ama-Cryptocurrency Asebenza Ngayo Ama-cryptocurrency asebenza ngokusebenzisa i-blockchain, okuyisizinda esiyisisekelo esiqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zenzeka ngendlela efanele. Uma umuntu ethenga noma ethengisa i-cryptocurrency, lezi zinkokhelo zifakwa kwi-blockchain, ziqinisekiswa ngama-computer amaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuhoxisa noma ukukhohlisa, njengoba kudinga imvume enkulu yokwenza lokhu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency awahlukanisiwe kuphela, kodwa angasetshenziswa ngendlela ebanzi. Abantu bangawathenga, bawagcine, noma bawasebenzise ezinkokhelweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency atholakala kalula ezimakethe zedijithali, lapho abantu bangasebenzisa khona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zokuhweba. Izinsiza Zama-Cryptocurrency Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-cryptocurrency. Okokuqala, ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhweba. Ngokungafani nezinhlelo zezimali ezivamile ezibiza izindleko eziphezulu, ama-cryptocurrency avame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi zokuhweba. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukwenza izinkokhelo. Okwesibili, ama-cryptocurrency anikeza izinga eliphezulu lokuvikeleka. Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, i-blockchain ivikela ulwazi, iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi akekho ongakwazi ukwephula imithetho. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuthi basebenzise ama-cryptocurrency. Izinselelo Zama-Cryptocurrency Noma kunjalo, ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency akuhambisani nezingozi ezithile. Okokuqala, intengo yama-cryptocurrency iyashintsha kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umuntu ongathenga i-Bitcoin namuhla angathola ukuthi inani layo liphansi kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kudala ukungaqiniseki kwabathengi. Okwesibili, ubungozi bokuphula ubumfihlo bukhona. Nakuba i-blockchain ivikeleka, kukhona abantu abahlala befuna izindlela zokuphula izinhlelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kuholela emaphutheni, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimali. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Ama-cryptocurrency awavumeli kuphela ukushintshwa kwemali, kodwa futhi alokhu ethinta umnotho jikelele. Izinkampani eziningi ziyaqhubeka nokuwamukela njengendlela yokukhokha, okukhuthaza ukwamukelwa kwama-cryptocurrency emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kusebenza kahle emikhakheni efana nezokuthutha, ezokukhiqiza, nezokuxhumana, okwakha amathuba amasha emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency akhulisa umqondo wokuthukuthaza ukuthengisa kwemikhiqizo nokuhlala kwi-inthanethi. Abanyeni abasha nabazimele, bahlala bezama ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkampani ezintsha. Isiphetho Ukuze sibe nezezimali ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ama-cryptocurrency. Lezi zimali zedijithali, ezimnandi futhi ezikhuthazayo, zishintsha umqondo wethu wezokuhweba, umnotho, nokukhokha. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zihlala zikhanga. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokushintsha, ama-cryptocurrency azoba nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezezimali. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi futhi baqonde lezi zimali, ukuze bakwazi ukufaka izinqumo ezinhle futhi ziqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ama-cryptocurrency azoba yinsika yomnotho wethu, kanye nezindlela zokuhweba eziphendukela phambili, futhi lezi zinkampani zedijithali zizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Umqondo wokuhlala sisemhlabeni wedijithali uzokwenza kube lula ukumisa izinkanyezi zamanje nezangomuso.
Ezokuxhumana: Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini Wethu Ezokuxhumana, noma i-media, zinemisebenzi ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi wanamuhla. Lezi zindlela zokuxhumana zifaka amaphephandaba, izincwadi, imithombo yezokuxhumana, kanye neziteshi zethelevishini. Zixhumene ngokuqondile nezimo zansuku zonke, zishintsha indlela abantu abacabanga, behlaziya, futhi bephila. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wezokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukene ezihambisana nazo, okuhlanganisa izinzuzo, izingozi, kanye nemithelela emisha ezimpilweni zabantu. Izinzuzo Zezokuxhumana Ezokuxhumana zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, imicabango, nezinhlelo. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangathola ulwazi olusha, bahlale bexhumene nabangani, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bekwazi ukusizana, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni imiqondo yomphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluthile, ezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, njengokukhuthaza imikhankaso yokuvota, ukulwa nezinkinga zokuhlukumeza, noma ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezempilo. Izingcuphe Nezingozi Noma kunjalo, ezokuxhumana azinakho konke okuhle. Ziphinde zibe nezingcuphe eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso, ukucwasa, kanye nokuhlukumeza. Ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, lapho abantu bephendukela kulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze benze izinqumo ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zikhuthaza ukucwasa, okungaholela ekwakheni imiphakathi ehlukanisayo, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, noma izinkolelo. Lokhu kubangela ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomphakathi. Umthelela Wokuxhumana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi olukhuluma ngezimo ezithile ezibhekene namazwe ahlukene. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okukhuthaza ukuqonda nokuhloniphana phakathi kwezizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta izinkinga zomhlaba, njengokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukulwa nobuphofu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezempilo. Ngokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izixazululo, kanye nezinsiza, okukhuthaza ukuhlela imikhankaso emisha yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zihlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nazo, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela umphakathi ekutholeni ulwazi olungelona iqiniso, ukucwasa, kanye nokuhlukumeza. Ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi, kufanele sisebenzise ezokuxhumana ngendlela efanele, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, futhi sithuthukise ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuvumelana, nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
### Ezokusakaza: Indaba Yezwi Nezithombe Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile, emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, kwabakhona umhlaba omusha, umhlaba wezokusakaza. Le ndaba iqala ekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi unjiniyela ophumelele emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, uMnu. Thulani Mthembu, wahamba waya emzini owawugqugquzela abantu ngezindaba ezimbalwa. Wayehamba nezinkanyezi ezishisayo, ezazikhanya kakhulu ezinkanyezini zeAfrika, ezazisakaza izindaba ezaziphilayo, ngendlela efana nehlobo elishisa. UMnu. Mthembu wayenombono ovusa umdlandla; wayefuna ukuhlinzeka abantu ngemicabango, izindaba, nezinto ezithokozisayo, ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokusakaza. Waqala ngokwakha isiteshi sakhe, esakhe ngothando, ezindlini ezincane ezingaphezulu kwedolobha, lapho abantu besebenzisa izwi labo ukuze bazwakalise imizwa yabo. Abantu bobabili babekhuluma ngezindaba zomphakathi, izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili, nomculo omusha, futhi lezi zindaba zazikhanya njengezinkanyezi. Ngemva kwesikhashana, isiteshi sikaThulani sathola udumo. Abantu babejabulile, bephendula izinhlelo zakhe ezithokozisayo. Waqala imicimbi emikhulu, ethokozisa izivakashi, unjiniyela abasha, nabaculi bezwe. Izimvo zabantu zazigcwele phakathi kwezikhala, kanti uMnu. Mthembu wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obubukeka bunzima bungaba namandla. Ngaleyo ndlela, isiteshi sakhe sathuthuka saphumelela, sathola izixhumi eziningi. Abantu bacela izinhlelo ezintsha, izinhlelo ezizwakalayo, nezinhlelo ezizwakalayo, kanti uyena uThulani wayefuna ukuqhubeka ekhanga izihloko ezintsha. Waqala ukuhlela uhlelo olwakhiwe ngengwazi, olwakhiwa ngothando, nesiphepho sezinhliziyo, ekwakhiweni kwezingoma. Ngaleso sikhathi, izithameli zabeziqonda kahle ukuthi izwi lethu lingakusiza kanjani, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi silwazi kahle. Ngaphandle kokuthola udumo, uMnu. Mthembu wayekwazi ukuthi ezokusakaza akukhona kuphela ukulalelwayo, kodwa futhi kuyisikhala sokuxhumana. Ngemva kokuphumelela, wanquma ukukhipha uhlelo olwakhiwe ngezithombe, olwakhiwa ngabantu. Walungiselela umcimbi wokubambisana, lapho abaculi bezwe, abathandi bezokwakha, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene beqhamuka ndawonye ukuze bezwakalise izinkumbulo zabo. Le micimbi yahlala izinsuku ezimbalwa, futhi ibikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyinsika yokwenziwa komhlaba, umhlaba onobungane, nezinye izindlela zokukhuluma. Kwavela abaculi abasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela ukuxoxa izindaba zabo, behlola izimo ezahlukene zabantu. Isiteshi sikaMnu. Mthembu saphila, sathola umoya omusha. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baphinde baphinde bahlangana, besebenzisa izwi labo, nezithombe zabo, ukuze bakhuthaze abanye. Ngesikhathi edlula, kwavela izinselelo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana luthuthuka, izimakethe ziqhubeka zishintsha, futhi izithameli zenziwa ngabantu abasha. UThulani wayezama ukuhlela izinhlelo ezintsha, kodwa wabona ukuthi izikhala ezikhona zidinga ukuphendulwa. Wafuna ukuxhumana nezinye iziteshi, ukuze ahlanganyele izinhlelo zabo, evula amathuba amasha. Lokhu kwakungukuphumelela kwezimakethe, okuholele ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Njengoba amakhono akhe abuthakathaka, uMnu. Mthembu wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyaguquguquka. Kwavela izindlela eziningi zokusakaza, ezazisiza abantu ukuba baphendule izindaba zabo, kodwa wakhumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwalufanele ukwaziswa. Waba nemibono emisha, yokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezazivumela abantu ukuba bazwakalise imibono yabo. Wafunda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo akufanele kube yinto eyodwa, kodwa kufanele kuhlanganiswe izimvo ezivela kubantu. Ubuqhawe bakhe bahlala bukhona, futhi izinhlelo zakhe zathola ukuthandwa okukhulu. UThulani wakhumbula ukuthi izwi labantu liyinsika, kanti ubuchwepheshe buyisikhumbuzo sokwazisa. Wayezama ukuvuselela izinhlelo zakhe, ehlose ukuhlinzeka abantu ngezindaba ezikhaliphe, ezithokozisayo, nezikhuthazayo. Ekugcineni, uMnu. Thulani Mthembu wathola ukuthi ezokusakaza akukhona kuphela ukukhipha izwi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Izithameli zashintsha, izindlela zashintsha, kodwa ubungane bahlala bukhona. Waqhubeka nokusebenza, ethokozisa abantu, ethokozisa izithameli, futhi waba ngumholi wemibono emisha. Izwi lakhe, nezwi labantu, lahlangana, lapha kwaba yinkanyezi ekhanya, ekhanyisa umhlaba wezokusakaza. Ngaphezu kwalesi sikhathi, izinhlelo zakhe zabeziqhubeka, nezindaba zakhe zabeziqhubeka zikhanya ezinkanyezini. Lokhu kwenza uMnu. Mthembu waba yisibonelo somphakathi, umholi wezokuxhumana, ovumelanayo nezinguquko, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe bahlala bukhona, benza ukuthi izwi labantu liqhubeke lukhanya. Le ndaba yokusakaza, isikhumbuzo sokubumbana, isikhumbuzo sokuphila, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungenza izimanga.
USuku lwaBasha luka-1976: Q&A Umbuzo 1: Yini uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976? Impendulo: USuku lwaBasha luka-1976, olukhunjulwa ngomhla wesishiyagalombili kuNhlangulana, liyinsuku ebalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Le nsuku ibaluleka kakhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu abasha, njengoba ibonisa umkhankaso wokulwa namalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi abantu baseNyakatho Afrika, okubalwa kubo abafundi, abaqhubela phambili umkhankaso wezokufunda. --- Umbuzo 2: Kwakuyini ukukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha? Impendulo: Ukuze siqonde ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi, kufanele sibuye emuva esikhathini som apartheid, lapho abamnyama bephathwa kahle kancane futhi bevinjwa amathuba amaningi. USuku lwaBasha lubonisa iSizotha sokuphikisa lokhu, kuba kwenzeka ubugebengu obuhlobene nokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi eSoweto, lapho balwela izilimi zabo, ikakhulukazi isiZulu nesiXhosa. --- Umbuzo 3: Yini eyaholela ekuphikeleleni kwabafundi eSoweto? Impendulo: Abafundi baseSoweto bacela ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo abo, nokungabandakanyeki kwendlela okufundiswa ngayo ezikoleni. Bafuna ukuba nethuba lokufunda ngesiZulu nezilimi zabo zomdabu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni bahlangane ndawonye ngomhla wesishiyagalombili kuNhlangulana, babhacka izinsizwa ezingu-2000. Kunoma yisiphi isimo, lokho kwaholela ekuhlaselweni by amaphoyisa. --- Umbuzo 4: Kwakuyini ukuhlaselwa futhi yini emhlabeni waleso sikhathi? Impendulo: Ukuhlaselwa kwenzeka lapho amaphoyisa eqhuba izixhumano ezinzima, ebulala, ephuca, futhi ephethe abanye abafundi abaphezulu. Abafundi bama phezulu bahlaselwe zezimoto zamaRhino, kwathi abanye babaleka baphuma phansi bezama ukusindisa. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuphazamise imibhikisho yabo, kuveza ubudlova bokuqhuba kwezombangazwe. --- Umbuzo 5: Yini ethathwa njengemiphumela yalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha kakhulu kwasuka ekubhaleni kwamamilestones. Abafundi abahlaseliwe baphinde baba umgogodla wezinguquko, ekugcineni, kwasuqhamuka nezinhlelo ezilungile zezombusazwe ezandleni zabantu, ebalula ezindabeni ezingokwenyama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSuku lwaBasha baqhubeka nokukhumbulwa, ukukhumbuza abantu ngobudlame nezinselelo ezahlaba umxhwele. --- Umbuzo 6: Ngabe uSuku lwaBasha lusafaneleka namuhla? Impendulo: Yebo, uSuku lwaBasha usagcina imiphetho yebhizinisi, ikakhulukazi ekukhulumeni ngezindaba zabafundi nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusiza ukukhumbula ngabafundi, ukukhumbula ukuhlaselwa nokuvuka kwezinsizakusebenza. Abafundi nabazali bahlala bethembekile ekwenzeni ukuthi kuhlonishwe amalungelo abantu bonke, ukuze bephile impilo engcono. --- Umbuzo 7: Ubani ofanele ukuhlela usuku lokukhumbula? Impendulo: Lima, izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezinhlangano ezahlukahlukene zihlala zihamba phambili ekukhiqizeni izinhlelo zokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha. Lokhu, okuhlanganyela izinsiza, ukusakaza ulwazi kulandela izinyathelo zomphakathi, wonke umuntu kufanele abambe iqhaza elswekile emiphakathini kudala ibhizinisi lokufundisa. --- Umbuzo 8: Umphakathi ungasebenza kanjani ukuze uqhubeke nokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungasebenza ngezindlela eziningi, kubalwa imicimbi, imibukiso, nemiphakathi yokufundisa. Ukuze kube nezehlo eziningi ukuze ziqwashise, ababhali, othisha, kanye nabazali kufanele bahlanganyele ekunikezeni indawo yokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha, procendlikle ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kube nezinselelo ezahlukahlukene ezingenza imiphakathi iqonde kahle kakhulu. --- Ngokufingqa, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 akusikho nje isikhathi sokukhumbula, kodwa yinsuku yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokuthola indlela yokuthola izinhlelo zempilo ezinqala. Umphakathi wonke udinga ukucabangela okwenziwayo, ukuze sithakasele zonke izintuthuko ezenzekile.
Imali Yokufunda: Ingxoxo Ngezithiyo Nezindlela Zokuxazulula Imali yokufunda, noma inani elifunekayo ukuze abafundi bakhande ezikoleni, izikole, noma ezikhungweni zemfundo, iwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Lokhu kumiswe kahle emiphakathini ehlukene, njengoba kunezinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nemali yokufunda. Emva kokuhlola lezi zinkinga, kuyacaca ukuthi lesi sihloko sidinga ukuba sithathwe ngokujulile, kungezelelwa izixazululo ezivulekile ezizokwazi ukusiza abafundi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imali yokufunda inamathuba amakhulu kanye nezithiyo. Abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini engathuthukile, bahlupheka ekutholeni le mali. Ukuphazamiseka kwalokhu kudala ukuthi abanye bahlalise thina ekutholeni imfundo ephakeme, baye bahluleka ukufinyelela ezikhungweni eziphakeme ezifanele izifiso zabo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso uma sikhuluma ngezinsiza zezemfundo ezikhokhwayo, amafutho okuphila, kanye nemiholo engatholakali. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi imvamisa kube khona ukwehluka okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi abathola amathuba nemali yokufunda, okuholela ekwehlisweni kwezinga lempumelelo emphakathini. Enye yeziqhamo ezivela efundweni ephezulu ikakhulukazi yasemakhaya, ukuthi abanye abangatholi imfundo elungile, bangase bahlukaniswe ezindaweni ezithile zezemisebenzi, okwandisa ubumpofu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imali yokufunda isishintshile kube yinto eyisiyingi, okuwukuthi inani elidingekayo alisondeli kulowo osebenza naye, kuhlanganisa nezinsiza ezikhona, kodwa konke kudinga ukucabangela ukuthi imininingwane idinga ukusethwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhungo zemfundo zithola ukuthi imali yokufunda iyazuzisa ngoba ivumela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezinhle nezinhle, ezisemqoka ezifundweni nasezivivinyweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzekwa kwabezindaba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, okufaka phakathi ama-laptops, amasiko ophando, kanye nezikhungo zokufunda. Imininingwane iyabonakala lapha; uma imfundo ibhujiswa, yonke imithombo iyahlupheka, izigidi zabafundi ziyoba ngaphansi kokucindezela. Izixazululo zalesi simo zidinga ukuba ziphume kulezi zinkinga ezinzima. Ukubamba amaqembu akhuluma ngezizathu ezahlukene kwi zinkolelo ezingcwele ezihambisana nemali yokufunda kudinga ukugxila emizamweni yokugcina imfundo itholakala kubo bonke. Sikufanelekela ukugqugquzela izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ezinjengezinhlelo zomphakathi, izimali zokufunda zamasiko noma zendawo ezivulekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwabo bonke abafundi kumathuba emfundo. Ukwenza kucace, izinhlelo zomphakathi ezixhumene nezikhungo zemfundo zithintela ukuphuma emthunzini, zinika ithuba kubafundi abaningi. Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlelo, izinhlelo ezikhipha imali yok ukufunda ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwabafundi ezikoleni eziphakeme. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, abazi, nezikhungo zikahulumeni nezithunywa ezikhokhayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusiza abahluphekayo nokwabelana ngolwazi ngezindlela ezahlukene zokufunda, izinzuzo zokuhlanganisa amasevisi ahlukahlukene ezimfuneko zemfundo, kuyoholela ekutheni imfundo ibaluleke kakhudlwana, futhi ibenze bakhombise ubuthakathaka. Yilapho-ke lapho kuhloswe khona ukudala umphakathi ophumelelayo, osebenzisa kahle neze zimali. Isikhumbuzo sikaHulumeni sabazali, izikole kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kumele siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izifiso, izidingo nezifiso zabafundi ziyaziswa. Ngokuhlanganisa, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imali yokufunda ibalulekile, kodwa futhi ingase ibangele izithiyo. Ukwakhiwa kwezixazululo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi kwemfundo kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikole, abahlali, nohulumeni, ukuze kuzuzwe imiphumela emihle emphakathini. Imfundo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ngakho-ke kufanele sicabangele indlela yokwenza kube lula yokufunda ukuze sikhulise izinga lempumelelo. Ukuba nemali yokufunda kweqiniso kufanele kube isikhumbuzo sothando, ukuhamba phambili nokuxhumana, hhayi umthwalo omkhulu.
Izindaba Zamanje: Ingxoxo NoMnu. Mthembu Ngempilo Yezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika Umhlangano wethu uqala ngenkulumo ejabulisayo, lapho uMnu. Mthembu, ongumholi wezepolitiki, ehamba phambili ekuphenduleni imibuzo ebalulekile mayelana nezindaba zamanje ezithinta iNingizimu Afrika. Umbuzo 1: Mnu. Mthembu, ungakuchaza kanjani isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika namuhla? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika sithokozisa, kodwa futhi sinesithiyo. Sihlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabi namsebenzi, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nezinselelo zempilo. Nokho, kukhona nethuba lokuthuthukisa izinto. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo emkhakheni wezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezokuphepha zikhombisa ukuthi sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo? UMnu. Mthembu: “Sisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni bamazwe omhlaba, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila. Umsebenzi wethu uwukwakha izinhlelo ezizofinyelela kubantu abavamile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa ukufinyelela emithonjeni yokufunda, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abavela ezindaweni ezinzima.” Umbuzo 3: Kukhona izinkinga ezithinta ukhetho lwangaphakathi kwezepolitiki. Ungakuchaza lokhu? UMnu. Mthembu: “Yebo, izinkinga zokuqokwa kwabantu emikhakheni ethile zikhona. Lokhu kubangelwa ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwababonisi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhetho lwenziwa ngendlela efanele, ukuze kube nesithunzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabaholi, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo.” Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo ezikhona zikhona yini ukuvikela amalungelo abantu? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyavuma ukuthi kuningi okwenziwe, kodwa sinesidingo sokwenza okuningi. Amalungelo abantu kufanele abe yinto eyinhloko ezinqubweni zethu. Sisebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa, futhi imithetho ivikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu.” Umbuzo 5: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa leNingizimu Afrika? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika linamathuba amaningi. Uma sikhuthaza ubumbano, sithuthukisa imfundo, futhi sithuthukisa umnotho, sizokwazi ukwakha izwe elinempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhula. Ngiyabonga!” Umhlangano wethu uphetha ngenkulumo evusa umoya, uMnu. Mthembu ebonisa ithemba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukuhamba phambili, uma abantu bebandakanyeka futhi besebenza ndawonye. Izindaba zamanje zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba sinezinselelo, sinesikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi unamandla okwenza ushintsho oluhle.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Ukubaluleka Kokubhekisisa Nokuxazulula Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, izinkinga zamanzi ziba yinkinga enkulu ethinta abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudala izinselele ezinkulu empilweni yethu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa ayisisekelo sempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngentengo yokuntuleka kwamanzi. Emazweni amaningi, abantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile bahlupheka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Izingane zikhathazekile, zikhula zinganempilo, futhi imindeni ibhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zokuphila. Ngakho, izinkinga zamanzi zikhombisa ukuthi ziningi izinselelo ezihambisana nezomnotho, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuyinkinga enkulu. Imifula nezilwandle zikhathazekile ngenxa yokukhishwa kwemfucumfucu, amakhemikhali, nezinsalela zezimboni. Lokhu akuthinti kuphela impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta izilwane nezitshalo ezisebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kudinga izinyathelo zokuqinisa imithetho yokuvikela imithombo yamanzi, ukuze sigweme ukulimala okukhulu. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emanzini. Ukushisa okwandayo, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezimbi zomoya, kudala ukungabikhona kwamanzi emithonjeni ethile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho imithombo yamanzi ingatholakali kalula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Kumele sikhulume ngamasu okuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kudingeka ukuthi sisebenzisane, sihlanganise imizamo yethu. Imibono yokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, njengokulima okungcono, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, iyadingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka kwamanzi nokusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, kuyadingeka. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi amanzi awawona umkhiqizo ongatholakala kalula, kodwa kufanele aqashelwe njengento ebalulekile empilweni. Izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangawagcina kanjani amanzi. Ekuphetheni, izinkinga zamanzi zidinga izinyathelo ezinzima. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudinga ukuhlolwa kwezindlela zokuxazulula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ayisisekelo sempilo, futhi kufanele siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana, kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Sifuna ikusasa elingcono, futhi lokho kudinga izinyathelo namuhla. Amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa empeleni, ayimpilo yethu.
Impilo Yaselokishini: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Impilo yaselokishini ibonisa ukutholakala kwabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-township. Lezi zindawo, ezaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, zidalwe ngesikhathi sobandlululo ukuze kuhlukaniswe abantu ngokobuhlanga. Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinkinga, izinselelo, kanye namathuba. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo? Abahlali bezindawo zasemakhaya bavame ukubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, ezinjengokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. Izindawo zokuhlala zihlupheka, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala ezindlini ezincane, okwenza kube nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 3: Kukhona yini amathuba empilo yaselokishini? Yebo, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi, zikhona nezinto ezinhle empilweni yaselokishini. Abantu bavame ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze bakhe imiphakathi eqinile, futhi izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokuziphilisa zikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela abantu abazisebenzisayo ukuze baphile? Abantu basemalokishini bavame ukusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze baphile, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba, ukwenza imisebenzi yezandla, noma ukuhlela imicimbi yokuthengisa. Abanye baphinde basebenzise izinkampani ezincane ukuze bathole imali, kanti abanye bahlala bephokophele izifundo ukuze bathole amathuba angcono. Umbuzo 5: Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala kanjani ngezokuxhumana? Izokuxhumana zibalulekile empilweni yaselokishini. Abantu bavame ukuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengezinkulumo, imicimbi yokuzijabulisa, kanye nemikhosi, okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuxhumana okuhle. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza impilo yaselokishini ibe yinhle? Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nomoya wokusebenza ndawonye. Abantu bahlala bephokophele ukuphila okungcono, bephinde bakhe izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yabo, okubukeka emisebenzini yokuzithandela. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yaselokishini? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yaselokishini, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela phakathi kukamasipala, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, ukufundisa amakhono, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bendawo kubalulekile ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Umbuzo 8: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo? Abantu bangathuthukisa impilo yabo ngokuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ukufunda amakhono amasha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, ukufunda, nokuhweba kungabasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umbuzo 9: Impilo yaselokishini izoba kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Esikhathini esizayo, impilo yaselokishini ingathuthuka uma abantu beqhubeka nokubambisana. Ukukhulisa imfundo, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile. Uma abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, impilo yaselokishini ingaba ngcono. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siqonde ngempilo yaselokishini? Impilo yaselokishini iyinkimbinkimbi, igcwele izinselelo nezinto ezinhle. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu basemalokishini bahlala bephokophele ukuphila okungcono, besebenzisa ubumbano. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise impilo yasemalokishini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, impilo yaselokishini izoba yinhle uma abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, bephokophele izinjongo ezifanayo, futhi beqonda ukuthi ubumbano lungakha amandla amakhulu.
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi: Izwi Lentsha Eliphakamisayo Ngokuqala konyaka, abafundi bezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika bahlangene emzamweni wokukhombisa ukuthokoza kwabo ngezinhlelo ezithile zemininingwane ebekufanele ifinyelelwe kalula. Lokhu kuhlangana kuhambisane nokubhikisha okubuhlungu okwakuhloselwe ukugqamisa izinkinga ezibuhlungu zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, okuhlanganisa nezindleko zempilo, izikweletu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhalipha abafundi. Ukukhathazeka okukhulu kwabafundi kube kuvela ngenxa yokwanda kwemali yokufunda, okuholela ekutheni abaningi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko eziphezulu zemfundo. UJuliette Mthembu, umfundi oneminyaka engu-21, uthe: "Sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi lethu lizwa. Uma singakwazi ukukhokha imali yokufunda, sizothola kanjani imisebenzi elindelekile? Lokhu kungenza sibe neqhaza elincane emphakathini." Ukubhikisha akwenzekile njengesizathu sokuqala sokukhangisa ngezimali ezihamba phambili. Abafundi bahlala bejolise ezikhungweni zabo, begqugquzela abantu bangesabi ukuphikisana nabaphathi. Ngemva kokuhlangana okukhulu, bacela iziphathimandla ukuba zibe namathuba amaningi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zifundingwa ngendlela efanele. Umdlalo wokubhikisha uqale eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, lapho abafundi behlangana ukuze baqondise izinkinga ezihlukahlukene. Umfundi ophakathi kwezinhlelo, uKabelo Dladla, uthe: "Sifuna ukuba nezwi elikhulu, futhi sibona ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezibalulekile. Ngeke sithule! Sifuna ukufakwa ezinqubweni eziphathelene nemfundo yethu." Ukubhikisha kwaze kwahlaba umxhwele, bekukhona izincwadi zokusekela ezikhiqizwa yizikhungo zomfundi ezihlanganisa izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kowukuthi abafundi bahlala besebenzisa izinkanyezi zayo ukuze bakhombise ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezikhona. Carina Hlongwane, osihlalo weQembu Lentsha Yezemfundo eNyuvesi yaseWits, uthe: "Abafundi bethu bembula izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Kumele sithole umqondo wezesekeli ezidingekayo ukuze siphumelele." Njengoba izinhlelo ziqhubeka, iziphathimandla ziye zabona banye abafundi besebenzisa izinkanyezi zokuqhuba ukuhamba kwemfundiso yabo. UZandile Khumalo, umfundi osemncane, uthe: "Sikhangca ukuze sithole izindlela zokuphuma emhlabeni wezindleko eziphezulu. Sifuna ukuba nabantu abachwepheshe abakwazi ukusinika izinsiza ezidingekayo." I from lapho, izihlangano zikhuthazwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikhaliphile ukuze ziqhube phambili izifundo ezibalulekile zamabhizinisi. Abafundi baye bacela kuhulumeni ukuthi anikeze izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo ezifanele ukudlula izinhlelo ezithile, ukuze kuzuzwe ukufinyelela kumathuba amaningi emfundweni. U-Julius Makena, ongumholi wenhlekelele yeMfundo Efundekayo, uthe: "Siyabazi ubuhlungu obuhlonipheka lapho sekubhekene nemikhawulo yokuhlonipha ulwazi. Sihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezibalulekile okulindeleke ukuba zinikezwe ngokushesha." Ngenxa yokukhushulwa kwalesi sikhumbuzo, kunezizathu ezithile ezithinta imfundo yezehlakalo. Ukususa izikhumba ezilungile kuphakathi kwezicwangciso ezinkulu ezingephuli umoya wempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Abafundi baveze ukuzimisela kwabo emizameni yokufinyelela ezimfanelweni zokubheka ubuchwepheshe, ukuze bakwazi ukuzibandakanya ezinhlelweni ezenzakalayo. Iziphathimandla zifunde nzima lokho okufunwa ngababhalisi abavela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kuthi ekugcineni ziphinde zarhumezela kahle umphakathi. Izinhlangano ezinezikole zibhala ngezinto zobuchwepheshe njengokuhlinzeka ngamasu okukhuluma nabafundi. Ngaphezulu, abaphathi benza kube lula ukufuna izimali ezivela emazweni angaphandle, efunwa yizikhungo eziyinhloko emhlabeni, ukuze kuthuthuke rakhe imfundo. Lokhu kuzinikela emnothweni wezwe, ukuze kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abafundi. Ukubhikisha kukaJuliette, uKabelo noZandile kwenze kube sobala ukuthi abafundi banganikeza umbono obalulekile ekukhulumeni ngezinsizakusebenza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuqubuka kuxhunywe kancane kancane ezinsukwini ezizayo, ukuze kube nezinhlelo zokuphucula imiphumela yemfundo, ukuze wonke umfundi azwe imiphumela emihle. Ngakho-ke, umgomo wabafo ukufinyelela ezicini ezithinta impilo yomumo wezimfuno zabo. Uthando nemibono yabo kufanekisela ukuzimisela okukhulu, okusho ukuthi abakudinga bangakwenziwa kudala. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabo kuzokwakha isimo esisha sokufunda, begxila ekukhulumeni ngezinkinga ezithinta abantu bonke. Ngalokho, lesi sikhathi sombiko sikhombisa ukuthi uhlelo olubumbene lwezimpilo zabafundi lungathinta imiphakathi eminingi. Futhi, kudinga ukuba lao bantu baziswe izizathu ezimbi nobuhlungu obukhona kuphela uma besake tadalwa kusuka. Ukukhombisa ubumbano kanye nezinto ezithule ezibhekeni ezinzima, abafundi baveza izwi labo ngendlela eyinhloko elindelekile. Ukwakha ukufunwa komkhiqizo omuhle, kumele sithole ukusekelwa okwengeziwe kumphakathi wagenile, ukuze sithole izinsiza ezisemqoka ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuhlomule abafundi, izikhungo, nomphakathi wezifundo, kuhambahambe umphakathi wonke.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Komsebenzi Emakhaya aseGauteng, phakathi kwezinsuku ezimvula ezilungiselela uhlobo lwezokuphiliswa, kwavela indaba ethokozisayo mayelana nomculo. UKabza De Small, umculi owaziwa kakhulu, uqale ukuthola impumelelo emculweni wakhe. Igama lakhe langempela linguKabelo Motha, futhi wayefuna ukukhulisa umculo we-Amapiano, okusebenzisa izakhi zomculo we-house nezomdabu. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwaqala ngesikhathi esencane, lapho ehlangabezana nomculo we-kwaito. Lokhu kuthandwa kwakhe kwakhula ngokushesha, njengoba yena nomngane wakhe uDj Maphorisa baqala ukudala izingoma ezidumile ezithokozisa abantu emaphakathini. Isahluko 2: Ukuhamba Kwezinyathelo Njengoba uKabza eqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ekuqaleni, umculo wakhe wawubhekwa njengokwehlukile, kanti abathandi bomculo babenelisekile ngalesi siqhamo esisha. Umehluko emculweni kaKabza wawukhombisa uthando lwakhe lokukhiqiza. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, lezi zinyathelo zaguquka zaba yizinkanyezi zempumelelo. UKabza wayezimisele ukwenza umehluko, futhi umculo wakhe wakhula waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wonke. Izingoma zakhe zazithandwa kumaphathi, zishaywa kwi-radio, futhi ziheha abantu abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomphakathi. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlonishwa Njengoba umculo kaKabza uqhubeka nokwenza kahle, wathola izinkanyezi eziningi, futhi yonke imisebenzi yakhe ibhakedwe ngothando. Kodwa akagcinanga lapho; uKabza waqhubeka nokwakha izimpendulo zokuphupha zakhe, wacela abanye abaculi ukuba bamxhase ngezigqi zabo. Lokhu kwenza umculo wakhe uhluke, uhlale ubukhoma. U-Kabza waqhubeka nokufuna ukuhlonishwa, njengoba ebona umculo njengomsebenzi ongenamkhawulo. Njengoba edumile phakathi kwabantu abasha nabazali babo, wathokozisa abantu ngezenzo zakhe ezinhle, ezikhanga izithakazelo zabantu. Isahluko 4: Imiphumela Yokubambisana U-Kabza De Small wayengumgibeli ophumelelayo, ethanda izinkanyezi, i-harmonies, nomoya wokubambisana. Waqoqa imizamo yakhe nomngane wakhe uDj Maphorisa, futhi ngokubambisana kwabo, baqonda kahle izidingo zomphakathi wemculo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izingoma ezinhle, ezizwakala kahle. Umphakathi wawujabule, izigcawu zazigubha izinsuku ezimnandi. Lezi zicabha zomculo zafika eminyakeni edlule, zenza ubukhazikhazi emcimbini we-2023, lapho uKabza ethola umklomelo omkhulu wokuhlonishwa kumculi ovela. Ukuphumelela kwakhe kube nemiphumela emihle, kungenza izinkanyezi zempilo yakhe zikhanye. Isahluko 5: Isiphetho Ukuqonda uKabza De Small njengenhlekelele yomculo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo ungathi uthando. U-Kabza ungumqondisi wezinkanyezi, ehamba phambili, efaka umoya. Umsebenzi wakhe awuqondi kude; zonke izikhumbuzo zikhumbula umoya oncomekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uKabza De Small usakaze umculo wakhe emhlabeni jikelele, waba yindoda edumile, efakaza ukuthi uthando nemisebenzi kahle kungaholela ekukhanyeni kokufinyelela. Noma kuphumelele ngezithiyo, uKabza ubonisa ukuthi ukuphikelela, ukuthanda, nokubambisana kuyindlela yokufeza amaphupho. Indaba kaKabza ifundisa, isikhumbuzo somuzwa okhuluma ngothando, imizamo, kanye nohlanga lokuthandana. UKabza uqhubeka nokwenzela abantu injabulo ngombukiso wakhe, futhi uthando lomculo, nomoya wakhe wothando, kuqhubeka ukuthokozisa.
Izinkinga Zokungcola Komoya: Ukuhlaziywa Nokuqonda Ukungcola komoya kuyinkinga ethinta bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, imvelo, noma umnotho. Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani lokhu kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi lesi sihloko sizohlola izinkinga ezihambisana nokungcola komoya, imithombo yawo, kanye nemiphumela yawo empilweni yethu. Imithombo Yokungcola Komoya Kukhona izinto eziningi ezibangela ukungcola komoya. Okokuqala, izimoto zenza umoya ube nomoya ongcolile. Izimoto ezidla uphethiloli, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamapaki amakhulu, zikhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwamagesi anobungozi afana ne-carbon monoxide ne-nitrogen oxides. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umoya ube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, kube nokwanda kwezifo zokuphefumula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imboni iyona enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokungcola komoya. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto, ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezimpahla, konke lokhu kudinga amandla amaningi, okukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwemikhawulo eminingi. Lokhu kudala ukungcola komoya, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziseduze nezimboni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Imiphumela Yokungcola Komoya Empilweni Imiphumela yokungcola komoya ibonakala ngokucacile empilweni yethu. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinomoya ongcolile bahlushwa yizifo eziningi, ezinjengokuphefumula okungahambi kahle, izifo zenhliziyo, kanye nezinkinga zesikhumba. Abantu abanesithakazelo empilweni yabo kufanele baqaphele izimpawu ezihlobene nokungcola komoya, njengokukhwehlela, ukuvuvukala, noma ukuvuvukala kwesikhumba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcola komoya kuthinta impilo yezilwane nezitshalo. Izilwane ezihlala ezindaweni ezithintekile zikhombisa izimpawu zokuhlupheka, kanti izitshalo ziba nekhono eliphansi lokukhula. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemithombo yokudla, okuthinta umnotho wezwe. Uma umoya ungcolile, izitshalo azikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okwanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokulwa Nokungcola Komoya Ukuthola izixazululo zokungcola komoya kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqwashisa abantu ngale nkinga. Imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izimoto ezisebenza kahle, njengezimoto ezisebenzisa ugesi, ingasiza ekunciphiseni ukungcola komoya. Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle, kudingeka imithombo ethile yokufundisa, njengemihlangano, izifundo, kanye nemithombo ye-intanethi. Uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezithile zokulawula ukungcola komoya. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufaka imithetho eqinile yokulawula imoto, imboni, kanye nezinsiza ezikhiqizayo. Ukuze imithetho ibonakale, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinsiza zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho iyagcinwa. Izinkampani nazo zinqoba indima ebalulekile. Zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise ukungcola okukhishwa emoyeni. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlanzekile, kanye nokwenza izinqubo zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni imikhiqizo ethuthukisa impilo yomoya. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokungcola komoya zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba zikhombisa imiphumela emibi empilweni yethu, emvelweni, nasezinhlelweni zomnotho. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukwakha umoya ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ongenazinkinga zokungcola. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yethu, imvelo yethu, kanye nomnotho wethu, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoba nempilo engcono. Ukubambisana kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekulwisaneni nokungcola komoya.
Isingeniso IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liyisikhungo esiyinhloko sokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi, elibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthetho, ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zomphakathi, nasekuphatheni izinqumo ezithinta izakhamuzi zethu. Ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi iPhalamende lisebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukwazi izigaba ezihlukene ezisemqoka, izinqubo, kanye nezimiso ezilawula ukusebenza kwalo. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukwakheka kwePhalamende IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liqukethe izingxenye ezimbili ezisemqoka: iNdlu ePhakeme (Senate) kanye neNdlu ePhansi (National Assembly). INdlu ePhakeme ibhekelela izindaba ezithinta izifunda, kanti iNdlu ePhansi ibhekelela izindaba ezijwayelekile zomphakathi. Ukuze ube yilungu lePhalamende, umuntu kufanele abe ngumuntu ophethe iziqu ezithile, athole ukhetho, futhi abe nekhono lokuhola. Isigaba sesibili: Ukhetho lwePhalamende Ukhetho lwePhalamende lwenziwa njalo eminyakeni emine. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi ziqonde izinqubo zokubhaliswa. Abantu kufanele babhalise ukuze bavote, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ezikhungweni ezikhethekile noma online. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izakhamuzi zithola ithuba lokuvota, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezintandokazi zabo, zikhombisa ukuthi zifuna ubani ukuba ummeleli wazo. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Uma ukhetho sekuqedile, iPhalamende iqala ukusebenza. Izigameko zokuqala zifaka phakathi umhlangano wokuqala, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ahlangana khona ukuze aqinisekise izikhundla ezibalulekile, njengeMenenja yePhalamende (Speaker) kanye noMholi weMpumalanga. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Isigaba sesine: Ukubhala umthetho Umthetho ubhalwa ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela iziphakamiso, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokwenza izinguquko uma kudingeka. Ukuze umthetho uphumelele, kufanele udlule ezinyathelweni ezithile, kuhlanganise nokuvunywa kwamaKomidi, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ebheka khona iziphakamiso ngokucophelela. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukuhlola umthetho Ngemuva kokuba umthetho ubhalwe, iPhalamende kufanele ihlole ukuthi umthetho uyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlola kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho awubangeli umonakalo, futhi ufinyelela ezinjongo ezithile zomphakathi. Uma umthetho uthola ukugunyazwa, uqala ukusebenza, futhi izakhamuzi ziqala ukuwusebenzisa. Isigaba sesithupha: Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi IPhalamende linomsebenzi wokubambisana nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuhlela imihlangano, lapho izakhamuzi zingabamba iqhaza khona, zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi wazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iPhalamende iqonde izidingo nezifiso zabantu, futhi ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nalezi zidingo lapho ibhala khona imithetho. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yePhalamende Ukuze iPhalamende iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlola imisebenzi yayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi imithetho ibhalwe kahle, ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngendlela efanele, nokuthi izakhamuzi zifinyelela kanjani ezinsizeni ezitholakala ngaphansi kwemithetho. Ukuhlola lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuphendula izikhalazo ezivela kubantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Isigaba sesishiyagalombili: Ukubuyekeza umthetho Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zomphakathi zishintsha. IPhalamende kufanele ibuyekeze imithetho yayo ukuze ihambisane nezimo ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umthetho uhlale uvumelana nezidingo zabantu, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhululekile futhi ziphila kahle. Isiphetho IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuqonda izinqubo zalo, ukusebenza kwalo, nokubambisana nezakhamuzi kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azibandakanye, aqonde, futhi abe neqhaza ekwakheni iPhalamende elisebenzayo, elihloniphekile, nelikhululekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvota, ukwakha umthetho, nokuhlola imisebenzi yePhalamende, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhululekile futhi zikhuluma ngezidingo zazo.
Ezokwakha: Indaba Yezithombe Zokwakha Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho umoya uphuphuma kancane, uvusa imimoya emisha. Kwakukhona umphakathi ophakathi kokwakha, lapho abantu bejabulile futhi benomdlandla. UThandi, umakhi ophumelele, wayehamba phambili kule ndaba. UThandi wayengumuntu onothando, owayekwazi ukwakha izindlu ezinhle, izikhumbuzo ezizohlala zikhumbuleka. Ngenkathi uThandi eqala ukwakha, wayenelungelo lokukhetha indawo efanele. Wathola indawo ethokomele, eduze komfula, lapho izinyoni zithokozisa khona. Lapho, uThandi waqala khona ukwakha indlu yakhe yokuqala. UThandi wayenolwazi olukhulu, kodwa wayazi ukuthi akekho umuntu ongakwenza yedwa. Waqasha abanye abakhi, ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke benolwazi olunzulu. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, imisebenzi yokuqhuba ibhizinisi yanda. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukwakha akukhona nje kuphela ukwenza izindlu, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Abantu babefika, behlanganyela, behlabelela, futhi bejabulisa. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, umphakathi omkhulu, owayebamba izifundo zokwakha eziphumelelayo. UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda kuye, waphinde wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Noma kunjalo, izinsuku zazingahlala zikhanya. Kwakukhona izinselelo. Ngenxa yokungabikhona kwemali, uThandi wayebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izinsiza zazivame ukungabi khona, futhi abanye abakhi babengasebenzi kahle. Kodwa uThandi akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, efuna izixazululo. Waqasha abanye abakhangisi, wathola izinsiza ezithile, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningi zokusebenza, indlu kaThandi yabe isiqediwe. Kwakuyindlu emnandi, enezinto ezinhle nezithombe ezihle. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, ukungapheli kwethemba kungaholela empumelelweni. Abantu bejabulile, behlanganyela emcimbini wokuvula indlu. UThandi wakhumbula ukuthi akekho owakha yedwa; wonke umuntu wayenendima. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqala ukucabanga ngezinto ezinkulu. Wayefuna ukwakha izindlu eziningi, ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela amaphrojekthi amasha, ahlanganisa izinsiza, abantu, nezifundo ezitholakele. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukwakha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokwakha, kwazulu abantu bejabulile. Umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu, futhi izinhlelo zikaThandi zaba yimpumelelo. Waba umholi, futhi abantu bamlandela. UThandi wayenohlonze, futhi wayebona ukuthi ukwakha akupheli kuphela emakhaya, kodwa kudinga umoya wokubambisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wakhula. Izindlu zanda, izikole zavulwa, nezindawo zokudlela zakhula. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, uthando, nokubambisana kungaholela empumelelweni. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa uThandi wayenokholo. Wazi ukuthi ukwakha akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima. Uthando lwakhe lokwakha lwasiza abantu abaningi, futhi umphakathi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, ukwakha kungenza umehluko. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, banganqoba noma yini. Ukukhanya kwelanga kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, izinsuku ezinhle ziza kulabo abakholelwa. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokwakha, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Umsebenzi wakhe wawuhamba phambili, futhi izinsuku zaba zinhle. UThandi wayephupha, futhi wayazi ukuthi, uma ubambisene, ungakha okukhulu. Lokhu kwakuyindaba yokwakha, indaba yokubambisana, nempilo engcono. UThandi, umakhi, waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhona umoya, konke kungenzeka.
Izinkinga Zamateksi: Ukuhlola Izimo Nezixazululo Emphakathini Wethu Amatekisi awukwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezithile ezinzima. Le mboni ibalulekile ekuletheni abantu ezindaweni zabo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingenamathuba amaningi okubambisana kwezokuhamba. Nokho, izinkinga ezibhekene namatekisi zikhombisa izinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila kwezimoto, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalokhu ukuze siqonde izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Okokuqala, udlame oluhambisana nomkhakha wamatekisi lukhona ezindaweni ezithile, lapho abashayeli behlukaniswa khona ngamaqembu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezingozi nasezibhedlela, okuwubufakazi bokuthi umphakathi udinga izinsiza eziphephile. Ukuze silungise le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi osomabhizinisi bamatekisi baxoxe ngokubambisana ukuze bathole izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwabo. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngeshoda komthetho. Abashayeli bamatekisi bavame ukwephula imithetho, okwenza kube nokungcoliswa kwezindawo zokupaka. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinzima kumjikelezo wokuhamba, njengoba abanye abashayeli bephosa izimoto zabo ezindleleni. Ukuze silungise lokhu, kudingeka imithetho ecacile nezithiyo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufaka izimoto. Okwesithathu, izindleko zokusebenza zikhona, futhi abashayeli bamatekisi bahlala bebhekene nezindleko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphuthume ukwenza imali, okuthinta ukwethembana kwabakhweli. Ukuze sithole ukusimama, iziphathimandla kufanele zihlaziye izindlela zokukhuthaza abashayeli ukuthi basebenzise amasu ahlakaniphile, njengokunikeza izikhuthazo ezimnandi. Okwesine, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabashayeli namakhasimende buphakathi kwezinkinga ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Abashayeli abathola ukutshudelwa okukhulu bangase babe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuntula ukuxhumana okuhle. Ukuze sithuthukise lokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikhuthazayo ezizokwenza abashayeli baqonde izidingo zamakhasimende. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zamatekisi ziveza ubunzima obukhona emkhakheni wezokuhamba. Izinkinga zemithetho, izindleko eziphakeme, nezimo ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubashayeli bamatekisi ukuphumelela. Nokho, uma sizama ukuhlola lezi zinkinga, sizokwazi ukuhlela izixazululo ezikhuthazayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nezinsiza ezithuthukayo, okwenza amatekisi abe yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu.
Umbiko Ngemisebenzi Nezimo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Isingeniso Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Zihlinzeka ngethuba lokufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini engatholakali kalula ezinsizeni zemfundo. Njengoba sithokozisa imfundo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo, izinselele, kanye nezinzuzo ezihambisana nalezi zikole. Izimo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza ngaphansi kwezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe uhulumeni. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi imikhawulo ethile emalini ethathwayo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha othisha. Ngokuvamile, izikole zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kuya ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kudala umehluko ekutholakaleni kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemithombo yokufunda, izincwadi, nezikhungo zokuhlola. Izinsiza Nezinhlelo Zokufunda Uhlelo lokufunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni luhlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka ezifanele zonke izigaba zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezifana nezibalo, isiZulu, isiNgisi, kanye nezifundo zomphakathi. Nokho, izikole ezithile zihlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukufundisa kahle. Izinsiza ezinjengamakhompyutha, izincwadi, nezikhungo zokufunda zihlala zingatholakali, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni zasemakhaya. Izinselele Eziqhubekayo Izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselele eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokusebenza kwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Izinhlaka ezithile zihlala zibhala izinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izikole, kodwa imiphumela ibonakala ingaphelele. Othisha, abanye babo bahlupheka ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuba bakwazi ukufundisa kahle. Okwesibili, izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abafundi abaningi bahlala kude nezikole, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphuthelwe yizifundo ezibalulekile, okwenza kuncishiswe amathuba abo empumelelo. Izinzuzo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Naphezu kwezinselele ezikhona, izikole zikahulumeni zinezinzuzo ezinkulu. Zihlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo imali yokukhokhela izikole ezizimele. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abantu bezokwazi ukufunda futhi bathole amathuba alinganayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabafundi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, lapho abafundi baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo. Izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza futhi ukuhweba ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda phakathi kwabafundi. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni kanye nezakhamuzi basebenzisane. Izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandisa imali ethathwayo ezikoleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okungcono kubo bonke othisha, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezithuthukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinsizeni zokufunda. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, izincwadi, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole, kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisayo ezizokwazi ukuxhasa abafundi, othisha, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Isiphetho Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, zikhuthaza ukufunda nokukhula kwabafundi. Noma zikhona izinselele eziningi, izinzuzo zazo zikhombisa ukubaluleka kwazo empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqhubeke nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kubafundi bethu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola amathuba alinganayo emfundweni.
Umbiko Ngomlando KaDesmond Tutu Isingeniso UDokotela uDesmond Mpilo Tutu, owazalwa ngomhla ka-7 kuNhlangulana 1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokholo eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Njengomfundisi, umholi wezokholo, kanye nomlwi wezemfundo, uTutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekulweni nobandlululo, futhi waba yisithombe esiqhakazile sokuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Imfundo Nokukhula UTutu wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa waphumelela kakhulu ezifundweni zakhe. Wafunda eSt. Peter's Theological College, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBhayibheli. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola iziqu zeBachelor of Arts e-Universiteit van Natal. Lezi zifundo zamsiza ukuba aqonde kangcono izinkinga zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nobandlululo. Umsebenzi Wokuhola Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uTutu waba umfundisi, waphinde waba umphakathi wezokholo. Waqala ukusebenza njengomfundisi eSoweto, lapho aqala khona ukugxila ezinkingeni zomphakathi. Ubuye waba umphakathi wezokholo eKapa, lapho akha khona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abampofu. Ubuye waba umphakathi wezokholo eNingizimu Afrika, lapho waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula. Ukwelulwa Kwezemfundo UDesmond Tutu waba yisithombe esiqhakazile sokulwa nobandlululo, futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abampofu. Waqala ukusebenzisa izinkulumo zakhe ukuze akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphumelele ezikoleni. Wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu ukuba bathole imfundo efanele. Ukwamukela Umsebenzi Wokuthula Ngemva kokuba uNelson Mandela ekhishwe ejele, uTutu waba ngumholi ophambili emizamweni yokwakha ukuthula eNingizimu Afrika. Waba umholi weKomidi Lokuthula, lapho abamba khona iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubuyisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ukwamukelwa Kwamazwe Ngamazwe UDesmond Tutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emhlabeni jikelele. Waba umholi weKomidi Lokuthula eNingizimu Afrika, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emazweni amaningi. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emazweni afana neZimbabwe, eRwanda, naseBosnia. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ukwamukelwa Kweziphakamiso UDesmond Tutu wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe. Wathola iNobel Peace Prize ngonyaka ka-1984, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe ekulweni nobandlululo. Ubuye wathola izindondo eziningi ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula. Isiphetho UDokotela uDesmond Tutu ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokholo. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Uhlale esikhumbuzo sokuthi ukuthula, ubumbano, nokuhloniphana kubalulekile ukuze sakhe umphakathi ongcono. UDesmond Tutu usashiya ifa elikhulu, elizohlala likhumbuleka eminyakeni ezayo.
Ezamandla Kudala, emzaneni oseduze nehlathi elijulile, kwakukhona umndeni ohluke kakhulu. Lo mndeni wawunomkhuba oqinile wokuhlala enobudlelwano obuhle nezinsiza zemvelo. Ubaba, owayenohlonze, wayelawula umnyango wezokwakha, kanti unina, owayeyinduna ekuphileni, wayehlonishwa kakhulu ngabantu bendawo. Kodwa omama namakhaya amaningi ayezwe ukuthi amandla awamukelekile emndenini wabo. Kwathi uma umusi wagcwala emakhaya, umndeni wabo wathola umbono ophakeme: ukuzama ukulondoloza amandla. Ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulu ngezimo ezinzima emhlabeni, umndeni wahamba lapho udinga ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokugcina amandla. Uhlelo lwabo lokugcwalisa izidingo zabo lwaluhamba ngezinyathelo ezilula nokukhula komthwalo wokuphila. Njengoba beqala, kwakumele bahlangane nemvelo. Umama, uNandi, wathola umqondo omusha wokusebenzisa imithombo ye-solar. Ngokuyihola kokuthanda kwabe, waqonda ukuthi ungalugcina kanjani amandla elangeni ukuze basebenzise lesi sikhathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umama uzama ukuphefumula umoya opholile, ebona ukukhanya kwayo kuthandeka. Umlingo wenjabulo owawukhipha phansi, bonke abantwana befunda ukwakha izijwabu ezivela ezindaweni ezincane zokuviva.
