Kwaba isihloko sendaba phakathi kwalabo abavela emakhaya ahlonishwayo, bejabuliswe uma besho ukuthi, "Sizobe siphila kahle! Amandla awaphumi kalula; mancane emthandazo!" Nakanjani, abantwana babefuna ukuphakamisa isiko lemvelo elihambisana nokwakha amandla. Babeyizibani ezikhanyayo, bejabulisa nazo zonke izifundo ezimnandi i-physics nabangani babo. Bahamba benza amatheku phezulu koqotshana, kanti uNandi ubavumele ukuthi babashebandla babandakanye imisebenzi. Enkosi ezinsizweni ze-maketa, uZola, indodana kaNandi, wajabulela ukuthola igalelo elisha ekwakheni amandla acacile. Ngezinsuku ezichumisa umhlaba uNkulunkulu, kwazalwa izithombe ezithokozisayo ezithinta umoya. Wabafundisa ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kuyo yonke into ayikwenzi abusho; zonke izinsiza zibhala indaba eya ekupshelweni kwezinsiza zemvelo. Uyibona le mpi yeqhawe, umndeni uzihlinzekile ngemithombo ethokozisayo. Kwakujabula ukwenza amafutha ezokuphepha emakhaya abantwana, behlunguza izinkampani ezimnandi ezandiwe ngombani obhodlwayo. Njengoba bephuma ebandezelwe uNandi, uzwa umswakama wombuthu wekhaya, umoya uphuzile. Abantu bendawo balanga wonke amanzi omhlaba ngokukulinda. Babefuna konke ukufaka izinyathelo ezintsha ezizothuthuka. Ubaba wayevele azinyakaze ngaphakathi kwezinkanyezi zamanje, abephakathi kweziqu zesibhakabhaka, efunda imithetho yokusingatha amandla kangcono. Basizwa ngothando lwemvelo, ngakho Umoya kusetshenziswa amandla okukhanya okukhuluma ukwazisa lokho. Ngokusho kwabantu, umoya waba yinkanyezi yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwababusi bekhaya nobuchwepheshe bezemvelo kwaba yinsizakalo ethokozisayo. Njengoba basebenzisa ulwazi olwakheke ebantwini abakulungele ukushintsha ukuthandwa kwemikhiqizo yendabuko, abantu bangase bathe bahlala futhi balindele. Mhlawumbe, lo mzuzu oyinqaba uzokwenza ukuthi uhlogo lwenqwaba lokuhlala ehlathini lube namandla azindayo. Isigameko sokugcina sasinolwandle olujulile ngaphansi kwemithombo emikhulu, zonke izingane bejolisa izinkanyezi ziphila ngobuqhawe obuhle. Kanti uqobo umoya wathokozisa umhlaba. Wathumba umbala omhle ozokwenza bagcine izinkanyezi zabo zikhazimula. Eminyakeni eyalandela, umndeni wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinto ezincane ezinjengamanzi nezinhlaka zamagange kumele zihlale lapho njalo, ziqhubeke nokwakha ezisebenzayo. Babefunda ukuthi uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuhlanza kanye nokutshintshisana kwezinsiza kungathinta izimpilo zabo nemvelo. Umoya, ukubaluleka kwesimo zemvelo, kwaba yinkanyezi yomculo, uMoya weMithombo! Ngokwenza izinyathelo ezincane, umndeni unqanda ukwenza izinqumo ezivuma ukuncipha kwandla, onke amanzi azotholakala emhlabeni, inguquko ibonakala. Yize umhlaba uthanda ukuphindeka, ubuhlobo nemvelo baphakade. Lena indaba efaka isinohwebo nolwazi, umndeni uhamba phambili ekwakheni amandla. Njengokuthokoza komdabu, kwazalwa umoya ophefumlayo, awushintshi lapho kwenzekile. Umndeni wapha lokho obekungakanani engosini bazinjengamazwi amabili, behlezi bezihlonipha. Ngakho-ke, umndeni uhlezi esezidingweni ezisemqoka, ubona ukuthi amandla ayithinta yonke into izinto ezenzeka. Kwathi umhlaba uvuka waphenduka, umndeni waqinisa amandla abo ahlabahlayo, uthando lwemvelo lukwazi ukugcina inhlonipho yayiyo. Ngemva kokuphela, umndeni uqwashisa ezamandla, kwathi lapho ilanga liphuphuma, ithemba elisha lahamba, umoya owazisa uNkulunkulu.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni: Izinsiza Nezinkinga Zokuhlala Kwezakhamuzi Ukuphila emadolobheni kungenye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu ezithinta izimpilo zethu namuhla. Emadolobheni, siphila eziqhingini ezinamandla, ezikhanya ngobuchwepheshe, ezikhangayo nezinezinsiza eziningi. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinsiza ziveza izinselelo ezithile, ezidinga ukuba sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngempilo yethu edolobheni. Ukwanda kokukhula kwamadolobha kuhlobene kakhulu nomnotho. Imisebenzi eminingi itholakala emadolobheni, okwenza kube lula ukuthola umsebenzi. Lokhu kwenza abantu abaningi baphume ezindaweni ezithile besiya emadolobheni, befuna ukuphila okungcono. Izakhamizi zifinyelela kalula ezinsizeni ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, kanye nezitolo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, kodwa kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi ukuhlala emadolobheni akuhambisani kuphela nezinzuzo; kunezinkinga eziningi ezithinta izakhamuzi. Okokuqala, kumele sikhulume ngengcindezi yokuhlala. Njengoba abantu abaningi behlaliswa emadolobheni, izindlu ziba nzima ukuthola, futhi amanani okuphila akhuphuka. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuba baphile kahle. Inkinga yokuntula izindlu ezithengekayo ibangelwa ukukhuphuka kwezimali ezidingekayo ukuze uthole indawo yokuhlala, okuholela ekwenzeni abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezinyangeni ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kudala ukungahleleki kwezakhamuzi, okukhathaza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphila emadolobheni kuholela ekwandeni kwezingqinamba zokuphila. Izingqinamba ezinjengokungcola, izithuthi eziningi, nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokusebenza kukhulu. Izakhamuzi zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yezenhlalakahle, futhi lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka okuhlelekile. Ukuze sithole impilo engcono, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuthutha, siphinde siphakamise izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokulawula ukungcola. Uma sikhuluma ngezinzuzo, asinakukwazi ukungabazi ukuthi amadolobha anikela ithuba elihle lokuhlangana nabanye. Izindawo eziningi zenkululeko, imicimbi yokuhlala, nezindawo zokusebenza zibhala izinkanyezi zamasiko. Lokhu kugqugquzela ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuhlelwe imicimbi eminingi yokubambisana. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubudlelwane obusha phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene, okwandisa umqondo wokuhlalisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, emadolobheni, sithola amathuba okufuna intuthuko. Izinsiza eziningi zaziwa kakhulu emazingeni omhlaba, futhi kukhona ubuchwepheshe obusha obuvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zibe nempilo engcono. Ukuphila emadolobheni, anikela ngempela ithuba lokuthi sithole ukwazi okuningi, siphinde sibe neqhaza elikhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela yokuphila kwethu emadolobheni kumele ibhekwane ngokucophelela. Udaba lwezokuphepha luhlala lukhathaza izakhamuzi. Izinga lokuphila eliphezulu alithinti kuphela izindleko, kodwa futhi lihlanganisa nemiphumela yokungapheli kwemigudu yokuphepha. Izakhamuzi zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zibe nokuphepha emadolobheni, nokubaluleka kokuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungqubuzana kwezinhlanga ezahlukene nokuphila kwazo kungaholela ekuhlukaniseni okujule. Ukuphila emadolobheni kudinga ukuqonda okukhulu kokuhlukahluka kwezakhamuzi, ukuze siqonde ngezinselelo ezibhekene nazo. Sizokwazi kanjani ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo uma singakwazi ukubheka izinkinga ezikhona? Ekugcineni, ukuphila emadolobheni kudinga ukucabangela okujulile. Izinsiza ezikhona ziwusizo, kodwa kunezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukusizakala. Kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo ezihamba phambili ukuze sithuthukise impilo yezenhlalakahle, siqinisekise ukuphepha, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwane phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Udaba lokuphila emadolobheni alupheli; kumele sikhumbule ukuthi kuliqhaza eliqhubekayo lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhulayo, futhi ohloniphayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, umphakathi, nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo.
Amahlaya - Umqondo, Umsebenzi, Nokubaluleka Kwawo Isingeniso Amahaha, noma amahlaya, ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yomuntu. Ukumamatheka, ukuhleka, nokuzizwisa kahle kuyizinto ezithokozisayo ezitholakala kumahlaya. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngamaahlaya, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi awafaneleki kuphela njengokuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Kulokhu, sizobheka ukuthi amahlaya ayini, ubuchwepheshe bawo, nezizathu ezenza kube kubalulekile ukuba siwasebenzise empilweni yethu. Umqondo WamaHlaya Amahaha angabhalwa, akhulunywa, noma adlalwe, futhi ahluka kakhulu ngokwamasiko, izinkolo, nezindawo. Umqondo wamaahlaya ungabhekwa njengokuhlekisa okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya angaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima ngendlela ethokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukuziqonda. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngezinkinga ezithile. Umsebenzi WamaHlaya Uma sikhuluma ngomsebenzi wamaahlaya, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amahlaya angaba nemisebenzi eminingi. Okokuqala, amahlaya anikeza abantu ithuba lokuphumula. Emhlabeni ogcwele ingcindezi, ukuhleka kungaba yindlela yokukhulula umoya. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya angaba yindlela yokwelapha, njengoba ukuhleka kukhulula imizwa emibi. Okwesibili, amahlaya angaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi. Abahlekisi basebenzisa amahlaya ukuze baveze izinkinga ezinjengobandlululo, ubuphofu, noma izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuveza imicabango ehlukene, futhi abantu bangakuthola kulula ukuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Izinselelo ZamaHlaya Nokho, amahlaya awanqobi ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezihambisana namaahlaya, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekubhaleni nasekudlaleni. Okokuqala, amahlaya angaba nezithiyo uma kungenziwa ngendlela engafanele. Abanye abantu bangase bahlulele amahlaya ngokwenkolo, ubuhlanga, noma ubulili, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kubo. Okwesibili, kunobungozi bokuthi amahlaya angase abangele ukungaqondi kahle. Abantu bangase bahlulele amahlaya ngendlela engafanele, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi amahlaya kufanele abe nokuqonda okukhulu, ukuze akwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlonishwa KwamaHlaya Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amahlaya akhuluma ngezinto ezithile, futhi kufanele sihloniphe imikhuba nemigomo yamasiko ahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahlekisi kufanele baqonde izilaleli zabo, futhi bazi ukuthi yini efanele futhi yini engafanele. Ukuhlonipha izinkolelo nezinkolelo zabanye abantu kubalulekile ukuze amahlaya akwazi ukudlula ezitheni. Ukubaluleka KwamaHlaya Empilweni Yansuku zonke Empilweni yansuku zonke, amahlaya anendima enkulu. Amahaha angaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokuhlekisa, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ukusebenzisa amahlaya empilweni yethu kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ngakho-ke, amahlaya ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Akukhona okukhuluma kuphela ngokuhlekisa, kodwa futhi akhombisa indlela yokubheka izinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuhleka akusizi kuphela ukuphumuza, kodwa futhi kukhulisa ukuqonda. Ngakho, kufanele sihloniphe amahlaya, siwasebenzise empilweni yethu, futhi siqonde imithelela yawo. Ekugcineni, amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Amatekisi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinsiza Zokuhamba Emphakathini Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini ehlukene. Le ndatshana izobheka izici ezahlukene zamatekisi, kuhlanganise nomlando wabo, izinzuzo, izinkinga, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsiza ukuze zibe usizo olukhulu emphakathini. Umlando Wamatekisi Umlando wamatekisi uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho abantu behamba ngezinyawo noma ngezilwane. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubekela phambili, kwavela izindlela zokuhamba ezithuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa amatekisi. Emazweni amaningi, amatekisi aqala njengemoto ezithengiswa ngabantu ngabanye, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinsiza zaba yizinkampani ezinkulu ezihlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo nolulula. E-South Africa, amatekisi aqala ukuvela ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho abantu abaningi behamba besuka emakhaya baye emadolobheni ukuze bafune amathuba emisebenzi. Izinzuzo Zamatekisi Amatekisi anikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzisi bawo. Okokuqala, ahlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo, olungabizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zokuhamba ezinkulu, njengezitimela noma izindiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ngezimoto zomphakathi kungathatha isikhathi eside. Okwesibili, amatekisi avumela abantu ukuba bahambe ngezikhathi ezihlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zabo zansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebenza ezikhungweni ezahlukene abadinga ukufika emsebenzini ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi anika abantu ithuba lokuhweba emiphakathini. Abashayeli bamatekisi bavame ukuba neziqondiso ezinhle mayelana nezindawo ezithile, okwenza kube lula kubagibeli ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezindawo zokudlela, izitolo, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabashayeli nabagibeli, okukhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Izinkinga Zamatekisi Nokho, amatekisi abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhwalithi yokuphepha. Abashayeli bamatekisi abavame ukuba neziqu eziphezulu noma ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo, okungaholela ezimeni ezimbi zokuphepha. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka kubagibeli, ikakhulukazi uma behamba ebusuku noma ezindaweni ezingaziwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto zamatekisi zihlala zisebenzisa amafutha, okukhulisa izinga lokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Enye inkinga ebalulekile yikhono lokuhweba. Ezinye izinkampani zamatekisi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuhweba ezingafanele, okuholela ekutheni abashayeli bahlupheke ngokwezimali, okungathinta ikhwalithi yokuhamba. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Amatekisi Ukuze amatekisi abe usizo olukhulu emphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kubashayeli bamatekisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izindinganiso zokuphepha, izindlela zokuhweba, kanye nezidingo zabagibeli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence aqinile kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlala bephila kahle. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni amatekisi. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhamba, kungasiza abashayeli nabagibeli ukuba baxhumane kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhamba, futhi kunciphise isikhathi sokulinda. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani zamatekisi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izindawo zokupaka ezikahle, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence afanele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisa amatekisi nezinye izindlela zokuhamba. Isiphetho Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini. Nakuba ebhekene nezinselelo eziningi, izinzuzo zawo zikhombisa ukuthi ziwusizo olukhulu. Ngokuthuthukisa amatekisi, singaqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaza umnotho, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabagibeli. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayeli, abagibeli, kanye nohulumeni kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lamatekisi.
iMinecraft - Umcimbi Wokwakha Nokuqhamuka Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umphakathi we-Minecraft ubungcweti obukhulu emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Umcimbi omkhulu, owawubanjelwe emaphandleni asezintabeni, wathokozisa abathandi be-Minecraft abavela kuzo zonke izindawo. Umcimbi lo wawuhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, nokukhuthaza ubuhlakani bokudala. Kusukela ekuseni, izivakashi zafika zikhombisa injabulo, zibhakabhaka emhlabeni ogcwele izakhiwo ezihlukahlukene, ezakhiwe ngothando, ubuciko, kanye nesineke. Izindawo ezihlukene zazihlanganisa izindawo zokwakha, izinkundla zokudlala, nezindawo zokufundisa, lapho abanye befundisa abanye izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha. Umoya wokubambisana wawubhalwe emoyeni, njengoba abantu babelana ngemicabango, izindlela, nezinsiza zabo. Kwakukhona umncintiswano omkhulu wokwakha, lapho amaqembu ahlukene ahlukaniswe ngokwezinga lobuchwepheshe. Abadlali baphakanyiswa ukuthi bakhe izakhiwo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini ezincane kuya ezakhiweni ezinkulu nezihlabahlosile. Umphakathi wawubukeka uzolile, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana wawukhanya kakhulu. Abadlali babekhuluma, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngama-strategies abo, bejabulisa umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivakashi zazithola ithuba lokubona izinkanyezi eziphakeme, njengoba abanye bephusha imingcele yokwakha. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, izimanga ezidumile, nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo ezazithokozisa bonke. Umcimbi wawuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuzijabulisa, futhi abanye babebhalisela ukufunda izifundo ezithile zokwakha, ezazihlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezakhiwo. Izingqungquthela ezithile zaxoxwa ngempumelelo yokwakha, ezikhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokwakha. Abafundi babenethuba lokuxhumana nabakhi abanolwazi, behlanganyela izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha, futhi benza ubuhlobo obusha. Umoya wokubambisana wawumangalisayo, njengoba abantu babelana ngemicabango, izindlela, nezinsiza zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wawuhamba kancane, kodwa umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya. Izivakashi zabe seziphakamisa izinkanyezi eziphezulu, zikhombisa ubuhlakani bokudala, nezindlela zokwakha ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi wawuhlangene, unomoya omuhle, futhi wawuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuzijabulisa, yokufunda, nokwakha. Ekugcineni, umcimbi we-Minecraft wawungaphezu kokwakha; wawuwumcimbi wokuhlanganyela, wokufunda, nokubambisana. Umphakathi wawuhlangene, umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya, futhi abathandi be-Minecraft baphumelele ekwakheni ubuhlobo obusha, bejabulisa umphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi umphakathi wawukhumbula izinsuku ezinhle ezazihlanganisa abantu abavela kuzo zonke izindawo, bejabulisa, befundisa, futhi bejabulela umhlaba we-Minecraft. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi we-Minecraft wawuhamba phambili, uhlanganisa abantu, uhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi uhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Umoya wokwakha, wokubambisana, nokufunda wawukhanya, futhi umphakathi wawuhlangene, uzinikele ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. Umcimbi wawungaphezu kokwakha izakhiwo; wawuwumcimbi wokwakha ubuhlobo, umoya, nokuhlanganyela. I-Minecraft, ngempela, iyindawo yokwakha, yokufunda, nokuhlanganyela, futhi umcimbi lo waba yisibonelo esihle salokho.
uUsain Bolt Emazweni aphakathi kwezinyembezi zempilo, lapho abantwana bejabulisa khona futhi abadlali begubha impumelelo, kwavela isibani esikhazimulayo. Leli phepha livela emlandweni wezemidlalo, elibhalwa ngothando, ngenhlonipho, futhi lufaka izindaba eziyinqaba zomzamo nomsebenzi. Kulolu hlelo, sikhuluma ngendoda eyaziwa ngegama eliyinhloko kwezokugijima — uUsain Bolt. UUsain Bolt wazalwa ngoNovemba 21, 1986, eTrelawny, eJamaica. Uyinsizwa enenkanyezi, owayenobuhlakani obuningi, obuphawulwe yizikhathi zokuqala. Ubukhulu bakhe, u-1.95m, bamsiza ukuba abe yisixazululo somjaho. Ngesikhathi abanye abantwana bejolise kwezinye izindlela zokuphila, uUsain wayethola ithuba lokukhanyisa izinyembezi zempilo, efuna imigudu yokuphila phambili. Njengomfana, uUsain wayejabula kakhulu ngezinto ezahlukene, futhi ukugijima kwaba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yakhe. Akazange aphuthelwe ithuba lokuhola emhlabeni wezokugijima. U-Usain waba yinkanyezi, esebenza ngezinhloso zokufinyelela impumelelo. Ngonyaka ka-2008, uUsain waba neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni ye-Olympics eBeijing, eChina, lapho wavula umqondo omusha wokugijima. Wathola iziqu ezinkulu, waphonsela inselelo, futhi wagubha amakhono akhe ngempumelelo. Waphumelela ezigabeni zokuqhuba, kuyi-100m nase-200m, waba yinkanyezi enkulu emhlabeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo lwaba umthombo wokudlondlobala, okuholela ekubeni umholi. U-Usain uqhubekela phambili, futhi uhamba ezikhaleni ezimnandi, abanye bakhe besekela imizamo yakhe. Wachitha izinsuku eziningi efunda kumadoda abamele umhlaba, okuhlale kusesimweni esihle. U-Usain ungumuntu ophakeme, ogijima njengesiphepho sothando. Wakhiwa ubudlelwane obuqinile nabangani bakhe, futhi imiphumela yayikhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2012, imidlalo ye-Olympics yeLondon yathokozisa izinkanyezi, uUsain waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu. Waqhubeka nokwakha izikhumbuzo ezinhle, futhi wakhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uUsain waphumelela izinguquko eziningi emkhakheni wezokugijima. Ngenhla kwalokhu, wathola umuzwa omuhle wokuba ngumholi. U-Ethos wakhe wephula imikhawulo, waba umfanekiso omuhle kubabukeli. U-Usain ungumholi ophakeme, ubumbene nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Njengoba ebuyela emsebenzini, ubala imizuzu yokugcina. Wafunda ukuthi impumelelo ibalulekile, kodwa umoya wokuzidela, ubudlelwane, nokwakha imifanekiso efanele kubalulekile. U-Usain uvuma ukuzikhandla, akazisa imizamo yakhe, futhi uthola imiphumela emihle. Ngempela, uUsain Bolt ungomunye wezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emlandweni wezokugijima. Uhlonishwa ngenkanyezi yakhe ehlala ifudumele, ibonisa ukuthi uthando, umzamo, kanye nesibindi, bakha izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emlandweni. Njengoba ethi, "Kodwa amaphupho akhe awapheli..." akhombisa ukuthi impilo idinga umoya wokuphila, ukuze kuhlangane nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. U-Usain Bolt, umholi wezokugijima, uhlobo oluhlala phambili, luhlaza emathubhini zempilo.
Othisha Ngonyaka owodwa, emzaneni ophakathi kwezimfunda, kwakukhona isikole esincane esaziwayo ngothisha bazo abahloniphekile. Lesi sikole sasingaphansi kwezimvula eziningi, futhi sasiqonda ukuthi ukufunda ngesikhathi semvula kube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yabantu bendawo. Phakathi kwalezi zinkanyezi, bekukhona othisha abaningi, kodwa ababili baye baba yizibonelo eziphawulekayo: uMfundisi Thandiwe noMfundisi Sipho. UMfundisi Thandiwe wayengumama opholile, othathekile ngothando lokufundisa. Wayekhuluma kahle futhi ewusizo kulabo ababephansi komuthi omkhulu ophakathi kwezinkanyezi. Ubani ongakukhohlwa ukuthi uThandiwe wayejabula ngokufundisa, futhi wayenothando lokuqonda izidingo zabafundi bakhe. Wayengowesifazane owayekwazi ukubamba inhliziyo yomfundi, engaba ngumphefumulo wabo emizamweni yabo yokuphumelela. UMfundisi Sipho, ngakolunye uhlangothi, wayengumuntu onobuchwepheshe, onomdlandla kakhulu. Wayenolwazi olunzulu ngazo zonke izifundo, futhi wayekwazi ukuphendula imibuzo engakaze ibuzwe. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwalukhula, futhi wayevame ukujabulisa abafundi bakhe ngezinkanyezi nemiyalezo emihle. Nokho, bekukhona okuthile okwakungahambisani phakathi kwalaba bobabili othisha, kokubili abaziphatha kahle, bedlula ezinye izimfanelo zabafundi. Ngesizini, uMfundisi Thandiwe waphawula ukuthi abazali bokuqala babasekela kakhulu ezikoleni, kodwa ukuntuleka kwemali kwakufuna ukuthi bazifundise ngemfundo. Wayebazi kahle – ukuba uSipho ababekhuluma ngokuncane, wayengavumi ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ngenhlanhla, wayenothando lokufunda, kodwa uThandiwe wayenendlela yokuxhuma nomphakathi. Kwakuyiphupho lakhe ukuba nabafundi bakhe bazi kahle ukuthi ukuhlakanipha akuwona umgomo kuphela, kodwa umuzwa wokuthula nokubumbana. Esikhathini esithile, uSipho wayehamba phambili, egxila emiphumeleni emihle, kodwa uThandiwe wayeqinile kakhudlwana. UThandiwe wakha umphakathi, wathi, "Uma sizama ukufundisa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abafundi bethu bangabantu abanezinkanyezi ezihlukahlukene." Wayekwazi ukubanikeza izifundo zenhlonipho, ukudlula phezu kokukwazi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uSipho wayengathandi ukusebenza nomphakathi. Wayefuna ukubona izimpumelelo zabo ngamazinga abhalwe phansi, okwakwenza uThandiwe akhathazeke uma ebheka isimo somoya ophakathi kwabo. UThandiwe wakwazi ukuhamba naphakathi kwabo, ewusizo nephumelelayo, eqhubeka ukufundisa abafundi bakhe ngezizathu zokuhlonipha. Ngelinye ilanga, kwenzeka ingaphakathi elibalulekile emabenzi. Bafuna ukukhipha isixazululo sokukhuluma nabazali ukuze babonane nomphakathi. Lokhu kwakubhalwe emuva kokuheha komunye umqondisi, owayecabanga ukuthi kusekude isizathu sokuhambisa izifundo, kodwa omunye odlalayo, ikakhulukazi uMfundisi Thandiwe, wathi, "Kumele sikukhumbuze okujulelwe emtsheni. Umphakathi ufuna upande." Ngaleso sikhathi, kusho ngokubonisa, bekuyovela izolo umqondisi wezokuxhumana. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho wakhumbula ngokufana naleso sikhathi, "Kuyabalulekile ukuvuma izinqumo ezizokwenza sibe ngcono." Umzwangedwa uThandiwe wenza imizamo emisha, ukwazisa emsebenzini wabo bahlonipha. Babengaphosi wonke uma behamba ndawonye, behamba bejezisa abafundi. Ukuze bakhumbule, kulandela usuku, babeqhuba umhlangano wokuxoxisana. UThandiwe wayekhala engathokozile, "Siyalindela izimpilo zabafundi." Lekhono labezinhlaka ezimbili. Kukhona okuhle nokubi ephakeme, kodwa abahlali bephikweni leziqhamo kwezokufundisana. Kulokhu, uSipho wayekhumbula kahle, "Ngabe sizokwenzenjani ukuze sizame ukudala ngamunye." Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandiwe nabanye othisha baphuma nezinye izinhlelo ezichazwe kuzwi, basebenzisa uSipho ukuxhobisa nokuqeqeshwa kwezizathu eziphakeme zokufundisa. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe noSipho bazifundisa nabanye, bazixhumanisa, bekwazi ukuveza ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukufundisa ngempela. Kwaphela izinyanga, kwanezelwa ikusasa elikhanyayo, ukufunda kube isimanga, kuthokozisa umphakathi. Uthando lwahlahlisa izinkanyezi, kwagcizelela ukusebenza kwabafundi, kwazoba umbono ophakeme ngothando lokufunda. Nakuba baphuma phezu kwalezi zinsuku, uThandiwe noSipho basengaphakanyiswa umoya wobuciko, umoya wokuhlonipha. Izizwe zokufunda zazingalungiswa, kodwa imizwa yokuhlonipha yaqhubeka isinikela, ilima eliqinisekisa omunye nomunye. Ngenhlanhla, ukuphila kwemfundo kwabafundi babebahlonipha, bekhumbula izifundo ezihlobene nezintho ezimbalwa. Othisha abababawa, baba nomphakathi, baphefumula ubukhazikhazi bacela umhlaba. Lezi zinkanyezi zakhumbula ukulingana okukhanyayo phakathi kokubili, bezama ukuthola izimpendulo. Kwakuyisifundo esikhulu, uThandiwe noSipho babengamakhosi omphakathi, bejabulile ngothando lobuchwepheshe, kuze kube sekupheleni kwabo nosuku, kwaze kwashintsha izimpilo zihambe phambili.
Ukufuduka Kwabantu Emakhaya Baya Emadolobheni Ekuqaleni, emakhaya amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, abantu babenokuphila okuthokozisayo. Izinkanyezi zazikhanya phezulu, izinkomo zazihamba emaphandleni, futhi imindeni yayihlangana emakhaya ukuze zikhulume, zidle, futhi zabelane ngezindaba. Kodwa, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinto zashintsha. Izinsiza zancipha, amathuba okusebenza ayeshoda, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila ezingcono. UThandi, intombazane encane eyakhulela emakhaya, wayehlala ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezindaba ezimnandi. Kodwa, njengoba efunda, waqala ukubona ukuthi umhlaba ungaphezulu kokuphila emakhaya. Wayefuna ukufunda, ukufunda kahle, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho, ngesikhathi esithile, uThandi wanquma ukuthi kufanele ahambe aye emadolobheni, lapho amathuba okuphila engaphezulu. UThandi wathola umsebenzi endaweni yokudlela edolobheni elikhulu. Uhlanga lwakhe lwaluhlukile, futhi wayezama ukufunda indlela yokuphila edolobheni. Kodwa, izinto zazinzima. Ukuphila edolobheni kwakuhamba kancane, futhi izindleko zaziphakeme. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abavela emakhaya babebhekene nezinkinga eziningi, njengokuhlala ezindlini ezincane, ukungabi nemali eyanele, kanye nokuhlukumezeka emsebenzini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukujwayela impilo edolobheni. Waqala ukwenza abangane, futhi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu bavele baphuma emakhaya afana naye. Babezama ukwakha impilo entsha, kodwa babezithola bephakathi kwezinkinga eziningi. UThandi waba nesibindi, wathola ukuthi akekho owodwa kuphela ophila lezi zinkinga. Kwakukhona umphakathi, abantu ababephila impilo efanayo, futhi babefuna ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngesikhathi esithile, uThandi waqala ukufunda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba emakhaya, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlangana, lapho abantu abavela emakhaya bejabulisa, bexoxa ngezinkinga zabo, futhi befundisana. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Kodwa, uThandi waqaphela ukuthi akekho umuntu ongakhipha imiphumela emihle ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga. Abantu abavela emakhaya babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, futhi uThandi waqala ukufuna izindlela zokubasiza. Waqala ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezahlukene, wathola izinsiza zokufunda, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu baphila kahle uma bephila ndawonye. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola iziqu, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Abantu abavela emakhaya baphila kahle, futhi uThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi waphinda wavakashela emakhaya akhe. Waqonda ukuthi nakuba efuduke, imizi yakhe yayisakhula. Abantu abavela emakhaya bahlala bejabulile, bexoxa ngezindaba, futhi bejabulisa imindeni yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi impilo edolobheni yayiyinsiza, kodwa imizi yakhe yayiyisisekelo. Waqonda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi umphakathi ungakha impilo engcono. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya kuya emadolobheni akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukufunda, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma ngabe sikhona emakhaya noma emadolobheni, umphakathi wethu uyinsiza enkulu, futhi kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi sitholakala ndawonye.
Ngiyavuma, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu zihlale zikhangayo futhi ziwusizo empilweni yethu. Ukuqala, cabanga ngendlela abantu abavame ukuhamba ngalezi zinto. Uzoqonda ukuthi amabhayisikili abalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna ukunciphisa izindleko, ngoba zishibhile futhi umoya ubuyela endleleni. Enye yezinzuzo zamabhayisikili, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezinamabhayisikili amaningi, ukukwazi ukwenza umkhankaso wokuhamba, okwenza kube yinto ethokozisayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu nazo zikwazi ukuheha. I-motorbike noma i-motorcycle, njengoba sikhuluma ngayo, ihamba kancane kodwa iyashesha, idala umuzwa wokukhululeka lapho uthola umoya. Abanye abantu bathanda ukuzenzela izithuthuthu zabo, bejabulile ngalezi zinto. Ngaphambilini, izithuthuthu zifunwa kakhulu ngoba zenza ukuhamba kube okukhawulezayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Uma sikhuluma ngama bhayisikili, kufanele sikhumbule ubukhulu bazo. Uhlanga olukhanyayo nezithuthi ezindala, uma sizithathela phezulu, kuyacaca ukuthi amabhayisikili angathuthukiswa, kodwa izithuthuthu zihlala zikhangayo. Akekho ongawuphika umoya omuhle wezimoto, ikakhulukazi ngoMgqibelo. Abantu bangahamba ezithuthuthu zabo, bejabulisa emakhaya nasemakethe. Kodwa uma sikhuluma ngempilo, amabhayisikili awahloni. Izithuthuthu zidinga abashayeli abanobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka kube nzima ngoba zidinga ukucwaninga okungcono. Ngizocacisa emathubeni okuphumelela. Abahlobo bakha ubudlelwano ngezithuthuthu ngoba bazi ukubaluleka kokuphepha. Sithandazela ukukhipha injabulo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda umoya. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amabhayisikili angashintsha kakhulu. Kuhle ukujula emizameni yokugcina ukuphepha. Uhambo lwamabhayisikili lujabulisa ngokukhulumela. Ngingakukhumbuza ngezindaba ezahlukene, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi sidinga ukuhamba. Ngenhlanhla, kunezinhlangano ezithobekile ezisiza ekuhlinzekeni ngamacala amahle emakethe. Abanye abantu bazithokozisa ngendlela ezicabangele ngayo. Umanqoba usinika umuzwa omuhle. Ngiye ngaba nephupho lokuphuma emakhaya, ngizumbule amabhayisikili, ngicophelese ezithuthuthu. Ukukhanya kwenyanga kuphakama, yonke into izinzile. Uhlanga nemiphakathi kufanele zihlale zithokozile, futhi uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, ukujabuliswa kufikile. Akukwazi ukukholwa ukuthi kancane enhliziyweni yami, ingithokozisile, sikhumbula nezimpilo zabantu. Uhambo lwethu lungama-unique, uthando lwethu lwezithuthi luhlanganisa abantu abaningi. Noma yisiphi isikhathi, uma sibuyela phambili, sizokwazi ukudala izinkumbulo ezilungile. Futhi, uma ubonisa ubuchwepheshe, uzobe uthola abaphile. Ngokuphathelene nalesi sikhathi, qiniseka ukuthi uthola isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi uma uthanda, zibuze ukuthi owayekhona bangakujabulisa kanjani. Ngiyazi, ubuhle balolu suku buhambisana namabhayisikili nezithuthuthu. Ngicabanga ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele akhumbule ukuba aphile, abekwazi ukufaka usizo endabeni. Khumbula, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu akho konke kuyazisa. Futhi, umoya obhalwe lapha awupheli, iziphakamiso zethu zikhona, futhi lokho kugcwalisa izithuthuthu, izinhlelo zethu zihlala ziphuphumile. Hamba ujoyine uhambisane nabo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuzalwa KwamaQhawe Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-18, emzini omncane waseKorsika, kwavela umfana ogama lakhe linguNapoleon Buonaparte. Ngesikhathi ethokozisa imindeni, wayefana nomntwana ophumelelayo, kodwa izinkanyezi zazikhanya phezulu, zikhuluma ngezinto ezinkulu ezazimlindile. UNapoleon wayenothando lwezombusazwe nempi, okwaholela ekubhaliseni kwakhe esikoleni esiphakeme eFrance. Isahluko 2: Ukufunda Namasu Napoleon wayephumelela ezifundweni, ikakhulukazi ezempi. Wafunda izindlela zokuhlela, nokuhlela kahle, eqonda ukuthi izimpi zidinga amasu amakhulu. Njengoba edlulela phambili, waqala ukujula ezindleleni zokugcina izinkanyezi zishintsha. U-Joseph, umfowabo, wamsiza ukuba athole ithuba kumasosha, futhi uNapoleon waba ngumholi ophakeme ngenxa yokuhlonishwa kwakhe. Isahluko 3: Ubuqhawe Nempumelelo Ngemva kokubamba iqhaza empini, uNapoleon wathola ithuba lokuhola. Waba yisikhulu esiphakeme, ethola impumelelo enkulu ezimpini. Waziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe e-Italy, lapho wahlasela khona izitha zakhe wathola izinqola eziningi. Wenze imisebenzi emikhulu yokwenza ubuhlakani bezempi, futhi wathola udumo olukhulu. Isahluko 4: Ukuqhamuka Kwezwe Njengoba esanda ukukhula, uNapoleon wathola ukuthi akafuni ukuba ngumholi wezempi kuphela, kodwa wayefisa ukuba ngumholi wezombusazwe. Wavula izinhlelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa uMthetho weNapoleon, owawukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba nemiphumela emihle, kodwa lwaluphinde lwaba nezinkinga njengoba abanye bezama ukumkhinyabeza. Isahluko 5: Ukuphumelela Nokuqedwa Ubusuku bukhanya ngezinkanyezi, kodwa uNapoleon wathola ukuba nezinqumo ezinzima. Waba umholi wesikhathi eside, kodwa ukuncintisana nezimbangi zakhe kwaba nzima. Kulapho uNjiniyela, umholi wezombusazwe, athola ithuba lokuphindisela. UNapoleon wahlaselwa kakhulu, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni akhishwe ezwenikazi. Isahluko 6: Ukuphila Ngemuva KweMpi Ngemuva kokuphelelwa kwezimfanelo, uNapoleon wathola ukuhlala kwiSikhumbuzo se-Exile, kodwa akazange ahlale phansi. Waphinda wahamba phambili, wakha izixhumanisi ezinzima, wabuyela kuFrance. Nokho, impi yakhe yokugcina, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Waterloo, yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni aphinde akhishwa, waze wafa eSt. Helena, lapho ahlala khona izinsuku zakhe zokugcina. Isahluko 7: Uhlanga Nemfundiso Ngemuva kokuhamba kukaNapoleon, kwasala imfundiso ebalulekile — ukuthi ubuholi bukhona, kodwa bukhona nemiphumela. UNapoleon Bonaparte akazange aphumule, kodwa izinyathelo zakhe zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni. Unomlando ophilayo, futhi izifundo zempilo yakhe ziqhubeka zifundiswa, zikhuluma ngezikhathi zethu namuhla. Ngakho, uNapoleon Bonaparte ungumholi okhumbulekayo, owafundisa umhlaba ngezindlela zokuphatha, ukulwa, nokuphila. Ubuqhawe bakhe bahlale bukhona, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo yakhe zihlala zikhanya, zikhumbuza bonke ukuthi ubuholi buveza amandla amakhulu, kodwa bukhombisa futhi izinselelo ezihambisana nempumelelo.
iGrammy Awards: Ubuqhawe BeMculo Nobumnandi Bempilo Ngonyaka, umcimbi omuhle kakhulu emhlabeni wezokumculo, iGrammy Awards, ubuyela emakhaya ethu. Lezi zinkanyezi zomculo zajolisa amehlo ezinkulungwane zabathandi bomculo emhlabeni jikelele. Kodwa-ke, njengoba imicimbi eyahlukene ibhekana nezinguquko ezithokozisayo, ukusungulwa kweGrammy Awards kukhombisa into eyodwa ebalulekile: ukumangaliswa komculo awupheli, kodwa kunalokho, kuqhubeka nokuthokozisa, kusikhumbuza ukuthi imculo uyinselele, uyinkanyezi, futhi uyinsika yokuxhumana. Uma sikhuluma ngeGrammy Awards, asikho isimo sokudlala phansi. Lokhu akusona nje umcimbi wokuncoma, kodwa kungumcimbi ohlanganyela isiko, ubunjalo, nemizwa yokwakha. Ubani owayecabanga ukuthi imicimbi yokuhlola imiklomelo izoma kanjani? Kuye kwaba nezinguquko ezinkulu, kusukela ekukhulisweni kwemithombo, izigaba eziningi, kanye nabaculi abasha abavela kwezobuciko. Lokhu kuveza ukukhula okuqhubekayo kwezwe lomculo, okuthokozisa kakhulu. Kodwa-ke, njengoba lezi zinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuhlonishwa, kudingeka ukuthi sibuye sihlole imiphumela yalesi sikhumbuzo. Imicimbi yeGrammy Awards isiyinsika ekulondolozweni kwamasiko nezilimi ezahlukene. Noma kunjalo, sithola nesithombe esingalungile, sokuthi izinto ezithile ziqhubeka zixhaswa, kanti ezinye imizamo iphucwa. Lokhu kungukuthi, abaculi abakhombisa ubuciko obuhle bagcina beshiywa emuva, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokunganakwa kwabahloli. Kungakuhle lokhu kuncishiswe, ukuze umbono wezobuciko ungabulawa. Izinselelo zifana nemizuzu eyinkimbinkimbi, lapho umculi ethola khona ithuba lokuziveza, athole ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezihlupha umphakathi. Umcimbi awuzange ube yisigameko esingabhalile, kodwa kube yisikhumbuzo sokuba abaculi baphakeme. Ngaphandle kokubakhumbuza, abaculi badinga ithuba lokuvuma izifundo zeqiniso kanye nezifundo ezinzima. Sha, njengendoda yebhasi elinamandla, abaculi bandenqa umhlaba, begubha imiphakathi ngempumelelo. Isikhathi sishintsha, futhi kuxhaswe abaculi abasha abazokwenza umehluko. kodwa lokhu kudinga ukuba babe nethuba lokucelwa. Njengoba isiGodi seGrammy sikhula, izithombe zomculo kumele sibe nemisebenzi ehlukene ebonisa izinhlelo zomculo ezibalulekile. Manje, njengoba imicimbi yeGrammy ingenye yezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni, kufanele sihlale siqaphela ukuthi abaculi namathalente amasha azitholele izikhala ezidingekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, iGrammy Awards ibonisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuqinisekisa ukuthi umculo uhlala uthandwa. Leli qophelo liyisikhumbuzo sokuthi kumele sixhase ngezimali kanye nezinsiza ukuze kubangelwe umsebenzi omuhle. Akukhona nje ukugubha kodwa kukhona ukudlulisela umyalezo, ukubalisa izindaba ezithi uk-folder lenkululeko. Ngalolu hlobo, iGrammy Awards ibalunisile umhlaba wonke. Ekupheleni kosiko, kufanele siqonde umqondo wokuhlanganyela, lokhu kuhlanganyela kuveza abantu. Umculo kufanele ube umgibeli othokozisayo, ungumbhoro wokuzihlanganisa, nomhlaba bonke abaculi bebamanzi. Abazimisele ukucabanga ngezinto ezintsha, ubuciko bembula amakhono amaningi. Kakhulu njengoMculi, indlela yokungena kwemicabango ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umhlaba ufaneleka. Ngokuphetha, iGrammy Awards akusona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umculo ungaphila, uhlanganise, futhi ubuyise ubuntu. Kulesi simo, sithokoze ngokuphawula nokubamba izinkanyezi zethu ngezimali ezdobekayo. Ake sibe nombono omusha futhi sikhuthaze ukudlulisela umyalezo omuhle emhlabeni wonke, umculo ufanele ukujabulisa, ube yisiteshi sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizombona umculo uhamba phambili, ufinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, ube yinsika yokwakha umhlaba wakho ozohamba phambili.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Entsheni Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthethwa, Ucwaningo Ngokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Entsheni Umhleli: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Ngabe ungazichaza kancane izizathu ezibangela ukuthi intsha ibheke ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa? Mnu. Mthethwa: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Izizathu eziningi zikhona. Okokuqala, intsha ikhangwa kakhulu yempilo yokuphila, lapho izidakamizwa zibonakala njengezindlela zokuphila kahle, noma zokuthola injabulo. Abanye baphinde bazame ukuzithokozisa noma ukufihla izinkinga zabo, njengokucindezeleka noma ukunganeliseki empilweni. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izidakamizwa zikhona ezindaweni ezithile, noma zisetshenziswa kakhulu emiphakathini ethile? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, ngempela. Izidakamizwa zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Intsha ethola ukungabi namsebenzi noma imfundo ibonakala ikhangwa kakhulu yizidakamizwa. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo omubi, lapho ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuthola umsebenzi. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngabe ubona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuphumelele ukulwa nale nkinga? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izinyathelo zikhona. Izikhungo zokwelapha zikhona, futhi zisebenza kanzima ukuze ziqinise imikhankaso yokuvikela intsha. Imfundo ibalulekile, futhi izinhlelo zokwelapha ezihlanganisa ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuxhaswa, nokubuyiselwa emsebenzini ziyaqhubeka. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele. Umhleli: Ngabe ubona ukuthi imithombo yezokuxhumana idlala indima ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Mnu. Mthethwa: Impela, imithombo yezokuxhumana inendima enkulu. Intsha ibona izithombe zokuphila okukhazimulayo, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni bacabange ukuthi izidakamizwa zingaba yindlela yokuphila. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokufundisa intsha mayelana nemiphumela emibi yokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Umhleli: Ngabe kukhona izindlela ezithile zokufundisa intsha ngalezi zinkinga? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izindlela eziningi zikhona. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokufundisa, izifundo ezikhethekile ezikoleni, kanye nemikhankaso yokuxhumana nabantu kungasiza kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi intsha ibone ukuthi kunezindlela eziningi zokuphila ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Umhleli: Ngabe ubona ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthola kanjani umphumela omuhle kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu. Ukuhlanganisa imizamo yokuxhasa intsha, ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kungasiza kakhulu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umhleli: Ngabe ungathanda ukwabelana ngeminye imibono yokugcina? Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa akuyona inkinga yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa kuyinkinga yomphakathi wonke. Sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Intsha iyigugu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza lokuyivikela. Ngiyabonga. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuxoxa. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngemicabango yakho. Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile.
Ukugonywa Kwezingane: Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokuvikeleka kwazo. Le nqubo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kudingeka yenziwe ngendlela efanele. Lapha sizobheka izinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokugonywa kwezingane, ukuze abazali nabakhulisa baqonde kahle izidingo zalesi simo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukubaluleka Kokugonywa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kungani ukugonywa kwezingane kuyingxenye ebalulekile. Lokhu kuvikela izingane ezimeni eziningi ezibuhlungu, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana kalula, njenge-measles, polio, ne-hepatitis. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugonywa kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, njengoba izingane ezivikelekile zinciphisa ukusabalala kwezifo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Ukuvakashela Kwezokwelapha Ngemuva kokuba uqonde ukubaluleka kokugonywa, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela ukuvakashela kudokotela. Kubalulekile ukuhlola abantwana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi baphila kahle ngaphambi kokugonywa. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, lapho udokotela ezobona khona ukuthi ingane ikulungele ukugonywa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhetha Uhlobo Lokugonywa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, udokotela uzokweluleka ukuthi yiziphi izigaba zokugonywa ezidingekayo, okuvamise ukuhluka kuye ngempilo yengane, ubudala, kanye nezimo zendawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazali baqonde lezi zigaba ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zithola ukugonywa okufanele. Isinyathelo 4: Ukugonywa Lapho sekufika isikhathi sokugonywa, kubalulekile ukuthi abazali bahlale bejabulile futhi bephumule, ukuze ingane ikhululeke. Udokotela uzobe eqinisekisa ukuthi ukugonywa kwenziwa ngendlela efanele, futhi abantwana kufanele bahlale bephumule ngemva kokugonywa ukuze bagcine impilo enhle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqapha Impilo Ngemva Kokugonywa Ngemva kokugonywa, kubalulekile ukuqapha impilo yengane. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi izimpawu ezithile, njengokukhwehlela, ubuhlungu besikhumba, noma ukungakhululeki, zingavela. Lokhu akukhathalekile, kodwa uma izimpawu ziba zimbi kakhulu, kufanele kube khona ukuvakashelwa kudokotela. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqinisekisa Ukugonywa Okuqhubekayo Ukugonywa akupheli ngemuva kokugonywa kokuqala. Abazali kufanele baqonde ukuthi kunezikhathi ezithile zokugonywa ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane ihlale ivikelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvakashela kudokotela ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zokugonywa zifeziwe. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Nabanye Abazali Ukuxhumana nabanye abazali kungasiza ekwaziseni kabanzi ngale nqubo. Abazali bangabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zithola ukugonywa okufanele. Lokhu kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, lapho bonke abazali bejolise ekugonyeni izingane zabo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Yokugonywa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuhlola imiphumela yokugonywa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi ingane isaphila kahle yini, nokuthi izimpawu zokugonywa zikhona yini. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzokwenza abazali bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane zabo esikhathini esizayo. Isiphetho Ukugonywa kwezingane kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekwakheni impilo enhle. Abazali kufanele baqonde kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zikhululekile futhi ziphilile. Ngokuqhubeka nokugonywa, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho izingane zethu zikhula ziqinile, ziphilile, futhi zikhululekile ezimeni ezimbi. Ukugonywa akuyona nje inqubo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuvikela ikusasa lezingane zethu.
Umbiko: Ukubhikisha Komphakathi Isingeniso Ukubhikisha komphakathi kube yinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonitshwa. Lezi zibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, njengokungabi khona kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuhlala, noma ukungabikhona kwezinsiza zempilo. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izimbangela, izindlela, kanye nemiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi, sihlole izimo ezithile ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Izimbangela Zokubhikisha Izimbangela zokubhikisha komphakathi zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu yikhono elingaphansi lokuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bavame ukuhamba phambili ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo uma izinsiza ezisemqoka zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala nezikahulumeni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubhekaneni nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngaphandle kokubandakanywa kwabo, lokhu kungaholela ekubhibhisheni. Izindlela Zokubhikisha Ukubhikisha komphakathi kudinga izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Ezinye izindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka phakathi kokuhlangana emihlanganweni, ukuhlela izinkulumo, nokwakha amaqembu okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo. Ezinye izibhikisho ziba nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba emigwaqweni, behlabelela, noma bephakamisa izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhalazo zabo. Lezi zindlela zikhombisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuzwana. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile, njengokwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha noma ukulungiswa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kubonisa ukuthi izwi labantu liyalalelwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komphakathi, lapho abantu bephikisana, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezimweni ezinzima. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhikisho zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwababhikishi nohulumeni. Izimo Eziyinhloko Zokubhikisha Kunezimo ezithile ezithinta ukubhikisha komphakathi ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Isibonelo, eMzanzi, izibhikisho ezivame ukwenzeka zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezingenazo izinsiza ezisemqoka, futhi lokhu kubangela ukunganeliseki okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emazweni athile, izibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinkinga zomnotho, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amathuba okusebenza awatholakali kalula. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukuze izibhikisho zibe nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwababhikishi nezikhungo zikamasipala. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana okuhle, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo ziyaqondwa. Izikhungo zikamasipala kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezivulekile zokwamukela izikhalazo, futhi zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuveza izinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha komphakathi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Izimbangela zokubhikisha zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izindlela zokubhikisha zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi imiphumela ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwababhikishi nezikhungo zikamasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zikhuluma, futhi abantu bathola izixazululo ezidingekayo. Ukubhikisha komphakathi akukhombisi nje ukunganeliseki, kodwa futhi kubonisa umoya wokuzwana nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu.
Izinkondlo: Umcimbi Wokubhalwa Kwezinkanyezi Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo uhlelwe ngempumelelo emzini omncane, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona njengemibala emihle ebhalwe phezulu. Umcimbi lo, owawuhlelwe ngothando, wawuhloselwe ukuvusa umoya wobuciko phakathi kwabantu, nokubavumela ukuba baveze imizwa yabo ngezinkondlo ezithokozisayo. Umsindo wezingoma ezithokozisayo wawuhamba emoyeni, uhlanganisa izwi lempilo nomoya wokudala. Ababhali bezinkondlo, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, babebuthene endaweni ethokomele, bejabulile futhi bephokophele ekubhaleni. Umoya wawugcwele ithemba, njengoba abantu bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkulumo zabo ezijulile. Umcimbi waqala ngenkulumo yokwamukela, lapho umholi wemboni, uMnu. Mthembu, ethula umqondo wokuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, izifiso, nezifundo ezitholakala empilweni. Wakhuthaza bonke abathandi bezinkondlo ukuba baveze imizwa yabo, baphinde bahloniphe izinkanyezi ezibhalwe emhlabeni. Ngemuva kwalokho, ababhali baphakanyiswa ukuba baveze izinkondlo zabo. Umoya wawugcwele ubuciko, njengoba izwi lethu lathokozisa izithameli. UThandi, owayebhalile izinkondlo ezimnandi, wakhuluma ngothando, wabelana ngezinkumbulo ezinhle, ezazithinta inhliziyo. Izinkondlo zakhe zazigcwele imizwa, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila. UPhumzile, owayebhalile izinkondlo ezithinta izinkinga zomphakathi, wakhuluma ngempilo yabantu abahluphekayo, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. Izinkondlo zakhe zazingezokukhumbuza, zikhombisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Abantu babemamatheka, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkulumo ezijulile. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkondlo zabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, njengoba ababhali bephakanyiswa ukuba baphendulane, babelane ngemicabango nemizwa. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wobuciko, kwenza umcimbi ube yimpumelelo enkulu. Ngemuva kokubhalwa kwezinkondlo, umcimbi waphothulwa ngengoma ethokozisayo, lapho bonke abathandi bezinkondlo behlanganyela. Umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubungane, nokuhlonipha. Izinkanyezi zazikhanya, zikhombisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana. Abantu babebuthene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi bephila ubuciko. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila, nokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, ubonisa ukuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma, zikhombisa imizwa, nezifiso. Abantu babebuthene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi, bephila ubuciko, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Umcimbi wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphothulwa, kodwa imizwa, izinkumbulo, nezinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya ezinkumbulweni zethu. Izinkondlo zaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila, nokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana.
Ubugebengu Emiphakathini: Iziphumo Nezindlela Zokulwa Nalesi Simo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubugebengu emiphakathini bukhula, buholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezithinta ubumpofu, ukuphepha, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezithile lapho izinga lokuhlala lisezingeni eliphansi, khona-ke abantu abanenkinga yokukwazi ukuthola imithombo yezimali ngendlela efanele. Ubugebengu buhlanganisa izinto eziningi, okubalwa kuzo ubugebengu obuvamile, ubugebengu obuphakathi, kanye nezinto ezithinta izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa. Ukwanda kwalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathekayo ukuze kubhekwane nezimbangela zazo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi uma imiphakathi inezinsiza ezanele, njengesikole, imisebenzi, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, kuba nokuncipha kwezinga lobugebengu. Kodwa-ke, lapho lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abantu bathola indlela yokuphila ngokungafanele, okwenza kube lula ukuba basemkhakheni wobugebengu. Esigabeni sokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubugebengu buvame ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezithile. Ngokuvamile, izigameko zobugebengu zenzeka lapho kukhona ukuwohloka kwemiphakathi, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezintweni ezinjengokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza zokuthuthukisa, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokungabi nabulungiswa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungabi nalwazi, okwenza abantu bazitholele izixazululo ezingekho emthethweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezisemadolobheni ziboniswa ngokuba nemisebenzi eminingi, kodwa futhi zikhumbula izingozi ezithile. Izindawo eziningi zinezikhungo zokuphila, kodwa uma kuhlangene nezinga eliphakeme lokuhlukunyezwa kanye nezifo ezithathelwana, izigameko zobugebengu ziba ziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane ukuze kudalwe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Esigabeni sesibili, kufanele sikhulume ngendima yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano zomphakathi, izikhungo zokusebenza, kanye neziphathimandla. Ukubambisana phakathi kwalezi ziqephu kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezinzima. Izinhlelo zokubambisana, ezinjengezinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi, zidinga ukusungulwa ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ukubambisana kwabo bonke abathintekayo, kusukela kumalungu omphakathi kuze kube sezikhungweni eziphezulu, kuyindlela ewusizo yokulwa nobugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphila eziphekwe kahle zingakusiza kakhulu ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Lokhu kuhilela ukwethula izinhlelo zokuqwashisa ezihlose ukufundisa abantu ngezingozi ezihambisana nobugebengu, kanye nezindlela zokuzivikela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula izinga lokuphepha emiphakathini. Esigabeni sokugcina, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abantu abahlala emiphakathini bangenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukuzibophezela kwabantu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Uma abantu behlanganyela, bakha imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane, basize omasipala, futhi babelane ngolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, obuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezinkingeni ezikhona. Ekugcineni, ukulwa nobugebengu emiphakathini akuyona into engathathwa kalula. Kudinga ubumbano, ukuzinikela, kanye nezinsiza ezanele. Umsebenzi wokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, enempilo, ungabhekwa njengomgomo ophambili. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudala izindawo eziphephile, ezikhululekile, nezithokozisayo, lapho wonke umuntu ezothola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ubugebengu buyinselele, kodwa kungenziwa ukuzama ukwenza ngcono izimo zempilo emphakathini.
Ibhokisi: Umsebenzi Wokuzikhandla Nendlela Yokuphila Ibhokisi, le midlalo ekhula ngokushesha emhlabeni, iyinsika empilweni yezinhliziyo ezilwela ukuphumelela, ukungenelela ezinkingeni, nokuqhubekisela phambili umphakathi. Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, ibhokisi liphinde libe umthombo wezimpendulo ezisheshayo kumaphuzu athile, kusukela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu siqu kuze kube ukwakha umphakathi ozinikele. Kulesi sihloko, ngizobalela izizathu engicabanga ukuthi ibhokisi lihlala libalulekile, ngisho nangemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okuningi. Ibhokisi, ngendlela yalo, akuwona nje umdlalo odlalwa ezinkundleni; uyindlela yokwakha isimo sengqondo, uthando, nokuzikhandla. Umdlalo ungumzila wezemidlalo ohuqulekile, ugqugquzela abantu ukuba baphumelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokuqonda izisekelo zebhokisi, umphakathi ubona okungagqugquzela ukusimama kwezobuchwepheshe bokufunda, njengokunciphisa umdlandla osheshayo emiphakathini eminingi. Ukwazi ukulwa kungathuthukisa impilo yomuntu siqu. Abadlali, ikakhulukazi, bahlala beqonda ukuthi izinhloso zifinyelelwa kanjani ngokusizana, ukusiza abanye, nokuthi kufanele baphawule ngalokho abakufunayo. Lokhu kwenza ibhokisi libe yinsiza futhi elibalulekile empilweni. Inselelo yokulwa, ukuhlose ukwakha izinzuzo, kanye nokulwela ukuphumelela, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga. Ubhokisi, ngokuhlanganyela, luqukethe izimfundiso ezifanele nezidingo zemvelo, hhayi nje zokuqhuma nesizathu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhokisi nemiphumela yalo iyakhanga kakhulu. Abantu abaningi basebenza njengeqembu, bejabulisa izidingo zomoya wezokuncintisana. Ibhokisi lidala ubudlelwane obusha nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abantu baqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela akulindelekile, kuchaza ukuthi kumele baziphathe kahle, baphinde bafunde kokubili ukuhamba phambili nokumba phansi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokunakekela, umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi umphakathi uyahlala unempilo. Kunoma yimiphi imidlalo, izici ezahlukene zithinta izinzuzo zomphakathi. Ibhokisi lihlala liphumelela kakhulu. Umphakathi uthola laba abakhumbula izimfundiso zabo. Ngisho nangesikhathi sokubi, ibhokisi lisiza abantu ukuthi bathole ukuvikeleka, ikakhulukazi abasha. Umphakathi uvuma ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze udale izikhathi ezibalulekile, futhi ibhokisi liphinde libakhumbuze ukufanelekela izimo ezinzima. Ukubuka ibhokisi, sibona ukuthi akukona nje ukuqhuma: kuyabhekwa izizathu ezinzima. Ukubamba iqhaza ebhokisini kuhlanganisa imizamo eminingi. Abadlali baphathwa ngokuqinile, bemukela ukuzenzakalelayo futhi befumana ukwesekwa komphakathi. Kuthuthuka ulwazi nokukhula, ngaphandle kokubandakanya ukuphazamiseka ngokuphelele. Ukubaluleka kobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu nempilo ibalulekile. Ibhokisi, njengoba sikhuluma, kuhlanganisa izinzuzo eziningi. Ngaphandle kwesimo sokukhuthazwa, abantu bayakwazi futhi bakhumbuleka. Uqaphela ukuthi akukona okuphikisanayo, kodwa kudinga umoya wokuthintana nokuxhumana. Ngaphezu komphakathi, ibhokisi linzima enhlosweni yokwakha izinganekwane. Uhlelo lwezokubambisana luhamba phambili olukhuthaza ukuhlela isikhathi esihlukile. Lokhu kuholela ekubumbaneni komphakathi onenqubekelaphambili, ukukhulisa indlela yokuphila ebumbene. Uhlanga lwezokuhlala lungabona izithiyo ezikhaliphile ezinqubeni zomphakathi. Njengoba kuncintisana, umoya uhlaselisa futhi ubudlelwane bukhula. Amaphuzu athuthukiswa kuhleke izimfanelo eziqinile zokuphila, futhi imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi ibhokisi lithuthukisa izimpendulo ezivamile zokuhlangana kwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhokisi liyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Kuyivulelekile, izinzuzo zayo zidalwa ngendlela ezinzima, futhi ithuthukisa izimpendulo zempilo zethu. Abasebenzisi bebhokisi basiza umphakathi ukuba uhlale umphakathi ophilayo, bazame ukufaka izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, ibhokisi akukhona okwenziwa kuphela; kuyisiqiniseko sokuba nezephula. Ukwengeza, ibhokisi liwakhiwe ezisizayo nezinsizakalo ezithinta abadlali, labanye abaphanda ezimbonini zempilo. Uma sigcina ibhokisi lisebenzisa zonke izinkulungwane zokubenga, imiphakathi izogqoka isigaba sokuphumelela. Ngokungazelelwe, ibhokisi lihlala liyo-aphenda elikhiphayo emphakathini, futhi izimpumelelo zitholakala kalula. Ngakho lo mdlalo weboka, ngaphakathi kwengqondo, usifundisa ukubona izinto ngcono. Yiqiniso, ibhokisi izovuma izinselelo ezibalulekile ukuze idalule okuningi empilweni. Akukho okujulile, futhi ibhokisi linomkhankaso oncomekayo, salt kanti umphakathi umele uzithathe kahle. Lokhu kusebenza kulesi sigaba, nakuba ifanele ukusiza abanye, ibhokisi yinto eyodwa egcwele izinkumbulo zezimfundiso.
Izikole Zikahulumeni Ingxoxo noMnu. Mthembu, Umphakathi Wabazali Uhlanga: Ngiyakwemukela, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngendaba ebalulekile — izikole zikahulumeni. Ngabe ungathanda ukusho okuthile ngalesi sihloko? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Izikole zikahulumeni zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ngoba ziwusizo ekufundiseni izingane zethu. Zihlinzeka ngokuqonda okujwayelekile, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni kubantu abaningi. Uhlanga: Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza kanjani? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza ngaphansi kukahulumeni, futhi zikhokhelwa nguhulumeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi abakhokhi imali yokufunda, okwenza kube lula kubazali abanemali encane. Izikole zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi zihlala zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono yokufunda. Uhlanga: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Kodwa-ke, kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezikole zikahulumeni, akunjalo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, impela. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizinsiza. Izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zibhekene nokushoda kwezinsiza ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi okufunda, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kungathinta ikhwalithi yemfundo ethola abafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole ezithile zihlala zikhungathekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali yokuphatha. Uhlanga: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, uhulumeni uhamba phambili ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuthuthukisa izikole. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa imali ethunyelwa ezikoleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabafundisi, kanye nokwakha izikole ezintsha ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezikole, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izifundo. Uhlanga: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyasiza. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zisebenzisana kanjani nomphakathi? Mnu. Mthembu: Izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zisebenzisana nomphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Abazali bavame ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izikole, futhi lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabazali, abafundi, nabafundisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zenza imicimbi yokubandakanya umphakathi, efana nemikhosi yokufunda, ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngempumelelo yezikole zabo. Uhlanga: Lokhu kubalulekile. Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile ezitholakala kubafundi abahamba ezikoleni zikahulumeni? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, izinzuzo ziningi. Abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Futhi, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ukufunda okujabulisayo, okwenza abafundi babe nentshisekelo yokufunda. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlanga: Ngabe ungakukhumbuza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zifaneleka kanjani kumphakathi? Mnu. Mthembu: Izikole zikahulumeni zifaneleka kakhulu kumphakathi, ngoba zenza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni. Zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono yokufunda, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, abazali, nabafundisi. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle. Uhlanga: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubazali nabafundi? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi abazali badinga ukuba bahlale bexhumana nezikole, futhi baphathe izikole zabo njengendawo yokukhula. Abafundi kufanele baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bazi ukuthi imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga. Uhlanga: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu. Lokhu kube ingxoxo ewusizo kakhulu. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Isiphetho Izikole zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi zidinga ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, abafundi, nabafundisi busekelwe ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuzinikela komphakathi wonke.
Izikhukhula Kwakukhanya emini, izinkanyezi zikhanye phezulu ezulwini, kodwa uThandi wayesebenza kanzima emakhaya. Wazi kahle ukuthi ngesikhathi sehlobo, imvula iyajuluka, futhi isikhathi sokuhlwanyela silindelekile. UThandi wayezama ukugcina umndeni wakhe uphila kahle, kodwa izimo zazingasebenzi kahle. Ngobusuku obuhlwanyelayo, isikhumbuzo senhlekelele sasilungiselela. Imvula eqhubekayo yavela, iphumela kwezintaba, iyokhukhula izindlela eziphakeme. UThandi noMama wakhe babecabanga ukuthi kuzoba nje imvula ejwayelekile, kodwa njengoba izinsuku zedlula, izimvula zanda, zikhanya kancane, zibe zinde. Umoya ubhuhudlile, izihlahla ziqhume, kuyacaca ukuthi into eyenzekayo ibikwenza kube nzima. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi waphuma emzini, ebona umfula ugeleza ngendlela engajwayelekile. Amathafa abebekade efuywa ngempumelelo, sephenduke izinkanyezi ezimnyama. “Mama, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuyinto engalungile,” kusho uThandi, ebukeka esaba. UMama wakhe wamaphakathi, emgibisela phansi, “Ngiyazi, mntanami, kodwa asikwazi ukulinda. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo.” Ngokushesha, umndeni wanquma ukulungisa izimpahla zabo, baphakamisa okuthile okubalulekile – ukudla, izingubo, nezithombe zokholo. UThandi wayezizwa edumele, ebona umhlaba wakhe uhlelekile usukhanya, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kufanele baqhamukele phezulu. Uthando kakhulukazi lwenza ukuba baphumelele. Izinsuku zedlula, imvula yayiqhubeka. UThandi noMama wakhe babebuka emihlanganweni yezakhamuzi, bejabulela ukubona abanye bezama ukuncedisa. “Siyafuna ukusiza,” kusho uMnumzane Khoza, ophakamisa isandla. “Kuyabakhona izikhumbuzo zalesi sikhathi, kodwa asikwazi ukukhipha imfudumalo yethu.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umfula waqhubeka nokugeleza, ugcwalisa izindawo ezizungezile. Leba impilo, izigameko zokuqala zenzeka – izindlu ezincane zibhakabhaka, izivunguvungu zimemeza, izinyoni zithokozisa izinsuku eziningi. UThandi noMama wakhe bahamba phezulu, behamba ngezinyawo, bezama ukufuna indawo ephephile. Lapho behamba, uThandi wabona umngani wakhe, uSipho, ehamba nathi. “Uthando lwakho lungaphola, kodwa izikhukhula zifuna uthando lwendlu,” kusho uSipho. UThandi wathi, “Kodwa yilokhu okwakuzokwenza sikhululeke.” USipho waphendula, “Ukwazi ukuyilungisa. Thina akufanele sikhohlwe isiko.” Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi, umfula wagcwala kakhulu, ugcwalise umhlaba. UThandi noMama wakhe bazama ukufuna indawo yokuphepha. Bafika endaweni eyaziwa kakhulu – umuzi owayekwa ngesisekelo sokholo, lapho abantu bezama ukusiza. “Hamba, mntanami,” kusho uMama, “siyakwazi ukusiza.” Ngaphambi kokuthi bakwazi ukufika, uThandi wabona ubuhle obuphuma phakathi kokukhanya. Ekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, waqala ukuhamba. “Sizoda,” kusho uMama, “ukuba sizoba semathafeni.” UThandi wayezwa umoya othokozisayo, kodwa umoya wawuthokozisa, wawufana nomkhumbi ophuma emanzini. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinde, umfula waqala ukuhamba phansi, izikhukhula zancipha. UThandi noMama wakhe babuyela emakhaya, behlola izimpawu zokuhlukana. Imizi yayingabikhona, kodwa umndeni wawukwazi ukuhlanganiswa. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba nokuqonda okukhulu – izikhukhula zingashiya umonakalo, kodwa uthando lwabo lungahlala luhlaza. Uthando lungaphola futhi lukhulise ubumnandi bempilo, noma ngabe izikhukhula zikhona. Umndeni wawubona izinto ezinkulu – uthando, umoya, nokuqonda. UThandi wagcina ebhalela incwadi, ethumele izinkanyezi, ezibhalwe ngothando futhi enobuhlakani. “Ngokubukeka, asikwazi ukulinda, kodwa sizokwazi ukuqhubeka.” Kanjalo, izikhukhula zashiya umhlaba, kodwa uthando lwaluhlala lukhona. UThandi noMama wakhe babuyela emakhaya, behamba ngezinyawo, beshaya izinkanyezi ezindaweni ezinhle. Umhlaba wawubumbene, kodwa uthando lwabo lwaluhambisana nabo. Ngaleyondlela, umndeni wathola impilo entsha, ithokozisa, futhi ubumnandi bephila. UThandi wathola ukuthi, ngisho nezikhukhula ezingavela, uthando luhlala lukhona, luhlaza njalo, futhi luzokwazi ukwandisa. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo empilweni yakhe, ukuthi isimo sabantu singaguquka, kodwa uthando lungahlala luhlaza. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nesikhathi sokukhumbula, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza izinto zibe ngcono.
Izinsiza Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Ukubaluleka Nobunzima Obubhekene Nabo Ezweni lethu, abantu abakhubazekile babhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukuphila, imfundo, nezinsizakalo. Ukuthi bangakwazi ukujabulisa impilo yabo ngendlela efanele, kudinga ukwesekwa okuhle nokufinyeleleka. Izinsizakalo zabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi olungile, ophumelelayo, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokwezinhlolovo zakrecent, kutholakele ukuthi umuntu omunye kwabahlala eNingizimu Afrika uyakhubazeka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona kufanele ziqinise ukwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile. Lezi zinsiza zifaka phakathi imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zempilo. Nokho, abavoti bangakhethi kahle izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi nokuqonda. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bangabantu abanelungelo lokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezahlukahlukene. Ngakho-ke, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi kumele bakhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezikhona. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqapha izinhlelo ezikhona, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zifinyeleleka kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinye izinsiza ezikhethekile zidinga ukusekelwa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ehloniphekile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo lusebenza kahle uma kuhlonishwa imibono yabantu abakhubazekile ngokwabo. Ukuze lokhu kuzuze abantu abakhubazekile, kubalulekile ukufaka phakathi imiphakathi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuyasiza ekwakheni izinsiza ezihambisanayo nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela imicimbi, imihlangano, kanye nemihlangano yokwazisa, ukuze abantu bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umphakathi udinga ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba okusebenza, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuzenzela. Izinkampani kumele ziqaphele ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bangaba nethalente elikhulu. Ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba bathole imisebenzi, kudala amathuba okuphila kahle, okwandisa umnotho wabo kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza zokwelapha kumele zibe khona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuhilela izikhungo zezempilo ezitholakalayo, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo edingekayo, kanye nokwelashwa okwenziwa ngodokotela abanolwazi. Ukuze kube nempilo enhle, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bezwakala. Izinsizakalo zezemfundo nazo zibalulekile. Abantu abakhubazekile kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezihlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zibe nezinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezinto zokufundisa ezivumelana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, abafundi abakhubazekile kumele bazi ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi banezinga elifanayo lokufunda. Noma kunjalo, abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi, ezivela emiphakathini yabo. Ukubandlululwa, ukungabi nalwazi, nokungafinyeleli ezinsizakalweni zikhona. Umphakathi kumele uqonde ukuthi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni akukhona okwenziwa kuphela nguhulumeni, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lukhona ukuze lweluleke abantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisa imfuno yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukugcina abantu benolwazi olufanele kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobungane. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele izinsizakalo ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukubambisana, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabantu abakhubazekile kufanele kube umgomo wethu, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ohlonipha, onobungane, futhi ophumelelayo kubo bonke. Ngokuhlanganyela, singenza umehluko empilweni yabantu abakhubazekile, sibavumele ukuba baphile impilo egculisayo, futhi baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukukhuthaza, kanye nokwakha izinsiza eziphathelene nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi wonke unendima yokudlulisela phambili lezi zinsiza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enempilo.
Amabhizinisi Amancane: Umqondo, Izimfanelo Nezindlela Zokuphumelela Amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho wanamuhla. Amaqhinga abo, izimfanelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela zihlala zikhuluma ngempumelelo emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle amabhizinisi amancane, kubalulekile ukuba siqale ngokuqonda umqondo wabo. Umqondo Wamabhizinisi Amancane Amabhizinisi amancane, ngokuvamile, abhekisela ezinkampanini ezincane ezisebenza ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe, imithombo, kanye nezisebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya izitolo ezincane, izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanye nezimboni ezincane. Ngokuvamile, amabhizinisi amancane ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo noma imikhiqizo ethile, enza kube lula kubantu bendawo ukufinyelela kulokhu abakudingayo. Izimfanelo Zamabhizinisi Amancane Okokuqala, amabhizinisi amancane ahlukaniswa ngezici ezithile. Zivame ukuba nezinga eliphansi lokuphathwa, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqumo ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi angakwazi ukusabela ngokushesha ezimfudlaneni zemakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba nekhono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende, njengoba umphakathi uvame ukuxhumana nabaphathi bawo. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kunciphisa ingozi yokulahlekelwa kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezinkulu, ezivame ukuba nezinselelo ezinzima uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bahlale bephila, futhi bahlale bephendula izidingo zemakethe. Izindlela Zokuphumelela Ukuze amabhizinisi amancane aphumelele, kudingeka izindlela ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ocacile. Lokhu kusho ukuba necebo eliqinile lokuthi umkhiqizo noma insizakalo izokwenziwa kanjani, kanye nezithiyo ezihlukene ezibhekene nalo msebenzi. Umqondo ocacile usiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuthi bahlale begxile futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokwakha umuzwa omuhle kumakhasimende. Ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende bungaholela ekutheni abantu babuyele futhi baphinde bathenge, okwandisa inzuzo yebhizinisi. Okwesithathu, ubuchwepheshe bukhona njengomngani omkhulu kumabhizinisi amancane. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokumaketha ku-inthanethi, kungasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi afinyelele emakethe enkulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele bahlale befundisa futhi bejwayela izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Izithiyo Ezingase Zibhekane Nezinhlelo Zokuphumelela Noma kunjalo, amabhizinisi amancane abhekene nezithiyo eziningi. Enye yezithiyo ezinkulu ukuhweba nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lezi zinkampani zinezinsiza eziningi, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane ukuba ancintisane ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nalwazi noma izinsiza ezanele zokuphatha ibhizinisi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi bazi izithiyo ezikhona futhi bazame ukuhlela izindlela zokuzigwema. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuqeqesha, noma ukuthola izeluleko kochwepheshe. Isiphetho Amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho, anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi akha umphakathi oqinile. Ukuze aphumelele, kudingeka ukuba abanikazi bawo babe nomqondo ocacile, bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende, futhi basebenzise ubuchwepheshe. Noma izithiyo zingase zibe khona, ubuchwepheshe, ulwazi, nokuzimisela kungasiza amabhizinisi amancane ukuba aphumelele, aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi akhuthaze umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sikhulise amabhizinisi amancane, ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu.
Ithenisi: Ingxoxo NoMfundisi Womjaho Wethenisi Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukwakha ingxoxo enomthelela noMfundisi uMnumzane Sipho Ndaba, ongumqeqeshi odumile emkhakheni wethenisi. U-Sipho unomlando ocebile emkhakheni wezokuzijabulisa, futhi sinesithakazelo sokuzwa izimvo zakhe mayelana nezimpilo zethenisi, amathuba, kanye nezinselelo ezihambisana nale midlalo. Umbuzo 1: Uthanda kanjani ithenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ithenisi, ngombono wami, iyimidlalo ethokozisayo kakhulu. Ikhulisa umqondo wokuncintisana, kodwa futhi ifundisa ubuchule bokubambisana, njengoba abadlali kufanele basebenzisane nabanye kumakhono abo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ithenisi iyindlela ephelele yokukhuthaza impilo enempilo, njengoba kudinga umzimba onempilo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokucabanga okuhle. Umbuzo 2: Uyini umthelela wethenisi empilweni yabantu? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ithenisi ithinta impilo yabantu ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, ithuthukisa impilo yomzimba. Abadlali badinga ukuba nekhono lokujabulela umzimba, kanti lokhu kusiza ekwakheni izindlela eziphusile zempilo. Okwesibili, ithenisi ifundisa ukuzethemba. Abadlali bahlala bephakathi kokuncintisana, futhi lokho kukhuthaza ukuzethemba, okubalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithenisi inikeza ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abantu, izigidi zabantu zidlala le midlalo emhlabeni jikelele, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano. Umbuzo 3: Yini oyicabangayo ngempumelelo yabantu abasha emkhakheni wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Kukhona amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kukhona nezinselelo. Abantu abasha baphokophele impumelelo, kodwa kudinga ukuzikhandla okukhulu. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zibalulekile, futhi abaqeqeshi kufanele babe nekhono lokuthuthukisa abadlali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela izinsiza ezifanele, njengemitholampilo, ubuchwepheshe bokuthuthukisa, kanye nemigomo eqinile, kuhlale kubalulekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, uma umphakathi ungabambisana ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinsiza, sizobona intuthuko enkulu. Umbuzo 4: Yini umthombo wokukhuthaza abantu abasha? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ngithanda ukuxoxa ngabadlali abavela ezimpilweni ezahlukene. Izindaba zabo zikhuthaza, njengokubona abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bephumelela. Ngitsho noMnqobi, umdlali owayevame ukujabulisa izithameli ngekhono lakhe. Ukubona abantu abasha bebona ukuthi banganqoba izithiyo eziningi, kuphakamisa umoya kubo.
