Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngikhuthaza abafuna ukulandela izinyathelo zabo ukuthi bangayeki. Umbuzo 5: Yini echaza ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile kumjaho wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ubuchwepheshe buphathelene nekhono lokuphatha umjaho, ukuqonda imithetho emisha, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele. Abadlali kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izindawo zedlalwa, bazi kahle izinqumo zabo, futhi babe nekhono lokulungisa imisebenzi yabo emjaho. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa nokuchithwa kwesikhathi, ngoba imidlalo ithatha isikhathi eside. Ubulili, ukuhlela, nokukhumbula ubuchule beqembu, kuyinto ebalulekile ukuze uthole impumelelo. Umbuzo 6: Uthanda kanjani ukuphatha umjaho wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ukuphatha umjaho wethenisi kudinga ukwazi kahle izimo zomjaho, futhi kusemqoka ukuba nekhono lokuphendula ngokushesha. Ngikholelwa ekwenzeni umjaho ube mnandi, kodwa futhi ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali bahlonishwa. Ukubambisana nabanye abaqeqeshi, ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, nokuxhumana nabadlali kubalulekile. Ngiyazama ukwenza imijaho ibe nesimo esijabulisayo, ngoba umjaho ophumelelayo ubalulekile empumelelweni. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga uMnumzane Sipho Ndaba ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi esihle. Ithenisi iyinsika yempilo, futhi ukuxoxa naye kudalile kuzo zonke izithameli zethu. Sinethemba lokuthi lezi ziqondiso kanye nemibono izokhuthaza abanye ukuba baqhubeke nokulandela amaphupho abo emkhakheni wethenisi. Kukhona amathuba amaningi, futhi abantu abasha kufanele bazitholele izindlela zabo. Ngibona umhlaba wethenisi uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi ukuphila okwenziwe ngothando lwethenisi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuqala Ukukhuluma Iziteleka zabasebenzi zibonisa ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu abavuma ukusebenzisana ukuze babheke izinguquko ezidingekayo emsebenzini. Lokhu akusikho nje ukukhala ngezinkinga, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Kuthiwani, kufanele kube nezindaba ezithakazelisayo? Ngabe zikhona izizathu ezinamandla zokuhlanganisa abantu? Ake siqale. Iziteleka zenzeka kakhulu uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi izimo zabo zokusebenza azihambisani kahle. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukunganeliseki ngemiholo, izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, noma ukungahambisani kahle nezinkambiso zomsebenzi. Abasebenzi bavame ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izwi labo liyasizwa, futhi lezi zinyathelo zingashintsha izinto ezinhlobonhlobo. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali, kodwa lokhu kukhombisa indlela abantu ababona ngayo imisebenzi yabo. Sikhuluma ngebhadi lapho iziteleka zenzeka khona. Kukhona imiqhudelwano eminingi, futhi iziteleka ezithinta abanye zisebenza ngokwezimiso ezithile. Uthando lwabantu emsebenzini lukhombisa izifiso eziphathelene nomsebenzi. Uhlelo lwezizwe lufuna ukusebenza kahle, kodwa ezimeni ezinzima, imizamo yesikhashana izobangela izinguquko. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bakhumbula ukuthi iziteleka zingaba yithuluzi eliqinile lokushintsha izimo. Abasebenzi bazama ukufakazela ukuthi izinguquko zidingeka. Kukhona abanye abathi, "Lokho akukhona konke," kodwa kukhona abaningi abavuma ukusiza. Siphinde sikhulume ngamasu abamemezeli beziteleka. Ubani ozokwazi ukuhola lo mzila? Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nomoya obambekayo, bezinikele, ukuze bathole umphumela ofanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bazama ukugcina izimpilo zabo zisebenza, nakuba bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Iziteleka azilingani; zikhona ezivamile nezizimele. Izinhlangano zisebenza lapho abanye bezama ukudlula emikhakheni, baphuma balwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuphila kokusebenza kukhona, futhi kuphila. Lokhu kuhlole izinzuzo zesikhathi esifushane, noma izimo ezithile. Ngokuqhubeka, sikhuluma ngamasu okuxhumana okukhuthaza abantu emsebenzini. Iqiniso ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zicacile, zifuna intshiseko, ziqhubekela phambili, futhi zikhuthaza abanye ukuba bawe, banakekele, nokuba bazimisele ekushintsheni. Uhlola Okwengeziwe: Ngabe imizamo yebhizinisi ibonakala? Abasebenzi baye baphawula noma kusezingeni elincane. Ngabe umphakathi ugcwele ubungqina bokusebenza kahle? Iziteleka zithinta abokuqala, nabanye, kubekwe phezulu izimo zempilo, umndeni, nempilo yomsebenzi. Uhlelo lwezeMali luhlobene nezinye izinkinga. Sidinga ukuzibuza: "Yini engase yenzeke?" Uhlelo lwezempilo lugcwele izinkinga ezikhulisa ithuba lokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sikhuluma ngokuqonda, sibhekelele imiphumela, nokuqonda izibalo. Abasebenzi bangase badlale indima, behluleka, bese bethi, "Ngabe lokho kuzoba ngcono?". Kukhona ezinye izikhathi lapho iziteleka zempilo zibalulekile ukuze kusize abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuziqukethwe emiphakathini, kwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamalungelo nezimfanelo zabasebenzi. Lokhu akukhona nje umqondo, kepha kube sisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza kwamaNingizimu, umoya wokuhlonipha nokubambisana kumasiko ambalwa. Ngakho, uma sicabangela iziteleka zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izingxenye ezihlukahlukene, ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umoya wabantu obambekayo ugcwele izinkinga eziningi. Ukugcina izinduna zibambisene, kabhe zinduna ibhizinisi akukona okokudala. Lokhu kucacile, abavoti bangasiza, futhi noma yikuphi ukuxhumana kuzodingeka ukuze kube nezinhloso ezithile. Ngakho, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyahlonishwa. Zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi kufanele benze imizamo yokwakha impilo engcono, bahlanganyele ezintweni ezikhaliphile, futhi bakhuthaze ukunqoba, okuveza okuningi. Lokhu kusenhla kwakho ukwakha udumo lwabantu abavuma ukuzama impi yokuhamba phambili. Ngakho, sithumeza izinsiza, sithumele ukuphikisana, ukuze uthole izinhlelo ezithinta wonke umuntu. Hamba phambili, hamba phambili!
Ukulahlwa Kwemfucuza Emphakathini Wethu Wanamuhla Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza sekuba yindaba ebalulekile emphakathini wethu, ethinta indlela esiphila ngayo. Njengoba umnotho uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela esiphatha ngayo imfucuza. Ukuze sifinyelele kuleli phuzu, umcimbi obalulekile uhlelelwe, uzobhekelwa izindaba eziphusile nemisebenzi yansuku zonke yokulahla imfucuza. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngeminikelo emisha yokugcina imvelo iphilile. Umcimbi uzoba ngosuku lwama-15 kuMsombuluko, phakathi nezinsuku ezinzima zomphakathi. Izivakashi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zikhona, kubalwa amalungu ezemvelo, izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza, nezikhungo zokucubungula imfucuza. Uhlelo lomcimbi luzoba nezinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe abahamba phambili, izibonelo zempumelelo, nezinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza abantu bathole ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezindlela zokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Umcimbi uzovulwa ngomlayezo ophakamisayo ovela kuNgqongqoshe Ophakathi kwezokuhlala nezokuthuthukiswa, ogcizelela ukwandiswa kokusebenza kwemihlangano eminingi kumaphrojekthi ahlakaniphile aqhubekayo. Ngokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano, izinkampani ezithintekayo zathola ithuba lokukhulisa ukusebenza kwayo ukuze kulahlwe imfucuza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlale kukholisa imiphakathi eminingi, ikakhulukazi lezo ezixhomekeke emithonjeni yemali engapheli. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, abantu bazothola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ezinsizeni ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukubona izindinganiso ezintsha zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, ukuzithokozisa izinkampani ezenza kahle emkhakheni, nokubandakanya izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imiphakathi yabo. Izinkampani ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ubuhlakani obuhle kulabo abayibambeleyo, zifundisa ngokubaluleka komsebenzi wazo ekuhlaliseni izinhlelo ezifanele. Umcimbi uzophela ngenkulumo ebalulekile, ekhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza. Lokhu kuhlakanipha kuzokwenza sithathe izinyathelo ezinkulu zokuqinisa ukuqwashisa kulabo abathintekayo. Ukuhlanganyela emkhankasweni wokulahla imfucuza kuzothuthukisa ukuzibandakanya kwendoda, umndeni, nomphakathi, ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Umcimbi uzokwakha ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi kanye nemikhiqizo efanele yokulahlwa kwemfucuza, okuzolekelela ukumiselwa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo ezinzile zomphakathi, nokunciphisa umphumela omubi wemfucuza. Izinhlaka ezahlukene, kokubili ezizimele nezomphakathi, zizodingeka zixhumane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukulatshwa kwempilo yomphakathi kuyathuthuka. Egunjini okukhuluma iziphakamiso zengqalasizinda, abaphathi bamaphrojekthi bazokwazi ukuhlaziya izindlela ezivele zaba nemiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuzobhekelwa izindlela ezifanele, futhi umphakathi uzothola imiqondo emisha mayelana nezinsiza ezisemphakathini. Kumqoka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi olunye usizo lutholwa ngokuxhumana namaphakathi, izici eziphathelene nokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwamalunga omphakathi nezinhlaka zomphakathi kuzolekelela ukudala isizwe esinempilo, esimnandi, futhi esithuthukayo. Inhloso yokugcina yomcimbi uwukuhlonipha imvelo, ukuqinisekisa ikusasa elihle, nokwakha imiphakathi edidiyelwe. Izinhlelo zokulahlwa kwemfucuza ezisebenzayo zizobaluleka ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, othuthukayo, nonobala, ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle. Umcimbi uphakamisa umqondo wokujabulela ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani, ukuze siqhamuke nesixazululo esiqinile nesokuziphendulela. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wokulahlwa kwemfucuza uzothuthukisa indlela esibuka ngayo imfucuza, okuzomelapha imiphakathi yethu nezizwe. Ubuchwepheshe obunikeza izixazululo ezinhle kumkhakha wobuchwepheshe kuzolekelela ukuphucula ubudlelwano bethu nezimpilo zethu, ukuphuhlisa imiphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi imvelo yethu iyaphumelela. Kumele sikhulume, sixhumane, futhi sizame ngaphezu kokulindela, sifune izixazululo ezilisekelo ezinezindleko eziphansi unyaka wonke.
Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Umqondo Wami Ukuthutha abantu emigwaqweni ziningi izindlela ezahlukene, kodwa ukusebenzisa amatekisi kungokwesikhathi esiningi okuthandwa kakhulu. Amatekisi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamaphuzu amaningi abantu, izindawo zokuhlala, nezindawo zokusebenza. Nokho, le ndlela yokuhamba akuyona engaphazamiseki, futhi izinkinga ezithile zikhona, okuyizinto esizodinga ukuzihlonza ukuze sithuthukise lesi sikhala. Okokuqala, sizobhekana nenkinga yokuphepha. Kulula kakhulu ukuba abashayeli bamatekisi babe nezimo ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungaziphathi kahle. Izingozi zenzeka njalo emgwaqeni, futhi abanye abashayeli bangase baqhubeke bephula imithetho yokuhamba, bephulaphula imiyalelo yabezimo. Lokhu kudala ukungathembeki phakathi kwabakhweli, nabanye bethu balapho beziphatha ngendlela enobungozi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqinise izinqubo zokuhlola abashayeli bamatekisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabakhweli. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngezindleko. Amatekisi angabiza kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma uhamba ibanga elide. Lokhu kudala ukuthi abanye abantu bacabangele ezinye izindlela zokuhamba, njengokuhamba ngezinyawo noma ukuhamba ngama-bus. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza abakhweli, kodwa futhi kudala umbandela omubi phakathi kwabantu nabezokuthutha. Ukungabi nezindleko ezikhangayo kungaholela ekutheni abantu bangazethembi imoto ye-taxi, baphinde baphinde bacabangele izinketho eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuphepha nezindleko, kudingeka kuphathwe kahle udlame lwezinkampani ezithengisa amatekisi. Abanye abashayeli bamatekisi basebenzisa izindlela ezingezinhle ukuze bathole amakhasimende, okuhlanganisa ukwehlisa izindleko noma ukusebenzisa izikhangiso ezididayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abashayeli bethola inzuzo encane, futhi abakhweli bahlushwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile neziphumelelayo zokuphatha amatekisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bathola okungcono. Ngokweqile, sizobona izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabakhweli nabashayeli. Abashayeli abaningi bahlala belahlekile emigwaqweni ezingaziwa, noma behamba imizila engalungile. Lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu, okwenza abakhweli bahlupheke. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezizolekelela abashayeli ukuthi bathole indlela engcono yokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba, kanti abakhweli bazoba nekhono lokufinyelela izindawo zabo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, udaba lokungabi nezinhlaka ezithuthukayo emadolobheni nasemadolobheni kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Emiphakathini eminingi, imigwaqo ayihambisani nezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuthuthweni kwabantu. Ngaphandle kokuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo, izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zizoqhubeka. Umphakathi udinga ukubambisana neziphathimandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zokuthutha zikhona futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zidinga ukwelashwa okuphumelelayo. Ukuphepha, izindleko, ubudlelwano, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhweli bazithokozela izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Umphakathi, abashayeli, nezinkampani kumele basebenzisane ukuze uthuthukiswe isimo sokuhamba. Ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, kudingeka sizame ukuzithuthukisa, sibe nemigomo eqondile, futhi sihlale sithembekile ezinkampanini zethu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela isimo sokuhamba ngamatekisi, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuhamba kalula, ngokuphepha, nangemali engafaneleki.
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Impumelelo Ngezingozi Izitolo ezinkulu, noma okuthiwa ama-supermarkets, zifaka isandla esikhulu empilweni yabathengi emiphakathini yethu yanamuhla. Ziqukethe imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kusukela kokudla kuya ezimpahleni zokuhlobisa, futhi zenza kube lula ukuthenga izinto eziningi endaweni eyodwa. Nokho, lezi zitolo zinezinzuzo eziningi, kepha futhi zikhona nezingcuphe ezidinga ukucutshungulwa. Okokuqala, izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza umnotho. Ngokuvamile, zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini, zenza kube nezinkampani ezincane ezithola ithuba lokubambisana nazo. Lokhu kudala umnotho ophilayo, lapho abantu bethola imisebenzi, futhi izinkampani ezincane zikwazi ukuhweba kalula. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izitolo ezinkulu zishintsha indlela abantu abathenga ngayo, zinciphisa isikhathi sokuthenga. Abathengi bangathola imikhiqizo abayidingayo ngokushesha, futhi ngokuvamile, ngamanani aphansi ngenxa yokuncintisana okuvela kwamanye ama-supermarkets. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle kwalezi zitolo. Njengoba zikhula, zenza kube nzima ezitolo ezincane ukusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwezinkampani ezincane, okukhathaza umphakathi. Izitolo ezincane ziwumthombo obalulekile wezimpahla ezikhiqizwa endaweni, futhi zihlala zixhasa umnotho wendawo. Uma izitolo ezinkulu ziqhubeka nokuthandwa, izitolo ezincane zingase ziqhubeke zishabalala, zishiya izindawo eziningi zinganawo amathuba okuthenga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitolo ezinkulu zinezinye izingozi. Ukuphathwa kwazo ngokuvamile kuncike ekuthengisweni kwemikhiqizo ethile, okungaholela ekugcineni kokuhlukumeza umkhiqizo. Imikhiqizo eminingi etholakala ezitolo ezinkulu ivame ukuba nezinga eliphansi lokuhlola, futhi lokhu kungaba nomphumela omubi empilweni yabathengi. Abathengi bangase baziqhenye ngentengo ephansi, kodwa baphuthelwe ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswa kulezi zitolo ingase ingabi nekhwalithi efanele. Izinselelo zezempilo nezingxaki zezemvelo nazo zikhona. Izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo eminingi engokwemvelo, okungaholela ekwandeni kokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Imikhiqizo enezithako eziluhlaza ivame ukungatholakali kalula, kanti izinkampani ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa imikhiqizo enezithako ezinemiphumela emibi empilweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuba abathengi babe qaphelisise, bazi ukuthi yini abayithengayo, futhi baqiniseke ukuthi bayazithokozisa ngemikhiqizo abayithengayo. Ngokuphetha, izitolo ezinkulu zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi. Zithuthukisa umnotho, zenza kube lula ukuthenga, kodwa zinezingcuphe eziningi ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bahlale beqaphile, bazi kahle ukuthi yini abayithengayo, futhi basekele izitolo ezincane ukuze bagcine umnotho wendawo uphilile. Ukwazisa konke okutholakalayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusezitolo ezinkulu noma ezincane, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle, kanti kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wethu. Uthando lokusebenzisana phakathi kwezitolo ezinkulu nezincane lungaholela ekutheni umphakathi ube namandla, ube nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi ube nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Izitolo ezinkulu zigcwalisa izinsizakalo eziningi, kodwa kumele sibe nabalindeli, siqaphele, futhi sikhuthaze umphakathi wethu.
Amahlathi: Ubukhulu Babo Ekuphileni Komhlaba Isingeniso Amahathi, lezo zindawo ezigcwele izihlahla, ziningi kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile kwi-ecosystem. Ziyindawo ethokomele yokuhlala izilwane, zikhuthaza inhlanzeko yomoya, futhi zifaka isandla ekulondolozeni amanzi. Kodwa njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izingozi kubantu nezinhlobo eziphilayo zingazala umonakalo omkhulu kumahlathi. Kule ndaba, sizabheka ukubaluleka kwamaahlathi, izinselelo abhekene nazo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulondolozwe lezi zindawo ezisemqoka. Indima YamaHlathi Ekuhlaleni Amahathi ayilondolozo lesimo, anikela ngokuphila kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ikhaya lezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezimila, amahlathi anikezela ngamaconsi amasha, uthuli lwezulu, kanye nezinsiza zokufuywa kwezilwane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlathi asiza ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komoya, njengoba izihlahla zithatha umoya-mpilo futhi zikhulula i-oxygen. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu avikelekile ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Umphakathi wasezindaweni ezithintekayo amahlathi angama-hassoll, imvuselelo ye-ecosystem, phakathi kokuphila komuntu. Abalimi, abavukuzi, nababhizi bathing odliwa ibangawo ngokuphuza izimpande. Ngakho-ke, kukhuthazwa ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke unakekela amahlathi, ngoba lokhu kuzokwakha ikakhulukazi umnotho wendawo. Izingozi Zokonakala KwamaHlathi Nokho, amahlathi abhekene nezimo ezinzima. Ukugugulelwa kwamahlathi nokuwahlakulela kuchaphazela izilwane nezitshalo. Lokhu kudalwa kekhulu yizimo ezinjengokulungiselela umhlaba wokuhlala, izinhlelo zokwakha, nemisebenzi yokuphuza phansi. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ukuthi umehluko uyahluka, ikhono lezemvelo lincipha, futhi izindlu zezilwane zishabalala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakhiwa kwezimboni nezindawo zokuhlala zenza ukwanda kokungcoliswa kwendawo. Uhlanga luhlala lungakhuli kahle, ezomnotho zinyuka, kodwa lokhu kulimaza imvelo. Okuningi kokwehlisa amanzi kuphinde kunciphise izinsiza ezingokwenkolo obalulekile kumahlathi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukwakhiwa okufanele kwamasiko. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Amahlathi Ukuze kuvinjezelwe lo mthelela, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela amahlathi. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, uhulumeni, nezakhamizi zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amahlathi asukuma. Imikhankaso yokulondolozwa kwezindawo ezisemqoka iyahlomula, futhi izinhlelo zokuphila, ezifana nezokufuywa kobungane nemihlangano nemphakathi, ziye zakhuliswa. Abantu basezindaweni ezithintekayo baphinde bahlomulelwe kwi-international partnerships ezilwela ukuhlanza amahlathi. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kuyasiza ukudala izinkumbulo ezinhle ngezinhloso zokuvikela amahlathi. Ukubuyiselwa kwemithombo emisha, kunciphisa ukwenziwa kwezimbiwa, futhi kuvula ithuba lokwakha izifundo ezingcono kumahlathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isiphetho Ngokudabuka, amahlathi ayizikhumbuzo zemvelo nezenhlalakahle. Ziyingxenye ebalulekile yomhlaba wethu, futhi ukuzikhumbuza ngempilo yazo kuyasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizophila izizukulwane ezizayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke siqinisa imizamo yethu yokuvikela amahlathi, ukuze siqhakambise ubungane nempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaleso sikhathi, singahamba nendlela yokulondolozwa kwesimo somhlaba, sazi ukuthi amahlathi ayindawo ephilayo eyiyo zonke inhlangano zethu.
Umculo we-Hip Hop: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini umculo we-Hip Hop? Umculo we-Hip Hop ungumkhakha wezokungcebeleka odume kakhulu emhlabeni. Uqukethe izici ezintathu ezisemqoka: i-rap, i-DJing, kanye ne-beatboxing. Lo mculo uqala ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1970 eUnited States, ikakhulukazi eBronx, New York. Kwaba khona abantu abaninzi abashisa izikhotha, bephuma nezinhlobo ezintsha zomculo, besebenzisa izinto ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza umculo we-Hip Hop wahluka? Umculo we-Hip Hop uhluke kakhulu kwezinye izinhlobo zomculo ngenxa yokugxila kwawo ekwabelaneni ngezindaba zomphakathi, ezombusazwe, nempilo yabantu. Abaculi bavame ukusebenzisa izinkulumo ezinzima, bephakamisa izinkinga ezifana nobandlululo, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile emphakathini. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izici ezibalulekile zomculo we-Hip Hop? Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta umculo we-Hip Hop. Okokuqala, i-rap, okuyindlela yokucaphela, igxile ekwakheni izinkulumo ezihamba phambili, ezinezithako ezibhalwe phansi. Okwesibili, i-DJing, ihlanganisa ukusebenzisa amadivaysi ahlukahlukene ukufaka ama-sample, ukudlala imisindo, nokwakha ama-beats. Okwesithathu, i-beatboxing, ingenye yezindlela zokwakha umculo usebenzisa imisindo yomlomo kuphela, okwenza kube nenhlonipho enkulu emculweni. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izimpumelelo zabadlali be-Hip Hop? Abaculi be-Hip Hop, njengokuthi u-Tupac Shakur, Notorious B.I.G., kanye no-Jay-Z, bahlala bephumelela ezinhlelweni ezihamba phambili. I-Hip Hop izuze udumo olukhulu, futhi abanye bayo babeqhamuka nezinkanyezi ezingama-global. U-Tupac, ngokwesibonelo, ungomunye wabaculi abanethonya elikhulu, njengoba engakha izinkanyezi ezihlala zikhumbuleka kuzo zonke izizukulwane. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube namandla? Umculo we-Hip Hop unamandla okukhuthaza abantu, uvuselela imicabango, futhi uthinta imizwa. Ucabanga ngezinto ezinjengobandlululo, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zezenhlalo, okubenza abantu bazi ukuthi abakhuluma ngokwabo. Lokhu kwenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe i-Hip Hop iyathuthuka? Yebo, umculo we-Hip Hop uyathuthuka njalo. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, imikhuba nezitayela ziguquka, kanti abaculi basha baveza izimvo ezihlukahlukene. I-Hip Hop isiphenduke uhlobo oluhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezivela emhlabeni wonke, ezifana ne-Afrobeat, Trap, kanye ne-Lofi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo we-Hip Hop ungahlanganisa izici eziningi ezivela ezizindeni ezihlukene. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani nge-Hip Hop eNingizimu Afrika? ENingizimu Afrika, i-Hip Hop ithole ukwamukelwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha. Abaculi abanjengo-K.O., Cassper Nyovest, no-Nasty C bathole udumo, futhi bakhuthaza abanye abaculi ukuba baveze izimvo zabo. I-Hip Hop eNingizimu Afrika ibhalwe ngesiZulu, isiXhosa, nangezinye izilimi zendawo, okwenza kube nethonya elikhulu emiphakathini. Umbuzo 8: Yini ebalulekile kubaculi be-Hip Hop? Kubaculi be-Hip Hop, kubalulekile ukuveza izinkinga nezizathu ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhuthaze abanye, futhi bakhombise ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphumelela nokwenza inguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubambisana phakathi kwabaculi, kanye nezinhlangano zomculo, kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuqhakamiseni umculo we-Hip Hop. Umbuzo 9: Uhlelo lwezikhumbuzo nezifundo ezihlobene ne-Hip Hop? Izikhumbuzo ze-Hip Hop zibandakanya imicimbi, izifundo, kanye nezingqungquthela ezihlobene nomculo. Izifundo ze-Hip Hop zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, kanti umnotho wabo uhamba phambili. Lokhu kudalaithuba lokuthi abaculi baqondise izifundo, bazifundise, futhi bakhuthaze abanye. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo kwi-Hip Hop? Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi umculo we-Hip Hop uzobamba iqhaza elikhulu esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abaculi bazoba namathuba amaningi okukhulisa umculo wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-Hip Hop uzoba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane, uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngokuhlanganisa izimpendulo kulolu hlobo, umculo we-Hip Hop ubonisa ukuthi ungumculo owaziwayo, ophumelelayo, futhi obalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ungaqhubeka nokuhlola leli khanda elikhulu, uthole imikhuba emisha, futhi uhlole izindaba ezithinta umculo we-Hip Hop.
Umbiko NgamaMamelodi Sundowns Isingeniso AmaMamelodi Sundowns, eqembu elidumile lemidlalwano yebhola eliseGauteng, eNingizimu Afrika, ligama elaziwayo hhayi kuphela ezweni, kodwa nakwamanye amazwe. Leli qembu, elasungulwa ngo-1965, selidale igama elihle emlandweni wombhoxo, libe nomthelela omkhulu kumphakathi nasemidlalweni jikelele. Ngomlando walo ogcwele impumelelo, amaSundowns abhekwa njengelinye lamakilabhu aphambili e-Afrika. Umgomo Nokuqhuba AmaMamelodi Sundowns ahlale enezinga eliphakeme emqhudelwaneni wePremier Soccer League (PSL), njengoba liphumelele isicoco sePSL ezinyangeni eziningi. Umdlalo wabo omkhulu, owaziwa ngothando ngegama elithi "Masandawana", uphumelele izicoco eziningi, okuhlanganisa neTelkom Knockout, iNedbank Cup, neCAF Champions League. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabo nokuqina kwabo emdlalweni. Ukuthuthukiswa Kweqembu Ukuze amaSundowns agcine izinga eliphezulu, abaphathi beqembu benze kahle ekukhetheni abadlali, begxila ekwakheni ithimba elinamandla. Abadlali abanjengoBongani Zungu, Percy Tau, noMosa Lebusa baye bathuthukisa umphakathi weqembu, baphinde banike umthelela omuhle emnothweni. Umdlali oncomekayo, uPeter Shalulile, ubukeka njengomfanekiso omuhle, njengoba ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni zokuhlangabezana nezinhloso zeqembu. Imiphumela Nezibalo Ngokubhekisisa ezibalweni, amaMamelodi Sundowns abamba izikhala eziphezulu kwiPSL. Njengoba uhlu lwezibalo luyaqhubeka, leli qembu lidlale imidlalo engama-30, linqoba imidlalo engu-20, liphinde libe nezinkanyezi eziyisithupha emidlalweni engama-10. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi bahlala benza kahle, baphinde banikeze umphakathi izizathu zokujabula. Isiko Nempumelelo AmaMamelodi Sundowns akhombisa isiko elihle, lapho abadlali, abaphathi, nabalandeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Uhlanga lwezikhathi ezikhethekile, lapho abadlali behlonishwa khona ngempumelelo yabo, lubalulekile. Ukuhamba phambili kwabo emqhudelwaneni, kunikeza igunya elikhulu kulabo abalandela ibhola, kwazise abanye bahlala bezilungiselela ukujabulisa abalandeli. Ikhono Lokuphatha Abaphathi beqembu, ikakhulukazi uPitso Mosimane, benze imizamo emikhulu yokuthuthukisa amaSundowns. Uqinisekisile ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zisebenza kahle ukuze kugcinwe ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabadlali nokuqanjwa kwezindlela ezintsha zomdlalo. Lokhu kuphumelela kwesikhala sokuphatha kudlale indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni amaSundowns abe qembu elihloniphekile. Ukujabulisa Abalandeli Abalandeli beMamelodi Sundowns bangabantu abanjalo, behlale beseka iqembu labo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi imiphumela ibukeka kanjani. Ukubamba imicimbi ehlukene, njengezikhumbuzo zomphakathi, kuhlobene nokubaluleka kokuba nemiphakathi eqinile, nokuxhasa abadlali ngesikhathi somsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweqembu nabalandeli. Isiphetho AmaMamelodi Sundowns aqhubeka nokuba ngempumelelo enkulu, ebonisa isibindi, ubuchule, nokuzinikela emqhudelwaneni. Ngokusebenza kanzima, izinqumo ezicacile, nezinsizakalo eziyinkanyezi, leli qembu liqhubeka lishaya izinhlelo eziphakeme zokudlala. Ngaphandle kokubhaliswa kwezikhalazo, amaSundowns ayisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi, ubudlelwano, nokuba neqhaza emiphakathini kungaba namandla amakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile emhlabeni wombhoxo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, amaMamelodi Sundowns azohamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika, futhi sizobona impumelelo yabo eminyakeni ezayo. Hamba uMasandawana!
Izinkinga Nezinzuzo Zezokumbiwa Phansi Ezokumbiwa phansi, noma mining, yinkambu ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezomnotho. Isebenzisa izinsiza eziningi, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, nezokuthutha. Nokho, le mikhakha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezibandakanya ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukushoda kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sithole izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nezokumbiwa phansi. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngezinsiza ezitholakala ezokumbiwa phansi. Izinsiza ezifana negolide, insimbi, amalahle, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka zitholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene zokumbiwa. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngempahla ezidingekayo emikhakheni eminingi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha izindlu, izimoto, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, ezokumbiwa phansi zidlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho, ikakhulukazi ezwenikazi elikhulayo. Nokho, nakuba izinzuzo zikhona, kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nezokumbiwa phansi. Okwokuqala, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kuyinkinga enkulu. Ukuhamba kwezimayini kuholela ekutheni umhlaba ungcoliswe, amanzi angcoliswe, futhi umoya ungcoliswe. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu izilwane nezitshalo, futhi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezindawo zokuhlala ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi bahlaselwa yizinkinga zempilo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa. Okwesibili, ukushoda kwezinsiza kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Njengoba izinsiza zikhula, kuthiwa ziya ngokuya zincipha. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezindleko eziphezulu zokuthola lezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubathengi nabakhiqizi. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwentengo yezimpahla, okuthinta umnotho jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokumbiwa phansi zihlala ziphakathi kwezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu, ezifana nokuphazamiseka kwemiphakathi, ukulahleka kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bayaphila kahle, kudingeka izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhumbule kuphela izinkinga. Kukhona nezindlela zokwenza kube ngcono. Izinkampani ezibamba izokumbiwa phansi zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izinqubo ezihlanzekile zokumbiwa, kanye nokuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela emibi incishiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zingasebenzisa izinsiza eziphindaphindwayo ukuze zinciphise ukuncika kuzinsiza ezinzima. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Ngokuphetha, ezokumbiwa phansi zinezinsiza eziningi ezibalulekile, kodwa zinezingqinamba ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise le mikhakha, sigcine imvelo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi baphila kahle. Ngaleyo ndlela, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo emhlabeni, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo noma impilo yabantu. Izokumbiwa phansi ingaba yinsiza enkulu, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.
Ibhokisi: Indaba Yomphakathi Ekuqaleni, emzaneni omncane ogama lakhe linguMkhumbane, kwakukhona umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abanesithakazelo esikhulu emidlalweni. Phakathi kwabo, kwakukhona uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyi-16, owayenothando olukhulu lokubhokisa. U-Sipho wayehlala ebuka ama-video abhokisi abavela emhlabeni jikelele, efisa ukuba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. U-Sipho wayengakaze abhokise, kodwa wayenokholo olukhulu. Ngosuku oluthile, uSipho wahlangana noMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumqeqeshi odumile emzaneni. UMnumzane Mthembu wayenolwazi olunzulu ngalesi sikhathi, futhi wayephokophele ukufundisa abantwana abasha. U-Sipho wathola ithuba lokuhlangana naye, wakhuluma ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa. “Ngicela ungifundise, Mnumzane,” kusho uSipho, enesibindi. “Ngifuna ukuba ngcono, ngifuna ukuba umbhokisi ophumelelayo.” UMnumzane Mthembu wamomotheka, wathi: “Kulungile, Sipho. Kodwa kufanele uqonde ukuthi ibhokisi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili. Kufanele ufunde ukuzithiba, ukuzinikezela, nokusebenza kanzima.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waqala ukuqeqeshwa. Waqala ukufunda izisekelo, izikhumbuzo, nezindlela zokubhokisa. Ngemva kwezinyanga eziningana zokuzikhandla, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emncintiswaneni wendawo. Kwakuyinsuku enkulu, futhi wonke umphakathi wawubheke phansi. U-Sipho wayezizwa ethokozile, kodwa futhi ethukile. Wazi ukuthi umphakathi wawulindele kuye, futhi wayefuna ukwenza kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuncintisana, uSipho waphuma emkhakheni, waphuma phambili, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu. Waqala ukulwa nomphikisi wakhe, uThabo, owayedume kakhulu. UThabo wayenamandla, kodwa uSipho wayenothando olukhulu lokuwina. U-Sipho wakhumbula izifundo zikaMnumzane Mthembu, wathola amandla okuphumelela. Waqhubeka nokulwa, waphumelela, futhi ekugcineni, wathola umqhele. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi emzaneni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuwina, uSipho waphinde wahlangana noMnumzane Mthembu. “Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane. Ngaphandle kwakho, ngingase ngingaphumelelanga,” kusho uSipho, enomusa. UMnumzane Mthembu wamomotheka, wathi: “Uphumelele ngenxa yokusebenza kwakho kanzima, Sipho. Khumbula, ibhokisi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili, kodwa futhi ukufunda nokukhula.” U-Sipho waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, futhi waba umqeqeshi wezizukulwane ezilandelayo. Wafundisa abanye abantwana emzaneni wakhe, wabelana ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma uzikhandla, ungafeza amaphupho akho. Ngaleso sikhathi, ibhokisi lathola ukubaluleka okukhulu emzaneni. Kwakungesikhathi sokuhlangana, sokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. U-Sipho, njengomqeqeshi, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, futhi umphakathi waba namandla. U-Sipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuncintisana emhlabeni jikelele. Wazithokozisa, waphumelela, futhi waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Kodwa akazange akhohlwe umphakathi wakhe, futhi njalo wabuya emzaneni, efundisa abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ibhokisi akukhona kuphela umjaho, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Wafundisa abanye ukuthi ibhokisi lidinga uthando, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza kanzima. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi engapheli. Ngakho-ke, ibhokisi lathola ukubaluleka okukhulu emzaneni, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma uzikhandla, ungafeza amaphupho akho. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo, ethokozisa abanye ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa.
Ithelevishini Ngaphakathi kwendawo ethokomele, uMnumzane Mthembu wayehlezi phansi, ebuka ithelevishini yakhe entsha. Uthanda kakhulu ukubukela izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa okwakumjabulisa kakhulu yizinhlelo zomculo. Ngenkathi ebuka, izigigaba zempilo zazingena emhlabeni wakhe, zimenza azizwe engakude nezinye izindawo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwaluhambisana nokuhlaziya izimo zempilo zabantu abahlukene. Ngelinye ilanga, uMthembu wabona isikhangiso sehlelo olusha olwakhiwe ngamahlaya. Wayezwa abantu besho ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa impilo yansuku zonke, zibhakabhaka phakathi kwezinkinga ezijwayelekile, kodwa zikhombisa futhi indlela yokuhlekisa ngazo. Waqala ukubuka, futhi wathola ukuthi uhlelo lwaluhlukile. Abalingisi babebonisa izimo ezijabulisayo, futhi uMthembu wathola ukuthi uhleka kakhulu, okwenza abe nesikhathi esihle. Ngemva kokubuka lezi zinhlelo, uMthembu waphupha ngokwakha uhlelo lwakhe. Wayefisa ukwabelana ngempilo yakhe nabanye, nokuthi abanye bakwazi ukujabulisa abantu ngendlela efanayo. Waqala ukuthola izindlela zokwakha uhlelo olwakhe. Wafuna abalingisi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene, ababe nemicabango ehlukene, ukuze baveze izimo ezihlukile zempilo. Ngesikhathi esebenza ngalesi sikhathi, uMthembu waqala ukucabangela ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza enkulu yokuxhumana. Wayefisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lungasiza abantu baziqonde kangcono izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Wayefisa ukuthi abantu babone ukuthi noma ngabe izimo zempilo zingaba nzima, ukuxhumana, ukuhlekisa, nokwabelana ngezindaba kungasiza. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaqala ukuvela, futhi uMthembu wathola ukuthi abantu baphokophele ukufaka izimvo zabo. Kwakukhona abalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ababe nezinganekwane ezihlukene ezazihambisana nezimo ezijwayelekile. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukuza phambili ukuze babuke. Uthando lwakhe lokuxhumana nabantu lwakha umphakathi omuhle, futhi abantu baqala ukwabelana ngezindaba zabo. Ngenxa yokuphumelela kwalolu hlelo, uMthembu wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abaculi nabadidiyeli. Uthole ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza yokwakha imiphakathi, yokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo zempilo. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezazivela emhlabeni, zikhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwaluhamba phambili, futhi uMthembu waphokophela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi ezizokwenza abantu bajabule. Noma kunjalo, uMthembu wazi ukuthi ithelevishini nayo inezinkinga zayo. Wabona ukuthi abanye abantu bangenza izinto ezingalungile, bebhala izindaba ezimbi noma bephula imithetho. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ithelevishini isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwamenza wacabanga ngokwakha uhlelo lokuphakamisa izimiso zokuziphatha, ukuze abanye bazi ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza, kodwa futhi ingaba yingozi uma ingasetshenziswa kahle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMthembu wathola ukuthi ithelevishini iyinsiza enkulu yokuxhumana, kodwa kufanele kube nokuhlakanipha ekuyisebenziseni. Waqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezihlekisayo, ezithokozisayo, nezifundisayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwakhula, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu angashintsha impilo yakhe nabanye ngempela. Ekugcineni, uMthembu waphumelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, nolwazi. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yinsiza yokuhlanganisa abantu, futhi ithelevishini yaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngempilo, nokuhlekisa. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi wathola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yindlela yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, uma kuphela abantu bephila ngokuhlonipha, ngokubambisana, nangokwakha izixazululo ezilungile. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMthembu waqonda ukuthi ithelevishini, nakuba ingaba yinsiza enkulu, idinga abantu abaqondayo, abahamba phambili, nabafuna ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Wafisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe luhlale lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi izinkinga zingaxazululwa uma abantu bebonisana, behlekisa, futhi bexhumana. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile empilweni kaMnumzane Mthembu, futhi ithelevishini yaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, nolwazi.
Ezentsha: Ukubaluleka Kokubandakanya Intsha Ekuthuthukiseni Umphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha ibonakala iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Izingane zethu, abasha, nabantu abasha, bahlala bejolisa emiphakathini yabo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zindaba ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi intsha inezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inamathuba amaningi okwenza umehluko. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokubandakanya intsha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukungasebenzi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, zonke lezi zinto zenza kube nzima kubantu abasha ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuxhasa intsha. Izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokusebenza, nezokwelapha zidinga ukwakhiwa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuthola amathuba afanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha inezwi elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Izingxoxo ezivela kubantu abasha zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinkundla ezivulekile zokuxoxa, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukwabelana ngemibono yabo. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuthuthukiswa. Ngokubandakanya intsha, sithola izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezinkinga. Abantu abasha banamakhono amasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nemibono emisha. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni ehlukene, njengezobuchwepheshe, ezemidlalo, nezokwakha. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokulalela intsha, sizokwazi ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ukubandakanya intsha ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuzithandela. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha umphakathi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza intsha ukuba ibonise ubuhlakani bayo. Ukuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokuzithandela kungasiza intsha ukuba ithole amakhono amasha, futhi ibenze babe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokukhuluma nabantu abasha, sizokwazi ukuqonda izifiso zabo, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinto abazifunayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba sakhe izinhlelo ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ukubandakanya intsha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi akusizi kuphela intsha, kodwa futhi kusiza umphakathi wonke. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokubandakanya intsha, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Ekugcineni, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke intsha njengengxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Sidinga ukwakha izinkundla ezivulekile, sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza, futhi sithathe izinyathelo zokuxhasa intsha. Uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungele ikusasa. Intsha iyinsika yomphakathi, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe, siyixhase, futhi siyibandakanye. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono, futhi sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umlando WaseNingizimu Afrika Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso wobuhlakani, ubukhosi, nezinkumbulo ezinzima. Izigameko eziningi ezibalulekile zenzeka kuleli, okuhlanganisa izinguquko zomphakathi, izimpi, nemibono emisha. Ukuze siqonde kahle leli lizwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sibheke izigameko ezahlukene ezakha umlando wethu. Umlando uqala lapho izizwe zokuqala, njengezamaKhoisan, zihlala kuleli. Lezi zizwe zazinomlando ocebile, zikhuluma izilimi ezahlukene, futhi zabeziqhenya ngamasiko nezinkolelo zabo. Izizwe zamaBantu, ezifana namaXhosa namaZulu, zafika kuleli maphakathi nekhulu le-1, okuholele ekwakhekeni kwezinkolo, izindlela zokuphila, nemiphakathi ehlangene. Ngesikhathi sokufika kwabantu baseYurophu, ikakhulukazi abangamaDutch ngo-1652, kwavela ushintsho olukhulu. Lezi zizwe zafika nezinhlelo zokuhweba, kodwa zabamba umhlaba, zabhidliza izimpilo zabantu bendabuko. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphuleni kwamalungelo abantu, ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zamasiko, kanye nezimpi ezandulela ubukhomanisi, okubizwa ngokuthi yimpi yokuqala phakathi kweDutch neZulu ngo-1836. Umgwaqo omkhulu wempilo yama-Afrika wenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-20, lapho umqondo wobandlululo waqala ukubonakala. Uhlelo lobandlululo lwezombusazwe lwavuma ngo-1948, lwathinta kakhulu izimpilo zabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphikisaneni okuqhubekayo, okuhlanganisa nezimpikiswano ezaziholela ekwakheni amaqembu afana ne-African National Congress (ANC). Ukwenzeka kweMpi yeMpi eGhana ngo-1957 kwaba nomthelela omkhulu, kuholela ekwandeni kokucaciswa kwempilo yokuphila kwabantu abamnyama. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphila ngaphansi kobandlululo, uNelson Mandela, obengumholi we-ANC, wakhululwa ejele ngo-1990, okuveza umphumela omuhle ebuhlotsheni phakathi kwamazwe. Izinyathelo eziyinqaba, ezinjengezivumelwano zikaCODESA, zakhulisa ithemba lokuthula nokuhlangana. Ukwamukelwa kwenhlalo enobulungiswa, umthetho wesibili wamaNgqongqoshe, kwaphumelela ngo-1994, lapho kwaba nezinqumo ezibalulekile zokuvota. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuba uMandela abe nguMengameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika, okwakuyisikhathi esisha sokwakha isizwe esisha. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibheka emuva kumlando wayo, ibalulekile ukufunda nokuhlola izifundo ezitholakala emlandweni. Izinselele zakhona zifaka ukukhathazeka ngezinga lokuhlukumezeka, ububha, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlupheka. Nokho, izinto zisabukeka zikhanya kwezokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, osuka ekubeni umphakathi owahlukanisiwe waya empilweni efanele yokuhlalisana. Sikhumbula ukuthi umlando awupheli, kodwa uhlala uhlobene nezikhathi eziphilayo. Ukubheka emuva kumlando weNingizimu Afrika, sikhumbula izifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala ezingqondweni zethu. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo nezamasiko ahlukene kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sinaso isibopho sokwakha isizwe esinobumbano, esihlonipha izimpilo zawo bonke abahlali bayo. Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumthombo wokukhumbula, ukufunda, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kungokwenza kube khona umoya wokubambisana, ukwakha isizwe esibumbene, futhi kuqhubekisele phambili izifiso zokuphila kwesizukulwane esizayo. Ngakho-ke, sithi: "Siyakhumbula, siyafunda, futhi sizokwakha."
Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Ingxoxo Ngendlela Yokuphumelela Isingeniso Ukufuna umsebenzi kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bejolisa khona emisebenzini ethile ukuze bakwazi ukuziphilisa. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola izindlela ezahlukene zokufuna umsebenzi, sikhuluma ngezinto okufanele zicatshangwe, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ingxoxo yokusebenza ibe yimpumelelo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Umsebenzi Ofunwayo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi olufunayo. Lokhu kusho ukuba necebo elicacile, lokho kusho ukuthola izimfuno ezithile zomsebenzi, izimboni, nezinkampani ozithanda. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, amaphephandaba, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile nolwakha. Ngokuhlola imakethe yomsebenzi, ungakwazi ukuthola izikhala ezithokozisayo ezihambisana nezifiso zakho. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela I-CV Nezincwadi Zokufaka Isicelo Ngemuva kokukhetha umsebenzi ofunayo, umnyango olandelayo ukuhlela i-CV yakho (i-curriculum vitae) nezincwadi zokufaka isicelo. I-CV yakho kufanele ibonise kahle amakhono akho, ulwazi lwakho, kanye nezifundo ozithathile. Kumele ube nokwethembeka, ugweme izimpazamo ezivamile, futhi ugxile kulokho okwenzile empilweni yakho, ikakhulukazi kokuhambelana nomsebenzi ofunwayo. Izincwadi zokufaka isicelo ziyisethulo esibalulekile, kufanele ubonise ukuthi kungani ungumuntu ofanele lo msebenzi, futhi unikeze izizathu ezikhuthazayo. Isigaba 3: Ukusebenzisa Izinkundla Zokuxhumana Izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yisikhali esinamandla ekufuneni umsebenzi. Ungasebenzisa uhlelo olufana ne-LinkedIn ukuze ukhulume nabantu abakwi ndawo ofuna ukusebenza kuyo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuboniseni izikhala zomsebenzi, ukuthola izixhumanisi ezibalulekile, noma nokwakha ubudlelwano obusiza ekufuneni umsebenzi. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uhlole iphrofayela yakho, uqinisekise ukuthi ibonisa kahle ubuchwepheshe bakho kanye namakhono akho. Isigaba 4: Ukulungiselela Ingxoxo Yokusebenza Uma usuthole ithuba lokuhlangana nendawo yokusebenza, kulapho ukuqala ukuhl准备. Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngenkampani, uqonde izinjongo zayo, nokwazi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zayo. Kulungiselela imibuzo ongayibuzwa, futhi ucabangele izimpendulo ezihlobene nemisebenzi yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nokuzethemba ngesikhathi sengxoxo, futhi kukhombise izinga lakho lokuzimisela. Isigaba 5: Ukuphumelela Ngeke Kube Kalula Kubhalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela ngokufuna umsebenzi akulona uhambo olulula. Kuzodingeka uthole izinkanyezi, uthole izinkinga, nokuthi ungaphazanyiswa. Uma ungaphumelelanga emsebenzini owuthandayo, ungaphinde uhlaziye izizathu, uhlolisise imvelo yakho yokusebenza, futhi uthole izindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nemiphumela. Ukubekezelela nokuba nezinhloso ezicacile kuyasiza emizweni yobunzima. Isigaba 6: Ukukhuluma Ngempumelelo Uma usukwazile ukuthola umsebenzi, ungakhohlwa ukubonga abaqashi kanye nabantu abakusizile ohambweni lwakho. Lokhu kuzwakala njengokuhlonipha, futhi kungakha izixhumanisi ezinhle zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhono akho nokufunda ukuze uqhubeke ube umholi emkhakheni wakho. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukufuna umsebenzi kuyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungaba nenhloso edidiyelwe yokuphumelela. Kubalulekile ukuba necebo, ukulungiselela kahle, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. Khumbula ukuthi, ngokuba nesineke nokuqhubeka nokusebenza, uzothola ithuba ofuna lona. Ukuphumelela akuyona into ethokozisayo, kodwa kuyindlela eqhubekayo yokufunda, ukukhula, nokuthola ukuzethemba. Futhi, khumbula njalo, isinyathelo sokuqala sokuqala lapho umgibeli emhlabeni omusha.
Umbiko Ngemountain Everest Isingeniso IMount Everest, eyaziwa ngokuthi iSagarmatha eNepal kanye neChomolungma eTibet, iyinsika eyinhloko yokuphila kwemvelo, iyona ntaba ephakeme kunazo zonke emhlabeni. Le ntaba ibhalwe emlandweni njengento ephakeme kakhulu, inezinga elingu-8,848.86 m ngaphezulu kwezinga lolwandle. Itholakala eningizimu yeHimalaya, iMount Everest iyindawo yokuthokozisa, yokuhlola, kanye nokuhlola, futhi ibamba izinkumbulo eziningi zabantu abavela kuwo wonke umhlaba. Umlando weMount Everest IGama leMount Everest livela kuSir George Everest, umphakathi waseBrithani owawuphatha iNepal ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-19. Ukuze kuhlonishwe lo mphakathi, igama lakhe lathathwa ngo-1865. Nokho, izithakazelo zentaba ziqala ngaphambi kokuba ibizwe ngalesi sikhathi, njengoba le ntaba ibiyingxenye yeHimalaya iminyaka eyizinkulungwane. Abantu bamaSherpa, abahlala eduze kwayo, babephila ngaphansi kwale ntaba isikhathi eside, bazi kahle ngendawo futhi benza izindlela zokuhamba ezihamba phezulu. Izimo Zemvelo IMount Everest ibonakala ngezimo eziyingozi, ezihlanganisa umoya opholile, izinga lokushisa eliphansi, nezimo zomhlaba ezinzima. Lezi zimo zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi abavakashi bahlala bephokophele phezulu ukuze bafinyelele phezulu. Ukuze bakwazi ukukhuphuka, abavakashi kufanele bazi kahle izimo zomoya, izimo zokwakheka, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nokukhuphuka. Izinsiza Zokukhuphuka Kunezindlela eziningi zokukhuphuka iMount Everest, kodwa izindlela ezivame kakhulu zifaka iSouth Col Route kanye neNorth Ridge Route. Lezi zindlela zidinga ukulungiselela kahle, futhi abaqeqeshi abavela ezinkampanini ezihloniphekile banikeza usizo oludingekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabakhuphukayo, abaqeqeshi, kanye nezinye izinsiza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabo bonke abahamba. Izingozi Nezithiyo Noma iMount Everest ibonakala iyindawo ephakeme, inezingozi eziningi ezihambisana nokukhuphuka. Izimo zomoya ezinzima, izikhukhula, kanye nezimo zokushisa eziphansi zingaba yingozi. Abakhuphukayo bahlala bephakathi kwezingozi ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa ukushoda komoya, ukushisa okukhulu, nokuhlaselwa yizimo zeqhwa. Ukuze baphumelele, kudingeka ukuthi bazi kahle izingozi futhi baqonde izinqumo ezibalulekile. Izinsiza Zokuhlola Izinsiza zokuhlola iMount Everest zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabakhuphukayo. Abahamba badinga izinsiza ezifanele, njengezicathulo ezikhethekile, izingubo zokuvikela, nemishini yokuhlola. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe lukhula njalo, futhi izinsiza zokuhlola ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhuphukayo bahlala bephila. Umthelela Kwezokuthengisa Nokuvakasha IMount Everest ibalulekile emnothweni wezokuvakasha eNepal. Ukuvakashelwa kwale ntaba kuholela ekukhuleni komnotho, futhi abantu abaningi bathola amathuba emisebenzi ngenxa yokuvakasha. Nokho, lokhu kuholela nakwezinkinga ezithile, njengezinkinga zokungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukwehla kwezimali zemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu bendabuko. Isiphetho IMount Everest iyinsika yokuphila, ibhadi lezemvelo elihamba phambili emhlabeni. Noma izimo zayo zingaba nzima, abavakashi bahlala bephokophele phezulu ukuze bafinyelele phezulu. Ukukhuphuka iMount Everest kudinga ukulungiselela, ulwazi, kanye nesineke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wezokuvakasha ungathinta izimpilo zabantu bendabuko, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukugcina le ntaba ibalulekile, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bayo. IMount Everest iyinsika yokuphila, ibhadi elikhumbulekayo, futhi kufanele sibe nomthwalo wokuyigcina iphilile.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini Umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa izigigaba ezithokozisayo nezinzima, ezihlanganisa imizamo yokusebenza, ubuhlungu, nobuhlakani bezakhamuzi. Izimayini ziye zaba yinsika yesizwe, zigcina izigidi zabantu zisebenzela imisebenzi ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ziye zabeka abantu ezinzwaneni ezinzima. Ukuqala Kwemayini Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, ngesikhathi sokukhula komnotho, izimayini ziqala ukuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Izinsiza zemvelo, ikakhulukazi igolide nezinye izinto ezisemqoka, zatholwa eGoli nasezinye izingxenye zezwe. Lokhu kwadala ithuba elikhulu lokusebenza, futhi abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, baqalisa ukuhamba baye ezindaweni ezinezimayini. Imisebenzi Yezisebenzi Zasezimayini Izisebenzi ezazihamba zifika ezimayini zazivame ukuhlala ngaphansi kwemigomo enzima. Umsebenzi emayini wawungeyona nje indlela yokuphila, kodwa kwakuyinselele enkulu. Iziphathimandla ezazihola izimayini zazinokuphatha okukhulayo, futhi izisebenzi zazithola imivuzo emincane kakhulu. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabo, njengoba abantu bahlupheka bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ubugebengu Nokuqhubeka Kwezimayini Kukhona nezinselelo ezinkulu ezazihambisana nezimayini. Ubugebengu, ukungabi nalungelo, nezinye izimo eziphazamisa umphakathi zaba yizinto ezijwayelekile. Izisebenzi zazikhuthazwa ukuba zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, kodwa umphakathi wawugcina uvalekile ezinqubweni zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo zokuhlukumeza, futhi izisebenzi zafuna izindlela zokuzivikela. Ukuvukela Ubulungisa Ngesikhathi sokukhula kokungqubuzana, izisebenzi zaqala ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuvukela ubulungisa. Kwakukhona izinyathelo ezinkulu zokuhlangana, zifaka phakathi amafemu ezombusazwe namaqembu omphakathi. Lezi zinyathelo zafaka phakathi izinxushunxushu ezinkulu, ezavusa umoya wokulwa nezinselelo ezazibhekene nezisebenzi zasezimayini. Uhlanga Lwezinguquko Kusukela ngekhulu le-20, isimo sezisebenzi sathuthuka kancane. Izikhungo zokuqala zemfundo zatholakala, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda ngezindaba zomnotho, ezombusazwe, nezenhlalakahle. Ubugebengu obubhekene nezisebenzi bukhuphuke, kodwa izisebenzi zathola indlela yokuvikela amalungelo azo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinyathelo ezibambene, okwakukhombisa umoya wokubambisana. Isikhathi Sokuguquka Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokulwa, izisebenzi zezimayini zathola impumelelo enkulu. Imithetho emisha yabhalwa, ivikela amalungelo ezisebenzi. Lokhu kuholele ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu emikhubeni yokusebenza, kwaholela ekwandeni kwemivuzo, izimo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, nokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo. Isiphetho Umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ubonisa ukuthi, yize izinselelo zikhona, abantu bangakha impumelelo uma bebandakanya imizamo yokubambisana. Izisebenzi ziye zaba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngezikhathi ezinzima, umoya wokulwa uhlala unamandla. Nokho, ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza amalungelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umlando ungasifundisa ngezinto ezithile, ukuze sikhemphe izifundo zomlando, sithole indlela engcono yokwakha ikusasa elihle. Ngakho-ke, umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini awuwona nje umfanekiso wezinkinga, kodwa ubonisa imizamo yokuphila, uthando, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Uhlanga lwezimayini luhamba phambili, nokho luhlala lukhumbuza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi umoya wokubambana ungakha izinguquko eziyinhloko. Uhambo lwezisebenzi luhlala luhamba, nokho, luhlale lukhumbula ukuthi, emzamweni, umphakathi uhlala unamandla.
Isahluko 1: Ukwamukela Ukugoma Umbhali: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungihlangabeza namuhla. Ngicela ungazise, yini okukwenza ukhulume ngalezi zimiso zokugoma? Umlingisi: Sawubona! Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Imigomo yokugoma ibalulekile ngoba ivikela impilo yomphakathi. Ngokwazi lezi zimiso, abantu bangakhetha kahle ngezempilo zabo. Isahluko 2: Ukubaluleka Kokugoma Umbhali: Ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi kungani ukugoma kubalulekile kumphakathi? Umlingisi: Ngokuqinisekile. Ukugoma kubalulekile ngoba kuvikela abantu ezitheni ezifana nezifo ezinzima. Ngokugoma, sithuthukisa ukuphepha komphakathi, futhi sithuthukisa ukuvikelwa kwabanye. Imigomo yokugoma ihlinzeka ngezixhumo phakathi kwegazi lenhlanzeko, ukwandisa ukuvikeleka kanye nabafundi. Isahluko 3: Izimiso eziyisisekelo zokugoma Umbhali: Ungabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezimiso eziyisisekelo zokugoma? Umlingisi: Yebo, kunezimiso ezithile ezisemqoka. Okokuqala, zonke iziguli kufanele ziqonde izinzuzo zokugoma, okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa ezingozini zomhlaba. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakhethe ukuzibandakanya. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusiza emigomweni yokugoma, ukudala ukuqwashisa, nokukhuthaza abanye. Lokhu kugcina umphakathi unempilo futhi uphephile. Isahluko 4: Izithiyo ekugomeni Umbhali: Kukhona yini izithiyo ezithinta ukufakwa kwemigomo yokugoma? Umlingisi: Yebo, zikhona. Abantu abaningi banokukhathazeka ngenxa yokungazi; kunezinkolelo ezithile mayelana nezithako ezisetshenziswayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashiswa kwezakhamuzi. Okuhle, imithombo ethile inikeza izimpendulo ezibalulekile, ezisiza abantu baqonde kangcono. Isahluko 5: Izinqubomgomo nezinto ezithinta izenzo Umbhali: Kukhona yini izinqubomgomo ezenza kube lula ukufaka lezi zimiso? Umlingisi: Yebo, iHhovisi leZempilo lisebenza ngezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayagoma. Ukuze kube neziphakamiso ezifanele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye namalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kudala umkhankaso wokugoma ophumelelayo. Isahluko 6: Ukukhuthaza ukugoma Umbhali: Yini okufanele kwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuthazela kwabantu ekugomeni? Umlingisi: Kubalulekile ukudala imikhankaso efinyelela enhliziyweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yokuxoxa, izifundo ezithinta imiphakathi, nezinsiza ezikhuthazayo ezikhombisa izinzuzo zokugoma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlonipha imikhuba nemvelaphi yamasiko kungasiza ekwandiseni isimo sokugoma. Isahluko 7: Ukuqonda imiphumela Umbhali: Ngabe imiphumela yokugoma ingachazwa kanjani emiphakathini? Umlingisi: Imiphumela yokugoma ibonakala emiphakathini ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo, ukukhululeka kwezifo ezithathelwanayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zezempilo komphakathi futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ukuze kube nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu asebenze ndawonye. Isahluko 8: Ukuqedela Umbhali: Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa! Yini ofuna ukuyishiya kubafundi bethu? Umlingisi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile. Ngifuna ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukugoma akukhona okwenziwa umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kukhomba umphakathi wonke. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukugoma, sithuthukise imibono yethu nezifiso ukuze sibe nempilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uhulumeni, imithombo yezempilo, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisane. Umbhali: Ngiyabonga kakhulu! Lokhu kuyasiza kakhulu kumphakathi wethu. Umlingisi: Ngiyabonga. Ngithokozile ukuthola ithuba lokuxoxa.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Ukujula Kwezemidlalo Emhlabeni Wokuzijabulisa Eminyakeni edlule, imidlalo yevidiyo iye yaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Emhlabeni wonke, abantu baye bahlola imikhakha eyahlukene yevidiyo, okukhuluma izilaleli ezincane, eziphakathi nendawo, nezinkulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo akusikho kuphela okwenziwa ngentshiseko, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, yokufunda, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuciko. ### Ukukhula Kwezimboni Zevidiyo Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ibalulekile, kufanele siqale ngokuhlola ukukhula kwayo eminyakeni edlule. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana ne-Activision, Ubisoft, kanye ne-Electronic Arts, zivele zisebenza kanzima ekwakheni imidlalo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kukhula kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza eziphambili, ezinjengezinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-computer, kanye namakhonsoli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyatholakala ku-inthanethi, okuvumela ababukeli abavela emhlabeni wonke ukuba baxhumane futhi badlale ndawonye. ### Umthelela Wokuthuthukiswa KwezeMidlalo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ithole ukuthandwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha. Abantwana nabantu abadala basenokudlala imidlalo yokwakha, yokuhlasela, neyezemidlalo, okwenza basebenze izinjongo ezihlukene. Lokhu kuhilela ukuzijabulisa, kepha futhi kudinga amakhono ahlukahlukene. Imithetho yevidiyo yokwakha imiphumela yokucabanga, yokuhlela, nesikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi. Abadlali baye bakwazi ukuhlangana, babelane ngamava, futhi baphumelele ndawonye. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza umhlaba ubonakale uhlobo olukhulu lokuxhumana. ### Izinselelo Nezindaba Zamanje Noma imidlalo yevidiyo ijabulela impumelelo enkulu, ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukukhathazeka ngempilo yezeMpilo, ukuhlukunyezwa ku-inthanethi, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha kuhlale kuphakamisa imibuzo eminingi. Izingane eziningi zikhuluma ngengcindezi yokudlala imidlalo isikhathi eside, okwenza kube nezinkinga zempilo ezinjengokungasebenzi, udlame, nokungena ezinhlelweni ezimbi. Izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela imithetho esobala yokuvikela abadlali, ikakhulukazi izingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izilawuli zokudlala, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphepha, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imidlalo ethile ifaneleka kubantu abancane kuphela. ### Ikusasa Lemidlalo Yevidiyo Ngokubheka phambili, ikusasa lemidlalo yevidiyo libukeka likhulu. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwakha imidlalo ethokozisayo. Ukusebenzisa i-virtual reality (VR) kanye ne-augmented reality (AR) kuyindlela yokuhamba phambili, evumela abadlali ukuba baqaphele imidlalo ngendlela engakaze ibonakale. Lokhu kuzokwenza imidlalo ibe nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imisebenzi ye-esports iyakhula, futhi imicimbi yokuncintisana ibonisa imisebenzi emisha yokuzijabulisa. Abadlali be-Esports baye bathola ukudlalwa ezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthola imiklomelo emikhulu. ### Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wokuzijabulisa. Itholakala emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano. Noma izinselelo zikhona, uma ziqhutshwa ngezindlela ezinhle, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yinsika eqinile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Umhlaba wethu uhlale ushintsha, futhi imidlalo yevidiyo izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lapho abantu bahlala behlangene, bejabule, futhi besebenza ndawonye. Imidlalo yevidiyo, ngakho-ke, akusikho kuphela ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Njengoba sithokozisa imidlalo yevidiyo, kufanele siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokwakha indawo ephephile, evulekile, nenempilo kubo bonke abadlali. Imidlalo yevidiyo akusikho kuphela ukukhumbula, kodwa futhi kuyajabulisa — umhlaba wokuzijabulisa ongenamkhawulo.
U-Eskom Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, okungukuthi, u-Eskom. U-Eskom ungumhlinzeki omkhulu kagesi kuleli, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Ukuze siqonde kahle izinselelo ezibhekene no-Eskom, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa nomphakathi, abahlinzeki, kanye nochwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu ngalesi sihloko. Ingxenye 2: Umlando ka-Eskom U-Eskom waqalwa ngonyaka ka-1923, futhi wathola umthwalo omkhulu wokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Ngaphandle kokukhula okukhulu, u-Eskom ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza ezindala, ukungabi bikho kokutshala imali, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokwanele. Ingxenye 3: Izinkinga Zamanje Namuhla, u-Eskom ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwaziwa ngokuthi "load shedding," sekuphenduke isimo esijwayelekile empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka emisebenzini, ezikoleni, nakwezinye izindawo. Siphinde sithole imibono evela kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, bechaza ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ingxenye 4: Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa U-Eskom uzama ukuthola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Abaphathi bakhe baveze ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zokutshala imali ezintsha, ukwakha iziteshi ezintsha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulawula amandla. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi u-Eskom uzama ukuvuselela izinsiza zawo ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Ingxenye 5: Ukubambisana Nezinkampani Zangaphandle Ukuze u-Eskom uphumelele, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezinkampani zangaphandle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo ezintsha, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha. Abanye ochwepheshe baveza ukuthi ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla avuselelekayo kungasiza u-Eskom ukuba uthole izixazululo ezibanzi. Ingxenye 6: Umthelela Emphakathini U-Eskom akawona umhlinzeki kuphela kagesi; unomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Izinkinga ezibhekene no-Eskom ziba nomthelela ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi, ezemfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzeka ngogesi kuhlobene nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Ingxenye 7: Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba sikhuluma ngendaba ka-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izixazululo azizukutholakala ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi u-Eskom, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izindlela zokuthuthukisa isimo. Ukubambisana, ukwethembeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izinqumo ezithathwayo kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni u-Eskom. Ingxenye 8: Isiphetho U-Eskom ungumgogodla wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Nakuba ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zingasiza ukuvuselela le nhlangano. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho u-Eskom engaba umhlinzeki okhaliphile, ophumelelayo, futhi othembekile. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi u-Eskom ungathuthukiswa ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi.
### Izinselelo Zempilo: Indaba Yempilo Yezizukulwane Isingeniso Emhlabeni wethu, impilo ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, ezingaphandle kokucabanga. Izinselelo zempilo zihlala zikhona, zihlala zishintsha, futhi ziguquka ngaphakathi kwemigudu yokwakha komphakathi. Lezi zinto zilethela abantu ubuhlungu, kepha futhi zikhuthaza ukuqina nokuqhubeka ekuphileni. Ukukhuluma ngezimpilo zempilo kudinga ukuthi sihlole izinkathi ezahlukene, nakanjani izibonelo ezikhumbulekayo ezivela ezizukulwaneni. Njengoba sihlola lezi zimo, sizobona ukuthi izinselelo zethu zishintsha, kepha ukuqina kokuphila kukhula unomphela. Ukuqala Kwesizathu Sezinselelo Ezikhathini zasendulo, abantu babebhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukushoda kokudla, kanye nezinye izimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, emakhathini amadala, izizwe eziningi zazibhekene nezikhathi zokuhlaselwa, okubangela ukuba izakhamuzi zifune ukuvikela impilo nokuhola impilo eyejwayelekile. Eqinisweni, izinkathi zebhadi zokuhlaselwa kwabantu, ziningi izifundo esizithola kulolu hlobo lwezikhathi. Kulezi zinkathi, kwavela izimpawu zokuqina nokubambisana kwabantu. Isikhathi Sezinqaba Zokuphila Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, abantu baqala ukuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezintsha. Ukukhula komnotho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, nezinguquko kwezepolitiki kwaholela ekutheni kube nezidingo ezintsha. Abantu baqala ukuveza isidingo sokufunda, ukwakha imikhakha emisha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kwezikhulu kwezepolitiki nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi yamakhosikazi kuholele ekwandeni kwezinselelo emphakathini. Izinselelo Zekhanda Nezenhlalakahle Ngokuya phambili emlandweni, izinselelo ezibhekene nezizukulwane zomphakathi zithinta abantu ngobuchwepheshe bombono nemizwa. Ukuze kulungiswe izinqumo ezibuhlungu, abantu bahlala bexhasa omunye nomunye. Izinkinga zempilo zikhona, futhi zinciphisa umqondo wempilo. Lokhu kuhlonipha ubuhlungu bempilo kudinga ukuba kubekwe izixazululo ezimnandi, nokusiza abantu abahlala bephila kahle. Lolu shintsho olukhula emcabangweni nakwezemiphakathi, lwazisa ukuthi ukuzinikela nokuzikhethela kubalulekile. Izinselelo Zobuchwepheshe Nempilo Yomphakathi Ngesikhathi sikaMandela, ukubuyiselwa kwezimpilo emphakathini kwabamba iqhaza elibalulekile. Lokhu kuveza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphila ezifanele, okuyinto eyayinikeza umuntu ngamunye ithuba lokuphila impilo eyanelisayo. Ngakho-ke, yize izinselelo zazikhona, kodwa abantu babesagubha okuyinto engaziwa — umoya ophakamisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, ngamunye unesisekelo sokwenza izinqumo obala, nokuthi ukudlula ezintweni ezinzima okufanele. Izimpilo Zesibhedlela Nokuqhubeka Kwezinkinga Zempilo Izinkinga zempilo zihlala zikhona, futhi zihlala zidla umoya wethu. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma ngezimo ezinjalo, abantu baphila, baphilekarisile, futhi baphinde bazame ukuphila ngempilo. Lokhu kwakhombisa ukuthi imizamo yokwakha izra no mleko yempilo kube yinzuzo, kungakhathaliseki impilo obekuhamba ngayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuba 'ukufunda' ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zilapho ukuze ziqinise ubungane phakathi kwabantu. Isiphetho Izinselelo zempilo zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Njengoba sithola izifundo emlandweni, izinkumbulo ezinzima zikhombisa ukusindiswa kokuphila okusha. Kuhlala kudingeka ukucabangela izimo ezahlukeneyo, ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Yize izingqinamba zempilo zihlala zikhona, ukuqina nokuphila okuqinisekisiwe kuyindlela yokuphila ejabulisayo. Izinselelo zempilo ziyiqiniso, kepha ukukwazi ukuhamba phambili yikhono eliqinile elihlanganisa umphakathi, lwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono.
Umbiko: Abafundi Basenyuvesi Isingeniso Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bebamba iqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango emisha, ubuhlakani, nezixazululo ezidingekayo ezindabeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile njengoba izikhungo zemfundo zikhula, futhi zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphendule izinselelo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezimpilweni zabafundi, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nemithelela yokufunda kwabo ezweni. Isimo Sabafundi Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bephuma ezizindeni ezahlukene, bevela emakhaya ahlukene, futhi bephuma ezimfundisweni ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onohlonze, ogcwele ubuhlakani obuhlukahlukene. Abafundi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olujulile, nokwakha amakhono adingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wabo ungumthombo wobungane, oxhasa abafundi ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi ubasiza ukuba bakhe izixhumanisi ezibalulekile. Izinselelo Abafundi Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abafundi basenyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kubo iwukushoda kwemali. Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlela izimali zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungaba nomthelela ongemuhle emiphumeleni yabo yokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka kwengqondo kuyinkinga ethinta abafundi abaningi. Ukukhathazeka ngokuhluleka, izivivinyo, kanye nezibopho zomndeni kungadala umqondo wokukhathazeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhube imikhankaso yokuxhasa abafundi, ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga zengqondo. Izinhlelo Zokuxhasa Abafundi Izikhungo zemfundo ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelulekwa, izikhungo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola imithombo yokuxhaswa kwezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, futhi bathole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele ezifundweni zabo. Imithelela Yokufunda Ukufunda kwaba yindlela yokukhulisa umqondo, futhi kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olusha, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo, bekwazi ukusiza abanye abantu. Abafundi abaphumelelayo bahlala bephakamisa izinga lokufunda, futhi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala benomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Noma beface izinselelo eziningi, izikhungo zemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ukuze baphumelele. Ukufunda akuyona nje indlela yokuthola ulwazi, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhulisa umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abafundi, sibanikeze amandla, futhi sibavumele ukuba babe nomthelela omuhle ezweni. Ukuxhasa abafundi basenyuvesi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelikhanyayo.
Ukuhlaziywa Kwezokuxhumana: Izinguquko Nezimpikiswano Isingeniso Ezokuxhumana ziyingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke, zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwabantu, emiphakathini nasemabhizinisini. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izindlela zethu zokuxhumana nazo ziguquka, zishintsha ubunikazi bethu nezinhloso zethu. Le ndaba izogxila ekuhlaziyeni izinguquko ezibalulekile ezokuxhumana, nemiphumela yazo, kanye nezimpikiswano ezithinta lezi zinguquko. Izinguquko Ezibalulekile Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithombo yezokuxhumana ibe yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abahlala kude. Izinkundla ezifana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, kanye ne-WhatsApp zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi omusha, lapho abantu bekhuluma, babelana ngemicabango, futhi behlanganyela ngezinto ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha, obuvumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane kalula, bathumele imiyalezo ngesikhathi sangempela, futhi bahlale bexhumene, noma bahlale kumazwe ahlukene. Ukwengeza, ubuchwepheshe be-smartphone buye baba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinkundla zokuxhumana. Abantu manje bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngezikhathi zonke, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango nemicimbi yansuku zonke. Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu abaningi ukuba benze izixhumanisi ezinamandla, futhi kube nomthelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhlala isikhathi eside. Imiphumela Yezokuxhumana Nakuba izokuxhumana zinikeza amathuba amaningi, zibuye zibuye nemiphumela emibi. Eyokuqala, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziye zaba yindawo yokuxabana, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngenxa yezinhloso ezihlukene. Ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso, noma ama-fake news, kudinga abantu ukuba babe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kweqiniso nobuzwe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuvikela ukwethembeka kolwazi, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ngezindlela ezingafanele. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga ezithinta impilo yengqondo. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukuhlala unxenxeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kungaholela ekukhuleni kokukhathazeka, umona, nokucindezeleka. Abantu banesidingo sokuqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana okufanele akuyona kuphela okwenziwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kodwa futhi kudinga ubudlelwano obubukhali nabanye abantu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela impilo yengqondo, kubalulekile ukufunda ukuhlela isikhathi sokuqhubeka kwezokuxhumana, futhi sithole isikhathi sokuphumula, sibuyele ebuhleni bokuphila bempilo yangempela. Izimpikiswano Nezinkinga Zokuziphatha Ezokuxhumana zibuye ziveze izinkinga ezithinta ukuziphatha kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlukunyezwa, ukuxhashazwa, nokuthola ulwazi olungekho emthethweni. Ngenxa yokuthi abantu bavame ukusebenzisa amagama anobudlova noma ahlekisayo ukuze baphonse izinkanyezi emiphakathini, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buba namahloni. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinzima ezivela kumakhasimende, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikelwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziya ziba neqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile. Abantu bakhuthazwa ukuba bacabange futhi bahlaziye izinqumo zabo, beqhathanisa imibono ehlukene, futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ukuze bahlale bexhumene, beqhubeka nokufunda, futhi bahlalisane. Isiphetho Ezokuxhumana ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango, izenzakalo, kanye nezindaba ezibalulekile. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zinguquko. Ukuxhumana okufanele kudinga ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela emihle, kanti nangaphandle kwalokho, izinkinga ezithinta impilo yengqondo nezokuziphatha zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Njengoba siqhubeka ukwakha umphakathi wethu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela nokukhulisa izokuxhumana ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole izinzuzo zayo ngendlela esebenzayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uhlala unempilo.
uToyota Uhlelo olukhulu lwezokuhamba luhlonishwa futhi luziswa emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa akukhona okukodwa okuphakama ngendlela efanayo njengomkhiqizo we-auto, uToyota. Ekuqaleni, iToyota yasungulwa e-Japan ngo-1937, futhi kusukela lapho izuze ubuhlakani benkolo yezokuthutha. Ngeminyaka edlule, uthando lwezithuthi zeToyota lukhule kakhulu, lwazisa abantu ngezinga eliphezulu lekhwalithi, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhula ngokushesha. Eminyakeni edlule, iToyota ihlale iyisikhumbuzo sezinguquko ezinhle kwezokuthutha. Iminikelo yayo emisha neyamabhizinisi ayingxenye yokwandisa impilo yabantu, ibavumela ukuba bahambe kalula futhi baphumelele ukuphila kwansuku zonke. I-Toyota Corolla, eyaziwa nangokuthi ingumshini ovamile emhlabeni, iyisibonelo esihle sokwakhiwa kwemoto eyenzelwe umnotho, ethokozela ukufaneleka, nokwethembeka. Emcimbini wamuva, owawubanjelwe edolobheni elikhulu, abathandi bemoto baqhakambisa impumelelo yeToyota, bakhanyisa izithuthi ezahlukahlukene, zisiza njalo ekushintsheni indlela abantu abahamba ngayo. Lo mcimbi uhanjiswe imiklomelo, ukusabalalisa imikhiqizo, kanye nokwabiwa kwezinsiza zokuqhuba. Abamodeli abasha beToyota baqala ukwaziswa ukuze kutholakale ithuba lokuhlola imoto, lokuhamba, namathuba amasha okuhamba ngenqola evuselelekayo, yonke lezi zici zakhangiswa ngokucacile nguToyota. Imoto ye-Toyota RAV4, yomdabu yomndeni wezithuthi ezihamba phambili, yathokozisa izivakashi, phakathi kokuhlola okunembile izici zayo ezintsha. Uhlelo lwe-hybrid lwama Toyota, i-Hybrid Synergy Drive, luhlinzeka ngogesi noshintsho lwemvelo, lwezezimali nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuthatha indawo phambili, luveza umbono ophusile wezakhamizi ezizimele nezithuthi zingase zisebenze kanjani edolobheni elinembile. Emini yalesi sikhumbuzo, abathandi bezimoto bazombangela uToyota ukuba baqhubeke nokwakha, befisa ukuba nemoto eyiqiniso ethatha imisebenzi emisha nezinhlelo zokuthutha eziphumelelayo. Ukuhlanganyela kwabantu abanothando ngemoto kwazisa imikhiqizo yeToyota njengomkhiqizo ohloniphekile, okulungele ikusasa lokwakhiwa kokuhamba okumangalisayo. Ukuzijabulisa okwandile kuhlanganiswe nezinkulumo ezivelele, kusho ukuziphatha kwethu okuguquguqukayo.
