Kwabayizigidi, uToyota usikhumbuza ukuthi izimoto akukhona nje kuphela ukulinganiselwa kwezikhiye, kepha se zinokuphila okukhulu nezitha njengoba kudalwe ubungoma bokuthula emhlabeni. Abathandi bezithuthi banikezwa ithuba lokuxoxa ngezizathu ezahlukene ezenza uToyota uhlale kulesi sikhumbuzo. NgoMfumfu, umcimbi ungenelela ezindaweni eziningi, uToyota uthokozisa izivakashi zawo ngezethulo ezinjengokuvezwa kwemisebenzi emisha ehlanganiswe nobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje. Imoto yeMirai, ethilekiwe nge-hydrogen, ibonisa ukuthi uToyota ungakha okuhlangenwe nakho okungcono ngendlela ebhekele ukwakhiwa kwemoto ehlala isidima. Le nto ibukeka njenge sikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi sizakhele ikamva elihle elisindayo endaweni yokuhamba. Ekuhlosweni kukaToyota, ukwakhiwa kwalezi zinto kuhlotshaniswa nendlela esikwazi ngayo ukufaka isandla esikhulu ezintweni ezenzeka emhlabeni. Ukuthokozisa abathandi bezimoto ezihlukahlukene ngoToyota kwaba nomthelela omuhle, kusiza ukwenza umkhiqizo wanamuhla ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni komnotho. Abantu bahlala behamba neToyota, behlela amaphupho, bekhanyisa izinkanyezi ezakha imiphumela emisha. Lo mcimbi ungumgcele opholile empilweni yeToyota, kuhlanganiswe ngothando olukhona ezithuthwini nasemagcekeni aphephile. Imigubho ebalulekile iqoka abesifazane nabesilisa ngokukhalipha kwezifundo zamaholide, kuqhubeka kuvezwe intuthuko enkulu ekuklanyweni kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokuhamba. Kwakuyigugu ukwazi ukukwenza kahle, ubuhle besigcawu sithokozisa abathandi bezimoto ngokungaphezu kokuhamba ngebhodi le-mobility. Ekugcineni, uToyota uhlala uyisikhumbuzo esihle sokwakha inguquko. Ubusuku obuhlalayo bugubuze umqondo wezemathupha, ubufakazi bokuthi uToyota ungumkhiqizo ogcwele ukuzethemba, ubuchwepheshe nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezizukulwana ezizayo. Umcimbi wenhlangano yeToyota uyisikhumbuzo esihlukile sokwanelisa izidingo zabantu, ubufakazi bokuthi izinkanyezi zesikhathi sethu zithokozisa uma sizithokozisa ngezimoto ezilungisa ukuphila kwethu. Ngakho, uToyota ubalulekile, hhayi kuphela eziteshini, kepha nohlanga lwempilo emhlabeni jikelele, ubufakazi bokuthi isiphakamiso singashintsha impilo yabantu ngendlela eyinkimbinkimbi nehlelekayo.
Izinguquko Zomthetho: Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezibalulekile zomthetho ezihloswe ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo, ezomnotho, kanye nokuphila kwabantu. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi izinqubomgomo ezithinta amalungelo abantu, ukulwa nobugebengu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emthethweni. Umcimbi omkhulu walesi sikhathi wenzeka eGoli, lapho izikhulu zikamasipala, abamele izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinguquko. Uhlelo lwezinkulumo luqukethe izethulo ezivela kubachwepheshe bezomthetho, abameli, kanye nabamele izakhamizi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibono emisha yokuthuthukisa umthetho ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zamanje. Ukwaziswa ngalezi zinguquko kwaba yinto ebalulekile, njengoba umphakathi udinga ukuqonda indlela lezi zinguquko ezizothinta ngayo impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Izinkulumo zakhuluma ngama-akhawunti amasha ezomthetho, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezithinta imithetho yokuhlala, imithetho yokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela abantwana. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Abamele izinkampani baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi izinguquko zomthetho zingasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, kanti abamele izakhamizi bagcizelela ukuthi imithetho kufanele ibheke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uqonda kahle ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azihambisani kuphela nezinqubomgomo, kodwa zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Ukwengeza, umcimbi ubuyekeza izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha. Abaholi bephakamisa ukuthi izinqubo zokuphatha kufanele zibe lula, ziqinise ukwethembeka, futhi zikhuthaze ubumbano phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula emthethweni, bazi ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma bephula umthetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko zomthetho zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta ubuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nezimo zokuhlala. Abaholi baphakamisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumalungelo abantu, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokuvikela abesifazane nezingane. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu bonke, futhi akekho ozoshiywa ngaphandle. Umcimbi ugcizelela ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azifanele kube yinto eyenziwa nguhulumeni kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube neqhaza labantu. Abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba baphathe izinkulumo, baveze imibono yabo, futhi babambe iqhaza ekwakheni umthetho. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinqubweni zomthetho, futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nesibopho sokuziphatha kahle. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukusebenzisana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukuze lezi zinguquko zibe nempumelelo, umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukwakha umthetho ophumelelayo, ovumelanayo, futhi ohloniphekayo. Izinguquko zomthetho zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, futhi ubuchwepheshe obusha bungasiza ekwenzeni lezi zinguquko zibe ngempumelelo. Umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, izinguquko zomthetho zingaba yinsika yempumelelo. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wezinguquko zomthetho awuqedi nje kuphela izinkulumo, kodwa uveza umbono omusha wokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi kanjani ukuhamba phambili. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ithemba, zikhuthaza ubumbano, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana, futhi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukugqugquzela abantu ukuba baphathe izinkulumo ezibalulekile ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Umbiko: Ukushoda Kwamithi Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela sekuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu kubantu abanesidingo semithi, kubandakanya abazithola ezibhedlela, emitholampilo, nasemakhaya. Ukushoda kwemithi kudinga ukuthi kukhishwe izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imithi abayidingayo ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ukwanda Kokushoda Kwamithi Ezemitholampilo eNingizimu Afrika zikhombisa ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi akukhona nje kuphela ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubangelwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, imitholampilo ikhalela ukungabi khona kokwanele kwemali yokuthenga imithi. Ngaphandle kwemali eyanele, abahlinzeki bezempilo abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithi eyanele kubantu abadinga ukwelashwa. Okwesibili, izinkinga zokuhamba kwemithi zikhona. Imitholampilo eminingi ibhekene nezinkinga zokuthola imithi efanele ngesikhathi, okwandisa isikhathi sokulinda kwabantu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abahlinzeki bemithi badinga ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithengisa imithi, futhi uma lezi zinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka, imithi iyashoda. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kwamithi Ukushoda kwemithi kudala umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Abantu abangenayo imithi abayidingayo bahlala besaba ukuvela kwezifo, okwandisa umphumela wokugula. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungaphili kahle, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuqhuba imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Isibonelo, abantu abaneziguli ezinzima ezifana nesifo sikashukela, umkhuhlane, noma isifo sezinso, badinga imithi ethile ukuze baphile. Uma le mithi ingatholakali, izinga labo lokuphila lincipha, futhi bangaqhubeka bephila ngokweqile, kwandise umthwalo wezempilo ohlinzekwa ohulumeni. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nokushoda Kwamithi Ukuze kuphumelele ekulweni nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela, kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele aqinise izinsiza ezikhona ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokwandisa imali ethunyelwa ezibhedlela, kanye nokuqinisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabahlinzeki bemithi nabathengi. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezithengisa imithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imitholampilo iyathola imithi ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ekuhlinzekeni ngemithi ngesikhathi, okuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kubantu abadinga imithi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisiza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela imithi online kungasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imithi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Imiphumela yokushoda kwemithi ibonakala kahle, futhi izixazululo eziphusile kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imithi abayidingayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele akusizi kuphela abantu abanesidingo, kodwa kuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo, kufaka phakathi uhulumeni, abahlinzeki bemithi, nezinkampani, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle kakhulu kubantu bonke.
Uphuthu: Izimfihlo Zomkhiqizo Wendabuko Isingeniso Uphuthu, umkhiqizo obalulekile ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke, uthathwa njengemfihlo yokuphila kahle. Lezi zinkanyezi eziphilayo zinezinsiza eziningi, ezifaka phakathi impilo enhle, ubuchwepheshe bokudla, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukisa impilo. Kulesi sikhathi, sizohlola imvelaphi yephuthu, ukusebenza kwalo, nezindlela ezahlukene zokuwakha. Imvelaphi yePuthu Uphuthu, okwakwaqanjwa ngezizathu eziningi, kuphila ngokwakha izimo ezintathu noma ezine. Izinceku zitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, zikhula njalo, futhi ziwusizo ezindaweni zokudla. Kancane kancane, uphuthu ufake izimpande ezinzulu emiphakathini yethu, ukuze uthakasele amathuba amaningi. E-Afrika, uphuthu uthathwa njengophuhliso lwemvelo, lapho abantu bezama ukusimama. Ukuze sisebenzise izinzuzo zalo, abantu baqala ukujwayela ukuphuza uphuthu, okubengabantu abahlukahlukene. Izindlela Zokwakha Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu, uma ikhuluma ngezindlela zokwakha, kudingeka ulwazi olunembile. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza amahlamvu afanele ukuze umkhiqizo uqine. Ukuze uphuthu lungathola usawoti, udinga ukudla kahle, uhlole izakhiwo, uqinisekise ukuthi uyathanda, bese uxhumanisa nemishanguzo emisha. Abakhiqizi basebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokwenza uhlanga lwephuthu, kubandakanya ukukhetha amahlamvu ahlanzekile, ukuwaqinisekisa ngokuhlanza kahle. Ngemuva kwalokho, badlula ezinyathelweni ezahlukene, kusuka ekuvuthweni, ukuze uhlanga lube nophethiloli, kube neqhaza elikhulu emandleni engqondo nasempilweni yomzimba. Izinzuzo zePuthu Emzimbini Nasempilweni Uphuthu ubonakaliswa ngokukwazi ukudala impilo engcono. Njengoba usetshenziswa kwezithako ezifanele, uthuthukisa ukukhula kwezakhi zofuzo, uqinisa isikhumba, futhi unciphisa izinhlungu ezinzima. Thina njengabantu, singancoma ikhono lephuthu lokusiza emithini, okwenze kube umkhiqizo ongakhalipha nezinhliziyo zethu. Ngokwemvelo, uphuthu uhlanganisa izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze izicubu zibe namandla. Abantu abahamba phambili ngezokwelapha baveza imiphumela emihle lezi zihloko zinikezwa ngalesi sikhathi sokudla. Kukhona izeluleko eziningi ezivela kumalungu omphakathi ezikhuthaza ukuthokozela uphuthu njengesixazululo sezikhalazo ezithile. Izindlela Zokusebenzisa Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu lungasetshenziswa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene emakhishini. Abaningi bazi ukudla uphuthu bezikhandla nezithako ezithile, bakha izithako eziphumelelayo. Ukuze uphuthu lungalethi imiphumela emibi, kubalulekile ukujwayela izindlela eziphumelelayo zokulawula ukwenzeka. Ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza, okumele kubalulelwe ukuhloza izimpawu zephuthu ezikhankanyisiwe. Ukubheka Izenzo Zokuthinta Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu uwumkhiqizo ophephile, kodwa umphakathi unokufaneleka ekusizeni uhambile. Amazingnazo uma kwenzeka kudlalwa ngamaqhinga akudala, akusizi. Umuntu noma imiphakathi kumele ibone ukuthi izinsiza ezithile ziyasebenza kanjani. Uhlanga lwephuthu luhlobene kakhulu nomphakathi, kulandela izinkolelo, kuthinta ubudlelwane bezimpilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uphuthu uyibhalansi ebaluleke kakhulu. Abantu base-Afrika bahlala benalo lonke ulwazi olunembile nolwakudala lokugcina uqondiso eceleni kwezinsuku zanamuhla. Ngakho, KwaZulu-Natal, izikhukhula zashiya izinkumbulo, kodwa zashiya nethuba lokwakha kabusha, ubumbano, nokuthi abantu bahlala bejolisa, bephokophelela empilweni yabo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izimo zingabi lula, ubumbano lungakha amandla amakhulu.
uMark Zuckerberg: Umholi Oguqula Umhlaba Wezokuxhumana uMark Zuckerberg, umdali weFacebook, ubhekwa njengomholi ophambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezihlobene nokubambisana, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu kubuchwepheshe. Ubulili bakhe buwubufakazi bokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungagcina buhamba phambili emhlabeni. Wazalwa ngo-1984 eWhite Plains, eNew York, waba neziqu zokujabulela ubuchwepheshe kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho aqala khona ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ustudying eHarvard University, uZuckerberg wahlangana nabangane bakhe ababili, uEduardo Saverin, uAndrew McCollum, uDustin Moskovitz, noChris Hughes, bese besungula iFacebook ngo-2004. Le nsizakalo, eyayincane ekuqaleni, yashintsha yaba yinsiza ethokozisayo yokuxhumana, ivumela abantu emhlabeni wonke ukuba baxhumane kalula. Ngemuva kokuthola impumelelo enkulu, iFacebook yaba yinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. UZuckerberg wengeze ezinye izici ezibalulekile ezifana neMessaging neNews Feed, ezaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabantu. Ubulunga bakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe buholele ekukhuleni okukhulu kweFacebook, okwenza kube yinkampani enezigidi zabantu abasebenzisi emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, impumelelo kaZuckerberg akukhona ukuhleleka kuphela; iFacebook ibhekane nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubugwegwe, nokukhwabanisa. UZuckerberg uphinde wavuma ukuhluleka kokuphatha kahle idatha yomsebenzisi, okwaholela ezinkulumweni ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kwezenzakalo ezinjengeCambridge Analytica. UZuckerberg akagxili kuphela kwiFacebook; uthakazelisa ngezinto ezifana nezobuchwepheshe bokwenziwa (AI) kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo emphakathini. Ube nezinhloso zokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kukhuthazwe abantu ukusiza umphakathi, nokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Umzamo wakhe wokuthuthukisa impilo emphakathini ubonisa isifiso sokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. UMark Zuckerberg uqhubeka nokuhola emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ehlanganisa ubungcweti bakhe ukuze athuthukise izimo zabantu. Ubuyele emiphakathini ehlukene ukuze abone izindlela zokuthuthukisa inhlalakahle yabantu. UZuckerberg ukhombisa ukuzimisela ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibhekene neFacebook, enikeza izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ukholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi kufanele kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Uzenzela izinhlelo ezihlobene nokufinyelela ku-Internet, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezintweni ezisemqoka. Ekugcineni, uMark Zuckerberg ungumbhali wesizukulwane esisha somholi wezobuchwepheshe. Uthole ukwazi ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni ibhizinisi lakhe ngenkathi efuna ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibucayi. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungahamba phambili, kodwa abantu badinga ukuthatha umthwalo wemfanelo ekusizeleni. UZuckerberg usaqhubeka nokuhola, ekhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe lungasetshenziswa ukuze kuqedwe ukuxhumana okuhlangene, okudala amathuba angcono kubantu bonke. Ngenxa yalesi sithombe, uMark Zuckerberg usazoba ngumholi ophumelelayo ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kumaphrojekthi amahle asazoba khona, futhi ikusasa lilindele uMark Zuckerberg namaphrojekthi azayo.
Impilo Yabafundi: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Impilo yabafundi ibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, iyinsika ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Nokho, le mpilo inezici ezingezinhle. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi izinkinga ezinzima ezihambisana nayo. Kulokhu, sizophendula imibuzo emibili ebalulekile: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezikhona empilweni yabafundi? Futhi, yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nabafundi? Izinzuzo Zempilo Yabafundi Okokuqala, impilo yabafundi inikeza amathuba amaningi okukhula. Abafundi bangaqonda izinto ezintsha, bakhe ubudlelwano, futhi bathole amakhono abalulekile. Isibonelo, imisebenzi yokuzithandela inika abafundi ithuba lokubambisana futhi iqinisa ukuqonda kwabo ngezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakhule babe ngabantu abakhuthazayo emiphakathini yabo. Okwesibili, impilo yabafundi iyindlela yokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izikhathi ezikhethekile, njengezinsuku zokugcina nemicimbi yokuhlonipha, zenza kube lula ukukhumbula izikhathi ezinhle zempilo. Lezi zinkumbulo zihlala zikhumbuleka, ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, futhi zenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabafundi inika abafundi ithuba lokuthuthukisa amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Abafundi bahlala bejuggling phakathi kwezifundo, imisebenzi, nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kubafundisa indlela yokuphatha isikhathi sabo, okubalulekile empilweni yabo yangemva kokuphothula izifundo. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi aqinisa ukuzimela, futhi akha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphumelela emsebenzini. Izinkinga Zempilo Yabafundi Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle empilweni yabafundi. Kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukunakwa. Okokuqala, ingcindezi yokufunda iyinkinga enkulu. Abafundi bahlushwa umthwalo omkhulu wokufunda, okungaholela ekucindezelweni nasekukhathazekeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bahlupheke ngengqondo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqonde lokhu ukuze zinikeze usizo olufanele. Okwesibili, izinkinga zezimali ziyaqhubeka zikhula. Abafundi abaningi baphila ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele zokufunda, okuhlanganisa imali yokufunda nezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kudala umthwalo omkhulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zicabangele izixazululo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabafundi ibhekene nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abafundi abaningi bahlala ezindlini zokuhlala ezibizayo, okuholela ezinselelweni zokuthola indawo yokuhlala efanelekile. Lokhu kudala izinselelo, njengoba abafundi bengenakugxila ezifundweni zabo ngenxa yezinkinga zokuhlala. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, impilo yabafundi inezinzuzo eziningi ezibalulekile, kodwa ibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuze balwe nezinselelo ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lwezimpilo. Izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi baphumelela. Impilo yabafundi iyinsakavukela, futhi uma ibhekwa kahle, ingaba yinsika eqinile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yomfundi Ngokwenyama, imiphumela yezivivinyo ithathwa njengophawu lokuphumelela noma ukwehluleka empilweni yomfundi. Lezi zifundo zenzeka ezikhathini ezithile, futhi abanye bahlala bejabule, kuyilapho abanye bephinde bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Imiphumela iyinsika yokuhlola umsebenzi owenziwe ngesikhathi sokufunda, kodwa umqondo wayo udinga ukuba ubhekwe ngokujulile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo ayisho ukuthi umphumela walezi zifundo yindawo yokugcina. Ezinye izici, ezifana nokusebenza kwezemfundo, ukuzimisela, kanye nekhono lokucabanga okujulile, zibalulekile. Abafundi bahlala befundiswa ukuthi kufanele basebenzise lezi zici ukuze baphumelele empilweni, hhayi kuphela ezivivinyweni. Ngakho-ke, uma umfundi engaphumeleli, akufanele abone lokho njengokwehluleka. Kungase kube nemibandela ethile ethinta impumelelo yakhe, njengezimo zomndeni, ukungabi namathuba, noma izinkinga zempilo. Okwesibili, imiphumela yezivivinyo ingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengqondo yomfundi. Ukuhluleka emivivinyweni kungaholela ekudabukeni, okungaholela ekuhluphekeni kwengqondo noma ukudangala. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yingozi, ikakhulukazi uma umfundi engakwazi ukuhamba phambili nezimo ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha, abazali, nabangane babe nesineke nokuqonda lapho imiphumela ingeyinhle. Ukubonisana, ukufundisa, nokukhuthaza kufanele kube yizinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze umfundi azitholele ukuzethemba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa izifundo eziningi ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukwazi ukubona ukuthi yini engasebenza, nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Umfundi kufanele afunde ekutheni ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela ekubhaleni iziphumo ezinhle, kodwa futhi nasekufundeni eziphumeleni eziphansi. Ukubhekisisa lezi ziphumo kuyavula amathuba okwenza ngcono, futhi kuyakwenza umfundi akhuthazeke kakhulu. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuba afune usizo, agcizelele ezindaweni azidingayo, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima. Bese sikhuluma ngendima ebalulekile yokuhlonza nemiphumela. Uma umfundi ethola imiphumela emihle, lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yithuba lokukhuthazwa. Ukuphumelela kudinga ukubonwa, kudingeka kuxhaswe, ukuze umfundi azizwe eqinisekile. Lokhu kungenza umfundi abheke phambili, agxile ezifundweni zakhe, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze athole okungcono. Noma kunjalo, uma umphumela ungavumi, umphumela ungase ube yithuba lokuba umfundi abone ukuthi akakafiki lapho afuna khona. Ngokujulile, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibalulekile, kodwa kufanele kube kucace ukuthi akufanele kube yisithiyo sokuphumelela. Umfundi kufanele azitholele indlela yakhe, ahlaziye imiphumela, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza. Lokhu kuyokwenza kube lula ukuba akhuthaze abanye, futhi adale umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokuxhaswa kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo iyinsika yokufunda, kodwa akufanele ibonakale njengosizo lokugcina. Kuningi okungafundwa, nokufundwa kuphumelelisa abanye ukuze benze kahle empilweni. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphumela njengengxenye encane ye-journey yempumelelo, hhayi ukuphela kwayo. Ngakho, asivumelani ukuba imiphumela ibe yinkinga, kodwa siyivumele ukuba ibe yithuba lokukhula, ukufundisa, nokuphumelela.
Izimpi ZamaZulu: Ukuhlola Ulimi Nokuhlonipha Izinhlanga Zethu Izimpi zamaZulu, ezaziwa kakhulu emlandweni, ziwumlando obalulekile, ophinde ubonise ukuzidela, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe. Lezi zimpi zenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-19, ngesikhathi sokuphikisana phakathi kweZizwe, izimpi zomhlaba, kanye nezinguquko ezazihambisana nezepolitiki. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zimpi zazikhona ngenxa yokulwa; zaziyingxenye yomlando obanzi wezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwaziswa Kwezimpi ZamaZulu Izimpi zamaZulu ziqalile ngonyaka we-1830, lapho uShaka Zulu, umholi ophakeme, eqala ukuhlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo esisodwa. UShaka, owaziwa ngokuqinisa ubuholi bakhe, wakhulisa umphakathi wakwaZulu ngokwakha izikhali ezinamandla, izindlela zokulwa, kanye nokuhlela izimpi. UShaka waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile, esaziwa ngokuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Ngemuva kokubulawa kukaShaka ngo-1828, umfowabo uDingane wathatha ubuholi. U-Dingane waba neziqu ezinkulu, kodwa impi eyaziwa kakhulu yenzeka ngonyaka we-1838, ngesikhathi seMpi yaseNcome. Le mpi yahlasela izixuku zamaNgisi, ikakhulukazi iVoortrekkers, ababephuma eKapa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uDingane wayefuna ukuvikela umhlaba wakwaZulu, kodwa impi yaphenduka yaba yinhlekelele. IVoortrekkers, bejabulile ngezinqumo zabo, bahlasela iNcome, kwaholela ekubulaweni kwamaZulu abaningi. Izimbangela Zokulwa Izimpi zamaZulu zazihambisana nezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi nempumelelo kwezomnotho, ukungaboni ngaso linye kwezombusazwe, kanye nezifiso ezihlukene zezinhlanga. Ukuphikisana phakathi kweZizwe kwakhuthaza izimpi, njengoba amaZulu ezama ukuvikela umhlaba wabo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izimpi zibe yindlela yokuphikisa, yokuzama ukuphila, nokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. Iziphumo Nezimpilo ZamaZulu Izimpi zashiya umphakathi wakwaZulu unokuhlukumezeka okukhulu. Ngemva kweMpi yaseNcome, amaZulu abhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, kuhlanganisa ukulahlekelwa kwemithombo yokuphila, izinsiza, kanye nezwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni zabo ukuze baphile. Nokho, izimpi zakhuthaza umoya wokuzidela, ubumbano, nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ukwamukela Umqondo Wokuhlonipha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimpi zamaZulu zaba yinkumbulo yokuhlonipha. Izinsuku zokuqhubeka kwempi zaba yizinsuku zokuhlonipha, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bakhumbule abaholi babo, izimpi zabo, kanye nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umoya wokuhlonipha, ukuqonda, nokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ukubaluleka Komlando Umqondo wezimpilo zamaZulu ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungakha kanjani, ukulwa, nokwakha izindlela zokuphila. Izimpi zifundisa abantu ukuthi ubuholi, ukuhlela, nokuhlalisana kwezizwe kudinga ukuqonda nokubambisana. Umhlaba wamaZulu ungumlando wezinto eziningi, futhi izimpi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephila ngokuhlonipha, benza izinqumo ezihloniphekile, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Isiphetho Izimpi zamaZulu ziwumlando ophawulekayo, ogcwele izifundo ezibalulekile. Zifundisa abantu ukuthi impi ingaphezu kokulwa; iyindlela yokwakha, yokuhlonipha, nokugcina isiko. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lezi zifundo, sihlole indlela esingakha ngayo umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Umlandweni wamaZulu kufanele uhlale uhlonishwa, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule izimpilo zabantu bethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Inkolo Nomoya Emkhathini owawugubungele idolobhana elincane elalibizwa ngokuthi uMfumalanga, kwakukhona abantu abahloniphekile ababesebenzisa inkolo njengesikhumbuzo sokuhle. Babezokhuluma ngezimfundiso zabo ngemibono ethokozisayo, baphinde beza nemikhosi emikhulu yokuhlanganyela. Kule ndawo, inkolo kwakungaphezu kokholo; kwakuwumoya owawuhambisana nabo enhliziyweni, ukwazi ukuqonda izimpilo zabo nokuqhubeka bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene. UMaMkhize, uMama omkhulu emkhaya, wayebonwa njengomholi wezenkolo. Wayeqonda kahle izinkolelo zabantu, futhi izingoma zikaMakhulu, zazingabhalwa ngendlela yokukhumbuza imihla yokuhlonipha abaphilayo nabangasekho. Ngemuva kokukhulelwa kwengane, uMaMkhize wayehlala esebenzisa isikhumbuzo seNkosi neMoya, ebonisa indlela yokuthokozisa nophoqelelwayo. Wayevezwa ngamakhono akhe okukhanyisa intshonalanga, ememezela izikhalazo ezazikhulunywa ngezinkanyezi zenkolelo. Ngemva kokuphuma kwelanga, uMaMkhize wayefunda kubantwana, ebaphethe ngezinsuku zempilo zesintu. Ikhaya lale nkolo laligcwele izimfundiso ezibhaliwe phansi. "Noma izinsuku zikhanya, kulandela isiko lethu," wayeqhubeka ethi. "Inkolo yisisekelo sokuhlanganisa umndeni, sithandazela isimo sengqondo esihle." Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwemikhosi, abantu bebenomoya ophakanyisiwe. Umoya wawuvulwe ngezingoma, izikhumbuzo zothando nokuhlonipha kwemithombo yabo. Isiko lokukhuleka laliyinsika eyayiqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Kwakufanele uhloniphe imiphakathi, eziyindilinga ezincane nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha umoya. “UbuMoya buhambisana nomoya wethu,” uMaMkhize wayephinda njalo, ethula izimfundiso ezisemqoka ezazincike ezindaweni eziphakeme. Esikhathini esiningi, umkhuleko wawungenisa abantu emoyeni. UMaMkhize wayebathumele ngokuphathelene nezikhathi zothando, uchwepheshe ekuhlinzekeni ngempilo ejabulisayo. Ngemva kwemikhuleko, abantu babelokhu bejabulela umoya ophakanyisiwe, bezwa uMoya kanti baphakathi centro bemifino nabo. Ukukunika umoya ophakeme kwakungakhumbuza ubuhle bezinto eziphilayo. Uhlanga lwesiko lwakhe, uMaMkhize wayequka izigaba. Wagenisa ishidi lokuhlanganisa abantwana, elalithinta umndeni nomoya. Izingane zazingathokozisi kuphela, zaziya ekukhulekeni, zibhalela ezandleni zabo. “Kufanele sikhumbule, uMoya udinga izinyathelo eziphakeme!” wayesho. Ngaleso sikhathi, indlela eya emoyeni yokuhlonipha yaphucuka, ibaluleka ngaphansi komoya ongenamkhawulo. Kwakunezikhathi lapho abantu babekhuluma ngezindaba ezinzima, ezazihlanganisa nempilo yabo. Kwakufanele baqonde ukuthi amalingo ayazenzakalela — izinyathelo ezinomoya, izizinde zokwethembeka, nezinye izinkinga. Ngenkathi bezincika emoyeni, uMaMkhize wabathokozisa, ebonisa indlela abangahlangabezana nezinkinga eziphathelene nemizwa. “Abohlanga bezinsuku, ngubani ongafakhile,” wayetshala izinkumbulo zezimpi ezazihlanganisiwe. Umoya, lapho usetshenziselwa ukuphakamisa izwi, waba isicinci esihambisana nezinsuku zempilo. Abesifazane abangamaNguni babengabakhumbuli besekela uMaMkhize. UMaMkhize wayebhalela izinkumbulo emizileni, ezikhumbuza ngemisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kwakungathi kudalwe umoya, uma wonke umuntu eyethembe. Kwathi lapho umoya uphakamisa njengebhande, Iziqhwaga zenzeka. UMaMkhize ngabomvu wathokoza ukuzigqaja. Phakathi komoya ohewuliwe, bathokozisa imizamo yabo, beka isigubhu esinothando tabanisa. Imikhuleko yaha ngezindlela ezimbili: … kwazulu, imanji. UMaMkhize wagubha ukusebenza phakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi. Ngaphezu kokuzithokozisa, imikhosi yafakazela isiko lesintu, iqiniso elithokozisayo elalisondela ezintweni ezisemqoka. Kwaziwa njalo ukuthi, uma umoya ungena, imisebenzi ikhuluma. Sekukhona izinsuku eziphindaphindiwe, abadala bayathokoziswa. Izesekeli zalolu hlobo kulandela abavela ezinhliziyweni zomthetho. Abantu abayikhipha onke amaphuzu, enza uthando lunamandla, behamba emkhathini unomoya wakhe omkulu. Umlando ube yinhlebo ejabulisayo, umoya uthokozisa, ingcwele, futhi ubumbene phakathi kwabo. UMaMkhize wayevuma lokhu, ukuthi nje umoya wokholo uthokozisa, ubuMoya buhamba ndawonye nomoya kanye namathuba. Ngomoya, umuntu wonke uzogubha umthandazo, uMoya usitu abavukayo, labeMoyeni, ephakamisa izingoma ezibhalwa ngobuqotho. Emkhathini uphinde uqhubeke, ludumo lwezinwele ezishubile, kwasuka umoya, kanti ibhodi yomoya yenzeka. Ukufuna, umoya umncane phansi, nokusebenza, kwenza kube nzima ukufunzwa. Noma uthando ludinga umoya ophakeme, umkhuleko uthengisa izinkumbulo. Bahlala bejabulile, indawo ehambelana nezimo zomuntu kanti uMaMkhize, wahamba phakathi kwamazinga ezinkanyezi, ebonisa okukhanyayo kumoya. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka, umoya uhlezi eduze nezinsuku, ubumbene, ikakhulukazi emkhathini. Umhlaba uqhubeka nomoya. UMaMkhize wayebona umgubho wempilo uqhubekayo, kanti umoya uhlezi uqhubeka, ungashintshi. Ngaleyo ndlela, abantwana bahlala bezithokozisa behamba ngemigqa yomoya, ubuhlobo obuhluke kancane, kodwa bobabili berekoding. Nakuba izinto zishintshile, umoya uhlala uphinde uphakamise. Umlando, umoya, unguMaMkhize, uthina, kuwumoya. Umoya wakho ukhanya namuhla, uqhubeka nokukhanya, uthokozisa umhlaba, uqhubeka busuku nobusuku.
Kwake kwaba nomuzi omncane obizwa ngeMkhumbane, lapho abantu babephila impilo ejabulisayo, begcwele imidlalo nezinsuku ezimnandi. Kule ndawo, kwakukhona umgibeli ophumelelayo odlalela abanye iCheckers. Igama lakhe linguSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nane. U-Sipho wayeyintokozo emzaneni, enobungane, futhi wayaziwa kakhulu ngezinsuku azichitha edlalela abanye. Njalo ngempelasonto, uSipho wayehamba ehlathini eliseduze nomuzi, elandela umphakathi wabelusi nabantwana ababejabulile. Uhlanga lwemithi lwalufana nendawo yokudlala, imithi emikhulu ihlukaniswe izindawo zokudlala ezahlukene. Abantwana babedlala iCheckers, behlukanisa amaphakethe amancane abewathola ezitolo, besebenzisa izinto ezitholakala endaweni, njengamapulangwe noma amathoyizi. U-Sipho wayehamba phambili, ethokozisa abanye ngekhono lakhe lokudlala. Lokhu kwenza abanye bezwa umdlandla wokuhlangana ukuze babone umdlalo, njengoba bekhumbula ukuthi uSipho uhlala edlala ukuze enze ubungani, hhayi ukuze anqobe. Ngempela, umdlalo wawungaphezu kokuphumelela; wawukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wahlangana noThandi, intombazane ethokozisayo enothando lokudlala. UThandi wayenobuchule bokuhlola amasu amasha, okwakuholela ekwakheni umphakathi omusha, lapho bonke bahlala beyindlalifa. U-Sipho noThandi badlala imidlalo ethokozisayo, behlakanipha ngendlela evelele. Bafuna izinkanyezi eziphuma phezulu, bezama ukufaka izinhlelo ezahlukene ukuze baphumelele. Njengoba bedlala, bahlola izinkambo ezintsha, benza izinqumo ezinzima, bezama ukuqonda izindlela zokuqeda izitha zabo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uSipho uthola ukuthi ukudlala iCheckers akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda. Ubuqotho, ubuhlobo, nokubambisana kwenzeka ngenhliziyo, okwenza umdlalo ube mnandi kakhulu. Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. Umphakathi wabe unokukhanya okukhulu, njengoba abantwana baphokophela phambili, befunda futhi begcina ubudlelwano obubanzi. U-Sipho noThandi baqala ukuhlela umjaho omkhulu weCheckers wendawo, bahlola ukuthi abantu bayakuthokozela yini. Umjaho wawuhloswe ukuxhumanisa wonke umphakathi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obukhudlwana phakathi kwabantu. Ngesikhathi sokubamba umjaho, uSipho noThandi babebonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma ubambisana. Abantu behlangana, behlukanisa iziphuzo nezitsha, bejabulisa imindeni eminingi. U-Sipho wanikela ngeziqhamo, uThandi wanikela ngezinsuku ezimnandi ezithokozisayo. Umjaho wabe ubuyisa imizwa emihle, ukuncintisana kwaba yinto eyenzeka, kodwa umphakathi wawumkhumbula, ubudlelwano bukhula bese kudlula imidlalo. Ngemuva komjaho, uSipho noThandi bahlala phansi, behlangana nabantu abavela kwaMkhumbane. Babebonisa ubufakazi bokuthi iCheckers ingaba umphakathi owodwa. U-Sipho waphakamisa ingxenye ethakazelisayo - "Umdlalo akukhona nje ukuwina, kodwa ukuhamba ndawonye. Lokhu kudlula impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abavuma ukusiza." Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. U-Sipho noThandi baqhubeka bedlala, bezikhandla nezinye izizukulwane. ICheckers yabe isiyinsiza yokubambisana, yokuhlanganyela, nokuqonda ukuthi ubuhlobo bukhulu kakhulu kunokuthola amaphuzu. USipho waqala ukufaka izifundo ezithile kumfundo, asho ukuthi umdlalo ufundisa umqondo wokuhlanganyela, ukweseka, nezinto ezinhle ezidlalwayo. Njengoba uSipho noThandi bephumelela, umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula. Umdlalo wawubalulekile, kanti abantu baqala ukucabanga ngamasu amasha. U-Sipho wafunda indlela yokubambisana, nokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma wonke umuntu enza isinyathelo. Ngakho-ke, umuzi waqhubeka nokukhanya, ubuhlobo bukhulisa izinsuku ezinhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani buvela ebudlelwaneni. ICheckers yabe isikhalazo sokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho noThandi baphokophela phambili, bekhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophelele, besebenzisa umdlalo ukuze bakhe izixhumanisi ezinzima. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuthi umphakathi ungakha umhlaba ophumelelayo uma wonke umuntu edlala ndawonye. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga, kodwa umgibeli owayethanda iCheckers wahamba phambili. U-Sipho noThandi bahlala bejabule, bephokophela phambili, bathe izinkanyezi zihamba, bezama ukuhamba ndawonye, ukuze umphakathi ube ngcono. Futhi, bahlala bejabulile emzaneni, baqhubeka bedlala, bezindla izikhathi ezinhle, bejabulisa abanye ngothando lwabo lokukhuthaza. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo seCheckers esikhulu - lapho ukudlalela, ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganyela kuhlonishwa, umphakathi ubuyisela umphakathi. ICheckers yabe isibonelo sokuthi ukuxhumana kwethu kwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Nokuhlola Izindlela Zokuphila Impilo yengqondo iyisihloko esibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, esithinta wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki iminyaka, ubulili, noma isimo somnotho. Ngaphandle kokuphila kahle emzimbeni, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ukuze siqhubeke siphila impilo egcwele, enempilo. Lokhu kuhlola impilo yengqondo kuhilela ukuqonda izinkinga zengqondo, izimpawu zazo, kanye nezindlela zokuzilungisa. Izizathu Zokukhathazeka Ngempilo Yengqondo Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani impilo yengqondo ibalulekile. Okokuqala, izinkinga zengqondo zingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu empilweni yomuntu, kubandakanya ukwehla kokusebenza, ubudlelwano obuphukile, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yomzimba. Ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, nokukhathazeka kwengqondo, uma kungalashwa, kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima, njengokuziphindisela, ukungazithandi, noma ngisho nokuziphilisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunempilo. Abantu abaphila kahle ngokwengqondo bavame ukuba nekhono lokuxhumana kahle nabanye, bakwazi ukuxazulula izingxabano, futhi babe nempilo engcono yokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile emndenini, emsebenzini, nakumiphakathi yethu. Izimpawu Zokuphazamiseka Kwengqondo Ukuze siqonde kahle impilo yengqondo, kubalulekile ukufunda ngezimpawu ezihlobene nezinkinga zengqondo. Izimpawu zihluka kumuntu nomuntu, kodwa ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka, ukungabi nandaba, ukungaphatheki kahle, ukucasuka kalula, kanye nokuhlukumezeka. Uma umuntu ezwa lezi zimpawu isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthi afune usizo, kungaba kudokotela, kumelaphi wezengqondo, noma kumuntu omtrust. Izindlela Zokuphila Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Yengqondo Kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Okokuqala, ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokukhulisa impilo yengqondo. Ukuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, noma ukuhamba emanzini kungasiza ekwehliseni ukucindezeleka futhi kukhulise umoya. Ukudla kahle, okuhlanganisa ukudla okunezithelo, imifino, noshukela ophansi, nakho kunomthelela omuhle empilweni yengqondo. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana nabantu abaseduze, njengemindeni nabangane, kubalulekile. Ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zakho nabanye kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yomphakathi, efana nezinhlelo zokuzithandela, nakho kungakhulisa umuzwa wokuxhumana nabanye. Okwesithathu, ukuzithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, njengokufunda, ukudlala imidlalo, noma ukwenza ubuciko, kungasiza ekwakheni umoya ophilayo. Ukuhlola izindlela zokuphumula, njenge-yoga noma ukujula, nakho kunikeza ithuba lokuthola ukuthula kwengqondo. Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Yengqondo Ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile. Imfundo mayelana nezinkinga zengqondo, izimpawu zazo, nezindlela zokuzilungisa kufanele kube yingxenye yezinhlelo zemfundo ezikoleni nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile futhi kufanele ihlonishwe njengempilo yomzimba. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abanezinkinga zengqondo, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelapha, zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ezidingekayo. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesithakazelo sokwakha izindawo eziphilayo, lapho abantu bezokwazi khona ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Isiphetho Impilo yengqondo iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuqonda, ukwelashwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwempilo yengqondo kufanele kube yinto esiyigxilile, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, egcwele, nenjabulo. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, ukuxhasa abanye, nokuzithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphila impilo egcwele nempilo.
I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo: Isikhungo Sokuzimela Kwamalungelo Nezibopho Zethu I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, njengoba iyinhlangano eyinhloko eqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yethu iyahambisana nezimiso zomthethosisekelo. Le nkantolo ibhekelele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enobulungiswa, kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umthetho uyaphumelela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indima yayo, izinselelo ezibhekene nayo, kanye nezindlela zokuqinisa le nkantolo ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle. Ukuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayikona nje kuphela indawo yokuxazulula izingxabano, kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umthetho awuhambisani nezifiso zomuntu siqu, kodwa uhamba phambili ekukhulumeni ngezinhloso ezinkulu. Isebenza njengomgibeli phakathi kokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zomphakathi nokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, lapho imithetho ingase ingahambisani nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukuthi abantu abaningi basawubona umthetho njengenhlangano ethile, hhayi njengesikhungo sokuvikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabantu nemithetho. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngezindlela zokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwale nkantolo. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, bahlushwa ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo, ukuze bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa lapho kudingeka. Ngaphandle kokwaziswa, abantu bangase bahlupheke, bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale benamathele ezinqubweni ezingalungile. Kodwa-ke, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayinakho ukufinyelela kuphela; kufanele futhi ibe nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Izinqubo ezinzima nezinde zingadala ukuthi abantu baphoxeke, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphumelele emacaleni abo. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokwenza izinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zayo kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo kufanele ibonise ubuholi obuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahluleli bayo kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu, kodwa futhi babe nekhono lokuphatha izindaba ezinzima. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezithile ezidingekayo, abahluleli kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izimo ezithile, bahlolisise izimo ezihlukene, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esihambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ekugcineni, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokuhlonipha amalungelo omunye nomunye. Ukuze le nkantolo iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwayo, sithuthukise izinqubo zayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abahluleli bayo banobuholi obuqinile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa, nolwazi oluqinile ngamalungelo abantu. Ngakho, asiqhubeke sikhuluma, sikhuthaza, futhi sithuthukise iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza njengesikhungo sokuzimela, ukuvikela amalungelo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kudinga imizamo eminingi, kodwa uma sisebenzisana, singakha ikusasa elingcono, elinobulungiswa, nelivumelanayo.
Abalimi BaseNingizimu Afrika: Umgogodla Wokuphila Kwethu Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika bangabantu ababalulekile empilweni yethu. Bahlala bephakathi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zomnotho wethu, benza umsebenzi onzima ukuze sihlale sithola ukudla okwakhiwe ngothando, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemizamo yabo. Abalimi bethu, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokweqiniso, abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, kanye nezinkinga zokuthola izinsiza, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu. Nokho, abanye bethu basakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho umhlaba wawugcwele izithelo nezitshalo, lapho imifino yayikhula kahle, futhi lapho umoya wawugcwele iphunga lempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha imizamo yabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa bahlala bephikelela. Ukusebenza kwabo akugcini nje ngokukhiqiza ukudla, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukugcina amasiko ethu, imikhuba, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinselelo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokuhlala, zikhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezindlini ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihlobene nezokwakhiwa kwezindlu, okuhlanganisa izinselelo, izindlela zokuthuthukisa, kanye nemithetho ethinta le mikhakha. Isingeniso Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu ziqala ngokuhlonza izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinga lokuhlala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhathaniswe nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala ezindlini ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, nabakhi bezindlu. Izinselelo Ezinzima Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokwakha kuyinselelo enkulu. Izindleko zokwakha ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezindlini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, ezihlanganisa imithetho yokwakha, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakhiweni kwezindlu. Imithetho ethile ingavimbela abakhi ekwakheni izindlu ezidingekayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Okwesibili, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengamanzini, ugesi, nezokuthutha, kungaphazamisa izinhlelo zokwakha. Izindawo eziningi ezithuthukayo zidinga izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze zikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokwakha. Okokuqala, ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabakhi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ekwakheni izindlu kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko. Ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezihlakaniphile, bungasiza ekwakheni izindlu eziphumelelayo, ezisebenzisa amandla kancane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ngaphandle kokwandisa izindleko. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Ukubambisana komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakhiweni kwezindlu. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabakhi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Isiphetho Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokuhlala. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nemithetho ethinta le mikhakha. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokwakha, ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo, nokubambisana komphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala ezindlini ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo, futhi sithuthukise izindawo zokuhlala.
Othisha: Abakhulisi Bezemfundo Abalulekile Emphakathini Ezweni lanamuhla, othisha bahlala bebaluleka kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi, bephakamisa izinga lemfundo nokwakha isizukulwane esinobuhlakani. Njengoba imfundo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo, othisha bayizikhali ezinamandla ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlanga Lwemfundo Othisha bahlala bephakathi kwezinhlelo eziningi ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa imfundo. Ngemva kokuhlola izifundo ezitholakalayo, kubonakala ukuthi abanye othisha baphokophele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufunda, njengokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi othisha abavumeli izithiyo, kodwa bahlala bephokophele ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abafundi babo. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Nokho, othisha baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikhala ezincane zokufundela, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle, konke lokhu kubangela ukuthi othisha bahlupheke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuhola zihlala zikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha baphokophele ekwakheni imfundo engcono. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baphendule ngamahlelo afanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othisha bayakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Ukwaziswa Nokwakha Ubudlelwano Ukwaziswa nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi nothisha kubalulekile empumelelweni yemfundo. Othisha bahlala bephokophele ukwakha isimo sokwethembana, lapho abafundi bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imibuzo yabo. Lokhu kudala indawo yokufunda enempilo, lapho abafundi bekhuthazwa khona ukuba baphendule kahle ezimfundo zabo. Izifundo Zokuphila Othisha akugcini nje ngokufundisa izifundo ezisemthethweni, kodwa baphinde babe nemisebenzi ebalulekile yokufundisa izifundo zokuphila. Ngokusebenzisa izimo ezithile, othisha bahlala befundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokuphila, ukuziphatha kahle, kanye nokubaluleka kokubambisana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala beqonda ukuthi imfundo ayigcini nje ngezifundo, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umuntu ophelele. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kothisha Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kothisha zibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono, izinkambo zokufunda, kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukwakha ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Othisha baphinde bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zabo zokufundisa, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela abafundi ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi othisha bahlala bebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Njengoba bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke ubabheke njengabakhulisi bezemfundo abanezibopho ezinkulu. Uhlelo lwezemfundo luthanda ukuxhomeka kubo, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo sokubavikela, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi banokuthula emsebenzini wabo. Othisha, ngempela, bangabakhulisi bemfundo abathinta izimpilo zethu zonke.
Kwakwakukhathala okukhulu kwabahlengikazi ngosuku olungelanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho umoya uhlehla izihlahla ezincane ezisemathafeni. UThandi, umhlengikazi, wayehamba esuka emsebenzini, enezinyembezi eziphuma emehlweni akhe. Usuku lonke ubhekene nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezimkhathazayo, ezimshiya edinga ukuphumula. UThandi waqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, kodwa namuhla, ubuhlungu bokukhathala kwakhe babungaphezu kokujwayelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho wayezwa umoya wokuzimisela. Eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule, waqala umsebenzi wakhe emnyangweni wezempilo, futhi wathokozisa ukusiza abantu, ukuletha ithemba, nokubuyisela impilo. Nokho, njengoba izinsuku zidlula, umthwalo wempilo wabahlali bendawo waba nzima kakhulu. Abantu abaninzi befinyelela ezibhedlela bezinokukhathala nezifo ezinzima, futhi uThandi wababona bebheda, ezwa sengathi umhlaba ubambelele emuva. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi waba noMnumzane Dlamini, indoda ethwele kanzima. Wayengumuntu omdala, futhi izimpawu zokukhathala zazicacile ebusweni bakhe. UThandi wamthanda, ngoba wayebona ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini uzama ukulwa nezinkinga zempilo, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babungaphezu kokubekezelela. Waqala ukuxoxa naye, uMnumzane Dlamini wabelana ngendaba yakhe, ethi: “Ngiyazama, kodwa ngiyakhathala. Ngithanda umndeni wami, kodwa ngizizwa ngisolwa, ngingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ungumuntu onothando, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babumshiya edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, futhi lokhu kumkhathaza. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukhona kuphela emzimbeni, kodwa nakweminye imizwa. Wayebona ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bephila ngethemba. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, uThandi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano noMnumzane Dlamini. Wamfundisa ukuthi akufanele azizwe edinga ukulwa yedwa. Wamkhuthaza ukuba axoxe nomndeni wakhe, abavumele ukuba bamsize. UThandi wathola ukuthi umndeni kaMnumzane Dlamini wawulungele ukusiza, kodwa babengazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Waba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwabo, wakhuthaza ukuxhumana, futhi waba umgibeli wothando. Nokho, njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenza, waqala ukuzizwa edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukwazi ukuncipha. Wazama ukuxhumana nabanye abahlengikazi, kodwa abanye babebonakala bephila kahle, bejabulile. Wacabanga ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi abanye abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bejabulile. Waziswa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyinto ejwayelekile, kodwa wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noNokuthula, omunye umhlengikazi. UNokuthula wayenobungane, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ungumngane omuhle. Bakhuluma ngezinsuku zabo ezinzima, futhi uNokuthula wabelana ngendlela abawasebenzisa ngayo ukuze baphile kahle. Wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi sikhathala, kodwa kufanele sithole izindlela zokuphila. Ngithanda ukuhamba, nokwenza izinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kusisiza ukuba sibe namandla.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uNokuthula wayenamakhono okwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, futhi wathola ukuthi lokhu kwakuyindlela yokuphila. Baphuma ndawonye, bahamba emathafeni, baphumula, futhi baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezinhle. UThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi badinga ukuphumula, badinga ukuthokozisa. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe kwancipha. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, kodwa wathola ukuthi kufanele azame ukuxhumana nabanye. Waqhubeka nokusebenza noMnumzane Dlamini, futhi wathola ukuthi umndeni wakhe wawulungele ukusiza. UThandi waba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwabo, futhi lokhu kumjabulisa. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi badinga ukuphumula, badinga ukuthokozisa. Wathola ukuthi umhlaba ungaba mnyama, kodwa uma sikhumbula ukuthi sikhona ukuze sisize abanye, sizothola amandla okuphila. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi umhlaba ungaba mnyama, kodwa uma sikhumbula ukuthi sikhona ukuze sisize abanye, sizothola amandla okuphila.
Izins challenges zempilo: Ukubuka Okuhlangene Uhlanga lwempilo luhlobene nezinkinga ezahlukene ezivame ukubhekana nazo abantu. Konke kuqala empilweni yethu, lapho uma sithola ubudala, simukela izinselelo eziningi ezilokhu zikhona. Izinselelo zempilo zingaba yizinkinga zomuntu siqu, izinkinga zokusebenza, noma izinselelo zempilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nendlela yokubhekana nezinkinga zempilo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlala siphila impilo enempilo futhi eyanelisayo. Isimo sokuphila nokubhekana nezinselelo Okokuqala, kudingeka siqonde ukuthi isimo sokuphila singaba nethonya elikhulu ezinselelweni zempilo. Emiphakathini ethile, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele, izinsiza zokunakekela impilo, noma izimo zomnotho ezinzima kuba yizinto ezithinta ukuphila kwabantu. Izimo ezinjalo zenza kube nzima ekugethweni kwesixazululo, futhi zikhokelela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukufutshane komphakathi, kanye nokwanda kwamacala okudangala. Isimo esinjalo singenza abantu babe nezingcindezi ezingavumi bona, begcwele ubuhlungu bemizwa. Ukwamukela izinselelo njengengxenye yokukhula Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zempilo ngezinye izikhathi zifaka nethuba lokukhula. Noma lokhu kungase kubonakale njengokungajabulisi, ikakhulukazi uma sibhekana nezimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinselelo zingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokuwina amandla. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zempilo kungaba yindlela yokubona amandla ethu okuphila, sithole ukukhula okungaphakathi. Izifundo ezitholakala ezimpilweni zethu zifana nemithiya ebalulekile ekuphuhliseni abantu. Asifuni ukungena engozini yokukhula kuphela, kodwa futhi sibe nezindlela zokwakha imibono ecacile kanye nemigomo. Ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nokweseka Ukuxhumana nokweseka abanye kusho ukufaka isandla ezimweni ezinzima. Izinselelo zempilo zingenza kube nzima ukubhekana, kodwa khumbula ukuthi awuwedwa. Ukuxhumana nabantu abakuzungezile, kungaba ngabangani, amalungu omndeni, noma ozakwethu, kungenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphawula, ukusizwa, noxolo kungaba nezithelo ezinhle emzimbeni nasemoyeni. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuzwana nokweseka kungakhulisa amandla empilo, futhi kuchaze indlela yokufeza izimpumelelo. Inselelo yokuphumelela nokukhula Ekuqedeni, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izindlela zokuphumelela ngisho nezins challenges zempilo. Inselelo enkulu ihlale ikuphi ekuthumeleni emakhaya amaningi, lapho abantu bahlala bephokophele ekubeni abantu abaphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuba siqonde izinselelo zethu futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele, ukuze sithole izixazululo. Yingakho i-mentality yokuthola amathuba ukuze uhlose ukuthuthuka ibaluleke kakhulu. Noma izinselelo zempilo zithinta zonke izimpilo, ukuphila okubunjwe ngendlela eqondile kuyoba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokuzenzela uzimele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zempilo zingaholela ekwakheni umbono ophusile nokufunda izinto ezibalulekile. Njengoba sithola amandla okuphila, sizoba nokuzimisela lokho okuhlangene, sibe abantu abangcono. Ngaleyondlela, sizokwenza siphile kwemvelo, sithole imfundo ebanzi ngezinselelo zempilo, futhi sibe yizibonelo ezinhle zokusebenza emiphakathini yethu. Izins challenges zempilo akuzona nje izinkinga, kodwa ziyinsiza yokukhula komuntu siqu, kanti lokho kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Isiphetho: Ukuhlonipha izinselelo zempilo Izins challenges zempilo ziyingxenye yomjikelezo wokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuthi siwubheke kanje: izinselelo azikwazi ukwehlukaniswa nempilo, kodwa ziyingxenye yethu. Ukuhlonipha lezi zins challenges futhi sizithathele izifundo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthuke, kuyisimo esibalulekile sokwakha impilo enamandla. Ekugcineni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi empilweni, ukuhamba ngendlela yokuthuthuka nokuxhumana, kuzoqhubeka kugcizelela uqobo lwethu noshintsho njengoba sisoze saphuma ezinselelweni zempilo.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha: Umhlahlandlela Oqondile Nothando Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuwumkhiqizo wesigameko esibalulekile esithinta impilo yomuntu. Le nqubo, ebandakanya ukuqala kokukhula komntwana, ivame ukubhekwa njengomphumela ophawulekayo wokuthokozisa kokuhlobana, kodwa futhi iphethe imiphumela eminingi edinga ukuqashelwa. Noma ngabe abantu abaningi bazi kahle ukuthi umntwana uhamba kanjani, kubalulekile ukuba sihlolisise kahle zonke izici ezithinta ukukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ebuhleni nasebuhlungwini obuhambisana nakho. Isizathu Sokukhulelwa Ukukhulelwa kuqala lapho ukuhlanganiswa kwamangqamuzana amabili, elinye elivela kumama nelinye elivela kubaba, kwenzeka. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokuvamile ngesikhathi sokuhlobana. Ngemuva kokuhlanganiswa, umhlonyane ulandela indlela yawo oya emathunjini, lapho uqala khona khona ukwakheka komntwana. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi intsha iqonde kahle lokhu, ukuze baqonde ukuthi ukuhlobana akusihlalo sokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuziphatha kahle nokucatshangelwa. Imiphumela Yokukhulelwa Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akukona okujabulisayo kuphela, ngoba kubandakanya izici eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ubulili, izimo zomphakathi, imvelo, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu, konke lokhu kwenza izindlela zokuphila nezinkambiso zabalulekile. Intsha ikwenza kube nesibopho sokwenza izinqumo ezifanele ukuze kugwenywe izimo ezingezinhle, ezinjengezithiyo, ukuswela, noma izinkinga zempilo. Kudala, umphakathi ubona ukukhulelwa kwentsha njengento enezithako eziningi. Ngenkathi abanye bebheka ukuthi ikhuluma ngothando, abanye bathi ukuthola ubandlululo. Lokhu kuthinta izimvelo zomndeni nomphakathi, okwenza uzive bekhuthalele ukuthola izixazululo ezinokwenzeka. Umonakalo omkhulu ungavela uma umntwana ekhulela ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, okwandisa amathuba okuba nezingqinamba eziningi empilweni yakhe. Izinyathelo Zokuxhasa Intsha Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uhlinzeke ngesiqondiso esifanele nokuqondiswa kwabantu abasha. Izikhungo zabantu, njengezikole nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze ziwuphathe lo mzila ukuze zikwazi ukuxhasa intsha. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo, ukuvikelwa kwezempilo, kanye nesibindi sokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zempilo, kuyinto efanele ukuba yenzeke, ivuselele umqondo wokukhula kwentsha enempilo. Ukukhuluma nezinsiza, izikhungo zokwelapha zingabahlinzeka ngolwazi lolwazi lokuphumelela kwezindawo ezibalulekile. Izinkulumo ezinhle, okuhloswe ngazo abachwepheshe, kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili, ukuze abantu abasha baqonde kangcono ukuthi yini okudingeka bazilungiselele, nangendlela yokukhuluma. Ukubamba Isandla Eunhlalweni Ngenxa yomthelela emiphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uphathe umoya ohloniphekile phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana kwamalungu omphakathi, abahlengikazi, nezikhungo zemfundo. Njengoba intsha ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa, kumqoka ukuthi kekukhiqizwe ukugqugquzela ukusekelwa kwabantu abasha, ukuze bakhule bezazi futhi benza izinqumo ezinhle. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kusemqoka futhi kudinga ukucabangela okujulile. Kungaba ukuphila okuhle, okugcwele ezinjabulo, uma kuphela umphakathi usiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zindaba kufanele kube yinto evulekile, ukuze ingane weza ikhulile, ibe nekhono lokubhekana nezithiyo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yethu ibambisene futhi ikhululekile, iphila kahle empilweni. Ukukhulelwa akusilutho olunye, kodwa kuyindlela esizokwakha ngayo ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Incazelo yomcimbi: iYouTube Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, sizobe sibhala umlando omusha emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho sizobamba umcimbi omkhulu we-YouTube. Lo mcimbi, ozobanjelwa eThekwini, uzohlanganisa abantu abanothando lokwabelana ngezindaba, imicabango, nobuciko, bonke bephumelele ekwakheni izikhala ezisemqoka ezivuleka emhlabeni we-digital. Umcimbi uzovula ngempelasonto ekuseni, lapho abantu abavela kuzo zonke izindawo zomzansi bezongena, bejabulela imihlangano ehlukene. Uzokwakha ithuba lokuthi abathandi be-YouTube bahlangane, baxoxe, futhi babelane ngolwazi oluwusizo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umqondo wobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okuhambisana nemigomo ye-YouTube yokuxhumana, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana. Izinhlelo zomcimbi zifaka izingxoxo ezibucayi, lapho ochwepheshe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi abazobamba iqhaza bazokwazi ukufunda kahle ngempumelelo ye-YouTube, izindlela zokwakha okuqukethwe, kanye nezindlela zokukhulisa izithameli. Kukhona futhi izifundo ezihlukene ezizokwenza abantu baziqonde kahle izidingo zabo nezifiso zabo kumhlaba wezokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nemicimbi ethokozisayo efana nama-workshop, lapho abazokwazi khona ukufunda izindlela ezintsha zokuphucula ikhwalithi yokuthumela izithombe, ividiyo, nemiyalezo ebhalwe phansi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zizoqinisekisa ukuba abaklami bethu bathola amathuba amaningi okukhula, bephucula amakhono abo ukuze babe neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni we-YouTube. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomcimbi, sizobamba neqhaza lezinhlaka ezihloniphekile ezivela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa abezindaba, abaculi, nabaculi bempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umcimbi ube yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu bejabulela ukufunda, ukuhlekisa, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Ngenxa yokuxhumana okuhamba phambili, sizobe sithokozisa uhambo lwethu ngezinhlobonhlobo zezimpendulo, iziphakamiso, nezixazululo ezivela kubantu abanamakhono ahlukahlukene. Umcimbi uzolandela izinyathelo ezilula zokubamba izethameli, ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kuma-video, izithombe, nemiyalezo ethokozisayo. Abangane bethu bazoba nethuba lokuxhumana ngokuqondile nabantu abahlukene, behlanganyela imicabango nezimvo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuze nabantu baziqonde kahle izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuholela ezindleleni ezintsha zokwenza ibhizinisi. Ngemva kwemihlangano nemicimbi, sizobamba umcimbi ophakathi, lapho sizobamba indawo yokubambisana phakathi kwabathandi bama-YouTube. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula abantu bathole amakhasimende amaningi, besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze bakhe izixhumanisi eziphumelelayo. Izinkampani ezizobamba iqhaza zifuna ukuzama imikhankaso emisha ye-YouTube, futhi sizobafaka phakathi kulo mcimbi. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi we-YouTube uzoba yithuba elihle lokukhuluma, ukufunda, nokuhlangana. Uzoqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ubuciko, nezindlela zokudala. Ngakho-ke, sicela uqhubeke ulandele iziqondiso nezimemo zethu, uqinisekise ukuthi ungakuvumeli ukuthola lokhu kuhlanganyela okumangalisayo. Hamba nathi kulolu hambo, futhi silindele ukukubona phansi komcimbi, lapho sizokwakha khona ikusasa eliqhakazile le-YouTube. Sibheke ngabomvu ukuhlangana nani nonke, sabelane ngalezi zindaba ezithokozisayo. Hamba nathi emhlabeni we-YouTube!
UJacob Zuma: Ukuhlola Umthelela Nokuphikiswa UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli weNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu abaphawulekayo emlandweni wezombusazwe kuleli. Ukuphila kwakhe, izinqumo zakhe, kanye nezinkinga abhekane nazo, ziye zaba yizihloko ezivusa impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene zempilo kaZuma, umthelela wakhe ezombusazwe, kanye nezimpikiswano ezivela ngaye. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uZuma wayenendawo ebalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe waseNingizimu Afrika. Wazalwa ngo-1942 eNkandla, eKwaZulu-Natal, wakhula ezimweni ezinzima, kodwa waba nesibopho sokuba ngumholi weqembu le-ANC (African National Congress). Ukuphikiswa kwezakhamuzi eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinkulumo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, kwaholela ekutheni uZuma abukeke njengomholi ophikisiwe, kodwa futhi ophumelelayo. Ukhetho lwakhe njengoMengameli ngo-2009 lwabhalela umlando omusha, kodwa lwavula iminyango eminingi yokuphikisana. Ngokubheka izinqumo ezithathwe nguZuma, kubalulekile ukuqonda imithelela ethile ezweni. UZuma waphakamisa izinhlelo eziningi ezazihlose ukuthuthukisa umnotho, njengezinhlelo zokwakha ezikoleni, izibhedlela, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo ziye zaphikiswa kakhulu, njengoba abanye bekubona njengokungaphumeleli. Abaphikisi baveze ukuthi izinhlelo zikaZuma zazingekho ezinqubweni ezithuthukisayo, futhi izinsiza zomphakathi ziye zathinteka kakhulu ngenxa yokuphathwa okungafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uZuma waphinde waba nezinselelo ezinkulu ezimweni zokuphatha. Ukuphikiswa kwakhe kokuqala kwavela ngesikhathi sezinxushunxushu zeNkandla, lapho abaphikisi baveza khona ukuthi uZuma wathola izinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni zokwakha indlu yakhe. Lokhu kwaholela ekubizweni kwezinsolo zokwephula umthetho, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinsuku eziningi zokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha. Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwezakhamuzi, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo zomthetho. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abalandeli bakaZuma baphikisa ukuthi izinsolo ezikhuluma ngaye ziwumqondo wokubandlulula, futhi zikhombisa ukungaboni ngaso linye kwezombusazwe. Baphinde baveze ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuthi ungumholi ophikisiwe, futhi lokhu kwenza kube nzima kuye ukuphumelela. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impikiswano ngempilo kaZuma akukhona nje kuphela okukhuluma ngempumelelo noma ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi kubonisa izinselelo ezinzima abhekene nazo njengomholi. Kodwa-ke, impikiswano ayipheli lapho. UZuma ubhekene nezinsolo eziningi zokungathembeki, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nokugxekwa okukhulayo kokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kwaholela ekubizweni kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zokuhlola, kuhlanganise neKomidi Lezokuhlola, okwakuhlose ukuhlole izinsolo zokungathembeki. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqumo zikaZuma ziye zathinta kakhulu ukwethembeka kwemiphakathi, futhi zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni abantu bakholelwe yini ezikhungweni zomthetho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphakamiseni izinkulumo ezahlukene ezithinta ubumbano lwezombusazwe. UZuma, njengomholi, ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa futhi ubonise ukuthi ubumbano lungabhekwa ngendlela ehlukile. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuthi ubheke izinqumo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubumbano lwezombusazwe alukho ezimweni ezinzima. Ekugcineni, uJacob Zuma ungumholi ophikisiwe, futhi impilo yakhe ibonisa izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabaholi bezombusazwe. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsolo zokungathembeki, izinqumo ezithathwe, kanye neqhaza lakhe emlandweni wezombusazwe, konke lokhu kudala impikiswano enkulu. Lokhu kuhlola impilo kaZuma kubonisa ukuthi abaholi bahlala bephikisana nabantu, futhi lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthi umphakathi uqonde kahle izinqumo ezithathwe. UZuma ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wezinkinga ezibhekene nabaholi, futhi impikiswano ngaye izoqhubeka, njengoba izwe lihamba phambili.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwakukhona idolobha elikhulu elibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Leli dolobha laliphezulu ngezinto eziningi, kodwa lalinokuhlupheka okukhulu okubhekene nezakhamuzi zakhona. Abantu bahlala impilo enezinkinga ngenxa yokungabi nempilo, izinsiza ezincane, kanye nezinhlelo eziphukile. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezenzo ezimbi zabaholi ababephatheka kahle, kodwa besebenzisa amandla abo ngendlela engafanele. UThandi, intombazane encane enomoya ophakeme, wayehlala eMzimkhulu. Wayenothando lokuphila futhi efuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Nokho, wayebona ukuthi izinto zazingahambi kahle. Umama wakhe, uNandi, wayephindaphinda ukuthi inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga enkulu. "UThandi, uma ungakwenzi kahle, ubuhlungu bethu buzokhula," wayekhuluma njalo. UThandi wayeziqhenya ngempilo yakhe, kodwa wayefuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu abaningi behlupheka. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noMnumzane Dlamini, umphakathi ophatha izinsiza zomphakathi. Wafunda ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ubengumuntu onamandla, kodwa wayephinde abe nezinhloso ezingalungile. Wayehlela izinhlelo ezazibonakala ziwusizo, kodwa empeleni, wayefuna kuphela ukuzuza imali. UThandi, onobuhlakani, wabona ukuthi kufanele enze okuthile. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabanye abantwana bendawo, ebakhuthaza ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. "Asikwazi ukuhlala sithule, kufanele sikhulume," kusho yena. Abanye baphendula, "Kodwa singenza kanjani? Ubugebengu bukhona!" UThandi wabakhumbuza ukuthi ubuhlakani bethu buhle kakhulu kunobubi, futhi uma besebenzisana, bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko. Ngemva kokuhlangana, uThandi nozakwabo baqala ukuhamba emigwaqweni, bephakamisa izikhumbuzo ezibhalwe ngamagama afana noMnumzane Dlamini. Bafuna abantu bazi ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe. Umphakathi waqala ukubona ukuthi lezi zinsolo zazingekho ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa zazingezokukhuluma. Abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi kunokukhathazeka, futhi baphakamisa izwi labo. Ubugebengu bukaMnumzane Dlamini baphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba phambili. UThandi nozakwabo baqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi, behlela imihlangano ukuze baphinde baphakamise izwi labo. UThandi waba umholi walesi sikhumbuzo, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi kufanele baphumelele. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMnumzane Dlamini wathola ukuthi izinsolo zikhona, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu ababephila ngaphansi kwayo babezokhuluma. Waqala ukucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kube nendlela yokuphuma. Wathola ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zazingekho ezandleni zikaMnumzane Dlamini, kodwa zazingokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokukhuluma, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo kumphakathi. Ubugebengu bukaMnumzane Dlamini baphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe. UThandi waba umholi, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba phambili. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi nozakwabo baqeda ukujula kwezinkinga zomphakathi, umphakathi wawuthola amandla, futhi abantu baqala ukuvula amehlo abo. Ubugebengu buphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe.

Umbiko Wakho: Izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Lapho sihlola izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi leli zwe linomlando ocebile ogcwele izimpikiswano, ububha, namathuba amasha. Ukuphathwa kwezomnotho, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba zomphakathi kudala izifiso nezidingo zabasebenzi. Kulesi sikhathi, sifuna ukuqonda kahle izimo ezithinta izepolitiki kuleli. Ukwakhiwa Kwezepolitiki Njengoba izinkanyezi zomhlaba zishintsha, izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika ziqhubeka zithuthuka. Ukukhula kwabantu abasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye namathuba embonini ye-digital, kudala amandla amasha ezepolitiki. Izinkampani ezincane, ezibizwa nge-startups, zikhula kakhulu futhi zenza izinguquko ezidingekayo emnothweni. Ukuze sithole impumelelo ema-startups, kubalulekile ukuba nezicwangciso ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izifundo Ezivela emlandweni Ukuze siqonde indlela ezepolitiki ezashintsha ngayo, kudingeka sibheke emlandweni. Ubulungiswa bezepolitiki buwaholela ebuhleni obukhulu, kodwa ngemva kweminyaka yobandlululo, umphakathi uphinde wajikijela emuva. Kuze kube manje, umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuthuthuka futhi awukhohlwa imiphumela emibi yezenzo zomhlaba. Ukuvuma lezi zifundo kungasiza amazwe afuna ukuthuthuka ngendlela efanele. Imibono Ehlukene Kodwa-ke, izepolitiki azinayo imbono eyodwa. Abantu bahlukile, izifiso zabo zihluke, futhi lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene nezamasiko. Izinkampani ezikhethekile, njengezombusazwe, zidinga ukuthola izisombululo ezihambisana nemibono ehlukene. Ukuvuma le mibono kungenza izinqumo eziphusile, futhi kugqugquzele ukwenziwa kwezinto ezibalulekile. Ubuhlakani Bethu Kulokhu, ubuhlakani bethu budinga ukwelulekwa nemihlangano ehlukahlukene ukuze kubhekwe umphakathi wonke. Akusiyo kuphela imiphakathi ekhona, kodwa ubuhlakani bethu bezepolitiki bouyaziwa futhi kudinga ukubheka izimfuno zomphakathi. Lokhu kubeka isibopho kumaphoyisa, emaphoyiseni, nakwamanye amahhovisi. Imizamo Yokwakha Ubulungiswa Ubulungiswa kuzona zonke izigaba zezepolitiki buhlukile, futhi kudinga imizamo eyengeziwe ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga. Akusona isizathu sokuthi kube khona ukungaboni ngaso linye, kodwa kufanele kube nezinqumo eziphusile ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Imizamo yokwakha ubulungiswa kufanele yenziwe, kuhlanganiswe nokuheha izinqubomgomo ezithinta umphakathi. Izinga LokuHlonipha Nokuqonda Kubahlali, kubalulekile ukuba nezinga eliphezulu lokuhlonipha nokwazi umphakathi. Ukuhlonipha okukhulayo kuzomisa ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nomphakathi. Ukuhlonipha iziko lezemfundo, lambako, kuzosiza ekwakheni imikhakha yengqondo, okuzothuthukisa imiphakathi. Izenzo Zokuphila Kwansuku zonke Izindaba eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezenzo zansuku zonke. Ukuze ukukhuthaze umphakathi, abazedwe bangakha amasu ahluke kakhulu ukuze kuvezwe izinguquko. Lokhu kudinga imikhakha engokwemvelo nezinyathelo ezithile ezizophumeza izinjongo ezibekwe. Ukuxhumana Nengxenye YamaNingizimu Afrika Ukuziqonda kahle, ukuxhumana nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kuzobeka isimo esisha ezepolitikini. Abantu abahlukene, izinkolo ezahlukene, kanye nemiqondo ehlukene kudala umhlaba ophilayo owawusho umbono. Ukujula komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sihlole izimo zepolitiki ezinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Kulokhu, kuzozuzwa okwengeziwe emnothweni, futhi umphakathi uzokwazi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezaziyo. Isiphetho Ukuze siphumelele futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, kudinga ubuhlakani obuphakeme ukufaka bonke abantu emphakathini. Ukuhamba phambili noma ukwakha ukuthi lezi zepolitiki zikhona, kumele sihlanganyele, sabelane ngemininingwane, futhi siqhubekele phambili. Sifuna umphakathi ozinikele, othobekile, nolwazi olunembile olungagxila ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo, ukuze sibheke phambili endaweni yezenzakalo ezinhle. Sidinga ukwakha ugqozi oluqhubekayo, ukuze izingane zethu zivikeleke, futhi umphakathi uthuthuke.
Ukufunda Ngaphandle Kwezindonga: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekuyinto ejwayelekile emhlabeni wethu. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu zobuchwepheshe, ngithanda ukwabelana ngemicabango yami ngalolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Okokuqala, kufanele ngikhulume ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nokufunda nge-inthanethi. Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu ukuthi abantu bangafunda noma kuphi, noma nini. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akudingeki ukuthi ube seklasini, futhi ungafunda ngenkathi uhamba, uphumile, noma ngisho nasekhaya. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube lula kubantu abanemisebenzi eminingi, abanesibopho emindenini yabo, noma abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuvumela abafundi ukuba bakhethe izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungafunda izinto ezikuthokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukujabulela ukufunda. Abafundi bangakhetha izifundo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezifundo ezivela emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, okwakha umphakathi omkhulu wokufunda. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukunakwa. Okokuqala, abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokuzikhandla. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kudinga ukuzimisela okukhulu, futhi abanye bangase bahluleke ukuhlela isikhathi sabo kahle. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphuthelwe izifundo noma baphazamiseke kalula. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abafundi bakwazi ukuzilungiselela kahle ukuze baphumelele. Okwesibili, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana okuqondile nabafundisi nabanye abafundi kungaba yinkinga. Eklasini, abafundi bangakwazi ukubuza imibuzo ngqo, futhi lokhu kudala ithuba lokuxoxa. Nokho, online, lokhu kungaba nzima. Abafundi bangase bazizwe behluleka ukufinyelela usizo oludingekayo, okungaholela ekutheni bahluleke ukuqonda izifundo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi ne-inthanethi efanele kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bangase bangabi ne-access ku-inthanethi, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda online. Lokhu kudala ukungalingani phakathi kwabafundi, njengoba abanye benethuba lokufunda kahle, kanti abanye bahluleka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zicabangele izindlela zokwenza ukufunda kube accessible kubo bonke. Ngokuphetha, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, ngiyavuma ukuthi ukufunda online kuyindlela ebalulekile yokufunda, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sithola izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze sithuthukise le ndlela yokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, ukuze sithuthukise ukufunda online, sithuthukise abafundi bethu, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu jikelele.
