Ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuyona nje indlela yokufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkinga zokungcola komoya Ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngikhulume ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile, esithinta impilo yethu sonke. Uma sikhuluma ngengcindezi yomoya, sizobe sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, izindawo esihlala kuzo, nemiphumela yokungcola komoya. Akukhona nje ukuthi umoya opholile uhleli njalo, kodwa izinkinga zokungcola komoya zikhona, zihlala zikhona, futhi ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Okokuqala, ake sibe nokuqonda okukhulu ngobungozi bokungcola komoya. Umoya opholile ungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu, kodwa uma kukhona ukungcola, lokho kungenza kube nenkinga. Izinto ezinjengomoya omubi, ukungcola okuvela ezimbonini, ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezithile, kanye nokungcola okuvela ezithuthumelweni, konke lokhu kudala izinkinga. Abanye abantu bangase bahlupheke ngezinkinga zezempilo ezinjengokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphefumula, izifo zesikhumba, nemiphumela emibi kwi-immune system. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngezindawo eziphila khona, sizobona ukuthi izinkinga zokungcola komoya zinezimpande ezijulile. Izindawo ezisemadolobheni, lapho abantu behlala bejwayele ukungcola, ziba nemiphumela emibi. Ukuhlanzeka kwendawo kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sigweme lokhu. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngempilo yethu kuphela, kodwa futhi kusemqoka ukuthuthukisa izindawo esihlala kuzo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcola komoya zibaluleke kakhulu. Izinhlelo ezahlukene zinesibopho sokuthuthukisa isimo somoya. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yokuvuselela, nokusebenza ngokuqinile ekulwisaneni nokungcola. Imiphakathi ingaqala izinhlelo zokuhlola umoya, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi izinga lokungcola likuphi, bese bethatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Noma kunjalo, akukhona kuphela amazwe noma izindawo ezikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Kukhona nezindawo ezithile ezifundisa abantu ngokuqonda ubungozi bokungcola komoya. Ukuqwashisa abantu ngezingozi ezingase zibe khona, kunikeza ithuba lokuthi bazi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma abantu bebambisene, ngezenzo ezincane, njenge ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukusebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, noma ukuzama ukunciphisa ukuhamba ngemoto. Kukhona futhi izifundo ezithathwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe. Abantu bahlala befundiswa ngezindlela zokunciphisa ukungcola. Lokhu kungaba ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezikhiqiza ukungcola, noma ukujolisa ekutholeni izixazululo ezivuselelwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi umuntu ngamunye unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo somoya. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona okunokuthula. Kunobunzima obukhona uma kuziwa ekuphenduleni lezi zinkinga. Abanye abantu basabela ngezindlela ezithile, futhi lokhu kungadala okungafani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sihloniphe izinkolelo zabanye, futhi sikhulume ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokugcinwa kokukhuluma ngezinselelo ezihambisana nokungcola komoya, kufanele siqonde ukuthi sihamba phambili. Ngabe sikhona isinyathelo esithathwayo? Yebo, sikhona! Uma abantu bebandakanyeka, behlangana, futhi besebenza ngokubambisana, bangakwazi ukuqeda lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma kuziwa ekuboniseni abantu ukuthi bahloniphe umoya, baluphathe kahle, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zabo zihlanzekile. Ngakho, ngemuva kokukhuluma ngezinkinga zokungcola komoya, ngiyafisa ukukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba acabange kahle ngalokhu. Umoya opholile, impilo enhle, nezindawo ezinhle, konke kuxhumene. Khumbulani, sisonke kulesi sikhathi, futhi uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Lokhu akuyona nje indaba yokuhlanzeka, kodwa indaba yokuphila kwethu sonke, kanti impilo yethu iyafaneleka. Lokhu kufanele kube umgomo wethu sonke, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umoya esiwuphefumulayo uhle, umphakathi uhle, futhi impilo yethu ihlale iphilile. Ngiyabonga.
U-Elon Musk: Umuntu Ohlukile U-Elon Musk, lo mholi onamandla, udume emhlabeni jikelele. Uthandwa yabaningi, abanye bayamvuma, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe. Uthole udumo olukhulu ngenxa yemikhiqizo yakhe, kodwa akukona konke okukhanya. Ngizokhuluma ngaye ukuze ngiveze ukuthi kungani engumuntu ohluke kakhulu. U-Elon wazalelwa ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika, ngo-1971. Kusukela ebuncaneni, wayenothando olukhulu lwezobuchwepheshe. Ngakolunye usuku, ngesikhathi eseneminyaka engu-12, waqala ukuhlela imidlalo ngekhompuyutha, okwakukhombisa ukuthi uzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo, uMusk wathuthela eMelika, lapho aqala khona ukuhamba phambili. U-Elon waqala izinkampani eziningi eziphumelelayo, kuhlanganise neZip2, eyathuthukisa izixazululo zokuhamba. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi, kodwa uMusk wakwazi ukwakha izinto ezintsha. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola ithuba lokwakha iPayPal, eyaziwa kakhulu, okwakuwimpumelelo enkulu futhi kumvumela ukuba aqhubeke nezinhlelo zakhe. U-Elon akagcini lapho; uthanda izinselelo, okwaholela ekwakheni iSpaceX, umgomo wakhe wukuthumela abantu emkhathini futhi athole izindlela zokuphila kwezinye izinkanyezi. U-SpaceX waba yimpumelelo enkulu, uMusk waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinto ezinzima zingafezeka uma unethemba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-Elon ungumholi weTesla, inkampani edume ngama-ev (izimoto ezihamba ngogesi). Uthanda ukwakha izimoto ezihlanzekile ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. U-Tesla akuyona nje imoto; iyisixazululo sokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. U-Elon uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi lokho kubonakala emisebenzini yakhe. Nokho, akagcini kuphela ezinkampanini. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, njalo ekhuluma ngezinto ezithinta umhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Uthi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze silondoloze umhlaba, kudinga ubuchwepheshe obusha. U-Musk akavumi ukuma; uhlala efuna izixazululo ezintsha. Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanya. U-Elon uthola ukugxekwa okuningi. Abanye bathi uhlanganisa izinkinga zokuphatha abantu, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe. Ubuye abe nezinye izinkinga ezithinta izinkampani zakhe, kodwa lokhu akumvimbi ekutheni aqhubeke. U-Elon ungumuntu onamandla, futhi uthanda ukuhamba phambili, kungakhathaliseki izithiyo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elon Musk ubonakala engumuntu ongenakuphikiswa. Uthanda ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta ikusasa, futhi ubonakala enethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi lokho kuhle kakhulu. Ngokuphetha, u-Elon Musk ungumuntu ohluke kakhulu. Uthanda izinselelo, futhi akavumi ukuma. Uthanda ukwakha izinto ezintsha, futhi ubonakala enethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. U-Elon ungumholi, umphakathi, futhi umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye ukuze sithole izixazululo ezintsha. Uthanda ukwakha, futhi lokho kuyisifundo esihle kithi sonke.
Ukushoda Kukagesi: Isidingo Sokubheka Izixazululo Zesikhathi Esizayo Kusukela ezikhathini zakudala, ugesi ubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Ugesi usetshenziswa emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini zethu, emabhizinisini, nasezikhungweni zomphakathi, kuze kube sekwakheni izinsiza ezisemqoka ezinjengezibani, amafriji, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Nokho, sekuphele iminyaka ethile sibuye sithole izinkinga ezinkulu zokushoda kukagesi. Ukushoda kukagesi akusikhumbuzi nje kuphela izinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokusebenza, kodwa futhi kuveza nesidingo sokuthi sifune izixazululo ezisemqoka. Ngokwenyuka kokushoda kukagesi, kucacile ukuthi le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlole izinsiza zokukhiqiza ugesi. Izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi ezisebenzisayo amalahle, ikakhulukazi, ziye zaba yingozi emvelweni. Ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, sidinga ukunciphisa ukuncika kwethu ezinsizeni ezilimazayo. Ukwakha izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi ezisebenzisa imithombo engrenewable, efana nelanga, umoya, kanye namanzi, kungaba yindlela yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Okwesibili, ukujolisa kwezemvelo kubalulekile. Izinhlelo zokuvuselela ugesi, ezibandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezisebenza ngogesi ophuma emithonjeni yemvelo, kulindeleke ukuthi zibe yizixazululo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imithombo yethu yokukhiqiza, kunciphise ukuncika kumalahle, futhi kuvimbele ukwanda kwemiphumela emibi yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzodingeka ukuze sifeze lezi zifiso. Ngaphandle kokukhathalela izinsiza, kudingeka futhi sikhulume ngezindlela zokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Izinhlelo zokonga ugesi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Ukuze sihlole indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ugesi, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngendlela yokusebenzisa kagesi kahle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufundisa abantu ngezinsiza ezihamba phambili, njengezibani ze-LED, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zethu zokwakha nezokuthuthukisa zidinga ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuphucula izinsiza ezikhona. Ukuthuthukisa imithombo yokufaka ugesi ezindlini, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kuzokhulisa ukufinyelela kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempilo yethu. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi nazo kufanele zikhuthazwe ukuthi zisebenzise izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nokushoda kukagesi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izikhungo ezintsha zokukhiqiza, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokwandisa imithombo yokukhiqiza. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza, njengokuhlanganisa ugesi ophuma emithonjeni ehlukahlukene, kuzothuthukisa ukuqina kokukhiqizwa kukagesi. Nakuba kunzima ukubhekana nale nkinga, akufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhamba phambili. Umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, futhi asikwazi ukuhamba emuva. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ezizimele kuyadingeka ukuze siphumelele. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomthelela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, futhi abantu kufanele bathathe izinyathelo zokufundisa abanye ngenjongo yokwehlisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ukushoda kukagesi akuyona inkinga ebalulekile kuphela, kodwa kuyisizathu sokuba sithole izixazululo ezikhona. Sidinga ukujolisa ekwakheni umphakathi othuthukile, ohlonipha imvelo, futhi okwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zesikhathi esizayo. Ukuphinde sibe nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zethu zokuphila, kanye nokubeka phambili izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokugcina ugesi, kuzoholela ekutheni sifeze izinjongo zethu. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi sithola amathuba amasha nsuku zonke. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha, nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu kuzoholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezithembekile. Ngakho, akumele sihlanganyele kuphela ekukhulumeni nganoma iyiphi inkinga, kodwa sizithathele izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sifeze umphakathi onempilo, ongamazulu, futhi ophumelelayo. Ukushoda kukagesi kumele kube yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sihamba phambili, sifuna izixazululo, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu.
AmaXhosa: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Isiko Nezinkolelo Ngaphakathi kwezintaba ezinhle zaseMpuma Koloni, umcimbi omkhulu wamaXhosa ubusuku nemini uhlelwe ukuze kuhlonishwe isiko, ubuciko, nezinkolelo zalesi sihlanganyelo esiyingqayizivele. Umcimbi, owawubanjelwe emzaneni waseQonce, wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile futhi bephakamisela phezulu izinkumbulo zabo ezinhle. Umsindo wezinsimbi zendabuko, izigubhu, nezinsimbi zomculo zashaya umoya, zikhumbuza bonke abakhona ngempilo yamaXhosa. Abantu bahlangana emaphandleni, behamba ngezinyawo, bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, behlanganisa imindeni, abantwana, nabadala. Umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha, njengoba abantu bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yokwamukela, lapho abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bechaza ukubaluleka kokugcina isiko lethu. Ubhala izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, uMnu. Mkhize, uthe: “Isiko lethu liyingxenye yethu, futhi kufanele siligcine, silondoloze, futhi sithuthukise.” Le nkulumo yakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza, futhi kwavela umoya wokubambisana. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezinkanyezi ezihlukahlukene zamasiko, lapho abaculi bendawo bephakamisa izwi labo ngezinkondlo, izinganekwane, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. Abantu babebukele, bejabulela ubuciko obuhlukahlukene, futhi bephendula ngezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu behlanganyela ezindabeni zabo, bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkanyezi zokudla, lapho abantu bejabulisa izitsha ezilungiselelwe ngothando. Izitsha zendabuko, ezifana ne-umngqusho, i-chakalaka, ne-bobotie, zathokozisa wonke umuntu. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu babelana ngezindlela zabo zokupheka, bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, futhi bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa imidlalo yendabuko, efana ne-ukuthunga, ne-ukugida, lapho abantu bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, bephakamisa umoya wokuncintisana. Abantwana babebonisa amakhono abo, bejabulisa bonke abakhona, futhi lokhu kwavusa umoya wokuhlonipha phakathi kwezizukulwane. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, kwavela ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, beqinisekisa ukuthi izwi labantu lizwa. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu behlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Umcimbi wamaXhosa wawungaphezu kokuhlonipha isiko; wawuwumcimbi wokubumbana, wokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba ubusuku buhamba, abantu bahlala behlangene, bejabulela umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, kanye nezinkumbulo ezinhle. Umcimbi waphothulwa ngenkulumo yokubonga, lapho abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baphuma emcimbini bejabule, bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo. Umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, kanye nezinkumbulo ezinhle wahlala ungena ezinhliziyweni zabo, uqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lamaXhosa lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Umcimbi wamaXhosa wawungumcimbi obalulekile, owawuhlanganisa abantu, ubuciko, nezinkolelo, uqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lethu lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi, ngisho noma izikhathi zishintsha, isiko lethu lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo.
Umlando Wezinyunyana Zabasebenzi: Isingeniso Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi uhlanganisa izigameko ezibalulekile ezihlobene nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizama ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, ukuthuthukisa izimo zabo zokusebenza, kanye nokufezekisa izinzuzo ezithile. Lezi zinyunyana zaba neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezomnotho, ezombusazwe, kanye nezokuhlalisana. Ukuze uqonde kahle umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu ezaholela ekwakhiweni kwalezi zinhlangano. Isigaba 1: Izizathu Zokwakhiwa Kwezinhlangano Zabasebenzi Ngaphambi kokuba zibe khona izinyunyana, abasebenzi babebhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezifana nokusebenza isikhathi eside, izinkokhelo eziphansi, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi kudingeka kube nenhlangano yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Izinyunyana zaba yindlela yokuhlanganyela, evumela abasebenzi ukuba bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo futhi bafune izinguquko ezizothuthukisa izimo zabo. Isigaba 2: Ukuqala Kwezinhlangano Zabasebenzi Ekuqaleni kwekhulu lama-19, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zaqala ukuvela emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eYurophu naseMelika. Lokhu kwavela ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemboni, lapho abanikazi bezimboni babefuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, kodwa bengenakukhokhela abasebenzi izinzuzo ezifanele. Abasebenzi baqala ukuhlanganisa izinyunyana ukuze bathole amandla okuphikisa, bakhe imithombo yokuxhasana, futhi babonise ubunye babo. Isigaba 3: Ukukhula Kwezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Njengoba izinyunyana zandise amaqembu, zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zomsebenzi. Izinyunyana zafaka izicelo zokuthi kube nezivumelwano ezicacile mayelana nezimo zomsebenzi, izinkokhelo, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlaka eziningi, ezifana nezinhlangano zabasebenzi ezikhethekile, ezazihlanganisa abasebenzi bezimboni ezithile. Izinyunyana zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu, njengezivumelwano zokusebenza ezihlonipha amalungelo abasebenzi. Isigaba 4: Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma izinyunyana zaba namandla, zaphinde zaba nezinselelo ezinzima. Abanikazi bezimboni, kanye nohulumeni, bavame ukungavumi izicelo zezinyunyana, baphinde baqhuba izinyathelo zokuzama ukuvimba ukukhula kwazo. Lokhu kwaholela ezimeni zokuphikisana, lapho abasebenzi babebhekene nezingozi zokulahlekelwa yimisebenzi, noma ngisho nokuhlukunyezwa. Nokho, lezi zinkinga zakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke bephikisa, befundisa abanye ngamalungelo abo. Isigaba 5: Izinselelo Zamanje Nezikhathi Zokuphumelela Namuhla, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zibuye zibe nezinselelo ezintsha, ezifana nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, ukuhamba kwemisebenzi, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Nokho, zisagcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu emisebenzini. Izinhlangano eziningi zikhuthaza ukufundiswa nokukhuthazwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokusebenza zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokuphikisa, ukuhlela imihlangano, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwazo nezinhlaka zomphakathi. Isigaba 6: Ukubaluleka Kwezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Izinyunyana zabasebenzi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banamalungelo afanele, zikhuthaza izimo zokusebenza ezinhle, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphandle kwezinyunyana, izinguquko eziningi ezitholakele emhlabeni wezokusebenza zingase zingabi khona. Abasebenzi bahlala bephikisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izimo zabo zihlala zinhle, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle yokusebenza. Isiphetho Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi ungumfanekiso obonisa indlela abantu abavumelana ngayo ukuze bathole izinguquko ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukubambisana, ukuzinikela, kanye nomoya wokuphikisa kube yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni izinyunyana ezinamandla. Njengoba siqhubeka nezinye izinkathi zomlando, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinyunyana zabasebenzi zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, futhi zidinga ukusekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuletha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni - Ingxoxo noMnumzane Thulani Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnumzane Thulani, ongumhlali wethu odumile emadolobheni, ukuze sihlolisise ukuphila kwansuku zonke emadolobheni. UThulani ungumuntu ohloniphekile, oneminyaka engu-35, ophila eThekwini. Kanjani ukuphila kwakhe emadolobheni? Ake sizwe ngaye. Umbuzo 1: UThulani, ungazichaza kancane ngempilo yakho eThekwini? “Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Ukuphila eThekwini, njengemadolobha amaningi, kunokuhle nokubi. Ngikahle kakhulu, kodwa futhi nginobunzima. Njengomuntu osebenza ezinsizakalweni, ngiyakhumbula ukuthi izindleko zokuphila zanda, ikakhulukazi ezindlini. Nokho, imisebenzi eminingi iyatholakala, futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okukhula.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ozithola emadolobheni? “Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, ubani ongaqondi? Izinhlelo zokuhamba, izimoto zomphakathi, zigcwele kakhulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kubekhona ukuhamba okungahambi kahle. Futhi, ezinye izindawo zinezinga eliphezulu lokuhlukunyezwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila kahle. Kodwa-ke, ngithanda isiko lethu, imicimbi, nezindawo ezihlukahlukene ezitholakala lapha.” Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo ziphumelele kangakanani? “Ngicabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zempilo emadolobheni ziningi. Ubuqotho bomphakathi buhle kakhulu. Ukuthola abantu abasha, ukuhlangana nemibono ehlukene, kuyathokozisa. Ngithanda ukufunda ngezamasiko ahlukene, futhi lokho kungenza ngibe nobungane obuningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunemithombo eminingi yokuzilibazisa, izindawo zokudlela, namakhefi.” Umbuzo 4: Uthembisa kanjani ukujabulisa impilo yakho phakathi kwezinselelo? “Njengoba ngishilo, ngizama ukuthola ukufinyelela kumathuba. Ngiyazama ukujolisa emisebenzini yami, kodwa futhi kumele ngithole isikhathi sokuzilibazisa. Ngithanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo emigwaqweni eThekwini, ngibuke izindawo ezinhle. Ngithanda nokubamba iqhaza emicimbini eyimikhuba yamasiko.” Umbuzo 5: Ucabangani ngempilo yempilo yempilo? “Empeleni, imvelo ibalulekile. Njengabantu abahlala emadolobheni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sihlala singabantu bezemvelo. Ngizama ukuvivinya umzimba futhi ngithathe isikhathi sokuphumula, ngikhumbule ukuhamba emaphakathini, nokuba nemvelo. Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni impilo eyinhloko.” Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izeluleko ongazinika abantu abasha abafuna ukuphila emadolobheni? “Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalombuzo. Okokuqala, kufanele uqaphele izindleko zokuphila. Qinisekisa ukuthi unayo imali eyanele ukuze ukwazi ukudla, ukuhamba, nempilo. Bamba iqhaza emiphakathini, ungazifihli. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nethuba lokudlula ezinkingeni. Futhi, ungathandabuzi ukufuna usizo lapho kudingeka.” Umbuzo 7: UThulani, kukhona okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokuphila emadolobheni? “Yebo, ngiyazi, isikhathi asimangazi. Ngibona abantu abaningi bejolisa ezinkingeni zomhlaba. Ukuphila emadolobheni kumele kube yindlela yokuphila enempilo, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuhamba phambili. Ngicabanga ukuthi imiphakathi iyashintsha, futhi abantu badinga ukuvumelana nezimo.” Isiphetho Ngokubamba le ngxoxo noMnumzane Thulani, sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngempilo emadolobheni. Ukuphila eThekwini kunokuthokozisa, kepha kunobunzima obuthile. Kubalulekile ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ukuze siqhubeke nenjongo yokuphila kahle. Njengabantu, sithanda ukujabulisa izimpilo zethu, futhi le ngxoxo isibonisa ukuthi, noma izinselelo zikhona, ubuchwepheshe, imikhuba, nezinsiza zingaba yizinsiza ezinkulu ekugcineni. UThulani ungumfanekiso ophumelelayo ohlangabezana nezinsuku zansuku zonke, futhi sitha konke okwaziyo ukuze sizuze impilo engcono.
Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso I-Eskom, njengomphakathi ophakathi kokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Kulokhu, sizochaza ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, izinselelo ezibhekene nayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Ukuze sithole ulwazi olunembile, sikhulume noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wezokukhiqiza ugesi e-Eskom. Ingxenye 2: Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom UMnu. Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha. Ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi i-Eskom isebenza? “Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. I-Eskom iyinkampani enkulu yokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika. Sihlinzeka ngogesi kumakhaya, ezimbonini, nasemiphakathini. Sisebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene, njengezikhukhula, amalahle, nezinye izinsiza ezivuselelekayo ukuze sithole ugesi. Ukusebenza kwethu kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze sikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu.” Ingxenye 3: Izinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom Kodwana, u-Eskom ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ungakuchaza lokhu? “Yebo, izinselelo zethu ziningi. Okokuqala, sinesidingo sokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu. Amadivayisi amaningi esiwasebenzisayo sephukile noma awasebenzi kahle, okwenza ukukhiqizwa kukagesi kube phansi. Okwesibili, sinesidingo sokuphatha kahle izinsiza zethu zemali; ukuntuleka kwemali kuholela ekubambezelweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa. Futhi, izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu; izikhukhula nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukukhiqiza ugesi.” Ingxenye 4: Izixazululo ezitholakalayo Ngabe zikhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo kulezi zinselelo? “Yebo, sikholelwa ukuthi izixazululo zikhona. Okokuqala, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zethu zokuphatha. Sifuna ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze sithole ugesi ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, sikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, njengezikhukhula, ukuze sinciphise ukuncika kumalahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo.” Ingxenye 5: Ukubambisana nomphakathi Ngabe i-Eskom ibambisana kanjani nomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwayo? “Ukubambisana nomphakathi kubalulekile. Sihlela imihlangano nezinhlelo zokubambisana ukuze sithole imibono evela kubantu. Siphinde sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubo bonke.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubheka phambili Ngabe ubona ikusasa le-Eskom linjani? “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa le-Eskom linethemba. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, futhi sithuthukise umnotho wezwe. Sifuna ukuba yinkampani ehamba phambili emhlabeni, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sifinyelele kulokho.” Ingxenye 7: Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom kubalulekile, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze uthuthukise izinsiza. Siyathemba ukuthi i-Eskom izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngifisela i-Eskom impumelelo emizamweni yayo yokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwayo.
Ezokuxhumana: Uhlanga Olubucayi Ekuxhumaneni Kwabantu Ezokuxhumana, ngokwemvelo yazo, ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Zibandakanya izindlela eziningi zokudlulisa ulwazi, imiyalezo, nemicabango phakathi kwabantu, izigaba, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle izokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukumukela ukuthi lezi zindlela zihlukaniswa ngokwehlukana kwazo, esitayela, nendawo yokusebenza. Okokuqala, izokuxhumana ziqala ngezindlela zombili ezikhona emhlabeni, okungukuthi, ezibhalwe phansi kanye nezikhuluma. Izokuxhumana ezibhalwe phansi, ezifana nezincwadi, amaphephandaba, nezincwadi zocwaningo, zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlinzekeni ngolwazi oluqinile noluchwepheshe. Lezi zindlela zifaneleka kakhulu ezimweni lapho kudingekayo khona ukufaka izizathu ezimiswe ngempumelelo, noma lapho kudinga ukunakekela izincazelo ezicacile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izokuxhumana ezikhuluma, ezifana nezinkulumo, imihlangano, nezingxoxo, ziqhubekela phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zindlela zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okuqhamuka emoyeni, nakwethuthukiseni ubudlelwano obunobudlelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zithinta izimo zempilo zansuku zonke, zisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezemfundo, kwezokuxhumana, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Emfundweni, izokuxhumana zidlala indima enkulu ekufundiseni nasekufundeni. Abafundi kudingeka bakwazi ukudlulisa imicabango yabo, baphinde bathole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuxhumana kusho ukuthi abaphathi, othisha, nabafundi kumele babe nekhono lokukhuluma kahle nangaphezulu, ukuze kube khona ukuqonda okuphelele phakathi kwabo. Ezweni lezemfundo, izokuxhumana zikhona ezindleleni ezahlukahlukene; njengokufundisa, ukuxoxa ngezihloko, nokwenza izifundo ezihlanganyelwe. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukuxhumana akugcini nje ngokudlulisa ulwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba ube nezindlela ezinhle zokubamba iqhaza, lokho okuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda kwempilo. Ukuze abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabo, badinga ukufunda ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana obubumbene nezinhloso zabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokuxhumana zibuye zibe nomthelela obalulekile kwezokuxhumana. Ukuxhumana kwezokuxhumana kuhilela iziteshi ezifana namasayithi wezokuxhumana, izithombe, nezinsizakusebenza ezisheshayo. Lolu hlobo lokuxhumana lunokuthuthukiswa okukhulu, njengoba lungavumela abantu abaninzi ukuthi baxhumane ngaphandle kwemikhawulo. Nokho, lokhu kuza nemiphumela emibi, njengoba kuveza izinselelo ezifana nokuntuleka kokuxhumana okungokwenyama, ukungaqondi kahle imiyalezo, kanye nezingozi zokuphepha komuntu siqu. Eminyakeni edlule, ubuchwepheshe buguqule kakhulu indlela esixhumana ngayo. Ukuze sikhulume ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukufaka izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukudlulisa imiyalezo, ukunikeza izimpendulo ezisheshayo, nokwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhlanganyelwe. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo akuphathelene nje nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuhlonishwa kwabanye. Ngesikhathi sokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuthola izindlela zokuxhumana ezihloniphekile, ezithokozisayo, nezisebenzayo. Ukuxhumana akupheli kuphela kumyalezo odlulisiwe, kodwa kudinga ukuthi umamukeli aqonde futhi azisebenzise ngempumelelo lokho akutholile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ukuxhumana okuvuselelayo, okuhlanganyela, futhi okuhle. Ekugcineni, ezokuxhumana ziwumkhakha obalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlakanipheni nasekukhulumeni, zisebenza njengesixhumanisi phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle, kudingeka siqhubele phambili, sifunde izindlela ezinzima, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu nabanye. Ngalesi sikhathi sokuguquka kwezobuchwepheshe, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sithuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuxhumana, ukuze sizuze impumelelo empilweni yethu. Ngakho-ke, ezokuxhumana zihlala zibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nesithakazelo sokuthuthukisa lezi zindlela ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana okuhle, okuhloniphekile, nokuphumelelayo.
Ezokusebenza Kukahulumeni: Ukuhlola Ukusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zikamasipala Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseMzansi ubonge umkhiqizo omuhle wezinsizakalo zikahulumeni, njengoba izikhulu zikamasipala ziqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabantu ziyaqondiswa. Uhlelo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni, oluhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, luye lwathola ukunakwa okukhulu eminyakeni yamuva, njengoba izinkinga eziningi zikhona emiphakathini. Uhlaka lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinsizakalo zempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa ubuphofu, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso. Izinsizakalo Zempilo Nezemfundo Izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethwele kanzima. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, kodwa izinkinga ezinjengokuntuleka kwemithombo, izinsiza ezanele, kanye nezisebenzi ezihloniphekile zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nanele kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokuba yinto ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufunda zenzelwa abafundi, kodwa izinkinga ezinjengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikole ezingekho ezingeni eliphezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezingasebenzi kahle zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlupheke, futhi lokhu kudinga ukulungiswa okuphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo Zokuthutha Ezokuthutha nazo zibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, izimpahla, nezinsizakalo. Nokho, izinkinga ezinjengokungabi nanele kwezokuthutha, izindlela ezingalungile, kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zokuhamba zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukene kalula. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukusungula izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, kanye nokuhlonipha izidingo zomphakathi. Ukubambisana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Ukungabi nanele kwezinsizakalo, ukungabikhona kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha zenza kube nzima ukufezekisa izinhloso zokusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Uhlelo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luphinde luthinteke ezindaweni eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa ubuphofu, nokwakha umnotho oqinile. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, aqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa, futhi akhe ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ezahlukene, uhulumeni ungalungisa izinkinga ezikhona futhi uthuthukise izinga lempilo labantu. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo baphatheke ngokubambisana, benze izinqumo eziphusile, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nolwazi oluqinile. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi ubheke phambili ekutholeni izinsizakalo ezinhle, ezithembekile, nezisebenzayo ezivela kukahulumeni.
Izinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Namuhla, abantu abakhubazekile babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukusiza lezi zinsizwa ukuba ziphile impilo egculisayo, zenza izinqumo ezibalulekile, futhi zithole amathuba afanele. Kulesi sihloko, sizoxoxa ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. Izinsizakalo Ezitholakalayo Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zihlukaniswe ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, sinezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Lezi zinsizakalo zisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ukuze bakwazi ukuzimela. Okwesibili, sinezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zifaka ukuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzi, ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuthola imisebenzi, kanye nokubasiza ukuba bahlale emsebenzini. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba imisebenzi inika abantu abakhubazekile ithuba lokuzimela, ukwakha ukuzethemba, nokuthola imali yokuphila. Okwesithathu, kunezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, ezihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhumusha, ezisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baxhumane nabanye. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imicabango yabo, izidingo, nezifiso zabo. Izinzuzo Zezinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zinezici eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhuthaza ukuzimela. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, abantu abakhubazekile bangathola amathuba okuphila impilo egculisayo, okwakha ukuzethemba nokuzimela. Okwesibili, lezi zinsizakalo zikhuthaza ukufakwa emphakathini. Ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezithuthukisa amakhono, abantu abakhubazekile bangakwazi ukujoyina imiphakathi yabo, benze ubungane, futhi bathuthukise izimpilo zabo, okwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Okwesithathu, izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zikhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo zokwelashwa, abantu abakhubazekile bangathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, okusiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zempilo ezivamile. Izinkinga Ezikhona Noma izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zinezinzuzo eziningi, zikhona nezinselelo. Okokuqala, zikhona izindleko eziphezulu. Abantu abakhubazekile bavame ukubhekana nezindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekutheni abanye bangakwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinsizakalo. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokufinyelela. Ezinye izinsizakalo zingase zingatholakali ezindaweni ezithile, okuvimbela abantu abakhubazekile ukuthi bathole usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kalula. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga zokwazi. Abantu abaningi basazithola bephazamisekile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okudinga izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ulwazi ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo. Isiphetho Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Zihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula kubantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo egculisayo. Nokho, izinkinga ezikhona, ezifana nezindleko eziphezulu, ukufinyelela, kanye nezinkinga zokwazi, zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kwalesi sizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokwesekwa, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, enothando, futhi egculisayo.
Umdanso: Umsebenzi Wokudlulisa Isiko Nezizathu Zokuhlanganyela Umdanso, njengomsebenzi wezokwakha, ubonakala njengengxenye ebalulekile yamasiko amaningi emhlabeni. E-Afrika, umdanso unomlando ocebile, uphinde ube yindlela yokudlulisa izindaba, imizwa, nezifundo ezibalulekile ezizweni ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso akuwona nje umsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi unomthelela omkhulu empilweni yamasiko. Emazweni amaningi, umdanso uhlanganisa abantu, udala ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izinkolo, imicimbi yokugubha, kanye nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo ziba yizizathu ezibalulekile zokudansa. Ngokwesibonelo, eNingizimu Afrika, umdanso weZulu, owaziwa ngokuthi yi-'Indlamu', ubonisa ubuhlakani bamasiko kanye nemigubho yokuhlonipha. Umdanso weZulu ubalulekile emicimbini efana neziqholo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze baphinde baqhakambisa izithethe zabo. Ngaphandle kokuba umdanso ubonisa isiko, unikeza nethuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhona emphakathini. Njengoba umdanso uvame ukusebenzisa izincazelo ezithile, abaculi bangasebenzisa le ndlela ukuze baphakamise izwi labo, baveze imizwa yabo, futhi baphendule ezinkingeni ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emidansweni ethinta izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlalisana. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ohlanganisa izindlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukudansa ngokwezinkanyezi, ukudansa kwesiko, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdanso ungashintsha futhi uthuthuke, uhambisane nezinguquko ezisemphakathini. Izinkampani zomdanso zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abaculi abasha ukuba baveze ubuchwepheshe babo, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Ngokwenyuka komdanso, izigidi zabantu ziya ziqonda ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphila. Abantu abaningi baphila ngokuqhubeka nokudansa, bejabulisa abanye futhi bephinde bephakamisa imizwa yabo. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphumula, yokukhulula ingcindezi, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuzithokozisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso unamandla okukhulisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhlanganise izizukulwane ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdanso ungenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Umdanso wezemidlalo, njengokudansa kwezemidlalo, ungathokozisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, udala umoya wokuhlanganyela nokuhloniphana. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso ungathuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, ube yindlela yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, umdanso wawusetyenziswa njengendlela yokukhumbula izinkanyezi zempilo, kodwa manje usuphenduke umkhakha ongenamkhawulo. Abaculi baphakathi komdanso bahlala bephokophele ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi beveza izifundo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ube yindlela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo eziphilayo. Umdanso, njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, ungaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlanganyela, sokuphila, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ubonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhle, nokuhlakanipha kwezakhamuzi. Njengoba umdanso uqhubeka nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuthi siwuhloniphe, siwugubhe, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso uzophinde ube yindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlangene, nelinobungane. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithandazela umdanso, siwufake emhlabeni wethu, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu.
ISahara Desert: Ukubuyekezwa Kwendawo Enomlando Nezindawo Zokuhlola ISahara Desert, eyaziwa njengenye yezindawo ezinkulu kakhulu zomhlaba, iyasithokozisa ngabuhle bayo bemvelo kanye nomlando wayo ocebile. Le ndawo isendaweni ephakathi neNyakatho-Afrika, ibhekele izwe elikhulu elishisayo, elinomoya onamandla, nezitshalo ezincane. Ukubheka isimo sezulu, iSahara ibonwa njengetholakale elingahlala likhukhuleka ezinzile, lapho izinsuku zayo zinesimo sokushisa esingenakuchaza, kodwa ngezikhathi zonyaka zibavuma abantu ukuba bathole izimo ezithile ezithandwa abantu abaningi. Umoya weSahara ungaphezu kokuphila – uhlanganisa izindawo ezithakazelisayo ezimnandi. Iqukethe amahlathi amancane, izigodi ezimnyama, nezindawo eziluhlaza nezithakazelisayo. Iso lesimo sezulu esomile lienza kube khona ukungaboni nhlobo izinyoni. Kodwa lapho ufunwa ukuchitha isikhathi eside, uzothola izinkanyezi ezijabulisayo zaphakade, lezi zikhanya ezivela phezulu, zineziteshi ezithokozisayo zokuqhubeka komphakathi. Ukwamukela izivakashi, iSahara inezindawo zokuhlola eziningi ezivulelekileyo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo phakathi kwezindela zezikhukhula ezivela ezintabeni, uzothola izindawo ezihamba phambili zobuhle bemvelo. Izihlahla zihlala zikhanyisa indlela, futhi ungahamba uma ubona uCape Verde, lapho ubudlelwano bezingelosi zikhanyisa kancane. Noma ngabe uhamba phansi, ujabulela ubuhle bezithombe ezimibalabala nezinhlobo zezinyoni. Ezinye izindawo ezifana neMerzouga, uBauz, kanye neChinguetti, zithokozisa izivakashi ngemibono ephawulekayo yeSahara. EMerzouga, ungazithokozisa ngama-sand dunes amakhulu, lapho ungahle uthathe isithombe esihle ngezithombe ezahlukene zenkanyezi. Pandaru lezo zici, ungavakashela ezindaweni ezithokozisayo ezikwenziwa yi-adventure, njengokugibela izinkanyezi nangokwakha ulwazi olujabulisayo ngamasiko endawo. I-Sahara isiphenduke isikhumbuzo semvelaphi yamasiko ahlukahlukene. Abantu abahlala lapha, bakha izinyathelo ezitholakalayo kwezamasiko, izindawo zokuhlola nezinhlelo zokuphila. Lokhu kumangaza kakhulu, indlela abantu abaphila ngayo kule ndawo eyinzima, usebenzisa imvelo ukuze balondoloze impilo yabo. Lokhu kuholela kubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abasebenza zesaphiwe neziza ekhaya. Ngokuphawula, abavakashi bangakwazi ukufunda ngezinkolelo, imikhuba, nezithakazelo zenhlalakahle yabantu bendawo. Uhambo lweSahara lungaba yinto esikukhumbulayo njengoba uhlangana nabantu baqhakambisa ubuhlobo, ukuphumelela kwezakhamuzi endaweni kanye nemibono yezikhumbuzo ezilula. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iSahara akukhulula kuphela, kodwa iphinde ibe ingxenye yezivakashi ezibhalwe emabhukwini wezwe lonke. Nokho, uhulumeni udinga ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi kube nokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ukuze iSahara igcine isimo sayo esikhangayo, kudingeka izinyathelo zokuvikeleka ukuze imvelo ingagugi futhi abavakashi bahlale bejabule. Lokhu kuhlangabezana nezinselelo, kodwa kuyadingeka ukufaka izinqumo eziphusile ukuze kubaluleke ukuvikela igugu lendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlekelele ezifana nezinhlamvu zokukhukhulelwa, imibuso yokuchithwa yama-sand dunes, nezulu elimbi zingadala umthelela omubi emvelweni yeSahara. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuzigcina lezi zindawo zihlanzekile, zitholakale, futhi ziphumelele ngenxa yokubopha umhlaba wonke kwezemvelo. Ekugcineni, iSahara Desert iyindawo ebikezelayo enezimfihlo ezingenakuchazwa. Ukwahlukaniswa kwendawo kuyona kudinga ukuqonda okujulile, futhi uphendula izivakashi ngezimfashini zosuku nezinto ezithokozisayo ezibhakabhakayo. Noma ngabe uhambe ngokuhamba ngezinyawo, uhlola izindawo, noma ube sesixhumaneni nabantu bendawo, iSahara izonikeza impilo ethokozisayo, okukhumbulelayo, nokukhumbuleka. Uhambo lwakho, lunokholo lungalimala umhlaba, uthole izinto eziyingqabavu eziphathelene nemvelo. I-Sahara, ngempela, iyinsika yokuhamba emlandweni nesiko labantu.
UJacob Zuma: Iphrofayela Yomuntu UJacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-12 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942, ungomunye wezizinda ezibalulekile emlandweni wepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika. UZuma, ovela esizweni samaXhosa, wazalelwa eNkandla, edolobheni elincane eliseMpumalanga. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nzima, njengoba ababephila ezimweni ezinzima, kodwa lokho akuzange kumlimaze; esikhundleni salokho, kwaba yimpilo eyamfundisa izifundo eziningi. UZuma uqale ukufunda ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi, kodwa ngenxa yezimo zomndeni, akazange aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe. Ngemuva kokuphuma esikoleni, wathola umsebenzi, kodwa waba nesithakazelo kwezombusazwe. Ngonyaka ka-1959, waba yilungu le-ANC (African National Congress), lapho aqala khona ukukhiqiza izifundo ezibalulekile ngempilo yezombusazwe. Ngemva kokubona uZuma njengomholi oqavile, wathuthela eBotswana, lapho ahlangana nabanye abaholi be-ANC, futhi waba yingxenye yeqembu elalilwa neziphathimandla zenkohlakalo. Waba yiNhloko yeMpi ye-ANC, eqinisekisa ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngalesi sikhathi, waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokulwa nobandlululo, okwaholela ekubuyeni kwakhe eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka ka-1990, lapho uNelson Mandela ephuma ejele. Ngemva kokuphuma kukaMandela, uZuma waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni uhulumeni wephalamende, eba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali, futhi ngemva kwalokho, nguNgqongqoshe wezangaphakathi. UZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezazihlose ukwakha umnotho wezwe, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni kubantu abamnyama. Ngonyaka ka-2005, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekutholeni ukunqoba esikhundleni sokuba nguMongameli we-ANC, kwathi ngo-2009, wathatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli wezwe. Njengomongameli, uZuma waphokophela ekwakheni umnotho, kodwa wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa, ukungathembeki, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukwahluleka kwakhe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqubomgomo zakhe. Ngesikhathi sokuphatha kwakhe, waqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kodwa izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaqhamuka, okuholele emiphumeleni emibi. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwela amalungelo abantu, kodwa izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zashiya umthelela omubi esithunzini sakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uZuma wathatha isinqumo sokuhoxa esikhundleni sokuba nguMongameli, ngenxa yezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abanye baphakamise izwi labo, bephikisa izinqubomgomo zakhe. Nakuba ebebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, uZuma wahlala eqinile ezinkolelweni zakhe, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. UJacob Zuma ungumholi okhumbuleka kakhulu, onobuhlakani obukhulu, lapho eveza khona ukuthi, nakuba ebhekene nezinkinga, akazange alahlekelwe yithemba. UZuma ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila akukhona nje ukuzithokozisa, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nesithakazelo kumphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uJacob Zuma uzohlala engomunye wezikhumbuzo ezibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi izifundo azifundisile zizohlala zikhumbuleka ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Ezocwaningo: Iqhaza Ebalulekile Empilweni Yansuku zonke Ezocwaningo ziningi kakhulu imithombo yokuqonda, ukucacisa, nokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta abantu. Ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezifana nezemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezobuchwepheshe, ezocwaningo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi, ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo enembile, nokwakha izixazululo ezintsha. Le mihlathi isihlola indlela ezocwaningo ezinikeza ngayo umbono ophusile ngempilo yethu, iqhubeka nokuqhakambisa ukufaneleka kokudala, nokuhlonipha izimiso zokucwaninga. Ukwazi Ngempela: Umqondo Wokucwaninga Ukucwaninga akuyona nje inqubo yokuhlola noma yokuhlola imizamo ethile, kodwa kunalokho kuwumqondo owakheke ngezinyawo ezine: ukuhlela, ukuqoqwa, ukuhlaziya, nokuxhumanisa idatha. Ukuze kube kokucwaninga okufanele, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezimiso eziqinile ezihlonipha ukuhambelana, ubuqiniso, kanye nokusebenza. Izinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni udaba lokucwaninga zifaka phakathi ukukhombisa ubufakazi, ukucacisa izinjongo, kanye nokugwema ukujolisa ngezizathu. Ubuchwepheshe Obuthuthukisiwe Nezindlela Zokucwaninga Ngokwenyuka kwezobuchwepheshe, izindlela zokucwaninga ziye zaguquleka. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njengezinkundla zemidiya, ukuhlanganiswa kwedatha, nezinsiza zokuhlaziya, kukhulise imikhakha ehlukahlukene yokucwaninga. Izigidi eziningana zedatha ziqoqwa nsuku zonke, zenzela abacwaningi ithuba elikhulu lokuhlola izimo ezithile ngendlela engakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi nokukhathazeka, kudala ithuba lokuthola imiphumela esheshayo, futhi okuyinto ebalulekile ezindabeni ezinjengezempilo, ezemfundo, nezomnotho. Izicelo Zokucwaninga Eziyisisekelo Nezemvelo Izicelo zokucwaninga ziyakhula zidlula emkhakheni, zibhekisiswe ezimweni ezithinta ikakhulukazi impilo yomphakathi. Ekubhekeni izimo ezinjengokugula, ezocwaningo ziyaqhubeka zisebenza ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokulawula izifo. Izinhlelo zokuhlola nezokuqonda izithintelo zomphakathi kudinga ubuqiniso, lapho abacwaningi begxila ezindleleni ezithinta abantu. Engxenyeni yezemfundo, izinhlelo zabo bokufunda ziguquguquka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuhlanganiswe nosuku nesikhathi bayanakuzwa ukuze kuqashelwe intuthuko nezinguquko. Ukubaluleka KweZifundo Zokucwaninga Okwamanje, ezocwaningo zikhuthaza ukufunda okuhlukeneyo. Abantu bangephumela emiphumeleni yokucwaninga ethula ukuqonda komhlaba jikelele. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zinezinsiza eziqinile ezivumela abantu ukuba baqonde izinkinga zomhlaba, ukuze badlule ezindaweni ezinzima. Kanjalo, abacwaningi bahlala bevuna abantwana nabathintekayo ukuze bashiye umhlaba ungcono. Lokhu kuhloswe ukufaka isandla esihle phakathi kwemiphakathi, ukwakha umqondo omnandi nemfundo ebanzi kumphakathi. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Ezingaphikiswa Kwezocwaningo Njengoba ezocwaningo zingahamba phambili, kufanele kuxazululwe izithiyo ezikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphazamiseka kwemali, ukungawenzi kahle umkhankaso, noma ukuntula indawo yokuhlala ethile yocwaningo. Zithinta kakhulu abantu abavuka emizweni yokwazi. Ukuhambisana nezimiso ezithile zokucwaninga, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okungekho emthethweni noma okuphindaphindiwe kuyinselelo enkulu. Ithuba Lokuhlola neMiphumela Yokucwaninga Ukubaluleka kokucwaninga akukwazi ukukhishwa phansi. Ukugcizelela lesi simo, abantu badinga ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi ezocwaningo azigcini endaweni engeziwe, kepha zisebenza ukusiza ukuhlola umhlaba, nezinkinga ezithinta abantu. Ucwaningo olusemthethweni lwenza kube lula ukufinyelela komphakathi, ludala imiphumela engcono nolwazi olunembile. Ukuphumelela Nokusebenziseka Kwezocwaningo Ekugcineni, umphakathi wesikhathi samanje udinga ukuxhumana namathuba ngendlela ezocwaningo ezithinta ngayo impilo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuzifaka ezibopheni ezingekho emthethweni, kufike effusively ukufinyelela kuthuthukisani elokhetho. Ukuphumelela kuzobalwa ezikhathini ezizayo, ukukhombisa ukuthi ezocwaningo azigcini nje ngokukhulisa ulwazi, kodwa futhi ukudlulisela umnqamulajuqu obalulekile kumphakathi. Ngakho, ezocwaningo zihlala ziyisifundo esiyinsakavukela, esizenzakalayo, nesihlanzekile. Ziyaguqula umqondo wethu, zisikhumbuza ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi okuhle kakhulu kuza kulabo abavuma ukuhamba nathi kulolu hambo lokucwaninga. Lokhu kusebenza kumuntu ngamunye, kuthinta umhlaba wonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezocwaningo ziyisenzo sokuphefumula somphakathi, futhi ziyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umbiko: Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Njengoba izwe lihamba phambili, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inethuba elikhulu lokwenza umehluko. Le mibiko izobheka izici ezahlukene zempilo yentsha, okuhlanganisa imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemiphumela yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Imfundo Imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yentsha. E-Ningizimu Afrika, uhulumeni usebenzise izinsiza eziningi ukuze uthuthukise imfundo, kodwa izinkinga zikhona. Izikole eziningi zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lemfundo. Intsha ibhekene nezithiyo ezinjengokuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezifundo ezithile ezingahambisani nezidingo zempilo yangempela. Nokho, intsha ibonisa ukuzimisela okukhulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, lapho abafundi bephusha imikhawulo ukuze bathole imfundo engcono. Amathuba Emisebenzi Ngokukhula kwenani labantu, amathuba emisebenzi ayancipha. Intsha ibhekene nenkinga yokungasebenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izindlela zokuphila. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenza ukuze ziqinise amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuzithandela, izifundo ezikhethekile, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuholela ekwakheni amakhono amasha, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha ibonisa ubuhlakani bokwakha amabhizinisi amancane, okukhombisa ukuthi inezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yentsha. Ngokwanda kokufinyelela ku-inthanethi, intsha ikwazi ukufunda, ukuxhumana, nokwakha amathuba amasha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi, futhi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ezokwakha, nezokuthengisa. Intsha ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhulume nentsha. Imiphumela Yokuphila Kwansuku Zonke Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ubuphofu, ukungabi namsebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, kodwa intsha ibonisa amandla okuphila. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenza ukuze ziqinise intsha, zikhuthaza ukuzibandakanya emiphakathini, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okukhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Nakuba ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, intsha ibonisa amandla okuphila, ubuhlakani, kanye nezindlela zokwakha amathuba. Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza. Ngale ndlela, intsha izokwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo, kanye naseNingizimu Afrika jikelele.
Umbikweni Ngobuhlakani Bokwenziwa EZwe lanamuhla, sithokozisa umcimbi okhethekile obuhlanganisa izinkanyezi zothando nezobuchwepheshe, okungukuthi, umbono wethu ngozimele bokwenziwa. Lo mcimbi, owenzelwe ukwakha ukuhlakanipha kokukhula, ubhekiswe kokubili kulabo abathanda ubuchwepheshe nezifundo ezithinta umhlaba wokwenziwa, kanye nabantu abajabulela ukuziphilisa emhlabeni wokwakheka kwemvelo. Sihlangene lapha namuhla, ezikhungweni ezihloniphekayo, ezilawulwayo ngothando nofaka ukucabanga okujule ngezinto eziqhamukayo emhlabeni wethu. Ukudla ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kuzakha izindlela eziningi zokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono, kudala amathuba amasha, futhi kwandise indlela esiphila ngayo. Umcimbi wethu usetshenziselwa ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukholisa kulabo abanamakhono ahluke kodwa bakhathazekile ngalokhu kuguquguquka. Uhlanga lwethu lwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa lukhula ngesivinini esikhulu, lube yinsika ekubeni izingxenye ezahlukene zempilo yomuntu zisebenze kahle. Uhlanga luthinta ing ngemigudu emisha yokukhiqiza, ukuthuthukisa ezoktransportation, ukufundisa, kanye nezokuxhumana. Kulolu hambo, iziphakamiso zethu kanye noshintsho lwezobuchwepheshe luhamba phambili ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo eziyisebenzi kahle. Umcimbi wethu uqukethe abakhiqizi, ochwepheshe, kanye nabathandi bebhizinisi ababelokhu becabanga ngezindlela ezihlukene zokuveza ubuhlakani bokwenziwa emikhakheni ephephile. Ngesikhathi sithokozisa le ndaba, sizoba nezingxoxo ezinobuchule ezizocacisa izinzuzo nezingozi zalesi sikhala. Izingxoxo zizoparticipant ngalendlela yokufundisa, ukuqonda ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, kanye nokuhlola izinzuzo ezithile ezilotshwe kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene. Singacabanga ngalokhu kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile zokwandisa ulwazi lwethu. Abakhuluma kuzodingeka ukuba baxhumane nezifundo zakamuva ezigciniwe, bahlolisise izinhlelo ezihambisana nesimo, #okukhona, nezinhlelo ezisebenza ngempumelelo. Lo mcimbi uzobhekelela izinhlelo ezingezenzo zocwaningo, okufaka phakathi namafomu ezikhalazo. Umhlaba ube nezigigaba zalesi sikhala, kodwa izindlela zethu zokuxhumana ngemva kokukhuluma ngebhubesi lethu, kuncane kakhulu kwabanye. Izifundo zethu zikhumbuza abantu bonke ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa yinkomfa evulekile, nemigudu evulekile yokufunda, lokho kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla oboshelwa ngumoya wokuxazulula. Siyazi bona ukwakheka kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kumele kuthathwe ngesineke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, singenza kahle uma sithokozisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso zokuhlonipha. Ukubaluleka kokuhlukana kwezinkambo emhlabeni wethu ofisayo ukuqhubeka ngokuveza izinyathelo eziphezulu kakhulu. Nokho, siyaphinda sibheke ukuthi kudinga uhlinzeko oluqhamukayo, okukhona, kanye nemihla yonke yokushintshela. Ngemva kokuphothula izingxoxo, sizoba nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihambisanayo. Uhlanga lwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa luhlupheka uma izinkanyezi zekhono zizama ukuhamba nomgudu, lokhu kuyindida engafaneleka. Sifuna ukuhlola amandla obuhlakani bokwenziwa, sinesaba sokuthi singenza impilo yethu ibe mhle nangaphezulu, kepha kumele sihlale sinobuhlakani bokwazi ngaphandle kokuphinda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobamba inhlangano yokubambelela ezinhliziyweni zethu, sigqugquzela kakhudlwana ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngokuhlanganyela. Lo mcimbi uzoyiHlala kube yimpumelelo, wagcoba amatshe! Imininingwane yokuqhubeka nalesi sikhala izojabula, futhi ibhande retngqe umphakathi jikelele. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa akuyona kuphela into ethokozisayo, kodwa ukudinga uhlelo, ukucabanga, nokuhlakanipha okuhlanganisiwe. Siqonda ukuthi umcimbi wethu uyaphumelela, kuhle ukwenziwa okubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, sizokwenza okufanele ukhumbule izinkanyezi zabo bonke abahlanganyeli nabathandi bokuhamba, salindele umfenyana nobuhlakani bokwenziwa esikhathini esizayo!
Ukwakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP: Ukwazisa Ngomcimbi Obalulekile Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi weNingizimu Afrika ubungazisa umcimbi obalulekile, okuwukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (Reconstruction and Development Programme). Lezi zindlu zidalwe ngenhloso yokubhekana nezinkinga zokungabi nezindlu ezigculisayo, futhi ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba angcono empilweni kubantu abahluphekayo. Umcimbi waqala ngempelasonto eMphakathini waseMahlabathini, lapho izinkulungwane zabantu ziqoqana ukuze zihlomule emcimbini. Umkhosi uvulelwe ngokukhuluma komholi wesifunda, uMnu. Mthethwa, owasiza ukufakazela isidingo esikhulu sokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithuthukisiwe. Wakhuluma ngokuqinile ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe, ephawula ukuthi “ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akusikho kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha amathuba, ukuzimela, kanye nokuhlinzekela umndeni.” Ngemva kokwethulwa kwephrojekthi, abahumushi bahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezindlu ezizokwakhiwa. Kwakukhulunywa ngendawo ezokwakhiwa khona, iziqondiso zokwakhiwa, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo ezizohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubahlali. Izindlu ze-RDP, ezakhiwa ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezithile, ziyamukeleka kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi zinikeza isitifiketi sokuba semthethweni kumphakathi. Umcimbi wawubhalwe phansi ngendlela yokubamba umoya womphakathi, lapho abantu bezama ukuxhumana nabanye, bejabulile futhi bephakamisa imicabango yabo. Abantu bahlabelela, begijima, futhi bejabulisa impilo yabo, bekhuthazela ukuthi ubumbano lwasemphakathini lungasebenza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ubanjwa ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, abahlali babekhuluma ngezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa futhi bathokozisa izithembiso ezivela kulolu hlelo lwakha umphakathi. Izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza, njengezinkampani zokwakha, zabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinto ezidingekayo zokwakha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakusebenza ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zikhona, ziphephile, futhi zihlala isikhathi eside. Abasebenzi bezinkampani bahloniphe umphakathi, bacacisa ngendlela yokusebenzisa imithombo ethile ukuze kube nokwakheka okuhle kwezindlu. Ngemva kokuphela komcimbi, abaholi bendawo balungiselela imininingwane yokuhamba phambili, beqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyayiqonda indlela yokufaka izicelo zezindlu ze-RDP. Lokhu kwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zathuthukiswa, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo nezidingo ezihambisana nokufaka izicelo. Umcimbi wawuwukubonisa ubumbano phakathi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Abantu baphuma benomoya ophakeme, bejabulile futhi bejabule ngokwesehlakalo esithokozisayo. Lokhu kuhambisana nomgomo wezwe wokwakha umphakathi onokuthula, onokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo, nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Umcimbi wokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP ubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izinto ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kuhlelwe ngendlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sekunesikhathi eside umphakathi ufaka izicelo, abanye bahlala begcwele ithemba lokuthi bazothola izindlu ezizohlinzekela izidingo zabo. Umcimbi obalulekile njenganoma yimuphi omunye, ubonisa ithuba lokuthi abantu baphinde baphile impilo engcono, futhi bakhe impilo ethokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akukhona nje ukwakha izindlu, kodwa kuwukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo kumphakathi. Umphakathi wakhumbula umcimbi, uhamba phambili ngokuthola izixazululo ezithuthukisayo, futhi ububanzi bokuveza izidingo zabo. Ngakho, uma ucabanga ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, khumbula ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP kuyindlela yokuhlomula, ukwakha, nokuphilisa umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuthi umphakathi udlule ezindleleni ezinzima, ufinyelele izimpumelelo ezinkulu, futhi uqhubeke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umbiko Ngobudlelwano Lomndeni Isingeniso Ubudlelwano bomndeni buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu, buhlanganisa izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Lezi zixhumanisi ziqala emndenini, lapho umndeni ubonisa khona izimiso, izinkolelo, nemikhuba ebalulekile. Ubudlelwano bomndeni buphinde buveze indlela esiphila ngayo, indlela esibona ngayo umhlaba, kanye nezindlela esixhumana ngazo nabanye. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimiso Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bomndeni buqala ngokwakhiwa kwezimiso ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali nezingane, phakathi kwezihlobo, kanye phakathi kwabazali beqembu. Abazali banelungelo lokufundisa izingane zabo izimiso zokuziphatha, izinkolelo, kanye nemikhuba yendabuko. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omndeni. Izihlobo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezihlobo buvame ukuba namandla, njengoba izihlobo zihlala zikhona ukuze zixhase, zikhuthaze, futhi ziqondise omunye nomunye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphepha nokuxhaswa, okubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Izinkinga Eziphakathi Kwezakhamuzi Zomndeni Noma ubudlelwano bomndeni bukhona, akukhona njalo ukuthi buphelele. Izinkinga zenzeka phakathi kwamalungu omndeni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni nasekuphazamisekeni. Izizathu ezivame ukuveza lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuxhumana, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezifana nezinkinga zezezimali noma izifo. Ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazali nezingane kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kobudlelwano. Izingane zidinga ukuqonda nokuxhaswa, kanti abazali badinga ukuqonda izidingo nezinselelo zezingane zabo. Uma lezi zidingo zingahlangatshezwana, kungase kube nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukwelashwa Kwezinkinga Zobudlelwano Ukuze ubudlelwano bomndeni buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu omndeni akwazi ukuxhumana kahle. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga, ukwabelana ngezinkumbulo, nokuxhasana ezimweni ezinzima. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudinga ukuzwelana, ukulalela, nokuhlonipha imizwa yabanye. Izindlela zokwelapha izinkinga zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana okuvulekile, ukuxhumana ngezikhathi ezithile, kanye nokuhlela imihlangano yomndeni. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi wonke umuntu akhulume futhi azwakalise imizwa yakhe. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala umoya wokubambisana, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ubudlelwano Bomndeni Nempilo Yomuntu Ubudlelwano bomndeni buphinde buveze umthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Ubudlelwano obuhle buvame ukuholela ekutheni abantu babe nenhlalakahle engcono, baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo, futhi babe nekhono lokubhekana nezinselelo. Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo buvame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, njengoba abantu bezwa ukuthi banesekelo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekutheni abantu babe nezinkinga zempilo, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, noma izinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bomndeni bukhulu kakhulu empilweni yomuntu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle. Isiphetho Ubudlelwano bomndeni buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu, buhlanganisa izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, sikhulume ngezinkinga, futhi sithuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omndeni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi buvumela abantu ukuba baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde futhi sihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubudlelwano bethu bomndeni.
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwezimoto Kwazulu-ngaphakathi, lapho umoya ubhalela izinkanyezi phezulu, kwaphuma imoto eyayihlekisa futhi ibhanga okukhulu embusweni wezimoto. Ngaleso sikhathi, izimoto zazingawubuyeli emuva, kodwa iMercedes-Benz, le mpumelelo yokwazisa, yayiyinyoni ebhalela izinkanyezi zayo emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe. Isigaba sokuqala saqala ngo-1926, lapho uKarl Benz, umphakathi wesikhumbuzo, ahlanganyela noGottlieb Daimler. Lezi zimbangi zashintsha umhlaba wezokuthutha, zenza izimpumelelo eziyingqayizivele ezahluka kakhulu. Isahluko 2: Imoto Yokuqala Kwavela imoto yokuqala yeMercedes-Benz, iModel O, ebelokhu ivusa ukudideka phakathi kwabantu. Imoto ethokozisayo, eguquguqukayo, yanyatheliswa nothengisa, yahamba ngendlela eyahlukahlukene. Abantu babenokubona kahle ukuthi le moto yayihamba phambili. Abantu babephupha ngokuyisebenzisa, kuyiwa emkhakheni wezokuthokozisa - okwakungekho phambili. Amazwi athokozisayo aphuma emlonyeni wabo, asho ukuthi le mhlaba izoshintsha imikhakha ethe xaxa. Isahluko 3: Ukuvusa Umcabango Njengathi abantu bebebonisa uthando lwezimoto, iMercedes-Benz yaphuma nezinye izimodeli ezahlukene. I-S-Class, i-E-Class, kanye ne-C-Class zashintsha umqondo wokuthi imoto kumele ibe kanjani. Lezi zimodeli ziye zafaka izinhlelo ezihamba phambili, izithuthi ezikhethekile, nezinhlelo zokuphepha. Bangujwayelani abahamba ezimotweni ezizimele, abakwazi ukuhamba bethembele kumafaneleka nezifiso. Imoto yabe iyisikhumbuzo sokuphila kwabantu, kwaphoqeleka ukuba bonke babe nethuba lokubona umhlaba ngamehlo amasha. Isahluko 4: Ukuhlola Umhlaba Njengoba iminyaka yehla emhlabeni, iMercedes-Benz yahlola izimakethe eziphuma phezulu. Iza nezimoto zayo eziningi emhlabeni wonke, zishiya umthelela omkhulu ezimweni zempilo zabantu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo kulezi zimoto ezinhle. Umoya wendabuko wawududuzile, njengoba abathandi beMercedes-Benz behamba emigwaqweni, behamba bezama ukukhipha umoya omusha. Izithombe ezinhle zikhala izithombe ezithokozisayo, zenza abantu babonakale ikakhulukazi, begqoka kahle, bejabulile. Isahluko 5: Ukuhlanganyela Empowerment Emkhakheni wezokuthutha, iMercedes-Benz ibiyilokhu isebenza ngamandla, ikhipha imikhiqizo eyinde phakathi kwezithuthi. Umhlaba ubonisa ukuguquguquka, futhi iMercedes-Benz yenza kube lula ukuze izimvume ziqhubeke. Ubuchwepheshe bezimoto buphuthumile, izimakethe zinokuhamba phezulu, futhi imoto I-GLE ibonisa ukushesha nezimo ezinhle. Izithuthi ezithuthukisiwe zihlala ziphakamisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzeka abathusi ngezimfanelo ezinhle ngaphambi kokuthi baphume. Isahluko 6: Isixuku Safika Nansi-ke, ekugcineni, umcimbi omkhulu weMercedes-Benz uhamba phambili, umcimbi ohlonishwayo ohlanganisa abalandeli bayo abavela kuzo zonke izinkanyezi. Umoya uhlele umhlaba ukuze bahlale benomsebenzi kanye nezimoto ezinzima. Abantu balathwa izinhlaka, babamba izithombe, beshintsha imicabango, bejabulela ukuhamba phambili. Umbukiso ubaholela bekhuluma ngezifiso zabo, kubonakale ukuthi imoto iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo. Kwavela umfutho onamandla, imicabango ibanjwe, izinkanyezi zikhanya. Isahluko 7: Ukuqhubeka Phambili Ngemva kwalokho, iMercedes-Benz iyakwazi ukuqalisa ikusasa elisha, ithatha izinyathelo ezinhle nezicacile, ebonisa imizwa yezenzo ezithile. Imoto isazophela kancane kancane ibonisa umdlandla, ikhipha izihlahla, ibalema, ibhalisela izinkanyezi. Abantu babephakamisela izikhali, belindele ukufinyelela esikhathini senkululeko, bejabulile emizweni yabo. Le mikhakha ifakazela ukuthi iMercedes-Benz izaphephisa isizukulwane esizayo, iqoqa udumo kanye nethuba lokuhlala kuzo zonke izikhalazo, njengoba ikhuluma ngalobu buhle obuphelele bempilo. Isahluko 8: Umoya Wokugcina Ngaphakathi kwemoto zeMercedes-Benz, abantu bakwazi ukuthola umoya ophumayo. Umoya opheleleyo, omkhulu, uhlelekile. Emahlathini, eqhuba, izinyoni zishaya izibhakabhaka; zebhange ziya phezulu, ziveza ukuthi lokho kuhjuma kudinga ukufiphalisa iminwe. Isithombe sakhanya, saguqulwe kwaze kwaba khona umoya olawulwa ababhikishi. IMercedes-Benz illokhu ingumqondisi, uze ufike kuzo zonke izinkanyezi, ubukisisa umhlaba wonke, njengoba iba yinsika ebalulekile yokuthinta impilo yabantu. Imoto ayisiyona nje isithuthi; but ona, ibhalela izinkanyezi emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe, ikhuluma ngothando lokholo, ihamba phambili kuzo zonke izinsuku. IMercedes-Benz ithokozisa umhlaba wonke, ibhalela izindaba zayo emoyeni, izinkanyezi ezikhanya ngobunono. Kwakuthoma konke, kanti isigqi siba sesiqhubeka, sikhumbula zonke lezi zinkanyezi ezithokozisayo.
Umculo we-Gospel: Umthombo Wokholo Nothando Umculo we-gospel ungumculo ogcwele imizwa futhi onomlando ocebile. Ubonisa uthando, ithemba, kanye nokholo. Namuhla, umculo we-gospel ungaphezu kokuba nje umculo; ungumthombo wokukhuthaza, ukwelapha, nokuhlanganisa abantu. Kubalulekile ukuhlola umthelela nomsebenzi walo emiphakathini yethu. Umculo we-gospel uqala emlandweni, lapho izinkolo zikhula khona, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama eMelika. Lolu hlanga luhlanganisa izitayela eziningi, kusukela kumculo wesintu, i-blues, kanye ne-jazz, okwenza umculo we-gospel udlule imingcele, ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, futhi ube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Umculo we-gospel uyakhumbuza ukuthi, noma izimo zingase zibe nzima, kukhona ithemba, futhi sikhona umthombo wokholo. Abaculi abanjengoMahalia Jackson, Aretha Franklin, noKirk Franklin baveza ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima empilweni. Uhlanga lwe-gospel lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephakeme, baphokophele phambili, futhi bahlale bejabulile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Umculo we-gospel uhlanganisa abantu, futhi izinkonzo ze-gospel zihlala zikhanga abantu abaningi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Lapho abantu behlangana ukuze baphile umculo, bahlala bejabule, bephila izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Umculo we-gospel ungumgogodla wokuhlangana, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi ubakhumbuza ukuthi sonke sabelana ngempilo, izinkinga, nezifiso. Nokho, umculo we-gospel ubhekene nezinselelo. Njengoba uqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo eziningi zikhona. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izitayela ezintsha, kanye nezinguquko emiphakathini zenza kube nzima ukugcina umoya wokuqala we-gospel. Abaculi abasha bahlala bezama ukuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, kodwa lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekeni komoya we-gospel. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi bahlale beqaphela imvelaphi yomculo wabo, ukuze bahlale bephila umoya wokholo nothando. Umculo we-gospel udinga ukugcinwa. Abaculi, abaphathi, nabalobi badinga ukugxila ekwakheni umculo onenhloso, onokuthinta, futhi ophilayo. Umculo we-gospel kufanele ube yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, njengobulungiswa, uthando, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuzokwenza umculo we-gospel ube yinsika eqinile emiphakathini yethu, uqhubeke nokukhuthaza abantu. Ekugcineni, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokholo, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Ubonisa ukuthi, noma izimo zingase zibe nzima, sikhona isikhumbuzo sokuthi sitholakala ndawonye, sikhuthaza, futhi sithokozisa. Umculo we-gospel ungumgogodla wokuphila, uhlanganisa abantu, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungaba yindawo engcono uma sabelana ngothando. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhasa umculo we-gospel, siwugqugquzele, futhi siwugcina, ukuze uqhubeke nokukhanya njengomthombo wokukhuthaza nokuqinisa imiphakathi yethu.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Umhlahlandlela Wokuthuthukisa Izimfuno Zabasebenzi Isingeniso Iziteleka zabasebenzi zenzeka lapho abasebenzi behlangana ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo, kakhulu uma kubhekwa izimo zokusebenza, imiholo, noma amalungelo abawathola. Lokhu kuhlangana kubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zomsebenzi. Lezi ziteleka, nakuba ziningi izizathu ezihlukene eziyenza zenzeka, zifaka phakathi ukulwa nokungabi nabulungisa emsebenzini, ukucela ukuhunyushwa kabusha kwemiholo, nokufuna ukuvikeleka kwesikhala sokusebenza. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izizathu Zokuhlanganisa Ukuze kube neziteleka eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle izizathu eziholela ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuhlangana. Abasebenzi kufanele baphawule kahle ngezinkinga ababhekene nazo. Lezi zingaba zihilela imiholo enganele, izinzuzo ezithile ezingenalutho, noma izimo zokusebenza eziyingozi. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukusungula ukuhlangabezana kwabantu bonke ukuze bahlale bezisola ngezinkinga zanguye. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kahle izizathu zabo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanganisa Iqembu Lokuphatha Ngesikhathi sokuhlangana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube neqhaza elikhulu elibamba iqhaza. Abasebenzi kumele bahlukane ngamaqembu, njengoba ukuxhumana nomunye kubalulekile. Inhloso yokuhlanganisa iqembu lokuphatha izinto ezizokwenziwa ngesikhathi sezi teleka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhetha abamele iqembu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu benza izinkulumo, nokudlulisa imiyalezo ngendlela ecacile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukufunda Ngezindlela Zokuxhumana Ngaphambi kokuqala iziteleka, kubalulekile ukufunda indlela yokuxhumana. Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nolwazi oluqinile lokuthi bangasizakalela kanjani. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezifana nezikhalazo zomphakathi, amabhodi ezindaba, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zindlela, abasebenzi bazokwazi ukudlulisa izikhalazo zabo kalula. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Izinyathelo Zokusebenza Ngemuva kokuthi sekubanjwe okukhulumile, kufanele kuhlelwe izinyathelo zokusebenza. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlale bejolisa emigqeni yokusebenza ethile. Lezi zinyathelo zingahlanganisa: 1. Ukubhalisela isiteleka: Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baphinde baziqhenye. Ukubhalisela isiteleka kuzobasiza ukwenza inhloso yabo ibe sobala. 2. Ukuhlela isikhathi nezindawo: Abasebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi isikhathi socwaningo sokuqhakambisa izikhalazo zabo sinqunywa kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, kubhengeze izinsuku, nezindawo ezizoba neziteleka. 3. Ukubamba umhlangano nezinkampani: Uma abaphathi bempela bephendule izikhalazo, abaphathi kumele bazicabangele izinyathelo ezithile. Ukubamba umhlangano okhulu nokukhuluma nabasebenzi kungenza kuhlale phambili. Isinyathelo 5: Ukumisa Izicelo Nezivumelwano Izicelo ezihlobene neziteleka kufanele zicace futhi ziqinile. Abasebenzi kufanele baqonde ukwamukela ukuzikhandla kokuthuthukisa izimo zabo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukuxhaswa kwezabasebenzi. Ukuzinikela kudingeka ukuze amaqembu abumbe izivumelwano ezithile. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuphathwa Kwezimphendvuli Ngemuva kokuhlanganisa izidingo nomphakathi, umphakathi kufanele uthole izimpendulo. Abasebenzi kumele bakhumbule ukuthi iziteleka zingathatha isikhathi, futhi okubalulekile ukuthi bahlale benza kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqhubeka Nokuxhumana Ngemuva kokuphumelela kokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi kube khona ukuvuselelwa kokuqonda ngezinyathelo ezithatiwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubuyisa umbono wabo bonke abaphatheli - Ukuhlele imihlangano yokuhlanganyela ngemuva - Ukuthola impendulo ezithile kumphakathi Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi, uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zingcono kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi bahlale behlangile futhi basebenzise izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kubalulekile ekutholeni imiphumela emihle. Kukhona ukwenza inzuzo, kookhuza izimo eziphambili kubasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi uthole izimpendulo ezijulile ezifundiswayo naphakathi. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi futhi kunikeze amajoka ezokuhlalisana ngendlela ehambisanayo.
Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika Ezweni elinothile ngezamasiko nezemidlalo, iNingizimu Afrika iyaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yayo emkhakheni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ebholeni. Ibhola, elaziwa ngokuthi "football" emhlabeni jikelele, liyinsika yokuhlanganyela nokubumbana kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswe ngezinga, izifunda, kanye nezikhungo zokuqeqesha, futhi ahlale enezigigaba ezithokozisayo ezikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana. Ekuqaleni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lathuthuka kakhulu ngemva kokuphuma kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho umphakathi waqala ukubona ibhola njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokubuyisela emuva izinkinga zomphakathi. Amaqembu amaningi aqala ukuvela, futhi ngaleso sikhathi, i-PSL (Premier Soccer League) yasungulwa, yenza kube lula ukuhlela imidlalo nokwandisa ukuthandwa kwebhola. Omunye wamaqubu amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika nguKaizer Chiefs, owaziwa njenge "Amakhosi." Lo mqeqeshi ube nomlando omuhle, uqale ngo-1970, futhi ube neziqu eziningi, kuhlanganise ne-PSL titles. Amakhosi abamba umoya wempumelelo, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bekhuthazekile, bekhombisa uthando olukhulu emidlalweni.
