Umdlalo wabo ophakathi kweKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, owaziwa ngokuthi "The Soweto Derby," uhlala uthokozisa izinkulungwane zabalandeli, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Orlando Pirates, eyasungulwa ngo-1937, iyinhlangano enomlando omude futhi ophumelelayo. Le nqola ibhizinisi elikhulu, ibonisa ubuhlakani obukhulu emidlalweni, futhi ibamba izicoco eziningi. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni, bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Umdlalo phakathi kwePirates neChiefs ungowokugcina izinkumbulo ezinhle, umoya ophakeme, nokuhlangana kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, iMamelodi Sundowns, eyasungulwa ngo-1970, iyinhlangano edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. I-Sundowns ithole udumo emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ngempumelelo yayo kwiCAF Champions League. Le nqola ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi inezinkanyezi eziningi ezidumile. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umdlalo wezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika awubandakanyi kuphela amaqembu amakhulu, kodwa futhi kunezinqola ezincane ezithokozisayo. Amaqembu afana ne-Black Leopards, i-TS Galaxy, ne-SuperSport United nawo anomlando omuhle, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Lezi zinqola zikhombisa ukuthi ibhola alikona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika liye laba yinsika yokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi. Amaqembu ahluke-hluke aphesheya kwezilwandle, ahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi liwumthombo wokujabula, ukuncintisana, nokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola eNingizimu Afrika liye laba yindawo yokukhuthaza abasha. Amaqembu amaningi abamba imicimbi yokukhetha abadlali abasha, ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, futhi abavula amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala likhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNingizimu Afrika ibonakale iyindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho amaqembu ebhola engumongo wempilo yomphakathi. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns abamba izindima ezinkulu, kodwa futhi abanye abancane bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Ibhola akusikho nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokwakha umphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lihlala linethemba, futhi abalandeli bazoqhubeka nokukhuthaza amaqembu abo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, ubumbene, futhi ubambisene ukuze uthokozise umoya wobumbano. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika azokwenza izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi umoya wokuncintisana uzohlala uqhubeka.
Ezokwakha: Umlando Wokwakha Ezinsukwini zokuqala, abantu babenokuhlupheka ngenxa yezidingo ezibalulekile zokwakha izindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhumbuzo zamasiko. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo babubucayi, futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindlu ezilula, ezakhiwe ngamathe, izinkuni, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezitini ezazitholakala emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ezokwakha. Emakhaya amakhulu, izindlu zakhangwa zibe nezakhiwo ezinzima, ezinjengezindonga eziphakeme nezimpahla ezithuthukisiwe. Izinkanyezi zokuqala, ezifana namaGrecian neRoma, zathuthukisa imikhuba yokwakha, zisebenzisa izinsiza ezifana ne-granit ne-marble, okwenza izakhiwo zihlale isikhathi eside. Lezi zinkanyezi zashintsha umqondo wokwakha, zifaka phakathi izinsiza ezithile ezathuthukisa ubuciko bokwakha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkanyezi ezahlukene zathuthukisa izitayela ezahlukene zokwakha. E-Afrika, izinkanyezi zokuqala zifaka phakathi amaZulu, amaXhosa, namaSotho, ababevele behlukanisa izakhiwo zabo ngezinkanyezi zabo. Izindlu zikaZulu, ezaziwa ngokuthi amaDonga, zaziqhakambisa ubuciko bokwakha, zineziqongo eziphakeme ezazivumela ukuhamba kalula emoyeni. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuhlanganiswa kwemvelo nezakhiwo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngesikhathi seMinyaka Ephakathi, izakhiwo zaba zikhulu kakhulu, zifaka phakathi izinqaba nezikhumbuzo. Lezi zinkanyezi zazihlanganisa ubuciko bokwakha obunobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi zazivame ukubonisa amandla nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi. Izinqaba zaziqinisekisa ukuvikeleka, kanti izikhumbuzo zazifaka isithombe esihle semiphakathi ethile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Industrial Revolution yaguqula ngokuphelele umkhakha wezokwakha. Ukutholakala kwezinsiza ezithuthukile, njengezinsimbi, kwavula amathuba amasha okwakha. Lezi zinsiza zashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngokwakha, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhumbuzo ezinkulu, izakhiwo eziphakeme, nezindawo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha wokwakha, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi. Ngesikhathi seMhlabeni Ohlangene, izakhiwo zanda, futhi ubuchwepheshe bokwakha bukhula ngokushesha. Izinsiza ezinjengezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi, izinhlelo zokwakha, nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi emikhulu zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezinkulu, ezinjengezikhungo zezemidlalo, izikhumbuzo, nezindawo zokuhlala ezibanzi. Uhlanga lwezokwakha lwalubukeka luhlukile, luhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Namuhla, ezokwakha ziba yinsika ebalulekile emiphakathini. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezimoto ezikhiqizayo, izinhlelo zokwakha ezisebenza kahle, nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside, kuqhubeka kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezinhle nezisebenzayo. Izinkampani eziningi zikhula, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona, ziqhubeka zenza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani eziningi ziqhubeka nokwakha izakhiwo ezihloniphekile, ezihambisana nemigomo yokugcina imvelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala isikhathi eside, izinkampani ziqhubeka zifaka izindlela zokwakha ezilungile, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, indaba yezokwakha ibonisa indlela abantu abahlangana ngayo nemvelo, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bokwakha buqhubeka buhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ubuciko, nemvelo kuqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izindawo ezinhle, eziphilayo, nezihloniphekile, okuholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. Ezokwakha, ngakho, akukhona nje ukwakha izindlu, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo, imiphakathi, nezinto ezizokhumbula izizukulwane ezizayo. Lokhu kuqhubeka kuveza ukuthi ezokwakha zihlala zibalulekile, futhi zihlala zikhula, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle, behlanganyela, futhi bejabulela izinzuzo zokwakha.
Ezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya, noma ngesiNgisi "rural development," yisihloko esibalulekile esihlobene nokukhuphula izinga lempilo kanye nezinga lemfundo, emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Lesi sikhala sithinta izinhlelo ezahlukene ezihlosiwe, ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezingqalasizinda. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya zihlukaniswe nokutholakala kwezinsiza, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zemfundo ezikahle. Izindawo eziningi zasemakhaya zihlupheka ngokuntuleka kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, ukwakha izikole ezinamazinga aphakeme, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo eziphephile, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Okwesibili, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kubaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni komphakathi. Imikhakha efana nezolimo, ubuchwepheshe befu, nezinsizakusebenza kufanele ithuthukiswe ukuze inikeze amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvuselela izindlela zokulima, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nokwakha izimakethe ezikahle ukuze kubonakale imikhiqizo yendawo, kungasiza ekukhuphuleni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha, okwenza kube nokwanda kwemali engenayo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesithathu, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya. Uhlelo lwezokuthuthukiswa lwezindawo zasemakhaya luyoba khona uma kunokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zingxenye. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bakhuliswa, baziqhenya ngezindawo zabo, futhi babe nesibopho sokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yabo. Imibono efana nokwakha amaqembu omphakathi, ukwakha izikhungo zokufundisana, kanye nokuxhumana ngezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuyasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kubalulekile ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo eqhubekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zibhekelele futhi zivikele imvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo ngendlela sustainable, ukwenza izinhlelo zokuqinisa umhlaba, kanye nokuthi abantu basemakhaya bazi kahle ngendaba yokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingafunda ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nokwandisa isimo sokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukuhunyushwa ngenhlonipho kumasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezifiso zabantu bendawo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ucwaningo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso nemigomo yomphakathi. Uhlelo oluhambisana nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya lukhombisa ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba babambe iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezithinta izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kudinga ukuqhubeka nokugqugquzela izinguquko ezizwakalayo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlobene, kanye nokuhlola imiphumela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi izinqubomgomo zithinta kanjani abantu, kanye nokuthi zidinga yini ukuhunyushwa kabusha ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakho, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya akusikho nje kuphela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza, kodwa kuyinqubo ebanzi edinga ubuhlakani, ubumbano, kanye nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izingxenye zomphakathi. Ngaleyondlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela izindawo zasemakhaya, sinikeze abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi sikhulise umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezithokozisayo, ezihloniphekayo, nezikhula ngokwezimali, ezilungele ikusasa.
UUber Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elikhulu, lapho izimoto zisheshayo ziphithizela khona, uSipho wayehlala ebuka izithombe ku-smartphone yakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi edlala nabangane bakhe, wathola ukuthi udinga ukuthola indlela yokuhamba. Wazama izinkampani ezahlukene, kodwa uUber, inkampani eyaziwa kakhulu, wavula umnyango. UUber, uSipho wayeziqhenya ngawo, wawungumngane wakhe omusha, owamsiza ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ngezikhathi ezithokozisayo. Wathola ukuthi akadingeki ukuba ahambe eziteshini zezimoto noma azame ukubangisana nezithuthi zomphakathi. Njengoba ehlala eGoli, uSipho wayevame ukuhamba emsebenzini, ethokozisa izinsuku zakhe ezinzima. Uhambo lwakhe no-Uber lwaqala ngempelasonto ethile. Uthole isiphakamiso esivela kumngane wakhe, uThando, owayevame ukuhamba noUber. UThando wamchazela ukuthi uUber ungumkhankaso omuhle, ovumela abantu ukuqasha izithuthi ngama-application. USipho wathatha isinqumo sokuzama, wathi: "Ngizozama!" Ngesikhathi ethatha uhlelo lokusebenza ku-smartphone yakhe, wayezwa ukulangazelela. Waqala ukufaka imininingwane yakhe, wathola umshayeli ogama lakhe linguSibusiso. Uhlelo lwakhe lwenziwa lukhanya, lwaphoqa uSipho ukuba alinde okuncane. "Uzofika emaminithini ambalwa," kusho uhlelo. Waqala ukucabanga ukuthi mhlawumbe lokhu kuzoba yinto emnandi. Ngokushesha, imoto kaSibusiso yafika, futhi uSipho wathola ukuthi uSibusiso wayenobungane. Bakhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi uSipho waphawula ukuthi uSibusiso wayekwazi ukuhamba kalula emiphakathini eyahlukene. "UUber uyindlela yokuhamba efanele," kusho uSipho, enokuthokoza. Kuze kube manje, wayekhuluma nezinye izinkampani, kodwa uUber wayesebenza kahle kakhulu. Njengoba behamba, uSipho wathola ithuba lokucabanga. Wayefuna ukufunda okwengeziwe ngenkampani, futhi uSibusiso wamxoxela ngempumelelo ye-Uber. "Bakhuluma ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho, benza kube lula abantu ukuhamba," kusho uSibusiso. USipho wabona ukuthi le nkampani ayibukeki njengezimali kuphela, kodwa ibonakala ithinta nezimpilo zabantu. Ngemva kokuhamba, uSipho wathola ukufika endaweni yakhe, wagcwalisa i-rating, futhi wanikeza uSibusiso umbono omuhle. "Ngiyabonga, Sibusiso. UUber ungumngane wami omusha," kusho yena. Uthokoze kakhulu, washaya isithupha, futhi wayezizwa enelisekile. Lokhu bekukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo, okwakungukuthandana okwakusuka kumakhasimende kuya kubashayeli. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwezinye izinsuku, uSipho waqhubeka ezama uUber. Uthole izimo ezimnandi, izikhumbuzo ezinhle, kanye nezinkanyezi ezivela kubashayeli abahlukene. Abanye babebonisa uthando, kanti abanye babenokukhulumisana okuhle. USipho waqala ukufunda ukuthi uUber akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuthinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Uhlelo lokusebenza luye lwahamba lwathuthukiswa, futhi uSipho waqala nokucabanga ngezindlela zokukhangisa uUber. Waqala ukusiza abanye abantu, wakhuthaza abangane bakhe ukuba basebenzise uUber. "Kuhle kakhulu, kuzokwenza izinto zibe lula," wayesho ngenkuthalo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi uSipho ezama ukwakha ibhizinisi lakhe. Ngesikhathi edinga ukuthola izinsizakalo, uUber waba uhlobo lwenqubomgomo yempilo yakhe. Uthole ukuthi akufuneki ukuba uhlale ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa ungahamba noma kuphi lapho udinga khona. UUber waba isixazululo esihle sokuphila kwansuku zonke. Wazizwa ekhululekile, engasondelene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSipho waqala ukufunda ngendima ye-Uber emnothweni. Wabhala izincwadi, wazama ukuxhumana nabantu abaningi, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. Wafunda ukuthi uUber ungumsebenzi ongcono, ogcwele amathuba, futhi ungaba yinkonzo eyakha umphakathi. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuhamba lwenza impilo yakhe ibe lula. Waqhubeka noUber, wahamba nabangane, emangalisa ngezinselelo ezithile, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umkhankaso ungaba yinzuzo. UUber waba umhlali, umngane, nezinsiza ezibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Ngemuva kokuhamba isikhathi eside noUber, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubuyela emuva, abheke phambili kwelanga elisha. Wazisa uUber, ngoba wawuphendula kahle impilo yakhe. Wathokoza kakhulu, ethola izifundo eziningi, futhi waqhubeka nempilo yakhe, edinga uUber ngempela. Ngaleyo ndlela, uSipho waba nesikhathi esihle, futhi uUber waba umngane wakhe omuhle. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, ekhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi ebhalela abanye izindaba ezimnandi. UUber waba uhlobo lwezimpilo zabantu, futhi uSipho wayenomsebenzi omkhulu; ukuzama ukusiza abanye ukuze bazi kahle uUber. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola lokho okwaziyo; uUber akuyona nje indlela yokuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, ubudlelwano, nezinsizakalo ezikhuthazayo. Ngakho, akakhumbuli nje uUber, kodwa uphinde alubhekele ngothando nomsebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yinkanyezi empilweni yakhe.
Imfashini: Umcimbi Wokukhanya Kwezemfashini eGoli Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi omkhulu wezokugqoka, owaziwa ngokuthi "I-Gauteng Fashion Week," wabanjwa eGoli, edolobheni elidume ngempumelelo yalo emkhakheni wezokwakha imfashini. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa abaqambi, abathandi bemfashini, kanye nezinkampani ezihamba phambili, wawuhloselwe ukukhombisa ubuciko, ubuhle, kanye nezitayela ezihamba phambili emhlabeni wezokugqoka. Umcimbi uqale ngengxoxo ethokozisayo phakathi kwabaculi bemfashini abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bechaza izitayela zabo, izinsiza abazisebenzisayo, kanye nezinto ezithinta imfashini namuhla. Ababukeli babenethuba lokuzwa izindaba ezithokozisayo ezivela kubadali bemfashini, okuhlanganisa nezifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxhumana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini nabadali, okwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile ngale mikhakha. Ngemuva kwengxoxo, umcimbi uqhubekile nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezazihamba phambili emkhakheni wezokugqoka. Abamodeli baphuma bejabulile, begqoke izingubo ezihlukahlukene ezikhiqizwe ngabadali abavela eNingizimu Afrika. Izingubo zikhombisa ubuciko obuhlukahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni ezijulile zamasiko zethu, kuze kube sezitayeleni eziphakeme ezivela emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuziveza, yokukhuluma, nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Izinkanyezi ezazihamba phambili zifaka phakathi uThando Thabethe, uBonang Matheba, kanye noMaps Maponyane, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. UThando, owaziwa ngempela ngempumelelo yakhe emkhakheni wezokwakha imfashini, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe lokuthi imfashini ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yomuntu. UBonang, onobuchwepheshe obukhulu bokuphatha, wakhombisa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokwakha ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo. UMaps, owaziwa ngokuqhubeka nokwakha umkhiqizo wakhe, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bejabulile, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngezimpahla abazigqokayo. Ngemuva kokukhombisa izitayela ezihlukahlukene, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi ababukeli baphenduka bezithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezibukwayo. Abathandi bemfashini baphinde banikwe ithuba lokuthenga izingubo ezithile ezitholakala emcimbini, okuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini nabadali. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi imfashini iyindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziveza, kanye nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Ababukeli baphuma bejabulile, bephinde bejabulisa abanye ngempilo yabo, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngezimpahla abazigqokayo. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi we-Gauteng Fashion Week ubonise ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziveza, nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Ubuqotho, ubuciko, kanye nezitayela ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi imfashini iyindlela yokuphila, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu.
