Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Mthembu: Umzamo Wokuphila Ngempilo UThandiwe Mthembu, umama oneminyaka engama-35, uhlala edolobheni laseThekwini. Uhlale ebhujiswa yizifiso zokuphila impilo enempilo, okwenze wathola indlela yokuzivocavoca eyamvumela ukuba akwazi ukuphila kahle. UThandiwe akazange aqale ukuzivocavoca ngenxa yokuthanda kuphela, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi wayefuna ukuphila impilo enempilo, engathinteki kalula yizifo ezihlobene nokungasebenzi kahle komzimba. Uthando lukaThandiwe lokuzivocavoca lwaqala ngemuva kokuba umngani wakhe emshiyile emcabangela izinzuzo zokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayezizwa engakhululekile emzimbeni wakhe, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhuthazo sokuthi aqale ukuzivocavoca. Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo, ematasa ekhanda, ethola umoya opholile, futhi ethokozisa umqondo wakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuhamba kwakhe, futhi kwaba yindlela yokuphuma emhlabeni wakhe wansuku zonke. Ngemva kokuhamba ngezinyawo, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukugijima kwaba yinto emjabulisayo. Waqala ukugijima emaphandleni, lapho ethola khona umoya omusha nezinsizwa ezimnandi. Uthando lwakhe lokugijima lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokuzivocavoca, futhi wathola ukuthi lokhu kumenza azizwe engcono, kanti futhi kumphucula amandla akhe. UThandiwe ubona ukugijima njengendlela yokukhulula ingcindezi, futhi lokhu kumenza azizwe ekhululekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akupheli ekugijimeni kuphela. Waqala ukufunda ngokuqina, futhi wathola izindlela ezahlukene zokuzivocavoca. Wafunda ukudlala ibhola, ukugibela ibhayisikili, kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca emakhaya. Lokhu kumenze waba nezinhlobonhlobo zokuzivocavoca, futhi wathola ukuthi umhlaba wezokuzivocavoca unikeza amathuba amaningi okuzithuthukisa. UThandiwe akazange akwenze lokhu kuphela ngenxa yokuzithokozisa, kodwa wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca kuyasiza ekuphuculeni impilo yakhe. Waqala ukufunda ngempilo, ukudla okunempilo, nokubaluleka kokuphumula. Wafunda ukuthi ukudla okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlobonhlobo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emiphumeleni emihle. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukudla okukhululekile, okuqukethe izithelo, imifino, nemifino, kuyasiza ekwakheni umzimba onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa umzimba, kodwa futhi kuyasiza ekwakheni umqondo ophilayo. Waqala ukuhamba nezinye izintokazi ezithanda ukuzivocavoca, kwaba yithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abasha, nokwakha ubungane obusha. Lokhu kwaba yisikhala esihle sokuxoxa, ukufunda, nokukhuthazana. UThandiwe uthanda ukuhamba ezikhathini ezithile, lapho abanye abantu behlangana ukuze bazivocavoce. UThandiwe akathandanga kuphela ukuzivocavoca, kodwa wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili empilweni yakhe kuyadingeka. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziphathelene nezokwelapha, ezimfundisayo, nezokuphila. Lokhu kumenze waba nolwazi oluningi, futhi wathola ukuthi ukujula kwempilo kuyadingeka ukuze akwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Waqhubeka nokufunda, futhi uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi lokhu kumenze abe nesithakazelo esikhulu empilweni. Namuhla, uThandiwe ungumama ophilayo, onempilo, futhi othokozisayo. Uhlale ebhujiswa yizifiso zokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi ukwazi ukusiza abanye abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. UThandiwe uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuzivocavoca akukhona kuphela ukuzithokozisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Uthando lwakhe lokuzivocavoca lukhombisa ukuthi impilo enempilo iyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi uyakuthokozisa ukusiza abanye abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. UThandiwe, ngempela, ungumama ophilayo, onemibono emihle, futhi oqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba babe nemiphumela emihle empilweni yabo. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akuyona nje into, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi lokhu kumenza abe ngumuntu ophilayo. Lokhu kwenza uThandiwe abe yisibonelo esihle sokuthi impilo enempilo iyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi umhlaba wezokuzivocavoca unikeza amathuba amaningi okuzithuthukisa.
U-Cassper Nyovest: Iphupho Elikhanyayo Nokusebenza Kwesimanje U-Cassper Nyovest, igama eliqhakazile emculweni weHip Hop waseNingizimu Afrika, ube nesandla esikhulu ekuguquleni umhlaba wezokungcebeleka. Ngonyaka we-2014, uCassper, ogama lakhe langempela linguRefiloe Maele Phoolo, wathola udumo olukhulu ngemva kokukhulula i-albhamu yakhe ethi "Tsholofelo". Le albhamu ikhuluma ngempilo yakhe, izifiso zakhe, kanye nezithiyo ahlangabezana nazo, ikakhulukazi njengoba efuna ukuphumelela emhlabeni obheke phansi. U-Cassper akavumanga ukuthi izimo zimpofu zizmbe indlela yakhe, kuphinde kachaze ubuhlakani nobungcweti bokuthola izixazululo. Kukhona phakathi kwamathuba amakhulu owakha wona emculweni. U-Cassper ugcizelele ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokwenza imali; uwumthombo wokukhuluma, obambisela ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Umculo wakhe uhlangene nemizwa, uvusa izinkumbulo, futhi ukhuluma nabantu, ikakhulu abasha, ngezinselelo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka umoya wokwakha, umphakathi, kanye Nezimpawu Zesimanjemanje, akuphinde kudalule umfutho othenjiswa kumphakathi konke. U-Cassper uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezobuciko, ephakamisa izinkanyezi ezisha. Ngamandla akhe, udlale indima enkulu ekuvuseleleni ubuciko beHip Hop eNingizimu Afrika, ekwakheni isimo sokuthi umculi angaphuma ngaphandle ehla ngenxa yokukhula kwezinkanyezi ezihamba phambili. U-Cassper uyazisa ukuthi umculo wakhe udinga ukuzwakala ezindaweni eziningi, ngakho-ke uhamba phambili ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abaculi abasha bayahlanganiswa, futhi bakhuthaza ezokungcebeleka. Ngaphandle kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, uCassper uphinde waba umphakathi. Unenhlonipho evelele emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini emisha efuna indlela yokuphila engcono. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zokuhlomulisa umphakathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini elwela ukuthola amathuba okusebenza. Ubuye uqhubeke nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, baphumelele, futhi baphokophele amaphupho abo. U-Cassper Nyovest ubonakalisa intshiseko yokwenza umphakathi ungcono, usebenzisa izinkuni zakhe ezinhlobonhlobo ukusiza abanye. Usebenzisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze aqinise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nezifundo kubantu abasha, ethuthukisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Ucwaningo lwakhe lokuzama ukuqhakambisa izinkanyezi ezincane luhlonishwa enhliziyweni yomphakathi futhi luphendula izinga eliphezulu lothando lokusiza. U-Cassper uqhubeke nokuhlonishwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ethokozisa izithameli zakhe ngezinsuku ezimnandi. Ngemva konyaka wezivivinyo ezingapheli zempilo, ubesanda kuthola izindondo ezinkulu emcimbini we-South African Music Awards. Lezi zindondo zikhombisa umsebenzi oncomekayo, ubuciko, nemali eyakhayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanye abaculi abakwenza okungaphezulu kokulindelwe. Okokugcina, uCassper Nyovest uphinde waba ngumkhiqizo wemikhiqizo emikhulu, ngezinhlelo ezijulile nezokuhlonza. Uhlele izinhlelo ezifana ne "Fill Up" uhlele emicimbini eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze abavakashi bazobona amaciko akhe phezu kwesigcawu. Hhumusha umqondo wokuhlanganyela, uCassper ukhuthaza abaculi abasha ukuba bangasebenzisa amandla abo ukuze bazathandwa. Umgomo wakhe omkhulu ukwakha ingqalasizinda yokwazisa nokuphathwa kwalabo abanamakhono. Ngakho, uCassper Nyovest ungubuhlakani obusha emculweni nasezinhlelweni zokusebenza. Njengomculi, umphakathi, umxhumanisi, necaba elijulile, uCassper ubonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi, ukwazi nokukwazi ukuphumelela, kakhulukazi elwela ukuphila okugcwele umhlaba, izizukulwane ezintsha zikwazi ukukwazi ukusungula izinto ezinhle ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Ngempela, uCassper Nyovest ubonisa indlela yokuphila engcono, kokubili emculweni nasekuhlinzekweni kwemiphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe ungumthwalo ongalibaleki, uvcimisela abanye ukwenza umqondo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi, ngendlela engokoqobo, imicabango emihle nezincazelo zokuphila zithuthuka ngokubambisana, kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esikhunjuzayo. U-Cassper ufana nedwa ngesithunzi sothando, ukuhlonipha, kanye nomsebenzi omuhle, okuhlonishwa okufanele futhi okungenakuphikwa.
Ukunakekelwa Kwamadoda Nabesifazane Abadala: Ubulungiswa Nempilo Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahamba phambili empilweni, kubalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Lolu hlelo lokunakekela ludinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba luhlanganisa izici ezahlukene ezithinta impilo, ubuchwepheshe, nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Abantu abadala, ngokwemvelo, bahlala bezithola bephila impilo ehlukile, futhi kudinga ukwenziwa ngendlela ethokozisayo, efanele, futhi eqhubekayo. Isimo Somphakathi Nendlela Yokunakekela Izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala zidinga ukwakhiwa kumasiko nemigomo yomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, umphakathi kumele unikeze amathuba okuthi abantu abadala bazizwe bebandakanyekile, bejabule, futhi bephila impilo ephelele. Ukunakekela, kungaba ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, ezokwelapha, noma izinhlelo zokuphila, kufanele kube yinto eqhubekayo. Umsebenzi wokuqonda izidingo zomuntu ngamunye, njengoba abantu abadala behluka ngokuya ngempilo yabo, izifiso zabo, nezinkumbulo zabo, ubalulekile. Izinselele Ezinhlobonhlobo Kukhona izinselele eziningi ezibhekene nabo abaphatha ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinqubomgomo ezingasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Abantu abadala, abaningi babo, bahlala bephathwa njengabantu abangenamandla, okwenza kube nzima ukuba baziveze. Ukuze kukhule ukuzethemba kwabo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abantu abadala, zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana nomphakathi, ukuxhumana kwezokwelapha, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphila. Ubuchwepheshe Nokunakekelwa Ubuqotho bokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala buhlobene kakhulu nobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka phambili, kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthi kuzothuthukiswe izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala. Izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana zingasiza abantu abadala ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomndeni nabangani, baphinde bathole usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze kube nezinqubo eziqhubekayo zokufundisa abantu abadala indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukwamukela Ubulungiswa Ubulungiswa bukhona ekunakekelweni kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, wonke umuntu kufanele athole ukunakekelwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Abantu abadala kufanele banikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngezidingo zabo, bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, futhi bezwe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhuluma ngempilo yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukugxila emkhakheni wezemfundo, ukuze abantu nabakhiqizi babone ukuthi abantu abadala bangaba nesandla ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabo. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ngokubuka phambili, kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokwandisa ulwazi emphakathini. Lokhu kuhilela ukufundisa umphakathi ngokubaluleka kokunakekela abantu abadala, ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezisemthethweni, kanye nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukisiwe. Ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele kungaba yindlela enhle yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akuyona nje into ethinta impilo yabo kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala, kufanele sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunobulungiswa, obuphumelelayo, kanye nezixazululo ezibhekana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu abadala baphile impilo egculisayo, benza umphakathi ube yindawo engcono kubo bonke. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kumele kube ithuba lokuhlonipha, ukuxhasa, nokwakha impilo enempilo.
uKabza De Small: Umculi Ohlonishwayo Nophumelelayo U-Kabza De Small, ogama lakhe langempela linguKabelo Motha, ungumculi ophumelelayo, umkhiqizi, kanye nomdansi odumile eNingizimu Afrika. Wazalelwa eSoweto, eGauteng, ngomhla ka-27 kuNhlangulana ngo-1992. U-Kabza, owaziwa kakhulu ngokuqamba izigqi ezijabulisayo neziphumelelayo, ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili emkhakheni we-Amapiano, uhlobo lomculo olwakhiwe ngama-sounds ahlukahlukene, okubandakanya i-house, jazz, ne-kwaito. U-Kabza De Small uqale ukuthanda umculo kusenesikhathi empilweni yakhe. Njengomfana, wayevame ukuhamba nabangane bakhe, edlala umculo ezindaweni zomphakathi. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqale ukufunda ukudlala izinsimbi, futhi wathola ukuthi ungakha umculo wakhe. Ngemuva kokuphothula isikole, u-Kabza waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe zomculo, lapho athola khona amathuba okusebenza nabanye abaculi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Ngonyaka ka-2016, u-Kabza De Small waqala ukwakha igama lakhe emhlabeni womculo, lapho ethola khona ithuba lokubambisana nabanye abaculi abanjengo DJ Maphorisa. Lezi zibopho zakhula zaba yimpumelelo enkulu, zenza ukuthi umculo wakhe udume kakhulu, futhi kwavela imisebenzi eminingi ethokozisayo. U-Kabza waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni i-Amapiano, futhi waba ngumholi walesi sitayela, enza izinkanyezi zikhanye emculweni. U-Kabza De Small uthole udumo olukhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emculweni. Uvele ezinkundleni ezinkulu zomculo, ezihlanganisa imicimbi emikhulu, futhi uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise ne-National Arts Festival, i-SAMA (South African Music Awards), kanye ne-MTV Africa Music Awards. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni abanye abaculi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo emculweni. Ngaphezu kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, u-Kabza De Small ungumuntu ophilayo impilo ethokozisayo. Uthanda ukuhamba, ukudla, nokuchitha isikhathi nabangane bakhe nemindeni. U-Kabza ubonakala engumuntu ophansi, onobuntu, futhi uhlala eqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima ukuze athuthukise umculo wakhe. Uhlonipha izimpande zakhe, futhi uhlala ebonga abathandi bakhe, abamthandayo futhi bemsupporta emsebenzini wakhe. U-Kabza De Small uyisibonelo sokuthi ngempela, uma ungasebenzela iphupho lakho, ungakwenza. Ubonisa ukuthi umculo unamandla okushintsha izimpilo, futhi uhlala ezama ukufaka umoya omuhle emphakathini. U-Kabza uyazi ukuthi umculo wakhe ungathinta abantu abaningi, futhi usebenzisa leli thuba ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi abasha abaphila ezindaweni ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Kabza De Small uqhubeka nokwakha igama lakhe emhlabeni womculo. Uhlale eqhubeka nokwakha, efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umculo wakhe ube ngcono. U-Kabza ungomunye wabaculi abahle kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi ubukeka ezokwenza izimpumelelo eziningi ezizayo. Uthando lwakhe lomculo, ubuhlakani, kanye nomsebenzi onzima kwenze waba yisithombe esihle emculweni wezwe. Ngokubuka phambili, u-Kabza De Small ubheka amaphupho amakhulu. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwakha umculo ophumelelayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekubambeni izinkanyezi ezinkulu emculweni. U-Kabza uyisibonelo sokuthi umculo ungashintsha izimpilo, futhi ubalulekile empilweni yabaningi. Ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe kanzima, u-Kabza De Small uzoba yinkanyezi engapheli emculweni, futhi sizobona izimpumelelo ezinkulu ezizayo.
Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu behlala khona ngokuthula futhi bejabula. Kule ndawo, uSipho, umculi ophumelelayo, wayenombono omkhulu. Wayefisa ukudala ifilimu ezodala umthelela empilweni yabantu, eqiniseka ukuthi ifilimu ingashintsha umhlaba, inikeze abantu ithemba, futhi ibakhuthaze ukuba balwe nezinkinga zabo. Ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wahlangana noNandi, umdwebi wezithombe, owawunobuchwepheshe obukhulu, kodwa engakaze abe nengxenye enkulu emhlabeni wefilimu. U-Sipho wamkhuthaza ukuba bahlanganyele, babaqale iphrojekthi yabo yokuqala. Baphenduka izinsuku eziningi bejolisa emcabangweni wabo, behlola izindaba ezithinta abantu bendawo. Bafuna indaba ethinta inhliziyo, ethinta izinkinga zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, bathola indaba kaThandi, intombazane enesibindi eyayiphila ezimweni ezinzima. UThandi wayephila emndenini onobunzima, kodwa wayenamaphupho amakhulu. Wayefisa ukufunda, nokuphuma endaweni yakhe, kodwa izithiyo zazingamjolisi. U-Sipho noNandi babona ukuthi le ndaba iyingqayizivele, futhi bangakha ifilimu ezodala umthelela. Ngemuva kokuhlela, baqala ukusebenza. U-Nandi wadweba izithombe ezinhle, ngesikhathi uSipho ebhala imibhalo. Bahlanganyela imicabango, behlola izimo ezahlukene. Kwakunzima, kodwa uSipho noNandi babengapheli amandla. Bafuna ukwakha ifilimu ezokhuthaza, ezojabulisa, futhi ethokozisa abantu. Ngesikhathi sokudalwa, bahlangana nezithiyo eziningi. Abanye abantu bendawo babengakuthandi ukubona ifilimu yabo, becabanga ukuthi ayizwakali kahle. Kodwa uSipho noNandi babengakuvumeli lokhu kubaphazamise. Bafuna ukwenza okuthile okukhumbulekayo. Bahamba phambili, beqinisekisa ukuthi ifilimu yabo izoba yinto eyingqayizivele. Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza kanzima, ifilimu yabo yaphela. U-Sipho noNandi babebonisa ifilimu yabo emiphakathini ehlukene. Umphakathi wathokozisa, abantu babebuka bejabule, bephendula ngemizwa emihle. UThandi, owayengumgibeli, waba yisibonelo sokuthi amaphupho angafezeka, noma ngabe izimo zikhathaza. U-Sipho noNandi bakwazile ukudala ifilimu eyashintsha impilo kaThandi, nezimpilo zabaningi. UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda, futhi waba yisithombe sokuphumelela. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho noNandi bazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awuphelanga. Ifilimu yabo yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungashintsha umhlaba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo uma bebelana. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwabo, uSipho noNandi baqhubeka bephusha imingcele yobuciko. Bafuna ukudala ezinye izindaba, behlola izimo ezithinta abantu. U-Sipho wakhumbula ukuthi ifilimu akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi ukuveza izinkinga zomphakathi. Bahamba phambili, bejolisa ekwakheni ifilimu ezothinta abantu, ezizokwenza baphinde bacabange. U-Sipho noNandi bazi ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha, futhi ifilimu yabo yayiyisinyathelo sokuqala. Babengaqondi kahle ukuthi izinsuku ezizayo zizoze zibe zinhle, kodwa babeqinisekile ukuthi ubuciko bawo bukhona. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho noNandi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi ifilimu yabo yayiyingxenye yempilo yabo, futhi izosala njalo emqondweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ifilimu yabo yathola udumo emhlabeni wonke. UThandi waba yisithombe sokuphumelela, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukulandela izinyathelo zakhe. U-Sipho noNandi bazi ukuthi benze okuthile okubalulekile, futhi ifilimu yabo izoba yinsika yokukhuthaza abanye. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphumelela, ethokozisa abantu, futhi ibakhumbuza ukuthi amaphupho angafezeka, uma kuphela bephikelela. Ekugcineni, uSipho noNandi bazi ukuthi ifilimu yabo yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungashintsha umhlaba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo. Baphinde bazitholele ukuthi ubuciko bungokwakho, futhi kufanele buphumelele, ukuze buhlanganyele nabanye. Ifilimu yabo yayiyinsika yokukhuthaza, futhi izokhumbuleka njengenye yezinto ezinhle ezenzeka empilweni yabo.
Ngifuna ukukwazisa ngendaba ethokozisayo mayelana neTheku. Ngiyazi ukuthi ungathanda ukuyazi, ngoba iTheku iyindawo egcwele impilo, isiko, nemigudu yokuhlola. Ngizokhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, izindawo ezinhle, namathuba ahlukeneyo okwenza izinto ezahlukene. Uma uhlela ukuhamba eThekwini, ungakhetha phakathi kwezitimela, izithuthi zomphakathi, noma ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Umoya weTheku uthokozisa, futhi uma uhamba ezitaladini, uzobona abantu abahlukene, imiphakathi, nemisebenzi ehlukahlukene. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, izindonga ezinezithombe zokwakha, nemigwaqo engama-pavement, konke lokhu kudala umoya omuhle. ITheku iyindawo yokuhlangana, lapho ungahlangana khona nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabase-Afrika nabavela kwamanye amazwe. Kodwa akujabuli nje umoya, kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko. Uthando lwamasiko lukhanya uma ubona abantu bejabula emishadweni, ezinkonzweni, nasemijukujukwini. ITheku inezinkonzo eziningi, okusho ukuthi ungakuhlala ubona izigigaba, imicimbi, namathonya amakhulu. Uthanda ukudla? Kulungile, iTheku inezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene, lapho ungathola khona ukudla kwamasiko ahlukene. Uthanda izindawo ezinhle? ITheku inezindawo eziningi ezinhle. Uthanda ogwini? Tye! Uthanda amajuba? ITheku inezindawo ezibhalwe kahle, futhi ungathola izindawo ezinhle zokuphumula. I-Beachfront iyindawo edumile, futhi ungathokozisa lapho uhleli phansi, ubuka abantu, noma udlala emanzini. Uma ufuna ukuvuselela umoya, ungavakashela eShaka Marine World, lapho ungafunda khona ngempilo yasemanzini, ubuke ama-saquiatters, futhi uthokozise ngezinto ezahlukene. Lezi zindawo zenza iTheku ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuvakasha, futhi abavakashi bavame ukubuyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTheku inemithombo eminingi yokuhlola. I-Old Fort, i-Durban Botanic Gardens, kanye ne-Moses Mabhida Stadium konke kuhle kakhulu. Ungavakashela lezi zindawo, uzithokozise, futhi ube neziqiniseko ezinhle. I-Old Fort ibalulekile, iyisibonelo sezakhiwo zomlando, kanti i-Durban Botanic Gardens iyindawo yokuphumula enezitshalo ezinhle nezindawo zokuhlala. Ngithanda ukusho futhi ukuthi iTheku ibalulekile emsebenzini. Imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ixhumene nezimboni, izimakethe, nezokungcebeleka. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, beyazisa lezi zindawo eziphilayo. Ukuhamba edolobheni kunganikeza ithuba lokufuna umsebenzi, noma ukuphakamisa amakhono akho. Ngaphezu kwezinto ezinhle, kufanele sikhulume ngalokho ongathanda ukukubona. Uthanda izinkanyezi? ITheku ineziqhingi ezinhle, futhi uzothola izinkanyezi ezithokozisayo ezibhakabhakayo. Uthanda lezo zinto? Ungakuthola lokho lapha! Noma ungase ubone izimpahla ezimnandi zesiko, eThekwini ungathola amakhaya ahlukeneyo, amabhizinisi amancane, nezitolo ezithengisa izinto eziphathekayo. Lokhu kuhle, ngoba udinga ukuthenga izinto, ungakhetha phakathi kwemikhiqizo yendawo, noma ungathanda ezinye izinto ezikadeni. Kodwa ekugcineni, iTheku ifana nokuphila. Ihlangene kakhulu, futhi umoya uyazwakala. Ngiyazi, uma uvakasha eThekwini, uzothola izinto eziningi ezinhle. Uthando lwezindawo, abanye abantu, namasiko kubonakala, futhi lezi zinto zenza iTheku ibe yindawo ethokozisayo. Ngakho, uma ungakaze uvakashele eThekwini, ngikukhuthaza ukuba uhlola lezi zindawo. Uzojabula, futhi uzokwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo. ITheku izokwenza uqonde ukuthi impilo iyajabula, futhi ungathola izifundo eziningi eziphuma ezindabeni zansuku zonke. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, ngithemba ukuthi uzothokozisa ukuvakashela eThekwini, futhi ungaba nesipiliyoni esihle. Hamba phambili, uthathe ithuba, futhi ujabulele konke okukhona!
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Abathengisi basemgwaqeni, noma abathengisi bejuba, bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Bangabantu abathengisa imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene emigwaqweni, izikhala zomphakathi, nakuma-park, bahlala bejabulisa abathengi ngezinto ezithengiswayo. Nokho, leli qembu labathengisi libhekene nezinselele eziningi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Imvamisa, abathengisi bahlala besebenzisa izinsiza ezincane, futhi bahlala bejolisa ekutholeni imali yokuphila. Lokhu kubavimbela ekutholeni izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi bahlala bephikisana nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezivamile, okungaholela ekutheni bahlukunyezwe noma bahlaselwe yizinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba siqonde kahle ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukwesekwa, hhayi ukugxekwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza kube nzima ukuthola izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa. Ukuze kube khona ukuhweba okuhle, kudingeka izindawo ezithile ezitholakalayo, kodwa abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bejolisa emigwaqweni, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni komgwaqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamiseni umphakathi, futhi kungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle ezindaweni ezikufuphi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bathole izixazululo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamisa abanye. Ukuphikisana kulokhu, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza kube nzima ukuthola izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba abathengisi bejolisa emigwaqweni ethile, okungaholela ezimeni ezimbi. Nokho, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubheka izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Bahlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, futhi bahlala bejabulisa abathengi ngezinto ezithengiswayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukuxhaswa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni nohulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, ezizovumela abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abathengisi, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kahle, futhi bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Nokho, bahlala bephikisana nezinkinga eziningi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukwesekwa, hhayi ukugxekwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi nohulumeni, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila kahle, futhi baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobumbano. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi badinga ukuba siwasekele, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Isingeniso Kuyaziwa ukuthi ugesi udlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngaphandle kukagesi, izimpilo zethu zingaba nzima, futhi ukusebenza kwezinsiza eziningi kuyaphazamiseka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukufinyelela kukagesi kubalulekile emakhaya ethu. Kulesi sikhumbuzo, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola ugesi emakhaya, izinzuzo nokubaluleka kokutholakala kukagesi, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unokufinyelela kukagesi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukutholakala Kukagesi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukutholakala kukagesi kusho ukuthini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kumasistimu kagesi asezingeni eliphezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu basebenzise amandla kagesi ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Ugesi usiza ekukhanyiseni izindawo, ekwakheni izinsiza zokuphehla, nakweminye imisebenzi ethile efana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zemfundo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthengisa. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokuthola Ugesi Uma uthanda ukuthola ugesi, isinyathelo sokuqala ukuhlela ukuvakashela izikhungo ezikhipha ugesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana nezikhungo zikagesi ezisemthethweni, njengama-ESCO (Electricity Supply Companies) noma amabhizinisi azimele anikela ngalesi sikhungo. Abanikezeli balesi sikhungo bazokwazi ukukwazisa ngezinhlelo ezikhona zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, izindleko ezihambisana nezinsiza, kanye nemigomo yokufinyelela kukagesi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izidingo Zakho Zokuthola Ugesi Ngemuva kokuxhumana nezikhungo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi udinga ugesi kangakanani, nokuthi uzowusebenzisa kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba izikhungo zikagesi zikuhlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka, kanye nezindleko. Ukubeka phambili izidingo zakho kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola ugesi owanele, owanele, nolungile. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubhalisela Ugesi Uma usucacisile izidingo zakho, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhalisela ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcwalisa ifomu lokubhalisela ugesi, lapho kudingeka ukuba uqedele ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu, ikheli, kanye nezinye izidingo ezithile. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela yonke imiyalelo efanelekile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthumele konke okudingekayo ukuze ugesi wakho uthole ukwamukelwa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlola Isimo Sengxenye Yakho Ngemuva kokubhalisela ugesi, izikhungo zikagesi zizohamba zihlola isimo sengxenye yakho ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kulungile ukufaka ugesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izintambo, izinsiza, kanye nezidingo zomhlaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ugesi ungafakwa ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lokhu kungenziwa ngochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe, abanolwazi lokuhlola izindawo ukuze baphendule izidingo zakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukufakwa Kukagesi Uma isimo sengxenye yakho sihamba kahle, izikhungo zizoqala ukufaka ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izintambo, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuphakela ugesi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ukufakwa kwenziwe ngochwepheshe abanenhlonipho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziyalandelwa futhi ukuthi ugesi uzohamba kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqeqeshwa Nokusebenzisa Ugesi Ngemuva kokufakwa kukagesi, uzodinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda indlela yokusebenzisa izinsiza ezintsha, ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ugesi, nokugcina izindlela zokuphepha. Ukuqonda kahle lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi uwusizo empilweni yakho. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Ukutholakala Kukagesi Ngemuva kokufakwa kukagesi, kubalulekile ukuhlala uhlola ukutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqapha amandla kagesi, ukuthola izinkinga ezingase zibe khona, nokuxhumana nezikhungo zikagesi uma kwenzeka izinkinga. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina ugesi uphila kahle, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi ubunjalo buhle. Isiphetho Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngendlela efanele yokuhlela, ukuqonda izidingo zakho, nokulandela izinyathelo ezichaziwe, ungathola ugesi owanele futhi owusizo. Ukusebenza nosokhaya, abahlinzeki bagesi, kanye nochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngakho-ke, qhubeka uqhubeke, ungavumi ukuthola ubunzima; ugesi uwusizo, futhi ungakuhlanganisa nempilo yakho.
Ezentela: Izigaba Eziyinhloko Zokuhleleka Kwezentela Isingeniso Ezwenikazi lethu, ezentela zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukukhokha intela ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zomthetho ezihambisana nalezi zinyathelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizosisiza bonke abantu, kanye nezinkampani, ukuba bazi kahle izidingo zabo zokuhlinzeka ngezentela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izinhlobo Nezincazelo Zezentela Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlobo ezahlukene zezintela. Zikhona izintela eziningi ezifana ne-intela yemihla-nemihla, intela yezimpahla, kanye ne-intela yokudluliswa. Umuntu ngamunye nesikhungo sakhe kufanele aqonde ukuthi iyiphi intela efanele kumkhiqizo wabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekubhaleni nasekukhokheni intela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Izikhumbuzo Zokukhokha Ngemva kokuthi umuntu eqonde kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izikhumbuzo zokukhokha intela. Lokhu kungaba ukufaka izikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe, ukuze umuntu abe nesibopho sokukhokha ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezithile. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele ngenxa yokuhoxiswa kwemali. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlela Imibiko Ngomthetho Ngemuva kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlela imibiko yezintela. Umuntu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi imibiko ibonisa kahle zonke izimali ezitholakele nezindleko ezikhokhelwe, futhi ibhalwe kahle. Ukubhalwa kwamadokhumenti kufanele kuhambisane nemithetho yokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubala Intela Yakho Manje sekuvele isikhathi sokubala intela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubala umholo, imithombo yezimali, nezindleko ezihambisana nomsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukufuna usizo kwezocwaningo uma ungazi kahle ukuthi ungabala kanjani intela yakho. Ungabuza abeluleki bezentela ukuze uthole izeluleko ezithile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlinzekwa Kwedokhumenti Yokukhokha Ngemuva kokubala intela, umsebenzisi kufanele alungise uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti yokukhokha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuvele ukuthi ulandele imigomo efanele. Kubalulekile futhi ukugcina ikhophi yezenzo zokukhokha ukuze uqinisekise uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Izindleko Zokukhokha Ngemva kokukhokha, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi izindleko zokukhokha ziqhubekile ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi awuzange ungeze izindleko ezingekho emthethweni. Ukuze uqhubeke uthola okuhle, hlola izinqubo ezitholakalayo noma ushintshe amasu. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubika Ngemva Kokukhokha Ngemva kokukhokha, kubalulekile ukuthumela umbiko wezintela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga ezinkulu zingavikelwa esikhathini esizayo. Ukubika akubalulekile kuphela ukuze kuhlonishwe umthetho, kodwa futhi kunika ithuba lokubuyekeza izinqumo. Isiphetho Ezentela ziwusizo olukhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ukwazi izinyathelo ezihambisanayo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazicabangele ngokuqondile. Ngalezi zinyathelo ezichazwe kahle, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uthola okwakhe, futhi unika isandla ekwakheni umnotho wenhlalakahle. Ngakho, qhubeka uzibophele ukuze ube qotho ekubhalisweni nasekukhokheni ezentela, ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela empumelelweni enkulu.
Ukusebenza Kwama-Ambulensi: Indaba Yomlando Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo ube sewandeni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwama-ambulensi. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi, kubalulekile ukubheka imvelaphi yawo, izinguquko ezenzekile, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Ekuqaleni, ngaphambi kokuba ama-ambulensi abe yinsiza ejwayelekile, abantu babebhekana nezimo ezinzima lapho kudingeka ukusiza abagulayo noma abalimala. Izithuthi ezinjengezinqola, izinyathi, noma izikebhe zazisetshenziswa ukuze zidlulisele abantu abadinga usizo. Lokhu kwakuyinselele enkulu, njengoba izithuthi zazingenakuhamba kalula ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi abahlinzeki ngosizo babephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, kwavela umqondo wama-ambulensi njengemoto ethile eyenzelwe ukusiza abantu abagulayo. I-ambulensi yokuqala eyaziwayo yadalwa eNgilandi ngo-1832, futhi yayiyimoto eyayihamba kancane, kodwa yayinezinhlaka ezikhethekile zokuthutha abagulayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula indlela yokwakha izinhlelo ezihamba phambili zokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo. Ngemva kwempi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Ngonyaka we-1865, i-Red Cross yaseSwitzerland yathuthukisa uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okwakuhlanganisa ama-ambulensi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo nemigudu yokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi phakathi neMpi Yezwe II, izimoto eziphuthumayo zathuthuka zaba nezinsiza eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza zokwelapha eziphuthumayo, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha. Namuhla, ama-ambulensi asebenza njengengxenye ebalulekile yesistimu yezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezithuthi ezisheshayo, izinsiza zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Abasebenzi bama-ambulensi bahlala beqeqeshwa ukuze baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-ambulensi awasebenzi kuphela ezimeni eziphuthumayo, kodwa futhi ahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu bengenakho ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude bangathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wokusebenza kwama-ambulensi ube sewandeni, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, ama-ambulensi, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ngokubheka emuva, singabona ukuthi ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kudlule ezinyathelweni eziningi, kusukela ezithuthweni ezilula kuya ezithuthweni eziphambili. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umqondo wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo uhlala uthuthuka, futhi umphakathi uqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo lwezempilo. Ngokuphetha, ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kuyindaba ebalulekile emlandweni wezempilo. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo, kuze kube namuhla, ama-ambulensi abe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuphatheni izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina ama-ambulensi esebenza kahle, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo oludingekayo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi akugcini nje ngokusiza abantu abagulayo, kodwa futhi kuveza umoya wokubambisana nokuzinikela emphakathini.
uElon Musk Umbuzo 1: Ubani uElon Musk? U-Elon Musk ungumholi ophambili kwezobuchwepheshe, umphakathi wezomnotho, kanye nomphakathi. Uzalwe ngoMfumfu 28, 1971, ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika. Uyi-CEO yeTesla, Inc. neSpaceX, futhi uphakathi kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokuhamba ngezithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izikhala zokuhamba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyamthuthukisa uElon Musk? U-Elon Musk wakhula enothando lwezobuchwepheshe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePretoria, wathuthela eMelika, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo eStanford University. Nokho, wathola ithuba lokwenza umehluko emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Waqala izinkampani eziningi, kuhlanganise neZip2, PayPal, neX.com, okwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkampani ezinkulu eziholwa nguMusk? U-Elon Musk ungumholi weTesla, Inc., eyaziwa ngokwakha izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi. Ubuye abe ngumqondisi weSpaceX, inkampani eyenza izikhala zokuhamba eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubambe iqhaza kwiNeuralink, eyenzela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezobuchwepheshe, kanye neThe Boring Company, ehlose ukwakha izindlela zokuhamba eziphumelelayo phansi komhlaba. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza uMusk ahluke kwabanye? U-Elon Musk ubonakala enomqondo ophusile, onokubona phambili. Uhlale efuna izixazululo ezintsha ezinkingeni zomhlaba, njengokushintsha indlela esihamba ngayo, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, nokwenza ukuhamba kwesikhala kube yinto ejwayelekile. Ubuye abe nesibindi sokuthatha izinqumo ezinzima, ezivame ukuhamba phambili nezingozi, okwenza kube nzima ukuziqhathanisa nabanye abaholi. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo uMusk abhekana nazo? Njengomholi, uMusk ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana emakethe yezithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izindleko eziphezulu zokwakha izikhala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha izinkampani ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uthola ukugxekwa okuvela kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Nokho, uMusk uyaziqhenya ngokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, futhi uthanda ukufunda eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 6: U-Elon Musk ubona kanjani ikusasa? U-Elon Musk ubona ikusasa elinokuthuthuka okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe. Uthemba ukuthi izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi zizoba yindlela ejwayelekile yokuhamba, futhi ubona umhlaba ophilayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ubuye abe nezinhloso zokuhamba kwesikhala, efuna ukuthumela abantu emhlabeni wonke, kuhlanganise noMars. U-Musk ukhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngalezi zinto, futhi ubakhuthaza ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Umbuzo 7: Yini uMusk ayifundisile kwabanye? U-Elon Musk ufundisa abantu abaningi ukuthi ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo kuyadingeka ukuze ufinyelele empumelelweni. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga isibindi, ukuzimisela, nokusebenza kanzima. Ubuye akhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, bahlale befuna izixazululo ezintsha, futhi bangesabi ukuphumelela. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kuMusk? Izifundo ezibalulekile esingazithola kuMusk zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuzimisela: U-Musk ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima nokuzinikela kuyadingeka ukuze ufinyelele imigomo. 2. Ukucabanga Okungajwayelekile: Ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo kungaholela ezixazululweni ezintsha. 3. Ukubhekana Nezinselelo: U-Musk ufundisa ukuthi izinselelo zingaba yithuba lokukhula. 4. Ukubambisana: Ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza nabanye kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu. Umbuzo 9: U-Elon Musk uyathandwa noma uyagxekwa? U-Elon Musk ungumuntu ophawulekayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni abathandwa kakhulu nabagxekwayo. Abanye abantu bamhlabela njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe nezindlela zokuphatha. Nokho, akekho ongenakuphikiswa ukuthi uMusk ungomunye wabantu abavelele kakhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo ku-Elon Musk? U-Elon Musk uqhubeka nokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezinkulu, efuna ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izinhlelo zokuhamba kwesikhala, kanye nezixazululo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. U-Musk ubonisa ukuthi ikusasa lisezandleni zethu, futhi ubakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphokophele phambili, bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi bahlale bephokophele phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elon Musk uzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zizohlala zikhumbuleka. Ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, isibindi, nokusebenza kanzima, konke kungenzeka.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kubhekisela ekwenzeni noma ekuphatheni izingane ngendlela engafanele, ehlukunyezayo noma ehlukunyezayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, noma ngokocansi. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengane, kubangela izinkinga zempilo zengqondo, ubudlelwano obuphukile, kanye nezinye izinkinga ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izindlela zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kubandakanya ukushaya, ukwephula amathambo, noma ezinye izinjongo zokulimaza. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo kubandakanya ukugxekwa, ukuhlekiswa, noma ukungabikhona kokuthanda. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kubandakanya ukuhlinzekwa noma ukuvuma ukuxhumana okungafanele. Zombili lezi zinhlobo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengane. Umbuzo 3: Yini edala ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zingahluka kakhulu. Ezinye izizathu zingabangelwa ubunzima bezimali, ukucindezeleka, izinkinga zomndeni, noma ukungabi nekhono lokuphatha imizwa. Abantu abahlukumezayo bangase babe nezinkinga zabo, njengokuhlukumezeka kwabo esikhathini esedlule. Ngakho, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akukhona kuphela umphumela wokuziphatha kwabantu, kodwa futhi kubangelwa izimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zingahluka, kodwa ziningi ezivamile. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingaba nokukhathazeka, ukungabikhona kokuzethemba, ukushintsha kokuziphatha, noma ukungathandi ukuya esikoleni. Ezinye zingase zibe nezinkinga zokulala, zikhathazeke, noma zibe nezinselelo ezingokwengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuba abazali, othisha, nabanye abantu abadala bazi lezi zimpawu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza izingane ezidinga usizo. Umbuzo 5: Yini okufanele yenziwe uma umuntu ebona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Uma umuntu ebona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kubalulekile ukuthi abhalise lokho. Lokhu kungafaka ukuvakashela emaphoyiseni, izikhungo zokuxhasa, noma izikhungo ezikhethekile ezibhekelela ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane. Abantu abavikela izingane kumele bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinkinga futhi bathumele izikhalazo. Ukuthola usizo ngokushesha kungasiza ekuvikeleni ingane. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela izingane ekuhlukunyezweni? Ukuvikela izingane ekuhlukunyezweni kudinga imizamo eminingi. Abazali kufanele babe nekhono lokuxhumana nezingane zabo, babafundise ukuziqhenya, futhi babakhuthaze ukuba baphawule uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Izikole nazo zingaba nezinhlelo zokufundisa izingane ngezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa nokuthi zingabika kanjani. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele ekwakheni indawo ephephile nekhululekile ukuze izingane zikhule. Umbuzo 7: Yini umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane empilweni yazo? Umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ungaba mubi kakhulu. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingase zibe nezinkinga zempilo zengqondo, ezifana nokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, noma izinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni zibe nezinkinga ezinzima empilweni yazo, njengezinkinga zobudlelwano, ukungaphumeleli esikoleni, noma izinkinga zomsebenzi. Umthelela ungaba phezulu kakhulu uma ukuhlukunyezwa kuqhubeka isikhathi eside. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo ezikhona zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo? Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka izikhungo zokwelashwa, izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abazali. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, kanye neminyango kahulumeni nazo zisebenza ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezingane ezidinga usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi lezi zinsiza ukuze bakwazi ukusiza izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Umbuzo 9: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngokuqinile ngalesi sihloko? Ukukhuluma ngokuqinile ngokuqhubekayo ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze sikhulume ngempilo yengane. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akufanele kube yindaba ethule, kodwa kufanele kube yindaba esikhuluma ngayo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ukukhuluma ngalesi sihloko kusiza ukukhulisa ukuqonda, kuvuse umqondo wokuvikela, futhi kukhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule uma bebona ukuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube indawo ephephile nekhululekile ezinganeni. Isiphetho Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokuvikela izingane zethu, sizame ukuqonda izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, futhi sithole izindlela zokuxhasa. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, singakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile, lapho izingane zingakhula khona zikhululekile futhi zifinyelele phezulu.
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Umcimbi Wokuthenga Ohloniphekile Ezindaweni zethu, izitolo ezinkulu, noma "supermarkets" ngesiNgisi, zibe yindawo ebalulekile yokuthenga. Lezi zitolo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuthengisa obuphambili, futhi zenze kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo eminingi endaweni eyodwa. Umcimbi wethu wokuqala wokuhlola lezi zitolo uhlelwe ukuze sithole ulwazi olujulile, futhi sithokozise abathengi nabanikazi bezitolo. Siqala ngokuhlola ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zaziwa kanjani kuqala. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, zaba indawo yokuhlangana kwabathengi. Abaningi bezwa ukuthi bayazithokozisa lapho befika ukuze bathole ukudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza ezidingekayo, okukhombisa ukuthi zidlala indima enkulu ekuphuculeni impilo yabantu. Umcimbi wethu wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubanikazi bezitolo, abathengi, kanye nochwepheshe bezokuthengisa. Bakhuluma ngezindlela zokuthengisa, ukuphatha izitolo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, futhi azigcini nje ngokuthengisa. Kwakukhona futhi ithuba lokuhlola imikhiqizo. Abathengi babenethuba lokuhlola okuhlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zokugqoka, nezinsiza zasekhaya, futhi baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokubeka izimvo zabo, okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wagxila ekuthuthukiseni imvelo. Abaningi baphakamisa izindlela zokunciphisa udoti, njengezinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, okukhombisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu ziyakuqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina imvelo. Umcimbi wahlanganisa nezifundo eziphathelene nezokuphepha, lapho abanikazi bezitolo bakhuthaza abathengi ukuba baqaphele izindlela zokuphepha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi baphila kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abathengi bazi ukuthi izitolo zikhathalela impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wethu ubonisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga, zikhuthaza ubudlelwano, futhi zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni imvelo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa lezi zitolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano, sithole imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi sigcine imvelo. Umcimbi uphakamisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu azigcini nje ngokuba indawo yokuthenga, kodwa ziba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokufunda, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sizithokozisa lezi zitolo, sihloniphe izinsiza zazo, futhi sibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthenga. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuthuthukisa impilo yethu, kuqinisekise ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhona njengendawo ebalulekile empilweni yethu.
iShoprite Isingeniso I-Shoprite, okuyisikhungo esikhulu sokuthengisa ukudla nemikhiqizo ehlukene, sithathwa njengomphakathi omkhulu emkhakheni wezokuthengiselana eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1979, futhi kusukela lapho, ibe yinsika emnothweni wezohwebo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. I-Shoprite inikezela ngezinketho eziningi zomkhiqizo, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zansuku zonke, nezinsiza, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende ahlukeneyo. Uhlaka lwezikhungo ze-Shoprite I-Shoprite inezitolo eziningi ezikhona emadolobheni nasemaphandleni, okuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthenga ezithokozisayo kumakhasimende. Isitolo ngasinye sisezingeni eliphezulu, sinesikhala esanele sokuhamba, futhi sithokozisa amakhasimende ngokubukeka kwaso okuhle. Ukwaziwa kwe-Shoprite akugcinanga ezitolo zayo, kodwa futhi naku-inthanethi, lapho amakhasimende angathenga khona kalula futhi athumele imikhiqizo emakhaya abo. Izinsizakalo Nezinto Ezitholakalayo I-Shoprite inikeza uhla olubanzi lwezinto ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imikhiqizo yokudla efana nezinhlanzi, inyama, imifino, nezithelo, kanye nemikhiqizo yokuhlobisa, imikhiqizo yezempilo, nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Ukuphathwa kwemikhiqizo kuhlinzekwa ngokucophelela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende athola imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Shoprite inezinhlelo zokuthenga ezikhethekile, ezifana nezaphulelo ezikhethekile, ezisiza amakhasimende ukuthi akwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ngentengo engcono. Ubuchwepheshe obusha Ngokubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha, i-Shoprite isebenzisa izinhlelo zakamuva zokulawula imikhiqizo, ukubala izinzuzo, nokuphathwa kokuthengisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusetyenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphrinta, izinhlelo zokuphatha impahla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokukhokha ezisheshayo. Ukwazi ukunikeza izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende, futhi i-Shoprite ibonakala iqashelwa kakhulu kulokhu. Ukwazisa Ngezinto Ezinobuchwepheshe Ngaphezu kwemikhiqizo, i-Shoprite ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwazo ezempilo yomphakathi. Iphinde ibambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza impilo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezindlela zokupheka eziphilile, izinto ezitholakalayo ezikhiqizwayo ngendlela enempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lokudla. I-Shoprite ibuye ibhekelele izidingo zempilo zomphakathi ngezinqubo zokuthenga ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Umthelela Emphakathini I-Shoprite ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, kodwa ibuye idlale indima enkulu emiphakathini lapho ikhona. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga, i-Shoprite iyasiza ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ithuthukisa umnotho wendawo, futhi ibamba imicimbi yokuxhumana nemiphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi udinga izinsiza ezithile ukuze uqhubeke uphila kahle. Izingozi Nezinselelo Nokho, njengazo zonke izinkampani, i-Shoprite ibhekene nezinselelo. Ukuncintisana okujulile emakethe yokuthengisa, izinguquko emthethweni, kanye nemithetho yokuphatha imikhiqizo kungenza kube nzima ukuhlala phezulu. Ukuphendula kulezi zingozi, i-Shoprite ihlale ibhekelela izinqumo zayo, ikhulisa izinsizakalo zayo, futhi izama ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezihamba phambili. Isiphetho I-Shoprite iyinkampani ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokuthengisa eNingizimu Afrika, inikezela ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile kumakhasimende. Ngendlela eyenza ngayo izinqumo, ibambisene nomphakathi, futhi ithuthukisa imikhiqizo, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili nolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni. Njengoba iqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Shoprite ibhekelele izinguquko ezisemqoka nezidingo zamakhasimende ukuze iqhubeke nokuziphatha kahle. Ukubeka i-Shoprite kwicala elihle, kubalulekile ukuthi ihlale ibhekelelwa izidingo zomphakathi, ibhekelele umnotho, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bayo.
Osomabhizinisi: Ukuhlola Indima Nobuhlakani Babo Emnothweni Osomabhizinisi, abanjengokwaziwa ngokuthi "entrepreneurs," banendima ebalulekile emnothweni wanamuhla. Lezi zinkanyezi zomnotho zikhula zisuka ezicini eziningi, ziqhuba ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe, futhi zenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nosomabhizinisi, okuhlanganisa izimfanelo zabo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nomthelela abawuwenzayo emiphakathini yabo. Izimfanelo Zosomabhizinisi Osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakeme ngezici ezithile ezibenza bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ubuhlakani, ukuzimisela, kanye nokubona amathuba lapho abanye bengakuboni, yizici ezibalulekile ezithinta impumelelo yabo. Osomabhizinisi abanothando lokuxazulula izinkinga bahlala bephumelela, njengoba bejolise ekwakheni imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha izinsiza, ukuphatha izingozi, kanye nokwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo, kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwabo. Izinsiza Nezinselelo Naphezu kwezici ezinhle ezihambisana nosomabhizinisi, baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, kuyinselelo enkulu. Osomabhizinisi badinga imali, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza zokusebenza ukuze bakhe amabhizinisi abo. Ukuze baphumelele, kudingeka bahlale bephokophele ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhaswa ngemali, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zokuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe zenza kube nzima kubanye osomabhizinisi ukuhlala bephambili. Ukuze bahlale bephumelela, kudingeka bahlale befundisa futhi beqonda izitayela ezintsha, izidingo zabathengi, kanye nezinguquko emthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela okukhulu, njengoba osomabhizinisi kufanele bahlale bephokophele ukufunda nokukhula. Umthelela Osomabhizinisi Emiphakathini Umthelela osomabhizinisi emiphakathini yabo ungaphezu kokwakha imisebenzi. Osomabhizinisi baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuthazeni umnotho wendawo. Ngokwakha amabhizinisi, bahlomula umphakathi ngokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, okwandisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakamisa umoya wokuzimela, okukhuthaza abanye ukuba bazame ukufinyelela amaphupho abo. Osomabhizinisi baphinde babe nomthelela omuhle ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngokuxhasa imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi yabo iyakhula. Lokhu kungaba ngokuxhasa izinhlelo zemfundo, imikhankaso yokunakekela impilo, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imvelo. Umthelela wabo ungafinyelela ezingeni elikhulu, uqhamuka ezinhlelweni ezincane ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Isiphetho Osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakathi kokwakhiwa komnotho wanamuhla, behlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhula kanye nokuqhubeka. Noma baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi, izimfanelo zabo ezikhethekile nezindlela zokusebenza zenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela impumelelo. Umthelela wabo emiphakathini ungaphezu kokwakha imisebenzi; bahlala bephakamisa umoya wokwakha, beqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi umnotho wendawo uyakhula. Ukukhuthazwa kwabo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomdlandla wokwenza umehluko, kudinga ukuhlonishwa nokuxhaswa, ukuze kuqhubeke ukuthuthukiswa komnotho. Osomabhizinisi bangaba izikhumbuzo ezinhle zokuthi, uma abantu bephokophele ukufinyelela amaphupho abo, bangakha umhlaba ongcono kubo bonke.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwenkathi Ezikhathini ezedlule, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kwaba yinkinga evame ukubonwa emiphakathini ehlukene. E-Afrika, ikakhulukazi, lezi zinkinga zaziqhakanjiswa kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi, ezinkolelweni, nasezindlela zokuphila. Ngalesi sikhathi, imikhuba yokukhulelwa kwentsha yayihambisana nezinkolelo zamasiko, lapho intsha ifunda khona izifundo ezibalulekile zokuphila. Abantu abasha babebhekene nezinselele ezinzima, ezivame ukuhambisana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nokuntuleka kwemfundo, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Isahluko 2: Izizathu Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Izizathu zokukhulelwa kwentsha zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemfundo efanele, ukungazi kahle ngezindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezimo zomndeni. Ezinye izindawo, ukungabi namathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yokuziphatha, kanye nezinkolelo ezithile ezivumela ubudlelwano obungajwayelekile, kwaholela ekukhulelweni kwentsha. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yentsha, okwandisa izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukushoda kwemali, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Isahluko 3: Umthelela Emphakathini Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akuthinti umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kubangela umthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Abantwana abakhulelwe bahlala bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantwana abakhulelwe bengenakuphothula izifundo zabo. Umphakathi ubhekana nezinselele eziningi, ezifana nokwanda kwezinga lokuhlukumezeka, ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo. Isahluko 4: Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi yathola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene zokubhekana nale nkinga. Izinhlelo zokufundisa intsha ngempilo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantwana abakhulelwe zaba zinyathelo ezibalulekile. Izikhungo zemfundo zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zakhuliswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha ifinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa, okwakwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibone izindlela zokuphila ezihamba phambili. Isahluko 5: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinkolelo Izinkolelo zomphakathi zashintsha. Imiphakathi yathola ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwentsha akuyona into eyamukelekayo, futhi kwadingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono, izinhlelo zokuxhumana zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baphendukela ezindleleni ezihamba phambili zokuxhasa abantwana abakhulelwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Isahluko 6: Ukubheka Phambili Namuhla, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuseyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, imizamo yokubhekana nale nkinga iyaqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokufundisa, izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda, futhi intsha iyakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibone izindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi, enezizathu eziningi nezimo ezithinta umphakathi. Nokho, imizamo yokubhekana nale nkinga iyavuma, futhi umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda. Ngokuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokwakha izixazululo, singasiza intsha yethu ukuba ibone izindlela ezinhle zokuphila, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu sonke. Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akufanele kube yimpilo yokuhlupheka, kodwa kufanele kube yithuba lokukhula, ukufunda, nokuphila impilo engcono.
Umbiko Ngemisebenzi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimakethe Zomsebenzi Isingeniso Ezimweni zezimali eziguquguqukayo, imisebenzi ithinta impilo yabantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle izimo zokuqashwa, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta imakethe yemisebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya izinga lokungasebenzi, izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nezinguquko ezibangelwa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ngalesi sihloko, sizobheka indlela imakethe yemisebenzi eshintsha ngayo, izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisebenze. Isimo Semisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika ENingizimu Afrika, isimo semisebenzi sikhathaza. Izibalo zakamuva zikhombisa ukuthi izinga lokungasebenzi liphakeme kakhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabasha. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi ekukhuleni komnotho. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abasha abaningi bahlala bengaqashwa, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, okubalwa kuzo ukungafani kwezimfuno zemisebenzi nezifundo ezikhonjwa kubafundi. Izifundo Nezidingo Zabasebenzi Njengoba imakethe yemisebenzi ishintsha, izidingo zabasebenzi nazo ziguquka. Izikhungo zemfundo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bazifundisa amakhono afanele ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zifunde izidingo zemboni ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango efanele. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemfundo nezidingo zemboni kuzokwakha isixazululo esinzima kulokhu. Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Ubuchwepheshe buye babalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla, nokuthi imisebenzi ethile iyashintsha noma iyadlalwa yizinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudala ukuncintisana okukhulu. Abantu badinga ukufunda amakhono amasha ukuze bahlale bephumelela. Ngokuvamile, izinkampani zifuna abasebenzi abaneziqu eziphezulu, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abangenayo imfundo ephakeme. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko Emsebenzini Kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabantu abafuna imisebenzi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezithile kuholela ekubeni abantu baphinde baphahlazeke. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zithathe indawo yemisebenzi ethile, okwenza abantu babe nokungafuni kokuqashwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe nekhono lokushintsha, ukuze bakwazi ukufanisa izidingo ezintsha. Izixazululo Nezaziso Ukuze sithuthukise imisebenzi, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Ukuze imfundo ihambisane nezidingo zomsebenzi, izikhungo zemfundo kumele zibambisane nezinkampani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ulwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngababekhona emsebenzini abanezinga eliphakeme. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops nabantu abasha, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola amakhono afanele. Isiphetho Imakethe yemisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa kunezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukwenza ngcono isimo. Ngokuhlanganisa imfundo nezidingo zomsebenzi, kanye nokudala amathuba amasha, sizokwazi ukwakha imakethe yemisebenzi ezinzile. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi, sithuthukise umnotho, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokwenza izinguquko luzodingeka, futhi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izinhlelo zidinga isikhathi, impumelelo izofika uma sisebenza ndawonye. Ukwazisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, okwaziyo ukubhekana nezinselelo zamanje.
Ukwakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP: Ukuhamba Phambili Kokuhlala Okuhle Ngaphakathi kwezemidlalo zenhlalakahle, ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (RDP Homes) kube yinkinga ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba uhulumeni uqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha nezinsiza, abantu abaningi baphuma ezinkingeni zokuhlala eziphansi. Lezi zindlu, ezihloselwe ukusiza abantu abangenamali, zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga lokuhlala elingcono. Uhlelo lwe-RDP, olwamiswa ngonyaka ka-1994, luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ngokuphephile naphakathi kwezimali kubantu abahlwempu. Uhlelo lwalusungulwa njengengxenye yomgomo we-ANC wokwakha umphakathi obumbene, lapho abantu bethola ithuba lokuba nekhaya elinempilo. Kulokhu, uhulumeni ubeke izinhlelo eziningi zokwakha, kodwa izithiyo eziningi zisabhekane nalezi zinhlelo. Umphakathi waseThekwini ubonisile izinzuzo zokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP. Ezindlini eziningi, abantu baveza ukwaneliseka, futhi imiphakathi iyakhula ngokuhlanganyela. UJohn Nkosi, ohlala endaweni ye-Durban North, uthi: "Ngithi ngiyabonga uhulumeni, ngoba umuzi wami wanikeza isithombe esisha sokuphila kahle. Ngiyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo engcono ezinganeni zami." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izindlu ze-RDP akuzona kuphela izikhala zokuhlala, kodwa zikhombisa umqondo wokwakha umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, zikhona izinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP. Omunye walezi zinselelo ikakhulukazi, yindleko yezinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zikhona, uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kusho ukwakha imithombo yokunakekelwa, ezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinsiza zempilo ezisondelene. Ubuye bahlaziywe izinhlelo zokwakha, lapho abanye bezwa ukuthi izindlela zokuphatha izinhlelo azanele. Umphakathi udinga ukubambisana ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ngokubambisana, abantu bangabhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zokuqashwa nezokwakha. UMnu. Xolani Mthembu, okhulumela umphakathi, uthi: "Uma sisebenzisana namalungu omphakathi, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezilungiselelweni eziningi zabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izindlu zakhiwa ngobuqotho." Lokhu kuko kubalulekile emizameni yokwakha izindawo. Uhlelo lwe-RDP lwasungulwa ngenhlosongqangi yokwehlisa izinga lezokuhlala. Njengoba uhulumeni eqhubeka nezinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlangano yempilo iqhubekela phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudala amathuba okwakha ezindlini ezintsha nezokuhlala ezinhle. Ukubuyiselwa kwemali nokwakhiwa kabusha kusuka kumaphrojekthi aqukethe amakliele ezinkampani ezivela ezweni lonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele zikwamukele imibono yobuchwepheshe obusha, okungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindlu eziphakeme nezongqondongqondo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe obukhokhelwayo kungakhulula izinsiza zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izindlela ezintsha zokwakha ngabomvu zingabhekana nezinselelo zansuku zonke. Ukukhula komnotho kuholela ekutheni abantu babe nentshisekelo yokuba nezindlu ezithuthukisiwe, ezijabulisayo. Lokhu kwenza umphakathi uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Abahlali bahlala njalo beqhudelana nempilo enempilo, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo nesiko labo. Ngendlela efanele yokwakha, okuhloswe ngayo kuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, kuzosiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP kumele kuqhubeke nokugxila emiphakathini ukuze kuzuze bonke. UHulumeni, kanye nomphakathi, kumele baqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yalezi zinhlelo. Ngokuqhubeka kwalokhu, sihlose ukufaka izandla ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono, lapho wonke umuntu angaba nendawo yokuhlala engcono. Njengoba uhulumeni eqhubeka nemizamo yakhe, kukhona ithemba lokuthi izindlu ze-RDP zizokwenza umthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, sihamba phambili, siphokophele izindinganiso eziphezulu zokuhlala, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezithuthukile ezizokwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuvumela abantu bahlala ezindlini ezingafaneleki. Lezi zinhlelo, lapho zisebenziswe kahle, zizoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomnotho kanye nezenhlalakahle, futhi kugcine kukhanya umthombo wokuphila okungcono kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Ezabesifazane: Uhlanga Lwempilo KaNandi Mthembu U-Nandi Mthembu, umama oneminyaka engama-45, ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphila kwabantu besifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlanga lwakhe luthokozisa, luhlaza, futhi luhlobene nezifiso ezinkulu zokuthuthukisa impilo yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. U-Nandi, owazalwa eThekwini, ubonisa izimpawu zokuhola kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe, lapho aqala khona ukwakha imiphakathi emincane yokuxhasa abesifazane. U-Nandi uqale ukufunda eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts. Ngalesi sikhathi, wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini yokuzithandela, ethokozisa abesifazane abasha ngezimfundiso zokuzimela. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izifundo zabesifazane, eqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane abasha bayakwazi ukufinyelela emathubeni afanele. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, u-Nandi waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho aqala khona ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abesifazane. Waqala uhlelo olwakha izikhungo zokuxhasa abesifazane abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, lapho abesifazane bengathola khona izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe izimpilo ezinhle. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, lwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi lwavula amathuba amaningi kubesifazane abaningi. U-Nandi ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi ubonisa uthando olukhulu emsebenzini wakhe. Uhlanga lwakhe luhlanganisa izifundo eziningi, ezithinta izinkinga ezibhekene nabesifazane, njengokuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila. ISIHLOKO: I-TikTok I-TikTok ikhulile ngokushesha eminyakeni edlule, yaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. Le app, ethokoziswa kakhulu ngabasha, ishintshe indlela abantu ababelana ngayo ngemicabango, imizwa, nezithombe. I-TikTok ibonisa umhlaba wonke ngokuhlanganisa ukudlalwa, ukuveza ama-video amafushane, kanye nokwakha izinkanyezi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukwakhiwa kwe-TikTok I-TikTok yasungulwa ngo-2016 e-China ngaphansi kwegama le-Douyin, yabe isithola udumo emhlabeni wonke ngo-2018. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko eziningi ezithuthukisa ulwazi lomsebenzisi, okusiza ekusakazeni imizwa nokuzijabulisa. Ukuhlanganyela kwabantu ku-TikTok kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene zokuzijabulisa, ezobuciko, nezamakhono. Ukusebenza Kwe-TikTok I-TikTok iyabavumela abantu ukuba benze ama-video kalula, ikakhulukazi ezimfushane ezithokozisayo. Izici zayo ezihlukahlukene, njengezinhlelo zokuhlela, imaski, nemisindo ehlukahlukene, zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi wonke umuntu akhe okuqukethwe okwakhe. Amathuba okwakha imiyalezo ahluke kakhulu, kusukela kumavidiyo amahlekisayo, amahora okudansa, kuya ezinhlelweni ezijulile zemicabango. Lokhu kuveza ukuhlukahluka komphakathi futhi kuholele ekwakhiweni kwenkulumo nezinkanyezi ezintsha. Uhlanga Lokukhuthaza Enye yezinto ezithokozisayo nge-TikTok ukuhamba kwayo ngokushesha. Abantu abaningi baqala ukufinyelela kuzithombe ezaziwayo, imisebenzi, nezixhumanisi ezitholakala kulolu hlelo. Ukuphumelela kwe-TikTok kuholele ezinkanyezini eziningi ezahlukahlukene, ezingama-‘influencers’ abakhuluma ngendlela yokwakha ubunikazi, baphuma emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Lokhu kuholela ekugcineni kokuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo, kulethe izinzuzo kubathengisi abancane nabakhulu. Ubuciko Bokuxhumana I-TikTok ivula izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukuhlanganyela abantu ezindabeni ezithile, njengokuhlola izinjongo zomphakathi, kudala umxholo ohlanganyela, ogxile ekuboneni umnotho wobuciko nezehlakalo zomhlaba. Lokhu kwenza ukuphepha komphakathi kube kuhle, futhi umphakathi uphila ngokubambisana, ubonisa ubuciko nolwazi lwesimanje. Ubungozi BokuToxicity Nokho, i-TikTok ayinakho konke okuhle. Kunezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu, okubandakanya ubuvila bokuphila, ukusakazwa kwemikhiqizo emibi, nocansi olubi. Izinselelo zokuphepha zabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho omncane, zikhula. Ukukhathazeka ngokuphepha kuhambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubantu. Ukunakisisa Komphakathi Kweminye imiphakathi, abantu basebenzisa i-TikTok ukukhuthaza izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, ukulwela amalungelo, nezinkinga ezibucayi. Kwamanye amacala, kukhona ukungaboni ngasolinye okubangela umoya wokungabambisani. Ukuphendula okubalulekile kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela ubumbano phakathi kwabo, benza izinkinga zomphakathi zibe yizithako ezivuthayo. Isiphetho I-TikTok iyathakazelisa ekwenzeni izinto zesimanje, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezihlukahlukene nezizwe. Ngabe ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe baluzenzo bungaba yinzuzo ekwakheni uthando nolwazi phakathi kwabantu? Lokhu kuncike kumuntu ngamunye. Kunezinto eziningi okufanele zihlolwe kulokhu, kanti impumelelo ye-TikTok ibonisa ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla. I-TikTok iyisixhumanisi esikhafulayo, esivulela iminyango emisha, futhi akungabazeki, kuzoholela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngokuhlanganisa ubuciko, izinkanyezi ezintsha, nezinto eziningi ezikhanga, i-TikTok ibonisa indlela ephilayo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa kubalulekile ukufundisa, ukuvikela, nokuhlonipha ubukhosi bomphakathi. Njengoba isikhathi siqhubekela phambili, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sisebenzisa le ndawo yokubambisana ngendlela efanele, ukuze sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomunye nomunye.
