iSamsung Galaxy Umbuzo 1: Iyini iSamsung Galaxy? IMikhiqizo yeSamsung Galaxy iwuhlobo lwezinto eziphilayo, izinsiza kusebenza zedijithali kanye nezikhala ezifana nama-smartphones, ama-tablets, nemishini yokuxhumana. I-Samsung, engomunye wabakhiqizi abaphezulu emhlabeni, yethule le mhlangano ngomqondo wokwenza izinsiza ezithakazelisayo, ezisemqoka, nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abaningi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi ezithakazelisayo ze-Samsung Galaxy? I-Samsung Galaxy yaziwa ngama-design ayo ahluke kakhulu, izici ezinzima, nomphumela wokusebenza ophakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartphones e-Galaxy avame ukuhlinzeka ngezithombe ezinhle kakhulu, izinketho zokukhipha, nezinye izici ezifana ne-5G connectivity, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba naku-inthanethi fast. Umbuzo 3: Kufanele ngikhethe i-Samsung Galaxy noma enye? Ukukhetha i-Samsung Galaxy kuzoba kuhle uma uthanda ukujabulela umkhiqizo osezingeni eliphezulu onemisebenzi eminingi. I-Samsung Galaxy inezici ezithakazelisayo ezifana nokuvikeleka kwedatha, ukhiye wefoni, kanye nezinye izinsiza zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Uma uhlola izidingo zakho, qhathanisa izici nezindleko, bese uthola okuthandayo. Umbuzo 4: Uma ngithenga i-Samsung Galaxy, yini engiyilindele? Uma uthenga i-Samsung Galaxy, uzothola umkhiqizo onohlelo oluhle, okukhuluma izilimi eziningi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene, nezithombe eziphezulu. Futhi, uzoba ne-interface yokusebenzisa eyakhayo, ethakazelisa, nehlangabezana nezidingo zabo bonke abasebenzisi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kuzoba ukulula nokusebenza kahle. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iSamsung Galaxy iyatholakala kuzo zonke izimakethe? Yebo, i-Samsung Galaxy iyatholakala ezimakethe eziphezulu eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezitolo ezikhethekile, nakumakethe eziku-inthanethi. I-Samsung isebenzisa inethiwekhi enkulu yethengisa ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu abaningi bangayithola le mikhiqizo. Umbuzo 6: I-Samsung Galaxy iyavuselelwa? Yebo, ama-smartphones e-Samsung Galaxy avame ukuhlinzekwa ngezibuyekezo ezithuthukisayo ezijwayelekile. Lokhu kubalwa nezibuyekezo zesoftware, ukulungiswa kweziphumuzi, nezici ezintsha. Ukuze uthole i-Galaxy yakho isesikhathini, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezibuyekezo ezifanele. Umbuzo 7: Ngingayithola kanjani usizo uma nginproblema neSamsung Galaxy? Uma uthola ubunzima nge-Samsung Galaxy yakho, ungaxhumana ne-Samsung Customer Service. Bakhona abanikazi bezinsiza abakhethekile ukuze bakusize ngezinkinga ezihlukahlukene. Futhi, ungavakashela kwiwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane nokwesekwa. Umbuzo 8: I-Samsung Galaxy ingasetshenziswa kangakanani? I-Samsung Galaxy inikeza imisebenzi ebanzi, kufaka phakathi ukufunda, ukubhala, ukudlala imidlalo, kanye nokuxhumana nabanye. Ngendlela yokwakheka, ungayisebenzisa ukuhlela izinkumbulo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba njalo nobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe i-Samsung Galaxy ifanelekile kubo bonke abasebenzisi? I-Samsung Galaxy ifaneleka kakhulu kubantu abaningi ngenxa yokuthokoza kwayo, ukusebenza kahle, nezinzuzo eziningi. Nokho, kuye ngokuthi izidingo zomuntu ngamunye, abanye bangakhetha ezinye izinketho. Kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zakho ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi kuthokozisa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyidingayo ukuze ngisebenzise iSamsung Galaxy? Ukuze uqale ukusebenzisa i-Samsung Galaxy, uzodinga i-smartphone noma i-tablet, umkhiqizo we-Sim, kanye nekhono lokuxhumana naku-inthanethi. Futhi, udinga umjikelezo wokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuze uthole okuningi kumphakathi wakho. Isiphetho: I-Samsung Galaxy iyinqubo yokudala izinsiza ezimnandi, ezinokuthokozisa, ezisebenziseka kalula, nezisebenza kahle. Ukuze uqonde kahle imikhiqizo ye-Samsung, yiba nogqozi lokuhlola izici ezintsha, ubungcweti, nezindleko. Noma ungathengwa i-Galaxy eyisipesheli, ukukhetha okuhle kuzokwandisa ukuzizwisiswa kwakho kwezobuchwepheshe. Uhlelo lweSamsung Galaxy luhlala luzwakala emhlabeni wonke, luhlinzeka ngolwazi olunamandla lwesimanje. Uyaqhubeka ukhuluma ngendlela obamba ngayo imisebenzi yakho nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Empofu Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngendaba ethinta abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emindenini empofu. Kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nalezi zindawo, futhi kudinga ukuthi sihlole lezi zinkinga ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile. Kukhona umbono ophawulekayo phakathi kwabantu, ukuthi ukudla kufanele kube yinto elula, kodwa empeleni, akunjalo. Emindenini empofu, izinkinga zokudla zenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempilo. Uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuthola ukudla okunempilo, lokho kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Abantu abaningi bazi ukuthi ukudla okunempilo kubaluleke kakhulu, kodwa uma izinsiza zikhona kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abanokudla, abakwazi ukuphila kahle. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngaphezu kwemali. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyenele yokuthenga ukudla, lokhu kudala izinkinga ezintsha. Abantu abaningi baphila ezindaweni ezinzima, lapho kungase kube nzima ukuthola umsebenzi, futhi uma umndeni ungatholi imali eyenele, lokho kusho ukuthi bazokwazi ukwanelisa izidingo zabo zokudla. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwemali nezinselelo zokudla bukhona, futhi kufanele sithole izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze umndeni ungabi nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngendlela yokudla. Abantu abavame ukwazi ukuzenzela ukudla okunempilo ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemithombo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqaphele izinkinga ezithinta izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini ethile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana futhi ubambisane ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezithile, okungaba kuhle uma kukhona izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza emindenini empofu. Kukhona futhi impatho yokudla. Inhlalakahle iyasiza, kodwa uma izinsiza zingekho, abantu baphuma ezindaweni ezinzima. Udaba lwezindawo zokudla, ezinjengezikhungo zokudla, luhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umndeni ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokudla, noma uma lezi zindawo zikhona, kudinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza eziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini. Ngokubambisana, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zokudla zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezingekho, kanye nezindlela zokuphila, konke lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu. Kudingeka ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile ezisiza ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Ngasolwazi, sikhuluma nangokubaluleka kokufundisa. Abantu kufanele bafundiswe ngokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi yini okufanele bayidlayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma abantu bazi kahle, bazokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Ngempela, uma umphakathi jukujabulela ukufunda, lokho kuzokwenza kube nokuthula. Kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithinta ukudla, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, sikhuluma ngempilo, kodwa ekugcineni, sikhuluma ngothando. Umndeni ophilayo uthanda ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla, futhi lokhu kubalulekile. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umndeni unenkinga, kufanele kube nesithakazelo sokuthola izixazululo. Izinkinga zokudla azikhuluma kuphela ngempilo, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngothando olukhona emindenini. Ukugcina umndeni uphilile, kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umndeni ube neqhaza ekwakheni isikhala esihle. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nokuthula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ngokwazisa, lokhu kuhlangene, izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu kudinga ukunakwa. Kudingeka ukuba sihlale sizama ukuthola izixazululo ezithile, ukuze umphakathi uphile impilo engcono. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezithile, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi lokho kuzokwenza kube nezinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kuyadingeka, futhi kumele kuqale manje!
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika: Uhlolo Olubanzi Kusukela emuva kweminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika usungule isisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umphakathi ovulekile, onobulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ukwakhiwa kwalokhu mthethosisekelo, owamukelwa ngempumelelo ngonyaka ka-1996, kuhambisana nezinguquko ezinkulu ezwenikazi, ezizwakala kumlando wezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo. Isizinda: Uhambo Olukhulu Lokushintsha Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuvuselelwa koMthethosisekelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola isizinda somlando. Ngaphambi kokuholwa kweMpi Yenkululeko, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babephila phansi kwemigomo yobufokeng, oxhaxha hlobo lobudlovandlela. Izinkombandlela zikhona ezingeni eliphakeme loshintsho, futhi kwangena isimo esisha lapho ubumbano lwezinkampani zamalungelo abantu, njenge-MK (uMkhonto weSizwe), lwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana. Lokhu kwafaka isandla ekwakheni isigaba esisha sokucabanga, sokuhlonipha izinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo: Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kwahambisana nezifundiso eziphambili, ezazidala isikhala esisha somqondo. Izinyathelo ezibalulekile ziqala ngonyaka ka-1994, lapho kwenziwa khona ukhetho lwokuqala nolwakho lweminyaka, olwakuvumela bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ngabe banemibala ehlukene, ukuba bavote. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komkhandlu omkhulu, owawuhlanganisa izizathu eziningi, okubalwa kuzo amaqembu ahlukene ezehlukeneyo, okwakubuhlungu ukuba abavoti bephumelele. Umkhandlu wawuhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokudidiyela imiqondo ehlukahlukene ukuze sakhe umthethosisekelo ophumelelayo. Umthethosisekelo uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unamalungelo alinganayo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlonishwa kweziphetho zamasiko nezinkolo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni indawo ephumelelayo yokuphila, efaka izidingo zomphakathi, amazinga obuhlakani, nezinto ezimbi ezazikhona emiphakathini. Ubuqotho bamabhuku bobuchwepheshe, imishado, kanye namalungelo okuzalwa akwenza umthethosisekelo ube yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha ubumbano nokuqhubeka. Ubuhle nezinselelo emthethweni Nakuba umthethosisekelo unikeza umbono omuhle mayelana nelungelo labantu, akuphuthelwa ukuthi kunezinselelo ezinqala ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ukuhlupheka, ukungabi namsebenzi, nemingcele yezomnotho kusekhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi abantu benze izinqumo ezintle ngesimo sabo. Ubufakazi obukhona bukhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezibangelwa ukuhleleka okungelungile kwezomnotho zenza kube nzima ukuhambisana nemigomo emisha yokuhlalisana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kubekhona amasu ahlukene okuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bayavuma lesi simo. Ukufuduka kokuziphatha komthetho Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi umthethosisekelo uhlale ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokulungisa inhlalakahle. Ukuvuselela umthetho wokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kungumsebenzi othembisa ikusasa elikhanya. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo zokusebenza zedlula ezakhamuzini, izigaba zempilo, nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi qinisekisa ukuthi umthethosisekelo awusiyihlanga kuphela, kodwa ungaphumi lapha. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akugcini nje ekubhalweni kokuqina kwezinyathelo, kodwa kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulondoloza incwadi yomthetho. Ukuze sizuze eduzane, abantu kumele baqhubeke bexhumana, benza izinhlelo ezifaneleko, futhi bahloniphe izimiso zomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kuzodala isizinda esiqinile sokwakha ezinhlelweni, nezimiso zokwakha umphakathi. Isiphetho: Umthethosisekelo Njengesikhumbuzo Sempumelelo Ngesikhathi sihlola ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo, sithola ukuthi umthethosisekelo uvula iminyango emisha yokuhlala esidlangalaleni, ukwakha ubumbano nokuqhubeka. Iminyaka edlule ibonisa ukuthi yize kunezinkinga ezikhona, uMthethosisekelo uhlale unguMhlahlandlela ezizweni eziningi, uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu awafudukeli phansi. Ngaleyo ndlela, umthethosisekelo ungohlobo olunsthyama ekwaziseni umphakathi wonke, uqinisekisa ukuba umphakathi ulondoloza isiko, ukhula ngokuhlanganyela, uvuma izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Emva kokubuyekezwa, sithola ukuthi uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumqoka kagesi odidayo okhombisa umehluko emlandweni, onqamulelayo phakathi kokuhluka komphakathi. Iphupha lesizwe liqhubeka liphila, lizama ukufezekisa umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumba bokuqonda okwenze kube sobala. Lokhu kuzophinda kube yisifundo emiphakathini eminingi, okungathiwa umuntu oyedwa, lapho siphelela khona, izwe lethu lisebenza kanjani empilweni.
uBafana Bafana: Uhlanga Lwezokudlala Kwezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika UBafana Bafana, okuyiqembu lesizwe lempilo yezeMidlalo eNingizimu Afrika, ubonisa ubuhle bokudlala ibhola lezinyawo. Igama elithi "Bafana Bafana" lisho "Bafana" okungukuthi "Bafana" ngesiZulu, elihlonipha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafana nabafana, okukhombisa umoya wokubumbana nokuhlanganyela. Le nqola ibalulekile emlandweni wezokudlala eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule, lapho ibhola lezinyawo lathola khona ukuthandwa okukhulu. Ukwakhiwa kweqembu UBafana Bafana waqala ukusebenza ngonyaka ka-1992, ngemuva kokuphela kokubandlululwa kwezenhlalo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubadlali abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezinhlanga ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, uBafana Bafana wathola abaqeqeshi abavela emazweni ahlukene, okuhlanganisa noCarlos Alberto Parreira, owaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ithimba eliqinile. Imidlalo emikhulu UBafana Bafana ube neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni emikhulu, kuhlanganise neNdebe yoMhlaba, lapho baqala khona ukuhamba phambili ngonyaka ka-1998. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula umnyango wokubambisana phakathi kwezwekazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBafana Bafana uphumelele neNdebe ye-Afrika, eyayibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka ka-1996, lapho baphumelela khona umqhudelwano, kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Izinkanyezi zikaBafana Bafana Abadlali abanjengoBenni McCarthy, Siphiwe Tshabalala, noItumeleng Khune baye baba izinkanyezi ezidumile, behola uBafana Bafana emidlalweni ehlukene. UBenni McCarthy, ngokukhethekile, waba ngumdlali wokuqala waseNingizimu Afrika ophumelele ukuhamba phambili eNgilandi, lapho adlala khona kwiPremier League. Umdlalo wakhe omuhle, kanye nekhono lakhe lokuphosa amagoli, kwenze waba yisibonelo esihle kubadlali abasha. Umthelela kwezenhlalo UBafana Bafana akugcini nje ngokuba yithimba lezemidlalo, kodwa futhi ubonisa umoya wokubumbana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Iqembu libonisa ukuthi ibhola lezinyawo lingaba yindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlanga ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni lapho ubuhlanga buphikisana khona. Izinkinga nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, uBafana Bafana ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungaphumeleli emqhudelwaneni, ukushintsha kwabaphathi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali ziye zaba yizinto ezithinta ukusebenza kweqembu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthuthukisa umphakathi wezokudlala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uBafana Bafana uqhubeka nokukhula. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa Ukuze uBafana Bafana uqhubeke nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abadlali abasha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izikole zebhola, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, kanye nokwakha amathuba okudlala emakhaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantwana baphumelele emidlalweni, futhi bakhule babe abadlali abaqavile. Isiphetho UBafana Bafana ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuhlanganyela, ubumbano, nokuphumelela. Njengoba iqembu liqhubeka nokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlale bexhasa, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa umoya wokubumbana. Ngale ndlela, uBafana Bafana uzoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ibhola lezinyawo lingaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, futhi ubonise ukuthi, ngaphezu kokudlala, ibhola lingaba yindlela yokuphila.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Izimpendulo Nezinkulumo Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo iwumkhakha wezokudlala ophakathi kwamakhompyutha, ama-console, noma ama-smartphone. Le midlalo ikuvumela ukuba uphume emhlabeni wokuqhathanisa, uyiluleke, futhi ujabulele izimo ezahlukene. Izinhlobo eziningi zifaka phakathi imidlalo yezenzo, imidlalo yokwakha, imidlalo yokuhlola, nezokucabanga. Umbuzo 2: Zini izinzuzo zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo inezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ingathuthukisa amakhono okucabanga nokusebenza, njengoba kudinga umqondo ophusile ukuze uphumelele. Okwesibili, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana nabanye, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni we-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganyela nabangane noma nabantu abanentshisekelo efanayo. Futhi, kudinga ukuthi umdlali abe nesineke, okungasiza empilweni yansuku zonke. Umbuzo 3: Ziyini izingozi zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Ngaphandle kwezinzuzo, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba nezingcuphe. Umdlalo ongenamkhawulo ungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale isikhathi eside behluleka ukuphumula, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana nokukhathala noma ubuhlungu bezinhlangothi. Kubalulekile ukufaka isikhathi sokuphumula phakathi kokudlala ukuze ugweme lezi zingozi. Umbuzo 4: Imidlalo yevidiyo ithuthukiswe kanjani? Imidlalo yevidiyo ithuthukiswa ngabadlali abahlakaniphileyo ababelana ngemibono nezobuchwepheshe. Abathuthukisi bemidlalo benza ucwaningo olunzulu, behlola izidingo zabadlali, futhi basebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze benze imidlalo ethokozisayo. Imidlalo ibhalwa ngamagama, izithombe, nemisindo, konke kudinga ukuhlela okuhle ukuze kuthuthukiswe umuzwa wokudlala. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezidume kakhulu zemidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo ihlukaniswe ngezindlela eziningi, kodwa ezinye zezinhlobo ezidume kakhulu zifaka imidlalo yezenzo, imidlalo yokuhlola, imidlalo ye-strategy, ne-role-playing games (RPGs). Imidlalo yezenzo igxile kumkhankaso, imidlalo ye-strategy idinga ukucabanga ngokucophelela, kanti i-RPG ivumela abadlali ukuba baphile izindaba ezijulile. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe imidlalo yevidiyo iyavuma kubantu bonke? Yebo, imidlalo yevidiyo iyavuma kubantu bonke, kodwa kubalulekile ukukhetha imidlalo efanele. Imidlalo ibonakale ihluka ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene, njengezinga lobudala nezimpikiswano. Abazali kufanele bazi kahle imidlalo ezithokozisayo nezingafanele ezinganeni zabo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi badlala imidlalo efanelekile. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekufundeni? Ngempela, imidlalo yevidiyo ingasiza ekufundeni. Imidlalo ethile ikhulisa amakhono afana nokubala, ukufunda, nokucabanga. Kukhona nemidlalo eqondile yokufunda efundisa izifundo ezinjengezibalo, isayensi, nezinye izifundo, okuveza ukuthi imidlalo ingaba ithuluzi elihle lokufunda uma isetshenziselwa kahle. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele lapho ngithenga umdlalo? Lapho uthenge umdlalo, kubalulekile ukuthi ucabangele izinto eziningi. Qiniseka ukuthi umdlalo uyahambisana nezidingo zakho kanye nezinga lobudala elihambisana nawo. Futhi, hlola izibuyekezo zabanye abadlali ukuze uqonde kahle umuzwa womdlalo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo ingadlalwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ungadlala wedwa noma nabanye abantu, kungaba ngokuqondile noma nge-inthanethi. Imidlalo ye-multiplayer ivumela abadlali abaningi ukuba badlale ndawonye, okwenza kube lula ukujabulela umuzwa wokuxhumana. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo emhlabeni wezemidlalo yevidiyo? Emhlabeni wezemidlalo yevidiyo, ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha njalo. Izithombe eziphakeme, imidlalo ehambisanayo, kanye nemidlalo yezokuxhumana kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kahle. Futhi, i-virtual reality (VR) iyakhula, ivumela abadlali ukuba bahlale ngaphakathi kwemidlalo ngendlela engakaze ibonwe, okuthuthukisa umuzwa wokudlala. Isiphetho Imidlalo yevidiyo iyinto ehlangeneyo efaka ubugagu bezokudlala, ubuchwepheshe, nemizwa. Ngokudlala, umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila iziphetho ezihlukahlukene, uxhumane nabanye, futhi athuthuke kumakhono amaningi. Ukuqonda kahle imidlalo yevidiyo kubalulekile ukuze sithole ubuchwepheshe bezemidlalo obungasiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu. Kuhle ukuhlola, ukudlala, nokubona ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingakwenza kanjani kube mnandi.
Emakhaya asemaphandleni, phakathi kwemvelo ethokozisayo, kwakukhona umndeni kaMnumzane Jabulani. UBaba uJabulani wayengumuntu onobubele, ehola umndeni wakhe ngezindlela ezicacile. Umama, uNandi, wayethanda izingane zabo, uSipho noThandi, futhi wayezama ukubafundisa ngezindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Nokho, empilweni yabo, kwakukhona inkinga — ubukhona bokukhanyisa. Kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka, umuzi wabo wawungakabi nagesi. Kwakulula ukuhlela izinto uma ubheka izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu, ubona umhlaba uhleli emnyama. Nokho, umndeni kaJabulani wawujabulela ukuphila kwabo okukhanyayo. Izindlela zabo zokuphila zakhombisa izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngelinye ilanga, uJabulani wahlangana nomngani wakhe, uThulani, owamkhumbuza isidingo sokusebenza ngempumelelo. UThulani, owazi kahle izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ugesi, waveza ukuthi, "UJabulani, kungani ungathathi isinyathelo sokwenza umuzi wakho ube nagesi? Kubalulekile ukuvuselela impilo yethu." UJabulani wacabanga kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi. Noma wayejabule ngomphakathi wabo, wayefuna ukushintsha izinto ezazithinta impilo yomndeni wakhe. Ngemva kokukhuthazela, uJabulani wenza uhambo lokuvakasha lapho umphakathi wabo uhlinzeka ngogesi. Bahlangana odokotela bempilo, abafundi, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe, becebisa umphakathi. UJabulani wabamba ithuba lokuhlanganyela. "Umphakathi wethu udinga ukushintsha," kusho uJabulani. "Akukhona kuphela ukukhiqiza ugesi, kodwa kumele sakhe impilo engcono." Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokwakha izibani nemigqa yegesi. Kwakukhona izinsiza ezandayo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Njengoba izinsuku zedlule, lezi zinsiza zaba yisikhumbuzo sokuphila okunempilo. Njengoba uJabulani eqhubeka, ugesi wavula amathuba amasha. Wakhuluma noNandi, obekhuluma ngemiphumela yezinguquko. Nokho, uNandi waveza imibono emihle. "Ngizoba nawe," kusho uNandi. "Umndeni wethu uzokhanyisa izinkanyezi emhlabeni wethu." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umndeni kaJabulani wathola ushintsho olukhulu. Kwakukhona ukukhanya, nemishanguzo eyodwa, lapho baphila khona kahle. Izinto ezilula zaba yizimanga, futhi umndeni wabo waba nezinhliziyo ezijabulayo. Usuku olukhulu lwafika, umndeni wahlanganyela izibani, uSipho noThandi baphuma phambili. Kwakukhona ukuvuka kwezinkanyezi, ezihambisana nemibukiso emihle. UJabulani wabona ukuthi ukukhanya kwakukhanyisa indlu, kwenza umndeni wabo wakhanya. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezine, umuzi wabo wathola ugesi, kanti ubaba noMama benza imisebenzi emihle, umkhanya waba yinjabulo, ubuchwepheshe baphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJabulani noNandi bahlala bephambili, babona izinto ezithuthukayo. Ugesi wawuphatha kahle, uvusa umuzwa wokunakekela, wakhuthaza umphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umndeni kaJabulani waba yisibonelo, wakha ikusasa elikhanyayo, wabonisa umphakathi ukuthi ugesi ungaba yisisombululo ezindaweni ezinzima. UJabulani nomndeni wakhe baba neqhaza elikhulu, bakhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhe impilo engcono. Umoya wokuphila kwabo waba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima, nokuthi ugesi usiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwabe kungakabikho izingane zithi: “Sizokwakha iminyango yokuhamba phambili.”
Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika latholakala emlandweni omude, elihambisana nezinguquko eziningi ezweni. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinhlelo zentela ezisemthethweni, abantu babebhekana nezindleko ezihlukahlukene, futhi izimali zentela zaziphuma ezindleleni ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, futhi izinga lentela lalingakabi yinto ebucayi njengamanje. Ngemva kokuphuma kwezwe eMhlabeni, iNingizimu Afrika yathola uhlelo lwezintela olwakhiwe ukuze kube nezimali ezanele zokuphatha izwe. Ngonyaka ka-1910, lapho iNingizimu Afrika ithola uzibuse, kwavulwa amathuba amaningi okwakha izinhlelo zentela. Izinga lentela laqala ngokuba phezulu, futhi kwaba nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela lathuthuka futhi lathola izinguquko eziningi. Ngonyaka ka-1948, umthetho we-Apartheid wathinta kakhulu izinga lentela. Izinhlelo zentela zaguqulwa ukuze zihlukanise phakathi kwabantu abamnyama nabamhlophe, okwakuholela ekubeni abantu abamnyama bahlupheke kakhulu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kwakhula ukungalingani phakathi kwezigaba zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba lokwakha uhlelo lwezintela olusha, olwakhelwe phezu kokulingana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinga lentela laqala ukwenyuka, kodwa kwaba nezinhlelo eziningi zokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Umthetho wezezimali wathuthukiswa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinga lentela lihlala lilingana, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ukuze athuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu. Eminyakeni edlule, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, kuxhomeke ezimweni zomnotho. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uhulumeni waphakamisa izinga lentela eliphezulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga eziningi, njengoba abanye abantu bephikisana nezinguquko ezazenziwa. Kodwa-ke, izinga lentela lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi nabakhiqizi bayakwazi ukuphila kahle, uhulumeni uhlele izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukwandisa izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala liphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ngokuphetha, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlupheka, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinhlelo zentela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zithola ithuba lokuphila kahle. I-Ningizimu Afrika ibheke phambili, ibheke ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi izinga lentela lizoba yinsika ebalulekile kulokhu kuqhubeka.
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Ukubuyisela Uthando Lwethu Emhlabeni Emhlabeni wethu, ubuhle bemvelo bujabulisa amehlo futhi budlulisa umoya opholile. Njengoba sihamba ezindaweni ezahlukene, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu, izintaba eziphakeme, nemifula egijimayo, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Lezi zinto zembuliwe zempilo zishiwo ngothando nohlonze, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sizigcinile njengezimpahla zomhlaba. Uma ubheka izinkanyezi ebusuku, uzwa umoya opholile uthintwa ubukhazikhazi besibhakabhaka. Ukubona izinkanyezi, umhlaba ubonakala ungowethukile, udinga ukuboniswa. Iphupho lokuba sesihlalweni semvelo, sithokozisa ukuphila, kukhumbuza ngempilo yethu. Kodwa uma sicabanga ngothando lwethu oluphakade endaweni yethu, kudinga ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izinkanyezi azikhaliphile kuphela, kodwa ziqinisekisa ukuthi siphila kancane. Izintaba zikhumbuza ngempilo engapheli, izitshalo ezikhula khona, izinyoni ezindizayo, kanye nezilwane ezihlala kuwo. Izintaba zikhona ukuze ziqinise umoya wethu, zikhumbuze ukuthi siphila kancane, zifundisa uthando lokuba yinxenye yalesi sikhathi esihle. Njengoba sithokozisa lezi zintaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuzigcina, ukuze ezizukulwaneni ezizayo zikwazi ukuzithokozisa. Izimanga zemvelo, njengezihlahla ezinkulu nezigodi ezijabulisayo, zibonisa ubuchwepheshe bezimbali. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba unamandla okwakha, wokuphila. Izimanga zikhombisa ukuthi, noma imiphi imizamo yethu, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sinesibopho sokukhetha indlela esizohamba ngayo. Umhlaba unamandla, futhi lesi sikhathi sethu sokubuyisela ubuhle bemvelo kudinga ukuthi siphatheka kahle. Umoya ojulile, imvula ethulile, kanye nezimbali ezihlaza, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi siphila emhlabeni okhanyayo. Njengoba sihamba emhlabeni, kufanele sithokozise ubuhle bayo, sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Ubuhle bemvelo abungangeni ezincwadini kuphela, kodwa buxhumene nempilo yethu. Ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, kusinika amandla okuphila kahle, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Sesikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo busuke budinga ukuthokoziswa, sithinteke kakhudlwana. Umhlaba unamandla okwakha, futhi kufanele sibe nebanga lokuphila ngokwenhlonipho. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nezintaba eziphakeme, bonke bembula ubuhle besimo, futhi kufanele sithokozise lokhu ngokugcina intshisekelo yokubuyisela umhlaba. Ukubheke phambili, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo buyinkanyezi esikhanyayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Umhlaba uhlezi ubuso, ubuhle bayo bukhumbuza ukuba sibe nokuqonda. Ubuhle bemvelo buhamba noxolo, futhi uma sithokozisa lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukubuyisela uthando lwethu emhlabeni. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo abukhona kuphela kumasiko, kodwa bukhona nakwimicimbi yokuphila. Kulabo abahlala eduze kwemvelo, ubuhle bayo buhamba noxolo. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nemvula ethulile, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi sithokozisa izimanga ezikhona emhlabeni. Ubuhle bemvelo bukhona ukuze busisize, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuphila kancane. Ngakho-ke, masithokozise ubuhle bemvelo, masigcine lezi zinto ezinhle, ukuze ezizukulwaneni ezizayo zikwazi ukuzithokozisa. Umhlaba uhlezi ubuso, ubuhle bemvelo bukhona ukuze busikhumbuze ukuthi sinesibopho sokuphila. Ubuhle bemvelo buyinkanyezi esikhanyayo, futhi uma sithokozisa lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukubuyisela uthando lwethu emhlabeni. Sisebenzele umhlaba, sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo buhamba noxolo, futhi kufanele sithokozise lezi zinto ukuze zihlale zikhona.
amaMamelodi Sundowns - Ingxoxo NgeMidlalo Nezinto Ezizayo Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukuhamba phambili kokukhuluma ngamaqembu amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaMamelodi Sundowns. Njengoba sihlangana nomqeqeshi weqembu, uMnu. Rulani Mokwena, sizobheka izimpi zabo ezidlulelayo, amathuba abawatholile, kanye nezifiso zabo zokukhula. Ingxenye 1: Ukubaluleka Kwamaqembu Ngokwezemidlalo UMnu. Mokwena, ungakuchaza kanjani ukubaluleka kweMamelodi Sundowns emidlalweni yaseNingizimu Afrika? Sifuna ukuba isibonelo esihle, hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasekuthuthukiseni izinkanyezi ezincane." Ingxenye 2: Ukuphumelela Kweqembu Ngokubukwa kwakho, yiziphi izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene neMamelodi Sundowns kulezi zinsuku? "Njengoba siqhubeka, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Kodwa, sihamba phambili emsebenzini wethu, siza phambili ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Siphokophele ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, nokuvumela abadlali bethu ukuba bavelele." Ingxenye 3: Amathuba Nezinhlelo Zesikhathi Esizayo Ngabe unazo izinhlelo ezithile zokukhulisa amaMamelodi Sundowns esikhathini esizayo? "Yebo, sinemigomo emisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithanda ukuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabalandeli bethu, ngoba yibo abanjalo abangakhuthaza abadlali bethu." Ingxenye 4: Ubudlelwano Nabalandeli Kuyini okukhuthazayo ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kweqembu nabalandeli? "Bengizama ukuhlanganisa abadlali nabalandeli. Ngiyakhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo lapho sidlalela emakhaya ethu, futhi umoya wethu uyavela. Sifuna abadlali bethu bazi ukuthi basendaweni ebalulekile, futhi ukuba nebanzi labalandeli, kubalulekile. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhlala isikhathi eside." Ingxenye 5: Isiphetho Nezikhumbuzo Ngabe ungathanda ukwabelana ngombono wakho wokuthi ukufinyelela kuphi amaMamelodi Sundowns eminyakeni ezayo? "Siyabonga, futhi ngithanda ukukholwa ukuthi kulapho sizogcina siphuma phambili. Sifuna ukujabulisa abalandeli bethu, sibe nezinye izicoco neziphakamiso zempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sihamba phambili, futhi sizobe sithandwa phesheya, ngaphandle kokuphuma emathafeni." Ngokuhlanganyela, amaMamelodi Sundowns awanqobi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa futhi adlondlobala ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga, uMnu. Mokwena, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi. Sifisela iqembu lethu impumelelo enkulu!

Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Isiko Nobuciko Bokuziveza Imidlalo yeshashalazi iyingxenye ebalulekile yobuciko bendabuko nezamasiko emhlabeni wonke. Ziningi izizathu ezenza imidlalo yeshashalazi ibaluleke kakhulu, zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa izindaba, ukusiza abantu ukuthi bakhulume ngokuqonda izinkinga zempilo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Nokho, lokhu kudala ingxabano phakathi kwabafundi, abaculi, nababukeli mayelana neqhaza leshashalazi emphakathini. Okokuqala, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana mezi zikaNkulunkulu, umphakathi, nesiko. Ngokusebenzisa ukubonisa, abalingisi bayakwazi ukuveza izimo ezinzima zokuphila, izinkinga zomphakathi, nezinselelo obhekana nazo abantu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi yize zikhona izithiyo ezihlukene, imidlalo iyithuluzi lokwenza abantu baziqonde kahle izimo ezithile. Ngokubona izinkinga ezihlangabezana nabanye, abalandeli beqala ukubona umhlaba ngamehlo ahlukile, banikezwa kanjani ubufakazi bokuthi bahlala endaweni eyodwa nabanye. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imidlalo yeshashalazi ingakha izingxoxo ezinzima nezihlabahlosile mayelana nezinkinga zempilo. Ngokusebenzisa izimo eziguquguqukayo, abalimisi bangakwazi ukuphakamisa imicabango mayelana nezifiso nemicabango yokuphila. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuholela ekwakhekeni komphakathi onobuhlakani. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuhlala ohlangothini oluphakeme lobuciko, lokho kudala ukuphikisana okwenziwa ngezifiso zomphakathi ngempela. Ukwakha umphakathi okhululekile nokwazi ukufunda kudinga imidlalo yeshashalazi. Ukubukeka kwemidlalo yeshashalazi kuhlanganisa umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze bahlanganyele izimvo zabo. Lokhu kugqugquzela ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo nabantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlanga noma izizinda zobuzwe zikhuluma ngokuma kwazo kumphakathi. Imidlalo iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuhlanganyela, ukudala ukuvumelana nokufuna ukuzimela, okukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abe nendima ekufundeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibalulekile ekugcineni amasiko. Izinkolo, izinkolelo, nezimpumelelo zamasiko zihlala zikhanya kulo mkhakha. Ngaphezu kokunikeza ividiyo yokuhlola, imidlalo igcina izixhumanisi zamasiko, iqinisekisa ukuthi izigameko ezisemqoka nezimo zihlala zivezwa. Lokhu kudala ukuxhumana komphakathi futhi kugqugquzela isiZulu, nabanye ubuchwepheshe bezikole. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sihlale sinokubuyekezwa kuphela ngezinto ezinhle mayelana nezinsiza. Ubulungiswa, izicathulo, noma izinkinga zempilo zomphakathi zingaba yingxenye yemibuzo ekubukeni okwenziwayo. Ngalesi sizathu, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ingaba nemiphumela emibi uma ingalungiswa kahle noma uma ibonisa izinkinga ezithile ngendlela engalungile. Ukuphrinta okuphelele kobuqotho nokuhlanzeka kwesiko kufanele kube yingxenye yephuzu ebalulekile. Ngeshwa, ezindaweni eziningi, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nemikhawulo yokuqhuba ezimeni ezinzima, okuthinta ubuchwepheshe nezinsiza. ukukhethwa kwemidlalo kuxhomeke kakhulu ezimakethe zomphakathi, kusukela ezindaweni ezilula kuya kwizikhungo ezinkulu zobuciko. Lokhu kudala ukubungebu okubukeka njengezithiyo emikhakheni eyahlukene, okungase kwenze ukuthi izinganekwane zibe nesithiyo ekudlaleni. Ngakho-ke, kuyadingeka ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi kube umthombo wobuchwepheshe, ukuze bonke abahlali bakwazi ukufinyelela izinhlelo ezihlukene, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Ngokusebenzisa izinkulumo eziqhubekayo nezenzakalo, imidlalo yaphakade ihlinzeka ngamathuba okuyiqonda, ithinta izinkalo ezahlukahlukene zomphakathi, ibalule izinkinga, futhi ikhulise amakhono abalingisi. Sifanele ukuhlonipha nokuvula izindlela ezintsha zokucabanga ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi iyindlela yokukhanyisa umphakathi wethu, igqugquzela umoya wokubambisana, kanye namakhono okubambisana uzokhula ezwenikazi lethu.
### Ukuphucwa Umhlaba Ngesikhathi Sobandlululo Umbuzo 1: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi "ukuphucwa umhlaba"? Impendulo: Ukuphucwa umhlaba kubhekisela ezinhlelweni ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo ababephathwa kabi ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwakha, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo. Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, lezi zinguquko zazibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelele. --- Umbuzo 2: Yini eyayiqondile ngalesi sikhathi sobandlululo? Impendulo: Isikhathi sobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika sathinta kakhulu impilo yabantu, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, ababephathwa kabi. Umhlaba wawuhlukaniswe ngokobuhlanga, futhi abantu babengenakufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile, ezifana nemfundo, impilo, kanye namathuba emisebenzi, okwaholela ekuphiviseni kwezinhlanga eziningi. --- Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuphuculwe umhlaba ngalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, kwakukhona izinyathelo ezithathwe, ezifana nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezazihlose ukulwa nobandlululo, njenge-ANC (African National Congress) nezinye izinhlangano ezazimemezela amalungelo abantu. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokufunda ezazihloselwe ukufundisa abantu abamnyama kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zazibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 4: Kungani imfundo ibalulekile ekuphuceni umhlaba? Impendulo: Imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, abantu abamnyama bavele benqatshelwe ukufinyelela imfundo efanele. Ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, kwakubalulekile ukukhulisa izinga lemfundo, njengoba imfundo ivula amathuba, ikakhulukazi ekutholeni imisebenzi engcono, okuholela ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. --- Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo ezazibhekene nabantu ngesikhathi sokuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Abantu babebhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabi nokwaneliseka ezinsizakalweni, ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, futhi abaninzi balesi sikhathi babengenakufinyelela ezimfanelweni ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo nesikhungo semfundo. --- Umbuzo 6: Uphi umthelela wokuphucwa umhlaba namuhla? Impendulo: Umthelela wokuphucwa umhlaba usabonakala namuhla. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zedlule ziye zathuthukisa izimboni, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zathuthukisa izinga lempilo kubantu abaningi. Nokho, kusekhona imizamo eminingi edingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila kahle. --- Umbuzo 7: Ingabe kunamathuba angaphezulu okuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Yebo, kunamathuba amaningi okuphucwa umhlaba, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyela nezokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi, nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile, konke lokhu kungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphuculeni izimo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 8: Yini eyenza kube nzima ukuqeda ubandlululo? Impendulo: Ukuqeda ubandlululo kubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabikhona kokuxolelwa phakathi kwabantu, izinkolelo ezijulile, kanye nezinhlelo eziphikisanayo. Umphakathi kumele ube nokuzimisela nokuhlanganyela ukuze ufeze uguquko olukhulu, futhi kube nokuhlonipha wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga babo. --- Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngekusasa lokuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Ikusasa lokuphucwa umhlaba lidinga umsebenzi oqhubekayo. Ukuxhaswa ngemali, izinhlelo zokwakha umnotho, kanye nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi esebenzisanayo kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, izimboni, nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. --- Umbuzo 10: Yini eyinhloko okumele sikhumbule uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sobandlululo? Impendulo: Okubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphucwa umhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Umqondo wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo nemvelaphi yomunye nomunye kumele kube yinsika yethu. Umphakathi unamathuba amaningi okwakha ikusasa elingcono, futhi sonke sinesibopho sokuba yingxenye yokuphucula izimo zabanye. --- Ngale ndlela, ukuqonda ukuphucwa umhlaba ngesikhathi sobandlululo kubalulekile ukuze sithole imfundiso nezixazululo ezizosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezemfundo Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, izikole zamabanga aphansi zazigcwele izingane ezazizama ukufinyelela emhlabeni wezemfundo. Nokho, le nqubo yayingenamathuba alula. Kwamanye amazwe, ukufunda kwakuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezinzima, okwakuthinta kakhulu intuthuko yabalimi. Abafundi babezibandakanya ezincwadini ezindala, lapho abasha bephikisana nezinqumo ezithile ezithinta impilo yabo. Njengoba lezi zinkomba zikhula, izikole zamanyuvesi zathola ukuvuselelwa kancane. Isahluko 2: Intuthuko Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zemfundo zathuthuka, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zaba yisisekelo sokwakha izinhlelo eziphakeme. Ngonyaka we-1900, abafundi basemanyuvesi baphenduka izigidi ezahlukene emhlabeni jikelele, behluka ngezindawo abavela kuzo. Lezi zifundo zayinikeza umoya omusha wezobuchwepheshe, futhi abafundi babengabafundi abavusa izinhlelo eziguqula izibalo zabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izimfundamakhwela zaziqala ukuvela, futhi abafundi bafunda ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, benza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ukuze baqhubekele phambili ezimpilweni zabo. Isahluko 3: Ukujula Kwezombusazwe Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, umkhankaso wezombusazwe wathola amathuba amasha. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde baba nezwi elikhulu ebuhleni bomphakathi, behlanganyela ezimeni ezinzima, futhi beqeqeshwa ngokubambisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinyathelo ezinzima zavele zafaka izidingo zokubonisana phakathi kwabafundi nezikhungo zemfundo. Izikhungo zabafundi zashintsha, zaba yizindawo ezahlukahlukene zokufunda, okuvulela amathuba okuhlola imibono emisha. Isahluko 4: Ubuhlakani Nobuhlungu Ngaphandle kwemfundo, abasha babephikisa. Ubuhlakani bahlala buphakeme, futhi abafundi basemanyuvesi baveza izifiso zabo zokufunda. Baziqonda kahle ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi baphokophele ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabanye. Izinkumbulo zabafundi zazikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu, okuqinisekisa ukuthi baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo. Bafunda ukuthi abazali babo bahlupheka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhuthazo sokufuna impumelelo. Isahluko 5: Ukuvuka Kwesiko Ngonyaka we-1960, abafundi basemanyuvesi baqala ukuveza isimilo esisha. Bahlanganisa izinhlelo zezimali ezithuthukisiwe, okwavula iminyango emisha yokwakha izifundo ezizothuthukisa imfundo. Ukuhlangana kwabo kwaholela ekutheni bafune ukuxhumanisa imicabango yabo yokuphila, behlanganyela nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkumbulo. Isahluko 6: Ukugubha Ibanga Abafundi basemanyuvesi bakhombisa isithakazelo esikhulu emakhonweni abawathola ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokwakha imikhankaso ezothuthukisa imfundo, kulotshwe izincwadi ezizokhumbuza ngezizathu ezithakazelisayo. Abafundi bahlola izinkinga zomphakathi, behlanganyela emisebenzini eyahlukene. Ukuhamba kwempilo kuphonsa izinyathelo eziyisithupha, okuqinisekisa impumelelo yomphakathi. Isahluko 7: Umphumela Ophelele Igalelo labafundi basemanyuvesi alihlinzeki kuphela ngekhwalithi yokufundisa elungile, kodwa futhi liqhubeka nokuhlola izinhlelo ezinhle. Abafundi bahlala benesibopho sokwakha umphakathi. Ukubambana kwabo kuveza amandla, kanti izindaba zabo zikhumbuza ukuba baphokophele phambili. Umphumela uphumelele, ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthuka uma abafundi benikela ngempumelelo yabo ezimfundweni. Lokhu kuphilisa umphakathi ngezinsiza zefunda, futhi abanye bazithokozisa, benza izinqumo ezinhle zokwakha ikusasa labo. Iziphumo zikhombisa ubuhle, futhi isikhathi eside sokuhlola umlando wabafundi basemanyuvesi sikhona, sikhuluma ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, ukuqonda kwemfundo kuyisisekelo sezinguquko ezizayo.
uBarack Obama: Impilo Nempumelelo Ukukhuluma ngempilo kaBarack Obama, lo muntu onomlando omuhle, kubalulekile. Uzalwe ngonyaka ka-1961 eHonolulu, eHawaii, uBarack ungumfana ophuma emndenini ohlukene. Ubaba wakhe, uBarack Obama Sr., wayengumAfrika ongene e-United States, kanti unina, uStanley Ann Dunham, wayengumNgisi. Lokhu kuhlangana kwezizinda kudala isithombe esihle sezwe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eHawaii, uObama waya e-California, lapho aqala khona ukufunda e-Occidental College, bese eqhubeka eHarvard Law School. Ufinyelele iziqu zeziqu zezakhamizi futhi waba ngumholi kwezokuphila. UBarack waba ngumhleli wombhalo we-Harvard Law Review, okukhombisa ukuthi wayengumuntu ophusile onobuchwepheshe. UBarack Obama ungomunye wabantu abakhombisa amandla okuphumelela, futhi akuyena nje kuphela umuntu ophumelele, kodwa ungumholi. Ngemuva kokufunda, wabuyela eChicago, lapho asebenza khona njengomfundisi wezomthetho. Ngesikhathi esebenza eChicago, waqala ukuthakazelisa ngopolitiki, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza umehluko emphakathini. Lokhu kwakuwukuhamba phambili empilweni yakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uObama waba yisihlabani emhlabeni jikelele ngesikhathi esikhuluma emcimbini wokuvota e-Democratic National Convention. Umhlaba uqaphele uBarack, futhi umoya wokushintsha waqala. Uthando lwakhe lokuhola, kanye namazwi akhe anomthelela, kwaphendula izigidi zabantu. Lokhu kwakuyisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yakhe, futhi kwaba yisinyathelo esijulile sokuba umholi wezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza eSenate, uObama waqala ukukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibalulekile, ezifana nokunakekela impilo, ubulungiswa bezomthetho, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihambisanayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wathola ithuba lokukhuphukela phezulu. Ngo-2008, waba umongameli wesithathu omnyama e-United States, okwakuwumcimbi omkhulu emphakathini. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula kubantu abaningi, njengoba uBarack wayephakamisa ithemba lokuthi izinto zingashintsha. Njengomongameli, uObama wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Wabangela ushintsho olukhulu kwezokwelapha ngohlelo lwe-Affordable Care Act, olwakha ithuba lokunakekelwa kwempilo kubantu abaningi. Waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi amalungelo abantu abamnyama, abesifazane, nabanye abavela ezizindeni ezihlukahlukene. Nokho, umsebenzi wakhe wawungekho maphutsa. Uhlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima, njengezimo zokushisa komhlaba, imikhuba yokungcolisa umoya, nezinkinga zezezimali. UBarack wayengumholi ophokophele phambili, futhi wayefuna ukufaka umqondo wokubheka phambili. Lokhu kwandulela ukuba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, futhi kwasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezithile ezimqoka. Ngemuva kokuphothula ubuholi bakhe, uObama akazange akhululeke kuphela. Waqhubeka nokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezahlukene, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngezindaba zomhlaba. Waqamba i-Obama Foundation, ebheke ekwakheni abaholi abasezingeni eliphezulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uBarack akahambanga phambili kuphela ngenxa yakhe, kodwa ubambisene nabanye abantu abathi bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Ngokubanzi, uBarack Obama ungumuntu ophilayo, onomoya ophakeme, futhi ohlonishwayo. Ube nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela e-United States, kodwa nasezwenikazi lonke. Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi, uma ungumuntu onomgomo, ungakwazi ukushintsha umhlaba. Uhlanga lwenhloso olufana noBarack lubonisa ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke okungcono uma ungathathi isinyathelo sokuhola. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo kaBarack Obama, sikhuluma ngempumelelo yokuphumelela, ubuholi, nokuhola abantu. UBarack usifundisa ukuthi uma sizimisele, sizokwazi ukufinyelela izimpumelelo ezinkulu. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Ngakho, ngabe uyakholwa ukuthi uBarack Obama uyakhombisa ukuthi izifiso zethu zingafezeka? Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinguquko zenzeka uma sithatha izinyathelo. UBarack ungumholi ohloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukufunda okuningi kuye.
iShoprite Isingeniso I-Shoprite Holdings Limited iyinkampani edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuqhuba inethiwekhi enkulu yezitolo ezithengisa ukudla nezinsiza eziphathelene nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Le nkampani, esunguliwe ngonyaka ka-1979, isiza ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini engaphansi komnotho. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka imisebenzi ye-Shoprite, izinzuzo zayo emphakathini, nemigomo yezenhlalo nezoqoqosho ehlangene nebhizinisi. Ukwakhiwa KweShoprite I-Shoprite yaqala njengethuluzi lokusebenza kwezemali, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yanda kakhulu futhi yaphinde yathuthukisa imikhiqizo yasekhaya. Uhlobo oluhloniphekile lwe-Shoprite lwandisa imikhiqizo etholakalayo, okuhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, izinkwa, kanye nezinye izinsiza. Ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezikhiqizayo, i-Shoprite ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yezezimali, yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwabathengi abavela ezingeni elihlukene lempilo. Le nkampani, ngaleso sikhathi, isungule amafiliyal esiteshi esiphezulu, lapho othintana nabo bengahlanganyela khona imikhiqizo eyahlukahlukene. Ubuhle BeShoprite Emphakathini Ibanga lokuhweba le-Shoprite alikhulisi nje kuphela inani lemisebenzi, kodwa futhi lithuthukisa umphakathi lapho likhanya khona. Ngenxa yokwandisa izitolo ezikwiindawo ezihlukene, ibhizinisi le-Shoprite libe nezinyathelo ezithile zokwakha umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eminingi, ezindleleni ezihamba phambili, kanye nemihlangano yokwakha imiphakathi. Ezinye izinhlelo ze-Shoprite zifaka izifundo zokulima, ezokwakhiwa kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelulwa kwezidingo zabathengi abancane. Lawa maphrojekthi ayasiza ukwakha umnotho wezwe, okukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuze ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Izimiso Zezenhlalo Nezomnotho Ngenkathi i-Shoprite ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile emphakathini, ibhizinisi layo linaso nesibopho sokuhlala sithobela izimiso zezenhlalo nezomnotho. I-Shoprite igcizelela umgomo wokuba yinkampani ethokozisayo, enesibopho, futhi ekhuthaza ukusizakala kokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza izinhlelo zokuphila eziphephile, ukunciphisa imfucumfucu, nokuqinisa umoya wobumbano phakathi kwezabasebenzi. Ngale ndlela, i-Shoprite iyazama ukuhlinzeka ngezenzo ezilungile kubathengi bayo, nokuqinisa ukuthi iyinkampani engathokoziswa ngabo bonke. Ukuqhubeka Nokuthuthuka Ngesikhathi i-Shoprite iqhubeka nokwandisa ibhizinisi layo, ibhekelele kakhulu izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselela izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokuphila, imikhankaso yokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa umphakathi. I-Shoprite ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuphothulweni kwezinhlelo zokwakha imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezingxenyeni ezisemadolobheni. Futhi, ukuze iqhubeke nokufinyelela izingqikithi zayo, ibhizinisi lenza izinhlelo ezinhle zokuhweba ezinqwabelanayo nezokuzinakekela, okuhlobene nezidingo ezishiwo ngababheki bemikhiqizo. Isiphetho I-Shoprite iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ibhizinisi lingakwazi kanjani ukuhlanganisa umnotho nokusebenza kwezenhlalo. Ngaleyo ndlela, le nkampani ithuthukisa imiphakathi, isekela imisebenzi, futhi inikela ngothando nokuqwashisa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Ukube i-Shoprite ikwazi ukugcina le mikhuba, izokwazisa imiphakathi eminingi, iqhubeke ibe yisikhumbuzo sokuqala sokusiza umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Shoprite izobamba iqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezohwebo, ibaluleke kakhulu emqoka wempilo yomphakathi, ibonisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lingaphandle kokuhweba futhi lingahamba phambili ekuqedeni izinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza i-Shoprite ibe yinkampani engaphezu kokuhweba; iyinqwaba yezenzo ezenza umphakathi ungeze isimo esihlanganyele sokwakha umnotho osebenzayo.
Iphrofayela Yomnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokukhula kwezomnotho e-Afrika. Uhlanga lwezomnotho luhlanganisa izimboni ezahlukene, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umnotho wethu, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukuhamba kwawo, izinselelo, kanye namathuba akhona. Ukwakhiwa Komnotho Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungowesithathu ngobukhulu e-Afrika, ulandela i-Nigeria ne-Egypt. Uhlanga lwezomnotho luhlanganisa izimboni ezinkulu ezifana nezokumbiwa phansi, ezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Izimayini zisebenza njengesisekelo somnotho, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yokumba amalahle, igolide, nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa futhi kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu, njengokungalingani komnotho. Izinsiza Zomnotho Izinsiza zomnotho ziwumgogodla wokukhula. Uhlelo lwezokuthutha, izikhungo zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakalo zezezimali zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, izimpahla, kanye nezinsizakalo. I-Stock Exchange yaseJozini iyinhlangano ebalulekile yokuhweba, lapho izinkampani zikhulisa khona imali ukuze zikhule. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuthembela phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, okubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Izinkinga Zomnotho Nokho, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungalingani komnotho, okukhombisa umehluko phakathi kwabantu abacebile nabampofu, kusemqoka. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu, okukhuthaza izinxushunxushu zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokungasebenzi lihlala liphezulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umnotho Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika usebenza ngezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokuhweba, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Amathuba Okukhula Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika unamathuba amaningi okukhula. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, kudala amathuba amasha. Izinkampani ezincane nezimaphakathi (SMEs) zikhula ngokushesha, zenza kube lula ukuhweba nokwakha imisebenzi. Ukwanda kokuhweba namanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi e-Asia nase-Europe, kudala amathuba okukhulisa umnotho. Isiphetho Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso wezinselelo nezithakazelo ezihlukahlukene. Ukubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona, kanye nokusebenzisa amathuba akhona, kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wethu uyakhula futhi ufinyelela kubantu bonke. Ngokuqhubeka nokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho wonke umuntu engaba nethuba lokuphila kahle.
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Ukuhlonishwa Nokugcinwa Kwezemvelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuhle bemvelo buye buba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Izindawo ezinhle zemvelo, ezifana nezintaba eziphakeme, izihlahla ezinkulu, nemifula ehlanzekile, zikhombisa ubuciko bemvelo obungapheli. Lezi zindawo azigcini nje ngokuba yizindawo zokuphumula, kodwa futhi zibalulekile empilweni yethu, zisinika umoya opholile, amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze siphile. Izindawo Zokuhlola Ubuhle Bemvelo Emazweni amaningi, izindawo zemvelo zikhangisa izivakashi eziningi. Izindawo ezifana neKruger National Park eNingizimu Afrika, iYosemite National Park eMelika, kanye neGreat Barrier Reef e-Australia, zikhombisa ubuhle obungapheli bemvelo. Lezi zindawo zihlala zikhangisa abantu abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba, abafuna ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo, kanye nokuhlola izilwane ezihlukahlukene nezitshalo ezitholakala kulezi zindawo. Izindawo zemvelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imvelo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, noma ukuhamba emanzini, kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde ubuhle bemvelo. Lokhu kubanika ithuba lokubona izilwane eziphilayo, izitshalo ezihlukahlukene, kanye nezimo zemvelo ezithokozisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zindawo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bagweme ukungcola, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Ubuhle Bemvelo Nezinkinga Zokugcinwa Kwayo Nokho, ubuhle bemvelo buhlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, konke lokhu kudala ingozi ezindaweni zemvelo. Izilwane eziningi ziyaqhubeka zishabalala ngenxa yokuphathwa kabi kwemithombo yemvelo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izindawo ezinhle zibe sengozini yokulahleka, okungaholela ekutheni izizukulwane ezizayo zingakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo bukhona futhi buhlala bukhona. Izinhlelo zokuvikela izilwane, izinhlelo zokuphatha kahle imithombo yemvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngobaluleka kokugcina imvelo, zonke zidinga ukusekelwa. Ukuze sikwazi ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumuntu siqu, umphakathi, noma uhulumeni. Ukubaluleka Kokufundisa Ngemvelo Ukufundisa abantu ngobaluleka kokugcina imvelo kubalulekile. Izikole, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzithandela, zonke zingaba nendima enkulu ekufundiseni abantu ngalesi sihloko. Ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile, kufanele bazi ukuthi izinsiza zemvelo zidingeka empilweni yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu babe nesifiso sokuvikela imvelo, futhi bazibophezele ekugcineni ubuhle bemvelo. Isiphetho: Ukuhlonipha Nokugcina Imvelo Ubuhle bemvelo bukhulu futhi bukhulu, kodwa bukhona engcupheni. Ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela lezi zindawo ezinhle, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuzigcina. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahloniphe imvelo, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuvikela izindawo zemvelo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela lezi zindawo ezinhle, futhi zifunde ukubaluleka kokugcina imvelo. Ubuhle bemvelo abukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethekile, kodwa bukhona nasemakhaya ethu, emizini yethu, nasemaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokugcina lezi zindawo zihlanzekile, ziphilile, futhi zihlala zikhangisa ubuhle bazo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela uthando nemfundo ngempilo yemvelo, futhi sibe nesibopho sokugcina ubuhle bemvelo buphila.
Isingeniso Ama-social media, noma imithombo yolwazi yokuxhumana, abe negalelo elikhulu empilweni yabantu abayizigidi emhlabeni jikelele. Le mithombo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ukwabelana ngolwazi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Ngaphandle kokuba imithombo yokuxhumana ithuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, nayo iphinde ivule amathuba amasha emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanabile. Kulolu chungechunge, sizohlola imiqondo ebalulekile mayelana nezinzuzo, izingozi, nezimo ezingavela ngokusebenzisa ama-social media. Izinzuzo zama-Social Media Okokuqala, ama-social media afaka izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana. Ngokuvamile, abantu banganikeza imicabango yabo, babelane ngezinto abazifunayo, futhi baxoxe ngemicabango ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala umphakathi ozimele futhi okhuluma ngezinto ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okuholela ekwandeni kokubambisana. Okwesibili, ama-social media adlulisela ulwazi olusheshayo. Ngokusebenzisa ama-platform afana ne-Facebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram, abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olunembile futhi oluqondile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukukhipha imibiko emisha, izindaba zomphakathi, nezinye izinto ezithinta umphakathi. Izinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene zisebenzisa lawa ma-platform ukwenza izimemezelo, okunikeza abantu ulwazi lwakamuva ngempela. Okwesithathu, ama-social media ayivula iminyango emisha emsebenzini. Abantu bangaqala izinkampani zabo, baqale imikhankaso yokuthengisa, noma babe yizinhlelo ezidonsa abantu. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kuhambisana nephuzu lokuthi ama-social media akha amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasebasha. Ngokukhuluma nabantu abaningi online, bangadonsa amakhasimende, bahlakulele izivumelwano, futhi bathuthukise ibhizinisi labo. Izingcuphe Nezingcindezi Nokho, noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, bakhona nabezindaba abakhombisa izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ama-social media. Okokuqala, i-cyberbullying iyinsakavukela. Abantu abathanda ukufaka imibono yabo bavame ukubhekana nezinsolo nokuhlukunyezwa online. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphila, kubangele ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinye izimo zokuphila ezingezinhle. Abantu kumele babe neziqu ezanele nezindlela zokuvikela ukuze baziqinisekise ukuthi baphila kahle empilweni yomphakathi. Okwesibili, imithombo yolwazi yokuxhumana ingaba yinsiza embi yokusabalalisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Ukuhlanya kwezindaba ezimbi, okuthiwa i-fake news, kudala ukufaniswa kokucabanga okungafanele. Lokhu kudala ukufutheka, ukudideka, nokuphikisana phakathi kwabantu. Kuhle ukuthi abantu babe nehloso enembile ukuze bathole ulwazi oluqondile oluhamba phambili. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana kakhulu kwamahhala okubhalwe kwi-inthanethi kungaholela ekwehliseni abantu emiphumeleni eyinqaba. Abantu bahlala behluleka ukulinganisa isikhathi abachasayo ema-social media, okuthatha isikhathi sabo esingokwemvelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baphile kahle, bazi ukulawula isikhathi sabo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basathokozisa izinzuzo zama-social media, kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuba nezifundo ezithile ezivula izinsizakusebenza zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi izingozi nezinzuzo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophusile nolwazi. Abafundi kufanele baqeqeshwe indlela yokubheka ulwazi, bakwazi ukusizakala ngalezi zinsizakusebenza. Okwesibili, izinkampani ezisebenzisa ama-social media kufanele zifake izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano ezithathwa ngamakhasimende ziqiniswe, futhi bazi kahle ngezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isithombe esihle sebhizinisi, kanti izivakashi zikhuthazwe ukuba zisebenzisane ngempumelelo. Isiphetho Ngasohlangothini, ama-social media ayinsiza enkulu ekwenzeni umhlaba ubonakale. Noma kunjalo, njengazinye izinsiza, kudinga ukuba siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nazo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu bakwazi ukulawula indlela abaxhumana ngayo, bazi izimo eziyingozi, futhi bathathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela. Ngemva kokuhlola zonke lezi zinto, kulindeleke ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-social media bube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu, nakanjani uma kusebenza ngokucophelela.
Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika: Umhlahlandlela Wokukhula Nokuphumelela Isingeniso Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iyingxenye ebalulekile yezenhlalo, lapho ibamba izikhundla ezibalulekile emiphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ocacile wokuthi intsha ingazuza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zayo nakuzo zonke izici zomphakathi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezizothuthukisa impilo nempumelelo yokuphila kwentsha. Isinyathelo 1: Ukufunda Nokukhula Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuphumelela, kufanele iqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ukufunda kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubhalela Isikole: Intsha kufanele ibhalisele izikole noma izikhungo zemfundo ezihlinzeka ngemicimbi ehlukene yokufunda. Akukhona kuphela ukufunda izifundo ezisemthethweni, kodwa futhi nokuqonda ukuthi imfundo ifaka phakathi amakhono empilo. 2. Ukufuna Ulwazi Oluphakeme: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha kufanele ibone ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yayo ngesikhumbuzo, njengokuhamba ezikoleni eziphakeme, izifundo ezikhethekile noma imiphakathi yokufunda. 3. Ukwakha Izinhloso: Kubalulekile ukuthi intsha ibeke izinhloso ezicacile zokufunda. Izindlela zokwenza lokhu zifaka phakathi ukwenza izinhlelo zezenzo ezicacile zokufinyelela lezi zinhloso. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuthuthukisa Amakhono Ukukhula empilweni akuhambisani kuphela nemfundo, kodwa futhi nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izifundo Zamakhono: Intsha ingabhalisela izifundo zamakhono ezehlukene, ezifana nezifundo zokusebenza ngezandla, ubuchwepheshe, noma izifundo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzowasiza ekuthuthukiseni amathuba emisebenzi. 2. Ukwakha Izingxoxo: Kumqoka ukuthi intsha ihlanganyele ezingxoxweni ezingebanga kube izinkulumo zempilo, njengezinkulumo ezihlobene nomsebenzi, umnotho, noma ibhizinisi. 3. Ukuqhuba Imisebenzi Yezandla: Ukuzama imisebenzi yezenzo, njengo-okusiza emiphakathini, kuzokwakha ulwazi nolwazi lwezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhokha Imibono Nancyakazayo Emphakathini wethu, intsha ibalulekile ekubumbeni ikusasa. Izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinhlaka zempilo, ezokuxhumana, nemfundo zidinga imibono emisha. Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuveza imibono yayo: 1. Ukubamba Izingxoxo: Izinkulumo ezivulekile phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza, iziphathimandla, nezifiki ezisemphakathini kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba intsha ibonise izimvo zayo. 2. Imibono Yokwabelana: Intsha ingavula izinkundla zokuxhumana, ezikhamanga noma ezibukwayo ukuze ibonise imibono. Lokhu kuzovumela ukuthi ibonakale kanjani engqondweni yabantu abahlukene. 3. Ukwamukela Izimpendulo: Izinselelo zokuqonda ngezimvo ezahlukahlukene zibalulekile. Intsha kufanele ikwazi ukuzama ukwabelana ngemibono yayo futhi ithole izimpendulo ezivela kwabanye. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlala Nempilo Impilo iyasiza ekuthuthukisweni kokuphila kwezinhlaka zomphakathi. Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kufanele ifunde ukuzithiba: 1. Ukudla Okuhle: Kubalulekile ukufunda ngokudla okunempilo, nokuthi kudlichwa kanjani impilo. Izivakashi zempilo zidinga ukugqugquzela ubulungiswa bokudla. 2. Uhlelo Lokuzivocavoca: Ukuzivocavoca kuyindida ebalulekile yokuphila okunempilo. Intsha kufanele ibone ukuthi ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca kuzosiza ekugcina amandla. 3. Ukuphila Ngemoyeni Othokozisayo: Ukuze kube nempilo enhle yengqondo, intsha kufanele ifune izindlela zokuphila zenkolo, ezokuzijabulisa, nezokuhlala nabantu abasukela phezulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenzisana Emphakathini Ukubambana nezinye abantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ekusebenziseni amakhono akho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izinhlelo Zebhizinisi: Intsha kufanele ibone izinkampani zendawo ezingabavumela ukuba babe neqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo. 2. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukwenza ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza, abaholi, nabanye abantu emiphakathini kuzokwakha indlela yokuthi intsha ibonise amandla ayo. 3. Ukubamba Izenzakalo: Ukuhlela nokubamba izenzakalo ezikhamanga, ezempilo, noma ezokufunda kuyindlela yokusebenza embonini. Isiphetho Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezibekiwe, intsha ingakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo, ukwakha ukuphila okungcono, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukuthola imfundo, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukwakha imibono, ukuhlala nempilo, nokusebenzisana kungaba nemiphumela emihle futhi kwenze impilo yentsha ibenokuphila okuphezulu. Njengoba siqhubekela phambili, kabili kubalulekile ukuthi intsha iqonde ukuthi inamandla okuzenzakalelayo nokuzithuthukisa.
Izinsalela Zempilo: Ukuhlola Izinselelo Zokuphila Empilweni, sithola izinselelo eziningi ezihlukahlukene ezithinta zonke izigaba zethu. Lezi zinsalela zempilo zifaka phakathi izinkinga zemali, ubudlelwano, impilo yomzimba, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinsalela, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izici ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke. Izinkinga Zomnotho Omunye wemithombo enkulu yezinselelo zempilo ubonakala ezinkingeni zomnotho. Ukuphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima zezimali kungaholela ekudambiseni isimo sokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi namali eyanele yokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo ezisemqoka, njengokudla, indawo yokuhlala, nezokwelapha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yezezimali kudinga ukuthi abantu bathathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze balungiselele ikusasa labo, okungaba yinkinga enkulu. Ubudlelwano Nobudlelwano Enye inkinga enkulu ebhekene nabantu yebudlelwano. Ubudlelwano obunempilo buvame ukuba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni, kodwa uma buphukile, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungathembani, noma ukungabi nesikhathi sokuxhumana kahle kungaholela ekuphukeni kobudlelwano. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu, kuholele ekudambiseni isimo sokuphila, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bafunde ukuxhumana kahle, bahloniphe omunye nomunye, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Impilo Yomzimba Impilo yomzimba nayo ibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsalela zempilo. Ukungaziphathi kahle, ukungadli kahle, nokungazivocavoci kahle kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi, ezifana nezifo, ukwanda kwesisindo, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ukuphila impilo enempilo kudinga ukuzinikela, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi akukhona konke okungokwemvelo. Ukuze sibe nempilo enhle, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, njengezokudla okunempilo, ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca, nokuphumula ngokwanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinye izinselelo zempilo. Izinkinga Zengqondo Izinkinga zengqondo zikhula ngokushesha emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukukhathazeka, ukudangala, kanye nezinye izinkinga zengqondo ziba yizinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta abantu abaningi. Lezi zinkinga zingavela ngenxa yokucindezeleka, izinkinga zomnotho, noma ukungabi nobudlelwano obuhle. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi akukhona okungokwemvelo ukuhamba bodwa kulezi zinkinga. Ukufuna usizo, ukuxoxa nabangane, noma ukufuna usizo lwezokwelapha kungasiza kakhulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuvuleka, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye ukuba sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Isiphetho Izinsalela zempilo zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukuba siqonde ukuthi ziwumsebenzi wethu ukuzithola. Ukubhekana nalezi zinsalela kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sikhuthaze impilo yomzimba nezingqondo. Noma izinselelo zempilo zingaba nzima, zikhona izindlela zokubhekana nazo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi asihambi bodwa. Ukuxhumana, ukuxhasa, nokufuna usizo kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsalela zempilo. Ngale ndlela, singakha impilo engcono, enempilo, futhi ethokozisayo.
Isingeniso ku-YouTube I-YouTube iyinsiza yokwabelana ngemicabango, imifanekiso, nemisakazo yevidiyo emhlabeni jikelele. Le nsiza inikeza abantu ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yabo, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa i-YouTube, kusukela ekuvuleni i-akhawunti kuze kube sekuthumeleni ividiyo yakho. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuvula i-Akhawunti Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuvula i-akhawunti ye-YouTube. Lokhu kungenziwa kalula uma unayo i-akhawunti ye-Google. Uma ungakayivuli, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Vakashela ku-www.google.com. 2. Chofoza ku “Bhalisela” bese ulandela imiyalelo yokwakha i-akhawunti. 3. Uma usuwakhe i-akhawunti, vakashela ku-www.youtube.com. 4. Chofoza ku “Ngena” bese ufaka imininingwane yakho ye-Google. Ngemuva kokungena, uzobona isikhangiso se-YouTube esikuvumela ukuba uqale ukuhlela, ukubuka, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubuka Ividiyo Ukubuka ividiyo ku-YouTube kulula. Ungakhetha ividiyo ethokozisayo ngokuyifaka esikhaleni sokusesha phezulu. Ungasebenzisa amagama angukhiye, noma ungakhetha kumavidiyo aphezulu noma kumachaneli owathandayo. Uma usuthole ividiyo, chofoza kuyo ukuze uqale ukuyibuka. Ungase futhi ulandele umkhondo wezithameli, ubuke izibuyekezo, noma ubonise imicabango yakho ngemuva kokubuka. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubhalisela Amachaneli Uma uthanda ividiyo ethile, ungabhalisela leyo chaneli ukuze uthole izibuyekezo ezivela kuyo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukwazi ukuhamba phambili nezinto ezintsha ezitholakala kumachaneli owathandayo. Ukuze ubhalisele, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Buka ividiyo ethokozisayo. 2. Chofoza ku “Bhalisela” phezulu kwesokudla. 3. Uma usubhalisile, uzothola izaziso uma kukhona okusha okukhishwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuthumela Ividiyo Uma unentshisekelo yokwabelana ngemicabango yakho, ungathumela ividiyo yakho. Ukuze uthumele ividiyo, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Qinisekisa ukuthi unayo ividiyo efanele. Lokhu kungaba yividiyo oyitholile, noma eyenziwe nguwe. 2. Vakashela ku-www.youtube.com bese ungene ngemvume. 3. Chofoza ku “Thumela” (Upload) phezulu kwesokudla. 4. Khetha ividiyo ofuna ukuyithumela. 5. Faka isihloko, incazelo, nezithombe ezihlobene nevidiyo yakho. 6. Khetha izilungiselelo zokubuka (umphakathi, ozimele, noma ozimele). 7. Chofoza ku “Thumela” ukuze uqedele inqubo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphendula Nokuxhumana I-YouTube iyinsiza yokuxhumana. Ungaphendula kumavidiyo, ubonise imicabango yakho, noma uxhumane nabanye abantu. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubhalela izimpendulo ezithile kumavidiyo, noma ngokuthumela imiyalezo kumachaneli. Ukuze uphendule: 1. Buka ividiyo. 2. Phakathi kokubuka, skrolela phansi ukuze uthole indawo yokubhala izimpendulo. 3. Faka imicabango yakho bese uchofoza ku “Thumela”. Isinyathelo 6: Ukusebenzisa Izici Zokuhlola I-YouTube inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezifana nezibalo zokubuka, izibuyekezo, nezithombe ezihlobene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imisebenzi yakho. Ukuze ubone izibalo zakho: 1. Ngena ku-akhawunti yakho. 2. Chofoza ku “Studio” ukuze uvule i-YouTube Studio. 3. Bheka izibalo ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zokubuka, izimpendulo, nezithombe ezithokozisayo. Isiphetho I-YouTube iyinsiza enamandla yokwabelana ngemicabango, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuvula i-akhawunti, ukubuka, ukuthumela, nokuxhumana nabanye. Qhubeka uhlola, ufunde, futhi wabelane ngemicabango yakho. I-YouTube iyinsiza ethokozisayo, futhi ungaba yingxenye yayo. Hamba phambili, ube nesikhathi esihle!
Izimpi Zomlando: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini Nempilo Yethu Izimpi zomlando ziwumfanekiso ophilayo wezinto ezenzakalayo ezithinta abantu, izizwe, nezifunda. Ziyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando, zikhombisa indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, izinqumo abazithathayo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Njengomuntu ohlola lezi zimpilo, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi izimpi azikhombisi kuphela ubudlova, kodwa zibuye ziveze izifundo ezinzulu mayelana nobuntu bethu. Ekuqaleni, izimpi zikhona ezindabeni zomhlaba, ziqala ezikhathini zakudala. Izimpi ezifana neMpi Yezwe Yokuqala neMpi Yezwe Yesibili zashintsha ubuhlakani bomhlaba. Lezi zimpi zathinta izigidi zabantu, zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa zafaka isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwezizwe buhlelekile, futhi buphelele ngezikhathi ezinzima. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zimpilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba kwempilo, kodwa kukhona nezinselelo ezibhekene nomuntu ngamunye. Noma izimpi zikhombisa ubudlova, zibuye ziveze amandla abantu okukhuthazela. Isibonelo, iMpi Yezwe Yokuqala yakhombisa ukuthi abantu bangabambisana kanjani ukuze balwe nezimo ezinzima. Izixuku zabantu zashintsha izinqumo zazo, zafaka izwi lazo emkhankasweni wokulwa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izimpi zidalela ubuhlungu, zibuye zikhuthaze umoya wokubambisana nokuzimisela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zishintsha izinkolelo nemigomo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ezimpini zenza ukuthi abantu bacabange kabusha ngezinto ezibhekwa njengokujwayelekile. Ngokwesibonelo, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili yakhuthaza ukwakheka kwezinhlangano ezinjenge-United Nations, ezazisungulwa ngenhloso yokugwema izimpi ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izimpi, nakuba zikhombisa ubudlova, zibuye zibe yizikhumbuzo zokuthi abantu bangakha izixazululo ezihlanganyela. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Izimpi zishiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, zishiya imiphumela emibi emphakathini. Izimpilo ezilahlekile, izifunda ezibhujiswe, nezizukulwane ezithintekile zikhumbuza ukuthi izimpi zihlala zishiya izilonda ezinzima. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni sibe nezinselelo zokwakha kabusha, ukuhlela kabusha, nokubuyisela emuva lokho okuphukile. Njengomuntu ophila kulezi zinsuku, ngithola ukuthi lezi zinkumbulo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokubheka izimpi zomlando, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Zifundisa ukuthi ubudlova akusona isixazululo, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, ophila ngokuhloniphana, futhi ophokophele ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ngokuphetha, izimpi zomlando ziwumfanekiso ophilayo wezinto ezithinta izimpilo zethu. Zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi zikhuthaza. Njengomuntu, ngiyavuma ukuthi izimpi zikhona, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubudlova abuyisona isixazululo. Kumele sibe nesibindi sokufunda ezimpini, sithathe izifundo, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophokophele phambili. Umhlaba wethu udinga abantu abakhuthazayo, abahlanganyela, futhi abavuma ukufunda ezimpilweni zabanye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Izinga Lemfundo Ezikoleni Zikahulumeni: Umqondo Wami Ezweni lethu, imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu. Izingane zethu zikhula zifuna ukufunda, zifuna ukwazi, futhi zifuna amathuba okuphila kangcono. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempela, izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni lihlala liphansi, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu. Ngiyavuma, imizamo yokuthuthukisa imfundo iyenzeka, kodwa izinselelo eziningi zihlala zikhona. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo ezweni lethu. Ziningi izikole ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa izinga lemfundo elitholakala kulezi zikole alihambisani nezidingo zamanje. Abafundi bethu bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza ezincane, izifundo ezingaphelele, kanye nezifundiswa ezinganaki kahle abafundi. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba abafundi bengenzi kahle ezivivinyweni nasemakhono abawadingayo ukuze baphumelele empilweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona ezikoleni zikahulumeni zihlala zinganele. Izincwadi, amathuluzi okufunda, nezikhungo zokufundisa zihlala zikhona, kodwa ziningi izikole ezithola ukungabi nakho. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlale behluleka ukufunda kahle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bahlale bephuma emkhakheni wemfundo. Abafundi abangenayo imfundo efanele bahlala benokungabi nempumelelo ezimpilweni zabo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokubheka izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngothando lokufunda. Abafundi badinga ukugqugquzelwa ukuze bathande ukufunda, kodwa uma izimo ezikhona zingezinhle, lokhu kuba nzima. Izifundiswa ezithanda ukufundisa, ezikhuthazayo, zidingeka ukuze ziqinise uthando lokufunda. Uma abafundi bebona ukuthi izifundiswa zabo zikhathalela impilo yabo, bazoba nesifiso sokufunda nokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhona ezikoleni zikahulumeni zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza izifundo zibe zikhuthazayo, zibe nezifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zamanje. Izifundo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezokuphila zibalulekile ukuze abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi bazobhekana nani emhlabeni.
