Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Emadolobheni: Ukubuyekezwa Emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, izinkinga zemigwaqo ziba yinkinga enkulu, ethinta izimpilo zabantu nsuku zonke. Imigwaqo emibi, ukungabikhona kwemigudu efanele, kanye nezithuthi eziningi zenza kube nzima ukuhamba kahle. Lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima, ezithinta umnotho, impilo, kanye nezinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ukungabikhona Kwezimali Zokwakha Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokungabikhona kwezimali ezanele zokwakha nokugcina imigwaqo. Izikhungo eziphezulu zihlala zikhuluma ngokuqinisa umnotho, kodwa uma izimali zingekho, imigwaqo iyahluleka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo eziningi zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengokuphuka kwemigwaqo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Abantu bahlala bephazamiseka, futhi lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu nabaholi. Ukukhula Kwezithuthi Okwesibili, ukukhula kwezithuthi emadolobheni kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokuthuthela emadolobheni, izimoto zanda, kodwa imigwaqo ayikhulumi. Lokhu kudala izimo zokuhamba ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba isikhathi eside ukuze bafike ezindaweni zabo. Izithuthi eziningi zikhuphula izinga lokungcoliswa komoya, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Abantu bahlushwa yizifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo eziphusile. Ukungabi Nezinhlelo Zokuhamba Ngempumelelo Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nezinhlelo zokuhamba eziphumelelayo kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Imigwaqo eminingi ayinazo izimpawu ezicacile, okwenza kube nzima kubashayeli nabahamba ngezinyawo. Lokhu kuholela ezimweni ezimbi, lapho abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezibalulekile, njengezikhungo zezempilo, izikole, nezindawo zokusebenza. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhamba, ezihlanganisa izithuthi zomphakathi, ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kanye nezithuthi ezincane. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Imigwaqo Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okubi. Kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze sithuthukise imigwaqo, kudingeka ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izinhlelo eziphusile zokwakha. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha imigwaqo emisha, ukulungisa leyo esivele ikhona, kanye nokwakha izindawo zokupaka ezanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngezithuthi zomphakathi ezisebenzayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezithuthi ezisemigwaqweni. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Kubantu, kubalulekile ukuba babe nesandla ekuthuthukiseni izimo. Ukuze sithuthukise imigwaqo, abantu kufanele babambisane nohulumeni. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezinkinga ezikhona, kanye nokubamba imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezixazululo. Umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu behlanganyela, izinguquko zingenzeka. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemigwaqo emadolobheni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukuthuthukisa imigwaqo akusizi kuphela abantu, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa umnotho, impilo, kanye nezinga lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imigwaqo yethu iyasebenza, iphephile, futhi iyathandeka. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha amadolobha angcono, ahlanzekile, futhi anempilo.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni - Ingxoxo Ngenkathi Yamanje Umkhiqizo Wengxoxo: UMalusi Ndlovu, Umhloli Wezombusazwe UMalusi Ndlovu, umhloli wezombusazwe, uveza izinkinga ezikhona kuhulumeni, ikakhulukazi mayelana nenkohlakalo. Kulolu hlelo, sizama ukucacisa izindaba ukuze abahleli bezepolitiki nabantu abavamile baqonde kahle lesi simo. Umlando Wenkohlakalo: UMalusi uthi, "Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, inkohlakalo ibiyinkinga enkulu ezweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibonakale ikakhulukazi kuhulumeni. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi nakuba imithetho nezinqubomgomo zikhona, zihluleka uma abaphathi bengenalo ulwazi olufanele noma izifiso ezinhle." Ubufakazi Bezinkinga: UMalusi uthi, "Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi inkohlakalo ithinta izinsiza zomphakathi, imfundo, nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezempilo, okuholela ekutheni izifundo zibe nzima, njengoba izinsiza ziba buthakathaka." Izizathu Zokwanda Kwenkohlakalo: UMalusi ubuza, "Ingabe sikhuluma ngempilo engalungile yokuphatha, ubuholi obungalungile, noma izinhlelo eziphakeme? Yebo, zonke lezi zinto zikhona. Ubugebengu bezombusazwe baziwa ngokuthi 'kuhlanga lesinyama,' okwenza izinto zibe nzima. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngenxa yalesi simo." Imiphumela Yokuhulumeni: UMalusi uthi, "Njengoba inkohlakalo ikhula, abantu bayakha ukungathembeki. Lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni, ukungaboni ngaso linye, nokwehla kokwazisa phakathi komphakathi. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi abaphathi bahlolwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinsiza zithinta kanjani impilo yabo." Izixazululo Zokuqeda Inkohlakalo: UMalusi ubonisa ukuthi, "Kubuhlungu kodwa kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi baziwa, bayahlolwa, futhi banelungelo lokubika. Ukwandisa imithetho eqinile kuzohlinzeka ngokuqondwa nokubika kwezinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele kube nezinkampani ezingathathi hlangothi ezizomelene nezinselelo." Ikhono Lokuthola Usizo: UMalusi uthi, "Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi banamalungelo okubika izigameko zokukhwabanisa, futhi kufanele banikwe ithuba lokwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezivumela ukufinyelela kumaphoyisa kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlola okuhle." Isigaba Sokugcina: UMalusi ubonisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekulweni nenkohlakalo kuhulumeni. Akagxili kuphela kumaphuzu, kodwa uzama ukusiza abanye futhi akhuthaze umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinguquko. Inkohlakalo ibambelela emphakathini, kodwa ngokuhlanganyela, ukuzimisela, nemizamo yokuphatha, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ikota: Umqondo Wokuhlala Ngaphandle Kwezithiyo Ikota, igama elikhiqiza imizwa ehlukene kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke. Ezweni elikhulayo, ikota iyinkomba yokuphila, imisebenzi, nezifiso zethu. Nakuba ikota ingase ibonakale ingathandeki, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele sazi ukuthi ikota ayisiyona nje indawo yokuhlala; iyisikhala sokwakha ubudlelwane. Uma sicabanga ngalezi zindawo, sikhumbula imiphakathi ehlukene, izinkolo, nezinkolelo ezahlukene. Ikota iyindlela yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokwakha umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ibalulekile ekwakheni izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izitolo, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, ikota ibonisa izinkumbulo ezimnandi. Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi ngikhula, ikota yami yayigcwele izinsuku ezijabulisayo, lapho sabelana khona ngezikhathi ezinhle nomndeni nabangane. Lezi zikhumbuzo zikhombisa ukuthi ikota akuyona nje indawo yokuhlala, kodwa iyindawo yokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ukukhumbula lezi zikhathi kusinika amandla okwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngezinkinga ezihambisana ne ikota. Ezinye izindawo ziye zaba nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengezinga eliphezulu lokuhlala, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungabi nankinga, nokungahambi kahle komnotho. Nokho, lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa uma sikhuluma ngokubambisana. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala. Ikota iyindlela yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Uma sithola isikhathi sokuhlangana, sithola ithuba lokuxoxa, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Uma singahlangani, sithola ukuthi sihlukaniswe, okungaholela ekutheni sibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ikota nayo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Izindawo ezithuthukile zinezinsiza eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukwakha imisebenzi, nokukhulisa umnotho. Uma ikota ithuthukiswa, abantu bathola amathuba amaningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphila okungcono, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ikota ingaba yindawo yokwakha ubuciko. Izindawo eziningi zinezindawo zokubukisa, izinkundla zokudlala, nezikhungo zamasiko, okwenza kube lula ukuveza ubuciko bethu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokwakha, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ubuciko buvuselela imizwa, bukhuthaza abantu, futhi budala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, ikota iyindawo yokwakha ikusasa. Uma sikhuluma ngekota, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sikhuluma ngekusasa lethu. Ukuthuthukisa ikota yethu kusho ukuthi sithuthukisa ikusasa lethu. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, ikota ayisiyona nje indawo yokuhlala; iyisikhala sokwakha ubudlelwane, izinkumbulo, nomnotho. Ngiyavuma, ikota inezinkinga, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo kuyisihluthulelo sokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono, lapho wonke umuntu engaba khona. Masibambisane, sithuthukise ikota yethu, futhi sakhe umphakathi onempilo, onobudlelwano obuqinile, nezinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ikota yethu ingaba yindawo yokukhula, yokuphila, nokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Lokhu kufanele kube yinjongo yethu sonke.
Izindlu Zomphakathi: Ingxoxo Nezidingo Zomphakathi Umqondisi: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokubambisana nathi namuhla. Ngifuna ukuxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile – izindlu zomphakathi. Ngabe unganginika umbono wakho ngokubaluleka kwezindlu zomphakathi emphakathini wethu? Umphakathi: Sanibonani! Ngiyabonga futhi ngalesi sikhathi. Izindlu zomphakathi zibaluleke kakhulu. Zisiza abantu abaningi abafuna indawo yokuhlala, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali eyanele ukuze bathenge izindlu. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, indawo yokuhlala ibalulekile ekwakheni impilo enempilo. Umqondisi: Ngempela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlu zomphakathi zidingeka kwi-eco­nomy nabantu. Zikuphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezinhlaka zokwakha lezi zindlu? Umphakathi: Kuneziningi. Okokuqala, izinsiza zihlala ziphansi – uma sikhuluma ngezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwakha. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemali kubangela izinhlelo zokwakha zihlale sezibhujiswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ziningi zidinga ukuhamba phambili nezidingo zezakhamizi, ezivame ukungabi lula ukuziqonda. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zomphakathi zingathuthukiswa kanjani? Umphakathi: Yebo, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile. Umphakathi kufanele uthumele izicelo nezidingo zabo ukuze izinhlelo zibe yimpumelelo. Futhi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza ezivela endaweni kungadambisa izindleko. Uhlelo kufanele lube nezindlela zokuhlola impumelelo ukuze kube nezenzo ezilungile. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kulungile. Ngabe unakekela isimo sokuhlala esikhona? Yikuphi okukhathazayo kulokhu? Umphakathi: Yebo, ngikhathazekile ngezindawo eziningi ezibikwe njengezindlu zomphakathi. Kwezinye izindawo, izindlu zikhula kakhulu, futhi kubonakala sengathi zikhula ngokushesha kunokuthi ziqhubeke zisebenze ngempumelelo. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga zokubonakala kokuphila, ngezinye izikhathi ezindaweni ezithandwa abantu. Umqondisi: Lokho kuyinkinga enkulu. Kuthinta kanjani izakhamizi ezihlala kulezi zindawo? Umphakathi: Izakhamizi zikhathazekile kakhulu. Uma izindlu zingalungile, lokhu kuthela izandla ezingekho emthethweni, lokhu kuveza izinkinga zempilo kanye nezinye izinkinga zomphakathi. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubuhlungu phakathi kwesimo sabo kanye nesimo sezimo ezandleni. Umqondisi: Ngabe kunendlela ethile yokuxazulula lezi zinkinga? Umphakathi: Ngikholelwa ekutheni indlela yokuxazulula lezi zinkinga kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Ukuhlanganyela kwabo kubalulekile; izihlalo zomphakathi zokwakha zidinga ukusizwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele ahehlela izinhlelo ezithuthukayo ukuze kuphumelele ukufunda ngempilo yendawo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuveza umbono ophakeme. Kuze kube manje, unayo imisho yokugcina okufanele uyiphephe? Umphakathi: Yebo, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi izindlu zomphakathi ziyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sinemithwalo engama kuleli. Uzokwazi ukusisiza uma ukhona nesiyaziyo. Ngakho-ke, ngicela abantu ukuba bahlale bezivakashela izidingo zomphakathi, kuphumelele ukufaka izwi labo, bese sikhuthaza uhlelo lwezindlu ezithuthukayo. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi, futhi ngiyabonga ngemicabango yakho ecacile mayelana nezindlu zomphakathi. Yilokhu okudingeka ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga futhi, ngithemba lokuthi lezizwi zizokhuthaza abanye. Futhi, kuzofanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzwana kwemiphakathi kusebenza lapho kanjani.
Ukushoda KweMithi Ezibhedlela Ezweni elikhaliphile, lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kuhlangabezana nezingxoxo zansuku zonke, kwakukhona umphakathi ophilayo ogama lawo linguMkhukhwini. Le ndawo yayidume ngothando lwayo lwezempilo, abantu baziwa ngokulalela imiyalelo yezokwelapha, bagcizelela ukuhlinzwa nobuchwepheshe bokwelapha. Nokho, kube kwenzeka okuthile okwehlela wonke umphakathi, okwaholela ekudabukeni. Okwakukhanya kulobu busuku, uDkt. Mthembu, udokotela owayengumholi wezempilo endaweni, wagcotshwa nguMnumzane Nkosi, umphakathi waziwa ngensiza enhle. UPhethakele, owaziwa ngabazali, wacela imishanguzo eminingi, kodwa imiphumela yalesi simo yathokozisa umphakathi. "Rhoqo, sishodayo emithini," kuphetha uDkt. Mthembu ngaphambi kokubona uhla olwaludlulisiwe phakathi labantu. Kwathi lapho umakhishi esukuma lapho engazi, uDkt. Mthembu washaywa yiphupho elingalindelekile. Ubuso bami babunokukhathazeka, futhi umoya omubi wawugubha izibhedlela. Abantu babebukeka bekhononda, bebona ulimi lwemithi oluphezulu, kwabe sekucacile ukuthi izibhedlela zazingatholi imithi eyanele. Uhlanga loyisa, umama uThandi, owayevame ukusiza abantwana abakudinga ukwelashwa, wayeboshwe ngokuqinisekile. “Ngiyazama ukugcina izingane zethu ziphilile, kodwa imithi ayitholakali,” echelekea nohudo, ubuhlungu bepulazi bukhula kuma visis, bokuphila kwethu. Ukuze siqonde kangcono lokhu, wanquma ukuhlola, afikele lezinyanga zekhaya ngobubele babo. Kodwa kunokubheka phansi, abathandi bezehlisa kabuhlungu beseya emithini. Kwasungulwa umoya omusha. Njengoba elihamba, uMnumzane Nkosi wabhala phansi wonke amanqaku, nyanya kaphethandaba zindatshana ezidingekayo. Ngokwenzeka, kubonakala ukuthi umphakathi uhamba phambili emphakathini nakubantu abampofu. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela umcabango omusha owaqala ukuba nempilo. UJeff, umhlekazi wamakhaya, wagxila ekutheni umphakathi udinga ukwakha izinsiza ezinokuthengiswa kwesikhathi eside. “Kham phaya, umphakathi kufanele ulungise umphakathi. Mhlawumbe singenza izifundo zokwelapha ukuze sithole isimiso esihle,” waqhamukela. Lokhu kudala isimanga ezweni, kwavuma ukukhanya kokufuna impilo ephilayo. Kwathi emva kwezinsuku eziningana, kwavuka umoya olandela onobuchwepheshe. Umphakathi wabamba imihlangano yokuhlola izinkinga, lokhu kwaphumelela futhi kwaqala ukufakazela i-ejenti ezindaweni ezinxephezelayo. Omakhalekhukhwini babezithokozile ngokukwazi ukuphila kahle, umphakathi wasaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuphuma emthonjeni. Uhlanga lwezokwelapha lwaqala ukwakha izinsiza ezithintekayo, izindlu zesikole zaguquka izikhungo zokwelapha, uDkt. Mthembu waze wathola izinsiza ngendlela ezikhokhelwayo, kanti uhulumeni wanika isandla. Ngaphezu kokuba nemithi, abantu baqala ukufunda indlela yokuziphilisa. Uthando lwezokwandisa umphakathi lukhula njalo, luzolisa kahle. Umoya osemqoka wawuwukukhumbula ukuthi imithi ngaphandle komoya othandweni iyoma. Bazama ukuzinika kahle, okukhanya kwakungamathuba. Ekugcineni, umphakathi waMkhukhwini wathola imithi eyidingekayo, umoya ofuna ukuhamba kahle wakho. Ukushoda kwemithi kwavulelwa umoya wokukwazi ukuphila, indawo yabadlali bezemidlalo ngezithombe zezimoto ezihamba phambili. Ukwakha isimo esiphilayo, umphakathi uyazama, futhi uhulumeni uphumelele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngale ndlela, uMkhukhwini waqala ukuveza umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, owenza impilo ibe ngcono. Futhi ngaphansi kwemigudu, umoya wabahlaseli onobuchwepheshe wawujabulela impilo engcono. Okwangempela, ukushoda kwemithi kwakungumthombo ophilayo wempilo, kwakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi unempilo uma bahlalisana. Ngakho-ke, lesi isifundo sokuthi uma kuvela izinkinga, kumele sithathe isinyathelo sesibili, singashiyi muntu ngaphandle, sikhumbule ukuthi imithi itholakala ezandleni zethu. Umoya kaMkhukhwini uhlala uhamba phambili, ungavumi ukuphuka!
Umbiko Ngemikhankaso YeZindiza eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Izindiza zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla emhlabeni jikelele. E-Ningizimu Afrika, izindiza zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni kwezindawo ezahlukene, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezokuvakasha. Lo mbiko uzogxila ekuthuthukisweni kwezindiza, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nemithelela yazo emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezindiza Eminyakeni edlule, umkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ube nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabagibeli, izinkampani zezindiza zikhulise izinsizakalo zazo, zengeza izindiza ezintsha, futhi zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza. Izinkampani ezinjenge-South African Airways, kulindeleke ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola ulwazi oluhle. Izinkampani Ezihamba Phambili I-South African Airways (SAA) iyinkampani enkulu kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, inezindiza ezihamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-SAA ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, ikakhulukazi ezindizeni ezide. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Mango Airlines, eyaziwa ngokuba nezindleko eziphansi, ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile kubagibeli. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkampani ezincane ezikhula ngokushesha, ezifana ne-FlySafair, ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile ezindizeni ezimfushane. Imithelela Emnothweni Umkhakha wezindiza unomthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthuthukisa imisebenzi, uthuthukisa ukuhweba, futhi ukhuthaza ukuvakasha. Ngokuhamba kwezindiza, izivakashi zifika eNingizimu Afrika, zikhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, njengokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulayo, izindleko eziphezulu zokusebenza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphephile, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye buba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezindiza. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindiza eziphakeme, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezindiza zenza kube lula ukuhamba. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abahambi bathola ulwazi olusheshayo nolunembile. Izinsiza Zokuhamba Izinsiza zokuhamba zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wezindiza. Izikhumulo zezindiza ezifana ne-O.R. Tambo International Airport, Cape Town International Airport, kanye ne-King Shaka International Airport zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu. Lezi zikhumulo zihlala zithuthukiswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, umkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze uqhubeke nokukhula, izinkampani zidinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabanye abathintekayo kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha. Isiphetho Izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu eNingizimu Afrika. Zikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, umkhakha wezindiza ubheke phambili, uqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uhlala unempumelelo, uhlanganisa abantu, futhi uthuthukisa umnotho.
Ezamanzi Nokuhlanzeka: Indaba Yomphakathi Wethu Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eNdlovukazi, idolobha elincane elisemaphandleni. Abantu baphila izimpilo zabo, kodwa babhekana nenkinga enkulu: amanzi. Amanzi ayengatholakali kalula, futhi lapho ethola khona, kwakungahlanzekile, okwakuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu emindenini. UMama Nandi, owesifazane oneminyaka engama-45, wayehlala nomndeni wakhe eduze komfula. Nakuba umfula wawubukeka kahle, uma ubheka phezulu, wawugcwele udoti. Lokhu kwenza uMama Nandi akhathazeke njengoba abantwana bakhe bejolisa emanzini. "Ngabe amanzi lapha ayaphepha?" wayephuza, ehlola ubungozi obubangelwa yilezi zimo. Ngelinye ilanga, uMama Nandi wahlangana noMnumzane Thabo, umholi wendawo onolwazi ngamanzi nokuhlanzeka. "Mama Nandi," esho, "kumele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise isimo samanzi lapha. Amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile empilweni yethu." UMama Nandi wavuma, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kuzodingeka imizamo eminingi. Ngemuva kokuhlangana noMnumzane Thabo, uMama Nandi wanquma ukuhlela umhlangano nomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngendaba yokuhlanzeka. Umhlangano waba yimpumelelo, abantu baphuma bezokhuluma futhi bephakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene. Abanye bavuma ukusiza ekwakheni iziteshi zokuhlanza amanzi, kanti abanye baphakamisa izifundo zokuhlanzeka. Ngesikhathi edlula emihlanganweni eminingi, umphakathi waqala ukuhlela. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo esihle, eqala ukufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa amanzi kahle. "Amanzi awavunyelwe ukuphuma, kodwa kufanele siwasebenzise kahle," wayeshumayela. Ngemva kwesikhathi, umfula waba nokuthula. Abantu baqala ukuhlela izinsiza zokuhlanzeka, futhi izinsiza zokuhlanza amanzi zatholakala. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwenza konke. Umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa, futhi umfula waba nezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo. Abantwana babengejabulile, bejabulisa emanzini ahlanzekile. UMama Nandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona imizamo yabo iyaphumelela. "Siyaphumelela," wayesho, "siyakwazi ukwenza umehluko." Ngemuva kweminyaka, umphakathi waba yisibonelo esihle. Amanzi ahlanzekile ayengumthombo wokuphila, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwenza konke. UThabo, umholi wendawo, waba nesithunzi esihle, futhi abantu bamthanda. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile. UMama Nandi waba nomqondo wokuthi kumele baqhubeke nokufundisa abantwana ngezidingo zamanzini ahlanzekile, ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nesithunzi esihle, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imizamo yokuhlangana ingaguqula izinto. UThabo waba umholi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu bamthanda. Umphakathi waqonda ukuthi ngokuhlanganyela, bangakwenza konke, futhi amanzi ahlanzekile ayengumthombo wokuphila. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangenza umehluko omkhulu.
Osaziwayo: Impilo Yabo Nezinto Abazithandayo Ngabe uyazi ukuthi osaziwayo bahlala kanjani? Kukhona okuthile okukhanga ngempela ngempilo yabo, futhi ngithanda ukukwabelana ngalezi zinto. Ngicabanga ukuthi sonke sithanda ukwazi ukuthi abanye abantu abaziwayo baphila kanjani, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-celebrities. Ngakho, ake sithathe isikhathi sithole ukuthi lezi zinkanyezi ziphila kanjani empilweni yazo. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngempilo yabo yangasese. Abafundi Basenyuvesi Umbuzo 1: Yini eyenza abafundi basenyuvesi bahluke kwabanye? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi bahluke kwabanye ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, baphakathi kweminyaka yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa, lapho behlangabezana nezinselelo ezahlukahlukene. Baphinde babe nethuba lokufunda okuningi, okungabathuthukisa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, kanye nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okuphatha. Lokhu kubenza babe neqhaza elibalulekile emphakathini, njengoba behola izinguquko eziningi ezibhekelele ikusasa. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi basenyuvesi? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimali, isikhathi, nokucindezelwa kokufunda. Abanye bahlupheka ngokungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokukhokhela izifundo, izindleko zokuphila, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isikhathi esithathwa ukufunda, ukwenza imisebenzi, kanye nokuzijabulisa kungaholela ekucindezelekeni. Lokhu kudinga abafundi ukuba bakwazi ukuphatha kahle izinsiza zabo ukuze baphumelele. Umbuzo 3: Abafundi basenyuvesi bangazithuthukisa kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze abafundi basenyuvesi bazithuthukise, kubalulekile ukuthi benze izinhlelo zokuphila ezicacile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda kahle, ukuhlela isikhathi, nokuzibandakanya emisebenzini ehlukene. Ukuze bazithuthukise, bangabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzijabulisa, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Futhi, ukufuna izeluleko kubafundisi noma kubangani kungasiza ekutholeni izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Umbuzo 4: Yini ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi? Impendulo: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi busekelwe ekuxhumaneni nasekuqondeni. Kubalulekile ukuba abafundi bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, izifundo, nezifiso zabo. Ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, kufanele bakhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, benze imihlangano, futhi baphathe izimo ezinzima ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba babe nempilo engcono, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ekufundeni kwabo. Umbuzo 5: Yini abafundi abangayenza ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela yabo yokufunda? Impendulo: Abafundi bangathuthukisa imiphumela yabo yokufunda ngokwenza izifundo zibe nenjongo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusetha imigomo ecacile, ukufunda izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele. Ukuze baphumelele, kufanele bahlale bephuma emakhonweni abo, bahlale bejolise ezintweni ezibalulekile, futhi baphathe izifundo zabo njengomsebenzi obalulekile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele ezivivinyweni nasemiphumeleni yokugcina. Umbuzo 6: Yini edinga ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda ezikoleni? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda ezikoleni, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, ukufundisa izindlela zokuphatha isikhathi, kanye nokwakha imiphakathi yokufunda. Abafundisi, abaphathi bezikole, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa izimo zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bazizwe bejabulile futhi benesithakazelo ezifundweni zabo. Umbuzo 7: Yini eyenza abafundi basenyuvesi babe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi banomthelela omuhle emphakathini ngenxa yokuba neqhaza elikhulu ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa. Bahlala bephakamisa izinhlelo zokuziphatha, ezokwelapha, nezokuxhumana. Ubudlelwano babo nabanye abantu, kuhlanganise nezinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni, buvumela ukuthi benze izinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubenza babe nokwazisa okukhulu emphakathini, futhi balingana nezimo ezikhona. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele abafundi bayikhumbule ngesikhathi sokufunda? Impendulo: Abafundi kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ukufunda akupheli kuphela ezincwadini, kodwa kuthinta impilo yabo yonke. Kubalulekile ukuba bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo, baphathe izifundo zabo ngokuzimisela, futhi bazi ukuthi impumelelo itholakala ngokusebenza kanzima. Ukuzijabulisa, ukuxhumana nabanye, kanye nokuphila impilo enempilo nakho kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Isiphetho: Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bephila empilweni egcwele izinselelo nezithakazelo. Ukuphumelela kwabo akuncike kuphela ezifundweni, kodwa nakubudlelwano, ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, nasekuphatheni izinsiza zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ukuthi banganqoba kanjani izinselelo zabo, benze izinhlelo ezicacile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze baphumelele empilweni nasemsebenzini wabo.
Isigaba 1: Ukuqala Kwendaba Kwakukhona umhlaba ophumelelayo ogcwele ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, lapho abantu bezijabulisa ngezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Phakathi kwalokhu, i-Microsoft yaqala ukuba umholi emhlabeni, idume ngama-software ayo afana ne-Windows ne-Office. Lezi zinhlelo zazakhiwe ngothando, ubuhlakani, nobuchwepheshe, futhi abantu bezithanda kakhulu. UBill Gates, umsunguli we-Microsoft, wayengumuntu ophusile onomqondo ovulekile. Waqala le nkampani ngensimu encane yokuhweba, kodwa ngemizamo yakhe nokusebenza kanzima, wathola indlela yokwakha umphakathi wezemfundo onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba isixazululo ezinkingeni eziningi zomhlaba, futhi wayehlose ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Isigaba 2: Ukukhula Kwe-Microsoft Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, i-Microsoft yakhula kakhulu. Yaqala ukufaka izinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezazenza kube lula kubantu ukusebenza, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. UBill waba nemikhiqizo emisha, eqhubeka ehlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha emakhaya, benza izinto eziningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-Microsoft yaphenduka umphakathi omkhulu wokwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu. Ukukhula kwe-inthanethi kwavula amathuba amasha, i-Microsoft yaba umeluleki wezobuchwepheshe, inikeza izixazululo ezithuthukile ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba. Isigaba 3: Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe Kwenzeka izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. I-Microsoft yahamba phambili ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo emisha, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni i-Cloud computing. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi bagcine idatha yabo endaweni ephephile, futhi bafinyelele kuyo noma kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kwashintsha indlela abantu abakha ngayo, behlola amathuba amasha okusebenza. UBill Gates, nakuba esesondelene nokuthula, wayesathanda ukuhamba phambili. Wayebona ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali eziphakeme, futhi wayefuna ukuthi i-Microsoft ihlale ikhokhela. Ngalesi sikhathi, abanye abantu babekhuluma ngama-robotics, futhi i-Microsoft yaphendula ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa. Isigaba 4: Izinselelo Nezimpumelelo Nokho, njengoba i-Microsoft ikhulile, yayiphinde yabhekana nezinselelo. Ukuncintisana okukhulayo kwabangakhiqizi abaningi, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kwakudinga ukuba i-Microsoft ibe nezinqumo eziphusile. UBill waqala ukuthola ukuthi abanye abaqhamuki bakhuluma ngezinselelo eziphakeme, izinkampani zokuqala zifuna izixazululo eziphusile. Nokho, i-Microsoft yathola amasu amasha. Yaqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ukuze ithuthukise imikhiqizo yayo. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi i-Microsoft ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isigaba 5: Ikusasa le-Microsoft Namuhla, i-Microsoft isemhlabeni wonke, ithuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Abantu balindele ukuthi i-Microsoft iqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, ibanikeze amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. UBill Gates, owayengumholi, usuke ethokozisa abantu ngezixazululo ezintsha ezithuthukisa izimpilo zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwemikhiqizo emisha, ukuhlola amathuba amasha, nokusebenza kuzo zonke izinkalo zempilo, kuveza umbono ohlanzekile we-Microsoft. Ithemba likhona lokuthi lo mholi wobuchwepheshe uzophinde uthuthukise imikhiqizo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomhlaba wonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu badinga kakhulu ubuchwepheshe. Isigaba 6: Isiphetho Ngale ndlela, i-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamandla. Ukusebenza kanzima, ubuhlakani, nobuqotho kudinga ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho, i-Microsoft iyinkanyezi emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe, isikhumbuzo sokuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga izinqumo eziphusile, ukwakha, nokuthuthukisa. Lokhu kudinga ukusungulwa kwemibono emisha ukuze impilo ithuthuke, futhi wonke umuntu athole amathuba alingana. Uhlobo lwezixazululo ezithuthukile ezihlinzekwa yi-Microsoft luyinkanyezi, futhi lokhu kuveza indlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo, bakha ngayo, futhi baphila ngayo. UBill Gates, ngempela, washintsha umhlaba - futhi i-Microsoft iqhubeka ikhulisa izinzuzo zobuchwepheshe emhlabeni wonke.
Ukudla KweSintu: Ubonelo Ngempilo Yethu Namasiko Ezimfundisweni zethu ezenzakalayo, ukudla kwesintu kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yosintu, kungaphezu kokudla nje. Ukudla akugcini ngokugcwalisa isisu; kudinga ukuhamba phambili kwamasiko nemigubho, kube yindlela yokuhlangana phakathi kwezizukulwane. Lokhu kuhambisana nenkolo yethu nokuhlobana, kukhombisa ukuhlonishwa kwemvelo nokuqonda kozulu. Abathandi bokudla kwesintu bavame ukuveza izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokupheka, njengoba izinhlobo zokudla zisuselwa endaweni, izimo zomnotho, kanye nezinhlanga. Umuntu ohloniphekile uMaXaba, oneminyaka engamashumi amathathu, uyinsika yokudla kwesintu endleleni ayiphilayo. Njengobaba nomama, usuka emndenini ophila ngamasiko ahloniphekile. Ngokuphila kwakhe, ukugubha izinsuku ezibalulekile ngezingxenye ezikhethwayo zokudla—lezinye zazo zihlanganisa isijingi sikaMsholozi, umphokoqo, kanye nenhlamvu. Umphokoqo, okungokwenene, kufanele ube yisithako esiyinhloko ekudleni kwesintu. UMaXaba uthe uma bephumule, ungashisa okuphilayo okwenziwe ngeziqhamo ezivela emithini, asanhlambele ukumangala nokuqonda. Lokhu kudla kukhumbuza abahlali balapha ngenhlangano yokukhipha umpheki ngomthombo wokudla okukhulayo. Imvuthuluka yokudla ekhula emaphandleni ibhalwe phakathi kwezincwadi zabo zokupheka. Evame ukufana, uMaXaba ubonisa ubuciko bakhe ekwenzeni ucwaningo, eqoqa izithako ezivela ekhaya, ezafika nezisindayo. Ngakhoke, akukhona nje ukudla kuphela; umphokoqo ungubuhlakani obuhlotshaniswa nomphakathi. UMaXaba uhamba ibanga elide ukudala isiqalo esisha, efundisa abantwana ndawonye imikhuba yokupheka ngendlela yesintu. Ngokuzithokozisa, uMaXaba ujabulela ukupheka ngayo yonke imfudumalo, enza ukuthi abantwana bakhe bazi kahle izithako ezivela emahlathini, okudala uthando lokugcina izimfihlo zokuhlanza. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuvuma iziko, okuholela ekwazini inhlangano engokwenyama kwabantu. Ngokukhuluma ngalokhu, uMaXaba uveza indlela yokuphila ethinta amakhosi nokuhlonipha kabanzi. Ukudla akuphili nje kuphela, kodwa kujabulisa futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezizayo. Imithetho yokudla yesintu imayelana nokuhlanganyela—not just for sustenance, but for togetherness. Lokhu kukhumbuza umphakathi ukujola ngezimo eziningi ezibucayi, kwehluka kwabantu baqonda kahle izizathu zokuhlangana. Ungathola uMaXaba esebenza emzini, nezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, lapho kwaziwa khona ukuthi izinyoni zilethe abantu ndawonye. Umuntu ngamunye unomsebenzi wakhe, ohambisana nemigomo yamasiko. KwaMaXaba, ukuhlanganyela kudinga ukuphila njengebhande eliqinisiwe—eyaziwa njengenhlangano, imihlangano, kanye nezikhathi ezinhle. Ukudla ngoxolo, ukudlia ngezibe, yindlela yokudlulisa izindaba; akushiye amehlo alungile, kodwa kudinga ukufakwe ekudleni. Okwaziyo, umphakathi uveza izinhlekelele, kufanele kube nesikhathi sokuhamba ngaphandle, ubuciko obuphendukayo, lapho umphakathi nenkulu bazi ngosuku lokudla. UMaXaba ubonisa indlela yokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi ohloniphekile, uvule izinkanyezi, ulungisa imigubho yamasiko phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kudla kwesintu kudinga ukuklanywa, njengokukhetha, singahamba phambili neNdlovukazi, kuye ngamaqhuzu aphikisana. Ngokuphetha, ukudla kwesintu akukaze kube ngaphezu kokudla noma imihlangano, kodwa kudinga ukuhlanganyela. UMaXaba ubonisa izinto ezilula, ukulawula izindleko, ukukhumbula umoya wokuhlanganyela, ukugcina umoya ophilayo nezinselelo. Ngale ndlela, sakha isiko lesintu, sibhala izinkumbulo, sithokozisa ukuhlonipha, futhi sakhumbula ukuthi ukudla kwethu, empeleni, kudinga ukuphila. I-akhawunti kaMaXaba ibonisa ukuvumelana kwezinto, ukuhlanganisa i-culinary roots kanye nokuhlonipha izimo zokuphila kwansuku zonke. UMaXaba ungumfanekiso ohlanzekile, ubhukuze izinkanyezi zenkulumo, uveza ubuhlakani bakhe nezindlela zokubamba amacala amasha. Lokhu kudla kwesintu akugcini ngokunambitha, kuthi ifa lethu liqhubeke lihlala kwiDlozi, liqhubeke libhalisa izimo zansuku zonke, ezibhaliswe ezinkumbulweni zempilo yethu.
U-Cristiano Ronaldo: Umqeqeshi Wokuphila Nokuhlala Ekhumbuleka U-Cristiano Ronaldo ungomunye wabantu ababhalela igama elikhulu emlandweni wezokudlala. Uqale ukufaka umqondo obalulekile emhlabeni wonke, kusukela esebenzisa amakhono akhe aphawulekayo enkundleni yezeMidlalo, kuze kube yilesi sikhathi esivamile esikukhulumayo. U-Ronaldo akayena nje umgibeli ophumelelayo, U-Ronaldo ungumfanekiso wokuzimisela, uthando, nesibindi. U-Cristiano, owazalelwa eMadeira, ePortugal, unolwazi oluhlukahlukene lapho izinto ziqala khona. Ukuthola izinkanyezi ezikhaliphile kudinga ukudlula ezishadweni, neminyaka ezinzima. U-Ronaldo waziwa kahle, kodwa lokhu akukhona kuphela ngokokumangalisa kwezinyawo zakhe. Kuqala, izinsuku zokuqala zomsebenzi wakhe zikhombisa ukuthi ukwazi kwakhe ukubhekana nezithiyo ezinzima. Lokhu kudlulisa umyalezo obalulekile – izimpumelelo azivamile, impilo yami idinga ukuzimisela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Ronaldo wafika emhlabeni jikelele ukwaziwa esemqhudelwaneni eyaziwa kakhulu, i-UEFA Champions League. Umdlalo wayo ufake izigaba zomphakathi wezomhlaba ophakathi kwezifundo, owagubha ubuhle bokudlala nezithakazelo zomlando. U-Luka Modric, uLionel Messi, njalonjalo babengabobani kwimikhakha emakhulwini. Nokho, lokho akushayisa phansi ithalente le-Ronaldo, obamba isikhala sakhe ngokucacile. U-Ronaldo ubalulekile engqondweni yezinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo, kodwa ubungqabavu bakhe buphinde ubuye kakhulu ngendlela yakhe yokuphila. Okwamanje, u-Ronaldo akaguquki kuphela emkhakheni wezokudlala, kodwa ubuye abe yisibonelo sezimo zokuphila. Uthwala izikhali ezibalulekile emphakathini, futhi ukwazi kwakhe ukuphinda afunde ngemva kokuhluleka kubalulekile. Ubuwena, uyakwazi ukuvuma ukubaluleka komphakathi, futhi ubukeka ezicini ezibarhu. Hhayi nje ukujabulisa abafundi nokuqinisa abaphambi kwakhe emathubeni, u-Ronaldo usikhumbuza ukuthi impumelelo ingalungiseka kuphela uma uthola ubuhlakani. Inline neziqu zami zomgibeli, kuveze izifundo ezibalulekile eziphuma kuma-Instagram nawo ngemikhosi yempumelelo. U-Ronaldo angowemisebenzi emikhulu, kodwa ubuyela emuva ukuze abuyise emiphakathini. Izimfundiso zakhe zikhuluma ngesibopho, uthando lokudlala, nezifundo zokuphila. Umqondo wekosi ophumelela ayikho emsebenzini kuphela, kodwa ungomoya ophilayo. Lokhu kwakhe okusho u-Ronaldo kwenzeka ngaphambili emiphakathini eminingi, okukhombisa ukuthi akakwenzi ngokwakhe kuphela. Ungakholwa othandweni bezemidlalo, lokhu kubukeka kuhlasela izinkanyezi eziningi. I-Ronaldo, kanye nomphakathi, ukhipha ubudlelwano obuhle nalabo abaphila nempilo ngemiyono. Ngelixa lokuchitha umphakathi, uthuthukisa ubudlelwano bezemidlalo, abavela emakhampasini, kuzo ubudlelwano obuqinile ezintweni ezinkulu. Ukuphila kwakhe kusebenza kahle, futhi lokhu kuzenza kube yindlela enkulu yokuziphatha. Ukuba u-Ronaldo uwe emkhakheni njengoba emzimbeni, unompilo oluningi obhalela izithakazelo zempilo. Lo mgibeli uyabamba into eyabamba umoya wenzima, eningacaceli imeko. U-Ronaldo uzisola, ukhumbuze abanye ukuthi yiphupho eliqhakazile, nokho akuyena osebenzayo ukuze abashaye izinkanyezi. Lolu hlobo luphathelene nezinto ezimnandi eziphelile, owanikeza abanye umoya ochichima. U-Cristiano Ronaldo, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubalulekile ezifundweni zamadokhumenti ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Ngaphandle kokubukeka kwamakhono akhe, ukuphilaongeza ubudlelwano, kulokhu umncintiswano akasakhumbuli kuphela. U-Ronaldo ungomunye wezitha ezikhulu, okubonisa ukuthi ungashintsha indaba yethu. Lokhu phakade kulungiswa uthi: "Uze, ungiphe eyakho ebe ngiyiseduze." U-Ronaldo unobungqabavu bakhe obugqokekayo nezinsuku ezizayo. U-Ronaldo akangabazeki – uyaziwa bukhulu kuphela njengobulembu obunothile, kancane sizoshaya umhlaba. U-Ronaldo ubalulekile empilweni, lohnta uyaziqhenya ngemisebenzi yakhe. Lokhu kuvela emihlweni yesikhathi, emhlabeni ozokwaziwa njengekanjani. Ekugcineni, u-Cristiano Ronaldo ungomunye wababhalayo emhlabeni wezokudlala, umphakathi kumehlo kabani; ubunomoya, yena asenamahloni akhe. Empilweni, usheshisa futhi ungitshana, kodwa ubuyile esiyinhloko. U-Ronaldo usakwazi ukufaka izifundo, nokho ubhalela abantu indaba yabo. Ngahluleka, ngiyafunda, ngiyaphila. Ukuphila kwegazi lakhe kunoMoya ophilayo, nendlela ahlekaya ngayo imisebenzi ehamba phambili, umkhankaso, noguquko olwaqinile. Nokho, indebe iyakuthinta kumazwi ahlakaniphile, sengiyavuma, uCristiano Ronaldo, onqoba, unothando lwezinkanyezi, umkhwezi obungadjwa. Nkulu impumelelo, izitokwe zezinsuku, uphumula ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi. Ngiyabonga, Cristiano, uyinsika, ungumusa, ungumqeqeshi onguMsizi, ungumuntu obalulekile emhlabeni.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvuka Komhlaba Ekuqaleni, kwathi uma usuku luphuma, izulu ladlula kuphiko lwendabuko. Ezindaweni ezihlahleni ezinkulu, abalimisi babezama ukuhlomula emhlabeni, bezama ukuthola umvuzo ophusile. Kodwa-ke, phakathi kwabo kwakukhona ukuguquka. Ama-drone amancane athumele umoya opholile ezindaweni ezikude, akhuluma ngezinto eziningi ezimangalisayo. UThandi, umnumnzane wendawo, wayengakaze abone lokhu. Wayezwa izindaba ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto ezindizayo, kodwa wakhulelwa emhlabeni ophakathi kwembiza yesintu. Waqhubeka nokucabanga: “Kwamanje, amadrone angabe akhuluma ngezinsiza ezilungile?” Isahluko 2: Ubuciko Be-Drone Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wahamba phansi enyameni yakhe, nomoya unothe nogu eliphakeme. Wabhekisa phezulu, lapho ama-drone amaningi ehamba emazulwini, efana nezinyoni ezilukhuni. Ngisho nenkanyezi enkulu, uMbhobho, wayehamba nayo; eqeda ukuhamba okukhulu, ngahamba izinsuku eziningi. Kanye phakathi kwjava, umngani kaThandi, uJabulani, wavula izinyembezi nezincwadi zabantu abahamba phambili kulo mkhakha. "UThandi, umhlaba ushintsha! Lawa ma-drone asinika ithuba lokumbonisa izinto ezinhle zokuqhamuka!" uJabulani akhomba. Wayenokuzimisela, ethanda ukuba ngumqondisi wesikhathi esizayo. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlangabezana Nezinselele Thandi waffle noJabulani bezamile ukufaka ama-drone ezosombulula izinselele zomphakathi. Kwakuyaqhuma izikhala zomhlaba, kodwa uthando lwabo lokufunda lwabe lungapheli. Kodwa izinto zaba nzima. Abanye abantu bendawo babenokungabi nankinga. “Ama-drone azoletha ukuchitha izinsiza. Ngabe sizopholisa imvelo?” babebala izinkinga zabo. UThandi wayefuna ukwazisa ukuthi angaziwa, umoya omusha ubhalwa ngama-drone, eyaqoka ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola nemifino. Isahluko 4: Uhambo Lokuzakhela Ngemuva kwesikhathi, unogada wezinsiza zendawo, uNokuthula, wahlela umkhosi wokwazisa abathandi bendawo mayelana namathuba ama-drone. UThandi noJabulani babebambe iqhaza, benasa ukuthi bangakha ukuthula emphakathini. Uhlelo lwabo lwase lwenziwa yitze ukudala lo mkhosi, kungezwe abathengisi abavela kude. Kwakuwumcimbi omkhulu, kudliswa izinkanyezi, ama-drones edlula phezulu. Kwavulwa iziphepho zenkanyezi, abazali bebafundisa izingane ngezinto zomhlaba ezingezona ezemali. Isahluko 5: Uhambo Lokukhanya Ngesikhathi umkhosi uqala, uThandi wabona ama-drone engaphansi kwansuku zonke, esephiphiza zonke izindawo. “Ngabe lokhu kuhlangene nathi, sivelile?” uJabulani wabuza. UThandi wayezithokozisa, eqonda umbono omusha. Kwaphela ubumnyama emathanjeni, uMbhobho wakhanya, uqhakazile emzini, ekhombisa isibhakabhaka esisha. Ngapha, emakhaya, abantu babebona impela ukuthi ama-drone ayengaphansi okwelakani, ewela phezulu. Isahluko 6: Ukuphila Ngobuchwepheshe UThandi noJabulani, ngemva kokubona izibani zikaMbhobho, bakhumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kuwukuhamba kwesikhathi. Indoda ethokozisayo yokuthuthukisa umhlaba yayigqoke isiqophi. Ama-drone ayenikela ngezinhlanhla ezinhle, futhi umphakathi wahamba phambili. Phakathi kwezinkanyezi, babefuna ukukhipha iziyaluyalu, oJabulani wathi, “Ama-drone akusisiza kanjani, saholeka? Babangazathusi.” “Ukwazisa kuphela!” uThandi wavele wamthanda, “Uhlonze ukwenza ukufunda okukulethe phakade.” Isahluko 7: Umhlaba Omusha Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza, umphakathi wabona izinzuzo, ugqozi lwawuthatha. UThandi noJabulani bahamba phambili, basondela ezindabeni. Izihloko zikaThandi zakhombisa ikamva elihle, lapho ama-drone ahlinzeka khona ngempumelelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNokuthula waphakamisa igama elisha, "UbuMphakathi beTue Technology!" Ngemuva kokukhuluma, izinyoni zabuya nezinja, zihambela phezulu. Umoya wagcwala yize bekufana nezinyoni, umqhudelana waze wabhakabhaka. UThandi waphumula udonga lwakhe, elindele ukusho into ethakazelisayo. "Kuthiwani uma singawuvula umhlaba, sihlangane nezinga lethu?" Ngamafuphi, ama-drone awathathwa nje, kodwa waba yithuba lokuphila, ukuzakha umphakathi, kanye nokukhula ezingeni elisha. Umhlaba ugcwele ithemba, umoya opholile, okuyilokho eyikhumbulayo uThandi.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha - Ingxoxo Ngesikhathi Samanje Isingeniso Namuhla, sijabule ukuba nezingxoxo ezibalulekile mayelana nokukhulelwa kwentsha. Le ndaba ithinta imindeni, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nemiphakathi eminingi. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka izizathu, izinselelo, nezixazululo ezihambisana nalokhu. Sizokhuluma noNksz. Thandiwe Mthethwa, ongumeluleki wezempilo, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Umbuzo: UThandiwe, ungakuchaza kanjani ukukhulelwa kwentsha? Impendulo: Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kubhekisela ekukhuleni kwentsha, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweminyaka yokufunda, ngemuva kokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezokwelashwa, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nemiphumela yokukhulelwa. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izizathu ezivame ukuholela ekukhulelweni kwentsha? Impendulo: Izizathu ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezokwelapha. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ngemithombo yokuvikela. Okwesibili, umphakathi ungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uma intsha ibona abanye bejabulisa ukukhulelwa, bangase bazame futhi. Futhi, izimo zomndeni nezomnotho nazo zidlala indima enkulu. Ingxenye 2: Izinselelo Eziphumelelayo Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha ekhulelwe? Impendulo: Izinselelo ziningi futhi zihluke kumuntu nomuntu. Okokuqala, intsha ekhulelwe ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zezezimali. Ukukhulelwa kudinga izinsiza eziningi, futhi uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka, kubalulekile. Okwesibili, kunokuthola ukuqonda nokwesekwa. Abanye abezwa kahle, bayazithola bephazamisekile, okuholela ekutheni bahlale bodwa, okwenza kube nzima. Umbuzo: Ingabe zikhona izingozi ezithile ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha? Impendulo: Yebo, zikhona izingozi eziningi. Okokuqala, intsha ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kungaholela ezinkingeni zokukhula kwezingane, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengane kanye nezinkinga zokuphila komama. Ingxenye 3: Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokweseka Umbuzo: Yiziphi izixazululo ezikhona ukuze kusizakale intsha ekhulelwe? Impendulo: Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zidingeka ukuze intsha iqonde izindlela zokuvikela. Okwesibili, umphakathi kufanele ube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo, ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuthola usizo. Ukubambisana komndeni kubalulekile; uma umndeni ungasiza, intsha izoba namathuba angcono. Umbuzo: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola usizo oludingayo? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zempilo zibe sezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlanganisa abeluleki abaqeqeshiwe, izikhungo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinsiza ezithile. Umphakathi kufanele uthuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze intsha ikwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ingxenye 4: Umphakathi Nokubambisana Umbuzo: Umphakathi ungaluthola kanjani usizo lwawo ekuxazululeni le nkinga? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elikhulu. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokufundisa, ukuxhumana nezikhungo zezempilo, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu kungasiza. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imithombo yezindaba ibambe iqhaza ekwaziseni umphakathi ngalezi zinkinga. Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lentsha ekhulelwe lingenziwa kanjani libe ngcono? Impendulo: Ikusasa lentsha lingathuthukiswa uma sikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, nezikhungo zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile kuzokwenza intsha ikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ebalulekile esidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokwazi izizathu, izinselelo, nezixazululo, singasiza intsha yethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lentsha yethu.
Uhambo Lwansuku Zonke: Izimpilo Zethu Zansuku Zonke Uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Njengoba sithokozisa izinsuku zethu, sithola ukuthi lezi zinsuku ziqala ngokuhamba. Lokhu kuhamba, kungaba ngezinyawo, ngemoto, ngebhasi, noma ngolunye uhlobo lokuhamba, kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano bethu nemiphakathi esiphila kuyo. Ngokujwayelekile, uhambo lwansuku zonke luqala ekuseni, lapho abantu bephuma ezindlini zabo, bejolise emsebenzini, ezikoleni, noma kwezinye izindawo zokusebenza. Umoya ungena emoyeni, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, futhi umgwaqo ugcwele abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngemoto, nabahamba ngebhasi. Lezi zinsuku ziqala ngokuthokozisa, kodwa zibuye zibe nezinselelo zazo. Abantu abaningi bahlala emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yinkinga. Izithuthi zihlala zigcwele, futhi isikhathi sokuhamba siba sikhulu. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphazamiseka, lapho abantu behamba bejolise emsebenzini, kodwa bephinde bahlale bephikisana nezithuthi eziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale bephapheme, beqaphela, futhi bahlale bejabulile, nakuba izimo zingase zibe nzima. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yithuba lokucabanga. Abantu bangaqonda izinkinga zabo, baphinde bacabange ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuzindla, sokubhala, noma sokulalela umculo. Abanye abantu bathola ukuthi uhambo lwabo luwumsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, lapho bejabulela umculo opholile noma izincwadi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi uhambo lwansuku zonke akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyithuba lokukhula nokuzithokozisa. Uhambo lwansuku zonke luhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abantu abahamba ngebhasi bahlala behlangana, bexoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi bejabulela ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bebonana, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda izifundo ezahlukene, baphinde bahlale beqaphela izimo ezithile. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokufunda izincwadi, ukufunda izindaba, noma ukufunda ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezitholakala emgwaqweni. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo ayipheli, kodwa iqhubeka njalo. Noma kunjalo, uhambo lwansuku zonke akukhona kuphela ukuhamba. Kukhona nezikhathi zokuphumula, lapho abantu behlala bezilungiselela izinsuku zabo. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuphuza ikhofi, sokudla isidlo sasekuseni, noma sokuxoxa nabangani. Lezi zikhathi zibalulekile, ngoba zenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu. Luhlanganisa izimo eziningi, izinselelo, nezikhathi zokujabula. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, nakuba uhambo lwansuku zonke lungase lube nzima, luyithuba lokukhula, lokufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi uhambo lwansuku zonke luyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu.
U-Winston Churchill: Umholi Ohlonishwayo U-Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill, owazalwa ngoJanuwari 30, 1874, eBladen, eNgilandi, waba yisimo esaziwa kakhulu emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba. Impilo yakhe ibiyinsakavukela kakhulu. U-Churchill wayengumuntu ophakeme, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lwezombusazwe. Imfundo yakhe yaqeqeshwa eHarrow School naseRoyal Military Academy eSandhurst, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela impilo yakhe yokuba umholi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, waba ngumsunguli wezomkhosi, ube neqhaza elikhulu ezindaweni eziningi zokulwa, kuhlanganisa eBhulogwa, eMpi yaseNdiya, naseMpi yaseBhulogwa. Lokhu kumfundeza kakhulu, kwaba yisisekelo sokuba abe umholi ophumelelayo. U-Churchill waqala ukungena emkhakheni wezombusazwe ngo-1900, lapho afaka isicelo sokuba uNgqongqoshe weSifunda saseOldham. Waba ngumsunguli weqembu le-Conservative Party, kodwa wathuthela kwezinye izigaba ezahlukene, okwenza waba umholi ohlonishwayo. Ngemuva kokuba esebenza ezikhundleni ezahlukene, ngo-1911 waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezempi, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwa ezasiza iNgilandi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe I. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe I, waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, lapho aphatha khona izinhlelo zokuthutha amasosha, nakuba waphikiswa ngempumelelo futhi wathola izinkinga eziningi. Ngemuva kwempi, u-Churchill waphinde waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, lapho ahola khona izinhlelo ezibalulekile zokwakha umnotho wezwe. Wazisa izinhlelo zokwakha, futhi wayenombono omuhle ngempilo yempucuko. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba, u-Churchill waba nguNdunankulu kaNgilandi ngo-1940, lapho waphakamisa umoya wokulwa, wathi: "Ngizokulwa emakhaya, ngizokulwa ezindlini, ngizokulwa ezilwandle, ngizokulwa ezindaweni eziphakeme." Lezi zisho zaba yizimpawu zomoya wakhe ophakeme, futhi zakhuthaza abantu baseNgilandi ukuba balwe. U-Churchill waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iNgilandi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekunqobeni uHitler, wabambisana nezizwe eziningi, okuhlanganisa neMelika, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba iyaphumelela. Wayengumholi onobuhlakani, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwa. Ngemva kokunqoba kweMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba, u-Churchill waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umhlaba omusha, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi izizwe kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze ziqinisekise ubumbano. U-Churchill wakhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha umhlaba, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni iNhlangano Yezizwe. Waqhubeka nokubhala, wathola umklomelo weNobel Prize for Literature ngo-1953. U-Churchill waba nguNdunankulu kaNgilandi futhi wathola ithuba lokuba nguMongameli weqembu le-Conservative Party. Nokho, waphinde waphikiswa, kodwa wahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme zomphakathi. U-Churchill wafa ngoFebhuwari 24, 1965, kodwa imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni. Wayengumholi ophakeme, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lwezombusazwe. U-Churchill waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uWinston Churchill waba yisithonjana sokuhola, futhi imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni. U-Churchill ungumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka emhlabeni wonke.
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Umphakathi, Umnotho, Nezinkinga Abathengisi basemgwaqeni, noma abathengisi bezimpahla ezithengiswa emgwaqeni, bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu. Lezi zindawo zokuthengisa zihlala zikhanga abantu abaningi, zikhombisa ubuciko bokuphila kwansuku zonke, futhi zenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola indima yabo emphakathini, umnotho, kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Umphakathi Wabathengisi Basemgwaqeni Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Bakhombisa ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izindawo zabo zokuthengisa zihlala zikhangisa imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekudleni okushisayo kuya ezimpahleni ezincane. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba nezinhlobonhlobo zezimpahla ezitholakalayo, okuvumela abantu abahlukene ukuba bathole lokho abakudingayo. Umnotho Wabathengisi Basemgwaqeni Ngokwezimali, abathengisi basemgwaqeni banendima enkulu emnothweni wendawo. Bakhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Abathengisi abaningi baphila ngokuthengisa, futhi lokhu kubanika ithuba lokwakha izimpilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphinde babe nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, njengoba bethengisa imikhiqizo yendawo, okukhuthaza ukuhweba phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Izinkinga Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu abahlangabezana nazo yizithiyo zomthetho. Ezinye izindawo zinezinqubomgomo ezinzima ezivimbela abathengisi ukuthi bathengise emigwaqeni, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhweba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abathengisi bahlale bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi, futhi abanye baphinde bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bephikisana nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Izimo zezulu, izinkinga zokuphepha, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala ziba yizithiyo ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abathengisi babe nekhono lokuphila, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili naphezu kwezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu. Bakhombisa ubuciko bokuphila, benza kube lula ukuthola izimpahla ezidingekayo, futhi banomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Nokho, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo zidinga ukunakwa, ukuze sikwazi ukuvuselela le ndima ebalulekile emphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinzima. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungele ikusasa.
Othisha (Teachers) Umbuzo 1: Yini indima ebalulekile othisha abayidlala ezikoleni? Impendulo: Othisha baphetha indima ebalulekile kakhulu ezikoleni. Bangaphezu kwabafundisi — bayabakhuthaza, bayabakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi banikeza iziqondiso ezibalulekile empilweni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, othisha banikeza abafundi ulwazi oluyisisekelo ezimfundisweni zangempela, ezithinta impilo yansuku zonke. Umbuzo 2: Ngabe othisha banamakhono afanele okwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, othisha kufanele babe namakhono amaningana. Kubalulekile ukuba babe nolwazi olunembile ngezifundo abazifundisayo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu nje, kufanele bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zifundo ngendlela ethokozisayo. Lokhu kudinga amakhono okukhulumisana, ukuzwelana, kanye nekhono lokuphatha izifundo ngendlela ehlelelekile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenza uthisha abe muhle kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe? Impendulo: Uthisha omuhle ushayela abafundi abakhe, ubalalela futhi ubakhuthaza, ungabasi ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokufundisa. Abanawo ubuciko kuphela, kodwa futhi bayazwela futhi baliyithokozisa imfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esinokuthula nesokubambisana esigabeni sokufunda. Umbuzo 4: Othisha badinga ukusizakala ngani ukuze bakwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini wabo? Impendulo: Othisha badinga ukuxhaswa kahle nothalamali, izinsiza ezifanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yemfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abafundi ngempumelelo futhi bagcine besebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, badinga ukuhamba phambili kuhlelo lokufunda ukuze bahlale bephile kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo othisha abahlangabezana nazo? Impendulo: Othisha bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinsiza ezibuthakathaka, izikhalazo ezivela kubafundi, kanye nezimo zempilo ezingezinhle. Izinselelo ezithinta umsebenzi wabo zidinga ukusizwa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye nophenyo olujulile lokukwazi ukuphuma kumatasa. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ukujwayela kwezinkolelo zomphakathi kudinga ukufundwa ngothisha? Impendulo: Yebo, othisha badinga ukuqonda izinkolelo zomphakathi ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhloniphekile phakathi kwabo nabafundi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze babhale izinhlelo zokufundisa ezimfanele nezihambisana nezimo zomphakathi. Ukujanji okukhulekile nokuhloniphayo ukuze kubunjwe umphakathi ovumelanayo. Umbuzo 7: Yini iyunivesithi edinga ukuyihlonipha ukuze ifundise othisha? Impendulo: Iyunivesithi kumele iphathe izifundo ezinhle, imfundo ecacile, futhi ibenze bekhuthazwe ukuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngokufanayo, izinhlelo ezifanele zokuxhaswa kothisha kumele zigcinwe, kanti ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili kufanele buphothulwe ngamafunda. Lokhu kuzokwakha uthisha onekhono futhi olandelwayo emsebenzini wakhe. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe othisha badinga ukuphathwa isikhathi sabo ngendlela ethile? Impendulo: Impela, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi kubalulekile. Othisha kumele balungiselele izifundo zabo kahle; lokho kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufunda eziphumelelayo. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi kuyasiza ukwenza ukuthi uthisha abeke imigomo ethile futhi ahlelwe kakhudlwana ezinsukwini ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthisha akwazi ukuphatha izifundo nabafundi ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 9: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba othisha babe nokuqonda okujulile kwezithombe zomphakathi? Impendulo: Ukuqonda izithombe zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuphatha izifundo ngendlela ehlangabezana nezidingo zebhodi abahlanganyela nazo. Lokhu kubafundisa ukuthi ukuthi imfundo ingabantu bonke, hhayi abagcina phansi kuphela. Othisha, uma bejwayele imvelaphi nabantu, kungcono kuhlinzeke izifundo ezithokozisayo nabafundi bazo ongalokothi bahlupheke. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izindlela othisha abangazisebenzisa ukuze bathuthukise imisebenzi yabo? Impendulo: Othisha bangakuthuthukisa umsebenzi wabo ngokuqhubeka befundisa ngezinqubo ezintsha nezisusa enhliziyweni, ukufunda ezintweni ezintsha ezifana nezinhlelo ze-inthanethi, futhi ukuzama ukufaka izinyathelo zokufunda ezikhethekile ngabafundi. ukuphila komphakathi kuyakha ubudlelwano obwanele phakathi kothisha nabafundi, okuwukuphepha kwengqondo kokudlula kwezemfundo. Ngapaqontshi, othisha bakhulu ngosizo abaluthola ezikoleni nakweminye imikhakha yokuphila muyani eqinile emiphakathini njengabafundisi nabalimi bemihla. Othisha bayinsika enkulu yokwakha isizukulwane esisha esiqinisekile, esinobuchwepheshe, nendawo yokusesha imfundo engapheli, okwenza imiphakathi ifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu.
### Ukuzivocavoca: Umgomo Wokuphila Okunempilo Isingeniso Ukuzivocavoca, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-fitness ngesiNgisi, kubalulekile ekuphileni okunempilo. Ngaphandle kokuzivocavoca, singabhekana nezinkinga eziningi zokuphila. Ukuze sithole izinzuzo zokuzivocavoca, kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi ziwusizo kanjani empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo Zokuzivocavoca Okokuqala, ukuzivocavoca kuthuthukisa impilo yamasosha omzimba, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umzimba ekuguleni. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulu ezimweni ezifana ne-diabetes ne-high blood pressure, lapho umzimba onempilo ungakwazi khona ukumelana nezifo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba phambili kwezinto ezinjenge-hormone, ezifana ne-adrenaline ne-endorphins, ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, kwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle nsuku zonke. Futhi, ukuzivocavoca kulethe izinzuzo zempilo engokwengqondo. Ukusebenza kwemizwa, ukucindezela, kanye nokugxila kwengqondo kuthuthukiswa uma uzivocavoca njalo. I-Endorphins, ethulwa ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, idlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni kube nokuthula nokucabanga okuhle, okuholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukugxila emisebenzini yabo futhi babe nenjabulo. Uhlobo Lokuzivocavoca Kunezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuzivocavoca, okungafaka phakathi ukuhamba, ukudlala imidlalo, ukwenza i-yoga, noma ukusebenzisa izinsiza zokuzivocavoca. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhlobo lokuzivocavoca luhlobene nezinga lokuphila, isikhathi sokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemisipha, ukuhlola imisebenzi yokuphila, nokusebenza kwezinsizakusebenza. Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukuziqhenya Ukuze ube nomkhuba wokuzivocavoca, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Hlela isikhathi: Thola isikhathi sokuzivocavoca nsuku zonke. 2. Khetha uhlobo lokuzivocavoca: Khetha okuthandayo ukuze ujabulele. 3. Zibophezele: Sebenzisa abanye ukuze nikuthokozise. 4. Faka udizayini: Dala imihlangano ehlukene ukuze ugcine intshiseko. 5. Qapha ukuthuthuka: Bheka ukuthi uthuthuka kanjani ukuze ugcine umoya ophakeme. Ukuzivocavoca Nezimo Zempilo Ngezinye izikhathi, ukufinyelela emgqeni wokuzivocavoca kungaba nzima ngenxa yezimo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthola iseluleko kumuntu osezingeni eliphezulu, njengodokotela, uma uthanda ukuqalisa noma uma unezinkinga ezithile. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuhamba phambili Ukwazi ukuthi kudingeka imizamo eyengeziwe noma ubuchwepheshe obungaphezulu ukuze ufeze izinhloso zakho, kubalulekile. Izinhlelo ezichwepheshile zingaba usizo kakhulu. Ukuphetha Ukuzivocavoca akukhona nje umsebenzi; kuyindlela yokuphila egcwele izinzuzo. Ukujabulisa, ukuhlela, nokuphila kahle kuncike ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. Zama ukuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuzivocavoca ukuze uthole okuhambisana nawe. Ngakho, thokozisa umzimba wakho, uqhubekele phambili, futhi uthuthukise impilo yakho!
Osomabhizinisi: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, emhlabeni wonke, osomabhizinisi babenobuhlakani obuhlukile, bephila ezikhathini ezinzima, kodwa bephinde babe nezinselelo eziningi. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkampani ezinkulu, abantu babengosomabhizinisi abancane, bephila ngokuhweba ngezimpahla ezincane, izithelo, nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha umnotho, futhi kwaba yindlela yokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi waqala ukujula. Emazweni amaningi, abantu baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Uhlelo lwezohwebo lwakha izimakethe, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkampani ezinkulu ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola imikhiqizo abayidingayo. Ngokubheka emlandweni, uHenry Ford ungomunye wabasunguli abaziwayo. Waqala imboni yokukhiqiza izimoto, futhi wathuthukisa indlela yokukhiqiza eyaziwa ngokuthi i-assembly line. Lokhu kwashintsha indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, kwavula amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, futhi kwakhuthaza abanye osomabhizinisi ukuba baphinde baphumelele. UFord waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, eNingizimu Afrika, osomabhizinisi baye bahlala bebalulekile emlandweni. USolomon Tshekisho Plaatje, owaziwa njengomlobi, umbhali, nomphakathi, waba nesandla ekwakheni umqondo wosomabhizinisi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama. Waqala imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bazimele. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokwakha osomabhizinisi abasha, ababephikisana nezithiyo eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi wathuthuka, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izinkampani ezinkulu ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene. URichard Branson, umnikazi we-Virgin Group, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emhlabeni wezohwebo. Waqala ibhizinisi lakhe elincane, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wakhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe laba yinkampani enkulu. UBranson waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukwakha imiphakathi emisha, futhi baphinde baphumelele ezimakethe ezinzima. Kodwa-ke, osomabhizinisi abavumi ukuhamba kalula. Bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi, ezifana nezomnotho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni. Lokhu kubenza bahlale bephokophele phambili, befuna izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi labo. USteve Jobs, owasungula i-Apple, waba nesandla ekwakheni imikhiqizo emisha, futhi wathuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukushintsha umhlaba ngezinto ezintsha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi uqhubekile nokukhula. Namuhla, sikhona isizukulwane esisha sabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abaqala amabhizinisi amancane, bephinde bephakela izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umqondo wosomabhizinisi awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhamba phambili nezikhathi. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bebalulekile emnothweni, futhi baphinde babe nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Bakhuthaza abantu ukuba bazimele, baphinde bakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Umhlaba wethu udinga osomabhizinisi abavuma izinselelo, abaphokophele phambili, futhi abashintshe umhlaba ngendlela engcono. Ekugcineni, indaba yosomabhizinisi iyindaba yokuphila, yokuzimisela, nokwakha. Iphakamisa umoya wokuphumelela, futhi ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinselelo zingaba zinkulu, osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephumelela, futhi benza umehluko emhlabeni. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umqondo wosomabhizinisi awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhamba phambili nezikhathi. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bebalulekile, futhi umhlaba udinga abantu abanjalo ukuze uqhubeke phambili.
Ukuqashwa Kwamathuba Emisebenzi: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane, abantu babengakaze bacabangele ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi ngendlela esiyiqonda ngayo namuhla. Umphakathi wawuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinzima, lapho abantu bejolise kakhulu ekutholeni ukudla, ukuvikeleka, kanye nezidingo eziyisisekelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, imisebenzi yayihlobene kakhulu nezimboni ezithile, njengezokulima, ezokwakha, kanye nezokuhweba. Abantu babebamba izikhundla ezithile, kodwa imisebenzi yayincane, futhi izinga lokuqashwa belingaphansi kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba wathuthuka. Ngemva kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika, njengelinye lamazwe amaningi, laqala ukubona ushintsho olukhulu. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izimboni, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukuthola imali, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, lapho abantu beqonda khona ukuthi kufanele bazithuthukise ukuze baphumelele. Ngalesi sikhathi, izikhungo zemfundo zaba yizikhungo ezibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abantu. Izikhungo zokufunda zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda amakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphatha. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha emisebenzi, futhi abantu baqala ukuthola izikhundla eziphakeme. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile, futhi abantu baqala ukucabanga ngempumelelo yabo, baphinde baphokophele emisebenzini ethuthukayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zaba nezidingo ezithile. Zafuna abantu abaneziqu, abanolwazi, nabakhono. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuhola, lapho izinkampani ziqasha abantu abaneziqu ezithile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izisebenzi ezikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukufuna abantu abaneziqu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, lapho izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokufundisa, zokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izikhundla eziphakeme, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga labo lokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukufuna abantu abaneziqu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, lapho izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokufundisa, zokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izikhundla eziphakeme, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga labo lokuphila. Namuhla, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Abantu bahlala befuna amathuba okuthuthukisa amakhono abo, futhi izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuhola ezithuthukayo. Ukuphepha Kwamalungu Emiphakathini Ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaphila, uyasebenza, futhi uyazizwa ephephile. Lokhu kuphakamisa izinga lempilo, kuthuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuqinise umphakathi. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngalesi sihloko, sizobheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphepha, izingozi ezikhona, nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuphepha emiphakathini. Izici Ezinomthelela Ekuphepheni Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta ukuphepha kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimo zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezepolitiki. Uma umphakathi unokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma umphakathi uhlangabezana nezinkinga ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezingozi, njengokweba noma udlame. Izingcuphe Nezingozi Izingozi ezithinta ukuphepha kwabantu zingahlukaniswa zibe izigameko eziphuthumayo nezimo ezijwayelekile. Izigameko eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezinhlekelele zemvelo (njengezikhukhula noma imililo), zidinga izinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokuphendula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo ezijwayelekile, ezifana nokweba, udlame, noma ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, zidinga izixazululo ezinzima ezibandakanya ubuholi bomphakathi, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuphepha Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu mayelana nezokuphepha kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izifundo zokuvikela, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bangakwazi ukuzivikela futhi baphendule kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile kubalulekile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphephile, ukwandisa izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya umphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi banendawo ephephile yokuhlala, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu emiphakathini yabo. Ubudlelwano Bomphakathi Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu emiphakathini busemqoka ekwakheni ukuphepha. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imihlangano yomphakathi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bejabulela ubudlelwano obuhle, bazoba nesifiso sokuvikela umphakathi wabo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zomthetho Ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuphepha. Izikhungo zomthetho, ezifana namaphoyisa, zidinga ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izikhungo zomthetho zisebenza nabo, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umphakathi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle, ubudlelwano obuhle, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudala imiphakathi ephephile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ephephile futhi enelungelo lokuphila impilo egculisayo. Ukuphepha akuyona nje indaba yomuntu ngamunye, kodwa kuyindaba yomphakathi wonke.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqhamuka Kwefa U-Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa, umholi onothile, wayezalwa ngo-17 kuMfumfu, 1952, eSoweto, eGoli. Umphefumulo wakhe waseSoweto wathola ubuholi bokuqala ngesikhathi engumfana omncane. Uthando lwezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ibhola, lwamphusha ukuba abe nomfanekiso ophelele wesikhumbuzo somphakathi. Wangena eNyuvesi yaseThekwini ukuze aqhubekele phambili ngomsebenzi wakhe, lapho athola khona iziqu zeziko lezomthetho. Ubuye waba ngumholi weqembu labafundi, ethola izifundo zokuhola phakathi kwenkululeko. Isahluko 2: Izikhumbuzo Zomzabalazo Ngaphansi kukaMengameli u-Apartheid, u-Ramaphosa waba nelungelo lokuzimela kwezombusazwe. Wasungula iNational Union of Mineworkers ngo-1982, ethuthukisa izimfuno zabantu basebenza emigodini. Waba yilungu elikhulu emzaneni, ehambisa izwi leshmba ezinsukwini ezinzima. U-Ramaphosa wajabulela ukuqhubekisela phambili imizabalazo yokukhululeka nokuqhakambisa amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, amashumi eminyaka edlule, uhlanga lwakhe lwashaya emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Isahluko 3: Umoya Wokwakha Ngemuva kokuphothula umzabalazo ngempumelelo, u-Ramaphosa waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kweSivumelwano seKhawunti yePhalamende ngo-1994. Uhambo lwendaba ye-ANC lwamnika ukudonswa kwabantu abaningi, ulethe umoya wezinhloso eziphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba ngumphakathi ophumelela kakhulu njengomphakathi ophethe izikhwama zezimali, ubeka izindawo eziningi zokusebenza. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga Lokuphumelela Ngemuva kokusebenza emkhakheni wezomthetho, u-Ramaphosa waqala ukufaka izinyathelo zempumelelo emkhakheni wezomnotho. Waba yinsika yebhizinisi, efaka izimali ezinkulu ezinzulwini zamabhizinisi. Uqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kokuhweba phakathi kokuhlanga, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banethuba lokwakha. Waziwa njengomholi onomsebenzi, owazalayo ngobunhlangothi bokuphila kahle. Isahluko 5: UBusisiwe Bokubusa Ngo-2018, u-Ramaphosa wathola ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokuphatha njengomengameli. Ubuye waba umholi ophakamisa izinjongo zomphakathi. Wayesebenza njengomfundi onothile emkhakheni wezokucebisa, eqinisekiswa ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Waqhubeka efundisa abantu ukunemba nokukhululeka, ebhizinisi, futhi ewusizo kumphakathi. Isahluko 6: Ukubukela Phambili U-Cyril Ramaphosa uphinde wathokozisa umphakathi ngokuphatha kokunga, efaka izinyathelo zokuphila kahle kwabaningi. Emagqumeni ezintweni ezinzima, uphishekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ukuvuselela isitoko sokuqasha, nokwakha imisebenzi. Umazisi wakhe ubonisa ubuholi obunomgomo, okwenziwa ngothando nomfutho, ngale ndlela ezokwenza ube ngumholi owaziwayo emhlabeni wonke. Isahluko 7: Ubulungiswa Obunokuthula U-Ramaphosa uhlola imiphumela yokusebenza ngenhlonipho kubantu bakhe. Ubuholi bakhe bukaqhubeka nobumbano, nempumelelo ye-South Africa ikakhulukazi eminyakeni ezayo. Uhlanga olungabaziyo lwesabelo sokuqala sokwakha. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uthando lwakhe lobumbano lwamqoka, sifuna ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizakhe pobumbene, ungalobi isithombe esithembisa izimanga eziningi. U-Cyril Ramaphosa uyinsika yokwakha umphakathi omuhle, kwaye iqhubeka iqhubeka nelanga elisha. Njengenjini yomphakathi, uhlanga lwakhe luyeza, ludinga ukwakha, luya emhlabeni onobubele. Uphakamisa ukuhamba phambili, ebeka umphakathi uqobo fell, umise umsebenzi oqhakazile, okhuluma ngempilo yesizukulwane esisha. Ubuyaqhubeka ukuphila futhi ubambe iqhaza emiphakathini, eqhubeka idebenze nemicabango ezobuholi, ubuyaqhubeka nomfutho wokwakha ikhaya elisha elizokhushulwa ngokuthula.
Umbiko Ngomsebenzi KaBlack Coffee Isingeniso UBlack Coffee ungumculi ophumelelayo eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ufinyelele impumelelo enkulu, edlulisela umculo owamukelekile, ohlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene. Umculo wakhe udala izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile empilweni yabantu. Kulolu mbiko, sizobheka izimpumelelo zakhe, izinhlelo ezithinta impilo yakhe, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe.
