Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngalesi sifo, singenza umphakathi wethu ube indawo engcono, lapho abantu bengahamba phambili bezokwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, ngaphandle kokuthinteka kwezidakamizwa. Ukubambisana komphakathi, ukufundisa, nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile ekulweni nale nkinga. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ezikoleni: Izingqinamba Nezinzuzo Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, izinhlelo zokufunda ezinokwakhiwa kwezobuchwepheshe zithuthukisa indlela abafundi abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudala nezingqinamba ezithile. Ngakho-ke, sithumele izimvo ezahlukene ezikhuluma ngezinzuzo nezinkinga zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ezikoleni. Ubufakazi bokuthi ubuchwepheshe bunikeza izinzuzo eziningi bukhona. Okokuqala, ukufunda ngekhompyutha noma ngama-tablets kukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezincwadini, ezifundweni ezahlukene, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuba baqonde izifundo zabo, baqhubele phambili, futhi bathole ulwazi olujulile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhono okuxhumana akhula, njengoba abafundi befunda ukuphendula, ukwenza izinhlelo, futhi babambisane emisebenzini yeqembu. Ngokuphambene, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekhuluphaleni komqondo nokunciphisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi abavame ukujolisa ezintweni ezikwi-inthanethi, okungaholela ekwenzeni kahle okuncane ezikoleni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali bubalulekile ukuze kufezwe impumelelo yokufunda. Uma ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomlamli, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi akufanele busebenze njengengxenye eyodwa kuphela yokufunda. Okwesithathu, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaba nzima ezikoleni ezinamathuba amancane. Ukuthenga ama-laptops, ama-tablets, nezinsizakusebenza zama-software akwazi ukuba yinkinga ezikoleni. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza zezimali ezinhle, okungase kube yinkinga ezikhungweni ezithola ukwesekwa okuncane. Abafundi abavela emindenini engakwazi ukukhokhela lezi zinsiza bangase bahluleke ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba othisha befinyeleleka ukuze basize abafundi. Ukufundisa ngendlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kufanele kube yingxenye yohlelo lwezifundo. Othisha kufanele baphinde bafundiswe ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, ukuze bakwazi ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, izikole kufanele zikhuthaze ukuqhubeka kokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bahlale belungile futhi bejabulile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuchwepheshe buye basiza ekwenzeni ukufunda kube mnandi. Uhlelo lokufunda lwezinkanyezi, izinhlelo zokuhlela izifundo, nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa zenza ukufunda kube izinto ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kwandisa ukuzibophezela kwabafundi, futhi kunikeza ithuba lokucabanga ngokuqhubekayo. Abafundi abajabulela ukufunda ngezinhlobo ezihlukene zokufundisa, futhi ubuchwepheshe budala lezi zindlela ezintsha. Ngakho-ke, uma sizama ukukhokhela izinsiza ezibalulekile, kubalulekile ukuthi siqaphele izinkinga ezitholakala. Ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza, hhayi umthwalo. Ukubeka phambili ukufunda komqondo, okukhuthaza ukujula kokucabanga, kubalulekile. Uma izikole ziqhubeka nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, sizokwazi ukuphishekela impumelelo kwabaqhamukayo. Ekugcineni, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziqondile. Abafundi kumele baqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buwusizo, kodwa abavumele ukuba buphule ubudlelwano obubalulekile obukhona phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi uma ubuchwepheshe busetshenziswa kahle, lungaba ngumkhiqizo omuhle ekuthuthukiseni indlela yokufunda. Lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo ezinkulu, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumaqembu omphakathi jikelele. Ngalolu hlobo, kufanele siqhubeke sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe ezikoleni, sisondela ekufundeni okuphumelelayo.
Izinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Umsebenzi Osafanele Ukwenziwa Ngokuhlola impilo yomphakathi wethu, singabona ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala behlupheka ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukusho ukuba nemikhawulo emzimbeni, kodwa kube nemiphumela ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabo, kokubili ngokomzwelo nangokwenhlalakahle. Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ukuze siphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ofanele wonke umuntu, kodwa sizobona ukuthi kunzima ukuya phambili. Abantu abakhubazekile, ngokuvamile, bahlushwa ukungabikhona kwezinsizakalo ezanele ezibhekelelayo. Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengokuhamba kalula, imfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kuhlanganisa nezinye izinkinga zokuxhumana, kube yisithiyo esikhulu ekufinyeleleni kokuphila okujabulisayo. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho wonke umuntu efisa ukuba neqhaza eliqhakazile emphakathini. Ngokweqiniso, izinsizakalo zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Izinhlelo zamanje azihlangabezani nezidingo ezithile zabantu abakhubazekile, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda okukhulu kwemvelo yokukhubazeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izidingo nemicabango yabantu abakhubazekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukukhiqiza izinhlelo ezivula amathuba, hhayi kuphela okuphepha, kodwa nemfundo, ukulungela emsebenzini, kanye nezinsizakalo zokufuna usizo. Ukuze sifezekise lokhu, kufanele sibe nokubambisana okunesisekelo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo egculisayo. Umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu kufanele ube nezinqubomgomo ezibhekelelayo, ezibandakanya abantu abakhubazekile ezinqumweni ezithinta izinsizakalo zabo. Ngokwakha umphakathi lapho abantu abakhubazekile bengakhubazeki khona, kufanele sikhuthaze umqondo wokubumbana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqonde izifiso zabo, sihloniphe izinkolelo zabo, futhi sibe nezinselele ezibhekelelayo ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nokukhubazeka nokwenza kube lula ukukhuluma ngalezi zihloko. Ngakhoke, ukwakha indawo evulekile yokuxoxa ngalezi zindaba, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto abazidingayo, kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba izinsizakalo zibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi zifezeke izinjongo ezithile. Umphakathi unethuba lokufunda nokukhula, kodwa kumele kube nezinqubomgomo eziqinile ezivuma ubulungiswa. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abakhubazekile akusikho ukuphikisana, kodwa yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ogcwele uthando, ukwamukela, nokubambisana. Umphakathi lapho umuntu angakhubazeki khona, lapho wonke umuntu enethuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, uyohamba phambili. Konke lokhu kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ezinqunyiwe, siqwashise nabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abakhubazekile bayakhethelwa izinsizakalo ezizwakalayo. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba amaningi, kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephila impilo ecebile. Ukuphila kulezi zimo, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuthatha izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ofaka wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, noma yisiphi isimo. Ukwamukela abantu abakhubazekile, ukufunda kumathuba, nokwakha izinsizakalo ezizungezile kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuyisidingo esikhulu, futhi kumele kube nomsebenzi oqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi sithola impumelelo ezinsizakalweni zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile. Kumele sithole indlela yokubambisana, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu abakhubazekile bejabulile, bephila impilo egculisayo, futhi bezizwa beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, akusiyo nje indaba yokuphepha, kodwa kuyinjongo yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onenhlonipho, nesibindi, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukujabulela zonke izinzuzo, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kumele kube yinjongo yempilo yethu sonke. Ubufakazi bokuthi umphakathi omuhle ususwa emizameni yokwakha izinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukusebenza okuqhubekayo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemicabango emihle. Sihlale sihlangene, sicela ukuthi sithuthukise izinsizakalo zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, onobumbano, nolwazi.
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yethu Empilweni yamanje, lapho ubuhlungu bempilo yengqondo buvele ngokukhanya, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba ngendlela efanele. Impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu yonke, kodwa, ngeshwa, ibhujiswa yizinkinga eziningi ezithinta abantu abaningi. Ngaphezulu kokuba yisigaba esibalulekile sempilo, impilo yengqondo ithinta indlela esibona ngayo umhlaba, izinqumo esizithathayo, kanye nobudlelwano bethu nabanye. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona into engatholakala kalula. Akukhona nje ukuthi umuntu uyazizwa engcono noma embi; impilo yengqondo ibhekene nezimo ezinzima, njengokukhathazeka, ukudangala, noma ezinye izifo ezihlobene nomqondo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokwejwayelekile, futhi akukhona ukungajabuli kuphela, kodwa kungaba nezimbangela eziningi zokuthi kungani umuntu ezizwa engcono noma embi. Kungaba yizimo zokuphila, imithombo yokucindezeleka, noma ngisho nokushoda kwezinsiza zokwelapha. Kodwa-ke, kunenkinga enkulu lapho sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Umphakathi uthanda ukuzama ukufihla lezi zinkinga, futhi abanye abantu bacasulwa uma bekhuluma ngazo. Lokhu kuze kube yinkinga, ngoba ukuvuma ukuthi sinesidingo sokwelashwa kwengqondo kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuphila kahle. Ukuhlonipha lesi sikhathi sokukhuluma, kudinga ukuba sithathe izinqumo ezinzima mayelana nokuthi singakha kanjani umphakathi owelapha. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo akukona ukuvuma ukuhlaselwa, kodwa kuyisiqalo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngesikhathi samanje, usuku nosuku sibona abantu besebenzisa izikhala eziningi zokukhuluma, njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, ukuthola ukwesekwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, kodwa kufanele kabusha nokuqonda ukuthi ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zempilo yengqondo akumele kube okukhathaza, kodwa kufanele kube okujabulisayo. Uhlelo lokuxhumana olukhulayo lungasiza ekwakheni isimo sokuhlonipha nokuqonda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayimkhulu nje, kodwa iyinselele. I-World Health Organization (WHO) ibonisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo ihlobene ngqo nezinga lokuphila. Uma sikhuluma ngalokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isinyathelo sokwakha izinsiza eziwusizo zokuthola usizo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinhlelo zezemidlalo, izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe, nezinye izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Ukwengeza, ukuxhumana nokuhlonipha abanye kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Abantu abavuma ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo kufanele bathole ukwesekwa, okungahlanganisa ukwelashwa, ukufunda, noma ukuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umuzwa wokuba nenhlonipho, kanti futhi kunciphisa umthwalo wezinkinga zengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhuthaze ukufunda ngempilo yengqondo. Imfundo ibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezenzakalayo, nokuthi singazixazulula kanjani. Namuhla, izikhungo eziningi zifundisa abantu ngezinselelo zempilo yengqondo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwenziwa kube yinto ejwayelekile, hhayi nje okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo iyinselele enkulu, kodwa ingasixazulula uma siphathelene nayo ngendlela efanele. Umphakathi, izikhungo, nabantu ngabanye kumele basebenzisane ukuze basize othile abakudinga. Ukukhula kwempilo yengqondo kudinga umsebenzi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomqondo ovulekile. Lokhu kwazisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo ikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe njengengxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukusiza ukuvuselela impilo yengqondo, futhi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, asifuni ukuba namathambo ezinkinga, kodwa sifuna ukubambisana ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngalokho, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyathokoziswa, futhi ibaluleke njengempilo yomzimba. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sikhuluma, sizame, futhi sigxile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Lokhu kuzosisiza nonke empilweni yethu, nangenhlonipho yokuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, kuphila kahle, nokuthi zonke izinsiza zidingeka ukuze sikhulise umphakathi ophilayo nonobudlelwano.
uHuawei Umbuzo: Yini uHuawei? Impendulo: UHuawei iyinkampani enkulu yezobuchwepheshe esungulwe ngo-1987 eShenzhen, eChina. Ibandakanya ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhiqiza, nokuhlinzeka ngamalaptop, amaphones, nezixazululo zokuxhumana. UHuawei uyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngempumelelo yawo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa nguHuawei? Impendulo: UHuawei uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ze-inthanethi zensiza, imishini yokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza zezifundo, kanye nezixazululo zezemidlalo. Ikakhulukazi, ibhizinisi layo le-ICT (Information and Communications Technology) lihlala libalulekile ekuxhumaneni kwezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo: UHuawei unamaphuzu anjani emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ungomunye wabaholi emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Iphinde ibe ngumkhiqizi omkhulu wamafoni esikhathini esiningi, ikakhulukazi ama-smartphones, futhi ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwe-5G, okuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zedijithali. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo uHuawei abhekene nazo? Impendulo: UHuawei ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokuphikiswa kwezinye izizwe, ikakhulukazi i-United States. Lokhu kube nemiphumela emikhulu emhlabeni wonke, okuhlanganisa nezithiyo ekuthengiseni nasekutholeni izinsiza ezibalulekile. UHuawei uhlose ukuvuselela ubudlelwano bawo ezimakethe ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kokukhula. Umbuzo: UHuawei uyasebenzisana kanjani nezinye izinkampani? Impendulo: UHuawei usebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izinkampani ezinkulu emhlabeni, okuhlanganisa izinkampani zokuxhumana, izikhungo zocwaningo, nezikhungo zemfundo. Lezi zixhumanisi zandise amathuba okuthola izixazululo ezintsha nezobuchwepheshe, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemikhiqizo emisha. Umbuzo: UHuawei ungena kanjani ebhizinisini labantu abaningi? Impendulo: UHuawei ungene ebhizinisini labantu abaningi ngokuhlinzeka ngama-smartphones anenani elifanele, izixazululo ze-inthanethi, kanye nemikhiqizo ye-ICT. Uthandwa kakhulu phakathi kwabantu abasha, njengoba unikeza ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ngezindleko ezincane. Umbuzo: UHuawei uyakuthanda kanjani ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ikhetha ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kokwakha imikhiqizo emisha, ibamba izifundo eziningi zokuthuthukisa amakhono abathengi nabasebenzisi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izixazululo zayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Umbuzo: Kungani uHuawei ebhekwa njengomholi wezobuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ibhekwa njengomholi wezobuchwepheshe ngenxa yokukhiqiza imikhiqizo ethuthukisiwe, isivinini sokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezixazululo ezihamba phambili ezitholakala emhlabeni. Ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula, uHuawei uziqhenya ngokuqeqesha abasebenzi bayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo, nokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Umbuzo: Yini esinokuyilindela kuHuawei esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, singenza okulindelekile ukuthi uHuawei uzoqhubeka nokwandisa imakethe yawo, uthuthukise ubuchwepheshe bayo obunobuchwepheshe, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile namanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulindeleke ukuthi uHuawei uqhubeke nokuhlola izinketho ezintsha zokusebenza ezizokwandisa imikhiqizo nemakethe. Umbuzo: Ngabe uHuawei unethonya elihle emphakathini? Impendulo: UHuawei ubonakala enethonya elihle emphakathini, njengoba uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezemfundo nasekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuxhumana. Uthanda ukusiza abantu ukuze banikezwe amathuba angcono, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kwawo ekukhuleni komphakathi. Umbuzo: UHuawei ungaba kanjani isibonelo kwabanye? Impendulo: UHuawei ungaba isibonelo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe ngokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukufaka imali ocwaningweni, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye. Imigomo yayo yokukhula, ukuhamba phambili, nokuba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini iyafundwa ngabanye abathuthukisi bebhizinisi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uHuawei ubonakala esebenzisa amaqhinga amasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nemigomo ezokwenza le nkampani iqhubeke nokukhula, iphinde ibe yisibonelo esihle emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe.
Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi: Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukufunda Kwakho Kube Ngcono Isingeniso Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekuyindlela ethokozisayo nethandwayo yokuthola ulwazi. Noma ngabe ufuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho, ukufunda izinto ezintsha, noma ukufinyelela emithonjeni eyahlukene, i-inthanethi ikunika amathuba amaningi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokufunda nge-inthanethi, ukuze ukwazi ukwenza kahle futhi uthole imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha Indawo Efanele Yokufunda Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukukhetha indawo ethokozisayo nekhululekile yokufunda. Indawo enokuthula izokwenza ukwazi ukuconsa kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yakho ikhululekile, inegumbi elanele, futhi ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezizokuphazamisa. Ungakhetha ukufunda ekhaya, kwi-cafe, noma emtatsheni wezincwadi, kuye ngesithakazelo sakho. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsiza Zokufunda Ezincomekayo Ngemva kokukhetha indawo, kufanele uthole izinsiza ozodinga. Izinsiza zokufunda zingaba izifundo eziku-inthanethi, amavidiyo, nezincwadi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Thola ama-websites anjaniwedi angcono kakhulu, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izifundo zamahhala, kanye nemithombo efana ne-YouTube. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ozikhethayo zikhokhelwa noma zethembekile. Isinyathelo 3: Dala Uhlelo Lokufunda Njengoba uqala ukufunda, kubalulekile ukudala uhlelo lokufunda. Beka izinjongo ezicacile nezifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela isikhathi sokufunda. Ungazama ukusetha izinsuku ezithile zokufunda, kanye nezikhathi ezithile zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyagcizelela ukufunda njalo. Faka izikhumbuzo kumakhalekhukhwini ukuze ungakhohliwe. Isinyathelo 4: Sebenzisa Amathuluzi E-Technology Ngokufunda nge-inthanethi, amathuluzi e-technology angaba usizo olukhulu. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikuvumela ukuthi ubhale amanothi, uhlele imisebenzi, futhi uqaphe ukuthuthuka kwakho. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Notion, Evernote, noma i-Google Docs zingakusiza ukwenza lula ukufunda kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyayazisa lezi zinhlelo ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono. Isinyathelo 5: Bamba Ingxoxo Nezinye Izifundi Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi kungasiza kakhulu ekufundeni. Bamba ingxoxo nabanye, noma ku-inthanethi, ngezigameko ezithile. Ungasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana noma ama-forum ukuze uxoxe ngemicabango, imibuzo, noma izinkinga ozithola ngesikhathi sokufunda. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umqondo ophusile, futhi uzofunda kakhulu uma uvuma izimvo zabanye. Isinyathelo 6: Thola Izibuyekezo Ngezifundo Zakho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthola izibuyekezo ngezifundo zakho. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda izindlela ezintsha, ukulungisa amaphutha, noma ukucabangela izindlela zokufunda ezihlukile. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazihlola lezi zinto, futhi ungazithathi kakhulu uma kunzima, ngoba ukufunda kuyinqubo ehlala njalo. Isinyathelo 7: Jabulela Ukufunda Ekugcineni, kufanele ujabulele ukufunda. Hlanganisa izifundo ezithokozisayo nezinto ozithandayo ukuze uvuselele isifiso sokufunda. Ungakwazi ukufunda izincwadi, ukujolisa kumavidiyo, noma ukujoyina amaqembu ahambisana nezifundo zakho. Ukufunda akufanele kube umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kufanele kube yinto ejabulisayo. Isiphetho Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela enhle yokuthola ulwazi, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela, uhlelo, kanye nokubekezela. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathuthukisa ukufunda kwakho futhi uthole imiphumela emihle. Khumbula, ukufunda akupheli, futhi kufanele uhlale uvulelekile ezintsha. Jabulela uhambo lwakho lokufunda, futhi ungaphumi emthanjeni wezokwazi!
Izindaba Zamanje: Ukubheka Emuva Nokuqonda Izenzakalo Zamanje Ngesikhathi sikaNovemba 2023, umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, eziphakamisa imizwa ehlukahlukene kubantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izenzakalo zomlando eziholele kulezi zimo esibhekene nazo namuhla. Izinto eziningi ezibuhlungu zenzeka eminyakeni edlule, kodwa zibhala indlela yokuphila kwethu namuhla. Izikhumbuzo Zezinguquko Zepolitiki Njengoba uhulumeni bezwe zingama-United States beqhuba izinqubo zeziqu zepolitiki, izinguquko ezenzeka emazweni amaningana ziqhubeka nezimpikiswano. Izinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuqhubeka nokuphila kwabantu zikhona, kodwa ziqhubeka nomthelela obalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala oluphumelele, izinkulumo ziqhubeka, futhi abantu bathembela ekubeni khona kwezinguquko ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuyingxenye yesizinda esiqhubekayo sokubambisana kwezombusazwe emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqumo zamazwe ahlukene mayelana nezindaba zezemvelo ziveza isimo esinzima. Izenzakalo ezifana nokushisa komhlaba, imvula engajwayelekile, nokwanda kwezinhlekelele zemvelo zifaka ingcindezi ezinkampanini, emiphakathini, nasemalawulweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezinzima zokulawula ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kanye nokuphikiswa phakathi kwezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Izinkinga Zomnotho Nezempilo Esikhathini esifanayo, umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Ngemuva kokuphuma kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19, izwe liqhubeka nokubhekana nezinkinga zokubi kwezezimali. Abantu abaningi basahamba ebhange lempilo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi nezinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni ibhekene nezikhathi ezinzima, futhi izinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana nezokudla, ezempilo, nezokuhlala ziya zishoda. Ngokwenhlalo, umnotho nezempilo zihlangana kakhulu. Ukuqonda ukuthi umnotho uthembela kanjani ezinhlelweni zempilo kubalulekile, njengoba ukungabi nandaba nezempilo kungaholela ekuwohlokeni komnotho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala benempilo futhi benza kahle emsebenzini zidinga ukuhamba phambili. Izindaba Zezenhlalo Nezokuthula Ezinye izinkinga ezizwakalayo emhlabeni ziqhamuka ezindabeni zezenhlalo. Ukulwa nokukhwabanisa, ubuhlanga, nokuhlukumeza komphakathi kudinga ukugxila okukhulu. Imibiko ethile ibonisa ukuthi izigameko zokuhlukumeza zikhula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kokuphathwa kahle. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokwakha ukuthula zibuye zibe nzima, njengoba ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene kuholela ezinkingeni. Abantu badinga ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene ukuze bakhe umphakathi onokuthula, nokho, lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomdlandla. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, izinkampani, kanye nabantu kuyadingeka ukuze kwakhiwe izixazululo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu nakwezinye izindawo ezithintekayo. Izenzakalo Zobuchwepheshe Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buyaqhubeka nokuthuthukisa impilo yethu. Izinguquko ezinkulu ezenzeka embonini yobuchwepheshe ziqinisa ukuxhumana, kodwa futhi zikhombisa izinselelo ezintsha. Ukuqwashisa ngemininingwane kanye nokuvikeleka kwemikhiqizo kubalulekile, njengoba abantu bephendula ezintweni ezinzima ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Izindaba ezithinta ubuchwepheshe zikhombisa indlela abantu abasha abathola ngayo ulwazi nolwazi. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala benolwazi lwakamuva, nokho, kudinga ukuthi kuqashwe izingozi ezihambisana nezinkampani eziphakela izinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Konke lokhu kuhlobene, futhi izindaba zamanje zidinga ukuqonda okujulile. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nekhanda elivulekile, sithathe izinyathelo zokusebenzisa ulwazi lwethu ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu. Izinkinga ezikhona zidinga ukuhamba phambili, nokuhlangana kwethu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokubheka emuva ezindabeni zomlando, sizothola ukuthi singenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Yilapho, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nenhlangano. Izindaba zamanje zikhombisa izifundo ezibalulekile, futhi ukuphila kwethu kuncike ekubeni sihlale siqaphele izimo ezenzakalayo.
Isingeniso Ukupheka, njengomsebenzi wokudala, kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Abantu abaningi bakubona njengomsebenzi ojwayelekile, kodwa empeleni, ukupheka kunomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu, ezempilo, nasemiphakathini. Kukhona abavuma ukuthi ukupheka kuyindlela yokukhulisa ubudlelwano, kuyilapho abanye bephikisa ukuthi kudinga isikhathi esiningi, okungaholela ekutheni kube nzima kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya, izinselelo ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ukupheka kube lula. Izinzuzo Zokupheka Ekhaya Okokuqala, ukupheka ekhaya kunikeza ithuba lokulawula izithako esizisebenzisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo. Izithako ezitholakala ezitolo zihlala zinezakhamzimba eziphansi, futhi zihlala zinezinye izinto ezingeziwe ezingenza kube nzima emzimbeni. Ngokupheka ekhaya, sikwazi ukukhetha izithako eziphilile, ezinjengemifino, izithelo, nemikhiqizo ye-organic. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, okungasiza ekugcineni isisindo esifanele, kanye nokuvikela izifo ezihlobene nokudla okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukupheka ekhaya kudala ithuba lokuxhumana nomndeni. Lapho sithokozisa umndeni wethu ngezinsuku ezikhethekile, noma ngabe yisiphi isikhathi sokudla, sithuthukisa ubudlelwano bethu. Lokhu kudala imikhuba emihle, lapho izingane zifunda khona ukubaluleka kokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Ukupheka ndawonye kungaba yindlela yokwakha imikhuba emihle, futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izinselelo Zokupheka Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukupheka kungaba yinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yisikhathi esincane, futhi ukupheka kudinga isikhathi, okungaholela ekutheni bakhethe ukudla okusheshayo, okungase kube nezithako ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abantu bephuma bephuza ukudla okungafanele, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase babe nekhono elincane lokupheka, okwenza kube nzima ukuzenzela ukudla. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile, futhi bakhethe ukudla okuthengwayo, okungase kube nezithako ezimbi. Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, izindlela zokupheka ezilula nezisebenzayo. Izindlela Zokwenza Ukupheka Kube Lula Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, singasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezinhlelo zokupheka eziku-inthanethi, ezisiza abantu ukuba bafunde izindlela ezilula zokupheka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle zomndeni. Okwesibili, singasebenzisa izithako ezilula nezitholakalayo. Ukupheka akudingi ukuba kube nzima; singakha izidlo ezimnandi neziphilile ngama-ingredients ambalwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlushwa yisikhathi, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe ukudla okunempilo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukupheka kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezihambisana nakho, izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya zikhulu kakhulu. Ukupheka akusizi kuphela ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, kodwa futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokupheka, sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi sifundise abantu izindlela zokupheka ezilula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukupheka kube lula, kube mnandi, futhi kube yindlela yokuphila enempilo. Ukupheka akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sithokozise le msebenzi.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Isingeniso Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ethinta izwe lonke, kanti kuthinta imiphakathi eminingi ngempela. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngezibalo, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa imizwa, izinkolelo, nezimo ezihlukahlukene ezenzeka emindenini nasemiphakathini. Ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kwezinye izinsuku kungenza kube nzima empilweni yentsha, njengoba izinqumo ezinzima zidingeka. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlole le ndaba ngeso lesibili, sibheke izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha. Izinzuzo Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuthiwa ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaba nezinzuzo ezintathu eziyinhloko. Okokuqala, kuyasiza ekwakheni umndeni. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi uma intsha ikwazi ukukhulelwa, izothuthukisa umndeni wabo, ikakhulukazi uma isebenza ngayo. Lokhu kusebenza uma kukhona uhlelo oluhle lokuthuthukiswa kwezingane, oluqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana uthola uthando oludingekayo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze akhule abe umuntu ophumelelayo. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaholela ekutheni intsha ikwazi ukuzithuthukisa. Futhi, uma kucabanga ngalesi sikhathi, intsha ingakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, ibonise amandla okukhula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi ukugcina umndeni kuyisibopho esinzima, okuholela ekukhuleni komqondo, kuyilapho kuthuthukiswa izindlela zokuziphatha nezokuxhumana. Okokugcina, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungakhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle emndenini. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kukhulunywa ngempumelelo yokwakha ubuhlobo obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Ukukhulelwa kudala ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nezifundo zidluliselwa phambili. Izinkinga Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Nakuba kunokuthakazelelwa okukodwa, izinkinga ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha zikhona futhi zidinga ukuba sikhulume ngazo. Okokuqala, ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kungaholela ezinkingeni zezezimali. Intsha ivame ukuba nemithwalo eminingi, futhi uma kwenzeka ukukhulelwa, kungenzeka kube nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahluleka ukubhekana nemithwalo yezezimali, ikakhulukazi uma bengenakukwazi ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga zempilo zomama, izinkinga zempilo zezingane, kanye nezifo ezithathelwanayo. Intsha ivame ukuba nezinkinga zokuqonda nezokuphila, okwenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhasa abakhulelwayo. Okokugcina, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungabhekana nezinkinga zendawo yokuhlala. Uma intsha ikhuliswa emindenini engaphili kahle, lokhu kungaholela ekukhuleni kwezinkinga ezinkulu. Izimo ezinzima zendawo yokuhlala zikhulisa izinselelo ezinobungozi, okungaholela ekwenzeni kube nzima ukusebenzisa amathuba empilo. Lokhu kudinga indlela yokubheka izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhasa intsha. Isixazululo Nezinyathelo Ezizothathwa Ukuze sithuthukise imiphumela yokukhulelwa kwentsha, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubalulekile. Abantwana abathola imfundo ephusile mayelana nezinselelo zokukhulelwa, izindlela zempilo, nezinsiza ezikhona, bazoba nethuba elingcono lokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphila ezithuthukile, ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, izifundo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhethekile zabantu abakhulelwe. Okokugcina, umphakathi kumele ube nempilo. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxhaswa kwemindeni, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kungase kuthuthukise impilo yentsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza intsha ikwazi ukukhula kahle, ithole izinselelo ezincane, futhi ibhekelele ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukuxoxwa ngokuqinile. Kukhona izinzuzo ezithile, kodwa futhi zikhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokuxhasa intsha, siqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bethu bathola uthando, imfundo, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhule kahle. Umphakathi wethu udinga ukuxhumana, ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukile, ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lethu. Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akukona nje umthwalo, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izimpilo ezintsha.
Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngokubheka izimo ezinzima ezibhekene ne-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda ubunzima obukhona kanye nemiphumela yalo emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. I-Eskom, njengomphakeli omkhulu wamandla kagesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nokusebenza kwayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo ye-Eskom esikhathini esedlule. Kukhona isikhathi lapho i-Eskom yayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ogcwele, futhi abantu babengakha izinhlelo zabo zokuphila ngokwethembeka. Nokho, lezi zinsuku seziyisikhathi esedlule. Ukungabi namandla kagesi okuvamile, okubizwa ngokuthi i-load shedding, sekwenze kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuphazamiseka kokuphila kwansuku zonke, kodwa futhi kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu emnothweni, njengoba izinkampani zikhubazeka futhi abantu behluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Esikhathini esiningi, izinkinga ze-Eskom zixhumene nezinsiza ezindala, ukungabi namali yokutshala, kanye nezinkinga eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezindala zidinga ukwenziwa kabusha, futhi lokhu kudinga izimali ezinkulu. Kodwa-ke, lapho sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zidinga ukutshala imali ukuze zithuthukise izinsiza zazo. Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, kudingeka izinqubo eziphusile zokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi namandla kagesi kubangela ukunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu. Abantu bahlala bephuma ezindaweni zabo ukuze bahlale emakhaya ngenxa yokungabi namandla. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni zabo ezivikelekile. Ukungabi namandla kagesi kusebenza njengomphumela omubi emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Ukwengeza, i-Eskom ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu eziphathelene nezinguquko ezisemthethweni. Izinguquko ezithile zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamizi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwalezi zinhlaka kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezixazululweni ezisebenzayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngezixazululo ezingase zibe khona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ithole ukuxhaswa kwezimali ukuze ikwazi ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhaswa okuvela kuhulumeni, abaninimasheya, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukutshala imali ezinsizeni ezintsha, ezifana nezinsiza ezisebenza ngelanga noma umoya, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Okwesibili, i-Eskom kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuphatha eziphusile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, kanye nokwandisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha amandla. Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha amandla, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bekwazi ukuthola ugesi. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinqubomgomo ze-Eskom. Ukuqwashisa abantu ngalezi zinqubomgomo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele, nokuthi bangaphatha kanjani izimo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwe-Eskom kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubomgomo eziphusile, ukuxhaswa kwezimali, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Uma sikwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabantu, kanye nomnotho wezwe. I-Eskom iyisikhungo esibalulekile emnothweni, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo esikhathini esizayo.
UThabo Mbeki: Umholi Wokwakha Isizwe UThabo Mbeki, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-18 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942, eEltig, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wezakhamuzi ezihlonishwayo nezidumile kuleli. Uthole imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukuba nesithakazelo kwi-politiki. Ubuye wenza izifundo e-United Kingdom, lapho aqhubeka khona nokufunda ngempilo yezenhlalakahle nemibono yokulwela amalungelo abantu. Ngemva kokuba uMbeki esebenzise isikhathi sakhe esikoleni, waba yinxusa le-ANC (African National Congress) e-United Kingdom, lapho aqala khona ukubambisana nabanye abaholi abanjengoNelson Mandela. Uthisha wabo babengaphezulu kweminyaka eminingi, baphikisana nempilo yokuhlukaniswa kobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika. UThabo Mbeki waba neqhaza elikhulu ekulweleni inkululeko, futhi waqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha izwe elikhululekile. Njengoba i-ANC iqhubeka nokulwa, uMbeki waqhubeka nokuba yinsika yokuqinisa amalungelo abantu. Waba uMphathiswa wezamaMali, ngaphambi kokuba abe nguMongameli wesibili waseNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaMandela. Emsebenzini wakhe, uMbeki waba nomthelela omkhulu emigomeni yezenhlalo, ezomnotho, nezepolitiki zezwe. Wazama ukususa ubuhlanga phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi wakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezinye izizwe. UThabo Mbeki, njengoba esaziwa, waba nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngonyaka ka-1999 kuya ku-2008. Phakathi kweminyaka yakhe yokuphatha, wacela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baphile ngokubambisana, bahloniphe umehluko wabo, futhi bakhe izwe elinokuthula. Waphinde waqhakambisa umqondo we-Afrika ezithuthukisayo, okwakuhloswe ngawo ukuba ne-Afrika ethuthukayo nezenhlalakahle ezilungile. Ngesikhathi sokuphathwa kwakhe, uMbeki wabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha nezomnotho. Ubumpofu, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS, nezinye izinkinga eziningi zazibhekene nezwe. Uthatha izinyathelo ezinzima zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi wahlaselwa ngempikiswano ngenxa yezinqumo azithathayo. Nokho, lemiphumela yayingesiyo indlela yokuphila, kodwa yayingakha umbono omusha wezinto ezikhona. UThabo Mbeki uqhubekile nokuba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezomnotho. Waba nephuzu elikhulu emhlanganweni wezizwe e-Afrika, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni uhlelo lwe-NEPAD (New Partnership for Africa's Development), oluhlose ukusiza amazwe ase-Afrika ekuthuthukiseni izimboni nezinsiza. Umsebenzi wakhe wenze kube sobala ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ophusile, oqhoshiswa ngemigomo yokwakha isizwe esiqinile nehlelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMbeki waba nempilo yokusebenza ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, waphinde wayehlola izindlela zokwenza izwi lakhe lizwe ezinhle, ukuze alungise izinkinga ezikhona e-Afrika. Ubuye wabamba izikhundla ezahlukene kwi-ANC, futhi uhlala ebalulekile emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza emkhakheni wezombusazwe, uMbeki waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindaba zokubambisana phakathi kwe-Afrika nezinye izifunda. Wazama ukususa izithiyo eziphazamisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izivumelwano ezithile zokuthuthukisa umnotho. UThabo Mbeki ungomunye wabaholi abahamba phambili e-Afrika, futhi ukuphila kwakhe kusempilweni yomphakathi. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yemizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, owaziwa ngokuhlonipha abantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi, ngempela, ubuholi obuqinile buhlelwa ngothando, ukuzinikela, kanye nezifiso ezinhle zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThabo Mbeki wathola izindondo eziningi, futhi uhlala engomunye wabaholi abahlonishwayo emhlabeni. Uhlale ezama ukusiza abanye, futhi umbono wakhe uyakhuthaza, ubonisa isibonelo sokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ukwethembeka, nokuqhubeka phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo Mbeki ubonakale engakaze alahle izifiso zakhe zokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Uhlala ehlala exhumene nezinye izinhlelo ezithuthukisa izwe, futhi uthumele imiyalezo yothando nokukhuthaza kubantu abaningi. Ngakho, uThabo Mbeki uyinsika eqinile, umholi onemigomo ecacile, futhi umuntu ophila impilo yokuzinikela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
AmaSotho: Isiko, Ubudlelwano, Nezindlela Zokuphila Isingeniso AmaSotho, abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, eLesotho, naseBotswana, banomlando ocebile kanye nezindlela zempilo ezihlukahlukene. Lesi sihloko sizogxila emlandweni wamaSotho, izimiso zabo, nemikhuba yabo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda ubudlelwano babo nemvelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihambisana nezinkolelo zabo. Umlando WamaSotho Ukuze siqonde amaSotho, kubalulekile ukuqala ngomlando wabo. AmaSotho aqala ukuvela phakathi nekhulu le-18, lapho uMoshoeshoe I, umholi wabo, ehola abantu bakhe emhlabeni onzima. UMoshoeshoe wahlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene ukuze akhe ubumbano, okwakuholela ekwakhiweni kwezwe laseLesotho. Lokhu kudalwa kwezizwe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni wamaSotho, njengoba kwavula indlela yokwakha isiko eliqinile nelihloniphekile. Isiko Nezinkolelo ZamaSotho Isiko lamaSotho lihlala ligxile ezinkolelweni zawo. Abantu bamaSotho banokholo oluqinile, futhi izinkolelo zabo zikhombisa indlela abaphila ngayo. Izenzo zabo zansuku zonke zikhombisa ukuhlonipha izinyanya, okukhombisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezedlule zibalulekile empilweni yabo. Izinkolelo zikaMoya, umoya ophilayo, zikhona emikhubeni yabo, njengokukhuleka, imikhosi, nemicimbi yokugubha impilo. Imikhuba Yansuku zonke Ubudlelwano bamaSotho nemvelo bukhombisa ukuthi bahlala bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Abantu bamaSotho bahlala benobudlelwano obuqinile nomndeni, futhi imisebenzi yabo ibonisa lokhu. Njengoba behlala emakhaya, imisebenzi yokulima ibalulekile. Abesifazane baphinde babambe iqhaza elikhulu ekulimaleni, kanti abesilisa bahlala beqondisa izinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane bamaSotho buhle kakhulu, futhi bonke bayawuhlonipha umkhiqizo wabo. Izinkanyezi Nezinkanyezi Zokuphila AmaSotho akha izinkanyezi ezithile ezihlobene nezinsuku zabo. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa izikhathi zokulima, izikhathi zokuvuna, kanye nezikhathi zokwakha. Lokhu kusiza abantu bamaSotho ukuba bahlale beqaphela izinguquko zemvelo, futhi baqonde kahle isikhathi sokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkanyezi zikhombisa izikhathi ezithile zokukhumbula izinyanya, okukhombisa ukuthi umqondo wokuhlonipha ubalulekile. Ukuxhumana Nezokuxhumana Ubudlelwano bamaSotho nabanye abantu buphinde bukhombise izindlela zokuxhumana ezihlukahlukene. Ubugebengu, imihlangano, nemicimbi yokugubha zenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi kwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. AmaSotho aphinde abambe iqhaza emicimbini yokubungaza izinkanyezi, okukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe bukhula. Izifundo Zokuphila Kukhona izifundo eziningi ezingatholwa emiphakathini yamaSotho. Ukubambisana, ukuhlonipha, nokusebenza kanzima yizimiso ezibalulekile. Lokhu kusiza abantu bamaSotho ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bahlale beqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano bukhulu kakhulu. Ukufunda nokwabelana ngolwazi kubalulekile, futhi abantu bamaSotho bahlala bephokophelela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabo. Isiphetho AmaSotho, njengabantu abanomlando ocebile, bahlala bephila ngokuhlanganyela, bejolisa emigomeni yokuhlonipha, ubudlelwano, nezinkolelo. Ubudlelwano babo nemvelo, izinkanyezi, nezokuxhumana kubalulekile ekwakheni impilo yabo. Ngokuhlonipha izinyanya, ukusebenza ndawonye, nokwabelana ngolwazi, amaSotho akha isiko eliqinile nelihloniphekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke sifunda nokuhlonipha lesi siko esicebile.
Imfashini: Ukuguquka Kwezitayela Nezindlela Zokugqoka Ezweni Lethu Ngonyaka ka-2023, imfashini ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuziveza, yokukhombisa ubunikazi, kanye nokwakha izithombe ezihlukahlukene. Ezweni lethu, imfashini ibonakala iguquka njalo, ihambisana nezinguquko zomphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezifiso zabantu. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nezimo zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokuphila ezishintshashintshayo. Izitayela Ezidumile Nezinguquko Zazo Izitayela ezidumile zihlala zishintsha, ziqhamuka nezinto ezintsha ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, izitayela ezinjengezimpahla ezikhululekile, ezilula, nezinemibala eminingi ziyaqhubeka nokuthandwa. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhula kokusebenza kwezemidlalo, lapho abantu bejolise ekutholeni induduzo, kodwa futhi befuna ukuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Izimpahla ezikhiqizwa ngama-sustainable materials zikhula kakhulu, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitayela ze-vintage zibuye zibe nempumelelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi bakhetha ukuhamba ngezimpahla ezindala, ezivela ezikhathini ezahlukene, ukuze bakhombise ubunikazi babo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubuyisela emuva, lapho abantu bejolise ekwakheni izithombe ezihlukile, ezihambisana nezinkumbulo zabo. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokuxhumana Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhona emkhakheni wemfashini. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitayela zifinyelela kubantu abaningi, izinkampani zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhuthaze imikhiqizo yazo. Izithombe ezinhle, ama-video, kanye nezibuyekezo ezivela kubathandi bemfashini zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezintsha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bexoxa ngezinto abazithandayo, behlanganyela imibono, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zenza kube lula ukuthola izitayela ezithile. Abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezilula ukuze bathole izimpahla ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi imfashini iyatholakala, futhi abantu bangenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Imfashini Nezinkinga Zokuhlukumezeka Nokho, imfashini ayinakho konke okuhle. Njengoba izitayela zishintsha, kunezinkinga ezithile ezivela, ikakhulukazi ezokuhlukumezeka. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuziphatha kahle, lapho bezama ukufanisa izithombe ezibukwayo ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu kufanele baphile ngendlela ethile ukuze bahlonishwe, okungaholela ekudumazekeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfashini ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta imvelo. Ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla eziningi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Ukukhuthaza imfashini esebenzisa izinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindlela zokukhiqiza ezihlakaniphile, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela imvelo. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, imfashini izoqhubeka nokuguquka, ihambisana nezimo zomhlaba. Abantu bazoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izitayela ezizayo, njengoba bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nemvelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini, abakhiqizi, kanye nezinkampani kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ngakho-ke, imfashini akuyona nje indlela yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuphila, yokuziveza, nokwakha umphakathi. Njengoba sithokozisa izitayela ezihlukahlukene, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imfashini ingaba yinsika yokuhlanganyela, yokuhlonipha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, sikhulise imfashini yethu, futhi sithuthukise umhlaba esiphila kuwo.
Ezokukhiqiza: Ukubheka Umongo, Izinto Ezibalulekile, Nezinto Eziwusizo Ezokukhiqiza, noma ukukhiqiza, kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, futhi kudlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukwakha imisebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Lolu hlelo lwezokukhiqiza ludinga ukucwaningwa ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi lungathuthukiswa kanjani, luqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethinta izimpilo zethu ngosuku nosuku. Umongo weZokukhiqiza Ezokukhiqiza zingabheka izinto ezahlukene lapho, kunoma yiluphi umkhakha, kudingeka khona imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa, kodwa akuphelelwe, emikhiqizweni yezimoto, imikhiqizo yokwakha, ezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zemidlalo. Izinqubo zokukhiqiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi le mikhiqizo itholakala ngentengo efanele, isezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ifinyeleleka kalula. Ukuze lezi zinto zikwazi ukuhlanganiswa, kudinga imishini ethuthukile, ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokuphatha. Izinyathelo Zokukhiqiza Inqubo yokukhiqiza ivame ukuhlanganiswa nezinyathelo ezithile ezisemqoka. Lezi zinyathelo ziqukethe ukuhlolwa kwemakethe, ukuklama, ukumisa, ukukhiqiza, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwemikhiqizo. Ukuze umkhiqizo uphumelele emakethe, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuhlola okuhle ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa. Lokhu kuhlola kugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo ezohambisana nezidingo zabathengi, ngempela kube nezixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe bokuqala buye baletha ushintsho olukhulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza. Ubuchwepheshe be-Industry 4.0, obuhlanganisa i-Internet of Things (IoT), ubuchwepheshe bokufakelwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa komshini, buyanda ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle nasekunciphiseni izindleko. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe, izinkampani zingakwazi ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo enezinga eliphakeme lokuchuma, ngasikhathi sinye zinciphise izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kuphela, kodwa futhi kuyasiza ekuvikeleni imvelo. Umthelela Emnothweni Umthelela wezokukhiqiza kumnotho awukho kuphela ekuhlinzekeni ngemikhiqizo, kodwa futhi ubandakanya ukudala amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani ezikhiqizayo zidinga abasebenzi abanobuchule, abakhono, nokuqonda okuphakeme kwi-automation kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, okwandisa ukuhweba phakathi kwezizwe. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, imboni yokukhiqiza ibamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile lapho abantu behlupheka khona. Izifundo Ezivela Kwezinye Izindawo Ukubheka izinto ezenzekayo kwezinye izindawo emhlabeni kungaba usizo ekutholeni izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Izinkampani ezinkulu zejwayelekile, ezifana neToyota neGeneral Electric, zitholakala zisebenzisa izinqubo zokukhiqiza eziqhuba kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza okwenziwe kwazulu (Lean Manufacturing) kanye nemodeli yeSix Sigma, edinga ukunciphisa amaphutha ezinqubweni zokukhiqiza. Ukufunda kulezi zinhlelo kungasiza izinkampani zethu ukuthi ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ephumelelayo. Izichasiso Nezinselelo Noma imboni yezokukhiqiza ingabika impumelelo enkulu, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko zokukhiqiza ezikhulayo, izinqubo zokuphatha ezinzima, kanye nezinselelo zokuqashwa. Izinqubo zokuqashwa kumele zikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi efanelekile, futhi imiphakathi kumele ibonise ukwesekwa nokuqonda izindima ezithile zabashayeli bemikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kumele zikhuthale ekwandiseni izinqubo ezivumelana nemithetho yokuvikela imvelo, ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezemvelo oholela ezingeni eliphakeme lokukhulisa umkhiqizo. Ikhono Lokulungisa Nenjongo Yekusasa Okokugcina, imboni yezokukhiqiza idinga amakhono okusebenza aphakeme nabantu abanomqondo ochwepheshe. Ukuze imboni iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthuthukisa izisebenzi, ukufundisa izinto ezintsha, nokukhuthaza ukusungula. Lokhu kudala umoya wokusebenza onempilo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa bexhaswe, futhi beqonda izinjongo ezinkulu zemisebenzi. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise imboni yethu yezokukhiqiza, ukuze ifinyelele izinjongo ezinhle zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle ezimpilweni zabantu, empilweni yezezimali, nasemhlabeni jikelele. Imboni yokukhiqiza, uma ibhekelela izindlela ezintsha futhi ithuthukisa izinqubo zayo, izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi eminyaka ezayo.
Umbiko Wokuphepha Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukuphepha ezikoleni kuyisihloko esibalulekile esidinga ukunakwa okukhulu kumphakathi. Izikole, njengendawo yokufunda, zidinga ukuba ziphephile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda nokukhula ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezibambekayo, ezihlanganisa wonke umuntu odlala indima ekuphuhliseni umphakathi, kusukela kubafundi, abazali, othisha, kuze kube kubaphathi bezikole. Izigameko Zokuphepha Izikhungo zemfundo zihlala zibhekene nezinsongo ezihlukene, ezifana nezingozi zemvelo, ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabafundi, kanye nezinsongo zempilo yomphakathi njengesifo esithathelwana kalula. Ngokusho kwezibalo, izigameko ezihlobene nokuphepha ezikoleni ziye zanda, kube nezigameko ezithinta ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukungabikho kokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yezikole. Izinyathelo Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinsongo, izikole kufanele zibe nezinyathelo ezicacile zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Abafundisi, othisha, nabaphathi baziwa ngokuthi bahlale bekulungele ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. 2. Izinhlelo Zokubika: Izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokubika izigameko zokuphepha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukulandela izigameko ezithile, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthola izixazululo eziphusile. 3. Izikhumbuzo Zokuphepha: Ukuhlinzeka ngezikhumbuzo ngezinsiza zokuphepha kubafundi nabazali, kuzosiza ekwenzeni abantu baziqonde kangcono izingozi ezingase zibe khona. 4. Ubudlelwano Nabazali: Ukuhlanganiswa kwabazali ezinhlelweni zokuphepha ezikoleni kubalulekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, nabaphathi bezikole. Izimo Zokuphepha Zangempela Izimo zangempela zokuphepha ezikoleni zikhombisa ukuthi izinga lokuphepha lidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngokuqhubekayo. Ngokwesibonelo, izikole ezithola izikhalazo ezivela kubafundi bangase zidinge ukwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola izimo zokuphepha. Izinkinga Ezingaba Khona Nokho, izikole zikhona nezinkinga ezithile okufanele ziqashelwe. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo ezikhona zokuphepha kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ngezinsiza ezanele. Ukubaluleka Kokufunda Ngokuphepha Abafundi kumele baqonde ngokubaluleka kokuphepha ezikoleni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi banemibono ecacile ngezingozi, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa ukufundisa abafundi ngendlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Isiphetho Ekupheleni, ukuphepha ezikoleni akusona isici kuphela sokuphila kwabafundi, kodwa kuyisici esibalulekile sokuphila komphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zihlala ziphephile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, nabaphathi. Ngale ndlela, izikole zingaba yizindawo lapho abafundi bakwazi ukuphila, ukufunda, nokukhula ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ukuphepha akusikho ukungabikho kwezingozi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umphefumulo wokuphepha uzogcinwa kuphela uma wonke umuntu ezibophezela ekwenzeni izikole zibe indawo ephephile.
Umbuzo 1: Yini iTikTok? iTikTok iyinsiza yokwabelana ngama-video amafushane, eyasungulwa nguByteDance, inkampani yaseShayina, ngo-2016. Le nsizakalo ivumela abasebenzisi ukuba benze, bahlele, futhi babelane ngama-video ahlukeneyo, avame ukuba nobude obuphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-60. I-TikTok isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufaka umculo, izihlungi, nezithombe ezithokozisayo ukuze ikhulise ubuchwepheshe bokudala babasebenzisi bayo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani iTikTok ithandwa kangaka? I-TikTok ithandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokuba lula kwayo. Abasebenzisi bangakha ama-video anomthelela omkhulu ngokushesha, okudala umoya wokuncintisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo ezifana nezihlungi ezihlukahlukene, umculo, nezinsiza zokuhlela ezithuthukile, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuziveza. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iTikTok? Izinsizakalo zeTikTok zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokudala, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele emkhakheni wezobuciko. Okwesibili, iTikTok iyinsiza yokuxhumana, ivumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, nokuhlangenwe nakho. Okwesithathu, iTikTok iyindawo yokufunda; abasebenzisi bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela, nezifundo ezivela kwabanye. Umbuzo 4: Zikhona izingozi ezihambisana neTikTok? Naphezu kwezithako ezinhle zeTikTok, kunokukhathazeka okuthile. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yengqondo, njengoba abasebenzisi bangase bahlupheke ngenxa yokucindezeleka kokuncintisana. Okwesibili, kukhona izinkinga zokuphepha kwedatha, njengoba iTikTok idinga ukufinyelela emithonjeni ethile ukuze isebenze kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abasebenzisi bahlale beqaphela ukuthi bangabelana ngani, bahlale bephapheme ngezinkinga zokuphepha. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iTikTok iyinsiza yokukhangisa? Yebo, iTikTok iyinsiza ewusizo yokukhangisa. Amabhizinisi amaningi asebenzisa iTikTok ukuze afinyelele izithameli ezintsha, ikakhulukazi abantu abasha. Ngemikhankaso yokukhangisa efanele, amabhizinisi angathola ukufinyelela okukhulu, okuthuthukisa ukubonakala kwabo emakethe. Izikhangiso kuTikTok zihluke kakhulu, zisuka ezikhangisweni ezijwayelekile kuya kumavidiyo akhuthazayo. Umbuzo 6: Ungawusebenzisa kanjani kahle iTikTok? Ukuze usebenzise kahle iTikTok, kubalulekile ukuba necebo. Qala ngokwenza ama-video akho ahluke, akhangayo, futhi anomqondo. Sebenzisa izihlungi nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthuthukise izinga le-video yakho. Futhi, zama ukuhamba phambili nezitayela ezisha, njengoba lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi uthole abalandeli abaningi. Qiniseka futhi ukuthi uxhumana nabanye abasebenzisi, uphendula iziphakamiso, futhi ubonise ukweseka abanye. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuphila ezitholakala kuTikTok? I-TikTok iyindawo yokwabelana ngezindlela zokuphila ezahlukene. Abasebenzisi bahlala bebamba izifundo zokupheka, izindlela zokuzivocavoca, izifundo zokuhlela, nomqondo wokuphila ophilayo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bengafunda khona izinto ezithokozisayo futhi benze izinguquko ezinhle empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 8: Yini ezayo kuTikTok? Ngokukhula okuqhubekayo kweTikTok, kubalulekile ukuthi silindele izinguquko ezithile. I-TikTok izothuthukisa izici zayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nokuphepha kwedatha, ukuze ivikele abasebenzisi bayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukukhula kwezinkampani ezisebenzisa iTikTok ukuze zikhangise, kanye nokwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Isiphetho: iTikTok iyinsiza ethokozisayo, enezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi inezingozi ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani le nsizakalo ukuze bathole okuhle kuyo, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi. Njengoba iTikTok iqhubeka nokukhula, sizobona izinguquko ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza le nsizakalo ibe ngcono nakakhulu.
UDesmond Tutu Nomsebenzi Wakhe Emphakathini wethu, kade sikhula sikhumbula abantu abanephupho, abahlala benza umehluko. Omunye wabo nguDesmond Tutu, umfundisi, umholi, nomlondi wezokuthula. UDesmond Tutu wazalwa ngomhla zingu-7 kuNhlaba ngonyaka we-1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika. Kwakuwumhlaba ogcwele izinselelo, lapho ubandlululo belubuswa khona. UDesmond, owayengumfana ophumelelayo, watshala izimpande zempilo yakhe emfundisweni yenkolo. Wafunda eTshwane naseCape Town, lapho athola khona iziqu zakhe zefilosofi. Ubuye wathola iziqu zokuba umfundisi, wabe esebenza njengomfundisi eGroot Schuur. Lapha, waqala ukubona ubuhlungu bebandlululo, okwakuphikisana nemfundiso yeNkosi. Ngesikhathi sokubandlululwa, uDesmond Tutu waba yisithonjana sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Wavuma ukuba yisikhumbuzo sezenzo ezinhle, waphikisa ubandlululo ngezwi lakhe eliqinile nelikhanyayo. Wayesebenzisa umthandazo, kodwa futhi waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi badinga ukulwa ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwezombusazwe, i-ANC, lwamkhumbula, futhi waba ngumsizi walo ohamba phambili. Ngemva kokuphumelela kokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika, uDesmond Tutu waba nguMkhulumeli Wezokuthula. Wazama ukusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhloniphana, behlanganyela ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ohlelweni lwe-Truth and Reconciliation Commission, olwakhelwe ukuvuselela ubumbano phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Kwakuyinqubo enzima, kodwa uDesmond wakha izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezaziphila ngaphakathi kwempilo yakhe. UDesmond akazange agxile kuphela ezinkambisweni zepolitiki. Wayefundisa ukuthi uthando luyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma ngabe izinkinga zikhona, kufanele sihloniphe omunye nomunye. Isikhumbuzo sakhe besikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke siphathe abanye ngezandla zethu. Eminyakeni yakhe yokugcina, uDesmond Tutu wathola izindondo eziningi, wahlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele. Abantu bahlonipha umqondo wakhe wokuthula, futhi izwi lakhe labanjwa njengomthombo wombono. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma izikhathi ziba nzima, kufanele sibe nethemba. UDesmond waba isibonelo esihle sothando lokufundisa, lokuphila, nolwazi. Noma sekuphele iminyaka eminingi, umbono nempilo kaDesmond Tutu udlula emijikelezweni, ubalulekile kuzo zonke izizukulwane. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sothando olusebenza, nokuthi sizokwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga uma sisebenzisana. Kwakungelula, kodwa wayengavumeli ukwehla komoya. UDesmond Tutu waphila impilo egcwele umoya wokuthula, emisha, nokwakha. Umsebenzi wakhe usaqhubeka, njengoba umhlaba uhlala ufunda kulokho akufundisile. Njengoba sigubha iminyaka eminingi, sikhumbula uDesmond Tutu njengomholi ophumelelayo, umthandi wezokuthula, nomphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wakhe usale uthinta imiphefumulo, uyilungelo lokuphila okungcono kubo bonke abantu. Ngakho, nakhu, uDesmond Tutu akazange abe nje umholi, kodwa waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando luhlala lusemthethweni. Uthando lukhona ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi umphakathi uphumelela uma wonke umuntu esebenzisana. UDesmond Tutu waba yinkanyezi, futhi izinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya, zikhumbuza umhlaba ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kwakho konke.
Umbiko Ngokwakha: Izinkolelo Nezinto Eziphambili Kwezokwakha Isingeniso Ezokwakha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zibhekelele ukwakhiwa kwezindawo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lezi zindawo zifaka izakhiwo ezahlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini zomphakathi, izikole, izibhedlela, kuze kube nezindawo zokuhlala. Umbiko lo uzobheka izinkolelo, izinqubo, kanye nezinto ezithinta ezokwakha, ngenkathi sigxila ezintweni ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Izinkolelo Nezithembiso Kwezokwakha Ezokwakha akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kube nezinkolelo ezinamandla ezimayelana nekhwalithi, ukuphepha, nokuhlonipha imvelo. Ukuze izakhiwo zibe nekhono lokusebenza kahle, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthobela izinkambiso zomsebenzi, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, nokwakha izakhiwo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinyathelo Zokwakha Ukuze ukuqala iphrojekthi yokwakha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Ukuhlela kuhlanganisa ukuthola imvume yokwakha, ukwakha isikhumbuzo sezezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano phakathi kwabahlali, abaklami, nabakhiqizi. Ngaphambi kokuqala, kubalulekile ukwenza ucwaningo lokuhlola indawo, ukuqonda izimo zemvelo, nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinsiza Zokwakha Izinsiza ezisetshenziswa kwezakhiwo zithinta kakhulu umphumela wokugcina. Izinsiza ezifanele zifaka phakathi amatshe, isihlabathi, nezinsiza zokwakha ezivuselelekayo ezifana namapaneli elanga. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezingaphezulu kokuqonda, kuzokwenza kube nokonga, futhi kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezindleleni zethu zokukhulisa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo zibalulekile ekwakheni izakhiwo eziphumelelayo nezihlala isikhathi eside. Izingozi Nezindlela Zokuphepha Ezokwakha zinezingozi eziningi ezihambisana nazo, futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemikhuba yokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqapha abakwaqashwa, ukuhlinzeka ngamasu wokuvikela, nokwenza izivivinyo ezithile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izisebenzi kumele zifundiswe ngamasu aphumelelayo okusebenza kanye nezingozi ezingase zibe khona. Izihlahla Nezindlela Zokwakha Ezihambisana Nemvelo Ngokwanda kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomhlaba, kubalulekile ukwenza izinqumo zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izakhiwo ezisebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, njengesoloko, umoya, nesichumiso. Izindlela zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo zikhuthaza ukonga amanzi, ukusebenza kahle, nokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Izinselele Zamanje Kwezokwakha Kwezakhiwo, kuningi okuhambisanayo nezinselele zamanje. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi namathuba okusebenza, ukwehla kwezimali, kanye nezinguquko emthethweni. Ukubhekana nalezi zinselele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthole izixazululo eziphusile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nokuqonda okujulile kwezokwakha. Isiphetho Ezokwakha zihlala zibaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokwakha, sizame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi sinakekele imvelo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukudala izakhiwo ezingcono, ezihlala isikhathi eside, futhi ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo lomphakathi. Ukusebenza ngamandla, ukuqonda izinkolelo, nokuhlonipha umhlaba kuzoba isiqalo esihle sokwakha ikusasa eliyingqayizivele.
iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika: Isibopho Sokwakha Ikusasa Elingcono Ngokwezazi, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liyisikhungo esisemqoka emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Njengosomatekisi, iPhalamende linomsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo, ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Nokho, uma sihlola ukusebenza nempumelelo yePhalamende, kubalulekile ukuthola umbono ophathelene nobunzima obubhekene naleli bhodi, nezindlela zokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi iPhalamende lenza umsebenzi onzima. Abamele izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi bahlukahlukene, futhi baphumelele emavotelweni ayiqiniso, okukhombisa ukuthi kuphakathi kwabo lokho abavoti bakhetha. Kodwa-ke, eminyakeni edlule, sike sabona ukuphoxeka kwabantu emsebenzini wePhalamende. Abantu abaningi baqala ukuphikisa ukusebenza kwezakhamuzi, bethi akuyona indawo yokukhuluma noma yokwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza nokukhathazeka ngempumelelo yePhalamende. Kukhona izizathu eziningi eziholela kulokhu kuphoxeka. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphatha nezimfundamakhwela. Abanye abamele bahlala ngaphansi kokpressure yokwanelisa izidingo zabantu abavota kubo, ngenkathi kwezinye izikhathi behluleka ukugcina izethembiso abazenzile. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni zokungathembeki, lapho ukwaziswa okungeyikho nokuphikiswa kwemigomo kwenziwa ngokweqile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umphakathi kumele uqaphele ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezilungile zidinga ukuxhaswa nokusekelwa okuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphakanyisi bezinhlelo zemithetho bangabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwePhalamende nabantu kuzodala umphakathi ophilayo, ocacile futhi ofuna ukulungisa imiphumela yempilo yezakhamuzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudingeka ukuthi iPhalamende iguqule indlela yokuphatha. Ukuze kube khona ukuguquleka, izindleko zokuphila zidinga ukwaziwa futhi izinkinga zendlela yokuphila ziyafaneleka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufikisa izinhlelo ezihambisanayo nezicacile, ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Abaminininingwane badinga ukuvuselela ukubhekelela izinkinga ezikhaliphile, njengokuhlukumeza, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zezezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwePhalamende nezinduna zomphakathi uyindima ebaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kusiza ukubhekana nezinkinga ezinzima ezinobungane phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezimbandakanyayo kubalulekile, ukuze kube khona ukuqonda okukhulu kwezinkinga ezikhaliphile nezenhlalo. Empeleni, iPhalamende alikho phansi kwenhliziyo, kodwa lidinga ukuyikhulisa ukuze ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezisheshayo ezitholakala emhlabeni. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe, ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezimo zomnotho zidinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Abamele abavoti kufanele baqonde izidingo zabo futhi baphinde basebenzise indlela esebenzayo yokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika linomthwalo omkhulu wokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuthanda phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabamele. Ukuba khona kwezinguquko ezibalulekile kungavuselela ithemba komphakathi, nokuthi wonke umuntu ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile, esiqhubekayo. Ngakho, ake sizame ukubuyisela ithemba, sihlanganyele ngezixazululo ezihlakaniphile, futhi sakhe iPhalamende eseziqhamukile, esiqhubeka siphumelela. Kukhona umphakathi omuhle, umkhumbule, futhi uthubelekile esikhathini esizayo.
IShoprite: Iphrofayela Yomuntu IShoprite, njengomkhiqizo ophumelelayo, ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuzinikela, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo zabathengi. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1979 eCape Town, eNingizimu Afrika, futhi yakhula yaba yinye yezitolo ezinkulu kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. IShoprite iyaziwa kakhulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola ukudla nezimpahla ezisemqoka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite yathola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi wayo ube lula. Ngaphezu kokuba yisitolo esikhulu, ibuye ibe yindawo yokuhweba enezinhlobonhlobo zemikhiqizo, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, njengokuthenga ku-inthanethi, kwenze iShoprite yaba yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga. IShoprite iyaziwa ngokuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi bayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, ukwakha izinhlelo zokwethembeka, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ethokozisayo. Abathengi bahlala bejabule ngempela uma bethenga eShoprite, njengoba bekwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethokozisayo ngamanani aphansi. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, iShoprite ibuye ibhekelele umphakathi. Iphakathi kwezinhlelo zayo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, iShoprite ibamba izinhlelo zokuphila kahle, ezokuthuthukisa imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono, okwenza kube yinkampani enobuntu. IShoprite ibuye ibe nezinhloso ezicacile zokuthuthukisa imvelo. Iphakathi kwezinhlelo zayo zokunciphisa imfucuza, iShoprite isebenzisa izindlela ezihlanzekile zokuphatha imfucuza, futhi ibambisene nezinhlelo zokuvuselela imithombo yemvelo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iShoprite ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, kodwa ibuye ibheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite ithole izindondo eziningi ngenxa yokusebenza kwayo okuhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindondo zokuhlonishwa kwezokuthengisa, izindondo zokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo, kanye nezindondo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iShoprite iyinkampani ehamba phambili emkhakheni wayo, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. IShoprite iyinkampani ehlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengi nenkampani bungaba namandla. Ngokuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, iShoprite ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile emiphakathini, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza iShoprite ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. IShoprite iyinkampani enobuchwepheshe, enobuntu, futhi enezinhloso ezinhle, futhi lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi ibaluleke kangaka emhlabeni wethu. Ngokubheka phambili, iShoprite izoqhubeka nokuba yisibonelo sokuphumelela, ibonise ukuthi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo, kuyindlela yokuphumelela emkhakheni wezohwebo. IShoprite iyinkampani esebenza ngokuzikhandla, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, iShoprite akuyona nje isitolo, kodwa iyindawo yokuhweba enezinhloso ezinhle, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. IShoprite iyinkampani esebenza ngempumelelo, futhi izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza iShoprite ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi.
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Wethu Impilo yengqondo ibalulekile njengempilo yomzimba, kodwa imvamisa ayithathwa njengokubalulekile. Njengomuntu ophila emhlabeni wanamuhla, ngiyabona ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinselele enkulu, hhayi kuphela kumuntu ngamunye, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba, siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibaluleke kangakanani, futhi sifune izindlela zokuyithuthukisa. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona into ethile ethile, kodwa ibonisa indlela esibona ngayo izinto, indlela esiphila ngayo, nezindlela esixhumana ngazo nabanye. Ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, nokukhathazeka ngempilo yethu yengqondo kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ezifana nezifo zengqondo, ezithinta impilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Ngokwesiko, sithanda ukucabanga ukuthi izinkinga zengqondo zenzeka kuphela kwabanye, kodwa empeleni, zenzeka kubo bonke. Ngiyakhumbula isikhathi esithile lapho ngibona umngane wami edlula ezinkingeni zengqondo. Wayengazi ukuthi angakwenza kanjani, futhi ngaleso sikhathi, ngazizwa ngingenamandla. Lokhu kwangikhumbuza ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayikhulumi kuphela ngempilo yomuntu, kodwa ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Uma umuntu enezinkinga zengqondo, lokho kuthinta wonke umuntu okukhona eduze kwakhe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu benempilo yengqondo enhle, bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile kahle, futhi babe neqhaza elihle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukukhuthaza impilo yengqondo kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Kodwa-ke, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo, kudingeka sikhulume ngamasiko ethu. Ezinye izinkolo nezamasiko zethu zikhuthaza ukuba sibe namandla, sithande, futhi sibe neqhaza elihle. Kodwa, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokukhathazeka akuyona into yokuhluleka. Kunalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokwesekwa zingasiza abantu abahlangabezana nezinkinga zengqondo. Ngiyakhumbula ngesikhathi esithile lapho ngithola usizo, futhi ngathola ukuthi akukhona okubi ukufuna usizo. Lokhu kwangikhuthaza ukuba ngikhulume nabanye, futhi ngibakhuthaze ukuba baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyabona ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba. Itholakala ezinkingeni zethu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokukhula. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona okungaphezu kokuba nekhanda eliphilayo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nekhanda elinempilo. Ngakho, asithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba lokukhula, futhi kufanele sithathe leli thuba ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo.
UMartin Luther King Jr.: Umholi Wokulwa Nezobulungiswa UMartin Luther King Jr. ungomunye wabaholi abavelele emlandweni waseMelika, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe ekulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo. Impilo yakhe yayigcwele ukuzinikela ekufuneni ubulungiswa, ukuthula, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Wazalwa ngoJanuwari 15, 1929, eAtlanta, eGeorgia, wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo yokholo. Uthole imfundo ephakeme, waphothula izifundo eMorehouse College, eCrozer Theological Seminary, naseBoston University, lapho athola khona iPhD. UKing waba yisithonjana sokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo phakathi kweminyaka yama-1950 kuya kwama-1960. Ngonyaka we-1955, waqala ukukhombisa amandla akhe njengomholi kwezombusazwe ngesikhathi sokubhikisha eMontgomery, eAlabama, ngemva kokuthi uRosa Parks engavuma ukuhamba esikhwameni somphakathi. Le bhikisho, eyaziwa njengeMontgomery Bus Boycott, yaphumelela futhi yakhuthaza abaningi ukuba balwe nezinhlelo zobandlululo. UMartin Luther King Jr. wayenombono wokuthi ukulwa kwezenhlalakahle kufanele kube nokuthula. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphatheke kahle, baphendule ngokuthula, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuhlonipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibhikisho emikhulu, efana neMarch on Washington for Jobs and Freedom ngo-1963, lapho uKing ethula khona isikhumbuzo sakhe esidumile, "I Have a Dream." Kuleli zinga, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athole amathuba alinganayo. Umlando kaKing awukhona nje kuphela wokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo, kodwa ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile bokuhlanganyela nezinkinga ezinzima. Waba yisithonjana sokuthula emhlabeni wonke, futhi imiyalezo yakhe yathinta izizukulwane eziningi. Waphinde wathola iNobel Peace Prize ngo-1964, okuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuhlonishwa komsebenzi wakhe. Nokho, impilo kaMartin Luther King Jr. ayizange iphelele ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Ngonyaka we-1968, uKing wabulawa eMemphis, eTennessee, ngesikhathi esebenza ekulwisaneni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kwashiya umhlaba ubuhlungu, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphinde bacabange kabusha ngempilo kaKing, nokuqonda ukuthi imizamo yakhe ayizange iphelelwe isikhathi. Umlando kaMartin Luther King Jr. usafundisa izifundo ezibalulekile namuhla. Ubonisa ukuthi ukulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo akuyona impi yokuhlukumeza, kodwa kungumzamo wokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. UKing usikhumbuza ukuthi ubulungiswa buyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokulwela amalungelo ethu, njengoba yena waba nesibindi sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Ngamafuphi, uMartin Luther King Jr. ungumholi ophawulekayo, owashiya umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Imigomo yakhe yokuthula, ubulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu izoqhubeka iphila ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
