Qiniseka ukuthi ufunda imithetho yendawo yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga zomthetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukulungiselela Ukuhamba Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi i-drone yakho ilungile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri igcwele futhi ilungile. 2. Ukuhlola Izimpahla: Bheka ukuthi zonke izingxenye zisebenza kahle, kuhlanganise nezimpahla ezihambayo. 3. Ukubhalisela Uhlelo Lokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-drone lukhona futhi luthuthukisiwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuphatha i-Drone Uma usulungele, ungakwazi ukuqala ukuhamba. Landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Thola Indawo Efanele: Khetha indawo enokuthula, ngaphandle kwabantu abaningi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. 2. Qala i-Drone: Vula i-drone yakho futhi ulungise izilawuli. 3. Thola Isikhala Sokuhamba: Qiniseka ukuthi awuphumi emkhawulweni wezindiza noma ezindaweni ezivulekile. 4. Qala Ukuhamba: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uqale ukuhamba. Qaphela izimo zomoya, njengoba umoya onamandla ungathinta ukuhamba kwe-drone. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuthwebula Izithombe Uma uhlose ukuthwebula izithombe, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Lungisa Ikhamera: Qiniseka ukuthi ikhamera isethwe kahle. 2. Thola Isikhala Esifanele: Khetha indawo enezindawo ezinhle zokuthwebula. 3. Thwebula Izithombe: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uthwebule izithombe ezinhle. Ungasebenzisa izilungiselelo ezahlukene ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubuyisela i-Drone Ngemva kokuphothula ukuhamba, kubalulekile ukubuyisela i-drone yakho ngendlela efanele: 1. Phinda Uhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri isebenza kahle futhi uyayigcina. 2. Hlanza i-Drone: Susa uthuli noma amanzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-drone yakho ihlanzekile. 3. Beka Indawo Ephephile: Gcina i-drone endaweni ephephile ukuze ivikeleke. Isiphetho Ama-drone ayithuluzi elinamandla elingasetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukujabulela ukuhamba nge-drone yakho ngendlela ephephile futhi enempumelelo. Khumbula njalo ukuhlonipha imithetho nemigomo yokusebenzisa ama-drone, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyawasebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, ungathola ulwazi olujabulisayo nolwakha, futhi ube neziqephu ezinhle nezikhumbuzo ezinhle.
Ukushoda Kwamithi Ezibhedlela: Izimbangela, Imiphumela Nokuxazulula Isingeniso Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela sekuyinkinga ebonakalayo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi ikakhulukazi emazweni aseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushoda kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezisemqoka zokwelapha. Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuba ziqashelwe ngeso elibanzi, ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Izimbangela Zokushoda Kwamithi Izimbangela zokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela ziningi futhi zihluke-hluke. Okokuqala, ukungabikhona kwezinsiza zokukhiqiza imithi, okuhlanganisa imithombo yokwakha, izinsiza zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, kudala ubunzima ekukhiqizeni imithi. Okwesibili, izinqubo zokuhweba ezinzima nezimfuneko zomthetho ezimweni ezithile zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emithini ethile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imithi ethile ingatholakali ezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi emithini edingekayo yokwelapha izifo ezithile. Okwesithathu, ukwanda kwezifo ezibangelwa izimo zokuphila, njengezifo zohlobo lwezifo ezithathelwanayo, kanye nezifo ezihlobene nezimo zokuphila, kufaka umthwalo omkhulu ezibhedlela. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwemithi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphakeli bemithi nezibhedlela nakho kudala ukungahleleki ekuthengeni nasekutholeni imithi. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kwamithi Imiphumela yokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela ingaba mibi kakhulu. Okokuqala, ukungatholakali kwemithi edingekayo kuholela ekwehleni kokwelashwa okufanele, okwandisa amathuba okuthi iziguli zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokufa, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphansi okuphila. Iziguli ezidinga imithi ethile, njengezidakamizwa zokwelapha izifo ezinzima, ziba sengcupheni enkulu uma imithi ingatholakali. Okwesibili, ukushoda kwemithi kudala ukucindezeleka emithini, kudala umfanekiso ongemuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kokwethemba ezibhedlela, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba bakholelwe ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphume emithini, baphinde bahlale bephila ngezindlela ezingezinhle. Izixazululo Zokuxazulula Ukushoda Kwamithi Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele zokukhiqiza imithi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokukhiqiza ezikhiqiza imithi ethile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi itholakala kalula. Okwesibili, ukwakhiwa kokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphakeli bemithi nezibhedlela kubalulekile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhleleka okungcono ekuthengeni nasekutholeni imithi. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imithi edingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesithathu, uhulumeni kumele aqinise izinqubo zokuhlola imithi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi ethengiswa iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ekusebenziseni imithi engasebenzi kahle noma engaphephile. Isiphetho Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi edinga ukuxazululwa ngokuhlanganyela. Izimbangela zayo ziningi, futhi imiphumela yayo ibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, abaphakeli bemithi, nezibhedlela basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi imithi ethile iyatholakala, futhi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okudingekayo ukuze ziphile impilo enempilo.
Ezokuphathwa Kwezimali: Ingxoxo Ehlakaniphile Sanibonani, bahlobo! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile empilweni yethu: ezokuphathwa kwezimali. Ngiyazi ukuthi le ndaba ingase ibonakale iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa ngizokwenza kube lula futhi kujabulise. Ngakho, masiqale! Okokuqala, ake sixoxe ngencazelo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu akukhona nje ukugcina imali, kodwa kuyinqubo yokuphatha izinsiza zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungafinyelela imigomo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlaziya izimali zakho. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephila impilo enezinkinga zezimali ngenxa yokungahlelwanga kahle. Ngakho, umgomo wethu wokuqala kufanele kube ukufunda ukuhlela. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuhlela izimali? Kulula! Uma ungahleleli kahle, ungase ube nebhajethi engalungile, okungaholela ekutheni ube nemali encane yokuphila, noma ungakwazi ukugcina imali yokuthenga izinto ezibalulekile. Ukuhlela kahle kusho ukuthi uzokwazi ukugcina imali yokuphila, yokuthenga, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile empilweni yakho. Ngaphandle kokuhlela, kubalulekile futhi ukufunda ukuhlela ibhajethi. Ibhajethi iyithuluzi eliwusizo elikusiza uqonde ukuthi ungakanani imali onayo, nokuthi iyiphi imali ozoyisebenzisa. Uma usuhlele ibhajethi, kubalulekile ukuyigcina, lokho kusho ukuthi kufanele uqaphele izindleko zakho. Ungase uqale ngokuqopha zonke izindleko zakho zansuku zonke, lokho kuzokwenza kube lula ukukubona ukuthi kuphi lapho ungase unciphise khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngokuqapha izimali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uhlale ubheka izimo zezimali zakho. Uma ubona ukuthi izindleko zakho zanda kakhulu, kufanele ubheke ukuthi kungani. Kungenzeka ukuthi kudinga ukuba uphinde uhlole ibhajethi yakho. Ukubheka izimali zakho njalo kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi uhamba kanjani. Kukhona ezinye izindlela ezilula zokuphatha izimali. Isibonelo, ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezikusiza ukuthi uqaphe izindleko zakho. Lezi zinhlelo zenza kube lula ukugcina amarekhodi, futhi zikusiza ukuthi uqonde kahle ukuthi imali yakho isendaweni efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungasebenzisa ama-akhawunti ahlukene ukuze uhlukanise izinjongo zakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho. Ngabe uke wacabanga ngokutshala imali? Lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokukhulisa imali yakho. Kodwa, kufanele uqaphele, ngoba ukutshala imali akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili. Kufanele ufunde kahle ngezinkampani noma izimakethe ozifaka imali kuzo. Ukutshala imali kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uma wenza kahle, ungathola imali eyengeziwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume nangokugcina. Ukugcina imali kubalulekile, ngoba kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo imali yokuphila uma kwenzeka okuthile. Lokhu kungaba yinto efana nokugula, ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi, noma okunye okungalindelekile. Ukugcina imali kuzokwenza uzizwe uphephile, futhi ungabi nengcindezi enkulu uma ubhekene nezinselelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngezimali, akufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinjongo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sicele izinjongo ezithile, njengokuthenga indlu, imoto, noma ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, ngoba uzobe wazi kahle ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifinyelela. Ukubeka izinjongo kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi kufanele usebenzise kangakanani imali yakho. Kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikukhumbule: izikweletu. Izikweletu zingaba yingozi uma ungaziphathi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma uthola isikweletu, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukukhokha. Ukuphatha izikweletu kahle kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awuphumi emkhakheni wezinkinga zezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi kahle izinga lezindleko zakho, futhi ungazami ukuthola izikweletu ezingaphezu kokwaziyo ukukhokha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yezezimali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izimali zakho zikhona njalo. Ukuphila kahle kwezomnotho kusho ukuthi kufanele ube necebo elihle lokuphatha izimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukuphila kahle, futhi ungakhathazeki ngezinkinga zezimali. Ngokuphetha, ezokuphathwa kwezimali akukhona nje ukugcina imali, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuphatha izinsiza zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukufinyelela imigomo yakho. Ukuhlela, ukuqapha, nokugcina izimali zakho kubalulekile. Futhi, ungakhohlwa ukufunda nokutshala imali ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyakhula. Ngakho, bahlobo, masithathe lezi zinyathelo ukuze siphile kahle, futhi sibe nezezimali ezinhle. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela!
Ukuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu ezihlukahlukene, futhi ibonakala ngokucacile emiphumeleni yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Esikhathini esiningi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya kuhlobene nezimo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zikhawulelwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono abantu abawatholile, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngaphandle kokufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokufunda ezisezingeni eliphezulu, abantu basemakhaya bahlala bephoqeleka ukuba baphile ngezindlela ezincane. Okwesibili, izimakethe zomsebenzi zihlala zikhula kuphela ezindaweni ezinkulu. Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, izinkampani ezinkulu nezimboni azitholakali kalula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlale bezama ukufuna umsebenzi emadolobheni, okwandisa izinga lokuhamba kwabantu. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Imiphumela yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi ibonakala ezimpilweni zabantu. Okokuqala, abantu abangenamathuba emisebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla, izindlu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala bephila phansi kwezinga lokuphila elidingekayo. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekutheni abantu baphume emiphakathini yabo, baye emadolobheni, okwandisa izinga lokuhlala abantu emadolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza emiphakathini yasemakhaya, futhi kwandisa umthwalo wezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Imisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi benze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngamasu okuphila. Ngokwenza lokhu, abantu bazokwazi ukuthola amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi zisebenzise abantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo zokwakha izinkampani ezincane, okungasiza ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani ezincane zingaba yinsika ekwakheni umnotho emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukunakwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izizathu ezibangela le nkinga, imiphumela yayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha izindlela zokuthuthukisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, enempilo, futhi enezinhloso eziphakeme. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa el better kwabantu basemakhaya.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umsebenzi Wokubambisana Nokuhlonipha Ibhola lomnqakiswano, noma i-basketball, liyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yami. Njengomuntu othanda le midlalo, ngithanda ukubona indlela ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha impilo yabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekayo. Lokhu akukhona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokokuqala, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishukumisela abantu ukuba basebenze ndawonye. Umphakathi wethu udinga imisebenzi ethokozisayo, futhi ibhola lomnqakiswano iyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa abantu. Ngibona ukuthi lapho abantu behlangana emidlalweni, bahlala bejabule, bephuma ezindaweni zabo zokuhlala, futhi bejabulisa omakhelwane. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu besebenzisana ukuze bafinyelele umgomo ofanayo – ukuwina umdlalo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bahlala behlukaniswe khona ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukudlala ibhola kudinga amandla, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuzivocavoca, baphume emakhaya abo, futhi baphile impilo enempilo. Ngiyakhumbula izinsuku zami zokudlala, lapho ngazithola ngikhuthazekile, ngithokozisa umzimba wami, futhi ngithola ubungane obusha. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Ngibona ukuthi abanye abadlali baphuma ezindaweni ezinzima, baphumelela, futhi baba yizibonelo ezinhle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abanye abantu badinga abantu abakhuthazayo, abakhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuphumelela, noma ngabe izimo zikhona ezinzima. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha izimpilo, futhi lokho kuyinto engiyithokozelayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba ibhola lomnqakiswano likhula, kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abadlali baphatheke kabi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo zengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi umphumela omuhle awuhambisani kuphela nokuwina, kodwa futhi nokuhlonipha abanye, nokwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kumele kube yisisekelo sokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lidinga ukugxila ekufundiseni. Abadlali abasha badinga ukuqonda ukuthi umdlalo awuhambisani kuphela nezinga lokudlala, kodwa futhi nezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Umlando weSoweto Uprising: Ukuhlola Umoya Wokulwa Umcimbi weSoweto Uprising, owenzeka ngomhla ziyi-16 kuNhlangulana ka-1976, ungomunye wemigubho ebalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo yayihlanganisa abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ubonisa ukuthi abantwana, nakuba bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima, bangaba namandla okwenza umehluko. Abantwana abaningi babebonakala benesibindi sokuphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, noma ubudala bethu buncane, singaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ngiyakhumbula izithombe ezinhle zabantwana abavela ezikoleni, bejabulile, kodwa bazi kahle ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekene nezithiyo ezinzima. Umlando weSoweto Uprising akuwona umcimbi owawenzeka ngosuku olulodwa; ubonisa umoya wokulwa okwakukhona phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abantwana baphakamisa izwi labo, baphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlanganisa amandla ukuze ufinyelele izinguquko. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi weSoweto Uprising waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo ayizange iphele. Ngemuva kokubulawa kwabantu abaningi, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba izimo zazingezinhle, abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo yayihlanganisa abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha.
Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini Ngomphakathi wonke ubumbene, umcimbi obalulekile wezemfashini, owaziwa ngokuthi "Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini," ubungcweliswa ngempumelelo enkulu eGoli. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa abathandi bezemfashini, abaklami, nababukeli, waba yisigcawu esikhulu sokukhombisa ubuciko, ubuhle, kanye nemigomo yokuphila enempilo. Uhlelwe ngempela ukuze ugqugquzele ubuchwepheshe bezemfashini obuhlonipha imvelo, umcimbi wasetshenziswa njengendlela yokubonisa ukuthi imfashini ayikhulumi kuphela ngesitayela, kodwa futhi ithinta impilo, umphakathi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zomhlaba. Umsakazo uqale ngengxoxo ebukhoma phakathi kwabachwepheshe bezezimali, abaklami, nabadlali emkhakheni wezempilo, bechaza indlela imfashini engathuthukisa ngayo impilo yomuntu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethinteka kakhulu. Leli sonto, abathandi bemfashini bacelwe ukuba banake umphakathi, baqondise ukuqonda kwabo ngezinselelo ezibhekene nabaklami abasha, nokubaluleka kokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala kalula. Ngemva kokukhuluma, umcimbi udlulela ezinhlelweni ezithakazelisayo zokwakha, lapho abakhangisi bemfashini bebonisa imiklamo yabo emisha ehlanganisa izinsiza ezihamba phambili nezindawo zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili buhlinzeke ngamathuba okukhombisa izitayela ezintsha ezithinta umoya wezemfashini, futhi abavakashi bayaziswa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuphila engcono, iqhakambisa impilo, ubuhle, kanye nezinselele zethu zansuku zonke. Umsakazo wahlanganisa nezinye izingxenye zomhlaba wezempilo, lapho abathandi bezokudla bebonisa ubuchwepheshe bokudla okunempilo, kuboniswa amathuba amaningi okukhuluma ngalokho okuphakanyisiwe. Ngemva kokudlalwa kwamafilimu afundisayo, abavakashi bathola ithuba lokuxoxa nabasebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, bephawula ngemicabango nemibono ehlukahlukene. Kwathi ngesikhathi sokudansa, abaculi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe baphakamisa umoya, bengeza ubuchwepheshe bokudala izifiso zomphakathi. Ubuciko bazo bukhombisa umdlandla, ubuhle, kanye nezikhathi ezinhle ezihlobene nezezimali. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde ukuthi imfashini ingabhalela izindaba ezenzakalayo, iyaziqhenya, futhi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni. Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini wahlanganisa abavakashi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganiswa nezinkanyezi zomhlaba wezokwakha, abathandi bemfashini, kanye nabadali bezindaba. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfashini iyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo kanye nempilo yomuntu, engafaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi okhululekile. Uhlelo lwemfashini yathi lwabe luhlala lukhombisa izitayela ezihamba phambili, uhola abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono, bejabulile, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Umgomo wokugcina lo mcimbi kwakuwukuthi ukhiphe abantu emkhakheni wezempilo, kubangele ukuthi bahlale bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo, futhi benza izinqumo ezithinta umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uzokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemfashini nezempilo, ngenkathi kudaleka izinkanyezi ezintsha emhlabeni wezobuciko. Njengoba umcimbi uphumelela, izivakashi zaphuma nezifundo eziningi, zikhumbula ukuthi imfashini ingaphezu kokugqoka, kodwa ingumphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphila kahle. Umdlalosezindebeleni aluhlanga lokuqala, kodwa umgomo wawo uhleliwe kahle — ukusiza abantu ukuba bakhe imfashini enempilo, ebumbene, futhi ephilayo. Umoya ophilayo, ubuchwepheshe obuphephile, kanye nempilo ehlanzekile, konke kuhlangene emphakathini ukuze kudaleke ikusasa eliqhakazile kulabo abahamba phambili emkhakheni wezempilo nezezimali. Ucwaningo luphinde lwaba yinsika yokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, okuhloswe ngazo ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezikahle kumiphakathi yethu. Ngale ndlela, Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini ube yisigcawu esibalulekile, esikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imfashini ingamathuba okukhula, ukwakha, nokuhlonipha impilo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuhle nobulelwe emphakathini, sithuthukise izimpilo zethu, futhi sisize abanye. Lokhu kuzoya phambili, kuqhakazise, futhi kuhloniphe imvelo, futhi ngokuqhubekayo, lo mcimbi uzoba sebenzisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Ekugcineni, kulindeleke ukuthi lo mcimbi uzophinde ube yisibonelo sokwakha imfashini ethokozisayo, enempilo, futhi esebenzayo, ehlonipha umhlaba kanye nomphakathi.
uCyril Ramaphosa Umbuzo 1: Ubani uCyril Ramaphosa? UCyril Ramaphosa ungumholi wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, owaziwa kakhulu njengomongameli wezwe. Wazalelwa eSoweto, eGoli, ngomhla ka-17 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1952. Ngaphambi kokuba abe ngumongameli, uRamaphosa wayengumsebenzi wezomnotho, umphakathi, kanye nomholi wezombusazwe. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekulweni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abamnyama ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyamkhombisa njengomholi? URamaphosa wathola ukuqashelwa kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Ube ngumholi weSACP (iSouth African Communist Party) kanye neCosatu (iCongress of South African Trade Unions). Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni iANC (iAfrican National Congress) eyaqhubeka nokulwa nezenzo zokuqalwa kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kwenze waba yisithonjana sokulwela amalungelo abantu, futhi waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni umthetho ohlonipha amalungelo abantu. Umbuzo 3: URamaphosa wathola kanjani isikhundla somongameli? Ngemva kokuphumelela kweziqu zeqembu le-ANC, uRamaphosa waba ngumongameli wezwe ngonyaka ka-2018, kulandela ukuhamba kukaJacob Zuma. Uthole ukwesekwa okukhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, njengoba abantu bebefuna ushintsho emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo uRamaphosa abhekene nazo? Njengomongameli, uRamaphosa ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula komnotho, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha zikhona ezweni. Ubuye abhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nezinkinga ezibangelwa yizigameko zokukhwabanisa. URamaphosa udinga ukujola phakathi kwezidingo zabantu kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 5: URamaphosa ubheka kanjani ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika? URamaphosa ubona ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika njengelihle, uma abantu behlanganyela ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uthembisa ukulwela ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ubuye ugqugquzele ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngezwe labo. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyakhayo uRamaphosa emkhakheni wezempilo? Ngaphansi kokuhola kukaRamaphosa, izinhlelo zempilo zathuthukiswa, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seCovid-19. Ubuye wabeka phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu banokufinyelela kwezempilo. URamaphosa uqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona, futhi zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 7: URamaphosa ubamba kanjani izinkulumo zomhlaba? URamaphosa ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ezinkulumweni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ezomnotho, kanye nezokuhlalisana. Uhlanganyela nezinye izizwe emihlanganweni emikhulu, lapho abamba khona izinkulumo ezibalulekile zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe. Ubuye ugqugquzele izinhlelo zokubambisana kwezomnotho phakathi kwamazwe. Umbuzo 8: URamaphosa ubona kanjani indima yabesifazane? URamaphosa ubona indima yabesifazane njengengxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthuthukisa izinhlelo zokweseka abesifazane emikhakheni ehlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuphepha. Ubuye ugqugquzele ukulingana phakathi kwabantu, ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukuthola amathuba alinganayo. Umbuzo 9: Yini uRamaphosa ayikhuthaza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa? URamaphosa ukholelwa ekutheni ukuthuthukiswa kwezwe kudinga izinhlelo ezihlangene. Uthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhweba, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ubuye uqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zifinyelela kubantu bonke, hhayi kuphela ezindaweni ezithile. Umbuzo 10: Yini abantu abangayilindela kuRamaphosa esikhathini esizayo? Abantu balindele ukuthi uRamaphosa aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima ekubhekaneni nezinselelo ezikhona. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuthuthukisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu baphinde balindele ukuthi uRamaphosa aqhubeke nokukhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze kube neNingizimu Afrika engcono. Isiphetho: UCyril Ramaphosa ungumholi onemibono ecacile, othembisa ukwakha ikusasa elihle leNingizimu Afrika. Noma ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ubona ithuba lokuthuthukisa izwe, futhi abantu baphinde baneliseke ngalesi sikhathi sokuhola. Ukubambisana kwabantu, izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, kanye nokuzinikela kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ithelevishini: Umhlahlandlela Wokusebenzisa Nokuyiqonda Ithelevishini iyithuluzi elibalulekile elithokozisa abantu, libanikeza ulwazi, nezokungcebeleka. Ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi ithelevishini isebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukwazi izigaba ezahlukene zokusebenzisa kwayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nemiyalelo yokuyisebenzisa kahle. Isigaba 1: Ukwakha Indawo Yokubuka Okokuqala, udinga ukukhetha indawo efanele yokubuka ithelevishini. Qiniseka ukuthi le ndawo inokukhanya okwanele, kodwa hhayi kakhulu ukuze ungakhathazeki. Faka ithelevishini endaweni ethule, lapho ungaphazamiseki khona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugxila kulokho okubukayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhala sikhulu ngokwanele ukuze ubukele kahle, futhi udinga ukuba nezihlalo ezikhululekile. Isigaba 2: Ukuxhuma Ithelevishini Uma usukhethiwe indawo, kulandele ukuxhuma ithelevishini. Qala ngokuxhuma ikhebuli yombane. Qiniseka ukuthi uxhumano luhlala lukhona ukuze ungaboni izinkinga zokungasebenzi. Uma unezixhumi ezifana ne-HDMI, qiniseka ukuthi zixhunywe kahle kumadivayisi afana ne-DVD player noma i-set-top box. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukushintsha phakathi kwezinhlelo. Isigaba 3: Ukusetha Ithelevishini Ngemuva kokuxhuma, sebenzisa umyalo wokusetha ithelevishini. Vula ithelevishini bese ulandela imiyalo ebhaliwe. Lokhu kuzokuholela ekwakheni izilungiselelo ezifanele. Ungakhetha ulimi olufunayo, ubone izinketho zokubuka, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ithelevishini iyakwazi ukuthola iziteshi ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuka izinhlelo ozithandayo. Isigaba 4: Ukukhetha Iziteshi Nokuqonda Izinhlelo Uma ususethile ithelevishini, ungakhetha iziteshi. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi iziteshi ezithile zingatholakala kuphela uma ubhalisile kumphakeli wezinsizakalo. Funda uhlu lweziteshi ukuze uqonde ukuthi yiziphi ezitholakalayo. Ungasebenzisa umphakeli wezinsizakalo noma imiyalo ye-thelevishini ukuze uthole izinhlelo ezikhethwayo. Isigaba 5: Ukusebenzisa Izici Zethelevishini Ithelevishini yanamuhla inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokurekhoda, izinhlelo zokubuka kabusha, nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Qonda ukuthi ungazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zici ukuze uthole okuhlangenwe nakho okungcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izinkumbulo ezinhle noma ukubuka izinhlelo ozithanda kakhulu. Isigaba 6: Ukuphatha Izilungiselelo Zokubuka Qiniseka ukuthi uyakwazi ukuphatha izilungiselelo zokubuka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukulungisa ivolumu, ukushintsha izilungiselelo zokuqapha, nokulawula izikhathi zokubuka. Ungasebenzisa umphakathi wezilungiselelo ukuze uthole izinketho ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulisa bonke abathandi bezokungcebeleka. Isigaba 7: Ukuzijabulisa Ngezinhlelo Zethelevishini Uma usuphethe konke, sebenzisa ithelevishini ukuze uzijabulise. Khetha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, izimidlalo, noma amafilimu. Ungabuka izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezingezona ezokungcebeleka, ukuze uthole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangani. Isigaba 8: Ukuhlola Izinkinga Nokuxazulula Noma kunjalo, kungase kube nezinkinga ezithile. Uma ithelevishini ingasebenzi kahle, hlola ukuthi zonke izixhumi zixhunywe kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli wezinsizakalo uyasebenza. Uma ungakatholi iziteshi, zama ukusetha kabusha ithelevishini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezivamile. Isigaba 9: Ukugcina Ithelevishini Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukugcina ithelevishini. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyahlanzwa njalo ukuze igcine ukubukeka okuhle. Ungasebenzisa isicoci esithambile ukuze uhlanze ifreyimu nezinye izingxenye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ithelevishini yakho ihlala isebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ithelevishini iyithuluzi eliwusizo elinikeza abantu ithuba lokuzijabulisa, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukujabulisa umndeni nabangani, uthole ulwazi, futhi ujabulele izikhathi ezinhle. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyayiqonda kahle ithelevishini yakho, ukuze ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Ngalolu hlelo, ungaba nekhono lokusebenzisa ithelevishini yakho ngendlela ephumelelayo.
ISAHARA DESERT: I-SANDY KINGDOM I-Sahara Desert iyindawo engaphezu kwezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezitshalo, iyinhlokodolobha yehlathi elikhulu lehlathi elinamahlathi abanzi azungezwe yizindonga zezimpophoma ezimhlophe. Lesi sikhala esiyisikhumbuzo sokuhle nokubi, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezimo zokuphila kanye nezingcindezi ezibhekene nehlobo elishisayo, izigameko ezinzima, kanye nezikhathi zobunzima. Ukwazi kahle le ndawo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-Sahara iyabhakabhaka impela, ibhalwe ngemihlobiso yokwakheka kwemvelo. Izindawo ezihlukahlukene zinemibono ehlukile, kusukela ezindaweni ezichwepheshile, lapho umoya opholile uvuselela khona, kuze kube sezindaweni ezikhukhulayo eziphezulu ezikhumbuza umhlaba omkhulu wezigidi zamathafa ezihlahla zomdabu. Ngelinye ilanga, lapho umoya ungena ngesithukuthuku, abavakashi bavakashela eSaharani kumasango eTassili n'Ajjer, indawo edume kakhulu ngemicimbi yamasiko namaqhawe. Lokhu kubukeka kukhombisa umhlaba wesibani onokuthula, lapho abavakashi behamba ngezinyawo, beshaya izinyathelo ezincane emsandleni wabo, nofana nendaba eshukumisa inhliziyo. Izinsuku zishintsha, izimo zezulu zishintsha, kodwa umoya weSahara uhlala unguye owamukelekile. Ngenxa yokuba yisikhumbuzo esingapheli, umoya ube uhlezi unqamuleka phakathi kwezinyoni eziluhlaza, izihlahla eziphilayo, kanye nezinyoni ezindizayo ezithokozisayo. Nakuba iSahara ingabukeka ingasondelene, ibambene kakhulu nezimpilo zabantu bayo. Abantu abahlala kule ndawo banobuchwepheshe bokuphila ezimeni ezinzima. Kukhona imiphakathi emikhulu, ezikhulumayo, nezikhumbulayo izinkumbulo eziyinqaba. Lezi zimphakathi zikhombisa indlela yokuphila ngendlela yokukhula, zikhuthaza ukujula emithonjeni yokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umuzwa ophakathi kwale ndawo ungatholakala, uvezwe ngendlela yokuphila kwansuku zonke kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kwazulu-ke izinkumbulo eziphilayo zempilo yomphakathi. Ubuciko bokuphila kwemvelo buhlezi bukhona, buvuselela izinkumbulo ezijulile ezihlobene neSahara. Ekuqaleni kwempilo, i-Sahara yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yokuhlola izimo zokuphila. Abantu baphakathi kwayo banemikhuba yokuziphatha ehambelana nemvelo, benza imisebenzi yokuhamba, yokuhlanza, nokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo. Lokhu kuhlangana phakathi kwabantu nemvelo kubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile obukhona phakathi kwabo. Ngaphandle kokukhula komphakathi, iSahara iyindawo yokuhlola. Izifundo ezitholakala kule ndawo ziqhubeka zikhula, zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokuphila, ezifaka phakathi ukujula empilweni, ukuhlanganisa imikhuba, nokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile, behlola izimo zemvelo ezithokozisayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emazweni endabuko noma ezindaweni zamasiko amasha. I-Sahara, iyinhlokodolobha yemvelo, ibonisa ubudlelwane obujulile phakathi kwemvelo nabantu. Lesi sikhala sinesimo sokwakheka esiyingqayizivele, esigcwele izindaba eziphilayo zempilo. Abavakashi, abahlala, nabafundi, bonke bahlanganyela emizimbeni ethokozisayo, behamba phambili ekufundeni nasekuthokoziseni okuhlangenwe nakho kwabo. Ekupheleni kosuku, i-Sahara iyindawo yokubona, yokuhlola, nokucabanga. Okwamanje, ibonisa ubuhle bezenzakalo zempilo, ibalulekile ekwakheni izinkumbulo eziphilayo. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu, kanye nemihlobiso yemvelo, konke kubonisa indlela yokuphila, ukuphila kwansuku zonke kwabo bonke abahlala kule ndawo engamaSand. I-Sahara iyakhanga, iyakhumbuza, futhi ibambene nezinkumbulo. Iphakathi kwethu izifundo ezaziso, izinkumbulo ezikhumbulekayo, nezinkanyezi ezihlaba umxhwele. Ngaphandle kokuhlala phezulu, i-Sahara iyisiqalo esisha sokuhlola, injabulo yokuphila, kanye nemigqa emisha yokubona izinto ezinhle. Noma ubani ophezu kwayo, uyakwazi ukufunda, ukuhamba, nokuhlonipha le ndawo engamaSand.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyi-15, waphuma endlini yakhe eThekwini, efuna ukuhlangana nozakwabo uThabo. UThabo wayenolwazi olunzulu emidlalweni yevidiyo, futhi uSipho wayefisa ukufunda okuningi ngalolu lwazi. UThabo wayenendawo yokudlala emnandi, igcwele imishini yokudlala nemishini ehlukahlukene. Lapho befika, uThabo wamukela uSipho ngenjabulo, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi uthanda imidlalo yevidiyo, ngakho ngizokukhombisa okuthile okukhulu.” USipho waphendula, “Ngiyabonga, Thabo! Ngifuna ukufunda konke ukuze ngibe umdlali ophumelelayo.” Baqala ukudlala umdlalo obizwa ngokuthi “I-Quest of Legends,” owawuhlanganisa izigigaba, izitha ezinzima, nezimfihlo ezithokozisayo. UThabo wakhombisa uSipho amakhono ahlukahlukene omdlalo, waphinde wamchazela ukuthi umphakathi wabadlali ungaba nomthelela omkhulu empumelelweni. Umdlalo uqale, uSipho wathola ukuthi udinga ukucabanga, ahlaziye izimo, futhi enze izinqumo ezisheshayo. UThabo wamsiza wathi: “Khumbula, Sipho, akukhona kuphela ukudlala; ukufunda nokukhula kubalulekile. Umdlalo ungakufundisa ngezindlela eziningi.” Ngemuva kokudlala isikhathi eside, uSipho waqala ukujabulisa. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ayiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa iyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye, yokwakha ubungane, nokufunda amakhono amasha. UThabo wakhumbuza uSipho ukuthi imidlalo ingaba yinsiza yokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi uma umdlali efuna ukwenza kahle. Njengoba beqhubeka, uSipho waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe, wahlele ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yakhe. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo imvumela ukuba aphume esikhathini esinzima, akhululeke, futhi adlale ngendlela enobungane. UThabo wathi: “Umdlalo ungakunika ithuba lokuphila izimpilo ezahlukene, ungaba yisiboshwa, umphakathi, noma ungumuntu wezinkanyezi.” Ngemuva kokudlala, uSipho waphawula ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokufunda. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo ethile ifundisa amakhono afana nokuhlela, ukuphatha isikhathi, nokuxhumana nabanye. UThabo waphinda wathi: “Uma udlala, ungafunda ukubamba izinqumo ezinzima, futhi ungabhekana nezimo ezinzima.” Umdlalo waphothulwa, futhi uSipho waba nomuzwa wokuphumelela. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi uThabo wamsiza ukuba aqonde ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe. UThabo wathi: “Khumbula, Sipho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa kufanele uyisebenzise ngokucophelela. Ungavumeli ukuba ibangele izinkinga empilweni yakho.” U-Sipho waphendula: “Ngiyavuma, Thabo. Ngizokwenza kahle, futhi ngizokusebenzisa imidlalo yevidiyo ukuze ngithuthukise amakhono ami.” UThabo wamamatheka, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi uzokwenza kahle, Sipho. Umdlalo ungakunika ithuba lokukhula, kodwa kufanele uqaphele.” Ngemuva kokuhamba noThabo, uSipho wathola ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu, yokwakha ubungane, nokufunda. Waqonda ukuthi akufanele ayivumele imidlalo yevidiyo ibangele izinkinga empilweni yakhe, kodwa kufanele ayisebenzise ukuze akhule. U-Sipho waphuma endlini kaThabo, enomuzwa wokuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathola ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuzijabulisa, yokufunda, nokwakha ubungane. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele ayisebenzise kahle, ukuze akhule futhi aphumelele empilweni. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba nesifiso sokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngemidlalo yevidiyo, efuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe, futhi waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuphila, yokukhula, nokwakha ubungane. U-Sipho wathola ithemba lokuthi uzoba umdlali ophumelelayo, futhi wafunda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvela KweCOVID-19 Kwathi lapho konke kubonakala kulungile emhlabeni, izinkanyezi zahambaklungile. Ngonyaka ka-2019, emzamweni wobuchwepheshe, isifo esisha saqhamuka ngaphakathi kwendawo yaseChina, edolobheni iWuhan. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, beqhuba izimpilo zabo nsuku zonke, begijima ebhizinisini, bephumula nozakwabo, begubha imicimbi. Kodwa-ke, kanti iCOVID-19, isifo esithathelana kalula, saba sekuvele, futhi kwashintsha umhlaba ongenangqondo ngokuphelele. Abantu baqala ukuhamba benganaki, bemisebe ngaphandle, bephuza iziphuzo, kodwa sekungaphakathi kobhontshisi benhliziyo, kube sekuvinjwa ubusuku. Amathuba okuxhumana atholakale ezimpilweni zabo, ezokukhulumisana azishiywa ziqhuqhuqe. Izibhedlela zathuthuka, zaba zindawo ezingenamathambo, lapho iziguli bezidinga usizo oluningi. Isahluko 2: Ukuqwashisa neZinyathelo Zokuvikela Njengoba isifo sisaqhubeka sithathela abantu, kwavela izinhlelo zokuvikela. Izikhungo zezempilo zathumela imiyalezo ezithombeni, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bagcine izikhuhlane. Umphakathi wathi ukwazi, uye nenyunyana yokwakha izitayela zokuhlala kude, ukuhlanzeka, nokuhamba ngezinye izindlela ezimbi kakhulu. Umphakathi wavuka, bahlangana futhi bahlasela lesi sifo, benza konke okusemandleni ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuhamba kwesitho sokugula. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, amakhompiyutha aqhubeka ahlola izinkomba, kwakhululeka imiyalezo eminingi. Ukuzihlanganisa umsebenzi, kubonakala njengomhlaba omunye, umoya wena uhlanganiswe, wasusa ubuhlungu obungaka. Bafunda ngokuhlangana, baqonda ukuthi umphakathi ubulungiswa kukho, futhi amandla omthetho nenkohlakalo awafaneleki. Isahluko 3: Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, umphakathi uzama ukujwayela ukukhalipha kweCOVID-19. Abantu baqala ukufunda ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, izinsuku zethu zikhula zathokozisa ngokuhlangana kokusebenza. Okuyintandokazi, abantu baqiniseka ukuthi inkululeko iyavuma ubuhlakani; badlala imidlalo ye-intanethi, besekela omakhelwane, benza ubungane. Ubudlelwane busakhula, futhi umphakathi ubhalela izindaba ezinhle eziphefumlelweyo. Ubuchwepheshe baphinda buvuleleka; abantu baqala ukufunda nokuhlala bexhumekile, zakhele amakhono amasha. Imikhankaso yokuxhaswa ngokwengqondo yabonakala ibalulekile, ngaleso sikhathi abantu beqala ukubeka izimpawu zomphakathi, beba nezimpilo ezithathe ngokwakho, bebonisa ubumbano. Becela abafundi, bese belandela imigqa yezehlakalo, besebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana njengezikhwama zokugcina ukuthula, behlakanipha ukuthola imithombo yokukhuthaza. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga LweMithetho Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izithiyo zathuthukiswa, kubonakala izindlela ezivuma ukuba nemigomo ethile. Umhlaba waba nesikhashana sokugcina ngaphansi kokuvikela, kodwa omunye nomunye wathola ngokuziqhenya impumelelo eminyakeni emithathu. Ukuzithokozisa nezinto ezenzeka emhlabeni zakha ivolumu yokubonisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu basifundisa isiZulu sokuqala. Bahamba ngebhajethi emisha yokugubha izimbizo, bethola izigidi zomsebenzi, benza izifundo zokuhlala bezithokozisa. Kodwa-ke, okwakukhona akukaze kuphinde kwenzele emhlabeni wesimanje, ukwakha ubudlelwane otatazile bekelele. Isahluko 5: Ukuhlanganisa Ukubuka Kwekusasa Ngokuba isifo seCOVID-19 sawuveza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, izinsuku zabe zimnthongo, zikhumbuza izinto eziyinkolo. Abantu bamele labo abasebenza, imindeni nabangane bephuma ezikhathini ezinzima. Bahamba embusweni, kubonakala ukuchuma, ubenzisa polokohle ekulungiseni. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka zihlangana, ubuchwepheshe buvuka emathafeni, sikubona izindlela ezintsha zokuceba. Abantu balungisela izikhathi ezilandelayo, behola izifiso zabo, bephila impilo engcono. Ngendlela, kuze kube namuhla, abafundi basacabanga ukuthi iCOVID-19 ihamba, kodwa kusalisaphila isiZulu sokuqala. Ngaphezu kwamazinga agulayo, umphakathi wobuhlobo baqinisekisa, bazama ukubuyisela okwakukhona, njengoba besebenzisa impilo yabo ngendlela efanele. Uhola izinyathelo, izinyunyana ezimbalwa, kugqugquzelwa ukubambisana — ukuze konke kuqhamuke, kuthi iCOVID-19 ibonakale njengehlelo njengokukhumbula, konke kuhamba, nobuhlobo baphakathi kwabo. Isiphetho: Ngalezi zinsukwana, iCOVID-19 ikhubaza umhlaba, kodwa thina siphumile siphilile, sithokozisa umoya wokubambisana, sikhumbule ubuhle bempilo. Abantu bazazi, bathokozisa ukuphila, behamba ngemigudu emisha, bephila ngezifiso zabo. Impilo isithonjiwe, ubuhlobo ayezothokozisa ngenhlonipho, ngomsakazo wothando, sengibuza umphakathi, ngiyabonga!
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThabo Mthembu - Umholi Wezemidlalo UThabo Mthembu, umphakathi owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni wezokuncintisana, ungumfana ophuma eThekwini, lapho akhulele khona. UThabo uthanda imidlalo kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho aqala khona ukudlala ibhola likanobhutshuzwayo emijikijeleni yasendaweni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhambisana nesifiso sokwenza kahle, lokho kwaholela ekutheni abe nesithakazelo esijulile emincintiswaneni yezemidlalo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuba umqeqeshi weqembu lezemidlalo lendawo, lapho aqala khona khona ukubonisa amakhono akhe. Ukusebenza kanzima kwaholela ekutheni aqashelwe emincintiswaneni emikhulu, lapho abamba khona izikhala ezihamba phambili. UThabo waphumelela kakhulu emiqhudelwaneni ehlukene, waze waba umholi weqembu lezemidlalo elidumile, elaziwa ngempumelelo yalo. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo yenza uThabo akwazi ukuhlangana nabantu abaningi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kumenze waba ngumuntu ohloniphekile. UThabo uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yomphakathi wezokuncintisana, futhi uyakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele emikhakheni yabo. Ukuze uThabo abe yimpumelelo, ubelokhu eqhubeka nokufunda, efunda ngezindlela ezintsha zokuphatha amaqembu nokuthuthukisa amakhono abathandi bezemidlalo. UThabo akagcini nje ngokuba umqeqeshi, kodwa futhi ungumfundi oqhubekayo. Uthanda ukufunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha imincintiswano, futhi uhamba emihlanganweni ezahlukene ukuze athole ulwazi olusha. Ubuye abe nomqondo omuhle wokuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo waba nesifiso sokwakha umphakathi wezokuncintisana ophumelelayo. Waqala umphakathi wezokuncintisana wezinsizwa ezincane, lapho abantwana behlangana khona ukuze bazifundise imidlalo ehlukene. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantwana baziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yomphakathi ophumelelayo. UThabo uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa akakaze akhohlwe izinselele abebhekene nazo. Uhlale ekhumbula ukuthi impumelelo ifika ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, futhi lokhu kumenza abe nesibindi sokubhekana nanoma yiziphi izinselele. UThabo uyakholwa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyithuba lokukhulisa amakhono, futhi uyakuthokozela ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo ube nesifiso sokuhola imincintiswano emikhulu, futhi waba nesibopho sokwakha amakhono abaqeqeshi. Uthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele, futhi ubona imincintiswano njengendlela yokwakha isizwe esiqinile. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuzithokozisa, nokukhuthaza abanye. UThabo Mthembu ungumholi wezokuncintisana, umqeqeshi, nomfundisi, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi uyakuthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo ungumfanekiso ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele impumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imincintiswano yezemidlalo, futhi ubona ukuthi ukukhula kwempumelelo akupheli. Uthanda ukufunda, futhi ubona imincintiswano njengendlela yokukhulisa ubudlelwano, ukwakha umphakathi, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele impumelelo emincintiswaneni yezemidlalo. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi uyakuthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo ungumholi wezokuncintisana, umqeqeshi, nomfundisi, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuzithokozisa, nokukhuthaza abanye.
Ukunakekelwa KweZinsizwa Nezinsizwa: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, emiphakathini yamaZulu, abantu abadala babebhekwa njengemithombo yokuhlakanipha, ubuhlakani, kanye nesiko. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kwakuyisiko elijulile, elalikhombisa ukuhlonipha nokubonga labo abahamba phambili empilweni. Abantu abadala babenendima ebalulekile ekwakheni nasekugcineni isiko, futhi imiphakathi yayiqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabo kwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lukhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala zashintsha. Phakathi nezikhathi ezinzima, njengempi nezinhlekelele, imindeni yayithola kunzima ukunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta indlela abantu ababephila ngayo. Nokho, imiphakathi yamaZulu yahlala ibambisene, ibonisa umoya wokubambisana, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bayathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zokunakekela abantu abadala zakhula, ziqala ukuvela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zikhungo zazihlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, kanye nezinsizakalo ezahlukene ezazidingeka ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle. Abantu abasha babefundiswa ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala akuwona umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umqondo wokuhlonipha, lapho abantu abasha bejabulisa abantu abadala ngenkonzo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolo zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekunakekelweni kwabantu abadala. Ezinye izinkolo zifundisa ukuthi abantu abadala banelungelo lokuhlonishwa, futhi kufanele baphile kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithile zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa imikhankaso yokubasiza, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo zabantu abadala zanda. Ukugula, ukuguga, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima zaba yizinto ezazidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu abadala bekwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezizimele zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala, ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izikhungo ezikhethekile zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Abantu abadala baphinde bathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ehlukene, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzilibazisa, imidlalo, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokugcina abantu abadala bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala zikhula, zikhona izinselelo ezithile. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu imiphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abasha baphinde baphinde bahlale bephokophele ekunakekeleni abantu abadala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abadala baqala ukuveza izidingo zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ekugcineni, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Imiphakathi yamaZulu ibonisa ukuthi ukuhlonipha abantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Lokhu kuhlonipha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi, isiko, kanye nezifundo zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu abadala bahlala bejabulile. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa, futhi wonke umuntu ethola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Ukukhuphuka Komsebenzi Wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika NgoMgqibelo, uMgqibelo njengoba kuqhubeka umkhankaso wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, izikhangiso zobuholi nemizamo yokubuyisela ithemba kubantu ziqhubekile. Kwaqhutshekwayo imihlangano emikhulu yokuxoxa ngamasu nezinhlelo ezingabhekelela izinselelo ezibalulekile ezifaka phakathi ubuphofu, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezinzima. Izinkampani ezisheshayo, izigidi zabantu ziqhuba umkhankaso wokusekela izikhundla eziqavile. Abantu bazwakalisa ukunaka okukhulu ekutheni iziphathimandla zisebenzise amandla azo kahle. Ngenkathi nohlu lwezikhulu zokulindela oluqukethe abaphathi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, umphakathi uvuma ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yawo. Ngemuva kokuthola imibono emisha, uMnu. Thabo Mbeki, owayengumengameli, uhlonziwe ngokuqhubeka komsebenzi wakhe wokudala umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthe ukuphila kwabantu akukhona nje ukukhula komnotho, kodwa futhi ukubandakanyeka kwabantu ekuthatheni izinqumo. Lokhu kukhuthaza imboni enkulu yokuzimela, lapho abantu bezikhuluma ngezindaba ezibakhathazayo. Kuvela ukuthi abaphakanyisi izinkulumo eziphusile, abaholi bezombusazwe baye baphendula izidingo zabasebenzi, bezama ukuhlinzeka ngamacala okufanele abavule iminyango emisha. UMsasazi wezombusazwe uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, ubelokhu ebekezela ekuhlinzekeni ngobuhle bendlela yokuhlonipha imiyalo yomthetho. Ngesikhathi evidwayo, ugcizelele ukuthi ukuthi izinyathelo zamuhla zizosiza ikusasa labantu. Kule miphakathi ethuthukayo, izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono izimo zempilo zimenywa kakhulu. Kwazulu, umphakathi ulandela izinyathelo eziphawulekayo zokwenza ngezinga elikhulu. Lokhu kube ngesinye sezizathu zokuthi umphakathi uqiniseke ngokuthi abaholi babo basebenza ngempela ukuze kube nezinguquko ezibuhlungu. Ukwanda kwamathuba emisebenzi kubalulekile emiphakathini ethuthukayo. UJohn Khumalo, umphakathi wakwaZulu-Natali, uncomile inqubekela phambili, esho ukuthi ukwanda kwezinto eziphilayo, kuyazikhukhumeza izifundo ezintsha. “Emaphakathini ethu, yilapho sithola izikhala eziningi. Sinokukholelwa kithi, sizobe sihamba phambili,” kusho uKhumalo emhlanganweni. Ubugebengu, nokungalungile kwezomnotho kuholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Lokhu kungenza kube nezinkinga zokuphepha. Abaholi bezombusazwe baphendule kulesi simo, bezama ukwakha uhlelo oluzosekela ukukhula nokuphepha kwezindawo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga uchwepheshe abahlolisisa izindlela zokubhekelela lezi zinkinga. Sikhumbula ukuthi abaholi bezombusazwe kumele babe nethuba lokuzilolonga, ukuze bakwazi ukukhuthaza ukusebenza emiphakathini yabo. Lokhu ngaphezu kwalokho kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazinikele ekwenzeni izinqumo ezenzakalelayo. Isikhumbuzo sokwenza kube okwakhe, wukuthi umphakathi uthwele umthwalo wezombusazwe, kuyilapho amaqembu ezombusazwe efuna ukufaka ingxenye yawo endleleni yokwakha ubuhlobo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi, izigidi zabantu zibhala iziphakamiso ezihambisana nempumelelo, kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuzwakalisa imizwa yabo, nokuthi baxhumane nezikhungo zokuphathwa kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kuqukethe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni nezithakazelo zomphakathi. Umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe uyasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo ezidingekayo emiphakathini. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuba kudaleke imisebenzi emisha, futhi kunciphise ukuntuleka kwezinsizakalo. Ukukhula kwezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo, kudinga ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabantu, iziphathimandla, nezikhungo. Ubugebengu busa eNingizimu Afrika, bunokuphendula nokwakha izindlela zokubhekelela ukudlula izinselelo. Ekugcineni, ukuxoxisana phakathi komphakathi nabaholi bezombusazwe kubalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzola, futhi abaholi badinga ukuqinisekisa izindlela eziphumelela. Ngokuvamile, imiphakathi edinga ukuba igqugquzelwe, ukuze ingabi sikhanyiso esifundisayo kuphela, kepha ikhululeke ngokuphelele. Lokhu kumanje kubonisa umoya wezimoto eziphusile ezidinga ukwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile. Imizamo yezenhlalakahle ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Abaholi bezombusazwe, kufanele bahlomule emizamweni yabo, bese bezehlisa izindleko, ukuze kube nezinsiza eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuba nempilo engcono, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube yisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Isifiso somphakathi wethu usuku nosuku siqhubeka sisebenzisana nabaholi bethu ngaphansi kokucabangela izidingo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza kahle ukuzazisa, nokwenza umehluko omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Kukhona umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwemibono nezinhlelo ezih-win. Uhlelo olungcono luzoqinisekisa ukuthi siqhubeka sithuthuka, futhi impilo yembimbi izokhula ngokwempela.
iNyuvesi yasePitoli: Ukwakhiwa Kwezemfundo Ezinomthelela Emphakathini INyuvesi yasePitoli, eyaziwa nangokuthi iUP, iyisikhungo semfundo ephakeme esikhipha izifundo eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kokuba indawo yokufunda, ibamba nendima yokwakha imiphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, nezifundo ezithuthukisa umqondo. Ngikholwa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sinomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa labafundi bethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo engcono nenqubekela phambili yomphakathi. Okokuqala, sizoqhubeka sihlole izinzuzo ezihlobene neNyuvesi yasePitoli. Le nyuvesi inikeza ukufinyelela kumakhono ahlukahlukene nezifundo ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izifundo zobunjiniyela, ezomnotho, ezokwelapha, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala amathuba okwakha amaqembu anobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, ahlinzeka ngamasu okuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi iseNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukuthi ukwakha isikhala sokufunda nemisebenzi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezimfanelweni eziphezulu. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zayo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibonakala ibeka phambili izifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinhlaka zayo zokufunda ziwuhlelo olwakhelwe phezu kokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo, okwenza abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi bazokwenza kanjani ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Isibonelo, abafundi baphumelele ekwakheni izixazululo ezithile ezithinta imiphakathi yabo, njengokuhlinzeka ngezifundo zasekhaya, ukufundisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abampofu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo ezizimele ezihlanganisa ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini ethile ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlinzeka abafundi ngamahora okusebenza, okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo nezinhlangano eziphumelelayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi imisebenzi ibukeka kanjani, kodwa futhi kubavulela amathuba okuthola izikhala emsebenzini. Izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela nabafundi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene zikhuthaza ukubambisana nokuqonda okungcono phakathi kwabafundi. Isimo sokufunda eNyuvesi yasePitoli sikhombisa ukuthi abafundi banesibopho sokwenza izinguquko. Abafundi bahlala bephushwa ukuba babe necebo eliphusile lokuxhumana nezinkinga zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani, nokungabi nendawo yokuhlala. Abanye baphumelela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusiza, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu abasha ngokuqonda ubuchwepheshe, ezokuphepha, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza imiphakathi imatasa ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngaphezu kokuba yisikhungo semfundo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyindawo yokwakha izinjongo eziphumelelayo. Abafundi baye baveza umbono omusha ngempilo, ngempilo engcono, kanye nentuthuko ethinta izimpilo zabantu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwama-lecturers nabafundi kudala indawo yokuxoxa, okwenza kube lula ukufaka iziphakamiso ezithile ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakanyiswa. Ngokuphetha, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi izikhungo zemfundo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngokuvumela abafundi bakwazi ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokwakha, le nyuvesi iyakwazi ukwakha isizukulwane esisha sabafundi abaqeqeshiwe futhi abalulekile emphakathini. Ngiphakamisa ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo kumele ziqhubeke zifuna izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabafundi nophiko lwezokufunda, njengoba lokhu kuzoqinisa umphakathi wonke. Ngokugxila ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibonisa indlela yokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhule, bahlale bephokophele empumelelweni, neNyuvesi iyophumelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kanjalo, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukuqonda, ukuxhumana, nobuhlakani bomphakathi ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Ezokuphepha: Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Impilo Nempahla Yakho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Zihlanganisa izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu, impahla, nemininingwane yethu ivikelekile. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zinyathelo, sizobheka izigaba ezahlukene zokuphepha, izinqubo ezilula zokuzilungiselela, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izingozi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izingozi ezihlukene ezingase zibe khona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izingozi zomzimba, ezifana nezingozi zokweba, kanye nezingozi zedijithali, ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zingozi, cela ukuthi ubheke izimo ezijwayelekile ezithinta indawo ophila kuyo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuvikela. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lokuphepha Ngemuva kokuba uqonde izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela uhlelo lokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Izikhumbuzo: Beka izikhumbuzo ezikhumbuza abantu abahlala nawe mayelana nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kungaba yizikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe noma izithombe ezikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphele. 2. Ukubeka Izinsiza Zokuphepha: Qinisekisa ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengokwakha izithiyo, ukufaka amakhodi okungena, noma ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zedijithali. 3. Ukuhlela Ukuhlola: Hlela ukuhlola izinhlelo zakho zokuphepha njalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zisebenza kahle futhi zihlala zisesikhathini. Isigaba 3: Ukuqeqesha Abantu Uhlelo lokuphepha alusebenzi uma abantu abazi ukuthi kumele benzeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abantu abahlala nawe. Lokhu kungafaka: - Izifundo Zokuphepha: Hlela izifundo ezimfushane ezichaza izinyathelo zokuphepha, izingozi ezivamile, kanye nezindlela zokuzivikela. - Ukuhlela Imicimbi Yokwazisa: Hlela imicimbi yokwazisa lapho abantu bengakwazi ukufunda ngempela ngezokuphepha. Lokhu kungaba yizinkulumo, izifundo ezibukhoma, noma imidlalo yokufunda. Isigaba 4: Ukuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Noma ngabe uhlela kahle, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela. Kubalulekile ukuba necebo lokuphatha lezi zimo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Izinhlelo Zokuphuma: Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi angaphuma kanjani endaweni uma kwenzeka ingozi. Lokhu kufanele kube lula futhi kube nesikhumbuzo esicacile. 2. Ukuxhumana: Hlela indlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Lokhu kungaba yifoni, i-SMS, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. 3. Ukuhlola Izimo: Ngemuva kokuphuma, hlola ukuthi bonke abantu baphumile ngokuphepha. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi akekho oshiywe emuva. Isigaba 5: Ukuvuselela Uhlelo Lokuphepha Uhlelo lokuphepha akufanele luhlale lungashintshi. Njengoba izimo zishintsha, kufanele uvuselele uhlelo lwakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubuyekeza Izinhlelo: Hlala ubuyekeza izinhlelo zakho zokuphepha ukuze zihlale zisesikhathini. Lokhu kungafaka izinguquko ezidingekayo ngenxa yezinguquko ezimakethe noma izingozi ezintsha. - Ukubuyekeza Ukuqeqeshwa: Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu kuhlale kuqhubeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bahlale beqaphele futhi bazi ukuthi kumele benzeni. Isiphetho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuvikela impilo yakho, impahla yakho, kanye nemininingwane yakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi uqonda izingozi, uhlela uhlelo lokuphepha, uqeqesha abantu, uphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, futhi uvuselela uhlelo lwakho njalo. Ngale ndlela, uzokwazi ukuvikela wena nabathandekayo bakho. Khumbula, ukuphepha akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo: Ukuhlola Zokuhumusha Nokuqonda Ezizindeni zomhlaba, izilimi zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Zisiza ukuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokuhumusha imicabango nemizwa yethu. Ubukhona bezilimi ezingaphezu kwekhulu emhlabeni kuchaza ububanzi bemicabango ehlukahlukene, izinkolelo, namasiko. Kodwa, kulapho-ke izinto ziqala khona ukuba inzima, njengoba ukuguqula ulwimi kube ingxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezehlukene. Uhlelo lwezinguqulo luhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuhumusha—kusuka kokulula njengokuhumusha amagama noma izisho, kuya kokusebenzisanayo okufana nezincwadi, izinkulumo, noma evenini. Noma ngabe umhumushi ngumuntu noma uhlelo, ukuphumelela kokuhumusha kuncike ekwakheni ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezilimi ezihilelekile. Ukungaqondi kahle intokozo yomhumushi kungaholela ekuqondeni okungalungile, okuyingozi emiphumeleni. Ukuhumusha kusemqoka emikhakheni eminingi, njengemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezomthetho. Ezikhathini ezinzima, ukuhumusha okuhle kungenza umehluko phakathi kokuphumelela nokwehluleka. Ukuhumusha engxenyeni yezempilo, isibonelo, kudinga ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalo iyafundwa kahle futhi iqondakalayo. Umphumela wokuhumusha ongenalwazi ungaholela ekuphumelelweni okuhle, okuphathelene nezimpilo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela esihumusha ngayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, ezinjenge-Google Translate, ziye zaba lula ukuthola izinguqulo ezisheshayo. Nokho, akumele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinhlelo azikabi nemiphumela efanele ngesikhathi somqondo. Ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile kwezimiso zomdabu kungavela kuphela komuntu onolwazi nolwazi lwamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa ukuphepha kokuhumusha, umuntu usengumgibeli omkhulu kulokhu. Izilimi zihlala zishintsha njalo. Amaphutha, izinto ezintsha ezitholakala kumphefumulo womuntu, nezinguquko eziphakathi kwemiphakathi zinomthelela omkhulu kulokho okukhulunywa. Lokhu kukwenza kusemqoka ukuthi sihlale silungisa izinguqulo zethu ukuze zihlale zifanele izimo. Ukuze uhlu lwezifiso lungalungi, ukuhumusha akumele kube nje ukukhiqiza umphumela osebenzayo, kodwa futhi kufanele kuhloniphe ubukhulu obukhulu bemvelaphi yesizinda, imishwana, nemibono. Ubhubhane, iziyaluyalu zezinhlanga zezilimi nezinguqulo zibhaliwe ezithakazelo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Zihlala ziqhubeka nezihloko ezinzima futhi eziyinqaba, okwenza kudingeke ukuthi sibe namakhono amasha kokuhumusha. Ukuqonda izilimi akusikhumbuzi nje ngenqubo yokuhumusha, kodwa futhi kubonisa ukuthi imibono eyisisekelo iphetha kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukucwaningwa okujulile kuzo zombili izingxenye—lemikhakha yesayensi yokuhumusha nezehfuzo—ukuze uhlale uyazisa lokhu kukhula. Izinxushunxushu zezilimi ezisemanzini zikhombisa ubukhona bethu njengoMhlaba. Ukuhumusha akusiyi nje ukuhamba ukusuka kolunye ulwimi kuye kolunye; kuwumsebenzi owenza imbangi yezizwe, uhlu lwezizwe, nolwabiwo lwezincwadi. Akupheli, kumiselwe ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlanga, ubuwangelanga udaba lwangempela, kuphinde kesha uhambisane nemigomo eyisibonelo yokuxhumana kwangempela. Lokhu kudala umhlaba lapho imiqondo eyinqaba ibonakala, kanti izilimi zenzeka njengomlilo phakathi kwezimo. Ngokuphetha, uma sibheka izilimi nezinguqulo, sizithola sigcinwe emsebenzini omkhulu wokukhanya kwemibono ehlukene. Lezi zinto zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukuhlalisana kwabantu, okuhlangene endaweni yokufunda, kwazulu ezempilo, nakweminye imikhakha. Ukuhumusha akuyona nje umphumela, kodwa impilo yezilimi ezifunayo ukusizana, ukuze sikwazi ukukhuluma, sihuthumise ubudlelwano, sikwazi ukufeza izinhloso ezivamile phakathi kwezizwe ezithokozisayo. Kanjalo, ukuhumusha akufuni ukubhekisisa nje ulwimi; kuwukubamba izinsuku, izithombe, nemicabango ezihlukahlukene, ehlukanisa ‘thina’ nathi.
Inyama Yenkomo: Umkhiqizo Wendabuko Nezindlela Zokupheka Sawubona, mngani! Ngifuna ukukhuluma nawe ngento ethokozisayo, inyama yenkomo. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi le nyama ibaluleke kangakanani ezimpilweni zethu, ikakhulukazi emakhaya? Kuhle! Ngizokutshela okuningi. Okokuqala, inyama yenkomo iyinsiza yokudla ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Isetshenziswa kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi emakhaya. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyingxenye ebalulekile yemishado, imicimbi, kanye nezinsuku ezikhethekile. Akukaze kube nesikhathi esihle sokuhlangana nomndeni nabangani, sithokozisa inyama yenkomo emlilweni. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile uma bephuza inyama yenkomo? Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi sikaKhisimusi, lapho umndeni uhamba phambili, bejabulile, bephuza inyama emnandi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyisiko elihlanganisa abantu. Ngokwenkolo, abantu bakhuluma ngezinhlobonhlobo zokupheka inyama yenkomo. Uthanda ukwazi ukuthi yini engiyithandayo? Ngiyathanda ukuyigaya, bese ngiyifaka emlilweni. Lokhu kuhambisa izithako ezikhethekile, futhi inyama iba mnandi kakhulu. Abanye abantu bathanda ukuyipheka ngezithako ezihlukene, njengama-sauces e-soya noma ama-chilli. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kahle nezinongo ezithile, okwenza kube nempilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukufaka izindlela ezahlukene zokupheka. Uke uzame i-braai? Uhlanga oluhle lwezikhathi ezijabulisayo! Uthanda ukungena emlilweni, uphonsa inyama, bese ubona ukuthi ikhuluma kanjani. Lokhu kuyajabulisa, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuhamba phambili sithokozisa izivakashi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo inezinzuzo eziningi empilweni? Iqukethe amaprotheni amaningi, okwenza kube kuhle emzimbeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma sidla inyama, sithola amandla, futhi sikhula kahle. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala bejolisa emithini yokudla, kodwa inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu yokuthola amandla. Ngaphakathi kwamasiko ethu, sikwazi ukubona ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile uma bephuza inyama yenkomo. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyisiko elihlanganisa abantu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi ezinye izindawo zinezigaba ezihlukene zokupheka? Kukhona i-bobotie, i-braai, nezinye izindlela ezithokozisayo. Ngabe uzama ukujabulisa umndeni wakho? Ngokuphathelene nezindlela zokupheka, ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuhamba phambili nendlela yokupheka. I-sosati, i-braai, noma i-stew, konke kuyajabulisa. Ngabe uzama ukugcina izithako zakho zihlanzekile? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithanda ukudla okuhlanzekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukugcina inyama yenkomo ibalulekile? Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayigcina kahle, ukuze igcine ubumnandi bayo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ungayigcina kanjani? Ngabe uphila kahle? Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuyigcina emanzini, ukuze igcine ubumnandi bayo. Ngokuphathelene nezithako, ngiyazi ukuthi ezinye izimo zidinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi ungathola izithako ezithile ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izithako ezahlukene. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo ingasetshenziswa kanjani ezitsheni ezahlukene? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izitsha ezahlukene. Ngabe uzama ukwakha izitsha ezithokozisayo? Ngokugcina, ngiyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi izindlela zokupheka zihluke kakhulu? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela kulolu hambo lokukhuluma ngenyama yenkomo. Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza sibe nesikhathi esijabulisayo emakhayeni ethu. Hamba kahle, mngani!
Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi: Iziqondiso Zokuhlola Nokuqonda Ukwazi ukuthi ungayithola kanjani imali yokufunda emanyuvesi kubalulekile kubafundi abaningi abahlose ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Ukuze uthole le mali, kufanele uhlole izinyathelo ezithile ezibalulekile. Lezi zinyathelo zizokwakha isiqondiso esiqinile sokuthi ungabhekelela kanjani izimali zakho zokufunda ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Qonda Izidingo Zokufunda Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zokufunda emanyuvesi. Lokhu kubandakanya izifundo ezitholakalayo, izinkambiso zempumelelo, nezindleko ezihambisana nokufunda. Hlalani nibheka izikhumbuzo ezivela emanyuvesi ahlukene ukuze nilandele izidingo zabo ezithile. Isinyathelo 2: Bheka Izikhwama Zokufunda Ngokuhamba phambili, kufanele niqonde ukuthi zikhona izikhwama ezahlukene zokufunda ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungaba izikhwama zezimali, izikhwama ezivela kuhulumeni, noma izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini ezizimele. Qhathanisani lezi zikhwama ukuze niqonde ukuthi yiziphi ezihambelana nezidingo zenu. Isinyathelo 3: Thola Ulwazi Ngemali Yokufunda Ukuze uthole ulwazi oludingekayo, sebenzisa izinsiza ezikhona ezifana nezinkampani ezikhipha izikhumbuzo noma amawebhusayithi anikezela ngemininingwane ethile. Hamba emihlanganweni yokufunda, enze imibuzo, futhi ube nekhono lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi ukuze uthole ukwaziswa okwengeziwe. Isinyathelo 4: Faka Izicelo Zokuxhaswa Ngemva kokuba niqonde izikhwama ezitholakalayo, qhubekani ngokufaka izicelo zokuxhaswa. Qiniseka ukuthi niyafaka zonke izimfuneko ezidingekayo, futhi nithumele izicelo ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba enu okuthola imali yokufunda. Isinyathelo 5: Qonda Izinqubomgomo Zokubuyisela Kubantu abathola imali yokufunda, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zokubuyisela. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kwenzeka ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nezifundo zakho. Hlalani nithinte umnyango wezokufunda ukuze niqonde kahle lezi zimpahla. Isinyathelo 6: Hlanganyela Nezikhungo Zokuxhaswa Ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali kungasiza kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zinganikeza izeluleko, izinsiza, noma ngisho nezinye izikhwama zokufunda. Hlanganani nabanye abafundi abawutholile uxhaso ukuze nabelane ngolwazi. Isinyathelo 7: Landelela Isimo Sokuxhaswa Kwenyu Ngemva kokufaka izicelo, landela isimo sokuxhaswa okwenzekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde uma sekwenzekile noma uma kudingeka ukuthuthukisa izicelo. Isinyathelo 8: Thuthukisa Amakhono Akho Ngaphezu kokucela uxhaso lwezimali, thuthukani namakhono enu. Lokhu kuzokwenza nibe nezinzuzo eziphakeme uma nifaka izicelo. Qhuba nezifundo, thola iziqu, noma ubambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuchwepheshe benu. Isinyathelo 9: Xhumana Nabafundi Abasafunda Xhumana nabafundi abakhuluma ngempumelelo yokuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza niqonde izindlela ezihamba phambili nezinye izindlela ezithuthukayo. Hamba emihlanganweni, ube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, futhi uxhumane nabanye. Isinyathelo 10: Yiba Nesineke Ekugcineni, yiba nesineke. Imali yokufunda ayitholakali ngokushesha, futhi izinqubo zingathatha isikhathi. Khumbula ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola uxhaso kuzokwenza uthole impumelelo ekugcineni. Isiphetho Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola ukuqonda okunembile ngendlela yokuthola imali yokufunda emanyuvesi. Qonda izidingo, hlola izikhwama, futhi uqhubeke nokuqonda izinqubomgomo. Ukubambisana nabanye abafundi, nokuthuthukisa amakhono akho, kuzokwenza ufinyelele impumelelo oyifunayo. Ngakho, qhubekani nithobekile, nisebenzisane, futhi niyazethembisa. Imali yokufunda ingaba yithuba elihle lokuqhubekela phambili.
Isingeniso Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa, noma i-Artificial Intelligence (AI), kube yinsakavukela emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Le mikhakha ithuthukile kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, futhi ibonakala ikhulisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nemithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo ze-AI Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu ze-AI ukuthi iyakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezokwelapha, izinhlelo ze-AI zisetshenziswa ekutholeni izifo, zihlaziya idatha enkulu ukuze ziqonde izimo ezinzima. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokwelashwa futhi kwandisa amathuba okuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthutha ziye zathuthuka kakhulu ngenxa ye-AI, lapho izimoto ezizimele ziqala ukuvela, zinciphisa izingozi zomgwaqo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-AI iyakwazi ukufunda nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezintsha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo ze-AI zingathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zifunde kumaphutha azo, futhi zibe ngcono ekwenzeni izinqumo. Lokhu kubalulekile emikhakheni efana nezokumaketha, lapho izinkampani zisebenzisa i-AI ukuze ziqonde izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zithuthukise imikhiqizo yazo. Izinselelo ze-AI Noma kunjalo, ukuvela kwe-AI akukhululekile ezinkingeni. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuphatha idatha. Njengoba i-AI idinga idatha enkulu ukuze ifunde, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kwedatha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha ayisetshenziswanga kabi, kudingeka izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela ulwazi lomuntu siqu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yomsebenzi. Njengoba i-AI ithuthukiswa, imisebenzi eminingi iyashintsha noma iyaphela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baphenduke, bafunde amakhono amasha ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekukhathazekeni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavame ukusebenza emikhakheni ethile. Imithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu Imithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu ibonakala kakhulu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga ezivela. Ngokwesibonelo, ezokuxhumana ziye zathuthuka kakhulu, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukuxhumana kalula, noma ngabe bakuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana okungaphezulu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ubudlelwano bomuntu nomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-AI ibonakala ikhulisa umnotho. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-AI zikhula ngokushesha, zikhulisa imisebenzi, futhi zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola imisebenzi. Isiphetho Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziye zaba yinsakavukela emhlabeni wethu, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi zingaba nemithelela emihle kakhulu empilweni yethu. Nokho, kudinga ukuba siqaphele izinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi i-AI iyithuluzi elinamandla, kodwa kufanele lisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi i-AI izoba yinsiza enkulu ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono, kodwa kufanele sihlale siqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ukubambisana, ukufunda, nokuvikela amalungelo abantu kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo nelinobulungiswa.
iKruger National Park: Umhlaba Wokuhlola Imvelo Nezinyoni IKruger National Park, eyaziwa njengomunye wezindawo ezinkulu zokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, iyindawo ehloniphekile futhi ecebile ngemvelo. Le parki, eyasungulwa ngo-1898, ibhalwe emlandweni njengendawo yokugcina izilwane zasendle, futhi iyingxenye yeNhlangano yeMvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika. IKruger ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli, izilwane eziningi, nezindawo ezihlukahlukene ezithokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa Nokuthuthukiswa IKruger National Park iyisikhumbuzo sokuzinikela kwabantu abaningi ekugcineni imvelo. Ngemuva kokusungulwa kwayo, le parki yathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabavakashi. Namuhla, iKruger inezindlela eziningi zokuhamba, izindawo zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bayakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Iphinde ibe nezinhlelo zokuvikela izilwane, ezihlanganisa ukulawulwa kwezifo, ukuvikelwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yasendaweni. Izilwane Nezindawo IKruger National Park iyikhaya lezilwane eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinyamazane, izindlovu, izimpala, nezinyoni ezahlukene. Abavakashi bangathola ithuba lokubona lezi zilwane zikhuluma emvelweni yazo, zidlala, noma zihlala emanzini. Le parki inezindawo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni eziphakeme ezinezihlahla ezinkulu, kuya ezindaweni eziphansi ezinamahlathi. Lokhu kuhluka kwemvelo kwenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuhlola, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bahlala bejabule. Izinhlelo Zokuvikela Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKruger National Park ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukwehla kwezilwane, kanye nezinsiza ezikhulayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le parki iyahlala ibalulekile, izinhlelo zokuvikela ziqhubeka zisetshenziswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nemiphakathi yasendaweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baziqonda izinzuzo zokuvikela imvelo.
