Lokhu kwagcwalisa umhlaba, kwashintsha izimpilo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu bonke.
Ibhokisi Endleleni yezimpilo zabantu, kunendlela ebizwa ngokuthi ibhokisi, eyejabulisa, igcwele umdlandla nezinselele. Le ndaba ibhalwe ngaphezulu kwamaqondo, isibani esikhanyayo sezinselelo, imisebenzi eyakha izimpilo. Ngale ndlela, siphinde sithole ukuthi ibhokisi akusona nje umdlalo, kodwa isithombe sokuphila komuntu. UThulani wayengumfana ophuma emndenini ohluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ubutfo bukaThulani buyingxenye yeqhawe labo abaphila ngaphandle kwemisebenzi. Ukuze athole imali yokuphila, wathola ithuba lokufunda ibhokisi emzaneni. Kwakuyinsiza emnandi, kodwa futhi ibiyinselele. UThulani wathola uthisha one'sithakazelo sokufundisa, uMnumzane Nkosi, owabona ukuthi uThulani unezikhono ezikhethekile. Njengoba uThulani eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukuba namava amnandi. Ibhokisi lwalungaphezu kokubhaliswa phansi kwezinyathelo, kodwa yindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziphatha nokubambisana. Ubona uqobo izinzwa zakho, uncisha imizwa, ube noqhugo olungapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwaba nesikhathi sokuzilungiselela, waphinde wahamba emijukujukwini yamaqumu. Ubuye abone amanye abaqeqeshi nabanye abadlali bebhokisi, bejabulisa nabangama-pugilists abahamba phambili. UThulani wayebona njengoba bebhakabhaka phakathi kwemigqa yezigcawu, bejolela, bejula, beshayisana, bezithokozisa. Uthandweni lwabantu ngokuphelele, kwaba yinto engalindelekile kudala, hobha ehlonishwayo. Kwathi ngesikhathi esisodwa, kwaba usuku lokuqala lokuncintisana. UThulani ubeyisinyathelo esimangalisayo, ezwa ukucasulwa nezithokoziso phakathi kwabadlali. Ujubane lwalungepqile; ubunjalo obungaphezu kokufanele. Akukhona kuphela ukuphupha, kodwa ukufuna ukuziveza, ukuzokwazisa. Emcimbini, uThulani wathola imphumo engeke ibhujiswe. Waqala ukwenyuka, wakhumbula imizamo yokuqeqesha, abanye abakhe abalethe umphefumulo, nemicabango ebhulungela impumelelo. Waqala ukusondela phezulu, wahamba ngebhodi, yebhaka. Umphakathi waba khona, wanqamula iziphakamiso zakhe, waqhubeka phambili. Kodwa wambuza kwazulu - kwakungathandeki neze. Umphakathi waba konke, uqonda ukuthi ngubani ozobona impumelelo. UThulani, ngeziphakamiso zobuchwepheshe, wabambelela. UJohannes, eneminyaka emine ubudala, ungumngani wakhe, wayekhanyisile, wafika eduze, ehlola indlela ngaphandle kokuba noshintsho. Ngenxa yalokhu, uThulani wathola ukufaneleka kumphakathi, wafuna ukusebenzisa izinsiza nezinsuku ezinkulu zeqhubeka phambili. Waqala ukubonisa unyazi, ubuso bakhe bufana ngebhodi elikhulu kwiHholo yamaPugilists. Yayikhanya, igqokiswa kanjani. Wazama, waphindela ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinzima, futhi impumelelo yakhanya kahle. Ngemva kokuphela kweqhaza, wathola umklomelo owawukhombisa wonke umsebenzi wakhe. UThulani wayevuya, enelisiwe kwaze kwaba yisikhathi sokuhamba emzini. Umoya wakhe wawwenza ukuba azimisele. Waqhubeka nohambo, ethinteka kakhulu, ebona ukuthi ibhokisi aliyona nje imidlalo; yindlela yokuphila, yokuvuma, yokukhula, yokuphumelela. Jikelele, le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukufezekisa amaphupho. Ibhokisi liyindawo yokuhlola, yokuphula imingcele, ukuphumula phansi, nezinselelo. UThulani udale umhlaba omusha, kanye nezinto ezithinta abanye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ngesikhathi sokusebenza, singakhonjwa ukuphila kwethu, libuya lokho okudingekayo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda, sithuthukise izimpilo, sikhokhele abanye ebhokisini lempumelelo. Ibhokisi alisona nje isikhumbuzo, kodwa indlela yokuzwakalisa ubuhlakani bethu. Futhi, njengokufika kwezinkanyezi, impilo isiveza kahle, iyazithokozisa kubo bonke abashumayelayo.
Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Kwakhanya ilanga, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Phakathi kwezinkanyezi, kukhona umhlaba owawungaziwa – umhlaba weshashalazi. Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane, futhi ibonisa ubuciko bokuphila kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokukhumbula izenzakalo ezibalulekile, izinganekwane, nemfundo ethile. Abantu babebuthana emithonjeni, ezindaweni ezikhethekile, ukuze babone abalingisi bephila izindaba ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwakungelula, ngoba abalingisi babephila izinkanyezi, bephila izimpilo ezahlukene, futhi bezama ukudlulisa imizwa yabo kubabukeli. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso zabantu. Ngonyaka owodwa, umqondisi ophumelelayo, uMnumzane Mthembu, waphakamisa umbono omusha. Wathi, “Ngifuna ukudala umhlaba lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuzwakalisa imizwa yabo, bahlabe umxhwele, futhi bakhumbule ukuthi baphila kanjani.” Waqala ukuhlela imidlalo ehlobene nezinkinga zomphakathi, efaka izindaba zothando, ubuhlungu, nempilo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho abalingisi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, behlola izimo ezinzima, futhi bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu baphenduka bezobona imidlalo, bejabulile, bezwa ukuthi imidlalo ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abalingisi, abaqondisi, nababukeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umhlaba ophilayo. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yabe isiyindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso, futhi yathola indawo ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu. Njengoba imidlalo yeshashalazi iqhubeka, kwavela abalingisi abasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. UThandiwe, intombazane eyayiphuma emakhaya, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imidlalo ingashintsha impilo yomuntu. Waqala ukudlala indima encane, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba yinkanyezi enkulu. UThandiwe wayenenhloso yokudlala, futhi wayefuna ukwabelana ngempilo yakhe nabanye. Waqhubeka nokukhula, waba yisithombe sokuphumelela, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Kwakukhona uSipho, owayengumculi, noNandi, owayengumqondisi. Bobabili babebambisene, behlanganisa umculo, ukudansa, nezinkanyezi eziphilayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ubuhle bokuphila, ubudlelwano, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ababukeli babebonisa uthando, behlabelela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Kodwa, njengazo zonke izinto, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nezinselelo. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengakuthandi, noma imidlalo ingatholi ukwesekwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubuyisela emuva, nokucabanga ngempilo. UMthembu, noThandiwe, noSipho, babebonisa ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ayigcini nje ngokuba yindawo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, yokubhekana nezinkinga, nokwakha umphakathi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinzima, imidlalo yeshashalazi yaphinde yaphumelela. Ababukeli babebuyela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. UThandiwe, uSipho, noNandi baphinde bakha imidlalo emisha, ethokozisayo, futhi eyakhayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane. Yaba yindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala ibalulekile, futhi izinkanyezi zayo zihlala zikhanya, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsika, ibhuloho, futhi iyindlela yokuphila. Ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile, esifanele ukuba sikhumbule njalo.
uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngizokhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile emlandweni wethu, okungukuthi, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976. Lolu suku luhlonishwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi luhlanganisa izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa futhi zinesifundo esibalulekile esithinta izizukulwane eziningi. Sizobuyela emuva kancane, sikhumbule ukuthi kwenzeka ini ngaleso sikhathi. NgoJuni 16, 1976, eSoweto, abantwana bephuma ezikoleni, bephakamisa izwi labo ngokuphikisa ukufundiswa ngolimi lwesiNgisi. Abantwana babenokukhathazeka okukhulu, bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzobathinta kakhulu empilweni yabo. Uhlelo lokufunda lwakha umphakathi, kodwa abantwana babengafuni ukuba bahlupheke ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle isiNgisi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uhlelo lwezemfundo lwaluhamba phambili, kodwa lwalunokungalingani okukhulu. Abafundi abamnyama babenokufunda okungaphansi, kanti abamhlophe babelungiselelwe kahle. Lokhu kwadala umuzwa wokungabi namandla phakathi kwabantu abasha, futhi kwavula umnyango wokuphikisa. Uhlelo lwemfundo lwaluhambisana nezinhlelo zikaHulumeni, ezazigxile ekwakheni umphakathi owodwa, kodwa lokho akuhambelani neqiniso. Abantwana beSoweto bahlala behlupheka, futhi lokho kwaba yisizathu sokuthi baphume emigwaqweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imihlangano yokuqala yamaBasha yenzeka, lapho abantwana behlangana khona, bephakamisa izwi labo. Uhlelo lokuphikisa lwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokho kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela izinkanyezi eziningi, abantu abanjengoHector Pieterson, owayengumfana ophuthumayo, owathinteka kakhulu kulolu suku. Uthando lwakhe nolwazi lwakhe lwashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha lwashintsha, lwaba usuku lokukhumbula. Ngonyaka wezi-1976, abantu baqala ukuhamba bephakamisa izikhumbuzo, behlonipha lezi zinsuku ezinzima. Iziphathimandla ziqhubekile nokubamba izinkulumo, zikhumbula labo abashonile, futhi zikhuthaza abantwana bethu ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha lwaba usuku lokubuyisana, lokukhumbula, nokwakha. Abantu baqala ukuhamba bephakamisa izinkumbulo, behlonipha labo abashonile, futhi beqonda ukuthi impilo yabo ibalulekile. Uhlelo lwezemfundo lwalusashintsha, kodwa abantwana basha bahlala behlakanipha, bephakamisa izwi labo. Namuhla, uSuku lwaBasha luhlonishwa emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini. Abantu bayahlangana, behlonipha, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhlangana kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, ukuze sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yethu ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Ngakho, mngani, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 akukhumbuli nje ngempilo yamaBasha, kodwa futhi kukhumbuza ukuthi thina sonke sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Abantwana bethu badinga ukufunda, badinga ukuba nomoya ophilayo, futhi badinga ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhumbulekayo, kodwa kuyisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi kufanele sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabanye. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinkumbulo zizokwenza ucabange ngempilo yakho, nendlela ongayithinta ngayo. Uthando, umoya ophilayo, nokukhumbula izinsuku ezinzima kumele kube yisifundo esiyinhloko kithi sonke. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sikhumbula, sikhuthaze, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha Ngiyavuma, lezi zinsuku sithola izinkinga eziningi ezithinta intsha. Ukungasebenzi kwentsha sekuyinkinga enkulu, futhi kubonakala sengathi akuphumi kalula. Ngabe sikhuluma ngani lapha? Ngabe intsha iyazama, noma kukhona okuthile okungahambi kahle? Lokhu kuzoba yinkulumo ethokozisayo, ngicela uhambe nami. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngezizathu eziholela ekungasebenzi kwentsha. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephikisana nezimo zomnotho. Imakethe yomsebenzi ibonakala iyinzima, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi. Abantu abasha baphuma ezikoleni, bephupha ngempilo engcono, kodwa uma befika emhlabeni, bahlushwa ukungabi namathuba. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, futhi abanye baphendukela ezindleleni ezingalungile ukuze bazame ukuthola imali. Ngabe ubona lokhu? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, kodwa akukhona nje ukuthi intsha ayifuni ukusebenza. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Abanye bahlala bezama ukuthola imisebenzi ethile, kodwa imakethe ibonakala inganiki ithuba. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela intsha, futhi lokhu kungenza abantu bazizwe bengafuni ukuzama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yansuku zonke yentsha. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu ngengcindezi yokuphila. Ubulili, ubudala, nezimo zomndeni zidlala indima enkulu. Abanye bahlala bezama ukusiza imindeni yabo, kodwa uma imisebenzi ingekho, lokho kuba nzima. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela, futhi abanye baphendukela ezindleleni ezingalungile ukuze bazame ukuthola imali. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi intsha ibhekana nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ukungasebenzi kungaholela ekudambiseni, futhi lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola amandla okuzama. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu ngengcindezi yokuphila, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukuthola usizo, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka. Ngabe sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi imiphakathi ingasiza kanjani. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona, kodwa abanye abantu abazi ngazo. Imiphakathi ingaba nendima enkulu ekusizeni intsha. Lokhu kungaba ngezinhlelo zokufundisa, izinhlelo zokusebenza, noma ngisho nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Uma imiphakathi ingasebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukusiza intsha ukuthi ibone amathuba. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi intsha ingazithola kanjani izindlela zokuziphilisa. Abantu abasha bahlala bezama ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe. Kukhona amathuba amaningi, kodwa abanye bahlala bephikisana nezimo. I-BMW - Uhlanga Olusha Lokuhamba Ngezimoto Isingeniso I-BMW, eyaziwa ngokuthi iBayerische Motoren Werke, iyinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ekwakheni nasekuthengiseni izimoto ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isebenza ngempumelelo nezidingo zabathengi bayo, ikhiqiza izimoto ezihamba phambili, ezinesitayela, nezokuphepha. Lesi sihloko sizogxila ekuthuthukisweni kwe-BMW, izimoto zayo ezintsha, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha. Ukwakhiwa Kwe-BMW I-BMW yasungulwa ngonyaka we-1916 eMunich, eJalimane. Yaqala njengomkhiqizi wemishini yokuphakela, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yathuthela emkhakheni wezokuthutha. I-BMW idume kakhulu ngama-motorcycles ayo, kodwa ngemva kokufika kwayo ezimotweni, yathola udumo oluningi. Izimoto zayo zaziwa ngama-‘Ultimate Driving Machines’, okukhombisa umgomo wayo wokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuhamba. Izimoto Ezintsha Nezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-BMW izama ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Izimoto zayo ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, zifaka izici ezithuthukisiwe zokuphepha, ukulawula, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. I-BMW ixhaswa kakhulu ekwakheni izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, njengama-hybrid namafutha kagesi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ekunciphiseni umthelela wayo emvelweni. I-BMW ibambelela emkhankasweni wokwakha izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi, okwakhiwe phansi komqondo we-BMW iX, ezihlinzeka ngempilo ende yokuhamba. Izinkinga Zokuncintisana Noma kunjalo, i-BMW ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Umncintiswano emkhakheni wezokuthutha uthuthuka ngokushesha, kanti izinkampani eziningi zikhuphuka ukuze zithole indawo emakethe. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Tesla zikhombisa ukwehluka okukhulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezimoto ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi. Lokhu kudinga i-BMW ukuba ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubo zayo futhi ithuthukise imikhiqizo yayo ukuze ihlale ibhekelele izidingo zabathengi. Ukukhula Kwezimakethe I-BMW ithuthukisa izimakethe zayo emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani zayo zikhula eYurophu, eNyakatho Melika, nase-Asia. Lokhu kukhula kuvula amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza izinkinga ezisha. Ukuze i-BMW iqhubeke nokukhula, kufanele ibhekane nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zabathengi, okuhlanganisa izidingo ezihlukene zezimali, izifiso zomkhiqizo, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Umthelela Wemvelo I-BMW ibuye ibheke umthelela wayo emvelweni. Ngokwanda kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomhlaba, izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zisebenzise izindlela ezihlanzekile. I-BMW ibeka izinjongo eziphakeme zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni, futhi isebenzisa izindlela zokwakha ezihlanzekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinto eziphinda zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindlela zokukhiqiza ezinciphisa umthelela emvelweni. Ukwamukelwa Kwemikhiqizo Abathengi baveza ukuthokozisa okukhulu ngemikhiqizo ye-BMW, ikakhulukazi ezimotweni ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi. Imikhiqizo ye-BMW ibonakala njengenkanyezi ezinkundleni zokuthengisa, futhi ikhiqiza izinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi i-BMW iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezithokozisayo nezisezingeni eliphezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuyithanda. Isiphetho I-BMW ibonakala njengomholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha, kodwa kufanele iqhubeke ibhekana nezinselelo ezithile ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula. Ukubhekana nezidingo zabathengi, ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa le-BMW. Njengoba izimoto zayo ziqhubeka nokuthandwa, i-BMW izoqhubeka nokuba yinkampani engakaze ibonwe emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
iMercedes-Benz Umbuzo 1: Yini iMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz iyinkampani eyaziwa kakhulu yokukhiqiza izimoto eJalimane, esungulwe nguKarl Benz noGottlieb Daimler ngo-1926. Le nkampani ibalulekile emhlabeni wezokuthutha, ithole udumo ngezithuthuthu eziphusile, izimoto ezisheshayo, kanye nezimoto ezikhululeka kakhulu. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izici ezihlukile zeMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz inezici eziningi ezihlukile. Izimoto zayo ziqinile, zinekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi zinezinhlobo zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Zikhiqiza izimoto eziphephile, ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola ukuhamba, okwandisa ukuphepha kwazo. Umbuzo 3: Yini etholakala kumamodeli eMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz inama-model amaningi ahlukahlukene, asezingeni eliphezulu, atholakala kalula kubathandi bezimoto. Ungathola izimoto ezifana ne A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, S-Class, kanye ne G-Class, eziklanyelwe ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukene zabathengi. Umbuzo 4: IMercedes-Benz ihlola kanjani ubuchwepheshe bayo? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz ihlola izinhlelo zayo zobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzisa imikhakha ehlukene, kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlola, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwe-‘Autonomous Driving Technology,’ okwenza izimoto zikwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokushayelwa. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona yini imikhiqizo ethile eMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Yebo, iMercedes-Benz inezimoto eziphezulu ezihlanganisa umkhiqizo weMercedes-AMG, okwenza ukuthi izimoto zibe namandla amakhulu, zisheshise kakhulu, futhi zibe nekhono lokuphuma emgwaqeni. Umbuzo 6: Kwenzekani uma ungahamba nezinkinga zezimoto zeMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Uma ungahamba nezinkinga zezimoto, iMercedes-Benz inezikhungo zokukhombisa ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zikhungo zihlola izithuthi, zisebenza nezinsizakalo zokulungisa, futhi ziqinisekisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthenga iMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokuthenga iMercedes-Benz zifaka umkhiqizo onokuhlonipheka, wokwakheka okuphezulu, kanye nezici ezithembekile. Iphinde inikeze izinsiza ezahlukene kubathengi bayo, okuhlanganisa nezinketho zezimali. Umbuzo 8: IMercedes-Benz ibheka kanjani umthelela wayo emphakathini nendalo? Impendulo: Yebo, iMercedes-Benz ibheka umthelela wayo emphakathini nasemvelweni. Ihlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kwemvelo, izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza umsebenzi ophumelelayo. Umbuzo 9: IMercedes-Benz izama kanjani ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz iqhubeka ithuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo ngokuhlola izibuyekezo zobuchwepheshe, ukwamukela izimiso zakamuva, kanye nokuba nomqondo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Umbuzo 10: Yini elindelekile kuMercedes-Benz esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, iMercedes-Benz ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezizimele, nezokuhamba zepulani ezinjenge-electrification, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezimoto ezingcono neziphumelelayo. Le nkampani izophinde ibambe izikhala ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
Impilo Yabantu Abasebenzayo: Ukuhlola Izimo Nezinselelo Impilo yabantu abasebenzayo, eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-working class, iyinkinga edidayo futhi eyahlukene. Laba bantu, abaneziqu eziphansi, bavame ukuba neziqu eziphansi, bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, besebenza imisebenzi eminingi ethwalisa kanzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekane nezinkinga. Le ndatshana izama ukufakazela ukuthi impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi akufanele ibonakale njengento engcolile. Ukuze siqonde kahle impilo yabo, kudingeka sihlolisise izici ezisemqoka. Okokuqala, lezi zisebenzi zithwalaniswa imithwalo eminingi, zikhungathekile ngezinto ezilula eziphathelene nosuku nosuku. Imisebenzi engaphandle kwezokuphila, efana nokusebenza ezindlini, ezinyangeni, noma emakhaya, ibabamba phansi, ikakhulukazi lapho ivame ukuzenzakalela ngaphandle kokunakekelwa. Abantu abasebenzayo bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezimali, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulisa imindeni yabo. Lokhu kubuhlungu, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kanti izinkampani ziphakamisa umholo ngendlela engahambisani nezindleko ezikhulayo zokuphila. Ukuhlupheka kwalezi zisebenzi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, ngoba akukhona nje ukusweleka kwemali, kodwa nakukwazi ukuzitholela isikhathi sokuphumula, sokuxhumana, nempilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonakala iphazamiseka ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izinselelo zomsebenzi, ezifana nokushoda kokuhlela isikhathi, ziye zashintsha. Abantu abahlala emakhaya bahlushwa ukuba basebenze imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile, okuholela ekucindezelekeni kwengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulela impilo. Izinhlangano ezinjengama-syndicate, ezivamise ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, zisebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziyaqondwa. Nokho, kunzima ukuphikisa umgomo omubi ophakanyisiwe. Abantu abasebenzayo banamazinga angaphezulu okungafaneleka. Impilo yabo ibonisa amagugu amakhulu - ukufaka isandla, ukuzinikela emsebenzini, nokuqamba amasu. Lokhu kuyazwakala lapho abantu beqalaza imiphakathi yabo, bezama ukufinyelela izimfuno eziphakeme. Ubumbano lwabo luwumphumela wezinhlelo ezithinta izifunda, ezithokozisa impilo yabo yonke. Umphakathi ojabulayo ungavela lapho abantu beqonda ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumene, bezama ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Baningi abantu abasebenzayo abaneliseka. Nakuba abaningi babo behlangabezana nezinselelo ezinzima, balindele ukuphila okuhle. Imali engaphezulu ayithathwa njengomzamo ophelele, kodwa ukuhamba phambili kumayelana nokuthi umuntu uzitholele ubumba emhlabeni. Lokhu kwenziwa ekuthuthukiseni izakhono, noma ukwandisa ukuxhumana emsebenzini ukuze baziqhenye ngendlela eqondile. Empeleni, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ikhuluma ngempilo ebucayi, ngoba ibonisa indlela ubudlelwano bethu nomphakathi. Lokhu kubhaliwe kumele kube uphawu lokuqonda, lokudlela abanye, kanye nokuphikelela emakhazeni ukuqhubeka. Abavukeli balesi simo kumele baqenjwe kahle, ukuze ubuhlungu babo buwuphawu lwezinguquko ezidingekayo emiphakathini yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kumele kufake imizamo yokukhulisa izinkolelo ezisemqoka, efana nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza emakhaya, kuxhunywe nemiphequlwano emisha yempilo. Kungakhathaliseki izinkinga ezinzima noma izimo eziphikisana nazo, abantu abasebenzayo baziqhenye ngamavolontiya, bazilungiselele imiphakathi. Akukho lutho olukhona olungasukumela ibanga wendawo, uma abantu basukuma, begqugquzela nabo bakhe le mpilo. Ngakho-ke, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa izama ukuhamba phambili. Ukwazi nokubona lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinye, futhi kuthuthukise impilo yomphakathi wonke. Lokhu akusiyona nje imicabango, kodwa kuyinkanyezi ethile yomusa ezimele, ebhalwe enhliziyweni zabantu. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba amasha, kuthi ibhande lothando nomoya wokuchuma lungene emiphakathini, ukuze sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili.
Inkantolo Yomthethosisekelo Kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu baseMzansi benqaba ukuchitha isikhathi bephakathi kokuphila kwansuku zonke. Izinkinga zekhaya, zomsebenzi, nezombusazwe zazivama ukudla iminyaka yabo. Kodwa, emoyeni, bekukhona ithemba elincane, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ehlala ibhalwe emakhanda abantu. Le nkantolo, yayingumqondisi wamalungelo, yayingumlamuli wezwi labantu. Ngosuku olukhanyayo, uSibusiso, umuntu ojwayelekile ohlala eThekwini, wayehamba emgwaqweni edolobheni. Uhla lwezinkanyezi ngezinsuku ezinzima lwalubhalwe ebusweni bakhe. Wayencike kakhulu ekutheni inkantolo izobhekelela izinkinga zakhe. U-Sibusiso wayethola amakhadi ekhaya elungile, obhekiwe, engalindelekile, ezindaweni zempilo yakhe. Ngempela, uSibusiso wayegcwele umuzwa wokuthi impilo yakhe ayihambi kahle. Kwakukhona udaba lwemali, okuyinkinga yokuthola ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Wayefuna ukufaka isimangalo esikhaleni, kodwa wayehluleka. Ekugcineni, walandela umgqigqo wezopolitiki owaqhamuka emakhanda amaningi, umgqigqo owawufaka amagama anomthelela. Usuku lwezinkantolo lwehlele. U-Sibusiso, ehamba ngezinyawo, wanqamula umgwaqo, emnyama, uqonda endaweni yeNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo. Izithombe zezakhamuzi zithokozisa, zigcwele amahloni nemizwa. U-Sibusiso wayezisa umcabango, ethumele izwi lakhe phakathi kokuhlushwa. Uhlanga lwenkantolo lwalusebenza njengeziphakamiso ezilinganayo zamasiko, futhi kumnyama phansi kulokhu. Kwathi u-Sibusiso efika lapho, wabona umphakathi uvuleka. Ujolise kumadoda nabesifazane abaninzi, behambisa izinto eziphilayo, ezifanayo, bezomdabu. Inkanyezi yengqondo iphazamisekile, kwaba namacala okuhlola ngezinguquko ezibalulekile. U-Sibusiso wayezwa umoya wempumelelo uvuma phakathi kwezindonga. Ngesikhathi uSibusiso ehlangana neNkantolo, wathola ukuthi umphakathi wasendaweni udinga izwi lakhe. Umehluko wempilo wagcwala esandleni sabantu abaningi. Izinhloso zikhula, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo yathola ukuthokozisa ekuzameni ukufaka isikhumbuzo kulokho okwakubi. Njengoba abakhuluma, uSibusiso wavuka, waba nesibindi. Wathi, "Ngiyabonga, nansi ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onenhlonipho." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwi likaSibusiso lasizwa. Umphakathi wawuthinta. Izinkanyezi zeNkantolo zathokozisa, futhi kwakukhona izindlela ezihlukene ezibalulekile. U-Sibusiso wakhumbula umqondo wombono ophakeme. Uhlanga lwabantu lwakhula kakhulu, lwalubambisana namandla omlilo. Ngesikhathi inkantolo ifaka izinqumo, kwavela umoya wempumelelo. U-Sibusiso, nokho, wathola umqondisi ongakujabuleli kukhethwa ezinye izinguquko, izinqumo ezehlukene ezimgcekeni zomphakathi. Kwakuwumoya ophilayo owaba uqhamuka. Njengoba uSibusiso esho, "Imibono ithuthukisa izimpilo, yimi eyenzayo." Izinsuku zedlule, uSibusiso waba inkanyezi yokulawula. Wayezwa amaphupho akhe eza, ahamba phambili. Uhlanga lwabantu lwezandla lwenziwe. U-Sibusiso wabona iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ingashaywa phansi. Lena bekungumkhankaso, umphakathi ophilayo ophuma emoyeni. Ekugcineni, uSibusiso wafunda ukuthi inkantolo ayiyona kuphela indlela yokuphila. Wayezwa izWI zoyedwa, ukhumbula izinsuku ezinzima. Kuwo wonke amakhasi nezithombe, ukhona umbono ohlanzekile. Ekuhlanganyeleni, umphakathi uthola amandla. Ukuhlangene, izwi lathokozisa umhlaba, futhi uSibusiso waba yisibonelo esiphilayo. Ngaleyondlela, inkantolo yomthethosisekelo yaba yinkanyezi ehlangene, eya phambili. Kwakuwumbono owawubhalwe enhliziyweni, umphakathi ozigxile, inhlonipho yokuphila. U-Sibusiso futhi umphakathi, bembiza, behamba phambili. Ekuhlanganyeleni, baphila.
Ukukhulisa Izingane: Izimiso Nezindlela Zokwakha Umphakathi Oqinile Ukukhulisa izingane kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kwezingane akukhathalekile kuphela, kodwa futhi kufaka phakathi ukwakha izimiso zokuziphatha, ukuhlonipha, nokuqonda umhlaba ozungezile. Ukuze kubekhona impumelelo ngesikhathi sokukhulisa, kubalulekile ukuba abantu abadala babenolwazi olufanele, babe neziqu ezithile ezihlobene nezinkinga zokukhulisa izingane, futhi baqonde izidingo zezingane, okuhlanganisa nezemfundo, emotweni, nasempilweni yengqondo. Izimiso Zokukhulisa Izingane Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe izinyathelo zokukhulisa izingane, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimiso eziyisisekelo ezikhona. Lezi zimiso ziqukethe umoya wokuthandana, ukunakekela, nokwakha isisekelo esiqinile semfundo. Abazali banomsebenzi wokwakha isimo esiphumelela ukusiza izingane zikhule ziqinile, zikhululekile, futhi zinesibindi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abazali baqonde futhi bamukele izidingo ezihlukahlukene zezingane zabo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa ezihambisana nobudala nezinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana Ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwabazali nezingane kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo yengane. Ukuvula indlela yokukhuluma ngendlela efanele kuholela ekwakhiweni komoya ophilayo, lapho izingane zizizwa zikulungele ukwabelana ngezinkinga, imicabango, kanye nemizwa yazo. Izingane ezifundisiwe ukuba zikhulume ngazo idinga ukuba zibe namandla okwenza izinqumo eziphusile kanye neziqu zokuhlakanipha. Abazali kumele baphendule ngezinhloso ezinhle, bahlale bezinikezela ukwazisa nokuqonda nokuzwakalisa ukunaka okukhulu. Izemfundo Nezindlela Zokufundisa Izemfundo iyinsika esemqoka ekukhuliseni izingane. Abazali badinga ukwakha umqondo wokufunda, okungabandakanya ukufaka isandla emfundweni yezenhlalo, ukufunda izincwadi, nokuqonda cwe oluvela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amaningi okuhweba ngolwazi olwakhelwe phezu kwemfundiso, olungaphezulu kokufunda kwezincwadi, kunikeza nokuqonda kokuhlalisana komphakathi. Umqondo wokufunda kufanele ubuye ugxile ekwakheni ezinye izinqubo ezithokozisayo, okufaka phakathi imidlalo, izifundo ezenzakalayo, nezinhlelo eziyindida, okwenza ukufunda kube mnandi. Ukwakha Izimiso Zokuziphatha Nokuhlonipha Okwengeziwe, kubalulekile ukusiza izingane zikhule zisendaweni efanele yokuziphatha. Abazali kumele babe nezimiso ezicacile, ezihloniphekile, ezizothuthukisa ukuhlonipha kokuziphatha, okuyisisekelo sabantu abangamaqhawe. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kokuthi izenzo zinomthelela kumphakathi jikelele, kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wokuthi umhlaba uhamba njengenhlangano eyodwa, kwazulu umphakathi uthola umphumela omuhle lapho lezi zimiso zisetshenziswa. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Izingane Emigwaqweni Zokukhula Ukuxhaswa kwezokuthuthuka kungenye indlela ezokhusela izingane. Abazali kanye nemiphakathi bangathola izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezithuthukisa izifiso zamakhosikazi, ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, kanye nezinsiza ezivulelekileyo. Ukukhuthaza imithombo yamandla kubalulekile empilweni yezenhlalo. Izinhlelo ezibandakanya amakhono, ubuciko, nesigaba somphakathi, zikhuthaza ubuhlakani ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngale ndlela, abafundi bayakwazi ukuzuza izizathu eziyisisekelo ezizobathuthukisa. Ukuhlaziya Nezimo Zokukhathalela Izingane Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo zokukhathalela izingane. Abazali kufanele baqaphele ukuphazamiseka okungase kube khona empilweni yezingane zabo. Noma kunjalo, ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukuphatha imiyalo, nokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokugcina izinto kuyasiza ekwakheni umoya omuhle wokukhulisa. Ngokuvumelanisa izidingo zezingane nezizathu ezingabonakali, abazali bangathuthukisa isimo sokukhula sezingane, benza ngcono indlela yokuphila. Isiphelo Ukukhulisa izingane kumele kube yinqubo ehlelekile, enesizotha, futhi enobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhuthazayo, kanye nezimiso ezifanele zokuziphatha, abazali bangasiza izingane zikhule, zifunde, futhi zibe abantu abazophila kahle. Lezi zinyathelo zidinga ukuzinikela okuqinile kwabazali, komunomphakathi, njengoba sizithola indawo ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwezingane zethu. Umphakathi onempilo uqala ezandleni zabazali, ngakho-ke, kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza izindlela ezinhle zokukhulisa izingane.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini iziteleka zabasebenzi? Iziteleka zabasebenzi yizenzakalo lapho abasebenzi behlangana khona ukuze baphikise izimo zokusebenza zabo, kakhulu ezihlobene nezisebenzi, amaholo, nokunye okuthinta ukusebenza kwabo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwanga, noma uma befuna izinguquko ezithile ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo emsebenzini. Umbuzo 2: Yini ebangela iziteleka? Izimbangela eziyinhloko zeziteleka zibuye zibe eziningi. Kakhulu, iziteleka zenzeka uma abasebenzi befuna ukunyukelwa kwemiholo, izinzuzo ezithe xaxa, noma izimo zokusebenza eziphephile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga ezinjengokungabi bikho kwezinsiza, ukuphazamiseka kwemikhawulo yokusebenza, noma ukuphathwa ngendlela engafanele kungenza abasebenzi baphume bayokwakha iziteleka. Umbuzo 3: Ziwusizo yini iziteleka zabasebenzi? Iziteleka zabasebenzi zingaba usizo olukhulu. Zivame ukuhlinzeka ngekhono lokubeka izinkinga ezibalulekile phambi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlaka zikaHulumeni. Lokhu kungenza kube nokucwaningwa nokuqonda okukhulu ngezidingo zabasebenzi, futhi kwezinye izikhathi, kudala izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ezijulile. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izingozi ezihambisana neziteleka? Noma iziteleka zingaba nezinhlelo ezinhle, zinezingozi zazo. Abasebenzi abangase babe nezinkinga uma kuneziteleka, ezinjengokuvalelwa emsebenzini, ukuvinjwa kwemiholo, noma ukungaphenduli kahle emsebenzini. Ngezinye izikhathi, iziteleka zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komkhiqizo, okuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kwibhizinisi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavunyelwa ngokomthetho? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi zivunywa ngokomthetho eziningi zezwe. Kokubili umthetho kazwelonke nezifunda zikhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi banezikhala zokuphikisana uma izinkampani zingakholwa izidingo zabo. Nokho, imithetho ingahluka kakhulu ezwenikazi nasemikhakheni ehlukene, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqonde amalungelo abo. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni? Uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle amalungelo akho. Ukuze kukhulunywe ngesivumelwano esifanele, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nezenzo ezithile ezilawulwa imo yokuphepha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuzijwayeza nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano zomsebenzi eziphathelene neziteleka. Umbuzo 7: Zithini izibonelo zeziteleka zabasebenzi ezidumile? Kuneziteleka eziningi ezidumile emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi bezokusebenza ezinkampanini zokuqashwa kwezimoto eMelika zabe ziveza izinkinga ezinzima zokusebenza. Ezinye izimo ziqhakambisa izitesi ezilawulayo, iziteleka zabakhweli bezokuxhumana, kanye neziteleka zomsebenzi wezempilo, okukhombisa izinkinga eziwohlokayo ezikhona emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngokubuyiselwa kwempahla nempilo ngemva kweziteleka? Ngemva kweziteleka, kungabakhona ukubuyiselwa kwezimali nempilo, kodwa lokhu kuxhomekeka ezivumelwaneni ezithathiwe ngesikhathi soberhelekileyo. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zigxile ekubuyiseleni izimali ezichithwa ngaphambi kweziteleka, zigcine synto efanayo. Ukubuyiselwa kwempilo kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni ungaphatha ngezindlela ezinhle. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavuma okuhlangenwe nakho emhlabeni? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho bahlala bephikisana nezinqubo zezimali, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlinzeko ngezintela zokusebenza. Izibonelo zikhona emakethe enkulu, nasemazweni ahlukeneyo, lapho izimpendulo ezihlukahlukene ziphuma khona. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe umphakathi unendima ekuxhaseni iziteleka? Umphakathi ungaba nendima ebalulekile ekuxhaseni iziteleka. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, ukuphakanyiswa kwezabelo zokuxhaswa kungakhale ukuphumeza izifiso zabathintekayo. Izinkampani kumele zibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo nezindawo zokusebenzisana, ezokuxhasa iziteleka. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Zihlinzeka ngamathuba okuphikisa ngezinkinga ezithinta abasebenzi, ukuze kube nezinguquko ezinhle ukuze kube nokusebenza okungcono, nempilo engcono kubo. Qhubeka uqwashise ngezimo ezithile, futhi uthole ulwazi oluqondile ukuze uqonde kahle amagugu ezimpilo zabasebenzi.
iNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II: Uhlanga Lwenkululeko neNhlonipho Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, kanye nezinga lempilo yangempela — lezi yizinto ezibalulekile ezithinta isithombe seNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II, owesifazane ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wobukhosi baseBrithani. Lokhu akukhona kuphela emithonjeni yezindaba nasezincwadini, kodwa futhi kuvezwa ezimpilweni zabantu abasha, abamnyama nabesilisa, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinga lempilo, u-Elizabeth II ube yisibonelo esihle sokwakha isizukulwane esisha esinokubambisana. Ngesikhathi u-Elizabeth II ebhalwa emlandweni, akubanga lula ukuthi wayengowokuqala ukuthola izimfaneli zenkolo, umdlandla, nokuqonda komphakathi. Ukuphila kwakhe kwakungokubuyekezwa njengoba ebhekana nezimo ezinzima, ezithinta izwe lonke. Njengomholi, wabhekelela izinguquko ezinkulu ezazikhula eBrithani nasemhlabeni jikelele, ezihambisana nezifiso zabantu. Isikhathi sika-Elizabeth II sashintsha indlela umphakathi ubhekwa ngayo, kanti lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlonipha nobumbano. U-Elizabeth, njengoba sazi kahle, wakhethwa ukuphatha ngemuva kokudlula kwabazali bakhe, u-George VI no-Elizabeth I. Lokhu kubonisa indlela imvelaphi yenkosi ebheka imizamo yokwakha imindeni, izinkumbulo, nezifiso ezizwakalayo. Ukuphuma kwakhe emndenini odumile kubonisa indlela eyasiza ukuba u-Elizabeth abambe isikhala esisabekayo embhalweni. Lokhu kufanele kube isifundo kubantu bethu, njengoba siba nolwazi lokuthi ubukhazikhazi buhle kodwa kudinga umthwalo wemfanelo. Ngenxa yobukhazikhazi bayo nobungcweti bakhe, u-Elizabeth II waphetha izigigaba eziningi, ezazihambisana nezinto ezinkulu ezinjengokuhlukana kokwenziwa ukuze kube nezizwe ezizimele. Ukuhlanganyela kwakhe emaqhulwini ezehlakalweni, okumangalisa kakhulu, kwenze ukuthi abantu bamthande kakhulu. Lokhu kubonisa indlela abebekwazi ngayo ukujabulisa izinhliziyo zabantu, abakhomba isithombe esihle sokuhlonipha nokuqonda lapho kwenzeka izinqumo ezinzima. Uphila kancane ngosuku olujwayelekile, ephila ebhizinisini, kodwa futhi engapheli ize. Ubufakazi bokukhula kwayo buncike ekubeni yinkosana enkulu, evame ukudlula kumabhuku ezincwadi zomlando. Kukhona abawakwazi ukuphenduka, ngenxa yezinsiza eziphakeme, umoya nemigudu yesimanje. U-Elizabeth II ushintshe izidingo zomphakathi, eqhubeka nokwakha ulwazi lomphakathi obumbene. Lokhu kuhlobisa kwakhe nesimo sakhe, ukwazi ukuhoxa izinkumbulo ezinhle, lapho kudlalwa idlalwana. Ngalesi sikhathi sokuphila, u-Elizabeth II, ubungcweti bakhe babucishe bobu, bekhombisa ukuba nemigudu elula yokuphathwa, okusho ukuthi ngempela ungusomqulu wezinto ezisemqoka. Ubhala izigaba zempilo yakhe, okuyinto eyahlukaniswa phakathi komphakathi nokuhlonipha izimilo namasiko. Lokhu kuqonda kuvumelana kakhulu nezinto ezithinta abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuthi u-Elizabeth II wahola kulo mphakathi ngothando nempumelelo. Ngobungcweti bokuphila, u-Elizabeth II wahola imikhankaso eminingi, eqhubekisela phambili izinhlelo ezithinta imindeni eminingi nobumbano olunamandla. Ukukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha ukuthi zikhombise ukuzimisela, ubuhlakani, nokuqina, kuzakha isimo esihle sokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlangene ngezikhathi ezinzima, lapho enza khona izinto ezibalulekile ukuze abameli abahlukene baziqhubeke noshisayo. U-Elizabeth uyasikhumbuza ukuthi imikhankaso ethinta abantu ayigcini nje ngokuhweba ngezifiso, kodwa ibuye isikhumbule nabantu abakubo abaqhubekayo. Ekugcineni, u-Elizabeth II uzoba isibonelo esiyingqayizivele emlandweni wobukhosi, nempela njengomholi obonisa ubuqotho. Uhlanga lwenkululeko lwakhululwa, kubonisa ukuthi ngezinga elikhethekile elawulwa ngenkosi, ingozi ingaphezulu kwezindleko zempilo. Lokhu kwahluka hlukene, kwaba nomthelela omningi ekuchazeni isithombe seNdlovukazi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazobongela u-Elizabeth II, ezingqondweni nakuphila kwabo. Njengoba sithokozisa u-Elizabeth II, sifunde izifundo ezibalulekile ezithinta abantu bethu, ukuhola, nephupho elingabheki emithonjeni yezenhlalo. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, kufanele sihloniphe, size sihlole imidlalo eyakhiwayo, ukuze izwe lethu lihlume ngempumelelo. U-Elizabeth II usishiye ephephile, ehlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene zomhlaba, ngakho thina, masizuze kulezo zifundo ukuze siqhubekele phambili!
UJulius Caesar: Umlando Ohlangene Nezenzakalo Zombusazwe UJulius Caesar, ungumuntu ohlukile emlandweni weRoma, waba yisithunzi esikhulu esihlangene nezinguquko ezibucayi ephathini yezombusazwe. Ukuphila kwakhe, okuhlanganisa nezinqumo zakhe eziphusile, kwaholela ekubeni abe yinsika ejulile ekwakheni isiko lezombusazwe eRoma. UCaesar wazalwa ngomhla we-12 kuNtulikazi, eminyakeni engu-100 ngaphambi kokuzalwa kwesintu, futhi wakhulela emndenini onezizathu ezinhle. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwakhe, ubona izikhathi ezinzima nezinzima, okwenza waba nesifiso esikhulu sokuthuthukisa ezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza njengeMeya eRoma, uCaesar wagxila ekuphuculeni isimo samalunga omphakathi. Ukwazi kwakhe ukuhlaziya izinkinga zomphakathi kwaholela ekuqhamukeni kwama-proposals ahlukahlukene, okwakha umoya ophelele phakathi kwalabo ababehamba phambili nezindlela eziphumelelayo. Ubuqu bakhe babukhombisa ukuthi ubani owenza izinto ukuze athuthukise impilo yomphakathi ngezindlela ezingenakubalwa. Njengoba ubhulungisa izinkinga zomphakathi, uJulius Caesar waqhubeka nokwandisa ububanzi bokuphila kwakhe ezombusazwe. Wazifaka ensimini yeziqubulo, kwavela izifungo ezimnandi ezifana nesigaba sokuvota nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa imindeni. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila ngendlela ehloniphekile lwazisa indlalifa yokugxila kweziqubulo ezihlakaniphile nezisebenza phambili, okwenza abanye babonakale besebenzisa konke okusemandleni abo ukuze bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe bezombusazwe. Ukwakha izimpilo zezenhlalakahle njengeCésar, kusitfupha enza izinkathazo ezinkulu kumazinga amahle ambalwa emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Yize izimbangi zikhona, umoya uvulekile kudala uCaesar abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isimo somphakathi esingcono. Umkhiqizo wezombusazwe Ukuqhamuka kukaGaius Julius Caesar kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni weRoma. Kwakhathalelwa imihlangano emikhulu ephakeme neziqubulo ezithakazelisayo, uCaesar wanikeza amandla amakhulu kubantu bakwaRoma. Umyalo wakhe obukhali phakathi kwezinto ezinkulu nohlangothi lwempilo yamasiko kwaba nethuba elikhulu lokuhlonipha izinqola zezinhloso. Lokhu kwaholela ekuqhamukeni kwezinhlelo ezintsha ezidonsa abahlala edolobheni ukuba bazithuthukise, nokwenza umphakathi waba nezinqumo eziningi ezinhle. Nokho, impilo kaCaesar ayizange ithathe izinyathelo ezivumelana nezinselele ezivela kubantu abanye. Njengoba ehamba phambili emizimbeni, ubudlelwano wakhe nezingane kanye nesikhathi sokuhola kwawagxila kumhlangano wezingane. Lokhu kunikela ngesifiso sokuphila esiyingqayizivele kwezinye zezingane, ezahola kwenze isimo sichume. Ukwenza uCaesar abe yimpumelelo enkulu ngokwengqalasizinda, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuphila sikulamula izikhumbuzo eziyingqayizivele, ezazifanekisela umoya wokuqhubeka nokuthola impilo engcono. Ubuqotho bakhe, intshisekelo yakhe yokuphila, nobuchule bakhe obuphezulu bafeza izinkanyezi ezinenjongo. UJulius Caesar ubeka isiqongo kweimithetho, wathola ukuvuma okukhulu emhlabeni. Naphezu kokuhlonipheka impilo yakhe, ukuphila kukaJulius Caesar kwaba nomphumela omuhle. Izinyanga zempilo zamuva zabe ziwumzamo omkhulu, okuholele ekufakweni kwezimpi ezinzima nelanga lokugadla kuze kube sekukhumbuleka. Impi yakhe yeGaul, yathanda ukuthola ngezikhathi ezinzima ezilishumi lamawele. Umsebenzi wakhe owafaka uRoma edolobheni wabanika izithakazelo ezenzakalayo, ehamba phambili emaqhulwini, wabhekana nezikhali ezinesizathu. Ekuqaleni, iziphakamiso zomphakathi zaqala ukuhlangana nezenzakalo ezimbi kakhulu. Ukuvota nokwahlula, uCaesar waba nohlaka oluqinile, alungile ukuze aqhase umkhankaso wezempi. Kodwa iRoma ibuyela ngaphandle kobudlelwane obuhlukahlukene, uJulius Caesar waba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yolwazi. Ukuphila kwempilo yakhe kube umlando omkhulu ngoMphakathi, okwakhiwa ngezinyathelo ezinhle, kwezombusazwe ezinomoya. Ekugcineni, uJulius Caesar ungumuntu okhumbuleka, ohlonishwayo, nakuba imposters bephikisa impumelelo yakhe. Uvaleleka kwiRoma futhi wathola akhawunti ezihlukahlukene. Umoya wakhe wehlukene, owashintsha indlela izinto ezibukwa ngayo. Ngakho uJulius Caesar uhamba phambili emlandweni, edlula isikhathi, futhi zonke izinyathelo zakhe zihlala ziphila ezindaweni zomphakathi.
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi Ngokwejwayelekile, ukubhikisha kwabafundi kube yindlela yokuzwakalisa imizwa, izinkinga, nezifiso zabo. Njengomfundi, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nokuqonda okujulile kwezimfuno zethu. Uma ngibheka izikhathi ezithile lapho abafundi benza khona ukubhikisha, ngiyabona ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zikhona ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngezimo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni nasemanyuvesi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abakha umphakathi wethu. Abafundi bangama-akhawunti amakhulu emiphakathini, futhi izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo zikhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinkinga zezimali, izinga lemfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abafundi kufanele baveze imizwa yabo, bahlangane, futhi bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo. Ukubhikisha, ngakho, kuba yindlela yokukhuluma, yokubeka izinkinga phambi kwabaphathi, futhi yokufuna ukulungiswa. Ngokwesibonelo, ngiyakhumbula isenzakalo esenzeka emnyuvesi yami lapho abafundi bahlala phansi ukuze baphikise ukwenyuka kwemali yokufunda. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, kodwa kwaveza ubuhlakani obukhulu. Abafundi babebonisa ukuthi akukhona nje ukuthi bahlupheka, kodwa baphinde bakhombise ukuthi banomqondo ophusile wokuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinezimpempe ezinzima emiphumeleni yabo. Lokhu kwavula izinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabaphathi, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukubhikisha akuhambisani nje nokuphikisana. Kunalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezihambisanayo. Abafundi kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuba baphathe izinkulumo ezivulekile, bazame ukuxhumana nabaphathi ukuze bathole izixazululo. Lokhu kudinga ubuholi obuqinile, futhi abafundi kufanele bakhe amabhandezi ukuze basebenzisane, bephumelele ekufezekiseni izinhloso zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Abafundi, othisha, nabaphathi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuhle, okungaba yinzuzo kubo bonke. Ngokubheka phambili, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukubhikisha kwabafundi kudinga ukuqhubeka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kufanele baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ezindabeni ezithinta imfundo, futhi bahlale bephakamisa izinkinga ezibucayi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imiphakathi yethu ibe namandla, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abafundi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ekugcineni, ngiyavuma ukuthi ukubhikisha kwabafundi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi baqhubeke nokuphikisa, kodwa kufanele baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze bathole izixazululo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imfundo yethu ibe ngcono, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nomphakathi onempilo. Ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukulwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha, yokuxhumana, nokufuna izixazululo. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza bonke abafundi ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhuluma, baphikise, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo.
Ikota Umbuzo 1: Yini ikota? Ikota iyisikhathi esithile sokuphila esivame ukwenziwa ngezinyanga ezine. Kubalulekile emikhakheni ehlukene, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ezemali, nasezinhlelweni zokuphatha. Ikota ibonisa indlela yokusebenza, yokuhlola, nokubika imiphumela ethile ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ikota ibalulekile? Ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza izinkampani ukuba zihlaziye ukusebenza kwazo, zenze izinqumo ezifanele, futhi zihlale ziqonda izimo zemboni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ivumela abaphathi ukuba bahlaziye izindleko, imikhiqizo, nezinsizakalo, ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. Umbuzo 3: Kanjani ikota isetshenziswa ezinkampanini? Ezinkampanini, ikota isetshenziswa ukuze kubonwe ukuthi izinjongo zonyaka zifezekile yini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubika ngezindleko, imali engenayo, kanye nezinga lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi basebenzisa ikota ukuze baphumelele ekwenzeni izinhlelo ezintsha, ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo, noma ukwandisa imakethe. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota? Izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukucacisa izinjongo: Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso ezizofezwa kule nkathi. 2. Ukuhlela: Ukubeka phambili izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinsizakusebenza, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 3. Ukusebenza: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ayenze. 4. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola imiphumela yokusebenza ukuze kutholakale ukuthi izinjongo zifezekile. 5. Ukubika: Ukubika imiphumela kumphakathi, kubaphathi, noma kubanikazi bezinkampani. Umbuzo 5: Ziyini izinselelo ezihambisana ne ikota? Izinkampani zibhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma zisebenzisa ikota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukungahambisani kwezinsiza, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlola imiphumela, ikakhulukazi uma izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokusebenza. Umbuzo 6: Kanjani ikota ingathuthukiswa? Ukuze ikota ithuthuke, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke zihlola izinqubo zazo, zifunde ezivela kwezinye izinkampani, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zenkampani kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe ikota. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kungaba nomthelela omuhle ekusebenzeni kahle. Umbuzo 7: Ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini? Yebo, ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini. Ngokuhlola nokubheka imiphumela, izinkampani zingathola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, njengokwandisa imikhiqizo, ukunciphisa izindleko, noma ukushintsha izinqubo zokusebenza. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota zifaka phakathi: - Ukuqonda kahle ukusebenza kwenkampani. - Ukuthuthukisa izinqumo eziphusile. - Ukukhulisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi. - Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ikota ibalulekile emkhakheni wezomnotho? Emkhakheni wezomnotho, ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza ekuhloleni imiphumela yezenzo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlola kusiza ohulumeni, abacwaningi, kanye nezinkampani ukuba baqonde izimo zomnotho, bahlaziye izinguquko, futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma ikota ingahambanga kahle? Uma ikota ingahambanga kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zihlaziye kahle izizathu. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlola izinqubo, izinsiza, nezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo kungasiza ekutholeni izixazululo eziphusile. Isiphetho Ikota iyinsika ebalulekile ezinkampanini nasemkhakheni wezomnotho. Ukuze ibaluleke, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke zihlola, zithuthukise, futhi zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile. Ngale ndlela, ikota ingaba ithuluzi elinamandla lokuphumelela.
Isingeniso Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, okwaziwa nangokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni," kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Lezi zindawo, ezakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yohulumeni, zihlala zinezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Umbhalo lo uzogxila ezimbangweni ezikhokelela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, izimpempe zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga. Izimbangela Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Omunye wemibandela eyinhloko eholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni ukuwohloka kwezimo zokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba umnotho uthuthuka, abantu abaningi bahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izindlu eziphuthumayo ezindaweni ezingavunyelwe ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwemithetho eqinile yokwakha ezindaweni ezithile, kanye nokungabi nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu ezisemthethweni, kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo, lapho izindawo ezisemthethweni zihlupheka ngenxa yokuthi zidinga izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokuhlala. Izimpempe Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezimpempe eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, ezokuphepha, nezomthetho. Okokuqala, lezi zindawo zihlupheka ngezinkinga zempilo, njengoba abantu bengenayo imithombo efanele yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu baphile impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlala zikhungathekile, futhi lokhu kuholela ezimeni zokweba, udlame, nokuhlukunyezwa. Okwesibili, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bavame ukuba sengozini yokwenziwa kwemithetho, okungaholela ekutheni kube khona ukuhoxiswa kwezindlu zabo. Lokhu kubangela ukungabi nokuqonda kwezokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu bakhe izimpilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlupheka ngezinkinga zomphakathi, njengoba abahlali bengenayo imisebenzi ethile yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Izixazululo Zokunciphisa Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni ezishibhile, ukuze abantu abampofu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzovikela amalungelo abantu. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemthethweni, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezizokwenza baphile kahle. Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezindawo abahlala kuzo, baqonde ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni aziholeli ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela izindawo ezisemthethweni. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kusemqoka kakhulu, futhi kudinga izixazululo ezithile ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni bazohlala bephila impilo enezinkinga eziningi, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukubambisana nokuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni kuzoba yisixazululo esikhulu ekunciphiseni le nkinga.
UMartin Luther King Jr. Kwakukhanya emini, kodwa izinsuku zikaMartin Luther King Jr. zazigcwele ubumnyama obugqugquzelayo. UKing, umfundisi obalulekile, wayengumholi ophikelelayo, owayezama ukugcina ithemba phakathi kwabantu abamnyama e-United States. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlanga babuphikisana, futhi ubuhlungu bekukhanya emoyeni. Noma kunjalo, uMartin wayebona ukukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabo, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza abantu bakhe bakhuphuke kuleso simo esinzima. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zempilo yakhe, uMartin wakhulela eAtlanta, eGeorgia. Wakhuliswa ngothando, futhi abazali bakhe bamfundisa ukubaluleka kokuphila ngokuhlonipha. Wabona indlela abantu abamnyama abebehlezi ngayo, bezama ukuphila ngendlela efanele, kodwa behlukunyezwa futhi behluleka ukufinyelela amathuba alinganayo. Lokhu kwadala isifiso esijulile enhliziyweni yakhe sokuthi izinto zishintshe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMartin waphuma waba umfundisi. Ubephinde esebenza njengomholi ukuze akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphikise ubuhlanga ngothando, hhayi ngodlame. Wazi kahle ukuthi ubuhlungu bobuhlanga abukwazi ukwelashwa ngodlame, kodwa ngothando, nokubambisana. Waqala ukusungula imibhikisho nokuhamba, efuna ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu bomdabu. Kwafika usuku olukhulu, ngosuku lwesimangaliso — usuku lokuthi uMartin akhulume esidlangalaleni eWashington, D.C. Wawuthumele umyalezo ophusile, ohlangene, osesithombeni senhliziyo zabantu. “Ngiyaphila, kodwa nginokuphila okungcono,” kusho uMartin. Uthando lwakhe, umbono wakhe, namandla akhe okuhamba, kwashiya imizwelo ewusizo ezinhliziyweni zabantu abangaphezulu kuka-250,000. Njengoba eshaya ezindaweni eziningi, uMartin wathola izithiyo eziningi. Abanye bebengavumi ukushintsha, bephikisana nemizamo yakhe. Nokho, uMartin waqhubeka, engavumi ukwehla phansi, ngoba wayeqiniseka ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kokuphikisana. Wazi ukuthi, noma izinsuku zishubile, umgomo wakhe wawudinga ukuqhubeka. Kwaze kwaba sekupheleni, lapho uMartin ebhekene nezinsongo eziningi, waphinde wagcizelela indlela, "Yimina, angiyena owodlame. Ngibona ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma sithanda, uma sithanda, sizama ukubambisana." Lokhu kwenza abantu baphinde bakhumbule ukuthi ubumbano bubalulekile. Ngesikhathi esiqhubeka, uMartin wathola ukujula kwezinkinga zempilo, kodwa wayehlale eqinile, edlula emingceleni yokuphikisana. Abantu abamnyama bahlala bematasa, bezama ukuthola amalungelo. UMartin wahamba phambili, efuna ukuthola lokho okwakufanele. Uhlanga lwalubanjwe, kodwa uthando lwezwi lwakhe lwawuhamba lukhazimula, lwalukhumbuza bonke. Kodwa uMartin wathi: “Kukhona okuthile okungavumi. Akukhona okukhathazayo, uma sikhuluma ngothando.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uMartin wahamba emhlabeni, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando lunamandla, njalo. Noma izinto zibe nzima, uthando lwake lwalubanzi, lwalukhuluma ngezwi lesizotha. Ngemva kweminyaka, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba yisithonjana, umholi owaziyo. Abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ngezinto azitshala, nezifiso zempilo ezakha umhlaba ozinzile. UMartin waphumelela, waba yisikhumbuzo esihle, futhi izwi lakhe lisasondeza emhlabeni, likhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha. Ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe, uMartin wadala umthetho ophakeme, okhumbuza abantu ngothando nokubambisana. Uhlanga lwalubhaqwa, kodwa uthando lwakhe lwalungashintshi. Ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, sithanda, sihambisane, siba yisibonelo — lokho kwaba umgomo kaMartin Luther King Jr. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zikaMartin Luther King Jr. zihlala zingaphezu kokuphila kwakhe. Zikholwa emhlabeni, zabamba izigidi, zakhumbuza abantu ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kwazo zonke izinto. Ngakho-ke, njengoba siqhubeka, sigcina izwi lakhe lisesimeni, sikhumbula izifiso zakhe: “Sizoba nesikhathi sokuphila esinempilo.”
Umbiko NgamaFilimu Isingeniso Amafilimu, njengobuciko bokuxhumana nemizwa, adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Lokhu kuhamba phambili emhlabeni wethu, amafilimu awekho nje ukufaka izithombe ezinkulu ezikholisayo, kodwa kuthiwa ayingxenye yamasiko, imishado, kanye nemininingwane yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlaziya amafilimu kusuka esikhathini sokudala kuya kwesimanjemanje, kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo. Ukuqala Kwamafilimu Umgomo wamafilimu uqale ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-20, lapho amafilimu ephakanyiswa eyisithombe esingenamazwi, azithokozisa abantu ngezenzo ezivela ebuhleni. I-Hollywood, edume kakhulu emhlabeni, yawela esikhathini sokengisa amafilimu emazwe angaphandle, yenza amaphrojekthi ayebheja ezintweni ezinjengokwaziwa ngokuhlekisa, ukulawula imizwa, kanye nokucaciswa kwezindaba. Lezi zinkampani ezingeni eliphezulu zapha umphakathi kwamafilimu anejubane lokukhula. Ukwakhiwa Kwamafilimu Ukwakhiwa kwamafilimu kulandela izigaba ezithile ezibandakanya; ukwakhiwa kwe-script, ukukhetha abadlali (casting), ukukhiqiza, kanye nokuhlela. I-script iyinhliziyo yephrojekthi, ihlinzeka ngesisekelo sezindaba ezizokhuluma ngazo. Ukukhetha abadlali kudinga ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, njengoba abadlali kufanele babonise izimfanelo ezithile ukuze baziveze ngokweqiniso. Njengoba kudlalwa izigaba zokuqhuba kusebenze abezindaba, abakhiqizi benza imisebenzi enkulu yokuhlanganisa imiphetho phakathi kwezinhlelo ezenzakalayo. Uhlanga Lwamafilimu Uhla lwezimakethe zamafilimu selukhula, kanti nezinhlobonhlobo zamafilimu zikhona. Kube nogaxekile, amafilimu abukeka njengemali ethokozisayo, amavidiyo akhuthaza, kanye nolwazi olujulile. Lokhu kugqugquzelwa okwenzeka emhlabeni kusiza ukudala amafilimu ahlukahlukene, afunwa ngamaqembu ahlukene. Izinhlelo zamasiko zenza kube nokuhlukahluka okukhulu, kanti amafilimu amaningi afana nemjolo, umjaho, nezokuhlakanipha azisa abantu ngezindaba ezithinta emphakathini. Amathrendi Nezinguquko Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eminingi edlule, imibono, izinqubo, nezinto ezifanele ziye zaguquka. Ngaleso sikhathi, amafilimu aqala ukugxila ezindleleni zabantu ezikhethekile, ukulwa kwama-viral, nokubheja kulezi zikhathi ezisheshayo. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinkinga zezenhlalo zihatshwe kakhulu ezindabeni zamafilimu, kanti ababhali manje basithola isikhathi sokukhuluma ngalezi zinto ngezindlela ezenzeka kumafilimu. Impact Ngemiphakathi Amafilimu akha imiphakathi njengoba ebonakalisa izinkinga zansuku zonke, izifiso, nemicabango ehlukahlukene. Ayiqondile kuphela njengokuldlalela; ayingxenye yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amafilimu ahlinzeka ngezindlela zokuphucula ukuqonda kwezimanga nokuhlangenwe nakho. Lokhu kukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuthi ingabi namahloni kodwa ivuleke kabanzi, ibonise ukuqonda okukhulu komphakathi. Isikhathi Samanje Nezinguquko Ezingaphezulu Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buye basha, amafilimu athola ukwaziswa okuningi nge-streaming services. Lokhu kuguqula indlela abantu abathenga ngayo amafilimu, njengoba benza kube lula uku-accessa okuqukethwe kwezokuxhumana. Kukhona nohlelo lokwandisa imisebenzi yamafilimu, njengoba abaqhubi beziqhenya ngaphezulu ngempela. Njengoba izinkundla zikhula, kuthiwa umbono wawamafilimu uyaqhubeka futhi uhambisana nezidingo zezwe. Inhlonipho Nokuqonda Selesikhona esikhathini sokujabulisa amafilimu, sibi asihamba siye elwazini. Imazwi ethokozisayo engizithandayo zingafakwe kumafilimu, zikhombisa ukuthambekela. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinhlelo, akunakuphikwa ukuthi amafilimu awulula, kanye nezinkumbulo eziphathekayo zikhanya emqondweni wabantu. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, amafilimu awaziwa kuphela njengenjabulo, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokufunda, yokuphila, nokuxhumana. Kumnandi ukufaka izithombe ezintsha nezimfashini ezikhuluma ngempilo, isiko, nezenzakalo ezithinta umhlaba. Njengoba uhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe amafilimu njengephuzu elibalulekile lokuxhumana, futhi sigcine isithakazelo sethu kulokhu kubukeka. Ngakho, amafilimu abheke phambili, eqhubeka nokwakha umhlaba omuhle, uyisikhumbuzo sokwenza, futhi uyindlela yokuphila.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Umthelela Wokuxhumana Nempilo Yethu Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, kodwa kudingeka sikhumbule futhi izinselelo ezithile ezivela kule mikhakha. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle imiphumela yalo, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokuxhumana. Ukuqala, ubuchwepheshe bukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi. Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngama-smartphone, amakhompyutha, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza, abantu bangathola ulwazi olukhulu ngezikhathi ezimfushane. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukufunda, ukuhweba, nokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nemicimbi emihle, okwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuxhumana okukhululekile kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abangakaze sihlangane nabo, futhi kwenza umhlaba ube mncane. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba sikhula kulesi sikhathi sokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, sithola nezinkinga ezithile. Ukuxhumana okungaqondile, okungokwenkolo, kuveza izinselelo ezinkulu. Abantu bahlala bexhumene, kodwa ukuxhumana kwabo kungase kube okungaphelele. Ukukhuluma ngobuso nobuso, ukuxhumana okwenziwa ngempela, kudinga umuzwa ophilayo, okungatholakali kalula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kungaholela ekudambiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi emoyeni nasempilweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhombise izinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba sabelana ngemininingwane yethu, sithola ubungozi bokuthi le mininingwane ingase ibhujiswe noma itholakale kalula kubantu abangafanele. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela, konke lokhu kudala ukungathembeki phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neziqinisekiso ezinamandla ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukuvikeleka okufanele, kodwa futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuvikeleka akukona kuphela okwenziwayo ngubuchwepheshe, kodwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zethu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisayo, ezithinta imizwa, nezokuxhumana okwenziwa ngempela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obuhlala isikhathi eside. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, behlola izindlela zokuxhumana ezizwakalayo nezinomthelela omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhuthaza ukufunda nokukhula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinkundla zokuxhumana kufanele zikhuthaze ukufunda, zifundise abantu ngezinto ezintsha, futhi zikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bejabulile, benza kube lula ukufinyelela kumathuba amasha. Ekuqedeni, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bunemiphumela eminingi empilweni yethu. Kunezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa kudinga ukuba sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze siphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zethu, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, futhi siqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yethu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu, sikhulise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe neqhaza elihle emhlabeni. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ubuchwepheshe, sithuthukise izindlela zokuxhumana, futhi sikhulise umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuqinile, futhi onokukhula okuqhubekayo. Ubuchwepheshe kufanele kube ithuluzi lokwakha, hhayi lokuphula, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwenzeni lokho kube yimpumelelo.
Amahlaya (Comedy) Isingeniso Amahala yisigaba esihlekisayo sokucabanga, besebenza njengesithombe sobuhlakani bezinto ezahlukene. Kulo mbhalo, sizokhuluma ngama hlaya, sihlaziye imbali yawo, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemithelela yawo emphakathini. Amahla ayindlela yokuzijabulisa futhi adlulisela umyalezo, evame ukuhlekisa abantu, ukuvusa imicabango, nokukhipha imizwa yokujabula. Imbali YamaHlaya Ukwazi imbali yama hlaya kubalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wazo. Amahla aqala ezikhathini zakudala, lapho abaculi babebhala izingoma nezincwadi ezihlekisayo ezazibhalwa njengezinkanyezi eziphathelene nemicabango yempilo, uthando, nezinselele. Emazweni amaningi, kuvela ababhali abanjengo-Aristophanes eGreece, owadlala indima enkulu ekwakheni amahlaya ashibhile. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, amahlaya aqhubeka eguquka; abaculi bayengeza imizwa, izimo, nezimo zempilo zansuku zonke, okwenza ahlale ehambisana nezimo zenhlalo ezikhona. E-England, abantu abaningi bahlonipha uWilliam Shakespeare, owasungula amahlaya afaka ubuhlakani nokuhlekisa okungaphezu kwemingcele yendawo. Izinhlobo ZamaHlaya Amahla ahlukahlukene anemishado yangempela, amaphikisho, nezinhlelo zokuhlekisa. Ezinye zezinhlobo ezidumile zamahlaya zifaka: 1. I-Comedy Stand-Up: Quizwa ngomshayi ohlonishwayo, odlalayo phambi kwabantu. Umshayi uhlola izimo zenhlalo, ukuhamba komphakathi, nezifundo zempilo ngendlela ehlekisayo. 2. I-Sitcoms: Lezi yizinhlelo zethelevishini ezahlukaniswe ngama-hlaya. Zihlaba ezindaweni ezijwayelekile, fokussinga abantu nokusebenza kwabo nsuku zonke. 3. I-Physical Comedy: Lezi amahlaya adinga ukusetshenziswa kwemizimba, ezifana nezinkanyezi ezihlekisayo eziqoshwa ngezinga eliphezulu ngenxa yokudumisa izisebenzi zomphakathi. Imithelela YamaHlaya Emphakathini Amahla ayindlela ebalulekile yokukhipha imizwa nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Kwabaningi, amahlaya anikela ithuba lokuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Ukuhlekisa kuqala kube nzima, kodwa kuthandwa ngenxa yokuthi kuputha ibhasi lezinkinga zansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya avame ukuvusa ingxoxo. Njengoba ababhali behlekisa, kungenzeka kube nemibuzo ethinta izindaba ezinzima, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, ubuzwe, nasekuchazeni ubulungiswa. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ngaphakathi komphakathi, kungaba kwezokuxhumana, ezemidlalo, noma ezobuciko. Ubuciko Bokuhlekisa Ukuphumelela kokuhlekisa kudinga ubuciko, ubuhlakani, nomqondo weqiniso. Ababhali bama hlaya bavame ukudala izimo ezihlekisayo ngenhloso yokuhlekisa okuyiqiniso. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba amahlaya angafaka abantu ebuhleni nasekukhulumeni. Ukuba ubuhlakani beqondise izinhlelo zamanje zama hlaya, kudinga ukubheka izinqaba zezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amahlaya ahlukahlukene, akhombisa ukunambitheka kwezinhlanga, izindawo, nemicabango eyakhayo. Lokhu kudala ukujula okuyingqayizivele, okwenza kubaluleke kakhulu. Isiphetho Amahla akha isiko emazweni amaningi, ikakhulukazi uma sibheka umhlaba wezenhlalakahle nezobuciko. Kukhona ezinye izindlela ezithakazelisayo zokuhlekisa, ukusuka kumabhukwana, ezinkanyezi, nezinhlelo zethelevishini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izindlela zifana kangakanani, umgomo omkhulu ungukubamba abantu behlekisa, baphinde bahlolisise izinkinga ezikhiqizayo emhlabeni. Ngakho-ke, amahlaya awekho nje ukuze ahlekise; akuyona kuphela indawo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa nendlela yokuxhumana, yokufundisa, nokwenziwako. Amahla ahlekisayo angaba yindlela yokukhaya, ukusiza abantu baphinde bancome ukuze baphile impilo ejabulisayo. Ngakho-ke, sihlezi sicela ukuthi sihlekise, sifunde, futhi sithokozise. Amahla aphilayo aqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, ehola izizukulwane eziningi endaweni yokuhlekisa.
Ukwakha Umlando Wokhetho Lukazwelonke eNingizimu Afrika Ukwenzeka kokhetho lukazwelonke eNingizimu Afrika kuyisixhumanisi esihlanganisa uthando, ubuhlungu, kanye nokuphikelela. Lokhu kuqala emlandweni wezombusazwe, lapho izigaba ezahlukene zashintsha impilo yamaNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ekubuseni komphakathi oyedwa kuze kube sekubeni umphakathi kadeni. Umnyaka ka-1994 waba yisikhathi esiyingqayizivele, njengoba ubandlululo belukhona, kanti abantu abamnyama babephikisana nezinhlelo ezazibahlasela. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukukhumbula imikhankaso yokhetho, okuhlanganisa nemihlangano yokulwa nobandlululo, njengama-ANC, SACP, nezinye izinhlangano ezagqugquzela ukunyakaza. Ngo-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lweminyaka eminingi lwaba khona, lwavula amathuba amasha, lwavumela abantu abamnyama ukuba bakhulume. Lokhu kwaba yithemba elikhulu, njengoba ukhetho lwaluphinde lwavula indlela yokwazi kwabaningi. Abantu babephuma ezitaladini, bebamba amaphephandaba nemithombo eyahlukene, besekela i-ANC, begcizelela ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, le minyaka yokhetho yayihambisana nezinselelo eziningi, njengoba iziphathamandla ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zazizama ukuheha abantu. Abanye, ngenxa yokwesaba, babengafuni ukuveza izinkulumo zabo. Isimo sezombusazwe sasingesihle; abantu babejolise ezikhangisweni, besondela ezindaweni zomphakathi. Ngo-1999, ukhetho lwesibili lwaba yithuba lokwakha amathuba amasha, kwavula indlela yokuhola imiphakathi eminingi ezinguqukweni. Izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezinsiza, imfundo, nezokwelapha zathuthuka, kodwa izinkinga zokungathembeki nokuqoqwa kwemithombo zaba yinqaba. Njengoba uhulumeni waqala ukwakha izinhlelo, amalunga e-ANC azama ukuhambisana nokuhamba kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kwagcizelela ukubaluleka kwezinhlangano ezisemqoka emnothweni, nokuxhumana phakathi kwamakhaya. Ubufakazi bokukhula nokuhlanganiswa kwabantu bukhona kulolu hlobo lwezombusazwe. Ekupheleni konyaka ka-2000, abathintekayo bahlangabezana nezimo ezinzima, bahlola izinkinga ezibhekene nezinkulungwane zabantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphakamiseni umoya ophikisayo. Nokho, izixazululo zaphuma, zaphinde zavuselela izinhlelo. Ukhetho luka-2004 lwaba ithuba lokuhlola okwenzekayo ezindaweni zomphakathi, kwavumela abameli bezombusazwe ukuqonda ukuphila kwabantu. Noma izinkinga zikhula, abantu baqhubeka besebenzisa ilungelo labo lokukhetha. Izinyanga zaphuma, kuze kube yilapho ukhetho luka-2009 lukhumbuza abantu ngentshisekelo yokuvota, kodwa imiphumela ibonise ukungaboni ngaso linye. Abakhethiweyo bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi, futhi lokhu kwavusa impikiswano. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ukhetho luka-2014 lwavusa ukuzinza. Nokho, izinguquko zaphinde zaba nomthelela emigomweni. Ukhetho lwakha isimo sokukhula, kodwa izimo zaphinde zaba nzima. U-2019 wadala umoya wokukhumbula izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa abanye baqhubeka bephakamisa izibuyekezo emnothweni. Abakhethiweyo bangena embusweni, behlonipha imiphakathi. Ukuphendula kwabantu kwaphinde kwavuselela isithakazelo, kuvumela abantu ukuba bakhumbule imikhankaso yabo. Namuhla, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlonishwa, njengoba abantu bephokophela emisebenzini yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthuthuka okwenzekayo, nezinga lokwaziswa kwabantu. Izinkulungwane zabantu zikhumbula indlela eyayithathwa, futhi nakuba izinhlelo zingakapheki kahle, abantu bayazi ukuthi ezizayo zikhona. Ngakho, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ngezinsuku ezithile, kodwa lukhombisa izifiso zabantu ngesikhathi samanje. Noma izinkinga zikhona, umoya wabantu uyavuma, ngoba lokho kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umzabalazo ungenzeka, kodwa ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlala luhlaza.
Ezabantwana (Children’s Welfare) Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaziwa ngempilo yebantwana? Impendulo: Impilo yebantwana ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudla okunempilo, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokunakekela, kanye nemfundo ewusizo. Ukuze abantwana bakhule kahle, kudingeka baphumelelise izinselelo ezithile nolwazi oluqinile. Umbuzo 2: Kanjani ukondla abantwana ngendlela efanele? Impendulo: Ukondla abantwana ngendlela efanele kuhilela ukunikeza ukudla okunempilo okwakha izakhi ezisemqoka emzimbeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amandla, ubuchopho, nezinhlelo zokulawula izifo. Iziphuzo ezifanele, ukudla okwakha amathambo, izithelo, nemifino kubalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Umbuzo 3: Kazi izinsiza ezingatholakala ezindaweni zokuhlala kwabantu abaningi? Impendulo: Ezindaweni eziningi, izinsiza ezifana nezikole, izikhungo zokunakekela, nezikhungo zokwelapha ziyatholakala. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwamakhandidethi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana baziqonda kahle futhi banelungelo lokuthola lezi zinsiza. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izinhlaka ezizimele zingaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yebantwana? Impendulo: Imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yebantwana njengoba ikhuthaza ukukhula kwengqondo, ivula amathuba emisebenzi, futhi ibasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfundo idala isisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ifundisa nezindlela zokubhekana nezinselelo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukudlala kudlala indima enkulu empilweni yabantwana? Impendulo: Ukudlala akuwona nje umphakathi, kodwa kubalulekile empilweni yabantwana. Kubasiza ukuba bahlakulele amakhono, bakhulume nabanye, futhi bejabulele. Lokhu kudala umhlaba owakhayo, owanelisayo, obalulekile ekukhuleni kokomoya. Abantwana badinga isikhathi sokudlala ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Umbuzo 6: Izinselelo zempilo yabantwana zikhona yini? Impendulo: Yebo, izinselelo zempilo yabantwana zikhona, njengekushoda kwemithwalo yokunakekela, ukugula, nemfundo engaphelele. Abantwana abaningi babhekana nezinkinga zokudla okungafanele, izinkinga zomndeni, kanye nemiphumela yokuhamba kwabo kwemali. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo ezisemthethweni ukuze kuzothuthukiswa izinyathelo ezizobasiza. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezinokwenziwa ukuvikela abantwana? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvikelwe abantwana, kumele kube nemithetho eqinile yokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhilela izinhlelo zokuvikela, izimiso ezivulekile zokwazi ngemithetho, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi onokuxhaswa. Ukuze lokho kwenziwe, uhlelo lokubambisana phakathi kwabaphethe imibono yempilo, izikhungo zemfundo, nabazali lungaba wusizo olukhulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani umphakathi ungasiza ekunakekeleni abantwana? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu empilweni yebantwana. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi ungaba nomthelela omuhle ngokwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisayo zokusebenza. Izifundazwe zingase ziqhube imicimbi ethile ukuxhasa abantwana, ukuvuselela umoya omuhle, futhi zikhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwabazali nezingane. Umbuzo 9: Yini ekhuthaza abantwana ukuba babe nemiphakathi emihle? Impendulo: Ukuze abantwana baziqhenye, kumele bakhule enhlalithelweni ethokozisayo, evulelekile, nezinsiza ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabazali, abafundisi, nabantu abahamba phambili emiphakathini. Ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokudlala nemihlangano engaphezulu kwezemfundo kungakhuthaza impilo yokuhlala phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umyalezo wokugcina ngempilo yabantwana? Impendulo: Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uqonda ukuthi impilo yabantwana iyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komphakathi, abazali, nabaholi bezenhlalakahle kumele baqinise izinhlelo ezisiza abantwana. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha isizukulwane esiqinile, esinesibindi, nesineke, esizokwakha umhlaba ohloniphekile.
Izindiza - Ukuhlaziywa Ngezindlela Zokuthengwa Kweminikelo Yezindiza Izindiza zithathwa njengendlela yokuhamba esheshayo, ethokozisayo, futhi efinyelelekayo kubantu abaningi emhlabeni. Njengoba izwe lihamba phambili, amakhasimende abona izindiza njengendlela eyodwa yokuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezikude, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhamba ibhizinisi noma uthokozisa umndeni. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinqubomgomo ezintsha ezivela kwizindiza ezihlukahlukene, okuyizinto ezithinta kakhulu ukukhetha kwethu. ### Ukukhetha Indiza Uma umuntu ehamba, isinyathelo sokuqala ufinyelela emangalisweni ayingqayizivele afika nofuna ukuhamba. Lokhu kuhilela ukukhetha phakathi kwezindiza eziningi ezihlinzeka ngeminikelo ehlukene. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukhetha izindiza zendawo noma ezizimele, ukuqonda izindleko, izinsizakalo, nezinga lempumelelo yenkampani kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile.
