Abaningi bakhetha izindiza ezinamabhanoyi ahlanzekile, kodwa futhi kufanele bazi ngokuhamba kwabo. ### Izinto Ezigqame Izindiza ezitholakala emakethe zibhekwa ngezinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa kwamakhasimende. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwezindiza kumele luhambisane nezidingo zethu, kungaba ngezinsizakalo zokudla, izinsiza zokuthola intambo ye-inthanethi, noma izinsizakalo zokwakha ubungane nokuhamba. Umsebenzi wezindiza ubalulekile, futhi kufanele kube necebo elikahle eliqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bakhululekile futhi naso sinokuthula kokuhamba. ### Ukuhlola Izindleko Ukuhlola izindleko zezendiza kube enye yezinto ezibaluleka kakhulu kubantu abahamba. Uthole ama-akhawunti amaningi, futhi akhawunti ngamunye uzama ukuncintisana ngezindleko. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkampani ezihlukene zinikeza izinto ezihlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuthola ama-odolo, izinsiza zamanje, nemali yokuthengisa. Ngesinye isikhathi, imiklomelo yokuhamba ingase ibuye ibhekelele ukubuyekezwa kwenzuzo, okubeka abahambi endaweni engcono yokukhetha. ### Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Ngaphandle kwezindleko ezitholakalayo, ukuphathelene nobuchwepheshe bokufaka izicelo nokuhweba khona kuhlale kubalulekile. Izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa yizindiza zenzelwe ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi lesi sikhala sinobuchwepheshe obusha bokuhlola izinga lemikhankaso yesikhumbuzo, phakathi kokunye ezikhuluma ngale mikhankaso. Ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko, kubalulekile ukuhlola izindleko zamasiko, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokuthi umthengi vying bejolise ngobunono. ### Ukuhamba Kwezentengiselwano Kwezentengiselwano, izindiza zibaluleke kakhulu ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo ethile. Ukuthengwa kwezindiza kuphinde kube nendawo ebalulekile. Ukuze uthole imo engcono yokuhamba, kubalulekile ukucabanga ngezinhlelo zokuhlela izindiza kanye nezindawo ezihlinzekwa imikhiqizo emisha. Lokhu kuletha ukuchuma kwezidingo ezikhethekile zezimali ezidala umqondo osebenzisa amakhulu ezinkampani ukuze uthole okuningi. ### Ukuqondanisa Nezidingo Zokuhamba Ukwazi ukujola nezinsizakalo zezilimi ezahlukene nezinye izidingo kubalulekile. Izindiza eziningi zinikeza ezokuhamba ezihambisana nezidingo zolimi, izinsizakalo ezihlanganisa imibhalo, nezithombe ezenzakalayo zemithwalo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umthengi uziswa, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ezinzima, ukuvikela izidingo zentela, futhi uthole izinsiza ezibalulekile. ### Umphumela Wokugcina Izindiza zikhula futhi ziphila kuzo zonke izici. Ngokuqhubekayo, ukuqashwa kwezindiza kumele kube namathuba okulungiswa okuqinisekisiwe, ukuhamba kube nezinqubo ezihambisanayo, futhi uphawu lwammanga lwezindiza ruzokwenza kube lula kuwe. Kuze kube yilapho isimo sadlula, ukuhamba ngokuzenzakalela lapho uhambela khona, umphakathi kabazali, izimangalo zempumelelo, futhi uphumelele emhlabeni. Ngokubuka konke, izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yamanje. Ukuhamba ngobuchwepheshe, izindleko, nezinsiza eziyinhloko, konke kubalulekile! Ngokuhamba, abahambi bangahamba kalula, bahlala bekhululekile nezindlela ezihlukile. Ngalesi sikhathi, izindiza ziyindlela ebalulekile yokuxhumanisa abantu emhlabeni jikelele.
Izimpande Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Kwathi emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwaba nesimo esihle. Le ndawo yayisemaphandleni, izindawo ezinhle nezithokozisayo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwalukhanya phezulu, luthokozisa abahlali. Nokho, uMkhumbane wawubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemithombo yokuphila, izikole eziphumelelayo, nezinsiza zempilo. Abantu bezama ukuziphilisa, kodwa impilo yaba nzima. Ngakho, emini ethile, umphakathi wahlangana ukuze wenze isinqumo. Bahlangana emzaneni, behlanganyela izinkumbulo, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu njengophawu lokubambisana. UMama Nandi, omama bendawo, waphakamisa ukuthi, “Sidinga ukuvuselela uMkhumbane, sithuthukise izindawo zethu. Asihlanganyeleni!” Abantu bavuma, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya. Ngaleso sikhathi, uBaba Thulani, owayaziwa ngolwazi lwakhe, wathatha isinyathelo. “Masithathe izinyathelo ezincane,” kusho yena, “sifune izinsiza, sikhuthaze abasebenzi bendawo, sithuthukise imfundo.” Umkhankaso omusha wezokuthuthukiswa waqala, abantu baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo, bejolise ekubambisaneni, befuna izinsiza ezivela kuhulumeni, ezizimele, noma kumaphrojekthi. Umnumzana Jabu, owayedlala indima enkulu ekugqugquzeleni abantu, wathi, “Sizokwakha izikhungo zemfundo. Sizokwakha iziteshi zamanzi, ukuze wonke umuntu athole amanzi ahlanzekile. Sizobambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ukudla, sikhuthaze ukuzimela.” Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqala ukukholelwa emandleni abo, bazi ukuthi bangazuza uma behlanganyela. Izinhlelo zathuthuka, izikhungo zemfundo zakhuliswa, futhi izingane zakhuluma ngokuthokozisa ngemfundo abayitholayo. U-Phumzile, uthisha, wathola ukuba neqhaza elikhulu. “Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ngalezi zinsuku,” esho. “Abafundi bethu bahlala bejabulile, bazi ukuthi balindelele ikusasa elihle.” Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane wahamba phambili, izinhlelo zathuthuka, abantu bahlala bezithokozisa. Iziteshi zamanzi zenzeka, zikhanyisa izimpilo zabantu. Abantwana babedla umhlaba, begijima bezijabulisa. Izinsiza zempilo zazitholakala kalula, abantu banikezwa ithuba lokuba neqhaza, bahlala bejabulile. Nokho, ukuphila akuhambanga kahle njalo. Kwakukhona izinselelo, nezinkinga ezazivela. Uhlelo olusha lwakha izinxenye eziningi, kodwa abanye abantu babengathandi. “Kungani kufanele sishintshe?” abanye babuza. “Uhlanga lwasekuqaleni lungakha izinkinga.” Kodwa uMama Nandi waphendula ngothando, “Ukukhula kudinga ushintsho. Sihamba phambili, asibuyele emuva.” Umoya wokubambisana waba yikhono elikhulu. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa zikhona nezixazululo. Baphakamisa amaphuzu, bahlanganyela, benza imihlangano, bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Umoya wabo wawufana nemvula ebusika, ulethela uMkhumbane isivuno esikahle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, imikhuba yendawo yathuthukiswa. Izikhungo zempilo zikhula, imfundo yayigqugquzela. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa lwaluphumelele, lwandisa impilo yezakhamuzi. Izinsuku zanyamalala, kodwa ukwakha umphakathi ongcono kwaba yinkumbulo engapheli. UMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bahlala bejolise empumelelweni, bangashintsha noma iyiphi indawo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwalukhanya phezulu, lukhuluma ngezindaba zempilo, uthando, nokubambisana. Umoya wokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya wawukhanya, futhi abahlali baqhubeka nokuthokozisa, bejabulile ngempilo yabo entsha. Ngalolu hambo, uMkhumbane waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma bephikelela, bahlala bejolise, bangathola impumelelo. Iminyaka yathuthuka, kodwa indaba yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya yaqhubeka, isingatha izimpande zesikhathi eside. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhanya, umphakathi unqoba, uthokozisa impilo.
Ukunakekelwa Kwabantu Abadala: Iphrofayela KaMnumzane Thandazani Ndlovu UMnumzane Thandazani Ndlovu ungumuntu oneminyaka engama-72, futhi uhlala emzaneni wakwaZulu lapho enza khona umsebenzi wobuholi emphakathini. Uthande abantu, futhi lokhu kwenze waba ngumholi ophumelelayo emsebenzini wakhe wokunakekela abantu abadala. UThandazani ukhomba ubudlelwano obuqinile nezinsizwa nezintokazi, abavakashela kumzala wakhe ukuqonda kakuhle izidingo zabo. UThandazani wazalelwa emakhaya aseMpumalanga, lapho rural lifestyle limthokozisa, akhule nabo onkosikazi abanjengobaba nabomama. Njengoba enza iminyaka, uThandazani waba nomuzwa ophusile wokuhlola izidingo zombuso, ikakhulukazi emphakathini walapha edolobhaneni, lapho abantu abadala bebhekana nezinselelo zempilo, izinsiza, nolwazi olwahlukahlukene. Ukwenza kahle kwakhe, uThandazani uyazisa ukufunda. Yena uthanda ukufunda izincwadi ezikhuluma ngezindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala, ikakhulukazi ezikhuluma ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, kodwa ubeqonda ukuba ukuthokozisa uthando kubaluleke kakhulu kunezimali. Akavumi ukuba kube khona umkhiqizo omubi emphakathini, umkhiqizo ophula ukholo kanye nokuzethemba kwabantu abadala. UThandazani ufunde ukubaluleka kokunakekela impilo yempilo yabo abadala. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukukhiqiza imithi nezinhlaka zempilo; kudinga ukuba imizamo ethile ibekwe ukuze abantu abadala bazizwe bethembekile, benakekelwa, futhi bephila kahle. UThandazani ubelokhu echaza ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, lapho izizukulwane ezancane zihlala khona nabantu abadala. Lokhu kudala umoya oncomekayo wombuso ophilayo emiphakathini yabo. Umkhiqizo wombono wakhe wahlangana nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa umphakathi, okwakwenza kwaba lula ukusiza abantu abadala ngokwabo naphakathi komndeni. Ithimba lakhe lathola uhlu lwabantu abadala abadingi olunye usizo, kanti ukukhalaza akwenzwa kakhulu. UThandazani uke wagovuzela umphakathi ukuphinya izinhlelo zokuthokozisa abantu abadala, okubandakanya izinsuku zokuhlala, imidlalo, nezifundo ezihlukahlukene zokuphila. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zebhizinisi ezifundisa abantu abadala ukudla okunempilo, ukugijima imidlalo, nokubhalela izincwadi, luveza amandla okwenyusa izinqubo ezizungezile. Njengoba eletha ukugubha, uThandazani uvuselela isithunzi somphakathi, udala ubudlelwano obuhle nezizukulwane. Iphakheji yakhe yokunakekelwa iyaziwa njengemfashini, edabula imihlangano wamanje nabantu abadala. Ngesikhathi esedlula eminyakeni, uThandazani ubona izinguquko ezinhle. Abantu abadala babenhlonipho, baphila kahle, bejabulile njengabantu abavela ezinye izikhumbuzo zabo. Umphakathi wakhe ubonisa uthando nokuqonda, uvuseleleke kulwazi oluwasizayo. UThandazani uphinde wahlanganyela nemikhosi yokuhlonipha abantu abadala, evuma imikhosi ethile, efaka imikhosi yokugubha izinsuku zempilo, kanti lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubonga ezinkundleni zabo. UThandazani udume kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi uhlala efinyelela ngokungapheli imeko ezinzima eziwuphawu. Uheha umphakathi ukuthi senze ukubambisana ukuze sifeze izinhloso eziyinqaba zempilo zabantu abadala. Uthando lwaThandazani nothando lwezimpilo zabo abadala kudinga ukugcina lomoya uhlala unjengoba uthuthuka. Ngokwengeziwe, amandla akhe okuba yisikhumbuzo sephakathi, ukumema, nokubulala izinkinga ezahlukene ekuphileni kwabantu abadala, kwehlulekile ukumshiya ethokozisa. UThandazani uvuma njalo ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, bebaphinde bebendlela kwezidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe uzoletha ithemba lokwethembeka, umphakathi ophilayo, nesibindi sokuhlonipha abangukuthi baphile kahle. Kuwo wonke amazwe yayeyimiphakathi, uThandazani um model oncomekayo wempilo yempumelelo. Uke ubophezela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala kuze kube sekuphumeleni, yena ubalulekile kulesi sikhathi, elwela ukwakha umbono ophilayo kube yimpumelelo ehloniphekile. UThandazani ubonisa ukuthi ubuholi bakhe bungahambisana namandla abantu abadala, bahlabelela impilo ezinhle, futhi bakhuthaze imiphakathi ukuba ithokozise. Ngakho, namuhla, uThandazani uphila kahle, udinga impilo ezikhumbuzwayo. Umbono wakhe nezinselelo azibhekile zifundisa, ziqondisa umphakathi ngemisebenzi nokukhulumisana okuhle, ukwenza kube kuhle empilweni yebantu abadala bakhe. UThandazani ungumuntu ophumelelayo, ophumelele emlandweni wokuziqhenya, ehlonipha ukholo nempilo.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Kwakukhanya usuku olukhulu emhlabeni wonkana, usuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Izixuku zabantu zazihlezi ezindaweni ezihlukene, zithe nikhona isibonda sokukhathalela ikusasa lezwe. Abantu babethokozile, behlanganyela imicabango yabo, bekhuluma ngomfanekiso okhula ezihlalweni zepolitiki. Imithombo yemvelo yayivulelekile, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, umoya uthanda ukuhamba, udlulisa izwi lothando phakathi kwabantu. UMnumzane Dlamini, oneminyaka engama-53, wayephethe izifundo zezombusazwe eNyuvesi. Ngolunye usuku, ngesikhathi enza ucwaningo, wathola ukuthi abantu abaningi abakacacisi kahle ngesinqumo sabo sokuvota. Lokhu kwammangaza, wahlala wacabanga ukuthi kumele enze okuthile. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi kufanele ahlasele umphakathi, achaze abavoti ngendima yabo. Umqondo wakhe washintsha, wathi, "Kumele sikhuthaze abantu bethu ukuba bazi ukuthi ukhetho lwethu luyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa." Uhlanga lwakhe lokuzama ukukhuthaza abantu lwalubhalwe ezincwajaneni, akhipha imiyalezo ehlukahlukene ngezikhalazo zikaHulumeni. Kodwa, njengoba kukhona abantu abaningi abashaya indiva, kwavela izithiyo. Ubuya kulezi zithiyo, wathola isixazululo—ukuphawula imibuzo nezinkinga ezibhekene nezinye izifunda, ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuvota akusiyona indaba encane. Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, uMnumzane Dlamini wadala umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukuvota. Wahlangana nomphakathi, wafundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, wabela abavoti abakhethiwe. Wazi kahle ukuthi abantu kufanele babenhloso, bangabi nokuphoxa, silindele impumelelo. Njengoba usuku lokhetho luzayo, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, izibani zezimoto zikhipha umhlaba wejuba. U-Dlamini ubungane noMfundisi Mkhize, umholi wenhlangano ethile, owawubona impumelelo yomphakathi wabo. UMfundisi Mkhize wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izinkampani ezinkulu, zisize umphakathi. Kwakungesikhathi esemi, abantu babewubona umphakathi wabo uyiqhawe. Emaphandleni, njengoba abantu bebhalisela ukuvota, uNksz. Madisha, owayekhokhela umphakathi, wathola ukuthi kunokuphoxeka. Abantu babengenamali yokuhamba, babelokhu bekhathazekile. Wazi ukuthi kumele athathe isinyathelo, wahlala phansi nabantu abamnyamalalayo emizini yabo, babonge zisize umphakathi bazi, ukwenza imizamo yokuthi bakwazi ukuvota. Ukuthokozisa abantu kwakuhamba phambili, uMadisha wathokoza. Njengoba isikhathi sishiya phezulu, usuku lokhetho lwafika. U-Dlamini, uMfundisi Mkhize noNksz. Madisha banqunywa ukuhamba ndawonye emzini wokuqala. Abantu bejabulile, kunjalo nofuna ukubona izibambo zempumelelo. Babengabukeli phansi, kwavela izivumelwano zenkolo, baqala ukuphila nomoya opholile. Ngokushesha, izinsuku ezedlule zashintsha, abantu babefika ezingxenyeni zokuvota. U-Dlamini wafa amazwi akhe, "Lena yinsuku yethu, asitheni, asivoteni!" Imiphakathi yabuya yaphakama, ibukela omama nababamkhulu bayo, imiphakathi yaphupha ngezimpumelelo ezitsha nekusasa eliqhakazile. Iziqhumane zabashayisana zamsinda, kwavuka umoya omnandi. Kwathi, sekwedlule isikhathi, abafundi bahlola amagama afakiwe. U-Dlamini, noMfundisi Mkhize noNksz. Madisha babebukeka bahlabene, kuyathokozisa ukukwazi ukuthi abavoti bakhetha kahle. Kuningi okwakukhuluma ngesikhathi sezingxoxo, ubuhlakani bukhanya, ibe khona imizamo yokuzivikela ekubeni neze. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiphithiphithi sihlanzeke. Kukhona abavoti abasha, abathokozisayo, abebevota ngokwenhloso. Ababukeli bathembisa impumelelo, baphakamisa imishayo, belezwa ukuhlakanipha kakhulu. U-Dlamini noMfundisi Mkhize, njengoba bekhuluma namhlanje, bazi ukuthi balungise ukudala ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umphakathi ubonisa inkanyezi; ukuholwa, ukholo, nezinhlelo. Ngemva kosuku lokhetho, wabhaliswa wonke amahlandla, abantu babebonisa ukubonga. Kwakungesikhathi somdlandla, bake bahlala bezwa ubuhle beqhawe elithokozisayo. Umoya wokukhushulwa uthokozisa abantu, uzikhiphile eziphathekayo. U-Dlamini, noNksz. Madisha, noMfundisi Mkhize b="{3}" baphumelele kumphakathi. Lokhu konke kuthokozisa, kubonakala umuntu ngamunye kwazulu wozalo. Ukhetho lwaluqukethe amaphupho, imizamo kababa, ubumbano phakathi komphakathi, lokho okukhombisa ukuthi uma abantu bebandlalala, bazokwakha umphakathi ovuselelekayo. Ngamanye amazwi, uDlamini, uMfundisi Mkhize noNksz. Madisha bephenduka abakhanyisa empilweni yethu. Impumelelo ibalulekile, kodwa iqhubeka ukuxoxwa ngolwazi, okukhulisa abantu bethu. Kwaba yisibhakabhaka sothando, u-Dlamini wagcizelela imiphumela, uNksz. Madisha wakhonza imiphakathi, uMfundisi Mkhize wagxila kumsebenzi. Kuze kube namuhla, izinto zishintshile; izizukulwane ezizayo zikhuluma ngobumbano, imizamo kanye nempumelelo, i-legacy yokhetho lukazwelonke. Isizinda somphakathi siqhubekela phambili, ukukwenziwa kwegazi lezikhalazo. Ukhetho aluhambisani namuhla, kodwa kwenza kube nempilo engcono yokubambisana.
IFIFA World Cup: Uhlanga Lwezokudlala Umhlaba I-FIFA World Cup, eyaziwa ngokuthi iNdebe yoMhlaba, iyisiganeko esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, esihlanganisa amaqembu ezizwe ezahlukene emqhudelwaneni omkhulu wombhoxo. Le midlalwano ibanjwa njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwamazwe. I-FIFA, okuyinhlangano ephethe imidlalo yeziqhingi zomhlaba, iyinhlangano eyasungulwa ngo-1904, futhi ibhekelele ukuphatha imidlalo yeziqhingi, ikakhulukazi iNdebe yoMhlaba. Ukwakhiwa KweNdebe yoMhlaba Ukwakhiwa kweNdebe yoMhlaba kuqala ngonyaka we-1930, lapho i-Uruguay yabamba umqhudelwano wokuqala. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuqala lokuhlangana kwamazwe ahlukene, okwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhombisa amakhono ezokudlala. Ukuze kube neNdebe yoMhlaba, amazwe kufanele abhalise, futhi ahlale enza kahle emqhudelwaneni wendawo. Lokhu kuhlola amakhono amaqembu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela amaqembu aphezulu angakwazi ukufinyelela emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. Izinguquko Nezithuthukisi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonile izinguquko eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko kumthetho, izindlela zokudlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Ngonyaka we-1998, kwaba nesinqumo sokwandisa inani lamazwe abamba iqhaza, kusuka kumazwe angama-24 kuya kumazwe angama-32. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi kumazwe amasha, futhi kwakhuthaza ukuncintisana okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuhlola imidlalo, ezifana ne-VAR (Video Assistant Referee), zengezelelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo ziqinile futhi ziqondile. Umthelela Wezokuxhumana Nezokuthengisa I-FIFA World Cup ayigcini nje ngokuba umqhudelwano wezokudlala, kodwa iphinde ibe yinsika enkulu kwezomnotho. Iziphakamiso zokuxhumana, izikhangiso, kanye nezinkampani ezithengisa imikhiqizo yazo zikhula kakhulu ngesikhathi somqhudelwano. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo kumazwe abamba iqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonisa ubuhle bezwe, ikakhulukazi uma ibanjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibe yingxenye yomcimbi omkhulu. Umphakathi Nezokuthuthukiswa I-FIFA World Cup ibuye ibe nempumelelo enkulu emiphakathini. Iphakamisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma amaqembu ahlukeneyo edlala. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamazwe, futhi kuqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi ibonisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana banethuba lokuthola imfundo yezokudlala. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, i-FIFA World Cup ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Izinkinga zokuphatha, izinkinga zezemidlalo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha zihlala zikhona. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umqhudelwano uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zithathwa ukuze kuvinjwe izinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, ezokuhlukana, kanye nezinkinga zokungabi nabulungiswa emqhudelwaneni zidinga ukugxilwa. Isiphetho I-FIFA World Cup iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imidlalo ingahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma ibhekwa njengomcimbi omkhulu. Ngaphezu kokuba umqhudelwano wezokudlala, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonisa umoya wokubambisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomnotho. Ukuze le midlalwano iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umqhudelwano ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. I-FIFA World Cup izoqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokudlala, futhi izoqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo.
Ukuntuleka Kwemisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya eNingizimu Afrika, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi sekuphenduke inkinga enkulu, ezwakalisa izinselelo eziningi kumphakathi. Izinsuku zethu zikhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyisisekelo sokuphila kahle, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwayo, abantu baningi abakhubazekile ukudla okwaneleyo, izindlu ezifanele, kanye nemfundo ezayo. Kuqala, kudingeka kuqondwe ukuthi le nkinga igqamile emiphakathini eminingi. Izizathu eziningi zenza ukuthi le miphakathi ibhekane nezithiyo ezinkulu ekutholeni imisebenzi. Ukuntuleka kwezimali zokutshala, ukwehla kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, kanye nezinselele ezinkulu kwezokuthutha, ziza phambili njengemithombo yalesi simo. Iziphathimandla zikhuluma ngale miphakathi, zikhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, kodwa imiphumela ivele ibonakale kancane. NgokweZibalo, inani labantu abavela emiphakathini yasemakhaya abangu-60% baphila ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuphila emaphakathini aanhlamvu omnotho, okwenza ukuba kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bakhuluma ngempilo elindeleke kabi, okukhombisa ukuthi bahlushwa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi nemisebenzi, nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka emindenini, lapho kukhula khona umuzwa wokwehluleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imfundo eyanele ikhalipha abantu ekutholeni imisebenzi, kodwa emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuqeqeshwa kwemicabango namakhono akabikhona. Izikhungo zemfundo azitholi ukweseka okuningi, futhi abantwana balahleka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusilela kwezinto ezifanele ezidingekayo ezikoleni, okubangela ukuba abafundi bahlale behluleka emikhakheni ethile. Iziphathimandla ziqhamuka nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa izimo zemisebenzi, njengokwakha izikhungo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Nokho, imiphumela yazo zihlala ziphansi, ngenxa yokuthi imithombo ethile ibonakala iyisitshalo esithile esithola ukufinyelela. Kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhamizi neziteshi zezimali, ukuze kube nokuqonda okukhululekile phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo ezithuthukisa umnotho wahulumeni zithinteka futhi zandiswa, kodwa akukhona okwanele. Umnotho omncane wezifunda ezisemakhaya uhlale ungapheli, nezinselele ezivela kumazinga aphakeme zihlala zibonakala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwehluka kwezifunda nemicabango, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuphila, eziklanyelwe ukwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuhlala kwezokuthuthukiswa kumele ziqinise imiphakathi yasemakhaya. Lokhu kumele kufake phakathi ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi, ukuphakanyiswa kwezinga lemfundo, nokukhuthazwa kokusebenza komphakathi. Umugqa wokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nosomabhizinisi kumele uqhubeke, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba okwakha imisebenzi. Ezinye izixazululo ezisematheni zifaka phakathi ukusungula imiphakathi emisha, ukuhlomisa izinsizakalo kulo mkhakha, kanye nokunikezela ngezinsizakalo ezinjengezohwebo ezineqhaza emiphakathini. Ukuze lezi zixazululo zisetshenziswe ngendlela ephumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuguqula indlela musha yokubona imisebenzi, kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kumele kube umqondo okhangayo, okubangela ukuqwashisa emphakathini. Ukuze siphumelele, kumele sifunde ukwakha izixazululo ezithinta izidingo zomphakathi, sinike izinsizakalo ezimqoka, futhi senze konke okusemandleni ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo nemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwezinto olunqamulelayo lukhona, kodwa sizokwazi ukuyedwa uma sithola isixazululo esifanele sokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Kulesi sikhathi sokuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya, kudinga ukuqwashisa okukhulu, ukusekelwa kukaHulumeni, kanye nokuqonda okunembile kwezinselelo ezikhona. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kumele sibe nesibindi sokuhlanganisa izindlela zokuxazulula nokuthuthukisa izimo, ukuze sikhulise amathuba okuphila kahle komphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela isithombe esitholakalayo emiphakathini yasemakhaya, sithuthukise izinga lempilo, nokugcina isithunzi somphakathi sibuye sibe ngaphezulu.
Amanani Okudla (Food Prices) Umbuzo 1: Amanani okudla ayini manje? Ngokwezinhlolovo zamuva, amanani okudla eNingizimu Afrika abheke phezulu, ikakhulukazi emaphandleni nasezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi, njengoba ukunyuka kwamanani kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlunge izindleko zabo ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu ezibangela lezi zinguquko? Izizathu ezahlukahlukene zikhona. Okokuqala, ukwanda kukaloliwe kanye nezindleko zokuhamba zikhuphukile, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla ngamanani aphansi. Okwesibili, izimo zezulu, njengokukhukhuleka noma umswakama, zithinta ukukhiqizwa kokudla, okukhulisa izinkinga zokukhiqiza. Lokhu kuholela ekushodweni kwemikhiqizo ethile, okukhuphula amanani. Umbuzo 3: Iziphi izitolo ezithengisa ukudla ngamanani aphansi? Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa amanani aphansi, kodwa abantu abaningi bangase bangatholi izinzuzo ezivela kuzona. Kuhle ukuba baqaphele izindawo ezithengisa imikhiqizo yasendaweni, njengoba lezi zindawo zivame ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo enempilo ngamanani aphansi, ngokuhlanganisa nezimakethe zokudla ezisemaphandleni. Umbuzo 4: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze banelise izindleko? Abantu bangasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze bahlale bephila kahle ngaphandle kokuchitha imali eningi. Okokuqala, bangathenga imikhiqizo yesizini, njengoba lokhu kuvame ukuba manzi kakhudlwana. Kwesibili, ukwakha uhla lokudla okuhle kusiza ukugwema ukuchitha imali engekho emthethweni. Okokugcina, ukuhlela izigcawu zokudla lapho umndeni ubuthana khona ukuze ufinyeleleke ezindlekweni. Umbuzo 5: Ukwenza kanjani ukuhamba ngebhajethi? Ukuze uhambisane nebajethi, kubalulekile ukuba noukandunana ngayo. Thola izimbalelwano okufanele uzithenge bese uhlela ukudla kwesonto. Futhi, zama ukuhamba nemali ethile ngempela ukuze ungachithi okwengeziwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela kahle izindleko zakho. Umbuzo 6: Iziphi izindlela zokuvikela ukuphepha kokudla? Ukwavikela ukuphepha kokudla kubalulekile emndenini. Qiniseka ukuthi ungakhetha imikhiqizo ehlanganisiwe, ubulale izilokotho noma izichitho ezithintekile. Phakathi nokupheka, qiniseka ukuthi ushisa ukudla ngokwanele ukuze ubhubhise amabhaktheriya athile. Ukugcina ukudla endaweni ehlanzekile nasemazingeni afanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kokudla. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe zikhona izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza abantu ngalezi zimo? Yebo, kuneminyango kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezihlinzeka ngempumelelo yokudla ukuze zisize abaningi. Ezinye iziFundiso zikhuthaza ukuthenga okuhle, ukufunda ngezindlela zokulima, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumakhono okufanele. Lokhu kungenza abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle futhi baphumelele ezindlekweni zabo. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokudla bunjani? Ubulungiswa bokudla buhlale buhlala busembhizeni. Izinkinga ezifana nokungabi nalokho abantu abakudinga, njengokudla kwemvelo nangolimi olufanele, zihlala zikhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi akhulume ngalokhu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bayathola ukudla okuphila kahle. Umbuzo 9: Zingaki izimboni ezihlinzeka ngana izimbuzi ezithengekayo? Izimboni ezahlukene zikhona ezithengisa ukudla, kusuka ezitolo ezinkulu kuya ezindaweni zokuhweba ezincane. Phakathi kokuthengwa, abathengi banikeza indawo ezithengwa ezilungile, ezithuthukile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhala, Nakanjani, izindawo ezizimele zidinga ulwazi olukhuluma kakhulu ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Ubani ongathinta kulezi zindaba? Wonke umuntu ungaba nesandla ekuthatheni izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa isimo sokudla. Lokhu kudinga ukuvuma izindleko zabo, ukusebenzisana nomphakathi, nokuhlinzeka ngezimpendulo ezisebenzayo. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi sithola isixazululo esihle sokudla. Umphumela: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwazulu kuzodingeka ukuthi siqaphele amanani okudla futhi sithathe izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ukuze silwisane nezinselelo ezikhona. Imikhankaso yokudayisa, ukuhweba, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanelekile ingaholela ekuvulekeni kwemizamo yokuhlala sithola izinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi kube khona okuthile esikufisayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu ukuthola ukudla okwanelisayo.
Ifilimu, njengemifanekiso ehambayo, idlalela indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umbono omusha, isivumela ukuba sihlole izikhathi ezahlukene, izindawo ezikude, kanye nezimo ezithokozisayo. Namuhla, ifilimu ibhekwa njengenye yezindlela eziyinhloko zokuxhumana nezilaleli, ihlanganisa izindaba zansuku zonke, izifundo zempilo, nemicabango ethokozisayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ifilimu ayiyona nje indlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyithuba lokuxhumana nezilaleli eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma ibhalwe futhi iqhutshwa kahle. Ifilimu ingase ibe yindaba ethokozisayo, ibhuku, noma ingxenye ye-biography, kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi isithombe sabelane ngemizwa nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Isinyathelo sokuqala sokwenza ifilimu siqala ekucabangeni ngendaba: ubani ophakathi kwendaba, futhi yini eyenzekayo? Lokhu kubeka isisekelo sokucwaninga okujulile ukuze kuqondwe kahle izimo zomphakathi nezemvelo ezithinta indaba. Uma sesikhethile indaba, kudingeka sithobele umthetho othi ubuchwepheshe budlala indima enkulu, kusukela ebhalweni lo mlingo kuze kube uhlelo lokukhangisa. Umqondisi, ophakathi kokuhola nokuxhumanisa, udinga ukuba nekhono lokuqonda izethameli zayo, ebhalela abalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhuluma ngendaba. Kulokhu, kudingeka ubuchule bokwakha izimo, izakhiwo, nezithombe ezikhethiwe, okwakha ubuhle obuhlobene nezimo eziyingqayizivele. Akukona nje ukwakha umhlaba ohluke, kodwa kubalulekile ukulinganisa izithombe zamakhono abalingisi abalwa nezindleko eziphambili. Njengoba siqhubeka nohlelo lokwenza ifilimu, kudingeka sisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, njengezithombe ezihambayo, umculo, nezwi, ukuze kubonakale kahle umoya nezinhloso ezithile. Umculo udlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni imizwa ethile futhi uyinsika yokugcina umoya ophakathi kwendaba. Lokhu kudinga abaculi abanolwazi ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezihambelana nezimo zomlando ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kulandelwe imithetho yenkampani yezenhlalo ukuze kuthintwe iziphetho ezithile, isikhathi sokwenza izinqumo, nezithameli ezahlukene. Uma sekuqediwe, ifilimu iba semukelweni emphakathini, lapho izilaleli zikhumbuza emlandweni wombono, zenze amaqiniso ajulile ezimweni ezithile, futhi ziqhathanise lezi zinhlelo nezinto ezenzakalayo empilweni yazo. Ukwazi ukuheha izithameli ngebhajethi ephansi nokuqonda kahle izidingo zalezi zihloko kubalulekile kule ndawo yomsebenzi. Ngenkathi ibhajethi ingavumeli ukwenza yonke imihlangano efiselekayo, kuhle ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga lekhwalithi. Lokhu kuzothinta umphakathi ngendlela yokuthi kube neqhaza elisemqoka ekwenzeni ifilimu idume futhi ithakasele. Lapho ifilimu isiqediwe, kumayelana nokuthengisa. Izingosi zokuxhumana, izikhangiso zezindaba, nemicimbi yokwazisa ifilimu kubalulekile ukuze izilaleli zihlale zikhumbula ifilimu, kuze kube sekuwusuku lokuthola ukumukelwa. Uxhumano lwemithombo yezindaba lungaba nendima ebalulekile ekwenzeni ifilimu iqhubeke nokufinyelela ezihlalweni zamaphiko amaningi. Uma sithanda ukuphinda sikukhumbuze, ifilimu ayiyona nje indlela yokubuka ubuwula noma izinkanyezi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana ngemithombo ethile, ivuliwe kakhulu ngokwakha kwesikhathi, indaba, nezimo ezithile ezimnandi nezinobuhlungu. Kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa, ukwandisa umqondo wethu, futhi sibe yingxenye yalesi siko esikhaliphile sefilimu. Lokhu kuhlonishwa ngokuphelele, kwazise ifilimu iyinsika yokuzijabulisa, ikakhulukazi uma ibhalwe kahle futhi iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, umkhakha wefilimu ungowokuxhumana, okukhumbuza ukuthi sithinteka kanjani kulokho okuletha indawo esiyiphilayo emhlabeni wezenhlalo, imicabango, nezinkolelo zethu. Ifilimu iyijubane lempilo, ibhalwa kusuka enhliziyweni, igcinwa engqondweni, futhi ibhalwa ezithombeni — futhi lokho kuzozikhumbuza ubuchule besikhathi sokuphila kwethu.
uBafana Bafana: Umbiko Ngemisebenzi Nezimpumelelo zonyaka ongu-2023 Ukwakha imbali yeqembu lemidlalwano yeqhawe laseNingizimu Afrika, uBafana Bafana, kudinga ukugxila emhlabeni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emlandweni nasezimpumelelweni zabo. Ngonyaka ka-2023, uBafana Bafana ubhekane nezinselele ezithokozisayo, izinhlelo zokwenza kahle, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo eqhubekayo. Kuqala, akumele silibale izikhathi eziyinhloko zeqembu, ezazihlanganisa nemidlalo yeziqongo, izifundo ezivela emqedweni nasekuphumuleni okubuhlungu. UJesse Lingard, umqeqeshi omusha ozinikele, ubhajwe ngoMfumfu ka-2022, washintsha umehluko kwezokwakha iqembu. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuhlela kahle isikhala somphakathi ludale umoya omuhle phakathi kwabadlali, kwenze kuhambisane ezicini eziningi zomphakathi. UMqeqeshi Lingard uholele uBafana Bafana ekuzuzeni umphumela omuhle emidlalweni yeCAF Africa Cup of Nations. Ukubambana phakathi kwabadlali abasha nabadala kube yinsika yokuphumelela, kanti izinjongo ezibekiwe nohlaka lwemidlalo ziqhubekile. Ukuze uBafana Bafana aqhubeke nokuhlonishwa, ukwenziwa kokuqeqeshwa okwakhelwe phezulu kuphumelele, lapho abadlali behlangene bezama izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza ndawonye. Uhlaka lwezemidlalo olwaziwayo luphinde lwengezwe, kanti imiphumela ibonisiwe nemidlalo eyinqaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubusuku bokudumisa ubuhlakani beqembu buphumelele ngokuphuma kwezinye izikhumbuzo emhlabeni jikelele. Izithombe ezikhumbulekayo zomphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi uBafana Bafana ujoyine izilaleli ezithokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa kokwakhiwa kwezikhumbuzo zomphakathi, ulwazi olunembile nolufanele, kuhumusha impumelelo yeqembu, okubuyisela ezikhaleni ezithakazelisayo. Ngenhlanhla, iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukuthola abalandeli abasha, abavuma ukunakekela imidlalo yeBafana Bafana. Ukulandelana kwemidlalo ehlukahlukene kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi umphakathi othanda umoya omnandi wokudlalela umphako. Umhlangano wezokuxhumana phakathi kwabadlali nabalandeli kusebenza njengesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi onokholo. Naphezu kwezinselele, uBafana Bafana ubonise amandla okuqhamuka nezinsiza zokuqinisa isikhumbuzo somphakathi. Izimiso zokusebenza ezihlala zikhona ekubhekeni impumelelo yeqembu kubalulekile, kusukela ocwaningweni, ukuhlinzeka ngezimpumelelo ezithile, kuya ekwakhiweni komnotho wezimali. Lokhu kuzinza izindlela zokuqhubeka nokwaziwa kwezokudlala. Ekugcineni, uBafana Bafana uqhubeka uhlanganyela imijikelezo emisha phakathi kokuphumelela, ubonisa izimpilo zabadlali abanesibindi, umoya wokuzikhandla, nokwengeza kuzo zonke izinselelo zempilo. Ukwakhiwa komndeni obumbene phakathi kwezithameli, ukudalwa kwamathuba omphakathi, nokwaziswa komikhankaso yokufinyelela izindinganiso, konke lokhu kuyisinyathelo esiqinile sokuphumelela. Ubuhlakani bokudlala, izinzuzo zeqembu, kanye nezikhulu ezazibonisa umbono ophezulu, kukhuthaza uBafana Bafana ukuba ube yizwe elibukekayo emhlabeni. Umoya wokuphumelela uvula izindlela ezintsha, ezikhuthaza umphakathi, nokuqhubekela phambili eminyakeni ezayo. Ngamafuphi, uBafana Bafana usezandleni ezinhle, usesithokoziseni ngezindlela ezijulile zokuzithokozisa, nezinzile. Izinhlelo ezinkulu zikhona, kanti imizamo yokwakha ibhuloho kulindeleke ukuba idlule ezimfuneko, zakhela uBafana Bafana impumelelo ewusizo neqhubekayo. Bese kuba nesikhala esikahle sokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokudlalela, uBafana Bafana kulindeleke ukuthi ibonakale njengeqembu elikhulu, elikhombisa umqondo oqinile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngemidlalo ezokhuthaza ubuholi, uthando, nezizathu eziyinhloko zokuphumelela.
Umdanso Wokuphila Kwakukhanya usuku oluhle eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinyanga zazikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo. Emzaneni waseMhlabeni, abantu babekhuluma ngokuhlangana okwakuzokwenzeka emnyangweni omkhulu. Le mnyango ibibizwa ngokuthi "Umdanso Wokuphila". Kwakuyisikhathi sokuhlonipha imvelaphi, ubungane, kanye namasiko. Umdanso wawuwumcimbi obalulekile emphakathini, owawuhlanganisa abantu bahlukene, bejolisa emhlabeni jikelele. Abantu babefika bejabulile, bejolisa ngezihlangu zabo ezihlotshisiwe, izigqoko eziphakeme, nemibala ehlukahlukene. U-dada uNandi, ongumlimi, wayeziqhenya ngekhono lakhe lokuhamba phambili emdansweni, eyaziwa kahle ngamakhosi emzini. "Umdanso akukhona nje kuphela ukunyakaza," kusho uNandi, "kodwa kuyindlela yokuzwakalisa imizwa, ukukhumbula abathandekayo, nokuhlonipha imvelo." Bese ivalwa umculo opholile, ophethe izithako ezithokozisayo. I-violin yabe isikhipha imisindo emikhulu, ihlanganisa izwi le-harmonica, i-djembe, kanye ne-piano. Njengoba umculo uqala, umoya wezothando nohombe wathinta wonke umuntu. Kwathi lapho uNandi eqala ukuqhubeka, wazithokozisa emdansweni. Izinyawo zakhe zashaya phansi, zishaya umhlaba, zikhombisa isibindi esikhulu. Abantu behlabelela, bejabulile, bejabulisa omama nabantwana. Umndeni kaNandi, owawuhlanganiswa nguBaba wakhe, uMkhulu, noMama, babemamatheka behlabelela, bejabulela ukuvuma umdanso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso wathola ukucasuka, abantu bejabulile bejabulisa, bekhumbula izinto ezinhle. U-Nandi wahamba phambili, enza izinyathelo ezihlukene, ezazikhombisa izilokotho zomphakathi. Kwakukhona umdanso owawuhlonishwa kakhulu, owawubizwa ngokuthi "Umdanso Wokuzalwa". Le ndaba yayikhuluma ngempilo, ukukhula, kanye nokuphila phakathi komphakathi. Emva kwesikhashana, uNandi wabona umama wakhe, owayebukeka ejabule, edansa eduze. Wathola umuzwa wokuthi umdanso wawuyindlela yokuxhumana, ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wawukhanya, futhi abanye abantu banyuko, bejabulile bejabulela. Umdanso wawuwumcimbi wokubuyisana, lapho abantu behlangana baphinde babuyise imizwa. Ngenxa yokuthi umdanso wawwuhambela phambili, umphakathi wawuhlanganyela, ukuxhumana kwabantu. Abantwana bejabulile, begijima, bejabulisa, behamba ngezinyawo zikaNandi, behlanganyela emdansweni. Umdanso wawuphuma enhliziyweni, futhi wanika amandla. Abantu babejabulile, behlabelela, behlanganyela, bebonisa izinyathelo ezihlukene. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso wagcwala, abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, behamba ngezinyawo, behanjiswa yi-music. Umdanso wawuhamba phambili, uNandi, uMkhulu, noMama behlanganisa iminyango yokubuyisana. Kwakukhona umoya omuhle, umoya wokuphila, umoya wokuhlonipha. Ngenxa yokuthi umdanso wawusendaweni, kwabakhona abathandi bemvelo nabantu ababejabulile, bejabulisa. Umdanso wawuhlanganyela imizwa ehlukene, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, nokuhlonipha imvelaphi. Kwakukhona umoya omuhle, umoya wokuphila, umoya wokuhlonipha. Ekugcineni, umdanso wawuhamba phambili. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi umdanso akukhona nje kuphela ukunyakaza, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, ukuhlonipha, nokuphila. Umdanso wawuhlanganisa abantu, wenza umphakathi uhlanganyele. Umdanso wawuhamba phambili, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula. Umdanso waba yimpilo, waba yindlela yokuphila, waba yindlela yokuhlonipha. Umdanso Wokuphila wawungaphezu kokunyakaza; wawuwumoya, ukufudumala, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha abanye. U-Nandi waqonda ukuthi empilweni, umdanso uyinqubo yokuphila, yindlela yokuhambisana. Njengoba izinyanga zazikhanya phezulu, abantu baphinde bahlangane, behlabelela, bejabulile, baphinde baphinde bakhumbule imvelaphi yabo. Umdanso Wokuphila, umdanso wokuhlonipha, umdanso wokuphila.
AmaXhosa: Umlando Wabo Naphakathi Kwemiphakathi YaseNingizimu Afrika INingizimu Afrika iyindawo enezizwe eziningi ezinezimfundo nemigubho yazo, futhi phakathi kwalezi zizwe, amaXhosa abamba isikhala esibalulekile emlandweni welizwe. Ukuze siqonde amaXhosa, kubalulekile ukubheka izinjongo zabo, izimpi abazibhekile, kanye nempilo yansuku zonke. Umlando wokuqala wamaXhosa uqala ngenkathi yeMfecane, lapho izizwe ezahlukene ziqhumeza izifunda ezinjengeZwelemehlo neZiyoni. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amaXhosa athuthele emhlabathini omusha, eza nezinkolelo, izilimi, nemigubho yabo. AmaXhosa, njengengxenye ebalulekile yamaNguni, abamba isiko elikhulu lokubhalwa. Ngesikhathi sikaNgqika, umholi ophakeme, amaXhosa aqala ukwakha uhlelo lokuphatha izifunda zabo. UNgqika wayeyisibonelo somholi onobuhlakani, ekhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwamasiko nobudlelwano phakathi kwamabandla. Nokho, baphinde babhekana nezinselelo ezinzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaXhosa namakhosi aseBurghers bahlala buphazamisekile, ngenxa yokwanda kwezifiso ezihlukene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yangaphakathi, amaXhosa akha ubudlelwano bokusebenza ndawonye ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Uhla lwezimpisi nezinsizakusebenza lwakha ubunzima kulolu hlobo lokuphila. Uhlelo lwamasiko lwalwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, lwabazalwane ezinkundleni zokucwenga. Ngaleso sikhathi, indaba encane yaba yinkinga enkulu - iMpi yeMfecane, ethinta izizwe eziningi. Ngesikhathi sikaDinizulu, amaXhosa aqala ukufuna izindlela zokuzimela. U-Dinizulu waba ngumholi ophakeme, owagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yomphakathi, kodwa ngenxa yokuncintisana, kwavela izimpi ezinzima. AmaXhosa abhekane nabantu abavela kwiNgilandi, okukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba wawuhlangene ngentando. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaXhosa akha izinkampani zomphakathi, ezathuthukiswa ngababengqongqozi nabanemisebenzi, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwamakhaya aqinile. Izinkambo zobungcweti zathuthukisa umfula wezinto ezivela kumamasiko amasha. Nokho, izinsuku ezinzima zikaJamaica nazo zafika, futhi kwavela ukuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ucwaningo lwamaXhosa luhlale lukhuthaza ubuntu, kodwa ubuholi badinga ukwandisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Ngemuva kweMpi YamaNguni, amaXhosa abhekana nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Ubulunga bamaXhosa bukhula, kanti uhlelo olwakhiwa abanye lwalwandisa izihlahla zabo. Imisebenzi yokukhumbula iyaqhubeka, njengoba kubalulekile ukuveza izinkumbulo namasiko abo. Ukuveza ukuphila kwamaXhosa kubalulekile ukuze sihlale sithembekile ekuziloleni kwamaNguni. Uhlanga lwamasiko lwamaXhosa lwalubhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, kodwa lwenziwa ngendlela yokubanga umhlaba. AmaXhosa agcina imikhuba neziqhamo ezijulile, esebenzisa izindlela zokuphila ezithile. Ubulawa bemikhiqizo bekuvuna impumelelo ezingeni. Izithakazelo zamasiko ezithile zamukelwa emnothweni nasemphakathini. Njengoba kudlula isikhathi, abantu bamaXhosa baqhubeka bephila impilo enempilo, bejabulile. Ukwazisa izinkumbulo zabo kubalulekile, njengoba kudinga imikhuba yamasiko yesikhathi eside. Ukwaziwa kwezinkumbulo zamasiko kunikeza umfanekiso obalulekile wamaXhosa, ubonisa ubufakazi bezinsuku ezedlule. Ubufakazi bukhona, futhi isikhathi sokuphila siqhubeka sikhanya. Ukwakhiwa kwamatraditions akhaliphile kudinga ukholo nolwazi olungapheli. AmaXhosa wayenolwazi olunzulu nokuthanda umhlaba abahlala kuwo. Ngakho, ubuhlakani nobuciko kwenza kube nempilo enhle. Izigidi zempilo zalezi zizwe zithokozisa, zikhanya kufaka izinkumbulo ezinamandla. Kulabo abafisa ukufunda ngamaXhosa nemvelaphi yabo, le ndaba ibalulekile ekucabangeni impilo yomphakathi. Ukuqonda imisebenzi yabo, izimpilo zabo zihlala phansi kwezimpande, futhi ukwenza izinhlelo ezisemqoka kusho ukuba nesibopho ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo nosizo. Lindela imiphumela ebushelelezi, ngaleso sikhathi amaXhosa ayaqhubeka aligugu lempilo. Ekuhlonipheni umlando wamaXhosa, kuhlanganiswe ubunikazi, izindawo, nezinsiza. Ubufakazi bomlando bukhomba ibhodi, futhi bazobaleka ngokuhambisana nezilimi, izinkumbulo nezinkolelo. Kuhlala kuyiqiniso ukuthi amaXhosa ayimfihlo enkulu yempilo eNingizimu Afrika, izithako zayo zikumlilo ogqamile wobuntu. Izoqhuba ubuciko bayo, iphakamisa izifiso ezintsha zobulungisa. Indaba yamaXhosa iyavuma ukufundwa, izalwa khona izinkumbulo, umkhankaso wokuhlonipha imisebenzi yawo emisha. Ngakho, izintaba zigoqe le ndaba ngezinkumbulo nemigenela yomlando, ukuze ubungani bamasiko buphumelele.

Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona amaPirates edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyisiko, kuyisiko elihlanganyela abantu, elihlanganyela umphakathi, elihlanganyela uthando. Ama-Orlando Pirates, iqembu elidume kakhulu, lihlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo.
Izinkinga Zomthetho: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezifundo Nezimo Zamanje Ezomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ovikelekile, nolondekile. Ukuqondisa izindaba zomthetho kuhlinzeka ngendlela yokulawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola izinkinga ezithinta ezomthetho, sihlole izifundo ezitholwe emlandweni, futhi siyabheka izimo zamanje ezithinta umthetho. Isizinda Somthetho Umlando wezomthetho ubonisa ukuthi izinkinga zomthetho azikhona kuphela emiphakathini ethile, kodwa ziwumongo wemiphakathi eminingi emhlabeni. Ukwakhiwa kwemithetho kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezimo zomphakathi nezidingo zawo. Izifundo zokuqala zomthetho zathinta izinhlelo zokuphatha, izinkantolo, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsiza zomthetho. Izifundo Zomlando Ukuqonda umlando wezomthetho kubalulekile ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile kwezinkinga zanamuhla. Izifundo zikaLutheran Luther, uJohn Locke, noThomas Hobbes ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izimiso zomthetho. Lokhu kuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi umthetho awuwona umphumela wezifiso zabaphathi kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nomthelela kulokho okwenziwa ngabanikazi bobuchwepheshe bemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zomlando ziye zaqondisa izinguquko ezinkulu, ezifana nezinguquko zomthetho wezobandlululo nobandlululo. Izimo Zamanje Namuhla, umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ezomthetho. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuhwebelana kwamazwe omhlaba, kanye nezinguquko ezimayelana namalungelo abantu kudinga ukuthi umthetho ube nezinqubomgomo ezisheshayo nezisebenzayo. Ukuze umthetho ube neqhaza elihle, iziphathimandla kumele ziqonde izidingo zenhlangano, zihlolisise izimo zomphakathi, futhi zifake imithetho ethuthukayo. Izinselelo ezikhona empilweni, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuphepha zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho kumele uqhubeke uhlanganisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuhweba Izinkinga zokuhweba, ezifana nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali, imigomo yokuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho ezithinta ububanzi bezinkampani, zibuye zibe nesigaba esibalulekile. Ukuhweba kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezomthetho ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukwakha izinqubo ezilungile, eziphathekayo, kanye nezinkantolo ezifanele kuyinsika yokuvikela ababambiqhaza. Ukwakhiwa Kwezichibiyelo Ukwakhiwa kwezichibiyelo ezisemthethweni kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. Njengoba umphakathi ushintsha, izichibiyelo zomthetho kufanele zihlale zihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ukuze kube nemithetho esebenza kahle, kumele kube nezinqubomgomo zokuhlola ezivumela ukuba imithetho ibhekelwe njalo. Isiphetho Ekuhlaziyeni izindaba ezithinta ezomthetho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lokhu akukhona okungapheli, kodwa kunokuhamba okujwayelekile. Umlando, izifundo, nezimo zamanje zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho unomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Ukuze kube nokwakhiwa komphakathi ophumelelayo, umthetho kumele uhlale uhambisana nezidingo nezimo ezishintshashintshayo. Njengoba singabantu, umthetho uyinsika esidingayo ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu, siqinisekise ubulungiswa, nokugcina ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo emiphakathini yethu.
uMangosuthu Buthelezi: UButhelezi ungumholi obalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu, owaziwa kakhulu njengomholi weqembu le-Izindaba ezimnandi, futhi wayengumuntu onamandla kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Wazalwa ngo-1928 eMlabathini, KwaZulu-Natal, futhi waphumula emhlabeni ngomhla zingama-9 kuNtulikazi 2023. UButhelezi waba neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezwe, edlula ezinselelweni eziningi ezaziphathelene nesikhathi sobandlululo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, uButhelezi wathola ulwazi eMnyangweni waseBantwini, lapho aqala khona ukugxila ezindabeni zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuthola iziqu zeDiploma, waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengophini lweSikhulu seKhabhinethi yaseBantwini. Phambi kwezinguquko ezinkulu emzabalazweni wamaNtu, uButhelezi wayengumholi ohlonishwayo, onamandla ezinqumweni zakhe. Ngonyaka ka-1975, waqukatha uMntwana uGadфa, wokwakha i-Black Consciousness, okwakuhloswe ngokuqinisa ukuzimela kwabantu abamnyama, nokuphikisana nenqubomgomo yokucindezela. Nokho, uButhelezi akazange azizwe ethokozile; impi yokuzimela kwama-Afrika yaholela ekuphikisaneni phakathi kwe-ANC ne-IFP, okuholele emaphusheni amakhulu. UButhelezi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuliseni izivumelwano zomphakathi, okukhombisa umbono wakhe omuhle. Umlando kaButhelezi ubonisa izinselelo, ukuvivinywa, nokuphakama phakathi kwezinsuku ezinzima. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, wayekwazi ukubekezela, efuna izindlela zokuvuselela izinhlelo, ubudlelwane bezenhlalakahle, kanye nezenhlalo zabantu abampofu. UButhelezi wayengumxhumanisi, ehlangana nabanye abaholi ukuze kube nokuxazulula izinkinga. Waqhubeka waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi, ethola ukwamukelwa emsebenzini wakhe ngenxa yokubona izinselelo ezikhulayo. Iziphakamiso zakhe eziphethwe kahle zikhombisa ubuqili bakhe. UButhelezi wajabulela ukubona izinguquko eNingizimu Afrika, ngesikhathi lapho izimfanelo zakhe, umqondo onobuhlakani, kanye nezindlela zokuphila kwabantu zikhanya. Umlando wokuphila kwamaNtu eNingizimu Afrika uhlanganisa abakhuluma iZulu, umbono obonisa izinqumo zamasiko ezide. UButhelezi wayehlonishwa njengomholi ophumelelayo ekuphatheni izinkinga, edinga ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Uhlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wezombangazwe, wakhangela izindlela ezithinta umnotho, impilo, nezinhlalakahle. Ababhali abambalwa bahlola lo msebenzi, behlola umbono omphakathi. UButhelezi waphinde waba nesandla ezindabeni ezinzima ezithinta abaholi bezenhlalakahle, ebamba iqhaza ezingqungqutheleni ezibalulekile. UButhelezi wayengomunye wabalwela ukuzimela kwama-Afrika, waba nesithangami esiyinhloko sokugcina izinkonzo ezibizwa ngaphezulu kwemiphakathi yethu. Umlando wakhe ubonisa ukuzinikela ekwakheni indawo engcono, ehambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. UButhelezi waziwa ngokuchaza uhlelo lwezithuthi oluqhubekela phambili, lokho kwaba ufakazi wombandela wamaMvela. Ubutfutfukwazi bakhe bobuzana nobuhlakani bamukelekile. Ekugcineni, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ubonakale njengobaba omuhle wezimila emkhakheni. Waguqula izikhathi, umbono wakhe wezombusazwe, kanye nemizamo yokwakha ubudlelwane obugqamile. Ngisho noma esehamba, umoya wakhe uzohlala ungacaphuni, usalindele abafundi nabanye abavela ebuhleni bemiphakathi yethu, uyokwakha impilo ezuzisayo. UButhelezi uyinkanyezi engapheli, isihlangu somphakathi ngendlela engavumelekile okulungiswa.
UDesmond Tutu Nomsebenzi Wakhe UDesmond Mpilo Tutu, owazalwa ngo-7 kuNhlangulana 1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuhlalisana, ubulungiswa, kanye nezokukhuluma. U-Tutu, ongumfundisi weSonto lamaAnglikani, waba yisithonjana sokulwa nobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nokuzinikela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. U-Tutu waqala ukufunda eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukuthola izifundo ezimayelana nezokuphatha, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokukhuluma. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, waba umfundisi, futhi wathola ithuba lokusebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika. U-Tutu waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola udumo ngenxa yokukhuluma kwakhe ngokuqinile ngokuchasene nobandlululo. Ubugebengu bobandlululo bukhombisa ububi obukhulu, futhi u-Tutu waba yisithonjana sokulwa nalokhu. Ngonyaka ka-1976, u-Tutu waba nguMphakathi weSonto leSonto lamaAnglikani eNingizimu Afrika, futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngokuqinile ngezinkinga ezithinta ubulungiswa, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. U-Tutu waba ngumholi ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuhlalisana, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. U-Tutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni i-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) ngemuva kokuphela kobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezane nazo ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Izimpi Zomlando: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezigameko Eziyinhloko Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umlando wezwe, zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta abantu, izizwe, nezindawo. Lezi zimpi zihlala zikhumbuleka ngenxa yokuthi zishintsha izimpilo zabantu, zidalela izwe izinselelo ezintsha, futhi zishintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimpi ezithile ezibalulekile, izizathu zazo, nemiphumela yazo emhlabeni. Impi Yezwe Yokuqala (1914-1918) Impi Yezwe Yokuqala, eyaziwa nangokuthi iGreat War, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1914 no-1918. Le mpi yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezizwe, izinkinga zezimali, kanye nezinkinga zempucuko. Izwe elikhulu elalibandakanyeka kule mpi kwakungamaNgisi, amaJalimane, amaFrentshi, kanye namaRashiya. Imiphumela yale mpi yahlasela kakhulu, yashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi yadalela izwe izinguquko ezinkulu kwezombusazwe, ikakhulukazi ukwakhiwa kwezimpi ezilandelayo. Impi Yezwe Yesibili (1939-1945) Impi Yezwe Yesibili, eyaziwa nangokuthi iWorld War II, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1939 no-1945. Le mpi yaphinde yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, kodwa ikakhulukazi yaphakanyiswa yizinhlelo zika-Adolf Hitler eJalimane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zashintsha umhlaba, zashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi zashiya izwe nezifunda zikhubazekile. Le mpi yaphinde yakhulisa umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweZizwe Ezihlangene, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izimpi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezinkulu zokuthula. Impi YaseVietnam (1955-1975) Impi yaseVietnam ibonisa indlela izimpi zomlando zingashintsha ngayo izwe. Le mpi yahlasela iVietnam, lapho amaMelika abamba iqhaza elikhulu, efuna ukuvikela iVietnam enhlangothini ye-Communist. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu, hhayi kuphela eVietnam, kodwa naseMelika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Imiphumela yale mpi ibonakala emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuthula phakathi kwezizwe. Izimpi Zase-Afrika Izimpi eziningi zenzeka e-Afrika, zidalwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukulwela inkululeko, izimpi zempucuko, nezimpi zendawo. Isibonelo, impi yaseNigeria phakathi kuka-1967 no-1970, eyaziwa nangokuthi iBiafran War, ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima ezihlobene nezombusazwe, ubuhlanga, nezomnotho. Le mpi yashiya izigidi zabantu bengenamakhaya, futhi yadalela izwe izinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Imiphumela Nezifundo Izimpi zomlando zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezinkulu zingavela uma abantu behluleka ukuvumelana, futhi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukuthula kubalulekile. Imiphumela yalezi zimpi ibonakala emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula, ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Isiphetho Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wethu ngomhlaba. Zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile, zikhombisa izinselelo ezithinta abantu, nezizwe. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola lezi zimpi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule izifundo ezitholakele, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono, onokuthula, nolwazi. Umhlaba udinga abantu abakhumbula izifundo zomlando, ukuze baphile ngokuhlonipha, bahloniphe izinkolelo zabanye, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe.
Ukungezwani Phakathi Kwemiphakathi: Izimbangela Nezixazululo Ngokwezindaba ezitholakala emiphakathini ehlukene, ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zomnotho, uk shortage of housing, kanye nezinkolelo eziphikisanayo. Lezi zinkinga zenza kube nzima ukuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, okuholela ekungaboni ngaso linye. Izimbangela Zokungezwani Okwamanje, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala kuholela ekwandeni kwezingxabano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Izindawo eziningi zihlupheka, futhi abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni ngamalungelo nezinsiza, njengoba abanye abantu bezama ukuvikela izinsiza zabo, kanti abanye befuna ukufinyelela kulokho abakubona njengamalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolelo eziphikisanayo zenza kube nzima ukuhlanganisa abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho imiphakathi ehlukene ihlangana khona. Izinkolelo zamasiko, izinkolelo zenkolo, kanye nezinkolelo zomphakathi zenza kube nzima ukuvumelana, okukhuthaza ukungezwani. Lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima, lapho abantu bephikisana khona, kuholele ezimeni ezinzima, ezifana nezinsolo zokuhlukunyezwa. Imiphumela Yokungezwani Imiphumela yokungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi ibonakala ngezindlela eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezimali, ukwanda kwezinga lokuphila, kanye nokungabi nendawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimpilo zomphakathi. Abantu bahlala bephikisana, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Iziphakamiso Zokwenza kube Ngcono Iziphakamiso zokwenza kube ngcono zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, okuzosiza abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene. Ukufundisa abantu ngamasiko ahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvumelana, kanye nokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinkolelo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Izixazululo Zokuxazulula Ukungezwani Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona, befundisana, futhi bebonisa izinkolelo zabo. Imicimbi efana nezinsuku zomdabu, imikhosi yokuhlangana, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukwengeza, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izinkolelo zomphakathi zingasiza ekwakheni ukuqonda okukhulu, okukhuthaza ukuvumelana. Isiphetho Ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kunezixazululo eziningi ezikhona. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuxhumana nokuhloniphana kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngobambiswano, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, lapho abantu bahlala bejabulisa, befundisana, futhi bebonisa izinkolelo zabo.
Amanani Okudla: Isimo Esidinga Ukubhekelwa Ngokuqinile Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, amanani okudla abe yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithokozisa izinkanyezi zethu zokuphila, sithola ukuthi amanani okudla ayanda, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza abathengi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphusile. Isizathu esikhulu sokwanda kwamaholo okudla sitholakala ezimakethe zomhlaba. Ukukhula kwabantu, izinguquko ezinkulu emnothweni, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima, konke lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekwandeni kwamaholo. Ngokwesibonelo, izimo zezulu ezimbi, ezifana nezikhukhula noma umswakama, zenza kube nzima ukukhiqiza ukudla, okukhuphula amanani. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho ukufinyelela ezitolo ezinkulu kungelula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhamba, ezokuthutha, kanye nezindleko zokugcina ukudla nazo zikhuphuka. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abathengisi baphakamishe amanani, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongenamkhawulo, lapho abantu bephoqwa ukuba bahlale bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokukhuphuka kwamaholo. Ngokubheka lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baphendule ngokushesha. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokulima ezinzile, ezibandakanya ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kungasiza ekwandiseni ukukhiqizwa kokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi kunciphise ukuncika ezimakethe zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukulima okwakhiwe endaweni, okungokwendabuko, kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko.
