Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThandiwe Ndlovu - Umqondisi WamaFilimu UThandiwe Ndlovu ungomunye wabaphumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wamafilimu eNingizimu Afrika, ethokozisa izigidi zabantu ngezindaba eziphilayo nezithokozisayo. UThandiwe wazalelwa edolobheni lasePitoli, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ojwayelekile, lapho ubumqoka bokuxhumana nemindeni buphakamisa uthando lwakhe lwezindaba nezokuxhumana. Kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe, wayenothando lokubuka amafilimu, ahlale ebuka izithombe ezihlukahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezimfundisa ngempilo, uthando, nezinselele. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMidlalo eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza njengomsebenzi wezokukhanyisa emafilimini amancane. Uhlale emisha, edinga ukufunda nokukhula, athola izifundo ezahlukeneyo emkhakheni wamafilimu. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola imfundo eyenele yokuhola nokuphatha, okuholele ekutheni akhe izimiso ezinamandla zokuphatha izigcawu, izikhumbuzo, nokukhiqiza. UThandiwe waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wamafilimu ngemuva kokuphumelela kweyakhe ifilimu yokuqala, ethi "Umoya Wothando," eyakha umbono omusha mayelana nothando phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene. Le filimu yahamba phambili, yaholela ekubeni ithole imiklomelo eminingi, okuhlanganisa ne-International Film Festival, lapho yafaka khona isithombe esiqhakazile sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bezenhlalo ezihlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, kwavula iminyango yokuxhumana nabanye abaqondisi nabakhiqizi bamafilimu emhlabeni jikelele. Njengomqondisi, uThandiwe unokuhlakanipha okukhulu ekubambeni izimo ezinzima, okunikeza izithombe ezikhangayo nezikhumbulekayo. Uhlonipha izinkolo, izilimi, nemikhosi yamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Izinhloso zakhe zokwenza amafilimu zifaka ukufundisa, ukukhipha imilayezo ethile, kanye nokukhuthaza abanye ukuze bahlale bephokophele phambili. Ubumbano lwakhe nolwazi oluwusizo lwakha izindaba ezibucayi, ezihambisana nemizwa yeqhawe, ukungabaza, nobunzima obuhambisana nezimo zempilo. Ithuba elilandelayo elalikhankasela uThandiwe kwakungokwakhiwa kwefilimu ethi "Izinyembezi Zothando," ethokozisa izilaleli ngendaba yeqhawe elihamba ngebhasi lothando, elihamba ngaphakathi kwezinselelo ezivamile. Le filimu yashukumisela izincwadi zomphakathi, yanikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngamaqhawe abo, kube nezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu nothando. UThandiwe wayefuna ukwakha ikholwa phakathi kwezilaleli, eyazi ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngempela. Ngaphezu kokuba umqondisi, uThandiwe ungumfundisi wezobuciko, ehlanganyela ulwazi lwakhe nabafundi bezobuciko. Ubonisa ukuqonda okukhulu kwezifundo ezihlukile, ehlanganyela imibono yakhe nokuqonda kwakhe. UThandiwe ubona ukuthi ukukhiqiza amafilimu akuyona nje imisebenzi yokwenziwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokubeka impilo ebuhleni, ukudlulisa imiyalezo yemvelo, nokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungenisa umoya omusha emkhakheni wamafilimu eNingizimu Afrika, enza izifundo eziphathelene nomnotho, ubuhlobo, kanye nemikhuba yokuphila. Uhlale efuna ukuhlola izinkolelo ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganiswe nezinkinga zomphakathi, ezithinta umphakathi nezwe. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nokwakha amafilimu, ubona ukuthi umhlaba uyashintsha, futhi izindaba zidinga ukuhamba nezikhathi. I-legacy yakhe izoqhubeka nokukhula, ibalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ihlale ibonisa ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuphila, yokufundisa, nokuhlanganyela. UThandiwe Ndlovu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuciko bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okhuthazayo, kanye nomhlaba obumbene. Ngalesi sikhathi, uThandiwe ubheka phambili, enza izinhlelo eziningi ezikhethekile zokukhuthaza abasha emhlabeni wamafilimu, eqhubeka nokukhulisa izwi lakhe, ukuze izindaba zodozane nezinye izilimi nezinkolo, zigcine zikhanya ezinkalweni zethu. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumqondisi, umfundisi, nempumelelo - ungumuntu obalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ohlonishwa kakhulu, futhi ophawula indlela ezayo.
Imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu, futhi ibonisa ubuhle bempilo yethu njengabantu. Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, izinkumbulo eziningi ziyaqhamuka. Ngabe ubani ongakuthandi ukujabulisa, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela nabantu abathandekayo? Lokhu konke kuza nezinhlobonhlobo zemishado yesintu. Ukuze siqale, imishado yesintu ivamise ukuhlela kahle. Ngokuvamile, umndeni wesilisa uzobamba umhlangano nomndeni wesifazane ukuze baxoxe ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlangana." Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkulumo ziba ziningi, futhi imindeni ibonisa izinkolelo zayo, izifiso, nezifiso. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Lokhu kuhlangana akukhona nje ukuhlela imishado, kodwa futhi kuyisikhathi sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, umndeni wesilisa uzothumela izipho, ezivame ukuba yizinkanyezi, izinkanyezi ezincane, noma ezinye izinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuhlonipha umndeni wesifazane. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuhlonipha kubaluleke kangakanani? Lokhu kudala isizinda esihle sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Uma sekukhulunywa ngempela ngemishado, akungabazeki ukuthi izinsuku ezilandelayo ziba zinhle. Umkhosi uqala ngokuhlanza, lapho umndeni wesifazane uhamba phambili. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlanza umuzi." Umndeni wesilisa ulandela, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umndeni wesilisa uzokwamukela umkhosi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuhlanzwa kuhlobene kanjani nezinkolelo zethu? Umuzi kufanele uhlanzeke ukuze umshado ube yimpumelelo. Ngemuva kokuhlanza, umkhosi uqala. Izinsuku zokugcina ziba nezinhlelo eziningi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Umkhosi uvame ukuba nezinsuku eziningi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Izinsuku zokuqala ziba nezinkanyezi, izinkanyezi ezincane, nezinsuku zokugcina ziba nezinsuku ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkolelo zethu, futhi kubonisa ukuthi umshado ungumcimbi omkhulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu ibaluleke kangakanani? Akukhona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhathi sokuhlanganyela, sokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabashadile. Ngemuva kokuphothula umkhosi, abantu bahlala bejabulile. Umndeni wesifazane uthola izipho, futhi umndeni wesilisa uthola izipho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile? Lokhu kudala isizinda esihle sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imishado yesintu iyashintsha. Kukhona abanye abantu abathanda ukwenza imishado yesimanje, kodwa imishado yesintu ihlala ibalulekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu? Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkolelo zethu, futhi kubonisa ukuthi umshado ungumcimbi omkhulu. Ngokuphetha, imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe imishado yesintu, ngoba ibonisa ubuhle bempilo yethu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabashadile. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sihlonipha imishado yesintu, futhi siqhubeke sithokozisa ubudlelwano bethu.
Izinkondlo: Uhlanga Lwezwi Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane, elalaziwa ngempela ngothando lwezinkondlo. Abantu bahlala bejabule, bephila impilo enothando nolwazi. UThandi, umntwana ophakathi kweminyaka eyishumi nambili, wayenothando olukhulu lwezinkondlo. Wayezithokozela kakhulu izinkondlo ezazibhaliwe, kodwa wayefisa ukuba naye umoya wokubhala. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wanquma ukuthi uzokwakha izinkondlo zakhe. Wathatha iphepha elikhulu, wanikeza umoya wakhe ithuba lokuphuma. Waqala ukubhala ngezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezisemkhathini, ezazimangaza izinkanyezi ezincane ezazikhanya phezulu. "Ngiyabonga, Moya, ngokunginika ubuhle," wabhalela. UThandi wathola ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhuluma naye, zimbuza ngezifiso zakhe, nezinkumbulo ezimnandi. Wabhalela izinkanyezi, wathi: "Nginomoya omuhle, ngifuna ukwakha umhlaba wezinkondlo, lapho uthando lungakhanya khona." UThandi wathola injabulo enkulu ekubhaleni, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zathokozisa umoya wakhe. Ngesikhathi edlula emgwaqweni, uThandi wahlangana noMama Nandi, umphakathi owaziwa ngempela ngothando lwezinkondlo. UMama Nandi wayengumculi ophumelelayo, futhi wathandwa kakhulu. UThandi wamtshela ngothando lwakhe lwezinkondlo. UMama Nandi wamomotheka, wathi: "Ngiyazi ukuthi ungumshayi wezinkondlo, kodwa kufanele ufunde nokubhala kahle. Ngizokuthokozisa ngalezi zinsuku." UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda noMama Nandi. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, ezinjengothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa. UMama Nandi wayefundisa uThandi ukuthi izinkondlo zifana nehlathi, lapho izithombe zikhula khona. "Uhlanga lwezwi luthokozisa, lwenza umhlaba ube mnyama," kusho uMama Nandi. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi waqala ukubhala izinkondlo ezinhle. Wawathokozisa abantu ababephila edolobheni. UThandi wabhala izinkondlo ezazikhuluma ngothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa eyahlukene. Abantu babefunda izinkondlo zakhe, babethokozisa, futhi uThandi waba yinkanyezi edolobheni. Kodwa, kwaba nesikhathi lapho uThandi waba nesikhathi esinzima. Wazizwa engazizwa kahle, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zathola ubunzima. Wazama ukubhala, kodwa amagama awazange aphume. Wazizwa njengomoya opholile, ungakwazi ukukhuluma. UMama Nandi wabona lokhu, wathi: "UThandi, khumbula, izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ungazikhathazi, phumula, futhi uzobona umoya wakho uphinde uvulekele." UThandi wathola ithuba lokuphumula, wagcina esebenzisa isikhathi sokuhlola imizwa yakhe. Waqala ukubhala izinkondlo ezazikhuluma ngaleso sikhathi esinzima. Wabhalela izinkanyezi ezazimkhumbuza ukuthi ubuhlungu bungaba yinsika yokukhula. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo azikhulumi kuphela ngothando, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngempilo yonke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waphinde waba namandla. Wabhalela umphakathi izinkondlo ezazihamba phambili. UThandi waqonda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinselelo, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngempumelelo. Waqhubeka nokubhala, futhi abantu baphenduka, bejabulile. UThandi waba yisibonelo somphakathi, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zaba nesithakazelo esikhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba umbhali wezinkondlo owaziwa emhlabeni wonke. Izinkondlo zakhe zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, zikhanya emhlabeni. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinkondlo zingaba yindlela yokukhuluma, nokuthi umoya wokubhala ungathokozisa abantu. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba nomoya ophakeme. Waqonda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngempilo, zikhuluma ngothando, nezinkumbulo. Waqhubeka nokubhala, futhi izinkanyezi zakhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezimnandi, nezinto ezinzima. UThandi waba yinkanyezi, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni.
Izinsizakalo Zokusekela Abantu Abakhubazekile Izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile zithinta zonke izici zokuphila kwabantu, kusukela ezimfundisweni kuya ezempilo, emsebenzini, nasemiphakathini. Ukunikeza lezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuthi baphile impilo eqhakazile, baze bazitholele amathuba afana nalawo abanye abantu abanawo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izindlela zokuqonda, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza eziziyo neziphephile. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kungenzeka kubonakale ngezinhlobo eziningi, ezinjengokukhubazeka komzimba, ukukhubazeka kwengqondo, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yezimo ezithile. Ukuze imiphakathi ibeyisikhala esikhuthazayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsizakalo ezisekela nezichazayo ezisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba bazuze amandla abo aphelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezintweni ezisemqoka ezifana nezokuthutha, izindlu, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo. Ngokwengxenye, izinsizakalo ezikhona zifaka phakathi izifundo ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zezempilo. Izifundo ezikhethekile zenzelwe ukusiza abafundi abakhubazekile ukuba bathole imfundo efanele, okuhloswe ngayo ukuqinisa amakhono abo futhi kubavumele ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlinzeka ngendaba yokusebenza, lapho abantu abakhubazekile bangathola khona ithuba lokusebenza, bese bethola izinkokhelo ezivumelana nezinga lakho lokusebenza. Lokhu kuwenza abantu abakhubazekile bazizwe bebalulekile emphakathini futhi kubavumela ukuba babe ngabaholi emikhakheni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza zezempilo zibalulekile ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuhlala bephilile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufinyelela kokwelashwa, imitholampilo ethile, kanye nezinsizakalo zamakhaya ezinquma izidingo zabo. Izinsizakalo zokwelapha zifaka phakathi ukwelashwa komzimba, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinsiza zokuqeqesha ukuze abantu abakhubazekile babe namakhono athile. Ukuvikeleka kwempilo kuhambisana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokukhuthaza impilo, okukhuthaza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukwenzenjani, imiphakathi kufanele ibambisane ukuze kube nokwakha izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kuhilela abaholi bendawo, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinkampani ezizimele, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, imiphakathi ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile zicutshwa, zihlala zikhuthazwa, futhi zisebenza kulezi zinsuku. Phakathi kwemizamo yokwakha umhlaba ophilayo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibe nokuzimisela ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo ezikhona. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubafundi, ukuphakamisa izinhlelo ezisekela abantu abakhubazekile, kanye nokugcina izikhungo zemfundo zithokozisa okubameleke. Ukulawulwa kwezimali nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe kumele kube yinto evamile ukuze izinsizakalo ziqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyavuma futhi zikhuthazekile. Ngenkathi imiphakathi iphila uhambo lokwakha izinsizakalo ezinhle zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile, isu elihlakaniphile kumele lifakwe ekwenzeni abantu baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukubona izindlela zokwenza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bubalulekile ukuze imiphakathi iqhubeke ibhekisela ukuphila kwabantu abakhubazekile. Abantu abakhubazekile bafanelwe ithuba lokuvuma ngezimpilo zabo, futhi kuphela uma sithumela izinsizakalo ezikahle, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi owahloniphekile, ophumelelayo, nolungisa lezi zifiso. Ngokwenhlonipho, izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, ezikhona, nezicacile kumele ziqhubekezelwe phambili. Iqoqo lezi zinsizakalo kuncike ekubeni abakhubazekile yabo balandele kahle izifiso zabo, bezama ukwaba isizotha, iqhubeke ukuze bazuze izinzuzo ezinzulu, bagqugquzele imiphakathi enesithunzi, namatshanelo okuphilayo. Ekugcineni, izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile ziyisibusiso esibanzi esithinta bonke. Abantu baphila phansi kwezimo ezahlukene, kanti imiphakathi isebenza emandleni ukuze ibabhekelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala benempilo, bethola izinzuzo ezivamile, futhi baphinde bazitholele ithuba lokuphila impilo ezigcwele izimfanelo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukubona umphakathi obumbene, ophumelelayo, nolungisa zonke izimpilo, kanti kuzokwandisa ithemba, ukholo, kanye nemfundo.
Ezobuhlakani Bokwenziwa: Indaba Yomlando Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa, noma i-Artificial Intelligence (AI), yinsiza ethokozisayo futhi ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mboni, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba zayo ezahlukene, kusukela emiqalweni yayo kuze kube yizinsuku zethu. Ukwakhiwa kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuqala eminyakeni engama-1950, lapho abacwaningi abanjengo-Alan Turing beqala ukucabanga ngempela ngezimiso zokwenza imishini eziphila njengezidalwa. U-Turing, owaziwa kakhulu ngombono wakhe wokuthi imishini ingakwazi ukufunda, waphakamisa umbuzo obalulekile: "Ingabe imishini ingakwazi ukujabulisa?" Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwe-Turing Test, okuyindlela yokuhlola ubuhlakani bemishini. Ngemva kwalokho, eminyakeni yama-1960, abacwaningi baqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokuqala zokufunda. Lezi zinhlelo zaziwusizo kakhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezithile, njengokuhumusha izilimi noma ukuhlela imininingwane. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zazikhawulelwe kakhulu, futhi abacwaningi babebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kwaholela esikhathini esibizwa ngokuthi "i-AI Winter," lapho ukuncipha kokuxhaswa kwemali nokuthakazelelwa kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa kwaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eminyakeni yama-1980, abacwaningi baqala ukuphinda baphinde bahlola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwenza imishini zibe nobuhlakani. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezibizwa ngokuthi "neural networks," ezazisiza ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni izinqumo. Lezi zinhlelo zathola impumelelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nokuhumusha, ukubona, nokuhlaziya idatha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu, futhi eminyakeni yama-2000, i-AI yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu. Ukuze kube lula, abacwaningi baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela zokufunda ezijulile, okuyindlela yokufunda eyenza imishini ikwazi ukufunda ngokwakha izakhiwo ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezinjenge-Google DeepMind, eyaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yayo yokudlala i-Go, umdlalo odinga ubuhlakani obukhulu. Namuhla, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinkampani, ezokwelapha, ezokuthengisa, kanye nasezokuxhumana. Izinhlelo ezinjenge-Alexa, Siri, kanye ne-Google Assistant zikhombisa indlela ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obuphila ngayo empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa sebuye bube yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Nokho, ukuvela kwe-AI akukhombisi kuphela izinzuzo. Kukhona nezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwayo. Izinkinga zokuphepha, ukuvikelwa kwedatha, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlukaniswa kwezobuchwepheshe zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nezibopho ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokulimaza abantu noma imiphakathi. Ngokubheka phambili, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ekwakheni izixazululo ezithuthukile, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kufanele busebenze njengomsebenzi wethu, hhayi njengomphumela wokuphila kwethu. Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imishini yethu iyasiza, futhi ayithathi indawo yethu. Ekugcineni, indaba yezobuhlakani bokwenziwa iyindida ebanzi, ehlanganisa izifundo eziningi, izinselelo, nezifiso. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha le mboni, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola, sithuthukise, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ngendlela efanele, bulethe izinzuzo, futhi buphila kahle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuhlakani, nolwazi olujulile.
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwama-Influencer KwakunguMsinsana, owayeyintombazane ezalelweyo ngasemzaneni oguquguqukayo. Ntombokazi, wayehlala ephakathi kwabanye abantwana abazalwe emakhaya aphethwe ubuchwepheshe. Uhambo lwakhe lwokuqala lohlelo lwezokuxhumana lwenzeka ngenkathi ethola umakhalekhukhwini wakhe wokuqala eminyakeni eyishumi nanye. Njengoba ethola ithuba lokuxhumana nabangani, waqala ukujabulisa ngokwabelana ngempilo yakhe, ezithombeni nezindaba ezincane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMsinsana waqala ukuzibonela ukuthi izithombe ezincane zamenza waphumelela kuhwebo lwezokuxhumana. Kanjalo, eminyakeni embalwa, waba yisibonelo esihle sabantu abanyakazayo abasebenzisa izinkundla ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kokuthumela izithombe, waqala ukuphatha izinsiza zezezimali, izifundo zokupheka, nezokuhamba. Khumbula, uMsinsana wayevame ukuthola izinkanyezi ezivela emhlabeni wonke, ezimemeza ukuthi uzuze izinkanyezi ezilandelayo. Isahluko 2: Ubuhlakani beSikhumbuzo Njengoba uMsinsana eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola nabanye abakhe bahlala bejabule benza imisebenzi efanayo. Isidumbu sazo sabakhe saphuma ebuhleni— behlangana, bephokophele, benza ubuhlobo obukhulu phakathi kwabo. Bangakaze baqonde ukuthi omunye nomunye wayengaba yinsika emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Kwenzeka into ethokozisayo; uMsinsana wahlangana noLwandle, indoda ebingaziwa, eyaziwa kakhulu ngama-video ayo afundisayo. Lwakha uvuko lwezemfundo kumaphuzu ahluke kakhulu. UMsinsana noLwandle bazithola bejabulisa ngesikhathi bamba izifundo ezihlasimulisayo. Bahlanganyela imibono, baphumeza ukuvumelana okukhulu, kube sesiyimfumbe yokugcina izinqumo eziningi zikwazi amakhono anothile. Isahluko 3: Ibhuku Lami, Ibhuku Labanye Njengoba uMsinsana nalabo abakhuluma naye behamba phambili, baqala ukubona ukwenza ngendlela yokubhala izincwadi. UMsinsana wayebona imihlangano, indawo yokuqhunyiswa kwengqondo. Izinsuku zenzeka nemizuzu, futhi kwaba nesigameko esikhulu sokwakha ibhuku elalisukuluza izifundo zakhe. Umsuka wakhe wabe usuhamba ngomoya. Ngokoqobo, leli bhuku laqalwa ukwenziwa kube yinzuzo empilweni yabo, kwavula iminyango emisha. Abantu abaningi bacela ukufunda ngezinto abavela kuzo; kwakungaphezu kokuqhakambisa impilo yabo, kwaba yindlela yokuphila. Isahluko 4: Izinkinga Nezithokoziso Nokho, impilo yabo yayihamba ngaphandle kwezithiyo. UMsinsana, nobuhlakani bakhe, wabona izinkinga ezithile nokuqhubeka kokusebenza. Ukuhamba phambili, kwaba nezinselelo ezithile zokwakha izinhlelo ezinhle. Kukhona abanye ababytes abavela emapulazini cushenyiwe, balandela ikhono lokuphila phakathi kokubona, kodwa bebhekene nezifiso eziphezulu, ezazinqoba ukugula ngokwaphakade. Naphezu kwemivimbo yempilo nobunzima, uMsinsana wafunda ukuthi uuidisa bangabaphucuzi abafuna ukuhlanganisa abantu, khona la waqala ukukha umphakathi wakhe, wabeesephose kadlule, ngesikhathi ehambisana noLwandle. Bazise benze ubudlelwano obuhle, ngempela kwathokozisa. Njengoba behlanganyela, bakhumbuza abantu ukuthi uhlelo lwezokuxhumana akuphili nje, kodwa ungumngane ukuze uphumelele. Isahluko 5: UkuThula Okungapheli Ukwaba yisibonelo, uMsinsana noLwandle bajabula ukufaka isandla esikhulu emiphakathini yabo. Bathola izithombe ezinamagama emizweni yangezikhathi eziningi, edlula izithombe zabo. Imingcwabo, imihlangano, imicimbi, nobuhlakani bakho bezezimali naye. Ngomsebenzi omuhle, kuqhuba imiphakathi eminingi, uvuliwe umqondo wokuthi ungafaniswa nemizwelo, kwazulu kwenzele izithombe ezinzima zokusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akukhona okudinga. Isahluko 6: Umqondo Omusha Ngaleso sikhathi, uMsinsana wacabanga ukuthi akuyona kuphela impilo ngenxa yezithombe, kodwa empilweni, kudinga ukuthokozisa. Kwakukhona imiqondo emisha njengoba eba umoya oqinile. Kwabe sekufika umqondo omusha - owayewumsebenzi owandile. Ibhuku, izithombe, nabangane babezobanza bakhulume ngezinto ezinzima. Umphakathi ozozibophezela kokubili baba yindida ejabulisayo. Umhlaba ugxile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wakho, uMsinsana esekwenzeniye eyaziqhenya ngempilo yabanye. Kukhona okwaziyo ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlala bukhona, nomphumela uzithokozisa. Isiphetho: Ingabe Uthando Luhlale Lukhona? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMsinsana noLwandle bahlala bejabulisa futhi bejabula. Lokhu akukhona ukwenza imali kuphela - kuhlangene uthando, ubungani, nokukhombisa izinkanyezi. Kwakungobuchwepheshe nempilo, kukhuluma imeko yokunakekela abantu. Iziphetho eziwu-365 zoshisizela umphakathi nasemazweni, kanti ama-social media influencer abavumela abantu ukuthi banqamule phezulu. Njengoba bekephula izimpilo zabo, bavezile umphakathi omkhulu wokuqala. Futhi njengezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, bahlala ngabaholi bokuphila, behlanganyela izimpilo zabo ngokukhululeka, bethemba okuyinto engaphezu kwenkwenkulu yomhlaba.
Umbuzo: Yini iPitoli? Impendulo: IPitoli, okuyinhloko-dolobha yaseNingizimu Afrika, iyidolobha elinemininingwane eminingi, ngokwezimfanelo zembali, amasiko, nezinsiza. Le dolobha, engaziwa nangokuthi "iPitoli," itholakala emlandweni njengeyindawo yokuhweba, izimboni, kanye nemfundo. Isebenzelana nezintaba zeMagaliesberg eningizimu ye-Afrika, futhi iyisikhungo sezokuphila, ezokuthutha, nezamasiko. --- Umbuzo: Yini eyenza iPitoli ibe yindawo ebalulekile? Impendulo: IPitoli ibalulekile ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, iyinhloko-dolobha, kusho ukuthi inezikhungo eziningi zikaHulumeni. Okwesibili, iPitoli iyindawo yokuhweba enezimakethe ezinkulu nezinkampani eziningi. Okwesithathu, inezikhungo zemfundo eziphakeme, njenge-University of Pretoria, ezikhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. --- Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindawo ezithandwayo ePitoli? Impendulo: Ezinye zezindawo ezithandwayo ePitoli zifaka iUnion Buildings, okuyindawo yokuhlala kaMongameli, kanye nePretoria Botanical Gardens, lapho abantu bengathokozela khona ubuhle bemvelo. IVoortrekker Monument ibalulekile, ibonisa umlando wama-Afrikaans. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo zokudla, izitolo, nezimakethe zenza iPitoli ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuvakasha. --- Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nePitoli? Impendulo: Njengoba kwenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu, iPitoli ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Ukungasebenzi, ubumpofu, nezinkinga zokuhlala kuyatholakala. Ukwengeza, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo nokuhamba kwemoto kungaba nomthelela empilweni yabantu. Nokho, uhulumeni nabanye abahlanganyeli basebenza ndawonye ukuthuthukisa lezi zinkinga. --- Umbuzo: IPitoli ibonisa kanjani amasiko? Impendulo: IPitoli ibonisa ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko. Ihlangene nezizwe eziningi, okwenza kube nempucuko ecebile. Izinkonzo zamasiko, imicimbi, nemikhosi yamasiko zenzeka njalo, zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi efana neHeritage Day, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babonise amasiko abo. --- Umbuzo: Yini ethokozisayo ngempilo yokuhlala ePitoli? Impendulo: Impilo yokuhlala ePitoli inezinzuzo eziningi. Izinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo, izikole ezinhle, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa zenza kube lula ukuhlala kuleli dolobha. Abantu bangathokozela izindawo zokuphumula, izinkanyezi ezinhle, nezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene. Ukuze kucaciswe, iPitoli inezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca nemicimbi yokuhlanganyela. --- Umbuzo: Uphi umbono wesikhathi esizayo sePitoli? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo sePitoli lubonisa ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Uhulumeni ubeka imigomo yokwakha izinsiza ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa izokuthutha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kuzokwenza iPitoli ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala, ukusebenza, nokuvakasha. Abantu basePitoli bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, onobungane, nolwazi. --- Umbuzo: Ngabe iPitoli iyindawo efanele ukuvakashelwa? Impendulo: Yebo, iPitoli iyindawo efanele ukuvakashelwa. Noma ungumuntu ofuna ukufunda ngempilo yamasiko, noma umvakashi ofuna ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo, iPitoli inakho konke. Izindawo zayo ezinhle, izinsiza ezithokozisayo, kanye nomoya ophilayo kwenza kube yindawo ethokozisayo yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, uma ucabanga ngendawo yokuvakasha, iPitoli iyisinqumo esihle. --- Ngakho, iPitoli iyinhloko-dolobha enothile ngamasiko, izinsiza, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo. Ngaphezu kokuba yindawo yokuhlala, ibalulekile emlandweni nasekuthuthukiseni ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika. Abantu bayo bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, okwenza iPitoli ibe yindawo enothile futhi ethokozisayo.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini: Iphrofayela kaMnumzane Sipho Mthembu UMnumzane Sipho Mthembu, owazalwa emzaneni ongaphansi kweMkhanyakude, ungumuntu ophuma emndenini wezisebenzi zasezimayini. Uthole imfundo yakhe eyisisekelo esikoleni samabanga aphansi, lapho athola khona ukuqonda okukhulu ngempilo yabantu abasebenza ezimayini. U-Sipho, njengabanye abaningi, wakhulela emndenini owawuhlonipha umsebenzi wezokumbiwa, okwakubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi wakhe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, u-Sipho waqala ukusebenza ezimayini zensimbi, lapho aqala khona khona ukuthola ulwazi olujulile ngalesi sikhungo. Waqala njengomsebenzi ophansi, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bukhula, wathola amathuba okukhula emsebenzini. Wazama ukufunda ngokuqhubekayo, efunda izifundo ezahlukahlukene eziphathelene nezimayini, ukuze akwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka nokusebenza, waba ingxenye yeqembu elikhulu labantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lezi zisebenzi zazihlanganyela izinkumbulo, zabelana ngemicabango, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ubuholi phakathi kwezisebenzi, waphinde waba yisithombe esihle sokusebenza ngokubambisana. Waqonda ukuthi ukusebenza ndawonye kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuphumelela emsebenzini. U-Sipho wagcina ethola iziqu zeBachelor of Engineering, okuyinto eyamnika amandla okuba uMholi weQembu. Waqala ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze athuthukise izinqubo zokusebenza, aqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zihlala ziphephile, futhi ziyaqonda imithetho nemigomo yokusebenza. Ngaleso sikhathi, waba umholi ophumelelayo, owaziwa ngokukhuthaza abanye, futhi ethuthukisa izinga lempilo yezisebenzi. Ukwazi kwakhe ngemigomo yokusebenza kwaholela ekutheni abamba iqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokuphucula izimo zokusebenza. Waqala imikhankaso yokuphucula impilo yezisebenzi, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izifundo zokuphepha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. U-Sipho wayehlonishwa kakhulu ezindaweni zokusebenza, futhi abantu babemfuna ukuze babonise izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuba uMphakathi Wokusebenza, lapho ahola khona imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezikhungo zempilo. Waba yisikhumbuzo sokubambisana, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule izinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. U-Sipho waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawuhlonipha izisebenzi, futhi wathuthukisa izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo. Waba ngumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi abantu bamsiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yezisebenzi. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhungo, ethuthukisa izindlela zokusebenza, futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zihlala ziphephile. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ohloniphekile, ophumelele, futhi onobuholi obuhle. Uhlonishwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezokumbiwa, futhi ubufakazi bokusebenza kwakhe buveza ukuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, abantu bangathuthukisa izimo zabo. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, abantu bangakha imiphakathi eqinile, futhi baphumelele emsebenzini. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi zasezimayini luhlala luhlobene noSipho, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka kumuntu wonke ophila ngaphansi komoya wezokumbiwa. Umlando kaSipho Mthembu ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, abantu bangathola impumelelo ezimayini, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho usaqhubeka nokuba yisibonelo, futhi uthokozisa abanye ukuba balandele izinyathelo zakhe. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi zasezimayini luhlala lukhumbula imizamo yakhe, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele.
Umbhalo Wendabuko Ngomhlaba Omkhulu: iSahara Desert Umbuzo: Yini iSahara Desert? Impendulo: ISahara Desert yinsimu enkulu yomhlabathi eyaziwa ngokuthi iyisihlabathi esisodwa esikhulu emhlabeni. Le ndawo ibhalwe ngenkanyezi ngokubanzi ikhuluma ngobushushuluzi, inhlabathi enempilo eyisisekelo, namazinga okushisa aphakeme kakhulu. I-Sahara ibonisa izici ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezigodi, ezinza njalo, nezinyuka, okuyintshumayelo ethokozisayo kuzo zonke izilwane nezitshalo. Umbuzo: I-Sahara ibangeni elingakanani? Impendulo: I-Sahara icishe ibe nendawo engama-9.2 million square kilometers, okuyinto eyenza kube yisihlabathi sesine esikhulu emhlabeni. Le ndawo ibuka kanjalo emapanini. Ihlanganisa izindawo ezahlukahlukene, okwenza kube nokuhlukahluka okuphawulekayo emvelweni nasemanzini. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinto ezitholakala eSahara? Impendulo: E-Sahara, ungathola izinto ezahlukene kakhulu, okuhlanganisa izimphahla ezinjengokhuni, amapulazi, nezilwane ezahlukeneyo. Izilwane ezinjengama-jackals, izimvubu, nezelinye ezincane zivame ukuhlala kule ndawo, zikhombisa ukuzinza nokuhlakanipha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Sahara inezitho ezizodwa zemvelo, ezifana nezinyathi nezimbali ezitholakala kuphela kulendawo. Umbuzo: Yimiphi imvelo e-Sahara? Impendulo: I-Sahara inemvelo ethokozisayo ehlanganisa izihlahla, izihlahla ezihlaza, nezindawo ezinosawoti. I-photochemistry iyisici esibaluleke kakhulu, inequkethe imithombo yamanzi ebalulekile. Kule ndawo, ungathola izindawo eziphakeme, ukuhlangana kwemimoya, nokukhanya kwezinkanyezi, okuyinto evusa umoya emphakathini. Umbuzo: Kukhona izithombe ezithakazelisayo eSahara? Impendulo: Yebo, izithombe ezithakazelisayo zikhona eSahara. Izithombe zendawo ezibukekayo ziveza ubuhle bendawo, ukuya phezu kwezintaba eziphakeme, umjikelezo wezintaba, kanye nezihlahla ezihlala ziqhakaza. Abavakashi bayajabulela ukuzithumele izithombe, banganqoba unyaka wonke. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinkolelo nemigubho ebucayi yeSahara? Impendulo: I-Sahara iyindawo enemigubho ethandwa kakhulu, futhi izinkolelo zabo zinezimpawu ezithakazelisayo zamasiko zendawo. Abantu basendaweni benza imikhosi yokuhlonipha imvelo, izinkanyezi nezilwane, benza ukudlala ngendlela yokugcina ubuhlakani bamasiko. Imigubho nazo zikhombisa ubuhlobo bezinhlanga ezahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo: I-Sahara ihlanganisa kanjani nabantu? Impendulo: I-Sahara iyisikhungo sokuhlanganyela kwabantu. Ihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene, konke kuhlobene nezokuhamba, ukuxhumana, nezokuhweba. Lokhu kudala umoya ophethe impumelelo, ubumbano, kanye nomusa phakathi kwabantu abasuke bejolise kulolu hlobo. Umbuzo: Yini okubalulekile ukuyazi ngempilo e-Sahara? Impendulo: Impilo eSahara ibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Ithinta izimo zomnotho neziphakamiso. Izitshalo namahlathi aphezulu ahlukanisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo. Ukubhekelela impilo kwabantu kuyasiza ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi komhlaba nemvelo, okuyinto ejwayelekile emiphakathini ethokozayo. Umbuzo: Awuyithola kanjani i-Sahara? Impendulo: Ukuze ufike eSahara, ungathola izindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Izindiza ezivela ezindaweni eziningi, ezifana neAlgeria, Tunisia, neMorocco, zingaveza okuhlangenwe nakho okuhle okuphathekayo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuhamba ngebhasi, noma ukuphakanyiswa ezindaweni ezithile kusenawo amandla okuphawula ubuhle beSahara. Umbuzo: Ikuphi okuthakazelisayo kwabavakashi eSahara? Impendulo: Abavakashi bangaqhubeka bazifake emhlabeni wendawo ehlukile. Bangaqaphela izkhiphokhitho ezihlaza, imifula, namadwala amakhulu adinga ukufinyelela. Uhlelo lokuvakashela izindawo ezithokozisayo, ukufunda ngezimpisi, ukuthola amadizi nezilwane, kuyathokozisa ukwenza izinjongo zokusizakala kweSahara. Izivakashi ziba nezinhlobonhlobo zempilo kule ndawo, zivula amathuba okukhulisa izifiso zabo. Umbuzo: Kuthiwani nempilo kaSahara esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Njengoba izimo zomhlaba zishintsha, i-Sahara izoba nezinselelo ezibalulekile. Ukuchithwa kwemvelo, izinguquko zamawela, nezimo zokwakha zinezinga lale mhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuqonda nokugqugquzela izinhlelo eziqondile zokugcinwa kwayo, ukuze imvelo nezilwane zikwazi ukuphila kahle. I-Sahara ikhuluma ngesifiso sokuzinza nokuqhubeka kwesikhathi esizayo. Umbuzo: Kungani iSahara ibalulekile kumhlaba? Impendulo: I-Sahara ibaluleke kakhulu kumhlaba ngenxa yemvelo yayo, izinsiza, nezimpawu zamukela izivakashi. Ibhalansi phakathi kokuphila, isiko, nezinsiza zokuqinisa ubulili benhlalakahle kubalulekile. Futhi, izifundo zempilo yeSahara zisiza ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo eziningi eziphumayo ezweni jikelele. Ngokuphetha, iSahara Desert iyiqoqo eliyingqayizivele lendawo, elihlanganisa izimo ezahlukahlukene, ezikhombisa ubuhle bezemvelo, ubuhlakani bendoda, nezinsiza eziphilayo. Ubulungisa bempilo kanye nemvelo kudinga ukuqashelwa nokuhlonishwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhalansi iyagcinwa phakathi kwezinsiza nezosizo.
Ezomthetho: Ukuqonda Izimiso Zomthetho Nezindlela Zokuziphatha Ezomthetho, noma umthetho, uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila komphakathi. Uhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila ngokuhloniphana, benza izinqumo ezilungile, futhi bagweme izenzo ezingafanele. Umthetho ungumhlahlandlela osetshenziselwa ukulawula izenzo zabantu, ukuvikela amalungelo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Isisekelo Somthetho Umthetho ungahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa umthetho wombuso, umthetho wezomnotho, umthetho wezobudlelwano, nomthetho wezokuphepha. Umthetho wombuso ubhekelela izinqubomgomo ezisemthethweni ezibhekelela izwe, kanti umthetho wezomnotho ugxile ekulawuleni izimakethe, ukuthengiselana, kanye nezinkampani. Umthetho wezobudlelwano ubhekelela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, njengemishado, izivumelwano, kanye nezinkinga ezivela phakathi kwabantu. Umthetho wezokuphepha, ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi, uvikele abantu ezinsongweni. Amalungelo Nezibopho Ngokuhambisana nomthetho, abantu banamalungelo athile, okungukuthi, amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okuthola imfundo, kanye namalungelo okuphila. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinto azizange zibe khona ngaphandle kwezibopho. Umuntu ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonipha amalungelo abanye, okungukuthi, akufanele enze okuthile okungalimaza abanye noma ukuphula umthetho. Izindlela Zokuziphatha Umthetho awusikhuthazi kuphela ukuba siphile ngendlela efanele, kodwa futhi usinika izindlela zokuziphatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi izenzo zethu zinezimpempe ezithile. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umuntu ephula umthetho, kufanele abhekane nemiphumela ethile, efana nezijeziso, izigwebo, noma amacala. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi izenzo zabo zinezimpempe, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi onokuthula. Izinkantolo Nezinhlelo Zokuphatha Izinkantolo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni komthetho. Ziyizikhungo ezibhekelela ukuxazulula izingxabano, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, nokwenza izinqumo ezisemthethweni. Uma umuntu ethola ukuthi amalungelo akhe aphuliwe, angaya enkantolo ukuze afune usizo. Izinkantolo zisebenza ngokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zomthetho, futhi zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ithuba lokuzwakalisa izikhalazo zabo. Umthetho Nezinguquko Zomphakathi Umthetho awuhlali unguye; uyashintsha futhi uthuthuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umphakathi uqhubeka ushintsha, futhi izidingo zabantu ziyaqhubeka zikhula. Izinguquko zomthetho zenzeka ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umthetho uhambisana nezimo zamanje. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umthetho uhlale unempilo futhi ube usizo emphakathini. Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Ngomthetho Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle umthetho, kubalulekile ukufundiswa ngawo. Imfundo ngale ndaba ibalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde amalungelo abo, izibopho zabo, nezindlela zokuziphatha. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani, futhi bazokwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo uma kudingeka. Imfundo ngale ndaba ingatholakala ezikoleni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, noma ngokuqhubeka nezifundo ezikhethekile. Isiphetho Ezomthetho zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila ngokuhloniphana, benza izinqumo ezilungile, futhi bagweme izenzo ezingafanele. Umthetho unikeza izindlela zokuziphatha, uvikele amalungelo, futhi uqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unokuthula. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke siqonde umthetho, siwuhloniphe, futhi siwusebenzise ukuze sakhe umphakathi ongcono. Ukufunda ngale ndaba kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onokuthula, nolwazi.
Ama-Robot Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Kwezobuchwepheshe Be-Robotics Umqondisi: Sanibonani, Dkt. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngama-robot. Ngabe ungakuchaza kahle ukuthi ama-robot ayini? Dkt. Mthembu: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ama-robot, ngokuyisisekelo, yizinto ezisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo, ezakhiwe ukuze zifeze imisebenzi ethile. Zingaba nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ekwenzeni imisebenzi elula efana nokuhlanza, kuya ekwenzeni imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi efana nokuhamba, ukuxhumana nabantu, noma ngisho nokwenza izinqumo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinto ethokozisayo. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi ama-robot asebenza kanjani? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ama-robot asebenza ngokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinzwa, nezinhlelo zokulawula. Izinsiza ezinjengama-sensors ziwusizo ekutholeni ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze ama-robot akwazi ukwenza izinqumo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma i-robot ihlanza, izinsiza zayo zihlola ukuthi yikuphi okukhona phambi kwayo, bese ikhetha indlela efanele yokuhamba. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkimbinkimbi. Ngabe ama-robot angakwazi ukufunda noma ukuthuthukisa amakhono awo? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ama-robot angafunda. Lokhu kuthiwa yi-artificial intelligence (AI). Ngamanye amazwi, ama-robot angafunda kumaphutha awo futhi athuthukise amakhono awo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi ama-robot akwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, njengokuhumusha ulimi noma ukuxhumana nabantu ngendlela efanele. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinselele. Ngabe ama-robot asebenza kanjani emikhakheni ehlukene? Dkt. Mthembu: Ama-robot asebenza emikhakheni eminingi. Esikhathini samanje, sithola ama-robot emkhakheni wezokwelapha, lapho asetshenziswa khona ukusiza odokotela emisebenzini ethile. Futhi, emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ama-robot asebenza njengama-drones, ahambisa izimpahla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, emkhakheni wezokwakha, ama-robot angasiza ekwakheni izakhiwo, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshe. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenzisa ama-robot? Dkt. Mthembu: Impela, izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ama-robot angasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi ethile ngokushesha nangempumelelo, okwandisa ukukhiqiza. Okwesibili, angasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi engathandeki kubantu, njengokusebenza ezindaweni ezinzima noma eziphazamisayo. Lokhu kunciphisa ingozi yokulimala kwabantu. Umqondisi: Kodwa-ke, kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-robot, akunjalo? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, kukhona izinkinga. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yindaba yokuphepha. Uma ama-robot engalawulwa kahle, angaba yingozi. Futhi, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yomsebenzi, njengoba ama-robot engase athathe imisebenzi ethile, okungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi kubantu. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinselele enkulu. Ngabe ubona kanjani ikusasa lama-robot? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngibona ikusasa lama-robot linethemba elikhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona ama-robot ethuthuka kakhulu, eba nekhono lokusebenza nabantu ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezintsha ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Umqondisi: Ngabe unayo imiyalo ethile kubantu abathanda ukungena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe be-robotics? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, yebo. Ngiyabonga kubantu abasha abathanda ukungena kule ndawo. Kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe, njengezibalo, isayensi, ne-computer science. Futhi, kufanele bazibandakanye emisebenzini yokwakha ama-robot, ukuze bathole ulwazi oluqinile. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Dkt. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngama-robot. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi lwakho. Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo kulokhu esikukhulumile.
Izokuphepha: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Wethu Ezokuphepha, njengengxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu yansuku zonke, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kulesi sikhathi lapho ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo ezihambisana nezokuphepha zikhula ngokushesha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha kwethu, kokubili emakhaya nasemphakathini. Isimo Samanje Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane kalula, kodwa lokhu kuza nezingozi eziningi. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuhlasela kwe-cyber, kanye nezindleko zokuphepha zikhula njalo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo ezithile ezithinta ukuphepha kwethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwemali, ukuvikelwa kwabantu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokuphepha kumakhompyutha, ukusebenzisa amagama okungena aqinile, kanye nokuhlola njalo izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo, kungasiza ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nezokuphepha kubalulekile. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bazi izindlela zokuvikela, njengezindlela zokuphepha emakhaya, izindlela zokuphatha imali, nezindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukubona izingozi ngaphambi kokuba zibe yingozi enkulu. Ukubaluleka Kwezinhlangano Zokuphepha Izinkampani ezikhethekile kwezokuphepha zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni, emiphakathini, nasemiphakathini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Ukuze lezi zinkampani zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi zibe nezinsiza ezanele, abantu abanolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezikhethekile nezakhamuzi kudinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemininingwane ebalulekile, izixazululo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ezindabeni zokuphepha kuzokwandisa ulwazi kanye nolwazi lwemiphakathi. Izingozi Zokuphepha Ezihlangabezana Nathi Njengoba sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwezokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuqonda izingozi ezithile ezihlangabezana nathi. Ukuhlasela kwe-cyber, ukweba imininingwane, kanye nezingozi zomzimba zikhula njalo. Ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nalezi zingozi, kudingeka sihlale siqaphile, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zokuphepha, futhi sibe nolwazi oluqinile lwezingozi ezikhona. Isiphetho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala, siqinisekise ukuthi sinesizinda esiqinile sokuvikela, futhi sifundise umphakathi ngokuqonda izingozi. Ngalesi sikhathi esikhulayo sobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha kwethu, kokubili emakhaya nasemphakathini. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, nonobungozi.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Indaba Yezinguquko Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eThekwini, lapho umphakathi wawuhlangana khona emaphandleni, ubusuku obubhalwe ngothando, ubungane, nezinkumbulo ezinhle. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayehlala emndenini ophakathi nendawo, kodwa wayenothando olukhulu lokufunda. Wayenombono omuhle wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamphatha kanjani empilweni yakhe. Njengoba uThandi efunda esikoleni, waqala ukuthola izifundo ezithokozisayo ngama-computer. Uthisha wakhe, uMnu. Dlamini, wayephawula ngokuqhubekayo ngendima ebalulekile yobuchwepheshe ekuxhumaneni. "Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busisize, bukhulise, futhi buphucule impilo yethu," wayekhuluma. UThandi wayezwa umoya wokuthakazelela, efisa ukufunda kabanzi. Ngemuva kwesikole, uThandi wayevame ukuvakashela emtapo wolwazi. Lapha, wathola izincwadi eziningi ezikhuluma ngama-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezindlela zokuxhumana. Waqala ukufunda ngama-social media, lapho abantu bekhuluma khona, behlanganyela izinkumbulo, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalokho. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umngane wakhe omusha. USipho wayenolwazi oluningi ngama-computer, futhi wayejabule kakhulu ukwabelana ngakho. "Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ungakha kanjani i-website?" ubuza uSipho. UThandi waphendula, "Cha, kodwa ngiyafuna ukufunda!" USipho wamkhombisa izinyathelo ezilula, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi noSipho baqala ukwakha i-website yabo. Babefuna ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo, izithombe, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze bukhulise izwi lakhe. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana zokusebenza kanzima, i-website yabo yaphuma, futhi babeyijabulela kakhulu. Ngesikhathi uThandi eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Kwakukhona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile, ama-smartphones, nezinsiza eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bangaxhumana kalula, babelane ngemininingwane, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Kodwa, uThandi waqala futhi ukubona izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Kwakukhona abantu ababephikisana nezinto ezithile, njengokuphepha kwemininingwane. Uthisha wakhe, uMnu. Dlamini, wakhumbuza abafundi ukuthi "Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busisize, kodwa kufanele siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nakho." Lokhu kwavusa umcabango kuThandi, futhi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zingozi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emcimbini wezobuchwepheshe. Lapha, wabona abantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela izimvo, bexoxa ngezinto ezintsha, futhi bekwazisa ubuchwepheshe. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke, futhi bonke bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emsebenzini wobuchwepheshe. Waqala ukufunda izinhlelo zokusebenza, wathola izifundo ezithokozisayo, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu emsebenzini. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nabanye. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke, futhi bonke bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ithuba lokuhola emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wabelana ngolwazi, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle kubanye. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yakhe, indaba yokukhula, yokufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Ngakho, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni, futhi bukhona ukuze busize abantu baphumelele. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi, uma sithatha ithuba lokufunda, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuhle. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokufunda, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu, sibe yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe.
Ukulondolozwa Kwezilwane Ngomhlaka 15 kuNcwaba, umphakathi wethu ubuhlanganyela emcimbini obalulekile wokulondolozwa kwezilwane, owawuhlelwe eMnyangweni Wezokuhlalisana Nezinto Zomhlaba. Lo mcimbi ube nesihloko esithi "Izilwane Zethu, Ikusasa Lethu," futhi wahlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izazi, abathandi bezilwane, kanye nabantu abavela ezinhlelweni zokulondoloza. Umsakazo wokuqala wecala, umholi womphakathi, uMnu. Dlamini, uvule umcimbi ngenkulumo ethokozisayo, echaza ukubaluleka kokulondolozwa kwezilwane emiphakathini yethu. Ubonise ukuthi izilwane azikhona nje kuphela ukuze zihlale emhlabeni, kodwa zinemisebenzi ebalulekile ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo. Uthe, "Uma silondoloza izilwane, silondoloza umhlaba wethu, izinsiza zethu, kanye nekusasa lezingane zethu." Emva kwalokho, izazi ezahlukene zethule izethulo ezimnandi. UProf. Mthembu, osebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilwane, wakhuluma ngempumelelo yezenzo zokulondoloza, ezibandakanya ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphephile nezokuvikela izilwane ezisengozini. Uveze izibonelo eziphumelelayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokulondoloza i-Black Rhino eNingizimu Afrika, ezithuthukise inani lezilwane lezi eminyakeni edlule. Uhlelo lwemihlangano lwalunemisebenzi ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkulumo, izifundo, nezethulo. Abantu babenethuba lokuxhumana nezazi, baphinde babuze imibuzo ethokozisayo. UMs. Khumalo, ongumholi wezinhlelo zokulondoloza izilwane, wakhuluma ngendaba yokuvikela izilwane ezisengozini, futhi wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube nengxenye ekuvikelweni kwezilwane. Uthe, "Akukona nje umsebenzi wezazi, kodwa wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala." Ngemuva kokuphothula izethulo, umcimbi ube nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa. Kwakukhona imidlalo yokufundisa, lapho izingane zifunda ngezinto ezahlukene ezihlobene nezilwane, zifunda ukuthi zingabavikeli kanjani. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokukhuthaza abantwana ukuthi bathande izilwane, baqonde ukubaluleka kokulondolozwa kwazo. Ngemuva kwemisebenzi, umphakathi waba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango yabo, izifiso, nemibono. UMs. Ndlovu, ongumthandi wezilwane, wabelane ngendaba yakhe yokuhlangana nezingwe, echaza ukuthi lezi zinto zihlala zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi kufanele silondoloze imvelo yethu. Uthe, "Uma sithanda izilwane, sithanda imvelo, futhi lokho kuholela ekukhuleni komphakathi." Emva kokuba umcimbi usuphelile, abahlanganyeli baphinde bakhumbuleka ukuthi ukulondolozwa kwezilwane akupheli lapha. UMs. Mkhize, owayengumengameli wombuthano, waphakamisa ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye, ube nezinhlelo ezithile zokulondoloza. Uthe, "Kufanele sibe nomqondo ophakeme wokuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zincane noma zikhulu." Lo mcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abanothando, abathanda imvelo, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokulondoloza izilwane. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi izilwane zisebenza njengomphakathi, futhi uma sikhuthaza ukulondolozwa kwazo, sikhuthaza futhi impilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi uthathe isinyathelo sokuhlanganyela, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izilwane zethu zihlala zikhona, zikhula, futhi ziphila kahle emhlabeni wethu. Emva kokuphothula umcimbi, kwaba nesikhumbuzo sokuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekulondolozeni izilwane. Abantu baphinde bakhuthazwa ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezinhlelweni zokuvikela izilwane, bephinde bahloniphe imvelo. Umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, ubonisa ukuthi uma sikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobungane nezilwane zethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu sokuthi baphinde bahlanganyele emicimbini efana nale, ukuze baqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukulondolozwa kwezilwane. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi unokuqonda okukhulu kokubaluleka kokulondoloza izilwane, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekukhuleni kokuhlanganyela emsebenzini wokulondoloza. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izilwane zethu zihlala zikhona, ziphila kahle, futhi zihlala zikhumbuleka emhlabeni wethu.
IFIFA World Cup: Iphrofayela Yomhlaba Wokuncintisana IFIFA World Cup, eyaziwa nangokuthi iMidlalo Yomhlaba, iyisiganeko esikhulu emhlabeni wonke sokuncintisana kwezemidlalo, esihlanganisa amaqembu aphesheya kwezilwandle. Le midlalo ibanjwa njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhle, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwamazwe. Iqala ngonyaka we-1930, lapho i-Uruguay yaba yisizinda sokuqala sokubamba le midlalo, futhi kusukela lapho, iFIFA World Cup ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. Ukwakhiwa kweFIFA World Cup kuhlobene kakhulu nomlando weFIFA, inhlangano ebhekelele umhlaba wonke wezemidlalo. Ngonyaka we-1904, iFIFA yasungulwa eParis, futhi umgomo wayo wukukhuthaza umdlalo wombhoxo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhula, kwavela umqondo wokubamba umncintiswano omkhulu, okwaholela ekubeni neFIFA World Cup. I-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokuncintisana, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalo ibonisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwamazwe, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umdlalo ungahlanganisa abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Njengoba amaqembu ahlukaniswe ngamasiko, izilimi, nezinkolelo, umoya wokubambisana ubonakala kakhulu ngesikhathi semidlalo. Ngonyaka we-1930, i-Uruguay yathola ithuba lokubamba umqhudelwano wokuqala, futhi yaphumelela, yaziwa njengomqedazwe wokuqala. Lokhu kwakuyisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula umnyango wokuncintisana okukhulu emhlabeni. Kusukela lapho, iFIFA World Cup ibanjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi iBrazil, iJalimane, i-Italy, ne-England, phakathi kwezinye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdlalo wombhoxo ungabamba abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha izwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup yathuthukiswa, yathola ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi yakhula yaba yinsakavukela. Izinkanyezi zomhlaba, ezifana noPelé, Diego Maradona, Zinedine Zidane, noLionel Messi, zaba yizithonjana zomhlaba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu emidlalweni. Lezi zinkanyezi zikhuthaza abanye abadlali, futhi zenza umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kokuncintisana, iFIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezindawo ezibamba umqhudelwano. Izindawo eziningi zikhulisa izinsiza zazo, zenza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo zokuhlala, izokuthutha, nezokwakha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umqhudelwano udala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izigidi zabantu ziqhuba izinkanyezi zazo, zikhumbula izikhathi ezinhle. I-FIFA World Cup ibuye ibe yinsakavukela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zomhlaba. Njengoba amaqembu edlala, izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, futhi zenza umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, njengoba abantu behlangana ukuze baphokophele izinjongo ezifanayo. Umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela umdlalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup ibonisa ukuthi umdlalo wombhoxo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha izwe, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalo ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo ezifanayo. I-FIFA World Cup iyisibonelo sokuthi umdlalo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup izoqhubeka nokukhula, ibonise ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ihlale ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. Umoya wokuncintisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomuzwa wokuhlanganyela kuzohlala kuhlonishwa, futhi iFIFA World Cup izoba yinsakavukela yokuhlonipha umhlaba wonke. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu, futhi kuhlale kukhumbuza ukuthi umdlalo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene.
Isomiso: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngiyavuma, isomiso sesiyinkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo. Kukhona izikhathi lapho umhlaba ubonakala ungawuthandi, lapho izitshalo zibhujiswa, izinkanyezi zikhanya kodwa amanzi ayashoda. Kulokhu, sikhuluma ngalesi sifo esibi esithinta abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi isomiso sithinta kanjani impilo yethu? Okokuqala, masikhulume ngempilo yomphakathi. Lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya kodwa amanzi engatholakali, abantu basemaphandleni bayazithola bephila empilweni enzima. Abanye bahlala emakhaya, bejolisa emasimini, kodwa uma izitshalo zibhujiswa, bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemfood. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu, ngoba umndeni ungase ube nekhanda elibuhlungu lokuthi bazothola kuphi ukudla. Kukhona abanye abathanda ukusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokulima, kodwa uma imvula inganqoba, konke kuyaphuma. Ngokwengxenye, isomiso asithinti kuphela abantu. Izilwane nazo zikhathazekile. Cabanga nje, izinyoni zidinga amanzi ukuze ziphile, izinkomo zidinga amanzi ukuze zihlale ziphilile. Uma amanzi engatholakali, izilwane ziba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Lokhu kudala ukungalingani, ngoba uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi, ziba nezinselelo zokuphila. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izilwane zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, futhi lokho kuthinta imvelo yethu. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izitshalo zibalulekile. Zithokozisa amehlo ethu, zikhulisa umoya, zenza umhlaba ube muhle. Uma izitshalo zibhujiswa, umhlaba uba mnyama. Lokhu kudala umoya omubi, futhi umphakathi uba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Kukhona izindlela ezithile esingazithatha ukuze silwe nesomiso. Okokuqala, singasebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise indlela esilima ngayo. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla nempilo engcono. Okwesibili, singenza imizamo yokugcina amanzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina amanzi, njengokusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezivumela ukongiwa kwamanzi. Uma sithola izindlela zokugcina amanzi, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla nempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume nabantu abaziwayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sabelane ngolwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho. Uma sabelana ngolwazi, sizokwazi ukufunda okuningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi isomiso asithinti kuphela abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Isomiso sithinta umhlaba wonke. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela umhlaba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imvelo yethu. Ngokuphetha, isomiso yinkinga enkulu, kodwa asithandi ukucasulwa. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Uma sithola izindlela zokugcina amanzi, sizokwazi ukuvikela izilwane zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela umhlaba. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze silwe nesomiso, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi impilo yethu, izilwane, nezitshalo zihlala ziphilile. Ngiyabonga.

Ikota: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezakhamuzi Ngaphakathi kwedolobha eliphithizelayo, lapho izikhumbuzo zomlando zixubene nezinto ezintsha, umcimbi obalulekile ubusondela. Ikota, okungukuthi umcimbi wokuqhakambisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane, izakhamuzi, kanye namasiko, uhlelelwe ukuba wenzeke emaphandleni aseMkhumbane. Lo mcimbi, ophakathi kwezinsuku ezine, uzobanjelwa emhlanganweni omkhulu, lapho abantu bejabulisa, befundisa, futhi bexoxa ngezinto eziphilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uqala ngokuphawula, lapho izakhamuzi ziqala ukuhlangana. Umoya uthokozisa, futhi izwi labantu lihlabelela, likhuthaza ubungane obusha. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, izinkumbulo, nemicabango. Izingane zidlala, zibhakabhaka emoyeni, zikhombisa ubuhle bokukhula, kanti abadala bahlala behlangene, bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yansuku zonke. Ngenxa yokubaluleka kokuhlangana, umcimbi uqala ngokukhuluma okujule. Abaholi bendawo, bejabulile, banikeza izinkulumo ezikhuthazayo, bechaza indlela yokwakha umphakathi owakhiwe ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhloniphana. Lezi zinkulumo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephakamisela phezulu izimvo zabo, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umoya wokubambisana ubonakala, njengoba izakhamuzi zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wazo. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi uqhubeka ngezinhlelo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa imidlalo, umculo, nemisebenzi yezandla. Izinhlelo zenzelwe abantu bonke, kusukela ezinsaneni kuya kwabantu abadala. Izingane zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza, zifunde imidlalo yendabuko, futhi zifunde ngamasiko amasha. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuthi izizukulwane ezahlukene zixhumane, zifunde komunye nomunye, futhi ziqonde izimpilo zabo. Umculo, owudlalwa ngababukeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ubonisa ubuhle bamasiko ahlukene. Izinsimbi zomdabu zikhanga, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele emculweni, baphinde baphinde bahlabelela. Umoya uthokozisa, futhi abantu baphuma ezindlini zabo, bejabulisa, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabumbana ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi umculo ungumgogodla walesi siko. Ngaphandle kwemidlalo nemicimbi, umcimbi ubandakanya nezinkulumo ezibucayi. Abantu baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, njengemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, futhi bakhuthaze izixazululo ezihlukene. Izingxoxo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephakamisela phezulu izimvo zabo, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, izakhamuzi zikhumbula ukuthi ikota akukhona kuphela umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokubumbana, ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Umoya wokuhlangana ubonakala, futhi abantu bahlala bejabule, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Umcimbi uphinde ubonise ukuthi ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane busemqoka, futhi kufanele bukhulunywe, buphathwe, futhi bukhuliswa. Ekugcineni, umcimbi we ikota uyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi unamandla uma uhamba phambili ndawonye. Izingxoxo, imidlalo, nomculo kuveza ubuhle bamasiko ahlukene, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulisa, bejabulisa. Umoya wokubumbana uyakhula, futhi abantu baphuma bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Lokhu kube umcimbi ongasoze waphuma enhliziyweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi uzokhumbula imicimbi ye ikota ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, ikota ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabumbana ngezindlela eziningi, futhi umoya wokuhlangana ubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sizofinyelela kuleso sikhathi esihle uma sikhumbula ukuthi sihamba phambili ndawonye, sikhuthaza, futhi sithokozisa. Umcimbi we ikota ungumgogodla wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa.
UMBIKO NGOKWELASHWA KWEZIFO ZENGQONDO Isingeniso Kuyaziwa ukuthi izifo zengqondo ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Lezi zifo zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka, ukuhlinzwa kwezinkolelo, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle yengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Kule mibiko, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokwelapha izifo zengqondo, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa ngokomoya, ukwelashwa ngodokotela, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa. Ukwazi Izifo Zengqondo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zengqondo zingahlukaniswa ngezizathu ezahlukene. Ukucindezeleka, isibonelo, kuvame ukuvela ngenxa yezimo zempilo, ukuhamba kwezinguquko empilweni, noma imicabango engalungile. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zengqondo zidinga izindlela ezahlukene zokwelashwa, ngakho ukuqonda isimo somuntu kuyisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Ukwelashwa Ngomqondo Ukwelashwa komqondo, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-psychotherapy, kubaluleke kakhulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Le ndlela igxile ekuxhumaneni phakathi komtholampilo nom患者, lapho bephendulana khona ngezimvo, imicabango, nezizathu ezibangela izinkinga. Lezi zifundo zigcizelela ukuthi umuntu uthola ukufundiswa okukhuthazayo, okwenza kube lula ukuzazi izimo zabo. I-Psychotherapy ingatholakala ngezinhlobo ezahlukene, njenge-Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) ne-Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), ezihlosiwe ukunceda abantu baphume ezinkingeni zabo. Ukwelashwa Ngomuthi Ngemuva kokuhlola izifo zengqondo, odokotela bahlola ukuthi ngabe kudingeka ukwelashwa ngodokotela, okubandakanya imithi ethile. Imithi yokwelapha izifo zengqondo, njenge-antidepressants ne-anxiolytics, iqhuba ukulinganisela kwezinto ezithile emzimbeni, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo ejwayelekile. Kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi imithi kumele ithathwe ngaphansi kwenkomba kadokotela, njengoba iziphenduli zomzimba zihluka kumuntu nomuntu. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Ngaphezu kokwelashwa ngokomoya nangokomuthi, kunezinye izindlela zokuxhasa ezibalulekile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka abantu emiphakathini yokuxhasa, lapho abantu bahlangana khona ukuze babelane ngamava abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa, ezinjengezokwelapha ezihambisana nomphakathi, zingasiza ekwandiseni ukuziqhenya kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abakuthandayo nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Isizathu Sokubhekelela Izifo Zengqondo Kuyacaca ukuthi kunesidingo sokubhekelela izifo zengqondo, hhayi kuphela kubantu abathintekayo kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Ukungabhekelwa kwezingqinamba zengqondo kungaholela ezimpilweni ezimbi, okuhlanganisa ukungasebenzi kahle emsebenzini, ukuwohloka kwemithwalo, kanye nokuxhumana okuhlulekile. Izenzo ezithathwayo ukuze zihlolwe lezi zifo zingaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemiphakathi. Isiphetho Njengoba sibheka lezi zindlela zokwelashwa, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akupheli lapho umuntu ethola ukwelashwa. Ukuqhubeka nokuxhaswa, ukufunda, nokwakha umphakathi okhulayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayaphila impilo enhle nengqondo. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuthi kube nomoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, odokotela, nabahlobo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo oludingayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, siyabiza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke izifo zengqondo ngendlela ehloniphekile, eqonda, futhi ephelele, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yomphakathi wethu.
Ezokuthengisa: Uhlanga Oludlula Izingqinamba Ezokuthengisa, noma i-marketing, zibalulekile ukuze amabhizinisi aphumelele. Uma imikhiqizo ingenakufinyelelwa, izokwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi ukuthola inzuzo. Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezindlela ezahlukene zokuthengisa, izimiso zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emphakathini. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezingozi ezihlobene nezokuthengisa ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi zisebenza kanjani ezimpilweni zethu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ezokuthengisa ziwusizo olukhulu kwezomnotho wanamuhla. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuthengisa ukuze zifinyelele emakethe, kuhilela ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokumaketha ku-inthanethi, izikhangiso ezikwi-social media, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukufinyelela izithameli eziningi, zikhuthaza ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo, futhi zandisa ubukhona bebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthengisa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile kumakhasimende, okuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabo emikhiqizweni. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nezokuthengisa. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqhubekayo kokukhwabanisa. Abathengisi abanobuqili bangase basebenzise izindlela ezingezinhle, ezinjengokukhanga abantu ngemikhiqizo engaqinisekisiwe. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni amakhasimende azizwe edukile. Izikhangiso eziningi zikhombisa izithombe eziphakeme kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima kumakhasimende ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kubangela ukungaqondi kahle, okungaholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo ezingalungile zokuthenga. Ukusebenzisa izindlela ezinzima zokuthengisa kungaholela ekuncipheni kokuhlangenwe nakho kwabathengi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abathengi bazizwe bephushwa ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo engasekho emandleni abo, okungaholela ezinselelweni zezezimali. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokuthengisa zingathuthukisa umnotho. Uma amabhizinisi ethola inzuzo, akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashwa, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Lokhu kubalulekile ezinkampanini ezincane, ezidinga ukusekelwa ukuze zikhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthengisa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethuthukile, ethokozisayo, nokwenza kube nokuncintisana okuhle emakethe, okwandisa izinga lokuphila. Nokho, akufanele sikhohlwe ngemithetho nemigomo ethile ezokuthengisa. Ukuze zisebenze kahle, kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubomgomo ezivikelekile ukuze kuvinjwe izindlela ezimbi, okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwamakhasimende, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo iyatholakala, nokuthi izikhangiso zikhombisa iqiniso. Ukuze sithole umphumela ophumelelayo, kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihloniphekile, nezibambisene phakathi kwabathengisi, abathengi, kanye nohulumeni. Ekugcineni, ezokuthengisa zibalulekile empilweni yethu, kodwa kudinga ukusetyenziswa ngokuqonda. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, nokuhlonipha imithetho, kuzokwenza kube nokuthula phakathi kwezokuthengisa. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele, ezokuthengisa zingaba yinsiza enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ezokuthengisa zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Uhlanga Oluhlukahlukene LweZinkinga Nezixazululo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kodwa-ke, izinkinga eziningi zikhona, ezithinta abafundi, othisha, nezikole. Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Okokuqala, sithola izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ezinye izikole, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana nezincwadi, amakhompyutha, nezinto zokufundisa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abafundi bangakwazi ukufunda kahle, njengoba bengenayo imithombo edingekayo yokuthola ulwazi. Ukungabi nazo lezi zinsiza kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlale behluleka, futhi lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongekho emthethweni wokungafundi kahle. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngothisha. Othisha bahlala bebalulekile emfundweni, kodwa bahlushwa izinkinga eziningi. Abanye bahlala bengekho kahle, ngenxa yokungabi namathuba okuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiholo ephansi kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Uma othisha bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi, kungenzeka badinge ukwenza izinto eziphuthumayo, okuthinta ikhwalithi yemfundo abayihlinzekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo zikhona, ezithinta abafundi. Ukuphila kahle kubalulekile ukuze umfundi akwazi ukufunda kahle. Kodwa-ke, izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kokudla, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, kanye nezifo zempilo zenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuba bagxile ezifundweni zabo. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi ekufundeni, njengoba abafundi bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni, imiphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo basebenzisane ukuze bahlale beqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banempilo enhle. Okwesine, sikhuluma ngokuqwashisa. Kwezinye izindawo, imfundo ayithathwa ngokubaluleka. Abanye abazali bahlala bephikisana nemfundo, becabanga ukuthi akubalulekile. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba izingane zingatholi ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze zifunde kahle. Ukuze sithuthukise imfundo, kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabazali nemiphakathi, ukuze baqonde ukuthi imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle, futhi kuzothuthukisa ikhwalithi yemfundo. Okwesibili, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kochwepheshe bempilo, ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphile kahle, futhi baphinde baphendule kahle ezimfanelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe nesithakazelo emfundweni yezingane zabo. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqwashisa, imiphakathi kufanele ibambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza imfundo, ukuze abazali bazi ukuthi imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izingane zifune ukufunda, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni. Imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube lula ukuze bonke abafundi baphumelele. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi, okuzokwenza sibe nempumelelo esikhathini esizayo.
Ukulimala Kwezemidlalo: Ukuhlaziywa Nokubuyekezwa Ukulimala kwezemidlalo kuyinkinga ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka, ikakhulukazi kubadlali abavame ukuzibandakanya emidlalweni ehlukene. Lezi zinkinga zenzeka ngezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungafaneleki, ukungaziphathi kahle, noma ukungabi neziqu ezifanele. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu, izinhlobo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Izizathu Zokulimala Izizathu zokulimala kwezemidlalo zihluke kakhulu. Okokuqala, ukungafaneleki komzimba kubalulekile. Abadlali abavame ukungazilungiselelanga kahle ngaphambi kokudlala bangase babhekane nezinkinga ezinjengokulimala kwemisipha noma izitho zomzimba. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emidlalweni efuna amandla amakhulu, njengokugijima, ibhola, noma i-rugby. Okwesibili, ukungaziphathi kahle ngesikhathi sokudlala kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima. Abadlali abavame ukungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha, njengokugqoka izicathulo ezifanele noma ukungaziphathi kahle emidlalweni, bangase babe sengozini yokulimala. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emidlalweni enobungozi obukhulu, njengezokuhamba ngezinyawo ezinzima noma imidlalo yeqembu. Izinhlobo Zokulimala Izinhlobo zokulimala kwezemidlalo zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, sithola ukulimala kwemisipha, okungaba yizinkinga ezinjengokuphuka kwemisipha, ukulimala kwemithambo, noma ukungasebenzi kahle kwemisipha. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma umgibeli engazilungiselelanga kahle noma engaziphathi kahle. Okwesibili, sithola ukulimala kwezitho zomzimba, okuhlanganisa ukuphuka, ukulimala kwezinyawo, noma izinkinga ezihlobene nezitho zomzimba. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka emidlalweni efuna ukunyakaza okukhulu, njengokugijima noma ibhola. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukulimala kwezemidlalo, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela. Okokuqala, ukuhlela kahle ukujolisa emsebenzini wokuzivocavoca kubalulekile. Abadlali kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bazilungiselela kahle ngaphambi kokudlala, ngokwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi imisipha yabo iyasebenza kahle. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukulandela imithetho yokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugqoka izicathulo ezifanele, ukulandela izinqubo zokuphepha, nokuhlala uqaphele ngesikhathi sokudlala. Abadlali kufanele bazi ukuthi ukungaziphathi kahle kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuba bahlale beqaphile. Isiphetho Ukulimala kwezemidlalo kuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka, kodwa ngokulandela izinyathelo ezifanele, singanciphisa lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sibe nekhono lokudlala, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izizathu, izinhlobo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Ngale ndlela, singagcina abadlali bephila impilo enempilo, bejabule, futhi bephumelela emidlalweni yabo. Ukuzivocavoca, ukulandela imithetho, nokuba neziqu ezifanele kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela ukulimala, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wezokungcebeleka.
Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe: Ukuqonda Nokusebenzisa Ubuchwepheshe Ekuhlaleni Isingeniso Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ezimpilweni zethu, buphinde bube namandla amakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuphila.
