Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukufunda ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, njengoba lokhu kusivulela amathuba okwazi kahle indlela ubuchwepheshe obusebenza ngayo kanye nezinto ezintsha ezivela njalo. Lezi zifundo zikhuluma ngenzuzo, izinselelo, nemithelela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zokubusebenzisa ngokuhlakanipha. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Ubuchwepheshe Ukuze uqale ukufunda ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amakhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, i-inthanethi, namadivayisi ahlakaniphile. Ukuqonda izisekelo zobuchwepheshe kufanele kube isinyathelo sokuqala. Thola izincwadi, izifundo eziku-inthanethi, noma ubuke imibukiso ethinta ubuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ngezinhlelo ezithile. Isigaba 2: Ubuchwepheshe Emhlabeni Wamanje Ngemva kokuba uqonde izisekelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlobene kanjani nezindawo ezahlukene zempilo. Isibonelo, emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe buguqule indlela esixhumana ngayo. Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana kukhuthaza ukuxhumana okusheshayo. Funda ukukhetha izinkundla ezifanele ezizokwandisa ukuxhumana nabanye. Isigaba 3: Ukusetshenziswa Kwetekhnoloji Kubuchwepheshe Bokufunda Ubuchwepheshe buphinde buhlinzeke izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Izifundo eziku-inthanethi, amavidiyo, nezifundo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe zikhona ukuze zikhuthaze abafundi. Ukuqhubeka uphumelela, kufanele uqonde izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda. Zama ukusebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ezifana namavidiyo, izincwadi zedijithali, nama-forums ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlola Izinsizakusebenza Ezingama-Online Izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ziwumthombo omuhle wokwandisa ulwazi lwakho. Kunezinkundla eziningi ezinikeza izifundo eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe, ezihlanganisa ezikhokhelwayo nezamahala. Qala ngokusesha izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zakho, usebenzisa amasevisi afana neCoursera, Udemy, noma i-Khan Academy ukuze uthole izifundo ezikhethekile. Isigaba 5: Ukuqonda Izinselelo Nezinzuzo Zobuchwepheshe Kubahlala kubalulekile ukujwayela izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Nokho, ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziningi, kunezingozi ezithile ezihambisana nakho. Ukukhuluma nge-cybersecurity, ubungani bokuxhumana, nezinkinga zokuphila, ungafunda ukuhlola kahle lezi zinkinga. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nemiphumela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuhlela kahle impilo yakho. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlela Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ngemva kokufunda ngalezi zihloko, ungase uzizwe uthakasela ukwenza izinguquko ezithile. Uma ubona izindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yakho, ungakwazi ukuhlela ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kungase kube ukuhambisa ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlakaniphile, noma ukufunda izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, ukuze ube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yakho. Isigaba 7: Ukubambisana Nezithakazelo Zobuchwepheshe Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abanothando lwezobuchwepheshe kubalulekile. Ungaxhumana nabafundi, ochwepheshe, noma abantu abaphumelelayo emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlanganisa imicabango nezinsiza kuphakamisa ulwazi lwakho. Hlanganyela ezinhlelweni, amabhodi emiyalezo, noma izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze uthole izeluleko nemibono. Isiphetho Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zikhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu. Ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokusebenzisa kahle ubuchwepheshe kuyisisekelo sokuphila okuhle. Qhubeka ufunde, uhlale uvulelekile ezintsha, futhi usebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngale ndlela, ungaba neqhaza elihle emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe. Uthando lobuchwepheshe luthuthukisa impilo yakho futhi lwenza kube lula ukuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Phila kahle, ufunde, futhi uthuthukise!
Izimayini: Ukubaluleka Nokuphikiswa Ezinsukwini zethu, izimayini zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wezwe. Zivula amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza intuthuko, futhi zenza kube nokwabelana ngempahla yokwakha. Nokho, akungabazeki ukuthi lezi zindawo zinezingozi ezinkulu, eziyingozi ezihlobene nemvelo, impilo yabantu, kanye nezindlela zokuphila zabantu bendawo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Okokuqala, sizobheka izinzuzo ezikhandwa izimayini. Umnotho wesizwe ubaluleke kakhulu ekukhiqizeni nasekuthuthukiseni. Izimayini zenza kube khona imisebenzi eminingi, okuhamba phambili kwezimali zabantu. Lokhu kusebenza kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasemiphakathini emincane. Kuphinde kulethe izinsiza ezengeziwe ezidingekayo ekwakheni izikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izimayini zishintsha impilo yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi lapho kuxhaswa khona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo nezokukhiqiza. Nokho, akumele sishaye indiva izingozi ezibangelwa izimayini. Ukuvuthwa kwalezi zindawo kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo okukhulu, okubangela ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphila zemvelo. Ukuhlukaniswa kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezimbi zenza umphakathi ube sengcupheni. Izimayini zenza kube nzima ukuba impilo ibaluleke, kanti abantu abahlala eduze kwazo bahlala besaba ukungcoliswa kwezinsiza zabo. Ngakho, umbono wami uthi kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezibhekelela lezi zingozi. Izimayini akufanele zisebenze kuphela ngenxa yezinzuzo zazo, kodwa kufanele futhi zikhumbule imithetho yokuvikela umnotho. Izinkampani ezisebenza ezimayini kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlanza, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo nemfundo kubantu bendawo, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphila ezizothuthukisa imiphakathi. Izinhlelo ezinjalo zingasiza ekunciphiseni umthelela omubi wezindawo ezihlobene nezimayini. Esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokwakha ezisemthethweni nezisemqoka. Izimayini kufanele zibe nemigomo ethile yokuphatha imvelo, efanele ukusiza ukuvimbela izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu bendawo kufanele babizwe ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana nezimayini, ukuze kube nokuqonda okuphelele kwezidingo nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nezinsizakalo ezibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, okuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imikhakha yokuvikela imvelo. Izimayini zidinga ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokwenyusa izindlela zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, ukuhlela izikhala ezisetshenziswayo, nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuphila ezihlanzekile. Kubalulekile ukwakha umbono ophumelelayo, lapho izimayini zikhona kodwa zihlala zikhumbula ukuziphatha kahle emvelweni. Ekugcineni, izimayini zingaba nomthelela omuhle uma ziqhutshwa ngendlela efanele. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu kufanele uhlale uphephile, futhi abantu kumele babe nempilo enhle. Izimayini zidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizohola phambili. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sizama ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, ezihlonipha imvelo, futhi zikhuthaze impilo yabantu. Isikhathi sokwakha ikusasa elihle sizotholakala kuphela uma sibambisene.
Isingeniso U-Cassper Nyovest, ogama lakhe langempela lingu-Refiloe Maele, ungumculi odumile waseNingizimu Afrika, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emculweni, kodwa futhi nohlanga lwezokuxhumana. U-Cassper ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wezinguquko ezinkulu emculweni waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi uzinikele ekwakheni umculo ophilayo, ohloniphekile, nolwakha umphakathi. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zempumelelo kaCassper Nyovest, ezivela ekwakheni umculo wakhe, ekwakheni ibhizinisi, kanye nendlela abathanda ngayo abalandeli bakhe. Isinyathelo 1: Ukwakha Umculo Ukuze uCassper Nyovest abe ngumculi ophumelelayo, waqala ngokwakha umculo wakhe. Lokhu kwenziwa ngezinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukwazi Izithakazelo Zakhe: U-Cassper uqale waqonda ukuthi umculo wakhe kufanele ube nekhono lokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene. Uhlanga lweHip-Hop, iKwaito, nezinye izitayela zamasiko zafakwa emculweni wakhe. 2. Ukubhala Izingoma: U-Cassper ubhala izingoma ezithinta izihloko ezahlukene, njengothando, impilo, nezinto ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba umculo wakhe ube nezinhlobonhlobo, uthokozise abalandeli abahlukene. 3. Ukubambisana Nabanye Abaculi: U-Cassper ubelokhu ebambisana nabanye abaculi abanjengo-K.O, Nasty C, no-Black Coffee. Lezi zixhumanisi zikhulisa umphakathi wakhe futhi zenza umculo wakhe ube nomthelela omkhulu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhulisa Ibhizinisi Ngaphezu kokuba ngumculi, uCassper Nyovest ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphatha ibhizinisi. Nansi indlela abaphatha ngayo ibhizinisi lakhe: 1. Ukusebenza Ngokuqinile: U-Cassper uthanda ukusebenza kanzima. Uhlala efuna amathuba amasha, futhi akavumi ukuhlala phansi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba ibhizinisi lakhe likhule. 2. Ukwakha Umkhiqizo: U-Cassper wakhe umkhiqizo wakhe, i-Cassper Nyovest Brand, ehlanganisa clothing, iziphuzo, nezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kumvumela ukuba ahlukanise imali eyengeziwe ngaphandle komculo. 3. Ukuxhumana Nabalandeli: U-Cassper usebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze axhumane nabalandeli bakhe. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi abalandeli bakhe bazizwa behlanganyela empumelelweni yakhe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuthuthukisa Umphakathi U-Cassper Nyovest akagxili kuphela empumelelweni yakhe, kodwa futhi ubonisa ukuzibophezela emiphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo: 1. Ukweseka Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa: U-Cassper uthanda ukweseka izinhlelo ezithinta imfundo, impilo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni eziningi zokupha, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. 2. Ukukhuthaza Abanye Abaculi: U-Cassper uhlanganyela nabanye abaculi, abavula amathuba emisebenzi. Uvikela abaculi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandela amaphupho abo. 3. Ukwakha Amathuba: U-Cassper udala amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini, ngokwakha imicimbi, imikhosi, nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuphumelela Nokuhlonishwa U-Cassper Nyovest uphumelele kakhulu emculweni nasezinhlelweni zakhe zebhizinisi. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwenziwa ngezinyathelo ezithile: 1. Imiklomelo: U-Cassper uthole imiklomelo eminingi emculweni, okuhlanganisa ne-SAMA (South African Music Awards). Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo wakhe uyathandwa futhi uhamba phambili. 2. Ukwamukelwa Emphakathini: U-Cassper uyaziwa kakhulu, futhi abalandeli bakhe bamamukela njengomholi. Lokhu kumenza abe nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. 3. Ukwakhiwa Kwendlela: U-Cassper wenza indlela yokuthi abanye abaculi baphumelele. Ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuhlala uqotho kuyindlela yokuphumelela. Isiphetho U-Cassper Nyovest ungumculi ophumelelayo, umphakathi, kanye nomphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifiki kalula, kodwa idinga ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha. Ngendlela ayakha ngayo umculo, ibhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi, u-Cassper ubonisa ukuthi ungumholi ongakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukuthi bangathola impumelelo uma behlale bephikelela emaphusheni abo.
UToyota: Indaba Yokuphumelela Nobuchwepheshe Kwazulu, kade kukhona inhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke, ebizwa ngegama elithi uToyota. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1937 eJapane, nguKiichiro Toyoda, owawaziwa ngokuqonda okujulile kwezobuchwepheshe. Kwakuwumqondo wakhe ukwakha izimoto ezinhle, eziphephile, futhi ezithengeka kalula kumuntu wonke. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komkhiqizo owayezobamba izinhliziyo zabantu abaninzi, kwazise izimoto zabo zazingezokukhanya, kodwa futhi zaziwa ngokusebenza kahle. Ngemva kokuhamba kweminyaka, uToyota wathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. Izimoto zayo zazihamba kakhulu, zishesha, futhi zaziqinisekiswa ngokuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawubukeka unomoya ophilayo, bonke befuna ukuzama lezi zimoto ezinkulu. Kwakukhona umndeni owawuhlala edolobheni elikude, okwakuyinto eyaziwa njengeNokogiri. UJohn, indodana yalesi sikhumbuzo, wayenombono omuhle wokukhuluma nabangane bakhe ngezithombe ezinhle zeToyota. UJohn wayehlala echitha isikhathi esiningi edlalela izimoto zabo zikaToyota, eqonda ukuthi ziwusizo kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kwakungelula ukufinyelela ezimotweni ezikhethekile, kodwa wayezithanda kakhulu, ngoba zazingazwakali, futhi zazingasenzi lutho ngaphandle kokusebenza. Waqhubeka nokufunda ngale nkampani, waqonda ukuthi uToyota wayengumholi ekwakheni izimoto ezivumelana nesimo sezulu. UJohn wayezimisele ukuba ngumagama omphakathi, eqhubeka efundisa nabangane bakhe ngezindlela zokwenza izimoto zibe ngcono. Ngemva kokuhamba kweminyaka, uToyota waqala ukuhamba phambili ezinhlelweni zayo, wabelana ngezinto ezintsha, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihlakaniphile. UJohn, njengomfundi, waqonda kahle ukuthi ukuze kube nezinjongo eziphumelelayo, kufanele kube nezindlela ezintsha zokuhamba. Umndeni wakhe wawujabule, ngoba umoya wokwakha izimoto eziphephile wawuhamba phambili, kanti abanye abantu babefuna ukufunda ngokuqonda okuphelele kwezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ihamba phambili, uToyota waqala ukugxila kakhulu ekunciphiseni umthelela wemvelo. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba izimoto zabo zenza kube lula ukuba abantu baphile kahle ngaphandle komthelela omkhulu. UJohn, owayezithokozela izimoto eziphephile, wanikeza iziphakamiso ezinhle, ezazenza zibe ngcono. Waqhubeka nokushicilela imicabango yakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezaholela ekuphawuleni kwezinye izinkampani ezinkulu. Ngonyaka ka-2000, uToyota waphakamisa umkhiqizo wakhe ophumelelayo, iPrius, okuyimoto yokuqala yokuhamba ngamafutha ahlanzekile. Lezi zindaba zashintsha umqondo wabantu ngabanye, njengoba bekhuthazeka ukufunda nokusebenzisa lezi zimoto ezivumelana nemvelo. UJohn waba nenhlanhla yokuba nelungelo lokuhlola iPrius, futhi wathola ubuchwepheshe obuhlukile obenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Le moto yaphawula isikhathi esisha kubo bonke abathandi bezimoto, kanti uToyota waba umholi ekwakheni izimoto ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. UJohn wayenothando olukhulu lwezinkanyezi, futhi wathola ukuthi uToyota ungumholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Njengoba izimoto zabo zazithuthuka zibe nezinye izici, nokubukeka kwazikhumbulo, uToyota waqala ukwakha imoto esebenzisa amandla elanga. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila eziqondile, ezihambelana nemvelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uToyota waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obuhlakaniphile, futhi waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukile ezimotweni zawo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu, njengoba izimoto zabo zazizokwazi ukuphatha izicelo, zixhumane nezinye izimoto, futhi zisebenze njengemishini ezinzima. UJohn, owayenethemba lokuba umphakathi uqhubeke ufunda, wathokozisa abanye ngalezi zinhlelo ezithokozisayo, futhi abanye abantu baqala ukusho ukuthi uToyota ungumholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukwaziswa kukaToyota kumhlaba kwaholela ekubeni abanye abenzi bezimoto bazame ukufaka izimiso ezifanayo. Kodwa uToyota wayehlala engumholi, edinga ukuba ngcono, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha izimoto ezihamba phambili. UJohn wayejabule, ngoba wayebona ukuthi izinto ezintsha zikhona, futhi umndeni wakhe wawuncintisana nawo ukuthola izimoto ezinhle. Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, uToyota wenza izinkampani eziningi zikwazi ukufunda izifundo ezithokozisayo. Kwakukhona umoya ohlangene phakathi kwabantu, nabanye besebenzisa lezi zimoto ezinhle, bahlanganyela nezifundo, futhi baqonda ukuthi uToyota ungumholi ongagqibeki. Njengoba ezimoto ziqhubeka ziba yizinsiza eziphilayo, uJohn waba nokuqonda okujulile kokuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi umphakathi uqhubeka uvuselela izimiso eziphile. Ekugcineni, uToyota waphumelela ngalesi sikhathi, wahlinzeka ngezindlela ezinkulu zokuhamba, ezazizokwenza umhlaba ube indawo engcono. UJohn, indodana yalesi sikhumbuzo, wagcina ebhalela incwadi, efuna ukwabelana ngale ndaba yokuphumelela, efisa ukuthi abanye abantu bazi uToyota, umholi kwezobuchwepheshe, onezindlela zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile, ezithokozisayo, futhi ezithuthukayo. Le ndaba kaToyota iyinkanyezi eqhakaza emhlabeni wezokuthutha, igcizelela ukuthi ubuchwepheshe, umoya wokwakha, nokuzithoba kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. UJohn, njengenhlangano, wokuqhubeka nokufunda, uyazi ukuthi lesi sikhumbuzo sizoqhubeka sikhanya, sikhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi izinguquko ezinhle ziqala ngamathuba amakhulu. UToyota akuyona nje imoto, kodwa ikusasa elikhanyayo lemoto nezindlela zokuphila emhlabeni.
uSerena Williams: Ibhola Lencwadi Yempumelelo Ngiyavuma, akekho omunye umphakathi odumile njengoSerena Williams. Uthandwa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yempumelelo yakhe emhlabeni wezokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. USerena, owazalwa ngoSepthemba 26, 1981, eSaginaw, eMichigan, ubonise ukuthi ukuphumelela akukona nje ukuncintisana, kodwa futhi ukulwa nobunzima, ukuqina, nokuba nesibindi. Kodwa ake sibuyele emuva kancane. USerena kanye nesizalwane sakhe, uVenus, baqala ukudlala ibhola elizimele ngaphambi kokuba babe neziqinisekiso ezinkulu emhlabeni. Abazali babo, uRichard noOracene, babezama konke okusemandleni ukuze baphakamise lezi zingane zabo, benze konke okusemandleni ukuze zifinyelele ephakamisweni. USerena uthathe lezi zifundo ezivela kubazali bakhe waze waphumelela emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSerena waba umphumela wezemidlalo, ethola iziqu eziningi, amakhono akhe emhlabeni wonke. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, esebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ukuze aqhubekele phambili izinto eziningi ezinhle. Akekho umphakathi ongalokothi ubonge kanjani uSerena; umphakathi wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo zabesifazane, uthole izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yokuthi uSerena udlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwalesi sikhala. Ngokwengeziwe, uSerena ubhale uhambo lwakhe, efuna izindlela zokuvula amathuba kubantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, ukuze bazitholele izikhala eziphakeme. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi noma ubani angakwenza, ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi uvelaphi. Uhlale esebenza kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi lokho kuveza ukuthi impumelelo yeyakho, ingekho ematheni. Ngaphandle kwemidlalo, uSerena ungena kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphupha, yena nomndeni wakhe benza izinhlelo eziningi zokugcina izimpilo zabanye zikhanya. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esiqinile kumasiko ahlukeneyo, lapho eveza khona ukuthi umhlaba ungcono uma ubumbene, unokuhloniphana. Uhlale ethanda ukuzama izinto ezintsha, kanti lokho kumenza abe nesithakazelo esijulile esikhathini samanje. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lungakwenza ube yisithombe esihle, kodwa uSerena uyazi ukuthi ubukhulu bempumelelo buncike kumzamo, ubunzima, nomqondo oqinile. Uthumele imiyalezo emihle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukubonisa ukuthi akukhona nje ukuncintisana nokuhlakanipha, kodwa futhi ukufuna izindlela zokuxhasa abanye. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo sokukhuthaza abanye, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabo. Kodwa akukhona konke okuhle, hayi? USerena ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi empilweni yakhe. Uthole izigwegwe ezinzima, izinkinga zomndeni, nezikhathi lapho engazange azizwe kahle. Kodwa, ngokuhlakanipha, uSerena waqhubeka nokunqoba, ebamba izifundo eziphuma kulokhu. Lokhu kunceda abanye ukuthi bazi ukuthi kuyenzeka, nakuba ungase udlule ezinkingeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhlale lukhanya. USerena uqhubekele phambili, esebenzisa izifundo, ubuchwepheshe, nesikhathi sokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuncintisana. Uthanda ukubonisa umphakathi ukuthi ibhola elizimele liwumdlalo, kodwa futhi liwumsebenzi ongenza kahle. Uhlonipha imvelaphi yakhe, futhi uSerena uvezile ukuthi ukuphumelela akuphathelene nokubamba izinto ezinkulu, kodwa kudinga ukwenza kahle, futhi uthande lokho okwenzayo. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungowakho, ungathanda ukufaka isandla, futhi ungathanda ukubona abanye bephumelela. Kusukela phansi, uSerena Williams ubonisa ukuthi uma unethemba, uthando, nomzamo, yonke into iyenzeka. Uhlale elwa, ebonisa abanye indlela. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi uSerena akayena nje umdlali, kodwa ungumholi, umqondisi, nomphakathi. Hamba phambili, uSerena! Uzokwenza izinkanyezi zikhanye!
Umculo we-Jazz: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezizukulwane Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-jazz usuphenduke uphawu lokuhlangana kwezizukulwane ezahlukene, uhlanganisa izindlela zomculo, izinkolelo zamasiko, nezifiso zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene. Lokhu kuvele kakhulu emcimbini wokuhlanganyela umculo we-jazz, ogujwa eGoli, lapho izithameli zifika zikhathele, kodwa zinejabuliso ezikhanyayo. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa abaculi abahamba phambili abavela kuzo zonke izindawo zalesi siko, behlanganyela emculweni owaziwa ngokuba nezinhlobonhlobo ezintsha nezikhumbuzo zomlando. Umsindo we-jazz uqala ukudala umoya wezinhlobonhlobo, lapho izigubhu, i-saxophone, ne-piano ziqala ukudlala. Njengoba abaculi behlangana, imisindo ibonisa ubuciko, isithombe somoya wobudlelwano, nempilo ebonakala. Umdlalisi we-saxophone uthola ithuba lokudlala solo, okwenza izithameli zizwe zixhumene nezinhliziyo zabo, zikhumbula izikhathi ezinhle nezimfihlo zempilo. Umculo we-jazz uveza imizwa ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekujabuleni kuya ekudabukeni, futhi zonke lezi zimo zikhombisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi komculi nomlistener. Emcimbini we-jazz, abaculi baphinde babe nabaxhumanisi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umculi usuka eNew Orleans, eChicago, noma eCape Town, bonke bazihlanganisa ukuze benze umculo ophilayo, okhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kungenza umoya wokubambisana, futhi ukufakwa kwezinqubo ezahlukene kungaholela ekuphumeleleni okukhulu. Njengoba umculo uhamba phambili, izithameli zikhuthazwa ukuba ziveze izimvo zabo, zibe yingxenye yezenzakalo ezithokozisayo. Umgubho we-jazz ulethe umoya wokukhumbula abaculi abaphumelele, njengama-legends afana noLouis Armstrong noElla Fitzgerald. Ukuhlonishwa kwemisebenzi yabo kudalula indlela umculo we-jazz uthinteka ngayo empilweni yansuku zonke. Abaculi baphinde bahloniphe lezi zinsakavukela ngezindlela zabo, bejolisa emculweni nasemikhulumweni, benza umoya oncomekayo obamba wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, izethameli zibe nezinye izigcawu ezihlukile, ezifana ne-Jam Sessions, lapho abaculi behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngemicabango nemigubho. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana okukhululekile, okwakha imizwelo eqinile phakathi kwabaculi nabalaleli. Ukuze umculo uqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube khona ukubambisana, futhi umcimbi we-jazz ubona lokhu kuphila, kwenza kube yindawo yokwakha ubungane obuqinile. I-Jazz iyindlela yokuziveza, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungakha kanjani ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubonakala ezintweni ezincane, njengokuhlangana kwasemakhaya, lapho umndeni uphumeza izigcwalisiso ezihlukahlukene zomculi. Umdlalisi we-piano udlula emuva, amehlo akhe ezilungile ethinta umoya, kanye nezwi elinothile le-saxophone, kudala umoya ophilayo. Umcimbi we-jazz awugcini nje ngokubamba abaculi, kodwa ukhuthaza futhi izethameli ukuthi zibe yingxenye yokwakha umculo. Umoya wokubambisana uvula indlela yokudluliselwa kwemizwa, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima ebalulekile. Lokhu kuveza indlela umculo we-jazz ungafinyelela ngayo ezimpilweni zethu, uhlanganise abantu abahlukene, ubavuselele, futhi ube umthombo wokuphishekela izifiso eziphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ugcina ubude bayo ngokubhaliswa kwezingoma ezidumile, futhi ubukhona bayo buphinde bukhumbule abaculi abasha. Lokhu kudala amathuba kubantu abasha ukuthi bathole izifundo, bazifundise, futhi baphumelele emculweni we-jazz. Abaculi abasha bazama ukwenza izinguquko, bejolisa emasikweni omculo, benza kube lula ukuba umculo we-jazz ube yinto ephilayo, ethokozisayo, nengashintshi. Umgubho we-jazz ungumcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganisa abantu abanokuthanda umculo, futhi uhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. Njengoba umcimbi uphothulwa, izithameli zishiya zikhumbula umoya ophilayo, zihamba nezinhliziyo ezijabulile futhi zibalela izinkumbulo eziveza ubungani obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-jazz ungumsebenzi ohloniphekile, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungaletha kanjani abantu ndawonye, uhlanganise izizukulwane, futhi ube umthombo wokujabulela izimpilo zethu.
Amalungelo Abasebenzi: Ukubaluleka Nokuhlola Namuhla, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engasafunwa; kunalokho, ayisisimangalo esidinga ukugxilwa. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi, olwakha umnotho, luthinteka kakhulu uma amalungelo abasebenzi engavikeleki. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubucayi balokhu, kanye nezizathu ezithile zokuhlonishwa nokuvuselelwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqukethe izinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okusebenza ngezimo ezifanele, amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okwakha izinhlangano, nokuvikelwa ekuphathekeni kabi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bezizwe beyingxenye yomphakathi. Uma lokhu kungafinyelelwa, abasebenzi bangase baphatheke kabi, baphume emsebenzini, noma bazizwe bengabalulekile. Isibonelo, uma sithatha izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, njengezindawo eziphakeme, kudinga ukuqashelwa izimo ezithile. Abasebenzi badinga indawo yokusebenza ephephile, amathuluzi adingekayo, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha uma kudingeka. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuvikelwa kwabantu, kodwa kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungahlonishwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwa, lokhu kunganciphisa umoya wokusebenza, okungaholela ekunciphiseni umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi awazwakali kuphela ezindaweni zokusebenza, kodwa ahambisana nomnotho jikelele. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazokwenza ngokuzikhandla, okwandisa imiphumela emihle. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zokuba nezinhlangano zabasebenzi. Lezi zinhlangano zenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa izwi labantu, ziqinisa amalungelo abo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala ziqinisekisa izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Ngokuhlanganyela, abasebenzi bangakwazi ukulwa nezimo ezingezinhle, futhi bahlanganyele emizamweni yokuthuthukisa izimo zabo. Nokho, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona konke okulungile. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zibe nezinhloso ezithile zokuvikela izinzuzo zazo, zishaye indiva amalungelo abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nesixazululo sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, ukuze kube nesithunzi esihle sokusebenza. Abasebenzi kumele babe nezinqumo ezithile, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabo. Kubuye kube nesidingo sokucabangela izimo zomhlaba wonke. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izimo zabasebenzi zihlala zishintsha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqhubeke nokuvuselelwa, ukuze ahambisane nezidingo zamanje. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziqonda izinguquko, futhi ziqhubele phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlanganisa, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ahlanganisa izici eziningi ezithinta impilo yomuntu, umphakathi, kanye nomnotho. Amalungelo abasebenzi kufanele ahlonishwe, aqiniswe, futhi avuselelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle, hhayi kuphela kubasebenzi, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nomoya ophumelelayo, owamukelekayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi ahlonishwa, futhi abavikelekile. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumqashi noma ungumsebenzi, aqonde ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi ayisona isithiyo, kodwa yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni isizukulwane esisha esizokwazi ukuphila kahle, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni. Amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuwagcina, ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa.
Ubuxhwanguxhwangu Ezikoleni – Ukubuyekezwa Ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni, obaziwa ngokuthi "school bullying," yinkinga enkulu ethinta imiphakathi eminingi. Le nkinga ivame ukubonakala ezikoleni, lapho abafundi behlangana khona, futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuxhwanguxhwangu, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimbangela, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, othisha, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Okokuqala, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bukhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi buphuma ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abafundi bangaba yizisulu ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene, njengokwehluka kwemvelo, izici zomuntu siqu, noma izimo zomndeni. Izinsuku zokuqala zesikole ziba nzima kubafundi abasha, ikakhulukazi uma behlangabezana nabanye abafundi abakhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuzizwa bekhululekile, futhi kungaholela ekutheni bahlale bephoxekile. Izindlela ezisetshenziswa ngabaxhwanguxhwangu zihluke kakhulu. Abanye bangasebenzisa amagama amabi, bahlambalaza, noma baqhamuka nezinsolo, kuyilapho abanye bengasebenzisa izindlela ezibucayi, ezifana nokuhlukumeza ngokomzimba. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezisizulweni, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nokwehla kokuzethemba. Abafundi abavame ukuba izisulu balahlekelwa ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuhlala ezikoleni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphume esikoleni noma baphumelele kahle ezifundweni zabo. Othisha, njengabantu abaphethe izikole, bahlala bebalulekile ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bazi izimpawu zokuxhwanguxhwangu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abafundi abathintekayo. Ukuhlonipha abafundi nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kudinga ukuba kube yinxenye ebalulekile yokwakha isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abafundi ukuze bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana nobani uma bebhekene nezinkinga. Mayelana nemiphumela, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yesisulu. Abafundi abahlukunyezwayo bangase baphatheke kabi, bahlupheke ngokomoya, futhi bahlale bephoxekile. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izisulu zingase zibe nezinselelo zokuxhumana nabanye, zibe nezinselelo zokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi zibe nezinselelo zokuphumelela ezikoleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuxhwanguxhwangu akukhona nje kuphela udlame phakathi kwabafundi, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela eminingi emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze sithole isixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke uhlanganyele. Abazali, othisha, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe isimo esiphephile nezindawo zokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngale nkinga, ukufundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubuxhwanguxhwangu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya ukufundisa abafundi ngezinto ezinjengokuhlonipha, ukuziphatha kahle, nokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni yinkinga edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze siqede le nkinga. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izimbangela, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa, futhi sakhe isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza abafundi bethu ukuba bakhule, bathole impumelelo, futhi babe nekhono lokuphila kahle empilweni yabo. Ubuxhwanguxhwangu akufanele buphumelele; kumele sibe neqhaza eliqinile ekulweni nalesi simo.
Ukufunda nge-Inthanethi Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eGoli, lapho uThandi, intombazane enezifiso ezinkulu, ehamba emgwaqweni. UThandi wayenothando lokufunda, kodwa ubunzima bokuhamba ezikoleni ezikude bukhathaze umndeni wakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, umama wakhe wamthola ethokozisa ngendaba ethokozisayo — ukufunda nge-inthanethi. UThandi wayengakaze azwe ngale ndlela yokufunda, kodwa umama wakhe wamchazela ukuthi ungafunda izifundo eziningi, afunde izincwadi, futhi axhumane nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla kuThandi, waba nesifiso sokuzama le ndlela entsha yokufunda. Ngemva kokuthola ikhompyutha encane, uThandi waqala ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Waqala ngokuvakashela izindawo ezahlukene ezikwi-inthanethi, ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda, izifundo zamahhala, nezincwadi ezitholakala kalula. Wathola izifundo ezimnandi ezikhuluma ngempilo, isayensi, nezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, waqala ukubona ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye. UThandi waqala ukuxhumana nabafundi abavela emazweni ahlukene. Waqala ukwakha ubungane noSipho, umfundi ophuma eThekwini, noLindiwe, owayefunda eKapa. Bahlanganyela izifundo, babelana ngemicabango, futhi baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezazibhalwe ezincwadini abazifundayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokufunda eyayijabulisa, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kwakungaphezu kokufunda kuphela; kwakuwukwakha ubudlelwano. Ngesikhathi edlula ezifundweni, uThandi wathola ithuba lokubhalisela umncintiswano wezobuchwepheshe. Umncintiswano wawuhloselwe abafundi abasha, futhi uThandi wayezimisele ukuwina. Waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngesoftware, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokwakha izinhlelo. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziningi zokusebenza kanzima, waphumelela emncintiswaneni, wathola umklomelo omuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda izifundo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha amakhono. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izifundo ezithokozisayo ezimayelana nezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezokuphatha. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, waqala ukwakha umbono omusha wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamphatha kanjani empilweni. Ngemva kokuhamba phambili, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emhlanganweni wezobuchwepheshe. Wazizwa ejabule, ngoba wayezokwazi ukuhlangana nabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, ababelana ngemicabango nezinto abazifundayo. Emhlanganweni, uThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo, kodwa bonke babenokholo lokuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuzobasiza. UThandi waphumelela emhlanganweni, wathola ithuba lokuba umxhumanisi wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, futhi waqala ukufundisa abanye abafundi ngendlela yokusebenzisa i-inthanethi ukuze bathole ulwazi. Waqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi wokufunda, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango, izinsiza, nezifundo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba ngumfundisi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ithuba lokuhamba emhlabeni, efundisa abanye abantu ngendlela yokufunda nge-inthanethi. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka kuze kube phakade. UThandi waphinde wakhumbula izinsuku zokuqala lapho aqala khona ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Wayebona ukuthi le ndlela yokufunda yamenza waba umuntu ongcono, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda izifundo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Wazi ukuthi, nge-inthanethi, akekho ophoqelekile ukuba yedwa; bonke bangahlanganyela, babelane, futhi bakhule ndawonye. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungashintsha impilo yomuntu. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo yokufunda, futhi wathola injabulo enkulu ekuboniseni abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathole ulwazi. UThandi waba yisithonjana sokufunda, futhi wathola ukuthi, nge-inthanethi, izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuphikisa Izimo Nokufuna Amalungelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziteleka zabasebenzi zibe yindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezimweni zokusebenza. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, izisebenzi ziyaqhubeka nokubhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, imiholo enganele, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima. Lokhu kudala isidingo sokuthi abasebenzi baphakamise izwi labo, baphakamise izicelo zabo, futhi bahlasele izinkampani nezikhungo ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Izizathu Zokuhola Iziteleka Iziteleka zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene. Ezinye zezizathu ezivame kakhulu zifaka phakathi ukunganeliseki kwemiholo, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezingeziwe, noma izinguquko ezithinta izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nezisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuphumelela, izisebenzi zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhokhelwa kahle, futhi zihlomula ngezinzuzo ezikhulayo, ukuze zikwazi ukuphila impilo enokuthula. Isibonelo, eminyakeni edlule, iziteleka ezinkulu zashaya umoya emkhakheni wezokwakha, lapho abasebenzi bephikisa izimo zokusebenzisa imishini engasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinsiza zokuphepha ezinganele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinkampani ziqhubeke nokucabanga ngamasu athile okwenza izimo zibe ngcono, kodwa akukaze kube nokushintsha okukhulu ngaphandle kokuthi abasebenzi baphakamise izwi labo. Umthelela Weziteleka Ezomnotho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zinezinhlobonhlobo zomthelela emnothweni. Ngokwesibonelo, iziteleka ezingapheli zibangela ukungasebenzi kwezinkampani, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu emnothweni jikelele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanikazi bezinkampani bahlupheke uma kwenzeka izinkampani zihlala zivalekile isikhathi eside. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka eziphumelelayo zingaholela ekutheni izinkampani zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithinta abasebenzi, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi. Izinkampani eziphumelelayo ngokuvamile ziba nezinhloso zokubambisana nezisebenzi, futhi lokhu kuvame ukuholela ezinkampanini ezizimele ngokwazo. Ubulungiswa emisebenzini, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinzuzo ezithile, konke lokhu kuthathwa njengemiphumela ethile yeziteleka eziphumelelayo. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Iziqu Zabasebenzi Ukukhula kweziteleka zabasebenzi kuphakamisa izidingo zokubambisana phakathi kwenhlangano yezisebenzi kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi kube khona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvulwa kwemihlangano phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Izinhlangano zabasebenzi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezinkampani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izimfuno zabo ziyaqondwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi imiphumela yeziteleka ingaholela ekutheni kube noshintsho olukhulu ezinqubweni zazo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba izinkampani ezithola ukuthula nokuziqhenya ngemisebenzi yazo ziba nezinga eliphakeme lokukhula. Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zihlala zibalulekile emhlabeni wonke, njengoba zikhombisa ukuzimisela kwabasebenzi ekufuneni amalungelo nezimo zokusebenza eziphusile. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokusekela labo abaphikisa, besebenzisa lezi ziteleka njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ongcono, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila impilo enokuthula nempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambisane, ukuze izizathu zokuhola iziteleka zithole ukwesekwa okuhle, futhi umphakathi uphumelele.
Ama-Social Media - Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Kwethu Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, umhlaba wethu usushintshe kakhulu. Emhlabeni wamanje, ukuxhumana akusashadiwe kuphela ezikhathini, i-imeyili noma esontweni. Izingqapheli zesimanje zifaka phakathi ama-social media, okuyizinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abantu ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwane. Lo mcimbi uzogqugquzela ingxoxo ebalulekile mayelana nomthelela wezokuxhumana ezimpilweni zethu, okuholela ekwenzeni umhlaba ube indawo ethokozisayo, kepha engazwakali. Umqondo Wokuqala: Ukuqonda ama-Social Media Ama-social media akha isakhiwo esisha sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli, ababhali, nabathandi bezindaba. Noma ngabe uthanda ukukhangisa, ukuyekethisa izithombe, noma ukwabelana ngemicabango, lezi zinkundla ziza nemininingwane ebanzi, ezihambelana namagugu nezifiso zethu. Imithombo efana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram kanye ne-YouTube ibalulekile kakhulu, njengoba ithuthukisa indlela esibuka ngayo izindaba, sigcina ubudlelwane, futhi sabelane ngaphezulu kwemizwa yethu. Ukusebenza Kwama-Social Media: Ekuqaleni Nokuthuthuka Ithuna lokuqala lama-social media laqala lapho abantu beqala ukuhwebelana ngobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholele ekuveleleni kwama-platforms anjengokuthi MySpace, aphawulekayo ngalo lonke ubukhulu bawo. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-social media asithandwa kakhulu, afika ezikhathini eziningi, abangela ushintsho olukhulu. Umsebenzisi owodwa angaba nezithameli eziningi, kanti amathuba okuthi umyalezo ufinyelele abantu abaningi kakhulu, akhula kakhulu. Ukwazisa Nokuqwashisa: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Zokuxhumana Ukuze sihloniphe futhi siqonde kahle ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuthi siwazise izinzuzo nezingcuphe ezihambisana nawo. Njengoba abantu bexhumana, bathola ulwazi olusemqoka, babambisane, futhi benze izinqumo ezibalulekile. Noma kunjalo, izingozi ezifana nokuphepha kokuphila kwabantu, ama-bots, nezihloko ezingezinhle zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuziqonda kahle. Ukuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Amathuba nemiphumela Ama-social media awagcini nje ngokusiza abantu ukuba baxhumane, kodwa anikela ngamathuba amahle nempumelelo emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Amabhizinisi nezinkampani zisebenzisa ama-social media ukuze zikhulise imikhiqizo, zithole abathengi, futhi zindlebe izifiso zabavakashi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba abantu babe nengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, nokuphuma kwabo komunitini kube ukwakha umnotho onempumelelo. Ubuhlakani Nempilo: Ukuziphatha Kwethu Kwi-Online Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izenzo zethu zikwazi ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukuziphatha kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, futhi ukuvikela abanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sispirela isikhala esihle sokuxhumana. Ukudala indaba yangempela, ehloniphekile, nokuqwashisa nabanye, kuyinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukubhekana Nezinguquko: Okuhlangenwe Nakho Kwethu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sebe saba nomqondo wokuthola indlela yokuxhumana, izidingo zethu ziye zashintsha. Ukuhlanganyela kulezi zinkundla kuholela ekwenzeni abantu babe witayithi elibalulekile, futhi impilo yabo isiphenduka ibe nobukhulu obukhulu. Umcimbi wethu uzokhuluma ngezindlela ezihlukene abantu abathola ngazo ulwazi, abashukumiseleka, futhi babe nomoya wokubambisana. Isiphetho: I-Impact Yama-Social Media Emiphakathini yethu, ama-social media akha “umjikelezo” wezinto ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza amandla okuxhumana, ukuqonda, kanye namathuba amasha. Njengabantu, kumele sizigcine sishesha, sihlaziye, futhi sifunde ukusebenzisa lawa mathuluzi ngendlela efanele. Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhala sokuxhumana, sikhaza umthetho ophumelelayo, sithola ithuba lokukhuluma, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-social media akhulisa umuzwa wokubambisana, uduku, nokuqonda ukuphila kwabanye. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, amandla ethu akhulu. Ngakho-ke, masithathe ithuba lokuxhumana ngokugqugquzela, siqonde, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumile, ophumelelayo nokuhambisana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Lo mcimbi uzobalulekile ekuvezeni lezi zinto njengomkhiqizo wempilo yesimanje, futhi sizodinga sonke sikwazi ukuziqonda nezidingo zethu, ukuze sidonse phambili kulezi zinkundla ezisemqoka.
Ezamabhizinisi: Ukuhlaziywa Nokusungulwa Kwemikhakha Yezomnotho Isingeniso Ezamabhizinisi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yomnotho wezwe, ziye zaba nendima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, ekuphuculeni izinga levene kanye nasekukhuliseni umnotho jikelele. Uhlaka lwezamabhizinisi lugcizelela ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo, ukuhweba nokuqondisa, ukwenziwa kwezakhiwo, kanye nezimakethe. Ukukhulisa ulwazi lwethu ngamabhizinisi kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwi-Afrika, lapho ubuchwepheshe obusha nobuchwepheshe bezamabhizinisi buye baba nomthelela omkhulu. Izinhlobo Zamabhizinisi Izinhlobo zamabhizinisi zihlukaniswa ngokwezindlela ezithile, okuhlanganisa amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi kanye namakhulu. Amabhizinisi amancane, ngokuvamile akhelekile ebhizinisini eliyingqayizivele, abasebenzi abambalwa, kanye nokusebenza endaweni ethile. Lamabhizinisi adlalela indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amabhizinisi amakhulu anezinsiza ezinkulu kakhulu, imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kanye nemakethe ebanzi okwenza kube lula ukwandisa imikhiqizo kubathengi. Ubuchwepheshe Kwezamabhizinisi Ubuchwepheshe buye baphawuleka ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zamabhizinisi. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili njengokuhweba kwedijithali, izinhlelo zokuphatha eziphumelelayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza, kunikeza amandla amabhizinisi ukuthi ahlale enza kahle emakethe. Ubuchwepheshe bunciphisa izindleko, kuthuthukiswa ukukhiqizwa, futhi kwandisa ukwaziwa kwemikhiqizo kumakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-e-commerce iye yavula amathuba amasha okusebenza kwezamabhizinisi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane ezincane ezithokozela izitolo zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi. Umthelela Wamasu Wamabhizinisi Ukuguquka kwemakethe kanye nezidingo zabathengi kuholele ekutheni amabhizinisi enze izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana namasu okukhula. Ukwamukela amasu ashukumisayo, njengokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi, kubalulekile ekukhuleni kwezamabhizinisi. Lokhu kungafaka izindlela zokuphatha ezibandakanya ubuholi obuphumelelayo, kanye nokwakha ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo. Amabhizinisi kufanele futhi ahlale eqapha izinguquko ezithinta imakethe, ezifana nezimo zomnotho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, kanye nezimo zokuncintisana. Lokhu kudinga ukubhalisela imiphumela emihlungwini, ngokuhlonipha nokuthola ithuba lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo eziphusile nezesikhathi esizayo. Imithetho Nezinqubomgomo Ukuphathwa kwemithetho nezimo ezinqumayo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni indawo engcono yebhizinisi. Ukuhlonishwa kwemithetho yezezimali, izivumelwano zendawo, kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni ziyadingeka ukuze kuhlonishwe amalungelo abasebenzi, abathengi, nezinsizakalo. Izinqubomgomo ezahlukene, ezifana nezokugunyazwa kwezamabhizinisi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezivela kumabhizinisi amasha, ziqinisa ukwethembeka kokuhweba. Ubuhlakani Bezemfundo Kwezokuphathwa Kwamabhizinisi Ubuhlakani bezemfundo buwumgogodla ekuphumeleleni kwamabhizinisi. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlukene zihluleke ukwakha abaholi abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle izimfundiso ezisemqoka ezimbalini zomnotho, izinhlelo zokuphatha, kanye nezindlela zokukhula. Okwamanje, izikhungo zemfundo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezokuphathwa kwemali, ezentengiselwano, nezokuxhumana, okuyimithombo ebalulekile yokufeza izinjongo zamabhizinisi. Isiphetho Ezamabhizinisi zikhombisa amandla amakhulu okuthuthukisa umnotho, ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi, kanye nokukhulisa impilo yabantu. Njengoba izinsizakusebenza zomhlaba ziqhubeka nezinguquko, kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi aphephe, azivumelanise nezidingo zabathengi, bese edlulela phambili ukuze athole impumelelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuthi imikhakha yebhizinisi ingathuthuka, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza inhlangano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni namabhizinisi, ukuze kufezwe imiphumela emihle. Ngale ndlela, amathuba okukhula kwezamabhizinisi ayindlela eqondile yok片huthukisa impilo ezindaweni zethu, kanye nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkundla Zokuxhumana Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Wezokuxhumana Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Namuhla sithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba yezinkundla zokuxhumana. Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ukuthi yini ezinkundleni zokuxhumana? Mnu. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga kakhulu ngokungimema. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zingamapulatifomu akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nezithombe phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla ezidumile njenge-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, ne-WhatsApp. Lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukuba abantu baxhumane, babelane ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubalulekile impela. Kodwa, yini eyenza izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe nempumelelo enkulu? Mnu. Mthembu: Okokuqala, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. Ngaphakathi kwesikhashana, ungathumela umlayezo kumuntu ophakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi zomhlaba. Okwesibili, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bangabelana ngezinto ezibalulekile, izindaba, nemicabango yabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bezwakalisa imibono yabo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile ezivela ekusebenziseni izinkundla zokuxhumana? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, ziningi izinzuzo. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Abantu bangathola izindaba ezisheshayo, izifundo, nezinsiza ezahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala kude. Okwesithathu, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi, ukwazisa abantu ngezenzakalo, nokwakha amabhizinisi. Umxhumanisi: Kodwa, kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, akunjalo? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, izinkundla zokuxhumana zinezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zokuphepha. Abantu bavame ukuvulela izinkundla zabo abantu abangafanele, okungaholela ekutheni ulwazi lwabo lungabi luphephile. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokudlwengulwa kolwazi. Abanye abantu bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baphumeze izinhlelo zabo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zinkundla. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakhipha izeluleko ezithile zokuthi abantu bangazisebenzisa kanjani izinkundla zokuxhumana ngendlela efanele? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngokuqinisekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezinto abazisharelayo. Kufanele bahloniphe abanye, bahloniphe izimfihlo, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezinhle nezimbi. Okwesibili, kufanele babe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amagama okufihla, ukuqapha izilungiselelo zabo, kanye nokungavuli izinkundla zabo kubantu abangabazi. Okwesithathu, abantu kufanele babe nesikhathi sokuphumula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ukuphuma kancane kungasiza ekugcineni ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo emhlabeni wangempela. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizothuthuka kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngicabanga ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizoba nethuba lokwandisa izici ezintsha, njengokuxhumana okungcono, izici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukuvela kwezinkundla ezisha ezizokwazi ukuxhumana ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene, njengezithombe eziphilayo, imifanekiso ye-3D, nokunye okuningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuxoxa. Ngikufisela inhlanhla ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo kule ngxoxo.
Umculo we-Hip Hop: Ukuphikisana Ngezimpande Nezimpumelelo Umculo we-hip hop, okwaziwa kabanzi emhlabeni, ungomunye wemikhakha ethokozisayo futhi edumile. Waqala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni eMelika, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yabamnyama, futhi usuphenduke isiko elikhulu elihlanganisa umculo, ubuciko, nezinkulumo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-hip hop, kufanele sithathele phezulu nezinkinga ezihambisana nayo, okuhlanganisa izinkolelo eziphikisanayo mayelana nemiphumela yayo emphakathini. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-hip hop. Lo mculo ube nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izwi labantu abavela ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Abaculi abanjengo-Tupac Shakur no-The Notorious B.I.G. baveze izinselelo ezihambisana nabantu abamnyama, njengobandlululo, ubuphofu, nokungabi nandlela. Lokhu kwenze umculo we-hip hop ube yindlela yokukhuluma, ukuchaza, nokuphikisa. Ngakho-ke, umculo we-hip hop ungumthombo wokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphakamise izwi labo, baphikise izinhlelo ezimbi, futhi baphokophele impilo engcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona abaphikisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop uveza izithombe ezingezinhle. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi izinkanyezi ze-hip hop zikhuthaza izenzo ezimbi, ezifana nokubhema, udlame, nokuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kubonakala ezinkondlweni eziningi, lapho abaculi bechaza izimo ezinzima, kodwa futhi behlaba umxhwele ngezinto ezimbi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi umculo we-hip hop ungase ube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi ezinsaneni. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop kufanele ube nomthwalo wokwakha izithombe ezinhle, hhayi ezimbi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-hip hop ungumkhakha obonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Njengoba umculo uthuthuka, ubona izinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini zomculo, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthengisa. Abaculi be-hip hop baye baba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, bephendula izinkinga zomphakathi, futhi bephakamisa izindaba ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop ungaphezu kokuba umculo; ungumsebenzi wobuciko obonisa izinguquko zomphakathi. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo we-hip hop awuhambisani nezimiso ezithile. Abaculi bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene zokubona izinto, futhi lokhu kudala izinkulumo ezinzima. Abanye bacula ngezinto ezithile, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop kufanele ube nezinjongo ezithile, njengokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabaculi, abalandeli, kanye nababukeli. Ekugcineni, umculo we-hip hop ungumkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni wezobuciko, kodwa futhi uveza izinkinga ezinzima ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ukuze umculo we-hip hop uqhubeke nokukhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokuba umculo; ungumsebenzi wobuciko obonisa izinguquko zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi bahlale bephikisana, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi bahlale bephokophela impilo engcono. Umculo we-hip hop ungumthombo wokukhuthaza, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo ungase ube nomthelela omubi uma ungasebenzisi kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umculo we-hip hop onobuhle, ohloniphekile, futhi onomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu.
Ukutshala Izingadi: Uhlanga Lokukhula Nokuthokozisa Ezweni elijulile lethu, ukutshala izingadi akusikho kuphela ukuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyisiko elihloniphekile elihlanganisa umhlaba, izitshalo, nemvelo. Ukukhuluma ngale ndaba, sithola ukuthi ukutshala izingadi kudinga ubuchwepheshe, uthando, nokubekezela. Ngakho, sizothatha uhambo olujulile kuleli thuba, sithokozise izinzuzo, izindlela, nezifundo ezitholakala kulolu hlobo lokuphila. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokutshala Izingadi Uma sikhuluma ngokutshala izingadi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinto eziyisisekelo. Okokuqala, umhlaba. Umhlaba omuhle, onempilo unikeza isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukuze umhlaba ube semthethweni, kufanele ube nezinhlaka ezinhle, okungukuthi, ube ne-nutrients ezanele. Ukuze uthole umhlaba onempilo, ungasebenzisa izinkuni ezibolayo, ama-mulch, noma izithako ezivela emvelweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo. Okwesibili, izitshalo. Khetha izitshalo ezivumelana nezimo zezulu endaweni yakho. Lolu hlobo lokukhetha luyisisekelo ukuze ube nezingadi eziphumelelayo. Izitshalo ezinjengezimbali, imifino, nezithelo zenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nemvelo. Izindlela Zokutshala Ukutshala izingadi akuyona into eyodwa kuphela; kunezindlela eziningi zokwenza lokhu. Uhlelo lwe-‘companion planting’ lungaba usizo olukhulu. Lokhu kusho ukufaka izitshalo ezihambisanayo eduze komunye nomunye, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela izitshalo ekulweni nezifo. Isibonelo, izinkuni ezinjengezithako ze-basil ne-tomato zikhombisa ukuthi zisebenza kahle uma zihlala eduze. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima eziphumelelayo, njengokufaka umhlaba opholile, kungasiza ekugcineni umswakama, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela izitshalo ezibuthakathaka. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ngokulinganayo, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo, kubalulekile ukuze izitshalo zihlale zikhula kahle. Izinzuzo Zokutshala Izingadi Izizathu zokutshala izingadi ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona impilo. Ukudla okukhulelwe ekhaya kuvame ukuba nezinhlobonhlobo eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukugcina impilo. Imifino nezithelo ezikhuliswa ekhaya zihlala zikhazimula, zihlala zisha, futhi zinezithako eziningi ezidingekayo emzimbeni. Okwesibili, ukutshala izingadi kungenza kube lula ukujabulisa. Ukusebenza emasimini, ukugubha izitshalo, nokubona ukukhula kwazo kuyajabulisa. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo, okwandisa umuzwa wokuthokozisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukutshala izingadi kungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano. Umndeni ungahlangana, uthokozise, futhi uhlele izinhlelo zokuhlola izitshalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Izifundo Eziphumelele Njengoba sithokozisa ukutshala izingadi, sifunda izifundo ezibalulekile. Ukuze ube nezingadi eziphumelelayo, kudinga ukuzimisela. Ukuhamba phambili, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi izitshalo zidinga ukunakekelwa. Ukubekezelela, ukugxila, nokuhlola izimo ezihlukahlukene zempilo yezitshalo zenza kube lula ukusiza izitshalo ukuba zikhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukutshala izingadi kusinika ithuba lokufunda. Njengoba sithola izinkinga, sithola izixazululo. Lokhu kusebenza emhlabeni jikelele, njengoba sithola izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezinkinga, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kungabe kuyizifo, izilokotho, noma izimo zezulu ezingalindelekile. Isiphetho Ukutshala izingadi akukhona nje okwenziwa emakhaya, kodwa kuyisiko elihloniphekile elihlanganisa abantu, izitshalo, nemvelo. Le ndlela yokuphila inikeza izinzuzo eziningi, kusukela empilweni, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze uzame ukutshala izingadi, sikhuthaza ukuthi uzame. Uhambo lokutshala izingadi lungaba yinto emnandi, efundisa, futhi ethokozisayo, eyokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Ngakho, phakamisa umhlaba, phakamisa izitshalo, futhi uvule isifiso sokuphila okukhanya. Ukutshala izingadi akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
UMark Zuckerberg: Umholi Wobuchwepheshe Oguqula Umhlaba UMark Zuckerberg, owazalwa ngoMfumfu 14, 1984, eWhite Plains, eNew York, ungumuntu ophawulekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. UZuckerberg waziwa kakhulu njengomqondisi we-Facebook, inkampani eyasungulwa ngo-2004, eyashintsha indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo. Wakhulela ezindaweni ezinhle, okwamnika ithuba lokukhulisa amakhono akhe okwakha izinto eziphumelelayo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eHarvard University, wathola umqondo wokwakha iwebsite yokuxhumana. Nakuba waqala nezinselelo eziningi ngemuva kokungena ku-inthanethi, wahlala eqinile. UFacebook waqala njengesayithi lokuxhumana labafundi beHarvard, kodwa ngokushesha wakhula waba ibhizinisi elikhulu elihlanganisa abantu abaningi. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwe-Facebook, uZuckerberg waqala ukugxila kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene, njengokuthengwa kwe-WhatsApp ne-Instagram, okwakha umthelela omkhulu ekuxhumaneni kwabantu. UFacebook waba yinkampani enkulu emhlabeni, futhi uZuckerberg waba ngumholi ophakeme embonini. Nokho, akagcinanga nje ngokuphumelela kwezimali; uhlale efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Waqala imizamo yokwakha izixazululo ezihlakaniphile ezizosiza abantu emhlabeni wonke, futhi uFacebook waba ngumholi emizamweni yokwakha ubuchwepheshe obuhlala buhlelwe. Uhlale ebhekana nezinselelo, njengokuphepha nokuvikela idatha yomsebenzisi, okuholele ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqubomgomo zenkampani. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu. UZuckerberg ungumholi onemibono emisha, futhi uphinde ube nesibopho sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngokwesibonelo, usebenzisile ubuchwepheshe bokufunda ngomshini ukuze athuthukise izinqubo zokuxhumana, eqinisekisa ukufinyelela kolwazi olufanele. Ngo-2015, uZuckerberg waba nesibopho sokwakha i-Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, enhlosweni yokuthuthukisa imfundo, impilo, kanye nemisebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi akakaze azibekele umgomo wokwenza imali kuphela. Uhlala efuna ukusiza abanye, futhi uzama ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zakhe zokuxhumana, lapho ehlosile ukudala indawo evulekile nehlanganyela. UZuckerberg ungomunye wezithunywa eziphambili zokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo idinga ukuzimisela nesibopho sokubhekana nezinselele. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi useqokweni elihle phakathi kwabantu. UZuckerberg ungumfanekiso wezizathu ezithandwa kakhulu ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, futhi uphinde akhuthaze ukuthi umphakathi ungaba nethuba lokuthuthuka.
Umculo: Izindlela Zokuwuqonda Nokuwudlala Umculo ungumthombo obalulekile wokwazisa, ukujabulela, kanye nokuxhumana. Ukuze umqondo wakho umculo ube sobala, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizinda zawo, izindlela zokuwudlala, nezimpande zawo. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinyathelo ezahlukene zokufunda, ukuwudlala, nokuwuqonda ngempela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Uhlanga Lomculo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo unohlanga olunhlobonhlobo. Uhlanga lomculo lungahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi, njengegitar, ibhendi, noma emkhakheni wombhoshongo wezokuziqhenya. Qonda ukuthi ubani umculi, yiziphi izinsimbi ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nesiko elihambisana nomculo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle umculo. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsimbi Nezindlela Zokudlala Izinsimbi zomculo zihluke kakhulu. Zifaka phakathi izinsimbi ezinjengepiyano, igitar, nezinsimbi zomoya ezifana nama-trumpets nama-flutes. Qala ngezinsimbi ezilula ukufunda, njengegitar. Thola izincwadi zokufunda noma sebenzisa izifundo ze-inthanethi ezikufundisa izisekelo zokudlala. Uma usulungele, phambili ufunde ukudlala izigqi ezinzima. Isinyathelo 3: Ukucula Noma Ukuqamba Umdlalo Uma ungumculi, ungakhetha ukuhamba phambili ngokucula. Ukucula kudinga umoya, uthando, kanye nezindlela zokucacisa imicabango yakho. Cabanga ngendaba ofuna ukuyicacisa; ungabhalela izinkondlo noma umyalezo othile, bese uzama ukukhipha imizwa yakho ngolimi lomculo. Umculo ungumthombo omuhle wokukhombisa imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuxhumana Ngezinga Lomculo Umculo unethonya elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Khetha umculo okukhombisa umoya wesiko lakho. Ungabambisana nabanye, udale amaphrojekthi omculo, noma udlale emikhosini. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufinyelele ezindleleni eziningi zokuxhumana nezinye izinkolo nezinkanyezi. Isinyathelo 5: Phumelela Ngezifundo Zomculo Ukufunda umculo akupheli. Bheka izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono akho. Ungafunda ngezincwadi ezahlukene, ubhalisele izinhlelo, noma uhlale uthola umculo ongena mahhala kwi-inthanethi. Hamba nemicimbi, hlola izikhala ezitholakalayo, nomphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufunde izitayela ezahlukene, imiphakathi, nezinkanyezi zomculo. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngomculo Njengoba uqhubeka nokuqonda umculo, ungakhuthaza abaculi abasha. Yabelana ngolwazi lwakho, uqhubeke nokuqinisa izindlela zokudlala, futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba baziqhenye ngemicabango yabo. Umculo unika ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwane, futhi ngokubambisana ungadala imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 7: Jabulela Umculo Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Umculo ungumnikazi wezinto ezinhle; ungama-banda, izinhlelo zokwakha, noma izigcawu ezinkulu zemicimbi. Gcina uhlanganisa okuthandayo, ujabulele izinsuku ezihlukile zokwakha umoya. Ujule ekuthuthukiseni ukuzijabulisa ngamaqhawe nezinkanyezi ezivelele emculweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhambisane nesiko nomculo. Isiphetho: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Umculo Emhlabeni wamanje, umculo ungendlela ebalulekile yokuxhumana; ungasiza empilweni yethu. Sizoqhubeka sifundisa abantu ukuthi baphile umculo, bawuqonde, bawuqhube, futhi baphume umculo baphishekela izinjongo zabo. Ngakho-ke, thatha isinyathelo, thola umculo, bese ujabulela ukuhamba kwezwe lomculo. Ukuze umculo uphile, kudinga umsebenzi, uthando, nomoya wokubambisana. Zizwe ukhululekile njalo emculweni wakho, futhi phumeza izinto ezinkulu.
Ezokumbiwa Kwezinsiza: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimpikiswano Nezimo Zamanje Ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza, okuyinqubo yokukhishwa kwezinsiza zemvelo ukuze zisetshenziswe ezimbonini, zibalulekile emnothweni wezwe. Le nqubo ihlanganisa ukutholwa, ukukhipha, nokucubungula izinsiza ezifana namafutha, amalahle, izinsimbi, namaminerali. Nokho, lezi zinsiza zitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, futhi ukumbiwa kwazo kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo lapho umnotho uvame ukuba nezinselelo. Isibonelo, izimayini ezikhiqiza amalahle ziqhakambisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemakhaya, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kubantu bendawo. Nokho, lezi zinzuzo zihlala zifaniswa nezingozi ezinkulu. Ukumbiwa kwezinsiza kuvame ukuholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo, okubandakanya ukungcoliswa komoya, amanzi, nomhlaba. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane, ukwehla kwezinhlobo ezithile, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezithintekayo zingabhekana nezinkinga zokuhlala, njengoba abantu behlupheka ngenxa yokungcoliswa, okuholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Futhi, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhombisa izinkinga zokuphatha kahle izinsiza. Izinkampani ezinkulu zihlala zikhathazekile ngenzuzo, okungaholela ekutheni zinganaki imithetho yokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezakhamuzi, lapho izakhamuzi zifuna ukuvikela imvelo, kanti izinkampani zifuna ukwandisa inzuzo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxoxisana okuqhubekayo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithuthukisa umnotho ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ukwengeza, izokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhombisa izinkinga zokulingana. Izinsiza zemvelo zitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, okudala ukungalingani phakathi kwezizwe. Izizwe ezithuthukayo, ezivame ukuba nezinsiza eziningi, zithola izinzuzo, kanti ezithuthukayo zihlala zihlupheka. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze aphile kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezibandakanyekayo ziqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuphatha kahle imvelo, okuholela ekusebenziseni ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle. Ziqala futhi ukusebenzisana nezakhamuzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngokuphetha, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, kodwa zidinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ukuze kube nokuthula phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezakhamuzi, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxoxisana okuqhubekayo, okuzokwenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kubantu, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ukubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zikhuthaza umnotho, futhi zivikela imvelo.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila: Izizathu Nezixazululo Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima zomnotho, sazi ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila sekuphenduke umkhuba osukhula ngokushesha emhlabeni jikelele, futhi ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ezimakethe, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, kanye nezimo zomhlaba. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izizathu zokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila, imiphumela yalesi simo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuncishiswe ukuvuvukala kwezindleko. Okokuqala, uma sikhuluma ngezizathu zokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila, kufanele sikhulume ngentengo yokudla. Izifundo zibonisa ukuthi intengo yokudla ibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokuthutha, izinkinga zokukhiqiza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima ezifana nezomiso neziqhwa. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umkhiqizo uthunyelwa emakethe kumele uhambisane nezindleko eziphezulu zokuthutha, okugqamisa ukuthi intengo yokudla iyanda. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okwanele, okukhombisa ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila akukhathaleli kuphela abampofu, kodwa kube nomthelela wonke umuntu. Okwesibili, izindleko zokuhlala zikhuphukile kakhulu. Lokhu kubangelwa ukuncipha kwezindawo zokuhlala ezitholakalayo, okudlulela ekwandeni kwemali yokurenta nezindleko zokwakha. Abantu abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezibiza kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziyisisekelo. Lezi zindleko ziphinde zandise ukukhathazeka, njengoba abantu bephoqeka ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezithile ukuze bahlale befinyelela emisebenzini, kodwa lokho kudinga imali eningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, siba nesimo lapho izindleko zokuhlala ziphakamisa ingcindezi emndenini, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina impilo enhle. Ngokwemiphumela, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuhlobene nokuncipha kwesimo sezimali somphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhula kokwehla kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Abantu banqunywa ukuthi benze izinqumo ezinzima mayelana nezidingo zabo, okukhuthaza umkhuba wokungabikhona kwemali eningi yokuthenga imikhiqizo eyisisekelo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abantu bephoqeka ukuba baqoqe imali, kodwa ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu, bahluleka ukufinyelela ezidingweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kulethe umthelela omubi emisebenzini. Abantu abaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinkampani zithuthukisa ukusebenza kwazo ukuze zikwazi ukuzama ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza. Lokhu kudala ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko ukuze zihlale zikhona emakethe. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, okukhathaza umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abantu abasha abafuna umsebenzi. Ngakho, yini engase yenziwe ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila? Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele athathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela abathengi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izintela ezithinta ukudla nezindawo zokuhlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka izinqubomgomo ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza kwasemakhaya kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zokudla. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthutha nezokwakha kungasiza ekwehliseni izindleko zokuthutha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwezimpahla. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi yokwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphusile, ukuze kube nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, kungasiza ekwandiseni izindawo zokuhlala ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu basebenze ndawonye nabaholi bendawo, ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphathelene nezimo zendawo. Ekugcineni, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kusemthethweni, kanti imiphumela yalesi simo ibonakala kubantu abaningi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa imizamo yohulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze sifeze impumelelo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo nemfundo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko zokuphila ziphakamisa izinselelo ezinzima, kodwa ngokubambisana, singathola izindlela zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umculo WaseNingizimu Afrika: Isiko, Uhlanga, Nezinguquko Umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso ohloniphekile wezinkolelo, izinkumbulo, nezimpilo zabantu bethu. Uhlanga lwezizukulwane ezahlukene, izinkolo, nezindawo zethu kukhombisa ubuhle obuhlukahlukene obutholakala emculweni wethu. Njengoba sihlola umculo wethu, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi awuwona nje umculo, kodwa uyindlela yokuxhumana, yokukhumbula, nokuhlanganyela. Uma sibheka emuva, umculo wethu uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho izizwe zethu zazisebenzisa izinsimbi ezilula, njengezinkanyezi, izigubhu, nezinsimbi zomoya. Lezi zinsimbi zazisetshenziswa ukuh recall izigigaba, izinkanyezi, nezinkolo. Umculo wawuhlanganisa abantu, ubavusa, futhi ubakhumbuza ngezimpilo zabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo wawungelona nje uhlobo lokuzijabulisa, kodwa wawuwumthombo wokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika wathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sobandlululo, kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezindlela ezintsha zomculo. Umculo weKwaito, owavela emaphandleni eGauteng, waba yisithombe esihle sokuphila kwabantu abasha, ubuhlungu, nokuphumelela. U-Kwaito uhlanganisa umculo weHip-Hop, iHouse, nezinye izitayela, futhi ubonisa indlela abantu abasha abaphila ngayo, izifiso zabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo weGospel ubonisa ukukhanya nokhopeka. Uhlanga lwezinkolo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama, luhlanganiswe emculweni, futhi umculo weGospel ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Ubuqotho, uthando, nokholo kubonakala emculweni, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika uqhubekile nokukhula. Izitayela ezinjengeJazz, iMaskandi, neAfro-Pop zathola udumo emhlabeni jikelele. Umculi onjengoHugh Masekela, uMiriam Makeba, noJohnny Clegg baveze ubuhle bomculo wethu, futhi baphakamisa izwi lethu emhlabeni. Lezi zinkanyezi zikhombisa ukuthi umculo wethu ungaphezu kwemikhuba yendawo; ungumkhiqizo wezinto eziningi ezihlangene. Namuhla, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ubonakala emhlabeni wonke. Abaculi abasha, njengeNasty C, uSho Madjozi, noBlack Coffee, baphinde baqhubeke nokwakha izitayela ezintsha, behlanganisa izithako ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo wethu awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhlanganisa izizukulwane ezintsha nezinkolelo ezahlukene. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sikhuthaza umculo wethu. Umculo ungumthombo wokuxhumana, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze siqhakambise izinkolelo zethu, izinkumbulo, nezimpilo zethu. Abaculi bethu badinga ukwesekwa, ukuze bakwazi ukuveza izwi labo, futhi baphinde bahloniphe izimpande zethu. Umculo ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze sakhe umphakathi onobunye. Ekugcineni, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumthombo wokuphila, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Ubonisa ubuhle bethu, izinkolelo zethu, nezimpilo zethu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sihloniphe izimpande zethu, futhi siqhubeke sikhuthaza umculo wethu, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bawo. Umculo wethu ungumthombo wokuphila, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze sikhulise umphakathi wethu, sikhumbule izimpande zethu, futhi sithokozise izizukulwane ezizayo.
iBMW - Umfanekiso Wokuhamba Okuphakeme I-BMW, okuyisithombe esihloniphekile emhlabeni wezimoto, ibonakala njengenkanyezi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Le mboni, eyasungulwa eJalimane, inhloso yayo enkulu iwukuhlinzeka ngempilo yokuhamba engcono. Ngaphezu kokuba imoto, iBMW ibonakala njengophawu lwezinga, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nesitayela. Ukuhlonishwa kwayo akugcini nje ngempahla yayo ebonakalayo, kodwa futhi kusekelwe emsebenzini wayo ophakeme. Ngokwethu sikhuluma nge-BMW, imoto ngayinye iyinsiza yokuhamba enezici ezihlukahlukene. I-BMW ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, obuhlanganisa izici zokuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokunethezeka. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezimotweni zayo ezidumile, njenge-BMW 3 Series ne-BMW X5, ezikhombisa ukuthi iBMW ayinikezi kuphela imoto, kodwa inikeza umuzwa ophakeme wokuhamba, okwenza umsebenzisi azizwe ehloniphekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iBMW ibonakale ibhekana nezinselelo, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni oshintsha ngokushesha. Ukukhula kwemakethe yemoto ye-electronic kanye nezidingo zokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni, kudinga ukuthi le mboni ibheke phambili. Ngakho-ke, iBMW ithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, njenge-BMW i3 ne-iX, okukhombisa ukuthi ibona ukubaluleka kokuzivumelanisa nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba iBMW ibhekana nezinguquko, kukhona abanye abakhathazekile ngentengo yezimoto zayo. I-BMW ibonakala iyimfashini, okwenza izimoto zayo zibe phezulu kakhulu, nokwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kuzo. Futhi, izindleko zokugcina lezi zimoto ziphinde zibe phezulu, okuvimbela abanikazi bazo. Ukuze ibheke phambili, iBMW kufanele iqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza izimoto zayo zibe zishibhile, ngaphandle kokunciphisa izinga. Lokhu kuzodinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza. I-BMW kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi zibe zithengekayo, ukuze ikwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuba babe neBMW, futhi kuzokwenza umkhiqizo ube neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iBMW kufanele iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bayo. Ukuze ibambe iqhaza elikhulu emakethe, iBMW kufanele iqonde izidingo zabathengi bayo, ifune izindlela zokwenza imoto zibe nezici ezithokozisayo, ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Ekugcineni, iBMW iyinkampani ehloniphekile, enezinhloso eziphakeme zokuhlinzeka ngempilo yokuhamba engcono. Nokho, kufanele ibheke phambili, ibhekane nezinselelo ezikhona, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha imoto ezithokozisayo, ezithengekayo. Uma iBMW ikwazi ukwenza lokhu, izoba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokuthutha, futhi izokwazi ukuheha abathengi abaningi. I-BMW ayigcini nje ngokuhamba, kodwa ibonisa indlela yokuhamba okuphakeme, okwenza umsebenzisi azizwe ehloniphekile. Lokhu kuyisifiso esikhulu, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi iBMW izokwazi ukufinyelela kulokhu.
Umbiko: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni sekuyinto ebalulekile emfundweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afana namakhompyutha, ama-tablet, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokufundisa. Ubulungiswa bokufunda bukhula ngokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsiza zingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemfundo. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezemfundo Izikhungo zemfundo ziye zathola izinzuzo eziningi ngokwethula ubuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile kunceda abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olusha kalula. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube khona ukufinyelela kwezinsiza eziningi, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umqondo wokuzimela nokuzifundela. Ukuxhumana Nokuqonda Ubuchwepheshe buphinde busebenze njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube lula ukuxhumana, futhi abafundi bangabeka imibuzo yabo kalula. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, lapho abafundi bezwa bekhululekile ukufaka imibono yabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bephokophele ekufundeni. Ukuphuculwa Kwamakhono Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, abafundi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ahlukene. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile, ama-apps, kanye nevidiyo zokufundisa akwazi ukusiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono okucabanga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokusebenza ngokuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla.
