Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni akukhululekile. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuxhumeka ku-inthanethi, kanye nokungabi namakhono afanele kubafundisi. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ukwenza imihlangano yokufundisa kubafundisi mayelana nezobuchwepheshe kungasiza ekwandiseni amakhono abo. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa imfundo. Ngokusebenzisa amakhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi, abafundi bangathola ulwazi olusha, bathuthukise amakhono, futhi bakhulise ukuxhumana. Nokho, izinkinga ezithile zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bayathola lezi zinsiza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busebenza kahle emfundweni. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele kuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emfundweni, kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo yabafundi.
iXbox: Umbiko Ngempumelelo neKusasa Kwezemidlalo Isingeniso Emhlabeni wamanje, ubuchwepheshe buhlanganisa izimpilo zethu ngendlela ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezokuzijabulisa. Okwamanje, ukukhetha kwezokuzijabulisa kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi iXbox, eyaziwa yonke indawo, iyisibani sokuxhumana, ukudlala, nokusebenza kube ngcono. Ngalesi sikhathi, sijolise ekubhekeni impumelelo yeXbox, izinguquko ezibalulekile ezithathe indawo, kanye nekusasa eliqhakazile elibhekene nomkhiqizo. Ukwakhiwa KweXbox iXbox yasungulwa nguMicrosoft ngo-2001, kwaba umkhiqizo wokuqala wombukiso wezokudlala owakhiwe ngenkampani ehamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Le mkhiqizo wahlelelwa ukuhlinzeka amalungelo amakhulu emidlalweni yevidiyo, kanye nemibono emisha yokuxhumana. I-Xbox Classic, iXbox 360, iXbox One, kanye neXbox Series X/S baye bahlala behlukanisa izinhlelo zokudlala ngendlela ephezulu, bephendula izidingo zabathandi bemidlalo. Ukukhula Kwezimboni Zokudlala Ngesikhathi sokukhula komkhiqizo, iXbox ibhekelele ukukhiqiza imidlalo ehlobene nezimo zokuphila zabantu, izinkanyezi zomhlaba, nezithombe zezimanga. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudlala ngomkhiqizo owaziwa ngeXbox Game Pass, okwakha induduzo yokuthola imidlalo eminingi ngenyanga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMicrosoft yakhuthele ekubandakanyeni abathandi bemidlalo olwazini olunembile, ivula izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze babe nethuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabo. Ubuchwepheshe Obuphambili Ubuchwepheshe beXbox buye buhlala bukhula, bukhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. I-Xbox Series X, eyethulwa ngo-2020, yethula ukusebenza okusheshayo kakhulu, ukuxhomuza kwamahhala, kanye nemisebenzi ethuthuke kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici zokudlala ezilula, ezinjenge-haptic feedback kwezilawuli, kanye nezinketho zokuxhumana ezivumela abadlali ukuba baqedela imishado yabo ngezinto ezingcono kakhulu. Imikhiqizo YeXbox neMidlalo Ehamba Phambili I-Xbox ibinenezinhlobo eziningi zemidlalo ezithakazelisayo, ezihlanganisa imidlalo yama-adventure, ama-RPG, ama-shooter, nezinye. Izihloko ezinjenge "Halo", "Gears of War", kanye ne "Forza Horizon" zigqugquzela abadlali, kwenze kube nenhlonipho futhi kube nomphumela omuhle kumphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe bezokwakha imidlalo obukhona, njengokubekwa kweDijithi (Digital Reality) ne-Virtual Reality, buye bukhombisa umphakathi imidlalo engakaze ibonakale phambilini. Izinguquko Zokuxhumana Ngaphezu kokudlala, ukuhlanganiswa kweXbox ne-inthanethi kube nomthelela omkhulu. Ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukudala izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana neXbox Live, evumela abadlali ukuthi badlale ndawonye, baphinde baxhumane. Lokhu kubonisa indlela yezehlukanisa umphakathi wezokudlala, wenza kube lula ukuba abadlali baxhumane, futhi baphinde babelane ngemininingwane nokuhlangenwe nakho. Ikusasa LeXbox Ukubheka phambili, iXbox ibonakala ngenkuthalo emisha. Ngezimbangi ezifana neSony PlayStation neNVIDIA, iMicrosoft ibhekelela ukufezekisa izinjongo ezinkulu zokuba umholi emkhakheni wezokudlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibheke ekuqhamukeni nezinye izinhlelo zokudlala ezingama-cross-platform, ukuvikela imidlalo emisha nokuthuthukisa izinto ezintsha zokuxhumana. Isiphetho Ngokubheka emuva, iXbox ibonise ubuhlakani namandla amakhulu ekwakhiweni kwabathandi bemidlalo. Kwaba umkhiqizo ophumelelayo, uhlanganyela izimfuno zabantu, futhi ulokhu uthokozisa ingqondo yabadlali. Ukutholakala kweXbox Game Pass, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezici ezithuthukayo zalesi sikhathi, kudala ikusasa eliqhakazile leXbox. Ngakho-ke, iXbox izohlala ibamba isikhala esihle emhlabeni wezokudlala, iphumela phambili ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele wokuzijabulisa.
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba elikhulu lokwakha ikusasa elisha. Ngalesi sikhathi, izwe lalisaphila ngaphansi kokuhlukumezeka, ubandlululo, kanye nezinkinga ezinzima ezazithinta wonke umuntu. Kodwa, phakathi kwalesi sikhathi esinzima, kwavela ithemba elisha, elalikhanya njengenkanyezi ebusuku. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha umthethosisekelo, owawuzoba yisisekelo sokuphila kwabantu bonke. Umgwaqo wokuqala walesi sikhathi wathatha uMnu. Nelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, owaphuma ejele ngemuva kweminyaka engama-27. UMandela wayezimisele ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, ezokwazi ukuphila ngokukhululeka. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabaholi bezepolitiki, abaholi bezinhlangano ezahlukene, kanye nabamele izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMandela wathola ukwesekwa okuqinile kumalungu e-ANC, i-IFP, nezinye izinhlangano ezazihlanganyela ekwakheni umthethosisekelo. Kwakukhona umuzwa wokuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle. Umhlangano wokuqala obalulekile waba seKapa, lapho abaholi bezepolitiki behlangana khona ukuze baxoxe ngempilo yelizwe. Kwakuyisikhathi sokukhuluma, sokuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula. Ngemuva kwemihlangano eminingi, kwavela umbono wokwakha umthethosisekelo ophathelene namalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavuma ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, kufanele abe namalungelo alinganayo. Umthethosisekelo wawuhloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho muntu ozokwenqabela abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela abathanda ngayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwavela ababhali abaninzi ababeqhamuka nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwakha umthethosisekelo. UProf. John Dugard, uProf. Kader Asmal, noMnu. Cyril Ramaphosa, babebambe iqhaza elikhulu ekubhaleni nasekucabangeni ngalezi zinhlelo. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, izinkulumo, nezifundo ezazihlelwa ukuze kuqondwe kahle ukuthi umthethosisekelo kufanele ube kanjani. Ngonyaka ka-1996, umthethosisekelo watholwa, futhi kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula. Abantu beNingizimu Afrika babebonisa injabulo enkulu, behlanganyela emigubuzweni, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezazikhanya phezulu. Umthethosisekelo wawuhlanganisa izimiso ezibalulekile, ezifana nokulingana, ubulungiswa, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu. Kwakuyisikhathi sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Nokho, ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akuzange kube lula. Kwakukhona izithiyo eziningi, izinkinga ezazivela phakathi kwabantu, nezinkulumo ezazihamba kancane. Abanye abantu babengavumi ukwamukela izinguquko, bephikisana nemigomo emisha. Kodwa, uMandela nozakwabo babenqaba ukuhamba emuva. Baphikelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, beqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzothola ithuba lokukhuluma, lokwazisa, nokuhlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthethosisekelo waba yisisekelo sokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwakukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezazihlelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila kahle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Umthethosisekelo wawuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezemfundo, nezempilo. Kwakuyisikhathi sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa umthethosisekelo usaqhubeka nokuba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abantu bahlala bephokophelela ekuthuthukiseni izwe, beqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe yizwe elihloniphekile, elihlangene. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika kuwumlando obalulekile, owakhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izifiso zabo, baphinde bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingavela, uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Umthethosisekelo ungumfanekiso wokuhlanganyela, uthando, kanye nokuqhubeka phambili, ukuze iNingizimu Afrika ibe yizwe elinokuthula, elinokuthula, nelinokuthula.
Izinkinga Zokungcola Komoya: Ingxoxo Isingeniso Namuhla, sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, eyodwa ezinzima kakhulu futhi edinga ukunakwa kwethu, okungcola komoya. Ngikholwa ukuthi kulungile ukuqala ngengxoxo enembile kanye nomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezempilo, uMnu. Dlamini, ongumeluleki kwezokuhlala kahle komoya. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngokuvuma ukudlula kithi namuhla. Umbuzo: Mnu. Dlamini, ungachaza kanjani izinkinga zokungcola komoya? Impendulo: Yebo, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Kulula ukusho ukuthi izinkinga zokungcola komoya zifaka phakathi izinsiza eziningi ezihambisana nomoya esiwuphefumulayo, ezifaka phakathi udaka, uthuli, nezinto ezibangela ukungcoliswa komoya. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokusebenza kwemishini emikhulu, ukwakha, noma ngisho nezinto eziphuma emathunjini abantu. Lokhu kuthinta impilo yethu, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezindaweni esihlala kuzo. Umbuzo: Uthini umthelela wokungcola komoya empilweni yabantu? Impendulo: Umthelela ungashintsha kakhulu. Njengoba uhamba phambili, ungaholela ezinkingeni ezinjengokuphefumula, izifo zenhliziyo, nezinkinga zokuhlala kahle. Unokuthinta iziguli ezikhuluma ngokuthi zihlupheke kanjani, noma ziba nezinkinga ezinzima njenge-asthma noma i-chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Umbuzo: Zithini izizathu ezikhulu zokungcola komoya eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: E-Ningizimu Afrika, izizathu ezinkulu zifaka phakathi ukuhamba kwezimoto, ukukhiqiza amandla, nokwakha. Izimoto zikhula ngokushesha, futhi zikhuphula amazinga okungcola komoya. Ukukhiqiza amandla, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yokushisa, kukhuphula izinga le-sulfur dioxide, okuyingozi emoyeni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindawo zokwakha zikhuphula uthuli, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba komoya. Umbuzo: Kukhona yini izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela abantu kulezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Yebo, izinyathelo zikhona. Uhulumeni usebenza ngokuqhubekayo ekwenzeni imithetho eqinile yokongamela umoya. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zilandela izinqubomgomo ezithile. Kukhona futhi imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile, njengokusebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile eziphathelene nemvelo. Umbuzo: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokungcola komoya eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Ngicabanga ukuthi umbono wethu udinga ukuba ngowesibili. Uma sibheka izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ngiyavuma ukuthi sinethemba. Kodwa, konke kuncike ekutheni sizimisele kangakanani ukwenza izinguquko. Uma abantu bezokwazi ukwakha imiphakathi ebhekelele imvelo, sizoba nempilo engcono. Ubulunga bokuphila kanye nokuhlala kahle komoya kuyoba nethuba lokuthuthuka. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo umuntu ngamunye angazithatha ukuvikela impilo yabo? Impendulo: Ngempela, izinyathelo ezilula zingaphinde zibe namandla. Umuntu angakhetha ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ukusebenzisa ibhasi esikhundleni sokusebenzisa imoto. Lokhu kuzonciphisa ukungcola komoya. Ukuze siqinisekise impilo yethu, kufanele futhi sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuhlunga umoya, njengezikhumbuzo zokuhlanzeka komoya ezivela ezinkampanini. Futhi, uma uhamba emakethe, khetha imikhiqizo enobungane bemvelo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi sokwabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Izinkinga zokungcola komoya zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi sicela abantu bazi ukuthi izinyathelo ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke ababekhona, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukwenza ushintsho oluhle empilweni yethu. Hayi kuphela ngezinkinga zomoya, kodwa nasezimpilweni zethu.
Amalungelo Abantu: Indaba Yokulwa Nempilo Nobulungiswa Ngaphakathi komlando womuntu, amalungelo abantu avele njengomgogodla wokuphila kahle, ubulungiswa, kanye nomqondo wokuhlonipha ubuntu. Lokhu kuqala emaphakathini amaningi, lapho abantu bebebhekana nezinkinga eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukucindezelwa, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinhlekelele zokukhwabanisa. Uhlanga lwezinto lungabuyiselwa emuva ezikhathini zakudala, lapho izinsika zempilo zafakwa khona ezincwadini eziningi. Kukhona amaMthetho kaHammurabi, akhiwe eBabiloni ngonyaka ka-1754 BCE, lapho kwafakwa khona iziqondiso ezichaza amalungelo nemisebenzi yabantu. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokubhekwa kokubaluleka kokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, nakuba lezi ziqondiso zazingabi nemiphumela emikhulu ezimpilweni zabaningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngamazinga ahlukahlukene, abantu baqala ukwazi ukulwela amalungelo abo. Iqhawe elalizwakalisa lesi sifo sokuqonda amalungelo abantu nguSocrates, owakholelwa ekutheni umuntu ngamunye unelungelo lokukhuluma nokuphila ngendlela afuna ngayo. Lesi sikhungo sekhuluma ngempela ngezinguquko ezinkulu ezazizobanga ezikhathini ezizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyaka yeMpi Yezwe I neMpi Yezwe II yafaka izikhumbuzo ezinzima ezizobangela ukuphakanyiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Ngemuva kwempi, abantu abaningi baqonda ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kuhlale kwehluka, nokuthi kufanele kube nezivumelwano eziphathelene namalungelo abantu. Kulokhu, ngonyaka ka-1948, iMibhalo YamaNgxenye Wezikhulu Zomhlaba yadalwa, okwakuwumsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Le mibhalo yafaka izinqubo ezisemqoka ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi, ukudala umhlaba onobulungiswa, nokukhulisa umoya wezokuthula. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kwalezi zinsiza, izizwe eziningi zathatha izinyathelo ezinzima zokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo zazikhona. Kwakukhona izinkinga ezinjengobuhlanga, ubuhlanga obuhlukile, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala imiphumela emibi, njengoba abantu behlukunyezwa, beboshwa, futhi bephoqelelwa ukuba baphile ngendlela engafanelekile. Ngesikhathi se-1960s, emhlabeni jikelele, kwaqala ukuvela izinyathelo ezinzima zokulwa nobandlululo, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu. Abaholi abafana noMartin Luther King Jr. e-United States, nabanye abaholi bezokuhlanganyela, baphakamisa izwi labo ukuze baphakamise amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu kufanele bazimisele ukulwa ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zemisebenzi zikhipha izikhumbuzo ezinzima, lapho zifuna ukukhangisa ngokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana neGoogle neApple, ziqale ukwazisa amalungelo abantu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavunyelwe ukucindezelwa noma ukuphathwa kabi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amalungelo abantu akuyona kuphela indaba yempilo yabantu abavela ezizweni ezithile, kodwa yindaba yokusebenza komhlaba wonke. Nokho, nakuba izinyathelo eziningi zenzekile, kusazoba khona imikhawulo ethile. Izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, ukungavunyelwa kwezwi, kanye nokungabi nalungelo lokukhetha zisazoba izinselelo ezinzima. Kulokhu, kudinga ukuba sibe nomdlandla, siqhubeke sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu, sishiye umhlaba ungcono kubantu bethu. Ngokuhamba kweminyaka, abantu baqhubeka nokulwa ukuze bahloniphe amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imikhankaso ehlukene, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinkampani ezazithanda ukuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. I-United Nations, ngokwazisa iMibhalo YamaNgxenye Wezikhulu Zomhlaba, iqhubekile ibeka izindinganiso eziphakeme zokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, iqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila, ukufunda, nokuqhuba impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, indaba yamalungelo abantu ayigcini nje kuphela emlandweni, kodwa iyindaba eqhubekayo. Abantu basebenza kanzima ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi bazimisele ukulwa nalabo abahlaselayo amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu akukhona ukuvota kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukugcina amalungelo abantu kuphakamisa ubungani, uthando, kanye nokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngakho-ke, njengomphakathi, kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu, sikhumbule ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila, futhi sikhuthaze ukwakhiwa komhlaba onobulungiswa. Indaba yamalungelo abantu iyindaba yethu sonke, futhi kumele sizibophezele ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinto ukuze umhlaba ube ngcono kulabo abazayo.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini Ukukhuluma ngempilo yezisebenzi zasezimayini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zindawo ziwumongo ophilayo wezomnotho, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhanya kwelanga, kwazulu, nababekezeli, bonke baqonda ukuthi izimayini ziningi zazo ezikhipha amandla, kodwa zikhona neziqu zomsebenzi ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, ake sithathe lokhu kubhekisiswe ngokuqhubekayo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yezisebenzi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izimayini ziqale zathuthukiswa ngesikhathi sobukoloni. Kwakukhona imfuno enkulu yamalahle, igolide, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka ezazidingeka ukuze kube nezidingo zomnotho. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika, baqala ukuza ezindaweni zasemazweni ukuze bazame ukuthola umsebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezindawo zokuhlala ezibizwa ngokuthi "amaTownship." Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, iminyaka edlule, izisebenzi zathola izinga eliphakeme lokusebenza, kodwa futhi zaba nezinselelo eziningi. Ukusebenza ezimayini kwakuthathwa njengokungasheshisi, futhi abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukuphila kwabo kwakuhlobene nezingozi nezingozi ezinzima, kufaka phakathi ukulimala emsebenzini, izifo ezithathelwanayo, nezimo zokuhlala ezimbi. Abesifazane babengabhaliswanga kalula futhi benganikezwa ithuba lokusebenza, ngakho-ke, ubukhona babo bekukholwa ukuthi bukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezincane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukwakha iminyango yokuvikela amalungelo ezisebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezahlukene zokulwa nokucindezelwa. Kwakukuhle kakhulu ukubona abantu bejabula, bephakamisa izikhwama zabo, begqugquzela amalungelo abo. Izinsuku zokuqala zokuvota, izinkulumo ezaziphakanyiswa, nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zaziyingxenye yokuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abo ayavikeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemibono yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, izisebenzi zasezimayini zaba nemibhikisho eminingi. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa izinsuku ezinzima, lapho abantu besiphakamisa izwi labo, becele ukuthi baphuculwe izimo zabo zokusebenza. Isibonelo, kwaba nezenzakalo ezinjengokuboshwa kwabantu, ukulwa nemali yokuhola enganele, kanye nezimo eziphazamisayo. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yomhlaba Yesibili, izimayini zazibhekwa njengendawo ebalulekile, futhi izisebenzi zaba negalelo elikhulu ekwakheni izinsiza ezazidingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe impi. Abesifazane, ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, baqala ukusebenza ezimayini, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekuvuleni amathuba amaningi. Kwakungesikhathi lapho abantu beqala ukubona ukuthi amandla abesifazane ayebalulekile, futhi lokhu kwasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukwamukela izisebenzi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izimayini zavula amahhovisi amasha, futhi izisebenzi zafika zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlukahlukene zokusebenza, ezagcwalisa umhlaba wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izisebenzi ziqonde ukuthi kumele zifunde, ziqhubeke zithuthukisa amakhono azo ukuze zikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezizayo emhlabeni. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izimayini zikhula, izinselelo zazo ziqhubeka. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, izisebenzi zidinga izimo ezinhle zokusebenza, futhi lokhu akusikhona njalo. Zikhona izinsuku lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi akekho ophakeme, kanti izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kwemali yokuhola, izimo zokuhlala ezingezinhle, nemikhawulo yokuphepha ziba yizinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi, njengoba izisebenzi ziqhubeka nokwakha impilo yazo, zikhona izindlela eziningi zokuthola ukwesekwa. Izinhlelo zokuziphatha, umphakathi obambisene, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhokhelwa ziyaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi ophephile, ophilayo, kudinga ukubambisana. Ukuze sifeze umbono omuhle wezisebenzi zasezimayini, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo iyingxenye enkulu yezenzakalo zomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, akusikhona kuphela ukubuka izindleko, kodwa futhi ukubheka izinzuzo ezitholakala ekubambeni izisebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sifeze izinjongo ezinhle, sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza, futhi sigcine isithunzi esihle somsebenzi wezisebenzi zasezimayini. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ubonisa ukuthi amandla okusebenza, ubuhlakani, nokubambisana kwazo, kungaholela ekuphuculeni izimpilo zazo. Njengoba sikhumbula izinsuku ezinzima nezimpumelelo, sithola ukuthi ukuqhubeka nokubambisana, ukusekela amalungelo ezisebenzi, kanye nokwakha isiko elihle lokusebenza, kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Futhi ngalendlela, somandla sithola ukuthi umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka, uqhubeka, uhamba phambili.
USuku lwaBasha: Umkhosi Wokuhlonipha Abasha Nokuqhakambisa Isiko Emphakathini wethu, usuku lwaBasha luvele lube usuku olukhulu nolugcwele ubusuku nezinsuku, lapho umphakathi uhlangana khona ukuze uhlabela abasha, ubavuselele, futhi ubahloniphe. Lolu suku, olugubha ubuhlakani, amandla, nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu abasha, luhlobene nokugqugquzela impumelelo futhi luthuthukise izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kusebenza ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa nakuba ubukhona bayo bukhona ezindaweni ezithile, umoya wayo usakazeke kakhulu. Uhlelo lweSuku lwaBasha luhlelwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Ngonyaka, lo mkhosi ubungama-29 kuMfumfu, ube nomoya opholile, ungena eminyakeni eminingi yokugubha leli suku. Izikhumbuzo ezihlukahlukene zafakwa ohlelweni, kufaka phakathi imicimbi yokukhuluma, imiqhudelwano, nemikhosi yokudansa, ukuze kuhlonishwe futhi kuvezwe ubuchwepheshe, ubuciko nemfundo. Kuleli sonto, umkhosi uqale ngephuzu lokukhuluma, okwakuholwa uMnumzane Thulani Zulu, umfundisi ophumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wemfundo. UThulani uvuselele abasha ngokukhuluma ngezifundo ezibalulekile empilweni, ezibandakanya ukubaluleka kokufunda, ukusebenza kanzima, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Izinkanyezi zomculo zabeziqhakambisa umoya wokujabula, zenza izingoma ezithandwayo ukuze kuzuzwe ukuvuselela umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziningi zanikela ngezikhumbuzo nokuxhaswa komphakathi. Khona-ke, izindawo zokuqeqesha zazikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zandisa ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhlangene nokuxhaswa kwezinhlelo zokufundisa, okuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze abasha baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Ngokusho kwezifundo ezitholakele, uSuku lwaBasha ubonakaliswe njengomhlahlandlela wokuphumelela kwabasha. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokuxhumana, izinkulumo-mpikiswano, kanye nemicimbi yokugcina izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngempumelelo, zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuphinde kuthekelelwe ukuba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, kuqhakambisa isithunzi sentsha. Uphakathi lwezokuxhumana lube nesandla esikhulu ekukhuthazeni umkhosi. Amathuluzi wezokuxhumana, afana ne-Facebook, Twitter, kanye ne-Instagram, adlulisa ulwazi ngalesi sikhathi esikhethekile. Lokhu kuvumela abasha ukuthi babonise ubuciko babo, benze izithombe ezikhangayo, futhi baxhumane nabantu abavela kwezinye izindawo. Umoya wokukhuthaza abasha ubonakala ungapheli, njengoba izikhangiso ezahlukene zezinkampani nazo ziqhakambisa uSuku lwaBasha, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe khona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubekile nokuhlonipha abasha ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Izikhumbuzo zefilosofi, ezicacisa ngempumelelo, zakhishwa ezikoleni, zibe nomthelela ekukhuthazeni abasha ukuba bazibandakanye. Lokhu kuhlangene nemikhosi yezenzakalo, efana nemikhosi yokuhlukaniswa kwamaBasha, eyenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo nengxoxo ezwakalayo. Ukuphendula kwezakhamuzi kuSuku lwaBasha kubonisa ukuthi leli suku lihamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla. Abantu abasha bazithola bekhululekile, bejabule, futhi bedlula ezivumelwaneni zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi isiko lethu linamandla okuphila, futhi ubuchwepheshe bethu buyasisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obufanele phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuphetha, uSuku lwaBasha awusizi nje kuphela ekwakheni isithunzi somphakathi wethu, kodwa ubuye uveze impilo ebumbene yabasha. Uhlanga lwethu lufanele ukujabuliswa, futhi uSuku lwaBasha lufanekisela umoya ophilayo wothando, ubumbano, kanye nempumelelo. Njengoba sazi ukuthi abasha bethu bangamaqhawe, kulindeleke ukuthi umoya lo uhanjiswe ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Lokhu kudinga ukugcinwa, ukuhlonishwa, nokuxhaswa, ukuze sikwazi ukubona isizwe esiqinile, esiyingqayizivele.
Ukubhujiswa Kwenziwa Ngenxa YeZimayini Umbuzo 1: Yini edala ukubhujiswa kwemvelo ngenxa yezimayini? Ukubhujiswa kwemvelo okubangelwa izimayini kuqala ngenxa yezinqubo zokumba nokuhlaziya umhlaba ukuze kutholakale izinto ezinjengogesi, uwoyela, namaminerali. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuhamba kwemithombo yemvelo, okukhuphula amathuba okukhukhuleka kwemithambo, ukonakala kwemifula, nokushintsha kwemvelo jikelele. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokumba izimayini? Izimayini ziqhuba phambili umnotho wezindawo ezitholakala kuzo. Zenza kube lula ukuthola amaminerali adingekayo embonini, futhi zandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Lezi zinzuzo, nakuba zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela efanele, kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi azilimazi imvelo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkinga ezihlobene nokubhujiswa kwemvelo? Ukukhula kwezindawo ezitholakalayo kuholela ekuphileni okuncishisiwe kwemvelo. Izimayini zishiya emhlabathini izinsalela ezinzima, ukuchithwa kwezinsiza, kanye nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni zokudla nezinye izinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabanye abathile ukuthola izinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo 4: Umthelela wezokungcebeleka ungakanani? Umthelela wezokungcebeleka ubalulekile. Uma izimayini zisebenza kahle, zingakhuphula umoya ophathekayo, okwandisa izinga lokushisa emhlabeni. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, okwenza kube nomthelela ongemuhle empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala eduze. Umbuzo 5: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalokhu? Ukukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga kusisiza siqonde indlela izinto ezihamba ngayo emhlabeni. Kudingeka izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela imvelo, ukuze izinqubo zokumba izimayini zibe nezinzuzo ngaphandle kokulimaza indawo. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi sikhulisa umnotho ngaphandle kokuchitha umhlaba. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izixazululo ezikhona ukuze kugwenywe lokhu? Kunoma yisiphi isimo, kufanele siqale ngokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimayini zisebenza kuphela emigqeni ethile, futhi zithole izitifiketi ezihambisana nemigomo yokuvikela imvelo. Ukuze sithuthukise ubuhlakani bemvelo, kufanele sihloniphe izinqubo ezikhona. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe kunezinyathelo ezenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe imvelo? Yebo, kunezinyathelo eziningi ezenzakalayo ezweni elithile. Izinyathelo ezifana nezifundo zabantu ngezinqubo zemvelo nokubamba izinkulumo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yendawo kunciphisa umthelela wezizimayini. Ukuqinisekisa imithetho ethile yokuhlola imiphumela yemigwaqo yezezimali emhlabeni, kungenza kube lula ukuveza izinyathelo eziphuma ezindabeni zomphakathi. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi kahle ngalesi sihloko? Abantu badinga ulwazi ukuze baqonde imiphumela emihle nehlupha yokumba izimayini. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi benza izinqumo eziphusile, ezivikelekile, nezinomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe abantu bangaqhamuka kanjani nezinqumo ezifanele? Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangafunda ngokubambisana nezikhungo ezithinta izimayini nezemvelo. Ukuhamba emihlanganweni, ukuhlola izikhungo, nokuqhubekisela phambili izikhumbuzo, kungenza abantu babe nomthelela omuhle esizweni futhi basize ukugcina imvelo ilawulwa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayilungisa ukuze sithole ibhalansi phakathi kokuthuthukiswa nezokuvikela imvelo? Ukuze sithole ibhalansi, kubalulekile ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabathintekayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuqoqeni imizamo yokuphila enempilo, kugxile ekusebenzeni komphakathi, nasezindaweni zokuhlala nezothando lwemvelo. Umphakathi ungathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana nokwakha izinqubo ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngendlela ehlelekile. Isiphetho: Ukukhuluma ngalokhu kusho ukuvula umnyango wezinkinga ezinzima ezithinta imvelo. Kubalulekile ukuhamba kancane, silandela izinyathelo eziphephile ukuze sivikele umhlaba nempilo yethu. Uma sithatha izinqumo ezicacile, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza eziphilayo.
Ezokukhangisa: Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini NakuMakhasimende Ezokukhangisa, noma advertising, ziwumkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Uhlelo lokukhangisa luhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene zokwazisa, ukukhuthaza, nokukhanga amakhasimende, ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo. Umgomo omkhulu wezokukhangisa uwukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okukhulu ngemikhiqizo ethile, kukhuthazwe ukuthengwa, futhi kuncishiswe umkhankaso wokuncintisana. Isigaba sokuqala sokuhlola ezokukhangisa siqala ngokuqonda imvelaphi yalesi sikhala. Ezokukhangisa ziqale zaba khona ngesikhathi sokuhweba, lapho abathengisi babengadinga izindlela zokwazisa abantu ngempahla abahlinzekayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izindlela zokukhangisa zazilula futhi zifaka phakathi izikhangiso ezibhaliwe, izithombe, kanye nezinkulumo zomlomo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izindlela zokukhangisa zathuthuka zaya emhlabeni we-digital, lapho izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zifinyelele kubathengi abaningi. Okwamanje, ezokukhangisa zifaka phakathi iziteshi eziningi, njengezikhangiso zomsakazo, ezemidlalo, ezokuxhumana, nezikhangiso ze-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhluka kweziteshi kukhombisa ukuthi abathengisi badinga ukuqonda izitayela nezifiso zabathengi ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela imikhankaso yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze kuqondwe kahle izidingo zabathengi, izinkanyezi zomkhiqizo, kanye nezimo zemakethe. Isigaba esibalulekile sokukhangisa siwokwakha imiyalezo esebenzayo. Imiyalezo kufanele ibe nomthelela, icacile, futhi ihambisane nezidingo zabathengi. Ukuze imiyalezo ibe neqhaza, kufanele ibonise izinzuzo zomkhiqizo, ikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi komkhiqizo nomthengi, futhi ibonise indlela umkhiqizo ungathuthukisa ngayo impilo yomthengi. Lokhu kudinga ubuciko obukhulu bokuhlela, ukwakha, nokuhlola imiyalezo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyafinyelela futhi iyathinta. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde imithetho nemigomo ethinta ezokukhangisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, yokwethembeka, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abathengi. Ukuze kube nokwethenjelwa, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izikhangiso zazo aziphuli imithetho, futhi zihlala zihlola umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini ethile. Ukuhlonipha umphakathi nokugqugquzela izimiso zokuziphatha eziyinqaba kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle somkhiqizo. Umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini ungahluka, kuncike kumkhankaso owakhiwe. Kwezinye izimo, ezokukhangisa zingaba nomthelela omuhle, zikhuthaze abantu ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo ethile, zikhuthaze umnotho, futhi zikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi. Nokho, uma ezokukhangisa zisetshenziswa ngendlela engafanele, zingaholela ekutheni abantu bathenge imikhiqizo engadingekile, okungaholela ekudluliseni izinkolelo ezingezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlela imikhankaso yazo ngendlela ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa umthelela omkhulu ezokukhangisa. Izinkampani zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezokuxhumana ukuze zifinyelele kubathengi. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha okubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi abathengisi baqonde kahle izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abathengisi kufanele bakhuthaze ukuxhumana okuvulekile, baphendule imibuzo, futhi baphendule izidingo zabathengi. Ekugcineni, ezokukhangisa zidlala indima ebalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Zihlinzeka ngezindlela zokwazisa, ukukhuthaza, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinkampani kufanele ziqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi zihlale zihlola umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini. Ngale ndlela, ezokukhangisa zingaba yinsika yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, okhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu.
Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika libe nendaba ebalulekile emphakathini, njengoba izinqumo ezithathwe uhulumeni ziqhubekile nokuthinta izigidi zabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle lesi simo, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi izinga lentela sisho izinga elisetshenziselwa ukukhokha intela kumholo, ezentela zokuthengiselana, kanye nezinto zokusebenza. Kuqala, sithola ukuthi izinga lentela yomuntu siqu ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Izinhlaka zikanxusa zihlala ziqwashisa abantu ukuthi intela ethile iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi, njengemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinselelo zokuntuleka kwemali nemithombo yezimali zihlala zikhona. Nokho, izinga lentela elikhulayo lingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kwaziswa ngengqikithi yokuthi uma izinga lentela lenyuka, umphakathi ubhekana nezindleko ezengeziwe. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bacabangele kabusha indlela abaphila ngayo, bese kudingeka izindlela ezintsha zokuphila ukuze bakwazi ukukhokha izindleko. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo ezahlukene ukuze athuthukise izinga lentela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqhamuka ezindaweni eziphansi. Kukho imizamo yokunciphisa izinga lentela kumholo ophansi, ukuze abantu bahlale bezithokozisa futhi baphile kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, akusiyona nje impendulo yokuthi izinga lentela lenyuka noma lehlisa, kodwa kumele sihlolisise imithelela ehambisana nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkinga zokungalingani, lapho abanye abantu besaba ukuncipha kwamathuba ngenxa yokwanda kwentela, kuyilapho abanye besebenzisa lezi zinguquko njengezindlela zokuzithuthukisa. Izinsuku zokuqala zika-2023 zafika nezinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta izinga lentela. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bamaNingizimu Afrika bahlala behlonipha izimiso ezikhona, uhulumeni wenze imizamo yokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezinga lentela. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlola nokukhipha intela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izigameko zomphakathi, ezifana nezinkulumo zokwakha ubumba phakathi kwezinkampani, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezwi elinothile ekuphakamiseni izinga lentela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi izinga lentela alinakho ukufana phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokho kudinga isixazululo esinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi izinga lentela lihlala ligubungele izimpilo zabo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abasha, ikakhulukazi, badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhokha intela ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele emisebenzini yabo nasemphakathini, futhi kube nethuba lokukhulisa izinga labo lemali. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga ezikhona, umphakathi unokuthile okukhuthazayo. Imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ibalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu baphila kahle zikhuthaza ukufunda nokwaziswa ngezinto ezibhekene nezinga lentela. Ekugcineni, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhokha intela akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwemali, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ohlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uvulelekile ekuxoxeni ngalezi zindaba, futhi usebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela eliphusile nelithuthukayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula nelibumbene eNingizimu Afrika.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Umsebenzi Wokuphepha Kwendawo Nokuphila Komuntu Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo yazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo. Kuwo wonke umhlaba, itholakala emithonjeni ehlukene, kufaka phakathi izifudlana, imifula, nezindawo eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukene ezifana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, imikhuba yokuphila, kanye nokungcoliswa, ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile sekuba yinkinga ezweni lonke, futhi ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo kakhulu. Ukwazi ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuqhubekayo kokuhlelwa kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. NgokweZinhlelo Zenkampani Yezempilo Yomphakathi, amanzi ahlanzekile ayasiza ekugwemeni izifo ezithathelwana emanzini, okwenza kube nezidingo eziqinile zokwenziwa kohlaka lokuphathwa kwamanzi. Izinhlaka ezisemthethweni kumele ziqinise imizamo yokuphatha amanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, kanye nokwehlisa ubugebengu bokungcolisa. Ukuze kuzuze imiphakathi, abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile akupheleli kuphela ekuphileni kahle, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, okusikhombisa ukuthi inhlanzeko yamanzi ibalulekile ekulondolozweni kwemiphakathi futhi ibaluleke kakhulu emithonjeni yemvelo. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ayancikile kuphela kumaphuzu okutholakala, kodwa futhi ivumela inkululeko yokuphila. Ukuze ubheke lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithi: "Amanzi ahlanzekile anika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo." Lokhu kusho ukunciphisa izingozi zokugula, ukukhulisa ukwandisa umkhiqizo kanye nezinga lempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ezindaweni ezinezinsiza eziphansi, lapho kwenziwa khona izinhlelo ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukwakhiwa kwemithombo esebenzayo, izivande zokuhlanza amanzi, nemithala yokwelapha, kuzoletha umphumela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezinamandla zokuqhakambisa indawo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu endimeni yokugcina amanzi futhi nesimo sezulu esinempilo. Ukuze uhlole ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphila, kudingeka umphakathi owodwa, lapho abantu baphila ngokuhlanganyela, bejabulela ubuhlobo bokuthola izinsiza ezihambisanayo, ngaphezu kokukwazi ukuhlanzeka kwemvelo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlala futsi lubalulekile ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba ubhekene nezinqoba ezinzima ezihlobene nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Izinhlaka ezithintekayo kumele ziqonde ukuthi imiphumela yalezi zinguquko ithinta ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezibuthakathaka zomphakathi. Ukuze sithathe izinyathelo eziphathekayo, kufanele sithathele phezulu ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngezindlela zokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukuvuselela imithombo engcolile, nokugwema uhlelo lwezokuthutha olubi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokunqoba ezimweni ezinzima ezibhekene nezinsiza zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula kakhulu ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kwempilo yamanzi. Izindlela ezithile ezifana nezithuthi eziphumelelayo zifanele zisetshenziswe ukuphatha izinzuzo zamakhaya. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu beqondiswa kahle, imiphakathi ithola amathuba okuphila akhula, futhi amanzi ahlanzekile avikela abantu ezinhlekeleleni eziningi. Ukukhulisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza, ukwabelana ngezinsiza, nokwakha ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukile, kudinga ukhethe; lesi simo kufakazela ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kokuphila kwethu nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ekugcineni, amanzi ahlanzekile anikeza ithuba lokwenza kahle. Imiphakathi edinga amanzi ahlanzekile, kufanele iqaphele ukuthi onke amalungu kufanele athathe isinyathelo sokuphila kahle. Iphuzu elisemqoka ukuthi lowo msebenzi awuphathwa yihhovisi lempilo kuphela, kodwa wonke umuntu unendima okumele iyigcine, futhi kumele kuxhaswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ahlinzekwa, avikelwe, futhi anqandwa ekungcolisweni. Njengoba besiphila ezimweni ezinzima, kudinga ukuba sibe nezindlela eziphumelela, siziphe izinsiza ukuze sibe nempilo enempilo, sigcine futhi sakhe umhlaba onempilo, onezinga eliphezulu lempilo kuzo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Inselele Enkulu Emfundweni Yethu Ngokubheka isimo semfundo ezikoleni zethu, kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi ukushoda kothisha sekuphawulwe njengensuku zonke ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuphazamisa imfundo yabafundi, kwenze kube nzima ukufeza izinjongo zemfundo eziphakeme. Kunemibono eminingi evezwa ngabantu abahlukene mayelana nenkinga yokushoda kothisha, kanye nezimbangela zayo, ezinzima kakhulu. Izinsuku eziningi zifike zashintsha isimo sokufunda. Abazali, othisha, kanye nabaholi bezemfundo baveza ukujula kokukhathazeka kwabo. Uthisha, uNkk. Zulu, usemkhulu eMnyangweni wesifunda, uthi: "Siyahluleka ukuhlinzeka abafundi bethu ngoqeqesho oluhle ngenxa yokushoda kothisha. Kukhona abantwana abaninzi abangafundi kahle, futhi lokhu kuyiqiniso elinzima." Lokhu kubonisa impilo yangempela yezikole, lapho izifundo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngothisha abaningi ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi olufanele. Izizathu zokushoda kothisha ziningi. Okokuqala, izinkinga zokuhola zikhulu. Abantu abaningi bahamba phambili bezama ukufuna amabhizinisi angcono, okuholela ekushodeni kwabantu abaneziqu ezidingekayo emfundweni. Ngokwe-Statistics South Africa, umkhakha wezokufundisa ubhekana nezinselele zokukhula kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha bahlale emsebenzini. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho imfundo ihamba phambili ngaphandle kokuthola abantu abaneziqu ezithuthukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezikoleni nakho kudinga ukunakwa. Izikole eziningi azinazo izinsiza ezanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha benze umsebenzi wabo kahle. Uthisha, uMnu. Nkosi, uthi: "Siyamangala uma sikhumbula ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zezifundo kwenziwa ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthi abafundi bethu bakhule." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi udinga ukuba nemithombo ethile ukuze udlule phambili, kodwa uma le mithombo ingekho, umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kokushoda kothisha, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nezinga lokuhlala kothisha. Ukuze othisha bahlale ezikoleni ezithile, kudingeka izimo ezinhle zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindlu, izindleko zokuphila, kanye nezidingo ezingokomoya. Uma othisha behlupheka ngenhlalakahle, kunzima ukuba bahlale bebambile emsebenzini. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuvuma izimfuno zempilo yabafundi, njengoba kufanele benze umsebenzi omningi, kodwa bengekho kuleso simo. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, kunezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Uhlelo lwezikhuthazo zokufundisa lungasiza ekuheheni abantu abasha emkhakheni wezokufundisa. Uhlelo olunikeza izikhuthazo kubafundi abathola iziqu eziphezulu kungenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazibandakanye emfundweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ezikhuthaza othisha ukuba bahlale ezikoleni ezithile zingasiza ekuvimbeleni ukushoda kothisha. Ukwaziwa komsebenzi wothisha kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngaphandle kwabo, akukhona ukusungulwa kwemfundo ethuthukisiwe. Uhlelo lwezokuphatha lufanele ukwakha izinhlelo ezivumela othisha ukuba basebenze kahle, futhi baqhubeke nokukhula emkhakheni wabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zemfundo eqhubekayo, izikhuthazo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akuyona nje inkinga yendawo ethile, kodwa kuyinkinga ebhekelele wonke umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ubuholi bezemfundo, uhulumeni, nabazali basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Ukukhulisa izinga lemfundo kuzodinga ukukhipha izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nokwakha isimo sokuphila esikahle kothisha. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizoba negalelo elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi jikelele, futhi sigcine imfundo yethu iphakeme. Ukugqugquzela ukusebenza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuvimbela ukushoda kothisha, futhi sizothuthukisa ikusasa lethu. Uthando nemizamo yethu kufanele kube ngaphezu kokucabanga; kumele kube yisisekelo sokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu zempumelelo.
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Ndlovu UThandiwe Ndlovu, ophuma emphakathini waseMpumalanga, ungumfazi ophilela imvelo, onothando, futhi ohlonipha konke okukhona emhlabeni. Uthandiwe, odabuka emndenini ophilayo ngokuhlonipha imvelo, ukhombisa uthando olujulile ngezinto eziphilayo. Uthanda ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinhle, lapho athola khona ukuthula nokubona ubuhle bendalo. Uthando lukaThandiwe lwemvelo luqala ngesikhathi esencane, lapho akhumbula khona izinsuku ezishisayo emaphandleni, ebuka izinyoni ezibhalela izinkanyezi emoyeni. Imvelo yaba yikhaya lakhe, futhi uThandiwe wayejabulela amaqabunga ahlaza, izimbali ezizimele, nezinyoni ezihamba phansi. Lezi zinto zaziyizikhumbuzo ezinhle, zikhumbuza ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi kanye nezinguquko zemvelo. Njengoba eminyakeni edlule, uThandiwe waqhubeka nokuhlola imvelo, efunda ngayo ngendlela ehlukile. Uthanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezindaweni ezihlanzekile, efuna ukuzwa izwi lemvelo. Izinyoni ezihamba phansi, umoya opholile, nezihlahla ezinkulu zihlala zikhumbuza uThandiwe ukuthi imvelo iyisisekelo sokuphila. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuvikela imvelo, eqhuba imikhankaso yokufundisa abantu ngokuqonda nokuhlonipha imvelo. UThandiwe ungumfundi onothando lokuthuthukisa ulwazi lwakhe ngemvelo. Uthanda ukufunda izincwadi eziphathelene nemvelo, ezimfundisa ngempilo yezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ubuye abe neqhaza ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokuhlola imvelo, ezihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze bazihlanganise nemvelo. Uhlanga lwezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane zikhombisa ubuhle obungapheli, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yalokho. UThandiwe ubonisa indlela yokuphila ehlonipha imvelo. Ubuye abe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini, efundisa abantu ukuthi imvelo iyinsika yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokufundisa abanye ngothando nemvelo, ethokozisa abanye ngezikhathi ezinhle. Ubuhle bemvelo buhlale bukhanya emhlabeni wakhe, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yemvelo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezimanga Kwakukhona isikhathi esithile, emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, lapho abantu bejabulile ngokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Phakathi kwezinsuku ezinjalo, kwavela uhlelo olusha olwakha izimanga eziningi — iChatGPT. Lokhu kwakungelula, ngoba abantu babekhuluma ngalesi sithombe esisha sokuxhumana, esingekho emhlabeni wabo. Uhlelo lwakha izimpendulo eziphusile, lukhuluma njengomuntu, futhi luhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile. Isahluko 2: Ukuthola Uhlelo UThandi, umfundisi ophumelelayo, wayehlala edolobheni elincane. Wayenothando olukhulu lwezobuchwepheshe, futhi wayehlala efuna izindlela zokwenza ukufundisa kube mnandi. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi esebenzisa i-inthanethi, wathola iChatGPT. Wazithokozisa kakhulu, wacabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzomnika ithuba lokuxhumana nabafundi bakhe ngendlela engakaze ibonwe. Waqala ukufunda ngalesi sithombe esisha, wathola ukuthi singasiza ekuphenduleni imibuzo, ekubhaleni izincwadi, nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okukhuluma. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlola iChatGPT Ngemva kokuthola ulwazi oluningi, uThandi wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame iChatGPT. Wavula uhlelo, wathumela umbuzo wokuqala: "Ungangitshela ngani ngempilo?" Ngemva kwemizuzwana embalwa, wathola impendulo ecacile, enembile, futhi ethokozisayo. Wazizwa ejabule, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buveza izimpendulo ezinhle. Waqhubeka nokuhlola, ethumela imibuzo ehlukene, futhi iChatGPT yaphendula ngokushesha, yenza uThandi azizwe sengathi ubambisene nomngane omusha. Isahluko 4: Ukufundisa Ngendlela Entsha UThandi wathola ukuthi iChatGPT ingasiza abafundi bakhe ngendlela engakaze ibonwe. Waqala ukufaka uhlelo ekilasini, wabelana nabafundi bakhe ngalesi sithombe esisha. Abafundi bahlala behlakaniphile, bejabule, futhi bephendula imibuzo ngendlela engajwayelekile. UThandi wathola ukuthi iChatGPT yenza ukufunda kube mnandi, futhi abafundi bakhe baqala ukujabulisa kakhulu. Bafunda izifundo ezinzima, kodwa ngeChatGPT, konke kwaba lula. Isahluko 5: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Nokho, njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenzisa iChatGPT, waqala ukubona izinkinga. Abafundi bakhe babebonisa ukuncika kakhulu kulolu hlelo, bengahambisani nezifundo zabo. UThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi kufanele abakhuthaze ukuba basebenzise iChatGPT njengomsebenzi wesithathu, hhayi njengomthombo ophambili. Waqala ukufundisa abafundi bakhe ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephikisana nemibono, bahlola izimpendulo, futhi bazi ukuthi iChatGPT iyinsiza, hhayi umphumela wokugcina. Isahluko 6: Ukukhula Kwezimpendulo Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi iChatGPT iyakhula. Uhlelo lwakha izimpendulo eziphusile, luthuthukisa amakhono okukhuluma, futhi luhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile. Abafundi bakhe baqala ukufunda ukuthi iChatGPT ingabathuthukisa, kodwa kufanele bahlale beqaphela. UThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi kufanele bahlale bephikisana nemibono, bahlola izimpendulo, futhi bazi ukuthi iChatGPT iyinsiza, hhayi umphumela wokugcina. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano phakathi kwabafundi, lapho bexoxa khona ngezifundo zabo, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bexhumana neChatGPT. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokubambisana, futhi abafundi bakhe baqala ukujabulisa kakhulu. UThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi kufanele bahlale bephikisana nemibono, bahlola izimpendulo, futhi bazi ukuthi iChatGPT iyinsiza, hhayi umphumela wokugcina. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waphumelela ekufundiseni, futhi iChatGPT yaba umngane wakhe omkhulu, emncedisa ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi bakhe.
Izimayini: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Izimayini, noma mining, yindlela ebalulekile yokukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni, ezifana nezinsimbi, amalahle, nezinsiza zemvelo. Le mboni inezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi ibhekene nezingqinamba ezithile ezidinga ukucutshungulwa. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nezimayini, ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo Zezimayini Okokuqala, izimayini zidlala indima enkulu emnothweni wezwe. Ukukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi, okwenza kube nezisebenzi eziningi ezithola imiholo. Lokhu kuholela ekukhuleni komnotho, njengoba abantu bethola imali yokuphila. Umsebenzi wezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezimboni zidinga lezi zinsiza, futhi lokho kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Okwesibili, izimayini zenza kube nokwabelana ngempumelelo kwezimali. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezisebenza emayini zikhokha izintela ezinkulu, okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi, okwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimayini zenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njengoba izinkampani zidinga izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi wazo ube lula futhi uphumelele. Izingqinamba Nezingozi Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Izimayini zibuye zibe nezingozi eziningi. Okokuqala, imiphumela yemvelo iyinkinga enkulu. Ukuvuna izinsiza kudala umonakalo omkhulu emithonjeni yamanzi, emhlabathini, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu izakhamuzi ezihlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba. Ukungcola okukhishwa emayini, njengamagesi nemfucumfucu, kubangela izinkinga zempilo kubantu abaseduze. Okwesibili, izimayini zidalela abantu izimo ezinzima zokusebenza. Imisebenzi emayini ivamise ukuba yingozi, futhi izisebenzi zihlala zibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Ukushisa, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezingozi zokuhlaselwa yizinto ezinjengemishini yokumba, konke lokhu kudala izimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zikhokhe izindleko ezinkulu zokuvikela izisebenzi, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi, lokhu akwenziwanga ngendlela efanele. Ukubheka Phambili Ukuze sithuthukise izimayini, kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphucula izinqubo zokusebenza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo emvelweni. Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokumba ezihlanzekile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela emibi iyancishiswa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuvikela izisebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele nokuphathwa kwezimo zokusebenza kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zikhululekile futhi ziphephile emsebenzini wazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini, okukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, izimayini zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi. Zenza kube nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, kodwa futhi zibangela umonakalo emvelweni nezingozi ezinkulu zokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphucula le mboni, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu nemvelo. Ngokubambisana, singathuthukisa izimayini zethu ukuze zibe yinzuzo kubo bonke, futhi sithuthukise izimpilo zethu ngendlela ehloniphekile.
Umbiko Ngokuqhubeka Kwenkululeko YaseNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Inkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika ibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezwe. Iphakathi kwezinto eziphawulekayo ezashintsha ubuso bezwe, ikakhulukazi phakathi nekhulu lama-20. Le nkululeko ibonisa isifiso sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika sokuphila ngaphandle kokucwaswa, ukungalingani, nokuhlukunyezwa. Umbiko lo uzogxila emlandweni, ezicini ezahlukene zenkululeko, kanye nezimpumelelo ezitholakele. Umlando Wokulwa Nenkululeko Umlando wenkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika uqala ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwempucuko yesikhumbuzo, lapho abantu abamnyama baqala ukubona ububi bokuhlukaniswa. Ngemva kokutholwa kokuzimela kwaseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1961, izinhlelo zokuhlukaniswa kwabantu, ezaziwa ngokuthi yi-Apartheid, zathuthukiswa. Lezi zinhlelo zashiya abantu abamnyama, abamhlophe, nabanye abantu bezizinda ezahlukene behlukaniswe, bephila ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi bephathwa ngendlela ehlukile. Ngalesi sikhathi, izigameko eziningi zenzeka. I-ANC (African National Congress) yasungulwa ngo-1912, futhi yabe isiba yinsika yokulwa ne-Apartheid. UNelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, waba yisithonjana sokulwa nalesi simo. Ukuboshwa kwakhe ngo-1962 kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, esakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphakame balwe. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkululeko Ukulwa nenkululeko akuzange kube lula. Izinhlangano eziningi, njenge-ANC, i-PAC (Pan Africanist Congress), ne-SACP (South African Communist Party), zaba neqhaza elikhulu. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlakulela imikhankaso ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinsuku zokuzindla, imibhikisho, nokuphikisana ngenkani. Umkhankaso we-Defiance Campaign ngo-1952, ophakanyiswe nguMandela, wawusiza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba baphikise izinqubomgomo ze-Apartheid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhikisho efana neSharpeville Massacre ngo-1960, lapho abantu abangu-69 babulawa, yakhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokulwa. Lezi zenzakalo zashiya umthelela omkhulu, zakhuthaza umhlaba wonke ukuba ubheke eNingizimu Afrika. Izinguquko Zomhlaba Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomhlaba nazo zaba nomthelela. Ukuqhamuka kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili kwashintsha umbono wabantu ngezobulungiswa. Izwe laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukubona ukwesekwa okuvela kwamanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni ye-1980. Izwe elijulile elalikhuluma ngezobulungiswa, njenge-United Nations, laqala ukucela ukuthi izwe laseNingizimu Afrika lenze izinguquko. Ukufika Kwenkululeko Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokulwa, inkululeko yafika ngo-1994. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile, lapho uNelson Mandela, emva kokuphuma ejele, waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweDemocracy, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, enelungelo lokuvota. Ukhetho lwango-1994 lwaluyisigameko esikhulu, lwabhalisa umlando omusha. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Zamanje Nokho, nakuba inkululeko ibonakala, izithiyo zikhona. Ukuhlukaniswa komnotho, ububha, nezinkinga zokungalingani ziyaqhubeka. Abantu abaninzi basakhumbula ubuhlungu be-Apartheid, futhi izinkinga zempilo, imfundo, nezokusebenza ziyaqhubeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi inkululeko iyatholakala kubo bonke. Isiphetho Inkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika iyisifundo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukuhlanganisa amandla abo ukuze balwe nezinhlelo ezimbi. Iphinde ibonise ubuhlakani, ukuzinikela, nokubambisana kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Nakuba kukhona izinselelo, umhlaba kufanele uqhubeke uvuselela umoya wokubambisana, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkululeko iyaphila, ibalulekile, futhi iyatholakala kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi izifiso zabantu zikhona, futhi izifiso zenkululeko zihlala zikhanya.
Ama-Drone: Ikhanya Elisha Esibhakabhakeni Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kungani ama-drone athandwa kangaka? Hhayi, akusikho nje ngoba amaningi abantu bayakuthanda ukukhangisa ama-drone, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuthi anomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ngabe singaqala ngempela kulezi zinto ezithokozisayo? Ama-drone, noma abafundi baqala ukuwazi, ayizinto eziphakanyiswa emoyeni ngengcindezi, futhi eziningi zazo zenza imisebenzi emangalisayo. Ukuthola ukuthi ama-drone aqala njani, kudingeka uhlole emuva eholweni lesayensi. Kuze kube sekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, ama-drone ayekwaziwa kakhulu njengamathuluzi ezempi. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, abantu baqala ukufuna ukusebenzisa ama-drone ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kukhona abanye asebevele sebephendule ama-drone abe yizithombe zamakhamera, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izithombe ezinhle nezibukwayo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi lapho ukuthola impahla kunzima khona. Ukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, ama-drone asebekhula ngokushesha. Manje, ungathola ama-drone angakwazi ukufunda, akwazi ukuzihlanganisa nemithwalo eminingi, futhi ahamba phambili nawe. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuziqalela imikhakha emisha, njengokuthula, ukufothela izenzakalo, noma ukwenza ucwaningo lwezindawo. Ngabe ubungakuboni lokhu? Ngokwenyani, abanye abantu bathola ama-drone angama-robotic, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu emsebenzini wabo. Kulabo abathanda ukuvivinya amathuba, ama-drone angumngani omuhle. Ukusuka kwezemidlalo zokusho, njengezincwadi zemidiya, ziqhubekile ukusabalalisa amathuba okuthola imiphumela emihle. Kuzwakala kahle!. Cabanga nje uma ungaba nesibonakaliso ngezinyoni, ungathola amahlathi angama-4000, uqaphela izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu. Lokhu kudala umbono wokuthi ama-drone angaphezu kwempahla; bangama-ambasada eqiniso bezokuxhumana nemvelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule nezinkinga eziyisipesheli ezivela kule mikhakha. Ukukhiqizwa kwama-drone okulungile kufanele kube namathuluzi amasha, amalungelo, nemigomo emisha. Uxhaso lwezomthetho luhlala lukhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nocwaningo lwemithetho, njengokuhlalisana nezindawo eziningi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwenzeni kube lula ukuzwa, kodwa futhi kusemqoka ukugcina ubunikazi balo mkhakha wokucwaninga. Mhlawumbe, sizogxila emiphumeleni yamadrone ezindaweni ezahlukeneyo. Njengoba ama-drone eza Nokuvikela, ezokulima, nezokuthuthukisa izidingo zabantu, baphinde babhekane nokunciphisa ubungozi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukusiza izifundazwe ezinozothando. kulezo zinto eziphathekayo. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okukhanya kakhulu, njengoba ama-drone ahlangabezana nezingozi ezilandelayo. Ngokwandisa umehluko, ama-drone khona lapho akwazi ukudala izingozi, ikakhulukazi uma ezinganeni, ezindaweni zokuhambela, zikhona. Lokhu kululekile, abanye abathandi be-drone baye bayothola imiphumela yokugcina. Njengoba abantu beqala ukusebenzisa ama-drone ngeminjanjalo emikhulu, bangase bafake izinhlelo ezithile zokuqapha nokwazisa ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle. Okokugcina, singakucacisa ukuthi ama-drone, njengomshini esematheni, aletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kubalulekile siqaphele iziNgxenye zawo ezithokozisayo nezezi. Njengoba sithandazela ukuba kanye kakhulu ngeyikhumbuzo, kufanele sazi izimpilo zethu ezizothuthukiswa. Ngakho, uma usakhumbula ama-drone — hayi, akusiwe umcabango kuphela — ungabazi, ukuba neqhaza, ungabhalelwa ukuthuthukiswa nokuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona. Uhlanganyela kumongameli, kulungile!
Amabhange Amabhange, njengemikhiqizo ebalulekile emnothweni, ahlale edlala indima enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuhweba, lapho abantu babebhadalela izimpahla ngezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, amabhange abe yinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, amabhange ahlinzeka ngesevisi ezahlukene ezinjengezimali, ukonga, nezinsizakalo zokuhweba, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amabhange athuthukile futhi ahlale ethuthukisa izinsizakalo zawo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabantu. Namuhla, sinamabhange amaningi, kusukela kumabhange amakhulu ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibanzi, kuya kumabhange amancane ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amabhange akhula ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi ahlale ebheke phambili ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bathola okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange anendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho. Ngaphandle kokugcina izimali, amabhange anikeza imali yokubolekwa, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu nabezindaba baphumelele ezinhlelweni zabo zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkampani, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, nokwandiswa kwemikhakha ehlukene yomnotho. Amabhange, ngakho-ke, akhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, futhi ahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphila kwabantu. Ukwengeza, amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ngamabhange, abantu bangakwazi ukonga imali, baphathe izikweletu, futhi baqonde kahle izindleko zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Amabhange ahlinzeka ngolwazi, izeluleko, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa ukuqonda kwabantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhula emabhange. Namuhla, amabhange anikeza izinsizakalo eziku-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuthokozisa, njengoba abantu bengakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kalula, noma ngabe bakhulumela emsebenzini noma emakhaya. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamabhange nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe kudalile izixazululo ezithuthukile, ezithuthukisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amabhange abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula kwezinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezimali, njengezimali eziku-inthanethi, kudinga amabhange ukuba aqhubeke ethuthukisa izinsizakalo zawo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amabhange azame ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza, ukuze ahlale ethokozisa abathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko emthethweni nasezinhlelweni zomnotho zidinga ukuthi amabhange azivumelanise nezimo ezintsha, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ahlale evikelekile. Amabhange, ngaphezu kwalokho, abhekene nezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, izingozi zokweba idatha zikhula. Amabhange kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zawo ziphephile, ukuze abathengi baziqinisekise ukuthi izimali zabo ziphephile. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu kanye nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphepha. Ekugcineni, amabhange azinze emnothweni, futhi adlala indima enkulu empilweni yomuntu. Ukugcina, ukuphatha, nokuhlinzeka ngempilo yezimali, amabhange akha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indima yawo, ukuze sikwazi ukuwasebenzisa kahle. Amabhange akhuluma ngempilo yethu, futhi kufanele sihlole ubudlelwano bethu nawo, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu nempilo yomphakathi. Ngamafuphi, amabhange awekho nje kuphela njengemiphakathi yokugcina izimali, kodwa futhi njengabalingani ababalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuzigcina, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukile, amabhange akha umnotho, ahlale ethuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphusile ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle amabhange, imisebenzi yawo, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuze sithole ithuba lokuphila kahle.
Amalungelo Abantu Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni ophakathi kwezintaba, kwavela udaba oluthusayo. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayehlala nomndeni wakhe emzini ophucukile, kodwa ubuhlungu bokungabi namalungelo abahlala nabo bukhona. UThandi wayephupha ngempilo engcono, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa khona, futhi amalungelo abantu engaziswa khona. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahamba edolobheni eliseduzane, lapho abanye abantu bephila impilo ehlukile. Babebonakala bejabulile, behamba phambili, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Lokhu kwashiya uThandi ecabanga kakhulu. Wazi kahle ukuthi emzaneni wakhe, abantu abaninzi babebhekana nezinkinga ezinzima, njengokungabi namsebenzi, ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, nokungabi namathuba okufunda. Ngemuva kokubona lokhu, uThandi wanquma ukuthi kufanele akhuthaze amalungelo abantu emzaneni wakhe. Waqala ukuhamba emakhaya, wakhuluma nabantu, wabachazela ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo, futhi kufanele bawasebenzise. Wabafundisa ukuthi bonke abantu kufanele babe namathuba alinganayo, ukuthi bonke kufanele bahlonishwe, futhi ukuthi izwi labo kufanele lizwe. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu, uThandi wathola abanye abantu abavuma ukujoyina umkhankaso wakhe. Babebandakanya abantwana, abadala, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Bahlangana njalo, behlela imihlangano, baphinde bahlele izinkulumo ezazikhuthaza abanye ukuba bazi ngamalungelo abantu. Kodwa, akukaze kube lula. Kwezinye izikhathi, uThandi nabangane bakhe babebhekene nezithiyo. Abanye abantu emzaneni babengafuni ukuzwa ngalokhu, becabanga ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayizinto ezingenamsebenzi. Kodwa uThandi waba nesibindi, waqhubeka nokukhuthaza, wathola ukuthi ukungaboni kahle kwabanye akwenzi amalungelo abantu angabazweli. Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza kanzima, uThandi nozakwabo bakwazi ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu. Umcimbi wawuhloswe ukujabulisa abantu, kodwa futhi wawuwumcimbi wokukhumbuza abantu ngamalungelo abantu. Babebhalela izinkulumo, behlola izinkanyezi, futhi benza imidlalo ethokozisayo. Umphakathi waba nomdlandla, futhi abantu baqala ukuveza izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngesikhathi somcimbi, uThandi wakhuluma phambi kwabantu abaningi. Wakhumbuza bonke ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma wonke umuntu efuna ukuphila impilo enhlonipho. Wabakhuthaza ukuba baveze imizwa yabo, babeke izinkinga zabo phambili, futhi bazame ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibabhekene nazo. Ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi, umoya emzaneni waguquka. Abantu baqala ukuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi izwi likaThandi labaluleka kakhulu. Bafuna ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu engahlonishwa khona. Amalungelo abantu aba yinsika yokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. UThandi nozakwabo baqhubeka nokusebenza, bephokophelela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungisa. Ngesikhathi esithile, umphakathi wabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi amalungelo abantu angashintsha impilo. UThandi waphuma phambili, futhi waba ngumholi ohlonishwayo, owaziwa kabanzi emzaneni nakwezinye izindawo. Kodwa uThandi waqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawungekho kuphela emzaneni. Waba nesifiso sokuhamba phesheya kwezilwandle, afunde kabanzi ngamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Wafunda ukuthi kunezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nabantu ezindaweni eziningi, futhi wathola ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma abantu bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha umphakathi. Wavula amathuba, wakhuthaza abanye, futhi waba umoya ophilayo wokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Umphakathi wakhe, owawubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, waba yindawo yokuhlala enobulungisa, lapho wonke umuntu engahlonishwa khona. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqonda ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma abantu bephila ngokuhlanganyela, behloniphana, futhi bejabulela impilo yabo. Kwakungesikhathi sokuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokuphila kahle, futhi kufanele ahlonishwe njalo. UThandi, nomsebenzi wakhe, waba yisibonelo esiqinile sokuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono uma sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu.
Izikhukhula: Umthelela, Izimbangela, Nezixazululo Izikhukhula zenzeka ezindaweni eziningi emhlabeni, zidalela abantu, izilwane, nomhlaba umonakalo omkhulu. Njengoba imiphakathi ibhekana nalezi zimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuba sicabange ngalezi zikhukhula, izimbangela zazo, nemiphumela yazo, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izikhukhula zingavela ngezizathu ezahlukene. Ezinye izikhukhula zenzeka ngenxa yokwehla kwemvula okukhulu, lapho izimvula eziphakeme zenza amanzi agcwele ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imifula igcwele kakhulu, kukhuphuke amanzi, futhi kube nokukhukhula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhukhula zingavela ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokufudumala komhlaba, okwenza izimo zokukhukhula zibe zinkulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje kuphela ngenxa yezinguquko zemvelo, kodwa futhi zixhumene nokuphathwa kabi kwemvelo. Ngokubheka umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhilela izici eziningi. Okokuqala, umonakalo wezikhukhula ungaba mkhulu. Abantu bahlushwa ukulahlekelwa kwezimpahla, izindlu, nezinsiza. Imiphakathi ethola ukulahlekelwa kwezakhiwo ibhekana nenkinga yokuphila, kanti abanye bangase baphumelele ngempela ukuphuma ezindaweni zabo. Lokhu kudala imiphumela emibi, efana nezinkinga zempilo, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila. Izikhukhula zishiya abanye abantu beshiywa bephila ezimweni ezinzima, kungase kube nezinkinga zokudla, ukuhlaselwa yizifo, futhi ezikhathini eziningi, abantu bacela usizo lwezinhlelo eziphuthumayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhukhula ziba nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni. Umhlaba ubonakala uthinteka kakhulu, izitshalo zibhujiswa, izilwane ziphila ezindaweni ezihlaselwe amanzi, futhi izinsiza zemvelo zishiywa zihlushwa. Lokhu kudala ukulahleka kwezitho ezisemqoka zemvelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba imvelo ibuyisele izimo zayo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngempilo yemvelo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile kumphakathi wabantu, njengoba izinsiza zezemvelo zidingeka ukuze siqhubekele phambili. Ngakho-ke, sinesibopho sokwenza izinto ezithile ukuze sinciphise umthelela wezikhukhula. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza zamanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezivimbela amanzi, ukwenziwa kwemifula, kanye nokuphathwa kokwakha izindawo ezihlanzekile. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni. Umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zezakhamuzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kokwaziswa nokufundiswa kumphakathi kubalulekile. Abantu kufanele bazi izingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula, bazi ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani ezimeni ezinjalo. Ukuze sikhulise ukuqwashisa, izinhlelo zokufundisa zidinga ukufakwa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufaka izinyathelo eziphusile ezimweni ezinzima. Ngokuhlanganisa, izikhukhula zibangela umonakalo omkhulu empilweni yabantu, emvelweni, nakumnotho. Kodwa-ke, uma sisebenzisana, sithola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuqonda izimbangela, umthelela, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela, kungasiza umphakathi ukuba uhlale uphephile. Kumele sihlale silungiselela, sikhulise ukuqwashisa, futhi siphumelele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ngaleyondlela, singakwazi ukuqhubeka phambili, sithuthukise impilo yethu, nemvelo esiphila kuyo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke siphanda izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela, ukuze sithole isixazululo esisha sokuphila. Izikhukhula ziyinsakavukela, kepha uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, singakwazi ukuvikelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo.
iGautrain: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezokuthutha Esifundazweni SaseGauteng Isingeniso IGautrain iyinhlangano yokuthutha ebukhoma eGauteng, eNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngendlela esheshayo, ephephile, futhi ewusizo yokuhamba phakathi kwemijikelezo emikhulu yedolobha. Le nsiza ithuthukiswe ngokubambisana nohulumeni waseGauteng kanye nezinkampani ezizimele, futhi yaqhamuka njengenqubomgomo yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuthutha eziphumelelayo ngaphansi kwesimo sokukhula kwemijikelezo yedolobha. Ukwakhiwa KweGautrain Uhlelo lweGautrain lwaqala ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 2010, lapho kwavulwa imigqa emibili eyinhloko: iMidrand ukuya eSandton, kanye neHoughton ukuya eGermiston. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zabahambi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala nezokusebenza. Iziteshi zeGautrain zakhiwe ngokuqapha, zihlala ziphambili emikhiqizweni yokwakha, futhi zifaka izici ezithuthukile zokuphepha kanye nezokwelapha. Izici Zokusebenza IGautrain ibonakala ngemininingwane yokusebenza engcono kakhulu, efaka phakathi izitimela ezisheshayo ezihamba ngokushesha okungama-160 km/h. Lezi zitimela zenzelwe ukuhamba kahle phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, ziqinisekisa ukuthi isikhathi sokuhamba sincishisiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lweGautrain lukhuluma ngaphezulu kwama-85% wokukhishwa kwegesi, olunikeza umthelela omuhle emvelweni. Izinsiza Nezinhlelo Zokuthutha Ngaphezu kokuba uGautrain ulinikeza izitimela, uhlelo luphinde luhlinzeke ngezinsiza ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezimoto zokushayela, ezihlinzeka ngendawo yokupaka eduze neziteshi. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezithuthi zomphakathi, njengoMetrorail, okuhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kwemigudu yokuhamba. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain luhlinzeka ngohlelo lokukhokha olwakhelwe ngaphakathi, olwenza kube lula kubahambi ukuthola amathikithi. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Naphezu kokuphumelela kwayo, iGautrain ibhekene nezithiyo ezithile. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhamba kungaba umthombo wezinkinga kubahambi, ikakhulukazi kwabanye abasebenzisi abavela emiphakathini engaphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhamba nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Gautrain zidinga ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi ezikhulayo. Umthelela Womphakathi Nezomnotho IGautrain ibonakale njengephuzu elibalulekile emnothweni waseGauteng, ikakhulukazi ekukhuliseni amathuba emisebenzi, ukwakha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo lemiphakathi. Umsebenzi ohambisana neGautrain ubone ukwanda kwemisebenzi ezindaweni ezizungezile, okukhuthaza ukukhula kwezokuthengisa nezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Iphuzu Lokugcina IGautrain iyisibonelo esiyingqayizivele sokwakhiwa kohlelo lokuthutha oluphumelelayo, oluhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi waseGauteng. Ngesikhathi esithile, uGautrain ungaba yisixazululo esiphumelelayo sokuhamba, kodwa udinga ukufaka izinqumo eziphusile ukuze uqhubeke uthola impumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uGautrain uqhubeka ufinyelela izinjongo zawo zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuhamba ezindaweni eziphakeme. Isiphetho Ngenhla kokukhuluma ngakho, iGautrain iyithuluzi elikhulu elibonisa izinga eliphezulu lokuhamba, ukwakha imiphakathi, kanye nokukhulisa umnotho. Ukuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, iGautrain kufanele iqhubeke ibheka izindlela zokwandisa ukufinyelela kwayo, inikeze izinsizakalo ezithuthukile, futhi iqinise ubudlelwane bayo nomphakathi. Ukuphumelela kwayo kuzobe kuhlobene ngokuqondile nokwaziswa, ukwamukelwa, kanye nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yedolobha.
Imidlalo Yokulwa: Umcimbi Obalulekile Wokuhlola Amaphupho Nezinhlelo NgoMgqibelo, edolobheni elithokozisayo laseMgungundlovu, kuhlelelwe umcimbi omkhulu ozobamba izethameli eziningi. Imidlalo yokulwa, eyi-athikili ebalulekile emasikweni amaningi, izonikezwa ithuba lokukhonjwa kwezinkanyezi zayo. Lo mcimbi uzoba nezinkanyezi ezahlukene zokulwa, ezihlanganisa izitayela ezilandelayo: i-Taekwondo, i-Karate, i-Judo, nezinye eziningi. Umcimbi uzoba nenhloso yokubungaza ubuciko bokulwa, ukuhlinzeka ngothando, nokukhuthaza impilo enempilo kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha. Ngaphambi kokuqala komncintiswano, abaphatheli bazobhala ngokucophelela imithetho nemigomo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imihlanganisela ibambisene ngamanzi nekhono. Abadlali bazoba nezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzilungiselela ngaphambi kokuba bezelane amakhono abo. Ukuhlangana kwabesifazane nabesilisa kulindeleke ukuthi kubonakale, kulandela isiko elihle lokwamukela. Abazali, abangane, kanye nomphakathi uzobe ubizwa ukuze basize, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulise abaphakathi. Umcimbi uzokwenza abasebenzi abasha babenesimo sokukhula, ikakhulukazi uma kukhonjiswa abadlali abaqeqeshiwe nabakhi bezinkanyezi. Uzoba nezizwakali ezahlukene ezizobizwa ukuba ziqhube izifundo, ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abaqalayo, iminyaka yentsha, kanye nabadlali abavela ezingeni eliphezulu bazokwazi ukuthola ulwazi olunzulu vềzinto ezilula, izindlela ezichwepheshile, kanye nezimfihlo ezibhalwe phezulu kochwepheshe. Khonamanjala, umcimbi uzokwakha umoya wokuncintisana obalulekile. Abadlali bazocindezela imizwa yabo, bazi nomqondo wokubonga umphakathi. Ukuncintisana ngeke kube zinkanyezi ezijwayelekile; kuzoba nethuba lokuthola iziqu eziphezulu, okuhlinzeka ngenjongo ebalulekile kubadlali bonke. Lokhu kuzokwakha umoya obalulekile wokuhlangana, ubudlelwano, nokuthi wonke umuntu akhuthazwe ukuba abone ukuthi ungakha kanjani imisebenzi yempilo. Ngaphambi kokuphothulwa, umcimbi uzophothulwa ngokuhlonipha ababhokisi abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzoba yisikhathi sokubonga, sokubhalela emqondweni, esihlonipha imizamo yabo yonke. Abathandi be-martial arts bakholwa ukuthi umcimbi awugcini nje ngokuqhuba umphakathi, kodwa uthanda ukukhiqiza inzuzo ethile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ithuba lokusiza imiphakathi ethile, ngokuqondisa amahhovisi ezempilo nezokwelapha. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uzogcwalisa izifiso zabangane bezobuciko bokulwa, kube nephimbo elikhulu lempumelelo nokuqhubekela phambili. Njengoba umcimbi ungena ezinsukwini zawo, othandweni bezobuciko bokulwa bazoza bezothokozisa, bekhuthaza, futhi bedlalisa abanye. Ngakho, umcimbi uzogcina uduzane, uthule, uyajabulisa emoyeni omuhle wezemidlalo. Umongo walokhu kuhlanganiswe, umcimbi wezobuciko bokulwa uzokwenza baziswe ngempela ukuthi ubuhle bokulwa buhlanganisa ukuthakazelelwa, ubuhlobo, nokuthandana. Kulukhuni lokuhamba kwemikhankaso, kodwa kuyinsika yokubuyisana, umoya wokuvikela, nempilo enempilo.
