Inhloso enkulu ukuze wonke umuntu abone umhlaba ube ngcono, kuzodingeka ukuthi siqonde amandla ezokulwa, ubuchwepheshe bokulwa, nezifundo ezilungele ukuqhubekela phambili ezihamba phambili emiphakathini yethu. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wezobuciko bokulwa uzoba yisikhathi sokubongela, sokuhlangana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Uzakwethu othembekile, uthando lwezobuciko bokulwa lolu ukuzokwakha ikilabhu ehlanzekile ehlobene nezokwelapha. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, sizophinde sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuhliseni ubuciko bokulwa, sihlinzeke ngezindlela zokuphila ezikhethekile. Ngakho-ke, ungena ngothando, uzoba yilowo nesibopho sokuphakamisa indlela yethu yokuphila ezithakazelisayo.
Ezobuchwepheshe Beselula: Ukuguqulwa Kwezimpilo Zethu Kusukela ekubukeni okubukekayo okwenziwa abantu bethu, ubuchwepheshe beselula buvele baphendula izimpilo zethu ngendlela engakaze ibonakale. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, futhi sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe beselula buyaqhuba ekwakheni umhlaba omusha. Ngiyazizwa ngothando nangenjabulo ngalokhu, kodwa njalo kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuhlohla. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela ubuchwepheshe beselula obusishintshile ngayo umhlaba wethu. Ucingo lweselula, oluqala njengomsebenzi wesimanje, sekuphenduke ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yethu. Manje, singakwazi ukuxhumana nabantu abahlukahlukene, sithumele imiyalezo, noma sikhulume ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuxhumana okungapheli kudale umphakathi ophilayo, wonke umuntu ekwazi ukuthola ulwazi olulandelayo, okukhuthaza ukuhweba, ukufunda, ningakukholwa! Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu busezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe beselula bufundisa izingane namathalente amasha. Ukuze umuntu aziwa kahle emsebenzini, udinga ukuba nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze kube sezingeni, abezindaba, abathengisi, kanye nosomabhizinisi bahlale befuna abaqeqeshwayo abakhetha ukuphila beselula. Lokhu kumele kufunywe kumakhaya nasezindaweni zokufunda. Kukhona umuzwa owengeziwe wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bufundisa abantu ukuba babe nokuqonda okwengeziwe kwezokuxhumana, benza ukuthi kube nezinselelo eziningi ezingaholela ekuphumeleleni. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinhlelo ezithokozisayo, kudingeka sikhumbule nezinselele ezithile ezithinta ubuchwepheshe beselula. Okwaziyo kakhulu, ubuxhakaxhaka bensuku zonke businika izinselele ezinzima. Ukuvula izinsiza eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo, okukhona ezigijimayo, nakuba zidinga ukubonwa ngokujulile, zishiya abanye bengaphumeleli, ngaphandle kokukwazi ukugcina isikhala esifanele. Ubufakazi balokhu buvele kahle emiphumeleni yokungabikho kwamakhono avamile emiphakathini yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe beselula bukhombisa izinselele zokuphepha. Njengoba siba namafoni ahlakaniphile, ukuzwelonke kwethu kuvezwa kalula ezinkingeni ezinjengokuphephisa idatha, izinsizakalo, noma ukubandakanyeka ekuhloleni. Imiphakathi yethu idinga ukuziqhenya nokuqonda kahle izinsiza ezikhona. Yiqiniso, ubuchwepheshe beselula bulethe izinzuzo, kodwa zibheka futhi izindlela zokuvikela izimpilo zethu nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnotho wethu uxhunywe nezobuchwepheshe beselula. Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuphayona, amabhizinisi amaningi asebenzisa izinhlelo zezelula ukudala imikhiqizo noma amasevisi amasha. Ukuhweba online kudinga amafoni afanele, futhi lokho kudale amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza ekwakheni imikhakha ehlukene, okwenza ukuthi umnotho wethu ube namandla, futhi ungeqiniso ukuxhomeka kakhulu ezobuchwepheshe. Kungaba nomthelela omuhle, kodwa kumele ndawonye sihloniphe izinhlelo ezimeni ezingama-bubble. Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempela ngalezi zinkinga, indlela esibona ngayo ubuchwepheshe beselula kuze kube yinkathazo, iguqula imicabango yethu ngokuqhubekayo. Siphila emhlabeni wesimo se-digital, futhi lokho kuyashintsha indlela esicabanga ngayo, sikhuluma ngayo, sithokozisa ngayo. Ukuthola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula buyaqhubeka ngokuphathelene nezimpilo zethu, lokho kumele kube nomthelela omuhle. Ubulungiswa, ubudlelwano, kanye nekhono lokwazisa abanye kuyinto engapheli. Ekugcineni, ubuchwepheshe beselula buyinselele engapheli. Njengoba sithola ubuchwepheshe obusha, kufanele sibuye sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi wethu ungenza izinqumo ezahlukene. Ukuze sikhulise umnotho wethu, kufanele sihlole nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe beselula bungomunye wezinsizakalo ezinkulu zezisombululo, kodwa kumele kuhlale kuphumelele izimfuno zomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, ngifuna ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe beselula ukuze sithole umphakathi obumbene futhi ozinza. Kulabo abathintekayo, kumele sikhulume ngezinkomba ezilungile zomphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe beselula bungumgibeli omuhle, kodwa sekuyisikhathi sokuba kudalwe ingxoxo eyhlabeni ukuze sikhumbule impilo yempilo yokujabulela ubuchwepheshe levuka. Sihamba phambili, kodwa kumele sibone umphakathi wethu, nintlilaze ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ezijabulisayo. Sihamba phambili, kodwa kumele sikhumbule impilo yethu futhi sizame ukufinyelela izinjongo ezigcwele phezulu.
UJohn Bolt: Uhambo Lwakhe Lokuphumelela UJohn Bolt, owaziwa njengo "iBolt," ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Uzalwe ngoJanuwari 15, 1990, eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika. Wakhula emndenini ophilayo, ogxile ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono. Umama wakhe, uNandi, wayengumfundisi, kanti ubaba, uThabo, wayengumsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kumfundisa ukubaluleka kwemfundo, ukusebenza kanzima, nokuhlala efuna ulwazi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zeMatrik, uJohn wangenela iNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona i-Computer Science. Wathola ithuba lokubamba izifundo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, okuhlinzeka ngendawo yokucabanga nokudala. Waqeda izifundo zakhe ngo-2011, wabe esethola umsebenzi njengomkhiqizi wezinhlelo zokusebenza emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe. UJohn wathola ithuba lokusebenza ngesikhathi ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili, wakha iBolt, inkampani ehlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphuthumayo zokuthutha. I-Bolt yakhula yaba yinkampani eyaziwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezinsizakalo zokuthutha, ikhiqiza izinhlelo ezivumela abantu ukuba bahambe kalula nangempumelelo. UJohn akagcini nje ngokwakha ibhizinisi, kodwa futhi waqonda ukubaluleka kokubuyisela emphakathini. Waqalisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abantu abasha emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Wabamba izingxoxo eziningi nabafundi, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe, futhi wakhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, iBolt yathola imiklomelo eminingi, kubalwa neNkampani Ephumelelayo Yonyaka. UJohn uthole izindondo ezahlukene ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo, okuhlanganisa umklomelo wokuhlonishwa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ubuye waba ngumholi ophawulekayo, futhi umphakathi uvuma imizamo yakhe yokwakha imisebenzi emisha. UJohn uhlala elwa nezinkinga ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe, ephendula emibuzweni ethile mayelana nokuziphatha okuhle kwezobuchwepheshe. Ukukhuthaza impilo enempilo kumphakathi, uJohn uqhubeka eqinisa izindlela zokuhlala usemthethweni, ezokuphepha, kanye nokuziphatha okuhle. Ngaphezu kokuphumelela kwakhe kwiBolt, uJohn uphinde abe umndeni ojabulayo. Uzakwabo, uThandiwe, ungumculi ophumelelayo, futhi banabantwana abane. UJohn uthi ukuba nomndeni kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yakhe, futhi uhlala enza isikhathi sokuchitha nabo. Uthanda ukuhamba, esho ukuthi ukuphila kuhle uma ubamba isikhathi nabathandekayo. Ngaphandle komsebenzi, uJohn uthanda ukufunda izincwadi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezomnotho. Ubuye athande ukuzijabulisa ngokubuka imidlalo yeholide, futhi ungumlandeli omkhulu weqembu lemidlalwana yezemidlalo yaseNingizimu Afrika. UJohn Bolt ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi, nomndeni. Uhlale efinyelela phezulu, esebenzisa amasu akhe okucabanga ukuze abheke phambili. Uthi “Iphupho liphila uma ulinakekela” — lokho kuveza impilo yakhe. I-Bolt, njengegama eliyinsika, ibonisa amandla okuhamba phambili, futhi uJohn uyisibonelo sokuthi ngekhono, ukuzinikela, kanye nomoya omuhle, konke kungaba khona. UJohn uphila impilo eyanelisayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kwiBolt, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Uqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, bazi kahle ukuthi impumelelo ayisiyona nje impumelelo yomuntu, kodwa ingumphumela wezinto eziningi ezihlangene. UJohn usaqhubeka nokuba umthombo wokhuthazo kubantu abamthandayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abaninzi.
amaKaizer Chiefs Kuwo wonke umhlaba, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, amaKaizer Chiefs akhuluma izilimi eziningi. Leli qembu, elibizelwa ngegama likaMnumzane Kaizer Motaung, lidlale indima enkulu emlandweni wezemidlalo kuleli. Lokhu kuhanjelwa kwenziwa ngedumela eliqinile, okudlulelwe eminyakeni eyi-50 yempilo yalo. AmaKaizer Chiefs, abizwa kanjalo ngokuthi iAmakhosi, ayikhona nje kuphela ithimba lemidlalwa, kodwa ithimba lenhloso, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Umcimbi wokuzalwa kwaMaKaizer Chiefs ugubha iminyaka engama-53 yokuba khona kwalesi sikhungo semidlalo. Ngaphezu kweminyaka yama-50, leli qembu belihambelana nemiphumela emihle, imicimbi ethokozisayo, kanye nemidlalo yama-derbies anjengeSoweto Derby, lapho phakade kubonakala khona izithameli ezinezinhlobo ezehlukene. Lo mcimbi, okhushulwa ngezinsuku ezimnandi nezikhumbuzo, uzoba yinsukwana ehloniphekile. Umcimbi ungabhalwa nemiphakathi eminingi, kuhlanganise nezindawo zomphakathi, izinkanyezi zokuqala, amaqhawe, abaphathi bomphakathi, kanye namalungu esigaba sezemidlalo. Imicimbi yonyaka iyakhumbuleka, ngaleso sikhathi lapho abalandeli bejoyina udumo lweqembu labo, belwela ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngandlela-thile, umhlaba wezemidlalo uthola ithuba lokubona ubuciko, ubuhlakani, kanye neqhaza labo. Lokhu kuzolungiselela omuhle abathanda ukuqhamuka, bejabulile, behlanganyela, bese belinda ukuhlanganyela nsuku zonke emicimbini, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Ukubamba amaqhuzu kanye namaloya, ukufundisana, nokubamba iqhaza kwabelani ngesiko lemidlalo ebelwa ngaphambi kokuba sazi ukuthi kuzobhalwa emlandweni, kulokhu kuseshimini. Uma uhamba uyojabulisa, umcimbi uzoba yindida, uzomema izihambeli ezivela phezulu kwezindawo ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izaziso zingathunyelwa futhi zibe nomthelela omkhulu ezinkundleni zomsebenzi. Ukuze bonke abathandi beze, iziphakamiso zezinkanyezi zokuqala zizosetshenziswa ukwenza umcimbi uhambe kahle. Izindaba eziwusizo, izimemezelo ezithokozisayo, nemicimbi yokukhumbula ihlotshaniswa nezinhlelo zokuphila. Emhlanganweni wokuhlonipha, umphakathi uzoba nezinye izinhlelo ezilungiselelwe ngamakhosi, ezihlanganisa imizuzu emide yokwenza izinkanyezi zimise, ukugubha imiklomelo, kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuhlonipha abaphumelele. Lokhu kuzomenza uzizwe efanele umhlaba wonke, eyokuqala kwezithameli namathuba, ngaphandle kokuphoqelelwa. Izinhlelo ezithakazelisayo zizoziqalayo, futhi abathandi beKaizer Chiefs bazobe bejabulile. Izinkanyezi zomphakathi zizothokozisa abalandeli, bezintumbane, kanye nemikhosi edlalayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalesi sikhumbuzo emqoka, kube nesithakazelo emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlangene nabaphathi bezemidlalo, kokubili endaweni ethile noma izinkampani ezithile, kuzoholela ekutheni umcimbi ubeimpumelelo. Ngenxa yesimo esibucayi, umcimbi uzobe udinga idokhumenti ethile yokuvikela. Lokhu kuzobandakanya konke okuhle okuvela kunoma iyiphi imvelaphi. Umkhankaso wokubambisana wenziwa ukuze uqalise umphakathi kepha ukufisa kukhombisa intshisekelo, ngesikhathi sokuqhubekisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezikhwepha. Ubudlelwano obuqinile bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi bukhona ubuhlobo obuphumelelayo phakathi kwamalungu ahlukeneyo nabathandi. Umbhoxo wezithameli udinga ukuchaza izizathu zokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo yelungelo, nibaleke emhlabeni jikelele. Umphakathi waKaizer Chiefs uzabonisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nezenzo ezinhle ukuze kugcwaliswe umkhankaso wezikhumbuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yalesi sikhumbuzo izobonisa umjayelo wemicimbi, evikela izakhono zezingane ezibhalwe emithonjeni. Lolu suku olukhulu luzosiza ukuba amaKaizer Chiefs aqhubeke nokuduma, abakhona, azikhumbuze, nabalandeli baphinde baqonde kahle. Umoya weqembu ungava emoyeni, uhambisane nezizathu zezenzo ezinhle, umoya wothando nempilo. Kungokuhamba phambili, uMaKaizer Chiefs uzobukela phansi izithombe zempumelelo. Ubuqhela balesi sikhumbuzo buphakanyiswe, beze bahloniphe imbali yabo nodumo lwabo. Umcimbi wokugubha amaKaizer Chiefs uzohlonishwa njengenye yezinsuku ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yezenhlalakahle, phakathi kwezemidlalo nezokuhlalisana. Lokhu kuzoletha ukukhaza, uthando nofana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, abalandeli bamaKaizer Chiefs bazoqhubeka bezijabulisa, behlanganyela ezindleleni eziphathekayo, bese bebagubha eminyakeni eyinkulungwane ezayo. Ubuqhawe bokuqala bube buvumelwano, umoya weqembu ube shimini. Kuze kube phakade, amaKaizer Chiefs azophakamisa izimpande zawo, uMsindisi, nomoya wesizwe. Ubudlelwano obuphakeme bazokwenza kucace kakhulu imfunda yokuzinikela.
Umbiko: Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi Isingeniso Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo nesikhala sokusebenza kubafundi abasha. Ekuphileni kwethu kwansuku zonke, imfundo iyisisekelo esiyinhloko sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi imanyuvesi zidlala indima enkulu kulokhu. Nokho, izindleko eziphezulu zemali yokufunda zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukufinyelela kwi-akhademi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta imali yokufunda emanyuvesi, izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nemithelela emiphakathini. Izindleko Zemali Yokufunda Izindleko zemali yokufunda emanyuvesi zihluka kakhulu kuye ngezikhungo zemfundo, izifundo, kanye nezwe. Emhlabeni jikelele, izifundo ezithile, njengezokwelapha nezinjiniyela, ziningi kakhulu uma ziqhathaniswa nezinye ezifana nezifundo zezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bakhethwe ngokuqhathanisa izindleko ezihambisana nezifundo abazikhethayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila, ezifana nokuqasha, ukudla, nezokuthutha, ziyanda kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuzitholela imali yokufunda. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Abafundi Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi banikezwa izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa, okuhlanganisa imalimboleko, izibonelelo, nezikhwama zokufunda. Imalimboleko ivame ukufunwa ukuze kufezwe izindleko zokufunda, kodwa izinzuzo zayo zifaka ingcindezi yokukhokha emuva ngemva kokuphothula. Izibonelelo, ngakolunye uhlangothi, zinikeza usizo kulabo abavela emindenini eziphila ngaphansi kwezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Lokhu kusiza ukunciphisa umthwalo wemali kumafunda. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokufundisa Ubuchwepheshe buye baphendula izindlela zokufunda, futhi emnyuvesi, izifundo eziku-inthanethi ziye zanda. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba benze izifundo zabo besebenzisa izinsiza ezikhona ku-inthanethi. Nokho, abanye abafundi bangase bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuxhuma nokungabi nekhono lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kubangela ukuba kube nokuhlukahluka ekufinyeleleni emfundweni, okungaba nomthelela ekubhekaneni nabafundi abavela emiphakathini ethile. Imithelela Emiphakathini Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi ingaba nemithelela eminingi emiphakathini. Ukungatholakali kwemali yokufunda kungaholela ekwehleni kwesibalo sabafundi abaphothula izifundo zabo, okuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kungadala umjikelezo wokuhlupheka, njengoba abafundi abangenayo imfundo ephezulu behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele nehlonishwayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma abafundi bethola uxhaso lwezimali, lokhu kungakhuthaza ukukhula komnotho emiphakathini. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwemfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni nezinhlangano ezizimele zisebenze ndawonye. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwezibonelelo ezihlukahlukene, ukunciphisa izindleko zemali yokufunda, kanye nokwandisa amathuba okuthola imalimboleko ezinhle kungase kube yizixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokufundisa nokwakha amakhono angama-workshops kuzokwandisa ukuqonda nokwazisa abafundi ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokufunda. Isiphetho Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi iyinselelo enkulu kubafundi abaningi, kodwa kunendlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, iminyango ezizimele, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abafundi bafeze amaphupho abo, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe, ukukhulisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni imfundo, okuzokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi nasemiphakathini, futhi kuqhakambisa izakhamuzi ezinamakhono. Iminyaka ezayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi ukufinyelela kwempumelelo emanyuvesi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile kulokhu.
Ithenisi: Ukuphila Okuphilayo Nempumelelo Ekhulayo Ithenisi, umdlalo odlalwa phakathi kwezinsika ezimbili, ungowokuzijabulisa, umthombo wenjabulo, kanye nomkhakha ophumelelayo obambe izimpilo zabantu abaninzi emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kokuhlangana komphakathi, ithenisi iyindlela yokukhombisa amakhono, ukuzikhandla, nokugqugquzela impilo enempilo. Ukuze siqonde ukuhlonishwa kwalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukubheka izinto ezithize ezibangela ukuba ithenisi ikhanye njengenkanyezi ebhalayo ezinkundleni zomhlaba. Okokuqala, ithenisi iyinselelo enkulu. Umdlalo ubandakanya ubuchule, isiqondiso, nokusebenzisa amandla ngokufanele. Ukuphumelelisa umgomo wakho wokuwina kudinga izinyathelo eziyinqaba, njengoba umphakathi wesansuku wanamuhla ungabheki nje kuphela kumphumela, kodwa futhi ubheka nezenzo ezinamandla ezingasiza ukufinyelela empumelelweni. Umgibeli odlalela izinsika, kufanele akwazi ukuthola izinga eliphakeme lokuqonda nokusebenza kwegagasi lokuphendula kwezithombe ezicacile. Ngaphezu kokusebenza ngempumelelo, ithenisi iyindawo yokukhuluma ngezenhlalakahle. Abadlalayo bakha izixhumanisi ezibalulekile phakathi kwabo nababukeli. Umbono wobugovu, ubudlelwano bamazwi nezimo zeqembu zikhombisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu ngezikhathi zokuqhuba umjaho. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuhlangana, sokwakha ubuhlobo obuyingxenye yezenzakalo ezinjalo. Umphakathi uhamba phambili, ubuthakathaka, bheka ukuthi abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bazithokozisa kanjani ngomqondo owodwa. Into ebalulekile ukuze ithenisi ibe njalo phambili ukwakha ikusasa lemidlalwano. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iminyaka emisha iyakwazi ukuthola ithuba lokubona nokubamba iqhaza emidlalweni. Ukuze sishintshe izimpilo zomsebenzi wezokudlala, kufanele kwenziwe umsebenzi onzima othinta ukufundiswa nokufundela ababambiqhaza abancane. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo nowaziyo. Ithenisi ayigcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa ibuye ibe yindawo yokukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga umzamo, kodwa akudingi ukuba kube ukuncintisana kuphela; kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukugijima, ukugxila nokusebenza endaweni udinga amandla okuphila. Ukukhuthaza abasha ukuthi baqhubele phambili amandla abo nokukhuluma ngesimo sezemidlalo sibe ngcono, kubalulekile ukuze kuvulele amathuba amasha. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwaziwisa kokuhlala kahle emiphakathini yethu. Kodwa-ke, ukuze sibe neqhaza, kudinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Ithenisi, njengomgibeli, idinga ukuxhaswa ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula. Ukuze sikhulise ubuchwepheshe bethu, kufanele kube nezinsiza ezinengqondo ezisekelwe ezikhaleni zokudlala, izikole, nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, kugcinwa umphakathi kuphela engapheli, umphakathi omnyama kakhulu. Ukuxhaswa ngobuchwepheshe, ukukwazi ukwakha ithuba lokudala izindawo ezisemqoka kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze sikhulise ibhizinisi lethu elinempilo. Okwamanje, ukusebenzisa ithenisi njengendlela yokuthuthukisa impilo kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukufaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuzivocavoca, ikakhulukazi kumakhaya ezingane, kuyoba nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imiphumela yokuphila. Uma sikhuluma ngethenisi, sisebenzisa ukuba yimpumelelo, sikhombisa ubungcweti, futhi sihlinzeka ngamathuba angcono obuhlakani. Ithimba, kepha umphakathi ubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi omkhulu. Ekugcineni, ithenisi ingaphezu kwenkundla, iyindawo yokukhuthaza umphakathi. Abadlalayo, abaxhasi, nababukeli bahlala bejabulisa kalula, futhi umphakathi uyavuleka ngezinto ezizwayo ezikhuluma ngempilo. Umdlalo unikeza izifundo ezibaluleke kakhulu - ukuthi ukuphikelela, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha kuyoba yizinto ezibalulekile ezizobakhumbuza onke umuntu. Lokhu kuyisisekelo sikhumbula ukuthi ithenisi, njengenqubo, yizinto ezinkulu ezenzakalayo emhlabeni. Ngokuqhubeka kokudlalwa kwezenzo, sizokwazi ukubona ukuthi ithenisi iyindlela ebanzi yokuvuselela umphakathi. Zilokhu zikhula, ziqhuba njalo, futhi zikhombisa amandla enhloso neqhaza. Okwamanje, umhlaba ubheke phambili kanye nezenzo zethu ukuze isikhumbuzo sibuye singafani. Ukuphila, uthando, nokuhlakanipha - konke kuboniswe emidlalweni yeqembu labadlalayo abaninzi njengoba behamba phambili. Kwazulu, i-tennis iyinsika eyodwa engenamkhawulo, exhumanisa abantu thr. Izikhumbuzo, izifundo nemigudu ezokwenza ubuhlobo buhamba phambili. Akudluli kulezi ndaba, inyusa ngezinkanyezi ezizonjikile, ithenisi iyindlela yethu yempilo, imidlalo ehloniphekile, nelungelo lokwabelana nempumelelo.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Ukuhlola Umhlaba Wokudlala Ngobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ibe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu abaningi emhlabeni. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala, lapho imidlalo yayikhiqizwa ngezithombe ezilula, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula kakhulu, buguqula indlela esidlala ngayo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimboni Zokudlala Imidlalo yevidiyo ikhiqizwa yizinkampani ezinkulu nezincane, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaculi, nabadali. Lezi zinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezithombe ezicacile, imisindo ethokozisayo, kanye nezinhlelo eziphusile, ukuze zenze imidlalo ejabulisayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni imidlalo edumile, efana ne-‘The Legend of Zelda’, ‘Call of Duty’, kanye ne-‘Fortnite’, eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Imiphumela Yokudlala Imidlalo yevidiyo ayigcini ngokuba umthombo wokuzijabulisa, kodwa inemiphumela emihle emiphakathini. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane ezahlukene. Abantu bahlala bexhumana nabangani, ngisho noma bahlale kude, ngokudlala. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile futhi kunciphisa ukwehlukaniswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekuthuthukiseni amakhono ahlukahlukene, njengoba abadlali bahlala bephendula ngokushesha, benza izinqumo ezisheshayo, futhi befunda ukuhlela kahle. Izinkinga Zokudlala Nokho, imidlalo yevidiyo inezinselelo zayo. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ekwehliseni izinga lokusebenza kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kudlalwa imidlalo enokuhlukumeza. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka ngezempilo yengqondo, njengoba abanye abadlali bengase babe nezinselelo zokuziphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba nomthelela omubi ezimweni zokuxhumana, njengoba abanye bengase bahlale bejolise kumadivayisi, baphuthelwe ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula, buvumela abadlali ukuba babe nezinhlobonhlobo zokudlala. I-virtual reality (VR) kanye ne-augmented reality (AR) ziye zaba yizinto ezidumile, zenza kube nokwenzeka ukudlala ngendlela engakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. Lokhu kudala umuzwa ophakeme, njengoba abadlali bezwa sengathi baphila ngaphakathi kwemidlalo. Izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zindlela, zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubadlali. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo izoqhubeka nokuba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuxhumana, yokufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuthi abadlali baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nokudlala, ukuze bagcine impilo yabo ibalulekile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, sizobona izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wemidlalo yevidiyo, okuzokwenza kube nentshisekelo enkulu kubo bonke abathanda ukudlala.
Ingxoxo Ngomthombo Wokuphila: iMount Everest Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ithuba lokukhuluma nomhambi ophumelelayo, uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, owakha igama lakhe njengomgibeli ophumelelayo eMount Everest. UThabo, oneminyaka engama-35, ube nezinsuku eziningi ezikhumbulekayo ezinyakazweni zakhe eziphakeme. Ngiyajabula ukukwazi, Thabo. Ungasichazela kanjani ukuthi waqala kanjani uhambo lwakho lokukhuphuka iMount Everest? UThabo Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukuqala, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi uthando lwami lwezintaba lwaqala ngisemncane. Ngakhula eMpumalanga Kapa, lapho izintaba zazingamaqhugwane. Ngazithokozela kakhulu, futhi ngafuna ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zindawo eziphakeme. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami, ngathola ithuba lokuhamba nezinkanyezi eziphakeme, futhi lokho kwangikhuthaza ukuba ngifinyelele iMount Everest. Umbuzo: Kuyajabulisa lokho! Yini eyakwenza wathanda ukuhamba eMount Everest, ikakhulukazi uma kukhona izingozi eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu? UThabo: Ngiyavuma, iMount Everest iyindawo enobungozi, kodwa umoya wokuphumelela ungaphezu kwezingozi. Ngithanda ukucabanga ngalezi zinto njengemithwalo engiyithwele. Ngiyazi ukuthi izingozi zikhona, kodwa ngifuna ukufunda nokukhula. Ngithanda umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, bonke bejolise ekufinyeleleni umgomo ofanayo. Lokhu kwenza kube mnandi futhi kukhuthaze. Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imikhuba ethile yokuzilungiselela ngaphambi kokukhuphuka? UThabo: Yebo, ngiyaziqhenya ngokuthi ngiyazilungiselela kahle. Ngithatha isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, ngihamba ngezinyawo ezinzima, futhi ngifunda ngempilo yezintaba. Ngiyazi ukuthi udinga amandla, kodwa futhi udinga ukwazi ukulawula imizwa yakho. Ngifunda ukucabanga kahle, ngiyazithokozisa, futhi ngithola izindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ngikwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Umbuzo: Ngabe ungabelana nathi ngolwazi oluthile olukhona ngempilo yakho ngesikhathi sokukhuphuka? UThabo: Ngempela, ngikhumbula kahle usuku engangikhuphuka khona. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, futhi izimo zazinzima. Ngafika endaweni ethile, ngazizwa ngikhathazekile, kodwa ngazithola ngikhumbula ukuthi ngingedwa. Ngabheka emuva, ngabona abanye abahambi, futhi lokho kwanginika amandla. Ngafunda ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ungaphezu kokuphumelela. Ngithole ukuthi ngingakwazi ukuhamba, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza. Umbuzo: Ngabe ubona izinguquko ezithile emhlabeni wezintaba, ikakhulukazi eMount Everest? UThabo: Yebo, ngiyabona izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kubonakala kakhulu. Izinga lokushisa liphansi, futhi izindawo eziningi zishintsha. Lokhu kuthinta izimo zokukhuphuka, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela lezi zindawo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kufanele sibe nomthwalo wemfanelo ukuze sigcine lezi zindawo zihlala zikhangayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalo ethile kubantu abafuna ukuhamba eMount Everest? UThabo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa kudinga ukuzilungiselela. Futhi, badinga ukwazi ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ubalulekile. Ngiyakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, baphinde baziqhenye ngezinto abazifundayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza kakhulu uma befika ezindaweni eziphakeme. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Thabo, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinto ezibalulekile. Uhambo lwakho lukhombisa ukuthi umoya wokuphumelela ungaphezu kwezithiyo. Ngiyabonga futhi ngokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi bahlale bejolise emigomweni yabo. Ngiyabonga!
iBolt: Ukuguqula Indlela Esihamba Ngayo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula izindlela eziningi zokuphila kwethu, futhi iBolt ingesinye sezibonelo ezikhombisa kahle lokhu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngale nkampani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iBolt ayisiyona nje indlela yokuhamba, kodwa iyisixazululo esihambisana nezidingo zethu zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuhlola iBolt, sizobheka izinzuzo zayo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela wayo emphakathini. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo yeBolt. Le nkampani, eyasungulwa e-Estonia, isiphenduke umholi emkhakheni wezokuhamba. I-Bolt ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphumelelayo, futhi ezikhangayo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuhamba elikhululekile kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane okuthola izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iBolt ibonakala iyindlela engcono yokuhamba uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezinkulu ezikhona, njengoba inikela ngezindleko eziphansi, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zayo. Ngokubheka izinzuzo, iBolt ibuye ibonise ukuzibophezela kwayo ekugcineni imvelo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisebenzisa izimoto ezihamba ngogesi, iBolt ibonisa ukuthi iyakuhlonipha umhlaba esiphila kuwo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokushisa komhlaba nokungcoliswa kwemvelo. I-Bolt ibonisa ukuthi izinkampani zingakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo, futhi lokhu kufanele kube isibonelo esihle kwezinye izinkampani. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba iBolt ikhulisa imisebenzi yayo, ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Omunye wemibuzo ephakanyisiwe uthi, "Ngabe iBolt iyakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma ibhizinisi layo likhula?" Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma izinsizakalo zayo zingatholakali noma zingahlinzekwa kahle, lokho kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke kwezinye izinkampani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphepha zihlala zikhona. Abashayeli bamaBolt badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaphepha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iBolt ibhekene nezinkinga ezihlobene nezimakethe ezahlukene. Njengoba ibhizinisi layo likhula emhlabeni jikelele, izimo zomthetho nezokuphatha zihluke kakhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iBolt ibhekane nezimo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kungathinta ukusebenza kwayo. Ukuze iBolt iqhubeke nokuphumelela, kudingeka ukuthi ibhekane nalezi zinkinga ngokuqinile. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo yeBolt, akufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ibhizinisi layo aligcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhamba. I-Bolt ibuye ibonakale njengomholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabashayeli nabagibeli. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ubudlelwano obuhle buholela ekwenzeni kube lula kubo bobabili. I-Bolt ibonisa ukuthi ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwemali, kodwa futhi nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuphetha, iBolt iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaguqula kanjani izindlela esihamba ngazo. Izinzuzo zayo zikhombisa ukuthi ibhizinisi elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili lingaba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi iBolt kufanele ibhekane nazo ukuze iqhubeke nokuphumelela. Njengoba sikhula emhlabeni ogcwele ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinkampani ezifana neBolt zidinga ukugxila ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, nokuhlonipha imvelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi iBolt iqhubeke nokukhula, futhi ibenethonya elihle emphakathini.
Imfashini Nobuhle: Izinyathelo Zokwakha Isitayela Esihle Isingeniso Imfashini nobuhle kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Zihlanganisa indlela esiziphatha ngayo, indlela esibukeka ngayo, kanye nezinto esizikhethayo ukuze sikhombise ubuhle bethu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile ezizosisiza ukuba sakhe isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zethu, futhi esikhombisa ubuntu bethu. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Isitayela Sakho Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isitayela sakho siwubani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ucabangele izinto ezifana nezinto ozithandayo, imibala ethokozisayo, nezinto ezikwenza uzizwe kahle. Thola izithombe ezikukhombisa kahle, noma ubuke izincwadi zemfashini ukuze uthole ugqozi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izingubo ezizokwenza uzizwe uthokozile. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izingubo Ngemva kokuba uqonde isitayela sakho, isikhathi sokukhetha izingubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomzimba wakho. Uma unomzimba omncane, ungakhetha izingubo ezikhululekile, kanti uma unomzimba omkhulu, ungakhetha izingubo ezihlanganisa kahle umzimba. Ungakhohlwa ukufaka imibala ehlukahlukene, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi imibala oyikhethayo ihambisana. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlanganisa Izingubo Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izingubo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezihambelana kahle. Isibonelo, uma ugqoke ijezi elikhulu, ungakhetha amabhulukwe amancane ukuze udale ibhalansi. Futhi, ungakhetha izesekeli ezifana nezikhwama, amabhande, noma izicathulo ezihambisana nezimpahla zakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukunakekela Ubuqotho Bakho Ubuqotho bethu buwubuhle obukhulu. Ukuze ugcine ubuhle bakho, kubalulekile ukunakekela isikhumba sakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugeza, ukusebenzisa ama-moisturizers, kanye nokusebenzisa izithako ezithile ezithuthukisa isikhumba. Futhi, ungakhetha ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo yemvelo, ngoba imikhiqizo enezithako zemvelo ivame ukuba nezinzuzo eziningi. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenzisa Izinwele Izinwele zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uzenza kahle, futhi ungakhetha isitayela esihambisana nezimo zakho. Uma ungenayo isikhathi sokwenza izinwele, ungakhetha izixazululo ezilula ezifana nezikhwama noma ama-braids. Futhi, ungakhetha imikhiqizo yokunakekela izinwele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangayo. Isinyathelo 6: Ukugqoka Ngokufanele Ukugqoka ngendlela efanele kubalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungagqoki kakhulu noma kancane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde izimo ezahlukene, njengezikhathi zomsebenzi, imicimbi, noma amaholide. Futhi, ungakhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomoya, ukuze uzizwe ukhululekile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuzithokozisa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa. Imfashini nobuhle akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuziveza. Zama izinto ezintsha, udlale ngemibala, futhi ungazithokozisi uma ungathandi okuthile. Ukuzithokozisa kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokwakha isitayela esihamba phambili. Isiphetho Imfashini nobuhle kuyindlela yokuziveza, futhi kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zakho, futhi esikhombisa ubuhle bakho. Khumbula, ubuhle bukhona ngaphakathi, futhi imfashini iyindlela yokukubonisa. Qhubeka uzithokozise, futhi ungavumeli imfashini ikuphazamise. Ubuqotho bakho bukhulu, futhi kufanele bukhanye.
UNelson Mandela: Impilo Nokusebenza Kwakhe UNelson Rolihlahla Mandela, owazalwa ngoMfumfu 18, 1918, eMvezo, eMpumalanga Kapa, wayengomunye wabantu abavelele emlandweni yeNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe. Njengomholi ophakanyisiwe, umthetho, nothisha, uMandela waphokophela ekufezekiseni ubulungiswa nentokozo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lapho eseyingane, wakhula ezimeni zokuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, okwamvusa ukuba abe nemicabango emisha yokulwa nobandlululo. Uthisha wakhe, uAlbert Luthuli, owayehola i-African National Congress (ANC), waba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, wamgqugquzela ukuba abe ngumholi. Waqala ukufunda ezikoleni ezinkulu, wathola iziqu kwi-Universitiy of Fort Hare. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, uMandela waya eJozi, lapho ahlangana khona nezinhlangano eziphikisa ubuhlanga. Waqala ukusebenza ne-ANC, futhi ngonyaka ka-1952, waba ngusomabhizinisi ophakeme, waba nelungelo lokugcinwa kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweMasekhasi, umkhankaso wokumelana nobandlululo. UNelson Mandela waba ngaphansi kobufakazi obuningi, futhi ngemva kokudlula ezindaweni eziningi nezinto zempilo, waba yisithwathwa esibalulekile kwizinhlelo zempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Ekuqaleni kwawo-1960s, i-ANC yashaywa nhlangothi zombili, kanti uMandela wayesebenzisa imizamo yabo yokulwa. Ngo-1962, waqanjwa icala lokubamba abantu, kwathi ngo-1964, wathola isijeziso sokubeletha iminyaka engu-27. Lokhu kwakubuhlungu, kodwa waphendula ngothando, ethula imicabango yakhe ezikhaleni ezahlukene. Ngesikhathi esefuze uzithibe, waqhubeka nokuthola ukujabulisayo ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, uye wahamba nabafo emkhankasweni. Ngemuva kokukhululwa ngo-1990, waba nomuzwa omkhulu wokuvuselela abantu, futhi waphakamisa umholi wezinhlelo zentuthuko. Wavula umnyango wobumbano, kulethe imiqondo emisha yokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. UMandela wathola umklomelo we-Nobel Peace Prize ngonyaka we-1993. Ngomsebenzi wakhe omkhulu, wakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, egxile emandleni abantu, kulungiswa ubudlova nobandlululo. Waphuma njengomongameli wesibili weNingizimu Afrika, wazuza impumelelo eningi ekuvuseleleni umphakathi nezwe. Ukuze aqedele ukwahlukaniswa, washintsha isimiso, uMandela wasebenzisa izinsiza ukuze aqinisekise ukuvota kwabantu bonke, ngokuhlukana kuphela kwezikhumbuzo zezakhamuzi. Eminyakeni yamuva, wabe esebenza njengomxhumanisi, enza isiqiniseko sokuthi abanye bahlala bekhumbula, ngenkathi kuvela izinkinga ezintsha. Uknownwa njengomuntu ophakeme, uMandela wabamba izinkulumo emhlabeni wonke, ethula khona indlela yokuphila ngothando, uxolo, nokukhuthaza. Ngesikhathi sika-2021, uMandela waphuma emhlabeni, kodwa izinsalela zempilo yakhe zisakhula. Umoya wakhe uhlala unjengomoya wokuphila esikhathini samanje, umfundisayo, umholi, nothisha. Nakuba kube nezinkinga ezithile, kuyaziwa ukuthi uNelson Mandela waphila engumuntu omuhle, owafundisa ubuntu nezimiso zempilo, ezalayo kuzo zonke izizukulwane ezilandelayo. Izifundo zikaMandela zisabhalwe emithonjeni yempilo, zikhuluma ngoThando, uBumbano, nokuthula. UMandela ubonisa ukuthi umuntu ungakhuluma ngesikhathi esinzima, futhi emsebenzini wakhe, abenzi banikeza amandla kubantu, ubukhona bokuqala. Ngale ndlela, impilo kaMandela iyimpumelelo yokuholela impilo eyanelisayo, eyengeza obala kumzuzu wezomphakathi nezwe. Ngakho, ungamubheka uNelson Mandela njengezimpawu, futhi ube yisibonelo sokuba ubenze bonke abanye, kuhlelo lokuqhuba izinguquko ezinhle ezimpilweni zethu. Uhambo lwakhe lwakha isizinda esiqinile sephephandaba lempilo, okuyinto eyasiza ukwakha indawo okukhona khona abantu abangaphezu kwalabo abanye; konke kuyi halfves, ukufana nesikhumbuzo. Ngakho-ke, uMandela asishiya nokubheka phambili ngaphakathi kwezinga lethu, sishiye imbali ethokozisayo.
Ezabesifazane: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha iZinduna Zabesifazane Ngomhlaka 15 kuJuni 2023, kwaba nempumelelo eMnyangweni KaMasipala weTheku, lapho abesifazane bahlonishwa khona ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo ekwenzeni izwi labo libonakale emphakathini. Lo mcimbi wawuhloswe ukukhumbuza nokuqhakambisa umthelela obalulekile wabesifazane ezimpilweni zabantu. Uhlelo lwawuholwa nguNkk. Thandiwe Nkosi, lwathi luhlanganyela abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze babelane ngamava, bavule izingxoxo ezimnandi, futhi banikeze izeluleko. Umcimbi uqale ngamazwi akhuthazayo avela kumongameli weqembu lesifazane, uNkk. Mbali Dube, owathi, "Amakhosikazi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kumele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhuthaza abesifazane ukuze babe namathuba alinganayo, sishaye indiva izithiyo ezibhekene nabo." Lokhu kwathokozisa abathandekayo, banika ugqozi lokulandela izinyathelo ezihlosiwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umphakathi wahlangana ngendlela ejabulisayo, lapho abesifazane abanikazi bamasiko nemisebenzi behlanganyela. Phakathi kokuxoxa, abesifazane banikeza izifundo ngezindlela ezintsha zokuphila, behlola izindlela zokuzijabulisa. Omunye wemicimbi ebalulekile wawuhlanganisa abafundi, abathandi bezobuchwepheshe, kanye nabaphathi, okwakuholela ekuxhumaneni nokwabelana ngolwazi ngezifundo ezahlukene, ezempilo, ezokukhangisa, nezobuchwepheshe. Kwakuphawulekayo ukuzwa abesifazane bethuthukisa amakhono abo, benika amacebo okwakha imisebenzi yabo. Kwakukhona nendaba ethokozisayo, lapho osaziwayo bephendula izinkinga ezithinta abesifazane, bephendula izimpendulo ezibalulekile. USolwazi Nandi Midiya, owaziwa kakhulu ngocwaningo lwakhe emkhakheni wezempilo, uthe, “Ukuphila kwabesifazane kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukugxilwa. Abesifazane kufanele bazi ukuthi banamandla okuthinga izikhala ezibalulekile.” Lokhu kudala ukwamukela, kukhombisa umbono wobuholi obuvulekile. Umcimbi uphinde wavula amathuba okwakha izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa, okwenza abesifazane abampofu bakwazi ukwenza izaziso ezithinta umkhiqizo, nokuvuselela umoya wokukhula ezimbonini. Umcimbi wagcina ngenkulumo ebandakanya bonke, ukunikeza ithuba lokuhlonipha abesifazane abasinikeza amandla. Uthando, umoya wokubambisana, nomgomo wokuhlonipha umusa wabesifazane kwaba izici ezibalulekile. Kwaba nomoya opholile phakathi kwezingxoxo, bavelisa izimvo ezintsha zokuhamba phambili. Umcimbi waphothulwa ngodumo nolwazi olusha, olwakha isibopho esijulile phakathi kwabesifazane. Lokhu kuveza umuzwa wokuhloniphana, umoya wokukhuthazela kokubumbana, nokwakha umphakathi onobuhle. Umcimbi, obubhalwe ezincwadini, uvale ukufudumala nokuhlomula kobudlelwano phakathi kwamakhosikazi. Ekugcineni, umcimbi waholela esimisweni sokuthuthukisa inhlalakahle yabesifazane, uqhubeka ngempumelelo, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nezinhlelo ezijulile ezizokwenziwa ukuze abesifazane bahlonyiswe futhi bakhuthazwe. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikhulise izwi labo, sithuthukise izifundo, futhi sibe nomnotho owaziyo. Umcimbi ubonisa amandla amakhulu abesifazane, kumele bahlonishwe ukuze bakhule ngezifundo ezikhethekile. Abesifazane bahlonipha izilimi zabo, bahlonipha imikhuba yabo, futhi bathola amandla okwenza uma behlangana. Umcimbi uzwakalisa lokhu, ulethe izikhumbuzo ezithinta ubunjalo babo futhi nokuqhubela phambili kokwakhiwa komphakathi onokuthula nobumbano.
Umbiko: Ukufuna Umsebenzi Isingeniso Ukufuna umsebenzi kube yisiko elijulile emphakathini wethu. Kunobufakazi obuqinile bokuthi ukuthola umsebenzi kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe ukuze kuphumelele ekufuneni umsebenzi. Lo mbiko uzohlola izindlela zokufuna umsebenzi, izinselelo ezibhekene nabafuna umsebenzi, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe kulesi sikhathi sokufuna. Izindlela Zokufuna Umsebenzi I-Intanethi ibonakala iyinsiza enkulu ekufuneni umsebenzi namuhla. Amathuba okusebenza angatholakala kalula kumasayithi emisebenzi, njenge-LinkedIn, Indeed, naww.mzansimjobs.com. Ukuze uphumelele, abafuna umsebenzi bangakha amaphrofayili aqinile kulezi zinkundla, kuhlanganiswe nemibhalo efanele efana nezincwadi zokuqoka nezitifiketi. Ukwakha inethiwekhi yokuxhumana, ngokuhlanganyela emicimbini yokusebenza, kuyinzuzo enkulu; abantu bavame ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi kusetshenziswa ubudlelwano obukhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka izicelo ezivumelaniswe kahle nezidingo zomsebenzi kubalulekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafuna umsebenzi kufanele bahlaziye kahle imisebenzi ethile, bazi ngempela ukuthi abaqashi badinga ini, bese bephendula ngale ndlela. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abazimisele ngokuphelele ukufaka isandla emsebenzini. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nabafuna Umsebenzi Noma kunjalo, ukuzama ukuthola umsebenzi akuhlali kulula. Abafuna umsebenzi bangase babhekane nezinselelo eziningana, kuhlanganisa ukuncintisana okuqine phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi. Lokhu kuncintisana kwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasha emsebenzini. Futhi, imfundo engaphansi nokuqeqeshwa okungafanele kungathinta amathuba omsebenzi kwabanye. Kunoma yisiphi isikhathi sezomnotho, abaqashi bangase bacabangele ukunciphisa izindleko, lokho kungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko ezinzima emhlabeni wezamabhizinisi, njengezinguquko zezezimali kanye nokuncishiswa kwemali yokusebenza, kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi ekhaya. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuqhubekisela Phambili Ngokuqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi abafuna umsebenzi bahlele kahle indlela yabo yokufuna. Ukuze bakwazi ukuhlola izinsiza zemfundo nezokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi, bangase bakhulise amakhono abo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile nezinhlelo zokuxhasa zikhona, eziza ukusiza ukulungiselela abagibeli ezintweni ezidingekayo emhlabeni woqobo. Ukwenza izifundo eziqondile lapho uthola ukubhunga nabantu abanethalente emkhakheni ofuna ukuhamba kuwo, kuyasiza ukufundisa. Ukusiza ohulumeni, izikhungo zokuqeqesha, nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze bathole izinsiza ezingasiza kulolu hlelo lokufuna umsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwenza amandla okukhuleka, ukuqhubekela phambili kulabo abahamba phambili, kubalulekile. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukufuna umsebenzi kubambisana nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa kunamathuba amaningi akhona uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Ukukhulisa ulwazi, ukufunda futhi simbandakanye ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, kuyindlela yethu yokukuqinisekisa impumelelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukusungula umqondo othile, njengoba sifuna umsebenzi. Iziqu ezitholakele, izixhumanisi ezakhiwe, nokubeka phambili amakhono ethu kuyakwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Njengoba sisebenza sonke, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi vui ube nemugqa wokuphila ocacile, okuhloswe ukuhamba nempumelelo empilweni.
Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile kakhulu empilweni yalesi sizwe. Lezi zinsizwa nezintombi, ezikhula ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, zidlala indima enkulu ekuguqulweni komphakathi. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, intsha nayo ibonisa ukuqonda okujulile kwezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kubonakala ezimpilweni zabo, ezinqumweni abazithathayo, kanye nezifiso zabo zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Ukungasebenzi, ububha, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokukhubazeka kwezemfundo kuyizinto ezithinta kakhulu impilo yomphakathi. Kodwa intsha ayikhaleli, ibonisa amandla okukhula. Ngaphakathi komhlaba wezobuchwepheshe, lapho imithombo yolwazi ifinyeleleka kalula, intsha ikwazi ukusabalalisa imicabango nemibono yabo. Izinkampani ezincane ezisungulwa ngentsha zikhombisa ukuzimisela kwabo ukuhamba phambili. Umkhankaso wezokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, udlala indima enkulu ekuboniseni izwi lentsha. Abantu abasha baveza imicabango yabo ngokukhululeka, baphakamisa izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi, bese bexhumana nabanye abavela ezimweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, okukhombisa ukuthi intsha ingashintsha ikusasa uma ibamba iqhaza elibonakalayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanya. Intsha ibhekene nemiphumela emibi yokuxhumana okungapheli, okubandakanya ukukhathazeka, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinye izinkinga zokuphila. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuze intsha ithole usizo oludingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ubuciko obuhlukahlukene. Emculweni, emdlandlweni, nakwezobuciko, intsha ibonisa amandla ayo okudala. Umculo we-hip-hop, i-kwaito, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zikhombisa izimpilo zabo, izifiso, nokukhathazeka kwabo. Umculo, njengomkhiqizo wobuciko, uhlinzeka ngemibono yamasiko, udala umuzwa wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abasha, kubavumela ukuba babelane ngezinto abazithandayo. Ukuba khona kwezemfundo ezithuthukisiwe kucatshangelwa njengomnyango onguqobo wokwakha intsha enamandla. Izingane zisebenzisa amathuba afinyeleleka kalula okufunda, zikhulisa izinga lempumelelo. Nokho, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokufundisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola amakhono adingekayo ukuze ibhekane nezimfuno zomnotho wanamuhla. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi, kuhlanganise nabazali, othisha, nabaphathi, kubalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware edingekayo ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuvuleka kumathuba amaningi. Njengoba intsha iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhono ayo, izokwazi ukugxila ezindabeni ezisemqoka, kuhlanganise nezindaba zentando yeningi. Ekupheleni, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ibonisa amandla, ubukhona, nezifiso ezinzima. Njengoba ibhekene nezinselelo zansuku zonke, ibonisa amandla okuphila, okudala, nokufunda. Umphakathi kumele usebenzisane ukuze uthuthukise amathuba okukhula, uqinisekise ukuthi intsha ithola ukuvuselela imicabango, futhi ibhekele phambili. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwentsha, umphakathi, nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuyinto esiyidingayo ukuze sikhule sizimele. Intsha iyinhloko yeNingizimu Afrika, futhi ikusasa lethu lincike ekutheni sikhuluma futhi silalela izwi labo.
Inyama Yenkomo: Ukubuyekezwa Kwekhwalithi Nempilo Inyama yenkomo, eyaziwa ngesiNgisi ngokuthi "beef," iyinsika ebalulekile emndenini wethu, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Iphakathi kwezithako ezisemqoka ezithokozisa izibiliboco zethu, futhi ibalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zenyama yenkomo, kuhlanganise nekhwalithi yayo, izinzuzo zempilo, nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuyipheka. Ikhwalithi Yenkomo Ukukhetha inyama yenkomo ehamba phambili kubalulekile. Inyama enempilo ibonakala ibomvu, inamafutha alinganiselwe, futhi inamathambo aqinile. Ukuze uthole inyama engcono, kubalulekile ukukhetha izinkomo ezikhuliswa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa kwemithi yokukhulisa. Izinkomo ezikhuliswa emapulazini anokunakekelwa kahle, ezithola ukudla okuphumelelayo, zikhulisa inyama enempilo, enezinga eliphezulu lezinhlayiya ezidingekayo emzimbeni. Izinzuzo Zempilo Inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu yokudla okunempilo. Iqukethe amaprotheni aphezulu, avumela ukukhula kwemisipha kanye nokwakhiwa kwezicubu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iqukethe amavithamini ahlukahlukene, njenge-B12, ebalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kwezinzwa. Iphinde ibe nezinhlayiya ezibalulekile, ezifana ne-iron, ezisiza ekwakheni igazi elinempilo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuyidla ngokulinganisela, ngoba amafutha amaningi angaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Izindlela Zokupheka Inyama yenkomo ingaphekwa ngezindlela eziningi, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuyihlanganisa nezitsha ezahlukene. Ukupheka inyama yenkomo kuhlanganisa izindlela ezinjenge-grilling, roasting, frying, noma slow cooking. Ukupheka ku-grill kuveza ukunambitheka okuhle, kanti i-roasting iyindlela ethokozisayo yokuthola inyama ethambile. I-slow cooking, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ivumela izithako ukuba zixube kahle, ikhiqiza isobho elinothile nelinambitheka. Izithako Ezihambisanayo Inyama yenkomo ihambisana kahle nezinye izithako, njengezithombo, imifino, kanye nezinkwa. Ukusebenzisa imifino efana ne-broccoli, carrots, noma izaqathe kuhlobisa ukudla, futhi kuqinisa inani lempilo. Izithako ezinjenge-garlic, rosemary, noma thyme zingathuthukisa ukunambitheka kwenyama, zenza kube mnandi kakhulu. Ukugcina Inyama Yenkomo Ukugcina inyama yenkomo ngendlela efanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ihlale iphilile. Kubalulekile ukuyigcina endaweni epholile, futhi uma ungayisebenzisi ngokushesha, kufanele uyifake efrijini. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi inyama iyagcinwa kahle, qiniseka ukuthi ibhalwe kahle ukuze ungabi nekhanda lokuthi iyashintsha ukunambitheka. Isiphetho Inyama yenkomo iyinsika ebalulekile ekudleni kwethu, inikeza izinzuzo eziningi zempilo, futhi iyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa izitsha ezahlukene. Ukukhetha inyama enempilo, ukuyipheka ngendlela efanele, nokuyigcina kahle, kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi uthola okunambitheka okuhle nokunempilo. Ngakho-ke, uma uthanda ukudla okuhle, ungaphuthelwa yithuba lokujabulela inyama yenkomo, eyenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Umthombo Wempilo Ngiyanemukela nongakholwa, sonke siyavuma ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile yinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Hhayi kuphela ukuthi asisiza siphuze, kodwa futhi anendima enkulu ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo. Ngokweqiniso, uma uthanda impilo, umkhuba wokuphila kahle udinga amahlanga amanzi ahlanzekile, akusaphumi ebuhleni. Siyazi ukuthi emiphakathini eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali kalula. Abantu basalokhu besebenzisa amanzi angahlanzekile okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezifana nezifo. Abantwana, izinsizwa, nabantu abadala bakhathazekile ngama bacteria nezifo ezihamba ngamanzi. Ngakho, kulungile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile iyinto ebalulekile kangangokuthi zingaba nemithelela eminingi empilweni yethu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi sizuze amanzi ahlanzekile? Kunezindlela eziningi, ezithokozisayo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uqale, singasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo endaweni yethu. Akukhona konke okungama-filter akhulu nababili. Kulungile ukufaka izinto ezilula ezifana nokuhlunga ngensimbi noma imithombo yemvelo, lokhu kuzodala indawo yokuphila engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumqoka ukuthi sifunde indlela yokugcina amanzi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amanzi akhanyisa? Uma sikhuluma ngemuva kokutsha, sikhuluma ngezinto ezinjengokuhlanza izinto, ukoma nokususa imfucumfucu. Lokhu akuhlungu, kodwa ukufaka ingqondo yokubheka izinsiza eziphumelela kakhulu, sizofinyelela kuhlo lwamazwe anenhlanzeko. Futhi, asikho isikhathi sokuyengela, kudinga ukusitsha umoya wokuzisholo. Uma senze kube yinqaba ukuba sikhuthazelele labanye abantu ukugcina amanzi ahlanzekile, sizoba nemiphumela emihle. Nakanjani, ukuhlangana kwemiphakathi kwenziwa njalo, sikushiya isikhathi sokubambisana ukuze sibe neqhaza ekwenzeni la manzi sizithokozise. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sikhuthazelele amaqhinga akhuluma ngokulondoloza amanzi, ngaleyo ndlela siphephe ezinkingeni. Uma sithenge imiphakathi sihlale sinesikhumbuzo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali kalula, kufanele sikhulume ngezinsiza ezinhle, ezizofaka esikhaleni, ukuhlanganyela nezinsiza ezikhiqiza amanzi ahlanzekile. Ubufakazi bokhuzi obuphumile, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuze sithole amahle. Ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile kusho impilo engcono nokusiza izimpilo zabantu, kukhulisa umqondo wempilo. Ungekho omncane, kusho lolu daba lunemvela enkulu. Ngakho, bonke abanye, sambulela ngezimpendulo, zisesikhathini senhlalakahle, singafinyelela emiphumeleni ethokozisayo. Kubalulekile ukwakha amandla empilo, lapho amanzi ahlanzekile ayingxenye ebalulekile yonke. Hhayi ukuhlola, kodwa ukunikela emiphakathini yethu, sizobe sikhanyisa umhlaba. Sekukhona konke kufanele kudingedwe, lawula abanye, ukubhaqa nokuhlukana kethu. Uma sazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile akhishelwe emhlabeni, sizoshintsha umbono wethu. Sizokwazi ukuphila ngokuphelele, phakathi kwezithako nezimo ezintsha, nezinye izinto ezenzakalayo. Ngasikhathi sinye, asikwenzi buhlungu, sithanda ukwenza umkhumbulo. Umthombo wempilo usimele sithole amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, asiweni emqondweni uma sesihamba kumathuba ohluzi nomthombo wempilo, kepha asimukele ukuhamba nolwazi. Noma imithombo yethu iyimpunga, sikhumbula ibhizinisi likaThuli, kumele siqhubeke senze kahle. Hamba, hamba kahle nathi, sibe nezilungiselelo ezibalulekile, akusikhumbulo, kodwa sizobambisana, khona-ke sisho ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba siphetha, amanzi ahlanzekile awusizo kuphela kithi, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sibhale izinhlelo ezinzima, ngesiqalile, besigcinile esikhahlelweni somoya wayo. Noma bekuhlonishwa nabantu, hamba uqhubeke, sasithanda amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngiyabonga!
Ibhola Lombhoxo (Rugby) Umbuzo 1: Yini ibhola lombhoxo? Ibhola lombhoxo, noma i-rugby, umdlalo odlalwa ngamaqembu amabili, lapho umgomo uwukudlulisela ibhola emgqeni ophakeme ukuze uthole amaphuzu. Umdlalo uvame ukudlalwa emhlabeni jikelele, futhi unama-variations ahlukene, njenge-Rugby Union ne-Rugby League. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimiso eziyisisekelo zomdlalo? Izimiso eziyisisekelo zomdlalo zifaka phakathi ukugijima, ukudlulisela ibhola, nokuvikela. Abadlali badinga ukwazi ukusebenzisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele, futhi umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaqembu. Umbuzo 3: Yini edlalwa ngempela emkhakheni we-rugby? Emkhakheni we-rugby, umphakathi udlala indima enkulu. Abadlali bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi umphakathi ubakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Umdlalo ubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokudlala ibhola lombhoxo? Ibhola lombhoxo inezinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomzimba, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokufundisa amakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Abadlali bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza umphakathi ube namandla. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenza ibhola lombhoxo lihluke kwezinye izemidlalo? Ibhola lombhoxo lihluke kwezinye izemidlalo ngenxa yokugxila kwalo ekubambisaneni. Umdlalo udinga abadlali ukuba basebenze ndawonye, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdlalo unokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu, okwenza kube mnandi kubadlali nababukeli. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakala emidlalweni ye-rugby? Emidlalweni ye-rugby, abadlali bafunda izifundo ezibalulekile, ezifana nokuhlonipha, ukuzimisela, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Umbuzo 7: Umdlalo we-rugby unethonya kanjani emphakathini? Umdlalo we-rugby unethonya elikhulu emphakathini. Uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi udala amathuba okuxhumana. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele uyazi uma uqala ukudlala ibhola lombhoxo? Uma uqala ukudlala ibhola lombhoxo, kubalulekile ukufunda izimiso zomdlalo, ukwakha amakhono, nokuzivocavoca. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuba neqhaza elihle, ukuze uthole ulwazi olungcono nolwaziyo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabadlali be-rugby? Abadlali be-rugby babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokulimala, ukuncintisana, nokuphumelela. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinselelo zifundisa abadlali ukuba bahlale beqaphile, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuzimisela. Umbuzo 10: Kungani ibhola lombhoxo libalulekile emhlabeni jikelele? Ibhola lombhoxo libalulekile emhlabeni jikelele ngoba lihlanganisa abantu, lishintsha izimpilo, futhi likhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi ubonisa amandla okusebenza ndawonye. Isiphetho: Ibhola lombhoxo, njengomdlalo, ungaphezu kokudlala; ungumoya, ubudlelwano, kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onamandla, futhi ufundisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze udlale, cabanga ngalesi sikhathi sokuzama, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuthi umphakathi wakho ungakwenza kube mnandi.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Inkinga Ethinta Bonke Isimo sezulu emhlabeni sishintsha ngokushesha, futhi lokhu sekuyinkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusikhulumi nje ngokunyuka kokushisa emhlabeni, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa nezinguquko ezinkulu eziphathelene nemvula, izikhukhula, nezimo zokuphila kwezilwane nezitshalo. Lezi zinguquko zidalwa ikakhulukazi abantu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide (CO2) nezinye izinto ezilimazayo emoyeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sikhulume ngale nkinga, sihlole izimbangela zayo, kanye nemiphumela ezoba nayo empilweni yethu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimbangela zokuguquka kwesimo sezulu zikhona emithonjeni eminingi. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, kanye nezimboni ezikhiqiza kakhulu zenza kube nokukhishwa okukhulu kwegesi ye-carbon. Lokhu kukhishwa kuholela ekwandeni kwegesi ye-greenhouse, okwenza umoya ushise kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo, njengokuhweba ngamafutha, kuveza ingozi enkulu emvelweni. Izimboni ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo eminingi zidinga amandla amaningi, okwandisa ukusabalala kwegesi eluhlaza. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ohlangene, lapho izenzo zethu zikhuphula izinkinga ezithinta isimo sezulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu ibonakala kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izimo zezulu ezinzima, njengezikhukhula, izivunguvungu, nezomiso, zikhula njalo. Lokhu kuholela ekuhluphekeni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu, ezinjengase-Afrika nasemazweni asathuthuka. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, izindlu, nezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane nezitshalo zihlushwa yizinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zazo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlala. Ngokubheka lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela isimo sezulu. Ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze imiphakathi yethu ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekulweni nale nkinga, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikelwa kokuphila kwethu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa imiphumela. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokulawula izimo zezulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela ezindaweni ezibhekene nezingozi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphila ezimeni ezinzima, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Uma singenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela imiphakathi yethu, izilwane, nezitshalo ezithinteka kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusikho okwenziwa yizizwe ezithile kuphela, kodwa kuyinkinga yomhlaba wonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi amazwe ahlanganyele ukuze abhekane nale nkinga. Ukuhlela imihlangano yamazwe omhlaba, njengokuhlangana kwe-Paris Climate Agreement, kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzovumela amazwe ukuthi abambisane, ahlanganyele izinsiza, futhi athole izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona nje inkinga yesikhathi eside, kodwa futhi kuyinkinga esidinga izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Njengoba izimo zezulu ziqhubeka zishintsha, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuqonda, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwethu sonke. Ekugcineni, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa kwethu. Njengabantu, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo, sishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nale nkinga. Uma singenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela imvelo, izilwane, nezitshalo, futhi sigcine impilo yethu. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje okuthinta izwe, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Ngakho-ke, akusikho isikhathi sokubheka phansi, kodwa isikhathi sokusebenza ndawonye ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Ezokushicilela - Ingxoxo noMshicileli Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnumzane Sipho Mthethwa, umshicileli ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokushicilela. U-Sipho ungumuntu oneminyaka engama-15 esebenza kulesi sikhala, futhi ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izincwadi ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezincwadini zezingane kuya ezincwadini ezinzima. Ngiyajabula ukukwazi, Sipho. Ungangichazela kancane ngempilo yakho njengomshicileli? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Impilo yami njengomshicileli iqale ngenkathi ngisemncane, ngithanda ukufunda izincwadi. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami, ngathola ithuba lokusebenza emnyangweni wezokushicilela, futhi ngashintsha umbono wami wokuthi izincwadi zingaba kanjani. Ngiyazi ukuthi umshicileli akasishayeli kuphela, kodwa uphinde abe umxhumanisi phakathi kwababhali nabafundi. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukubaluleka kokushicilela Umbuzo: Kutheni ubona ukuthi ezokushicilela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu? U-Sipho: Ezokushicilela zibalulekile ngoba zenza kube nokwabelana ngolwazi, izinkolelo, nezindaba. Zisiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukufunda, ukukhuluma, nokuxoxa. Ngaphandle kokushicilela, izincwadi eziningi ezibalulekile zingalahleka, futhi imicabango emisha ingavela. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezweni lethu, lapho sinesiko elicebile lokulandisa. Isigaba sesibili: Izinkinga ezibhekene nezokushicilela Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezinkulu obhekene nazo emkhakheni wezokushicilela? U-Sipho: Kunezinkinga eziningi, kodwa eyodwa enkulu yikhono lokufinyelela. Ababhali abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi namathuba okushicilela, ikakhulukazi abavela ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Futhi, izindleko zokushicilela zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubabhali abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhona umncintiswano omkhulu, njengoba izincwadi zedijithali zikhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokushicilela ukuze sikwazi ukuheha abafundi. Isigaba sesithathu: Ubuchwepheshe obusha Umbuzo: Ucabanga kanjani ngendima yobuchwepheshe ekushicileleni? U-Sipho: Ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela esishicilela ngayo. Izincwadi zedijithali zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezincwadini, futhi zinciphisa izindleko. Lokhu kuvuleka amathuba amasha kubabhali, njengoba bengakwazi ukuzishicilela kalula. Nokho, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abufanele buphumelele kuphela uma sikhumbula ukubaluleka kokubhala okuhle. Akukhona konke okukhona ku-inthanethi okungamukelekile. Isigaba sesine: Ukuthuthukiswa kwababhali Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ababhali abasha? U-Sipho: Sisebenza ngokubambisana nababhali abasha, sibanikeza izifundo zokubhala, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokushicilela. Siphinde sibe nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, lapho ababhali bengathola khona uxhaso lokushicilela izincwadi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithanda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi lababhali abasha lizwa, futhi izincwadi zabo zifinyelela kubafundi. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukubheka phambili Umbuzo: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lezokushicilela? U-Sipho: Ngibona ikusasa lezokushicilela linokukhanya. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela abafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izincwadi ezibhaliwe kahle zizohlala zibalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zishicilelwa kanjani. Umsebenzi wethu njengomshicileli uwukugcina lezi zincwadi zikhona, zifinyeleleke, futhi zibe nomthelela. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Sipho, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi nathi. Ukukhuluma nawe kuveza kahle ukuthi ezokushicilela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, futhi zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze ziqhubeke nokukhula. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izincwadi eziningi ezinhle ezivela kubabhali abasha.
Izindaba Zomphakathi: Uthando Lokubambisana Luthembisa Ukukhula Kwezakhamizi eMgungundlovu UMgungundlovu – Esifundazweni saseKwaZulu-Natal, umphakathi ubambisene ukuze udale izindlela ezinzima zokuxazulula izinkinga ezahlukene ezibhekene nalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kuhlangana kwemiphakathi kwakhula kwazalwa izinhlelo eziningi zentuthuko ezenzakalayo, okukhuluma khona ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Uhlelo lomphakathi, olwaqanjwa ngokuthi "Siyavuma", lwasungulwa ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi lwahlomula ezinhlelweni ezibandakanya imfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthengisa. Izithakazelo ezicacile zikaHulumeni, ezakhamizini, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ziye zashumeka nemigomo ethile yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. UJohnson Mthembu, usomabhizinisi ophumelelayo endimeni yokwentengiselwano, ukhuluma ngezizathu zokungena kulolu hlelo. Uthi: “Ngizizwe ngishaywa ngento yokubambisana. Nakhu ukuthi, uma sibambene singenza izinto ezinkulu. Abantu bethu badinga izindlela zokuphila ezbetter. Ngimnene ngifuna ukusiza umphakathi. Impilo iyashintsha uma sikhulumisana.” Uhlelo lwe-Siyavuma luhlobene nokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abakufinyelela, okuhlanganisa nohlelo lokufundisa abesifazane ngezinhlelo zokuphila, ezokusebenza, nezokuthengisa. Izifundo zifinyelela kubantu abaningi, futhi zikhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane avela ngaphakathi komphakathi. Abesifazane abaninzi baveze ukuthi sebevele benza imisebenzi yezenhlalakahle, ekhombisa impumelelo enkulu phakathi kwezithakazelo ezilindelekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, abesifazane kanye nabesilisa bahlanganisa imizamo yokugcina izinga lemfundo liphezulu, lapho abantu behlanganyela ezicathulweni zamakilasi asekhaya. KwaMhlekazi Primary School, othisha bahlonishwa ngeqhaza labo elikhulu ekwandiseni ukufunda kwabantu abasha. Uthishanhloko, uNksz. Ndlovu, uthi: “Siyabona izinga lempumelelo labafundi lishintshile. Impumelelo yethu ayidingi ukunganqikiwe.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwenhlalakahle luhlanganisa izinsiza zabantu abahlelekile, njengokusiqinisekisa nokwazisa ngempilo. Abahlali bahlonishwa ngemizamo yabo yokuphakamisa abantu abahlangeneyo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zezempilo, kanye nokufundiswa okuthumelelayo ngomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezempilo oluzenzakalayo luthuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu abaningi, futhi luthumele izikhumbuzo ezinhle zokuthi umphakathi kumele uhambisane. Nokho, akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili kwezinyathelo zentuthuko. Umphakathi ubhekana nezinselelo ezithile, njengezinkinga zezokuthutha nezinsiza ezikhulayo. Ukuze baqhubeke bephumelela, umphakathi uhlele izinhlelo zokuhlela imisebenzi eqondile yokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubambisana nezinkampani zezokuthutha, okuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwabantu, nezimpahla zokubiza izimpahla ezithandwayo. Ukwakhiwa kwemibondela eqinile phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi kudinga ukuthi abantu babambisane, futhi benze izinqumo ezibhekelela ikusasa. Ukuhlomula kwempumelelo kudinga ukunakekela, ukwazisa, nokuthuthukisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhula. Abantu bahlazile ukuthi ukuphumelela kokuqala kuhlangana nokubambisana. Njengoba uhulumeni, ezikhungweni, kanye nabantu bezinsiza bezama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlukene, imiphakathi ifuna ukuphinde ibonakale ibe namandla. Uthando lokuhlanganyela, kanti ukuxoxisana kwezinto ezahlukene kudinga ukusizakala njalo. Impilo enempumelelo isekelwe kwakukhanya okukhulu kwezindlela ezixhumene ndawonye. Uma kudingeka ukwaziswa ngokwandisa izinsiza, izimanga ziyaziwa. I-Siyavuma igxile ngendlela elula yokuphila, ibonisa ukuthi uma umphakathi ubambisene, izinkinga ezingokwenhlalakahle zingaxazululwa kalula. Ngamafuphi, izindaba zomphakathi zikhuluma ngempumelelo, ubumbano, kanye nokukhula. Uhlelo lwe-Siyavuma lukhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kukhombisa ukuthi uthando lomphakathi lungabuthaka abantu, kuphumelele impilo yezakhamizi. Njengoba sigubha lo msebenzi wobumbano, kuthiwe kulindeleke ukusebenza okwengeziwe nezindlela ezintsha zokuxhasa, ukuze kuhlale kuhamba phambili ukusebenza nakho. Okwamanje, umphakathi ubhalisela ukuba ngosuku olulandelayo, uqhubeke ubonisa indlela yokuphumelela eyeqisayo. Uthando lokubambisana luhlala lukhula, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukukwazi ukwakha ukuxhumana okujulile emiphakathini. Lo mkhankaso ubonisa ukuthi asishiyi muntu ngemuva, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi wakwaMlaba uhlala uphila omuhle.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Eziphansi Emazweni amaningi, ukudla kubalulekile empilweni, kodwa emindenini eshoda ngemali, izinkinga zokudla ziba yinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile ukuze sikwazi ukusiza lezi miphakathi. Izinkinga zokudla zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kokudla, ukungabi namali yokuthenga ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezimo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuntuleka Kokudla Okokuqala, emindenini eshoda ngemali, ukuntuleka kokudla kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya, bahlushwa yizithiyo zokufinyelela ezitolo zokudla. Lokhu kungenxa yezizathu eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemithombo yokuhamba, ukungabi namali, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ethile ibhekane nokudla okunganele, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Ukungabi Namali Yokuthenga Ukudla Okunempilo Okwesibili, ukungabi namali yokuthenga ukudla okunempilo kuyinkinga enkulu. Imindeni eminingi eshoda ibhekene nezindleko eziphezulu zokudla okunempilo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla eziyisisekelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ikhethe ukudla okungasekho emthethweni, okubangela izinkinga zempilo ezifana nezifo zenhliziyo, izinkinga zesikhumba, kanye nezinye izifo ezihlobene nokudla. Izimo Zokuphila Ezinzima Okwesithathu, izimo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni ngokudla okunempilo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezimo zokuhlala eziyinkimbinkimbi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kokudla Imiphumela yokuntuleka kokudla emindenini eshoda ibalulekile. Ukudla okunganele kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, okubandakanya izifo ezahlukene, ukwehla kwemithwalo yemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda ezinganeni. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo enhle nezinselelo ezithinta impilo. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Ukudla Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokudla emindenini eshoda, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa ngemikhuba yokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa imindeni ngezindlela zokupheka ezilula, ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezindlela zokulima ezilula. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ngezimali zingasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlinzeka ngezikhwama zokudla ezithile, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisa imisebenzi. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izinkinga zokudla emindenini eshoda zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokuqonda izizathu eziholela kulezi zinkinga, singakwazi ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokudla, kudingeka sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufundisa, sithuthukise amathuba emisebenzi, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imindeni ithola ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo, kwandise amathuba, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesandla ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga ukuze sifeze umgomo wempilo engcono.
UNovak Djokovic – Umgibeli Ophakeme Kakhulu U- Novak Djokovic, igama elikhanyayo emhlabeni we-tennis, uyinkanyezi yezenhlalo nezemidlalo, futhi ubonakala engumgibeli ophakeme kakhulu emlandweni wezokungcebeleka. Njengoba sibheka izimpumelelo zakhe nezimpikiswano ezimzungezile, kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi ubuchule bakhe buye buphinde baphakanyiswe ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe empilweni, okuyinto eyenza ahluke kwabanye abadlali abavela ezikhathini ezahlukene. U- Djokovic, odabuka eSerbia, uthole izifundo zokulwa nezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezimpilo zakhe. Kusukela ebuntwaneni, wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa ubephikelela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono akhe. Lokhu kuhlola amakhono akhe, nokuba nesibindi sokubhekana nemiphumela, kuveza isimo esinamandla esihlanganisa ubuchule, ukuphikelela, nokuzimisela. Abaningi bangase bacabange ukuthi umgibeli ophakeme kufanele ube nekhono lokudlala kuphela, kodwa u- Djokovic ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila ngendlela ethile, ukufunda nokukhula, kubalulekile empumelelweni. Emhlabeni we-tennis, u- Djokovic uyinhlangano yokusebenza kanzima. Ubuye abe ngumgibeli ophumelelayo kakhulu, eqhathaniswa noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal. Nokho, impumelelo yakhe ayigcini nje ngama-titles ayishumi nane eGrand Slam, kodwa ibonisa ibhuku lokuphikisana, impilo yokusebenza, kanye nemizamo yokwakha umphakathi. U- Djokovic unamaqiniso akhe, abuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezokwelapha kanye nezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kuhambisana nokwaziswa komphakathi, okubonisa ukuthi umphakathi nokuphila kahle kubalulekile. Nokho, u- Djokovic akagcini nje ngokuba umgibeli ophumelelayo. Ubuye abe nomthelela ophathelene nezinkinga ezinzima, ezifana nezinkinga zokwelashwa. Izinqumo zakhe zikhombisa ukuthi ungumuntu ophikisana nezinkolelo ezijwayelekile, futhi ubeka phambili izinkolelo zakhe. Lokhu kwenze abanye bamhleke, kanti abanye baphinde bamsize, bayabona ukuthi u- Djokovic ungumuntu ophakathi kokuphikisana nokuphumelelayo. Ingabe lokho kumenza ahluke kwabanye? U- Djokovic ubonisa izici ezinhle zokuba ngumholi, nokuhleleka okuhle kokuphila. Ubuye abe nesimo esiqinile sokumelwa kwabantu abakhuluma ngempumelelo, noma ngabe kungenzeka kubaluleke kakhulu kumuntu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo ayiweli kuphela emikhawulweni yezezimali, kodwa ikhuluma ngezifiso, izinkolelo, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile empilweni. Isimo sika- Djokovic sisesimweni sokuba ngumsebenzi ohlanganyela nabanye. Ubuye abe nomthelela ophathelene nezempilo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ungumgibeli osebenza ngokuhlanganyela nempilo yabanye. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye, abazimisele ukusiza abanye, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. U- Djokovic uyisibonelo sokuthi impumelelo ayigcini kuphela kumuntu oyedwa, kodwa ibalulekile emndenini nasemphakathini. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka u- Djokovic, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhlanganisa izici eziningi. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqumo eziphusile, okukhombisa ukuthi akafuni kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa ufunela abantu abaninzi impilo engcono. Lokhu kungenza abanye bakhumbule ukuthi umgibeli ophakeme akufanele ukuba yedwa, kodwa kufanele abe nelungelo lokuphila ngekhanda eliphezulu, alwe nezinkinga, futhi abekezelele izimfuno zempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela ka- Djokovic uzohlala ungena emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi umuntu angaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, noma ngabe umphakathi ukhathazekile. U- Djokovic akagcini nje ngokuba ngumgibeli ophumelelayo, kodwa ubonisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinkolelo eziqinile, sibe nemigomo emihle, futhi sisebenze ukuze sifeze izifiso zethu. Ekugcineni, uNovak Djokovic ungumgibeli ophakeme, owaziwa ngezimpumelelo zakhe, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ubonisa indlela yokuphila edinga ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela, ukuzibophezela, kanye nemigomo ethile. Njengabantu, kufanele sifunde ku- Djokovic, siqonde ukuthi impumelelo ayikhawulwanga kweminye imikhakha, kodwa ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu, empilweni yabanye, kanye nasemphakathini. Uziqhenyise, u- Djokovic, njengoba ukhombisa ukuthi ubungcweti, ukuzikhandla, kanye nesibindi sokuphikisana, kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela.
### ITable Mountain: Intaba Ethokozisayo Ekhaya Ekhazimulayo LaseKapa Ekhaya elihle laseKapa, lapho imifula ibhalela izinkanyezi phezulu, kukhona intaba eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi iTable Mountain. Le ntaba, enezinhlangothi eziphakeme nezimfushane, ibonakala njengendawo ethokozisayo ebhalwe ngothando lwemvelo. ITable Mountain iyinsika yalesi siqhingi, ibhalela izinkanyezi zayo ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le ntaba yahlala ibalulekile kubantu bendawo. Abantu ababehlala eduze bavele bejabulela ukuhamba ngezinyawo, bephokophela phezulu, behlola ubuhle bayo. Umoya ohlanzekile, izihlahla ezimibalabala, nezinyoni ezithokozisayo zakhanga abaningi. Babekwazi ukuhamba phezulu, behlangana nemvelo, behlola izimangaliso zayo. Nokho, le ntaba ayigcini nje ngokuba yindawo yokuhlala; iyindawo yokucabanga, yokuphila, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezindaba zothando, ubuhlungu, nokuphumelela. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo emoyeni, behamba phansi, befaka izinkumbulo zabo ezithokozisayo. ITable Mountain yayiyisikhumbuzo sothando, ubuhlungu, nezifiso eziphakeme. Ngesikhathi sokuphila kwamaXhosa, iTable Mountain yabe iyindawo ebalulekile. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngamaNdebele, amaKhoisan, nabanye abantu ababehlala kule ndawo. Le ntaba yayiyingxenye yempilo yabo, ibabamba ngezandla, ibanika amandla. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinzima, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngezikhathi zokujabula, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlola izimangaliso zayo.
