Nokho, njengoba izinkanyezi zikhuluma, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyashintsha. Umhlaba uthola izinguquko, futhi iTable Mountain ayiphunyukanga kulokhu. Izikhathi zashintsha, abantu baphila ngezindlela ezahlukene, kodwa le ntaba yayihlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zayo ezikhanyayo. ITable Mountain iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma yini eyenzekayo, imvelo izohlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi, izizukulwane zashintsha, kodwa iTable Mountain yahlala ibalulekile. Abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa imicabango yabo, behamba ngezinyawo, behlola izimangaliso zayo. ITable Mountain yabe iyindawo yokuhlangana, yokuxoxa, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, le ntaba yahlala ibalulekile. Abantu baphila ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, kodwa iTable Mountain yahlala ibalulekile. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba eKapa, ungaphuthelwa ithuba lokuhlola le ntaba. ITable Mountain iyindawo yokuhlangana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nokuhamba ngezinyawo. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu baphila ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, kodwa iTable Mountain iyinsika yempilo. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngakho-ke, hamba uye eKapa, ubone iTable Mountain, uzwe izinkanyezi zayo, futhi uhlanganyele nalesi sikhathi esikhethekile. ITable Mountain izohlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli.
Abadlali Bebhola Abadumile Ibhola lezinyawo, elibizwa nangokuthi ibhola, liyinsika enkulu emhlabeni, linabantu abaningi abathanda ukuhamba, ukudlala, nokuxoxa ngalo. Phakathi kwale midlalwano, kukhona abadlali abaninzi abavelele nabathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yemiphumela yabo. Kulokhu, sizobheka abadlali bebhola abadumile, imisebenzi yabo, kanye nomthelela abawenza emhlabeni jikelele. Ukwaziswa Ngabadlali Abadumile Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi, kodwa ikhono labo lokudlala libaluleke kakhulu. Abanye baziwa ngempumelelo yabo kumqhudelwano omkhulu, njengeFIFA World Cup, iChampions League, noma emakhampasini emazwe. Abanye baziwa ngamaqembu abawadlalela, njengamaqembu afana neBarcelona, Real Madrid, Manchester United, neBayern Munich. UMessi noRonaldo: Izinkanyezi Zamanje Omunye wabadlali abaziwa kakhulu nguLionel Messi. UMessi, odlalela iParis Saint-Germain (PSG), ubhekwa njengomunye wabadlali abakhulu besikhathi. Uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neBallon d'Or, okuyisicoco esinikezwa kumdlali ophakeme. Ubuye abe nekhono elikhulu lokudlala, ukuhamba, nokuphosa amabhola, okwenza kube nzima kubavikeli ukumvimba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uCristiano Ronaldo, odlalela iAl Nassr, naye ungomunye wabadlali abaziwa kakhulu. U-Ronaldo uphinde wathola izindondo eziningi, futhi ubalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. U-Ronaldo unamandla amakhulu, futhi uyaziwa ngokuphosa amabhola anamandla, okwenza kube nzima kubavikeli. Abanye Abadlali Abadumile Ngaphandle kukaMessi noRonaldo, kukhona nabanye abadlali abavelele. UNeymar, odlalela iPSG, ungomunye wabadlali abathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okuthokozisayo. UMbappe, osemncane, naye ungomunye wabadlali abavelele, futhi ubhekwa njengomunye wabadlali abasha abakhombisa ikusasa elihle. UDavid Beckham, owayedlalela iManchester United, ungomunye wabantu abaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Umthelela Wabadlali BeBola Emphakathini Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yabo. Bahlala bephakamisa izinga lezemidlalo, futhi bahlala bejabulisa abantu. Abanye bazo basebenzisa udumo lwabo ukusiza abanye, ngokwesibonelo, ngokuxhasa imikhankaso yokusiza, izikhungo zemfundo, noma imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali bebhola bahlala benomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini, bukhulisa imikhiqizo, futhi baphakamisa izinga lokuthengisa, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini. Isiphetho Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala bephakamisela abantu ithemba, futhi bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. UMessi, uRonaldo, uNeymar, noMbappe baveza ukuthi ibhola akusikho kuphela ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abadlali abavelele bahlala benza okuningi ngaphandle kokudlala, futhi baphakamisa umoya wokubambisana, umphakathi, kanye nezifiso zabantu. Ibhola liyinsika yokuxhumanisa abantu, futhi abadlali bayo bahlala bephakamisela umhlaba umoya ophakeme.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu Kwake kwaba khona emaphakathini amancane, izindawo ezinhle ezazikha phezulu ezindaweni ezimhlophe, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona ngobuhle bazo. Kule ndawo, uMnumzane Jabulani, oneminyaka engama-60, wayehamba ngebhasi lakhe lezemidlalo, edabula izintaba eziphakeme nezimfudumalo. UJabulani wayehlonishwa ngababukeli, ngenxa yokuhlonipha nokunakekela imvelo. Njalo ngoMsombuluko, ubaba Jabulani wayeqala usuku lwakhe ngokuhamba uye emoyeni, ethanda ukuzwa umoya opholile uhamba phakathi kwezihlahla. Kodwa namuhla kwaba nokuthile okungajwayelekile. Izinyoni, ezazithokozisa ngengoma yazo, zazithule. Izihlahla, ezazihamba phezu kwendawo, zaziza nezinyembezi. UJabulani wacabanga ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba, uJabulani wabona umbala obomvu, owawukhanya emkhathini. Uma ebheka phezulu, wabona izinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya, kodwa kube khona umoya omkhulu, okwakuhambisana nezinto ezishisayo ezazikhipha umoya omubi. UJabulani wanqena ukuba konakalisa imvelo, kodwa akazange athathe lezi zimo kalula. "Kukhona okungahambi kahle," wacabanga. UJabulani wathola ukuthi izitshalo ziqala ukushabalala, izilwanyana ziya phezulu zibhakabhaka, nokuthi izinkanyezi eziluhlaza ziye zashintsha zaba mnyama. Umphakathi wawusokhakhathini, futhi abantu babengaphili kahle. UJabulani, njengomfowethu, wathatha isinqumo. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano wesigceme, lapho abantu bangaba khona ukuze baxoxe ngalesi simo esinzima. Kuzongxoxwa ngezindlela zokuvikela imvelo nokubuyisela indlela esiphila ngayo. "Siyabonga uNkulunkulu, kodwa sinesibopho sokukhulisa imvelo yethu," kusho uJabulani. Abantu bacasuka, behlola ubukhona bezinkanyezi, bejabulisa ngempela, kodwa bebona ukuthi izinguquko zikhona. UJabulani wabona ukuthi kudinga umzamo ongenamkhawulo. Bafaka izinhlelo zokukhulisa izihlahla, baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. UJabulani wabona ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje ukuphazamiseka, kodwa kuyinselele efinyelela kubo bonke. Izindlela zokuvikela imvelo zaba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo idinga ukunakekelwa. Kwaze kwaba yimpumelelo, izitshalo zabuya zakhula futhi izilwanyana zafika, izinyoni zaphinda zathokozisa, futhi izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu emkhathini. UJabulani wababiza bonke babukele lezi zinkanyezi, ukuze bazethembe, futhi baveze lokhu okubhalwe emandleni. "Umhlaba wethu uhlezi, kodwa udinga ukuba sibe nesibopho. Ngaphandle komhlaba, asikho," wakhuluma uJabulani. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waba nolwazi, walwela ukugcina imvelo, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela lezi zinto ezinhle. Ngalesi sikhathi, uJabulani wakwazisa osomabhizinisi ukuthi bangasebenzisa izinsiza zabo ukusiza ukugcinwa kwemvelo. Bafaka izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela imvelo, bese benza izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokulima. UJabulani waba yisibonelo, umholi wezinguquko, futhi umphakathi wawuhlala ungena emhlabeni omusha. Ngesikhathi uhamba emkhathini, uJabulani wathokozisa umoya opholile, wabona izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu. Wayezazi kahle ukuthi umhlaba ubuhlungu, kodwa abanye babekwazi ukuguqula, futhi ukuthi bonke kumele basebenze ndawonye. "Akekho ongakwenza yedwa, kodwa uma sikhonza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuvuna," wakhuluma uJabulani. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi wathola isifundo esijulile, ngokuqonda ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusona isimo esiphakeme, kodwa yisinyathelo esifanele sokubhekana nemvelo. Ngakho, uJabulani waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imvelo iyigugu, futhi kufanele siyinakekele, ukuze kuzotholakale izinkanyezi ezikhanya njalo. Ngale ndlela, uJabulani waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, enza umhlaba ube ngcono. Kanjalo, izinkanyezi zenza ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo iyisisekelo sokuphila kwethu, futhi kufanele sizithande, sizigcine ukuze zihlale zikhanya.
Umhlaba Wokwazi Ngolunye usuku, uSipho, umfana owayenothando olukhulu ngezinto eziphilayo, wanquma ukuya emkhakheni wezokucwaninga ezesayensi. Wayenolwazi oluhle ngalesi sikhala, futhi wayefisa ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo emhlabeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke efunda, efuna ukujula emhlabeni wezinto eziphilayo. U-Sipho wayehlala edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu besebenza ezicini ezincane zokuphila. Nokho, yena wayefuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani izinto zisebenza ngendlela ethile. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziningi eziphathelene nezesayensi, ezimfundisa ngama-atomu, imikhakha yezinto eziphilayo, kanye nezifundo ze-physics. Njengoba efunda, wathola ukuthi imvelo inemithethonqubo yayo, futhi le mithetho ibalulekile ukuze siqonde indlela izinto eziphila ngayo. Ngolunye usuku, uSipho wahlangana noDkt. Mthembu, isazi esidumile emkhakheni wezokucwaninga. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayenolwazi olunzulu ngempilo, futhi waba nomusa wokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi noSipho. U-Sipho wacela uDkt. Mthembu ukuba amfundise kabanzi ngalesi sikhala, futhi uDkt. Mthembu wamvumela ukuba abuyele emsebenzini wakhe. Ngesikhathi uSipho esebenza noDkt. Mthembu, wathola ithuba lokubona izifundo ezahlukene. Wabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlola izitshalo, izilwane, kanye nezimo zomhlaba. Wafunda ukuthi izitshalo zidinga ukukhanya, amanzi, kanye nezinto eziphilayo ukuze zikhule. U-Dkt. Mthembu wamsiza ukuba aqonde indlela imvelo ehamba ngayo, nokuthi izilwane zisebenza kanjani ukuze zigcine ibhalansi emhlabeni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana zokusebenza noDkt. Mthembu, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuhamba naye emhlanganweni wezokucwaninga. Kulokhu, uSipho wathola ithuba lokwabelana ngocwaningo lwakhe noDkt. Mthembu. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale efunda, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza izinto ezinkulu emhlabeni. U-Sipho waqala ukucabanga ngendlela angasiza ngayo umphakathi wakhe. Wafuna ukwenza umkhankaso wokwazisa abantu ngalesi sikhala, ukuze bazi ukuthi izesayensi zibalulekile empilweni yabo. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane ezikoleni, lapho abantwana bekhuthazwa ukuba baphendule imibuzo, bahlanganyele, futhi bafunde ngezinto eziphilayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwakha umoya opholile phakathi kwabafundi, futhi kwavula amehlo abantu abaningi. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubhalela izincwadi ezincane eziphathelene nezesayensi. Wabhalela abantwana izincwadi ezichaza izimfihlo zomhlaba, izitshalo, nezilwane. Lezi zincwadi zathokozisa abantwana, futhi zakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphinde bakhuthaze izifundo eziphathelene nezesayensi. U-Sipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emaphandleni, lapho abathintekayo bezama ukuphucula impilo yabo. Wafuna ukubona ukuthi izesayensi zingasiza kanjani ekwenzeni imiphakathi ibe ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ezazisiza abantu ukuba bakhe izitshalo eziphilayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imithi engcolisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi wakhe ube neqhaza elikhulu ekulimaleni kwemvelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba isibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi izesayensi zibalulekile, futhi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi zempilo. Waba ngumholi emkhakheni wezokucwaninga, futhi wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokufuna ulwazi, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ekugcineni, uSipho waphinde waqonda ukuthi izesayensi azihlanganisi kuphela nezinto eziphilayo, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngempilo, uthando, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Wafunda ukuthi umhlaba uyinkanyezi, futhi wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. Ngalokho, uSipho waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando lwezesayensi lungakhuthaza abantu, lwenze umphakathi ube ngcono, futhi lukhulise ulwazi lwethu ngempilo emhlabeni. Ngale ndlela, uSipho waba umholi wezokucwaninga, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphendule imibuzo, bafunde, futhi baphile impilo enobuchwepheshe. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwaholela ekutheni umhlaba ube yindawo engcono, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umqondo omuhle ungashintsha impilo yabanye. Ngakho, uSipho waphila impilo egcwele uthando, ulwazi, kanye nesifiso sokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Abalandeli Bebhola: Umcimbi Wezothando Nezobuciko Ngaphakathi kwempilo yezenhlalo, abalandeli bebholayo badlala indima ebalulekile, behlanganisa abantu abaningi ngezikhathi ezahlukene. Njengoba umhlaba ubona ukuhamba kwemidlalo yezeMidlalo, ikakhulukazi ibhola, abalandeli bembula umoya ongenamkhawulo, uthando olujulile nolokuxhumana. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukwakheka kwempilo yabantu, lapho umphakathi ubumbene, ubambisene, futhi ujabulela umphakathi owodwa. Umcimbi wethu ubuhlanganisi abalandeli bokuqala bebhola, okwakuyinsakavukela eminyakeni edlule. Izinsuku zokuqala zokuqala zazigcwele umoya omuhle, lapho izinkanyezi zibhakabhaka phezulu, zigubha imidlalo ephakeme. Abadlali abahlonishwa kakhulu bavele kulezi zinsuku, kuthi abalandeli babephakamisa izinsika zabo eziphezulu, bejabulisa yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, izinkumbulo, nezithombe ezithokozisayo. Izinkanyezi zibhakabhaka, kanye nezinkanyezi ezincane zazivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Abalandeli behlabelela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukwakha umoya opholile, opholile. Iphakade, umoya wokukhumbula kudlalwa ibhola udinga ukuqinisekiswa. Noma ngabe ubani, noma yiliphi iqembu, ubudlelwano buyafaneleka; lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umoya opholile. Umcimbi wenza umehluko emiphakathini, njengoba abalandeli bephakanyiswa ngezikhathi ezimnandi. Abanye babebhalisela ukubamba iqhaza, bezama ukuthola izinsiza ezithokozisayo, abanye bezama ukwakha impumelelo. Lezi zinsuku zaziwa ngaphezu kokuba umcimbi wamakilasi, kodwa bekungokwakha ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Eminyakeni edlule, uhlu lwabalandeli lukhule, lwakha izinkanyezi ezahlukene. Abanye babalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bekhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo zabadlali, bejabulisa umphakathi. Izinsuku zikhumbula, abalandeli bephakanyiswa futhi besiza abanye, bonke behlanganyela ekukhumbuleni. Lokhu kukhumbula akusiwo umoya odinga ukuphakanyiswa, kodwa kuveza ukholo olujulile olwenzeka ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ubonisa ukuba khona kwamasiko ezehlakalo ezihlukahlukene. Abalandeli bebholayo bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi ibhola akuhlangani nezokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuba nokuqonda okukhulu komphakathi. Kuzwakala ukuthi abalandeli bebholayo bahlonipha imvunulo yabo, bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umuntu ungubani, ibhola liyisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana, ukuhlonipha, nobudlelwano. Umcimbi udinga ukukhiqiza ubudlelwano obuqinile, ubudlelwano obuqondile phakathi kwabantu, ukuze umphakathi ube nomoya opholile. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wokuhlanganyela wabalandeli bebholayo ubonisa ubuhlakani, uthando, nomoya omuhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuwumoya ophilayo, umoya wokwakha ubudlelwano, nemiphakathi eqinile. Abalandeli bembula indlela yokubambisana, bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo, bese behlabelela umoya opholile. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wethu awugcini nje ngokubona ibhola, kodwa kuwumcimbi wezothando, ubudlelwano, nokuhlanganiswa kwamalungu omphakathi. Abalandeli bebholayo bakhombisa indlela yokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo, umhlaba ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi omuhle. Njengoba umcimbi uphumelela, abalandeli bembula ubuhlakani babo, bejabulisa umphakathi, behlanganyela njalo, ukuze ibhola libe yinsika yokwakha izimpilo eziyingqayizivele.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Umqondo Wami Isimo sezulu sithinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke. Njengoba ngibuka emoyeni, imishayo, nezinganekwane zemvelo, ngizizwa ngikhathazekile kakhulu ngezinguquko eziqhubekayo ezibalwa njengokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngokwehla noma ukukhula kokushisa, kodwa kukhomba ebuchwepheshini bokuhlanganyela kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo emphakathini. Leli sonto, ngithanda ukwabelana nombono wami ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusona isinqumo esincane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zibhalwe emlandweni wethu, zisuka ezingeni lemvelo, zifika ezingeni lempilo yomhlaba wonke. Isigaba sokuqala esikhombisa izinguquko ezibalulekile yizimo zemvelo ezibuhlungu, ezimake—kukhona ukwehla kokuphuma kwelanga, izikhukhula ezivamile, kanye nezikhungo zempilo ezithinteka ngezikhukhula nemvula eziningi. Kulesi sihloko, sengikhuluma ngempela ngezimo eziphawulekayo ezizayo uma sisheshe senze izinyathelo. Ukwehla kokuphuma kwelanga kwenza kube nzima ukuqhubekela phambili izimboni zemfundo, ezolimo, nolwazi. Izimvula ezinkulu zithinta amasimu okwaziyo ukunciphisa umkhiqizo, okwenza izinduna zomhlaba badinge ukulinda imikhiqizo eminingi. Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokukhiqiza, olwakha izinsiza zokudla, lubalulekile ekuphuculeni izinga lempilo, futhi uthintwa ngqo yizinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo esidala sokuthi uma kungenzeka kulungiswe kabusha, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezimbili. Ukusebenzisana nabalawuli, izinkampani, kanye nezimboni ezahlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuguquka okuhle. Ngokwendaba, akukaze kube ngcono lapho sizama ukuqonda impilo yethu. Izinselelo ezivela ezinkampanini ezisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokusiza abantu ezindaweni eziphansi zikhombisa umqondo ophumelelayo. Abesifazane abagqugquzela izinhlelo zokuvuselela, ukukhiqiza izinkanyezi, baneqhaza elikhulu ekuguqulweni kwemikhuba yokuphila. Ngokukodwa ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kwazulu, ukufundisa, umugqa wezinqubomgomo, ukuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze siqede ukudla okwenziwe ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo. Ngokucacile kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezibangelwa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi ngibe nemibono yokuthuthukisa — akukhona nje ukuthumela izinsiza ezithile, kodwa ukuxhumana. Ulimi lwezinto ezizokwenziwa lwaluphumelelisa, nokuthi akufanele kuthathwe ngezinyathelo ezithathekayo ukuze kugwenywe izingozi zempilo, izinkinga zemali, nezibalo. Ngakhoke, ukuhlola izinyathelo ezintsha nemishayo enezinhloso ezithile kulungile — ukuzama ukwakha uhlelo oluhlukile ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela weziningi ezithinta izikhalazo zansuku zonke. Ngemuva kwalolu hlangothi, kusemukelekile ukucabanga ngamathuba angeziwe. Hamba, fundisa! Ukukhuthaza amathuba okusebenza, kuphumelelisa zonke izinkampani ezizimele. Isifundo sokwenza izimboni, izindlela eziphumelelayo zokukhuthaza ukuqonda, kuyacashelwa. Ngaleyondlela, sizoqhuba impilo yethu ukuze siphushe izimo ezibalulekile ezizokhula, sizame izindlela zethu ezikhandiweyo. Njengoba kuncike empilweni yabantu, ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha ezithandwayo neziqukethe amalungelo kubalulekile, kuyilapho kudala ubuhlobo phakathi kwabezobuchwepheshe nezinhlelo ezenzakalayo. Ekugcineni, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje okuhlobene nezinkinga, kodwa kuyinzuzo yokubambisana. Sinokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu emhlabeni wemvelo, futhi njengoba sibona izinguquko ezinkulu ezintweni ezincane, kufuneka senze isifungo sokuthanda imvelo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sihlanganyela, singenza umehluko. Ngakho-ke, asithumeli kuphela izimvo eziphakeme, kodwa masithathe izinyathelo ezivamile, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba omusha uyathuthuka — umhlaba ophilayo, omangalisayo, nocansi — ohlala phakade. Uthando lwephuzu lokuzenzela izinguquko ezinhle lukhona, kanti sizokwenza njengoba sikhuthaza izinhlelo ezithile. Ngithanda ukukholwa kulokhu encane, elwa nokuguquka kwezimo — uyinto engakhi izinga lethu lokuphila, impilo yethu, nomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, sizibophezela ekusebenza ndawonye — umhlaba wethu uyaqhakaza! Sinakho konke ukuphila okukhululekile nesinokukhanya. Qhubekani (siyaphi) ekwenzeni izindaba zesizukulwane esisha. Kulungile, jama, ukufunda, imali, futhi izifundo zendawo! Kungani ungasethemba? Nansi indlela ezinhle yokuvuselela umphakathi wethu!{% endblock %}
Ukulima – Umsebenzi Wokwakha Ikusasa Ukulima, umkhakha othokozisayo nonomsebenzi omkhulu, ube yinsika yempilo emhlabeni. Ngaphandle kokulima, impilo yethu ibingeke ibe lula. Ukudla esikudlayo, imikhiqizo esiyisebenzisayo, konke kuvela ezindaweni eziliminiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi ukulima akukhona nje ukuphila, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngiyavuma, ukulima kudinga ubuchule, uthando, kanye nesineke. Ukwazi ukuthi izinto eziningi ezithinta ukulima zishintsha ngokushesha, kubalulekile ukufaka izindlela ezintsha. Njengoba sikhula nobuchwepheshe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulima kwasendulo kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Abalimi bethu banele ukufundiswa ngezindlela ezihamba phambili, kodwa kufanele sihloniphe izindlela ezikhona, ezithathwa njengomlando wethu. Abalimi bethu balotshwa emlandweni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi bahlala bezama ukugcina umkhakha ophilayo, obalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wethu. Namuhla, sithola imikhakha emisha yokulima, efana nezolimo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nokuba nobuchule, kodwa futhi sihloniphe izindlela zethu zendabuko. Ngakho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abasha nabadala kubalulekile. Abantu abadala banolwazi oluningi, futhi kumele sibe nokukhuluma ukuze sithole ukufunda. Ngokwenza lokhu, siza ukuvikela imvelo. Ukulima okuphumelelayo akuhlangene kuphela nokukhiqiza, kodwa futhi nokugcina imvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngezemvelo, ukudala ibhalansi phakathi kokulima nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zethu ziyahlala zikhona, kubalulekile. Umhlaba, amanzi, nemifino, konke kufanele kuhlonishwe. Ngiyavuma, ukulima namuhla kudinga ukushintsha okukhulu. Izinkinga ezinjengokushintsha kwesimo sezulu zidinga izixazululo eziphusile. Abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukujwayela izimo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukufundisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sicabanga ngokudla, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kokudla, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola okungcono emhlabeni. Esikhathini esizayo, umhlaba uzodinga abantu abanakho ukuzithiba. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngomsebenzi wabo, baphinde basebenzisane ukuze baphumelele. Ukulima akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa ukuhamba ngemigudu emisha, okuhloswe ngayo ukudala umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kumele kube yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona nezinkinga ezikukhathazayo, njengokungabi bikho kwezimali ezinganele ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulima akuphili ngaphandle kokuxhaswa. Ukuze impumelelo yeze, kudinga izinsiza ezanele, imfundo, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezikahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza abalimi bazizwe behloniphekile, futhi kunciphise ubunzima obuhambisana nomsebenzi wabo. Ngokuphetha, ukulima akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa umkhankaso wokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Njengobo sikhuluma, kufanele sihloniphe izindlela zethu zendabuko, kodwa futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukulima kudinga ukubambisana, uthando, nolwazi. Ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukwakha umhlaba ophilayo, lapho ukulima kuhlonishwa futhi kukhuthazwa. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olukhulu, hhayi kuphela ezimpilweni zabalimi, kodwa nakwempilo yethu yonke.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuyisici esibalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokuba negesi, njengokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Nokho, kunokungafani okukhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ukwakhiwa Kwesakhiwo Sokutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kutholakale ugesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwakha nokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi, izintambo zokuhambisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina ugesi. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza zingaba yiziteshi zamandla ezivela emithonjeni ehlukene, njengamandla elanga, amanzi, noma amalahle. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka zisebenza kahle, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ugesi ngendlela elula. Izithiyo Ezinqubweni Zokutholakala Kukagesi Kukhona izithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi izindleko eziphezulu zokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Izindawo ezisemakhaya zihlala zinezinkinga zokuhamba, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo zokwakha ugesi. Lokhu kudala ukungafani kokutholakala kukagesi, lapho abanye abantu besebenzisa izindlela ezindala zokukhanyisa, ezifana nezibani zezimoto, noma izibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo. Izinzuzo Zokutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Uma ugesi utholakala kalula emakhaya, izinzuzo zikhula. Okokuqala, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kudala amathuba amaningi okukhula komnotho, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhaya abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugesi uvumela abantu ukuba basebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengamakhompyutha nemishini yokusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuphila kwansuku zonke. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo ezivela kuhulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nasemiphakathini. Hulumeni angasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze akhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezilula, nezisebenza kahle. Izinkampani ezingezona ezikahulumeni zingase zibe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala benokutholakala kukagesi. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Ukubambisana komphakathi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukutholakala kukagesi. Imiphakathi ingase ibambisane ukuze ithole izixazululo ezisemqoka, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina ugesi ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izinga labo lokuphila. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuzodinga ukuqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala benokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nezinselelo ezikhona, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi sibe nesithakazelo sokubambisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akusona nje isidingo, kodwa kuyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziphelele zokutholakala kukagesi, kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, sithuthukise izinga lokuphila, futhi sithole amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umbuzo 1: Yini iFacebook? iFacebook iyinsiza yokuxhumana ethokozisayo esebenzisa i-inthanethi, eyasungulwa nguMark Zuckerberg nabangane bakhe eHarvard University ngo-2004. Le nsiza ivumela abantu ukuba basebenzisane, babelane ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Umbuzo 2: Kungani abantu besebenzisa iFacebook? Abantu basebenzisa iFacebook ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, iyinsiza elula yokuxhumana nabangane, umndeni, kanye nezihlobo, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala kude. Okwesibili, iFacebook inikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi nabathengisi bangasebenzisa iFacebook ukuze bafinyelele amakhasimende amaningi. Umbuzo 3: IFacebook isebenza kanjani? IFacebook isebenza ngokwakha iphrofayela yomsebenzisi, lapho umuntu engabeka khona ulwazi lwakhe, izithombe, nezithakazelo. Umsebenzisi angakha "amakhasi" noma "amaqembu" ukuze axhumane nabanye abantu abanezimfanelo ezifanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFacebook inezici ezifana ne-"News Feed" lapho umsebenzisi engabona khona okuthunyelwe kwabanye abantu abalandelayo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iFacebook? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iFacebook ziningi. Okokuqala, ivumela abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene, ngisho noma bahlala kude. Okwesibili, iyinsiza yokwabelana ngolwazi, lapho abantu bengathola khona izindaba ezisheshayo nezokwakha. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi lingasebenzisa iFacebook ukuze lithole amakhasimende, lishicilele izikhangiso, futhi likhuthaze imikhiqizo yalo. Umbuzo 5: Zikhona izingozi zokusebenzisa iFacebook? Yebo, kunezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa iFacebook. Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kolwazi lomuntu siqu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu bangase babe sengozini yokukhwabanisa noma ukweba imininingwane. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa iFacebook ngokweqile kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwesikhathi sokuxhumana ngqo. Okwesithathu, kukhona ingozi yokubona okuqukethwe okungafanele, okungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle empilweni yomsebenzisi. Umbuzo 6: IFacebook ithuthukisa kanjani ubudlelwano? IFacebook ithuthukisa ubudlelwano ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Abantu bangathumela imiyalezo, babelane ngezithombe, futhi baphendule ezithombeni zabanye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba seduze, ngisho noma abantu behlukaniswe yizikhala ezinkulu. IFacebook iphinde inikeze ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, njengoba abantu bengathola abanye abanezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele uma ngisebenzisa iFacebook? Uma usebenzisa iFacebook, kubalulekile ukuba uqaphele ukuvikeleka kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu luhlala luphephile, futhi ungabelani ngemininingwane eyimfihlo. Futhi, zama ukugcina isikhathi sokusebenzisa iFacebook sibe semthethweni, ukuze ungaphuthelwa yizikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yangempela. Umbuzo 8: IFacebook izoba kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Esikhathini esizayo, iFacebook ingase ithuthukise izici zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukisa ukuvikeleka, kanye nokwandisa amathuba okuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFacebook ingase ibhekane nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuphepha nokuvikeleka, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bahlala bephephile. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iFacebook iyinsiza ewusizo? Ngokuvamile, iFacebook iyinsiza ewusizo, ikakhulukazi uma isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Inezici eziningi ezithuthukisa ukuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuba abasebenzisi baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Yini engingayenza ukuze ngithuthukise ulwazi lwami lweFacebook? Ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho lweFacebook, zama ukufunda ngezici ezintsha ezitholakala kule nsiza. Hlanganyela emakhasi nasezinhlelweni ezithokozisayo, futhi ungabhalisela izifundo ezihlobene nezokuxhumana. Futhi, zama ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abanezimfanelo ezifanayo, ukuze uthole ulwazi olusha nolwakha. Ngamafuphi, iFacebook iyinsiza enamandla yokuxhumana, kodwa kufanele isetshenziswe ngokucophelela. Ngokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zokuphepha nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle, abantu bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlelo lokuxhumana.
Ukwesekwa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane: Isidingo Esibalulekile Sokukhula Komnotho Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi anikeza amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa futhi adlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo. Nokho, amabhizinisi amancane abhekene nezinselelo eziningi, futhi ukwesekwa kwawo kubalulekile ukuze aqhubeke nokukhula. Ngalesi sihloko, ngizobheka izizathu ezibalulekile zokuthi kungani ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane kubalulekile, kanye nezindlela ezithile zokwenza lokhu. Okokuqala, amabhizinisi amancane anikeza amathuba emisebenzi. Njengoba sikhuluma, izinkampani ezincane zisebenza njengomthombo omkhulu wokuqashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu okungasebenzi. Uma amabhizinisi amancane ethola ukwesekwa, akwazi ukukhulisa imisebenzi, okwenza kube nokwengeza emnothweni. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa inani labantu abaqashwayo, kodwa futhi kudala umnotho ophilayo, lapho imali ibuyela emiphakathini. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane anikeza ubuchwepheshe obusha nemibono emisha. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezithile, kodwa lokhu kubavumela ukuba bacabangele izixazululo ezintsha. Ukuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezintsha, okungase kube nomthelela omuhle emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuncintisana okukhulu emakethe, okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane kudala umphakathi onobudlelwano. Amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yawo. Njengoba ethola ukwesekwa, akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi onobudlelwano uhlala unempilo, futhi ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu buvame ukuholela ekwakheni umnotho ophilayo. Kodwa-ke, ukuze amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithile zokweseka. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele anikeze izikhuthazo ezithile, njengokunciphisa izintela noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokweluleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane ukuba baqale futhi bakhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo zingase zibe nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokwenza abanikazi bamabhizinisi babe nekhono elidingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhona. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuxhasa ngemali, lapho abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangathola uxhaso lwezezimali ukuze baqale noma bakhule amabhizinisi abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezinjalo zingasiza ekunciphiseni ingcindezi yokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukuxhumana. Ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakwazi ukwazisa abathengi ngemicabango yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amakhasimende. Izinkampani ezincane kufanele zisebenzise izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhulume nabathengi, futhi zikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle. Ekugcineni, ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akukhona nje kuphela okudingekayo ukuze amabhizinisi akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophilayo. Amabhizinisi amancane anikeza amathuba emisebenzi, ubuchwepheshe obusha, nemiphakathi enobudlelwano. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithile zokweseka, ezizokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho ophilayo, ogcwele amathuba, futhi okhulisa umphakathi wethu. Lokhu akusizi kuphela abanikazi bamabhizinisi, kodwa futhi kusiza wonke umuntu emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, masibambisane ukuze sikhulise amabhizinisi amancane, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Kukhona into ethile esimweni sethu esibaluleke kakhulu, okungukuthi, ukulahlwa kwemfucuza. Kuyaziwa ukuthi izwe lethu, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni, libhekene nenkinga enkulu yokuphatha imfucuza. Ngiyajabula ukuthi sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, ngoba kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba sibe nolwazi oluqondile ngakho, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza izwe lethu. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngekuhlahlwa kwemfucuza, kuthe uma kungekho uhlelo oluhle lokuphatha imfucuza, lokho kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Cabanga nje, imfucuza eyenziwa nsuku zonke – kusuka kumabhodla okupakisha, iziqu zokudla, izinsiza zokwenziwa, yonke imfucuza leyo kumele ithathwe, iphathwe kahle, futhi ingabi neze ibangele umonakalo emhlabeni. Kodwa-ke, empeleni, izindawo eziningi ziqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezinselelo. Ukubuyela emuva, uma sithatha isinyathelo sokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imfucuza ikakhulukazi ihluka ngohlobo. Sine-municipal waste, okungukuthi, imfucuza eyenziwa emakhaya, nezimboni. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde lezi zihloko ukuze sikwazi ukuphatha kahle. Ngizwa kuthiwa izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza enkulu kumele zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthumela imfucuza yazo, kungabi khona ukuzithoba. Ngiyabona ukuthi abantu abaningi basenokungazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izindlela ezihamba phambili zokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Lokhu kulandela isidingo sokwakha isigaba sokufundisa. Uma sikhuluma ngokuqondisa umphakathi, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ukuthi bahlukanise imfucuza yabo – okungukuthi, imfucuza engaphinde isetshenziswe, imfucuza ethanda ukuba nokuminyana, nezinye. Lokhu kungumsuka wesixazululo esisebenzayo, futhi ngiyazama ukuthi kungani lokhu kubaluleke kangaka. Uma kungenjalo, sithola ukuthi imfucuza ifakwa ezindaweni zokuhlanza, okwenziwa ukugwema imfucuza engapheli. Ngiyavuma ukuthi abanye abantu bathanda ukusho ukuthi akunasidingo sokugxila endleleni ezinzima, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi ukungahambisani nemigomo yokuqonda kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zesikhathi esizayo. Kungakhiwa uchungechunge olungcono, uma sizoba nokuzibophezela kokuhlanza okukhona kusemhlabeni. Abantu abaningi basathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula. Cabanga nje, uma uqonda kahle imfucuza yakho, uthola ukuthi kukhona okukhulu ongakwenza. Ukuze lokhu kusebenza, sizobamba iqhaza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile. Isibonelo, uma abantu beqonda ukuthi indlu yabo ingahlengwa kabusha futhi ilahlwa, kufanele bayenze kube ithuba lokwenza ukusiza imvelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe nakho kubalulekile. Manje, njengoba sesikhuluma, cabanga ngezindlela ezibangela ukwaziswa emhlabeni. Imikhankaso yokuhlwithwa kwemfucuza isiza ukwakha isimo esihle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa udaba lokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlanzwa, ukufaka izindawo zokufaka imfucuza emikhakheni ehlukene, nezindlela zokuphatha ukuhweba imfucuza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani namuhla zigcwalisa izibopho ezingafanele. Zikhona izinkampani ezisebenza ngempumelelo ekulahlweni kwemfucuza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imfucuza ukuze kuyilungiselelwe. Lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni imfucuza ekhaya, kanti kungasiza nemvelo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi wonke umuntu ungenza umphumela omuhle. Izinqumo zethu zidlala indima ebalulekile kumphakathi. Ngokuvamile, uma sithola imfucuza emamaskhathini ahlanzekile, uma unomqondo ohlakaniphile, okokusebenza akufanele, kuthe uma sisuke lapho, umphakathi unganqoba. Akukho ukufunda okungabalulekile. Isithombe esihle sithi uma ugxila empilweni, uzokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kudinga ukubeka phambili izinqumo ezilungile nezindlela ezizwakalayo. Into eyinhloko ethinta imvelo yithi, kumele sihlale sibheke indlela yokwenza kahle. Ekwenzeni lokhu, ungazuza ngokwelashwa kwemfucuza. Kukhona izinyathelo ezilula ezithathwayo, njengokuhlukanisa imfucuza. Sithandazela ukuphila kahle – akufanele kube lula ukuphinda udale izinkinga. Qhubeka ubeke izinyathelo ezinhle, futhi uzoshayela esigabeni esisha. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sizilungiselelwa. Noma ngabe ukhuluma nomngani, noma uthi kumshado, ungabala izifundo, ungakwenza kube kuphumelele kakhulu. Ngisho labo abakwaziyo ukuthanda ukukhokha imali ngoba kudinga hedging potential. Ngibamba ithemba lokuthi lokhu kuzosisiza sonke, ukuze sibe nelungelo lokuphila kahle emhlabeni ophilayo. Nizingcengela, udinga ukwenqaba imfucuza futhi ubambe iqhaza. Ngokuphetha, kumele sikhaliphe uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi imizamo yethu izoba nezithelo. Imininingwane ibalulekile, futhi kumele sibheke phambili. Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kubalulekilea, masiqhubeke siphakamisa izwi lethu emhlabeni.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Isingeniso Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlale luwumcimbi obalulekile empilweni yabantu besizwe. Luhlanganisa inqubo yokukhetha abaholi nemigomo ezothatha izinqumo eziyohlukanisa isizwe, futhi luhlanganisa umsebenzi wokukhuthaza intshisekelo yomphakathi. Lezi zinguquko zenzeka ngezindlela ezihlukene, kuya ngentuthuko yezombusazwe, izifiso zomphakathi, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo ezisemthethweni ezihambisana nokhetho lukazwelonke, izinselele, kanye nezinzuzo ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukwakhiwa Kwesikhashana Ngaphambi kokhetho, kube nezinyathelo ezihlukahlukene ezibalulekile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo iyasebenza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlaka ezihlukene ezibhekelela ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluchachile lokuthi abavoti bangakhetha kangakanani. Abalawuli bezokhetho, njengeKomidi Elibusayo, banenqubo ethile yokubhalisa abavoti, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhaliswayo bahlala bezimele futhi bekwazi ukukhetha ngokukhululekileyo. Ukwaziswa Nokuqwashisa Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezikhangiso zokuqhakambisa, imishwana yokhetho, nezinhlelo ezithile ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuxhunyaniswa nokukhuthazwa kwempilo yesifunda, isimo somnotho, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ukuvezwa kwemibono ehlukene emathubeni okhetho kunciphisa ubuphofu bokuqonda kwabahlanganyeli, okwadlalela indima enkulu ekuthatheni izinqumo ezizwakalayo. Izinqwaba Nezinselelo Zokhetho Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokhetho, izinselele zikhona. Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zezombusazwe kuvamise ukwenzeka, okungaholela kudlame noma ukungalungi. Futhi, kungenzeka ukuthi kube nezinkinga zokusebenza eziholela ekuqoqweni kolwazi olungelona iqiniso noma olungamanga. Lokhu kungaba nemiphumela emibi kumphakathi, okubangela ukuthi abavoti bangalindeli kahle izithombe ezizwakalayo nezihlongozwayo. Ubucayi beMiphumela Isikhashana ngasinye sokuqhuba ukhetho luthinta ukubuyiselwa kwesithunzi nokwethembeka komphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile emiphumeleni yokhetho ehlanganisa isikhathi eside sokubusa okuyimpumelelo. Izinqumo ezithathwa nguhulumeni kumele zifake izidingo zomphakathi, kukhuthazwe ukukhula kokumbi kanye nokuphila kahle, kubonise ukuthi ukhetho liluhlobo oluthile lwezidingo zomphakathi. Ukukhuthazwa Kokuthola Amathuba Noma kunjalo, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhanyi nje njengokukhetha kuphela kodwa futhi kungumthombo wokwakha amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi kwabantu abasha, okukhuthaza ukuthola amandla okuba neqhaza ezinqumweni zomphakathi. Ngakho, imikhankaso yokuxhasa abantu abasha ukuthi balandele izikhungo zezombusazwe iyadingeka ukuveza amandla abo. Ukuhlonishwa Kwezimvo Izinyathelo ezithathwa ngaphambi, phakathi, nangemva kokhetho zidinga ukuhlonishwa. Kubalulekile ukuba abaholi bahloniphe imizwa yomphakathi kanye nemibono ehlukene, ukuze kube nokuphila okukhona entabeni yobumbano. Ukuhlonishwa kwamazinga okuphathelene nabavoti nokuqinisekisa ukuthi basubathi ekubaleni - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukwethembeka nokufaneleka kokhetho. Imiphumela Yakusasa Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yesimo sokhetho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela oyibona namuhla izoba nemthelela emiphumeleni yelokhu kuzokwenziwa kwesikhathi esizayo. Umphakathi onenhlonipho ubonisa amandla okuphila kahle, futhi ubuchwepheshe obusheshayo bendawo buphinde bubonakale. Ukukhula ngokuhleleka ezindabeni zezombusazwe kuzongena ngegoli lokuphila kahle, okukhombisa izifiso zabantu. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlaba umxhwele wokusebenza kwezinhlaka ezithile, okukhiphayo nokuhambisa izinqumo ezifanele kumphakathi. Izinyanga zokhetho zenziwa ngendlela efanele, ziphinde zibe umsebenzisi ophumelelayo osiza umuntu ngamunye. Uma umphakathi uqonda inqubo yokhetho, ubambisene ukuze uqinisekise umphumela ophelele, khona-ke ukhetho luzoba umgudu ngempela wokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kumele sihlale siphakamisela ukukhetha okungenamkhawulo, ukuze sibe neqhaza eliyigugu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithintekayo, okulungiselela imiphakathi yethu ngokukhanyisela izinkanyezi zasemhlabeni.
Ukungondleki Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eMkhumbane, edolobhaneni elincane elisemaphandleni. Abantu baphila impilo yokusebenza kanzima, kodwa abanye babebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. UNomsa, intombazane encane enezinyanga eziyishumi nane, wayehlala nomama wakhe, uMavis, emzini omncane ophakathi kwezihlahla. UMavis wayengumama onothando, kodwa wayenkinga enkulu — uNomsa wayengatholi ukudla okwanele. Kusihlwa, uMavis wayehlala efaka uNomsa ebhedini, ethokozisa intombazane yakhe ngendaba ezimnandi. Kodwa uNomsa wayengakwazi ukufihla ubuhlungu obubangelwa ukungondleki. Umzimba wakhe wawubukeka ungaphatheki kahle, izitho zihlala zicindezelwe, futhi amehlo akhe abukeka engakhanyisiwe. UMavis wayezama konke okusemandleni akhe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uNomsa uthola okuthile ukudla, kodwa izinsuku zazidlula, futhi izinsiza zazincipha. Ngolunye usuku, uMavis wahamba edolobheni eliseduzane ukuze athole umsebenzi. Wazama ukuthola okuthile okungamthokozisa, kodwa akuzange kube lula. UNomsa, esekhaya, wayedlala ngaphandle, kodwa wayezwa ubuhlungu besikhumba, futhi umoya wawumshaya ngendlela eyamkhathazayo. Wazama ukudlala, kodwa umuzwa wokukhathazeka wawuphakeme kakhulu. Ngemva kokubuyela, uMavis wathola uNomsa ehlale phansi, ebuka izinyoni zibhakela phezulu. "Ngiyazi, mntwanami," kusho uMavis, "ukudla akukhona okwanele, kodwa sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithole okuthile." UNomsa wamamatheka, kodwa ubuhlungu obungaphakathi buphinde baphuma. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMavis waqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthola ukudla. Wavakashela emaphandleni, wakhuluma nabanye abantu, futhi wathola izitshalo ezithile ezazikhona. UNomsa wayejabule uma ebona umama wakhe ethokozile, kodwa wayehlala ezwa umuzwa wokunganeliseki. Ngelinye ilanga, uMavis wathola umngani wakhe, uThandi, owayenokudla okuthile. UThandi wayenothando, futhi wayefuna ukusiza. "Ngabe ungathanda ukusiza uNomsa?" ubuze uThandi. UMavis waphendula, "Ngiyabonga, Thandi. UNomsa udinga ukudla okungcono." UThandi wanikela ngamaswidi, izithelo, nezitshalo ezithile. UNomsa wathokozisa kakhulu, futhi wabona umama wakhe ejabule. Lokhu kwenza umama noNdodana bakwazi ukujabulisa izinsuku zabo. Kodwa uMavis wayazi ukuthi lokhu kwakungeyona isixazululo esiqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMavis waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokutshala izitshalo. Wafunda ukuthi izitshalo zidinga umhlaba, amanzi, kanye nokunakekelwa. Waqala ukutshala izitshalo ezincane emakhaya, futhi uNomsa waba neqhaza ekukhuliseni. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokuthi uNomsa afunde futhi akhule. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izitshalo zakhula, futhi uMavis noNomsa baqala ukuthola ukudla okwanele. UNomsa waqala ukubonakala engcono, izitho zakhe zanda, futhi amehlo akhe aqala ukukhanya. Umama wakhe waba nezenzo ezinhle, futhi uNomsa waba nomuzwa wokuthi impilo yabo iyashintsha. Ngesikhathi esithile, uMavis noNomsa baqala ukwenza izifundo zokudla. Babefunda ngezindlela zokupheka, ukulungisa ukudla, nokubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. UNomsa wathola ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Waqala ukujabulela ukudla, futhi umama wakhe waba nesizotha. Ekugcineni, uNomsa waba yintombazane enempilo, enothando, futhi ethokozile. UMavis wabona ukuthi ukungondleki akukhona nje ukungabi nokudla, kodwa kuyinkinga ebonakalayo. Waqonda ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo kudinga ukubambisana, uthando, nokukhuthazela. Ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile, uMavis noNomsa baqala ukusiza abanye abantu emzaneni. Bafundisa abantu ngendlela yokutshala, ukulungisa ukudla, nokubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNomsa waba yisibonelo sokuthi impilo ingashintsha. Ukungondleki kwaba yinto eyaziwa, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. UNomsa noMavis bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo yokuphila, uthando, nokukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNomsa waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo, owayekwazi ukusiza abanye. Waqonda ukuthi impilo ayinakho ukungondleki kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuthi impilo ingashintsha, futhi ukungondleki akukona ukuphela, kodwa kungaba yithuba lokukhula. Ukwazi ukuthi uMavis noNomsa baphumelele, umphakathi waba yindawo yokuphila, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle. UNomsa waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngothando, ukhuthazo, nokubambisana, singakwazi ukuphila kahle. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, futhi uNomsa noMavis baqhubeka nokukhula, behlanganyela, futhi bejabulela impilo.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Isidingo Esibalulekile Emphakathini Wethu Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo enhle, futhi anendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yabantu. Uma kungenawo amanzi ahlanzekile, umphakathi ubhekana nezinkinga eziningi ezifana nezifo ezithathelwanayo, ukungaphumeleli kokudla, nezinkinga zokuhlala. Izinhlaka zomhlaba jikelele ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile, njengoba lokhu kudinga umphakathi onempilo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimiso Zamanzi Ahlanzekile Ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile kudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zokuhlanza amanzi nezinhlelo zokugcina. Izinhlelo zokuhlanza kufanele zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile avelayo avala izinkinga zokuphepha. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, udinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Izenzo Zokugcina Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ngaphezu kokuhlanza, kubalulekile umphakathi uqonde indlela yokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubandakanya imikhuba yokuphatha udoti, ukugwema ukungcola kwemithombo yamanzi, nokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukuqwashisa umphakathi ngalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile agcinwa. Umthelela Wokungabi Nawe Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ukungabi nawa amanzi ahlanzekile kunomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Izifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid zikhula emiphakathini engatholi amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zezempilo, ukwehla kwezimali, nezinkinga zokuthola ukudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ophila ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile ubhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuthuthukiswa. Izixazululo Zokuthola Amanzi Ahlanzekile Izixazululo zokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlanza ezisebenzayo, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokukhuthaza imikhuba yokugcina amanzi. Ukuze lezi zixazululo zisebenze, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Isiphetho Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ekutholeni nasekuhlanzeni amanzi. Ukuze sithole impilo engcono, kudingeka siqonde izindlela zokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile, sikhuthaze imikhuba emihle, futhi sisebenzise izixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, sithola ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onokuthula. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuphatha amanzi ahlanzekile luzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelinokuthula.
Umbuzo 1: Yini ama-social media? Ama-social media yizinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, izithombe, namavidiyo. Zihlanganisa izinhlelo ezifana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, ne-WhatsApp. Lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngempilo, izenzakalo, nezindaba phakathi kwabantu emhlabeni wonke. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza ama-social media abe nesisindo emphakathini wanamuhla? Ama-social media abe yinsika enkulu ekuxhumaneni. Zisetshenziswa ngabantu ukuze baxhumane nabangane, umndeni, kanye nabantu abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-business nawo asebenzisa lezi zinkundla ukuze afinyelele emakethe, akhe ubudlelwano namakhasimende, futhi akhuthaze imikhiqizo yabo, okukhuthaza ukuthengisa nokuqwashisa ngezempilo ezimbonini ezahlukene. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezihambisana nama-social media? Izinzuzo zama-social media ziningi. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi nolwazi olusha. Abantu bangafunda, bakhuthaze imicabango yabo, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Okwesibili, ama-social media anikeza amathuba amaningi okwakha ubudlelwano, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abanesithakazelo esifanayo. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe ama-social media anenkinga? Yebo, ama-social media anenkinga eziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi, lapho abantu bavame ukwabelana ngemininingwane engalungile noma eyingozi. Okwesibili, kukhona udlame lwemizwa, njengoba abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukucwaswa nokugxekwa, okwakha izinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani abantu bangavikela izinkinga ezihambisana nama-social media? Ukuze bavikele izinkinga ezihambisana nama-social media, abantu kufanele benze ngokucophelela lapho babelana ngemininingwane. Kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izilungiselelo zokuphepha ezitholakala ezinkundleni ukuze kugcinwe ubumfihlo. Futhi, abantu kufanele bahlale beqaphele uma behlanganyela nezinye izinkampani, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubomgomo zokusebenzisa. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe ama-social media azoba nempilo ehlukile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Yebo, ama-social media azoba nempilo ehlukile. Ngokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe, kulindeleke ukuba kube nezinkundla ezintsha ezizothokozisa futhi ziqinise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuxhumana kanye namathuba amaningi. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngemiphakathi ethile ezama-social media? Imiphakathi ethile ikhuluma ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta izithakazelo zabo, okuholela ekwakheni izinkundla zamasiko lapho abantu babelana ngempilo yabo, iziphiwo, nezinkumbulo, kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe ama-social media angaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini? Yebo, ama-social media angaba nomthelela omuhle. Zivumela abantu ukuthi babe nezwi eliqinile, bahlanganyele ezindabeni ezibalulekile, futhi bakhe umphakathi olungile. Izinhlangano ezizimele zingasebenzisa ama-social media ukuze zikhuthaze izizathu ezifanele, zikhuthaze impilo yomphakathi, futhi ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani umphakathi ungathuthukisa ukuhamba phambili kwezokuxhumana nge-social media? Umphakathi ungathuthukisa ukuhamba phambili kwezokuxhumana nge-social media ngokwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngezindlela ezinhle zokusebenzisa lezi zinkundla. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukufundisa abantu ngemiphumela emihle nemibi yokusebenzisa ama-social media ukuze benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayifunda ku-social media? Sifunda ukuthi ukuxhumana, ukwabelana, nobudlelwano bubaluleke kakhulu empilweni. Ama-social media asisiza ukuba sibe nolwazi oluningi ngempilo yabanye, nokuqonda izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi onokuqonda, ohloniphekile, nolwazi. Ekugcineni, ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu yanamuhla, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziningi futhi siqonde izingozi ezihambisana nawo. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzise ama-social media ukuze sikhulume, sihlanganyele, futhi sakhe umphakathi omuhle.
### Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona: Indaba Yethu Emphakathini wethu, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zinezimpawu ezinkulu emindenini nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuze siqonde ukuthi lezi zifo ziqala kanjani nokuthi zashintsha kanjani impilo yethu, kubalulekile ukuhlola umlando wazo. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa izenzakalo, izimo, namagugu esintu abhekane nakho ukuze siqonde ubudlelwano phakathi kwezifo ezingamahlalakhona nomphakathi. Ngokuqala, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zathi ziphuma ngezindlela ezahlukene. Njengoba iminyaka idlula, abantu babeveza lezi zifo kodwa bengenazo izincazelo ezanele. Ngaphansi kwezinkolelo, abantu babexwayiswa ngezindlela zokuphila ezithinta impilo enempilo, bekhuluma ngokuqina, ukudla okungafanele, nokuphila ngendlela enempilo. Izifo ezifana nohlobo lwesifo sohudo, umhlaza, nezinye zazithathwa njengemiphumela yokuphila okungafanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abacwaningi baqonda kahle ukuthi lezi zifo zithinta imiphakathi eminingi. Ngemva kokuhlola izinkolelo nemikhuba yokuphila, kwavela ukuthi izifo ezinjalo zixhumene kakhulu nezimo zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa nezinkinga zokuhlalisana, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezingezinhle. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwemihlangano yokwelapha, lapho abelusi, ababeletha, nabanye okuhlonishwa bangenela ekuxhumaneni nabantu ukuze balungiselele izindlela ezingcono zokuphila. Ngesikhathi sekhulu le-20, umhlaba wathola ubuchwepheshe obukhulayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezithombe meteorological, izinhlelo zempilo, nezinsiza zezokwelapha kwasiza ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona emphakathini. Ukuqonda izindlela zokwelapha kwenze imiphakathi ithole izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, okuholele ekwandeni kolwazi ngokuqakatheka kokudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokugcina umqondo ophilayo. Kodwa-ke, ukhetho lwemiphakathi lukhombisa ukuphikiswa ezinqumweni zomphakathi. Amalungelo abantu ahluka phakathi kwezindawo, okubangela ukuba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhule ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kahle. Lokhu kugcizelela izinselelo ezithinta ukuqonda izinjongo zempilo yendawo. Izigameko ezifana nezifo zika-diabetes, isifo sikashukela, nezinye, ziyaqhubeka nazo izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuphila nezifo ezingamahlalakhona kuhlobene kakhulu nezinkumbulo, ubuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokuphila zethu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zifo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona nje ukwelashwa, kodwa kudingeka nomkhuba ophilayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele babheke phambili, benze izinqumo ezinhle, badle ukudla okunempilo, futhi babe nokuphumula okwanele ukuze balungiselele impilo yabo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kufanele sazi ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwezempilo, umphakathi, nezimo zomhlaba kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Abantu kumele balwele impilo yabo, bakwazi ukufuna usizo, futhi bazi ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azizenzakaleli. Sifuna ukuba nezingane eziphilayo, nendlela yokuphila enempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo zikhula phakathi kwezimo ezinzima noshintsho kumakhelwane ethu. Uma sithola ulwazi olungcono, nezinsiza ezinhle, sizoba nempilo enempilo. Ukukholwa emandleni okwenza izinguquko ezintobekeni zethu, sizoba neqhaza elihle ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ovumelayo, nonobuchwepheshe bokuphila. Ekugcineni, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zisetshenziselwa ukudala isithombe esengeziwe sokuhlola impilo yethu. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi kufanele isebenze ndawonye ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga eziphakathi, kuhlangane izindlela zokwelapha ezintsha, nendawo yokupha isimo esifanele sokuphila. Lokhu kuzogcwalisa imithombo yokwelashwa, kuphinde kuphumelele izindinganiso zempilo eziphakeme, futhi kusekele ukuvikeleka kwempilo yempilo yethu nesizukulwane sethu. Ngale ndlela, indaba yezifo ezingamahlalakhona ibalulekile, iba isifundo esikhulu sokuthi sithole indlela yokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, kanye nezimiso zokuphila ezilungile ukuze sihlanganyele emiphakathini. Ngokubambisana, sizokwazi ukusiza abathintekayo, sisize iqulu, futhi siqhubeke nokwenza imiphakathi yethu ibe nezinhlobonhlobo ezinhle, kusebenze kuzo zonke lezi zifo.
Izimpi ZamaZulu Izimpi zamaZulu ziwumphakathi obalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, zibonisa ubuhlakani, ikhono lokuhlela, kanye nezindlela zokulwa ezazisetshenziswa nguShaka Zulu, umholi ophawulekayo. UShaka, owaqala ukuhamba phambili ngokuhlanganisa amaZulu aba yinqaba eqinile, wakha izimiso ezizoguqula isimo sangenxa yokulwa nezimpi eziningi. Izimpi zakho zabonisa ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, ezinjengokusebenzisa izikhali ezisemkhathini ezinjengezibhakela, amafa, nezinhlelo zokuhlola izindawo. Ngokwakhiwa kwenhlangano yamaZulu, uShaka washintsha imikhuba yokulwa, efaka phakathi ukuhlela izinqwaba zezinduna, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha okuvikelwa kwendawo yobukhosi, okugcina isithunzi somphakathi samaZulu sizinzile. Izimpi zathi ke, ziwela ezindaweni ezahlukene namazwe angomakhelwane, kuhlanganisa namasosha kaDingiswayo, umholi weNguni, kanye nezizwe ezikhalipha isikhathi samanje. Izimpi zamaZulu zikhombisa ukugcizelela esikhathini sekoloni, lapho izimpi ezinokusebenza khona zenzeka ngemva kwekhulu le-19. UShaka, ngokudlula, waya phambili nezempi ezinzima, ezihlanganisa neMpi Yezinsizwa ZamaNguni, eyenzeka phakathi kuka-1818 no-1828. Izinselelo ezahlukeneyo zempimpi zaveza ukubaluleka kokulawula izifunda ezivela ezinhlobonhlobo, okuholela ekutheni amaZulu abe nemithombo eyanele yokuphila. Emva kokuhamba kukaShaka, uDingane Zulu wathola impi yakhe, okuyimva yokulawula uMbuso wamaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpini ezenzeka phakathi kweZulu nabantu abahlala eduze, okwakuhambelana neMpi yeGubhuka ngonyaka ka-1838, lapho amaZulu ahluleka khona. Lokhu kwaqeda umkhankaso wenhlangano yamaZulu, futhi kwakha iziqhumane ezinzima zokuphazamiseka komphakathi. Umgwaqo wamaZulu washintsha kakhulu njengoba abanye abantu behamba phambili nemibono eyahlukahlukene yempi. UZulu, njengoba ungenela emezwe ahlukahlukene, waba nezenzo ezizwakalayo, ezagqugquzela amabhange amasha nezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhlaziya izimpi zamaZulu kwenza kube sobala ukusebenza kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene nezithakazelo ezihlukahlukene emlandweni wempi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zamaZulu ziye zavela ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi lwezohwebo. Ukuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla zaphoqa ukuvuleka kwezindawo ezahlukene. Njengenhlangano, amaZulu avuleka emhlabeni wezohwebo, akha amacebo aphumelelayo okuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwehlisa izikhala phakathi kwabantu, okwakukhuthaza ukuvela kokuxhumana okuhle emhlabeni. Ukwenza kube sobala, izimpi zamaZulu azizange zibe yinto eyodwa kuphela yokubuka emlandweni. Zihlanganisa izinselelo ezinzima, ubuchwepheshe bezenzo, nezinhlelo zempilo. Zigsilengisa ezinkathazweni zempilo ezikhona, njengoba abaholi beZulu behlongoza izinqumo ezahlukene mayelana nempilo, ubumfihlo, kanye neziqu ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukhuluma ngempilo kwamasiko namaZulu, izimpi zabonisa izinyathelo ezilondolozayo mayelana nomhlaba, ubuhlakani, namandla ezomkhuba. Ngakho, izimpi zamaZulu ziyisibonelo esihle somzabalazo, umoya wokuhlangana, kanye neqhaza lokuhlonipha abakhulu besizwe. Lezi zimpilo zempimpi, ezazithinta ngezindlela eziningi, zisafanele ukuthathwa njengokugqugquzela, imfundiso, nezifundo kumaphoyisa akhula nokuphuma phambili. Kungakhathalekile ukuthi imiphumela yaba mnyama noma emhlophe, ziye zashiya umphumela omkhulu emlandweni wokwakha isizwe, kokubili kube nsindiso nokuphila. Ngokuhlanganisa izifundo ezitholakala kulezi zimpimpi, umphakathi ungathuthukisa imiqondo emisha yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Izinyathelo Zokubhekana Nazo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, imfundo ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokufunda. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinkinga ezinkulu zemfundo kanye nezinyathelo ezithile zokubhekana nazo. Isigaba 1: Ukuhlonza Izinkinga Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta imfundo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: 1. Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Izikole eziningi zihlupheka ngokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengezincwadi, amathuluzi okusebenza, nezikhungo zokufunda. Lokhu kudala ubunzima kubafundi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo. 2. Izinga Lokufundisa: Abafundisi abahlangabezani nezidingo ezanele zokuqeqeshwa, okuholela ekutheni abafundi bangatholi ukufundiswa okufanele. 3. Ukungalingani Kwezokufunda: Abafundi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bahlushwa ukungalingani ngenxa yezimo zomnotho, izinkinga zomndeni, kanye nezimo zempilo. 4. Ukwanda Kwezimfuno: Njengoba izidingo zomsebenzi zishintsha, imfundo kufanele ilungiswe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zamanje, kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe nezifundo ezihambisana nezimfuno zomsebenzi. Isigaba 2: Ukubheka Izixazululo Ngemva kokuhlonza izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Nazi izinyathelo ezithile ezingathathwa: 1. Ukuthuthukisa Izinsiza: Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele, kungafaka ukufaka izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali, noma ukwakha ubudlelwano nezinkampani. 2. Ukuqeqesha Abafundisi: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokufundisa, kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abafundisi ngama-programmes okuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. 3. Ukwenza Imfundo Ibe Ngenxa Yomphakathi: Imfundo kufanele ibandakanye umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bayathola ithuba lokufunda. 4. Ukuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokufunda: Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda zihlala zisesikhathini, zihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi. Isigaba 3: Ukubeka Phambili Ubufakazi Ukuze izinyathelo ezithathwayo zibe neqhaza, kubalulekile ukubeka phambili ubufakazi bokuthi izinguquko zisebenza. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Ukubheka Imiphumela: Izikole kufanele zihlaziye imiphumela yokufunda ukuze ziqonde ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza yini. 2. Ukwabelana Ngolwazi: Ukuze kube nokwabelana ngempumelelo, izikole kufanele zabelane ngolwazi ngezindlela ezisebenzayo zokufundisa. 3. Ukwamukela Izimvo: Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zamukele izimvo ezivela kubafundi, abazali, kanye nomphakathi. Isigaba 4: Ukugcina Uxhumano Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, umphakathi, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola uxhaso nezinsiza. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganyela: 1. Ubudlelwano Nezinkampani: Izikole zingasebenza ndawonye nezinkampani ukuze zithole uxhaso lwezimali nezinsiza. 2. Ubudlelwano Nomphakathi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo ithuthukiswa, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezibandakanya umphakathi. 3. Ubudlelwano NoHulumeni: Ukuze kutholakale uxhaso lwezimali, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganyela nohulumeni. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ngokuhlonza izinkinga, ukuthola izixazululo, ukubeka phambili ubufakazi, nokugcina uxhumano, singakwazi ukwakha imfundo engcono, ethuthukisa abafundi, umphakathi, kanye nezwe. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise le ndawo ebalulekile.
Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-20, umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima ezihlanganisa iziMpi, iziqhumane, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho, okuholele ekubeni izigidi zabantu zibe sengcupheni. Uhlanga lwezizwe lwaludinga ukuxhumana, lufuna indlela yokubuyisana, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwe-United Nations (iZizwe Ezihlangene) ngo-1945. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, izizwe eziningi zafuna ukuvikela ukuphindaphinda kwezingozi ezinjengalezi. Umqondo wawuwukuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, badinga indawo yokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla. I-United Nations yathathwa njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezizwe ukuze kube nokuthula emhlabeni. Yasungulwa eNew York, lapho izizwe ezingu-51 ziqhube umhlangano wokuqala, umgomo wayo waba ukuvikela ukuthula, ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa, kanye nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu. Abaholi babezama ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, i-United Nations yathola amandla futhi yaqala ukuhlela imihlangano, izinkulumo, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo. Izigaba zayo ezahlukene, ezifana nomnyango wezempilo, umnyango wezokudla, kanye nomnyango wezokuthula, zathola izinsiza ezinkulu ukuze ziqhube umsebenzi wazo. Izinsuku zashintsha, izimpi zashintsha, kodwa i-United Nations yahlala ikhuluma. Kwakukhona izinkinga eziningi ezazidinga ukuxazululwa, okuhlanganisa ukungalingani, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zemvelo. I-UN yaphendula ngokwakha izinhlelo ezahlukahlukene, efuna ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi abahluphekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-United Nations yathola udumo emhlabeni, izinhlelo zayo zakhula, zafinyelela ezindaweni eziningi, zakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Le nhlangano yenza izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni, kodwa akuzange kube lula. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho izinhlelo zayo zaziphazamisekile, futhi abaholi baziqhenya ngezizathu ezahlukene. Abanye babebona i-United Nations njengomkhiqizo wezizwe ezithile, okwaholela ezinkulumweni ezinzima. Kodwa i-UN yaphikelela, yazi ukuthi umsebenzi wayo wawubalulekile, futhi izinkinga ezazikhona zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngasekupheleni kwawo-2000, i-United Nations yenza umkhankaso omkhulu wokubhekana nezinkinga zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha, ezemvelo, nezokuthuthukiswa. Umgomo wayo waba ukuvuselela umhlaba, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. I-UN yaphinde yasungula izinjongo ezithile zokuthuthukiswa kwezeMvelo (Sustainable Development Goals) ukuze ikhuthaze izizwe ukuthi zisebenze ndawonye. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni izizwe zisebenzisane, zixoxe ngalezi zinkinga ukuze zithole izixazululo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, abantu baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwe-United Nations, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni umhlaba. I-United Nations yaphinde yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu, lapho izinkinga zixoxwa khona, futhi izixazululo zifinyelelwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi, i-United Nations yahlala ibalulekile, ikhubaza abantu ukuthi, uma benza umsebenzi ndawonye, bangakwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. I-United Nations ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba zinkulu, umoya wokubambisana ungakwenza konke. Ekugcineni, i-United Nations iyisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangahlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze baphumelele. Ngaphezu kokuba yindawo yokuxoxisana, ibuye ibe yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, emhlabeni onobunzima, ukuthula nokubambisana kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngakho, i-United Nations iyinsika yokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bephila ngokuthula, bejabule, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ibonisa ukuthi, uma sikhumbula ukuthi sonke singabantu, singenza izimanga.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqonda Amabhange Amabhange ayizikhungo ezibalulekile ezisebenza kwezomnotho emphakathini. Zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukugcina imali, ukuhweba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemalimboleko. Ukuze uqonde amabhange kahle, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuqonda izinjongo zawo kanye nezindlela ezisebenzisayo. Isahluko 2: Izinhlobo Zamabhange Amabhange ahlukaniswa ngalezi zinhlobo: 1. Amabhange Abantu (Commercial Banks): Lezi zikhungo zisebenza abantu ngabanye, zinikela ngezinsizakalo ezifana nokuvula ama-akhawunti, ukuhlinzeka ngemalimboleko, nokuhweba. 2. Amabhange Ezinsizakalo (Investment Banks): Lezi zikhungo zigxile ekuphathweni kwezimali ezinkulu, zisebenza ngokuhweba ngezimpahla kanye nokuhlinzeka ngocwaningo lwezimali. 3. Amabhange Kahulumeni (Development Banks): Lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga ukwakhiwa. Isahluko 3: Ukuvula I-Akhawunti Ebhangi Ukuvula i-akhawunti ebhange, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Khetha Uhlobo Lwe-Akhawunti: Thola uhlobo lwe-akhawunti oluhambelana nezidingo zakho, njenge-akhawunti yokonga noma yokuhweba. 2. Hamba Ebhangeni: Vakashela ibhange ofuna ukuvula kulo i-akhawunti. Qiniseka ukuthi ubhonga izinsuku nezikhathi ezivulekile. 3. Letha Imibhalo Ebalulekile: Uzodinga imibhalo efana ne-ID, isitatimende somholo, kanye nezinye izincwadi ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ubunikazi bakho. 4. Gcwalisa Ifomu Lokuvula I-Akhawunti: Uma usukhona, gcwalisa ifomu lokuvula i-akhawunti, uqinisekise ukuthi ufunda kahle yonke imininingwane ngaphambi kokusayina. 5. Thola I-ATM Card: Ngemuva kokuvula i-akhawunti, uzothola ikhadi le-ATM elizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imali yakho. Isahluko 4: Ukusebenzisa I-Akhawunti Uma usuvule i-akhawunti, ungasebenzisa izinsizakalo zebhange. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukufaka Imali: Ungafaka imali kwi-akhawunti yakho ngezikimu zebhange, ama-ATM, noma ngokuqondile kumphakathi. 2. Ukukhwezela Imali: Ungathola imali usebenzisa ikhadi le-ATM noma ngokuhamba ebhange. 3. Ukudlulisa Imali: Ungakwazi ukudlulisa imali kwabanye noma emakhawuntini ahlukene, ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zebhange. 4. Ukubheka Isimo Se-Akhawunti: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlole isimo se-akhawunti yakho njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi awunayo imali engaphelele. Isahluko 5: Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Nezokuxhumana Amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene zokuxhumana: 1. Ucingo: Ungaxhumana nebanga ngefoni ukuze uthole usizo noma imibuzo. 2. I-imeyili: Amabhange avame ukuba ne-imeyili yokuxhumana ukuze uthumele imibuzo noma izicelo. 3. Izinsizakalo Zokusebenza Kwi-Intanethi: Amabhange amaningi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokusebenza kwi-intanethi, okuvumela abathengi ukwenza izinqubo eziningi online. Isahluko 6: Ukuhweba Ngezinsizakalo Zebhange Ukuze uzuze kakhulu ezinsizakalweni zebhange, qonda izinzuzo ezitholakalayo: 1. Izintela Nezimali: Qonda izintela ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zebhange ukuze ungaboni izindleko eziphakeme. 2. Izinhlelo Zokonga: Amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokonga ezikhethekile, ezikuvumela ukuba ube nemali eningi. 3. Izinsiza Zokuthuthukiswa: Qonda izinsiza zokuthuthukiswa ezitholakalayo, ezinjengezimali zokwakha, ukuze uthole usizo oludingayo. Isahluko 7: Ukuqonda Imigomo Nezimo Ngaphambi kokwenza izinqumo, kubalulekile ukuqonda imigomo nezimo zebhange. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izibopho zakho nezinsizakalo ozitholayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ufunda zonke izivumelwano ngaphambi kokusayina. Isahluko 8: Ukuhlola Izinketho Ezingcono Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, hlola izinketho ezahlukene zamabhange. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi yibuphi ubhange obuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili nezikahle kakhulu. Qhathanisa izintela, izinhlelo zokonga, nezinsizakalo ukuze ukhethe kahle. Isahluko 9: Ukubheka Izinguquko Amabhange ahlale enza izinguquko ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zawo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale ubuyekeza izinhlelo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Isahluko 10: Isiphetho Amabhange ayizikhungo ezibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuqonda indlela yokusebenzisa amabhange nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene kubalulekile ukuze sithole inzuzo ezimali zethu. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvula i-akhawunti, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo, nokuhlola izinketho ezihlukahlukene ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Qhubeka ufunde futhi uqonde amabhange ukuze ube nezezimali eziphumelelayo.
Ukunakekela Abantu Abadala: Ingxoxo Nomhleli Wezempilo Isingeniso Namuhla, ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, sikhuluma noMnu. Zulu, umhleli wezempilo ophumelelayo emkhakheni wokunakekela abantu abadala. Ubuza ngezinto ezahlukene ezithinta lezi zinsizwa nezinsizwa, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ukuphila kwazo kube ngcono. Ingxenye 1: Ukubaluleka Kokunakekela Abantu Abadala Mnu. Zulu, ungachaza ukuthi kungani ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile? “Ngempela, ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile kakhulu. Lezi zinsizwa zinesipiliyoni esikhulu, futhi zifundisa izizukulwane ezincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abadala bahlala bezidinga usizo ngezinto ezilula, njengezokuhamba, ukudla, nokuphila nsuku zonke. Ukunakekela kahle kubasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina isithunzi sabo.” Ingxenye 2: Izinkinga Eziyinhloko Zokunakekela Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abadala? “Yebo, izinselelo ziningi. Okokuqala, iminyaka yokukhula kwebhizinisi lokunakekela abantu abadala ibalulekile. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala kuncike kuphela ekudleni nasekuphatheni. Nokho, lezi zinsizwa zidinga ukuxhumana, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Ubugebengu obukhulayo, izimo zokuhlala ezinzima, kanye nezinkinga zezezimali nazo zenza kube nzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase bahluleke ukuqonda izidingo zempilo zalesi sigaba.” Ingxenye 3: Izindlela Zokunakekela Kukhona izindlela ezithile zokunakekela abantu abadala? “Yebo, izindlela eziningi zikhona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka abantu abadala ngemithi yabo ngesikhathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomndeni nabangane. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, njengezinto zokuhamba, izinsiza zokudla, nezindawo zokuhlala ezikhululekile, kubalulekile. Ukubamba imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengokuhamba emaphakathini, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Futhi, ukuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bayaziswa.” Ingxenye 4: Umsebenzi Womndeni Umdlalo womndeni unendima enkulu ekunakekeleni abantu abadala. Ungakuchaza lokhu? “Ngempela, umndeni unendima enkulu. Umndeni kufanele ube yisikhungo sokwesekwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele babe khona, baphendule izidingo zomuntu omdala, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Uthando nomoya wokuhlanganyela kubalulekile. Umndeni kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bahlala bejabule, benempilo, futhi bezizwa beqondile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumana, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bahloniphe izinqumo zomuntu omdala.” Ingxenye 5: Izinselelo Zokusebenza Yiziphi izinselelo ezithinta abasebenzi abakhathalela abantu abadala? “Abasebenzi abakhathalela abantu abadala bahlala bebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, ukuntuleka kwemali, kanye nezinsiza ezingekho zokufundisa zenza kube nzima. Abasebenzi badinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle ukuze baqonde izidingo zempilo zabantu abadala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka okukhona emsebenzini kungabangela ukuthi kungabi nezinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokusekela abasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubheka Phambili Ngabe unayo imicabango yokuthi izinga lokunakekela abantu abadala lingathuthuka kanjani esikhathini esizayo? “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa ukuqwashisa emphakathini, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okungcono kubasebenzi, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ikhulume ngalezi zindaba, ukuze abantu abadala baziwe futhi bahlonishwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zokunakekela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni le mikhakha.” Isiphetho Ukunakekela abantu abadala akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi. Njengoba sithola izixazululo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe, sithandazele, futhi sinakekele lezi zinsizwa ezibalulekile. Ubuza uMnu. Zulu, sithola ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala kudinga uthando, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi ophumelelayo.
Umbiko: Iziteleka Zabasebenzi Isingeniso Iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zaba yinto edumile ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, zikhombisa amandla kanye neqhaza labantu emsebenzini. Njengoba izimo zomnotho zishintsha, izisebenzi ziba nemizwa ehlukahlukene mayelana nezimo zabo zokusebenza.
