Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezithinta iziteleka zabasebenzi ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zenzakalo. Izizathu Zokuhola Iziteleka Izizathu eziholela ezitelekeni ziningi, kodwa ezinye zazo zibalulekile. Okokuqala, izimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle, njengokucindezeleka, imiholo enganele, kanye nezinsiza ezinganiki ithuba lokuthuthuka, zenza ukuba abasebenzi bazizwe bephucwa amalungelo abo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphakamise izwi labo, befuna izinguquko ukuze baphile kahle. Okwesibili, izinkinga zemigomo yokusebenza, njengezinguquko emiholweni noma izindinganiso ezingalungile, zenza kube nomfutho phakathi kwabantu. Abasebenzi bahlala benethemba lokuthi izinkampani zabo zizobabhekelela, kodwa uma lokhu kungahambisani nezifiso zabo, iziteleka ziba yindlela yokuzwakalisa le mizwa. Imiphumela YeziTeleka Iziteleka zabasebenzi zingaholela emiphumeleni eminingi, ethinta hhayi kuphela abasebenzi, kodwa nomsebenzi wabo, izinkampani, kanye nomnotho jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka zingaholela ekwakhiweni kwezixazululo ezinhle, lapho izinkampani ziqonda khona izidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza, ukwandisa imiholo, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinsiza, uma izinkampani zivala amasango ngenxa yeziteleka. Lokhu kungashiya abasebenzi bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi kungabangela ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabafundi nezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iziteleka azihlanganisi kuphela izinkinga, kodwa futhi zifaka izixazululo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe izizathu ezibangela iziteleka, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhuluma kahle nabantu bazo. Ukwenza kube lula ukuba nezithangami, lapho abasebenzi bengavula khona izinkulumo, kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqhube ucwaningo ukuze ziqonde kangcono izidingo nezifiso zabasebenzi. Kubantu, kubalulekile ukuba bahlale befunda futhi baziqhenye ngezinto ezithinta ubudlelwane babo nomsebenzi. Ukwamukela izinguquko, ukufunda amakhono amasha, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izimo zokusebenza, kungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi ozinzile. Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhombisa amandla abantu, futhi zenza kube nokubaluleka kokukhuluma nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi nezinkampani. Njengoba sizama ukuqonda izizathu ezibangela lezi ziteleka, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzwana nokubambisana kungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezizoletha impumelelo. Umsebenzi wethu, njengomphakathi, ukufunda kulokhu futhi sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yethu iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zifika nezifundo ezibalulekile, futhi umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukusiza abanye, ukuvuselela umphakathi, kanye nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kithi sonke.
Ukudla Kwesintu Ngaphakathi kwenhliziyo yeNingizimu Afrika, ukudla kwesintu kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Phakathi kwezihlahla ezinkulu, phezulu ezindaweni eziphakeme, kutholakala umuzi omncane ophila ngokuhlanganyela, khona lapho imindeni ibambisana ukuze iqhube izinkumbulo ezinhle, ikakhulukazi lapho kudliwa khona. Kwakukhona umndeni owawuphethe lezi zinkumbulo, uMkhulu uJabulani, owayengumholi wabo. UJabulani wayenothando lwezinkanyezi, kepha okwakumjabulisa kakhulu kwakungukudla. Njalo ngempelasonto, umndeni wabuthana eduze komlilo, kanti uJabulani wayefaka phambili izimbiza ezinkulu ezazigcwele ukutya okuhamba phambili, okwakubizwa ngokuthi “isitsha sikaMkhulu”. Enye yezinganekwane zakhe zakuqala yayihamba ngale ndlela: “Bafana, sizokwenza isitshulu segusha namuhla. Ukudla okwakumfaka empilweni yami yokuqala kwaba yisitshulu esikhulu, futhi lokho kuzokwenza sizwe umoya omusha kulesi sikhala.” Wasuka esiphuzwini futhi waqale ngokuhlanza ingulube. Umndeni wawudlala izigubhu, ubhimba izinkanyezi, kanti umoya wawuthinta ubuso babo. Kusukela ekwenzeni isitshulu, uJabulani wayevame ukuxoxa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokukhipha amazinga amasha. "Uphondo lwesitsha sikaMkhulu luhluka, futhi umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wokudla, ukungabikhona kothile, yikhona okwenza kube muhle," wayephawula njalo. Ukudla kwakhe akukhona nje ukudla; kwaba amandla, ubuhlobo, nempilo. Ngemuva kokupheka, imindeni yayithokozisa umoya. UZandile, indodakazi kaJabulani, wayezokwenza isinkwa esibizwa ngokuthi "isiqhingi". Isondo lesiqhingi, eliphephile, lalisetshenziswa njengokudla okuvamise ukwenzeka. UZandile wayethanda ukukhipha izithako ezivela emaphandleni, efaka ubhontshisi, izaqathe, nemifino eyahlukene, ukuze athole ubumnandi obuhlukahlukene. UJabulani wayejabule ngokubona indodakazi yakhe ikhuluma ngokudla kwesintu, ikhuluma ngempilo, ikhuluma ngothando. Isidlo sasinomoya wokubambisana, kahle. Kwakukhona abantwana abebhucunga, begijima bejabulile, bephakamisa izingxenye zomzimba zabo, bekhumbula ukuthanda ukudla. UJabulani wayephindela emqondweni, ehlola ukuthi ukuhlanganyela okuletha injabulo, kunjalo? “Yebo, ukuthokozisa, okukhona,” wathi. Ngesikhathi umndeni uvula izitsha, umoya uzungeza, ukhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukudla akuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa kukhona umoya wosuku, umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wokubuyisana. “Bona, thina asifuni ukugcina, sifuna ukwabelana,” kwasho uJabulani. Ngemva kokudla, umndeni waqhamuka ukuze uzithokozise, wahamba ehamba. UJabulani, eveza umsebenzi wabo, wathi: “Ukudla kwesintu akugcini nje ngokwabelana, kodwa kuhamba phambili, kubamba izinkumbulo. Umoya wethu, izinkumbulo, ubuhlobo bethu, lokho kudinga ukuba sikuphathe kahle.” Kuleso sikhathi, uZandile waphakamisa isiphakamiso: “Mkhulu, kungani singakwenzi lokhu njalonje minyaka yonke?” UJabulani wayejabule, esuka ezinkumbulweni zodlule, waphendula: “Bafana, kudinga umzamo, kudinga uthando. Thina sisemzabalazweni okhanyayo.” Ngakho, ukuqhubeka kwabo, umndeni waqhubeka nokuthokozisa, waphila ngezinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngisho noma izikhathi zaqhubeka, umoya wokuhlanganyela, ukudla kwesintu, wayezohlala njalo, uJabulani wayazi ukuthi lokho kuyobakhumbuza, kube umoya wabo. Kwakungakhathaleki ukuthi iminyaka izophuma, kodwa umoya wezimvo, umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wezakhamuzi, ubuhlobo, lokho kuzohlala kuhlangene nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kwakuyisiko, lezi zinkumbulo ezaziyigugu, ezintsha nezidala, ekugcineni, indaba yokudla kwesintu, yayihlanganisa imindeni, izinkanyezi, neminyaka. Ngakho, njalonje, umndeni wakwaJabulani usaqhubeka nokugcina lesi simo, njalo ngempelasonto, ukuze baphinde baphinde bahlale behlanganisa izinkumbulo, behlala bejabulile, bephila ngothando. Kwakungumoya omuhle, umoya wezinkumbulo, umoya wokudla kwesintu.
Kwakhanya ilanga elishisayo eNingizimu Afrika, umoya uthokozisa izihlahla eziphakeme. Emzaneni omncane, uMafikizolo, kwakuhlala umndeni ophilayo owaziwa ngothando lwabo lokupheka. UMaMkhize, umama wendlu, wayengumculi ophumelelayo, kodwa wayenothando olukhulu lokwenza uphuthu, isidlo esidumile esivela ezimpandeni zethu. Ngolunye usuku, wanquma ukwenza uphuthu olwakudala, olwakhiwe ngothando nemfundo ayitholile emndenini. UMaMkhize waqala ngokuhlanza izithako: ufulawa, ushukela, ubisi, kanye nezinye ezidingekayo. Wayazi ukuthi uphuthu luthanda ukunakekelwa, futhi wayezimisele ukwenza kahle. Uphuthu lwaluhamba phambili, umoya omuhle wawuhamba emzini, ubhiyozela izithako ezihlangene. Wabhalela izingane zakhe, uThandi noSipho, izinyathelo zokupheka. "Ningakhohlwa, izingane," esho, "ukupheka uphuthu kudinga uthando, futhi uthando lukhona lapho sabelana khona." UThandi noSipho babebonakala bejabule, bejabulisa umama wabo ngenkathi bephendula izinyathelo. UThandi, oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, wayenothando lokuphendula izithako, kanti uSipho, oneminyaka eyisithupha, wayezama ukusiza ngokuhlanza izitsha. UMaMkhize wathokozisa izingane zakhe, wathi: "Niyizinkanyezi zami." Ngemuva kokupheka, uphuthu lwakhe lwalubukeka luhle, lukhanya ngombala ophuzi opholile. Wathatha isikhwama sokuphakela, waphaka uphuthu emathinini amancane, wathi: "Sizokwenza umkhosi, sizobamba umcimbi omkhulu." Umndeni wahlangana nabangani babo, umoya wawugcwele injabulo. UMaMkhize wabelana ngophuthu, wathi: "Nansi isidlo esikhethekile, esikhiqizwe ngothando." Abangani baphendula ngothando, bejabule ngalesi sidlo esisha. Uphuthu lwakhe lwathokozisa wonke umuntu, futhi umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni. Wathola ukuthi uphuthu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokubumbana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu. Ngemuva kokuphela komcimbi, wathola ukuthi uphuthu lwakhe lwalungaphezu kokudla. Wazi ukuthi uthando, ubudlelwano, nokuhlanganyela kwenza impilo ibe mnandi. UThandi noSipho babebonisa umama wabo ukuthi bazi kahle ukuthi uthando lukhona lapho kudliwa khona, futhi lokho kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile empilweni yabo. Umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni, futhi uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi uphuthu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Uthando lwabo lokupheka lwaluhamba phambili, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu. Ngakho-ke, uphuthu lwakhe lwalungaphezu kokudla, lwalukhombisa ukuthi uthando lukhona lapho kudliwa khona. UMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni. Uthando lwabo lokupheka lwaluhamba phambili, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, futhi uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu.
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThandekile Mthembu - Umholi Kwezobuchwepheshe Beselula Ekuseni okukhanya ilanga, uThandekile Mthembu, umholi ohloniphekile kwezobuchwepheshe beselula, uqala usuku lwakhe. Wazalwa eThekwini, uThandekile uthanda ubuchwepheshe, okwakuholela ekutheni aqhubeke nendlela yakhe yokuphila. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezenhlalo, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi efunda eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu zeziMali nezeNkampani, kodwa wakhanga kakhulu ezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zefoni. Njengomuntu ophusile, waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, eqonda izidingo zabathengi. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula buwumgibeli obalulekile emphakathini, waqala ukukhuthaza imiklamo ethuthukisa impilo. UThandekile ukholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe kufanele busebenze njengensiza yokuxhumana, hhayi nje indawo yokudlala. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uThandekile wabona ithuba lokwakha inkampani yakhe yokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lokhu kwaba umqondo ophumelelayo, futhi inkampani yakhe, i-Tech Innovations, yathola udumo olukhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. UThandekile nozakwabo badala izinhlelo zokusebenza ezidumile, ezifana ne-app yokuxhumana nemindeni, engeza kalula kubantu abangabakhulumayo. UThandekile uqhubeka nokukhuthaza impumelelo emiphakathini esezingeni eliphansi, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Uhlanga lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe luhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufunda, uhlelo lokuxhumana oluthuthukile, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhiqiza imisebenzi. Njengoba edlula eminyakeni, uThandekile waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula bungaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Uqhuba imihlangano nemicimbi yokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe emiphakathini, elwela ukufaka izinhlelo ezisimeme nezithuthukayo ezithinta izwe lonke. Ubuye abhale izindatshana kwi-intanethi ezicacisa indlela uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe oluhlanganyela ngayo embonini. UThandekile ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula akusizi kuphela ezimeni ezinzima, kodwa futhi kungenza kube lula ukuphila kwansuku zonke. Ubuye abe nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni abesifazane emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ekhuthaza abesifazane ukuba baphumelele futhi balwe nezithiyo ezithinta umkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. UThandekile ukhombisa ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma bekhuthazekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandekile waba neqhaza elibalulekile emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi ezemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuxhumana, futhi uthole imiklomelo eminingi, ehlanganisa neziqu zokuhlonipha ezivela emiphakathini ehlukahlukene. Ngokukhuluma ngempilo yakhe, uThandekile uthanda ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula, ikakhulukazi uma ehamba emizileni ye-KZN, lapho abuye abone khona ubuhle bemvelo. Ukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, baphumule emsebenzini, futhi bathole isikhathi sokuzithokozisa. Njengomholi ohlonishwayo, uThandekile Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula bungaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi impumelelo ibalulekile, kodwa ukuhlonipha abantu, imvelo, nesiko kumele kubhekwane, ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandekile usaqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu abaningi, ebakhombisa indlela yokuphumelela, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa nempilo jikelele.
iFacebook Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uThandi, intombazane encane eyayihlala edolobheni elincane, wathola umqondo omusha. UThandi wayehlala edinga indlela yokuxhumana nabangani bakhe, ikakhulukazi kulabo ababephila kude. Ngakho, wathola ithuba lokubhalisela iFacebook, indawo yokuxhumana eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. UThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook iyinsiza enkulu. Wayengakwazi ukwabelana ngezithombe, izindaba, nezinto azithandayo. Ngemva kokubhalisela, wathola abangani abaningi ababephila kude, futhi baqala ukuxhumana njalo. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayezwa sengathi abanye baphila edolobheni lakhe, nakuba bephila kude. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa iFacebook, uThandi waqala ukubona izithombe zabangani bakhe, izenzakalo ezithokozisayo, nezinto ezithokozisayo ezenzakalayo. Waqala nokubhalela izimo zakhe, ezimnandi nezibuhlungu. Kodwa, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukubona ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Abangani bakhe babebonakala bejolise kakhulu ezithombeni, kunokuxhumana ngempela. UThandi wathola ukuthi abanye babangani bakhe babezama ukuveza impilo yabo ngendlela ethile, bephakamisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa bephila impilo ehlukile. Lokhu kwenza uThandi azizwe engakhululekile. Wayefuna ukuxhumana, kodwa wathola ukuthi abantu babezama ukufihla izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kwenza umuzwa wakhe wokuxhumana ungabi namandla. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wathola umyalezo ovela kumngani wakhe, uSipho. USipho wabhala ukuthi wayezwa edangele, futhi wayefuna ukukhuluma. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi uSipho uphila kanjani. Bahlangana ku-video call, futhi uSipho wabelana ngempilo yakhe, izinselelo, nezifiso zakhe. UThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho wayebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kodwa wayefuna ukulwa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqonda ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokuxhumana, kodwa akufanele ibe yindlela yokufihla. Waqala ukugqugquzela abangani bakhe ukuba baveze izinkinga zabo, ukuze bakwazi ukusizana. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu badinga ukuxhumana ngempela, hhayi nje ngokwabelana ngezithombe ezinhle. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenzisa iFacebook, waqala ukuhlela izigcawu zokuxhumana. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabangani, ukuze baxoxe ngezinto ezinzima, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Lokhu kwenza uThandi azizwe enempilo, futhi waqala ukubona ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa iFacebook, uThandi wathola ukuthi abantu badinga ukuxhumana, futhi badinga ukwazi ukuthi abanye baphila kanjani. Waqonda ukuthi impilo ayiyona nje izithombe ezinhle, kodwa ibalulekile futhi izinselelo zempilo. UThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yindawo yokwakha ubudlelwano, uma abantu bephila ngempela. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook iyinsiza enkulu, kodwa abantu badinga ukusebenzisa kahle. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabangani bakhe, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola ukuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi ukuxhumana ngempela kuyasiza. Ngakho, waphuma phambili, ehlonipha ubudlelwano, futhi eqhubeka nokwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo kubangani bakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi, uma abantu bephila ngempela. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayazi ukuthi ukuxhumana ngempela kuyasiza, futhi impilo iyinhle uma sabelana ngayo.
Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Isingeniso Ukuhamba ngamatekisi kubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke kubantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Amatekisi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisheshayo nezifinyeleleka kalula, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezithinta abagibeli lapho besebenzisa amatekisi, okwenza kube nezinkinga. Lolu cwaningo luzogxila ezinkingeni ezivamile abantu abahlangabezana nazo. Izinkinga Zokuphepha Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhamba ngamatekisi ukungaphephi. Abagibeli bavame ukukhathazeka ngezinga lokuphepha, ikakhulukazi uma bephuma ezindaweni ezingaziwa. Ukuhlaselwa, ukweba, noma izimo ezingalindelekile akuyona into engajwayelekile. Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamatekisi bahloniphe imithetho yokuphepha, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abagibeli bazi ukuthi bangawathola kuphi usizo uma bephakathi kwezinkinga. Izinkinga Zokuphathwa Kwezimali Okunye okukhathaza abasebenzisi bamatekisi yizinkinga ezihlobene namaholo. Izindleko zokuhamba ngamatekisi zingashintsha ngokushesha, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izabelomali. Abagibeli abakwazi ukuqonda kahle ukuthi kuzobiza malini, okwandisa ukungaqondi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zamatekisi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zamaholo ezingaqondakali, okwandisa ukudideka phakathi kwabafuna izinsizakalo nezinkampani. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuphepha nezokuphathwa kwezimali, ukusebenza kwamatekisi kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngezinye izikhathi, amatekisi awatholakali kalula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, okwenza kube nzima kubagibeli ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ukungatholakali kwamatekisi ngesikhathi esifanele kungaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, okungabangela ukungathembeki kwabagibeli. Ngakho-ke, abanikazi bamatekisi kanye nohulumeni badinga ukuhlela izinsizakalo zabo ukuze bathole impendulo efanele ezidingweni zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabagibeli nabashayeli bamatekisi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Abashayeli abathola kahle izindawo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi kusemkhankasweni wokuhlanza imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele phakathi komshayeli nomgibeli, okungase kubangele ukungaboni ngasohlangothini olufanele. Ukuze kulungiswe le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi abashayeli bazi kahle izindawo zokusebenza kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuxhumana nabagibeli. Izinkinga Zokuhlonza Abashayeli Ikhono lokuhlonza abashayeli bamatekisi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Abagibeli bavame ukufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlonipha imithetho yokuphepha, futhi balungile ukuhamba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda izimvume ezisemthethweni, iziqinisekiso, nezikhumbuzo ezikhombisa ukuthi umshayeli uyiqolo. Ngakho-ke, abanikazi bamatekisi badinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile ngemisila yokuhlola abashayeli, ukuze bagibeli babe nokuzola emsebenzini wabo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuqhubeka Ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezihambisana nokuhamba ngamatekisi, kudinga izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinkampani zamatekisi kufanele ziqhube izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abashayeli, zihlinzeke ngokuqwashisa kokuphepha, futhi ziqonde izimfanelo ezidingekayo zabagibeli. Okwesibili, izinkampani zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abagibeli bayakwazi ukufinyelela kumatekisi ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzekwa kwemininingwane ecacile ngamanani ezinsizakalo zokuhamba kuzokwenza kube lula kubagibeli ukuhlela izabelomali zabo. Isiphetho Ukuhamba ngamatekisi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuhamba, kodwa izinkinga ezihambisana nakho kumele ziqhutshekwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamatekisi, ohulumeni, nabagibeli basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthela phambili kwezokuhamba kuyashesha, kuphephile, futhi kuhlonishwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo kuzosiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi, futhi kuqinise ukuzethemba kokuhamba kwezakhamuzi.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Ngemva kokuhlwa, umuzi wawugcwele ukukhuluma nokuxoxisana phakathi kwabantu. Izakhamuzi zazilindele usuku olukhulu – usuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, ithemba, kanye nesifiso sokwenza ushintsho empilweni yabo. U-Naledi, intombazane eneminyaka eyi-18, wayechazela umngane wakhe, uThabo, ukuthi ubani ofuna ukumkhetha, kanye nemicabango yakhe ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. “Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sikhethe umuntu ozosikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona, onomoya wokuhola, hhayi nje omunye ongena esikhundleni,” kusho uNaledi, ebuka izithombe zabaholi ezazikhanyiswe emikhankasweni. UThabo wavuma, “Yebo, kufanele sithathe isinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa lethu. Kumele sibe nomqondo obonakalayo.” Ngesikhathi usuku lokhetho lufika, umuzi wawuthule. Izakhamuzi zazingekho ezikhaliphile, kodwa zazilungele ukuvota. U-Naledi noThabo bahamba behamba bejabulile, befuna indawo yokuvota. Njengoba bephuma emnyango, babona ubuhlalu bomoya bumile phansi, bukhumbuza ukujula kokuhluka kwemibono phakathi kwabantu. U-Naledi wabona abanye abafundi behlabelela, bejabulisa umphakathi, bezwakalisa izinto ezinhle ezihambisana nezihlandlo ezinkulu. “Bona, uThabo, abanye abantu bayavuma, baziqhenya ngemiphumela yokhetho. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ivoti lethu linomthelela omkhulu,” kusho uNaledi, ethokozisa umoya wakhe. UThabo wavuma, “Ngiyavuma, akumele sithathe lokhu kungenangqondo. Noma ubani okhetha umholi ungasondela futhi akhombise uthando komunye nomunye. Sizonqoba!” Ngemuva kokufika endaweni yokuvota, uNaledi noThabo bathola imizamo yokuvota. Babona abantu abaningi, bonke bephethe amaphepha avota, befuna ukukhetha umuntu abazokhumbula. Uthando lwabantu lwalukhanya. Izinhliziyo zabantu zaziphezu kwemvelo, zikhumbula imizamo yabo yokwakha ikusasa elihle. U-Naledi wagcizelela, “Noma unqumayo, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kunomoya wokubambisana. Akekho umuntu ongaqonda ukusho okukhuluma.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukhetho lwavula izinkanyezi zempilo, umphakathi waqhamuka nezinto ezithakazelisayo. U-Naledi noThabo banezinto ezinhle ezikhuluma ngempilo, izifiso zokwakha imiphakathi, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. U-Baba uMali, umholi omdala, waba sesimweni sokwakha umphakathi, waqhakambisa ubumbano. “Uhlanga lwethu lufanele ukusebenza futhi luhlale luthokozisa. Umphakathi wethu udinga uthando, hhayi ukulwa,” kusho uBaba uMali, ememeza emkhankasweni. Uthando lwakhe lwavusa uNaledi noThabo, bahlala beletha izwi elisha. UThabo wakhala, “Ngabe umphakathi wethu ungakha isinyathelo, uma sizokhetha umuntu ozoba njengomholi esiqhubekayo?” Ngemva kosuku lokhetho, umoya wawufudumele. U-Naledi noThabo bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa imiphakathi yabo. Umphakathi wabonisa ubumbano, futhi izinkanyezi zezimanga zavela. U-Naledi noThabo, ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinyathelo esilandelayo, banquma ukuhamba nabo bonke abantu abavota, baphinde bakhumbule imizamo yabo. “Akukhona nje ukukhetha umuntu, kodwa lokhu ukwakha ikusasa. Umoya wethu udinga ukukhanya, futhi sizoba nabantu abasha abahola impilo yethu,” kusho uNaledi, ethokozisa umoya wezakhamuzi. UThabo wavuma, “Ngiyavuma, asikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kungokuhola okuhle, kusho ukwakha umphakathi.” Njengoba behamba, umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, kanye nezinhloso ezinhle. Ukhetho lukazwelonke lwaba yisifundo esikhulu sokukhumbula ukuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, bahlale bezwakalisa amandla abo. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babona ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngaleyondlela, uthando lwabo lwazalelwa esikhathini eside, balandela izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, unamandla, futhi ukhanya njengezinkanyezi ebusuku. Ukhetho lwavula umnyango omkhulu wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ukuphila. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babonisa ukuthi ukhetho akusikho kuphela ukukhetha, kodwa kusemqoka ukukhetha ukuphila okukhanyayo. Umphakathi wawuqhubeka, uthi uhambe phambili, uthando lwabo lungabavimba. Ngalesi sikhathi, umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, nempilo, futhi u-Naledi noThabo bazi ukuthi lesi sikhathi sikhumbuza abantu ukuthi baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, bahlale bekhuthaza ukusho okukhuluma. Izinhliziyo zazo zazinothando, zaziqhakambisa izifiso zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukhetho lwakuphakamisela phambili, ngenxa yobumbano, uthando, nempilo. Njengoba umuzi usuku lusondela, umoya wawuhamba phambili, ubumbano lwakhe lwalukukhanya. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babona ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhanya, ziqhakambisa ikusasa elihle. Ukhetho lwavula umnyango omkhulu wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ukuphila.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-e-learning ezikoleni Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yesikole namuhla, akusikho okwakukhona eminyakeni edlule. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zishintshile kanjani? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona izincwadi ezinkulu, sibhala ngezandla zethu, futhi sithola izifundo ezinzima. Kodwa manje, sikhuluma nge-e-learning, okungukuthi ukufunda online. Lokhu kuza nezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi nezinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngalezi zinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi zenza kube lula ukufunda? Ngempela, uma umntwana efuna ukufunda ngendaba ethile, angavula i-laptop yakhe noma i-tablet, abheke ku-Google, bese ethola ulwazi oluningi. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, ngoba akusikho kuphela ukufunda okwenziwa esikoleni, kodwa futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthola ulwazi. Ngabe uyavuma? Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Ngabe ubona ukuthi abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi akukhona wonke umuntu onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Abanye bethu sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona izincwadi ezinkulu, sibhala ngezandla zethu, futhi sithola izifundo ezinzima. Kodwa manje, sikhuluma nge-e-learning, okungukuthi ukufunda online. Lokhu kuza nezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi nezinkinga ezithile. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umntwana engakabi ne-laptop noma i-tablet, noma uma engakwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, uzoba nenkinga enkulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi bahlale behluleka, kanti abanye baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zicabangele izixazululo, mhlawumbe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-computer ezikoleni noma ngama-lab e-inthanethi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yesikole, akusikho kuphela ukufunda. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ezifana nokuxhumana nabanye. Uma abafundi befunda online, kungenzeka ukuthi bahlale bodwa, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba nezingxoxo phakathi kwabafundi? Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, ngoba akusikho kuphela ukufunda okwenziwa esikoleni, kodwa futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthola ulwazi. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngakho, izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukuxhumana, kungaba ngezingxoxo eziku-inthanethi noma ngama-forums. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bakhulise ubudlelwano, futhi bazi ukuthi abakhulumi bodwa. Ngabe ubona ukuthi e-learning ingasiza kanjani othisha? Othisha bangasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ukuze bathuthukise izifundo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, futhi kube lula ukuhlela izifundo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungaba usizo? Othisha bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, futhi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo engcono kubafundi babo. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Othisha badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kahle. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemali, futhi izikole kufanele zicabangele lokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinselelo? Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma nge-e-learning, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona wonke umuntu onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zicabangele izixazululo, mhlawumbe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-computer ezikoleni noma ngama-lab e-inthanethi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi e-learning ingasiza kanjani othisha? Othisha bangasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ukuze bathuthukise izifundo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, futhi kube lula ukuhlela izifundo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungaba usizo? Othisha bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, futhi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo engcono kubafundi babo. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Othisha badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kahle. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemali, futhi izikole kufanele zicabangele lokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinselelo? Ngokuphetha, e-learning iyinsiza enkulu ezikoleni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule izinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Kumele sithole izixazululo ukuze bonke abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka? Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sisebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwenza ukufunda kube lula futhi kube mnandi kubo bonke. Ngabe unayo eminye imibono? Ngiyafisa ukukuzwa!
Izindiza: Ukukhula Kwezokuhamba Ngemoya eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindiza zibe yindlela ebalulekile yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zindiza zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ezomnotho, nakwezokuthutha. Ukuze sithole umqondo ocacile ngalokhu, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezindiza, ukuqala ngokukhula kwemakethe, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezinguquko ezithinta abahambi. Ukukhula Kwezindiza eNingizimu Afrika Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe yiSikhungo Sokucwaninga Ngemoya, imakethe yezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukukhula okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwanda kwabantu abavakasha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izikhumulo zezindiza. Ngokweqiniso, izikhumulo zezindiza ezifana neO.R. Tambo International Airport eGoli, zikhula zibe yizikhungo ezibalulekile zokuhamba, zikhokhela ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Izinkampani Zokuhamba Ngemoya Izinkampani ezihamba phambili ezifana neSouth African Airways, kulandela iBritish Airways neKulula.com, zikhona ukuletha izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kubahambi. Lezi zinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, okukhona phakathi kwazo izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo, izikhumbuzo zokuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhankaso wokuhamba ophumelelayo, zifaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zabo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphepha nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izinguquko Ezinzima Naphezu kokukhula, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukwehla kwemali yokuhamba, izindleko eziphezulu zokuphepha, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima, konke lokhu kuthinta ukusebenza kwezindiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhakha uyaphumelela, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezindiza. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe buye babaluleka kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindiza. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhamba, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphatha izindiza, izinhlelo zokuqapha izimo zezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezindiza nezikhumulo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izindiza zisebenza kahle, ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabahambi, futhi zinciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Izindiza zineqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Zikhuthaza ukuvakashelwa kwezivakashi, okukhuthaza imboni yezokuvakasha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukuphucula izinga lokuphila kwabantu, kanye nokwandisa umnotho. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezibandakanya uhulumeni, zisebenzisana nezinkampani zokuhamba ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uthuthuka futhi ufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, nasekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zokuhamba. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, ukukhula komkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani zokuhamba, kanye nezikhumulo zezindiza, kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo, okuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nasemnothweni. Izindiza zihlala ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana, futhi umkhakha wezindiza uzoba nendima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo lwe-National Health Insurance (NHI) eNingizimu Afrika: Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngohlelo lwe-NHI eNingizimu Afrika, olukhuluma kakhulu emiphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle le phrojekthi, sithole ithuba lokukhuluma noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wezempilo kuleli. Mnu. Mthembu, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi uvela kuphi kulolu hlelo lwe-NHI? Ingxenye 1: Umqondo we-NHI Mnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga, ngijabule ukukhuluma lapha. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo eyanele kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki indawo abahlala kuyo noma izindlela zokukhokha. Umgomo uwukwenza ukuthi wonke umuntu akwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okungcono, ngaphandle kwezithiyo zezindleko.” Ingxenye 2: Izizathu zokwakhiwa kwe-NHI Interviewer: “Kungani le phrojekthi ibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Siyabona ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zihlukaniswe kakhulu. Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemiphumela yabo. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzama ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, luhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo jikelele.” Ingxenye 3: Ukusebenza kwe-NHI Interviewer: “Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza kanjani?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Uhlelo luzoba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, sizodinga ukudala imithombo ehlangene yokuxhasa uhlelo. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuxhasa ngemali, ukwakha izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Sizobambisana nohulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele.” Ingxenye 4: Izinselelo ezitholakalayo Interviewer: “Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lwe-NHI?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Kukhona izinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempilo yomnotho. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngokuqonda kwabantu. Abanye bangase babe nokungabaza ngale phrojekthi, futhi kudinga imizamo yokubasiza baqonde ukuthi kubalulekile. Ekugcineni, kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo.” Ingxenye 5: Umthelela we-NHI emphakathini Interviewer: “Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nomthelela muni emphakathini?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Umthelela uzoba mkhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu babe nempilo engcono, okuzoholela ekwenzeni kahle emisebenzini yabo. Uma abantu benempilo, bazokwazi ukusebenza kahle, lokhu kuzothuthukisa umnotho. Futhi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengokudla, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubambisana komphakathi Interviewer: “Umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza kulolu hlelo?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi uhlelo lwe-NHI lungumsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele babambe iqhaza, balandele izinqubo, futhi banikeze impendulo ukuze sithuthukise uhlelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa futhi zisetshenziswe.” Isiphetho Interviewer: “Ngabe unazo iziphetho noma iziphakamiso zokugcina?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi uhlelo lwe-NHI luhlobene kakhulu nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sisebenze ndawonye, sithuthukise izinsiza, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okudingayo. Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile.” Ngokuphetha, uhlelo lwe-NHI luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithuthukisa lesi simiso, kubalulekile ukuba sihlanganyele, sikhulume, futhi sisebenze ndawonye ukuze sifeze lezi zifiso. Uhlelo lwe-NHI lungaba yisixazululo esihle, uma sithuthukisa izinsiza, sikhuthaza ubambiswano, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izwi zomphakathi ziyaqondwa.
Iphrofayela kaSiphiwe Mthethwa: Umholi Wezokuxhumana Nomphakathi USiphiwe Mthethwa, umholi ophumelelayo kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi, ubonakala njengomuntu onomdlandla futhi onobuchule obuphezulu. Wazalelwa edolobheni laseThekwini, uSiphiwe wakhulela emndenini ohlonipha imisebenzi yokuxhumana nabantu, okwakwenza kube lula kuye ukuthola uthando lwakhe lwezokuxhumana. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athole khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts kwezokuxhumana, waphuma wathola ithuba lokusebenza emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. U-Siphiwe waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomxhumanisi wezindaba enkampanini encane yokumaketha. Lapha, waphumelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwekhasimende nezindaba, okwenza kube lula ukwenza imikhankaso ephumelelayo. Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, uSiphiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza ebhizinisini elikhulu, lapho aqhubeka khona nokukhulisa amakhono akhe. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezazihlanganisa izinkampani eziningi ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSiphiwe waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umfanekiso omuhle wezinkampani azenzayo. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwekhasimende nabaphathi, okwandisa ukwaziswa nokwethembeka kwemikhiqizo. U-Siphiwe ubona ukubaluleka kokuxhumana okuhle, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nezithameli zakhe. U-Siphiwe ungumuntu onothando, futhi ubona ukuthi ukuphumelela emsebenzini kudinga ukusebenzisana nabanye. Uhlale ethola izindlela zokukhuthaza abanye, ebonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle bukhona phakathi kwabantu. Ubuye abe ngumfundisi wezokuxhumana, efundisa abanye ngempumelelo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. U-Siphiwe ubelokhu eyinhloso yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi ubona ukuthi izokuxhumana nomphakathi ingumgogodla wokufeza lokhu. U-Siphiwe uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa akakaze forget ukuthi impumelelo ayitholakali ngaphandle kokusebenza kanzima. Uhlala efundisa abanye ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kudinga ukuzimisela, ukuhlela, nokuba nesineke. U-Siphiwe unethemba lokuthi uzokwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele emikhakheni yabo, futhi unethemba lokuthi uzokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile emhlabeni. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wakhe, u-Siphiwe uyathanda ukuhamba, ukufunda izincwadi, nokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi. Uthanda ukuxhumana nabantu, futhi uhlala edinga ukufunda izinto ezintsha. U-Siphiwe ubona ukuthi ukuphila kahle kudinga ukuxhumana, futhi uzama njalo ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu abamzungezile. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa ungumholi oqavile kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi, onomdlandla wokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi uyinsika emkhakheni wakhe. Uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ezokuxhumana nomphakathi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. U-Siphiwe uqhubeka nokwenza umehluko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abanye baphinde bafunde kumphakathi wakhe. Njengomholi, u-Siphiwe ubonisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi kudinga ukuzinikela, ubuchule, nokuhlonipha abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Siphiwe ubona ukuthi impumelelo ayigcini nje ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Uhlala efuna izindlela zokukhuthaza abanye, futhi ubona ukuthi umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi ubalulekile emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nomphakathi. Uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ubona ukuthi impumelelo yakhe iyinsika yokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. Ngokubambisana, u-Siphiwe ubonisa ukuthi izokuxhumana nomphakathi iyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa, umholi wezokuxhumana nomphakathi, uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi ubudlelwano obuhle bungakha umhlaba ongcono.
Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Emadolobheni Emadolobheni amaningi, imigwaqo ibalulekile ekwakheni isimo sokuphila esihle. Imigwaqo ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuhamba, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekuxhumaneni, ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, nasekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nemigwaqo emadolobheni, ezithinta abantu nsuku zonke. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta imigwaqo emadolobheni, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Ukukhwabanisa Nokungahambi Kahle Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta imigwaqo emadolobheni ukukhwabanisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukungahambi kahle kwemoto, izithuthi eziningi, kanye nezithuthi eziphuthumayo ezithola ubunzima bokuhamba. Ukukhwabanisa kudala ukuhamba kancane, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela emisebenzini yabo, ezikoleni, noma kwezinye izindawo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuhamba, okungaholela ekudambiseni umoya wokusebenza kwabantu. Izimo Zokwakha Nezokuphatha Izimo zokwakha nezokuphatha imigwaqo nazo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinkinga. Imigwaqo eminingi emadolobheni ayitholakali kahle, futhi izakhiwo ezindala zidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni nemigwaqo engaphumeleli kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphatha imigwaqo zidinga ukuba ziqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo ihlale iphephile futhi iyasebenza. Uma lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, izinkinga zikhula. Ukungabi Nendawo Yokupaka Enye inkinga enkulu emadolobheni ukungabi nendawo yokupaka. Njengoba abantu behamba ngezithuthi zabo, kudingeka indawo yokupaka, kodwa emadolobheni amaningi, lezi zindawo zikhona kancane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinkinga zokuhamba, njengoba abantu bejolisa ekutholeni indawo yokupaka, okwandisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa, njengoba abanye abantu benza izinqumo ezingafanele zokupaka ezindaweni ezingavunyelwe. Izingozi Zokuphepha Izingozi zokuphepha zihlala zikhona emigwaqweni emadolobheni. Ukungahambi kahle kwezithuthi, ukungabi nendawo yokupaka, kanye nezimo zokwakha ezimbi, konke lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezingozi. Lokhu akukhathazi kuphela abashayeli bezimoto, kodwa futhi nabagibeli, abahamba ngezinyawo, kanye nabanye abantu abathintekayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokuphatha imigwaqo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nokuphepha emigwaqweni. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokwakha imigwaqo ezinzile nezisebenzayo zidingeka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha imigwaqo emisha, ukulungisa lezo ezindala, kanye nokwandisa izindawo zokupaka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphatha imigwaqo kufanele ziqinise, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo ihlale iphephile futhi iyasebenza. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nokuphepha emigwaqweni. Lokhu kungafaka izinhlelo zokufundisa abashayeli, abahamba ngezinyawo, kanye nabagibeli mayelana nezindlela zokuphepha. Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izingozi ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Okwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga. Lokhu kungafaka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi ezisebenzayo, ezifana nezitimela, amabhasi, kanye nezithuthi ezizimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba, futhi kuzokwehlisa umthwalo emigwaqweni. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemigwaqo emadolobheni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba zithinta impilo yabantu nsuku zonke. Ukukhwabanisa, izimo zokwakha, ukungabi nendawo yokupaka, nezingozi zokuphepha, konke lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile. Ngokuqinisa izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuphatha, nokufundisa, singathuthukisa imigwaqo emadolobheni, sithuthukise impilo yabantu, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ezokwenza impilo ibe ngcono kubo bonke.
Isingeniso Ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emazweni ase-Afrika, lapho impilo yezingane ibhekwa njengento ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nokudla okwanele, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni zempilo, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ukungondleki akuhlanganisi nje ukungabi nokudla, kodwa kubandakanya nezimo eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nokungondleki ezinganeni. Izimbangela zokungondleki Izimbangela zokungondleki ezinganeni zingahlukaniswa zibe yizigaba ezahlukene. Okokuqala, izimo zomnotho zidlala indima ebalulekile. Emazweni amaningi ase-Afrika, izinga lokuhlupheka liphezulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuze abazali bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono ezinganeni zabo. Ukuntula amathuba emisebenzi, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kahle, konke lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amandla okuthola ukudla nokunakekela izingane. Okwesibili, izinkinga zempilo zomphakathi nazo zifaka isandla ekungondleki. Izifo ezinjengokukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, konke lokhu kuthinta impilo yengane. Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kuholela ekunciphiseni izinga lempilo lemindeni, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni ezincane. Imiphumela yokungondleki Imiphumela yokungondleki ezinganeni ibaluleke kakhulu. Izingane ezithola ukudla okunganele ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kwazo nasekuthuthukiseni impilo yazo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuphumelela ezimpilweni zabo. Izingane ezikhula zingakhula zibe nezinkinga zempilo, ezifana nezinkinga zokuthuthuka kwezingqondo, izifo eziyingozi, kanye nezinkinga zokucindezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungondleki kukhulu kakhulu emiphakathini, njengoba izingane ezikhula zingakwazi ukuhamba phambili ukuze zifunde, ziqhubele phambili ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungondleki kungenza kube nzima ukuthi izingane zifinyelele emfundweni. Uma izingane zinganakiwe, ziba nezinkinga zokugxila, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda kahle. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kwezinga lemfundo, okukhokelela ekungatholakali kwamathuba emisebenzi ezikhathini ezizayo. Izixazululo zokulwisana nokungondleki Ukuze kulwisane nokungondleki ezinganeni, izixazululo ezihambisanayo kumele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele anakekele izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ezihluphekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuyisisekelo, ukuxhasa imindeni ngezinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisa umnotho. Ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo ezibhekiswe ekwenzeni umnotho ube namandla kuyasiza ekunciphiseni izinga lokuhlupheka, okukhuthaza impilo engcono yezingane. Okwesibili, izinkampani ezizimele nezinhlelo zomphakathi zingadlala indima enkulu ekulwisaneni nokungondleki. Ngokuqinisa imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukudla okunempilo, ukulethwa kwezinsiza zokunakekela impilo, kanye nokufundisa abazali ngokuqwashisa ngemfundo yokudla, izinkampani zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga eqhubekayo, edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze sikhiphe izingane emiphumeleni emibi yokungondleki, kumele kuqashelwe izimbangela eziyisisekelo, kucutshungulwe imiphumela, futhi kube nezinqubomgomo ezihamba phambili. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphelele. Njengoba sithuthukisa izimo zokuphila ezinganeni, sithuthukisa futhi ikusasa lempilo yomphakathi jikelele.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane - Isidingo Sokuvumelana Nokuqwashisa Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyindaba edabukisayo edinga ukunakwa okukhulu emphakathini wethu. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuvikela izingane, ngoba ziwukuhlola kwekusasa lethu. Uma sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo ngokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zehlakalo azikhanyi kalula, futhi ziphakathi komphakathi wonke. Ukuhlukunyezwa akusikho kuphela ukuphathwa kabi, kodwa kungaba futhi ukuhlekiswa, ukuvikelwa, nokuhlangabezana nezimo ezinzima emndenini. Kulesi siqeshana, ngifuna ukucacisa ukuthi le nhlobo yokuhlukunyezwa ithinta kanjani umqondo wethu wobuntu, nempilo yezingane ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akuvamile nje kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kulolu hlobo lwesimo, luhlangana phakathi kwabantu, emakethe yokusebenza, nasemakhaya. Ubudlelwane bezingane nomphakathi, umndeni, nabangani bukhulu, futhi uma ubudlelwano buwohlokile, imiphumela ingaba yinhle kakhulu. Ukuhlukunyezwa emazingeni ahlukene kudala umuzwa wobuhlungu obungapheli, buphinde budale izinkinga ezinzima zesikhumba nezingqondo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zihlupheka ibhadi empilweni yazo, zithandabuzeka, zikhathazekile, ziba nezinkinga zokuphepha, futhi kunezingozi ezinkulu ezifaka ukuphila kwazo engozini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase bacabange ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kudlalwa kakhulu ngezinto ezilula, okungavela emndenini noma ezingeni lokuhweba. Noma kunjalo, abanye baxwayisa ngokuqonda kahle ukuthi izimo ezinjalo zingathiwa kube iqiniso, kwaqhamuka izincwadi eziningi ezibhala ngazo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abanye abazali bavele badinga ukuchaza kahle kumafomu ahlukahlukene ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi banganikeza kanjani abantwana babo ukwesekwa kakhulu. Ukuze sithole incazelo ethile, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izimo ezithile, sijabulele izinkanyezi zempilo ezikhombisa ubuhlakani bethu bemiphumela emibi. Kodwa singakwenza kanjani ukuze wehlise lezi zingozi? Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokubambisana, sishayisana nemigozi yokuhlonipha izingane zethu. Ukuze sithuthukise indlela yethu yokuphila, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngalezi zinkinga. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi ezinye izingane zibhekene nezimo ezinzima, kungenzeka ukuthi sizoba nezenzo eziphusile. Izingane zidinga ukubhaliswa nezifundo ezithathelwa phezulu, ukuze zikwazi ukubona phezulu lezi zimo, nezindlela zokuzikhulula. Lokhu kudinga ukusiza, ukusebenza nbantu abahlala nazo, namaqembu ezokwelapha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, imphakathi kumele iqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikazwelonke zikhona ukudlula emendeni, ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zikhululeke ngokuphelele kubabantwana. Uhulumeni kufanele ahlale ekhumbula izinsiza ezidingekayo ezifanele, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ezithakazelisayo zidinga ukuphathwa kahle, isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuzoba nempilo engcono ezingeni eliphelele. Izinhloso zoxhaso, umfundaze, kanye nezinhlelo zokuletha izinsiza ezikhethiwe zidinga ukukhishodwa kubantu bonke. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sikhuluma ngenhlonipho ehloniphekile. Okokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule njalo ukuthi izingane zinemigomo ehlukene, futhi akufanele sithathe imiphumela yethu ngokweqiniso. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokubambisana ukuze senze umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, siphendule izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa. Kuphehla nokubhala izindatshana, sicebise, sikhuthaze, nabanye, sihlonipha izingane zethu, sikhuthaza umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwethu. Ukuthanda nokuhlonipha kuyimfihlo yokwakha ikusasa elinempilo lezingane zethu. Akukwazi ukusisiza kwazulu osuku lonke, siphinde sikhumbule ukuthi asikho isinyathelo esincane sokuvikela imiphakathi yethu. Ngakho, sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, ukuze sikhumbule ukuthi sizogxila kwi-tangent yethu. Akusikho ukwenza okuncane kakhulu, kodwa kufanele sibhakabhise umqondo wokuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akuyona into engalungile, futhi singakwazi ukuvikela izingane zethu. Njengoba sizokhanda izindululo ezihambelana nezidingo zabo, sizogubha umphakathi ophumelele nezimpilo ezilungile. Ngakho-ke, asifanele sihluleke, asifanele sihoxise. Izingane zethu zidinga impilo ezinganeno zokuqwashisa, kanye nenhlonipho, ukuze zikhulise ubumba bomphakathi okhululekile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukuziphatha kwethu, sithuthukise umphakathi, siphile ngezinsiza ezinhle, sizobe sikhuluma ngempilo ewusizo. Ngemuva kwalokho, sigcine umphakathi uzinzile. Ngalokhu, sizokwakha umhlaba onempilo nezingane eziphila ngokukhululeka, ngempela.
Othisha: Izinyembezi, Izinhliziyo Nempilo Yokufundisa Siyavuma, othisha bethu bangabantu abalungile. Ngemuva kwesikole, bahlala bezama ukusithuthukisa, ukusifundisa, futhi baqonde izinselelo zethu. Noma ngabe ngabe umnyango wezemfundo ungawazi, thina sazi kahle ukuthi othisha bethu baphila ngaphakathi kwezinkinga eziningi. Abanye bethu basuke bahamba kancane, bebambisene nabafundi, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze sifunde kahle. Uma sikhuluma ngothisha, sizokhuluma ngama-grit, impilo, nezifundo eziphathekayo. Abafundi bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi othisha bethu bahlala bejolise ekuqondeni lezi zinkinga, bezama ukusisiza. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi othisha abahlala belungiselela izifundo zabo? Bangama-hero bempilo yethu, balungiselela izifundo ezinhle, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngabe ubuchwepheshe bwuye buphumelele emkhakheni wemfundo? Impela! Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nemibhalo ehlukene okwenza kube lula ukufundisa. Othisha badinga ukufunda lezi zinto ukuze basebenze kahle, ukuze baqhubeke nokwandisa ulwazi lwabo. Kukhona izinsuku lapho ubuchwepheshe bujabulisa, kanti kwezinye izinsuku, kudinga umqondo omkhulu. Kodwa othisha bethu bahlala bejolise kumfundi, bezama ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngale kwalokhu, sikhumbula ukuthi othisha bethu bahlala bephila ngezinkinga zabo. Lokhu akukhona nje ngezimali, kodwa nakwezinye izinto. Umsebenzi wothisha uhlanganisa ukugxila, ukuzimisela, nokubekezela. Abanye bethu basuke bephila nemindeni emincane, bahlala bejuggling phakathi komsebenzi namakhaya. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi baphile ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, bathole isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi baphinde banakekele izidingo zabo. Yize kunjalo, kunzima ukusho ukuthi othisha baningi abaphila kahle. Kukhona abanye abahlala bephila ngaphansi komthwalo omkhulu, bephoqeleka ukuba benze izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Abanye bahlale bephila ngezinkinga zempilo, kanti abanye bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezingezinhle. Kodwa, bahlala besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi bazama ukwenza kahle. Ngabe singakuphakamisela kanjani lokho? Noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezitholakalayo? Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezindlela ezihlukene zokubambisana. Othisha bethu badinga ukwakha imikhankaso yokuxhumana ukuze basize omunye nomunye. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kumqoka ukuba sibe nezingxoxo, sabelane ngolwazi, futhi sifeze izinjongo ezihlangene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufundisa, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha bethu bahlala bejolise eminyakeni edlule, behlola izindlela eziphumelelayo zokufundisa. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola izifundo, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokuhlola izifundo ezihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kakhulu, futhi kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni komfundi. Uthisha, ngokwenhloso, uyakwazi ukusizakala kuzo zonke izifundo, abamba izifundo ezichelekileyo, futhi aqhubele phambili izifundo. Noma kunjalo, akukona konke okwenziwa othisha. Bahlala belwela ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabafundi. Othisha bethu badinga ukufundisa ngezinhliziyo zabo, benze abafundi babe nomdlandla, bejabulisa. Noma ngabe umphakathi unzima, othisha bethu baphila ngaphakathi kwalokho, bahlala bezama ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhlobene. Ngokuphetha, othisha bethu bahlala bekhuthaza, bejabulisa, futhi bezama ukusiza abafundi. Othisha babalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibabonge ngakho. Lokhu akuyona nje imfundo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni sabelane ngothisha bethu, sibabonge, futhi sihloniphe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngiyabonga.
Ezokuthengisa: Ukuhlola Izinguquko Nokwakha Ubudlelwano Obuqinile Ezokuthengisa, noma i-marketing, ziwumgogodla ophawulekayo emhlabeni wezohwebo. Njengoba izimakethe zishintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bahlale bephenya izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela kubathengi. Lokhu kuhilela ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukuqonda izidingo zabathengi, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo namakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwesikhathi, izindlela zokuthengisa ziye zashintsha kakhulu. Kukhona izikhathi lapho abathengisi besebenzisa kuphela izikhangiso ezibhalwe phansi, kodwa namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokuxhumana nabathengi. Izinkundla zokuxhumana, izikhangiso eziku-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza seziwumthombo obalulekile ekuthengiseni. Lokhu kudinga abathengisi ukuba babe nekhono lokuhlela izinhlelo zabo ngendlela efanele ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela izithameli ezibanzi. Okwamanje, abathengisi bahlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze baqonde izidingo zabathengi. Ukuhlola izimpendulo zabo, ukuqonda izitayela zabo, kanye nokubona ukuthi yini ethokozisa abathengi kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhiqizo iyahambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ucwaningo olujulile, futhi abathengisi kumele banake amandla okuhlaziya idatha ukuze benze izinqumo ezifanele. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nabathengi busekelwe ekutheni umkhiqizo uyawuthokozisa yini umthengi. Abathengisi kumele bazi ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokwakha ukwethembana. Uma umthengi ezwa ukuthi umkhiqizo noma insizakalo iyamjabulisa, kungenzeka azobuyela, okwenza kube lula ukwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambisanayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala phambili emncintiswaneni. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha imikhiqizo emisha, ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Abathengisi kufanele bahlale befunda futhi bejolise ezintsha ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngento ethokozisayo kubathengi. Esikhathini esizayo, ubuchwepheshe buzoqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ezokuthengisa. Imishini yokuhlaziya idatha, i-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza abathengisi bakwazi ukufinyelela kubathengi ngendlela engcono, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi eyingqayizivele. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi baqonde ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi, ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komthengi nomkhiqizo akukwazi ukufakwa endaweni yokusebenza. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buhamba phambili ekwakheni ukwethembana, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, kanye nomqondo wokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, ezokuthengisa zidinga ukuba zihlale zishintsha, zifunde, futhi zikhule. Abathengisi kumele bazi ukuthi, ukuze baphumelele, kumele bahlale begxila kubathengi, baqonde izidingo zabo, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ibhizinisi eliqinile, elizokwazi ukumelana nezinguquko emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ekugcineni, ezokuthengisa akusikho kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nabathengi. Ngakho, abathengisi badinga ukuba bahlale bejolise ekwakheni izixazululo ezithokozisayo, ukuze baphumelele emncintiswaneni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile, ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nokuqonda izidingo zabathengi kuzoba yizinsika ezibalulekile zokuphumelela kwezokuthengisa.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini Emiphakathini eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, izinkinga zamanzi ziba yinkinga enkulu, ethinta impilo, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuhlala kwabantu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu bahlala khona ezindaweni ezingenamathuba amaningi. Ukuqala, sithola ukuthi ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuhlobene kakhulu nezimo zezulu eziguquguqukayo. Izimo zokushisa eziphezulu, izikhukhula, kanye nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphila, njengoba amanzi eba yinto eyigugu kakhulu. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphile, balime, futhi baphile kahle. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, izimpilo zabantu ziba sengozini, futhi lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emnothweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuyinkinga enkulu. Izinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi zihlala zinganele, futhi lapho amanzi ehlanzekile engatholakali, abantu bahlala bephila engozini yokugula. Izinsiza eziningi zikhombisa ukungcoliswa okukhulu, okuvela ezimbonini, emaphandleni, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kudala ukuthi amanzi angase abe yingozi, futhi abantu badinga ukusebenzisa amanzi angcolile, okukhombisa ubungozi obukhulu empilweni yabo. Izinkinga zamanzi zikhombisa ukuthi imiphakathi idinga ukusebenzisana ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile akusikho kuphela ukuxazulula inkinga, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi ibonisa amandla okuzimela. Abantu baqala ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezibandakanya imiphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza wonke umuntu. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ibheke izindlela zokuvuselela amanzi. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ukusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi, kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zamanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa nokufundisa abantu ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha amanzi, ukuze baziqhenye ngempilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile akusikho kuphela ukuxazulula inkinga, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi ibonisa amandla okuzimela. Abantu baqala ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezibandakanya imiphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza wonke umuntu. Ngokuphetha, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Imiphakathi idinga ukusebenzisana ukuze kutholakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nempilo engcono, umnotho oqinile, kanye nezimo zokuhlala ezinhle.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN: Umthelela Nokubhekana Nezimo Ezibucayi Izikhukhula ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal (KZN). Lezi zikhukhula, ezivame ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sezimvula ezinkulu, zishiya umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Kulokhu, sizobheka imiphumela yeziqhumane ezibangelwa izikhukhula, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zimo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Umthelela Wezikhukhula Izikhukhula ezivamile eKZN zishiya umphakathi uthukile, zibhubhisa izindlu, zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka, futhi zishiya abantu behluleka ukuhlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanzi angcolile angaba yimbangela yokusabalala kwezifo, okukhulisa izingozi zokugula. Abantu abaningi baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifana namanzi ahlanzekile, ukudla, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo. Izikhukhula zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni, zibhubhisa izinsiza, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani ezincane, okuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Izinyathelo Zokubhekana Nezimo Uhulumeni kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele basebenza ngokubambisana ukuze baphendule kulezi zimo ezibucayi. Izinhlelo zokuhlenga zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekile bathola usizo. Lokhu kuhilela ukusiza abantu abahlala ezindlini ezibhujiswe, ukuhlinzeka ngokudla, kanye nokusebenzisa izikhungo zezempilo. Uhulumeni uhlose ukukhulisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu eziphumelelayo, ezikwazi ukumelana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu eziphephile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile ukuze imiphakathi ikwazi ukuvuselela. Izixazululo Zesikhathi Esizayo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhukhula aziphindi zenzeka ngendlela efanayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezibanzi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, ukuhlola izindawo ezibucayi, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukuqwashisa imiphakathi ngalezi zimo, kanye nokubafundisa ngezindlela zokuvikela, kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Isiphetho Izikhukhula zaseKZN zishiya umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi kunezindlela zokubhekana nalezi zimo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo phakathi kukahulumeni, izinhlelo ezizimele, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekile bathola usizo oludingekayo. Izixazululo eziphusile nezinhlelo zokuvikela zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhukhula ezinjalo aziphindi zenzeka, futhi umphakathi ungathuthuka ngokuzinzile. Kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu baphila kahle, futhi izindawo zethu zihlala ziphephile. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi umhlaba unamandla, kodwa nathi sinamandla okwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela umphakathi wethu.
iTikTok - Uhlanga Lwezokuxhumana Olwakha Noma Oluphula? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTikTok iye yaba yinsika enkulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Le nsizakalo yokwabelana ngama-video, eyasungulwa ngo-2016, ibonakala iyinsiza ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ihlale ibhekwa ngamehlo anganeno. Kukhona abavuma ukuthi iTikTok iyinsiza ewusizo, ikhulisa ubuciko, futhi ibeka abantu phambili, kanti abanye baphikisa, bephakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha, umphakathi, kanye nemiphumela ethile yokusebenzisa le nsizakalo. Uhlanga Lwenjabulo Okokuqala, iTikTok iyinsiza edlalwa yizigidi zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ikuvumela ukuba uveze ubuciko bakho, ubonise amakhono, futhi ufinyelele abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu bengaxhumana khona, bejabulisa, futhi befundisana. Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi iTikTok iyindlela yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezibalulekile, izinkinga zomphakathi, noma izenzakalo zansuku zonke. Ukubeka izindaba ezithile ematheni, okungaba izindaba zomphakathi, izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, noma imikhuba emisha, kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukwakha Umsebenzi Nokuqwashisa Ngaphezu kokujabulisa, iTikTok ibonakala iyinsiza ewusizo kulabo abafuna ukudala imisebenzi emisha. Abantu abaningi bathola amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi abaculi, ababhali, nabadansi. I-TikTok inikeza abantu ithuba lokuthola udumo, futhi lokhu kungaholela emathubeni amakhulu emisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok iyinsiza yokwazisa abantu ngezinto ezibalulekile, njengezempilo, imvelo, kanye nezokuphepha. Amavidiyo afundisayo angaba nethonya elihle emphakathini, akhuthaze abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Izinkinga Zokuphepha Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle ngale nsizakalo. Abaphikisi baveza izinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana neTikTok, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuphepha kolwazi. Izinkampani eziningi zikhathazekile ngendaba yokuthi idatha yomsebenzisi ingase ingavikeleki kahle. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuthi ubani ongalufinyelela ulwazi lwethu, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zomphakathi. Abantu baphikisana ngokuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela ulwazi lomsebenzisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luphathwa kanjani. Imiphumela Emphakathini Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok ibonakala ithinta imikhuba yomphakathi. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi iTikTok ikhuthaza imikhuba engafanele, efana nokucasulwa, ukweqisa, noma ukwakha izithombe ezingalungile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke bahlale bephila impilo engalungile, begxila emibonweni engafanele. Ukuphila ngaphakathi kwezithombe ezinhle kakhulu kungadala ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebasha, abavame ukuqhathanisa impilo yabo nabanye. Ukuphila Ngemva KweTikTok Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iTikTok iyinsiza, futhi njengazo zonke izinsiza, inezinzuzo nezinkinga zayo. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe neziqondiso ezicacile zokusebenzisa le nsizakalo, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise iTikTok ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, iTikTok iyinsiza enamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi inezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe neziqondiso ezicacile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise iTikTok ngendlela efanele, futhi sigcine izinga lokuphepha kolwazi lwethu. Njengoba sithola izinzuzo ezivela kule nsiza, kufanele futhi siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ngale ndlela, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuhle.
### UShaka Zulu: Umholi Ohlonishwa NgesiZulu UShaka Zulu, igama elivelele, libonisa ugqozi olukhulu lwezinkanyezi ezingakaze ziphume emlandweni wezizwe. Kwakukhona isikhathi sokuqala lapho uShaka Zulu, iNkosi enkulu, waphuma khona. Impilo yakhe akukhulumi kuphela ngezindawo ezisemphumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika, kodwa iphinde ibonise izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Kukhona izinkolelo eziningi ngomlando wakhe, abanye bethi wazalwa ngo-1787, emndenini ophakathi kweSilo esidala, iNkosi uSenzangakhona, okwakuyisizathu sokuthi kube nezinto eziningi ezinkulu ezenzakalayo. UShaka wayengumfana ophakeme, futhi kunzima ukuphawula ukuthi ngabe wayefuna kanjani ukwakha umphakathi wakhe. Ubuhlakani bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi ubhuti wakhe, uDingiswayo, wamsiza kakhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo. UShaka wayelungisa ibutho labesilisa ngezindlela ezintsha, okwakuholela ekutheni aqhubeke nokwakha amandla amaZulu. Lokhu kwashintsha umhlaba wabo. Kuphakanyisiwe ukuthi uShaka nabantu bakhe babekhuluma ngothando, futhi wayeqonda kakhulu ngesidingo sokuvikela umphakathi. Wayezama ukuhuthula izinkinga ezihambisana nezinhlanga, ngakho umqondo wokubambisana waba yinkinga enkulu kwazulu. Waqhubeka nokwakha izinsika ezazidala ukubakhulula ezimeni ezinzima, futhi izimpi zaziyinsakavukela. UShaka wayazi ukuthi akufanele alale, kodwa kumele aqhubeke nokuvikela abantu bakhe. Izimpi ezinkulu zenzeka phakathi kwezizwe, phakathi kweZulu nabaseNguni, futhi uShaka wavimba izitha zakhe. Lokhu kwahlala kuchaza umbono wakhe omkhulu wokuqonda nokuqhuba impilo izakhamuzi ezibandakanyekayo. Ngemva kokuhlangana nezinkinga eziningi, kwavuma ukuthi uShaka wayengumholi onobuhlakani obuhlukahlukene. Wazi ukuthi ubuholi akukhona nje ukuzulazula, kodwa kufanele unikeze abantu bakho lokho okubahlonipha, uthokozise futhi ubanike ithemba. Lokhu kwalesa izimpumelelo eziningi. Nokho, akusoloko kuhle; uShaka wahlushwa nezinkinga ezivela kubaculi nabaholi abavela kumadodana akhe. UShaka wayesebenzisa izindlela ezinzima ukuze afinyelele abantu bakhe, futhi wayenobuhlakani obukwazi ukuzenza zandanisa izikhumbuzo zakhe. UShaka Zulu, owayengumholi omkhulu, wakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa wayesazi ukuthi ukukholwa njalo kuyadingeka. Ezakhamuzini zakhe, wayefuna ukwakha umphakathi onothando, futhi wanikela ngothando lokubuyisela. UShaka uhlala enhliziyweni yamaZulu, ezokhuluma ngothando, umoya nemikhuba, futhi kujabulisa ukukhumbula uShaka njengomholi ohlonishwayo.
Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukufunda emanyuvesi sekuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngempumelelo yomuntu siqu kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Nokho, lezi zifundo zifaka izindleko ezinkulu, okwenza kube khona ingxoxo-mpikiswano mayelana nemali yokufunda. Ngabe le mali iyadingeka, noma ingabe iyisithiyo esikhulu kubafundi abasha? Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nemali yokufunda emanyuvesi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imali yokufunda iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Imali ethathwa emafundweni isiza ekwakheni izinsiza ezifanele, njengemithombo yokufunda, izikhungo zokucwaninga, kanye nezifundo ezihamba phambili. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, okubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imali yokufunda isiza ekukhokheni othisha abaqeqeshiwe, abahlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi le mali yokufunda ingaba yinkinga enkulu kubafundi abaningi. Ezweni elinokuntuleka kwemali, abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukukhokhela izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni badinge ukuthola izikweletu ezinkulu, okungase kube nzima ukukhokha emuva. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi baphazamiseke emsebenzini wabo, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngempela ngalesi sithiyo esikhulu esibhekene nabafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akuwona wonke umuntu ongena emanyuvesi. Abafundi abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho ukufinyelela emanyuvesi kungaba nzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba abanye abafundi bengenakukwazi ukuhamba emuva kwemali yokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise ukufinyelela emfundweni, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufunda. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunezindlela ezithile zokunciphisa izindleko zokufunda. Izinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali, izikhwama zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokubolekwa kwemali zingasiza abafundi abangenamali. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka kakhulu ngempilo yabo yezezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo zingase zisebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko, njengokuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela abafundi ukuba bafunde besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko zokufunda zihlala zikhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufunda. Izinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali kufanele zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokuhlinzeka, ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abafundi abaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufunda, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ngokuphetha, imali yokufunda emanyuvesi iyinkinga enkulu, kodwa futhi iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise ukufinyelela emfundweni, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise imfundo emhlabeni jikelele.
Abafundi Basemanyuvesi: Izifundo, Izinselelo Nezinto Eziwusizo Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, njengoba bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi uqobo, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabafundi basemanyuvesi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izifundo abahlangabezana nazo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinto eziwusizo ezitholakala kulolu hambo. Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe Nezokufunda Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olujulile nolwakhiwe. Izifundo ezitholakala emanyuvesi zihluke kakhulu, kusukela ezifundweni zezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, ezomnotho, nezobuciko. Lezi zifundo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bacabange ngokuqhubekayo, bakhe amakhono amasha, futhi bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwezifundo zabo nezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo ezinkingeni ezithile. Izinselelo Abafundi Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abafundi basemanyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizindleko zemfundo. Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungase kube nomthelela ekutheni bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka kuyizinkinga ezivamile phakathi kwabafundi. Ukuphila emanyuvesi kudinga ukuzivocavoca, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nokuphila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bedangele noma bephazamisekile, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ekufundeni kwabo. Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi badinga izinsiza ezihlinzekwa emanyuvesi, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwengqondo, izifundo zokuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa. Izinto Eziwusizo Nezixazululo Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi basemanyuvesi badinga ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zemfundo zihlala zinikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ezihlanganisa izifundo ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokuthola usizo lapho kudingeka khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde babe nethuba lokuthola ulwazi olungaphezulu ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzithandela, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono amasha, bathuthukise ubuholi, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwabo nabanye. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Noma bephakathi kwezinselelo eziningi, izifundo abahlangabezana nazo zikhuthaza ukukhula kwabo, kokubili njengabantu kanye nabafundi. Ukuze baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, baphinde basebenzise amathuba okuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Ngokwenza lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo, bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke.
Usuku lweNkululeko: Ukuhlonipha Umhlaba Wethu Wenkululeko Njengoba sihamba phambili emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nemicabango ejulile ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, uSuku lweNkululeko, olugujwa minyaka yonke. Lokhu akukhulumi kuphela ngempilo yethu, kodwa futhi kukhombisa isiko, ubuhlakani, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nathi njengenhlalo.
