Usuku lweNkululeko, oluthathwa ngokujulile ngabaningi, lukhombisa umoya wokuzimela, impilo, nokuqhubekela phambili. Ngokwami, akusiyo nje insuku yokugubha umcimbi, kodwa kuyithuba lokubuyekezwa kokuthi silwela ini. Ngonyaka ka-1994, lapho sithola khona inkululeko, bekukhona umuzwa ophakeme wokuthi izwe lethu lizothuthuka. Ngaleso sikhathi, sathola ithuba lokwakha isizwe esinobumbano, esihlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ubuhlakani bethu, ubumbano, kanye nomzamo wokubuyisela emuva izinhlelo ezazikhona, kwavula umnyango omusha wokuthula. Nokho, njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkululeko akusiyo into ethola ukuthola kalula. Isebenza njengomgibeli, ehlasela izithiyo ezikhona ekuphileni kwabantu. Ubulili, ubuzwe, kanye nezimo zomnotho kusengaphambili kukhona izithiyo ezisithinta. Ngaleso sizathu, kufanele siqhubeke siphakamisa izwi lethu, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta abantu abaningi, njengoba uSuku lweNkululeko luhloswe ukusikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sihloniphe izwi labanye. Phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo ngalesi sikhathi, singabheka izinkumbulo zethu. Ngisakhumbula izithombe zamadodana nentombazane ezaziwela emigwaqweni, zikhangisa izifanekiso zenkululeko. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi siphila emhlabeni lapho akukhona okukhuluma ngempela. Kodwa, akukhona okungapheli. Umhlaba wethu unama-encumbrances, futhi lokhu kusebenza ebuhleni nesimo esikuso. Ngakho, uma siphokophela phambili, kubalulekile ukufaka izinyathelo ezihambisanayo. Siyazi ukuthi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantwana bethu bangase baphinde bacabange ngendlela esibheka ngayo inkululeko. Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlala zikhona, kufanele zihlale ziphambili ezinhlelweni zethu. Ubulili obufana nezenzo ezithinta amalungelo abantu kufanele kube phezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwempilo enhle, ezokuthula, nemfundo eqinile. Ubulungiswa bempilo kufanele bube yintshisakalo yethu, ngoba inkululeko ayinakho ukwakha uhlelo olungavumeli ukuba kube nokuwohloka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSuku lweNkululeko akusikho okokuhlonipha kuphela. Kuphinde kube yithuba lokuhlola imiphumela yezenzo zethu. Njengoba sikhumbula izigameko eziphawulekayo zomlando, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi imizamo yethu ayikho ukuze kuphela kwabanye, kodwa futhi kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho, kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo ophusile, sihlale sihamba nemfundo ezikhaliphile. Kumaqhawe, akusiyona nje imizamo yokukhumbula izinsuku ezithile, kodwa imizamo yokuhlola izinsuku ezizayo. Uthando lokuthula kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kumele kube yinto eyinhloko. Njengoba siqhubeka sikhumbula uSuku lweNkululeko, kufanele siqhubeke nokukhuthaza intuthuko, imfundo, nobuchwepheshe, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uzodlondlobala. Ngokukhuluma ngalezi zinto, ngisebenzisa leli sikhathi ukukhumbula abakhokheli bethu abaphakeme, abashiya imikhondo emihle, ngesikhathi abakhipha izwi labo, benza ngezindlela ezithandekayo. Ukukhumbula uMandela, uHendrik Verwoerd, uOliver Tambo, kanye nabanye, ngenxa yokuthi babe nemfanelo yokukhathalela abantu. Lokhu kuhlonipha umoya wabo, nokuthi sithole ithuba lokwakha umhlaba omusha, akukupheli. Ngakho, uSuku lweNkululeko akusiyo nje insuku yokugubha, kodwa iwubufakazi bokuthi siqhubeka sikhumbula indaba yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yindlela yokukhumbula, futhi sikhumbula izinzuzo zenkululeko. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sizokulethela ukuzimisela, ukukhuthazela, kanye nempumelelo, ukuze sithole umhlaba ohlanganyele. U-Suku lweNkululeko, ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuyisa ithemba, ubonisa ukuthi sithanda ukuhlonipha, sikhumbula izinkumbulo, futhi sithole ubumbano. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nesibindi, sikhumbule ukuthi inkululeko ayikuphi ngaphandle kwezinsizakalo zethu. Uthando, ukuxhumana, nokusebenzisana kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube indawo engcono. Ngakho-ke, sisemoyeni wokubuyisa umhlaba wethu, sithokozisa, futhi siqhubekele phambili, sikhumbula uSuku lweNkululeko.
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Indlela Yokuhamba Ngezinyathelo Zokuthenga Isingeniso Izitolo ezinkulu zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathole izinto eziningi ngasikhathi sinye. Kulokhu, sizobe sikhuluma ngezinyathelo okufanele uzithathe ukuze uhambise kahle ezitolo ezinkulu, uqonde kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi uzuze kokubili ukhetho nezindleko. Isinyathelo Sokuqala: Ukuhlela Ukuhamba Ngaphambi kokuba uhambe, kubalulekile ukuhlela. Qala ngokubhala uhlu lwezinto ozidingayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izinto ezibalulekile ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Bheka izaphulelo namathikithi akhona, njengoba izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa. Hlela isikhathi sokuhamba, ungahambi ngezikhathi eziphezulu kakhulu ukuze ugweme izixuku. Isinyathelo Sesibili: Ukungena Esitolo Lapho usufikile esitolo, qinisekisa ukuthi ungena ngendlela efanele. Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zinezingxenye ezahlukene, ngakho qaphela izikhombisi-ndlela ezikuleso sikhungo. Phakathi kokungena, ungathola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, njengemisebenzi yokuphakela, ezinsizeni zamakhasimende, kanye nezikhangiso ezithile. Isinyathelo Sesithathu: Ukuzulazula Esitolo Ngemuva kokungena, sebenzisa uhlu lwakho ukuze uzulazule kahle. Qala endaweni ethile, njengendawo yokudla, bese uqhubeka nezinye izigaba, njengezingubo, imikhiqizo yokuhlobisa, namathoyizi. Lindela izimpawu ezikhombisa imikhiqizo ethile, njengoba izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zihlola izigaba ezihlukene. Isinyathelo Sesine: Ukuze Uthole Okuthile Ngokushesha Uma udinga ukuthola umkhiqizo othile, ungabuza umsebenzi wendawo. Abantu abasebenza ezitolo banolwazi olunembile mayelana nezimpahla ezitholakalayo futhi bazokwazi ukukuholela endaweni efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinto ozidingayo, kanti futhi kunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Isinyathelo Sesihlanu: Ukuthenga Nokusebenza Nezimali Njengoba uqhubeka nokuthenga, qaphela izindleko. Bheka izimpahla ezikhangisiwe, futhi uqaphele ukuthi zikhona izaphulelo noma izinzuzo eziqondile. Uma uthenga, ungasebenzisa ikhadi lesikweletu noma imali. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela izinqubo zokukhokha, njengezinketho zokubuyisela. Isinyathelo Sesithupha: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Ngesikhathi sokuthenga, qaphela ukuphepha kwakho. Gwema ukuhamba ngezixuku ezinkulu ezingenakuhlala kahle. Kuhlale uhlole izimpahla zakho, uqiniseke ukuthi akukho okulahlekile. Uma uthola ukuthi udinga ukusiza, thintana nabaphathi ukuze bakusize. Isinyathelo Sesixhenxe: Ukupakisha Nokuhamba Ngemva kokuphothula ukuthenga, qiniseka ukuthi uthwale kahle imikhiqizo yakho. Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zinikeza izikhwama zokuthenga, kodwa ungathanda ukuletha zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi izinto eziphakeme zifakwe kahle ukuze zingaphumi ezikhwameni. Hamba kancane, uqaphe izinyathelo zakho, ikakhulukazi uma ubhikisha izikhwama ezinzima. Isinyathelo Sesishiyagalombili: Ukuhlola Imikhiqizo Ngemuva Kokuhamba Ngemva kokubuyela ekhaya, hlola imikhiqizo yakho. Qiniseka ukuthi konke okuvumelekile kuhle, futhi uma kukhona okungalungile, thintana nesitolo ukuze ufake isikhalazo. Lokhu kuzokugcina uqinisekile ukuthi uzuze impumelelo ekuthengeni kwakho. Isiphetho Izitolo ezinkulu zizele ngezinto eziningi ezikhethwayo, futhi ukwenza kahle ukuhamba ezitolo kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungazithokozisa ngokuthenga, uphinde uzuze ngempela esikhathini esisodwa. Hamba uvuleka, udinge kahle, futhi ujabulele ithuba lokuthenga. Izitolo ezinkulu zikhona ukuze zisebenze kahle empilweni yethu, zingcashe izidingo zethu ezahlukene.
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo: Ukubuyekezwa Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kubalulekile emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi, njengoba kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha izwe. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila kumaphuzu abalulekile ahlobene nokwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ezenzekile, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nemiphumela yazo emphakathini. Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophakeme, okhombisa izimiso ezisemqoka zokuphatha izwe. Uhlelo lokwakha umthethosisekelo luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukucabanga, ukuhlela, nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kuhlangene nezifiso zomphakathi, izifundo ezitholakele emlandweni, kanye nezidingo zamanje. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwe lethu lidlule ezinguqukweni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokulwa nokucindezelwa. Lezi zinguquko zafaka isandla ekwakhiweni komthethosisekelo wethu, njengoba abantu baphakamisa izwi labo ukuze babonise izidingo zabo. Umthethosisekelo wokuqala, owawubhalwe ngemuva kokukhululeka, wawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo ayisisekelo kubantu, kodwa wawungakabi namandla okuphatha izwe ngendlela efanele. Ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okunzima, umthethosisekelo wethu wahlangabezana nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola amalungelo akhe, kwadingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezithile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komthethosisekelo omusha, owawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha, ukulwa nokungabi namthetho, kanye nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukubuyekezwa komthethosisekelo akupheli nje emakhanda ababhali, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa ngokujulile kumphakathi. Izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthethosisekelo uyabhekwa futhi uyaphumelela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayavikelwa, futhi abantu baphila ngendlela efanele. Naphezu kwalezi zinguquko, umthethosisekelo wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze uqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezithile ezizobhekelela izidingo zamanje. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselela izigaba ezithile zomthethosisekelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi ziyaqondiswa, futhi zikhuluma ngezidingo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi umthethosisekelo awupheli nje emthethweni, kodwa uhlanganisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni umthethosisekelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa. Ukuze lezi zinguquko zibe nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaholi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthethosisekelo wethu uzoba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezothola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesikhathi sokucabanga, sibe nesineke, futhi sibe nokuzimisela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akusikho ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuphetha, ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwe lethu lihlala linobulungiswa, futhi abantu baphila ngendlela efanelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nesineke, sibe nokuzimisela, futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umthethosisekelo onobulungiswa. Umthethosisekelo akusikho kuphela umthetho, kodwa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube khona ithemba lokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Izincwadi: Umcimbi Wokubhalwa Kwezincwadi Ngaphakathi kwesimo esikhulu sokuhlanga, umcimbi omkhulu wokuqhakambisa ubuciko bokubhala wenzeka, uhlotshaniswa nezincwadi ezimnandi. Lo mcimbi, owayehlelwe emnyangweni wezokucabangela eNyuvesi yaseMzanzi, wathatha izinsuku ezimbili ezijabulisayo. Abantu abaningi, okuhlanganisa abakhiqizi bezincwadi, ababukeli, nabanikazi bezincwadi, bafika bejolise emiphakathini yezincwadi, okwakunguyena ophilisa amakhalekhukhwini ezitolo. Uqala umcimbi ngezinkulumo zokuqala ezivela kubabhali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ababeqhuba izifundo ezithokozisayo zokufaka imizwa nempilo emibhalweni yabo. UGladys Ngubane, umbhali odumile, waphakamisa umqondo othi, “Izincwadi zihlala zingenza igama lami labehluleli bezimpilo, ngakho kumele sikubhale kahle okukhona phakathi kwethu.” Lokhu kwavusa izinkanyezi eziningi ezazifuna ukujabulela lezi zifundo. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi waphendukela ezinsukwini zokuxoxisana, lapho ababhali bavuma ukwabelana ngemicabango emisha nemibono yokwakha izincwadi eziphawulekayo. UThuli Mkhize, ophumelelayo kumsakazi wezincwadi, wahlakulela izeluleko ezinkulu zokuthi umbhali angakwenza kanjani uma eqhamuka nesibalukiso esikhulu sempilo yakhe. “Zama ukufaka ukwazisa kwabantu kulokho okubhalayo, ngale ndlela uthola ikhono lokuxhumanisa abaphulaphuli,” esho, ethokozisa izihlwele. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba neseshini yokubhalisa, lapho ababhali behlangana, bekwazi ukuxoxa ngobuciko babo. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wokubambisana ubukeka uthokozisa. USipho Ngcobo, omunye wababhalayo, wabelana ngendaba yakhe yokulwa nobunzima bokubhala, wathi: “Kubalulekile ukuthi sizame ukwakha izincwadi ezithinta inhliziyo, njalo kumelwe sibekela umbono wethu.” Umgqigqo wesikhathi uhamba kancane, umcimbi uqhubeka uhlangabezana nezikhathi zokuhlonipha ababhali abaphumelelayo, lapho abantu beqonda khona amagugu ezincwadi. U-Nokuthula Baloyi, umbhali ophumelele, ethokozisa ngokuhlonishwa kwalezi zinkanyezi kubantu ababenjengobasekeli kuphela. Amabhuku ahluka-hlukene abekwe kumakhalekhukhwini, abathandi bezincwadi bekhuluma ngokuqinile ngalokho ababona kwincwadi ngayinye. Kwaba nemika yethuba ebabazekayo yokuthenga ezincwadini ezithokozisayo, umcimbi ufinyelela ebantwini abaningi, okwakukhumbuza ngempela ukuthi izincwadi zisekhona njengezibani ezikhanyisayo emhlabeni. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ugcine usiphe imicabango emisha, imishado ehlangene phakathi kwezimvo nezincwadi, edlisa udumo lobuciko. Kwakuyinsuku enenhlonipho, ewusizo, echaza kabanzi ngencwadi nokubhala. Izincwadi zaziphithizela kahle phakathi kwethu, zaba yizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, ezintsha, nezivumelwano ezizayo emphakathini. Ngenkathi umcimbi uthokozisa, ababhali nabathandi bezincwadi bahlala bekhuluma ngokusebenzisa izincwadi njengenhlangano yokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni. Ukuhlelwa kwalesi sikhathi kwahambisana nabantu abanjalo, kwakhumbuza ukuthi izincwadi zidlalela i-ecosystem, zidinga ukuhamba nathi endaweni yethu yokuphila. Lokhu kufezekile, futhi kugcinwa kumasiko nezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Umcimbi wenziwa kabusha ukuthuthukisa ukwenza kahle kwababhali, izincwadi, kanye nomphakathi. Abantu bakhumbulile ukuthi izincwadi azigcinwa kubhalwe emakhathalogu kuphela, kodwa ziyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha isiko lethu. Umcimbi ubonise indlela yokuthi izincwadi zicashe emqondweni wethu, zibe yizikhumbuzo ezihlala zikhanya esikhathini esingokomoya. Izincwadi – zihlala zikhanyile, zisenza siphile, zisenza sibe nemibono emisha.
Ukwesekwa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane Ngiyahlanganyela nomuzwa omuhle kulolu daba lwamabhizinisi amancane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkampani ezikhulayo, ngoba yilezo ezikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza umnotho wethu, futhi ziphinde ziqinise umphakathi. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane? Ngizokutshela ngakho kahle. Lokhu kuqala, ngizokwenza kucace ukuthi kungani amabhizinisi amancane ebalulekile. Uma ubheka emaphandleni, noma ezindaweni eziphakathi kwedolobha, uzobona ukuthi lezi zinkampani, noma zikhona ezindaweni zokudlela, izitolo, noma izisebenzi ezizimele, zenza umehluko omkhulu. Zivuleka ezindaweni eziningi, zikhulisa umkhiqizo, futhi zenza umphakathi ube nempilo. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umnotho wethu uphila ngezinyathelo ezincane, ezikhuthazwe yilezi zinkampani. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokwesekwa. Ngabe sikhona yini isiqondiso esikhona ukusekela lezi zinkampani? Yebo, izinhlelo eziningi zikhona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezivela kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni ezizimele, noma ngababambiqhaza emphakathini. Ngokwesibonelo, uhulumeni unikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, njengezimali zokuqala, imihlangano yokufundisa, namathuba okuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane banganqoba izithiyo eziningi uma behola imali, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhulume ngebhizinisi elizimele. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bahlushwa izinselele eziningi, kodwa umphakathi ungasiza. Cabanga ngalesi simo: umuntu osebenza emkhakheni webhizinisi, engase abe nezinye izinkinga ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, noma ukwakha igama. Uma umphakathi uqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinselele, ungawasekela ngokuhlinzeka ngemibono, izinsiza, noma ngisho nokuxhumana nabantu abanomqondo ofanayo. Kukhona futhi imibono emisha ezimele ezithola ukwesekwa. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinkampani ezintsha nezobuchwepheshe zidinga ukwesekwa? Ngempela! Lezi zinkampani zikhula ngokushesha, futhi uma zingathola ukwesekwa, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi umnotho unguquko, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze sizivumele. Uma izinkampani ezintsha zithola ukwesekwa, zizokwazi ukukhulisa imisebenzi, zikhulise imboni, futhi zihlinzeke ngemisindo emisha. Ngaphezu kwezinhlelo ezikhona, kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko. Ukuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane akupheli kuphela ezinhlelweni ezisemthethweni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi siqhakambise amasiko okuxhasana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha umoya wokuxhasana phakathi kwabantu. Cabanga uma umphakathi uqala ukuthanda nokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kungenzeka kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Sizokwazi ukusiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bahlale beqhubeka, futhi sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele futhi sikhulume ngemininingwane ethile. Kungani izinkampani ezincane zidinga ukuxhaswa kwezobuchwepheshe? Izinsiza ezinjengezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuphatha, nemithombo yokuxhumana ziwusizo kakhulu. Uma umnikazi webhizinisi ethola usizo kwezobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka ukuthi akhuphule ukusebenza kahle, akhulise ukukhiqiza, futhi ahloniphe isikhathi. Lokhu kuhlobene nemicabango yethu yokuthuthukisa umnotho, ngoba uma izinkampani ziqhubeka, umphakathi uthola izinzuzo. Ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akupheli lapha. Kukhona nezinye izindlela eziningi zokuxhasa, ezifanele ukuba sikhulume ngazo. Isibonelo, ukubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amancane nakakhulu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uma abanikazi bamabhizinisi bexhumana, bangakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, benze izivumelwano zokuhweba, futhi bakhuthaze umphakathi. Lokhu kudala umoya womsebenzi ongenakuphikwa, futhi kukhuthaza ukuxhaswa phakathi kwabanye. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akuyona into eyodwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ofanayo, sisebenzisane, futhi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, noma umphakathi, sonke sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sibe nethemba, sibe nokuqonda, futhi sikhuthaze. Ngakho, ngicela ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane awusizo kuphela emnothweni, kodwa futhi awusizo ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nokwesekwa okuhle kungaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi kuyinsakavukela yempilo yethu. Sihamba phambili!
Abadali Bokuqukethwe (Content Creators) Umbuzo 1: Abadali bokuqukethwe bangobani? Abadali bokuqukethwe yibo abantu abakhiqiza futhi babelana ngezinto ezithokozisayo zokuxhumana, njengezithombe, amavidiyo, izindatshana, nezinhlelo zomsakazo. Lezi zinto zisetshenziswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kumasayithi e-inthanethi, nasezinhlelweni zethelevishini. Bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala umthelela kubadali bokuqukethwe? Umthelela kubadali bokuqukethwe ungavela ezicini eziningi, okuhlanganisa izifiso zababukeli, izitayela ezikhona, nezidingo zomphakathi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abadali bokuqukethwe badinga ukujwayela izinguquko ukuze bagcine ababukeli benelisekile. Ukubambisana nabanye, ukusebenzisa izinkundla ezihlukene, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile ukuze bakhe umthelela omuhle. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba umdali wokuqukethwe? Umdali wokuqukethwe uthola izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezindlela eziningi zokwenza imali, njengezikhangiso, ukuhweba, noma ukubambisana nezinkampani. Okwesibili, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakha umphakathi wabo, okuvumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane futhi babelane ngemicabango. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba baveze ubuciko babo, benze izinto ezinhle, futhi baphumelele emhlabeni wabo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo abadali bokuqukethwe abahlangabezana nazo? Ngaphandle kwezinzuzo, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwabanye abadali kudinga ukuthi bahlale bephakamisela izinga eliphezulu. Okwesibili, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zingaba nomthelela ekubeni neziqu ezimangalisayo. Okokugcina, ukuthola isikhathi sokwenza okuqukethwe okuhle phakathi kwezibopho zomsebenzi nezinhloso zomuntu siqu kungaba inselelo enkulu. Umbuzo 5: Singafunda kanjani kubadali bokuqukethwe? Ukuze sibe ngabafundi abahle, kufanele siqonde izidingo zethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda izitayela ezihlukahlukene, ukujula ekwakheni okuqukethwe, nokuhlola izinkundla ezahlukene ukuze sithole ukuthi yini esebenza kahle. Ukubambisana nabanye abadali, ukufunda ezincwadini, kanye nokubuka izifundo eziku-inthanethi kungasiza ekwakheni amakhono ethu. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa amakhono okudala? Ukuthuthukisa amakhono okudala kudinga ukuzikhandla. Ukuze ube umdali ophumelelayo, ungazama ukufunda izifundo eziku-inthanethi, ukulandela izifundo ezihlobene, noma ukuhamba emihlanganweni yabadali bokuqukethwe. Ukwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene, njengokudala amavidiyo, izithombe, noma izindatshana, kungasiza ekwakheni amakhono akho. Ukubuka abanye abadali, ukuthola impendulo, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokudala, konke kubalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyicabangele uma uqala njengomdali wokuqukethwe? Uma uqala njengomdali wokuqukethwe, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile. Qiniseka ukuthi unokucacisa ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifeza, futhi ubeke phambili izinjongo ezithile. Hlala unethemba, futhi ungavumeli izinselelo zikudikibale. Futhi, ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi kubalulekile; xhumana nababukeli bakho, futhi uthole impendulo ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinkundla ezinhle zokwabelana ngokuqukethwe? Kunezinkundla eziningi ezinhle zokwabelana ngokuqukethwe. Izinkundla ezifana ne-YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, ne-Facebook zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngezithombe, amavidiyo, nezindatshana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amasayithi afana ne-Blogspot, WordPress, ne-Medium angasiza abadali bokuqukethwe ukuthi babelane ngemicabango yabo ngezindatshana. Ukukhetha inkundla efanele kuncike kumphakathi ofuna ukufinyelela kuwo. Umbuzo 9: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli bukhulu kangakanani? Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli bukhulu kakhulu. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bezama ukuqonda izidingo, izifiso, nezinkathazo zababukeli babo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhamba phambili futhi okuxhumana kahle. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli buvame ukuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, owabelana ngemicabango, futhi ohlanganyela ezindabeni ezithokozisayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo kubadali bokuqukethwe? Kusasa, abadali bokuqukethwe bazobhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ubuchwepheshe buzothuthuka, futhi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizoqhubeka nokuba nezici ezintsha. Lokhu kuzodinga abadali bokuqukethwe ukuba bahlale bephakamisela izinga eliphezulu, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, futhi bahlale bejolise ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo. Ukubambisana nabanye, ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha, nokugcina umphakathi ophilayo kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kubadali bokuqukethwe. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bejolise ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okukhanga, futhi okuxhumana nabantu abaningi. Njengoba beqhubeka nokukhula, badinga ukuhamba phambili, bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi bephumelela emhlabeni wabo.
Imidlalo Yesikole: Ukuqala, Uhlelo, Nezinga Lemfundo Imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile empilweni yamanje, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni nasebusheni. Le midlalwano ayikhulisi kuphela amandla omzimba, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekuqeqesheni ubuntu nemisebenzi yokubambisana. Isifundo somzimba, esiphakathi kwemfundo yansuku zonke, sifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, kubalwa imidlalo ethokozisayo efana nebhola, ibhola lezinyawo, nezinye eziningi. Kulezi zinsuku, imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile ekwenzeni izingane zibe nekhono, uzwelo, nesimilo esihle. Isingeniso Emidlalweni Yesikole Ukwazi ukuthi imidlalo yesikole ibaluleke kangakanani, kufanele siqale sihlole izinzuzo ezitholakala kulokhu. Izinzuzo zomzimba zingabhekwa njengenye yezinzuzo eziyinhloko imidlalo yesikole. Izifundo zomzimba zingasiza ekwakheni amandla, ukujikeleza, nempilo yenhliziyo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya wokuncintisana ubalulekile ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Lapha, abantwana bayakwazi ukufunda ukuthi ukuphumelela kuncike ekusebenzisaneni, ukuzinikela, kanye neqiniso lokuthi akupheli yonke imidlalo. Imiphumela Emihle Yomqondo Nongqondongqondo Ngaphandle kokuba nomthelela omuhle emzimbeni, imidlalo yesikole nayo ibalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Izingane zithola ithuba lokufunda ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, nokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yazo yesikole, ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bafunde ukulawula ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi semiphakathi ethina. Ukuze uthole okuningi, imidlalo ibavumela ukuthi bazitholele izindlela ezintsha zokuqhamuka nezixazululo, okwakha ukucabanga okuthuthukile. Ubuciko Bokubambisana Nempumelelo Imidlalo yesikole ifundisa abantwana ukuthi basebenze ndawonye. Ubuciko bokubambisana buvelela lapho izingane zisebenza njengeqembu. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ukusebenza eqenjini kudingeka emikhakheni eyahlukene, kusukela emsebenzini kuya ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Isimo sokuncintisana nobumbano kungenza abantwana bazwe befana ngoba benza okuhle ngokuhlanganyela. Ukuze sikhulise lezi zinto, izikole kufanele ziqinise izinhlelo zokuhlela imijaho nemidlalo yokubambisana. Izifundo Zokubekezela Zokuhlola Imidlalo yesikole nayo ifundisa abantwana ukubekezela. Izingane zithola ukuthi ukufinyelela empumelelweni kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi obalulekile ekufundeni. Ngokuhlanganyela esigabeni sokubhekana nezithiyo, umntwana ufunda ukuthuthuka, ahlule ubunzima, futhi aqhubeke yini akwenziwa. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwezizukulwane, ngoba kwenza kube lula ukuza nezixazululo ezintsha. Umthelela Wokugqugquzela Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Ezinhle Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, ukudlala kwemidlalo yesikole kufanele kudlale indima enkulu ekuqwashiseni ngempilo. Izinhlelo zokudla eziphilile, ukwelulekwa kahle, kanye nezindlela zokugcina umzimba unempilo zibalulekile. Uqhakambisa umqondo wokuhlala unempilo, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokuqonda indlela yokuphila kahle ngoba imidlalo ibalulekile ukuze izingane zifeze lokho. Izikhumbuzo Ezingangeza Ekuphileni Kwemfundo Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ibhodi yezenzo kumele ibuha izindlela zokukhuthaza ukugqugquzela nokuqwashisa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezinkezi zokuqwashisa ngemiphumela emihle yokudansa phakathi kwemidlalo yesikole. Lokhu kuyindlela yokukhumbuza abantwana ukuthi ukuphila kungenziwa kube okuthokozisayo nempela. Iminhla yokwazi, imicimbi yokugqugquzela amandla okuncintisana, nemikhosi yamasiko kufanele kube yingxenye yenzuzo yephakheji yepolitiki. Umbono Wokugcina Imidlalo yesikole ihloba kakhulu neziqu ezinkulu zemfundo. Izikole, abafundisi, nabazali banelungelo lokusebenzisa lesi sikhali ukuze baqinise umqondo wokubambisana, ukusebenza, nokukhuliswa kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobuciko, nokuzikhandla. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yesikole ayisiyona nje eyomzimba, kepha iyinsiza ebaluleke kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi nosonkanyezi abavulelekile. Emavi emidlalo yesikole, kufanele siqhubeke nokuqhubekisela phambili umoya wokuthola amandla obukhali, ubumbano, nokuqonda impilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekugcinweni kwempilo nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Kukhona umyalezo ophumelelayo okukhuthaza izingane ukufunda, ukujabulisa, nokuqonda ukuthi imidlalo akukhona nje ukuhlangana, kodwa kuyingxenye ebalulekile yezehlakalo zokuphila.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Isifundo Esibalulekile Namuhla, ukuhamba phambili kwemfundo kuncike ekutholeni izinsiza ezanele, kuhlanganisa uthisha onekhono. Nokho, njengoba izikole zikhula, inkinga yokushoda kothisha iyavela. Le nkinga ibalulekile, njengoba ithinta umphakathi wonke, ikakhulukazi abafundi. Isizathu Sokushoda Kothisha Ukuze siqonde le nkinga kahle, kufanele sibuze imibuzo ethile. Kungani sithi kunoshoda kothisha? Okokuqala, ukuntula izinsiza ezanele kumasipala, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, kubangela ukuthi kube nzima ukuthola abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe. Izikhangiso zomsebenzi azitholakali kalula, futhi lapho zikhona, izizathu ezifana nokukhula kwemali yokuphila zenza kube nzima ukuheha uthisha onekhono. Umthelela Wokushoda Kothisha Umthelela wokushoda kothisha ubonakala ezindaweni eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukuthola imfundo efanele, okukhokelela ekunciphiseni amathuba abo okuphumelela empilweni. Uthisha omncane ungenza kube nzima ukufundisa kahle, okubonakala kakhulu ezifundweni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nezibalo nezesayensi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushoda kothisha kudala ukucindezeleka kubo bonke abasebenzi bezikole, okukhuthaza ukungakhathaleli izifundo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwesimilo sezikole. Imiphumela iyazwakala, njengoba izikole ziba nezinga eliphansi lokufunda, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi abafundi bathole amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele empilweni. Izixazululo Ezingaba Yindlela Yokuphumelela Kucacile ukuthi kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kulwiswe le nkinga. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlonza abafundi ukuze baphumelele emfundweni yokufundisa. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamasheya afanele, izifundo ezithokozisayo, kanye nemihlahlandlela eqinile yokufundisa. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo kumathisha kungaba yindlela enhle yokukhuthaza abasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezikude, okuhlanganisa izifundo ezikhokhelwayo, amathuba okuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizobasiza ukuthi bakhulise amakhono abo. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambelele kumaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa izikole, kuhlanganise nokuxhumana nabazali nabezindaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi injongo yokufundisa iyaphumelela. Ubulungiswa kumele busebenze ngezinga eliphezulu, ukuze bonke abafundi bathole imfundo efanele. Isiphetho Ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akusiyona inkinga encane. Kubalulekile ukuqonda imithelela yayo, ukuba nezixazululo ezilungile, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, neziphathimandla. Uma singakwazi ukuxazulula le nkinga, sizobhekana nezinkinga ezimbi empilweni yabafundi, umphakathi, kanye nezwe. Ngakho, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze sithuthukise imfundo, siqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bethu bathola ithuba elihle lokufunda, futhi bakhulise amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele empilweni.
Ukufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole: Uhlanga Olusha Lokufunda Namuhla, ukufunda ngengqondo ye-inthanethi sekuyindlela ejwayelekile yokuthola ulwazi, ethokozisayo futhi evumela abantu abaningi ukufinyelela emithonjeni ehlukene yolwazi. Lokhu kuxhumene nokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube lula kubafundi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo, ezindaweni abazikhethayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukufunda ngale ndlela, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Izizathu Zokufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Okokuqala, ukufunda online kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu kumithombo ehlukahlukene. Abafundi bangathola izifundo ezivela ezikoleni ezahlukene, izifundo, nezinsiza ezivela emhlabeni jikelele ngaphandle kokuhamba. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amasha, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezingatholakali kalula izifundo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda online kuvumela abafundi ukuba benze izifundo ngezikhathi zabo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa izifundo nemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Enye yezinzuzo ezibalulekile ukufunda online ukuthi abafundi bangazimela kakhulu. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe izinhlelo zokufunda ezifanele izidingo zabo. Ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezifundo zevidiyo, ama-podcast, kanye nezincwadi ze-inthanethi, abafundi bangakhetha indlela abathanda ngayo yokufunda. Izinselelo Zokufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Noma kunjalo, ukufunda online akuphelele ezinzuzweni. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile okufanele ziqondwe. Isibonelo, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana okuqondile nomfundisi kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bedangele. Abafundi bahlala befuna ukusiza ngqo, futhi uma befunda online, lokhu kungaba nzima. Futhi, izinkinga zobuchwepheshe, njengokungasebenzi kwe-inthanethi, zingaphazamisa ukufunda. Enye inkinga enkulu ukuthola ukuzibophezela. Abafundi abaningana bahluleka ukuhlangabezana nezifundo zabo ngenxa yokungabi nokuqonda kahle kokubaluleka kokufunda. Ukuze ube nempumelelo ekufundeni online, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo oqinile wokuzibophezela, ukuhlela isikhathi kahle, nokwakha isikhala esikahle sokufunda. Izindlela Zokuphumelela Ekufundeni Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Ukuze ube nempumelelo ekufundeni online, kunezindlela ezithile okufanele zicatshangwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlela isikhathi sakho kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusetha izinsuku nezikhathi zokufunda, nokuphuma emisebenzini engadingekile ngesikhathi sokufunda. Uhlelo oluhle lokufunda lungasiza ukufaka umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo yakho. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukudala isikhala esikahle sokufunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi unendawo ethule nehlanzekile yokufunda, ngoba isikhala esihle singakhuthaza ukugxila nokwandisa umkhiqizo wakho. Futhi, sebenzisa amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokuphatha isikhathi, izinhlelo zokuhlela, kanye nezikhumbuzo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uphumelelisa izifundo zakho. Okokugcina, ungakhohlwa ukubambisana nabanye. Ukufunda online akumele kube yinto eyodwa. Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi, ukuhlela amaqembu okuxoxa, noma ukufuna usizo kumfundisi kungasiza ukwandisa ulwazi lwakho. Ukubambisana kungakhuthaza izifundo ezinzima futhi kukusize uqonde kahle izifundo ezinzima. Isiphetho Ukufunda online kuyindlela enamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunobunzima bayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi baqonde izinzuzo nezinselelo zabo ukuze bakwazi ukuzilungiselela kahle. Ngokuhlela kahle, ukusetha izinjongo ezicacile, nokubambisana nabanye, abafundi bangakha izindlela eziphumelelayo zokufunda. Ngale ndlela, abafundi bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlobo lokufunda, bahlale bephambili emhlabeni ogcwele amathuba. Ukufunda online akukona nje kuphela ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Impilo yaselokishini iyindawo enomoya opholile, imiphakathi ehlukahlukene, nempilo yom everyday. Uma ubheka izindawo ezinjengokwakho, uzothola abantu abahlukahlukene, ubuhlobo obuqinile, nemigubho eyakhayo. Ngempela, izinsuku zethu zihlala ziwubukhuni, kodwa zikho nezikhathi ezijabulisayo ezikwenza uqonde ukuthi impilo kufanele ithokoziswe, nokuthi abantu baphila kanjani ngezinselelo ezihlala zibakhona. Ukukhuluma ngezinsuku zethu, akudingi ukuba udlule emigwaqweni eyiqoqo yeTownship. Uhlobo lwethu lokuphila lubuhlungu futhi lujabulisa ngasikhathi sinye. Izinkanyezi lezi, izinsuku zikhanya kakhulu, ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabantu – ingane ibhalisela umphakathi. Ungahamba emigwaqweni, uzozwa izitshalo zebhungo, uzwa amaqanda amalangabi, nezinsizwa ezihlekisayo. Umoya uhlezi ukhulu, futhi abantu bahlangene. Izakhamizi zethu zihlala zikhuthaza ukuxhumana. Uhambo lokuphila kwethu luhlobo lokuxhumana. Uma ubona umama ephosa, usuku oluhle lokuvutshelwa ukunakekelwa, ungasondela – "Sawubona Mama, ubhalela ukudla kwasekhaya?" Lokhu kuxhunyaniswe nemikhuba yethu yokuhlala, singavuma ukujabulela ukuphila ngokubambisana. Ngeke kube nebhadi lokubambisana emiphakathini yethu. Ngabe ubani ongeke aphumelele ngaphandle kokubambisana? Ngokwesibonelo, uma kukhona umjikelezo wokuthengisa, izakhamizi ziya emkhumbini. Umfono nje ubonisa izinyathelo ezidingekayo, umoya walezo zinsuku uyancomeka. Njengoba sithokozisa ukudla nezinsiza, sizwa ukuthi sinamandla okupakisha imiphakathi yethu. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi impilo yaselokishini isebenza ngoba abantu basebenza ndawonye. Covid-19 inhlawulo ibangele ukuthi impilo yaselokishini ibonakale inezinhlawulo. Abantu bezwe bezwa, "Bayede! Ngabe lo mkhuba uzoba budlanga kuzo zonke izimboni?" Ukuze singaphezulu uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi. Besibona izinsiza zingalingani, kodwa abantu banesibindi, basiza omunye nomunye, basebenza ukuze bahlale bephila. Lokhu kwaqhubeka ngezikhathi ezinzima, sahlala silungile. Izinsiza zempilo, izifundazweni, imfundo, kuthinta ukuphila kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngabe kukhona ezinye izinkinga ezenzakalayo ezingenza sibe nesibhedlela esingahamba phambili? Izinhlelo zempilo ziqhuba indlela yokuxhumana ezinhle, zize zikhumbule izinto eziphansi kuphela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imiphakathi yethu iyacwaninga ukuze ifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu lempilo. Isiko lethu lifana nesikhumbuzo esiyinqaba. Izekafozi, oduma, nemithendezi, lezi zinto zikhumbule imisebenzi yokuqala. Umkhuba wethu ungowokuhlanganisa – umgubho wezinsuku ezinkulu, ukuvota kwezokuphila. Konke lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvakasha kokuziqhenya; umcimbi wokuthokozisa nosuku oluhle. Uthando lutholakala lemali esiyishayayo emaphephandabeni, lokho kuhlobisa impilo, kuhamba kubona umehluko empilweni. Ukuphila kwethu kunomoya okhulayo. Sihlanganyela, siphila, sithokozisa, sihlanganyela. Ingabe akekho owayengeke aphile uma engathokozisa? Njengoba sikhumbula izinsuku eziphila, empilweni yaselokishini, sizobona ukuthi impilo inhlobonhlobo. Kukhona okuthandwa, okukhuluma, nokuvuthwa komphakathi, nanokhuma kokuya phambili, okuholela empilweni engcono. Ezemidlalo, izivakashi, kanye nezifundo zemisebenzi kuyafana. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, kudlalwa othandweni lwezinhlobo zakho, ikakhulukazi emizini eyahlukene. Basikushiya-kukhona umoya, leso simo esiqhubekayo esikwenza sazi izifundo phakathi kwezakhamizi. Uthando nolwazi olwadalwa emiphakathini, luhlala luheha amehlo amasha, lunothi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi impilo ifinyelela kumphakathi wonke. Ngakho lapho uhamba emigwaqweni, hamba nomoya, ubhalela impilo yaselokishini. Ibuye ibonakale iphelele, ihlangene, ikhuluma izindaba ezimnandi – njengenhlangano engokwenziwe ngabantu. Ubuye uthole umfowethu, ubaba, umama nabangani. Kuzinzima, kodwa ukuzimisela okuvamile kuhambisana nezinsuku zempilo yaselokishini. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye neqhaza lelo lidlulela phambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza impilo yaselokishini igcwale ukuphila. Ukwakha imiphakathi yethu, ukuze siphile kahle, sizokwenza umbono ophilayo. Hamba, ubuke, uthokozise; lokho kuwukuhlala kuhle impilo yaselokishini. Impilo yethu ikhuluma, futhi isephila—siyahlangana, siyaziswa, sikhumbule, futhi sizobusa!
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umcimbi Wokuzijabulisa Nokuhlonipha Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umcimbi omkhulu wezemidlalo, ibhola lomnqakiswano, ubungamukela izinkulungwane zababukeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Le midlalelo ibiyinsakavukela, igcwele umoya wokuncintisana, ukujabulisa, kanye nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Ibhola lomnqakiswano, elaziwa nangokuthi i-basketball, luhlobo lwezemidlalo oludumile emhlabeni wonke, futhi umcimbi walo uthokozisa abathandi bezemidlalo. Umcimbi uqale ngokuqhuma kwezinsimbi, lapho amaqembu amabili, elinye lithi "Izinkanyezi" nelinye "Amabhubesi", ehlanganyela emjahweni ophakeme. Izinkanyezi, ezimele idolobha elidumile, zifaka abadlali abanolwazi olukhulu, kanti Amabhubesi, abavela endaweni ethokozisayo, banelungelo lokubhalisela ukunqoba. Umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala ebusweni babadlali, njengoba bonke bejolise emgqeni ophakeme, befuna ukujabulisa abalandeli babo. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kweqembu, abadlali bahlala phansi ukuze baphumule, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuhlela isu labo lokudlala. Umphakathi ubukeka uzolile, kodwa ukucasuka kwabo kubonakala lapho umphakathi uqala ukuxhumana, ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Ababukeli banomsebenzi obalulekile, njengoba bejabulisa abadlali ngokuqhubeka nokuxhasa. Umoya wokuhlanganyela ubonakaliswa ngababukeli abavuma ukuvuma kancane, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lapho umcimbi uqala, isithombe sebhola siba sikhanya. Abadlali behluleka ukuhlala bezithokozisa, behamba ngezinyathelo ezisheshayo, bejolise emgqeni. Ukuphosa ibhola kwi-basket, okwakungumgomo wabo, kubonisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu. Abadlali baphosa, baphinde baphinde, bejabulisa ababukeli. Umoya wokuncintisana uphakamisa izinga lokudlala, njengoba amaqembu ebonisa amandla awo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi ubonakala ungena emoyeni, ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuphosa ibhola, zikhuphuka emkhakheni wokuqhuba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela emaphuzwini aphezulu, lapho ibhola lisuka kancane kancane. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, zenza izinyathelo ezithokozisayo, zifaka iziphumo ezinhle. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela emaphuzwini aphezulu, lapho ibhola lisuka kancane kancane. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, zenza izinyathelo ezithokozisayo, zifaka iziphumo ezinhle. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela ekugcineni, lapho umphakathi ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuphosa ibhola, zikhuphuka emkhakheni wokuqhuba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele, izinkanyezi zithola ukunqoba, futhi umphakathi ujabulisa. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Umcimbi we-basketball ubonisa ubuhle bezemidlalo, ubuchwepheshe, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kube yinsakavukela, futhi umphakathi ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ibhola lomnqakiswano luhlobo lwezemidlalo oluhlala lukhanya, futhi umcimbi walo uhlale ukhumbuleka.
Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu Umbuzo 1: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi ubugebengu? Ubugebengu lubhekisela ezimisweni noma ezisebenzelwaneni ezimbi eziphula umthetho. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlukunyezwa kwabanye, ukuthola izimpahla zomunye ngaphandle kwemvume, noma ukulimaza impahla yomphakathi. Ububanzi bobugebengu buyahluka ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi ubungako bubugebengu bunamaphuzu ahlukene. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza ubugebengu bube phezulu? Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu livame ukuba nemiphumela ethile efana nomnotho, izinga lempilo yoluntu, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bephila ezimeni ezinzima njengokungasebenzi, ukuntuleka kwemithombo, noma ukuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kobugebengu. Noma yiziphi izinyathelo zokuzivikela zingaba nzima uma izimo zempilo kanye nezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu zingalungile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eholela ekwandeni kobugebengu ezindaweni ezithile? Izindawo ezinomnotho ophansi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukuhamba okungavikelekile, kanye nemvelo engavikelekile. Abantu abaningi baphila ezimeni ezinzima, futhi ubugebengu buvame ukuba yindlela yokuphila, ikakhulukazi uma kunezinkinga zomndeni noma ukungabi nesiqondiso. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe abantu banamandla okuphikisa ubugebengu? Yebo, abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekunciphiseni ubugebengu ngezimfuno ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha imiphakathi eqinile, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo ezisheshayo zokuxhasa abavela ezindaweni ezinzima. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu behlanganyela, ukuqubuka kobugebengu kuvame ukuncipha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu? Izinyathelo eziningi zingathathwa ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zemfundo, ukufundisa abantu ngokubaluleka kokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa imiphakathi. Umphakathi kufanele ube nokubambisana nezikhungo zomthetho ukuze kuqashwe ubugebengu kahle. Umsebenzi wabaphathi bendawo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nemindeni ubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esikahle sokuphila. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ubona ubugebengu? Uma ubona ubugebengu, kubalulekile ukufaka isikhalazo kumaphoyisa. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumaphoyisa kufanele kube yisisekelo somphakathi. Ukuthola izinsiza ezitholakalayo nezokwazi kumphakathi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubungozi. Ubulungiswa kufanele bukhuthazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthula emphakathini. Umbuzo 7: Yini ezokwenza umphakathi uyeke ubugebengu? Umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, owakhiwe kahle, ungaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwehliseni izinga lobugebengu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni, ukwakha imisebenzi, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze abantu baphile impilo engcono kuyaphakamisa abantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ukufundisa ngezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ubugebengu kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ngezinhlelo ezithile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nomphakathi? Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zomnotho, ubuhlanga, kanye nokwamukela abantu abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kudala izinselelo eziningi, okubangela ubugebengu obungathandeki. Ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha amagugu nokuhlala kucela ukuxoxisana. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kunezinhlelo zokulawula ubugebengu? Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokulawula ubugebengu ezitholakalayo, futhi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa izikhungo zokuphepha, ezokweluleka, kanye nokubambisana nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukamasipala. Ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela zenza abantu bazizwe bephila endaweni evikelekile. Umbuzo 10: Yisiphi isibonelelo somphakathi esitholakalayo? Izikhungo zasendaweni zifanele ukusiza abantu ngezisombululo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezindawo zokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abahamba phambili ezinkingeni. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza lokukhulisa impilo engcono kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kufanele simise izindlela zokubambisana ezikhuthaza izixazululo ezihlala zikhona ekwehliseni ubugebengu. Ubufakazi obuphuma ezinyathelweni ezithathwayo bukhombisa ukuthi uma sinqoba ububi ngothando, sizonqoba nezinye izinkinga.
Umbiko Ngamazwi Ezamahlathi Isingeniso Ezamahlathi, noma ezokulima izihlahla, zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi zisebenza njengomthombo wezinto eziningi ezidingekayo. Zihlanganisa izihlahla, izitshalo, nezilwane ezihlala emahlathini, futhi zidlala indima enkulu ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle izinzuzo ezihambisana nezamahlathi, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sigcine lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile. Izinzuzo Zezamahlathi Ezamahlathi zinezici ezinhle eziningi. Okokuqala, zisebenza njengomthombo omkhulu wezokudla, izinkuni, nezinsiza zokwakha. Izihlahla zikhula zibe yizinkuni ezisetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu, izinsiza zokusebenza, nezinto zokuhlobisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amaningi asekelwe ezamahlathini, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba ngezinkuni, ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuphumula, kanye nezinsiza zokuvakasha. Okwesibili, ezamahlathi zibalulekile ekugcineni umoya. Izihlahla zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide (CO2) futhi zikhulula umoya-mpilo (oxygen), okwenza kube nokuphila okuhle emhlabeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini lapho izinga lokushisa lomhlaba liphakeme kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amabhande ezihlahla anciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya, okwenza kube nempilo engcono kubantu nakwezinye izilwane. Okwesithathu, ezamahlathi zisebenza njengendawo yokuhlala kwezilwane. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukudla, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze izilwane zihlale ziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo, njengoba izilwane zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nezamahlathi Noma ezamahlathi zinezici ezinhle, zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuncipha kwezimali ezamahlathi kubangelwa ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izimboni, nezolimo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezihlahla, okwenza kube nokuncipha kwezinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kokuhlala kwezilwane, okuthinta ibhalansi yemvelo. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezamahlathini. Ukukhishwa kwemikhumbi, imfucumfucu, nezinsiza ezikhiqizwayo zenza kube nokungcoliswa okukhulu emanzini nasemoyeni. Lokhu kuthinta izihlahla nezilwane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi zihlale ziphilile. Ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ezamahlathi zihlala zikhona. Okwesithathu, izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuhlela ezamahlathi. Ukushisa okukhulu, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima izihlahla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bezamahlathi bahlale beqaphela izinguquko ezithinta izimo zemvelo. Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ezamahlathi Ukuze sigcine ezamahlathi, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphatha ezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokulima, ukwakha izindawo zokuphumula, kanye nokuvikela izindawo ezibalulekile. Abaphathi bezamahlathi kufanele basebenzisane nabantu bendawo ukuze baqonde izidingo zabo futhi benze izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza umphakathi. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izinzuzo ezihambisana nezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngendima ezamahlathi ezimpilweni zabo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela lezi zinsiza. Ukufundisa umphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikelwa kwezamahlathi, njengoba abantu bezoba nentshisekelo yokugcina lezi zinsiza. Okwesithathu, kudingeka izinhlelo zokubuyisela ezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa uk planting izihlahla ezintsha, ukuvuselela izindawo ezonakele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulima ezihlala zikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwanda kwezihlahla, okuzokwenza kube nokuphila okuhle emhlabeni. Isiphetho Ezamahlathi zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zisebenza njengomthombo wezinsiza eziningi. Nokho, zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezidinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze sigcine lezi zinsiza, kudingeka ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphatha, ukufundisa umphakathi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubuyisela ezamahlathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile, ukuze zihlale zikhona futhi zisebenze kahle empilweni yethu.
Ifilimu: Umhlaba Ohlukahlukene Wezinkumbulo Nesiko Emlandweni yesintu sethu, ifilimu ibaluleke kakhulu ekuqhakambiseni nasekugcineni izinkumbulo, izindaba, kanye namasiko. Ifilimu ingankulu, iyingxenye yobuciko, kodwa ikakhulukazi iyinsika yesizukulwane. Uhlanga lwesiko, olukhombisa amaphupho, imicabango, nezifiso zabantu, luthathe indawo enkulu ezinhliziyweni zethu, lungatholakala ezinkundleni zezifundo, ezinsizakalweni, nakubuchwepheshe bamanje. Kukhona okuthile okugxilisa imicabango yami uma ngikhuluma ngokubaluleka kwefilimu. Ngokuvamile, uma sikhuluma ngama-movie, sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi, imidlalo yokudlala, nezinsizakalo zokukhangisa. Nokho, ngezinye izikhathi, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ifilimu iyinhlanganisela yokubona, ukwenza, nokuqonda. Izincwadi zethu zempilo zikhona kule mibono; ngemizwa yokuhlukahlukene esingayithola kulolu hlobo lobuciko, siphila nabanye ngokubona ngezithombe ezaziwayo. Ngokwezifundo eziningi, indawo yefilimu ibalulekile ekuqwashiseni ngezinto ezahlukene. Ngokukhuluma kwezinkanyezi noma izigameko ezithile, ifilimu ingavusa ucwaningo noma ukuvuselela izinkumbulo zempilo yethu. Cishe sonke sinesikhumbuzo esithile esihlobene nefilimu ethile — umcimbi wokuqala, isizathu sokuhleka, noma umuzwa wokucabangela okwenziwa abalingisi bayo. Lesi sici sokuxhumanisa sithinta izimo ezihlukene zempilo, futhi kuzenzakalelayo sinesidingo sokwakha umphakathi. Lapha, ngingathanda ukucacisa ukuthi ifilimu ayigcini nje ngezinhloso zokuheha ababukeli. Izithombe ezikwiqhaza, izindaba ezithokozisayo, namajamo akhombisa ukuze aba nempilo, ngempela akwenzi kuphela umqondo; ziyathinta imizwa, ziphinde zikhuthaze ukuthola indlela yethu emhlabeni. Izinhlaka ezihlukahlukene khona lapha, kubalulekile ukucacisa ukuthi abantu bangeza izinhlelo zempilo zabo ezinhlobonhlobo. Ngokuphathelene nezwe lanamuhla, ifilimu ibalulekile ekwakheni ukuqonda okuhle. Ubulili, ubuhlobo, nomoya wezinkanyezi – konke kuhlangene ukuze kucacise umbono wokuthi abantu bakhuluma ngani. Ngale ndlela, ifilimu ingase ingabi nje umdanso wezithombe, kodwa ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Fredrik Backman, umbhali, uthi: “Umuntu ongenawo umlando, uyindlela eholayo engeyona eyeqiniso.” Lokhu kusho ukuthi ifilimu iyisikhungo sokukhumbula, ikakhulukazi uma isikhipha izifundo ezibhekene nezizukulwane ezizayo. Ngibhalela imicabango yami, ngazithokozisa ngokuthi ngabe kanjani izenzakalo ezikhumbulekayo zingenza umkhiqizo omuhle. Ngithokozile ngokuchaza lesi sici sokuxhumanisa; kukhona izifundo ezisemqoka ezitholakalayo kuphela uma abantu besebenzisa ifilimu njengendlela yokuxhumana. Mhlawumbe lokhu kungathinta impilo yethu yansuku zonke, uma sithola izinkumbulo zabantu ablaziyo. Izinselelo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana zomhlaba zikhula ngesivinini. Ukuba nezithombe - umkhuba omusha - ubonisa ukuthi abanye bethu bangase bazithole ezithombeni zefilimu bese bephendulela kwizethulo. Iqiniso liwukuthi isifiso sokuxoshwa kwehlukaniso sobumba sefilimu silokhu sikhula emhlabeni, kwenze kube nemiphumela emisha. Ngokujwayelekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi sikwenze kube yinsika, singavumeli ukusatshiswa kwezithombe ukukhipha imithambo yethu. Futhi lesi sici sefilimu singesinye sezinto ezahlukene ezikhombisa ukuthi kumalungelo abantu bethu, siphila ngendlela ethinta umlando. Ngakho-ke, uma sibheka izimfanelo ezisemqoka zezimfashini, kungabe kuhamba kahle ukuthi ifilimu iyisisekelo sokwakha abakhulumayo, ukuze ikwazi ukukhulumela zonke izinhlaka zomhlaba. Uma sizoncoma umfundi, kumele sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma ngezinkumbulo nezimo ezijulile, ukuze sithole ubuhlakani bokwabelana. Ukubenga kalula inguquko, sichaze ukuhluka komoya wethu, siphinde sihlanganyele erenjeni yezenzakalo ezisemqoka emhlabeni. Ekuqaleni, ngabe ifilimu ayangabaza? Ngingakusho ukuthi ihamba ngemuva kwentombazane edinga ukukhalipha. Njengoba ikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bethu bemfashini, ifilimu iyatholakala njengenhlangano yokwenza izigameko eziyiqiniso nezivamile. Izenzo ezithokozisayo, izigigaba ezifundisayo, zibhakabhakile emhlabeni; abanye bethu bayazithokozisa, abanye bayazithokozisa, futhi abanye bazahlukanisa njengoba bephendukela ezincwadini zebhizinisi. Ngalokhu, ngifisa ukusho khona ukuthi ifilimu yisikhathi esijulile, imfashini enhle yokucabanga. Ngaphandle kokujula kwayo ezicini zokuhlala sezibala ngaphambi, yenza umbono wokuphila ngendlela ehlukile. Ngiyavuma, ukuklanywa kokukhumbula, izifiso ezijabulisayo, namasu okukhombisa ukuthi umuntu angabhekana kanjani nezinkumbulo. Ifilimu iyimfashini — isikhumbuzo esiveza izinkumbulo, ibonisa isikhumbuzo sempilo yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sizithokozisa ngezinkumbulo ezibuyisela emuva, futhi sazi ukuthi umhlaba uhlezi uyoqonda izinkumbulo zethu. Kukhona ukwazi okukhona — ifilimu ingelinye lamavela okukhumbuza. Lokhu kuhlobene nesiko; kumele siqhubeke siphila, sinikezwe izithombe zokuthi sikhona. Ngiyavuma, ifilimu ingaphezu kwesithombe; iyinsika yethu emhlabeni.
Umdlavuza Kwabesifazane Kwabesifazane Kwakukhanya elangeni elihle eNhlabathi, umuzi ohlanzekile ogcwele izitshalo ezimibalabala nezihlahla ezinkulu. UZanele, intokazi yasendaweni, wayehamba ethokozisa, ephakamisa imindeni emincane. Wathi, "Uthando lukhona emhlabeni, futhi nathi singaluthola." Waqhubeka ehamba, edlula emnyango wezokwelapha, lapho abesifazane abaningi beqashwe khona ukuze baphumelele ekwelapheni izifo. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uZanele wathola izimpawu ezihlukahlukene. Wazizwa enza okuthile okungajwayelekile embhodweni wakhe, okwenza wazizwa engakhululekile. Ngemuva kokuvakashela kudokotela, wathola ukuthi ubhekene nomdlavuza. Lo mzuzu washintsha impilo yakhe. UZanele waba nesibindi, kodwa ubuhlungu buvuselele imizwa yakhe. Wayefuna ukwazi nokuhlola, kodwa wayesaba. Umdlavuza kwabesifazane awukona okuncane. Wafunda ukuthi baningi abesifazane abahluphekayo, abavame ukungakhulumi ngalolu daba. Wathola ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukwazi, udinga ukuxoxa. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, okhuthazayo. Wabamba izifundo, waphuma emakhaya, wabamba izandla nabanye abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngesinye isikhathi, uZanele wathola abanye abesifazane abafana naye, abathintekayo emlandweni wokulwa nomdlavuza. Bahlangana njalo, behlakulela izindlela zokulwa nalolu bhubhane. Imibono yabo yayiyingqayizivele, kanti ubungane babo babuphila kahle. UZanele wagcina esebenzisa imihlangano yabo ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwelashwa, ezokuxhumana, nezokweseka. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukuba neqembu labantu abahluphekayo kwakuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi akasodwa. Waqonda ukuthi abesifazane abanenhliziyo efanayo badinga izwi, badinga indawo yokukhuluma. Ngalesi sikhathi, umoya weqiniso waze uyashintsha; abesifazane baqala ukukhuluma, bekhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, bese bephakanyiswa. Ngemuva kokulashwa, uZanele wathola ukuthi impilo iphakeme ukuwa. Umdlavuza wawungamphazamisanga, kodwa wawumkhuthaza ukuba aqonde kahle ukuthi impilo yayibalulekile. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabesifazane, ebandakanya umphakathi emisebenzini yokukhuluma, ehlanganisa wonke umuntu. Umphakathi waqala ukufunda, wawazi ukuthi umdlavuza awukona ukuwa, kodwa kuwukuphila. UZanele waqhubeka nokusebenza, edlulisela ulwazi nokuqonda kwabanye abesifazane. Kukhona umphakathi omkhulu ovukile, ungakhathaleli ubuhlungu. Umsebenzi wakhe waba yisibonelo sokuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukuvivinya, baphumelele, bahlale bephila kahle. UZanele waba yisibonelo esihle, umoya ophilayo, okhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhuthaze futhi baqinise. Ekugcineni, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwabesifazane akubona ubuhlungu kuphela, kodwa kuwukubona amandla okukhuluma, okuphila, nokuhlanganyela. Wathi, "Sisebenzise lesi sikhathi, sibe nezwi elikhulu, sikhulume, sizwakalise isizotha sethu." UZanele waba yinkanyezi, ekhanyisela abesifazane abaningi, ebavulela indlela yokuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawusemkhathini ophilayo, ubuhlungu baphuma emoyeni, ubungane bukhula, futhi uthando lukhula. Umdlavuza wawungasizi, kodwa wawuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umuntu akasodwa, futhi ukunakekelwa komphakathi kuyinto ebalulekile. UZanele waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba zinkulu, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa, bakhuthaze, futhi baphile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZanele wakwazi ukujula emfundweni, waphendukela kwabanye abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezikude, waba yincwadi yempilo yabo. Wabathokozisa ngezindlela ezahlukene, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale benempilo. Kwakuwumkhankaso omkhulu, owawuhambisana nolwazi oluqinile lokuthi umdlavuza awumelanga impilo, kodwa ubuhlungu buhlangene nobungane, uthando, nempilo. Ngokuphila kwabo, uZanele nabezinye izintokazi zaphumelela, zashintsha umhlaba, zenza umphakathi waba yindawo engcono. Umdlavuza wawungasathathi izimpilo, kodwa wawuhlonipha ubungane, uthando, nobuqotho. UZanele waba isibonelo sokuthi umuntu, uma esebenza kanye nabanye, angakwazi ukuzitholela impilo ebenza bakhumbule. Umdlavuza waba yisifundo sokuphila, waba umoya ophilayo kuZanele nabanye abesifazane. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma yiziphi izinkinga, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa, bakhulume, baphile. Lokhu kwaba yinsiza, ethokozisa, futhi evuswa. UZanele waba yindlela yokuphila, ekwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abesifazane, ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuhlukahlukene. Ngale ndlela, impilo kaZanele yathuthuka, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo evulekile, ethokozisayo. Umdlavuza wawungasathathi izimpilo, kodwa wawuhlonipha umqondo wokubambisana, uthando, nobungane. UZanele waba umholi, owahola abanye, ebakhumbuza ukuthi impilo ingaphezu kokuphila, kodwa ingaphezu kokuxhumana, nokuba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni.
Ezokukhiqiza: Umgomo Wokwakha Ikusasa Elinempilo Ezokukhiqiza, noma i-manufacturing, ziwumgogodla wezomnotho emhlabeni. Le mboni ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ekwakheni imikhiqizo, kodwa futhi ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukwenyusa izinga lempilo, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yethu nasemphakathini. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ezokukhiqiza akuhambisani nje nokukhiqiza izinto, kodwa kuyinqubo ehlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, kanye nokuba nezinqubo ezisebenzayo. Uma lokhu kungafinyeleli, umkhiqizo ungase ungahlangabezani nezidingo zabathengi, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali nasekunciphiseni ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula kakhulu indlela esikhiqiza ngayo. Izimboni ziye zathuthukiswa ngezindlela eziningi, kusukela ekusetshenzisweni kwemishini ethuthukisiwe kuya ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ezokukhiqiza kumele zihlale zikhona futhi ziqhubeke zithuthuka ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, ikakhulukazi ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ezokukhiqiza zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezithola amathuba amancane. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banethuba lokuphila kahle, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Imisebenzi ethuthukisiwe, efana nezobuchwepheshe, ibonisa ukuthi abantu bangathola amathuba angcono, okwandisa izinga lempilo. Nokho, imboni yokukhiqiza ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulu, izindleko zokukhiqiza ezikhulayo, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emakethe zenza kube nzima kubakhiqizi ukuba bahlale bephambili. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imboni ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokufaka i-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-automation, kungasiza ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe lula, zisheshise ukukhiqiza, futhi zinciphise izindleko. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, okukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezisebenzi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza imboni ikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imboni eqinile, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abakhiqizi, ikakhulukazi abancane nabaphakathi, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi bakhe imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza imboni yokukhiqiza ukuba ibheke phambili, okuhlanganisa ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo emisha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Ekugcineni, ezokukhiqiza ziwumgogodla wezomnotho, futhi zidinga ukuba ziqhubeke zikhula, zithuthuke, futhi zibe nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Njengabantu, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa le mboni ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono futhi sakhe ikusasa elinempilo. Ngakho, asithathe ithuba lokwakha imboni yokukhiqiza eqinile, ethuthukile, futhi enobuchwepheshe, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi.
Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika: Umqondo Wokwakha Ikusasa Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ithuba lokubona izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini yethu. Kodwa-ke, le ntsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ub unemployment, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sithuthukise izimo zabo. Ngokokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabo zidinga ukuxhaswa, hhayi kuphela nguhulumeni, kodwa nakubantu abadala. Ukuze sithuthukise intsha, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa amakhono, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza, kanye nokwakha amathuba okuziphilisa. Ngokwesibili, intsha idinga ukugqugquzelwa ukuze ibonakale. Kumele sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibonise amakhono ayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuciko, ezemidlalo, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba bathole amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ubuqotho bokwakha umphakathi obumbene busekelwe ekutheni intsha ibonakale futhi ibonise izifiso zayo. Ngokwesithathu, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngempilo yengqondo yentsha. Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zikhula kakhulu, futhi intsha ibhekene nezimo ezinzima. Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthetho: Umphakathi Wezokuvakasha Ngesikhathi esihle eGoli, uSipho Mthetho ubonise ukuthi ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuvakasha. Uhlanga lukaSipho lungumfanekiso wezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela yakhe ehlanzekile ekwakhiweni kwesiko lethu. Wazalwa eThekwini, uSipho wakhulela endaweni enothile ngezothando, imisebenzi yezandla, nezimanga zemvelo. U-Sipho waqala ukuthanda umhlaba wezokuvakasha eneminyaka eminingi, lapho esencane evakashela izindawo ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika noMama wakhe, efunda ngamasiko ahlukahlukene. Wabeka amandla akhe ekuthandeni izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, amaphupho, nezifiso—konke lokhu kwaholela ekufundeni ngezakhamuzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uSipho waqala ukusebenza njengomholi wezihambi eDrakensberg, indawo ethokozisayo edumile phakathi kwabavakashi. U-Sipho waba umfundisi ophumelelayo, ebakhombisa izindawo ezinhle, imifula, nezindawo zomlando ezinomthelela. Kodwa uSipho akazange ayeke lapho; wahamba phambili ngokufunda ngezifundo ezengeziwe emkhakheni wezokuvakasha ukuze aqonde kangcono nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavakashi nendawo abavakashela kuyo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, uSipho waqala ukuqasha abantu abancane ababehlela emhlabeni wezokuvakasha, wahlanganisa izinhlelo zokuvakasha eziphumelelayo ezihlanganisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi osebenzisanayo, futhi uSipho wanikela ngaphezu kuka-30% wemali engenayo emiphakathini yendawo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izinhlelo zezenhlalakahle zingakhula ngokuhlanganyela nezokuvakasha. U-Sipho uqhubekile nokukhuthaza umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabavakashi nabantu bendawo, ethuthukisa umqondo wesiko lokwamukela futhi efundisa abavakashi ukuze baqonde okukhona. Uthembisa ukuqhubeka nokukhanyisa izinkanyezi zabantu abaphumelelayo, eqhubeka nokwenza izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Njengoba esebenza emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, ubona ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onamandla. U-Sipho ungumholi wezimvo ezibukhali, unothile ngothando lwemvelo, njalo ethuthukisa umhlaba wakhe. U-Sipho Mthetho, osendaweni yokuphumula, usaqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, ugqugquzela abavakashi, ebavumela ukuba benze izinkumbulo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonakala enhliziyweni yeDrakensberg, uhlanganisa imizwa yephinde ahloniphe izinzuzo zomphakathi. U-Sipho usebenzela ukuphila okwenziwayo, okukhuthaza, futhi esekela abantu. Le ncazelo yezenzakalo zempilo ibonisa uSipho njengomfanekiso wempilo eshintshashintshayo, umthombo wezindaba ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, uSipho Mthetho ungumfana odume kakhulu emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, obalulekile, futhi onomusa, uhambo lwakhe luzogcina luhlaza, liphumelele, ngegama lakhe lizohamba phambili.
### Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini ukhetho lukazwelonke? Impendulo: Ukhetho lukazwelonke wumcimbi obalulekile lapho izakhamizi zensimu zikhuluma ngezithakazelo zazo. Kulolu suku, abantu bavota ukuze bakhethe abamele izindawo ezahlukahlukene, njengokhetho lwesikhathi eside lwezombusazwe, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye noMongameli. Lokhu kwenzeka njalo eminyakeni ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ithuba lokuzwakalisa imicabango yabo. --- Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukhetho lukazwelonke l важно? Impendulo: Ukhetho lukazwelonke lubalulekile ngoba luhlinzeka abantu ithuba lokuthatha izinqumo mayelana nokuhlelwa kwabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bangakhetha abaholi abazobaphathisa imfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izifiso nezidingo zabantu zifakwa phambili, futhi abaholi benziwa balalele izidingo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezicacile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezaziso ezanele ukuze abantu bazi isikhathi sokhetho. Okwesibili, kugcinwa ukulungiselela kahle emaphandleni, kuhlanganise nezindawo zokuvota ezikhangayo. Okwesithathu, izikhungo zokuvota kufanele zibe nezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu lapho kudingeka, futhi kube nezinsiza ezithile zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bavote. --- Umbuzo 4: Yini efanele ukuba ibhekwane ngayo ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho? Impendulo: Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi bangavota kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi bhaliswe kanjani, izindawo zokuvota, kanye nezidingo zokuvota. Abantu kufanele bahlale besondelene nezindaba ukuze bazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona nezikhala ezithile ezishiwo ngabaholi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile. --- Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani uma abantu behluleka ukuvota? Impendulo: Uma abantu behluleka ukuvota, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni yokhetho. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni uhulumeni ongawrepresenti kahle izidingo zabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhangiso zikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavote, futhi zifake izinyathelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukuvota. --- Umbuzo 6: Kutheni kubalulekile ukuba nezikhangiso nezokuxhumana ngalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Izikhangiso nezokuxhumana zibalulekile ukuze zikhuthaze abantu ukuthi bavote. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsiza ezingabavumela ukuthi bakhethe kahle. Izikhangiso ezihlelekile zidingeka ukuze zibe nezithombe ezicacile zabaholi, izinhlelo zabo, nezizathu zokuvota. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kuzobanjwa kanjani ukhetho. --- Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezokhetho? Impendulo: Izinselelo ezibhekene nezokhetho ziningi. Zingase zibe ukuvota okungaphelele, ukuthengisa kwezikhangiso ezingalungile, nokungabi nalwazi olufanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuba abantu benze izinqumo ezicacile. Ubufakazi bokukhetha obuphelele nezinqubomgomo ezinqala zidinga ukuba ziqinise ukuze kuhlangabezane nalezi zinselelo. --- Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezinqumo zomphakathi ngemuva kokhetho? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokhetho, izinqumo zomphakathi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezingxoxo ezithile, ukufundwa kwezinhlelo ezitholakele, nokuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okukhuluma. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bayakwazi ukuba bahlale bexhumene nezakhamizi zabo, futhi bakhulume ngalezi zinto. --- Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenzekayo uma umuntu ethola amavoti amaningi? Impendulo: Uma umuntu ethola amavoti amaningi, lokho kubonisa ukuthi abantu bameseka. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abaholi basizakale ekukhuleni kwezinto ezithile ezifana nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Abaholi bazokwazi ukusiza izakhamizi zabo ngezinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu baphile kahle, futhi kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo. --- Umbuzo 10: Ngabe ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlaluka? Impendulo: Yebo, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlala lusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokuvota ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukhetho oluqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube khona ukuqhubeka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono emiphakathini. --- Ukhetho lukazwelonke yisikhathi sokuhlola imiphumela yokuthandwa kwabantu. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe neqhaza, sikhuthaze abanye, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izifiso zethu zivele zikhona. Ukhetho alukona nje umcimbi; luyindlela yokwakha ikusasa lethu.
IHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya Isingeniso IHIV/AIDS iyisifo esithinta kakhulu umphakathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokubhekana nale nkinga, kubalulekile ukuqonda imbangela zayo, indlela esithinta ngayo abantu, nokuthi singasiza kanjani ukuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu abathintekayo. Umphakathi wethu udlala indima ebalulekile ekutholeni izixazululo eziphumelelayo zokukhuthaza impilo enempilo nokuvikela abantu abanale sifo. Ukwazi iHIV ne-AIDS IHIV, noma i-Human Immunodeficiency Virus, ithinta uhlelo lokuvikela lomzimba, inciphisa amandla omzimba ukuvikela izifo. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuphila kahle nale nkinga, sikhuluma nge-AIDS, noma i-Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome, okuyisimo esibucayi esivame ukuhamba nephutha. Izimpawu zalesi sifo ziveleka ngemva kokuba ne-HIV emzimbeni, futhi zingaba yingozi empilweni. Izimbangela zeHIV/AIDS Izimbangela zokwanda kweHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zezinto eziyinhloko zifaka phakathi ukuthola ulwazi olungelona, ukungcoliswa, nezindlela zokuphila ezingafanele. Ukungabi nokuxhumana okusebenzayo kubangela umphakathi ukuthi ungatholi ulwazi olufanele. Ukuze sifeze impumelelo ekwaziseni, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuvikela, njengokusebenzisa ama-condom nezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Izimpawu zikaHIV/AIDS Abantu abaningi abazi kahle izimpawu zikaHIV/AIDS, okwenza kube nzima ukubona lesi sifo. Izimpawu zokuqala zingabandakanya ukuzizwa ungaphilile, ukuvuvukala kwemilenze nezinyawo, ukuhamba gazi, nokunye okuningi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umphakathi ungathathi izinyathelo zokuhlola, ukuze bazi ngalesi gciwane eliyingozi. Umthelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya Umthelela weHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya ubalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekuthintweni kwezimilo zomndeni, nokunciphisa amathuba okukhulisa nokuthuthukisa abantu. Abantu bahlala besaba, bephikisana nalokho okukhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezithinta umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukusiza wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala emakhaya, ukuqonda ukuthi akusiyona icala, futhi akukhona okuthile okuphikisa. Izixazululo ezitholakalayo Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokunceda emiphakathini yasemakhaya ukuze iHIV/AIDS ingagcini ngokwaziswa kodwa futhi ilashwe. Ukuqwashisa abantu, ukufundisa ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile, kubalulekile. Izikhungo zezempilo zingavulwa emaphandleni, ukukhuthaza ukuhlolwa, izifundo zeHIV/AIDS, kanye nezinsiza ezivela ezinhlelweni zomphakathi ezinkulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukwelashwa kuyatholakala, futhi kubalulekile empilweni yabo. Isiphetho I-HIV/AIDS iyinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, kufanele sithathe ithuba lokuba neqhaza lokuhlala sikhumbuza umphakathi. Njengomphakathi, sinesifiso sokuphila kahle, nokufinyelela ekuthuthukiseni impilo, sizame ukulwa nokwanda kwe-HIV/AIDS. Sifuna ukuthola izixazululo ezithembekile ezisiza umphakathi, sithuthukisa impilo, sibe neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizoqhubeka sithinta izindlela ezithokozisayo nemiphakathi yasemakhaya, ukuze abantu bazizwe benelungelo lokuphila nekusasa elihle.
Ukuphucwa Umhlaba Ngesikhathi Sobandlululo Kwathi ngesikhathi sobandlululo, umhlaba wethu wahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu bahlukaniswa ngemibala, izinkolo, nezizinda zabo. Kulezi zikhathi ezinzima, kwavela abantu abaninzi abazinikele ekuphuculeni umhlaba, baphikisana nezinhlelo ezazibekwe ngempela. UThandi, intombazane encane eyayihlala edolobheni elincane, wayengomunye walabo ababengazi ukuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono kanjani. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lokufunda, futhi wayehlala efunda izincwadi ezazikhuluma ngamalungelo abantu. Wayazi ukuthi, noma ngabe ubani, kufanele anikezwe ithuba lokuphila impilo enokuthula. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umfana owayengaziwa edolobheni. U-Sipho wayehlupheka kakhulu, ngenxa yokuthi wayengomunye wabantu ababesebenzisa izinsiza ezincane. UThandi wamkhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba ubuhlanga bethu bungahluka, sonke siphila emhlabeni ofanayo. Bahlangana njalo, bexoxa ngezindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Bahlala behlola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Bafunda ukuthi, uma bephikisana, kufanele bakhulume, bangavumelani, kodwa bahloniphe imizwa yomunye. UThandi noSipho baqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu, lapho abantu bekuza khona ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene beze, bejabulile ngokuhlangana. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, uma abantu behlangana, izinkinga ziba lula. Kwakukhona izinkulumo eziningi, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa umhlaba ongcono. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, abantu baqala ukubona ukuthi, yize bephila ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlobene. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, umhlaba ungaphucwa uma abantu behlangana, bephikisana, kodwa bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphucwa komhlaba. Kodwa, izinkinga zazingapheli. Kwakukhona abanye abantu ababesekela ubuhlanga, bephikisana nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela. UThandi noSipho bazi ukuthi, ukuze umhlaba uphucwe, kufanele bahlale bephikisana nobandlululo. Bafunda ukuthi, uma abantu behluleka ukuxhumana, umhlaba uhlala ubuthakathaka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane, lapho abantu befundiswa khona ngamalungelo abantu, ubuhlanga, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ndawonye. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Kwakukhona izinselelo, kodwa uThandi noSipho babengayeki. Bahlala bephusha phambili, bephikisana nezinkinga, beqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba wabo uyaphucwa. UThandi wakhumbula umusho owawukhona encwadini yakhe: "Ukwazi ukuthi ungashintsha umhlaba, kungakuhle uma uqala ngokuqonda." Ngaleyondlela, umhlaba wabo waqala ukushintsha. Abantu baphuma ezindaweni zabo, behlangana, bexoxa, futhi befundisana. UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, noma ubani angaba nesandla ekuphuculeni umhlaba, uma kuphela ebekezela, futhi enza okuthile. Ekugcineni, umhlaba wabo waba ngcono. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila ndawonye, bexhumana. UThandi noSipho babazi ukuthi, uma abantu behlangana, baphikisana, kodwa bephila ngokuhlanganyela, umhlaba ungaba ngcono. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqonda ukuthi, ukuphucwa komhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Futhi, njengoba besebenza, babona ukuthi umhlaba ungahlala uphucwa, uma kuphela abantu bephila ndawonye, behlanganyela, futhi behloniphana.
