Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezazihlosiwe zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKwaZulu-Natal yathola ukwakheka kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlosiwe, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezazihlosiwe zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Namuhla, iKwaZulu-Natal ibonakala njengendawo ebalulekile kwezepolitiki, lapho abantu behlanganyela ezindabeni ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Izinhlelo zokuphatha zikhula, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ubulungiswa, nezinsiza. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokubheka emuva, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal ubonisa izigameko eziningi ezibalulekile ezithinta abantu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu baseKwaZulu-Natal bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha. Umlando wabo ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba bezama ukwakha ubumbano, izinkinga zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu - Ingxoxo Nomhlinzeki Wezindlu Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnu. Sipho Mthethwa, ongumhlinzeki wezindlu odumile eNingizimu Afrika. U-Sipho unolwazi olunzulu kwezokwakhiwa kwezindlu, futhi uzokhuluma nathi ngalezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokuba lapha. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umbono wakho ngentuthuko yezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika? UMnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Intuthuko yezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile kakhulu. Njengoba abantu abaningi befuna izindawo zokuhlala, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izindlu ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izindlu ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezithengekayo, futhi ezihambisana nemvelo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo emkhakheni wezokwakhiwa kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Kunezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, sinesidingo sokwakha izindlu eziningi, kodwa izinsiza zethu zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngaleso sikhathi. Okwesibili, izindleko zokwakha ziya zanda, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezithengekayo. Futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindawo eziningi zidinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezifana namanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zikamasipala ziwusizo kanjani ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izinhlelo zikamasipala zibalulekile. Zisiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezithile ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma umphakathi uthola ukwesekwa okuhle, izinhlelo zokwakha ziba lula. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza izindlu zakho zihluke kwabanye? UMnu. Mthethwa: Sihlala sigxila ekwakheni izindlu ezihambisana nezidingo zethu zomphakathi. Sisebenzisa izinto eziphilayo nezihlala isikhathi eside, futhi sikhuthaza izindlela zokwakha ezivumelana nemvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithanda ukufaka izici ezithokozisayo, ezifana nezindawo zokudlala neziphuzo, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi izakhamuzi zingabamba kanjani iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi zibe neqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemibono, ukusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma izakhamuzi zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela ezithuthukisiwe ozisebenzisayo ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokwakha ezisebenzisa i-3D printing, kanye nezindlela zokwakha eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni izindleko, futhi kusebenza kahle ekwakheni izindlu ezisheshayo. Futhi, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokulima ezincane ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokudla emiphakathini yethu. Umbuzo 7: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lezokwakhiwa kwezindlu lizinzile? UMnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa lezokwakhiwa kwezindlu lizinzile uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela ezihlakaniphile zokwakha, futhi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi olujulile ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukukhuluma nawe kuveza ukuthi ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zibhekisela ezinselelweni ezihambisana nokutholakala, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, noma izinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ezindaweni ezithile. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zingavela ngenxa yezinto ezahlukahlukene. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izinguquko zesimo sezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezingasebenzi kahle, konke lokhu kudala izinselelo ezinkulu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi? Izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi zifaka phakathi ukuncipha kokutholakala kwamanzi emithonjeni, ukwanda kwezindleko zamanzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kokutholakala kwamanzi emiphakathini. Abantu bangase baphinde babone ukwanda kwezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Umbuzo 4: Kungani ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile? Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile ngoba kuthinta impilo yomphakathi. Amanzi angcolile angaholela ezimeni ezinzima, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwanayo, futhi kungaba nomthelela omubi ezilwaneni nasemvelweni. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izindlela zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi? Kunezindlela eziningi zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 6: Yini umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi anele. Ukushisa okwandayo, izikhukhula, nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola amanzi anele. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani umphakathi ungaba nesandla ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga? Umphakathi ungaba nesandla ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzeka, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi, nokwakha imikhankaso yokuvuselela imithombo yamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinhlaka, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi? Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuxhaswa kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. Umbuzo 9: Yini umthelela wezobuchwepheshe ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi? Ubuchwepheshe bungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi. Izixazululo ezinjengokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi? Abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi ngokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, njengokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi emakhaya, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, nokuhlanza amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukufundisa abanye ngalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Umbuzo 11: Yini okumele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi, ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yamanzi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemfundo kubantu mayelana nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile. Umbuzo 12: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi zifaka phakathi ukubaluleka kokuhlakanipha ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi, ukuhlela kahle izinsiza, nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukufunda ngezinkinga zamanzi kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yamanzi. Umbuzo 13: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi? Umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi ngokuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufundisa, ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanza imithombo yamanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zinto kuzokwenza abantu babe nesibopho sokugcina amanzi. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi? Singathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ngokwenza ucwaningo olujulile, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ubuchwepheshe bokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 15: Kanjani izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho? Izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho ngendlela enkulu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqiza, ukwanda kwezindleko, kanye nokwehla kokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyakhula. Isiphetho: Izinkinga zamanzi zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokuqonda izizathu, izimpawu, kanye nezixazululo, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukubambisana, ukufundisa, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga.
I-Mount Everest: Ubukhazikhazi Benjabulo Nokungabaza Ngikhumbula ngisebenza endaweni ethile lapho abantu bebebuza khona, "Ucabanga ukuthi kungani abantu behamba phezulu e-Mount Everest?" Ngempela, i-Mount Everest ikhangayo futhi iyingxenye yesiko lethu lendawo yokuphila. Itholakala eHimalayas, le ntaba enkulu ibizwa ngokwenziwa kwayo, kodwa ngaphakathi, ingaphezulu kwezinye izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezikhanyela emkhathini. Njengoba ngibuka le ntaba, ngithola kungabazeki ukuthi ibonisa ubukhulu bezinselele ezikhona empilweni. Izinkulungwane zabakhuphukeli bahamba, benza imizamo yokufinyelela phezulu, kodwa akukwazi ukuba kube lula. Kuye ngempela, lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokukhuthazela okukhulu. I-Mount Everest kayilungeli, ifuna labo abanobuchule nemizwa ethile, kube thina sithokozisa izimanga zayo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi imengameli ye-Mount Everest ikhipha umoya. Ingxenye ethokozisayo yokuphuculula impilo ngaphezu kokwenziwa lokho, ivuleka ngaphansi kwenqubo yokuphila. Kodwa ke, ngiyazibuza, "Ingabe ukuchuma kwalezi zifundo ngezinhlekelele ezithile? I-Mount Everest iyingxenye yokuphila lokhu, kodwa kuyini okwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kubanzima kuhamba phambili?" Bazalwane, lokhu kubonakala kuhle, kodwa akukhona nje ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ngabanye. Lokhu kubangela inkinga enkulu kithi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yasendaweni, inhlabamkhosi yesimo sezulu, nemiphumela yokwenziwa kwezemvelo. I-Mount Everest, ngokuyinhloko, ikhuluma ngamakhono abantu, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izifundo ezifundwe phezulu kule ntaba ziza nesibopho sokuthinta wonke umuntu. Abanye bahamba ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene – abanye babheke uhambo lokuzithokozisa, abanye bangeqa abahlengikazi, kodwa ngabe kukhona ukusangana phakathi kwemiphakathi? Uhlanga luzakuva lapho ufinyelela phezulu, kodwa kufanele futhi siqaphele ukuthi silokhu silokhu sinesidingo sokwenza imisebenzi efanele ukuze sigcine lezi zindawo ziqhakazekile. I-Mount Everest ikhiqiza umoya omusha, umoya ohlanzekile, nomoya wempilo engapheli. Ngabe sishiya izinkanyezi ezazisebenzisela abantu abaningi abahlala ezinhlobonhlobo zezimvula, imiphakathi emihle? Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yisinyathelo esikhuluma ngenhlalakahle, ukuze sizohlala sithokozisa impilo yethu. Emiphakathini eminingi, abantu baphila ngezixhamazela nezinkinga ezikhungethe, kusho ukuthi abaningana abaqondile. Ubukhazikhazi be-Mount Everest bucebisa abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, basebenzisane, futhi babelane ngemicabango. Ngicela ifa lethu eliqinile, elihlobisa izimanga zeHimalayas, ukuze sizithole izifundo ezingaba yinsika yokukhuthaza abazali bethu bamanje. Ngokuphathelene nomoya wezemvelo, sibona ukulwa okukhona ekuphatsweni kokwaziswa, ukuzama ukudlula okuhle phakathi kwethu. Abanye bakhuthazwa uhambo, ngesikhathi esifanayo, kudinga kube nephakathi kwezinto. Sifuna isikhathi esanele sokuphila ngendlela efanele. Ngenkathi sihlonipha i-Mount Everest, asinakulibala ukuthi izimpilo zethu zihambisana nempilo yemvelo; zenze ukuba imiphakathi iqhubeza ibambisane. Kuba usuku olubi uma sikhuluma ngazo zonke lezi zinkinga, kodwa sikhumbula njalo ukuthi i-Mount Everest izigubha izifundo eziphila. Uhambo olwenziwa phezulu akukhona nje ukukhuphuka, kunalokho, kube yindlela yokusebenzisa amandla ethu, amabhizinisi ethu, nemindeni yethu njengabantu. Ukuhlanganyela, uma sikhuluma ngempilo ye-Mount Everest, sikhuluma ngathi; kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi, nangaphandle komthwalo obalulekile lapho ukuhamba kwethu, akufanele sidlule engozini, ngaphandle kwamalungelo nezimiso ezenzakalayo. I-Mount Everest iyingxenye yokuphenya ngaphakathi kwabantu besintu, ukufiphaza imikhuba engalungile, ukuhlanza umoya, nezifundo zakwaHimalayas. Tina, njengabantu, kufanele siphendukele kwi-Mount Everest yethu siqonde izifundo ezichaza ukuthi singabaphila baphakathi. Uhambo lungacela ukukhanya kwemfihlakalo, lungavuleka kokubalulekile, uhambo olukhuluma ngethemba lalezi zifundo zamathekhnoloji nemiphakathi emihle. Ngokuhamba kwangempela, i-Mount Everest iyinsika, ibonisa ukuhamba kwezinto ezinkulu, imiphakathi ezithokozisayo, nezithunywa zempilo. Njengoba sizama ukufinyelela emaphakathini ethu, kufanele sikuphathe kahle uhambo, sihlose ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze izimanga ezimbi kule ntaba, sihlanganyele ezimfundisweni, futhi sikhuthaze abanye. Uthando lwezangoma nemindeni yethu, akuyona nje i-Mount Everest; kuyinto eyenzeka phakathi kwethu.
Iphrofayela kaSipho: Uhambo Olukhanyisayo Lokulwa Nokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa USipho, umfana oneminyaka engu-28, uhlala nomndeni wakhe eThekwini. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, lapho ubaba wakhe engumfundisi kanti umama wakhe engumsebenzi wezokwelapha. Lokhu kumenze waba nolwazi olunzulu ngezempilo nokubaluleka kokuphila kahle. Nokho, njengoba edlula ezinsukwini zakhe zokuqala, izinto zashintsha. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezifundo eziphakeme, uSipho wathola umsebenzi omuhle emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Kodwa ke, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukuhamba nezingane ezithanda ukuphuma nokujabulela impilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, okwakungakaze kube yinto ayicabangele. Uqala ngeziphuzo ezinamandla, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi, waqala ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ezinzima. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kwaholela ekutheni uSipho ahlupheke kakhulu. Waqala ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi wakhe, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe nomndeni nabangane baphenduka bubi. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisithombe esingezwakali kahle, esikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yokuphila kwempilo enobuhlungu, uSipho wathola usizo. Wavakashela emtholampilo wezokwelapha, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abanesimo esifanayo. Uthando lokuphila, kanye nomoya wokulwa, kwamsiza ukuba aqale uhambo lokuphila kabusha. Uthole ukwesekwa okuhle, futhi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo, izinzuzo zokuphila ngendlela enempilo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho wathola ukuthi ukulwa nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa akuyona into elula, kodwa kuyinto edinga ukuzimisela. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziningi, wahlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, futhi wathola umphakathi owamukelayo. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila lukhula, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane abasha, abamkhuthazayo. Ngemva kweminyaka emithathu yokulwa, uSipho waphumelela. Waphinde wathola umsebenzi, futhi waba ngumfundisi wezokwelapha, lapho efundisa abanye ngempilo enempilo nokubaluleka kokuphila ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe ubuhlungu bukhulu kangakanani, kunendlela yokuphila kabusha. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila lukhula, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane abasha, abamkhuthazayo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe ubuhlungu bukhulu kangakanani, kunendlela yokuphila kabusha.
Ukukhathala Kwaphezulu Kwabahlengikazi E-Helathcare Sector Isingeniso Ezimeni eziningi, abahlengikazi bavelaphiwa njengenhlangano yokugcina impilo, kodwa eminyakeni edlule, ubunzima obandayo ababhekana nabo bufake impilo nokusebenza kwabo engcupheni. Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi, okubangelwa izimo ezihlukahlukene, sekuthathe isikhala esikhulu ezinkulumweni zomphakathi, okukhombisa iziphumo ezinzima emsebenzini wabo nasempilweni yabo. Ukukhathala Kwamazinga Aphezulu Ngokwezifundo ezenziwa emikhakheni ehlukene, kubonakala ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlupheka ngokukhathala okukhulu ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Kwesinye isikhathi, ukulwa namazinga kokuphila, ukunqoba ubuningi bomsebenzi, kanye nezinsuku zokusebenza ezide, kudala ukukhathala okukhulu ezingqondweni nasemzimbeni. Lokhu kudala izimo zengqondo ezinzima ezifana nokuphazamiseka kwemizwa nokukhathala komqondo. Imiphumela Emibi KweZempilo Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kusebenza kakhudlwana, okukhombisa imiphumela emibi ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abahlengikazi baqhubeke ngesimo esibi sanoma yiliphi ibhodi lokwelapha, yize behamba phambili ekutholeni izixazululo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, uma abahlengikazi behlupheka, imiphumela ibalulekile kubaguli, okwenza ukuthi inkinga ikhokhelwe ngempilo yomphakathi. Izizathu Zokukhathala Izizathu ezibanjwe zabahlengikazi zihlanganisa ukungabi namathuba okuphucula izimo zokusebenza, ukuncipha kwezinsiza, kanye nokungahleleki kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukwenza kwesimo sokusebenza kube nzima emithonjeni yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza zezeMpilo ngesikhathi esiningi sokukhathala esivela kumakhosikazi nabadali bezinqubomgomo. Isixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuphumelele ukulungiswa kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabaphathi bezempilo benze izinyathelo ezinqala. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubahlengikazi, ukwakha izikhathi zokuphumula ezanele, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza kusebenza zempilo, kungasiza ekwehliseni ukukhathala. Ukusebeni Komphakathi Umphakathi nawo udinga ukwakha isimo sokusebenzisana. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi uma abahlengikazi bethola ukusekelwa okuvamile, kuzothuthukisa impilo yabo kanye nezinga lokusebenza. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ezinhloko ezithuthukisiwe nezokwelapha. Isiphetho Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi akuyona nje inkinga yomsebenzi, kodwa iyinkinga ebucayi esithinta bonke abantu. Izenzo kufanele zenziwe ukuze kuncishiswe lesi simo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlengikazi banempilo enhle, ukuze baqhubekele phambili bezinikele ekwelapheni umphakathi. Uhlelo lwezempilo kumele lube nemigomo yokuphila esebenzile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yezeMpilo nezinkonzo zezenhlalakahle.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile Kwakukhanya ilanga, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, futhi umoya wawuhamba kancane. Emzaneni omncane, uMfula uNhlanga wawuhamba ngokuthula, uthela amanzi akhe ahlanzekile. Abantu bendawo babewathokozela kakhulu, ngoba amanzi ayewasiza ekuphileni kwabo. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayejabule kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngamanzi ahlanzekile akhukhulayo. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wahamba noMkhulu wakhe, uMnumzane Ndlovu, waya emfuleni. UThandi wayefuna ukubona ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awavela kanjani. UMnumzane Ndlovu, onolwazi oluningi, waqala ukuchaza. "Amanzi ahlanzekile, Thandi, avela ezintabeni. Zikhona izintaba eziphakeme ezithokozisa umoya, futhi lapho imvula ihlaba, amanzi ahlanzekile ayehla phansi, efika emifuleni yethu." UThandi wayemamatheka, ethokozisa uMkhulu wakhe. "Ngabe amanzi ahlanzekile angasiza kanjani abantu, Mkhulu?" ubuza. UMnumzane Ndlovu waphendula, "Amanzi ahlanzekile asiza ekuphileni. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphile, ukuze balime, futhi ukuze bathokozise imindeni yabo." Ngemuva kokuchaza, uMnumzane Ndlovu wathola ithuba lokufundisa uThandi ngendlela yokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile. "Kubalulekile, Thandi, ukuthi sigcine imvelo yethu ihlanzekile. Uma sishiya udoti emfuleni, amanzi azoba namagciwane, futhi lokho kuzokwenza abantu bahlupheke." UThandi wathola ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile, futhi wathi, "Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngigcine amanzi ahlanzekile." Ngemuva kokuhamba emfuleni, uThandi wanquma ukuhlela umcimbi wokuhlanza umfula. Waqala ukuhlela nabangani bakhe, wathi, "Sizohlanza umfula wethu, sizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono." Abangani bakhe bamamukela, bejabule ngokuhlanganyela. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, bahlangana emfuleni, behamba neziphuzo, izikhwama, nezinsiza zokuhlanza. UThandi wakhuthaza wonke umuntu, "Masihlanze umfula, ukuze amanzi ahlanzekile aqhubeke ehamba." Bonke bahlanganyela, bejabule, behlanza udoti, bephinde bejabulisa umfula. UThandi wayebona ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayebalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba ndawonye ukuze bagcine imvelo yabo. Ngemuva kokuhlanza, umfula wawubukeka kahle, amanzi akhanya njengegolide. UThandi noMkhulu wakhe babebuka umfula, bejabulile. "Ngiyabonga, Mkhulu, ngokungifundisa. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngigcine amanzi ahlanzekile." UMnumzane Ndlovu wamamatheka, "Ngiyazi, Thandi. Uthando lwakho lwezinto ezinhle luzokwenza umehluko." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awaveli kuphela emfuleni, kodwa adinga ukunakekelwa. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi wakhe, ebakhumbuza ukuthi bahlale behlanza, baphinde baphinde bahloniphe imvelo. Umfula uNhlanga waba yisibonelo sokubambisana, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngemva kwesikhathi, umfula waba yindawo yokudlela, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behamba ngezinyawo, bejabule. UThandi waba yintokazi edumile emzaneni, futhi abantu bamthanda kakhulu. Waqhubeka nokufundisa abanye, wathi, "Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisibusiso. Masigcine, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto ezinhle lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi umfula uNhlanga waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlala behlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umfula waba yindawo yokuhlala, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisibusiso esikhulu. UThandi noMkhulu wakhe bahlala bejabulile, behlola umfula, bejabulisa amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awaveli kuphela emfuleni, kodwa adinga ukunakekelwa. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto ezinhle lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi umfula uNhlanga waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni, futhi umfula waba yindawo yokuhlala, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile.
Ezabantwana: Izindaba Zokukhathalela Abantwana Kwathi lapho umoya uvunguza kancane, izinyanga ziye phambili, indaba yethu iqala khona. Kukhona umuzi omncane, owawuthokozisa zonke izizukulwane, okwakukhona khona izingane eziningi. Lezi zingane zazimnandi, zishaya amahlaya, zidlala zikhululekile emikhakheni efana nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Kwathi kube nesikhathi sokudayisa, uMama uSiphiwe, umama wengane encane yokuqala uThando, wayehlale ehlezi ezindlwini, elungiselela okuhle okwakuzobhalwa ezindleleni. "Abantwana bethu badinga izinto ezinhle, badinga umoya opholile namathuba amaningi," wayekhuluma esobala. UThando, owayenonophethwe emlonyeni, wayechitha imihla yakhe edlalela othandweni bakhe, kodwa uMama uSiphiwe wayenokholo olukhulu ukuthi uzomthola umoya omuhle empilweni. UThando, njenganoma ibani, wayephupha ngezinto eziningi. Wayefuna ukufunda, ukudlala, nokwazi izinto ezahlukahlukene. Kodwa, empilweni yakhe, kwakukhona izithiyo eziningi. Abazali bakhe bahlala bezama ukuphila, kodwa bezama futhi ukusiza uThando. UThando wayezwa imithwalo yobunzima kunoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uhlanga lwayo lwaludinga uthando, futhi uMama uSiphiwe wayefuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uThando uthola konke akudinga ukuze abe ngumuntu ophumelelayo. Ubusuku obukhulu, uMama uSiphiwe wenza isinqumo sokuhlanganisa abantu endaweni yokudlela, ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona. "Kumele sikhulume ngezidingo zethu, kumele sikhulume ngezinto ezinjengokufunda nokuhamba phambili," kubekezela uMama uSiphiwe ngothando. Abanye abazali bahlangana, beshaya izandla, bezama ukwakha umoya wokulendawo eziphakeme. UThando, ehlanganyela nabangane bakhe, wayebamba izifundo ezibalulekile. Uthando noSiyabonga, ongumngane wakhe, babedlala emshallweni, bejabulisa kakhudlwana. Beyingane eziphathe kahle zabanjwa ngenkuthalo yokuba — ubuciko, umculo, nezifundo zomhlaba. Babedlula phezulu emhinini izizathu eziningi, kepha bazi ukuthi bonke babehlanganyela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngemva kokubheka izikhumbuzo, uMama uSiphiwe waxoxisana noMnumzane uPhungula, owayethanda ukuthanda ukusizakala kwabantwana. "Ngiyakwazi ukukhipha umoya opholile endaweni yethu. Abantwana bethu badinga izikhala zokudlala, ngemva kokudlala badinga lezozindawo zokucabanga," uxoxe kahle. Isikhathi senzekile, izinhlelo ziqala ukuthuthukiswa. Othisha babezama ukusiza, sibanika amathuba amahle abafanele ukuwasebenzisa. Umphakathi wabantu balokhu uphakamisa izinhlelo ezahlukene, ezingama-activities zokufundiswa ezithokozisayo. Abantwana babeziqhenya behlangene kuleso sikhathi, njengoba uThando ebamba kahle ubuciko obuhlukahlukene. Ngempela, labo abangabazali babengazii ngempela, kodwa babenothando olukhulu. Babezama ukusebenzisa izinsiza abazitholile, beyifaka kwiHholo YaseMphakathini ukuze bazise abantwana ngezindleko eziphansi. Kwenziwa imicimbi eminingi yokukhuthaza ukuhamba phambili ngokubuka izincwadi, ukuzihlanganisa nezinye izifundo, ibhuku lelagazi lobuciko bethu. Inhloso yaba abababonakalisayo ukuze kube nezindawo ezihlukahlukene zokuqhuba umculo, imidlalo yasendaweni, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Abantwana bezothatheka ukuze baqonde emakhaya abo, lapho bezothokoza besebenza ndawonye. Emakhaya, imidondoshiya yaqhubeka, imfundo yayizalwe ngothando. UThando wayelungela ukuhamba phambili, nazo zonke izifundo abezithola. Abazali bathokozisa umphakathi, ukuyisiza abantwana ukuba baphume phambili. Ekugcineni, le ndaba ibalulekile, yaphenduka yinhlekelele emiphakathini. UThando, nabangane bakhe, bamba izandla begubha lezi zinsuku ezimnandi. Kwaphela isikhathi, uMama uSiphiwe ubona ukuthi zonke izifiso zawo zifezekile; umoya obuhlungu manje uzolile. Uthando, ngokuziqhenya, waphakamisa izandla zakhona, enedumo ebukekayo. Ngale ndlela, impilo yokuqala kwabantu ifomethwe ngothando nebambiswano. UThando wayephupha futhi wayesebenzisa ithalente lakhe. Babengenazo kuphela indlela ezibalulekile, kepha benemoya opholile, futhi abafisilwe lokho. Kwathi ezinsukwini ezinhle, uThando washintsha, wazalwa esahlukweni sokuphila. "Abantwana bethu badinga imfundo, uthando, nesikhala sokukhula," wathi uMama uSiphiwe, wabe eshawula kahle, esho ngokusobala. Indlela yabe yisifundo sokuba neqhaza elikhulu. Njengoba uThando eqhubeka, njalo ubhiyoza, imiphakathi iyashanela kahle, izwi likhanya, izinto ezahlukene zenza uThando ajabule. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantwana bayobalekela esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kusebenza izinkumbulo ezihlabelela amandla abantwana; bahlala bejabulela impilo yabo, benelisa ugqozi lwezinto ezinjengothando nobudlelwano. Ukukhula kwankosikazi, ukuhamba phambili. Abantwana badinga uthando, futhi umphakathi wazo uhlanganyela, kangangokuba, ufuna ukuba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yeqiniso. Le ndaba igcwele umoya wokuphila, uyavuma ukuthi abantwana, jikelele, kumele bakhuliswe ngothando. Indaba ibonisa indlela yokukhanyisa umoya, nokugqugquzela umphakathi, ukuze ukwenze kudlule phezulu. Ngale ndlela, abantwana bazoba nempilo engcono, imiphefumulo izothokozisa.
Izimpi ZamaZulu Kwathi kudala, emhlabeni wezinkanyezi, lapho izinkanyezi zazikhanya khona njengemibala emihle, kwavela isizwe esikhulu, esaziwa ngokuthi amaZulu. Leli qembu labantu lalingabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinhle, ezimnandi, ezisemaphandleni, lapho izinkomo zikhula khona, futhi izihlahla zikhula zikhanya. Kodwa, njengokujwayelekile emlandweni, izimpi zazingekho kude. Ngaleso sikhathi, uShaka, umholi ophakeme, wathola ukuthi isizwe sakhe sithwele kanzima. Izitha zazingamnyama, zifuna ukuthumba izwe labo. UShaka, owayenobuhlakani obukhulu, wathola ukuthi kumele enze okuthile ukuze avikele isizwe sakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izimpi, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wakhulisa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe. UShaka wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, futhi wayazi kahle ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqale kuphela emadodeni, kodwa zazingabantu bonke. Waqala ukufundisa abantu bakhe indlela yokulwa, wababonisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ungabavikela. Ngaleso sikhathi, izimpi zokuqala zenzeka, futhi amaZulu aqala ukuhamba phambili, edlula izitha zawo. Kwathi ngesikhathi seMpumalanga, uShaka wahlangana nezitha ezazivela eMthethwa. Lezi zitha zazihlasela izwe lamaZulu, zifuna ukuthumba izinkomo nezinsizwa. UShaka, enesibindi, wahola umkhankaso, wathumela amabutho akhe ukuze avikele izwe. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wokulwa wawukhona. AmaZulu abamba izikhali zabo, behlakanipha, behlula izitha zabo. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa izindlela zokulwa, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Kwathi ngesikhathi seMfecane, izimpi zashintsha ubuso bezwe. AmaZulu abamba izikhali, kodwa izitha zaba ziningi. Kwakukhona izizwe ezazihlasela, zifuna ukuthumba izwe lamaZulu. UShaka, enesibindi, wathola ukuthi kumele ahlale eqaphile. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa izindlela zokulwa, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Izimpi zamaZulu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni, zashiya izifundo ezibalulekile zokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuhlonipha. UShaka, njengomholi, waba yisibonelo sokuthi umoya wokulwa ungavikela isizwe, kodwa umoya wokubambisana ungakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izimpi zashiya izinkumbulo, kodwa zashiya nethuba lokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihloniphekile, nesizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, izimpi zamaZulu zaba yisifundo esibalulekile, esifundisa ukuthi amandla akhona emoyeni, hhayi kuphela ezikhali. UShaka, umholi ophakeme, waba yisibonelo sokuthi isizwe esihlangene singakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithole impumelelo, futhi sikhulise izimpilo zethu. Izimpi zashiya umthelela, kodwa umoya wamaZulu wahlala uqhakazile, uqhubeka nokukhanya njengenkanyezi emhlabeni.
Amabhizinisi Amancane - Ingxoxo Nendoda Ethuthukisa Umnotho Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozile ukuba nezingxoxo nomnqobi wempumelelo emkhakheni wamabhizinisi amancane, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu. U-Sipho ungumuntu ophumelele kakhulu, futhi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wakhe. Sizobe sikhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe, izinselelo abhekane nazo, kanye nezifundo azifundile endleleni. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: U-Sipho, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi waqala kanjani ibhizinisi lakho? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngathanda ukusungula ibhizinisi lami ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami. Ngibone ukuthi umphakathi wami udinga izinsiza ezithile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokudla. Ngakha umqondo wokuvula isitolo sokudla esinikeza ukudla okuphumelelayo, okwenziwe ngempela ngezithako ezisemqoka. Ngathola uxhaso oluncane oluvela kubangani bami, futhi ngaqala ngenkampani encane. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekane nazo ekuqaleni? U-Sipho: Kunezinto eziningi ezinzima. Okokuqala, kwakunzima ukuthola imali yokwakha ibhizinisi. Ngabe ngidinga ukuhamba ngokuqhubekayo, ngikhuluma nabantu abahlukene ukuze ngithole uxhaso. Okwesibili, kwakunzima ukuheha amakhasimende. Ngafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yami iyathandwa, ngakho ngasebenzisa izindlela zokumaketha ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezincane emiphakathini. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba nebhizinisi elincane? U-Sipho: Izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ungakwazi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela oyithandayo, okuvumela ukuba ube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Okwesibili, ungakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende akho. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngithanda amakhasimende ami, bayazizwa bekhululekile futhi baphinde babuyisele. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo. Umbuzo 4: Uthola kanjani izixazululo ezinzima? U-Sipho: Ngithanda ukufunda. Ngihlala ngifunda izincwadi, ngibuka izifundo eziku-inthanethi, futhi ngihlanganyela nabanye osomabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi akekho owazi konke, ngakho ngiyazama ukufunda kwabanye. Ngithola izixazululo ezinzima ngokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene, futhi ngiyazama ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izifundo ezibalulekile ozifundile? U-Sipho: Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile. Ngithole ukuthi uma ungenalo uhlelo, ungase ungaphumeleli. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana kubalulekile. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye osomabhizinisi, amakhasimende, kanye nabahlinzeki bangeza impumelelo. Okwesithathu, kufanele uhlale uvumelana nezinguquko. Umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi kufanele ube nesimo sokuzivumelanisa. Umbuzo 6: Uthanda kanjani ukusiza abanye osomabhizinisi? U-Sipho: Ngiyakholelwa ekutheni umphakathi kufanele usebenze ndawonye. Ngihlanganyela izifundo zamahhala nabantu abasha abathanda ukuqala amabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sabelana ngolwazi, siphumelela sonke. Ngithanda ukusiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani, futhi ngiyabavumela ukuba babuze noma yini. Umbuzo 7: Yini oyibona njengomgomo wakho wokugcina? U-Sipho: Umgomo wami wokugcina ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emiphakathini. Ngifuna ukusungula ibhizinisi elizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo, futhi ngithanda ukusiza abanye ukuba bathole amathuba. Ngifuna ukuba isibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Isiphetho U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhombisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukufunda, nokuxhumana nabanye kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni yakhe. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze amabhizinisi amancane, ngoba ayisisekelo somphakathi. U-Sipho ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi, uma sinesifiso, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.
Amaphoyisa: Umsebenzi Wokuzivikela Nokwakha Ubulungiswa Amaphoyisa, njengomnyango obalulekile emphakathini, anendima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphoyisa awagcini nje ngokuba yizikhali zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa futhi ayizinsika zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela esingabathuthukisa ngazo ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngempumelelo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amaphoyisa abhekene nezimo ezinzima. Njengoba ububi buqhubeka nokukhula, amaphoyisa ahlale ebhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi babe nekhono lokuphatha izimo ezinzima, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo eziphuthumayo. Nokho, akusikho konke okukhuluma ngobubi; amaphoyisa kufanele futhi abe nekhono lokuxhumana nabantu, ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu besebenzisana namaphoyisa, kuba lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa adinga ukwakha isithombe esihle emphakathini. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, njengokuhlanganyela emicimbini yomphakathi, noma ukuhlela izifundo zokuphepha. Uma abantu bebona amaphoyisa njengabavikeli, hhayi njengabaphangi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuma ukusiza lapho kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa azithathele izinyathelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule kahle uma bebuza noma bexhumana nabo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanya. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene namaphoyisa, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinkingeni zokuhlukumeza. Ukukhathazeka ngalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abhekane nezimo ezinzima, futhi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bempilo yomphakathi bayaziswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa amaphoyisa ngendlela yokuphatha izimo ezinzima, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo ezinzima ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla ngokweqile. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa ahlale ebuyekeza izinqubomgomo zawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola ukusebenza kwabo, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini esebenzayo nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Ukuze bakwazi ukwenza lokhu, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa kufanele aqhubeke nokufunda. Umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi izindlela zokusebenza zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kufanele bahlale befundisa futhi beqonda izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithuthukisiwe, ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa ayisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubulungiswa buyadingeka emiphakathini yethu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amaphoyisa awagcini nje ngokuba yizikhali zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa futhi ayizinsika zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo sokubambisana, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke amaphoyisa njengabavikeli, hhayi njengabaphangi. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizokwenza kube nzima ukuvimbela ubugebengu, futhi sizokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Amaphoyisa adinga ukwesekwa, futhi thina sonke sinesibopho sokubasiza. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile.
### Ama-Smartphone: Uhlanga Lokuxhumana Lwezobuchwepheshe Isingeniso Kulezi zinsuku, ama-smartphone sezidume kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi kube uthando lokuthi abantu basebenzise lezi zinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma sihamba ezindaweni zomphakathi, sithola abantu abaningi besebenzisa ama-smartphone, okuhleli phakathi kwezandla zabo. Kule ncwadi, sizobheka imvelaphi, izici, kanye nokubaluleka kwe-smartphone empilweni yansuku zonke. Imvelaphi Ye-Smartphone Ama-smartphone awaqalanga njengokujwayelekile. Qala umqondo owayevame ukuba yifoni yendabuko, eyayikwazi kuphela ukuxhumana nokuqhubeka nezinkampani. Khona-ke, eminyakeni engamashumi amabili edlule, yima inhlanganisela enkulu ye-intelligent technology, okuholele ekwakhiweni ama-smartphone. Lawa ma-smartphone anikela ngezici ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ikhamera, i-inthanethi, nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Enye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wama-smartphone wukuthi awanemiko emincane, njengama-Blackberry ne-Nokia, okwakuyizifanekiso ezazida futhi zazidumile ngesikhathi sazo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buchuma, ama-smartphone aqala ukuvela, futhi kuze kube namuhla, anikezela ngezici ezinzima, ezibandakanya amandla okuxhumana, ukudlala imidlalo, nezinye izilungiselelo eziningi zomsebenzi. Izici Ze-Smartphone Ama-smartphone akhiwe ngezici eziningi ezizenza zihluke kwi-foni yendabuko. Okokuqala, kukhona isikhombimsebenzisi esihambisana ne-touchscreen esivumela abasebenzisi ukuthi baphathe izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokuthinta kuphela. I-touchscreen ibhekwa njengomsebenzi ophawuleka kakhulu wama-smartphone, phakathi nezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani zaziwa kakhulu. Okwesibili, ama-smartphone anama-processor akhuphukayo, okwenza kube lula ukuphatha imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukusebenza, baphule imidlalo, kanye nokuxhumana nabangani baphinde bazithokozise. Ikhamera yama-smartphone nayo ibalulekile. I-smartphone yanamuhla ibikhiqiza izithombe eziphakeme kakhulu, ezivumela abantu ukuba bathathe izithombe ezizwakalayo nezibukwayo. Njengoba imithombo yezokuxhumana isiphenduke indawo yokwabelana ngezithombe, isikhathi sokuthatha isithombe sibe lukhuni, bakeshe imithombo yokuxhumana ingasekho, ihlaba umxhwele. Ukubaluleka Kwe-Smartphone Ama-smartphone awasiyena kuphela amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa asebenza futhi njengama-hub ahlakaniphile empilweni yethu. Ngaphezulu kokuzenzakalelayo, ama-smartphone ahlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda, yokusebenza, kanye nezokungcebeleka. Abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakhasi e-inthanethi, baxhumane nabangani, futhi bathuthukise izifundo zabo ngale ndlela. Ukwengeza, ama-smartphone asiza ekuxhumaneni kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlela izibopho, balandele impilo yabo, noma baphathe imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eyahlukeneyo. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubekele phambili kabili futhi baphendule emaso. Ngokwengxenye, ama-smartphone abe nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Abantu bakwazi ukuxhumana kalula, kungakhathaliseki ukuba baphila kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kuxhumana kwesiteshi esisodwa kubavumela ukuba babelane ngemicabango, izincwadi, nezithombe, okwenza kube lula ukuthi baze baphinde bahlale bedlalisa. Izingozi Nezingqinamba Zama-Smartphone Kodwa-ke, nakuba ama-smartphone enezinzuzo eziningi, akulula kodwa futhi eza nezingozi. Ukuxhumana okungafunwa kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwezinsuku zethu, kungase kuphumele izinkinga zokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ukubamba ngaphandle kokuhlala sibukeka, sithathele izithombe, kungaba yingozi, kungenzeka campa emiphakathini yangempela. Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi ama-smartphone azama ukufaka umthelela ekukhuleni kwengqondo. Abanye abantu baqala ukuthola ukuphazamiseka kokucabanga ngenxa yokusebenzisa ama-smartphone kakhulu, okukhomba ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sihlale sikhumbula ukujula kubona. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ama-smartphone awavulekile nje amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa akhiwe ngezici ezividlaysisayo empilweni yethu. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukubheka izinzuzo nemikhawulo yama-smartphone njengengxenye yemvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, singathuthukisa impilo yethu, sisize abanye, futhi sigcine isikhalazo esithokozisayo ngaphansi kwenguquko ye-intelligent technology. Amasimu amasha aphuma emfundweni yethu yomhlaba phakathzail lezi zinto, kuyiphuzu elikhalipha emhlabeni ukuze sibe abaphuma phambili emhlabeni wezamabhizinisi. Ngakho, masikubheke njengemithombo yokufunda nokuqhakambisa ukuphila kwethu, siqonde indlela yokuxhumana ngendlela eyakhayo futhi ethokozisayo. Kumbe kungenzeka sibeke izijobelelo ezintsha ukuze sithole oyena masimi oyiqatha sinnye-noqhubekiswayo.
uThabo Mbeki: Umholi Ohloniphekayo UThabo Mbeki, umholi owayengumengameli weNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wezikhumbuzo ezibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe kuleli. Uthabo wazalwa ngo-18 kuNhlangulana 1942 eIdutywa, eMpuma Koloni. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uMbeki akazange abe umholi wezwe kuphela, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophumelele ezindabeni eziningi, ezemfundo, nezamasiko? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu bemhloyi. Ngaphambi kokuba abe ngumengameli, uMbeki waba neqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wokukhulula iNingizimu Afrika. Waqala ukufunda eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abafundi ababesebenzela ukulwa nobandlululo. Uthabo waba neqhaza elikhulu kwi-African National Congress (ANC) futhi waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuguquka ezombusazwe. Ngemuva kokuphunyuka emzabalazweni, uMbeki waba ngumsunguli omkhulu wezinhlelo eziningi ezazihlosiwe ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi uMbeki wayekholelwa ekutheni ubumbano lwabantu luyisihluthulelo sokwakha isizwe esiqinile? Lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuthi wayenobuhlakani bokuhola, futhi wayekwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizoshintsha impilo yabantu. UThabo Mbeki waba ngumengameli ngo-1999, futhi wathatha izinqumo eziningi ezibalulekile. Phakathi nezinsuku zakhe, wayefuna ukwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi wayephokophele ukunciphisa ubuphofu. Ubuye waba nohlelo lwe-African Renaissance, olwaluhloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho nezenhlalo e-Afrika. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele, lapho azama khona ukuveza izinkinga ezikhungethe i-Afrika. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMbeki wayebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izinqumo zakhe ngezinye izikhathi zazibhekwa njengokungahambisani nezidingo zabantu. Isibonelo, ngesikhathi seHIV/AIDS, ukungavumi kwakhe ukwamukela imithi yokwelapha kwabangela ukugxekwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngenxa yokungabi nokwelashwa okufanele. Uthabo Mbeki akazange agcine kuphela emzamweni wokwakha iNingizimu Afrika, kodwa waba nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo e-Afrika. Waba yisithwathwa sokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamazwe, futhi waba nomthelela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezombusazwe nezomnotho e-Afrika. Naphezu kwezinkinga, uMbeki waphumelela ekwakheni imishado phakathi kwezizwe. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni i-African Union, okuyinhlangano ehlanganyela amazwe ase-Afrika. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamazwe, futhi kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngemuva kokuphuma esikhundleni sikaMengameli ngo-2008, uMbeki akazange aphumule. Waqhubeka nokusebenza emikhakheni ehlukene, efaka isandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho e-Afrika. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe. UThabo Mbeki ungumuntu okhumbuleka kakhulu, futhi umthelela wakhe uzohlala ukhanya emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi umholi ongcono akakhulumi kuphela, kodwa futhi uhola ngezinyathelo eziphusile. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma ngabe ub faced with challenges, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo zakho. Ngokuphetha, uThabo Mbeki ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika. Uthando lwakhe lwezwe, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe wokwakha ubumbano, kubonisa ukuthi umholi angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uthando lwakhe lwe-Afrika luhlala lukhanya, futhi umbono wakhe wokwakha isizwe esiqinile uzohlala ukhumbuleka. UThabo Mbeki ungumholi ohloniphekayo, futhi impilo yakhe iyisifundo sokuthi, uma sinesifiso sokwenza kahle, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukuhlola Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Ukubamba imicimbi yomphakathi kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Imicimbi efana noMkhosi Wezithelo, imishado, nezinkumbulo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuhlela le micimbi ngendlela efanele ukuze ihlale ibalulekile, ibekwe kahle, futhi ifinyelele kulabo abayidingayo. Sizofunda izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi emicimbini yomphakathi ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu. Izinzuzo Zemicimbi Yomphakathi Okokuqala, imicimbi yomphakathi idala ithuba lokuhlangana. Abantu bathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela, babelane ngemibono, futhi basebenzisane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, nezinkampani. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuwina ezinkingeni eziphathelene nezimpilo zabo, kudingeka isikhala sokwabelana ngezimvo nemibono. Imicimbi ibuye ibe yithuba lokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile emphakathini, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuziphilisa, amandla phakathi kwabantu, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Okwesibili, imicimbi yomphakathi iyakhuthaza ukwakhiwa komnotho. Izinkampani ezithinta le micimbi, njengezindawo zokudlela, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, nezokuthengisa, ziba nomthelela ophumelelayo emnothweni. Lapho umcimbi ubamba iqhaza, abantu baya emaphethelweni edolobheni, okukhuthaza ukuthenga nokuthengisa. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo kumabhizinisi amancane. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi imicimbi ethile ikhanga izihambeli, okuholela ekufakweni kwezimpahla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yomphakathi iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Lapho abantu behlangana, bakha ukuqonda nokuqwashisa, okuvulela amathuba okuba neqhaza emphakathini. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokuhlonipha, izinkulumo, noma imfundo ibalulekile ekuqwashiseni abantu ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi wabo. Imiphumela Emibi Yemicimbi Yomphakathi Nokho, imicimbi yomphakathi ingaholela emiphumeleni emibi uma ingahlelwa kahle. Ukuze abantu bahlale bephumulele emicimbini, kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. Ukuntuleka kokuhlela kahle kungaholela ezinkingeni ezifana nokungezwani, izingozi, noma izinkinga zokuphepha. Lokhu kungalimaza umphakathi, kudala ingqondo yokuthi imicimbi zingaba yingozi. Futhi, imicimbi yomphakathi ingadala ukuhlukumezeka kumalungelo abantu uma imizwa yabo ingalalelwa. Izinqumo ezithathwa ngumphakathi zingase zithinte abantu ngendlela engafanele, okuholela ekutheni bahlupheke ngengqondo. Umphakathi Ohlangene Ngemibono Ekugcineni, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Iphakamisa ukuxhumana, izinkumbulo, nokukhuthaza ukholo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzisanayo. Ngaphezu kwezizathu ezinhle, kubalulekile ukufaka umfutho emicimbini yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye nokwenza imicimbi ibe yithuba lokukhula komnotho. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuhlela imicimbi ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano, ophumelelayo, futhi onempilo. Uma sikhumbula lokhu, sizoba nolwazi lokuphila kahle ngokwamukela imicimbi yomphakathi, kusukela ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlangana, kuze kube phezulu ekwakheni umphakathi okhongayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi akusikho okwenzekayo kuphela, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo.
Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi: Uhambo Lwethu Lokukhula Ngiyavuma, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuyinto ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ingaba yinkimbinkimbi. Njengoba siphila emhlabeni oshintsha njalo, kudingeka sihlale siphakanyiswa, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole amathuba amasha. Ngicabanga ukuthi sizoqala ngokuqonda ukuthi yini lezi zinto ezibizwa nge-"career development." Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje ukufuna umsebenzi. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kwalokho. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, akusizi nje ukuba nomsebenzi, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokukhula kulolo msebenzi. Ngabe ubani owenza lokhu? Ngicabanga ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi usaqalayo noma usuphezulu emsebenzini. Uhlelo lokuqashwa kwemisebenzi lungaba yinto ethokozisayo, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezilungile. Ukuze sithuthukise, kudingeka sithole izifundo, sibhale izincwadi, futhi sibe neziqu ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sishayele amakhono amasha, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba uyashintsha, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhambisana nezinguquko. Ngiyavuma, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe necebo. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kufanele sibe necebo elihle lokukhula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinyathelo zethu, nokubeka imigomo. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sibe necebo eliqinile, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona amathuba lapho ethola khona. Ukubona amathuba akusizi kuphela, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuwathatha. Ngabe ubani ongasiza kulolu hambo? Ngicabanga ukuthi abanye bethu singaba nomthelela omkhulu. Abaholi bethu, ozakwethu, nabangani bethu bangasiza kakhulu. Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu emkhakheni wethu kungaba yindlela enhle yokufunda. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlala bejabulile uma bekhuluma ngempumelelo yabo? Lokhu kungenza sithole izeluleko ezibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akupheli. Kukhona njalo okuthile okusha okufanele sikufunde. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Lokhu akusizi kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuzivumelanisa nezimo. Ngabe ubani owaziyo ukuthi imisebenzi emisha iyavela njalo? Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimakethe, sithole izinkampani ezithakazelisayo, futhi sithole ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze sibe neqhaza. Kukhona izinkampani ezithokozisayo ezithola abaqashi, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona lezi zinkampani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje ukufuna umsebenzi. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kwalokho. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona amathuba, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphumelela akufani nokuphumelela kwabanye. Umuntu ngamunye unendlela yakhe yokukhula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona ukuthi yini esiyithanda, nokuthi sithanda ukwenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akupheli. Kukhona njalo okuthile okusha okufanele sikufunde. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuphetha, umhlaba wokusebenza usushintshile kakhulu, futhi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuyindlela yokuphila. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kokufuna umsebenzi; kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ethu. Ngakho, qhubekani, thuthukani, futhi nithole amathuba amasha. Uhambo lokukhula luhlala lukhona, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Ngiyabonga.
UBlack Coffee: Umculi Ohloniphekile Isingeniso UBlack Coffee, ogama lakhe langempela linguNkosinathi Maphumulo, ungumculi odumile emhlabeni jikelele. Uthandwa kakhulu ngenxa yomculo wakhe opholile, owaziwa ngokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, kuhlanganise ne-house ne-afro-house. Kule ndatshana, sizobheka indlela uBlack Coffee akhule ngayo, izimpumelelo zakhe, kanye nomthelela wakhe emculweni nasempilweni yabantu. Isigaba 1: Ukuqala Kwakhe UBlack Coffee wazalelwa eLanga laMafene, eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, njengoba ababephila ezindaweni ezinzima. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwaqala esencane, lapho eqala khona ukudlala i-dj emicimbini yasemakhaya. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe emculweni, futhi kwamsiza ukuba aqonde ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila. Isigaba 2: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemisebenzi Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uBlack Coffee waqala ukusebenza njengomculi ophakathi nendawo. Waqala ukwakha igama lakhe emculweni, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wathola ithuba lokubamba imicimbi emikhulu. Uthando lwakhe lokudala umculo oluhlukile lwamvumela ukuthi aqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izitayela zakhe. Ngalesi sikhathi, waqala ukusebenzisana nabanye abaculi, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile emhlabeni womculo. Isigaba 3: Izimpumelelo Zomhlaba Wonke UBlack Coffee wathola udumo olukhulu ngemva kokukhulula ama-albhamu akhe, afana no "Africa Rising" no "Pieces of Me." Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ubuchule bakhe bokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, futhi zathola izindondo eziningi. UBlack Coffee waba yisithonjana emhlabeni, futhi waqala ukuhamba emhlabeni wonke, edlala emicimbini emikhulu, efana ne-Coachella ne-Tomorrowland. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abanye abaculi baphinde bamlandele, futhi umculo wakhe waba nomthelela omkhulu ezizweni ezahlukene. Isigaba 4: Umthelela Emphakathini Ngaphandle kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, uBlack Coffee ubonakala njengomholi emphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abanye abaculi, futhi usebenzisana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umculo eNingizimu Afrika. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abasha, eqinisekisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila. UBlack Coffee ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokuzijabulisa; ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Isigaba 5: Ukubhekisisa Ikusasa Njengoba uBlack Coffee eqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi aqhubeke nokwakha umculo opholile, okhuthaza abantu. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana, futhi ungafaka isandla ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. UBlack Coffee ubalulekile emculweni, futhi umthelela wakhe uzohlala ukhanya ezizweni eziningi. Isiphetho UBlack Coffee ungumculi ohloniphekile, onomthelela omkhulu emculweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwakhe kusukela ezingeni eliphansi kuya phezulu kubonisa ukuthi ngeqhaza, uthando, nokusebenza kanzima, umuntu angafinyelela impumelelo. Umculo wakhe uyakhuthaza, futhi umphakathi uyamthanda. UBlack Coffee ungumfanekiso wokuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi umphakathi ungathola izinzuzo eziningi kulokhu. Njengoba eqhubeka nokudala, sizobona ukuthi umculo wakhe uzohlala unomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni.
Abafundi Basemanyuvesi: Izinkinga Nezithombe Zokuphila Kwabo Ngonyaka wezi-2023, abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta imfundo, ezomnotho, kanye nezokuxhumana. Njengoba izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubeka nokukhula, abafundi bahlola izinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezibhekene nabo, okuhlanganisa izindleko zokuphila, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, kanye nezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo. Izindleko Zokuphila Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nabafundi basemanyuvesi yizindleko zokuphila. Ngokwezinhlolovo ezithile, izindleko zokuhlala, ukudla, nezokuthutha zikhuphuka ngonyaka. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu kubafundi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini eziphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Abafundi abaningi baphinde bahlola izindlela zokuthola imali eyengeziwe, njengokusebenza ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ukufinyelela Ezinsizeni Ngaphezu kwezindleko, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo emanyuvesi kuyinselelo enkulu. Abafundi badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezincwadi, izikhungo zokufunda, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Nokho, ezinye izikhungo zihlala zinganikezi izinsiza ezanele, okwenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuba bafeze izifundo zabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba abafundi benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze baphumelele. Izinkinga Zokwelashwa Kwengqondo Ngokukhula kwezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo phakathi kwabafundi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Abafundi bahlushwa ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye nokudangala, okuvame ukuvela ngenxa yokucindezeleka kwezifundo, izinkinga zemali, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Izikhungo eziningi ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwengqondo, kodwa kusemqoka ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona futhi zifinyeleleka. Ubuchwepheshe Nezokuxhumana Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabafundi basemanyuvesi. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kwe-COVID-19, izikhungo zemfundo zishintshe indlela yokufundisa, zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kulethe izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudalile izinselelo ezintsha. Abafundi badinga ukufunda ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, futhi abanye bahlushwa ukungabi nekhono lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi bukhulu kakhulu empumelelweni yabo. Abafundi badinga ukuxhumana nabafundisi ukuze bathole usizo, izeluleko, kanye nokukhuthazwa. Izikhungo eziningi ziqhuba izinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, okuhlanganisa imihlangano, izifundo ezikhethekile, kanye nemicimbi yokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakathi komphakathi. Izinhlelo Zokuxhasa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokubolekisa imali, izikhuthazo zokufunda, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Abafundi badinga ukwazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga, futhi izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zifinyeleleka kalula. Isiphetho Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu, futhi izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo zidinga ukunakwa. Ngokuqhubeka kokukhula kwezindleko zokuphila, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakathi komphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele, izikhungo zingasiza abafundi ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini imisebenzi eyinhloko yezinkampani zobuchwepheshe? Imisebenzi eyinhloko yezinkampani zobuchwepheshe ibandakanya ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhiqizwa, nokuhlinzekwa kwezixazululo zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhilela izinto eziningi, njengesoftware, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ze-inthanethi. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Google ne-Microsoft zisebenza ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezokuxhumana kuya kwezobuciko bokufunda (artificial intelligence). Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe emhlabeni wamanje? Ubuchwepheshe bulethe izinzuzo eziningi, ezifana nokwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ukwenza imisebenzi ibe lula, nokusheshisa inqubo yokuthola ulwazi. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze abantu benze imisebenzi ethile, futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyehlukile ezinkampanini zobuchwepheshe ezinkulu? Izinkampani ezinkulu, njenge-Apple ne-Amazon, zihluke ngokuthi zinezimali ezinkulu, izinsiza, kanye nezikhala zocwaningo olukhulu. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, benze ucwaningo olunzulu, futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimfuno zemakethe. Izinselelo zabo zifaka phakathi ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezincane ezithuthuka ngokushesha. Umbuzo 4: Ukubuyekezwa kwemikhiqizo yokuthengisa kuyini, futhi kungani kubalulekile? Ukubuyekezwa kwemikhiqizo yokuthengisa kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ihlangabezana nezidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukwethembeka kwabathengi futhi kuhambisana nemithetho nemigomo yokusebenza. Izinkampani eziphumelelayo zihlala zihlola impendulo yabathengi ukuze zithuthukise imikhiqizo yazo. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zinezibopho zomphakathi? Yebo, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zinezibopho zomphakathi. Zidingeka ukuba zisebenze ngendlela ethinta kahle umphakathi, ziqinise imithetho yokuziphatha, futhi zisebenzise izinsiza zazo ukwenza izinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukweseka imfundo, ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle emvelweni, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufinyelela kulabo abangenayo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe? Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nokuphepha kwedatha, ukugcina imithetho yokusebenza, nokuncintisana okuqinile. Ukuphepha kwedatha kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukuvikela ulwazi lwabathengi bazo. Ukwenza lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela. Umbuzo 7: Kungani izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emnothweni? Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emnothweni ngoba zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zithuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ukuvuselelwa kwezobuchwepheshe kudala amathuba amasha, kuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, okwandisa umnotho jikelele. Umbuzo 8: Yini okuthandwa kakhulu kubathengi emikhiqizweni yezobuchwepheshe? Abathengi bathanda imikhiqizo ethuthukisiwe, elula ukuyisebenzisa, futhi enezici ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Umsebenzi wokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe bokufunda, kanye nezinqubo eziguquguqukayo zenze imikhiqizo ibe neqhaza elikhulu kubathengi. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Samsung ne-Apple zikhokhela imakethe ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Umbuzo 9: Ukuzibandakanya kwezinkampani zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini kubaluleke kangakanani? Ukuzibandakanya kwezinkampani zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini kubalulekile ngoba kuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nabathengi. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, kwenza izinkampani zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula okuthuthukisiwe. Izinkampani ezikhuthaza umphakathi zikhulisa ukwethembeka kwabathengi. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, sizobona ukuthuthuka okukhulu ezindabeni ezifana ne-artificial intelligence, i-blockchain, nezixazululo ezihlakaniphile. Lezi zinto zizothuthukisa indlela esiphila ngayo, sikhuluma, futhi sikhokha. Ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwezobuchwepheshe kuzokwandisa amathuba, nokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Ngamafuphi, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emhlabeni wethu, zikhuthaza ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ziba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni nasemiphakathini. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani nabathengi kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa eliyinqaba.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Indaba Yomlando Ningizimu Afrika, izwe elinothile ngempilo yalo, linomlando omude nowenhle, owakha isimo somnotho esihlukahlukene. Ukuze siqonde isimo samanje somnotho, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, ezabeka isisekelo sokwakheka kwalesi simo. Umlando wezimali waseNingizimu Afrika uqala ngenkathi yeMibuso, lapho izwe laziwa khona ngempela. Ngalesi sikhathi, umnotho wawususelwa kakhulu emasimini nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Abantu bendawo, ikakhulukazi amaXhosa, amaZulu, nabanye, babephila ngokubamba izinkomo, ukulima, nokuhweba. Lezi zindlela zokuphila zabeziqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni ibhekelele izidingo zayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi nekhulu le-19, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka. Ukuvela kwezimboni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokumbiwa phansi, kwashintsha kakhulu isimo somnotho. Abathengisi bamaNgisi nabaJalimane baqala ukufika, belethe ubuchwepheshe obusha nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimayini, ikakhulukazi ezimayini zegolide nezinsimbi, ezase zaba yizinsiza ezibalulekile emnothweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhweba kwangaphandle kwanda, kwenza ukuthi izwe liqhamuke njengomholi emkhakheni wezinsiza. Kodwa-ke, lokhu akuzange kube ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezenhlalo, okubangelwa uhlelo lwe-apartheid, kwashiya abanye abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kokungalingani okukhulu, okwakha izithiyo ezinzima emnothweni. Ngemva kokuphela kwe-apartheid ngo-1994, izwe labhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ukubuyiselwa kwezinsiza ezithile, kanye nokwakha umnotho onobulungiswa, kwaba yinjongo enkulu. Uhlelo lwezokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho lwakha izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi engaphansi, kodwa izinselelo zazingapheli. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwezimali ezibolekiwe, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, zaba yizinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwe laqala ukuhamba phambili. Ukukhula komnotho kwanda, nakuba kuncane, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi zathuthukiswa. Izimboni ezinjengokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokukhiqiza zathuthuka, futhi izwe laqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namanye amazwe. Ibhizinisi elincane naphakathi laqala ukuvela, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Kodwa-ke, izinselelo zazingapheli. Ukungalingani kwezomnotho, ukwehla kwemali yokutshala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, zaba yizithiyo ezinkulu. Ukukhula kokuphila, okukhula okukhulu, kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu abaningi bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuphila engaphansi. Namuhla, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sithinteka kakhulu izinguquko zomhlaba. Ukuvuselelwa kwemithombo, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umnotho onobulungiswa, zikhona. Abantu bahlala bephokophele ekwakheni umnotho onobulungiswa, kodwa izinselelo zikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika uzobe usendleleni yokuvuselela, kodwa izinselelo eziningi zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bathola ithuba lokukhula nokuphila kahle. Umnotho ungathuthuka kuphela uma wonke umuntu ebamba iqhaza, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela nokubambisana. Ngakho-ke, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa indaba yokubambisana, izinguquko, nezinselelo. Ngaphandle kokubheka emuva, kufanele siqonde ukuthi umnotho ungaba yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukubambisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezinhle zingasiza ekwakheni umnotho onobulungiswa, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bonke. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umnotho awuwona umgomo, kodwa yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ekuqaleni, emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwakuhlala abantu abanothando olukhulu lwezinyawo. Le ndawo yayigcwele abalandeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa bonke babebambisene ngokuthanda ibhola. Phakathi kwalesi sikhala, ubuso babantu babugcwele injabulo njengoba bephakamisa izimpahla zabo zeqembu. UThabo, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nane, wayengumlandeli ophakeme weqembu leMkhumbane United. Wayenothando olujulile lwezinyawo, futhi wayejabula kakhulu lapho edlala ibhola emgwaqweni. Ngaphandle kokuba umgibeli omuhle, wayephinde abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekubukeni imidlalo yeqembu lakhe. Njengoba imidlalo ibiqhubeka, uThabo wayehlala efika ngaphambi kwesikhathi, elindele ukuzwa umsindo weqembu lakhe elibhalwe phansi. Ngolunye usuku, umphakathi wahlangana ukuze ubuke umdlalo obalulekile phakathi kweMkhumbane United neMafikizolo FC. Umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, abalandeli bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane ezazithokozisa. UThabo wayephakathi kwabo, ebona ubuso obujabulayo babangani bakhe, uSipho noNandi. Umdlalo uqale, umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, uThabo wababona umgibeli weqembu lakhe, uMthethwa, edlula abadlali beMafikizolo FC. UThabo wayezwa inhliziyo yakhe iphuphuma, umoya wakhe ugcwele ithemba, ekhala, “Uzozama, Mthethwa! Uzozama!” Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, kodwa ngesikhathi sokuphela, uMafikizolo FC wathola ithuba lokuphosa ibhola emgibeleni. UThabo waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ethukile, “Hamba, hamba!” kodwa ibhola laphuma emgibeleni. Umdlalo waphela, kwaba umphumela ophakathi. Ngemuva komdlalo, abalandeli babebonakala bejabulile, kodwa uThabo wayephawuleka ethukile. “Sizobuyela, sizobuyela!” kusho uSipho, eduduzela uThabo. “Kukhona imidlalo eminingi ezayo, sizokwenza kahle.” UThabo wathokozisa, wathola ithemba, futhi waba nesithakazelo sokubuka imidlalo ezayo. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, waqhubeka nokubuka imidlalo, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe nabangani bakhe baphumelela. Uthando lwabo lwezinyawo lwabashintsha, lwabavumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo. UThabo wathola ukuthi abalandeli bebebalulekile, hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasempilweni yabo. Ngonyaka olandelayo, uMkhumbane United wathola ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. UThabo, uSipho, noNandi babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane, bephakamisa izimpahla zabo. Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, umoya ophakeme, umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umdlalo waphela, futhi uMkhumbane United waphumelela. UThabo waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ejabulela, “Siphumelele! Siphumelele!” Abalandeli babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane. UThabo wathola ukuthi uthando lwezinyawo lwalungaphezu kokudlala ibhola; kwakuwukuhlanganyela, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola ukuthi abalandeli bebebalulekile empilweni, futhi uthando lwabo lwezinyawo lwalungaphezu kokudlala ibhola. UThabo noSipho noNandi bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane, bephakamisa izimpahla zabo, bejabulisa umoya omuhle phakathi komphakathi. UThabo wathola ukuthi ibhola lalingaphezu kokudlala; kwakuwukuhlanganyela, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuwumcimbi obuhlungu, obuholela emiphumeleni emibi ezimpilweni zabantu abancane. Lokhu kuhlukunyezwa kungaba ngezindlela ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, nangokocansi. Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu, zifaka phakathi izimo zomndeni, izinkinga zomnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ukuze siqonde kangcono le ndaba, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, imiphumela yakhona, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela izingane kulokhu kuhlukunyezwa. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kubonakala njengokubopha, ukuhlinzwa, noma ukuhlinzwa okungafanele. Lezi zenzo zihlala zenzeka emakhaya, lapho izingane zihlala khona nabazali noma abakhulisa. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kuvame ukuhamba ndawonye nokuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo, lapho izingane zihlukunyezwa ngemicabango emibi, ukwehliswa, noma ukungabaziswa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izingane zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni, okuhlanganisa ukungathembi, ukwesaba, nokuba nobudlelwano obunzima nabanye. Ngokwengeziwe, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ngokocansi kubonakala njengomsebenzi ophikisana nemigomo yokuziphatha, okuholela ekutheni izingane zibe nezinselelo ezinzima zokuphila. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi akuhlanganisi kuphela izenzo eziphikisana nomthetho, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa nokungabi nendaba nokuphathwa kabi kwengane. Lezi zenzo zibhubhisa imizwa, ziphazamise ukukhula komqondo, futhi zishiya izingane zinesizungu esinzima. Imiphumela yokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ibonakala emiphumeleni eminingi ehlukene. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zihlala zikhathazekile, zinezinselelo zokukhula, futhi ziba nezinselelo zokuphila ezinzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphazamiseka emiphakathini, okubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta umphakathi wonke. Ukuze siqedele le miphumela emibi, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthathe izinyathelo ezinqala zokuvikela izingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abazali nabasebenzi bezempilo mayelana nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa komphakathi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Izikhungo zokuxhasa zingaba nesandla esikhulu ekusizeni izingane, zinikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukubhekana nemiphumela yokuhlukunyezwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwezingane kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezibambisene zokuvikela izingane, eziqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula zikhululekile, zikhululekile, futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akukhona nje kuphela ukwephula umthetho, kodwa kuyaphula amalungelo abantu abancane. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokuvikela izingane, ukuze zikwazi ukukhula zikhululekile futhi ziphile impilo enempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile, ukuze siqedele le nkinga engathandeki, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula zikhululekile, ziphilile, futhi zinekusasa eliqhakazile.
Amatekisi: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhamba Amatekisi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba emadolobheni nakwezinye izindawo, abamba indawo enkulu ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Ukuphuma emsebenzini, ukuya ezikoleni, noma ukuhamba ngezizathu zokungcebeleka, amathuba okusebenzisa amatekisi ayanda. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekubalulekeni kwamatikisi, izinzuzo nezinselelo zawo, kanye nezici ezithinta izinkonzo ezitholakalayo. Ukubaluleka Kwamatekisi Amatekisi anikeza indlela elula, esheshayo, futhi ethokomele yokuhamba. Ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamahlathi noma ezikhungweni eziningi, amatekisi akhombisa ukwanda okukhulu kokuhamba. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqasha izimoto noma ukuthola izindawo zokupaka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi avumela ukuhamba okukhululeka, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhamba ezisheshayo. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Amatekisi Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa amatekisi wukuthi akudingeki ukuba umuntu abe nemoto yakhe. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumuntu ongenayo imali yokugcina noma osebenza edolobheni elikhulu, lapho izindleko zokuphila zikhula. Amatekisi akhombisa ukuphuma okuhle kokuhamba, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo eziningi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomgwaqo. Ngokwezinye izinhlelo, amatekisi ahlinzeka ngezinsiza ezenzakalelayo, njengezinhlelo zokubhalisela ukuhamba. Lokhu kukhombisa ukusebenza kahle, njengoba abahambi bengakwazi ukuhlela izikhathi zabo kahle.
