Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ophusile ngokubheka imililo yasendle, bese sithathwa izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ukuze kulawulwe imiphumela yayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziqhubekayo ezizokwakha indlela yokuphila engcono, ngenkathi sikhumbula ukubaluleka kwalesi simo sezemvelo. Ekugcineni, imililo yasendle yisici esibalulekile semvelo, okwazi ukusiza ukukhulisa izindawo ezithile, kodwa kudingeka ukuba sibe nezinqubo ezivumelana nezimo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela emibi iyancipha. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe ngabakhathaleli bemvelo, sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imililo yasendle iyasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, igcine ibhalansi yemvelo, futhi ikhulise ukuphila kwabantu nezilwane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuphila okungcono, okuvikelwe ngokuhlonipha imvelo yethu, ukuze sithole injabulo yokuphila emhlabeni.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Uhambo Lwakhe uSipho USipho, oneminyaka engama-22, uvezile ukuthi impilo yentsha yamanje ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokungasebenzi. Udlule ebunganeni obuhle, kodwa umgwaqo wakhe wokuqashwa ungaphansi kwemithwalo emikhulu. Uhlanga lwakhe, oluthokozisayo, luveza ukukhathazeka okukhulu okukhona enhliziyweni yakhe. Wazalwa eMgungundlovu, uSipho uqale ukufunda ezikoleni eziphakeme lapho abekhuluma khona ngemicabango emihle yokuphila. Wenza kahle ezifundweni zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezemfundo kanye nesayensi. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, umndeni wakhe wawethemba kakhulu ukuthi uzothola umsebenzi osheshayo. Nokho, kwaba nzima, njengoba umnotho wesifunda wathinteka kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuphothula iDiploma yakhe, uSipho waqala ukufuna umsebenzi. Wathumela izicelo eziningi, waphendula izikhangiso eziningi, futhi even ecela ngezikhala ezikhona, kodwa ukuphendulwa kwakhe kwakuncane. Lokhu kumshiya ebonakala engaphelelwe yithemba, ebona abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bephumelela, kanti yena eqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya. U-Sipho uyazi ukuthi ukungasebenzi akukhona okwenza umuntu ungabi nalutho, kodwa kumphatha kabi. Waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokwakha imisebenzi emisha, ehamba emihlanganweni yentuthuko yomphakathi, efunda izindlela zokuzimela. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukamvimba, kodwa kumenze waba nesineke. Uthi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi kukhona amathuba. Kumele ngihambe ngayo le ndlela, ngingavumi ukudikibaleka.” Esikhathini esingamashumi amabili, uSipho wathola ithuba lokufunda umsebenzi wezandla, lapho abekwazi khona ukukha imikhiqizo yezandla. Lokhu kumenze wathola imali encane, kodwa okukhona okukhuthazayo. Waqala ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yakhe emakethe, kanti abathengi baqala ukubona ikhono lakhe. Kodwa ebuka phambili, uSipho uthi: “Ngifuna okungaphezulu. Ngifuna ukuba nebhizinisi elikhulu.” Ngenxa yokusebenza kanzima, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuqala ibhizinisi lakhe, elibhekiswe ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yensimbi. Uthathe isinqumo sokuthola uxhaso oluncane, waze wathola abakhethiweyo abamtshela ukuthi baphakamisa izinhlelo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi lakhe laqala ukwenyuka, kanti abanye abasha abavela emiphakathini yabo bakhuthazeke Ngolwazi lwakhe. U-Sipho usebenza ngokucophelela, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukuthola umsebenzi akuwona umgomo kuphela. Ufumene umqondo wokwakha umphakathi onempilo, wabelana nabo bonke abasha abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo. Ube nesifiso sokwakha uhlelo lokweseka abasha, ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho ufinyelele kulokho ayephupha ngakho. Uthole ithuba lokukhuluma emicimbini ehlukene, enza izethulo ezimnandi ezikhuthaza abanye. Ukukhuluma kwakhe kugcwele amandla, futhi umoya wakhe wokuphila ubonakala kuwo wonke umuntu. U-Sipho uyazi ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukungasebenzi okukhathaza, kodwa umoya wokufunda, wokwakha, nokuzimisela ungakwenza umehluko omkhulu. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi noma kuhlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, nokusebenza kanzima kuzokwazi ukweqa lezi zinselelo. Ikusasa lentsha, uSipho uthi, likhulu kakhulu kunokungasebenzi. Ngamafuphi, uSipho usikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ingaba yinhle, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezithile zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi sikhumbule ukuba silwele impumelelo yethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, uSipho ubonisa ukuba nokhohlwa kwempilo, uboniswa njengomholi wesizwe esisebenzayo, eshaya umoya omusha ebantwini, abasha, nempilo. Izenzo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukungasebenzi okukhathaza intsha, kodwa ukuthi impilo ingavuma uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela empumelelweni, futhi uSipho ubonisa lokhu ngokuphila kwakhe kwansuku zonke.
ISOMISO: UTHINTWA KAHLE KWABANTU NEMVELO Ngonyaka wezi-2023, isimo sezulu sithole ukugxekwa okukhulu njengoba isomiso sithinta izindawo eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Izifunda ezahlukene ziqhubeka nezikhathi zoshintsho olukhulu lwezimo, kanti abaninimzi bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemvula. Isomiso sitholakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezingasogwini, lapho imvula ingase ibonakale kanzima. Lokhu kudalwa yizimo ezihlanganisa izinguquko ezinkulu zokushisa, ukulahleka kwemithombo yokuphuza, kanye nokuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwezolimo. Ezimweni lapho izivunguvungu zeshisayo zikhula khona, umphakathi ubona izindlela ezinkulu zokuphila zigcina ziziwa. Izinyoni zibhakabhaka zikanjengothuli, izilwane zibhugshelwa kuzindonga, futhi omakhelwane bahlala bebuzana ngempilo. Abalimi babona ukuthi izitshalo zabo azikhamile, kanti izitshalo ezindala ziba nezinhlobonhlobo ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqizwa kwezokudla, okudala umkhankaso owawuzobangela ukwanda kwezindleko eziphathelene nokudla. Okwamanje, izifunda ezithintekayo zisebenzisana noHulumeni, izikhungo zocwaningo, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kubhekwe izixazululo. Umnyango wezolimo uveze ukuthi, kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo zokubhekana nale nkinga, kubandakanya amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa ukulawulwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukusiza abalimi ngezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, nokukhuthaza izindlela zokuqhubeka nokulima ezinzile. Izidingo zokuhlala kohlanga lwezilimo zikhombisa umthwalo omkhulu. Umphakathi uyacasula ngoba izinsuku ezingenamvula zikhula zaba ziningi, futhi lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwamathuba okusebenza. Abalimi baphakathi nezinkinga zokubika izinga lokudla, bahlushwa ukucabanga ukuthi izinyanga ezizayo zizoletha ukuhamba kwempilo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukusiza umndeni, ikakhulukazi uma abanye bekhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Izinga lemvula eliphansi linyukisa ingcindezi kwezemvelo. Imithombo ethulile ngokurekhoda izinga lempilo, kuthola ukuthi izindawo ezihlukahlukene zibhakabhaka phakathi kwezimo eziphakeme zamazinga okushisa. Lokhu kuthinta ngqo wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezimbi. Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselele ezinkulu, kubalulekile ukuba bonke abantu basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezinzile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezinye izifunda ziye zaqaphela ukuphumela phambili kulokhu. Izimboni eziphathelene nezolimo zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wesomiso. Izindlela zokugcina amanzi nokusebenzisa izinsiza zokulungisa umanyolo kuboniswa njengamathuba amasha okubona izinzuzo zenhlalakahle. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amasha kulabo abaningana, kuqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo iyaphumelela. Abaphathiswa bezindawo, imiphakathi, nabalimi bahlanganyela izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezikhona. Inhloso yabo ukukhuthaza ukulima okungcono nokulawulwa komhlaba, okwenza kube nezinga elifanele lokukhula komnotho. Abalimi baphinde banikezwa ukuthola amakhono okuphatha izimo ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuvumelanisa nezimo eziguqukayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi iqhubeke nokuzigcina ikhumbula imiphumela yesomiso. Abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi isikhathi sabo sokulima asikuchithi nje isikhathi, kodwa should kube yithuba lokubona amathuba. Izivumelwano zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zingaba yisixazululo esibalulekile sokwakha imiphakathi eqinile nenempilo. Ngokuvamile, kubonakala ukuthi isomiso sizoba yinkinga eqhubekayo, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphila emhlabeni. Njengoba sithokozisa umhlaba, kufanele sicabangele izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphila. Njengabantu, kufanele sifunde ukucabanga ngokungaphezulu kokuphila kwethu, sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziwumqondo. Ngamafuphi, isomiso singaba ubunzima, kodwa akuhambisani nalokho okwakhoza. Ukubambisana kungenza izimo zibe ngcono, sithole izinzuzo ezintsha, futhi sihlinzeke ngezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukugcina imithombo yethu yokuphila iphilile. Ukugqugquzela izinhlelo ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa umqondo wobukhazikhazi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile kuzothuthukisa umphakathi. Phela, umhlaba ukhula ngendlela engama-alleys, kodwa kumele ukuvikelwe, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoqhubeka ziphila.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Umthelela Wabo Emphakathini Wamanje Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) baye baba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lezi zinsizwa nezintombi, ezikhiqiza okuqukethwe okuhlukahlukene, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo, ukusakaza ulwazi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngentokozo kubantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wabo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lomsebenzi. Ukwanda Kwezinhlobo Zokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ababhali, abaculi, abavakashi bezinkanyezi, nabadali bama-video. Ngamunye wabo unendlela yakhe yokuxhumana nezithameli, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ohlangene. Ngokwesibonelo, ababhali bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-Twitter noma i-Facebook ukuze babelane ngezindatshana zabo, kuyilapho abaculi besebenzisa ama-platforms afana ne-YouTube noma i-Instagram ukuze baveze ubuciko babo. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela wabakhiqizi bokuqukethwe empilweni yabantu ungabonakala kalula. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngentokozo, lezi zinsizwa zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni, lapho abadali bokuqukethwe bephendula khona ngokushesha ezindabeni ezibalulekile, bephinde benze izethulo ezithokozisayo ezithinta izifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezihloko ezibalulekile. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, abadali bokuqukethwe babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulu, izinguquko ezisheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezimfuneko ezinzima zokugcina izithameli zikhangekile, konke lokhu kudinga ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlale bephambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubungozi bokuphulwa kwamalungelo obunikazi kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha ku-inthanethi zikhona, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe baqaphele izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala buguqula indlela abadali bokuqukethwe abakhiqiza ngayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izinsiza zokuhlela, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bakhule futhi bathuthukise amakhono abo, benza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okuthokozisayo nokwazisayo. Ikhono Lokuxhumana Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephendula izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bahlale bexhumene nezithameli zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabadali bokuqukethwe kudala umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi, okwenza abantu bazizwe bebalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima, lapho abantu befuna ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze bazizwe bephila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadali bokuqukethwe baye baba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Umthelela wabo empilweni yabantu ubonakala ezindabeni, ezokuxhumana, nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Noma bahlushwa nezinselelo eziningi, ubuchwepheshe obusha buvulela amathuba amasha, futhi ikhono labo lokuxhumana lwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okuthokozisayo. Njengoba sithokozisa imisebenzi yabo, kubalulekile ukuqonda nokuhlonipha indima abadayisi bokuqukethwe abayidlalayo empilweni yethu yansuku zonke.
iTakealot: Indaba Yezitolo Zamanje Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile emhlabeni wezohwebo, umqondo omusha wokuthenga wavela. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elikhulu, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho abantu baqala ukujwayela izindlela ezintsha zokuthenga. Phakathi kwalezi zindlela, iTakealot yaphakama njengomholi, iqhakambisa indlela yokuthenga online ngendlela eyayingakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. UTakealot, owaziwa njengomthengisi omkhulu wezimpahla eziningi, waqala njengomqondo ophusile. Abantu abaningi babejolise ekuthengeni, kodwa bahluleka ukuthola izimpahla ezithile kalula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uTakealot waphakamisa isixazululo esisha: ukuthenga online. Lokhu kuvule amathuba amasha, kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izinto abazidingayo ngaphandle kokuphuma emakhaya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTakealot yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. Abantu baqala ukujabulela ukuthenga izimpahla ezahlukene, kusukela ezincwadini, ezemidlalo, ezokugqoka, kuya kwezobuchwepheshe. Umqondo wokuthenga online waba yinto evamile, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi ukuze bathole okuthandayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuthengiswa, futhi iTakealot yaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinto ezinkulu ziqala ngezinyathelo ezincane. UTakealot akagxilanga kuphela ekuthengeni. Waqala futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengisi abancane. Lokhu kuvule amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kwasiza abathengisi abancane ukuba bathole izimakethe ezinkulu. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu baqonda ukuthi iTakealot ayiyona nje indawo yokuthenga, kodwa iyindawo yokwakha umphakathi. Abathengisi babezithola bejabulile, okuvuse umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi. Njengoba iTakealot iqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo zayo zanda. Ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithengisa online kwaba yinto ejwayelekile. Nokho, iTakealot yathola indlela yokuhlala ibalulekile. Yaqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo, yenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izimpahla, futhi yathuthukisa izindlela zokukhokha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabathengi, abantu baqala ukuthembela kuTakealot njengomthengisi ophumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTakealot yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokulethwa. Abathengi babefuna ukuthola izimpahla zabo ngokushesha, futhi iTakealot yaphendula ngokwakha izinhlelo zokulethwa ezisheshayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izinto abazidingayo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthenga okungcono. Abantu babebona ukuthi iTakealot iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, okuvuselela isithakazelo sokuthenga. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, iTakealot yathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Abantu babebona ukuthi le nkampani iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezimpahla ezisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthenga okungcono. UTakealot waba yisibonelo sokuthi umqondo omusha ungashintsha kanjani umhlaba wezohwebo. Abantu babebona ukuthi ukuthenga online akusikho nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, iTakealot yaphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuthi izinto ezinkulu ziqala ngezinyathelo ezincane. Umqondo wokuthenga online waba yinto ejwayelekile, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulela ukuthenga izimpahla ezahlukene. UTakealot waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabambisana kanjani ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo. Ngakho-ke, iTakealot iyindaba yokuphumelela, yokubambisana, nokwakha umphakathi. Ibonisa indlela umqondo omusha ungashintsha ngayo umhlaba, futhi ibonisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle. UTakealot ungumholi, futhi indaba yayo iyakhuthaza, ibonisa ukuthi uma sithanda, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.
Umbiko: Impilo Yengqondo Yentsha - Isingeniso Impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo, esiqinile, nesikwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ezijwayelekile empilweni. Njengoba intsha ibhekene nezinguquko eziningi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa intsha ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lo mbiko uzogxila ezicini ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yengqondo yentsha, izimbangela zalesi simo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izici Ezithinta Impilo Yengqondo Yentsha Impilo yengqondo yentsha ithonywa yizinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa izimo zomndeni, ubudlelwano nabangane, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Ubudlelwano obuhle nomndeni bungasiza intsha ukuba ibhekane nezinkinga, kanti ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zengqondo. Izimo zomphakathi, ezifana nezinga lokuhlupheka, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda, nazo zineqhaza elikhulu empilweni yengqondo yentsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhona njengomthombo wezinkinga. Ukusetshenziswa kwezingxoxo zokuxhumana, izithombe, nezindaba ezitholakala ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinga eliphezulu lokucindezeleka, ukungazethembi, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhethekile ezibhekana nalezi zinkinga. Izinselelo Zempilo Yengqondo Yentsha Izinselelo ezithinta impilo yengqondo yentsha ziningi. Okwamanje, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye nokuziphatha okungafanele kuyizinkinga ezivamile. Intsha ibhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezifana nokuhlukumezeka, ukucwaswa, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlukana, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zingaholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinkinga ezinzima, ezifana nokuziphindisela, ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, noma ukuzibulala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi kubhekwe ngokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola usizo oludingekayo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuxhasa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yengqondo yentsha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufundisa intsha ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana. Izikole, imindeni, kanye nomphakathi kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza intsha. Ukwenza izifundo ezithinta impilo yengqondo ezikoleni kungasiza intsha ukuba iqonde izinkinga zayo, futhi ibone ukuthi akayedwa kulolu hlobo lwezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukufuna usizo uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, lapho intsha ingakhuluma khona ngezinkinga zayo, kungasiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Isiphetho Impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa intsha. Ngokubambisana, imindeni, izikole, kanye nomphakathi bangakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza intsha ukuba ibhekane nezinkinga zayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba bakhe impilo yengqondo eqinile, futhi bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zempilo yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise impilo yengqondo yentsha yethu.
Izikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal: Isikhumbuzo Sokuhlupheka Nokuphila Izikhukhula eKZN zibe yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini eminingi. Lokhu kuthinta imvelo kwenza kube nezindaba ezinzima nezivuselelayo. Kukhona ubuhlungu, uthando, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, ngathatha isikhathi sokubhala lokhu ukuze ngiqonde ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje kuphela njengezingozi, kodwa zikhombisa nezinselele esibhekene nazo. Zenzeka ngezinsuku ezinzima, lapho imvula ingena emanzini, ikha amanzi amaningi ezindaweni eziphakeme. Okwesabekayo ngalesi sikhathi yindlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Abangane, odadewabo, nabangani bahlala bekhathazekile, befuna indawo ephephile. Izinga lokuhlupheka lishintsha kalula, kanti abanye bahlala benqena ukuvuka kulokho okubanjwe yimvula. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje izinyembezi, kodwa zikhumbuza ukuthi ukuphila kuncike kumoya wethu wokuqhubeka. Njengoba abantu besinda ezikhukhuleni, bahlangana, benza izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha. Izikhukhula ziveza umfanekiso onzima, kodwa zikhuthaza ubumbano. Lokhu kubumbene kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuvuma, besebenzisana ukuze bakhe imiphakathi eqinile. Ngibona ukuthi iminyaka yokuphila ebusuku ibonakala empilweni yabantu. Abahlali bahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, kanti abanye bahlala benethemba lokubona usuku olukhazimulayo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi, kodwa umoya wethu uyasiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo iyinsika yokusebenza, futhi abantu baphakathi kokuphila. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima, siphinde sihlole izindlela esizisebenzisayo. Siphakamisela ukunakekela imvelo. Izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo zidingeka ukuze sinciphise imiphumela yalezi zinsuku ezinzima. Umthelela wezikhukhula awukhawulelwanga, kodwa udlula ezicini ezahlukene zokuphila kwabantu. Ngiyavuma, izikhukhula zikhumbuza izinkumbulo ezimbi, kodwa ziqinisa ukholo lwethu empilweni. Ukuhlupheka kuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, lapho abantu bevela emazweni ahlukahlukene behamba ngezinyawo. Izibonelo zomphakathi ezinhle zikhona, lapho abavakashi bahlala bechubeka bethu. Ngifisa intuthuko e-KZN. Ukuze sibe nezikhumbuzo ezinhle ngezikhukhula, kufanele sithinte izinselelo zokuvikela imiphakathi. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlungu bukhona, kodwa bangenza izinhlelo ezinhle. Ubuqotho bokubambisana, ukucabanga, nezinqubomgomo ezifanele zingasiza abantu bakhule. Ngemva kwesikhathi esinzima, umoya wezinkumbulo ulethe umuzwa wokuphila. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ubuNkulunkulu bomphakathi, obhukuza abantu ukuba babekezelele, bese bezivumelanisa nezinhlelo zempilo. Kukhona ukuphila kwemiphakathi ethe xaxa, izikhukhula zikhuthaza ucwaningo nolwakhiwo. Ngaphezu kwamazwi, zikhumbuza ukuthi ukugcina imikhuba emihle kuyadingeka. Imizamo yokwakha ibhodi lokuphila ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo. Namuhla, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aphinde athathe izinyathelo eziningi, ukuphila okwaziyo. Ngiyavuma, izikhukhula eKZN zikhumbuza ukuhlupheka, kodwa zihlala zikhuthaza ukuqhubeka. Kumele sizame lezi zinto, sizisebenzise njengomthombo wezinkumbulo. Kukhona amandla okuhlanganisa imiphakathi enothando. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula ziveza izinselele ezinzima, zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Sithanda ukubona imiphakathi ibonisa uthando oluphakeme, futhi sizokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo.
Abadlali Abasebasha: Ukuhlola Izinselelo Nezithuthukisi Zempilo Yabo Isingeniso Abadlali abasebasha bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba bephakathi kokukhula nokuthuthukiswa emikhakheni ehlukene yezeMidlalo. Lokhu kuhlola kuzobheka izinselelo ezihambisana nokuba ngumdlali omncane, izinzuzo zokubandakanyeka emidlalweni, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo. Izinsiza Zokuthuthukiswa Kwabadlali Abasebasha Ukwanda kwemidlalo ehlukene, kusukela ku-rugby, ibhola, kuze kube ku-athletics, kubonisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha bahlala benethuba elikhulu lokuthuthuka. Izikhungo zemfundo, izikole, nezinhlelo zomphakathi zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza zitholakala kalula kubadlali. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundiswa kwezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuzivocavoca, ukwakha amakhono, nokwakha umqondo ophumelelayo wokuncintisana. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nabantu Abancane Noma kunjalo, abadlali abasebasha babhekene nezinsiza eziningi ezinzima. Okokuqala, ukucindezeleka kwemfundo kanye nezifundo ezinzima kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza kwabo emidlalweni. Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi abadlali abasha bavame ukuhamba phambili emidlalweni, kodwa uma bephazamiseka ezifundweni, lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empumelelweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehla kwezinga lokwesekwa emndenini nakubangani baphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwabo. Izinzuzo Zokubandakanyeka Emidlalweni Kodwa-ke, ukubandakanyeka emidlalweni kunikeza abadlali abasebasha ithuba lokuthola izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, imidlalo iyathuthukisa impilo yomzimba, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekwakheni imisipha, ukuqina kwezitho zomzimba, kanye nokugcina isisindo esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo inikeza abadlali ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabo nabanye abadlali. Lokhu kuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana, okubalulekile empilweni yabo yonke. Ukubaluleka Kokwesekwa Komphakathi Ukuze abadlali abasebasha baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bathole ukwesekwa okuqinile komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwesekwa okuvela kumazinga ahlukene, kusukela emndenini, kubangani, nakumfundisi. Ukuze umphakathi ube nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abadlali abasha, njengezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono, izifundo zokuphila, kanye nemicimbi yokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abadlali babe nesiqiniseko sokuthi bakhona abantu ababaxhasayo, okwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Yabadlali Abasebasha Kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa impilo yabadlali abasebasha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abadlali ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile, okuhlanganisa ukudla okunempilo, ukuhlela isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, nokuphumula okwanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emidlalweni yabo, futhi baphinde bazuze impilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abadlali ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile. Ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokungabi nokuqina kwengqondo kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kokuphatha ingqondo, njengokufunda izindlela zokuphumula, kungasiza abadlali ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zabo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, abadlali abasebasha banendima ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokweseka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizwa. Ukuqonda izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, kungasiza ekwakheni abadlali abaphumelelayo, abakhula kahle, futhi abanezimpilo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi, imindeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abadlali abasebasha banelungelo lokuphila impilo egculisayo, futhi baphumelele emikhakheni yabo.
Ukuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezizathu Nezixazululo Isingeniso Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, okwaziwa ngesiNgisi njengokuthi "unemployment," kuyinkinga enkulu ebanzi emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emazweni angathuthukile. Le nkinga ibhekene nezici eziningi ezithinta umnotho, umphakathi, nezombusazwe. Ukuhlola izizathu zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze siqonde izixazululo ezitholakala ukuze siphendule lo mkhuba. Kulo mbhalo, sizobheka izizathu ezihlukahlukene zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, izimpempe ezithinta abathintekayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ekuhlaziyweni kwempilo yomsebenzi, izizathu zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi zingahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningana. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kungavela ngenxa yokushoda kwemathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi emhlabeni wanamuhla, izimboni eziningi ziye zashintsha, ziye zaphuma emsebenzini wezemisebenzi eziningi ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Izinkampani zifuna ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nokuncipha kwamathuba okusebenza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi ezidinga ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Okwesibili, izizathu zezomnotho nazo zibalulekile ekuntulekeni kwemisebenzi. Izimo zomnotho ezingezinhle, ezifana nezinga lokukhula eliphansi, ukuncipha komkhiqizo, kanye nokukhululeka kwemali, kungenza kube nzima kunezinkampani ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Lokhu kudala umthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, njengoba abantu abaningi behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele, okukhombisa ukuntula kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izici zomphakathi nazo zidlala indima ebalulekile. Ukuhlukaniswa kwempilo yomphakathi, ukuhlupheka, kanye nezinga lokufunda eliphansi kuholela ekutheni abantu bangakwazi ukungena emsebenzini. Ukuhlupheka kungenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise amakhono, okwandisa ubunzima bokuthola umsebenzi. Lokhu kudala isithombe esinzima, lapho abantu abaningi behluleka ukufinyelela emathubeni alungile. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukwazi ukubhekwa njengemphumela nje kuphela, kodwa kuholela emiphumeleni eminingi engathandeki. Okokuqala, kubangela ukwanda kokuhlupheka, njengoba abantu abaningi behluleka ukuthola imali yokuphila. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka emphakathini, okungase kubangele ukwehla kwempilo yomphakathi. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuthola, kubangela ukuncipha kokuthenga, okukhawulela ukukhula komnotho. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomuntu. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokucindezeleka, ukuphazamiseka kwempilo yengqondo, kanye nezinkinga zokwelapha. Abantu abahlala bengekho emsebenzini bavame ukuzizwa bephansi, okukhulisa izinkinga zengqondo, okungabangela ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi ezimpilweni zabo kanye nasezimfundisweni zabo, kuthinta umphakathi wonke. Izixazululo Zokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ukuze kuphumelele ekwehliseni izinga lokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zibalulekile. Ukuphucula imfundo kanye nezifundo ezihambisana nezimboni kunikeza abantu amathuba okuthola imisebenzi engcono. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono amasha, ezifana nezobuchwepheshe, zingasiza ekwandiseni amathuba omsebenzi. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo zingasiza ekuhlinzekeni ngokuqhubekayo amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma izinkampani zenza izinhlelo zokufaka abantu abasezingeni eliphezulu emisebenzini ethile, okwenza kube nokukhula kwemisebenzi. Abaholi bamasipala bangase benze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho walendawo, okuholela ekwandeni kwamathuba omsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni ungakha izinhlelo zokusekela abavela ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwabantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufundisa. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta wonke umuntu emhlabeni jikelele. Izizathu zakhona zihluke kakhulu, zihlala zixhunyaniswa nezimo zomnotho, ezomphakathi, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Ukuze siphendule le nkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithinta abantu abahlukene. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sihlose ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphelele zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi.
Ukufuduka Kwezimboni Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika: Imiphumela Nezindlela Zokubhekana Nazo Eminyakeni edlule, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa izinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi ziveza amathuba amasha. Njengomuntu ophila kuleli, ngikholelwa ukuthi le ndaba iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa kufanele sixoxe ngayo ngokuqondile, ngendlela ehloniphekile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe bayeza eNingizimu Afrika ngezizathu ezahlukene. Abanye baphuma ezimeni ezinzima, befuna ithuba lokuphila kangcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, izimpi, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho ezibuhlungu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bangena kuleli ukuze bazuze amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaneziqu ezithile noma amakhono akhethekile. Lokhu kuveza ubudlelwano obubucayi phakathi kokufuduka nokuphila kwezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kodwa-ke, ukwanda kwabantu bangaphandle kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinkinga ezithile. Abanye abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bakholelwa ukuthi ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kubangela ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhlala, kanye nokuncipha kwezinye izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungabaza phakathi kwabantu, kube nemibono eyeqisayo nokuxabana phakathi kwendawo nezihambeli. Kubuhlungu ukuthi izinkinga ezinjalo zikhuthaza imikhankaso yokwehliswa kwamahemuhemu, ebandakanya izinsolo zokuthi abantu bangaphandle baphula umthetho noma bahlala ngokungekho emthethweni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umfanekiso omubi ngabo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba sihlangane kahle. Kumele siqonde ukuthi abantu bangaphandle abaveli eNingizimu Afrika baphila njengezimpilo eziphilayo, futhi kufanele sibabheke ngeso lokhozi, sikhumbule izizathu ezingemuva kokufuduka kwabo. Ngokuqhubeka, ukwamukela abantu bangaphandle kungaba nenzuzo enkulu. Lokhu akukhulumi nje ngokwakha umnotho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe banikeza amakhono amasha, baphinde baveze izimfashini ezahlukene, izindlela zokuphila, nezinkolelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi ehlangene, lapho abantu bangafunda khona futhi benze ubudlelwano obusha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, njengamazwe, kudingeka sibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhekana nale mikhankaso. Ukuze sikwazi ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaNingizimu Afrika nabantu bangaphandle, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle, imihlangano yomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga, futhi kukhuthaze ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi uhulumeni anikele ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuvikela amalungelo abantu bangaphandle, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlinzekwa ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufuduka okukhulu, futhi kuvikela izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ekukhathazekeni okukhona. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinezinhlobonhlobo. Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle akukhona okubalulekile kuphela; kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele ubuhlakani, namathuba. Njengabantu, kufanele sihlanganyele ukuze siqonde izizathu zokufuduka, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sakhe iNingizimu Afrika engcono kulabo bonke. Ngakho, ngalolu hlelo lokubheka izinzuzo nezinkinga zokufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle, ngikholelwa ukuthi kumele sihlanganyele ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele ukunakekelana, nokuhlonipha izimpilo zomunye nomunye. Ekuvuleni ithuba lokufuduka, singenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngcono—hhayi kuphela kubantu bangaphandle, kodwa naphakathi kwethu sonke.
Isingeniso UNapoleon Bonaparte ungomunye wabaholi bezenkolo nabapolitiki abavelele emlandweni, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emazweni aseYurophu ngemuva kokuphumelela esikhathini seMpi Yenkululeko yaseFransi. Ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile, ubuchule bokuhlela, kanye nezimfundiso ezithinta umphakathi, ezakha isithombe esiqinile esihambisana nepolitikhi yaleso sikhathi. Le ndatshana izogxila emlandweni kaNapoleon, izifundo azifundile, kanye nomthelela wakhe emhlabeni. Ubuntwana Nokuqalwa Kwezemfundo UNapoleon Bonaparte wazalwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu we-1769 eAjaccio, edolobheni eliseCorsica. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, futhi ubugagu bepolitiki bempucuko yamaFrentshi bamnikeza ithuba lokuhlola izifundo eziphakeme. U-Napoleon waba umfundi ophumelelayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobudlova, lapho afunda khona izifundo ezinamandla zamasu nezombusazwe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wayesebenza njengomphakathi wezokuhlola emphakathini, okwakugqugquzela imicabango yakhe ngamasu okuphatha. Ukukhula Njengomholi Ngonyaka we-1785, uNapoleon waba yisikhulu esisemthethweni sezempi, lapho aqala khona khona ukuveza amakhono akhe okukhuluma, ahlaziye, futhi abhekelele izimo ezinzima. Ngaphambi kokuba abe umholi, uNapoleon wajabulela ukuphumelela emikhankasweni eyahlukene yezezimpi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yenkululeko yaseFransi. Kwakungaleso sikhathi lapho abe nesibopho sokubambisana nemibono yezenhlalo, kahle kakhulu emikhankasweni yokukhululwa nokuvuselela izwe. Ukwakha Umbuso Ngemuva kokuphumelela kweMpi Yenkululeko, uNapoleon waba yinjini yokushintsha kwezokuphatha eFransi. Ngo-1799, waguqula uhulumeni ngokuthi abe nguKhalipha, waphinde wethula uMthethosisomthetho kaNapoleon, owawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngemithetho eqinile nebalulekile. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuphatha lwaluhlanganisa izimfundiso zamaNgisi, izichasiso zamasiko, kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nesimo esisha sempucuko kanye nekhono lokuphathwa komphakathi. Impumelelo Nokuphumelela U-Napoleon wayaziwa njengehlakaniphile, futhi ukulawula kwakhe kwahlala kukhuthaza abanye abaholi bezenkolo nabapolitiki. Phakathi neminyaka yakhe yokuphatha, wayewuthuthukisa umnotho, ewina imikhankaso eminingi, futhi eba nomthelela omkhulu kwiGeopolitics. Uthola ukuhamba phambili kwiMpi yeNapoleonic, lapho wayehola khona amabutho amaningi, okwakuholela ekudlondlobeni kwezifundazwe eziningi. Isimo sakhe sokuphatha sathola ukunconywa ezindaweni eziningi, kepha kwazalwa nezinselelo ezithile. Ukwahlukaniswa Nokuphela Nokho, impumelelo kaNapoleon ayizange iphelelwe isikhathi. Ngemva kokuhluleka emkhankasweni wakhe eRussia ngo-1812, izinkinga zokuqala zempilo zenzeka. Ngemuva kwezimpi eziningi, wathola ukuhluleka eWaterloo ngo-1815, lapho kwaholela ekuthumeleni kwakhe eSt. Helena, isiqhingi esisemhlabeni ngaphansi kwelwandle. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokucabanga nokuhlanza, lapho uNapoleon wakhumbula ukuhluleka kwempilo yakhe, kodwa wakhombisa isithunzi esikhulu. Isiphetho UNapoleon Bonaparte ungumuntu omkhulu emlandweni, ongase asibonise izifundo eziningi kumphakathi waseYurophu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuphatha, izinqumo azithathile, nezifundo azitholile, zenza kube sobala ukuthi ubuholi bezepolitiki buxhomeke emkhankasweni wokuzethemba, ubuchule, kanye nezifundo eziphuma ezimweni ezinzima. U-Napoleon ungumfanekiso ohlangene wezinto ezinhle nezimbi ekuphatheni, futhi umthelela wakhe kuzo zonke izinkanyezi zomhlaba uqhubeka nokuhlola izinkolelo zomphakathi nomlando.
Isingeniso INingizimu Afrika, ezweni elinamasiko nezemidlalo anothile, ibonakala njengezwa elihloniphekile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ebholeni. Ibhola, okwaziwa njenge "football" emhlabeni jikelele, liyinsika ebalulekile yokuhlanganyela komphakathi, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuphakamisa impilo enhle. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswa ngezinga lawo, izifunda, kanye namasiko ahlukene, okuveza izimpawu ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa Kwamathimba Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika akhiwe ngamakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa amaqembu amakhulu njengeKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns. Lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngaphakathi kwePremier Soccer League (PSL), okuwumjaho ophakeme kakhulu ezweni, futhi anemlandvo ocebile, enezinhloso zokuphumelela ezihambisana nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona amaqembu amancane asezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, asebenzela ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wendawo. Izimpumelelo Nezinselelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhudlwana phakathi kwamakilabhu kudala umoya ophilayo emidlalweni, kodwa kuholela nezinselelo ezifana nokuphathwa kwemali, ukushoda kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaqembu abeke izinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha ukuze aqinisekise impumelelo ezingeni eliphezulu. Izimpawu Zamasiko Ibhola akusikho nje ukuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi kuyinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika adlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umoya wokuhlanganyela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Izinsuku zokudlala ziba yizikhathi ezibalulekile zokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze basekele amaqembu abo, okuvusa umoya wobumbano. Ukwakhiwa Kwezemidlalo INingizimu Afrika iyaziwa ngempumelelo yayo emkhakheni wezokwakha, okubukeka ngokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezinkulu zokudlala, njengeFNB Stadium neMoses Mabhida Stadium. Lezi zikhungo zikhangisa izenzakalo ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa imidlalo ye-World Cup, okuveza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elikhiqizayo emkhakheni wezokwakha. Imiphumela Yezokukhuthaza Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumakilabhu, ibhola linomthelela omuhle ekukhuthazeni impilo. Amaqembu amaningi akha izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, ezifaka ukufundisa abantwana ngempilo enempilo, ukwakha izikhungo zokuzivocavoca, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, ahlinzeka ngempumelelo, ubudlelwano, kanye nezinsiza ezithinta impilo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamaqabane, izinhlelo zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo kubalulekile ukuze amaqembu akwazi ukuhamba phambili emkhakheni wezokwakha. Njengoba ibhola liqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhola lihlala lihlaza, lishisa, futhi linethemba.
Ama-Drone: Izinkanyezi Zesibhakabhaka Kwasekuqaleni, emhlabeni omncane ohlangene nezinsuku ezimnandi, kwavela umqondo omusha. Umqondo owawubizwa ngokuthi “ama-drone.” Lawa ma-drone, ayebukeka efana nezinyoni ezincane ezindizayo, ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu babebuka phezulu, benethemba lokuthi lezi zinto eziphilayo zizobasiza ezimpilweni zabo zansuku zonke. UThandi, umphakathi omncane ohlala edolobheni elisemaphandleni, wayenothando olukhulu lokuhlola. Wayejabule kakhulu uma efunda ngezobuchwepheshe, futhi ngesikhathi ethola ithuba lokusebenzisa i-drone, wathola umuzwa omusha. UThandi wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi lezi zinto ezindizayo zingamphatha kanjani. Ngakho, wathola i-drone encane, eyayihamba phansi kancane, kodwa yayinekhono elikhulu. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wanquma ukuba ahambe nendiza yakhe ye-drone. Waqala ukuyindiza phezulu kwezintaba ezisemhlabeni wakhe. Njengoba i-drone yakhe yandiza, wahamba phansi, ebona izitshalo ezihlaza, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nezilwane ezithokozisayo. Kwakukhanya kakhulu, futhi uThandi waba nomuzwa wokuthi uzokwazi ukubona izinto eziningi ngendlela engeke ayicabange. Njengoba i-drone yakhe iqhubeka nokundiza, uThandi wabona umfula omkhulu, ogcwele amanzi acwebile. Wathola ukuthi i-drone ingathola izithombe ezinhle kakhulu, futhi wayefuna ukwabelana ngalezi zithombe nomphakathi wakhe. Wabhalela abahlobo bakhe, ebachazela ukuthi lezi zinto zingamphatha kanjani, nokuthi kufanele bazame ukuyisebenzisa. Ngesikhathi edlula ezindaweni ezahlukene, uThandi wathola ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu bokuqala baphendula ngezithombe, bethi bayawathanda. Kwakukhanya ukuthi uThandi wayesebenzisa i-drone yakhe ukuze abone izinto ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi wayefuna ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ukuze asize abantu. Waqala ukucabanga ngezindlela ezahlukene ama-drone angasebenza ngazo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu. Wafuna ukuba abantu baseThandeni bazi kahle ukuthi ama-drone angasiza kanjani emiphakathini yabo. Wabiza abantu abaningi, wathi bazobona ukuthi ama-drone angathola izithombe ezinhle, futhi angasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokubona lezi zinto ezindizayo. Ngelanga lomcimbi, abantu bahlangana, behleka futhi bejabula. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yabo. Waqala ukwakha umbono, wathi: "Bheka, ngizokuthumele i-drone phezulu, ukuze ubone konke okuthokozisayo." Abantu babebukeka bejabulile, behamba phansi, bephakamisa izandla zabo. UThandi waqala ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bangasebenzisa kanjani ama-drone. Wabakhombisa ukuthi bangathola izithombe ezinhle, futhi bangawasebenzisa kanjani ukuthola izinsiza. Kwakukhanya ukuthi abantu babezofunda okuningi, futhi uThandi waba ngumholi omuhle. Njengoba i-drone yakhe ibhampa phezulu, wayebona abantu behleka, bejabule, futhi bephokophela phezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlangana nabantu abaningi ababephila ezindaweni ezahlukene. Wafunda ukuthi ama-drone angasiza ekuphatheni izinhlelo zokudla, ekuboniseni izinkanyezi, nasekutholeni izinsiza ezisemqoka. Abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zinto ezindizayo zazingaba usizo olukhulu empilweni yabo. UThandi wayengakaze acabange ukuthi ama-drone azoshintsha impilo yakhe, kodwa manje wayebona ukuthi lezi zinto zazingamphatha kahle. Waqhubeka nokufundisa abantu, ebakhuthaza ukuthi baphinde bazame. Kwakukhanya ukuthi uThandi wayethanda ukwazi, futhi wayefuna abantu bakhe bazi kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseThandeni waba ne-drone eqinile. Abantu babebona izithombe ezinhle, futhi baqala ukuhamba phansi, bejabule. UThandi waba ngumholi, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise ama-drone ukuze bathole izinsiza ezisemqoka. Kwakukhanya ukuthi lezi zinto zazingasiza abantu, futhi uThandi wayejabule kakhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zinto zazingasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza, futhi zazingasiza ekutholeni izithombe ezinhle. UThandi waba umholi omuhle, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise ama-drone ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseThandeni waba ne-drone eqinile, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ezindizayo. UThandi waba umholi, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono, bejabule, futhi bephokophela phezulu. Kwakukhanya ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu, futhi uThandi waba umholi ophumelelayo, umholi wezinkanyezi zesibhakabhaka.
UMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umlando Nomthelela Wakwakhe UMangosuthu Buthelezi ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Uzalwe ngomhla ziyi-27 kuNhlangulana ngo-1928 eBabanango, eKwaZulu-Natal. UButhelezi uphumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wezombusazwe, waba ngumholi weqembu le-Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni isimo sezombusazwe esikhona namuhla. Umlando Nokukhula UButhelezi wakhulela emndenini wezobukhosi, njengoba uyindodana kaNkosi uMathole Buthelezi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola ithuba lokufunda e-United Kingdom, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo zezeMpi nezeZombusazwe. Ubuye waba ngumfundi ophumelelayo eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abaholi bezombusazwe abanjengoNelson Mandela noOliver Tambo. Ipolitiki Nezombusazwe UButhelezi waba umholi we-IFP ngonyaka ka-1975, futhi waqala ukulwa ngokumelene nezinhlelo zokubusa ezaziphakanyiswa nguMkhonto weSizwe, inhlangano ye-ANC. UButhelezi wagxila ekwakheni umphakathi ohlukanisayo, owawuhlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu baseZulwini. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni umthetho we-Black Consciousness Movement, owawuhlose ukwakha ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu abamnyama. Ukwamukela Izinguquko Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-apartheid, uButhelezi wanikela ngempumelelo ekwakheni izivumelwano zokuthula phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC. Waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthethosisekelo wezwe, futhi waba nguNgqongqoshe wokuqala wezasekhaya. UButhelezi waqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu baseZulu ayavikelwa, futhi waphinde waba nesandla ekwakheni uhulumeni wezwe. Umthelela Womphakathi UButhelezi ungumholi onemibono ehlukene, futhi ubonakale esebenza ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezahlukene, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezinjengokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuthutha. UButhelezi ubelokhu eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, uButhelezi ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi emlandweni wakhe. Ubuye waba neqhaza ezinkingeni zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC, lapho kwavela khona ukungaboni ngaso linye. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpini ezinzima, ezashiya umphakathi unokuhlukana. Nokho, uButhelezi ubelokhu ezama ukuthola izixazululo, futhi ubelokhu esebenzisa izinkulumo zokuthula ukuze ahlukanise abantu. Isiphetho UMangosuthu Buthelezi ungumholi onemibono ehlukene, ohlonishwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezombusazwe, kanye nemizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi, kuhlonishwa ngababukeli abaningi. Noma kunezinkinga ezibhekene naye, uButhelezi ubonakala engumholi onomthelela omkhulu, futhi imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika iqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa, umbono kaButhelezi uzohlala unomthelela, futhi uzofundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngokuqhubeka kokubambisana nokwakha umphakathi onobumbano.
Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi: Ukuhlola Uhlelo Olusha Lokufunda Kulezi zinsuku, imali yokufunda ihamba phambili ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene. Enye yezi zindlela ezithandwayo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabafundi, iwukufunda nge-inthanethi. Le ndlela yokufunda iyakhanga futhi iyahambisana nezidingo zesikhathi sethu samanje, ikakhulukazi njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Kulokhu, sizobheka ukufunda nge-inthanethi ngokubona okwehlukeneyo, izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenzisa le ndlela. Ukwethula Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungenye yezindlela eziphawulekayo emakolishi nasezikoleni. Lolu hlelo lwakha ithuba lokufunda ngemfundo ngokusebenzisa amahlelo e-inthanethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba abafundi bangenza izifundo zabo bahlala bezazi ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuhlonzwe kahle, kulungile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuhambisani nekhono lokufunda kuphela, kodwa futhi kushayelela abafundi ukuba basebenzise izinsiza eziphathelene nezimfundo ezikhona ku-inthanethi. Izinzuzo Zokufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokufunda nge-inthanethi ukukwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza eziningi. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufundiswa ithuluzi elisha lesimanje – i-inthanethi – ngokusebenzisa imithombo ethile efana nezifundo ezikwividiyo, izincwadi ze-elektroniki, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda. Lokhu kukhulisa umngani abangawutholi uma befunda ngendlela yephephabhuku noma ezikhungweni zomfundo. Ngokwengeziwe, okufundwayo ku-inthanethi kudinga ukuzikhandla kakhulu. Abafundi banikwe ithuba lokuphendukela emithonjeni engcono ukuzibonela. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokufunda ngoba bangakhetha lokho abakuthandayo. Njengoba abafundi besebenzisa imeyili, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemicimbi yeziqu, bangafunda babe nezifundo ezikhethekile kalula, bheka uhlelo lwabo futhi bathole izimpendulo ezithile. Izinkinga Ezingavela Ngokufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Noma kunjalo, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunezinselelo zayo. Enye yezi zinkinga ezidumile ukuthi abafundi bangenza ukungasebenzi kahle njengoba bekhuthazwa ukwazi ukusebenza ngebhodi yokuxhumana. Ukungabi khona komphakathi wesikole, okuyikhulu elikhulu, kungabanga khona ukuthi abanye abafundi bazizwe begqokile kakhulu. Ukusetshenziswa koshintsho lwezinhlelo zokusebenza nazokuxhumana kungenza kube nzima bacacise imiqondo ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithunzi yamakhono ephezulu iyadingeka ukuze ufunde kahle kulezi zimo. Abafundi badinga amandla okuphatha isikhathi, ukugxila, nokuphendula imibuzo ezothusayo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela cishe okungaphezulu kunokufunda okwenzeka endaweni yebhodi. Ukwengeza: Izingxenye Zokwenza Imfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ikhule Ukuze uthole impendulo efanele kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bakhuthazwe ukuba badlule imikhawulo, bakhulise amazinga abantu abahlinzeki, futhi benze izivumelwano ezihambelana nezinhloso. Ukuze kube nezifundo eziphumelelayo, kuhloko ezimeni ezikhethekile, kuyasiza ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinqunyiweyo, kugcizelelwe abaphathi bezemfundo. Uhlaka olusebenza kahle kumele luhlanganise zokugcina uhlanga lwezimo ezahlukene nabafundi. Njengoba imfundo ye-inthanethi ikhulisa amathuba, kumele kube kube nesikhathi sokuxhumana nokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, ukuze kudaleke indawo yokufunda eqinile. Umqondo Wokugcina: Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Njengemfundo Ephuhlisayo Ekugcineni, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungaphathwa njengendlela ethokozisayo yokufunda, eyandulelayo ekufundeni kwabafundi namuhla. Njengoba sivele besithole izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, kufanele sihloniphe ukukhetha ubuchwepheshe esibutholayo. Kumele silungise izifundo zethu ukuze sikhulise ukukhula kwethu siqhubeke nobunjalo obuphumelelayo. Ngalo mkhuba, le ndlela yokufunda uzokhulisa umfundi, imfundo yethu namuhla iyinsika yokuhlela impilo yazo zokuyivuma emiphumeleni engokwenziwa. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyithuba elimangalisayo, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle ngayo yonke imikhakha yempilo.
UNovak Djokovic: Umphakathi Wokudlala Itennis Emhlabeni UNovak Djokovic, umdlali odumile we-tennis, wazalwa ngoJulayi 22, 1987, eBelgrade, eSerbia. Uhlanga lwakhe luhlanganisa izimpande zamasiko aseYurophu, kodwa impilo yakhe ibingeyona eyomndeni kuphela, futhi ibingeyona eyomphakathi. Wakhulela ezweni elibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, kodwa lokhu akukavumi ukuvimba ekufezekiseni amaphupho akhe. Umdlalo wakhe we-tennis waqala esencane, lapho enza khona izifundo ezijabulisayo, efuna ukufunda umdlalo. UNovak wathola uthisha odumile, uMarjan Vajda, owamsiza ukuba aqonde kahle imithetho ye-tennis nokuthi angathuthukisa kanjani imidlalo yakhe. Ngemva kokuzikhandla, uNovak waqala ukujabulisa izithameli ngezindlela zakhe ezihlukile zokudlala, ezamthuthukisa ekubeni isikhumbuzo emlandweni. Ukunqoba kwakhe kokuqala kwenzeka ngo-2003, lapho enqoba umqhudelwano we-ATP e-Amersfoort, eNetherlands, okuwukuhamba kwesinyathelo sokuqala endleleni yakhe yokuba ngumdali ophumelelayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uNovak waqhubeka nokukhula emkhakheni we-tennis, wathola iziqu eziningi ezibalulekile, kuhlanganise neGrand Slam, okuyizindlalifa ezinkulu zomhlaba. Umdlalo wakhe ubukeka unamandla, ubonisa ubuchule obuphezulu, kanye nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2011, uNovak wathola impumelelo enkulu, waba ngumdlali wokuqala ukuncintisana noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal, abanye bama-greats emlandweni we-tennis. Uqhubekile nokudlala kahle, wathola iziqu eziningi, futhi waba nguMphakathi Wokudlala Itennis. UNovak ubonisa isibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela, okwenza abanye baphuphe ngempumelelo efana neyakhe. Ngaphezu kokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, uNovak ubonisa uthando lwakhe emiphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi izingane, ngokusebenzisa imifundaze yakhe. Uhlanganisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa imfundo, impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uNovak akagcini nje ngokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu onomoya omuhle, ofuna ukusiza abanye. UNovak Djokovic akafuni ukuba umphakathi umcabangele njengomuntu ophumelelayo kuphela, kodwa futhi njengomuntu onobuntu. Uhlonipha imindeni yakhe, abahlobo, nabalandeli, futhi ubona ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuhlonipha kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhliziyweni zabantu, futhi uNovak ubonakala engumuntu osebenzayo, onobuhlakani, futhi onobuqotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNovak uqhubeka nokukhula, efunda ezintweni ezintsha, futhi eqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umdlalo wakhe. Uhlale eqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi akavumi ukuhamba phansi. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwenza ngcono, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uNovak ungumuntu onomoya wokuphumelela. UNovak Djokovic ungumlingani omkhulu, umphakathi, nomphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela ngamakhono, kodwa futhi ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlala unethemba. Ubonisa ukuthi noma ngabe izinkinga zikhona, kungenzeka ukufinyelela phezulu uma umuntu ezikhandla futhi enza imizamo. UNovak uhlala engumfanekiso omuhle, owaziwayo, futhi ophumelelayo, futhi umphakathi uhamba phambili, uqhubeka nokukhula, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe kanzima. Ngokuphetha, uNovak Djokovic ungumuntu owaziwayo emhlabeni, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ungumuntu ophilayo, onothando, futhi onomoya omuhle. Uhlale efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi akavumi ukuhamba phansi. UNovak ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela ngamakhono, kodwa futhi ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlala unethemba. Ngalokhu, uNovak Djokovic uyisibonelo esihle sokuphila, sokusebenza kanzima, nokuhlala unethemba, okwenza abanye baphuphe ngempumelelo efana neyakhe.
Izimfihlo Zokukhiqiza Kwakhanya ilanga elihle eMkhumbane, idolobha elincane elaziwa ngempumelelo yalo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza. Abantu babejabulile, behlabelela izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezisemkhathini, kodwa empeleni babezama ukwakha impilo engcono. UJabulani, umkhiqizi ophumelelayo wezinto zokwakha, wayaziwa ngempahla yakhe ethi "Ithuba Lempilo," eyatholakala ezitolo eziningi. Nakuba uJabulani ephila impilo ejabulisayo, wayenobunzima obuthile. Ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola ukuthi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina ibhizinisi lakhe liphila. Wazama ukuthola izixazululo, kodwa izinkinga zazimjolisa kakhulu. UNandi, umngani wakhe, wamsiza wathi: "UJabulani, kungani ungazami ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha? Kukhona izinto ezithuthukisiwe ezizokwenza umsebenzi wakho ube lula." Lokhu kwavula umqondo kaJabulani, kodwa wayengazi kahle ukuthi angazithola kuphi. UNandi, onobuchwepheshe, wathola ithuba lokumfundisa. Baphuma ndawonye, behamba ezitolo ezithengisa imishini yokukhiqiza. UJabulani wathola imishini ethuthukisiwe, njengezinsiza zokwakha ezisebenza ngogesi, ezamsiza ukukhiqiza kalula. Ngemuva kokuthola le mishini, uJabulani waqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezamnika ithuba lokulawula ukukhiqiza kwakhe ngokuphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi lakhe laqala ukuhamba kahle; izindleko zokukhiqiza zancipha, futhi umkhiqizo wakhe wathandwa kakhulu. Abantu baseMkhumbane babebona izinguquko ezinkulu, kanti uJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, waqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo zokufundisa abanye abantu bendawo ngezindlela zokukhiqiza, efuna ukuthi bonke bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu baphendula kahle, futhi izifundo zakhe zaba yimpumelelo. U-Jabulani wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abakhiqizi emkhakheni, behlangana emhlanganweni wezokukhiqiza, lapho bekhuluma khona ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa imboni. UJabulani wabelana ngempumelelo yakhe, futhi abanye bakhiqizi bamthokozisa. Waqonda ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha amathuba amasha. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uJabulani wathola ithuba lokwakha inhlangano yokukhiqiza eMkhumbane, eyayihlose ukusiza abakhiqizi abancane, ibanikeze amathuba okukhula. Waba ngumholi walesi sikhungo, waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waqala ukuhamba phambili. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uJabulani wathola umklomelo wezokukhiqiza, okwakuwumsebenzi omkhulu, futhi abantu baseMkhumbane babemjabulisa. Waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe, uma buhlanganiswa nomphakathi, bungakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Wazi ukuthi impumelelo yakhe yayingenxa yokubambisana, futhi wathanda ukusiza abanye. Ekugcineni, uJabulani waba yisithombe sokuphumelela eMkhumbane, efunda ukuthi ezokukhiqiza akukhona nje ukukhiqiza kuphela, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Wazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza, kodwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bukhulu kakhulu. UJabulani waphila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJabulani wathola ithuba lokuhamba emhlabeni, efuna ukufunda okwengeziwe. Wafika ezindaweni ezahlukene, efunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhiqiza, wabuyela eMkhumbane ethwele izifundo eziningi, waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula. UJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe, ubudlelwano, kanye nomphakathi kungenza kube nokwenzeka. Wazi ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. UJabulani waphila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yisithombe sokuphumelela. Izimfihlo zokukhiqiza zaba yimpumelelo, futhi uJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izinguquko ezinkulu.
Ukufunda nge-Inthanethi: Amandla Nokuhlupheka Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekubhekwa njengendlela esheshayo, elula, neyokufinyelela ulwazi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, imfundo iye yathola izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela kubafundi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene, izizinda ezahlukene, kanye nemigomo eyahlukeneyo. Kodwa, kulokhu kukhululeka, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezibalulekile okufanele sizicabangele. Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo zokufunda nge-inthanethi. Le ndlela ifaka phakathi ukufinyelela kolwazi oluningi, lapho abafundi bengakhetha khona izifundo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe kuya kwezobuciko. Lokhu kungenza abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile, bephuma emikhawulweni yezikole ezivamile, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Ngokufanayo, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kukhulisa ukuhwebelana kolwazi, njengoba abafundi bengakha ubudlelwano nezifundo, othisha, nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhululekile kubo bonke. Abanye abantu basahlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukufinyelela okuphansi ku-inthanethi, izinsiza ezibizayo, kanye nolwazi olungavumelekile. Lokhu kudala umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwabafundi abavela ezindaweni ezithuthukile nabavela ezindaweni ezisafufusa. Ukungabi nalwazi olufanele lokusebenzisa izinsiza ze-inthanethi, njengamathuluzi okuxhumana, kungaholela ekunqandeni amathuba okuthola imfundo. Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi, uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo zendabuko, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu kumfundi. Abafundi badinga ukuba nokuqonda okuhle kokuhlela isikhathi sabo, njengoba izikhala zikhona zokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kudinga ukuzibophezela okukhulu, futhi abanye bangase babe nezinselelo ekugcineni umgomo wabo. Ngakho, ubuchwepheshe buza nezidingo ezithile ezithinta abafundi, futhi umbono wokuthi bonke bangakwazi ukufunda kahle nge-inthanethi awuphumeleli. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinkinga, ukugqamisa imfundo efinyelelekayo kungenzeka kube kuhle. Ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle ekufundeni nge-inthanethi, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo eziphathekayo, ezihlinzeka ngensiza yokuqeqesha, nezinsiza ezingabizi. Abafundi badinga izinsiza ezithile ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zindlela, futhi lokho kuzosiza ekunciphiseni umehluko phakathi kwabafundi. Ngokuqhubeka, udinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akupheli nje ekufundeni okuthile. Lolu hlobo lokufunda luhlanganisa nezinye izici, njengokuxhumana nabanye, ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile, nokwakha amakhono amasha. Abafundi bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinkundla zokufunda, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze bakhe umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imfundo nge-inthanethi ingumkhiqizo owawuhlanganisa umphakathi, hhayi nje ukufunda okungaboni ngeso lengqondo. Ekugcineni, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kulethe ithuba lokukhula, kodwa kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo oqinile wokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezanele, ukuqeqesha, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzodinga imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabafundi uqobo. Uma singayifinyelela le miphumela, singenza ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube yindlela eyinhloko yokufinyelela imfundo, okuzosiza ukufezekisa amaphupho emisha nezifiso zabantu abaningi. Ngakho, njengoba sithuthukisa le ndlela yokufunda, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza, sithuthukise, futhi sithole izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufunda okuqhubekayo. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuphatheki kahle, kodwa uma sihamba sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa imfundo yethu, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
USteve Jobs: Umholi Wobuchwepheshe Nezinguquko USteve Jobs, igama elaziwa emhlabeni wonke, ungumuntu obalulekile emlandweni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengomfoundi we-Apple Inc., uJobs waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, efana ne-iPhone, iMac, ne-iPad, eyashintsha indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezobuciko, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho imikhiqizo yakhe ibonakala njengemigqa yokuhola. UJobs wazalelwa eSan Francisco ngo-1955, wakhulela eMountain View, eCalifornia. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, waqala ukufunda eReed College, kodwa waphuma esikoleni ngemva kokuhamba unyaka owodwa. Lokhu akukaze kumphazamise, ngoba wathola ithuba lokusebenza ne-Atari, inkampani edume ngogesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJobs waqala ukwakha izinjongo zakhe, wathola umngane wakhe uSteve Wozniak, owaba yisibambiso esikhulu ekwakheni i-Apple. Ngonyaka ka-1976, uJobs noWozniak basungula i-Apple Computer, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, baqhamuka ne-Apple I, umshini wokuqala wabo. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphumelela kwabo, kodwa uJobs akazange ayeke lapho. Ngonyaka ka-1984, wakhuluma ngempumelelo ye-Macintosh, umkhiqizo owawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okungcono kumsebenzisi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, njengoba iMac yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhompyutha. Nokho, impilo kaJobs ayizange ibe lula. Ngonyaka ka-1985, wakhishwa kwi-Apple ngenxa yokungavumelani nezinhlelo zenkampani. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, kodwa uJobs akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokwakha, wathola iPixar Animation Studios, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela amafilimu anjenge "Toy Story," okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo emisha. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uJobs wayengumuntu ongenamkhawulo, owayezimisele ukufuna izixazululo ezintsha. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, uJobs wabuyela kwi-Apple ngo-1997, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela kabusha inkampani. Waqala ukwakha imikhiqizo emisha, efana ne-iPod, iTunes, ne-iPhone. Lezi zinto zashintsha umkhakha wezokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezobuchwepheshe. UJobs wayaziwa ngokuqonda kwakhe okukhulu kwezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kwaba yisizathu sokuphumelela kwe-Apple. UJobs wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, kodwa futhi wayenobuntu obukhulu. Waziwa ngokuba nekhono lokukhuthaza abantu, nokubakhuthaza ukuba benze kahle. Wayekholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube lula, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha imikhiqizo yakhe. UJobs wayenobuhlakani bokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe nobuciko, okwenza imikhiqizo yakhe ibonakale kahle futhi ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngeshwa, uSteve Jobs washona ngo-2011, kodwa umthelela wakhe usaqhubeka. Imikhiqizo yakhe isaqhubeka nokushintsha izimpilo zabantu, futhi izifundo azishiye emhlabeni zihlala zikhumbuleka. UJobs waba yisibonelo sokuthi umbono, ukuzikhandla, nokungapheli ekufuneni izixazululo ezintsha kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSteve Jobs uzobonwa njengenye yezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha kanjani umhlaba, uma enomgomo, umbono, kanye nesifiso sokwenza okuhle. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza yokuphila, hhayi nje umkhiqizo. USteve Jobs, ngempela, ungumholi ophawulekayo, futhi umhlaba uzohlala ukhumbula igama lakhe.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwemininingwane: Ukubaluleka Kwezinqubo Zokuvikela Emhlabeni Oshintshashintshayo Njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane (cybersecurity) sekuba yisihloko esibalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Abantu baye besebenzisa izinsiza eziningi ezikwi-inthanethi, okukhulisa izingozi zokuhlaselwa kwemininingwane. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye baphendule ngokushesha ukuze baqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yabo. Ezinsukwini ezedlule, izigameko zokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber zikhule kakhulu, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu ezifana ne-Equifax ne-Sony zibhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphepha, zikhombisa ukuthi akukhona abantu kuphela abajwayelekile abathintekayo, kodwa nezinkampani ezinkulu zidinga ukuvikela imininingwane yazo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuvikela imininingwane, ezifaka phakathi izinqubo zokuhlola, izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsiza zokufundisa abasebenzi. Ukwanda kokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kubonisa ukuthi izindlela ezivamile zokuvikela, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezilula, azisasebenzi. Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-ML (Machine Learning), ukuze zikwazi ukubona izingozi ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izigebengu ze-cyber zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha nezihlakaniphile ukuhlasela izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane akuyona nje indaba yezinkampani ezinkulu. Abantu ngabanye badinga ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi. Ukusebenzisa amagama ayimfihlo aqinile, ukugwema ukwabelana ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu, kanye nokuhlola izilungiselelo zokuphepha kumadivayisi, kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela imininingwane yomuntu. Uhlelo lwezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, kusukela ekuhloleni izingozi, ukwakha izinqubo zokuvikela, kuze kube sekuphenduleni ezinhlekeleleni. Ukuhlola izingozi kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezithintekayo, nokuthi iziphi izingozi ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale zihlola izinhlelo zazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Ukuhlela izinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula, kanye nokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe, kuzosiza ekunciphiseni umthelela wezingozi. Ukuvikela imininingwane akukhona nje umsebenzi wezinkampani, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, izinqubo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukuvikeleka okudingekayo. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu nababhali bezinqubomgomo baqonde ukuthi ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane akukhona nje umsebenzi wezinkampani ezinkulu, kodwa kuyisidingo somphakathi wonke. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izingozi ezihambisana nakho nazo ziyaqhubeka nokwanda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, ezihlanganisa wonke umuntu, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Ekugcineni, ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yethu kumele kube phezulu ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile.
I-Microsoft Iqhubeka Nokuhola Emhlabeni Wezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft, inkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, iqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izinkonzo zayo, imikhiqizo, kanye nezinhlelo zayo. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ibonakale ibalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzisi bayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe be-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenziseka kalula. Ukwanda Kwezinsizakalo Zokuxhumana Ngokukhula kokusebenza kwabantu emakhaya, iMicrosoft ibuyekeze izinsizakalo zayo zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi i-Microsoft Teams. Le nsiza isetshenziswa kakhulu ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezinkampanini, nakwezinye izindawo zokusebenza. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ikhiphe izici ezintsha ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kweTeams, okuhlanganisa izinketho zokuhlanganyela ezithuthukisiwe, izinkulumo eziphumelelayo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphatha imihlangano ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa uxhumano phakathi kwabantu, nokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imihlangano, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi abantu bakuphi. Ubuchwepheshe be-AI Obusha Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMicrosoft ibonakale ikhuluma kakhulu ngentuthuko ye-AI. Ngonyaka ka-2023, inkampani yethule izinhlelo ezintsha ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-AI ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo yayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa i-AI ye-Office 365, eyenza kube lula ukuhlela imibhalo, ukwenza iziphakamiso, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe be-AI buyasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi yansuku zonke ibe lula, futhi lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bathola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Izinhlelo Zokusebenza Ezithuthukisiwe I-Microsoft ibilokhu ibhekelela izidingo zabathengi bayo, futhi lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo zokusebenza. I-Windows 11, esanda kukhishwa, ibonisa izici ezintsha ezithuthukisa ukusebenza, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlanganisiwe, izinketho zokuhlela ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezici zokuphepha eziphezulu. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bathola isipiliyoni esihle, esiphephile, futhi esisebenziseka kalula. Ukugxila Emphakathini Ngaphezu kokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo, iMicrosoft ibuye ibonakale igxile emiphakathini. Inkampani ibambelela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. I-Microsoft ikhiphe izinhlelo zokuxhasa izikole, izinhlelo zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono, okuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhula futhi busebenze kubantu bonke, hhayi kuphela kubantu abathile. Izifundo Zokuphumelela Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ibonakale ibalulekile ekwakheni izifundo eziphumelelayo. Inkampani ibambisene nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlomula ngempumelelo ezinhlelweni zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono, izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi abasha. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba iMicrosoft iqhubeka nokuhola emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka. Inkampani ibonisa ukuzimisela kwayo ekwakheni izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo ezithuthukisiwe, ubuchwepheshe be-AI, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft izoba yinkampani ebalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinguquko zayo ziyaqhubeka nokuthinta izimpilo zabantu. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhula, busebenze, futhi bukhuthaze abantu abaningi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithuthukisiwe. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni Kwakuyisikhathi esinzima endaweni yaseSiyaphambili, lapho abantu bahlushwa khona yizinkinga ezinzima. Izinkomo zokuqala zanjwe ziba zinhle, kodwa abantu bezwa ukuthi izinto ziya zibi empilweni yabo. I-hulumeni wabo, obekulungela ukuletha ushintsho, wabe usuhamba emnyango wezinto ezimangalisayo. UThandi, intokazi encane ke, wayehlala nomama wakhe, uMabuyi, endaweni ethokozisayo. UMabuyi wayethanda ukusikhumbuza uThandi ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kuzodinga ukugqugquzela, kodwa uthando lwenkululeko belungakazukanga. UThandi waqala ukufunda izindaba zabantu abahluphekayo, ababejola kuMabuyi bezama ukuthola indlela yokuphila. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wezwa indaba ethusayo. Umnuz’Bheki, ongumholi wendawo, wayesendleleni yokucekelwa phansi ukubusa kwezakhamizi. Ngemuva kokukhuluma nomama wakhe, uThandi wathola ukuthi umnuz’Bheki wayekhipha imali emikhakheni yokwakha izikole nezibhedlela. Imali leyo yayimfushane, isikhangiso sikhulu sezakhamizi, kodwa umnuz’Bheki wayezama ukuzithokozisa ngokwakhe. UThandi wayezwa isikhulumi sikaMabuyi emkhulumeni wokuthi “Uma kudlula isikhathi, izinkanyezi zikhanya njengoba uhulumeni enza izinto ezimbi.” UThandi wachaqiswa, ngoba wayecabanga ukuthi imisebenzi yokwenza izinsiza ezidingekayo izoba nobungane banoma iyiphi inkampani. kodwa umnuz’Bheki wathola ukuthi kwakukhona indlela yokugadla. Lokhu kuphinde kahle kephululwa umoya. UThandi wathola ukuthola amakhasi amabili ezinyangeni ezilandelayo, eqhubeka enza izifundo ngezakhamizi, izinkampani nezinsiza ezichithwa nguMnuz’Bheki. Wayefuna ukuqonda indlela ezinkampani ezisebenza ngayo, abazithokozisayo, nokuthi lezi zinsiza zungele ziphumelele kubantu abahlaba, izimfuno ezithile, kumkhakha omncane omdala. Ngemuva kokuhlola, uThandi uthola izinto ezikhulu. Abantu ababezasizwa bejola, bese ziphumelela uma kuziwa emayaleni. Kwakukhona izincwadi zomthetho ezazicebile, zithi “masiphike lapho kudinga ukuba sithathe isinyathelo.” UThandi wanquma ukuthatha isinyathelo. Wayezothi ngempilo yakhe, ukuze abelane ngalezi zindaba ezinzima. Owayengumngani kaThandi, uSipho, wayebonakala emnandi. UThandi wathembisa uSipho ngokusetshenziswa kwalezi zindaba, ukuze abambisane ekuthatheni izinqumo zamasiko. USipho wayenamahloni, kepha uThandi wamncoma. “Uma siholwa, kufanele siqiniseke ukuthi sithola ithuba ukuyalela, lokho kuzojabulisa abantu.” UThandi wakhumbula isisho sakhe sokuthi “ukubhalwa kwemiyalezo yangempela kudinga ukuzithokozisa.” UThandi noSipho bahamba edolobheni ukuyovakashela izinhlelo zomphakathi. Bafika emhlanganweni, lapho abanye babehamba bangazi noma baskhuluma phakathi. UThandi wenza izicucu ezinhle, futhi wakhuluma ngokukhanya. Belle ngekwazi ukuhlunga abanye, bahlala behlangana. Ngemva kokubamba iqhaza, abakhuluma bakhuluma njengobuhlungu, baphila imizamo. UThandi waguqula izindatshana ukuze ababe kumele bancike. Imali yenkohlakalo yenza kube nzima, futhi abantu babezizwa bekhululekile. Kusukela kulobo su, uThandi wahamba edolobha, ehamba phakathi komphakathi, eyaziqhenya okuphamukayo kwentuthuko. Akubanga nzima kuThandi ukuba qaphela, izinhlelo zomphakathi ezikhuluma ngezinkinga zebhizinisi. UThandi wagcizelela ukukwaziwa kahle kwezinhlelo ezikhalela ukuphikiswa. Izigaba zatholakala, ziqhuba izinsiza eziphoqelelayo. Ekuhlangabezaneni nemiphakathi, uThandi wezwa nothando lwezinhlelo ezipheleshi. Umphakathi waba esijabulisayo, lowo esahamba phambili, wawukhumbula umyalezo wakhe. “Iziele, we must choose wisely” – akusebenzi uma siphalazela. Bazama ukuziphilisa endaweni ebukeka ijwayelekile, kodwa umnyango ukhuluma ngezinsiza ezakhe, unalo umoya oya phambili. Ekujuleni kwemini, uThandi wakwazi ukuthola imiphakathi, ebuka phansi, ebuka izinkanyezi. Izinhloso zabantu zazibalulekile, kodwa wayezwa ukusaba kwemali. Ukubambisana nezinkanyezi kubo kuzokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Lokhu kw bonwa nakuqala. UThandi wabona izinyathelo zikaMabuyi zikhanye ensizayo. UThandi noSipho baba izigebengu, babekhombisa indlela yokuphila. UThandi wahamba phambili, izinjongo zabantu zazikhanya, kepha eyombono yezehlakalo yayingahlonishwa. UThandi wanikela njengoba abanye bephakamisa imigudu. Ukukhanya kwakukhanye, waphinde waqonda okufanele. Ubulili, kanye ithemba, byazi ngawe. Ezimnqubweni uThandi, wahamba ubuso nemigaqo eyaziwayo, wahlola indlela yokuhamba. Ukubuyiselwa kwemigudu kumphakathi kuphinde kwaze kwanda. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wazi kahle, wayzithokozisa ngokwakhe, wathi: “Hamba phambili, hamba, hamba lapho abantu behamba.” Phakathi kokuphazamiseka, uThandi wakhumbula sinje nokuthanda ezinhlewazweni zomoya. Ukwazi ukuthi isihloko sathathwa ubuthongo, isikhathi eside. UThandi waqonda ukuthi i-hulumeni wafika ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezezeni.
