Umbuzo 7: Kukhona yini imiphumela emihle engavela ekukhuleni kwezindleko zokuphila? Ngaphandle kwemiphumela emibi, kukhona imiphumela emihle engavela. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokuphila, ukuqhamuka kwezinkampani ezintsha, nokukhula kwemakethe yokuhweba. Lokhu kungenza abantu bancintisane, futhi kube nezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kwezindleko kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo eziphusile, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zomphakathi. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezizathu ezithile zokukhathazeka? Kunokukhathazeka okuningi okudingekayo ngalesi sikhathi. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kungakhanyisa izinkinga ezinkulu, ezinjengokungalingani komnotho, ukungabikhona kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezibucayi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhamba phambili, futhi kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi babone lezi zinkinga futhi benze izinqumo ezinhle. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kulokhu? Izifundo ezitholakala kulokhu kubalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda okujulile kwezindleko zokuphila nokuthi ziqondanisa kanjani nezimo zomphakathi. Okwesibili, abantu kumele babe nekhono lokuphila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, imiphakathi kumele ibambisane futhi ihlanganyele ukuze ithole izixazululo ezinzima. Umbuzo 10: Yini okubalulekile ekupheleni? Ekupheleni, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinselele enkulu, kodwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, kukhona nethuba lokuthi izinto zingathuthuka. Ukubambisana, ukusiza, nokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo kulabo abadinga usizo kungenza kube nokwenzeka. Kumele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, sithumele izwi lethu, futhi sithole izixazululo ezithinta wonke umuntu. Isiphetho: Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuphakamisa izinkinga eziningi, kodwa ngokubambisana singathola izixazululo. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi umphakathi unamandla. Ngakho, kumele sihlanganyele, sibambisane, futhi sikhuthaze ukuhamba phambili ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.
iTesla Ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezikhiqiza amandla emhlabeni, kwavela inkampani eyayizoshintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngemoto. Le nkampani, eyaziwa ngokuthi iTesla, yayingathandwa kuphela ngenxa yokusebenza kwayo, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokubuka kwayo phambili. Ngonyaka ka-2003, u-Elon Musk, umphakathi wezemali owaziwayo, wathatha isinqumo sokwakha imoto engasebenzisi uphethiloli. Ngalesi sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bezimoto ezisebenza ngogesi besiqala ukuthandwa, kodwa u-Elon wayefuna okuthile okungaphezu kwezinto ezilula. Wayefuna ukuhlinzeka imoto engahambisani nezinto ezinjengokungcoliswa komoya, futhi enezinga eliphakeme lokusebenza. Kwathi uma iTesla iqala ukukhiqiza imoto yayo yokuqala, i-Tesla Roadster, umhlaba waphenduka. Le moto yayiwumsebenzi ohlakaniphile, eyakhiwe ngensimbi eyinqaba, futhi ikwazi ukuhamba amakhilomitha angama-390 ngaphandle kokukhokha. Abantu baqala ukuthakazelela lezi zinguquko, benza iTesla ibe isithombe esisha sokuhamba. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba phambili, iTesla yathola izinselelo eziningi. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezikhiqiza uphethiloli zazikhathazekile ngokushintsha kwezomnotho ezazizovela. Kodwa u-Elon Musk wayenamandla okuphikisa. Waqhubeka nokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, wengezelela nezinhlelo zokukhucululwa kwama-battery ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni ne-Tesla Model S, imoto eyayikhipha umoya opholile, ngaphandle kokukhipha imfucumfucu. U-Elon, ongumholi onenhliziyo, wayengavumeli izinkinga zimbambezise. Waqhubeka nokwenza ubuchwepheshe bukhule, ehlanganisa izici ezintsha ezifana nezinhlelo zokukhiya ezizenzakalelayo nemoto ethola amandla emoyeni. I-Tesla yathola ukuqashelwa okuhle, futhi abantu baqala ukuvikela imvelo, beqonda ukuthi kungaba khona indlela yokuhamba ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yikhwalithi. Njengoba imoto yokuqala ye-Tesla igxilile ekwakheni izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, uthando lwemoto olwahamba phambili lwakhula. Abantu abaningi bashintshe izimfanelo zabo, besukuma ezitimeleni nasezindaweni zokubasa, bejabulile ukufaka i-Tesla empilweni yabo. Isehlakalo sokwakheka kwemigwaqo eyenzelwe lezi zimoto, nesikhumbuzo sokuthuthuka kwedolobha, sathuthukisa umnotho, sazi ukuthi umhlaba ususwa phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTesla yaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimfanelweni zomhlaba. Abantu baqala ukufunda ukuthi izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi zingaba yisisombululo esingcono kwezokuthutha, futhi nezinkampani ezinkulu zavuma ubuchwepheshe obusha. I-Tesla yaphenduka uphawu lokuzinikela emhlabeni ophilayo, komphakathi ozinikele ekulondolozeni isimo semvelo. Ngemuva kokuthi iTesla ibhalwe emlandweni, u-Elon Musk waba uphawu lwezinguquko. Wazama ukuhamba phambili, ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Uhambo lwakhe lwemvelaphi lwaba yinsika yokuthola izixazululo ezizothuthukisa umhlaba. Ubuchwepheshe be-Tesla buye bukhula, bukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba ungathuthuka uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. U-Elon Musk, ngezimoto zakhe, waqhubeka nokushaya umoya opholile, ethungatha phambili, ebamba izinkanyezi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqonda ukuthi iTesla akuyona nje imoto; kuyindlela yokuphila, umqondo ohlanganisa umhlaba ozinikele emvelweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo we-Tesla waba isibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu benza izinqumo ezizinzile, bangashintsha umhlaba. I-Tesla yaveza ukuthi izinguquko zingavela, ziqhamuke ezindaweni eziphakeme, kodwa zidinga unyawo oluqinile lokukhuthaza. Kusukela kulokhu, kwavela umphakathi ophilayo, ofuna izinto ezingcono, olandela izinyathelo ezithile. I-Tesla yabe isiqhubeka nokugcina umoya wokuthuthuka, ikhuluma ngezindaba zezobuchwepheshe, nezinto eziphilayo ezithuthukile. U-Elon Musk wayenqaba ukuhamba emuva, ehamba phambili, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngothando emhlabeni. Ekugcineni, iTesla yaphenduka isibonelo esiqinile sokuthi, uma abantu besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, bangashintsha umhlaba. Le ndaba, eyayiqala emsebenzini, yaba yimpumelelo eyaziwa emhlabeni wonke. U-Elon Musk wakhumbula ukuthi impumelelo ayifiki ngaphakathi komshini, kodwa ikhuluma ngothando nesimilo somuntu. Ngaleyo ndlela, iTesla yabe iyisiteshi sokuzinikela, esikhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe nezinkinga, benza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi Emphakathini wethu, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile kakhulu. Lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubunye bethu, ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza ukuhlanganyela. Ngiyavuma ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi, njengemikhosi, izinkonzo, nemihlangano, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ngokokuqala, imicimbi yomphakathi iyindlela yokuhlangana. Lapho abantu behlangana, baphila izikhathi ezinhle, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla lapho abantu behlukaniswa kakhulu ngenxa yezobuchwepheshe. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvumela abantu ukuba babe nesithakazelo esikhulu emiphakathini yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobunye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni isiko. Izinkolo, imikhosi yamasiko, nemicimbi yokugubha izinsuku ezibalulekile zikhombisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza abantu ngezimpande zabo, ziqinisa isiko, futhi zifundisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Ngaphandle kwemicimbi, isiko lingase liphume emoyeni, futhi abantu bangase baphuthelwe ithuba lokwazi nokuhlonipha imvelaphi yabo. Ngokubheka emicimbini ethile, njengezinkonzo zomphakathi, sithola ukuthi zikhona izinzuzo eziningi. Lezi zenzakalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bephila ngokuhloniphana. Imicimbi efana nezinsuku zokubonga, imikhosi yokuhlonipha abaphumelelayo, noma imihlangano yokuxoxisana ngezinkinga zomphakathi, zonke zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nesibopho emiphakathini yabo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emibi uma ingaphathwa kahle. Ukuhlukaniswa kwabantu, ukungaboni ngaso linye, noma ukungabi nendlela yokuxhumana kahle kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemicimbi. Kubalulekile ukuthi imicimbi ihlelwe ngendlela efanele, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ebalulekile. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, noma isimo somnotho, kubalulekile ukuze imicimbi ibe yimpumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba yithuba lokukhuthaza izinhlelo ezinhle. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangase bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa, izinhlelo zokwelapha, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezemidlalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bephila kahle futhi bejabule. Ngokuphetha, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobunye, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlanganyela, sabelane ngezikhathi ezinhle, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi imicimbi yethu ihlelwe kahle, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ebalulekile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ongcono, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza emicimbini yomphakathi. Hlanganyela, thokozisa, futhi ube yingxenye yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Imicimbi yomphakathi akukhona nje kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi yindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga.
uMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umholi Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule UMangosuthu Buthelezi, omunye wabaholi abavelele emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ubalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Uzalwe ngomhla ziyi-27 kuNdasa ka-1928 eMgungundlovu, ubaba wakhe uMphenyane Buthelezi wayengumholi wesizwe samaZulu, umama wakhe uMaMeyi engumama womdabu. Ukuze kuqondwe ubukhona bakaButhelezi, kubalulekile ukufanisa imvelaphi yakhe somdabu kanye nesimo sezepolitiki esangizayo phakathi nezinsuku zeNtshonalanga. Ngokuhamba kwemihla, uButhelezi waba ngumsunguli weZULU, okuyinhlangano eyasungulwa ngo-1975. Le nhlangano, eyayihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane sahamba phambili ezinyathelweni zomphakathi. UButhelezi wathola ukuyisiza le nhlangano ukuze iqinise umehluko phakathi kweZizwe zamaZulu nezinye izizwe. Njengomholi, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubelokhu engumqondo ophambili wezombusazwe, enza ukukhuluma ngezimvo zakhe ngokukhululekile. Kukhona imikhawulo engokwenkolo eyabe ingekho emthethweni, nolimi alulwanga, okwakubizwa ngokuthi ubuvila kwezombusazwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ubukhona bukaButhelezi babukhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezazingathinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindleleni zamakholwa. UButhelezi wayenelisa ukuba nesibindi ekuphikeni kwemithetho eyayizama ukunciphisa amalungelo abantu. Emzini, uButhelezi waphendula njengezwi labantu, ebonisa izibopho zakhe kumasiko amancane, kanye nomlando wokuhlala nabanye abaholi. Njengomholi weZULU, waqinisekisa ubuqotho bendabuko nemigomo yezomthetho. Phakathi kwezinselelo ezazibhekene nabo, uButhelezi ubebonakala enomsebenzi owagqugquzela, uhola izichibiyelo ezazihlosiwe ukuze kuphumelele ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuphakamisa umoya wokuqonda, uButhelezi wayekhuluma ngekusasa elifanele labantu. Kule mikhiqizo eyamukelwa ngekhulu, izinqumo ezithathwe uMangosuthu Buthelezi zashintsha umqondo wesimanje osesimweni sezombusazwe. Noma kungathi abanye abantu befanekisela ukudideka, uButhelezi uyaziwa ngokucaca kwakhe. Kungakhathaliseki amathuba, ugqugquzela ukuba abasebenzi baphumelele ezindaweni zabo, baphinde bakhuthazwe. Ubuthelezwa bukhombisa impendulo ethile esigabeni esinzima phakathi nezinsuku zakho. UButhelezi ungomunye wezinhlelo ezihlonishwayo, kodwa zonke zikhombisa umoya wakhe wokwandisa uhlelo oluthile ngezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukholo lwakhe olungapheli ekwakheni isizathu sokugcina lobu buthelezwa. Ngokubheka emuva kulokho uMangosuthu Buthelezi akwenze, kuhlanganiswe nezimfanelo zakhe ezivelayo njengomholi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uthando lwakhe lokukhuluma nokukhuthaza abanye kungenzeka kube yimpilo yakhe. Ubuqotho bakhe bungumbonisi emphilweni yengqondo. Kodwa, ungase ubone ukuthi umbuzo wokhetho unika impinduka ekubeni izinkampani ezincintisana ngenhloso yokwakha isimo esisha ziqhubeka nokwakheka. Umthelela kaButhelezi emlandweni uzohlala ukhanya, ngaphandle kokuphikisana nomphakathi. UButhelezi wandisa indlela yokukhetha imikhakha eyabonakala emnothweni, ethinta umkhiqizo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhambela kwesikhathi, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubalulekile emlandweni, akwenzi kuphela ezepolitiki, kodwa futhi ubalulekile emiphakathini, ukwazisa umuntu, kanye nokwakha imiyalezo eyenza kube lula kwabanye. Njengomholi, uButhelezi ubala imiphumela emhlabeni jikelele, wonke umuntu ofuna ukwazi ukuthi igunya lakhe liyalibala emigqeni yezenzakalo. Ngenxa yalezi zinto, uButhelezi ungasali emuva empini yakhe, akamukeli lapho, ngoba ufisa ukuphila esikhathini esizayo. Ukusebenza kwakhe, ukukhulu, ubuchopho, futhi uyabavikela bonke abantu abaseziqhwini, ukuze balwe nezimpilo zabo. Ukugcina umoya wakhe esikhathini esizayo uMangosuthu Buthelezi uhlala ehlinzeka izifundo ezibalulekile kumphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, ingikhumbula uMangosuthu Buthelezi. Ngokubuyisela emuva kulokho akwenza, ngiwuthola umqondo omqoka wakhe. Njengomholi ongaguquki futhi onamandla, uyaziwa, kube nempumelelo, futhi skuthetheli phambili emlandweni. Ubudoda bahlonishwa ukuqhubeka nokukhula kohlanga. Konke lokhu kuveza ukuba uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki, futhi imiphumela yakhe ithinta ubudala obuphakeme. Kukhona izifundo ezibalulekile esizifundile, futhi sihamba phambili nendlela yokuphila ngendlela ezwakalayo, edlula ukungabaza, futhi okuhloniphekile. Umuntu omkhulu, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, uhlala ehamba phambili, esimweni sethu.
Ezokusebenza Kukahulumeni: Umhlahlandlela Wokusebenza Isingeniso Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni, noma ezokuphatha, ziwumgogodla wabantu nempilo yomphakathi. Kuhlala kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kanjani, ukuze kungabi khona ukudideka nezinkinga phakathi kwababambiqhaza. Umhlahlandlela unikeza izinyathelo eziyisisekelo ezidingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusiza umphakathi wabo, baqonde izinqubo, futhi balingise izidingo zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi Ukuphatha kahle izokusebenza kukahulumeni kuqala ngokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi kufanele baqhube ucwaningo oluqondile, bavule iziteshi zokuxhumana, futhi balalele izikhalazo nezicelo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezenzakalayo zitholakala kubantu ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphatha Umsebenzi wophenyo kumele uhlanganise ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ezibandakanya ohulumeni bendawonye, izikhungo ezizimele, nabavoti. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nomqondo ophakeme wobambiswano. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokuhlela imihlangano, ukufaka abantu emisebenzini, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izicelo zabantu ziyaziswa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhulisa Izinsiza Ngemva kokuba izidingo zomphakathi seziqondwa, indlela elandelayo iwukukhulisa izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela izabelomali, ukuthola amalungelo, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyimfuneko. Abaphathi kumele baqonde ukuba izinsiza kumele zenziwe zibe lula zokutholakala, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzithola kalula. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Imisebenzi Ukuphathwa kwalokho okukhulisiwe kumele kuhlelwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela imisebenzi nezinqubo ezizosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umnyango uyawuqonda umsebenzi othile. Kubalulekile ukusetha izinyathelo ezicacile, ukugcina amarekhodi afanele, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwazo ngokuvamile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi Abasebenzi bakahulumeni bangenye yeziqhamo ezisemqoka ezokusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo, kudinga ukuthi baqeqeshwe ngezifundo ezisemqoka, izinhlelo zokufundisa, nezikhangiso eziphathelene nezimpoqo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzowandisa amakhono abasebenzi, kubenze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezidingweni zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziywa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba zonke izinhlelo eziphathelene nezokuphatha zisebenza kahle, kumele kuqashwe ukuhlola nezindlela ezithile zokuhlaziywa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubhalwa kwemiphumela, ukuqhuba izifundo, nokuhlola izinsiza. Ukuhlola kufanele kube njalo ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zikhona kuphi izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ezifanele. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Nezindaba Zesimanje Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni akumele zenziwe zibe sengxenyeni ethile kuphela. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nezindaba zesimanje, okubandakanya ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kuyisici esibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola impendulo ngokushesha, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokwenze kube nokubambisana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Isiphetho Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni zidinga ubuchwepheshe obunembile, ukuxhumana okuhle, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Ukuze umphakathi uthole izinzuzo ezivela kulezi zinhlelo, kumele silandele lezi zinyathelo ngokunembile, siqhubeke sihlola futhi sihluze izinqubo, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Ngokwakhiwa kwezokusebenza kukahulumeni okuyiqiniso, siqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unempilo, ubumbene, futhi unikezwa zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kwandiswe izinga lempilo yawo. Lokhu kuyimpumelelo yezenzo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha.
ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean luyindawo emangalisayo. Lutholakala phakathi kwesinye sezilwandle ezinkulu, lwenziwe phakathi kwe-Afrika, i-Asia, ne-Australasia. Noma ungakaze uvakashele, ngiphakamisa ukuthi uzame, ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo lapha. Kukhona ama-archipelago, izindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, kanye nezilwane eziningi ezikhalweni zasolwandle. Uma uhamba ngolwandle, ungabona izinkanyezi, izigwaca, nezinyoni eziphakeme phezulu. Ngabe ufuna ukuhamba ngebhodi ukuze ubone lezi zinto eziphilayo? ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean unomlando ocebile, uhlanganisa izizwe eziningi. Kukhona izindawo ezithokozisayo ezifana neMaldives, Seychelles, neMauritius, ezaziwa ngama-beaches amahle, amanzi acwebile, nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle. Phakathi nezikhathi, lolu lwandle lwaba yindawo yokuhweba, lapho abantu baye bahlala bezama ukuthola izimpahla ezivela kwezinye izindawo, okwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwezizwe. Nokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Izimo zezulu zishintsha, futhi izingozi zenzeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi sigcine izikhumbuzo zempilo zasolwandle, ukuze sikwazi ukuvakashela lezi zindawo ezithokozisayo. Ngakho, uma uhamba lapha, khumbula ukuthi ungathola izinto eziningi ezinhle, futhi ungajabulela ubuhle bezindawo ezinjengeMaldives, Seychelles, neMauritius. Qhubeka uhamba uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, uzothola izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo.
Amalungelo Abantu: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimiso Nezithiyo Amalungelo abantu, njengokwaziwa kwethu, ayizimiso ezisemqoka ezihlonipha ubuntu bomuntu nomphakathi. Lezi zinkolelo ziqhakambisa isidingo sokuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, unelungelo lokuphila, ukuthula, nokuqhuba impilo enempilo. Amalungelo abantu akha isisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolwaziyo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amalungelo abantu awawona umqondo omusha; imibono yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu ibhalwe emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ezincwadini ezisemthethweni ezifana neSivumelwano Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu, esayiswa ngo-1948. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umhlaba onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bejabuliswa khona ngokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abo. Nokho, nakuba lezi zinkolelo zikhona, izithiyo eziningi zikhona ezivimbela abantu ekutholeni amalungelo abo. Izinkinga ezihlobene namalungelo abantu ziye zakhula, zidalwa yizimo zomphakathi, ezombangazwe, nezomnotho. Ezinye zezinkinga ezinkulu zifaka phakathi ukucindezelwa kwabantu, ubuhlanga, ubudlova, kanye nokungabi nandlela emnothweni, okuvusa ukungalingani emphakathini. Kukhona izifunda ezithile emhlabeni ezibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, lapho amalungelo abantu engahlonishwa khona, futhi abantu bahlukunyezwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezizimele, nazo zineqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zikhula zibe namandla emhlabeni jikelele. Uma izinkampani zingahambisani nemigomo yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, zingadala umonakalo omkhulu, okungaholela ekuphulweni kwamalungelo abantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinise izinqubomgomo ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yazo ayilimazi abantu. Ukwaziwa nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhona kuphela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa nakumaqembu amancane, izizukulwane, nezinhlangano. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu, uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ngalokhu, futhi ubonise indlela yokulwa nezinsolo zokuphulwa kwamalungelo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlangano ezizimele. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujule ngamalungelo abantu, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangawathola kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukufundiswa, ukuze abantu bazi amalungelo abo, nezindlela zokuzivikela uma lezi zinkinga zenzeka. Ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokufundisa amalungelo abantu ezikoleni nasemiphakathini kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokwakha umhlaba onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona ezivimbela abantu ekutholeni amalungelo abo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho amalungelo abantu ehonishwa khona. Lokhu kudinga ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi amalungelo abo, baphakamise izwi labo, futhi balwele ukwakha umhlaba onobulungiswa. Ngakho, amalungelo abantu awawona nje amagama, kodwa ayisixhumanisi esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Izinyathelo Zokulandela Ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumcimbi obalulekile empilweni kazwelonke, unikeza abantu ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono, izifiso, nezidingo zabo. Ukuze ukhetho lube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kulandelwe izinyathelo ezithile. Nansi indlela yokuhlela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ukuvota Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izakhamizi zibe nolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvota. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zibhale igama lazo ohlelweni lokuvota. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuvakashela emahhovisi kahulumeni endaweni, noma ngokuqhafaza kwi-inthanethi uma kungenzeka. Abavoti kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo ihambisana, futhi uma kudingeka, benze izichibiyelo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Ngabadayisi Ngaphambi kokuvota, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle abadayisi abavela ezikhundleni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufunda ngamaqembu ezepolitiki, izifiso zawo, nezinhlelo abakhipha uma sebekhethwe. Abavoti bangasebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukahlukene, njengamaphephandaba, iziteshi ze-TV, nezinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baqonde kahle abadayisi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuvota Uma usuku lokhetho lufika, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle indawo yokuvota. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-akhawunti yomvoti noma ngezinsiza ezikhona emakhaya. Ngaphambi kokuhamba, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baphathe izinsuku ezifanele zokuphuma, balungise iziqu zabo zokuvota, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi banezinto ezidingekayo, njenge-ID yomvoti. Endaweni yokuvota, abavoti bazodingeka baphendule kumabhalane ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuthi baphuma kokuqala, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ngemva kokuvota, kuqala inqubo yokuhlonza imiphumela. Lokhu kwenziwa ngababheki bokhetho, abaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe phansi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku zibalulekile, ukuze kukhuthazwe umoya wokubambisana. Isinyathelo 5: Ukwamukela Imiphumela Lapho imiphumela isitholakele, kubalulekile ukuba ibikwe ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi ubani ophumelele. Lokhu kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba bahloniphe izinqumo ezenziwe, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphatha kahle imiphumela, beqonda ukuthi ukhetho lungukukhetha kwabantu. Lokhu kubambisana phakathi kwabantu kungakhuthaza ukuthula emiphakathini. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubambisana Ngezinye Izinsuku Ngemva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhunywe ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bangabakhona khona ukuze bacele imiphumela, futhi bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni ezizayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi kuzokwakha umoya wokuhlanganyela, okuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Isiphetho Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisigameko esibalulekile, esiqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banesikhala sokuzwakalisa izifiso zabo. Ukuze le nqubo ihambe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinyathelo ezichaziwe zilandelwe ngokunembile. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngenkundla efanele yokuvota, sithuthukise isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika. Ukhetho akusikho nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqinile nezwe elikhaliphile.
Izimpi ZamaBhunu: Uhlanga Lwezinkumbulo Nezinguquko Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili, izimpi zamaBhunu zaguqula umqondo wezombusazwe, umnotho, kanye nezimpilo zabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zimpilo zashintsha zaba yizinkumbulo eziyinkimbinkimbi, zishiya izilokotho ezinzima emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zimpilo, kubalulekile ukuhlola imvelaphi yazo, izigameko ezibalulekile, kanye nemiphumela yazo. Imvelaphi Nezizathu Zokulwa Izimpi zamaBhunu ziqala ngemuva kokufika kwabantu baseYurophu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaBhunu abavela eNetherlands, eFrance, naseGermany. Ngemva kwesikhathi, amaBhunu akha izindawo zokuhlala ezazibizwa ngezimpi, lapho abelokhu bephikisana nezizwe zendawo, ikakhulukazi amaXhosa namaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezizathu eziningi zokulwa, okuhlanganisa ukulawulwa kwezinsiza, umhlaba, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo. Izimpi Zokuqala: Iziqubu ZamaBhunu Izimpi zokuqala zamaBhunu zenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-19, lapho amaBhunu eqala ukulwa nezinye izizwe zendawo. Iziqubu ezifana neMpi YamaBhunu (1835-1846) zaba yizigameko ezibalulekile, lapho amaBhunu abebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila nezokuphatha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezimpi ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa iMpi YamaBhunu Yezwe (1880-1881) neMpi YamaBhunu Yesibili (1899-1902). Iziphumo Zokulwa Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka, izindawo zashabalala, futhi izinsiza zemvelo zaphazamiseka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezimo ezinzima, lapho izigidi zabantu zashiywa ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zashintsha umqondo wezombusazwe, zakhuthaza imikhankaso yokuzimela, futhi zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izifunda ezahlukene. Ukwakhiwa Kwezizwe Nezinguquko Ngemuva kwezimpi, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukwakha izizwe ezihlukene, lapho amaBhunu abebhekene nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umnotho, njengoba izwe laqala ukwakha izimboni ezahlukene. Izinkumbulo Nezifundo Zempilo Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, zishiya izizukulwane eziningi zikhumbula ubuhlungu nezinkinga ezazihambisana nezimpi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa, lapho abantu befundiswa ngalezi zimpilo ukuze baziqonde kahle izifundo ezivela emlandweni. Izinkumbulo zempilo zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, bahloniphe izinkumbulo zabanye, futhi bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, zashintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lezi zimpilo, sifunde kuzo, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Ukubheka emlandweni, singathola izifundo ezibalulekile ezizosisiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono, elihlonipha izinkumbulo nezifundo ezivela ezimpilweni zabantu bethu. Ngakho-ke, izimpi zamaBhunu zihlala zibalulekile, zikhumbuza abantu bethu ngempilo, ubuhlungu, kanye nezifundo ezivela emlandweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ohambisana nezidingo zabantu bonke.
Umbuzo 1: Yini amahlathi? Impendulo: Amahlathi, noma amahlathi amnyama, yizindawo ezinkulu ezinezitshalo nezilwane eziningi. Ziqukethe izihlahla eziphakeme, izimpande ezinamandla, kanye nezitshalo ezahlukene. Amahlathi adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ahlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, umoya opholile, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Umbuzo 2: Kungani amahlathi ebalulekile? Impendulo: Amahlathi abalulekile ngoba ahlinzeka ngempilo ebalulekile. Athuthukisa umoya opholile, avikele umhlaba ekugugumeni, futhi akha izindawo zokuhlala ezahlukene zezilwane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlathi anikela ngezinsiza ezifana nezinkuni, izithelo, nezitshalo ezisetshenziswa emithini. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izilwane ezitholakala emahlathini? Impendulo: Emahlathini, sithola izilwane eziningi ezahlukene njengezinyoni, izinyamazane, izimpungushe, kanye nezilwane ezinkulu ezifana nezindlovu. Lezi zilwane zidinga amahlathi ukuze zihlale, zifune ukudla, futhi zikhule. Amahlathi anika lezi zilwane indawo yokuphepha. Umbuzo 4: Kuthiwani ngempilo yomuntu emahlathini? Impendulo: Amahlathi ayindawo yokuphumula nokuzijabulisa kubantu. Abantu bavame ukuvakashela amahlathi ukuze baphumule, bahambe, noma baphuze amanzi. Ukusebenza emahlathini, njengokulima, kunceda abantu bahlale bephila kahle. Amahlathi anikela ngamathuba okucwaninga nezifundo ngezinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izingozi ezibhekene namaahlathi? Impendulo: Amahlathi abhekene nezingozi eziningi ezifana nokukhishwa kwezihlahla, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nokuguqulwa kwesimo sezulu. Ukukhishwa kwezihlahla kungaholela ekwehleni kwezilwane ezithile, kanti ukungcoliswa komoya kubangela ukuthi amahlathi aphile kancane. Kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amahlathi. Umbuzo 6: Yini esingayenza ukuvikela amahlathi? Impendulo: Ukuze sivikele amahlathi, kufanele sithuthukise imikhuba yokuphila esebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugwema imithi enobungozi, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinkuni, kanye nokuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezihambisana nemvelo. Imicimbi yokuvikela amahlathi, njengokuhlanza, ingasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngamasiko ahlobene namaahlathi? Impendulo: Ezinye izinkolo namasiko ahlobene namaahlathi. Ezinye izizwe zikholelwa ukuthi amahlathi anamandla okuphila, futhi ziwahlonipha njengezindawo ezingcwele. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo, okwenza kube nokuhlonipha amahlathi. Izinkanyezi nezinkolelo zamasiko zikhumbuza abantu ukuba bahloniphe lezi zindawo. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayifunda emahlathini? Impendulo: Emahlathini, singafunda okuningi ngezindlela zokuphila, izimfanelo zezinto eziphilayo, kanye nezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu nemvelo. Ukuhamba emahlathini kusiza abantu baqonde ukuthi imvelo iyaphila futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Lokhu kucacisa umthwalo wemfanelo ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani amahlathi angaguqulwa abe yizindawo zentuthuko? Impendulo: Ukuze amahlathi angaguqulwa abe yizindawo zentuthuko, kufanele kube nokuhlelwa kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo, ukugcina izindawo eziluhlaza, kanye nokuvikela izilwane nezitshalo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zentuthuko nezokuphila kwemvelo kubalulekile ukuze sithole ibhalansi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esiyithola ekugcineni? Impendulo: Ekugcineni, amahlathi ayisikhumbuzo sokubaluleka kwemvelo empilweni yethu. Ukubona amahlathi, ukuhamba phakathi kwezihlahla, nokuzwa umsindo wezinyoni, konke lokhu kusinika umuzwa wokuxhumana nemvelo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithokozisa amahlathi, sikhuthaze abanye ukuba bahloniphe futhi bavikele lezi zindawo ezibalulekile. Amahlathi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu, futhi kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukugcina lezi zindawo ziphilile.
Isingeniso Ukubhukuda kuyinto emnandi futhi ewusizo, engasiza ekuphuculeni impilo yethu. Ngaphandle kokuba umthombo wokuzithokozisa, ukubhukuda kuthuthukisa amandla omzimba, kuthuthukisa ukujikeleza kwegazi, futhi kunciphisa ingozi yokugula. Kulabo abaqala, lezi zinyathelo ezilula zizokwenza kube lula ukufunda ukubhukuda ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukubhukuda, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi unendawo efanele yokubhukuda, njengemfula, ichibi, noma ichibi elikhulu. Bheka izimo zomoya nezamanzi, uqiniseke ukuthi akukhona okungase kube yingozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qiniseka ukuthi unempahla efanele yokubhukuda. Izimpahla zokubhukuda ezifanele zifaka i-swimsuit, izicathulo zokubhukuda, kanye nekhanda elivikelayo uma kudingeka. Ungakhohlwa futhi ukuthola umoya omuhle, ungathola izibuko zokubhukuda uma uthanda ukubona kahle ngaphakathi kwamanzi. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Izinyathelo Zokuqala Uma usulungile, qala ngokufunda izinyathelo ezilula. Thola indawo enamanzi angashintshi kakhulu, bese uqala ukufaka izinyawo zakho emanzini. Qala ngokuhamba kancane, uzame ukujwayela umswakama. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ukhululekile emanzini. Ngemva kwalokho, zama ukugxila ekuphumuleni. Beka izandla zakho phansi, bese uzama ukuphakamisa umzimba wakho ngaphezulu kwamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi ungaphila kanjani emanzini. Qhubeka uzama ukugcina umoya wakho, ungavumeli ukungezwa kwephunga ukuba kukuthinte. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubhukuda Ngendlela Eyisisekelo Uma usuzizwa ukhululekile, qala ukufunda indlela yokubhukuda eyisisekelo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokubhukuda zikhona, kodwa sizogxila ku-front crawl, okuyindlela elula futhi esheshayo. Qala ngokubeka isikhumba sakho emanzini. Phakamisa izandla zakho phezulu, bese uzama ukuhamba phambili. Phakamisa isandla esisodwa, bese usithumela phambili, kanti omunye usendaweni yalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umzimba wakho uhamba phambili. Khumbula, uma uvula umlomo wakho ukuze uphume umoya, qiniseka ukuthi uvalile kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza ungatholi amanzi emlonyeni. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuthuthukisa Amandla Nokusebenza Njengoba uqhubeka, zama ukwandisa isikhathi sokubhukuda. Zama ukuthola umoya omuhle, ungavumeli umzimba wakho uphume emanzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole amandla amakhulu. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze uthuthukise ukusebenza kwakho. Izinsiza ezifana nezikhwama zokubhukuda zingasiza ekwakheni amandla emzimbeni. Zama ukwenza imisebenzi ethile, njengokubhukuda ngamamitha angu-25, bese uphumula. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole umoya omuhle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphepha Emanzini Ukuphepha emanzini kubalulekile. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale unakekela, ungakwenzi okuthile okungase kube yingozi. Hamba nabangani, ungakwazi futhi ukufunda ukubhukuda ndawonye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube mnandi futhi kuphephe. Uma ungakaze ubhukude, cabanga ukufunda nezifundo zokubhukuda. Abafundisi bezokubhukuda bangakusiza uqonde kahle izinyathelo ezithile nokuthi ungazithuthukisa kanjani. Isiphetho Ukubhukuda kuwumsebenzi omuhle ongakwenza ungathokozisa impilo yakho. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula, ungafunda ukubhukuda ngendlela efanele. Khumbula, ukubhukuda akukhona nje ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo. Qhubeka uzijwayeze, uzithokozise, futhi uphile impilo enempilo. Qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungakuthola ukufunda okungcono kakhulu, ukuze uthole injabulo emanzini.
Amaholide AseNingizimu Afrika: Ukubaluleka Nokuphikisana Emazweni amaningi, amaholide ayisikhathi sokuphumula, sokuzijabulisa, nokuhlanganyela nezothando. E-Ningizimu Afrika, amaholide ahluke kakhulu, ahlanganisa izinsuku ezibalulekile zomlando, amasiko, nezinkolelo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngama-holide aseNingizimu Afrika, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi akuwona wonke amaholide ahlangabezana nezidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela engxoxweni ethokozisayo mayelana nokubaluleka kwama-holide, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nawo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amaholide ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezahlukene: amaholide omphakathi, amaholide ezinkolo, kanye nama-holide omhlaba. Amaholide omphakathi afana ne-Youth Day, i-Human Rights Day, kanye ne-Freedom Day. Lezi zinsuku zikhumbuza abantu ngempilo yabo, izifiso zabo, kanye nezifundo ezithathwe emlandweni. Ukukhumbula lezi zinsuku kubalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle izimpilo zethu namuhla, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile kwezinto ezakha isizwe sethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaholide ezinkolo, njenge-Christmas ne-Ramadan, anika abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela ezinkolelweni zabo, futhi ahlale eqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni nabangani. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhloniphana, uthando, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kube khona ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinkolo, futhi amaholide anikeza ithuba lokuhlangana nokwabelana ngezinkolelo ezahlukene. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amaholide awanikezi kuphela ithuba lokuphumula, kodwa futhi angaholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Isibonelo, amaholide amaningi awavumelani nezidingo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-holide akhokhelwayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke ngenxa yokuphuma kwemali, njengoba abantu bahlala bephoqeleka ukuba baye ezindaweni zokungcebeleka, izindawo zokudla, noma emikhosini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezindleko zokuhamba, ezokudla, nezokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaholide angaholela ekwandeni kokungcola. Izindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu, njengezindawo zokungcebeleka, ziba nempilo engcono, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungcola nemfucumfucu. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukugcina izindawo zihlanzekile, futhi kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke ezinkingeni zezempilo ngenxa yokungcola. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi amaholide awavumelani nezidingo zokugcina imvelo, futhi kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela amaholide ngaphandle kokubangela umonakalo emvelweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika akhombisa izici ezithile ezidinga ukucubungula. Uhlanga lwesiko, njengemikhosi yamasiko, luhlangana nezinye izinkolelo ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukujwayela amaholide. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni umoya wokuhloniphana phakathi kwezinkolo nezamasiko. Uma sikhuluma ngama-holide, kufanele siqonde ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhlonipha izinkolelo zabanye, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi amaholide angaba nethonya elihle emiphakathini. Amasiko ahlukahlukene, lapho abantu behlangana khona, akha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, othando, nokuhloniphana. Amaholide angaba yithuba lokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona, behlanganyela, futhi bekwazisa imvelaphi yabo. Ekugcineni, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika ayisikhathi esibalulekile sokuphumula, sokuhlanganyela, nokukhumbula. Nokho, kudinga ukuba siqonde izinkinga ezihambisana nawo, ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela amaholide ngendlela efanele. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nesibopho sokuhlonipha izinkolelo nezamasiko ahlukene, kodwa futhi uqaphele izinkinga ezihambisana nama-holide. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi amaholide ahlala ebhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, futhi aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu.
Isingeniso Iphalamende laseNingizimu Afrika libalulekile kwezombusazwe, elawula izinqubomgomo ezithinta bonke abahlali baleli. Ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi zalo msebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola indlela eliphatha ngayo izindaba zomphakathi, ukuhlanganiswa kwezwi labantu, nokuthi izinqubomgomo zikhula kanjani ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi wePhalamende Iphalamende linenhloso enkulu yokwazisa imithetho, ukuhlola izinqubomgomo zamasiko, kanye nokulawula uhulumeni. Lokhu kukhulisa ukuhamba phambili kwezinhlelo ezibhekene nezinkinga ezibalulekile ezifana nokungasebenzi, ubumpofu, nokwehla kwezinga lemfundo. Nakuba kunengxoxo ezindaweni eziningi, umphakathi ungenza ngezindlela ezahlukene ukuze ucele izinguquko abazifunayo. Izimvo Ezihlukahlukene KwaZulu, abanye baveza ukuthi iphalamende linomthelela omuhle ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo, kanti abanye bakhathazekile ngokuthi kudinga ukuphathwa kangcono. Ukuhlolwa kwezithangami zePhalamende kukhombisa ukuthi imithetho ethile iyathuthuka, kodwa abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokungabi nezibopho ezinqubweni ezithile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kumele kube neqhaza elikhulu lokusebenzisa izwi labantu ukuze bazwakalise izinkinga zabo. Ukubheka Izinhlelo Zokwakha Nezimpumelelo Iphalamende inendima yokwakha imiphakathi. Izinqubomgomo ezithile, njengokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, izibhedlela, nemigwaqo, ziye zakhula, kodwa zibhekene nezithiyo ezinjengokuphatha okungafanele. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha kuhlobene ngqo nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokhilimuza, okuqinisekisa imiphakathi eqinile. Ukubambisana Kwamazinga Ahlukene Umsebenzi wePhalamende awupheli emnyangweni wombuso kuphela. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zikwazi ukuhamba phakathi kweQuantum nemiphakathi yendawo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuhwebelana kwabantu, okwenza kube nokuthola izinsiza ezingcono ezivela kubakhokheli. Ukushoda Kokuzwakala Kwezingxoxo Nakuba iPhalamende ibonakala iyisikhungo sokuphendula izinkinga zomphakathi, kukhona abanye abantu abangalutholi ithuba lokukhulumela izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekudumazekeni, okwenza umphakathi ungabi namandla okudlulisa imizwa yabo. Kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi izwi labo linomthelela kumaphuzu abucayi. Isimo Sezinqe Nokwesekwa Kwamalungu Amasha Ukuze iPhalamende ithuthukiswe, kubalulekile ukubandakanya amalungu amasha avela emiphakathini ehlukene. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abantu zidingeka ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi bangaba kanjani yingxenye yephalamende, okuhlanganisa ukusiza abantu ukuthi bazi ngezindlela zokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi. Ukuvuselelwa KweZinqubomgomo Kubhalwe ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezikhona zihlolwe njalo ukuze ziqhubeke zisesha izixazululo. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinqubomgomo kungaholela ekukhuleni kokuqonda ngempela kwezinkinga ezikhona, kudingeka ukuthi iPhalamende ibambisane namanye amalungu omphakathi. Isiphetho Ngaphandle kwezinto eziphikisanayo, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika linendima ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Kubalulekile ukuqonda le ndima nokukhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwemizamo yePhalamende nabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha, kubalulekile ukuqhubekisela phambili izwi lomphakathi ukuze bonke bazwe ukuthi isithombe sikhuluma ngempela. Iphalamende lingaba yindlela eqinile yokukhulisa iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga zomphakathi ezinzima.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Ingxoxo Nenduna Yendawo Isingeniso Uthando lwamanzi luyimpilo, kodwa ezindaweni eziningi zethu, izinkinga zamanzi zikhula ngokushesha. Ukuze siqonde kangcono lezi zinkinga, sithintane nenduna yendawo, uMnumzane Dlamini, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umbono wakho ngezinselele zamanzi esizweni sethu? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Izinkinga zamanzi zikhula kakhulu. Ngabe kukhona okukhuluma ngezinye izinsuku, kodwa ukudlula kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Izifunda eziningi zethu ziyaqhubeka nokubhekana nezinkinga zokuntula amanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinzima, njengokungaphumi kahle kwezinhlaka zomphakathi.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela ezikhona zokuntula amanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Kunezinto eziningi ezithinta le nkinga. Okokuqala, imvula iyancipha, futhi le miphumela ibangelwa izinguquko zesimo sezulu. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yamanzi, kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga. Ngesikhathi sokuhlala, izinkampani ezinkulu zifaka imfucuza emithonjeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile.” Umbuzo 3: Uthini umbono wakho ngempilo yomphakathi ngenxa yezinkinga zamanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Impilo yomphakathi ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola amanzi, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka. Ukuntula amanzi ahlanzekile kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwana emanzini. Abantu abakwazi ukuhamba kahle, futhi lokhu kubangela ukwehla komnotho. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinjalo ezidinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo.” Umbuzo 4: Kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Yebo, zikhona izixazululo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngendlela yokugcina amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukungaphumeleli. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhlanzwa kwamanzi kufanele ziqiniswa. Kukhona amaphrojekthi amaningi angasebenza ukusiza abantu bakithi, kepha kudinga ubambiswano phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni.” Umbuzo 5: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze uthuthukise isimo samanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Umphakathi unendima enkulu. Abantu kufanele babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzwa kwamanzi, futhi baziswe ngezindlela zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana namanye amaqembu, njengezikhungo zomphakathi, kungasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosebenza. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho umphakathi uhlanganisa imizamo, izinto ziba ngcono.” Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ubonisa umbono omuhle ngekusasa? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi singathola izixazululo uma sisebenza ndawonye. Iziphakamiso ezithile zingahlala zifinyelelwa uma sikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale benolwazi ngalezi zinkinga. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nohulumeni kungaholela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke siphikelela ekutholeni izixazululo.” Isiphetho Izinkinga zamanzi zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizoba nenhlalakahle engcono. Njengoba uMnumzane Dlamini esho, ubambiswano nomphakathi, kanye nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo, kungasiza ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Ngakho-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi sikwenze, kodwa kufanele sibe nomdlandla ekutholeni izixazululo. Njengoba sithuthukisa ulwazi, sithuthukisa umphakathi, futhi siphephisa ikusasa lethu.
Uhambo Nokuzijabulisa: Indaba Yomlando Kusukela ezikhathini zakudala, abantu bahlale bejabulela ukuhamba, ukufuna izindawo ezintsha, nokuzijabulisa. Uhambo akukhona kuphela ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana namasiko ahlukene, ukufunda izifundo, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Uma sithatha isinyathelo emlandweni, sithola ukuthi uhambo lwaluwumgubho wokuphila, nokuthi izizukulwane eziningi zaluqhuba ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Ngasekancane, emakhulwini ambalwa edlule, uhambo lwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu bezizwana ezahlukene. Abantu baseMali, njengezinduna zohambo, babengabashayi phansi, bejolisa ekufundeni izizinda ezahlukene. Kwakukhona nezinsuku lapho ukugibela izinkanyezi kwaba yindlela yokuphila, abafana noHammurabi, uMongol uGenghis Khan, kanye nabantu abavela eBhagavad Gita, basiza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo ezinjengeGibhithe, iGrisi, neRoma zaba nezikhumbuzo eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lezi zindawo zathakazelisa uchwepheshe nabavakashi. Izindawo ezinjengalezi zazifaka izindawo zokuhlala, izimakethe, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuxoxa, bahlangane, futhi bazijabulise. Uhambo lwaba yindlela yokuthola ubuhle bempilo, futhi lwaluhambisana nemicabango emisha. Ngemuva kokuhlupheka kukaMhlaba, uhambo lwaphinde lwavuselelwa ngesikhathi sokuhlwaya. Abantu bahlola izindawo eziningi ezazikhona, futhi umkhankaso wokuhamba ube usubiza kakhulu. Izitimela, izindiza, nezikebhe zaba izindlela eziyinhloko zokuhamba, futhi abavakashi baphumelela ekufinyeleleni izindawo ezikude. Lokhu kwashintsha kakhulu indlela abantu ababheka ngayo ukuhamba, kwavula amathuba amasha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zokuhlala zakhula, izindawo zokuzijabulisa zanda, futhi izimakethe zathuthuka. Uhambo lwakha umnotho omkhulu, abantu babefuna izindawo zokudla, izindawo zokuhlala, nezinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izindawo zibe nezinhlobonhlobo ezihambelana nezidingo zabavakashi, futhi kwavula amathuba emisebenzi. Kodwa uhambo akukhona nje ukufuna izinzuzo; bekukhona nemibuzo ethinta imvelo. Njengoba abantu behamba, izindawo zaba nezinkinga. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhumba, ukungcoliswa, kanye nokungaziphathi kahle kwezinto eziphilayo kwaba yizindaba ezibalulekile. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kube nesidingo sokubuyisela emuva, sithuthukise izindlela zokuhamba ngempumelelo, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuthi baphatheke kahle emvelweni. Ngesikhathi samanje, uhambo luhamba phambili, futhi izinkampani ezithengisa izindawo zikhula. Uhambo lwemisebenzi, izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinto zokuhamba, nezinhlelo zokuhamba ezilula zanda. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufuna izindawo ezithokozisayo, izindawo zokuphumula, nemikhosi eminingi. Uhambo selwaba wumkhankaso omkhulu, futhi abantu bangathola izindawo eziningi ezihlukahlukene, bezijabulisa futhi bejabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Kubuhlungu ukuthi, nakuba uhambo luhamba phambili, sikhumbula njalo izifundo ezitholakele emlandweni. Kubalulekile ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yethu ixhumene nokuhamba, futhi kufanele sibe nomqondo wokuhamba ngempumelelo. Ukuze sithole injabulo, kufanele sihlole izindawo ezihlukene, sifunde ngempilo, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwakha umhlaba ophilayo, ogqugquzelayo, futhi ogcwele ukujabulisa. Ngakho-ke, uhambo nokuzijabulisa akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa yindlela yokuhlola, yokuxhumana, nokwakha umphakathi. Njengoba siqhubeka sithuthuka, kufanele siqaphele izifundo zomlando, futhi siphinde sihlole izindlela zokuhamba ezihlangabezana nezidingo zethu, nezizukulwane ezizayo. Uhambo luyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sihamba ngayo ngenhlonipho nangezwi elihle, ukuze sithole imfundo, injabulo, nokuhlangenwe nakho okungapheli. Ngalendlela, sizokwazi ukuhamba kahle, futhi sizokwazi ukujabulisa, sithole izifundo eziningi emhlabeni omkhulu. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uhambo luyindlela yokuxhumana nemvelo, nabantu, nezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kube yisifundo sokubambisana, sokuthuthukisa, nokuqonda okukhulu phakathi kwethu sonke.
Umculo We-Gospel: Umthombo Wokukhanya Nezinto Eziwusizo Umculo we-gospel unendima enkulu empilweni yamaKristu nabanye abantu abaningi emhlabeni. Lo mculo awugcini nje ngokuculwa ezikhathini ezikhethekile, kodwa unomoya ophilayo ophakathi kwabantu. Njengomuntu okhuluma ngezinto eziningi, ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu hlobo lomculo, oluhlanganisa izimpilo zethu, uthando, nendlela esihlangana ngayo noMdali. Umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wesikhuthazo esivela kwiBhayibheli, ubonisa izinkolelo zethu nezindlela zokukhuluma, ugcizelela imigomo efana nothando nokubuyisana. Izihlabani ezikhanyayo zalesi siko, njengeMahalia Jackson noYolanda Adams, zaphendula kwiZwi likaNkulunkulu ngezindlela ezicacile. Zama ukuqonda lokho okuvela enhliziyweni, okwakha uxhumano phakathi kwabantu, lapho umculo uvela njengendlela yokukhuluma noMdali. Isiko le-gospel lihlala lisendlini yethu, libonisa ukukhula kokholo, futhi umculo unomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Uthandwa kakhulu emaphandleni nasemiphakathini, uthokozisa abantu abafuna ukuhamba phambili. Umculo we-gospel usiza abantu ukuba bahlale beqinile, naphezu kwezinkinga nempilo enzima, ubonisa indlela yokuphila engcono nezifundo ezivela ezimeni zempilo. Nokho, umculo we-gospel awuhanjiswa kuphela njengokukhuthaza; kukhona izigameko ezithile ezishiya umphumela omubi. Emhlabeni wanamuhla, umculo we-gospel ubhekana nezimo zomnotho, izinkonzo, nemibono ethile. Abaculi baphokophela ukuthola abalandeli abasha, kudinga imibono ethile, ukuze bahlale benguquko. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo we-gospel uthuthuka, uyashintsha, ufinyelela ezingeni elikhulu lokuhlanganiswa. Ukuxhumana kombhali nomzimba we-gospel kudinga ukuhlonishwa, kudinga ukudalwa kwezinkampani, nokwakha amathuba okukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel usiza abantu ukuba baziqhenye ngezenzo ezinhle, usisiza sithole umqondo omuhle phakathi kwezimo zansuku zonke. Ngalesi sithombe, ngincoma wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abancane, ukuba baqhubeke becula umculo we-gospel obalulekile. Umculo we-gospel uyakhanya, ufinyelela ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi usikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona, ukhuluma ngothando, umndeni, nempilo. Ngakho-ke, ake sibe nesibindi, sithi 'yebo' kumculo we-gospel. Akufanele kube umculo kuphela; kufanele kube umoya wempilo. Phendukani nizwakalise, nikhumbule ukuhlanganyela umusa, uthando, nemizwa emihle, ukuze sizuze ubuhle bomculo we-gospel, udlule ezithombeni ezinobuhlobo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuhlanganisweni kokholo nobuhle, umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezimo, nokwabelana ngemizwa emqoka.
Odokotela Nabahlengikazi: Abagibeli Bephila Nathi Emhlabeni wanamuhla, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala besebenza njengabaphikisi abakhulu empilweni yethu. Njengoba sithola izinsiza zezempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yabo, ubunzima abahlangabezana nabo, kanye nomthelela abawenza empilweni yethu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila nathi, besebenza ngenkani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Odokotela, njengabaphathi bezempilo, banomsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlola, ukuxilonga, nokwelapha iziguli. Bafundiswe iminyaka eminingi ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezihlukahlukene zempilo, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu. Kodwa, akukhona nje ukuthi bahlala behlola iziguli; baphinde babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle neziguli zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma isiguli sikhuluma kahle nodokotela, kuba lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abahlengikazi bahlala bephakathi kokusebenza kanzima. Bahlala besebenza ezindaweni ezinzima, bephatha iziguli eziningi ngasikhathi sinye. Umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekunakekeleni iziguli, kodwa ubandakanya futhi ukuxhumana, ukweseka, nokuhlinzeka ngothando. Abahlengikazi bahlala bejabulisa iziguli ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga umoya ophakeme nokuzinikela. Ngaphandle kwabo, odokotela bangase bahluleke ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukusebenza ngezinsuku ezinde, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula, kanye nomthwalo omkhulu wezibopho, konke lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi, futhi lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo nasempilweni yeziguli. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ziqinisekise ukuthi odokotela nabahlengikazi banesikhathi sokuphumula, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele kubalulekile. Ezinye izibhedlela zihlala zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi odokotela nabahlengikazi benze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi bezempilo baphendule ngokushesha ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izibhedlela zikhona izinsiza ezanele. Uma izinsiza zikhona, odokotela nabahlengikazi bazokwazi ukusebenza kahle, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yeziguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukubaluleka komsebenzi wabo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila ezinsukwini ezinzima, futhi umphakathi kufanele ubabonge. Ukubonga kungaba yindlela elula yokubakhuthaza, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngenkani. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi impilo yethu incike kakhulu emsebenzini wabo, futhi kufanele sibabheke njengabalingani bethu empilweni. Ekugcineni, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila nathi, besebenza ngenkani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekwelapheni iziguli, kodwa ubandakanya futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukweseka, nokuhlinzeka ngothando. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukubaluleka komsebenzi wabo, futhi uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi banezinsiza ezanele ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Ngaphandle kwabo, impilo yethu ingase ibe sengozini. Ngakho-ke, masibabonge, masibakhuthaze, futhi masiqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila nathi, ngoba impilo yethu incike kubo.
UJacob Zuma: Indaba Yomlando UJacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-12 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942 eNkandla, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezwe. UZuma wakhulela emndenini ophila ezimeni ezinzima, lapho ubaba wakhe, uJulius Zuma, ayengumsebenzi wezolimo, kanti unina, uNongoma, wayengumama ophila impilo ejwayelekile. Lezi zimo zashiya umthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, zamsiza ukuba aqonde ubunzima obubhekene nabantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kokuphuma esikoleni, uZuma waba yilungu le-ANC (African National Congress) ngonyaka ka-1959. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo, lapho ahlanganyela khona nezinye izinkanyezi zomzabalazo ezifana noNelson Mandela noOliver Tambo. UZuma wathola ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe bokulwa, waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphathweni kwezempi ye-ANC, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili. Ngonyaka ka-1963, uZuma wabanjwa wabe esethunyelwa ejele, lapho ahlala khona iminyaka engu-10. Ngesikhathi esebhajwe, uZuma wathola ithuba lokucabanga ngempilo yakhe, izinjongo zakhe, kanye nezifiso zomzabalazo. Ngemva kokuphuma ejele, uZuma waqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, waba umholi ophakeme kwi-ANC, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-ANC nezinye izinhlangano zomhlaba. Ngonyaka ka-1994, uZuma waba nguMphakathi Wezokuphepha, lapho ahola khona izinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. UZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthetho ophathelene nezokuphepha, okwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha. Ngalesi sikhathi, uZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waqala ukwakha igama lakhe njengomholi onobuhlakani. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwe-ANC, uZuma waba nguMongameli we-ANC ngonyaka ka-2005. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, njengoba uZuma wabhekana nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa, kodwa waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-ANC nezinye izinhlangano. UZuma waba nguMongameli wezwe ngonyaka ka-2009, lapho abhekana khona nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Njengomongameli, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa waphinde waba nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwe-ANC, kanye nezinsolo zokuthi uZuma ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano obungafanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Nokho, izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi uZuma wathola ukugxekwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwe-ANC, kanye nezinsolo zokuthi uZuma ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano obungafanele. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uZuma wathatha isinqumo sokuhoxa esikhundleni, kwathi uCyril Ramaphosa wathatha indawo yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola impumelelo kaZuma, kanye nezinsolo ezihlobene nezinto eziningi ezenzakalayo ngesikhathi sokuphatha kwakhe. UZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waqhubeka nokusebenza ezindabeni ezihlobene nezokuphepha, kodwa izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaba yinkinga enkulu. UJacob Zuma ungumholi onobuhlakani, ophumelele emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo, kodwa waphinde waba nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi impilo yomholi ayilula, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. UZuma ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezwe, futhi indaba yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika.
Ezamabhange: Ukuhlaziywa Kokubaluleka Kwazo Emasikweni Asethu Ezamabhange zisebenza emhlabeni wonke futhi zinemisebenzi ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali. Zithuthukise izindlela zokuphila kwabantu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangagcina imali yabo, okwakha ithuba lokuhlela izindleko zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba ukulahlekelwa yimali. Amabhange awasizi kuphela ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zokulondoloza, kodwa futhi adlala indima enkulu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezifana nezikweletu, ukutshala izimali, nokwenza ukuhweba kwezimpahla kube lula. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezamabhange ziza nezimo ezahlukene, futhi izinzuzo nezithiyo ezihambisana nazo kumele zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Akubona bonke abantu abathola kalula lezi zinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile, lapho ukuntuleka kokufinyelela nezindleko zokusebenzisa amabhange kungaholela ekuhlukaniseni. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ezamabhange. Imithetho ethile yokubhalisela amabhange ibalulekile ekuvikeleni abathengi, inika abantu ithuba lokubanga amalungelo abo. Nokho, le mithetho ingase ibangele izithiyo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanenkinga zokulawula izindleko. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubo ukufaka izicelo zemali, okukhulisa ubunzima. Amabhange adinga ukuthi umphakathi uphathwe kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ukukhula kwezimali kumabhange kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayi bezezimali, futhi lokhu kudinga umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obufanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende, kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngamasu amasha afanele. Ukuba nolwazi olunembile mayelana nezinsizakalo zamabhange kubalulekile ukuze abathengi baqonde kahle izinqubomgomo ezithinta izimali zabo. Ukuhlakanipha kwabathengi kudinga ukuba kube ngaphezu kokuhlola ibhange elithile; kumqoka ukuthi kube nokuhlonipha nolwazi oluqinile. Ngokuphetha, ezamabhange zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxoxa ngalezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bathola izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze umnotho ube muhle, umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle, ukuze amabhange ahlale enza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu.
Ezobunjiniyela: Umhlaba Wokwakha Nokuqamba Ngiyakwemukela, mngani! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ethokozisayo, ezobunjiniyela. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona ezindaweni eziningi empilweni yethu? Yebo, ngempela! Akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo ezinkulu, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuhlela, ukudala, nokwenza izinto zisebenze kahle. Ngakho, ake sihlole le ndaba ngokujulile. Ukuqala, ake sikhulume ngencazelo yobunjiniyela. Ngabe ubunjiniyela buwukwakha kuphela? Cha, mngani! Ubunjiniyela buhlanganisa izimfanelo eziningi, kusukela kumakhono okucabanga, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nekhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Umjikelezo wokwakha uhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, kusukela ekucabangeni ngempela, ukuya ekwakheni, bese ekugcineni, ukwakha umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, futhi akulula, kodwa kuyajabulisa! Ngabe ubunjiniyela bukhona emikhakheni ehlukene? Impela! Sinezakhiwo, ubunjiniyela bezokwakha, ubunjiniyela bezokuthutha, ubunjiniyela bezobuchwepheshe, nokunye okuningi. Ngicabanga ukuthi ubunjiniyela bezokwakha bukhona obala kakhulu. Cabanga nje ngalezi zikhumbuzo ezinkulu ezikhaliphile, ezinjengezikhumbuzo zezimoto, izakhiwo ezinkulu, noma izinhlelo zokuhamba. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha, kodwa futhi nokuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubunjiniyela buye buguquka. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona emhlabeni wonke? Yebo, mngani! Abantu bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezintsha, futhi lokhu kudala amathuba amasha. Ngabe ubunjiniyela bukhona ezindaweni ezinjengokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, noma izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile? Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Ngabe ubunjiniyela buhamba kanjani nezobuchwepheshe? Lokhu kuyinto ebalulekile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ubunjiniyela bukhona ukuze buphendule. Cabanga nje ngama-drones, izinhlelo zokusebenza, noma izimoto ezizimele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ubunjiniyela buhamba phambili ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zidinga ubunjiniyela ukuze zisebenze? Lokhu kudinga abantu abanolwazi ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Usain Bolt: Umjaho Ohlonishwayo Nokuphila Kwamandla UUsain Bolt, umjaho wezemidlalo ophakeme, uphumelele izicoco eziningi emhlabeni wokuqhudelana. Ubuye waziwe njengenhloko yezeMidlalo, futhi uyisibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima nokuzinikela. UBolt, owazalwa ngomhla ka-21 kuMfumfu ngo-1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayiqa, uqale ukuthola udumo lwakhe ngonyaka ka-2008 lapho ebuya nephayona elisha emkhakheni wezemidlalo. Ukuqala Kwezemidlalo UUsain uqale umjaho wakhe wokuqhudelana eseyingane. Uthole uhlelo lwezemidlalo esikoleni, lapho athola khona ithuba lokukhombisa amakhono akhe. Ngemva kokuhamba esikoleni, uqhubekile nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe, futhi wathola ithuba lokuphuma emqhudelwaneni wezinga eliphezulu. Uthole ithuba lokudlala eminyakeni yakhe yokukhula, lapho echitha khona isikhathi esiningi eqhuba emijahweni ehlukene. Ukukhula Kwempumelelo Ngonyaka ka-2008, uBolt waphumelela emqhudelwaneni wezigaba ezintathu ze-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m eMidlalweni Yezwe eBeijing. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yakhe, ngoba waphula irekhodi lomhlaba we-100m no-200m, okwakuyizinto ezazihlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBolt waphinde wathola izindondo eziningi emqhudelwaneni wezimpumelelo zezemidlalo, okuhlanganisa neMidlalo ye-Olympic. Isimanje Nezinkanyezi UUsain Bolt ungumuntu ophila impilo ejabulisayo neyingqayizivele. Ubonakale ezinkundleni zomphakathi, edlala izimfashini ezihlukile, nokuhamba kwenhlonipho. Ubuyise umoya omuhle emijahweni, futhi ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukufinyelela empumelelweni kudinga ukuzinikela. Uthakasela umculo, futhi ugqugquzela abanye ukuba benze kahle emikhakheni yabo. Ubuye abe nezinhloso zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, lapho edlala indima ebalulekile ekuxhaseni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izingane ezisematheni. Imiphumela Yempumelelo UUsain Bolt akavumi nje ukujabulisa abalandeli bakhe emijahweni, kodwa uphinde abe yisibonelo sokusebenza kanzima. Ukuphumelela kwakhe kwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu kumjaho wezokuthuthukiswa. Uhlonishwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi izifundo zakhe zokuphila zikhombisa ukuthi yize ubungozi bungahlala, impumelelo ingafinyelelwa. Uthumele umyalezo obalulekile wokuthi, "Kuhle uma uthanda, kodwa kuncono uma ulungiselela." Ukwaziswa Ngesikhathi Esimnandi Njengoba esho, uBolt akashiyi nje imiphumela emijahweni, kodwa uphinde abeyisibonelo sokuhlonipha izifundo, uthando lwezemidlalo, nomsebenzi. Uqhubeke nokugcina umphakathi ubambisene nabanye, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abawuthandayo umjaho. Ukukhula kwakhe kungenxa yokuthi waqonda ukuthi umzamo, ukukhuthazela, kanye nezifundo zibalulekile empilweni. Ukwakha Ikhono Nezinga Eliphezulu UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli ophakeme, futhi izifundo zokuphila zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele phambili. Uhlonishwa njengomunye wezinkanyezi eziphezulu emijahweni. Ukuphumelela kwakhe akugcini nje emijahweni, kodwa kubonakalisa kahle ukuthi amazwe amaningi akwazi ukufinyelela empumelelweni uma kunokusebenza kanzima. Uhlale ejabule futhi eqinisa izixhumanisi phakathi kwezemidlalo nabathandi bazo. Isiphetho Usain Bolt ungomunye wabaphumeleli abaningi emlandweni wezokugijima. Ubuchwepheshe bakhe, okwenza kube lula ukufunda kubathandi bezemidlalo, buye bukhumbuleka emhlabeni wonke. Uhlala ethokozisa futhi emikhakheni yezeMidlalo, kodwa futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila kuhle uma umuntu ebhekisisa indlela yokuphila nezifiso. Ubuye asize ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokhu kumenza abe yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi impumelelo iyenzeka uma umuntu esebenza kanzima. UUsain Bolt, okungukuthi, ungumgibeli ophakeme, ubalulekile emlandweni wezokugijima, futhi uyisibonelo esifanele sokuqhubeka nokwakha.
### Umculo WaseNingizimu Afrika Umculo waseNingizimu Afrika unomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, kodwa kuleli zwe, unomoya wemvelo, unothile futhi uhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo ezahlukene. Umhlaba wakhe ugcwele izwi, imisindo nemigqa yeziqu, edala umoya omuhle ophakamisa imizwa. Umculo awusizi kuphela ekudlaleni, kodwa uphinde uqhakambise ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kokuvuka kwelanga, abantu baseMakhaza bahlala bejabulile, behlangana emicimbini yomculo. Umama uGugulethu, umculi wendawo, wayevame ukuhamba ezitaladeni, eqhuba imicimbi emifushane. WayenguMzukulu, umculi ophilayo owayebhalela umculo ophuma ezinyaweni zezingelosi. Owayengabukeli konke lokhu, wathola umoya wakhe ungene ekubhaleni izinkanyezi ngenhliziyo, ngoba umculo uthinta wonke umuntu. Ngonyaka othile, ubaba uThabo, umphakathi wabo wathola ithuba lokuhlangana emikhosini yomculo, lapho bonke abantu baphuma ezimpilweni zabo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlangana, kwaqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo weGqom, owawuhamba nezinsuku ezijabulisayo, wawugubha. Umculo weGqom, owavela ezindaweni zamadolobha, uxhasa umoya opholile, uhambelana nemizwa yentshisekelo nezinhlelo zamasiko. Kwakuwumcimbi ophakamisa umoya, amaqembu afana noMampintsha noBabes Wodumo adlala imicimbi emikhulu. Zonke izinsuku, izinsimbi zabantu zaziphakanyiswa, zikhuthaza imicabango nezincwadi. Abantwana bahlala behleka, bejabulile, bedlala phansi kwezinkanyezi zasehlobo. UThabo, umyeni kaGugulethu, wayengumqondisi omkhulu. Waqhubeka phambili waphonsa ama-CDs akhe ahlakaniphile. Wasebenza njengomqondisi, edlala izigqi ezivusa imizwa ezivela ezwenikazi. Ngempela, umculo wawungowokuphila, futhi ekugcineni, uGugulethu wagxila eMarimba, ngendlela ethokozisayo. Ngenkathi ethola izinkanyezi ezintsha, waqala ukusebenza nabaculi abasha. Bahlanganyela emkhankasweni, baphakamisela umculo njengoba umoya wabo uguquka. Umculo, kuleli sonto, wawumangalisa, umphakathi ubonisa indlela yokwakha, izinkanyezi zikhanya, zonke imiphakathi ihlangene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo noGugulethu basungula umkhosi omkhulu, ngenhloso yokuphakamisela umculo waseNingizimu Afrika. Kwakupa ubuciko, ukuzwakala kwemibala, neziya ezivela empilweni, nezikhathi ziduduza nezikhumbuzo. Umphakathi wenza kahle, umculo waba umoya wokuxhumana, ukwaziswa kwezindatshana ezinothile, ngezimfundiso ezithokozisayo. Ekhaya, umculo waxhentshela iAfrika, uqhume imikhumbuzo, nhlangothi zombili zezwe. Abantwana bephonsa izinkanyezi, uGugulethu edlala izinsimbi ezivela ezihlahleni, ophethe amaphuzu avusa impilo. UThabo, odlalisa abantwana, ukuze baqhubeke bejabulisa imiphakathi yabo. Bakha amakhono kulo mkhankaso, ubuchwepheshe, umgaqo-nkqubo, nomoya, konke kithina. Umgubho waze wafika, konke kwahamba kahle. Umphakathi ubhalise konke okwenziwa kulezi zinsuku, nolimi lwezinkanyezi lwezindaba, ube udawe. Kwagcwaliseka izikhumbuzo eziningi, bekhumbula izinsikazi ezinjengamaphupho, nezifiso zamaqiniso. Umculo waqhubeka nokukhanyisela, kanye neziqu ezintsha ezikhanyayo ezivela empilweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wakhumbula umculo wabo, wezwa ukufudumala, uhlanga lwakhe lwawukhumbula izinkanyezi. UThabo noGugulethu bahlala nomndeni, banokuhluka, kodwa baphila ngokuhlangana, uxolo, uthando, nomculo. Umculo ube yimpumelelo, okuwumbono wezinkanyezi, umoya onqobayo, nokuvusa imizwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umculo ungowethemba, uhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezihambisanayo, wonke umuntu wengeza imizwa yothando, uqhubeke ungekho. Umculo, ezinzisa ezinsukwini, ungowomndeni, ungowokholo, ngezimoto ezinhle zomoya, uveza wonke umuntu endaweni evulekile. Umhlaba, ubuthongo, uvuka, ngomculo uyikwa, uSomdaka, iMikhulu, noMsholozi, ubehlelo, umusa, umoya, izinto ezihambisanayo. Kanjalo, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika uyaziqhenya, udinga ukuba uqhubeke, uthokozise, ube yimvelaphi. Ngoba umculo ubonisa ubuhlobo, ubonisa ubuntu. Umuzi wethu ube umculo, umhlaba ube umusa, konke lokho kudinga ukuhamba kancane, njengesikhathi sizophila. Okwamanje, asiphathe umculo, asixoxe ngakho, sizwe izwi, singavuma ukuba uyiqoqe, umculo nokuhlangana. Ngakho umculo owamukelwa eNingizimu Afrika awuthathi nje ibhadi, kodwa ubukeka njengomqondisi, uhlaziya, ubonise izindlela ezingalezi ukuthi umhlaba ubuhlungu, futhi ungakhuluma ngezinto ezinjalo ngendlela ephilayo. Umculo ungowethu, umculi ungowethu, umoya ungowethu, umhlaba ungowethu. Asithokoze, asithokozise ngemihlangano yokuhlala, umculo ube yinsika yethu, iqhubeka, isigqoko sethu, i-Africa.
Umbiko: Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Isingeniso Izinkinga zemigwaqo zihlala zishiya umthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola lezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithuthukisa izimo zokuhamba, zikwazi nokukhulisa umnotho wendawo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezinkingeni ezisemqoka, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingasetshenziswa. Izinkinga Eziphambili Ezinye zezinkinga ezibhekiswe emigwaqweni zifaka phakathi izimbobo, ukungabi nalungiselelo olufanele, kanye nokuntuleka kwezimpawu zomgwaqo. Izimbobo ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, zibangela ukuhamba kancane kwezithuthi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Ukungabi nalungiselelo okufanelekile kwenza kube nzima ukulawula ukuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomthamo omkhulu wezithuthi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungqubuzana, okuvame ukuholela ezimeni ezinzima zezimoto. Izimbangela Zezinkinga Izizathu eziholela kulezi zinkinga ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungabikhona kwemali yokulungisa imigwaqo kuholela ekutheni izinkinga zihlale zikhona. Ukuze kube nezinhlaka ezihamba phambili kwezokuthutha, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza ezikhona kulimaza ukusebenza kwemigwaqo. Abantu abavame ukuhamba ngemoto, kodwa uma imigwaqo ingalungile, lokhu kuyabaphazamisa. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela wezinkinga zemigwaqo emperorshi ubalulekile. Izimbobo ezinkulu zingaholela ezimeni zokuhlala ezingezinhle, njengokungabi bikho kokwaneliseka kwabantu. Lokhu kungathinta ezokuthutha, futhi kuholele ebhizinisini eliphazamisekile. Abanye abantu bayakhetha ukungasebenzisi izithuthi zabo ngenxa yezimo ezingezinhle, okuholela ekwehleni kokuhamba okwenziwa ngamasosha. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kokuhamba kwabantu, okungakha umphakathi ongenamandla. Izixazululo Ezikhona Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisebenzayo ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Okokuqala, umnyango wezokuthutha kumele uqinisekise ukuthi kukhuphuka imali yokulawula nokulungisa imigwaqo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimo zokuhamba, kunciphise izingozi, futhi kukhuphule ukuhamba kwemithwalo. Okwesibili, ukwenza izinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukulawula izithuthi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo iyahlolwa njalo. Ukwamukela Izindlela Zokuxhumana Ukwamukela izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi kumphakathi nakubasebenzi ezindaweni zomgwaqo kuzokwandisa ukuqonda ngezinkinga ezikhona. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebonakalayo kumphakathi ngezinhlelo zokwakha, izikhathi zokulungisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukubekezela. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuhlela kahle izinto zabo. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezidingekayo zokuhamba. Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza, ukulawula kahle, kanye nokuhlola izinkinga ezikhona kuzokwenza umphakathi uthuthuke. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha imigwaqo engcono, ethuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu nempilo yansuku zonke. Umsebenzi onzima udinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Sifuna ukufinyelela imigwaqo esheshayo, ephephile, nephumelelayo, ukuze sikhulise umnotho nempilo yomphakathi.
Ukufuduka Kwezakhamuzi Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kubalulekile emlandweni wezwe, kuhlobene nezigigaba ezahlukene ezithinta impilo, umnotho, nezokuhlaliswa. Lokhu kufuduka kuhambisana nezimo zomnotho, izimpilo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nobudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi zendawo nezangaphandle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu zokufuduka, izinselelo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Izizathu Zokufuduka Izizathu zokufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle zihlukaniswa ngezici ezahlukene, njengezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlaliswa. Abantu abaningi bafuduka befuna amathuba angcono emsebenzini, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela emazweni anobunzima bezomnotho noma ezepolitiki. Ngokwesibonelo, abantu abavela eZimbabwe, eMozambique, naseMalawi bahlala begxile eNingizimu Afrika ngenxa yokukhula komnotho kanye namathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Lokhu kudala ukwanda kwezisebenzi, okwenza kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimbonini ezifana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezinsiza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo ezinzima emazweni afana neSyria ne-Afghanistan zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphume ezweni labo, befuna ukuphepha nokuthula. Ukuqhuma kwezinsongo ezibangelwa yizimpi, izinhlekelele zemvelo, kanye nezimo ezinzima zokuphila kuholela emiphumeleni ethile yokufuduka. KwaNingizimu Afrika, abantu abaningi befuna ukuphila kahle, umphakathi ophumelelayo, kanye namathuba afana nemfundo engcono. Izinsiza Nezinselelo Zokuhlaliswa Nakuba ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kunikeza amathuba, kuza nezinsiza ezinzima. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zikhulu zihlala kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinselelo ezihlobene nezokuhlaliswa. Njengoba abantu bangaphandle befika, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni evikelekile, futhi banelungelo lokuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Izinselelo zizophinde zikhule uma kukhona umbandela omubi phakathi kwezindawo zabantu bendabuko nezangaphandle, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eyahlukanisiwe. Lokhu kungadala umqondo wokuphikisana okungase kubangele izinkinga zokuqonda, ubuhlobo obubi, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Imiphumela Yomphakathi Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kunezimpande ezijulile emiphumeleni eminingi yomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi emisha, ethinta imikhuba yokuphila, izinkolelo, nezilimi. Ukuxuba kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eyingqayizivele, enezinhlobonhlobo zezemfundo, izinkolelo, nezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kungaba yinzuzo enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhuthazayo, kanye nokuthuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokucabanga. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela ingase ibe nemiphumela emibi njengoba abantu bangaphandle bahlupheka ngezinkinga zomnotho, ubuhlanga, nezokuphila. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi ethile ebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengezinga eliphezulu lokuphila, ukungasebenzi, nokungabi nandaba komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zezakhamuzi zendawo, okwenza kube baluleke kakhulu ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onezinto ezahlukene ezithinta izimo zomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlaliswa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu, izinsiza, nezinselelo ezihlobene nalolu hlobo lokufuduka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi oseNingizimu Afrika uhlala ubumbene, kudingeka ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwezizinda zempilo, izinhlelo zempilo, kanye nezinsiza.
