Ngakho-ke, ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kufanele kubhekwane ngeso elibanzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unokuthula, ubumbene, futhi ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila.
Isingeniso seCOVID-19 Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba uhlangabezana nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta impilo yabantu. Phakathi kwalezi zinguquko, iCOVID-19 ibe yisihloko esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Le nhlobo yeziqubu ibangele izinkinga eziningi, kubandakanya ukulahleka kwemindeni, izinkinga zezomnotho, kanye nemiphumela emibi empilweni yengqondo. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile ngezihloko ezihlobene neCOVID-19, okuhlanganisa ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka, ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nemiphumela yayo. Ukuhlukaniswa Kwezimvo Ukuze siqonde iCOVID-19 kahle, kufanele sihlole izindlela zokulawulwa kwayo. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukulawulwa kweCOVID-19 kudinga izinyathelo ezinzima, ezifana nokuhlukaniswa, ukuvalwa kwezindawo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola umuthi. Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuzimisela, kodwa abanye abantu baphikisa, becabanga ukuthi zidalela ukucindezeleka nokuphazamiseka emisebenzini yabo. Nokho, abanye baphikisana nabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusabalala kweCOVID-19. Njengoba izibalo zikhombisa ukukhula kwezifo, abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukungazikhathaleli kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zempilo, futhi izinyathelo ezinzima zingasiza ekunciphiseni lezi zingozi. Izimpikiswano Zokulawulwa Enye yezimpikiswano ezisemqoka ngalesi sikhathi iwukuthi izinyathelo zokulawulwa kweCOVID-19 zixhasa impilo yomphakathi kangakanani. Abanye abantu baphikisa imithetho yokuhlukaniswa, ukuvalwa kwezindawo, kanye nezidingo zokuhlala ekhaya, ngokuthi lezi zinyathelo zibangela ukuwohloka emnothweni. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza phakathi kwababusi, abezindaba, kanye nezakhamizi. Umnotho unokuthuthuka uma abantu bejolise ekusebenzeni, kodwa ukuvalwa kwabo kungaholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvimbela ukusabalala kweCOVID-19 kubalulekile, njengoba ukungabi nakunakekelwa kwezempilo kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Ukwamukela Imithi Nezindlela Zokuvikela Ngokukhula kokuhlola, imithi ehlukene yeCOVID-19 ivelile. Lokhu kudala izinkulumo ezithokozisayo, njengoba imithi ethile ibonakala isebenza kahle. Nokho, lokho kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Ukuze abantu bathole imithi, kumele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola, futhi abantu kumele bazi ukuthi le mithi ayiyona imithi yokwelapha, kodwa iyindlela yokuvikela. Kanjalo, ezinye izifundazwe zikhuthaza ukuphepha komphakathi, njengoba abantu beqala ukufunda ngalesi sifo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ukufundiswa kwabantu ngeCOVID-19 kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezihlobene nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Umthelela Wempilo Yengqondo I-COVID-19 ayithinti kuphela impilo yomzimba, kodwa futhi ithinta impilo yengqondo. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningi baphila nokucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nomqondo ophukile ngenxa yokuhlukana nezothando, ukungakwazi ukuhamba, nokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iziphathimandla zifake izinhlelo zokusekela abantu abaphethwe yizinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Abantu kumele bakhumbule ukuthi akekho ophila ngaphansi kwemithetho engavunyelwe, futhi lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuba baphile kahle. Ukwakha izikhungo zokusekela nokuhlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo kwenza abantu bazizwe beqhamuka futhi bekhululekile, okubalulekile ukuze bathole imiphumela emihle. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iCOVID-19 ibonisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinyathelo ezicacile, ezihlanganisa izimvo ezihlukene. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukulawulwa kweCOVID-19 akuyona into elula, futhi izinqumo zidinga ukucabangela kahle. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi, kanye nokubona ukuthi impilo yomphakathi ibalulekile, kuyisihluthulelo sokubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta iCOVID-19. Ngokubambisana, singabhekana nezinkinga ezinzima, sisebenzisana ukuze sithole izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze impilo, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nokukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ukuze simise lesi sifo esinzima. I-COVID-19 ingathinta impilo yethu, kodwa ngokuhlanganyela, singaphumelela.
I-Load Shedding Nomthelela Wayo Emnothweni I-Load shedding, noma ukuhoxiswa kukagesi, yinto esiyaziyo kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqubo, eyenzeka lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokukhiqiza ugesi, ibonakala njengomphumela wokungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wayo emnothweni, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezithile zomlando ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, i-Escom, okuyinkampani eyinhloko yokusabalalisa ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, yathola ukuthi izinsiza zayo zokukhiqiza ugesi ziqhubeka zincipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwaholela ekutheni kube nezikhathi zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umnotho wawusakhula, kodwa izinkampani eziningi zathola ukuthi zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungabi nokwaneliseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Load shedding yaba yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweminyaka ye-2015 kuya ku-2020. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehliseni ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, okwakuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo ezinkampanini. Izinkampani ezincane, ikakhulukazi, zathinteka kakhulu, njengoba zazingakwazi ukukhokhela izinkonzo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezinzima. Lokhu kwagcina kuholela ekwandeni kwenani labantu abangasebenzi, okwakukhathaza kakhulu uhulumeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-load shedding ayisiyona nje inkinga yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kodwa futhi ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo yomnotho. Izimboni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezincike kakhulu kumshini, zathola ukuthi zidinga ukwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, njengoba izinkampani zazingakwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela we-load shedding wawungaphezu kwezomnotho kuphela. Umphakathi waba nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila, njengoba abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Izikole, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokusebenza zaphinde zathinteka, okwakwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuhamba phambili empilweni yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka emphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uqala ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuphendula kulolu hlobo lwesimo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi, ngokwakha iziteshi ezintsha zokukhiqiza ugesi. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zathatha isikhathi, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka ubhekana nezinkinga zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa amandla elanga, zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwakusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngaphandle kokuncika kuphela kumphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, kodwa umphakathi wawusadinga isikhathi ukuze ubuyisele emuva umnotho. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda ngezifundo ezitholakele. I-load shedding yakhombisa ukuthi umnotho awungaphumeleli uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baziqhenye ngezindlela zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, futhi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuba nezinhlelo ezizinzile zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokwenza izinyathelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ubhekane ne-load shedding. Kukhona ukuzimisela okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, okukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okuphendula. Umnotho, nakuba ubhekene nezinkinga, uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokufuna izixazululo ezihlakaniphile. Ngakho-ke, i-load shedding ibonisa ukuthi umnotho awukwazi ukuhamba phambili uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Kodwa futhi ibonisa amandla abantu, ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphendula ezinkingeni, futhi baphile kahle, naphezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nabo. Lokhu kwenza umphakathi uqhubeke nokukhula, futhi ubheke phambili, ungavumeli izinkinga ziwuphazamise. I-Load shedding, nakuba iyinkinga enkulu, iyisifundo esibalulekile kumphakathi, esifundisa ukubaluleka kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, nokuthi umphakathi unamandla okuphendula ezinkingeni.
Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 eNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisigaba esisha sokuphila kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, lapho kwavulwa amathuba amasha emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle leli phepha, kubalulekile ukubheka izigameko ezaholela kulolu khetho, izinqubo ezazisetshenziswa, kanye nemiphumela yalo. Ngonyaka ka-1990, umholi we-ANC, uNelson Mandela, wakhululwa ejele, lapho abesebenza khona iminyaka engama-27. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, kwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukukhululwa kukaMandela kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlangano eziningi ezazifuna ukulwa nokucindezelwa, futhi kwavula ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, izinkulungwane zabantu zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhetheni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubuyisana, lapho abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene behlangana ukuze bakhe ikusasa elisha. Ukuze kube nokhetho oluqondile, izinhlelo zokuvota zaphakanyiswa, futhi izikhungo zokuvota zavulwa ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abaningi, kuhlanganise nabesifazane, ukuba bavote, okwakungakaze kube khona ngaphambili. Uhlelo lokhetho lwaluqukethe izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokuvota ezisemthethweni. Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, bekhombisa isifiso sabo sokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubambisana, lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukwamukelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo. UNelson Mandela waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama weNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu behlanganyela. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha, futhi kwavulwa amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlanganise nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezomnotho. Ukwamukelwa kukaMandela njengomongameli kwaholela ekwakheni uhulumeni obumbene, owawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwavula ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha, futhi kwavulwa amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlanganise nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezomnotho. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 awugcini nje ngokuba yisigameko esibalulekile, kodwa ubonisa amandla abantu uma behlanganyela. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu bephakamisa izwi labo. UNelson Mandela waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi wakhombisa ukuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zaba khona, kodwa umqondo wokubumbana wahlala uqinile. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwaluhlala lukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze bakhe ikusasa el better. Uhlelo lwezokhetho lwaba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele, futhi bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele, futhi bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu behlanganyela, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. UNelson Mandela, njengomholi, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ngakho-ke, umlando wokhetho luka-1994 ungomunye wezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe, futhi ubonisa amandla abantu uma behlanganyela. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. UNelson Mandela waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi wakhombisa ukuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini: Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mkhize Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukuxoxa noMnu. Thabo Mkhize, ongumholi wezobuchwepheshe enkampanini ethuthukisa izixazululo ze-AI. Uhlelo lwethu lwentatheli lubheke kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI emsebenzini, kuhlu lwezinto ezishintsha indlela esisebenza ngayo. Mnu. Mkhize, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuzoxoxa nathi namuhla. Umbuzo 1: Yini i-AI, futhi iyini indima yayo emsebenzini? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngiyabonga. I-AI, noma i-Artificial Intelligence, iyindlela yokwenza izinhlelo zibe nekhono lokucabanga, ukufunda, nokwenza izinqumo ngokwakho. Emsebenzini, i-AI isiza kakhulu ekwenzeni amaphrojekthi aphumelelayo. Isibonelo, ikwazi ukusiza ekucubunguleni idatha enkulu, ibone izitayela, futhi ithuthukise izinqubomgomo eziphusile. Lokhu kusiza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze kahle, zinciphise izindleko, futhi zenze imikhiqizo ethuthukile. Umbuzo 2: Ingabe i-AI ithinta zonke izimboni ngokufanayo? Mnu. Mkhize: Yebo, i-AI iyathinta izimboni eziningi. Emkhakheni wezokwakha, isibonelo, ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphakathi nendawo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Kwezokuhweba, i-AI isiza ekuthengiseni imikhiqizo ngendlela eqondile. Nakuba izimboni zingahluka, umphumela wokusebenzisa i-AI uvame ukuba yimpumelelo. Lokhu kugqugquzela abanye ukuba baqhubeke nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezivela ekusetyenziswa kwe-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, i-AI ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imisebenzi yansuku zonke iyenziwa kahle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo. Okwesibili, i-AI ingasiza ukunciphisa amaphutha. Ngokuvamile, abantu bayaphutha, kodwa uma usebenzisa i-AI, amathuba okwenza amaphutha ancipha kakhulu. Okwesithathu, ivumela izinkampani ukuthi zibe nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende, okuyinto engcono kakhulu emqhudelwaneni. Umbuzo 4: Zikhona izinselelo ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Okokuqala, ukungaqondi kahle indlela i-AI esebenza ngayo kungaholela ezinkingeni. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi i-AI ayiyona isixazululo esiphelele, futhi kumele isetshenziswe ngobuchule. Okwesibili, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza zokuthuthukisa i-AI, ezihlanganisa abantu abaneziqu eziphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu, okungase kube inkinga ezinkampanini ezincane. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi i-AI izoshintsha kanjani umhlaba wezokusebenza emasikweni ezayo? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngikholelwa ukuthi i-AI izoba nomthelela omkhulu. Izinkampani zizoba nekhono lokwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ezizocacisa ukuphumelela kwazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha nabaphathi bazoba namathuluzi angcono okuphatha abasebenzi. I-AI izovumela abantu ukuthi bagxile emisebenzini ethuthukisayo, ngenkathi imisebenzi ejwayelekile iphathwa ngama-robot. Lokhu kuzoletha izinguquko ezithokozisayo emsebenzini. Umbuzo 6: Yimaphi amakhono abantu abadinga ukuwathuthukisa ukuze bahlangabezane nezinguquko ezilethwa yi-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Ukuze abantu bahlangabezane nezinguquko, kudingeka baphucule amakhono abo. Izifundo eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe, njengokufunda ngama-algorithms, zizoba usizo olukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhono okuxhumana, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, nokucabanga okujulile azoba neqhaza elikhulu. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi i-AI iyithuluzi eliwusizo, kodwa kubalulekile ukugcina umoya wabantu emsebenzini. Umbuzo 7: Ekugcineni, ungathanda ukwabelana ngakho okwengeziwe mayelana ne-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngiyabonga. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi i-AI ingumngani wezinkampani, kodwa kufanele siyisebenzise ngendlela eqondile. Abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekusebenzeni kwe-AI, futhi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI kuzokwenza umhlaba umsebenzi ube ngcono. Ngakho, asiqhubekeleni phambili, sibuye sizinakekele izinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mkhize, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi lwakho ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini kuyashintsha, futhi kubalulekile ukuba abathintekayo balungiselele izinguquko ezizayo. Uhlelo lwethu lwentatheli luthokozisa ukuhlangana nezinkampani ezisebenzisa i-AI ukuze ziqedele imisebenzi ethile, futhi sizokubona lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Amagwinya - Ingxoxo Ngesiko Lokudla Kwethu Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukufika komlobi wethu, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu, ongumculi, umphakathi, futhi ongumsebenzi wezokudla. U-Sipho uyaziwa kakhulu ngempela ngamagwinya akhe, okwenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi sithanda ukwazi kabanzi ngalesi sidlo esidumile. Umbuzo 1: U-Sipho, ungachaza kanjani amagwinya? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Amagwinya, uma ngicabanga ngawo, angumkhiqizo othandwayo emakhaya ethu. Ziyizinkwa ezincane, ezivame ukujiywa, ezikhiqizwa ngempela ngempela ngezithako ezilula ezifana nophuthu, amanzi, noshukela. Zinezindlela eziningi zokupheka, kungaba ngefrypan, oven, noma ngisho nangemva kokuhlanza emlilweni. Amagwinya ayingxenye ebalulekile yemikhosi yethu, izinsuku zokuhlala, nokudla kwasekuseni. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza amagwinya akho ahluke kwabanye? U-Sipho: Ngicabanga ukuthi okokuqala, amagwinya ami akhiwa ngothando. Ngisebenzisa izithako ezisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi umoya owenziwe lapho ngipheka udlala indima enkulu. Ngikhetha izithako ezivela ezindaweni ezithile, futhi ngiyazama ukuhlanganisa izindlela zakudala nezamanje. Ngithanda ukufaka izithako ezikhethekile, njengemifino noma amafutha anempilo, ukuze ngenze amagwinya ami ahluke. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi amagwinya adlala kanjani indima empilweni yamasiko ethu? U-Sipho: Amagwinya ayingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu. Ziyizinkwa ezihlanganisa abantu, zenza kube lula ukufika ndawonye. Ngaphandle kokudla, zikhumbuza abantu ngezikhathi ezinhle, imicimbi, nezikhathi zokuthokozisa. Ngiyakhumbula, ngesikhathi sokuhlangana komndeni, sithokozisa amagwinya, sikhuluma, sibhakabhaka izinkumbulo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe unayo imfihlo ethile yokwenza amagwinya? U-Sipho: Yebo, ngicabanga ukuthi imfihlo ingekho kuphela ezithakweni, kodwa nasekuthandeni lokho okwenziwayo. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ungeze uhlelo oluthile, njengokupheka amagwinya ngothando, kuyashintsha konke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyazama ukugcina izinga lokushisa elilungile, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi isikhathi sokupheka singaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuxhumana nezithako, ukuzwa umoya, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Umbuzo 5: U-Sipho, ungakuchaza kanjani umphakathi wakho? U-Sipho: Umphakathi wami ungowabantu abathanda ukudla, abahlala bexhumene. Siphila emiphakathini ehlukene, kodwa sonke sithanda amagwinya. Ngiyavuma ukuthi emakhaya ethu, amagwinya akhumbuza abantu ngezinsuku ezinhle. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu baye bazama ukwenza amagwinya ahluke, kodwa umoya wokuhlanganyela uhlale uqinile. Umbuzo 6: Ucabanga ukuthi amagwinya angashintsha kanjani esikhathini esizayo? U-Sipho: Ngicabanga ukuthi amagwinya azohlala ebamba indawo ebalulekile. Nokho, ngicabanga ukuthi kuzoba nezinqumo eziningi ezizokwenziwa. Abantu bazoba nezinselelo zokwakha, bazokwenza amagwinya anempilo, bese behlola izindlela ezahlukene zokupheka. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi amagwinya akhule, futhi kube nezindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganyela. Isiphetho U-Sipho Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi amagwinya awanqatshelwa kuphela njengokudla, kodwa njengomkhiqizo ohlanganisa abantu, imikhuba, nezinkumbulo. Ngaphandle kokuba umphakathi ubambe iqhaza, amagwinya akhe akhombisa ubuciko, uthando, kanye nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngiyabonga, u-Sipho, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi esihle nathi. Amagwinya akho ayohlala enza izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi sizokubona emicimbini yethu ezayo.
uThabo Mbeki - Umholi Ohloniphekayo UThabo Mbeki ungumholi ophawulekayo kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, owabamba isikhundla sikaMengameli phakathi kweminyaka ka-1999 no-2008. Wazalelwa eMbizana, edolobheni eliseMpumalanga Kapa, ngomhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu ngowe-1942. Uthando lwakhe kwezombusazwe lwaqala ngesikhathi esenhlangano eNyuvesi yaseTshwane, lapho athola khona ukuqonda okujulile ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokwehlukaniswa kwabantu. Lokhu kwehlukaniswa kwaba umthombo wezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwezakhamuzi ezahlukene. Njengomholi we-ANC (iAfrican National Congress), uThabo Mbeki wathatha izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane, edlala indima ebalulekile ekuphishekeni nasekukhululekeni. Umsebenzi wakhe wahlanganisa nokusekela uNelson Mandela, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo esinamandla ekuphikisaneni nobandlululo. Ukwaziswa kukaMbeki kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, njengoba waba nobudlelwano obuhle nezinye izizwe. Uhlanga lwakhe lokubambisana lwaholela ekwakheni izivumelwano ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, umnotho, nezokuhlalisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, uMbeki wahola izifundo eziningi zamazwe ase-Afrika, ethuthukisa umbono wokwakha umnotho oqinile nokuxhumanisa amazwe. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili njengomengameli, uThabo Mbeki wabhekana nezihe ezinzima. Iziphikiso ezivela emiphakathini mayelana nezinqumo zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezimayelana nezindaba zokusebenza kazwelonke, zakhumbuza abanye ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ongenamahloni, ophikisana nezimvo zomphakathi. Nokho, akumelanga kulahlekelwe umbono omuhle owawuhambisana noMbeki. Waziwa nangokusebenzisa izindlela eziphusile zokuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima, okuholele emthethweni omkhulu empilweni yabantu. UThabo Mbeki ubalulekile emlandweni wombuso waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi umbono wakhe wokwakha i-Afrika eqinile usaqhubeka nokuphila. Njengomholi, wayenobuhlakani obumangalisayo, ezama ukuhlanganisa abantu bezizinda ezihlukene ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Ubuye abe yisibonelo sokuthi ubuholi obuhle busekelwe ekuthandeni abantu, ukuhlonipha izidingo zabo, kanye nokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Izimvo zikaMbeki mayelana nezindaba ezinjengobandlululo, umnotho, nezokuphepha zihlala zikhona emqondweni wabantu. Akumangalisi ukuthi, izithombe ezibhalwe uMbeki zikhumbuza izizukulwane ezizayo mayelana nemithwalo ethwala ubuholi. UThabo Mbeki, njengomholi, ukhumbuleka ngokukhuthaza izakhamuzi ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa isimo sabo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Kulo mhlaba wezezimali eziguqukayo, uMbeki ubalulekile ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokubambisana kanye nokwakha izixazululo ezizinzile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugxile ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwe-Afrika nezinye izifunda zomhlaba, edinga ukuqaphela ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, futhi uphakamisa umqondo wokuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufaka isandla ekwakheni izwe elingcono. Noma kunini lapho uThabo Mbeki edlula, uthinta abantu ngezwi lakhe elinamandla, elikhuthaza. Umsebenzi wakhe usaqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha, ubafundisa ukuthi ubuholi buhamba nezinhlelo ezithile, futhi kufanele kube nokuzimisela okukhulu ukuze uphumelele. UThabo Mbeki ungumholi obekwe emlandweni, futhi izenzo zakhe zikhumbula izifundo ezibalulekile ezizothinta umhlaba ngezizukulwane ezizayo. Ngaphandle komqondo wakhe, izinto eziningi ezikhona namuhla zingase zingabikhona. Ngokubhala lokhu, sikhumbula uThabo Mbeki, umholi owayenobuhlakani, ubuholi obuqotho, nothando lwempilo yomphakathi. Uhambo lwakhe luhlala lukhumbuleka, njengoba ethinta abantu abaningi ngeqhaza lakhe emlandweni wobumbano, ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, nolwazi oluqinile. UThabo Mbeki uyisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, ubuholi, nokuzimisela zingaholela ekuthuthukiseni izwe.
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Ezinyangeni ezedlule, umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokukhula kwama-social media. Lezi zinkundla, njengeFacebook, Instagram, Twitter, kanye neTikTok, zihlala zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yentsha yanamuhla. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kudala ingxoxo ethakazelisayo, ethusayo, futhi evusa amadlingozi mayelana nemiphumela ethile ethinta intsha. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle umthelela wama-social media, kuhlanganise nezinzuzo nezingozi ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, masiqale ngokubheka izinzuzo zama-social media. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwentsha. Ngaphandle kwezithiyo zemikhakha, intsha iyakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto eziningi, njengezifundo, imicimbi, noma izinkinga ezibathintayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo we-communitiy, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona futhi besizana. Ngokwakha ubudlelwane obunempilo, intsha ingathola ukwesekwa, imihlahlandlela, nokuxhumana nezinye izizinda ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media anikeza ithuba elikhulu lokufunda. Ngaphandle kokuxhumana, lezi zinkundla ziqukethe ulwazi oluwusizo, olufanele, nolwakha. Abantu abavela kuzo zonke izizinda bangabelana ngemibono, izifundo, nemiphumela ehlukene. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhula, ukucabanga, nokuhlola izinto ngendlela ebanzi. Intsha ingafunda ngezinhlelo zokusebenza, izifundo ezenzakalayo, nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene, okungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele sikhulume nangemiphumela emibi. Okokuqala, ukuxhumana okungapheli kungaholela ekutheni intsha ibe nezingcindezi zempilo ezinkulu. Izithombe ezinhle nokuphila okunempilo okukhombisa abanye kuzosiza ekwakheni izinga lokuphila eliphezulu, okungaholela emoyeni wokunganeliseki. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela kulokhu okubukwayo, okubangela ukuthi baqhubeke bezama ukuphila ngendlela ethile, okungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media angaba yindawo yokubandlulula. Amathuba okudlulisa imibono ahlukeneyo angaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwane obubi, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngenxa yezinkolelo zabo, imakethe, noma imikhuba. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungaboni ngeso lengqondo, ophazamisa ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Abantu abavame ukuhlola nokuthola amaqiniso angokoqobo, futhi lokhu kungaba yingozi. Ukwengeza, kumele sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo yentsha. Ukuhlwithwa kwezinto ezikwi-inthanethi, ukushoda kokuxhumana okukhishwayo, nokushoda kwesikhathi esikhuluma nabanye abantu, kungaholela ekutheni abantu babe nezinselelo zempilo yengqondo. Ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokwehla kwemizwa kungenzeka kube yizimfanelo ezivame ukuvela ngenxa yokuxhumana okungapheli. Lokhu kudinga ukuphathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbula ukuthi ama-social media akhuthaza ubucayi nokubukeka kahle. Intsha iphakathi kokuphila emhlabeni lapho ubucayi bukhuthazwa, futhi lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukuthola izithombe ezinhle, imiklamo, namathrendi. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu baqonde ukuthi ubuhle bokuqala bukhona kuphela uma uthobela okukhombisa lokhu. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi ubuhle buhamba phambili, okuholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi. Kuwo wonke la maphuzu, kubalulekile ukuthola ibhalansi phakathi kokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela enempilo nokugwema izingozi ezihambisana nawo. Abazali, othisha, nabanye abantu abadala badinga ukusiza intsha ukuze ithole ulwazi olufanele, ikwazi ukuqonda imiphumela ehlukahlukene, nokuhlonipha izinsiza ezikhona. Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukusebenza kahle nokuziqhenya, udinga ukuqonda nokuhlola indlela yokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela efanele. Ngamafuphi, umthelela wama-social media entsheni ungaphakathi kokwaziswa, ukuzithokozisa, nokushintsha impilo. Noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, akumele sikhohlwe ngezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Ukuze intsha ibhekane nazo zonke lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuba ibe nolwazi olufanele, izikhombisi, kanye neqhaza eliqinile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelizwakalayo. Kuhlala kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu bethu, imizwa yethu, kanye nezimpilo zethu zibalulekile kakhulu kunoma yisiphi isithombe esingaphandle.
Ukufunda Ku-inthanethi - Ingxoxo Ngemikhuba Nezindlela Isingeniso Namuhla sizokhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokufunda ku-inthanethi, okuyindlela esheshayo nekhululekile yokufunda. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndlela, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumfundisi onolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokufunda. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Thabo, ngokuba lapha namuhla. Ingxenye 1: Ukufunda Ku-inthanethi - Yini? Thabo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi, noma ukufunda nge-inthanethi, kusho ukufunda ngezinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, amavidiyo, izincwadi ezidijithali, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Le ndlela ivumela abafundi ukuba bafunde ngesikhathi sabo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo yokufunda. Umbuzo: Ingabe le ndlela yokufunda iyasebenza? Thabo: Yebo, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izinzuzo eziningi. Abafundi bangafunda ngezikhathi zabo, futhi bangakhetha izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Ingxenye 2: Izinzuzo Zokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Yiziphi ezinye izinzuzo zokufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Okokuqala, ukufunda ku-inthanethi kukhulisa ukuzimela kwabafundi. Abafundi badinga ukuba bazitholele izinsiza, baphendule imibuzo, futhi benze izinqumo ezithinta ukufunda kwabo. Okwesibili, lokhu kubavumela ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, bezifunda emikhakheni ehlukene nabafundi abavela emhlabeni wonke. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona nezinselelo? Thabo: Yebo, kunezinselelo ezithile. Abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo zokuzikhandla, njengoba kungase kube lula ukuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abafundi bangase bangabi nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, okungaholela ekutheni bahluleke ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ingxenye 3: Izindlela Zokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindlela ezinhle zokufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Kunezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bangasebenzisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi ezitholakala kumasayithi afana neCoursera, Udemy, noma iedX. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bafunde ngezifundo ezihlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe kuya kwezokuphatha. Okwesibili, ukufunda ngevidiyo kuyindlela ethokozisayo, lapho abafundi bangabuka amavidiyo afundisayo ukuze baqonde kahle izifundo. Umbuzo: Ingabe izinkundla zokuxhumana zinezindima ezibalulekile? Thabo: Impela! Izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukufunda ngokubambisana. Abafundi bangaxhumana, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhulume ngezifundo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, okubalulekile ekufundeni. Ingxenye 4: Ukubaluleka Kokuzikhandla Umbuzo: Kungani ukuzikhandla kubalulekile ekufundeni ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Ukuzikhandla kubalulekile ngoba ukufunda ku-inthanethi kudinga ukuzimisela. Abafundi kufanele bazitholele izinsiza, baphendule imibuzo, futhi benze izinqumo ezithinta ukufunda kwabo. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ophusile nokuzimisela. Uma umfundi engazikhandli, angase aphuthelwe amathuba amaningi. Ingxenye 5: Ikusasa Lokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda ku-inthanethi lizinzile? Thabo: Ngempela! Ngobuchwepheshe obukhulayo, ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuzoba nethuba elikhulu. Izinhlelo zokufunda zizoba nezici ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezifundo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufakelwa (augmented reality) nezinye izindlela ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Isiphetho Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalelo yokugcina kubafundi abafuna ukufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Yebo, ngincoma abafundi ukuba bahlale bephapheme futhi bazitholele izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Bafunde ngezikhathi zabo, kodwa bahlale beqaphelekile ukuze bangaphazamiseki. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuyindlela enhle yokwandisa ulwazi, futhi uma benza kahle, bangathola amathuba amaningi empilweni. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuyindlela esheshayo, ethokozisayo, futhi enezinzuzo eziningi, futhi sizokwazi ukujabulisa izifundo zethu uma sizikhandla.
IShoprite - Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Zayo IShoprite iyindawo yokuthenga ehlonishwayo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibhekwa njengomunye wezitolo ezinkulu kakhulu kuleli. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nale ndawo yokuthenga, futhi sizohlola ukuthi iziphi izindlela ezithinta impilo yabathengi. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Okokuqala, iShoprite inikeza izintengo eziphansi, ezilungele umphakathi ophakathi nendawo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abathengi bamaNingizimu Afrika, njengoba kudingeka izimakethe ezingabizi. Izintengo ezikhangayo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bavakashele iShoprite, okwenza kube nezithombe ezinhle ngezinsizakalo zayo. Okwesibili, iShoprite inikela ngempahla ebanzi, okuvumela abathengi ukuba bathenge izinto ezidingekayo emakhaya. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, iziphuzo, nezimpahla zansuku zonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola konke abakudingayo endaweni eyodwa, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphise isikhathi sokushiya emsebenzini. Okokugcina, iShoprite ihlinzeka ngocingo olwenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezimakethe ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuhlanganyela ukuze kutholakale imininingwane ethile, njengeminyango yezezimali nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izipesheli nemikhankaso ethokozisayo, okwandisa ulwazi lwabathengi. Izinselelo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nabathengi. Okokuqala, izindleko zomsebenzi ezihambisana nezokuthenga ziya zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubathengi abathile. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abathengi kufanele baqaphele izindleko ezithile ezikhuphukayo, okwenza kube necala. Okwesibili, kukhona impikiswano mayelana nephalethi yeShoprite nezimpahla ezibizayo ezithengiswa. I-Shoprite ikhuluma kakhulu ngalesi sihloko, kodwa abanye bahlongoza ukuthi izimpahla zikhuphuka kanjani eminyakeni ethile, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imikhiqizo engabizi. Okokugcina, ubukho beShoprite emiphakathini yezezimali bunomthelela omubi ezitolo ezincane. Njengoba iShoprite iqhubeka nokwethula imikhiqizo emisha, izitolo ezincane ziba sengozini yokuntuleka. Lokhu kuholela empikiswaneni emiphakathini yethu, njengoba izitolo ezincane zikhuthaza ukuhweba okuhlukahlukene. Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, iShoprite iyindawo ebalulekile yokuthenga, kodwa iphakamisa imibuzo eminingi. Yize inezinzuzo ezinkulu, njengezintengo eziphansi nezimpahla eziningi, ubukhona bayo buveza isidingo sokuxazulula izinselelo ezithile, njengezindleko eziphakeme nezinqwaba ezithile. Lokhu kuqonda kubalulekile ukuze sithole indlela eziteshi ezinkulu ezithinta ngayo izitolo emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, sizoba nekhono lokuhola imikhankaso ehlukanisayo ekuphileni kweShoprite.
Imincintiswano Yezemidlalo: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Ubulungiswa Nobuchwepheshe Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, ihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, izizukulwane, nezizinda ezihlukene. Lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlonipha, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, ubungani, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka imincintiswano yezemidlalo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emphakathini. Ukuqala, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ivame ukuhlela ngezikhathi ezithile, ikakhulukazi emaphakathini amakhulu, ezikoleni, noma ezikhungweni zokuqeqesha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imidlalo efana nebhola, i-rugby, i-athletics, nezinye eziningi. Umcimbi uvame ukuhlela ukuze ubonise amakhono abathandi bezemidlalo, futhi uvame ukuheha izixuku ezinkulu zababukeli. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bahloniphe abaqhudelana, baphinde baphakamise umoya wokuncintisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlangana, bahlala ndawonye, futhi babelane ngemicabango nemizwa. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bexhasana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ukuzivocavoca nokubamba iqhaza emidlalweni kuthuthukisa impilo yomzimba, kunciphisa izinga lokukhathala, futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngezinkinga zokuphila eziphila kahle. Imincintiswano ibavumela abantu ukuba baphume emakhaya, bazivocavoca, futhi baphinde bathole ubungani obusha. Ngokubheka imiphumela yezenzakalo ezinjalo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo ayigcini nje ngokuba umcimbi wokuncintisana, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Imincintiswano ibalulekile ekwakheni izinkumbulo ezinhle, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlakaniphana, futhi bezama ukufinyelela imigomo yabo. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bephakamisa omunye nomunye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe. Abadlali bahlala befuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle, befundisa abanye, futhi bephinde bathuthukise amakhono abo. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemidlalo, futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlala bejabulisa, bephakamisa umoya wokuncintisana, futhi bephinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Ekugcineni, imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile sokuhlanganyela, ukuhweba, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Imincintiswano ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, futhi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze imincintiswano yezemidlalo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphume, bazivocavoce, futhi bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi onobungani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo izohlala ibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi izoqhubeka nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle, ubungani, nokuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokukhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, ubungani, kanye nokuhlanganyela, okubalulekile empilweni yethu. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze bonke abantu ukuba bahlale bejabulisa, bephakamisa omunye nomunye, futhi baphinde bahloniphe ubuchwepheshe obukhona. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokukhuthaza imincintiswano yezemidlalo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphume, bazivocavoce, futhi bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi onobungani. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile sokuhlanganyela, ukuhweba, nokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze bonke abantu ukuba bahlale bejabulisa, bephakamisa omunye nomunye, futhi baphinde bahloniphe ubuchwepheshe obukhona.
Usain Bolt: Umqeqeshi Wezimbangi Zokugijima Umbuzo: Ubani uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli odumile waseJamaica, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi zokugijima. Uzalwe ngomhla ka-21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eSherwood Content, eJamaica. Ubephakeme emqhudelwaneni wezimbangi zokugijima, ikakhulukazi emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhumbuza uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt wakhula enethemba lokudlala ibhola, kodwa wathola uthando lokugijima ngesikhathi esesikoleni. Uthole ukuqashelwa ngesikhathi enza kahle emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, futhi lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila kwakhe njengomgibeli. Wazithola esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze afeze amaphupho akhe. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimpumelelo ezinkulu zikaUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumqeqeshi ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi. Uthole amahlandla ama-8 eMidlalo ye-Olympic, lapho ahlula khona izimbangi zakhe emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Ubuye waphumelela imiqhudelwano ye-World Championships, lapho athola khona izindondo eziningi. Uthole irekhodi lomhlaba emigqeni ye-100m no-200m, okuyizikhathi ezingu-9.58 seconds no-19.19 seconds, ngokulandelana. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kanjani emlandweni wezokugijima? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezokugijima ngoba waguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngale midlalwano. Waba isibonelo sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphumelela. Ubuye waba yisithonjana sokukhuthaza abanye abantwana, ikakhulukazi eJamaica, ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Uthandwa kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yezimpumelelo zakhe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuzithoba kwakhe nendlela ahlangana ngayo nabalandeli. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhuthaza uUsain Bolt ukuba aqhubeke? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt uthi ukusebenzela umndeni wakhe kanye nezwe lakhe kube yinto eyamkhuthaza kakhulu. Uqonda ukuthi impumelelo yakhe ibaluleke kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kuye, kodwa nakubantu abaninzi abamlandelayo. Ubuye akhuthaze abanye ukuba basebenzise amathuba abawatholayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, ukusebenza kanzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angafinyelela noma yiziphi izinjongo. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubhekana kanjani nezinselelo? Impendulo: Njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, uUsain Bolt ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukulwela ukuhlala uphumelelayo emqhudelwaneni, ukugwema ukulimala, nokuphatha ingcindezi yokuba ngumgibeli ophumelele, konke kwaba yizinto ezinzima. Nokho, uBolt uthembisa ukuthi umsebenzi onzima, ukuzikhandla, kanye nokubambisana nabanye kuhlale kumphumelela. Ubuye waba nomoya ophakeme, okwenza akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo: Yini uUsain Bolt ayisebenzisela umphakathi? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt usebenzisa impumelelo yakhe ukuze asize umphakathi. Uthembisa ukweseka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantwana, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, futhi uhlanganisa imithombo yokuxhasa ezempilo kanye nemfundo. Ubuye abambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza abantwana ukuba bakhule bezithanda imidlalo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi imidlalo ingaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Izifundo eziningi zingafundwa kuUsain Bolt. Okokuqala, ukusebenza kanzima kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo. Ubuye ufundise ukuthi ukuphikelela, nokungayeki, kubalulekile ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo zakho. Ubuye ubonise ukuthi ukuhlala uzithoba nokuhlonipha abanye kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uphumelele kangakanani. UUsain Bolt ungumfanekiso ophilayo wokuthi, uma unethemba, ungafeza noma yini. Umbuzo: Yini ezayo kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Njengoba uUsain Bolt eseshayile emqhudelwaneni, ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ubonisa intshiseko yokuba umphakathi, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa abanye. Uthanda ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, futhi uqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli ophawulekayo, futhi impumelelo yakhe izohlala ibhalwe emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi, ngekhono, umsebenzi onzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, uUsain Bolt uzohlala engumfanekiso wempumelelo, futhi izifundo zakhe zizohlala zikhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo.
Izinselelo Zempilo: Uhlanga Olubhalela Umzabalazo Wethu Empilweni, izinselelo zihlala zikhona, zifana nezikhukhula eziphakamisayo. Siphila emhlabeni ogcwele izithiyo, futhi lezi zithiyo zihlala zikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ayilula. Lezi zinselelo zingavela ngezindlela ezihlukene, kusuka ezimweni ezimfushane nezincane, kuya ezinkingeni ezinzima ezichitha amandla ethu. Kulokhu, ngizobe ngizama ukucacisa izinselelo zempilo, ngendlela engicabanga ngayo, futhi ngibone ukuthi zingafundisa kanjani. Okokuqala, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izinselelo zingaba ngezemali. Ukuphila emhlabeni wamanje kubiza kakhulu, futhi abanye abantu bakhuthazeka kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemali. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu, ikakhulukazi uma ubheka umndeni. Imali ayinayo kuphela isidingo sokuphila, kodwa ibalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuthola imfundo, ukwelashwa, nezinsiza zempilo ezifanele. Umsebenzi ungaba nezinselelo zawo, futhi ukungenisa imali enganele kungaba umthwalo omkhulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinselelo zezimali zikhona, futhi kumele sizilwele ukuze siphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zempilo zikwazi ukufaka isandla ekuphathweni kwempilo yethu. Abantu abaningi balwa nezinkinga zempilo, ezinjengokugula, ukugula kwengqondo, noma izimo ezithile eziphindaphindayo. Lezi zinkinga zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu, zishiya abantu bebheda nempilo yabo. Ukubhekana nemithi, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa, kudinga amandla amaningi. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo kokuqala kubalulekile, njengoba kuyinkinga ebonisa izinselelo ezinzima. Ukwenza izinqumo ezinzima kuyinselelo eyodwa eyaziwayo, okuyinto yansuku zonke. Ukuzikhethela phakathi kwezinketho, noma ukwenza izinqumo ezinkulu ezithinta ikusasa, kungaba yinkinga. Imiphumela yalezi zinqumo ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izimpilo zomuntu zingashintsha ngokuphelele. Njengoba sithola ulwazi, sithola izinketho eziningi, kodwa ukwaziswa kahle kuthinta umqondo wethu. Lokhu kudinga ukufunda okukhulu nokuhlola, ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziyinqaba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinselelo zempilo zikhona kwazulu. Kukhona abanye abantu abathola ubunzima ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ubudlelwano obuhle buxhumene nezinsiza zempilo yengqondo, kanti uma lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abantu bangazizwa behluleka. Ukuthola izixazululo kulokhu kudinga ukuthi sithole abantu abathembekile, futhi sibe nesineke, kuphinde kwaziwe ukuthi uthando, ukuqonda, nokuxolelana kubalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zempilo zifundisa okuningi. Zifundisa ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi ubunzima. Ubuqotho, amandla, nokuqonda kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila. Siphila edolobheni elikhulayo, futhi abantu bethu abavumi ukuhamba phambili. Ukufunda ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, ukufunda ukuvuma izinkinga, kuyasiza ekwenzeni impilo ibe ngcono. Ekugcineni, izinselelo zempilo zidlala indima enkulu empilweni yethu. Ziyazama, zikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ayikabi lula, kodwa umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukufunda nokukhula. Siphila emhlabeni lapho kuhlangana khona ubunzima nemizamo yokuphila. Ngakho, kumele sihlale siphokophele impumelelo, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi emkhakheni wezinselelo, sikhona amandla okukhula, uhlobo oluphila, futhi lokho kuphila kuyakwazi ukunika umqondo ohlangene. Izifundo ezitholakala ezinselelweni zempilo ziwusizo ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Akukhona nje izigameko ezibuhlungu, kodwa izifundo ezitholakele zenza kube nokukhula. Ngakho-ke, kumele sibe nezinhliziyo ezivulekile, sibe nesineke, futhi sihloniphe zonke izinselelo eziphuma empilweni yethu. Lokhu kunikeza amandla olwethu emhlabeni ogcwele izithiyo. Njengoba sikhula, sithola amandla okujabulela impilo yethu, nokuvuma ukujula ebunzimeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizofunda ukuthi lezi zinto zifundisa ubuhlakani, futhi lezi zifundo zizokhumbuza ukuthi empilweni, konke kuyenzeka, uma sithatha izinyathelo zethu. Uhlanga oludlalayo, luhlaza, futhi lukhula ngezimo eziningi, njengempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengokuthi bonke abantu badinga izinsiza zokuphila, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlanganisa impilo yabo. Noma izinselelo zempilo zigcwele, kufanele sithokozise umhlaba, siphokophele ukufunda, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphila kuyinto enhle, ngisho noma kubonakala kunzima. Lezi zifundo zihlala zikhona, futhi ziwusizo empilweni yethu. Qhubeka nokukhula, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo ephelele, ezinzima, kodwa futhi ezijabulisayo.
U-Lionel Messi: Umqeqeshi Wamaphupho ULionel Messi, owazalwa ngoJanuwari 24, 1987, eRosario, e-Argentina, ungomunye wabalingisi bebhola abahamba phambili emhlabeni. Uthole udumo oluningi ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okukhulu, ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, kanye nesikhono sokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nezithiyo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhula okungajwayelekile, okuholele ezinkingeni zempilo ezithinta izitho zakhe. Ngemva kwesikhashana, uMessi wathola ithuba lokudlala kwi-Barcelona, lapho aqala khona ukuvelela. Ngonyaka ka-2004, waba ngumdlali ophambili, futhi waphenduka isithonjana sebhola. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okuhle, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuphosa, ukuhamba, nokuphendula ngokushesha. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni amathuba, okwenza abanye abadlali bakwazi ukufaka amagoli. U-Lionel Messi ungumuntu onobuntu obuhle, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nabanye abathandi bebhola buphakeme. Uhlala ethanda ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi izingane ezidinga usizo. Ubuye abe nomsebenzi omuhle wokuphila, usebenzisa udumo lwakhe ukuze athuthukise izimpilo zabanye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi akugcini nje ngokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu onothando. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMessi wathola izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neBallon d'Or, okuyisithonjana sokuhlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele. Ubephinde wathola izindondo eziningi zeLa Liga, iChampions League, kanye nezinye izicoco ezibalulekile. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu eqenjini lesizwe le-Argentina, lapho ehlanganyela khona ekutholeni i-Copa America ngo-2021, okuwumcimbi owawulindelwe isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwezimoto, uMessi wathuthela kwi-Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) ngo-2021, lapho aqhubeka khona nokukhombisa ubuchule bakhe. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ithimba eliqinile, futhi uqhubeka nokudlala kahle, ngisho nangemva kokushintsha kweqembu. U-Lionel Messi ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphikelela, okwenza kube sobala ukuthi ubuchule bakhe buphuma emoyeni wakhe. Ngaphandle kokudlala, uMessi ungumndeni onothando. Uhlala edlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomndeni wakhe, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nomkakhe, uAntonela Roccuzzo, bujabulisa abaningi. U-Lionel Messi ungumuntu ophila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nezingane zabo buveza uthando olukhulu. U-Lionel Messi ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuthi, noma ngabe ubhekene nezinkinga, ungakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu uma uzinikele. Uhlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yobuntu bakhe. U-Messi ungumqeqeshi wamaphupho, futhi izimpumelelo zakhe zikhumbuza abantu abaningi ukuthi, uma usebenza kanzima, ungakwazi ukufinyelela noma yiziphi izinjongo zakho. U-Lionel Messi, umqeqeshi, umphakathi, nomuntu onothando, uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi impilo ingaba yinhle uma sithanda lokho esikwenza. Uqhubeka nokukhanyisa izimpilo zabantu abaningi, futhi izinkanyezi zakhe zikhanya kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. U-Lionel Messi, umqeqeshi wamaphupho, uyisithonjana esizohlala sikhumbuleka.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN Ingxoxo noMnu. Nkosi Zulu, umphakathi wezokuhlaliswa kwezakhamuzi eThekwini Umbhali: Sanibonani, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuthatha isikhathi sokukhuluma nathi mayelana nezikhukhula ezikhathini zakamuva eKwaZulu-Natali. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithole umbono wakho njengoba uhlala kule ndawo. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Izikhukhula ziningi kakhulu eKZN, futhi zishayisa kakhulu abantu bendawo. Umbhali: Ungangitshela ukuthi zenzeka kanjani lezi zikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, izikhukhula zenzeka kakhulu emakhazeni, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezikhathi zokuna kwemvula. Lokhu kubangelwa ukungakwazi kwezimvula eziningi ukwakha, futhi umhlaba awukwazi ukuwathwala amanzi. Lokhu kuholela emifuleni nasezindaweni ezimboze abantu. Umbhali: Kukhona yini imiphumela ethile esibonakalayo emphakathini? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, imiphumela iyahluka. Abantu bayalahlekelwa yizinto zabo, izindlu, nezimpahla. Abanye baphinde babe nezinkinga zezempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwanayo ngenxa yokuhlangana kwamanzi angcolile. Lokhu kudala umonakalo omkhulu emphakathini. Umbhali: Ngabe umphakathi uthola kanjani usizo emuva kwezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Ngemuva kwezikhukhula, izinhlelo zokusiza ziqala. Uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nemiphakathi yemfundo, bayahlanganyela. Kukhona ukusiza ngezimali, ukudla, nemishini yokwakha. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezinjengokungabi namathuba afanele. Umbhali: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zanele? Mnu. Zulu: Cha, ngicabanga ukuthi zidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Kudingeka izinhlelo zokwakha ezinhle, izindlela zokuphuma, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Uhlelo lokusiza abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibuthakathaka luyadingeka. Umbhali: Uthini umbono wakho mayelana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo wezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kakhulu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela kahle, singasebenzisa amamephu edijithali ukuze sithole izindawo ezibuthakathaka. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze sikwazi ukwazisa abantu ngezimo ezimbi. Lokhu kuzogcina abantu bephephile. Umbhali: Njengomphakathi, yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikeleka ezikhukhuleni? Mnu. Zulu: Umphakathi kufanele ube nekhono lokuzivikela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu indlela yokuphuma ezindaweni ezibuthakathaka, ukwakha izikhungo zokuphila eziphephile, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile mayelana nezindawo ezibuthakathaka. Umbhali: Kungani kubaluleke kangaka ukuxhumana nezinye izindawo ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo? Mnu. Zulu: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma sabelana ngolwazi nolwazi, singafunda kokunye okwenzekile kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo ezizophumelela. Umbhali: Ngabe unayo imikhokhelo ethile kumphakathi mayelana nezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngincoma abantu ukuba bahlanganyele ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuzivikela. Bafundise ukuthi bahlale beqaphele izimo zezulu, baqonde izinhlelo zokuphuma, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala behlola izindawo zabo. Umbhali: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ngikufisela inhlanhla emisebenzini yakho yokusiza umphakathi. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, futhi ngiyabonga ngokuhlinzeka ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi. Nakanjani sizobambisana ukuze siphumelele. Umbhali: Ngiyavuma, kumele sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngiyabonga! Le ngxoxo ibonisa ubunzima obubhekene nomphakathi waseKZN ngenxa yezikhukhula, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuhlaliswa kahle kwezakhamuzi. Ukuhlonishwa kwezimvo zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo.
I-Mercedes-Benz: Umkhiqizo Wokuhamba Okuyingqayizivele I-Mercedes-Benz iyinkampani edumile emhlabeni wonke, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezithuthi zayo eziphezulu nezisezingeni eliphezulu. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1926, kwathi eminyakeni eyalandela, yaba yisibonelo sokuhamba okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe, umklamo, kanye nokuphepha. I-Mercedes-Benz isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yayo ihlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende, futhi igcina isithunzi sayo njengebhendi elihloniphekile. I-Mercedes-Benz iyingxenye yeDaimler AG, okuyinkampani enomlando omude emphakathini wezokuthutha. Uhlanga lwezokuthutha lweMercedes-Benz luhleliwe kahle, luqukethe izimoto ezihlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi izimoto ezincane, ezinkulu, kanye nezimoto ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi ezahlukene, kusukela kubantu abafuna izimoto zokuhamba eziphumelelayo, kuze kube sezingeni eliphezulu lemikhiqizo yokuhamba. Ukwakhiwa kwezithuthi zeMercedes-Benz kugxile emaphethini amahle, okwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi komsebenzisi nezithuthi. Ukugxila ekwakhiweni okuhle kusekela umbono wokuthi imoto ingaphezu kokuhamba. I-Mercedes-Benz ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okukhombisa ukuzinikela kwayo ekwenzeni izimoto eziphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umklamo wenziwa ngendlela efanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zihlala zinhle ngisho nomnyaka edlule, okwenza kube yizimpahla ezilondekile. Ukwanda kwezimoto zeMercedes-Benz akukhulumi kuphela ngohlangothi lwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ekuphepheni. I-Mercedes-Benz ikholwa ukuthi ukuphepha kuzoba yinsika eyinhloko ezimotweni zayo. Ngakho-ke, ibhande lokuphepha, izinhlelo zokubona izingozi, kanye nezinto zokulwa nezingozi zifakwe kuzo zonke izimoto ezikhiqizwayo. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuvikela abashayeli nabagibeli, kube yisibonelo sokuhlonipha impilo yomuntu. Ngaphezu kokwenza izimoto ezinhle neziphephile, iMercedes-Benz ibuye ibonakale njengomholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezemoto. Uhlobo lwezithuthi oluhambayo, olufana nezimoto ezisebenzisa ugesi, lukhombisa ukufuna kweMercedes-Benz ukusiza ekunciphiseni umthelela emhlabeni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi inkampani iyawuhlonipha umhlaba, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izimoto zayo zixhumene nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMercedes-Benz iye yathola izindondo eziningi, ikhombisa ukuthi iyikhanda emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nokwakhiwa. Lezi zindondo zikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani kumphakathi, nasekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezithuthukisiwe. Ukusebenza kwenkampani ngokuhlanganyela nezikhungo zocwaningo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuvumela iMercedes-Benz ukuba ikwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokwakhiwa nokwenza izimoto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMercedes-Benz ibonisa umgomo wokuhlonipha izidingo zamakhasimende. Ngalesi sizathu, inkampani ibeka phambili ukukwazi ukuthola impendulo kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela kwabathengi, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zihlala zihlala zifaneleka nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubuyisela emuva ekutheni iMercedes-Benz iyinkampani okufanele ibhekwane nayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna umkhiqizo ophakeme. Ekupheleni, iMercedes-Benz iyimpahla yezenzo ezinhle, umkhiqizo onobuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nesithunzi esihle emakethe. Ukubona indlela inkampani ebambisana ngayo nezidingo zomphakathi, nokuhlonipha impilo yomuntu, kubonisa ukuthi iMercedes-Benz iyakha isithunzi esiqinile emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Njengoba ibhizinisi leli liqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi lihlale ligxile ekwakheni izimoto ezinethezekile, eziphephile, nezihamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokho kuzoqhubeka kwenza iMercedes-Benz ibaluleke emphakathini wezokuthutha emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe obuhlanganiswe neMercedes-Benz buzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezidingweni zomphakathi, kanti izimoto zayo zizohlala zikhumbuleka njengesibonelo sokuhamba okuphumelelayo, okuphumelelayo, nokuphephile. I-Mercedes-Benz iyindlela yokuhamba esebenzayo, enezinga eliphezulu, futhi iyinsika ehlonishwayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
iChatGPT Isingeniso iChatGPT iyithuluzi elithuthukisiwe elisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (artificial intelligence) ukuze luthumele izimpendulo ezicacile, ezihlukile, nezisebenziseka kalula. Le mishini yakhiwe ukuze iqhube ingxoxo nabantu ngendlela efana nokuxoxa phakathi kwabantu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi iChatGPT ikwazi kanjani ukufunda nolimi lwethu, futhi ikhulume ngempumelelo ngezihloko eziningi ezihlukahlukene? Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela le mshini esebenza ngayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezinkinga ezingase zivele. Ukwakhiwa kweChatGPT iChatGPT yakhiwe ngokusebenzisa imodeli ye-Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT). Lokhu kusho ukuthi le mshini ifundiswe ngemininingwane eminingi yezenzakalo, imibhalo, kanye nezincwadi ezivela emithonjeni ehlukahlukene. Ngokufunda le miphakathi, iChatGPT iyakwazi ukuqonda izimo zolimi, izakhiwo zamasiko, kanye nezifundo ezahlukene. Ngenxa yalokhu, ibona izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi, ikwazi futhi ukuphendula ngezinto ezithile, ngezinga eliphakeme lokucacisa. Ukuqonda Kolimi Ukusebenza kweChatGPT kungenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ikwazi ukuqonda kahle ulimi. Isebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlaziya amagama, izisho, nezakhiwo zokwakha imibhalo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kusiza iChatGPT ukuthi ikwazi ukusebenzisa amagama afanele, ibeke kahle umqondo, futhi ihlale ibhalela ngokuhambisana nezimo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi komsebenzisi nomshini. Izinzuzo zeChatGPT Izinhlelo zayo zokuxhumana nezithombe zokukhuluma zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukusiza abantu ngezimpendulo ezisheshayo, futhi zikhuthaze ukuxhumana okungcono. IChatGPT ingaba usizo ezindaweni eziningi, njenge: 1. Imfundo: Abafundi bangasebenzisa iChatGPT njengomhloli, befuna izincazelo, izibonelo, noma izixazululo ezithile ezibandakanya izifundo zabo. 2. Ezokuxhumana: IChatGPT ingasiza ekwakheni izincwadi, ama-imeyili, noma ama-messages, ikhuluma ngesiZulu esicacile nesihloniphekile. 3. Ubuchwepheshe: Okwamanje, abathuthukisi bangasebenzisa iChatGPT ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emisha ngezingqinamba ezithile, noma ukwenza ucwaningo ngezihloko ezithakazelisayo. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Nakuba iChatGPT inezinzuzo eziningi, akukhona konke okuthiwa kusemthethweni. Zikhona izinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwayo. Okokuqala, iChatGPT ingase ingaqondi kahle amaphutha, izaga, noma izisho ezithile ezijulile, okungaholela ekuqondeni okungalungile. Lokhu kungenza kube nezinkinga uma umsebenzisi efuna impendulo ethile ethile. Okwesibili, izinkinga zokuphepha zingavela uma iChatGPT ingadicili kahle kahle izinhlelo zokuvikela. Umsebenzisi kufanele ahlale eqaphela futhi aqonde ukuthi le mshini iyithuluzi, hhayi umuntu; ngakho-ke, ulwazi olutholayo lungase lungabi neqiniso ngokuphelele. Isiphetho iChatGPT iyithuluzi elikhulu elithuthukisa indlela esikhuluma ngayo, esifunda ngayo, futhi esisebenzisana ngayo. Ngenxa yokuthi ibamba izifundo eziningi, ifaka izimpendulo ezihlukahlukene, futhi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, ingaba usizo olukhulu kubantu abaningi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi akuyona indawo yokugcina, futhi imikhawulo yayo kufanele ibhekwe. Njengoba ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buqhubeka nokukhula, sizobona izindlela eziningi zokusetshenziswa kwayo, okuzokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Kuhle ukuba neChatGPT, kodwa kudinga ukuqonda okuphezulu kokuthi iyithuluzi elisekela abantu, hhayi esikhundleni sabo.
Imfashini Nobuhle: Indaba Yezitayela Zethu Kwazulu, ngosuku olukhanyayo, lapho umoya ubushelelezi futhi izinyoni zibhakabhaka, abantu emzaneni babezilungiselela umkhosi omkhulu wezobuciko. Imfashini nobuhle kwakuyizihloko ezibalulekile. UZandile, intokazi enobuhle obungapheli, wayengaphakathi kokulungiselela. Wayenothando olukhulu ngemfashini; wayefuna ukufakazela ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuziveza, yokukhuluma ngempilo yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZandile wahlangana nezingubo ezahlukene egumbini lakhe. Kukhona izingubo ezimnyama ezimfushane, ezilula, nezinemibala egqamile. Wakhumbula nama-accessories anhlobonhlobo, ama-anklets, ama-necklaces, nezicathulo ezinhle. Wayazi ukuthi umkhosi udinga okuthile okukhazimulayo, okuzokwenza abanye baphenduke bamehlo kuye. Ngemuva kokukhetha, uZandile waya kumama wakhe, uMama Nandi, owayesebenza emakhaya. UMama Nandi wayenokuthula, kodwa uZandile wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi umqondo wakhe ngemfashini uyamjabulisa yini. “Mama, ucinga ukuthi lezi zingubo ezikhethiwe zingangiholela empumelelweni emkhosini?” kubuza uZandile, ethokozile. UMama Nandi waphendula ngothando, “Ngiyabonga, mntwanami. Uthando lwakho lwezinto ezinhle lwenza ube yinto eyingqayizivele. Khumbula, ubuhle bukhona ngaphakathi. Imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuziveza, kodwa ubuhle bangempela buvela enhliziyweni.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uZandile waqonda ukuthi imfashini ayikhulumi nje ngokuqhakambisa ubuhle, kodwa ibalulekile ekuboneni ubunikazi bethu. Umkhosi wawuzoba yithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokwazisa, yokwenza umyalezo, nokukhombisa uthando lwethu ngezinhlobonhlobo. Njengoba umkhosi usondela, uZandile wathola isikhathi sokuhlanza. Waqala ngokuhlanzeka kobuso, efaka i-moisturizer, bese esebenzisa i-makeup encane, eyayikhanyisa ubuso bakhe. Wayefuna ukubukeka emuhle, kodwa engafuni ukulahlekelwa umoya wakhe wemvelo. Ngesikhathi umkhosi uqala, umoya wawugcwele injabulo. Abantu bejabulile, behlangana, behlabelela. UZandile waphuma phambili, efaka izingubo zakhe ezinhle, ezimhlophe nezimnyama. Wabhalela wonke umuntu umyalezo wokuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokukhombisa ubunikazi bethu. Lapho efika emkhakheni, uZandile wabona abanye besebenzisa izitayela ezahlukene, abanye bejabulisa ngemibala ehlukahlukene. Wathola ukuthi imfashini ibonisa ubuhlakani bethu, izinkolelo zethu, nezifiso zethu. Ubuhle babuhlukahlukene, futhi wonke umuntu wayebonisa ubuchwepheshe bakhe ngendlela eyingqayizivele. Ngemuva kokuphela komkhosi, uZandile waphuma, ejabule. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayehlanganyela umoya wombukiso, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nomoya wokwakha ubuhlobo. Waqonda ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje indlela yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, yokuhlanganyela, nokukhombisa uthando. UZandile wathi: “Imfashini nobuhle akukhona kuphela okubonwa ngaphandle, kodwa kuyinto esiyithola ngaphakathi. Ngiyabonga, Mama, ngokungifundisa lokho.” UMama Nandi wamomotheka, eqonda ukuthi indodakazi yakhe isiqedile ukufunda okubalulekile empilweni. UZandile waqhubeka nokwakha isitayela sakhe, enza imfashini ibe yindlela yokuziveza, yokukhombisa ubuhle bempilo yakhe. Waqhubeka nokuhlanganyela nezinye, efundisa ngokubaluleka kokuba nekhono lokuba ubani, nokuthi ubuhle bethu buvela ngaphakathi. UZandile waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imfashini nobuhle akukhona nje okukhanyayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa uthando, ubuhlakani, nokuba yinto eyingqayizivele. Imfashini, empeleni, iyindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono.
Ukakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (Reconstruction and Development Programme) kube yinsakavukela ezweni lethu, njengoba izinsuku zikhula zihlala zihlaba umxhwele. I-RDP yenzelwe ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni amancane. Ngicela ukwazi, ngabe ungabala izinselele ezitholakala ekwakhiweni kwezi zindlu, nokuthi lokhu kudlula kanjani umqondo wempilo yabantu? Ingxenye 2: Ukuqala Kwesikhala Sichaza Uhlanga Sizisho njalo ukuthi umqondo wokwakha izindlu ezithuthukisiwe uqala kuleli zinga eliyinkimbinkimbi, lapho kudingeka ukuthi kubhekwe izidingo zomphakathi. Yini eyenza lezi zindlu zafaneleka kubantu, ikakhulukazi lezi ezibhalwe ku-RDP? Njengoba sixoxa, kufanele sikhumbule amandla nemikhawulo yalesi sikhala. Abantu abasha nabadala bahlala benelungelo lokuphila kahle, kodwa izinselele eziningi zikhona. Ingxenye 3: Inqubo Yokwakha Uma sithinta inqubo yokwakha, sigxila ezintweni ezibalulekile ezifana nemigomo, izithiyo, nokwakheka kwalesi sikhala. Uhlelo lwe-RDP lusebenza ngendlela ethile, kuhilela ukuthi izindlu zikhishwe kusukela ekuhloleni indawo, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nokuhlinzeka ngemali. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uma ubuhlobo phakathi kwezakhamuzi nosomabhizinisi buhle, akukwazi ukungabikho kwezinto ezixhasayo. Ingxenye 4: Ukubambisana Komphakathi Abantu basebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo ukuze basebenze ndawonye? Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi kanjani ukubambisana ukuze ibuyisele amandla kulesi sikhala. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza nezinsizakusebenza kusiza ekwakheni udumo nolwazi, okwenza ukuba kube neqhaza elikhulu. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphi, usizo lokubambisana lungakhuphula izinga lokuphila. Ingxenye 5: Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu akupheli nje ekwakheni izakhiwo, kubalulekile futhi ukuphatha kahle izinhlelo uma zikhona. Kuze kube manje, izinkinga ezidlangile ziletha ukusindwa kumaphrojekthi. I-RDP kudinga ukubhekwa ngendlela ebanzi, kungebanga lokuthi abantu badinga izindlu ezigungeni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kubhekelwe izinsiza ezifanele. Ingxenye 6: Izikhumbuzo Nezixazululo Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi izikhumbuzo zohlelo lwe-RDP zibaluleke kangakanani. Iziphumo ezitholakalayo zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezijwayelekile zikhona, kodwa futhi zikhona nezixazululo. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisa umphakathi kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke phambili. Kodwa-ke, asikwazi ukweqa izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezihambisanayo. Ingxenye 7: Izifinyezo Zokugcina Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akukhulumi nje ngokwakha izindlu, kodwa kuyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwabantu. Ukuhlanganyela kwethu kumaphrojekthi akwemukelekanga kuzodingeka. Asiphambukeli kulokhu, sibheka phambili, sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza, ukuze kube nezinto ezizokwenziwa ngeqiniso. Ingxenye 8: Ukuphetha Siyavuma ukuthi lezi zindlu ze-RDP zingasiza ukuvuselela umphakathi, kodwa kudinga ukuba nesivumelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Le ngxoxo inikwe amandla ukuhlinzeka ngedlanzela elikahle lempilo yetu. Ukubambisana, ukuziqhenya, nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle kuzo zonke izigaba kuwufanele, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ngabe ungakhetha izindlela ezitholakalayo zokwenza ngcono i-RDP? Njengoba sisondele ekugcineni, ngabe unganikeza isithombe sesikhathi esizayo sokwakhiwa kwezindlu?
Izindaba Zempumelelo: Uhlelo Lokuphumelela Kujabulisa ukufunda izindaba ezinhle zempumelelo ezikhombisa umphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngenhlonipho kulabo abathathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze bafinyelele impumelelo emikhakheni ehlukene. Ngaphambi kokuhlola lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impumelelo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhweba kwezimali noma izikhundla eziphakeme, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuthola ukwaneliseka kanye nokufeza amaphupho ethu. Ukukhula kwempumelelo kubonakala ezindabeni eziningi zomphakathi. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka, bakhombisa imibono, ubuciko, nokuzimisela. Isibonelo esihle nguNokuthula, owayengumfundi ophumelele emsebenzini wakhe wokufundisa, owakha isikhungo sokufunda esibiza abantwana abavela emiphakathini ethile. Uhlanganyele nomphakathi ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bakhula befunda ngempela. Lokhu kube yindlela yokuhlomulisa umphakathi, kukhombisa umyalezo othi, "Siyakwazi ukwenza kahle uma sibambisene." Izindaba zempumelelo azigcini nje kuphela kulabo abaziwayo, kodwa ziqukethe nezindawo eziningi zempumelelo ezitholakala emakhaya, emiphakathini nasemadolobheni. UThabo, othanda ukubhaka, waphawuleka ngesikhathi edlula ezinyathelweni ezinzima, kodwa kwase kuthiwa "umgibeli wehlisa umoya" ngemuva kokuba eqalile umncintiswano wokubhaka. Njengoba efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezingubo zokudla ezifanele emndenini, akazange ahluleke, waphumelela. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayesevele ethole izifundo eziningi ezibalulekile. Izindaba zempumelelo zibuye zikhanyise umhlaba ngokuqonda nokusebenza okuhle. Ubuchwepheshe buhambisana nokukhula, kuyilapho umphakathi uqhubeka nokuxhasa nezinhlelo ezilungile. Lokhu kuvumela abantu abasha ukuqonda ukuthi banganempumelelo kangakanani uma benolwazi futhi benethezekile. Izikhumbuzo ezinjengokuphishekela ukuya enhliziyweni yeqembu lendabuko lakho, ziphakamisa ukuhamba kwakho empilweni ukuze nezinye izindawo zisize. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kunezinto eziningi ezingachaphazeleka. Empilweni, ukuhlakanipha kujulile. Kukhona izimo ezilakazayo, amaphephandaba, nemihlangano yokwabelana ngempumelelo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside sokuzuza, abanye abantu bacabanga ukuthi huzunguzela emasahladini akhe. Kunesiteshi esiyinkanyezi esiyinqaba, siphinda siqhamuke sibe sizo. Kulezi zikhathi, sithola ubuhlakani obuncane obukwazi ukusiza kumathuba nezikhathi ezinzima. Uma siphawula indlela izindaba zempumelelo zikhanya, ibhadi emithonjeni ethandwa, uzwa ukuvelela kwenhlonipho. Ukuxhumana kwebhizinisi, ukunakekela, nokuhleka komndeni, kuyaluleka. Lapho kwenzeka lokho, siphumela kakhulu esizweni sokuhlala siphila kahle, silandela izinyathelo ezinhle. Izindaba ezinhle zempumelelo ziyakha amashashalazi ngezindlela ezahlukene, zisithokozisa ngokwandisa izifiso zethu, kwathi umphumela obalulekile waba ukudala ubudlelwane bempilo. Ngakho, uhambo lokufinyelela empumelelweni luhlanganisa izinto eziningi ezimbi nemibono emisha. Futhi unemisebenzi ehlala ibalulekile ebantwini, ivuselela ithemba. Imithetho evamile, efanele, ikhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuveza indlela ezinhle zempilo, kuhlanganisa izixazululo zabantu abanesisekelo somiselo. Ikhompyutha isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuyisimangaliso, oluvela kumkhiqizo omkhulu, losizakale izinkanyezi zempumelelo. Ngokuphetha, izindaba zempumelelo zikhombisa ukuthi impumelelo ayihambisani nemibono engalungile. Yiba nomoya ophakeme, faka uthando emsebenzini, futhi ukhonze abanye, kulindeleke ukuthi ungaphendula umhlaba uhlebe futhi ube isibonelo sezokwenza izinto ziphumelele. Imizwa iyathinta, izinyathelo zikhona, futhi lapho umqondo uhlangana nomsebenzi, impumelelo izovela. Ngakho-ke, asithokoziseni ngobudlelwane nokuxhaswa, siqhubeke sifuna impumelelo ebushelelezi.
iPlayStation Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eGoli, umoya uvunguza kancane, kanti izingane zazijabulela ukudlala ngaphandle. Kodwa uThabo, umfana oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, wayenokukhathazeka okukhulu. Wayefisa kakhulu ukuba ne-PlayStation, umshini wokudlala imidlalo odume kakhulu emhlabeni. UThabo wayehlale ezibona nabangane bakhe bedlala imidlalo emisha, behleka futhi bejabula, kanti yena wayehamba phambili edinga izindlela zokuwathola. Ngelinye ilanga, uThabo wathola ithuba lokukhuluma nomama wakhe. "Mama, ngicela ungithengele iPlayStation. Ngiyakwazi ukudlala imidlalo eminingi, futhi ngizofunda kakhulu," esho ngentokozo. Mama wakhe, uNandi, wayemazi kahle amandla okudlala imidlalo, kodwa wayezwa ukuthi umshini wawubiza kakhulu. "Thabo, ngiyakuqonda, kodwa imali ayikho. Sizodinga ukulinda," kusho yena, enomusa. Noma kunjalo, uThabo akazange ayeke. Waqala ukuhamba emgwaqweni, ehlola imisebenzi engatholakala. Waqala ukusiza abavakashi, ethengisa izithelo, futhi nakuba imizamo yakhe yayinzima, wayeqhubeka nokusebenza. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, wathola imali eyanele. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, kodwa akazange akwazi ukuthenga iPlayStation, ngoba wayefuna ukugcina imali ukuze akhokhe imfundo yakhe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuvakashela emakethe yedijithali. Kwakukhona izitolo eziningi ezidayisa imidlalo, futhi wayezwa umoya wokujabula. Waqonda ukuthi umshini wayefuna, iPlayStation, wayeseduze. Wafaka imali yakhe esandleni, wathenga umshini, wathi: "Ngiyaphumelela!" Wabuyela ekhaya, enomoya ophakeme, efuna ukwabelana nabangane bakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo waqala ukudlala imidlalo, wabelana ngezikhathi ezijabulisayo nabangane bakhe. Kodwa, phakathi kokudlala, wathola ukuthi imidlalo ayizange imsize kuphela ekuzijabuliseni, kodwa futhi yamfundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Wafunda ukubambisana, ukuhlela, nokuxhumana nabanye. UThabo waba yisibonelo esihle kubangane bakhe, futhi wayejabulela ukwabelana ngalesi sikhathi. Nokho, kwaba nezikhathi ezinzima. UThabo wathola ukuthi imidlalo ibingamjabulisi kuphela, kodwa ibingamphazamisa ekufundeni. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele abeke phambili imfundo yakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi, umama wakhe, wabona ukuthi umntwana wakhe ufinyelele esicongweni sokudlala, kodwa waba nesidingo sokumkhumbuza ngokuqonda. "Thabo, khumbula, imfundo iyasiza. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi udinga ukufunda," wathi. UThabo wathola ukuthi uMama wakhe wayenelungelo. Waqala ukuhlela isikhathi sakhe, edlala imidlalo kuphela ngemva kokufunda. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo, njengoba wathola imiphumela emihle esikoleni. Waqhubeka nokwabelana nabangane bakhe, kodwa manje wayenobuchule bokuhlanganisa imidlalo nezifundo. Waqonda ukuthi iPlayStation ingaba umngane, kodwa imfundo iyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Njengoba iminyaka yadlula, uThabo wakhula waba umfana ophumelelayo, wathola iziqu zakhe, futhi waba nekhono lokwakha imidlalo. Waqala ukwakha imidlalo yakhe, efaka izifundo ezithile ezazimfundisa. Wazisa abanye ngezifundo ezitholakala emidlalweni, futhi waba umholi emphakathini wakhe. Ekugcineni, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuhlanganisa imidlalo yePlayStation, enza ukuthi abanye bakwazi ukufunda futhi bajabule. Wazalelwa emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa akazange akhohlwe izifundo zempilo. Wazi ukuthi iPlayStation iyinsiza, kodwa imfundo iyisikhali esinamandla. Ngakho-ke, uThabo waba isibonelo sokuthi, noma imidlalo ingaba yindlela yokuphumula, imfundo iyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazisa umndeni wakhe, abahlobo, nomphakathi, futhi waphumelela empilweni, eqhubeka nokukhulisa izizukulwane ezizayo. I-PlayStation yaba umthombo wokukhuthaza, kodwa imfundo yabe iyinsika yokuphila kwakhe.
Impilo Yasemakhaya Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle, izinkanyezi zazingakabi seziqhamukile. Emzaneni omncane, uMkhondo, abantu babebuthene emaphandleni, bejabulile, bephila impilo ejabulisayo. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, uphonsa izinyembezi zothando nezokuthula. UZanele, intombazane encane, wayehamba ngebhodi lehlathi, efuna izimbali ezinhle zokuhlobisa indlu yabo. Umama wakhe, uNokuthula, wayesebenza emakhaya, efuna ukudla okwakuzokwenziwa ngempelasonto. UJabulani, umngane kaZanele, wayehamba naye. UJabulani wayenothando olukhulu lwemvelo; wayejabulela ukuhamba phakathi kwezihlahla, ezithokozisayo, nezinyoni ezidansayo. "Zanele, bheka lezi zinyoni! Zibukeka zifana nezithombe ezinhle," esho, elingisa izinyoni ezibhakabhakayo. UZanele wahlala phansi, wathokoza, "Yebo, Jabulani! Impilo yasemakhaya iyamangalisa." Njengoba behamba, bahlangana noMkhulu uSizwe, umphakathi omdala, owaziwa ngazo zonke izindaba zomphakathi. UMkhulu uSizwe wayehamba nebhuku, efunda izinkanyezi. "Sanibonani, bantwana! Nikhona emhlabeni omuhle," esho. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngempilo yethu? Ziyazisa ukuthi sikhona." UZanele noJabulani baphendula, "Yebo, Mkhulu! Sifuna ukufunda kakhulu." Ngemva kokuhamba isikhathi esithile, bahamba baphuma emapulazini. UZanele wabona umama wakhe, uNokuthula, esebenza emasimini. "Mama!" abiza, "Siyavuma izimbali ezinhle!" UNokuthula wamamatheka, "Ngiyabonga, Zanele. Izimbali zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo, kodwa khumbulani, umsebenzi wethu udinga uthando." UJabulani waphendula, "Siyavuma, Mama. Sizokwenza umsebenzi omuhle." Ngemuva kokuphuma emasimini, uNokuthula wabathokozisa ngempela. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi umhlaba unikeza konke okudingayo? Njengoba sikhuluma, umhlaba uyakhula, izitshalo zikhula, futhi sithola ukudla." UZanele noJabulani babebuka umama wabo, begcwele umuzwa wokuhlonipha. Ngempelasonto, umndeni kaZanele wahlela umcimbi wokudla. Babebuthene emakhaya, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle. UZanele noJabulani bahlabelela izinkanyezi, bejabulela ukuxoxa izindaba. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya inezinkanyezi eziningi?" kubuza uJabulani. "Yebo, zikhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo," kuphendula uZanele. "Futhi zikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona." Umlilo wawukhanya, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu. UZanele noJabulani babebuthene nabangane babo, bejabulela ukudla okwenziwe ngothando. Umama kaZanele wayebathokozisa ngamaqanda, uMkhulu uSizwe wabelana ngezindaba zomlando. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi umhlaba wethu unothando olukhulu?" kubuza uMkhulu. "Yebo, Mkhulu! Umhlaba unikeza impilo," kuphendula uZanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZanele noJabulani baqala ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwabo. "Siyabonga, Mkhulu, ngokusifundisa," kusho uJabulani. "Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sihloniphe umhlaba." UZanele wamamatheka, "Yebo, sizokwenza." Njengoba ilanga lishona, umndeni kaZanele wawuhamba emuva endlini, bezithokozisa ngezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. UZanele wayejabule, eqonda ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyigugu elikhulu. "Siyabonga, Mama, ngokusifundisa ukuthi umhlaba unothando," kusho uZanele. "Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sihloniphe umhlaba." Ngale ndlela, impilo yasemakhaya yahlala igcwele uthando, ukuhlonipha, nokuhlanganyela. UZanele noJabulani baqhubeka nempilo yabo, bejabulile, bephila impilo ejabulisayo. Futhi, izinkanyezi zakhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza bonke ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyigugu elingapheli.
Ama-Social Media: Iziphumo Zokuxhumana Kwabesifazane Nezizinda Zokubambisana Kuze kube manje, izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Lokhu kubandakanya ama-platforms afana no-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, neTikTok, okuyizindawo lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nolwazi. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, zengeza umhlaba wethu ngamasiko nezinkolelo ezihlukahlukene.
