Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media anemiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi anemiphumela emibi engaletha izinkinga. Okokuqala, ama-social media akha amathuba okuxhumana. Ngalezi zinkundla, abantu bangahlala bexhumene, noma ngabe bekhulu-khulu. Lokhu kubalulekile kubantu abahlala kude, abavela emindenini ehlukene, noma abaphakathi kwemiphakathi eyeqisayo. Isibonelo, abesifazane nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezincane bangasebenzisa ama-social media ukuze babelane ngemicabango, babelane ngezifundo, futhi baxhumane nabanye abesifazane abaphumelelayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kwemithombo yokwesekwa, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola izixazululo nezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media anikeza indawo yokwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bangashicilela izifundo zabo, imisebenzi, nezifiso, okuvumela abanye ukuba bathole izifundo ezithokozisayo noma izimvo ezingabathuthukisa. Lokhu kuphinde kuvule amathuba okudala, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukudala okuqukethwe okusha, bephinde benze imihlangano yokubambisana, okukhuthaza ubuciko nemikhuba emisha. Ngokuvamile, lokhu kudala umkhankaso wezinto ezintsha ezithokozisayo ezithokozisa umphakathi. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media angase abe nemiphumela emibi. Ukuqhamuka kwegciwane lokuqhathaniswa, lapho abantu beqhathanisa impilo yabo nabanye, kubangela ukuzenqaba kwabanye, ikakhulukazi abesifazane. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengoba abantu bezama ukufanisa izithombe ezinkulu zempilo enempilo ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Abesifazane baphinde babhekane nezithombe ezikhaliphile, okukhuthaza imicabango yokuthi kumele babe ne-‘ukubukeka okuhle’ ukuze bahlonishwe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola ukuzethemba nokwaneliseka. Okwamanje, ama-social media akhuthaza ukuxhumana, kodwa futhi akhombisa umfanekiso ophambene. Abantu bangathola injabulo, kodwa baphinde babhekane nosizi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sibe nekhono lokukhumbula ukuthi, nakuba sithola izinzuzo eziningi, kufanele sibe nesineke nezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga ezivela. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekuphatheni impilo yethu yezenhlalo. Ekuqedeni, ngicabanga ukuthi ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana kwethu, kodwa adinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezindlela zokuziphatha ezifanele lapho sisebenzisa lezi zinkundla. Uma sikhuluma ngabesifazane, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzethemba kwabo kuxhomeke kulokho abakubonayo, futhi ukuziphatha kwethu kuncike ekwenzeni umphakathi ube yindawo efudumele, ethokozisayo, futhi evumelana nezifiso zethu. Ukuxhumana kuhambisana nomthwalo wemfanelo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sifunde ukusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela ephumelelayo, ethuthukisa ubudlelwano bethu, futhi ikakhulukazi, ibhekise ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwama-social media ukuze sakhe imiphakathi eqinile nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba sithole izixazululo ezikahle, sabelane ngempilo yethu, futhi sakhe izindaba ezinhle ezizoshiyela umhlaba ubuhle. Kukhona amandla amakhulu lapha, futhi kufanele sizisebenzele ukuze senze izinguquko ezithinta impilo yethu.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umlando Walo Ibhola lomnqakiswano, noma i-basketball, liyinsimu ethokozisayo futhi edumile emhlabeni wonke. Lo mdlalo wadalwa ngonyaka ka-1891 nguJames Naismith, umfundisi wezokwakha eColumbia University e-United States. U-Naismith wayefuna ukuhlinzeka ngemdla ohlangene owasiza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bephila ngesikhathi sebusika, lapho imidlalo yangaphandle ingavumelekile ngenxa yezimo zezulu. Wabhala imithetho eyisisekelo, ethinta izinyathelo ezilula zokudlala, wabe esebenzisa ibhasi elincane, izigubhu ezimbili, nezikhumbuzo ezilula ukuze akhe umphakathi wokuqala wombukiso. Umdlalo wokuqala wabanjwa emnyango, lapho abadlali bejabulisa izithameli ezincane. Ngesikhathi leso, ibhola lomnqakiswano lalingakabi namazinga aphezulu, kodwa lwalukhombisa isithembiso sokuba umdlalo ophumelelayo. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba, ibhola lomnqakiswano laqala ukuthandwa kakhulu. Ngonyaka ka-1936, le midlalo yathathwa njengengxenye ye-Olympics, okwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwandiseni ubukhona bayo emhlabeni, okwakuvulela amathuba amaningi kubadlali, abaqeqeshi, nababukeli. Umdlalo waqala ukuhamba phambili, wathola izinkanyezi ezinkulu ezifana noMichael Jordan, uKobe Bryant, noLeBron James, abaguqula ubuchwepheshe bawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola izinguquko eziningi. Imithetho yalo yathuthukiswa, izikhumbuzo zashintshwa, futhi izindlela zokudlala zathuthukiswa. Umdlalo waqala ukufaka izici eziningi, ezinjengokukhuphuka kwezikhumbuzo, izinyathelo ezinzima, nezindlela zokudlala ezihlukahlukene, okwenze kube mnandi kubabukeli. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola ukuthandwa emhlabeni wonke, izwe ngalinye laqala ukwakha amaqembu, futhi imiqhudelwano yathuthukiswa. I-NBA (National Basketball Association) yatholakala e-United States, ibe yinhla enkulu yokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano emhlabeni. I-NBA yenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu, yenza abadlali baziwe, futhi yathuthukisa izinga lokudlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola ukuthandwa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini, lapho abafundi baqala ukudlala emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasezindaweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abadlali abasha, okwakha amathuba amaningi kubantu abasha. Namuhla, ibhola lomnqakiswano seliyinsimu ethokozisayo, edlalwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi abadlali bahlonishwa njengamaqhawe. Umdlalo usaqhubeka nokukhula, uthokozisa izigidi zabantu, futhi akusikho nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, ubungani, nokuhlanganyela. Noma kunjalo, ibhola lomnqakiswano libhekene nezinselelo zakhona, njengezinkinga zokuncintisana, izimali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Nokho, umoya wombukiso, wokuhlanganyela, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana kuqhubeka kukhuthaza abadlali nababukeli. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lihlala linethemba, lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphumelele, futhi lihlale lingenakuphikiswa njengomdlalo ophumelelayo, ophilayo. Umdlalo ubonisa ukuthi, noma izimo zishintsha, umoya wokudlala, wokuhlanganyela, kanye nowokuncintisana kuhlala kukhanya. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lihlala lingenakuphikiswa, lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphumelele.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya: Izinselelo Nezixazululo Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo eNingizimu Afrika. Imiphakathi emakhaya ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizweni ezisemqoka ezifana nezikole nezibhedlela. Nokho, entuthukweni, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwakheni amathuba, hhayi kuphela ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Okokuqala, sithinta impilo nezezimali zabantu basemakhaya. Abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezinzile, kodwa bahlupheka ukungabi nezinsiza ezithile. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa izinsiza, njengokwakha izindawo zokulima, ibalulekile. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo—ukufundisa abantu indlela yokulima ngendlela efanele—kungasiza ekwenzeni izimpilo zabo zibe ngcono, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa kwezempilo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yomsebenzi kubalulekile. Ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha izindawo zasemakhaya, kudinga imisebenzi eyengeziwe. Lokhu kungafezwa ngezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukutshala izimali ezinhlelweni zokwakha, njengokwakha izikole ezintsha nezikhungo zokwelapha, kuzokwakha amathuba emsebenzini, okuzosiza imiphakathi emakhaya. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezolimo nezokwakha imikhiqizo emisha kungasiza abantu emiphakathini. Ukwakha izimboni ezincane, okwaziwa njengama-micro enterprises, kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhweba kahle, abantu bazothola imisebenzi, okuzosiza umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubomgomo yokwakha izikhungo zemfundo ezithuthukile ibalulekile. Inkqubo efanele yokufundisa ezindaweni zasemakhaya ingavula amathuba amasha kumakhono, okuzosiza abantu bahlomule ngezifundo nezinsiza zokusebenza. Izikhungo zemfundo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe. Nokho, izinkinga ezihlobene nezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya azilula. Kunezithiyo eziningi, njengezinkinga zemali, ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza. Abaholi bemiphakathi badinga ukusebenzisana nezinhlangano ezizwelonke ukuze bathole uxhaso. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezizimele nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuxhasa izindawo zasemakhaya. Kubalulekile ukugcina ubumbano phakathi kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa. Inhloso akuwona nje ukuvuselela umnotho, kodwa futhi ukuqinisa ubumbano phakathi kwezizinda nezikole. Umphakathi onobumbano uthuthukisa ukuzwakala kwezimo ezithuthukayo. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya akukhona kuphela ukuphendula izinkinga, kodwa kudinga indlela ehlangene yokuhlela. Abantu basemakhaya badinga imithombo yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi lokhu kudinga umzamo owodwa kulabo abahola kulezi zinhlelo. Uma sithatha izinyathelo, sigxile ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza nezinhlelo, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kulezi zinkalo, kubalulekile ukwakha amathuba, ukudala imithombo emisha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlela imiphakathi emakhaya futhi kudaleke ithuba lokuphila okungcono. Kulesi simo esinzima, lezi zinhlelo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ziqinise umnotho, futhi zishintshe izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Isikhathi sesifiso sokwaziswa nezenzo ezinhle, ukuze sithuthukise, sidlule emnothweni ophumelelayo, ngenkathi sithandazela umphakathi ophindaphindayo.
Umbiko: ITheku Isingeniso ITheku, eyaziwa nangokuthi yiTheku leNingizimu Afrika, iyidolobha elikhethekile elinikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubantu. Le ndawo iyinhloko yezokuthutha, ezomnotho, nezamasiko, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni wezwe. ITheku itholakala eningizimu-mpumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika, eduze nolwandle lwe-Indian Ocean, futhi inezindawo eziningi ezithokozisayo ezifana nezikhumbuzo, izimakethe, nezindawo zokungcebeleka. Umlando Umlando weTheku uqala eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane, lapho amaKhoisan, abahlali bokuqala, bahlala khona. Emva kwalokho, iTheku yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise amaNgisi, amaBhunu, namaZulu. Ukuze siqonde kahle iTheku yanamuhla, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yayo emlandweni wezombusazwe nezamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Izakhiwo Zomlando EThekwini, izakhiwo zomlando zikhumbuza abantu ngempilo yamaNgisi nabantu bendawo. I-Old Fort, eyakhiwa ngo-1843, iyisibonelo esihle sokwakhiwa kwesikhathi esidlule. Lezi zakhiwo zikhangisa izivakashi, zikhombisa ubuciko bokwakha besikhathi esidala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Emperor's Palace, eyaziwa njengendawo yokudlela, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha obuphambili. Izindawo Zokungcebeleka ITheku inezindawo eziningi zokungcebeleka ezihamba phambili. I-Umhlanga Rocks, enezihlabathi ezimhlophe, iyindawo ethokozisayo yokuphumula. Izivakashi zingadlala emanzini, zibhakabhake, noma zihlale phansi zikhangela ubuhle balolu lwandle. Futhi, i-Durban Botanic Gardens iyindawo ethokozisayo yokuhlola izitshalo ezahlukene, ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo. Ezokuthutha ITheku iyinhloko yezokuthutha eNingizimu Afrika. I-Port of Durban iyindawo yokuhweba enkulu, ibalulekile ekuthumeleni nasekutholeni imikhiqizo emhlabeni jikelele. Izikhumulo zezindiza, njenge-King Shaka International Airport, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kweTheku nezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuthutha kwenza kube lula kubantu nempahla ukuhamba, futhi kuthuthukisa umnotho wedolobha. Izamasiko ITheku iyindawo ebanzi yamasiko, lapho abantu bahlukene behlangana khona. Izimakethe zendawo, njengemakethe ye-Victoria Street, zikhombisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene. Lapha, abantu bangathola ukudla kwasekhaya, imikhiqizo yesintu, nezimpahla ezikhethekile. Imicimbi yamasiko, efana ne-Durban International Film Festival, ibonisa ubuciko bendawo futhi ikhulisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umnotho Umnotho weTheku ubonakala ngokukhula okukhulu emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Ukuhweba, ezokuthutha, nezokuvakasha zenza kube lula ukuheha abatshali bezimali. Izinkampani ezinkulu zifaka imali eThekwini, zikhuthaza amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kukhula kwenza iTheku ibe yindawo efanele yokuhlala nokusebenza. Izinkinga Naphezu kokukhula, iTheku ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ubumpofu, nezinkinga zokuhlala zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuba uhulumeni nabezindaba basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu. Ukuze iTheku iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Isiphetho ITheku iyidolobha elinothile ngamasiko, umlando, nezokuthutha. Ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo, izakhiwo zomlando, nezindawo zokungcebeleka ezihamba phambili. Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokuphila zabantu. ITheku, njengendawo, inezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo ezilindelela ukuba zihlolwe, futhi umhlaba uqhubeke ufinyelela kuleli dolobha elinothile.
Udlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela Nokuphuma Emathubeni Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga enkulu emphakathini wethu. Lokhu kudlame kungaba ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, noma ngokocansi, futhi kubangela ubuhlungu obukhulu ezimpilweni zabesifazane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuzivikela, siqonde izimpawu zodlame, futhi sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile ezizosisiza ekuphumeleleni ekulweni nodlame. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Udlame Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane lungatholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Udlame lwezocansi: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yokocansi ngaphandle kwemvume. - Udlame lwemizwa: Lokhu kubonakala ngokuhlukumeza, ukugxekwa, noma ukwehliswa kwenhlonipho. - Udlame lwemizimba: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlaselwa ngokomzimba, njengokushaywa noma ukuhlinzekwa ngodlame. Ukuqonda lezi zindlela zodlame kuzosisiza ukuba sibe nekhono lokuzivikela. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubona Izimpawu Zodlame Izimpawu zodlame zingahluka, kodwa kunezinto ezithile okufanele sizibheke. Uma ubona noma uzwa: - Ukukhathazeka okungapheli, ukungabi nankinga, noma ukungazethembi. - Ukuphazamiseka emsebenzini, ezikoleni, noma emiphakathini. - Ukuphazamiseka kokuxhumana nabanye, noma ukugwema abantu abathile. Lezi zimpawu zingaba uphawu lokuthi umuntu ubhekene nodlame. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona lezi zimpawu, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhuluma Ngodlame Uma ubona izimpawu zodlame, kubalulekile ukukhuluma. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa kubalulekile. Ungakhuluma nomngane, umndeni, noma umuntu omethembayo. Uma ungakakwazi ukukhuluma, ungabhalela phansi imicabango yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuveza imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukufuna Usizo Uma udlame lukhona, kubalulekile ukufuna usizo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze uthole usizo lwezempilo. - Ukuxhumana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwengqondo. - Ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezikhethekile ezisiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo. Ukufuna usizo akusho ukuthi uyaphoxeka, kodwa kusho ukuthi uyazithanda futhi ufuna ukuphila impilo engcono. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuzivikela Ukuzivikela kubalulekile. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukufunda izindlela zokuzivikela, njengezokulwa. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphepha, njengokwazi ukuthi ungaphi uma uzizwa ungaphephile. - Ukuxhumana nabangane noma umndeni ukuze uthole ukwesekwa. Ukuzivikela akukhona kuphela ukuvikela umzimba, kodwa futhi nokuvikela imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokwesekwa Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakalayo ezisiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo. Lezi zikhungo zinganikeza: - Ukusekela ngokomzimba. - Ukusekela ngokwengqondo. - Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuphuma ezimeni ezinzima. Ukuxhumana nalezi zikhungo kungaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphuma emathubeni. Isinyathelo 7: Ukukhuthaza Abanye Ngemuva kokuthola usizo, ungaba yisibonelo kwabanye. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukwabelana ngempilo yakho nabanye. - Ukukhuthaza abesifazane abanye ukuba baphume emathubeni. - Ukuxhasa imikhankaso yokulwa nodlame. Ukukhuthaza abanye kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuphila Impilo Engcono Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuzivocavoca ukuze uthole amandla. - Ukudla kahle ukuze ugcine impilo. - Ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula nokuzijabulisa. Impilo engcono izokwenza kube lula ukuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba udlame. Isiphetho Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga enkulu, kodwa sinesibopho sokuzivikela nokuphuma emathubeni. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, singakwazi ukusiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo, sikhuthaze abanye, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Khumbula, akuwona umthwalo wakho kuphela, kodwa umphakathi wonke unomsebenzi wokulwa nodlame. Sihlanganyele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabesifazane, sikhulise umphakathi onobudlelwano, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa elingcono.
### UHuawei: Umlando, Inoveli, Nezimpumelelo Isingeniso UHuawei, inkampani eyaziwa kabanzi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, yatholwa eChina ngo-1987 ngu-Ren Zhengfei, umqondisi osemqoka. Kusukela yasekelwa, le nkampani ibonakale iyinkanyezi eqhubekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, iphumelele kakhulu ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni amathuluzi kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi. Umlando Wokuqala UHuawei yaqala izimpande zayo njengefektri encane eShenzhen, lapho yayikhiqiza khona imikhiqizo yezokuxhumana ephansi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uRen Zhengfei wayenokubuka okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe, ubehlanganisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje nezinqubomgomo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubekayo, uHuawei wathuthela emikhiqizweni ebalulekile, uqala ukukhiqiza izingcingo eziphathwayo namakhalekhukhwini. Inoveli Nokuthuthukiswa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uHuawei wawina inhlonipho emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, eba ngumnikazi wezincwadi eziyinhloko ezibhalwe yizikhungo zezenhlalo ezifana nezikhumbuzo, ubuchwepheshe bomhlaba, nezikhumbuzo zobuchwepheshe. Izikhumbuzo zayo ze-5G zibhalwe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa okuyinqaba. Yona yayingeyokuqala ukuhwebelana nalolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe, yenza kube nephuzile uma kuziwa ohlelweni lokuxhumana. Ukwanda Kwenkampani Ngemva kokuba uHuawei esethole impumelelo kulesi sikhala, inkampani yanda kakhulu. Kuvula amashbranch amasha emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi eYurophu nase-Asia. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, yashintsha izinhlelo zayo, yathuthukisa imikhiqizo ebizwa nge-Huawei Pwa, eyokutholwa kwamakhompyutha, namaphesenti aphakeme oscillators, okwenze kwavela izinhlelo eziyinkulu zemikhiqizo eyahlukene. Lesi simo sithathe ikhwelo leminyaka eminingi. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Njengoba uHuawei eqhubekele phambili, kuza nezinkinga ezinqunyelwe. Izingqinamba zomhlaba eziqhamuka ezwenikazi ziqhamuka ngenxa yokungathembeki kwezepolitiki, futhi kwezinye izinhlelo ezizimele. Kodwa uHuawei, ngendlela efanele, wafaka amagalelo akhe ezinhlelweni vele, waphinde waba yinkampani eyaziwa kahle ngezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi zezenhlalo nezokuxhumana. Isithombe Esimangalisayo Uhlelo lwe-Huawei lwenziwa ngezigaba ezithuthukisiwe kakhulu, ezifaka phakathi i-IoT, ukuxhumana okuphakeme, kanye ne-AI. Lokhu kukhuthazwe ubuchwepheshe bokwakha imiphakathi yezenhlalo nezokuxhumana nokuxhumana. UHuawei udlale indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba okukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, egcizelela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezithuthukisa izinga lemisebenzi. Uhlanga Lokugcina Namuhla, uHuawei ubalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, udlula nemikhawulo yokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela ethuthuke kakhulu. Ubuye uthole izitifiketi eziningi, wahlonishwa ngezinto eziningi ezenzakalayo ezithinta umphakathi. Ushalazela phambili emashumini eminyaka yokusebenza, doda uqhubeka nokuzibophezela emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ukuletha okuhle ezizweni ezahlukene nokuthuthukisa uzinzo lokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, uHuawei akagcini nje ngokuba umkhiqizi obalulekile, kodwa futhi usemhlanganweni wezobuchwepheshe ohamba phambili, wenza izinguquko ezithokozisayo emhlabeni jikelele. Ubulungiswa, inoveli, nokusebenza kwamaHuawei kulindeleke ukugcina impumelelo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ukwamukela isifiso sokukhula, uHuawei ube nesiko eliqhubekayo lokukhiqiza imikhiqizo emisha, ilwela ukuhlala phambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuyi-oda kulolu hlelo oluqhubekayo lokuthuthuka, nobuchwepheshe obuthuthukiswe miro, kungenxa yomgomo ophumelelayo. UHuawei, ohambisana nezidingo zezinkonzo zomhlaba, uyacinga uthando nomoya wokusebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Umlando kaHuawei umhlopeka bukhoma, futhi izinkanyezi zayo zoqobo zikhanya phezu kwamaholidi azayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lempumelelo yethu, inspirishes izizukulwane ezizayo, kuvula uhla lwezinkangala zemikhiqizo, idolobha lempumelelo ngennium edluleyo.
Impilo Yasemakhaya: Izifundo Nezinselelo Zokuphila Emzaneni Impilo yasemakhaya, ibonisa isiko elijulile nelimnandi, ithinta izigidi zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Kulezi zindawo, impilo ithathwa njengokuhlala emkhayeni, lapho ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buphakanyiswa khona. Kanjalo, impilo yasemakhaya ibonisa izifundo ezinzulu ezithinta imvelo, ubudlelwano, kanye nezindlela zokuphila. Uhlanga lwemvelo lwemakhaya luthinta impilo yomuntu. Abantu bahlala eduze kwemithombo yemvelo, befunda ukuphila ngokuhleleka nokuhlanganyela. Umphakathi uvame ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha, lapho umphakathi wonke uhileleka khona. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile. Abalimi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlala bephokophele ukwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukulima akusikho kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kuwumthombo wezimali nezinsiza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yasemakhaya ibhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukushoda kwemithombo yokuxhumana nemfundo kuyasondela ekuphileni kwabantu. Abantwana abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezinhle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinselelo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele, njengamakhaya amasha nemitholampilo, kuyasiza ekutheni abantu bahlale behlupheka. Ngokubheka izindlela zokuphila, impilo yasemakhaya iyashintsha. Imininingwane ethile ibonisa ukuthi abahlali baye bacela izindlela zokuphila ezivamile, hamba phambili. Imikhiqizo yendabuko iyathandwa, kodwa ngokuya phambili, imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu edinga ubuchwepheshe iyathandwa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abantu basemakhaya baye bahlale bephokophele ukuhambisana nezimo ezishintshayo zomhlaba. Ukwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi yempilo yasemakhaya kubalulekile. Abantu basemakhaya bahlale bephokophele ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi impilo iyahlobene kakhulu nokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu bahlala bexhumana ukuze bangaphuthelwa yizinto ezibalulekile. Ubuqotho, ukusizana, nokuhlanganyela kwempilo, kudala umoya ovumelanayo phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukugcina izindlela zomdabu, ukuze kuhlonishwe isiko. Umphakathi uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni ezithinta umculo, imidlalo, nezamasiko, okwenza impilo yasemakhaya ibe mnandi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophele ukugcina ubuhlobo nemvelo, futhi lokho kuhlobene kakhulu nezindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko ezithinta izindawo zemakhaya ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwemizi, ukwanda kwezizinda, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kunciphisa izinselelo ezithinta impilo yasemakhaya. Kodwa-ke, abahlali bahlale bephokophele ukwakha izindlela ezizokwazi ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo yabo, ukuze baphile kahle. Njengoba abahlali begcina izimpilo zabo, kuhlezi kubalulekile ukuba bahloniphe izimo ezithinta impilo yasemakhaya. Ukufunda, ukuzimela, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile kubalulekile ukuze impilo yasemakhaya iphumelele. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophele ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezihamba phambili nezamasiko, ukuze impilo yasemakhaya ibenokuthula, uthando, nokuphumelela. Ekugcineni, impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile, ibusa izifundo ezibalulekile kubantu bakuleso sikhathi. Ukukhuthaza umoya wobudlelwano, imfundo, neziqu zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuze impilo yasemakhaya ihlale isebenza kahle. Njengoba abahlali bephokophele ukuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi umphakathi, imvelo, nezindlela zokuphila zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono emakhaya.
### Isomiso: Indaba Yomlando Njengoba izinyanga zishintsha, izinkanyezi zikhanya, umhlaba ubona izinguquko eziningi. Kodwa phakathi kwalezi zinguquko, kwesinye isikhathi, kudinga ukubhekana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nezwe lethu, lapho isomiso siba yinkinga enkulu, sithinta impilo yabantu abahlala kule ndawo. Uma sibuyela emlandweni, sithola ukuthi isomiso sasiwumthwalo omkhulu ezindaweni nasemiphakathini. Lezi zimo azikabi ezintsha; izizukulwane eziningi zidlule ezimweni ezinjalo. Ezikhathini ezedlule, abantu babekhumbula lezi zimo ngezingoma, izinkolelo, nezinkolelo ezikhuthazayo. Enyanga eyaziwa ngokuphila, abantu babenombono omuhle wempilo, owawukhula emhlabeni. Kwakukhona izinyanga ezomile, lapho izinkomo nezitshalo zazithola khona ubunzima. Ngesikhathi sikaMdumazi, isomiso sahlala isikhathi eside, sithinta imfuyo nezolimo, okubangele ukungabi nokudla. Uthando nemithetho yokubambisana phakathi kwemindeni yayibalulekile, futhi izigebengu zazibe qhawe ezihlahleni. Izazi zezulu zathi isomiso siphuma ngaphansi kwempilo yemvelo. Kwezinye izikhathi, izimo zokuhlala zabantu zaziphikisana nemizamo yokuhlanza imithombo, okwakuholwa ngothando lwezizukulwane ezedlule, izinkanyezi, nemvelaphi yemvelo. Ukukhanya kwelanga, izinyanga eziphuma ngezikhathi ezithile, kuveza izinselele ezithile, nezinkinga ezithinta impilo yomhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukufuna izixazululo ezizokwazi ukubhekana nesimiso. Basungula izindlela zokugcina amanzi, badala amathafa, futhi baqala ukuphila ngokugcwele esizindeni ezivunguvungwini. Izinhlobo ezintsha zokulima, ezazikhuthazwa yizimfundiso zabokufika, zimele umsebenzi wokulima. Abantu bafunde ukusebenzisa izinsiza zomhlaba ngokuhlakanipha, behlukanisa izinkomo nemifino, benze i-direct planting, njalonjalo. Njengoba izinyanga ziqhubeka, izindlela eziningi zaziqala ukugcina impilo yezilimo. Izimvula ezincane ziqhathaniswa neziqhingi zemimo ezejwayelekile, ukuphakamisa izinga lomhlaba, ukuphuma kwezinto ezintsha, nokukhula kwemifino. Abantu bajabule ngalezi zinguquko, futhi imifino yabuya, kwavela izinhlobo ezintsha zokudla nemikhiqizo, okuyinto eyayiqhuba ubuhlobo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Futhi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isomiso sakhula imfundiso. Abantu baqala ukuhlosele izinyathelo ezihlangene, benza imihlangano nezinkulumo ezimfushane zokubambisana. Izithombe zempilo zabantu, imicabango, nezindawo zomhlaba zaqinisekisa ukuba isimo somhlaba siyashintsha. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, futhi kwehlisa isizathu sokungqubuzana. Naphezu kwezizama, isomiso sasisakwenza kancane kancane konke okukhona, kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani. Uma sihamba emkhakheni wezinsizakalo, kungokwakho ukuyobona izindlela eziningi zabathintekayo baphila ezindaweni ezithile, bethola izindlela ezahlukene zokuqhubeka. Ngamanye amazwi, isomiso sathinta imibhikisho; imikhankaso yokubambisana yasungulwa, izingcaca zavela, amasu ahlukene atholakala ukuba abenze izinqumo ezinhlangothini ezahlukene. Lokhu kubuyisela amandla nentuthuko kulezi zindawo. Ekupheleni kokuqukethwe kwale ndaba, kumenyezelwa ukuthi izinyathelo zokuqwashisa, zokubambisana, kanye nemisebenzi yokwakha udumo alisali, kodwa umphakathi uqhubeka uhlala qotho emizweni yokuhamba phambili. Isomiso sasiqonda ukuthi izingxenye zomhlaba, izinsiza, nezinsizakusebenza zidinga ukwelashwa, futhi kuphela abantu abazokwazi ukukhuluma ngomphakathi. Izinyanga zifika janji, ngenkathi abantu bahlala bephethe izinsizakusebenza zabo. Umoya wabantu ubumbene, futhi impilo iqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ngakho, kwesinye isikhathi, inhlalakahle yabantu ibizwa ngamadla nemithombo engapheli. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waphila, wagcina izinyathelo zokuphila ezifundise abanakho ukuzimela, ngothando nemizwa eyakhayo. Ngakho, ngaleso sikhathi okwakuyisomiso, abantu bakwazi ukuyidinga inyama, kwezokuphuza, umnotho, nezinye izinsiza. Sazibonakalisa izithombe zempilo, izinkanyezi, emathafeni, ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, ukuvusa imizwa. Isomiso sasiwukuhlala kwesisekelo somhlaba, imposi iwubumnandi, kodwa kube nokuhlushwa — konke lokhu kudinga ukucubungula, futhi okuhlangenwe nakho kwaba yisisetshenziswa esiveza impilo. Namuhla, isithombe sokuphila sihamba emkhakheni wempilo — izinyanga zihlala zinenqangi, abantu bazithandela imicabango yokwakha. Ngalendlela, isimoniso singaphansi kweziyalezo zobuhlobo, sihlala phakathi kwezinga, kubaluleke kakhulu. Umhlaba ubonisa amandla obumbano, futhi kulapho impumelelo ibuswa khona. Le ndaba yalesi sicefe sothando, sithinta lapho kuxoxwa khona izinkonzo zikaJehova, ezibiza ubuhlobo, nezithombe ezithinta izizukulwane zabantu. Kulezi zikhathi, izinto zishintsha, kodwa izifundo zihlala zikhona — zingamalungelo okuphila. Ubuza kufanele kugxiliswe kokubili ebuntwini nasekusebenzelaneni. Umphakathi awudingi ukulangazelela; kudinga ukukwazi okuhle — ubumoya uma ukwazi impilo nenhlalakahle njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isomiso sathinta impilo, sakhulisa izinjongo, senze abantu bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga. Ubulunga buyaqabula, umhlaba uhleli ngokuphelele, futhi impilo iqhubeka.
Amalungelo Abantu Besifazane: Impilo Engcono NgeMizamo Yokulingana Amalungelo abantu besifazane abephakathi kwezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni. Phakathi nezinkulungwane ezedlule, abantu besifazane babenobunzima obukhulu, okuhlanganisa ukungabi namathuba afanele emsebenzini, ezemfundo, kanye nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Nokho, eminyakeni yamuva, kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezilungiselelwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane, okuholele ekutheni baphile impilo engcono. INingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukuthuthuka okuhle kulokhu, njengoba imithetho efana ne-Employment Equity Act kanye ne-Promotion of Equality and Prevention of Unfair Discrimination Act iqinisekisa amalungelo alinganayo phakathi kwabantu besifazane nabesilisa. Le mithetho ivikela abantu besifazane ekucindezelweni futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi bathola amathuba alinganayo emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu besifazane ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi iyakhula. Lokhu kubandakanya imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abafundi besifazane ukuba baqhubeke nemfundo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi ukuze ziqinisekise ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifanele. Nokho, nakuba kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisayo, abantu besifazane basahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi namathuba emsebenzini, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala zihlala zikhona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokweseka abantu besifazane ukuze baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze abantu besifazane bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amakhono abo, kubavulele amathuba emsebenzini, futhi kubanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukubandakanya abantu besifazane ezindaweni eziphezulu zomphakathi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphumelele, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ukwamukela abantu besifazane bezindima eziphezulu kuzokwenza kube nokulingana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amalungelo abantu besifazane azoba yinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Njengoba sikhuthaza imikhankaso yokulingana, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhululekile, futhi onobulungiswa. Ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu besifazane bekwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, bephumelela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Amalungelo abantu besifazane awanqandeki, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuwavikela ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni Ukuphila emadolobheni kuyinto ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi kunobunzima obuthile. Amadolobha ayizikhungo ezinkulu zokuhlala, umsebenzi, nezokuxhumana, futhi zinezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa zibuye zibe nezinselelo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zokuphila emadolobheni, kuhlanganise nezinto ezinhle, izinkinga, nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukile. Izici Ezinhle Zokuphila Emadolobheni Okokuqala, amadolobha anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezinkampani ezinkulu, amadolobha avame ukuba nezimboni ezahlukene, ezihlinzeka ngokuqashwa kwabantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola imisebenzi efanele izifundo zabo, futhi lokhu kudala umnotho ophilayo. Okwesibili, amadolobha anikeza ukufinyelela okulula ezinsizeni. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikole, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa zikhona eduze, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba. Lokhu kukhulisa izinga lempilo, njengoba abantu bengadingi ukuhamba kude ukuze bathole lezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha avame ukuba nezindawo zokudla ezihlukahlukene, okuvumela abantu ukuba bazame ukudla okuvela ezizindeni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Okwesithathu, ukuphila emadolobheni kuvumela abantu ukuba bahlanganyele ezindabeni zomphakathi. Amadolobha avame ukuba nezinhlelo eziningi zokuhlanganyela, ezifana nemicimbi yokuzijabulisa, imicimbi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Izinkinga Zokuphila Emadolobheni Nokho, ukuphila emadolobheni akukhululekile. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhala lokuhlala. Amadolobha amaningi abhekene nenkinga yokuntuleka kwezindlu, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuthola indawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi nendawo ukuhlela izimali zabo. Enye inkinga enkulu yizinkinga zokuhamba. Ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu, izindlela zokuhamba zihlala zigcwele, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuhamba, okungaholela ekudambiseni izinga lempilo. Abantu bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuhamba, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokucindezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha avame ukuba nezinkinga zokuphepha. Ukukhula kwabantu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lobugebengu, okwenza abantu bezwe bengaphephile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphile, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka. Izindlela Zokuphila Ezithuthukile Ukuze abantu baphile kahle emadolobheni, kudingeka izindlela zokuphila ezithuthukile. Okokuqala, abantu kufanele bafunde ukuhlela kahle izimali zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangakusebenzisa kanjani kahle imali yabo ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izindleko zokuhlala, zokuhamba, nezokudla. Ukuhlela kahle izimali kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuntuleka kwemali. Okwesibili, abantu kufanele baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephila kahle, baphuze amanzi anele, badle ukudla okunempilo, futhi benze ukuzivocavoca. Ukuphila impilo enempilo kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuphila emadolobheni. Okwesithathu, abantu kufanele bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, baphinde baphathe kahle abanye. Ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo, futhi kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bephila kahle. Isiphetho Ukuphila emadolobheni kunobuhle bayo, kodwa futhi kunezinselelo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde lezi zici ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngokuhlela kahle izimali, ukuphila impilo enempilo, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi, abantu bangakwazi ukujabulisa ukuphila kwabo emadolobheni. Ngakho, ukuphila emadolobheni kungaba yinto ethokozisayo uma abantu benza izinqumo ezifanele.
IKapa: Amadolobha, Imikhakha, Nezindaba Zansuku Zonke IKapa, okuyinhloko-dolobha yeMpumalanga Kapa, itholakala ngaphansi kwesigubhu seTable Mountain, ibonakala iyindawo enezindawo ezinhle nezithakazelisayo. Le dolobha iyikhaya kubantu abaningi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni nasenkululekweni yamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Isimo Sezulu Nezindawo Zokuhlala Isimo sezulu eKapa siphawuleka ngezinsuku eziningi zokukhanya kwelanga, okuhleleka kahle nezinyanga zokubanda. Lokhu kukhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zibe khona, zigubhe ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli. Izindawo zokuhlala zihluke-hluke, kusukela ezindlini ezincane ezisemadolobheni kuya ezindlini ezinkulu ezikwiindawo eziphakeme, okwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene ukuthi bathole indawo yokuhlala efanelana nezidingo zabo. Isiko Nezamasiko IKapa iyikhaya lesiko elicebile, elihlanganisa izinkolo eziningi, izilimi, nezamasiko. Izinkanyezi zomculo, njenge-Jazz ne-Gospel, zikhanya kakhulu eKapa, futhi imicimbi yezamasiko ibanjwa njalo, okubandakanya imikhosi yezinkanyezi, imikhosi yamasiko, nemicimbi yokudla. Abantu bendawo bahlala bevuselela izithakazelo zamasiko, benza kube lula ukuba izivakashi zifunde nokuhlanganyela kulokho okujabulisayo. Umnotho Nezokuthengisa IKapa iyindawo ebalulekile kwezomnotho, inomnotho ophilayo ohlanganisa ezokuthengisa, ubuciko, nezokuvakasha. Izimakethe ezinkulu, ezinjengeGreenmarket Square, ziphakamisa izimpahla ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kumasiko endabuko kuya ezicathulweni ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nethuba lokuhweba nokuqinisekisa ukuzinza komnotho wendawo. Izivakashi Nezokuvakasha Izivakashi zifika eKapa ngonyaka wonke, zifuna ukujabulisa amehlo azo ngezinto ezithokozisayo. I-Table Mountain, iCape of Good Hope, kanye neRobben Island ziyiwo amaphuzu abalulekile okwenza izivakashi zifake izithombe ezinhle. Abavakashi bangathokozela imisebenzi efana nezikebhe, ukuhamba ngezinyawo, nokuhambela izindawo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho wendawo, kwenza kube nesidingo sokuthuthuka kwezinsiza zendawo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, iKapa ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezindlu, ukungalingani komnotho, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi basebenza ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ezihambisanayo nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuphepha. Ikusasa leKapa Ikusasa leKapa libukeka linethemba, njengoba izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho ziqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokukhulisa imisebenzi emisha, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemadolobheni ziqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. I-Kapa iyaqhubeka nokuba yindawo lapho abantu bengahlangana, bejabulisa, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Ngokubona konke lokhu, iKapa iyindawo ehlala iyinhle, igcwele izinsuku ezijabulisayo nezifundo ezithembisayo. Izingxoxo ezimnandi, imicimbi eyahlukene, namathuba okuhweba esikhathini esizayo, konke kulungiselela iKapa ukuba ibe yindawo ethokozisayo nehlonishwayo eNingizimu Afrika.
Osaziwayo Nodumo: Amaphupho, Izinselele, Nezimpilo Ake sibheke izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke. Sihlala sibonile izithombe ezinhle, izikhangiso ezikhangayo, nezindaba ezimnandi eziphathelene nosaziwayo. U-‘celebrity’ uvela lapho ibhizinisi lemidlalo, umculo, noma izinto zokuzijabulisa selitholakala emhlabeni. Kepha, kuyini ukuthanda osaziwayo, futhi kuyini okukhuluma ngempilo yabo? Ngibheke lokhu phakathi kwami, ukuze ngidwelise kahle. Kukhona okuthandayo lapho kukhuluma ngosaziwayo. Inhliziyo yezenhlalo ifuna ukwazi okuningi ngabo – abashadile, abanakanga, abanesithunzi, abani imali eningi. Phakathi nemihlangano, sihlangana nezifiso zokuba yibo, ukuphila ukuphila okuthandwa umphakathi. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule, akekho umuntu ophelele. Abaningi bamele i-photogenic, kodwa abanezinkinga ezinzima zangaphakathi. Kukhona futhi ububi obuhambisana nodumo. Amasiko athwele kanzima futhi ahluphekile. Osaziwayo bahlala ngaphansi kwekhamera, abakwazi ukuphila impilo ejwayelekile. Cabanga nje, lapho uthola lo mculi omncane socela ukuthi uthumele isithombe, uvuma ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, udinga ukukwazi ukwakha ikhono lokuphila, okwenza umcabango ukuthi ungumuntu ophila njengabo bonke. Kukhona abampofu abavela ezindabeni, abafuna uthando nesikhumbuzo. Ngabe abavela ezindawenikazi, banelungelo lokubhekwa? Esikhathini esiningi, izinkinga zashintsha, okusho ukuthi abaculi bahlupheka kakhulu. Uphethwe izingcindezi zokubukeka, ukwenziwa kwezakhamuzi, nokugcina umphakathi uyajabula. Kodwa akufanele sibhale ngeso lokugxila kuphela. Abanye, abavela ezindaweni ezizimele, bazama ukwakha ibhizinisi labo. Ukuze bazame ukusiza, kukholelwa ukuthi uma nje uma bezithola, baqala ukufuna kuphela impilo elungile. Ngaleyondlela, kudinga ukucabanga ngobuchule, bahlala bephakathi kokuba abamukeli umphakathi. Ngabe kukhona okungase kube khona okungcono? Lokhu kudinga ukuphikelela ukuze kube nesizathu sokuphumelela. Khumbula, ikusasa labaculi alilula njengokufana nomkhiqizo. Ngibukele abanye abavela kuNetflix, behlola izinkanyezi ezithuthukayo. Uhlobo lokupthelwa kwabo kwabangela ukungaqondi kahle, bezama ukuzinza, futhi bazame ukuhlinzeka ngothando. Kwenziwa ngothando nolwazi, ngakho-ke abaphile njengoba bekulindelekile. Ngabe umculi wethu ubonakala njengomuntu odlula phezulu? Abaculi bahlala bebidinga ukwakha umgwaqo wabo. Abesifazane abahlakaniphile, bephakathi kwezinkanyezi zothando, bayazi ukuthi baqinisa imikhono yabo. Kwenziwa ngendlela yokuba balwe, balwe ukuze bafeze imali, nokuthola ikhono. Ngabe ungakuthola kahle lokhu okuvusa izithakazelo? Khumbula, umjikelezo omkhulu uyaqhubeka nolaka. Abakhiqizi bayazifaka impilo ezintsha, bezama ukukhiqiza abaculi abasha, abanye bakhokha imali engakwenzi. Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uminyaka uthisha umculi ofuna ukungena, phela izinsiza zenza kube nzima ukuya phambili. Ezemfundo, ezemidlalo, kufana nezinhlelo eziningi exubile. Akamfuni umphakathi, kufanele acacise izifiso zezehlo, imikhankaso nezizathu. Impilo ithokozisa kakhulu uma ubona ulwazi lwenkanyezi, ungathola ukuphila ehla ngaphezu kwezindonga ezimnyama. Uyazi kusho ukuthini. Lokhu kumele kube ngogqozi, ukuze uziqhenye futhi ukwazi ukubaluleka kokuba uyiqaba yabalungiselela izifiso zabo. Ngakho, lapho sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, asikho sehluko phakathi kwezinkanyezi eziphakeme nezempilo ezinokungafani. Ubulili, ubuchwepheshe, unaphi zenzwayo lilokhu silungiswa phakathi kwezinto ezilindelekile. Ngabe siyazi kahle okukhuluma ngakho? Ngcuka uma lokho kudinga izinkanyezi ezithile, sikhumbule ukuthi konke kuhlangene, njengenhliziyo elungisa konke. Ngamafuphi, impilo yosaziwayo iyinkimbinkimbi. Phezu kwakho konke, nezinto ezithile zikhona. Akekho ophelele, futhi abanye bahlala befuna ukuzijabulisa. Isikhathi sishintsha, futhi izinkanyezi ziyashintsha. Ngakho-ke, hamba izinto ezinhle, uzoba nezinselele, ukuze usebenze ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu kubalulekile, usaziwayo nalowo ogcizelela umoya obalulekile. Ubudlelwano, uthando, nezinkanyezi – konke kushintsha. Ngiyabonga.
Ukusweleka Kodokotela Ezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Isingeniso Ukusweleka kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kungumkhuba ophawulekayo ophazamise kakhulu izinsizakalo zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ikhubazekile imithwalo yemfanelo yodokotela, idala umthelela omubi kwiziguli nezimo zempilo zomphakathi. Lesi sikhathi sikhombisa ukunganeliseki okuqhubekayo ezinhlelweni zempilo, okusiza ukuhlinzeka ngemfundiso eqondile ngezizathu eziholela kulokhu futhi ukufaka izindlela zokwenza ngcono. Izizathu Zokusweleka Kubhekwa izici ezihlukahlukene eziholela ekuswelekeleni kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Okokuqala, ukuncipha kwezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kudinga ukuba abezempilo bahlale besebenzisa isikhathi esiningi ukuze bahlinzeke ngezidingo eziyisisekelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhola iziguli ezintweni ezingaphezulu. Ukwehla kwesibalo sodokotela, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaqeqeshwe ngokwejwayelekile, kusele nezibhedlela eziningi zikhunya emngceleni wokufinyelela odokotela abalungile. Lokhu kudala ukuncipha kokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo. Okwesibili, ukuntula izinhlelo ezicacile zokugqugquzela abasha ukuba bangene emkhakheni wezempilo kuholela ekutheni abampofu babe nobunzima bokufinyelela imfundo efanele. Ukwehla kwemali yokuphila ezingeni eliphansi kuthinta kakhulu abathanda ukugqashuka ezindabeni zokwelapha. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bathelwe aphezu, bephila impilo engekho emthethweni, lokhu kuze kube yimbangela yokuhamba kancane kwezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwelashwa. Umthelela Ezibhedleni Ukusweleka kodokotela kuthinta ngqo izibhedlela zikahulumeni namagumbi okuxilongwa. Iziguli zihlala zidlula ukusuka kwelinye udokotela kuya kwenye, kanti abanye bahlala bemukela ukwelashwa okungaphumeleli kube nezinga eliphakeme lokuhluleka. Lokhu kubangela ukulinda okude emagumbini, ukuzikhathaza kwabantu, nokuba nezinkinga ezikhiqizayo ezimeni zempilo, okungathinta (ngokubanzi) umphakathi. Umphakathi Wokuhlola Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele kulokhu, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuqeqesha odokotela nezinhlelo zentuthuko ezithinta iziguli ezithintekayo. Izingqungquthela zezemfundo zingaba yinsiza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba bejolise emkhakheni wezempilo. Kwakhulukazi, ukwakhiwa kwamathuba okuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezibhedlela kukhulisa amathuba okubamba uqeqesho oludingekayo. Izixazululo Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha nezokuma zodokotela. Imfundo, ukuhlinzeka ngezikhala zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa izimo zokuphila kumadokodo kufanele kube izinto ezibalulekile. Ungakubeka nohlelo lokuphakamisa izigaba zempilo ukuthi zihlakaniphe ngezinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo, lokhu kuzokwandisa ukulindela kwezinga lokuphila komphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme nakho kumele kube yindlela yokwenza ngcono le nkinga. Ukuze kufinyelelwe olwazini, izinyathelo zedijithali, okufana nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, kufanele zisetshenziswe zamukelekile. Lokhu ngeke nje kwandise ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, kodwa futhi kuzothuthukisa ukutholakala kwemali yokulawula izibhedlela ezithuthuke. Isiphetho Ukusweleka kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kudinga ukufuna isixazululo esiphumelelayo. Izifunda, uhulumeni, nabacebisi badinga ukuhlanganisa izinsiza ukuze bakhe izixazululo ezingcono. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele kanjani ekwakhekeni ngesimo sezinhlaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezimiso eziqinile ezizogqugquzela inhlalakahle nokwelashwa kwezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Ngokwezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukujula kolwazi, kanye nezinqumo ezicacile ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezempilo, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zithola usizo oludinga kahle. Lokhu kucela ukusebenzelana kokuphila kwezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene ezebhizinisi, nemindeni, nodokotela ukuze kwandiswe inhlalakahle nokukhula okuhloniphekile. Ukusebenza ngale sizatshana kuzothuthukisa izimo ezinhle zomphakathi jikelele. Siyavuma ukuthi isimo sabodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni sisafaneleka ukulungiswa, kanele, ngaphansi kokuholwa okuhle nokuhlonipha, izibhedlela zingaqinisekisa imiphumela emihle, zenze ingqikithi oyintandokazi kubantu bonke.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwezenhlalo: Ukubaluleka KwezeMisebenzi Zokuvikela Imininingwane Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani nezikhungo eziningi zikhula zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemisebenzi. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ingozi enkulu yokuphulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela imininingwane. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuhlaselwa kwezinhlaka, kanye nezinsongo ezivela kumakhompyutha kubonisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka izinyathelo eziqinile zokuvikela imininingwane. NgokweZikhungo Zokuvikeleka KweMisebenzi, ukuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kuyanda emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezincane, kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni ziya zihlushwa yizigebengu ze-cyber ezihlasela izinhlelo zazo ukuze zithole imininingwane ebalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukwehla kwesithunzi, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile lokuvikela imininingwane. Ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zinsongo, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo eziphambili zokuvikela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokubethela, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zabo ngokuqhubekayo. Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuvikela imininingwane kubalulekile, futhi kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwemithombo yolwazi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ukubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nezinsongo ezikhona, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela imininingwane. Izinhlelo zokubambisana zingaba yinzuzo enkulu, njengoba zenza kube lula ukufunda ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo zokuvikela. Naphezu kwemizamo eminingi yokuvikela imininingwane, izinsongo zihlala zikhona. Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zisesimweni sokulungela ukuhlaselwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele zihlale ziqapha izinhlelo zazo, zihlola izingozi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela. Ukubuyekeza njalo izinqubomgomo zokuvikela imininingwane kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umphakathi uqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwemithombo yolwazi, abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amagama aphusile, ukugwema ukucindezela izixhumanisi ezingaziwa, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zabo zokuvikela. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kulindeleke ukuthi izinsongo ze-cyber zikhule. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izinkampani zifune izixazululo ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane. Izinkampani eziningi ziyaqonda ukuthi ukuvikela imininingwane akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinhlelo. Ekugcineni, ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane kuyinselele enkulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Noma izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela, zihlala zidinga ukuqapha izinsongo ezikhona. Ukubambisana, ukuqeqesha, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwemithombo yolwazi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zihlala ziphila ezinsukwini ezinzima ze-cyber. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane, kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu, kanye nokugcina isithunzi sezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza ekulweni nezinsongo ze-cyber. Noma ngabe ungumsebenzi, umphakathi, noma umsebenzisi, wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala ekuvikeleni imininingwane. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizoba sengozini enkulu yokulahlekelwa yimininingwane ebalulekile. Ukuthi sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, kuyoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile nelinempilo.
Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi: Umcimbi Wokuthuthukiswa KweMisebenzi Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, owaziwa ngokuthi “Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi”, wabanjwa eGoli. Umcimbi lo wawuhloselwe ukusiza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukuthi bathole amathuba okusebenza, bathuthukise amakhono abo, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Ngokufika kwabantu, umoya wawugcwele ithemba nokukhuthazeka. Ababambiqhaza bahlala ezindaweni ezihlukene, behlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuxhumana, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Umcimbi waqala ngenkulumo yezenzakalo, eyaphakanyiswa uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumholi emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. UThabo uthe: “Siyazi ukuthi emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukukwazi ukuthola umsebenzi akusiyona kuphela indlela yokuphila, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.” Ngemuva kokwethulwa, abahlanganyeli bahlola izinketho ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Kwakukhona izinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe bezemisebenzi, abaqeqeshi, kanye nabamele izinkampani ezahlukene, ababeveza izidingo zabo kanye nezindlela zokuhlangabezana nalezo zidingo. Abantu babenethuba lokubamba izingxoxo ezijulile, bebuza imibuzo ethile futhi behlola izinkampani ezithakazelisayo. Phakathi komcimbi, kwaba nezifundo ezihlukahlukene ezazihlelwe, lapho abahlanganyeli bekhuthazwa ukuba baphendule izinselele ezihambisana nezimakethe zomsebenzi. Lezi zifundo zazihlanganisa izihloko ezifana nokwakha i-CV efanele, amasu okuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuzithuthukisa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Uhlelo lwemisebenzi lwaluhlanganisa nezingxoxo ezimfushane phakathi kwabantu abavela ezinkampanini ezihlukahlukene, ababeveza izidingo zabo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuxhumana okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi kanye nezinkampani ezithakazelisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwaba nezingxoxo ezithinta izinhlelo zokufunda eziphakanyisiwe, lapho abahlanganyeli bezitholela ulwazi olunembile mayelana nezifundo ezitholakalayo ezikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okucabanga ngale kwalezi zifundo, kubavumela ukuba bacabangele izindlela ezithile zokuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, futhi abantu babenethuba lokuhlola izindawo zokusebenza ezithile, lapho behlangana khona nabaphathi bezinkampani, bezama ukuthola izimpendulo ezizwakalayo mayelana nezikhala ezikhona. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okuholela ekutheni abantu bazitholele amathuba angcono emsebenzini. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu. Abahlanganyeli baphuma bezithokozisa, bejabulile ngolwazi abaluziwe, futhi beqonda kahle ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingabasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi yabo. Umoya wokuxhumana, wokufunda, nokukhuthazeka wawukhanya, umbono ophakeme wokuthi abantu bangenza umehluko emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona kuphela ukulandela amathuba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umcimbi lo ubonisile ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphokophele impumelelo emsebenzini, baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakhe izimpilo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi ubonisa indlela eya phambili, ubuhlakani, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi nezinkampani. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze sikwazi ukuphumelela emhlabeni onzima wezokusebenza. Umcimbi lo ube yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
AmaKaizer Chiefs - Ingxoxo Ngeqembu Elidumile Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma nokuqonda amaKaizer Chiefs, elinye lamaqembu aphambili emhlabeni wombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kube yithuba elihle lokuhlola umlando, impumelelo, nezifiso zalesi sikhungo esidumile. Ukuze siqonde kahle, sithintana nomqeqeshi, uNksz. Zanele Ndlovu, onolwazi olunzulu ngale nqola. Umlando WamaKaizer Chiefs UNksz. Ndlovu, singakucacisela ukuthi amaKaizer Chiefs asungulwa ngo-1970. Ngabe ungathanda ukusitshela okwengeziwe ngalesi sikhathi sokwakha? "Yebo, amaKaizer Chiefs asungulwa nguKaizer Motaung, owayengumgadli ophumelele. Waqaphela ukuthi kunezidingo ezinkulu zabalandeli bomjaho, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga ukwakha iqembu elizoba yinto enhle eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaqala uhambo olukhulu, njengoba amaKaizer Chiefs aba nezinhloso zokubeka imithetho emisha emqhudelwaneni." Imiphumela Nezimpumelelo Kukhona imiphumela ethile eyenzeka eminyakeni edlule. Ingabe ungakuchaza ukufinyelela kweqembu emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu? "Ngempela, amaKaizer Chiefs ayaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yawo emqhudelwaneni. Sineziqhumane eziningi, ikakhulukazi ePremier Soccer League naseNedbank Cup. Lokhu kwenza kube nomoya ophakeme phakathi kwabalandeli bethu. Iqembu lethu lihlala likhumbula izikhathi ezinhle, futhi sihlala sikhuthaza abadlali bethu ukuba bagcine lezi zinsuku zikhumbuleka." Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ngokuqhuba kwemidlalo, izinqumo zokwakha iqembu, nokuthi umqeqeshi uhlale enamathiselwe kumaphuzu athile? "Ukuze wakhe iqubu elihle, sidinga ukuqonda izidingo zethu. Sihlanganisa abadlali abasha nabadala, abaneziqu ezahlukene. Sizama ukufaka abadlali abasha abanesifiso sokufunda. Umqondo wethu uwukuthi bonke kufanele bazibophezele kulokho okufanele bakwenze, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yeqembu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bethu kubalulekile, futhi umoya wokubambisana uyasiza kakhulu." Ubuhlakani Bokuphelela Kuyinto ebalulekile ukwazisa ngendlela omqeqeshi abona ngayo ubuhlakani bokuphelela. Ungakuchaza ukuthi lokhu kulawula kanjani impumelelo? "Ubuhlakani bokuphelela buhlobene ngqo nemiphumela. Ngaphezu kokuba nabadlali abahle, kufanele sibe necebo elihle lokuqhuba. Uyazi, umphakathi, abalandeli, nabaphathi bonke banendima ebalulekile. Singabathandi kuphela, kodwa kufanele sikukhumbule ukuthi sikhona ukuze sibe neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wombhoxo." Izinselelo Nezindlela Zokubhekana Nazo Yiziphi izinselelo ezihlangabezana neKaizer Chiefs, futhi uhlela kanjani ukubhekana nazo? "Njengoba sikhula, izinselelo zikhula. Ukuze sibe neqhaza emqhudelwaneni, kufanele sibe nokuqonda okukhulu. Izimo zokuncintisana ziya ngokuya ziba nzima, kodwa sikubona njengethuba lokukhula. Sihamba phambili, sihamba phambili ngempumelelo ethile. Ngabe izifiso zethu zihlala ziphakathi, nokuthi sizothola ithuba lokubuyela emuva." Izifiso Zesikhathi Esizayo Ngabe kukhona izifiso ezithile ezikhona ngaphakathi kweKaizer Chiefs? "Yebo, sinesifiso sokwakha iqembu eliqhubekayo. Njengomqeqeshi, ngifuna ukubona abadlali bethu behluma, bephumelela, futhi bephumelela emikhakheni ehlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umgomo wethu wukubamba izicoco eziningi, ngaphezu kokuba nekhono lokwakha umphakathi onempilo." Isiphetho Ngikubonga kakhulu, uNksz. Ndlovu, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkumbulo ezisemqoka. IKaizer Chiefs iyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wombhoxo, futhi kucacile ukuthi ibalulekile nakweminye imikhakha. Ngithokozile ngomqondo nangesifiso sokubona iqembu likhula. "Ngiyabonga, nansi inhliziyo yeKaizer Chiefs. Sifisa ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza, nokubambisana nezinkanyezi ezizayo. Ngalunye usuku, sizoqhubeka nokwenza kahle." Ngokuhlala sizolokhu silindele, amaKaizer Chiefs azohlala engumholi emkhakheni wombhoxo, futhi impilo yabo izobe igcwele izinkumbulo ezinhle.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Kwake kwaba khona umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abajabule, izinsizwa nezintombi ezidansa emigwaqweni, zikhuluma ngezinto ezinhle. Kodwa phakathi kwalezi zinsizwa, kwakukhona uThabo, umfana owayenokukhanya okukhulu emehlweni akhe, kodwa owayesebenzisa izidakamizwa. UThabo wayengumfana ophumelelayo, efunda kahle esikoleni, kodwa kwaba khona umoya omubi owawumjolisa emhlabeni wezidakamizwa. UThabo waqala ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ngemuva kokuhlangana noSipho, umngane wakhe owayenobudlelwano obubi nezidakamizwa. USipho wayenokuthanda okukhulu kokuphila okusheshayo, futhi wathola uThabo esebenzisa izidakamizwa ukuze akwazi ukujabulisa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThabo wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinto zazingamphuca konke okwakukhona empilweni yakhe. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThabo waqala ukulahlekelwa yizinto ezibalulekile. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwashabalala, futhi izifundo zakhe zaphenduka umthwalo omkhulu. Abangane bakhe baphenduka kancane, behluleka ukuqonda ukuthi kungani uThabo engasekho njengesikhumbuzo esihle. UThabo waba yisithombe esingaphili, edlula phakathi kwabantu, kodwa engaboni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uThabo wathola ukuthi ubuhlungu obubangelwa yizidakamizwa buphindaphinda. Waqala ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinzima, ezindaweni ezithile eziphithizelayo, lapho abanye abantu bephila khona. UThabo wathola ukuthi izidakamizwa zazingamphucukile, zamsusa emndenini wakhe, zamsusa ezikoleni, futhi zamsusa empilweni yakhe. Ngesinye isikhathi, uThabo wathola umngane omusha, uNandi, owayenothando olukhulu lokusiza abantu abahluphekayo. UNandi wayenokholo olukhulu ekutheni uThabo angabuyela empilweni yakhe. Wamkhuthaza ukuba abuyele esikoleni, aphinde azame ukuphila impilo engcono. UThabo waqala ukubona ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi uzokwazi kanjani ukuphuma kulokhu, kodwa uNandi wayemkhuthaza njalo. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, uThabo wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokushiya izidakamizwa. Waqala ukuhamba noNandi, bejolisa emiphakathini yokwelashwa, lapho abanye abantu bephila impilo efanayo. UThabo wathola ukuthi akekho owodwa kuphela ophila ngale ndlela, futhi lokhu kumenze waba nesibindi sokubhekana nezinkinga zakhe. UThabo waqala ukufunda kabusha, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda kwakuyindlela yokuphila. Waqala ukubhala izincwadi, echaza izifundo zakhe, nokuthi izidakamizwa zamsusa kanjani empilweni yakhe. Wafunda ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi ukufuna indlela yokuphila kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba noNandi, uThabo wathola ukuthi ubuhlungu obubangelwa yizidakamizwa buphelile. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane bakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi uthando nokuxhaswa kwabangane kungamphatha kahle. UThabo waba yisibonelo esihle emphakathini, ebonisa abanye ukuthi kungenzeka ukuphuma ezinkingeni. UThabo waphinde wathola ithuba lokukhuluma emphakathini, echaza izifundo zakhe. Wafundisa abanye abantu ukuthi izidakamizwa zingamphuca konke, kodwa ukuphila okuhle kungenzeka uma umuntu ethatha isinyathelo sokuphuma. Waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi akekho ophila ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, kodwa umoya wokuphila ungabuyiselwa. Ekugcineni, uThabo waba ngumfana ophilayo, owayenokukhanya okukhulu emehlweni akhe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola imfundo ephakeme, futhi waba ngumholi emphakathini. UThabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma ubani angaphila impilo engcono, uma enokholo, uthando, nokuxhaswa. UThabo waba yisithombe sokuphila, esikhumbuza bonke abantu ukuthi impilo iyigugu, futhi kufanele siyigcine.
Amabhange: Ukuhlola Umsebenzi Wawo Nezinguquko Eziqhubekayo Amabhange, njengemithombo ebalulekile yezomnotho, adlala indima enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Njengoba sithuthuka emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, amabhange nawo abhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ezithinta indlela esisebenzisa ngayo izinsiza zabo. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi amabhange asebenza kanjani, izinzuzo ezihambisana nawo, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta abathengi. Umsebenzi Wamabhange Amabhange anomsebenzi obalulekile wokugcina imali, ukuhweba, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezezimali. Ngaphandle kokugcina imali, amabhange ahlinzeka ngama-akhawunti, izikweletu, nezinsizakalo zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuphatha kahle izimali zabo, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuboleka, amabhange akwazi ukusiza amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ukuthi akhule. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu. Ngakho-ke, amabhange awagcini nje ngokuba izikhungo zezimali, kodwa futhi abe yizikhungo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, amabhange abhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njenge-inthanethi nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zamabhange. Namuhla, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela ama-akhawunti abo, ukwenza ukudluliswa kwemali, nokuphatha izimali zabo kalula, konke lokhu kungenziwa ngefoni yabo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zamabhange zenza kube lula ukuhweba, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe izimali zabo ngokwakho. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa kwezomnotho, njengoba abantu beqonda kangcono izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zibuye zibe nezinselelo, njengoba kudingeka ukuthi amabhange aqinisekise ukuphepha kwedatha yomsebenzisi. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Amabhange Ukusebenzisa amabhange kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, amabhange ahlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kwemali. Uma umuntu egcina imali yakhe ebhange, ubeka imali yakhe endaweni ephephile, engakhathazeki ngokulahlekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezimweni ezinzima, lapho umuntu angase abhekane nezinkinga zezimali. Okwesibili, amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene ezithuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikweletu ezitholakalayo, ezivumela abantu ukuba bathenge izinto ezinkulu, njengezindlu nezimoto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange anikeza amathuba okutshala imali, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhe impesheni yabo. Izinkinga Eziqhubekayo Noma amabhange enezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinkinga ezithinta abathengi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhono lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zamabhange. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezithiyo ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba abantu besala emuva ekutholeni izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Enye inkinga ibangelwa ukungaqondi kahle izinsizakalo zamabhange. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zisebenza kanjani, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphathe izimali zabo ngendlela engafanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukusiza abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi ahlinzeke ngokuqwashisa okwengeziwe, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa umnotho. Nokho, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe kanye nezinkinga ezithinta ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zidinga ukuthi amabhange abheke phambili, aqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ukuze amabhange aqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi amabhange aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa okuhle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umnotho oqinile, ophumelelayo, nolwazi olunembile.
Impilo Yabafundi: Indaba Yomlando Kwakukhona isikhathi esithile lapho impilo yabafundi yayingekho nje kuphela emkhakheni wezokufunda, kodwa futhi yayihlanganisa nemicabango, izinselele, kanye nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abafundi babegcwele umoya wokuzimisela, befuna ukufunda, ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Iminyaka engama-1950, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika babebhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ezazihamba phambili emazweni ahlukahlukene. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babethwele kanzima ngenxa yokuhlukaniswa kwemibono kanye nemithetho yokwakha ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwamagugu. Kangangokuthi, imfundo yayingabantu abaningi ababehluleka ukungena ezikhathini ezijwayelekile. Noma kunjalo, kuhlanga lwabafundi, kwaqhamuka abantu abaziyo nezifiso ezinkulu zokuphungula lezi zinto. Ngalesi sikhathi, abafundi abavela ezikoleni ezahlukene bathutheleka eThekwini, eGoli, nasemhlabeni jikelele ukuze bathekelele izikole ezihamba phambili. Ubuchwepheshe bube bukhulu, obubuhlungu obwakuletha imithombo yokufunda eningilizayo, bese lokhu kudala umoya omusha phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi babebona njengomsebenzi wabo ukunikeza igalelo emiphakathini yabo, okusho ukuthi, bekudinga ukuthi baze baphikise izimo ezingezinhle ezibhekene nabo. Kodwa-ke, impilo yabafundi akukhona nje ukugijima ezincwadini. Abafundi bahlala behlangana emicimbini yezokuthula, bephikisana nemithetho engahambisani nemigomo yabo. Lokhu kwakuholwa ngababefundi abanjengoSteve Biko, owayeyisigodi sokukholwa ekusebenzeni nsuku zonke. Isikhumbuzo somkhosi omkhulu sokuphikisa ubuphofu behleli endaweni yokubhalela izivivinyo ezazihlala ziphansana; abadala babezama ukuzibandakanya, kambe abafundi babezothi: “Ngempela, sikhumbula imihla ephakeme”. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abafundi baqala ukwakha amabhande okukhumbula, umphakathi wawuzothi abavukile, bazonothola ngesikhathi esithile uma beziphatha kahle. Izijobelelo zomphakathi zanda lapho abafundi bezithokozisa ngezimpumelelo zabo, befundisa abasha indlela yokuphila ngempumelelo. Le mibhikisho emisha yaphinde yazuza ukunwaya okujabulisayo phakathi kwabafundi nakwabashayeli, okwakuhambelana kahle nokubukeka kwabo. Emakhulwini amasha, imfundo yaba yindlela yokulwela amalungelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izikhungo zokucwaninga nezemfundo, nendlela yokwakha izibonelo ezinhle zezimali zokukcredita kwabafundi elizweni. Abafundi babethola ukuthi udumo lozimele, imisebenzi yabo yayiqhubeka. Abafundi baqala ukubona ukuthi kungcono baqhubeke bephikisana, behlanganisa imizamo yabo ngaphandle kokudangala. Naphezu kokuphikisana okukhulu phakathi kwemibono, abasha baqhubeka bephila impilo yazo. Ukuzongena ezinhlelweni zezenhlalakahle kwenkosi kwi Afrika, impilo yabanemibono emisha yakuqala ukufezwa okuthembisayo. Kanjalo, abahlali bezikole babefunda еmiphakathini, bakha izindlela eziphumelela, baphendule abafundi abavela kwezinye izindawo ukuze bathole isikhala, lokho kwadonsa ubudlova obukulu. Izinkanyezi zikhanya emkhakheni wemfundo, abafundi bakwazi ukuwa beshaya umoya ngezinjongo ezivela emafutheni ahlukahlukene. Umsebenzi wobudlelwano bezenhlalakahle wayeqhubeka, ukwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi nakumafundisi. Bakhuthazwe ukuba bathole indlela yokusebenza, bebambisana ukuze bathole impumelelo ezindaweni ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wasuke wabona izijobelelo ezimbi ezavela emakhempini omphakathi, imibono eyayithokozisa izinsiza zempilo yomphakathi kwaholela ekukwakheni uhlobo olusha lwezinye izinhlelo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokubamba izanda ezazibhalwe emhlabeni wonke, yimuphi umoya ophakeme abaqhamuka nawo ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi nawo. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, abahlali bezikole baphuma bahamba eminyakeni edlule, bayithola ithuba lokwandisa izinkumbulo zabo ezinhle ezikhombisa izifundo ezithuthukayo. Ngalokhu, impilo yabafundi yaphenduka, kuhlanganiswe izishoshovu ezihlala zenza umhlaba ube yindawo engcono kakhulu yokuhlala. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, impilo yabafundi ibonakala iyinto edlulelwa phambili lapho abalimi besikhathi esizayo besebenzisa konke abakufundile. Le ndaba yama-Afrika ayisiyona nje oduma nalokho, isibonelo sokuthi abantu badinga ukuncedisana, bazimisele, futhi baqhubeke nokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono—ngokuhamba kwabo, impilo yabo, neqhaza elinamandla abakubeka emkhakheni wezeMfundiso. Emhlabeni ohlangene, impilo yabafundi iyinsika yokukhanya, ebonisa ukuthi isifiso sokufunda, sokuba umholi, nokuqhubeka nokukhula akupheli. Lokhu kuphila, lokhu kuthutsa, ukuhlwitha okukhulu kwempumelelo—lezi yizinto ezizophinde zikhumbuleke, zifakwa emikhumbulweni yokuphila emisha yabaninimithi lemiyalo emisha ehloselwe ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, impilo yabafundi ayikhaliphe lesi sikhumbuzo, kodwa ikafula ezigabeni zempilo, izinselele, nezimpumelelo eziba yingxenye yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophila ngempumelelo.
Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi seKhisimusi, indawo kaMnumzane Bhengu yayihlotshiswe kahle kakhulu. Izihlahla ezinhle, imihlobiso eminingi, nezibani ezikhanyayo zazigcwalisa izindlu zakhe nabangane bakhe. Umoya weKhisimusi wawuqhakazile, ugcwele uthando nokuhlangana, okwakujabulisa bonke abahlali bendawo. UMnumzane Bhengu, indoda enobuhlakani, wayethokozela lezi zinsuku, ngoba zazingezokuphila okubalulekile. Ubhuti wakhe, uSizwe, wayevame ukufika ngesikhathi seKhisimusi, ezinsukwini ezikhethekile. Njengoba uSizwe efika, uMnumzane Bhengu wayejabula, ubuso bakhe bukhanya ngothando. "Ngabe ubuya ngempela ukuze uvuse umoya wokukhumbula, mngani?" kubuza uMnumzane Bhengu, efuna ukuqonda indlela uSizwe azokwenza ngayo lesi sikhathi. USizwe, owayeqaphelile, waphendula: “Yebo, umngani, ngizohlala ngikhumbula iminyaka edlule, lapho sazi ukuhamba sihlola izihlahla ezinhle. Ngifisa ukwabelana ngalokho.” Bebehamba ngezinyawo emzini, behleka bejabule. Ukitshimi omncane wawusemoyeni, uzungeza amakhaya, uphakamisa umoya wokudlala. Abazali babo baphuma behleli, bejabulile, behlobisa izingane ezicela imiqhingle. Umama uMahlobo, unina kaMnumzane Bhengu, wayeletha imifino, izithelo, kanye nezimbuzi zokupheka. Imvuselelo yokuphila yayikubuyisela eminyakeni edlule, lapho amakhosikazi ayebhalisela amaholo nsuku zonke ukuze baqhubeke. Ngesikhathi esinzima, uZinhle, umntwana omncane, wayehamba no-gogo wakhe, evula izindololwane ezazikhala emoyeni. UMhlobo wakhe, uThandi, wayehamba, enza izinhlelo zokuhlala noKhisimusi. Kulawa maholide, uMnumzane Bhengu wanikeza umntwana izipho. Uthando lwempilo lwalukhanya phezulu, futhi uThandi noZinhle bakhuluma ngothando lwabo. Njengoba besondela ezinjeni, uMnumzane Bhengu wavuma ukuthi baphume bonke. “Sizokwakha iviki eliphephile, sizohamba. Umhlanga ungahlala isikhathi eside, okukhuluma ngomoya.” UMama uMahlobo wathokozisa bonke ngemifino, zikhumbula izinkanyezi ezimnyama, ekubhekeni ebusuku. Ubhuti uSizwe wathokoziswa empilweni, ukufika kwasebucikweni, nokuqhubekela phambili kokukhumbuza izinkanyezi ezihamba ngale kwelanga. Ngesikhathi efika elangeni, uMnumzane Bhengu wathola ukuphendula okuhle. Abafowabo babekhonjiswa ukubekezela, bekhombisa umndeni ukuqhakambisa impilo yothando. “Phuma, sithakele khona,” bathi lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya. Kukhanya izinkanyezi ezifakazela uhlobo lwenhlonipho. Uthokozisa, uMnumzane Bhengu waphakamisa izinkanyezi ezinhle, ugqozi lokukhanya kwakhe lwalukhanya emoyeni. Impilo yokugcina yayigubha umndeni, lapho izilo zichuma emagumbini. Khumbula izinkanyezi ezihamba, uMnumzane Bhengu wafunda uthando, ubusuku obunobungane konke. Lapho behamba besuka, ukudla neqhwa kwavuma. Iziqholo zegolide zebhasi zanyathelisa ngenxa yokuthokozisa, futhi bahlala befika besebhasi. Phakathi nemihlangano, bahlala bezama ukuphumula, bekhuluma ngothando, benza izinkanyezi zikhanye emzimbeni. Kwahamba isikhathi, umnyango wawuvulekile, futhi njengoba uKhisimusi uphelile, uMnumzane Bhengu wahamba nethuba lokwakha umndeni. Gxila emphakathini, ubusuku ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi kuqhamuke, kuncibilika. UThandi noZinhle bahlala behamba, bekwenza izindlela ezilungile, baphumula izinkanyezi. UKhisimusi wawuphelile — kodwa uthando, ubudlelwano, nempilo yempilo bekukhanya, kuyavuma. Emvcwebe, idlozi lalingekho, uMnumzane Bhengu ugwema ukuthi umndeni uzokhula. Lokhu, isilinganiso sokugcina, kuxoxa njengoba izinkanyezi, umoya, uvuka kabusha, kucela ukuthula nemihlangano esewuzayo, kuhamba nomndeni, umyalezo omuhle wothando. I-Khisimusi ayipheli; ithokozisa, ibaluleka, ithokozise, iphile. Umndeni wachuma ngamunye, kwavuma ngenhliziyo. Ngaphansi kokukhanya, impilo yayimnandi, ijabule.
Ifilimu: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, ifilimu edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, yadalwa nguSipho Mthembu, umqondisi ophumelelayo owayengumlingisi ophumelele emkhakheni wezokwenziwa. U-Sipho wazalelwa eThekwini ngo-1985, lapho aqala khona ukuthanda ifilimu. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwakhe, wathola ugqozi kumafilimu akhuluma ngezimpilo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwakuhambisana nezimo zempilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. U-Sipho uqale ukufunda ubuciko bokwenza amafilimu eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu. Ngalesi sikhathi, wathola ithuba lokusebenza kumafilimu amancane, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bakhe baphuma phambili, kwaze kwaba sekutholeni ithuba lokuba ngumqondisi kumafilimu amakhulu. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, owawukhuluma ngempilo yentsha eNingizimu Afrika, waba yimpumelelo enkulu futhi wathola imiklomelo eminingi emhlabeni jikelele. Le filimu ibonisa izinselele ezibhekene nentsha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. U-Sipho usebenzise izimo zangempela nezindaba zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe indaba ethinta inhliziyo. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi akukhulumi nje ngothando, kodwa futhi kukhuluma ngezinkinga ezifana nezidakamizwa, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza ifilimu ibonakale iyinsiza yokufundisa, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. U-Sipho Mthembu akazange akwenze lokhu yedwa. Wasebenzisana nabanye abaculi, ababhali, nabalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisibonelo sokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwakuhambisana nemigomo yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Sipho wathola ithuba lokuhola imikhosi emikhulu yezehlakalo zamafilimu, lapho abelokhu ethola khona izindondo eziningi. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi wathola imiklomelo eminingi, kuhlanganisa ne-‘Best Film’ kumkhosi wezokwenziwa eCannes. Lokhu kwenza u-Sipho waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokwenziwa, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu angaphumelela uma esebenza kanzima. Ngaphezu kokuba umqondisi, u-Sipho ungumfundisi. Uthanda ukufundisa abanye abaculi abasha, futhi uhlala ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. U-Sipho ubelokhu ebamba izifundo ezahlukene ezikoleni, lapho efundisa khona ngempilo, ubuciko, kanye nezindlela zokwenza amafilimu. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhasa abaculi abasha, ukuze baqale izindlela zabo emhlabeni wezokwenziwa. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi akukhulumi nje ngempilo yentsha, kodwa futhi kukhuluma ngothando, ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganyela. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi ifilimu ingaba yinsiza yokuxhumana, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ifilimu ingashintsha izimpilo zabantu, futhi ingaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Sipho Mthembu uqhubekile nokwakha amafilimu amasha, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umkhakha wezokwenziwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi, noma izinselele zikhona, uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi ifilimu yakhe, Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, iyinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokwenziwa. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwakha umphakathi. U-Sipho uhlala efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umkhakha wezokwenziwa, futhi uhlala ethokozisa abantu ngama-filimu akhe. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, ifilimu eyaziwa kakhulu, izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezokwenziwa eNingizimu Afrika.
Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Uhlaka Nendlela Yokusebenza Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zethu zanamuhla, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zineqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yethu. Zisebenza ekwakheni, ekuthuthukiseni, nasekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo ezithuthukisa indlela esiphila, sisebenza, futhi sithokozisa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani ezisebenza ngayo, ukuthi zixhumeka kanjani nezidingo zabantu, kanye nendlela esingasebenzisa ngayo imikhiqizo yazo ukuze sithole izinzuzo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zifaka phakathi lezo zikhiqiza isoftware, imishini, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza zedijithali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ama-giants afana ne-Google, Apple, Microsoft, ne-Facebook, kanye nezinkampani ezincane ezithuthukayo ezifana nezinkampani zokuqala ezihlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Ngokubheka ukuziphatha kwemakethe, lezi zinkampani zihlala zikhuthazwa izidingo zabathengi, zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlangabezana nazo. Isigaba 2: Izinqubo Zokwakha Umkhiqizo Ukudala umkhiqizo obuchwepheshe kudinga inqubo ethile. Okokuqala, izinkampani zenza ucwaningo ukuze ziqonde izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola imakethe, ukufunda ngababhekiswe kwezidingo ezithile, kanye nokuhlola imikhiqizo ekhona. Okwesibili, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha umqondo wombono, okukhuluma ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwethimba lezakhiwo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaklami, nabaphathi.
