Ngemuva kwalokho, i-prototyping iyenzeka, lapho umkhiqizo wokuqala udalwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwawo. Lokhu kuvumela izinkampani ukuba ziqonde ukuthi umkhiqizo uzosebenza kanjani empilweni yangempela. Uma umkhiqizo ubukeka usiza, izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuwuthuthukisa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi uyahlangabezana nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Isigaba 3: Ukwethula Umkhiqizo Uma umkhiqizo sekuqediwe, usuku lokwethulwa lufika. Lokhu kuwumcimbi omkhulu, lapho izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhiqizo kumakethe. Ukwethulwa kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze abathengi bazi kahle ukuthi umkhiqizo usetshenziswayo kanjani. Izinkampani zisebenzisa iziteshi ezahlukene zokuxhumana, njengezikhangiso ze-inthanethi, imicimbi, nezikhangiso ezinkulu ezitolo. Okubalulekile, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zithola impendulo kubasebenzisi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuqhubekeni nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa, izinkampani ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthola izimvo, nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka, ukuze umkhiqizo uhlale uphucukile futhi ufinyelele izidingo zabathengi. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngesevisi Nezixazululo Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe azikhokhi nje umkhiqizo, kodwa zenza kube lula ukuwusebenzisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhaswa, izifundo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuxhaswa okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukusebenzisa umkhiqizo ngendlela efanele, futhi bathole usizo uma kudingeka. Izinkampani zihlala zikhuthaza ukuxhumana nabathengi, ukuze ziqonde izidingo zabo, kungaba ngokuqondile, nge-imeyili, noma ngezingxoxo eziku-inthanethi. Izinkampani eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe zihlala zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlala ziqhubeka nezinselele nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Isigaba 5: Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zishintsha, zifuna izinto ezintsha ezithuthuka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokufunda okuphezulu, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), ne-Blockchain. Lezi zinto ezintsha zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze ngomqondo omusha, zikhulise imikhiqizo yazo, futhi ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukile. Ngokusebenza nezinhloso ezithile, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zabathengi, futhi zithuthukise umkhiqizo wazo ukuze ufinyelele ezimfanelweni ezithile. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha. Ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngayo, kusiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ingaba kanjani usizo empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda izinkampani zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinhle kubuchwepheshe obusha nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa impilo yethu.
Ithenisi: Umhlahlandlela Wokudlala Nokuthuthukisa Amakhono Ithenisi, umdlalo odlalwa emhlabeni wonke, ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ukugcina impilo, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga ubuchule, umqondo ophusile, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokuzikhandla. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokudlala ithenisi, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni. Isigaba 1: Ukulungiselela Ukudlala Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukudlala, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nezingubo ezifanele. Ukugqoka izingubo ezikhululekile, ezikhethekile zokudlala ithenisi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Qiniseka ukuthi unama-sneakers anekhono lokubamba kahle emhlabeni, ukuze ugweme ukuwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele ube nebhola letennis elihle, kanye nezinsiza ezifanele, njengezintambo ezinhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyazithokozela izikhathi zakho zokuqeqesha, hlela isikhathi esithile sokudlala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujolisa emgqeni wakho. Isigaba 2: Ukuqonda Umgomo Womdlalo Umdlalo we-tennis udlalwa phakathi kwabantu ababili (singles) noma amaqembu amabili (doubles). Umgomo uwukuphosa ibhola phezu komgqomo, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya emkhakheni womphetho. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola, bese umphosa ophendulayo kufanele abuyisele ibhola emuva. Ngokujwayelekile, umphosa ophumelela ukugcina ibhola emkhakheni womphetho uthola amaphuzu. Iphuzu linikezwa kumphosa ophumelele uma umphosa ophendulayo engakwazi ukubuyisela ibhola. Umphosa ophumelela amaphuzu angu-4, uthola umjaho, uma efika ku-6 amaphuzu, udlula emjaho. Isigaba 3: Amakhono Okudlala Ukudlala ithenisi, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Okokuqala, qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi ungakha kanjani i-forehand ne-backhand. I-forehand iwumphosa owenziwa ngendlebe yakho ethanda, kanti i-backhand iwumphosa owenziwa ngendlebe yakho engathandi. Zama ukwenza lezi zindlela zibe lula, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qonda ukuthi ungayithola kanjani i-serve. I-serve iyisinyathelo sokuqala somjaho, ngakho-ke qiniseka ukuthi uyayithuthukisa. Thola indawo efanele emkhakheni, uthathe ibhola, bese uphonsa phezulu, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya kahle emkhakheni. Ukusebenza kanzima ekuthuthukiseni i-serve kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu emidlalweni yakho. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlonipha Umphikisi Ngokudlala ithenisi, kubalulekile ukuhlonipha umphikisi wakho. Zama ukugwema ukukhuluma noma ukwenza izenzo ezincane eziphikisana nomphikisi. Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ukuhlonipha, kodwa futhi kukhombisa umoya ophakeme. Ukusebenza ndawonye, noma ngabe ungaphikisana, kudala umoya ophilayo emidlalweni. Isigaba 5: Ukuqeqesha Nokuthuthukisa Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Hlela isikhathi sokuzilolonga, ungazami kuphela ukudlala imidlalo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlala uphila, uthanda ukudlala, futhi uthuthukise amakhono akho. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo uzokwenza ube ngcono, futhi uzokwenza uzizwe ujabule emidlalweni. Isigaba 6: Ukubuyekeza Imidlalo Ngemuva kokudlala, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza imidlalo yakho. Bheka ukuthi yiziphi izindawo okudingeka uzithuthukise. Ungasebenzisa amavidiyo ukuze ubuke imidlalo yakho, noma ucele umngane ukuthi akubheke. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izindawo okudingeka uzithuthukise. Isigaba 7: Ukuzijabulisa Ekugcineni, khumbula ukuthi ithenisi kufanele ibe yinto yokuzijabulisa. Ngakho, qiniseka ukuthi uyayithokozela imidlalo. Yiba nomoya ophakeme, futhi ungavumeli ukwehluleka kukudikibalise. Ukudlala ithenisi akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi ukujabulela isikhathi esihle nabangani. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho, ujabulele ithenisi, futhi ube nomphumela omuhle emidlalweni. Qhubeka uqeqesha, uzithokozise, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuhlonipha umphikisi wakho — lezi zinto zibalulekile emhlabeni we-tennis. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula. Hamba phambili, ujabulele, futhi ube yinkanyezi emkhakheni we-tennis!
Umbiko Ngempilo Yezimayini eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Umkhakha wezokumbiwa udlala indima enkulu emnothweni weNingizimu Afrika, ulethe izinsiza, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Le ndaba ibheka izici eziningi zomkhakha wezokumbiwa, kubalwa izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela kulezi zindawo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimayini Izimayini ziqala ngokuhlola izindawo ezinezinhlobonhlobo zezinsiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhetha indawo efanele, ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokuthola imvume yokusebenza. Izinhlobo zezinsiza ezitholakala ezimayini zifaka igolide, insimbi, amalahle, nezinye izinto eziyigugu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kuthuthukisa ukutholakala kwezinsiza, kusebenza izindlela eziphambili zokuhlola nezokumbiwa. Izinzuzo Zokumbiwa Umkhakha wezokumbiwa uhlinzeka ngezindlela zokusebenza eziningi, udala amathuba emisebenzi emadolobheni nasemaphandleni. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni komnotho, njengoba izinkampani ezimayini zikhokha imisalo kubasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakusebenza zomphakathi, futhi zifaka imali ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izindawo. Ukuze umnotho uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umkhakha wezokumbiwa uhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, umkhakha wezokumbiwa ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukonakaliswa kwemvelo, ukuphazamiseka kokuphila kwabantu abaseduze, kanye nezingozi ezithinta abasebenzi. Ukungcola kwamanzi, umoya, kanye nezindawo ezizungezile kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo yokuphepha ezindaweni zokusebenza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ukukhula Nokuthuthukiswa Umkhakha wezokumbiwa ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yokwanda kwemithetho yokuvikela imvelo. Izinkampani kumele zenze izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlala zifanele, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha bokunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokusebenza, ukwakhiwa kwemboni ehlakaniphile, kanye nokwandisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuhlangabezana Nezidingo Zomphakathi Izimayini kufanele ziqhubeke nohlelo lokuhlanganyela nomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo, ukuqonda izidingo zabo, nokwakha izinhlelo ezizobasiza. Ukuze umkhakha wenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhube izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Umkhakha wezokumbiwa ungumthombo obalulekile wezimali, umhlaba, nezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo empilweni yomphakathi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi lo mkhakha uhlale uhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, uhlole izindlela zokunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle, futhi uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Ngaleyo ndlela, izimayini zingaba yinsiza ethuthukisa umnotho, ziqinise izimpilo zabantu, futhi zishintshe izindawo zibe ngcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kuzokwenza kube nempilo engcono kubo bonke.
uMfula iNile Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mkize, Ucwaningo lweMvelo Umhlangano wethu wawuqale kumhlanganyeli wezimbali, imvura ihla kancane, kanti uDkt. Sipho Mkize, uchwepheshe kwezempilo, wemvelo, nenkululeko yokucabangela izimpilo zabantu nezinto eziphilayo, ubungakanani, kanye nemvelo yeNile, wenza umusa wokubamba le ngxoxo. Umbuzo: Dkt. Mkize, ngicela usitshele ngokubaluleka komfula iNile emlandweni nasekuziphileni kwabantu base-Afrika. Impela, umfula iNile, njengoba sazi, uyindlela ewumgogodla yokuphila kwabaningi eNkulunkulu. Iphakathi nendawo ye-Afrika, uNile utholakala e-Egypt, uSudan, kanye nezinye izindawo eziningi. Ngokwenkolo, uNile ungumfanekiso wokuphila, nokuthi usuku nosuku uphuphela ngempilo, uma izivunguvungu zikhona; lapho iNile igcwele, uMhlaba uvula izandla zawo. Ngaphambili, izizwe eziningi zifundile kuNile, futhi ubudlelwano bayo nemvelo yenza ihlale ibalulekile kumasiko nezinkolelo zabo. Umbuzo: Kukhona izinkolelo noma imihla yokukhumbula ethinta iNile? Kunjalo, iNile ibhidliza ukuthokoza kwabantu. Ngokwesiko, abantu bakwaNile bahlonipha umfula njengeMoya. Ngempela, kwiMibhalo Engcwele, iNile ibhalwe khona. Kwazulu, izinkolelo ezithinta umfula zihlobene nezinsuku ezithile, ezifana neMikhosi yokuvuselela, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona ukuze bahloniphe umfula, bakhumbule izinsuku ezithile zomlando. Umbuzo: Uthinteka kanjani umfula iNile ekuthuthukisweni komnotho? Uphinde uphinde ukhokhe ukudla komhlaba. I-Nile inika umhlaba inhlabathi efanele yokukhulisa imifino, futhi lokho kukhuthaza uhwebo. Kakhulu kakhulu, abantu basendaweni besebenzisa umfula wokuhamba izimpahla nemikhiqizo ehlukene. Ngamafuphi, umfula unika abantu amandla okuphila, futhi ubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wabo. Umbuzo: Uthinta kanjani ubudlelwano bomphakathi nezokulima phansi komfula? Ngokukwazi ukusho, uNile udlalwa ibhizinisi emithonjeni yokuphila kwabaningi. Izinkampani zikhula, futhi abantu bakhulakulana nezinsizakalo ezikhona, njengokubona ukuhamba kozoshukuma. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi umphakathi uthole imisebenzi, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi. Ubuqhawe bomfula buncishiswa yizinkinga zomoya, ngakho sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sizame ukugcina umfula umgogodla wobudlelwano bethu. Ucwaningo lube negalelo, kubalulekile ukwenza abantu baqonde ukuhlonishwa kwemvelo nokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela umfula. Sihlanganyela nezikhungo zemfundo, futhi sidlulisela ulwazi kubantu ukuze bazi kahle ukubaluleka kokugcina umfula uhlanzekile. Izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele ziqaleke emiphakathini ukuze sikhulise abantu. Kulungile, ngabe lokho kubalulekile ukuze akukho emkhakheni wesintu lapho umfula uhlanzekile. Umbuzo: Yini ezokwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomfula iNile? Kubalulekile ukuvuselela izindlela zokuphila nabantu, ukusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza eziphilayo, nokuxhumana kwezitho zomphakathi. Ukuhlola izinkinga, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, ukugcina izinyathelo ezilungile zokuhlanzeka – konke lokhu kubalulekile. Uhlelo lokuvuselela nokwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe olwazini lwangempela kuyadingeka, ukuthuthukisa impilo kodwa nokuvikela umfula. Umbazo: Ngabe uhwebo nemvelo zomhlaba kuzo zikhuluma kanjani? U-Africa ungumhlaba okhula ngogqo. Njengoba umhlaba wethu usushintsha, izimpendulo zomndeni, uhwebo nemvelo, zidinga ukubambisana. U-Nile unikeza amandla okubumba ukuphila; akufanele sikhumbule lokho, uma sizama ukuphila kahle, kufanele siqinisekise ukuhlanzwa kwempilo esizungezile. Ukubambisana kwezindawo ezahlukahlukene kukhuthaza ukuhweba, ngakho-ke kuhle ukuhlonishwa, okuzenzakalelayo nezinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo: Sifakele umbono wakho ngempilo nomfula iNile. Uphakathi nokuphila kuzothi umfula ube umgogodla, ukugcina imvelo ihle; akukhona kuphela ukuzinakekela kodwa nomphakathi ukuze sikwazi ukubumbana. Kufanele silwele ukuphila kwe-Nile, futhi singakwazi ukwakha ikhaya elihle lapho umfula uthola igugu. Umfula uhlala uyisifundo, umthombo wokuphila okwephula. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe lokhu, ngaphandle kokuphula imvelo. Ubuqhawe obufuna ukuba buyiNile, ubukhulu bemvelo bukhona kumngcele wethu. Ngiyabonga. Kukhumbule, umfula iNile akusiyona nje imithombo yamandla, kodwa uthinta zonke izici zokuphila, kuhlanganiswe nemvelo, ubudlelwano, nezinsizakalo. Sifuna ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, futhi ubungane bethu nomfula buphila njalo. Lokhu sikwazi kuphela uma sihlonipha umfula iNile. Umbiko ubonakala ungenakuhambisana kodwa kuhambisana nezinye izimpilo, aphephe izimo, bheka ubungane bethu nomfula, uzithole uhamba phambili. Ngiyabonga!
Ezamandla: Ukubaluleka Kwezamandla Emhlabeni Wethu Ezinsukwini zethu zanamuhla, amandla (energy) abe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngaphandle kwamandla, imisebenzi yethu yansuku zonke ingase ingaqhubeki. Kusukela ekukhanyiseni izindlu zethu, ekushiseni amakhaya, kuze kube ekusebenzeni kwemishini eminingi, amandla adlala indima enkulu empilweni yethu. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula, futhi ukusetshenziswa kwawo kudinga ukuba siqaphele. Ngokweqiniso, amandla ahlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezinto eziphilayo, ezivela emithonjeni yemvelo, kanye namandla aphuma emithonjeni yokwenziwa. Amandla avamile, njengezinto eziphilayo, ahlanganisa amandla elanga, amanzi, nomoya. Lezi zinsiza zikhona emhlabeni, kodwa zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze ziqhubeke zikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umhlaba wethu ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu, ezifana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, ukungcoliswa, kanye nokuncipha kwemithombo yemvelo. Ngokubheka izimo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amandla asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokusebenzisa amandla elanga zikhula ngokushesha. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukusiza ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela enempilo. Amandla elanga akhombisa ukuthi singakha kanjani umphakathi ozimele, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa okuqinile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lwamandla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla akhulu kakhulu, futhi kufanele siqaphele ukuthi asiwafuni kuphela, kodwa kufanele siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise imikhuba yokuphila, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula. Ukukhiqiza amandla kudinga izinsiza, isikhathi, kanye nemali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amandla asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ekugcineni, amandla ayinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukusebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele akusizi kuphela ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela enempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa okuqinile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lwamandla. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, ube nekhono, futhi ube nekhono lokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula, kodwa uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, ube nekhono, futhi ube nekhono lokuphila. Amandla ayinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke - Ukubaluleka Kwezinqumo Zethu Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Lolu suku luhlanganisa izinketho eziningi, ezithinta ikusasa lethu, izwe lethu, kanye nezizukulwane ezizayo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukhetho akukhona nje ukhetho lwabantu abathile, kodwa luhlanganisa izwi lezakhamuzi zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinketho zethu, siqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuhola izwe, futhi sithathe izinqumo ezizokwenza umehluko. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlanganisa izifiso nezidingo zabantu. Abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, kodwa ekugcineni, sonke sifuna ukuphila kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele zibe nezimpande ezijulile emphakathini. Uma sikhuluma ngama-akhawunti ezomnotho, izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo, noma izinhlelo zemfundo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinto zibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi bethu baqonde kahle izidingo zomphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona nje ukhetho lokukhetha umholi, kodwa kuyithuba lokubeka izimiso ezizokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaholi bethu kufanele babe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma umholi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto, kufanele sibuze ukuthi kungani simkhetha. Ukhetho lwethu kufanele lube nezinjongo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezifiso zethu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempumelelo. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nezwe lethu, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinketho zethu, siqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuhola izwe, futhi sithathe izinqumo ezizokwenza umehluko. Ukhetho akukhona nje ukhetho lwabantu abathile, kodwa luhlanganisa izwi lezakhamuzi zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinketho zethu, siqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuhola izwe, futhi sithathe izinqumo ezizokwenza umehluko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona nje ukhetho lokukhetha umholi, kodwa kuyithuba lokubeka izimiso ezizokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaholi bethu kufanele babe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma umholi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto, kufanele sibuze ukuthi kungani simkhetha. Ukhetho lwethu kufanele lube nezinjongo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezifiso zethu. Imigomo Yokugoma Kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngemuva kokugoma, ngakho ngithanda ukwabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nemigomo yokugoma. Njengoba sikwazi, ukugoma kuyindlela yokuvikela impilo yethu, kodwa kukhona izinto ezithile okudingeka sizazi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo wokugoma. Imigomo yokugoma ibhekisela ezinjongweni eziyisisekelo zokuvikela abantu emithini nasezifo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwezifo ezithathelwana kalula, njengezifo ezifana nokhuhlaza, i-flu, kanye ne-COVID-19. Ukugoma kusebenza ukuvikela labo abakhathazekile, njengezifo zenhliziyo, abakhulelwe, nabanye abathinteka kakhulu. Ngokubheka emuva, ukugoma akuwona umqondo omusha; isiko lokugoma lisekela emlandweni omude. Ukuqala, abantu babefuna ukuvikela umphakathi ezifo ezincane ezazihlasela. Ngesikhathi esithile, besenobuchwepheshe obuncane, kodwa benza konke okusemandleni ukuze baqonde ukuthi ukugoma kungaba indlela efanele yokuphila. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhuluma ngendima yokugoma emphakathini. Ukugoma akuyona into eyenzelwa umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana komphakathi. Uma umphakathi ugoma, uthola ukuvikeleka, okwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Futhi, uma abantu bebona imiphumela emihle yokugoma, lokho kuholela ekuqiniseni ukuthi kuyadingeka. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokugoma; abanye abantu bahlala bephikisa ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma izimangalo ezingelona iqiniso. Lokhu kudinga ukukhulumisana okuhle ukuze sabelane ngemininingwane efanele. Kumele siqonde ukuthi ukugoma kudinga ukubhekelelwa, futhi kunezindlela ezinhle zokuphendula imibuzo yabantu abangenalo ulwazi olucacile. Futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukukhetha ukuvuma ukugoma kubandakanya nemigomo ethile. Ukugoma akuphuli amalungelo abantu, kodwa kuwumkhankaso ophakathi kokunikeza ukuvikeleka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baqonde imiphumela engaba khona uma behluleka ukuvuma ukugoma. Kukhona izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezibhekene nezinkinga ezithile, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukugoma kunciphisa lezi zinkinga. KwaZulu, umoya wokuhlalisana nokubambisana ungumgogodla wempilo. Ukugoma kufanele kube yisinyathelo esisodwa esihamba phambili ukuze sithole umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukunikeza ukuqonda okuthile ngezinto ezahlukene ezihambisana nokugoma. Umqondo wokugoma uhilela izinqubo ezithile, njengokubhalisela ukugoma, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyagoma ngesikhathi esifanele, nokulandela izeluleko eziphathelene nempilo. Kumele siphinde siqonde ukuthi kulandela izinyathelo ezifanele, sizokwazi ukuvikela abanye, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uhlala uphephile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalezi zinto, siphinde sabelane ngalezi zimiso ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Ukugoma akusiyona kuphela into esiyenza njengabantu, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono, ukugcina izizukulwane ezizayo ziphephile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizoba nesimo esihle, lapho imiphakathi ihlanganyela khona, igqugquzela impilo, futhi ibambisene ukuze ikwazi ukuvikela bonke abantu. Ngemuva kokuhlola lezi zinto, ngifisa ukuthi sithathe lesi sikhathi sikhumbule ukuthi ukugoma kungumnqamulajuqu wokuphila okuncane, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze omunye nomunye ukuze sibe nesithakazelo sokugoma. Ngalokhu, sizoba neqhaza elihle empilweni yethu nempilo yomphakathi. Hamba phambili, ugome, uvikele, futhi ube ngumhlatsi omuhle!
Ukulima: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezolimo Kuvulekile umcimbi ongcwele, ogqugquzelwe yizifiso zabaqalayo nabakhokhela umhlaba wezolimo, owaziwa ngokuthi iNkundla Yezolimo. Ucwaningo lwezindlela zokulima, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi, kube yizinto eziphawulekayo kulo mcimbi obungcono obubanjwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi uqale ngokubamba umoya, lapho abezindaba bejabulisa izivakashi ngezinkanyezi ezivelele emhlabeni wezolimo. Izimakethe zomkhiqizo wezolimo, ezinjengezithako, izitshalo, nezilwane, zaba yinsika ezintsha zabakwazi ukufinyelela kumakhasimende abasha. Abalimi bavula amavolontiya namaqonga amasha okugcina nokuhlonipha imisebenzi yamanje yokulima, okwakuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza umgwaqo wokukhiqiza ompofu. Ngenkathi emaphethelweni emcimbini, izivakashi zabeziqhelisa ngempilo emhlabeni wezolimo. Ukuze kufudukele emhlabeni wempilo yolwazi, futhi uhlanganyele ngobuchwepheshe, phakathi kokukhulelwa kwezimoto, izinsiza zezimali zafakwa phakathi kwalokhu ukubhekana nobunzima bokuhlala phansi kwesikhumba seplanethi. Abasebenzi bezolimo baphinde badele ukuzwakala kokuthengisa cosekucwaningo nokukhuthaza umnyango owedlula umphakathi, okwakuhloswe ukuyolisiphakela imifino, izithelo, nemifino emisha. Abalimi bakhuluma ngempumelelo nemithwalo ethile yokulima. Izifundo ezenzakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zezimali, ukwenza kahle kwezinsiza, nakho konke okubhalwe phansi, kuxhumene nendlela yokubambisana yokugcina imiphumela. Ubulili buphawulekayo phakathi kokufunda kwezimpawu, ukwakha izindlela ezikahle zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokulima. Umphakathi ubheke ukuze ube neqhaza elikhethiwe elikulandelayo, ukuze uzame ukucubungula nezixhumanisi zempilo eziqinile. Ngesikhathi somcimbi, imifino eyanele yalethwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, ibhizinisi lokuphuma kwamasiko azihambisani namatekhnoloji amasha. Lokhu kuhlangenwe nakho kwezivakashi kukhombisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende, osomabhizinisi, nabalimi, ukuveza impilo efanele nezikhungo ezivulekile. Abalimi baphinde bamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ebusuku, bexoxa ngokushintshwa kwemikhuba, izimidlalwana, nezinguquko ezethulwayo emhlabeni wezolimo. Uphenyo lokugcina lwaholela ekutheni bahlanganyele imicabango, bahlola izinkinga zokulima impilo okuthinta abaninimzi, nezehlakalo ezicebile. Izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zafaka ezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nabalimi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulima, nokwakha amathuba okusebenza. Ngemva kwalokhu, umbono omusha uphumelele, uhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithokozisayo zemvelo yokulima. Ukwenziwa kokugcina kumqoka kakhulu ukwazisa imikhiqizo ezishayabala ubuso bomhlaba, ukuqinisekisa ukuzenzela nokukhula kwezokuhlala. Ubusuku bahlale bebambisene, besebenzisa izinsiza eziphansi, abafuna ukuba babonise izifundo ezihamba phambili ezinjengokwakhiwa komphakathi ukuze benze ibhizinisi elihle. Ngalesi sikhathi, abaholi bezolimo baphinde balandela imikhuba emisha yokulima, bazali, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa umhlaba, befuna umsebenzi ophumelelayo. Umcimbi ugcine ngokukhumbuza bonke ababebekhona ukuba badalele amaphuzu abawathathayo, futhi bajabulele umphakathi ofuna ukuphila kahle. Impumelelo yeNkundla Yezolimo ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba wezolimo awudingi ukuthosizwe; udinga ukusubulawa ukuze uphinde ube buhle. Ngemva kosuku olunomsebenzi, ubudlelwano obubumelene ekwenzeni umhlaba ube nobungane bukhumbuza ukuthi ukusebenzisa umhlaba wokuqala futhi uqhakazile kuyizinto ezibalulekile zokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Uthando namandla abathokozisayo ababebekhona kuze kube sekugcineni kwela mcimbi, lapho uhlelo lukasizo lwakhasimende lukhombisa ngendlela eqinile yokuphakela umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wezinhlaka ezikhiphayo unikeze ithuba elihle lokulima, ukhuthaza ukuzibophezela okwengeziwe ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi nabalimi abahlanganyela umqondo ofanayo wokukhulisa impilo yezolimo. Noma kanjani, izigaba zomcimbi weNkundla Yezolimo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukulima kube yingxenye ebalulekile yezenhlalakahle. Ubulili obunamandla, imfundo, nokuxhumana phakathi kwemindeni nakweminye imiphakathi kuzohlinzeka ngomphumela ophumelelayo nokuqhubekayo kwalowo mcimbi.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwemininingwane (Cybersecurity) - Isingeniso Ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-cybersecurity, kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni obumbene nobuchwepheshe. Njengoba sikhula futhi sithuthuka kwezehlakalo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile sithole izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu. Esifundweni sethu, sizobe sihlola incazelo ye-cybersecurity, izinselelo ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze sivikele ulwazi lwethu. Yini i-Cybersecurity? I-cybersecurity iwumkhakha ophathelene nezindlela, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikela amasistimu, amanethiwekhi, nemininingwane ethinta i-intanethi. Umgomo omkhulu we-cybersecurity ukuvikela ulwazi kanye nokusebenza kwemishini esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ulwazi olunzulu ngezingozi ezahlukene, ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwama-hacker, ukuvuza kwem秘密, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Izinhlobo Zokuhlasela Kunezinhlobo eziningi zokuhlasela ezithinta ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane. Omunye ovame ukubonwa ngu-kephula iphephabhuku, lapho umuntu engena kokungemthetho kulwazi lwemfihlo. Kukhona futhi i-malware, efaka phakathi ama-virus, ransomware, neminye imishayo emibi ethinta ulwazi lwethu. Lezi zingozi zingaholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinkampani kanye nemibuso. Izingozi Eziyinhloko Izingozi zihlala zikhona emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ziyaqhubeka zikhula njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula. Izinkampani ezithola uxhumano nabangani be-inthanethi, njengokuthenga nge-inthanethi, zikhona engozini yokuhlaselwa. Futhi, izingozi ezihlobene nemisebenzi yokuvula ubuchwepheshe, njengokungena ezinkampanini, ziyaqhubeka zikhukhuma. Ukuzwisisa lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokuvikela. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuvikela ulwazi lwethu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zihlala zisesikhathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezibuyekezo ezikhona nokugwema izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingathandeki. Okwesibili, amagama anamandla kufanele asetshenziswe ukuvimbela abantu abangagunyaziwe ekufinyeleleni kulwazi lwethu. Amagama aqinile avikela okokusebenza nemininingwane yethu. Ukwengeza, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela i-cyberspace, njenge-firewalls nemisebenzi yokuhlonza izingozi, kubalulekile ukuze kube lula ukubona nokuvimbela ukuhlasela ngaphambi kokwenza umonakalo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufundisa abasebenzi noma amalungu omphakathi ukuze baqonde izingozi nezindlela zokuphatha imininingwane yabo ngendlela ephephile. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe bukhula njalo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandiseni kwezinselelo ezivela kumasistimu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sigcine ulwazi lwethu luqinile ngokuhlala silungisa izinqubo zethu zokuvikela. Izinhlelo ezintsha ziyaqhubeka zithola izisebenzi ezijulile ezizothola izixazululo ezenzakalayo ezithinta izingozi ezikhulayo. Ngakho, ukuqapha izinguquko ezintsha eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Umqondo Wokuba Nombono Ngaphandle kokwaziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile futhi ukuba nemibono ethile. Akufanele sikhulume kuphela ngokuvikela, kodwa futhi kufanele sikhathalele impilo yethu ye-inthanethi nendlela esiphatha ngayo ulwazi lwethu. Kudingeka ukuthi sakhe imibono eqhubekayo ezosiza ekukhuleni kokuhlakanipha kwethu, okuhlanganisa ukufundisa abafundi namalungu omphakathi ngezimfanelo zokuthatha izinqumo ezinhle eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane ibalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe namuhla. Ukuze sibe nenhloso yokuvikela ulwazi lwethu, kudinga umdlandla wokubona izingozi, ukwakha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo, nokubuyekeza izinhlelo zokusebenza zethu. Umsebenzi wethu wokuvikela awupheli, uhamba phambili njengoba ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, akufanele silibalise ukufundisa nokwazisa abanye ngalolu hlobo lwezokuphepha. Ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha, kodwa ulwazi lwethu lungagcinwa luphephile uma sikwazi ukuphatha kahle.
Ukugonywa Kwezingane Ingxoxo noDkt. Zanele Mthethwa, udokotela wezempilo yomphakathi Umqondisi: Sanibonani, Dkt. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Namuhla sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokugonywa kwezingane. Ungasichazela ukuthi kungani ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile? Dkt. Mthethwa: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile ngoba kuvikela izingane ezimeni eziningi ezibuhlungu, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana kalula. Ukuze izingane zikhule zibe nezempilo, kudingeka zibe nezinhlaka ezivikelekile. Ukugonywa kwenza kube lula ukuvimbela izifo ezinjengokukhwehlela, umkhuhlane, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi yiziphi izigaba zokugonywa ezibalulekile ezinganeni? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kunezinyathelo ezithile zokugonywa ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kunezivivinyo ezisemqoka ezifanele ukuba zenzeke ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa i-BCG yokuvikela umkhuhlane, i-DTP yokuvikela izifo ezinjenge-diphtheria, tetanus, ne-pertussis, kanye ne-Polio. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezivivinyo ezithile ezitholakala eminyakeni ethile, njenge-MMR yokuvikela umkhuhlane, umkhuhlane, ne-rubella. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona izizathu ezithile ezibangela ukuthi abanye abazali bangagonyi izingane zabo? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kunezizathu eziningi. Abanye abazali bangase babe nezinkolelo ezithile ezibavimbela ekugonyeni, noma bangase babe nolwazi olungaphelele mayelana nezins benefits zokugonywa. Abanye bangase babe nesaba sokuthi imithi yokugonya ingaba nemiphumela emibi, noma bangase bahlale ezindaweni ezingenayo ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zokugonywa. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Yini ongayiphakamisa ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga? Dkt. Mthethwa: Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abazali ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nezins benefits zokugonywa. Izikhungo zezempilo zingase zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa, ezihlanganisa izinkulumo, izincwadi, nezinsiza ezitholakala kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogonyo ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze wonke umphakathi ufinyelele kalula. Umqondisi: Ngabe ukugonywa kwezingane kudinga ukwenziwa njalo, noma kukhona isikhathi esithile? Dkt. Mthethwa: Ukugonywa kwezingane kudinga ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi ezithile. Izingane zidinga ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze zifinyelele ezivivinyweni ezithile eminyakeni ethile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zivikelekile ezimeni ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona nezivivinyo eziphindaphindwayo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhlala uvikelekile. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikhumbule mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abazali bazi ukuthi ukugonywa akukhona kuphela ukuvikela izingane zabo, kodwa futhi kuvikela umphakathi wonke. Uma izingane zigonywa, zinciphisa amathuba okuthi izifo zibe yingozi emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izifo zingathathelwana kalula. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubazali? Dkt. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho kubazali ukuthi bahlale bexhumana nodokotela bezempilo, baqonde izidingo zokugonywa, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zikhuluma kahle. Ukugonywa akuyona nje into yokwenza, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqinile nezinhloso ezinhle. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle. Ngiyabonga futhi ngemininingwane ebalulekile oyabelane nathi. Dkt. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngiyethemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izosiza ekwandiseni ulwazi nolwazi mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane.
Ukuhlonza Uhlanga lweMahlaya: Ukunambitheka Kwenjabulo Ezweni lethu eligelezayo, amahlaya adlalela isikhala esibalulekile. Kusho kakhulu ukuhlekisa, ukujabulisa abantu, nokubathokozisa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Umoya we-mahlaya uhamba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo, uqhubeka ungena emibhalweni ehlukene, ezindaweni zemidiya, nakwizinkanyezi ezidumile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka imisebenzi ethile yehlaya, sihlole izici zayo, sithole imvelaphi, nokuthi ithinta kanjani imizwa yabantu. Ukuqala, amahlaya akha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuboniswa kahle emidlalweni, kumasimu, nakuhlelo lwamakhasi. Ubulukhuni bempilo bujoliswa ngokuhlekisa ngalokhu okukhona empilweni. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, omuntu uhlala enezinkinga eziningi ezahlukene, amahlaya agqama ezithombeni ezikhaliphile zomphakathi. Izithombe zenzeka ziba ngaphezulu komqondo, ezifakazela izinselelo zokuphila, zibheke ezindleleni ezihlekisayo. Kufanele sikhumbule amandla amahlaya anawo ekuphuculeni impilo. Kumuntu ngamunye, ukuhlekisa kuhlinzeka ngodlame oluhle lokuwina. Sinokholo lokuthi ukuphumelela kwengqikithi yama “stand-up” kuboniswa ezikhukhu, zibahlenganisa futhi zibacingise. Izithombe ezibhalwe kahle zamahlaya zikhetha ukusingatha izinkumbulo zethu nempilo yethu. Ngokwemvelo, zonke izinhlelo ezihlekisayo zihlala zibhekisela ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Ukuhlekisa ngempilo ethile, imicimbi eyishwa, nempilo yomndeni kubalulekile. Kukhona abaculi abanobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, abahleka baphinde bahlakaniphe ukudala izimo ezihlekisayo. Kwazulu, umculi omkhulu uSiyabonga B ofuna ukwaziwa ngemidlalo yakhe ehlekisayo ethi “Emakhosini.” Ngenxa yeziqubulo ezidumile, uthande ukusebenzisa umehluko phakathi kwempilo yansuku zonke nezimo ezinzima ukuze uhlanganise ahlaya ahamba phambili. Izinhlamvu ezahlukene zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuhlukene nokwakha izimo. Umnqweno unamandla, kanti izindaba ezibhalwe ngendlela ehlekisayo zenza izwe liphumelele. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezithameli nezicukuthwane ziphenya izinqubo ezichaza kahle impilo, bese zidudula izimo ezinzima, zifuna ukwenza abantu bahlale behleka. Umculi owaziwa uThokozani, ubevele wafaka izithombe ezihlekisayo empilweni. Uma uhamba emhlabeni wezokuhlekisa, kufanele unake izinhlelo eziphakeme, njengezokusithokozisa ezikhethekile. Lezi zinhlelo ziba nezinselelo, futhi zifakaza ukuthi amahlaya angagxila ezindabeni ezithile. Nansi isibonelo esivela kuhlelo olwaziwa kakhulu olunokuhlekisa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amahlaya anomshado phakathi kwezindikimba ezixakile. Ukubuyisela emuva, sithola ukuthi amahlaya akhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezinhloso ezinhle, aphinde aqinisekise imizwelo ehlukahlukene. Yiqiniso, imivuzo eholela emikhakheni ehlukene yempilo ifuna ukwenziwa ngama-comedians abahluka. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi amahlaya anciphisa ukucindezeleka, aqhuba umoya opholile, futhi akhulise indlela esibona ngayo izinto. Kubalulekile ukufaka uMphakathi lwezothando ezinjalo, ngoba ukudlalela phansi ezincwadini nokubonwa komoya kudinga ukubonga. Ngokubheka ivesi yangempela yama-comedy, ukufakazela ukwenza izinkanyezi eziphumela kuncike ohlelweni olubonisa imiqondo eyisisekelo. Zithokozise umoya wemidlalo ethakazelisayo, kulawa ma-comedians asitafula emhlabeni, ovezwe emithonjeni ehlukahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezithameli nezithombe ezihlekisayo zakwaZulu nezeNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina izinto ziphilile, ziyavuma ukuthi amahlaya ahamba kahle, aqhubeka nokuhlobisa izimo zocwaningo lwangempela, ezisela imizwa emihle. Ngenxa yokukhalipha okubolile kwabathakathi abasha, ukwaziwa kwama-comedians kusekelwe kwimizamo yokufakazela ispirit spieno. Uhlanga lwezama-luzulu ne-mahlaya kuvuma ukuzicana nezimo zensizwa. Njengoba sihlonipha ubuciko be-mahlaya, kuyabonakala ukuthi ukuhlakanipha kudinga ukuba kube khona kwemibono, futhi udinga ukucabanga ngezindlela ezihlukene zokwandisa ukudlala esikhathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zama-mahlaya zenziwa ukwakha izinsiza ezibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi. Amakhasi ahlakaniphile nabaculi bakhonjiswa kuzo zonke izinkambu, bezothokozisa izithameli zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa umsebenzi ohlangene, ohloniphekile, nezinga lemibono ehlukene kolwazi, uphinde uthuthukise ukuhlekisa okukhona. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obugculisayo kwehlisa izinqubo, kanti akhazimula umoya oqhakazile. Ekugcineni, amahlaya ayindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, akha izimvo ezimnandi, kanti ubungcweti bama-comedians bukhona. Umhlaba uhlala uchela ezihlekisayo, ngenkathi sihamba. Njengamanje, kudinga ukuba sihloniphe ubuciko, uma sicabanga ngempilo yethu, ubudlelwane bethu, kanye nemizwa yethu. Ngalokhu, amahlaya ayahlonishwa futhi aqhubeke ehamba phambili, enza umphakathi wethu uhuve endlini yokuhlekisa.
Usain Bolt: Umgibeli Oqavile Isingeniso UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabagibeli abaphambili emlandweni wezokugijima, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni. Uhlonishwa njengomgibeli ophumelele kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi ubukhazikhazi bakhe buyabonakala ezindaweni zokugijima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqwaba zezilokotho eziphakeme, izindondo eziningi, kanye nesithunzi esikhulu emphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezahlukene eziholele empumelelweni kaBolt, izifundo esingazithola kuye, kanye nendlela angathinta ngayo abanye. Ukwakha Isizinda Ukuze uqonde impumelelo kaUsain Bolt, kubalulekile ukuqala ngesisekelo somlando wakhe. Uzalwe ngo-1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayka. Uqala ukuzijayeza ngokugijima esemncane, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha amakhono akhe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ukwesekwa komndeni kwakubalulekile, njengoba uBolt ethola ukwesekwa okukhulu kubazali bakhe. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima. Ukuqala Ukujwayela Umjaho Ngemva kokuthola izifundo ezinhle, uBolt waqala ukujwayela umjaho. Ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqala kancane. UBolt waqala ngemijaho emincane, efaka phakathi imijaho yezikole. Lokhu kumjabulisa futhi kumfundisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ngokuzikhandla. Kubalulekile ukuthi umgibeli aqhubeke nokuzijwayeza, aqonde izindlela zokuphumelela, futhi akhulise amakhono akhe. Ukusebenza Kaningi Nokuzikhandla Njengoba uBolt eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola ithuba lokusebenza nabathuthukisi bezemidlalo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile empumelelweni yakhe. Ukuze ufinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, kubalulekile ukuba nomqeqeshi onolwazi, ongasiza ekwakheni uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhambisana nezifiso zomgibeli. UUsain Bolt wagcina ebamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezinzima zokuqeqesha, ezihlanganisa ukujwayela imijaho emide, ukwakha amandla, nokusebenza emathubeni okuphumelela. Izifundo Zokuphumelela UUsain Bolt ubonisa izifundo eziningi kubagibeli abasha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. UBolt wayenhloso yokuba ngumgibeli ophumelele emhlabeni, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba agxile. Okwesibili, ukuzikhandla akukwazi ukungabazeki. Umgibeli kufanele azimisele ukuphumelela, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla nokusebenza kanzima. Okwesithathu, ukusekelwa komndeni nabangani kubalulekile. UUsain Bolt wathola ukwesekwa okuhle, okwakwenza kube lula kuye ukuhamba phambili. Ukuphumelela Emqhudelwaneni UUsain Bolt waba yisithonjana emqhudelwaneni. Waqala ukuhamba phambili emqhudelwaneni wezemidlalo, waphumelela izindondo eziningi, okuhlanganisa neziqinisekiso ze-Olympics. Ukuze ufinyelele lezi zimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nomoya ophakeme, ukwazi ukuphatha ingcindezi, nokuba nesineke. UBolt waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphumelela akufanele kube lula; kudinga umsebenzi, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela. Ukwamukela Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuphumelela, uBolt waba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni. Waqala ukuhamba phambili ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle, ezihlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abanye. Ubulungiswa bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi impumelelo akuyona kuphela yokwakha igama, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enobuntu. UUsain Bolt waphinde waba ngumfundisi, efundisa abanye ngezifundo azifundile empilweni. Isiphetho UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabagibeli abavelele kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi izifundo azihambisani nazo zibalulekile. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuba nesineke kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni. Ubulungiswa bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi impumelelo akuyona kuphela yokwakha igama, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enobuntu. UUsain Bolt ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi uma uzimisela, ungafinyelela noma yini. Lokhu kungenza abanye bazame ukufezekisa amaphupho abo, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi onzima.
Ukukhathala Kwamahlengikazi Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzini omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwavela umoya opholile, ubonisa ukuthi kube nesikhathi eside sokusebenza. Abahlengikazi bendawo, uNokuthula noSipho, babephakathi kokulungiselela usuku olujwayelekile emtholampilo. Njengoba bephuma emakhaya abo, babebona izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo enzima, umhlaba unikeza ithemba. UNokuthula, owayenobungane obukhulu, wayehlala ebakhumbuza abanye abahlengikazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo zabantu, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephendula njalo. Kodwa, ngaphakathi, wayezwa ukukhathala okukhulu. Izinsuku zabe ziphila zifana, ziqhubeka zikhathaza, futhi imithwalo yokukhathazeka yayiqinile. USipho, owayenobuchule bokwelapha, wayehlale edinga izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo. "Sidinga ukuhamba phambili, Nokuthula. Abantu bethu badinga usizo, futhi akufanele sithule," wayekhuluma, kodwa wayezwa umoya wokukhathala emzimbeni wakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, wayehluleka ukulala kahle, imicabango yakhe ibihamba ngezindlela eziningi. Ngelinye ilanga, kwafika umama oneminyaka engama-70, uMama Zodwa, owayenokukhathala okukhulu. Wayefika emtholampilo enezimpawu zokukhathala, kodwa wayehlale eqinile. "Ngiyazi ukuthi ningabahlengikazi, kodwa ngicela ningithumele emuva, ngidinga ukuxoxa," kusho yena. UNokuthula noSipho babemthanda, futhi bazi ukuthi uMama Zodwa wayengumuntu onothando, kodwa izinkinga zakhe zazinzima. Baqala ukuxoxa naye, bahlola izinkinga zakhe, futhi uMama Zodwa wabelana ngendaba yakhe. "Ngiyazi ukuthi ngikhuluma kakhulu, kodwa ngiyazizwa ngikhathazekile. Ngiyazama ukusiza umndeni wami, kodwa ngiyazizwa ngiphukile," kusho yena. Lokhu kwavusa imizwa eminingi kubo, ngoba babebona ukuthi abahlengikazi nabo bahlupheka, nakuba bephila impilo yokusiza abanye. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, uMama Zodwa wathola umoya omusha. "Ngiyabonga, ngiyazi ukuthi niyakhathala. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngithole amandla," wathi. Lokhu kwavusa umoya omusha kubo bonke abahlengikazi. Bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, ukuxhumana nabantu abanjengoMama Zodwa kwaba yindlela yokubuyisela amandla. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola, uNokuthula noSipho baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imitholampilo. Babefuna ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bekwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye. "Sizokwenza izinhlelo zokuxhumana, sizokwakha imihlangano, sizokwenza ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bahlala behlangene," kusho uSipho. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umoya wokubambisana, futhi abahlengikazi baqala ukujabula. Ngesikhathi edlula emitholampilo, uNokuthula wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, bephuma bezithokozisa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umsebenzi wabo wawubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephinda njalo. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uNokuthula noSipho baqala ukubona izinguquko. Abantu bephila kahle, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhula. UMama Zodwa waba yisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba abantu behlupheka, ukuxhumana nokuxhasana kungabavusa. Abahlengikazi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla. Ekugcineni, uNokuthula noSipho baqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwabo akukona okungapheli. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," baphinda, kodwa manje bazi ukuthi, ngokubambisana, bangakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umoya wokubambisana wawunamandla, futhi umhlaba wawunethemba. Ngakho-ke, abahlengikazi baqhubeka nokusebenza, bephila impilo enothando, bejabulisa abanye, futhi bephila impilo enomoya opholile. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla.
Isingeniso I-Bitcoin, eyasungulwa nguSatoshi Nakamoto ngonyaka ka-2009, iyimali edijithali eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Le mali iyingxenye ye-blockchain technology, okuyindlela yokugcina ulwazi ngendlela ephephile futhi engashintshi. I-Bitcoin ibonakala njengezinga elisha lokuhweba, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Ukukhula kwayo eminyakeni edlule kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimakethe zezimali, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwe-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obubizwa nge-blockchain, okuyinethiwekhi yokugcina amarekhodi ezezimali. Le nethiwekhi ibhalwa ngama-node amaningi, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuhlela noma ukuguqula ulwazi olukhona. I-blockchain ibhalwa ngama-block, lapho i-block ngayinye iqukethe ulwazi lwezohwebo ezithile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ongena kule nethiwekhi unokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Izici ze-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin inezici eziningi ezihlukile eziholela ekutheni ibe yimpumelelo. Okokuqala, i-Bitcoin iyimali engathathi hlangothi, okusho ukuthi ayilawulwa noma iphethwe yizikhungo ezinkulu ezifana namabhange. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba basebenzise i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokuhweba ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqondisa kwemali. Okwesibili, i-Bitcoin inezinga eliphansi lokuhlawula uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zokuhweba ezivamile, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kule mali. Izingozi nezinselelo Noma i-Bitcoin inezinzuzo eziningi, ibuye ibe nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Enye yezingozi ezinkulu ukuthi intengo ye-Bitcoin iyashintsha kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimali. Lokhu kudala ukungaqiniseki kubatshalizimali, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zinkampani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin ibhekene nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba izigebengu zisebenzisa le mali ukuze zisebenze ngaphandle kokuboshwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezinzima zokuvikela abasebenzisi. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin isetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba, ukutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Abanye abantu bayisebenzisa njengendlela yokugcina imali, njengoba ibonwa njengendlela yokuvikela imali yabo ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin isetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi zokuhweba, lapho abantu bengathenga khona imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlobene ne-Bitcoin, okuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuhweba ezikhethekile. Umthelela we-Bitcoin emnothweni I-Bitcoin ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile emnothweni. Iphinde ibe nomthelela omkhulu ezimakethe zezimali, njengoba izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukwamukela i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokukhokha. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin ibonakala iyindlela yokuhweba evumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba ukuba baxhumane kalula, okukhuthaza ukuhweba phakathi kwamazwe. Isiphetho I-Bitcoin iyimali edijithali enezici eziningi ezihlukile, eziholela ekutheni ibe yimpumelelo emhlabeni. Noma ibhekene nezingozi ezithile, umthelela wayo emnothweni, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nasempilweni yomphakathi ungabhekwa njengomkhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle i-Bitcoin, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwale mali edijithali.
Izindaba Zomphakathi: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwabantu Bendawo Ngomhlaka 15 Kwananga, emzini ohloniphekile waseMpoqweni, kubanjwe umcimbi okhethiwe owawuhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abantu bendawo. Umcimbi lo, obizwa ngokuthi “Usuku Lwabantu Bendawo,” wawuhanjiswa ngezinsuku ezithile ezedlule njengoba izakhamuzi zakha umqondo wokubambisana ukuze ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwazo. Usuku lwaluhlelwe kahle, futhi ngosuku lokuqala, izimpahla zendawo zabe seziqhamuka ezitolo ezincane nezindawo zokudla, lapho izakhamuzi zazihanjiswa khona ukudla okumangalisayo nempahla yokuthula. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezicishe zidalwe abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, benamalungelo azimele ukufaka isandla kumphakathi. Umkhankaso wokuqala wathinta abancane, abasha, nabadala, bonke belindele ukuxoxa, ukuhlekisana, nempilo yabo yangempela. Imidlaliso ibihlelwe kahle phambi kwesikhumbuzo esikhulu senza sibe nesithombe esihle sokuhlangana. Umdlalo wezenzo zempilo zasekhaya, owayehlanganisa ukudlala imidlalo yasendaweni, wakhuluma kakhulu kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Abantu babegubha umoya wezokuhlala, bebumbene, baphinde bazwakalise ukwaziswa okuhle ngemikhosi nezenzakalo ezithembekile ezazithuthukisa umphakathi. Kubonakala ukuthi wonke umuntu uzihlanganisa ngendlela eyayingenza kube nokuhlangana okuhle. Phakathi nemidlalo, abasha benza amaqembu, benza imiqhudelwano yokudansa neyekhono lokudlala, kwathi phakathi kwalokhu, bekukhuluma ngenhlonipho nezifundo ezitholwa empilweni. Abanakekeli bezemidlalo baphinde babe khona, babonisa abantu indlela yokuhlala behlakaniphile nohlanga. Umoya wokugcina umphakathi uqinisekiswe ngezithako zemvelo ezinhle, bathokozele ubuhle bezempilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezinkulu ezivela kubantu abadumile bendawo abakhuluma ngempumelelo yabo emakhaya. Lezi zinkulumo zazihambisana nezindaba ezihambisanayo nezinhle ezithinta umphakathi. Abaziqhenyi bamagugu ezakhamizi, baxoxa ngomthelela wokuhlangana nemiphakathi, baveza indlela lezi zindawo zikwazi ukwenzela umphakathi ukuze uthuthuke. Abantu babethokozisa lapho bebhala izincwadi ezincane, behlanganyela imicabango nezindaba zabo, kuthi futhi bakhulume ngezifiso zabo, izinkinga nezinhloso ezifanele uhulumeni. Usuku Lwabantu Bendawo lwaphumelela ngokuvezwa ngazo zonke izindlela, lapho izakhamuzi zigcwele uthando, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nezinhloso ezilungile. Abavakashi, abathintekayo, nabanye bezicelo bahlala benethuba lokuxoxa, behlangana, benza ubungani obusha. Umcimbi ube yindlela yokwakha imizwelo emisha, kuhlanganiswa izizukulwane ezahlukene, kungaholela ekwakheni umuzwa wokuba yinto eyodwa. Umphakathi ubonese uthando nolwazimagama phakathi kwalabo abavakashele emcimbini. Uhlobo lokuxhumana olubonakalayo phakathi kwezizukulwane lwenze ukuba izinsuku zibe nezinkumbulo ezihamba phambili, abantu beyaqhubeka bekhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuba kanye. Izindaba zomphakathi zazivuma ukukhipha izithombe ezinhle, okwakwenza kube necala lamakhosazane, nobungani obungapheli. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubuyisela izinhlelo ezinhle ezazizungeze uMpoqweni, uqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokubambisana nemisebenzi yokukhuthazelela kuyavela endaweni. Lokhu kungahlala kuqhubeka kuzo zonke izinsuku, njengoba umphakathi uvuselela izinkumbulo ezintsha, unomphela uvame ukuphindaphinda lawo mASIZO ayathokozisa, engalahli isithunzi sokuhlangana. Umoya opholile uhlala ukhululekile, ubonisa ukuthi izindaba zomphakathi ezihlangene zihlala zinqoba, ziveza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, nohlelo olwaziyo ukudala ikhaya. Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwabantu Bendawo ubukhona, futhi kube yimpumelelo engapheli. Ngamunye wethu ungumgibeli kulesi siqalo esisha, lapho izindaba zomphakathi ziqhubeka zihluma, zigqugquzela izimo ezinhle, futhi zakha ikusasa eliqhakazile emiphakathini yethu.
IHollywood Ekuqaleni, eHollywood, kwakukhanya izinkanyezi eziningi. Le ndawo, eyaziwa njengegqugquzela yezinkanyezi, yayigcwele amaphupho, izifiso, nezibani ezikhanyayo. Abantu abaningi bayeza lapha, befuna amathuba okwenza izinkanyezi zikhanye emhlabeni. Kwakuyindawo lapho izithombe zikhuluma, futhi lapho izwi lomuntu lwalungavunyelwa ukuba lishayeke. UThandi, intombazane encane eyayinethemba elikhulu, wayehlala edolobheni elincane elikude neHollywood. Wayefisa ukuba ngumculi, kodwa ubunzima bokuphila bamenza wahamba phambili. Njengoba ethanda umculo, wayehlale ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezinkanyezi ezincane ezazikhanya emoyeni. Kodwa uThandi wayeziqhenya ngempela ngempilo yakhe, futhi wayezazi kahle ukuthi udinga ukwenza okukhulu ukuze afinyelele amaphupho akhe. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wanquma ukuhamba eHollywood. Wathola imali yokuhamba, waphuma edolobheni lakubo, wajabula kakhulu. Waqonda ukuthi leli dolobha laligcwele amathuba, kodwa futhi laligcwele izinselelo. Njengoba efika, wathola izithombe ezinkulu, izakhiwo ezinhle, nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Waqala ukuhamba ezitaladini, ethokozisa abantu ababejabulile, edlala umculo wakhe. Kwathi uma esebenza, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umculi odumile owayesebenza eHollywood. USipho wathokoziswa umculo kaThandi, wambiza ukuba abambe iqhaza emculweni wakhe. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elikhulu kuThandi, futhi washo ukuthi, "Ngiyavuma!" UThandi wajabula kakhulu, kodwa wayezwa ukwesaba. Wayecabanga ukuthi angakwazi yini ukuhamba phambili, futhi ukuthi abantu bazomthanda yini. Kodwa uSipho wamkhuthaza, wathi, "Ungesabi, uThandi. Umculo wakho unamandla, futhi abantu bazowuzwa." Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, uThandi waba yingxenye yephrojekthi enkulu, umculi ophakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi. Umculo wakhe waba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukumthanda. Wazi ukuthi wayefezile amaphupho akhe, kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, waqala ukuqaphela izinselelo ezazihambisana nalokhu. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini, uThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi iHollywood ayiyona indawo elula. Abantu abaninzi babefuna ukuhamba phambili, futhi izimbangi zazikhona. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho wayezwa sengathi angakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kodwa wayenokholo. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, waphinde wathola abaxhasi abasha abamthandayo. Ngemuva kokuhamba phambili, uThandi wathola umklomelo omkhulu. Waba yinkanyezi eHollywood, futhi umculo wakhe wawuduma emhlabeni wonke. Kodwa akazange akhohlwe ukuthi uhambo lwakhe lwalungelula. Wazi ukuthi ubumba obukhulu buza nezinsizi, kodwa wathola ukuthi uthando lwakhe lomculo lwalungakwazi ukumthwalisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wakha umphakathi wakhe, waba yisibonelo kwabanye abaculi abasha. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali ngaphandle kokusebenza kanzima, nokuthi izinselelo zingaba yizifundo ezibalulekile. UThandi waba yisithombe sokuthi amaphupho angaphila, futhi abantu baqala ukumbiza ngegama elisha, "UThandi, intombazane yeHollywood." Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yinkanyezi, kodwa wahlala ehlonipha izimpande zakhe. Waqhubeka nokudlala umculo, futhi waba ngumholi wezobuciko, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. IHollywood, yize iyindawo enezinselelo, yabe iyikhaya lakhe, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona, futhi umculo wakhe waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi amaphupho angafezeka uma umuntu esebenza ngokuzikhandla. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi iHollywood iyindawo yokuphila amaphupho, futhi umculo ungaba yindlela yokudlula ezinsizweni. Waqhubeka nokukhanyisa izinkanyezi, eqhubeka nokukhumbuza abantu ukuthi, noma ngabe izinselelo zikhona, uthando nomsebenzi oncomekayo kuzoholela empumelelweni.
Umdlavuza Kwabesifazane: Ingxoxo Nompilo Mbatha, Udokotela Ochwepheshe Isingeniso Namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, umdlavuza kwabesifazane. Umdlavuza ungomunye wezifo ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa noDkt. Nompilo Mbatha, udokotela ochwepheshe emkhakheni wezokwelapha, owaziwa ngempumelelo yakhe ekwelapheni umdlavuza. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Umdlavuza Umbuzo: Dkt. Mbatha, ungachaza ukuthi umdlavuza kwabesifazane uyini futhi ubuhlungu bawo bukhona kanjani? Impendulo: Umdlavuza kwabesifazane ubandakanya izinhlobo eziningi, kodwa ezivame kakhulu zifaka umdlavuza wesifuba, umdlavuza wombungu, kanye nomdlavuza wesitho sangaphakathi. Umdlavuza uveza izinkinga ezinkulu empilweni, ngoba ungase ube nomthelela omkhulu emzimbeni nasempilweni yengqondo. Abesifazane abaningi bahlushwa ukwesaba, ukungaqondi kahle, kanye nokubandlululwa ngenxa yokuthi umdlavuza ungaba yinkinga engathandeki. Ingxenye 2: Izimbangela Nezimpawu Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimbangela ezivame ukuholela emdlavuzweni kwabesifazane? Impendulo: Izimbangela zingahluka, kodwa ezinye zezinto ezidumile zifaka phakathi izinguquko ezithinta ama-hormone, ukungahlali kahle, kanye nomlando wezokwelapha emndenini. Izimpawu zihluka futhi zingafaka phakathi ukuvuvukala, ubuhlungu, noma ukwehla kokudla. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi lezi zimpawu ukuze bakwazi ukufuna usizo ngokushesha. Ingxenye 3: Ukuhlolwa Nokutholwa Umbuzo: Ingabe abesifazane kufanele benze ukuhlolwa njalo ukuze kuvinjwe umdlavuza? Impendulo: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane benze ukuhlolwa njalo. Ukuhlolwa kwe-mammogram, ukuhlolwa kwe-pap smear, kanye nezinye izivivinyo zingasiza ekutholeni umdlavuza ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuthi umdlavuza ube mubi futhi kube lula ukuwulawula. Ingxenye 4: Ukwelashwa Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindlela zokwelapha ezitholakalayo uma umdlavuza utholakele? Impendulo: Kunezindlela eziningi zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzwa, ukwelashwa nge-chemotherapy, kanye nokwelashwa nge-radiotherapy. Uhlelo lokwelashwa luncike ekutholeni umdlavuza, umumo womuntu, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bakhulume nodokotela babo ukuze bathole uhlelo olufanele. Ingxenye 5: Ukusekelwa Nokuphila Ngemva Kokwelashwa Umbuzo: Njengomuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, ungakupha izeluleko zokuthi abesifazane bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zokusekelwa? Impendulo: Izinsiza zokusekelwa zibalulekile. Abesifazane bangathola usizo ezikhungweni zokwelapha, emiphakathini, nasezinhlelweni zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuxhumana nabanye abesifazane abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo kungaba usizo olukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana nezihlobo nabangane kungasiza ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ingxenye 6: Ukubaluleka Kokukhuluma Ngendaba Umbuzo: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngendaba yomdlavuza kwabesifazane? Impendulo: Ukukhuluma ngale ndaba kubalulekile ukuze sithole ukuqonda, sikhulise ulwazi, futhi sithuthukise ukwesekwa. Umdlavuza akuyona into okufanele siyihloniphe noma siyigcine imfihlo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sithuthukisa amathuba okuthi abesifazane bathole usizo oludingekayo. Isiphetho Umdlavuza kwabesifazane ungumkhankaso omkhulu, kodwa ngokukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokuxhumana, singakwazi ukusiza abesifazane baphile impilo engcono. Njengoba sithola ulwazi olushisayo nolwakamuva, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukweseka abesifazane abathintekayo kubalulekile. Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mbatha, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi oluwusizo ngale ndaba ebalulekile.
Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika: Umfanekiso Wokukhula Nokwazisa EBhola, impilo yamaAfrikaans, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, iyinsika ebalulekile yamasiko nezenhlalakahle. Amaqembu ebhola anjengomlingani, akhulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela nokwazisa okuvelayo phakathi kwabantu, okuhambisana nemisebenzi eminingi yombono wezenhlalo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngamaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela abathinteka ngayo empilweni nasemiphakathini. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukujula kuhlelo lwamasiko olwakhiwe yile midlalwano. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns awaze wathela ithoni ehluke kakhulu emhlabeni wethu. Lokhu akuhlangene nje nokuthokozisa, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, izifundo zempilo, kanye nezikhuthazo zokuziphatha kahle emiphakathini. AmaChiefs nePirates awangama ‘derbies’ akhangayo, akhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, bejabulisa izinkulungwane ezibukele emidlalweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sihlangabezana nokukhula nokuguquka kwezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika. I-South African Premier Soccer League (PSL) iyinsika yalo mkhakha, igcwalisa izinkanyezi eziningi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akusikho ukuhamba phambili kuphela kwezikhwama zemali, kodwa futhi nakuqala kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa emidlalweni. Izikhumbuzo zamakilabhu, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu kudala ithuba lokukhula kwezemidlalo futhi kwandisa ubuchwepheshe bokulinganisa. Ukwazi ukuthi ingabe amaqembu anjengeGolden Arrows, Supersport United, neBidvest Wits axhumene kanjani nezifunda ezahlukahlukene kuyathakazelisa. Njengoba imiphakathi ihamba phambili, amaqembu abona izinselelo zabo ezithile, efaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, nokugcina abasebenzisi bawo benelisekile. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi izinkolelo eziwumgogodla wokulwa nezinkinga zempilo yesikhumbuzo njalo zikhona. Kubavubukuli bebhola, njengamathimba weBafana Bafana, umsebenzi wabo obalulekile ubonakala engxenyeni yase-Africa. Ngemva kokuhluleka kwabanye, uBafana Bafana uyisibonelo sokuthi uma uhola kahle, ungafinyelela impumelelo enkulu. Ukukhula kolwazi nolwazi lokuhola okayela kokufunda okuxhasayo, kubalulekile empumelelweni yeqembu. Noma kunjalo, ukwehluka kwamaphepha ezokuxhumana gewela eceleni komhlaba wezokungcebeleka. Ubhubhane lweCovid-19 luveze izinselelo ezingakaze zicaciswe. Ngaphezu kwesithangami sokuncintisana, abathandi bebholana benza izifundo ezinzima, bezama ukugcina uthando lwabo lwezemidlalo, ngenkathi bejabulisa izigidi abantu abanebhadi ngokwenziwa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ibhola langempela lidlula imikhawulo yokungaphezulu; umoya wokuhlanganyela kufanele ube phezulu. Ukufingqa, amaqembu ebhola eNingizimu Afrika angaphezu kokuphila komdlalo, adinga ukuba abambe iqhaza empilweni yomphakathi. Ngaphakathi kwemigqa ethokozisayo, amaqembu afundisa ngempilo, angeza umoya wokubambisana emiphakathini, akhuthaza izifundo ezinkulu, futhi avumela abantu ukuba banikezele ngothando. Lokhu akusho ukusho ugqozi kuphela kodwa nokukhuthazwa kokuzimisela. Ubani owaziyo, kuze kube phakade, ibhola lizokhumbula lesi sikhathi njengokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle, kanti abantu bazokwazi ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni ithemba elisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ibhola lenza ukuba sithokozise imiphakathi yethu, lihlolisise izakhiwo zempilo zamasiko ethu, nezinkunka zezinhlangothi eziningi. Amaqembu akhombisa ubuhlakani bethu, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha, okufanele kwazise izizukulwane ezizayo. Ngakho-ke, ibhola akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kwenza kube nemigudu eqinile yokuba abantu bahlale bephakeme.
Amanani Okudla: Uhlanga Lwenhlalo Yethu Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngamanani okudla, akukhona okuthile okungathinta impilo yethu njengokudla. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngiyazi, sonke sithanda ukudla, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamanani, sithola ukuthi izinto zishintsha njalo. Ngiyazi, ngiyazi, ungase ube nesithakazelo sokwazi ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezithinta amanani okudla. Okokuqala, sikhumbula ukuthi izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu. Uma umhlaba ungena emoyeni, izitshalo zethu ziba nezinkinga, futhi lokho kuholela ekwandeni kwamaholo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani izithelo zikhula zibe zishibhile ngonyaka othile, bese ziba phezulu ngonyaka olandelayo? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izimo zezulu zishintsha, futhi lokho kuthinta ukukhiqizwa kokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yomnotho. Uma umnotho uphila kahle, abantu banelungelo lokuthenga okungaphezulu. Kodwa uma umnotho ungena ezinkingeni, abantu bahlala bejolisa ekuthengeni okuncane. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanani okudla akhuphuke, ngoba abathengisi bazi ukuthi abantu badinga ukudla, ngakho-ke baphakamisa amanani ukuze benze inzuzo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukucabangela? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu bahlala bezibuza ukuthi kungani izinkampani zokudla zikhuphula amanani. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka. Uma izindleko zokuthenga izinto ezisemqoka, njengezithako, zikhuphuka, abathengisi badinga ukwenyusa amanani ukuze balinganise. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo onzima, lapho abantu bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bejolisa ekuthengeni okuncane. Kodwa akukhona konke okubi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi kunezindlela zokunciphisa izindleko zokudla? Ukuthenga ezitolo ezincane noma ezisemaphandleni kungaba yindlela enhle yokuthola ukudla okungabizi kakhulu. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungazama ukutshala izitshalo zakho. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekunciphiseni izindleko, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngamasiko ethu. Ezinye izindawo zinezakhamuzi ezithanda ukudla okwenziwa ngamasiko. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu bahlala bejolisa ekuthengeni ukudla okwenziwe ngamasiko. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo omuhle, lapho abantu bejolisa ekuthengeni okuthile, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo kubathengisi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi amanani okudla awanqotshwa kalula? Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta lokhu, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sithinta impilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba esitolo, cabanga ngalezi zinto. Ucabanga ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuze unciphise izindleko zakho? Futhi, ungakuthola kanjani ukudla okungcono, okungabizi kakhulu? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi amanani okudla azoshintsha. Kodwa uma sikhumbula lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, hamba phambili, thola izindlela zokuthola ukudla okungabizi, futhi ungakhohlwa ukujabulisa umndeni wakho ngempilo enempilo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kukhuthaze ukuba ucabange ngamanani okudla nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuze uphile kahle. Hamba phambili, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
Isikole Sikahulumeni: Ukubaluleka Kwaso Emphakathini Wethu Izikole zikahulumeni, ezaziwa njengesikole samabanga aphansi ukuya phezulu, zihlala zithokoziswa njengemithombo ebalulekile yokufunda nezifundo eziletha umphumela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Kulezi zinsuku, sikhuluma kakhulu ngempumelelo yezikole ezizimele, kodwa kunjalo, asikwazi ukukhohlwa indima ebalulekile edlalwa izikole zikahulumeni. Lezi zikhungo zifana neqhaza elikhulu, zikhombisa indlela yokuphila, nezifundo ezithokozisa izingane zethu. Ukuqala, izikole zikahulumeni zinikeza ukufinyelela emfundweni kumphakathi wonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphakathi kwezinga eliphansi. Bamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuqiniseni umphakathi, zingasiza ukuthuthukisa imiphakathi ibe namathuba alinganayo. Ukusiza ukuthi izingane zokwenyama, ezinemfundo ephakeme nezidingo ezithile ziphumelele, izikole zikahulumeni zenza umphakathi ube namandla. Lapha sizithola izingane ezivela emazweni ahlukene, ezidlangile ezizayo, kanye nemisebenzi enenhlonipho. Ngokuhambisana nalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhulisa ukuzazi okuhle, lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yengane. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izingane ezithola imfundo ezikole zikahulumeni ziba nekhono lokuthola izinkundla eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Kusho ukuthi, ukuthola imfundo oyithola emkhakheni wakwaHulumeni kudala izinga eliphezulu lokuwina izifundo ezinzima, ezikhona emhlabeni jikelele. Njengoba izingane zikhula, zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe nesibopho, futhi ziqonde imithetho yomphakathi nezimiso zempilo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kudinga kubhekwane nezinkinga ezisemqoka ezibhekene nezikole zikahulumeni. Ngokuvamile, lezi zikole zibhekene nezinsiza ezikhudlwana, ngokwesibonelo, umnotho omubi. Ukuvama, izikole zikhathazekile ngezezimali eziphezulu zokufundela, eziholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezincwadi, ama-laptops, nezinsiza zokufundela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uHulumeni abeke imizamo eyengeziwe yokuthuthukisa lezi zikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izingane zithola imfundo efanele. Futhi, kumqoka ukwazi ukuthi ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele kungaholela ekubeni nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabafundi. Izingane ezikhaliphile nezinomsebenzi omuhle zingaphenduka zingathola ukuqashelwa okungaphansi, ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube neqhaza, ofuna ukuhlanganisa ukuhlobana, ukuze athuthukise izikole zikahulumeni. Okokugcina, ngithanda ukugqamisa ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zithokozisa kakhulu ngesimo esihle esigcwele amathemba. Ukuhamba kwezingane ezindaweni eziphezulu kumiphakathi, ezithokozisayo, kumele kwenze kucace ukuthi ziningi izinzuzo ezivela kumfundiso ephezulu. Ukuba nemfundo ejulile kuvula iminyango yokuxhumana nezinye izinkampani, lokhu kumqoka empumelelweni yomsebenzi. Ngokuhlanganisa, izikole zikahulumeni zibalulekile empilweni yethu nakumphakathi. Zinikeza ithuba lezingane zokufunda, besebenza kumholi ngokuthola imfundo yomhlaba wonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, udinga ukuthi umphakathi usondele ezikole zikahulumeni futhi ube nohlanga lokuthuthuka. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuphuculeni imiphakathi, kulindeleke ukuthi abantu bagcine belokhu bekhalipha nekhanda eliqinile. Umbono wami uwukuthi, kumele sithathe izifiso zabafundi bethu sizame ukuhamba phambili sithuthukise izikole zikahulumeni, ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle empilweni yethu sonke.
iNetflix: Ukushintsha Kwezokungcebeleka Kwamanye Amabhayisikobho Namashwa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokungcebeleka ziye zashintsha kakhulu, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. Phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo ezikhona, iNetflix ibonakala njengephuzu elikhulu ekuguqulweni kwezokungcebeleka. Le nkundla yokubuka amavidiyo inikeza abantu ithuba lokubuka amabhayisikobho, uchungechunge, nezinhlelo zokwakha ezihamba phambili, konke ngokushaya nje kwesithombe. Ngesikhathi iNetflix iqala, kucace bha ukuthi izobangela ushintsho olukhulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Kuqala, yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu ngenxa yokukwazi kwayo ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezivamile, ezisheshayo. Ukungena kwayo emakethe yama-streaming kushiye izikhala ezinkulu ezitholakala kumasiko esintu. Abantu baye baphendukela ekubukeni amavidiyo, bejabulisa izidingo zabo zokungcebeleka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Enye yezinto ezikhethekile ngamaNetflix ukuthi ibonise amandla okwenza okuqukethwe okuhlukahlukene. Njengenhlangano, iNetflix ikwazi ukugxila emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ivumela abangu-100% ukuthi bathole okuthandayo. Lokhu kuqhamuke nezinhlelo ezifana ne "Money Heist" ne "Stranger Things," ezithole ukwamukelwa okukhulu emazweni ahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iNetflix ayihlali nje kuphela ezinkundleni zendawo, kodwa ibheka emhlabeni wonke, inikela ngezinhlelo ezihambelana namasiko ahlukahlukene. Ngokuphathelene nekhwalithi, iNetflix ibonakala ikhethekile. Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ikhulula amavidiyo anekhwalithi ephezulu, okwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuba bajabulele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokukhangisa nemiphumela yevidiyo ibukeka izinhle, okwenza kube nokudlalwa okuphelele. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi abanye abakhiqizi bamabhayisikobho bathola ugqozi ukuze bancintisane neNetflix, benza imizamo yokuthuthukisa umkhiqizo wabo. Nokho, ukungena kweNetflix emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka akukhombisi kuphela ukubonakala kwayo. Kunemiphumela ethile ezinzima engase ibonakale kule nkundla. Okokuqala, ukuvela kweNetflix kuholele ekwehleni kwesidingo samakhaya amakhulu. Abantu abaningi baphenduke kumasevisi e-streaming, okwenza kube nzima kumagumbini amakhulu ukusinda. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukwehla kwenani lababukeli, okuthinta kakhulu ukuthuthukiswa kwabanye abakhiqizi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNetflix idinga izindleko ezinkulu ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okujabulisayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinkinga zama-licensing, okungaholela ekuphumeleleni kokungasebenzi kahle. Abanye abaphenduli baveza ukuthi ukungabikho kwama-licensing amasha kungabavala ithuba lokubuka amabhayisikobho abathandayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iNetflix iqhubeke ibhalela izinkontileka ezinzima, okubonisa ukuncintisana okukhulu. Kubantu abaningi, iNetflix iyindlela yokungcebeleka engaguquki. Abantu bakhululekile ukukhetha ukuthi bafuna ukubuka ini, futhi ngesikhathi esithile, abakwazi ukuthola izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ama-documentaries, izinhlelo zengcebo, nezinhlelo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bathole okuthandayo. Noma kunjalo, indlela iNetflix esithinta ngayo ukukhetha kwethu ibonisa izinkinga ezithile. Uhlelo lokubuka luyaqhubeka luthinta izinqumo zabantu, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kudala ukuvuka kwemikhuba yokungaboni kahle. Ngokuthola uhla olukhulu lwezinhlelo, abanye babukeli bangase baphuthelwe amathuba okuthola okuthokozisayo emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iNetflix, nakuba inikeza izinzuzo eziningi, nayo ibeka phambili izinkinga ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNetflix ibonakala iyindawo ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Iphinde ibonise ukuthi ibhizinisi lezi zinsuku lidinga ukuba lihlale likhula, ukuze libe nesizinda esiqinile. Njengoba imibono yama-streaming iqhubeka nokukhula, iNetflix izodinga ukuqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ukuze ihlale ibamba isikhala sayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuthola izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, kanti iNetflix izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekukhuliseni amasiko ahlukahlukene. Ukuphetha, iNetflix iwumkhiqizo ophumelelayo futhi odumile, osiza abantu ukuba bathole izinhlelo ezihambelana nezifiso zabo. Nokho, kufanele sihlale sikulungele ukufunda nokuhlola izinselelo ezilethwa yile nkundla. Njengoba izokhula, ukuhamba kwayo kuzoba yinto ebalulekile ukuze kutholakale izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, nokugcina umphakathi uthokozisa izidingo zabo zokungcebeleka. INetflix iyinhlangano ebalulekile, futhi izoshintsha umqondo wethu wokungcebeleka emhlabeni wonke.
Osomabhizinisi: Iphrofayela Yomuntu Uhlelo lwezomnotho luhlala luhamba phambili ngenxa yosomabhizinisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Osomabhizinisi, noma osomabhizinisi, bangabantu abahlakaniphile, abanesibindi, futhi abathanda ukuthatha izingozi. Bahlala bephusha imingcele, befuna izixazululo ezintsha nezindlela zokwenza izinto, futhi bangabavulindlela bezinguquko emiphakathini yabo. I. Isizinda Somuntu Ngokwesiko, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephuma ezimpilweni ezihlukahlukene. Abanye baphakathi kwemindeni emikhulu, lapho bezifundisa khona ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha, kanti abanye baphuma ezimweni ezinzima, lapho behluleka khona ukuthola amathuba. UThandi Nkosi, osomabhizinisi ophumelelayo, ungumzekelo omuhle. UThandi wazalwa edolobheni elincane eMpumalanga, lapho ababephila khona impilo elula. Uthando lwakhe lokwenza izinto lwalukhula kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho eqala khona ukuthengisa izithelo ezincane emgwaqweni. II. Ukuqala Kwezimali Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThandi wathola umsebenzi emnyangweni wezokuphatha, kodwa akazange abone imisebenzi yakhe iyamthokozisa. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi kufanele azame ukuvula ibhizinisi lakhe. Ngemali encane ayitholile, waqala ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo yokudla enempilo, efaka phakathi ama-smoothies nezibiliboco ezilula. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokumaketha bamsiza ukuba abone amathuba amasha, futhi waqala ukwakha igama elihle emiphakathini. III. Ukukhula Kwebhizinisi Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, uThandi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngamasu okuphatha. Waqasha othisha abanolwazi ukuze bamfundise ngamasu ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza, ukumaketha, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhe ibhizinisi eliqinile, elinokuthenjwa. UThandi waqhubeka nokwandisa imikhiqizo yakhe, wengeza iziphuzo ezihlukahlukene, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. IV. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlangano UThandi akazange agxile kuphela ebhizinisini lakhe. Waqonda ukubaluleka kokubambisana nezinye izinkampani. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namafemu amancane, abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ukuze benze imikhiqizo yabo ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu. Lokhu kubambisana kwaholela ekwandeni komkhiqizo wakhe, futhi waqala ukuthola izivakashi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. V.
