Ukuphendula Emiphakathini UThandi ubelokhu eqaphela ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe alihlinzeki kuphela ngemali, kodwa futhi linomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Waqala imikhankaso yokubuyisela emiphakathini, ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa izingane, nokuxhasa abalimi bendawo. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe libe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. VI. Ukuqhamuka Kwezinkinga Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, uThandi ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana, izinguquko ezimakethe, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zaba yizithiyo. Nokho, uThandi akazange ayekele. Waqhubeka efunda, efuna izixazululo, futhi ehlola izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha ibhizinisi lakhe. Lokhu kumenza waba ngusomabhizinisi ophumelelayo, owaziwa ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezomnotho. VII. Iziphakamiso Zokuphumelela UThandi ufunde izifundo eziningi ngesikhathi sokwakha ibhizinisi lakhe. Ubonisa ukubaluleka kokuba nesibindi, futhi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga isikhathi, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela. Uthanda ukusho ukuthi "ukuphumelela akukhona ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda." UThandi ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba yizikhumbuzo ezinhle zomsebenzi, umdlandla, nokuzinikela. VIII. Ikusasa Elikhanyayo Namuhla, uThandi Nkosi ungumholi emkhakheni wezokudla, futhi ibhizinisi lakhe selikhule laba nezinhlaka eziningi. Ubuye abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. UThandi uyazi ukuthi ikusasa lamasiko amasha lincike ezinqubweni ezithathwa namuhla, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi eliqhubekayo. UThandi Nkosi ungumzekelo omuhle wosomabhizinisi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, abathanda ukwakha, futhi abavula amathuba. Ubonisa ukuthi ngeqhaza, umdlandla, kanye nesibindi, konke kungenzeka. Ukuphumelela kwakhe akugcini nje ekwenzeni imali, kodwa kuphinde kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaseduze kwakhe. UThandi uyisibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba yizikhumbuzo ezinhle, futhi umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye ukuze ube ngcono.
I-Load Shedding Nomthelela Wayo Emnothweni Isingeniso I-load shedding, noma ukwehliswa kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, kube yinkinga ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ibonakala ikhiqiza umthelela omkhulu emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ezentengiselwano, nakubantu ababhekene nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuhlola kuzobheka imbangela ye-load shedding, izimpawu zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emnothweni. Imbangela ye-Load Shedding I-load shedding ivame ukwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, okungathinta izizathu eziningi. Ezinye zezizathu zifaka phakathi ukungabi negesi eyanele, izinkinga zokusebenza ezimbonini zamandla, kanye nezinselelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Izikhungo zamandla, njenge-Eskom, zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokugcina izinga lokukhiqiza amandla eliphezulu, okuholela ekutheni kudingeke ukwehliswa kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ukuze kugwenywe ukwehla kokusebenza. Izimpawu Zokwehla Kokuhlinzekwa Kukagesi I-load shedding ibonakala ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Izimpawu zayo zifaka phakathi ukwehla kokusebenza kwezinkampani, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa nokungabi namandla okusebenzisa izinto ezisemqoka ezifana nezibani, izitofu, nemishini yokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, njengoba abantu badinga izixazululo eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezizinda zamandla ezizimele nezinye izindlela zokugcina amandla. Umthelela Emnothweni Umthelela we-load shedding emnothweni ubalulekile. Izinkampani eziningi zihlushwa kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini ezincike kakhulu kumandla. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwemikhiqizo, okwandisa izindleko zokukhiqiza, futhi kuholele ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziphinde zibe nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha amakhasimende. Lokhu kungaholela ekwehleni kwemisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukusika izindleko ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela we-load shedding ungabonakala ezingeni lomphakathi. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuphila, njengoba ukungabi namandla kukagesi kuholela ekwehleni kokusebenza kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, okwandisa umthwalo emnothweni. Izinga lokuphila liba phezulu, futhi abantu badinga ukusebenzisa imali eningi ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokubhekana Nezinkinga Ukuze kubhekwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zamandla zithuthukise ukusebenza kwazo, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhulise ukukhiqiza amandla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, okuzogwema i-load shedding. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamalanga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kuzokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamandla. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo zamandla nezinkampani ezizimele. Isiphetho I-load shedding iyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umthelela wayo emnothweni ubonakala kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banamandla okuphila kahle, futhi izinkampani zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngamandla, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela we-load shedding, futhi sakhe umnotho oqinile, onempilo. Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngenkathi sikhuluma ngesimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi leli zwe libhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezinzima. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphazamiseka, umnotho wethu ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima ezifana nokungasebenzi, ukwehla kwemali engenayo, kanye nokwanda kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngentshisekelo yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngengxenye yokungasebenzi. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi amazinga okungasebenzi aseNingizimu Afrika aphezulu kakhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza umphakathi, kodwa futhi kuthinta umnotho jikelele. Abantu abangenamsebenzi bahlala bezama ukuthola amathuba, kodwa izinkampani zikhathazekile ngokukhula kwezindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile, ezifana nokukhuthaza imfundo ethuthukile kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono adingekayo emakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehla kwemali engenayo kubonakala njengomunye wemiphumela emibi yokungasebenzi. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezama ukuphila ngezindleko eziphansi, kodwa lokhu akukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokukhuthaza umnotho, njengokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokubheka izindleko zokuphila, sithola ukuthi zikhula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izindleko zokudla, ezokuthutha, nezokuhlala zikhuphuka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokulawula lezi zindleko, mhlawumbe ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthenga ezithengekayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo kubantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha umnotho ohlangene. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika udinga ukuba ube nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi banamathuba amaningi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sikhuthaze ubuchwepheshe, imboni, nezinsizakalo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ngokuphetha, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sinesimo esinzima, kodwa akukhona okungapheli. Uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi ohlangene. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nethemba, futhi sikhuthaze izixazululo eziphusile ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umnotho wethu ungathuthuka, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni umnotho onempilo.
Izifundo Zokuphumelela KwezamaBhizinisi: Ukuhamba Phambili Ngobuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokwakha Ezamabhizinisi zihlala zibhekwa njengenhloso yokwakha izinkampani eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Nokho, empilweni yansuku zonke, abhizinisayo abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene bahlala bephikisana nezinselele eziningi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo ezihamba phambili, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zokwakha zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhambela phambili. Kulezi zinsuku, ubuchwepheshe buphendule indlela esisebenza ngayo, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezamabhizinisi. Amabhizinisi amancane athola ithuba lokukhula ngokusebenzisa amaphakheji e-software avumela ukuhlela kahle, ukuthengisa, nokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ngendlela efanele, ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi ahlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Ngezizathu ezinjalo, izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa ama-plathifomu e-inthanethi ukuze zikhulise ukuthengisa kwazo. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kubekhona ukwanda kwezinkampani ezisebenzisa amakhasi e-web, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokukhangisa ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukufinyelela komkhiqizo, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa isithombe sendawo yebhizinisi. Ngakho, njengabathandi bezamabhizinisi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale buthuthuka. Uma sithanda ukuba phambili, kumele sihlale sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ukuze sithuthukise imikhiqizo nemisebenzi, lokho kudinga ukuba siqhubeke sifunda, sibe nokuzimisela, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezikhuthazayo. Kodwa akukhona nje ubuchwepheshe obuyisihluthulelo. Izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsizakusebenza, izindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezikhwama zezimali zidinga ukuba siqaphele. Kumele sibuye siphendule izinselelo zokuphatha ezithinta izinkampani, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zethu zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuphatha abantu, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kumayelana nokunika indawo yokusebenza ekhuthazayo, lapho abasebenzi bezwakala benesithakazelo emsebenzini wabo. Izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokusebenza zingaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, kube nezinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kubasebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Ngemuva kokwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile, kufanele sihlole indlela yokubambisana. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, amabhizinisi kufanele axhumane nabanye ukuze athole ukufinyelela ezinsizeni nezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kungaholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha, kuhlanganyele izinsiza, futhi kulethe izinzuzo kubo bobabili. Ukubambisana kungenza kube lula ukuncintisana emakethe futhi kudale amathuba amasha. Kodwa futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ezamabhizinisi akupheli ekwakheni kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukusiza umphakathi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezihlobene nokubaluleka kokuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo kubantu. Amabhizinisi kufanele abheke ukuthi angawathuthukisa kanjani amathuba emisebenzi, anikeze imiholo efanele, futhi abe nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimfundiso ezivela ezamabhizinisi ziqinisekisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuba siyiqonde impilo yomphakathi. Ibhizinisi elinobuhlakani alikhulisi kuphela inzuzo, kodwa futhi linikela ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuphila sabantu. Lokhu kuyindlela engcono yokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, nokwakha ikusasa eliqinile. Ekugcineni, ezamabhizinisi zinhle kakhulu uma zisebenza kahle, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ziqinisekise abasebenzi, zisebenzisana, futhi zikhathalela umphakathi. Ngamafuphi, izifundo zokuphumelela ezivela ezamabhizinisi zikhombisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ngenkulu yokuthengisa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili ngendlela efanele, enobuntu, futhi eqondile. Lokhu kuzoholela emiphumeleni emihle, hhayi kuphela kubanikazi bamabhizinisi, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabantu abahlala emiphakathini yethu.
Odokotela Nabahlengikazi: Izindima Eziyinhloko Empilweni Yomphakathi KwaZulu-Natali, 22 kuCwaninga 2023 – Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, odokotela nabahlengikazi baqhubeka bephendula ngezimpilo zethu, bezivumelanisa nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezifo, ubhubhane nokunye, lezi zinsiza zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono. Odokotela, njengoba bes Nolwazi olunzulu kwezokwelapha, banezibopho ezinkulu. Bahlinzeka ngeluleko nosizo emithini, balungisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo, futhi banikeza ithemba kulabo abakhalwe yizinkinga ezinzima. Odokotela bahlala befundisa ngokubaluleka kokugcina impilo kahle, beqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi kabanzi ngempilo yabo. Bayakwazi ukuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, futhi abanamahluleli, bazihlanganisa kakhulu nomsebenzi wabo. Naphezu kokuba odokotela benza imisebenzi ebalulekile, abahlengikazi bayabahlobisa kulezi zinsizakalo. Abahlengikazi banikeza ukunakekelwa okukhulu, behlola izimo zempilo zeziguli nsuku zonke. Basiza ekuphenduleni ezimweni eziphuthumayo futhi balungiselela iziguli ukukhethwa kwemithi efanele. Ngaphandle kokunakekela, abahlengikazi basiza ukuhlelela izinhlelo zokwelapha zansuku zonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kusebenza kwezakhamuzi kunika igunya elikhulu kubo bobabili. Ukuhlobana phakathi kwabo, odokotela nabahlengikazi, kuveza ubudlelwane obubalulekile bokuxhumana. Lokhu kusebenzisana phakathi kwabo kubalulekile, njengoba kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zikhululiwe futhi zinesiqiniseko sokuba nempilo engcono. Odokotela banika abahlengikazi ithuba lokwenza imisebenzi yabo, kanti abahlengikazi benza izinto ezenzakalayo zibe lula kumadokhumenti, okwenza umsebenzi uhambe kahle. Naphezu kwezimo zomsebenzi eziyinkimbinkimbi, odokotela nabahlengikazi baphinde bahlale bephikelela ekuthuthukiseni izimpendulo zempilo. Banamabanga okubambisana nabezindaba, bahlola ukuthuthukiswa kwezokwelapha, futhi beqonda izidingo ezikulu zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kudala umphakathi ophilayo, ophethe izinsiza ezisiza abantu ukuze bahlukane nezimo ezingezinhle. Kodwa-ke, nakuba odokotela nabahlengikazi benza imisebenzi emangalisayo, bayakwenziwa nemithwalo engapheli. Ubunzima obuhambisana nesikhathi sokusebenza, ukungabi nabambiswano ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi futhi dalela isimo somnotho esinzima kudala ukungezwani. Odokotela bathola izinsuku eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanti abahlengikazi bahlushwa phakathi kokuphila kwabantu abanesidingo esiphuthumayo. Kumele sinakekele lezi zinsiza, sigcizelele ukubaluleka kokuxhasa odokotela nabahlengikazi emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kungafaka izinsizakalo zokuqeqeshwa nokubambisana ezindaweni zokwelapha, ukuze kufakwe izindlela ezizokwandisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ngesikhathi umhlaba udlula ezimeni ezinzima, ukwaziwa kwezikhungo zempilo zibalulekile ekukhuseleni impilo, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlinzeka ngeluleko elibalulekile ekuhlangabezaneni nezinselelo ezinzima, bahlala bekhanda ubuthakathaka bezempilo emphakathini. Emhlabeni wokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala beneqhaza elibalulekile. Kufanele sibe nomoya ophakeme, sizigqugquzele kulezi zinsizakalo eziza nabuphukuphuku bokushintsha izimo zempilo, futhi sihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubantu. Imininingwane yokugcina: Odokotela nabahlengikazi basebenzisa isizinda sabo sokusebenza ukuze benze ukuphila kube ngcono, bazi kahle ukuthi impilo yisantande ibalulekile. Umsebenzi wabo unika izethembiso ezinzile, futhi uhlelo lwemphilo luthola ukwesekwa okuhle, kuhlangene noBaba nomama, abenza kube nokuxhumana okuvelele kokuphila. Impilo ithintwa kakhulu yizinqumo ezenziwe izinsiza, futhi lokhu kuhlangana kugcizelela umsebenzi born, usebenzisana ekwakheni umhlaba ophilayo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bemelela okuhle ukuthi umphakathi uzothuthuka, futhi basiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nesibopho, sibe neqhaza elihle ekuhlonipheni lolu thando olunikela ekuphileni kwethu.
Imidlalo Yamakhompiyutha: Uhlobo Oluthokozisayo Lokudlala Uhlelo lokudlala kumakhompiyutha, olwaziwa ngokuthi imidlalo yamakhompiyutha, luthokozisa abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuqala ngezinsuku zokuqala lapho imidlalo yemishini yokuqala yakhiwa, lezi zinhlelo zehlile ngezindlela eziningi futhi zathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Namuhla, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha isikhala esihamba phambili, esinesiphazamiso esiza ukwedlula imingcele yokukhetha, ubuchwepheshe, nemidlalo eqondile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizogxila emlandweni, ekuthuthukisweni, nasekuthokoziseni kwabantu kule midlalo. Ukudala izipho ezintsha ezimnandi, abathuthukisi bemidlalo bahamba phambili emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Kuthe kuqala imidlalo yobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, imidlalo eminingi yagxila kumkhiqizo, lapho abadlali bazi ukuthi bakhetha ukudlala imidlalo ethile. Lokhu kudale ukwanda kwemali yokudlala ngebhajethi, okwenza abyale ukuzibandakanya kwamakhasimende okukhulu. Iminyaka edlule ibonakale iyinhlekelele; umkhiqizo owawuhlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu ufike waba ngowama-industry ayizigidi. Lokhu kulindelwe ekuqaleni kwamakhompiyutha, lapho imidlalo yokuqala ibonakala yehlukile, kodwa ibikhipha impilo emisha kumakhasi amasha. Abadlali baphakathi kwemidlalo yamakhompiyutha kubalulekile ukuthokoza ngokwama-culture ahlukene. Imidlalo ayilokothi ihlale efana; ithokozisa abantu abahlukene ngezinhloso ezifanayo, izinsiza ezihlukene, nezindaba ezithile ezithokozisayo. Umdlalo we-'The Legend of Zelda' wakhuluma ngokuziqhenya ngamasiko eJapane, kanti 'Grand Theft Auto' udlalisa izinselelo zempilo eceleni kwezilwandle. Lokhu kwenza imidlalo ibe nendaba eqondile ngesikhathi abafundi bejolise emhlabeni jikelele. I-competitive gaming, noma i-esports, ibe yintsha phakathi kwezinye izilimi zitholakala phesheya. Njengoba imidlalo iyishayeli yesikhumbuzo, abaqeqeshi, nabadlali bamalungu abahlonishwayo, bezama ukufaka izitayela ezenzakalweni ezikhulayo. Ukuxhasa izimbangi ezinkulu, imidlalo iyinqubo ethokozisayo ekwandiseni izinselelo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni imijamo, izixhumo nezinhlelo zamasiko eziphathelene nemidlalo. Kodwa-ke, zikhona izinkinga ezihambisanayo nezinhlelo zokudlala. Ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ezinkingeni zomzimba nokuhlupheka okujwayelekile, nokwehlukaniswa ebudlelwaneni. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, izinto ezenzakalayo zaba nezimo ezihlukile; abanye abantu bazithola bephazamisekile, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlali benelisekile phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ibonakaliswa njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali bakha ubudlelwano nezinye izindawo, benza abanye abaphumelele, bese ke abanye befunda ukuhlonipha. Lokhu kudala umhlaba omusha wezenzo, mkhulu ngokuziqhenya ngempela. Umphakathi ludinga ukuzwana, futhi imidlalo yamakhompiyutha inikeza amathuba amaningi okukhuluma nokuxhumana. Umdlalayo, njengoba babizwa ngalesi sikhathi, ubugqugquzela ukubaluleka kobuchwepheshe empilweni yabadlali. Abadlali bahlola izinkampuni ezikhonjiwe nezinhlelo eziningi zesiqhamo, zibona okuhle. Ukudlala kuqedela ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuphazamise izinkumbulo zomphakathi, kuholela ekunqobeni imicabango endala. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha iye yathuthuka kakhulu, yaba yinsiza yokukhumbula, yokuxhumana, neyokudlula imingcele. Ihlanganisa abantu, ihlotshaniswa nezimo ezahlukene, futhi ibonisa umhlaba obuthakathaka. Lokhu kwenza kube ngokwedlulele lokho okwenziwa ngabadlali, okwakha umphakathi ogcwele izinkumbulo. Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ayiyona eyodwa, kodwa imizwa ehlukile evela kumphakathi, izakhiwo, nezinkumbulo okungaholela ezimpilweni ezikhethekile kubadlali. Hamba ube nengqondo, hamba, uqhubeke, futhi uphume kweminye imikhiqizo eyinqaba emakhompiyuthweni, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, nathi sizohlala siqhubeka sithokozisa kulolu hlobo oluthokozisayo lomsebenzi.
Isingeniso Namuhla sithokozile ukuba nezingxoxo ezijulile ngendawo yezinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okuhle, sikhulumisa uMnu. Sipho Ndlovu, ongumxhumanisi wezokuphathwa kwemali osebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene zomnotho. USipho, siyakwamukela! Uhlanga 1: Ukwethulwa kwezinga lentela USipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Izinga lentela liwumqondo obalulekile emnothweni wethu. E-Ningizimu Afrika, sinesistimu yeziqondiso ezibalulekile ezihlanganisa intela yengeniso, intela yokuthengisa, nezintela ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza uhulumeni ukuba aqoqe imali yokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi. Uhlanga 2: Izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi lenza kube nzima kubanikazi bamabhizinisi? USipho: Yebo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile. Izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika liphakathi kwezinga eliphakeme, lokho kubangela ukuthi abaninimabhizinisi bahlupheke. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi amancane, njengoba bekudingeka ukuthi baphathe izindleko eziphakeme. Uhlanga 3: Intela yengeniso Umbuzo: Ungasichazela kancane ngentela yengeniso? USipho: Impela. Intela yengeniso iyintela ekhishwa kubantu ngemali abayitholayo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, sinezinga elihlukahlukene lentela yengeniso eliqondene nezinga lemali etholwa. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuba kube nezinga eliphansi kubantu abathola imali encane, kanti abathola imali enkulu bahlawuliswa kakhulu. Uhlanga 4: Izinguquko kwezinga lentela Umbuzo: Zikhona izinguquko ezilindelekile kwezinga lentela? USipho: Yebo, uhulumeni uhlala ebheka indlela yokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Izinguquko zingahlanganisa ukuhlaziya izinga lentela, ukunciphisa izindleko zabantu, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezithile kubanikazi bamabhizinisi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekukhuliseni umnotho nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Uhlanga 5: Izinyathelo zokwenza ngcono izinga lentela Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela? USipho: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani, izinyunyana, kanye nabantu ngabanye. Ukuxhumana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikahle. Ukubambisana kuholela ekutheni umphakathi uqonde kangcono izinga lentela, kanti nokwazisa ngalezi zinyathelo kubalulekile. Uhlanga 6: Umthelela wezinga lentela emnothweni Umbuzo: Umthelela wezinga lentela emnothweni ubaluleke kangakanani? USipho: Umthelela mkhulu. Izinga lentela eliphezulu lingaholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo kumphakathi, okwenza kube nzima ukufaka izinhlelo ezithuthukisa umphakathi. Lokhu kuvame ukuholela ekunciphiseni kokutshalwa kwezimali nokukhula komnotho. Ngakho-ke, ukubeka izinga lentela eliphusile kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise umnotho. Uhlanga 7: Isiphetho Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubaphakathi mayelana nezinga lentela? USipho: Yebo, ngicela bonke abantu baqonde ukuthi izinga lentela akukhona okungokwezezimali kuphela, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi kumele ubambisane ukuze uphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo ngezinga lentela, ukuze abantu baqonde kangcono izimpikiswano ezihlobene nokuthola izinzuzo ezivela kulezi zinhlelo. Isiphetho Siyabonga, Mnu. Sipho Ndlovu, ngalesi sikhathi esijulile sokucacisa izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga lentela libalulekile emnothweni wethu, futhi ukuqonda kwethu konke okuhlobene nalokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga!
Amahlaya Nezimpilo Zethu Ukuqala, sithanda ukujabulisa, futhi amahlaya ayisikhumbuzo sokuthi siphile. Njengoba sihamba ezimpilweni zethu, siyakwazi ukuthi laugh is a universal language. Kodwa-ke, kukhona abanye abantu abakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya ayaphazamiseka, ayinembile, noma ngabe abathokozisi. Lokhu kwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngale ndaba — ngabe amahlaya ayisikhali esiwusizo empilweni yethu, noma ngabe kudinga ukusho ukuthi siphumelele ngempumelelo? Uma sikhuluma ngama-hlaya, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ahluka kakhulu. Kukhona amahlaya amnandi, amahlaya ahlekisayo, amahlaya aqondile, kanye nama-satire. Uhlobo lokugcina, i-satire, luwusizo uma kudingeka ukuhlambalaza imikhuba engalungile emphakathini. Njengoba umphakathi uhlala ushintsha, amahlaya aqhubeka nokuba nezinto ezithokozisayo eziphathelene nezindaba zamanje, kanti lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele ekutholeni izixazululo ezinhle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye baphikisa ngalokho okukhuluma ngama-hlaya. Bathi amahlaya angaba nemiphumela yokuhlukumeza, noma ahlambalaze abantu abathile, ikakhulukazi uma ehlekisa ngezinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kuphikisana kuyiqiniso, kodwa akukwazanga ukuphika ukuthi imishado, izinkumbulo, nezenzakalo zempilo zikhuluma ngama-hlaya, zikhuluma ngempilo yethu nsuku zonke. Amahlaya angasiza abantu ukuba baqonde indlela yokubhekana nezinkinga, ngisho noma zikhuluma ngempilo engathandeki. Ngakho-ke, uma sihamba phezulu, amahlaya akha ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kungenzeka uma sihamba ezindaweni zokuzijabulisa, izinkundla zomphakathi, noma nasemakhosini. Ukukhuluma ngama-hlaya kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana, futhi lokhu kudala inhlangano phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlangana nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, nokuthi bangakwenza kanjani ukuphila ngokujabulisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya angaba nemiphumela emihle empilweni yethu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukuhlekisa kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukucindezeleka, ukukhuthaza impilo enhle, nokwandisa ubudlelwane obuhle. Njengoba uhlekisa, unika amandla omzimba wakho, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba empilweni, umkhuba ophumelelayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uhlekisa akusiyo nje indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Sikhiphe udaba lwama-hlaya ezindabeni zethu zansuku zonke. Ngabe sikhumbula isikhathi lapho uhlekisa khona nabangani? Lokhu kuqhubeka kusisiza ukufaka izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi sihlala sikhumbula ukuthi siphilile. Amahlaya akha izikhathi ezimnandi, zikhumbuza ukuthi kumele sihleke, kungakhathaliseki izinselelo esibhekene nazo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi amahlaya angaba yindlela yokubhekana nezinto ezinzima, futhi ahlinzeka ngethuba lokubhekana nezinkinga zethu ngeso lokuhlakanipha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya awakwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukungabi nandaba maqondana nesimo esinzima. Kodwa yini engcono — ukuhlekisa noma ukuhamba phambili isikhathi sonke? Ukukhuluma amahlaya ngokubhekisela ezinkingeni zempilo kungenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi akufanele basabe ukuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Ekugcineni, njengoba siba nomcabango ngeqhaza lama-hlaya ezimpilweni zethu, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amahlaya awanqobi. Abakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya ahlambalaza, akukhona okubhekwayo kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa njengenhloso yokuhlekisa. Amahlaya alula, ahlekisayo, kanye nemishado yesikhumbuzo, okwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabanye abantu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nesineke, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhlekisa kuyinsika yokuphila. Lokhu kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sithokozise ngempela amahlaya — kakhulu. Umlando wama-hlaya ungena kulesi sikhala, futhi ngakho-ke kufanele sigcine sikhumbula ukuthi indlela esihlekisa ngayo iyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwethu. Ukuthi amahlaya angasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuqinile, okwenza impilo yethu ibe mnandi, kufanele sikhumbule njalo. Amahlaya awanqobi, kodwa akha umhlaba onothile, ogcwele uthando, umusa, nokuhlekisa. Lokhu, ngempela, kuyisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi siphile.
Izilwane Ezifuywayo: Uthando Olungapheli Izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo omuhle wokuthokozisa, uthando, nokuxhumana. Emhlabeni wethu, lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngezinkinga eziningi, izilwane ezifuywayo ziba yizithunywa ezinhle ezisiza ukunciphisa ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kubonakala ngokukhethekile uma sikhuluma ngama-pets afana nezinja, amakati, nezinye izilwane ezincane. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuveza umbono wami ngokubaluleka kokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo empilweni yethu. Okokuqala, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhulisa umuzwa wothando phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izilwane zikhombisa uthando olungapheli kum owners bazo. Uma ubheka inja, ngokwesibonelo, uzobona ukuthi iyakwazi ukujabulisa umnikazi wayo ngisho noma usuku lube mubi. Izinja zikhombisa uthando nokwethembeka, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukujabulisa. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izilwane ziba yizinsiza zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Okwesibili, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ukuhamba nezinja, ngokwesibonelo, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukujolisa emoyeni, ukugijima, nokudlala. Ukuzivocavoca kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomzimba, okwenza abantu babe nempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane zifundisa abantu ukuba babe nozwelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini lapho abantu behlupheka khona. Ukunakekela izilwane kudinga umoya wokuzithiba, okwenza abantu babe nomoya omuhle. Okwesithathu, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza umqondo wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Izilwane zifundisa abantu ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nokubambisana. Uma umuntu enezilwane ezifuywayo, ubona ukuthi izilwane zidinga ukunakekelwa, ukudla, nempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umnikazi abekezelele, ahlele, futhi asebenze ngokubambisana nezilwane zakhe. Lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu, njengoba kufundisa abantu ukuba babe nezinhloso ezihlangene, futhi lokho kukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza ubuhlakani. Ukunakekela izilwane kudinga ukuthi umnikazi abone izidingo zazo, aqonde indlela yokuziphatha kwazo, futhi akwazi ukuhlela isikhathi sokudlala. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubuhlakani, njengoba kudinga ukuthi umnikazi afunde ngezinto eziningi ezihlobene nezilwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngempilo. Nokho, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ukunakekela izilwane ezifuywayo kudinga umthwalo. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngezindleko zokudla, kodwa futhi kudinga isikhathi, uthando, nokunakekela. Abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi izilwane azitholakali kalula, futhi zidinga ukunakekelwa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilwane zihlala ziphilile, zikhululekile, futhi zikhona empilweni yomnikazi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo omuhle wokuthokozisa, uthando, nokuxhumana. Zikhuthaza impilo enempilo, umqondo wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela, nobuhlakani. Nokho, zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngakho, uma unomqondo wokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo, qiniseka ukuthi uzilungiselele kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ube nobudlelwano obuhle nezilwane zakho, futhi kuzokwenza ukuphila kwakho kube mnandi kakhulu. Ekugcineni, izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo wokujabula nokuthokozisa, kodwa zidinga umthwalo. Uma sithatha isinqumo sokuba nezilwane, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokunakekela, ukuhlinzeka, nokuthokozisa izilwane zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba siphile impilo enempilo, ethokozisayo, futhi egcwele uthando. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba acabangele ukufaka izilwane ezifuywayo empilweni zabo, ngoba zikhona izinzuzo eziningi ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono.
Umbiko Ngenhlangano Yezomthetho KwaZulu-Natal Isingeniso Kulolu cwaningo, sizobheka izindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta ezomthetho KwaZulu-Natal, sikhuluma ngempumelelo nezithiyo ezibhekene nezinhlelo zomthetho. Izinqubo zomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Ukwakhiwa Komthetho Ukuze umthetho ube neqhaza eliphumelelayo emphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi udlule ezinqubweni ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa, ukufaka iziphakamiso, nokuhlolwa kwezinhlelo zomthetho. KwaZulu-Natal, uhulumeni uhlose ukwenza izinguquko ezisemqoka ezindleleni zokwakhiwa komthetho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho uyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga Ezinzima Nokho, izinkinga ezithile zikhona ezweni lethu. Ubulungiswa buphikiswa ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, ukungabi namathuba alinganayo, kanye nezinkinga zezombusazwe. Lokhu kudala ukuthi kube nezinselelo ezinkulu zokufinyelela ezomthetho kubantu abavamile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ubulungiswa Kukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezibhekelele ukuthuthukiswa kobulungiswa KwaZulu-Natal. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zomthetho nabantu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngesimo sezomthetho, zibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde amalungelo abo, futhi baziswe ngezindlela zokuzifaka emthethweni. Ukubhekana Nezinselelo Zokwephula Umthetho Ukuze kubhekwe izinselelo zokwephula umthetho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubamba abaphula umthetho. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokubopha, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukufundisa abaphula umthetho ngethuba lokuqala. Izinhlelo zokubuyisela abantu emphakathini ziyasebenza kakhulu ekunciphiseni inani labantu abaphula umthetho. Ukubaluleka Kwezinsizakusebenza Zomthetho Izinsizakusebenza zomthetho, kufaka phakathi izikhungo zomthetho, abameli, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakala emphakathini, zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomthetho, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinsizakusebenza zibe sezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela, futhi zibe nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana. Ukwazi Ukufinyelela Kwezobulungiswa Ukwazi ukufinyelela kwezobulungiswa kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukufundisa, kanye nemikhankaso yokwazisa ingasiza ekwandiseni ukuqonda kwabantu ngezindlela zokufinyelela ezomthetho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazi lapho kufanele baye khona uma behlangabezana nezinkinga zomthetho. Isiphetho Ngaphezu kwakho konke, umthetho kufanele ube yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onokuthula, futhi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuvikela amalungelo akhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwakha umthetho, nokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona, kuzoletha ushintsho oluhle ezomthethweni KwaZulu-Natal. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zomthetho, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho uyaphumelela. Ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinsiza zomthetho ezitholakalayo kuzogqugquzela ukuqonda okukhulu nokusebenzisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ubulungiswa, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nempilo engcono. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo manje zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezizukulwaneni ezizayo, ngakho sizodinga ukuba sonke sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa.
Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wazo Empilweni Yethu Izifo ezingamahlalakhona, ezaziwa nangokuthi izifo ezihlala isikhathi eside, zibe yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wonke. Lezi zifo, ezifana nesifo sikashukela, umoya, nezinto eziningi ezihlobene, zihlala zikhona empilweni yomuntu futhi zishiya umthelela omkhulu emzimbeni nasempilweni yengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo zidinga ukwelashwa okuqhubekayo, futhi zishintsha indlela esiphila ngayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azithinti kuphela umguli, kodwa ziba nomthelela emndenini nasemphakathini. Umuntu onezifo ezingamahlalakhona ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukwelashwa okungapheli, izindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, kanye nezinguquko ezinjengokuphila kwansuku zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukusekelwa okuqinile, hhayi kuphela kumndeni, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Umndeni udinga ukufunda ukuhamba nomguli, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu iyinselele. Umuntu ophila nesifo sikashukela, isibonelo, udinga ukulawula ukudla kwakhe, ahlale eqapha amazinga akhe kashukela, futhi aqaphele impilo yakhe yonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu, futhi kungaholela ekudambiseni umoya uma umguli engatholi ukwesekwa okwanele. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze kusebenze ekwakheni izixazululo. Njengoba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhula, ziba yinkinga enkulu kwezempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izifo ezinjengokukhuluphala, umoya, nesifo sikashukela zikhula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ezifana nezindlela zokuphila, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezinga lokungasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukudla okunempilo, futhi sithuthukise imikhuba yokuzivocavoca. Nokho, akusikho konke okubi; izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Abantu abaningi baye bathola ukuthi uma bephila kahle, bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona. Ekugcineni, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu ayilula, futhi zidinga ukusekelwa okuqinile. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Izifo ezingamahlalakhona zingaba yinkinga enkulu, kodwa uma sikhuthaza impilo enempilo, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, okuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN: Ukuphila Ngaphakathi Kwemvelo Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma, izikhukhula zaseKZN ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu kulezi zinsuku. UZululand, uMkhanyakude, noThekwini, lezi zindawo ziye zathinteka kakhulu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeka kanjani? Ngizokutshela. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula zidalwa izimo zezulu ezinzima. Uhlanga lwezulu lungashintsha ngokushesha, futhi uma imvula ikhuluma, amanzi adlula emakhaya. Ukuhamba kwamanzi emadolobheni, emakhaya, nasezindaweni zokulima sekuyinto evamile. Ingabe ubona izithombe ezikhombisa amanzi adlula ezindlini? Lokhu akukhona nje okungokwemvelo; kudinga abantu bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishiya umonakalo omkhulu. Abantu balahlekelwa yizimpahla zabo, futhi abanye bahlala bephuma ezindlini zabo. Ukuphila kwabo kuncike kakhulu ekutholeni usizo. Njengoba sikhuluma, izikhungo zokuhlala zikhona, kodwa akukhona bonke abathola usizo olufanele. Abantu badinga ukuxhaswa, okudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphendula. Kodwa akukhona konke okubi. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi abantu bayazama kanjani ukusiza? Izikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, nabantu ngabanye baye bahlala bezama ukusiza. Ingabe ubona izithombe zabantu bephakathi kokusiza? Lokhu kuveza umoya wokubambisana. Uthando lomphakathi luyasivusa, futhi luthuthukisa umoya wethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yezenhlalakahle. Izikhukhula zishiya abantu bezwa ubuhlungu, futhi lokho kudinga sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile bangase babe nezingqinamba ezinzima. Ukuze sikwazi ukusiza, kudinga izinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abantu. Ingabe siyazi ukuthi izikhungo zokwelapha zingasiza kanjani? Lokhu kufanele kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubo ezinhle zokuphendula. Ukuphathwa kwezimo ezinjalo kudinga izinhlelo ezilungile. Abantu badinga ukufundiswa ukuvikela. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokweluleka, futhi lokho kumelwe kwenziwe ngempela. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeka kanjani? Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi imvula ingashintsha impilo yethu? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela abantu, kudinga izinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula zaseKZN zifundisa ukuthi impilo iyashintsha. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo. Uthando lomphakathi, ukusizana, nokubambisana kuyasivusa. Ingabe sikhumbula ukuthi imvelo iyasithinta, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela? Lokhu kudinga izinqubomgomo ezilungile, futhi lokho kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukusiza abanye. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle, futhi lokho kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo.
Umshado Nomndeni: Ukuhlola Ubudlelwano Obubalulekile Umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ziqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezimpilo zethu, zikhulisa ubudlelwano, futhi ziqinisa izimpande zomphakathi. Umshado, njengomcimbi wokuhlangana kwababili, akukhona nje kuphela ukuvuma ukuba ndawonye, kodwa futhi kuyisivumelwano sokwakha ikusasa elihlangene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umndeni ubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi kwabantu, obuhlanganisa izizukulwane ezahlukene, futhi ubonisa indlela esiphila ngayo njengomphakathi. Umshado: Isivumelwano Sokuhlangana Umshado ungumcimbi ophawulekayo empilweni yomuntu. Uqala ngokuthandana, lapho ababili behlangana, bezwa uthando, futhi besebenzisa isikhathi ndawonye ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana. Umshado awupheli lapho umcimbi uqeda; kunalokho, uqala impilo entsha, lapho abashadile bahlala bexhumene, bephokophelela empilweni engcono. Ngokwesiko, umshado uhlanganisa imicimbi ehlukene, efana nemishado yendabuko, lapho imindeni yomshado ihlangana khona ukuze ibonise ukwamukela. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umshado ube nemigomo ethile, efana nokuhloniphana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izingxabano. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umshado uthuthuka, futhi abashadile bahlala bejabule. Umndeni: Isikhungo Sokuxhumana Umndeni ungumgogodla wezimpilo zethu. Ubonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, abantwana, nezizukulwane. Umndeni unikeza uthando, ukweseka, nokukhula. Abazali banomsebenzi omkhulu ekwakheni isizinda esiqinile, lapho abantwana befunda khona izimiso zokuphila, njengokuhlonipha, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza kanzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali nabantwana bukhulu kakhulu, futhi kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Abazali kufanele babe yisibonelo esihle, bebonisa indlela yokuphila enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantwana bakhule babe ngabantu abakhathalelayo, abahlonipha, futhi abakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezinhle, zikhona izinselelo ezithile. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, izinkinga zezimali, noma ukungabi nesikhathi sokuba ndawonye kungaholela ezinkingeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile nabazali bazi ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavela, futhi bazi ukuthi zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokuxhumana. Ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Abashadile kufanele bakhulume ngokukhululeka, baphendule izinkinga zabo, futhi bahlale bephokophelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza umshado ube namandla, futhi kuzokwenza umndeni ube yindawo yokuthula. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Komshado Nomndeni Umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi sikhula, sithuthuka, futhi sithola uthando. Umshado ubonisa isivumelwano sokuhlangana, kanti umndeni ubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile. Noma zikhona izinselelo, ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuqonda, nokuhloniphana kuzokwenza umshado nomndeni ube yimpumelelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuhlonipha umshado nomndeni, siwasebenzise njengesisekelo sokwakha impilo engcono, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Umshado nomndeni akukhona nje kuphela izigameko, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze lezi zinto ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ibhola Lombhoxo: Umlando Walo Ibhola lombhoxo, elaziwa nangokuthi i-rugby, ungumdlalo owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, futhi unezinhlobo ezahlukene ezithokozisayo. Umlando walo uqala ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-19 eNgilandi, lapho abantu bezama ukuhlela imihlangano yokuzijabulisa. Ngesikhathi lapho izikole zisebenzisa imidlalo ukuze ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, umqondo wokudlala ibhola elihlukahlukene waqala ukuvela. NgokweJoseph Strutt, imiphakathi yamaNgisi yayijwayele ukudlala imidlalo efana ne-football, kodwa eRugby School, esifundazweni saseWorcestershire, kukhona okuthile okuhlukile okwenzeka. Ngo-1823, umfundisi uWilliam Webb Ellis, owaziwa kakhulu, wathatha isinyathelo esisha. Waphosa ibhola elisindayo, elalidlalwa ngamalungu omphakathi, wabe esithatha waphosa ngesandla, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemithetho emisha. Lokhu kwadala uhlobo olusha lomdlalo, olwaluhloselwe ukukhuthaza amandla, ukuhweba, nokuhlangana. Abanye abafundi baseRugby School baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zinguquko emdlalweni wabo, bathola injabulo nokwaneliseka. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokukhula kweRugby, kanti mqhudelwano eminingi yaqala ukwakheka, kuhlanganisa nezikole eziningi ezazisebenzisa indlela efanayo yokudlala. Umdlalo wakhula waze waphuma ezindaweni eziningi, waba nomthelela omkhulu ezingeni labantu abasha. Ngo-1871, kwasungulwa iRugby Football Union (RFU), okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokudlala ezizwakalayo. I-RFU yaqala ukuhlela imiqhudelwano emikhulu, okuhlanganisa amaqembu avela ezikoleni, ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, nakwezinye izifunda. Lokhu kwavusa ibhola lombhoxo, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, kukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, le midlalwano yakhula yathola imikhuba emisha, efana nemidlalo eyayihlanganisa amaqembu amabili anama-15, namathuba okwenza izigaba zomphakathi ezihlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezifundo ezikhethekile zokudlala ibhola lombhoxo, ezasiza abadlali ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lombhoxo laba usuku olwaziwa emhlabeni jikelele, kwavela amaqembu ahlukene ezizweni ezahlukene. Ngo-1900, umphakathi waba nesifiso sokwandisa umdlalo, kwavela iRugby League, eyahlanganisa izindlela ezihlukile zokudlala. Lokhu kwaholela emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu efana neNdebe yeRugby World Cup, eyaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlanganyela kwabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Namuhla, ibhola lombhoxo siwumdlalo odumile, ohlanganisa izigidi zabantu, ikakhulukazi eNew Zealand, e-Australia, eNgilandi, naseFransi. Amaqembu ahlukeneyo abamba imiqhudelwano emihle, futhi abalandeli balokhu bezizwa bejabulile, behlabelela emavikini okukhumbula amaqhawe abamba iqhaza emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu. Umdlalo usuphenduke umphakathi, lapho izizukulwane eziningi zikhula zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza emikhankasweni ethuthukisa ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Ibhola lombhoxo, njengomdlalo wendabuko, ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana, ukuphila kahle, nokuxhumana. Ubonisa ukuthi nakuba sihluka ngezizinda zethu, singaba nomphakathi ophumelelayo, okhulisa izimfanelo ezinhle, ubungane, nokuzwana. Ibhola lombhoxo akusona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, ukudala izinkumbulo, nokwakha isizwe esinamandla. Kubalulekile ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngalesi siko, ukuze siqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi, sigcine izimfanelo ezinhle zenkululeko, ubumbano, nokuhlonipha. Ibhola lombhoxo luhlaza, futhi luhlala lukhanya, lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi umdlalo nabangane bethu babalulekile empilweni yethu. Sokuqhubeka, asishiyi emuva, kodwa sikhumbule izinyathelo ezithathwe abaphambili bethu, siqhubeke nokwakha izinkanyezi ezintsha emkhakheni wezemidlalo.
Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uSipho, umfana ophuma edolobheni elincane, wathola ithuba lokuba ne-iPhone. Le foni yayiyinsiza ethokozisayo, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezobuchwepheshe. U-Sipho wayephupha ngale foni isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuhamba kwayo phambili, izici zayo ezithokozisayo, kanye nokuxhumana okungakaze kube khona. U-Sipho wayehlala ekhaya, edlala imidlalo yevidiyo, efunda izincwadi, kodwa wayephupha ngalesi sikhumbuzo esisha. Ngemva kokusebenza kanzima emasimini, uSipho wathola imali eyanele yokuthenga i-iPhone. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, njengoba le foni yayizokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabangani bakhe, futhi wayengakwazi ukulinda ukufaka izithombe ezinhle. Ngemuva kokuthenga i-iPhone, uSipho wathola ukuthi le foni yayihamba phambili kakhulu kunalokho ayekucabanga. Izithombe ezithathwe ngale foni zazicace, zikhanya, futhi zikhumbuza izikhathi ezinhle. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ungathumela imiyalezo, abhale izincwadi, futhi abuke amavidiyo kalula. Waqala ukuhamba phambili, efunda izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uSipho waqala ukubona izinselelo ezihambisana ne-iPhone. Abangani bakhe babebonisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa uSipho wathola ukuthi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabo. U-Sipho waqala ukuzizwa engaphansi, njengoba abanye bejabulile, kanti yena ezwa ubuhlungu bokungabi nalokho abanye abanakho. Waqonda ukuthi i-iPhone, nakuba iyinsiza enkulu, ayikwazi ukuxazulula zonke izinkinga. Wafunda ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo, okwenziwa ngamehlo, kungcono kunokuxhumana ngefoni. Waqala ukuphila impilo enempilo, edlala ngaphandle, ehamba nabangani, futhi ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa akufanele ibe yinto eyodwa kuphela empilweni yakhe. Waqhubeka nokusebenzisa i-iPhone, kodwa wayephinde abuyele ezindleleni zakhe zendabuko. Waqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano obuqinile nabangani bakhe, kanye nezikhathi ezijabulisayo, zibaluleke kakhulu kunokuba ne-iPhone. Ekugcineni, uSipho wathola ibhalansi phakathi kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuphila impilo enempilo. Waqhubeka nokuthokozisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa wayephinde abuyele emhlabeni wangempela, lapho ubudlelwano bukhula khona. U-Sipho waba nesifundo esibalulekile: i-iPhone ingaba yinsiza, kodwa impilo yangempela iyinhloso enkulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho wathola injabulo empilweni yakhe, eqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano, uthando, nokuxhumana okungokoqobo kuyizinto ezibaluleke kakhulu. I-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa impilo yayiyinsiza enkulu. U-Sipho waphila impilo egcwele, ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle, futhi waba nesifundo esibalulekile sokuthi ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza, hhayi umphumela. Ngakho, uSipho waqhubeka nokuphila impilo yakhe, ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle, futhi eqonda ukuthi i-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa ubudlelwano bukhula kakhulu.
U-Napoleon Bonaparte, lo mdundu owaziwayo emlandweni, uzwakala njengomuntu onemibono eminingi. Uthathwa njengomholi onamandla, kodwa futhi nokuthi ube nemiphumela emikhulu emlandweni waseYurophu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uNapoleon wazalwa eCorsica, ngonyaka ka-1769? Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila kwakhe okwandayo, lapho ahlale khona ezindaweni eziningi, eFrance, e-Itali, nakwezinye izindawo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngaye, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uNapoleon wayengumuntu ophumelelayo. Uqala njengomphakathi ojolayo, kodwa akazange ame ukuma nje; wayephusha phezulu, efuna ithuba lokuba ngumholi. Ngemuva kokuhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, waba iGeneral lezempi, futhi kamuva waba nguMongameli. Lokhu akuzange kube lula, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokulwa, izinhlelo zempilo zakhe, nezifundo azifundile empilweni bamsiza kakhulu. Okwaziwa kakhulu ngaye yizimpi aziholela, ikakhulukazi iMpi Yezwe Yokuqala. U-Napoleon wayenobuchwepheshe bokuhlela impi, futhi wayaziwa ngethuba lokwakha izinhlelo ezinhle. Kodwa-ke, akazange abe nempi eyodwa kuphela. Kwakukhona izimpi eziningi, futhi ngenxa yabaphikisi bakhe, akazange akwazi ukusinda. Uhambo lwakhe lwezombusazwe lwaluyinselelo enkulu, futhi wayesebenzisa amasu ahluke kakhulu. Ngemuva kokuphuma esigodlweni, uNapoleon wafaka imiqondo emisha emlandweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abanye babe nokuqonda okukhulu ngempilo. Ubephinde abe nomthelela emfundweni, njengoba abefuna ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zefundiso eFrance. Ngisho nasemazingeni emhlabeni jikelele, wayebonwa njengomholi onenjongo, owakha izinhlelo zokuhlela izwe. Kodwa-ke, akuzange kube lula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yokuqala, uNapoleon wahlala enezinkinga eziningi. Wayezithola ebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abuyele eFrance. Lokhu kwaze kwaba nzima, njengoba izimpi zaphinde zakhula. Kwakukhona nezinkinga zempilo, futhi uNapoleon waba nesikhathi esinzima. Kodwa uNapoleon akazange akwenze konke kube nzima; wayengumuntu ophokophelelayo. Wazama ukubuyisela amandla, futhi kwaba nezinye izikhathi lapho abaphikisi bakhe bephikisana naye. Lokhu kwaba yinto enzima, kodwa uNapoleon wayezama ukuba neqhaza emlandweni. Ubephinde abe nesithakazelo emhlabeni nasemafundweni, futhi wayebona ukuthi izwe lakhe liyadinga izinguquko ezithile. Noma kunjalo, izinsuku zikaNapoleon zashabalala. Ngemuva kokuhlaselwa phezulu, wathola ukuthi umhlaba ubunzima kakhulu, futhi izinhlelo zakhe zaphuka. Uqedele isikhathi eside lapho abelokhu esebenza, kodwa ekugcineni, waba nesikhathi sokubuyisela emuva. Iziphumo zempilo zikaNapoleon zashintsha, futhi wathola ukuthi isikhathi sakhe siphelile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNapoleon ube usuku lwakhe lokugcina eSt. Helena, lapho abehlezi khona ezinsukwini zakhe zokugcina. Kwakungesikhathi sokuhlola konke okwakwenziwe, futhi ubephinde abheke emuva ngezinkumbulo zakhe. U-Napoleon wayengumuntu onemizwa eminingi, futhi ngempela, wayengumholi owawuthanda izwe lakhe. Ubuye waba nemisebenzi eminingi emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zingakuphakamisa. Ngombono wami, uNapoleon Bonaparte ungumuntu ongakhumbulekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokuhlela impi, izifundo emfundweni nasemazingeni emhlabeni jikelele ziwusizo. Kodwa ngasohlangothini, izinkinga azihlangabezane nazo zikhombisa ukuthi ngisho abaholi abanamandla bangabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima. U-Napoleon ufakazela ukuthi impilo iyinselele, futhi ngempela, imiphumela yempilo iyashintsha.
Ezokusakaza: Umcimbi Wokuhlola Izinga Lokuxhumana Ngomhla wesithupha kuNcwaba ka-2023, umcimbi obaluleke kakhulu ezindabeni zokuxhumana, owaziwa ngokuthi "Ezokusakaza: Umcimbi Wokuhlola Izinga Lokuxhumana," wabanjwa eThekwini. Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa abaholi bezokuxhumana, osomabhizinisi, nabaculi, nangaphezulu, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejolise ekuhloleni izinguquko kanye nezinto ezintsha ezithinta umkhakha wezokuxhumana. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yephayona, uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumholi ophakathi kokwenziwa kwezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Ubonge ithuba lokuqwashisa abantu ngempumelelo yezeMidlalo Yezokuxhumana, ukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba athathe izinyathelo zokuqonda nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Uthe, "Ezokusakaza akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu." Ngemuva kwalokhu, abezindaba baphinde babamba izingxoxo ezithakazelisayo, zabhala izifundo ezitholakele kumaphrojekthi ahlukeneyo. Ucwaningo olunzulu lwashicilelwa, lukhombisa ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zenzekile ezokusakaza, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhula kwe-inthanethi nokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezokuxhumana. Okwalandelayo, umcimbi waphinde waziwa ngeminye imicimbi emincane, efana nezinkulumo-mpikiswano nezifundo ezisebenzelana nezitshudeni ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Kwakukhona amaphaneli ahlukahlukene, abakhuluma ngezihloko ezihlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokuxhumana, indlela yokuphumelela kwezokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokugcina izinsiza. U-Ramona Nkosi, umculi odumile, wabelane ngexperiences yakhe nohlu lwezinkinga ezihambisana nezokuxhumana. Uthe, "Ukubandakanya izethameli, nokwenza ukuthi zibe neqhaza kumculo, kukhulisa ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi komculi nomlistener." Lokhu kwavusa izimvo ezinkulu phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, kwavusa ukukhuluma ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, umcimbi wahlanganisa nemisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, lapho abaculi bendawo bephakanyiswa. Umculi uSipho Mthethwa, ophumelele izicoco eziningi, uphinde waba nemibono emihle ngokuqhuba umncintiswano wokuhlola amakhono abantu. Lokhu kuveze amakhono amaningi, futhi kwabavakashi ithuba lokubona ubuqhawe bendawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ugcwaliswe ngokuqhubeka nezinkulumompikiswano ezinzulu, ezibandakanya abaholi bezokuxhumana nezincwadi ezikhuluma ngempumelelo. Uhlelo lwenziwe ngothando nolwazi olunamandla, lwehla kwezinkinga ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlola kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, okwandisa imiqondo emisha kanye nezixazululo ezithinta umkhakha. Njengoba umcimbi uphetha, uMnu. Mthembu ubabaza bonke abathintekayo, abavakashi, kanye nabaculi ngokuhlanganyela kwabo. Uvuselela umoya wokuhlanganyela, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokwakha izixazululo ezinzima zokuxhumana ukuze umphakathi ube nobudlelwano obuhle. "Sihamba phambili, sihlanganyela izinzuzo, futhi sihlonipha izinguquko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwethu," kusho yena. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukuthi ezokusakaza akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Kwaba ukufunda, ukujabulisa, nokuhlanganyela, okwenza kube yinsakavukela yokwazisa abantu ngempilo yabo, izifiso, nemibono. Umcimbi ubusemthethweni, ubonakalisa izifiso zokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, nezokuxhumana. Ngalolu suku, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokubambisana, wahlola izindlela zokuxhumana eziyimpoqo. Ukuhlola izinga lokuxhumana kwavula amathuba amasha, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baziqhenye ngemisebenzi yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinsuku ezizayo zikhombisa ukuthi ezokusakaza ziyothuthuka, zikhula, futhi ziqhubeke zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wethu.
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwezimoto Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngeMphakathi, elalithokozisa abantu bayo ngezinto eziningi ezinhle. Phakathi kwezinto ezinhle, kwakukhona uHuawei, inkampani eyaziwa emhlabeni jikelele ngobuchwepheshe bayo obuphambili. UHuawei wayengumholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ethuthukisa izixazululo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kumafoni aphakeme kuya ezinhlelweni zokuxhumana. UHuawei wathola udumo olukhulu, kodwa akuzange kube lula. Izinkampani eziningi zazifuna ukuncintisana naye, zikhombisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Nokho, uHuawei wayehlale eqinile, ebheka phambili, futhi ethuthukisa imikhiqizo emisha. Isahluko 2: Ukukhula Nokubhekana Nezinselelo Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo zaphakanyiswa. Izwe langaphandle laqala ukungabaza izinhlelo zayo, lukhombisa ukungathembeki. Lokhu kwaphumela ekutheni uHuawei abhekane nezithiyo ezinzima. Kodwa uHuawei wayengakafiki ekugcineni, waphinde wathola amandla emisha. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lwakhe lwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabanye, lwahlanganyela nemiphakathi emisha, futhi lwazisa abantu ngezinto ezintsha. UHuawei waphinde wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Isahluko 3: Umphakathi Wokuxhumana Ngesikhathi uHuawei eqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano, umphakathi wathola izinzuzo eziningi. Abantu baqala ukuxhumana kalula, bezithokozisa ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. UHuawei wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, ezokuxhumana, nezokusebenza, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Izinsiza zikaHuawei zaba yisisekelo sokukhula komnotho, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa izimpilo zabo. UHuawei wahamba phambili, eqhuba izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Isahluko 4: Ukuvuma Nokubuyisela Emuva Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe, futhi izinkampani eziningi zafuna ukusebenzisana naye. UHuawei waphinde wathola ubuhlakani obuphakeme, waphendula izinselelo ezazibhekene naye. UHuawei wathola ithuba lokubuyisela emuva emphakathini, wahlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Isahluko 5: Ukubuyela Emuva Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, waphinde wabona izinselelo ezithile. Izwe langaphandle laqhubeka nokubheka uHuawei ngeso lokungathembeki, kodwa uHuawei wayehlale eqinile. Wazama ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu. UHuawei wathola izindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, waphinde wahlanganyela nemiphakathi emisha. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe. Isahluko 6: Iphupho Elisha Ngemuva kokubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, uHuawei wathola ithuba lokwakha iphupho elisha. Waqala uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. UHuawei waphinde wathola ithuba lokubuyisela emuva emphakathini, wahlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Isahluko 7: Ukukhanya Kwekusasa Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, waphinde wathola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqhubeka nokwakha izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. UHuawei waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinselelo zingavela, ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa akupheli. UHuawei wathola uthando nokuqashelwa emhlabeni jikelele, abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe, futhi izinkampani eziningi zafuna ukusebenzisana naye. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma uqinisa, ungakwenza. Isiphetho UHuawei waba yinkampani ehlonishwayo, eqhubeka nokukhula, futhi abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, uHuawei wathola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, futhi uHuawei waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma uthembekile, ungakwenza.
iBolt: Ukushintsha Indlela Esihamba Ngayo Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngifuna ukukhuluma ngento ethokozisayo, iBolt. Kukhona abanye bethu esijwayele ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abanye besebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, kodwa iBolt ithokozisa kakhulu. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani? Hhayi, ake ngikutshele. Okokuqala, iBolt iyinsizakalo yokuhamba esheshayo, futhi iyatholakala ezindaweni eziningi. Ngabe uke wayibona le app? Kulula ukuyisebenzisa, futhi ungayithola kalula ku-smartphone yakho. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuyinto enhle kakhulu, ngoba akudingeki ukuthi ube nekhadi lempahla, ungasebenzisa nje i-app yakho. Futhi, uma uthanda, ungakhetha phakathi kokuhamba ngebhasi, imoto, noma ngebhayisikili. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zethu ezihlukahlukene. Ngabe uke wazibuza ukuthi kungani iBolt ithandwa kangaka? Ngicabanga ukuthi okokuqala, izindleko zayo zikhangayo. Uma uqhathanisa nezinye izinkampani, iBolt ivame ukuba nezinzuzo ezinhle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungahamba ufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuchitha imali eningi. Futhi, uma ungumfundi noma ungumuntu osebenzayo, lokhu kuyasiza kakhulu. Kodwa akukhona lokho kuphela. I-Bolt inikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, njengokuhamba okusheshayo, okungabizi, nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezikhethekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi noma ngabe uhambo lwakho lungakanani, iBolt inezinketho ezihambisana nezidingo zakho. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungakwazi nokuhamba nabanikazi bezimoto, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngabe uke wacabanga ngokuthi iBolt isiza kanjani umphakathi? Lokhu kuyinto engiyithokozelayo. Ngokuhamba ngebhasi, abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi, futhi lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni ukungcola emoyeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi. Futhi, uma abantu behamba ngebhasi, kunciphisa nezithuthi eziningi ezisemgwaqweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezihambisana neBolt. Njengoba abantu abaningi besebenzisa le nsizakalo, kungenzeka kube nezinkinga ezithile, njengokulibaziseka. Ngabe uke waba nesikhathi lapho ubekade ulinde imoto? Lokhu kungaba yinkinga, ikakhulukazi uma ungenalo isikhathi esiningi. Futhi, abanye abantu baphawula ukuthi izithuthi azihlali zihlanzekile, okungase kube yinkinga uma uhamba ngebhasi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iBolt isebenzisa abaqashi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Abanye abaqashi bangase bangabi nekhono elidingekayo, noma bangase bangenzi kahle. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga uma uhamba, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abaqashi badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zabo zisebenza kahle. Kodwa, ngikholwa ukuthi iBolt iyinsiza ewusizo. Ngabe uke wayicabanga njengendlela yokuhamba? Uma ungakakwenzi, ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungabhalisela iBolt ukuze uqale ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi uzothola izinzuzo eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyazi ukuthi iBolt izoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Abantu bayashintsha, izidingo zethu ziyashintsha, futhi iBolt izoba yinsizakalo ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, mngani, uma usukhuluma ngale nsizakalo, cabanga ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nayo. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngiyabonga ngokulalela. Ngiyathemba ukuthi le ngxoxo ikusize ukuba uqonde kangcono iBolt. Futhi, uma uneminye imibuzo noma iziphakamiso, ngicela ungazise. Ngiyajabula ukuxoxa nawe!
I-European Union: Uhlaka Lwayo I-European Union (EU) iyinhlangano yezepolitiki neyezomnotho eyakhelwe phezu kokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe aseYurophu. Isebenza njengomphakathi ophakathi kwezizwe ezihlukene, futhi inhloso yayo enkulu ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko, ukuthula, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu. I-EU yasungulwa ngemuva kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho izwe laseYurophu lathola ukuthi kudingeka ukuhlanganisa amandla ukuze kuvinjwe izimpi ezaziholela ebuhlungwini obukhulu. I-EU yathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo, iqala ngezakhamuzi ezingu-6 ehlanganisa iBelgium, iFransi, iJalimane, iItali, iLuxembourg, neNetherlands. Lezi zizwe zazifuna ukuvuselela umnotho wazo ngemuva kwempi, futhi zathola ukuthi ukuhweba phakathi kwazo kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, i-EU yayaziwa njenge-European Economic Community (EEC), kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yanda yaba nezinhlaka eziningi ezihlanganisa izici ezahlukene zempilo yomphakathi. Namuhla, i-EU ibandakanya amazwe angama-27, kuhlanganisa iSpain, iPoland, iSweden, neHungary, phakathi kwabanye. I-EU ibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni eziphathelene nezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlalisana. Iphinde ibe nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta ubulungiswa, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezindaba zokuvikela imvelo. I-EU inezinhlaka ezihlukene ezisebenzayo, ezifana neKomidi lezeMali, iKomidi lezeMisebenzi, kanye neKomidi lezeMithetho. Lezi zinhlaka zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izidingo nezifiso zamazwe angamalungu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-EU inezinhlelo eziningi ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amazwe angamalungu athola ithuba lokukhula. I-EU ibeka izinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe zokuvikela imvelo, ezokuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi, ukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo engRenewable, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezihlala abantu. I-EU ibhekelele izinkinga ezithinta ubulungiswa, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamalungelo abantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ukubambisana kwe-EU kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe ahlukene, futhi ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ezinkulumweni zomhlaba ezithinta ukuthula, ukuvikelwa kwempilo, kanye nezindaba zokuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-EU ibhekelele izinkinga ezithinta izikhala zokuhweba, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Noma i-EU ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezithinta izinkinga zezimali, ukungqubuzana kwezombusazwe, kanye nezinkinga zokufuduka, lezi zinkinga zidinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-EU iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. I-EU iyisibonelo esihle sokubambisana, ibonisa ukuthi uma izizwe zisebenza ndawonye, zingakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuthula, intuthuko, kanye nokubambisana. Njengoba i-EU iqhubeka nokukhula, izifiso zayo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, kanye nokuthula zihlala zibalulekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngempela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-EU iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, ibhekelele izidingo zamazwe angamalungu, futhi iqhubeke nokuba yisibonelo esihle sokubambisana emhlabeni jikelele.
Ama-Social Media: Umthelela Wawo Empilweni Yethu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ama-social media asebenza njengomnyango omkhulu ohlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Njengoba sikhuluma ngama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi awawona nje ama-platforms okuxhumana, kodwa futhi ayizinkundla ezinamandla ezithinta izimpilo zethu, izinqumo zethu, kanye nemibono yethu. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukwabelana ngembono yami ngalezi zinkundla ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, ama-social media anikeza ithuba elikhulu lokuxhumana. Ngaphambi kokuba kube khona lezi zinkundla, abantu babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephila kude. Namuhla, umuntu angaxhumana nomngani osemazweni angama-10 kanyekanye, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango, izenzakalo, nezithombe. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba seduze, nakuba sikhona kude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media akhuthaza abantu ukuba babelane ngemicabango yabo, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media awanazo zonke izinzuzo. Njengoba sithola ulwazi olukhulu, sithola nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhathazeka ngempilo yengqondo sekuyinto ejwayelekile phakathi kwabantu abathola ulwazi olungapheli. Ukuphazamiseka okukhulu, ukucwaswa, kanye nokucindezelwa kungenzeka uma abantu bephendula ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungazethembi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abathola ukuthi izinga labo lokuphila lilinganiswa ngempela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media akhuthaza umqondo wokuphila okungokoqobo. Abantu bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi impilo ayilula. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile uma impilo yabo ingahambisani nalokho abakubona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Umphakathi uthola umbono ongafanele wokuthi impilo kufanele ibe yinhle njalo, okwenza kube nzima ukwamukela izinselelo ezijwayelekile. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphila kahle phakathi kwama-social media. Okokuqala, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kokuxhumana okuhle nokubi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana ziwusizo kanjani empilweni yethu. Uma sithola ukuthi izinkundla zenza sibe nezinselelo, kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuzihoxisa noma ukunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa kuzo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, ngezingozi ezihambisana nama-social media. Ukuqonda ukuthi izithombe ezithunyelwe noma imibono engafanele ingaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile futhi bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, ama-social media angaba yinsiza enkulu uma sisebenzisa kahle. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi, njengabantu, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngendlela efanele. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukujabulisa impilo yethu, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke ama-social media ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Akukhona nje ukuthi sithumele izithombe ezinhle noma sabelane ngemicabango, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, ophilayo, nolungile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukujabulisa impilo yethu, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele.
Abadlali Bebhola Abadumile: Umhlaba Wokudlalela Ubhola Ngaphansi kwelanga elikhanyayo, umhlaba ubonakala uthokozisa ngempela uma kukhulunywa ngabadlali bebhola abadumile. Lezi zinkanyezi zibhakabhaka ezinkundleni, zishaya izigigaba ezimnandi, futhi zishiya izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizokhumbuleka unomphela. Kulokhu, sizobheka abanye babezikhumbuzo ezinkulu emhlabeni wobhola, ababe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umdlalo, nokuthi baphinde bahlonishwe ngempela. U-Diego Maradona: Umphakathi Wokudlala U-Diego Maradona, owaziwa njengenkanyezi ye-Argentina, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emlandweni wobhola. UMaradona, ophumelele kakhulu ngesikhathi sakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani bokudlala bungaguqula umphakathi. Ngonyaka we-1986, waphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba, lapho akhombisa khona ubuchwepheshe obungakaze bubonwe. UMaradona, owaziwa ngempela ngama-dribbles akhe amangalisayo, waba yisithonjana sokuphumelela, futhi usenayo imithombo eminingi yokukhumbula, ehlanganisa nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo. U-Pele: Umhlaba Wokuhlonipha U-Pele, ongumfana waseBrazil, ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wobhola. Njengomdlali ophumelele, uPele waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eBrazil. Uthole ama-trophy amaningi, kuhlanganisa neNdebe yoMhlaba ezintathu, okwenza waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni jikelele. U-Pele uphinde waba umphakathi wokuhlonipha, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. U-Lionel Messi: Ubuchwepheshe Obuphakeme U-Lionel Messi, owaziwa njengenye yezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni, ubhalwe emlandweni wobhola njengomdlali ophakeme. UMessi, ophumelele izicoco eziningi, unamakhono akhangayo, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe buhlale bujabulisa izigidi zabalandeli. U-Messi ubonakale emkhakheni wobhola kusukela esemncane, futhi usaqhubeka nokukhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu eminyakeni engama-15 edlule. Uhlonishwa ngempela, futhi uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganisa neBallon d'Or, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ungomunye wabathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni. U-Cristiano Ronaldo: Umsebenzi Nokuzinikela U-Cristiano Ronaldo, ongumdlali ophumelelayo, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola. U-Ronaldo, owaziwa ngokusebenza kanzima, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni amakhono akhe. Uthole izicoco eziningi, futhi ubonakale emakhampasini ahlukahlukene. U-Ronaldo ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuzinikela nobuqotho kungaholela empumelelweni. Uthole izindondo eziningi, futhi ubona impumelelo emhlabeni wobhola, okwenza kube khona umthelela omkhulu kulabo abalandela umdlalo. U-Zinedine Zidane: Umphakathi Wokuhola U-Zinedine Zidane, ongumdlali ophumelele, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola. Njengomqeqeshi, uZidane ubonakale eqhuba izinkanyezi eziningi, futhi uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wobhola. UZidane, owaziwa ngama-goals akhe amahle, ubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eFrance. Uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi wobhola, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Isiphetho: Umhlaba Wokudlala Ubhola Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala bephakamisa umhlaba wobhola. Njengoba bephakela izigigaba ezimnandi ezinkundleni, bahlanganisa abantu, benza umphakathi ube munye. UMaradona, uPele, uMessi, uRonaldo, noZidane bangabantu abavelele, futhi imisebenzi yabo ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, abadlali bebhola bazohlala bebalulekile, futhi bazokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizohlala zikhumbuleka.
uTrevor Noah Uhlelo olukhuluma ngempilo, ubuhlakani, kanye nezimo zomphakathi, uTrevor Noah, umhumushi wezindaba, umculi, nomlobi, uzobamba umcimbi omkhulu eNingizimu Afrika. UTrevor, owaziwa kakhulu ngohlelo lwakhe lwezokuhlola, "The Daily Show," ulethe izwi elisha emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho ehlola khona izinkinga ezinzima ngendlela ehlekisayo, kodwa enobuhlakani. Umcimbi uzobanjwa eTheater eJohannesburg, lapho izinkanyezi eziningi zikhanya khona. Abantu abaningi bazobe bejabulile, behlelele ukuza ukuze baphinde bazwe uTrevor ethokozisa, efundisa, futhi edlalisa. Uhlelo luzoba nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, izinkumbulo ezihlekisayo, kanye nezifundo ezinzulu ezivela empilweni yakhe, kusukela ebuntwaneni bakhe eNingizimu Afrika, kuya ezimweni ezinzima abhekane nazo njengomuntu omnyama ophuma ezweni elinokuhlukumezeka. UTrevor Noah, owazalelwa eJohannesburg, ubonisa indlela yokuphila ehluke kakhulu. Uhlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, kodwa uthole amandla akhe ekuthuthukiseni izimo ezinzima. Umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokubona uTrevor edlulisela izifundo ezibalulekile, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, baphinde bakhuthaze abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uTrevor uthole udumo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejabulile futhi bejabulisa. Uhlelo luzoba nezingxenye ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinkulumo ezimnandi, izimvo ezijulile, kanye nezinsiza ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza abantu bacabange futhi bahlekise. Ukwazi ukuthi uTrevor Noah ungumuntu ophuma ezimweni ezinzima, uzokwenza umcimbi ube neqhaza elikhulu. Uhlanga lwezinto ezithokozisayo, izinkumbulo ezihlekisayo, kanye nezifundo ezinzulu kuzokwenza umcimbi ube yinto engasoze yalibaleka. Abantu bazobe bejabulile, behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bezokwazi ukufunda okuningi ngempilo, uthando, kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha. UTrevor Noah uzoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe izimo zikhathaza, umuntu angathola indlela yokuphila impilo enenjongo. Uhlelo luzoba yithuba lokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenhloso, baphinde bakhuthaze abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uzoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, uTrevor Noah ubonisa ukuthi kukhona ithemba. Uhlelo luzoba yithuba lokuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha. Ezokuphathwa Kwezinhlekelele: Ukuhlaziywa Nokubaluleka Kwamathuba Nezinselelo Ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, okuyinqubo yokuphatha izimo ezikahle, inqubo ebalulekile kakhulu emiphakathini yanamuhla. Le nqubo ibonisa indlela abantu, izinhlangano, nohulumeni abaphendula, bephatha, futhi besilungiselela izinhlekelele ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezikhukhula, iziphepho, izikhukhula, noma ezinye izimo eziphathekayo ezithinta impilo nomnotho.
