Ngakho-ke, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nokwanda kwezinhlekelele kwanda, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele akuwona nje umsebenzi onyaweni, kodwa kuwumkhakha wemfundo, wezobuchwepheshe noshintsho emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisebenzayo nezikhona ezitholakalayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka nokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela okuhle, ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuqinile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokufunda okuqhubekayo. Ukuhlelwa okulungile kubalulekile, ngoba kuzosiza imiphakathi ukuba ibe necebo lokuphendula ngesikhathi sezinhlekelele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okuphawulekayo, kufanele kubekwe phambili ukufundiswa komphakathi mayelana nezingozi ezahlukene, ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono ngesikhathi sezinhlekelele. Ukwesshwa kolwazi kudinga ukuzihlanganisa kwezinhlangano zomphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo phakathi kwezinhlaka zezokuphatha, izakhamizi, nabaholi bendawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangathola usizo oludinga ekushayweni kwezinhlekelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kuthanda ukuba nendima enkulu ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele. Izinkampani zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuthola ulwazi, njengokuphathwa kwedatha, indiza yamazwe, nezinqubomgomo zokuphendula, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokuphatha ezanelisayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutholeni ulwazi olukhawulelwe mayelana nezinselakheli eziphathekayo ezishayiswayo, okuholela ezifundweni ezimbalwa mayelana nezimo zempilo zenhlalo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlekelele zikhona, zikhona nezinselelo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusweleka kwezinsiza, ukuhlwithwa kwemithalo nezihlahla, kanye nengcindezi yokukhula komnotho. Imiphakathi eminingi ibhekene nezimo ezinzima zokuphila, okuholela ekutheni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele zibe nzima ukuyisebenzisela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zibe seamless, futhi ziqhathaniswe nezidingo zezakhamizi. Ukuze kuzuze ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, ukufaka iziyalezo ezikhethekile ukuze sekuhlangabezwane nezimo ezithile zezinhlale kubalulekile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganyele nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo ezisekelwe kumqondisi wokukhula, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kolwazi oluqinile kudinga ukusiza izinhlekelele. Izinhlangano zomphakathi zikhethekile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele ziqhamuka nombresho esebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze abafundi nabafundi ukuba baphendule ngobuchwepheshe kulokhu kuhlanganyela. Ngaleso sikhathi, kuzoba nokukhanya okukhulu lapho kudingeka ukuqonda okwengeziwe, kuphume lesi sikhumbuzo sokuthi izinhlekelele zenzeka, kodwa indlela esiphatha ngayo lezi zinto yunikezo lwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele kuchaza ukuzama nokuphendula ngezindlela ezilungile nezisebenzayo okuphathelene nezinhlekelele. Imithombo ibalulekile empumelelweni ekuphathweni kwezinhlakadi ezihlekisayo. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlola ukwakha izixazululo ezenzakalayo, ukukwazisa ngokubambisana, nezinsizakusebenza ezisebenzayo nasemphakathini ngokujulile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuqinisekiswe ukuziphatha kahle kweMiphakathi, nokuqinisa amandla, ukuthembana, nokuhlonipha phakathi kwazo. Izimpilo zethu, impilo yomqondo nokukhula komnotho zixhomeke kulesi sikhumba esibaluleke kakhulu, futhi akufanele siphuthume lapho izimo ziba nzima. Imininingwane ilungile, izinyathelo zifanele, okusho kuthula izinkumbulo ezinzima, kuholwa umoya omuhle, nokuqinisa amakhono ezehlakalo. Khumbula, tanzi, izinhlekelele zingase zibe yinsada, kodwa indlela yokuphatha nokuphendula izithiyo lezi isiyalela indlela yempilo yethu.
Amabhizinisi Amancane: Indaba Yempumelelo Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Leli dolobha laligcwele abantu abahlala khona, abathanda ukusizana, futhi abanesifiso sokwakha ikusasa elihle. Phakathi kwalezi zindawo, kwavela indaba ethokozisayo yokuphumelela kwamabhizinisi amancane, okwakuhlanganisa izifiso, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokusebenza kanzima. Ngonyaka owodwa, uThandi, intombazane enomoya ophakeme, wathola umqondo wokuvula ibhizinisi lokuthengisa izithelo ezisemqoka. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lwezithelo, futhi wayazi kahle ukuthi abantu badinga ukudla okunempilo. Ngakho, wanquma ukuthi uzothengisa izithelo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezinjengezithelo ezivela eMpumalanga naseNingizimu Afrika. UThandi waqala ngokuqasha indawo encane edolobheni, eyayitholakala eduze kwemakethe. Waqala ngokuthenga izithelo ezisemqoka ezivela kubalimi bendawo, eqinisekisa ukuthi izithelo azithengisayo zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemva kokuhlela kahle, waqala ukuhlela izithelo ngendlela ebonakalayo, ezithokozisayo, ukuze abathengi bakwazi ukuzibona kahle. UThandi wayekwazi ukuthi ukubukeka kwempahla kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhe igama elihle. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe liqala ukuhamba kahle, uThandi wathola ukuthi abathengi bayeza, bethi bazokuthenga izithelo ezisemqoka. Waqala ukufaka izithombe ezinhle zezithelo zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakwenza abantu bazi kahle ukuthi uthengisa ini. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abathengi baphenduka abavakashi abajabule. Kodwa, impilo ayizange ibe lula. UThandi wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuza ezindleleni zokuthutha izithelo. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho izithelo zifika zishwabene, noma zifika zikhuluma. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga, kodwa uThandi akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabalimi, eqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izithelo ezisemqoka, futhi wathola izindlela zokuthutha eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi likaThandi laqala ukuhamba kahle kakhulu. Waqala ukuthola abathengi abavela kwezinye izindawo, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhule. Waqala ukufaka izithelo ezihlukahlukene, ezinjengezithelo ezibhalwe phansi, izithelo ezivela phesheya, kanye nezithelo ezikhethekile ezitholakala kuphela ngesikhathi esithile sonyaka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe alisiyona nje kuphela indlela yokwenza imali, kodwa futhi lisenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa abantu ngokuqhuba izifundo zokudla okunempilo, lapho abathengi bangaqonda khona ukuthi izithelo zingaba kanjani yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo. Lokhu kwenza abantu baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe selikhule kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga usizo. Waqasha abanye abantu abaninzi ukuze basize, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba emisebenzi emisha. Abantu bendawo baqala ukuthola imisebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsiza enkulu emndenini nasemphakathini. UThandi waphinde wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lidinga ukwandiswa. Waqala ukucabanga ngokuqhubeka nokuthengisa izithelo, kodwa futhi wathola ukuthi angathengisa nezinye izinto ezihlobene, njengezithako zokupheka ezivela ezithelweni. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi waba nebhizinisi elikhulu elihlanganisa izithelo, izithako, kanye nezinsiza zokupheka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabanye abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane, behlanganyela izifundo, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Umphakathi waba nempilo engcono, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nebhizinisi elikhulu, kodwa akazange akhohlwe ukuthi ibhizinisi elikhulu lidinga umoya wokusebenza kanzima. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, eqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lihlala lisezingeni eliphezulu. Waqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuthengisa, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi udinga izinsiza eziningi. UThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane awanqotshwa, futhi akha umphakathi onempilo, onothando, nolwazi. Ngale ndlela, indaba kaThandi ibonisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo, futhi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza uMzimkhulu waba yindawo engcono, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela.
Ukubhujiswa Kwenziwa Ngenxa Yezimayini Ngiyanibingelela, ngithanda ukucacisa ngendaba ebalulekile ethinta impilo yethu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo zihlala khona. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izimayini zineziphumo ezinzima emvelweni? Lokhu akukhona okungaqondakali, kodwa kuyinto esiyibona nsuku zonke. Masikhulume ngalezi zimayini. Ziyindawo lapho kudingeka khona izinsiza eziningi ukuze kuqhubeke imisebenzi yokumba, okwakha izinkinga ezinkulu zemvelo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemvelo, okuvulela indlela yokubhubhisa izitshalo nezilwane. Uma umhlaba uthinteka, izitshalo ziningi ziya phezulu, kanti izilwane zihlala zikhathazekile. Ucabanga kanjani uma izimayini ziqala? Umhlaba ushintsha ngendlela engalindelekile. Izingadi zethu, izindawo ezijabulisayo, zonke ziye phansi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukubhujiswa, kodwa kudala izinkinga zempilo ezinzima. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo ezinezimayini bahlupheka kakhulu. Uhlanga lwezempilo lungaphazamiseka, futhi imiphumela ingaba yingozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngamanzi. Izimayini zikhona ezindaweni eziningi ezinamachibi, imifula, nezindawo zokugcina amanzi. Lapho kudingeka ukumba, amanzi angase aphazamiseke, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabanye abahlala kulezi zindawo. Ucabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani uma amanzi engatholakali? Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zikhula, izimayini zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile, kodwa akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi lezi zindlela zinezinselelo. Abanye abanikazi bezimayini bazama ukwenza kahle, kodwa abanye bahlala bejolise kuphela emalini. Lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabantu, izimayini, nemvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngoMhlaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ihlangene nezinhlobonhlobo zempilo, futhi uma ibhujiswa, sithola ukuthi sibhujiswa sonke. Uhlanga lwezinto eziphilayo luyahluka, futhi uma sikhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zonke zibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Sifuna ukugcina izindawo zethu zihlanzekile, futhi imithombo yethu yamanzi icace. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imvelo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela imvelo ibalulekile? Izinkampani ziyaqonda ukuthi uma ziqhubeka nokwenza izimayini ngaphandle kokucabangela imvelo, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokumba, ukuvuselela izindawo ezibhujiswe, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola imiphumela yemisebenzi yezimayini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukwakha imiphakathi yokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi imvelo iyathinteka. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo iyingxenye yokuphila kwethu. Njengoba izimayini ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ngabe sithanda ukuphila endaweni enempilo? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo iyaphila. Uma sikhuluma ngezinyathelo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zonke zibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi imvelo iyakha impilo. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Ngakho, ngabe sithanda izimayini? Yebo, kodwa kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela. Ngabe uneminye imibuzo?
Isingeniso Ezentela, okungukuthi umthetho wemali owukhipha uhulumeni ukuze uxhaso izinhlelo zosasaziso nezenhlalo, iyinsika ebalulekile yezomnotho. Kumphakathi wethu, ezentela idlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithinta zonke izingxenye zokuphila kwabantu, ezokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nemigudu yokuthuthukisa umnotho. Inhloso yokubhalwa kwalolu cwaningo iwukuhlola ukuthi ezentela zisebenza kanjani, ubuhle bazo, kanye nemiphumela emihle nephuzi engabangelwa ukuhlela kwazo. Ukwakha Uhlaka Lwezentela Ezentela zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izentela zomhlomulo, ezomnyango, nezemali. Izentela zomhlomulo, njengoba igama lisho, zikhokhelwa abantu abathola umholo, kanti ezomnyango zifaka imalini ethathwa emabhizinisini. indlela yokuhlela ezentela ibandakanya nezentela ezikhokhwayo kumanxusa nezikhali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakheka kwesigaba somphakathi nakho kudlala indima ebalulekile, njengoba abaholi bezinhlangano zezombusazwe belinganisa izidingo zomphakathi ukuze baphakamise izinqumo zokuhlela ezentela. Izizathu Zokuthuthukisa Uhlelo Lwezintela Uhlelo lwezentela lushayelwa ikakhulukazi amandla oHulumeni okuphatha. Ngokusebenzisa izimali ezitholakalayo, uhulumeni uthuthukisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko. Uhlelo lwezentela oluhle lungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okukhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga labo bophezo. Umphakathi ophilayo, owakhelwe phezu komnotho owaphumelela, ubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuphila. Ubuhle Bezintela Ubuhle bezentela bukhulu, njengoba zikhona ezinye izinzuzo ezifaka ukwakhiwa kokulinganiselwa kwemali, ukwelulwa kokubhuka kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokweseka, ezithinta izakhamuzi ezidinga usizo. Ukubhaliswa kwezintela kuhlinzeka ngendlela yokunciphisa ubumpofu, njengoba uhulumeni engathola insiza yokusebenza ukuze enze izinhlelo zokusiza. Ukuxhaswa kwezidingo eziphuthumayo, njengokwelashwa, ukudla, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi, zithuthukiswa ngezimali ezitholwe ngezintela. Ngakho-ke, ububi bokungakhokhi izintela buveza umthelela omubi emphakathini. Izinselelo Zohlelo Lwezintela Noma kube nezinzuzo eziningi, ezentela nazo zibhekene nezinselelo ezehlukene. Ukwehluleka kokuphatha kahle izimali kungaholela ezinkingeni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nokukhwabanisa okwenziwa ngezintela, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu kuhulumeni. Umthelela wezintela eziphezulu emnothweni ungaholela ekutheni amabhizinisi anciphe, okusho ukwehla kwezimali ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazimele kanye nohulumeni kungaholela ekungqubuzaneni okukhulu kancane. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokuhlola ubuhlobo phakathi kwezintela kanye nokuphathwa kwemali, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqondwe indlela ezentela ezithinta ngayo umnotho ubumbe impilo yabantu. Kufanele kube nezinyathelo eziqinile ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlela izintela. Kuze kube manje, iqiniso elibalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni kumele abambe isibopho sokwandisa ulwazi lwezintela phakathi kwabantu ukuze kuqashelwe ibhizinisi elingasebenzi kahle kanye nezinsizakalo. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa indlela ezentela ezihlose ukuba ngcono, kubalulekile ukuqonda umthelela wazo empilweni nasemnotho. Ukuhlela kahle, ukuxhumana okwanele, kanye nokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi kuyizinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni uhlelo lwezentela oluphumelelayo. Umphakathi wezwe kufanele udlale indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izintela ezisenza sibe nempilo engcono, enobulungiswa, nehlala njalo. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa okukhulu, uhulumeni angase angathembeki ekwenzenjeni ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuze umphakathi jikelele, okuholela ekuhluphekeni okungabangelwa ukungatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ezentela, kukhona inkambo yokuzihlanganisa, isikhumbuzo sokuthanda umphakathi, nokuhlola izindlela ezinjalo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuvimba izinkinga, kuhlehlisa izinqumo ezinzima esikhathini esizayo.
ISAHARA DESERT Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo, izinkanyezi ziqhakaza phezulu, zikhanya njengemibala emihle emkhathini. I-Sahara, umhlaba omkhulu wezihlahla ezincane, izihlahla ezimnyama, nezihlahla eziphilayo, yayingaphansi kwelanga elishisayo. Le ndawo, eyaziwa njengendawo enkulu kakhulu yehlathi elingaphansi kwamanzi, ibonakala iyinhle, kodwa iyingozi. Kwathi ngosuku oluthile, uThabo, umfana osemncane ohlala edolobheni eliseduzane, wanquma ukuhamba phesheya kweSahara. Wayefisa ukubona ubuhle bayo, nokuhlangenwe nakho okwakungakaze kube khona. UThabo wayenothando lokuhlola, futhi wayazi ukuthi le ndawo iyimfihlo enezinto eziningi ezithakazelisayo. Uhambo lwakhe lwaqala ekuseni, lapho ilanga lishisa kancane. Wathatha amanzi, ukudla, nezinto ezidingekayo, waphuma emzini wakhe. Njengoba ehamba, wathola izihlahla ezincane, izinyoni ezibhakabhakayo, kanye nezilwane ezincane ezijabulela ukuphila. UThabo wayejabule, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kufanele aqaphele, ngoba iSahara iyindawo enobungozi. Ngemva kokuhamba isikhathi eside, uThabo wafika endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-"Uhlanga LweMimoya." Le ndawo yayigcwele imimoya ethokozisayo, futhi izihlahla zayo zazikhanya ngombala ophuzi. Wathola umthombo wamanzi, futhi wathokozisa umoya omusha. Wazizwa ethokozile, kodwa waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe, wathi: "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukuhamba phambili?" Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo wahlangabezana nezinselelo. Izinsuku zashintsha, kwavela izivunguvungu ezinamandla, futhi umhlaba waba mnyama. Wazama ukufihla, kodwa umoya wawumshaya, wamshiya edangele. Wazama ukukhumbula izifundo azifundile, wathi: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona indlela." Ngemuva kokuhlala isikhathi eside, uThabo wathola indlela yokuphuma. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, wathola izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, ezamkhombisa indlela. Wazizwa eqinile, futhi waphuma emoyeni. Waqhubeka, wathola umhlaba omusha, lapho izihlahla zikhanya khona, futhi izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu. Ekugcineni, uThabo wafika endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-"Iphupho LweSahara." Le ndawo yayigcwele ubuhle, futhi izinkanyezi zazikhanya kakhulu. Wazizwa ethokozile, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wathi: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona izinto ezinhle." UThabo wathola abantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi waphendula izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Babemjabulisa, futhi bamfundisa ngezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enobuhle, kodwa futhi iyingozi. Wazithokozisa ngempilo yakhe, futhi wathola ubungane obusha. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uThabo waphinde wahamba emuva. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wafika emzini, wathola umndeni wakhe, futhi wabelana ngalesi sihambo esiyingqayizivele. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enezimfihlo, kodwa futhi iyindawo yokuhlola. UThabo wathola ukuthi ukuphila kuyajabulisa, futhi izifundo azifundile zamsiza ukuba abe umuntu ongcono. Wazithokozisa ngempilo yakhe, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enobuhle, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThabo waba nesifiso sokubuyela eSahara, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlola, futhi afunde izinto ezintsha. Wazi ukuthi le ndawo iyimfihlo, futhi izimfihlo zayo zikhona ukuze zifundwe. Uhambo lwakhe lwaba yindaba, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila kuyajabulisa, futhi izifundo zempilo zibalulekile. Ngakho, uThabo waphinde wacabanga: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona izinto ezinhle." I-Sahara, umhlaba wezimfihlo, yabe isiyindawo enothando, futhi uThabo waba nesifiso sokuyivakashela njalo.
Ezocwaningo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yethu Namasiko Ezocwaningo, noma i-research, ibalulekile empilweni yethu nasemasikweni ethu. Izinselelo, izimfuno, nezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngolwazi olunembile nolwakha. Ngakho, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buphakathi kwezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda ukuthi le mikhakha ihlukaniseka kanjani, ibaluleke kanjani, futhi iziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izocwaningo ukuze zibe yinzuzo kulabo ezibhekene nazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izocwaningo ziqala ngenhloso yokuthola impendulo ezinkingeni ezithile. Lokhu kuphumelela kuphela uma kudalwe izindlela eziphumelelayo. Imibuzo eminingi ibe yinqaba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, ezemvelo, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sizama ukuqonda izizathu zokwanda kwezifo ezithile, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izici eziningi – ezempilo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezomnotho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izocwaningo akukhona nje ukwenza ngezinto ezithile, kodwa kudinga ukuqonda okunembile kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngenhloso yokucwaninga. Itholakala emiphakathini eminingi ukuthi abantu bahlale bephikisana nemiphumela ethile yokucwaninga. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle, noma ukunganeliseki ngezinqumo ezithathwayo. Ukuze siphumelele ekutholeni ukwaziswa okunembile, kudingeka ukuba sithuthukise imikhuba yokuxhumana, siphinde siphinde sifundise umphakathi ngokubaluleka kwezocwaningo. Uma abantu behlale beyazi ukuthi izocwaningo ziqhuba kanjani, kuzoba lula ukuvuma imiphumela, noma ngabe ingahambisani nezinkolelo zabo zangaphambili. Kodwa-ke, kunobunzima obukhulu bokwenza izocwaningo ezinhle. Ukuze kudaleke ucwaningo olunembile, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi. Imali, izinsiza zabantu, nezinsiza zempahla zidingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo ezithile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abacwaningi bahlale benza izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi mayelana nezinto abazidingayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela omkhulu ekutholeni imiphumela ethile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ziqhubele phambili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izocwaningo zithola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izocwaningo akufanele ziqhutshelekile kuphela emkhakheni wezempilo noma wezomnotho. Kukhona umkhakha obaluleke kakhulu - ezokwakha. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ezindaweni zokwakha lungathuthukisa izindlela zokwakha ezilungele imvelo, ezisebenzayo, nezikhumbulekayo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukwakha izakhiwo ezingcono ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo olwenziwa ezindaweni zokwakha lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuhlanganisa izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokwakha. Futhi, ezocwaningo idinga ukuba ibe nobumbano. Ukwenza ucwaningo olunembile, abacwaningi badinga ukusebenzisana nabanye emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi uqobo kufanele ubambe iqhaza, ukuze uthole umbono ohlangene. Njengoba sithuthukisa imikhakha yethu, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabacwaningi, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ekutholeni imiphumela eyanelisayo. Ekugcineni, izocwaningo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile. Kuzo zonke izinkinga nezinkumbulo esibhekene nazo, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buzohola ekutholeni izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo yezocwaningo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela ayikhombisi kuphela ubuchwepheshe bethu, kodwa futhi ibonisa ukuthi singabantu abaphumelelayo uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho, asikho isidingo sokubona izocwaningo njengomsebenzi ophathekayo kuphela, kodwa njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onolwazi, nosizo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha izizukulwane ezizayo ezizokwazi ukumelana nezinselelo zomhlaba wethu.
Umlando Wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal KwaZulu-Natal, le ndawo enezinhlobonhlobo zamasiko, ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika. Umlandvo uqala ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwezizwe, lapho amaZulu, ngaphansi kobuholi bukaShaka, akha umbuso onamandla. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, ehlanganisa izizwe eziningi ngaphansi kokubusa kwamaZulu, okwakuholela ezimpini eziningi, kodwa futhi kwaba nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlanganisa izindawo eziningi. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kwekoloni, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal waphenduka. Ngeminyaka yama-1800, iNgilandi yathola izizathu zokungena kule ndawo, ikhuluma ngempilo engcono nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimpi ezinzima phakathi kwamaZulu neNgilandi, okwakuholela ekutheni amaZulu aphumelele ngamandla, kodwa ekugcineni, iNgilandi yathola ukujula kwezombusazwe. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kweNgilandi, kwavela izinkinga eziningi. Ipolitiki yendawo yahlukaniswa, futhi amaZulu akhombisa ukungavumi ukuvuma ubukhosi bezwe elisha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinkampani ezahlukene, ezazihlanganisa izimfuno zabantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Ubugebengu, ubuphofu, nokungalingani kwaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu umphakathi. Ngeminyaka yama-1940, i-ANC (African National Congress) yathola ukwamukelwa eKwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuphikisana, njengoba i-ANC yayingathandi ukugunyazwa kwezepolitiki okwakwenziwa ngamaNgisi. Uhlelo lwe-Apartheid lwaba yingozi, lwaholela ezimpini ezinzima phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene. AmaZulu abamba iqhaza elikhulu kulokhu, eba nezinhlangano ezifana ne-IFP (Inkatha Freedom Party) ezazihlanganyela ekulweni ne-ANC. Ngemva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngo-1994, KwaZulu-Natal yahlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Ukhetho lokuqala lweminyaka yama-1990 lwaludinga ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwamaZulu nezinye izizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi emisha, kodwa futhi kwavula izinkinga eziningi, njengoba izinkolelo zamasiko nezepolitiki zazihlangana. Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho kwaba yizinto ezazidingekayo. Uhlelo lwezempilo, ukufinyelela emanzini, kanye nezinsiza zempilo zaba yizinto ezazidingeka kakhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, KwaZulu-Natal yahlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Ubugebengu, ubuphofu, nokungalingani kwaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu umphakathi. Izinkampani ezihlukahlukene zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, kodwa izinkinga zazihlala zikhona. Namuhla, KwaZulu-Natal iyindawo ebalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ziyaqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa elinempilo. Nokho, izinkinga ezazikhona zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala befuna izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nempilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal ubonisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befuna ubumbano, baphikisana nezinkinga, futhi bahlala bephokophela phambili. Le ndawo iyisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, besebenzisa umlando wabo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye nezifiso zokuphila kahle zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ngakho, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal uyindida ehlobene nezinselelo, izifiso, nezifundo, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophela phambili, bephila ngokuhlanganyela, futhi bephokophela impilo engcono. Le ndaba ibalulekile, njengoba ibonisa indlela abantu abahamba ngayo, balwa nezinkinga, futhi bephokophela ikusasa elingcono.
Impi yaseSandlwana, eyenzeka ngonyaka we-1879, yenzeka ngesikhathi sokungqubuzana eNingizimu Afrika. KwaZulu, uSuthu noMfecane kwaba nezimpi eziningi, kodwa okwakuzoba yimbangela yokungqubuzana enkulu, kwakuwuhlaselo lweNgilandi. UCetshwayo, inkosi yamaZulu, wayephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuhlaselwa, elwela ukuvikela isizwe sakhe. Ngaphambi kokuqala kwempi, amaNgisi ayesezandleni, ehlela ukuhlasela amaZulu ukuze athole izinsiza. UGeneral Lord Chelmsford, owayengumholi wezempi, wathumela amabutho akhe eNingizimu Afrika, efisa ukuwaphula amaZulu. Nakuba kwakukhona ukungabaza, uChelmsford wayeqiniseka ngephumelelo yakhe. Amabutho akhe, aphakanyiswa ngamaNgisi, ayebonakala eqinile, kodwa wayengazi ukuthi ubuhlakani bamaZulu babezokwenza kube nzima. Ngenkathi izinsuku zedlula, impi yaseSandlwana yabe isiseduze. Ngempelasonto, uGeneral Chelmsford wathumela ingxenye yebutho lakhe, elibizwa nge-1st Battalion 24th Regiment of Foot, ukuze lihlole indawo. UZulu, besebenzisa ubuhlakani babo, baqonda ukuthi amaNgisi azosondela. UCetshwayo, enesibindi, wasebenzisa izindlela eziphusile zokuhlasela amaNgisi. Ngokushesha, impi yamaZulu yahlasela, yathola ithuba lokwenza impi enkulu. Ngemva kokuhlola, uGeneral Chelmsford wathola ukuthi amaZulu abambelele endaweni ethile, wacabanga ukuthi uzokwazisa kalula. Lokhu kwakuyiphutha elikhulu. Ngomhla ka-22 kuJanuwari, impi yaseSandlwana yaqala. Amabutho amaZulu, eziningi, akhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu. UZulu babebonakala benza izinto ngendlela ehlukile, bephikisa izindlela ezazijwayelekile. Ngaleso sikhathi, amaNgisi abebonakala edidekile, engazi kahle ukuthi uzokwenzenjani. UZulu bahlasela ngamandla, bejabulisa imiphefumulo yabo. Impi yabe isiyaziwa njengomlando, njengoba amaNgisi akhombisa ukungakwazi ukulwa. UZulu bahlula, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokunqoba esikhulu. UGeneral Chelmsford, ebona ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle, uzame ukuhlela kabusha, kodwa kwakusele kancane. UZulu bahlasela, bahlasela, bahlasela, futhi ekugcineni, amaNgisi abebonakala engakaze abone ukwehluleka okunjalo. Umphumela walolu suku wawungakaze ubonwe. UZulu bahlula amaNgisi, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokunqoba esikhulu. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ezulwini. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, okokuqala ukuthi amaZulu aphumelele impi enkulu, futhi lokhu kwashiya umhlaba ubheke phansi. Umlando wempimpi yaseSandlwana wawungaphezu kokuhlasela; wawungumfanekiso wokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuzimisela. UZulu babenamandla, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izimo zishintsha, umoya wesintu awupheli. UGeneral Chelmsford waphinde wathola ukuthi ubuhlakani bamaZulu abukhona kuphela emhlabeni, kodwa bukhona nasemoyeni. Ngemuva kwempumelelo, uCetshwayo wathola ukuthi impi ayizange iphele. Kwakukhona izinselelo eziningi ezazilindele. Kodwa, impi yaseSandlwana yabe isikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma ubuhlakani bukhona, akukho okungatholakali. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi bahlala bephila impilo yabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zempilo zabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, impi yaseSandlwana yaba yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu, futhi izifundo zayo zaphinde zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile emlandweni wempucuko. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esingasoze sakhishwa emlandweni, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi ezivamile. Ngakho-ke, impi yaseSandlwana yabe iyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando, futhi ibonisa ukuthi, uma ubuhlakani bukhona, akukho okungatholakali. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi bahlala bephila impilo yabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zempilo zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esingasoze sakhishwa emlandweni, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi ezivamile.
UNelson Mandela Nomlando Wenkululeko UNelson Mandela, owaziwa njengomholi ophambili emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika, ungumfanekiso obalulekile emlandweni wenkululeko. Ubulili bakhe, ubudala, kanye nezimo ezithile zempilo yakhe zamenza waba yisibonelo esihle sokuzinikela, uthando, kanye nokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. UMandela wazalwa ngo-18 Julayi 1918 eMvezo, eMpuma Koloni, futhi wakhulela emndenini owawuhlonipha izinkolelo zamasiko nezokholo. Ukwaziwa kukaMandela kwanda ngesikhathi esebenza njengomfundi e-University of Fort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abaholi abanjengoWalter Sisulu noOliver Tambo. Lezi zinkanyezi zaba yisisekelo sokwakha umbono omusha wokulwa nobandlululo, okwakuhlosiwe ukuvuselela amalungelo abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMandela wathola umsebenzi njengomeluleki wezomthetho, kodwa akazange akhumbule ukuhlala ethule. Waqala ukujoyina i-African National Congress (ANC) ngo-1944, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukulwa ngokusemthethweni. Ukwakha umkhankaso wokulwa nobandlululo kwaholela ekubeni uMandela abe yisikhumbuzo sokuzimisela. Ngonyaka ka-1960, ngemva kokubulawa kwabantu eSharpeville, uMandela waba ngumsunguli weMkhonto weSizwe, umkhankaso ophikisana nezinqubomgomo zobandlululo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aboshwe ngo-1962, lapho wahlala khona ejele iminyaka engama-27. Noma kunjalo, le minyaka ibiyisikhathi sokucabanga, sokuhlola, nokwakha amasu amasha okuphikisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokuphila kwenkululeko, futhi imizamo yakhe yokukhulisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bamaZulu, abamnyama, nabamhlophe yathuthukisa umqondo wokubumbana. Ngonyaka ka-1990, ngemva kokukhululwa ejele, uMandela waba ngumholi ophambili emzabalazweni wokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, enobulungiswa. Ukuphumelela kwakhe ekutholeni inkululeko kwaholela ekubeni abe nguMengameli wokuqala omnyama weNingizimu Afrika ngo-1994, lapho ahola khona uhulumeni obumbene. Ukwamukela uMandela njengomholi wezwe akukhombisi kuphela impumelelo yakhe, kodwa futhi kukhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezenzeke eNingizimu Afrika. UMandela waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho noma ubunzima bujabulisa, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinkolelo zabo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi, uMandela waba yisikhumbuzo sokubambisana, uthando, nokuxolelana. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, baphile ngokubambisana, futhi baphile ngokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe ukuvuselela umnotho, imfundo, nezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umlando kaNelson Mandela ungumlando wenkululeko, umqondo wokuthi abantu banelungelo lokuphila ngaphandle kokucwaswa. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. UMandela waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zawo uma ubambisana, futhi lokhu kuhlonishwa kuzoqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandela waba yisithonjana emhlabeni jikelele, futhi imizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa yathuthukisa izinkolelo eziningi. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ukuze sithole inkululeko, kufanele sihlale sizimisele, sikhuthazelele, futhi sibe nesibindi. UNelson Mandela, ngempela, ungumholi ongasoze wakhumbuleka, futhi umqondo wakhe wenkululeko uzohlala ungena ezimpilweni zethu. Ngokuphetha, uNelson Mandela ungumfanekiso obalulekile emlandweni wenkululeko, futhi imizamo yakhe yokulwa nobandlululo izohlala ibalulekile. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. UMandela waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zawo uma ubambisana, futhi lokhu kuhlonishwa kuzoqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ukuze sithole inkululeko, kufanele sihlale sizimisele, sikhuthazelele, futhi sibe nesibindi.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha: Izinyathelo Zokuhamba Ngempumelelo Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda, ukulungiselela, nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezihambisana nalokhu. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile ezidingekayo ukuze uqonde kahle le nqubo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukukhulelwa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwenzeka kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazi ukuthi umjikelezo wesikhathi sokukhulelwa uqala kanjani. Umjikelezo wesikhathi sokukhulelwa uqala ngosuku lokugcina lokukhulelwa, lapho umjikelezo wesikhathi uqala khona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqonde kahle izinsuku ezithile lapho ukukhulelwa kungase kwenzeke khona. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ngaphambi kokuba uqale uhambo lokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuba uxhumane nabazali noma abantu abadala abanolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ngale nqubo, izinselelo ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezindlela zokuzilungiselela. Abazali bangakunika izeluleko ezibalulekile ezizokwenza uqonde kahle imizwa nezimo ezihambisana nokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuzilungiselela Ngempilo Ukukhulelwa kudinga umzimba ophilile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuzilungiselela ngokudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi udla ukudla okunothe ngama-vithamini, amaminerali, kanye nezakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula emzimbeni wakho ukwakha indawo efanele yokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Impilo Yezokwelapha Ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuvakashela kudokotela ukuze uhlole impilo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo jikelele, ukuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, kanye nokuhlolwa kokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle isimo sempilo yakho, futhi kudinge izinyathelo ezithile uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqonda Izinketho Zokukhulelwa Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokukhulelwa, futhi kubalulekile ukuzazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhulelwa ngokwemvelo, ukukhulelwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokwelapha, noma ezinye izindlela. Qonda ukuthi yiziphi izinketho ezitholakalayo, bese ukhetha leyo ehambelana nezidingo zakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nomlingani Uma usukhuluma ngokuqhubeka nokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuba uxhumane nomlingani wakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba nokuqonda okuhle phakathi kwenu. Khuluma ngezifiso zenu, izinselelo, kanye nezinto ezithokozisayo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kule nqubo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubheka Izimpawu Zokukhulelwa Uma usuhamba phambili, qaphela izimpawu zokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhamba kancane, ukuvuvukala, noma izinguquko emzimbeni. Uma uzwa lezi zimpawu, kubalulekile ukuthi uvakashele udokotela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukukhulelwa kuyenzeka. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuphatha Imizwa Ukukhulelwa kungaba nemizwa eminingi, okuhlanganisa injabulo, ukukhathazeka, noma ukungaqiniseki. Kubalulekile ukuphatha le mizwa ngendlela efanele. Thola izindlela zokuzithokozisa, njengezokuphumula, ukuzivocavoca, noma ukuxhumana nabangani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 9: Ukulungiselela Ukubeletha Uma usukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuqala ukulungiselela ukubeletha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda ngempilo yengane, izindlela zokubeletha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi ube necebo lokuthi uzokwenza kanjani uma isikhathi sokubeletha sifika. Isinyathelo 10: Ukubamba Umoya Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukubamba umoya. Ukukhulelwa kuyinqubo ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ingaba nezinselelo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazithokozisa, futhi ungazikhathazi kakhulu ngezinto ezingalungile. Ukubamba umoya kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuhamba ngempumelelo ekukhulelweni kwentsha. Khumbula, le nqubo iyingxenye yokukhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuyithokozisa. Hamba phambili ngokuqonda, uthando, nokuhlonipha, futhi uzokwazi ukuhamba kahle kule nqubo ebalulekile.
Impilo Yaselokshini: Umlando Wokuphila Kwezingane Ngaphezu kweminyaka engamashumi amabili edlule, impilo yasemalokshini yathola ukunakwa okukhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Izindawo ezibizwa ngamaTownships, ezakhelwe ngemuva kokwahlukaniswa, zaba nezimpawu ezenza zaziwe, ziqhakambisa umlando wobunzima, nokuphila kwamaNtu. Nakuba impilo kulezi zindawo ibinzima, izici ezifana nothando, umndeni, nemigomo yokuphila ngcono zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyisayo. Uhlanga lwezindawo zokuhlala lwakha imiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Abantu bebehamba ngezinyawo, besuka emsebenzini, behamba bephuma ezindaweni zokuhlala ezimnyama nezihluphekayo, ukuze baqhubeke nokuphila. Izikole zazingekho kahle, kodwa zazigcwele abafundi abanomdlandla, ababephupha ngekusasa elikhanyayo. Nokho, impilo yaselokshini ibivame ukuphathwa ngokuqhekeka nokudabukisa. Abantu babebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengokungabi nezinsiza, ukushoda kwemisebenzi, nokunye okukhathazayo. Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1980, izibhelu zokuqala zenzeka eTownship, lapho abantu bephakamisa izwi labo. Lokhu kwaba yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ukuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezahlukene zakhula, zihlanganisa abaholi bendawo abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Izinsiza ezibizayo, izinhlelo zokuhlala, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zaba yindlela yokuphikisana nezinqubomgomo zokuhlukaniswa. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, abahlali bezindawo zokuhlala baqhubeka nokwakha izindlela zokuphila. Izimakethe zamahhala, izinhlelo zezenhlalakahle, nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlobene nezobuciko, ezokungcebeleka, nezindlela zokukhuthaza ubuhlakani. Umculo, ubuciko, nemidlalo zaba izindlela zokudlulisa imiyalezo, nokukhumbuza abantu ngezimo abaphila ngaphansi kwazo. Nokho, ukuphila eTownship akukaze kube lula. Imiphakathi ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokushoda kwezimali. Izinsiza zomphakathi ezifana nezibhedlela, izikole, nezindawo zokudlela zaba ngethuba, kodwa zazingabi nazo zonke izidingo. Abantu bahlala bezama ukujolisa izifiso zabo, begxila ezinhlelweni ezicacile, ukuze bakhe impilo engcono. Abesifazane bahlala bephambili emizweni yokwakha impilo engcono. Babanamandla okuba izinkanyezi ezikhanyisayo, bekwenza kube lula ukuthi imiphakathi ibonakale. Izinkulumo ezibandakanya izifundo, imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa, nezinhlelo zomphakathi zakhula ngokusimeme, zaziwa kakhulu. Abesifazane bahamba phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izifundo zokuqwashisa ngempilo, ukulwa nezinsizwa, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Nakuba bephila ezinkingeni, abantu bahlala bethanda impilo yabo yaselokshini. Izingane zidlala ezitaladini, zikhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo. Ubuqhawe obuqhubekayo bukhanya njalo; imiphakathi iyazama ukuphila, nakuba izimo zingezinhle. Izinyanga ziya zihlaba, kodwa umoya wokuphila uqhubeka, ungapheli. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu baselokshini bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo, bephila ngokukhuthazela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo zokuhlala zathuthuka zaba nethuba elingcono. Ubuqhawe bokuhlala, ukuthuthukisa izindawo, nezinqubomgomo ezihloniphekayo, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo ezinjengamaTownships zaba nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, izikole ezinhle, nezinsiza ezithuthukile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni impilo engcono, kulandela izifiso zabantu. Ngokubheka emuva, impilo yaselokshini ibonisa indlela yokuphila eqhubekayo, ejulile. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, impilo yaselokshini iyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando wethu, ibonisa amandla, uthando, kanye nesibopho sokuphila. Iziqhamo zalesi simo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba izimo zingaba nzima, abantu bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Izimpilo zabo zibe yizifundo ezinhle, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudlula izithiyo futhi sithole impilo engcono.
Ukutshala Izingadi: Imibuzo Nezimpumelelo Umbuzo 1: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngilungiselela ukutshala ingadi? Ukulungiselela ukutshala ingadi kuqala ngokukhetha indawo efanele. Kubalulekile ukuthola indawo enelanga enomhlabathi onempilo. Uhlanga akufanele lube nezinsalela ezinkulu noma ubunkulunkulu obukhulu. Ngemuva kokukhetha indawo, hlanza ibanga, ususe noma yiziphi izithako ezingezinhle, ezifana nezihlahla ezindala nezimpande eziphukile. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zemifino ezilungele ukutshala? Izimfino ozikhethayo zingancika ebudleleni bakho nasemikhiqizweni ofuna ukuyithola. Ezinye zezizitshalo ezilula ukutshala zifaka phakathi u-garlic, u-pepper, u-tomato, no-cabbage. U-garlic uthandwa kakhulu ngoba unamandla okuvikela ezinye izitshalo, futhi ungashiywa phansi isikhathi eside. U-pepper, onjengokuthanda, uhle kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo. Umbuzo 3: Ingabe kudingeka ukubulala izilokazi noma ezilwane ezingafuneki? Yebo, kubalulekile ukulawula izilokazi. Izilokazi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emangcwabisweni akho. Umzamo wokuvimbela izilokazi ungaba nempumelelo enkulu. Ungasebenzisa izindlela zemvelo, njengokukhulisa izitshalo ezivimbela izilokazi, njengezimbali, noma usebenzise izinto ezitholakala ngokwemvelo ukugcina izilokazi kude. Umbuzo 4: Yini engiyidingayo ukuhlinzeka izitshalo zami? Izitshalo zidinga amanzi, ukukhanya, nomhlabathi onempilo. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola umquba omuhle ukuze ukhulise imifino. Ubudlelwano phakathi kokwabiwa kwamanzi nokukhanya busebenza ngendlela efanayo; udinga ukufaka amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe izitshalo zidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikhule kahle? Yebo, izitshalo zidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikhule kahle. Hlanganisa umquba noma umquba wokhuni bese ufaka emhlabathini. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukukhulisa imiphumela emihle. Uchwepheshe uthi, ukungabi nembilibe kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka umphumela omuhle emhlabathini. Umbuzo 6: Ngingawathanda kanjani amahlanu amabili abhekise esigabeni sokulungiselela umhlabathi? Ukulungele ukusebenzisa amahlanga amakhulu kuzeka amanzi emhlabathini kufanele kube uhlelo olujwayelekile. Ungabeka amakhilomitha amancane, ungasebenzisa into efana nemithombo yokuwasha, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungawukwazi ukusebenza ngezinsizakalo zezitshalo. Umbuzo 7: Yikuphi ukutshala okungafanele bank-bay? Izitshalo ezithanda izindawo ezinemvula, ezifana ne-nasturtium, lungasebenzi kahle uma zifakwe endaweni engajwayelekile. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nobunzima ekutshaleni. Umbuzo 8: Ngingakuthola kanjani ukusiza kwabanye uma ngisahlanza ingadi? Hamba ujolise ekutholeni olunye usizo emizamweni yokuthwala izingadi. Unezinkundla ezahlukahlukene ezifana ne-microgreens, ezithinta umhlaba. Ukubhalisela izingadi zakho zokusiza kungaba yindlela yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe ukudla okutshaliwe kungafana nomsebenzi wakho? Yebo, lokhu kudla okwenza umphumela ophilayo kudala umphumela omkhulu. Ungafaka imifino, izinhlanzi ezithombile, nezithako ezinamanzi. Ubulili bemifino bubandakanya izindlela ezilungile zokwakha amafushane amancane ukuze uthole imiphakathi ehlelekile. Umbuzo 10: Kukhona isikhathi esikahle sokutshala? Yebo, kunezikhathi ezifanele zokutshala, njengenkathi yokuqala yasehlobo, nesikhathi sokuthola ukutshala. Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, unganquma izimfuno zenhlanga nezinhlelo ezisemqoka. Isiphetho: Ukutshala izingadi akuwona umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kudinga ubuchwepheshe. Ukuba nekhono elithile nokuhleleka kuhlanganisa izinyathelo eziphumelelayo. Qhubeka uphumelele kuzo zonke izingadi ozitshala, futhi uvumelekile ukusabela kuzo zonke izidingo zakho!
Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukukhanya Nokuqhubeka Kwezemfundo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivivinyo zibe yisigaba esibalulekile empilweni yabafundi, zikhombisa imizamo yabo, ubuhlakani, kanye nezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Ngalesi sikhathi, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibikade ibhekwa ngamehlo abukhali, njengoba abafundi, abazali, kanye nothisha bekulindele ukwazi ukuthi imizamo yabo ibiyimpumelelo noma cha. Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe uMnyango Wezemfundo, imiphumela yezivivinyo zonyaka ibonisa ukuthuthuka okukhulu emiphumeleni yabafundi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngempumelelo yokuthuthukisa izinga lemfundo ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izifundo, olwakhiwe ngonyaka odlule, luthole impendulo enhle, njengoba abafundi abaningi bephumelele kakhulu. UJohn Mthembu, umphakathi wesikole esiphakeme eMgungundlovu, uthe: “Siyajabula kakhulu ngale miphumela. Abafundi bethu benze kahle, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa izifundo ibiyimpumelelo.” UJohn uthe, izifundo ezithuthukisiwe, ezihlanganisa izifundo ezikhethekile, zibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwandiseni ulwazi lwabafundi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi kunezindawo ezidinga ukunakwa. Ezinye izikole zikhombisa izinga eliphansi lokuphumelela, okukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona izinselelo ezithile. UProf. Thandiwe Nkosi, umeluleki wezokufunda, uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise izikole ezikhombisa izinga eliphansi. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nohulumeni.” Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izikole eziphansi luhloswe ukusiza abafundi abaneziqhamo eziphansi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa othisha ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi abafundi abaningi baphumelele emathubeni okuthola izifundo eziphakeme. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfundo iyindlela ebalulekile yokuphumelela empilweni. UThandiwe, umfundi ophumelele, uthe: “Ngiyajabula kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngiqhubeke nokufunda, ngifuna ukufinyelela emaphusheni ami.” Uhlanga lwezivivinyo luhlinzeka ngenkundla yokuhlola imiphumela, kodwa futhi luhlinzeka ngethuba lokubheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa imfundo. Uhlelo lokubuyekeza imiphumela luzosiza ekutholeni izifundo ezitholakala ezivivinyweni, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokufunda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphumela yezivivinyo izoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imfundo iyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Abafundi, abazali, nothisha badinga ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempumelelo. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imfundo luhloswe ukusiza bonke abafundi, ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi imfundo iyisikhali esinamandla. Abafundi badinga ukwazi ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma, futhi imiphumela iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza kahle. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imfundo luhloswe ukusiza bonke abafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlola, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokubheka indlela esihamba ngayo, nokuthi singakwenza kanjani kube ngcono. Imfundo iyindlela yokukhulisa amathuba, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuyisebenzisa ukuze sithole impumelelo.
Ubugebengu Emiphakathini: Uhlolojikelele KaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophuma emiphakathini ehlukene, futhi izimpilo zakhe zikhombisa izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithile ezisemadolobheni. Ubonile ukuthi ubugebengu buphazamisa ukuthula nokuphepha kwabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezithwele kanzima. Ekhuluma ngokukhula eThekwini, uSipho waqala ukuqonda izimo ezinzima abantu abaphelela kuzo, futhi lokhu kwaqhubekela phambili empilweni yakhe. U-Sipho, osanda kuphothula izifundo, wathola umsebenzi wokuba umfundisi wezokuphepha emphakathini, lapho efuna ukusebenzisana nabantu bendawo. Njengoba efundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuzivikela, waqonda ukuthi ubugebengu abuthinti kuphela abantu ababi, kodwa buphinde buthinte nemindeni, izingane, kanye nemiphakathi yonke. U-Sipho wakhuthazwa ukuba abe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi, efuna izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ubuhlungu obuvela ekuhluphekeni kubonisa izimbangela eziholela ekwenzeni ubugebengu. U-Sipho uqonde kahle ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlala ezimweni ezinzima, futhi umnotho omubi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, kanye nobubha, kuhloswe ukuvusa izinqumo ezingezinhle. Waphawula futhi ukuthi ukuvikeleka komphakathi akupheleli ezinsizeni zomthetho, kodwa kudinga ubambiswano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Waqala imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bendawo, lapho ababehlanganyela khona izinkinga zabo neziphakamiso. Lezi zinhlelo zakhombisa izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezifana nemicimbi yokufundisa, ukusiza abasha ukuthola imisebenzi, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola izindlela eziningi eziphumelelayo zokulwa nobugebengu. Wabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokwakha umphakathi, ezazihlanganisa abantu abakhethiwe, izikhulu zomphakathi, nabantu abathintekayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuxhumana, futhi kwaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyakha isithunzi esihle. U-Sipho wanikela isikhathi sakhe emisebenzini yokubambisana, futhi uzitholela umoya ophakeme emsebenzini wakhe. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. U-Sipho ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, njengezinkinga zokubandlululwa phakathi kwamanye amaqembu, nokuqonda okungafanele phakathi kwabantu. Ngenkathi efaka imizamo yokuxhumana, wathola ukuthi abanye abantu besadla umhlane ekuthembeleni ezinhlelweni ezazenziwa. Lokhu kwaba buhlungu, kodwa uSipho wathola ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima kufanele kube yindlela yokuphendula. U-Sipho uqhubekile nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obukhona ukuze aqinise imiyalezo yokuxhumana. Waqala izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo phakathi kwemiphakathi, ngoba wabona ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuxhumana kahle. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, uSipho wathola ukuthi izinguquko ezincane ziqoqwa ukuze kube nezinto ezinkulu. Ubugebengu buncipha, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinzuzo zokusebenza ndawonye. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuba khona kwakhe emiphakathini, okukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphela, kodwa izinselelo zokuqhubeka zihlala zikhona. U-Sipho ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi umuntu angakha imiphakathi ukuze kube nezinguquko. Ubugebengu abukhona nje kuphela empilweni yomuntu, kodwa buphindaphindiwe emiphakathini. U-Sipho usenkundleni yokubuyisela umphakathi, nokwakha isithunzi esihle sesizukulwane esizayo. U-Sipho Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamandla okwenza umehluko. Njengomfundisi, umkhankaso wakhe wokulwa nobugebengu ubonisa indlela yokubambisana, ukuhlela, nokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngomoya omuhle, u-Sipho uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze akhuthaze uthando, ubumbano, nokuphepha emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenza uSipho abe yisibonelo esihle, ebonisa ukuthi, nakuba ubugebengu bukhona, imiphakathi ingathola izixazululo eziphumelelayo uma abantu benza umsebenzi omuhle ndawonye.
Usain Bolt: Umgibeli Ohlonishwayo Emhlabeni Wokugijima UUsain Bolt, owazalwa ngomhlaka 21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eTrelawny, eJamaica, uyisibonelo esihle sokuphumelela emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Ubulili bakhe, ubuhlakani bakhe, kanye nesifiso sokuphumelela, konke kumenze waba yisithonjana esihamba phambili emhlabeni wokugijima. Usain, owaziwa kakhulu ngophawu lwezikhala, uqale ukujolisa abantu emhlabeni ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinzima ezifana ne-100m ne-200m. Ubulunga bukaBolt buqala eminyakeni eminingi edlule, lapho aqala khona ukuzikhandla futhi efuna ithuba lokukhombisa amakhono akhe. Ngonyaka we-2008, uBolt waphakanyiswa washiye umhlaba udana ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni weziMidlalo zeMidlalo yaseThunazi, lapho akhiphe khona irekhodi elisha le-100m elingu-9.69 seconds. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuqala sokuthi uBolt ungumgibeli oyingqayizivele. Ngemva kwalokho, wahamba wahola kumqhudelwano omkhulu, ethola izindondo eziningi zeGold Olympic, izindondo eziphakeme kakhulu emhlabeni wokugijima. Ngaphezu kokuba umgibeli ophumelele, uUsain Bolt ungumholi omkhulu emkhakheni wezokugijima. Ubuye waba nokuzimela okukhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo zakhe, ethola izikhangiso eziningi kanye nezivumelwano zokuqashwa nezinkampani ezinkulu. Ubuye waba nguMphakathi, ehlanganisa imikhankaso yokusiza abantwana kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo ezikoleni. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uBolt akagibeli nje kuphela kodwa uphinde abhekelele izidingo zomphakathi. UUsain Bolt uzinze emhlabeni wezemidlalo, futhi ukwazi kwakhe ukujabulisa izigidi zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni ubuhlobo phakathi kweJamaica nezinye izizwe, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo. Ubuye wagqugquzela amalungu amasha emhlabeni wokugijima ukuba aphile impilo enempilo futhi azikhandle ukuze afinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ubulungiswa bakhe nokuzinikela akubonisi kuphela ekugijimeni, kodwa futhi nakwezinye izici zokuphila. UUsain Bolt uveze ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthokozisa kanjani emithonjeni emisha. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu kulabo abathanda ukuzijabulisa ngemidlalo, ikakhulukazi abantwana. Ngempela, uBolt uyinkanyezi enkulu eqhubekayo nokukhanya emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Ubulungiswa bakhe emqhudelwaneni, umoya wakhe ophila, nokuzimisela kwakhe, konke kumenza waba yisigaba esihlonishwayo, futhi akukhona nje kuphela emhlabeni wezemidlalo kodwa nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. UUsain Bolt uqhubekile nokuba yisibonelo esihle sokuphumelela, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele phambili. Ukuba khona kwakhe emhlabeni wezemidlalo kuzokhunjulwa njalo. Usuku lokugcina lokugijima kwakhe, owawuqedwa ngoMgqibelo, ungobunye bezinsuku ezikhumbulekayo, lapho abalandeli bethu behamba phambili bephakamisa izithombe zikaBolt, bezibonisa imizwa yokuhlonipha. Ngokuphetha, uUsain Bolt ungumgibeli onguye owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, onomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezokugijima, owahlinzeka ngothando, umoya, nokuzinikela. Uyenze umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi lapho umhlaba ubona izinhlonipho ezinjalo, uUsain Bolt uzohlala engumgibeli ophumelele, onobuntu, ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo ayikhona nje kuphela ngemijaho, kodwa futhi kuyi-journey yokuphila lapho ubumqoka bukhona, nokuthi wonke umuntu angafinyelela izinjongo zawo uma enza kahle, efuna ukufinyelela empumelelweni.
Umshado Nomndeni: Indaba Yomlando Umshado, njengomcimbi obalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ubalulekile emiphakathini eminingi. Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe uhambo olujulile emlandweni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umshado akukhona nje kuphela ukuxhumana phakathi kwababili, kodwa futhi kuyisixhumanisi esiqinisa imindeni, imiphakathi, nezinkolo. Ekuqaleni, umshado wawuhlonishwa kakhulu, futhi wawuhlanganisa izinkolelo namasiko ahlukahlukene. Emazweni amaningi, umshado wawuhlinzekwa ngamalungelo nezibopho, okwakuhlanganisa imindeni emibili. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha imindeni eqinile, lapho abantwana bephuma khona, beshaya izinyathelo ezilandelayo emlandweni. Ngokwesibonelo, emiphakathini yamaZulu, umshado wawuhlanganisa izinkanyezi eziningi, ezazihlanganisa imishado yesintu, imishado yezinkolo, kanye nemishado yezenhlalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokwenza umshado zashintsha. Kwamanye amazwe, umshado waba yinto ethokozisayo, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibhakabhake imishado emikhulu. Emazweni amaningi, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha izinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlela imishado, okwakuhlanganisa izinsiza eziningi, kusukela ezindaweni zokuhlala, izipho, kuze kube nezinsiza zokudla. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umshado ube yinto ebizayo, kodwa futhi ube yinto ethokozisayo. Emiphakathini ethile, umshado wawuhlanganiswa nezinkolelo ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, emiphakathini yamaXhosa, umshado wawuhlanganiswa nemikhuba ethile, efana nokuhlonza izinsiza ezithile nezimfanelo zomuntu ofuna ukushada. Lokhu kwakuholela ekwakheni umshado onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho umyeni nomkakhe benza izivumelwano ezithile ukuze bagcine ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umshado waba nempilo ehlukile. Ekuqaleni, umshado wawuhamba nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinkolweni. Kwamanye amazwe, umshado wawuhlotshaniswa nezinkinga ezinkulu, ezifana nezimpi, izifo, kanye nezinguquko zezombusazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinselelo ezinzima, futhi umshado waba yindlela yokugcina ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka emshadweni. Izinkampani ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, ezihlanganisa izinsiza zokuthenga, izindawo zokuhlala, kanye nezinsiza zokudla. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemishado emikhulu, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibhakabhake imishado emikhulu. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zashintsha indlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo ngempilo yomshado. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umshado waba yindlela yokwakha imindeni eqinile, lapho abantwana bephuma khona. Imindeni yathola amandla okukhulisa abantwana, futhi umshado waba yindawo yokufundisa izimiso ezibalulekile. Abazali babefundisa izingane zabo ukuthi umshado uyisibopho, futhi kufanele uhlonishwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni imindeni enobudlelwano obuhle, lapho abantwana bephila khona ngaphakathi kwemikhuba ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umshado waba yindlela yokuhlanganisa imiphakathi. Emazweni amaningi, imishado ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bephila khona ngokuhlanganyela. Umshado wawuhlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Umshado unikeza abantu ithuba lokwakha imindeni eqinile, futhi uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhula komphakathi. Nokho, kumele sihloniphe izinkolelo nemikhuba ehlukahlukene, ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi umshado ungenza kanjani umthelela empilweni yethu. Umshado awuwona nje umcimbi, kodwa uyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando wethu, futhi kufanele siwuhloniphe. Ngakho-ke, umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezihambisana, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, sihlinzeke ngothando, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imindeni yethu iqinile. Umshado ungumthombo wothando, ubudlelwano, kanye nezinselelo, futhi kufanele siwuhloniphe ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ukubhujiswa Kwemvelo Ngenxa Kwezizimayini Ukukhula komnotho emhlabeni jikelele kuholele ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo, okukhombisa izidingo ezinkulu zokumba izinsiza ezinjengamalahle, insimbi, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zinezimpawu ezinzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekubhujisweni kwemvelo. Izimayini, nakuba zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Umthelela Wokumba Izinsiza Uma izimayini ziqala ukusebenza, zidinga indawo enkulu yokumba. Lokhu kuholela ekuchithweni kwemvelo, njengoba izihlahla, izilwane, nezindawo zokuhlala zibhujiswa. Ukumba izinsiza kudinga ukwakha izindawo ezinkulu zokugcina, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emvelweni. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola ukudla nokuphila. Ukukhishwa Kwezinto Ezingcolisayo Izimayini zikhishwa izinto eziningi ezingcolisayo, ezinjengemfucumfucu, amanzi angcolile, nezinto eziphuma emoyeni. Lezi zinto zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma amanzi angcolile efakwa emifuleni, kungaholela ekubeni izilwane eziphila emanzini zife, futhi abantu abahlala eduze bangase bahlupheke ngezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukushintsha Kwezimo Zokuphila Ukusebenza kwezizimayini kuholela ekushintsheni kwezimo zokuphila. Izindawo ezazikhona ngaphambi kokumba zingase zishintshe zibe izindawo ezingenakuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo badinge ukuhamba, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemiphakathi nasemiphakathini. Ukushintsha kwezindawo zokuhlala kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola ukudla, amanzi, nezinsiza. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Imvelo Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela omubi wezizimayini, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokumba, obunciphisa umonakalo emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimayini kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva, lapho umhlaba obhujiswe ubuyiselwa esimweni esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izindawo ezazibhujiswe zibuye zibe nezitshalo nezilwane. Ukubambisana Nezindawo Zokuhlala Kubantu abahlala eduze kwezizimayini, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlangano ezibambisene nezimayini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyahlangatshezwa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashwa, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi. Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuhle, izimayini kufanele ziqonde izidingo zomphakathi futhi zisebenze ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uyathuthuka. Isiphetho Ukubhujiswa kwemvelo ngenxa yezimayini kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Nakuba izimayini zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, umthelela wazo emvelweni ungaba mubi kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singagcina imvelo yethu futhi siqinisekise ikusasa elihle kubantu nezilwane. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizimayini, iziphathimandla, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile sokuvikela imvelo.
Ama-Amapiano: Uhambo Lwezinguquko Nezintuthuko Emculweni. Ama-Amapiano abhalisela umlando ophawulekayo, adumile emhlabeni, futhi aqhubeka nokukhula. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko zomculo, kufanele sibuyele emuva ezinsukwini lapho la magama aqala khona. I-Amapiano, igama elihlanganisa izitayela eziningi, yaziwa njengenhlobo yomculo ophuma eNingizimu Afrika. Izimpande zayo ziqala ezikhathini zokuqala zekhulu leminyaka, lapho umculo we-house uqala ukuthandwa. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, ama-Amapiano ahlukaniswa njengohlobo oluhlukile, olunezici ezinzima ze-bass, izigubhu ezimnandi, kanye nezimvumi ezikhangayo. Ukuqala kwama-Amapiano kwenzeka eminyakeni yama-2010, lapho abaculi abanjengo DJ Maphorisa, Kabza De Small, no-Vinny beqala ukukhipha imisebenzi ethokozisayo, behlola izihloko ezifana nempilo, uthando, nezinsuku zansuku. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ophilayo, owenze abantu bajabule. Lokhu kwaba yinsika yokwazisa abathandi bomculo ngalesi sikhathi esisha. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, ama-Amapiano aqhubekile nokukhula, abe yinsika ebalulekile emakhaya ama-Afrika. Ukuhamba phambili kwawo kuholele ekuxhumaneni nezinye izinhlobo zomculo, njengemizwelo ye-gospel, i-jazz, ne-kwaito, okwakha imisebenzi emisha ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ogcwele injabulo, okwazi ukudansa abantu ezikhathini eziningi. Njengoba ama-Amapiano ekhula, abantu basemakhaya nabafudukela emadolobheni baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela zokuphila ukuze baphile izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholele emicimbini emikhulu, lapho abantu behlangana, behudulela izinyathelo, behlanganyela imizwa futhi bejabulela ubudlelwane. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe ngumculo odumile, kanti izinkanyezi ezivela kulo mkhuba zandisa umphakathi, zikhombisa izindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ukwanda kwama-Amapiano akuphezu komculo kuphela, kodwa kukhombisa nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Abaculi abavela kwezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi eZimbabwe, eZambia, naseBotswana, baqala ukuvuselela ama-Amapiano, behlanganisa izitayela zabo zomculo ukuze bakhe umculo ophathekayo, ohambisana nezimo zabo. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe yinkanyezi yokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamazwe. Eminyakeni edlule, ama-Amapiano aqhubeke nokukhula emhlabeni jikelele, futhi abaculi abasha baqala ukuveza imisebenzi emisha, behlanganisa ama-Amapiano nezitayela ezahlukene, okwenza umculo uthokozise abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokujabula, lapho abantu bekwazi ukujabulela iziphuzo, ukudla, nokuhlanganyela ngezindlela ezihlukene. Njengoba ama-Amapiano eqhubeka nokukhula, aqhubeka nokubamba abalandeli abaningi, abathanda umculo, nezizukulwane ezintsha. Lokhu kusikhumbuza ukuthi umculo uhlanganisa abantu, ubasukela ezimpilweni zabo, ubakhiphe emithini yobuhlungu, futhi ubathokozise. Ama-Amapiano akhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokuzijabulisa, yokukhumbula, kanye nendlela yokuthokozisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-Amapiano azogcina engumkhiqizo oholayo, usetshenziswa emicimbini emikhulu, ezinkundleni, nakwezinye izindawo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzovumela umculo ukugcina ubukhona bawo, nokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-Amapiano, sikhuluma ngempilo, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo ungaphezulu kwekhono lokudansa; ungumkhiqizo wezifiso, izifundo, kanye nemizwa esishukumisayo. Ama-Amapiano akhuthaza umculo, avusa umoya wokubambisana, nokuhlanganyela, futhi azoba yingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko nezenzakalo ezizayo, aqhubeke nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu, futhi agcine engumthombo wokujabula nempilo.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngezinkinga zamanzi ezithinta imiphakathi yethu. Amanzi ayisisekelo sokuphila, futhi uma engatholakali kahle, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Sihlangana noMnu. Zulu, umholi emphakathini waseMkhumbane, ukuze siqonde izinselelo ezihambisana namanzi. Ukuhlangana noMnu. Zulu U: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngokuba lapha. Ungachaza izinkinga zamanzi ezithinta umphakathi wakho? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene namanzi. Okokuqala, kunokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Amathafa amaningi awanawo amanzi ahlanzekile, okwenza kube nemiphumela emibi kwezempilo. Izinkinga Zempilo U: Lokhu kuzwakala kunzima. Yiziphi izinkinga zempilo ezivela ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile? Mnu. Zulu: Izinkinga zempilo ziningi, kodwa okukhathaza kakhulu yizifo ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid. Abantu bethu bahlala besebenzisa amanzi angcolile, okwenza kube lula ukuthi bagule. Izingane zethu zikhathazekile kakhulu, zihlala zikhula zinezinhlungu. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwamandla Amanzi U: Yini edala lezi zinkinga? Zikhona izizathu ezithile ezibangela ukuntuleka kwamanzi? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, izizathu ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi, njengezihlahla nezifunda, kudala ukuthi amanzi angatholakali. Futhi, izinga lokuhlala liphansi, okwenza abantu bangenakufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi bahlale bezama ukuthola amanzi emithonjeni engavikelekile. Izixazululo Ezingaba Khona U: Ngabe kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kukhona izixazululo. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile. Umphakathi kumele ube nezinhlaka ezinamandla zokuphatha amanzi. Futhi, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuhlanzeka. Ukubambisana Nezinhlelo Zikamasipala U: Ucabanga ukuthi uhulumeni unendima enkulu kulokhu? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, uhulumeni unendima enkulu. Kudingeka kube nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Izinhlelo zikamasipala kufanele ziqhube izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamanzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukubaluleka Kokubambisana U: Ngabe ukhona umbono wokuthi imiphakathi ingasebenza kanjani ndawonye ukuze ixazulule lezi zinkinga? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Singakha amaqembu okusebenza ukuze sithole izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Isiphetho U: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubantu abahlala emiphakathini abhekene nezinkinga zamanzi? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifisa ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yabo. Akukhona kuphela uhulumeni okumele enze, kodwa thina sonke kumele sibe neqhaza. Uma sibambisene, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, onamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukuvala Namuhla, sihlole ukuthi izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ubuqotho, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo. Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sokuphila, futhi kufanele siwafake phambili ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Abadlali Abasebasha: Ukuhamba Komzila Wokukhula Nezinkinga Eziwubuhlungu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadlali abasebasha bakhula ngokushesha ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izigidi zethu ngezinsuku zemidlalo. Abantwana abavela ezindaweni zemidlalo, izikole, nezikole ezimaphakathi, bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi yabo yokudlala. Nokho, ukubhekelela izinzuzo eziqhamukayo kulezi zindawo kudinga ukucaciswa. Abadlali abasebasha banamathuba amaningi emhlabeni wezokudlala, kepha baphinde babhekane nezinselelo ezinzima. Lapho sikhuluma ngabadlali abasebasha, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abanye baphikiswa yizimo eziningi. Okwokuqala, sinama-athletics, imidlalo yeqembu, kanye nezemidlalo ezinzima ezidinga ukuthi abadlali babe nekhono eliphezulu. Abadlali abancane bakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe imidlalo ukuze bathole ithuba lokuphumelela, kepha kanjani, uma umuzwa wokuncintisana ungaholela ekucindezelweni? Lokhu kwempi yoxhaso phakathi kokuzijabulisa nobunzima bokuthola impumelelo kukhombisa isimo esingabi nansi esivame ukwenzeka. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abezindaba kumele bahloniphe abadlali abasebasha, begcizelela imithetho nezindlela zokuziphatha ezinhle. Ngokuphambene, abanye abakholwa ekutheni imidlalo kufanele ibe yinsika yokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi edlini yezenhlalo nabadlalayo abadala kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni abantwana abasha ithuba lokukhula. Izingxoxo ezinjalo zishaywa indiva, zikhombisa indlela ezahlukeneyo zokubheka isimo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha badinga ukuhlonishwa ngebanga locwaningo lokuziphatha, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bajabula kangakanani. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuzijabulisa emidlalweni, okukhuthaza abantwana ukuba baqhubeke bezama. Abadlali abaningi basengozini yokucindezelwa, okukhumbuza ukuthi imidlalo akuyona nje into yokuzijabulisa, kepha ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Njengoba abantwana bejolisa emkhakheni wezenhlalo, kudingeka bahlale bexhumana nabazali, othisha, nabaphathiswa abakhuthazayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona zikhula kakhulu, kodwa zidinga ukuhamba phambili emikhankasweni yokuletha izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Imali yokuxhasa abathandi bemidlalo iphakathi kwezinsiza ezibucayi. Abakhiqizi bemidlalo nabaxhasi kufanele bahloniphe imiphumela ethile yokuthuthukiswa kwemidlalo phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kucwaninga kubalulekile ukuze kubhekelwe ukukhula kwempilo nokuxhasa umphakathi. Kodwa ke, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokudlala esebenzayo. Izingane zidinga ukunikezwa amathuba okujabulisa emidlalweni, naye umphakathi kufanele ube nenkathazo yokuthuthukiswa. Othisha, abazali, nabaphathiswa kufanele babe uchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela emihlanu yempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi udinga ukuhlanganyela ukuze hushe izinqumo eziphathelene nempilo yamalunga. Ngokukufingqa, abadlali abasebasha babhekwa njengezimpawu zokukhula emphakathini wezemidlalo. Ubuhle bezemidlalo buphinde buhlobene nezinsiza eziphuma ezintweni eziningi. Abadlali abancane badinga ukunakekelwa, abathandi besikhumbuzo, nezinsiza ezinkulu ukuze bakhule. Kusemqoka ukufaka umqondo omuhle kwemidlalo, benesibopho sokugcina impumelelo yezenhlalo. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinhlelo ezinethezekile, ukuxhumana okuhle, nokuqhuba izifundo eziphumelelayo. Kukhona uzhokufa ozodinga ´ukwazi ukubamba kokubili, ukuzijabulisa nokuxhasa imisebenzi ezothuthukisa impilo yabo. Sifuna ukusekela abadlali basebasha ukuze bakhule babe nethuba lokuphumelela, bahloniphe isimo, bemukele uhla lwezinselelo, bese beqhubeka phambili. Ukugcina umhlaba wobuchwepheshe, bawuthumele lokho kuchaza ese, bekwazi ngempela ukwenza njengempilo, bathuthukise umqondo wezemidlalo, negalelo elichaphazelekayo elizogqugquzela ubuchule. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuhamba phambili kwezemidlalo phakathi komphakathi, kuzokwenza umkhakha wezemidlalo ube yinsika ethe xaxa.
Imigomo Yokugoma: Ukubaluleka Nokubuyekezwa Umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ezithinta impilo, ikakhulukazi izifo ezithathelwana kalula, okwenza udlame ezempilo. Ukuze lezi zifo zinqandwe, kubalulekile ukugqugquzela ukugoma. Imigomo yokugoma iyisihluthulelo sokuvikela abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala, kanye nabantu abanezimo zempilo ezithile. Le migomo ibandakanya izinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu. Lokhu kubandakanya ukugoma abantu abaneminyaka ethile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokugoma, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezingozi zokungagomi. Ukuze le migomo ibe neqhaza, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokugoma nezingozi ezihambisana nokungagomi. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukugoma kunciphisa amathuba okuthola izifo ezithathelwana kalula, njengo measles, polio, ne-hepatitis. Uma abantu bephumelela ekugomeni, kudaleka umphakathi onempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela labo abangasakwazi ukuzivikela, njengabantwana nabantu abadala. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izinsiza zokwelapha zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imigomo yokugoma ikwakha umoya wobumbano emphakathini. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi ukugoma akukhona nje ukuvikela umuntu, kodwa nokuvikela umphakathi, bazoba nesithakazelo ekugomeni, okuholela ekubambisaneni. Kodwa-ke, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nemigomo yokugoma. Abanye abantu bahluleka ukuvuma ukugoma ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma ukukhathazeka ngezingozi ezihambisana nezivivinyo zokugoma. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokwazisa abantu ngendlela efanele ukuze baqonde izinzuzo zokugoma. Abaholi bemiphakathi, odokotela, nabanye badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Izinhlelo zokugoma kumele ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zifinyeleleka kubo bonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvuma ukugoma, izinhlelo kumele zibe lula nezifinyeleleka, ukuze zibe neqhaza elihle ekutholeni ukuvikeleka. Izinselelo ezihlobene nemigomo yokugoma zidinga ukuhamba phambili, sikhuthaza abantu ukuba beqonde ukubaluleka kokugoma. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi, futhi lokhu kungenziwa kuphela uma sikhuthaza ukugoma. Ekugcineni, imigomo yokugoma ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukukhangisa ukugoma, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, nokwenza izinhlelo zokugoma zifinyeleleke kubo bonke. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela izizukulwane ezizayo nokuqinisekisa impilo yomphakathi. Ukugoma akukhona nje isinqumo somuntu, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
### Abadlali Abasebasha: Izifundo Eziqalayo Ezweni Lokuncintisana Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, abadlali abasebasha babe nemisebenzi ebalulekile eminyakeni edlule. Izenzo zabo, izinzuzo zabo, nezifundo abahamba kuzo, kudinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokuqonda okujulile. Lokhu kudinga izizathu eziningi, kodwa ngokuqinisekayo, abantu badinga ukujula kancane endleleni yokwenza amalungiselelo kulezi zinsuku. Abadlali abasebasha bahlala benesifiso sokuphumelela, kanti lokho kubaholela ekunqobeni emakhono abawathola ezivivinyweni zabo. Nokho, lapho sikhuluma ngabadlali abasebasha, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo ayikhulumi kuphela ngokuxabana noma ngezimali, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ubuhlobo, ukufunda, kanye nokukhula njengabantu. Ubuhlakani besikole, izifundo ezimnandi zokuhlonipha, nezifundo zokubambisana nazo zikhona. Abadlali abakha izinselele, begxile ekugcineni amaphupho abo, bathola ithuba lokufunda izifundo eziphusile. Baphinde baqaphele amaphutha abo, badlule ezindaweni ezinzima, bese bephumelela, okwenza kube sobala ukuthi ukuzinikela nobuhlakani bakho kumele kube yizinto ezibalulekile. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngezithiyo ezibhekene nabadlali abasebasha. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi umjaho wokuncintisana ubandakanya ingcindezi enkulu. Abazali, othisha, nababukeli baphakamisa amazinga aphezulu. Lokhu kudala ukucindezeleka okukhulu, okuvame ukuhambisana nokuhluleka ukujabulisa abantu abaseduze. Lokhu kwenza kubalulekile ukuthi nabazali baziqonde izidingo nezinselele zezingane zabo, behlale bexhasa ngothando, hhayi ukwenza isikhumbuzo somjaho wokuncintisana kuphela. Imikhuba yokugcina ukudla, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphila impilo ethile, lokho kudinga ukuqashelwa. Izinselelo zokudla okulungile nezokuphila impilo enempilo zihlala zikhona. Abadlali badinga ukuphepha kwangempela, ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kuchaze kahle ukuthi ukukhula kwemizimba yabo kudinga izindlela zokusebenzisa njengezokuzivocavoca.
