Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlela ngempela indlela lezi zinhlelo ezithuthukiswe ngayo, ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emakethe nakumphakathi. Ngenkathi sihamba phambili, kuthe uma sicabanga ngezakhiwo ezidala, sizibona zihamba phambili ngesinye isikhathi. Isibalo sabantu abawasebenzisayo sikhuphuka, kanti nendlela yokuphila ithuthuka kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abunjiniyela bakhe izixazululo ezintsha ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukukhula kwempilo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi isidingo sokufundisa odabeni bezobunjiniyela kuyasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sibeka izifundo eziqinile emakhanda abantu abasanda kuvela. Ukukhuluma ngothando ngethuba, kudinga ukuthi sizibuze nathi: yini engaholela ekutheni ubunjiniyela busize ukukhulisa umnotho wethu? Ukuphendula le nkinga kudinga ukufakwa ezivivinyweni ezinzima. Uma abunjiniyela besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha okuhlakaniphile, bangakha izakhiwo ezihlala isikhathi eside nezivumelana nemvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, okufaka phakathi i-solar energy ne-wind energy, okwamanje izinsiza ezishibhile futhi ezihamba phambili kwezobunjiniyela. Izinselelo zokuntuleka kwenhlanzeko emphakathini zikhona, ngaleyo ndlela kubalulekile ukuba abunjiniyela baxhumane nabo ohlangothini lwezinhlelo zokwakha izinhlelo ezikhuthaza ukusimama. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile nengqalasizinda yokuhlala, uhlu oluqhubekayo lokwakha izintambo nezinsiza zokuphila. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubalulekile ngoba kudala umphakathi osebenza kahle, okhulisa umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubunjiniyela bukhombisa indlela yokufundisa. Ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme bukhombisa izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufunda ngezenzakalo ezithinta umphakathi. Noma ngabe ezibhedlela, ezikoleni, noma emakhaya, abanjiniyela basebenzisa imikhankaso yokufundisa ukuze bacebise abantu ngethuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisa ezokuthutha, ukusiza ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhamba. Okokugcina uma sikhuluma ngezobunjiniyela, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi iphupha elidumile elithi "izinkanyezi zingenziwa" liyavuma. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka imizamo ehlukahlukene yokwakha ukuphila okungcono. Amathuba okuphila koMdabu akha izidingo eziningi. Ukuthuthukiswa complaisant kuncike ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlukahlukene, futhi lokho kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ezobunjiniyela akugcini nje ekwakheni imithetho emisha kodwa kudinga uhlobo oluthile lwezibopho phakathi kwababezinhlelo. Ukuhweba nokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene kuqukethe inhlalo, ukubukela phansi uphiko lwezempilo, nokuwina izinkanyezi eziza nezehlakalo ezintsha ezikhombisa ubunjiniyela obukhulu. Ngokujuluka, ukuhamba phambili kwezobunjiniyela kuphinde kuhlelwe izinhloso eziphakeme, kungaba endaweni engokwenziwe ngezakhiwo ezenzakalayo, ezinezinhloso ezinhle nokukhathalela imvelo. Lesi yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubunjiniyela akukhona kuphela ukudala izinto, kodwa futhi kudinga ubuhlakani, ubuchwepheshe, nezinqumo ezikhalipha, ngakho sizophela ekubeni nekhono lokubeka umgomo olinhle emhlabeni. Lokhu kuhlobene nemigomo emisha, efana nokwakha isimo sokuphila kumuntu ngamunye, emkhakheni wezobunjiniyela ozosiza ukwakha ikusasa elihle. Izwi elihle, ubunjiniyela, libhekele iMbewu.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Kwezokuhlaliswa Kwezemvelo Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, Dkt. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuthi uvume ukusikhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Ukuqala, ungachaza kancane ukuthi yini ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu? Dkt. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kubhekisela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ezibangelwa izici ezihlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa emhlabeni, ukushintsha kwemvula, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima ezifana nezikhukhula nezomiso. Lezi zinguquko zenzeka ngenxa yokwanda kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide nezinye izinsalela ezikhishwayo emoyeni. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Yiziphi izizathu ezisemqoka zokuthi lokhu kuqhubeke? Dkt. Mthembu: Izizathu ezisemqoka zifaka phakathi ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto, imboni, kanye nezolimo. Lezi zinto zikhupha amagesi abamba ukushisa, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncipha kwemithi nezindawo zokuhlala kwemvelo, njengamahlathi, kukhulu kakhulu, njengoba lezi zindawo ziwusizo ekunciphiseni amagesi abamba ukushisa. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe lezi zinguquko zinezimpawu ezithile ezithinta abantu? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ziningi izimpawu ezithinta abantu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukuncipha kwezinsiza zokudla, kanye nezimo zokuhlala ezinzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu, njengezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Ukushintsha kwemvula kuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahlala kulezi zindawo. Umxhumanisi: Yini eyenziwa ukuze kulwe nale nkinga? Dkt. Mthembu: Kunezinyathelo eziningi ezithathwayo. Uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezakhamuzi kumele basebenzisane ukuze banciphise ukukhishwa kwamagesi abamba ukushisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izindlela zokuhamba ezihlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngale nkinga ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezinhle zokuthi abantu baphumelele kulokhu? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezibonelo eziningi ezinhle. Emazweni amaningi, abantu basebenzisa amandla elanga newind, okunciphisa ukuncika kumafutha. Ezinye izindawo zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanzekile, njengezithuthi zomphakathi ezisebenza ngogesi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu benza izinguquko ezincane, bangaba nomthelela omkhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukuhamba phambili nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma abantu beqonda ubukhulu balolu daba, bazokwazi ukwenza izinguquko. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhuluma ngalesi sihloko zingasiza kakhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukugcizelela? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona inkinga yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa yinkinga yomhlaba wonke. Kumele sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Dkt. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukufunda futhi benze izinguquko ezidingekayo. Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle emhlabeni wethu.
Ibhukuda Liyanda eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Uma ubheka eNingizimu Afrika, uyakwazi ukubona ubuhle bemvelo obuhambisana namanzi, kusukela ogwini lwezindawo ezithokozisayo ezifana ne-Kwazulu-Natal, kuya ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni ezifana nemifula nemithombo. Kulokhu, ukubhukuda sekubuye kwaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu, kungokwezempilo, ukuhlanganyela, noma ukujabulisa. Lokhu kubonakala ngempela emicimbini emisha yokubhukuda yeNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abantu abaningi bejabulela ubuchwepheshe obusha bokubhukuda. Ukukhula Kwezokubhukuda Ukubhukuda akusona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa futhi kuyindawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona. Izikhungo ezahlukene zikhuthaza imicimbi yokwakha ubuqotho kanye neqhaza elibalulekile lokuthuthukisa impilo enempilo. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zendlela yokuphila ehloniphekile, imiphakathi iyazama ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubhukuda ezisebenza kahle ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umphakathi wase-Ethekwini ugxile ekwakheni izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zokubhukuda, kulandela umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe ngaphambilini. Othisha basebenza ngokubambisana nezinsiza zomphakathi ukuze kufundiswe izingane, futhi baqale imicimbi emisha yokubhukuda, okwanika ithuba lokuthakasela izipho zempilo. Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi ukubhukuda kunenzuzo enkulu empilweni. Abahlali baveza ukuthi ukuhamba emanzini kubasiza ukuphumuza ingqondo, kwenze bazise ukuthi baphila kahle, ngokwenyama nangokwengqondo. Lo mkhuba ukhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuba babe nomoya opholile, bajabulele ubuchwepheshe obutholakala ezikhungweni zokubhukuda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNingizimu Afrika iyazisa kakhulu kokubhukuda, njengoba ithola izindondo eziningi emiqhudelwaneni yamazwe omhlaba. Lokhu kudala umoya wezinga eliphezulu phakathi kwezingane nabantu abadala, kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhankaso efana ne-‘Swimming for All’, eyenzelwe ukwenza izifundo zokubhukuda zifinyelele kubo bonke, kungakhathaliseki isimo sempilo, ukudlala, noma ukuphuza amanzi. Imicimbi Yokubhukuda ehlukene Imicimbi yokubhukuda iqhubeka ivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kwemijaho yendabuko, kunezinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezihlanganisa imidlalo yokubhukuda, okuqukethe ukukhetha izigaba ezahlukene, ukusuka ebhukuweni elijabulisayo lokuziqeqesha, kuya ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ibhukuda labesifazane libonise ukukhula okukhulu, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abesifazane balandela izifundo zokubhukuda, beshaya amamaki amasha emiqhudelwaneni. Lokhu kudala isikhala sokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuze zisebenzisane futhi zihambisane nemithetho yokuphila. Izinselelo Zokubhukuda Nokho, nakuba sikhula, kunezithiyo ezibhekene nababhukudi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ubungozi obuhlangene nemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokungabi khona kwemifula ephephile, kusewuya kumkhankaso wokubukuda eNingizimu Afrika. I-‘Water Safety Initiative’ iqhubeka ibhekana nezingozi ezahlukene, iqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, bazi ukuthi amanzi kufanele ahlale ephephile. Isifinyezo Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika ibheja phambili, ukubhukuda akukhona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Ukuze sithole impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka senza imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukubaluleka kokubhukuda. Lokhu kuzokuvula indlela yokuba amazwe afunde kahle, emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe, noma ubani angaba yibhukudi abazi kahle izinto ezinjengalezi. Ibhukuda, njengoba sesikubonile, liyingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlonipha impilo, impilo emphakathini, kanye nempumelelo yephupho lokubona zonke izigaba zomphakathi zenza kahle.
Umbiko: uShaka Zulu Isingeniso UShaka Zulu, umholi ohlonishwayo, ungomunye wababusi abakhulu emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Uzalwe ngo-1787, eMkhumbane, edolobheni elalaziwa njengezindaweni zeZulu, waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni umbuso omkhulu weZulu. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe, futhi izimpilo zakhe zashintsha umhlaba wamaZulu nempucuko yalesi sifunda. Ubudlelwano bomndeni noShaka UShaka wazalelwa emndenini ophakathi nendawo, indodana kaSenzangakhona, umholi wesizwe samaZulu. UShaka wakhula enezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokungamukelwa kahle emndenini wakhe. Ubuye waba nesithakazelo esiqinile emlandweni wamaZulu, okwakuhlanganisa izinkolelo, amasiko, nezinkolelo zomndeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abe nesifiso sokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihloniphekayo. Ukuqhamuka kwempi Ngemva kokuphuma emndenini, uShaka waqala ukuhlela izimpi ezinkulu ukuze aqinise isizwe sakhe. Wazama ukuthola izinsiza eziningi, futhi waphonsa izikhali eziningi ukuze akhe ithimba elinamandla. UShaka wayengumholi ophumelelayo, futhi izimpi zakhe zashintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukahlukene. Waqala ukuhlela amasu amasha, afana ne-‘iklwa’, umkhonto owawusetshenziswa kakhulu empini. Ukwakhiwa kwezwe leZulu UShaka akazange akhombise amandla kuphela empini, kodwa waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isizwe esinokuhlangana. Waqala ukuhlela izifunda, wahlukanisa izindawo ukuze kube lula ukuphatha izinsiza. Ukwakhiwa kwezwe leZulu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ezazihlanganisa izinkonzo, izimiso, nemithetho. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola okuhle, okwakuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Umthelela wezokuxhumana UShaka wayaziqonda kahle izindlela zokuxhumana, futhi wakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe. Waqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano, nokwakha izivumelwano ezinhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izizwe eziningi ziqhubele phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, okwakuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wazo. UShaka njengoMholi UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi izinqumo zakhe zazihlala zisebenza kakhulu. Wayengumholi onothando, owayenobuhlakani obukhulu, futhi wakhuthaza abantu bakhe ukuba baphile ngokuhlanganyela. UShaka waba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni, futhi izimfundiso zakhe zashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo. Ukubuyekezwa komlando Ngemuva kokushona kukaShaka ngo-1828, umthetho wakhe wahlala unamandla, futhi izifundo zakhe zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu. UShaka waba yisikhumbuzo sokuhola, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe. Izifundo zakhe ziqhubeka zikhuluma ngezinsuku zethu, futhi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ubuhlakani obuqinile bungaholela ekwakheni izizwe ezinamandla. Isiphetho UShaka Zulu ungumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi umthelela wakhe emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika ungakaze unqandwe. Ube yisibonelo sokuhola nokuqinisa isizwe, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. UShaka ungomunye wabaholi abahlonishwa kakhulu, futhi umhlaba uzohlala ukhumbula igama lakhe. Izimpilo zakhe zashintsha umhlaba, futhi zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile ezizogcina zikhumbuleka ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Izindaba Ezintsha: Ukukhuthazwa Kwentsha Emphakathini Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha ibonakala iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ezweni lethu, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inethuba elikhulu lokwenza umehluko. Kuleli sonto, sizobheka izinhlelo ezahlukene ezikhuthaza intsha, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa ubuhlakani nobuchwepheshe bayo. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Intsha Izinhlelo ezikhona zokuqinisa intsha zifaka phakathi imifundaze, ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha ithola amathuba afanele. Ngokwesibonelo, uHulumeni weSizwe uqalile uhlelo olusha lokuxhasa abafundi abasha abahamba phambili ezikhungweni zemfundo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imifundaze ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zokusebenza zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezobuchwepheshe, ezokwakha, nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha ithola amakhono adingekayo ukuze ibe neqhaza elihle emnothweni. Ubuhlakani Nobuchwepheshe Intsha yamanje ibonakala iphenduka ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kobuchwepheshe. I-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi, okuvumela intsha ukuba ibonise ubuhlakani bayo. Izinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ifunde ngezifundo ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu zokufunda. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-‘Code.org’ ne-‘Khan Academy’ zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ifunde izifundo zobuchwepheshe, okuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abanamakhono ahlukahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinkinga Ezibhekene Nentsha Nokho, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungasebenzi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubantu abasha ukuba baphumelele. Ubulungiswa bezimali, ukungabi namathuba okusebenza, kanye nezinkinga zempilo zikhathaza intsha, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana lukhombisa ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi zokuphila, okuhlanganisa nokucindezeleka, ukwehla kwemizwa, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube nezinqubomgomo eziphusile zokuxhasa intsha, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle, nokwakha izinhlelo zokwelashwa. Ukubambisana Emphakathini Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambisane. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwenza intsha ibonakale. Izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzithandela, imicimbi yokwazisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi yokuxhasa intsha, njengemiphakathi yokufunda, imiphakathi yokusebenza, kanye nemiphakathi yokuxhumana, kungasiza intsha ukuba ibone ukuthi ayiyedwa kulolu hambo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni, futhi kubavumele ukuba baphumelele. Isiphetho Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukusiza intsha ukuba ibonakale, ibonise ubuhlakani bayo, futhi ibambe iqhaza empilweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezikhuthaza intsha, kanye nokuxhasa ubuhlakani bayo, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibonakale njengengxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelinothile, ukuze intsha yethu ikwazi ukuthola amathuba afanele. Ukwakha umphakathi onempilo kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo, kodwa uma sibambisana, singakwazi ukufezekisa lokho. Intsha iyisizukulwane esizayo, futhi umphakathi ungakha izisekelo eziqinile ukuze ibonakale futhi ibambe iqhaza emhlabeni.

Abalimi BaseNingizimu Afrika: Umbiko Isingeniso Ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, abalimi babalulekile ekwakheni umnotho, ekuphakamiseni izinga lempilo, nakwazisa ubuciko nokwaziswa kwemvelo. Abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika banenhlobonhlobo yokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa ukulima, ubulili bezinkomo, nemifino, okwenza izwe lethu likhanye emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ezingxoxweni zethu ngezinkinga ezithinta abalimi, izinselelo abazihlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imikhakha yabo. Ubuhle Bokulima Abalimi, ikakhulukazi abasemaphandleni, bayingxenye yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Bayabamba iqhaza ekwakheni imisebenzi, ngokukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukulima kudala amathuba emisebenzi, okukhuthaza ukusimama komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abalimi banendima ebalulekile ekulondolozeni izinsiza zemvelo, njengamanzi, umhlaba, nezitshalo. Izinkinga Eziyinselelo Kodwa-ke, abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika babhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukushoda kwezinsiza, okungukuthi, ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza zokukhiqiza, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo ezithintekayo, kubangele ukuthi abanye abalimi babe sengozini yokungakwazi ukukhiqiza ngokwanele. Ukushoda kwamanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezithinta kakhulu izinqubo zokulima. Ukwamukela Ubuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bube yinsiza ewusizo kubalimi. Ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ethuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokulima ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhweba ezikwi-inthanethi, kube nemiphumela emihle ekwandiseni ukukhiqiza. Abalimi abaningi baphumelela ekutholeni imithombo yezimali yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, okukhuthaza ukwanda kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimali Nezinhlelo Zokweseka Uhlaka lwezomnotho lwezokulima lwakha ithuba lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokweseka abalimi. Izinhlelo zomshuwalense, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa ezokulima zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho. Lokhu kudinga ubambiswano phakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, nabalimi uqobo. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali kumkhakha wokulima kungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Izinselelo Zokuphila Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokukhiqiza, abalimi baphinde babhekane nezinkinga zokuphila. Ukungabi namakhaya afanelekayo, ukuntuleka kwemfundo, nokuhamba kancane kwezinsizakalo zempilo, kubangela ukuthi abalimi babe nesikhathi esinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabalimi. Imiphumela Yezinguquko Zesimo Sezulu Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu kubalimi. Ukuze balungiselele lezi zinguquko, abalimi kufanele bathole izindlela zokwenza ngcono imikhuba yokulima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlakaniphile zokulima, ezifana nokulima ngendlela yokugcina amanzi, nokusebenzisa izitshalo eziphumelelayo ezinamandla okukhula ezimweni ezinzima. Ukwakhiwa Kwezixazululo Zokubambisana Ukuze kuzuze abalimi, udinga kube khona ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa uhulumeni, abathengisi, izikhungo zocwaningo, nezikhungo zemfundo. Uhlelo lokuhweba olusebenzayo, oluhlanganisa izinkampani ezincane nabakhulayo, lungakhuthaza ukuqhubeka komnotho wokulima. Ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yasendaweni, nokuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, kuyindlela yokwakha umnotho okhula ngokushesha. Isiphetho Abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika banendima enkulu ekwakheni umnotho, ukuphakamiseni izinga lempilo, nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Noma bephakathi kwezinkinga eziningi, imizamo yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokweseka, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni imikhakha yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke ubonge futhi usekele abalimi bethu, ukuze bakwazi ukuqhubekela phambili, bese beqhakambisa ikusasa lempilo nempumelelo yeNingizimu Afrika.
Imfashini Nobuhle: Ukuhlola Izitayela Nezindlela Zokwakha Isithombe Emhlabeni wethu, imfashini nobuhle zihlala zibalulekile, zidalela abantu ithuba lokwakha isithombe esihle, ukukhombisa ubuhle baphakathi kwethu, nokuvula indlela yokubonisa ubunikazi bethu. Namuhla, sizobheka izitayela ezisematheni, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuhle bethu, sikhangela lesi sikhathi esiguqukayo. Izitayela Zamanje: Umthelela Wezokuxhumana Izitayela zemfashini zihlala zishintsha, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezinkanyezi, izinkulumo zomphakathi, nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithuthukisa imikhiqizo yazo. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhula, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba balandele izitayela ezithile. Uhlobo lwemfashini olukhona luhlanganisa izitayela ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-urban, i-bohemian, kanye ne-classic chic. Izinkampani ezifana neZara, H&M, kanye ne-Nike zisebenzisa izinkanyezi ezidumile ukuze zikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile kahle nezinye izitayela. Izinkundla zokuxhumana, njenge-Instagram, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngezithombe, okwandisa ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezahlukene. Ubuhle Obungokwemvelo: Izithako Zokwakha Isithombe Ngaphandle kwemfashini, ubuhle bukhombisa indlela esizithanda ngayo, futhi kudinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ukuze sibe nobuhle, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo efanele isikhumba sethu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza imikhiqizo yokunakekela isikhumba enezithako ezisemvelweni, njengezihlahla namafutha, okukhuthaza ubuhle bethu futhi kuhlonipha imvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi behlola umthelela omubi wemikhiqizo enezithako ezimbi emvelweni. Ukuze sibe nobuhle obuqinile, kufanele siqaphele imikhiqizo esiyisebenzisayo, ukuze sikhulise isithombe esihle ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Imfashini Nezokuxhumana: Ukuhlangana Kwezimboni Izinkampani ezinkulu ziqhubeka nokuhlangana nezinkanyezi, okuholela ekwakheni izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwemfashini nobuhle. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuthola izitayela ezintsha nokwabelana ngemicabango nezithombe, ukudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Beauty Blender ne-Fenty Beauty ziqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, zikhuthaza abantu abanemibala ehlukene ukuba baveze ubuhle babo, okwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukuze sakhe isithombe esihle, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhle buhluke kumuntu nomuntu, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze lezi zinto. Izifundo Zempilo: Ukubaluleka Kokunakekela Ngaphandle kwemfashini nobuhle, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yethu iyisisekelo. Ukudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isithombe esihle. Imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle bethu, kodwa impilo yethu ibalulekile kakhulu. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala bephila kahle baveza ubuhle obungokwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo ukuze sikwazi ukuveza ubuhle bethu ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba sithokozisa imfashini nobuhle, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemvelo, ukuthuthukisa ubuhle bethu, nokukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Imfashini ingaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bokuqala buvela ngaphakathi. Sihlanganyela ukwakha isithombe esihle esihambisana nemvelo, sikhuthaze ubuhle baphakathi. Imfashini nobuhle kuzohlala kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze izindlela ezilungile zokwakha isithombe esihle. Ubufakazi bokuthi imfashini nobuhle kungaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubunikazi bethu, kufanele sithokozise lezi zinto ezinhle empilweni yethu.
UMartin Luther King Jr. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1920, emhlabeni omkhulu, kwavela umntwana ophakathi kwezinkanyezi zenkululeko, uMartin Luther King Jr. Wazalwa ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana, ngonyaka we-1929, eAtlanta, eGeorgia. UMartin wayengumfana ophilayo, onothando, futhi enothando lokufunda. Wakhulela emndenini owayenobuhlakani, umphakathi owawukhuluma ngenkululeko, ubulungiswa, kanye nezinqumo ezinzima. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emfundweni yakhe, lapho afunda khona izincwadi eziningi ezikhuthaza impilo yakhe. Njengoba uMartin ekhula, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Abantu abamnyama babebhekana nokucwaswa, ukungabi nabulungiswa, nokuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, futhi kwavusa umoya wakhe wokulwa. Wayefuna ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, engaba nethuba lokuphila kahle. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMartin wahamba eBoston, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo zakhe. Wafunda ngezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi wathola ukuthi uNkulunkulu ubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Waqonda ukuthi indlela yokulwa nokucwaswa akufanele ibe yodwa, kodwa kufanele kube nendlela ethule, ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale ukwakha izinhlelo zokulwa nokucwaswa, ezazigcwele umoya wokuthula. Ngonyaka we-1955, kwenzeka umcimbi omkhulu. U-Rosa Parks, owesifazane omnyama, waphika ukuma emuva kwendiza ye-bus ukuze umnumzane omhlophe akwazi ukuhamba. Lokhu kwavusa umphakathi, futhi uMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokukhuthazela. Waqala ukuhlela imibhikisho, izinkulumo, nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. UMartin wayekholwa ukuthi amandla abantu abamnyama angavuselelwa uma behlanganyela, benza imisebenzi ethokozisayo. Ngonyaka we-1963, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba nesikhumbuzo esikhulu eWashington, D.C. Lapha, wakhuluma khona izwi lakhe elidumile, "Ngiyaphupha." Wakhuluma ngothando, ukulingana, nokuhlanganyela. Wayefuna umphakathi lapho abantu bonke bengaphila ngokuthula, ngaphandle kokucwaswa. Izwi lakhe lavusa umoya, futhi abantu babephendula ngothando, benza izinqumo ezinkulu zokuba neqhaza emzamweni wokulwa nokucwaswa. UMartin akazange ayeke. Noma ubani owawazi uMartin, wayebona ukuthi ungumholi onobuhlakani, onokholo, futhi onothando. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe, baphumelele, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuthula. Kodwa, njengokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsizi zakhula, futhi izitha zikaMartin zanda. Kwakukhona abanye ababenobudlova, ababenomqondo ophikisana nezifiso zakhe. Ngonyaka we-1968, uMartin Luther King Jr. wabulawa. Lokhu kwashiya umhlaba uphahlazekile, abantu bephendula ngezinyembezi, ubuhlungu, nokukhala. Kodwa, izifiso zakhe azizange zife. Umoya wakhe wahlala uphila, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokulandela izifundo zakhe. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umhlaba ungashintsha, uma abantu bephikelela ezinhlelweni ezinhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba yisibonelo esikhulu sokuthi uthando lungahlula ubudlova. Umsebenzi wakhe wathinta abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi izifundo zakhe zakhuthaza izizukulwane eziningi. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, uthando, ukulingana, nokuhlanganyela kuzoholela empumelelweni. Namuhla, uMartin Luther King Jr. uyahlonishwa, futhi izifiso zakhe zihlala zikhona. Umhlaba usaqhubeka nokufunda emsebenzini wakhe, futhi abantu bayazi ukuthi uma behlanganyela, bangakha umphakathi ongcono. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, "Uthando lungcono kunezinkinga," futhi lokhu kuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu emhlabeni wonke. UMartin Luther King Jr. akazange abe ngumholi kuphela, kodwa waba yisibonelo sokuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma abantu benza okuthile.
Iphrofayela KaMnu. Thabo Mkhize: Umsebenzi Wokulwa Nokungcola Kwemvelo Mnu. Thabo Mkhize, indoda enomlando ocebile kwezokulima, ungomunye wabantu abaziwayo emkhakheni wokuvikela imvelo. Wazalelwa eDurban, edolobheni elidumile, lapho aqala khona ukuthanda imvelo esemncane. Uhlanga lwakhe lwasemakhaya lwamfundisa ukubaluleka kokuhlala imvelo ihlanzekile, futhi imishado yakhe ngemvelo yathuthukiswa kakhulu ngesikhathi efunda ezikoleni eziphakeme. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe ezemvelo, uThabo waqala ukusebenza neqembu labalimi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokulwa nokungcola kwemvelo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto eziphilayo lwamvumela ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. Waqala imikhankaso yokuhlanza izindawo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezivame ukuba nezingcolile, lapho athi "ukuhlanza akusikho ukuphuma phambili, kodwa kuwukuhlala unempilo." Njengoba edlula ezikhathini ezintsha, uThabo wabona ukuthi ukungcola kwemvelo akukhawulelwanga ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kuthinta wonke umhlaba. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngezinkinga ezinzima ezibangelwa ukungcola, njengokuguguleka kwemithombo yephunga emanzini, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezibangelwa umnotho ongazinzile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, ethula izinkulumo ezinzulu ezimayelana nezindlela zokunciphisa ukungcola. Uhlanga lwakhe lwezokulandela imikhankaso yokuvuselela imvelo lwamvumela ukuba asebenzise amakhono akhe njengomfundisi. UThabo wenza izifundo ezihlukahlukene ezikoleni, edlulisela abafundi izifundo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo, nokuthi bangayithokozisa kanjani imvelo yabo. Uqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana baqonda ukuthi imvelo iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo, futhi kufanele bahloniphe futhi bayivikele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThabo ube nesandla ekwakheni amaphrojekthi ahlanzekile, afana nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa kabusha izinto ezingasetshenziswanga, futhi abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokugcina izitshalo eziningi, ukuze kugcinwe imvelo ihlanzekile. Uthando lwakhe lokusebenza kahle luholele ekutheni abamemezeli bakhe baqonde ukuthi isimo sezulu sihlukile, futhi kudinga imizamo ejulile ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona. UThabo ungumholi onekhono, futhi ubamba iqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayaziswa futhi baqonda izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokugcina imvelo ihlanzekile. Uthanda ukwabelana ngamava akhe nabanye, futhi njalo uthokozisa abanye ngempumelelo yakhe. Ukukhombisa umoya wokubambisana, uhola imihlangano yokuhlola izinyathelo ezenziwa ezindaweni ezithile, futhi akhawunti kaThabo iyakhuthaza njengoba edlulisela uthando lwakhe lokuvikela imvelo. Njengomuntu obonisa ukuzinikela okukhulu, uThabo usaqhubeka nokusebenza ngezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwandisa ulwazi mayelana nokungcola kwemvelo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokwenza umehluko luye lwalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, futhi umphakathi uyiwa ngokuziqhenya ngokusebenza kukaThabo. Uthando lwezinto eziphilayo, ukuhlonipha imvelo, nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwenza uThabo Mkhize engumholi ongenakuphikiswa emkhakheni wezemvelo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokuzinikela luye lwagcina imiphakathi ibukeka ihlanzekile, futhi uThabo ubukeka njengomfundi onobuhlakani. Njengoba eqhubeka nokwenza umehluko emhlabeni, uhamba phambili nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphathe kahle imvelo yabo. Uthando lwezinto eziphilayo, ukuhlonipha imvelo, nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwenza uThabo Mkhize engumholi ongenakuphikiswa emkhakheni wezemvelo. Njengomuntu owenza umehluko, uThabo usaqhubeka nokusebenza ngezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwandisa ulwazi mayelana nokungcola kwemvelo, futhi uthokozisa umphakathi ngempumelelo yakhe. UThabo Mkhize, umphakathi uyakubonga ngokuzinikela kwakho, futhi ubonisa indlela yokuba yisibonelo esihle esifanele ukulandela.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ingxoxo NokuChaza Isidingo Samanzi Ahlanzekile Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, baphumelelayo. Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile, leyo ethinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke — amanzi ahlanzekile. Umhlangano wethu namuhla uyinselelo, ngakho-ke sizoba nenhlolovo noProfesa Thandi Nkosi, onguchwepheshe emkhakheni wezokuhlanzeka kwesikhathi eside. Ngiyabonga, Profesa Nkosi, ngokuthatha isikhathi sakho ukuza lapha. Profesa Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Amanzi ahlanzekile yisihloko esiyinsika empilweni yethu. Umxhumanisi: Uthini ngempela, Profesa, mayelana nokubaluleka kokuba namanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Amanzi ahlanzekile abaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi ajabulisa, kodwa akhulisa impilo yethu. Amanzi aphila anobubanzi bayo, axhasa imisebenzi ephilayo kulabo abavuma ukuphila. Uma amanzi engahlanzekile, lokho kuholela ezinkingeni eziningi ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungasho ukuthi ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile kungenza kube khona ukwanda kwezinhlobonhlobo zezimpathe? Profesa Nkosi: Impela! Izifo njenge-cholera, i-typhoid, kanye nezinye izifo zokugula ziphumelela lapho amanzi engahlanzekile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abanye abantu basakhumbula amanzi angcono, zib_halalise imithombo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo nokuhlanzeka okuhle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubaluleka kakhulu. Yimiphi imithombo namanethiwekhi atholakalayo ukuze kube nokuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi? Profesa Nkosi: Kukho izindlela eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukukwenza kube nezinye izingxenye ezifana neziteshi zamanzini, ukusebenzisa amafilitha amanzi nezinye izinhlelo zokuphatha. Ukuze umphakathi wokusebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe abantu abangawuthwala kanjani umthwalo wokuba nekhaya elihlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Ukukhulisa umphakathi kufanele kube yinto ebonakalayo. Abantu kumele bathole isikhalo sokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokufundisa abantu ukuthi banakekele amanzi, bangawasebenzisi ngendlela engekho emthethweni. Ukubamba imikhankaso yokuhlanzeka nokuhlanza amanzi kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe umthelela wezomnotho ubonakala kanjani uma sikhuluma ngamanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Akusikhulumi kuphela ngempilo, kodwa kukhona nezindleko ezithintekayo. Izinhlangano ezithile zithi amanzi ahlanzekile zingakhuphula izinga lempilo nokusebenza kahle kwezomnotho. Izindlu ezihamba phambili zidinga amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze zisebenze, futhi kulokhu, imiphumela iyabonakala. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe tuzi ungachaza izinyathelo ezenzayo emiphakathini emincane ukuze kukhuliswe isimo samanzi? Profesa Nkosi: Yebo, izinyathelo ezithile zifaka phakathi imikhankaso yokubambisana, izifundo ezikwelula umphakathi, kanye nemibango yokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu nokubambisana ngezenzo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi uzobhekana kanjani nezingozi zamukela amanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Umphakathi uthanda ukufunda futhi uthanda ukuxhumana. Uma kuboniswa izinzuzo zokuba namanzi ahlanzekile, abantu bazokwenza umzamo. Ukuhlanzeka kuyoba yinsika phakathi kwabo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ugunyazwe kanjani ukuvala izixhumanisi phakathi kwezinzwa ezimbili, amanzi ahlanzekile nomphakathi? Profesa Nkosi: Lokhu kubalulekile. Imibukiso yokuhlanzeka ingavula indlela yokubambisana. Ukushicilela izindaba zamafutha aphuma emanzini, izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, nezinye izinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi kuzodala isithombe esisekela ukuhlanzeka. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Profesa Nkosi. Sekuyisikhathi samukele. Ngabe kudingeka uthumele ukuphawula kokugcina? Profesa Nkosi: Yebo, ngifuna kuphela ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda. Amanzi ahlanzekile akhombisa ukukhanya kwempilo. Umphakathi wethu udinga usizo lwakho, ukuze sithandazele impilo enempilo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga ngamazwi akho nemibono ecacile. Lokhu kuzoba isikhumbuzo esihle kubantu bakithi. Ngiyabonga, Profesa Nkosi, ngokwabelana nathi nolwazi lwakho. Profesa Nkosi: Ngiyabonga. Please, qhubekani nokuphambili. Amanzi ahlanzekile asivumela ukuphila phila.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu: Ukukhula Nokuthuthuka Kwenhlalakahle Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukuxoxa nawe ngendaba ethokozisayo, leyo yokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ukuthi izidingo zethu zikhula futhi. Abantu abaningi bahlala ezindlini ezincane, noma ngabe bahlala emakhaya, badinga izindawo ezinkulu, ezinokuthula, nezokuhlala kahle. Lokhu kwenza kube nesidingo esikhulu sokwakha izindlu ezintsha. Ngabe ubona kanjani lezi zinhlelo zokwakha? Ngicabanga ukuthi ziningi izinto ezithinta lezi zinhlelo. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngendawo. Indawo yokwakha ibalulekile. Uma sikhuluma ngendawo, sikhuluma ngendawo ezothuthukiswa, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezokuthutha. Uma izindlu zikhona endaweni enezinsiza ezinhle, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngendawo. Kukhona nezinto eziningi ezithinta izindleko zokwakha. Uma sikhuluma ngezindleko, sikhuluma ngempela ngezinto eziningi. Izinto ezinjengokwakhiwa kwezinto, izinsiza, kanye nezisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezindleko eziphusile. Ngoba uma izindleko ziphakeme, abantu abaningi ngeke bakwazi ukuthenga lezo zindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakalayo, kodwa uma zingahlelwanga kahle, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathintekayo, njengabaholi bendawo, izinkampani zokwakha, kanye nabantu bendawo, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zikhula. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi ophilayo udinga izindlu ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhaswa? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu abaningi badinga ukuxhaswa ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga izindlu. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo. Uma abantu bengekho ezinhlelweni zokuxhaswa, bazoba nezinkinga zokuthola izindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma abantu behlanganyela, bazokwazi ukuhlela kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu behlanganyela, bazokwazi ukuxhumana, futhi bazokwazi ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ubuchwepheshe? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize ekwakheni izindlu ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize ekwakheni izindlu ezinhle, eziphumelelayo, nezokuhlala kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhaswa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu abaningi badinga ukuxhaswa ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga izindlu. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo. Uma abantu bengekho ezinhlelweni zokuxhaswa, bazoba nezinkinga zokuthola izindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Ngakho-ke, asihlanganyeleni ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, onezindlu ezinhle, eziphumelelayo, nezokuhlala kahle.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane: Ingxoxo Nothisha Osezingeni Eliphezulu Isingeniso Ngiyakwemukela kulolu hlelo lwezingxoxo, lapho sizogxila khona ekunakekelweni kwezingane. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane kubalulekile, njengoba kuthinta ikusasa lethu. Namuhla, sithumele imizwa yothisha onolwazi olukhulu kulesi sikhala, uNkk. Zodwa Mthethwa, ongumqondisi wesikhungo sokunakekela izingane esiseGoli. Ngizokhuluma naye ukuze sithole imibono emisha nokuhlangenwe nakho okuthakazelisayo. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umqondo wakho wokunakekela izingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ubudlelwane phakathi kokunakekelwa kwezingane nemiphakathi bukhulu. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akukhona nje ukugcina izingane ziphilile, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukufundisa, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokwakha ukuzethemba. Izingane zidinga indawo ephephile, ethokozisayo, lapho zingakhula khona zibe abantu abakwazi ukuzimela. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezivame ukuvela lapho unakekela izingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Izinsiza zihlala zikhona, kodwa inkinga enkulu ukuthola izinsiza ezanele. Abazali bethu bahlala bebenemisebenzi, ngakho isikhathi sokuba nezingane sikhula. Lokhu kudala inkinga yokuthi abanye abathuthukisi bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo efanelekayo. Futhi, kunezingane eziningi ezibhekene nezinkinga zempilo, ezizithinta kakhulu ekunakekeleni. Umbuzo 3: Ungawuthola kanjani umphumela ophumelelayo ekuhloleni izingane ezihlukahlukene? Nkk. Mthethwa: Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuhlola olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izici ezifana nokukhula komqondo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemizwa. Ukuhlola akufanele kube yinto eyodwa kuphela; kudinga ukuba kube nenhlonipho nengxoxo phakathi kwezingane, abazali, nothisha. Lokhu kudala umbono ophelele. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela ozisebenzisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle? Nkk. Mthethwa: Sisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa, okuhlanganisa ukudlala, ukufunda, nokudala. Ukudlala kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangene nomqondo wengane, kuyakwazi ukuvusa imizwa, nokwakha ubungane. Ukwengeza, sizama ukugcina ukuxhumana phakathi kwethu nothisha nabazali, ukuze sizwe izidingo zezikhathi ezithile. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko nabantu zibaluleke kangakanani ekunakekelweni kwezingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Ukwazisa izinsiza zamasiko kubalulekile. Izingane zikhula zidinga ukuzihlanganisa nezingxenye ezahlukene zamasiko. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubuhlobo, ukwaziwa kwamasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa umqondo wobuntu. Ukuhweba ngokuhlanganyela kulabo abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene kuyakhuthaza futhi kuyavuselela. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kunezifundo ezithile ozitholile ezithinta ukuphila kwakho njengothisha? Nkk. Mthethwa: Yebo, ngifunde kakhulu emsebenzini wami. Ngithole ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kuletha imiphumela emihle. Futhi, ngiyaziqhenya ngokusebenza nezingane, ngoba zikhombisa eziningi ezinhle. Ngithokozisa impilo yami futhi ngithanda ukubona izinguquko ezinhle ezivela ezicini ezahlukene. Umbuzo 7: Ukubona izinguquko kwi-society yethu, kukhona okuthile okukhathaza? Nkk. Mthethwa: Yebo, kukhona. Ngibona ukuthi iningi labantu alikakhulumi ngokubaluleka kokunakekela izingane. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle. Izingane zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi uma sikhula umphakathi ophumelelayo, kudinga ukusondelana kwabantu bonke. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Nkk. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nezimvo ezibalulekile. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane kuyinselelo enkulu, kodwa kuhlobene nethuba lokwakha umphakathi oqinile. Ngithanda ukufakazela ukuthi kulabo abavula iminyango sokunakekela izingane, bahlala bekwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngiyabonga nonke abalandeli bethu, ngethemba lokuthi le ngxoxo izokwenza ubuhlakani bokunakekelwa kwezingane bube obukhulu. Ukuphetha Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akusikho kuphela ukugcina izingane ziphilile, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokhuthaza abakha ikusasa lethu.
Uhambo Lwansuku Zonke: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezithuthi Zansuku Zonke Uhambo lwansuku zonke luyingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi luhlobene kakhulu nezinguquko ezikhona empilweni yethu. Njengoba izimo zempilo zishintsha, abantu abaningi bakhetha ukuhamba ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze bafike emsebenzini, ezikoleni, nasemakhaya. Kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi lezi zithuthi zansuku zonke ziwusizo kanjani ekwenzeni impilo yethu ibe ngcono, noma zikhona izinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Izithuthi Zansuku Zonke Izithuthi ezijwayelekile zifaka phakathi izimoto, izithuthuthu, amabhasi, nezitimela. Umgwaqo osezingeni eliphezulu ubalulekile ukuze kube nezithuthi ezihamba kahle. Kunezindawo ezimnandi ezitholakalayo nezikhala ezithuthukisa ukuhamba, kodwa imithwalo yezemidlalo, izithuthi eziningi, nezithuthi ezindizayo zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obufanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokuhamba ezisebenzayo. Ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezithuthi zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuba amaphoyisa, abahlinzeki bezokuthutha, kanye nezishoshiso zomphakathi baphathe izidingo zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuhamba Noma kunjalo, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungabangelwa izinselelo. Izinkinga ezifana nokuhlala isikhathi eside emgibeni, ukuphazamiseka kwezokuthutha, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zihlala zikhona. Ukuze kube nokuhamba okuphumelelayo, iziphathimandla kufanele zikwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo zamashejuli, izixazululo zedijithali, kanye nezinhlelo zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo kungasiza ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Izinkinga zempilo zidinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngezokuphepha, ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile bephakathi kwezinye izithuthi. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Uhambo Ukuze uhambo lwansuku zonke luthuthuke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu babe nemininingwane ethile. Izinhlelo zokuhamba ezithuthukisiwe, ezihlanganisa izindlela zokuxhumana, izinhlelo ze-apps, nezinsiza zokuhlola izimo zokuhamba, zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imininingwane ethile futhi kuthuthukise uhambo. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokupaka engcono, izithuthi ezihamba phambili, nezinhlelo zokuphatha kwezithuthi zomphakathi kuyasiza ekwandiseni ukuhamba okuphumelelayo. Ukwakha Umoya Wokuhamba Ohlanzekile Njengoba sithuthuka, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuhamba okuhlanzekile. Izindlela zokuhamba eziphumelelayo zidinga izinyathelo zokunciphisa umthelela empilweni. Ukuze sithuthukise uhambo lwansuku zonke, kudingeka ukugqugquzela umphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokuhamba ezihlanzekile, ezifana nokuhamba ngezinyawo, ukugibela amabhasi, noma ukusebenzisa izithuthi ezibuyiselwa. Isiphetho Uhambo lwansuku zonke lunokubaluleka okukhulu empilweni yethu. Kuhle ukuba sihlole izithuthi zomphakathi, izinselelo ezikhona, nezindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zethu zokuthutha, sizokwazi ukuthola impilo engcono nephumelelayo. Uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumqondo obalulekile, futhi kudinga ukubambisana ukuze kube nokuphila okuhle sonke. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamizi neziphathimandla kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Engekho Nezinsiza Ngemva kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokudla zibe yinkinga enkulu emindenini engaqondile eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu kubantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude nasemakhaya. Ukuhlaziya le nkinga kudinga ukuthi sibheke izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona ukuze sithole indlela yokuphendula lesi simo. Izimbangela Zezinkinga Zokudla Enye yezimbangela eziyinhloko zokushoda kokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali ibangelwa ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanelekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla eziyisisekelo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokungabi nemali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, ezifana nokungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Futhi, izinkinga zendawo yokuhlala zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Ezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi ezisemakhaya, zidinga ukuthuthwa kwezinsiza zokudla ezifana nezitolo ezithengisayo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kokudla Ukushoda kokudla kubangela imiphumela emibi emindenini engaphansi kwemali. Izingane ezikhulayo zidinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze zikhule kahle, kanti ukuntuleka kokudla okwakha umzimba kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, ukungakhuli kahle, nezinkinga zokucabanga. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi emphakathini, njengoba izingane ezingenamandla zingakwazi ukufunda kahle esikoleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nokudla okwanele kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwandisa izindleko zezokwelapha. Lokhu kuyalwa nezindleko ezinkulu emndenini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinye izidingo ezisemqoka. Izixazululo Ezingenzeka Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emisha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokususwa kwezithiyo ezifaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kube nokwaziswa ngempilo phakathi kwemindeni, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi yikuphi ukudla okudingekayo ukuze bakhe imizimba enamandla. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ngemikhuba yokudla okunempilo zingabasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezinhle uma bezikhetha ukudla. Ukwakha izitolo zokudla eziseduze nezindawo ezisemaphandleni kungasiza kakhulu ekwehliseni izinkinga zokushoda kokudla, njengoba zingahlinzeka ngamakhasimende ukudla okuthengiswayo ngezindleko eziphansi. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali zidinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokubambisana ukuze zixazulwe. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi bangakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokudla. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze imindeni ikwazi ukuphila kahle, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Ama-Drone: Uhlanga Olusha Kwezobuchwepheshe Nokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Eminyakeni yamuva, ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe kubonakale kakhulu emikhakheni ebanzi, futhi phakathi kwalezi zinto ezisho ukuguquka okukhulu, ama-drone abambe iqhaza elikhulu. Ama-drone, noma ama-‘unmanned aerial vehicles’ (UAVs), asungulwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi asebenza ezindaweni eziningi okubandakanya ezokuphepha, ezokuthutha, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Lezi zindiza ezingathathi muntu ziguqule indlela umhlaba osebenza ngayo, zifaka izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, zikhulisa ukusebenza, futhi ziphendula izidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Igama Nencazelo Igama elithi "drone" libhalwa lishintshile kusukela enkathini yokusebenzisa abantu, liqhamuka ku-‘drone’ elichaza ithuluzi lempi noma ivenkile yempi. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone abhekisela ezindizeni ezingenamkhumbi, ezakhiwe ngezinto ezilula kakhulu nezisebenza kahle. Lezi zindiza zifakwe izinjini ezincane, izinhlelo zokubhalela, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile ezikuvumela ukuba ulethe imishanguzo, udlule ngaphezu kwezithiyo, noma uqaphele izimo ezithile zomhlaba ngokwenziwe. Ukusetshenziswa Kwezezimali Nezemidlalo Ama-drone asheshe avunyelwe emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Ekuqaleni, ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu ezindaweni zempilo, okuthiwa "drone delivery services," okuvumela ukuhanjiswa kwemishanguzo ezindaweni ezinzima ukufinyelela. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezifundazweni ezisemakhaya, lapho abantu behlangabezana nezinkinga zokuthola imishanguzo edingekayo. Uhlamvu lwezempilo lwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo ngokuqhubekayo, luthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone ahlonyiselwa izinjini zokubhalela ezithuthukile ziye zathathwa ngabathandi bezemidlalo, okuhlanganisa ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukugijima, nokunye. Lezi zinto ziveza ulwazi olunembile, futhi zithuthukisa ukufundwa kwezemidlalo, zenza kube lula ukugxila ezindaweni ezithile ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinselelo Nezinkinga Zokuphepha Nokho, nakuba ama-drone enza izinto eziningi ezinhle, ubuchwepheshe bawo bukhona nezinkinga. Ukuze ama-drone asebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokulawula ezimfanele. Ukuntuleka kwezinhlelo ezivikelekile, kudala ingozi yokusebenzisa ama-drone ngezindlela ezingekho emthethweni, okubangela ukungabikhona kokuphepha. Lokhu kuphinde kudinge izinqubo ezithile kumthetho. Izinkinga ezinkulu zihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa okungafanelekwanga kwamadrones, njengokubhekelwa okuphathelene nemfihlo, lapho ama-drone angase abhekelele abantu noma izindawo ezingafanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi, ohulumeni, nezinkampani zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kwehliswe lezi zinkinga, kufakwe imithetho eqondile yokusetshenziswa kwamadrones. Ikhono Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-drone abamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuthola ulwazi nezinsiza. Imithetho ethile isebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-drone asetshenziswa kahle, aqhubele phambili ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi akhulise amathuba okuthuthukisa imiphumela emihle. Ubuchwepheshe balo bulandela indlela yokwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo ekusesheni, kulinganise ukusetshenziswa okungafanele, ngaleyo ndlela kuphumelele ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Iziphetho Ngamafuphi, ama-drone ayizinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezithuthukisa izinqubo eziningi emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi zishintsha izindlela zokuphila zabantu. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezikhona ezidinga ukuhlaziywa ukuze ama-drone asindiswe ngendlela efanele. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ubambisene ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa ukuphepha nempilo yawo wonke umuntu, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-drone akha amathuba kumphakathi wonke. Iqiniso lokuthi lezi zinto zisebenza ezindaweni eziningi, libonisa ukubaluleka kokuhlola nokuqonda izinzuzo ezisa nazo uhlelo lokusebenza lwama-drone, futhi kuyasiza ekukhetheni ukuthi imiphakathi ifanele ukusebenzisa kanjani lezi zinhlelo ezintsha.
uBill Gates - Umphakathi Nokuphila Kwakhe UBill Gates ungumuntu odume kakhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, njengomtshali-zimali kanye nomphilanthropist. Uthathwa njengomunye wezinsika ezinkulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ngenxa ye-Microsoft, inkampani ayasungula ngo-1975. Nokho, ngaphezu kokuba nomthelela omkhulu, uGates ubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlala zikhona. Kule ngxoxo, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana noBill Gates, sikhulume ngempumelelo yakhe, izinselelo abhekana nazo, kanye nezinhlelo zakhe zomphakathi. Okokuqala, uBill Gates uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yezimpumelelo zakhe kwezobuchwepheshe. I-Microsoft, inkampani ayisungulile, yenza ushintsho olukhulu emkhakheni wekhompyutha, ivumela abantu abaningi ukufinyelela ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe. Ngaphambi kokusungulwa kwe-Microsoft, ubuchwepheshe be-computer babufinyeleleka kuphela kubantu abambalwa, okwenza uGates abe ngumuntu obalulekile emlandweni wezobuchwepheshe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba inkampani yakhe ikhula, uGates ubhekane nezinkinga zokuncintisana, okuhlanganisa ukusizakala ngamandla akhe ukuze agcine isikhala esikhulu emakethe. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abanye baphikise indlela imisebenzi ye-Microsoft ethinta ngayo umphakathi, bethi lokhu kungenza kube nzima kwezinye izinkampani ezincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBill Gates udlale indima ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngemva kokuthi i-Microsoft isiphumelele, wagxila ekusizeni abantu ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi nge-Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, enikezela usizo ezinhlelweni zokulwa nezifo, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, nokuphucula izimo zokuphila kwabampofu. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuhlakani obuhle nokukhathalela umphakathi. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi uGates usebenzisa izinsiza zakhe ukuze enze izinqumo ezithile ezithinta umphakathi, okuholela ekutheni kube nezindaba zokuhlukumeza. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu, njenge-Microsoft, zinezinzuzo ezihambisana nemiphumela emibi. UBill Gates uphinde abhekane nezinkinga ezithinta izwe, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Uthatha isinyathelo sokukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi akakwenzi kahle lokho. Ekugcineni, uBill Gates ungumuntu onomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kepha impumelelo yakhe kumele ihlolwe ngokuqhubekayo. Izinsiza zakhe zidinga ukubhekelwa ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. UBill Gates, ngempela, ungumuntu ophendulayo, kodwa izinqumo zakhe kufanele zihlolwe ukuze kuzuze umphakathi wonke.
uWinston Churchill: Umholi Ongaguquki Otwala Izenzakalo Zomlando UWinston Churchill uwumuntu ongakaze wamukeleka ngisho ezindleleni eziningi, emlandweni wesikhathi sakhe. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi abhekelele izinselelo ezinzima kakhulu emhlabeni. Njengomholi, inhloso yakhe yayihamba phambili, eqinisa umqondo wokuthi amandla amakhulu angavuselelwa ngezimiso nezimilo eziqinile. Ukuze siqonde kahle lo mholi, kufanele sihlole izici zempilo yakhe, izinqumo zakhe, nemiphumela yazo empilweni yomhlaba. UChurchill wazalelwa eLondon ngo-1874, esuka emndenini othembekile ngaphakathi kombuso. Ukhulelwa phakathi kwezimo zengqondo ezithile, ethola imfundo engaphezulu e-Harrow ne-Oxford. Umehluko wakhe kwenzeka ngesikhathi esebenza njengosokhulumeli, lapho athola khona ithuba lokukhanyisa umbono wakhe nobuholi. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayeka ukugxila kuphela ezindabeni zomphakathi, kodwa waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yomhlaba wonke. Ngokukhula kokungqubuzana kwezombusazwe, uChurchill waba yisithombe esiqinile sokulwa nodlame. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, waba ngumbangi ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kwakuhambisana nokuhlonishwa kwamasiko ahlukahlukene. Imibono yakhe ibonakala izimbali, inika umbono obalulekile wokuthi ubuholi bethu bukhulu kale uthando olukhangelekile. Uhlanganise izwi elichazayo, elikhombisa umoya wokunqoba emizweni yomhlaba wonke. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi, uChurchill waba nesandla ekwakheni i-United Nations, lapho abona khona ukuthi ukufuna ukuthula kumele kube ngaphambili kwezenzo ezikhalipheleyo. Ubelokhu edlula imingcele yokuphila kwangempela, ehlangabezana nezimpi eziningi. Imizamo yakhe yokwakha uthando phakathi kwezizwe yenza umthelela omkhulu emoyeni wesikhathi sakhe, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwezixazululo ezilungile. Ngokwenyama, ukwakhiwa komqondo okhulayo, uChurchill wenza uqhubekela phambili emphakathini. Ubuye waba nesandla ekuxhumeni izizwe, okuwusizo olukhulu ukuze kuhlonishwe abantu abavela kwiindawo ezahlukene. Ngemibono yezenhlalakahle, wakhuthaza ukuthula nokusebenzisana, nokwenza uMphakathi kukhulise izimpilo zawo. Nokho, uChurchill akazange ahlale yonke isikhathi izimo bezihlale zimnandi. Ubudlelwano bakhe nabantu abahluphekayo buyaqondwa njengokuphuthumayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinqumo zakhe zenziwa ziwubuhlungu; ngisho nalapho enza kahle kwezombusazwe, waphinde wahlinzeka ngemicabango ebanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuholi abuphathelene nje nezimpumelelo, kodwa kuyimfanelo yokubona imiphumela. Ukuhamba kancane kwezikhathi, uChurchill wavezwa njengesibonelo sokwenza okuhle noma ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Izinselelo zakhe zaphakamisa izinkolelo zethu zokuqhubeka; izinhloso ezithile, zomsebenzi wakhe, zathi zikhulisa umqondo wokuthi isenzo sithi makube namandla, yize sikhumbula phambili. UBuyela emuva kubuholi nezimilo zethu, asibona umoya wakhe ongapheli. Emiphumeleni yakhe, uChurchill waba nezinhlinzeko, okwakuhambisana nobuchopho obubanzi nezinhloso ezinkulu. Umphakathi usala emasikweni akhulayo akhuluma ngezinsizakalo Zakhe, okwakungahambisani nephutha. Ubufazi obuhlukahlukane buthuthukisa imikhawulo enye emphakathini, okwenza kube lula ukusungula udumo. Njengoba sihlola izimpande zomlando, uChurchill ufakazela uthando olungapheli. Ngesikhathi sokudla umhlaba, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili, waba ngumbangi ophambili walokhu kokuhlupheka, wathola imiphumela yokuba ngumbangisile. Ubufakazi bokukhanya kukakhanyiselwa kuyabhalwa emlandweni, ubufakazi bokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha umlando. Ukwazi okwengeziwe ngempilo nempumelelo yabo, uChurchill uyilanga elithokozisayo. Iziqhamo zokuhola, sibona ngokukhula, zibalulekile. Nakuba abanye bephikisana ngemikhuba yakhe, kuphinde kubonakale ukuthi uthando, uthando lobuholi, nezehlakalo zivela kuphakathi. UChurchill umemela ithuba lokuthokozela umhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuholi bukaChurchill buphathelene nempumelelo enkulu. Ubufakazi bokuphikelela, ukubekezelelana, neqiniso lokuba uphayona emhlabeni, kuni nesihe samazwe amaningi. Kuwumphumela omkhulu izinqumo zakhe ezinkulu, nemiphakathi ewumthombo wezinhlelo ezithile. Ukhankasela najengabe, umholi, njengoba sibhalela umlando. Ngokuphetha, uWinston Churchill ungumphakathi obaluleke kakhulu, esinika isibonelo sokuthi ubuholi buphathelene nezimo ezinzima. Likhona itilosi lapha; sithokozisa izinqumo zethu, sikhuthaza ukususa izithiyo. Ubuye waba nesandla ekutholeni impumelelo, sikhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa futhi sikhumbula ithuba lokuqhubeka. Wena mholi ongenakuphikiswa, uthumela umyalezo wokuthi ngisho ezikhathini zansuku zonke, umbono awakhambe yini ngempela!
Isingeniso IMicrosoft iyinkampani enkulu emhlabeni wonke, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezinqubo zayo zokwakha isoftware, imikhiqizo, nezinsizakalo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe. Yasungulwa ngo-4 kuMfumfu 1975 nguBill Gates noPaul Allen, futhi ithole udumo olukhulu ngokwakha iWindows, okuyisoftware yokusebenzisa imishini yokusebenza esetshenziswa ezigidini zabantu emhlabeni. Lokhu kwenza iMicrosoft ibe yinkanyezi kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezinhlelo zokusebenza. Umgomo neMikhiqizo IMicrosoft inezinjongo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa umgomo wayo omkhulu uwukuphakamisa ukusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kusebenza kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo ezahlukene, ezifana neMicrosoft Office, iAzure, neXbox. IMicrosoft Office ihlanganisa izinhlelo ezinjenge-Word, Excel, ne-PowerPoint, ezisetshenziswa kakhulu emisebenzini, ezikoleni, nasezikhungweni. I-Azure, ngakolunye uhlangothi, iyinsiza yokugcina idatha, yokwenza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, esiza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Xbox ibonisa ubuchwepheshe bokudlala, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Izinguquko Zebhizinisi IMicrosoft ibonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emsebenzini wayo, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. Ngemva kokuphumelela kweWindows, inkampani yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi ezihlanganisa izidingo ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi ekusebenzeni kwe-inthanethi kanye nezinsizakalo ezivamile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudluliselwa kokwakhiwa kwe-software ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene kumakhasimende. IMicrosoft ikwenze kahle lokhu ngokwandisa imikhiqizo yayo, nokuhlinzeka ngesoftware nezinqubo ezizokwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Enye yezinto eziphawulekayo ezithuthukisiwe yiMicrosoft izinhlelo zayo zokufunda ngomshini, ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokucabanga komshini. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwe-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ezinsizweni zayo, okubandakanya ukukwazi kokuthi izinhlelo zisebenze ngenqubo yokufunda ezithombeni, ezwi, nezinto eziphilayo. Ukusungulwa kwe-AI kuMicrosoft kudale amathuba amaningi, okwenza kube lula ukuphathwa kolwazi, ekuboniseni izixazululo ezithile kumakhasimende. Ukwakha Izenzo IMicrosoft ibuye ibhekelele izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi. Ilwela ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude nezisemadolobheni, ukuze bonke abantu bathole ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu, futhi abantu abaningi badinga ukufundiswa ngendlela yokusebenzisa lezi zinsizakalo. Ukuphathwa Kwemikhiqizo IMicrosoft iphatha imikhiqizo yayo ngendlela ehloniphekileyo, ibheka izidingo zabathengi bayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokweseka, ezisiza abathengi bokugcina nabakhiqizi ukuba baqonde futhi basebenzise imikhiqizo yabo kahle. Lezi zinsizakalo zifaka ukufundiswa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezikhethekile ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusebenza kahle. Ukubheka Esikhathini Esizayo IMicrosoft ibheka phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zayo, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe obusha. Kulindeleke ukuthi izinkampani zisebenze ngokubambisana, zihlola izindlela zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuguqula izinqubo zokuphatha, ukuhlinzeka ngobuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili, nokwenza kube lula ukusebenza. Isiphetho Ngokujulile, iMicrosoft iyinkampani eyinhloko emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, esiza abantu abaningi, izinkampani, nezikhungo ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Ubulungiswa bokuphatha, ubuchwepheshe obuphelele, kanye nezinqubomgomo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kuveza ukuthi iMicrosoft izimisele kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kungenzeka ukuthi le nkampani izothola izixazululo eziphakeme, ezithinta kakhulu impilo yabantu, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza emhlabeni. Izifundo ezitholakala kuMicrosoft zifaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, ogxile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bonke.
Umculo we-Gospel: Uhlanga Olwakha Uthando Nokuqonda Umculo we-gospel ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulu yomculo, futhi uhlanganisa izici eziningi ezithokozisayo nezibalulekile empilweni yamaKristu. Kodwa, njengoba umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokwanda, kube nezinkulumo eziningi eziphikisanayo mayelana nendlela umculo lo okumele ubonakale ngayo, izinjongo zawo, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nomculo we-gospel, futhi sizokhuthaza ingxoxo ebanzi ngale ndaba. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungumculo ophuma enhliziyweni, futhi uhambisana nezinkolelo zenkolo. Uhlanga lwawo luthinta imizwa, lukhuthaza, futhi luhlinzeka ngethemba kulabo abawulalelayo. Ngakho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza ukholo, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Lokhu kubonakala emishinini eminingi ye-gospel, lapho abaculi bechaza izinselele zabo, bezama ukwabelana ngothando lukaNkulunkulu. Nokho, abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngokuqhubeka komculo we-gospel. Bakholelwa ukuthi umculo we-gospel usuphenduke umkhiqizo, udinga ukujolisa kumakhasimende kunokuhlonipha izinjongo zawo zokuqala. Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kwemali edlalwa emicimbini ye-gospel, lapho abaculi behluleka ukugcina ubumsulwa bomculo wabo. Lokhu kungase kube yinkinga, njengoba umculo we-gospel ungase ube yinsiza yokukhuthaza, kodwa uma uphenduka umkhiqizo, ungase uphumelele kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kube sekuphazamiseka umqondo wawo wokuqala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela emphakathini. Abaculi abaningi be-gospel baphumelela ekwakheni imiphakathi ethokozisayo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngothando, bahlabelela, futhi baphile impilo enothando. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi ungakhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina le miphakathi ibumbene. Kodwa-ke, kumele siqaphele ukuthi umculo we-gospel awuwona umculo owodwa, kodwa uhlanganisa izitayela eziningi ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo we-gospel ungavuma ukufaka izitayela ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-hip-hop, i-R&B, kanye ne-blues. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungaba yindawo yokuhlanganyela kwezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi ungakhuthaza abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Nokho, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukwamukela izitayela ezihlukahlukene kungaphazamisa umqondo wokuqala we-gospel, okungase kube yinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungaba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinkolelo zenkolo. Abaculi be-gospel bahlala bephakamisa izinkolelo zabo, bencenga abalandeli babo ukuthi baphile impilo enokholo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enobuntu, futhi baphile ngokuhlonipha abanye. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina lezi zinkolelo zihlala ziqinile. Ekugcineni, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza, ukuxhumana, nokwakha imiphakathi ethokozisayo. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nomculo lo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezingxoxo eziphusile mayelana nendlela umculo we-gospel okumele ubonakale ngayo. Kumele sihloniphe izinjongo zawo zokuqala, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuba yinsiza yokukhuthaza uthando, ukholo, kanye nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-gospel ungaba yindlela yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, uma siqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza umculo lo ube yinsiza ethokozisayo nehloniphekile.

Waqamba izindlela ezintsha zokulwa, ezazihlanganisa ukusebenzisa izikhali ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezindlela zokuhlela eziphumelelayo. Ezokudoba: Umcimbi Wokukhulisa Imiphakathi Nokuqinisa Ubudlelwano Ezokudoba zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Umcimbi wezokudoba, owawubanjelwe emfuleni uMgungundlovu, wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo, ukufundisana, nokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko zokudoba. Lokhu kwenzeka ngempela, njengoba abathandi bezokudoba, abathengisi, nabahlali bendawo behlangana ukuze babelane ngolwazi, izindlela, nemiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Umcimbi waqala ngempelasonto, lapho abantu beqoqana emfuleni, behamba ngezinyawo, behamba ngezikebhe, futhi bekhuluma ngezinto ezihlukahlukene ezihlobene nezokudoba. Izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli. Abadala bahlala phansi, bexoxa ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokudoba, besebenzisa izindlela zendabuko ezivela ezizukulwaneni ezedlule. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo, njengezinkuni nezinye izinto ezitholakala emvelweni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi udobo lwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yokufundisa, lapho abanye bezokudoba befundisa abasha izindlela ezahlukene zokudoba. Kwakukhona izifundo ezithokozisayo, ezifana nokusebenzisa amakhono okudoba, ukuqonda izilimi zezilwane zasemanzini, nokuhlonipha imithetho yokudoba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yezilwane zasemanzini, nokubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yemvelo. Abafundi babebonisa intshiseko enkulu, bephakamisa imibuzo, futhi bejabulela ukufunda ngalezi zindlela ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waba nethuba lokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu babezokwazi ukwabelana ngezinto abazitholile emanzini. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezinhle, izimfishane ezinkulu, nezitsha eziningi ezazigcwele ukudla okuhle. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuhlonipha imiphumela yokudoba, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yabo. Abaningi babebonisa ubuhlakani bokuphila, bejabulisa abanye ngempilo yabo yansuku zonke, futhi bebonisa ukuthi ukudoba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezinye izinhlelo, ezazihlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, njengemidlalo yokudoba, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bekhombisa amakhono abo. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi ezinkulu, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bejabulisa abantu ngokukhetha okuthile. Kwakukhona umjaho wokudoba, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bejabulisa umphakathi, bejabulisa nabangane babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yokukhuthaza, lapho abathandi bezokudoba befundisa abantu ngezindlela zokugcina imithombo emihle. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngempilo yezilwane zasemanzini, nokubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yemvelo. Abaningi babebonisa intshiseko enkulu, bephakamisa imibuzo, futhi bejabulela ukufunda ngalezi zindlela ezithokozisayo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wezokudoba wawuwumcimbi ophumelelayo, owavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yemvelo, nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephinde behlanganyela, futhi bejabulisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokuhlonipha imithombo yemvelo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe izindlela zendabuko zokudoba. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, nokukhuthaza ukuthi imiphakathi ihlale ibambisene, ikhulise umnotho, futhi iqinise izindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wezokudoba uzoba yinkumbulo emnandi, futhi abantu bazohlala bekhumbula izifundo abazitholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nemiphumela emihle yokuhlangana. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yabo, futhi bazithokozise ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Umcimbi wawuwumcimbi ophumelelayo, owavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yemvelo, nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko.
Isingeniso Ibhola lomnqakiswano, elaziwa kakhulu njenge-basketball, liyithuba elidumile emhlabeni jikelele. Lo mdlalo wasungulwa e-United States ngonyaka ka-1891 nguJames Naismith, futhi usuphenduke umkhiqizo wezokungcebeleka, umjaho wezinkanyezi, kanye nendlela yokuhlanganyela kwabantu. Ibhola lomnqakiswano linezithameli ezinkulu, kusukela ezikoleni kuya ezingeni lempumelelo, futhi linomoya ophakeme wokuhlanganyela. Kuleli bhakede, sizobuyekeza ibhola lomnqakiswano, sihlolisise izici zayo ezithokozisayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emphakathini. Izici Ezithokozisayo Zombhoxo Umdlalo we-basketball udinga abadlali abanezinhloso ezifanayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola phansi, ukudlula, kanye nokuphosa, okudinga amakhono ahlukahlukene, njengokusheshisa, ukugijima, nokuphosa. Umphakathi ubona ukwakheka kwabantu kuhle, njengoba abadlali badinga ukuxhumana ukuze bafeze imigomo yabo. Umphakathi ophakathi kokudlala, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana, unikeza ithuba lokubambisana. Izinzuzo Zempilo Nezokuhlalisana Ibhola lomnqakiswano, ngaphandle kokuba umdlalo owaziwayo, linikeza nezinzuzo ezinkulu zempilo. Ukudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano kukhuthaza ukuzivocavoca, okukhuthaza impilo enhle. Lokhu kudala izimo ezithuthukisa amandla, ukucabanga, kanye nokuphathwa kwempilo. Abadlali baqeqesha imisipha yabo, baqeqesha izinga lempilo, futhi bahlala bephila kahle. Umphakathi uthola izinzuzo, njengoba umdlalo uhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano linikeza ithuba lokuthola amakhono amasha, ukwakha ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuqonda imithetho yomdlalo kudinga ukucabangela nezenzo zomphakathi, okuthuthukisa umphakathi njengoba abadlali beqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha abanye. Umdlalo Wokuncintisana Umdlalo we-basketball ungumjaho wokuncintisana, okuholela ekutheni abadlali bazithuthukise. Izimpi zihlala ziba nezinselelo, okukhuthaza abadlali ukuba balwe umphumela omuhle. Abadlali bangowabo, kodwa umphakathi ubahlanganisa, bafenya izinjongo ezihambisanayo, okukhuthaza umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umgomo Wezobuchwepheshe Ubhola lomnqakiswano luthuthuke kakhulu ngobuchwepheshe. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, ubuchwepheshe buhlanganiswa emidlalweni, izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinsiza zothando ziba yinsiza enkulu kubadlali. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba nezici ezithokozisayo, njengoba abadlali bekhuthazeka ukuthuthukisa imikhawulo yabo. Imiphumela Emphakathini Ibhola lomnqakiswano linomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Umdlalo unikeza amathuba okukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana, bahloniphe, futhi bahlanganyele. Ukubamba imicimbi ye-basketball kungaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, okukhuthaza ukuhlela izenzakalo ezithuthukisa umphakathi. Isiphetho Ibhola lomnqakiswano liyinto ethokozisayo edinga abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, banikeze umphakathi ithuba lokukhula. Lo mdlalo uhlinzeka ngezinzuzo eziningi, kusukela empilweni yomuntu siqu kuya emiphakathini. Umjaho wokuncintisana, izici ezithokozisayo, nezindlela zokuhlalisana zenza ibhola lomnqakiswano libe umdlalo ohlukile. Ngakho, wonke umuntu ungaba yingxenye yomphakathi we-basketball, ubambe iqhaza, futhi ufinyelele empumelelweni, okubalulekile ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi ohloniphekile.
Izokuxhumana Nomphakathi: Ukusungula Ubuhlobo Kanye Nokwakha Ukwethembeka Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi (public relations) zidlala indima ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Njengoba izinkampani, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano zikhula ngokushesha, kumele zazi ukuthi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu akusho kuphela ukuxhumana ngezinto ezithile, kodwa kusho ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile nokuhlonipha izifiso nemibono yabantu. Ngokuya kwesimo samanje, sengibona ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sithathe lesi sikhala sithandazele ngokwakhiwa kobuhlobo obenziwe ngothando, ukuqonda, nokwethembeka. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi akuyona nje indawo yokukhangisa, kodwa kuyisisekelo sokwakha isithombe esihle senhlangano. Kulokhu, izinkampani kufanele zibe necebo eliqinile lokuxhumana elithokozisayo, eliyingxenye ethokozisayo yamasiko nezidingo zomphakathi. Kunezinto eziningi ezisemqoka okufanele zicatshangelwe, futhi kufanele sihlole indlela lezi zinto ezithinta ngayo ubudlelwano bezimpahla ezikhiqizwayo nezikhungo zomphakathi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthanda nokungathandi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zabo, ukuzwa imibono yabo, nokubahlola ukuze baqonde izinkampani. Ukucubungula indaba yomphakathi, izinkampani zidinga ukukwazi ukwakha umkhiqizo noma insiza ehlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izenzo zami zenkampani kufanele zibe nemiphumela engathuthuka, okwenza umphakathi uqaphele nokuthi kumele uxhumane nezinhlaka ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Okwesibili, ukuziqhenya ngempumelelo zabo kufanele kube yisisekelo esinamasiko ahlukahlukene. Imiphakathi esetshenziswa kwizinkampani ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho inkinga zokukhangisa zikhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nezinhlelo ezakhiwe ngempela, ezikhuthaza imiphakathi ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Isibonelo, izinkampani zingaxhumana nezinkampani ezivela endaweni ukuze zakhe amakhono nezinhlangano ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ziqhube izinhlelo zokwakha imiphakathi emihle. Okwesithathu, ukuthuthukiswa kobudlelwano bezindaba kufanele kube yiqiniso. Akukhona nje ukuba ne-press release noma izincwadi ezibhalwe kahle; kumele kube noxhumano oluqinile nolwazi oluqondile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zikhulume ngezenzakalo zazo kodwa futhi zibe nezinto ezizocacisa ukuthi zikhona ukuze zisebenzise. Njengoba kuxhumana nababambiqhaza, kubalulekile ukuba baqhubele phambili umoya wokuxhumana, benza umphakathi wazi kahle ngalezi zindlela ezithinta izinkampani zomphakathi. Okwesine, ukuziphatha kahle kumqoka. Ukuthi uhlelo lokuxhumana luthuthukiswe nje kuphela ukuze lubonise izifiso zokukhumbula, kodwa futhi kube neqhaza elithile lokusebenza. Ukuze ukwazi ukuba yinkampani ethandwayo, kudinga ukuziphatha okulungile.
