Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziphendule imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, zithathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuqonda izinkinga zomphakathi futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona ezindabeni. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bumqoka kangakanani, uma ungathobeli izinqumo zomphakathi, izinkampani zizoswakswe indawo zabo ngemiphumela engathuthuki. Ekugcineni, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi kufanele ziqhubeke zishintsha njengoba umphakathi ushintsha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele sibe nethuba lokuhlola izindlela zokuxhumana ezintsha, sidlulele phambili kumanani nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Kulokhu, kumele sikhumbule ukwakha izinqubo ezihambisana namagama esithombe sethu. Izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi izinkampani ezizithola zihamba phambili emishinini yokuxhumana kumele ziqhubeke sawula izinkanyezwayo ezivela ezingqungqutheleni zomphakathi, zinikeze abantu indawo yokulalela abahlanganyela khona. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto zonke, izinkampani zingakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzozuzisa bobabili - izinkampani kanye nomphakathi. Zizoba nezindlela zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene nezindlela ezithokozisayo. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi akuyona nje imikhuba yokukhangisa, kodwa kuwumsebenzi woke, owamukeleka, nokufundisa. Ngakho, mela izinkampani, ukuqinisa ubuhlobo nemiphakathi, zazi izinkinga ezithinta izimpilo zethu, bese zikhuluma ngempela. Kulokhu, sizobona imiphumela emihle, futhi umphakathi uzoba nempilo engcono.
Isingeniso Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ukuthi ukufunda akukhona nje ukuthola ulwazi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umqondo, ukwazi ukuqonda izwe esiphila فيه. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokufunda lihlala liwumgogodla wobuchwepheshe, inhlalakahle, kanye nezinga lempilo elihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukucabangela izimbangela zokuhluleka noma zempumelelo kwabafundi, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizothuthukisa izinga lokufunda. Izici ezithinta izinga lokufunda Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lidinga ukubhekwa kumqondo obanzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici eziningi, njengokufundiswa, ukuphathwa kwezikole, kanye nezimo zomndeni. Uma sifunda, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abafundi bangabantu abahlukene, abanezimo ezihlukile, izifiso, nemikhuba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, indlela abafundi abaqondiswa ngayo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kudinga ukuba zihluke ukuze zifanele wonke umuntu. Ngokwesibonelo, izikhungo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezincwadi, amakhompyutha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukufunda. Lokhu kuyabakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bazibandakanye, bahlakulele amakhono okucabanga, nokufunda ngendlela ethokozisayo. Nokho, uma lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abafundi bangasala bejwayele ukungafundi kahle. Indima yomfundisi Ngakho-ke, indima yomfundisi ibalulekile. Umfundisi onekhono akavuli nje umnyango wokufunda, kodwa futhi udala isimo esikhuthazayo. Umfundisi kufanele abe khona ukuze akhuthaze, ahlolisise, futhi abheke ukusebenza kwabafundi. Lokhu kudinga ukuphawula okusezingeni eliphezulu, ngoba abafundi bahlala bephendula kahle uma bezwa ukuthi umfundisi uyabakhathalela. Umfundisi odlala indima efanele uyavula amathuba okuphumelela, futhi uthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabafundi. Izimo zomndeni Ngaphandle kokufundiswa, izimo zomndeni nazo zinemphumela omkhulu. Abafundi abaphuma emindenini enezinkinga, njengokushoda kwemali, ukungalali kahle, noma ukungabi khona kokusekela, bavame ukuba nemiphumela emibi ekufundeni. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, kanye nezimo zokuhlala nazo zingaba nomthelela. Uma umndeni udinga ukuxhasa, kufanele kubekhona uhla lwezindlela ezihlukene zokweseka, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufeza amaphupho abo. Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uthola ithuba elifanele lokufunda. Ubuchwepheshe bokufunda Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bube nomthelela omkhulu ekufundeni. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, izifundo ezikwi-intanethi, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ziye zathuthukisa indlela abafundi abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi ukufunda kube lula, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle. Kodwa-ke, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokuphela kwendlela yokufunda. Kubalulekile ukubhekisisa ukuthi kungani abafundi behluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kuthiwani uma umphakathi ungakabi nesiqiniseko sokuthi ukuthola ubuchwepheshe kuyatholakala kubo bonke. Ukubambisana komphakathi Uhlanga olukhulu lokuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lutholakala ekubambisaneni phakathi kwemiphakathi. Uma imiphakathi ibambisana nezikole, kudala izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthiwe kulula ukuvuselela izinga lokufunda. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu, sihlinzeke ngezinsiza, futhi siphendule ezidingweni zabafundi. Isiphetho Njengoba sithanda ukufunda, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi alikona nje ukushaya amaphuzu ezivivinyweni, kodwa kuyindlela yempilo. Kuhle ukuqonda ukuthi abafundi bahluka, banelungelo lokufunda ngendlela ehlukile. Umphakathi, izikole, nabafundisi badinga ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze kube nempumelelo. Ngakho, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokufunda, siqinisekise ukuthi sonke sithola ithuba elifanele lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuqhamuka nezinqumo ezithembekile. Lokhu akusizi nje abafundi, kodwa kuthuthukisa umphakathi wonke.
Izinsuku Zokuqala Zama-Social Media: Uhlanga Olwakha Umhlaba Wokuxhumana Ngonyaka we-1971, umhlaba wabona inguquko enkulu uma umyalezo wokuqala we-imeyili uthunyelwa. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuxhumana okuhlangenwe nakho ngefoni, okwakukhuluma ngebanga elikhulu lezakhamizi ezazizokwazi ukuxhumana ngaphandle kwemikhawulo yesikhathi nolwazi. Njengoba iminyaka yayiqhubeka, amandla okuxhumana aphesheya kokuthi ulwazi lungadluliselwa kalula, alithola ungeqondi. Ngonyaka we-1997, i-website eyaziwa ngokuthi iSixDegrees.com yathokozisa umhlaba ngenkathi ibonisa umqondo wokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu. Lesi situs sethula izici zokuhlanganyela, kugcina kube yisiqalo se-social media njengoba siyazi namuhla. Umqondo wokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okwakuhlanganisa ukuxhumana kwabanye, kwavula indlela yokuthi abantu bawamukele kabanzi amasejima okuhle nabanye. Ngemva kwalokho, ngo-2003, kwavela iLinkedIn, ipulatifomu ehloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngesikhala sokuxhumana kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ezahlukene. Kwaba yinkanyezi eziletha abantu ubumqoka bezokuxhumana kwezebhizinisi. Ukuthi uhwebo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani kungenziwa ku-inthanethi, kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana kabanzi phakathi kwabantu abavela emhlabeni jikelele. Kodwa, izikhathi zashintsha ngesivinini sokuqhamuka kwezinye izinkundla ezinzima. Ngo-2004, iFacebook yathuthukiswa futhi yachuma ngokushesha. Lesi site sathola ukunakwa kwabantu abaningi abavela ezintweni ezahlukene. Abantu bakwazi ukusungula amakhasi, ukwabelana ngezithombe, nemicabango yabo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo, izigameko, kanye nemicabango engokwenyani, okuhlanganisa abantu phakathi kwezimfuno zabo nezifiso. Ngemuva kwalokho, ngo-2006, kwaphuma iTwitter, eyayihloselwe ukuxhumana okusheshayo. Ubudlelwane bovimba obubhalwayo bekuhlanganiswe ne-tweet, okuvumela abantu ukuthi babelane ngolwazi ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqhakambisa umqondo wokuthi abantu bangabelana ngemicabango yabo ngokuqondile, okwaholela ekutheni iTwitter ibe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthumeleni imiyalezo esheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ngo-2010, iInstagram yathuthukiswa, igxile ekuhlinzekeni abasebenzisi ngezithombe ezisheshayo kanye nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaqhubekela phambili umqondo wokuqala wokuheha abantu kusuka kumavidiyo ukuya ezithombeni, okwakudinga ukuthi ubudlelwano bube nemikhuba ethile. Ukuthi izithombe zithokozisa, kwavula indlela yokuxhumana yokubona izinto eziphilayo, okuwubuhlakani bokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Esikhathini samanje, ama-social media awashintshile kakhulu. Imithombo yezokuxhumana njengamaTikTok, WhatsApp, kanye neminye yehlushwa kahle, inikeza abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela, ekwakheni ubudlelwano ezikhuthazayo. Abantu basenweba inethiwekhi yabo yabadlali abahlala bexhumana, babona amandla nobuhle balesi sikhala. Kodwa, njengoba ukuxhumana kwandile, kuphinde kuvele nezinselelo. Umbhalo wesigameko sobuzwe ubhalwe ngokuphuthuma, izindaba zezinhlaka zingase zibe lula, kepha kube engcupheni yemiphumela engafanele. Ukuqonda ubuhlungu bokuxhumana okungafanele bukhona; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsuku ezinzima zingakhinyabeza ubudlelwano nobungane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphepha nokuziphatha zisaqhubeka zikhula. Ubuqotho bokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiyalezo iyahlonishwa, njengezithombe nokubhalwa kwezindaba, kube yinsiza ebalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa umqondo wokuthi ubudlelwano obwakha phakathi kwezokuxhumana kufanele buhlonishwe, kuhambisane nezindinganiso ezivunyiwe. Nokho, ama-social media awaphumi ngokuphelele ekutheni anika abantu ithuba lokuxhumana ngezindlela ezinhle. Noma kunzima, ubuchwepheshe obusha buyaphuma njalo, buvikela izimo ezintsha zokuxhumana. Ubufakazi bomsebenzi wabo bukhuluma kakhulu, lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ama-social media azoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wethu, kuze kube sekupheleni. Ngakho, njengoba sihamba kancane ngaphakathi kwalezi zinsuku ezinzima, sesikhona ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi eziwusizo kithi. Ama-social media asihlanganisa, asihlanganisela, asithokozisa; futhi nokho, kudingeka sihlale siqapha indlela esisebenzisa ngayo lezi zinsiza. Lokho kumfumbezi ozokwenza siqhubekele phambili ngethuba elisha, ngethemba lokwakha umhlaba omuhle, okunobudlelwano obunempilo. Ezinsukwini ezizayo, ama-social media ayoba yisixhumanisi sokugcina sokuxhumana. Kufanele sihloniphe umqondo wokuzethemba, silungise izikhathi zethu zokuxhumana, sizibophezele emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzodala ubudlelwano obuqinile, obuqinisa ingqikithi yokuxhumanisa ezizayo. Futhi sizodinga futhi sihlale sihamba phambili, sihamba nohlanga lokuxhumana, ukwakha umhlaba obumbene.
Amanani Okudla: Izinguquko Nezinkinga Ezingaqhamukayo Ngonyaka ka-2023 Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezimeni zamakhosikazi okudla. Ukuze sithole umbono ocacile, sithumele abaphenyi bethu ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze siqoqe imibiko evela kubathengisi, abathengi, kanye nochwepheshe bezomnotho. Izizathu Zokwenyuka Kwamamanani Ukukhula kwamamanani okudla kuxhomeke ezintweni eziningi, njengokusebenza kwezimo zezulu, izindleko zokuhamba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka. Izimo zezulu ezinzima, njengezikhukhula nezomiso, ziye zabangela ukuncipha kokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezisemqoka, okukhokelela ekwenyukeni kwam prices. UProfesa Thandi Nkosi, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uthe: “Izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinkinga zokudla. Uma umkhiqizo uncipha, amanani akhuphuka.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhamba ziye zanda ngenxa yokunyuka kwamanani wamafutha, okuholela ekuphakamiseni kwamamanani ngababathengisi. UJohn Mthembu, umthengisi wezokudla eGoli, uthe: “Sibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Amanani okudla akhuphuka njalo, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka kubathengi bethu.” Imiphumela Kubathengi Abathengi bahlushwa kakhulu yizinguquko kumanani okudla. Ukuze bahlale bephila, abaningi badinga ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezindlekweni zabo. UThandi Dlamini, umama onabantwana abane, uthe: “Ngiyazama ukusindisa, kodwa amanani okudla awavumeli. Ngithenga okuncane, ngidinga ukukhetha phakathi kokudla nezidingo ezisemqoka.” Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani okudla akuthinti kuphela abantu abavamile, kodwa futhi kubangela ukwanda kwezinga lokungabi nalutho. UProfesa Nkosi uthe: “Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani okudla kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungabi nalutho, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethinteka kakhulu.” Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo ezizimele seziqalile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Izinqubomgomo zokuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi, zibe nezixazululo ezibalulekile. UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa kweZolimo, uMnu. Sipho Mkhize, uthe: “Sizama ukwandisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka abathengi ngamanani aphansi.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, imizamo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwezinsiza zokudla, njengokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhambisa, ibalulekile. UProfesa Nkosi uthe: “Ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuthutha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kokudla, okuzokwehlisa izindleko.” Isiphetho Amanani okudla aseNingizimu Afrika abhekene nezinguquko ezinzima, futhi lezi zinguquko zinemiphumela eminingi kubathengi. Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungabi nalutho, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Nokho, izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ezifana nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuthutha, zikhombisa ithemba lokuthi umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ezidingekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola ukudla okuphumelelayo, okungabizi kakhulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abalimi, nabathengi kuzodingeka ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile. Njengoba sikhangisa phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokwenza umnotho wethu ube namandla, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemisebenzi Nezimpilo Zethu Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana ziye zaba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, okwaziwa nangokuthi "information technology," kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwane, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngolwazi phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela obuphatha ngayo izimpilo zethu, imisebenzi yethu, kanye nezindlela esixhumana ngazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zathuthuka kakhulu. Ekuqaleni, abantu babephila ezikhathini lapho ukuxhumana kwakwenziwa ngokuthumela izincwadi noma ngocingo olungabizi. Kodwa-ke, namuhla, sinesikhathi sokuxhumana esiphumelelayo, esisheshayo, futhi esihlukahlukene. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-WhatsApp, Facebook, ne-Twitter ziye zaguqula indlela esixhumana ngayo. Lokhu kwenze kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi, ukuxhumana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Okwamanje, ubuchwepheshe bukhona emhlabeni wonke, futhi izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukile zokuxhumana ukuze zifinyelele kumakhasimende azo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ukuze ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okukhuthaza umnotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhombisa izinzuzo eziningi empilweni yomuntu. Ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, kudingeka sibe nolwazi olwakhiwe kahle. Ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buvumela abantu ukuba baphumelele ekufundeni, bakhe amakhono, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi babe nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele. Noma kunjalo, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukukhula kwezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuholele ezinkingeni ezithile, ezifana nokungabikhona kokuphepha kolwazi. Abantu bahlala bephazamiseka ngezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba izinkampani zihlala zibhekene nezinsongo ezivela kubaphangi be-inthanethi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha eziqinile ukuze zivikela ulwazi lwamakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buphinde buveze izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abanye abantu bahlala bejolise kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuxhumana okuqondile. Lokhu kungaholela ekudambiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bephila ezweni eligcwele ubuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe bunikeza izinzuzo, akufanele buphumelele emhlabeni wabo. Ngokubuka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezithuthukile zokuxhumana. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo. Izinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye kumele basebenzisane ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ovulekile ekwabelaneni ngolwazi. Ekugcineni, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buye bahlala bujolise ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba siqinisekise ukuthi sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sakhe ubudlelwane obuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, singaqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphumelela empilweni yethu, futhi buhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Izinguquko Nezinselelo Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekubalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhula komnotho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo zokuphila kahle zikhuthaze uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo ukuba benze izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi. Nokho, lezi zinguquko ziza nezinselelo eziningi. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Uhulumeni, ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi, usungule izinhlelo eziningi zokwandisa ukufinyelela kukagesi emakhaya. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezitholakala kalula, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumakhaya angakatholi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umehluko phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola ugesi kanye neyangaphandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abangenamali zikhona, lapho uhulumeni enikeza izinsiza zokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza kukagesi, njengezikhungo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela enempilo, futhi baphile kahle. Izinkinga Ezingaphazamisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga eziningi ezithinta ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezikhona zihlala zinganele. Izindawo ezisemaphandleni zihlupheka kakhulu, futhi abanye abantu basathola ugesi kuphela ngezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuphatheni izidingo zansuku zonke, njengoba ugesi usetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, ezifana nezikole, ezibhedlela, nakumakhaya. Okwesibili, izindleko zokufaka ugesi emakhaya zihlala ziphakeme. Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokufaka ugesi, ikakhulukazi uma behlupheka. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye bahlale bephila ngaphandle kukagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila impilo efanele. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokubambisana Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi, kanye nemiphakathi. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezibandakanya imiphakathi zingasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezizwakalayo. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, zingasiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze baphile kahle, futhi baphumelele emikhakheni ehlukene. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokutholakala Kukagesi Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akusikho kuphela isidingo sokuphila, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokufinyelela kukagesi okungaguquki. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akuyona nje into ethinta izindlu, kodwa kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Ngonyaka wezi-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yahamba emzuliswaneni omkhulu wokuguqulwa, lapho izakhamizi zokuqala zavuza amalungelo azo okukhetha. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esiyingqayizivele embhalweni wezwe, njengoba izimpande zalesi sikhathi ziqhamuka emlandweni onzima we-apartheid. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukubheka izizathu, izinyathelo, kanye nemiphumela yokhetho luka-1994. Ukhetho lwezi-1994 lwakhelwe phezu kokubambisana phakathi kwezixazululo ezizayo ezazisemqoka, lapho abaholi bezenkolo nezombusazwe behlanganyela, kanti uNelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, waba yisithonjana sokuphakanyiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlupheka, imibhikisho, kanye nezinkulumo, kwavulwa indlela yokuthuthukisa izifunda ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngaphambi kokhetho, izinsuku zixhunywe nezinqola zokukhulumisana, ezaqhakambisa imikhankaso yokuvota. Abantu bebebonisa imizwa emihle, behambele izikhangiso eziningi ezazihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezehlakalo nokuxhaswa kwemikhankaso. Lokhu kwaba ithuba lokuvumela izakhamizi ukuthi zikhulume ndawonye, zishintshe imibono, nezinsiza zokwazisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo ezithathwe ezinyangeni ezingama-90, zaveza izinkinga ezinzima ezazithinta umphakathi. Kwakusobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yayidinga uhlelo oluhlangene ukuze ibhekane nokuphikisana okuvuthayo kokuhlukana phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ukubambisana kwezombusazwe, okwakuhlanganisa abaholi bezenhlalakahle, abanye bezakhamuzi, nesikhumbuzo sokuhlukaniswa, kwavula indlela yokwenza ibhande lesikhathi esisha, nawe ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlobo. Izwe laseNingizimu Afrika lavuleka ezindleleni zokuvota, lapho uphiko lwe-ANC lwamukela imiphumela emihle yomsebenzi walo maqondana nokuhlonishwa kwamaqiniso emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko, ngoba kwabeyisisekelo sokuguqulela ubuholi obufanele somnqamulajuqu, njengoba uMandela esebenza khona phezulu. Ngokwecala lokhetho, abasebenzi bezeNhlangano yezenzakalo zomphakathi baphakanyiswe ukuziphatha ngendlela efanele, njengoba izikhumbuzo zomlando zanezela udumo emithonjeni yezenzakalo. Umthelela wokhetho luka-1994 wawuphakeme, kuwukuphuma ebuhlungwini bokuhlukumeza, kwavula umnyango wokujabulela imiphumela yokuthula nothando. Kubalulekile ukusikhumbula ukuthi, nakuba izigameko zokhetho zibe nomphumela omuhle, umsebenzi omningi wawusafaneleka, njengoba sahlasela imikhakha eyisicefe, njengezikhala ezisemthethweni ngezinkinga zobuhlanga. Ngokwezimali zomphakathi, kube nomuzwa ophakathi, nobulunga buphakanyiswe kwazulu. Abahlala endaweni yokuxhumana nokuxhumana kumsingathi bazi ukuthi ukhetho lwabathakathi luhamba phambili. Ukwenza kube ngcono izwe, ububha obunje neholi ezingahambisani nezindinganiso nokuziphatha ngendlela efanele, kwaqhamuka izinselele ezintsha. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana phakathi kwezihlahla, phakathi kwezinhlangano ezihlukene nezabaqhamuki. Ukuhweba ngezihlahla ezihlukene, njengezinkampani eziphila ngamafutha, zihlala zibhalwe emlandweni, njengomoya omusha wokuhweba. Njengoba imizamo yokwakha iNingizimu Afrika engcono iqhuba, kube khona ubunzima obukhulu, kodwa ubudlelwano bomhlaba bobabili - iNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe - buphinde buqinise umphakathi. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lwathela imiphumela emihle, nezinkampani ezibhekele ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe zavula amasango emisha. Umphakathi ungabuyiselwa emlandweni, njengoba ubuholi bukaMandela, kanye nezindlela zokuhlanganisa, zakhuthaza izinkulumo eziqinile ngemiphakathi emibini. Imisebenzi yokuphakanyiswa kokuhlalisana phakathi kwezizwe yayiphakamisa umoya wokuhlanganyela, lokho kube yisisekelo sokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ekupheleni, ukhetho luka-1994 lwalungasenza sikhumbule ngezehlakalo ezimqoka, ukuze sithuthukise iziyaluyalu zomphakathi. Lolu hlelo luchaza umbono, lapho umuntu ngamunye ethatha isikhumbuzo sokuqala sokuhola, asize ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika esebenzayo. Izakhamizi zanikezwa ithuba lokuba yizakhamizi zomhlaba, nokubakhumbuza ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhanya ngempela uma zisebenza ndawonye.
Ezobuhlakani Bokwenziwa: Ukuqonda Nokubaluleka Kwayo Emhlabeni Wanamuhla Isingeniso Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa (Artificial Intelligence, AI) kusemqondweni wokwenza izinto ezithile zenzeke ngokwahlukana ngaphandle kokufaka ukucabanga kwabantu. Le nqubo yokwakha ubuhlakani obufana nobomuntu ibalulekile emhlabeni wezemfundo, ezobuchwepheshe, nezomnotho. Lokhu kubaluleka kuveza ukuhlakanipha kokwenza izinqumo, ukufunda, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo, okwenziwa ngama-algorithms nemishini. Umlando wobuhlakani bokwenziwa Ubulukhuni bokwakheni ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvela emkhakheni wezinye izifundo ezinjengoMthetho, Isayensi, neZibalo. Ukuqala kwayo kunxulumene nokuqulwa kwemibono emisha ngeminyaka ewu-1950, lapho abacwaningi basebenzisa izinkanyezi zamakhompyutha ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizenzakalelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, imizamo yokwenza imishini eqonda ifana neyezenzo zomuntu yathi nemizamo yokukala imikhiqizo yokubala kwahuqulwayo. Manje, amakhono e-AI asebenza ezindaweni eziningi, eziningi zazo eziyiphikisa. Izinhlobo ze-hlakani bokwenziwa Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa zihlukaniswa ngezigaba eziningana. I-AI engaphansi (Narrow AI) igxile emisebenzini ethile, njengokuhumusha ulimi, ukwazi ukuhamba, noma ukudlala imidlalo. I-AI ephezulu (General AI) ingakha ukuqonda okunjengokwakhiwa komuntu, ikwazi ukufunda nokwenza izinqumo ezinzima. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-AI ethuthukisiwe (Superintelligence) ibonisa ukucaciswa okuphezulu, okungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingaphezu kwemikhawulo yomuntu. Ubuchwepheshe be-AI Ubuchwepheshe obusekelwa ku-AI buqukethe imishini yokufunda (machine learning), imishini yokufunda kwemishini (deep learning), kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuqonda ulimi (natural language processing). Lezi zindlela zisetshenziswa kabanzi emikhakheni ebanzi, njengemisebenzi yokuphatha, ukwelapha, kanye nezokuxhumana. Imishini yokufunda ikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nedatha ethile, kuyilapho imishini yokufunda kwemishini ikhipha imiphumela ethuthukisiwe ngokusebenzisa amanethiwekhi ajulile. Izicelo ze-hlakani bokwenziwa Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa zisebenza ezindaweni eziningi zempilo yansuku zonke. Umphakathi ubona izinzuzo kukhuluma kwethu, uma kuxoxwa ngobuchwepheshe bokuhlola izifo, ukwakhiwa kwezikhumbuzo, kanye nokusebenza kwamasistimu okuphathwa kwezimali. Kanjalo, ibhizinisi liphumelela ngempumelelo ngokusebenzisa ama-AI ezinhlelweni zentela, ukucwaninga kwemakethe, kanye nezokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa abuyona nje ithuluzi, kodwa yindlela ebalulekile yokuphucula ukusebenza okungapheli. Izingozi nezinselelo Noma izinzuzo ze-AI zifakazelekile, zikhona nezinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwazo. Ukwenza izinqumo ezizenzakalelayo kudinga ukucabangela izinto ezifana nobulungiswa nokuphepha kwedatha. Izingozi ezinjengokuthi indlela yokuphatha idatha ingaqhamuka nezingozi ezimphakathini, ngakho ukufaneleka kwezombusazwe nokuxhaswa kwemithetho kubalulekile. Okwamanje, ukuvikeleka kwabantu nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo ze-AI zisebenza ngendlela ehlelekile kuyinkinga ethinta abacwaningi, osomabhizinisi, nabaphathi. Ukwakhiwa komhlaba munye ophumelelayo Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziletha ithuba lokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo. Kukhona umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI, okubangela ukuba sizwe izinzuzo zokwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa ngendlela ethanda ukwakha impilo engcono, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, ukuphucula imfundo, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, neminyango eyahlukene kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eqinile nehlelekile. Isiphetho Ngokubuka phambili, ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziza nezinketho eziningi ezisebenzayo nezitholakala kumakhono. Ukwenziwa kombono wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo zalolu hlobo. I-AI, njengoba ikhula, izoba yinhlanganyelo ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ohlakaniphile, onobuchwepheshe, noshintshe kahle. Kungakho kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinguquko umazisi uhambisana nazo njengoba sizele phambili emhlabeni onezinselelo eziningi. Amaqhubu ethu okuphila kahle adinga ubuhlakani nokuhlinzeka kwethu, okwenza i-AI ibaluleke kakhulu ezindleleni zethu zokuphila. Ngakho, ngesikhathi sobuhlakani bokwenziwa bukhula, izwi lokusebenza, ukucabanga, nohambo oluhlangeneyo luzofaka isandla kulokhu ukukhanyisa umgwaqo ukuya phambili.
Ezomlando: Ukubaluleka Kwezinto Esizifundile Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, akukhona nje okukhona manje. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ezomlando zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi ziqondisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi izinto ezenzeka eminyakeni edlule zenza ukuthi sibe nohlu lwemibono nezinkolelo? Ngakho, masiqale kule ndaba ethokozisayo! Ukuqala, sizobheka ukuthi yini ezomlando. Ngokujwayelekile, ezomlando zifaka phakathi izenzakalo, abantu, nezindawo ezibalulekile. Umqondo wokuthi "ukufunda emlandweni" ungase ubonakale ungajwayelekile, kodwa empeleni, kungenxa yokuthi lezi zinto zifana nezikhumbuzo ezithile. Zisitshela ukuthi singenza kanjani okungcono, siphinde sikhumbule ukuthi izinto azihlali zishintsha. Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikhumbule abaphambili bethu. Abantu abafana noShaka Zulu, uNelson Mandela, noHendrik Verwoerd. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani sikhumbula laba bantu. UShaka, ngokwesibonelo, wayengumholi ophumelelayo, owashintsha kakhulu izimpi nezinqubomgomo zamasiko. UNelson Mandela, yena, usikhumbuza ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa futhi usinika ithemba. Ukukhumbula lezi zinkanyezi zomlando kusinika amandla okwakha ikusasa el better. Ngokuphathelene nezindawo, akusiyona nje imizi esiyazi, kodwa nezindawo ezibalulekile ezifana neShaka's Kraal, iRobben Island, neGugulethu. Lezi zindawo zikhumbuza izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa futhi zikhombisa amandla abantu. Ziyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, zikhumbuza ukuthi sithathwa kanjani, futhi zikhombisa indlela esihamba ngayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezomlando zikhona emhlabeni wonke. Akukhona nje eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa nasemhlabeni jikelele. Izwe ngalinye linomlando walo, futhi lezi zindaba zihlala zibalulekile. Ukufunda ngezinye izizwe, izinkolo, nezinkolelo kungasivulela umqondo omusha. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sibe nobudlelwano obungcono nabanye abantu. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi ezomlando zikwazi ukusifundisa ngezinto ezimbi? Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhumbula izimpi, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga ezibuhlungu. Lokhu kufundisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa kumele sikhumbule nezikhathi ezinzima. Lokhu kungenza sibe nokuqonda okukhulu, futhi sithole indlela yokuphila ngokuhlonipha abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezomlando zikhona ezikoleni. Abantwana bethu kufanele bafunde ngempela ngalezi zinto. Ukufundiswa kwezomlando akukhona nje ukufunda izinsuku ezithile, kodwa ukufundiswa kwezifundo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi baphuma kuphi, futhi benze kahle ekwakheni ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezomlando zihlale zishintsha. Njengoba sithola izinsiza ezintsha, izincwadi, nezinsiza zedijithali, kumele sibe nekhono lokuhlola lezi zinto. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sithole izimo ezihlukahlukene zomlando, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona nje okukhona, kodwa kukhona okungakaze kubonakale. Ngokuphetha, ezomlando zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi ziqondisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngakho, asifundi nje, kodwa masithathe isikhathi sokucabanga nokuqonda. Lokhu kuzokwenza siphile impilo engcono, sikhumbule abaphambili bethu, futhi sibe nekhono lokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha, futhi ngithemba ukuthi le ngxoxo ikwenze ucabange kabanzi ngezomlando. Hamba kahle, futhi ungakhohlwa ukubheka emuva ukuze uqonde kahle ikusasa!
Amaqembu Ezepolitiki: Iqhaza Labo Emphakathini Wethu Amaqembu ezepolitiki ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu, futhi awakwazi ukugwenywa uma sikhuluma ngempilo yezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithokozisa izinqumo ezithathwayo, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki adlala kanjani indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano nolwazi. Ngokujwayelekile, amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlukaniswa ngezinhloso zawo, izimiso zawo, kanye nezithakazelo ezihlukene. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhethe ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elihambisana nezimfanelo zabo, izifiso zabo, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bekhetha amaqembu azoholela ezinqumweni ezithinta ukuphila kwabo, kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zinkampani zisebenza kanjani. Ngokwesibonelo, amaqembu amaningi akhona eNingizimu Afrika ahlale ebheke izidingo zabantu abampofu, ababhekene nezinkinga zokungabi namisebenzi, nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki angaba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ezinye izinkampani zingase zibe nezithakazelo ezihlukile, okungaholela ekutheni ziguqule izinqumo zazo ukuze zifanele izifiso zabantu abathile kuphela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki awamukeli kuphela izinkinga zomphakathi, kodwa futhi adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwawo nabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bezepolitiki. Uma abantu benza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo, kufanele bazi ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, futhi bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle okukhona phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezithinta amaqembu ezepolitiki, okuhlanganisa ukungabikhona kokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungaboni ngaso linye, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingabi nempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, hhayi kuphela phakathi kwabo, kodwa futhi nabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakhuthazwe ukuba babe neqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlale ebheke izidingo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela izithakazelo zabo. Ngokubheka phambili, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza emisebenzini yezepolitiki, ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinezimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, futhi bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Amaqembu ezepolitiki kufanele abe yinsika eqhubekayo yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano nolwazi, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila. Ngokuphetha, amaqembu ezepolitiki adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Kumele sibe nekhono lokukhetha kahle, sikhumbule ukuthi izinqumo zethu zinezimpilo zethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki, nabantu, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezithinta izinkinga zomphakathi. Amaqembu ezepolitiki kufanele abe yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, onobulungiswa, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sibe neqhaza elihle empilweni yethu, futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi – Ukuhlola Emhlabeni Wanamuhla Ukubhikisha kwabafundi sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezikhungweni zemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ubuhlakani nezinselelo abafundi abahlangabezana nazo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zibhikisho, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu ezisemqoka, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zivele. Izizathu Zokubhikisha Abafundi bahlangana ukuze baveze izizathu ezithinta impilo yabo yokufunda. Izimo ezinjengohlelo lokufunda olungasebenzi kahle, imithetho engahambisani nezidingo zabo, kanye nezindleko zokufunda eziphakeme zenza abafundi bazizwe badinga ukuveza izinkinga zabo emphakathini. Ngokwesibonelo, ukubhikisha ezikhungweni ezinkulu, njengezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, kubonisa isidingo sokuhambelana nezifundo nezidingo zempilo zanamuhla. Abafundi abaphuma emkhakheni we-IT bangase bahlupheke uma imfundo ethuthukile ingatholakali, okukhombisa ukuthi ukufunda kahle kubalulekile empilweni yabo. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha ingahluka kakhulu. Kwezinye izimo, iziphakamiso zabafundi ziyaqashelwa, okuholela ezinguqukweni ezinhle njengokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokufunda noma ukwehliswa kwezindleko. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abafundi kufanele bahlale bejabule futhi baphakamise izinkinga zabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, kwezinye izimo, ukubhikisha kungaholela ezinkingeni, njengokuphazamiseka kwezemfundo, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ekufundeni kwabo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Kubhalwe ukuthi abafundi baphakamise izinkinga zabo ngendlela ehloniphekile, ngokuxoxa nezikhungo zemfundo, ukubamba imihlangano nezikhulumi, noma ukuvula izingxoxo nomphakathi. Ukubambisana nabanye kungasiza ekwakheni umfanekiso ophelele wezinkinga ezikhona, okuzodala umphakathi ophumelelayo lapho abafundi bezokwazi ukuveza izinjongo zabo. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha kwabafundi kuyisiko elibalulekile elikhombisa amandla abafundi ekuphenduleni ezinkingeni ezithinta impilo yabo yokufunda. Nakuba kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokubhikisha, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ukuze abafundi baphumelele, kudinga ukuba bahlale bephakamisa izinkinga zabo futhi bejabule, bazi kahle ukuthi izinguquko zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukugxila ezinkingeni, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono kwabafundi.
Ezokuphathwa Kwezinhlekelele Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni omncane iMahlabathini, kwavela izinkanyezi zensuku ezimnandi. Abantu babehamba bejabule, bejabulisa imindeni yabo, bephuza amanzi abandayo, futhi bejabulela umoya opholile. Kodwa, njengokujwayelekile, izinhlekelele azikhumbuli isikhathi noma indawo. Kwathi ngempelasonto, umoya uqala ukuhamba ngamandla, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, futhi izinkanyezi zaphenduka zaba neziphithiphithi. Umoya omkhulu wathumba izihlahla, wakhukhula imizi, futhi izikhukhula zaqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Umphakathi waba nesaba, ubona izinkanyezi zishintsha zibe yizinkanyezi ezimnyama. UThandi, umphakathi wezokuphatha izinhlekelele, wayesebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabantu bendawo, ehlela izinyathelo ezidingekayo. “Sidinga ukuhlanganisa imithombo yethu, sibe namasu okuphuma kulokhu,” kusho yena, ebona ubuhlungu obubangelwa yilesi simo. Kwathi lapho behlangana, uThandi wacacisa ukuba kudingeka bakhe ithimba lokuphendula. “Kumele sithumele abanye abantu ukuba bahlale emaphakathini ahlaselwe, sithumele izinsiza ezinjengezimpahla zokudla, amanzi, nezinto ezisemqoka,” wathi. Abantu babenokukhathazeka, kodwa uThandi waba nesibindi. “Kukhona okukhona, kodwa kumele sibe namandla.” Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uThandi wahamba nebhodi labantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Bafika ezindaweni ezithintekile, behamba ngezinyawo, bephusha izimpahla ezidingekayo. Umoya wawubhubhisa, kodwa ubuhlungu babantu babubavumela ukuba baqhubeke. Babebona izimpahla ezimnandi, umoya opholile, kanye nezinhliziyo ezivulekile. Kwathi lapho befika endaweni ethintekile, babona abantu bejolise ezindaweni ezithintekile. Okwakukhona, izindlu zibhujiswe, abantwana bebhalela emanzini, futhi abantu babezama ukusiza omunye nomunye. UThandi waqonda ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqumo eziphusile. “Sizokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala, sizokwenza izindawo zokugcina izimpahla, sizokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo,” wathi, enza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile. Ngesikhathi abantu bephuma, uThandi wahlangana noMama Nandi, umama omkhulu emzaneni. “Ngiyabonga, mntwanami, ngokuba lapha. Uthando lwakho luthokozisa,” kusho yena, ebheka uThandi ngamehlo agcwele umusa. UThandi wamukeleka, wathi, “Siyabambisana, Mama. Noma yini esingayenza, sizokwenza.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, izinhlelo zikaThandi zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Izikhungo zokuhlala zakhuliswa, abantwana bathola ukudla, futhi abantu baqala ukuvakasha izikhungo zokwelashwa. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi abantu bamlandela, beqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bukhulu kakhulu. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umphakathi wathola amandla. Izindlu zakhazimula, abantu babebuyela emsebenzini, futhi umoya wathokozisa. UThandi waba neqhaza elikhulu, waba yisibonelo sokuphila okukhululekile. “Siyakwazi ukuphila, sithanda, futhi sikhumbula,” wathi, ebheka abantu abajabule. Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wathokozisa, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, kodwa umphakathi wawukhumbula. UThandi wayazi ukuthi izinhlekelele zikhona, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwayo zenza umehluko. “Siyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithanda, futhi sihlanganyele,” washo, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nomoya opholile. UThandi, noMama Nandi, nabanye abantu, bathola amandla okwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Izinhlekelele zaba yizifundo, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo busemandleni. Ngaleyondlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuphila, esikhumbuza abantu ukuthi, noma izinhlekelele zikhona, ubudlelwano, uthando, nokuhlanganyela kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umoya wathokozisa, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, kodwa umphakathi wawuphila, wakhula, futhi waqhubeka.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile Umbuzo 1: Yini amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile angamafutha amanzi anobumsulwa futhi awanazo izifo. Akukhona nje ukubukeka kwawo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze siphile, izilwane, nezitshalo zibe nempilo. Amanzi ahlanzekile akhuthaza impilo enempilo, futhi ahlale efaneleka ukusetyenziswa ezindaweni zokudla nasemiphakathini, njengoba izinga lawo lithinta impilo yethu. Umbuzo 2: Kungani amanzi ahlanzekile ebucayi? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile ukuze siqhubeke siphila kahle. Amanzi angahlanzekile angaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezifo nezinkinga ezahlukahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanzi ahlanzekile adinga ukugcina imvelo iphila, asiza izitshalo nezilwane. Ngakho, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile empilweni yemiphakathi yethu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinsiza eziqhubekayo zokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Ukuze sithole amanzi ahlanzekile, kudinga imithombo ethile njengezithombe, izigodi, nemithombo emihle. Ukuze amanzi abe ahlanzekile, kumele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlanzwa, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinto eziphuzwayo. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanele, njengezinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi, kungasiza ekwandiseni ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 4: Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Kukhona izinto eziningi esingazenza ukuze sigcine amanzi ahlanzekile. Okokuqala, kufanele sigweme ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, okuhlanganisa ukuhoxisa imfucumfucu, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo enokungcolisa, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela. Futhi, izinhlelo zokubhaliswa zidingeka ukuze abantu benze kahle. Umbuzo 5: Kuthinta kanjani amanzi ahlanzekile izimpilo zomphakathi? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile athinta izimpilo zomphakathi ngokuqondile. Uma abantu bethola amanzi ahlanzekile, lezi zinto zinciphisa izinkinga zezempilo, njengezifo zokudla. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukuziphatha kwabantu nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezamabhizinisi. Futhi, uma amanzi ahlanzekile ekhona, umphakathi ujabulela impilo engcono. Umbuzo 6: Yisiphi isimo samanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni jikelele? Impendulo: Isimo samanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni jikelele sikhathazekile. Ezinye izindawo zithola amanzi ahlanzekile kalula, kodwa ezinye zibhekene nezinselele zokungcola. Izimo zezulu nezinsiza ezikhona zihlala zithinta imithombo yamanzi. Kunezinhlelo ezihamba phambili, kodwa kusekhona imiphakathi ethola amanzi angahambisani nezidingo zabo, okudingeka izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 7: Kukhona yini izinhlelo ezikhona zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi zomphakathi nezamazwe wonke eziqhubekayo ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka amaphrojekthi okwakha izinsiza, imithombo yokuhlunga, kanye nemfundo kubantu mayelana nokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Imali ethile iphumeza imithombo yokuhlola amanzi, ukusiza ukugcina izinga lempilo. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayenza njengomphakathi ukuze sisekele amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Njengomphakathi, singagqugquzela izinhlelo zokuhlalisana ezithinta ukuphathwa kwamanzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa amanzi kahle, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana nemiphakathi yendawo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ukwazi ukuvikela amanzi ahlanzekile kuzothuthukisa umoya wokulondoloza phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe amakhono ezokuhlanzeka amanzi awama ikhono lokuziphatha kahle? Impendulo: Impela, amakhono ezokuhlanzeka kwamanzi afuna ukuthi sithole ulwazi olunembile. Lokhu kuhilela ukufunda ngezinto ezihamba phambili, izingozi ezithinta amanzi, kanye nezindlela zokuziphatha ezihlukene. Sonke singaba nezinsiza zokuvikela amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezihlalayo. Isiphetho: Izinselelo zikhona, kodwa umphakathi unamandla okwenza umehluko. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile kudinga ukuba sithandazele impilo engcono, ukuze sithole ubuhle bemvelo bokuphila. Njengoba sikhuluma ngamanzi ahlanzekile, asijoli lapho—phaqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophephile, onempilo, kanye nomoya wokuhlalisana. Amanzi ahlanzekile, impilo enempilo!
Umbiko: Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni Isingeniso Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Zihlinzeka ngempilo, ukwelashwa, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Kuleli thuluzi, sizobheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta izibhedlela zikahulumeni, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zikhungo. Uhlaka lwezibhedlela zikahulumeni Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu. Izibhedlela ezincane, ezivame ukuba sezingxenyeni ezisemaphandleni, zihlala zinikeza imisebenzi eyisisekelo, njengokwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukwelashwa kwemindeni, kanye nokunakekelwa kwezifo ezilula. Izibhedlela eziphakathi, ezivame ukuba seziqhingini noma emadolobheni, zihlala zinikeza imisebenzi ebanzi, okubandakanya izinsizakalo ezithuthukile zokwelapha. Izibhedlela ezinkulu, ezivame ukuba seziqhingini ezinkulu, zihlala zinezinhlaka eziningi zokwelapha, zifaka phakathi iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa okukhulu, iziguli ezisengozini, kanye nezinsizakalo zeziguli ezikhethekile. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa odokotela, abahlengikazi, nabanye ochwepheshe bezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho kudingeka khona ukwelashwa, bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezihlukahlukene. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazi ngalesi sikhathi, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izivakashi zabo, nokuthi bazi ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. Izinselelo Noma zikhona izinzuzo eziningi, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu abaningi. Izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nokuntuleka kwezinsiza, okuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, imishini yokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izibhedlela zingabi namandla okuphendula izidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokuphathwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Izixazululo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngempahla eyanele, kubandakanya izinsiza zezimali, imishini yokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezempilo kuzokwenza ukuthi baqhubeke nokuthola ulwazi olusha, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuxhumana oluphumelelayo phakathi kwezibhedlela nezindawo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Isiphetho Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Noma zikhona izinselelo eziningi, zihlala ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubantu abaningi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zisebenza kahle, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziyisibopho sokuhlinzeka ngempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze zisebenze kahle.
Ubulili: Uzimiso Lwenkululeko: Ubhubhane lwezinkumbulo neziqubulo zika-2023 Umgwaqo omuhle, izinsuku ezimnandi kanye nomoya opholile ungenisa usuku lokukhumbula nokuhlonipha - uSuku lweNkululeko. Le njabulo ibanjwa minyaka yonke eNingizimu Afrika, ihlonishwa ngokuhlanganyela kwababebandayo, ovavanaphaneli, and abavoti abanolwazi, bonke behlale behlonipha izimpumelelo ezinkulu zenkululeko esiyifinyelele eminyakeni edlule. Usuku lweNkululeko lwenziwa emaphandleni nasemadolobheni, okwenza ukuba kubonakale isimo sabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Kulesi sikhathi, abantu basendaweni ehlukahlukene, bejabulile futhi behleleka, bathokozisa umoya wempumelelo kwazulu nabaphila kuloluhlu lwezizathu. Izikhumbuzo zempilo, ukwelela ezingeni eliphakeme, zisondeza imiphakathi ukuze ibambisane, ibonakale ifuna uthando nokuhlonipha kwesikhumbuzo esiyisisekelo. Umpetha wokukhumbula, umphakathi wigubha izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwe abaholi benkululeko phakathi neminyaka engama-90. Izinkumbulo ezithokozisayo, lapho umoya wokuzikhandla ubonakaliswa khona, uyakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bencintisana, beyahlala bezama ukufinyelela izigcawu ezithuthukile ezithinta izidingo zempilo, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. UZwelakhe Mbatha, ongumholi ophakathi kwezinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngezimvo zenkululeko, ukhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngempilo yabo nokuthi bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ukuze balondoloze isiko nemigomo emihle. Uhlelo lokugubha luqukethe imicimbi ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkulumo zomphakathi, imicimbi yokuhlomula, kanye nezinselelo zokuwina imiklomelo emiphakathini. Uhlelo lemicimbi luhlanganisa izifundo ezithinta izifundo zenkululeko, nemihlangano ethokozisayo ezindaweni ezihlukene, edalula ubuhlakani nabantu bendawo abasidelelayo ngesiko nemigomo yolwazi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni, izikhungo zezifundo, kanye nezifundiswa bahlanganyela ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile futhi bahloniphe izigigaba zomlando ezikhombisa indlela yimina nethemba lesizukulwane esizayo. Ngokwendlela lo mkhosi obhubhayela ngayo, ububanzi bempumelelo bulokhu bukhula, kusiza ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zokukhula kwezemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zempilo ezihloniphekile. Izinhlelo ezikhona zenziwa ukwazisa umphakathi ngempumelelo yomhlaba wonke, kuthembisa ukuthi azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuliseni ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Iziqondiso zenkululeko nezinselelo zoxhaso zempilo ziba yizinsukuzakhe, zenza umoya wokuthi onke amaqhawe azothola isikhala sokukhuluma, baveze ubuhlakani babo, bayokhombisa ukuthi bakuqonda kahle ukubaluleka kokuba nezwi elikhulu. U-Emmanuel Ndlovu, umcwaningi, uveza ukuthi lezi ziqondo ziba nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni umnotho omkhulu, ngamandla esizukulwane esisha elubambene phezulu. Linhlanga yokuphisa umoya, umoya wokukhumbula nezimiso zomphakathi uhluza izimpendulo ezimnandi. Ngokuhlanganisa abantu abanhlobonhlobo, sithola imiphumela ephusile ezweni lethu. Ziningi izindleko zamakhanda ezikhulisa amagama emiphakathi, ezinhlelweni ezithinta indaba yamalungelo abantu nokuhlonishwa. Ukhumbula ukuthi uSuku lweNkululeko luhlala luhlaza, kube khona imizamo yokwenza kube phezulu. Umphefumulo walesi sikhathi uhamba kahle kuzo zonke izimpande zomphakathi, kuqhakambisa izinkumbulo zomlando ezikhumbuza abantu ngeqhaza elibi ezimpi zempilo, ukukhimiza uNtu nokukhuthaza ukukhipha imiqondo emisha. Uhlanga olwakhayo kuzothi lwangcazela, abavoti bazophaka ubuntu, benze izinqumo ezinobuhlakani. Lokhu kuhlanganyela, ngamandla omphakathi, kuhlonishwa phakathi kwabazali nabakhokhelwayo, kuzokwenziwa ukuthula, imiqondo yokwakha izwe eliphumelelayo, okuyoqhubeka. Umgwaqo wempumelelo unzima, kodwa umoya wokujabula, ubumbano nezinqumo eziphusile kuqinisekisa ukuthi uSuku lweNkululeko ngeke lwenqabe. Yiqiniso, uNsuku material, njengoba ubuhlungu besikhathi buyavela, kuhlonishwa kahle kuso sonke isikhathi. Uhambo lwakhe luhamba phambili luhamba ngokucacile phakathi kwabanikazi bazo zonke izifunda, ikakhulu kufinyelela nezigaba ezitholakele. Ngakho, uSuku lweNkululeko wukukhumbula ukuphila, ufunde imikhuba emisha, ubumbane nomoya wesikhumbuzo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhula ngothando, ifaneleka, futhi inenhlonipho, idlulele phambili ikhuluma ngempumelelo yezenzakalo ezenzeka emhlabeni wethu.
Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Iphrofayela kaThabo Mthethwa UThabo Mthethwa, umshayeli wamatekisi oneminyaka engu-35, uhlala edolobheni elikhulu laseGoli. Njengomuntu osebenzela ukuthola imphilo, uThabo ungena emsebenzini wakhe nsuku zonke ekhangisa izinkanyezi zempilo ezihlotshaniswa nokuhamba. Noma ngabe imoto yakhe inezinhlaka ezinhle, uthola ukuthi izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zikhula kakhulu. Njengomuntu ohlangabezana nezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi ukuhamba, uThabo uthembisa ukuba yisithombe esicacile sokukhathazeka kwabashayeli bamatekisi. Uqala indaba yakhe ngokukhuluma ngokuqonda kwakhe ngesimo sezinto. "Uhambo lokuhamba ngamatekisi luhluke kakhulu. Kunezikhathi lapho izigidi zabantu zikhona, futhi lokhu kudala umnotho omkhulu kuma-taxi," kusho uThabo. Nokho, njengomshayeli, ubona izinselelo ezihambisana nale mboni. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu uThabo abhekana nazo yizithuthi eziningi ezisemgwaqweni. "Izimoto zikhona yonke indawo, futhi lokhu kudala izithiyo ezinkulu," eqhubeka esho. UThabo ubona ukuthi lokhu akubangeli kuphela ukungabi nankinga kokuhamba, kodwa futhi kungaphazamisa izinsiza zamanje. Esikhathini lapho umgwaqo uphakathi kokuba ubuhlungu, uThabo uphinde ahlangabezane nezimo ezinzima zokuhlala esikhathini sokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo uthola ukuthi abanye abashayeli bamatekisi bahlasela impilo yabo. "Abanye bethu bahlushwa yizinkinga zezimali. Imithetho emisha ibiza imali yokuthenga isikhumbuzo, futhi abanye basuke bephila ngosuku nosuku," echaza. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izinkinga ezinjalo ukuze kwandiswe ubuchwepheshe bokuhamba. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi abashayeli bamatekisi bangabambisana ukuze benze izinkinga zibe lula ngokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwezithiyo zomgwaqo, uThabo ubona isidingo sokuthuthukiswa kwezokuphatha. "Izinkampani eziningi zikhona, kodwa abanye abashayeli basakhungathekile. Umkhakha awusebenzi kahle," kusho uThabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukungabikhona kwemithetho efanele kuchitha kahle ithuba lokuthola izinzuzo. UThabo uthi udinga ukuxhumana nabanye abashayeli ukuze bazitholele izixazululo. UThabo ubona ukuthi i-technology idlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni uhla lwezinkinga. "Izinhlelo zokusebenza ziye zaqhubeka, kodwa abashayeli abaneziqu kufanele baqhube izicelo zabo," echaza. Lokhu kudinga uchwepheshe bezokuxhumana ukuze baphendule izinkinga ezinzima ezivela kumakhasimende nabashayeli. UThabo uqinisekile ukuthi uma abashayeli besebenza ndawonye, bangakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. UThabo uthi, "Sidinga ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabashayeli nabathengisi." Ubonisa ukuthi lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu. UThabo ubonisa isigaba esisha sokuhamba ngamatekisi, lapho abashayeli bengakwazi ukuxhumana nezinkampani ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga, uThabo uhlale eqinile. Uthi, "Ngiyazi ukuthi izinkinga zikhona, kodwa uma siphumelela, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili." UThabo ungumholi phakathi kwabashayeli bamatekisi, futhi uthanda ukusiza abanye ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene. Ubonisa ukuthi ukukhula komkhakha kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. UThabo Mthethwa ungumshayeli wamatekisi onobuhlakani obukhulu, ohlangabezana nezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi wakhe nsuku zonke. Noma izinkinga zikhona, uThabo uveza ithemba lokuthi uma abashayeli begxila ekuthuthukiseni uhla lwezokuhamba, bazoba namathuba amahle kakhulu. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani, ubumbano, nokuzinikela kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wamatekisi, futhi uThabo uhlala ekulindeleni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ubudlelwano: Ukuhlola Izici Zokuxhumana Kwezinhloso Zomphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buye baba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ubudlelwano bukhombisa indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo, bahloniphana, futhi benza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ehlukene, lapho izinkolelo, amasiko, nezindlela zokuphila zihlala zihluka. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bukhona ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezindaweni zomndeni, emsebenzini, nakweminye imiphakathi. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, izifiso, nezinkinga ngendlela efanele. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle buholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka empilweni, okwenza abantu bazizwe bejabule futhi bephumelelayo. Izithiyo Ezinzima Noma kunjalo, ubudlelwano abuhlali buphumelelayo. Izithiyo eziningi zingavela, okuhlanganisa ukungaqondi kahle, ukungaboni ngaso linye, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezithinta abantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphulweni kobudlelwano, okungase kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yomuntu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bafunde ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, nokuthi bazi ukuthi izinkinga zingavela, kodwa zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukwamukela Umehluko Ubudlelwano buphinde buhlobene nokwamukela umehluko phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile emiphakathini ehlukene, lapho abantu bahlukene ngezinkolelo, izinkambiso, nezindlela zokuphila. Ukwamukela umehluko kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi bahlonipha abanye. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, okwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokuxhumana Ngokuthuthuka kobuchwepheshe, izindlela zokuxhumana ziye zashintsha kakhulu. Namuhla, abantu bangaxhumana kalula ngezingcingo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubudlelwano, kodwa futhi kudinga abantu ukuba baqaphele ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo kubalulekile. Ubudlelwano obuhle bukhula lapho abantu behlangana, bexoxa, futhi behlanganyela izikhathi ezibalulekile. Ubudlelwano Emsebenzini Ubudlelwano emsebenzini buye baba yinto ebalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwezinhlangano. Ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi babe nobudlelwano obuhle nabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwenza izinkampani zibe nempumelelo. Izinkampani ezikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu zihlala zikhula, futhi zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babe nemisebenzi emihle. Ubudlelwano Nezempilo Yengqondo Ubudlelwano buye bahlobene kakhulu nezempilo yengqondo. Abantu abanobudlelwano obuhle bavame ukuba nezenzo ezinhle, futhi bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengokukhathazeka nokudangala. Ukuze abantu baphile kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, bahloniphe abanye, futhi bazi ukuthi badinga ukuxhumana. Isiphetho Ubudlelwano buhlobene kakhulu nempilo yomuntu, futhi buye bahlobene nezici eziningi zomphakathi. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakhe izindlela zokuxhumana ezinhle, bahloniphe umehluko, futhi bazi ukuthi izinkinga zingavela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, ukuze baphile impilo enempilo, ejabulisayo, futhi ephumelelayo. Ubudlelwano, uma buhle, bungaba yinsika eqinile empilweni yomuntu, buholele ekwandeni kokwaneliseka, impumelelo, nokujabula.
Ukusebenza Kwamaphoyisa: Umqondo Wokubheka Phambili Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta ukuphepha nokuthula. Amaphoyisa, njengomnyango obalulekile ohlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, adlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Nokho, ukusebenza kwawo kudinga ukucwaningwa, ukuze siqonde kahle izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwabo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphoyisa akha isithombe somphakathi. Njengoba behlola izigameko, behlola izigameko, futhi besebenzisana nabantu, amaphoyisa adinga ukuba ahloniphe futhi abheke phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlonipha kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazizwa bekhululekile ukuvuma ukusiza amaphoyisa, ngokubika izigameko noma ukuxoxa ngempilo yabo. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi buyisisekelo sokwakha ukuphepha okuqinile. Nokho, izinselelo eziningi zikhona. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu amaphoyisa abhekana nazo yisithombe esibi esitholakala emiphakathini ethile. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungabi namqondo ophusile wokusebenza kwabo, noma ngenxa yezigameko ezithile ezithinta amaphoyisa, eziholela ekutheni abantu bakhathazeke. Ukuze amaphoyisa athole ukwethembeka, kudingeka ukuthi aqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele aqhubeke nokufunda, akhuthazwe futhi abuyekezwe ngokuqhubekayo ukuze bahlale behlakaniphile. Izifundo ezitholakala ezimeni ezahlukene zingasiza amaphoyisa ukuba aqonde kangcono izidingo zomphakathi, futhi akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthuthukisa amakhono, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye baba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa. Izinsiza ezifana nezokuxhumana, izithombe ezikhamera, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ziye zashintsha indlela amaphoyisa asebenza ngayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa aqonde kahle indlela yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze zisebenze kahle, futhi zibe usizo emsebenzini wabo. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nabanye abahlinzeki bezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bulethe izinselelo ezintsha. Ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukuba bahlale bephapheme, bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungenza kube lula ukuphula amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa aqhubeke nokuhlola izinqubomgomo zabo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi basasebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile, futhi bagcine amalungelo abantu. Kuyaphawuleka futhi ukuthi amaphoyisa adinga ukusebenzisana nabanye abezinhlaka, njengemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzokwenza kube lula ukusiza umphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa abheke phambili, futhi aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukuba kube nokuheha, ukwakha, nokuzinikela. Amaphoyisa kumele aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze athuthukise izinsizakalo zawo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophila ngokuthula, futhi onokwethembeka. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuxhasa amaphoyisa, futhi sikhuthaza ukuthi bahlale bephokophele phambili, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngendlela enjalo, sizokwakha umphakathi onokuphepha, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo.
Ama-Orlando Pirates: Ukuhlola impilo yebhola lezinyawo eNingizimu Afrika Ama-Orlando Pirates, okuyiqembu eliyaqhamuka emadolobheni amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, kubeka izimpawu ezinhle emlandweni wezokugijima. Umsebenzi waleli qembu uqinisekiswe yikhono lawo lokwenza impumelelo emidlalweni eminingi, okuhlanganisa nezinyathelo ezithokozisayo ezifaka phakathi izicoco zePremier Soccer League, iNedbank Cup, kanye neCAF Champions League. Kunokuhamba phambili okungalindelekile kwalesi sikhumbuzo, sithola izinkanyezi ezahlukene ezisebenza ngaphakathi kwayo. Imvelaphi nethonya lezingxenye zomphakathi Ama-Orlando Pirates asetshenziselwa ukunweba umnqopho wezokuphepha phakathi kwenhlalo yebhola. Yasungulwa ngo-1937, leli qembu lihlala likhumbula izimpumelelo zasendulo. Leli qembu libonwa njengenye yezingxenye ezinkulu zomlando wesifunda saseNingizimu Afrika, elihlanganisa umphakathi weziqhingi, abavakashi, nabadlalayo. Izinhlelo zawo zokuthuthukisa ibhola lendawo zikhiqiza abadlali abasha abakhula ukwenza imisebenzi emangalisayo. Ubuhlakani bokuphatha Ukuphathwa kweqembu kudinga umsebenzi omkhulu, futhi amaPirates akwenza lokho kahle. Ubulungiswa bokuphatha buncike emgomeni ohlomiwe, ofaka phakathi ukuqhubeka komphakathi kanye nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwamaqembu. Abaphathi bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe Bama-Orlando Pirates buhlanganisa abaninimabhuku nabafundi, okubandakanya ukufundisa amalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngaso sonke isikhathi ukudala umkhosi ophumelelayo, onikeza abadlali nethimba lonke ithuba lokukhula. Ukusebenza komkhankaso Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha semidlalo, ukuphumelela kwegame yeqembu sekubhekwene kahle. Ekuqaleni konyaka, amaPirates abethe umkhankaso oqine woMqhudelwano, abantu abaningi bejabule futhi bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kwalandela indlela yokuhlola imiphumela yokuqala nezinyathelo zokulungisa isimo somqhudelwano. Unezimpumelelo ezinzima, i- coaching staff isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuyingqayizivele ekwakheni imidlalo ehlakaniphile. AmaPirates abona ukuthi kunenkinga ethile ebuhlotsheni nomhlaba wezemidlalo, okwenza kuphumelele izimbangi ezinzima ezifanele ibhande lemidlalalo. Izinkanyezi nabadlali Ngaphambi kokuthi iPirates ibonakale njengeqembu eliphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuba kuba nezinkanyezi ezikhanzilephathi. Abadlali abanjengoThembinkosi Lorch, Happy Jele, noGabadinho Mhango baveza izimfanelo ezihlukene ezibangela ukubaluleka kwabo emsebenzini. Abadlali abafaka imakhono, ubuchule kanye nokuphikelela izama ukukhombisa izinga eliphezulu lemidlalo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkanyezi futhi nabalandeli bukhulu, kubonisa isitayela sokuqhuba imidlalo esiphumelelayo. Lokhu kudala isiko elihlangene, elijabulisayo nelihloniphekile phakathi kwamaqembu noma izigaba. Isigaba Sokuncintisana Uma sibheka isigaba sokuncintisana, amaPirates aphokophele phezulu kakhulu kuzo zonke izingeniso. Kwezinsuku zakamuva, lokhu kugudluza izithombe ezinkulu zokuheha abalandeli, abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, laba abathanda ibhola. Lokhu kudala uhlobo lwezikanathi phakathi kweqembu nomphakathi, kudalula imiphumela emihle. Ithuba Lokuthola Ukuthola Imiphumela Ekuhlakanipheni AmaOrlando Pirates naye ajabulela ukuthola amalungelo okuthola emiphumeleni ebucayi ngaphakathi kokuhlelekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokucishe kwenziwa kubaluleke kakhulu endaweni yokuhlonipha nezinkanyezi zabafana abasha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhamba phambili kuza kutholakala emakethe yezezimali - ngakho-ke nokuthola impumelelo okukhulu. Isiphetho Kuphinde kube nokubungaza ukunqoba okukhulu okuwufaneleke kakhulu, futhi ama-Orlando Pirates angaba yimfuno yebhola elahlukile eNingizimu Afrika. Kwabaningi, umoya ophakathi kwabo uyazwakala, futhi ubharia eliheha ibhizinisi elikhanya phansi nezinyathelo zenhliziyo. Isiphetho ukuthi la maqembu kumele ahlale eqhubekayo, edlula emkhakheni omkhulu. Abalandeli bazothokozisa okusunguliwe, okungakhetha ukwenza ukuba amaPirates ahlale phambili kumakhono nomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela kuvuleka amathuba amaningi ezintweni ezingakaze zenzeke phambilini.
Ithensi: Uhambo Lwemfazwe Nayise Kwake kwaba nesixuku esikhulu sezingane eNqabeni, idolobha elikhulu elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Phakathi kwazo, uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nanye, wayengumthandi ophawulekayo wezemidlalo. Ngaphandle kokuphuma emnyango, wayehamba nomoya okhishwe umdanso omuhle, ethanda umphakathi nempilo. Uthanda kakhulu ukudlala ithenisi, umdlalo obucayi owenza umoya wakhe ube ovuthuza. Njengoba elandela izinyathelo zokuba umphakathi ovelayo emlandweni wezothando, uSipho wayesebhodini eliphathekayo, ebonisa amakhono akhe. Wajabula kakhulu ngesikhathi athola ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni wethenisi wezifunda, phakathi kwemidlalo ebibanjwe ngonyaka. Uxolo lwezinyembezi kwadingeka uSipho ukufunda ukunciphisa imizwa, njengoba imikhuba emisha ingaholela ezinguqukweni ezintsha. Usuku lweqhaza lwalwehlukile. USipho waphuma endlini efake izinto ezidingekayo nemishini yakhe, ezimbalwa ezikhethiwe ezazivumelekile emzamweni. Wangena ngethuba elisha, ewumfana okhula ezinkulumweni zomndeni wakhe. Kulungile, wasebenzisa izinyathelo ezimnyama zomgibeli, evula umoya ozokwenza impumelelo. Esitezi, wabona abanye abantwana bezijabulisa, bejolise kumakhadi nezinkumbulo zomkhathi ophilayo. U-Sipho wavusa ukuthokozisa empilweni yakhe, edlula phakathi kwabantu abashaya izinkanyezi zesibhakabhaka. Wayefuna ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kubonakala sengathi ubude bejuba lwalungaphezu kwempumelelo. Umphakathi, walungile ukwenza izivivinyo, UNkk. Mthethwa, uthisha wakhe owaziwa kakhulu ngezithombe ezithokozisayo, uzomphakamisa. Wafaka izifundo emqondweni wakhe, ukuze angakhulumi ngendlela adinga ukuthi atholakale, kodwa eqhubeka nokuhambisa umoya opholile. U-Sipho wayezwa isizungu, kodwa wavuma ukuqhubeka nokwenza kahle. Umphakathi wanikeza amathuba amaningi, lapho uSipho waqhamuka nabo. Nakuba wathola ubunzima, waqina, ejoyina umjaho oyingozi. Kukho izinyathelo ezizwakalayo ezaziphathelene, nezinyembezi zentokazi yena nomphakathi. Waphakanyiswa izimfumbe zomhlaba, ezimnandi, efaka embonini izimanga zosuku. U-Sipho waba nethuba lokuhlangana nomphakathi wezithombe ezimnandi. Wafunda ukwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, nendlela yokubuyisa imiphumela emihle. Uzwela ukukhuluma noSipho, owawuthokoza ngempela, ngenkathi abanye bezama izinto ezintsha. Kwakunemizamo emisha emkhatsini wabo. U-Sipho waphakanyiswa igama elisemqoka emzabalazweni, ukwandisa ubuchwepheshe. Uthisha wakhe, UNkk. Mthethwa, umemezela ukuthi iqhaza lakhe livuma ukufunda izifundo, ukuhlola amakhono akhe, noSipho. Hhayi njalo, uSipho wakhasa isisusa esikhulu sokuhlangana nemifantu emisha. Wabona ukuze abezwe ukwenziwa okuhle, ebonisa amakhono obuchwepheshe endaweni ethize. Uthando lwakhe lweqhawe, ku-Nkosi, waphumelela ngezinyathelo ezimnandi. Kwathi emcimbini, uSipho waqala ukudlala namaqhawe amakhulu, ulungiselela umphakathi wezempilo. Vele, kurhwebo olwakheka umthombo, umhlathi omusha bekhuphuka phakathi kwakhe, udumo lwezenzo ezinhle. Kwaba ugqozi lokuba uSipho abuyele emkhathini, umkhathizwe wethu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa umphakathi ‘nemizamo, ngaleyondlela, wenza umphakathi ubone. Wenze abantu bajabule nempilo zibe ngcongwana, besebenzisa uthi lomoya wengomeza. U-Sipho, uthando lokuphishekela izimpumelelo, wakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi akuyona into eyokwenziwa njengenkanyezi, kodwa ngempela omunye ovuswa nempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba isibonelo sabanye, eqhubeka nokudlala ithenisi, evula umhlaba omusha. Imigudu yakhe yaphetha ekugcineni ngempumelelo enkulu, ihlale ihlonishwa. Uthando lwakhe nolwazi, lwaba wumbono obonakala mkhulu, waqina, wagcina izakhiwo zendawo ezaziwayo. Ngemva kokuhlangana nezinye izigameko, uSipho waphuma eziteshini zomphakathi ezilungile. Uthando lwezemidlalo lwalwakha indaba yakhe. Kwaze kwaba impumelelo ezihamba phambili, ungqongqoshe, uma kunikeza umphakathi ophilayo izinguquko eziningi phambili. Uhambo lwakhe lwemizwa, lwasijabulisa. Eminyakeni eminingi, uSipho ubephakathi kwebhodi ethe xaxa, eqhubeka nempilo yakhe ethokozisayo, ukuphila ezikoleni ezinkulu, engawa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhamba isikhathi, waba umphakathi obonisa izimanga ezinhle, eqhubeka nezifundo. Noma ngabe imimbangadla yayishiwo, umoya ohloniphekile waba yisifundo esikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Uthando lweqhawe olwalukwazi ukufezekisa iziphuphutheki, lwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophakathi kwamaqhawe angabhalwa, omkhulu nosuku oluthokozisayo. U-Sipho ubalansiwe, ubufuphuma nezinyathelo ezimfundisa ukuba neqhaza kulezi zinsuku ezikhanyayo. Ithempelra, uSipho wayesekela uthando lwakhe. Endabeni ye-ithensi, umphakathi uthokozisa, uchaza uSipho ongalahlwa isikhathi, kuzo zonke izinkanyezi eziphila ngokuphelele. Le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uhloniphe imizamo ebanzi, edlula izimfuno zobuchwepheshe, ubufanele ukufakazela ubuchwepheshe ngempela. U-Sipho, watshala umphakathi, wasiza ophumelele, nokuthi umoya wempumelelo ubalulekile. Ngakho, uhambo lwakhe lwalungcono. U-Sipho waba nesibonelo esihle, galayisha imizwa, rawomkhosini wezimpilo ezithokozisayo. Izinyathelo zakhe zabeziyiphuma, zizesha izinyembezi zeqiniso, zakha umoya onenhlonipho nomdaki. Ngenxa yokuhamba phambili, uSipho ube umkhwabo nomphakathi, kwavela umoya opholile, zonke izinkanyezi zembongolo, umkhathi ophakeme.
Isingeniso Ukugonywa, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-vaccination, kuyinqubo ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke, futhi kudlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Le nqubo yenziwa ngenhloso yokuvikela abantu ezithweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibangela izifo ezinzima nezingaba yingozi. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola ukuthi ukugonywa kuyini, ukuthi kusebenza kanjani, kanye nezinzuzo zayo. Ukwazi Ukugonywa Ukugonywa kuwumsebenzi wokufaka umuthi othile emzimbeni ukuze kuvuselelwe amandla okuphikisa izifo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusebenzisa umjovo, ophakathi kwakhe kukhona izakhi ezincane ezivela ezilwaneni, noma izakhi ezithile ezitholakala kwi-pathogen (umgibeli wezifo). Izinhloso zalesi sikhungo zifaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa ukuvikeleka, ukwakha imimoya yokukhuthaza, nokunciphisa ukuhlaselwa kwezifo. Indlela Ukugonywa Okusebenza Ngayo Uma umuthi we-vaccine ufakwa emzimbeni, uhlelo lokuvikela (immune system) lwenza izakhi ezibhekelela ukuhlasela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokwakha ama-antibodies, okuyizakhi eziqaphela futhi zikhombise izifo. Uma umuntu ebhekene ne-pathogen yangempela, lezi zidakamizwa, ezakhiwe ngesikhathi sokugonywa, zikhona ukuvikela, zinciphisa ithuba lokukhula kwesifo, futhi zinciphisa ubungozi bokufa. Izinhlobo Zokugonywa Kunamakhono ahlukene okugonywa, ahlukaniswe ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kunezivivinyo ezivamile ezifana ne-vaccines ze-measles, mumps, rubella (MMR), i-polio, ne-hepatitis. Okwesibili, kukhona ne-vaccines ezithuthukisiwe, ezitholakala kuphela ngezimo ezithile, njenge-vaccines ezivikelayo ku-COVID-19. Lokhu kubonisa indlela umhlaba wezokwelapha ushintsha ngayo, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ukuze busebenzise izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuvikela. Izinzuzo Zokugonywa Izinzuzo zokugonywa azinakuphikiswa. Okokuqala, kugcina impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu abaningi bekwazi ukuvikeleka ezifo, lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, okunciphisa umthelela wezifo. Okwesibili, ukugonywa kunciphisa izindleko zezokwelapha ezingase zibe khona. Lokhu kunciphisa izindleko zokwelashwa nezindleko ezihambisana nezifo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugonywa kunciphisa ubungozi bokwanda kwezifo emiphakathini, kudala umphakathi ovikelekile, okuyinto ebalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethwele izifo ezinjengemalaria, i-tuberculosis ne-HIV. Izinselelo Nezinkinga Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinselelo zokugonywa. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokwamukela imithi yokugonywa ngenxa yokukhathazeka ngezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinzuzo zikhona futhi zibalulekile. Ukufundisa abantu ngalesi sihloko, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, kubalulekile ukuze kube nomphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukugonywa kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavume ukugonywa. Ukukhuthaza ukugonywa akusizi kuphela abantu ngabanye, kodwa kuthinta nomphakathi wonke. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka phambili, sizobe sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela, kanti ukugonywa kuzoba yisixazululo esisebenzayo ekunciphiseni izifo. Ngakho-ke, ukukhuthaza ukugonywa kubalulekile ukuze sithole umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi ophephile.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini: Ingxoxo Ehlakaniphile Ngaphakathi kwempilo yansuku zonke, amanzi abhekwa njengomthombo obalulekile, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwawo kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, emiphakathini ethile, izinkinga zamanzi zikhathaza kakhulu, zidalula izinselelo ezinzima ezithinta impilo, ezemvelo, kanye nezomnotho. Ukungabi khona kwamanzi acacile, ukungahlinzeki kahle, kanye nezimo zokungcoliswa kwamanzi, konke lokhu kumele kubhekwane ngeso elibucayi ukuze kuqondiswe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkinga zamanzi ziba nemiphumela emibi emiphakathini. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zendawo, ukwanda kwabantu, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza. Ngokwesibonelo, emadolobheni amakhulu, ukwanda kwabantu kuholela ekwandeni kwesidingo samanzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi aneziqu eziphezulu. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu baphuze amanzi angahlanzekile, okwandisa izinga lokutheleleka ngezifo ezihlobene namanzi, njenge-diarrhea ne-cholera. Ngakho-ke, kumele kwenziwe izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ngokubhekelela izimo zokungcoliswa kwamanzi, kuphinde kube khona izinselelo ezinkulu. Izimboni, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, lapho imfucuza, izikhalazo, nezinsalela zezimboni kuphumelele kulo mkhathi. Lokhu kungcola amanzi, okwenze kube nzima ukuwasebenzisa, futhi kuholele ezinkingeni zempilo ezinzima. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi akukhona nje kuphela ekuphazamiseni impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuphazamisa izitshalo nezilwane eziphathelene nomjikelezo wemvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngezinselelo, kubalulekile futhi ukuhlola izindlela zokuphatha amanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kwamanzi kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi anele, futhi kubalulekile kumaphrojekthi okwakha. Izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zifanele ziqinisekise ukuthi amanzi afinyelelwa kalula, ahlanzekile, futhi akhuphuka ngempumelelo.
