Lokhu kungachaphazela izidingo zomphakathi, kubaluleka ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ukuze babambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izindlela zokugcina amanzi kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga. Ukuvuselela imikhuba yokulondoloza amanzi, njengokusebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile kuphela lapho kudingeka, nokunciphisa ukusebenzisa amanzi emisebenzini engadingeki, kungavula umnyango wezixazululo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezisekelwe emiphakathini zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nomqondo ophumelelayo mayelana nokuphila kwamanzi, okuholela empumelelweni yokugcina izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinkinga zidinga ukubhekwa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe bokuhlanza amanzi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlanza eziphakeme, kungasiza ekuphatheni izinkinga zokungcola. Uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lungahlanganisa izindlela zokuhlanza amanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuholela ekutheni amanzi abe sezingeni elihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima ukufinyelela. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zifaka izinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga ukunakwa. Ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, nokuphathwa okungafanele, konke lokhu kubangela umphumela omubi empilweni nasemphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nomqondo ophumelelayo, silandele izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha amanzi, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ukuze sigweme izinkinga ezinzima. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezizokhulisa impilo, ukuvikeleka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezizinzile emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi enezinsiza zamanzi eziyinqaba, eziphumelelayo, nezihlanzekile, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Izinhlelo zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ukufundisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ezithuthukisiwe zizoba yisisekelo sokwenza lokhu kungenzeke. Siphila emhlabeni onamathuba amaningi, kodwa uma singaphatheki kahle, sithola izinkinga ezinkulu. Sihamba phambili siphokophelele ekuzitholeni izixazululo ezinzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ayikho impilo yethu, hhayi nje umphakathi.
Ukuntuleka KweMisebenzi emiphakathini YaseMakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga ebalulekile, ethinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kungenxa yezizathu eziningi ezihlanganisa ukushoda kwezinsiza, ukuntuleka kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, kanye nezinguquko ezibalulekile emnothweni. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akuwona umkhuba omusha; kudala sekukhona abantu abaningi besebenza emakhaya abahamba beshaya imikhawulo ngenxa yokungabi namathuba afanele okuhweba. Kulesi sihloko, sizoxoxa ngokubaluleka kokuxazulula le nkinga, izizathu ezibangela le miphumela, nokuthi singathuthukisa kanjani umnotho wethu emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akuhambisani nje nokungabi khona kwezinsiza, kodwa kubonisa futhi ukungabi nalwazi nokufaneleka ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bacindezelwe ngemikhuba ethile yokufunda, eyenza kube nzima ukuba baqonde izidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuthi bahlale bephakathi kwezikhala zomsebenzi, behluleka ukuhweba ngezifundo zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda ziguqulwe ukuze zifundise abantu amakhono adingekayo emnothweni wanamuhla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlupheka. Abantu abangenamsebenzi bahlala bezama ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo, kodwa bahluleka ukwenza lokho. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongenamkhawulo lapho kuvela khona izinkinga eziningi ezifana nokuntuleka kwemali, izindlu, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila. Ukuze siqedele lesi simo, kudingeka ukuba imiphakathi ibambisane, ibheke izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya zidinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni. Uhlelo lokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane lungase lube yisisombululo esikhulu. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo, kungaba yindlela yokunika amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, okuthinta kahle ukusimama kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhasa, njengokunikeza imali yokwakha amabhizinisi, ukuqeqesha abantu, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhweba. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okuphathelene nemali. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kukhuliswe umqondo wokusebenza ngamahora amaningi. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi lokusebenza kufanele zikhuthazwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni futhi kuvule amathuba angcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngokubaluleka kokufaka izinhlelo zemvelo ezithuthukisa imisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokulima eziqhubekayo, ukuvuselela amabhizinisi emvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza, zingaba yizixazululo ezinhle. Lokhu akukhulisi nje umnotho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele, onempilo, nezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisana kakhulu, befinyela emathubeni angcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina izinsiza zethu zemvelo. Ukulima ngendlela efanele, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela esebenzayo, nokuhlonipha imvelo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imiphakathi yasemakhaya ikwazi ukuhlala izinzile, ikwazi ukuphila ezindaweni eziphilayo, futhi ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zayo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya akuyona nje inkinga yomphakathi, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Ukuxazulula le nkinga kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nohulumeni. Kumele sihlose ukwakha umnotho osebenzayo, onempilo, futhi ozinikele, ukuze sizuze izinzuzo eziningi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzosisiza ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, engakhathazeki, futhi elwela impilo engcono. Ngakho-ke, asithathe izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile emiphakathini yasemakhaya.
Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezokudlala: Umgomo Wokuphumelela Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo sekuye saba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yabaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathanda imidlalo. Ukuqeqeshwa akukhona nje kuphela ukulungiselela umjaho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni impilo enempilo, uthando lwezemidlalo, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Izikhungo eziningi zokuzivocavoca, izikole, kanye nezinhlangano zokuqeqesha ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwabadlali. Izizathu Zokuqeqesha Izizathu zokuthi abantu baqeqeshe ziningi. Okokuqala, ukuqeqeshwa kukhuthaza impilo enhle. Abadlali abaqeqeshayo bahlala bephila kahle, bephucula amandla abo, futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. Okwesibili, ukuqeqeshwa kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isithombe somuntu. Abadlali abaqeqeshwa kahle bahlala bejabulile futhi beqonda kahle imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emakhazeni lapho umphakathi ubheka khona abanye njengemodeli. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zokuqeqesha Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zihluke kakhulu kuye ngohlobo lwezemidlalo. Ngokwesibonelo, emhlabeni wezemidlalo yebhola, ukuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene ezifana nokuzivocavoca, ukwakha amandla, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Abadlali bahlala behlola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle emidlalweni yabo. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kudingeka ukuthi bahlale beqeqesha njalo, bahlale bejolise emigomweni yabo, futhi bahlale bephokophele phezulu. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo sekuye kwathola izindlela ezintsha. Izinsiza ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola ukusebenza, izibalo zokusebenza, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zaba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa abadlali. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bahlale benolwazi olwakamuva mayelana nokusebenza kwabo, bahlale beqonda izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buvumela abaqeqeshi ukuba baqonde kahle izidingo zomdlali ngamunye, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Imiphumela Yokusebenza Imiphumela yokusebenza kokuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo ibonakala kakhulu. Abadlali abaqeqeshwa kahle baveza izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza emidlalweni yabo, futhi lokhu kubavumela ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kubadlali abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezithile, lapho umphakathi ubabheka njengabavela ezindaweni eziphakeme. Uhlelo oluhle lokuqeqesha luholela ekwandeni kwamathuba okuthola izikhala emakhazeni, okubavumela ukuba baphumelele futhi baphumelele. Izifundo Zokuthola Izifundo ezitholakala ekuqeqesheni zibalulekile. Abadlali bahlala befunda izinto ezintsha, bahlola izindlela ezintsha, futhi bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Ukuqeqeshwa akupheli nje ekupheleni komjaho; kuqhubeka njalo, njengoba abadlali behlola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokuncintisana, futhi kubavumela ukuba bahlale bejabulile emsebenzini wabo. Ubuhlobo Phakathi Kweqembu Ubuhlobo phakathi kwabadlali nabaphathi bayo busemqoka ekuqeqesheni. Ukuqeqeshwa akuyona into eyodwa kuphela; kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo. Abadlali badinga ukuxhumana nabaphathi ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zabo, futhi abaphathi badinga ukwazi ukuthi abadlali bahlala bejabulile futhi bephokophele phezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuphumelela. Akukhona nje kuphela ukulungiselela imijaho, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza impilo enempilo, uthando lwezemidlalo, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaqeqeshi, abadlali, kanye nomphakathi bahlale bejolise ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuqeqesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemidlalo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezokudlala.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Ukhetho lukazwelonke yisigameko esibalulekile emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Lezi zinkulumo ezibucayi zikhuluma ngokwakha izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabantu nezwe ikakhulukazi. Ngaphambi kokuba siqonde kahle ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke lusebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi luhlanganisa izici eziningi, kusukela ekuhlelweni, ekukhethweni, nasekuphathweni kwemiphumela. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinqubomgomo Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhamba phambili ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza nezinhlelo zokuphila kwabantu. Ukuze lokhu kukhule, izinhlelo zokusungula izinqubomgomo zidinga ukuhamba phambili. Izinhlelo zihlala ziqhuba ngokuhlanganyela, kuhlanganiswe imiphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze izinqubomgomo zibe neqhaza elihle mustazwe ngokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ukweseka Ukhetho Ukuze ukhetho lube neqhaza, kudingeka kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle kubavoti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhethwa kwezikhumbuzo, izikhangiso, nezinkundla zokuxhumana ezikhuluma ngemicabango emisha. Izinhlaka eziphakathi, njengezikhungo zokuphatha ukhetho, zenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukusabalalisa, nokuvikela ukhetho. Izinyathelo Zokhetho Lapho sekusondela isikhathi sokhetho, abantu bahlukahlukene bazobamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusungulwa kwezinsuku zokhetho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-ballot, kanye nezikhungo zokuvota. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zokuvota zikhona kuwo wonke amandla, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukuvota ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Imiphumela Nokubika Ngemuva kokuvota, imiphumela iyahlaziywa futhi ibikwa. Izinhlaka ezisemthethweni ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe phansi kahle, ukuze kube nokukhanya nokuthembeka. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwaziswa ngemiphumela yokhetho, futhi baqonde ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinegunya elivela emiphumeleni. Ukwamukela Imiphumela Umphakathi kufanele wamukele imiphumela yokhetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ophumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abaholi, nezikhungo zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ukuhlonishwa kwemiphumela kubalulekile ekwakheni izinga lokwethembana phakathi kwabantu nezinhlaka eziphethe. Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhamizi Ukhetho lungumkhankaso owakha izakhamuzi ezinobuhlakani, ezithintekayo, nezizimele. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, kanye nokubazisa ngemicabango emisha. Uma abantu bejabulela ukhetho, bakwazi ukusungula umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukhetho lukazwelonke aluwona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha isizwe esinempilo. Ngalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi silwele ukhetho olukhululekile, olungcono, nolwaziyo. Ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokuthatha icala kulezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu nomphakathi jikelele. Umphakathi wonke kufanele uvote, ubambe iqhaza, futhi ube neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukhetho lukazwelonke lukhombisa amandla abantu, uthando, nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle.
Izinsuku Zokuhlupheka ZikaMnu. Njabulo Esigodlweni esisemaphandleni, kwakukhona indoda eyaziwa kakhulu ngelikaMnu. Njabulo. Wayeyindoda ejabulisayo, eyaziwa ngama-hlaya akhe aphathelene neziphuzo, izilwane, kanye nezimo zansuku zonke. Ngama-akhawunti akhe, wayekwenza kube sobala ukuthi bukhona ububanzi bokuthola ukuhleka empilweni, noma ngabe izimo zikhathazekile kanjani. Nokho, uNjabulo wayengaphansi kwezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu. Wayengumngane ezikhathini ezithile, kodwa futhi wayenamakholwa akhe ezinsukwini lapho efuna ukuphumula, njengoba impilo yansuku zonke imthukuthelela. Kodwa, kwaba nosuku oluthile olwakuzoqinisekisa ukuthi uNjabulo uzokwazi ukujabulisa abantu. Ngesikhathi esebenza, uNjabulo wathola ithuba lokuphumula. Waphuma ehholo elikhulu, ehamba emfuleni, ukuze ahlale ezungezile. Kulapho wahlangana noMnu. Mpumelelo, umphakathi wendawo owaziwa njengezinto ezimbi. UMnu. Mpumelelo wayengumuntu ongajabuli, futhi uNjabulo wayazi kahle ukuthi uma engatholi ukujabulisa uMnu. Mpumelelo, lokho kuzoba ukudabuka okukhulu. "Sanibonani, Mnu. Mpumelelo!" kusho uNjabulo, ehlikihla isandla sakhe ngothando. "Ngabe usuku lokugcina luhamba kanjani?" "Ngabe uthanda ukuhlupha abantu?" ubuza uMnu. Mpumelelo, nomoya opholile. "Ngicela ungawusiqhenyanga esikhathini esizayo." Njabulo wacela ithuba lokukhuluma kahle, wathi: "Ngabe ubona ukuhamba kwezingane?" Wabhekisela ezinganeni eziphuma emakhaya zinemidlalo yazo emithwaleni yamanzi, zigijima nokuhlekisa. Ubuze: "Ngabe umama wakho ungekho emzini? Ngabe inja isithanda izinyoni?" UMnu. Mpumelelo wathuleka, kodwa uNjabulo wayeqhubeka. "Ngabe ubona lezi zinyoni zikhwela phezulu? Umoya ovunguza – ungubani ocabanga ukuthi ungabe ungababa?" Ngaphandle kokuhlekisa, uNjabulo wabona uMnu. Mpumelelo ephephuka phansi, ezama ukunciphisa imizwa yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yinsizwa ethusayo emizweni yaKwaZulu, noma ngezinga elingaphansi. "Ngabe ubona kahle, uMnu. Mpumelelo? Ngiyazi ukuthi ungumuntu omncane kakhulu, kodwa kufanele ungahluleki! Gijima! Gijima! Gijima!" kusho uNjabulo, ehlekisa. "Uma ungathola isiko, ungakubona kahle. Ngabe ungaphi? Ngokufanayo, nansi indaba." UNjabulo waqala ukwethula izindaba ezihlekisayo. Wayehlekisa ngezitshalo, izinyoni, izilwane ezincane, kanye nabantu abavakashela emfuleni. Izwe laligcwele ukwehluka, futhi uMnu. Mpumelelo ekugcineni wahamba phakathi kokuncipha, egijima phambili kancane. Ngemva kwalesi sikhathi, uNjabulo waphinde wawela emaphandleni, wathola uZiningi, osana ojabulelayo, elungisa isidlo, eyaziwa ngamasondo wakhe. UNkulunkulu, kubonakala, washaya uMnu. Mpumelelo, kwaba ukuhlekisa, kwashintsha izimo zomuntu omubi. "Njengoba ungena emnyango," kusho uNjabulo, "uma uMnu. Mpumelelo ehlala endlini, bonke bazobona umehluko. Abangani bethu, jabulani!" Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNjabulo waqaphela ukuthi izingane zazikhula zinobuchule bokuhlekisa. Zazifuna ukujabulisa uMnu. Mpumelelo, begijima emkhathini. Ubuze, "Ngabe zingakwazi ukukhipha izinyoni ezivela emisebenzini?" Ngemva kwezinye izinsuku ezihamba phambili, umoya ohlanzekile wanqamuka emazingeni obuhlungu. UNjabulo, owazi kahle izinkanyezi, waphumelela, wathola ukuthi kukhona amandla okuhlekisa. Phakathi nezinsuku zehlazo, uMnu. Mpumelelo wayebona umehluko. Ubuza kancane, "Ngabe ngabe lezi zinsuku ziyakubona kahle?" Waphendula: "Ngabe uthanda ukujabulisa abantu? Ngabe inkanyezi osanda kuyibona iyihlaya?" Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, ubuhlungu bayo bujela kwesinye isikhathi. Kwandiswa ubudlelwano bomndeni, nokuqonda okubuhlungu. Njabulo, onguMnu. Mpumelelo, wagcizelela uthando. Kodwa-ke, uNjabulo wathola ngaphakathi komndeni, okwakuhlekisa. Umanzi owaziwayo kwaphela umfundi owayengazi ukuthi uyavuma ukuthi ungabe esebenza. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zatholakala, uNjabulo wathola impumelelo. Njengoba sibona uMnu. Mpumelelo, izinsuku zaba zihlekisa. Ulwazi lwabo lwenza umphakathi wathokozisa ikakhulukazi. Kwakungelula, kodwa uNjabulo wathola ukuthi ibhande labantu livuselela izinsuku zomoya. Hamba ujabule, uNjabulo wathola isikhathi sokuhlola, ehlanganyela nezinsuku ezithile. Lokhu kwakuhlekisa, futhi umphakathi ubongela uMnu. Njabulo, owathola umuzwa wokuthokozisa nokuqhamuka nokukhumbula ukuthi ukuhleka kuholela empilweni.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Indlela Yokuthola Nokuqhubeka Nempumelelo Isingeniso Ekukhuleni komhlaba wendawo ye-inthanethi, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) bahlala bejabulile futhi befikile ezingeni eliphezulu lokwenza kahle. Abadali bokuqukethwe bangaqukethe abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengezithombe, ividiyo, umculo, nokubhala. Le njongo ihlola izinyathelo ezisemqoka okufanele zicatshangwe ukuze ube ngumkhiqizi wokuqukethwe ophumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Thola Umqondo Wakho Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuthola umqondo ohehayo. Cabanga ngezinto ozithandayo, izifundo ozikhumbulayo, noma izihloko ozidumile. Lokhu kuzokwakhela isizinda esiqinile sokwabelana ngempilo yakho nempilo yabanye. Ungabheka izitayela ezidumile, kodwa ujabulele ukuveza izindlela zakho ezihlukile. Khumbula, umqondo omuhle uvame ukumangalisa futhi uncike ekuthandeni kwabantu. Isinyathelo 2: Yenza Ucwaningo Ngemuva kokuba nomqondo, qhubeka ngocwaningo. Bheka okuphathelene nomqondo wakho; funda kabanzi ngakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukhuthazeke futhi inhloso yakho ibe nocwaningo olunembile. Hlanganisa izinsiza ezinjengezincwadi, ama-blog, nezinye izikhungo ze-inthanethi ukuze uqonde ngabafundi, abalandeli, noma izilaleli ozobabamba. Isinyathelo 3: Qamba Isithombe Sakho Somkhiqizo Isithombe somkhiqizo sibalulekile kwabanye abadali bokuqukethwe. Lokhu kusho ukwakha isithombe esibonakalayo sokuhweba komkhiqizo wakho, ngokuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle, izithombe ezikhangayo, nemibhalo ehlakaniphile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuheha abantu abaningi. Ungakwazi ukuthuthukisa isithombe somkhiqizo wakho ngokubeka kombono obuhlungu, okhombisa umkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ethakazelisayo. Isinyathelo 4: Dala Uqukethwe Nokukhulisa Ukubambisana Ngokuhamba phambili, sebenzisa izikhangiso, izithombe, nevidiyo ukuze uqale ukudala okuqukethwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi okukhuluma kusho okuthakazelisayo, kusemthethweni, futhi kuhlonipha izidingo zezilaleli zakho. Ukuze uthuthukise ukubambisana nabanye abadali, zama ukuxhumana, uvule izithangami, okanye ube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo nemikhiqizo efana neyakho. Isinyathelo 5: Hlonipha Izilaleli Zakho Abadali bokuqukethwe kumele bahloniphe izilaleli zabo. Lokhu kuthetha ukuba uqonde izidingo, izintshisakalo, nezimpawu zabo. Hlanganisa imibono, iziphakamiso, nezimpendulo ukuze uqonde kangcono. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukwethembana, futhi kubathuthukisa abalandeli. Isinyathelo 6: Thuthukisa Imakethe Yakho Njengoba uhamba phambili, bheka ukuthi ungawenza kanjani amaqhinga akho awasebenzisayo ukuze ufinyelele izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwenza amaqhinga ezokuxhumana online, ukulandela izithameli zakho ezicelweni, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha zokuthengisa. Hlonipha izimo zomphakathi nezezimali lapho uhlela inqubomgomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhlobo lwakho luthandwe kakhulu. Isinyathelo 7: Phikelela Ekuthuthukiseni Ngokuphumela, qhubeka ngenkuthalo, uhlale uzama ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda izinkomba ezintsha, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokulalela iziphakamiso zezithameli zakho. Ukuphikelela ekuthuthukiseni kuzokwenza ube sebenzisa amakhono wakho ukuze ufike ephepheni lempumelelo. Isinyathelo 8: Qonda Ukubaluleka Kokuphuma Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuba umuntu ophumelelayo akwazi ukuphuma. Njengoba usukhule, ungakha umphakathi ozokukhokhela, labhulile, futhi laphinde lukuhehise. Hamba ngezinyathelo ezahlukene zokuphepha, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza ube ngumholi emkhakheni wakho. Isiphetho Ukuba abadali bokuqukethwe kukusiza ukuba ube nesimo sokuqhuba imikhankaso yokudala, udale izikhathi ezikhumbulekayo, futhi ukhuthaze abanye. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungafinyelela empumelelweni ynqayidule eza phezulu. Qhubeka, bumba izinga lakho, futhi ube ngumthombo wom inspiration kubantu abavela kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba. Hamba phambili, futhi okukhulumayo akukho nemigudu ezaqhamuka emndenini!
Ezokuvakasha: Ukwakha Uxhumano Phakathi Kwezingxenye Zethu Nezizwe ZakwaZulu Ezokuvakasha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa indlela ezokuvakasha ezishintsha ngayo, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka unomoya ophakeme. Akukhona nje ukuphuma siye ezindaweni ezinhle, kodwa futhi ukuzama ukuqonda izimpilo, amasiko, nemicabango yabanye. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ovulekile, umoya wokufunda, kanye nesifiso sokuxhumana. INingizimu Afrika inezindawo eziningi ezithakazelisayo ezokuvakasha. Kusukela enhlokodolobha, iPretoria, kuze kufike ezintabeni eziyinqaba zeDrakensberg, nezindawo ezihlekisayo eWestern Cape. IKwaZulu-Natal ikhangwa kakhulu ngemvelaphi yayo, ikhetha impilo yasemaphandleni neyesimanje, ibhizinisi, kanye nemfashini yezenhlalakahle. Ukwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwezingxenye zethu nezizwe kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lokwakha uxhumano lukhombisa ubuciko, ikhono, nempumelelo yomdabu. Abantu abaningi bakha imibukiso, imicimbi, nabahambi bembula izimfihlo zamasiko amasha. Lokhu kudinga ukusizwa ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nomphakathi. Nokho, izithiyo zikhona. Ezokuvakasha zidinga ukufundwa kwezifundo ezichaza amabhuku akhombisa ubukhona base-Afrika ukuze sifunde amagugu okuvakasha. Kubahloli bezifundo, izazi zenza imfundo esemqoka, futhi lezi zifundo zingase zifake iminyango emisha ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ezokuvakasha ziqhubeka nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokuxhumanisa zikhombisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile, imicimbi yokuhlangana, kanye nokwakhiwa kwabathandi bokuhamba. Lesi sikhathi sokuhlangana sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zibe nengxenye ngaphansi komoya wokuhlanganyela, ngaphandle kokweqa izithiyo. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ezokuvakasha kufanele zikhuthaze ukugcinwa kwemvelo. Imikhiqizo efanelekayo, njengokudla, izimpahla ezingcolile, kudinga amasu akhululekile. Kumele siqonde ukuthi izindawo ezaziwa ngempilo kahle zingase zibe yiziteshi zokuthokozisa izivakashi, kodwa futhi zidinga ukwakha umhlaba omuhle. Njengoba sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi, kufanele sibe nemiphumela ehloniphekako yasendaweni. Ezokuvakasha, uma ziqhutshwa kahle, zingaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi oqinile. Kumele sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umkhankaso ovulekile, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Esikhathini esizayo, ubuchwepheshe buzothola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, kodwa kuzodingeka sihloniphe izimiso zendabuko. Okukhethwa kubalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano bethu nabanye. Ekugcineni, ezokuvakasha zingaba nomthelela omuhle, zifake umqondo wokuhlangana, nokwakha uxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okukhona okuhle, futhi okukhuthazayo. Kumele sizame, silethe, futhi sithumele izinkanyezi.
Impilo Yasemakhaya: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, kodwa ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mpilo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Kule ngxoxo, sizogxila ezicini ezithinta umphakathi, umnotho, nezimo zokuphila ezikhona emakhaya. Sizok开始 ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nempilo yasemakhaya. Abantu abahlala emaphandleni banethuba lokuphila eduze kwemvelo, okuholela ezindaweni eziluhlaza nezikhala zomoya opholile. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakwazi ukulima izitshalo ezahlukene, okwakha ukuzimela ekudleni, futhi kunciphisa izindleko zokuphila. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bujabulisa, njengoba abantu bethola ithuba lokubambisana ekulimaleni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yasemakhaya ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu wukuntuleka kwemithombo yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubeka abantu engozini yokugula, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila impilo enempilo. Futhi, izinsiza ezifana nezibhedlela, izikole, nezithuthi zihlala zikhona kodwa zihlukumezekile, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Impilo yasemakhaya ithinta umnotho ngendlela ethile. Nakuba kunezinzuzo, umnotho emakhaya uvame ukuba phansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezindawo zomuzi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani ezinkulu zifuna ukwakha ezindaweni ezinezinselelo eziningi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baphume emakhaya baye emadolobheni, okuphula ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yasemakhaya. Abahleli bezinqubomgomo kufanele basebenzise izinsizakusebenza ezinkulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izikole ezithuthukile, ukuqinisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zezempilo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abadala. Ubulunga bezinsiza kufanele buphakanyiswe ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. Ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yasemakhaya, njengoba izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezinhle zingasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, zikhuthaze ukusakazwa kolwazi, futhi zikhuthaze ukuhweba. Ekugcineni, impilo yasemakhaya inezinzuzo nezinkinga ezithile. Nakuba kunezithiyo, kungenzeka ukuthuthukisa impilo yasemakhaya ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ukwakha izinsiza eziphusile, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqhubeke phambili, ubhekane nezinselelo, futhi uthuthukise izimpilo zabantu abahlala emaphandleni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula.
Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe: Imibuzo Nezincazelo Umbuzo 1: Yini izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo nemisebenzi yabo. Lezi zifundo zihlola indlela ubuchwepheshe obuthinta ngayo izimpilo zethu, izinqubo zethu zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Zifaka phakathi izifundo ezihlukahlukene, njengekhompyutha, ubunjiniyela, ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bemvelo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba imikhakha eminingi idinga abantu abanolwazi kwezobuchwepheshe. Zikhuthaza futhi ukucabanga okwakhiwe, lapho abafundi befundiswa khona ukuhlaziya izinkinga nokufuna izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zikhuthaza ukusungula ubuchwepheshe obusha, okwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emhlabeni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izifundo ezivamile ngaphakathi kwezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe ziqukethe izifundo eziningi ezifana ne-Information Technology (IT), ubunjiniyela, ukuthuthukiswa kwesofthiwe, kanye nezifundo ze-robotics. Futhi, izifundo eziphathelene nezokuxhumana, njengezokumaketha kwi-inthanethi, kanye nezokuphepha kwedatha, zibalulekile kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Kungani kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla? Emiphakathini yanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini lapho ubuchwepheshe buguqula izinqubo zokusebenza. Abantu abanobuchwepheshe bangasiza imiphakathi yabo ukuthi ithuthuke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezifana nezempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuxhumana. Umbuzo 5: Yini okufanele ikhulunywe uma sikhuluma ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Uma sikhuluma ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuhunyushwa izimfanelo ezibalulekile ezifana nokucabanga okwakhiwe, ukuxhumana kahle, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Abafundi kumele babe nekhono lokuhlaziya izinkinga bese befuna izixazululo ezisebenzayo, okufanele kube yisisekelo sokuphumelela emsebenzini nasempilweni yabo. Umbuzo 6: Zithini izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi bezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Abafundi bezifundo zobuchwepheshe babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlala unolwazi olusha. Okwesibili, izindleko zokufunda zingaba phezulu, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Okwesithathu, abanye abafundi bangase bazizwe bedidekile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olujulile ngalesi sikhathi sobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezimboni. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bathole ulwazi olwakhiwe nolwakamuva. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini kukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ibhekwane nayo uma ufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Uma ufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ovulekile. Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukufunda ngokushesha nokuqonda izinto ezintsha. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokubambisana, njengokusebenza emaphrojekthi, kuzobasiza bathuthukise amakhono abo. Ukufunda ukuhlela kahle isikhathi sabo kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni ezifundweni. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokugcina ulwazi olusha ezindabeni zobuchwepheshe? Ukuze ugcine ulwazi olusha ezindabeni zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili nezifundo ezitholakalayo. Ukubhalisela izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi, ukufunda izincwadi ezisematheni, kanye nokubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni yokwabelana ngolwazi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlala unolwazi. Ukuxhumana nabanye abanolwazi olufanayo kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esiyifunda ngempela ezifundweni zobuchwepheshe? Ekugcineni, izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomuntu. Zikhiqiza abantu abakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, bahlaziye izinkinga, futhi bathuthukise izixazululo. Zikhuthaza ukucabanga okwakhiwe nokubambisana, okubalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke sithuthuka njengomphakathi, sithuthukise izimboni zethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni. Ngakho-ke, izifundo zobuchwepheshe azigcini nje ngokufundisa amakhono, kodwa zifundisa futhi indlela yokuphila, yokusebenza, nokuxhumana, okuhamba phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izikhukhula Kwakukhona idolobha elincane, elalibizwa ngeMhlangamvula, elaliphila ngokuthula ezwenikazi elikahle. Abantu balo babeyazisa kakhulu imvula, ngoba imvula yayiletha ukuphila. Kodwa, kwaba nezinsuku lapho imvula yaguquka yaba umoya, yaphenduka ingozi. Kwakungumjolo ohlukeneyo, njengoba kwakukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emkhathini. Ngolunye usuku, kwavela izinkanyezi ezinhle phezulu, kodwa abantu baseMhlangamvula bazi ukuthi lokho kusho ukuthi imvula izofika. UMaNandi, umama odabuka emndenini omkhulu, wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayezokwazi ukujabulisa umndeni wakhe ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ngemuva kokuthi imvula iqale, uMaNandi waphakamisa izikhumbuzo zendabuko, ezifana namasiko okuphakamisa izihlahla ukuze athole izibusiso. Kodwa imvula yanda kakhulu. Izinsuku zashintsha zaba izinyanga, imvula yaphenduka ingamaphuzu amakhulu okukhala. Izinkanyezi zashabalala, imvula yenza umhlaba waba nzima, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezinzima. Abantwana babehamba bezama ukuvikela imiphako yabo, kanti omama benza imizamo yokuhlanza imizi yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imvula yanda kakhulu, yenza amanzi ahlume. Amaphuzu okukhala aqala ukufika ezindaweni eziphakeme, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi kudinga ukuhamba ngokushesha. UMaNandi, naye, wagxila ekutheni angawuqeda kanjani umndeni wakhe. Wafaka zonke izinto ezibalulekile emathangeni, efuna indawo ephephile. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, umphakathi wezinsuku, owayehamba enanela izimo zomhlaba. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zikhukhula zazingaphezu kwalokho okwakukhulunywa ngakho. Wavuma ukuhamba nendoda yakhe, uBheki, naba lezozisebenzi ukuze bazame ukwakha izivivinyo ezincane ukuze bavikele umphakathi. Ubenamasu azama ukukhipha abantu ezindlini zabo, kodwa izikhukhula zashaya kalula. Abantu bahlala phansi, beziqhenya ngezimali zabo, kodwa umoya wawuhlasele, ubafaka emoyeni. UMaNandi wanika abantwana bakhe izinqumo zokuhlala phansi, balinde ukuzwakalisa izwi labo. Ukuphila kwabo kwakukanye, futhi bahlala benethemba lokuthi kuzofika usuku lapho imvula izoba nomusa. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, izikhukhula zafika phezulu, zaphenduka umfula omkhulu. Izinto zashabalala emanzini, izindlu zashiywa zinefulegi, izimpahla zashabalala. Umphakathi wabona ukuthi kudinga ukuhamba, kanti uMaNandi noBheki bazi ukuthi kufanele basebenze ndawonye. Ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga, uMaNandi wabona umhlaba ubukeka unguzi omkhulu. Kwakuwumfula omkhulu, umoya uthelelekile. Abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo, bezama ukufinyelela endaweni ephephile. Kukhona abanye abavela emiphakathini ethile, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, imvula enezibusiso. UMaNandi noBheki bahamba naphakathi kwabantu, benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuvikela umphakathi. Umoya wezinsuku ezinzima wabuya, izikhukhula zathinta ithafa, kodwa abantu bazi ukuthi bazohlala bephila, bejabulisa imindeni yabo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku, izikhukhula zancipha kancane, ukuze umhlaba uphinde uthole umoya omusha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuvuka, bahlola ukuthi kukhona okukhona. UMaNandi wabona ukuthi imiphakathini ibonakala ibusisiwe, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi umphakathi ungasebenza ndawonye. Izindlela zaba ngaphezulu, iziqephu zatholakala, futhi abantu basaqhubeka nokulima, behlola izindlela ezithokozisayo. Uhlanga lwaluphilile, izikhukhula zashabalala, izinhlelo zashintsha. Abantu babefunda ukuthi uma behlangene, bangenza konke. UMaNandi, noBheki, nabanye bakwaMhlangamvula bazi ukuthi izikhukhula zazifana nezivunguvungu, zishintsha izinto, kodwa umoya wokubambisana wawunamandla. Ngemuva kwezinyanga, kwavela izimbali ezintsha, izihlahla zakhula futhi umhlaba wabukeka kahle. Abantu bahlala behlangene, behamba phambili, benza izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha. UMaNandi waba yisibonelo sokuhlanganyela, ethi: "Sihamba ndawonye, sikhuluma ngothando, sibhekene nanoma yini." Ngaleso sikhathi, izikhukhula zenzeka, kodwa umoya wokuqina wawuhlala unamandla.
iGautrain: Uhlelo Lokuhamba Olusha E-Gauteng Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu emadolobheni. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziyiphusile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lweGautrain, olwakhiwa ngenhloso yokwenza uhambo phakathi kwamadolobha amakhulu kube lula, luthathe izinyathelo ezinkulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. ### Isingeniso iGautrain, okuyinhlangano yokuhamba ngemabha, yethulwa ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisebenza kahle. Ihlanganisa iziteshi ezikhethekile ezihlanganisa amadolobha aseGauteng, njengeJohannesburg, Tshwane, ne-Ekurhuleni. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubahambi ukuhamba, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhuba izimoto zabo, okwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini nasezindleleni. ### Ukusebenza Kwe-Gautrain Uhlelo lweGautrain luhlinzeka ngohambo olukhawulezayo noluphephile, olunokusebenza okukhuthazayo kubahambi. Izitimela zihlala zifika ngesikhathi, zisheshisa uhambo lwabantu, futhi ziqukethe izinsiza ezithuthukile. Iziteshi zihlala zihlanzekile futhi zinesimo esikahle, okuhlinzeka ngamava amahle kubahambi. Ngokuhlanganyela nezinye izindlela zokuhamba, iGautrain iba yisixazululo esihle kulabo abafuna ukuhamba ngendlela elula. ### Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa iGautrain Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa iGautrain ukukhululeka okutholakala kubahambi. Abahambi bavame ukukhokha imali encane uma bekhetha ukuhamba ngeGautrain uma kuqhathaniswa nezingozi zokuhamba ngemoto. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhamba, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba njalo emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iGautrain ikhulisa isikhathi sokusebenza, njengoba abahambi bengachitha isikhathi esincane ezimotweni. ### Ukuhlola Ukusebenza Kwe-Gautrain Abanye abadlali bezokuthutha baseGauteng baveza izinkinga ezithile ezithinta iGautrain. Njengoba iGautrain ithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zabahambi. Abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi iziteshi ezithile zixhaswa kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola indawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi beGautrain bahlale beqaphela ukubaluleka kokuphuculwa kwalezi zindawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo esihamba phambili. ### Umphakathi Nezimoto Uhlanga lweGautrain luthinta umphakathi jikelele, njengoba luhlinzeka ngohambo olukhawulezayo noluphephile ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhulisa umnotho, njengoba abahambi bengahamba beya emabhizinisini, ezikhungweni zokungcebeleka, nasezikhungweni zemfundo. I-Gautrain ivumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahlale behlanzekile, benciphisa umthelela wabo emvelweni. ### Izinselelo Noma kunjalo, iGautrain ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kweziteshi, abanye abantu bahlala bekhuluma ngentengo yokuhamba, ethintwa yamanani okuphila. Ukuhlola kabusha kwentengo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabahambi. Abanye abahambi baphawula ukuthi ukudlula komphakathi uma kuqhathaniswa nemoto kubangela ukusilela okuthile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. ### Ikusasa Le-Gautrain Ngokubheka phambili, iGautrain inethuba elikhulu lokukhula. Njengoba iGauteng iqhubeka nokukhula, udinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokwenza ukuthi uhlelo luhlale lusebenzela umphakathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe obusha, njengokuhlola amakhadi amasha nezinhlelo zokuhamba, kuzoba nethuba lokwandisa ukusebenza kahle. Ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamizi nezinkampani, iGautrain ingaba yisixazululo esiyingqayizivele sokuhamba. ### Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kweGautrain, umphakathi waseGauteng uthole ithuba lokuhamba kalula, okwandisa umphumela wokuphila kwabantu. Noma izinselelo zikhona, ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iGautrain iyinsiza ewusizo yempilo yansuku zonke. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo kungaholela emiphumeleni emihle, okukhombisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana nokuhamba okukhululekile kuyinselelo ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. I-Gautrain ibhekwa njengomgibeli obalulekile eGauteng, ikhombisa indlela yokuthuthuka nokuqhubeka.
Odokotela eNingizimu Afrika Ekuqaleni, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, odokotela eNingizimu Afrika benza umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubantu. UDr. Thandiwe, udokotela ophumelelayo, wayengomunye walabo. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, kodwa wayenombono omkhulu wokuba udokotela. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola ithuba lokusebenza esibhedlela esikhulu eGoli. Lapha, wabona izimo ezinzima, abantu abahluphekayo, nezifo eziningi. Noma kunjalo, uThandiwe wayenokholo, futhi wayazi ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawubalulekile. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezisebenzi zempilo. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandiwe wathola isimo esinzima. Umfana omncane, uSipho, wayelimele kakhulu emgwaqweni. UThandiwe waphuthuma, wathola ukuthi uSipho udinga ukuhlinzwa ngokushesha. Wakhumbula izifundo zakhe, waba udokotela onobuchule, waqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abanye odokotela bazi ukuthi uSipho udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Ngemuva kokuhlinzwa, uSipho waphila. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuba odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika bangabantu abanesibindi, abakhuthazayo, futhi abahlala bephokophele ukuphila kwabanye. Kodwa, uThandiwe waphinde wabhekana nezithiyo eziningi. Ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazinganele. Izibhedlela zazigcwele, futhi abanye abantu babengenakho ukufinyelela emithini. Lokhu kwenza uThandiwe azizwe edabukile, kodwa akazange ayeke. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabanye odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze bathole izinsiza ezidingekayo. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuhlanganyela, waqala umkhankaso wokwakha izikhungo zokunakekela impilo ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze abantu bahlale befinyelela usizo. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana, abakhubazekile, nabantu abadala bahlala benakekelwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso kaThandiwe waba yimpumelelo. Izikhungo eziningi zakhululwa, futhi abantu baphila kahle. UThandiwe waba yisithonjana emphakathini, futhi abantu bamthanda. Wafunda ukuthi odokotela akumele babe yizigidi ezithile, kodwa kufanele babe nabantu abakhathalelayo, abathanda ukusiza abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokuhola umnyango wezempilo. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona kubo bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba udokotela ophumelelayo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo empilweni. Wafunda ukuthi impilo ayinayo imingcele, futhi odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika bahlala bephokophele ukusiza abantu, benza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ngakho, uThandiwe waphila impilo egcwele, enza umsebenzi wakhe ngothando, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima, umoya wokuzinikela ungaguqula impilo yabantu. Odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika, njengomoya opholile, bahlala bephokophele ukusiza, bephila impilo enenjongo.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Kahulumeni Isingeniso Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abathola impesheni. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile ehlinzeka ngezinhlinzeko zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nezimpesheni zabo. Le mbiko igxile ekubalulekeni kokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, izinqubo ezihambisanayo, kanye nemiphumela yokungaqinisekiswa okuhle. Ukubaluleka Kokuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo abazidingayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yezezimali iyasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abathola impesheni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kunciphisa amathuba okukhwabanisa, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni. Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Inombolo Yempesheni Ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unayo inombolo yempesheni efanele, etholakala ezincwadini ezisemthethweni noma kumarekhodi ezemali. Okwesibili, umsebenzisi kufanele avakashele iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-GEMS noma abize ucingo kumphakathi wezinsizakalo ukuze athole imiyalelo yokuhambisa isicelo sokuhlolela. Ngemva kokuhambisa isicelo, umsebenzisi uzothola impendulo, evamise ukuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane efakiwe iyahambisana nezincwadi ezisemthethweni, futhi uma kunokungahambelani, umsebenzisi uzocelwa ukuthi alungise imininingwane. Izinkinga Ezivamile Nokuqinisekiswa Kunamaphutha avamile ahambisana nokuhlolela inombolo yempesheni, okuhlanganisa ukungafani kwemibhalo, izinkinga zokuxhumana, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithintekayo. Lokhu kungabamba inqubo yokuhlolela, okungase kube nomthelela omubi kubathola impesheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi abheke lezi zinkinga futhi azame ukuzenza zibe lula ukuze inqubo iphumelele. Imiphumela Yokungaqinisekiswa Okuhle Uma inombolo yempesheni ingaqinisekiswa, imiphumela ingaba yimbi. Abathola impesheni bangase bahlale bezama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banemali efanele, okungaholela ekukhathazekeni. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo, njengoba abanye bangase babe nezinselelo zokuphila uma behluleka ukuthola impesheni yabo ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaqinisekiswa kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni, njengoba izinsizakalo ezithile zingatholakali kubathola impesheni. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bathole izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathola impesheni bazi izinkinga ezivamile ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphile futhi alandele izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ngokwenza lokhu, abathola impesheni bangakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, futhi kuholele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, inani labantu abavuma ukujoyina uMnyango wezempilo weGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) liqhubeke nokukhula nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthandwa kwenqubomgomo yezempilo ekhokhelwa nguhulumeni, ehlanganisa izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze abathanda ukuthola lezi zinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi bamukele imigomo nenqubomgomo yeGEMS, ukuze baqhubeke bezithola izinsizakusebenza okufanele zikhokhwe. Izinsuku ezimbalwa ezedlule, abaphathi beGEMS bahlela umcimbi omkhulu wokwamukela abasha emkhakheni wezempilo. Lo mcimbi, obanjwe edolobheni elikhulu, wabamba izinkulungwane zabantu, kufaka phakathi abasebenzi, odokotela, kanye nezinhlangano ezihamba phambili emkhakheni wezempilo. Umholi weGEMS, uMnu. Khwezi Mlamli, uvule lesi sithangami ngokwazisa kubantu abasha ukuthi imithetho nemigomo yeGEMS iwusizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna ukunakekelwa kwabempilo okuhamba phambili. U-Mnu. Mlamli wagcizelela ukuthi ukuqonda kahle le migomo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. “Sifuna abantu bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukunikeza ukwesekwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi kini abesifazane, abantwana, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile,” kusho uMlamli. Ubulimungu bezempilo bukhula emhlabeni wonke, ngobunye ubusuku kwezobuchwepheshe, kumele kube namathuba angaphezulu okubona ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abavoti bahlala behlangabezana nezinkinga ezithile, njengezindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, isikhangiso seziguli eziningi, kanye nezizathu ezahlukahlukene zokungaphumi kahle. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinkinga, uGEMS usungule izinhlelo eziningi zokulwela abantu abavela ezindleleni eziphansi zomphakathi. Lesi sikhumbuzo sokubamba iqhaza sinikela eli thuba elihle lokuthi abathintekayo baqonde izinqubomgomo ezisemthethweni futhi baneture engakhathalelwa. Ngokwengxenye yombukiso, abathintekayo banikwe ithuba lokuthola ukuxhumana ngqo nodokotela nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kwavuleka ithuba lokucacisela umbuzo ongalungile nokusiza abantu abakazalwa ukuba baqonde izinzuzo ezenza umphakathi wazi ukuthi cishe ungakuthola kuphi. Umphakathi uyaqhubeka nokukhuluma ngendlela yokuxhumana nemigomo yamapholisi, okuyinto ethokozisayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abheleleka kunoma yisiphi isikhangiso. Uhlanga lwemali luhlala lungokubhekwa futhi abahlomuli bangacela izilirho ngosuku lokubhaliswa ukuze iqhaza ngqo. Lokhu kunciphisa isidingo sokuthi abathintekayo baye emiphakathini yokwelashwa, nabo banika ithuba lokwamukela imithetho yesikhathi esikwazi ukuba kulabo abavame ukudlula emafutheni aphakeme. "Kuyasiza ukuba siqondise imigomo eqondile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufaka izicelo zokwelashwa kalula," kusho uMnumzane Thabo Khumalo, ongumholi wezokuxhumana eGEMS. “Ngokukhipha lolu hlaka, sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akekho umuntu ozodlula emnyango weGEMS ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle.“ Ukuze abatungamizwi bezempilo baqinisekise ukwakhiwa kwezinklanyiso ezintsha, uGEMS uhlinzeka ngocwaningo lokumalunga nemigomo eyomile, ngalesi sikhathi kumele uthole izithombe ezinhle kakhulu ezingakuholela ekusebenzeni okuhlejj! Ngale ndlela, uGEMS uphinde wenze iziqinisekiso zokwelashwa ezihambisana neziqu zomphakathi, kuhlanganiswe nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubaqhamukayo ukuthi bafoo umphakathi njengabazulelayo, futhi banikezwe iesemwayeni uma befika. Ngokuphumula, uMnu. Mlamli wagcizelela ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enakekelwayo kubalulekile, bese bukhona abavuma ukufaka ukuphenya, okuhlobene nezifundo ezithile ezinzima zeGEMS, okuyinto ewusizo. Lokhu kuzojabulisa futhi kuzokwenza kucace ukuthi uGEMS ungumkhiqizo odumile emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngokuqhubekayo, abavuma abangewona abavumelekile, kodwa baqhubeka nokugqugquzela abantu ukuba bavele baphakamise izinqubomgomo zentuthuko, njengoba imizamo yeGEMS isiza ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. Izinhlelo zokwamukela imithetho ziyavuma, zikhumbuze bonke abantu ukuthi empilweni, onke amagalelo abaluleke kakhulu!
Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye (GEMS spouse/partner beneficiary status) Kwakukhona indaba emnandi eMshwati, lapho uThandi, intombazane ethokozisayo, kwakuhamba kahle empilweni. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lukaSizwe, umyeni wakhe, owamthandele futhi wamkhombisa ubuqotho. Bobabili babehlangene emshadweni obuphilayo, bejabulile futhi benethemba elikhulu ngekusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngamalungelo abantu abashadile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo. Kwakukhuluma ngohlelo lokuxhasa abantu abashadile, iGEMS, elinikezela ngokukhululeka kumalungu alo nasempendulweni zezempilo. UThandi, njengokuphila kwabanye, wayefuna ukuqiniseka ukuthi uSizwe uzothola ukwelashwa okufanele uma kudingeka. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi uvakashele umtapo wezincwadi zasendaweni, afuna ukuthola ulwazi oluthe xaxa ngalesi simo. Wafunda izincwadi eziningi nemibhalo edlalayo, ethola ukuthi amalungelo omshado adinga ukuvikelwa, futhi umenzi wezempilo ungena ngezimo ezihlukahlukene. Wazama ukuqonda ukuthi uma kwenzeka ungozi, uSizwe uzobe edinga ukukhathalelwa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba edlulela ezincwadini, uThandi waqaphela ukuthi uma umyeni wakhe engahlala ethola umvuzo wokwelashwa, kumele kwenziwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokubhalisa uSizwe njengomhlomuli. Wakhumbula izinsuku zokuqala zomshado wabo, lapho babebonisa izithakazelo zendlela efanele yokuphila ngempumelelo. UThandi wakhumbula izingxoxo zabo ezihamba phambili, bemane beqhubeka beshayela impilo yabo. Njengoba ubungcweti bumsiza, uThandi wanquma ukufika emsebenzini wezempilo owawuphakathi. Wafaka isicelo sokubhalisela uGEMS, wabhalela wonke amaphepha adingekayo, wakhumbula ukuhweba ngezinsuku ezinzima, ngaphezu kwamathuba amasha. UThandi wabhalisela uSizwe njengomhlomuli, eqiniseka ukuthi baze phambili futhi balungiselelwe impilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola impendulo ephezulu – umyeni wakhe ubhalisiwe futhi uyinqaba emgibeni wezempilo. Ukukhathalela kwabo kwazisa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabo, njengoba uThandi ethola ithuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili zeGEMS. Lokhu kwadala umfundaze omkhulu futhi kwavusa ithemba elisha empilweni yabo. UThandi noSizwe baqala ukuhlola izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, bezama ukufunda kabanzi ngemfundo yezeMpilo. Umoya wokwabelana otholakala phakathi kwabo wawuvuselela intokozo yempilo yabo, ngenkathi behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezimnandi kabi ezinkumbulweni. Baziqhenya ngekuhlonipha imithetho yezempilo, futhi kahle ukuthi umfanekiso wabo umhlomuli ulawulwa ngendlela efanele. UThandi wanikeza izeluleko zokugcina nezizathu ezinoshintsho, eziyisisekelo ezibalulekile zomshado. Wafundisa uSizwe ukuthi bangasoze bavele bakhathalele impilo, kodwa kufanele bahloniphe izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ngalesi sikhathi, waphinde waphawula ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bujolile kumkhakha wezempilo, kanti ngokuzayo, bazothola abesifazane abengeziwe ababonisa ukuthi bangabhalisani. Kukhona imiphumela ethokozisayo emlandweni wabo, njengoba behlangana nezinye izimpilo. Njengoba bezuza izifundo ezithokozisayo, baqedela izinzuzo zeGEMS. Ngalesi sikhathi, uThandi noSizwe babona ngezinsuku ezizayo, behlanganyela izifungo zempilo. Bagcina befunda nomhlomuli, behamba phambili empilweni yabo enothando, behlakanipha kabusha lesi simo. UThandi wayekujabulele ukujabulisa uSizwe, njengoba bobabili benza izinto ezithokozisiwe. UThandi uthi, "Uhlale uthinga emkhakheni wezempilo, siphephe umhlomuli wethu ukuze sibe nempilo engcono." Ngexesha elithile, uThandi noSizwe bathola lezi zifundo ezimnandi. Bafunda ukuthi umhlomuli wayesebenza nomphakathi, besekela abanye abantu bezempilo. Babejabulile ngendlela ababehlanganyela ngayo, futhi bejabulile ekudaleni umphakathi odlalayo ezindabeni zabo. Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye, sakhula sathi "Yebo, sinamalungelo." Ngaleyo ndlela, umshado wabantu ababili kwaba nenqubekela phambili. Baphendula umphakathi, bahlonipha imithetho yezempilo, futhi bafunda izixazululo ezithuthukisa impilo emhlabeni jikelele. UThandi noSizwe babezenza oqeqeshiwe futhi bagcina bezilungiselela ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaba umkhuba omuhle kubo, umthombo wokuzimisela nabahola phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSizwe bahlala bejabulile empilweni yabo, bexoxa ngothando, bephila kahle neGEMS. Bafisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuqonda izici ezisemqoka, okwakukhona umhlomuli njengenye indlela yokwakha izimpilo ezithembekile nezibungengelekileyo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kulungile futhi kujabulisa ukuba umhlomuli, uthando lwasendaweni, kuzo zonke lezi zinkumbulo ezinjalo. UThandi noSizwe, baqhubeka kahle, besebenzisa lezi zifundo ezivela emlandweni wabo, ukuze bakhe isitayela esiqinile emiphakathini, benze imihlaba emisha, futhi bathuthukise izimpilo zabo. Impilo yabo yahamba njengesipho, kanti umhlomuli wayekudala imiphumela emihle, emenza axhase abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umshado wabo waba uphila nokukhanya, uphumelele, uthokozise, futhi uqhubeke ukwenza impilo yabo ibalulekile. UThandi noSizwe bahlala bejabulile, bephila kahle neGEMS, bephinde bathokozisa abanye abantu ngothando lwabo. Lokhu kwaba ngumkhiqizo wobudlelwane njengoba bephinda bejula naleso sifiso sokuphila izimpilo ezizwakalayo futhi ezingenamkhawulo.
Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama esedlule Ngosuku olulodwa, uMnumzana Ndlovu, ohlala edolobheni elincane laseMpumalanga, wathola ithuba lokushintsha impilo yakhe. Njengoba ehamba edolobheni, wabona izikhangiso ezikhuthaza impilo engcono kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo eziphambili. Lokhu kumkhuthaze, kwathi emva kokucabanga, wanquma ukukhansela ubulungu bakhe besikhwama sokunakekelwa kwezempilo esedlule, iGEMS. Wafisa ukukwazi ukuhlola izinketho ezintsha ezitholakalayo. Nokho, ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke, wayedinga ubufakazi bokukhansela lesi sikhwama. Lokhu kwakubalulekile, njengoba umthetho wezempilo udinga ubufakazi bokuthi akasekho ngaphansi kwesikhwama esidala. Umlando wokuqala wokuqonda ubufakazi bokukhanselwa waqala ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule, lapho uMnumzana Ndlovu efika kwi-ofisi yeGEMS. Lapho efika, wabona abantu abaningi bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngemuva kokulinda emgqeni, wathola ithuba lokukhuluma nomphakathi ophathelene nezinsizakalo. Ummeli, uNksz. Mbali, wamkhombisa ubuhlakani bokuphatha izinqubo zokuqhubekisela phambili izicelo zamakhasimende. "Mnumzana Ndlovu," kusho yena, "ukukhansela ubulungu bakho kudinga amaphepha athile. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukusiza." U-‘GEMS’ wayekwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezithile zempilo, kodwa ezinye zazinzima. Ngemuva kokukhuluma, uNksz. Mbali wamnika ifomu lokukhansela ubulungu, elalidinga ukuba ligcwalisiwe ngokucophelela. Njengoba uMnumzana Ndlovu ebuya ekhaya, waqala ukucabanga ngalesi sikhathi esisha sokuphila. Wazibuza ukuthi angakhetha kanjani isikhwama esizomthokozisa. Wayenombuzo omningi mayelana nobufakazi bokukhanselwa, kodwa wayenethemba lokuthi uNksz. Mbali uzomqondisa. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, uMnumzana Ndlovu wathumela izicelo ezidingekayo kuGEMS. Waqhubeka nokulinda izinsuku ezimbalwa, ethokozisa impilo yakhe ngokuqhubeka nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wathola umyalezo obalulekile: “Siyavuma! Ubhalisele ukuphuma kuGEMS. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa buhlelwe.” Wajabula kakhulu, usuku lwakhe lwenyuka. Wazisa uNksz. Mbali ngeziphumo zakhe, futhi umfana omncane wakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima ezedlule. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, esikhombisa ukuthi wayesebenzisa isikhathi sakhe kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnumzana Ndlovu wakhetha enye insiza yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, eyayihambelana nezidingo zakhe. Lokhu kwenza waba nokuqonda okukhulu ngempilo, futhi wanqoba izithiyo ezingalindelekile. Wazi ukuthi ukulandelela impilo yakhe kwaba yinto ebalulekile, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola usizo lapho kudingeka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMnumzana Ndlovu wathola umyalezo ovela esikhwameni esisha. Lezi zinsuku zazigcwele ukujabulisa, njengoba umndeni wakhe wawuhlangene, bejabulela impilo engcono. Ibhuku lempilo elisha lalifana nensika, elibamba izifiso zakhe zokwakha ikusasa elihle. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayazi kahle ukuthi konke kwenzeka ngenxa yokuphikelela nokuhlakanipha kwakhe. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama esedlule babufana nendlela yokukhulula indlela, yokudala impilo engcono. Kwakungokwakhe, futhi lokho kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila okujabulisayo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kwaba yisikhumbuzo sezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe empilweni, futhi uMnumzana Ndlovu waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchule nemizamo yokwakha ikusasa elingcono kuholela ekuphumeleleni. Njengoba ehamba phambili, uMnumzana Ndlovu waba nethuba lokukhuluma nabanye, abakhuthaze ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile eziphathelene nezempilo. Kwaba yindaba yokuthi ubufakazi bokukhanselwa akukona nje iphepha, kodwa kuyisithombe sokuphila, sokukhula, nokuhlakanipha. Lokhu kwenze uMnumzana Ndlovu aqonde ukuthi impilo yempela iqala lapho sithatha izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Futhi ke, impilo yakhe yaphenduka yimpumelelo, ibonisa ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma unethemba nokuzikhandla.
Isibopho Selungu Ngolwazi Olungamanga Ngiyanibingelela, futhi ngifuna ukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile ethinta wonke amalungu eGEMS. Njengoba sazi, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile yokunakekela impilo, kodwa kunezibopho ezithile ezihambisana nokuba yilungu. Kulokhu, sizobe sikhuluma ngolwazi olungamanga, nokuthi lokhu kungaba nemiphumela emibi kumalungu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini eyaziwa ngokuthi "ulwazi olungamanga." Lokhu kungaba yizinto eziningi, njengokufaka izinsiza ezingekho, ukungazisi kahle ngezimo zempilo, noma ukusebenzisa amafomu angalungile. Lokhu akukhona nje ukungathembeki, kodwa kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezindlekweni zokwelashwa. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi uma ungafaki ulwazi oluchanile, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme? I-GEMS iyadinga ulwazi oluqondile ukuze ikwazi ukuhlela izinsiza zayo ngendlela efanele. Uma ulwazi lungalungile, kungaholela ekutheni uthole ukwelashwa okungafanele, noma ngisho nokungatholi ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umalungu efaka isicelo sokwelashwa kodwa engakaze akhulume ngempilo yakhe yangaphambilini, lokhu kungaba yinkinga. Uma uthola ukwelashwa okuthile, kodwa iGEMS ithola ukuthi bekukhona okuthile okungafanele, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha lezo zindleko. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhathazayo, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iGEMS inezinqubomgomo ezithile ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayawazi umthwalo wawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyifake, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izinqubomgomo zeGEMS, ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile kuwe njengelungu. Kukhona nezinye izindlela zokuvikela wena njengelungu. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso, ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhumana neGEMS ngqo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uthole izeluleko ezichanile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luhambisana nezidingo zakho. Uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyifake, ungase ucabangele ukufuna usizo kumeluleki wezempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqonde kahle izinqubo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso. Akukho okungcono kunokuxhumana nabantu abanolwazi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS izokwenza izinguquko ezithile ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ayazi kahle izibopho zawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile, futhi kuzovikela amalungu ekubeni nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme ngenxa yolwazi olungamanga. Ngokuphetha, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke amalungu eGEMS aqonde kahle izibopho zawo. Ulwazi olungamanga lungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izinqubomgomo zeGEMS. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukuxhumana neGEMS ngqo noma ukufuna usizo kumeluleki wezempilo kungasiza kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso. Qhubeka uqaphele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphakeme. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqonde kahle izibopho zakho njengelungu leGEMS. Hamba kahle!
Isimo Somhlomuli Somlingani Noma Oshade Naye (GEMS Spouse/Partner Beneficiary Status) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Phakathi kwezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala njengomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokunikeza usizo lwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuqonda isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye, okungukuthi, ukuthi ubani ongathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nale nhlangano. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathintekayo baqonde kahle ukuthi izinzuzo zifaka phakathi kanjani umshado noma ubudlelwano obuseduze. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kubantu abashadile noma abahlala ndawonye, njengoba izinzuzo zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngokwezimiso ze-GEMS, umhlomuli ungumlingani ophakathi kokuhlanganyela kwezomnotho, okungukuthi, umyeni, unkosikazi, noma umngani obambisene naye. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umsebenzisi we-GEMS eshadile, umkakhe noma umyeni wakhe bangathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokwelapha, izivivinyo, kanye nemithi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuhlela izidingo zabo zezempilo. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo ezithile zingase zibe nomthelela ekutholeni lezi zinzuzo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umshado ungakabhaliswa ngokofficial, umhlomuli angase angatholi izinzuzo eziphelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile baqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ezisemthethweni zifeziwe ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile mayelana nezimo zokuhlala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umhlomuli engakahlali nomsebenzisi, kungase kube nzima ukuthola izinzuzo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinzuzo zempilo zifinyelela kulabo abahlala ndawonye futhi abavumelani ngokwezimali. I-GEMS iphinde ibeke izinqubo ezithile zokubhalisela umhlomuli. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa ubudlelwano, njengemishado, izivumelwano zokuhlala, noma amanye amadokhumenti afanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokubheka izinzuzo ezitholakalayo, umhlomuli ungathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinzima, izivivinyo ezijwayelekile, kanye nemithi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abashadile baqonde ukuthi izinzuzo ze-GEMS azikhawulelwanga kuphela ezindleleni zokwelapha. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo zokwelapha ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezikhethekile, ezinjengokwelashwa kwezifo ezithile, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelashwa kwezokwelapha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okugcwele, okungaholela empilweni engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile yokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze umhlomuli athole izinzuzo ezihambisana nezinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile baqonde izinqubo ezisemthethweni nezidingo ezihambisana nezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi banakekele izidingo zabo zezempilo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile bahlale beqaphela izinguquko ezithinta izinhlelo ze-GEMS, njengoba izinqubo nezimo zingashintsha. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinzuzo eziphelele, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale ubuyekeza izinqubo ezisemthethweni futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubudlelwano bakho buhlonishwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zakho nezomlingani wakho. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumsebenzisi we-GEMS, qiniseka ukuthi uqonda kahle isimo somhlomuli wakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ezisemthethweni zifeziwe ukuze uthole izinzuzo eziphelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izidingo zakho zezempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wena nomlingani wakho nithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo.
Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile (GEMS dependent information confidentiality) Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, luhlobene kakhulu nokuhlonishwa kwezimpilo zomuntu kanye nezidingo zabo zokuphepha. Lezi zindaba zibalulekile, njengoba zikhuluma ngamalungelo abantu abancikile, okuhlanganisa izingane, abakhubazekile, kanye nabanye abahluphekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubani ofanele ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi, nendlela yokulugcina luvalwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akuphazamiseki. Ngokwejwayelekile, ubufakazi bokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo nolwazi lwabancikile luhlala luhlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izinhlangano eziningi, kuhlanganise nezikhungo zezempilo, zisebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezikhethekile ukuze zigcine lezi zinsiza zikhululekile ekubeni zivele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola, izivumelwano zokugcina ubumfihlo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ulwazi. Imigomo ethile, efana ne-Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) e-United States, ibeka izindinganiso eziphakeme zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhlobene kakhulu nemithetho yokuvikela idatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa, futhi luhlala lukhona kumazinga aphezulu okuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokuvikela idatha ibalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abancikile bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngolwazi lwabo, beqonda ukuthi lolu lwazi luzogcinwa luhlanzekile. I-GEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme) iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi izinhlelo zokwelapha zingagcina kanjani ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile, kuhlanganisa nezinyathelo zokuphepha ezibucayi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela idatha eziphakeme, kanye nezivumelwano eziqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bahlonipha ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buyahlonishwa, kubalulekile ukuba neziqondiso ezicacile ezichaza ukuthi ulwazi lungasetshenziswa kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile kubantu abathintekayo mayelana nokuthi ulwazi lwabo luzosetshenziswa kanjani, nokuthi banganjani ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Lokhu kuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi bazi kahle ukuthi banamalungelo athile mayelana nolwazi lwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile ziyasebenza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi, kanye nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo uma kudingeka. Ukuze ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buphumelele, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinyathelo eziphusile ezithathwa njalo. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile akukhona nje kuphela umthetho, kodwa kuyinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa, bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule ngokukhululekile, okungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, lapho abantu badinga ukwethembela kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile luhlala luhlobene nezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukuvikelwa, nokwethembeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimiso ziyagcinwa, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, izinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abancikile bahlonishwa, futhi bazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lukhona, luhlanzekile, futhi lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, ngakho, akuwona umgomo, kodwa kuyisidingo esiyisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, ophumelelayo, nolwazi.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Kuwo wonke umuntu, impilo iyigugu. Ukuze siqhubeke siphila kahle, kufanele sithole ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okwanelisayo, futhi kulokhu, kube nokukhululeka ekutholeni imishanguzo, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nakho. Enye yezinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezitholakala ezinkampanini zokwelapha yikhono lokugunyazwa kokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi ukufaneleka kwesivumelwano sokunakekelwa kwezempilo kweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Kulokhu, ngicela ukuphakamisa umbono wami ngomthelela walolu hlelo ezinganeni, emindenini, nakubantu abaningi abavakashela ezikhungweni zokwelapha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iGEMS iyinhlangano yokwelapha edqwaqla uHulumeni, eqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni nabasebenzi bezinhlangano zomphakathi banela ukuzitholela imishanguzo kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Ukuze lokhu kube ngempumelelo, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile; lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bazi kahle izinsizakalo eziphathelene nomphakathi, nokuthi izinsizakalo ezinikwa abantu zifanelana nezidingo zabo. Noma kunjalo, lo msebenzi awuhambanga ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ngokwesibonelo, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi kunobunzima obubonakalayo kulabo abadinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi uma kucacile ukuthi ukugunyazwa kweGEMS kuthatha isikhathi eside kunalokho abanye abantu abakulindele. Lokhu kungenza abanye abantu bazizwe bengasizi, futhi kuvame ukunciphisa ithemba labo ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo abazitholayo. Lokhu kunokuphazamiseka okungase kubangele izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Okwesibili, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa okwenziwa yiGEMS kudinga ukwenziwa futhi kube lula, ukuze kubize kuqede izithiyo ezikhona. Abantwana, abantu abadala, kanye nabantu abanesimo sezempilo esiphuthumayo, kufanele bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Kulokhu, iGEMS kufanele ithuthukise izixhobo zayo zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezimbobo zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola imishanguzo, izinsizakalo ezifanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokugunyazwa. Ngokubaluleka kokwenza lula lezi zinhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabezempilo, uhulumeni, nabantu bonke. Lokhu kuzophucula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokugunyazwa kokwelashwa lungasiza ukuphuma kwabantu bebhedlela, kanti lokho kunciphisa izindleko zokwelapha ezikhuphuka kubantu. Ngezinga elikahle, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa akuyona into yokubhaliswa kuphela. Kuhle ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo iyahamba phambili noma kusezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS kufanele ivumelane nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezizothuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo... Zifundo ezikhona zikhombisa ukuthi lapho izinsizakalo zempilo ziqinile, abantu bangaphila impilo engcono, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sihlole nezinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba impilo ye-GEMS iyathuthuka futhi iqhubeke. Lokhu kudinga ubulungiswa phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi, kubandakanya ohulumeni, abezempilo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Kudingeka izinhlelo eziphathelene nokuphatha ukuhlanganyela nokuvuselela lezi zinhlelo. Uma izinhlelo zomphakathi zingaphumelelanga, kuzodingeka ukufaka imizamo eyengeziwe yokwakha isixazululo esiqhubekayo. Njengoba siphokophele emiphakathini yethu, kufanele sigcizelele ukubaluleka kokuxhaswa kokwelashwa okuhle. Ukuze ukusabela kwezinhlelo zempilo kube nakho, iGEMS kufanele inakekele ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, zifanelane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kunciphise izithiyo ezibangelwa ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungabhekelelwa ngendlela efanele, nangokubambisana. Ekugcineni, sabona ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kunzima, kodwa kudinga ukusizakala ngenxa yezifiso zempilo zethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi netheku kudlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni lezi zinhlelo zibe ukuma okungcono. Ngakho-ke, masenzeni konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze siphume phambili ekwakheni uGEMS obucayi, onenhlonipho, futhi osebenzelana kahle ngempilo emhlabeni wonke. Uthembiso olungaqhubeka luveza ukuthi impilo ingathengwa futhi ilungiswe, kodwa kuphela uma sonke sixhumene futhi silwela lokhu esikufunayo. Izimpilo zethu ziphumelele, singabantu bempilo, kudinga isimo esivumelana nganoma iyiphi indlela.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) kubalulekile kakhulu kulezi zinsuku. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezimpilo zabo, kudingeka ukuba babe nemininingwane ethile ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Uma kuziwa ekufakeni izicelo zokuxhaswa ngemali noma izinsizakalo, ulwazi oluqinile nolwakheke kahle mayelana nemali engenayo luyadingeka. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile, futhi kuyingxenye ebalulekile ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubo bobabili abazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nemali engenayo kudinga izinqubo ezithile. Abazisebenzayo, abangasebenza emikhakheni ehlukene, kufanele bathumele ubufakazi bemali abahola ngayo, okubandakanya izinkokhelo ezitholwa emisebenzini yabo, ama-invoice, noma amabhuku ezimali. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali engenayo, ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yezezimali evela kumeluleki wezomnotho kungaba usizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathatha impesheni badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ehlobene nezinsizakalo abazitholayo, okuhlanganisa amakhadi empesheni, izitatimende zezimali, kanye nemibhalo ethile evela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakala eminyakeni edlule. I-GEMS ibheka lezi zidingo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abagibeli bayo bahlonipha izimfuneko zomthetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abazisebenzayo baqhubeke behlola izimo zabo zezimali, njengoba imali ingenayo ingashintsha ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi bahlale benolwazi olwakheke kahle ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo zokuphila. Futhi, abathatha impesheni badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala behlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze bazi ukuthi bahlala bejolise emiphumeleni ethile. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Uthando lokuthola umbono ophusile kulokho okudingayo kubalulekile, futhi i-GEMS ibonisa indlela yokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kube lula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abatholi bezinsizakalo bahlala bejolise emiphumeleni ethile. Ekuphetheni, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuze kube nezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, abantu badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala behlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa isimo sokukhula komnotho kuwo wonke umuntu, futhi umphakathi ungalindela izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlonishwa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba banemithombo ethe xaxa yokusiza abantu bafeze izidingo zabo zezimali.
Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 ngezinguquko empilweni Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi wethu wathola isaziso esibalulekile esivela kwiGEMS, okuyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Lesi saziso saphakamisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezizokwenziwa ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abantu abaningi abathintekayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokucabanga, nokuhlela izinyathelo ezizayo. Ekuqaleni, abantu abaningi babengazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinguquko zizothinta kanjani impilo yabo. Abanye babebona lokhu njengokuphazamiseka, kanti abanye babekubona njengethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezingcono. Kwakukhona ukungabaza, kodwa futhi kwaba nokukhanya okukhanyisayo. Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinguquko ezizayo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Izinsuku zokuqala zalesi saziso zazigcwele ukungaqondi. Abantu babebuza imibuzo eminingi: “Yiziphi izinguquko ezizokwenzeka?” “Ngabe sizokwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele?” “Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo ezintsha?” Le mibuzo yayiyingxenye yokuphila kwansuku zonke, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, umphakathi waqala ukujula ekuqondeni izinguquko. Izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo zaba neziqubulo ezithile, zakhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezizayo, ziqinisekisa abantu ukuthi izinguquko zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Lokhu kwavusa ithemba, kwavula umqondo wokuthi izinguquko zingaba yithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezinhle kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsuku ezingama-30 zaba yisikhathi sokuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona. Abantu baqala ukuhlela izinyathelo ezizothathwa ukuze baphendule kulezi zinguquko. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, izifundo, nezinkulumo ezazihloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde kahle izinguquko ezizayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kwavela izinkampani eziningi ezazihlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule kahle ezinguqukweni. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo kudinga ukuba bube namandla. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, umphakathi waqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo.
