Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuxhaswa. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo, nezindlela zokuphendula ezinguqukweni ezizayo. Ekugcineni, izinsuku ezingama-30 zaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubambisana, nokwakha umoya wokuxhumana. Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zazingezokuthuthukisa impilo, futhi abantu baqala ukujula ekuqondeni izidingo zabo. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuba zibe yinsika yokwakha impilo engcono. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuba zibe yinsika yokwakha impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zazingezokuthuthukisa impilo, futhi abantu baqala ukujula ekuqondeni izidingo zabo. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuba zibe yinsika yokwakha impilo engcono. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, lesi saziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sasingesinye sezikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, sakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ezinguqukweni ezizayo, futhi sakhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo.
Umbiko: Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS Major Member Classification) Isingeniso Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS major member classification, kubalulekile ekuqondeni kahle izimo zomhlaba kazwelonke, ikakhulu emkhakheni wezokuphatha, wezokwakha, nezokuhlalisana. Lesi sihloko sihloselwe ukufaka isibani kulokhu kuhlukaniswa, sihlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile mayelana nezifundo, izizathu, nezindlela ezisetshenziswayo ekwakheni lezi zigaba. Izinhlobo Zezinga Labalungu Elikhulu I-GEMS major member classification ihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezibandakanya imikhakha ehlukene efana nezintaba, izindawo zasemadolobheni, nezindawo eziyinxenye ezinkulu. Umkhakha wezemvelo, ovelayo, ungomunye wezinto ezibhekwa kakhulu, njengoba uhambisana nemiphumela yokwakhiwa kanye nezinselele ezihambisana nokugcina izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa kukhombisa ukuthi imboni iyakwazi yini ukulawula izinsiza zayo ngendlela efanele. Izizathu Zokuhlukaniswa Izizathu zokuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu zifaka phakathi ukunikeza umbono oyingqayizivele nosudinga ukuze uba nethezekile. Lokhu kuvumela abaphathiswa nabasebenzi bokuqonda imisebenzi ehlobene nemikhakha yabo ngendlela ecacile. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenziseka kakhulu emzamweni wokuhlonza izindawo ezihlala inzima, ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi benze izinqumo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuhlukaniswa Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu kuhlukaniswa, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka phakathi ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuhlaziya le datha, kanye nokwakha izigaba ezihlukene. Ukuze le nqubo ibe nekhono, kudinga ukuba kuhlolwe futhi kuqondwe izimo ezahlukene zomkhakha, kuhlanganiswe nezinselelo nezinzuzo zokubambisana. Umsebenzi wokuhlola kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izigaba ezingama-GEMS ziyahambisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile zomphakathi, ezokuphepha, kanye nemvelo. Izifundo Nokwenza Ngcono Ngokuhlanza kahle, isifundo esithathiwe kulolu hlobo lwezokuhlukaniswa sikhombisa ukuthi intuthuko yenkampani noma inhlangano ibondla kancane izigaba eziphezulu ezingama-GEMS. Ukuze kufezeke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuphatha ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu, karolo ebaluleke kakhulu empumelelweni yokuhlukaniswa. Izindlela zokusebenza ezilungile kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kudalwe isimo esihambisana nempumelelo, okuholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izifundo Ezivela Kwalolu Hlelo I-GEMS major member classification ikhuluma izaziso eziningi ezizohlonishwa. Ukuhlukanisa izigaba kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise uhlelo lwezokuphatha, kokubili emkhakheni ophakeme nasezinhlelweni eziphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa mayelana nezimo ezithile ezikhona futhi kuhlale kwenziwa izinqumo ezihambisana neemfuno zabantu. Izingcindezi ezivela kwelokuhlalisana koluntu kudinga ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuze kube khona ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Imiphumela Yokuhlukaniswa Imiphumela yokuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification ibonisa ukuthi ngokwenza izigaba ezihlukanisiwe, izinkampani zingakwenza kube lula ukuhlola izindawo ezinzima, zisize ukuhlonipha imithetho yendawo, futhi zithuthukise ubumba bomphakathi. Lokhu kunciphisa izingozi nezinkinga ezingavela, futhi kuhlinzeka ngendawo ehlelekile yokwazisa ngempumelelo ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isiphetho Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification kusemqoka ezinhlelweni zakuqala nezikhandidawayo. Imiphumela yalokhu kuyavuma ukuba kucace izimo ezahlukene emkhakheni, kunciphise izinkinga ezazikhona, futhi kube nemiphumela ehlukahlukene edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinto ezithinta bonke abantu. Kodwa-ke, lo mkhiqizo wobuchwepheshe awukwazi ukwakhiwa ngaphandle kokuba nezinhlangano ezisekela. Omni wokuhlola uhambisana neqembu labantu, umphakathi, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomhlaba, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo emisha. Kulesi sikhathi esibucayi, ukuhlinzeka ngembono engcono kulapho izimo ezisemqoka zikhukhula khona, okungenza izinqumo ezintsha zibe nohlu olusha. Ngakho-ke, le theory yesigaba se-GEMS major member classification iyasiza ekwakheni izinkulumo ezignele nezisizo, ubonisa indlela eqinile yokuthola izixazululo zokuphila okukhululekile kumuntu wonke. Ngalolu hlobo, umphakathi uzuza kakhulu okuwusizo.
Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi (GEMS management package documentation) Emhlabeni wamanje, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngale ndlela, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi zidinga ukuhlelwa kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokwaziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bandelekile. Iphakheji ye-GEMS (Governance, Efficiency, Management, Sustainability) iwumkhiqizo obalulekile ohloswe ukusiza abaphathi bezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuholele ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngendlela efanele. Imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS inikeza ulwazi olujulile ngezici ezisemqoka ezibandakanya i-governance, ukusebenza kahle, ukuphathwa, nokusimama. Lokhu kudinga izincazelo ezihlukene eziza kuzoncika kwiwo wonke umphakathi, abaphathi, nabanye ababambiqhaza. Ukuqala, i-Governance ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zihlakaniphile futhi ziyahambisana nezinhloso zomphakathi. Imibhalo echaza le ngxenye ibonisa izinhlelo nezindlela zokulawula ukusiza abaphathi bakhe izinqubomgomo ezicacile. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwezinsiza, okwenza kube lula ukukhomba ubungozi, ukulawula, nokuhlonza amathuba okuthuthuka. Ngokwehlukana, ukusebenza kahle kubalulekile ekwenzeni uqhenya lokuhola nemithombo. Le ngxenye ibheka ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani ngokuphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela iqhubeka ingcono. Imibhalo ye-GEMS inikeza izibonelo zokuthi izinsiza zingahlukaniswa kanjani ukuze zithuthukiswe, njengalokho okubandakanya ukuhlaziywa kwemisebenzi, izinqubo, nezindlela ezimangalisayo zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuze abaphathi baveze ukusebenza kahle, kudingeka babheke izinjongo zabo futhi bahlaziye izinga lokusebenza kwemithombo ethile. Ku-GEMS, ukuphathwa (Management) kubhekana nokuhlela, ukulawula, nokwandisa amandla ezinsiza zomphakathi. Iphakheji iveza izindlela zokuphatha eziqondile nezincomekayo, ezichaza izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe ukukhiqiza imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela izinsiza, ukwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene, kanye nokwenza ngcono ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi. Imibhalo ye-GEMS ifaka iziphakamiso eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa, okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwenhlangano. Okokugcina, ukusimama kubalulekile ekwakheni isu eliqhubekayo lokuphathwa kwemithombo. I-GEMS ibeka phambili izindlela zokwenza uqhakambisa imithombo yokusimama, ukuhlomisa abaphathi ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze banikeze imihlahlandlela efanele. Lezi zindlela zigxila ezingxenyeni ezibukhali zokuhlonza indlela enokuthuthuka, okuholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezinzile zesikhathi eside. Imibhalo ye-GEMS ikhuluma ngokuqhathanisa izinyathelo ezithathwa ngamanye amazwe, nokuthi kube nezenzo ezibonisa ukusimama. Ngokuphathelene nalokhu, imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS ibalulekile futhi iyisisekelo esiqinile sezinhlaka ezahlukene zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle. Abaphathi kumele baqonde futhi basebenzise le mibhalo ukuze bakhe izinqubomgomo ezihlakaniphe kakhulu, eziphumelelayo, futhi ezinokuthuthuka. Ukusetshenziswa kwemibhalo ye-GEMS kudinga ukuba nekhono lokuhlaziywa kokuqonda izimo zomphakathi, ukwazi ukuphatha imithombo ngendlela efanele, nokukhuthaza indawo yokusimama. I-GEMS iyinsiza ewusizo esize ukwakha izindawo ezinhle zokusebenza, ezilungele ukusiza abantu, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibeka izifundo ezibalulekile ezizokwaziwa yiyo yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, abaphathi baphakathi kwesibopho sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ukuphatha kahle, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyathuthuka ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Ngakho, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa kahle imibhalo ye-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nefinyeleleka kubo bonke. Abaphathi kumele bathathe lezi zinyathelo ngendlela efanele ukuze uzinzo lwezempilo nentuthuko lwezomnotho kube impumelelo, futhi lokhu kuzoba amandla okukhulisa isizukulwane esizayo. Ngaleyondlela, amaxhama enhle abaphathi angakwazi ukuletha izinguquko ezinhle empilweni yomphakathi, amalungelo abantu, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuphila kahle.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana Ku-GEMS: Okubalulekile Ekuqinisekiseni Impilo Yamakhaya Ngokulandelana kwezinsuku, ukukhula kwemishini yokuxhumana nezokwelapha kuveza izinselelo ezintsha ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokwelapha emakhaya. Kulokhu, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala iyinsika eqinile ekuhlinzekeni izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezinembile. Lokhu kungubufakazi bokuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana emkhakheni wezempilo kudinga ukuqondwa kahle ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomphakathi. I-GEMS ikhuluma ngokubaluleka kokugunyazwa kodokotela, okubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abahlali bangathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethola ukwesekwa kwezokwelapha. Uhlelo lokugunyaza kudokotela lubalulekile ngoba lwenza kube nesimo esiphumelelayo sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile ezithinta impilo yabantu. Ngaphandle kokugunyazwa, abelaphi bangase benze izinqumo ezingase zibe nemiphumela emibi ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abahlinzeki bezempilo, kanye nabantu abathola usizo lwezempilo kudinga ukuba kuhlelwe nangokucophelela. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yini engatholakala kubo, nezinyathelo ezizothathwa ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana akusikho kuphela ukukhulumisana, kodwa kudinga ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obunempumelelo phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo. Kukhona imfundo ebalulekile edingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, imihlangano yokwazisa, izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa kudinga ukuba kube yizindlela ezibanzi zokwethula ulwazi kubantu. Ukuzwakala kolwazi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi izinqumo zokwelapha ezithathwa yizinkampani eziyinkimbinkimbi, nokuthi bazi indlela yokuxhumana nabodokotela uma beface nezinkinga ezithile. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalabo abakhiqiza izinsizakalo nezala izinsizakalo kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle se-GEMS. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kudinga ukubhekwa njengokuhlanganyela okwenziwe ngozakwethu ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuxhumana olwakhiwe ngendlela efanele luba yinsika eqinile yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwabadokotela nabahlali. Ngokwezibalo, abahlali abanolwazi olunganele mayelana nezinhlelo zokwelapha kungase kudaleke izinkinga ezinzima ezimweni ezingathandeki. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi i-GEMS ibambelele ekwaziseni nasekuqwashiseni umphakathi. Izinhlobo ezithile zokuxhumana zingathuthukiswa ukuze zibe lula ezandleni zabantu. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kokwelashwa kwezifo nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, ukudinga izinguquko kusemqoka. Ukukhuthaza abadokotela ukuba bahlale beyazi izimo zomphakathi kudinga ukuba kube neziqondiso ezicacile ezikhombisa izindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nababaleki, okuzoqinisekisa ukuthi amazinga okusebenza aphezulu akhonjiswa. Ekuqedeni, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana akungoshi nje umsebenzi, kodwa kufanele kube yinjongo yansuku zonke. U-GEMS, njengolawulo lwezempilo, kumele iqhubeke nokufundisa, ukuxhumana, nokugunyaza ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Izizathu ezilotshiwe ziwubufakazi bokuthi ukwakhiwa komphakathi ophilayo kudinga ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo, ukugunyazwa okunembile, nokuzibophezela kubo bonke abathintekayo. Ngaphezu kokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo, lokhu kuzodala umphakathi ophilayo, okhulile, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka ngomphakathi, nabantu baphile impilo enempilo nenokuthula. I-GEMS kufanele iqhubeke ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umhlaba onempilo, oqinile, nolwazi olwakhiwe ngobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabodokotela.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa (GEMS Treatment Outcome Responsibility) Umbuzo 1: Yini iGEMS? IGEMS, noma iGlobal Evaluation and Management of Services, iyinqubo yokuhlola nokuphatha imiphumela yokwelashwa emithini. Le nqubo ibhekene nokuhlonza imiphumela ehlobene nokwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olungcono. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukufaka isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa siqukethe umthwalo wokuhlola ukuthi inqubo yokwelapha ikhiqiza imiphumela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhamba kahle noma cha, futhi kusiza odokotela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle kumakhosikazi abo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinto ezibhekwa uma kuhlolwa imiphumela yokwelashwa? Uma kuhlolwa imiphumela yokwelashwa, kubalulekile ukubheka: - Izinga lokuphila leziguli - Ukuncipha kwezimpawu - Izindleko zokwelashwa - Imiphumela emibi ethinta iziguli - Ukusebenza kwezinsiza zempilo Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ingahambisani nezilindelo? Uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ingahambisani nezilindelo, kudinga ukuba kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukubuyekeza indlela yokwelapha, ukusungula izindlela ezintsha, noma ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhulu zezempilo neziguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zicacisiwe. Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani ngezingozi ezihambisana neGEMS? Njengokuhlola noma iyiphi enye inqubo, iGEMS nayo inezingozi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukungabi nalo ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela ngendlela efanele - Ukuhamba phambili nezikhathi zokubuyekeza ezinzima - Ukungaqondi kahle izidingo zeziguli Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuqinisekisa isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Izinzuzo zokuqinisekiswa kweGEMS zifaka: - Ukwanda kokuzethemba phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo neziguli - Ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokunakekelwa - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi odokotela banolwazi olucacile ngesimo sokwelapha Umbuzo 7: Ubani ofanele ukuthatha umthwalo wesibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Umthwalo wesibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa uthwalwa yizikhungo zokwelapha, odokotela, kanye nezisebenzi zezempilo. Bonke kumele bahlale behlanganyela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa igcinwa iphawuleka kahle. Umbuzo 8: Kumphumela uma ukuphathwa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa ingenela? Uma ukuphathwa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa kungenela, iziguli zingabhekana nemiphumela emibi, ezinjengokuthola ukwelashwa okungafanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekuncipheni kokwethemba emithini nasabezempilo, nokwandisa izinkinga zezempilo ezithinta umphakathi. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kunezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakalayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe iGEMS? Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakalayo ezizama ukusiza osomabhizinisi, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo ukuthi baqonde ngemiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlola izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene nezifundo ezimayelana nezimfanelo zokuphatha nokuhlola imiphumela. Umbuzo 10: Yini ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iGEMS iyaphumelela? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iGEMS iyaphumelela, kufanele kube ne: - Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo - Ukuqonda izidingo zeziguli - Ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezisezingeni lomhlaba Isiphetho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa (GEMS) siyisici esibalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke iziguli, odokotela, kanye nezikhungo zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhamba kahle. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekelwa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ukwethemba phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zempilo. Ngakho-ke, qhubekani nokuqonda isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lempilo yethu.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Ngomoya ophakeme, umphakathi wethu ubona ithuba elikhulu lokwakha nokuqonda izinsiza ezitholakala ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nhlangano ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo ezithuthukile kubasebenzi boHulumeni. Ubulungu be-GEMS buhlinzeka ngezidingo eziphathelene nezokwelapha, ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, kanye nokubhekana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubulungu be-GEMS buhlanganisa iminyaka ethile yezezimali, lapho kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko nezikhuthazo ezithile. Iminikelo ehambisana nobulungu ibonisa indlela esithola ngayo izinsiza nezinsizakusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo nesikhuthazo semisebenzi ebalulekile. Iminikelo yobulungu be-GEMS ibhekelela izinsizakalo zezeMpilo, ezikhokhiswe ngezinyanga ezahlukene. Ukuze uthole ubulungu, abakwa-GEMS badinga iminikelo ethile, okuyizinkokhelo ezisemqoka ezihlinzekwayo ngababambiqhaza. Lezi zinkokhelo zingase zishintshe ngokwemigomo yokusebenza, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amapulani ahlukahlukene angavumelana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye. Abahlinzeki bezempilo abavela ku-GEMS banikezela ngezinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezifo ezithile nezinyathelo zokuphepha. I-GEMS ibhekelele ukufaka izimali emsebenzini wezempilo, iqinisekisa ukuthi abanye bethu bangathola usizo oludingekayo ngaphandle kwezindleko ezinkulu. Ukuze kudalwe umbono ocacile mayelana nezinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuthi ababhalisile balandele izinyathelo ezifanele zokukhumbuza, ukuze bazi kahle izinsizakalo abazitholayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuzibhala phansi izinkokhelo ezibekwe, izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo, nezixhaso ezenziwa yi-GEMS. Lezi zinyathelo zifanele ukusiza bonke abahlanganyeli ukuqonda obala izinzuzo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abakulayo baqonda kahle ukuthi iminikelo nezinkokhelo zombili zinendima enkulu ekuphileni kwabantu. Lokhu akugcinanga kuphela ezinsizeni, kodwa futhi kuthinta umoya wezimali nokuphumelela kwansuku zonke. Izisebenzi zempilo zidinga ukubonwa, kanti ukugqugquzela lesi sikhungo kubalulekile. Ukubona impendulo ethile kumele kube umgomo wakudala, ngenkathi sigqugquzela abanye ukuba babe nesithakazelo ekuthandeni ukulandela lesi simiso. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi konke lokhu kuxhumene nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. I-GEMS akukhona kuphela ukuhlomula kwemali, kodwa ibalulekile kumphakathi wonke. Ubuhlakani obuyisisekelo buncike kulokhu: umphakathi unikwa imiphumela efanele, futhi ukuxhaswa kwezempilo akufanele kube into kuphela yekhwalithi, kodwa kube umphakathi ophilayo. Ukuthathwa kwegama le-GEMS kudinga ukuqondiswa ngezindlela ezithile. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi okukhona okwamanje kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sizihlanganisa ngezindlela ezikhethekile. Siyavuma ukuthi isimo somnotho sishintsha, kodwa ikakhulukazi kunenkohlakalo ebukeka ngendlela ezinzile. Lokhu kuthinta ukuhlinzekwa kokwelashwa, okuvimbela ukusaiwa kwempilo. Cabanga ngokuthi i-GEMS ingase ibalazwe izinsizakalo zomphakathi eziwujuqu, ibhekelele izidingo ezihlukahlukene ezikhuluma ngemvelaphi yempilo ezitholakalayo. Ekupheleni, siveza imishanguzo eyenzelwe ukusiza umphakathi uqonde izinzuzo nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Abagibeli bethu bazoba nenhlonipho yokubhekisela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo, bephinde babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi oqinile. Kulezi zinyanga ezizayo, sizobona izinzuzo zalesi simiso, futhi sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza. Ngokuhlanganyela, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sifaka imithombo yokuxhumana phakathi kwethu, ukuze sithole izisombululo ezingcono nezindlela eziphumelelayo. Ukubumbana nokuhlala sinolwazi ngempumelelo ye-GEMS kuyakwenza ukuthi sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo nezinsiza eziqhubekayo. Sigubha amaphuzu afanele namathuba okwakha umphakathi we-GEMS kube yiphupho langempela.
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ngenxa yokukhuluphala nokwanda kwezinkampani ezihamba phambili, kuvele kudingeke ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziqinile zokubhekana nemithetho yokusebenzisa izinsiza kanye nemigomo yokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS (Government eMarketplace System) luhloselwe ukwakha indawo yokuhweba ethula izinkampani ezincane, kodwa kufanele kube nezikhawulo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza kuhambisana nemigomo yezezimali neyekhwalithi. Umsebenzisi ohambisana ne-GEMS kumele abheke ngokucophelela imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi. Lokhu kuvumeleka ukuthi kuphela izinhlelo ezithile zokuhweba nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezinhlelweni ezifanele, okuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlanganyela kulezi zinhlelo bahlangabezana nezidingo ezisetshenziswa umphakathi. Kumqoka ukuthi, uma umsebenzisi ehlangabezana nokwephula imikhawulo, uzobhekana nezijeziso ezinzima, okungaholela ekudlaleni phansi kwesibopho sakhe sokuhweba. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo kwezebhizinisi ngaphansi kwe-GEMS akuvumelekile ngaphandle kokuhambisana nemigomo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthi kube nohlelo oluqinile lokuphepha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo ethile, efana nezinsiza zamabhizinisi amancane, ayisetshenziswa ngendlela engafaneleke. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izicelo zazo ziyahambisana nemigomo yezezimali, futhi zihlola amandla nezinsiza ze-GEMS ukuze zishintshe uma kudingeka. Ukwamukelwa kwe-GEMS kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhuba izinhlelo zakho, zibhala phansi imisebenzi yabo, futhi zihlale zibheka imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi aziphuli iziqondiso. Lokhu kujolisa ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nabanye osomabhizinisi, lapho umphakathi ungazuza olwazini oluwusizo kanye nokuqhuba kwezimali. Ukwaziwa kweziqu ze-GEMS kusho ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zifinyeleleka kumuntu wonke, futhi azikho izimo lapho abantu abanye bengathola ukukhetha okukhethekile. Lokhu kuvuma ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukahlukene zomsebenzisi kungaholela ekuphumeleleni kokusebenza kweziqondiso ze-GEMS, okudinga ukubhekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma umsebenzisi ethola ukuthi imishanguzo yokuhlola ibhalwe ngalolu hlobo olungavunyelwanga, khona-ke uhulumeni uzodinga ukufaka izinyathelo ezinzima zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani ezinjalo azinamanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba umsebenzisi aqonde kahle iziyalezo ezichaziwe ukuze angabhubhisi izinto, futhi ahloniphe ngokwanele imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni indawo yokuhweba eqinile nehlala njalo. Umsebenzisi kufanele azise ngokuphumelelayo izinsiza kunye nezinsuku zokuhlola ukuze abavumelekile bahlanganyele ngempumelelo. Ukuqonda lokhu kulandelayo, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani ne-GEMS kuzoba yisinyathelo esiyinqaba empumelelweni yezebhizinisi, bese kubusiza umphakathi. Ngokuhlola imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, singaqinisekisa ukuthi isisekelo sokuphila kwezebhizinisi sithokozisa zonke izinhlaka ezihilelekile. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzisi kufanele avule amehlo akhe kuzo zonke izifundo namathuba, agcine umkhuba ovulekile nokuqonda, bese eqinisekisa ukuthi uhwebo lwakhe luhambela phambili ngaphandle kwezingqinamba ezididayo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kanye nemikhawulo yesikhashana uzothola izinzuzo ezinhle, ukuvumela umphakathi ukuba ugcine i-GEMS njengomthombo ochazwe kahle wempumelelo. Izikhumbuzo zokuhweba azikaze zikhumbulelwe ngaphandle kokuhlola imikhawulo ye-GEMS. Ngokuhlonipha nesinyathelo esiqinile sokusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqinile lempumelelo kwezamabhizinisi nasemphakathini, futhi sisebenze ukuze siqonde indlela yokugcina isithombe esihle sakwa-GEMS. Njengoba sibona ubuchwepheshe obuvela, kuzodingeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze iqinise imfundiso ezisizayo ngenkathi sithuthukisa ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ingabhekwa njengesihluthulelo sokubumbana phakathi kwezinkampani kanye nohulumeni, okuzokwakha izinto ezinhle emhlabeni wezebhizinisi.
Izivumelwano Zokufinyelela Kosonkontileka Besithathu (GEMS Third-Party Contractor Access Agreements) Ngaphakathi komhlaba wezokwakha, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezinsiza, lapho izinkampani zidinga ukuxhumana nezinkampani zangaphandle ukuze zifeze izinjongo zazo. Izivumelwano zokufinyelela, ezaziwa ngokuthi "GEMS third-party contractor access agreements," zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene, nakuba zikhona nezinselelo ezithile. Uhlaka lwezivumelwano luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zivumelwano zidinga ukucacisa izimo zokufinyelela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, osonkontileka besithathu kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi bangafinyelela kuphi, ngesikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kanjani. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho ukuphazamiseka emsebenzini, futhi zonke izinhlangothi ziyakwazi ukuhambisana nemigomo ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izivumelwano zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinsiza zemali, izinsiza zabantu, nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Ukucacisa lokhu kuzosiza ekugwemeni ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinkampani, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokusebenza. Ukuze kube nokuhlalisana okuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu baqonde kahle izinsiza abazitholayo, kanye nezibopho zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo yokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane ethintwayo iphephile. Osonkontileka besithathu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi kufanele bakhumbule izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izivumelwano kumele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezichaza izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo. Ngokubheka izinhlelo zokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi izivumelwano zokufinyelela zibe nezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutholeni ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu bayahlangabezana yini nezimfuneko ezibekiwe. Ukuhlola kufanele kube yinto ejwayelekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokuhambisana nemigomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisesikhathini nezinguquko ezisemkhakheni wezinsiza. Ukuvuselelwa kwezivumelwano kuzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu ziwumgogodla wokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani. Zihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokuhambisana nemigomo. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu baqonde kahle izimfuneko, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ngale ndlela, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zizosiza ekwakheni umnotho onempilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zikhula ngokuhlanganyela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzodingeka ukuthi lezi zivumelwano zihlale zisesikhathini, futhi zihlale zifaneleka emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo wezinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze zifeze izinjongo zazo. Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu, uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zingaba yinsika eqinile yokuphumelela emkhakheni wezinsiza.
Ubufakazi Bokukhanselwa Kobulungu Besikhwama Sangaphambilini Ngonyaka ka-2005, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wathola ithuba elisha lokuthola izinsizakalo zezempilo eziphakeme ngokuvulwa kohlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lolu hlelo lwenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi lwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, abanye ababeqashwe ngaphansi kwesikhwama baqala ukubona izidingo ezahlukene, okwaholela ekutheni bacabangele ukukhansela ubulungu babo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza izimo eziningi ezithinta izinqumo zabantu. Abanye babebona ukuthi izindleko zokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo zikhuphuka, kanti abanye babenokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo, okwaholela ekutheni badinge izixazululo ezihlukile. Lokhu kwaholela ekukhulumeni okujulile phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezempilo, njengoba bekudingeka ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abanye abantu baqala ukufuna ubufakazi bokukhansela ubulungu babo, okuyisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi umuntu usemthethweni ekukhanseleni ubulungu bakhe. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa bukhombisa izinsuku ezithile, izizathu zokukhansela, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula kubantu abahamba phambili. Nokho, ukukhansela ubulungu akukhona okwenziwa kalula. Abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nalokhu, okukhona izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe. Lokhu kuhilela ukufaka isicelo sokukhansela, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, kanye nokulinda impendulo evela kubaphathi besikhwama. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, futhi abanye abantu bahlala bephazamisekile ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle izinqubo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu babebona ukuthi ukukhansela ubulungu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni baphinde bacabangele izinzuzo zokuhlala ngaphansi kwesikhwama, njengoba izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu bephakathi kokufuna izixazululo ezinhle, kodwa futhi bephakathi kokufuna ukuzimela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaphathi bezempilo baqala ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe kubantu abakhansela ubulungu babo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, ezazihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhansela ubulungu. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza ukuthi abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi baphinde bahlola izinketho zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlola izinsizakalo zezempilo, ezazihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinketho ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, njengoba abantu beqala ukufuna izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ekugcineni, ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza ukuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhansela ubulungu kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezempilo, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okuphumelelayo. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi bahlale bephokophele izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza indaba ebalulekile yokuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezempilo yabo.
Ukuqinisekisa Izinkokhelo Zempilo Ngolunye usuku oluhle, uMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumfundisi esikoleni samabanga aphansi, wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela kuGEMS, uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo. Wayefisa ukuziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zakhe zempilo zikhona ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono emndenini wakhe. Ngesikhathi ehlole izincwadi zakhe, uthole le ncwadi ebalulekile. Wawazi ukuthi kufanele athathe izinyathelo ukuze aqinisekise izinkokhelo zakhe, ngoba lokhu kuzomvumela ukuthola ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola ukuthi kufanele aphenye ku-inthanethi. Wavula ikhompyutha yakhe, wahamba kwiwebhusayithi yeGEMS, futhi waqala ukufaka imininingwane yakhe, efaka igama lakhe, inombolo ye-ID, neminye imininingwane edingekayo. Ngemva kokufaka konke, wacindezela inkinobho ethi "Qinisekisa." Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, uthola impendulo emnandi—izinkokhelo zakhe zempilo zikhona futhi ziqinisekisiwe. Wazizwa ethokozile, ngoba wayazi ukuthi manje uzokwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, njengoba wayefuna ukuvikela impilo yakhe nomndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuphothula le nqubo, uMnumzane Mthembu waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo akukhona nje ukubaluleka, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphila kahle. Wazi ukuthi uma abantu beqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, bazokwazi ukwakha impilo engcono ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngemuva kokuphothula konke, uMnumzane Mthembu waphuma waya emzini wakhe, lapho abantwana bakhe babedlala. Wawathokozisa, wathi: "Ngithole ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo zethu, okusho ukuthi sizoba nempilo engcono." Abantwana bakhe bamjabulisa, baphendula bethi: "Yay! Baba, sizokwazi ukuya esibhedlela uma kudingeka!" Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba nesithakazelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuyisinyathelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngesikhathi edlula, uMnumzane Mthembu waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kudinga ukuba kube yinto ejwayelekile. Waqala ukufundisa abafundi bakhe esikoleni ngalolu daba, ukuze nabo baqonde ukubaluleka kokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Wabakhuthaza ukuba baqinisekise izinkokhelo zabo, ukuze bazi ukuthi baphila kahle. Umphakathi waqala ukwakha umqondo omusha, abantu baqala ukuqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, okuholele ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Uhlelo lweGEMS lwaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kungashintsha impilo yabantu. Ekugcineni, waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazi ukuthi uma abantu beqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, bazokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Q: Yini eyenza kube nesidingo sokugunyazwa kokwelashwa ebhodini le-GEMS? A: Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kuyinqubo ebalulekile ehlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zeziguli ezingama- medical aid, kuqinisekiswe ukuxhaswa kwemali, nokubheka ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezivumelekile. Q: Kanjani umuntu angaqala khona inqubo yokugunyazwa? A: Ukuze uqale inqubo yokugunyazwa, kufanele ube nekhadi le-GEMS lakho. Ungaqala ngokuxhumana nodokotela wakho noma umhlinzeki wezempilo, abazokwenza isicelo sokugunyazwa. Phinde, ungathumela isicelo ngokuqondile kwi-GEMS. Q: Yiziphi izigaba ezithintekayo ezingakwandisa amathuba okuthola ukugunyazwa? A: Amathuba okuthola ukugunyazwa ahluka ngokwezigaba ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi oluthile lwezempilo, izimo eziphuthumayo, noma izinsizakalo ezithile ezidingekayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubhalwe kahle emkhakheni wezempilo, izincwadi ezisekelayo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho ubhalisiwe ku-GEMS kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela. Q: Ingabe kudingeka incwadi ethile ukuze kutholakale ukugunyazwa? A: Yebo, incwadi ethile ibalulekile ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo sokugunyazwa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi isimemezelo esivela kudokotela, okuyindlela yokushayela umsebenzi wezempilo ukuthi kudingeka ukwelashwa okuthile. Le ncwadi izoba nemininingwane ecacile ngempela yokuthi kungani ukwelashwa kukhethwe. Q: Kuhluka kanjani ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa phakathi kweziguli ezahlukene? A: Yebo, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuncike ezintweni eziningi ezifana nomkhakha wezempilo, izimo zomuntu siqu, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Iziguli ezinemishanguzo ethile noma ezibhekwa njengedlula esikhathini esiningi zidinga ukugunyazwa okukhona. Ukuhlola ukuthi umhlinzeki wombiko ungowakakholwa ku-GEMS kuzoqinisekisa udaba olunembile. Q: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthola impendulo yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa? A: Isikhathi sokuphendula sithinta ubunzima besicelo. Ngokuvamile, izicelo ezilula zingaphendulwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-5 kuya kwezingu-14. Nokho, uma isicelo siqukethe izimo ezinzima, kungathatha isikhathi eside. Kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano no-GEMS ukuze uthole izibuyekezo. Q: Kukhona yini okungase kwenzeke uma ukugunyazwa kukwenqatshelwa? A: Uma ukugunyazwa kukwenqatshelwa, uzothola incwadi echaza izizathu zokwenqaba. Ungakhetha ukufaka isicelo sokubuyekeza, lapho ungabhalela incwadi ethi ‘appeal’ ebanzi ezifakazelo ezikukhombisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungathola usizo oludingekayo. Ukukhuluma nodokotela wakho kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni isicelo sokubuyekeza. Q: Ingabe zonke izinsizakalo zempilo zidinga ukugunyazwa? A: Kwamanye amacala, akudingekile ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zempilo zidinge ukugunyazwa. Izinsizakalo eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo noma ezivamile, njengokuhlinzwa kwempilo ephuthumayo, zingathola ukugunyazwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Nokho, izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga izinsizakalo ezithile zidinga ukuyobhaliswa. Q: Kungenzeka yini ikheli lazo ezimeni ezithile ku-GEMS? A: Yebo, ikheli le-GEMS lingaba nezindaba ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izimo zomkhiqizo oceliwe, imishanguzo etholakalayo, nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo. Ngesikhathi sokuxhumana, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka imibhede etholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ufaka izicelo ezithile. Q: Yini okufanele uyenze uma uthethiswa ukuhlaba umxhwele yilezi zinqumo? A: Uma ucabanga ukuthi izinqumo ze-GEMS azihambisani nezidingo zakho, ungavula icala lokubizela udaba ukwazisa ezokuphepha kulolu hlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okunembile nokutholakale okuvumelekile ukuze kwenziwe isiqiniseko sokuqonda izinqumo. Umgomo Wokugcina: Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo lwezempilo ezifanele. Kubalulekile ukuqoqa yonke imininingwane edingekayo, ukugcinana kwezokuxhumana no-GEMS, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola konke okudingayo ukuze ubhekane nezidingo zakho. Ukuba necebo elihle lokufaka izicelo kuzokhulisa amathuba okuthola usizo lomsebenzi wezempilo.
Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa (GEMS treatment outcome responsibility) Isingeniso Ukwelashwa kwezempilo kudinga ukuba kubekwe phambili izinjongo, izinqubomgomo, nemigomo ecacile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola usizo bathola imiphumela engcono. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Governance and Evaluation of Medical Services), sihlose ukuhlola, ukuphatha, nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokwelapha ukuze kuzuze abaguli, imindeni yabo, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Kulolu daba, sizobheka izici ezibalulekile zalesi sibopho, izinselelo ezihambisana naso, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisa umphumela wokwelashwa. Isizathu sokubaluleka kwesibopho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uma abelaphi beqonda futhi bezibophezele ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa, kuyasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abathola usizo nezisebenzi zezempilo. Lokhu kudala indawo yokuzethemba, okwandisa amathuba okuthi abaguli bazwe bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela emihle yokwelashwa ingakhuthaza abanye abantu ukuba baziqhenye ngokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezempilo, okuholela ekwandeni kwesibalo sabantu abathola ukwelashwa. Izici ezibalulekile zalesi sibopho Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sifezekiswa, kunezici ezithile ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, izinqubo zokuhlola kufanele zicaciswe kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwemibandela yokuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yokwelashwa ngezindlela ezithile. Izinga lokuphumelela kwesiguli kufanele libe nenqubo ecacile yokubala, ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukubona kahle ukuthi imiphumela yalesi sifo ibukeka kanjani. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo, abaguli, nemindeni yabo kubalulekile. Ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ugqozi lokushintsha izindlela zokwelapha, kufanele kube nokwaziswa okulinganayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, lapho abaguli baziwa khona, benikezwa ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze bazi ukuthi yini okulindelekile. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukwaziswa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo sokubambisana. Izinselelo ezihambisana nesibopho Noma kunjalo, izinselelo eziningi zikhona ekufezeni lesi sibopho. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemithombo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele ekufinyeleleni imiphumela engcono, kudinga ukuba kube nezinsiza ezanele, ezihlanganisa kakhulu ezolimo, ezemali, nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukwenza kahle imisebenzi yazo, ukuletha imiphumela ethuthukile. Okunye ukukhathazeka kukhona ezindleleni zokuphatha, lapho imiphakathi ethola usizo ingase ingabi nokuqonda okuhle ngemithetho nemigomo ebekwe. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ezivela emiphumeleni yokwelashwa, okungase kubangele ukunganeliseki kwabathola usizo. Kulokhu, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlala njalo, ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zihlale zinolwazi olusha nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokwenza. Izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphumela wokwelashwa Ukuze siqhubeke siphumelele ekufezeni isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, kufanele sithuthukise amasu okusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengama-software wokuhlola imiphumela, kungasiza kakhulu ekugcineni amarekhodi ahlanzekile nokuthola izibalo ezichazayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukujolisa ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathola usizo nezisebenzi zezempilo kubalulekile. Lokhu kungachazwa ngendlela efanele yokuphatha, lapho abelaphi beba nesikhathi sokukhuluma nabaguli, beqonda izidingo zabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, izifundo, nezifundo ezihlobene nezempilo kungasiza ekwakheni lezi zixhumanisi. Isiphetho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa siyinselele emikhulu, kodwa sinesidingo esibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ukuze sifezekise leli banga, kudingeka umoya wokubambisana, izinsiza ezanele, nezinhlelo ezicacile zokusebenza. Uma sikwazi ukuvuselela lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yokwelashwa, sigcine abantu bejabule, futhi sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi. I-GEMS, njengendlela yokuphatha, izosiza ekwakheni umphumela ongcono, okhulisa ithemba lokuthi sizoba nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abaningi.
Ukuhlinzekwa Kwegama Len­kampani Ne­khodi (GEMS Company Name and Code Provision) Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi kungani ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi kubalulekile, kufanele siqale sithole incazelo ejulile ngalesi sihloko. Kulezi zinsuku, inkinga yokuhlonza izinkampani nobuchwepheshe bazo ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni. Ukuhlinzeka ngamagama nekhodi ethile kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezidingo zomkhiqizo, izimiso zomthetho, kanye nezidingo zezimakethe. Ngokujwayelekile, igama lenkampani lidinga ukuba liqondakale, libe nesixhumanisi esiqinile nezinsizakalo noma imikhiqizo ethile ehlinzekwa yinkampani. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amakhasimende akwazi ukukhumbula kalula igama lenkampani, kanye nokwakha isithombe esihle esimqoka emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ikhodi, evame ukuba yi-alphanumeric, isetshenziswa njengefomethi yokuhlonza ikakhulukazi ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinkampani, ukugcina amarekhodi, noma ukufaka izinhlelo zezimali. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinqubo eziphathelene nokuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi. I-GEMS, noma i-Global Entity Management System, iyisistimu esetshenziswa amaningi ukuze kuhlonzwe, kuhlelwe, futhi kuqondiswe izinkampani emhlabeni jikelele. Le sistimu iyasebenza ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinkampani zibhala amagama azo ngendlela efanele, ngenkathi zilandela izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Kuleso simo, izinkampani kufanele ziqaphele ukuthi igama elikhethiwe alidingi kuphela ukuhamba phambili kumakhasimende, kodwa futhi kudinga ukungahlangabezani nezinselelo zomthetho nezobuchwepheshe. Kungakuhle ukuthi izinkampani zisebenzise izinsiza ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola amagama, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukuthi ingabe igama elikhethiwe selivele likhona yini, futhi uma kungenjalo, kulungile ukufaka isicelo. Naphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi igama lenkampani lihambisana nezinhlelo zabo zokumaketha kanye nemigomo yabo yokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, ukuqhamuka negama elisha kudinga ukucabangela izici eziningi, njengezithakazelo zomphakathi, ubuchwepheshe obukhona, kanye nemikhuba yokuhweba. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lenkampani lisendaweni efanele ukuze libe neqhaza elibonakalayo emakethe. Ngemuva kokukhetha igama elikahle, kubalulekile ukwakha ikhodi efanele. Le khodi izogcina ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinkampani, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kokuhlola, ukukhipha amafa, nokubika. Ikhodi, evame ukwakhiwa ngemininingwane ethile, isiza ekwaziseni izinkampani ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili ezimakethe ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abaninzi bahlola izinkampani abazifisayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, igama lenkampani nekhodi yokuhlonza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle. Umphakathi udinga ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngokuhlonipha imithetho, zifaka izinqubo ezivumelekile, futhi zikhumbula ukuziphatha kahle emsebenzini wazo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlinzeka kwegama lenkampani nekhodi akusona isinyathelo esincane. Kuyinqubo ebanzi edinga ukuhweba ngokuqonda, ukuhlola, nokuhlonza. Izinkampani ezikhetha amagama nekhodi ngendlela efanele ziba nethuba elikhulu lokuphumelela, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zibambisene nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke zihlola izidingo zomkhiqizo wazo, zibe nekhono lokwakha amagama nekhodi ezihambisana nezimiso zomthetho, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhumbula ukuthi inhloso yazo iwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwazo namakhasimende. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okunembile nokwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu namabhizinisi, okhulisa umnotho ngendlela efanele.
Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS (Government Electronic Management System) ibalulekile kakhulu emnothweni wanamuhla, njengoba amabhizinisi edlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho wezwe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda le mikhawulo, ngoba ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphumeleleni kwezimali nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zamabhizinisi. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bakwaMasipala kufanele baqonde ukuthi imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuba imithetho, kodwa iphinde ibalulekile ekwakheni impumelelo. Izinsiza ze-GEMS ziwusizo, kodwa zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Imikhawulo yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kufanele ibhekelwe ukuze amabhizinisi angalahlekelwa amathuba okuthola izinkontileka. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kubalulekile ukuba nezincazelo ezicacile mayelana nezimfuneko ezithile ze-GEMS, ukuze abanikazi bamabhizinisi bakwazi ukuzijwayeza nezindlela zokuphumelela. Imikhawulo ibonakala njengokuthile okuphazamisayo kwabanye, kodwa emabhizinisini, ingaba yithuba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umnikazi webhizinisi ehamba ngendlela efanele, angakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo. Ukuqhubeka nokulandela imithetho nezinhlelo ze-GEMS kukhombisa ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zamathuba atholakalayo. Ukuphumelela ebhizinisini kudinga ukuzimisela, ikhono, nokuhlonipha imikhawulo. Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS iyashintsha, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi ukuqonda izindlela ezamukelekayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho ayiphuliwe, kumele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo ofanele wokusebenza. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS lungahlanganiswa nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukusebenzisa amathuba ezebhizinisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu abafaka isandla ezinsizakalweni bathola izinzuzo. Ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempumelelo yamabhizinisi, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo. Ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithile, kubalulekile ukufuna izixazululo eziqondile eziphathelene nezinsiza ze-GEMS. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa amabhizinisi futhi kusize ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Umphakathi wempumelelo kahulumeni ungakhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane uma kungekho ukuphazamiseka kumthetho. Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuzinza komnotho, futhi kufanele ibhekelwe ukuze kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuphumelela. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibalulekile emabhizinisini namuhla. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene nezinsizakalo, ukuze kukhuliswe ukuphumelela. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, izinsizakalo zikamasipala, kanye nohulumeni kuyadingeka ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezivela kumathuba amasha, okwandisa umnotho. Ngokuhlonipha imikhawulo, kufanele sikhuthazwe ukulandela izinqubo ezinhle zokusebenza, ukuze sithole izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi lethu linciphe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle ezinkonzweni ezenzakalayo, futhi imikhawulo ye-GEMS iyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lamabhizinisi.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sesisebenzi Sikahulumeni (GEMS Government Employee Status Verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni kubalulekile emisebenzini yezezimali, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano enikeza izinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhethekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola izinsiza bahloniphekile futhi banelungelo lokuthola lezi zinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahloniphekile, i-GEMS ibeka izinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo zokuhlola isimo somsebenzi, lapho umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzisi ungumsebenzi osemthethweni. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwa ukuvikela izinsiza ze-GEMS, ukuze zisetshenziswe kuphela ngabantu abavunyelwe. Isinyathelo sokuqala ekuqinisekiseni isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni siqukethe ukufaka isicelo sokuhlola isimo somsebenzi. Lokhu kungenziwa online, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi anikeze ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifaka phakathi izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezivela kumqashi, ezikhombisa ukuthi umsebenzisi ungumsebenzi osemthethweni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo kumuntu ofanele. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, i-GEMS izobuyekeza ulwazi olunikeziwe, okubandakanya ukuhlola izincwadi ezithunyelwe, kanye nokuxhumana nomqashi uma kudingeka. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, umsebenzisi uzothola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sakhe, okuzomvumela ukuthi aqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinsiza ze-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kubalulekile, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezeMpilo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zifinyeleleka kuphela kubantu abavunyelwe. Kubantu abathola izinsiza ze-GEMS, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezilandelwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina izincwadi ezisemthethweni, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile uma kudingeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zihlala zikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde lezi zinqubo, futhi bazi ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze baqinisekise isimo sabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye inikeze izinsiza zokuxhumana ukuze abasebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukuthola usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nezinhlaka ezithile ezisebenzela i-GEMS, ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinsiza ezithile. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinsiza ze-GEMS, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Uma abasebenzi bakahulumeni benelisekile ngezinsiza abazitholayo, lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi onempilo ubonakala njengesisekelo sokwakha izwe eliqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi baqinisekise isimo sabo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ze-GEMS zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abaphathi, kanye nezinhlaka ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde izinqubo ezihambisana nokuhlola isimo sabo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinsiza ze-GEMS ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unempilo.
Iminikelo Nezinkokhelo Zobulungu be-GEMS Ukuba yilungu le-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubalulekile ukuze uthole usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubulungu bakho busebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda imininingwane yeminikelo nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nalokhu. Nansi indlela yokwenza izinkokhelo zakho zokubulunga ngendlela efanele: Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Iminikelo Zobulungu Iminikelo eyenziwa yilungu le-GEMS ihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ngokuvamile ngokuhambisana nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Iminikelo ye-GEMS ifaka phakathi iminikelo eyenziwa ngonyaka, ethuthukiswa ngokuhlanganiswa kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mikhawulo ingashintsha, ngakho-ke kufanele uhlale ubheka izibuyekezo ezivela ku-GEMS. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhalisela Ubulungu Ukuze ubhalise njengelungu le-GEMS, kufanele uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo noma ehhovisi labo. Uzothola ifomu lokubhalisela ubulungu elidinga ulwazi oluthile njengeminyaka yakho, idatha yomsebenzi, kanye nolwazi lwezezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi ufaka yonke imininingwane edingekayo ukuze ugweme izinkinga zokuhamba phambili. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhetha Uhlelo Lokuhlinzeka Ngemuva kokubhalisela ubulungu, kuzodingeka ukhethe uhlelo lokuhlinzeka olufanele. I-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ezokwelashwa, ezokuhlinzwa, nokunye. Qhathanisa izinzuzo nezindleko zohlelo ngalunye ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukhetha lokho okuthokozisayo. Ungacela usizo kumeluleki we-GEMS uma ungazi kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukwenza Izinkokhelo Zobulungu Izinkokhelo zakho zidinga ukuba zenziwe ngenyanga futhi zihlala zikhokhelwa emuva. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungumsebenzi, izinkokhelo zingaqhathaniswa nezinye izinxephezelo zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izinsuku zokugcina zokukhokha ukuze ungabhekani nezinkinga zokungabi nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqinisekisa Ukukhokha Ngemuva kokwenza izinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zifakwe kahle. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokuhlola i-akhawunti yakho ye-GEMS online, noma ngokuxhumana nekhaya le-GEMS. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle, futhi uzothola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Njengoba usuku lokukhokha lufika, qinisekisa ukuthi ubuyekeza izimali zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukufaka izinkokhelo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awudluli ezindlekweni ezithile, futhi uzoba nekhono lokuphatha izimali zakho kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Ne-GEMS Uma unemibuzo noma izinkinga mayelana nezinkokhelo zakho, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ngokuqondile. Bahlala bekulungele ukusiza, futhi ungathola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ungasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, kufaka phakathi ucingo, i-imeyili, noma iwebhusayithi yabo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqonda Izibuyekezo Nezinguquko I-GEMS iyashintsha izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zayo ngezikhathi ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale ubheka izibuyekezo ezivela ku-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi ngezinguquko ezithinta ubulungu bakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Isinyathelo 9: Ukulandelela Izinsiza Zempilo Ngemva kokukhokha, ungathola izinsiza ezahlukene ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya izikhungo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela impilo, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyawasebenzisa la mathuba ukuze uthole usizo olufanele. Isinyathelo 10: Ukuqonda Izinsiza Zokuxhumana I-GEMS inezinsiza eziningi zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo, ezihlanganisa imithombo ye-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazisebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uthole ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi uqhubeke uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungu bakho be-GEMS busebenza kahle, futhi uthola usizo lwezempilo oludingayo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale unolwazi oluqondile, futhi uvuselela izinkokhelo zakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga. Ukwazi kahle imininingwane yokubulunga kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele.
Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo (GEMS member consent for health provider communication) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi ubona ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabantu abathola lezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile kakhulu. Ngalesi sizathu, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ithuthukise indlela yokuphatha imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwalabo abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabathengi bempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye kuyaphumelela. Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana iyinqubo ebalulekile, ethinta zonke izigaba zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngaphambi kokuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo baqale ukuxhumana nolwazi olubalulekile ngaleli qembu, kubalulekile ukuthi imvume itholakale. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo alabo abathola usizo lwezempilo ayahlonishwa, futhi bazizwa bekhululekile uma bechaza izinkinga zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imvume ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwayo luhambisana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye, futhi luhlonipha izinqubo zomthetho ezikhona. Ngokubambisana nezinhlaka ezahlukene, iGEMS ibone ukuthi kubalulekile ukwakha indlela elula yokuthola le mvume. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-imeyili, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibukhoma. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi unolwazi oluningi noma oluncane ngempilo, angakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi futhi aqonde kahle ukuthi imvume yakhe ibaluleke kangakanani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iGEMS ibeka phambili ukuqwashisa ngale nqubo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa nezokuxhumana zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu abazi kahle izinzuzo zokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi imvume ingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokunakekelwa, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komhlinzeki kanye nelungu. Ukuqwashisa kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu abathola usizo, ukuze bonke baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS ibona ukuthi imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo akugcini nje ngokuba inqubo yokubhalisa, kodwa iyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo olufanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, iGEMS ibambisene nabahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imvume iyavuma, futhi ulwazi olunikezwayo luhambisana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye. Ekugcineni, imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibona ukuthi le nqubo iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabathengi bempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde kahle imvume yabo, futhi bazi ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bathola usizo olufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngale ndlela, iGEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo iyinqubo ehloniphekile, esebenzayo, futhi efinyeleleka kalula, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi okwazi ukuphila kahle.
Isibopho Samalungu e-GEMS Ngolwazi Olungamanga Emphakathini wethu, ukwethembeka nolwazi oluqondile kubalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphathelene nezempilo. Imishanguzo, uthando lwezempilo, nezinsiza zidinga ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi ukuze zisebenze kahle. Ngokuqhubeka nokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS, kudingeka izindlela eziphephile nezinembile zokwabelana ngemininingwane ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuphila kahle. Kulomcimbi, sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile: isibopho samalungu e-GEMS mayelana nolwazi olungamanga. Umgomo wethu uwukwakha ukuqonda okukhulu ngemithetho nezinyathelo ezikhona uma amalungu engaphumeleli ukunika ulwazi olunembile mayelana nezempilo, izinsiza, noma ukwaziswa kwabo kokwelashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle ekwabelaneni ngemininingwane. Sizobe sibhunga ngezinjongo ezisemqoka zokuba amalungu abe nolwazi olunembile nemiyalelo ehlobene nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ngohlelo lokuhlola izinqubo zokuphatha ulwazi, sizokhuthaza amalungu ukuba alandele izinqubo ezilungile zokubheka nokuphatha ulwazi lwabo, ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela emibi engase ibe khona ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezikhulumeli ezizokwabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezingozi zokwabelana ngolwazi olungamanga. Ngokusebenzisana namalungu, sizokwakha isikhala sokuxoxa esivulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwakha isithombe esihle sokuhlanganyela. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olungamanga kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezempilweni, okungaholela ekunganelisweni kwezokwelapha. Sizobandakanya amalungu kwiworkshop, edlulisa izifundo eziphawulekayo mayelana nezingozi ezihlobene nolwazi olungamanga. Izifundo eziphusile, umdlalo ongenaqophelo, kanye nezingxoxo ezinzulu zizokwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayazi ukuthi kufanele baphathe kanjani ulwazi lwabo, ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Amalungu azofaneleka ukuba nocwaningo olucacile lwezimo zomthetho ezibhekene nalolu hlelo, njengoba ukuphula imithetho ye-GEMS kungaholela ekukhishweni kwezinsiza. Kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde lokhu ukuze bagweme izinkinga. Sizohlinzeka ngezifundo ezicacile, ezizokwenza amalungu azuze izinzuzo ezithile. Umcimbi uzoba nethuba lokuhlanganyela ulwazi oluwusizo nokubanga impendulo ezokwenza kube nesiqiniseko sokuthi amalungu akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele mayelana nezinsizakalo ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwamalungu. Ngokuhambisana nohlaka lwe-GEMS, sizogubha ubuchwepheshe nezindlela ezintsha ezizokhulisa impilo yamalungu, futhi siqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabafundi nababukeli. Umsebenzi wethu uwukugqugquzela umthetho nosizo abalulekile ukuze kuqashelwe imiphumela engathandeki uma amalungu eshaya indiva izinqumo eziphathelene nolwazi lwabo. Umcimbi uzothokozisa wonke amaqembu, kusukela kumalungu, odokotela, nabezindaba, ukuze bakhe umqondo wobudlelwane obusheshayo – umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo wobuchwepheshe, kanye nomphakathi onokufinyelela kwempilo. Ekugcineni, sizokhumbuza amalungu ethu ukuthi ukwethembeka kuyisihluthulelo emhlabeni we-GEMS. Ukubambisana kwethu, ukuphathwa kohlelo, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyiyo kuzokwenza ukuthi sonke sihlinzeke isithombe esihle sokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kumalungu nemiphakathi yethu jikelele. Ngalesi simo, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokubambisana kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa elihle kumphakathi. Siyabonga ngokuba nathi kulomcimbi, silindele impumelelo enkulu!
Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike Kwabanye (GEMS Dependent Member Classification) Isingeniso Sanibonani, ngiyajabula ukukwazi lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngendaba ebalulekile yokuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ngaphansi kweGEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye, kanye nezimfuno zefomu elithile, zihlangene kanjani nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngicela ungithumele izinkinga, imibuzo, nemicabango ongase ube nayo. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Uhlaka lweGEMS Ngaphambi kokuba sithinte ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda uhlelo lweGEMS. GEMS, okuyisifinyezo seGovernment Employees Medical Scheme, iyisikhwama somshwalense wezempilo esihlinzeka ngozakwethu abasebenzi bakamasipala. Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa amalungu ahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nalabo abanezingane, abashadile, nabanye abantu abancike kumalungu. Ingxenye 2: Ubuhlobo phakathi kwamalungu ancike kwabanye Ukuqonda ubani ongena ngaphansi kwesigaba samalungu ancike kwabanye kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukuthi umqashi noma ilungu elikhulu lungathatha umthwalo wezidingo zempilo zabanye abantu, kuhlanganise izingane, abashadile, kanye nabanye abancike kumalungu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izimfuno zabo ukuze bahlale befakwe esicelweni seGEMS. Ingxenye 3: Uhlaka lokuhlukanisa amalungu Uhlaka lokuhlukanisa amalungu ancike kwabanye luqukethe izigaba ezithile, ezifana nabashadile, izingane, nabanye abancike kumalungu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu athola usizo olufanele nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Umama emsebenzini kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izingane zakhe zifakwe esicelweni seGEMS ukuze zikwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Ingxenye 4: Izinkinga ezivame ukubakhona Naphezu kokuhlukahluka kwezidingo, zikhona izinkinga ezivame ukubakhona. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, noma mhlawumbe nezinkinga zokuhlonza amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuthola usizo lwezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu banakekele lokhu futhi bazi ukuthi bangakuthola kanjani ukwesekwa. Ingxenye 5: Ukubaluleka kokuhlola izidingo zomndeni Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye athola usizo olufanele, kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zomndeni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqonda ukuthi ubani ongena ngaphansi kwesigaba samalungu ancike kwabanye, okuholela ekutheni abantu baqonde kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ingxenye 6: Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi banganikela kanjani izicelo zokuhlukaniswa. Lokhu kuhilela ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, kanye nokulandela izinyathelo ezinzima. Amanye amalungu angase akuthole kalula ukwesekwa uma ethola ukuqonda kahle indlela yokufaka izicelo. Ingxenye 7: Ukubambisana nezinsiza zeGEMS GEMS inikeza izinsiza ezithile ezisiza amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nemihlangano yokwazisa. Kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu ahlanganyele kulezi zinsiza ukuze aqhubeke efunda futhi ethole ulwazi olufanele. Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ngaphansi kweGEMS kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Abantu kufanele baqonde izimfuno zabo, bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsiza, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bekwazi ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi wonke amalungu ancike kwabanye azokwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalesi sihloko esibalulekile.
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, kanti nezidingo zezimboni ziya ngokuya zanda. I-GEMS (Government Electronic Management System) ibonakala iyinsiza ewusizo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza zik 정부. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda imikhawulo yokusebenzisa le nsiza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho lisebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Umkhawulo omkhulu wokusetyenziswa kwe-GEMS ubandakanya imithetho yokuhweba. Ukuze uhwebo luhambe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu ophakathi kwenqubo aqonde izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. I-GEMS ibeka izimiso ezicacile zokusebenzisa, ezihlanganisa imikhawulo eminingi yokuthi ubani ongasebenzisa le nsiza nokuthi isetshenziswa kanjani. Lokhu kuzosiza ekugcineni ukwethembeka nobulungiswa, okubalulekile emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ngokwengxenye, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibandakanya izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ukuze uvikele idatha ebalulekile, i-GEMS ibeka imithetho eqinile mayelana nokufinyelela kolwazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuphela abantu abaqinisekisiwe abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kudatha ethile. Lokhu kuqinisa ukuphepha, kepha kungaholela ekutheni kube nezithiyo ezithile kumabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi uma engazi kahle indlela yokufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Enye imikhawulo ibonisa ukuthi i-GEMS ayifuni ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakusebenza ezihlobene nezinhlelo eziphikisanayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zik 정부 zitholakala kubasebenzisi abahamba phambili, futhi azitholakali kubantu abenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ziqondisiwe futhi zisetshenziswa kahle, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi angafuni ukulandela lezi ziqondiso. Ukuphela komkhawulo wokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ubonisa umthelela wezomnotho. I-GEMS ibhekelela izinqubo ezithile, futhi lokhu kungashintsha umthelela kumabhizinisi amancane. Uma umkhawulo ubonakala ungenza kube nzima ukuhweba, kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, okuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okukhula. Kubalulekile ukuthi abahlinzeki bazi ukuthi imikhawulo ethile ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yezinguquko ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinto ezinjengokushintsha kwemithetho yokuhweba, ezokuphepha, noma izinqubomgomo zomnotho. Ngakho-ke, abahlinzeki kufanele bahlale beqaphile ngezinguquko ezingenzeka, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi imikhawulo ikhona yini nokuthi izithiyo zingaba kanjani. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zik 정부 zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlinzeki baqonde kahle le mikhawulo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezithiyo ezinzima. Ukuqonda lezi zimo kuzobasiza ekuqhubekeni phambili kwezimboni zabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi bayakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, uma uhweba usebenzisa i-GEMS, kubalulekile ukulandela le mikhawulo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelela, futhi ugweme izinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi ukuqonda imikhawulo akukhawuleli kuphela ekusebenzeni, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukukhula okuzinzile komnotho. Njengoba uhamba phambili, khumbula ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi iyinsika ebalulekile yokuphumelela.
Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi Lwezempilo ku-GEMS Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi lwabantu. Sizobheka izinqubo eziyisisekelo ezihambisana nezokuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lezi zinqubo zidinga ukulandela ngokucophelela ukuze ziqinisekise ukuvikelwa komkhiqizo we-GEMS. Isigaba 1: Ukuhlonipha Imigomo Yokuvikeleka Kolwazi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi zonke izinqubo eziphathelene nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo zibhaliwe ngaphakathi kwemigomo yokuvikeleka ye-GEMS. Le migomo ivumela abasebenzi ukuba baqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lusebenza kanjani, luhlolwa kanjani, futhi lutholakala kanjani. Uhlelo lwezokuphepha kumele lwaziswe kubasebenzi kanye nakuzo zonke izigaba ze-GEMS. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela Nokugcina Ulwazi Ukuze ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwe ngokuphephile, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuhlela, zokubhalisela, nokugcina. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zesoftware ezivikelekile, ezisetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala kuphela kubantu abafanele. Umsebenzisi ofinyelela kulezi zinhlelo kumele alandele imiyalo ethile yokuphepha. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Ukuze abafuna ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo bakwazi ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele kube nemigomo eqinile yokubopha ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamakhodi avikelekile, lapho kuphela abanolwazi lokufinyelela abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kulezi zinhlelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi alufinyeleli kubantu abangafanele. Isigaba 4: Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Abasebenzi Kubantu abasebenzi, kubalulekile ukwazi izinqubo ezimqoka zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha, ezifana ne-workshops, ama-seminars, kanye nemihlangano ebukhoma. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kumele kube njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala beqaphele. Isigaba 5: Ukuphendula Izimo Zokuphula Ubumfihlo Uma kwenzeka izimo eziphula ubumfihlo, kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela iphendulwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lokuphendula kumele lubeke izinqubo ezicacile, ukuze ulwazi lwezempilo lungatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinsizwa eziyiqeqeshelwe ukwenza ukuhlola nokuphendula ezimeni ezingalindelekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlanganisa Izibuyekezo Nokuhlolwa Kwenqubo Ukuze sithuthukise ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola futhi ziqhube izibuyekezo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, nokubuyekezwa njalo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka. Isigaba 7: Ukuxhumana Nokubambisana Nabanye Ukuze uhlelo lokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu e-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abakhiqizi bezinsizakalo, nabanye ozakwethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukudlulisela ulwazi nokuhlala uhlanganyela. Isigaba 8: Ukubeka Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesimo sokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinyathelo eziphakeme. Lokhu kubandakanya ukucwaninga njalo ngezindlela eziphephile zokuphathwa kolwazi, ukwakha isithombe esiqinile sokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luqinisekisiwe. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa luphephile, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ku-GEMS kufanele zibe yimpumelelo eqinile, evikelekile, futhi zenze kube lula ukusimama kwemisebenzi ye-GEMS.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS: Umqondo Womuntu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho izinsiza zempilo zibalulekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi banele yini ekutholeni izinzuzo zeGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le mikhakha ibalulekile emalini esiwela ukuyokhishwa ezinsizeni, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezempilo, futhi iphinde ibaluleke emiphumeleni yethu yokuphila. Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo nokufaneleka kwama-GEMS, kufanele siqonde ukuthi le mnyango wawakhiwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenziGovernment. Ukufaneleka kwe-GEMS kuncike ezintweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ubudala, kanye nezidingo ezithile zezokwelapha. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi akuyona yonke umuntu ongena kuhlu lwe-GEMS ofanele ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Okwamanje, kunemivuzo eminingi nezinzuzo ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, futhi lezi zinsiza zibalulekile ekunakekeleni impilo yempilo yabantu. Nokho, ukuthola lezi zinsiza akuhambanga kalula. Ukuthola izinzuzo ezithile kungadinga ukuhamba ngezinyathelo eziningi, ukuhlolwa okungake kwabangele izinkinga, nokuthi kube nezinsizakalo ezithile ezilungile nezikahle ezifanele ukuthola ukufinyelela nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa yiGEMS. Ngokuphathelene nezindlela zokuhlola ukufaneleka, kudingeka ukuba kube neziqu eziphakeme ezithinta ubunjalo besicelo sokuthola izinzuzo. Abazali badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala bazi ukuba ngubani ofanele ukujula, futhi lokhu kubaluleke ukuze kube nokusungulwa okufanele kokufaneleka kwe-GEMS. I-GEMS ibalulekile, kodwa ibhulogu yayo ihambisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile, okwenza kube importantes ukwazi izinzuzo ezithathwayo.
