Kodwa-ke, inkinga enkulu esibona kulezi zinsiza zempilo yikhono local ebhizinisini lendalo. Ikakhulukazi, ezindaweni eziningi, abanye abantu bashoda ngempela emalini yokuhlola izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa umusa obalulekile, lapho izinsiza ezithile zempilo kufanele ziqinisekiswe abantu abaningi, kanti abanye abaphakathi nezocwaningo badinga izinsizakalo ezikhona. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukwazi ukuthi uGEMS unikeza izinzuzo ezinjengokhulumela wabanye abasebenzi baseGovernment kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuziphatha ngendlela efanele. Abantu abanesizotha, kudingeka bahlole ukuqonda izimo abazitholayo, kanti lokho kudinga okubona okuningi esikhaleni se-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubiza amakhono aphesheya kwasekhaya. Abantu abaningi bangazihlola izinsizakalo ze-GEMS ngezinhloso ezithile, kanti kuyinto ebalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izindlela ezithile zempilo zinganikeza imikhakha ethile. Lokhu kungaba yinsiza enkulu emndeni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Alukho uhlelo oluhamba phambili, futhi lokho kuthinta izinqumo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola okunembile nokunembile kokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuzuze izwe lonke. Lokhu kudinga izinto ezibucayi ezithinta izinsizasazi zempilo, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakele. Ubulungiswa nokufaneleka kumele kube nemisebenzi ethile, futhi lokho kuzoholela kumuntu izinzuzo eziyinqaba. Abantu badinga ukuqonda izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezithinta izinzuzo zemali, kuma-GEMS. Lokho kuhlelwe kahle kuyokwenza umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo, ikakhulukazi uma buka imiphumela engabhalwa. Njengoba nesizotha kwenzeke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izinzwa ezikhaleni ezithile zinganikeza ukuqonda okujule kokubili kwe-GEMS. Ukucacisa ngezinga elinomthelela yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekukhulumeni ngalezi zinsiza. Njengoba siqhubeka sikhuluma ngendawo ezithinta abafayo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhlosiwe kuqondwa ngendlela efanele. I-GEMS iwusizo kakhulu uma isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kodwa uma kutholakala ukungabi nalwazi, lokhu kungase kube nabantu abampofu. Ukugcina ngenxa ebalulekile nokuhlinzeka ngeziqondiso ezicacile kuyabhekwa, kufanele kubhalwe phansi imiyalo neziqondiso ezindawo ezithile, futhi umuntu ngamunye udinga ukuqonda izidingo zokuphila kwansuku zonke. Lokhu kufaka izinyathelo ezinzima kanti akusizi ukwenziwa ngezwi elijulile. Ukunciphisa lezi zinkinga, kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okuhle kwezeMali yempilo eqonde eqondile ukwenza umthelela ophakeme. Ngokuphetha, ukwazi ukufaneleka kweGEMS kuzokwenza umthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Khona lapho singayithola imiphumela emihle, ukuze uthole izinzuzo ezinqunyiweyo, kufanele sibe nesithunzi esihle, sithobela izinqubomgomo namazinga okukhuthaza. Umqondo wobuntu, ukuthola ngamandla kanye nezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi zempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. U-GEMS, wonke umuntu ofanele ukusebenza, kulabo abawazi, izinyathelo zalolu hlelo zizoba yizibonelo eziqhubekayo zokuphila kwethu. Ngakho, kumele sihlosise izindlela zokuqonda okufanele, sigxile kulabo abasebenzi, sikhumbule izingxoxo ezinjengalezi. U-GEMS ungagcina ungumakhalekhukhwini ezimfanelweni zempilo. Kuqakathekile ukuba siqonde kahle ukuzikhandla kwansuku zonke, ukuze siphumelele ezimvumelwaneni nezinzuzo ezintsha ezikhaleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuqondisa ikusasa.
Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye (GEMS spouse/partner beneficiary status) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza yokwelashwa eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. I-GEMS inikeza amalungu ayo izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa, kuhlanganise nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezibalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okudingekayo. Umbuzo 2: Yini umhlomuli? Umhlomuli ungumuntu okhethwe ngumuntu obhaliswe kwi-GEMS ukuze athole izinzuzo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya umshado, umlingani, noma umntwana, kuye ngohlobo lwesimo somhlomuli esikhethwe. Umbuzo 3: Yini isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye? Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye sisho ukuthi umpartner noma umyeni/womkakho ungumhlomuli kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umyeni noma umkakho bangathola izinzuzo zokwelashwa ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, uma umyeni noma umkakho ebhaliswe njengomhlomuli. Umbuzo 4: Ungabhalisa kanjani umhlomuli wakho? Ukuze ubhalise umhlomuli wakho, udinga ukufaka ifomu lokubhalisela umhlomuli. Lokhu kungafaka imininingwane efana negama, usuku lokuzalwa, kanye nezinye izincazelo zomhlomuli. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izincazelo ziqondile futhi ziqedile ukuze kube lula ukuhlela izinzuzo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakalayo kumhlomuli? Umhlomuli onguye umyeni noma umkakho ungathola izinzuzo ezahlukene ezifana nezindleko zokwelashwa, izindleko zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezidingo zomhlomuli, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe umhlomuli angase abe nezinye izinzuzo? Yebo, umhlomuli angase abe nezinye izinzuzo ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, ezifana nezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo, ukwelashwa kwezifo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okuphelele. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe umhlomuli kufanele ahlangabezane nezimfuneko ezithile? Yebo, umhlomuli kufanele ahlangabezane nezimfuneko ezithile ukuze abhaliswe. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufakazela ubudlelwano, njengemishado, noma ukufakazela ukuthi ubuhlobo busemthethweni uma ungashadile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele uyenze uma umhlomuli wakho eshintshe? Uma umhlomuli wakho eshintshe, njengokushada kabusha noma ukuhlukanisa, kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi ushintsho lwenziwa kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kuzodinga ukufaka ifomu lokushintsha umhlomuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinzuzo zihlala zikhona kumuntu ofanele. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izinzuzo zihlala zikhona uma umhlomuli eshiywe? Uma umhlomuli eshiywe, izinzuzo zingase zishintshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nezinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngenxa yokushiywa komhlomuli. Umbuzo 10: Ungathola kuphi olunye ulwazi? Olunye ulwazi lungatholakala kwi-GEMS website, noma ungaxhumana nethimba le-GEMS ngocingo noma nge-imeyili. Bazosiza ngazo zonke izidingo zakho ezihlobene nomhlomuli wakho. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zihloko, sithola ukuqonda okujulile ngesimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye kwi-GEMS. Kubalulekile ukuba amalungu aqonde izinqubo, izinzuzo, nezimfuneko ukuze bakwazi ukujabulela izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kumalungu ayo, futhi ukuqonda kahle isimo somhlomuli kubalulekile ekufezeni le njongo.
Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi (GEMS management package documentation) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhula, futhi izinhlelo zokuphatha ziba nezidingo ezinzima. Kulokhu, i-GEMS management package ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile kubaphathi abadinga ukuphatha izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Le mibhalo yephakheji iyinsiza ebalulekile, eqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani leli thuluzi ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS package yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha. Imibhalo yayo ibhalwe ngesiZulu esicacile, okwenza kube lula kubaphathi abakhuluma isiZulu ukuyiqonda. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izilimi eziningi zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluqondile kubalulekile ekuphatheni kahle izinsiza. Ngokubheka izigaba ezihlukene zomsebenzi, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izinsiza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zezezimali, abantu, nezinsiza zokusebenza. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubaphathi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha. Imibhalo ibuye ibonise izibonelo ezithile, ezisiza abaphathi ukuba baqonde kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zezezimali, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuphatha izabelomali, ukuhlela izindleko, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani lokhu. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izabelomali. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zabantu, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuhola, ukuqasha, nokuphatha abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangabaphatha kanjani abasebenzi babo, futhi bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bayaziswa futhi bayakhuthazwa. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqubo zokuphatha abantu. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zokusebenza, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuphatha izinsiza zokusebenza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zokusebenza, izinsiza zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokuphatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya ukusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangahlola kanjani ukusebenza kwabo, futhi bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuhlola ukusebenza. Ngokuphetha, imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS management package ibalulekile kubaphathi abadinga ukuphatha izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Le mibhalo ibhalwe ngesiZulu esicacile, okwenza kube lula kubaphathi abakhuluma isiZulu ukuyiqonda. I-GEMS package ihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha, futhi imibhalo yayo ibonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izinsiza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zezezimali, abantu, nezinsiza zokusebenza. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubaphathi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi basebenzise le mibhalo ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zabo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS management package izoba yinsiza ebalulekile kubaphathi, futhi imibhalo yayo izoba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangaphatha kanjani izinsiza zabo ukuze bafeze izinhloso zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bahlale befundisa futhi behlola le mibhalo ukuze baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zabo zokuphatha.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Ngaphambi kokuba sihlole kabanzi ngokuqonda kokugunyazwa kokwelashwa ngaphansi kwe-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yomuntu. Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathola izinsiza zempilo ezidingekayo, bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano yokwelapha ehlonishwayo, inikeza izinsizakalo eziningi ezihlosiwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ayo athola ukwelashwa okufanele. UJohn, umphakathi ophila eGauteng, ungumuntu ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa njengabanye, ubhekene nezinkinga zempilo ezithile. UJohn ungumuntu onothando, onobungane, futhi onomsebenzi oncomekayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini zakhe, uJohn uthola ukuthi udinga ukwelashwa okuthile, okungase kudinge ukugunyazwa ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokuba aqonde kahle inqubo yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa. UJohn uqala ngokuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze athole ulwazi oludingekayo. Uthola ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kudinga izinyathelo ezithile, kuhlanganise nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinkinga zempilo zakhe. UJohn uqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bayazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, uJohn uthola ukuthi i-GEMS izobuyekeza isicelo sakhe. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zisebenza kahle. UJohn uyazi ukuthi le nqubo ingathatha isikhathi, kodwa uyazi futhi ukuthi ibalulekile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngesikhathi sokulinda, uJohn uqhubeka nokuphila impilo yakhe ejwayelekile, kodwa akakwenzi kube yinto engathandeki. Uhlale ebheka izindaba ezithinta impilo, futhi uqhubeka nokuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze athole izibuyekezo. UJohn uyazi ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa akukhona nje kuphela ukugunyazwa, kodwa kuyinqubo yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwakhe ne-GEMS, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ekugcineni, uJohn uthola impendulo evela ku-GEMS. Uthola ukuthi isicelo sakhe sokugunyazwa kokwelashwa sithole imvume. Lokhu kumjabulisa kakhulu, ngoba manje usungakwazi ukuqhubeka nokwelashwa okudingekayo. UJohn uqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile, futhi uyabonga i-GEMS ngokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokugunyazwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJohn uqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo ngaphansi kwe-GEMS. Uthola ukuthi le nhlangano inikeza izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinsiza zokwelapha, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. UJohn uyazi ukuthi lezi zinsiza zenza kube lula ukuthola ukwelashwa, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abanjengoJohn bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. UJohn uqhubeka nokuxhumana ne-GEMS, futhi uthola ukuthi le nhlangano iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze aqhubeke nokuphila impilo enempilo. UJohn uyazi ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa akukhona nje kuphela inqubo, kodwa kuyinqubo yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwakhe ne-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele, futhi uqhubeke nokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJohn uqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi uthola ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze aqhubeke nokuphila impilo enempilo. UJohn uyazi ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile, futhi uyabonga i-GEMS ngokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokugunyazwa. Lokhu kumjabulisa, futhi kumenza azizwe eqinisekile ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS (GEMS medical information protection) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe bukhula khona ngezinga elikhulu, ukwazi ukuvikela kolwazi lwethu lwezempilo kuba wumsebenzi obalulekile. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ziza nezidingo ezinkulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu lwezempilo. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kweziqubu zempilo, ngithanda ukukhipha umbono mayelana nezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kwi-GEMS. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lungumkhiqizo wokuthula owenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuphila kahle. Lokhu ulwazi lubalulekile, ngoba kudinga ukuvikelwa okubhekiswe ekukhanyeni kwezinto ezimbi ezingase zenzeke uma kudingeka. I-GEMS, njengomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zempilo, ineqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ukuqonda nezinyathelo zokuvikela ulwazi lwabantu. Ukubona ukuthi ulwazi lwazempilo lungagcinwa kanjani, kulindeleke ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siluvikele. Ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngonyaka owedlule, kuboniswe ukuthi abantu abaningi abakuvumeleli ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo luphume ngaphandle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzwelana nokuvikela okungekuhle. I-GEMS, njengephrojekthi ephethwe nguhulumeni, kufanele iqinise amasu ayo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwabathengi luhlala lukhona kuphela ezandleni eziphephile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganise ukwenza kahle izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubuhlobo obusondele phakathi kwabathengi nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kungenzeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi ophumelelayo wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS kufanele igxile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iwufanele futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga umgomo ophakeme wokuphepha okuhlanganisa ukuqapha okuhlanganyelwe nokuphathwa kwesimo sephepho. Uhlelo lokuphepha kumele lube nezinqubomgomo ezihambisanayo ezinikeza indlela yokuhlonza, ukugwema, nokuphendula ezimweni zengozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukufaka ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela obuhlasela amabutho. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokuphepha kwedatha ezisebenzisana ne-GEMS zingathuthukiswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe phambili imisebenzi yokuvikeleka. Kulolu hlobo, ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yokugcina izimfihlo, izinhlelo zokubika, nemisebenzi yokuhlola ingadlala indima enkulu. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwephula umthetho akusona isimo esijwayelekile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu baqonde izinqubo zokuvikela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsiza elula yokufinyelela, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuqonda indlela ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo olunakekelwa ngayo. Ngokusho kohlelo olukhalipha ubuchwepheshe, kungasetshenziswa izinhlelo zokuphendula ezihloniphekile, zibe nomthelela omuhle emizamweni yokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kufanele kube ingxenye ebalulekile yokugcina iso kulwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS kufanele ibe nezinsuku zokuhlola eziningi, ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ziyasebenza yini. Lokhu kusebenza njengesithunywa ukuze kutholakale iziphakamiso ezithile ezingathuthukisa amasu athile. Ngalokhu, umphakathi ungavuma ukuphatheka ngempela emabangeni okuvikeleka kwempilo yabo. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo akukona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngedatha ephephile, kodwa kube nezimo ezinhle zomkhiqizo ochumi. Uma i-GEMS ikwazi ukugcina ulwazi lwezempilo luyimfihlo, izothola imvume enkulu kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesithombe sokuthi i-GEMS iyinhloko yezeMpilo ezinokuhlala okuphephile. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kudinga ukusebenza okuqinile, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, imihlahlandlela efanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Sizofakaza kahle ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze umahluko uhlale uphila, kuyilapho singabheki phezulu ukuvikeleka kwempilo yethu. Ngakho, asikhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo yinsiza ebalulekile, kufanele lukhululeke, kodwa kuphela uma lutholakala ezandleni eziphephile. Siphakamisa i-GEMS nezinye izinhlelo ezizobheka izinqubomgomo eziqondile nezisezingeni eliphezulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwemiphakathi. Ukwakha umuzwa wezimiso ezizothuthukisa ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kusemqoka, futhi kufanele kube ngumphumela wethu sonke. Asiwuqhakambiseni umphakathi wethu, kodwa sigcizelele ekufundiseni ababambiqhaza mayelana nezidingo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS iyindawo eqala imizamo yokwakha ikusasa elinokuphepha nolwazi oluqinisekile lokwenza ngcono impilo yethu somphakathi. Lokhu kuncike kithi, futhi kungenzeka kuphela uma siqaphela izinselelo nokubambisana ekwakheni izinhlelo ezenza umthelela omuhle. Ngakho sizobe siye phambili, siqhubeke nokusela izinyathelo zethu, kuya emhlabeni osembili, lapho suntu sithola ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, siphumelela ngokweqiniso. Ukusiza omunye nomunye empilweni, ukuhlonipha ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezempilo, kuyindlela yokubuyisela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsizakalo yethu esiyenzayo, ukuze siqhubeke nokukhulisa umphakathi ophephile.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Umxoxisana: UProf. Thandeka Mthethwa noMnu. Sipho Dlamini UProf. Mthethwa: Sawubona, Mnu. Dlamini. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namhlanje ukuze sikhulume ngokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni. Ngabe ungathanda ukusho kancane ngalesi sihloko? Mnu. Dlamini: Sawubona, UProf. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sithakazelo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, ikakhulukazi yeGEMS (Government Employees Pension Fund), kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi umuntu ungowemali ethile yokupensiona. UProf. Mthethwa: Lokhu kuzwakala kuhle. Kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe le nombolo? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo ezilula. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele abe nenombolo yempesheni yakhe, kanye nemininingwane yomuntu efanele. Ngemuva kwalokho, ungavakashela kuwebhusayithi yeGEMS noma ucele usizo kumphakathi ozimele. Ukuze sinqande ubuqili, kudingeka ukuthi imithombo ibe yinhle. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngabe lezi zinyathelo zihlala zisebenza ngesikhathi sonke? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngempela, UProf. Mthethwa. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinqubo zingashintsha, ngakho ukufunda nokwazisa kubalulekile. Futhi, uma kunezinkinga, abathengi bangaxhumana nabaphathi beGEMS ukuze bathole usizo. UProf. Mthethwa: Lokhu kuyiqiniso. Kukhona yini ukubaluleka kokuba abantu baqinisekise le nombolo yabo? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngempela! Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bakwazi ukuthola imali yabo ngesikhathi. Lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekuphathweni kwezimali zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuvikela ukweba noma ukukhwabanisa okwenzeka uma imininingwane ingaqinisekiswa. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngabe kudingeka ukwenziwa okuthile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayazi ngale nqubo? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, kubalulekile ukwandisa imfundo kanye nolwazi. Izinhlangano zikahulumeni zingahlinzeka ngemisangano yokwazisa, futhi izikhungo ezihlukene zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi ngale nqubo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinzuzo zabo. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngabe ukhona umphumela omubi uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqinisekisa le nombolo yempesheni? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqinisekisa le nombolo, angase abhekane nezinkinga zokungatholi izinzuzo ezifanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni bahlale bezama ukuthola okungokwakho, okungaba yinkinga enkulu. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngabe ungakhuthaza abantu ukuthi benze kanjani ukuze baqinisekise le nombolo yabo? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyathi, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphelekile, baqinisekise ngezinsuku ezithile, bese bephendula ngokushesha uma beqaphela ukuthi badinga usizo. Ukukhulumisana nabanye abantu abanesipiliyoni kungasiza kakhulu. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini. Lokhu kube yinsiza enkulu. Ngabe kukhona okuthile ofuna ukuyongeza? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, UProf. Mthethwa. Ngifuna kuphela ukugcizelela ukuthi ukwazi ukuhamba phambili kulolu hlelo kuncike ekwazini nasekusebenzisaneni. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhilela wonke umuntu, futhi kufanele sibe nomthwalo wokunikeza ulwazi olufanele. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngiyavuma, Mnu. Dlamini. Lokhu kuyakhuthaza. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, UProf. Mthethwa. Ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. UProf. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Lokhu kube yinhle. Lokhu kube inhlolokhono ehambisana nezihloko eziningi ezibalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo nezokupensiona, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni. Ukuqonda okukhuluma ngakho kudinga ubuhlakani nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu.
Ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS kanye nemibhalo edingekayo Kwakuyilanga elimnandi, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, umoya wawupholile futhi uthokozisa njengomoya opholile olwandle. UNandi, umama oneminyaka engu-35, wayephumule endlini yakhe, ehlezi ethokozisa izingane zakhe. Nokho, namhlanje wayezokwenza umsebenzi obalulekile: ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS, okwakuzomnika ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono emndenini wakhe. Kusukela ekuseni, uNandi wakhumbula ukuthi ukuhamba kwayezokwenza kube nezinselelo. Wayazi kahle ukuthi amafomu e-GEMS ayadingeka ukuze athole usizo lwezempilo, izimali zokufunda, nomsebenzi ongalindelekile. Nokho, wayesebenzisa izinsuku eziningi efunda ukuthi angawugcwalisa kanjani kahle lo mfuno. “Inhloso yami iwukuthi ngithole konke okudingekayo,” kuphakamisa uNandi. Uhlanga lwakhe lwalugcwele amaphuzu angama-12 wezinto ezidingekayo, anjengemibhalo yokuhlonza, izithombe, kanye nemibhalo ekhombisa imithombo engenayo. UZodwa, umngani wakhe omkhulu, wamsiza ngezinyathelo zokwakha lezi zinsiza. "Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi wonke umthetho kufanele ulandelwe ukuze sithole usizo," kusho uZodwa, ethokozisa ukudlulisa ulwazi lwakhe. UNandi wahamba eceleni kwekhompyutha, ethinta izinkinobho ngokucophelela. Njengoba egcwalisa amafomu, kwaba nezinye izinkumbulo ezimnandi. Ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu bekuyinqubo efana nokudweba. Waqala ngokubhala igama lakhe, uNandi Ndlovu, wabe esehamba phambili nezinye izinketho. Uxolo lwakhe lwalukhanya, futhi isikhathi sasingajabula. Kwathi lapho efika emaphethelweni amafomu, wathola ukuthi ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ubulili balo msebenzi babunobunzima bokuhlonza. “Ngabe ngifaka isigaba esifanele?” kubuza yena. UZodwa, owayekshedlile, wamsiza. "Thina sesingabantu abavela ezigabeni ezahlukene, kodwa kufanele siqondiswe kahle." Izinsuku zedlule, uNandi wayebhekelele imiphumela yokuhlonza. Ufumene ukuthi kufanele enze izinto ezithile ukuze akwazi ukufaka izithombe ezidingekayo. “Ngabe kukhona owaziyo ukuthi izithombe zidingeka zifakwe kanjani?” kubuza uNandi. UZodwa waphakamisa umbono: "Bheka, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuhlonza kudinga ukuba sihlonishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqonde kahle." Ngemva kwesikhashana, uNandi wafaka izithombe zakhe, ethokozisa ukuqonda kokuhlonza. "Ngiyabonga, Zodwa, ngempela ungenze ngaziswa," kusho uNandi, edlulisela izwi elithokozisayo. UZodwa wayekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, futhi lokhu kwaba isipho esihle. Ngemuva kokuhlanganyela, uNandi uqedile ukugcwalisa amafomu. Ukubhalwa kwezincwadi, izithombe, kanye nemibhalo eyengeziwe kwahamba kahle. “Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoletha izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yethu,” kusho yena, ethokozisa umoya opholile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wabhalela i-GEMS incwadi yokufaka isicelo, enza amakholi, futhi wagcwalisa amafomu ahlanzekile. UZodwa waphakamisa umbono: “Manje kufanele sithumele lezi zinto, bese silindele impendulo.” Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokugcina sokuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uNandi wayenecebo lokugcina, lapho ahlola izinsuku ezithile ukuze alindele impendulo. "Ngiyazi ukuthi impendulo izothatha isikhathi, kodwa ngizohamba phambili,” kusho yena. Leli sonto, uNandi wagcina efunde ukuncika emizweni yakhe, ezwa ijoyi kuyo yonke inqubo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili, uNandi wathola i-imeyili ethokozisayo. U-GEMS wamamukela amafomu akhe, futhi bamsiza ngemibhalo eyengeziwe. "Ngiyabonga, uZodwa, lokhu kuyiqhamuka kuphela kokuqala," kusho uNandi, edlulisela umoya wezinhlonipho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wanqoba uhlelo lwe-GEMS, wathola izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi wathola ukwazi ukuxhasa umndeni wakhe. Uthando lwakhe lokuzinikela, nokuxhumana noZodwa, lwenza izinguquko ezinempilo zenzeka, kube umfaniswano omuhle wokuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, noma yikuphi, nathi sikhona. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphumelela, ukuxhumana, kanye nokubambisana. U-Nandi wayeboniswa ukuthi ukufaka izicelo ezinembile nokuhlonza kokulungisa, kuzosiza ekwenzeni impilo engcono. Lokhu akukwazanga kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kwaba yinsizakalo ethokozisayo emndenini wakhe. Uthando lwakhe, ubudlelwano noZodwa, kwaba yinsizakalo enkulu empilweni yakhe. Futhi, njengoba umoya wezimanga uphakamisa, uNandi wabona ukuthi imizamo yakhe yokugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS yayihamba phambili, izinsiza zikhula, futhi izinsiza zempilo ziqhubeka. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngokubambisana, bangakwenza konke.
Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo Isingeniso Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bayawulandela umthetho, futhi baphinde bagcine izindlela zokuxhumana ziphephile. Le ndaba ihlola impumelelo yalesi simiso, izinguquko ezitholakele ezikhathini ezedlule, kanye nemithetho ehambisanayo. Izizathu Zokuhlinzeka Ngemvume Imininingwane elula kodwa ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo ibalulekile, njengoba umuntu kumele anikeze imvume ukuze abahlinzeki bezempilo bakwazi ukuphatha idatha yakhe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eGEMS nabahlinzeki bempilo kuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Ukungahlinzeki imvume kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuxhumana, nokudlula kwemiyalo ethinta imininingwane eyimfihlo. Ukubaluleka Kwezimvume Ukugcina isithunzi somuntu kubalulekile ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzethemba phakathi kwabahluleli kanye nezinsizakalo zezeMpilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo phakathi kweGEMS nabahlinzeki bezempilo kudinga imvume efanele. Abantu bazizwa bephumule uma beqinisekiswa ukuthi imininingwane yabo izophathwa ngendlela efanele, futhi bazogcinwa benelungelo lokugcina ubulungu bempilo bungalokothi buphazanyiswe. Izinselelo Ezinzima Nakuba imvume ibalulekile, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokuhlinzeka kwayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziye zaba nezithiyo ezimayelana nezinsizakusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukutholakala kwemvume, kanti abelungu bangase babe nezizathu ezahlukene zokungathumeli imvume. Lokhu kungadala ukukhathazeka komphakathi uma abathintekayo bengaqondi kahle izinzuzo ezikwi-vidiyo nemithombo emisha yokuxhumana. Izinyathelo Zokuthola Imvume Ukuthola imvume kudinga ukufundisa amalungu ngendlela efanele ukuze baqonde ubungozi obuhambisana nemvume yabo kanye nezindlela zokuzuzisa. Izinyathelo ezichazwe kuhlu lokucacisa, ezisiza ekwakheni umkhankaso wokufundiswa, kufanele ziqashelwe. Lokhu kungabandakanya imihlangano ebukhoma, izinhlelo zevidiyo, noma izincwadi zobuchwepheshe ezibhaliwe ngendlela elula ukuze abahlulele baqonde kahle. Ubuchwepheshe Obukhulu Ubuchwepheshe busiza ekwenzeni lula ukuthola imvume, futhi buvumela ukukhiqizwa nokuhambisa imininingwane. Izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ezifana nosoftware yokuphatha imvume, ziwusizo ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwamalungu eGEMS nabahlinzeki bempilo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuphatha imvume, okuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile empilweni nasekuphathweni kwemininingwane. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze ukuxhumana kube kuphephile. Ukuqonda imvume kubalulekile ekuvuseleleni ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS nabahlinzeki. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kuqhubeke nokugxila emvume ukuze imiphumela ibe yinhle, ihloniphe abahluleli, futhi igcine izinga lemisebenzi emisha.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo/nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kuqhubeka nokuba yinkinga ebalulekile kubantu abaningi. Ikakhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, abantu basemakhaya nakwezomnotho bacela izinsiza, futhi ukwethembeka kwemali engenayo kubalulekile ukuze bathole izinzuzo ezithile ezibhekelele impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo okugcinwe ngaphansi kweMithetho ye-GEMS, okuyinsika yokuphila kahle kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Emavikini ambalwa edlule, kuvele izinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuhlola izincwadi zokuphila kwabathola izinzuzo. Abanye basebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokukhombisa imali engenayo, ezihlanganisa izinqwaba zamadokhumenti ezisemthethweni, kodwa lokhu akuhlali kuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile, ikakhulu uma kubhekwa ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano ehlanganisa izinsiza zezempilo, ibonisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kunomthelela omkhulu ekwanelisekeni kwabantu. Njengoba abantu besebenzisa izinsiza zabo, bakhombisa ukuthi imikhuba yokuphila, njengokudla, izokwelapha, nezinye izidingo, kufanele ihambisane nemali abayitholayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlolwa okuqinile kwezincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa imali engenayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsiza bangakhokha izindleko zabo. Ngokwesimo samanje, izithiyo ezivela kwezokuxhumana nezokusebenza zenza kube nzima kwabanye abantu ukuthola lezi zinsiza. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zidinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze baqinisekise imali yabo, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu abafanele bathola ukuhlinzekwa, i-GEMS ihlose ukwenza izinguquko ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuxhumana nabazisebenzayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabathola izinsiza. I-GEMS iphinde ibonise ukuthi izinsiza zayo zidinga ukwandiswa ukuze zifinyelele nakubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza. Ngokubheka uhla lwemibuzo evamile, kubonakala ukuthi abathola izinzuzo bangakhathazeki uma bezama ukuqinisekisa imali yabo, uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona izinqubo ezilula ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa nokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthola ukukhululeka ngalezi zinguquko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzisane ne-GEMS ukuze bathole imininingwane efanele. Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kanjani kuzokwandisa ukwaneliseka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile zidinga ukwenza ngcono ukuzibophezela kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale bexhumene nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokubhalisela izinzuzo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa imali engenayo luzoba yinsika enkulu yokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizeni abakudingayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo, bahlale bexhumene, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS izobe iqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu abathola izinzuzo bahlala befinyelele ekuphumeleleni kwempilo yabo. Lokhu kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu engathola khona okudingayo ukuze aphile impilo enempilo.
Isimemezelo Sokunemba Kwefomu LeLungu (GEMS Member Form Accuracy Declaration) Uhlanga lwezempilo luyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zempilo ezinhle kuncike kakhulu emnothweni wezemali okwenziwa izinhlelo eziphathelene nezempilo. Ngalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu omphakathi aqonde kahle isu elibhekelele ukunemba kwefomu lelungu, ikakhulukazi kulabo ababhalisela uhlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nqubo ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe ngamalungu luyiqiniso, futhi iyahambisana nezidingo eziningi ezimqoka. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi olunembile kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsizakalo zempilo ezifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane efanele, efana negama, ikheli, usuku lokuzalwa, nezibalo zempilo ezisemqoka. Ukungahambisani kwalolu lwazi kungaholela ekubeni izinsizakalo zinganikezwa ngendlela efanele, okuyinto engathokozisi amalungu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubhalisela leli thuba, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi wonke amafomu abhalwe kahle, ngaphandle kwamaphutha. Ukudlula emkhakheni wokunemba kwezifundo, kuyadingeka ukuthi ukufunda kahle imiyalelo ethile yeGEMS ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze ufake isicelo sokuba yilungu. Lokhu kuhlonipha umthetho, futhi kukhulu kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphawulekayo. Ngokuhamba phambili, uma ufaka le fomu, kubalulekile ukuthi uthathe isikhathi esanele ukuze uhlele kahle yonke imininingwane. Ukuhlola kabusha imininingwane yakho ngaphambi kokuyithumela kungasiza ekuqedeni noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingase zivele ngaphambi kokuba uqedele inqubo. Lokhu kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe luhambisana neziqondiso ezisemthethweni, okuzothuthukisa ithuba lokuthi uhlelo lweGEMS lwenze kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uthola izinguquko emindenini yakho, njengokushintsha kokuhlala, izinguquko ezithintekayo ezimweni zempilo, noma ushintsho kusemsebenzini, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nesineke futhi uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinguquko zikhonjiswa okufanele efomini lakho. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi uhlangabezana nezidingo zempilo zansuku zonke. Ngokuphathelene nokuhlola, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi ithimba leGEMS linikeza ukuhola okudingekayo kubalungu ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokufaka izimemezelo zokunemba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane ethile yokuxhumana kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uqonde kahle izidingo ezifanele. Ukuxhumana nezisebenzi zeGEMS akugcini nje ngokukusiza, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni isikhala sokuxhumana esivulekile phakathi kwebhodi yeGEMS namalungu. Ekugcineni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukunemba kwefomu lelungu akukhona nje ukugcina imithetho, kepha kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS nabantu abawasebenzisayo. Amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphumelelayo zempilo azothuthukiswa uma sithobela imithetho, sikhumbule ukuhlonipha, futhi sibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke amalungu ukuthi azithathele izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane efakwe efomini lelungu ilungile. Lokhu kuzobeka isisekelo esiqinile sokuthi konke okwenziwe ngaphakathi kweGEMS kube nempumelelo, futhi amalungu akwazi ukuthola izinsiza zempilo abazidingayo. Ngokuhlonipha lezi ziqondiso, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlonipha izidingo zempilo zomphakathi, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlonishwa, ubhaliswe, futhi uthola izinsiza ezihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, akungabazeki ukuthi sithatha le nqubo ngokungathi sína, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi sihamba phambili ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole ikitoko elihle lokuphila.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo eziphezulu zezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma sebesondela ekupheleni kwesikhathi sabo sokusebenza. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka ukuthi inombolo yempesheni iqinisekiswe. Le nqubo ihilela izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola izinsizakalo zempilo bahlala bephila kahle futhi benokwesekwa okudingekayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bahlale befika ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze uqinisekise inombolo yakho yempesheni, kubalulekile ukuthi uqale uhlole ukuthi unayo yini inombolo efanele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuxhumana ne-GEMS ngqo, noma uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene ezihambisana nezidingo zempilo, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungathola lezi zinsizakalo. Uma usuthole inombolo yakho yempesheni, ungasebenzisa le nombolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle kwi-GEMS, okuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane yakho, efana negama, ikheli, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ukuqinisekisa lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngokuqondile kumakhasimende. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma unezinkinga noma imibuzo mayelana nenombolo yakho yempesheni, ungaxhumana nethimba le-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala benolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabathengi nezinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, okuyinto ebalulekile ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izama ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bahlale befika kulezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kufaka izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala bekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bahlale bephila kahle futhi bethola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu ohlanganyela kwi-GEMS aqinisekise inombolo yakhe yempesheni ukuze aqhubeke nokuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle nezisemthethweni.
Ukuqinisekiswa KweSimo Sokusebenza (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Emakhaya amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, kwavela izindaba ezidumile phakathi kwabantu, iyona yabezindaba ezithinta izimo sokuqashwa. Phakathi kwazo, indaba yeGEMS, iGoverning Employees Medical Scheme, yakhona ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwababambiqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo. Izikhathi zakudala, abantu bezishayisa izifuba ezinkulu, behlola izimo zokuqashwa ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza zeGEMS. Kwathi ngeSonto, uMnumzane Mthembu, osebenza njengomhlengikazi esibhedlela esikhulu, wacabanga ukuthi kumele aqinisekise isimo sakhe sokuqashwa. Kwakuhalaliswa isimo esijabulisayo, imindeni yekakhulu iphawula kanjena: “Ngabe uyazi, iGEMS iyalawula? Uma ungakatholi nje, ungaba nobunzima.” Lokhu kwaholela ekubonweni kokuthi isimo sokuqashwa, singenzeka kube yinkinga enkulu uma kungenzeka ungatholi lokho okufanele. UMnumzane Mthembu, nokho, wayengowesilisa ophumelelayo. Wazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo zeGEMS zibalulekile empilweni yakhe nasekwheni lokuhlinzeka usizo kubantu. Njengoba enza uhlu lwezinto ezidingekayo, wathola ukuthi kumele ahahe izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezivela ebhizinisini lakhe lokuqashwa, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyasebenza empilweni. Waqala ngokuthinta umphathi wakhe, uNkk. Khumalo, ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. UNkk. Khumalo, owayazi kahle imithetho yeGEMS, wamtshela ukuthi kudingeka agcwalise ifomu elithile ukuze aqinisekise isimo sakhe sokuqashwa. “Mnumzane Mthembu, kuzodingeka ubonise ukuhamba kwemali, izinsiza zezimali, nengxenye eyengeziwe yebhizinisi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubhalisile neGEMS,” kusho yena. Lokhu kwenza uMnumzane Mthembu aqonde ukuthi akufanele kube lula, kodwa kuyadingeka ukuba enze kahle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wahlola izincwadi zezimali zakhe, ezazisakeleki futhi ezalelwe usizo lwezempilo. Uthembise ukulandelela futhi wathumela yonke imininingwane efanele kuGEMS njengokufanele. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlakani bakhe bukhona, kanti khumbula imishwana yamaZulu esithi "ukufunda kumaphutha kuyingxenye yokuphila". Waqhubeka nokuphuma esibhedlela ngezinsuku ezilandelayo, njalo ethunyelwe ukuze alandele. Ngesonto elandelayo, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola impendulo evela kuGEMS. I-imeyili yeGEMS, echaza ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo sakhe sokuqashwa, yamenza wakhanya. “Ngempela, umsebenzisi wezinsiza, uMthembu, unokuqinisekiswa!” Lolu suku lwaba yinsuku yokujabula ngoba wayezobona izinsiza ezazifanele ukuthi ziqhubeke. Waqonda ukuthi wayedlulelela inqubo yokuphila, eyayingadingeki ukuphuthelwa noma ukungabaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsiza zale nhlangano yeGEMS zavuma futhi zabamba uqhakambisa emhlabeni wezempilo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokusebenza lwaba nempumelelo, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kwase kuza nezithelo. Izinsizakusebenza zakhe zathuthukiswa, uMnumzane Mthembu ngahamba phambili ngebhizinisi lakhe elinjalo, elikhona kude nekhaya lakhe, kodwa linethemba. Ukusebenza ngeGEMS, kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu abanye abanikezwa izinsiza ezifanayo. N clássico, indaba kaMnumzane Mthembu ibonisa indlela impilo, izikhali, namathuba adinga ukuqinisekiswa ukuze aqukethwe kahle emangalisweni. Njengoba indaba yeGEMS iqhubeka, abantu basenhliziyweni zeNingizimu Afrika bahlala bejabulile futhi bematasa, ngokujoyina umhlaba wezinsizakusebenza zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuqotho bokuphila nokuqhuba impumelelo ngaphandle kokungabaza, bonke behamba phambili emva kokuphumelelwa kwesimo sokuqashwa. Njengoba sizama ukuhamba nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele, sikhumbula ukuthi konke kuqala ngokuhlola ukuthi “ngabe ulungile, unelungelo?” Futhi lokho kuzoholela endleleni efanele yokwenza impilo enye eyengeziwe – okunenseku — ngenhloso nemibono ephusile. Ukusebenza noGEMS kuyafana nokwakha umuzi ophumelelayo, udinga izinkanyezi zokuqinisekisa, imibono ehlakaniphile, nezinyathelo ezisemthethweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa konyaka omusha, owenzelwe umphakathi wonke. Ngale ndlela, sihlanganyela sonke emicabangweni yokuphila, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola konke okwanele ukuze siqhubeke, kuze kuba yimpumelelo. Lokhu kunomthelela omkhulu, kwehlukanise izidingo zempilo zethu, kube yinsika yokusiza, uncedisiye emibhalweni yokwenza lula imizamo yethu. Ukubuyekezwa kwenzeke, nabantu bawaqhuba ukuyokwenza okukhulu, uma besimemeza inhloso nesimo sokuqashwa kuphela, kuze kube kunjalo. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu, uyazithokozisa ngempumelelo yakhe, iqiniso elikubona kakhulu: Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa akusikho kuphela ukwenziwa kukaMnumzane, kodwa kwaba yimpumelelo yempilo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kokuqinisekiswa kwempilo nezinsiza zeGEMS bukaMthembu bahlala bejabulile, baphuma emshadweni omkhulu wezempilo, behamba phambili bephumelele. Futhi lezi zitshalo, zibhalwe phansi ngalendlela eyingqayizivele, ezifuna ukuthi umhlaba wonke ubone izinyathelo ezibomvu ezingenziwa — kuZoom, kuGoogle Meet, noma kwelinye iphrojekthi. Kanjalo, le ndaba kaMnumzane Mthembu nokuphatha kwayo iGEMS, isifundo esiyinhle esiyaqonda okukhulu, esithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi, siphakamisela uqhakambisa izinsizakusebenza eziphathelene kokufanele. Ngakho-ke, ukuba ngumuntu ophumelelayo akudingi indlela ethile, kodwa kuyingxenye yokwaziswa kokuqinisekisa — ngisho nangaphandle, ikakhulukazi, uma uMnumzane Mthembu esebenzisa kahle iGEMS.
Ukwazisa ngezinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS Ubulungiswa kepha kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ezithinta bonke abathintekayo. Lezi zinguquko, ezaziswa kubasebenzi ngosizo lwemiyalezo ehlukene, zishiye abantu abaningi bezicabangela ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, izinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS ziqhutshwa ngebhizinisi lokunikeza imishwalense yezempilo, futhi zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abacela izinsizakalo bakhethwa ezifanele. Ekuqaleni, kumele siqonde ukuthi kungani lezi zinguquko zenzeka. Umnotho wezempilo uguquka njalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abe nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezitholakala kalula kubasebenzi bakhe. Ukuze kube khona lokho, i-GEMS izame ukujwayela izidingo kanye nezimfuno zabasebenzi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi inhlangano iphendule ngezindlela ezinjengokwandisa umkhawulo wezinsiza ezitholwayo, ukwandisa izinketho zobulungu, kanye nokunikeza izinsizakalo ezingeziwe eziwusizo. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinguquko zingancintisana nezimo ezithize. Abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka ngalezi zinguquko, bethi kungaba nezinselelo eziningi uma imishwalense yokwelashwa ibhujiswa ngokungafanele. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza, njengoba abanye abasebenzi begcizelela ukuthi sezihamba kahle izimpilo zabo, kanti uma izinguquko ziqiniswa, kulindeleke ukuthi zifake umthwalo omkhulu kubasebenzi. Ngokucacile, izinguquko eziqokonyiswe yi-GEMS zifuna ukuphucula izinga lemisebenzi yemishwalense, kodwa kumele sikhumbule ukuthi lo mshini wezempilo uchaza ukuthandwa kokwelapha nokunakekelwa. Uma imishwalense ithinteka kakhulu ngezimali, lokhu kungadala ukuthi abangani bezempilo baphume engcupheni yokulala, okungenzeka kube nezinkinga ezikhulu ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona izinguquko ezinkulu, kubalulekile ukuba kukhuliswe udaba lokuthola ulwazi olunembile nokucatshangelwa kwabantu. Ngokunjalo, abanye baphokophele ukusebenza kahle nokulekelela umphakathi. Kwa-GEMS, izinguquko kumele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe eqondile futhi eqinisekisiwe. Izinguquko kufanele zibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu, hhayi ukulimaza. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukulayisha imithwalo emisha kubasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi bahloniphe izinqumo zohulumeni, babe nokuqonda, nokuqhubekela phambili ngokubambisana nabanye. Kodwa-ke, kumele sikhulume ngama-FAQs: abafundi, amalungu omphakathi, nabanye abathintekayo bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinguquko zithintwa ngokweqiniso. Lokhu kushukunyiswa kuzothuthukisa ukholo phakathi kwabantu ne-GEMS, okudingayo ukuze kusebenze imishwalense ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zonke lezi zinguquko zingaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi uma kuhlanganiswa impendulo enhle, izixazululo ezibulala izinkinga, nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabathintekayo. Ubulungiswa bokwelapha kumele bujule emqondweni wabo bonke abasebenzi. Yilapho kuphela lapho sizomkhumbula umbono wokuthula, lapho impilo yembula intuthuko. Ekugcineni, izinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS ziwusizo kakhulu, kodwa kumele kube nezinyathelo ezithile eziqinisekisa ukuthi lonke uhlanga luhlangana kumgogodla omkhulu. Ukuhlala sizama njalo ukuqonda, ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo, noxolo okungawutholi, kuzokwandisa ukuzethemba kwethu. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, sizodinga ukuqhubeka sikhuluma ngalezi zinguquko, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zihlangana ukuze zibe nezesekeli ezithuthukayo, kuzuzwe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngakho, kube sithokozisa ekuthandeni amanqampunipuni abavela ezinhlelweni ze-GEMS, ukufakazela uthando lwabo ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinhle ukuze babe yizinsiza ezikhaliphile. Ubulungiswa bempilo kumele budlule ezinyathelweni ezikuhle. Okwamanje, hamba sizolanda izinguquko zobulungu ukuze siphile impilo ejezile, silondoloze izinjongo zethu ezingokwelashwa kube nomthelela omuhle.
Ukuvikelwa Kwezempilo kwe-GEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo sekubalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo, lapho ulwazi lwezempilo luthinteka kakhulu. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibhekana nezinselelo eziningi ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu. Njengamanje, ubungozi bokwephulwa kolwazi lwezempilo buye bukhula, ngenxa yokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela ziqinise imithetho nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwabantu. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekwakheni izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabantu luhlala luvalekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, i-GEMS isebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela, njengokusebenzisa ama-encryption, izinhlelo zokulandelela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukufinyelela kolwazi. Lezi zindlela zenzelwe ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ezinsukwini zethu, lapho ubungozi bokwephulwa kolwazi buye bukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibeka phambili ukuqwashisa nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bayo mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangavikela kanjani ulwazi lwezempilo lwabanye, kuhlanganisa ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokuphatha ulwazi, izinqubo zokubika izigameko zokwephulwa kolwazi, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS iphinde ibambisane nezinhlaka ezahlukene, ezifana nohulumeni, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zokubambisana zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubambisana kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinqubo zokuvikela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luvalekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akuyona nje into yokugcina, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela kumele zihlale zihlaziywa futhi zithuthukiswe ukuze zikwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS ibheka phambili ekwakheni izinqubo ezizokwazi ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ngenkathi ibheka izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona kuphela ukuvikela ulwazi, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo luhlala luvalekile, bazoba nokwazisa okukhulu ngale nhlangano. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuxhumana ngokukhululekile. Ekugcineni, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akuyona nje imfuneko, kodwa kuyisibopho esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu luhlala luvalekile, futhi izinqubo zokuvikela zihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izobheka izindlela ezintsha nezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ukuze ihlale ibhekelele izidingo zabantu.
Izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS hospital notification protocol? Impendulo: I-GEMS hospital notification protocol iyinqubo ethile yokwazisa izibhedlela uma umtholampilo uthola ukuthi umtholampilo udinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubo zilandela imithetho ethile yokuphatha. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukwazisa ngesibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48? Impendulo: Ukwazisa ngesibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48 kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo ezingase zivele uma ukwelashwa kunganikiwe ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zesibhedlela zisetshenziswa kahle, futhi iziguli zihlala ziphila kahle. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kwaziswe ngesibhedlela? Impendulo: Ukuze kwaziswe ngesibhedlela, umtholampilo kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uthumele imininingwane ethile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi igama lesiguli, imininingwane yokuxhumana, isimo sempilo, kanye nezizathu zokwelashwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi le mininingwane ithunyelwe ngesikhathi ukuze iziguli zingalibali ukwelashwa. Umbuzo 4: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo engakwazi ukwazisa ngesibhedlela? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo engakwazi ukwazisa ngesibhedlela, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokulandela lezi zinqubo? Impendulo: Ukulandela lezi zinqubo kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zesibhedlela zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Okwesithathu, lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo, okungaholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale ziphilile. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe lezi zinqubo zihlala zishintsha? Impendulo: Yebo, lezi zinqubo zingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zezempilo zihlala zishintsha, futhi izibhedlela zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo ahlale ebuyekeza lezi zinqubo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze kanjani. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqondise umtholampilo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqondise umtholampilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izincwadi zokuhlela, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsizakusebenza eziku-inthanethi. Lezi zinsiza zingasiza umtholampilo ukuba aqonde kahle izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela. Umbuzo 9: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe lezi zinqubo zihlala zishintsha? Impendulo: Yebo, lezi zinqubo zingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zezempilo zihlala zishintsha, futhi izibhedlela zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo ahlale ebuyekeza lezi zinqubo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze kanjani. Ngokulandela lezi zinqubo, umtholampilo angasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo ngesikhathi, futhi lokhu kuzosiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphila kahle kweziguli.
Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS Kwakukhona umphakathi omncane, ogama lawo linguMahlathi, owawuhlala ezindaweni ezinhle, eziphilayo. Abantu baphila ngokubambisana, bejabulile, futhi bephokophele phambili. Kodwa, njengakwamanye amadolobha, bekukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uMnumzane Dlamini, umholi wendawo, wathola ithuba lokwazisa abantu ngohlelo olusha olwakhelwe ukusiza abantu abaningi, olwakhiwe yi-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Government Employees Medical Scheme. UMnumzane Dlamini waqala ngenkulumo yakhe, echaza ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsiza yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni. "Nina nonke, ningabathintekayo kulolu hlelo," kusho yena, "kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sibe ne-GEMS." Abantu babebukele ngamehlo amakhulu, befuna ukwazi ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo zokuba ngamalungu. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi kuhle kube neziqu zokuqonda izinyathelo ezidingekayo. "Okokuqala," eqhubeka, "kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyasebenza kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba i-GEMS iyinsiza ethokozisayo kuphela kubasebenzi bakahulumeni." Abantu baphendula ngokuqonda, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe esisha sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uMnumzane Dlamini wakhuluma ngencwadi yokufaka isicelo. "Kumele uthole ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-inthanethi noma ehhovisi le-GEMS eliseduzane. Qiniseka ukuthi ufaka yonke imininingwane efanele, njengeminyaka yakho, ubulili, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana." Abantu babebhalela phansi, beqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Ngemva kokugcwalisa ifomu, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka izincwadi ezidingekayo. "Kufanele ube nezincwadi ezikhombisa ubudlelwano bakho nomsebenzi, njengemibhalo yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi i-GEMS iqinisekise isimo sakho." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngokwazi ukuthi izinyathelo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, uMnumzane Dlamini waphinde wakhuluma ngokuqinisekisa isicelo. "Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, kuzodingeka ulinde isikhathi esithile ukuze uthole impendulo. I-GEMS izobuyekeza isicelo sakho, futhi uma konke kuhamba kahle, uzothola ubulungu." Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuba amalungu. Ukwengeza, uMnumzane Dlamini wakhuluma ngokuqonda izinzuzo zokuba ngamalungu e-GEMS. "Uma usungamalungu, uzothola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, ezifana nezibhedlela, odokotela, nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila impilo enempilo." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe esisha sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi abantu baphinde bahlale bexhumana ne-GEMS. "Kubalulekile ukuthi uqhubeke uxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izibuyekezo, izinhlelo ezintsha, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola konke okudingayo." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi abantu baphinde bahlale bephokophele phambili. "Nina nonke, ningabathintekayo kulolu hlelo. Qhubekani nisebenze kanzima, futhi nithole izinzuzo ezinhle ze-GEMS." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waseMahlathi wathola ithuba lokuba ngamalungu e-GEMS, futhi abantu baqala ukujabula ngokwazi ukuthi bazoba nezinzuzo eziningi zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu empilweni yabo, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula, uhlanganisa abantu ukuze baphile impilo enempilo.
Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana (GEMS doctor authorization and communication) Isingeniso Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zokugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ekuchazeni lezi zinqubo, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bathola usizo olufanele. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo zikhokhelwa yi-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo zokwelashwa, ezivame ukuhlinzekwa odokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Ukuze umtholampilo uthole ukugunyazwa, kudingeka ukuthi udokotela ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile, efana nezizathu zokwelashwa, izivivinyo ezidingekayo, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nalokho. Izinsizakalo ezidinga ukugunyazwa zifaka phakathi, kodwa azikhawulelwe kulokhu: ukuhlinzwa, izivivinyo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabo nabathengi. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, okuhlanganisa izingcingo, ama-imeyili, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bangathola ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinsizakalo zabo, izinqubo zokugunyazwa, kanye nezimo ezithile ezithinta impilo yabo. Kubantu abathintekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi bakwazi ukufinyelela odokotela babo kalula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi odokotela babe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle, ukuze bakwazi ukuchaza izinqubo ezithile, izinzuzo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezithile. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Izinselelo ezihambisana nokugunyazwa kodokotela Noma kunjalo, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nokugunyazwa kodokotela. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu wukuthi abathengi bavame ukungaqondi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Odokotela nabo bahlushwa izinselelo ezithile, njengokungabi nesikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo yokugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abathengi bangatholi ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe zokugunyazwa. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugunyazwa kodokotela, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kubathengi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izicelo zokugunyazwa zifinyelela ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS ingase ibheke ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abathengi ukuba bafake izicelo zokugunyazwa kalula, kanye nokuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukufinyelela odokotela babo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS idinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza kahle ukuze abathengi bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zinqubo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola usizo olufanele, ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zikhona kubo bonke abathengi.
Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS I-GEMS, okuyiGrootte Excellent Medical Scheme, iyinsiza ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo kubantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ekuqaleni kokufaka isicelo sobulungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela yonke imiyalelo edingekayo. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukusiza abafake izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Ukuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi ubulungu be-GEMS bukhuluma ngokuqala isibhakabhaka sokuzuza izinsiza zezempilo ezikhokhelwayo. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi ubalulekile. Njengomfaki-sicelo, ungabhalisela ubulungu obuhlukene, kuhlanganisa obuvamile, obunikezela ngezinsiza ezikhethekile, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuvumelanisa idokhumenti yakho, okubalulekile ekufakeni isicelo. Isinyathelo sokuqala sokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS ukuqinisekisa ukuthi unemibhalo ethile edingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa identifikasheni yakho, njenge-ID noma ipasipoti, kanye nemininingwane ethile mayelana nezomnotho, njengemali yakho engenayo kanye nezinsizakusebenza zakho. Kungenzeka futhi udinge ukufaka imininingwane ethile ngezinhlelo zezempilo ozithandayo, uma usushintsha isikhwama sokuqashisa noma ulungisa ulwazi olukhona. Uma zonke izincwadi zakho zilungile, umphakathi kufanele uqale ukufaka isicelo online, usebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-GEMS. Le nqubo ihlaliswe kahle ukuze ?aqinisekise ukuthi kunobuchule bokupa usizo ngokushesha. Uma ungazi kahle indima ethile, uzothola izikhumbuzo ezinsizayo ezisuka ekhasini lewebhu, okwenza kube lula ukukulandela. Njengoba ulandela lezi zinyathelo, kubalulekile ukuthi uqaphele ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singahluka, ngakho-ke kufanele ulinde ngezinyanga ezithile ukuze uthole ukuphendula. Lokhu kuzokuthola uhambisana nemihla ethile ethile yokuhlola isicelo sakho. Uma ungenalwazi uthola iziphakamiso, ungabiza emkhakheni wezinsizakalo ukuze ufune ulwazi oluningi. Lapho urhoxisa izinkanyezi ngaleli su, kubalulekile ukuba, uqinisekise nezinsiza zakho uma ubona engathandeki, ukuze ungaphezi izindleko ezingalindelekile. Ukulandela izinqubo ezilungile kuzosiza kakhulu ekupheleni kwesicelo sakho, ukuze umphakathi ezimpilweni zakho ube ngumphefumulo ofanelekileyo kulesi sikhathi. Uma isicelo sakho sivunyelwe, uzothola i-akhawunti yakho ye-GEMS ivuliwe, futhi kulokhu, uzoqondiswa ekusetshenzisweni kwayo. Uzoqonda izinzuzo ezitholakalayo, imishanguzo, nezinhlelo ezihlangene. kuyotholakala izinkomba ezinzima ukuze uqhamuke nemithombo yezempilo ezikhethekile engaphokophela kumaphuzhu nezinye izithuthi. Ukwazi ukuthi ungabhalela uhlelo lweGEMS, ungasithola isixhumi esisodwa, sangaphambili futhi sishintsha indlela yokuphila komphakathi, sigcwalisa impilo enhle. Kungani, ekufakeni isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS, izinyathelo ezihlekisayo, ezingaqinile, nezikhiqizayo zenza kube lula ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukuphothula lesi sikhumbuzo, singasho ukuthi ukulandela izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS kudinga ukubekezela, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula, uzofinyelela kalula ezinzuzweni eziyigugu ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS. Ngakho-ke, cwaninga kahle, hamba kahle, futhi ulinde kahle ukuze uthole okuhle okuhlanganyela ngokuphelele nezinsizakalo zeGEMS ezikufanele.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye nemininingwane yaseBhange ye-GEMS Umbuzo 1: Iyini i-debit order? Impendulo: I-debit order iwumqondo wokukhokha lapho umthengi evuma ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo akhiphe imali kwi-akhawunti yakhe yebhange njalo ngenyanga. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindleko ngokukhokha okungapheli. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kufanele ngisebenzise i-debit order ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhokha kwemali yokubhalisela izinsizakalo zempilo kwenziwa ngendlela elula futhi enembile. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuphuthelwa izinkokhelo futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo zakho ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze ngiqale ukusebenzisa i-debit order? Impendulo: Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho yasebhange, okubandakanya inombolo ye-akhawunti, igama lesikhwama, kanye nemininingwane ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuzodingeka ukuze ukwazi ukuhlela i-debit order yakho. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe kukhona izindleko ezihambisana ne-debit order? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezindleko ezithile ezihambisana ne-debit order, ezivame ukuba yizindleko zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukufunda imiqathango ye-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zindleko. Umbuzo 5: Ngithola kanjani imininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Imininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS ingatholakala kwi-website yabo esemthethweni noma ngokuxhumana ne-ofisi yabo yokwesekwa. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola imininingwane yakamuva ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokha kumthombo ofanele. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ngingashintsha i-debit order yami uma kudingeka? Impendulo: Yebo, ungashintsha i-debit order yakho uma kudingeka. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukushintsha inani elikhokhwayo, usuku lokukhokha, noma imininingwane yasebhange. Qiniseka ukuthi uxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinguquko ziqhutshelwa phambili. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngithola izinkinga nge-debit order? Impendulo: Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga nge-debit order yakho, kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ngokushesha. Bazoqonda kahle isimo sakho futhi bakusize ukuze uthole isixazululo esifanele. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokwesekwa? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokwesekwa ezitholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa nezingcingo, i-imeyili, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana. Ungathola usizo oludingayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo zakho zihamba kahle. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ze-GEMS ngenye indlela? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezindlela eziningi zokukhokha, kuhlanganisa ukukhokha ngokuqondile kwi-akhawunti ye-GEMS. Nokho, i-debit order iyindlela elula futhi esebenzayo yokukhokha izindleko zakho zempilo. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokuqala zifaka phakathi ukunciphisa imithwalo yokuphatha, ukuqinisekisa ukukhokha okungapheli, kanye nokuthola izinsizakalo zakho zempilo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ungagxila ekuphumeleleni kwakho kwezempilo. Isiphetho: Ukusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS kuyindlela elula, enembile, futhi esebenzayo yokuphatha izindleko zakho zempilo. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo zakho ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Uma unemibuzo engaphezulu, unganqikazi ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo oludingayo.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo (GEMS payment verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezokwelapha, ikakhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinsiza yokwelapha enikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwayo zifaneleka, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda kahle le nqubo. Ukwazi i-GEMS I-GEMS iyinhlangano eyaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo eziphezulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Le nsiza ibalulekile ngoba inikeza ukwesekwa kwezokwelapha, okwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuqinisekiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinkokhelo. Inqubo Yokuhlonza Izinkokhelo Ukuze uqinisekise izinkokhelo, kufanele uqale ngenqubo yokuhlonza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqoqa yonke imininingwane edingekayo, efana nezinsiza ezitholakele, izindleko ezikhokhwayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakele. Izinyathelo ezilandelayo zibalulekile: 1. Ukuqoqa Kwedatha: Ukuze uqinisekise izinkokhelo, kufanele uqoqe yonke imininingwane efanele, okuyi-invoice, izincwadi zokwelapha, nezitifiketi zokwelashwa. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le datha ibhalwe kahle futhi iyatholakala. 2. Ukubuyekezwa Kwedatha: Ngemuva kokuhlanganisa imininingwane, kufanele ubuyekeze le datha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ayinaphutha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindleko ezikhokhwayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona, futhi ukuthi izinkokhelo zifaneleka. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, kubalulekile ukuxhumana nezinsiza zempilo ukuze uthole ukucaciseleka. 3. Ukuqinisekisa Izinkokhelo: Ngemva kokubuyekeza, kufanele uqinisekise izinkokhelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi izinkokhelo ezikhokhwayo zifaneleka futhi zikhona. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nezinkokhelo. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana I-GEMS inezinsiza ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze zisebenze kahle nezisebenzi zayo. Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga noma udinga usizo, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ngocingo noma nge-imeyili. Ukuze uthole usizo olusheshayo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, efana nenombolo yokubhaliswa kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ukubaluleka Kokuqinisekiswa Kwezinkokhelo Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubalulekile, ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinsizakalo zempilo ezikhokhelwayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona, okubalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphakeme lezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle, okuyinto ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Izinkinga Ezijwayelekile Nezixazululo Noma inqubo yokuhlonza izinkokhelo ibalulekile, izinkinga zingavela. Ezinye zezinkinga ezivame ukubonwa zifaka phakathi: - Imininingwane Engalungile: Lokhu kungenzeka uma imininingwane eqoqiwe ingahambisani nezinsizakalo ezitholakele. Ukuze uxazulule lokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlole ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle. - Izindleko Ezingalindelekile: Kwezinye izimo, izindleko ezikhokhwayo zingase zibe phezulu kunalokho okulindelekile. Lokhu kungavela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle izinqubo zokwelapha. Ukuze uxazulule lokhu, kubalulekile ukukhuluma nezinsiza zempilo ukuze uthole ukucaciseleka. - Ukuxhumana Okungahambi Kahle: Ezinye izikhathi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nezinsiza zempilo kungase kube nezinkinga. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano oluqinile. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo ku-GEMS kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, abasebenzi bakahulumeni bangaqinisekisa ukuthi bathola izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona, okubalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde le nqubo futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsizakalo ezidingekayo.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa: Ukuhlola Uhlobo lwe-GEMS Ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa kwezempilo, kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalesi simo esibucayi esibizwa nge-GEMS (Guided Outcome Measures for Specialized treatment). Lezi zindlela zokwelapha ziwusizo olukhulu kubantu abanenkinga zempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekulawuleni izimo ezinzima. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sikhuluma ngenhloso yokuhlola nokukhuluma ngempumelelo ethathwa ebuhlotsheni phakathi kwabahlali nabaphathi bezempilo. Uhlolojikelele lwe-GEMS lungaqala nje ngesibhakabhaka esifanele, sihamba siphuma ezinsukwini ezidanile zezemidlalo zasendaweni. I-GEMS iyinsika yokuxhaphaza imiphumela yokwelashwa, ibhekelela zonke izinqubo nokusebenza okwenziwa ukuze kuqashelwe ukuthi ngabe ukwelashwa okutholakele kusebenza kahle yini. Lokhu kugqugquzela umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo. Isibopho sokwenza kahle semiphumela yokwelashwa siwusizo olukhulu, njengoba sikhuthaza abahlinzeki bezempilo ukuthi bahlale bephikelela emiphumeleni engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukusiza abatotombikhwe kulezi zinsuku kudinga ukuthi sihlale silandelayo, sahlulele imiphumela ngenxa yokuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ihluke kumuntu nomuntu. Ngakho-ke, ukubona ukuthi uhlelo lwe-GEMS lusebenza kanjani kumuntu ngamunye kumayelana nokuhlonipha izidingo zabo. Uma senza isigaba sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa, kudingeka siqonde izici ezihlanganisa uhlelo lwe-GEMS. Lezi zici zihlanganisa indlela yokuhlola okwenziwa ngedatha eth gathered, nezindlela ezihlukene zokufaka iziguli esimisweni sokwelapha. Abahlinzeki bezempilo badinga ukujabulela ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, bokuhlola ukuba imiphumela izophumelela kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokwelashwa ingathuthukiswa ngokubamba izingxoxo ezicacile namaklayenti. Lokhu kunikeza ithuba lokuthola impendulo ngqo, okungabhekelwa njengesikhumbuzo sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kokwelashwa neziguli, ukukhuthaza ukuthi zigulise izichazamazwi zendlela ezichazwa ngayo imiphumela. Ngokubambisana ne-GEMS, umqondo wokuhlola imiphumela uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphumelela. I-GEMS inika ithuba lokuthola impendulo ethile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele. Isibopho sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa kubalulekile emiphumeleni ye-GEMS, ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo. Kuwo wonke umkhakha wezempilo, isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sithinta iziguli, abahlinzeki, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Njengoba silwela ukuphucula ukutholakala kwemiphumela yokwelashwa, kuhle ukuthi sibe nenqubomgomo eqinile kulokhu. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imikhuba yokwelapha, kuholele ekutheni kuhlanganyelwe imiphumela engcono, kunciphise izindleko, futhi kugqugquzele ukusimama kwemiphumela yokwelashwa.
