Ukuze u-GEMS uphumelele, kuthinta abahlinzeki bezempilo futhi kumele baphendule ebuhlotsheni obukhona namaklayenti abo. Lokhu kutusa iziguli ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo, kubasiza ukuthi bahlale benempilo, futhi bahloniphe imiphumela yokwelashwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ubuhle bomqondo obukhulu, kanye nemikhuba ethuthukisiwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela kwe-GEMS. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imiphumela engcono yokwelashwa ingatholwa kuphela uma senza izinga elifanele lokuhlola. I-GEMS iyinhloso eqhubekayo yokuthuthukisa imiphumela, nokukhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezidingo zomuntu siqu kanye nemigomo yezenhlalakahle. Lokhu, ngempela, kwenza kube nomthelela omuhle ekwenzeni imibono nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukayo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlola isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa nge-GEMS kudinga ubuhlakani nokuxhumana okuhle. Njengoba sithuthukisa izindlela zempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile ohlwini lwezempilo. Ukubambisana kwabathintekayo, ukuphumelela kwempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukayo kuzokwenziwa ngempela kuphela uma sithobela lesi sibopho, ukuze iziguli zisebenze ngokubambisene nathi. Ngendlela ethile, lezi zinsizakalo zikhombisa ukuthi u-GEMS ungaba isikhumbuzo sokuthi ukwelashwa kuyinqubo yokuphila, hhayi nje okwenziwayo.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye Nezidingo Zasebhange ze-GEMS Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali ziye zashintsha, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuphatha izindleko zabo. Okwamanje, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ithuthukise imiyalelo yayo ye-debit order ukuze kube lula kubasebenzisi bayo. Lezi zinguquko zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo engcono, ukunciphisa izinkinga zokukhokha, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emalini yokwelashwa. I-GEMS, esebenza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bathola ukukhokha kwabo ngesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu akhumbule ukulandela imiyalelo ethile uma efaka i-debit order. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezihlobene nezinkokhelo ezingalungile. Okokuqala, amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banemali eyanele kwi-akhawunti yabo ukuze i-debit order iyaphumelela. Ukuze uthole imininingwane ethile, amalungu angavakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-GEMS, lapho kuzotholakala khona izinyathelo ezichazwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane yasebhange, ukukhetha usuku lokukhokha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe edingekayo. Uma usuhlinzekile ngemininingwane yakho, i-GEMS izoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba aqaphe izinkokhelo zabo njalo, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkokhelo ezikhokhwayo nokuthi zikhokhiswa ngempela. Mayelana nemininingwane yasebhange, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekuphatheni izimali zayo. Amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo ibhalwe kahle futhi ibuyekezwa njalo ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungahambisani kwemali. Njengoba iminyaka idlula, izidingo zezimali zishintsha, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu abuyekeze imininingwane yabo ukuze baqhubeke bejabulile. I-GEMS iphinde inikeze izinsiza eziningi ezithuthukisayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, izaphulelo kumalungu, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukwandisa izinketho ezitholakalayo kumalungu, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze uthole lezi zinsiza, amalungu kufanele bahlale beqaphela izikhumbuzo ze-GEMS nezibuyekezo ezivela kuwebhusayithi yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izohlaziya indlela yokuphatha izinkokhelo, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo engcono kakhulu kumalungu ayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha ukuthi bangeze i-debit order, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bayakholwa ukuthi bakhokhelwa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde ukuthi i-debit order iyithuluzi eliwusizo lokuphatha izimali zempilo. Ukuze bakwazi ukuzenzela, amalungu kufanele baqonde imiyalelo ye-GEMS, baqinisekise ukuthi banemali eyanele kwi-akhawunti yabo, futhi bahlale beqaphela izinkokhelo zabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekugcineni impilo yabo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo nakubantu abaseduze kwabo. I-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi izimisele ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zayo zokuphatha izimali ukuze ihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke abahlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela, baqonde imiyalelo, futhi bahlale bejabulile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo.
Ubumfihlo Bolwazi Lwabancikile (GEMS Dependent Information Confidentiality) eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi nolwazi lwabancikile kudlala indima enkulu empilweni yomuntu. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwabancikile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathola izinzuzo zokwelapha kanye nezimali, kubalulekile ukuze kudalwe isisekelo sokwethembeka nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile, njengoba izimo zokuphila zidinga ukwenziwa ngokucophelela. Abancikile, nabanye abavela ezigabeni ezifana nababhalisile, bathola ithuba lokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zeGEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme), kodwa lokhu kudinga ukugcina ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuvikela le mininingwane kubalulekile ekwakheni umuzwa wokuqinisekiswa nokuphepha kumuntu. Umcimbi wethu uhlose ukuxoxa ngemicabango nezinqubomgomo ezithinta ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izindlela zokuvikela idatha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo igcinwa iyimfihlo, nokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo aluphumi ngaphandle kokuhlola. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zifundise abathola izinsizakalo mayelana nezici zobalo nokubaluleka kokuba nemininingwane efanele yokuphila kwabo. Umthetho kanye nezinqubomgomo zenkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi ubumnyama bemininingwane busebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa osomabhizinisi, othisha, nabaphathi bezempilo. Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudingeka uhlelo oluqinile lokufundisa abanicikile nabakhiqiza ulwazi. Ukuqonda izikhathi ezinzima kudinga ukuphendulwa ngobuchule, futhi imfundo ngosizo lweGEMS izoba nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abancikile ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo zezinsizakalo, ukubhalisa kahle, nokuzicabangela ngokucophelela empilweni yabo. Izinselelo zokuthi ubani ofanele ukufinyelela kulwazi nokuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo, kudinga ukuqashelwa. Izinhlangano kufanele zihlale zibheke izinqubo zokuphakela, uqobo lwabazali, nokuqonda phakathi kwabafuna imisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukugxila ezimweni zamanje ezinzima, njengoba sinesimo esinzima esihlobene nezempilo nezokwelapha. Ukuze abantu balwe nezehlakalo eziphuthumayo, izinhlelo zokubhalisela izinzuzo zempilo, okubalwa kuzo neGEMS, zidinga ukuhlonishwa, okuhlanganisa nokuqinisekisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuphepha kwezimali nabanganikazi bezempilo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa ukuze kuzuze impumelelo. Uma ubumnyama bolwazi lungalandelwa kahle, imiphumela engalindelekile ingase ibekhona, okudinga ukuqapha ngokucophelela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iphephile, izinkampani zidinga ukuvuma ukufundisa abancikile ngokuqondile mayelana nokuphatha ubumfihlo, ukuze babe nemithetho yokuvikela. Ukuze baphumelele, izixazululo eziningi zidinga ukufakwa, nezindlela zokuxhamazela zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhanya. Ubumfihlo bolwazi abuqhamuki kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuqhubeka, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekelwa izinguquko zesimanjemanje. Ekugcineni, uma singazisa abancikile ngezidingo zokuqonda ubumnyama bolwazi lwabancikile, sizosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Ukuphathwa kahle kolwazi lwabancikile kuyisici esiyinhloko sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umcwaningi kufanele aqhubeke ukuhlaziya imithetho, ahlaziye izinguquko, futhi abheke phambili ekwakheni isikhala esihlonishwayo senhlangano, okuhlanganisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Inhloso yethu iwukwakha umphumela osiza abantu bonke, kusetshenziswa ubumfihlo ukuze kutholakale ushintsho nokuphila okungcono.
Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama (GEMS member scheme compliance commitment) Kulezi zinsuku, ukuhambisana nemithetho yesikhwama se-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu athola ubuqotho bezinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kudinga ukuzibophezela okuqinile kwabantu bonke abahlanganyela kulesi sikhwama, okunceda ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwemalungu kanye nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo. Izinsizakalo zempilo ziyadingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi i-GEMS ibaluleke njengesikhungo esiqinisekisa ukuthi abarbeiter bakahulumeni bathola ukufinyelela kwezempilo okwakhiwe ngempumelelo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukulawulwa kwemithetho ye-GEMS kudingekile. Ukuhamba phambili, kube nezinkqubo ezithile ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayawuqonda umgomo wokuhambisana nemithetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu azithola izinzuzo ezilindelekile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Manje, le mithetho ibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngedatha efanele, ukulandela izinqubomgomo zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo, nokugcina imithetho eqinile yokuhumusha. Ukuhlola okuqhubekayo kwezimali nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo kuhlelwa ngokuqinile, kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukugwema izinkinga eziphuma ekungahambisani nemithetho. Ingqikithi yalesi sikhwama ibhalwe phansi kumagugu okufanele ahlonishwe, futhi cada kube umgomo ophelele wokugcina ukhono lokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungu adlulele kancane kancane ekulandeleni imihlahlandlela, aqonde ukuthi izinzuzo ezitholwayo zingaholela ekukwaziwa kwezimali kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo ezinhle. Ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, i-GEMS ibisungula ukuhlola okujule komkhiqizo nezinsizakalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto ezihlinzekwayo ziyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhambisana nemithetho akukhona kuphela kumalungu, kodwa nakwakho konke abafakizelo njengoba kuqhakambisa umoya wokubambisana ophakathi kwezinkampani. Izithangami eziyinkomba zezempilo nezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukukhuluma ngamathuba nezinselelo ezihlobene nokuhambisana kwemithetho. Lokhu kusiza ukuba kuhlanzwe ezinye izinkinga noma izingozi ezivela ngalesi sikhwama. Kanjalo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuveza ukuthi bayazibuza imibuzo ethile engabavumela ukuxazulula izingqinamba abahlangabezana nazo. Hamba phambili kwezinye izinyathelo ezithile, i-GEMS iphinde ibonise ukufundayo ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze ithuthukise amasu nokuvuselela imithetho yayo, ija ulwazi olusha, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezenzo zayo. Lokhu kuzama ukwakha umgubho kubalulekile, okwazi ukwakha ithemba phakathi kwamaGEMS kanye neziphathimandla ezithinta imithombo yezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukholwa kokwaziswa kwependulo kuyisihluthulelo ekuphumeleleni kwezinqubomgomo. Ngokusho kwabalulekile, izincwadi zokuqhuba ezibhalwe phansi zikhombisa izikhalazo ngemithetho, zifaka phakathi nodoliwe. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukusiza kulolu hambo, aqhube imikhankaso yokuhambisana, nokuqhakambisa izinqubomgomo eziyinqaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izoxhumana ukuze ihlonze izinkampani eziphumelelayo emkhakheni wezempilo, ukwandisa amagama agqugquzelayo naso yizingxenyekazi eziwusizo phambi kokuphila komphakathi. Lokhu kuwenza kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni nasekusekeleni ukuhlonishwa kwempilo yomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukulandela imithetho yesikhwama se-GEMS kunomthelela omkhulu ekutheni abarbeiter benze ngokuzimisela futhi bahlakulele ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthola izinsizakalo ezilungile. Kulabo abahlanganyela, ukuqonda imithetho yokusebenzisa, kanye nama-operations ahambisanayo kuzogqugquzela impumelelo yayo yonke. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuveze indlela ehlanzekile yomugqa wesikhathi wokufinyelela izinsizakalo zempilo ezikhethiwe. Isibopho sokuhambisana kwe-GEMS sizohlala senza umehluko omkhulu, ubuncane bukhonza umphakathi, futhi bunikeze amalungu ithuba lokuphila kahle. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS izobambelela ezimisweni zayo zokuhlonishwa, ikhulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela nosizo. Emva kwalokhu, kubalulekile ukuba wonke amalungu abheke phambili, aqonde umgomo wabo wokulalela imithetho ye-GEMS, okunomthelela omuhle empilo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhamba nendlela yokuqhubekela phambili, kukholwe ukuba, sonke sinesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ye-GEMS iyahlonishwa, okukhuthaza impumelelo yezeMpilo eziphakanyisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhumbuzo esinamandla sokuhambisana okulindelekile, okukhuthaza ezempilo zethu sonke.
Imibhalo Yesimo Sempesheni Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumsebenzi wezempilo emnyangweni wezokwelapha, wathola incwadi ethokozisayo. Le ncwadi yayivela kwi-GEMS, okuyinhlangano ethokozisayo eyayiphatha izinsiza zempesheni zabantu abasebenza emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngokujabula, uMthembu wabona ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola isimo sempesheni yakhe. Uhlanga lwempesheni lwalubhalwe kahle, kodwa uMthembu wathola ukuthi kudingeka athumele imibhalo ethile ukuze aqinisekise isimo sakhe. Wazi ukuthi lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile, ngoba impesheni iyinsika yokuphila eminyakeni ezayo. Ngakho, wathatha isinqumo sokuhamba uye ehhovisi le-GEMS ukuze aqonde kahle izidingo. Ngokufika kwakhe ehhovisi, uMthembu wathola umoya opholile, kodwa ubuhlungu bokukhathazeka babusakhanya ebusweni bakhe. Waqala ukukhumbula izinsuku ezinzima lapho abanye abasebenzi bephuthuma ukuze bathole izincwadi zabo, kodwa yena wayezimisele. Uhambo lwakhe lwalungelula, kodwa wanqoba izithiyo. Uthole umphakathi ohloniphekile, ogcwele abantu abazinikele ekusizeni. Umphakathi lo wawuhlanganisa abaphathi, osomabhizinisi, nabanye abasebenzi abahlanganyela ukuze baqonde izinqubo ze-GEMS. Uthole uNkk. Khumalo, ongumxhumanisi, owayezwakala ethokozisa. "Ngiyavuma, Mnumzane Mthembu," kusho yena, "siyazi ukuthi imibhalo yesimo sempesheni ibalulekile. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukukusiza." UNkk. Khumalo wathola uhlu lwemibhalo edingekayo. "Sicela ulethe izincwadi zakho zokuqashwa, izitatimende zezimali, kanye nezinye izincwadi ezikhombisa isimo sakho." Uthola ukuthi lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile, kodwa akukhathazi. Uthokoze kakhulu ukuthi uNkk. Khumalo wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza. Ngemva kokuhlanganyela, uMthembu wathola ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zidingeka ukuze aqinisekise isimo sempesheni yakhe. Wazisa uNkk. Khumalo ukuthi uzothumela imibhalo edingekayo ngokushesha. Uthokoze kakhulu ngokubambisana kwabo, futhi wathola umuzwa wokuthi akasodwa kulolu hambo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uMthembu wathola ithuba lokubuyela ehhovisi le-GEMS. Lesi sikhathi, wayezinikele ekuthumeleni imibhalo yakhe, eqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. UNkk. Khumalo wamamukela, futhi uMthembu wathola umuzwa wokuthokozisa. "Ngiyabonga, Nkk. Khumalo," kusho yena, "ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela impesheni yami." Ukwaziswa kwempesheni kwakuhambisana nezifiso zempilo ezinhle. Uthokoze kakhulu ngokuba ne-GEMS, ngoba yayimphatha kahle. Uthola ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yakhe izoba ngcono, futhi uzokwazi ukujabulela impilo yakhe ngemva kokuthola impesheni. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMthembu wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela kwi-GEMS. Le ncwadi yayimemezela ukuthi isimo sempesheni yakhe sihle, futhi uzokwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezithile. Uthokoze kakhulu, futhi wakhumbula ukuthi lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Uthokoze kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi isimo sempesheni sikhona ukuze sithokozise. Uthole ukuthi uGEMS ungumngane omkhulu, futhi uzokwazi ukujabulela impilo yakhe ngemva kokuthola impesheni. Uthokoze kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Ngemuva kokuhlola izincwadi ezitholakele, uMthembu wathola umuzwa wokuthi ukuhamba kwakhe kwaba yimpumelelo. Uthokoze kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi isimo sempesheni sikhona ukuze sithokozise. Uthokoze, futhi wathola ukuthi uGEMS ungumngane omkhulu, futhi uzokwazi ukujabulela impilo yakhe ngemva kokuthola impesheni. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola ukuthi ukulandela izinqubo ezilungile nokubambisana nabanye, kungaholela empumelelweni. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma uhamba ngendlela efanele, impilo ingaba ngcono, futhi impesheni iyinsika yokuphila eminyakeni ezayo. Uthokoze kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi isimo sempesheni sikhona ukuze sithokozise.
Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu, okubizwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Good, Effective, and Meaningful Services), kubalulekile emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lezi zinsizakalo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekiswe ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi, zikhuthaze impilo engcono, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-GEMS iyinsika ebalulekile yokuhlola nokuphucula izinga lezinsizakalo, iqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezisetshenziswayo zihlala ziphumelela futhi zisebenza kahle. Ukuze siqonde kahle i-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuqonda izimiso eziyisisekelo ezihambisana nayo. Lezi zimiselo zihlanganisa ukwethembeka, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuhlonipha abathengi. Ukuthembeka kubalulekile ukuze kube nokwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nabathengi bazo. Ubuchwepheshe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, buhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kahle. Ukuhlonipha abathengi, okungukuthi, abathengi bazo kanye nezidingo zabo, kubalulekile ekwakheni izinsizakalo ezizokhuthaza ukwaneliseka. I-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo ezikhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngokufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibaluleka ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza ekuqondeni izidingo zomphakathi kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nalezo zidingo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwaziswa nokwazisa, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. I-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze izinsizakalo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaze impilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Emphakathini, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze izinsizakalo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ngokuphetha, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaze impilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-GEMS, ngakho-ke, iyinsika ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa (GEMS Treatment Outcome Responsibility) Ngaphakathi kwezinkulungwane, umhlaba kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nokwelashwa zishintshile, kodwa into eyodwa ihlale ifana: isibopho sokunikeza imiphumela ethile phakathi kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Emiphakathini evamile, lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu neGEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-‘Generalized Outcome Measure for Standardized Treatments,’ esisiza ochwepheshe bezempilo ukuba bahlaziye imiphumela yokwelashwa ngendlela eqondile nefanele. Izinsuku eziphakathi kronjiwe zikhumbuza abantu abaningi ngezindawo ezenza imiphumela yokwelashwa ifinyeleleke. Kusukela ngesikhathi sokuzindla kwabantu, okwasekuhlaleni, izinqaba zokwelapha, iziguli zazifuna ukwazi ukuthi ziyobe ziphuma njani emkhakheni wezempilo. Kodwa ngaphambi kokuba kube khona izindlela ezicacile zokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa, lezi zinsiza zazihlala zinezinkinga ezithile — ezokuhlola nezokubuyekeza. Emaphakathi nekhulu lama-20, kuba khona intuthuko enkulu emkhakheni wezokwelapha, lapho kuchazwa khona ngokucacile izindlela zokwelapha nezindlela zokuhlala zempilo. Kulezi zikhathi, kuchazwa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa akukhona kuphela okufanele kube nemikhuba yokulwa nezifo, kodwa kufanele futhi kube nomthelela empilweni yesiguli. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi baveza ukuthi ukwelashwa kufanele kube nezinqubo ezisemqoka zokuhlola, ezizokwenza kube khona izinkomba ezichaziwe ukuze zihlolwe. Njengoba kusondela ekupheleni kwale nkathi, umphakathi wezempilo waqala ukubona izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izinkomba ezithile, okuyinto eyamenza lokhu kube ukwakha uhlaka olujulile lokuhlola imiphumela. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili, uhlu lwemiphumela lokuhlola, okwakuhlanganisa izinkomba ezivumelana nezinga lesiguli, lwadalwa. Lokhu kwavuleka emaphethelweni okuzama ukujula ekuqondeni indlela yokuthi iziguli ziwuthola kanjani umphumela wokwelashwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS yavela njengomkhiqizo wokwakha i-model esebenzayo, evumela ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo ziqoqa, zihlaziye, futhi ziqhathanise imiphumela yokwelashwa. Iphrojekthi ibikade ibhekwa njengomphumela obalulekile emigqeni yokwelapha ukwazisa ngokwengeziwe ngezidingo zeziguli. Njengoba amakhono akhula ngemisebenzi ehlukene yokwelapha, imiphumela yokwelashwa yaba into eyenza ukucabanga okukhulu nemisebenzi emisha. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezibopho ezishiwo yiGEMS kwaba nomthelela ezinqubweni zokuphila zabantu. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela empilweni yabo, kodwa nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziguli zenzeka zokuqala ukuzimisela ukuba nomthelela ekuqondeni imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu qallakaza indlela abaphila ngayo, kwabahlala bagcina bezibophezela ezimisweni ezithile, ukuze baqhubeke nokugqugquzela izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezinqala futhi ezinezinhloso. Abasabalalisi bemiphumela yokwelashwa behlole izinkinga nezinselelo ezihlobene neGEMS, futhi bazizwa bethokozisa ngokuhlanganyela imiphumela ethokozisayo. Le miphumela, okwakukhona izibalo ezithile nemiphumela ethile, yaholela ekubeni bathathe izinyathelo ezinkulu. Isizukulwana sokuqala sokusebenzisa iGEMS siphathe izithembiso zokwelapha ezithuthukile, ezaguqula indlela yokubhekisisa nezokwelashwa kahle. Phakathi nezinsuku ezithile, lezi zinto ziwubufakazi bokuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa iyashintsha. Ngenkathi amakhono eGEMS eqhubeka, umphakathi wabantu uthola ulwazi olunembile, oludingekayo ezindleleni zokuphila zokugcina imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, lokhu kubala okuhle akusayo kuphela ukwakheka kwemiphumela yokwelashwa kodwa kuhlobene nokwethula umkhankaso, ukuqonda okwandayo phakathi kwezempilo nezenhlalakahle. Isibopho sokusebenza sizinikele ekwakheni izixazululo ezivumelana nezidingo zabantu, nokwazisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukwazi impilo ildir jweji uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ibhekwa futhi ihlonishwa ngaphezu kokuhlola, lokhu ateka umphakathi ukuze balandele iziphakamiso ezithile ezilindelekayo. Ngamafuphi, isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sineqalisa ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye nemiphakathi, okuhamba phambili kumazinga aphezulu. I-GEMS isiqhubeka nokufuya ubuchwepheshe besimanje, ibalulekile emithini ewusizo yokuhlola imiphumela ekhulayo. Izinkampani zempilo zikhumbule, iziphakamiso zifinyelelwa ngenhloso yokubambisana, ngoba emaphayipini akhona, imiphumela yokwelashwa iqhubeka nokukhula nezindaba zomphakathi zezenzo zempilo. Ekupheleni kosuku, isibopho sokwelashwa sokuqala kulezi zinsiza zingenza isiguli sibe nesithakazelo esiqinile emkhakheni wokwelapha, okwenza kube lula kakhulu Ukuba neziguli ezijabule ngempela. Imiphumela yokwelashwa yaziwa, ibeka imiphakathi ibilingana, iGEMS izokwenza umphumela phambili, ehlonishwa futhi ethathwa njengento ebaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu okubikiwe kudinga ukusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezithile, ezithuthukayo, ezinde ziza kubekezela ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokwelashwa. I-GEMS iyinsika ebalulekile yokwazisa abantu, umbono, neziphakamiso zokwelapha, okwenza kube kube yinsika yeqhaza ethe xaxa. Uhlelo olwakhiwa ngempumelelo lusebenza ukuze luthuthukise imiphumela yezempilo ngokuphathelene nezinto ezinqumayo zokubona. Njengoba siqhubeka, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuhlonipha, ukusebenza kahle, nesibopho senzelwa kahle ngokuchumisa imiphumela yokwelashwa, sizoqhubeka sithuthukisa izimfanelo zendalo, sithokozise iziguli, futhi sibe umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo (GEMS claim reimbursements) Ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo, ikakhulukazi ngaphansi kweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kuyisihloko esithokozisayo esithinta izigidi zabantu abasebenza kuhulumeni. Le nqubo ibalulekile, njengoba ihlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi baphinde bahlomule ngokwezimali. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nale nqubo, ezidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amalungelo akhe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iGEMS iyinhlangano eyenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo ezihlobene nezokwelapha. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabule uma bezwa ukuthi bangathola imali yabo emuva ngemva kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Nokho, inqubo yokubuyiselwa kwemali ayilula, futhi lokhu kudala ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana nokubuyiselwa kwemali yizithiyo ezikhona ekufakweni kwezicelo. Abasebenzi bavame ukubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, njengokungaqondi kahle izinqubo, izidingo ezithile zokufaka izicelo, kanye nezikhathi ezide zokulinda. Lokhu kudala ukucindezeleka, futhi abanye bangase baphinde baphumele ngaphandle kwemali abayifanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke lezi zinkinga futhi ithuthukise izinqubo zayo ukuze kube lula kubasebenzi ukufaka izicelo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zeGEMS zidinga ukuba ziqinise ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuphela abantu abafanele abathola ukubuyiselwa kwemali. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ubugebengu bokufaka izicelo ezingekho emthethweni, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali. Nokho, lokhu akufanele kube yisizathu sokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abaqotho abafuna ukusiza imindeni yabo. Kumele kube khona ibhalansi phakathi kokuvikela izinsiza zeGEMS nokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile nokufundiswa kubasebenzi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kuGEMS nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekutheni abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukufaka izicelo. Abasebenzi abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bangasebenzisi amalungelo abo. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke indlela yokukhuthaza ukufundiswa nokwaziswa ukuze abasebenzi bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa inqubo yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo. Uma iGEMS ingakwazi ukwenza lokhu, izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bayo, futhi ibasize ekutholeni imali abayifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibambisane nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zayo zihlala zikhona ezandleni zabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola impendulo ezivela kubasebenzi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kweGEMS nezinyunyana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezithile ezithinta izinkinga ezikhona. Ekugcineni, ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo ngaphansi kweGEMS kuyinqubo ebalulekile, kodwa kudinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo ezidingekayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, iGEMS kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, nokubambisana nezinyunyana. Uma lezi zinto zingaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthuthuka okukhulu ekubuyiselweni kwemali, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abasebenzi bakahulumeni baphile impilo engcono.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sokusebenza (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kubalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza, izinzuzo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelashwa. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle kwezinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu abahlanganyela kule nhlangano. Isizathu Sokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezimali Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kuhloswe ukuvimbela izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathola izinzuzo ze-GEMS bangabantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zifinyeleleka kubantu abafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kusiza ekugwemeni ubugebengu bokukhwabanisa, lapho abantu bezama ukuthola izinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni. Indlela Yokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa Ukuze uqinisekise isimo sokuqashwa, umsebenzisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa igama, isibongo, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngale mininingwane, i-GEMS izobheka lezi zinsiza ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzisi uqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kusebenza ngokuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela ye-GEMS, futhi kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi abe neziqu ezithile ezivumelekile. Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa 1. Ukufaka Isicelo: Umsebenzisi kufanele aqale ngokufaka isicelo sokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Lokhu kungafakwa ku-inthanethi noma ngokuqhafaza ehhovisi le-GEMS. 2. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemininingwane: Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, umsebenzisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo, efana ne-ID, igama, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. 3. Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali: I-GEMS izobuyekeza le mininingwane ukuze iqinisekise isimo sokuqashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinhlelo zokusebenza zabasebenzi, izinkontileka, kanye nemininingwane ethile ethathwe kumqashi. 4. Ukwaziswa: Ngemuva kokuphothula inqubo yokubuyekeza, umsebenzisi uzothola isaziso sokuthi isimo sokuqashwa sakhe siqinisekisiwe noma cha. Uma kunenkinga, umsebenzisi uzothola izeluleko zokuthi angayilungisa kanjani. Izinzuzo Zokuqinisekiswa Kwezimali Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zifinyeleleka kubantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni, okwenza kube nokwethenjelwa. Okwesibili, kuvikela i-GEMS ekukhwabaniseni, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zezimali. Okwesithathu, kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abaqashwe noHulumeni, njengoba kubonisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyazimisela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Izinkinga Ezivamile Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga ezithile ezivamile ezihambisana nokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa. Enye yezinkinga ezivame ukubonwa yikhona ukungahambisani kwemibhalo. Lokhu kungavela uma umsebenzisi enza amaphutha ekufakeni imininingwane, noma uma izinkampani zisebenzisa amagama ahlukene kumadokhumenti. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ayihlinzeki iyahambisana. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zifinyeleleka kubantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Le nqubo ayigcini nje ngokuvikela i-GEMS, kodwa futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo ezidingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi baqonde le nqubo futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala beqinisekisiwe ukuze bathole izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abaqashwe noHulumeni kuzokwenza kube nokwethenjelwa, futhi kuqinise umnotho wethu.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-2000, izinhlelo zokwelashwa zashintsha ngokukhulu. Umphakathi wawudinga izixazululo ezithile ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavulwa i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), uhlelo lokwelashwa olwakhelwe ngempela ukuze lusebenze kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezithuthukile, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kodwa lokhu kwaholela ekubeni nemibuzo eminingi mayelana nokufaneleka kwabantu kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni babefuna ukuqonda kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezithile, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemigomo ethile yokunquma ukufaneleka. Ukwenziwa kwemigomo yokunquma ukufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile. Kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezindlela ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwamadokhumenti ahlukanisayo, aphakamisa izimfuno ezithile okufanele zifezekiswe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujabulisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kwahlanganisa izinga lemfundo, iminyaka yokusebenza, kanye nezinye izimo ezithinta ukufaneleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yahlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola ukufaneleka. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kubo yini. Umphakathi wawudinga ukwazi ukuthi izinzuzo ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa zikhona yini kubo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abasebenzi ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zafaka phakathi ama-workshops, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kwathuthukisa ukwazi kwabantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ze-GEMS, futhi kwavumela abantu ukuba bakwazi ukusebenzisa izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Nokho, nakuba i-GEMS yayihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, kwavela izinselelo ezithile. Abanye abantu babebhekene nezithiyo ezithile zokufaneleka, okuholela ekutheni bangakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezazifunwa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, i-GEMS yahlala ihlola izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinzuzo zifinyeleleka kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo zayo kwavumela i-GEMS ukuba ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufaneleka ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS yaziwa kakhulu ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezithile, i-GEMS yahlala ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ekugcineni, ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile emlandweni wezokwelapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha izixazululo ezinhle ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ukukhula kwe-GEMS kubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezithuthukile, futhi lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi umsebenzi omuhle ungakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izidingo zamaphepha omholo zamalungu aqashiwe (GEMS employed member salary slip requirements) Ukuze amalungu aqashiwe e-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) akwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi abenamaphepha omholo afanele. Lezi zidingo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi akwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo zempilo zabo ngendlela efanele. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahlangabezana nezidingo ezisemthethweni. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda amaphepha omholo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphepha omholo ayisithombe esicacile sokwaziswa kwemali eyamukelwe emsebenzini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane efana nemali eyamukelwe, izaphulelo, nezindleko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo akhe ahlanzekile, acacile, futhi anembile ukuze akwazi ukuwasebenzisa kalula. Isigaba 2: Izidingo eziyisisekelo zamaphepha omholo Lapho uthola amaphepha omholo, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ahlangabezana nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, amaphepha omholo kufanele abe nezinombolo ezisemthethweni, ezifana nenombolo yempesheni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nenombolo ye-employee ID, ukuze kube lula ukuhlela nokuhlola izinsiza. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezitholakele zifanele izindleko ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Uma amaphepha omholo engahambisani nalokhu, amalungu kufanele axhumane ne-HR (Human Resources) ukuze athole usizo. Isigaba 4: Ukubheka izaphulelo Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukubheka izaphulelo ezikhona kumaphepha omholo. Izaphulelo zingase zibe yizindleko zokwelashwa, izindleko zokuhamba, noma ezinye izindleko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Amalungu kufanele aqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zaphulelo zisebenza kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Isigaba 5: Ukugcina amarekhodi Ngemva kokuthola amaphepha omholo, amalungu kufanele agcine amarekhodi awo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzosiza uma kudingeka ukuthi baphinde baphinde bahlola izinsiza ezitholakele noma uma kudingeka ukwenza izichibiyelo. Ukugcina amarekhodi kahle kuzovikela amalungu ekulahlekelweni yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuxhumana ne-GEMS Uma amalungu ebhekene nezinkinga noma udaba oluthile mayelana namaphepha omholo, kufanele axhumane ne-GEMS ngokuqondile. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezihlukahlukene, ezinjengefoni, i-imeyili, noma ngokuqhafaza kwiwebhusayithi yabo. Lokhu kuzovumela amalungu ukuthi athole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha. Isigaba 7: Ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo Ekugcineni, amalungu kufanele ahlale ebheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezivela ku-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izaphulelo, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisa impilo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale unolwazi olusha nokuthi ufunde ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, amalungu aqashiwe e-GEMS angakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphepha omholo abo ahlangabezana nezidingo ezisemthethweni, futhi akwazi ukuhlela impilo yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bazuze ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo.
Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu (GEMS third-party contractor access agreements) Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. Le ndaba ibalulekile ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-‘third-party contractors’ noma osonkontileka besithathu, abenza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene emikhakheni ehlukene. Singakubona kanjani ukuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani ezizimele nezinkampani ezinkulu, futhi ikakhulukazi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela ezibhalwe phakathi kwazo. Uhlaka lwezivumelwano Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zifaka phakathi iziqondiso ezithile ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimfuneko zokuphepha, izinqubo zokusebenza, kanye nezimo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ngabe izivumelwano zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi osonkontileka bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi bayayazi imithetho nemigomo yokusebenza kulezo zindawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezivumelwano Ukwakhiwa kwezivumelwano zokufinyelela kudinga ukuhlela okucophelela. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Uhlelo lokusebenza kufanele luhlanganise izidingo zomsebenzi, izinsuku zokusebenza, kanye nemigomo yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka baqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile kubo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo Kubalulekile ukufaka izinsiza ezitholakalayo kumavumelwano. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi amathuluzi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi uphumelele. Izivumelwano kufanele zicacise ukuthi ubani ozohlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, ukuze kungabikho ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwabathintekayo. Izimo zokuphepha Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngensiza, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zidinga ukubheka izimo zokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi, bekwazi ukusebenza endaweni ephephile. Izivumelwano kufanele zifake izinqubo zokuphepha, imihlahlandlela yokusebenza, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma kwenzeka ingozi. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuphumelela Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izivumelwano zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola ukusebenza kosonkontileka, ukuhlola izinga lezinsizakalo, kanye nokubuyekeza izivumelwano uma kudingeka. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe yizinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwezivumelwano. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana okukhululekile phakathi kwabaphathi, osonkontileka, kanye nabasebenzi. Ukuxhumana kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga uma zenzeka. Ukubaluleka kwezivumelwano Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibalulekile emkhakheni wezokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaziqonda kahle izimfuneko zomsebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, izivumelwano zifaka isisekelo sokusebenza okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, singaqonda ukuthi izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqonda izimfuneko zomsebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ukuxhumana okuhle, izinqubo ezicacile, kanye nezinyathelo zokuphepha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yalezi zivumelwano. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi iyaphumelela.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: I-GEMS Iphakamisa Izinga Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokwelapha ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, i-GEMS ibeka phambili ukugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola imithi, izivivinyo, noma izinqubo ezidingekayo. I-GEMS inezinqubo ezicacile zokuthi odokotela baphumelele kanjani ekugunyazweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni, lapho odokotela badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nesimo sezempilo sesiguli. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele, futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS. Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, i-GEMS ibuye ibhekelele izinguquko ezithinta izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokugunyazwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, odokotela bangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zabo nge-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshise inqubo yokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zithole ukwelashwa ngokushesha, okubalulekile ekwelapheni izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Ukuxhumana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo nezidingo. I-GEMS ibeka phambili ukwakha izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-smartphone, ezivumela iziguli ukuthi zixhumane ngqo nodokotela bazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye inikeze izinsiza zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngefoni, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zihlala zazi kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezidingo ezithile ezihambisana nezimo zazo. Izifundo Eziqhamukayo Ngenxa yokwanda kwezidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi kudingeka izifundo ezithile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa odokotela mayelana nezidingo ezithile zokugunyazwa, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. I-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukufundisa odokotela nokuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye ibheke izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinqubo zayo zokugunyazwa, ukuze kube lula futhi kusheshise inqubo yokuthola ukwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokugunyazwa. Isiphetho I-GEMS ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibeka phambili ukugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele, futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS. Njengoba izidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhula, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okungcono.
Ukufakwa Nokucutshungulwa Kwezicelo Zezimangalo Ze-GEMS Emhlabeni wezempilo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zibalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsiza zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Nokho, ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuba sikhulume ngokuqonda, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufakwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ku-GEMS akuyona into elula. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukuze umsebenzisi akwazi ukufaka isicelo, kudingeka ukuthi aqonde kahle izidingo ezithile, njengokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane efanele, izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Ngokuphathelene nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Abasebenzisi bahlala bekhathazekile ngalesi sikhathi sokulinda, njengoba izicelo zingathatha isikhathi eside ukuze zicutshungulwe. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki, futhi kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuze bathole usizo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke indlela yokwenza lezi zinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi kubalulekile. Abasebenzisi badinga ukwazi ukuthi izicelo zabo zikhona, zicutshungulwa, noma zidinga okuthile ukuze ziqhubeke. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kufanele ibe nezindlela ezithile zokuxhumana, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ezokuxhumana, noma izikhungo zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona kuphela ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo ezidinga ukwenziwa. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke futhi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kufanele ibambisane nezikhungo ezahlukene, ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke izidingo zabantu. Abasebenzisi badinga izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi i-GEMS kufanele ibheke ukuthi izinsiza zayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezicacile, ezisebenzayo, futhi ezithuthukisayo. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza lezi zinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi kubalulekile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza ezinhle, futhi izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke lezi zinto, ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezinhle, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo baneliseka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo. I-GEMS kufanele ibe yisibonelo sokusebenza kahle, ukuze ibonise ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zingathuthukiswa, futhi abantu bangathola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS (GEMS eligibility and requirements) Ingxoxo noMnu. Zulu, Umeluleki wezeMali Umphakathi: Sawubona, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngokuqonda okufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ungangichazela ukuthi iyini i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyindlela yokwelapha eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi kanye nezihlobo zabo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ungachaza ukuthi ubani ofanele ukujoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ukuze umuntu abe ne-GEMS, kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abasebenzi bezikhungo zomphakathi, abaphathi, kanye nabanye abasebenzi abahlinzekwa nguhulumeni. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengeminyango ehlukene, bangakwazi ukujoyina. Umphakathi: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi i-GEMS igxile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngabe kukhona izidingo ezithile okufanele zifeziwe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kunezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele kube nesivumelwano sokuqashwa esiqhubekayo, okusho ukuthi umsebenzisi kufanele abe ngumsebenzi osebenzayo, hhayi ophumile emsebenzini. Okwesibili, kufanele kube nesivumelwano esibhalwe phansi sokuba ne-GEMS, esivunyelwene phakathi komsebenzi nomqashi. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele umuntu azithathe ukuze aqinisekise ukufaneleka kwakhe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle emnyangweni wakhe, ukuze ulwazi lwakhe luhambisane nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngemva kwalokho, kufanele ahlole izinhlelo ezitholakalayo ze-GEMS ukuze akhethe eyamukelekayo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kulula. Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile zokuba ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa. Okwesibili, inikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezahlukene, kusukela ezikhungweni ezinkulu kuya ezincane, futhi inikeza izaphulelo ezinkulu ezindlekweni zokwelashwa. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinto ezithile okufanele abantu bazi ngazo uma bejoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi izinqubo zokubhalisela i-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqonda izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukufaneleka ne-GEMS kudinga ukuqonda okuhle. Unganikeza izeluleko kubantu abacabanga ngokujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Ngempela. Okokuqala, ngincoma ukuthi bahlale bephapheme futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Bafanele baphendule imibuzo ethile, njengokuthi, "Yiziphi izinsizakalo engizidingayo?" noma "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo?" Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalezi zeluleko ezibalulekile. Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukwabelana ngakho mayelana ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsiza ewusizo, kodwa kufanele bazi kahle izinqubo nezidingo ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa kahle. Futhi, bahlale bexhumana nomnyango wezabasebenzi ukuze bazi izinguquko ezithinta i-GEMS. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinto eziningi ezithakazelisayo. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abacabanga ngokujoyina i-GEMS.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wenzeke eGoli, lapho abahlanganyeli beGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) bahlangana ukuze bamukele futhi baqonde imigomo yenqubomgomo yephrojekthi yabo. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile mayelana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezithinta amalungu, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo kubo. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evula umhlangano eyethulwe nguMnu. Sipho Mthembu, umphathi weGEMS. Uthe, “Siyavuma ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukufundwa kahle ukuze amalungu ethu aqonde izinzuzo ezizovela. Ukuze sibe neGEMS eqinile, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke siqonde imigomo esiyamukelayo.” Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuxoxa, futhi abahlanganyeli baqala ukuxoxa ngemicabango yabo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemigomo, kwaba neseshini yokuxoxa, lapho amalungu abethula imibuzo eminingi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abahlanganyeli babejabulile ngokuba nesikhala sokwazisa, futhi lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana. UMsizi Nkosi, omunye wamalungu, waphakamisa ukuthi, “Kubalulekile ukuthi sizwe izinzuzo ezithile ezizovela kulolu shintsho, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela kahle ikusasa lethu.” Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo akukhona nje kuphela ukwamukela izinqumo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS namalungu ayo. UMsizi Thandiwe Ngubane, owayekhona emcimbini, uthe, “Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinguquko zizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo. Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuba yilungu leGEMS.” Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izifundo ezithile ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile. Kwaba nezinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe bezempilo, abacwaningi, kanye nabamele iziguli, bonke bephakamisa indlela ezithinta ngayo izinqubomgomo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaveza ukuthi imiphumela yokwamukela le migomo izoba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu, okwakuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obusha, okwakuzoba usizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. UMsizi Siphesihle Dlamini, owayekhuluma ngesikhathi somcimbi, uthe, “Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwethu bungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezinzima ezithinta impilo yethu.” Ukugcina umoya wokubambisana, umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuthi iGEMS iyakwenza kanjani ukuba amalungu ayo azizwe ebalulekile. UMsizi Zanele Khumalo, owayephethe iseshini yokugcina, uthe, “Siyabonga nonke ngokuba lapha. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezithuthukile.” Ngemuva kokuphothulwa komcimbi, amalungu abawathokozela kakhulu, futhi kwavela izinhlelo eziningi zokuhlanganyela ukuze kuqhubeke nokukhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezibalulekile. Umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha kwaba yizinto eziphawulekayo emcimbini. Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo yeGEMS akukhona nje ukuvuma, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelithembekile. Umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuthi iGEMS iyakwenza kanjani ukuba amalungu ayo azizwe ebalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zempilo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo akukhona nje ukwamukela izinqumo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS namalungu ayo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, ubonisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Amalungu abavuma ukuhamba phambili, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kwazisa iGEMS njengomholi kwezempilo, futhi kuzoqhubeka kugqugquzela amalungu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS (GEMS membership contributions and payments) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano yokuhlomula yezempilo, iyinsiza eyenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezinhle kubasebenzi bakamasipala eNingizimu Afrika. I-GEMS iyisixazululo esiyingqayizivele sokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezithuthukisiwe, okuyinto ethokozisa kakhulu amalungu ayo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu le-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukuze ube yilungu le-GEMS, ungathola izinzuzo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokwelashwa, nezinsiza zokuhlala eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungu angathola izaphulelo ezithile ezinhlelweni ezithile, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Umbuzo 3: Uphi umthombo wemali weminikelo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Iminikelo ye-GEMS itholakala kubasebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nohulumeni. Ngokuvamile, umkhiqizo wezezimali wokuhlinzeka nge-GEMS uhlinzekwa ngqo emholweni wabasebenzi, lapho uhlelo lwe-GEMS luhlinzeka khona ngeminikelo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe iminikelo ye-GEMS iyahluka? Impendulo: Yebo, iminikelo ye-GEMS iyahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lwenhlangano, izinga lokuhlinzeka kwezempilo, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amalungu angase athole izinketho ezahlukene zamaholo, okubandakanya nezinkokhelo ezincane noma ezinkulu, kuye ngezinga labo lokusebenza. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani izinkokhelo zisebenza? Impendulo: Izinkokhelo ze-GEMS zenzeka njalo, ngokuvamile ngenyanga, bese zihlolwa futhi zikhokhwa ngempumelelo. Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bangathola izinsiza eziphelele ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngikhumbula ukukhokha? Impendulo: Uma uthola ukuthi kukhona okukhumbulelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ngokushesha. Ungabafonela noma uvakashele i-ofisi yabo ukuze uthole usizo lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukukhokha isikweletu sakho. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo zokukhokha ngaphambi kwesikhathi? Impendulo: Yebo, ezinye izinhlelo ze-GEMS zikhuthaza amalungu ukuba akhokhe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokho kungaholela ezinzuzweni ezikhethekile, ezifana nezaphulelo noma izinzuzo ezithuthukisiwe. Umbuzo 8: Kunjani ukufaka isicelo sokuhlinzwa? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo sokuhlinzwa, amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi baphatha zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo, kuhlanganise nezincomo zomtholampilo. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, isicelo sizophenywa, futhi uma kutholakale ukuthi kuhlinzekwa, kuzokwenziwa ukufinyelela. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe i-GEMS inezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi ezihloselwe ukusiza amalungu akhona, kuhlanganise nezinyathelo zokukhuthaza impilo, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezixazululo zengqondo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza amalungu abhekana nezinselelo zempilo. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani ngithola olunye ulwazi mayelana ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Ungathola olunye ulwazi oluvela ku-website esemthethweni ye-GEMS, noma uvakashele i-ofisi yabo. Futhi, ungaxhumana nezinye amalungu ukuze uthole izeluleko nezincazelo ezithile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokubambisana, i-GEMS inikela ithuba lokuhlomula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga khona usizo lwezempilo. Ukuthola izinsiza ezimnandi nezihloniphekile kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka amalungu ngenhlalakahle engcono. Njengamalungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zeminikelo nezinkokhelo ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziphelele ezitholakalayo.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo (GEMS health facility coordination) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Green Endeavour for Medical Services, iyisinyathelo esakhiwe ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ezisemqoka emiphakathini. Isebenza njengomphakathi ohlanganisayo, ihlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basebenzelana kahle nemithombo yezempilo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile? Impendulo: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhweli besiwo sonke izinzuzo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukuthuthwa kolwazi, kanye nokwabelana ngamasu okuheha izinsiza. Umgomo uwukuba abantu bathole imishanguzo kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ngaphandle kokwenza uhambo olude. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinga lezinsizakusebenza, amakhono, kanye noshintsho kumkhankaso wezempilo kuyizinselelo eziphambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele kanye nokwakhiwa komphakathi okukhuthazayo kubalulekile. I-GEMS idinga ukuphendula kulezi zinkinga ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zithola ukwesekwa okuyisimanga. Umbuzo 4: Zithini izinzuzo zokuhlanganyela kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zibandakanya ukunciphisa izindleko, ukuhlinza izinsizakalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi osekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kukhulisa ukwakhiwa komthwalo wezithuthi kanye nokuhambela phambili ngokuhlangana kwemininingwane nokwabelana ngolwazi. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuletha ushintsho emphakathini? Impendulo: Nakanjani! I-GEMS ifaka izinguquko ezinkulu ngokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zezempilo, kuphumelele nakwezokusebenza. Lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokugula emiphakathini, ukusiza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, futhi kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokuphila komphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izikhungo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinhlobo zezinqubomgomo zokuqala zihlanganisa ukuqokwa kwezikhulu eziphethe, ukwakhiwa kwemigqa yokuxhumana, ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezinhlelo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuphila. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsizakalo kufanele kube ngaphansi kokuhola kweZikhungo zezempilo futhi kuxhaswe nguhulumeni nabanye ababambiqhaza. Umbuzo 7: Yini okumele ibhekwane kakhulu ekuphathweni kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukugxila kwezindinganiso zempilo, ugcino noma ukwenza ngcono izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kumele kube sezinhliziyweni zemisebenzi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zithola uxhaso olwenziwayo lokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani imiphumela ye-GEMS iyabhekwa? Impendulo: Ukuhlola imiphumela ye-GEMS kwenziwa ngokuhlaziywa kwemibiko, ukubuyekezwa kwezinsizakalo, nokubandakanya imiphakathi. Lokhu kunika umbono ocacile wokuthi kuyasebenza yini imizamo ethile futhi kuyakwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kubalulekile ukuba nodlame lwempilo kumphakathi? Impendulo: Yebo, udlame lwempilo lukhulu emiphakathini. I-GEMS idinga ukwazisa abantu ngendaba yezenhlalo, ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha kahle, kanye nokubhekelela izidingo zamakhosikazi nezinsizwa ezisebenzayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini esikufundile mayelana ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Siyazi ukuthi i-GEMS ikhulisa indlela esisebenzisana ngayo nezikhungo zezempilo. Imizamo yokubambisana ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuqonda kwethu lokho konke okuhlangene, kufanele sikhuthaze imithombo yakho yokuhlala nezinsizakalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusizakala kwabantu. Isiqedelo, i-GEMS inikeza amathuba amasha.obuchwepheshe futhi iyindlela ebalulekile yokuqhubeka nokukhulisa izinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa kuphela kepha kuthokozisa uxhumano phakathi kwabantu nabakhiqizi bempilo. Ngokuhlanganiswa nokuxhumana, sinethemba lokushintsha impilo yabantu, lapho sihamba phambili funa izinzuzo.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: Umqondo Wokubaluleka KweGEMS Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nabaguli kubaluleke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamasistimu afana neGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezokwelapha nabaguli. Uma sicabanga ngempilo yethu, sithola ukuthi ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kudinga imizamo emikhulu. Odokotela badinga ukuqonda kahle izidingo zabaguli babo, kanti abaguli nabo badinga ukuba nokuqonda okuhle ngezinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ngokuqondile, lokhu kudinga ukugunyazwa kodokotela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezidingekayo zikhona. Uma kukhulunywa ngamaGEMS, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nokugunyazwa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokwesibonelo, uma isiguli sithola ukuthi kudingeka ukwelashwa okuthile, udokotela kumele aqinisekise ukuthi lezo zinsiza zikhona ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kodokotela nabaphathi beGEMS, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokugunyaza ziqhutshwa ngendlela efanele. Uma lezi zinto zisebenza kahle, sizobona ukuthi abaguli bathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngaphandle kokulibaziseka. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo akugcini nje ngokuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nabaguli, kodwa futhi kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kodokotela nabaphathi beGEMS. Odokotela kumele bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bagunyazwe, kanti abaphathi beGEMS badinga ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zabaguli. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, okungase kube yinkinga uma kudingeka izinqubo ezithile ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, udokotela kufanele abe nekhono lokuphendula imibuzo yabaguli ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi udokotela abe nolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe, ukuze akwazi ukusiza isiguli sikwazi ukuqonda kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha ukwethembana, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wokuthi isiguli sikhululekile ukusho imizwa yaso. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nokugunyazwa kodokotela. Ezinye zezithiyo zifaka phakathi ukungabi nolwazi olufanele, ukungabi namathuba okukhuluma, noma izinqubo ezinzima ezithinta ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yesiguli. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abaguli, nabaphathi beGEMS. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kodokotela ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyaza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo ukuze abaguli bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma lezi zinto ziqhutshwa kahle, sizobona ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwabantu abathola ukwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu phakathi kodokotela nabaguli. Ekugcineni, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza kanjani futhi ziqhuba kanjani empilweni yethu. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sithole ukwelashwa okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza siphile impilo engcono, futhi sibe nokuqonda okuhle ngezinsiza esizitholayo. Ngakho, masiqhubeke silwela ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kodokotela, abaguli, nabaphathi beGEMS, ukuze sithole impilo engcono, futhi sithuthukise izinga lokuphila kwethu sonke. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzoba isisekelo sokuphumelela kwethu empilweni.
Isibopho selungu ngolwazi olungamanga (GEMS member liability for false information) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano enikeza imishanguzo nezinzuzo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ihloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo athola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle, okuphumelelayo, futhi okuthengekayo. Umbuzo 2: Yini esichaza ngayo isibopho selungu? Impendulo: Isibopho selungu sisho ukuthi amalungu e-GEMS banesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile, enembile, futhi ephelele uma befaka izicelo zokuhlala kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 3: Kungani kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile? Impendulo: Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile kubalulekile ngoba lokho kuthinta izinqumo ezithathwa yi-GEMS mayelana nezinsizakalo nezinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Uma amalungu e-GEMS enza amanga noma ahlinzeka ngemininingwane engalungile, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, kufaka phakathi ukulahlekelwa kwezinsiza noma ukuxoshwa kwi-GEMS. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izingozi uma ummember enza amanga? Impendulo: Uma ummember e-GEMS ethola ukuthi unikeze ulwazi olungamanga, kungaholela ezicini eziningi ezinzima. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi: - Ukulahlekelwa kwezinsizakalo - Ukuvinjelwa ekutholeni izinsiza zesikhathi esizayo - Ukubhekana nezinyathelo zomthetho, okuhlanganisa ukuxoshwa kwi-GEMS. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe i-GEMS iyakhipha izinyathelo ezithile uma kutholakala ulwazi olungamanga? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile ezithathwayo uma kutholakala ulwazi olungamanga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola udaba, ukufaka izinyathelo zokuphendula, nokuhlinzeka ngesixazululo esifanele. I-GEMS ikholelwa ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amalungu ayo ayakwazi ukuphila ngokukhululeka futhi akhuthazwe ukuba ahlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile. Umbuzo 6: Uyangithanda yini ukusinika izibonelo zezimo ezingenzeka? Impendulo: Impela! Isibonelo esivamile singaba ummember ophakamisa ukuthi unayo idokhumenti ethile yokwelashwa, kodwa empeleni akunayona. Lokhu kungaholela ekukhokheni izindleko ezibhaliwe, futhi uma kutholakala ukuthi lokhu bekungamanga, ummember angase abhekane nezinyathelo ezibucayi. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ungazi ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyinembile? Impendulo: Uma ungazi ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyinembile, kubalulekile ukuthi uthintane ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Ungabufuna ukuthi bakhombise ukuthi kula maphuzu kufanele uthumele ulwazi olunembile, nokuthi ungabavala kanjani ukufaka kahle esikhathini esizayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe i-GEMS inikeza izifundo noma izinhlelo zokwazi ukuze amalungu aqonde kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inikeza izifundo ezithile ezihloselwe ukusiza amalungu aqonde kahle izinqubo zayo, izidingo, nezibopho zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zokuphatha, imihlangano, nezinsizakalo zokusekela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu afaka ulwazi olunembile. Umbuzo 9: Yini ongayenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza ulwazi olunembile? Impendulo: Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza ulwazi olunembile, kubalulekile: 1. Ukuhlola izincwadi zakho zomuntu siqu, 2. Ukugcina amarekhodi anembile, 3. Ukuthola usizo uma ungazi noma ungathandeki ngemininingwane ethile. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umyalezo wokugcina kubo bonke amalungu? Impendulo: Umyalezo wokugcina kubo bonke amalungu e-GEMS uwukuthi: "Ihloniphe izinqubo zethu, uhlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile, futhi uzothola izinzuzo ezitholakala ku-GEMS ngendlela efanele." Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzayo, ophilayo, nolondekile. Ngamafuphi, ubufakazi bokuthi ulwazi olungamanga lungaba nemiphumela emibi kubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, amalungu e-GEMS kumele aqaphele futhi ahloniphe isibopho sawo sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphila ziye zashintsha, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emkhakheni wezimali, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinhlelweni zempesheni. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bezempilo nabanye abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile, kodwa ibuye ibangele izingxoxo eziningi phakathi kwabathintekayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhilela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu uthola izinzuzo ezifanele ezivela kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudinga ukuba kube nokwethembeka emalini ethunyelwa kumalungu e-GEMS. Uma kungekho ukuqinisekiswa, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphatha, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali noma ekutholeni izinzuzo ezingalungile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi bezempilo bangatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye baphikisa ukuthi le nqubo iyabambezela abantu. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kudinga isikhathi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale belindile ukuze bathole izinzuzo zabo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba phambili empilweni, abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezinsiza ezithile. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuqinisekisa kufanele zibe lula futhi zisheshiswe ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziphatha lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise lesi sikhathi sokulinda. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngesikhathi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile zidingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo, futhi kuzokhulula umthwalo ezinkampanini eziphethe lezi zinhlelo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakala kubantu zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubheka ukuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azisetshenziswanga ngokungafanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu bezimali, okungaholela ekutheni izinsiza zempesheni zihlale zikhona ukuze zisetshenziswe ngempumelelo. Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo eqondile, ehloniphekile, futhi esheshayo. Abantu kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo ngaphandle kokubambezela, kodwa futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, le nqubo kumele ithuthukiswe ukuze ibhekelele izidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sibe nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola lokho akufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu, futhi kuzokhulisa ukwaneliseka kwabo ngezinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onothando.
