Izinqubo zokuphatha idatha yocwaningo (GEMS research data protocols) Zidingeka izinqubo ezicacile ukuze kutholwe imiphumela ethile. Lezi zinqubo ziqukethe izinyathelo ezisemqoka okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha iqoqwa, igcinwe, futhi ihlaziywa ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo sokuqala: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Locwaningo Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuqoqa idatha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle uhlelo locwaningo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusungula izinjongo, imikhakha yocwaningo, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola. Kubalulekile ukucacisa izinkinga ozama ukuzixazulula, futhi uqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ozoba neqhaza ocwaningweni. Isinyathelo sesibili: Ukuqoqa Idatha Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha iqoqwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungula izinqubo ezicacile zokuthi idatha izotholakala kanjani. Uma usebenzisa imibuzo, qinisekisa ukuthi ibhalwe kahle ukuze ivumelane nezilaleli zakho. Futhi, uma kusebenza, sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola ezisemthethweni ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi idatha iyatholakala futhi isetshenziswe. Isinyathelo sesithathu: Ukugcina Idatha Ngemuva kokuba idatha iqoqwe, kufanele igcinwe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha iphephile futhi iyatholakala. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokugcina idatha ezithembekile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izipele ezivela emhlabeni. Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha iyahlolwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuze ubone ukuthi isasebenza. Isinyathelo sesine: Ukuhlaziya Idatha Uma idatha igcinwe kahle, sekuyisikhathi sokuyihlaziya. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlaziya, njengezibalo noma izindlela zokuhlaziywa ezithuthukile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale uhambisana nezinhlelo zakho zocwaningo. Noma imiphi imiphumela etholeka kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi ihlaziywe ngendlela efanele ukuze kubonakale kahle izixazululo. Isinyathelo sesihlanu: Ukubika Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuhlaziya, kulandela ukubika imiphumela. Lokhu kuhilela ukubhala imibiko enezincazelo ezicacile nezifundwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe kahle futhi ibonisa izixazululo ezitholakele. Uma kungenzeka, hlanganyela nemiphumela yakho nabanye abantu ukuze uthole impendulo ethokozisayo. Isinyathelo sesithupha: Ukuvuselela Idatha Izinqubo zedatha zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubuyekeza izinqubo zokuhlela, ukuqoqwa, nokuhlaziya. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izitayela ezintsha nezindlela zokucwaninga. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luhlale luhamba phambili. Isinyathelo sesixhenxe: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Kwedata Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha yakho iphephile. Lokhu kuhilela izinyathelo zokuvikela idatha, njengokusebenzisa ukufihla, izinhlelo zokuvikela, nezinsiza zokuphathwa kwedatha. Qinisekisa ukuthi abanye abantu abangenayo imvume yokufinyelela kudatha yakho. Isinyathelo sesishiyagalolunye: Ukuhlonza Amaphutha Ngaphezu kokuhlola idatha, kubalulekile ukuhlonza amaphutha. Ungavumeli amaphutha aphumele emiphumeleni yokugcina. Beka isikhumbuzo sokuhlola kabusha idatha yakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uphinde uhlole izindlela ezisetshenziswayo. Isinyathelo seshumi: Ukugcina Ubudlelwano Nomphakathi Kubalulekile ukugcina ubudlelwano nomphakathi. Hlanganisa nemiphakathi yakho, futhi ubonise imiphumela oyitholile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luthokoziswe, futhi nabanye bazokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uqonde izidingo zomphakathi, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luhambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokulandela lezi zinqubo, ungathola imiphumela ethile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi idatha yakho yocwaningo ibhekwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza ucwaningo lwakho lube namandla, luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi luthole imiphumela enembile.
Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile (GEMS dependent information confidentiality) Ngaphansi kwelanga elikhanyayo, kumadokhumenti ahlanzekile, kudubula indaba yesiZulu ethinta umphakathi wethu. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, noma i-GEMS dependent information confidentiality, luhlobo lwezinto ezibalulekile eziphathelene nokuvikela ulwazi lomuntu. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwezimfihlo kubalulekile, hhayi kuphela emhlabeni wezokwelapha, kodwa futhi nasezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, kudingeka ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwabancikile, njengokutholakala kweziguli noma ubudlelwano bazo nemindeni yazo, lungaba yinhlekelele uma lungavikelwe kahle. Njengoba sikhuluma ngale ndaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi udaba lwabancikile akukhona nje kuphela kumalungelo abantu, kodwa futhi kumthethosisekelo wethu. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile zikhona ezikhungweni eziningi, ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, nezikhungo zezimali. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi udinga ukuqonda ukuthi idokhumenti ethile ingalahlwa ngobuchwepheshe, kepha izimfihlo zayo kumele zihlale zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo eziphakeme zokuvikela ulwazi, ezinjengokufaka izinhlelo zokuphepha, ukuhlola amaqembu angaphakathi, kanye nokugcina izimfihlo zomuntu siqu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa emakethe mayelana ne-GEMS dependent information confidentiality kubalulekile, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde ukuthi kungani lesi sikhathi sokugcina ulwazi lwabancikile kubalulekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinqubo ezivumelekile zokubika noma yokubamba ulwazi, ukuze bazivikele ezinkingeni ezingase zivelwe uma ulwazi luphuma ngaphandle. Ubuqotho bokuphatha ulwazi lwabancikile kuphakathi kokuphila kwethu kwezemfundo, umsebenzi, kanye nezinye izindawo zempilo. Abantu badinga ukuba nomuzwa wokuthi bayavikelwa, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwethembeka kwabaphathi balolu lwazi. Ukungathembeki kungaholela ekuphumeni kolwazi, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, ezihlobene nokulahleka kokwaziswa, ukusola, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Njengoba siqhubeka phambili, kubalulekile ukuhlonipha izinqubo ezikhona zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqwashisa abaqashwa, ukunikeza izifundo ezivamile ezikhuluma ngale ndaba, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana ukuze bonke abathintekayo bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezithinta ubumfihlo. Umphakathi kumele unakekele ubumfihlo balabo abakha izinsiza zempilo, ngoba njengoba sisondela kakhudlwana ezinsukwini ezinzima, kumqoka ukugcina ubudlelwano besithakazelo. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhumusha futhi bukhombisa indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi sihlanganisa izimfanelo ezinjengokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sihlose ukuvikela lokhu kubalulekile, ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho wonke umuntu evele ethe kwazulu, elinokuthula nempilo ezingqondweni zabo. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile akukhona nje ukuphepha, kodwa kuyisibonakaliso sokuhlonipha abantu nabantu. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bawavikela kahle. Ubuqotho bethu njengomphakathi bukhombisa indlela esizobhekelela ngayo lezi zinkinga, futhi lesi sikhathi sokuhlola sisikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuvikela ulwazi lwabanye. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sizilungiselele, sizithathele izinyathelo ezidingekayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhlala bukhona, buphephile, futhi bukhombisa isiko lethu lokuhlonipha. Kukhona okukhulu okukhona phambi kwethu, futhi sizobhekana nakho ngokubambisana, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, nonobuhlakani.
Izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 Kulezi zinsuku, ukuhlinzekwa kwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zibalulekile. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) inezinqubo ezithile zokwazisa ngesibhedlela, ezidinga ukuthi iziguli ziqinisekise ukuthi ziwazisa izibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuvikela iziguli, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle, futhi zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondile nokuphumelelayo. Uma isiguli sithola udokotela, kufanele sithumele isaziso esisemthethweni esibhedlela esithintekayo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuthi uma isiguli sifika esibhedlela, sizoba nezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika. Lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde izidingo zempilo zesiguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinsiza ezifanele zikhona. Izinqubo zokwazisa zidinga ukuthi isiguli sithumele isaziso esisemthethweni ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma isiguli sithola usizo lwezempilo, kufanele sithumele isaziso esibhedlela esithintekayo ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba kusiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde iziguli ezizofika, futhi zibe nezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika kwesiguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinqubo ezithile ezilungiselelwe iziguli ezizofika. Ngokuhambisana nalezi zinqubo, kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde ukuthi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa igama lesiguli, inombolo yokukhumbula, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokwelashwa edingekayo. Le mininingwane izosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde kahle izidingo zesiguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zikhona. Ukuze lokhu kube lula, iziguli zidinga ukuxhumana nezibhedlela zazo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqonda kahle izinqubo zokwazisa. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, iziguli zidinga futhi ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziqondile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuzosiza iziguli ukuba ziqonde ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde kahle izidingo zeziguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika kwesiguli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 zikhombisa ukuthi ziwusizo kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle. Ukuze lezi zinqubo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde kahle izinqubo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zixhumana nezibhedlela zazo. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 zidinga ukuba ziqondwe kahle, futhi zisebenze kahle ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zihlala ziphila kahle. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekwenzeni lokhu kube ngempumelelo, futhi iziguli zidinga ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqonda kahle izinqubo zokwazisa. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke.
Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini eziningi, futhi ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo akuzange kube ngaphandle kwalokhu. Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, eziphephile, nezisebenzayo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngempilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle somkhakha wezempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini i-GEMS. I-GEMS, noma i-Good Education and Management Systems, ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kuhilela ukufakwa kwezindlela ezithile zokuhlola, ukusungula izinqubo, nokwenza izinhlelo ezizokwandisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Umgomo wokuqala we-GEMS uwukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje ukuthi ukufakwa kwe-GEMS kuzoholela emiphumeleni emihle. Abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nokwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwe-GEMS. Ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, ezibandakanya izinsiza zezimali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza zabantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bangase baphendule ngokungathandi, becabanga ukuthi lezi zindleko zingaholela ekwandeni kwentengo yezinsizakalo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko eziphezulu zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zingaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu zokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, ukwakhiwa kwe-GEMS kungaba yindlela yokunciphisa lezi zindleko ngokwandisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Ngokwesibili, i-GEMS iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi bezempilo, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Lokhu kuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, futhi bonke bayahlanganyela ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, okukhuthaza ukuvuma izimvo ezahlukene, futhi kugqugquzela ubuchwepheshe obusha. Uma abaphathi bezempilo benza izinqumo ezisebenzayo, lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enempilo, engathinta ngempela impilo yabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS akusikho kuphela ukwakha izinqubo eziphezulu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola njalo nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuba nezinqubo eziqinile zokuhlola ikhwalithi, ezizohlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuthi yiziphi izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izinguquko ezidingekayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS iyathinta umphakathi ngokujulile. Uma izinsizakalo zempilo zikhuliswa, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphile impilo enempilo, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wonke. Umphakathi ophilayo ubonakala ngempela ezingeni lezempilo labantu bawo, futhi i-GEMS iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS ayinakho konke okudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa, kufaka phakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, izimo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibhekelele lezi zici, futhi ibambisane nezinye izinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kwezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwezindlela eziphumelelayo, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi bezempilo, kanye nokuhlola njalo ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umkhakha wezempilo ungase ube sengcupheni yokwehluleka, okungaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu zokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa elinempilo kubantu bonke.
Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinhlangano enikeza izinsizakalo zempilo ezihlinzekwa kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza amalungu ayo izinzuzo ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nokwelashwa kwezempilo, ezokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 2: Ngubani ongafaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS? Impendulo: Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abathintekayo emsebenzini, bangafaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abaphathiswa, abaqashwe ngqo, kanye nabanye abasebenzi abahlinzekwa nguhulumeni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izidingo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, udinga ukuba ube ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele ube nemininingwane ethile, efana ne-ID yakho, ubufakazi bokusebenza, kanye nemininingwane yomndeni uma ufuna ukufaka amalungu omndeni. Umbuzo 4: Ungafaka isicelo kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, ungavakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-GEMS, noma ungathintana ne-ofisi ye-GEMS eduze kwakho. Kukhona ifomu lokufaka isicelo elitholakalayo ku-inthanethi, noma ungathola ifomu lokuphrinta. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqedele isicelo? Impendulo: Isinyathelo sokuqala ukufaka ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kufanele kuhlanganise nemininingwane yakho, izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kanye nezincwadi zokuxhasa. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho ku-GEMS ukuze kuhlolwe. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe kukhona izindleko zokufaka isicelo? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izindleko ezihambisana nokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kuye ngohlobo lobulungu ofuna ukuluthola. Kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izincwadi ezihambisana nesicelo ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe ngizothola kanjani impendulo ngesicelo sami? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokuthumela isicelo, uzothola isaziso sokwamukelwa noma sokwenqatshwa. Lokhu kuzothunyelwa kuwe nge-imeyili noma ngeposi, kuye ngendlela oyikhethile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma isicelo sami sikhanseliwe? Impendulo: Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, uzothola imininingwane ethile mayelana nezizathu zokukhansela. Ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izeluleko zokuthi ungabuyisela kanjani isicelo sakho noma ungakwenza kanjani ukuze uthole ubulungu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe ngingafaka amalungu omndeni esicelweni sami? Impendulo: Yebo, ungafaka amalungu omndeni, njengomkakho, izingane, noma abanye abantu obathandayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi uthumele imininingwane yabo efana ne-ID, ubufakazi bokuhlala, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Umbuzo 10: Kuthiwani uma ngithola usizo olungafanele ngemva kokufaka isicelo? Impendulo: Uma uthola usizo olungafanele, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze ubike le nkinga. I-GEMS inezinqubo zokuphendula ezizokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Umbuzo 11: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakala kubalungu be-GEMS? Impendulo: Amalungu e-GEMS athola izinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwelashwa kwezempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa iziguli eziphezulu, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezindleko zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 12: Ngabe i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezikhethekile? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihlinzekwa kumalungu, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwempilo, nezinhlelo zokuvikela impilo. Umbuzo 13: Kuthiwani uma ngithanda ukushintsha uhlelo lwami lwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Uma uthanda ukushintsha uhlelo lwakho, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi ufake isicelo sokushintsha, futhi kuzothatha isikhathi esithile ukuze kuqedwe. Umbuzo 14: Ngabe ngidinga ukwenziwa ukuhlola ukuze ngibe yilungu? Impendulo: Akudingeki ukuthi wenziwe ukuhlola ukuze ufake isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Nokho, uma uthola izinsizakalo ezithile, ungase udinge ukuhlolwa ukuze uthole ukuqinisekiswa. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ngiyenze ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngithola izinsizakalo ezinhle? Impendulo: Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi ubhalise kahle, ulandele izinqubo ezidingekayo, futhi uthintane ne-GEMS uma udinga usizo. Isiphetho: Ukufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS kuwumsebenzi obalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngokuqonda lezi zinqubo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle nezidingo zakho zempilo zaneliseka. Qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ngokucophelela, uthintana ne-GEMS uma kudingeka, futhi ube nesineke ngesikhathi sokuphendulwa kwesicelo sakho.
Umbiko: Ukuhlukaniswa Kwelungu Elingaphansi (GEMS Subordinate Member Classification) Isingeniso Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi, okwaziwa futhi njenge-GEMS subordinate member classification, kubalulekile ezempilweni eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, bathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezicini ezahlukene zokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi, izinzuzo zalo, kanye nezithiyo ezibhekene nalolu hlelo. Uhlaka lwe-GEMS I-GEMS, okuyi-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi, bangakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlukaniswa kwabantu ngokwezinga labo lempilo, izidingo zabo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izizathu zokuhlukaniswa Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kudinga izizathu ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo bahlupheka ngezinkinga ezahlukene, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala efanele, kanye nezinkinga zezempilo ezivamile. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abanjalo. Okwesibili, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zisetshenziswa kahle, futhi zifinyeleleka kulabo abadinga kakhulu. Izinzuzo zokuhlukaniswa Izinzuzo zokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi ziningi. Okokuqala, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo bathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola ukwelashwa. Okwesibili, kuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahluphekayo. Izithiyo ezibhekene nohlelo Nokho, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi akukhululekile ezithiyweni. Enye yezithiyo ezinkulu yindlela yokufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle izinqubo zokufaka izicelo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bahlale bengekho emkhakheni wezempilo. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zingabi zanele, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahluphekayo ukuthola ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuyasebenza, kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezitholakalayo kufanele zandise, ukuze abantu abahluphekayo bakwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahluphekayo. Isiphetho Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Noma kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nalolu hlelo, izinzuzo zalo zikhombisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo kubantu abahluphekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufundisa abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nokwenza lula izinqubo zokufaka izicelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abantu abahluphekayo bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo.
Ubufakazi Bokukhanselwa Kobulungu Besikhwama Sangaphambilini (GEMS Previous Scheme Membership Cancellation Proof) Umbuzo 1: Yini ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini? Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini, obukwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS cancellation proof, kuyidokhumenti ebonisa ukuthi ummember (ilungu) usukhanseli ubulungu bawo esikhwameni se-GEMS. Le dokhumenti ibalulekile ngoba ifakazela ukuthi ilungu alisasebenzisi izinsizakalo ze-GEMS futhi ingasetshenziswa uma kudingeka ukufakazela isimo salo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba ne-GEMS cancellation proof? Ukuba ne-GEMS cancellation proof kubalulekile ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, le dokhumenti isiza ukuvikela ilungu ekukhathazekeni ngezinsizakalo ezithile ezivela esikhwameni se-GEMS. Okwesibili, uma ilungu ifuna ukujoyina esinye isikhwama sokwelashwa, le dokhumenti ingaba usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi alikho ubuhlobo obukhona phakathi kwemishanguzo emibili. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Umbuzo 3: Ngabe ngingayithola kanjani le dokhumenti? Ukuze uthole ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama se-GEMS, kufanele uqale uxhumane ne-ofisi ye-GEMS. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokushayela inombolo yabo yocingo, noma uvakashele iwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole imininingwane ethile yokuxhumana. Kuye ngohlobo lokukhansela, ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile efana nenombolo yakho yokubhaliswa, igama, nomndeni wakho. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo okufanele ngizithathe ukuze ngikhanseli ubulungu bami? Izinyathelo zokukhansela ubulungu bethu zihluke kancane kuye ngesikhwama, kodwa ngokujwayelekile, kufanele ulandele lezi zinyathelo: 1. Xhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ulwazi olucacile. 2. Bhala incwadi yokukhansela, ubonise isizathu sokukhansela. 3. Thumela le ncwadi kwikhompyutha ethile noma ngeposi, ngokwezidingo ze-GEMS. 4. Linda ukuqinisekiswa kokukhansela, okuzokwenziwa nge-imeyili noma ngeposi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izindleko ezihambisana nokukhansela? Ngokuvamile, ukukhansela ubulungu akuhlanganisi nezindleko ezinkulu, kodwa kungenzeka kube nezindleko ezithile ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukufunda imigomo nemibandela ye-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko ezingase zibe khona. Uma ungazi kahle, ungababuza ngokuqondile ngesikhathi uxhumana ne-GEMS. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ngithola ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngesikhathi esifanele? Yebo, uma usuhambisile zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze ikuthumele ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuvame ukuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa kungase kube nezimo ezithile ezithinta isikhathi sokuphendula. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephelele ukuze kube lula kubo ukuhlela. Umbuzo 7: Yini engiyenzayo uma ngingatholanga ubufakazi bokukhanselwa? Uma ungatholanga ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngemva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, kufanele uxhumane ne-GEMS ukuze ubheke isimo sokuphendula. Ungase udinge ukuhambisa izincwadi zakho noma ukucacisa izinyathelo ozithathile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubufakazi buyatholakala. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe ngingabuyela esikhwameni se-GEMS uma ngikhansile? Yebo, uma usukhansile ubulungu bakho, ungabuyela esikhwameni se-GEMS uma uthanda. Kodwa, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyahlangabezana nezidingo zokubuyela, ezihlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile futhi uhlole izimo ezithile ezihambisana nokubuyela. Kubalulekile ukufunda izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo zokukhansela ubulungu? Yebo, ukukhansela ubulungu kungaba nezinzuzo ezithile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokwelashwa uma ungasebenzisi izinsizakalo ze-GEMS, noma ukubeka isikhala sokuthi uthole ezinye izinsizakalo ezihambelana nezidingo zakho. Kodwa, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlole kahle izinzuzo nezingozi ngaphambi kokwenza isinqumo. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyifunda kulolu chungechunge? Kulolu chungechunge, ufunde ukuthi ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama se-GEMS buwusizo kakhulu ekuphatheni izinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Ukwazi izinyathelo ezidingekayo, izindleko, nezimo ezihambisana nokukhansela kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba uthathe izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsizakalo zakho zezempilo. Ngakho-ke, uma ucabanga ngokukhansela ubulungu bakho, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo futhi uthole ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungena ezinkingeni ezizayo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa buwumgogodla wokuphatha kahle izinsizakalo zakho zezempilo.
Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha: Umqondo Wokwakha Isiko Elisha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ziye zathola ukuthi ukwamukela abasebenzi abasha akukhona nje ukugcwalisa izikhala, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha isiko elisha. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi ezikhishwe yiGEMS, zikhombisa indlela yokuhlonipha, yokwakha ubudlelwano, kanye nokwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izincwadi zikhombisa ukuthi umqashi uyabahlonipha futhi ubabheka njengengxenye ebalulekile yempumelelo yenkampani. Ukuqala, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zifanele zibe nezinto ezithile ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kufanele zibe nezinhloso ezicacile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele achaze kahle ukuthi yini okulindeleke kubasebenzi abasha, izinjongo zenkampani, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde kahle indawo yabo ngaphakathi kwenkampani, futhi bazizwe bekhululekile ukuveza imibono yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi kufanele zibe nesithakazelo sokwakha umoya wokubambisana, okungukuthi, umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi ukuba basebenzisane, baphinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Okwesibili, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nesithakazelo sokwakha isiko elisha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baphatheke kahle, baphinde bahloniphe isiko lenkampani. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokubafundisa ngamasiko, izinqubo, kanye nezimiso ezisemqoka zenkampani. Uma abasebenzi beqonda kahle isiko lenkampani, bazoba nesifiso sokuligcina, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nezinto ezithokozisayo. Umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baveze izifiso zabo, izinjongo zabo, kanye nezinto abazithandayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazizwe bekhululekile, futhi bazokwazi ukujabulisa izifiso zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izifiso zabasebenzi zikhombisa ukuthi banelungelo lokuba neqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yenkampani. Okwesithathu, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nezindlela zokuxhumana. Umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baxhumane, baphinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi bazokwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye uma kudingeka. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani. Ngokuphetha, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zibalulekile ekwakheni isiko elisha. Umqashi kufanele aqonde ukuthi lezi zincwadi azikhona nje ukuze ziqedele izinqubo, kodwa zibalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwesiko, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi. Uma umqashi enza lokhu, uzokwazi ukwakha indawo yokusebenza enempumelelo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa bejabulile futhi bephumelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zibe nezinto ezithile ezibalulekile, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bayaziswa, bahlonishwa, futhi baphumelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zikhombisa ukuthi umqashi uyabahlonipha, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isiko elisha.
Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi (GEMS Risk Management) Ukuphathwa kwezingozi, okwaziwa njenge-GEMS risk management, kubalulekile emkhakheni wezokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezahlukene ezifana nezamabhizinisi, ezokwakha, nezokwelapha. Le nqubo ihlanganisa ukuhlela, ukuhlola, nokuphatha izingozi ezihlobene nezinhlelo, imisebenzi, noma imikhiqizo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuphathwa kwezingozi, kubalulekile ukuba sazi ukuthi izingozi zingaba yiziphi, zenzeka kanjani, futhi zingathinta kanjani inhlangano. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izingozi Izingozi zingabhekwa njengemiphumela engalindelekile engase ibe nomthelela omubi emsebenzini. Lokhu kungabandakanya izingozi zemali, izingozi zokuphepha, izingozi zemvelo, noma izingozi ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ukuze siqonde izingozi, kufanele sihlole izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta inhlangano, njengezimo zomnotho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, nezimo zokusebenza. Ukuhlola lezi zici kusiza ekwakheni umbono ophelele wezingozi ezibhekene nenhlangano. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlola Izingozi Ngemva kokuhlonza izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela ukuhlola ubungozi bazo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuchaza ukuthi ingozi ngayinye ingaba nomthelela omkhulu kangakanani, nokuthi ingase ibangele izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuhlola izingozi kudinga ukucabangela izici ezifana nobukhulu bengozi, ubungozi bokuphindaphinda, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela ezikhona. Lokhu kuhlola kusiza ekwakheni isithombe esicacile sokuthi izingozi zingaba namandla kangakanani ekuthuthukiseni noma ekuphazamiseni imisebenzi yenhlangano. Isigaba 3: Ukuphatha Izingozi Ngemuva kokuhlola izingozi, inhlangano kufanele ithathe izinyathelo zokuphatha lezi zingozi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela izinqubo zokuvikela, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphendula, noma ukunciphisa ubungozi. Izindlela ezivamile zokuphatha izingozi zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukugwema: Ukugwema izingozi ngokushintsha izinqubo noma imisebenzi engase ibangele ingozi. 2. Ukunciphisa: Ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuvikela ukuze kuncishiswe amathuba okuthi ingozi yenzeke. 3. Ukudlulisa: Ukudlulisa ingozi kwabanye, njengokusebenzisa umshwalense. 4. Ukubhekana: Ukuba nezinhlelo zokubhekana nayo uma ingozi ingagwenywa. Isigaba 4: Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Ukuphathwa kwezingozi akupheli ekuthatheni izinyathelo; kudinga ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuhlola. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphatha izingozi zisebenza kahle. Ukuqapha kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingozi ezitholakele zihlolwe njalo, futhi izinyathelo ezithathiwe zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Isigaba 5: Ukubambisana Nokuxhumana Ukuphathwa kwezingozi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zenhlangano. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, bonke abasebenzi kufanele baqonde izingozi ezibhekene nenhlangano, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo. Isigaba 6: Ukufunda Nokuthuthukisa Ekugcineni, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kudinga ukufunda okuqhubekayo. Njengoba izimo zomhlaba zishintsha, izingozi nazo zishintsha. Ukuze inhlangano iqhubeke nokuphumelela, kufanele ibheke izifundo ezitholakele ezivela ezinkingeni ezedlule. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathiwe zisebenze kanjani, nokuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Isiphetho Ukuphathwa kwezingozi (GEMS risk management) kubalulekile ukuze inhlangano ikwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuqonda, ukuhlola, nokuphatha izingozi, inhlangano ingathuthukisa ukusebenza kwayo, ivikele izinsiza zayo, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi izinjongo zayo zifezekiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zenhlangano ziqonde le nqubo, zisebenzisane, futhi zifunde ukuze ziqhubeke zikhula futhi zithuthuke.
Izidingo Zemibhalo Yabasebenzi Abasha: Ukuhlonipha Isiko Nezidingo Zamanje Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho izinguquko zenzeka ngokushesha, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqinisekisa izidingo ezithile zokubhaliswa kwabasebenzi abasha. Ngikubona lokhu njengomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezinsiza zabantu, futhi ngifisa ukwabelana ngombono wami mayelana nezidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, ukuhlela, kanye nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Abasebenzi abasha badinga ukufaka imibhalo ethile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila ngaphakathi kwemigomo nemibandela yeGEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala isithombe esicacile sokuthi ubani, yisiphi isimo sabo, nokuthi bangaba kanjani ingxenye yalesi simo esikhulu. Ngokwesibonelo, imibhalo efana nezitifiketi zokuqashwa, izincwadi zokuhlonza, kanye nezitifiketi zezemfundo kufanele zibe khona. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuhlonipha izinqubo, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabantu abasha emsebenzini. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zidingo zingase zibonakale njengokuphazamiseka, kodwa ziwusizo ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho bonke abantu behlonishwa futhi bejabuliswa. Uma izinqubo zikhona, izinkampani zikwazi ukuvikela izithombe zabo, ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqonda ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zingase zibe nzima kwabanye abantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Kunezimo lapho abantu bangase babe nezithiyo ezithile, njengokungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngale mibhalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zibe nesineke futhi ziqonde izimo zabo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuxhasa abasebenzi abasha ukuze bakwazi ukufaka le mibhalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Uma izinkampani ziqonda izidingo nezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abasha, zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobungane, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa futhi bahlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zifaneleka ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zihlala zikhona, kodwa futhi zihlala zikhanga kubantu abasha. Ekugcineni, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS, zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba izinkampani ziqonde izidingo zazo, zibe nesineke, futhi ziqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Njengomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezinsiza zabantu, ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyahlonishwa futhi uzwakala. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona, zikhanga, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza engcono, enobungane, futhi enempilo, lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa.
Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi (GEMS business use restrictions) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, noma i-General Enterprise Management System, iyinsiza ebhekene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukulawula izinqubo, kanye nokwenza kahle kwezohwebo. Isebenza njengepulatifomu yokwenza lula izinqubo zebhizinisi, iqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ye-GEMS ibandakanya izinqubo ezithile ezithinta indlela imikhiqizo nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungavunyelwa kokusebenzisa i-GEMS ngezinto ezingekho emthethweni, ukulawula ukusebenzisa amakhono anjalo emisebenzini eyingozi, kanye nokugwema izinqubo ezingahambisani nemigomo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Umbuzo 3: Kungani imikhawulo ibalulekile? Impendulo: Imikhawulo ibalulekile ngoba iqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lisebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuphatha izinsiza, ukunciphisa ubungozi, nokugcina ukuqina kwezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi liyakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinkinga ezingavela uma imikhawulo ingalandelwa? Impendulo: Uma imikhawulo ingalandelwa, ibhizinisi lingabhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu, okubandakanya ukujula kwemali, ukulahlekelwa yizinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni ibhizinisi liphumele ekutheni likhuphuke kancane, futhi kungashintsha isithombe salo emakethe. Umbuzo 5: Uphi umthombo wokwazi ngezikhawulelo? Impendulo: Umthombo wokwazi ngezikhawulelo ungatholakala kwi-website esemthethweni ye-GEMS, ezincwadini zokuphatha, noma ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha. Ukuze uqonde kahle imikhawulo, kubalulekile ukufunda nokuhlola lezi zinsiza. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona izinzuzo zokulandela imikhawulo? Impendulo: Impela! Ukulandela imikhawulo kuza nezinhlelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ubungozi, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokusebenza, nokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwezakhamuzi, abathengi, kanye nabanye ozakwethu. Lokhu kuthuthukisa isithombe sebhizinisi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi liyakwazi ukufinyelela izinjongo zalo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyicabangele uma uhlela ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle izidingo zomthetho kanye nezimfuneko ze-GEMS. Qiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenza ebhizinisini uyazi ngemikhawulo futhi unokuqonda okuhle kwezingozi ezihambisana nokungahambisani nemikhawulo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuvamile nokuhlinzweni kwezinsiza zidinga ukufakwa ezinhlelweni zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kunzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo? Impendulo: Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuhlelwa kahle, kanye nokugqugquzela izinguquko. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezinzima zokusebenza kungaba inselele, kodwa uma ibhizinisi linokuhleleka okuhle, kuzoba lula ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo. Umbuzo 9: Yini engaholela ekutheni izinkampani zingalandeli imikhawulo? Impendulo: Izinkampani zingase zingalandeli imikhawulo ngenxa yokungazi kahle, ukungabi nesineke, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuncintisana kungaholela ekwehlulekeni ukuhamba kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola nokulawula izinqubo zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 10: Kukhona yini iziphakamiso zokwandisa ukuqonda ngemikhawulo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Yebo, iziphakamiso zokwandisa ukuqonda zifaka phakathi ukuhlela izifundo, ukwenza izivivinyo zokusebenza, kanye nokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni ye-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zingaxhumana nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ukuze bathole izeluleko ezithile nezixazululo ezihambisana nemikhawulo. Ekugcineni, ukuqonda nokulandela imikhawulo ye-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze ibhizinisi likwazi ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa izingozi, nokwakha isithombe esihle emakethe. Kubalulekile ukufunda, ukuqonda, nokwakha inhlangano ekhuthaza ukusungulwa kwemikhawulo ethile ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi ezihambisana nokungalandelwa kwemigomo. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenza ebhizinisini abambe iqhaza ekwenzeni ukuthi imikhawulo ihlale ibhekwa futhi iyahlolwa njalo.
Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha: Ukubaluleka Kwezincwadi Zokuqala Zabasebenzi eGEMS Uma sihlangabezana nezinguquko eziningi emsebenzini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqizwa yinkampani njengeGEMS, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lezi zincwadi azikhiphi nje kuphela izincazelo zezinqubomgomo zenkampani, kodwa futhi zikhombisa umoya wokwamukela, oxhumene nemigomo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezakhamuzi zomsebenzi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi incwadi yokuqala yabasebenzi ibaluleke kanjani ekwakheni umuzwa wokwamukelwa. Lapho umnewa eqala emsebenzini, incwadi ethile iyasebenza njengophawu lokuqala lokuxhumana phakathi kwakhe nemisebenzi yenkampani. Iqukethe iziyalezo ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezibopho, amalungelo, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi inkampani ikholelwa ekubeni yindawo enobungane, lapho abasha bezothola ukwesekwa neziqondiso ezidingekayo ukuze baqale kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezici ezithuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izithombe, izithombe zenkampani, nemininingwane ethokozisayo ngaGEMS. Lokhu akukhulisi nje kuphela umoya wokubambisana, kodwa futhi kudala umbono omuhle ngesiko lenkampani. Ukubona izithombe zabasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zenkampani kuxhumanisa umnewa nomphakathi wendawo, kube sengathi uyangena emhlabeni omusha, ogcwele amathuba nokuphumelela. Ezinye izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha ziqinisekisa ukuthi umnewa unolwazi olunembile nolwakha isithombe esihle ngenhloso, izinqubomgomo zomsebenzi, nezimiso zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlinzeka abasha ngokuqonda okujulile ngesimo sokusebenza, okubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kahle emisebenzini yabo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezilula nezicacile kulezi zincwadi kuhloswe ukusiza wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani owenza isiqalo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zidinga ukuba zibe nezici ezithuthukisayo, njengezikhumbuzo ezibhalwe phansi nezincwadi zokuqonda ezitholakala ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kuzosiza umnewa ukuba akwazi ukubuyekeza imininingwane uma edinga. Ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakusebenza kuhlonipha isikhathi somsebenzi, futhi kubonisa ukuthi inkampani ibheka phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Noma kunjalo, akukhona kuphela ukujwayela izinqubomgomo nezinhlinzeko. Izincwadi zabasebenzi zidinga ukufaka umoya wokukhuthaza. Ukufaka izigaba ezikhethekile ezikhuthaza umnewa ukuba aziveze, ahlanganyele, futhi adlale indima ebalulekile emsebenzini kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Umsebenzi uwukwakha umphakathi, futhi lokho kudinga abantu abawaziyo ukudlala izindima zabo ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zingase zibe nezixhumanisi ezihlobene nezinqubo eziningi zomsebenzi, njengezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinhlelo zokubuyiselwa komsebenzi. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle kuzokwenza kube lula kumnewa ukufinyelela kulawa maphrojekthi, kuveza ukuthi inkampani ikhulisa ubuchwepheshe bayo ekuvuseleleni amandla abasebenzi bayo. Ngokuphetha, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha eGEMS zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Zihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nomoya wokwamukela, okuholela ekwakheni isiko elihle. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi ziqhubeke zithuthukiswa, zikhombise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi zihambisane nezidingo zabasebenzi abasha. Njengoba uhamba phambili emsebenzini, lezi zincwadi zingaba yinsika yokuxhasa, zikhuthaze, futhi zigqugquzele, ukuze umnewa akwazi ukuthola impumelelo. Isikhathi sokwaziswa, ukwamukelwa, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle kuqala ngezincwadi ezilungile. Lezi zincwadi zifaneleke kakhulu, futhi kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka zithuthukiswa ukuze zibe yinsika eqinile yokukhula kwabantu nabantu.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, indoda esebenza ngokuzikhandla, owathola incwadi ethokozisayo. Le ncwadi, eyayivela kuhulumeni, imtshela ukuthi usuku lokuthola impesheni yakhe selufikile. U-Mthembu, oneminyaka engama-60, ubengumsebenzi emnyangweni wezokwakha iminyaka engama-35, futhi umsebenzi wakhe wakha izakhiwo eziningi ezazisiza umphakathi. Nokho, wayenokukhathazeka. Wayazi ukuthi ukuze athole impesheni, kudingeka aqinisekise inombolo yakhe yempesheni, eyaziwa njenge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nqubo yayidinga ukunaka okukhulu, futhi wayengazi kahle ukuthi angayiqedela kanjani. Ngemuva kokucabanga, uMthembu wanquma ukuya ehhovisi le-GEMS elisedolobheni, enethemba lokuthola usizo. Ehhofisini, wabona abantu abaningi bekhuluma futhi bejabule, kodwa yena wayezizwa engakhululekile. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zinsuku zokuqala zokuphila ngaphandle komsebenzi, futhi wayezama ukujwayela. Kodwa, abaphathi behhovisi bamamukela ngenhlonipho, futhi uMnu. Khumalo, umphathi, wamtshela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kudinga izincwadi ezithile. U-Mthembu wathola ukuthi udinga ubufakazi bokusebenza, isithombe, kanye nenombolo yakhe yempesheni. Ngemuva kokuhamba phambili, wathola zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo. Wabuyela ehhovisi, lapho uMnu. Khumalo emphendula izicelo zakhe. “Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu,” kusho uMnu. Khumalo. “Sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yakho yempesheni. Lokhu kuzothatha izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa sizokuthumelela imiphumela.” U-Mthembu wathokoziswa, kodwa waba nokukhathazeka. “Ngabe ngizokwazi ukuthola impesheni yami?” wayecabanga. U-Mnu. Khumalo wamkhumbuza ukuthi le nqubo iyajwayelekile, futhi kufanele alinde. U-Mthembu wanquma ukuba nesineke, waphuma ehhovisi enethemba. Izinsuku zedlula, uMthembu wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela ku-GEMS. Wayezokwazi ukuthola impesheni yakhe! Wazizwa ejabule, kodwa waba nesithakazelo sokwazi ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni iqinisekisiwe kanjani. Wabuyela ehhovisi, lapho uMnu. Khumalo emtshela ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni ibhalwe kahle futhi iqinisekisiwe. “Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Khumalo,” kusho uMthembu, enomoya ophakeme. “Ngiyabonga ngokungisiza.” U-Mnu. Khumalo wamphendula, “Siyajabula ukusiza. Lokhu kuyinsiza kubantu abanjengawe.” U-Mthembu waphuma ehhovisi, enethemba elisha, futhi wafunda ukuthi impesheni yakhe izomnika ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono, nokuthi uzokwazi ukusiza umndeni wakhe. Waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMthembu wathola impesheni yakhe yokuqala, wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathokozisa umndeni wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. U-Mthembu waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zempesheni. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMthembu waba umholi emphakathini, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye abantu ababephakathi. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe izincwadi zabo kahle. Wazi ukuthi impesheni iyinsiza enkulu, futhi wayefuna ukuthi wonke umuntu akwazi ukuyithola. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMthembu waba nesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi waba nesifiso sokuthi bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono. Wazi ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kwakuyisinyathelo sokuqala, kodwa impilo engcono yayidinga ukuzinikela, uthando, nokubambisana. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo esihle emphakathini, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo. Wazi ukuthi impesheni yakhe yayiyinsiza, kodwa uthando nomphakathi kwakuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuphila. U-Mthembu waphila impilo egcwele, enethemba, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS. Njengoba sonke sazi, impilo yethu ibalulekile, futhi uma kudingeka ukuthi sithole ukwelashwa, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nalokho. Okokuqala, uma uhamba emtholampilo noma udinga ukwelashwa, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-GEMS medical aid. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba i-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze uthole ukwelashwa. Ngakho, uma ungakabi ne-GEMS, kungase kube kuhle ukuthi ucabangele ukufaka isicelo sokuba yilungu. Uma usunayo i-GEMS, okokuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi uthole ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udinga ukuthola imvume ngaphambi kokuthi uqale noma yisiphi isinyathelo sokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuvikela izindleko ezingalindelekile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngokujwayelekile, uma udinga ukwelashwa, kufanele uvakashele udokotela wakho. Udokotela uzokwenza ukuhlola, bese ethumela isicelo sokugunyazwa kokwelashwa. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisicelo sokuhlinzwa, ukwelashwa okuthile, noma imithi ethile. Udocotela uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi isicelo sakhe sihamba kahle, futhi sizokwenziwa ngokushesha. Ngemuva kokuthumela isicelo, i-GEMS izobheka imininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi ukwelashwa okuceliwe kuyadingeka yini, futhi ukuthi kudinga ukugunyazwa yini. Uma i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukwelashwa kuyadingeka, izokunikeza imvume. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nokwelashwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Kodwa-ke, uma i-GEMS ingavumi isicelo sokugunyazwa, ungathola ithuba lokuphikisa le miphumela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungabhalela i-GEMS, ubonise izizathu zokuthi kungani ucabanga ukuthi ukwelashwa kufanele kugunyazwe. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisinyathelo esinzima, kodwa kubalulekile ukulwela impilo yakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uqaphele izinsuku zokuphendula. I-GEMS inezinsuku ezithile ezibekwe ukuze iphendule izicelo. Uma ungatholi impendulo, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi isicelo sakho sikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awuphuthelwa yithuba lokuthola ukwelashwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma uthola imvume, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uqonda kahle izinqubo ezilandelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izindleko ezizokhokhwa yi-GEMS, nokuthi yini okufanele uyikhokhe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi awubhekani nezindleko ezingalindelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uthola ukwelashwa, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka izinga lokunakekelwa. I-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile zokuhlola izinga lokunakekelwa, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okuhle. Uma unganelisekile, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze ubike izinkinga zakho. Ekugcineni, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uqonda izinqubo, futhi ungathintana ne-GEMS uma unemibuzo. Impilo yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayithola imvume yokwelashwa okufanele. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokwenza kube lula kuwe uma udinga ukwelashwa. Khumbula, impilo yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uyilwele. Hamba kahle!
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ezweni elishintsha ngokushesha, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgibeli ophakeme emhlabeni wezebhizinisi. Kodwa-ke, uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhuba ibhizinisi, kubalulekile ukuqonda imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethile, njengezezimali, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Kulokhu, sizobheka imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi, okwaziwa nangokuthi yi-GEMS (General Enterprise Management System) business use restrictions. Ukwazi Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ihlose ukuvikela izinsiza, ukugcina ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi bazi kahle imithetho nemigomo ethile. Izinsiza Zokusebenza Izinsiza ezisetshenziswa emabhizinisini zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokusebenza, isoftware, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile mayelana nokuthi lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwesibonelo, isoftware ethile ingase ibe nemikhawulo yokuthi ingasetshenziswa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokusebenza ezithile, noma ingase ifune ukuthi kube nezeluleko ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza Ngokuhambisana Nezidingo Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele baqonde ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale behlola izidingo zabo zokuqhuba ibhizinisi futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza abazisebenzisayo zihambisana nalezi zidingo. Uma izinsiza zingasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengokuphazamiseka kokusebenza noma ukusilela ekwenzeni inzuzo. Ukulawulwa Kwezinsiza I-GEMS ikwenza kube lula ukulawula izinsiza. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ukungasebenzisi izinsiza ngendlela efanele kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele babe nezinhlelo zokulawula ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi. Imiphumela Yokwephula Imikhawulo Ukwephula imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi kungaholela eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinyathelo zokuphatha ezinzima, ezinjengokulahlekelwa kwezimali, ukulahlekelwa yithemba, noma ngisho nokubekwa enkantolo. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lihlala lisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale beqaphela izinqubomgomo ezithile ezibekiwe futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazazi lezi zinqubomgomo. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa iyahlonishwa, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezinsiza ezithile, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza. Ukuqeqeshwa okuphumelelayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi liphumelele. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lihlala lisebenza kahle, futhi abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele baqonde le mikhawulo ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukulawula izinsiza, nokuhlola izidingo, abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa iyahlonishwa, okuzoholela empumelelweni yebhizinisi.
Imithetho Nemigomo Yesikhwama Se-GEMS Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku zethu, isikhwama se-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) sithathwa njengomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi lesi sikhwama sakhula kanjani, kubalulekile ukubheka imithetho nemigomo yaso, okwakhiwa ngemuva kokuba kubonakale isidingo esikhulu sokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo abakhonza uhulumeni. Isikhwama se-GEMS saqala ukusebenza ngo-2006, sikhuluma ngempilo engcono nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze sithole lezi zinsiza, kwadingeka ukuthi kube nemithetho nemigomo ecacile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayazi kahle ukuthi angawathola kanjani amalungelo awo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile, eyayihloselwe ukusiza amalungu akhulise ulwazi lwawo ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Imithetho yokuqala ye-GEMS yayihlanganisa izinqubo ezithile ezazisetshenziswa ukujolisa ekwenzeni kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kwahlanganisa izinqubo zokubhalisela ukujoyina isikhwama, izidingo zokuba yilungu, nezindlela zokukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yayihlanganisa nezindlela zokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza ezisemthethweni nezifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa imithetho yayo ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezithile, ezifana nokwandisa uhla lwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngama-claims, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe phakathi kwamalungu ne-GEMS. Lezi zinguquko zazihloselwe ukwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwenqubo yokuthola usizo lwezempilo, okwakubalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa imithetho yayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza eziphumelelayo nezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo zihlola izindinganiso eziphakeme, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kwasiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwenhlangano neziguli. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni, i-GEMS ibuye yathuthukisa izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukufundisa amalungu mayelana nezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene, njengezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ukuvikela izifo, kanye nokubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zazihloselwe ukukhuthaza amalungu ukuba abe nemikhuba emihle yokuphila, ukuze bahlale bephilile. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, i-GEMS yakhulisa izinhlelo zayo zokuxhumana, ukuze amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela kalula emalini yazo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkundla ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela amalungu ukuthi athole ulwazi lwezempilo, abhalisele izinsizakalo, futhi axhumane ne-GEMS kalula. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza, i-GEMS yenza izinhlelo ezihloselwe abantu abanezidingo ezikhethekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho muntu oshiywe ngaphandle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yaphinde yaphendula ezimweni ezithile ezibuhlungu, njengezinhlekelele ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemithetho emisha yokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola usizo lwezempilo ngokushesha. I-GEMS yaziqhenya ngokuba yisikhwama esiphendulayo, esithatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza ezisemthethweni nezifanele. Le mithetho ibalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS namalungu ayo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Njengoba i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi imithetho nemigomo yayo ihlale ivuselelwa ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, isikhwama se-GEMS sithokozisa kakhulu, sikhombisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo akusizi kuphela abantu, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Imithetho nemigomo yaso ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemthethweni, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nesifiso sokwakha ikusasa elingcono kubantu bonke.
Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elincane, lapho abantu behlale bejabulile futhi bephila impilo ejabulisayo, kwakukhona isikhungo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo esaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS. Lesi sikhungo sathandwa kakhulu ngababhalisile, ngoba sasinikeza ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Abantu abavakashela i-GEMS babebona ukuthi izidingo zabo zihlala zikhuliswa, futhi lokhu kwakubavusa ithemba. Uthando lokunakekela abantu belwakhiwa ngothando lukaDkt. Mthembu, ongumholi wesikhungo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayenobuchwepheshe obukhulu kwezempilo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, wayenothando olukhulu lokunakekela abantu. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo akukhona nje ukwelapha izifo, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababhalisile nabahlengikazi. Ngelinye ilanga, uDkt. Mthembu wathola umyalezo ovela kumphakathi, owawukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu babengajabuli ngempela ngezinqubo ezithile ezikhona e-GEMS. Lokhu kwenza uDkt. Mthembu wacabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nabasebenzi besikhungo, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. “Ngiyazi ukuthi sikhona isikhungo esihle, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube ngcono,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu. “Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlala bejabule futhi bezizwa bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe yisikhungo esihloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Abasebenzi bavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubo ezithile zokuphendula izikhalazo zabantu. Baphinde bahlanganyele iziphakamiso ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekelwa. Kwakukhona umqondo wokwakha uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, olwakha izinyathelo ezithile zokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uDkt. Mthembu wathumela izincwadi ezithile kubabhalisile, echaza izinguquko ezizayo. Wabavuma ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni izinqubo ezintsha, futhi wababiza ukuba baveze imicabango yabo. Lokhu kwenza abantu bazizwe bebamba iqhaza, futhi kwaba nomthelela omuhle emoyeni wesikhungo. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lwe-GEMS quality care assurance lwaqala ukuvela. Abasebenzi baqala ukuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, behlola ukuthi zifinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlelo lwakha izigaba ezahlukene zokuhlola, kuhlanganiswe nezibuyekezo ezivela kubabhalisile. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo, futhi kube nendlela yokuthola izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uDkt. Mthembu waphinde waqala umkhankaso wokuhlonipha imiphumela yokusebenza. Abasebenzi bahlala bejolisa ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokusebenza zihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni isimo sokubambisana phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nababhalisile. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu. Abantu babejabulile futhi bezizwa bephumelele. Isikhungo sakhula, futhi izinsizakalo zakhula zaba ziningi. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayehlale ebakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima, futhi baphinde bahlale bephokophele ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinhle. Ekugcineni, i-GEMS yaphumelela ekwakheni isithombe esihle emphakathini. Ababhalisile babebona ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uDkt. Mthembu waphinde wakhumbula ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu akupheli. Kuhlala kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinguquko, futhi kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwabahlengikazi nababhalisile. Wazi ukuthi i-GEMS izoba yisikhungo esihloniphekile, uma bonke abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye. Ngakho, uDkt. Mthembu wagcina ethi, “Ukwenza kahle akupheli. Sidinga ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza i-GEMS ibe yisikhungo esingcono, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Futhi, ngaleso sikhathi, i-GEMS yahlala ibalulekile empilweni yabantu, yaziwa njengendawo yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okukhuthazayo, futhi izinga lokunakekelwa layo laqhubeka nokukhula.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile, emzaneni omncane ohlangothini lwezintaba, kwaba khona umfana ogama lakhe linguSimphiwe. USimphiwe wayenempilo enhle, kodwa, njengabanye abaningi, wayeseyindoda ewukhezi. Waqhubeka ebamba izifundo zakhe esikoleni, kodwa yayikhona into eyayimjolise kakhulu – ukufuna ukwazi ngokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo, ikakhulukazi i-GEMS, zingenza kanjani umehluko empilweni yakhe nasemndenini wakhe. Ngakhoke, uSimphiwe waqala ukufuna ulwazi ngezinsizakalo i-GEMS ezihlinzekayo. Wafunda ukuthi i-GEMS, okuyinsiza yokwelashwa kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile ezinjengokwelashwa, izidakamizwa, nemishini yokwelapha. Wazi kahle ukuthi, uma efuna ukufinyelela kulezi zinsizakalo, kufanele aqonde ukuthi uhlobo luni lwezinzuzo angezwa. Ngemuva kosuku olukhulu esikoleni, uSimphiwe wahlala phansi nenhliziyo yakhe igcwele ithemba. Wayecabanga ngalokhu: “Kufanele ngiqonde ukuthi ngafaneleka kanjani ukuze ngithole lezi zinzuzo.” Waphuma endlini, wathola umngane wakhe, uThandiwe, oyedwa owayene-GEMS. UThandiwe wayenolwazi olukhulu ngale nsizakalo, futhi uSimphiwe wamkhumbuza ukuthi kuhle ukufunda kulabo abavela endaweni eyinhloko. “UThandiwe,” eshaya itheku, “ungangikhombisa ukuthi ngingabhalisela i-GEMS kanjani? Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo okufanele ngizithathe?” UThandiwe wahleka, ebona ukuthi uSimphiwe ufisa ukufunda. “Yebo, kuba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele ubone ukuthi ungekho yini owomphakathi, ngoba i-GEMS yenzelwe abantu abavuyelela izidingo ezithile. Kufanele udinge ukufakazela ukuthi uyiNhloko yomndeni, noma Umsebenzi Osemthethweni, ngoba lezi zinto zibalulekile ekunqumeni ukufaneleka kwakho,” kusho uThandiwe. Ngemuva kokukhuluma noThandiwe, uSimphiwe wathola ukuthi kumqoka kakhulu ukuba nesikhathi sokuhlola imiyalelo nezithako ezisemthethweni. Waqhubeka nokucwaninga, wafunda ngalesi sikhathi sokufaneleka. Wazitholela ukuthi izinto ezinjengokuphila impilo enempilo, izinga lemali engenayo, kanye nezidingo zomndeni wakhe, zonke zikhona. “Ngeke ngithokoze kuphela ukusho ukuthi ngifuna i-GEMS,” echaza. “Kufanele ngifake isicelo ngokusemthethweni bese ngikela izincwadi ezikhombisayo ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngingakaziswa.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uSimphiwe walungisa zonke izincwadi ezazidingeka. Wahlela umsebenzi, wathola ubufakazi bokuthi ukhokhela umndeni, kwaye wahamba uyofaka isicelo se-GEMS. Usuku lokuhlola lwasondela, watusa lapho. Ukuhamba ngamasango amakhulu, imizwa yakhe yayiphezulu. Uhlangane nezinye izihlobo, othandweni, bejabulile ngokubona umphakathi udlalela izinsiza ezinhle. Ngemva kokuhamba bucayi, uSimphiwe waqinisekisa ukuthi ubheke kahle izimpendulo. Kwaphela izinsuku ezingu-7, kwavela impendulo eyayilindelwe, ewumthwalo omkhulu. “Ngiyanqoba!” kusho uSimphiwe, ethi umoya wakhe usufanelwe. UThandiwe, edlulisa izindaba ezinhle, wahle yaphakamisa. “Ngiyavuma, uSimphiwe! Ukwenzile konke! Ngabe uthole ukuze uqhubeke?” USimphiwe wayedidekile, kodwa ethokozile, owazi kahle ukuthi lokhu kusho izinsiza ezinzima ukuze aphilise kangcono. “Ngiyabonga, uThandiwe. Lokhu kuzongisiza nempilo yami. Ngifisa ukuqhubeka ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo.” Waqhubeka nemizamo yokuhlola izinsiza, ezinjengokubhaliswa kwezinhlelo zokwelapha, ukuthola izidakamizwa, nezinye izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Wayenamathuba amaningi, futhi waba nesibopho ekuphatheni izikhathi ezinzima. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila nempilo emangalisayo lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokufuna ukwazi, futhi uGEMS waba ngempela yinsiza ebabalekayo emndenini wakhe. Ngempela, le ndaba yempilo kaSimphiwe ibonisa ukuthi ukuzinikezela, ukufunda, nokubambisana nabanye kungasiza ukuya phambili. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila kube kwelanga eliqhakazile, futhi kwawuqinisa umoya wakhe lapho efuna izinsiza ezingenza umehluko empilweni yakhe nakwabanye. Ngaphandle kwabantu abanjengoThandiwe, uSimphiwe uphuma kwamanye amahlangano ukuze abambisane nemiphakathi eminingi. Eziwubala zaba yizinsiza eziningi zempilo, zikhona, zikhona zikhona! UChilo, uMnisi, noMakhosi bamkhumbuza inqubekela phambili, kusho ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthukisa impilo yabo sonke uma bexhumana. Ekugcineni, uSimphiwe wabona ukuthi i-GEMS yayiyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa lokhu kuthola inkonzo bekwakhombisa ukuthi umsebenzi wako ungaphezu kokuthola izinzuzo. Waqonda ukuthi phakathi kokukhula, ufisa ukusiza abanye baphinde baxhumane, ngenxa yokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe. Ngakho, uSimphiwe waba umholi emphakathini, ehlanganisa abantu, evuselela nokuqinisa umqondo wokusebenzelana nomunye. Futhi ke, izinsuku zaqhubeka, uSimphiwe wahamba phambili. Kwaqhubeka ukukhula, kubonisa indlela yokuphila engena esweni lomphakathi, yabelana ngempilo enganqamuki. Waqhubeka nomgomo wakhe wesikhathi eside, ukuqinisekisa nokwenza izuhu empilweni yesisu ehlotshaniswa nemiphakathi. Ngale ndlela, indaba kaSimphiwe yathi igcwele impumelelo, yakhombisa umhlaba ukuthi izinsiza zinganqotshwa, kodwa uthando, ukusizana, nokuqonda, kuna izinzuzo eziphezulu ezithinta izimpilo zethu. Kwaye kwaba khona ithemba, nezindlela ezintsha zokukhuluma ngezinsiza, okukhule laidwaba basebenzisa. Futhi lokho, sekuyindaba yempilo kaSimphiwe, okuyinto ewubala, idolobha elincane lekwaGEMS. Yaqhubeka iphonsa izaba, igcwalisa imizwa, nokuqhubeka nezinzuzo ezintsha. Uma uSimphiwe ephehla, uzakuqonda ukuthi izinsiza ezinikezwayo zingaba nemiphumela emihle, iqhula izimpilo zabantu, futhi inikeza umphakathi ithuba lokukhula.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Sanibonani nonke! Namuhla ngizokhuluma ngenhloso ethile, okuyi-GEMS, okuyinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abaningi. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS imele ini? I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinsiza yokwelashwa eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulabo abathanda ukwazi, i-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi ezihlukahlukene ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kodwa okukhuluma kakhulu lapha yiminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu. Uma sikhuluma ngemali yokungena, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zihlala zikhona. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zidingeka ukuze kube nokwaneliseka kwezinsizakalo? Kulungile, ngizokuchazela. Umuntu obulunga kwi-GEMS udinga ukukhokha imali ethile njalo, ukuze abe nezinzuzo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ngaphandle kwemali yokungena, i-GEMS ingakwazi kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle? Ngicabanga ukuthi kulungile ukucacisa ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zihluke kakhulu kuye ngohlobo lobulungu. Kukhona lezi ezibizwa ngokuthi "izinkokhelo zenyanga" ezikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga, kanye nezinye ezibizwa ngokuthi "izinkokhelo zonyaka." Lezi zinkokhelo zikhokhwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umbulali uzothola ukwelashwa okudingayo. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi uma ungakhokhi, ungase ungabi nezinzuzo ezithile? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukugcina umthetho. Ngokuphathelene nezinkokhelo, i-GEMS inezindlela ezahlukene zokukhokha. Ungakhetha ukukhokha nge-inthanethi, ngeposi, noma ngokuqhafaza emnyangweni. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavame ukuba nezinkinga zokuhamba. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezithile ezikhethekile zokukhokha? Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakakwazi ukukhokha yonke imali ngesikhathi, ungase ube nezinketho ezithile zokuhlela ukukhokha. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuba nezinzuzo eziningi? Ngaphezu kokwelashwa okujwayelekile, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinsizakalo zezempilo, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwezingane. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi badinga izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezimo ezithile ezithinta iminikelo nezinkokhelo. Kukhona izimo lapho umbulali angase abe nezinselelo zokukhokha, futhi i-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuthi inezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abanjalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakwazi ukukhokha, ungathola usizo ukuze uqhubeke uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhokhe? Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinzuzo ezengeziwe kubantu abakhokha ngokushesha, noma abakhokha izinkokhelo zonyaka. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle futhi bakhokhe ngesikhathi. Ngokuphathelene nezinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo zokukhokha, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila kahle. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinsizakalo ezithokozisayo ezithinta iminikelo nezinkokhelo? Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhlola, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwezingane. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi badinga izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Ngokuphetha, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abaningi, futhi iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nsiza iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukubaluleka kokukhokha, ukuze siqhubeke sithola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto ezikhuluma ngazo zizokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuqonda i-GEMS nokubaluleka kwemali yokungena.
Ubumfihlo Nokuvikelwa Kolwazi lwe-GEMS Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi sekuba yizinto ezibalulekile kakhulu. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, okuyinsiza yokunakekela impilo ehloswe ngokuqinile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngemininingwane ethinta abantu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuvikelwa okukhulu. Ubumfihlo bukhona ezindabeni eziningi, kodwa uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nsiza ibhekene nemininingwane eyimfihlo kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane yokwelashwa, izimo zezempilo, kanye nemininingwane yomuntu siqu. Ngakho-ke, ukuvikela le mininingwane akusikho kuphela isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu abathola izinsiza zayo. Ngokubheka izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS, kubonakala ukuthi le nsiza ibeka phambili ukuvikelwa kolwazi. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela imininingwane, kanye nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha ulwazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayitholakali kalula, futhi ivikelwe ezinsongweni eziningi ezikhona emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu abaphatha le mininingwane badinga ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwayo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyingxenye yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuziphatha okuhle, ukucophelela, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kumele iqhubeke nokuxhumana nabantu, ibanikeze ulwazi olucacile nolunembile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela imininingwane yabo. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukwethembana, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Izinsongo ezivela kwi-cybercrime zikhula, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke ibuyekeza izinqubomgomo zayo zokuvikela imininingwane. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zihlala zisebenza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuvikela imininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS kumele ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-blockchain, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane ayishintshiwe futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abangenamvume ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi baphila emhlabeni lapho ubumfihlo bukhulu. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwe-GEMS akusikho nje isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ukuze le nsiza iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi akusikho nje okubalulekile, kodwa kuyisidingo esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokwethembana, nolwazi.
