I-GEMS, njengensiza yokunakekela impilo, kufanele iqhubeke nokubeka phambili lezi zinto, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle, futhi bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile.
Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kudlulelwe phambili eminyakeni edlule, sihamba phambili ekwakheni ezempilo eziphumelelayo, kodwa lokhu kuza nemiphumela eminingi, ikakhulu uma kuziwa ekuvikeleni kolwazi lwezempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukubheka i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nendlela yokuphatha ulwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luyigugu elikhulu, oluhlanganisa nemininingwane eyimfihlo, efana nezimo zokuphila, izifo, nezokwelashwa. Ukuvikela lokhu kulwazi kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokwesaba izinkinga zokuphepha. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-GEMS kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ulwazi, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi, ukuze kuphela abantu abafanele banokufinyelela. Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovikela iziguli emaphutheni, kuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kokwephulwa kolwazi. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwe-GEMS, izibhedlela, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kudinga izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuvikela ulwazi, kubandakanya ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha, kanye nokuhlola njalo izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa lihlanzekile futhi lwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sihlole umthelela wobuchwepheshe obuphambili ekuphathweni kolwazi lwezempilo. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela ulwazi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, ezifana nezokwelapha, kufanele zibe nezindlela ezivikelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ngokuphepha, ukuze kungabi neziphakamiso ezingafanele. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke izimo zomphakathi ezisebenzayo, njengoba iziguli zidinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi ulwazi lwazo lungavikelekile. Ukuqinisekisa lokhu, izikhangiso ezicacile nezihambisanayo kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kudaleke ukuqonda phakathi kweziguli, futhi kube nezindlela zokuxhumana ezichazayo. Ngakho, izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo akufanele zibe zinsuku nje kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yinkqubo eqhubekayo. I-GEMS kumele ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, imithetho, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luphumelelisa izidingo zabantu, luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphephile. Ekugcineni, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS akukhona nje ukulandela imithetho, kodwa kuyisivumelwano esidinga ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani obuphambili, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nezinsizakalo ezisebenza kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa luhlala luphephile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokholo, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukuzethemba kwabantu kwi-GEMS, okuvumela abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, engcono. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke ukuthi ikuphi lapho kudinga ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, iqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luphila ngaphansi kwemigomo eqinile yokuvikela. Umphakathi wethu uyafuna lokho, futhi kufanele sizame konke okusemandleni ethu ukuvikela leli nani eliyigugu.
Ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo (GEMS statistical data handling) Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS (Global Education Monitoring System). Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa nomnu. Mthethwa, ongumqondisi wezibalo eGEMS, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe ngale ndaba. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: Mthethwa, ungachaza kanjani umsebenzi wakho eGEMS? Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga ngokungibiza. Njengomqondisi wezibalo, umsebenzi wami uwukuphatha, ukuhlaziya, nokuhlinzeka ngedatha yezibalo ethinta imfundo emhlabeni jikelele. Sisebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala, iyasebenza, futhi iyathuthukiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuyihlela, nokuyihlaziya ukuze sithole izindlela zokwenza ngcono imfundo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene neGEMS ekuphathweni kwedatha? Mthethwa: Kunezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuqoqa idatha ezindaweni ezahlukene kungaba nzima. Kunezimo ezihlukene zomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezamasiko ezithinta indlela idatha eqoqwa ngayo. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngedatha enembile kuyinselelo. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi idatha esiyitholayo iyakhombisa iqiniso lemfundo kulezo zindawo. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinsiza ezanele. Umbuzo 3: Uthini umbono wakho ngokuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni kwedatha? Mthethwa: Ngiyavuma ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphendule indlela esiphatha ngayo idatha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokuhlaziya, kanye nezinsiza zokugcina idatha zenza kube lula ukuqoqa, ukuhlela, nokuhlaziya idatha. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokuthola imiphumela esheshayo, okwenza kube lula ukusiza izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta imfundo. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani iGEMS ibambisana nezinye izinhlangano ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwedatha? Mthethwa: Sisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano eziningi, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo. Lezi zixhumanisi zisiza ekutholeni idatha enembile, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yethu iyasetshenziswa. Ngokubambisana, sithola izinsiza eziningi, futhi sabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Umbuzo 5: Uthini umphumela wokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo emfundweni? Mthethwa: Ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo kunomthelela omkhulu emfundweni. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokuhlola ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala yini, iyasebenza, futhi iyathuthukiswa. Ngale ndlela, sikwazi ukubona izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi sithole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iyavikeleka? Mthethwa: Ukuze siqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwedatha, sithatha izinyathelo eziningi. Sisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha eziphambili, futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela abantu abanegunya abakwazi ukufinyelela idatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi bethu ukuze baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kwedatha. Umbuzo 7: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo? Mthethwa: Ngibona ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha nokuhlaziya idatha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela esheshayo, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta imfundo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, okuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo emhlabeni jikelele. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Njengoba sithole imiqondo ehlukahlukene emqondweni kaMthethwa, sithola ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukayo kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha le datha. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Sifisa iGEMS nethimba layo konke okuhle emizamweni yabo yokuphatha idatha yezibalo.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezenzo Zesisebenzi Sikahulumeni: I-GEMS Isixazululo Esibalulekile Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ngeshesha, izinqubo ezivamile zidinga ukuhamba nalesi sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kuyinto ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nhlangano idlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni kube lula ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathole izinsizakalo zezempilo eziphakeme, kodwa lokho kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kwempumelelo nasemsebenzini. Ukuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ukuze kugcinwe ubufakazi bokusebenza, kodwa futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bayakwazi ukujabulela izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwesitoreji, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nomqondo ophusile wokuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ziqinisekisa ukukhula nokuphila kahle kwalezi zisebenzi. Ukusiza abasebenzi ukwazi ukuthi bahlala bexhaswa, kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Ngokwe-GEMS, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi kukhombisa ubulungiswa bokusiza abasebenzi, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela labo abasebenza emsebenzini kahulumeni abangathola lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kudala isimo sokwethembana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi, ngoba abasebenzi bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo abasithandayo zikhona futhi zikhona ngezinqubomgomo ezicacile. Lokhu akugcini nje ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, kodwa futhi kusekela umqondo wokusebenza ngempumelelo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinhlinzeko azibheki kuphela izidingo zabasebenzi; zihlola futhi izidingo zempumelelo kahulumeni. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi izinsizakalo abazitholayo ziqinisekisiwe futhi zisebenza kahle, bazoba nethemba lokuthi imizamo yabo izogqamisa izinzuzo emsebenzini. Lokhu kudala umoya wokugqugquzela, okuthuthukisa umkhiqizo kanye nenhlonipho emsebenzini. Noma kunjalo, kunobunzima obuthile obungavela lapho sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo. Izinkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zazo zisebenza kahle, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile, ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, kanye nezinsiza ezanele zokubheka izimo. Uma lezi zinto zingaqinisekisiwe, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini nasempilweni yabasebenzi. Okokugcina, kuhle ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni akukhona nje uhlelo lokuphatha. Kunomqondo omkhulu wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abasebenzi bekhululekile futhi bejabulile. I-GEMS iyisixazululo esibalulekile, kodwa kudinga ukujula kokuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo kumele zisebenze ngendlela eguquguqukayo, ukuze zihlale zithuthukisa isimo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngakho, uma sicabanga nge-GEMS kanye nokuhlolwa kwesimo sesisebenzi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kuyinto ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elihle, hhayi kuphela kubasebenzi, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. I-GEMS akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi ibiza ukwakha ithemba, ukugcwalisa izifiso, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi kanye nohulumeni, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle, obumbene, nonempilo. Ngalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kufanele kube yinto esiyibheka ngeso elibukhali, ukuze sigcine izinsizakalo zezempilo zisebenza ngokufanele, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulezi zikhathi ezishintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinqubo zethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke, futhi sibe nempilo engcono.
ISIMEMEZELO SOKUNEMBA KWEFOMU LELUNGU (GEMS MEMBER FORM ACCURACY DECLARATION) Isingeniso Ngokuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yeGems (Government Employment Medical Scheme), sihlela ukusiza bonke ababambiqhaza beGEMS ukuthi baqonde ukubaluleka kokunemba kwefomu lelungu abawafaka ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa. Le ndaba ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba imiphumela yokungahambisani nemininingwane ingaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi emithini yokwelashwa nokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukubaluleka Kokunemba Kwefomu Ukunemba kwefomu lelungu kubalulekile ngoba kuvumela iGEMS ukuba ikwazi ukugcina imininingwane efanele yamalungu ayo. Lokhu kuphumelela kuphela uma amalungu eGEMS efaka imininingwane eqondile, efana nezinsuku zokuzalwa, amalungelo abelungu, nezindawo zokuhlala. Ukuhlola le mininingwane kuyinsakavukela, ngoba ukungahambisani kungaholela ekudluliseleni okulungile nokwehluleka kokuthola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokunemba Ezinyangeni ezedlule, iGEMS ibone izinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nokungahambisani kwemfuno kanye nemininingwane edingekayo kumafomu ezicelo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka lapho amalungu engahambisani nokwaziswa okukhona ezithombeni zabo, noma lapho bephikisana nemininingwane yokuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga, lezi zilandelayo izinyathelo ezithathwayo: 1. Ukucaciswa Kwemininingwane: Amalungu agcizelelwa ukuthi aqinisekise imininingwane yabo ngaphambi kokufaka ifomu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amagama abhalwe kahle, izinsuku zokuzalwa, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. 2. Ukuqinisekisa Izithombe: Kulapho kudingeka khona izithombe ezibhaliwe kumafomu, kudingeka ukuthi lezi zikhumbuze amaphuzu afana nokukhanya, ukusikeka kanye nemibono ephuma ohlwini lwamalungu. 3. Ishadi Lokuhlola: Umgomo wokuqinisekisa imininingwane uyathuthukiswa ngezinyathelo zokuhlola ezitholakala kumafomu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela itholakala kahle nangempumelelo. Izizathu Zokungaqondi Kwemininingwane Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokungaqondi kahle kwemfuno kungenzeka ngenxa yokuhluleka ukwenza izichibiyelo ezidingekayo. Amanye amalungu akholelwa ukuthi uma bebonisa imininingwane ethile, kuzoholela emiphumeleni emibi. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi, ngakho kufanele sibe nezinqubo ezithile ezizogqugquzela ukwaziswa okukhulu. Umsebenzi Wokubambisana I-GEMS ibona ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwamalungu, ezempilo, nezikhungo zezokwelapha. Kumele sithole izinsizakusebenza eziyimfihlo ezivumela amalungu ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi izinketho zabo zokwelashwa zinhlelekile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni komsebenzi wethu. Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqonda nokubambisana, iGEMS izosungula izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezingasiza amalungu ethu. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa: - Izifundo Zokuqwashisa: Ukuze kuxoxwe ngemigomo nemibandela yeGEMS, kuzobanjwa izifundo ezithuthukiswe ukuze amalungu aqonde. - Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana: Ukuthi amalungu abe nendlela yokuthola usizo olukhona uma besebenzisa izinsiza, kumele kube nesixhumanisi esesimweni esiphelele. Isiphetho Ukucacisa nokuhlola kunemba kwefomu lelungu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kweGEMS. Amalungu kumele aqhubeke nokubambisana, akhumbule ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kuzobasiza ngesimo abagqokile lapho becela usizo lwezempilo. Ngalesi simemezelo, sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umbono wesimo salabo abahlala ngaphansi kweGEMS uvumelana nemigomo nemibandela yokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, sizoba nodumo lokuphumelela ekuthuthukiseni imininingwane efanele, okuzoholela empumelelweni enkulu yokuphila kwabantu abavuma ukuthola izinsizakusebenza ezikhona. Siyabonga.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezinkokhelo (GEMS Payment Verification) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinkokhelo zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezimeni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezimali okuqondile kuzo zonke izigaba zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bathole ukufinyelela okulinganayo ezinsizeni zempilo. Kulokhu, ngifuna ukugxila ekubalulekeni kokuhlola nokuqinisekisa izinkokhelo ze-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nemiphumela engase ibangele uma lezi zinkokhelo zingaqinisekiswa kahle. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo, ikakhulukazi ezinsizeni zempilo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona kulabo abazidingayo. I-GEMS iyinhlangano enikeza ukufinyelela kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakamasipala, kodwa uma izinkokhelo zayo zingaqinisekiswa kahle, umphakathi ubhekana nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukungaqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kungaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, kulezi zikhathi zokuqinisekisa, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkokhelo eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze wonke umphakathi uthole izinsiza ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Ukuqinisekisa izinkokhelo kuhilela izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona futhi zenziwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwedatha yemali, ukuqinisekisa ama-akhawunti, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezikhona. Uma lezi zinyathelo zingagcinwanga, umphakathi ungase ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezindleko eziphezulu zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izinkinga zokufinyelela, kanye nokuncipha kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuhlola nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhona futhi zenza umsebenzi wazo kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okubandakanya i-GEMS, osomabhizinisi, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo olufanele. Noma ngabe umuntu uthola insiza yezempilo, ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube khona ukuze kucaciswe izinto ezifanele ukuhlinzekwa. Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zokuhlola izinkokhelo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zikhona ngesikhathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhona phakathi kwezinsuku ezithile kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga uhlelo oluqinile lokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo, oluhlanganisa ukuzinza kwedatha, ukuqonda kwezinselelo zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezisebenzayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka nokuhlola izinkokhelo akuphephile; kudinga izinsiza, isikhathi, kanye nokuzikhandla. Ukuze kube nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, izikhungo ezinjenge-GEMS kumele zifune izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kusebenze ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ezidingweni zempilo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube nezinsiza ezanele, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nohlelo olwakhiwe kahle lokuphathwa kwemali. Ngokuqhubekayo, kumele sithumele imiyalezo eqinile emphakathini mayelana nezinsiza zempilo ezifanele, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kuzodala ukwazi kwempilo, lapho abantu bazi nobuchwepheshe bezempilo obukhona, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani izinkokhelo ze-GEMS. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kufanele kube yinsika yempumelelo ekuphathweni kwezinkokhelo. Uma abantu beqonda ngokuphelele izinqubo, bazokwazi ukuthola izinsiza zempilo ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo ze-GEMS kudinga izinyathelo ezicacile, ukuzinza, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuhlinzekwe izinsiza zempilo ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuqonda okuphezulu kwezinsiza, kanye nokubaluleka kokufinyelela kwezempilo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, akusikho ukuthi izinkokhelo kuphela ezibalulekile, kodwa nokuthi lezi zinkokhelo zibe lula, zisebenze kahle, futhi zifike kubantu abadingayo. Ngaleso sizathu, kumele sikhuthaze izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, sithuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi sigcine umgomo wokuthuthukisa izinsiza zempilo kubantu bonke. Lokhu kuzoletha impumelelo enkulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikahle, eziphusile, nezifanele.
Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ezimfundisweni zansuku zonke, umqondo wokunakekelwa kwesimo seGEMS ubonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokunikeza izinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izinkomba ezichaza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinhlelo, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuchopho, kanye nomoya wokuhlonipha, zenza kube lula ukufezekisa izinjongo ezisemqoka zokunikeza ukunakekelwa okuhle. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhloselwe ukuqinisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okucatshangwa njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokwandisa ukwethembeka nezinselelo ezivela emiphakathini emikhulu. Ngokuhlanganyela, inhlangano enza umgomo wokukhalipha ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bonke bathola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyiqiniso. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi, odokotela, nabanye abanakekeli, bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze babhekelele ukuhlonipha izidingo zabantu. Ngokunyuka kwebhizinisi lezempilo, izinsizakalo ziqhubeka nokukhula kakhulu. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezimo zokukhokha ezibucayi, okwenza kube nzima ukunikeza umkhiqizo uphumelele emqondweni wokunakekela. Kulokhu, uhlelo lweGEMS lubonisa ubuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza, kudalwa amathuba okukhuthaza, okwandisa ukuzinza nokumelana nezimo ezintsha. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhlinzeka ngaphezu kokunakekelwa. Luzama ukuhlanganisa izici ezahlukene zempilo - kumalungelo abantu, izicelo zempilo, kanye nezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe. Uhlelo luphinde lwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuhlola indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuqonda ukuthi iziyalezo kanye nezinsiza zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukufunda nokwenza izinto ngendlela efanele kuyahlobana. Uhlelo lweGEMS lwakha indlela esebenzayo yokwazisa isehlakalo sokunakekelwa, kulungiselelwa izindlela ezithile zokusebenza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubheka indlela yokubhalisela izingane, ukufaka umkhandlu wezinyathelo ezinhle, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izinqubo zokunakekela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lweGEMS lwenziwa luhlale lujwayelekile ukunjalo, luhloselwe ukwakha isixazululo esiqhubekayo sokusebenza kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukwenza izinto ngendlela efanele kuholela ekutheni uhlelo lutuze, olufanelwe ukwenziwa kahle, lwenze kube lula kubantu ukunikela ngesizakalo esikalwe kakhulu. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka ukwenza izifundo ezihlukile ukuze kuhlonishwe izidingo nemithetho yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuhlola izinqubo ezithile zokunakekela kuzokhulisa umoya wokuzimisela nokwazisa imikhuba emihle. Lokhu, ngesikhathi esifanayo, kwandise ithuba lokugeleza okuhle nokwandisa ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abakhuluma ngempilo. Ngesikhathi inhlangano ibheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa, ubuchwepheshe bokuhumusha imithombo yezokuxhumana kudinga ukusebenzisa amakhosombe nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzodala ithuba lokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abasha nabadala, okwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhamba phambili, okuhloswe kumqondo wokubambisana. Lawo maholoholo ezinsizakalo azokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinhlelo zokunakekela ezithuthukisiwe. Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lweGEMS luthinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kutholakala kuphela ngenkathi izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa zithuthuka ziqinisekiswa. Abantu badinga ukuhlonishwa ngosuku nosuku ngokuphila kwabo, ukuze kube nekhwalithi ekahle yokunakekelwa. Lokhu kuyazisa, futhi kumele kube umgomo wazo zonke izinsizakalo ezihlangene, ukuze kufinyelelwe emiphumeleni ewusizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kuningi okufanele kucace. Umoya odingekayo wokuhlanganyela ungayifeza imisebenzi ethuthukayo. Lezi zinhlelo zokukhalipha zingakhuthaza, zijabule, futhi zisebenze ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuhlola kudinga izikhalazo eziphakeme, ukuze kudaleke isithunzi sokuhlonipha esilondolozwayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lweGEMS luyoba yisibonelo esihle sokwakhiwa komphakathi, okwenza kube nekhwalithi yokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buyanda, kuhlale kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ikakhulukazi kunamathuba amaningi okufunda umphakathi ngezidingo ezithile. Lokhu kuncike ezindleleni ezihambisanayo, futhi umgomo wokuhlonipha abantwana eziphakamisweni zomphakathi onobuhle. Ngamanye amazwi, uhlelo lweGEMS lumele lihlale lwenza ukuboshelwe kakhulu ukuze kuhlonishwe izidingo zabantu. Njengoba siya phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule imiphumela engaba khona uma lezi zinhlelo zingaqinisekiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukukhuthazwa okuqhubekayo, ukuze kuxhunywe umoya wokusebenza okuphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kuhle ukuthi uhlole uhla lwezinhlelo ezihambisanayo, kanye nezindlela zokugcina ukuhlonishwa kwezidingo. Uhlelo lweGEMS luveza ukuzimisela okungapheli ekwenzeni izifundo ezinhle. Lesi simemezelo silobolerho, ukudala isikhumba esisha sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sihamba phambili, sihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi sakha ikusasa elikhanyayo lokunakekelwa kwezitho nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi konke okwenzeka kubantu kwenziwa ngezinga eliphezulu, futhi ukunakekelwa kuyadedelwa ngendlela efanele. Uhlelo lweGEMS luzokhumbula каждый umnyango omusha.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kubalulekile abathintekayo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile enikezela ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze ubambe iqhaza kule nhlangano, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde futhi avume imigomo nemibandela ethile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvikela amalungu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okucacile, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu abathintekayo. Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imigomo yenqubomgomo ibhalwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Le migomo ibonisa izimiso ezisemqoka, imikhawulo, kanye nezibopho ezihambisana nale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuvuma le migomo kusho ukuthi amalungu ayavuma ukulandela izinqubo nemithetho ebekwe yi-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zisebenza kahle futhi ziqondile. Ngokwamukela le migomo, amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezahlukahlukene, ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinye izinsiza ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungu abhalise futhi avume izimo ezithile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, i-GEMS ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze amalungu akwazi ukukhetha kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujule, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayazi izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, eziphathelene nezempilo yabo. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi ukuvuma le migomo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibonile ukuthi ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezilula nezicacile. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza ezikhethekile ezisiza amalungu ukuthi aqonde kahle le migomo. Izinsiza ezifana nezincwadi ezichazayo, amawebhusayithi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana zenzelwe ukusiza amalungu ukuthi aqonde kahle izinqubo ezithile, futhi aqonde izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuvuma le migomo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi ukuvuma le migomo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu ayazi ngalezi zinsizakalo, i-GEMS ibeka phambili izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuqeqesha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibandakanya amalungu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ekugcineni, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo ye-GEMS akukhona nje ukulandela imithetho, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu azithola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, futhi ahlale enolwazi oludingekayo ukuze akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo yabo. I-GEMS, ngokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, ibeka phambili impilo nempumelelo yamalungu ayo, ibavumela ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, enokuthula. Ngakho-ke, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo ye-GEMS akuyona nje isinyathelo esisemthethweni, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlala bekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka, futhi bazi kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwezempilo. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo ayakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi ahlale enobudlelwano obuqinile nezinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo.
Ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi (GEMS company name and code provision) Ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhulayo zomnotho, uhulumeni uthathe isinyathelo esibalulekile sokuhlinzeka ngamagama nezikhodi zenkampani ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukulawula, nokuphathwa kwezinkampani ezisebenza ngaphansi kweGEMS (Government Enterprise Management System). Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abanikazi bezinkampani, abathengisi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo ukuba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula emisebenzini yabo. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhloswe ukusiza ukuhlela nokuphatha izinkampani ezisebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokukhiqiza. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni ubona ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinkampani zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele, futhi zikhona ezinhlelweni zokubhaliswa ezisemthethweni. Ukuze kube lula, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngohlu lwamagama nezikhodi ezisemthethweni ezizokwenziwa zisetshenziswe ezinkampanini. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka okungase kube khona emisebenzini yansuku zonke, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani, njengoba kuzoba nezinqubo ezicacile zokubhalisela amagama nezikhodi. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti ahlukene, okwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezinkampani ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokubhaliswa, izidingo zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni. Abanikazi bezinkampani bazokwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo kalula, futhi bazothola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zabo zisebenza kahle. Ngokuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi, uhulumeni uhhlose ukwakha isimo esihle sokuhweba, esizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani, njengoba kuzoba nezinqubo ezicacile zokubhalisela amagama nezikhodi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS major member classification) Ngomhlaka 15 kuNcwaba 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wenzeka eGoli, lapho kwahlangana khona abamele izigaba ezahlukene zeGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ukuze baxoxe ngokuqhubeka kokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezinguquko ezithinta amalungu, kanye nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlela amalungu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yeMenenja yeGEMS, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, owakhuluma ngokuqonda okukhulu ngendaba yokuhlukaniswa kwelungu. Uthe, "Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ethu ahlukaniswa ngendlela efanele, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo." Ubuye wakhumbuza bonke ababekhona ukuthi lezi zinguquko zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu, nokuthi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aziswe ngalezi zinguquko. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba neseshini yokuxoxa, lapho amalungu ahlukahlukene eGEMS abebamba iqhaza. Abamele izigaba ezahlukene zaphendula imibuzo ethile, futhi babelana ngemicabango yabo mayelana nezinguquko ezizayo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziqonda izinqubo ezithinta izinsizakalo zabo. Ukwengeza, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezifundo ezithile ezazihlinzekwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo, ababeveza izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphila kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amalungu abone ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu akukhona kuphela ukwehlukaniswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhilela nokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yomuntu siqu. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi uma amalungu ethola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, kuthuthukiswa impilo yabo yonke. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, umcimbi waphinde waba neseshini yokubambisana, lapho amalungu akwazi ukuxhumana nabanye abamele izigaba ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwamalungu, okwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa futhi zisetshenziswe kahle. Uhlelo lokubambisana lwakha umoya wokubambisana, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa. Umcimbi uphothulwe ngenkulumo yokugcina kaMnu. Sipho Dlamini, owayekhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu. Uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi lezi zinguquko zidinga isikhathi, kodwa sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo." Ubuye wakhuthaza amalungu ukuba aqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabo. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu weGEMS wawuwumcimbi obalulekile, owahlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhulu mayelana nezinguquko ezizayo. Kwakuwumcimbi owawuhlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi wakhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu akukhona kuphela ukwehlukaniswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yomuntu siqu. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi iGEMS izimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo athola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa: Ukubaluleka KweGEMS Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo kuphumelelayo kudlula kakhulu iso lesiguli, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempilo nokuqonda okungokoqobo. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi kuGEMS (Geographic and Emergency Medical Services), sikhula sibe yingxenye ebalulekile yesimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuzindla okukhulu futhi kudinga ukuxhumanisa ubuchwepheshe bokwelashwa nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene. Yize imithi yokwelapha esebenzayo iyatholakala kakhulu, imiphumela engalindelekile yesiguli iyasehla, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba sizame ukuphenya imikhuba eyodwa ethinta umphakathi. Imiphumela yokwelashwa, engamaGEMS, ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, nabeziqinisekiso zezempilo. Ubulungiswa kulokhu kunikezwa ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nemiphumela emihle efaneleke kubantu. Uhlaka lweGEMS luhlose ukuzama ukusiza imiphakathi emisha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokwelapha eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukushintsha kwendlela esibheka ngayo impilo nokwelashwa. Uma sikhuluma ngezibopho, kumele siqonde ukuthi udokotela, isiguli, nezinsizakalo ezithinta ukwelashwa zinengxenye ebalulekile emiphumeleni. Umphumela wokwelashwa akukhona nje kuphela ukuphulukiswa komzimba kodwa kube yisifiso sokwakha impilo engcono empilweni yomuntu. Ukwelashwa kufanele kube yinto ebambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa iziguli ngesimo sabazo, ukufundisa izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze zenze ukuqapha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezithokozisayo nezisebenzayo. Ngalolu hlobo, umphumela wokwelashwa akuwona nje umsebenzi owenzelwa umphakathi, kodwa kwaziwa futhi njengezinga lokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. I-GEMS ingaholela emiphumeleni engcono uma iziguli zibona ubudlelwano obuhle nodokotela babo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba nodokotela babe nesineke, baphathe iziguli njengabantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene. Noma kunjalo, ukuphumelela kwemiphumela yokwelashwa akuphelele uma kungahambisani nezimo zabo bonke ababandakanyekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kudingeke ukuba kwehlonishwe izidingo zempilo zomphakathi, eyaziwa njengokuhlaziywa okuphathelene nemiphumela yempilo yolwazi. Abanye bangase bahluleka ukukhohlwa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ayiphekiwe, kepha ibhekelelwe ngokuhlakanipha izidingo ezihlukahlukene, kanti lokho kuncika emiphakathini yolwazi, izinganekwane, namasiko. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo zezokwelapha zingaba nemiphumela eyingozi uma zingasetshenziswa kahle. Ukuze umphakathi uzuze kwenziwa, ulwazi oluqinile lokwelashwa lufanele luqinisekiswe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sigcine ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemithombo yolwazi, abaphathi bezinsizakusebenza, kanye nesiguli. KuGEMS, ukwazisa iziguli mazinzima izindleko zabokhuphuka, kudinga ukuhlonishwa kokuphila kwazo. Ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo neziguli kudinga ukuba kube muse nophenyo olujulile. Njengoba sibheka emuva esikhathini eside, sokuqala sokuqala kweGEMS kubonisa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ingathola ukunqoba uma iziguli zifaka izinhlelo ezenzakalayo zokuphila. Lokhu akukhona kuphela ukuthuthukisa impilo yomuntu, kodwa futhi kuvuselela umphakathi jikelele. Isibopho sokuchaza imiphumela yokwelashwa sibusha, sisho ukuthi singakwazi ukufinyelela ebuhleni bemiphumela engcono, futhi sibonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kuthinta impilo yawo wonke umuntu. Noma kuwumkhosi obalulekile, lezi zinguquko zidinga ukuba abantu bahlale bephokophele ukuphumelela. Ngempela, imiphumela yokwelashwa yeGEMS iyisiqalo esihle, kepha kumele siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ukuze ibhershishe izifiso, izinyathelo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma sibambene, sithinta imibono yethu nokuqhuba phambili izindlela ezinhle zokuziphatha ezizothuthukisa imiphumela evumelaniswe nawomphakathi jikelele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizoxoxa ngalezi zimo ezibalulekile emiphumeleni yokwelashwa. Kulula ukuthola imiphumela emihle uma sibambisene, sithuthukise, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezinhle zokwelashwa. Ubulungiswa bokuGEMS bushintshe izimvo zokuhlala kube yindawo ephumelelayo, futhi ikakhulukazi oGEMS bodinga ukuba baphendule ngobuqotho, ukuze iziguli zihlale zikhululekile, zithole izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo, futhi zibuye zibe neqhaza elihle ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa yeGEMS.
Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi Lwezempilo lwe-GEMS Isingeniso Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka futhi izinsiza zokwelapha zikhula. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyisikhungo esibalulekile sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwamalungu lukhululekile futhi luvikelekile, i-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuvikela le datha. Ukwaziswa Kwenqubo Yokuvikela Ulwazi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, i-GEMS iyasebenzisa izinqubo ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe, ezokuphatha, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphephile, ezihlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwezinhlaka zedatha, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ezisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lukhululekile. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zifaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amakhodi, izigxivizo, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuvikela ezithuthukisiwe. Izinsiza Zokuvikela Ulwazi I-GEMS inikeza izinsiza ezihlukahlukene zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa amalungu mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amalungu aqonde ukuthi kufanele aqaphele kanjani lapho ethola izinsizakalo zezempilo. I-GEMS iphinde inikeze amathuluzi okuphatha ulwazi lwezempilo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivumela amalungu ukuthi baphathe ulwazi lwabo kalula futhi ngokuphepha. Izingozi Zokwephulwa Kolwazi Noma kunjalo, ukwephulwa kolwazi lwezempilo kungaba nemiphumela emibi. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka, ukwehluleka kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezifanele, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. I-GEMS ibona lezi zingozi futhi ibeka izinqubomgomo ezinzima zokuvikela ulwazi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwabo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ulwazi zisebenza kahle, i-GEMS ibambisana nezikhungo zokuphepha ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenza nezinkampani ezikhethekile ekuphepheni, ezihlinzeka ngolwazi nolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kolwazi. Lokhu kubambisana kusiza i-GEMS ukuthi ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukwaziswa Nokufundiswa Kwamalungu Ukwaziswa kwamalungu kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuqonda okuphelele kokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izifundo ezithinta ukuvikelwa kolwazi, ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuqonda izinqubomgomo ezikhona. Lokhu kufundiswa kuhloswe ngokuqinisa ukuqonda kwamalungu, ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela ulwazi lwabo ngokwabo. Isiphetho Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwabo. Ngezinqubomgomo ezicacile, izinsiza zokuvikela ulwazi, kanye nokubambisana nezikhungo zokuphepha, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuqwashisa nokufundiswa kwamalungu kuqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo nolwazi. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zamanje, iqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lukhululekile.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zempilo zabantu abavela ezimbonini ezehlukene, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS) iyinsiza ebalulekile yokugcina ukuphila kahle kwemisebenzi. Le scheme ithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kumasebenzi kahulumeni futhi ibavumela ukuba bathole imishwana ehlukene yokwelashwa. Okwamanje, i-GEMS inemiphakathi emikhulu, futhi ukwazi okwabiwe kweminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Ukuhlelwa Kwezimali Zobulungu Ukuze ube yilungu le-GEMS, kubalulekile ukwenza iminikelo ethile. Le midlalwa ikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga, futhi isebenzisa amazinga ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine. Lokhu kwizinsuku ezisemthethweni, izinkokhelo zibalwa ngemali ethile phakathi kokuhlela abadlali, kufaka phakathi abahlala ngaphansi kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo, eziphakeme, ezibhekelele izimo ezinzima nezifanele. Ezinsukwini zamuva, i-GEMS ithuthukise izinhlelo zayo ukuze zithuthukise ukuhamba kwemali nokwenza kube lula ukwazisa amalungu ngeminikelo yabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile ngababalelwa ezindleleni zokukhokha, okwandisa ukuqonda kwabantu ukucia okukhona emalini abayikhokhayo. Njengoba ukuhlonishwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kudinga ukusekela, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwenzeni iminikelo ngokwakho. Izinsiza Ezinikezwayo Ngokungeziwe kumaholo okhulu, i-GEMS inika ububanzi bezinsiza eziqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izikhungo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa emtholampilo, nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Ubufakazi bokuba sevesheni yaseGEMS kwaziswe ngabahlali, bethola izinsizakalo ezibhekelela kahle izidingo zabo zempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ilunga le-GEMS kumele azise ngokuqhubekayo ngemali abayikhokhayo ukuze aqiniseke ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Ngokwezinsizakalo eziphezulu, i-GEMS iyasebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokwelashwa zihlonishwa, futhi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayaneliseka ngabantu abakhokhelwa. Uhlelo lwama-urgent care lunikezwa ukuze lwenze kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, noyedwa oyisithupha uyakwazi ukukhokha ngamaholo athile. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Nakuba i-GEMS ibonisa ukuphumelela ezindlelweni zayo, akukhona kokuphela okuhle. Abanye amalungu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene babe nezinselele zokukhokha izindleko eziziphakeme, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezidingweni ezimazombezombene. Lokhu kuphakanyiswa kwezimali eziphezulu ezimbalwa kuhlangene nezimo ezingathandeki, njengezindleko eziphezulu zokuhlola kanye nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Ngokuqaphela lokhu, i-GEMS isebenzisa izinqubo ezikhethekile ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Amabhodi afaka ukunikeza izixazululo zamasosha ezinkulu ukuze abavote ezindleleni zokuphila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba phambili kwemali, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS izoshintsha ukuphathwa kwezimali zobulungu bayo. Abalungiswa be-GEMS bahlala bekhuthaza amalungu ukuba babhalise futhi bakhokhe ngokukhululeka. Njengoba impilo ibalulekile, ukuqonda imininingwane ye-GEMS kanye nokukhumbula izidingo zabo, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS ibe yinsiza ebonakalayo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiGEMS siyakhula, futhi lichaza ukuthi wonke umuntu onamakhono aweGEMS kufanele aqhubeke nokunakekela, ahlanganise izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, nezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzokhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kabusha kwezempilo walabo abahlala emazweni athile. Ngokujulile, i-GEMS iyinsiza eyaziwa phakathi kwabantu abaningi, futhi iminikelo yubulungu bayo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihamba phambili. Ukubambisana phakathi kwe-GEMS, amalungu, nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kuzoba yinsiza eqhubekayo ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo (GEMS health facility coordination) Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo, owaziwa njenge-GEMS health facility coordination, wabanjwa eGoli. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo ezahlukene, uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ebanzi mayelana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo, ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo kubantu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo, uDkt. Sipho Mthembu, owakhuluma ngokuqakatheka kokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. Uthe, "Ukuhlanganiswa kwethu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza, futhi kuzokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude." Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo omkhulu walomcimbi, okungukuthi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo oludingekayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abahlanganyeli bahlala ezinkundleni ezihlukene ukuze baxoxe ngezihloko ezithile. Kukhona izinkulumo ezithokozisayo eziphathelene nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuphucula izinqubo zokusebenza. Abaholi bezikhungo zezempilo baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokwabelana ngempumelelo yabo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokwelapha, izindlela zokuphatha iziguli, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nezingxoxo ezibucayi phakathi kwabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abamele izikhungo zezempilo, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Lezi zingxoxo zakhuthaza ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwezikhungo, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Abahlanganyeli baphinde bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule ezinkingeni ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo zabo, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezingxoxo ezimnandi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlanganyela izinsiza. Abahlanganyeli baphinde banikwe ithuba lokubona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abahlanganyeli baphuma bejabule, bephuma nemibono emisha yokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wagcizelela ukuthi, "Umsebenzi wethu awupheli lapha. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo." Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nolwazi. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination ubonise ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zethu zisebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo, futhi umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination uzoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sibambisene, singakwazi ukufezekisa izinto ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola usizo lwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi, ngokuhlanganyela, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nolwazi.
Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziningi, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Phakathi kwalezi zinhlangano, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) yaziwa kakhulu. Le mfundiso yempilo yadalwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. I-GEMS yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2005, ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni efuna ukwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga eziningi zempilo zazikhona, futhi abantu abaningi babengenayo indlela yokuthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. I-GEMS yabe isiza ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho izinsiza zezempilo zazingatholakali kalula. Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina i-GEMS, bekudingeka ukuthi ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, umgomo wokuqala wukuthi umuntu kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abasebenzi bakahulumeni bekwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibhekelele izidingo ezithile ezihlobene nezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathola izinsiza banelisekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze ibonise izinzuzo zayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangawathola kanjani la maphakheji. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle, njengoba abantu abaningi baqala ukujoyina i-GEMS, bejabulile ngempilo yabo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba i-GEMS inezinzuzo eziningi, bekukhona nezinkinga ezazivela. Abanye abantu babengathokozile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi bekukhona izikhalazo ezivela kubantu ababephakathi kwalesi simo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni i-GEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo, ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Ngiyanemukela, ngiyabonga ngokungithinta ngalolu daba olubalulekile. Namuhla sikhuluma ngempesheni, ikakhulukazi mayelana nemibhalo ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nesimo sempesheni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma ucabanga ngempilo yakho yesikhathi esizayo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impesheni iyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu. I-GEMS iyinhlangano ethuthukisa izinsiza zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unempesheni efanele uma usuhamba emuva emsebenzini. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde kahle ukuthi yimaphi imibhalo edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise isimo sakho sempesheni. Uma sikhuluma ngemibhalo yesimo sempesheni, okokuqala, kudingeka uqinisekise ukuthi unayo yonke imibhalo edingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amafomu akho okungena, izincwadi zokugunyazwa, kanye nemininingwane yokugcina yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi le mibhalo ibhalwe kahle, futhi ayinaphutha. Uhlanga olungaphelele lungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu uma kufika isikhathi sokuhola impesheni. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayithola imihlahlandlela ethile ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda izinqubo zokufaka izicelo, izidingo zokuhola, kanye nezinsuku ezithile zokuhola. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde ukuthi imaphi amalungelo akho. Uma ungazi kahle, ungase uvule iminyango yokungaqondi kahle, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Kukhona futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze usize abantu abafuna ukuqonda kahle isimo sempesheni yabo. Ungaxhumana nabameli be-GEMS, noma ungavakashela kwiwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhipha imibuzo yakho, futhi uqonde kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi impesheni yakho ihamba kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale uvuselela imininingwane yakho. Uma kwenzeka ushintsha umsebenzi, noma uthola izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yakho, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifakwe kumarekhodi akho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela impesheni yakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase ube nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene nemibhalo yakho. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwezinqubo, noma ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi ungazidela uma uthola izinkinga. Xhumana nabameli be-GEMS, bese ubacela usizo. Bazi kahle ukuthi izinkinga zingavela, futhi bazokwazi ukukusiza ukuthi uzixazulule. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase uthole ukuthi isimo sempesheni yakho sishintsha. Lokhu kungaholela ezinqumweni ezinzima, kodwa kufanele uqonde ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale ubheka izinguquko ezithile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi impesheni yakho ihamba kahle. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde ukuthi isimo sempesheni sikhona ukuze sikusize. I-GEMS iyinhlangano ehlose ukusiza abasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kufanele uyisebenzise kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi yimaphi amalungelo akho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawasebenzisa. Ngakho-ke, uma unombuzo noma udinga usizo, ungathandabuzi ukufuna usizo. I-GEMS ikhona ukuze ikusize, futhi ungavuma ukusiza. Impesheni yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi iyahamba kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela ngalolu daba, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumibhalo yesimo sempesheni yakho. Hamba kahle, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhamba phambili.
Ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS (GEMS claim submission and processing) Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyisikhwama sezempilo esisungulwe nguhulumeni wesiNtu, esihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kube nohlelo olusebenzayo, abahlali badinga ukuzazi izinqubo ezihambisana nokufaka izicelo zezimangalo, ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezingase zivele ngesikhathi sokucubungula lezi zicelo. Kokuqala, ukufaka isicelo sezimangalo kumasistimu e-GEMS kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi abe neziqu ezanele zokuhlonza, okuhlanganisa nezinombolo zezimangalo, imininingwane yomtholampilo, kanye nezinkcukacha zomuntu siqu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngezimpendulo ezithile ezisemthethweni okufanele ziqinisekiswe. I-GEMS inikeza izindlela eziningi zokufaka izicelo, kuhlanganise nezinsiza ze-inthanethi, okuyindlela ekhuthazwayo ngenxa yokuphumelela kwayo. Umsebenzisi kufanele agcwalise ifomu lokucela izimangalo elitholakala kwiwebhusayithi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane efakiwe iyiyona efanele. Imininingwane engalungile noma engaphelele ingaholela ekuhlulekeni kokucutshungulwa kwesicelo, okuyinto efanele ukuqaphela kwabafaka izicelo. Ngemuva kokufakwa kwesicelo, i-GEMS izoqala ukulicubungula. Lesi sinyathelo sihamba ngokucophelela, njengoba izinqubo zokuhlola zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izicelo zihambisana nemigomo neziqondiso ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nezincazelo eziqondile lapho kudingeka futhi, uma kudingeka, izinsizakalo ezithile zempilo kufanele ziqinisekiswe ngodokotela abaqashiwe. Ukucutshungulwa kwezimangalo kudinga ukuthi izinsizakalo zenziwe ngezindlela eziphathekayo, kubandakanya ukuhlaziywa kwemithetho ethile yokubheka ubufakazi. Lesi simo siza ekugcineni ukuthola ukunembileko kokuthola ukuxhaswa kwezimali, okubalulekile ukuze abahlali bakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sibuye sithole ukuphikiswa noma izinkinga, i-GEMS izobhalela umsebenzisi incwadi yokuphikisa enezizathu ezicacile. Lokhu kusebenza njengomhlahlandlela ophusile wokuthi umsebenzisi angakwenza ukuphikisa kanjani lesi siphakamiso, futhi uhlinzeka ngamathuba okuba kuhlolwe izinkinga. I-GEMS iyasiza ekulondolozeni ulwazi nokuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusebenzisa izimpendulo ezivela kubasebenzisi, okuyelulekela ukukhulisa izinqubo zayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba umsebenzisi uyawuqonda umkhiqizo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezicaciso ezithile ezitholakalayo kumasistimu e-GEMS. Ngamafuphi, ukufaka nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezinyathelo ezisemthethweni, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Imiphumela efanele ingafezwa uma umsebenzisi ethobela yonke imithetho nemigomo ethile, okuhlanganisa ukukhombisa ubuqotho bemininingwane. Lokhu kusebenza njengesibonelo sokuthi, uma kwenziwa ngezindlela ezifanele, i-GEMS ingaba yinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ihlinzeka ngesixazululo esiqinile kwizidingo zabo zemali nezempilo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqwashisa bonke abasebenzisi mayelana nezici eziphuma kulesi sikhwama. Ukuhlaziya izimangalo ze-GEMS akugcinwa nje ngokuheha izinsizakalo, kodwa kujolise ekwakheni umuzwa wokwethembeka noxhaso kumphakathi, okubandakanya umphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo nezinhlelo zokufaka izicelo kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo eziphuthumayo zempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni.
Isimemezelo Sokunemba Kwefomu Lelungu (GEMS Member Form Accuracy Declaration) Ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inhlangano ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni nasempilweni yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezidingekayo kubasebenzi, okuhlanganisa neqhaza labo emindenini yabo. Ukuze lolu hlelo lusebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlinzeke ngemininingwane eqondile futhi enembile ku-fomu lelungu. ### Ukwazi Ukubaluleka Kokunemba Isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu lelungu singumkhiqizo obalulekile ohlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwaziwa komkhiqizo wezinsizakalo zempilo ohlangene no-GEMS. Lokhu kusiza ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lokuphatha, kanti kuphinde kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yabasebenzi. Ngakho-ke, ukuhlonishwa kwalesi simemezelo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kunoma ubani ofaka le fomu. ### Izizathu Zokuhlonipha Isimemezelo Noma ubani ofaka ifomu le-GEMS kufanele aqonde ukuthi ukungena kwemininingwane enembile kudlala indima enkulu ekuphathweni kwesiguli. Uma umuntu enza iphutha, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinjengokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelashwa okungakuhle, ukungafuneki kokuhlolwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinkinga ezicashile ezithinta ukukhokhwa kwemali. Kanjalo, ukungabi neqiniso kwemininingwane kungaholela ezinkingeni zomthetho nezokuphatha. ### Ubulungisa Nokuphathwa Kwamafomu Abasebenzi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukufaka amafomu aphelele, afinyelela ezingeni lobulungiswa, kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi igama, idayari, idokhumenti efana ne-ID, nezinye izincazelo ezifanele zifakwe ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Umphakathi wesikhungo wezempilo, abaphathi, nabaphathiswa bempilo balindele lezi zinkcukacha ukuze kukhululeke ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo. ### Ukuqinisekisa Ukunemba Kwefomu Kumele kubonakale ukuthi ukuqinisekisa ukunemba kwefomu lelungu akuwona umkhawulo, kodwa kunjalo, kuyinqubomgomo efanele. Umuntu ofaka lesi simemezelo kufanele ahlole kahle imininingwane ayifakile, abuyekeze noma iyiphi ingxenye engalungile, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi konke kulungile ngaphambi kokuphawula. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthuthukisa ukwethembeka kkomkhankaso wokwelashwa. ### Ukusekelwa Noma Izimo Zokungahlangabezani Ngokufaka isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu, umthengi uvuma ukuba neqhaza elithile emisebenzini ye-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kwenzeka kungekho ukugadwa noma izimo ezinjalo, umthengi angase abhekane nemiphumela ethile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi ukuthi yini okufanele bayenze uma bahluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengokufaka izikhalazo noma ukubika izinto eziphuthelwe. ### Emva Kokufaka Ifomu Uma ifomu selifakiwe, abamukeli bempela be-GEMS bazokwenza umnyaba wokuhlola ukunemba kolwazi olufakiwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, abasebenzi bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezinikezwayo, kodwa kumelwe bazi ukuthi bangakwazi ukuthola izikhalazo uma kuvela izinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi uqhubeke nokubuyekeza imininingwane yakho njengoba kudingeka. ### Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu lelungu sikhumbuza bonke ababhalisile be-GEMS ngobuhle bokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelashwa uma kunemininingwane efanele efakiwe. Ngokuhlonipha isimemezelo, sizothuthukisa inhlonipho kubo bonke abathintekayo kulolu hlelo lwezempilo olukhulu. Lokhu akugwemezi nje ezinkingeni, kodwa futhi kuphinde kuthuthukise impilo yabaningi. Ukwazi lezi zinto kuzoholela ekutheni kube nokukhula okuhle emikhakheni ye-GEMS, okuhlasela umphakathi wakithi ngokuphelele. Uma sonke sithatha umthwalo wokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, sizobe sikulethe emiphumeleni eyakhayo. Cishe njengoba ukhula, kwenza kube lula nabanye, kanti ekugcineni, sizobaqondise kahle empilweni yabo.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye nemininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zempilo ziye zathuthuka, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuhlela izimali zabo. Omunye wemigomo ethokozisayo yalesi sikhathi ukuhlinzeka ngezimali zempilo nge-deduction eyaziwa njenge-debit order. Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu ngabasebenzisi be-GEMS, okuyinkampani enezinsizakalo ezinhle emikhakheni yezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthola imiyalelo ecacile mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza i-debit order, kanye nemininingwane yasebhange edingekayo. Okokuqala, i-debit order iyindlela ephephile yokukhokha izindleko zempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali ethile ikhululwa ku-akhawunti yakho yebhange njalo ngenyanga ukuze ikhokhe izindleko ezihlobene ne-GEMS. Lokhu kusiza ukuhlela izimali ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhubekayo kokukhokha. Bonke abahlanganyeli be-GEMS kumele baqonde imiyalelo ethile ukuze le ndlela isebenze kahle. Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuba ne-akhawunti yasebhange evulekile, okuyisidingo esiyisisekelo. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uthole ifomu lokubhaliswa kwe-debit order, elitholakala kalula ku-inthanethi noma ehhovisi le-GEMS. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane efanele, njengegama, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane ye-akhawunti yasebhange, ifakiwe ngendlela efanele ukuze ugweme izinkinga. Uma ifomu selithunyelwe ehhovisi le-GEMS, ungakwenza lokhu ngeposi noma ngokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuthumela. Kubalulekile ukukhetha indlela yokuthumela ehamba phambili kuwe. Uma ifomu lingene, uzothola isiqinisekiso sokuthi i-debit order yakho isiqalile, okuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwakho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase udinge ukubuyekeza imininingwane yakho yasebhange, njengoba izinguquko empilweni yakho zingase zidinge izinguquko ezifanele. Kubalulekile ukufaka izinguquko ezidingekayo ngesikhathi, ukuze ugweme izinkinga ezizovela. Futhi, qaphela izindleko ezihambisana ne-debit order, njengoba izinkampani zempilo zingase zibe nezimali zokubhaliswa. Ukwazi izindleko zakho kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali. Abathengi kufanele bazi futhi ngezinkinga ezingase zenzeke, njengokungafaki kahle imali ku-akhawunti, okungaholela ekutheni ungakhokhi izindleko zakho zempilo. Ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga kuyasiza kakhulu. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle imiyalelo ye-debit order nemininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS. Le ndlela yokukhokha iguqula indlela esihlela ngayo izimali zempilo, futhi iyindlela elula yokugcina izindleko zethu zempilo. Ngakho, hlola kahle, qonda izinqubo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhlala ufinyelela ukwelashwa okudingayo. Ukuphumelela kwe-debit order kudinga ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nomsebenzisi ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni yethu.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana (GEMS Doctor Authorization and Communication) Kulezi zinsuku, ukubaluleka kokuxhumana kahle phakathi kwezokwelapha nezinsizakalo zezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela, ikakhulukazi ngaphansi kwe-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo lwezempilo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekubalulekeni kokugunyazwa kodokotela, izinqubo ezidingekayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhilela inqubo lapho udokotela efaka isicelo sokuthi umtholampilo noma insiza ethile ivunyelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokuhlola ukuthi ukwelashwa okukhulunywayo kuhambisana nezidingo zomtholampilo kanye nezimfuneko ze-GEMS. Ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi udokotela ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nesimo sempilo somtholampilo, izizathu zokwelashwa, kanye nezinkomba zokuthi kungani le nsiza ibalulekile. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abathola usizo, kanye ne-GEMS kubalulekile. Ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezindlela ezicacile zokwabelana ngemininingwane. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izincwadi, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezikwi-inthanethi. Ukuze abathola usizo baqonde kahle inqubo yokugunyazwa, udokotela kufanele abelane ngemininingwane ecacile, futhi kube nokuxhumana okuvamile ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga noma izidingo ezenzakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathola usizo baqonda izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele ngalesi sikhathi sokugunyazwa, izikhathi ezithile zokuphendula, kanye nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze kube nokuphumelela. Uma abathola usizo benolwazi olunembile, bazoba nethuba elingcono lokuba nesimo esihle sokwelashwa. Ngokubheka izinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile nezilula zokugunyazwa kodokotela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo bonke abathintekayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngabe udokotela, umtholampilo, noma abathola usizo. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuphatha izicelo zokugunyazwa zingasiza ekwenzeni le nqubo ibe lula futhi ibe nesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezokwelapha nezinsizakalo zezempilo kunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezivela ekugunyazweni. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, udokotela kufanele ahlale ethintana nabathola usizo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi bazi kahle izinqubo, izidingo, kanye nezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza futhi kunciphise izinkinga ezingavela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana ngaphansi kwe-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo lwezempilo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nolwazi olunembile kubo bonke abathintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abathola usizo babe nempilo engcono, futhi kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo, kusukela kodokotela kuya kubathola usizo, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle, baphumelele ekugunyazweni, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zezempilo, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukwelashwa abakufunayo, futhi kube nokuthula phakathi kwezokwelapha kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) Ingxoxo: Uma sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuze abantu abathola imali ngokuzimela noma impesheni bathole izinsiza ezidingekayo, kudinga ukuhlola kahle izinsiza zabo. Uma ufuna ulwazi oluqondile, sithintane noMnu. Nkosi, ongumeluleki wezezimali onolwazi olunzulu kulolu daba. Mnu. Nkosi, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola izinsiza zempilo, ezifana ne-GEMS, bahlala bephila kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinkokhelo zempesheni kanye nemali engenayo evela emisebenzini abazenzayo. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe le mali engenayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Okokuqala, abathintekayo badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, efana namaphepha afanele, njengemibhalo yokuhola, izinkontileka, noma izitatimende zezimali. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinkcukacha zibe neqiniso futhi ziqinisekiswe ngababheki bezimali. Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Nkosi: Izinkinga ezivamile zifaka phakathi ukungabi namaphepha afanele, noma ubufakazi bokuthi imali engenayo iyatholakala. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinselelo zokuhumusha imibhalo, ikakhulukazi uma bephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyahambisana. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kusizakale abantu abahlangabezana nalezi zinkinga? Mnu. Nkosi: Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zezimali, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo ezikhethekile zingasiza abantu ukuthi baqonde le nqubo. Futhi, imihlangano yokufundisa ingaba usizo olukhulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo uma umuntu engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kudingeka ukuthi axhumane nezikhungo eziphathelene nezinsizakalo zempesheni noma ezemali. Kuhle ukuthi abhale phansi izizathu ezithile zokungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinkcukacha. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekutholeni izixazululo ezihambisanayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe le nqubo ithinta kanjani abantu abasha abaqala ukusebenza? Mnu. Nkosi: Abantu abasha abaqala ukusebenza badinga ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona ukuze bazilungiselele kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi baqonde izinqubo zokuhola, imithetho, kanye nezidingo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ukuze bangahlangabezani nezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubantu abathintekayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafuna. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphile futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Ukugcina amarekhodi anembile, ukuxhumana nabachwepheshe bezimali, nokufunda ngalezi zinsizakalo kuzobasiza ekuphumeleleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele bakhathazeke uma behlangabezana nezinkinga; ukuxhumana kuzobasiza. Umbuzo: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Nkosi, ngempela izeluleko zakho ziwusizo. Ngabe ungathanda ukwengeza okuthile? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngithanda ukuphetha ngokuthi ukuqinisekisa imali engenayo akukhona nje ukulandela izinqubo, kodwa kuyinqubo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabachwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi kunciphise ukungaqondi kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, abantu bangathola usizo olukhulu futhi baphile impilo engcono. Ukuxhumana, ukuqonda, kanye nokubambisana kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwale nqubo.
Umbiko: Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sesisebenzi Sikahulumeni (GEMS Government Employee Status Verification) Isingeniso Ukuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubaluleke kakhulu emisebenzini yohulumeni, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphatheni nasekulethweni kwezinsizakalo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni, inika abathintekayo ithuba lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umbiko lo uzobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokuvumelanisa isimo sesisebenzi, izinqubo zokugcina izinsiza zisebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela ethintwayo kulabo ababhaliswe ku-GEMS. Ukwaziswa Ngomsebenzi Wokuhlola Isimo Sesisebenzi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo, abasebenzi bakahulumeni badinga ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhaliswe ku-GEMS bahlonishwa futhi banelungelo lokuthola izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlola isimo, ukuhlola ubufakazi, nokuhlanganisa imininingwane ebalulekile. Izinyathelo Zokuhlola Isimo Okokuqala, abasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banemininingwane yabo yokuxhumana efanele ku-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amagama, izibongo, izindawo zokuhlala, nezikhumbuzo ezisemthethweni. Ukuze kutholakale uhlu lwabasebenzi abavumelekile, kudinga ukuxhumana nezikhungo eziphethe imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zezimali nezezemidlalo. Ukwengeza, ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane efanele kwamahhala kubalulekile. Abasebenzi kufanele baphendule kahle emibuzweni ethile eyenziwa ngesikhathi sokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusho izizathu zokuthola imvume, izifundo ezitholakele, kanye neminyango ehilelekile. Izindleko Nezinselelo Nokho, kunezindleko nezinselelo ezihambisana nalesi simo. Abasebenzi bangahlangabezana nezinselelo zokuthola ubufakazi obudingekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokwelashwa zingase zibe phezulu, okwandisa ingcindezi kubasebenzi abakwanayo. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokweseka, aqinise izinkampani ezithintekayo, futhi aguqule izinqubo ezintsha zokuhlola. Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ukuhlola imiphumela yokuhlola isimo sesisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo zisebenza ngokufanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabathintekayo, ukuhlola izimo eziningi ezinomthelela, nokuhlanganisa iziphakamiso zokwenza ngcono izinqubo. Abasebenzi kumele bahlale bexhumana ne-GEMS ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zabo ziphumelele, futhi baphendule kahle ezidingweni zamanje. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile ekuphatheni nasekulethweni kwezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni. I-GEMS inika ithuba eliyigugu lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa kudinga ukugxila ekwenzeni izinqubo zihlale ziphumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, uhulumeni, kanye nezisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo banikwa ithuba lokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngaleyo ndlela, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinkampanini zempilo kukhuthazwa, kwenze kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukujabulela izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba yingxenye ye-GEMS. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuhlola izinqubo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni sithuthukiswa, futhi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze zithuthukise impilo yabantu. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi kaHulumeni, kubaluleka ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
### Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi (GEMS employer contribution coordination) Kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu bebengazi kahle ukuthi yini eyayichaza ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abathintekayo kuhlelo lweGEMS. Lokhu kwenzeka emzaneni omncane, lapho abantu babengazi ukuthi izimali abazinikezayo zisebenza kanjani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle. Emuva kweminyaka ethile, lezi zindleko zempilo zazingekho phansi, futhi izinkampani zazidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhokha iminikelo efanele ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bathola okudingekayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMnu. Dlamini, umphakathi onothile wombuso, wayengumqashi ophumelelayo. Wayevuma ukuthi uhwebo lwempilo lwaluhamba kancane, kodwa wayekwazi ukuthi uma engafaki izimali ezanele, kuzophumela ekutheni abasebenzi bakhe bangatholi ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ngakho-ke, uMnu. Dlamini wathintana noNkk. Mpofu, ongumeluleki wezokuphatha, ukuze athole impendulo. U-Nkk. Mpofu, onolwazi olunzulu ngale ndaba, wathi: "Uhlelo lweGEMS luyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa iminikelo yomqashi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umqashi efaka imali, le mali izogcinwa ukuze isetshenziswe ezindlekweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zabasebenzi." UMnu. Dlamini, enomqondo ovulekile, wavuma ukuthi kufanele akwazi kahle indlela lezi zimali ezihlanganiswa ngayo. "Ngabe lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizodinga ukudala izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlanganisa lezi zinkokhelo?" wabuza. U-Nkk. Mpofu wamkhumbuza ukuthi yebo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakwazi ukujabulisa izinhlelo zabo zezempilo. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana, uMnu. Dlamini wathola ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo kwakubalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imishwalense yokunakekelwa kwezempilo iyahamba kahle, kodwa futhi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okucacile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzekayo kanye nabathengi. Lokhu kwavula umqondo omusha kumphakathi, futhi uMnu. Dlamini wazizwa ethokozile ngokwazi ukuthi akahlanganyela kuphela ekwenzeni kahle kodwa futhi uthola umqondo wobumbano. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlanganiswa kweminikelo. Waqala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakhe bazi kahle ukuthi iminikelo yabo iyahlanganiswa kanjani. Wabavumela ukuthi babuze imibuzo futhi banikeze imibono, okwakwenza kube lula ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komqashi nomsebenzi. Ngemuva kokwengeza izinhlelo ezihlukile, uMnu. Dlamini wanquma ukuba nezinye izifundo ezithile. Lezi zifundo zazihlanganisa indlela yokuphatha izimali, izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, kanye nokuthi kanjani izimali ezithile zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bekwazi kakhulu futhi baguquka baziqhenya ngeminikelo yabo. Ukwengeza, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye abaqashi emzaneni. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umphakathi uqonda kahle izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, futhi waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho wonke umuntu ebona ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo akukhona nje kuphela umqondo omuhle, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo ezithile.
