Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Ezinengi Ngomhlaka 15 kuMandulo 2023, kwenzeka umcimbi obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zathinta kakhulu impilo yabantu. Kwakuphakathi kwezinsuku ezimnandi, umoya wawupholile, kodwa ngezikhathi ezithile ubukhulu bezingozi benza kube nesithukuthezi phakathi kwabantu. Kwakukhona umcimbi wezimoto eziningi owenziwa edolobheni, lapho uhulumeni, izikhungo zezokwelapha, kanye neziphathimandla zomphakathi behlanganyela ukuze baphendule ngendlela efanele ezimeni eziphathelene nezingozi eziphuthumayo. Umcimbi waqubuka ngenhloso yokuvuselela ulwazi lokuphendula ezintweni eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ezimotweni eziningi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila kahle futhi baphumule. Ukuze siqonde kahle, izimo eziphuthumayo ngokuvamile ziqukethe izimo ezinjengezingozi zomgwaqo, izikhukhula, noma izimo ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kubangela ukumemezela okuphuthumayo, okudinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo. Umcimbi waphela uhlanganisa izigidi zabasebenzi bezokuphepha, abezokwelapha, kanye nababambiqhaza abahlukene, bonke bejolise ekwenzeni imizamo ephezulu yokuphendula. Ngemva kokuvula umcimbi, kwaba nezingxoxo ezibalulekile phakathi kwabaphathi bezokuphepha nezithunywa zezokwelapha mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kube nempumelelo ekuphenduleni ezimeni ezinjalo. Kukhona ukugxila okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuziqhenya emiphakathini, ukuze kube neziqu ezizwakalayo zokuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kumele benze kanjani ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Umhlangano wawuqhakambisa izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza ngcono ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi. Kukhona izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa, okwakuhlanganisa izifundo zomphakathi, ezifundisa abantu ukuthi baphendule kanjani uma bethola izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ukuphendula okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo kudinga ukuqonda kahle izinyathelo ezilandelwayo. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zaphinde zakhuluma ngokuqhubekayo, zisiza abathintekayo bazi ukuthi bangawathola kanjani amalungelo abo, izinsizakalo, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka zokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo ukuze bathole ukuhlinzekwa komsebenzi ophumelelayo, njengokuthola usizo lwezokwelapha, ukuzithokozisa, noma ukuxhumana nezinsiza zokukhuluma. Umcimbi uphinde wavula amathuba okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe obuthuthukile bokuphendula. Abathuthukisi bezobuchwepheshe bamemezela izixazululo ezizosheshisa ukuphendula, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakalayo ezisiza ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwezinsiza zomphakathi nabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpendulo eziphuthumayo, futhi kuthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwempilo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonise ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo ezihlukene. Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo akuyona indaba yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo, ulwazi, nezinsiza. Ukubambisana kwenza kube lula ukuphendula, kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyafinyelela usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi ubonise ukuthi, njengoba izimo zishintsha futhi zikhula, kufanele sibe neziqu eziphambili zokuphendula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi impilo yomphakathi iqhubeke nokuphila kahle, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi basendaweni ephephile, lapho usizo lungatholakala kalula. Umcimbi ubonise umdlandla phakathi kwabantu, ubufakazi bokuthi, uma sihlanganyela, singakha umphakathi onempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sinesithakazelo esikhulu sokubona izinhlelo ezidingekayo zikhula, futhi sithi, kumele siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sifundisane, futhi sizame ukusiza omunye nomunye ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Khumbulani, impilo iyigugu, futhi ukuphendula kahle ngesikhathi esifanele singasiza ukusindisa izimpilo.
Ukufezwa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15: Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Bukhombisa Impumelelo Ngokwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani eziningi ziye zathola indlela yokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, okuholele ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo. Iphrojekthi eyaziwa ngokuthi "Ukufezwa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15" ibonisa indlela abaphathi bezinsizakalo abangasebenzisa ngayo ubuchwepheshe ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izimpendulo zifinyelela kumakhasimende ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukwethula le phrojekthi kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinga lokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo lwezokwelapha, izimo zokuphepha, noma izimo zokuphuthumayo ezithinta abantu. Uhlelo lwasungulwa ngenhloso yokunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda, okuholela ekutheni abantu bathole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha. Ubufakazi bokusebenza kwalesi simo bubonakala emiphumeleni ethokozisayo. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo eziphambili, izinkampani zikwazile ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo zibe ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-15. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisheshayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha izinsizakalo eziklama izinqubo ezisebenzayo. Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, izinkampani ezisebenzisa lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bekhululekile uma bezwa ukuthi usizo lungafika ngokushesha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uhlelo lokuphendula oluphumelelayo luhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Ukuze kutholakale usizo oluphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenze ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakalo zezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinsizakalo kuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwazo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezithuthukisiwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zazo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinga lokuphendula, ukuhlola izinkinga ezivela, kanye nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala ziphansi. Izinhlelo zokuhlola zikhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuphendula zikhula kakhulu, zikhombisa ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ukwengeza, ubuchwepheshe obusha bukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo zenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baxhumane nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, bahlale bezwa ukuthi usizo lungafika ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphepha, okubalulekile ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. Kodwa-ke, le phrojekthi ayinakho konke okulungile. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Okokuqala, izinkampani zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazo banolwazi olufanele lokusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, izinkampani zidinga ukugcina izinsiza ezanele ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zokuphendula zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube khona ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zihlala zisebenza kahle, futhi izinsiza zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphendula okusheshayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le phrojekthi ibonakala iyimpumelelo enkulu. Izinkampani ezithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuphendula zikhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhle, futhi lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinga lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 sekuyinto ebonakalayo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa izinsizakalo eziningi. Ekugcineni, ukwenziwa kwale phrojekthi kubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bathole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha, okwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu kumakhasimende. Njengoba izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo, kulindeleke ukuthi lezi zikhathi zokuphendula zihlale zincipha, okuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabantu.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezempilo nenhlalakahle, obonakalisa ubuholi bakhe obuqinile emiphakathini ehlukahlukene. Uthole ukuqashelwa kwezifundo zakhe ezikhethekile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ubuholi bakhe bokwenza imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Umlando Nokufunda UThandiwe wazalelwa eThekwini, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ophumelelayo. Wafunda ezikoleni eziphakeme, lapho akwazi khona ukubonisa amakhono akhe ezempilo kusenesikhathi. Ngemuva kokuphothula iBachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB) eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uqhubeke nezifundo zakhe ngokuqhubeka neMaster’s degree kwezempilo yomphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe olandelayo, owawuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile, wambona eqala ukuthola izinkanyezi emkhakheni wakhe. Umsebenzi Wokusebenza UProf. Ntuli uqale umsebenzi wakhe njengodokotela emtholampilo eThekwini, lapho abhekana khona nezinkinga ezinzima, njengezifo ezithathelwanayo kanye nezifo ezihlobene nokuphila kahle. Ubuye wagxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphila, ezagcina ziqinisa impilo yabantu ezindaweni ezisengozini. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukubona uhlelo olukhulu lwenhlalakahle olubalulekile, olwakha izikhungo zempilo ezithuthukile. Ukwenziwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Ukwazisa umsebenzi wakhe, uThandiwe waqala ukuqala imicimbi ethinta impilo yomphakathi, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokweluleka, izinsiza zokwakha imiphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zashintsha impilo yemindeni eminingi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bazinakekele, futhi ziqinisa imiphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe ungumfanekiso weqiniso wokuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigcini nje ngezixazululo zokwelapha, kodwa iyahlanganisa futhi nezindlela zokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukwamukelwa Nezikhumbuzo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uProf. Ntuli wathola izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neNational Health Service Award, ezithokozisa kakhulu imizamo yakhe. Ubuye waba umxhumanisi omkhulu phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo nezinhlangano ezizimele, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zifinyelela kulabo abazidingayo. Imicimbi Yezempilo Nezokwelapha UProf. Ntuli ungasoloko athola imicimbi emisha, efaka phakathi izinsuku zokuhlonipha impilo, lapho abamba khona izifundo ezihlobene nemikhuba emihle yokuphila. Lezi zinsuku zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile kahle, zigqugquzela imiphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekwakheni izimo ezingcono zokuphila. Ubuye abambe imihlangano yokufundisa, lapho abaholi bendawo befundiswa ngempumelelo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zempilo. Imiphumela Nalokho Okuzayo Ngaphandle kwamazinga aphezulu okuphumelela, uProf. Ntuli uhlala ebheka phambili. Ubelokhu esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi ithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Uthi: “Umsebenzi wami awupheli lapha. Ngihlose ukuhamba phambili, ngithuthukise amakhono ezempilo, futhi ngisize abanye ukuba baphile impilo engcono.” Ubuye wanikela ngengxoxo ezinkulu ezithinta izinhlelo zomphakathi, eqinisekisa ukuthi imicimbi yakhe iqhubeka nokwenza umehluko. Isiphetho UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli ungumfanekiso ohloniphekile weqiniso lesimiso sokubaluleka kwempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, nokwakha imiphakathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokwakha umhlaba ongcono. Igama lakhe libuye libe yinsika yokukhuthaza abanye abaholi ukuze baqhubeke nezinhlelo ezenzakalayo zokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuphumelele imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle. Njengoba eqhubeka, uProf. Ntuli uzoba yisibonelo sokuphila kahle, esikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela efanele.
Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni: IsiNgisi NesiZulu Kulezi zinsuku, umhlaba wethu ub faced with an unprecedented challenge—ukukhula kokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile futhi ezibambisene, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, ezemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kubalulekile ukufaka isandla ekusekeleni izilimi eziningi, okuhlanganisa isiNgisi nesiZulu. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isiZulu, njengolimi lwezizinda, linomlando ocebile futhi luwusizo ekwakheni ubunye phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kube nokusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi, abafundisi, nabazali, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokweseka isiZulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa kahle isiZulu ezikoleni, ukwakha izinsiza ezifanele, kanye nokudala indawo yokukhuluma nokuqonda phakathi kwabafundi. Kodwa-ke, isiNgisi sibuye sibe nendima ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lomhlaba. Njengoba uNingizimu Afrika ihamba phambili ekukhuleni komnotho, isiNgisi siba ulwimi oluyinhloko emikhakheni eminingi, okuhlanganisa ezokuxhumana, ezemfundo, nezobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganisa isiNgisi, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ezingeni lemfundo nasemisebenzi. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akugcini nje ngokufundisa izilimi; kubalulekile futhi ukukhuthaza umqondo wokuhlonipha izilimi ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokukhuluma isiZulu nesiNgisi, ngasikhathi sinye, ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuzethemba kwabafundi, kubavumele ukuba bakhulume kahle futhi bahloniphe izilimi zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhuthaze ukusekela izilimi eziningi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-webinars, nemithombo ye-inthanethi kufanele kube yinto evamile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuhlanganyela ngolimi oluthile, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abafundi bakwazi ukufaka izimvo zabo ngesiZulu nesiNgisi ngempumelelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukuze zabelane ngempumelelo nezindlela zokusebenza. Izikhungo ezahlukene zingafunda komunye nomunye, zabelane ngamasu okuphumelela, futhi zixhumane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kuqhubeka nokuqiniswa. Ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo kuzo zonke izilimi kudinga ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ekuqedeni, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kumele kube yisivumelwano phakathi kwezindlela eziningi zokufunda, izinhlelo, nezinsiza. Ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi onobumbano, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izilimi zikhuliswa futhi zisetshenziswa ngokulinganayo. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabafundi, kubavumele ukuba bakhule, baphumelele, futhi bagcine isiko labo liphila. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akukhona kuphela ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwakha umqondo wokuhloniphana nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu abakhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukukha amathuba, ukwakha ubumbano, nozwelonke olukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi osebenzisanayo, ophumelelayo, nolungiswayo, lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi baveza izimvo zabo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqhubeke nokweseka izilimi eziningi, ziqinise amakhono ebhizinisi, futhi zikhuthaze ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wesizwe esihloniphayo, esikhaliphe, futhi esisheshayo.
### Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokukhula okuhle kwezingane. Le nqubo ibandakanya izinyathelo ezahlukene ezithinta ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuvikelwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane ezincane. Kulokhu, sizoqhubeka sithinta izigaba ezibalulekile zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kusukela ekufikeni kwazo ezibhedlela, kuya ekunakekelweni kwazo. #### Ukufika Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Lapho ingane ifika ezibhedlela, ibhekwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abezokwelapha, abahlengikazi, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo abaneziqu. Ukuqala, ingane ibhekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphilile futhi ayinazo izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Abahlengikazi bahlola isisindo, ukuphila, nezimpawu zempilo zengane. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iyakwazi ukujabulisa impilo yayo. #### Ukuhlola Nokunakekela Ngemuva kokuhlola, abahlengikazi baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi ingane iyathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina ingane ifudumele, iyakwazi ukuphefumula kahle, nokuyinika ukudla okufanele. Uma ingane idinga ukudla, abahlengikazi bahlola ukuthi ingane iyakwazi ukuncela kahle. Uma kudingeka, bangasebenzisa izindlela ezihlukile zokudla, njengokusebenzisa ifomula yokudla uma ingane ingakwazi ukuncela kahle. #### Ukuxhumana Nezingane Ukuxhumana nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kubalulekile. Abazali bencike kakhulu ekuxhumaneni nezingane zabo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba abahlengikazi bahlale beqaphele. Uxhumano oluhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali lwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezithile. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi uma benemibuzo noma bekhathazekile ngezimpilo zezingane zabo. #### Ukuvikelwa Kwezingane Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akugcini nje ngokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuvikelwa kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikela izingane ezinsongweni ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezifo, ukuvuvukala, noma izimo zokuphila ezingezinhle. Abahlengikazi bahlola izimpawu zokugula futhi benza izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane ivikelekile. #### Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Ngaphezu kokunakekelwa kwezempilo, abahlengikazi banomsebenzi wokuthuthukisa izinga lokukhula kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina izingane zikhula kahle, zikhula ngokomzimba, nangokwengqondo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abahlengikazi bahlola izindlela zokukhula, izidingo zokudla, kanye nezimo zokuphila. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezingane luhlanganisa izindlela zokukhuthaza ukukhula okuhle, ezifana nokubamba izingane, ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokudlala, nokuxhumana. #### Ukunakekelwa Kwabazali Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli kuphela ezingeni lezingane, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukunakekela abazali. Abazali badinga ukwesekwa ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi, bazi ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele, futhi baqonde izinqubo ezihambisanayo. Abahlengikazi bangenza izinkulumo ezibalulekile nabazali ukuze baqondise izinqubo zokunakekela izingane zabo. #### Ukuqhubeka Nokunakekela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli lapho ingane isitholele impilo. Ukuqhubeka nokunakekela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iyakhula kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlolwa okuvamile, ukufundiswa kwabazali, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi uma bekhathazekile. Ukuze ingane ikwazi ukujabulisa impilo yayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlengikazi baqhubeke nokunakekela. #### Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokukhula okuhle. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula zibe nekhono, ziqinile, futhi zihlala ziphilile. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akuyona nje umsebenzi wezempilo, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yethu, njengoba zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okukhulu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni ezinjalo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi eminyakeni yamuva, izindlela ezahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe le nqubo. Ezikhathini ezedlule, izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zazingakwazi ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, ukulimala okukhulu, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezazithinta imindeni eminingi. Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, izinhlelo ezahlukene ziye zashintshwa, kuhlanganiswa nezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifika ngesikhathi esifanele. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula kube ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-GPS. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo eziphatha izicelo zokuphuthumayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinsiza eziphuthumayo zingathola ngokushesha indawo yokwakha, ziqinisekise ukuthi zifika lapho kudingeka khona. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nesikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo, okwandisa amathuba okuthi abantu abathintekayo basindiswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo ziye zathuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuxhumana. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, njengokuxhumana ngocingo, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, kanye nezixhumanisi ze-inthanethi, kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukuxhumana kalula. Lokhu kubalulekile ekutholeni ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi eziphusile. Ukusebenza ngamasu afanele nawo kubalulekile ekwandiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ziye zathuthukisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bazo, ukuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha amakhono, okwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokwandiswa kwemizamo yokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula, imiphakathi ibonisa ukukhula okukhulu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ziye zanda ukufika ezindaweni ezidingekayo ngaphezu kokuthola izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ziye zanda ukuthuthukiswa, okusheshisa izinqubo zokusebenza. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okukhanya. Kunzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, ikakhulu ezindaweni ezikude noma ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezengeziwe, kuhlanganise nezimoto ezinhle, amathuluzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Abaholi bendawo badinga ukusungula izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bahlala bephephile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuzivikela emiphakathini ziye zabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu bendawo kumasu okuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kungasiza ukunciphisa umthwalo ezinsizakalweni. Lokhu kuvumela umphakathi ukuba ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okusiza ekubhekaneni neziyaluyalu ezithile. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwababusi, izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo, nemiphakathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwababheki, kuhlanganisa nemizamo yokwakha ulwazi, kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuba imiphakathi ibhekane neziyaluyalu ezinzima. Njengoba sikhula, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokwenza ngcono lezi zinhlelo ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, sigcine imiphakathi yethu iphephile futhi inempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umgomo wethu kumele kube ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuhlola izinhlelo zethu, siqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenziseka, futhi sithuthukise amasu okuphendula ukuze baqede izingozi ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha impilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo siyisisekelo sokuphila komphakathi.
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Kwake kwaba nesikhathi esikhethekile emsebenzini kaMnumzane Dlamini, umphathi omkhulu wezokuthengisa enkampanini edume kakhulu eGoli. Uhlanga lwakhe lwaluhlala lukhanya, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokuphatha abukhumbuleki. Kodwa, uMnumzane Dlamini wayazi ukuthi imisebenzi emihle ayizwakali kuphela ngezinga lokusebenza, kodwa futhi nangezindlela zokuhlonipha abasebenzi bakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi sokuphela konyaka, uMnumzane Dlamini wanquma ukuthi kufanele kube nesigcawu sokuhlonipha abasebenzi abaphumelele. Wazi kahle ukuthi abasebenzi bencike kakhulu ekwenzeni kahle kwenkampani, futhi lokho bekufanele kudunyiswe. Wabiza umhlangano nabaphathi bakhe ukuze baphakamise iziphakamiso zokuthi bangabazisa kanjani abasebenzi. “Ngiyacabanga ukuthi kufanele sibe nemiklomelo,” kusho uMnumzane Dlamini, ethokozisa ababekhona. “Sizokwenza umcimbi omkhulu, lapho sizokwazi khona ukuhlabela abasebenzi bethu abahamba phambili. Lokhu kuzobakhuthaza futhi kubenze bazizwe bebalulekile.” Abaphathi bamukele le mbono ngenjabulo, futhi baqala ukuhlela umcimbi. Bafuna ukuhlela indawo ethokomele, ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza imiklomelo, nezinsiza zokuhlela umcimbi. Kwakuyisikhathi sokubambisana, futhi bonke babebonisa umoya ophakeme. Njengoba umcimbi usondela, uMnumzane Dlamini wathola ukuthi abasebenzi babezithokozisa, bejabulela ukwazi ukuthi bazobonwa. Kwakukhona abanye abasebenzi ababevele bephumelele izindondo ezinkulu eminyakeni edlule, kodwa abanye babephupha nje kuphela. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuthi bonke bazizwe beqhakazile. Umcimbi wenzeka ngosuku olukhanyayo, lapho umoya wawuhlabelela izinkanyezi. Abasebenzi baphuma bezimnandi, behlabelela izigubhu zothando nemfudumalo. UZanele, umphathi wezokusebenza, wayehlezi phambili, elungiselela izinkanyezi ezizoboniswa. “Ngiyazi ukuthi sonke sizobonisa uthando lwethu,” kusho yena, ecela wonke umuntu ukuba azizwe ethokozile. Lapho umcimbi uqala, uMnumzane Dlamini wanikeza isingeniso esifushane, echaza ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile. “Siyazi ukuthi umsebenzi oncomekayo awuqhamuki kuphela emsebenzini, kodwa nakuwo wonke umuntu. Ngakho, namuhla sizokhonza abaphumelele, abakhombisa ukuzinikela, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokubambisana.” Kwathi lapho izinkanyezi ziqala ukuhamba phambili, abanye abasebenzi baphakanyiswa. UThabo, owawaziwa ngempela ngokuqhuba kahle imikhankaso yokuthengisa, wathola umklomelo omkhulu. Wazizwa ejabule, kodwa akazange akhohlwe abanye. “Ngiyabonga, kodwa lokhu akukaze kube yimi kuphela. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke abanguwe, ngoba sabelana ngempumelelo,” kusho yena, ethokozisa bonke ababe khona. UThandi, owayengumqondisi wezokuthengisa, naye wathola umklomelo. Wabanjwa umoya wokujabula, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi le mikhankaso ibalulekile, kodwa akukaze kube yimi kuphela. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke abahlanganyela, ngoba sabelana ngempumelelo.” Umcimbi wawuhamba kahle, futhi wonke umuntu waba nesikhathi esihle. Uhlanga lokuhlonipha abanye lwalukhanya, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayejabule kakhulu. Wayazi ukuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonipha, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya ophilayo emsebenzini. Ngemuva komcimbi, uMnumzane Dlamini wabona izinguquko ezinkulu. Abasebenzi babebonisa umdlandla, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhula. Kwakukhona ukuvuselelwa emsebenzini, futhi bonke babefuna ukuba ngcono. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayezazi ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono emsebenzini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zenzakalo zaba yisifundo esikhulu. Uhlanga lokuhlonipha abanye lwalukhula, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini waba yisibonelo sokuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonipha, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya ophilayo. Abasebenzi babebonisa uthando, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu enkampanini. Ngakho, umcimbi wokuhlonipha abaphumelele waba yinkanyezi, futhi wakhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi umoya wokubambisana, uthando, nokuhlonipha ungakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Uhlanga lwemiklomelo lwalukhanya, futhi bonke babebonisa ukuthi umphakathi ophilayo ungabamba izinkanyezi. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayazi ukuthi imiklomelo izohlala ibalulekile emsebenzini.
Umbiko: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphendula Ngemizuzu Eyishumi Nanhlanu Isingeniso Ekuthuthukiseni nasekuhloleni izinga lokuphendula kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukufinyelela isikhathi sokuphendula esibekiwe. Kulokhu, sihlole ukuthi izinsizakalo zethu zikwazi yini ukuphendula ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lo mbiko uzogxila ekuboneni indlela esifezile ngayo isikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15, izinselelo esihlangabezane nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu. Uhlolojikelele Ukuze sihlaziye ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula, sathatha izinsuku ezingu-30 ukuze sihloloze ukusebenza kwethu. Lokhu kuhilela izinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zokuphuma. Kubalulekile ukusetha izinkomba ezicacile zokusebenza ukuze sikwazi ukukala impumelelo yethu. Izinhloso zethu zazihlanganisa ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula, ukwengeza ukusebenza kahle, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izindlela Zokuhlola Ukuze sithole imiphumela ecacile, sakha uhlelo lokuhlola olwakhiwe ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo: 1. Ukuqoqwa Kwemininingwane: Sasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze siqoqe idatha ngalesi sikhathi sokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukulandela izikhathi ezithathwa yizinsizakalo zethu ukuze zifeze izicelo eziphuthumayo. 2. Ukuhlaziywa Kwemininingwane: Ngemva kokuqoqwa kwemininingwane, sahlaziya imiphumela ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo eziphumelela kakhulu nokuthi yiziphi ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3. Ukwenza Izinguquko: Ngemuva kokuhlaziya, sathatha izinyathelo ezithile zokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinqubo ezintsha. Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuphothula lesi sikhathi sokuhlola, sithole imiphumela emihle. Ukuphendula kwethu kwehlile kusuka ezinsukwini ezingu-20 kuya kwezingu-15, okukhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu ekusebenzeni kwethu. Izinsizakalo ezinjengokwelashwa zaphakanyiswa, futhi isikhathi sokuphendula saphumelela kakhulu. Nakuba kunezinsizakalo ezithile ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi sizokwazi ukufezekisa izinjongo zethu. Izinselelo Eziqhamukayo Noma sithole impumelelo, sithole nezinselelo ezithile. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kwakungukusebenza kweqembu. Abasebenzi abaningana babengakakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni elidingekayo lokuphendula, okwakubangelwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa ukungabi neziqu ezanele kanye nezinsiza ezincane. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi sithuthukisa ukuqeqeshwa kwethu futhi sithole izinsiza ezanele ukuze sikwazi ukufeza izinjongo zethu. Izinyathelo Ezithathiwe Ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu, sathatha izinyathelo ezilandelayo: 1. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi: Sihlele izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ukuze sithuthukise amakhono abasebenzi bethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda izinqubo eziphuthumayo, ukuxhumana kahle, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezisheshayo. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza: Siphinde sathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo. 3. Ukusebenza Ngemva Kokuhlola: Sazisa izinsizakalo ezithile ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa futhi sakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwazo. Isiphetho Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 kube yimpumelelo enkulu, nakuba sithole nezinselelo. Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi sithuthukise kakhulu ukusebenza kwethu, futhi sithole izindlela zokwenza ngcono. Njengoba siqhubeka, sizogxila ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zethu, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza izinqubo zethu zibe ngcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezikhiqizayo, okuzothuthukisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende nokuqinisekisa ukuthi sifeza izinjongo zethu. Sizokuqhubeka nokuhlola ukusebenza kwethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola izinga eliphezulu lokuphendula ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemva Kwezikhathi Zamahloli Isingeniso Ngenkathi zamaholide, abantu bavame ukuhamba, bejabulela izikhathi zokuphumula, kanye nezinsuku ezikhethekile zokuhlangana nomndeni nabangani. Nokho, lokhu kuhambo nokujabula kuza nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokunakekelwa kwabantu. Kulesi sikhathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwezimo ezingalindelekile, okuhlanganisa izigameko zokwelashwa, ukuhambisa abantu ezindaweni eziphuthumayo, kanye nemisebenzi yokuvikela. Izinsizakalo Zokwelashwa Ngokujwayelekile, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibandakanya izikhungo zokwelashwa eziphezulu, ezihlinzeka ngempumelelo ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zabantu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Emazweni amaningi, izikhungo zokwelapha zihlala zifinyeleleka, futhi abezempilo bahlala bekulungele ukusiza, kungakhathalekile ukuthi umphakathi usendaweni yokuphumula noma ehamba. Ngokwengxenye, izikhungo zempilo zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ezindaweni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuhlinzeka izivakashi ngendawo yokwelashwa elula uma izimo ziphuthuma. Ubuye ubone ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zenzeka ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bakhona lapho kufanele. Ukwenza Imisebenzi Yokuhamba Ezinsukwini zamaholide, ukuhamba kubaluleke kakhulu. Izinsizakalo zokuhamba, ezifana nezokuthutha, zikhonza njengezinto ezisemqoka ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Uhlelo lokuhamba luhlala luthuthukiswa ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ngezikhathi zamaholide, izimo eziphuthumayo zingase zenzeke, njengokuphazamiseka kokuhamba noma izingozi ezithinta abantu. Izinsizakalo zokuhamba zisebenzisa izimoto ezikhethekile, okuhlanganisa izithuthi ezithutha abantu abanezimo eziphuthumayo ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baye ezikhungweni zokwelapha noma ezingxenyeni zokwelapha ngempumelelo. Ukwengeza, abantu bahlala bezazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhamba zikhona, okuyinto edala ukuthula kwengqondo. Ukubambisana Kwezikhulu Zomphakathi Ngokweqile, ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhulu zomphakathi, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthutha kubalulekile. Lokhu kubambisana kuhlanganyela izinsiza ezifanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola usizo olusheshayo. Izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuhlela kahle izinsizakalo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zingathuthukiswa ngokuhlanganyela, kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izigameko eziphuthumayo ziphathwa kahle, futhi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ukubambisana okuhle kuholela ekuphumeleleni kwezinsizakalo, okuthuthukisa izinga lokuphepha emphakathini. Ukuqwashisa Komphakathi Ngokuphumelelayo, ukukhuthaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngalezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile. Imiphakathi kufanele iqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zitholakala, futhi zihlala zikhona uma kudingeka. Izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi zingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsizakalo ezikhona, nezindlela zokufinyelela kuzo. Ukukhuthaza ukuqwashisa kumayelana nokuhlanganyela nabezimpilo, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthutha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela izinsizakalo, futhi baqonde izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe uma behlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuqwashisa komphakathi kuzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphepha, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Isiphetho Ngokuhlonipha izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, ukwaziwa kwemisebenzi ethile kubaluleke kakhulu. Njengoba izikhathi zamaholide ziwusuku lokuphumula, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe neziqu eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo. Ukwaziswa ngobuchwepheshe nokuqwashisa komphakathi kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinsizakalo zibe ngcono, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kanye nezokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zikhona, ngakho-ke, abantu bazothola usizo oludingekayo.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokunakekelwa Kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekunikezeni abantu ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezempilo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, ukufakwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umehluko phakathi kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezindaweni ezahlukene, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu bonke. Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokucwaninga, kanye nezikhungo zokufundisa. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezifo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ulwazi olufanele lungasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo yabo. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinhlaka zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nolufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifake ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi sebekhuluma nge-inthanethi, futhi ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo nge-inthanethi kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zisebenza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi. Lezi mikhankaso zihlala ziqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuvikelwa kwezifo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinqumo zabo zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Kodwa-ke, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ububha, obuvimbela abantu abaningi ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezisemaphandleni zidinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanele. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izikhungo eziningi ezisemaphandleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ulwazi lwezempilo olufanele, oluthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuxhaswa, kanye nokuzinikela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu bethu bazi kahle ngezempilo zabo, futhi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Umbuzo 1: Yini eyenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, umama udinga ukunakekelwa kahle. Izibhedlela zisebenzisa izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi odokotela abanolwazi, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhaliphile. Umama kufanele agcinwe ethokomele, kanti izingane zidinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhula kahle. Umbuzo 2: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ngemuva kokubeletha? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuphumula okwanele. Kubalulekile ukudla ukudla okunempilo ukuze akhuthaze ukukhiqizwa kwegazi, futhi afune usizo uma kudingeka. Ukuhlola impilo yakhe, kanye nokubona ukuthi ingane iyaphila, kubalulekile. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Izinyathelo zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa zifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukugcina ingane ibanda, kanye nokunikeza ukudla okufanele. Izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho izinkinga zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngengane ngezakhamzimba ezifanele. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinkinga ezivame ukwenzeka ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinkinga ezivame ukwenzeka zifaka phakathi ukungaphatheki kahle, ukushisa okukhulu, noma izinkinga zokuphefumula. Ukuhlolwa kwempilo okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale lezi zinkinga ngesikhathi. Abahlengikazi bahlola izingane njalo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi zikhula kahle. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenziwa uma ingane ingaphatheki kahle? Impendulo: Uma ingane ingaphatheki kahle, abahlengikazi bazoqala ngezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlola amazinga okushisa, ukuphendula kwezingane, kanye nezimpawu zempilo. Uma kudingeka, umntwana angathola ukwelashwa okusheshayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uphila kahle. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe umama unelungelo lokukhuluma noDokotela? Impendulo: Yebo, umama unelungelo lokukhuluma noDokotela noma abahlengikazi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi ukuthi bangabeka imibuzo ngezinkinga zabo, futhi baziqinisekise ukuthi bayawuqonda umthelela wokunakekelwa kwezingane zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komama nabasebenzi bezempilo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ikhulile kahle? Impendulo: Umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ithola ukudla okufanele, izinsiza zokunakekelwa, futhi iboniswa uthando. Ukuthola usizo lwezokwelapha njalo, kanye nokulandela izeluleko zodokotela, kubalulekile ukuze ingane ikhulise impilo yayo. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ukuze azinakekele? Impendulo: Umama kufanele azinakekele ngokuphila kahle, ukuhamba, futhi abheke impilo yakhe. Ukuthola usizo kumngane noma emndenini, ukuze akwazi ukuphumula, kubalulekile. Ukuze akwazi ukunakekela ingane, umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi naye uyaphila. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izibhedlela zikhona ezikhethekile zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezibhedlela ezikhethekile ezihlinzeka ngempilo yezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lezi zibhedlela zihlala zinezinqubo ezithile ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela izingane, ezihlanganisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, abahlengikazi abanolwazi, kanye nodokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Umbuzo 10: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze usize umama nezingane? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa umama, ezifana nezinsiza zokunakekela izingane, izifundo zokunakekela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphila kahle. Ukuxhasa umama ngemali, izinsiza, noma ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ikhulile kahle. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yabo. Ukuqonda lezi zinyathelo, kanye nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi komama nabasebenzi bezempilo, kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Umama, umphakathi, kanye nezibhedlela kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula ziphilile, zithokozile, futhi zikhululekile.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula EZimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zethu zokuqhubekela phambili, izimo eziphuthumayo zibe yinsakavukela emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuphendula okusheshayo nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayasindiswa futhi izinsiza zikhona ekufuneni usizo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubalulekile, njengoba kunciphisa ukulimala nokuwa kwabantu. Ubufakazi bokuthi izigameko eziphuthumayo zidinga ukuphendula okusheshayo bukhona emihlanganweni, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini engaphansi kwenhlekelele. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphendula kudinga ukwakhiwa kwesixazululo esihloniphekile. Kubalulekile ukufaka amakhono ezobuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza. Izinhlelo eziqondile zidinga ukuklama imishini yokuphendula ngokushesha, ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nezikhungo zokusiza, nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto zisebenza kahle. Izinsiza ezilikomidiwe zidinga ukufakwa ocwaningweni lwemiphakathi, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okukhona nezidingo zabantu. Ezinsukwini ezedlule, imiphakathi ibhekane nezinsuku ezinzima ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kanye nezimo zezulu ezibandakanya izixhumi. Lokhu kubonise ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, izikhungo zokuphendula, nokwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokubambisana ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka eziqondile nezinhlelo zokwenza ukuze konke kugcine kukhululekile futhi kuqinile. Umsebenzi wokuqeqesha abantu abaningi uye waqala ukuthathwa ngokweqile. Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi eziphuthumayo, abezindaba, kanye nabantu bendawo kudinga ukuba zikhulume imishado yokubambisana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bakha izinyathelo eziqine zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele kakhulu kulandela i-PPR (Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support) kanye ne-EMT (Emergency Medical Technician) kudinga ukufundiswe emiphakathini. Ukusebenza kahle kwezikhungo zempilo, izikhungo zokusiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinsiza ziqhubeke ziqinise izinqubo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo ukuze zigculise izidingo zomphakathi. Kunomthelela omkhulu uma izikhungo zempilo zenziwa zanele ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngesikhathi esifanele. Izifundo zempela zezakhamuzi, okuhlanganisa ezinye izifundo zempilo ezifana nokwephula umthetho, zimqoka ukuze ziphumelelane ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nemikhankaso yokufundisa isizinda esiqinile ukuze abantu bazi imiphumela yokuhlolisisa izimo eziphuthumayo ngokushesha. Imfundo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle okudingekayo, futhi kunciphise izingozi ezibangelwa ukungaqondi kahle izimo ezinzima. Uhlaka lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo harusho ngqo ezimisele ukuphendula okusheshayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kuhlanga okukhulu ekupheleni kwezimpendulo ezinqala. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza nokuqonda okuqinile, imiphakathi izoba namandla okuqinisa ukuhlela ngaphambi kokuba izigameko eziphuthumayo zenzeke. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwezixhobo zempilo, ukuqeqeshwa kwempilo yomphakathi, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinqubo ezinzima zidinga ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo. Akukhona ukukhuluma nje ngezinsiza, kodwa nokwakha isimo esivumelanayo sokuphendula okuphumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nemiphakathi kuzwelonke kumele kube yisisekelo sokwakha isixazululo esiqinile esihambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nasezingeni eliphezulu, kuhlale kuhlelekile ukuze sihlinzeke ngezinsiza nezixazululo ezidingekayo. Umsebenzi wethu ukufaka isiphetho sokuthi ukuhlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nemizamo eqhubekayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikelwa, ukusindiswa, nokwenza ngcono impilo yabantu ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Iziphakamiso eziqondile, ukwaziswa okufanele, nokuhlanganyela kuhola ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula, phakathi kwemiphakathi nezinhlaka. Lezi zinyathelo zizoqhubeka ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwethu, okuholela empilweni engcono nasemphakathini osizayo.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi Ingxoxo Nenduna Yezempilo Yomphakathi, uMnu. Mthembu Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, Mnu. Mthembu. Siyakwamukela kulolu hlelo lwezempilo nezokuphila kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngithokozile ukwazi ukusiza nokukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Umxhumanisi: Ukuze siqale, ungakwazi ukusichazela ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kangakanani? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, imicimbi yezempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ithinta impilo yawo wonke umuntu emiphakathini. Le micimbi ifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokugqugquzela impilo, imikhankaso yokwelapha, kanye nemihlangano yokwakha ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezifo ezithathelwana, izindlela zokuphila, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuwumsebenzi omkhulu. Ingabe kunemikhankaso ethile obesebenza kuyo muva nje? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, sithumele imikhankaso eminingi ehloswe ngokuqinisa ulwazi lwezempilo. Isibonelo, sibe neqhaza elikhulu emkhankasweni wokuvimbela izifo ezithathelwana, lapho sikhuthaza abantu ukuba bavakashele izikhungo zezempilo ukuze bahlolwe. Ukwengeza, siphinde sabamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nabantu ukuze sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo, okuholele ekwakheni izindawo zokuxhumana eziphephile. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigxili kuphela ezinkingeni zomzimba. Ucabanga ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile kangakanani emiphakathini yethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Impilo yengqondo iyisici esiyinhloko sempilo yonke. Njengoba sithola ukukhathazeka okuningi, ukuziqhenya, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthi siphinde sikhulume ngalezi zindaba. Imicimbi yethu ihlanganisa izifundo ezikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, futhi sikhuthaza abantu ukuthi baziqhelise ukuthola usizo uma bephila nokucindezelwa. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe uhlanganyela kanjani nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo ukuze kusekelwe le micimbi? Mnu. Mthembu: Hhayi, lokhu kudinga ukubambisana. Sisebenza eduze kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene. Lokhu kusenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezivumelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithumela izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze sibe nokuqonda okuhle kakhulu kwezidingo zomphakathi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu ezinhlelweni zempilo. Ungakuchaza kanjani ukubaluleka kokubambisana kwababambiqhaza? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, ukubambisana kubalulekile. Uma abantu behlangana, bahlanganyela izinsiza, ulwazi, kanye nemithombo. Lokhu kwenza kube nokuhlakanipha okukhudlwana futhi kwandisa amathuba okuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi amandla akhe akhula lapho abantu benza izinto ndawonye. Umxhumanisi: Noma kunjalo, inkinga yokungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele iyenzeka. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo emiphakathini enezinselelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukusungula imikhankaso yokwakha ulwazi ukuze sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baqonde izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokusebenzisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela abantu. Lokhu kudinga uthando, ukuzinikela, kanye nemigomo ecacile yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma. Ngabe kukhona okukhumbulekayo ofuna ukukwabelana nabantu? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi bonke abantu bangenza umehluko. Impilo yethu ithinta wonke umuntu, ngakho kufanele sikhuthaze ukubambisana, ukwazisa, nokuxhumana. Ukusebenza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, nolwazi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu. Uhlanga lwenhlonipho luhamba phambili ekusizeni umphakathi, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu ukuthola imicabango yakho. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngijabule kakhulu ukuba lapha. Hamba kahle!
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okulungele Abasebenzisi Ngempelasonto edlule, insuku ezimnandi zakhula emkhakheni wezokwakha zezikhungo ezizokhuthaza umphakathi, ngendlela ehlelekile futhi enobungane. Lo mcimbi, owenziwe eGoli, wawuhloselwe ukudala izikhungo eziwusizo, lapho abantu bengahlanganyela khona, benze imisebenzi ehlukene, besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo kalula. Imicimbi yasendaweni ibiyinsika yokwakha izikhungo eziyohlala zihamba phambili empilweni yasemphakathini. Ukuvulwa kwalolu suku lodlame olwenzeka esikhungweni sokuxhumana seMidlalo, kwagcwala abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejabulile, begcwele ithemba lokuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezimqoka empilweni yabo nsuku zonke. Kuqala, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela nezingcweti eziphezulu ezithinta izakhiwo, ezokwakha, nezindawo zokusebenza nezokuhlanganyela. Omunye wabaqondisi, uMnu. Mkhize, waphawula ngesidingo sokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi lapho kudingeka ukufaka imizamo emisha yokunciphisa ukhula olungokwezemvelo. "Sidinga izikhungo ezikhethekile ezizodlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu nakusizakali," kugcizelela. Abakhangisi baphinde benza iminikelo yokubambisana, behlukanisa izimpendulo ezahlukene maqondana nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezikhethiweyo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zokudlala izingane, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zokufunda. Abanye nabo banikela ngezixazululo ezisebenza kahle, ezifana nezinsizakusebenza ezenzakalayo nokwakhiwa kwezindawo eziphilayo. Owokwakha umphakathi, uNkk. Dlamini, uthe: "Umsebenzi wezakhiwo awupheli lapha, ngempela, uqhubeka lapho abantu behlangana nabanye, benza imisebenzi eyisiqalo." Ngalesi sikhathi, izikhungo ezithokozisayo zobuchwepheshe baphinde bandele izinsizakalo zazo. Ukuba khona kwezinhlelo zokufunda nokuhlanganyela, okwakwenziwa ngezingxoxo ezithokozisayo kanye ne-workshop, kwanikeza abantu ithuba lokuhlola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha izikhungo ezisebenza kahle. Hhayi kuphela izinhlelo zemfundo, kepha namarobhothi athuthukisa izinqubo zomsebenzi baboniswa, ukuze abantu bazi okuthile okusha ekwakheni. Izikhungo ezitoreyishayo zathokozisa izivakashi eziningana, futhi umhlangano wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphuthumayo, okwenza umphakathi uqhubeke uhamba phambili, izwi lemfundo nemfundo yayingashiyi ngemuva. Umhlangano wawwenyusiwe ngemisebenzi eminingi ehlukene, kufaka phakathi imibukiso yama-artisans, imidlalo yeqembu, nezifundo zokwakha phakathi kwabesifazane abasha. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wahlanganyela ukuze uphumeze imiphumela ehlanganyelwe, kuye kwavela imiklamo emisha yokwakha nezikhungo ezizothuthukisa imiphakathi. Kuzwakalise ukuthi abantu baye bazibuza ukuthi bangayithuthukisa kanjani impilo yabo, kwezomnotho, nasekukhangiseni ngempumelelo. Umsebenzi wasendaweni ubumbene kakhulu, wehlisa unesidingo sokwakha izikhungo eziphilayo nezithuthukisiwe. Kulabo abavaka lezi zikhungo, kusobala ukuthi umphakathi uyakwandisa umqondo wokuhlangana komhlaba, njengoba ucela ukuthi baqhube izinkulumo ezijulile phezu kwezidingo ezinzulu zabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi wahamba phambili, kucacile ukuthi ukufaka izidingo zomphakathi ngaphambili kubalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo ezizothokozisa abantu. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza ikusasa lokhula kwezokwakha ezikhungweni, udaba oluzoqhubeka lungxoxwa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani eziphumelelayo kanye nezazi, uhlu lwezikhungo ezihambelana nezehlukahlukana kwemiphakathi lukhutse, lema nempumelelo izovumela umphakathi wethu ukuba wakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, elizongenela ezikhathini ezizayo. Umcimbi wokwakhiwa kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi ubuhlakani, ubonisa kahle ukuthi umphakathi ungahlala ube yibo obumbene, uma kukhulunywa ngezinkinga eziphilayo. Ngakho-ke, ukwakha izikhungo ezilungiselelwe abasebenzisi akuhambeli phambili, kodwa kungenzeka, ngempela, kube ngumgomo okukhhekhelayo wethu sonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, iziphakamiso aziphumeli kuphela emicimbini, kodwa zikhuthaza wonke umphakathi ukuba enze izinto ngendlela engcono kuzo zonke izindawo zempilo. Njengoba sizokwakha ikusasa, kumqoka ukuthi siphathe izikhungo ezihlangene, ezizothuthukisa imisebenzi ehlukahlukene nezidingo zamapulazi. Lokhu kuzogcina kwenze kube yimpumelelo enkulu kuthi sonke.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Ukuphila kahle komuntu kusekelwa ngempela ezimpilweni zokwelashwa ezitholakala ezikhungweni zezempilo. Lezi zikhungo, ezilungiselelwe ukuletha izinsizakalo ezisemthethweni zezempilo, zinikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuphila, zokwelashwa, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhasa imiphakathi. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda izindawo ezingama-72 zezikhungo zezempilo zentela eNingizimu Afrika. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukuhamba kwezimali nezichasiso Ezikhungweni zezempilo, izikhungo ezasolwandle nezisemkhatsini kwazulu, kukhona indawo yomphakathi ehambisana namathuba okwelapha. Lokhu akukhona nje ukufaka izinga eliphakeme lokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa futhi kubangela uhla lwezikhungo ezithuthukayo ezikhethwe ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho, ukusungulwa kwezakhamuzi nezenzo ezigxile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele kucatshangelwa njengomqondisi. Isigaba sesibili: Izindawo nezinsiza Kunezikhungo eziningi, ezihlukahlukene zokwelapha, ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezinezinsiza ezihlukene. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi izibhedlela, ama-clinic, nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Izibhedlela zihlala zihamba phambili ekunikezeni usizo lwezokwelapha oluphuthumayo, kuyilapho ama-clinic ewumgcinimafa kabusha ukusebenza okuncane, okuvame ukugxila ekunikezeni imiphumela emihle. Izikhungo zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukusondela ezinsizakalweni kubantu abaningana, zigcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana komphakathi. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukuphathwa kwezempilo Ukuphathwa kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika kudinga ukuba kudlule izigaba ezithile. Ukuze lezi zikhungo ukuze zisebenze kangcono, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezizinda zomphakathi. Lesi sigaba senza ukuthi izikhungo zilethe izinsizakalo ezithile eziphumelelayo, zezehlise izindleko eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Isigaba sesine: Izinhlelo eziqhubekayo Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zolwazi nezokuthuthukisa zidingeka ukuze kulungiswe amalungelo ezempilo kubantu bonke. Izikhungo ezingama-72 zidinga ukugcina ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo nabantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazi ngempela izinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ukuxhumana okuthile, nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa, kulethe izibopho eziningi phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo nemiphakathi. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ubuchwepheshe obusha Ubuchwepheshe bukhula kashukela emkhakheni wezempilo, kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezahlukene ezikhungweni. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezokuxilongwa, kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi zidingeka ukuba zithuthukiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zingakwazi ukusiza abantu ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lezi zinhlelo zengeza ngendlela yokuthola ukwaziswa kusebenza kwempilo, okuholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokwelapha. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ukuhlonishwa nokuphila kwabantu Ukuhlonishwa kwabantu kufanele kube okuyinhloko empilweni yezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Ukuphila kwabantu kuncike ebubhalweni obuhle nezinhlelo zempilo ezikhethiwe. Izikhungo ezizwana nazo ziza nezinhlelo ezithile ezithuthukayo, ezihlosiwe ukuheha abantu ukuphila kahle, balandela izinqubo ezilungile. Isigaba sesishiyagalombili: Ukubheka phambili Uma sibheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ezikhethiwe zezeMpilo ezingama-72 ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, zenzeka ngezindlela ezintsha. Imiphakathi kumele ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisha, lapho izimpumelelo ezifanele kufanele zibhale unyaka. Lokhu kuzothelela ukuhamba phambili kwezempilo ezindawo ezahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izifunda ezivuthayo, ngendlela yokwenza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kube khona nokuqhubekayo. Isiphetho Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zinemisebenzi ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo emiphakathini. Lezi zikhungo ziphikisana nenhloso yokuhlinganisa ukusebenza kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizokwazi ukuvikelwa ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabantu, kuzobamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni imiphakathi enempilo. Kuhle ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi onzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okwemvelo, okuhloniphekile, nolungile.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Kwazulu, emhlabeni ogcwele izimanga, kukhona izindawo eziningi ezisemqoka ezikhona ukuze ziqinisekise impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu. Kukhona izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, ezihlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene, ezibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi. Lezi zikhungo zikhona ezindaweni ezikude neziseduzane, ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola izikhungo ezinkulu ezisemadolobheni, lapho kubonakala khona izinsiza ezithuthukile, odokotela abanolwazi, nezinsiza zokwelapha ezisebenzayo. Lezi zikhungo zihlala ziqhuba imisebenzi yokuvikela impilo, njengezinhlelo zokuhlola izifo ezithathelwana, kanye nezifundo zokuphila kahle. Umphakathi uthola ithuba lokuthola imishanguzo, izeluleko zokudla, kanye nezifundo zokuzivocavoca. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola izikhungo ezincane ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bathole usizo lwezempilo. Lezi zikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngezindlela ezithile, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala benza imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Njengoba abantu behlangana ezikhungweni, kuba nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango nezinto abahlangabezane nazo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yokwazisa, lapho abantu beziswa ngezifo ezithile, izindlela zokuzivimbela, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyazi kahle izindlela zokuphila kahle, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa izinga lezifo. Ngenxa yokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokuthola imishanguzo, izeluleko zokudla, kanye nezifundo zokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba impilo ibaluleke kakhulu. Izikhungo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukile. Lokhu kubandakanya izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithinta izifo ezinzima, njengokwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo, izifo zempilo yengqondo, kanye nezifo ezithathelwana. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala beqeqeshwe ukuze banikeze usizo olufanele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Ekugcineni, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, lezi zikhungo ziza nezixazululo ezithuthukisa impilo. Umhlaba unothando, futhi izikhungo zezempilo zikhombisa ukuthi impilo iyigugu elikhulu, elidinga ukunakekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba ezikhungweni zezempilo, khumbula ukuthi lezi zindawo azikhona nje kuphela zokwelapha, kodwa zikhona ukuze ziqinise umphakathi. Zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi impilo iyinto engaphezulu kokuphila—iyinto yokuphila kahle, yokubambisana, nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba impilo ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi izikhungo zezempilo ziyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sidinga ukusizana ukuze siphile kahle.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela: Ukuhlola Ngaphandle Kweqhinga Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke yezokwelapha. Umsebenzi wokuqala ofaneleka kakhulu uma isiguli sifika esibhedlela, ukubhaliswa kwaso kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izidingo zayo ziqashelwa, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubhaliswa kuletha uthobekile, kulungele isiguli ukuxhumana nodokotela nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Iziguli zifanele zigcwaliswe izincwadi ezithile lapho zifika. Lokhu kubhaliswa akugcini nje ngokufaka igama, ubudala, noma isikhumbuzo somndeni; kudinga futhi imininingwane yokuhlola isimo sempilo yesiguli kanye nemigomo ethile yokwelashwa. Kuyisinyathelo esiqondisa iziguli zomzimba noshayela ezoshintsha ukuphila kwazo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimo zikhona ngaphambi kokuqhubeka nokwelashwa. Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zokubhaliswa kweziguli eqhubekayo yimikhiqizo yezeMpilo. Njengoba iziguli zifaka izincwadi zazo, kufanele zihlola kakhudlwana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bagcine imiyalelo ethile kanye nezitifiketi ezakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kungaholela ekujoleni izinsiza ezithile ezidingekayo neluleme iziguli ukuthi zithole ukunakekelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu. Ukuhlola imininingwane yokubhaliswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabantu kubalulekile kumasevisi ezokwelapha. Kumathuba amaningi, iziguli zidinga ukwazi izinqubo ezibandakanya ukubhaliswa okufanele. Lokhu kuqondisa iziguli ngempela, zibuza imibuzo eqondile futhi zifinyelele emathubeni akhuthazayo. Ngesikhatsi sokubhaliswa, iziguli zingakhohlisa imicabango yazo, zibe neqhaza elibhekene nezinyathelo ezithinta impilo, futhi zizithokozise ngempela ukwamukela imiphumela ethile. Ukwazisa iziguli ngezinqubo ezithinta ukubhaliswa kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma abahlinzeki benza imihlangano neziguli. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engcono yokubhaliswa nezidingo ezincane ezitholakalayo kudala isikhala sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, okwandisa umuzwa wokudingeka kokuba iziguli zibhaliswe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bezempilo banikeze ithuba lokukhuluma, banikeze imihlahlandlela, nokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphusile. Ngokuphindaphindiwe, ukubhaliswa kweziguli kuhambisana nezimiso ezithile ezisemqoka, ezinjengezinhloso ezinhle zokubhaliswa nokuxhumana. Umsebenzi walu okhethekile waziwa kakhulu phakathi kwenhlangano ethuthukayo, uhambisana nezinhloso ezicacile ezizosiza iziguli ezikhethekile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zazo. Lokhu kubhaliswa kusebenza njengesikhumbuzo esiqavile sempilo esiguquguqukayo. Uma kwenzeka iziguli zingezelela imikhuba yokubhaliswa, lokhu kubalulekile. Akubalulekile nje ukuba khona kwezinkolelo zenhlangano eyahlukene, kodwa nemithombo yesikhumbuzo iyahlala ibalulekile. Ukuthola imiphumela engase ibaluleke ekugcineni kubaluleke kakhulu, kusiza abahlinzeki bezempilo ukuthi bahlale beqaphile ngezindleko nezindlela eziqhamukayo zokuphatha iziguli. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela akukhawulelwa nje ezinsizeni zokwelapha. Kubalulekile ukuphakamisa ulwazi, ukuxhumana, nokuhlola iziphakamiso ezintsha ezivela phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka endaweni yokwelapha, sinemfanelo yokuhlonipha izimo zempilo ezithile nezidingo ezikhethekile zabantu. Lokhu kubhaliswa akuba umnyango kuphela; kuba yindlela yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi ngokwakha umhlaba ongcono. Sinokubambisana okuhle kuyo yonke imihlangano, sipela silandele lezi ezinjengokubhaliswa, siqhosha isimo sokuphila kwezokwelapha esizayo.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Kwakungokwesikhathi sasebusuku, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo. Ebhakabhakeni, umoya wawuhamba kancane, ulethe umuzwa wokuthula. Kodwa ngaphakathi kwezibhedlela, kwabe sekukhanya okukhanyayo, izwi lezingane ezisanda kuzalwa lalisakazeka, likhombisa umhlaba omusha, umhlaba wezithelo ezimnandi. UThandi, umama omncane, wayephakathi kokukhathazeka nokujabula. Uthando lwakhe lwazalwa emhlabeni, kodwa wayesaba. Wayefuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana wakhe, uSipho, uzothola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngemuva kokubeletha, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezinhle zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheli, kodwa ubuhlungu bokubeletha babumkhathaza. Uthandi wakhumbula izifundo azifundile, ukuthi umntwana udinga uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuphepha. Ngaleso sikhathi, udokotela, uDkt. Mthembu, wangenela. Wayenobungane, enomoya opholile, futhi wakhuluma noThandi ngendlela efanele yokunakekela uSipho. “UThandi,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu, “umntwana wakho udinga ukudla okunempilo, ukulala kahle, nokuthola uthando lwakho. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uSipho uthola konke okudingayo.” UThandi wathokozisa, waba nethemba. Uhlanga lwakhe lwakhe lwalukhanya, njengoba uDkt. Mthembu eqhubeka nokuchaza izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Wafundiswa ukuthi umntwana udinga ukuxhumana nomama wakhe, ukuze akwazi ukujula emhlabeni. Uthandi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana kwangempela kuqala ngothando, futhi lokho kwaba yisisekelo sokukhula kukaSipho. Izinsuku zedlula, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekela izingane. Kwakukhona abahlengikazi abazinikele, ababeqinisekisa ukuthi uSipho uthola ukunakekelwa okuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi abahlengikazi babenobungane, bejabulile, futhi bephendula imibuzo yakhe ngothando. “UThandi, ungakhathazeki,” kusho uNandi, omunye wabahlengikazi. “Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze uSipho akhule kahle. Uthando lwakho luwusizo olukhulu.” UThandi waba nethemba, futhi wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela ukwelashwa, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheli, futhi lokho kwaba yinsika yokukhula kukaSipho. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uSipho wathola ukuvakashelwa ngabazali, abangane, kanye nemindeni. UThandi wathokozisa, njengoba ubudlelwano bukhula. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela izingane, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nezifundo zokuxhumana. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho uqala ukukhula, ethokozisa, futhi ejabulela impilo. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okuhlangabezana Nezidingo Zabasebenzisi: UThandiwe Mthethwa UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo, onothando lokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Wazalelwa edolobheni elincane eMpumalanga, lapho akhulela khona, ebona izinselelo eziningi abantu abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kukhula kumenze abe nomdlandla wokwenza umehluko emphakathini wakhe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMvelo eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uThandiwe waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomklami wezikhungo. Waqala emnyangweni wezokwakha, lapho afunda khona izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. UThandiwe uhlala eqhubeka nezifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono akhe, efunda ngezindlela zokwakha ezihlala isikhathi eside, eziphumelelayo, nezihambisana nemvelo. Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje ukwakha izakhiwo ezinhle, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuqonda izidingo zabantu. Uthandiwe uqonda ukuthi izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinto ezithokozisayo, ezilula ukufinyelela, futhi ezihlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala emisebenzini yakhe, lapho ehlanganisa izimvo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe izikhungo ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. UThandiwe uphinde abe nomdlandla wokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ekwakheni izikhungo. Uhlale ebheka izindlela ezintsha, ezifana nokusebenzisa izinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela emvelweni. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokwakha izikhungo ezihlala isikhathi eside, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandiwe uphinde abe nomsebenzi omkhulu wokufundisa, evuleka ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye, futhi ubamba izifundo ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. UThandiwe ukholelwa ekutheni ukufundisa abantu indlela yokwakha izikhungo ezilungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zihlala zisebenza kahle. UThandiwe ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi ubonakala emisebenzini yakhe yokwakha izikhungo ezihambelana nezidingo zabantu. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi ubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokwakha izikhungo ezizokwazi ukuxhasa umphakathi. UThandiwe ungumuntu onomdlandla, onothando, futhi onokubona okuhle, futhi ubona izikhungo njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubekile nokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, futhi ubona ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ungumsebenzi ongenakuphuthelwa. Uthanda ukubona abantu bejabule, bephila kahle, futhi bejabulela izikhungo ezakhelwe bona. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ongcono. UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu onomdlandla, onothando, futhi onobuchwepheshe bokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ubonisa ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. UThandiwe uqhubeka nokwenza umehluko, futhi umphakathi wakhe uyamthokozisa ngempela.
Izikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72? Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 ziwumkhankaso ohlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kumiphakathi ehlukene. Lezi zikhungo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuvikela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nezikhungo zezempilo eziningi? Ukuba nezikhungo zezempilo eziningi kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangenza izivakashi eziseduze, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba, kunciphisa izindleko, futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe kahle impilo yabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala kulezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zihlala zinikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa: - Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo - Ukunakekelwa kwezifo ezithile - Ukuhlinzwa okuncane - Izinsizakalo zokwelapha - Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwezempilo - Izinsizakalo zokuvikela, njengokugomela Umbuzo 4: Zitholakala kuphi lezi zikhungo? Lezi zikhungo zitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, kusukela emadolobheni amakhulu kuya ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizakalweni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izikhungo zezempilo? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa lezi zikhungo ziningi. Okokuqala, abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okusheshayo, okungasiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu. Okwesibili, izikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi. Okwesithathu, abantu bangathola ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezempilo. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe lezi zikhungo zisebenza nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo? Yebo, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenza ngokubambisana nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo, njengemitholampilo, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokwelapha. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu, futhi izinsizakalo zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngokuqashwa kwabasebenzi kulezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo zidinga abasebenzi abanamakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa odokotela, abahlengikazi, nabanye abachwepheshe bezempilo. Ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezinikezwayo zisezingeni eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza imiphakathi? Yebo, izikhungo zezempilo zikhuthaza imiphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Zihlinzeka ngokuqwashisa ngempilo, zifundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilile, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokuvikela, imihlangano yokufundisa, nezinhlelo zokuxhasa. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nalezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo zingabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zisebenze ngokubambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze zithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zezempilo? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zezempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhaswa okuqinile kwezimali, ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Isiphetho: Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi, uhulumeni, nabahlinzeki bezempilo bangathuthukisa lezi zikhungo, benza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, futhi baphucule impilo yabantu. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kufinyelela kuhilela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, ulwazi, nezinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza zifaka phakathi izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ukuze umphakathi ube nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo somnotho, uthole ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Okokuqala, izikhungo zemfundo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufinyeleleni kwamahhala. Izikhungo ezifana nezikole, amanyuvesi, nezikhungo zokuqeqesha zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokufunda olutholakala kubo bonke. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, okwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bathole ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo kuholela ekwandeni kwemfundo, okukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nekhono eliphezulu, okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Okwesibili, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kumphakathi. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlola, ukuhlinzekwa kwemithi, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Uma abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okungathinta umphakathi wonke. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo zezempilo kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngempilo kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Okwesithathu, izikhungo zomphakathi zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokuxhumana, izikhungo zokuzijabulisa, nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi.
