Imihlangano yokuhlanganyela ibalulekile ukuze abesifazane bazi kahle lokho okulindelekile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenzekayo ngesikhathi sokubeletha? Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, umama uthola ukunakekelwa ngokucophelela. Izinsiza ezinjengamadokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinye izisebenzi zempilo ziqinisekisa ukuthi umama nengane bakhishwa ngokuphepha. Ukubhekelwa kuhilela ukugcinwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, ukuxilongwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokunikezwa kosizo lwezokwelapha uma kudingeka. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo emva kokubeletha? Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama uthola ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukwelashwa kwezinkinga ezingase zivele, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda ubaba nomama mayelana nokunakekelwa kwengane. Izibhedlela zinikeza izinhlelo zokuxhasa, ezifaka phakathi izifundo zokubeletha, izinhlelo zokufundisa abazali, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana nezingane. Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani ngezinselelo ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokubeletha? Nakuba izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona, kunezinselelo ezithile. Ukuthola izinsiza ezifanele kudinga imithombo yemali, futhi ezindaweni ezithile, ukufinyelela ezibhedlela kungaba nzima, okwenza kube nzima kwabanye abesifazane ukusizakala. Ubugebengu nokushoda kwezinsiza kungase kube nomthelela ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Umbuzo 6: Kungani kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuphepha nokunakekelwa kwabakhulelwe. Ukuze kube nezimo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bathole ukwelashwa okutholakala ezibhedlela, okunciphisa izingozi ezihlobene nokubeletha, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta impilo yomama nengane. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukufinyelela kumadokotela abanolwazi, izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nokuphathwa kwezingane okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, futhi kuqinisekisa impilo enhle yomama nengane. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezinketho zokubeletha ngaphandle kwezibhedlela? Kukhona nezinye izinketho zokubeletha, ezifana nokubeletha emakhaya, kodwa lezi zidinga ukuqonda kahle izingozi ezihambisana nazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bakhethe indlela yokubeletha ehambisana nezidingo zabo kuphela uma bezazi kahle izinzuzo nezingozi. Umbuzo 9: Umehluko phakathi kokubeletha emakhaya nezibhedlela? Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kokubeletha emakhaya nezibhedlela ubonakala ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Ezibhedlela, kunezinsiza ezithuthukile nezokwelapha, kanti emakhaya, izinsiza zingase zibe zinqabile, okubalulekile uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okudingeka ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kudingeka ukwenza izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele, kanye nokufundisa abahlengikazi nabezempilo ukuze babe nolwazi oluphakeme. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kungasiza ekwakheni izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngokufingqa, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekuphathweni kokubeletha, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane nabantwana bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, okuyinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wezeMpilo.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ekuhlangabezaneni nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zemakethe, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi ziba yinsika ebalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo, baphendule kahle ezinguqukweni nasezidingweni zenkampani. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zazo, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu phakathi kwabantu abasebenza ndawonye. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abasebenzi bejwayelana nemigomo efanayo yokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okungcono, okwandisa ukusebenza kahle kwethimba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma abasebenzi beqeqeshwa, bahlomula ngolwazi olusha nolwakhiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo. Ngokwesibili, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu. Abasebenzi abathola ukuqeqeshwa bahlala bejabulile futhi bephokophele phambili, njengoba beqonda ukuthi inkampani ibanakekela futhi ibafuna ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo emsebenzini, okwandisa umkhiqizo nokusebenza kahle. Abasebenzi abathola amathuba okuthuthukiswa bahlala bephakanyiswa, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuncintisana okuhle phakathi kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abanolwazi olusha ukuze bakwazi ukuncintisana emakethe. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bekwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, okwandisa ukusebenza kahle nokunciphisa izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olufanele. Ngokwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani. Izinkampani ezithola ukuthi ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo ziba nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kakhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu kumakhasimende, okwandisa ithuba lokuphumelela kwenkampani. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshwe kahle baziqhenya ngomsebenzi wabo, futhi lokhu kubonakala emiphumeleni ethile. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa azisebenzi kahle uma zingahlelwanga kahle. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona. Ukuhlola izidingo zabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kuhambisana nezifiso zabo kanye nezidingo zenkampani. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyavuma futhi uyawuqonda umgomo wokuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zidinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele kugxilwe kuphela kumakhono athile, kodwa kufanele kube nokubheka konke okuhlobene nemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa okukhona kufanele kube nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okuphatha isikhathi, kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini, njengoba abasebenzi beqonda ukuthi badinga amakhono amaningi ukuze baphumelele. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele, zikhulisa umoya wokubambisana, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhona emakethe. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze kahle, zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona. Ngale ndlela, izinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi abasebenzi bazokwazi ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokugxila ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle emhlabeni oshintsha njalo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele abantu abaqeqeshiwe nabakhuthazekile, okuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini nasempilweni.
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile kakhulu, okungukuthi, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ezihilela izimoto eziningi. Njengoba sikhuluma, sithola ukuthi izimo ezinjalo zenzeka njalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi singaphendula kanjani. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zingaba yingozi kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma izimoto eziningi zikhona, ingozi ingaba yinhlekelele. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, okokuqala okumele kwenziwe ukuvikela abanye. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abashayeli kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi bangayeka kanjani izimoto zabo ukuze bangaphazamisi abanye. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezimpawu zomgwaqo, kanye nezindlela zokuphuma eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza, njengokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka ingozi enkulu, abashayeli kufanele bazi ukuthi kufanele baxhumane nabaphathi bezimo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi usizo lufika ngokushesha. Abaphathi bezimo bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze baphathe isimo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabiza kanjani izinsizakalo ezifanele, njengemoto yokuhlola, abezimo zokuphuthumayo, noma abezokwelapha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezihlelelekile zokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukuhlela izinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yokuthi bangaphendula kanjani. Kukhona futhi izindlela zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abakwazi ukuxhumana kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwabashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela ukuphendula, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi usizo lufika ngokushesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Abashayeli kufanele bazi ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze bavikeleke, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabiza kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimoto, ukuqeqesha abashayeli, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yokuthi bangaphendula kanjani. Ekugcineni, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, sithola ukuthi singakwazi ukuvikela abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi akuyona into elula. Kudinga ukucabangela, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezinhlelo ezicacile. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, sithola ukuthi singakwazi ukuvikela abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaphendula kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. Ngakho, ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto ezikhuluma ngazo zizokwenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Qhubekani nokuqonda, nokuqeqesha, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo.
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Emazweni amaningi, ukuhamba ngezindlela ezinkulu ezilula kubalulekile ekuphatheni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Kunezimo eziningi ezidinga ukuphendulwa ngokushesha, kubandakanya imicimbi eyingozi, izimo zokulahlwa kwemali, noma ezinye iziphithiphithi ezithinta impilo yabantu. Ngenxa yalesi simo, ukuhamba ngezinto ezihamba phambili ezinzima, njengezimoto eziningi ezinokuphendula, kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Izimoto eziningi azijwayelekile kuphela ezikhathini zomphakathi ezivamile, kodwa futhi zisebenza njengenqubomgomo yokuphepha. Lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka, izinsiza ezifanele ziyadingeka ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nazo. Ukuze ukuqonda lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokubheka umqondo wokuphendula ngezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa indlela izimoto eziningi ezifaka ngayo isandla ekuqedeni izimo eziyingozi nendlela okukhula ngayo ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Sikhuluma ngezimo eziphuthumayo, izimoto ezinelogo yokuphendula, njengemoto yedlanzana, iyisithonjana. Ziningi izigameko lapho izimoto ezilungele ukusiza, ukuphuthuma, noma ukuhlinzeka ngomsindo ngezimo eziphuthumayo abantu. Izinhlaka zomphakathi ezibandakanya amaphoyisa, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlenga, zonke zifanelwe ukuba zenze ngempumelelo izimo ezimbi. Lezi zinsiza kufanele zibe nezimoto ezikhiqiza okungcono, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kudinga ukusizwa okuza ngezinga eliphezulu. Kodwa, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngezimoto eziningi. Ukuze ukuphendula kwenzeke ngendlela efanele, izinhlelo zokusebenza, ezifana nohlelo lwezokuhlola, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphathekayo ezifanele ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza ukuqhubeka komphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ngendlela yokubamba izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuhlanganiswe ubuchwepheshe nezigaba ezahlukene zokuphendula. Yize izimoto eziningi zikhona, izinhlelo zokwakha izinhlelo zazo azisatholakali. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphakeme zokuqeqesha abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ngezimo eziphuthumayo. Umsebenzi wabo ungathinta uthando nobuchwepheshe, ukuze thief mkhaya kwazulu kwezindiza, izimo ezinjalo ziqhutshelwe phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izimbiwa eziningi zingabangela izimo eziphuthumayo zibe munye. Ukuze umphakathi uqonde izimo eziyingozi eziphuthumayo, isidingo sokusungula ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo buvele kahle. Hamba umphakathi ngumsele kumnotho, ukuze uthole amathuba okuphuthuma ngokufanele. Ukwamukela izimoto eziningi kuhlinzeka ngebhadi lokuphuthuma, lokhu kudinga ukuba kubhalwe ezikhathini ezikahle. Lezimoto kufanele zibe nezinye izinsiza ezifana nokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kweziguli, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. kuye kwezizinda ukuthi kubhekelelwe izinqubo eziphansi eziphuma ezinkampanini ezithokozisayo eziningana ezitholakala ngama-oda, umsindo nezinqubomgomo zokuphendula ngezimoto eziningi. Ngaphandle kokushesha kokuphendula kwezinye izinhlelo ezisebenzelana, izimoto eziningi zinozakwabo, nathi kufanele simise umgomo wokwakha izinhlelo eziyoda emigqukezi yokuphendula. Lokhu kusho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi nabantu baziqonda kahle umgomo wentuthuko, nezinga lenzalo yokuphendula ngempela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantu kufanele babhezela ukusebenza, futhi balwe izifiso ezinkulu. Ukuphendula ngomqondo njalo kwezimo eziphuthumayo kuletha izinselelo ezinkulu kumphakathi. Akukhona nje ukuthi izimoto eziningi zidingeka ukuze ziphendule kalula, kodwa kudinga ukuthi umuntu ube nesisombululo esilungile. Lokhu kuphendula kubalulekile lapho kuhlolwa kahle, ukuze kuhlonishwe imithetho ehambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho, ngemuva kokuhlola izimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi ufunde ukubaluleka kokuphathwa komphakathi nooziqeqeshi bezokuphendula. Lokhu kuzogcina kungumgomo wokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimotweni eziningi, ukuze ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela engcono yokuphendula. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwezixazululo ezinhle nezinjongo zokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kuhilela ukuthola imiphumela engcono kunokuphuma okubuhlungu. Ukubhekela izinkinga ezikhona, will ungenza izimoto eziningi zibe nomthelela omuhle kumphakathi, futhi uthumele izimemezelo zomphakathi. Lolu hlelo lwalwazulu nezinyathelo ezithile zizophinde zibe yinto engapheli, futhi kugcine ukugcinwa kwempilo yazo zonke.
Ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni Izithombe nemidwebo zihlala zinhle ukuze kusebenze kahle ezinhlakweni eziningi, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ezikhungweni. Leli phepha lizokuhola ngezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zisebenza kahle ukuze zifeze izinjongo ezithile. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Umsebenzi Nezinhloso Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlonza umsebenzi ofanele nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezithombe nemidwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuhlela ukuthi yini ezomemezela, ukufundisa noma ukuphumelela. Isibonelo, uma ubeka izithombe emnyangweni wezemfundo, kufanele uqonde ukuthi izithombe zidinga ukweluleka noma zikhumbuze abafundi ngamalokhu. Izithombe ezithile zingadala imizwa ethile, zibe nomthelela omuhle kubantu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izithombe Nemidwebo Ngemuva kokuthi umgomo sebubekiwe, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukukhetha izithombe nemidwebo ezithintana nomqondo. Izithombe kufanele zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu, ngaphandle kokungabaza, futhi kulula ukuziqonda. Ukuze ufinyelele lokhu, ungasebenzisa izithombe ezitholakala kuma-database anobuchwepheshe obuphezulu noma uqhakambise abaculi bendawo. Qiniseka ukuthi izithombe sizivezwa kahle ukuze zitshele indaba efanele. Isinyathelo 3: Ukumisa Nokubeka Izithombe Nemidwebo Ngemuva kokukhetha, izithombe nemidwebo kufanele zibekwe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubeka izithombe ezindaweni ezithe xaxa nezithombeni, ukugwema ukuhlangana nemiyalezo engafanele. Ukubeka kahle kunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kwemiyalezo eqondiswe kubabukeli. Khumbula ukuhlola ukuthi isikhala sokubeka sikhona futhi sinikeza umbono ophusile nesicaci. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufundwa Kwezithombe Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abawubhalayo abezithombe nemidwebo bayakwazi ukuziqonda. Lokhu kungahilela ukufaka imishwana encane edlulisayo incazelo ezithombeni, noma ukusebenzisa ulwazi olwakha umqondo othi "ngalezi zithombe". Izithombe ezihlangene nemiyalezo egxile kulokho abantu abakwaziyo ukucabangela kuzokwazi ukukhulisa ukuqonda kakhulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukumisa Izinqubo Zokuxhumana Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zimomotheka ngendlela elungile, kubalulekile ukusungula izinqubo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlola impendulo yababukeli, ukuqonda ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zifika kahle, futhi uma kudingeka, ukwenza izinguquko. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenzisana nazo uyayazi imiyalo, ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphumelelisa izinjongo zokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 6: Uhlolo Lokugcina Ngaphambi kokuphuma nomsebenzi, kuhle ukuhlela ukuhlola lokho okukhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba nezithombe nemidwebo zikalathisa, futhi abantu bazihloniphile. Hamba uhlole izithombe, uthembele kumphakathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda umthelela wazo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuvuselela Ngemva kokusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza. Uvuselelo lwamathuba amasha lokuthola izithombe ezizobhalwa ngokusesha, nakukhombisa ukuthi izithombe zikhulisa kanjani amaphuzu abawubhalayo. Izinkinga ezithile ezifўся dapat ukufaka izithombe ezisemkhakheni wezemfundo, kangangokuthi izithombe zihlale zivethelekile. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni kudinga indlela eqondile, umqondo obucayi nokuzimisela ukuze kufezwe umgomo wethu. Ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo esizichaze, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo ziseza namaphuzu ahlukene, kungakhathaliseki umkhakha okhuluma nawo. Ngalesi sixazululo, sizovula ithuba lokuxhumana okuphumelelayo nabantu, futhi umcabango uzothokoziswa ngezithombe ezithintayo. Faka lezi zinyathelo ezisebenzayo endaweni yakho, futhi uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi wakho ngendlela emphezulwini.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokukhula kwazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinqubo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kusukela emzini wezibhedlela kuze kube sekupheleni kokunakekelwa kwazo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlolwa Kwezingane Ngokufika kwengane emhlabeni, kubalulekile ukuthi ihlolwe ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa ukuhlola isimo sezingane, izinga lokuphefumula, kanye nezimpawu zokuphila. Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bazobheka izimpawu ezibalulekile ezifana nokukhanya kwamehlo, izinga lokushisa, nokuphendula ezitheni. Lokhu kuhlola kuqinisekisa ukuthi ingane iphephile futhi ayinazo izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanzwa Nokunakekelwa Ngemva kokuhlolwa, ingane kufanele ihlanzwe kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukususa amanzi amnandi nokuhlanza isikhumba sayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho okungcolile okungase kube yingozi. Abahlengikazi bazogcina izinga lokuhlanzeka eliphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iphephile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nokugqoka izingubo ezihlanzekile nezithambile, ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuzizwa ikhululekile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukudla Nokunikeza Imithi Ukudla kwengane ezisanda kuzalwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Uma ingane iyinsikazi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyathola ubisi lwezinyanga. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba ubisi lwezinyanga lunikeza izingane zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze zikhule. Uma ingane idinga imithi, abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imithi iyinembile futhi iyatholakala. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqapha Impilo YezeMidlalo Ngemva kokunakekelwa kwezidingo ezisemqoka, kubalulekile ukuqapha impilo yezeMidlalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca ehambisana nezidingo zengane. Abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi zinemisebenzi efanele yokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ingane ikwazi ukujabulisa futhi ibonakale ikhululekile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli kuphela ezibhedlela. Kubalulekile ukuthi abahlengikazi baxhumane nabazali ukuze babanikeze ulwazi olunembile mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezingane zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ingane kufanele ikwazi kanjani ukugcina impilo enempilo, izidingo zokudla, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imidlalo. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi bangabathinta kanjani abahlengikazi uma bephawula izinkinga ezingase zivele. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kuhlanganisa futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane azitholi izingozi. Abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi zonke izindawo zokudlala zihlanzekile, ziphephile, futhi zihlala zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho izingozi ezithinta impilo yezeMidlalo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuhlinzeka Ngothando Nokunakekelwa Ukwengeza, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga uthando nokunakekelwa. Abahlengikazi kufanele babe nesineke, bakhulume kahle, futhi banikeze uthando oludingekayo ukuze izingane zikhule zikhululekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uthando lungasiza izingane zibe nesimo esihle sokukhula, futhi zikwazi ukujabulisa. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Ngokujulile Ekugcineni, abahlengikazi kufanele baqhubeke nokuhlola impilo yezeMidlalo ngemuva kokukhululwa ezibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokukhula, impilo, nokuhlola izidingo ezithile. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi imitholampilo iyatholakala ukuze ibasize uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kudinga ukucophelela, uthando, nokuhlangenwe nakho. Abahlengikazi nabazali kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Ngalezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantwana bethu, sithuthukise isizukulwane esisha esiqinile, esinempilo, nesinothile.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Ukuhlola Izinto Eziyinhloko Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi abantu behlale bejolise ezintweni ezithinta impilo yabo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka imicimbi ebalulekile ezempilo nenhlalakahle, sithintane nemicimbi ethile, izinhlelo, nezindlela ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigcini ngokubhekana nezifo noma izinkinga zempilo, kodwa ibandakanya nezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Izinhlelo zokuvikela impilo, njengokuhlola impilo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi yokuhlola izinga lempilo, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuzivocavoca. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, zinezithelo ezinhle emiphakathini. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokuhlala zempilo, imicimbi eminingi ibonakala ihlanganisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo emphakathini. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha zenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhlangene nemicimbi yokukhuthaza imikhuba emihle, efana nezinsuku zokuhlola impilo, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokuvikela izifo. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo zezempilo, futhi zikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umphakathi onempilo uyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, futhi unikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokuphila, izinkundla zokuxoxisana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, zonke zikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu babelane ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ibalulekile ekwakheni ukuqwashisa. Imikhankaso yokukhuthaza impilo, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela izifo, zifundisa abantu ngezingozi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela impilo yabo, futhi baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ukuqwashisa ngempilo kuholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo eziphusile, okukhuthaza impilo engcono. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ayisebenzi ngaphandle kokubambisana. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, kudingeka ukuthi abantu babambisane, kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nabantu. Imicimbi yokuxhumana, efana nezinsuku zokuvikela impilo, izifundo, kanye nemikhosi, ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu babelane ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ukwakha imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle kudinga izinsiza eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimali, abantu, kanye nezinsiza. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kudinga ukuba babe nesandla ekwakheni lezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imicimbi iyaphumelela. Imicimbi yokuvikela impilo, izifundo, kanye nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza impilo, zonke zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zibe nempumelelo. Ekugcineni, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imicimbi ehloswe ngokuqinile iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, futhi ikhuthaza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nempilo yabo. Njengomphakathi, kumele siqhubeke nokukhuthaza le micimbi, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, konke kudinga ukuba kube khona ukuze imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ibe nempumelelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo.
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Isingeniso Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumula, futhi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi ubani okufanele ahole, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ezikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Sizobheka izinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokubamba iqhaza kwabavoti ukuze siqonde indlela yokwakha intando yeningi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Indima Yabavoti Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abavoti banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi. Abavoti bamele izwi labantu, futhi kufanele baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zinefuthe elikhulu ezinqumweni ezithathwayo. Ukuze abavoti baqonde kahle, kufanele bahlale befundiswa ngamalungelo abo, izinqubo zokhetho, kanye nezinketho ezikhona. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhalisela Ukhetho Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhalisela ukuvota. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuphela abavoti ababhaliwe abavuma ukuvota. Ukuze ubhalise, kufanele uvakashele ihhovisi lezakhamizi lendawo yakho noma usebenzise izinsiza eziku-inthanethi. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyiqiniso. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvota ngosuku lokhetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinketho Zokhetho Ngemuva kokubhalisela ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinketho zokhetho. Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngababambiqhaza, izinhlelo zabo, kanye nezinto abazimisele ukuzifeza uma bephumelela. Ungafunda ngezinhlelo zabo ezisemthethweni, ubuke izinkulumo zabo, futhi uxoxe nabanye abantu ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha umuntu ofanele. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuvota Lapho usuku lokhetho lufika, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo zokuvota. Vakashela endaweni yokuvota ebekiwe, uthathe ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kwakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela imiyalelo yokuvota. Khumbula, ukuvota akuwona umcimbi ophuthumayo; thatha isikhathi sokucabangela kahle ukukhetha kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izwi lakho lizwa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukubamba Iqhaza Ngemva Kokhetho Ngemuva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukulandela izinqumo ezithathwayo, ukuhlinzeka ngombono, noma ukufaka iziphakamiso kumalungu omphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza ngemuva kokhetho kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bahlala bephendula ezidingweni zomphakathi. Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi akupheli ngosuku lokhetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza, bahlale befundiswa, futhi baphakamise izwi labo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula. Qhubekani nibambe iqhaza, nikhumbule ukuthi izwi lenu linamandla!
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo Isingeniso Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi nolwazi olufanele. Lezi zikhungo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe khona, zisebenze kahle, futhi zifinyeleleke kalula kubantu bonke. Uhlaka lwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka phakathi izibhedlela, izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, nezikhungo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Lezi zikhungo zihlukaniswa ngokwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Izibhedlela, ngokwesibonelo, zinezinhlaka eziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinzima, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, zifaka phakathi izikhungo ezincane ezihlinzeka ngempilo yokuvikela, izinsiza zokuhlola, kanye nemfundo yezempilo. Izizathu zokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Izizathu zokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziningi. Okokuqala, lezi zikhungo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezibhedlela ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhona, okubalulekile ekwandiseni ulwazi lwabantu ngezempilo, izifo, nezindlela zokuvikela. Okwesibili, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zikhuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, nabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa kwabantu, njengoba izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezindlela zokwelapha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kukhuthaza futhi ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukene, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Izithiyo ekufakweni kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Noma kunjalo, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo akukhululekile ezitheni. Izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezisebenzi ezifanelekile. Izikhungo eziningi zikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokusebenza, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali yokusebenza, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Lokhu kudala izinkinga zokufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwezisebenzi ezifanelekile kuyinkinga enkulu. Izikhungo eziningi zihlushwa ukuntuleka kwezisebenzi ezinemfundo efanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale bengekho ezikhungweni zezempilo, okwandisa izinga lokungaphili kahle. Izixazululo zokuthuthukisa ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Ukuze sithuthukise ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezivela kuhulumeni, izikhungo zabantu, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imfundo nezifundo ezikhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zezempilo zihlala ziqeqeshiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola abantu abaqeqeshiwe abangaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithuthukisa, izikhungo zingase zisebenzise izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe. Isiphetho Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lezi zikhungo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, zikhuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lufinyeleleka kalula. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezifuna izixazululo ezithile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufakwa kwezikhungo. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukene, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ukukhuthaza ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, okuholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo.
### Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikaPistorius Isigameko sikaOscar Pistorius, umjaho ophakeme waseNingizimu Afrika, sathinta izwe lonke ngemuva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp ngomhla kaFebhuwari 14, 2013. U-Pistorius, owaziwa njengomjaho onenhloso yokuphila, watholakala enecala lokubulala, okwaholela ekutheni kudingidwe nokuqondwa kahle kwesinqumo esithathwe yisigungu esiphezulu sokwahlulela. ### Izizathu zokuba nezimo ezinjalo Ukuze siqonde ukuthi izigameko ezifana nalezi zenzeka kanjani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo zomphakathi zishintsha kanjani ngenxa yokuhlukumeza, ubudlelwano, kanye nokusebenzisa izikhali. U-Pistorius, owayengumfana ophila nezitho zomzimba ezihlukile, waba isibonelo sokuzimisela, kodwa lezi zimo zenzeka endaweni enokuncintisana, lapho izinkinga zomphakathi ziphakamisa imibuzo eminingi mayelana nokuphepha, ubulili, nobuhlanga. ### Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo U-Pistorius watholakala enecala lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, owayengumthandi wakhe, ngesikhathi eshaya udonga lwesikhumba. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngemuva kokuba abavivinywa bephikisana nezimpikiswano eziningi, ezaziphakanyiswa ngama-advocates ababili, omunye ehamba phambili emthethweni nezinye izimo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, watholakala enecala lokubulala ngokungaqondile, kodwa umphakathi walwa nokuqonda ukuthi kwenzekeni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nemithetho yokubulala, nokuthi izinqumo zalesi sigameko zingafaka kanjani umthelela kumphakathi wonke. ### Umthelela wesinqumo Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibe nomthelela omkhulu kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Abantu abaningi babebona lesi sigameko njengomfanekiso wezinkinga ezikhona ezinsukwini zethu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma ngensimu yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma izinto ezihlobene nezobudlelwano. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kuhlanganise nezindlela zokuhlonipha abesifazane, kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. ### Ukuqonda umthelela wezomthetho Ukuze siqonde umthelela wezomthetho kuPistorius, kudingeka ukuqonda ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho kumele ziqondiswe ngabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi uvule izwi, futhi abezindaba baphakamishe izindaba ezithinta umphakathi. Imiphumela yesinqumo sikaPistorius ibonakala ngokuhlanganiswa kwemicabango emisha ezimweni zomthetho, njengoba izinkantolo zifuna ukwakha izinqumo ezizobhelwa ngempela. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokwakha umqondo wokuhlonipha, kudinga ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho zihlale zisenkingeni yokwesekwa komphakathi. ### Ukubaluleka kokuxoxwa Ukubaluleka kokuxoxwa ngezindaba ezifana nalezi akugcini nje emthethweni, kodwa nakumaqembu omphakathi. Izinkulumo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezwi, baphendule ezinhlungwini ezikhona. Ukuxoxisana ngezindaba ezinjalo kuveza izinkinga ezibalulekile, futhi kudinga ukuthi wonke umuntu azinake. ### Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikaPistorius kuphakamisa imibuzo eminingi emqoka, okuhlanganisa izinkinga zomthetho, izinjongo nemithetho, kanye nomphakathi. U-Pistorius, njengoba esebenza ekwehlukaniseni phakathi kwesimo somphakathi nesomthetho, waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinqumo zempilo yomphakathi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Isifundo esibalulekile esitholakala kulolu hlobo lwezimo sithi imithetho akumele ishiywe kuphela ezandleni zomphakathi, kodwa kufanele ibhekiswe emnothweni wezomthetho, umphakathi, nezinkambiso zethu. Lezi zifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukufunda nokuhlaziya izinqumo zomthetho akukhona nje kuphela ukucabanga ngempilo yomuntu, kodwa ukufaka imithetho enothile emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi izinqumo zethu zinomthelela omkhulu, futhi kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi ophumelelayo.
Inkinga yosuku olwaziwa nge-Day Zero eKapa ichaziwe (Day Zero water crisis) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-Day Zero? Impendulo: I-Day Zero ibhekisela ngosuku lapho amanzi ezokwehla kakhulu eKapa, okwenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kwenzeka uma izinqolobane zamanzi zifika ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, okwenza kube khona ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Umbuzo 2: Yini edale i-Day Zero eKapa? Impendulo: I-Day Zero yadalwa yizimo ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemvula, ukwanda kwabantu, kanye nokungaphumeleli kokuphathwa kwamanzi. Izinga lokushisa eliphezulu, ukungabi namvula okwenzeka eminyakeni edlule, kanye nokungabi nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo zokulondoloza amanzi, konke lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenzeka ngesikhathi se-Day Zero? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi se-Day Zero, izakhamuzi zaziphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Amabhokisi amanzi abekwe ezindaweni ezithile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, okwakuholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bezama ukulondoloza amanzi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuvimbela i-Day Zero? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe i-Day Zero, uhulumeni waseKapa uthathe izinyathelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi. Izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi zaphinde zathuthukiswa. Umbuzo 5: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze basize? Impendulo: Abantu bangasiza ngokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi emakhaya abo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe, ukugwema ukugeza izimoto njalo, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakele kusukela ku-Day Zero? Impendulo: I-Day Zero ifundisile abantu abaningi ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokulondoloza amanzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi amanzi ayinsiza engatholakali kalula, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuwagcina. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe i-Day Zero iyinkinga kuphela eKapa? Impendulo: Cha, i-Day Zero ayiyona inkinga kuphela eKapa. Izindawo eziningi emhlabeni jikelele zibhekene nezinkinga zokuntuleka kwamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi inkinga yokuphathwa kwamanzi iyinkinga yomhlaba wonke, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwamanzi? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwamanzi, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokulondoloza amanzi, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokulondoloza, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokulondoloza amanzi? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokulondoloza amanzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi emithonjeni, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayifunda kwabanye abantu abaphumelele ekuphatheni amanzi? Impendulo: Singafunda ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani. Ukuhlonipha izinsiza, ukusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, nokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, konke lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole impumelelo ekuphatheni amanzi. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukushintshwa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze zihlale zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 12: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wokulondoloza amanzi? Impendulo: Singathuthukisa umqondo wokulondoloza amanzi ngokufundisa abantu, ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza, nokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezindawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde ukubaluleka kokulondoloza amanzi. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe i-Day Zero izophinde ibonakale? Impendulo: Kungenzeka ukuthi i-Day Zero ibonakale uma izinyathelo ezithathwayo zingasebenzi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amanzi ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi? Impendulo: Singathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ngokubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, nokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Umbuzo 15: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo okufanele zithathwe? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezilandelayo zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, nokwakha izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Day Zero ibonisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo zokulondoloza amanzi ukuze sithole ikusasa elingcono.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Umbuzo 1: Yini i-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant? Impendulo: I-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant iyisibonelelo esenziwe nguHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokusiza izakhamuzi ezithintekile kakhulu yilezi zimo ze-COVID-19. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo ngemali kubantu abangenayo ngenxa yokuncipha kwemisebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Ubani ongawufaka isicelo salesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Abantu abanemali encane, abaphila ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile, bangafaka isicelo salesi sibonelelo. Lokhu kuhilela labo abavela emindenini engatholi imali ethile, abaphila bodwa, kanye nalabo abangenayo imithombo yokusebenza ngenxa yokuphelelwa yisikhathi kwemisebenzi. Umbuzo 3: Umsebenzi walesi sibonelelo ungakanani? Impendulo: Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sinikela ngempahla ethile yemali, eyi-R350 ngenyanga. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abantu ukuthi bafeze izidingo ezisemqoka ezifana nokudla, izindleko zokuhlala, nezokuthutha. Umbuzo 4: Ziyini izinyathelo okufanele zilandwe ukuze ufake isicelo? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, udinga ukuvakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-SASSA (South African Social Security Agency) noma usebenzise izinhlelo zefoni ezitholakalayo. Isicelo sifaka imininingwane yakho, isikhumbuzo esiqinile, nezimpawu zokuqinisekisa ubunikazi. Umbuzo 5: Kungakanani isikhathi sokucubungula isicelo? Impendulo: Isikhathi sokucubungula singaba phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kwezingu-21, kuncike ekutheni isicelo sithunyelwe kahle futhi zonke izidingo zifakiwe. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona imikhawulo yokusebenzisa le mali? Impendulo: Yebo, le mali ibhekelelwa kuphela ezidingweni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudla, izindleko zokuhlala, nezindleko eziyisisekelo. Akukhuthazeki ukuyisebenzisa ezinhlelweni ezingekho emthethweni noma ngenye indlela engafanele. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezikhona zokusebenzisa lesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Le mali inikeza usizo olubalulekile kubantu abavela ezimeni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi lapho kungekho msebenzi. Iphinde ithuthukise umnotho wendawo ngokukhuthaza ukuthengwa kwezimpahla ezisemqoka. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona isikhathi esinqunyiwe sokuthola lesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Yebo, lesi sibonelelo sikhona kuze kube uJuni 2024, kodwa kungaba nezinguquko ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuhlala ubheka izimemezelo ezivela kuhulumeni ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo lapho befaka isicelo? Impendulo: Abantu abaningi babhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela ku-inthanethi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Kwesinye isikhathi, izicelo zingabhekwa isikhathi eside, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imali ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe kukhona izindlela zokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo? Impendulo: Ukuze kukhuthazwe abantu, kungaba kuhle ukuhlela imihlangano nemisebenzi yokwazisa emphakathini, lapho abantu bangathola khona ulwazi olunembile. Ukubambisana nezinkampani ezithile ezibandakanya imiphakathi kungasiza ekukhuthazeni abantu. Umbuzo 11: Zithini izindlela zokulandelela isimo sesicelo? Impendulo: Ungakwazi ukulandelela isimo sesicelo sakho ngokuxhumana ne-SASSA, noma uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo. Abantu bangasebenzisa futhi izinhlelo zefoni ezitholakalayo ukuze bathole izibuyekezo. Umbuzo 12: Yini okudingeka abantu bayazi mayelana nesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izimiso nezimo ezihambisana nale mali. Futhi kufanele bazi ukuthi lesi sibonelelo akumele sithathwe njengokuhlala, kodwa njengezinyathelo zalesi sikhathi esinzima. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe le mali izosizwa ngabanye abantu? Impendulo: Yebo, imiphakathi ingakwazi ukusiza abanye ngokwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, noma ngempela, ngokuthola izinto zokuphila. Ukuhlanganyela komphakathi kubalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibangelwa yilezi zimo. Umbuzo 14: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo uma isicelo singenamphumela? Impendulo: Uma isicelo singenamphumela, ungathintana ne-SASSA ukuze uthole izizathu. Kungenzeka futhi ufake isicelo esisha uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezikhona. Umbuzo 15: Ingabe i-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant izoqhubeka ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Lokhu kuncike ezinqumweni zikaHulumeni. Uma kudingeka, kungenzeka kube nezinhlelo ezintsha ezizokwakhiwa ukuze zisize abantu abathintekile. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlale bekwaziswa. Ngokuhambisana nalezi zihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sibonelelo singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi. Ukwaziswa kahle nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zokufaka izicelo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezezimali abaluqhamukayo.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Ngonyaka ka-2014, umhlaba waphenduka waba nesithombe esibi kakhulu lapho umgibeli odumile, uOscar Pistorius, ethola isinqumo sokwahlulela ngemva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, intombi yakhe. Lesi senzo saphendula izinkulumo eziningi mayelana nezokuphepha, ubudlelwane, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho ezithinta abantu abadumile. Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kudinga ukuba sihlole izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimo zomthetho, izinkolelo zomphakathi, kanye nemiphumela yalesi senzo. UOscar Pistorius, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela emhlabeni wobunzima, njengoba enezinyawo eziphukile. Waba yisithonjana sokuzimisela, futhi wathola udumo emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, impilo yakhe yaguquka ngokuphelele ngemuva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp ngonyaka ka-2013. U-Pistorius wathi wacabanga ukuthi uReeva ungumthakathi, futhi waphosa isibhamu, okwaholela ekufeni kwakhe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwecala, lapho abameli bakhe bezama ukufakazela ukuthi ubulale uReeva ngokungafanele, ngenxa yokucindezeleka okukhulu. U-Pistorius waphikisa ukuthi wayengazi ukuthi uReeva ubekhona endlini, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokuvikela kwakhe. Nokho, umphakathi wawungavumi lezi zinsolo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Abantu abaningi babebona lokhu njengokungafanele, futhi baphikisa ukuthi uPistorius wayenokwazi okukhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uPistorius wathola isijeziso sokuvalelwa emzini, esikhundleni sokuba aboshwe. Lokhu kwavusa ukungabaza okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaningi bebebona lokhu njengokungafanele. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abathile bangathola izinzuzo ezikhethekile ngenxa yokudumisa kwabo, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezinga lokuphila kwabantu abajwayelekile uma bephakathi kwezinkantolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isinqumo sikaPistorius saguqulwa, futhi wathola isijeziso esinzima sokuboshwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola umthetho, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi uPistorius kufanele abhekane nezimo ezinzima, njengoba abanye abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho, njengoba izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa, nokuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zisebenze kanjani. Uhlanga lwezokuphepha lwalubhekwa kakhulu kulolu daba. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abaninzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha. Abantu abaningi babebona ukuthi uPistorius wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa lokhu akukhombisi ukuthi wayengavikeleki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zihlale ziqinile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane. Inkinga yamanzi eKapa, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Day Zero, ibonisa isimo esinzima sokushoda kwamanzi, esikhumbuza ukuthi imithombo yethu yamanzi iyancipha. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezinguquko ezinzima emhlabeni. Njengom resident eKapa, ngiyavuma ukuthi le nkinga ayikhona nje kuphela ekushodeni kwamanzi, kodwa ibonisa futhi izinselelo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu nsuku zonke. I-Kapa ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuntuleka kwamanzi, futhi umkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngamanzi ubonisa ukuthi izinga lokuhlola amanzi alikakhuphuki. Ngempela, ubuhlungu bokuthi umuzi omkhulu, owaziwa njengendawo yokuvakasha, ungafika ezingeni le-Day Zero, kukhombisa ukuthi uma izinga lamazinga amanzi lehla, sizofika esimweni sokuthi amanzi abe yimpahla engatholakalanga kalula. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphila ngaphansi komondli, okuthinta abantu abaningi eKapa. Ngikhumbula ngo-2017, lapho uhulumeni waseKapa waqala imikhankaso yokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Izinyathelo ezifana nokubeka imikhawulo kumakhosikazi, ukunciphisa izinga lokuhlanzeka kwemithi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basize ekugcineni imithombo yamanzi, kwakuwumzamo wokubhekana nale nkinga. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba necebo elibanzi elihlanganisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ayiyona nje eyomphakathi, kodwa ibonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezimboni. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi laba basemakhaya, bahluleka ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ye-Day Zero iyinkinga yezenhlalakahle. Ngabe singakwazi ukuthola izixazululo zokwakha umphakathi onempilo uma abanye bethu besaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima? Ngaphezu kwalokho, inkinga yamanzi ibonisa ukuthi umnotho wethu uyahluleka. Imikhakha efana nezokuthutha, ezokwakha, kanye nezokuphepha kwamanzi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Kodwa lezi zinhlelo zidinga amanzi, futhi uma amanzi eshoda, umnotho uba sengcupheni. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinkinga zokungasebenzi kahle ezikhathini ezahlukene, okusho ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bayabe besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ngokungafani. Ukubheka izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlakaniphile zokuphatha amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokuvuselela amanzi, kungasiza ukunciphisa umthelela we-Day Zero. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukwakha umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono ekulondolozeni imithombo yamanzi. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene ezazithathwa ezindabeni zethu ezingu-2020, lapho sizama ukuqonda indlela yokuphuma kule nkinga. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nezindlela zokulondoloza amanzi, ukwenza imikhankaso yokuqwashisa, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenza kahle, kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wethu. Uhlelo lokuhlola amanzi, olwakhiwe ngokuhlakanipha, lungaba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho, ngikholwa ukuthi inkinga ye-Day Zero eKapa iyisixwayiso esibalulekile. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi asikwazi ukuncika kuphela emithonjeni engcolile, kodwa kumele sithathe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngabe singakwenza kanjani lokhu? Ngabe singaba necebo eliphumelelayo lokuphatha amanzi? Ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokushoda kwamanzi akufanele kube yinto esijabulela, kodwa kufanele kube yinto esiyithokozisayo. Siphila emhlabeni ogcwele izinselelo, kodwa kufanele sibe nokholo lokuthi sizokwazi ukuvula amathuba amasha. Ngakho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-Day Zero akuyona nje imiphumela yokushoda kwamanzi; iyisifundo sokuthi kudinga ukuba sibe nokubambisana ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ekugcineni, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi sonke thina singaba nesandla ekuthatheni izinyathelo. Akukhathaliseki ukuthi sihlala kuphi, sitholakala kuphi, noma sithanda ini; sonke singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, omuhle, nokhaliphile. Izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi azifanele ukuba yinkinga yokuphila, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuthi sithuthuke, sithole izixazululo ezisha, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Ngiyabonga.

Ngiyabonga futhi kubalaleli bethu, sibheke phambili ekutholeni izindaba ezinhle ezivela ema-podcast. Mnu. Ndlovu: Ngiyabonga!
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ukusebenza ukude, okuyinto evame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-remote work, sekuyinto ejwayelekile emhlabeni wonke. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, le mikhuba ibonakala ihambisana nezimo ezithile ezivela emlandweni, uhlanga, nemigomo yezezimali. Ukuze siqonde kahle izimpande zokusebenza ukude kuleli, kubalulekile ukucabangela izigameko zomlando ezithintekayo ezilethe lezi zinguquko ezinkampanini zethu. Ngemuva kokuphela kwezimpi zenkululeko, eNingizimu Afrika, leli zwe lathola izindlela zokwakha emikhakheni ehlukene. Nokho, abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga zokufuna umsebenzi. Umsebenzi wanamuhla waqala ukuvela kubantu abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imisebenzi esemthethweni. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, izinkampani zikhula, kodwa zikhona nezinselelo ezithinta abantu kanye nezikhungo ezithola ukuqashwa. Ngesikhathi sokulungiswa kwezimali, izimboni ezinjenge-IT zathuthuka, zenza ukuthi izinkampani zifune izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto ukuze zikhule. Kwakukhona ukwakhiwa kwezinkampani eziningi ezibhaliswe kwi-inthanethi, okuhlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi kumakhasimende ahlukahlukene. Ukuze zisebenze kahle, izinkampani zathi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuba abantu basebenze ezindaweni ezikude, kubandakanya izindawo zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni. Ngokukhula kwamathuba okusebenza ukude, izinkampani ezinkulu eNingizimu Afrika zathola izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuvana umsebenzi kumuntu okude. Uhlelo lwezimpahla, ezamalungelo, nolwempilo lwenza kube nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza ezinkampanini ezikude. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abantu, nabanye ababephila ezimweni ezinzima, bathole amathuba amaningana emisebenzi. Ngemuva kokuphuma kwemicimbi ye-COVID-19, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukusebenza ukude kwakuyisixazululo esiphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amalungu ezinkampani aqale ukuqonda ukuthi ukude kusebenza kahle, futhi kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali, ukunciphisa izindleko, nemisebenzi yokuxhumana. Izinhlangano zathola izindlela zokusebenza ukude, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezinkampani ukuze kubonakale ukufaneleka kwabantu emsebenzini. Noma kunjalo, ibhizinisi eliseNingizimu Afrika lenza kube nzima ukufakazela ukuthi izinkampani zingakwazi ukwenza ukundirhiza okwenziwe. Ukuze ziqinisekise ukusebenza kahle, izinkampani zinezinhlelo ezithile ezinesithunzi. Lokhu kube nomthelela ekuxhumaneni, nokwakhiwa kwemibono yokusebenza okude kochwepheshe. Ngokuqhubeka, izingozi eziphathelene nemisebenzi ecindezelayo ziqhamuka, zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zifeze imisebenzi ethile ukuze zithuthukise ukuqonda kokusebenza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukufunda kule modeli ye-remote work kuvulelwe izinkampani ezinkulu nezincane ukufaka inzuzo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene, kubonisa ukuthi izinkampani eNingizimu Afrika ziqala ukwenza ushintsho oluhamba phambili emisebenzini yazo. Namuhla, ukuqhubeka kwenhlanhla yokusebenza ukude kunomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezimbonini ezahlukene. Abantu bahlola amakhono nezinto ezithintekayo, okuvulela amathuba okuthi baqonde indlela yokusebenza eNingizimu Afrika, basheshe baphinde bashintshe imicabango yabo. Ekugcineni, ukwakha isithombe esicacile ngesimo sokusebenza ukude ezinkampanini nasezindaweni zethu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle, nesimo esikhona. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ukuze kudaleke umphakathi ohlanganyela, onobuchwepheshe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaqhinga ahambelana namazinga okusungula. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuholela ezinkampanini ezinkulu nezincane eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini eNingizimu Afrika akukabi ngamathuba kuphela, kodwa kusemkhakheni ophumelelayo, ophelele, nowezinzile. Ibhizinisi, umphakathi, kanye nabantu kufanele baqhubeke nokusebenzisa lokhu ukuze kuncitshiswe izinkinga, futhi ukufinyelele ezindaweni ezimbi emhlabeni wezinkampani. Ukusebenza ukude kudinga ubuchwepheshe nemikhuba esebenzayo, ukuqinisekisa umphakathi owodwa, kuyabaluleka emzuzwini ohlangene.
Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Umbuzo 1: Yiziphi izinkinga ezivamile zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa? Impendulo: EMpumalanga Kapa, izibhedlela zibhekene nezinkinga eziningi zengqalasizinda. Okokuqala, kunenkinga yokuntuleka kwezinsiza kusebenza. Izibhedlela eziningi zinemishini endala futhi ethile ingasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yezokwelapha. Okwesibili, kunenkinga yokuntuleka kwabasebenzi. Izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nokuntuleka kwababhekelele iziguli, okukhathaza kakhulu njengoba lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zingatholi usizo olufanele. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo? Impendulo: Izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zibhekene nezithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukuthola izinsiza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kwemali eyanele yokuthenga imishini nezinye izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubo zokuthenga ezimaphakathi zihlala zibhakabhaka, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisheshayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izibhedlela zihlale zinesimo sokungabi nalutho, futhi iziguli zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga. Umbuzo 3: Ikuphi indawo yokuhlala iziguli ezidinga usizo? Impendulo: Iziguli ezidinga usizo zihlala zidinga indawo yokuhlala ehlinzekwa izibhedlela. Ngaphandle kokuhlala okuhle, iziguli zithola ukuthi kunzima ukuthola ukwelashwa okukhulu. Ezinye izibhedlela zikhona, kodwa zihlala zigcwele, futhi iziguli zidinga ukuma isikhathi eside ukuze zithole usizo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zibe nezinhlobonhlobo zezinkinga, ezinjengokungakhathali nokukhungatheka. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela? Impendulo: Kukho izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa. Uhulumeni usebenza ekwandiseni izinsiza, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zethimba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhulu kwabaphathi bezibhedlela, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Futhi, kukhona imikhankaso yokuxhumanisa izibhedlela ngezinsizakusebenza eziphumelelayo, okuyinto engasiza ekwandiseni ukutholakala kwezinsiza. Umbuzo 5: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze uthuthukise isimo? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo sezibhedlela. Okokuqala, abantu bangabamba iqhaza emikhankasweni yokwazisa abantu mayelana nezidingo zezibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo nezempilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungabamba izandla nezinhlangano ezizimele ukuze kube nokuxhaswa kwezinsiza, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Umbuzo 6: Yini edinga ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lezokwelapha? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lezokwelapha, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubo bonke abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukuthuthukisa ingqondo yokusebenza nezinqubo zokuqapha kungase kube nomthelela omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezokwelapha. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa kuzoletha izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, iziguli zizothola ukufinyelela okukhululekile ezinsizeni zokwelapha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukwelashwa, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela ezithuthukisiwe zizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ekwelapheni iziguli, okuholela ekwehleni kwezifo nezifo ezithathelwana. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholwa kwezinye izifunda? Impendulo: Ezinye izifunda ziye zaba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphathwa kwezibhedlela, ezifanele ukuthathwa njengesibonelo. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zifaka phakathi ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezibhedlela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, nokwakha izinhlelo ezihambisanayo zokuthuthukiswa kwezokwelapha. Lezi zifundo zingasiza eMpumalanga Kapa ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngezindaba zempilo yomphakathi? Impendulo: Izindaba zempilo yomphakathi zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Umphakathi kumele uqonde izidingo zabo ezithinta impilo, futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezithinta impilo. Ukuze lokhu kuzuzwe, kudingeka ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezibhedlela, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise isimo sezibhedlela. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezizayo? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezizayo zibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza, ukwandisa iqembu labaphathi, kanye nokwakha imikhankaso yokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthola izibhedlela ezisebenzayo, ezikhona, nezihlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinsizeni zezemidlalo nezempilo eMpumalanga Kapa. Isiphetho: Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zidinga ukuba zixazululwe ngokubambisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, umphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezibhedlela, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yeziguli. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isibhedlela esihlala sihlanganyela, esinempumelelo, nesikhona.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Ngiyavuma, lo mkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela ezikhathini eziqondile ezadlalwa, kodwa nasemhlabeni jikelele. Asiqale ngokuqonda. Wasuka ngempela onke amakhamphani, imiphakathi, nezikole, ubizwa ngempela ngokuthi "umkhankaso." Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kwenzekile? Ngaphandle kokuba kudlalwe umoya phakathi kwabafundi, izinsuku zodwa, kodwa lezi zinsuku zikhumbula amadolobha amaningi, ukufundisa, nokuhlanganyela. Ngicabanga ngezinhloso zokuqala. Umsebenzi wokuqala waba ukufaka isithombe, ukubhekana nemfundiso ebanzi, nokwenza ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi umphakathi wethu udinga ushintsho. Abafundi baqale bazwakala, izinkulumo zaba phezulu, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zifundo azizange zifinyeleleka kuphela ezikoleni ezithile. Kunjalo, uma ubheka lokhu, kunokugonyama okuphakathi, njengoba umoya wokusebenza, udinga ukuba yinto edinga izinyathelo. Ubani owawazi kahle ukuthi izifundo zizoshintsha kanjani? Okokuqala, kwakukhona umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabafundi. Abantu babefuna ukuba nezezimali. Ngabe ubona lokhu? Nokho, akuphali nje, ngenxa yokuhlukana kwezemali, uthishanhloko awazange ahambisane. "Thina sizokwenza okuthile," bekulokhu kukhulu. Umfundisi ubenobunzima empilweni yakhe, kepha abanye bezwa, lokhu kwaqala ukufaka izinqumo zawo ezinzima. Izikhathi zashintsha, abanye abavakashi bamukela izifundo ezithile eziphakeme, nezikhangiso zitholakala. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Kukhona izinyathelo eziningi ezithathelwe nenhloso yokududuzela abafundi. Abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi akusho ukuthi angama-70% akhona kuphela. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abantu bakwazi ukubona ukuthi umnyango ubukhona, baphakamisa izwi labo. Futhi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuphumelelanga kuphela kwi-education system, kepha futhi kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Abantu baziwa kakhulu, ukusebenza kwabo kwezemfundo kudinga ukusizwa. Lokhu kwaba umgogodla, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi abakulindele ekuphuzeni, ukudala izikhalazo namalungelo abantu. Ngabe umphakathi wazifaka kanjani? Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi basebenze izisekelo. Umsebenzi waba yinto ethokozisayo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi uqhubeke uhamba phambili. Kwaholelwa futhi ezintweni ezinjengokuhumusha iziphetho zokuthola imfundo, nezinsuku ezinzima. Sazomangalisa ngendlela abafundi bakhombisa izithakazelo zabo kumaphoyisa. Ngaphakathi kwalokho, iminyango yokuqala yokuqala yathatha izinyathelo zebhande, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Abantu bazi kahle ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala, futhi imiphakathi iqhubeka, kudinga ukufuna ukuba umsebenzi udinga ukuthokozisa. Ngokubuza lezi zindaba, kuphinde kuvimbe, abantu bazi ukubona ukuthi izinto sezisiphendukile. Thembisa lokhu, sizokwenza ukusika umcabango. Hhayi-ke, lokhu umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall kube umcimbi omuhle empilweni, kepha akukhona ukuthi akukhona nephutha. Kukhona ukungabaza okufana nokuthi "ngabe sifuna ukushintsha imithetho,?" kepha lokhu bekungesona isizathu esingaba yisinyathelo esisha. Umkhankaso uveze izifundo ezithile, ngabe lokho kudalwa yikuphi ukungabazeki? Futhi akukhona nje esikhathini esisha, kukhona abavota abasha, izinsiza zikaMasipala. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi naye uyashintsha. Umsebenzi wezemfundo uyathokoziswa kakhulu. Ukubhekwa kwezemfundo kokuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokufunda kuqabula izixhumanisi ezithile. Ngabe abathinta abathinta? Abafundi bahlala baphumelela emhlabeni jikelele, kepha umkhosi ubonisa ezinye izigwegwe ezithandwayo. Abafundi baqala ukufunda ukuthi banakho. Lokhu kunika umhlaba umbono omusha. Isikhathi sihamba, kepha umthelela womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ufuna ukuxhaswa, izikhangiso ezidingeka, nokubamba iqhaza emazweni ahlukile. Kukho abaqhoshayo, abathokozelayo, nabe nezinhlangano ezithile abangenazo izinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umkhankaso uqhubeka, ngisho naphakathi kwezinhlekelele. Ubufakazi bokuthi abafundi babekwenza akukho kuphumelelayo nakancane. Mhla ubona izimpi ezinzima, sinokukhumbula ukuthi lokhu akupheli. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvula amathuba, kepha uthinta igunya, ngabe lokho kuyinto edinga ukubhekwa? Ngokuvamile, umsebenzi omuhle we-Fees Must Fall awukupheli, futhi sizokwazi ukuxoxa ngo-2016. Ngokubungaza lokho, sithi umphakathi udinga ukwenza ukufuna impilo. Ngabe kunokuthile okungashintsha lokhu? Lo mkhankaso uzobonisa ukuthi ubungcweti busemathubeni. Ngiyazi ukuthi imfundo iyadingeka, nokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall waphakanyiswa ngezinyathelo ezinzima, futhi umthelela unamandla. Funda, hamba phambili! Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfundo iyinsiza, futhi lokho kuzoletha ushintsho. Uhambo nutshwala, futhi akupheli!
Ngiyavuma, le ndaba yeMedupi iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa sizama ukuyiqonda kahle. Ngabe ubazi ukuthi ama-boiler aseMedupi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza ugesi? Yebo, kodwa kukhona okuthile okungahambi kahle. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngama-boiler, lawo ma-mashini amakhulu akha umusi ukuze akhiqize ugesi. Kodwa, kulokhu, ama-boiler aseMedupi abhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Lokhu kuhluleka kwama-boiler kubangelwa izinto eziningi, njengokwakhiwa okungafanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinto ezithile ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.
