Amaphrojekthi ahlangabezana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu Njengoba siqhubeka nokuphila emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona inkinga kuphela kubantu abathengisa noma ohulumeni, kodwa kubalulekile kithi sonke. Lokhu kuhlobene nempilo yethu yonke. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu sekuholele ekutheni sithole izixazululo ezihlukene ezizothinta kahle umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nemvelo yethu. Ngakho, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise izinga lethu lokuphila, futhi siqonde kahle impilo yethu yesikhathi esizayo. Omunye wemikhankaso emikhulu emhlabeni jikelele uhilela amaphrojekthi akhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, okuhlanganisa imithombo efana nelanga, umoya, namanzi. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ukuvuselela amandla kuyisixazululo esiyinhloko ekunciphiseni umthelela wezokukhiqiza kwezimbiwa, okungakhuthaza ukuncipha kokungcola. Izinhlelo zokufaka amandla avuselelekayo emakhaya zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, zikhulula izabelomali ezinkulu, futhi zinciphisa ukungcola kwenhawunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphrojekthi okubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu angase aqhube imikhankaso yokungcwaba okuhlakaniphile, okukhuthaza ukungcwaba kwemfucumfucu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukudla okuvela emakhaya, kube nomthelela omuhle ekulondolozeni imithombo yethu yemvelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlalisana kwezilwane nemvelo yazo kubalulekile ukuze kugcinwe ukulinganisela. Amaphrojekthi avikela izindawo zemvelo, njengezinkanyezi zomhlaba nezikhukhula, ahlinzeka ngombono omuhle wokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zinkinga. Njengoba izindawo ezinjalo zigcinwa, zikhuthaza ukuhamba kwemvelo, okwenza sikhumbule ukubaluleka kwazo. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni nabantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kudinga hhayi kuphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqwashisa emphakathini. Umqondo wokusebenzisa kahle izinsiza kufanele uqale ezindaweni ezincane, njengemindeni nezikole. Izifundo ezithinta imvelo ezikoleni zidinga ukufundiswa, ukuze izigaba ezahlukene zempilo ziqonde ngempilo yethu, impilo yomhlaba, nezinsiza esizisebenzisayo. Ngokwesibonelo, lapho sisebenzisa amandla ekuphileni kwethu, kudingeka siqinisekise ukuthi sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukufaka izipho zokuphila eziphilayo, njengemithombo evela ezitshalweni, kugqugquzela umqondo wokulinganisa nempilo. Lokhu kungathuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuphila, futhi kuvikele imvelo yethu ekongoleni nasekugugulelweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaphrojekthi okuphila ngendlela ehlanzekile kufanele ahlanganise izindawo ezichichimayo. Ngokuvamile, abantu basendaweni ezimnyama bahlala nemikhubulo yokungcola. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi simo sidinga izixazululo zendawo, uma singathatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizoba nempilo ehamba phambili. Amaphrojekthi ezokuthutha kufanele ahlanganise ukucacisa phakathi kokuthutha, izinyathelo ezincane zokuhlala ziqashwa njalo. Ngokufingqa, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kudinga umqondo ohlukile ophumelelayo kwi-ecosystem yethu. Amaphrojekthi akhuthaza izinsizakusebenza, izifundo ezithinta imvelo, kanye nokugcina izimo zenhlalakahle, zonke zikhombisa indlela esifuna ngayo. Ngokubambisana, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, onobuchwepheshe obuphathelene noshintsho lwezulu. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, eliphephile nezeluleki. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, singenza umehluko, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sidlulisela umhlaba ophilayo kwabanye.
Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Isingeniso Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa indlela yokuhlela izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. Uhlelo lwethu luzogxila ezicini ezihlukahlukene ezithinta intsha, izizathu zokungasebenzi kwabo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Kulolu hlelo, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingxoxo zikhuluma ngempumelelo futhi zikhuthaza izinqumo eziphumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Izingxoxo 1. Ukubamba Izingxoxo Zokuqala Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abamele ikomidi bazi kahle izihloko ezizoxoxwa. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezitholwe ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngaphambili mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. 2. Ukuhlela Izinsuku Nezindawo Beka izinsuku ezithile zokuhlangana. Qinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsuku zikhona kubo bonke abamele ikomidi, futhi uhlinzeke ngezindawo ezikahle nezidingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana kahle. 3. Ukubiza Izikhulumi Biza izikhulumi ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezithunywa zezinhlangano zentsha, abezindaba, kanye nochwepheshe bezokusebenza ukuze bahlale bephendula imibuzo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlola Izizathu Zokungasebenzi Kwentsha 1. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Qinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwakhelwe kahle ukuze kutholakale izizathu ezivela kubantu abasha. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezibhalwe phansi, izifundo zocwaningo, kanye nemibuzo ethunyelwe kubantu abasha. 2. Ukuxoxa Nezithunywa Zokwakha Thola izinkulumo ezivela ezithunyweni ezihlukene ezikhuluma ngempumelelo yokusebenza kwentsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izizathu ezihambisana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. 3. Ukuhlanganisa Imibono Hlanganisa imibono ehlukahlukene evela ezithunyweni, ukuze uthole umbono ophelele mayelana nezizathu zokungasebenzi kwentsha. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuxoxa Ngezixazululo 1. Ukubheka Izixazululo Ezingaba Khona Ngemuva kokuhlola izizathu, qhubeka nokubheka izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokusebenza, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, noma izinhlelo zokufundisa. 2. Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokusebenza Dala uhlelo lokusebenza olucacile oluzobandakanya izinyathelo ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqedwe ukungasebenzi kwentsha. Lokhu kuzofaka izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, izinsuku ezithile, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 3. Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokusebenza Xhumana nezikhungo zendawo ezifana nezikole, izikhungo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zentuthuko ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo zikhona. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela 1. Ukubeka Izinkomba Zempumelelo Dala izinkomba ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlola impumelelo yezixazululo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kungafaka izibalo zokusebenza kwentsha, izibalo zokuphuma emsebenzini, kanye nezilinganiso zokwaneliseka. 2. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Lokubuyekeza Hlela ucwaningo lokubuyekeza ukuze uthole umbono wokuthi izixazululo zisebenza kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3. Ukuphendula Izimpendulo Phendula izimpendulo ezitholakele ukuze uthuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula izixazululo ezitholakalayo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nentsha 1. Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana Dala izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela intsha. Lokhu kungafaka izinkundla zokuxhumana, imihlangano, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 2. Ukwenza Imikhankaso Yokukhuthaza Hlela imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuze uthumele imiyalezo ethile ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. 3. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Qinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwePhalamende nentsha buye bukhula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izixazululo ezithile. Isiphetho Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izizathu, nokubheka izixazululo ezithile. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuxazulula le nkinga ebalulekile. Ukuxhumana nentsha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izixazululo zethu zisebenza futhi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa imiphumela emihle ezimpilweni zabantu abasha.
Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-podcast aseNingizimu Afrika abe yinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokuzijabulisa. Lezi zinhlelo zokulalelwayo, ezivame ukwenziwa ngabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, zikhombisa ukukhula okukhulu, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayazithokozela futhi bayazifuna lezi zinhlelo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izizathu eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-podcast, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezifundo ezitholakala kulokhu kuthuthuka. Okokuqala, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubona ama-podcast njengendlela yokuxhumana ngezinto ezibalulekile. Njengoba abantu bethola ithuba lokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta impilo yabo, izinkinga zomphakathi, nezindaba zomnotho, ama-podcast akha indawo yokuxoxa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu babelane ngemicabango nemibono yabo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baxoxe ngezindaba ezibucayi. Okwesibili, ukwanda kwezobuchwepheshe nezinsiza zokulalela ama-podcast kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwama-podcast. Njengoba abantu bethola ukufinyelela kalula kumadivayisi afana namafoni, ama-tablet, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, kulula kakhulu ukuwathola ama-podcast. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila nezindaba ezintsha, bephendula ezimweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukusabalalisa ama-podcast, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babelane ngama-podcast abawathandayo nabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izihloko ezithinta ubuciko, ezemidlalo, ezempilo, nezokwakha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bejolise ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi ama-podcast anikeza izixazululo, izeluleko, kanye nezifundo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ama-podcast abe yinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi nolwazi. Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika akukhona kuphela ngenxa yokutholakala kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Abantu abaningi baveza izindaba zabo, izifundo, kanye nemicabango yabo kumama-podcast, okwenza kube lula kubanye ukuba bafunde futhi bakhule. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast akhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ezimweni ezinzima. Njengoba abantu bephila emhlabeni ogcwele izinselelo, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa ngezinto ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu babone ukuthi abakhulumi bodwa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela zokuphila, nezindlela zokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezivela kubantu abanolwazi, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhule futhi bathole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuhlobene nendlela ama-podcast akhuthaza ngayo ukufunda okuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, ukukhula kwama-podcast akukhona ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Njengoba abantu bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, kunezinto ezithile ezidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinselelo zokuhlonza ama-podcast aphumelelayo, njengoba kunezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga abantu ukuba bahlale bephendula futhi bahlolisise ama-podcast ukuze bathole lezo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuhweba zikhona. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, abenzi bama-podcast badinga ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali. Lokhu kudinga ukucabanga ngendlela yokuhlanganisa izikhangiso, izixazululo zokubambisana, noma ezinye izindlela zokuthola imali. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze ama-podcast akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayafuna izindlela zokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi abenzi bama-podcast bahlale bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, ukuze baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngama-podcast anekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubheka ukuhamba phambili kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhona ukuze zixhumane, zifundise, futhi zikhuthaze abantu. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-podcast awukuphela kwezindlela zokuxhumana, kodwa ziwusizo olukhulu empilweni yethu. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokulalela, ukufunda, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall, ophakamiswe ngabangani bezeMpilo nezokufunda eminyakeni edlule, ube nesizathu esijulile emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zimpikiswano, ezazifaka impilo nezindleko zamaholo ezikoleni ephakeme, zaphinde zavula ithuba lokuxoxa ngababukeli bomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Ngalesi sihloko, sizobuyekezwa umthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso, wokuqonda ukuthi usithinte kanjani umphakathi, izinqubomgomo zezemfundo, kanye nokuqhubeka kwempilo yabafundi. Ukuphakanyiswa kwe-Fees Must Fall kwakuwuphawu lokuphikisana kokufuna uguquko olukhulu ezindlekweni zemfundo. Lokhu kwaholela ezimfudlaniswaneni phakathi kwabafundi, abanikazi bezikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Umkhankaso, ophakanyiswe ngezinga elikhulu ngo-2015, waphawula ukufana kwezinkinga ezithinta abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi amafundi avela emiphakathini ethukile. Lokhu kubonisa isidingo sokwehlisa izindleko zemfundo ukuze ivule izindlela zokufunda komphakathi wonke. Naphezu kwamathuba amaningi afunwa amalungelo abantu, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ushayele ubuhlungu ezikhungweni zemfundo. Uhlale ubonisa ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezifundiswa, okuyinto edalule izifundo ezibalulekile ezithinta ubunjalo bezikhozi zomphakathi. Njengoba abadlali abahlukene behambisana nezimpikiswano, umphakathi uqhubekile ngokwethula izinhlelo ezintsha, ezifana neMali yokufunda, ezihlosiwe ukusiza abafundi abangasekho kuzo zonke izigaba. Kodwa, umthelela walomkhankaso akugcinanga nje ngokwenyuka kwezindleko. Uhisile ubuchwepheshe bokuqonda kwempilo yempilo zabafundi. Abafundi abangama-Fees Must Fall baveze izinselele ezenzeka emiphakathini ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlaba umkhosi wezothando nolwazi lwemfundo. Lokho kuholele ekubeni abafundi bazame ukuhlanganisa amalungelo nezidingo zabo, besebenzisa izikhungo zokuxhumana ukuze babelane ngezinto ezihlukene ezibahambayo. Umkhankaso ubenomthelela ekugqugquzeleni izinqubomgomo ezilungisiwe. Uhlangothi lwezombusazwe, oluhlangene nalezi zicelo, luzange lube nemiphumela emihle. Izikhungo zemfundo ziphinde zenze izinyathelo ezinzima ekushintsheni izinqubomgomo, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele nama-bursaries kwabafundi abavela emiphakathini ethukile. Lokhu kuveza ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza, kuphinde kudlule kudinga izikhungo ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi abakhiqizi bazo babhekelela umphakathi wonke. Kodwa-ke, kunokukhathazeka okuningi kuphakathi. Noma sezikhona izinyathelo ezithathwe, ubudlelwane phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nabafundi buphatheke kabi. Amabhande asezulwini ashiywe emhlabeni, ngemishumo ezishukumisayo ezifunwa ukusombululwa. Lokhu kubangela ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwabafundi, okuyinto eyangaqondakali, bese kudala imikhankaso engalindelekile. Ngaphezu kwezinqubomgomo, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvuselele ingxoxo emikhulu ngenhlonipho yokufunda. Kuphinde kwaba nempumelelo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe bemfundo, okuhlinzeka ngaphezulu kwethuba lokufunda ngemithombo ehlukene. Abafundi bayaziqhenya ngokuveza ubuciko bomphakathi, besebenzisa indlela yokuphila ehloswe ngophiko lokwazisa nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ukuze siqonde umthelela wesikhathi eside, kufanele sihlole nokuphambana phakathi kokuphakanyiswa kwesimo esihamba nalesi sikhumbuzo. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ukhuthaze ukuxhumana okukhanyayo phakathi kwabafundi, abaholi bezifundo, nohulumeni, kodwa unganqoba ukukhathazeka kwezifundiswa. Ukusho lokhu, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ukuyenza imizamo emisha yokutakula izithiyo, Ukwazi kamba izidingo ezifanele izigaba futhi sibe nezingxoxo ezikuleso sikhumbuzo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube yinto eyisikhumbuzo sokuguquka kwemiphakathi kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi ungakha izindawo eziphathekayo zomphakathi ezinhloboni. Ngokufingqa, umthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso kuveza ithuba lokwazisa kwabafundi, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zemfundo, nezinqubomgomo ezithinta yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kungase kube yisifundo esimaqhubu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane, abesilisa, nosomabhizinisi banokufunda futhi baphumelele, baphinde bakhulise ithemba lobuchwepheshe obusha. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungomunye wezinto eziba namandla okufundisa umphakathi nezifundo eziphakeme, zikhumbuza imbali yokuphila nezimpilo zabafundi. Ukukhipha izimpendulo eziphumelelayo ezaziyingxenye yeziqu, ukwazisa ngemfundo, kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi ube belungile. Lokhu akusona nje isifiso, kodwa ibhadi eliqinileyo lokuphuma, ukuhamba phambili, nokubuyisela ithemba kulabo abake bahlula izindlela. Ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, kuzodingeka ukuthi siguquke, sibe nezindlela eziqhubekayo, thina sonke. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukufunda akukona ukuhlola, kodwa ukuhamba phambili ndawonye, ukunxenxa uthando nesifiso sokuphila, sifuna izimpendulo ezingaphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba izifundiswa zobuchwepheshe bukhulise izinqola ezilungile, uhlelo lwezizinda nemfundo, ukuze izizukulwane zethu zibe nesizathu sokukhula. Lokhu kuzoshukumisela ubuchwepheshe, umbono wezemfundo, nezimpilo zethu zonke, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala nakwezinye izindawo eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abantu baphila ndawonye, behlanganyela izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhweba. IThekwini yaba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi omkhulu ungaba nomthelela omuhle kwezohwebo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlukene. Ngokubheka emuva, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala njengomlando obalulekile. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi omkhulu ungaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi ungakhuthaza ukuhweba, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi. IThekwini iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, ezokuthutha, nasempilweni yabantu. Lokhu kuhlobene nokwakhiwa komphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ngakho-ke, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala njengomlando obalulekile, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezohwebo eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Isingeniso Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021, ezazihlanganisa izigameko zokuphikisana, ukugqugquzela, nokuphikisana nezinsiza, zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zigameko zikhombisa ubunzima obukhona emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokuphepha, kanye nezokuphatha. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuzogxila emtheleleni wezibhelu emnothweni, izizathu eziyisisekelo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi. Izizathu zezibhelu Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zenzeka ngenxa yokuhlangana kwezinto eziningi. Ukukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi, ukungabi nabulungisa kwezomnotho, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yomphakathi ngenxa ye-COVID-19 kwaba nemithelela emibi. Ukudlondlobala kwemali yokuphila nokungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kuhlanganiswe nezinsolo zokuphathwa kabi kwempahla yomphakathi, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphume emigwaqweni, bephikisa izinqubomgomo zohulumeni. Umthelela emnothweni Izibhelu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuphazamiseka kwezohwebo, ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nokwanda kokungabikhona kwezinsiza zikhombisa isimo esinzima. Izindawo ezithintekile kakhulu zifaka phakathi izimboni ezincane, ezokuthutha, kanye nezokwakha. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi, futhi kwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuthola imali yokuphila. Izinyathelo zokubuyisela emuva Ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi yezibhelu, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zicatshangwe zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukubuyiselwa komnotho: Uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva ezizothuthukisa umnotho, njengezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zikhona ukuze kuqedwe izinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuphepha. 3. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi: Ukuze kuqedwe ukungaboni ngaso linye, uhulumeni kufanele ahlale exhumana nomphakathi, abelane ngemininingwane, futhi athathe izinyathelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. 4. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha: Ukuze kuvinjelwe izigameko ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo, ezizobandakanya zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Isiphetho Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezikhona emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Umthelela wazo ubalulekile, futhi udinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo nezisebenzayo ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi. Ukuze umnotho ubuyiselwe emuva, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umnotho oqinile, onobulungiswa, nolungele ikusasa.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule Izinhlelo zama-internship zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono nolwazi lwabafundi abaphothule. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukufunda okwenziwa emsebenzini, okuvumela abafundi ukuba baqonde izidingo zemboni, baphinde bathole ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo olutholakele ezikhungweni zemfundo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zama-internship ezitholakalayo kubafundi abaphothule, izinzuzo zazo, nezindlela zokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokusebenza. Izindlela zama-internship 1. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa ezihlelwe yizikhungo zemfundo Izikhungo zemfundo ziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zama-internship ezikhethekile ukuze ziqhube abafundi emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zivame ukuhlanganisa izifundo ezithile ezihlobene nomkhakha, okuvumela abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile. Ukuze abafundi baphumelele kulezi zinhlelo, kudingeka bahlale beqedile izifundo ezithile, futhi bahlale bephumelela ezivivinyweni ezithile. 2. Izinhlelo zama-internship ezizimele Abafundi bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zama-internship ezizimele, lapho behlola amathuba emisebenzi bezodwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufaka izicelo ezikhungweni ezahlukene, ukuthola ama-referensi, noma ukwenza ucwaningo ukuze bathole izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngama-internship. Le ndlela ivumela abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokuphatha izinqumo zabo, futhi ibavumela ukuba bakhe amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. 3. Izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinkampani Izikhungo zemfundo ziningi ezisebenzisana nezinkampani ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola ithuba lokusebenza. Lezi zinhlelo zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala befinyelela ezinhlelweni ezihlinzekwa yizinkampani ezihamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezemfundo nezomnotho, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. 4. Ama-internship ahlinzekwa ngabezindaba Abafundi abaphothule bangasebenzisa ama-internship ahlinzekwa ngabezindaba, lapho bethola ithuba lokusebenza ezinkampanini ezinkulu, ezikhiqiza izindaba, noma ezokuxhumana. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono okukhuluma, ukubhala, kanye nokuxhumana, okuvumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Izinzuzo zama-internship Ama-internship ahlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa abafundi abaphothule. Ezinye zezinzuzo zifaka: 1. Ukwanda kwamakhono Abafundi bathola ithuba lokuthuthukisa amakhono abo emsebenzini, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ikhono labo lokusebenza ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. 2. Ukwazi imisebenzi Ama-internship avumela abafundi ukuba baqonde kangcono izimfuno zemisebenzi emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bahlale beqonda izinguquko ezisemkhakheni, nezidingo ezithile ezihambisana nezifundo zabo. 3. Ukuxhumana nabantu Abafundi bathola ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obubalulekile nabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala amathuba okuxhumana, okungaholela emathubeni emisebenzi esikhathini esizayo. 4. Ukuthola izitifiketi Abafundi abanama-internship bangathola izitifiketi ezikhombisa ulwazi lwabo, okungasiza ekwandiseni amathuba abo emisebenzi. Lezi zitifiketi zikhombisa ukuthi abafundi benza kahle emkhakheni wabo, futhi zikhuthaza abaqashi ukuba bacabangele abafundi abanezi zitifiketi. Izindlela zokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokusebenza Ukuze abafundi baphumelele emkhakheni wezokusebenza, kudingeka balandele izinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukuzimisela Abafundi kumele babe nezifiso ezicacile zokuphumelela. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuzimisela ukufunda, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokusebenza kanzima ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. 2. Ukuxhumana Abafundi kumele bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu abavela emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bathole amathuba emisebenzi, futhi bahlale befinyelela ezinsizakazini ezihlukene. 3. Ukuzibandakanya Abafundi kumele bazibandakanye ezinhlelweni ezihlukene, njengokuhlanganyela emisebenzini, izifundo ezengeziwe, noma imihlangano. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi bahlale beqonda izinguquko emkhakheni wabo. 4. Ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela nabanye, ukuze bathole amava ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, futhi bahlale beqonda izidingo zomsebenzi. Isiphetho Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphumelela emsebenzini. Lezi zindlela zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, baqonde kangcono izimfuno zemisebenzi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obubalulekile emikhakheni yabo. Ngokulandela izinyathelo ezithile, abafundi bangathola amathuba angcono, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela emsebenzini. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzimisela, nokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze abafundi baphumelele emkhakheni wezokusebenza.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile E-Kusile, isiteshi esisha sokukhiqiza ugesi esiseMpumalanga Kapa, sekukhulunywa kakhulu ngokuqhubeka kokubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas. Lokhu kubambezeleka, okuthinta izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, kubonisa izinselele ezinkulu ezikhona emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, okukhathaza kakhulu abathintekayo. Iphrojekthi ye-flue gas, eyakhiwa ngenhloso yokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi eyingozi emoyeni, iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kweKusile, okuyisiteshi esikhulu sokukhiqiza ugesi esizothuthukisa ukutholakala kukagesi kuleli. Nokho, izinkinga ezahlukene, kubalwa nezinkinga zokwakha, ukungahambisani nezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezimali, kanye nezinkinga zokusebenza, ziye zenza ukuthi le phrojekthi ibambezeleke. Okwamanje, abaphathi bephrojekthi bathi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubo zihamba kahle ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukusebenza. Lokhu kubambezeleka kuthinteka kabi ezinhlelweni zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengoba izimakethe zithwele kanzima ngenxa yokwehla kokutholakala kukagesi. Izinselele ezikhona ziphinde ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezimbonini ezincane, okuyinto ethinta umnotho wendawo. Kodwa-ke, ubuchwepheshe obusha obusetshenziswa ekwakhiweni kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas bukhombisa ithemba lokuthi lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa. Abachwepheshe bahlola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanza umoya, ezizoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza ugesi. Uhlanga olwakhiwe kule phrojekthi luzophinde luthuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo, njengoba kusebenza izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya. Ummeli wenkampani ephakathi kokwakhiwa kweKusile, uThabo Mthembu, uthe: "Siyaziqonda kahle izinselele ezikhona, kodwa sinesifiso sokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukuze siphumelele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa umoya esiphila kuwo, futhi kuzokhulisa amandla ethu okukhanyisa." Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abahlali bendawo baveza ukukhathazeka kwabo ngezinkinga eziqhubekayo. UNaomi Dlamini, umphakathi wezindawo eziseduze neKusile, uthe: "Sicela ukuba lesi sikhungo sithathe izinyathelo ezisheshayo. Imindeni yethu iyathinteka kakhulu, futhi sithandazela ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezisheshayo." Uhlelo lwephrojekthi ye-flue gas lungathuthukiswa ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezakhamuzi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kube nokubambisana okuhle, kuthuthukise izinga lemisebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwakha kanye nokuhlanza umoya zikhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iKusile ingaba yisibonelo esihle sokuphila kahle kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zethu zemvelo zihlala ziphila. Abanye abachwepheshe bathi, ukuhlinzekwa ngogesi okwanele kubalulekile emnothweni. Uma iKusile ingaphumeleli, lokho kuzothinta kakhulu izimboni ezahlukene, okuholela ekwehleni kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abancane abakhaliphile abakhangayo umsebenzi. Ngaphandle kokubambezeleka, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umoya zidinga ukuba ziqhubeke. Abasebenzi baphinde bakhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwedlanzana lezi zinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umoya ophumayo uhlala uhlanzekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Ikhono lokuhlanza umoya lingenza umehluko omkhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umphakathi awukwazi ukuzifihla. Njengoba izinhlelo zeKusile ziqhubeka, umphakathi ubheke phambili ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga ukuze kuzuzwe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokubheka phambili, ubuchwepheshe obusha obutholakala ekwakhiweni kweKusile buhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umoya ungena ezindlini zabantu ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Lokhu kuzophinde kuthuthukise umnotho wendawo, kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uphakamisa izwi lokubambisana ukuze kuxazululwe izinselele ezikhona. Iphrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile ibalulekile, futhi kubalulekile ukuba wonke umuntu abe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa elihamba phambili. I-Kusile ingaba yinsika yempilo engcono, uma wonke umuntu edlalela indima yakhe. Isikhathi sizobonisa ukuthi le phrojekthi izophumelela yini, kodwa ithemba lidlulela phambili njengoba umphakathi unikezela usizo, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka, futhi izinkampani zikhuthaza ukukhiqiza ugesi ngendlela ehambisana nemvelo. I-Kusile ingaba yisibonelo esihle, uma zonke izithako zisebenza kahle, nazo zikhona emhlabeni.
Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, olwaziwa nangokuthi "ukondla izingane ezikoleni," luhlanganisa izinhlelo ezikhethiwe zokuhlinzeka ukudla okuthuthukile nekhwalithi ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola ukudla okunempilo okudingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuhlola izinguquko ezithinta imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo kakhulu. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwavela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa lwaba neqhaza elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ngemva kokuphuma kwenkululeko ngo-1994. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga zokuntuleka kokudla, ubumpofu, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokungabi nempilo phakathi kwezingane zaba yizinto ezazidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane ezithola ukudla okunempilo ziba nekhono eliphezulu lokufunda, zikhula kahle, futhi ziba nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, uhulumeni we-ANC waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ukudla ezikoleni, okwakuhloswe ukusiza izingane ezivela emindenini enezinkinga zezimali. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweMnyango Wezemfundo, owawuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikole, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zithola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngonyaka ka-1999, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwathuthukiswa kakhulu, lwafaka phakathi izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokudla, okuhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, nezinye izinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kwavumela izingane ukuba zibe nokudla okunempilo, okwakuhloswe ukunciphisa izinga lokungabi nempilo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezingane ezincane. Uhlelo lwaba nempumelelo ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezifundo, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi, okuhloswe ukuqinisa umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ezinye zezinkinga ezazikhona zifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ukudla okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni uhulumeni abheke izindlela ezintsha zokwenza ngcono uhlelo, kuhlanganise nokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uhulumeni waqala ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza ezithile, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngempahla yokupheka, izitsha, kanye nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Lokhu kwavumela izikole ukuba ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ukudla okuphumelelayo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izikole zathola ithuba lokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ukudla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukudla okunempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhamba phambili, lwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungasebenza kanjani ukuze uthuthukise izimo zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa ngemikhuba yokudla, ezazihlose ukufundisa izingane ngokuqonda okungcono kokudla okunempilo. Ngonyaka ka-2010, uhulumeni waqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lokuphila kwezingane ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luyasebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba izikole zathola izinsiza eziningi, futhi izinhlelo zokondla zathuthukiswa ukuze zifanele izidingo zezingane. Lokhu kwavumela izingane ukuba zibe nekhono eliphezulu lokufunda, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lezemfundo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhamba phambili, luhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlinzeka ukudla, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala lukhona, luhamba phambili, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala lukhona, luhamba phambili, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi.
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition (JET) luhloselwe ukusungula umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolondolozayo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza amandla. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula izindlela zethu zokukhiqiza, ukuthola amandla, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emvelweni. I-Just Energy Transition ibalulekile ngoba ibheka izidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola amandla ahlanzekile. ### 1. Yini i-Just Energy Transition? I-Just Energy Transition iyinqubo yokushintsha umthombo wamandla, igxile ekwehliseni ukuthembela kumafutha emvelo, njengegesi ne-coal, bese kuthathwa amandla ahlanzekile, njenge-solar, wind, ne-hydro. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvimbela ukushisa komhlaba, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emisha. I-JET ibalulekile ngoba ibheka izici zokulingana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo kakhulu, ezinjengokuhlupheka, ububha, nezindawo ezinomthelela omubi. ### 2. Izizathu zokutshala imali ku-JET Ukutshala imali ku-JET kunezinzuzo eziningi: - Ukunciphisa Ukungcoliswa: Ukusebenzisa amandla ahlanzekile kunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, okwenza kube nokuphila okungcono kubantu nakwezilwane. - Ukudala Imisebenzi: Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlinzeka ngokuqashwa emikhakheni emisha, efana nezokwakha iziteshi zamandla ahlanzekile, ukwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, nokunye. - Ukuthuthukisa Umnotho: Ukutshala imali ku-JET kungakhuthaza umnotho wendawo, njengoba izinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla ahlanzekile zidinga abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. - Ukuphucula Ukufinyelela Kwamandla: I-JET iqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude noma ezihluphekayo bathola amandla ahlanzekile, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo engcono. ### 3. Izindlela Zokutshala Imali ku-JET Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-JET lungabandakanya izindlela eziningi: - Ukuxhaswa Kwezimali: Izikhungo zezimali zinganikeza uxhaso lwezimali kumaphrojekthi ahlanzekile, okwenza kube lula ukuwakhulisa. - Ukwakhiwa Kwamathuba: Ukuphakamisa izinhlelo zokufundisa nokwakha amakhono kubantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza emikhakheni yamandla ahlanzekile. - Ukubambisana Nezinkampani: Izinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla zingabambisana nohulumeni ukuze zisebenzise izinsiza ezikhona, zikhulise imisebenzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazuza. - Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokulawula: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lwe-JET lusebenza kahle, kudingeka izinhlelo ezilawulayo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza. ### 4. Izinselelo Zokutshala Imali ku-JET Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokutshala imali ku-JET: - Ukungabaza Kwezimali: Abanye abantu bangase babe nokungabaza mayelana nokubeka imali emaphrojekthini ahlanzekile, ngenxa yokungaqiniseki ngezimali ezizotholakala. - Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe obusha bukhona, kodwa kudingeka isikhathi nemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. - Ukuphikiswa Kwezombusazwe: Ezinye izinhlelo zingase zibe nezithiyo ezivela ezombusazwe, njengoba abanye abantu bengase baphikise izinguquko ezinkulu. ### 5. Ukubaluleka Kokubambisana Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, nabantu bomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele. Ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu, kudingeka ukuthi bonke abathintekayo basebenze ndawonye, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula, ukulingana, nokuthuthukiswa. ### 6. Isiphetho Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luhloselwe ukusungula umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolondolozayo. Ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elinokuthula, nelinobulungiswa. Ukutshala imali ku-JET akusizi kuphela ekunciphiseni ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukisa umnotho, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amandla ahlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sifeze lezi zinjongo, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uthola izinzuzo eziphelele zokuguqulwa kwamandla.
Amasu okulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane Kulo nyaka, ubhejane, noma i-rhinoceros, ubhekene nezinsongo ezinkulu ezivela ekuncipheni kwezindawo zawo zokuhlala, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, nokuzingelwa okungapheli. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lesi simo, kubalulekile ukuhlola amasiko, izindlela, nezinhlelo ezisetshenziswayo ukuze kulwe nokuzingelwa kobhejane. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzoqonda izindlela eziphumelelayo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe. Izindlela Zokulwa Nokuzingelwa Izindlela ezisetshenziswayo zokulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala ziqondiswe ekwandiseni ukuvikeleka kwalezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Okwamanje, izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala evikelekile, ukulawulwa kwezinsiza, kanye nokwakha ubambiswano phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi nezokuphila kwendalo ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ukwakha Izindawo Zokuhlala Eziphephile Enye yezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ubhejane iwukwakha izindawo ezivikelekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuvikelwa kwezimila ezisemqoka, ukuvimbela ukufinyelela kwabantu, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala ezihlala zihlala ziphephile. Izindawo ezinjalo zidinga ukugcinwa kahle, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo zihlala ziphephile. Ukubambisana Nezindawo Zokuhlala Ukubambisana phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlelo zomphakathi kubalulekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa abantu bendawo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuvikela ubhejane, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibandakanya umphakathi. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, futhi abantu bazizwa bekhululekile ukuvikela lezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Izinselelo Ezinzima Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izinguquko zezulu, kanye nokwanda kokuhlala kwabantu kudala imiphumela emibi ezindaweni zokuhlala. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukufundisa abantu, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokulawula izinsiza. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye buvele njengomgqugquzeli omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane. Izinhlelo zokubona izilwane ezisemqoka, izinhlelo zokulawula izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izithombe ezivela phezulu, izinhlelo zokulandelela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibandakanya abantu bendawo. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa Izinhlelo zokufundisa zibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsongo ezibhekene nobhejane. Ukuze abantu bazi ngezinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi mayelana nemiphumela yokuzingelwa. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izingane nabantu abadala, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela lezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Izixazululo Eziphakanyisiwe Izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganisa abantu, izinhlelo zokuphila kwendalo, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya umphakathi, ukusiza abantu bendawo ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela ubhejane, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokulawula izinsiza. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, amasu okulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane adinga ukuba ahlaziywe ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinyoni ezinkulu zihlala ziphephile, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokuphila kwendalo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlala. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zindlela, singenza umthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinyoni zihlala zikhona ezweni lethu. Ukubuyekezwa kwezinselelo nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe kuzoqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane, futhi kuzoqhubeka nokuba yinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wokuvikela imvelo.
Ngiyavuma, asiqale! Ngicabanga ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom kuyinto ethokozisayo kakhulu. Njengoba sonke sazi, i-Eskom ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Manje, uma sikhuluma nge-smart meters, kusho ukuthi sikhuluma ngama-meters akwazi ukuxhumana ngokuqondile, akwazi ukusakaza idatha, futhi akwazi ukusiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zisebenza kanjani? Ziyakwazi ukukala ugesi osukumiwe, futhi zikhumbula izikhathi lapho umsebenzisi ethola ugesi kakhulu. Lokhu kuhle ngoba kuzosiza abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bahlala kanjani. Futhi, uma kukhona ukusetshenziswa okungajwayelekile, lezi zinto zikhumbula lokho, futhi zingabika. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kukhona okungajwayelekile, i-Eskom ingakwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzoba usizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi emakhaya. Ngabe kukhona owake waba nezinkinga zokukhokha ugesi? Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala benecala lokuthi bahlala bekhokha kakhulu, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, lokho kuzoshintsha. Uzokwazi ukubona kahle ukuthi ugesi owusebenzisa ubani, futhi uzokwazi ukwenza izinguquko uma kudingeka. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngalezi smart meters. Bakholelwa ukuthi kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, noma ukuthi i-Eskom izoba nekhono lokubona konke okwenzayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yinkinga, ngoba abantu bahlala befuna ubumfihlo. Nokho, i-Eskom ithi izokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi idatha yakho iphephile. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, kufanele sikhulume nangezindleko. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi lezi zinto zingabiza kakhulu. Nokho, uma ucabanga ngempela, uma zikhona izinzuzo eziningi, kungenzeka kube kuhle ukukhokha kancane ukuze uthole lezi zinsizakalo. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi lezi zindleko zifanele? Kukhona futhi abanye abantu abakhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokufaka lezi smart meters. Kukhona abathi lokhu kuzoba yinkinga, ngoba kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kodwa, uma i-Eskom iqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, lokho kuzokwenza kube lula. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Ngiyazi ukuthi zifakwe ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa abantu bazi kahle ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uqala ukusebenzisa i-smart meter, uzoba nekhono lokubona ukuthi ugesi wakho usebenza kanjani, futhi uzokwazi ukulawula kangcono. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, kufanele sikhulume nangezinhlelo ezihambisana nazo. I-Eskom inezinhlelo eziningi zokufundisa abantu ukuthi bangasebenzisa kanjani lezi zinto. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bengazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani, kuzoba nzima ukuzithola. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokufundisa zibalulekile? Ngabe uthanda ukwazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zisebenza kanjani emakhaya? Ngicabanga ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela ugesi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile? Ngokuphathelene nezimo zomhlaba, i-smart meter ingasiza ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma abantu beqonda kahle ukuthi bahlala kanjani, bangakwazi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa komhlaba. Lokhu kuyasiza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomhlaba. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zingasiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle? Uma abantu benokwazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi, bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle zokusebenzisa ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo, i-Eskom ikhuluma ngama-smart meters njengendlela yokwenza izinto zibe lula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma i-Eskom ifaka lezi zinto, kuzoba lula ukuphatha ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lezi smart meters zizoba yinzuzo? Ngicabanga ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali. Lokhu kuyasiza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomhlaba. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi smart meters zinezinto eziningi ezinhle, kodwa kufanele siqaphele nezinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Ngabe ukhona omunye umbono noma imibuzo onayo? Ngiyajabula ukusizwa ngalezi zindaba!
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Ngokwezimo zomnotho emhlabeni, iCOVID-19 ibangele ukuhamba phambili kokungasebenzi, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuphila, kanye nezimo ezinzima kubantu abaningi. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zibhekwane, uhulumeni wakwaZulu-Natali kanye nohulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika, baphakamise isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant. Lo mbhalo uzobheka indlela lesi sikhwama esisetshenziswa ngayo, imiphumela yaso, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezindleko zokuphila. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo waleli sikhwama. Isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant siphakanyiswa ukusiza abantu abathintekayo ngqo yiCOVID-19, kanye nezindawo zempilo zomphakathi. Lezi zibonelelo zafaneleka kumaphesheya aphansi, kubantu abahola kancane, kanye nabathintekile kakhulu ezimeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kube nomphumela omuhle, njengoba kuvele kwanda abantu abahola kahle. Naphezu kokuba isibonelelo sikhona, abanye abantu basenobunzima ekukufinyeleleni. Lokhu kubonisa izinkinga ezivela ekutholeni lesi sikhwama. Imingcele Yokufinyeleleka: Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuthola lesi sikhwama, umphakathi kufanele uhambisane nemigomo ethile, efaka phakathi izidingo zokubhaliswa, ezivame ukuba nzima kubantu abangenazo izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu kuveza inkinga yokuthi abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela lesi sikhwama ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi noma izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwesibonelelo kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi amafomu ahlanzekile, ukuhamba kwezimali kuhamba kahle, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa kahle. Ubululelwe bokuphatha buvame ukuba yinkinga, lapho imiphakathi ethile ibonwa ingatholi kahle ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuwa kokuthola imiphumela engafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi nesabelo sesikhwama seSocial Relief Grant kuveza umbuzo, "Ngabe sikhona isidingo sokuphinde sihlolisise le mibandela?" Le ngxoxo ibalulekile ngoba umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uhlinzeka ngensizakalo ehambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke kabusha imigomo yokufaneleka, futhi abheke izindlela zokuphathwa okungcono ukuze avumele abantu abaningi ukufinyelela kulezi zibonelelo. Nokho, kufanele sazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoba nezindleko ezihambisana nakho. Umphakathi uzodinga ukufaka imali eningi kuzo zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenzisa. Nakuba ithonsi leSocial Relief Grant likhona, alikwazi ukwenziwa kabusha. Lesi sikhwama siphumelelayo emphakathini, njengoba singasebenza njengensizakalo esheshayo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokugxila ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosiza lesi sikhwama, njengoba sizokwenza izinqumo ezibeka izidingo zabantu phambili. Futhi, ukugxila kwethu emiphumeleni yeSocial Relief Grant kubalulekile. Ubuwena bubalulekile, njengoba kuvele kudinga ukukhumbula ukuthi iGrant ithuthukisa izimo zabantu abathintekayo ngqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile ezinhlelweni zomnotho. Abantu abathintekayo bakhombisa ukuhlela kabusha izimpilo zabo, ukuphuma ekuthatheni kwezindlela ezimbi, futhi balwela ukuthuthukisa izikhala zabo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo seCOVID-19 Social Relief Grant kutshengisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezinqubomgomo zikahulumeni. Nanoma izinkinga ziyavela ekufinyeleleni, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kumavolontiya, umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelayo. Ukuze iGrant ibe nomthelela omuhle, kudingeka sishintshe izindlela zethu zokuphatha, sihlolisise izidingo zabantu, futhi sithuthukise imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokudlulisela imiyalezo ebalulekile emphakathini, okwenza isibonelelo sijabulise izimpilo zezakhamuzi. Ngakho-ke, ukuba siqhathanise nemiphumela yasendaweni nezinzuzo ezinkulu zomnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe izidingo zabantu. Njengempela, kuphela lapho umuntu efunda ukuhamba komnotho kahle, sizokwazi ukuphumelela ekuphileni kwethu. Ukuba nohlelo oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuqinisa imiphakathi yethu futhi sisize ukubuyisela umphakathi ngokuphelele ngemuva kweCovid-19.
Okutholakele kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli Isingeniso Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ubangele ukugxekwa okukhulu nokuhlolwa. Lesi sihloko sizobheka izinyathelo ezithathwe kuphenyo, izizathu ezitholakele zokuthi kwenzeka umlilo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezidingekayo ukuze kuvinjezelwe izigameko ezifana nalezi esikhathini esizayo. 1. Ukuqonda Umlilo Umlilo ubonakala njengomcimbi ophazamisa impilo, impahla, nemvelo. Ukuze uqonde izimbangela nemiphumela yalokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umlilo utholakala kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Izinsiza Zomlilo: Izinto ezivumela umlilo ukuvutha, njengezinto zokwakha ezithile, amafutha, noma izinto eziphilayo. - Izimo Zokwakha: Isakhiwo esakhiwe ngezakhiwo ezingavikeli umlilo kahle siba sengozini. 2. Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Phezu kokuba umlilo usuwonke, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphenyo lwenziwa kahle: - Ukubhaliswa Kwesigameko: Ukuqala, izinyathelo zokuqala zifaka ukubhaliswa kwesigameko sokuphuma komlilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu basendaweni baphume ngokuphepha. - Ubufakazi Bobuchwepheshe: Abahloli baphenyi izinsalela zomlilo, izinsiza zemizila, nezinsizakusebenza zokwakha ukuze babone ukuthi kwenzekeni. 3. Izizathu Ezingaba Nemiphumela Ngemuva kokuhlola izinsiza ezithintekayo, abaphenyi bathola izizathu ezithile ezichaza ukuthi umlilo wenzeka kanjani: - Ugesi Oweqile: Imithombo yokushisa engaphephi ibangele ukwehla kwemigudu kagesi, okuholele emlilweni. - Ukungavikeleki Kwensiza: Izakhiwo zihlolwe zatholakala zingalungile, zinezikali eziphansi zokuvikela umlilo. - Ukwehluleka Kokuphendula: Izinhlangano eziphathelene nokuphendula ziphumelele kakhulu ekuphenduleni, kodwa izinqubo ezihlobene nezenzakalo ezinjalo zidinga ukuphuculwa. 4. Ukuphendula Kwezimpendulo Ngemuva kokuhlonza izizathu, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezithile: - Ukulungiswa Kwemithetho: Kudingeka ukuhlela kabusha imithetho yokwakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zonke zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kubandakanya izindinganiso zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zihlola izidingo zokuvikela umlilo. - Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Abasebenzi badinga ukuqeqeshwa njalo ngemikhuba emihle yokuphendula emlilweni ukuze bathole ulwazi olunembile lokuphuma kulokhu. - Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokuphendula: Ukuze kube nokuphendula okuphumelelayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa nokuqiniswa. 5. Ukuvikelwa Kwezakhiwo Ukuphepha kwezikhala zomphakathi kumele kube yinto yesibili: - Ukufaka Izinhlelo Zokuvikela: Izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuvikela umlilo ezifana nezishintshi zokuqhuma, ama-alamu, nezinsiza zokuphepha kumele zenziwe zibe yizinjongo eziphakeme. - Izinsiza Zokuphepha: Ukunikeza izinsiza ezifanele, ezifana namafire extinguishers, kumele kube umgomo ophakeme ezakhiweni. 6. Ukuhlola Izinqubomgomo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zifika kulokho obekuhlosiwe, kuhle ukuhlola izinqubomgomo: - Uphenyo Olwaqhamuka: Izinyathelo ezithathwe kumaphrojekthi okwakha zidinga ukuhlolwa njalo ukujolisa izinhlelo ezithuthukayo. - Ukubuyekeza Izinqubomgomo: Izinqubomgomo kumele zihlolwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisesikhathini futhi zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Uphiko lwezokuphepha luthola izifundo eziningi kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli. Ukuze kuvinjwe izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinyathelo ezithile zokuphepha, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuvikeleka okungcono, futhi kunciphise amathuba okuthola umlilo ezakhiweni zomphakathi.
Uphenyo Lokuvuza Kwamaphepha Kamatikuletsheni Isingeniso Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luhambisana nokwanda kokuhlangenwe nakho kwezindaba ezimbi emhlabeni. Ukuvuza, okungukuthi, ukusakazwa kwemininingwane engafanele, kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezimbonini ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha, ezemfundo, nezomnotho. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuhlola izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona zokuvikela amaphepha kamatikuletsheni, okungukuthi, imibhalo ebalulekile ethinta izinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Izimbangela Zokuvuza Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kungenzeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuhweba ngemininingwane engalungile, lapho abantu abavula izinkampani noma izikhungo bangase baphule imithetho yokuvikela imininingwane. Okwesibili, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezindlela zokuvikela nokuphatha amaphepha kamatikuletsheni kungaholela ekuvuzweni. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezingasebenzi kahle noma ezindala zingaholela ezinhlekeleleni zokuvuza. Imiphumela Imiphumela yokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni ibalulekile futhi iyingozi. Ukuvuza kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka kwezinhlangano, okungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuthembela kwabantu. Imiphumela yokwephulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela imininingwane ingaholela ezijezweni ezinzima, okungaholela ekwehleni kwemali. Futhi, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ethile ingaphathwa kahle. Izixazululo Zokuvikela Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zithathwe. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zisesikhathini futhi zisebenze kahle. Lokhu kusho ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokuvikela imininingwane. Okwesibili, izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha amaphepha kamatikuletsheni kufanele zisetshenziswe, futhi lezi zinqubomgomo kufanele zihlale zihlaziywa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisesikhathini. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi kuzokwandisa ithuba lokuvikela imininingwane. Ukubaluleka Kokuqwashisa Ukuqwashisa ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile. Izinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni akuyona inkinga kuphela yokuphepha, kodwa futhi kuyinkinga yokuthembeka. Ukuqwashisa kufanele kuhlanganise ukuxhumana okuhle nabantu ukuze baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokuvuza, okuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha isiko lokuvikela imininingwane. Isiphetho Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luhlobene nezinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zithathwe, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nokuqwashisa okuhle. Uma zingathathwa lezi zinyathelo, imiphumela yokuvuza ingaba yingozi, hhayi kuphela ezinkampanini kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokuvikela imininingwane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kuyinto eyaziwayo futhi engavunyelwe. Ukuvikela imininingwane kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kubo bonke abantu.
Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni: Iphrofayela KaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu, oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala, ungumfundisi ophumelelayo osemkhakheni wezokudla nezokondla. Uthole iziqu zakhe kwiNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona iBSc in Nutrition and Dietetics. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uSipho waqala umsebenzi wakhe ezikoleni, eholwa umgomo wokuthuthukisa impilo nezinhloso zokufunda zabafundi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waphawula ukuthi uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlukumezeka. Abafundi abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga zokudla, okuholela ekutheni bahlupheke ezifundweni zabo. Lokhu kwakhuthaza uSipho ukuba aqale ukuhlaziya uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, ukuze abone ukuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Uhlolo lwakhe lwokuqala lwagxila ezindaweni ezithile, njengokwakheka kokudla, izinga lokudla okukhona, kanye nezidingo zezingane ezihlukene. USipho wathola ukuthi izikole eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokondla, ezingahlangabezani nezidingo ezithile zabafundi. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abanye abafundi baphumelele kancane ezifundweni zabo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kokudla okunempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waqala ukubambisana nezikole ezahlukene, esebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze anikeze izeluleko eziphusile. Waqala uhlelo lokuqwashisa abafundi, abathintekayo, nabazali ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. Waphinde wathuthukisa uhlelo lokondla olwakhelwe abafundi, olwakhiwe ngokuqondile ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Uhlelo lukaSipho lwakhelwe phezu kwemigomo emibili ebalulekile: ukudla okunempilo nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhuba yokudla. Lokhu kwavumela abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izithako ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Uhlelo lwakhe luhlanganisa ukudla okwenziwe ngezithako ezisemqoka, okukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathande ukudla okunempilo. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zikaSipho lwabandakanya izifundo ezihlukene, ezihlanganisa imikhuba yokudla, izifundo zokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Uhlelo lwakhe lwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokudla okunempilo, futhi lukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. U-Sipho uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana nabazali, ukuze babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni imikhuba yokudla emakhaya. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abazali bayazi ukuthi ukondla kahle izingane zabo kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhula kwazo, futhi ukuthi imikhuba yokudla ibalulekile empilweni yazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi imiphumela yohlelo lokondla ezikoleni ibonakala. Abafundi baqala ukukhula ngokomzimba, futhi izinga lokusebenza kwabo ezifundweni lenyuka. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uSipho wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yemizamo yakhe. U-Sipho ungumholi othembekile, ohlala elwela impilo engcono yebanga labafundi. Uhlanga lwakhe lokondla lwenza kube lula ukufinyelela impumelelo, futhi uthanda ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni, futhi ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi. U-Sipho uhlala eqhubeka nokusebenza ekuthuthukiseni uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, futhi unethemba lokuthi izikole eziningi zizokwamukela izinhlelo zakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi ukondla kahle akukhona kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kuwumgomo wokwakha impilo enempilo, ethuthukisa imiphumela yokufunda, futhi igqugquzela ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokubambisana nabanye othisha, abezindaba, nezikhungo zokondla, uSipho uqhubeka nokwakha umkhankaso ophumelelayo wokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zokudla, futhi ubaluleka kokubambisana ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho uzoba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi, futhi uzohlala esebenzela impilo engcono yezehlakalo. Uhlelo lwakhe lokondla ezikoleni luhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zabafundi, futhi lukhombisa ukuthi ukondla kahle kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ozinikele, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lokuthuthukisa impilo yabafundi, futhi uzohlala edlondlobala emkhakheni wezokondla.
Inkinga Yokubhalisa Emanyuvesi: Izithiyo Ezingabhekana Nabafundi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inkinga yokubhalisa emanyuvesi iyinhloso ebalulekile, ibhidliza amaphupho nezifiso zabafundi abaningi. Lokhu kubangelwa izinselelo ezihlobene nokuhlinzekwa kwezindawo zokubhalisela izifundo, izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanye nezimo ezinzima zezimali. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuze kucace ukuthi kungani le nkinga ibalulekile kubafundi nabazali, nakuba ivame ukuvela njalo ngonyaka. Ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka wesifundo, abafundi abasha banikezwa ithuba lokubhalisela izifundo, kodwa lokhu kuvame ukuhamba kancane ezinsukwini zokugcina zokubhalisa. Lokhu kudala ubunzima kubafundi abasha nabathuthela emanyuvesi, njengoba imfuneko yokubhaliswa iba nzima kakhulu. Abafundi bahlola izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokubhalisa, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuqedela lezi zinqubo. Izinkinga ezitholakala emakhosombeni emanyuvesi zikhuluma ngokuqinile ngokuvela kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithile ezihlinzekwa yizikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Ngokwesibonelo, ezinye izikhungo zikhombisa izinkinga zokungabi nakho ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezivela ezinhlelweni zokubhalisa, okuhlanganisa amawebhusayithi angasebenzi kahle, izinsizakalo ezitholakala zikhawulelwe, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikole neminyango yokubhalisa. Ukungqubuzana phakathi kwemali, isikhathi, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kudala umoya wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabafundi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abaningi bahluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo ukuze baqedele izinqubo zabo zokubhalisa. Abafundi abavela emakhaya anothile bangathola izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kodwa labo abavela emakhaya aphansi bahlala behluleka, njengoba izinsizakalo zokubhalisa zingase zibe zikhawulelwe, noma nezimali zokubhalisa zingabizi kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu zokubhalisa, abanye abafundi baphinde babhekane nezinselelo zokuhamba. Izinhlangano ezithile zikhuluma ngokuthi kukhona izinkampani ezizimele ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubhalisa, kodwa lezi zinsizakalo zihlala zikhokhiswa kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima kwabafundi abaningi. Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi inkinga yokubhalisa ayikhona nje emkhakheni wezokubhalisa, kodwa ibanjwe ezindlekweni eziphezulu ezihambisana nezifundo. Uhlaka lwezombusazwe luphinde lunikeze isithombe sokuthi izinkinga zokubhalisa zingahluka uma kubhekwa izikole ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlobene nezimboni zokufundisa ezihlukene, ezithinta izikole ezincane kanye nezikole ezinkulu. Izikole ezinkulu zihlala zikhona ezikhaleni ezikhangayo, kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kwabafundi abasha abafuna ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezidumile. Abafundi abasha basebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukukhangisa izinkinga ezibhekene nabo, njengezinkinga zokungabi nakho kokubhaliswa, ukuze baziwe. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwamagama ezinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubhalisa ezisheshayo, kodwa akukwazi ukuqeda zonke izinkinga ezikhungethe abafundi. Uhlaka lwezombangazwe lunenhloso yokunciphisa lezi zinkinga zokubhalisa, futhi abaholi bazo balungisa izinqubo ezahlukene ukuze kuzuzwe ukuxhaswa kwempilo yabafundi. Ucwaningo olwenziwa ezikhungweni zemfundo luhloswe ukuthola izixazululo eziphelele ezizophumelela ekubhaliseni, njengoba kudingeka izinguquko ezinkulu emikhakheni yokuheha nokuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwezimali. Ngokuphetha, inkinga yokubhalisa emanyuvesi ibalulekile, futhi izidingo zabafundi zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngempumelelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathweswe iziqu bangaphumelela, bahloniphe izifundo zabo. Ubulunga bezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa yizikhungo zemfundo ephakeme bukhomba ukuthi kwenziwa umsebenzi omkhulu, kodwa izivumelwano ezikhethekile zidingekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinkinga zokubhalisa zixazululwa. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, ukwandisa izinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo zokubhalisa ngendlela elula.
Ucwaningo Ngezinkokhelo Zabasebenzi Embonini Yezimayini Sawubona! Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi sinesikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, okungukuthi izinkokhelo zabasebenzi embonini yezimayini. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wethu? Ngempela, izimayini zenza umsebenzi omkhulu, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamaholo, sithola ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle. Ucinga kanjani ngalezi zinkampani ezinkulu? Ziyaziqhenya ngokukhuluma ngamaholo aphezulu, kodwa uma sithanda ukuhlola okwenzekayo, sithola ukuthi abanye abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yazo, kodwa uma kukhulunywa ngamaholo, zihlala zikhuluma ngezindleko kuphela. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Ngikhumbula ngikhuluma nomunye umphakathi wezabasebenzi, futhi wakhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhona. Wathi, “Siyazi ukuthi imboni yezimayini iyakhula, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamaholo, sithola ukuthi abanye bethu basathola amaholo aphansi.” Lokhu kwangithokozisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kudingeka baphakanyiswe. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma kanjani ngempilo yabantu? Zithanda ukusho ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi izinkampani zikhokha kahle kuphela kulabo abaphezulu. Abasebenzi abavamile, ikakhulukazi laba abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Izinkampani zikhuluma ngempilo yabantu, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma kanjani ngempilo yabantu? Zithanda ukusho ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi izinkampani zikhokha kahle kuphela kulabo abaphezulu. Abasebenzi abavamile, abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile.
Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan nemiphumela yazo Uhlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) lwasungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuhlela izinsiza zamandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamandla, kuhlanganise nezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, ezikhanyayo, nezokwakha. Ukubuyekezwa kwalesi hlelo kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kube yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Ngo-2010, i-IRP yokuqala yethulwa, yahlola izidingo zamandla ezweni, yaphinde yahlola izinsiza ezikhona. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha iziteshi zamandla, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqiza ugesi. Nokho, imiphumela yalesi hlelo yakhombisa ukuthi izinsiza ezivuselelekayo zidinga ukuba sezingeni eliphezulu, njengoba izinsiza ezivamile, njengezimayini z coal, zikhombisa ukuncipha kokusebenza kahle. Ngo-2018, kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa okukhulu kwe-IRP, okwakuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esisha sokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamandla. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kugxile ekwandiseni amandla okukhanyisa, ukwehlisa ukuncika kumafutha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo. Izinhloso eziphakanyisiwe zazifaka phakathi ukwandisa amandla okukhanyisa ugesi ophuma ezinsizeni ezivuselelekayo, njengezikhukhula, umoya, nelanga. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu abaningi bahlala khona. Lokhu kwanciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza ugesi, kwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ugesi. Nokho, izibuyekezo ze-IRP azizange zibe lula. Kwakukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kwaholela ezinkingeni ezithile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamandla, okwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ngo-2020, kwenziwa olunye uhlelo lokubuyekezwa kwe-IRP, lapho kwavuma khona ukuthi izinsiza ezivuselelekayo kufanele zibe yizinto ezisemqoka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha iziteshi zamandla ezivuselelekayo, okuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ohlangene, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nesimo sezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi ezindaweni eziningi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okudingayo ukuxhaswa kwezimali. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ekuphathweni kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kwaba yinkinga enkulu, okwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngokuqhubeka, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika, zaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni, empilweni yabantu, nasempilweni yomhlaba. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Lokhu kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ohlangene, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nesimo sezulu.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa impilo, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, nokwakha umphakathi. Lezi zingadi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, zinciphise ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, futhi zandise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zokwakha nokuphatha izingadi zokudla emadolobheni. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha Indawo 1. Thola Indawo Efanele: Khetha indawo enelanga elanele, enomhlabathi onempilo, futhi engaphansi kokungcoliswa. Izindawo ezinjengemakhaya, izinkundla, noma izindawo ezingenamahlathi zifaneleka kahle. 2. Hlola Umhlabathi: Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlabathi unempilo. Ungasebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unama-nutrients adingekayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izinhlobo Zezithelo Nezimbali 1. Khetha Izinhlobo Ezifanele: Khetha izithelo nezimbali ezivumelana nezimo zendawo yakho. Izithelo ezifana namakhowe, amakhabe, nezimbali ezifana nezimbali zothando zifaneleka kahle emadolobheni. 2. Bheka Isikhathi Sokukhula: Qonda isikhathi sokukhula kwezinhlobo ozikhethayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela isikhathi sokuhlwanyela. Isinyathelo 3: Ukulungiselela Umhlabathi 1. Susa Izitshalo Ezindala: Uma kukhona izitshalo ezindala, qiniseka ukuthi uzisusa ukuze uvule indawo yokukhula. 2. Phakamisa Umhlabathi: Faka umhlabathi omusha noma uthuthukise umhlabathi okhona ngama-organic fertilizers ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unama-nutrients adingekayo. 3. Hlanza Umhlabathi: Susa izinsalela, izinsalela zezitshalo, nezinsalela eziphilayo ukuze uvikele izitshalo zakho ekuguleni. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlwanyela 1. Hlanza Izikhala: Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhala phakathi kwezithombo zanele ukuze zikhule kahle. Lokhu kuzovumela umoya nokukhanya ukuba kufinyelele ezitshalweni. 2. Hlwanyela Ngendlela Efanele: Landela imiyalelo yokuhlwanyela yeziqubulo ezikhethiwe. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlwanyela ngezinga elifanele, ungawufaki umhlabathi kakhulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukunakekela Izingadi 1. Phuza Ngendlela Efanele: Qinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zithola amanzi anele. Ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphuzisa ezizenzekelayo ukuze unciphise isikhathi sokunakekela. 2. Susa Izihlahla Nezihlahla: Qinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho azinazo izihlahla eziphilayo. Lokhu kuzovikela izitshalo zakho ekuguleni. 3. Faka Ama-Fertilizers: Faka ama-fertilizers ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izitshalo zikhula kahle. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuvuna 1. Bheka Isikhathi Sokuvuna: Qonda isikhathi sokuvuna kwezinhlobo ozikhethayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuna ngesikhathi esifanele. 2. Vuna Ngendlela Efanele: Qinisekisa ukuthi uvuna izithelo nezimbali ngendlela efanele ukuze ungaphazamisi izitshalo ezisele. Isinyathelo 7: Ukwabelana Ngezithelo Nezimbali 1. Yabelana Nomphakathi: Uma uvuna, yabelana ngezithelo nezimbali nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophilayo futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba bakhe izingadi zabo. 2. Hlela Imicimbi: Hlela imicimbi yokwabelana ngezithelo nezimbali ukuze uthuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa impilo, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha ingadi yokudla ephumelelayo, ethuthukisa impilo yakho, futhi ibandakanye abanye emphakathini. Qhubeka nokukhula, ube nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni wakho.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaholela ekwenziweni kokulalelwa kwePhalamende ngale nkinga kagesi? Impendulo: Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kwenziwa ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulu kwabantu mayelana nezinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi zibhakane nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu emnothweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kagesi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthi uhulumeni abheke le nkinga ngokujulile. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyayibhekwa ngesikhathi sokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sokulalelwa, bekubhekwa izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nezizathu zokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kagesi, izinqubo zokuphatha ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ugesi ongenamaphutha. Abamele izinkampani zikagesi, izikhulu zikahulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele babenethuba lokwethula imibono yabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkinga eziphawulekayo ezavela ngesikhathi sokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinkinga eziphawulekayo ezavela zifaka phakathi ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokukhiqiza ugesi, izinkinga zokuphatha ezikhona, kanye nokuntuleka kokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni. Abanye baphinde bakhomba ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo ezintsha zokukhiqiza ugesi zidinga ukusheshiswa ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Umbuzo 4: Kuthiwani ngemuva kokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokulalelwa, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni athathe izinyathelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izikhungo ezintsha, ukwandisa imithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kubasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zomkhakha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi iziphakamiso ezivela kulalelwa? Impendulo: Iziphakamiso eziningi zaphakanyiswa, kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ukwandiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, nokuhlinzeka ngama-subsidies ezinkampanini ezincane ezikhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ugesi, kuze kube yilapho izinkampani zikagesi zikhulisa ukukhiqiza kwazo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa uhulumeni ukuze abhekane nale nkinga? Impendulo: Uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngama-grants ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokwakha imithetho eqinile yokuphatha izinkampani zikagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ongenamaphutha kubantu. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngempumelelo yokulalelwa? Impendulo: Impumelelo yokulalelwa izobonakala kuphela uma izinyathelo eziphakanyisiwe zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani zikagesi, kanye nabantu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kuzodingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohulumeni ekuthatheni izinyathelo? Impendulo: Uhlelo lokuthatha izinyathelo luhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezimali, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo ezithile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza.
