Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokuxhumana ezitholakala phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni? Impendulo: Izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni zifaka phakathi imihlangano, izinkomfa, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zikagesi ziyaqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 10: Kuthiwani ngekusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika lidinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzodinga ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ukwandiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwezakhamuzi ukuze ziqonde kahle izidingo zomkhakha. Isiphetho: Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kubonisa ubukhulu bokukhathazeka kwabantu ngalesi simo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani zikagesi, kanye nabantu basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzodinga ukubambisana okuqhubekayo.
Ukusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abafuna ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezahlukene ezihlinzekwa yiHhovisi lezeMisebenzi, iZwe, kanye neMiphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngenkonzo yokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zombuso, kuphinde kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Ukusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezindlela ezitholakalayo, izinzuzo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Izinsizakalo Ezitholakalayo Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo ze-ID, izicelo zokuhlala, kanye nezicelo zezimali. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthi bafake izicelo zabo ngaphandle kokuhamba emaphandleni, okwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Uhlelo lusebenza ngohlelo oluhlelwe kahle, oluhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi izicelo zingafakwa kanjani, izidingo ezidingekayo, kanye nezikhathi zokuphendula. Izinyathelo Zokusebenza Ukuze uqale ukusebenza ngohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online, umsebenzisi kufanele avakashele iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-Home Affairs. Ngemuva kwalokho, umsebenzisi kufanele abhalise, uma engakabhalisile, bese eqhubeka nokufaka isicelo. Iwebhusayithi inikeza iziqondiso ezicacile nezinyathelo ezilandelwayo, ezisiza umsebenzisi ukuba aqonde kahle inqubo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinyathelo ezilandelayo zidinga ukufakwa kwemininingwane ethile, njengegama, idatha yokuxhumana, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokuhlonza. Izinzuzo Zohlelo Lokusebenza Online Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online lunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, lwenza kube lula kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, okunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda. Okwesibili, luhlinzeka ngenkonzo esheshayo, njengoba izicelo zingabhekwa futhi ziphendulwe ngokushesha. Lokhu kwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu, njengoba kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zendabuko, ezifana nezikhala ezinkulu zokulinda emaphandleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwe-online luhlinzeka ngokuqina kokuphepha, njengoba imininingwane yomsebenzisi igcinwa ngokuphephile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinsizakalo zidinga ukuvikela imininingwane yomuntu siqu. Izindlela zokuphepha ezifana nezokufihla imininingwane kanye nezokuphepha kwe-inthanethi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane ibhekwa kuphela ngababhaliswe ngokusemthethweni. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nohlelo Noma kunjalo, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online lunezinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zokufinyelela ezilindelekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba aphansi okuxhumana ne-inthanethi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwe-inthanethi ezindaweni ezikude. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenza kahle kohlelo. Abanye abasebenzisi baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izicelo zabo aziphenduli kahle, noma ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula sithatha isikhathi eside. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlola okuqhubekayo kohlelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenza kahle, futhi ukuthi abasebenzisi bathola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngenkonzo ebalulekile kubantu abafuna ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Izinzuzo eziningi zikhona, kodwa izinkinga ezithile zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lusebenza kahle. Ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo, kanye nokwandiswa kokufinyelela kwe-inthanethi, kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezihlinzekwa yiHhovisi lezeMisebenzi, iZwe, kanye neMiphakathi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, kanye nohlanganyela.
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Isingeniso Ukuthathwa komhlaba kuyinqubo ebalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo ekwakheni izinhlelo zokwakha, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Nokho, le nqubo ibhekene nezimpikiswano eziningi zomthetho, okuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, izinqubo ezisemthethweni, kanye nemithetho ethinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Le doku mentsi ihlose ukukhombisa izimpikiswano ezisemqoka ezihlobene nalolu daba, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo ihambisana nemithetho nezimiso zokuhlalisana kahle. Izimpikiswano Zomthetho 1. Umlando Wokuthathwa Komhlaba Ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenzeka ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, izinhlelo zokwakha ezinkulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanza izindawo. Nokho, umlando walolu daba ubonisa ukuthi le nqubo ibiyinkimbinkimbi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bahlala khona. Izimpikiswano zihlala zikhona phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. 2. Amalungelo Abantu Omunye wemibuzo ebalulekile ngalesi sihloko ubandakanya amalungelo abantu. Umthetho ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamalungelo athile uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola izinxephezelo ezifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bangavuma noma baphikise ukuthathwa komhlaba, futhi baphinde bathole izinxephezelo ezikhona. 3. Izinyathelo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinyathelo zokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngendlela efanele, ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo, ukuxhumana nabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezizathu zokuthathwa komhlaba. Ukuhlola izimo zomhlaba, izinsiza, kanye nemiphakathi ethintekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zenzelwa ngesisekelo esiqinile. 4. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezivela lapho kuthathwa umhlaba ukuhamba kahle kokuxhumana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezihlukene. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bahlala bezwa ukuthi abaphathi abavumelani nabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezibandakanya izithakazelo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. 5. Izinqubomgomo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinhlelo zokuthathwa komhlaba kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezihambisana nezimfuneko zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo zokuthathwa komhlaba zenzelwa abantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinxephezelo ezikhona zikhona. 6. Izixazululo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kuhamba kahle, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izixazululo zingabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo, ukuze baqonde izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba, kanye nezindlela zokuphikisa uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo ihamba kahle, futhi ibhekelela amalungelo abantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuthathwa komhlaba kufanele kube inqubo esebenza kahle, ehlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izithakazelo zikhuluma ndawonye ukuze kuzuze umphakathi wonke. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi noma ukusiza, sicela uxhumane nezikhungo ezifanele zomthetho noma ezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zibe usizo ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthathwa komhlaba.
Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezimali kumasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlolwa kwamabhuku kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho nezinhlinzeko zokuphatha izimali ziyalandelwa, futhi kuhloswe ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemali. U-Nkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uMenenja wezeMali, uvule umcimbi ngekhulumo echaza izinjongo zokuhlolwa, wathi: “Sihlose ukwakha ukwethembeka nokuphumelela ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuhlola amabhuku kumasipala akusizi kuphela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni.” Ngemva kwalokho, kwaba nezigaba zokuhlola, lapho abahloli benza iziphakamiso ezithile. Ukuhlolwa kuhilela ukubuyekezwa kwamarekhodi, izincwadi zezimali, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Abahloli bahlola izindleko, izinzuzo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala kumasipala, ukuze baqonde kahle indlela izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa ibonise ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ekuphathweni kwemali, kumasipala amaningi kube nezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe. Kukhona amaphuzu abahloli abawafakazile, njengokungabi khona kokubhaliswa kwezimali ezithile, okukhombisa izinkinga ekuphathweni kwemali, okudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwemithetho. Ubulungiswa bokuphathwa kwemali bukhombisa ukuthi kumasipala amakhulu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kusebenza kahle, kodwa kunezikhala ezidinga ukunakwa. Abahloli bagcizelela ukubaluleka kwemfundo nokwakhiwa kwamakhono ukuze kufezwe izinjongo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwemali. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, kwaba nezingxoxo phakathi kwabahloli nabaphathi bamabhuku, ezazifaka iziphakamiso zokuthi masipala bahlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwezinhlelo. Uhlelo lokuhlola luzoba yinsika yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi luzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwemali. Abahloli baphinde baphakamise ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubika ezicacile, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluhlobene nezimali zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani, futhi kuzokwandisa ukwakhiwa kokwethembana. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoshintsha indlela amabhuku aphathwa ngayo kumasipala. Ukuhlolwa kuzoholela ezifundweni ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala uzoba isibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuphathwa kwezimali kungathuthukiswa kanjani. Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezinzima, ezizokwenza ukuthi umphakathi uthole izinsiza ezingcono. Ekupheleni komcimbi, uNkk. Mkhize wakhumbuza bonke abathintekayo ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlolwa iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi kunezinkinga, kodwa sizimisele ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwemali kumasipala. Sifuna ukwakha isiko lokubambisana, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.” Umcimbi ugcine uhlelwe kahle, futhi abavakashi bahlonipha imizamo yokuphatha izimali kumasipala. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqinile, lapho umphakathi uzokwazi ukuthemba ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza abazidingayo.
Ingxoxo: Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngibe lapha namhlanje. Ngithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba ethokozisayo yokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini, kanye nomthelela wayo kwezohwebo. Ngabe ungazichaza izinzuzo ezitholakala ngenxa yokuminyana kwedolobha? Umphenyi: Sanibonani! Ngiyabonga ngokungibiza. Ukuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kunemiphumela eminingi emihle kwezohwebo. Okokuqala, kukhula amathuba okuthengisa. Uma abantu behlala edolobheni, izitolo nezinkampani ziba nekhono lokukhulisa ukuthengisa kwazo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungawuthinta kanjani umnotho wendawo? Umphenyi: Impela. Umnotho wendawo uthola amandla lapho abantu abaningi behlala edolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abaningi ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho wendawo uthola ukwesekwa okuhle, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhuthaza ukutshalwa kwezimali. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umnotho wendawo uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Kodwa-ke, ngabe kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuminyana? Umphenyi: Yebo, zikhona nezinselelo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuphatha izinsiza. Uma abantu behlala ndawonye, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Uma lezi zinsiza zingekho, kungaholela ekudumazekeni kwezohwebo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho ungase ube nezinselelo zokuncintisana, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zifuna ukwanelisa izidingo zabathengi. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta kanjani izimakethe ezahlukene? Umphenyi: Umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta izimakethe ezahlukene ngendlela ehlukile. Ngokwesibonelo, izimakethe ezincane zingazuza kakhulu, njengoba abantu abaningi befuna izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezithile. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokukhula kwezohwebo ezincane. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimakethe ezinkulu zingase zibe nezinselelo zokuncintisana, njengoba izinkampani ezinkulu zifuna ukuthola izabelo ezinkulu emakethe. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nezinselelo ezahlukene. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi izinkampani zingazithuthukisa kanjani ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle? Umphenyi: Izinkampani zingazithuthukisa ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, kufanele ziqonde izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe ukuze zazi ukuthi yini efunwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezithile zokuthi ubuchwepheshe buphumelele kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinkampani? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezibonelo eziningi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinkampani ezisebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhamba zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo kubathengi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabathengi, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abasha. Futhi, izinkampani ezisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ubudlelwano bamakhasimende (CRM) zikwazi ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bazo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omuhle. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta kanjani izinkampani ezincane? Umphenyi: Umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle ezinkampanini ezincane. Njengoba abantu behlala edolobheni, izinkampani ezincane ziba nekhono lokukhula. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhula, njengoba izinkampani zingakwazi ukuheha abathengi abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezincane zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ngabe unazo iziphetho noma izeluleko zokugcina? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini ungaba yithuba elikhulu kwezohwebo, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde izidingo zabathengi futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi futhi kuqinise umnotho wendawo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zihloko zibalulekile. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nathi namuhla. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqwashisa ngezinkinga zokuphepha komphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuhlola impumelelo yezinkundla zokuphepha ezikhona ezinyangeni ezedlule. Kukhona izindawo ezikhombisa ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo nezinhlaka zokuphepha, okuholela ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kudingeka sihlole izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Izinkundla zokuphepha zifaka phakathi izinsiza zomphakathi, izithunywa zamaphoyisa, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ezitholakala ezindaweni eziningi. Umphakathi uqhubekile ukufunda ukubaluleka kokubambisana, lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zokuvikela izindawo zabantu. Isibonelo, eThekwini, iMeya yedolobha ibonise ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwemali kwezinkundla zokuphepha, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Osomatekisi nabaholi bendawo baphinde bathintwe ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zokusebenzisana. Ngokubambisana, abavoti bakha izinkundla zokuxhumana eziphakamisa izindaba zokuphepha, futhi abantu bangathumela izikhalazo ngqo kumaphoyisa, okukhuthaza ukuphendula ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kuholele ekuqhamukeni kokuphenya okusheshayo ezindaweni ezithile. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-‘app’ ziye zaba usizo, lapho abahlali bengathumela khona izithombe noma babele izinkinga zempilo yomphakathi. Izinkundla zokuphepha zifundisa umphakathi izindlela zokuziphatha eziphephile. Umkhankaso wezokuphepha owawuhlelwe nguMnyango Wezobulungiswa ushaye umoya, ugqugquzela abantu ukuba bathumele iziphakamiso zabo, okukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza futhi kukhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezinkundla zokuphepha. Ubukhona bokungaziwa phakathi kwabantu bendawo namaphoyisa kanye nokungabi bikho kwemali eyanele, kube nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukwehluleka kwezinye izindawo kokubambisana nokubhalisela izinkundla zokuphepha kungaholela ekwandeni kobugebengu, njengoba ezinye izindawo zibika ukwanda kwama-cases obugebengu. Ngaphezu kokusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha, ukuhlinzeka ngokwakha inhlonipho kubalulekile. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisana nabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abasha, kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo ethuthukayo. Ukuze kuphumelele, umphakathi kumele ubambisane ukuze uthole izimpendulo ezidingekayo. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezisebenzayo ukuze kuzuze umphumela omuhle. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zidinga ukwazi izinsiza zokuxhumanisa phakathi komphakathi nezinhlaka. Akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile, kodwa ukufaka abantu abasha abasebenzayo ezinhlelweni zokuphepha kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yethu. Namuhla, izinkundla zokuphepha zikhona, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze silwe nezinselelo. Uma ukwehla kwezinkinga zokuphila kuncishiswa, umphakathi udinga ukuthola izixazululo ezihambisana nezinkinga abhekene nazo. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene kuzokwazi ukunciphisa obahlaselayo. Muva nje, umhlahlandlela omusha wezinhlaka zomphakathi ubeka phambili ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizolungisa izinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuze sifinyelele ukuphepha, kudingeka ukwenza isifundo sokubheka izindawo ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukucatshangelwa njengoba imiphakathi isiya phambili. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze uthuthukise imizamo yokubambisana. Ukwakha izinkundla zokuphepha ezinomthelela omuhle, umphakathi udinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuyahambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikeleka. Lokhu kuzoba qiniso kuphela uma sizitholela izimpendulo ezivela kumphakathi mayelana nezokuphepha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizophawula ukuthuthuka nokubuyiselwa kokuthula nezokuphepha emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda izinto eziphakamisa ukuphepha kumphakathi kubalulekile, futhi kumele siqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze siqinisekise impilo enempilo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuthola izixazululo zokusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha kwezokuphepha komphakathi, okuzokwakha umphakathi onenhlonipho, ugcwele amathuba, futhi uqondise phambili emakhaya ethu.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo Izindawo zasemakhaya eLimpopo zibhekene nenkinga enkulu yokushoda kodokotela, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngenxa yokungabi nakho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwelapha ezifanele. Uhlaka lwezempilo lukhombisa ukuthi nakuba kunabantu abaningi basemakhaya, inani lamadokotela alindelekile lincane kakhulu. Ngokwezibalo, kunezindawo eziningi ezinemitholampilo engaphansi kokusebenza, futhi ezinye zazo azinamdokotela nhlobo. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengoba abantu behluleka ukuthola imithi, izeluleko, kanye nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. UProf. Thandiwe Mkhize, odokotela ophakathi kwezempilo eLimpopo, uthe: “Ukushoda kodokotela kuyingxenye ebalulekile, futhi kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo. Abantu badinga ukwelashwa okusheshayo, kodwa uma kufanele baphumele emitholampilo imizuzu engama-30 noma ngaphezulu, lokho kuyabahlupha.” Izizathu zokushoda kodokotela ziningi. Isizathu sokuqala siwukuhola okuphansi, okuvimbela odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Abantu abaningi bakhetha ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinkulu, lapho behola kahle futhi bethola izinsiza ezinhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo ezisemakhaya zihlale zinesimo sokushoda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemitholampilo efanele, izithuthi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana, kudala ubunzima ekusebenzeni kodokotela. UProf. Mkhize uqhubekile: “Kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zempilo, ukuze sikwazi ukuheha odokotela abasha, futhi sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza.” Abahlali bezindawo zasemakhaya baveza ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalolu daba. UMaMkhize, ohlala edolobheni elincane laseLimpopo, uthe: “Ngiyazama ukuthola usizo emitholampilo, kodwa ngithola ukuthi akukwaziwa. Ngithumele emitholampilo eminingi, kodwa abanye bahlali bahlala belindile izinsuku eziningi.” Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezindawo zasemakhaya luphinde lwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale bephila ngaphandle kokwelashwa, okukhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezempilo zomphakathi. Izinyathelo zokuxazulula le nkinga zidinga ukuba zibe phezulu. Uhulumeni kufanele aqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokukhuthaza abanikazi bezemfundo ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo kubodokotela abasha, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Uhlelo lwezempilo oluphumelelayo luyadingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu. Ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, odokotela, kanye nohulumeni kudinga ukuba kube namandla, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zidinga ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuxazululeni le nkinga. UProf. Mkhize wagcizelela: “Sidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha odokotela, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola usizo oludingekayo.” Ekupheleni, ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukusizakala ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo eziphuthumayo nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lwezempilo kumele luhlelwe kabusha ukuze luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlali bahlala bezithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele.
Ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika Emini ethokozisayo, uThandi wayevele esenkampanini enkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wakhe wawuyinjongo yokukhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu emsebenzini. Kodwa lokho kwashintsha ngesikhathi izwe lilwa nezinkinga eziningi ezahlukene, kusukela emikhakheni yezomnotho, kuthela lokho ekukhuleni kwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu ngempela, akakaze acabange ngalokho okuzokwenzeka. Njengoba iba nesikhathi sokusebenza odokotela, umphakathi wawasala uzolile, ngemva kokuba neziyezi ezimnandi lokho obekungabhalwa. Ngokuphenduka kwesimo, uThandi wathola ukuthi kudingeka kwenziwe izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwaba sekuqhamuka umqondo ophawulekayo — ukusebenza ukude. Ngobubanzi, uThandi wayengezwi ubuhlungu bokuhamba ezinsukwini ezilandelayo ngenxa yokuzikhandla kude. Noma kunjalo, ubuhlungu obuncane bangaba usizo ngoba kwaholela ekutholakaleni kwezinsizakalo ezimangalisayo. Yiqiniso, kumshayeli ohlakaniphile, lokhu kwakhombisa indlela yokusebenza efanelana nezidingo zamanje. Umphakathi wezokuphathwa kwempilo uhambisana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezinzima ezake zenzeka. UThandi, owayenobuhlakani bokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, wayezikhandla ukwakha ifa elisha lokusebenza sokukhombisa ngendlela yokubambisana. Ngaphandle kokushaywa yimvula yokuhluleka, izinkampani eziningi zathola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukasipinat hlangene nohlelo lwakhe lwezokuphathelene nezinkampani ezikude. Waqala ukuphenya imikhuba emisha yokusebenza, efaka phakathi ukuxhumana nge-inthanethi, izinkulumo ezibukhoma, kanye namathuluzi okubambisana. Abasebenzi babengase balungiseleleke ukuphila, kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, benza izinqumo ezinkulu zokuphumelela. Noma umsebenzi wokugcina Wayenezingane ezimnandi, uThandi wayevame ukuqhubeka phambili. Abantu bebebhalela izinkampani zezokuxhumana, kanti ngesikhathi esifanayo, izinyathelo ezithile ezakhayo zaholela ekwandeni kwemizamo. UThandi wanakekela izifundo, eqhubeka efunda ngamasu ahlukeneyo. Ngesikhathi umndeni wakhe ufinyelela kuye ngezingxoxo zikaBaba noMama, kwaba njengokuhambisana nomphakathi. Izifundo ngobuchwepheshe, izifundo zokuphila, nezifundo zezimali zazinokuhlangana, zazenzelwa ukuba zibe ngempumelelo. Kukhona okukhudlwana kokuba abantu bahlale bebambisana. UThandi wayebona ukwenziwa kwemikhiqizo, ngisho nasezihlalweni ezimnandi. Umehluko phakathi kwabavakashi nabasebenzi baba yisixazululo esiphumelelayo kakhulu. Ubuqotho bokusebenzisana buhamba phambili kuhlala phansi, uThandi nozakwethu bakhe benza izinto zenzeke. Uzakwabo uMandla, owayesebenza nezingane embonini yezezimali, wakhombisa uthando lwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi noMandla babengabantu abazalayo, bemelele ukuphakamisa, behlola ijubane lempilo. Kwakungumbono omuhle, uhlelo lokuphila luhamba phambili, ngabe uThandi uMandla sikhumbule, ngisho naloko okulungile. Lokhu waqonda ukukhokhela uMandla kuqala ukuhlola izinkampani ezaziwa okufanele kedahliwa. Lokhu kwaba yinzuzo enkulu kumuntu ofuna kakhulu ukukhokhela izikole. UThandi waqaphela ukuthuthukiswa okwandisa igunya lokusebenza kude. Lezi zinkampani, kusukela emkhakheni wezokuxhumana zezimali de kube yizinkampani eziyindida, zafeza isivuno esihle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uThandi noMandla baqala ukuze basebenze Imininingwane Iglobal, ezobuchwepheshe obulinganayo. Lokhu kwakukhipha isithombe esikhangayo somphakathi lapho bezohamba beqhamuka nezimo ezijabulisayo. Imininingwane ifana nezithombe ezizwakala kumatasa abendzeli bezenhlalakahle, izifundo ezihleliwe. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside esisebenza kude, uThandi wakhumbula ukuthi kuyafana njengenhliziyo, okukhombisa umphakathi. Ubhekanisa nosuku olukhejwayo lokulawulwa, nesikhathi sokusebenza sinobudlelwane obuphambili. Esethulela umbono wakho, akekho ozokwazi ukuhamba phambili, uThandi noMandla basibangela umnotho. Ekugcineni, uThandi wajabula ngezithukuthuku ezinhle nezinkanyezi, futhi uMandla wanxusa abafowabo ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle. Njengabantu abasaqalayo, umsebenzi ukude wakwenza kumzamo omkhulu khona kulolu chungechunge olunobuhlakani. Bayazisola, kanti kwayenqaba izithombe ezinzima. Ubuqotho, uMandla noThandi babungangezwi, kanti lesi sikhathi sikhulu silindele ukuhamba phambili — lokhu kube ubufakazi buluntu lwezakhiwo. Baphelelisa imijikelezo, begxila kulokhu, ukukhokhela ukuqonda okwandile, okubonisa ukuba khona okumqoka kokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi nombono wakhe wezokuxhumana,behlanganisa kubasebenzi kodwa bebenza okwabelana ngayo. Uthando lwezokuphathelene nomsebenzi ukude lwaba umcabango omuhle, lwenza lokhu kube okufunayo. Isifundo esephuma emsebenzini ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukusebenza ukude kubalulekile, ukugcina umoya omuhle, nokuhamba phambili kuhlangene ngokuthandekayo yemibono ehamba phambili nezizathu ezinzima zomsakazo. UThandi wayekwazi ukuhamba phambili, kwakuyisikhathi esihle sabo. Lokhu kube yindaba emangalisayo, enokuthuthuka okukhulu endaweni yokusebenza!
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa: Ukubuyekezwa Ekuhlangabezaneni nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa akhombisa ukukhula okukhulu nokwakha amathuba amasha. Le ndawo, eqhakazile ngezinsiza zemvelo, ibhaliswe njengenye yezindawo ezihamba phambili ekuchaphazeleni amandla avuselelekayo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzoqonda ukuthi imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo zishintsha kanjani umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila. ### Ukukhula Kwamandla Avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi afana nezezimali ze-solar, umoya, namafutha amancane ahlanzekile aqhubekele phambili eNyakatho Kapa. Ukushintsha kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, ikakhulukazi kumasipala, kubonakala kulula. I-Solar Cape, isibonelo, iyiphrojekthi ephelele yokutshala izinsiza zomoya ezikhiqiza amandla amaningi, okuholela ekunciphiseni kokuncika kumithombo yamandla anganeni. ### Umthelela Emphakathini Ukwakhiwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo kuye kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Izisebenzi zikhulisiwe ekwakhiweni nasekugcinweni kweziteshi zamandla, lokhu kudala ukuhamba phambili okuhle emiphakathini. Abantu bahlala bezwa izinzuzo zempilo ezikhula ngezinga eliphakeme, njengoba amandla avuselelekayo akhulisa ukufinyelela kumandla kuzo zonke izinhlaka. ### Ukubambisana Neminyango Kahulumeni Ukwakhiwa kwalezi zinhlelo akuhambisani nezinhloso zomphakathi kuphela, kodwa futhi kukhuthazwa kakhulu yiminyango kahulumeni. Iziphathimandla zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezibhekelela ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwama-initiatives wamandla avuselelekayo. Kwakuhloswe ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezivumela ukusetshenziswa kwama-solar panels kumakhaya, okuphucula izinga lokuphila labahlali. ### Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Naphezu kokukhula okuvelele, amaphrojekthi awamukeli wonke umuntu. Ukukhathazeka ngezindleko zokufaka, noma ngabe izinsizakusebenza zikhona, kusemqoka. Lokhu kudinga ukuba abahlinzeki bemali babambisane nokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo eziphumelelayo ezisheshayo. Imali yokubambisana ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphrojekthi awama-solar akwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. ### Ukubheka Ikusasa Iziphathimandla zikhumbula ukuthi amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa awaqediwe. Ukuze kuqhubeke nokuthuthuka, kudingeka izinhlelo ezingqondweni ezizoshintsha indlela yokuphila. Ucwaningo lwezokuthuthukiswa kufanele luthuthukiswe, futhi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zabantu zifanele ukwenziwa ukuze kugcinwe ulwazi olufanayo. ### Ukuphetha Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anikela ithuba elihle lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Ukukhula okuqhubekayo kwemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha ikusasa elinothile. Ngakho-ke, amaphrojekthi amaningi aphesheya kokuphila kwansuku zonke kumele aqashelwe, avunyelwe, futhi asizakale emiphakathini engabaphila. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba abantu baphile impilo engcono, baphile ngokuhlanganyela, futhi baphile ethubeni eliqhakazile. Ukubuyekezwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa kufakazela ukuthi ngempela, amandla avuselelekayo angumkhiqizo wesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kusebenza kumaphrojekthi akhula ngempumelelo nangokubambisana, okukhombisa ukuthi ukwethembeka kumakhasimende, umphakathi, kanye nezokuphila kuzoba yinto ebalulekile emzamweni wokwakha umhlaba omusha.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Intuthuko Ecaleni Lokushushiswa KukaJacob Zuma Ngasese 1. Isingeniso Kulolu hlu lwezinhlinzeko, sithuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma, owayenguMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika. UZuma ubhekwa njengenye yezindaba ezinkulu zentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi le d document izogxila ezinqubweni zokushushiswa kwakhe ngasese, izinzuzo, nokuphazamiseka okungenzeka kulolu hlelo. 2. Umqondo Wokushushiswa Ngasese Ukushushiswa ngasese kubhekisela ekutheni izinqubo zokushushiswa zenzeka ngaphandle kokwaziswa kwabantu abaningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwecala, ukuhlolwa kwemibhalo, kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula ukuvuza kolwazi. Lokhu kungenza kube nezizathu ezilandelayo zokuthi kungani kubalulekile: - Ukuphepha Kwabafakizolo: Ukuvikela ubufakazi kanye nabafakizolo ekushushisweni okungafanele. - Ukuphumelela Kwenqubo: Ukugwema izinkinga zokuphazamiseka ezivela ekwandeni kwezithameli. - Ukwethembeka Kwenqubo: Ukukhuthaza ukwethembeka kokuphathwa kwecala. 3. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Lokhu Kushushiswa 3.1. Ukubekwa Kwezinqubomgomo Izinqubomgomo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokushushiswa zenzeka ngasese kufanele ziqukethwe ezinhlelweni ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukubeka imithetho ecacile yokuphatha izinqubo zokushushiswa. - Ukubambisana nezinsiza zomthetho nezokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kwezinqubo. 3.2. Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Kubalulekile ukuqwashisa bonke abasebenzi abathintekayo ngezinyathelo ezidingekayo zokushushiswa ngasese. Ukuqeqeshwa kufanele kugxile: - Kumigomo nemigudu yokuphatha izinqubo. - Ekubalulekeni kokugcina ulwazi lwasendaweni yokushushiswa. 3.3. Ukuhlola Nokuhlela Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo ezikhona kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kufanele kufake: - Ukuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona zokushushiswa. - Ukuhlela izinhlinzeko eziphathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo. 4. Izinzuzo Zokushushiswa Ngasese - Ukwenziwa Kwezinhlelo: Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqubo zokushushiswa zibe neqhaza elikhulu. - Ukuthuthukiswa Kokwethembeka: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zihlala zikhangayo futhi ziphucukile. 5. Imiphumela Yokuphazamiseka Ukuphazamiseka kwenqubo yokushushiswa kungaholela emiphumeleni emibi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukwehla kokuthembeka kwenqubo. - Ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokubika ezisemthethweni. 6. Ukuhlaziywa Kwamacala Aphezulu Ukuhlaziywa kwamacala ahluke-hluke kaZuma, okuhlanganisa amacala okubanga ubufakazi, kumele kuphathwe ngokuqinile. Ukwenza kahle kulezi zinyathelo kuzothuthukisa umphakathi, kuqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi kugweme ukuphazamiseka okungafanele. 7. Isiphetho Ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle, ukugxila ekuphepheni, nakubufakazi bokwethembeka. Izinqubomgomo ezinhle nezisebenzayo zizokwandisa ukwakhiwa kokwethembeka kwezinqubo zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ubufakazi bokuthi ukushushiswa ngasese kusebenza kahle kuzoba yimpumelelo enkulu ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinqubo zomthetho ezifanele. 8. Izinyathelo Ezinconyiwe - Ukuqoqa imibono nezimvo ezivela kubaphathi bemithetho. - Ukuphathwa kwezemfundo kulabo abathintekayo ezinqubweni zokushushiswa. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zishintshwa ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zomphakathi. Le d document ibeka izinyathelo ezilindelekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese kudlula kahle, kusebenza ngempumelelo, futhi kuhlanga nezimfuno zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika.
Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini kwezohwebo Umbuzo 1: Uminyana uyini, futhi kungani ubalulekile eThekwini? Uminyana ubhekisela enanini labantu, izakhiwo, nezindawo zokusebenza eziseduzane. EThekwini, uminyana ubalulekile ngoba udala amathuba okukhula kwezohwebo. Ngokwanda kwabantu, imakethe iyakhula, okwenza ukuhweba kube lula, futhi kukhula nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umbuzo 2: Uminyana uthinta kanjani izimboni eThekwini? Uminyana unethonya ezimbonini eziningi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuthengisa. Izimboni zokwakha zikhula ngenxa yokwanda kwezidingo zokuhlala, kanti ezokuthutha zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha abantu abaningi. Lokhu kukhula kuholela ekwandeni kokuhweba, njengoba izinkampani zidinga izinsiza eziningi ukuze zifeze izidingo zabantu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuminyana kwezohwebo? Izinzuzo zokuminyana kwezohwebo ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhula kokuhweba njengoba abantu abaningi befika emadolobheni, okuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo ezinkampanini. Okwesibili, uminyana uvula amathuba emisebenzi, izikhungo zokufunda, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, okwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. Umbuzo 4: Kukhona izinselelo ezihambisana nokuminyana? Yebo, kunezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula kwabantu kuholela ezinkingeni zokuhlala, njengokuntuleka kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Uminyana ungathuthukisa imfucumfucu, okungaba nomthelela omubi emvelweni. Umbuzo 5: Umnyango wezohwebo ungabhekana kanjani nalezi zinkinga? Umnyango wezohwebo ungabhekana nalezi zinkinga ngokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, ezifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu, ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, nokuxhasa izinkampani ezincane. Futhi, umnyango ungasebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziqhubeka ziqhutshekela phambili. Umbuzo 6: Ubufakazi bukhona obukhombisa umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini? Yebo, izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi waseThekwini ukhule kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, okuholele ekwandeni kokuhweba. Izinkampani eziningi zikhulise imisebenzi yazo, futhi umnotho waseThekwini ukhule ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungazithuthukisa kanjani ukuze ube nezinzuzo ezinkulu zokuminyana? Umphakathi ungazithuthukisa ngokubambisana, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezidingo zomphakathi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsizakusebenza, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokufunda. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uminyana uphumelela? Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokwakha, ukwakha izikhungo zokuthutha eziphumelelayo, nokuxhasa izinkampani ezincane. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphatha imfucumfucu ukuze umphakathi ungabi nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlala. Umbuzo 9: Ubufakazi bukhona obukhombisa umthelela wokuminyana emhlabeni jikelele? Yebo, emhlabeni jikelele, iminyana ibonakale inezinzuzo eziningi. Izifunda ezinaminyana emikhulu, njengeNew York neTokyo, zikhombisa ukukhula okukhulu kwezohwebo, okukhombisa ukuthi uminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle uma uphathwa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Kutheni kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuhlola umthelela wokuminyana? Ukuqhubeka nokuhlola umthelela wokuminyana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezithathwayo zisebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nokwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo, okuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nokukhula komnotho. Ngamafuphi, uminyana eThekwini unomthelela omkhulu kwezohwebo. Noma kunezinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zikhona, futhi umphakathi ungazithuthukisa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uminyana ube yinzuzo. Ukubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile, nokuhlola umthelela kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuphumelela.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Smart Meter kwa-Eskom Isingeniso I-smart meter iyithuluzi elibalulekile elisetshenziswa yi-Eskom ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube lula ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi, zinciphisa izindleko, futhi zandisa ukusebenza kahle. Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa i-smart meter, izinzuzo zayo, nezinyathelo okufanele uzithathe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono kakhulu kuyo. Izinyathelo Zokusebenzisa i-Smart Meter 1. Thola i-Smart Meter: - Qinisekisa ukuthi u-Eskom unikeza i-smart meter endaweni yakho. Ungavakashela ku-inthanethi ku-website ye-Eskom noma uxhumane ne-ofisi yendawo ukuze uthole ulwazi oluthe xaxa. - Uma uthola ukuthi i-smart meter iyatholakala, cela ukufakwa kwayo. Lokhu kungafaka ukugcwalisa ifomu lokucela noma ukuxhumana nomhlinzeki. 2. Faka i-Smart Meter: - Uma usuthole imvume yokufaka, umhlinzeki uzohlela usuku lokufaka. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungatholakali ngosuku lokufaka ukuze kube lula. - Umhlinzeki uzofaka i-smart meter, aqinisekise ukuthi isebenza kahle, futhi akutshele ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani. 3. Qonda Ukusebenza Kwayo: - Ngemva kokufakwa, thola isikhathi sokufunda indlela yokusebenzisa i-smart meter. Lokhu kungafaka ukufunda izinkomba ezisemqoka, njengokuthi ungabala kanjani ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. - Bheka izinkomba ezikhanyayo ezikwi-smart meter ukuze uqonde ukuthi imaphi amamitha akho akhombisa ukusetshenziswa. 4. Sebenzisa i-App ye-Smart Meter: - I-Eskom inikeza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakala ku-smartphone. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luzokwenza kube lula ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. - Landa uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Eskom ku-Google Play noma ku-App Store, bese ulandela izinyathelo zokubhalisela i-akhawunti. 5. Bheka Ukusetshenziswa Kwakho: - Sebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ubheke ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi ungayinciphisa kanjani. - Bheka izibalo ezitholakala ku-smart meter ukuze uqonde izikhathi lapho ukusetshenziswa kukho kuphezulu kakhulu. 6. Phatha Izindleko: - I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi ubone izindleko zakho zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuhlela kahle izindleko zakho. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uyayiqonda indlela yokubala izindleko zakho eziphathelene nokusetshenziswa kukagesi. 7. Thola Izaziso: - I-smart meter ingakuthumelela izaziso uma ukusetshenziswa kukho kuphezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqaphele futhi uthathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uvula izaziso kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthole lezi zixwayiso. 8. Thuthukisa Ukusetshenziswa Kwakho: - Sebenzisa izeluleko ezitholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi. Lokhu kungafaka ukusebenzisa izibani ezisebenza kahle, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamadivayisi angadingeki, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezisebenza kahle. - Bheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, njengama-thermostats aphathwayo. 9. Xhumana Ne-Eskom: - Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga noma unemibuzo, xhumana ne-Eskom. Ungabathinta ngefoni, nge-imeyili, noma uvakashele i-website yabo. - Qinisekisa ukuthi unemininingwane yakho yokuhweba ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana. 10. Qhubeka Ufundisa: - Qhubeka ufunda ngama-smart meters nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqhubeke uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. - Bhalisela izinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakala ku-Eskom ukuze uhlale unolwazi olusha. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa i-Smart Meter - Ukulawula Okungcono: I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi ubone kahle ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela. - Izindleko Eziphansi: Ngokwazi ukusetshenziswa kwakho, ungathola izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko. - Ukusebenza Kahle: I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi uthole izinsiza ezisebenza kahle, okwenza kube lula ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa. - Izaziso Zokuxwayisa: Izaziso ezitholakala ku-smart meter zikusiza uqaphele izinkinga ezithile. Isiphetho Ukusebenzisa i-smart meter kwa-Eskom kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ngalezi zinyathelo ezilula, ungathola izinzuzo ezinkulu, unciphise izindleko, futhi uthuthukise ukusebenza kahle. Qhubeka ufunda futhi uhlale unolwazi olusha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono kakhulu kwi-smart meter yakho.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala Njengoba izinkinga zezimali ziqhubeka nokukhula, izinkampani ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi i-Eskom, ziba nenkinga enkulu. Kulesi sikhathi esinzima, kubalulekile ukuqonda icebo elisha lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala. Lokhu kuza ngesikhathi lapho izinkampani zikagesi zikhathazekile futhi umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. I-Eskom, njengomphakathi, ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezikweletu. Izikweletu ezikhulayo kumasipala zenza kube nzima ukuthi le nkampani ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo wezingqinamba, lapho izikweletu zikhula, kanti izinsizakalo ziya phansi. Ngakho-ke, icebo lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom iqonde ukuthi izikweletu kumasipala zikhona ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zezezimali. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala kufanele lube nezinqubo ezilula nezicacile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Uma izinqubo zikhona, kuzobe kulula ukuhlela izinkokhelo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Okwesithathu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ibheke izindlela zokukhuthaza amakhono okuphatha izimali kumasipala. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumasipala ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo ngendlela efanele. Uma amakhono okuphatha izimali ethuthukiswa, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala kufanele libe nezinhloso zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom nomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi ekwakheni izixazululo. Uma umphakathi ubamba iqhaza, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Ekugcineni, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Uma izinqubo zikhona, kuzobe kulula ukuhlela izinkokhelo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ibheke izindlela zokukhuthaza amakhono okuphatha izimali kumasipala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele ubambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle.
Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan Ingxoxo noMnumzane Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Wezomnotho Umxoxi: Mnumzane Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukungihlangabeza namuhla. Singaqala ngenkulumo engajulile mayelana nohlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan? Yini leli phrojekthi elikhulu? Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngale ndaba. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukusiza umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi uvuselelwe ngemva kwemiphumela emibi ye-COVID-19. Lolu hlelo luthinta zonke izigaba zomnotho, ikakhulukazi ezokwakha, ezemfundo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izigaba ezahlukene zomnotho kufanele zisebenze ndawonye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kunamathuba, yini izinselelo ezibhekene nalolu hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, izinselelo ziningi. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngezinsiza. Uhlelo lufuna izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa kunobunzima ekutholeni lezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ziningi izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi kudinga ukuhlela kahle kwazo ukuze zifinyelele empumelelweni. Umxoxi: Yiqiniso, futhi umphakathi uthanda ukubona ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhuluma kanjani nezinye izinqubomgomo. Ingabe uhlelo luhlelekile kahle ukuze luhambisane nezinqubomgomo ezikhona? Mthembu: Yebo, uhlelo lwenziwe ngokucophelela ukuze luhambisane nezinye izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, zikazwelonke, kanye nezomhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlangene ukuze sithole impumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokufunda, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokuphucula imisebenzi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zomphakathi. Ingabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu bayathola usizo? Mthembu: Ngempela, umphakathi ophila ngaphansi kwemithwalo yokuqashwa kancane udinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa amaphrojekthi akhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kumasifundisane. Kulolu hlelo, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo efanele iyatholakala kubantu abampofu, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokufundisa amakhono. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngabe uhlelo luhlelwe kanjani ukuze luqinisekise ukuthi lusebenza kahle, futhi lubuyekezwa njalo? Mthembu: Uhlelo luzobuyekezwa njalo, futhi kukhona izigaba ezithile zokuhlola. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinkomba ezicacile zokusebenza ukuze sithole ukuthi imiphumela iyafinyelelwa yini. Izinhlaka ezahlukene zizosiza ekubuyekezweni nasekusebenzeni kahle komqondo. Umxoxi: Lolu hlelo lungaba namathuba amakhulu emiphakathini. Kukhona yini izinhlelo ezithile eziqondene nezokwakha? Mthembu: Yebo, izinhlelo zokwakha zibalulekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikole, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukufunda, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuyizinto eziyisisekelo kubantu. Umxoxi: Ngabe zikhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana nomphakathi ukuze abantu bazi ngemiphumela yalo hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, sizobe sikhuluma nomphakathi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bazi ngalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzofaka izifundo, imihlangano, nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza kanjani, futhi bazise ngempumelelo ezitholakala. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubumbano luyisihluthulelo. Ngabe ukhona umbono owodwa ofuna ukusho kubafundi? Mthembu: Yebo, ngifuna ukuveza ukuthi ukuvuselela umnotho akukhona nje umsebenzi wombuso kuphela; udinga ubambiswano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Sidinga ukufaka izandla zethu ndawonye ukuze uthole impumelelo. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan lungaba yimpumelelo uma sisenza ngokubambisana. Umxoxi: Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu, ngempela le ngxoxo ibe yinsiza enkulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nathi! Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho, kugqugquzela imisebenzi, futhi kukhethiwe ukuthi kubhekwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi uhlelo lube yimpumelelo, futhi umphakathi uzothola izinzuzo ezinkulu.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika Ngenkathi uNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, iphrojekthi ye-digital migration ibonakala ibambezeleka, okudala ukukhathazeka kubantu abaningi. Le phrojekthi, ehlose ukuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ibingumgomo obalulekile kuhulumeni, kodwa izinkinga ezahlukene zivele zaphazamisa inqubekela phambili. Ukudlula ku-analogue kuya ku-digital kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezintsha nezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokubuka eziphezulu nezokuxhumana. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinsiza ezindala, kanye nezinguquko eziphuthumayo emthethweni, zibe nomthelela omubi ekwenzeni lokhu kube yimpumelelo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana luhamba phambili, kodwa ukuhluleka kokuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo kwezinsiza kudale ukuthi izigidi zabantu zihlale zingatholi ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kubangele ukunganeliseki kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho izinsiza zokuxhumana zihlala zikhawulelwe. Uhlelo lwe-digital migration luhloselwe ukuqeda ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezindala, okuyinto ethinta kakhulu izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuhluleka kuholele ekubambezelekeni kokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola ulwazi olufanele nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokwezibalo, cishe u-80% wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika basathola izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezindala, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zidinga ukusheshiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlelo lwe-digital migration lwenziwa ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, kodwa izithiyo ezikhona zibonisa ukuthi kudinga ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana lukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana ukuze kube nokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile kuhulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisiwe. Umlando we-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika ubuhlungu, njengoba izinhlelo zokuqala zabeziqale eminyakeni edlule, kodwa ziye zabambezeleka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi iyaphumelela. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nabahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze kwandiswe ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzodinga izinhlelo ezicacile, ezisebenzayo, nezisebenziseka kalula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Iziphakamiso ezithile zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze baqonde kahle izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithuthukisiwe, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-digital migration iyaphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhona ezindaweni zonke, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa kuzoba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ekugcineni, ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinselele ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Nokho, ngokubambisana, kungaba nokwenzeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi kube nokuhamba phambili emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nabantu abathintekayo kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi ye-digital migration.
Inqubekela Phambili Yokuqedwa Kwezindlu Zangasese Zemigodi Ezikoleni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukungatholakali kwezindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ezikoleni kube yinkinga enkulu eSouth Africa, ethinta impilo yabafundi nempilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kukhona abantu abaninzi abake baba nesandla ekuxazululeni le nkinga, kodwa uMnu. Thabo Mthembu ungumuntu ophawulekayo kakhulu kulolu hlelo. UThabo, oneminyaka engama-35 ubudala, ungumfundisi ophumelele eMphumalanga, futhi ungumholi ophakathi kokusebenza ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. UThabo wakhulela endaweni enobunzima obukhulu, lapho amaholo aphansi nabantu abangenamathuba amaningi bephila khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zendawo zazihlala zinezinkinga ezinkulu, ikakhulukazimayelana nezindlu zangasese. Njengomfundi, uThabo wayebona ubuhlungu obuphuma kulokhu, futhi lapho efika esikhathini sokuba umfundisi, waqala ukucabanga ngezinqumo ezizokwenziwa. Ngemva kokuqala ukusebenza, uThabo wahlangana noMphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izikole, inhlangano enobuchwepheshe, enezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Lezi zindlu zazingekho kuphela, kodwa zaziphinde zihlale zihlanzekile, zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokuphila kahle. UThabo waba yilungu eliyisisekelo kulolu hlelo, ebamba izithangami, efundisa abanye, futhi edala ukuxhumana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nabafundi. Ngendlela yokuhlela, uThabo wenza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi izindlu zangasese ezinhle zingasiza ekukhuleni kwabafundi. Waqala imikhankaso yokuhamba, nokwenza imicimbi yokuhlanza, evusa umdlandla emiphakathini. Ubuye wahlela izinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezindlini zabo bonke abesifazane, ekhuthaza abesifazane ukuba babe nomthelela ekwakheni izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Ngemva kokusebenza kanzima, impumelelo yokuqala yatholakala. Izikole eziningi zathola izindlu zangasese ezisha, futhi abafundi baqala ukubonisa izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi impilo yabo iyathuthuka. UThabo, onobuhlakani bokuhola, waqhubeka nokwandisa imizamo yakhe, esebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukwandisa lezi zinhlelo. Ubuye waxhumana namabhizinisi endawo, edla amakhono namathuba okuthola uxhaso ukuze kunwetshwe umkhankaso. Ngemuva kokusebenza ngokubambisana, abakhokhi bezinsizakalo baphendula kahle, baziqhenya ngokuphilisa izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube neziqu ezinhle, njengoba imiphakathi yaziqhenya ngempumelelo yazo. UThabo akagcini lapho; ufunwa ukuba umeluleki kwezokwakha, ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe ezidingekayo ekwakheni izindlu zangasese. Uthole imivuzo eminingi yokwazisa, okwandisa umuzwa wakhe wokuthi ungumholi oqinile. Ubuye washintsha izinhlelo ukuze abanye abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngezindlu zangasese, beqonda izindleko ezibandakanyekayo nezidingo. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi eziphakame, uThabo uqhubeka nokusebenza ekugcineni umphumela omuhle. Uthi, "Kufanele sibe nendaba yokugcina abantu bethu bephila kahle, futhi lokho kuqala ezindlini zangasese." Le misho ikhuluma ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe, okuhamba phambili ekutholeni izixazululo ezihlala zikhona. Ukubuka phambili, uThabo ufisa ukuvuselela izinhlelo zakhe, adale imikhankaso emisha ukuze abanye abaholi bahlale bephumelele. Ubonisa ukuthi akekho owaziyo konke, kodwa abantu kufanele bahlanganyele ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uThabo uyakholwa ukuthi imizamo yokwakha izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ingazisa kakhulu uma wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo Mthembu ungumholi obalulekile, owakha izimpilo zabafundi, abavuselela umphakathi, futhi abathuthukisa izikole. Njengomuntu ongenamkhawulo, uhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini, enza umehluko ongakhethi phakathi kwabantu. UThabo ungumfuziselo wokuthi uma sithanda, singakha izinguquko ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu.
Ukulalelwa Komphakathi Mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Enye yezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe, futhi ezibhekwa njengendlela yokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, nguMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI). Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho kuwukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubo bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi noma baphila kanjani. Nokho, le msebenzi ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukulalelwa komphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke uhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunikeza abantu ithuba lokuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba iningi labantu eNingizimu Afrika lingakwazi ukukhokhela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezizimele, okuholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale zisebenzisa izinsiza eziphansi noma ezingekho emthethweni. Ngakho, uNHI uzoba yindlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, engabizi kakhulu, futhi ethokozisayo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka mayelana nezinsiza ezikhona. Abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke uzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, izisebenzi zezempilo, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ube yimpumelelo. Lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika zikhona yini ukuze zikwazi ukusekela le msebenzi. Uma izinsiza zingekho, uNHI ungase ungabi nempumelelo, futhi abantu bangase bahlupheke kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ukungabaza ngempumelelo yokuphatha uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi uhulumeni ungenza kahle ekuphatheni izinhlelo zezempilo, kodwa baphikisa ukuthi uNHI uzodinga ukuphathwa okuhle ukuze ube yimpumelelo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekubhekeni nasekuphatheni uNHI. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwethembeka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke ungaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezisemthethweni, bazoba nethuba elikhulu lokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa umnotho, ngoba abantu abanempilo bayakwazi ukusebenza kahle, futhi bangakha izimpilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni komnotho, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umphakathi ube nengxoxo evulekile mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uNHI ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uNHI ube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokulalelwa mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uNHI ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ekuphetheni, uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke ungaba yithuba elikhulu lokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ukuze ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kubalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxoxa ngale msebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uNHI ube yimpumelelo, futhi uhlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery, ethokozisa izakhamuzi zokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, iyinhloko-mbumbulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza uwoyela nezinsiza zamafutha. Ukuqala kwayo kwaba maphakathi nekhulu lama-21, lapho uhulumeni wezwe ubona udinga ukunciphisa ukuncika kwamafutha avela kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwalesi sikhungo esikhulu sokucubungula uwoyela, esikholwa ukuthi sizokwandisa umnotho wendawo, sidale amathuba emisebenzi, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Umlando wephrojekthi uqala ngonyaka we-2012, lapho kwaqala khona ucwaningo lokuhlola izindawo ezihambisana nezidingo zokwakha i-refinery. Kuhlolwe izindawo ezahlukene, kodwa ekugcineni, kwakhiwa isinqumo sokwakha i-refinery eMthomboni, eduze kweMiddelburg, eMpumalanga. Le ndawo yakhethwa ngenxa yokuba seduzane nemithombo yamanzi kanye nezinsiza zokuhambisa izimpahla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kokuthunyelwa nokuthathwa kwezimpahla. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kokuhlola, iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery yathola ukwesekwa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, kanye nabahlali bendawo. Lokhu kwaba nemiphumela emihle, lapho izinkampani zakuwo zazinikezela ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, zathumela abaqeqeshi nabasizi abanezinga eliphezulu, futhi zakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kubambisana kwaziwa njengomgomo omkhulu wephrojekthi, njengoba kuveza ukuthi izinkampani ezizimele nazo zingaba neqhaza elihle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ngonyaka we-2015, kwaba nezithiyo ezithile ezazithinta iphrojekthi, njengokungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabaphathi bezokwakha, imithetho yokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinkinga zezezimali. Nakuba lezi zinkinga zaba yinkinga, umphakathi waba nethemba lokuthi le phrojekthi izogcina isiqhuba njengoba izakhamuzi zazi ukuthi izoba nesandla ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yokwakha, iMthombo Oil Refinery yavulwa ngempumelelo ngo-2017. Lokhu kwaba umcimbi omkhulu, okwenziwa ngempumelelo edolobheni, lapho abaholi bendawo, osomabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi babonisa ukusekela kwabo. Umphakathi wawujabule kakhulu, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zathola amathuba emisebenzi, futhi abanenhlonipho kule ndawo baphendukela emsebenzini. I-refinery yathola ukwenziwa kwezimoto, ukukhiqizwa kwezinsiza zamafutha, kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. I-refinery, ethokozisa izidingo zendawo, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile, ezinjengamafutha, uwoyela, nezinye izinto eziningi ezidingekayo ezimbonini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemikhiqizo engaphezulu, okuthi, phakathi kwamanye, kube nezinhlangano ezithengisa imikhiqizo ehlukene kulabhathi zomhlaba. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, njengoba uhulumeni wathola izinsiza ezisemqoka zokuqinisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMthombo Oil Refinery ibonakale ifisa ukusiza umphakathi ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Ngemuva kokuvulwa kwayo, yaqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezithile ezibalulekile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zakhuthaza ukuphila kahle nokwakha umphakathi ozimele, ophethe imibono emihle ngempilo. Ngonyaka we-2020, i-refinery yathola izindondo eziningi zokuhlonishwa ngokusebenza kwayo kahle, ukunakekela imvelo, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwavusa umoya omuhle phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaninimabhizinisi nabahlali bebonisa ukwazisa ngokuhlonishwa kwezinsiza eziphathelene nemiphakathi. Umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ukwesekwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, futhi uqhubeka nokusebenza ngempumelelo. Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery ufakazela ukuthi ingxenye yokwakha imikhiqizo yezokwakha ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Iphrojekthi ibonisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu, lapho izinsiza zikhuluma ngokwakhiwa komphakathi ozimele. Njengoba i-refinery iqhubeka nokukhula, izikhumbuzo zayo zikhumbuza abantu ngokubaluleka kokubambisana, ukwakha amaphrojekthi afanele, nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Njengoba sibhala le ndaba, sizimisele ukuqhubeka sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza iMthombo Oil Refinery ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi liqhubeke nokukhula, futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi nemikhiqizo emisha, okuhlangene nokwakha umphakathi ohlala phansi. Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery, ngezinselelo zayo, izinkinga ezitholwe, kanye neziphumo zayo, ibonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana, ukusekela le phrojekthi, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza iMthombo Oil Refinery ibe yimpumelelo eqhubekayo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, sinesiqiniseko sokuthi le phrojekthi izoba yisibonelo sokuthi ngempela, uma abantu bephumelelayo, bangakha umhlaba ophilayo, ogcwele amathuba nempumelelo.
Ukulalelwa komphakathi mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Umbuzo 1: Yini iNHI? Impendulo: I-National Health Insurance (NHI) iyohlelo oluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kokubheka isimo sabo sezimali. I-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile iNHI? Impendulo: I-NHI ibalulekile ngoba izohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Izinhloso zayo zihlanganisa ukunciphisa ukungalingani kwezempilo, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphakeme, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 3: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza kanjani? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza zezempilo ezikhona, kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni. Abantu bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, izibhedlela, nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhokha. Umbuzo 4: Uphi umphumela we-NHI kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene? Impendulo: I-NHI izoba nomthelela omuhle kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude nezinhlaka zezempilo bazokwazi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, okuzoholela ekwandeni kokuphila kahle. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezizotholakala nge-NHI? Impendulo: I-NHI izoletha izinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi: - Ukufinyelela okungcono kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. - Ukunciphisa izindleko zezempilo kumphakathi. - Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okudingekayo. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe i-NHI izophazamisa izinhlelo ezikhona? Impendulo: I-NHI ayihlosile ukuphazamisa izinhlelo ezikhona, kodwa izosebenzisana nazo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo. Izinhlelo ezikhona zizodlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni uhlelo lwe-NHI. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngifuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-NHI? Impendulo: Uma ufuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-NHI, ungavakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezempilo, noma ujoyine imihlangano yokulalelwa komphakathi lapho ungabeka khona imibuzo nemibono yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe i-NHI izoba nezinselelo? Impendulo: Njengazo zonke izinhlelo ezinkulu, i-NHI izobhekana nezinselelo ezithile, njengokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo bayatholakala, nokwakha ukwethembeka komphakathi. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni uzosebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinselelo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-NHI iyaphumelela? Impendulo: Ukuze i-NHI iphumelele, uhulumeni uzothatha izinyathelo eziningana, ezifaka phakathi: - Ukuhlela kahle izinsiza. - Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo. - Ukuxhumana ngempumelelo nomphakathi. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 10: Ngabe i-NHI izokwandisa izindleko zezempilo? Impendulo: I-NHI ihloselwe ukunciphisa izindleko zezempilo kumphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula, izindleko zokwelashwa eziphakeme zingancishiswa, okuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi. Umbuzo 11: Ngabe i-NHI izobandakanya izikhungo ezizimele? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI izobandakanya izikhungo ezizimele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokukhetha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, okuzoba yinzuzo kumphakathi. Umbuzo 12: Uphi umphumela we-NHI ezimbonini ezihlobene nezempilo? Impendulo: I-NHI izoba nomthelela omkhulu ezimbonini ezihlobene nezempilo, njengoba izodinga izinsiza eziningi, abasebenzi, nezikhungo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kwamathuba emisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 13: Ngabe i-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. Izinsizakalo zizotholakala kalula, futhi abantu bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Umbuzo 14: Yini okufanele ngiyazi ngempela nge-NHI? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-NHI iyohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela, futhi izohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ukulalela imicabango nemibono yomphakathi kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni i-NHI ephumelelayo. Umbuzo 15: Ngabe i-NHI iyohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubheka isimo sabo sezimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi wonke. Ngokuhlanganyela, i-NHI iyinsiza ebalulekile ezohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo luhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi futhi luthuthukisa impilo yabantu.
Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs 1. Isingeniso EmaHhovisi akwa-Home Affairs, izinsizakalo ezinikezwa kubantu zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezidingo zomphakathi. Nokho, abavakashi bayabhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma befika emahhovisi, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela izinsiza abazidingayo. Le dokhumenti izobheka izinselelo ezivamile ezithinta abavakashi, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuphuculwe lezi zimo. 2. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 2.1 Ukuhlangana nezimo ezinzima Abavakashi bahlala behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima njengokuthi ukuhamba kungazelele, izimo zezulu, noma izigameko eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudala ukuhamba okungalingani, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phezulu emigodini yokubhalisela izinsizakalo. 2.2 Izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhubazekile Izinhlelo zokuphatha emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs azilingani kahle, okwenza kube nenselelo yokuphatha izicelo. Imishini yokubhalisela, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zedijithali zihlala ziphuthumayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni abavakashi balinde isikhathi eside. 2.3 Umthwalo Wokufaka Imibhalo Abavakashi badinga ukufaka imibhalo eminingi ukuze bathole izinsizakalo ezifanele. Lokhu kubandakanya amakhophi wezimvume, izincwadi zokuhlala, nezincwadi zokuhamba. Ukuhamba kahle kwezinqubo zokufaka le mibhalo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bathola izinsizakalo zabo ngesikhathi. 2.4 Ukuntuleka kwezinhlaka ezihambisanayo Izinhlaka ezihambisanayo, njengeminyango yokubhalisela ezempilo, iminyango yezemfundo, nezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi, zihlala zingahambisani kahle. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwezinhlaka, okwenza kube nzima kubavakashi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo abadinga ngempumelelo. 3. Izimbangela Zalezi Zinselelo 3.1 Ukuntuleka Kwamathuba Anezinga Eliphezulu Ukuntuleka kwamathuba okulungiselela abavakashi, kubangela ukuthi abavakashi bahlupheke ekutholeni izinsizakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuntuleka kwezingcweti ezikwazi ukusiza abavakashi ngenqubo yokufaka izicelo. 3.2 Ukungabi Nazo Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Izinsiza zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinsizakalo eziku-inthanethi, azitholakali kalula, okwenza kube nzima kubavakashi ukuthola ulwazi olunembile. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungahambi kahle kwezinqubo. 3.3 Ukungaboni Njengokubalulekile Imiphakathi eminingi ayiqondi kahle ukubaluleka kokubhaliswa nezinsizakalo zamahhovisi. Lokhu kuholela ekuthi abavakashi bangase benze iziphakamiso eziphuthumayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba kahle kwezinsizakalo. 4. Izinyathelo Zokuphucula 4.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bathola izinsiza zabo ngokushesha, izinhlelo zokuphatha kumele zithuthukiswe. Lokhu kubandakanya ukukhiqiza izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle, ezinekhono lokuphatha ngempumelelo. 4.2 Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Izisebenzi ezikhona emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs kumele ziqeqeshwe ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abavakashi ngempumelelo. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele kuzothuthukisa ikhono lezinhlaka zokuphatha izicelo. 4.3 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokuxhumana Izinsiza zokuxhumana zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwabavakashi nezinsiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezingosi zokuxhumana ezikhona ku-inthanethi, ezikuvumela abavakashi ukuthi bathole ulwazi olulula nolunembile. 4.4 Ukubambisana Nezinhlaka Eziphakeme Ukuze kwandiswe ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kube nokubambisana phakathi kweminyango ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubavakashi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, kunciphise nokuphazamiseka. 5. Isiphetho Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs zidinga ukuqashelwa nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Ukuthola izinsiza ezisebenzayo, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle, nokuqeqesha izisebenzi zibalulekile ekuphuculeni izimo zabavakashi. Ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sihlanganyele ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo ezitholakala emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs, ukuze abavakashi bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza abazidingayo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo namuhla zingaba nomthelela omkhulu kokuthuthukiswa kokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu athathe isinyathelo sokwenza ngcono lezi zimo.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi njengoba izinkinga zokudla, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila zikhula. Izingadi zokudla, ezaziwa nangokuthi "izingadi zokudla ezisemadolobheni," zikhula ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala, zifaka phakathi izindawo ezincane, izikhala zomphakathi, kanye nezindawo ezithile ezikhethekile. Lezi zingadi zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okusha, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, kanye nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukubaluleka kwezingadi zokudla Izingadi zokudla zinezinzuzo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle, kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokudla okusha, lezi zingadi zinciphisa ukuncika ekuthengeni ukudla okuvela ezitolo, okungabiza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudla okukhuliswa ezindaweni zokudla kudla izinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi.
