Ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo kubalulekile, njengoba izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, njengoba abantu bejabulela ukudla okukhuliswa ngokwemvelo. Izifundo ezivela emadolobheni ahlukene Ukwanda kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa futhi kusezingeni eliphezulu emazweni ahlukene. E-United States, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhula kakhulu ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ekudleni okuphila kahle, okukhuliswa ezindaweni zabo. E-United Kingdom, izinhlelo zokwakha izingadi zokudla zikhuthazwa nguhulumeni, njengoba kuhloswe ukuvuselela izindawo ezithile eziphila kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izikhala zomphakathi ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zinciphisa izinkinga zokudla. E-Afrika, ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Izinhlelo ezihlukene zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izingadi zokudla, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkinga zokudla zikhula kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izithiyo ezibhekene nokukhula kwezingadi zokudla Noma kunjalo, ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla akukhululekile ezitheni ezithile. Izithiyo eziningi zikhona, okuhlanganisa uk缺乏 indawo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Ezinye izindawo zinezinkinga zokufinyelela emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona zokwakha izingadi zokudla zihlala zincipha, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba bakhe izingadi zabo. Ukwenza kube lula ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenzisane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokwakha izingadi zokudla, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nokwakha izingadi zokudla zibalulekile, njengoba lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle. Noma kunjalo, izithiyo ezithile zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bangenza izingadi zokudla. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabantu emadolobheni. Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izikhala ezinhle, kodwa futhi kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuthuthukisa impilo yabantu.
Izinguquko Zenqubomgomo Yemfundo Yezingane Ezisencane 1. Isingeniso Izinguquko zenqubomgomo yemfundo yezingane ezisencane zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola imfundo efanele, esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ethuthukisa amathuba azo empilweni. Le doko ibonisa izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi, izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisayo. 2. Umgomo Wethu Umgomo wethu uwukwakha uhlelo lwezemfundo oluqinile nolubhekene nezidingo zezingane ezisencane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zengane. - Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwemfundo kubo bonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. - Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nomphakathi. 3. Izinguquko Ezidingekayo 3.1. Ukuvuselelwa Kwezinhlelo Zokufundisa Izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa: - Ukufundisa ngemicabango evulekile, ukwakha amakhono okucabanga. - Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ezifundweni. - Ukugxila ekufundeni okusebenzisanayo, okukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwezingane. 3.2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kothisha Uthisha uyisihluthulelo empumelelweni yemfundo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othisha banamakhono adingekayo, kudingeka: - Ukuhlinzekwa kwezifundo ezithuthukayo. - Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwezobuchwepheshe bokufundisa. - Ukugqugquzela ubuholi phakathi kothisha ukuze baphumelele. 3.3. Ukufinyelela Kwezemfundo Ukuze kube nokufinyelela kwemfundo kubo bonke, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zidingeka: - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zemfundo ezikude. - Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zemfundo ezidingekayo, njengezincwadi nezinsiza zokufunda. - Ukusebenzisana nohulumeni bendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane ezisencane zithola imfundo. 4. Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ukubandakanywa kwabazali empilweni yemfundo yengane kubalulekile. Izinyathelo eziphakanyisiwe zifaka: - Ukuhlela imihlangano evulekile phakathi kwabazali nothisha. - Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe yingxenye yokufunda kwengane yabo. - Ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabazali. 5. Ukubheka Nokuhlola Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinguquko zenqubomgomo zisebenza, kubalulekile: - Ukuhlela izivivinyo ezivamile zokuhlola impumelelo yezinhlelo. - Ukuqoqa impendulo evela kubazali, othisha, kanye nezingane. - Ukuhlola futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemiphumela etholelwe. 6. Isiphetho Izinguquko zenqubomgomo yemfundo yezingane ezisencane zidinga ukubhekwa njengomsebenzi oqhubekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kubandakanya uhulumeni, othisha, abazali, kanye nomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuze sifinyelele imigomo yethu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yezingane ezisencane kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. 7. Izinyathelo Ezilandelayo - Ukuphakanyiswa kokwakhiwa kweqembu elihlanganisa bonke abathintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle. - Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokusebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinguquko zenqubomgomo zisebenza. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ngalezi zinguquko. Ngalezi zinguquko, sizobe sihlose ukwakha uhlelo lwezemfundo oluqinile noluhambisana nezidingo zezingane ezisencane, ukuze zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza UThandiwe wayengumfazi ophumelelayo, oneminyaka engama-35, owayebhekene nezinselelo ezinzima zokwelashwa komdlavuza. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuthi unomdlavuza wesifuba, wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe izoshintsha phakade. Waqala ukwelashwa, wathola imishanguzo, futhi waba neziguli eziningi ezazimkhuthaza. Kodwa, ngemuva kokuphumelela ekwelashweni, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwakhe akusabukeki njengokwakunjalo. Ngemuva kokuphuma esibhedlela, wayezizwa engathokozile. Uhlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi, ezazihlanganisa ukungabi namandla, ukucindezeleka, nokungabi nokuqonda kahle ukuthi uzophila kanjani empilweni yakhe entsha. UThandiwe wayefuna ukubuyela empilweni yakhe, kodwa wayezwa sengathi umhlaba wakhe ubhujiswe. Ngesinye isikhathi, uThandiwe wahlangana noNandi, umngani wakhe omdala, owawazi kahle umgwaqo odabukisayo owawuhamba. UNandi wayenobuchwepheshe bokuphila, futhi wayezama ukusiza uThandiwe ukuthi abheke phambili. "Thandiwe," kusho uNandi, "ukwelashwa komdlavuza akupheli lapho uphume esibhedlela. Kukhona okunye okufanele sikubheke." UNandi wakhuluma ngempilo yokuphila, wathi: "Kumele sithole indlela yokuphila kahle, sithole izindlela zokuphila ezizokwenza sibe namandla." UThandiwe wathola ukuthi uNandi wayenokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu, futhi wathola umdlandla wokuphila. Ngemuva kokuhamba noNandi, uThandiwe waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi ezikhuluma ngempilo, wathola izifundo zokupheka eziphilayo, futhi waqala ukuhamba. Waqala ukuxhumana nabanye abahlala nezinkinga ezifanayo, futhi wathola umphakathi ophilayo. Ngesikhathi esithile, uThandiwe waqala ukuzizwa engcono. Waqala ukubona izinguquko emzimbeni wakhe, futhi wathola amandla okwenza izinto ezazimjabulisa. Waqala ukugijima, wathola umoya omusha, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza kwakungaphezu kokuphuma esibhedlela. Kwakuwukuhlola impilo, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. Waqala ukubhala, wabhala izincwadi ezazichaza indlela abebhekene ngayo nezinkinga, futhi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu babefuna ukwazi. Ngemuva kokuhamba le ndlela, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, futhi waba umholi emphakathini wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza abanye abahlala nezinkinga ezifanayo, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuphila. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukuphuma esibhedlela, kodwa kuyindlela yokubhekana nezinkinga, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola injabulo. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye. Waqala ukufundisa abantu abasha, wabelana ngempilo yakhe, futhi waba umholi emiphakathini. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwakhe akusabukeki njengokwakunjalo, kodwa kube yindlela yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Waba nesifiso sokuphila, futhi wathola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Waba nesifiso sokuphila, futhi wathola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuphila, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono.
Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo Isingeniso Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano, nolwazi. Umthethosisekelo, njengesisekelo somthetho, udinga ukuhunyushwa nokubuyekezwa ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuchibiyelweni kwalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izindlela ezivumela abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza, baphendule, futhi baveze imibono yabo. Ukubaluleka kokubamba iqhaza komphakathi Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo kudala ithuba lokuthi izwi labantu lizwe. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umthethosisekelo kufanele ubonise izifiso, izidingo, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, lokhu kudala umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu banomthelela ezinqubweni ezithinta impilo yabo, okwandisa ukuzibophezela kwabo ekuphathweni komphakathi. Izindlela zokubamba iqhaza Kunezindlela eziningi zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. Lezi zindlela zingahlanganisa: 1. Izinkulumo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela izinkulumo ezivulekile, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano, izinkulumo, noma izinkundla zokuxhumana. Izinkulumo zomphakathi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule futhi babelane ngemicabango yabo. 2. Uphenyo: Ukuqhuba uphenyo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqoqa imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ukuze kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okungcono ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. 3. Izinhlelo zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nezici zomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo ezithinta umthethosisekelo, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo ngendlela efanele. 4. Ukubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi: Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi, ezifana nezikole, izinkampani, nezinhlangano ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezinqubweni zokubamba iqhaza. Izithiyo zokubamba iqhaza Noma kunjalo, kunezithiyo eziningi ezivimbela ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. Lezi zithiyo zingahlanganisa: 1. Ukungabi nolwazi: Abantu abaningi bangase bangabi nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezinqubo zomthethosisekelo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba babambe iqhaza. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo. 2. Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza: Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima bangase bangabi nezinsiza ezanele zokubamba iqhaza, njengokufinyelela ezinkulumweni noma ezinhlelweni zokubambisana. 3. Ukungaboni kahle kwezinhlelo: Uma izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza zingacacile, abantu bangase bangabi nentshisekelo yokubamba iqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinqubo zibe sobala futhi ziqondakale. 4. Ukungabikhona kokuxhumana: Ukuxhumana okunganele phakathi kwezikhungo eziphethe umthetho nomphakathi kungavimbela abantu ekubambeni iqhaza. Ukuze lokhu kuxazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Isiphetho Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthethosisekelo ubonisa izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezindlela ezivumela abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza, baphendule, futhi baveze imibono yabo. Noma kunjalo, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, futhi kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokubamba iqhaza. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe inqubo yokubamba iqhaza ethuthukile, eqinile, futhi efinyeleleka kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umthethosisekelo onobulungiswa, obumbene, nolwazi, okuzokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Imijondolo: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Imijondolo iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingaphansi komnotho. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zenzelwe ukukhulisa izinga lempilo yabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjalo. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo azilokothi zibe nezinzuzo kuphela; zinezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni ubonisa ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngokwakha imijondolo emisha, abantu banethuba lokuphila endaweni enempilo, enezinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana namanzi ahlanzekile, ugesi, nezikole. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni omsebenzi, okwakha umnotho ozinzile. Ngakho, lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zithola ukugxekwa ngenxa yokungahambisani nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhona kuphela ukuze kuhlanzwe izindawo ezidumile, kodwa azinaki izidingo zangempela zabantu abahlala kule mijondolo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokukhathazeka ngokuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingasatshiswa kahle yini, noma zisebenze ngokuphumelelayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuxhaswa ngemali eyanele. Ukuntuleka kwemali kungaholela ekutheni izinhlelo zihluleke, okukhombisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwezomnotho kubalulekile. Uma uhulumeni engakabi nezinsiza ezanele, lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlinzekwa okungafanele, okungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinzuzo ezincane. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezenzo ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabaxhasi bezimali. Okwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukufaka izwi labantu abahlala kulezi zindawo. Abantu bahlala ngaphakathi kwemijondolo, futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubandakanya abantu emaphaketheni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kwandise umuzwa wokuba nempilo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazobe bejabulile futhi bephendula kahle ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona nemiphumela emibi yokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo. Abanye abantu bakholwa ukuthi imijondolo emisha ingaholela ekutheni kube nokwandiswa kwezindawo ezithile, okukhathaza abanye. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphazamiseka kwemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokwandisa izindawo ezingaphansi komphakathi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle lezi zinhlelo ukuze zingalimazi imvelo. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zinezinto eziningi ezinhle, kodwa zidinga ukunakwa okuningi. Ukubandakanya abantu, ukuxhaswa ngemali, kanye nokuhlonza izidingo zangempela zabantu, kuzokwenza lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngakho, uma uhulumeni efuna ukuthuthukisa imijondolo, kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono, hhayi ukubangela ezinye izinkinga. Umphakathi unelungelo lokuphila endaweni engcono, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zibe yinsika yokufeza lokhu. Izenzo ezinhle, ukuhlela okuhle, nokubambisana kuzoholela empumelelweni ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo.
Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) bahlala phambili ekwakheni umqondo, ubuciko, nemikhiqizo edidiyelwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lezi zinkundla ziguqule indlela abantu ababelana ngayo ngolwazi, izimvo, nezinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuveza amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kubeka nezinselelo ezinkulu. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlola indima yabadali bokuqukethwe, izinzuzo nemiphumela yokusebenza kwabo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo. 1. Indima Yabadali Bokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe bangabantu abakhuluma ngezinto ezithile, bephakamisa izimvo, noma bekwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Bahlala bephendula izidingo zomphakathi, beqonda izifiso zabalandeli babo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuxhumana, bejolise ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo nabalandeli. 2. Izinzuzo Zabadali Bokuqukethwe Izinzuzo zokuba abadali bokuqukethwe ziningi. Okokuqala, bakwazi ukufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imakethe. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bakwazi ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yabo, noma ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Okwesibili, abadali bokuqukethwe banethuba lokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe babo, befundisa abanye, futhi bephakamisa izinga lokwakha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. 3. Izinselelo Zabadali Bokuqukethwe Nokho, ukuhweba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana akukhululekile. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala beface izinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuncintisana okukhulu, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kanye nezinkinga zokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kuholela ekutheni kudingeke ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlale bephakanyiswa, bephendula izidingo ezishintshashintshayo zabalandeli. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, amandla, kanye nezinsiza eziningi. 4. Ukuvikelwa Kwamalungelo Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ukuze abadali bokuqukethwe bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezivumela abadali bokuqukethwe ukuba baphumelele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yabo ivikelwe. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuvikela amalungelo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. 5. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Imisebenzi Yabadali Bokuqukethwe Ukuze abadali bokuqukethwe bakwazi ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo, kudingeka ukuthi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli, futhi bahlale bephakanyiswa. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokufunda izifundo ezihlobene, ukuhamba emihlanganweni, nokuxhumana nabanye abadali. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni amathuba amasha, futhi kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. 6. Isiphetho Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuguquka kwezinkundla zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ngenxa yokukhula kwalezi zinkundla, abadali bokuqukethwe banethuba lokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, kodwa baphinde bahlale beface izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephakamisa izinga lokwakha, futhi bejabulisa izithameli zabo. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Ukuze sithuthukise imisebenzi yabadali bokuqukethwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezifundo, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakanyiswa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadali bokuqukethwe bazoba nethuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu, futhi kuholele ekutheni bakwazi ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yabo, noma ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Isiphetho Sokugcina Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuguquka kwezinkundla zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephakamisa izinga lokwakha, futhi bejabulisa izithameli zabo.
Izibuyekezo ze-Integrated Resource Plan kanye nemiphumela yazo Isingeniso Uhlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) luyisisekelo esibalulekile sokuphatha izinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlela, ukuphatha, nokuphucula izinsiza zamandla ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi, kuncishiswe umthelela emvelweni, futhi kuthuthukiswe umnotho. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zenzeka njalo ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo ezishintshashintshayo nezinguquko ezidingekayo. Izizathu zokubuyekeza i-IRP Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidingeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinguquko kwezobuchwepheshe, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Isibonelo, ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengamandla elanga namandla omoya, kudinga ukuba i-IRP ibuyekezwe ukuze ibheke lezi zinguquko. Izinqubomgomo ezihlose ukunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngohlelo oluhambisana nalezi zifiso. Ukuze i-IRP ibe yimpumelelo, kufanele ibhekelele izinguquko ezimnandi zomnotho, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izibuyekezo ezinkulu ze-IRP Ezinyangeni ezedlule, izibuyekezo ezinkulu ze-IRP zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, ukunciphisa ukuthembela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, nokwandisa amandla okugcina. Ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokwakha, kuveze izidingo ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kuholela ekubuyekezweni kwemigomo ye-IRP ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengamandla elanga namandla omoya, kunikeza izinzuzo ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni i-IRP. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza amandla avuselelekayo, okunciphisa ukuthembela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, futhi kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abahlinzeki bamandla avuselelekayo. Ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni Ukukhathazeka ngokuphila komphakathi kanye nomthelela emvelweni kuholele ekubuyekezweni kwemigomo ye-IRP ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon. Lokhu kubandakanya ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha angavuselelekayo, okukhuthaza ukwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni. Izimo zomnotho Izimo zomnotho eNingizimu Afrika zidinga ukuba i-IRP ibuyekezwe njalo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta umnotho. Lokhu kubandakanya izinguquko ezithinta izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, izinga lokukhula komnotho, nezimo zezokuthutha. Imithelela yezibuyekezo ze-IRP Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zinezinto eziningi ezithinta umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nemvelo. Ukukhuliswa kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Isiphetho Izibuyekezo ze-Integrated Resource Plan zibalulekile ekwakheni nasekuqondiseni izinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, impilo yomphakathi, kanye nemvelo. Ukuze i-IRP ibe yimpumelelo, kufanele ibhekelele izinguquko ezidingekayo, okuhlanganisa ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ukubuyekezwa kwe-IRP kufanele kube yinqubo eqhubekayo, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamandla zihlala zikhona, zisebenza kahle, futhi zisebenza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi.
Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Isingeniso Ukwakhiwa kwezimoto zokuhamba kwezimpahla ezisebenza ngaphansi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail kudinga ukuhlaziywa okujulile kwezinsiza, izinqubo, nezimo ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Le dokhumenti ibheka izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ukugcinwa, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsiza zomsebenzi. 1. Ukuphepha Ukuphepha kusebenza njengesisekelo sokusebenza kwezitimela. Izinselelo ezinkulu zifaka phakathi: - Izingozi Zokuphepha: Kunezingozi eziningi ezihlobene nezitimela, okuhlanganisa nokuphahlazeka, ukuhamba okungafanele, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo eziqinile zokuhlola nokugcina. - Ukuphazamiseka Kwezimoto: Ukuhluleka kokusebenza kwezitimela kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni okukhulu. Ukubhekelela izinhlelo zokugcina ezisebenzayo nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zingozi. 2. Ukugcinwa Kwezinsiza Ukugcinwa kwezinsiza zokuhamba kwezimpahla kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele zokugcinwa, njengemishini yokulungisa, kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zihlala zisebenza kahle. - Ukwanda Kwezindleko: Izindleko zokugcinwa ziya zanda, lokhu kungenxa yokukhula kwezindleko zokusebenza, izinsiza, nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zindleko, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle izinsiza nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 3. Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengezinga elibalulekile lokusebenza kwezitimela. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezobuchwepheshe: Ukuze kube nokusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi izitimela zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukuntuleka kwezobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Ukuphazamiseka Kwamathuluzi: Ukuphazamiseka kwamathuluzi obuchwepheshe kungathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola nokugcina ubuchwepheshe. 4. Izinsiza Zomsebenzi Izinsiza zomsebenzi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezisebenzi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinselelo zokusebenza ezanele. Ukuntuleka kwezimali ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha: Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bejwayele izinqubo ezisemqoka. Ukuqeqeshwa okunganele kungaholela emaphutheni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. 5. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlaka Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlaka kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukungabikhona Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail nezinye izinhlaka. Ukungabikhona kwezokuxhumana kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinkinga Zomthetho: Izinkinga zomthetho zingathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Isiphetho Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuqonda lezi zinselelo nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-Transnet Freight Rail ibambisane nezinye izinhlaka, ihlaziye izinqubo zayo, futhi ithuthukise izinsiza zayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle, ziphephile, futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwezimpahla, kuqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabathengi zikhuthele, futhi kuthuthukiswe umnotho wezwe.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo IMphakathi yaseLimpopo ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. USimphiwe Moyo ungumfundi wezokwelapha oyisifiso somphakathi, ogxile ekubhekeni izinselelo ezibhekene nodokotela kulezi zindawo. USimphiwe, owazalelwa edolobheni elincane laseLimpopo, ubonile izidingo ezinkulu zomphakathi emakilasi akhe. Uhlangabezane nobunzima obukhulu phakathi kokulandela izifundo zakhe, ebanjwa ngaphansi koxhaso oluncane. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi indawo yaseLimpopo iphethwe yizikhala ezinkulu zokungabi khona kodokotela. USimphiwe ukhumbula ukuthi, "Ngaphakathi kweminyaka emithathu, ngiphumelele ukuthola udokotela oyedwa kuphela, ngenkathi umphakathi ungaphezu kwamathathu amajenti, lokho kuye kwaba yinkinga enkulu." Lokhu kusebenza kokushoda kodokotela kudinga isixazululo esiphusile futhi esibanzi. Ubusuku obuhlukahlukene bobuhlungu, uSimphiwe uthanda ukufunda ngendaba yokwelapha. Uhlala ezindaweni ezithile zasemakhaya, ethola ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokwelapha ngenxa yokungabi khona kadokotela, izithuthi, noma imali yokuhamba. Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi ubunzima bakhe bungaphezu kokungabi khona kodokotela. Uthole isibopho esikhulu emiphakathini yokuthi, "Abantu bethu badinga ukusizwa, imibiko yempilo yabo iyakhathaza." Ngenxa yalokho, uSimphiwe uqala inhlangano emasha ebizwa nge-"Izinyosi Zempilo," ebanjwe ngemigomo yokuqinisa isimo sezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Le nhlangano yokuxhasa iyazama ukudala imfundiso ezinzulu nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi komphakathi nabodokotela. USimphiwe uchaza ukuthi bahlangana nabantu, bejolisa ezintweni ezisemqoka, besebenzisa izindlela ezithokozisayo zokwakha ubudlelwane. "Hhayi kuphela ukufinyelela ekwelapheni, kodwa nokuqonda izidingo zabantu," kuphawula uSimphiwe. Ngokwakha lo mnyango, uSimphiwe ubona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zokuqhakambisa ukuzinikela komphakathi. Amakhosikazi aneminyaka ethile edlulile kusenesikhathi bakwazi ukufunda izindlela zokwelapha ezisheshayo ezisemqoka phakathi kwezenzakalo zomndeni. Lokhu kukhuthaza abasha nogogo nabodwa ukuba babe nesibopho sokuphila ngokwempilo. USimphiwe ubona lokhu njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphuma ezinkingeni, abhekele kahle imiphakathi yabo. Uyasiza abanye abafundi ukuba babe neziqu zobudokotela ngosuku olwandulela. Lokhu kusebenza kuze kube sekuhamba phambili, kunendlela yokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi ngesikhathi esisodwa. USimphiwe usebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumanisa abanye odokotela abakhululekile ezindaweni zasemakhaya, okukhuthaza udlame lokwakha amakhono asezingeni. Uqaphela ubukhulu bezingozi ezidlula phambili, akakhumbuli ukufundisa abahlanganyeli indlela ehloniphekayo yokwelapha. Njengomphakathi, uSimphiwe uqhakambisa izinzuzo zokuxhumana nokubambisana ngezihloko ezithinta impilo - kokubili ukuphila komuntu nomphakathi. Uthembisa umphakathi ukuthi uzoletha izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezempilo, ngenhloso yokwakha indawo engcono. Uqhuba imihlangano ethile ukuze afake imizwa nemibono emaqondiseni abanye ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhumbuzo, uSimphiwe ucinisa umdlandla ngokubeka phambili indlela yokuba nabodokotela abaningi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ukukhula kweshishini labodokotela kuncike kumphakathi. USimphiwe uyazi ukuthi njengoba kudinga ukunciphisa amandla okubonga ukuze kube noshintsho, kuzodingeka ukuhlinzeka ngezemfundo ezinzulu kubo bobabili abahola ezempilo kanye nomphakathi ukuze babekezelele izinkinga. Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuveza ukuthi izinkinga zezempilo zihambisana nezinhlelo zokuphucula izithuthi nezinsiza. USimphiwe uhlose ukusiza futhi ahlukanise umphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingafinyelela izivuno ezinkulu ezifana nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhekana nezinkinga, uSimphiwe ubonisa ukuthi ikhono lokusiza abanye kungenza umehluko omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ekugcineni, uSimphiwe Moyo ungumfanekiso obonakalayo wokuthi abantu bangenza kanjani umehluko omkhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngezempilo. Ukufuna izixazululo eziphusile nokubambisana nabondli, usebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze akhulise lezi zimo ezibucayi. Ubuye akhuthaze ukuzibandakanya komphakathi, kucacisa ukuthi umehluko ungaholela emiphumeleni emihle engakwazi ukwenziwa. USimphiwe ungumsebenzi onamandla, enza isizathu sezenzo ezinhle, ukuze kuholele emiphumeleni engaphezu kokuphefumula kuphela.
Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole, akukhona nje okuthile okwenziwa phansi kokuphathwa kwezemfundo, kodwa kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yabafundi nempilo yomphakathi jikelele. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikole zidinga ingqalasizinda eqinile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele? Njengoba sikhuluma, sizobona ukuthi izikole ezinamakhaya ahlanzekile, izifundo ezinhle, nezinsiza ezifanele zenza umehluko omkhulu. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngakho, kodwa kubalulekile empilweni yabafundi. Kukhona izikole ezithola izinsiza ezinhle, kodwa uma ubheka izikole ezisemaphandleni, ungathola ukuthi zihlupheka. Ngabe lokho akukhathazi? Ngoba uma umntwana engakwazi ukufunda kahle ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, lokho kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ahlanzekile, izindlu zokuhlala eziphephile, nezinsiza zokufunda? Lokhu akukhona nje okuthile okufanele kucatshangelwe, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukufunda kahle. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umntwana efunda endaweni enempilo, uthola amathuba amaningi? Futhi, akukhona nje ukufunda kuphela, kodwa izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala, izindawo zokuzivocavoca, nezinsiza zokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umntwana ejabule, uthola izinga eliphezulu lokufunda? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikole ezinamakhaya ahlanzekile nezinsiza ezanele zikhulisa abafundi abaqinile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, osebenzayo. Futhi, uma umphakathi unempilo, uthola ukuthi izinga lokuphila liphumelela. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zabafundi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Uma izikole zingakwazi ukugcina izidingo zabafundi, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi, akukhona nje ukufunda, kodwa izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukuzijabulisa, nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuthi bazibandakanye emisebenzini ehlukene. Lokhu kuyasiza ekuqiniseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umphakathi ubambisene, izikole ziba neqhaza elikhulu? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi uphumelele. Futhi, uma umphakathi unokubambisana, uthola ukuthi izikole ziba nezinsiza eziningi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono? Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngakho, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukufunda kahle. Uma izikole zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala? Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Futhi, uma umntwana ejabule, uthola izinga eliphezulu lokufunda. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukuzijabulisa, nokukhuthaza abafundi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukufunda kahle. Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall UMkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uqale ngo-2015, uwumzamo wokuphikisa izinhlelo zokufunda ezibiza kakhulu ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mkhankaso, owawuhlanganisa abafundi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, wakha izwi elihlangene elalizwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngempilo yezemfundo, ikakhulukazi ngokugxila ezindlekweni zokufunda. Umgomo wombhikisho kwaba ukususa izikhwama ezibizayo zokufunda, okwakukholwa ukuthi zivikela ukufinyelela kwabafundi abavela emindenini enezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall waphumelela ekwakheni ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nemfundo, ukungalingani, kanye nezinkinga ezibalulekile ezifana nokutholakala kwemali yokufunda. Abafundi, ngezwi labo elikhulu, baphakamisa izinkinga ezinzima ezithinta izimpilo zabo, okwenza umphakathi uqonde kakhulu izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwakhiwa komkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall kubonakale ukuthi akuwona nje umphumela wesikhashana, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esiholela ekubuyekezweni kwezinhlelo zemfundo. Izinyathelo ezithathwe ngemuva komkhankaso, kufaka phakathi ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwezimali kubafundi, ukufakwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha imfundo engenamkhawulo, nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezibonelelo kubafundi abahola kancane, zikhombisa umthelela omkhulu kulesi sikhala. Umphakathi uqhubekile nokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezibangelwa ukungabi bikho kwemali, okukhuthaze uhulumeni ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu ekuphatheni nasekuxhaseni abafundi. Lokhu kuphakamisa isimo sokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Izifundo ezitholakele ezivela emkhankasweni zikhombisa ukuthi ukunikeza abafundi ithuba lokukhuluma nokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni wezokuphatha kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumphumela omuhle. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uphinde waba nomthelela ekwakheni izinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abafundi ukuba babelane ngemicabango, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Lokhu kube nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, okwakha umphakathi onokuzwana. Abafundi baqala ukuzizwa bephakathi kwesikole, besebenzisana ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvule amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yabafundi, ubonisa izinkinga ezifana nokucindezelwa, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, nokungabi neqhaza elanele ezinqubweni ezithinta imfundo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi umphakathi uqonde kangcono izinselelo ezikubangela ukungafundi kahle, okwakha isikhala sokuthi abantu baqhamuke nezixazululo ezenzakalayo nezinselelo ezithinta abafundi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphumela yalezi zinguquko ibonakalile. Ukuphakama kwezimali ezitholakalayo kubafundi, ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokuxhasa abafundi, kanye nokwandiswa kwezinhlelo zokufunda, kuveza izinguquko ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Lokhu sekufake pfungwa ethile emiphakathini ethile, okuvusa umqondo wobumbano nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu kwi-political landscape yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ubuye wagqugquzela izishoshovu eziningi ukuba zibe nemibono ehlukahlukene, zikhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta abafundi, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungumfanekiso ogqamile wokuthi umphakathi ungashintsha kanjani izinqumo zepolitiki nezemfundo ngokubambisana. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphikisa, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall usengxoxweni enkulu futhi ubonisa amandla abantu abasha, okwenza kube lula ukubona umthelela ohlala isikhathi eside. Abafundi baqhubeka nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuqwashisa abantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezingokwemvelo ezithinta ukufunda, ukungabi neqhaza, nezinto ezenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zemfundo. Ngaleyo ndlela, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuzange ube yisikhathi esidlule, kodwa ube yinsika yokwakha ingxoxo eqhubekayo mayelana nemfundo, ukulingana, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abafundi. Umthelela womkhankaso usaqhubeka nokuzwakala, ukwakha umphakathi onobumbano nolwazi, futhi uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kubafundi baseNingizimu Afrika. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi uma abantu behlangana, benza imizamo yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, bangakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Imiphumela yalo mkhankaso ibonisa ukuthi ukufunda akuwona umgomo kuphela, kodwa kuyinselelo yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onobumbano, nolwazi, okukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphokophele empumelelweni. Ngakho-ke, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyinsika ebalulekile kulandela umgwaqo oya phambili emfundweni nasezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Ngomhla ka-21 kuNtulikazi 2023, umphakathi ubhekene nesinqumo esikhulu esithathwe yinkantolo ephakeme mayelana nesigwebo sikaOscar Pistorius, umjaho ophumelelayo we-Olympic noMvikeli Womhlaba. Lesi sinqumo sithinte abantu abaningi, sihlangabezana nemibono eyahlukene ezindabeni, ikakhulukazi eziphathelene nezokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, ubulungiswa, kanye nezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Pistorius, owaziwa kakhulu njengomjaho omncane onezinkanyezi, wathola udaba lwakhe lwezomthetho lwezizathu ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2013, washaywa yicala lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, umkakhe, ngokungafanele. Le m事件 yaphazamisa kakhulu umphakathi, yakhuluma ngempilo kaPistorius, okwamanje ibonakala iyinselele enkulu kumphakathi ophakathi kokuhlukumeza. Inkatho yeNkantolo Ephezulu yathatha isikhathi eside ukuhlaziya izinkomba zobufakazi, izinsolo, nemiphumela yokuhlala kwePistorius ejele. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinto zaphenduka zaba zinkulu, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokuhlola uPistorius, izinhlelo zokubuyisa, nezinqumo ezinzima ezimayelana nezomthetho. Abantu abaningi babekhaliphile ngalesi sikhathi, bephikisana ngokuqinile mayelana nenhloso yokuphendula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi weNingizimu Afrika, owayengaphansi kwezinkinga ezinzima zokuhlukunyezwa, uqhubeke nokuhlola indlela uPistorius abhekana ngayo nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kwavusa izingxoxo ezinzima ngempilo yomjaho, nokuthi abantu abanjengaye kumele babhekane nezimpilo zabo ngokuzithiba. Izinkanyezi ezahlukene zakhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, zibona uPistorius njengomfanekiso wezinkinga zomhlaba, okukhuluma ngokuphangisa ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika. Isinqumo sokugcina sikaPistorius saphumelelisa ukwakhiwa komphakathi, kwavula indlela yokuxoxisana ezindleleni eziningi. Abantu basaba nesithakazelo esikhulu esivela ezindabeni, bephikisana ngokuqinile, benze izikhumbuzo ezinzima, bezama ukuthola ukuqonda okukhudlwana ngalesi simo. Izinhlobo zokuqonda zashintsha, zaphenduka emizweni eminingi yokuhlukunyezwa, ubulungiswa, nenqubekela phambili. Ngokubheka esikhathini esizayo, isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhombisa ukuhamba phambili komphakathi. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda izindaba ezinjengalezi ukuze siqonde indlela ethinta abantu abaningi. Uhlanga lwezokuhlukunyezwa, izinkinga zomthetho, nezinqumo ezithathwa yinkantolo, zidinga ukuthi abantu babe nesithakazelo, bephikisana phakathi kwalolu hlobo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle, nokuqonda okujule. Kuyacaca ukuthi isinqumo sokugcina sikaPistorius sikhumbuza umphakathi ngempilo, ubulungiswa, nobudlelwane obunobungozi. Umphakathi udinga ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ufinyelele emiphumeleni emihle. Uhlanga lwezomthetho luhlose ukuthola ubulungiswa, ukuze izimpilo zabantu zinganqandwa, kanti izinkinga ezinjalo zingathathwa njengomthwalo ophakeme. Uhlanga lwezokuhlukunyezwa ludinga ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinjengalezi, ukuze sithole ukuqonda okukhulu. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungenza umehluko, ube nesithakazelo, uhlele kahle izinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kumele kube yisifundo sokuhlola, sokubhala, nokuhlaziya izinkinga ezithinta ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, nezinkinga ezibucayi zomthetho. Ngemva kokuqeda ukuhamba kwalesi sinqumo, umphakathi uqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela ezinhle zokwakha ubudlelwane obunempilo, ube nempumelelo, ukuze uthole umphakathi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kuyisifundo esiqhubekayo, esidinga ukuba silandele, sifunde kakhulu, futhi sibe nesithakazelo. Izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka, zigqugquzele ukuhamba phambili, nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhumbuza abantu abaningi ukuthi ubulungiswa abukhona kuphela ezinhlelweni zomthetho, kodwa futhi nakuwo wonke umuntu. Kulula ukweqa izinkinga, kodwa kubalulekile ukuyibhekana nabantu, sifunde futhi sikhumbule izifundo ezitholakele. Ngalokhu, umphakathi ungenza umehluko, ube nesithakazelo, ube nezinqumo ezifanele ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika.
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amabhizinisi amancane abalulekile ekukhuleni komnotho. Lokhu kudalula ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kokuphatha amabhizinisi nezinselele ezibhekene nawo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekucishweni kukagesi. Lo mcimbi obalulekile uzoletha umbono wokuthi lezi zimo zisebenza kanjani ezimpilweni zabanye ngokwezimali, ukukhula, kanye nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ngemuva kokuhlaziya izimo eziningi, siyakubona ukuthi ukuciswa kukagesi kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi amancane. Okokuqala, sizocabanga ngempumelelo yokuphatha amabhizinisi, njengoba izinsuku zokukhiqiza, ukuletha, kanye nezinsiza zidinga ukuxhumana okungapheli. Lokhu kuzodingeka uma sikhuluma ngezinye zezinselelo ezithinta ukudayiswa nokuphathwa kwezimali. Okwenqaba, ukucishwa kukagesi kuvame ukuvimbela amabhizinisi amancane ekutholeni imikhiqizo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo, opharetha ababevele bephila ezinhlakahleni ezinzima. Imakethe ibhunqwa ngezikhathi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphila - okuhlanganisa ukhokho bezimboni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusilela kwezinsiza ezisemthethweni, okubangela ukuhamba kwesikhathi emsebenzini kanye nezinkinga zezimali. Okwesithathu, ukucishwa kukagesi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezindleleni zokujika kwemali. Njengoba amabhizinisi amancane evame ukwenza kahle, kuba nempikiswano yokuthi imikhiqizo ethile isebenzisa izinsiza eziza nalesi simo esiphuthumayo. Ukuze kube khona umkhuba wokugwema ukuncika ekuhlinzekeni kwamandla, abafakizwayo badinga izindlela ezikhetheke kakhulu ezizokwenza umkhuba ube ngokwemfundo. Njengoba sithola ukuthi ukucishwa kukagesi kuhlobene nemiphumela ethile emsebenzini wansuku zonke, sibuye sithole nokwehluka okukhona kumphakathi. Lokhu kuveza umthelela ohluke kakhulu phakathi kwabahlinzeki bemisebenzi, abathengi, nezinye izinsiza. Amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuphendula umqondo omusha nezindlela zokwakha ukuze azikhulise ekunciphiseni izingozi. Okwesine, sizohlola izindlela ezingasetshenziswa amabhizinisi amancane ukuze avikela izingozi zokucishwa kukagesi. Amabhizinisi angase athathe izinyathelo zokusungula indlela yokusebenza esezingeni eliphakeme ngokwakha izinhlelo ezokwazisa abantu mayelana nenkinga yokuncika kumandla kagesi ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzovula umnyango wokuvikela imithombo yokugenqulwa kwemali. Umhlanganiso wezinsizakalo ezibalulekile, ukuhlinzeka ngemini, nokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi kufanele kwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani kungaphinde kube nomthelela ophusile, oqhubekelayo futhi oligugu kakhulu. Ekugcineni, ukucishwa kukagesi kukhulu kakhulu emabhizinisini amancane, kuhlobene nezinsizakalo nezinsizakusebenza kumanje. Lo mcimbi uzosikhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba singalindela ukuthi ugesi uqhubeke noma unqamuke, amabhizinisi amancane kufanele aqhubeke edlondlobala, ethuthukisa izixazululo, futhi athole izindlela zokuphila ezikahle nezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufundisa amabhizinisi amancane ngezindlela zokuzilungiselela okuhambisana nokuncika ekucishweni kukagesi. Lezi zinyathelo zingahlanganisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezahlukene, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlela, kanye nokwenza izinto ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha imfundo eqinile, enobuchwepheshe ezinsizakalweni, futhi kubalusise ekwakheni ikakhulukazi. Ngemuva kwalokho, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane akukhona nje kuphela ezinzima ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi uvula umyalezo wokuqhubekela phambili emazweni nasezizweni, lapho amabhizinisi amancane kufanele aqhubeke ezwikela ekwakheni izinsiza ezinomthelela omuhle ekuziphatheni. Lokhu kuzobhekelela izimo zezimali, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinxusa eziyi-orthodox, ebhalwe ukubambisana phakathi kwemindeni nezizinda. Ngaphandle kokucishe kudlule isikhathi semizamo, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ungathinta indlela esiphila ngayo, silungiselela ubuchwepheshe, izinkampani, nabathengi ukuze babe nemiphumela emihle emsebenzini wabo. Lo mcimbi, okhombisa ubuchwepheshe obungcono, uzobamba iqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi amancane.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Kwenzeka ngaleso sikhathi esinzima, ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ubhekene ne-COVID-19. Izingane zazivame ukujabulisa, kodwa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezithile babezizwa belahlekile, besala ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Kulokhu, uhulumeni weNingizimu Afrika wenza isinqumo esibalulekile sokwethula isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-42, wayenobunzima bokuphila. Uhlala emzaneni omncane, eSoweto, lapho imisebenzi ibingekho njalo. Umkhaya wakhe wawudinga ukudla, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngemva kokufunda ngalesi sibonelelo, uThandi wanquma ukuba azame ukuthola ukwesekwa. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uThandi wathola izaziso zokuthi uzothola lesi sibonelelo. Wathola u-R350 ngenyanga, okwakuyisithako esincane sokuthuthukisa impilo yakhe nemindeni yakhe. Lokhu kwaba wumsebenzi omkhulu, njengoba wabona ukuthi angathenga ukudla okwakudingeka kakhulu. UThandi wathenga izithelo, imifino, nemikhiqizo yokudla eyayidlayo. Waqala nokufundisa izingane zakhe ukuthi zabelane ngalokho abakutholayo. Ukubambisana nomndeni wakubo, baqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke bayaphila, bahlala bexhumene. Lokhu kube yindlela yokwakha umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabo, nakuba babezizwa benomthwalo. Kodwa-ke, akuzange kube lula. Ubunzima bokuqala bukhona lapho uThandi ehlangana nezinkinga zokusebenzisa lesi sibonelelo. Kwakudingeka ukuthi abhalise ku-inthanethi, futhi lokho kwaba nzima ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. UThandi waphinde wabhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela kwi-inthanethi, okwakuphazamisa ukuqhubeka kwakhe. Ngemva kwamasonto ambalwa, uThandi waqinisekisa ukuthi ubhalisile. Wathola isikhumbuzo sokuthi uzothola imali yakhe, futhi lokho kwamlethela ithemba. UThandi waba nesizotha, futhi wayenombono omuhle wokuthi izinsuku ezizayo zizoba ngcono. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo. Wazama ukugcina ingxenye encane yokubhalela imfundo yezingane zakhe, eqinisekisa ukuthi bazoba nekhono lokuphila elingcono esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi wayejabule ngokwazi ukuthi ubakhathalela. Nokho, abanye emzaneni babebona uThandi edlula. Kwavela imibuzo, nokungabaza, nokukhuluma okungathandeki. Abanye babecabanga ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sasingekho, futhi sathathwa kalula. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi, kodwa uThandi wachaza ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuwusizo. Wayengazama ukuzama ukuze abone ukuthi abanye baphila kanjani. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uThandi waqala ukufuna izindlela zokwenza imali engaphezulu. Waqala ukuthengisa izithelo nemifino emakhaya, ebamba imfashini yendlu. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi waphumelela ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazisiza ekuhlinzekeni ngemfundo ezizayo. UThandi uphumelele ukukhokhela abantwana bakhe imfundo, futhi umndeni wakhe waqala ukuhlala kahle. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathinta impilo yakhe, samnika ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. UThandi wabona ukuthi imizamo yakhe, nokuhlanganyela nomndeni, bekuyinto ebalulekile ekuphumeleleni. Noma kunjalo, uThandi akazange akhohlwe abanye abangenamathuba. Waqhubeka nokusekela abanye, ebakhuthaza ukuthi bafune izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kwavula umoya wokubambisana emzaneni, futhi abantu baqonda ukuthi badinga ukusebenzisana ukuze baphumelele. UThandi wayephila ngezinsuku ezinzima, kodwa isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant samnika ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqonda ukuthi, nakuba ubunzima buhlala bukhona, uNkulunkulu wayekanye nabo, futhi izinsuku ezinhle zazizofika. Ngaleyondlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabambisana kanjani ukuze uphumelele, futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingaba yindlela yokuphila. Ubuye wathola ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze ufinyelele empumelelweni. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathuthukisa impilo yakhe, futhi uThandi waba ngumama okhuthazayo, ebakhuthaza abanye ukuthi baphumelele. Ngempela, izinto ezinzima zingaholela kwezinye, futhi ngezifiso ezinhle, ukuphila kungaba ngcono. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi imizamo, uthando, nokubambisana kungaguqula impilo.
Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Izibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi njengoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo zempilo eziyisisekelo. Nokho, eMpumalanga Kapa, njengasemaphandleni amaningi eNingizimu Afrika, izibhedlela zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Lezi zinkinga zihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukusweleka kwezisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza eziphumelelayo. Okokuqala, izinsiza zempilo eMpumalanga Kapa ziningi, kodwa zisezingeni eliphansi. Izibhedlela zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza ezanele, okuhlanganisa imithi, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinto ezisemqoka zokunakekela iziguli. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokukhula, izibhedlela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanelekile. Ukuntuleka kwemithombo yokusebenza kuholela ekutheni izisebenzi zempilo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphumelelayo kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangamaZulu. Okwesibili, ukusweleka kwezisebenzi zempilo, ikakhulukazi odokotela nabanye abasebenzi, kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. EMpumalanga Kapa, ubukhulu bokushoda kwezisebenzi buhambisana nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha abasebenzi abasha. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu. Izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Imisebenzi emisha ibhekana nezinselelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezithembekile kudinga ukugxila ekuthuthukisweni kwezokwakha ukuze izibhedlela zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kokuntuleka kwemithombo, ezinye izinkinga ezinzima zihlanganisa ukungabi khona kukagesi, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinkinga zokusebenza kwemishini. Izibhedlela zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zinezinsiza eziphathekayo ukuze zigweme ukungasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokufaka ezibhedlela ukuze zithuthuke. Imininingwane eqoqiwe ingasiza ekuboneni izinkinga ezitholakalayo. Ukuze impilo ithuthuke, izinkinga zengqalasizinda zidinga amasu nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo. Imiphakathi idinga ukwaziswa ngokubaluleka kokukhululwa kwemali ukuze izibhedlela zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukusiza ukuhlela ukuhlinzeka, kubalulekile. Abantu bangenwa ukuhamba-bhuku, imibiko evumayo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo eziphathelene nezinsizakusebenza. Iziqu zobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ezikhungweni ezahlukahlukene. Ukuze impilo eMpumalanga Kapa iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokubambisana phakathi kwezokwakha, izinhlelo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zempilo. Imiphakathi ingabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela ngokuba nemihlangano, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kanye nokukhuthaza ukutshalwa kwezimali. Uma izinkinga zengqalasizinda ziqhubeka, impilo yabantu izothinteka, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zidinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo ezithintekayo. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukufaka izinsizakusebenza, nokuthola izixazululo eziphathekayo kuzothuthukisa isimo sezibhedlela, kuthuthukise impilo yomphakathi, futhi kwandise ukutholakala kwezinsiza ezihamba phambili. Ukusebenza ndawonye kuzoguqula izibhedlela zibe yizikhungo eziphumelelayo ezikhuthaza impilo engcono kubantu baseMpumalanga Kapa.
Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan I- Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan (ERRP) iyisinyathelo esibalulekile esithathwe uhulumeni ukuze kubuyiswe umnotho wezwe elibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokuphazamiseka okubangelwe yizimo ezihlukahlukene ezifana neCOVID-19, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho ezikhona. Le plan ibhalwe ngenhloso yokwakha umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi obandakanya bonke abantu. Isizathu sokwakhiwa kwe-ERRP Ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwe-ERRP, uhulumeni ubhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nokukhula kwamazinga okungasebenzi, ukuncipha kwemali engenayo, kanye nokungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, i-ERRP yadalwa ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga, ibuyise umnotho, futhi iqinise izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinto eziyinhloko ze-ERRP I-ERRP ibandakanya izigaba eziningi ezibalulekile ezizokwakha umnotho. Lezi zigaba zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuphuculwa Kwezinsiza Zomphakathi: Lokhu kuhilela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, nezindlela zokuhamba. Ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola imfundo nezinhlaka zempilo ezinhle, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokukhula komnotho. 2. Ukukhuthazwa Kwezokwakha Nezokuthuthukiswa: Ukuze kube nokukhula komnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokwakha. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izakhiwo zezimboni, kanye nezindawo zokuhweba. Lokhu kuzokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, okuzokwandisa umnotho. 3. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuxhasa Amabhizinisi: I-ERRP ibheka ukusiza amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuxhasa, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Amabhizinisi ahlume kakhulu angasiza ekunciphiseni amazinga okungasebenzi. 4. Ukwakha Umnotho Ohlangene: I-ERRP ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umnotho uhlanganisa wonke umuntu, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlaselwe kakhulu. 5. Ukuvuselelwa Kwezobuchwepheshe: Ukuze umnotho ube phambili, kubalulekile ukuvuselela ubuchwepheshe. I-ERRP ibheka ukusiza izinkampani ukuthi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Zokuphumelelisa I-ERRP Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, izinyathelo ezithile zidingeka: 1. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Ezizimele: Uhulumeni kumele ubambisane nezikhungo ezizimele, ezifana nezinkampani ezinkulu, amabhizinisi amancane, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. 2. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemali: Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, kudingeka imali eningi. Uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. 3. Ukukhuthaza Umphakathi: Umphakathi kumele uqondiswe ukuze uqonde izinzuzo ze-ERRP. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nokufundisa abantu ngendlela yokuthola amathuba kuzokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi. 4. Ukusebenza Ngokuqhubekayo: I-ERRP akumele ibhekelelwe kuphela ngesikhathi esithile, kodwa kufanele kube nesu eliqhubekayo lokuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma izinto zingahambi kahle. Izinto Ezinzima Ezibhekene Ne-ERRP Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezinhle ze-ERRP, kunezinto ezinzima ezibhekene nayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Izinsiza Ezinganele: Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni angase abhekane nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. 2. Ukungaboni Ngasolinye: Abantu abaningi bangase bangathandi izinguquko ezizokwenzeka. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphikisaneni nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinqubo. 3. Izimo Zomnotho Eziguquguqukayo: Umnotho ungase uguquke ngokushesha, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizophumelela. Isiphetho I- Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi obandakanya bonke abantu. Noma kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene ne-ERRP, uma uhulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisana, le plan ingaba yimpumelelo enkulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singenza umnotho wethu ube ngcono, ube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abantu.
Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Isifo sofuba, esaziwa nangokuthi i-tuberculosis (TB), singenye yezifo ezibulalayo ezivame kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala ezivulekile nezingcolile, ukungena kwezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokushoda kwemisebenzi. Ukuze kuqedwe lokhu, uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele, bahlele izinhlelo ezahlukene zokulwa nesifo sofuba. Okokuqala, imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba. Izinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi ziqhutshelwa phambili ngendlela yokwazisa abantu ngezimbangela, izimpawu, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela lesi sifo. Iminyaka edlule ibonise ukuthi uma umphakathi unolwazi olwaneleyo, kubalulekile ekwenzeni kube nokuncipha kokushaqeka kwemiphumela yesifo. Uhlelo olukhona luhlanganisa ukudlulisela ulwazi ezinkampanini, ezikoleni, nasezikhungweni zokwelashwa, okwenza abantu bakwazi ukuhlonipha izizathu zokuvakasha kumaphoyisa wezempilo. Okwesibili, kwesinye sezinyathelo ezibalulekile, uhulumeni uhlela uhlelo lwezokwelapha oluhlanganisa ukwelashwa kumahhala kwabo bonke abathola isifo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba isifo sofuba sithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abahlala ezindleleni eziphansi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumaphayiphi emithi yamahhala eluthathwa khona, okusiza ukubuyisela amandla kwabaphila nesifo lokhu, okwenza kube lula ukubagqokisa abathola usizo. Uhlaka lokuxhaswa kwezemiti lubuyekezwa njalo emihlanganweni yakhe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinga lokulashwa lisebenze kahle. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithi esemthethweni, ngokuhambisana nemigomo esebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abanesifo sofuba bathola usizo olwanele. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukugqugquzela ukuhlolwa okuvamile kwempilo kubalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kwe-TB kudinga ukuba kube yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezizinda eziphakeme zokushayelwa yilesi sifo. Uhlelo lokuhlola oluhlanganisa ukubamba izithombe zokuqagela nokuhlolwa kwe-viral liqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banikela ngeziqu zempilo zabo futhi, uma kungenjalo, bathole ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Uhlaka lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwehliseni izinga lokwanda kwesifo. Ukuze kulandwe empumelelweni, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi yazo nemiphakathi, ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhuba imiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela olwazini oluthile nokwelashwa okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba okubhekana nezinsiza zokwelapha kudinga ukuhlanganyela okunomsoco emazingeni ahlukeneyo, kuhlanganise noHulumeni, ozimele, nabantu basekhaya. Ukuze uHulumeni ube nempumelelo yalesi sifo, kudinga ukuba kube kudalwe isikhala sokusebenzisana phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlangano ezibhekelele ezempilo. Okwesibili, kudinga imithombo eyengeziwe yokuxhasa abantu abane-TB, okubandakanya imithombo yezezimali yokwenza ucwaningo olujulile. Lokhu kulungisa imithombo ethize yokwenziwa kocwaningo lokwelapha kombuso, okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlela ezintsha neziphumelelayo zokwelapha ziyaqhubeka nokutholakala. Ucwaningo oluqinile luphethe amathuba amasha okuthola imithi emisha yokwelapha, okuyinto ethokozisayo ehlinzeka udaba lwempumelelo kumqondisi. Ekugcineni, ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, nezinhlaka eziphezulu zibalulekile ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zibe nomphumela omuhle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanye abafundi, abafana nabangamaTBB, baxhaswa, kuhlinzeka umqondo wokuthi umphakathi ungalwa kanjani ne-TB ngokuhlanganyela. Yingakho ukubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza, izinsiza zemibono, kanye nezinhlelo ezisemthethweni zibalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal. Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudinga ukugqugquzela ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izindima zomphakathi, kuhlanganisa izikole, izibhedlela, nabahlinzeki bendawo okubekezela okubambisene. Lezi zinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba ziyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nempilo yesizwe, sigqugquzele ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu ukuze basebenze kahle ekunciphiseni isifo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela efanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokwelapha ziba nezinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini yaseKwaZulu-Natal, okuzokwenza kube nokwehla kwezenzakalo zomhlaba jikelele eziqhamuka nesifo sofuba.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubonakale ungumgogodla wokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, njengoba izwe lethu lidlula ezikhathini ezinzima zokuphikisana kwezombusazwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinsongo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu shintsho. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, lesi simo sithinta izimpilo zethu njengabavoti kanye nokwakha isizinda esiqinile sezombusazwe. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act uhlose ukuvumela ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezithile ezindleleni zokhetho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandiswa kokufinyelela kwabantu abaningi emisebenzini yokhetho, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuvota. Nokho, lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuphatha izinguquko ezinjalo ngendlela efanele. Izinselelo ezivela kulokhu zikhona, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutheni abantu bazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo kanjani. Okwesibili, umthetho lo uzama ukwakha isithombe esisha sokuphatha izinkampani ezimaphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala njengokuhlosiwe okuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavoti bayazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza kanjani. Uma abantu bengazi kahle ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni inani labantu abavota, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokwakha isithombe esihle sokhetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeka izinkinga ezithile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izinsiza ezikhona kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izinsiza ezanele ukuze kube nokwenzeka kokuvota. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuphepha zihlala zikhona. Ngaphandle kokuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeke izinhlelo zokuvikela, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zokuphepha zingaholela ekunciphiseni ukwethenjwa kwabavoti. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi ukuvota kungaba yingozi, kuzobangela ukuthi baphume ezinkampanini zabo bangenandaba nokuthi baphinde bavote. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinamandla zokuvikela abavoti, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bangavota ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho lo ubeka izinqubo ezinzima ezihambisana nokubhaliswa kwabavoti. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela ukuvota kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze basize labo abangenazo izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhaliswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani ukuvota. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Okwamanje, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabavoti. Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeka izinhlelo ezithile zokwakha ukwethenjwa, kodwa lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibucayi phakathi kwabavoti kanye nohulumeni, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo ziyavumelana nezidingo zabo. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Ekugcineni, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubonakala ungumgogodla wokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokhetho, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Izinselelo ezikhona zidinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuphatha izinguquko ezinjalo ngendlela efanele. Uma sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuvikela abavoti, nokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabavoti, sizobona ukuthi umthetho lo uzoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, akusizi kuphela ukuba nomthetho omuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwe lethu lihlala likhululekile, linobulungiswa, futhi linokuthula. Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabantu abavota, sizwakalise izwi lethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Inkinga Yokubhalisa Emanyuvesi: Indaba Yomlando Emhlabeni jikelele, ukubhaliswa emanyuvesi kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. ESouth Africa, le nkinga ibonakala ikakhulukazi phakathi neminyaka yezi-2000, lapho izinga lokufunda liphakamisa izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukubheka izizathu eziholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, iminyango kahulumeni, kanye nemfundo jikelele. Ngonyaka ka-2000, iNyuvesi yaseCape Town yathola ukwanda okukhulu kwabafundi abafuna ukufunda. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, njengoba izinsiza ezikhona zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Abafundi abaningi babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinsuku ezide zokulinda, izinhlelo eziphukile, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphumelele ekubhaliseni, kanti abanye bahlala bengabhaliswanga, okwakuholela ekutheni baphuthelwe amathuba okuthola imfundo. Ngonyaka ka-2015, inkinga yokubhalisa yafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, lapho izikole eziningi ziqala ukuveza izikhalazo ezinkulu. Abafundi baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisana nezinhlelo zokubhaliswa ezazibonakala zingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezazihlosiwe, kodwa izinkinga zaphinde zaphinda zaphakanyiswa. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa. Kwakukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezazihlosiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa, kodwa izinselelo zazingapheli. Izikole eziningi zazidinga ukwandisa izinsiza zazo, kodwa lokhu kwakudinga izimali ezinkulu, okwakungatholakali kalula. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphinde bahlale bezama ukuthola izindlela zokubhaliswa, kanti abanye bahlala bephuthelwa amathuba okuthola imfundo. Ngonyaka ka-2018, inkinga yokubhaliswa yathola ukugxila okukhulu, lapho abafundi baphakamisa izwi labo emaphakathini. Kwakukhona izinhlelo eziningi zokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, kodwa izinkinga zaphinde zaphakanyiswa. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Ngonyaka ka-2020, iCOVID-19 yathinta kakhulu izinqubo zokubhaliswa emanyuvesi. Ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokubhaliswa, njengoba abafundi bephoqeleka ukuba baphendule ezinhlelweni ezisha zokubhaliswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuxhumana, njengoba abanye abafundi bahlala bephuthelwa amathuba okuthola imfundo. Izikole zaphinde zathola izinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba zidinga ukwandisa izinsiza zazo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa zathuthukiswa. Izikole zathola izinsiza eziningi, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, kodwa izinkinga zaphinde zaphakanyiswa. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Namuhla, inkinga yokubhaliswa emanyuvesi isaqhubeka, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa zikhombisa umphumela omuhle. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa. Inkinga yokubhaliswa emanyuvesi ibonisa ukuthi imfundo iyinselele enkulu, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa zikhombisa umphumela omuhle. Kodwa, kusemqoka ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi banethuba lokufunda, futhi baphumelele ezinhlelweni zabo zemfundo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkinga yokubhaliswa iyaxazululwa.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Isingeniso Izinhlelo ze-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi kahulumeni, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka kubantu nabezindaba. Nokho, lapho lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, umphakathi, izisebenzi, kanye nohulumeni bahlupheka kakhulu. Le dokhumenti ibheka umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA, izimbangela zalesi simo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlaka. Umthelela Kwezinsizakalo Zikahulumeni Ukungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kudala ukuhamba kancane kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu bahlale belinde izinsizakalo ezinjengokubhaliswa kwemali, izicelo zezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki kubantu, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokwethembeka kukahulumeni. Umphakathi uphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu. Izindleko Zokungasebenzi Izindleko zokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA azikhawulelwe kuphela emsebenzini ongaphumeleli, kodwa zifaka phakathi nezindleko ezinkulu zokuphinda kwenziwe imisebenzi. Lokhu kudala ukuchithwa kwemali kahulumeni, okungaholela ekwehleni kwesabelomali sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Izindleko eziphakeme zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezisemqoka, okukhathaza kakhulu izigidi zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izimbangela Zokungasebenzi Izimbangela zokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA zingahluka kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezobuchwepheshe: Izinhlelo ezindala noma ezingenayo ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingaholela ekungasebenzi kahle. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe luhlala luthuthuka, futhi uma uhulumeni ungazivumelanisi nezinguquko, izinhlelo zingase zibe nezinkinga. 2. Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokusebenza, njengemali, abantu, noma amathuluzi, kungaholela ekungasebenzi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle. 3. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlangano: Ukuhluleka kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ukungahambisani phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kuholela ekungasebenzi kahle. 4. Ukungahambisani Nezidingo Zomphakathi: Uma izinhlelo zingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, umphakathi ungase ungathokoziswa, okukhathaza kakhulu. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezobuchwepheshe Obuphambili: Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi zibe nezobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. 2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi ezisebenzisana nezinhlelo ze-SITA kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. 3. Ukuphathwa Okunembile: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kube nokuhleleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. 4. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi: Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izidingo zomphakathi. Isiphetho Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ubalulekile kakhulu ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ukwethembeka phakathi kukahulumeni nomphakathi, okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni.
Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler eMedupi Power Station, eyakhelwe ukuthuthukisa umthombo wamandla eNingizimu Afrika, kubonakala njengomkhakha obucayi kwezobuchwepheshe. Nokho, le mboni ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, lapho ukwehluleka kwama-boiler kubonakala ngokusobala. Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi simo kuveza izizathu eziyisisekelo, okudinga ukuxoxwa okujulile ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela nemithelela yalesi sikhathi. Okokuqala, kudingeka sihlole izimbangela zokwehluleka kwama-boiler. Izikhungo eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi ukungasebenzi kahle kokwakhiwa kwe-boiler kwakuwumqondisi ophawulekayo.
