I-Medupi ithole usizo lwemininingwane yezobuchwepheshe evela kwamanye amazwe, kodwa kungekho ukuqonda okwanele kwezimo zasendaweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezingxenye ezisemqoka ezakhiwe ngendlela engafanele, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsiza ezithile azizange zifinyeleleke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabikhona kokuhlola okwanele ngesikhathi sokwakha kwabangela izinkinga ezinzima. Ukungahambi kahle kwamasu okukhulisa izinga lokuhlola nokubheka ukwakhiwa kwamafektri kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphumela engachazeki. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwama-boiler, okwaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqizwa kwamandla. Njengoba ama-boiler engatholakali, umkhiqizo wamandla awufinyeleli ezingeni elihlongozwayo. Uchungechunge lweziqiniso zocwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi le miphumela ayithinti kuphela ukukhiqizwa kwamandla, kodwa futhi inezimpempe emnothweni wesizwe. Ukwehluleka kwamandla kuhlanganiswa nezindleko ezinkulu, okudingeka ukufaka uhlelo lokwakha kabusha ukuze kuhlonishwe lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuphazamiseka kuthinta i-Eskom, okuyinkampani ehlinzeka ngamandla, futhi kuhlangana nezinkinga ezibucayi zemali. Umphakathi kumele uqaphele futhi uxoxe ngalolu daba ngoba umthelela omkhulu ungenzeka ezimpilweni zomphakathi. Ukwehluleka kwamandla kubeka engcupheni izinhlelo eziningi zokwakhiwa ezithinta izimboni, imidlalo, nezinsiza eziyisisekelo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni ukusimama komnotho, okusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Futhi, izindleko ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwezinye izinsiza zifaka ingcindezi emkhakheni wezomnotho. Abantu abaningi balahlekelwa yimisebenzi yabo ngenxa yokuthi amabhizinisi awakwazi ukuhlinzeka amathuba, ngakho-ke ukwehluleka kwama-boiler akuhambisani kuphela nezinkinga zamandla kodwa nakwimiphumela eyinqaba. Lokhu kubeka ingcindezi kumphakathi ukuba uzame ukuvuselela imizamo yokwakha amanye ambozi aqukethe ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngokubheka phambili, kunemikhakha eminingi ezodinga ukunakwa ukuze kubonakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwezimali ekwakhiweni kwe-boiler amahle kudingeka ukuze kwandiswe lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kungahlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo ukuze kusizakale osomabhizinisi abasha namabhizinisi amancane. Hhayi nje ukuthi kuhlinzekwa ngama-boiler, kodwa futhi kumiswe izinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukugcina izinga lokuhlola. Ngokuphathelene nokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwe-Eskom nezinkampani zomhlaba. Ukuqonda okuhle phakathi kwalezi zinhlelo kuzokwenza kube nokubambisana okuyophumelela, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandiseni amathuba okukhulisa izinga lokuhlola, okuzokwenza ukuthi ama-boiler asebenze kahle. Ekuphetheni, ukwehluleka kwama-boiler eMedupi akuwona umqondo oguquguqukayo, kodwa umphumela wokungasebenzi kahle okukhona emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda imikhakha ehlobene, izinxephezelo ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nokukhuluma ngemiphumela ehlobene nalokhu kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekufinyeleleni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umqondo wokwakha, ophambili ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, ubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomnotho ozayo. I-Eskom, imiphakathi, kanye nezehlakalo zomhlaba wonke kufanele ukuba uhlanganise ukuze kube khona ukwaneliseka kokwehluleka kwama-boiler, nokufezekiswa kwemigomo yeNingizimu Afrika.
Umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwe-District Development Model Isingeniso Le mfuneko ibalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa izindawo. I-District Development Model (DDM) iyithuluzi elisetshenziselwa ukuhlela, ukuphatha, nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Umbiko lo uzohlinzeka ngemicimbi ethile yokusebenzisa i-DDM, izinqubo ezisemqoka, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Izinqubo Zokusebenzisa i-District Development Model 1. Ukubona Isidingo Sokuthuthukiswa - Qala ngokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungenziwa ngocwaningo, izinkulumo zomphakathi, noma ngokuqoqa idatha ethile. - Bheka izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, njengezokuthutha, imfundo, nezempilo. 2. Ukubandakanya Abahlanganyeli - Thola abahlanganyeli abahlukene abafaka phakathi ohulumeni bendawo, izinkampani, nezakhamizi. - Hlela imicimbi yokuhlanganyela ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene nokuxhumana. 3. Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa - Dala uhlelo olucacile oluhlanganisa izinjongo, izinsiza, nezikhathi. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi ezitholakele. 4. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali - Thola izinsiza zezimali ezidingekayo ukuze uhlelo luphumelele. - Hlela indlela yokuphatha izinsiza zezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle. 5. Ukusebenza Nokuqhuba - Qala ukusebenzisa uhlelo ngokuhleleka. Hlela imihlangano yokuhlola inqubekela phambili. - Bheka ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo ezibekiwe. 6. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza - Beka uhlelo lokuhlola ukusebenza kwe-DDM. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlola imiphumela, izinkinga, nezinsiza. - Thola impendulo kubahlanganyeli ukuze uthuthukise uhlelo. 7. Ukuphakamisa Izifundo Eziphumelele - Qopha izifundo ezitholakele ukuze zisetshenziswe kwezinye izinhlelo. - Hlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngalezi zifundo nabanye abahlanganyeli. Ukubaluleka Kwe-District Development Model - Ukubambisana: I-DDM ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. - Ukuhlangabezana Nezidingo: I-DDM ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. - Ukuphucula Ukuphathwa: I-DDM ithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphatheni izimali nezinsiza. Izinto Ezidingekayo Ukuze Uhlelo Luphumelele - Ubuholi Obuqinile: Ukuphathwa kwe-DDM kudinga ubuholi obuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zithathwa ngendlela efanele. - Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bonke abahlanganyeli kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini elindelekile. - Izinsiza Zokuxhasa: Izinsiza ezifanele, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza, idatha, kanye nezinsiza zezimali, zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Isiphetho I-District Development Model iyithuluzi eliwusizo ekuthuthukiseni izindawo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezichazwe ngenhla, izindawo zingathuthukiswa ngendlela efanele, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abahlanganyeli babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo ye-DDM. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo zabantu, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho wesifunda.
Ngiyavuma, sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko esinzima, kodwa ngizokwenza kube kulula. Njengoba sonke sikwazi, izikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngabe ubona kanjani lezi zikhukhula? Yini odinga ukuyazi? Okokuqala, kufanele kuthiwe, izikhukhula zenzeka ngenxa yokungena komoya opholile, izimvula ezinzima, nezimo zemvelo ezimbi. Ngabe ubona lezi zinto zenzeka kangakanani? Impela, ngiyazi ukuthi abantu bahlupheka kakhulu. Izindlu zibhujiswa, abantu bayalahleka, izimpilo ziyanqamuka. Lokhu akukhanyi, akunjalo? Kukhona abangane bethu, imindeni, abathanda, abalahlekile. Lokhu kumosha imiphakathi ngempela. Ngabe sikhumbula izikhukhula ezinkulu ezihambile? Kukhona lezo zenzeka ngo-2022, lapho izimvula zashaya kakhulu. Abantu bahlala bedinga usizo, imizamo yokusiza yayinjalo, kodwa isimo sasingesihle. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kukhona abantwana abahluphekayo, abazali bejolise emizimbeni yabo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi asikwazi ukusindisa bonke. Lokhu kucacisa ubunzima balesi simo. Kodwa uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sithola imiphumela emibi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithinte izinhlelo zokuphila zethu. Izikhukhula zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, izindawo zokuhlala ziba nzima ukufinyelela. Ngabe ubona kanjani lokhu? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo, kodwa-ke, ngabe sizokwazi yini ukuhamba phambili? Izakhiwo zidinga ukwakhiwa kabusha, futhi imiphakathi idinga ukwakha kabusha. Lokhu kungenzeka, kodwa kudinga ukusebenza ngamandla. Abantu badinga ukuvuselela izindawo zabo, ukuze kubuyiswe umoya ophilayo. Ngabe sikhumbula izinhlelo zezimali? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile ezivumelana nezidingo zabantu. Kodwa, ngabe ukusabela kwethu lokhu kuphumelela? Lokhu kubalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukusabela okusheshayo. Izinhlelo zokuphuma, imindeni eqinile, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Njengoba sithokozisa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula azizwakali, zisebenza, futhi zifuna ukusabela okufanele. Ngiphakamisa ukuthi siphendule kanjani? Ngabe sikhona isinyathelo esithile esingavula indlela yokuletha ushintsho? Thina, njengabantu, kufanele sihlanganyele, sihlinzeke usizo, sibe neqhaza. Lokhu kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Kukhona abaholi bezenhlalakahle, izinkampani ezizimele, nezinhlangano ezizokwazi ukusiza. Lokhu kudinga ukusebenza kahle, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Ngabe sikhuluma ngesimo semvelo kuphela? Cha! Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinzima, sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kumele sihlale sikhumbula. Izikhukhula zibhujisa, kodwa zifundisa nathi. Zifundisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, siphendule ngendlela efanele. Khumbula, asikwazi ukusindisa bonke, kodwa singenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngabe sikhumbula izinkumbulo zethu? Ngabe izinkumbulo zethu zifundisa ngendlela? Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi sizama kanjani ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, sithumele izinsiza lapho kudingeka khona. Sikhuluma ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi iyakha. Abantu badinga ukwakha kabusha, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi, kodwa badinga ukusekelwa. Ngabe sesikukhuluma, sikhumbula izinsiza zethu, izinhlelo, namathuba? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe neqhaza, sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula zikhombisa ubunzima, kodwa zifundisa futhi. Ngabe sikhumbula izinyathelo ezithathwe? Sithi kulungile, sibe nesibopho, sibe nezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula. Ngabe uyavuma? Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho, sibe nokuqonda. Ngiyazi, izikhukhula zibhujisa, kodwa kumele sithole indlela yokuphila, yokwakha kabusha. Lokhu kungenzeka uma sihlanganyela, sihlanganyela, sibe neqhaza. Ngiyabonga, ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu okukhuluma khona, kudinga ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula, sithinte imiphakathi yethu. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezilungile? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sihamba phambili, sizame, sithumele izinsiza, futhi sibe neqhaza. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukubambisana. Ngabe uyavuma? Izikhukhula zikhombisa ubunzima, kodwa zifundisa nathi. Hamba kahle, futhi ngiyabonga kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithumele izinsiza, sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile. Ngabe uzobamba iqhaza? Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho, sithumele izinsiza, futhi sibe neqhaza. Ngiyabonga!
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition (JET) luhloswe ukuthuthukisa ikusasa elihlanzekile futhi elizinzile, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhathazekile ngempilo yomhlaba kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wamandla. Lokhu kubhekwa njengendlela yokuhlangabezana nezidingo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon, ngenkathi kuqinisekiswa ukuthi imiphakathi ethintekayo ithola izinzuzo. Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, ezifana nokutshala imali ezinhlelweni zamandla avuselelekayo, ukwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusha obungasiza ekwehliseni ukuncika kumafutha emvelo. Kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo. Njengamanje, izifunda eziningi zikhathazekile ngempilo yomphakathi kanye nomthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izidingo zomphakathi kanye nezisebenzi ezikhona ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Uhlelo luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamathemba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezithintekayo kakhulu, ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela emisebenzini kulabo abavela emiphakathini ethintekayo, abavame ukuba nezinselelo ekutholeni imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwe-JET luhlose ukunciphisa ukuncika kumafutha emvelo, okuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokukhiqiza amandla. Uhlaka lwe-JET luhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamandla avuselelekayo, izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha. Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yamandla. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa nokuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini emisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola izinzuzo ezivela ekuhlinzekeni kwamandla avuselelekayo. Ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkampani ezizimele, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza amandla.
Ngiyavuma, le ndaba yokuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza ingeyodwa enokuthakazelisa kakhulu. Ngicabanga ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi kwenzekani ngemuva kokwelashwa, futhi ngiyafuna ukukwabelana ngalokhu. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngalesi simo sokwelashwa. Umdlavuza ungumkhuhlane onzima, futhi ukwelashwa kwawo kungaba nzima kakhulu. Abantu bahlala bejolise ekwelashweni, kodwa akuwona wonke umuntu obona ukuthi kukhona okuthile okuzolandela. Ngemuva kokwelashwa, abantu bahlala bephakathi kokukhathazeka, ukungabaza, nokuthi bazozizwa kanjani empilweni yabo. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza kungashiya imiphumela eminingi emzimbeni nasemoyeni? Abantu abaningi bahlala bephinde baphinde bahlola izimpawu zabo, baphinde bacabange ukuthi umdlavuza ungabuyela kanjani. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu. Ngabe umngani wakho ushadile? Ucabanga ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhlala uthokozile? Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu kumuntu ongakaze abhekane nalesi simo. Ngokuphathelene nezempilo, ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala benokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Imithi yokwelapha isebenza, kodwa ingase ibangele imiphumela emibi. Abantu bangase bazizwe benesimo sokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kungakhathaza impilo yabo. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala bephila kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa, kodwa abanye bahlala bezwa ubuhlungu obungapheli? Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Umdlavuza ungashiya izilonda ezinzima, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala bephila nezinye izinkinga zengqondo, njengokudangala noma ukukhathazeka. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka? Ngoba umqondo ubonisa indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi uma umqondo ungenankinga, impilo iphindaphindeka. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bathole usizo lwezengqondo ukuze baphumelele ekulweni nalokhu. Ngabe uyangithanda? Ngithanda ukucabanga ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlala bephila ngezindlela ezahlukene. Abanye abantu bangase baqonde kahle ukuthi kufanele baphile kanjani ngemuva kokwelashwa, kanti abanye bahlala bephakathi kokungaqondi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni abantu abaphila nalokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imindeni ingaba nomthelela omkhulu? Imindeni iyasiza, kodwa futhi ingaba nomthwalo omkhulu. Abantu abahlala bephila nezinye izinkinga, futhi imindeni ingase ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi imindeni ibheke phambili. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi abanye abantu badinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze baphumelele? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi kunezindlela eziningi zokuthola usizo? Ukuze abantu baphile kahle, kudingeka ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo, usizo lwezengqondo, futhi bahlale bephila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu bahlala bephila ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuxhumana nabanye? Lokhu kungasiza kakhulu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusekela zingaba usizo? Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ngazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ucabanga ukuthi imiphakathi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni abantu? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza kanjani? Uxhumano lwemindeni, abangani, nabanye abaphila nezinkinga ezifanayo lungasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kuza nomthelela omkhulu empilweni. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi abawedwa, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle. Ngokuphathelene nokuphila kahle, ngicabanga ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi impilo ibalulekile. Ukudla kahle, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphila impilo enempilo kuyasiza. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izindlela zokuphila zihluke kanjani kumuntu nomuntu? Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi yini ehamba kahle kubo. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukujabula? Ukuphila kahle akukhona nje ngokungabi nomdlavuza, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukujabulisa impilo yabo. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi ukujabulisa impilo yakho kungaba yindlela yokubhekana nezinkinga? Ngokuphetha, ukuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu bahlala bephila nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi bathole usizo. Ukuxhumana, ukuxhaswa, nokuphila impilo enempilo kubalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi baphile kanjani ngemuva kokwelashwa? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Nokho, le nqubo ibangela izimpikiswano eziningi phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi, ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Izinzuzo Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Okokuqala, amaloli amanzi anikeza isixazululo esisheshayo sokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Ezindaweni lapho amanzi engatholakali kalula, amaloli amanzi angasiza ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ngokushesha, okubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezithintekile yizinhlekelele zemvelo, lapho izinsiza zamanzi zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Okwesibili, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaba yindlela yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Uma umphakathi ungathola amanzi ahlanzekile kalula, lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu, kunciphise izifo ezithathelwana ngamanzi, futhi kuthuthukise imiphumela yokufunda ezikoleni. Ngakho-ke, amaloli amanzi angaba yinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaba yithuba lokwakha imisebenzi. Izinkampani ezithengisa amanzi zidinga abasebenzi, okungaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi endaweni. Lokhu kungasiza ekunciphiseni bezinga lokungasebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wendawo. Izinkinga Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi. Okokuqala, izindleko zokuthenga amanzi zihlala ziphakeme. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga enkulu kubantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi uma umphakathi ungenayo imali eyanele yokuthenga amanzi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bephila ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile, okungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Okwesibili, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuphakelwa kwamanzi emithonjeni yemvelo. Uma abantu bephuza amanzi amaningi kumaloli, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwamanzi emithonjeni yemvelo, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezilwaneni nasemvelweni. Lokhu kubalulekile uma sikhumbula ukuthi amanzi ayinsiza ebalulekile ekugcineni impilo yomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungabi nabulungisa. Abantu abahluphekayo bangase bangatholi ukufinyelela kalula kumaloli amanzi, kanti abanye abantu bangase bathole amanzi kalula ngenxa yokuthi banemali. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni ukungabi nabulungisa phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emphakathini. Isixazululo Esingaba Khona Ukuze sithole isixazululo esingcono, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Uhulumeni angase aqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zamanzi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile ngaphandle kokuthenga amaloli. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, noma ukwakha iziteshi zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezitholakala kalula. Izinkampani ezithengisa amanzi zingase zisebenzise izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ukuze zinciphise izindleko. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile ngentengo engabizi kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungase uqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ayatholakala kubo bonke. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuyinkinga enezinzuzo nezinkinga. Nakuba amaloli amanzi engasiza ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, izindleko eziphezulu, ukungabi nabulungisa, kanye nomthelela emithonjeni yemvelo kuyizinto ezidinga ukunakwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onobulungisa, futhi ophumelelayo.
Intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli waseNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima zomthetho ezihlobene nezinsolo zokushushiswa kwakhe ngasese. Lokhu kushushiswa kuhilela izinsolo ezinzima zokuphula umthetho, ezifaka phakathi ukukhwabanisa, ukungathembeki, kanye nokuphula izinqubomgomo zezwe. Ukuze siqonde kahle intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma, kubalulekile ukuhlola izigameko zomlando, izinqubo zomthetho, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. UZuma wakhuluma kakhulu ngesikhathi esebenza njengomengameli, lapho abezindaba bahlala bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo ezihlobene nezinto ezahlukene. Ukubhekana nalezi zinsolo, uZuma wathola izeluleko eziningi ezivela kubameli bakhe, okuhlanganisa izinyathelo zokuzivikela. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithile zokuphendula, ezazihloselwe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe, ngenkathi kuqhubeka nokuhlola izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsolo zokushushiswa zathuthuka zafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, lapho iziphathimandla zokuqala ziqala ukucwaninga ngokuqinile izenzo zikaZuma. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinsuku zokuphikisana ezibucayi, lapho abavoti, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ziqala ukuveza ukukhathazeka ngempumelelo yokuphatha kukaZuma. Izinhlangano eziningi zaphakamisa izwi lazo, zikhumbuza umphakathi ngokuqakathekiswa kokuphatha kahle kwezomnotho, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwemithetho. Intuthuko enkulu yenzeka ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezinsolo ezihlobene nezimangalo zokukhwabanisa. Izinsuku eziningi zokuqhubeka nokuhlola zakhombisa ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nemiphumela emibi, njengoba izinsolo zakhula zaba yinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo ezinzima ezithathwe ngabezinhlaka zomthetho, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokubamba uZuma ukuze abhekane nezinsolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inqubo yokushushiswa kaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabantu, lapho abanye bebona uZuma njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Izinyathelo zokushushiswa ziqhubekile, futhi uZuma waphakanyiswa ukuba abhekane nezinsolo ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokubamba uZuma, ezazihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziphathimandla zazingazimisele ukungaboni lutho, futhi zazithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo eziningi ezihlobene nezombusazwe, lapho abantu bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nezinsolo. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Ukwengeza, izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zathuthuka zaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini, futhi uZuma wathola ukwesekwa okuhlukahlukene. Abantu abaningi babona uZuma njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inqubo yokushushiswa kaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi iziphathimandla zathatha izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziphathimandla zazingazimisele ukungaboni lutho, futhi zazithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese ibonisa ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka, noma ngabe izinsolo zikhula zibe nzima. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umthetho unamandla, futhi iziphathimandla zikhuthazekile ekutheni ziqinisekise ukuthi abaphula umthetho babhekana nezinsolo zabo. Lokhu kudala ithemba kubantu, njengoba kubonisa ukuthi umthetho uyasebenza, futhi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.
Ubufakazi obethulwa ngabaphathi bakwa-Eskom kwiKhomishini kaZondo buwumsebenzi obalulekile ohloswe ukuveza izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, izinqubo zokuphatha, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ukuze uqonde kahle ubufakazi, landela lezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Umongo Wobufakazi 1.1. Funda kahle izincwadi ezihlobene neKhomishini kaZondo, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibhekisela kwi-Eskom. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde izizathu zokubizwa kwabaphathi. 1.2. Bheka izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe, ezifana nezinkinga zokuphatha, ukungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwemali, nezinkinga zokusebenza. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlola Ubufakazi Obethulwe 2.1. Bheka ubufakazi obutholakele, okuhlanganisa imibiko, izitatimende, nezincwadi ezithunyelwe kwiKhomishini. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izizathu zabaphathi bakwa-Eskom. 2.2. Qhathanisa ubufakazi obutholakele nezinkinga ezikhuluma ngazo, ukuze uqonde ukuthi ubufakazi buhambisana kanjani nezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlaziya Izizathu Zokubizwa KweKhomishini 3.1. Bheka izizathu eziholele ekubizweni kweKhomishini, okungabandakanya izigameko ezithile noma izinqumo ezithathwe abaphathi. 3.2. Qonda ukuthi lezi zizathu zikhombisa kanjani ukungabi nempumelelo kwe-Eskom, ukuze uqonde umthelela wezinqanaba ezithathwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Yobufakazi 4.1. Bheka imiphumela yobufakazi obethulwe, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezidingekayo nezinyathelo zokulungisa. 4.2. Qhathanisa imiphumela yobufakazi nezinhlelo ezikhona, ukuze uqonde ukuthi zidinga ukuvuselelwa noma cha. Isinyathelo 5: Ukubeka Phambili Izixazululo 5.1. Phakamisa izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube nokuphuculwa kwe-Eskom, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezinkulu noma izinyathelo ezincane. 5.2. Bheka ukuthi izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zingasebenza kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubika Imiphumela 6.1. Bhala umbiko ophathelene nobufakazi obethulwe, uhambise izigaba ezahlukene kusukela ekuhloleni ubufakazi kuya ekubekeni phambili izixazululo. 6.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbiko uqukethe imininingwane ecacile, izibalo, nezibonelo ezisekela iziphakamiso zakho. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubamba Izingxoxo 7.1. Hlela izingxoxo nabaphathi bakwa-Eskom ukuze uthole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngezinselelo ezikhuluma ngazo. 7.2. Bheka ukuthi abaphathi bakwa-Eskom baphendula kanjani ezinkingeni eziphakanyisiwe, ukuze uqonde izinqumo zabo. Isiphetho Ubufakazi obethulwe ngabaphathi bakwa-Eskom kwiKhomishini kaZondo buwumsebenzi obalulekile ohloswe ukuveza izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuhlela, ukuhlaziya, nokubika ubufakazi ngendlela efanele, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Qinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi buhamba phambili ekwakheni izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuphuculwa kwe-Eskom, ukuze kube nokwaneliseka komphakathi.
Inkinga yosuku olwaziwa nge-Day Zero eKapa ichaziwe Ekhaya elilindelekile, uKapa yidolobha elikhangayo, elinamagquma ahlanzekile nemifula ehlanzekile. Kodwa, eminyakeni edlule, leli dolobha lidlule engozini enkulu yokushoda kwamanzi - ukukhalipha kwe-Day Zero. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho amanzi, abephumelele, efika ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, kwaze kwaba yilapho abaphathi bephuma bathi uma izinga lempilo lingaphansi, kuzofanele umphakathi uthole amanzi kuphela ezindaweni ezithile. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-35, wayekade ehlanganyela nemindeni eminingi eyakha izimpilo zabo ezinkulu eKapa. Wayebona izinkanyezi zempilo ezikhanya ezindleleni, kodwa kwavela umoya wobuhlungu. "Ngempela, ngabe sizowela kwazulu, sithole amanzi amancane?" kubuza uThandi, ehlabelelayo ekukhathazekeni. Abantu beqala ukududuzela, bekhuluma ngempilo yabo, izindleko, nemfundo. Kodwa ukuthula akusiyo indlela yokuphila. Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, ubuhlungu buphawula kakhudlwana. Izinsizwa ziphakamisa izinkanyezi, zikhumbula izikhathi lapho bezijabulisa emanzini aluhlaza. "Uthando lwami, akubona abaninimabhuku," kusho uMshengu, umngane kaThandi, "ndiyazi ukuthi sithanda ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa manje amahle ayebonakala engasekho." UThandi wajabula ngokuhlukumezeka, kodwa wayefuna ukuthola indlela yokuphila. Ukuze akhe umndeni wakhe, udinga amanzi. Waqala ukuxhumana nabangane, wabafundisa ngezindlela zokulondoloza amanzi. "Thina, asiwavumele amanzi asiphume," akhaliphe, "singathanda ukuba noguquko. Kukhona amathuba amaningi." Kwathi uma sekuhamba isikhathi, uThandi wathola umphakathi udinga umhlahlandlela. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane zokulondoloza amanzi. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, abantu baqala ukufika, bezama ukufunda. Bahlangana ngokuhlanganyela, behlanganyela ngemibono, bephakamisa izixazululo. "Asibuyiseni umoya," kusho omunye, "sidinga ukuhlela inhloso ebambene." Izinyanga zedlule, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe uthole impumelelo. Abantu baqala ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi, beqala ukufaka izindlela ezifana nezigubungela umsebenzi wokuhlanzeka, ukugwema ukuchitha amanzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, kwathuthukisa umoya omuhle phakathi kwabantu. "UThandi, ubungaguqula kanjani impilo yethu?" kubuza umama odabukile. "Ngokubambisana, sizokwenziwa," kuphendula. Kodwa izinsuku zashintsha, futhi uDay Zero wawusondela. Abantu baqala ukukhathazeka, bephosa izinsolo ezikhaliphile. UThandi wayesezandleni ezinzima, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kumele aqhubeke. Waqhubeka efundisa, eqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. "Thina sonke, sikhona emanzini. Asithini, asihambisani," kusho uMshengu ngesikhathi ebona umoya ophakamayo. Ngempela, uThandi wabona abantu bebandakanya imizamo, bephokophela endaweni ethile. Lokhu kwavumela umphakathi ukuba ube nobumbano, nempilo yahluka. UDay Zero waba yisifundo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ndawonye, ngisho nasemanzini, uma besebenza ndawonye. Uyazi ukuthi yize izinsuku zihlala zikhona, umoya wokubambisana uzohlala uqhubeka. UThandi, umama onothando, uphumelelisile. Uday Zero wawungaphenduli nje, kodwa waba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi wayazi ukuthi ngothando, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda, abantu bangaqhubeka. "Ngiyakhumbula izinkanyezi, kodwa manje sinothando neziqu," kusho uThandi. "Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili." Ngaleso sikhathi, uKapa kwaba yidolobha elikhanye kahle, elithokozisayo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. UThandi wabona abantu bejabulile, besebenzisa amanzi kakhudlwana, ngoba bazi ukuthi ubudlelwano nabanye bukhulu kunazo zonke. Ngakho, umoya wokubambisana waqhubeka, uKapa waba yinkanyezi enkulu echaza umhlaba. Lena indaba kaThandi, umama onjengempela, ophumelela ekulondolozeni umphakathi, uday Zero waba yisifundo sokuthi izimo ezinzima zingakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola umoya ophilayo phakathi kwabantu, bejabulile, bezama ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinsolo zenkohlakalo ezikhuluma ngamakomidi omasipala zihlala ziba yinkinga enkulu emphakathini, zikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu obuhambisana nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde umthelela wezinsolo zenkohlakalo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulungiswe lezi zinkinga. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde izinsolo ezivame ukuvela. Emasipala amaningi, izinsolo zenkohlakalo zifaka ukungathembeki emalini, ukufaka izinkampani ezingekho emthethweni ezinkonzweni zomphakathi, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwemithombo yomphakathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokungabikhona kokuhlola okwakha ukungathembeki phakathi kwabaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi. Uma umphakathi ungakuboni ukuthi imali yawo isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, lokho kudala ukungabaza nokungathembeki. Okwesibili, imiphumela yezinsolo zenkohlakalo ibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baphule umthetho, baphule imithetho yokuphatha, futhi kube nomthelela omubi ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukungathembeki kuholela ekunciphiseni kwenhlalakahle yomphakathi, njengoba izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthutha zingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nankinga emphakathini, okuholela ekwandeni kweziphithiphithi, ukungaboni ngaso linye, kanye nokuphakama kwezinga lokuphila eliphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsolo zenkohlakalo zenza kube nzima ukufaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma abantu benokungabaza ngezinhlelo ezithile, bazokwenza kube nzima ukuhlela nokuphumelelisa izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuthuthukiswa komnotho, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo azikaze zibe yisixazululo. Kunezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinsolo. Uhulumeni kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kufanele zisebenzise izinhlelo zokuhlola eziphumelelayo, ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yokuphatha iyahlolwa njalo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu, futhi kubenze bakhuthazeke ekutheni baphathe izinsiza zomphakathi ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele ubambe iqhaza ekulawuleni izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, enezinhlelo zokubika izinsolo zenkohlakalo, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela izinsolo zenkohlakalo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazithola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Uhulumeni, izinkampani zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abantu baziqhenya ngemiphakathi yabo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukugxila ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo komasipala. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukulwa nokungathembeki, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umphakathi onempilo ubonisa ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa kahle, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuphatha kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu sonke.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Ukusebenza Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Komphakathi Isingeniso Ukuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula. Le dokhumenti ihlola izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi, izinjongo zazo, kanye nezindlela ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nokuphepha ezindaweni zethu. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Izinjongo Zokusebenza Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha 1. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zomphakathi ziphephile, kunciphisa izigameko zobugebengu, futhi kuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabantu. 2. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphepha ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. 3. Ukuqwashisa Ngobungozi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezinsiza zokufundisa abantu ngezingozi ezikhona nezindlela zokuzivikela. 4. Ukwandisa Ukubambisana: Ukuhlanganisa izakhamuzi ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha komphakathi, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuqinile. Izindlela Zokusebenza 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinkundla Zokuxhumana: Ukusungula izinkundla ezivumela izakhamuzi ukuba zabelane ngemininingwane, izinkinga, nezixazululo ezithinta ukuphepha. 2. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphepha nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. 3. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezikhona, ukuhlaziya izigameko ezedlule, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. 4. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha: Ukusebenzisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, amaphoyisa, kanye nezinye izikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Ukubandakanywa Kwezizinda Zomphakathi Ukubandakanywa kwezizinda zomphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni izinkundla zokuphepha eziphumelelayo. Izakhamuzi kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha kwazo. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Izinhlelo Zokubambisana: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokubambisana phakathi kwezizinda nezakhamuzi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. 2. Ukubamba Imihlangano: Ukuhlela imihlangano evulekile ukuze izakhamuzi ziveze imicabango yazo, izinkinga, nezixazululo. 3. Ukwakha Amathimba Okusebenza: Ukusungula amathimba ahlanganisa izakhamuzi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kube nokubambisana okuhle. Izinsiza Zokuxhasa Ukuze le nqubomgomo isebenze kahle, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinsiza Zezimali: Ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo zezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. 2. Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphepha. 3. Izinsiza Zokuqeqesha: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga Kubhalwe ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha komphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinhlelo Zokuphendula: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. 2. Ukuhlola Izimo: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo. 3. Ukwazisa Umphakathi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze izakhamuzi zazi kahle ngezinsiza zokuphepha. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwezizinda, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Le nqubomgomo ibeka izisekelo ezibalulekile zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onokuthula, futhi ophephile. Ngokusebenza ndawonye, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zethu zihlala ziphephile, futhi izakhamuzi zethu zinethemba lokuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphepha.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Isingeniso Izikhukhula zihlala ziba yinkinga enkulu ezindaweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimo zezulu ezinzima. KwaZulu-Natal, isifunda esiseNingizimu Afrika, izikhukhula ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni nasemvelweni. Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula kule ndawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezithathwa ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo. Izizathu zezikhukhula Izikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal zenzeka ngenxa yezimo eziningi. Okokuqala, izikhukhula ezivela emanzini aphakeme, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yamanzi, zenzeka kakhulu ngesikhathi sezimvula ezinzima. Izimo zezulu ezinjengokwanda kwezinga lokushisa, ukushintsha kwemikhawulo yemvula, kanye nezimo zokuhlala kwabantu zikhuthaza lezi zikhukhula. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha ezingalungile, kuholela ekwandeni kwezikhukhula. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanzi ahlale engaphumeleli, okwenza kube lula ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeke. Imiphumela yezikhukhula Imiphumela yezikhukhula ibalulekile futhi ibanzi. Ngokomnotho, izikhukhula zibhubhisa izakhiwo, zishiye abantu bengenamakhaya, futhi zinciphisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemithombo yokuphila kwabantu, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezisemqoka, okuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuhamba nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokwengqondo, izikhukhula zishiya abantu bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukulahlekelwa kwemindeni, izimpahla, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala kudala ukucindezeleka, ukwesaba, nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo. Izindlela zokuphendula Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona ezindaweni eziphephile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngezingozi, izindlela zokuzivikela, kanye nezindlela zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukudla, nezinsiza zokwelapha kubantu abathintekayo. Ukuze kube nokuphendula okuphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula. Izikhukhula zinezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nomphakathi, umnotho, kanye nezimo zempilo. Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphendula, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza, kanye nokufundisa umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukunciphisa umonakalo owenziwa izikhukhula, sithuthukise impilo yabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zethu ziphephile. Izinsiza Zokufunda 1. Department of Water and Sanitation. (2022). Flood Management in South Africa: A Guide for Local Authorities. 2. South African Weather Service. (2021). Climate Change and Its Impact on Flooding in KwaZulu-Natal. 3. National Disaster Management Centre. (2020). Disaster Management Framework for South Africa. Lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kahle izimo ezithinta izikhukhula, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezithathwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wazo.
Izinqubo zamacala amakhulu enkohlakalo Izenzo zokukhwabanisa, noma enkohlakalweni, ziqukethe izenzo eziyingozi ezithinta impilo yomphakathi nezomnotho. Amacala amakhulu enkohlakalo avame ukwenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengezikhungo zikamasipala, ezinkampanini ezinkulu, kanye nasezikhungweni zikGovernment. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinqubo, kufanele sihlole ukuthi yiziphi lezi zinyathelo ezithathwa ekuhloleni nasekuphenduleni amacala enkohlakalo. 1. Ukuthola Ubufakazi Inqubo yokuqala yokubhekana namacala enkohlakalo iwukuthola ubufakazi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqoqa imininingwane ebalulekile efanele ukuphikisana noma ukusekela icala. Ubufakazi bungahlanganisa imibhalo, ubufakazi bokuqonda, nezinsizwa ezikhuluma ngemicimbi eyenzeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphenyisi baqoqe ubufakazi obuqinile ukuze bahlolisise ngokucophelela. 2. Ukuhlola Ubufakazi Ngemuva kokuthola ubufakazi, abaphenyisi bahlola le mibhalo ukuze bazi ukuthi iyasebenza yini. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izincwadi zomthetho, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuhlola ubufakazi kudinga ubuchule obukhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlala benokuthula. 3. Ukuqhamuka Kwezinsolo Uma ubufakazi buphakanyisiwe, abaphenyisi baphawula izinsolo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kubhalwe phansi ukuthi yiziphi izenzo zokukhwabanisa ezenziwe. Izinsolo zingase zibe ezinzima, njengezokukhwabanisa imali, noma ezingase zibe lula, njengezokwephula imithetho ethile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinsolo zibhaliwe ngokucacile ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi. 4. Ukuhlola amaNhlangano Ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kwezinsolo, abaphenyisi bahlola amaNhlangano ahilelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinkampani, izikhungo zikamasipala, noma abantu abathintekayo. Ukuhlola lezi zindawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuyaziwa kanjani ukuhamba kwemali nokuthi ngabe abathintekayo bahlala bephila ngokuhambisana nemithetho. 5. Ukuxhumana Nezinkantolo Uma ubufakazi buqinisekisiwe, abaphenyisi bangakhetha ukuhambisa icala ezinkantolo. Lokhu kusebenza njengesinyathelo sokugcina lapho abaphenyisi bebona ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlola iyafaneleka. Ezinkantolo, abezomthetho bazokwazi ukuveza izinsolo eziphakanyisiwe futhi bayephula izinkantolo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abathintekayo bayabuzwa. 6. Izigwebo Nezinqumo Njengoba icala lihamba phambili ezinkantolo, izigwebo zingakhishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphenyisi, abavela ezinkampanini, nabameli bahlale beqaphele izinqumo ezithathwayo. Izinkantolo zingase zikhupha izigwebo ezinzima, njengezijeziso, noma zicacise ukuthi abathintekayo akufanele bahlawulwe. 7. Ukuqinisekisa Ukuthula Komphakathi Ngemva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ukuthula. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezakhamuzi, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi amacala ayahlolwa futhi abathintekayo bayahlawulwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumphakathi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela ubulungiswa. 8. Ukufunda Nokusungula Izinyathelo Eziphumelelayo Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwemisebenzi, kubalulekile ukufunda eziphethweni ezitholakele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukucabanga ngezinyathelo ezithathwayo ekuphathweni kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwezinhlangano, nokubhekelela izinqubo zomthetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nekohlakalo zisebenza, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zisetshenziswe ekuphathweni kwezinhlangano ezithintekayo. 9. Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezinsiza Ukubhekana namacala enkohlakalo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlangano ezihlanganyela, ezifana nohulumeni, ezokuphepha, nezinkampani zomthetho. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza kubalulekile ukuze kuzuzwe imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amacala ahlolwa kahle. 10. Umphakathi Wokuphila Ngaphandle Kwenkohlakalo Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi uqonde kahle ukuthi ukulwa nekohlakalo akuwona umthwalo kuphela wababusi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke. Ukuqwashisa ngezinto ezimbi zokukhwabanisa, ukufundisa izakhamuzi ngamalungelo azo, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, kuzosiza ekunciphiseni izinga lenkohlakalo. Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinyathelo ezingama-10 zikhombisa indlela yokubhekana namacala amakhulu enkohlakalo. Kuhlala kubalulekile ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela iphakanyiswa, izinsolo ziphathwa ngendlela efanele, futhi umphakathi uthola ukuthula. Ngalolu hlelo, singaba nokwazi kahle ukuthi sihamba kanjani phambili ekulweni nalesi sifo sokukhwabanisa esibucayi.
Ngiyavuma, lokhu kuhle! Ngizokhuluma ngendaba ye-Jacob Zuma, le ndoda engakaze ibaleke ezindabeni. Manje, njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokushushiswa, kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi yini eyenzeka. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uZuma usanda kube khona ezinkantolo? Yebo, ngempela, izinsuku zempilo yakhe zishintshile kakhulu. Ngempela, abantu abaningi bahlala bekhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokushushiswa. Kukhona abathi lokhu kuhle, abanye bathi akuhambisani nokufanele. Ngabe ubona ukuthi abantu bahluke kanjani ngezimo zabo? Ngithanda ukucabanga ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ubuye waba nesikhathi eside esebenzisa amandla akhe, kodwa manje ubhekene nezigameko ezinzima. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhamba phambili? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola uZuma, ngempela. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi uZuma usephenduke izinkanyezi ezimnyama, kodwa abanye bathi lezi zinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu bahluke kakhulu ngezindlela abazibona ngazo. UZuma, ngempela, ungumuntu oneminyaka eminingi, futhi ube neqhaza elikhulu kwezombusazwe. Kodwa, ngabe lokhu kuzomthokozisa noma kuzomshiya edolobheni? Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinqumo zakhe zikhona? Kukhona abathi uZuma akazange abone ukuthi izenzo zakhe zinezithelo ezimbi. Lokhu kuhlola izimo zomphakathi, ngempela, kuyinto engathokozisi. Kukhona abanye abathi uZuma kufanele abe nesibopho, kanti abanye bathi akufanele kube njalo. Ngicabanga ukuthi lezi zinsuku zikaZuma zikhombisa ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokufunda, hhayi kuphela kuye, kodwa nakwabanye. UZuma ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, futhi kufanele kube nesizathu sokuthi abanye bahlale bemkhumbula. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi uZuma uzokwazi ukufaka isandla emiphakathini? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola izimo ezinzima. Abantu bahlala bekhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, futhi uZuma ungumuntu ophakathi kwazo zonke lezi zindaba. Kukhona abanye abathi kufanele kube nezinqumo ezinzima, kodwa abanye bathi akukhona. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkantolo zihlala zikhona? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola ukuthi uZuma uzokwazi kanjani ukuphuma kulolu shintsho. Ngabe uzokwazi ukuthola ithuba lokuziphendulela? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu bahlala befuna izimpendulo. Ngiyavuma, le ndaba ibalulekile, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngakho. Kukhona abathi uZuma kufanele abhekane nezinselelo, kanti abanye bathi akufanele kube njalo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu bahluke kakhulu, futhi lokhu kuhlola izimo zomphakathi. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi uZuma uzokwazi ukuhamba phambili? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola izimo ezinzima. UZuma ungumuntu oneminyaka eminingi, futhi ube neqhaza elikhulu kwezombusazwe.
