Kodwa, ngabe lokhu kuzomthokozisa noma kuzomshiya edolobheni? Ngiyabonga ngokukhuluma ngale ndaba, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizoba nezinye izingxoxo ezinjalo. Ngabe uneminye imibuzo?
Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Kwakungokwesibili ekuseni, uNandi wayevuka ekuseni, ehlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima. Umama wakhe, uGogo, wayengaphilile kahle, enezimpawu ezinzima zokugula. U-Nandi wayezama ukuthola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, kodwa wayazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku, izibhedlela zazihlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi. U-Nandi wahamba waya esibhedlela esiseduzane, enethemba lokuthi kuzotholakala imithi edingekayo. Lapho efika, wathola umphakathi omkhulu abantu abahlala bezilindele. Abanye babebonakala bephoxekile, abanye bephuza amanzi, bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. U-Nandi wathola umgibeli, umphakathi ubonakala ungenamandla, uthwele izinkinga ezinzima. "Ngiyaxolisa, kodwa imithi ayitholakali," kusho udokotela omncane, ebuka uNandi ngamehlo anokukhathazeka. "Sizama konke okusemandleni ethu, kodwa imithombo yethu iphelile." U-Nandi waphendula, "Kodwa kungani? Kungani umphakathi wethu ungatholi imithi edingekayo? U-Gogo udinga imithi yokwelapha." "Ngiyazi, kodwa izinkinga ezinkulu zikhona. Ukushoda kwemali, izinkinga zokuhlinzeka, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima," kuchaza udokotela. U-Nandi waphuma esibhedlela, enezinyembezi emehlweni akhe. Wayazi ukuthi uGogo wayengakwazi ukulinda. Wazi ukuthi kufanele athole indlela yokusiza, noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi wanquma ukuhamba edolobheni elikhulu eliseduzane, lapho kuthiwa khona imithi iyatholakala. Waqala uhambo lwakhe, emoyizela izinyathelo zakhe. Wafika edolobheni, kodwa wathola ukuthi imithi ibiza kakhulu. U-Nandi wayengenamali eyanele, futhi lokhu kumshiya edidekile. Ngemva kokuhlala edolobheni, wahlangana noSizwe, umngane wakhe owayesebenza ezibhedlela. USizwe waphendula, "Nandi, ngiyazi ukuthi kudinga imithi, kodwa kufanele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Akukhona nje ukushoda kwemithi, kodwa kudinga ukuba sikhulume ngempilo yethu, nendlela yokwenza izibhedlela zisebenze kangcono." U-Nandi wathola umqondo omusha. Wavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezinkulu ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Bahlangana nabanye abantu bendawo, benza umhlangano wokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. Baphakamisa iziphakamiso, bafuna ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emisha ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uNandi wabona ukuthi abantu bezibhedlela bakhuluma kakhulu. Bahamba besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngemithi, basebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokubambisana. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abantu bezwe bahlala bejolile, bephokophelela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uGogo wathola imithi edingekayo. U-Nandi waba nomuzwa wokwaneliseka, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye abantu bekuyindlela yokuthola izixazululo. Wazi ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi akukhona kuphela, kodwa kuyinselele yokwakha umphakathi onamandla. U-Nandi waphinde waphuma esibhedlela, kodwa manje wayenokholo. Wayazi ukuthi imizamo yabo yayizokwenza umehluko. Ukushoda kwemithi kwakuyinselele, kodwa ubuhlakani, ubumbano, nokusebenza ngokubambisana kwakuwumgomo omuhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi wayeqonda ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi imithi iyisixazululo, kodwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bayo yinto ebaluleke kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibhedlela zathola ukwesekwa, zathuthukiswa, futhi zaba nezinsiza ezinhle. U-Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangathola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uGogo waphila kahle, futhi uNandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba nzima, ubumbano lungavula izindlela eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba namandla, futhi izibhedlela zathola imithi eyanele. U-Nandi wayejabule, ngoba wayazi ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bayo bukhulu kakhulu. Kwakungesikhathi sokuphila, futhi uNandi wayezimisele ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze akhe umphakathi ophilayo.
Uphenyo Lokuvuza Kwamaphepha Kamatikuletsheni Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kubhekisela ekuveleni kolwazi oluyimfihlo lwemali, ibhizinisi, noma imininingwane yomuntu siqu ethunyelwa noma ikhululwa ngaphandle kwemvume. Lokhu kwenzeka kakhulu ezinkampanini, lapho izimfihlo zomkhiqizo, izinkontileka, noma izinqubomgomo zenzeka ukuba zivele emphakathini, okubangela ukubaluleka kwalesi sifo. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kungadalwa izizathu eziningi, ezifana nokungagcini kahle izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, ukwephula umthetho wabasebenzi, ubuchwepheshe obuphukile, noma ubudlelwane bobungozi phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase baveze imininingwane ngenxa yokubusa kwamafilosofi ahlukene noma ukufuna ukusiza abanye. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izingozi zokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Izingozi zokuvuza zingaba ziningi kakhulu. Okokuqala, kungase kubangele ukulahleka kokwethembeka kwezimali noma izinkampani, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwamakhasimende. Okwesibili, izinkampani zingaba nezingqinamba zomthetho, njengokubhalelwa amacala okubhayiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle ezimpilweni zabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ehambisana nezokuphepha kube khona. Umbuzo 4: Yini okungaqhathaniswa nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abasebenzi ngokubaluleka kokugcina izimfihlo, ukuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela, njengokufaka amakhodi okungena, ukuhlola ukuphathwa kwesistimu, nokuphatha ngokuphepha amafayela anemininingwane ebalulekile. Umbuzo 5: Yini umthelela wokuqhamuka kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni emhlabeni wonke? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni akugcini nje kuphela endaweni ethile, kepha kuthinta abantu emhlabeni wonke. Imininingwane ethunyelwa ngaphandle ingase ibangele ukungathembeki phakathi kwezinkampani, kuthumele imibuzo mayelana nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zemali, futhi kudale ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kumakhasimende. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezinkampanini ezinkulu, lapho ukuphathwa kwemali kudinga ukuqashelwa okukhulu. Umbuzo 6: Ziyini izinyathelo okumele zithathwe uma ukuvuza kwenzeka? Impendulo: Uma ukuvuza kwenzeka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezisheshayo zokubhekana nakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza abathintekayo, ukuvula uphenyo olunembile, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zihlanzwe. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukulawula lezi zinkinga, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluccelayo futhi ziqikelele ukusiza abathintekayo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izibonelo ezidumile zokuvuza kwamaphepha? Impendulo: Kunezibonelo eziningi ezidumile zokuvuza, njenge-Whistleblower Edward Snowden, owavula imininingwane eyimfihlo ye-NSA ngendlela eyahluka kakhulu ekukhulumeni ngedijithali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezinjenge-Wikileaks zaveza amaphepha amaningi akhombe izinqubo ezizimele, okwakuholela ekwenzeni izinguquko eziningi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuzwakalisa indima enkulu yokukhuluma kwempilo elula emphakathini. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi ngalezi zindaba? Impendulo: Kulula ukuba abantu bakhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwasemphakathini luyisibopho, futhi kunomthelela empilweni yabo. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zindaba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi izingozi ezihambisana nokungena kwemali nokuhlala kusesimweni sokuvikela izimfihlo zabo. Lokhu kungalawula izingozi zokuphazamiseka kwezimali noma ukulahlekelwa ukufaka izinhlelo ezithile kumasiko. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana nokuvuza? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezisemthethweni zokubhekana nokuvuza, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa abaqondisi abahlola ukuphepha kwedatha, izinhlelo zokubikela ukuvuza, nakho konke okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ukuphatha izinkinga ezithile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zigcina izimfihlo zazo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 10: Yini okwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okusezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphepha. Ukuze ukuqina kokukhethwa kwezokuphepha, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise uhlaka lwezobuchwepheshe olwakhiwe, kanjalo nezinhlelo zemvelo zokugcina ukuzwelana nesikhungo sabo. Isiphetho: Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luyisihloko esibalulekile emkhakheni wezokuphepha, okudinga ukuqonda okujule nokusebenza okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikeleke imininingwane eyimfihlo. Izinkampani nezinhlaka kufanele ziqhubeke nokwakha izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ukuvuza akwenzeki, futhi uma kwenzeka, kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nakho. Kulokhu, abantu bangenza izinqumo eziphusile futhi bazidalela ikusasa eliqinile.
Amaphrojekthi Okubhekana Nokuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Ukuhlaziywa Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuyinkinga enkulu ebhekene nomhlaba namuhla. Izinguquko ezinzima ezimweni zokukhanya, izikhukhula, nemisebenzi yamandla kagesi kuhlobene ngqo nokwanda kwezinga lokushisa emhlabeni. Amaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene abhekene nale nkinga aqhuba izindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nalesi simo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu. 1. Amaphrojekthi Okulima Ahlakaniphile Olunye lwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu kubalulekile amaphrojekthi okugcina ukwakheka kokulima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ezifana nezigaba ezilungisiwe zokulima, izinyathelo zokulima ezilungiselelwe izimo zezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokulima ezisekelwe kumadivayisi e-teknoloji. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zindlela, abalimi bangakwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezimo ezimbi zezulu futhi bathole imiphumela engcono ekukhiqizeni. 2. Amaphrojekthi Wokuphathwa Kwamanzi Ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni imithombo yamanzi. Ngaphansi kwemizamo yokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, amaphrojekthi okuphathwa kwamanzi afaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokugcina amanzi, izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Lokhu kunciphisa izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi ezivela ezikhukhulweni nasekufuneni okukhulayo kwemithombo yamanzi. 3. Amaphrojekthi Wokwakha Izindawo Ezizinzile Izinhlelo zokwakha izindawo ezinokuzinza ziqhubeka zikhula, zifaka phakathi amaphrojekthi okwakha izakhiwo ezihlakaniphile nezisebenzisa amandla avuselelwe. Lezi zindawo ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle, zinciphisa imithelela emibi yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kanye nokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelwe. Iziqu zezakhiwo ezinjalo zihlanganisa izindonga ezihlakaniphile, amapaneli elanga, nezinhlelo zokugcina ukushisa. 4. Amaphrojekthi Wokunciphisa Ukungcoliswa Ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Amathuba amaningi ako amaphrojekthi okunciphisa ukungcoliswa, njengokwenza imoto zisebenze kahle, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo esebenzisa amandla avuselelwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphinde zisetshenziswe izinto ezikhishwe. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo eluhlaza futhi zinciphisa imithelela emibi yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. 5. Amaphrojekthi Wokwakha Ulwazi Nokuqwashisa Ukuze abantu baqonde kangcono imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, amaphrojekthi okwakha ulwazi nokwazisa abantu baphakathi kokubaluleka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokufundisa, imihlangano yokwabelelana ngolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezinguqukweni zesimo sezulu, kubalulekile ukuthi baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalokhu futhi bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele. 6. Amaphrojekthi Wokubambisana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Izinkinga ezihlobene nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu azikwazi ukuxazululwa kalula yizizwe ngamunye. Ngakho, amaphrojekthi okuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe ahlukahlukene abamba iqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yezenhlalakahle, izivumelwano zokuhlanganyela, kanye nemikhankaso yokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukuhlangana kwamazwe kunikeza ithuba lokubambisana ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibhekene nomhlaba jikelele. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi okubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu abalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kumiphakathi eminingi. Ngamaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene, sifunda ukuthi singawavikela kanjani amandla ethu, sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokuphila, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu baphakathi komphakathi baqonde futhi babe neqhaza ekunciphiseni imithelela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuze sihlanganise izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, nolwazi ukuze siphumelele kulolu shintsho olukhulu. Njengoba siqhubeka kuphela ngama-aphrojekthi anjengalezi, sizoba nethuba elingcono lokwakha umhlaba ongcono, onobungane, futhi ozinzile.
Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity kumasipala: Ukukhula kwezingozi ezikhathazayo Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi esishintshashintshayo se-cybersecurity, kumasipala kukhona izinsongo ezikhulayo eziyingozi. Izehlakalo ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuvulwa kwezinhlelo, kanye nokwephulwa kwedatha, zibonisa ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuvikela imininingwane yawo. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekuvikeleni imininingwane yomuntu, kodwa futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu nomasipala. Njengoba i-inthanethi ikhula, izinkampani ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi zikhula futhi, lokhu kusiza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsongo ezinkulu. Umasipala unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina imininingwane ebalulekile, efana nezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Uma le datha ingaphathwa kahle, ingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengokwephulwa kwedatha okungase kubangele ukulimala kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umasipala ube necebo eliqinile lokuphatha izingozi ze-cyber. Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity ziveza izinselelo ezithile, kodwa zihlola ubuthakathaka obukhulu ezinsizweni ezitholakalayo kumasipala. Ngokwesibonelo, umsipha waseBaltimore, e-United States, ubhekane nezinhlekelele ezinkulu eziholele ekulimaleni kwemali, izinsizakalo, nezinsiza. Ukuhlasela kwe-cyber okuvela kubahlaseli, kwenze kwaba neziphumo ezinkulu emsebenzini wamasipala, kwaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukwakha amasu aqinile okuvikela amakhompiyutha nezinhlelo zawo. Ngokwenyanga, imizamo yokuvikela i-cybersecurity kufanele ibandakanye ukufundisa abasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuqwashisa ngezingozi ze-cyber kanye nezindlela zokuvikela kubalulekile. Abasebenzi kufanele babe nolwazi oluqinile lokuvikela umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezifanele nezindlela zokuphatha izingozi. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kumasipala nezinkampani ezikhethekile ku-cybersecurity kuyinselelo enkulu. Umasipala ungasebenza nabantu abanolwazi, okungasiza ekuqedeni izinqubomgomo ezifanele. Umasipala kufanele futhi ube nezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela imininingwane. Lezi zinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinise izinyathelo zokuphatha, njengokubhaliswa kwemiyalezo, ukuvikelwa kwamaphasiwedi, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwemishini ye-cyber. Umasipala kufanele unakekele izinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zivikelekile. Njengoba izingozi ze-cyber ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, umphakathi kufanele ulungiselele kahle. Ukushoda kokwaziswa noma ukunakekela izinsiza zokuvikela kungabangela imiphumela emibi, hhayi kumasipala kuphela, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabantu. Ukuze umphakathi uhlale uvikelekile, kudingeka ukuba kube necebo eliqinile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izingozi ezikhona. Ngakho, umasipala kufanele uqhubeke nokwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibhekelela i-cybersecurity. Kubhalwe phansi ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nomqondo wokuvikela imisebenzi yabo, kanti umasipala kufanele ube nezehlakalo ezizokwazi ukuvikela abantu, ugcine imininingwane yabo iphephile. Njengoba sithuthuka emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, umphakathi kufanele uthuthukise izindlela zokuvikela i-cybersecurity ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwawo. Ekugcineni, i-cybersecurity kumasipala akuyona nje indaba yezenzakalo ezithile, kodwa iyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophephile. Umasipala kumele uqhubeke nokwenza izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezikhulayo, ukuvikela abantu, nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi othembele futhi ophephile, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni nasekukhuleni komphakathi.
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Isingeniso Ukucishwa kukagesi kwenzeka ngezizathu ezahlukene, kubandakanya ukuguguleka kwezinsiza, izikhala zokusebenza, noma izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kukhansela imisebenzi eminingi, ikakhulukazi emabhizinisini amancane, lapho ukuncishiswa kokusebenza kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza. Le doko ibhalwe ngenhloso yokuhlola umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi amabhizinisi angazivumelanisa kanjani nezimo ezinjalo. Umthelela Wezomnotho 1. Ukulahlekelwa Kwemali - Ukucishwa kukagesi kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu, njengoba amabhizinisi amancane evame ukuncika kumakhasimende. Uma kukhona ukuvinjelwa kokusebenza, amabhizinisi angase ahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okukhuthaza amakhasimende ukuthi abheke kwezinye izinkampani. 2. Izindleko Zokusebenza - Ukuze amabhizinisi agcine ukusebenza, kudingeka izixazululo eziphuthumayo, njengezizinda zokugcina ugesi, eziholela ezindlekweni ezengeziwe. Lokhu kungaphazamisa isabelomali samabhizinisi amancane, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. 3. Ukunciphisa Imikhiqizo Noma Izinsizakalo - Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaholela ekunciphiseni imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukuthengiswa, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina ibhizinisi. Umthelela Emisebenzini 1. Ukulahleka Kwezisebenzi - Uma amabhizinisi engakwazi ukusebenza, izisebenzi zingase zishiywe ngaphandle kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola abasebenzi abanekhono uma ibhizinisi selithola ugesi. 2. Ukunciphisa Umsebenzi - Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Abasebenzi bangase bahlale bezama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihambisana nokungasebenzi kukagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukugxila emsebenzini. 3. Ukuphazamiseka Kwezinqubo Zokusebenza - Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhomeke kukagesi, njengohlelo lokuphatha, zingase zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kungaphazamisa izinqubo zokusebenza, kuholele ekwehliseni izinga lokusebenza. Izixazululo Zokuphila Ngezimo Zokucishwa Kukagesi 1. Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza Zokugcina Ugesi - Amabhizinisi angafaka izinsiza zokugcina ugesi, njengezibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo, ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngesikhathi sokucishwa kukagesi. Lokhu kuzovumela amabhizinisi ukuba aqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo. 2. Ukuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuhlinzeka Ngogesi - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumayo, kungasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi azivumelanise nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokuqhubekayo. 3. Ukuhlela Ngaphambi Kwezimo Zokucishwa Kukagesi - Amabhizinisi kufanele ahlele izinhlelo zokuphila nezimo zokucishwa kukagesi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukuthuthukisa izinqubo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphila eziphuthumayo. Isiphetho Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emabhizinisini amancane, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukunciphisa ukusebenza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila. Nokho, amabhizinisi angathola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ukuze azivumelanise nezimo ezinjalo. Ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokugcina ugesi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nokuhlela ngaphambi kwezimo zokucishwa kukagesi, amabhizinisi angazivumelanisa nezimo ezinzima futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane aqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokuphila nezimo zokucishwa kukagesi ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi awalahlekelwa yithuba lokukhula nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yawo.
Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubone ukukhula okukhulu, okuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nokwandiswa kwezinsizakalo. Lokhu kukhula kubonakala ngokuthi izinkampani eziningi zikhulisa izikhala zazo ukuze zifeze izidingo zamakhasimende, futhi lokhu kuveza ithuba elihle lokuthola imisebenzi kubantu abaningi. I-Call centre iyindawo lapho abathengisi, abaphakeli, nabanye abasebenzi bexhumana namakhasimende ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezifana nezokuxhumana ngefoni, i-imeyili, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana. E-Ningizimu Afrika, le mboni ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu afana neGauteng, eKapa, naseThekwini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ziqaphele ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle namakhasimende kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza umkhakha wama-call centre ube nethuba lokukhula. Ngokwenyuka kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, umkhakha wama-call centre ube nokwanda kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezihlukene, okuholele ekwandeni kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kubonakala ekutheni izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ukuze ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle kwama-call centre, kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda samakhasimende, futhi kukhuphule ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre kuxhumene nokwanda kokusebenzisa izilimi eziningi. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lapho kunezilimi eziningi ezikhuluma, izinkampani ziqaphele ukuthi ukwazi ukuxhumana ngolimi lwekhasimende kubalulekile. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana kahle namakhasimende abakhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi amakhasimende abhekwa kahle, futhi kunciphisa ukukhungatheka. Ngokubheka izimo zomhlaba jikelele, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze baqhubeke nokukhula, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ziqhuba izifundo ezithuthukisayo kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephambili emkhakheni, futhi bakwazi ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Kodwa-ke, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre akuhambisani kuphela nezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ubugebengu bokuxhumana, lapho abanye abantu bezama ukukopela amakhasimende, bukhona futhi bukhathaza umkhakha. Izinkampani zidinga ukuthuthukisa izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende azizwa ephephile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhakha uhlale uphila futhi uthuthuka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika uzoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo, ziqhube izifundo ezithuthukisayo kubasebenzi, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende anelisekile. Ngokuphetha, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ithuba elikhulu lokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani namakhasimende. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha uqhubeka nokukhula, uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi uthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoba nempumelelo emnothweni, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Intuthuko Ecaleni Lokushushiswa KukaJacob Zuma Ngasese Kuyajabulisa ukubona intuthuko ethile ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma, owake waba nguMengameli weNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushushiswa, okungavumelekile, kubonisa ubuhlakani obuphakeme kanye neqhaza elikhulu elithathwe abezindaba, izinhlangano zamalungelo abantu, kanye nezakhamuzi ezijulile ezithintekayo. Kodwa-ke, kudinga ukuthi siqonde kahle izimpikiswano ezizungezile le ndaba. UJacob Zuma, owaziwa ngamaqhaza akhe afana nohlelo lwezokuhlaliswa okwakuhamba phambili, uphakathi kokucwaningwa ngesigameko esidlule. Abantu abaningi baye baba nemibono ephikisanayo ngalesi simo. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kushushiswa kuyingxenye yesikhumbuzo sokuthi uZuma, njengomholi, uphathiswe ngendlela engalungile, kanti abanye bathi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube sobala ukuze kuphumelele impilo yomphakathi. Ngokubheka emuva, kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi uZuma ubesebenza ezindabeni eziningi, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha, izinqumo ezinzima, kanye nokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi. Uhambo lwakhe olukhathazayo lwezobulungiswa lubonisa ukuthi akusikho ukusola kuphela, kodwa nokuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwa ne-corruption. Abantu bayathandazela ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwa ecaleni lakhe zibe nezinhloso ezinhle, futhi azisoze zaphuthelwa. Okunye okukhathazayo, wukuthi kulezi zinsuku zamuva, izinkantolo ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphathweni kwezobulungiswa. UZuma, ngoshintsho lwakhe, ungase abe nethonya elikhulu ekuphathweni komthetho. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile futhi ezihlakaniphe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezindaba, izikhungo zezemfundo, kanye nezakhamuzi zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ubulungiswa buza kuphela uma abantu bethi baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma ibalulekile, futhi kudinga ukuthi simemeze zonke izinyathelo ezenziwa. Kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kuzoba yisibonelo sokuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, noma ungumholi, kufanele uphathiswe ngendlela efanele. Noma ngabe uzama ukulwa nemigudu yokushushiswa, izinqumo ezithathwa kufanele zibe nemiphumela ecacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezibekwe phambili kuzo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zithinta nempilo yomphakathi. Abantu bakhathazekile ngezinga lokungathembeki okuqhubekayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo yokutakula. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubeka ingcindezi kumaphoyisa, ezinkantolo, kanye nasemphakathini, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi ubulungiswa bungenziwa ngezinga eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi uZuma uthole imikhuba eminingi ethinta izinqumo ezithathwa phambili. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu bahlala begcizelela ukuthi kungekudala bazothola ukuthi kunjani empilweni. UZuma, njengomholi, udinga ukuba abe neqhaza lokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokuthi usemthethweni, kodwa ngoba abantu banethemba kuye. Ngaphandle kokuphikisana, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwa ecaleni lakhe zikhumbula izidingo zomphakathi. Ekupheleni kosuku, abezindaba, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa busebenze ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ayigcini nje ngokuba yindaba ethokozisayo, kodwa iyisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi ubulungiswa obuphelele buphethwe ngezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile, ezihlakaniphile, futhi eziphefumulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bethu bayakwazi ukuphila impilo enobulungiswa, futhi baphile ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, kufanele siqhubeke sikhalela, sithumele imiyalezo yokuthi ubulungiswa buqhubeke, futhi sithumele umyalezo wokuthi akekho ophunyukayo. Ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma kufanele kube yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umthetho uyiNhloko yempilo yethu, futhi kufanele sibe neqiniso eliqinile lokuthi ubulungiswa buyaphumelela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, ezihloniphekile, futhi ezilungile, ukuze sonke sihlale sithokozile ngezimpilo zethu.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall, oqale ngonyaka we-2015, ube nemiphumela eminingi emikhulu ezinqolobaneni zethu, ezemfundo, nasezimpilweni zabantu abasha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengomuntu obona izinguquko emkhakheni wezemfundo, ngifuna ukwabelana ngombono wami mayelana nomthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall wawungeyena nje umholi wezidingo nezifiso zabafundi, kodwa waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantwana bethu badinga ithuba lokufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu. Lokhu kugqugquzela izwi elisha lwemibono, ngesikhathi lapho abantu bahlola izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo, ezemfundo, kanye nezomnotho. Umkhankaso ube nomthelela oqondile ezinqubweni zokufunda, njengoba izikhungo zemfundo ziphinde ziqhubele phambili izindlela ezilula zokufunda, ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nabantu abavela ezizindeni eziphansi, banethuba lokufunda. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwenhlonipho kwezobuchwepheshe, njengoba abafundi abaningi bephumelela ezikhungweni eziphezulu. Lokhu kubonakala ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa, lapho abaFundi bahlola izifundo zabo, bephumelela kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkathi zangaphambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umqondo wokuzimela phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi abavela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomphakathi baqonda ukuthi uma bebonke, bangaba namandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuqhakambisa ubudlelwane obukhulu phakathi kwabafundi, okwakha umphakathi onamandla, okwazi ukulwa nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi jikelele. Nokho, umkhankaso awudluleli nje ebuhleni; ube nemiphumela emibi nakakhulu. Ngaphezu kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabafundi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi kwaqhamuka nezinselele ezinkulu ezimbonini eziningi, njengoba abanye abafundi bebengakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuholele ekukhuleni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantu abaningana bahlala bephelelwa yithemba lokuthola imisebenzi. Noma kunjalo, umkhankaso ubuye waholela ekubeni kube nezinqumo ezinzima mayelana nezindleko zemfundo. Izikhungo zemfundo ziqalile ukuxoxa ngendlela yokuthola izimali ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bangenza izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuholele ekubeni kube nezinqumo ezinzima, kanye nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abafundi abahlwempu, okungavunywa yiphi indlela yokuphila. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuqediwe; ungomunye wemikhankaso eyisikhumbuzo sokuthi imfundo iyisisekelo sokukhula komnotho, futhi kufanele iqhutshekiswe. Abafundi bahlukumezekile, futhi umqondo wokuthi imfundo kufanele ibe mahhala kufanele uqhubeke ukuphakama. Ukuphumelela kwabafundi kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo yindawo yokwakha ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyabonakala ukuthi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onengqondo, lapho imfundo iyinsiza yokukhulisa umnotho. Abafundi, osonhlamvukazi, kanye nezinye izinhlangano kumele babambisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko eziyinqaba ziqhubeka. Ngokuphetha, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezemfundo, wokwakha umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi abahlwempu. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, umbono wokuthi imfundo kufanele ibe mahhala uyaphumelela, futhi ukhuthaza abantwana bethu ukuba baphokophele impumelelo. Umkhankaso kufanele uqhubeke, futhi sonke kufanele sizibophezele ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Izinselelo ze-Acid Mine Drainage eGauteng Ukwakhiwa kwemigodi eGauteng kuthole indawo enezinhlobonhlobo zokugcina nezimfuno zomnotho, kodwa kwaholela nasezinselelweni ezinkulu, lapho i-acid mine drainage (AMD) ingesinye sezinkinga eziphambili. I-AMD ibonakala ngokukhipha amanzi anokungcola okubangela acid, okuphuma emigodini emikhulu yokumba. Lokhu kuqhamuka ngokumayelana nokwakheka kwamaminerali, ikakhulukazi lapho uwoyela, umhlaba, nezinye izinto ziwandiswa, okwandisa ukukhululeka kwe-acid kulawa manzi. Izakhiwo Zeziqu zikaMhlaba I-Gauteng iyindawo ekhangayo yokumba amaminerali, ikakhulukazi i-gold ne-platinum. Ukumba kwezakhiwo zomhlaba kuveza ama-rainfall acids, ahlwanyela umhlaba, ahlangene nezinsiza ezithile ezifana ne-sulfides. Lapho lezi zinsiza ziguqulwa, i-sulfuric acid ikhiqizwa, okukhuthaza ukuqhathaniswa kwe-acid mine drainage. Lokhu kuthinta izindawo eziningi eziseduzane, kubangela ukonakala kwemifula, imifula, nezinsiza zamanzi. Imiphumela Emibi Imiphumela ye-AMD ibonakala kulwazi olulungile nolungahlanzeki, okuthinta imvelo, impilo yomphakathi, nezenzo zomnotho. I-acid mine drainage ibangela ukushoda kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo, okwandisa izinga le-acid emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila kwezinto eziphilayo ezisondelene. Imininingwane iyakhombisa ukuthi, lapho i-phosphate ne-nitrate ziphathwa ngamandla, i-AMD ingabhekana nezibalo eziningi zezimali ezingabalulekile ezindaweni ezikhatheleyo. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni izitshalo zihlale zibuthakathaka, futhi kwezimbobo ezithile, imiphumela ibangela ukungcoliswa okungapheli kwezinhlaka zemvelo. Izinkinga Zokuphatha Amanzi Ukubhekana ne-AMD kudinga izindlela ezibucayi zokuphatha amanzi. Ukulawula amanzi angcoliswe yi-acid kudinga izinqumo eziqondile zokuhlanzeka. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lamazinga amanzi, izinhlelo zokuqinisa izinsiza zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Nokho, izigaba zikahulumeni azilungile, futhi lapho izinsiza ezinokwenzeka zikhona, zikhona izithiyo zokwenza ikusasa eliqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo eziqinile, ezingafaka izigaba zokuhlola, ukugcina izimpahla, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabavikelayo bemvelo nezokuphepha. Izinhlaka Ezakhiwe Zokulawula Izincwadi zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika zikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, njengoba umthetho wezokuphila komuntu udinga ukuba ubhekele ezokuhlala komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ukuba khona kwezindlela zokukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabavikelayo bemvelo, abakwaMnyango wezamaMali, nezinkampani ezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukwakha imigudu esatyhidwa yokuvikela ama-acid mine drainage, kanye nezindlela zokuphelezela nezinyathelo ezithinta imiphakathi yendawo. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuze kuqedwe i-AMD, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele ziqhutshekwe. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Ukuqwashisa: Umphakathi kufanele uqwashiswe ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze abantwana nezizukulwane ezizayo bazi ngemiphumela emibi. 2. Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokuphepha: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha amanzi, ngokwelula izinsiza zomphakathi kuma-pipeline ahlanzekile. 3. Ubumba Nezifundo: Ukuhlanganyela ngezifundo ezithinta imiphakathi, eziqinisekisa ukuzazi kahle kwezemvelo. 4. Ubambiswano: Ukubambisana phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni, abahlali, kanye nezinkampani ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga. Isiphetho Izinselelo ze-acid mine drainage eGauteng zithinta kakhulu ukuphila kwezilwane, izitshalo, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuze kube nezindlela ezinempilo zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqondwe nezinqwaba ezivikelekile. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziqinile ezicacisa izinyathelo, imihlahlandlela, nezinhlelo zokuhlola kuzobaluleka ekuqedeni lezi zinkinga. Ngakho, impikiswano mayelana nezinsiza ezinamathiselwe emithonjeni yamanzi iyoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo eGauteng. Lokhu kuzokwandisa izimo zempilo, izinhlelo zomnotho, kanye nezinselelo ezizayo zokugcina izinsiza.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi 1. Isingeniso Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo futhi ophephile. Le dokhumenti ibonisa indlela ezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi okufanele zisebenze ngayo, zifaka izinyathelo ezidingekayo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze umphakathi uthole imiphumela emihle ezinkundleni zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo baqonde imithetho nezindlela ezisemthethweni ezithinta lezi zinkundla. 2. Uhlaka lomsebenzi wezinkundla zokuphepha Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zifaka amaphoyisa, izinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo, izikhungo zokwelashwa, kanye neminyango yokuphatha. Ukuze zikhulise imiphumela, kumele kube nohlu lwezicwangciso ezihlukene: - Ukuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokuhlangenwe nakho kolwazi phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi kudlulelwe imininingwane mayelana nezingozi, izigameko, nezimo eziphuthumayo. - Ukuhlolwa kwezingozi: Izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele ziqhube ukuhlolwa okuvamile kwezingozi ukuze kubonakale izindawo ezidinga ukugxilwa. - Ukuqeqeshwa: Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukuvikela, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuphendula, ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. 3. Ukuhlela Izinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle imisebenzi: - Ukumisa izinqubo ezicacile: Kumele kube nokuhlela okuhambisanayo kwezinkundla zokuphepha, okuhlanganisa izinqubo ezicacile zokuthi okufanele kwenziwe ezingozini ezithile. - Ukufuna nokubamba izithangami: Izithangami zibalulekile ekwabeleni ulwazi emiphakathini, ukuze wonke umuntu azi ngemithetho nemigomo. 4. Ukusebenza Ngokubambisana Kubhalwe ukuthi izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezizimele ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi, izifunda nezikole. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amazinga omphakathi abamba iqhaza ekwakheni indawo ephephile. - Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zomphakathi: Izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele zikhuthaze uxhumano nemiphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela imihlangano, imicimbi, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. - Izinhlelo Zokuthumela Ubufakazi Boukuphumelela: Kubalulekile ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha ukuze kunqandwe izinkinga. 5. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Izinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zihlolwe futhi zibuyekezwe ngezikhathi ezithile: - Izibalo Zokuphepha: Ukuqoqwa kwezibalo zokuphepha kusiza ekutholeni izindawo ezidinga ukunaka. - Ukuhlola Imiphumela: Uhlolojikelele lwemiphumela yezenzo kufanele lwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha. 6. Izinsizakalo Zokuphuthumayo Izinsiza zokuphuthumayo zibalulekile ukuze ziphendule ezimeni eziphuthumayo: - Ithimba Lokuphendula Eziphuthumayo: Ithimba eliqeqeshiwe kumele liqondise izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo. - Izinsiza Zokuphila Nezokwelapha: Kubalulekile ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifakwe ezinkundleni zokuphepha ukuze zibhekele izingozi. 7. Ukuphetha Ngamafuphi, ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukubambisana, ukuhlela kahle, nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Imiyalelo ethile kufanele ilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka komphakathi. Ukuze kuqhubeke kahle, izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zihlolwe futhi zibuyekezwe njalo, ukuze zihlale zikhathalela izidingo zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwezinkundla zokuphepha kumphakathi kuncike enhlosweni yokudlulisela umphakathi osekela, ophumelelayo, nezinhlelo ezisunguliwe phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuqhubekela phambili, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuphuma ezinkingeni futhi ube yindawo ephephile, ezinokuthula nemibono emisha.
Inqubekela phambili ye-Operation Vulindlela Operation Vulindlela, ehlanganisa izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ibonisa inqubekela phambili ebalulekile emizamweni yokukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Le msebenzi, eqale ngonyaka ka-2020, ibheke ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula komnotho, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuhlupheka okubangelwe yiCOVID-19. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise izimpumelelo eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokwakha izinsiza ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, amanzi, kanye nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokusebenza ezizokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekwakheni umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuphatha. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, uhulumeni usebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukufaka izicelo zezinsiza ezithile. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokwaziswa nokwaziswa kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokufunda. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, uhulumeni usebenzise izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banamakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini, okwandisa amathuba okukhula komnotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile eMpumalanga Kapa, lapho abahlanganyeli behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngempilo yengqalasizinda yezibhedlela kulesi sifunda. Lo mcimbi waba nezinhlaka ezahlukene zabantu, kuhlanganisa ohulumeni, izodokotela, abaphathi bezibhedlela, kanye nemiphakathi, bonke bejolisa ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezikhungethe imitholampilo. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinkinga ezikhona, kube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo ezikhombisa izinselelo ezihambisana nezibhedlela, njengezinkinga zezimali, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Kukhona umbono ovamile wokuthi izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zihlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima ezenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezidingekayo ngempela. Esigabeni sokuqala somcimbi, kudalwe inkulumo-mpikiswano phakathi kwabamele izibhedlela ezahlukene, lapho bakhombisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nezinkinga zengqalasizinda. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi lezi zibhedlela zidinga ukusekelwa okuningi ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ukuhluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, njengokwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kwaba yinkinga enkulu eboniswe ngababambe iqhaza. Okwengeziwe, umcimbi ubeke emphasis ekubhekaneni nezidingo zamakhasimende. Abantu abahlala eMpumalanga Kapa baveze ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngempilo yabo ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yezibhedlela, ukuze abantu bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, ngesikhathi esifanele. Abaholi bezinhlaka ezahlukene baphinde basebenzise leli thuba ukukhipha iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda. Kwakukhuluma ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha iziguli, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo. Abaholi baphinde bagcizelela isidingo sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezibhedlela nemiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabantu ziyaziwa futhi ziyaqondiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi waba nezingxoxo ezinzulu mayelana nezinto ezithinta izibhedlela, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo phakathi kwezibhedlela namakhasimende. Kunomqondo ophakanyisiwe wokuthi izibhedlela kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola ulwazi olufanele nolwakha ithemba, kusukela ekufikeni kwazo ezibhedlweni kuze kube sekuphathweni kwazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nezingxoxo ezithinta izixazululo ezitholakalayo, ezinjengezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela. Lezi zinhlelo zingasiza ekwabeleni izinsiza, ukuze izibhedlela ezincane zikwazi ukuthola ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezithile, ngaleyo ndlela zithuthukise izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umcimbi ugcine ngokuba nomhlangano wokubuyekeza, lapho abahlanganyeli benza isifinyezo sezinkinga ezikhuluma ngazo. Ngemuva kokuthi bekwazile ukuxoxa, kwavela iziphakamiso ezithile ezisheshayo nezizokwaziwa, ukuze kuncishiswe izinkinga ezintsha ezithinta ingqalasizinda yezibhedlela. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, umphakathi uyalwela ukuthuthukisa impilo yezakhamizi, futhi abaholi bayazimisela ukusebenzela izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kwazise, lo mcimbi ubonise ubunzima bokuphathwa kwezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa, kodwa futhi wagcizelela ithuba lokubambisana kwezinhlelo ezahlukene. Umphakathi ubonakale uzimisele ukuxhasa izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa ingqalasizinda, okuqinisa ithemba lokuthi iziguli zizothola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngemva kokuba lo mcimbi usuphelile, abahlanganyeli bathole umuzwa oqinile wokuthi kunezinyathelo ezahlukahlukene ezifunekayo ukuze kuzuzwe umgomo wezempilo ophumelelayo eMpumalanga Kapa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi uphumelele ekubambiseni izandla, ukuze uqhubeke uthuthukisa isimo sezibhedlela, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokunakekelwa kwezempilo eMpumalanga Kapa.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV Licence ye-SABC Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wahlangana emcimbini obalulekile owayenzelwe ukuxoxa ngezimpikiswano eziphakanyiswe ngoxhaso lwe-TV licence ye-SABC. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe eGoli, waba nethuba lokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabamele izinkampani, abezindaba, nabantu abajwayelekile, ukuze baxoxe ngale ndaba ebalulekile. I-SABC, okuyinhlangano enkulu yokukhangisa eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nokho, izinkinga ezithinta ukungabikhona kwemali, ukunganeliseki kwabathengi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali zikhuluma kakhulu emiphakathini. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yeMenenja ye-SABC, uNkk. Thandiwe Mthembu, owakhuluma ngokuqinile ngendaba yokuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence akusizi kuphela i-SABC, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi. Uthe, "Uma singatholi uxhaso olufanele, sizobe sithola ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo." Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, abanye bephikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube okwenziwe ngababhalisile kuphela, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhasa. Uhlelo lwemibono lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana. UJohn Nkosi, umphakathi ophakathi, waphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuxhasa, njengokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokwazi ukuheha ababukeli abaningi. "Uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuheha ababukeli, izokwazi ukuthola uxhaso olungcono," kusho uNkosi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNkk. Sipho Dlamini, ongumsebenzi wezokuxhumana, waphikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yinto ejwayelekile, futhi akufanele kube nomkhawulo. "Sidinga i-SABC ukuze ibonise izindaba zethu, izinkolo zethu, nezamasiko ethu. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, hhayi yokuhlukanisa," kusho uDlamini. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze ikwazi ukufinyelela kubabukeli abaningi. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu abaningi behamba phambili besebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokubuka izinhlelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waba nethuba lokubamba izingxoxo ezinzima, lapho abantu bephikisana khona ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa i-SABC. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuthola uxhaso olungaphezulu, njengokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu befuna izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokubamba izinkulumo ezithinta izinkinga ezithinta i-SABC, njengokuphathwa kwezimali, ukungabikhona kwemali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Uhlelo lwezinkulumo lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhuluma ngezindlela ezithinta i-SABC, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokubamba izingxoxo ezinzima, lapho abantu bephikisana khona ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa i-SABC. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuthola uxhaso olungaphezulu, njengokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu befuna izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo. Ekupheleni komcimbi, kwavela umbono ophakeme wokuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kudinga ukucutshungulwa okujulile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi ubona ukuthi lezi zimpikiswano zibalulekile, futhi zidinga ukuqhubeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezithokozisayo, nezifundisayo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokubamba izingxoxo ezinzima, lapho abantu bephikisana khona ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa i-SABC. Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs Emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, abantu bakhala ngezinhlelo ezinzima zokufinyelela kwezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa ehhovisi leZindaba Zasemaphethelweni, elaziwa njengama-Home Affairs. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisekisa ubunjalo, imvume yokuhlala, nezincwadi zokuhamba. Kusukela ezinsukwini zeCovid-19, izinhlelo zokuhamba e-Hom Affairs ziye zanda kakhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zikhala ngokuqashwa okunganele kanye nezinsiza ezincishisiwe, okuholela ekubeni nezinsizakalo ezivela kancane. Lokhu akubanga nje ubunzima kuphela ekutholeni izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kodwa kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwempilo yabantu. UJohn Mthembu, ongumlamli ubenengxoxo nekhanda lefilimi, uthe: "Ngivame ukuzama ukuya ehhovisi le-Home Affairs, kodwa ngibona ukuthi izinsuku ezingu-10 noma ngaphezulu ukuze ngithole indawo. Lokhu kuphazamisa kakhulu izinhlelo zami, futhi ngiyazibuza ukuthi kungani kungafuneki kube phakathi kwemizuzu embalwa." Izinto eziyinqaba zenzeka emashumini edolobha, lapho abanye abantu bekhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsuku ezikhuphukayo zokulinda. Izinombolo zabantu ezingenakufinyeleleka ziyavela emoyeni onamandla, njengoba izinsuku zokusebenza ezivamile zingagciniwe ngalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi kubantu abayingxenye yezenhlalakahle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhulumeni uthe ubheke ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuqhuba eHaffisi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwandisa inani labasebenzi abanogcozi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi ezizovumela abantu ukuthi bakwazi ukwenza izicelo zabo ngekhompyutha zabo. Nokho, kusalindwe ukuthola ukuthi lokhu kuzoba namathuba aphumelelayo ngaphambi kokuba kugqashuke. Okungabazisayo, izinsuku zomphakathi zikhombisa ukwanda kokuhlaselwa kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, kanti abanye bayeza ukuze bazame ukuthola imvume yokuhlala, noma izincwadi zokuhamba, kodwa babe nezinselelo ezinkulu. UDr. Siphesihle Zulu, owaziwa njengomholi wezokuhlaliswa, uthe: "Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ubunzima, kodwa futhi kubonisa indlela esizilungiselela ngayo izinsiza." Imithombo yezeMidlalo I-Afrika ibeke phambili ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngama-Home Affairs kwempumelelo enkulu yezenhlalakahle. Ukuhlunguzeka kwezinsiza kusebenza kakhulu ezikhathini ezinzima, njengoba izinto ezilindelekile zikhombisa izinkinga ezifana nezinsiza ezithile ezingenakufinyelelwa. Ophathinhloko bezempilo bahlongoza ukuba uhulumeni aqinise ukukhethwa kwezinsiza, ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo. Lokhu kusebenza ngokuhlakanipha, okulindeleke ukuthi kuzokwenza izinqubo zokubhalisela izinqumo zibe lula. Ukuze kuqinise ukuphathwa kwempela kwezinsizakalo, picha kufanele kube izindlela eziza yena. Umlingani empilweni yansuku zonke uThandi Ndlovu, oshayele uhulumeni izinsuku eziningi ukuxhumana, uthe: "Ngikhethiwe, ngihamba emigqeni, ngihlala kude. Lokhu konke kudinga ukuhamba kahle, kodwa uhlelo olufanelekile alunikezi." Okukhona kungabazisayo, uThandi akagculiseki ngensizakalo enikezelwa kulolu hlelo. Ukuze kube nempumelelo yempilo, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemthethweni kubaluleke kakhulu kwezokuphila kwabantu. Esikhathini esizayo, uhulumeni kufanele abone ukuthi umqondo wezinsiza ubalulekile futhi ungavuma izinhlelo eziseduze ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimpilo zabantu. Okwenziwa yizikhungo ze-Hom Affairs kuzocacisa uma abantu befuna ukwenziwa ngosizo lwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo nezikhuthazayo. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemthethweni, kuzodala ukuhamba kahle eminyakeni ezayo. Kodwa, kwenziwe kahle ukuze kuhlikishwe izinhlelo phakathi kwalabo abaphathe i-Hafice. Njengoba umnyango uzame ukwenza izinguquko ezithile, abanye abantu basaqhubeka nokuhlushwa izinkinga ezibandakanya ubungako obuncane bezinsiza, ubunzima bezinqubo zokubhalisela ezigelezeni. Kuhlala kucacile ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile ku-Hom Affairs zidinga ukwandiswa nokwenziwa ngcono, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ngosuku oluthile. Lolu hlelo luzobhekwa kahle ngethemba lokuthi kuzokwenziwa izinguquko ezifanele ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola okuqukethwe okuthile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. I-Hom Affairs izokhuluma kulolu chungechunge, yazi lokhu kumqoka ngaphansi kwezinsizakalo ezibaluleke kakhulu ezizobukeka kahle.
Heee, ngiyavuma, asiqaleni! Uma sikhuluma ngezitolo zama-spaza, kuyajabulisa ukwazi ukuthi ziningi izinkinga ezibhekene nomnotho wasekhaya. Ngabe usuke ubone ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza kanjani? Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zitolo zibalulekile emphakathini. Kuthiwani uma sikhuluma ngezitolo ezincane? Zivamise ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zansuku zonke zabantu. Hhayi nje ukudla, kodwa nezinto zokubhalela, iziphuzo, nezinsiza ezincane ezinjengemali. Kuhle, akukhona? Kodwa, sikhuluma ngazo, kudingeka sikhumbule nemithetho ethile ezibophezele kuyo. Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi lezi mithetho? Ngabe uyakwazi ukujwayela? Umthetho wokuqala, kanti, ungakuchaza njengokuphathwa kahle kwezimpahla, akunjalo? Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukusiza ukugcina lesi sitolo sisesimweni esihle. Lokhu akukhona nje okuningi. Khumbula uma uhamba uye esithathu, kunezinto ezidingeka ukuthi zifezekiswe ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga. Kumele kube nezimvume ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi yonke into ikulolu hlobo. Uma ungaphethi kahle, kwenza kube nzima kancane. Lokhu kusemthethweni, futhi abantu kumele bayiqonde le mithetho, ukukwazi ukuhweba ngokukhululeka ngezizathu ezihlukene. Ngabe ubona? Ngithanda ukuthi umphakathi ukhuthaze ithuba. Hhayi nje ukwenza imali, kodwa nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Njengoba lezi zindawo zikhula, ziqhuba ukwakha imisebenzi eningi. Uzobona, kuhle ukubona abantu behola imihlola, lokhu kuhle kakhulu! Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umphakathi ookhuluma ngabo kumele uqaphele izinto ezithile. Uma kwenzeka umphakathi ungenzi kahle, abanye abantu bazophuma bazama ukuthola ubugebengu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube nenhlangano eqinile ezindaweni zokuhweba. Kukhona umthetho wezokuphepha okumele ulandelwe. Kukhona izinto ezinzima ezingase zenzeke, kanti umphakathi kumele ungathathi izinto alula. Ngokusho kwayo, ukukhula kwezinto kudinga ukwenziwa komphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma usuthola imvume, kumele uhambisane nezimfuneko. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi abanye abantu baphumelele ngaphandle kokulawulwa? Kumele bazi ukuthi wonke umuntu bobabili udinga ukuqonda imithetho, ukuze konke kuhambe kahle. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukusebenza ngokubambisana, futhi umphakathi uthokozise. Noma kunjalo, uma sikhuluma ngezimali okufanele zifakwe kulezi zindawo, sikhona isidingo sokuthi kube nezimali ezithile ezisiza ukusiza uphuhliso. I-Local Economic Development, noma i-LED, ibalulekile kukho konke lokhu. Kwanele ukusiza ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi, kodwa kumele kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezohwebo kanye nohulumeni. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani? Umphakathi kufanele uhambisane, ukuze ube nezinye izinhlelo ezihle. Lokhu kuletha imisebenzi emisha, futhi umphakathi uyawuthokozela ukukwazi ukusiza umphakathi. Ubuza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile? Ucabanga ukuthi kukhona abanye abantu obathanda ukuhweba, bese ifa elibandlululayo lenza kube nzima? Kulokhu, bazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukusiza. Ngakho-ke, uma ngiphakamisa, sathuthukisa izinto ezibalulekile ukuze sithole ubuchwepheshe obuqinile. Ucabangani ngezindlela ezithile ezizokwakha umnotho omuhle? Kumele sithuthukise imikhankaso esiza abantu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza futhi ziqhuba umnotho wonke. Akungabazi, lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi uthokozise izimvume ezahlukahlukene. Ngabe uyayiqonda imithetho ewubukhali yokuhweba? Kuhle kakhulu, lokho kuyisigaba esibalulekile. Ngokuphetha, imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile emnothweni wasekhaya. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele sibheke izinto ezilula. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sithole indlela yokuthi abathengi baphumelele, ukuze umphakathi ungaxhaphazeki. Khumbula, umphakathi wethu uqhubeka phambili kuphela uma sizibophezela kumthetho. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza umphakathi wethu!
Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaholela ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala? Impendulo: Ukukhathazeka okukhulayo ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo emaphikweni omasipala kube yinto ebalulekile. Abantu baveze ukukhathazeka ngezimali ezichithwa, izinkontileka ezingalingani, nezinsiza ezingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kuholele emaphakathini ukuba aphakamise izinkulumo ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinsolo ezibalulekile ezikhuluma ngenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinsolo eziphakanyisiwe zifaka phakathi ukwephulwa kwezimiso zokuphatha kahle izimali, izinkontileka ezikhethwe ngendlela engafanele, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabathengisi ukukhipha imali engafanele. Lokhu kuthe xaxa kwahlola izimo ezicacile zokungathembeki. Umbuzo 3: Uhlolo lwenziwe kanjani? Impendulo: Uhlolo lwezinsolo lwenziwa ngokubamba izingxoxo nezinhlaka ezihlukene. Izikhungo zocwaningo, izinkantolo, nabahlali baphakathi kwama-committees abekwe ukuhlola izinsolo. Lokhu kudinga ubufakazi obusemthethweni kanye nemibiko yezehlakalo eziyingozi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi iziphakamiso ezivela kulolu hlolo? Impendulo: Iziphakamiso ezivela kulolu hlolo zifaka phakathi ukuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuphatha izinsiza, ukwandisa ukubonakala kwemali, nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukayo zokubika izinsolo. Ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga, kudingeka ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 5: Zithini izinzuzo zokudluliselwa kolwazi kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukudluliselwa kolwazi kulokhu kukhuthaza ukugunyazwa kobufakazi kanye nokukhulisa ukuzwakala kwakho komasipala. Lokhu kusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zenzelwe impilo yebhizinisi elungile. Izinzuzo zihlanganisa ukwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwezakhamuzi kanye nemiphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe kukhona izinhlelo ezithathwayo ukuze kubhekwane nezinsolo zenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi ezithathiwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokubika ezivulekile, kanye nokwandisa ithuba lokuhlola izimali. Lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukuze zinciphise amathuba okungeqisi nokwehlisa izinga lenkohlakalo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinselelo ezikhona uma kuziwa ekulalelweni kwezinsolo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo zifaka ukungabikhona kobufakazi obuqinile, ukukhokha kokubhujiswa kwabantu abavela ezinkampanini zokusiza, nokushaqeka kwamaphoyisa nezinhlaka eziphathelene nezokuphatha. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukufakazela izinsolo ezithile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela ezithathwe ukuze kugwenywe inkohlakalo? Impendulo: Izindlela zokuvikela zifaka phakathi ukujolisa emithonjeni yokubika, ukusungula izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nokuphathwa okuhle kwempumelelo. Konke lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe inhlonipho nokusisha phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubika ezivulekile, ukwakha imithombo yobufakazi kanye nezinhlelo zokubonisana, kanye nezehlakalo zokufundisa ebuholini. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazame ukuhlanganyela. Umbuzo 10: Ubulili besakhamuzi buhlinzeka nobani? Impendulo: Ubulili besakhamuzi busiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Abesifazane nabesilisa kufanele babe nesikhala sokubamba iqhaza ekuvikelweni nasekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza. Ubulili buhlangana nezinhloso eziphakeme zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuphatha. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe imiphumela yenkohlakalo ibonakala kanjani? Impendulo: Imiphumela yenkohlakalo ibonakala ngokuncipha kwemali yokuphathwa, ukungabi namathuba alungile omsebenzi, futhi kunezingozi ezingaba khona ekuphileni kwabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuba kube nempikiswano ende phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabaphathi. Umbuzo 12: Umaphakathi ubamba imaphi imisebenzi ekulweni nenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Umasipala uthatha ubumqoka bokwenza ucwaningo olunembile, ukuxhumana nezakhamizi, kanye nokwakha amaqembu ahlose ukubhekana nenkohlakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusizakala kubo bonke abantu. Ukwenza kokuqeda: Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokulandela izinsolo zenkohlakalo kumasipala ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphepha nokuthula. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi, kanye nezakhamuzi kuzoba nezithelo ezizwakalayo emiphakathini. Izinyathelo ezithathwe kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophila kahle, ubumbene, futhi onokukhangeleka okukhulu.
Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni (AI in public administration) Umbuzo 1: Yini ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) futhi kungani kubalulekile kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) ubhekisela kumakhono wekhompuyutha okwenza izinqumo, ukufunda, nokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngendlela efana nokuhlangenwe nakho komuntu. Kubalulekile kuhulumeni ngoba kungenza izinqubo zibe nezindlela eziphumelelayo, kunciphise isikhathi sokusebenza, futhi kuthuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izindlela ezilula zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ziningi izindlela zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza: I-AI ingasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza zomphakathi ngokuhlaziya idatha futhi inikeze izincomo zokuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswe kanjani kahle. 2. Izinsizakalo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa i-AI zingathuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni nezakhamizi, njengokusebenzisa ama-chatbots ukuze kube lula ukuphendula imibuzo. 3. Ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga: I-AI ingasiza ekuhloleni nasekuxilongeni izinkinga ezithile emphakathini, ikakhulukazi lezo eziyingozi, ukuze uHulumeni uthole izixazululo ezisheshayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni zifaka: - Ukuphumelela: I-AI ingasiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle, okwenza izinqubo zibe ngcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Ngokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-AI ingase isize ukunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. - Ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo: I-AI ingahlinzeka ngensizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu, ukwenyusa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo zihlanganisa: - Ukuphepha kwedatha: Ukusebenzisa i-AI kudinga ukuvikeleka kwedatha, njengoba izinkampani nohulumeni badinga ukuvikela imininingwane yabantu. - Ukungabi nankinga kwezobuchwepheshe: Uhlelo lwe-AI lungase lungasebenzi kahle uma kungekho ubuchwepheshe obufanele, okungaholela ekunganeliseki. - Ukwamukela: Abantu abaningi bangase babe nezinselelo zokwamukela ubuchwepheshe obusha, okungase kube nomthelela ekuphumeleleni kokusebenzisa i-AI. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni emhlabeni? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izibonelo eziningi: - E-Estonia: UHulumeni wase-Estonia usebenzisa i-AI ukuphatha izicelo zokuhweba, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. - E-United States: Izinhlelo zokuhlaziya idatha ezisebenzisa i-AI ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. - E-Singapore: Uhlelo lwe-AI lwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga zomphakathi, ngaphandle kokubanga ukwephula umthetho. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI? Impendulo: Ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI, izinyathelo ezibalulekile zifaka: 1. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze basebenzise i-AI ngempumelelo. 2. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo: Uhlelo oluqinile lwezokuphepha nolwezemvelo luzodingeka ukuvimbela imiphumela emibi ehambisana ne-AI. 3. Ukubambisana: Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, uhulumeni kufanele ubambisane nezinkampani ezizimele kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ibhekwane kakhulu uma kuziwa ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabantu ivikelwe. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle kwabasebenzi nabantu, ukuze kube neziqondiso ezicacile nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa ngokuhlola imiphumela engaba khona, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-AI ayikhubazi izigaba ezithile zomphakathi futhi ithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza kubo bonke. Ukuhlola njalo ukusebenza kwe-AI kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okuhle kwezinguquko ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 9: Ubulungiswa besimo se-AI kungakhuthazwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze bulungiswe, kubalulekile ukufaka imithetho eqinile yokulawula i-AI, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kwabantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa izimiso zokulingana, ubulungiswa, nokulungiselela izidingo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 10: Yintoni esikhathini esizayo esilindelekile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, silindele ukuthi uHulumeni uzokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ezindaweni eziningi, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngendlela ethuthukile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi ngokwenanela kwezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngale ndlela, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buphakathi kwezinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezizokwenza uhulumeni ube nokusebenza okuhle nokuphumelelayo, ngaphakathi komphakathi.
Isigaba Somcimbi: Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali Isikhathi: 15 Mashi 2024 Indawo: Ikhaya leMisebenzi, eGoli Umsuka: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM Ngabe uyazibuza ukuthi ungawuqala kanjani umkhankaso wokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana? Kanjani ungathuthukisa izinga lakho lokubuka futhi ukhulise izethameli zakho? Hamba kithi emcimbini ophawulekayo, "Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali," lapho sizocobelelana khona ngamathiphu, amasu kanye nezinsiza zokwakha umphakathi ozinikele endaweni yezezimali, ezobuchwepheshe, nezokuxhumana. Lo mcimbi uzoba nendawo yokubambisana lapho abadali bokuqukethwe, osomabhizinisi, nabathandi bezokuxhumana bezoba nethuba lokuhlangana, baxoxe ngamaqiniso nezindaba ezithinta imikhakha ehlukene yomsebenzi. Sizoba nezingxoxo ezimnandi ezihlanganisa ohulumeni, abaholi bezomnotho, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele eziphumelela ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bokuqukethwe. Abaphakathi bazoba nezinhlaka ezazisayo ezifanele amalungu ahlukene, ukusuka kwabasaqalayo kuze kube kwabama-expert. Sizoba nezifundo ezimfishane ezihlanganisa izihloko ezifana: - Ukukha iBrand yakho ku-Social Media: Thola ukuthi ungazakhela kanjani igama eliqinile kukhulu kwi-Instagram, Twitter, ne-Facebook, ungachitha isikhathi esinankinga. - Ukwakha Okuqukethwe Okuhlinzekayo: Hlanganyelani nabachwepheshe abahamba phambili ekwakhiweni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, ngokuphathelene nezincwadi, amavidiyo, nezithombe. - Amasu Okukhulisa Izibalo: Ukuthola izindlela eziningi zokukhulisa izibalo zakho kuhlu lwezithakazelo nabalandeli, ngohlu lwezimpendulo, ugcizelela izithako ezibalulekile zempumelelo. - Ukusebenzisa Izigaba Zokukhangisa: Hlola indlela yokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ngendlela efanele ukuze ufinyelele izithameli ezikhulayo. Ngaphezu kwezingxoxo, sizoba ne-‘networking session’ ngesikhathi sonke somcimbi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uzwe okwengeziwe, uxhume nabanye abadali, futhi uthole izinzuzo ezinkulu zomsebenzi wakho. Uzokwazi ukuyixhumana imicabango, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola amathuba amasha okusebenza, okungase kuveze imizila emisha yokubambisana. Izigaba Zombukiso Nezihlangano: - Ubuchwepheshe Bokwazisa: Khuluma nabakhiqizi bokuqukethwe abaphumelelayo, begxile embonini yedijithali. - I-Panel Discussion: Abaphathi bezehlakalo abavela ezinkampanini ezinkulu bazobe behlaziya ukwakhiwa kokuqukethwe okuhle, nokuthi umsebenzisi angasebenza kanjani ukuze avikele umkhiqizo wakhe. - Umdlalosemthethweni: Hlanganyela kwezemidlalo ye-social media, bese uziqhenya ngamalungu akho angavamile. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwalezi zicathulo kanye nezingxoxo, umcimbi uzobhekelela impumelelo yabadali bokuqukethwe, bahlanganyele futhi bafunde ukuthi bangawakhulisa kanjani amaqhinga abo ezinhliziyweni zabathandi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezinye izinto ezizokhipha izikhumbuzo nezinsiza ezibucayi. Izenzo ezithile zokuqina, dabuka izincwadi zokufunda ezithinta izinkundla eziningi, kanye nemiyalezo yokwakha izifundo ezikufundisayo, kuyajabulisa ukuphuma. Ukwabelana ngezindlela eziningi zokwazi ezokuxhumana kwezalokhu, sizobangani bokuqala ezikhathini ezimnandi zokuxhumana. Hamba naye, uze ukumo kuwona imicabango, udale, faka isikhumbuzo! Umcimbi uzokhulisa ukukhululeka kwakho kokucabanga ngalezi zinhlelo zedijithali, umnyango wezezimali, nezokuxhumana. Zikhiphe, uphendule izimpendulo, futhi uwine ibhodi yokuqeda. Ngakho, ungamali ukwenza lokhu. Bhalisela imicimbi etholakalayo futhi ubhalise ukuze uthole ngesikhathi sokuqonda ukuthi ungaba kanjani umdali ophumelelayo, naye udinga okufana nokwenzeka! Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, sizoba nezinye izenzakalo ezizokuqondisa phezu kwalezi zifundo. Phinda uphume lula, uhambisane nezinto ezinzima, ushiye indawo yakbozwayo. Bafika, ujabule, ufinyelela izithongoi ezikhulayo, ukwazi ukuba ngumqondo othembekile phansi kwezezimali. Futhi okokugcina, ukuze uthole ukuqhubekela phambili, khumbula ukufaka izinkumbulo zakho, ubhalise manje, bese uxhumana ngokuhamba phambili! Sibheke phambili ukuze sihlangane khona!
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain Ngomhlaka Msombuluko, umphakathi ubhekene nokwaziswa okujabulisayo njengoba uhulumeni ethumele isiphakamiso esisha sokwandisa uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, oluhamba phambili eGauteng. Le ngxoxo ikhombisa ithuba lokwabelana ngemibono ezosiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono lokuhamba ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Isiphakamiso sihlose ukwandisa umgqa we-Gautrain ukuze ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, kuhlanganise neMamelodi, Tembisa, noSoweto. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngezindlela zokuhamba eziphusile, kuholele ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, futhi kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, olwakhiwa ngonyaka ka-2010, luphumelele ekuthuthukiseni indlela yokuhamba kwabantu, kodwa kudinga njalo ukuba kubhekwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabahlali. Lokhu kuveza izinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubadlali abahlukene, abathi, "U-Gautrain uveza izinketho eziningi, kodwa udinga ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude.” Umphakathi uphakamisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho kuxoxwa khona ngezinkinga ekutholeni izinsiza zokuhamba. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izwi labantu liwulalela, uhulumeni ukhombisa ukuzimisela ekwakheni ibhodi labantu ukuze babambisane ekwenzeni lesi siphakamiso sibe yimpumelelo. Ulimi olukhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso luthinta izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, izindawo zokupaka, kanye nolwazi olubalulekile kubahlali. Lokhu kuzojoliswa ekwakheni izindawo ezithuthukisiwe ezizodala umphakathi omusha, lapho abahamba ngezitimela bezoba nezinsiza ezithokozisayo. Ukukhathazeka ngodlame lwezokuthutha kuqhubeka nokukhathaza izakhamizi eziningi. Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele kuyakhathaza, kodwa abantu baphikelela ekuphakamiseni uhlu lwezindlela zokuhamba ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. Lo mphenyi ubonisa ubukhona obukhulu bezokuthutha, ekhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwemigwaqo nezinye izindlela zokuhamba. "Ngaphandle kokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, sizobe silahlekile — isidingo sokuthutha sikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bemfundo nabangasebenzisi, ungalindela.” Njengoba umphakathi uphakamisa lo mbono omusha, kubalulekile ukukhipha ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukuhamba phakathi ezindaweni ezikude kuzoba lula, futhi izithuthi ezikhona zizothuthukiswa ukuze zifinyeleleke kalula. Izithuthi zikhona, kodwa abantu abahamba ngezinyawo badinga izinsiza eziphusile. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba elihle lokukhombisa uhulumeni izindleko eziphusile zokuhamba, okulungiswa kuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha imihlangano nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa ezokuthutha zikhombisa ukubaluleka kokusebenza ndawonye. Uhlaka lwezimali luzongenisa izinkampani eziningi, ngakho kuhilelekile abantu abaningi abakhuluma ngebhodi, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukuqina kwezomnotho, njengoba kuzokwehlisa izindleko zokuhamba kubantu abaphakathi komnotho ophansi. Njengoba izidingo zomphakathi zikhula, izindlela zokuhamba zizoqhubeka zithuthuka. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imboni yezokuthutha, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi uma i-Gautrain iqhubeka nokwandiswa, kuzoba nezinto ezikhuthazayo ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba komphakathi. Umnikelo wobuqotho udinga ukusheshe, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisa izinsiza zokuhamba. Izindlala zomphakathi zikhona, kodwa imizamo kufanele ibe nezimpumelelo. Ukuze kube nokukhanga kwemali nokuxhaswa okuhle, kudinga imizamo emikhulu. Ngokuxhumana nezinye izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezimali, umphakathi ungakhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso, uhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ohlanzekile, noguquko. Abalaleli basamukela lezi zinhlelo, bejolisa ekuvuseleleni emithonjeni emisha, ukuchuma, nokuqhubekela phambili. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabahlali kuyisiqalo esihle sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, uma lwandiswa, luzoba yinzuzo enkulu esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, iziphakamiso zamuva zizosiza ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bazuze. Ngokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, umhlaba uzoba yindawo ewusizo nolondekile. Ukungena emishinini yokuhamba kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila, izinkampani zikhuthaza abantu, futhi umphakathi ujabulele izinzuzo zokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain lukhombisa ikusasa elikhanyayo, futhi uma abantu bejolisa ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizophumelela, umkhankaso wethu uzothola impendulo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umnotho ube namandla, kube nezinsiza eziza namathuba amasha kubo bonke abahlali baseGauteng. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain luzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo nekusasa elizwakalayo.
Ukukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla Emadolobheni 1. Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, njengoba kunciphisa ubungozi bokudla okungekuhle, kukhuthaza ukulima okuqinile, futhi kwandisa ukufinyelela kokudla okuvumelanayo. Le dokhumenti ihlola izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokukhulisa izingadi zokudla, izinzuzo zazo, nezindlela zokubhekana nezinselelo ezibhekene nezindawo ezisemadolobheni. 2. Izizathu Zokukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kuhlobene nezizathu ezithile: - Ukuphila Okunempilo: Ukudla okukhiqizwa ezindlini kuvame ukuba nezinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukusiza ekudleni okunempilo. - Ukunciphisa Izindleko: Ukulima okuncane emakhaya kunciphisa izindleko zokuthenga ukudla. - Ukuthuthukisa Umphakathi: Lokhu kuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuqalisa umqondo wokubambisana. 3. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla 3.1 Ukucabangela Indawo - Khetha indawo enelanga elanele, okungaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-6 ngeviki. - Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlabathi unokuthula okungcono ukuze kube ne-drainage efanele. 3.2 Ukwenza Umhlabathi Ube Ngcono - Thola umhlabathi onempilo: Ungasebenzisa imikhiqizo yokunisela, ukudla okusakazwayo, noma imfucumfucu. - Khipha imifino, izimpande, nezinto ezingafuneki. 3.3 Ukukhetha Ukudla - Khetha imifino nezithelo ezifanele imvelo yangakini. - Qinisekisa ukuthi unolwazi lokukhula kwezinto ezikhethiweyo. 3.4 Ukwakha Izicabha - Faka izicabha zokuphepha ezithokozisayo. - Zama ukwakha izimo ezilula ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. 3.5 Ukulima - Faka imbewu noma izitshalo emhlabathini. - Qiniseka ukuthi uthola amanzi anele, ikakhulukazi ezinyangeni ezomile. 3.6 Ukuphathwa Kwezihlahla - Naka ukuncipha kwezinyoni nezilwanyana, qhathanisa nezisebenzi. - Gcina umhlabathi unempilo ngokusebenzisa ama-organic fertilizers. 4. Izinsiza Zokuxhasa 4.1 Izinhlangano Zokulima - Xhumana nezinhlangano zasendaweni ezikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezingadi zokudla. - Bamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokufundisana. 4.2 Izifundo Zokuqeqesha - Phenya ngemifundaze eqhutshwa endaweni. - Bhala imishwana ewusizo yokuthuthukisa amakhono akho. 4.3 Amathuba - Hlanganyela emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zezigaba ezithile. - Cwaninga ngama-webinars nezinye izindlela zokuqhubeka ufunda. 5. Izinto Ezingahambisani 5.1 Ukwakha Umphakathi - Hlanganyela nabanye abakha izingadi zokudla ezindaweni ezizungezile. - Dala ukuxhumana phakathi kwezokuxhumana ukuze ukhulise umphakathi. 5.2 Izinhlelo Zokukhangisa - Khombisa imiphumela ezinhumeni uma sekukhuliswa izitolo ezikhangayo. - Hlela imicimbi yokwabelana abantu ngezinto ezitholakalayo. 5.3 Ukuphathwa Kwezokwenza - Qhuba izifundo ezivusa ukuze uthole izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo nezindlela zokulima ezihamba phambili. - Lungisa izinhlelo ngendlela efanele ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza okuthuthukayo. 6.
