Izinselelo Ezibhekelele 6.1 Isimo Sezulu - Cabanga ngezinye izindlela uma kukhona ukwehla kwezulu okungalindelekile. - Phendula ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokulima ezifanele izimo. 6.2 Ukufinyelela Kwezinsiza - Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezifanele kungaba yinkinga; hlanganyela nemiphakathi ukuze uthole izinsiza ezidingekayo. - Qhubekela phambili nokuxhumana nabakhiqizi bezinto ezisetshenziswayo. 7. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okuthuthukisa izindawo zokukhula eziphilile, kanye nemfihlo zokulima. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu, futhi kuphumelele ekwandiseni izitshalo zokudla, kuthuthukiswe ukujula komphakathi. Lokhu kuzoletha izinzuzo eziningi, kunikeze uthando, uthando, nempilo enhle ezinhliziyweni zabakhokhisi bezomnotho. Hlahlela phambili futhi uphathe izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise impumelelo yokwakha izingadi zokudla.
Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Ngokwezibalo ezitholakala kuhulumeni, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhombisa ukushoda okukhulu kwemithi, okuvele kubangele ukungahambi kahle kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushoda kwemithi kuhambisana nezinkinga eziningi, okuhlanganisa nokungabi khona kwemali eyanele, ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kwemithi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali ezibhedlela. Izibhedlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezisezingeni eliphansi, zikhala ngokuthi azikwazi ukuthola imithi edingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukunakekela abafundi bazo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abaguli badinge ukuhamba imikhankaso emide ukuze bathole imithi ezindaweni ezingezona ezibhedlela, okwandisa ubuhlungu babaguli. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezwe luphinde lukhombise ukuthi izibhedlela eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha ezibucayi ukuze zikwazi ukugcina izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi, abanye abaguli baphinde badinge ukulala ezibhedlela isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuthola imithi abayidingayo. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga zokuphila, ngenxa yokuthi imithi ibalulekile ekwelapheni izifo ezihlukahlukene. Okwamanje, abezindaba bathole ukuthi izibhedlela ezisemaphandleni zikhathazekile kakhulu, ngoba akumele zithole imithi ngesikhathi, futhi lokhu kubangela ukungabikho kwesithunzi sokwelashwa. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi abanye abaguli baphendukela ezindaweni ezizimele ukuze bathole imithi, okukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezempilo lukhona ezinkingeni ezishubile. “Siye sahlala isikhathi eside silindile imithi esibhedlela,” kusho uMnu. Mthembu, ongomunye wababebonakala ezibhedlela. “Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu badinga imithi, kodwa uma ungatholi lutho, ungayithola kuphi? Lokhu kwenza kube nzima empilweni yami.” Uhlelo lokuphathwa kwemithi luthathwa kakhulu, futhi abezindaba bathole ukuthi sekudlulelwa indaba yokuthi imithi ethile ayitholakali, okukhombisa ubunzima bokuhlinzeka ngemithi eyanele. Uhlelo lwezempilo luhlala luthinteka yizinkinga zezimali, futhi lokhu kuhlangene noshintsho olungafanele olwenziwa kumaphrojekthi okutholakala kwemithi. Umnyango wezempilo uthe uqhubekile nokusebenza ukuze uthole izixazululo, nokho, inhloso yokukhulisa ukutholakala kwemithi iyinselele enkulu. UMsizi, umphakathi ophakathi kweNingizimu Afrika, uthe: “Kulokhu, sinesithakazelo sokuthi imithi kufanele ifinyeleleke kalula kubantu bethu. Njengoba umphakathi, kufanele sithumele izwi lethu ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo.” Uhlelo lwezempilo luhlala luhlaziywa, futhi umnyango uthe uzothathela phezulu iziphakamiso ezivela emphakathini ukuze kutholakale izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlinzeka ngemithi ezibhedlela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaguli bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngemithi abayidingayo. Ngokwesikhathi esithile, umnyango wezempilo uqhakambisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngemithi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwemithi yokwelapha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhweba ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo emisha. Kubantu abaningi, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kusemqoka, futhi sekukhona imizamo eminingi yokuthola izixazululo phakathi komphakathi kanye nohulumeni. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo kuyadingeka ukuze kutholakale izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuphatha imithi, ukuze abantu bahlale bephila kahle. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kusemqoka, futhi udaba lufanele ukubhekwa ngeso lokho. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi iyatholakala, futhi izimpilo zabantu ziqhubeka zikhula. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomthelela ekutholeni izixazululo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezidingekayo kubantu.
Ngiyavuma, sizoxoxa ngalesi sihloko esithakazelisayo sokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi zimpikiswano zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Abantu banezizathu ezahlukene zokuthi kungani bebona lokhu kungcono noma kungabi kuhle. Okokuqala, sithanda ukuveza ukuthi abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi i-TV licence iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kuyiqiniso, ngoba uma ungakakhokhi, usuke ungatholi izinto ezinhle. Ngabe uyavuma? Kodwa-ke, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani kufanele zifune ezinye izindlela zokuxhasa, hhayi kuphela nge-TV licence. Kukhona abathi, “Kungani kufanele ngikhokhe uma ngingasebenzisi i-SABC? Ngabe kufanele ngikhokhe ukuze abanye babe nezinhlelo?” Lokhu kudala ingxabano, ngoba abanye abantu bahlala bejabule ngezinye iziteshi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kucace ukuthi abantu abaningi bazizwa sengathi i-SABC iyabakhokhisa imali engafanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantu abakhokhayo bathi, “Uma ungakhokhi, ubuhlungu bukhona! I-SABC iyadingeka ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo.” Lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa akukwazi ukusho ukuthi bonke abantu basebenzisa i-SABC. Kukhona abanye abantu abathanda ukubukela ezinye iziteshi, futhi lokho kudala ukungavumelani. Futhi, sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi lapha. I-SABC iyinkampani yomphakathi, futhi kufanele ibhekelele izidingo zabantu. Uma abantu bengakhokhi, kungenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile ziba phansi, futhi lokho akukhuthazi. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Uma kungenjalo, yini eyenza abantu bazizwe bengekho emkhakheni? Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona abathi lezi zinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokukhangisa ukuze zikhulise imali. Lokhu kulungile, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nezinhlelo ezimbi. Bakhathazekile ngokuthi uma i-SABC ibeka izikhangiso eziningi, kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubukela izinhlelo. Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo ye-TV licence, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezindleko eziningi ezihambisana nayo. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi uma i-SABC ikhokhisa, kufanele ibheke izindleko zayo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi akufanele kube nezindleko eziphezulu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uma ungakhokhi i-TV licence, ungabhekana nezijeziso? Lokhu kudala ukungavumelani. Abantu bahlala bephikisana ngokuthi lezi zijeziso zifanele yini. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezijeziso, ngoba lokho kuzokwenza abantu bakhumbule ukukhokha. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kudala ukungakhululeki. Lokhu kudala ingxabano enkulu phakathi kwabantu. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zimpikiswano, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC iyinkampani ebalulekile. I-SABC inezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nayo, futhi uma abantu bengakhokhi, lokho kuzokwenza kube nzima. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokuxhasa i-SABC ngaphandle kokukhokha i-TV licence? Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC inezinhlelo ezithile ezithokozisayo, futhi uma abantu bengakhokhi, lokho kuzokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kudala ukungavumelani, ngoba abanye bahlala bejabule ngezinye iziteshi, kanti abanye bahlala bejabule nge-SABC. Lokhu kudala ingxabano enkulu phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuphetha, izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Lokhu kudala ingxabano, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto ukuze sithole isixazululo esihle. Ngabe unayo eminye imibono?
Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka KweNational Development Plan I-National Development Plan (NDP) iyisicwangciso esibhekene nokuthuthukiswa kwezwe eNingizimu Afrika. Le mhlahlandlela ibalulekile ngoba iqukethe izinyathelo ezidingekayo nezinsiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimpilo, izinto zokwakha, kanye nomnotho. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ukubaluleka kwazo, kanye nemiphumela ethintekayo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. 1. Umongo weNational Development Plan I-NDP yasungulwa ngo-2012 ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlola, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Iqukethe izinhloso eziphakeme ezizoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, ihlanganiswe nezinhlelo ezithile ezikhula ngonyaka, ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lempilo, imfundo, nezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile. 2. Ukuqhubeka kweNDP Ukuhlola ukuhamba kwe-NDP kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhloso zifanele izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubhekisela ekutholeni ukuthi izinhlelo ziwuvuma kanjani umoya wokuphila kwabantu, zifinyelela izifiso zabo. Nokho, kunezihibe nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenza kwayo, okubandakanya: - Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaholi: I-NDP idinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kombuso, uhulumeni bezifunda, nezimboni. Ukuxhumana okuhle kwenza kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. - Ukwesekwa kwezimali: Izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze izinhlelo ziqhube kahle zidinga ukuxhaswa ngemali. Uma uhulumeni engahlinzeka ngoxhaso oluthile, amaphrojekthi angase angaphumeleli. - Izikhala emsebenzini: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyakhula, abantu kufanele babe namathuba okusebenza. 3. Izinselelo Nezinye Izingozi Isikhathi sokuphumelela kwe-NDP siphinde sibe nezinselelo ezinkulu ezihlobene nezimo zomnotho, izinkinga zezenhlalo, nezinguquko zomhlaba. Lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi: - Ubulungisa bendawo: Kunezindawo ezithile lapho ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP ungase kubonise izinkinga ngokungalingani, okwenza kube nzima ukusungula izinhlelo ezifanayo. - Ukwenyuka kokungasebenzi: Inkinga yokungasebenzi ihlala iholela ekuhluphekeni kwabantu, futhi umnotho odinge ukuncintisana uvame ukukhokhelwa kakhulu laba abangenamsebenzi. - Izinguquko zezimo zezulu: Izimo zezulu ziba nomthelela omkhulu emashumini eminyaka ekufezekiseni izinhlelo zokuthuthuka. 4. Ubufakazi Bokuphumelela Kuhlolwe ukuthi i-NDP isithinta kanjani izimpilo zabantu. Bakhona ubufakazi bokuthi imiphumela ethile iyakhula, njengokwanda kwemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa kwamathuba emisebenzi, nemikhankaso yokunciphisa ububha. Lokhu kuvezwe kumaphuzu athile: - Izinga Lemfundo: I-NDP ithuthukisa izinga lemfundo, abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba bafunde, futhi inhlangano yezemfundo ikhulisa ukubhekelwa kwengqondo. - Izinsiza Zokwelapha: Ukuphuculwa kwezinsiza zomtholampilo nezokwelapha kungenye yezinto ezithonya kakhulu abantu, uhlelo lwe-NDP lwenza kube lula ukuthola imithombo yokwelapha. - Ukwanda kwezinsiza zezimali: Uhlelo lwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zezimali ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuxhasa amabhizinisi abo, lokho kuholela ekwakheni amathuba okusebenza. 5. Iqhinga Elizayo Kubhalwe ukuthi ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP kumele kuhlale kuhambisana nezidingo zabantu abahluphekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zibe nengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo. Abantu kufanele baveze imibono yabo ukuze kuhlonishwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izithiyo ziyazizwa. Ukukhuthazwa kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano nongoti kuyinselelo eqhubekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukulinganiselwa, ukugxila ekuphuculeni imiphumela kuyoba ngesinye sezindlela ezihamba phambili. Ngokufingqa, ukuhlola ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan kudinga ukucabangela izinzuzo, izinselelo, nokusebenza kwesikhumbuzo kulabo abathintwayo kanye nezenzakalo zomnotho. Ukuze kufezwe izinjongo zezeNhlangano, sinesibopho sokulandelela izinto ezenzekayo futhi sihlole izindlela ezitholakala ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.
Ngiyabingelela, abangane! Ngifuna ukuthokozisa kakhulu ngalokhu okukhuluma ngakho: umshwalense wezempilo kazwelonke, noma i-NHI, njengoba sikwazi ukuwubiza. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi le nto ithinta impilo yethu sonke, kunjalo? Kukhona abantu abaningi abakhuluma ngakho, kwezinye izikhathi kushayisana nemibono, kodwa kulungile, sithumele kahle! Kukhona abantu abathi i-NHI izozama ukusisiza. Lokhu kutsho ukuthi sizothola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuthi sizokhokha malini. Khumbulani, siphila ezikhathini ezinzima, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu. Futhi uma uMnyango Wezempilo ufuna ukwazisa ngezinguquko, kudinga ukuba sithathe isikhathi sokulalela, sizwe abanye abantu abahlanganyela imibono yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunabanye abantu abanye abathi i-NHI izobe ibangela izinkinga. Bajabulela ukuphikisa ukuthi lokho kungenzeka. Ngabe ube nakho lokho? Lokho bekukukhathaza? Ngoba abantu bathi, "Kutheni kufanele ngikhokhe imishwalense uma ngizokwazi ukuthola usizo mahhala?" Futhi lokhu kuyinqaba. Akukhona nje ukuthi babonisa ubuhlungu bempilo, kodwa baphinde bazibuze nezindleko. Ngabe ngithumele emathubeni ahlukene? Uthanda ukuhlola kahle? Futhi uma sizobe sikhuluma ngalezi zindaba, kufanele siyikhumbule le ndlela esiqhuba ngayo nokuthi yini esizama ukuyenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uyakwenza lokho okukhuluma. Uma ubuka impilo yabantu endaweni ethile, ungakubona ukuthi abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zomphakathi kahle, impilo yabo iyahlupheka. Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, futhi lokho akukhona okumele sikhohlwe. Futhi uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kuncike emhlabeni wethu wonke, hhayi kuphela kumuntu oyedwa noma inhlangano eyodwa. Ngabe ubona kuphi ukuthi umshwalense wezempilo ungandileka? Umphakathi usekela kanjani lesi qophelo? Kungani impilo ibalulekile kuwe? Umbono wakho ubalulekile, futhi ngiyafisa ukuwazi. Ngikhumbula isikhathi esedlule lapho sikhuluma ngempilo. Kuthiwani uma lengxenye ye-NHI ibhekelele izinkinga zempilo? Abanye abantu bahluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ngenxa yezizathu eziningi — ngabe kusho nokuthi behluleka ukuthola usizo lwezempilo? Lokhu, ngempela, kufanele kutshwe phansi. Futhi kumqondo wami, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole amaqhinga athile. I-NHI kufanele ibheke imiphumela ukuze ibone ukuthi bantu basheshe bashintsha kanjani impilo yabo nokuthi bathola kanjani usizo. Ngabe lokho kuhambisana nezidingo zethu? Ngabe umuntu, njengokuthi mina, uhola kanjani? Ngabe u-NHI uhambelana nezidingo zami? Lokhu kumele sibuze ngazo. Okungama-engxoxweni, kumayelana nokubambisana. Abantu bahlukahlukene banezidingo ezihlukahlukene. Uma sikhuluma ngendawo yomphakathi, kumele sibe nomdlandla ohlanganyela. Ngabe kudinga kube nemihlangano? Ukuthi abantu baphendule imibuzo, baphawule, ukusizakala kwezempilo? Ngabe sizoba nendlela yokubamba ngempela? Ngabe uma kudinga ukufaka iziphakamiso, sizoba thepha izinsuku zethu, bhalile imibono yenu. Kungabangani lezi zinsuku ezinjalo? Ungavula izinkanyezi emqondweni wakho. Ummoya wezempilo ulula, kodwa uphinde ube mningi. Ngabe sikhuluma ngokutholakala kwemithi? Ukutholakala kwezinsizakalo? Ngabe sikhumbula ukuhlonza izici? Izinkombandlela? Amandla ethu okuthola lokho okukhuluma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngabe uthisha uphakamisa umbuzo? Ngabe lezi zifundo zingasisiza sisebenzise indlela eziphelela empilweni yethu? Yingakho kunemihlangano yezempilo, izinkulumo eziningi ukuze sithole izixazululo. Mina, ngithanda uma abantu bephakama baphendulela, kungaba yinkulumo ephilayo. Lokhu, kuzo zonke izinhlelo, iziphakamiso, nezibopho, akukhona ukuzama ukufaka izinkanyezi ezibhakabhakeni; thina siphila emhlabeni wamabhlogo. Ucwaningo, izindlela zempilo nezidingo zibakhumbuza bonke. Ngaphambi kokuphetha, ngithandeka ukukubuza: Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kuhlanganyela nezinkanyezi kuyasiza? Ngabe lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yakho? Ukuthi umphakathi uphakamisa izimvo ezithile? Ngabe i-NHI iyazama ukuphendula izidingo zethu? Ngabe sizobe sisheshisa impilo yethu? Siyacela, yehlisa izithiyo, uvule izinkanyezi, khetha impilo enempilo! Ngiyabonga, futhi ngibheke phambili ekutholeni imibono yenu! Kulungile, ngiyabonga!
Ingxoxo Ngama-Internship Abafundi Abaphothule Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba nithumele le ngxoxo. Namuhla sizoxoxa ngezindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule. Ngicela ungazise ngamagama akho kanye nendawo ovela kuyo. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngiyinhloko ye-Institutions for Learning, ngisebenza ekuphathweni kwama-internship kubafundi abaphothule. Ngivela eGoli. Umxhumanisi: Kulungile, ngizokubuza umbuzo wokuqala. Yini eyenza ama-internship abalulekile kubafundi abaphothule? Umphenyi: Ama-internship abalulekile ngoba anikeza abafundi ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi abaluqoqile esikhathini sokufunda. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bakhulise amakhono abo, bathole ulwazi olujulile emkhakheni abawuthandayo, futhi bathole ithuba lokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene emsebenzini. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izindlela ezithile abafundi abangazisebenzisa ukuze bathole ama-internship? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bangavakashela amawebhusayithi ezinkampani ezithanda ukuhlinzeka ngama-internship. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkampani ezinkulu nezincane. Okwesibili, bangasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ezikoleni zabo, njengokuxhumana nabafundisi noma izikhungo zokusebenza. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana nabantu emkhakheni ofanele kungasiza kakhulu; kungaba ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana noma izenzakalo zomphakathi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyindlela enhle. Ngabe kukhona izinkinga ezivamile abafundi abahlangabezana nazo lapho befuna ama-internship? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezinkinga ezithile. Abafundi bavame ukuthola ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ulwazi oluthile, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abasha. Futhi, abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlela isikhathi sabo, ikakhulukazi uma benemisebenzi eminingi. Ukuntuleka kokuzethemba nakho kungaba yinkinga, njengoba abanye abafundi bezwa ukuthi abakwazi ukufaka izicelo. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kucacile. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokuthi abafundi bangakwenza kanjani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela ekutholeni ama-internship? Umphenyi: Ngiyavuma. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezincwadi ezinhle zokufaka isicelo, kubandakanya i-CV ne-portfolio. Lokhu kufanele kube nezinhlaka ezichaza kahle amakhono, izifundo, nolwazi. Okwesibili, abafundi kufanele baqonde kahle izinkampani abafuna ukuzenzela ama-internship kuzo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bakhulume kahle ngesikhathi sokuhlangana. Okwesithathu, ukuhlela kahle isikhathi sokusebenza nokufunda kungasiza kakhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakhuluma kancane ngendima yokuxhumana nabantu emkhakheni we-internship? Umphenyi: Impela. Ukuxhumana nabantu kubalulekile kakhulu. Abafundi kufanele bazame ukwakha ubudlelwano nabantu abavela ezinkampanini, emiphakathini, noma ezikhungweni zemfundo. Lokhu kungabavulela amathuba amaningi, njengoba imisebenzi ivame ukuphakanyiswa kubantu abakwazi ukuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba emicimbini yokuxhumana, njengemihlangano nezinkulumo, kungasiza abafundi ukuba bazitholele amathuba amahle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyisiphiwo esihle. Ingabe ungakuchaza ukuthi ama-internship angashintsha kanjani ikusasa labafundi? Umphenyi: Ngempela. Ama-internship angashintsha kakhulu ikusasa labafundi. Ngokuthola ulwazi oluqondile emsebenzini, abafundi bakwazi ukujula emkhakheni abawuthandayo, bathole izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenza, futhi baqonde kahle izidingo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthola imisebenzi emihle ngemva kokuphothula, njengoba izinkampani zikhumbula abantu abaneziqu ezithile. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakukhumbuza ukuthi abafundi kufanele bakwenze kanjani ukuze baphumelele ngesikhathi se-internship? Umphenyi: Abafundi kufanele bahlale bephokophele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephuthuma, bezimisele ukufunda, futhi baphendule kahle emisebenzini. Ukubambisana nabanye futhi ukusebenzisana nabaphathi kubalulekile. Futhi, kufanele bazame ukufaka iziphakamiso ezinhle, njengoba lokho kungabakhombisa njengabantu abakhathalelayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubafundi abaphothule? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi ama-internship awakhombisi kuphela amakhono abo, kodwa futhi akha izixhumanisi ezibalulekile. Bafanele bazimisele, baphokophele, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ukusebenza kanzima kuzobavulela iminyango eminingi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngifisa ukuthi abafundi baphumelele ekutholeni ama-internship abawafunayo. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma. Ngithemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izosiza abafundi abaningi.
Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Umbuzo 1: Ngabe kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi uKomidi lePhalamende uqale izingxoxo mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Ukuqonda ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile emsebenzini, uKomidi lePhalamende wenza ucwaningo olunzulu. Kubonakale ukuthi izinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha likhulu kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamasu aqinile ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba emisebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela eziyinhloko zokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Izimbangela zihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemfundo efanele, ukungabi nezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Ngokwesibonelo, intsha iphinde ibhekane nezithiyo zokungena emisebenzini ethile ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlangenwe nakho. Umbuzo 3: UKomidi lePhalamende ubhekephi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: UKomidi ugxile ekubambeni imihlangano nezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Izinhloso zethu ukwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizophumelela. Umbuzo 4: Yimaphi amasu ahlongozwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Amathuba okufunda nokusebenza kufanele avuleke kakhulu. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuthile, ukuvuleleka kwemisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ukuqashwa kwezinsizwa. UKomidi ubuye uphakamise ukwakha izinhlelo zokweseka abaqashi ukuze baqashe intsha. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe uKomidi lePhalamende linethemba lokuthi izinhlelo ezihlongozwayo zizoletha izinguquko? Impendulo: Yebo, sinezinga eliphezulu lokuthemba ukuthi izinhlelo ezihlongozwayo zizolethe izinguquko ezinhle. Njengoba sikhuluma, sithole ukwesekwa okuhle kwiPhalamende, futhi sithande ukubona impumelelo emiphakathini eminingi. Umbuzo 6: UKomidi uthola kanjani impendulo evela emphakathini? Impendulo: Sivula iziteshi zokuxhumana ezahlukahlukene, kubandakanya imihlangano, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezibalo ezithile. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sithole imibono nemibuzo evela kubantu abasemakhaya, okubalulekile ekuqondeni izidingo zabo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izifundo ezithathwe kwezinye izizwe mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Sifunde kakhulu ezindaweni ezithile ezifana ne-Scandinavia, lapho izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenza kahle. Izifundo ezitholwe zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezimfuno zemakethe, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokusekela intsha ekufuneni imisebenzi. Umbuzo 8: UKomidi uhlela kanjani ukubona ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza? Impendulo: Sinomqondo wokubeka izinkomba zokusebenza, ezizokwenza sikwazi ukukala impumelelo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuqashwa kwentsha, ukutholakala kwemisebenzi, kanye nemiphumela yokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo ezintsha. Umbuzo 9: Ukomidi lePhalamende luthini ngezinsiza ezikhona zokuxhasa intsha? Impendulo: Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona, kodwa zidinga ukuphuculwa. UKomidi ubona ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo azihambisani nezidingo zentsha, ngakho-ke kudingeka kube nokwenza izinguquko ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise lezi zinsiza. Umbuzo 10: Yini eyenza uKomidi lePhalamende uqhubeke nokusebenza, noma kunzima? Impendulo: Uthando lokuthuthukisa ikusasa lentsha lwenza sibe namandla. Siyathemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukuletha izinguquko ezithile, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi intsha iyigugu elikhulu elizokwenza umehluko. Uthando lokubona intsha iphumelela luyisiqhamo sokuqhubeka. Umbuzo 11: UKomidi unezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizayo kulolu daba? Impendulo: Yebo, sihlela imihlangano eyengeziwe nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze siqhubele phambili izingxoxo. Siphinde sicele ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze siqonde kahle izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nentsha. Umbuzo 12: Ngabe kunendlela ethile yokuhlanganyela umphakathi kulokhu? Impendulo: Ngokuqinisekile. UKomidi ufuna ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuhlanganyela umphakathi, ukuze sithole imibono ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile ezizothuthukisa impilo yentsha. Umbuzo 13: Ngabe uKomidi ubona impumelelo kulolu hlelo? Impendulo: Sinethemba lokuthi kuletha impumelelo, kodwa kumele sibe nomsebenzi onzima. Impumelelo izodinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo ethe xaxa phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Umbuzo 14: Yiziphi izinqumo ezivelayo ezithathwa uKomidi? Impendulo: Siphakamisa izinqumo ezihambisana nokwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezinzima zokuxhasa intsha, ezihlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokuxhasa emsebenzini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 15: UKomidi uqhubeka kanjani nokudla izikhumbuzo zokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Sihlala sikhumbula ukuthi impilo yentsha ibalulekile. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza ukuthi sizame ukuhlinzeka ngamasu ahlukene, ahlose ukusheshisa izinqubo zokuxhasa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha inezinketho ezanele. Inhloso enkulu yalesi sikhumbuzo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke intsha inethuba lokusebenza, ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni. UKomidi lePhalamende uzobamba imihlangano eqhubekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza. Isiphetho: UKomidi lePhalamende uzimisele ukugxila ezinkingeni ezibhekene nentsha, futhi uzosebenza ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza ukuze intsha ithole amathuba angcono.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery uqala ngonyaka ka-2006, lapho izinhlelo zokuqala zokuqalisa le mboni zathuthukiswa. Le phrojekthi yaziwa njengomunye wezinto ezibalulekile emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi ezwenikazi lase-Afrika. Ukubuyiselwa kobuchwepheshe bokucubungula uwoyela kwaba yinjongo eyinhloko, njengoba izwe belidinga ukunciphisa ukwethemba kwalo kwi-imports ye-oyela. Ngonyaka ka-2007, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqinisekisa ukuthi le phrojekthi izoba yinsika yokwakha umnotho ophilayo, ngenxa yokuthi uzobangela imisebenzi eminingi futhi uthuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Icala lokuqala lokwakhiwa kwalesi sikhungo savula ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo zomnotho nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Ngaleso sikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yayihloselwe ukuba ibe yindawo enkulu yokucubungula uwoyela, izokwazi ukukhiqiza uphethiloli, i-kerosene, nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ezisemqoka emnothweni. Ngonyaka ka-2008, kwavulwa izikhungo zokucwaninga, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi izosebenza kahle. Abacwaningi bacwaninga ngama-technology ahlukahlukene, nezindlela zokucubungula uwoyela ezizothuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, kanti lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kuqale ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuhambisane nezinhlelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani eziningi zaxhumana noHulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lezi zinkampani zazihlanganisa izinkampani zomhlaba wonke ezazishaya indiva kumasiko aseNingizimu Afrika, kodwa zafika kuleli ngenxa yezinzuzo eziphathelene nomnotho. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani zangaphandle nohulumeni. Ngonyaka ka-2010, umsebenzi wokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery uqale ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kube yisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi behola imisebenzi, kanye nezinkampani eziningi zathola ithuba lokwenza izinto ezithile. Ukwakhiwa kwalesi sikhungo kwafaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaqashwa bahlala ezindaweni ezinhle. Nokho, nakuba iMthombo Oil Refinery yayiqhakambisa izinzuzo, kwakukhona nezinkinga ezithile ezazihambisana nayo. Ukujika kwemali, izinkinga zokuphatha, nokuhlangenwe nakho komphakathi kwaba yizinto ezazidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Okwaneno, umphakathi wakhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezenzo zalesi sikhungo, njengoba umoya ophuma emoyeni ubungakhathaza ezimpilweni zabantu, nokuthi ukuvunguza kwemali ezivela kule phrojekthi kwabe kungaqinisekisiwe. Ngonyaka ka-2015, uhulumeni wathatha izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi le phrojekthi iyahamba phambili. Izinkampani zashintsha izindlela zazo zokwakha, zifaka izindlela ezilungile zokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina umphakathi uzwakala. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi uqhubeke nokuba nokubambisana, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezizungezile zaphakanyiswa. Ngonyaka ka-2018, iMthombo Oil Refinery yagcina icubungula uwoyela. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, njengoba kwavela imiphumela emihle emnothweni. Ukuvulwa kwalesi sikhungo kwaholela ekukhuleni kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nesimo sokuphila esithuthukile. Umnotho wendawo waqala ukuthuthuka, futhi abantu abaningi bathola ithuba lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Nokho, ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery akukapheli. Uhlanga olunzulu lwalesi sikhungo lwalubhekelele izinselelo ezihlobene nokuphatha, ukulawulwa kwemvelo, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi wahamba noHulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuzobhekelwa yonke imiphumela, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisemqoka ziyaqhuba. Ngonyaka ka-2021, umkhankaso wokugcina wokuqinisa iMthombo Oil Refinery uqhubekile, futhi izinkampani zaku-international zazinikeze izinsiza ezikhulayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthuka zaneqhaza elikhulu, futhi umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphatheni le phrojekthi. Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa ukuthi kube nezinto eziningi ezizwakalayo, futhi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kudingeka ukuba basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuzuzwe inhloso yokwakha umnotho ophilayo. Lokhu kuyindlela ebalulekile yokubona ukuthi uma kukhona ubambiswano, izinkinga ezithile zingahlulwa, futhi umphakathi ungavuselelwa. Ukubheka phambili, iMthombo Oil Refinery izosebenza njengomholi emkhakheni wezokucubungula uwoyela, futhi izoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi izinhlelo ezinhle zidinga ukubhekelelwa ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Lokhu kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomnotho, futhi umphakathi uqhubeke uthuthuka.
Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Sifo sofuba, noma i-tuberculosis (TB), sisabhekwa njengesithiyo esikhulu empilweni yethu, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal. Ukuze silwe nale ngxaki, kudingeka ukuba nezinhlelo eziqondile, ezibanzi, nezihlanganisayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba kufanele zithuthukiswe, zibe nomthelela, futhi zifake wonke umuntu ukuze sithole impumelelo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sifo asithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa siphazamisa umphakathi wonke. Abantu abathola lesi sifo bahlushwa ngezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kokudla, ukungabi namsebenzi, kanye nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zibe nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezibhekiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela ekwelapheni abagulayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka, izinhlelo zokuvikela zidinga ukuqiniswa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola abantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukusabalala kwesifo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufaka imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi ngalesi sifo, izimpawu zaso, nezindlela zokuvikela. Ngomkhankaso ophumelelayo, singakhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphumelele ekutholeni usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele ube nesandla esikhulu ekulweni nale ngxaki. Njengoba izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlali babambe iqhaza emisebenzini ethile, njengokuhlinzeka ngolwazi, ukusiza ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo, nokuthuthukisa ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wobumbano nokuzimela phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile empumelelweni yokulwa nesifo sofuba. Ithimba lezempilo linendima ebalulekile, kodwa akufanele kube yilo kuphela ophakathi kokuthwala umthwalo. Uhlelo lokulwa nesifo sofuba kufanele luhlanganise iminyango ehlukene, njengemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nezokwelapha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, futhi zifinyeleleke kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinsiza kuzosiza ukwakha indlela eyodwa yokusebenza, okuhlanganisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukisiwe. Sizodinga futhi ukugxila emiphumeleni yezinhlelo ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba kumele zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona izinguquko ezithuthukile. Lokhu kusho ukuhlola izinga lokuphila kwabantu abathintekayo, kanye nokubona ukuthi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo zisebenza yini. Uma kunokungaphumeleli, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokwenza ngcono futhi ziqhutshekwe phambili ukuze sithole impumelelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi silungise izinkinga ezihlobene nezezimali. Ukuze sikwazi ukufeza izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhaswa kwezimali okukhulu, okungagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezizimele, kanye nabaxhasi abavela emiphakathini. Ngokwami, uma singanqoba lezi zinkinga, sizoba nethuba elihle lokulwa nesifo sofuba. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal zidinga ukwakhiwa ngempumelelo, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukugxila emiphumeleni, kanye nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukukhipha isifo sofuba empilweni yabantu bethu, sithuthukise izimo zabo zokuphila, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wonke. Lokhu akusizi kuphela abantu abaphethwe yilesi sifo, kodwa kuzothuthukisa umnotho, ubudlelwano, nempilo yansuku zonke KwaZulu-Natal. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeleni phambili, sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba, futhi sithuthukise impilo yethu sonke. Izenzo zethu namuhla zizosipha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sifuna ukuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba, sihlanganyele ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano, nolungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sihlanganyela ngokuphelele, sibhudlaza, futhi sithumele izwi eliqinile lokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal.
Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo Ngonyaka ka-1994, emuva kokhetho lokuqala elivulekile, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wawubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lo nyaka wawufanekisela ukubuyiselwa kwezinto, kodwa futhi wawubeka phambili nesidingo sokuchibiyela emthethosisekelo wamaNgisi. Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kulolu shintsho kwaba yigugu elikhulu. Lokhu kwavula amathuba wokuthi abantu bangenelele ngezwi labo emibuzweni ebalulekile ebhekene nezwe. Ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaNelson Mandela, indawo yokuxhumana phakathi komphakathi neziphathimandla yaguquka kakhulu. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwemiphakathi lwasungulwa ngokuhambisana nosuku olunqamukile, lapho kwabekwa umgomo wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo nesithemiso esihle. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwazisa abantu bengabathathi, bakhulume ngezinto ezibucayi ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Ngesikhathi sokubambisana phakathi kwezifundazwe, abaklami bezinhlelo besebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze babambe iqhaza emphakathini. Izinkulumo, imihlangano, nezibopho zokuhlanganyela zabe zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhulume ngempumelelo yezehlakalo ezithinta impilo yabo. Umsebenzi wemiphakathi owawuhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi, uthintekayo empilweni nasemphakathini, waba yisixazululo esikhaliphile sokukhulisa izwi elibushelelezi. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwathiwa "Iyasebenza" lenza izinyathelo eziyinqaba. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene ukuba basize ekuhleleni imigomo namagugu ezobulungiswa kumthetho. Empeleni, umphakathi waba ngumsebenzi ongokwayo, umbono ophakeme wokukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkanyezi zawo kokwazisa lokuthuthukiswa. Umkhosi, ogcwele imihlangano, wasungulwa ukuze kuhambisane nezinsuku ezisemqoka zenqubo yokuchibiyela komthetho. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukuxhumana ngokukhululekile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi neziphathimandla kwakhuthaza inhlonipho nemigomo emisha. Abaningi babebonisa ukuvuma izinqumo ezicomekayo, beqhakambisa izifiso zabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinyathelo ezithile zivyathwa yizinto ezinkulu ezazisicking phakade ekwakheni imithetho yezokuphatha engaba yokuhlaleka. Uma edlula eminyakeni, abaqhamukeli abahamba phambili baveza ubuhlakani obumangalisayo ukuze babonge izimvo ezivela komphakathi, behlukana nokubukeka kwezimvo ezinhle ezihambisana nezindikimba ezahala. Lokhu kuhlangana kwavula indlela yokuhlola imithetho, ovame ukuba nempumelelo emithonjeni ebonwa komphakathi, uhambisana nezidingo zempilo ezibalulekile. Kanye nokubambisana okulindelekayo, ukuhlobana komphakathi nezinhlelo ezibucayi zaphinde zavuma izigaba ezihlukahlukene. Abesifazane, izinsizwa, ubuhlakani bezifunda, nezindlalifa zaba phakathi kwezingxenye eziyinhloko zendaba ebalulekile yezehlakalo. Lezi, zaqhubeka zikhula zodwa, zibhalela izimvo ngezindaba ezahlukahlukene ezibandakanya ubumqoka bezombusazwe, izinsiza, nezinsiza. Izinqumo ezithathiwe zabathintekayo kwavuma ukuveza izici ezintsha ezikhombisa ukuqondiswa kwemigomo eyenzekile. Lokhu kuboniswe ngokukhuluma ngokucacile, ukugqugquzela kuphakamisa udumo lokuzigcina. Ukujula kwezincazelo zemithetho ezichaza umphakathi, kuveza ubunzima bokubambisana nezindlela ezizinzile. Lokhu kuveza umkhuba osemtshali emhlabeni jikelele ukuze umphakathi uzimele ekwahlukaniseni. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelelise izinjongo zawo, uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza ludinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kudinga abadlali abaningi, abathintekayo, abasanda kuhlangana nezici zomphakathi, nasesikhathini esizayo. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe, umthetho, nobuhlakani bempilo zidinga ukuqaphela ukungqubuzana okukhona, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile. Isidingo senqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isidakamizwa esiphezulu, ngokuhlanganisa izwi ofuna ukudala igugu elisha. Futhi, lokhu kuholele emsebenzini omusha wokwakha umthetho ofanele nezindlela zokuphatha ezikhiqiza umphakathi ophilayo. Ngenxa yesi sikhathi esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza komphakathi, umkhiqizo owakhiwa kulezi zinguquko udinga ukuhlolwa, ukuze kuhlale kutshalwa umoya omusha emiphakathini nasezweni. Ngokubambisana, izimvo zikhula ngokuphumelelayo, zithinta imiphakathi ezithile, zikhuthaza ukuba umphakathi ube nomthelela omkhulu ekuchibiyelweni, kwempumelelo, nokwenziwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elikhulu, ube neqhaza elivelayo ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuhlonipha nokwandisa ubuhlakani bazo. Kuze kube namuhla, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo isazogcina isebenza, ifaneleka njengemodeli yolwazi lokwandisa ubuhlakani nolwazi phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi, uma uhlanganyela, ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile, okugqugquzela isibopho somphakathi, nezokuphatha eziyisisekelo. Le ndlela ivula amathuba okwenziwa kwezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni, xa kuthiwa izikhathi zishintsha. Ngakho-ke, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo ibalulekile, ibonisa ukuthi amandla omphakathi avulekile futhi akwazi ukuyakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, umphakathi onothando nezinto ezimangalisayo. Ubuqotho kumele kube yisiko, kanti ubumbano lwabantu luzoba yinsika eqinile yokwakha izizukulwane ezizayo.
Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time Isingeniso I-Presidential Question Time iyisikhathi esibalulekile esenzeka ngaphakathi kwePhalamende, lapho abameleli bezakhamuzi bephakamisa imibuzo kumongameli. Lezi zingxoxo zenzelwa ukukhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezinhlelo zikamasipala, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezimo ezithinta izakhamuzi. Le dokhumenti ibheka izici ezisemqoka ze-Presidential Question Time, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ngcono le nqubo. Izinhloso ze-Presidential Question Time I-Presidential Question Time inezinhloso eziningi ezibalulekile: 1. Ukubambisana: Ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi. 2. Ukuphendula imibuzo: Ukuvumela abameleli bezakhamuzi ukuba baphakamise imibuzo ethinta izindaba ezibalulekile, okuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuphendula izidingo zomphakathi. 3. Ukukhulisa ukubonakala: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umongameli ubonakala emphakathini, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngokuqondile. 4. Ukuphendula izikhalazo: Ukuvumela umongameli ukuba aphendule izikhalazo ezivela ezakhamuzini, okukhombisa ukuzibophezela ekuphenduleni izidingo zomphakathi. Izici eziyinhloko ze-Presidential Question Time 1. Isikhathi esinqunyiwe: I-Presidential Question Time ibanjwa ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, okuvumela abameleli ukuba balungiselele imibuzo yabo ngaphambi kwesikhathi. 2. Imibuzo ebhaliwe: Imibuzo ivamise ukuba ibhaliwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umongameli unakho konke okudingekayo ukuze aphendule kahle. 3. Ukuphendula okusheshayo: Umongameli kufanele aphendule imibuzo ngokushesha, okukhombisa ukuzimisela nokuhlonipha izakhamuzi. 4. Izimpendulo ezicacile: Izimpendulo kufanele zibe zicacile, ziqondile, futhi zikhombise ukuqonda okujulile kwezindaba eziphakanyisiwe. Izinzuzo ze-Presidential Question Time 1. Ukukhulisa ukwazi: Izingxoxo zikhulisa ulwazi lwezakhamuzi mayelana nezinhlelo zikamasipala, izinqubomgomo, nezimo ezithinta impilo yabo. 2. Ukuphucula izinqubomgomo: Imibuzo ethile ingaholela ekutheni umongameli abone izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. 3. Ukukhuthaza ukubandakanywa: I-Presidential Question Time ikhuthaza abameleli bezakhamuzi ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezinqubweni zomphakathi, okwakha umphakathi ozinikele. 4. Ukukhulisa ukwethembeka: Ukuvumela umongameli ukuba aphendule imibuzo ngokuqondile kubalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. Izindlela zokwenza ngcono i-Presidential Question Time 1. Ukukhulisa ukufinyelela: Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokufinyelela i-Presidential Question Time, njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, ukuze izakhamuzi eziningi zikwazi ukubamba iqhaza. 2. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqeqesha abameleli bezakhamuzi ngendlela yokuphakamisa imibuzo efanele, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. 3. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubo: Ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. 4. Ukubuyekeza izimpendulo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpendulo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisesikhathini, futhi ziqondile, ukuze zikhombise izinguquko ezithile ezithinta izakhamuzi. Isiphetho I-Presidential Question Time iyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. Le nqubo inezinzuzo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ekukhuliseni ukwazi, ukwethembeka, nokubandakanywa komphakathi. Ukuze le nqubo iqhubeke ithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhuluma, futhi umongameli uyaphendula. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obumbene, futhi obonisa ukuzimisela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bonke.
Okutholakele kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli Isingeniso Emashumini eminyaka edlule, imiphakathi eminingi eGoli ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphepha kwempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibhekelela izakhiwo ezindala nezikhungathekile. Umlilo wesakhiwo esikhulu owaqhamuka eGoli, owenzeka ngoMsombuluko, uveze izinselelo eziphuthumayo ekuphathweni kwezokuphepha kwezindlu. Phakathi kophando olwenziwe ngemuva kwalesi sigameko, kwatholwa izinto eziningi ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezimbangela, izinxephezelo, nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezizothathwa ukuze kugwenywe izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Izimbangela zomlilo Uphenyo lunikeze ubufakazi bokuthi umlilo uqale ngenxa yokukhanya okungafanele, okwakuhambisana nezinsiza zokusebenza ezaziphukile. Ubuchwepheshe obungaphelele, ukudluliswa okungafanele kwemishini, kanye nezinga eliphansi lokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha kwaba izizathu ezidumile zokwandisa amathuba okuba nomlilo. Ukuhlolwa kwabanikazi bezakhiwo kwaphawula ukuthi kunokungahambisani nezinga elidingekayo lemigomo yokwakha, okwakwenza izakhiwo zingabi neziqondiso ezanele zokuphepha. Izimpawu zomlilo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuhlolwa komlilo kwathola ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona ezazizitholele nje kuphela ukwakhiwa, kodwa futhi zazingenayo imithetho ethile yokuzivikela. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezimoto zomlilo, ukuphazamiseka kwezokuphepha, kanye nokungaqiniseki mayelana nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nezinhlaka ezanele zokuvikela umlilo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphuthuma, kwaholela ekubeni abahlali bahlupheke kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Izindleko zomlilo Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ubangele ukulahleka okukhulu kwempahla, okuhlanganisa nezakhiwo, izimpahla, kanye nezinsiza ezibalulekile. Ukubhekelwa kokuphila kwabantu, okwakuholele ekufingqeni kwabantu abaningi, kwaba nesiphithiphithi esikhulu. Lokhu kubangele izindleko eziphezulu ezihambisana nezokwelapha, izindleko zokuhlenga, kanye nezindleko zokubuyisela impahla. Uphenyo luthole ukuthi izindleko zezimali ezitholwe ngenxa yomlilo zithinteka kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuphathwa kwezingozi. Izinqubo zokuphuthuma Lapho kwenzeka umlilo, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphepheni kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo ezifanele zokuhlanza, izinhlelo zokuphuma, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Uphenyo lwafakazela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphuma ezazikhona azizange zibe neziphumo ezihle. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo ezinzima zokuphucula izinhlelo zokuphuthuma ukuze ziphumelelise ukuvikela impilo yabahlali. Izinyathelo zokuvikela ezizothathwa Uphenyo luphakamisa izinyathelo ezithile ezenzakalelayo ezizothathwa ukuze kuqedwe izingozi ezihlobene nomlilo wesakhiwo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola izakhiwo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zinezinsiza zokuphepha ezanele, kanye nokuqeqesha abahlali ngezindlela zokuzivikela. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhiwo, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma, nemiphakathi kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma kwenzeka umlilo. Isiphetho Ukuphenya komlilo wesakhiwo eGoli kubonisa ubunzima obuhambisana nezokuphepha kwezindlu eGoli. Izimbangela, izimpawu, nezindleko zomlilo zifundisa imiphakathi ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezokuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma, nemiphakathi kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlilo awuqhubeki ngokuphindaphindiwe. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile, futhi izakhiwo zitholakala kahle, ziqinile, nezingeyona ingozi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi, abanikazi bezakhiwo, nezinsizakalo zokuphepha zibe neziqondiso ezinamandla ukuze bazigcine bezilungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphepha kwempilo emiphakathini, kunciphise izingozi zomlilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi isivuno somphakathi sikhula ngokukhula okungapheli.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile Ekuqaleni kuka-2007, kwaqala ukuhlela iphrojekthi enkulu yokwakha isiteshi samandla eKusile, esiseMpumalanga, eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi siteshi, esiklanyelwe ukukhipha amandla angama-4800 MW, sibe yinsiza enkulu yokwandisa umthamo wamandla kuleli. Nokho, phakathi nezinyathelo zokwakha, kwabakhona izinselelo eziningi ezaholela ekubambezelekeni kokuphothulwa kwesistimu ye-flue gas, okuyinsiza ebalulekile yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya. Umsebenzi wokuqala wawuqala ngokuqinile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuqala zaba sobala. Izinkampani ezingaphansi kokwakhiwa kwalesi siteshi zathola ukuthi izinsiza ezidingekayo azitholakali kalula. Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemishini ethile, kwadlala indima enkulu ekuvimbeleni inqubekelaphambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kuqashelwe ukuthi isikhumbuzo seLanga, okuyi-mozambique, nesikhumbuzo seGoli, sibe sezindaweni ezikude nezokwakha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwempahla zikhula, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezimali ezichithwa ngokweqile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi ibhekelelwa ngendlela efanele, kwadingeka ukuthi kube nezivumelwano eziningi phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa uhulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nezinkampani eziphakathi kokwakha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinto. Ukwengeza, ukusimama kwezimo zezulu kwaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha, izikhukhula nezimvula ezinzima zaba yindlela yokuphazamisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuhambisa izinsiza nezisebenzi endaweni yokwakha. Lokhu kwaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, njengoba izisebenzi zazingeke zikwazi ukugcina umjikelezo wokwakha. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zezulu, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bendawo nabakhi baphinde baba yinkinga. Abantu bendawo babekhuluma ngezidingo zabo, ezazihlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, kodwa babephinde baphikise izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Lokhu kwaholele ekubambezelekeni kokuvunyelwa kwezinhlelo ezithinta imvelo, ngoba abanye babebona ibhizinisi lephrojekthi njengokuphazamisayo emiphakathini yabo. Uhlaka lokuphatha lwephrojekthi, olwakhiwe ngenhloso yokulawula izinselelo, lwathola ukuthi izinqubo zokusebenza azihambisani nezidingo ezishiwo. Lokhu kwaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, njengokungafinyeleli ezingeni elilindelekile lokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abahlinzeki bezinsiza babephinde babe nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha. Kuyenzeka ukuthi ngenxa yalesi simo, izimali eziningi zashoda. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinkinga ezazikhona, izinkampani eziphathelene neKusile zathola ukuthi kudingeka izinhlelo ezikhethekile zokwakha ubudlelwano obuphilayo phakathi kwabo nabahlinzeki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuba nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela, okwakuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezisemqoka zokuhlola nokuphathwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili kwephrojekthi zathuthuka. Izinguquko ezibucayi zafakwa ekuphathweni kwezakhiwo, okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuhlola izimpahla nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nokwenza kahle, futhi kwathuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Ukwengeza, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukufaka isandla emphakathini kwandisa ukuzethemba kwabantu bendawo. Ngokwenza imizamo ethile yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubambisana, abahlinzeki bezinsiza bakwazi ukuhlanganisa izifiso zomphakathi nezidingo zempumelelo yephrojekthi. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxhumana okungcono, okwakhulisa ukufinyelela kweziphakamiso ezithile. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingana yokubambisana nokuthuthukiswa, iphrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile yawela esigabeni sokuphothulwa. Njengoba izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwakha, izinzuzo zokuqala ziqala ukukhanya, futhi umphakathi uqala ukubona imiphumela yokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iphrojekthi igunyazwe njengemodeli yokwakha ezindaweni ezinkulu, ibonisa ukuthi nakuba izinselelo zikhona, khona-ke ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nokusebenza ngokubambisana kungaholela empumelelweni. Ukwakhiwa kwesistimu ye-flue gas eKusile kube yinto ebalulekile ekunciphiseni ukungcoliswa komoya, futhi kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo. Lesi simo siphinde sibe ngumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuthi, noma izinselelo zikhona, umphakathi ungenza uma kubhekwa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlanganyela. Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile kube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yomphakathi kudinga ubudlelwano obunempumelelo phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Lesi sihloko sikhombisa ukuthi nakuba isikhathi sokubambezeleka sikhona ezinkampanini eziningi, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela kwephrojekthi kungaba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu. Uhlelo lokuhlanganyela, ubudlelwano obunempumelelo, kanye nezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuphatha kwaholela ekwakheni umsebenzi ophumelelayo, okwagcina sekubangela impumelelo yephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile. Le miphumela ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingaqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain I-Gautrain iyindlela yokuhamba esheshayo, efaneleka kakhulu emiphakathini yaseGauteng, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweJozini nePretoria. Le ndlela yokuhamba ibalulekile ngoba ihlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo, oluthembekile, nolungabizi, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokusebenza. Nokho, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kudingeka ukuthi i-Gautrain yandiswe ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabahambi. Ukubaluleka Kwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain Ukukhula komphakathi, izikhungo zokusebenza, nezindawo zokuhlala kudinga ukuthi izinsiza zokuhamba zikhulise amandla azo. I-Gautrain, njengendlela yokuhamba, ibalulekile ekunciphiseni izithuthi emigwaqweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, nokunciphisa umoya ongcolisayo. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kuholele ekwandeni kokuhweba, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emisha. Izindawo Ezihlosiwe Zokwandiswa Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhuluma ngokuqhubeka neziteshi ezintsha ezizokwakhiwa ezindaweni ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo ezifana neCenturion, Midrand, kanye neEast Rand. Lezi zindawo zikhona ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, ezikhula ngokushesha, futhi zidinga izinsiza zokuhamba ezithembekile. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kulezi zindawo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Izinzuzo Zokwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain 1. Ukunciphisa Izithuthi Emigwaqweni: Ngokwandisa i-Gautrain, abantu bazoba nezinye izinketho zokuhamba, okuzokwenza kube nokuncipha kwezithuthi emigwaqweni. Lokhu kuzoholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokuhamba, njengezithuthi eziningi ezimigwaqweni. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokusebenza, okuzokwenza kube nokukhula komnotho. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi emisha, okuzothuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. 3. Ukwandisa Izinsiza Zokuhamba: I-Gautrain iyindlela yokuhamba esheshayo, futhi ngokwandiswa kwayo, abantu bazoba nezinye izinketho zokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu. 4. Ukwandisa Ukutholakala Kwezinsiza: Ngokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, izindawo ezikude nezikhungweni ezinkulu zizothola ukufinyelela okungcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izindleko Nokuxhaswa Kwezimali Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzodinga izimali ezinkulu. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlinzekwa ngoxhaso lwezimali, kungaba kuhulumeni, ezinkampanini, noma ngababambiqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zindleko, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona futhi zisetshenziswa kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlangano ezihlanganyela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Izinyathelo Zokwakha Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzodinga izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi: 1. Ukwenziwa Kwezifundo Zokuhlola: Kubalulekile ukwenza izifundo zokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo ezihlosiwe ziyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. 2. Ukwakhiwa Kweziteshi Ezintsha: Iziteshi ezintsha zizodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela kalula ezindaweni ezihlosiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo emiphakathini. 3. Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi: Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyahlangatshezwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uyaziswa ngalezi zinhlelo. 4. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Gautrain iyasinda, kudingeka izinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Isiphetho Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuhamba eGauteng. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kokuhamba, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emisha. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu, futhi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Gautrain iyasinda futhi iyathuthukiswa.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Isingeniso Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, owamukelwa ukuze uthuthukise izinqubo zokhetho nezokubhaliswa kwabavoti, ulethe izinguquko eziningi ezibalulekile kumthetho wokhetho. Nokho, lezi zinguquko ziye zahlala nezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Le dokhumenti igxile ekuchazeni izinselelo ezithinta lo mthetho, izizathu ezisemqoka eziholela kulezi zinselelo, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 1. Ukungaqondi kahle izinguquko Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ukuwaqonda kahle amazwi nemigomo ethile. Abanye abantu, ikakhulukazi abavoti nabamele, bahlala benokungaqondi kahle ukuthi izinguquko zisho ukuthini empeleni. Lokhu kuhlangene nokungabi nolwazi olwakhiwe kahle, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuphazamiseka ezinqubweni zokhetho. Kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imikhankaso yokwazisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyawuqonda umthetho. 2. Izinsiza zokubhaliswa Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act uphinde wacacisa izinqubo zokubhaliswa kwabavoti, kodwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala ziphansi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nesibalo esiphansi sabavoti ababhala ngaphambi kokhetho. Ukuze kube nokubhaliswa okuphelele, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele, ezifaka phakathi izikhungo zokubhaliswa ezitholakalayo, imikhankaso yokukhangisa, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zokuxhumana. 3. Ubuthakathaka bezinqubo zokhetho Izinqubo ezivamile zokhetho, ezifaka phakathi lezi ezithinta ukuhlela, ukusabalalisa, nokuphathwa kwemiphumela, ziye zaba nzima njengoba umthetho uthuthuka. Lokhu kudala ukungahleleki nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwama-komidi okhetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi yokhetho iyahamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela kabusha lezi zinqubo, kufaka phakathi ukuqeqesha abakhethiweyo ukuthi basebenze kahle. 4. Izinkinga zokuphepha Uhlelo lokuvota lungabekwa engcupheni uma kunganakwa izinkinga zokuphepha. Ukushintshwa kwabantu emigqeni yokuvota, ukuqinisekiswa kwabavoti, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha imiphumela, kudinga ukuqashelwa okukhulu. Izinselelo zokuphepha zingaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuvota nokuphetha kwezinkinga zokhetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile kwezokuphepha, kuhlanganise nomthetho ophathelene nezinsizakalo zokuphepha eziphelele. 5. Ukuhluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho Ukuze umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo eziphethe izindaba zokhetho. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kudingeka izinhlelo ezihlelekile zokuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwemikhiqizo yokhetho, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Ukuhluleka kokubambisana kungaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuvota kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha ezinzima. Izinyathelo Zokuxazulula Izinselelo 1. Ukuqinisa imikhankaso yokwazisa Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zokubambisana, imikhankaso yokwazisa ingabekwa emqoka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nezakhamuzi ukuze ziphumelele ekubhaliseni. Ukwakha izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukubamba imihlangano emphakathini, kanye nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulabo abangakabhalisile. 2. Ukwandisa izinsiza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti banethuba lokubhaliswa, izinsiza zokubhaliswa kufanele zande. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezikhungo zokubhaliswa eziningi, imikhankaso yokukhangisa, kanye nezinsiza ezibambekayo ezinokuthola kalula. Ukubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezokuxhumana, kanye nezinye izinhlangano kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela. 3. Ukwenza kube lula izinqubo zokhetho Ukuze kugwenywe ubuthakathaka bezinqubo zokhetho, kunesidingo sokuhlela kabusha lezi zinqubo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okuqhubekayo kumalunga ama-komidi okhetho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-manuals nezinsiza zokusebenza, kanye nokufaka ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yokhetho. 4. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima kufanele zisetshenziswe. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola izinsiza, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha kumaphoyisa, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubo zokuphepha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabavoti. 5. Ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokhetho ziqhubeka kahle, kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukusungula imihlangano evamile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana ezizokwenza kube lula ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivela. Isiphetho Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ulethe izinguquko ezibalulekile emkhakheni wezokhetho, kodwa uhlanganisa nezinselelo eziningi ezidinga ukunakwa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lo mthetho uyafezeka, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima, singathuthukisa imiphumela yokhetho futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ufinyelela izinhloso zawo.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Umxoxisi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngibe lapha namuhla. Ngifuna sikhulume ngempela ngezizinselelo ezihambisana nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act. Ungangichazela ukuthi yini le mthetho, futhi kungani ubalulekile? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. I-Electoral Amendment Act iwumthetho ohloswe ngawo ukuthuthukisa indlela yokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Uhloswe ukusiza ekwenzeni ukuthi ukhetho kube sobala, kube nekhwalithi, futhi kube nezindlela ezinhle zokubhalisela ukuvota. Nokho, kuningi okukhuluma ngalesi sikhumbuzo, futhi kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nawo. Umxoxisi: Ngabe ungakuchaza kahle lezi zinselelo? Umphenyi: Yebo, ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ukuze umthetho ufezeke, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele, ezinjengemali, abasebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu akukhona njalo, futhi izifunda eziningi zihlupheka kakhulu ngezinsiza ezikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokhetho. Ingabe kukhona okunye okukhathazayo? Umphenyi: Yebo, okunye okukhathazayo yizinkinga zokuhlanganiswa kwedatha. Umthetho ubeka izidingo ezinzima zokuhlanganiswa kwedatha yokhetho, kodwa izinhlelo ezikhona akukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngedatha efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zokuvota, futhi kungase kubangele ukuphazamiseka ekuphathweni kokhetho. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona. Ngabe kukhona nezinye izinselelo ezihlobene nezepolitiki? Umphenyi: Impela. Izinselelo zezombusazwe zibalulekile. Abanye abantu bangase baphikise le mthetho ngenxa yokuthi bakholelwa ukuthi izinguquko ezithile zingathinta izikhundla zabo. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukuvumelana. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umthetho awunqamuki, kodwa udinga ukuxhaswa ngempela. Ingabe kukhona izindlela ezithile zokuthuthukisa lezi zinselelo? Umphenyi: Yebo, ziningi izindlela. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlinzeka ngensiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka izinsiza ezithile ezivela emiphakathini, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni zokuvota. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle bukhona. Ngabe kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikhulume ngakho? Umphenyi: Yebo, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act awuqondakali kuphela kumalungu ezepolitiki. Ubuye uthetheleleke kubantu bonke, futhi kufanele kube nokwaziswa okwanele ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi le mthetho izosiza kanjani. Lokhu kuzodinga imikhankaso yokwazisa, ukuze abantu bazi izinzuzo zalesi sikhumbuzo. Umxoxisi: Ngabe umthetho ungathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi? Umphenyi: Yebo, umthetho ungathuthukiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kusize ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokhetho. Umxoxisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngabe kukhona okokugcina ofuna ukusho? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuphetha ngokukhumbuza ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ungumsebenzi obalulekile. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudingeka ukuthi bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi abaholi, basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinselelo zixazululwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokhetho olungcono, nolusiza umphakathi wonke. Umxoxisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyawuhalalisela umsebenzi wakho, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle.
Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Ukusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail kunendima ebalulekile ekuhwebeni nasekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zokuthutha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe umnotho ophelele. Nokho, le misebenzi ibhekene nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga ukusizakala ngazo ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Lapha, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuqonda nokuphatha lezi zinselelo. ### Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Izinselelo Ukuze uqonde kahle izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela, kubalulekile ukuhlolela lezi zinto ezilandelayo: - Izimo Zesikhala: Kubalulekile ukuba uhlole izimo zesikhala ngenxa yokuthi izinkinga zendawo zingaholela ekutheni izitimela zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhamba. - Izinsiza Zokugcina: Qiniseka ukuthi izinsiza zokugcina zikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinto ezifana nezitimela eziningi, imithwalo nezitimela ezihamba phambili. - Izinkinga Zobuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe obuphuma phezulu bungase bube nomthelela ekusebenzeni kwezitimela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zamakhompyutha ziyahambisana kuyadingeka. ### Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlelwa Kwezinsizakalo Ngemuva kokuhlonza izinselelo, uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza kufanele lwenziwe ukuze kubhekelwe izimo ezithile: - Ukuhlelwa Kokusebenza: Gcizelela ukuhlelwa kwezimoto ukuze uthole ukuthi yiziphi ezidingekayo endaweni ethile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezimali luhlala luhlangene, ukuze ube nezezimali ezanele zokusebenza kwezitimela. - Ukubambisana Nabanye: Kuhle ukwakha ubuhlakani phakathi kwezinkampani ezithutha imithwalo, ngoba lokhu kuzogqugquzela ukusebenza kahle. ### Isinyathelo 3: Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Abasebenzi banendima ebalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kwezitimela. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi basebenza kahle, lezi zinyathelo kufanele zicatshangwe: - Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukwenza ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze baqonde izinqubo ezihlukahlukene nokuqonda izingozi ezenzeka. - Izinhlelo Zokuhlola: Beka izinhlelo zokuhlola ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kuyathinteka yini emsebenzini. - Imiklomelo Nokuqwashisa: Phakamisa imiklomelo ukuze uthokozise ukusebenza kahle nokuzinikela kwabasebenzi. ### Isinyathelo 4: Ukusebenzisa Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe bujwayelekile emhlabeni wanamuhla futhi bungasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwezitimela: - Izinhlelo Zokulawula: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokulawula ezihamba phambili ukuze uphathe izitimela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela ephumelelayo. - Ubuchwepheshe Be-Tracking: Faka ubuchwepheshe bokulandelela ukudla ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imithwalo ithunyelwa ngesikhathi. - Ukubambisana Nezinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Hlanganyela nezinkampani ezikhethekile bobuchwepheshe ukuze uthole izixazululo eziphumelelayo nezisemqoka. ### Isinyathelo 5: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukusebenza kuhlelekile, izinyathelo zokubuyekezwa kwezimali zidingeka: - Ukuhlola Imali Engenayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlole imali engenayo njalo ukuze uthole izinkinga eziphakeme. - Ukunciphisa Izindleko: Faka izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihamba kahle ngesikhathi esifanayo. - Ukwenza Izibalo Zokusebenza: Qhathanisa izibalo zokusebenza ukuze ubone izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. ### Isinyathelo 6: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuphepha Ukuphepha kwempahla nokuhamba kwezitimela kufanele kube ukuhlanganyela: - Izivivinyo Zokuphepha: Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izitimela zihlolwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. - Ukwenza Amathuluzi Okuphepha: Vula izinhlelo zokuphumelela kuphrojekthi yezehlakalo ukuze unciphise ubungozi bokusebenza. - Ulwazi Nokuqwashisa Ngenhlekelele: Nikeza abasebenzi ulwazi lokuthola nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. ### Isinyathelo 7: Ubufakazi Bokusebenza Ukugcina ikhono lokusebenza kwesitimela, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubufakazi bokusebenza: - Ukubuyekezwa Kwemiphumela: Hlela ukubuyekezwa kwemiphumela ukuze uqonde ukuthi ibhizinisi lisenza kahle kangakanani. - Amaphrojekthi Wokuthuthukisa: Qhuba amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa onke amakhono nezinsizakalo ezitholakala. - Ukubambisana Nabasindisa: Hlanganyela nabaqeqeshi nabasindisa ukuze uthole okokusebenza nokubuyekezwa ### Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqhubeka Nelson Ukwamukela izimo ezizayo, kudingeka ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza: - Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lwakho: Bhalela phansi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi usebenza kahle. - Ukujwayela Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe: Bezelwe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, bese uqhubeka ubuyekeza uhlelo lwakho. - Izinhlelo Zokuphatha: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ukuqhuba imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. ### Isiphetho Ukwenza kahle kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail kuncike ekuphathweni kahle kwezinselelo ezibhekene nakho. Ngokuqonda izinyathelo ezibalulekile nezindlela zokusebenza, inkampani inganqoba lezi zinselelo futhi iqhubekele phambili emsebenzini wayo. Ngalolu lwazi, iTransnet Freight Rail ingazi ukuthi ithuthuka kahle futhi iqhuba umsebenzi wayo ngendlela engcono.
Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kungamanga ukuthi ukungasebenzi kwentsha kube yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ithinta izigidi zabantu abasha futhi ithinta kwazulu danosube, ikakhulukazi emzamweni wabo wokufuna imisebenzi. Ukuze sihlonze izizathu ezisemqoka eziholela kulokhu, umcabango ophucukile udinga ukubhekwa. Okokuqala, ukukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha kuhlobene nokuqhamuka kwezinhlelo zokufunda eziphezulu. Abantu abaningi baqeda izifundo eziningi, kodwa uma befika emhlabeni wokusebenza, behlangabezana nenkinga yokungatholi izikhala eziyimfanelo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziguqule ukuhlakulela amakhono ahambelana nezidingo zemakethe. Umthetho wobuchwepheshe uphinde uveze ukuthi imfundo kufanele ikhulise amakhono awusizo okungasebenzi, ukuze khona ukufika okungapheli emsebenzini. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zezomnotho ezinzima zibeka umthwalo omkhulu kulesi sikhala. Ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, izinkinga zokukhula komnotho, kanye nezinhlekelele ezinjengezimo ze-Covid-19 zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kufaka umfutho omubi kwezobuhlakani, ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezikhundla ezintsha. Umphakathi kufanele uhlaziye lokhu ukuze uhlonze izixazululo ezinhle zalesi simo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuphila zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nemithetho eqinile yokusiza, nazo zibalulekile. Inani elikhulu labantu abasha abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-township alahlekelwe yithuba lokuthi baphumelele emsebenzini. Lezi zimo ziqhubeka ziqinisa ukungasebenzi kwentsha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okukhulu kogesi kwabazwelonke nezifunda ezibalulekile. Umphakathi wezepolitiki unendima enkulu ekukhiqizeni izixazululo. Imibono yesikhumbuzo nemfundo kukhombisa ukuthi njengoba izinhlelo zomphakathi nezezimali ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuyekethisa izinqubomgomo ezikhethekile ezigxile ekufundeni nasekuqeqesheni. Lokhu kuzokwenyusa amathuba okusebenza सहज. Ukuze kubaluleke, kufanele kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zamasiko nezomnotho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo iyahambisana nezidingo zempilo. Ngaphezu kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiz resources, ukuhweba nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu basendaweni basize bazakhele amakhono. Ukuze lokho kudluliselwe empilweni yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngeziqu nezinhlelo ezihlinzekwa ngamathuba angcono okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe impi yokungasebenzi. Imali ethile kufanele ihlinzeke izifunda ezinomthelela omkhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana nabantu abasha bahlala bejolise emgibeni wokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuphatha, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngezinyathelo zokuqapha, kudinga ukuthi zibukwiswe ngokukhalipha. Umphakathi wezomnotho uzoba nesandla ekwakheni umsebenzi, uma kubhekwa izindlela ezizokwazi ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abasha futhi baphinde bakwazi ukuxhuma nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwenza abatekenya. Ekuhlaziyeni kwesimo sokutholakala kwentsha, kudinga ukubhekiselwa ezinhlelweni ezenzakalelayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuthaza uhlelo lokubjobiya ezikhundleni ezintsha, ukujikijela izifundo ezimfushane zokusebenza, nezinye izinhlelo ezikwenziwayo zokwakha indawo yokusebenza engcono nesikhala. Lokhu kuzokwenza umuntu ngamunye akwazi ukubona intuthuko, okuzenzakalelayo kunciphisa indlela yokusebenza eziningi. Ukufingqa, ukuhlola izimo ezizwakalayo nezokungasebenzi kwentsha kumele kube ugqozi oluqinile emphakathini nabaphathiswa. Iphalamende, izinkampani, nezinkampani zomphakathi kudinga ukuba baxhumane futhi bakhe izinkambiso ezizokhulisa iscripe sesikhathi esizayo. Uma siphuma kulesi simo, sizoba neziphumo ezihlangene, nezinhlelo ezenzakalelayo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwentsha. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olusemthethweni, oluqinile nolwanelisayo, ukuze kwenzeke ukuguqulwa okudingekayo empilweni yabantu abasha. Ngalokhu, sizodinga ukuqhubeka nokuxoxisana, noma ngabe kuhlelwe imihlangano erhubhulayo nezinhlelo eziphambili, ukuze sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinethuba lokusebenza, noluthokozisayo. Iphalamende kudinga ukuba ibonisane ukuze zenzeke izinxephezelo, ukuze izinkampani, uhulumeni, nemiphakathi ibonakale ixhumene ndawonye ekwandiseni izikhala ezikhona. Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezinhle zemisebenzi, ezihlonza umsebenzi nenhlalakahle, kuzohlala kusemqoka. Ngakho-ke, ngazo zonke lezi zinkinga, sinesidingo sokuhleleka, ukuphikelela, nokuhlonza izixazululo, ukuze sithumele umyalezo wokuthi intsha yethu ingamaheliwe. Izinqubomgomo ezimfanele nezisizayo kungama-tools, ukuze sithumele izisho ezizokwenza isimo sibe ngcono. Lokhu kuyacaca – sizodinga ukwakha izinkonzo ezinobuhlakani nesizinda esiqinile, ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuwina empilweni, ithola amathuba okwenza kube ngcono futhi yakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imiphumela yokubambisana kwe-Life Esidimeni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicimbi ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo ibenze umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Okwenzeka e-Life Esidimeni kwaqala njengohlelo lokuhlala, kodwa kwagcina sekuba yinkinga enkulu ngenxa yokungahambisani nemigomo ethile yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuhlukanisweni kwabantu abaninzi ezikhungweni zokuphumula, okuvuselela ukucaciswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zempilo. Ngemuva kokuphikisana nokuhlukumezeka, kwavulwa ithuba lokuxazulula izinkinga ngendlela engemthethweni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komcimbi wokulamula ogxile ekutholeni izixazululo ezizuzisayo kubantu abathintekayo. Umcimbi obalulekile kule nqubo kube yisigameko sokuqala sokubhekelela izinkinga ezitholakala ezikhungweni zezeMpilo, lapho iziguli zophila zaziwa ngokuqhathwa. Ekuqaleni, imisebenzi yokulamula ibihlose ukuphucula izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola induduzo. Lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Abamele umphakathi, izikhungo zempilo, neminyango ezinzima bekwazi ukuhweba ngempumelelo ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zamalungelo abantu abathintekayo. Ukuqala kwezinkulumo kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwecala elihle lokuxoxa ngemicabango ehlukeneyo. Uhlelo lokwamukela izikhalazo lwaluhlose ukugqugquzela umbono wokuthi imiphumela efanele kuncike emgomeni ohlangene. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima ezithinta iziguli, kufaka phakathi ukungabi namathuba okulawulwa kwezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nomdlandla wokwabelana ng experiences zabo, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethuthukisayo eyasiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yeziguli ezikwi-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqhakambisa amalungelo abantu, kanye nezinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela iziguli ezibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Umphakathi wahlanganyela ekwenzeni izicwangciso ezithile ezibheke phambili. Uhlelo lokuhlola izimpilo, ukuhweba ngempumelelo, kanye nokuhlangabezana kokufundisa abathintekayo kwavela njengezici ezibalulekile zokuzama ukuphendula lesi simo. Izidingo zempilo zabantu zafakwa eziphethweni ezithakazelisayo, kwaholela ekutheni imiphumela yokulamula ku-Life Esidimeni ingene ngempela emiphakathini ejabulayo. Ngokuphumelela kokuzenzakalelayo, umcimbi wokulamula ubeke isibonelo sokuthi empeleni kwenzeka kanjani ukuhweba ngempumelelo ezindabeni ezinzima. Ukufundisa kanye nezifundo ezatholakalayo zabe ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezidingekayo zisunguliwe ukuze kubhekwe izimpilo ezifuna ukwenziwa, okuhlinzeka nogqozi lwempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zempilo, ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuthola amalungelo abantu, nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abathintekayo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele.
