Izingozi neziphukhuphuku ezibandakanyekayo kule miphumela ziqhuba umcabango odinga ukwenziwa. Lokhu kuvumele ukugxila ekubuyiseni kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela iziguli ezihloniphekile. Umphakathi ube senkambisweni yokubuyiseka, kwazulu kumele kube nefuthe elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu. Ngokuphetha, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni isivele ijwayele ukubaluleka okukhulu emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zezempilo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bahlala bemthokozisa, futhi bakwazi ukuthola impilo enempilo, kulindeleke ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, kudinga ukuba nezinye izinyathelo ezijulile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kuhlola kwempilo akupheli kuphela, kepha kuhlale kuqhuba phambili imiphakathi ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga ezithinta abantu. Umlando uzohlala ukhuluma ngalezi zinyathelo ezibalulekile ezithintekayo, njengoba kuyinto ebalulekile ephezu kwezincwadi ezikhuluma ngempilo. Ngamafuphi, ukubhalwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthuka kwempilo nokukhuthazwa kwemigomo ethuthukisayo kumele kube sezingeni eliphezulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ayisizi kuphela, kepha iphinde ibeke isizinda esiqinile sokuphila kwemiphakathi emisha.
Umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State UMhlaba wezolimo eFree State uthinteka kakhulu izimo zezulu, ikakhulukazi kumkhiqizo wezolimo. Isomiso, indlala esheshayo emanzini, sishiye umthelela omkhulu ezitsheni, kukhulu kakhulukazi njengemiphumela yeClimate Change. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wesomiso kwezolimo kudinga ukubheka zonke izici ezihambisana nezimo zokutshala, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqizayo ezifana nezitshalo, izinkomo, nezinyoni. Ukwanda kwesomiso empeleni kubalulekile, ngoba kugcizelela imiphumela emibi kubalimi, okubenza bahlupheke kakhulu. Ngonyaka ka-2022, izinga lokushisa eliphezulu, kanye nesomiso, kwaholela ekunciphiseni komkhiqizo wezolimo, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo yabantu abaningi. Ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kuyiwona msebenzi omkhulu wezolimo eFree State, njengoba izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule. Ukungabi namanzi okwanele kuholela ekutheni izitshalo zingathuthukisi kahle. Ngokwendlela umhlaba ozolimo ushintsha ngayo, sithola imiphumela emibi kwizindlela zokwakha, ukuzinakekela, kanye nemisebenzi yokulima. Kukhona nezinkundla eziveza izindaba zabalimi okukhuluma ngazo. Izinkulumo zahlanganiswa nomnotho wezolimo – umkhiqizo ophuma ezoliminini kanye nezimali ezitholakala ngemikhiqizo ethengiswa ezitolo. Ubuye ukwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zezimali zomkhakha wezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nezimo ezijwayelekile. Ukwanda kwesomiso kungaholela ekutheni, izitshalo ezithile zingakwazi ukufakwa emkhakheni wezolimo. Imiphumela emnandi, ngempela, ubonakalisa ukuthi izimfuno zokuhlanga zikhuphuka; kodwa ngemva kokuhla kwechungechunge, abanye abalimi bebheka izitshalo ezidliwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye bakhuluma ngokudinga izixazululo esimeme - ezihlanganisa izitshalo ezidinga amanzi amancane. Lokhu kubalulekile kumhlaba wezolimo eFree State. Ukufana kakhulu, uma sikhuluma ngalesi simo, kuphinde kube nezinselelo zokukhiqiza. Izitshalo ezingaphumeleli kahle kungenzeka zishiye abafundi bejabulile kuphela uma zikhona izinkomo ezincane. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokulima nemikhankaso yokuthola amanzi, okukhuthaza ukuzikhandla komphakathi. Phambilini phakathi nyaka, abanye abalimi basixhume izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalimi anikwa usizo oludingekayo. Nokho, kwezokuthutha, umthelela wesomiso ezingadini ezithile uphinde ube nomthelela. Ukwehla kokuhamba kwezimpahla kubalulekile, njengoba izimpahla ezingalungiswanga kungabathinti abathengi. Izinsuku zokusizakala kuncipha kodwa ungakwazi ukukhokha, ushintsho luveza izinzuzo zamabhizinesi nezimboni ukudala izimo ezithile ezisezingeni. Ngalokhu, umnotho wezolimo uyanda, kodwa ubungozi bemvelo bushayisana nempilo yomphakathi. Ezakhamuzini, umthelela wesomiso ubonakala nakwiqembu labalimi; lokhu okuqukethwe kumkhakha wezolimo. Abalimi banelisekile ngezimo ezibalulekile zomhlaba, ngenkathi bephicha izinkinga ezivela ezimweni ezinzima zokuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abanye balimi bathola izindlela ezithuthukile zokusebenza, ukuze badlule kulezi zimo ezinzima. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabanye, umthelela wesomiso uzokwandisa futhi uzowela kokubili okuphehlwa kwamanzi. Uma kuhlangene iziftsuko, ukuqhamuka kwezimo ezinhle kuhlale kulindelekile. Umphakathi uyamukeleka, idlanzana labalimi lekhono libhalwa ndawonye; okungase kube nomthelela omuhle emkhakheni wokulima nokukhiqiza. Ngokungakhathali kumele kube nesimangalo sokuvumelana nezimo. Kubalulekile ukuthi oteza ukuhamba phambili naye. Kulezi zimo, abesifazane nabesilisa baye bayaphumelela mudzanga ngemisebenzi yabo yezezimali, ngakho-ke umphakathi ufunda izifundo ezithile ezichaza ubuchopho nophoqelelo wezokuthengisa. Ekugcineni, umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State uphakamisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezidingayo ukubhekwa ngokuphumelelayo. Umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zoLimo, abezindaba, noMkhandlu waseFree State usetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisizayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukholo kwempilo yokudla, bonke bezokwazi ukunqanda umthelela wezimo zezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezithuthukile zokulima, ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekise ukuhlala komphakathi okuhle ngumthombo wokusebenza kokukhula komnotho. Umphakathi wezolimo eFree State kufanele uphinde ubhekele phambili ukuze ubone indlela yokuphefumula kwezimo ezinzima zempilo ngesikhathi esifanele, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle ekukhiqizeni. Siyavuma ukuthi umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State ungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo engeyona imfashini, kanye nokwakha umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuzodala isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwemboni yezolimo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo kanye nezinga lokuphila kwabantu.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala 1. Isingeniso I-Eskom iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kubalulekile ukuthi iqoqe izikweletu ezikhokhwayo kumasipala. Le dokhumenti ibonisa izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezizothathwa ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu kumasipala, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bayakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo. 2. Inhloso Inhloso yale dokhumenti iwukuchaza izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu kumasipala, kuhlanganise nezinyathelo zokuxhumana, ukuhlela, nokuphatha izikweletu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza, ukunciphisa izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe, nokwandisa imali engenayo ye-Eskom. 3. Izinyathelo Zokuhlela 3.1 Ukuhlonza Izikweletu - Qala ngokuhlola uhlu lwezikweletu ezikhokhwayo kumasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikweletu ezikhokhwayo ezivela kumakhasimende ahlukene, izikhungo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlobene. - Bheka izikhathi zokukhokha ezihlukene, ukuze uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izikweletu ezidinga ukunakwa okuphuthumayo. 3.2 Ukuxhumana Nabasizi - Thumela izaziso kumasipala mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya izincwadi, ama-imeyili, noma izikhangiso ezisemphakathini. - Qinisekisa ukuthi abathengi banolwazi olunembile mayelana nezikweletu zabo, izinsuku zokukhokha, kanye nezinyathelo ezizothathwa uma izikweletu zingakhokhwa. 4. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izikweletu 4.1 Ukuqoqwa Kwezikweletu - Hlela imihlangano yokuhlanganyela nabaphathi bamakhaya ukuze baxoxisane ngezindlela zokukhokha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezikweletu. - Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze uqoqe izikweletu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izikweletu, ukulandela izinkokhelo, nokubika izimo ezithile. 4.2 Ukuqinisekisa Ukukhokha - Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo ezitholakele ziqinisekiswa ngokushesha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezitholakalayo. - Bheka izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bayakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo. 5. Izinyathelo Zokuxazulula Izinkinga 5.1 Ukuxhumana Nabathengi - Uma umthengi engakhokhi, thumela izaziso ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuzobavusa ukuthi bakhokhe izikweletu zabo. - Hlela imihlangano yokuxoxisana nabathengi ukuze baxazulule izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene. 5.2 Ukusebenzisa Izinyathelo Zomthetho - Uma izikweletu zingakhokhwa, sebenzisa izinyathelo zomthetho ezisemthethweni ukuze uqoqe izikweletu. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukufaka izicelo enkantolo ukuze uthole imvume yokubuyisa izikweletu. - Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zomthetho zilandela imithetho nemigomo efanele. 6. Ukuhlola Nokubika 6.1 Ukuhlola Izinyathelo Zokuhlela - Hlela ukuhlola njalo izinqubo zokuhlela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. - Bheka izibalo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ukuze uqonde ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa kanjani. 6.2 Ukubika Imiphumela - Bhala imibiko ethile mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwa kumasipala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubaphathi be-Eskom. - Thumela imibiko kumasipala ukuze bazi ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa kanjani, nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe. 7. Isiphetho Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala libalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, i-Eskom izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uphumelele.
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba wezokusebenza ushintshile kakhulu, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukungabazeka. Ukusebenza ukude, okwaziwa nangokuthi yi-remote work, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezinkampanini eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuveza izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba siqaphele nezinselelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngezizathu eziholela ekutheni abantu bakhethe ukusebenza ukude. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu yikhono lokuphila impilo engcono. Ukusebenza ukude kuvumela abantu ukuba bahlale emakhaya, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bagcine isikhathi esiningi sokuchitha nezingane zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezweni elinokuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezomnotho, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngenxa yokungabi namathuba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza ukude kudala amathuba okusebenza kubantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani zingathola abasebenzi abakhono kakhulu, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo abahlala kuyo. Lokhu kuveza ithuba lokwakha ithimba elihlukahlukene, elinokuhlukahluka kwezizinda, izinkolelo, namakhono, okwenza izinkampani zibe nekhono lokuphendula kahle ezimfuno zomhlaba jikelele. Nokho, ukusebenza ukude akukhululi ezinkampanini ezithile ezibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Ngenkathi izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi baxhumana kahle, akusizi uma umoya wokubambisana ungatholakali. Ukusebenza ukude kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bazizwe behlukanisiwe, okunganciphisa umoya wokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza ukude kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele zokuxhasa abasebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngama-computer, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma izinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, abasebenzi bangase babe nezinselelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi wabo, okungaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqiza. Kodwa, uma izinkampani ziqonda kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga zokusebenza ukude, zingakwazi ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube lula. Ukuze izinkampani zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela imihlangano evamile, noma ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikuvumela ukuthi uxhume nabanye abasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bazizwe bejabulile futhi bephumelela emsebenzini wabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, izifundo, noma amathuba okukhula emsebenzini kungasiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Kubhalwe futhi ukuthi ukusebenza ukude akusho ukuthi abasebenzi badinga ukusebenza isikhathi eside. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukujabulisa imisebenzi yabo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika kuyithuba elikhulu, kodwa kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Uma izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukisa abasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, zingakwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi zibe neqhaza elikhulu emnothweni. Ukusebenza ukude akusiyo nje indlela yokusebenza, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi kufanele sithathe leli thuba ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV Licence ye-SABC Isingeniso Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC (South African Broadcasting Corporation) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nhlangano iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthokozisa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, kunezimpikiswano eziningi ezibhekene nale ndaba. Lezi zimpikiswano zifaka phakathi izinzuzo, ubungozi, nemiphumela yokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Umqondo we-TV Licence Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-TV licence iyini. I-TV licence iyimali ekhokhwa yibo bonke abanikazi bama-TV ukuze bathole ukufinyelela kumabonakude we-SABC. Le mali isiza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokubuka, izindaba, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Isinyathelo 2: Izizathu Zokuxhasa I-TV Licence 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimali: I-TV licence iyisizinda esibalulekile sokwakha imali engenayo ye-SABC. Le mali isiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezikhona, ukwakha izinhlelo ezintsha, nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumabonakude. 2. Ukwaneliseka Kwab viewers: Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluhle nolwanelisayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilaleli zihlala zikhumbula i-SABC. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni: I-SABC iyisikhungo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izimboni zendawo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukweseka abaculi bendawo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuciko. Isinyathelo 3: Izinkinga Nezimpikiswano Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC. 1. Ukungaboni Ngasolinye: Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwe-TV licence akufanele kube umthetho. Bakholelwa ukuthi abantu kufanele bakhethe uma befuna ukukhokha noma cha, futhi abanye bakhuluma ngokuthi izinhlelo ze-SABC azihambisani nezifiso zabo. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Kukhona ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali ye-SABC. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi imali ethathwa nge-TV licence ayisetshenziswanga kahle, futhi kunezinkinga eziningi zokuphathwa kwezimali ezikhona. 3. Ukwanda Kwezinketho: Ngokuvamile, abantu bahlala benokukhetha okuningi kwezokuxhumana, okwenza kube nzima ukuba i-SABC igcine izilaleli zayo. Ukukhula kwezinkampani ezizimele nezokuxhumana kwenza kube nzima ukuba i-SABC ikwazi ukuheha izilaleli. Isinyathelo 4: Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa 1. Ukwenza Ngcono Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Kubalulekile ukuthi i-SABC ithuthukise ukuphathwa kwayo kwezimali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusebenzisa imali ethola nge-TV licence, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lisebenza kahle. 2. Ukukhuluma Nezithameli: I-SABC kufanele ibambisane nezithameli zayo ukuze iqonde izidingo zabo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwenziwa kwezifundo zocwaningo ukuze kuhlonishwe imicabango nezidingo zabantu. 3. Ukwanda Kwezinhlelo Zokuthokozisa: Ukuze i-SABC ikwazi ukuheha izilaleli, kufanele ikhulise imikhankaso yokuthokozisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezithameli ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zentsha, ezokuthokozisa, nezokufundisa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nezithameli Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezithameli kubalulekile. I-SABC kufanele ikhulume ngokuqhubekayo nezithameli zayo, ibanike ithuba lokuphendula, nokubavumela ukuthi bazise ngemibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo futhi ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zikhombisa ukuthi le ndaba ibalulekile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kunemiphumela eminingi, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi i-SABC ithuthukise izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ihlinzeka ngohlelo oluhambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-SABC izokwazi ukuheha izilaleli zayo, iqinise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuba yinsika ebalulekile kwezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika.
IDOKHUMENTI YENQUBOMGO: IZINGXABANO ZAMAHOLO EMKHAKHENI KAHULUMENI Isingeniso Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zibe isihloko esivusa amathuba okuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlangano zabasebenzi, ohulumeni, kanye nabanye abakhiqizi bezinsiza. Ukuze sithole umqondo ophelele ngalezi zingxabano, kudingeka sikhumbule izici ezahlukahlukene ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa, ukuphathwa nokwenziwa kwezimali zendlela yokuphila yabasebenzi ababambisene nohulumeni, kanye nombono omkhulu wokuhlinzeka ngemigomo ethuthukisa izimo zokusebenza. Izingxabano zamaholo nezizathu zazo Izingxabano zamaholo zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa: 1. Amathemba Obungcweti: Abasebenzi banelungelo lokulindela ukuthi amaholo afaneleke ukuze ahambisane nezindleko zokuphila, imfuno yokukhuphuka kwesikhwama sokugcina, kanye nezinkokhelo ezincane, okwenza kube lula ukuziphilisa. 2. Amaphutha Emigomweni: Ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo engacacile mayelana namaholo, izikhala ezingenakuhambisana nezinye izixazululo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, kunomthelela ekukhuleni kokuphikiswa phakathi kwezinkathazo zabasebenzi nohulumeni. 3. Izidingo Zokukhushulwa: Ukukhushulwa kwamaholo kumchazela uhlelo lokusebenza okudingekayo, kukhuthaza umnotho, kunika amandla abasebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukuzikhandla, okuyizinto ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. 4. Ukwehla Kwemali: Izinselelo zezomnotho zenza kube nzima ukugcina amaholo, ngenxa yokwehla kwelanga, okuholela ekukhuleni kwezimali ezincane ezitholakalayo ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga zomphakathi. Umthelela Wokungabi Nezixazululo Ezingafanele Izingxabano zamaholo ezinqandekile zingaholela emiphumeleni emibi ebalulekile: - Ukwehla Kwezemisebenzi: Uma izingxabano zihlala isikhathi eside, zikhuthaza ukwehla kwamathuba emisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko. - Ukungabi Nezithakazelo: Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwakhiwa kwezithakazelo eziseqhulwini, izinkampani zingasebenza phansi ukuze zifeze ukukhulisa inzuzo, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha ubudlelwano obumnyama nomphakathi. - Ukungezwani Nabaphathiswa: Uma imiphumela naso ibizwa ngokuthi ingalungile, kuyinkinga evamile yokungezwani phakathi kwabaphathiswa kanye nezinkampani ezikhuluma ngezingxabano zamaholo. Imizamo Yokuxazulula Izingxabano Zamahlengethu Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zingxabano, kubalulekile ukuba kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo: 1. Ubungcweti Bezinqubomgomo: Uhulumeni kufanele anake izidingo zabantu abavela kwezinye izindawo zokusebenza, isibonelo, izinkombandlela ezisemthethweni ezithinta amalungelo kanye nemiholo. 2. Ukusebenzisana Nabezindaba: Ukudalwa kwezinhlaka ezikhuthaza ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izinyunyana zabasebenzi, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzovumela ukuhlangana kwezindlela ezahlukene zokuxazulula izingxabano. 3. Ukwanda Kwenhlalakahle: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokwakha ukulinganiselwa phakathi kokusebenza, uma kubekwe imikhawulo ethile ezindleleni zokuhlola amaholo. Isiphakamiso Ukuze iHhovisi Kahulumeni lithole impumelelo ekuphathweni kwezingxabano zamaholo, kudingeka: - Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezempilo Nezimo Zokusebenza: Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezikhuthaza izindawo zokusebenza ezithembekile nezibhekelelayo, ngokuhlanganyela nabathintekayo. - Inhlonipho Yezinhlaka: Ukusheshisa ukubambisana nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezintsha ezithokozisayo. - Ukuvuselela Izinqubomgomo: Ukuhlola njalo izincomo ezitholakalayo ukuze kuxazulule izingxabano zamaholo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zizodingekayo kumazinga aphansi. Isiphetho Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kugweme umonakalo emnothweni nasezimpilweni zabasebenzi. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinsiza, izinyunyana, nohulumeni, kusiza ekubumbaneni izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokwenza uqinisekiso lwemiphumela emihle. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo kufanele zihambe ngokuhlanganyela, zisebenze ezingeni lohlelo, kanti lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukile nezilungiselelwe kahle. Ubuholi obunamandla, obusebenzisanayo nabazimele, buholela ekuphathweni kahle kwezinsizakusebenza nezinsiza, kubhekelela izidingo zabantu abadlalayo emkhakheni. Ngokwenza lezi zinguquko, sizokwazi ukusiza ekuqedeni izingxabano zamaholo, siphinde sigcine izinga eliphakeme lokuphila nempilo yokusebenza ezimbonini ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzofaka isandla empumelelweni yomnotho wethu nasemphakathini jikelele.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa I. Isingeniso Ezinye zezinselelo ezibalulekile zomhlaba wanamuhla zifaka phakathi ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, kanye nezinguquko zezulu. E-Nyakatho Kapa, lezi zinkinga zikhomba isidingo sokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa abheke ukusiza ukunciphisa ukuncikiswa kumamandla aphuma emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza impilo engcono kanye nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside. II. Uhlolojikelele lwezinhlelo zamandla avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ahlanganisa izinhlelo ezahlukene ezifana namandla elanga, amandla omoya, nokusetshenziswa kwamandla avela emithonjeni ye-hydro. Amandla elanga, njengemithombo ewusizo yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ayathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokutholakala kalula kwelanga, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu lokukhanya kwelanga. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amandla omoya azitholela ukubaluleka, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimvula ezinkulu. III. Amaphrojekthi amakhulu eNyakatho Kapa 1. Uhlelo lwamandla elanga eThekwini Uhlelo lwezokukhiqiza amandla elanga eThekwini luhlose ukwandisa ukuhlinzeka ngogesi wezimboni nezindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufakwa kwezinsiza zokukhiqiza amandla elanga ezindaweni ezinjengamasu amakhulu, izikole, nezikhungo zempilo. Izinzuzo zale nhlelo zifaka phakathi ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ukuphakamisa ukwaziqabukela, kanye nokwehlisa umthelela wokungcoliswa kwemvelo. 2. Uhlelo lwamandla omoya eBokkeveld Uhlelo lwamandla omoya eBokkeveld luhlinzeka ngomthombo othembekile wamandla, futhi lunomthelela omuhle emnothweni wakule ndawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izikhumbuzo zomoya ezakhiwe ngenqubo yokwakha eluhlaza, okukhuthaza ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungafani nokwendawo engavuselelekayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kuyilapho kunciphisa ukungcoliswa. 3. Uhlelo lwamanzi avela emithonjeni ye-hydro eCeres Uhlelo lwe-hydro eCeres luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamandla avuselelekayo ngokusebenzisa amanzi afika emifuleni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha iziteshi zamandla ezisebenzisa amanzi ukuze kukhiqizwe ugesi. Le ndlela ingabhekwa njengokuhlinzeka ngogesi okuphakeme, okuyinsiza ehlanzekile, futhi ethokozisa ukuhweba. IV. Izinzuzo zamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ahlinzeka ngezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, akunciphisi ukukhishwa kwegesi eluhlaza okukhuluma ekwakhiweni kwemvelo. Lokhu kudinga ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle emvelweni. Okwesibili, akhulisa umnotho wendawo ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emikhakheni emisha. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngengqalasizinda eqinile yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. V. Izinselelo Noma kunjalo, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo ahlangabezana nezinselelo ezithile. Lezi zinkinga zihlanganisa ukungabi bikho kwemali eyanele, izinkinga zokufinyelela, kanye nezinkinga zokusungulwa kwezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezithiyo ezivamile ezisemthethweni lapho izikhungo eziningi zikhokhela ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithile, okuyinto engathumela izinkinga ezinkulu ekwenzeni ngempumelelo. VI. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo nelinokuthula. Ngokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, iNyakatho Kapa ingathuthukisa umnotho, inciphise ukungcoliswa, futhi ikhuthaze ukusimama kwemvelo. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezithile ezithinta impumelelo yalezi zinhlelo, ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izinzuzo zikhula kakhulu kunezingozi. Ukuze kuqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, nabantu baphakathi bakhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo engcono, enempilo, nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside eNyakatho Kapa.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuyinqubo ebalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithola amanzi anhlobonhlobo. Nokho, le nqubo ibandakanya izimpikiswano eziningi ezihlukahlukene, ezithinta izinzuzo, izinkinga, nezindlela zokuphatha. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimpikiswano ezisemqoka ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi, ukuze siqonde kangcono le ndaba. 1. Izizathu Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kungani amaloli amanzi ethengwa. Ezinye zezizathu zifaka phakathi: - Ukushoda Kwamanzi: Ezinye izindawo zihlala zinesidingo esikhulu samanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomkhuhlane omkhulu noma lapho amanzi engatholakali kalula. Amaloli amanzi anikeza isixazululo esisheshayo sokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. - Ukusebenza Kwezokuthutha: Amaloli amanzi aklanyelwe ukuhamba amanzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima ukufinyelela. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo: Ezinye izikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo ezifana nezikhukhula noma izinhlekelele zemvelo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ngokushesha. Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekuphatheni lezi zimo. 2. Izinzuzo Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Izimpikiswano eziningi zikhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi: - Ukutholakala Kwamanzi: Amaloli amanzi anikeza ukufinyelela okusheshayo nokulula kwamanzi, okungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi. - Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezempilo: Ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile empilweni. Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekunciphiseni izifo ezithathelwana ngamanzi. - Ukukhuthaza Umnotho: Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo, njengoba amanzi adingekayo ezimbonini, ezolimo, nakwezinye izinsiza. 3. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi: - Izindleko: Ukuthenga amaloli amanzi kungaba nezindleko eziphezulu, okungase kube yinkinga kumaphrojekthi amancane noma emiphakathini enezinsiza ezilinganiselwe. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuze kuthengwe amaloli amanzi, kudingeka ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. - Ukungabi Nembuyiselo: Uma amaloli amanzi ethengwa, kungenzeka ukuthi abuyele emuva, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinsiza. 4. Izindlela Zokuphatha Nokuthuthukisa Ukuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuhamba kahle, kunezindlela ezithile eziphakanyisiwe: - Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuthengisa: Ukuze kuthengwe amaloli amanzi ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezikhungo ezithembekile zokuthengisa ezihlinzeka ngamaloli anekhwalithi. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Okunembile: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindleko zihlala ngaphansi kokulawula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha izimali. - Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi abaphatha amaloli amanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi iyenziwa kahle futhi ngokuphepha. 5. Ukubheka Ikusasa Lokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuzodinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ubuchwepheshe Obusha: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokulawula amanzi, kungasiza ekuphatheni kahle amaloli amanzi. - Izinhlelo Zokuhlola: Ukuhlola njalo izinga lamanzi nokusebenza kwamaloli amanzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe zinkulu. - Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuhlola: Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngocwaningo nolwazi olusha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano ngokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi zibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Ngokuqonda lezi zimpikiswano, imiphakathi ingathola izixazululo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukisayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila zabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi le nqubo iyaphumelela.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ezinkundleni Zokuxhumana Nemisebenzi Yedijithali Kwazulu, emadolobheni amancane, kwakukhona uSipho, umculi ophumelelayo owayethanda ukudala. U-Sipho wayehlala ethokozisa abantu ngezithombe zakhe ezinhle, ezithathwe emhlabeni wakhe. U-Sipho wayelokhu ehlanganyela izithombe zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezithokozisa abantu abaninzi. Kodwa uSipho wayazi kahle ukuthi akukhona konke okwakukhona emhlabeni wezithombe; kwakukhona okuthile okwakufanele akwenze ukuze abe ngumbhali ophumelelayo. Ngosuku oluthile, uSipho wahlangana noThandi, umngani wakhe owayekhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. UThandi wayenobuchwepheshe bokudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo, okwakwenza abantu bazithande. Wamkhumbuza uSipho ukuthi akufanele agxile kuphela ezithombeni, kodwa kufanele akwazi ukuhamba phambili, adale okuqukethwe okukhuluma ngempilo, imizwa, nezifundo. Lokhu kwavusa umcabango kuSipho, wacabanga ukuthi kungani engawenzi kahle lokhu. U-Sipho wathola umqondo omusha: kungani engafundi ukwakha izindaba ezimnandi? U-Sipho waqala ukucabanga ngalezi zindaba ezimnandi, ezithinta abantu, ezikhuluma ngempilo yabo. Waqala ukuhamba emhlabeni, ethola izimfihlo ezincane ezivela kubantu abahlukene, ezimfihlo ezazizwakala kahle ezithombeni zakhe. Wathi, “Ngizokwenza izindaba ezithokozisayo, ezizokhuthaza abantu, ezizobafundisa.” Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uSipho wathola isikhala sokubhala izindaba zakhe. Waqala ukudala okuqukethwe okuhlobene nezithombe, lapho abekwazi khona ukufaka izincazelo ezijulile ezithombeni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izithombe zakuye zaba nezinhloso, zaba nezindaba ezinhle ezazihambisana nazo. U-Sipho wathola indlela yokuxhumana nabantu, wathola indlela yokubakhumbuza ukuthi bonke bayahluka, kodwa bonke banemizwa efanayo. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka, wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili akukhona kuphela ukudala okuqukethwe, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha umphakathi. Waqala ukufaka izithombe zabanye abadali bokuqukethwe, ebakhuthaza ukuba bahlanganyele izindaba zabo. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuxhumana, futhi uSipho waqala ukuthola abalandeli abaningi. Abantu babefuna ukwazi okwengeziwe, babefuna ukuxhumana naye, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waqala ukufunda ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ukuzinikela. Waqala ukufunda izindlela zokuthuthukisa okuqukethwe kwakhe. Wafunda ukuthi izithombe ezinhle zidinga ukuxhumana nezincazelo ezijulile, futhi izindaba ezithokozisayo zidinga ukwakhiwa kahle. Wafunda ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukufaka izikhangiso, nokubhala izindatshana ezithokozisayo. U-Sipho waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo emhlabeni wedijithali, futhi lokhu kwavula iminyango emisha. Kodwa uSipho akazange akhohlwe ukuthi impumelelo ayizange ifike kalula. Wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengamthandi, izikhathi lapho izithombe zakhe zingatholakali, nezikhathi lapho wacabanga ukuthi akazange akwenze kahle. Kodwa uSipho wayazi ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga ukubekezela. Waqhubeka, wathola izindlela zokwakha okuqukethwe okuhehayo, wathola izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu, futhi wathola indlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningi zokusebenza kanzima, uSipho wathola ukuthi umphakathi wakhe wawukhula. Abantu babebhalela izindaba zabo, bexoxa ngezinto ezazibathinta. U-Sipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, ungakhuthaza abanye. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlangana, lapho abantu bekwazi khona ukuhlangana, babelane ngezindaba zabo, futhi bakhulume ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka, wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili akupheli. Waqhubeka nokufunda, efunda izindlela ezintsha zokudala okuqukethwe. Wafunda ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zishintsha njalo, futhi kufanele azivumelanise nezinguquko. Waqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi, waba ngumholi, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bangaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. U-Sipho waphenduka umculi, umbhali, nomholi, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela emalini, kodwa nasekuthokoziseni abantu, nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngakho, uSipho waba isibonelo sokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali bangaba nethonya elikhulu, futhi bangashintsha izimpilo zabantu ngezindaba zabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, uSipho wakhumbula ukuthi impumelelo yakhe yayingenxa yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokufunda. U-Sipho waqhubeka nokudala, wathola ubuciko obusha, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta abantu. U-Sipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma sabelana ngezindaba zethu, singashintsha umhlaba.
Izinselelo Zokungcoliswa Kwamaminerali eGauteng Isingeniso EGauteng, okuyisifunda esiyinhloko somnotho eNingizimu Afrika, kubonakala isimo esinzima sokungcoliswa kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yokumba amalahle nezinsimbi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kule ndawo yi-acid mine drainage (AMD), okuyinto evezwa ngokuphuma kwegazi elinobungozi ezindaweni zokumba. Le miphumela ibangela ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, okuthinta izinhlelo zokuphila, ezolimo, kanye nezinsiza zokuhamba. Ukuchaza i-Acid Mine Drainage I-Acid mine drainage iwukuphuma kwamanzi anokungcoliswa okukhulu, okuvame ukwenzeka lapho amalahle noma izinsimbi zikhishwa. Lezi zinsiza zisebenzelana ne-oxygen nemithombo ethile, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-asidi. Lokhu kwenza amanzi abe ne-pH ephansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuba khona kwezinto eziphilayo. E-Gauteng, lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi ezihlobene nokumba, njenge-Randburg, Soweto, nase-Ekurhuleni. Izimpawu Zokungcoliswa I-Acid mine drainage iboniswa ngezimpawu ezithile. Amanzi aphuma ezindaweni zokumba abe ne-pH ephansi, avame ukuba nezinhlayiya ezimnyama, futhi angaba ne-iron, aluminium, kanye nezinye izinto ezinzima. Lokhu kungcoliswa kudala izinkinga ezinkulu emithonjeni yamanzi, okuthinta izitshalo, izilwane, kanye nabantu. Imiphumela Emibi I-Acid mine drainage inemiphumela emibi eminingi. Okokuqala, ikhona ingozi yokungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi angaphansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, okuholela ezinkingeni zokuphila kwabantu. Okwesibili, izitshalo ezithintekayo ziba nezinselelo zokukhula, okuthinta imiphakathi ethile. Izinselelo Zokulawula Ukulawula i-acid mine drainage kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo kwemithombo yamanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ayithinteki. Lokhu kuzodinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinyanga zomphakathi, ezokuphatha, kanye nezinkampani ezisebenza ezindaweni zokumba. Okwesibili, kudinga izinhlelo zokuhlanzwa amanzi angcolile ukuze abuyiselwe emithonjeni yamanzi. Izixazululo Zokubhekana Nezinkinga Ukuze kube neziphakamiso eziphumelelayo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhekana ne-acid mine drainage, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukusebenza Nezindawo Zokumba: Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izinqubo ezihlanzekile zokumba ukuze zinciphise ukungcoliswa. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinqubomgomo: Uhulumeni kumele athuthukise izinqubomgomo ezibhekene ne-acid mine drainage, kuhlanganisa nezindlela zokulawula, ukuhlola, nokubika. 3. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi: Umphakathi kufanele ube nengxenye ezinhlelweni zokulawula ukungcoliswa, ukuze kube nokwaziswa nokubambisana. 4. Ukwandisa Imfundo: Kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze baqonde imiphumela yokungcoliswa. Isiphetho I-Acid mine drainage iyinselelo enkulu eGauteng, enezimpawu ezimbi ezithinta imithombo yamanzi, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, izinkampani, nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzovikela imithombo yethu yamanzi, kugcine impilo enhle, futhi kuthuthukise umnotho wesifunda. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina imvelo, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eGauteng.
Izinqubo zamacala amakhulu enkohlakalo Isingeniso Enkohlakalweni, amacala amakhulu ahlanganisa izenzo ezithinta kakhulu umphakathi, ezokuphatha, nezomnotho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinyathelo ziqhutshelwa phambili, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Lezi zinhlelo zizosiza ekuphatheni amacala enkohlakalo ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Uhlaka Lwenkohlakalo 1. Chaza Uhlaka: Qonda kahle ukuthi yini okukhuluma ngayo. Uhlaka lwenkohlakalo lungaba yizinkampani, uhulumeni, noma abantu ngabanye. 2. Thola Izinsiza: Bheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezifana nezincwadi, izifundo, nezifundo ezihlobene nezinkohlakalo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuqoqa Ubufakazi 1. Hlanganisa Ubufakazi: Qala ukuqoqa ubufakazi obukhombisa izenzo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungabandakanya imibhalo, izithombe, noma izinkulumo. 2. Bhalela Izincwadi: Qopha zonke izinsiza ozitholile, ubhale izincwadi ezichaza kahle ubufakazi obuqoqiwe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubika Ubulungiswa 1. Thumela Umbiko: Ngemva kokuhlanganisa ubufakazi, thumela umbiko kumaphoyisa noma emaphoyiseni akhankanywe. 2. Hlanganyela Nezikhulu: Hlanganyela nezikhulu eziphethe ukuhweba, ukuze ziqonde ubungozi obuhambisana nalolu daba. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Amacala 1. Bheka Ubufakazi: Ubufakazi obuqoqiwe kufanele buhlolwe ngochwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho bawo. 2. Thola Abafakizolo: Xhumana nabafakizolo abangaqinisekisa ubufakazi obukhona. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphendula 1. Hlela Izinqumo: Ngemva kokuhlola, hlela izinqumo zokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo zokuvikela abathintekayo. 2. Thumela Izinyathelo: Thumela izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bayazi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuphathwa Kwamacala 1. Bheka Ukuxhaswa: Qinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuxhaswa okuhle, kungaba ngokomoya noma ngokwezimali. 2. Phendula Ngomqondo: Hlinzeka ngempendulo engokwemvelo ukuze abathintekayo bazizwe bekhululekile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubuyekeza Izinyathelo 1. Bheka Imiphumela: Ngemva kokuphothula amacala, hlola imiphumela yokugcina. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda ukuthi izinyathelo zithinteka kanjani. 2. Phakamisa Izinguquko: Uma kudingeka, phakamisa izinguquko ezizothuthukisa izinqubo zokuphatha amacala enkohlakalo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi 1. Hlela Ukuqeqesha: Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphatha amacala enkohlakalo. 2. Phendula Ngemibuzo: Nikeza ithuba lokuphendula imibuzo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke bayakuqonda. Isinyathelo 9: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuvikeleka 1. Hlinzeka Ngemigomo: Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezikhumbuzo ezicacile ezivimbela izenzo zokukhwabanisa. 2. Bheka Ukusebenza: Hamba phambili ubheke ukusebenza kwezinqubomgomo ezibekwe. Isinyathelo 10: Ukubika Izinkinga 1. Thumela Izinkinga: Uma kunezinkinga ezivela, thumela izinkinga kumaphoyisa noma ezikhungweni eziphethe. 2. Qhubeka Ulandela: Landela izinkinga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zixazululwa. Isiphetho Izinqubo ezichaziwe lapha zidinga ukugcinwa ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amacala enkohlakalo aphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nezikhulu kubalulekile ekulwisaneni nalesi sifo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophila ngaphandle kwenkohlakalo.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Ngonyaka ka-2020, umhlaba wabhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu ngesikhathi i-COVID-19 iqala ukusabalala. Iziqubulo eziningi zashintsha, imisebenzi yahlala, futhi abantu abaningi bahlupheka. Ezinye izinhlelo zakuqala zabeziqukethe izindlela eziphuthumayo zokubhekana nalesi simo. Omunye walabo babambelela kuzo, kwakungumbono wokwethula isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant, esihlose ukusiza labo abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. UThandi, ungumama oneminyaka engu-32, wabhekana nenkinga enkulu ngesikhathi sokuvinjelwa. Wayengumsebenzi osemthethweni osebenza ezindaweni zokudayiswa, kodwa ngenxa yokwakhiwa okukhula kancane kwezinhlelo zokuvikela, isitimela samabhizinisi saziwa, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yahamba phansi. Lokhu kwashiya umndeni wakhe, onabantu abane, behlupheka kakhulu. Ngesikhathi uThandi ebona izikhangiso ngalesi sibonelelo somphakathi, wathola ithemba. UThandi wanquma ukuthi uzobhalisela leli thuba. Ngasikhathi sinye, wayezwa umuzwa wokuhlupheka kwabanye, njengoba ezwa izindaba zabangani nomndeni ababehlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo. Waqala uhambo lwakhe lokubhalisela isibonelelo. Ngenxa yokuthi kwakuyinkathi yokuhlupheka, izinsiza eziningi zabeziphansi, kodwa uThandi wathola ithuba lokuzama. Ngemuva kokubhalisela, wathola imilayezo eminingi yokuxhumana, okuhlanganisa nemiyalelo yokuthi angawathola kanjani amaphuzu azodingeka ukuze athole isibonelelo. Waqhubeka nokuqonda ngokucophelela lezi zinyathelo, wathola ukuthi ubhaliso kumele lwenziwe ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kwaba inselelo enkulu, ngoba uThandi wayengakaze asebenzise i-inthanethi kakhulu. Nokho, akazange ayeke; wayekhathele, wayezazi izinselelo ezinzima ezibhekene nomndeni wakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziningana zokuhamba phambili, ekugcineni uThandi wathola isikhumbuzo sokuthi isicelo sakhe samukelwe. Ukuhamba kwesikhathi, umndeni wakhe waba nezinye izinzuzo, okuhlanganisa nesibonelelo esingama-randi angama-3500. Lokhu kwaguqula impilo yakhe nempilo yomndeni wakhe. Njengoba ethola le mali, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuthenga ukudla, ezidingweni ezingokwemvelo, kanye nokukhokhela ezinye izikweletu ezincane. Noma kunjalo, uThandi akazange akwazi ukwehlisa ingcindezi. Wayazi ukuthi le mali ibalulekile, kodwa wayevuma ukuthi ibhajwe kalula. Waqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi wahlangana nabanye abantu ababejolise emsebenzini wabo. UThandi waqonda ukuthi kumele aguqule umqondo wakhe, akhuthazwe ukukhuluma nabanye abantu ababephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza, wahlangana noNokuthula, ongumngani wakhe. UNokuthula naye wathola isibonelelo, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka ngendlela abathola ngayo izinsiza ezithile. UThandi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu bahamba phambili, benza imisebenzi eyahlukene ukuze bathole imali eyengeziwe. Lokhu kwavusa umqondo wezimali phakathi kwabo, futhi waqala ukucabanga ngendlela yokwakha ibhizinisi elincane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlela umcimbi wokuhlangana nomphakathi, ukuze baxoxe ngezindlela zokuziphilisa. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlanganyela amasu. UThandi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nabanye, kwazise babezokwazi ukusizana. Uthando lwabo lokuba nezezimali lwakha umoya opholile, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okukhula. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uThandi waqala umsebenzi omusha wokuthengisa izithelo nezitshalo ezinkulu ezithengiswa emakethe. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhulisa umndeni wakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ukwakha amathuba amasha. Nakuba leli thuba liyeza ngenxa yezikhathi ezinzima, uThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona, futhi abantu bayakwazi ukuphumelela kakhulu uma bexhunywe. Njengoba usuku luhamba, uThandi waphakamisa izwi lakhe, efuna ukusiza abanye ababephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Waqhubeka nokuhlanganyela nezinye izinhlelo ezithuthukile, futhi waqala ukufundisa abanye abantu indlela yokufaka izicelo ngezinhlelo ezithile zempilo. Waqonda ukuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza kuphela uma abantu besebenzisa kahle amathuba akhona, futhi bekwazi ukuzama ngendlela ehlukile. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela umphakathi omncane wokuxhumana, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukufunda, ukukhuthazela, nokwabelana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, futhi umoya wokwabelana wabonakala. UThandi wanquma ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu besebenzisa ithuba, bangakwazi ukusiza abanye. Uhlanga lwezimo ezinzima luhamba, kodwa uThandi uthokozisa impilo yakhe nemali eyengeziwe eyayihamba nezindleko zomndeni. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ukwenza izinguquko, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuphila kahle, ngaphandle kokwehla phansi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wenza ubudlelwano obunempilo nomphakathi futhi wakhulisa umndeni wakhe. Njengoba ethola izifundo ezintsha, uThandi waqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza, futhi waqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli. Isibonelelo sasiwumthombo wokuphila, kodwa umoya wokusebenza kanye nokukhuthaza uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, indaba kaThandi yaba yindaba yokukhuthaza, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuthi baphile ezimeni ezinzima. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza, kodwa ibhizinisi lakhe elincane lasiza ukuvuselela umhlaba wakhe. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma kudingeka, abantu bangakha amathuba amasha, futhi baphile kahle ngezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokuphila, futhi uThandi wanqoba empilweni yakhe. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ngezindlela eziningi, futhi umphakathi udinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze ube namandla. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, izinzuzo zalesi sibonelelo zikhula, futhi ikusasa liyaphila.
Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Umbuzo 1: Yini isifo sofuba? Impendulo: Isifo sofuba, esaziwa nangokuthi i-tuberculosis (TB), yisifo esithathelwana kalula esibangelwa yibaktheriya ye-Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Lesi sifo sithinta ikakhulukazi amaphaphu, kodwa singathinta nezinye izingxenye zomzimba. Umbuzo 2: Kungani sifo sofuba sibalulekile eKwaZulu-Natal? Impendulo: KwaZulu-Natal, isifo sofuba sitholakala kakhulu, futhi sithinta impilo yomphakathi. Izinga lokushaywa yilesi sifo liphezulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwisana naso ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwa nesifo sofuba eKwaZulu-Natal? Impendulo: E-KwaZulu-Natal, kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezihlanganisa: 1. Uhlelo lwezokwelapha: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-antibiotics ahlukeneyo ukuze kubhekwane nesifo. 2. Uhlelo lokuhlola: Ukuhlola abantu abathintekayo ukuze kutholakale isifo ngokushesha. 3. Imfundo yomphakathi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela, izimpawu, nokuthi kufanele benzeni uma bezwa izimpawu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayaziswa ngalesi sifo? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka: - Ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa emphakathini. - Ukusebenzisa iziteshi zomsakazo, amaphephandaba, nezokuxhumana ukuze kufinyelelwe kubantu abaningi. - Ukuhlinzeka ngama-brochures nemibhalo echaza isifo, izimpawu, nezindlela zokuvikela. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zisebenza kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zikhombisa impumelelo. Ukuhlolwa kwenzeka njalo, futhi abantu abathola ukwelashwa bahlala bephakanyiswa ukuze baqhubeke nokulandela imiyalelo yokwelashwa. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza abantu bangatholi ukwelashwa? Impendulo: Kunezizathu eziningi ezibangela ukuthi abantu bangatholi ukwelashwa, okuhlanganisa: - Ukungabi nolwazi ngalesi sifo. - Ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokwelapha. - Ukungaboni isidingo sokwelashwa ngenxa yokwesaba noma ukungaqondi kahle izimpawu. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela abantu ekutholeni lesi sifo? Impendulo: Ukuze uvikeleke, abantu kufanele: - Bagcine izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanzeka. - Bagweme ukusondela kakhulu nabantu abane-TB. - Baphumelele ekuhlolweni njalo uma bephakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izibhedlela, kanye nezinhlelo zikamasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwabelana ngemininingwane, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha. Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenziwa uma umuntu ethola isifo sofuba? Impendulo: Uma umuntu ethola isifo sofuba, kufanele: - Abike udokotela ukuze ahlolwe. - Alandele imiyalelo yokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa ukuthatha imishanguzo ngendlela efanele. - Abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokwelapha ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abanye abantu abathintekayo bayahlolwa. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zifaka: - Ukunciphisa izinga lokushaywa yilesi sifo. - Ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. - Ukunciphisa izindleko zezokwelapha ezihambisana nesifo. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zidinga ukwesekwa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zidinga ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo, kungaba ngemali, izinsiza, noma ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwandiseni umphumela wezinhlelo. Umbuzo 12: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze basize ekulwisaneni nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Abantu bangasiza ngokwabelana ngolwazi, ukuhlinzeka ngenkxaso kubantu abathintekayo, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlolwe. Ukwenza lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukulwa nesifo. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Izinselelo zifaka: - Ukungabi namathuba afanele okwelapha. - Ukungabi nolwazi olufanele kubantu. - Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele zokwelapha. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo, kufanele: - Sifake izinsiza eziningi zokwelapha. - Sihlinzeke ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi. - Sihlanganise imizamo yokwazisa umphakathi. Umbuzo 15: Yini okukhuluma ngayo emiphakathini mayelana nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Emiphakathini, abantu baphawula ngezimpawu, izindlela zokuvikela, nezindlela zokwelapha. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale beqaphile futhi baziqhenye ngempilo yabo. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo, KwaZulu-Natal iyazama ukunciphisa umthelela wesifo sofuba, futhi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nezinhlelo zikamasipala kubalulekile ukuze sifeze lezi zinhloso.
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Kwathi ngelinye ilanga eGauteng, lapho umoya ubhujiswa khona ngothando lwezithuthi nempilo, kwavuka isimo esibuhlungu. UThando, owayekhululekile emsebenzini, wathola ucingo oluphoqayo. Umngani wakhe, uSipho, wayephuthumile, ekhombisa uphethiloli ezingalweni. Uthando waphuthuma, wabiza i-ambulensi, echasisa isimo sikaSipho. “Ngidinga usizo, umngani wami ucindezelekile,” kusho uThando, ecashile. Kodwa kwaba yisikhathi esengeziwe asindayo. Kwaphela imizuzu eyishumi, futhi i-ambulensi yabe isakufa. Noma kunjalo, umoya wokubamba ithemba wawusemoyeni, ungakufuna noma isimo sikaSipho sishintsha. I-ambulensi yaze yafika, abantu bezobona okubuhlungu bezama ukuthola ukuzola. Umqhubi, uMusa, wenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokuzikhandla. “Siyavuma, sithumele ezigulini,” usho njalo. Wenza kahle ukuhlonipha izinqubo, kodwa emakhosini eyazo, izikhathi zokuphendula zinokuhluka. Ngenxa yobuqhophololo, le nkinga ibonisa ubunzima. Noma i-ambulensi ithola ukufinyelela kalula ezindaweni ezithile, ezinye izindawo zokuhlala zicindezelwe, zifuna ukuxazululwa. Kwakukhona abanye abagibeli abavetshwe ezitaladini ezikhawulelwe, phakathi kwemigwaqo elahlekileyo. UMusa, nozakwethu, bazama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuphendula, kodwa izinsuku ziwukujeza. Okwenzeka eGauteng kwavame ukulandelwa. Izimo zokuphendula zishintsha ngempela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi. Nakuba i-ambulensi ibhoda impi, kwavuleka ithuba lokukhuluma ngezikhathi ezibuhlungu. Abalamuli bezinsiza bazi kahle ukuthi izinsuku zezemidlalo zingahluka, kodwa umphakathi ufisa ukuqonda ukuthi kungani isikhathi sokuphendula singasho lutho. U-Phumla, osebenza njengomphenyi wezokwelapha, wathola ukuthokozisa ngoMsombuluko. Ubuza: “Kungani kufanele kulindwe izinsuku lapho siyobona ukuphendula ngokushesha? Mhlawumbe umphakathi kumele uqonde ukuthi i-ambulensi idinga ukusekelwa.” Njengoba iqembu le-ambulensi, lilwa nokunqoba izithiyo zabo, zindlala ngobuhlungu, izimo ziphindaphindwa. Bobabili uThando noSipho bazi ukuthi akukhona kuphela isiphetho sabo, kodwa konke kwenzeka emhlabeni owaziwa ngezimanga. Uthando ubevele election isikhalazo, “Abaningi bethu balinda isikhathi eside, futhi lokho akukuhle.” Uhlanga lwesithombe lwalulinganiselwa emqondweni. Uthando, uSipho noMusa babephakathi kwepuzzle elingapheli. Phela, izinsuku zokuphendula zaba yindida. Futhi, uma kuxoxwa, izinkanyezi zithembele ezindalweni ezinjengezinsuku, phakathi kwebhodi, zikhona izinkanyezi zomphakathi. Uthando, efuna ukusebenzisa isimo, wanxusa: “Mhlawumbe singasiza ukuhlola izikhalazo zempilo, uma sizoba nabantu abavumelanayo.” Kusuka kulokhu, nezinhlaka zomphakathi zaphenya, zaba nezikhumbuzo. Isikhathi sikaSipho sidlule, futhi uMusa, ongamukeli lokho ngokuphelele. Uthando, uqonda kahle umuzwa, waphindisela, “Mhlawumbe izikhathi zokuphendula akuhluki, kodwa umphakathi uthanda ukufundisa izifundo.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zifundo zaba zintsha, zazama ukuqedwa phakathi ukukhuluma kwegatsha. Uthando, noSipho, ugibeli omuhle benza isiqiniseko sokuthi ukuphila kwezinye kwaba yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile. Uhlaba umxhwele uMusa kanye nemizamo ye-ambulensi. Ngokuhamba kwemizuzu, imikhiqizo ye-ambulensi ibonakale iyavuma. Umphakathi uthembisa ukwakha, ukuze siqhubeke. Ngale ndlela, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zezigiwa, kodwa uthando nemvelo yayihamba phambili. Isiphetho UThando noSipho babona ukuthi ngaphezu kwendlela, umphakathi udinga ukuhamba ubonisise, ukuze sithole isixazululo ngemikhankaso ethile. Umuzwa weziphumo ubonakale, uyiye umlilo futhi uqhubeke, udlula ezinsukwini zaphezulu. I-ambulensi iyakhonza, isiphetho sokuqonda sizosiza ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo eziphakeme eGauteng.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ungenele izinqubo zokhetho emakhandleni eNingizimu Afrika, uhlelo lokhetho oluthinta izigidi zabantu. Le mthetho wahlukahlukene udinga ukucubungula zonke izinselelo eziphathelene nezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho lwenziwa ngokufanele, ngokobulungiswa, nangokwemigomo evumelekile. U-Elias Mthembu, umphakathi ophawulekayo kulesi sikhala, ungumfundi ophothule izifundo zakhe kwezobulungiswa. U-Elias waba nenhloso yokuhlola izinselelo ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, ngenxa yoxhaso olwekanye nolwakha imiphakathi. U-Elias ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinile nokubhala izincwadi ezisemthethweni kungasiza ekudluliseni izinkinga ezikhona. U-Elias uqala ukuveza ukuthi imithetho emisha ibonakala iyinselele enkulu ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo ngokuzalwa kwabantu. Uhlanga lwezizinda zomthetho olukhulu lubhalwe phansi izinkinga ezahlukene, ezihlanganisa ukuvinjwa kwabantu abasha ekuthatheni izinqumo zokhetho. U-Elias uthi, "Ukuthola abantu abasha ukuthi bathathe ingxenye emikhandlwini yokhetho kubalulekile. Ngaphansi kwemithetho emisha, izigidi zezizinda zomthetho ezikhona zingase zibe nomthelela omubi." U-Elias ugxila nakwezinye izinselelo ezithinta abamele abavoti, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Uhlanga lwezinselelo lukhombisa indlela yokuhlukanisa imiphakathi, lapho abavoti bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bezinyaniso emiphakathini ethile. Lezi zimo zikhombisa ukuthi imithetho emisha ingaphazamisa ukuhwebelana kwezinkolo, izinkolelo, nezikhumbuzo ezihlukene phakathi kwemiphakathi. U-Elias ubonisa ukuthi ubukhona bomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act buholela emiphumeleni emibi yokuphikisana kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kusebenza ngezigameko eziningi eziveza ubukhosi kwezombusazwe lapho imithetho ingahambisani nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi. U-Elias uthi, "Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezombusazwe akusizi, kudala ukukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu." U-Elias ubona izinselelo ezinzima zokufinyelela kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zomthetho olukhona lubonisa ukuthi imithetho emisha ingase ibe nemiphumela emibi ezindaweni ezithile. U-Elias uthi, "Kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina umphakathi unolwazi nolwazi oluqinile ngemithetho emisha." U-Elias ukholelwa futhi ekutheni izinkinga ezikhona zidinga ukuxoxwa ngokubambisana nozakwethu. Ubuza, "Ngabe sikhona yini isikhala sokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezikhona? Kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi bethu bahlale bexhumana nomphakathi ukuze kuhlonyiswe izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elias ubonisa ukuthi ezikhathini ezizayo, izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukubhekelelwa ngokuqhubekayo. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zomthetho olukhona lubonisa ukuthi abavoti bangase bahlale bephoqeleka ukuba baphendule ekubeni neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezombusazwe. U-Elias uthi, "Sifuna imiphakathi ethokozisayo, futhi lokho kuncike ekutheni abantu bazi ukuthi imithetho ibathinta kanjani." U-Elias Mthembu, umphakathi ophumelelayo, uqhubeka nokubeka phambili izimvo zakhe nezifiso zakhe ukuze athole izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act. Ubuza, "Ngabe sikhona yini indlela yokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise izinqubo zokhetho?" U-Elias ugcizelela ukuthi lo mthetho ungaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi oqinile, kufanele bezwe izinselelo ezikhona futhi bahlale bephokophele phezulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokhetho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elias uqinisekisa ukuthi izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukwenziwa kwazulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ubuza, "Ngabe sizokwazi yini ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukuze iNingizimu Afrika ibe yindawo lapho abantu bephila khona ngokuthula?" U-Elias ubelokhu edlulisela izinzwa zakhe ezithinta uhlelo lwama-oda, nokuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act udinga ukubhekelwa ngeso elibukhali ukuze uqinisekise izinguquko ezizothuthukisa isimo sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ngale ndlela, u-Elias Mthembu uqhubeka nokuba yisithunywa somphakathi esiphakamisayo, echaza futhi evalelisa izinselelo ezihambisana nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, ukuze kube nokuvuka kokuthula nokubumbana phakathi kwabantu.
Isiphakamiso Sokwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain Isingeniso I-Gautrain iyinsiza ebalulekile yokuhamba eGauteng, ikhuluma ngezindawo ezibalulekile ezifana neJohannesburg, Pretoria, kanye ne-O.R. Tambo International Airport. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokwanda, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokwandisa le nsiza ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu. Le dokhumenti ibonisa isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, ibheka izinzuzo, izindleko, nezindlela zokuphumelela. Izizathu Zokwandiswa 1. Ukukhula Kwabantu: Njengoba abantu abahlala eGauteng bekhula, kudingeka izindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kunciphise umjikelezo wezithuthi zomgwaqo, futhi kunciphise ukungcoliswa komoya. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokusebenza, okuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinkampani zikhule, zandise imisebenzi, futhi zikhuthaze ukutshalwa kwezimali. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuthutha: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzohlinzeka ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuthutha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bahlale bejabulile futhi bephumule ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Izinhlelo Zokwandiswa 1. Ukwakhiwa Kweziteshi Ezisha: Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabahambi, kuzodingeka kwakhiwe iziteshi ezintsha ezindaweni ezidinga ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa iziteshi eziseduzane nezikhungo zokuhweba, izikhungo zemfundo, nezindawo zokuhlala. 2. Ukwandisa Umugqa Wezitimela: Umugqa we-Gautrain kufanele wandiswe ukuze ufinyelele ezindaweni ezikude, njengeMidrand, Soweto, ne-Ekurhuleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahambi bahlala bexhumekile, kuzodingeka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuxhumana ezihambisana ne-Gautrain. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphakeme, izikhangiso ezisebenzayo, nezinsiza zokuhamba ezihamba phambili. Izindleko Nezinsiza Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa izinzuzo ezizotholakala kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka. Izindleko zokwakha iziteshi ezintsha, ukwandisa umugqa wezitimela, nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuxhumana kuzodingeka zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi basebenzisane ukuze kutholakale izinsiza ezidingekayo. Izindlela Zokuphumelela 1. Ukubambisana Nezinkampani: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezizimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswe kahle, futhi izinkampani zibe nesithakazelo ekwakheni iziteshi ezintsha. 2. Ukubandakanya Umphakathi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu kumphakathi. 3. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Olufanele: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngokucophelela, kubalulekile ukwenza ucwaningo olufanele mayelana nezidingo zabahambi, izindleko, nezinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Isiphetho Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuhamba eGauteng. Ngokwandisa i-Gautrain, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuthutha, sithuthukise umnotho, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisane ukuze le phrojekthi iphumelele, futhi izinzuzo zayo zifinyelele kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi i-Gautrain ibe yinsiza ebalulekile yokuhamba, ehambisana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe (National shutdown) Isingeniso Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe, owaziwa ngokuthi i-National Shutdown, ungomunye wemibhikisho emikhulu eyenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, enezizathu eziningi ezihlanganisa ukwenyuka kwezindleko zokuphila, ukungasebenzi kahle kukahulumeni, kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Lo mbhikisho ubonisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngempilo yabo, kanye nezinkinga ezibhekene nezwe. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela yawo ezwenikazi, emphakathini, nasezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Umongo wombhikisho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe uqala ngokukhathazeka okujulile kwabantu ngezimo ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Izindleko zokuphila zikhuphukile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokudla, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kukhuphuka kwentengo kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abaphila ngaphansi komngcele wezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungasebenzi kahle kukahulumeni, okubandakanya ukungabi namasu acacile, kukhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphume emizileni ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo. Umthelela wezenhlalo Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe unomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zempilo yomphakathi. Ukuphuma kwabantu emigwaqweni kuholela ekwandeni kokuphikisana, okungase kuholele ezimweni zokuphazamiseka kwezomnotho. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izinkampani zibe nesikhathi esinzima sokusebenza, okuholela ekwandeni kokungasebenzi. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho ukungasebenzi kuholela ekukhuleni kokuhlupheka, okwandisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola umthelela omkhulu emithonjeni yokuxhumana. Umbhikisho uvamise ukuholela ekukhuleni kwemithombo yolwazi, lapho abantu bexhumana khona ukuze babelane ngemicabango, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umuzwa wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, kodwa futhi kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Umthelela wezomnotho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe unomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Izinkampani ezincane nezinkulu zibhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphazamiseka, okuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi. Umbhikisho ungenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba nokuthola izimpahla. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezithintekayo zidinga ukusebenzisa izinsiza eziningi ukuze ziphinde ziqinise izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba. Umthelela wezomnotho ungaba yingozi enkulu, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Umthelela wezombusazwe Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu kwezombusazwe. Ubonisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngohulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungabaza ngohulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Umbhikisho ungase futhi uholele ekwandeni kokubusa kwabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwemiphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nawo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo. Isiphetho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ubonisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezwe, ezibangelwa ukunganeliseki kwabantu. Umthelela wombhikisho unomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, emnothweni, nasezombusazwe. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu eziholela emibhikishweni, kanye nemiphumela yazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi bagcine izinga lokuphila labantu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala? Impendulo: Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala siqukethe izinyathelo ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu ezivela kumasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu ezikhona zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Uma amasipala engakhokhi izikweletu zawo, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza ze-Eskom, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi kubo bonke abathengi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom ekutholeni izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom zifaka phakathi ukungakhokhi kahle kwezikweletu, izinkinga zezimali kumasipala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekutholeni izimali ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhubeke nokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuqinisa ukuqoqa izikweletu? Impendulo: Ukuqinisa ukuqoqa izikweletu, i-Eskom ithatha izinyathelo ezihlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumasipala mayelana nezikweletu, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokulandelela izikweletu. Umbuzo 5: Ubuqotho bamasipala busebenza kanjani ekutholeni izikweletu? Impendulo: Ubuqotho bamasipala busebenza njengesisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ne-Eskom. Uma amasipala ebonisa ubuqotho ekukhokheni izikweletu, lokhu kudala ukwethembana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumasipala akhokha izikweletu? Impendulo: Mamasipala akhokha izikweletu, i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungcono, okwandisa ukuthuthukiswa komasipala. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsiza, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga lempilo labantu. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokuxhasa amasipala akhokha izikweletu? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokuxhasa amasipala akhokha izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunikela ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amasipala ayakwazi ukuphatha izikweletu zawo kahle. Umbuzo 8: Yini eyenza i-Eskom ikhethe izindlela ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngogesi? Impendulo: I-Eskom ikhetha izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokuya ngezidingo zamakhasimende, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimo zezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele futhi esebenzayo. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubuyekeza izikweletu ezikhona? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubuyekeza izikweletu ezikhona ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izikweletu ezikhona, ukuxhumana namasipala, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala, kufanele sisebenzisane ngokubambisana, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi amasipala ayathola ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqoqa izikweletu futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe i-Eskom ibheka izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom ibheka izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 12: Yini okumele ikhokhwe uma umphakathi ungakhokhi izikweletu? Impendulo: Uma umphakathi ungakhokhi izikweletu, i-Eskom ingase ibhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza, ukwehla kwezinga lempilo, kanye nezinkinga zezimali kumasipala. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubambisana namasipala? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubambisana namasipala ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqoqa izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amasipala ayakwazi ukuphatha izikweletu zawo kahle. Umbuzo 14: Yini eyenza i-Eskom ibe yinkampani ebalulekile kumasipala? Impendulo: I-Eskom ibalulekile kumasipala ngoba iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngogesi, okuyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungcono kuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 15: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, kufanele sibe nokuxhumana okuhle, sabelane ngemininingwane, futhi sisebenzisane ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqoqa izikweletu futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Eskom izoqhubeka nokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu kumasipala zikhokhwa, ngaleyo ndlela iqinisa ubudlelwano bayo namasipala. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ze-Eskom, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabantu bonke.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom Ngolunye usuku, uSipho, ohlala eGauteng, wathola incwadi ethunyelwe kwa-Eskom. Le ncwadi yayikhuluma ngokuqhamuka kwezinsiza ezintsha ezibizwa ngokuthi "smart meters." USipho waba nolaka, ngoba wayesevele eqaphela ukuthi izindleko zikagesi zikhuphuka njalo, futhi wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizomnika usizo yini. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, uSipho wanquma ukuya ehhovisi le-Eskom eliseduzane ukuze abuze kabanzi. Lapho efika, wathola uNandi, umphathi wezokuxhumana. UNandi wamamukela ngenjabulo, wathi: “Sawubona, Sipho! Ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ngabe ufuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-smart meter?” USipho wavuma, wathi: “Ngiyabonga, Nandi. Ngicela ungichazele ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani.” UNandi waqala: “I-smart meter iyithuluzi elihlakaniphile elikuvumela ukuthi ubone kahle ukuthi ugesi wakho usebenza kanjani. Ibonisa ukuthi ungakanani ugesi osebenzisa, futhi ikwazisa uma izindleko zikhuphuka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhokha izikweletu zakho.” USipho wathokoza, kodwa wabuza: “Kodwa, kuzodingeka ngikhiphe imali eningi ukuze ngifake le meter?” UNandi wamchazela: “Cha, Sipho. Ukuze ufake i-smart meter, kuzodingeka ukuthi ube ne-application, kodwa akudingeki ukuthi ukhokhe imali eningi. Futhi, uma usuyifakile, uzothola izinzuzo eziningi.” Ngemuva kokukhuluma noNandi, uSipho wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame le smart meter. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umakhelwane wakhe, uThandi, wamsiza ukuthi afake i-smart meter. UThandi wayekwazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani, futhi wamchazela ukuthi kuzomnika ithuba lokulawula izindleko zikagesi. Ngemuva kokufaka i-smart meter, uSipho waqala ukubona umehluko. Wathola ukuthi usebenzisa ugesi omningi ngesikhathi esithile sosuku, ikakhulukazi ekuseni nasebusuku. Lokhu kwamnika ithuba lokwenza izinguquko, waphuma ezindaweni ezithile ezazidla ugesi kakhulu. Waqala ukusebenzisa izibani ezincane, waphinde wacisha imishini engasasebenzi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uSipho wathola ukuthi izindleko zakhe zikagesi zinciphile. Wayejabule kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi le smart meter yamsiza kakhulu ekulawuleni izindleko zakhe. Waqala ukwabelana ngalesi sihloko nomphakathi wakhe, wathi: “Ningakhethi, niyazithokozisa. I-smart meter iyasiza!” Abanye abantu emzaneni babenokungabaza, kodwa uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuthi bafake lezi zinsiza, wathi: “Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zethu.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waqala ukwamukela i-smart meter. Abantu baqala ukujabulisa izindleko zabo, futhi kwavela umoya omusha wokubambisana. U-Eskom naye wathola ukuthi izindleko zawo zinciphile, njengoba abantu beqala ukukhokha izikweletu zabo ngesikhathi. USipho, owakha umphakathi wakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphela izindleko zabo, futhi wathola ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi be-Eskom bukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emisebenzini ye-Eskom. Waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yebhizinisi, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana noNandi, futhi baqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa umphakathi ngalezi zinsiza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingashintsha impilo yabantu. USipho waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter ayisiyona nje indlela yokulawula izindleko, kodwa iyithuluzi elihlanganisa abantu, elikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, wathi: “Siyakwazi ukwenza umehluko, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yindawo lapho abantu bejabulile, bephila kahle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. I-smart meter yaba yinsiza ebalulekile, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sithatha izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom: Ukubuyekezwa Eskom, njengomphakathi omkhulu wezokwakha amandla eNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi zokuphathwa kwamandla, ikakhulukazi ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamandla nokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Ngalesi sikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kube yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Lezi zinsiza zihlala zikhuluma ngempumelelo, kodwa zidinga ukuhlolwa ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinzuzo zazo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela wazo kumakhasimende. Izinzuzo ze-Smart Meter Okokuqala, i-smart meter iyithuluzi eliqinile elithuthukisa ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Lezi zinsiza zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamandla, okwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amandla abo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko, njengoba amakhasimende engakwazi ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamandla ngesikhathi esifanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokuphakama kwezindleko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-smart meter iyasiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamandla. Ngendlela yokuxhumana ngqo, i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuthola imininingwane yokusetshenziswa kwamandla ngesikhathi sangempela, okwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezithile ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kwamandla. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezinkingeni, okuholela ekwenzeni ngcono ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter akukhululi i-Eskom ezinkingeni zayo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile obudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kahle. Ukufaka i-smart meter kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kungaba yinkinga kumabhizinisi amancane noma kumakhasimende angatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemininingwane yabo. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane yomuntu siqu kubalulekile, futhi i-Eskom kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zayo zokuvikela imininingwane ziqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende azizwa ephephile futhi ethembekile. Umthelela Kumakhasimende Umthelela we-smart meter kumakhasimende ungathathwa njengomphumela ophambene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amakhasimende athola ithuba lokuphatha kahle ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamandla, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindleko. Lokhu kunciphisa umthwalo wezindleko eziphakeme, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokuphakama kwezindleko zamandla.
