Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye amakhasimende bangase bazizwe bephazamisekile ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle indlela i-smart meter esebenza ngayo. Ukuze i-Eskom iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhasimende ayawuqonda kahle umqondo we-smart meter, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuba baqonde izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom kubonisa izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqashelwa izinselelo ezithile. Lezi zinsiza zikhombisa indlela yokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, kunciphise izindleko kumakhasimende, futhi kuthuthukise ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom iqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhasimende ayawuqonda kahle umqondo we-smart meter, futhi aqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma i-Eskom ingakwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, i-smart meter ingaba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwayo, futhi ikwazi ukusiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile nelinempilo lamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Ukubambisana phakathi kwe-Eskom, amakhasimende, kanye nezikhungo ezithintekayo kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela kokusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter.
Ukuphendula kwenqubomgomo yokuphila kahle emlilweni waseMarshalltown Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkinga zomlilo, eMarshalltown, umoya wawuphola, abantu benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Bebehamba ezitolo, besebenzisa izithuthi zabo, bengazi ukuthi isiphithiphithi somlilo sasizokwandisa. Umphakathi wawujabule, uhlezi uqine, kodwa izinsuku ezilandelayo zazizoba nezinsuku ezinzima. Ngobusuku bokugcina, phakathi kwezinkanyezi, umphakathi wakwaMarshalltown waphahlazeka. Umoya wawugijimela ezitolo, izindlu zathi ziqweqwediswa abantu ababephila kahle. U-Palesa, umfundi ophumelelayo, waphonsa umandlakudla phezulu, ethola umfundi ophuma ngebhasi elithela izincwadi. Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuhlale isikhathi eside. Ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa, uPalesa wathola izimemezelo eziphuthumayo. Umphumela ovela kumaphoyisa wawufike ngokushesha - "Kunezimpawu zomlilo eMarshalltown! Bona bazalwane, sisonke!” Kwakukhona ukudideka phakathi kwabantu, abanjwe yiphupho lokugwema. UMkhulu Mkhize, owayesebenzela le ndawo iminyaka engama-70, wabona umakhelwane wakhe, uThandiwe, edlulisa uPalesa ngaphesheya kwesiteshi. “UThandiwe, hamba!” wathukile uMkhulu Mkhize. “Umoya usheteleka kuhle! Gcina umahluko!” Ngoba umoya uphonsa umlilo onuka, uPalesa uqhubeke ngokunqoba izinyembezi, ethola isigcawu eceleni. Izinyoni zobumnyama ziqhume zinyakazise umoya, zishayisa iphupha lokuqhubeka – lombhali wakhe uDali, obekhuluma ngezinkanyezi, waba nendaba epholile. Emva kokuhlangana nabantu abasha, uPalesa wathola umyalezo ophusile. “Kulukhuni, thina sonke, ngabe sizokwazi?” Ngaphandle komphakathi, kuqhamuke imibiko, iziphathimandla zeziphakamiso zikhombisa izithombe ezinkulu zemililo, izincwadi zathumela ezikhathini ezikhethekile - akekho omubi. Zama ukuthola ukusiza komphakathi, kanye nomphakathi othintekayo. Kuhlale kube nesithukuthezi sokuhlola esivela ezinhlelweni ezihamba phambili, ezokuphila. Ukukhala kwamaphoyisa nakho kwaba nenhlangano, ababhali bemithombo yabanikazi bezingane, befundisa. Ujjabulo likaMshayisa, isikhulu esisebenzayo, wathi: "Sidllalile! Sidinga ukuvuma imiyalelo yethu yedlanzana yokuphila. Noma sikhathazekile, sonke sidinga ukuba sizoxhumana." Ephendula, uDali wakhipha ikhamera, azama ukuthola izithombe zezingane namahlathi aphephile. Izinyoni zomlilo zaveza umqondisi walolu hlobo olufanele. U-Palesa noMkhulu Mkhize, uThemba kanye noThandiwe baqoka phakathi kwezinhlelo zabalandeli. Nakuba umphakathi ungabekezelelanga, bakha iphrojekthi ezwakalayo nezihlala ziphila kahle. Babheka ithuba lokuphokophela ezindaweni ezinde, bejabulile, beseshandleni. Kufika amakhaya, abakhokheli bemibuthano baphula ubumba, bebuya nemishado ethulile kwazulu. Izinyathelo zenzeka, uDali ube esehamba. Umphakathi wawuhamba ngobunono, uqhamuke ezindaweni zoruba futhi uPriya, umphakathi owazi, wabamba ukujola komlilo. “Sigcwaliswe! Ngabe ubani ofuna sizinike umkhulumela?” ukuthula kudlula phakathi komphakathi. Ukuze babe phambili, umoya ube nokuphila komhlaba, ukwakha kuchaza ukuthi yonke into iyashintsha. Kwathi kube sekuphakanyiswa, isibani somkhosi sakuveza umhlaba. Uhlanga lwabantu lwavuka njengendlela ehlanzekile. Perfector kaMarshalltown, uMshayisa, uqhubeke nokuhlala phambi komphakathi ukuze azobathokozisa. Nokho, izinto zazeziqeda. Umbangi wendlaleko umoya wobuhlungu waba ngaphezu kokubukeka kwezigidi zabantu, uze kube izinsuku eziyisi-30. Uhlanga lwakhe lwegazi luhambela emoyeni opholile, neqhaza lezakhamuzi ekubuyiseleni umphakathi – abantu abahamba abavumi, abadliwe yincithakalo. Okwamanje, izinyoni zize zinike ithuba lokuvuma, okuthakazelisayo – baqinisekile. Ngabe umphakathi uzobona ukuphila? U-Palesa, uMkhulu Mkhize kanye noDali bahlala bephelezela phakathi kwethembiso, bejolisa izinyoni zabo uhulumeni omnyama. "Umhlaba uzoshintsha, futhi sizohamba phambili!" sakhuluma. Ngemuva kwemililo, umcimbi wemimoya yebhubesi umhlaba wathola uhlanga facebook, izigidi zabantu zaphenduka ezinhle. Izinyoni zashintsha imoya, umthombo wabantu wachuma. Kuhlabelela ukugubha, izahluko zafika, kwavela imiphumela emisha—umphakathi wawuwathola emamitha amasha. Ngakho, emgwaqweni ifika intokozo, umthwalo wokusebenza usithole ngesikhathi. Uhlelo lokusiza, iziteshi ezisondelene nezinkanyezi, zakhula. Okugqoka uDali washiywa, njalo ukhona – imizamo ezihambisayo khipha umhlaba wethu, izindawo ezinhle zihlala kuzo. Ekugcineni, umhlaba wavuka, izinyoni zamaphoyisa zayovuka lapho ziqhubekela phambili. U-Palesa, uThandiwe, noMkhulu Mkhize babonisa ukuqhubeka, ngokukhalipha umvuzo, ikakhulukazi emoyeni wobuhlungu. Umphakathi wathola ubumnyama, kodwa wahamba phambili, kuxhumene izinselelo ezihambayo. Ukuphumelela yinto enhle, ukuncintisana ubuhlungu ubukhona, nomsebenzi wabo wawuhamba phambili. "Sesibona!! Phezulu! Umhlaba, ubuhlungu, uzothola ukuthula!” yakhazimula izinqaba zabo ezincane, ziqhubeka ukusebenza, zikhuluma nokukhanya! Umphakathi wawukwazi ukuvuka, umoya rawusa, ukuhluleka kwakhalaza emnyangweni, kube emhlabeni, bese kuze kuphume ubukhosi bemithambo eMarshalltown. Ngakho, emlilweni walolu hlobo lwezinto, umoya womphakathi wathola ubukhulu bokuphinda, wahlala!
Umbiko: Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imisakazo yomphakathi, kodwa uhamba nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuxhaswa. Imisakazo yomphakathi iyinsiza ebalulekile yokwazisa, imisebenzi, nemicabango ehlukahlukene, kodwa izinselelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali zenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Uhlelo lwezimali olukhishwe nguhulumeni lunemithetho ethile eyenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kulokhu, okudinga umphakathi ukuba ube neqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kwehluleka kokuxhaswa kwenza kube nzima ukwabelana ngemininingwane nemibono emisha, kuholele ekuncipheni kwamathuba okusebenza kwemikhankaso. Umlando ubonisa ukuthi imisakazo yomphakathi ivame ukuxhaswa ngencane, njengaseJohannesburg Community Radio Station, ethola uxhaso oluncane, ibhekene nezinkinga zokugcina abasebenzi, okungaholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi yezinhlelo zayo. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekwakheni okuqukethwe okukhangayo ezindaweni ezingezona ezomnotho. Ngokubheka iNkomba yeMithombo yeZindaba, imisakazo yomphakathi ihluleka ukufinyelela emaphesheni amakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela ubudlelwano bebhizinisi nabaxhasi. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuxhasa kuyinkinga enkulu esivele eminyakeni edlule, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nezizathu ezahlukene ezifana nezinkinga zezimali, izinqubomgomo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta abantu abathintekayo. Imithombo engaxhasiwe inezikhiqizayo ezithile, kodwa ibhendi lempumelelo yezenhlalo ibonakala liphansi. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ezinye izikhungo zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha, ezifana nezinhlelo zokubambisana, ukuze zithuthukise ubudlelwano nemiphakathi. Ngokombiko weMasipala weJozini, imithetho ethile ivimbela imiphakathi ukuba ikhulume ngezindaba ezithinta ubuhlakani, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha imikhankaso ebalulekile. Amashishini amancane nemikhankaso yahlukile ayathola izinselelo ezithinta ubumqoka bempilo, okukhumbuza imiphakathi ukuba ibhange ezikhalweni zayo zamakhaya. Lokhu kuholela ekuthenjweni kumithombo yezenhlalo, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane ukuthola ukuxhaswa. Kubhalwe ukuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezenziwe ezimfundazweni zamasiko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisakazo yomphakathi iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali oluyingqayizivele. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi komphakathi, izimanga, nemithombo yempilo. Uhlelo lokuxhasa imisebenzi yomphakathi kumele luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kudingeka ukuthi uHulumeni nabaxhasi baqale ukuvuma izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Imizamo yokwakha amakhono, ukufundisa abasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo ezikhethekile kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemithombo eyanele yokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi. Ekuphetheni, imisakazo yomphakathi ibalulekile ekuhlanganiseni izwi, izinkolelo, nemicabango ehlukahlukene. Nokho, izinselelo zokuxhasa kufanele zixazululwe ukuze kuqhubeke ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, okuzodlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Izinzuzo zalesi sikhathi sizothuthukisa umphakathi jikelele, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi zisebenze zikhululeke ukuze ziphumelele. Imisakazo yomphakathi izothola izixazululo eziphusile ukuze igweme izinkinga ezithile, futhi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile.
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, kuzoba nomcimbi obalulekile obizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition" eGoli. Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa emnyangweni wezokwakha, futhi ubhekelele ukukhuthaza izimboni, abenzi bezinqubomgomo, kanye nezakhamuzi ukuthi ziqonde futhi zisebenzise amathuba anikezwa ushintsho lwamandla olulinganayo. Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luveza indlela yokuhamba phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona kokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, kuhlonishwe izidingo zomphakathi, futhi kube nokulingana kwezinsiza. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinzima ngenxa yokukhuphuka kokushisa komhlaba, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibhadele lezi zinguquko ngendlela efanele, engathinti kuphela umnotho, kodwa futhi ibhekele izidingo zomphakathi. Lo mcimbi uzohlanganisa izinkulumo ezibalulekile ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa, ezokwakha, nezemvelo. Abakhulumeli bazoletha imibono ehlukene ngokuqonda okukhulu kokuthi ushintsho lwamandla lungaholela kanjani ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, kanti kuzoba nezifundo ezivela ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo ezisunguliwe emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma, kuzoba nezikhangiso ezizokwenza abafundi bacabange ngendlela engapheli. Lokhu kuzobandakanya izinkampani ezihamba phambili emkhakheni wamandla avuselelekayo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kanye nabasakazi abasebenza ekudluliseni ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuze bonke. Izinhlelo ezishiwo zizosiza ukwazisa abantu ngamahla okutshala imali, izindawo zokutshala, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa amandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani eziningi, ezokuxhumana, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zamanje. Ukwengeza, lo mcimbi uzohlinzeka ngethuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamabhizinisi kanye nabaphathi. Abahlanganyeli bazoba nethuba lokuxhumana, ukuphakamisa imibono, futhi benze izixazululo ezihlukene zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani ezihlukahlukene kuzokwandisa amathuba okusebenza ndawonye ukuze kucaciswe indlela yokuphumelela kulesi sikhathi sokuguquka. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinhlelo, kulindeleke ukuthi lo mcimbi ube nezingxoxo ezinzulu, lapho abahlanganyeli bengabeka khona imibono yabo, iziphakamiso, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo ekushintsheni kwangempela. Izinkulumo ezizohlanganisa abaholi emkhakheni wezemvelo, abezindaba, nezikhungo zokucwaninga zizokwenza kube nempumelelo enkulu yokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba phambili, lo mcimbi uyavuma ukuthi ushintsho lwamandla kufanele lwenziwe ngezindlela ezithinta wonke umuntu. Lokhu kusho ukufaka izinsiza ezitholakala kalula, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zemfundo, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emisha emphakathini. Umgomo uwukuthi ushintsho lwenziwe ngendlela efanele, ngenkathi kugcinwa umqondo wobulungiswa, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukuzuzwa kulokhu kutshala imali. Sicela ubhalise ku-inthanethi ukuze uqinisekise indawo yakho, ngoba indawo imincane. Lo mcimbi unikeza ithuba elihle lokuthola ulwazi, ukuxhumana, nokwenza umehluko omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ngokuhlanganyela, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi futhi luthuthukise amandla avuselelekayo. Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizoshintsha indlela esibuka ngayo amandla, futhi lusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobulungisa, nolungele ikusasa. Hamba nathi, ungaphutheli leli thuba lokuba yingxenye yalesi sikhumbuzo esiyingqayizivele sokwakha ushintsho olunempumelelo.
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Ngaphakathi kwezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba ziye zabamba iqhaza elibalulekile emlandweni nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Lesi sikhathi sihlobene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezweni, ezikhombisa ukuthinta okukhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Umqondo wokuthathwa komhlaba uqala ngezikhathi zamasiko amaZulu, lapho umhlaba ubhekwa njengento enomqondo omkhulu. Lapho uhulumeni bahlala bequbuka izizathu, bebenza i-aphoyintimenti yokuthatha umhlaba kubantu bendawo ukuze vidipho umhlaba wezakhamizi. Lokhu kwadalwa yizinguquko zezimiso zomthetho ezazithi zingenisa imithombo efanele ekuthathweni komhlaba. Ngemva kokuhlukaniswa kwesizwe ngemuva kokufika kwabantu baseNgilandi nezinye izizwe, kwaba nokudlula umhlaba ophethwe ngabantu bendawo, okuyinto eyayimpilo yabo. Kwakukhona imithetho ehlukahlukene ewazwayo, njengemithetho yeTrek, eyayiqukethe ukuhamba kwezinhlanga ezahlukene kumhlaba. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpikiswaneni ezinkulu malunga nezinhlelo zokutholwa komhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Union of South Africa yasungulwa ngo-1910, kwathi ngalesi sikhathi yayisenza kube lula ukuthatha umhlaba, ikakhulukazi kumuntu ongumZulu. Lokhu kube koqobo, ngenkathi abaphathi bebelokhu beqhubeka nezinhlelo ezintsha zokuthuthukisa umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume yalabo abawuthandayo. I-Land Act ka-1913 yayibalwa njengomthetho obalulekile, ophikisana nokwabiwa komhlaba phakathi kwamazinga. I-Land Act yayikhumbuza imikhuba emibi yokuhlukaniswa kwezakhamizi ngokwehlukana kwemibono. Iyahlaba ikhwela ngesigidi sabantu, ikakhulukazi labo ababesebenzisa umhlaba. Lokhu kudala ukungahambisani phakathi kwabantu abahlala endaweni ezahlukene nezukanye nezizaba zomthetho. Lokhu kudalwa ezinkulumweni ngemizamo engama-oda emibili: isifunda sabelana nomhlaba nomengameli. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, imithombo yokuthola umhlaba iye yaholela ezimpikiswaneni ezenzeka ukusuka phambili. Ngokuhlanganyela, izishoshovu zafuneleka ngempela ukwakha izinhlelo ezizwakalayo eziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bembali babuyiselwa umhlaba. Kuvele ukuba nemizamo yokukhuluma ngoMthetho Wokutholwa Komhlaba ka-1991, owayekhanga kakhulu kulokhu, ulesi sikhathi esizoba sekuqala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho eqondiswayo ibikhuluma ngebhodi yokuphila komhlaba. Lokhu kwavakasha umuntu ngamunye, nendlela yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zenhlalo nezizindeni zomhlaba, lezi zigaba zafuna ukuxazulula ezimfanelo zalezi zinhlelo. Ngo-1994, lapho kwaba khona izinguquko ezinkulu ezweni, imithetho yayiqala ukubuyekezwa, ukuze kuphume isivumelwano esisha. Baphawula ukuthi umhlaba wawufanele ukuzubekela gugu, futhi abahlali benza izinqumo eziyinqaba zokubuyiselwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bahlanganyele ezintweni eziphakeme, benze amathuba avulekile ukuze kube nokubuyiswa okuphumelela. Kubantu abaningi, lezi zinguquko zazisebenza njengendlela yokuphila emhlabeni, kodwa inkinga yayiqhubeka. Kuzinyathelo ezithile, izinsiza zomthetho zazingazali ukwenziwa ukuze kubuyiselwe umhlaba kulabo abakufanelekayo ngenxa yokuhlupheka. Yize kwagcwala ukungavumi kuhlangene, ikusasa lithumele ikhono lokulawula izinsiza ezifanayo. Esikhathini esiningi, imishado emisha yahlabelela umphakathi, yethule izinhlelo zamazwe ahlanganelayo anokuthatha umhlaba komphakathi okwakha inhlangano efanele yokuhola ubulungu. Izinhlelo zashintsha ukuze zisizakale kubo bonke ophilayo, snakho ezizondelayo ezigunyaziwe. Ubulawa obufanele kulo mhlaba wawungathwetshulwa emigqeni yamazwe amaningi, kotayela kokuziphatha ngendlela evumayo. Ukwazi ukukhetha indlela yokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle kwalandela kuzinsuku ezinzima, uma kunezinyathelo eziphumelelayo. Iqembu labaholi bezizwe elizimele emazweni ehlukahlukene likhuthaza ubufakazi bokuchithwa, bahlazile ukuthi umhlaba ungottshengisa ezizweni ezithi zibhaliselwe. Kulokhu, izimpikiswano zomthetho ziye zaba yisikhumbuzo semizamo yokuthola ubulungiswa nokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwazisa abantu ngale ndlela yokuphila emhlabeni, edala umphakathi omusha, owakhayo, futhi ogcwalisa ubumnandi. Noma izimpi zishoda, ukwakha ubuhlobo nezinyathelo ezikhanyayo kuzoba inhlansi efaneleko ekubuyiseni umhlaba. Ekugcineni, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela, ukuze izifunda nezinhlelo zithole ukufinyelela kokubili kwi-ngakuko umhlaba. Lokhu ukube kungaphetheki ngokuphelele, kube yisixazululo esingadliwa phansi ngempela, kulindeleke ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuveza imiphumela eyingxenye ende yomlando wethu, etholakala ngangokuningi, kuze kulandwe izithunzi ezilukhuni ezingase zibhalwe emlandweni wesintu.
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain: Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, Umphakathi Wokuthuthuka Umphakathi: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngalesi siphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain. Ngabe ungakuchaza kancane ukuthi kungani leli phrojekthi ibalulekile? Mnu. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga. Ngempela, leli phrojekthi ibalulekile kakhulu. I-Gautrain isiza ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba kwabantu phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene eGauteng. Ukukhulisa le nsiza kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba, kunciphise umjaho wezithuthi emigwaqweni, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wendawo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Yiziphi izindawo ezihlosiwe zokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain? Mnu. Mthembu: Sihlose ukwengeza imigqa emisha ehlanganisa izindawo ezibalulekile ezifana ne-OR Tambo International Airport, iCenturion, kanye neMidrand. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezisemqoka, njengezikhungo zokusebenza nezokuthenga. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kakhulu. Kodwa, yini ezokwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela? Mnu. Mthembu: Ukuze le phrojekthi iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Sizodinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobheka izindleko zokwakha, izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nezikhathi zokuphothula. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nalolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezinto eziningi okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, izindleko zokwakha zingaba phezulu, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sithole uxhaso lwezezimali. Okwesibili, sizobhekana nezinkinga zokuhamba kwabantu ngesikhathi sokwakha, okungase kube nomthelela ekuphileni kwansuku zonke kwabantu. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa. Umphakathi: Ngabe le phrojekthi izoba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela. Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, okuzokhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa umnotho, njengoba abantu bezoba nekhono lokufinyelela emisebenzini nasemakethe kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukwakha, ukuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinsiza enkulu. Ngabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza. Sizohlela imihlangano yokwazisa abantu ngalesi siphakamiso, futhi sizobavumela ukuba baphakamise imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bebamba iqhaza, futhi bazokwazi ukuveza izidingo zabo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngabe kukhona izifundo ezithathwe kwezinye izindawo eziphumelele ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhamba? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, sithole izifundo eziningi ezivela kwezinye izindawo ezifana neLondon neTokyo. Lezi zindawo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuhamba komphakathi kungathuthukiswa uma kunezinhlelo ezicacile nezokuxhumana. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezitimela ezisheshayo nezokuthutha ezisebenza kahle. Umphakathi: Ngabe unayo imiyalelo ethile kubantu abavela emphakathini mayelana nalolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Bafanele bazi ukuthi le phrojekthi izothuthukisa impilo yabo, futhi badinga ukuxhasa lezi zinhlelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kuzokwenza kube lula ukufezekisa lezi zinhlelo. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkcukacha ezibalulekile. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi sizobona impumelelo kule phrojekthi, futhi abantu bazokwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zayo.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery I-Mthombo Oil Refinery iyiphrojekthi ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, eyaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngamafutha aphezulu, futhi ibalulekile ekukhuleni komnotho kanye nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Le phrojekthi yadalwa ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zamafutha ezweni, ikakhulukazi njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo zokuncika kumafutha avela kwamanye amazwe. ### Ukusungulwa kwePhrojekthi Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery uqala eminyakeni yama-2000, lapho uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uqala ukucabangela izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta umnotho, njengoba izindleko zokuthenga amafutha avela phesheya zikhuphuka. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, uhulumeni wahlela ukwakha imboni yokucubungula amafutha, okwakuzoba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. ### Ukuhlola Izindawo Ngemuva kokuhlola izindawo ezahlukene, kwatholakala ukuthi indawo efanele yokwakha i-refinery ibikwiMthombo, eduze kwedolobha lasePort Elizabeth. Le ndawo yathathwa njengendawo efanelekile ngenxa yokwakheka kwayo, okuyenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuhambisa amafutha. Ukuhlola le ndawo kwahlanganisa izifundo eziningi ezazihlosiwe, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimo zezulu, imithombo yemvelo, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. ### Ukuxhaswa Kwezimali Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kudinga uxhaso lwezimali olukhulu. Uhulumeni wahlanganisa izinsiza ezivela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abaxhasi bamazwe aphesheya. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinkampani ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi izoba yimpumelelo. ### Ukwakha Nokuhlinzeka Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kwaqala ngonyaka ka-2010, futhi kwathatha iminyaka eminingana ukuze kuqedwe. Le nqubo yokwakha yahluka kakhulu, ihlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi zokwakha, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Ukusebenza kwale phrojekthi kudinga abasebenzi abanekhono, futhi kwavula amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini yasendaweni. ### Ukusebenza Kwe-Refinery Ngokuphothulwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery, imboni yokuqala yama-refinery eNingizimu Afrika yatholakala, futhi yathuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha. Le refinery inezinga eliphezulu lokucubungula, ikwazi ukukhiqiza amafutha ahlukeneyo, okuhlanganisa amafutha enjini, amafutha okudla, kanye nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa emikhakheni ehlukene. ### Umthelela Emnothweni Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwandise ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha, kwavula amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kwathuthukisa imisebenzi yezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le refinery yathuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo, njengoba izinkampani ezincane zathola amathuba okukhula. ### Izingozi Nezinkinga Noma kunjalo, iMthombo Oil Refinery ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Izingozi zokungcola kwemvelo zikhona, njengoba imboni yokucubungula amafutha ingaba nemiphumela emibi emvelweni. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, uhulumeni kanye nezinkampani ezihlanganyela kule phrojekthi bahlongoza izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izindlela zokucubungula ezihlanzekile, kanye nokuhlola izinga lokungcoliswa kwemvelo. ### Ikusasa leMthombo Oil Refinery I-Mthombo Oil Refinery ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezimboni zokucubungula amafutha kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ekukhuleni komnotho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngama-fuel ahlanzekile. Ukuze le phrojekthi iqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. ### Isiphetho Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa ukuthi imiphumela emihle ingatholakala uma uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisana ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Le phrojekthi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, futhi ibonisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zamafutha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, iMthombo Oil Refinery iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imizamo yokwakha imboni yokucubungula amafutha ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu.
Umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State Umbuzo 1: Yini elandelayo uma sikhuluma ngesomiso eFree State? Impendulo: Isomiso sisho ukungabi khona kwamanzi okwanele, okuthinta kakhulu izitshalo nezilwane. EFree State, isimo sezulu sithinteka kakhulu yizimo zokushisa eziphezulu nezikhathi zokungabi namvula. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza kwezolimo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izitshalo ezithinteka kakhulu ngalesi simo? Impendulo: Izitshalo ezifana nezinkomo, u- maize, ne-soya zikhula kakhulu eFree State, kodwa uma kunesomiso, lezi zitshalo ziba nezinkinga zokukhula. U- maize, okungumkhiqizo obalulekile, uthola umthelela omkhulu uma umswakama unganele. Umbuzo 3: Umthelela wesomiso ungakanani ekukhiqizeni? Impendulo: Isomiso sikwazi ukwehlisa ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo ngaphezu kuka-30%. Lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwemali engenayo kubalimi, okwenza kube nzima ukuba baphile. Umphakathi wezolimo ubonakala uthinteka kakhulu, njengoba ukungabi namvula kuthinta zonke izigaba zokukhiqiza. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza ukuthi iFree State ibe sengozini enkulu yokushoda kwamanzi? Impendulo: IFree State ithola imvula encane uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifunda eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kokushisa kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu kwenza kube nzima ukuthola umswakama owanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubalimi ukuhlela kahle ukukhiqiza kwabo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izindlela ezisetshenziswa abalimi ukuze balwe nesomiso? Impendulo: Abalimi baseFree State baphendukela ezindleleni ezahlukene zokulima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, ezifana nokulima okungaphansi komhlaba, kanye nokusebenzisa izitshalo ezimelana nesomiso. Abanye basebenzisa amasu afana nokubeka izikhukhula ukuze bagcine umswakama. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi? Impendulo: Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele zisebenza ukuze ziqinise abalimi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokulima, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukusiza abalimi bakwazi ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 7: Umthelela wesomiso ungaba yini kumphakathi? Impendulo: Isomiso sithinta umphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuncipha kokukhiqiza kuholela ekwehleni kokudla, okungaholela ekudleni okunganele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abavela emiphakathini ethile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso kungasiza ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, kunciphise ukuncika emanzini, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Lokhu kungakhuthaza ukwakha umnotho oqinile, uphinde ulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu kumalimi. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izinguquko zesimo sezulu ziba nomthelela ekulimaleni kwezolimo eFree State? Impendulo: Yebo, izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ukwanda kokushisa, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubalimi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesomiso, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela ukukhiqiza. Abalimi badinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze baphendule kulezi zinguquko. Umbuzo 10: Yini okudingeka yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bayakwazi ukumelana nesomiso? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezimboni zokulima zisebenzisane ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuqwashisa umphakathi ngalesi simo nakho kubalulekile. Umbuzo 11: Uthini umbono wesikhathi esizayo kwezolimo eFree State? Impendulo: Uma izinyathelo ezifanele zithathwa, iFree State ingaba neziphumo ezinhle kwezolimo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele, kungasiza abalimi ukuthi baphile kahle ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Umbuzo 12: Ingabe umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ezithile? Impendulo: Yebo, umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ngokubambisana. Ukuhlanganisa imithombo, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu nabalimi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela kahle ukukhiqiza. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izifundo esingazifunda kulolu hlobo lwesimo? Impendulo: Isifundo esiyinhloko esivela kulolu hlobo lwesimo siwukuthi ukubaluleka kokuhlela kahle nokuba nezinhlelo eziphusile. Ukuze sibe neziphumo ezinhle kwezolimo, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imithombo yethu, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyaziqonda izinselelo ezikhona. Umbuzo 14: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulima ezimelana nesomiso zingathuthukiswa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulima ezimelana nesomiso zingathuthukiswa ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukufunda ezindaweni eziphumelelayo, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela ukukhiqiza kwethu. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bahlala bephumelela? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bahlala bephumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisiza ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuphatha izinsiza, kanye nokwakha izinkundla zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuvuselela umnotho wezolimo eFree State, sithuthukise ukuphila kwabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi sizoba neziphumo ezinhle nakusasa.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Kwakukhanya emini, izinsuku ezikanye, lapho izwe lethu, iNingizimu Afrika, lathola khona ukudabuka okuningi. Emini yamaJulayi ngonyaka wezi-2021, abantu bahlala em street corners, emizileni nasemakhaya bejabulile futhi bejabulisa omunye nomunye. Kodwa emhlabeni ka 2021, lapho konke kubukeka kuhle, wafika umoya wezinhlekelele, ubhubhisa ithunzi lemphilo yamaZulu. Kwathi uma izinsuku zidlula, umkhiqizo wezokungcebeleka oqhakazile, uthathelwa phezulu ngezingxabano ezivame ukuhlupha abantu. Kukhumbuleka ukuthi lezi zibhulu zokuqala zazihambisana nemijikelezo yokulwa nokwephula umthetho, okwakuthuthukisa ukungavumi kwezinhlelo zamanje. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga zomnotho ezazithinta amadola yonke, nezimo zalabo ababephila emizileni, nezimo zalabo ababeziqhubeka nayo. Izinsuku zokuqala zomhla zingakaphumi phakathi kwezinsuku ezinkulu. Abantu bejoyina imizamo yokukhombisa ukuzwakala kwabo, ngokuzibophezela empilweni yomqondo wokwakha izinyathelo zamakhaya. Kwaba nezingxabano phakathi kokukhangwa, lapho abanye bekhangwa ukwemukela imithethonqubo ehlukile. Izinhloso zazidlondlobala, nokukhathazeka ngabantu bemizamo yempilo yabo kwavela. Abaxhasi bakhuluma ngezinhlelo zokuthuthuka umnotho ezalotshwe yizo ezikhumbulayo – izinga lokukhula komnotho belikwazile, kodwa kwaba nezahlulelo ezinzima ezazithinta imisebenzi. Kodwa ka sekwenzekile, izinhlelo zamaphathiswa azithintekanga kahle. Kwathathwa imizamo yokwandisa ukuhweba, kodwa ivumelwano elingaqedi kangako lwenze abantu bavele babe nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kwadala ukucasuka nokungaqondi kahle okwabulala ithemba labantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlekelele zindawo zikaMphakathi zatholakala ngendlela ezibuhlungu. Lezi zinkinga bebebavimbela ekuhwebeni nasemsebenzini, kanti abadluli bezishoshovu bazama ukuthola izixazululo. Ukuhlaziywa kukhombisa ukuthi umnotho walokhu kwamahlekelele uyaqhamuka ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa nakho lokho ngenxa yokufuna ukwehlisa okwenziwa ngabadlula ngaphandle. Lokhu kuyadabukisa, kubanga imiphumela eminingi empilweni yabo. Kwakungezinkanyezi ezidlagitha ezingajazi, ezichaza izifundo ezihlukaniselayo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezama ukuthola izinzuzo zokuhweba, nokhulumela izinjongo zomphakathi, kodwa izinto zathola imiphumela emibi. Ukungabi naluthando lwezinsongo ezithwala izinkanyezi ezinhle, kwakhuthaza impilo engapheli. Abantu bahlala behluleka ukufunda ukuze baphinde bangene ezinhlelweni eziphuthumayo, ukuze baphinde bazitholele izikhala ezinkulu. Esikhathini esidelwe ubungozi, imizamo yokukhuluma ibikwenza kube nokwakha okungakafiki. Abanye babeyizinyanga abathintekayo ekwakheni umnotho, belindele ukuba nempumelelo eMphakathini. Lokhu kube yikushoda kobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezivela kumasu omnotho. Kodwa umhlaba wawuchophisa – kodwa owawa waqhubeka nokwenza ubuhlobo, kuze kube sekwitchini eziphakamisa izikhalo. Isimo sezinhlekelele sahlala sibhubha, kanti nabafuna ukuhamba bayavuma ukuvala izinkanyezi ezihlukile kanti nabashoshovi abayinyango bezama ukwakha ubuhlobo. Lokhu kuboniselayo ukuthi abantu bayakuthanda ukuphiwa inhlonipho, bese bakhuluma futhi bezwe umbuso wabo. Ithuba lokulahlekelwa, akujwayelekile; umnotho wafelwa uklekeliswa. Ababamba iqhaza bezama ukujabulisa kanye nezinhlangano ezikhethiwe. Kubuhlungu ukulindela, kodwa kanti isimo samanje sikhumbuza izinyathelo ezivumayo. Abantu bejabula kakhulu emadodeni kanti imiphumela ibingekho. Bese kuthiwa “phuma” kanjena, kwavela uhulumeni wamaZulu, kanti lokhu kube yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umnotho ofanele ukuvumpa. Umphakathi wawa ungenegozi, kanti kubizwa ukuhlonipha. Lezi zibhulu zangoJulayi 2021, zigxile emkhakheni wezokuhweba. Zonke lezi zinxushunxushu zaku luthando ezeqisa ukwehluka, kanti uMphakathi uthola ithuba lokuphikisa imiphumela emisha. Umnotho ugxile ekuthuthukiseni inhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukubambisana kukamasipala. Ngakho ke ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ikhanda laphakanyiswa ngezimpande zokuvikela. Ekuhlonzeni kobuchwepheshe, lokhu kungenza kube nezinsizakalo ezinkulu, kanti umphakathi uthola umsebenzi omningi. Ngokuphetha, izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zitshengisa ukuthi umnotho awubheki abanjani, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba babe nabantu abavumayo. Uthando lomphakathi lubalulekile, futhi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezakhelwe ukuvikela umnotho. Ukungaboni ngaso linye akuthandi, kodwana umhlaba uthanda, kanti umaphepha ahlanganiswe imizamo, olumkumbulo nempumelelo ehlangene. Izigigaba zithakazelelwa, kanti izifundo ziphakamisa umnotho, okwenza kube yinsakavukela enhle, emnothweni.
Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo EThekwini, umuzi ogcwele impilo, ubuhle bemvelo, nezinsiza eziningi, umthelela wokuminyana ungumqondo obalulekile okufanele siwucabangele. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika kuleli dolobha, umnotho wethu uyakhula, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga ezithile. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umminyano unamathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Okokuqala, umminyano ulethela izinkampani ezincane ithuba lokukhula. Njengoba abantu abaningi befika eThekwini, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi, okuholela ekwandeni kokuthengwa kwemikhiqizo. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izitolo ezincane, izindawo zokudlela, nezinsizakalo zempilo ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, zikhulisa umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, umminyano ungumthombo omuhle wokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela zokuhweba. Nokho, umthelela omubi wokuminyana awukwazi ukwenqatshelwa. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika, izinsiza zomphakathi ziyaqala ukuba nzima. Izikole, izibhedlela, nezindawo zokuhlala ziba nomthwalo omkhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi nendawo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umnotho uyakhula, kodwa uma abantu bengakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, umphakathi ungase ube sengozini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umminyano ungaholela ekwandeni kokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, izindawo eziluhlaza ziyaqhubeka nokuncipha. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezindawo zokuphumula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola indawo yokuphumula. IThekwini, enezindawo eziningi ezinhle, kufanele igcine lezi zindawo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umminyano ungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika, izinga lobugebengu lingakhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu bendawo basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila endaweni ephephile. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, ngiyavuma ukuthi umminyano eThekwini unamathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Umnotho wethu uyakhula, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini ungumqondo obalulekile okufanele siwucabangele. Njengoba umuzi wethu uqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi wethu ubalulekile. Ukubambisana, ukwakha izinsiza, nokugcina imvelo kuyizinto ezibalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wethu uyakhula ngaphandle kokulimaza abantu bethu. EThekwini, sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elihle, elinempilo, nelinokuthula.
Ukukhula Kwamapodcast eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-podcast aseNingizimu Afrika abe yinsiza ebalulekile yokwabelana ngolwazi, izindaba, nemibono. Lokhu kukhula kubonakala ngokwanda kwabantu ababathandayo, abawakhulumayo, kanye nezinkampani ezithola izinzuzo ezinkulu kulolu hlobo lokuxhumana. Ukuze siqonde kahle lesi sikhala esikhulayo, kubalulekile ukuhlole izizathu eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-podcast, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezinkinga ezithintekayo. Izizathu Zokukhula Okokuqala, ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwandeni kwama-podcast. Ngokutholakala kwezinsiza eziningi zokulalela ama-podcast, abantu bangakwazi ukuwathola kalula, noma bahlala kuphi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana neSpotify, Apple Podcasts, neGoogle Podcasts zenza kube lula ukuwathola, okukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale ukuwulalela. Okwesibili, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana engajwayelekile. Abantu bahlala bezama izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, futhi ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuzwa izinkulumo ezijulile, izindaba ezithokozisayo, kanye nemibono ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule futhi babonise izithakazelo zabo, okwandisa umphakathi wama-podcast. Okwesithathu, ama-podcast anikeza indawo yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta abantu abaningi, njengezindaba zomphakathi, ezepolitiki, nezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izindaba ezithinta umphakathi zidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo ukuze kube nokwaziswa okwanele. Ama-podcast anikeza abantu ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo. Izinzuzo Zama-Podcast Ama-podcast anikeza izinzuzo eziningi, kokubili kubalaleli nakubakhulumayo. Kubalaleli, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendlela yokufunda nokuzijabulisa ngesikhathi esifanayo. Abantu bangalalela ama-podcast ngesikhathi esifanele kubo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphumile, emsebenzini, noma ekhaya. Lokhu kukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukufunda ngezihloko ezithokozisayo. Kubakhulumayo, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo, izipiliyoni, nezimvo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha umphakathi, futhi abakhulumayo bangathola izithameli ezinkulu, okungaholela ezinzuzweni ezinkulu, ezifana nezikhangiso noma ukuxhaswa. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nama-Podcast Noma kunjalo, ukukhula kwama-podcast akukhululekile ezinkingeni. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhwalithi yokuqukethwe. Njengoba abantu abaningi beqala ama-podcast, kukhona ingozi yokuthi izinga lokuqhuba lingase lingabi phezulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abalaleli baphumelele, okungathinta umphakathi jikelele. Okwesibili, ukuncintisana kukhula. Njengoba ama-podcast enza umkhankaso, abakhulumayo badinga ukuba nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile ukuze bahlale bephambili. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokukhangisa, kanye nezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-podcast akhula futhi ahlale ethokozisa. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa indlela abantu abathanda ngayo ukufunda, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokuxhumana. Noma kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zikhombisa ukuthi ama-podcast azoba yinsiza ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwakha, baphinde baphendule ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, ama-podcast azoba yindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma, ukufunda, nokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kulindeleke ukuthi ama-podcast aqhubeke nokukhula, ahlinzeke ngolwazi olunembile, futhi abe yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindabeni ezithinta abantu abaningi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izwi labantu lizwa. Njengoba sikhula, ama-podcast azoba yinsiza ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokwabelana ngolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo Kwazulu, ebhizinisini eliphumelelayo, ethekwini laseThekwini, kwakukhona umphakathi ophila kahle, kodwa wabhekana nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuminyana. Kwakuyidolobha elikhulu elinabantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kwadala umphumela omkhulu kwezohwebo. UThandiwe, umphakathi ophila eThekwini, wayengumthengisi wezimpahla ezincane. Wayenoshintsho olukhulu empilweni yakhe, kodwa ukukhula kwemakethe kwakuvulelekile. Njalo ekuseni, uThandiwe wayevula itende lakhe lokuthengisa edolobheni. Abantu bejolise emikhiqizweni yakhe, kodwa umnyango wesimo sezulu wabuya nezinye izinkinga. Njengoba abantu benshi bebuya emsebenzini, umnyango wezohwebo wakhula. UThandiwe waqala ukuphupha ngokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe, kodwa umthelela wokuminyana wawuhlala unomthelela omkhulu. Amaphrojekthi amancane ayengakabi namathuba okukhula, futhi lokhu kwashiya abathengisi abaningi bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bejolise emnothweni wobuchwepheshe. UThandiwe, kodwa, wayengakahluleki. Wayazi ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo udinga ukwakha ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze ubhekane nezinselelo. Waqala ukufunda mayelana nezindlela zokuhweba ezikwi-inthanethi, futhi wathola amathuba amasha. Lokhu kwavuleka indlela yokufinyelela emakethe enkulu, lapho abantu bejolise emikhiqizo yakhe. Ngesikhathi sokukhula, umphakathi wezemfundo uThandiwe waqala ukunikeza izifundo eziphathelene nezohwebo, ukuze abanye baphumelele. Wazama ukufundisa abantu ukuthi kuminyana akukhona kuphela ukuhlupheka, kodwa futhi ukuvumelana nezimo ezidingekayo ukuze uthole impumelelo. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana waqala ukushintsha. Abantu bazi ukuthi bangakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuba bahlale endaweni eyodwa. UThandiwe wahola imihlangano yokuhweba, okuhlanganisa abathengisi abancane. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhula, futhi umthelela wezohwebo wabonakala. Kodwa, njengazo zonke izindaba, kwakukhona nezinkinga. Umthelela wezokuphepha waba yinkinga, njengoba abantu beqala ukuzama ukukhwabanisa ukuze bathole inzuzo. UThandiwe waphakela izeluleko ezinhle mayelana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi, okufanele babe namandla okuphila. Ngesikhathi uThandiwe ebona umthelela omuhle, waqala ukujabula. Wabona ukuthi abantu abadala bayakwazi ukufunda nokukhula, futhi lokhu kwakhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephusha imikhawulo. EThekwini, umthelela wokuminyana wawuvula amathuba, kodwa wawudinga abantu abakhuthazayo ukuze bakhulise izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, uThandiwe wahamba phambili. Waphakela iziphakamiso zokwakha izikhungo zokuhweba ukuze abathengisi bahlale bejolise emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokufinyelela ezimakethe zomhlaba. Kwaphela isikhathi, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaholela ekukhuleni kwezohwebo, uma abantu behlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, uThandiwe wayengasabi umthelela wokuminyana. Wayazi ukuthi uvuma izinselelo, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nabantu abakhuthazayo bangachaza indlela yabo. EThekwini, umthelela wokuminyana wawuhamba ngemigudu emisha, unika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Ibhizinisi likaThandiwe lathuthuka, kwavela abanye abathengisi abasha, futhi umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawubonakala njengezinkinga, wawuguqulwa waba yithuba lokukhula. UThandiwe wabona ukuthi umnotho ungathuthukiswa uma abantu bejolise ekubambeni izandla. EThekwini, izixazululo ezintsha zakhula. UThandiwe waba ngumpheki wezohwebo, njengoba eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephusha imikhawulo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawumkhumbuza izinselelo, wakhula waba yithuba lokuphila kwempumelelo. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe wathola uhlelo lokuhweba lwe-inthanethi olwakha ingqalasizinda eyenza kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe. Abathengisi abancane bahlala bejabulile, futhi uThandiwe, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba ngumholi wezohwebo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawuholela ezinkingeni, waba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo eThekwini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu emnothweni, futhi abathengisi baqala ukusebenzisana, baphendula izinselelo ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nokukhuthaza, umthelela wokuminyana wahamba phambili, unika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Uthando lobudlelwano, ukwakha nokuhlala uqhubekela phambili, kwaba ifa elihle lokuphila kwempumelelo eThekwini. Umthelela wokuminyana wagcina ukhombisa ukuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, banganqoba noma yiziphi izinkinga. UThandiwe, umthengisi ophumelelayo, waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma ubambisene, ungakwazi ukuvuma izinselelo, futhi wathola umthelela omuhle emnothweni.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal KwaZulu-Natal, leli khona elibhalwe emlandweni wokuthula neziphithiphithi, libhekene nezinselelo ezinzima ezibangelwa yizikhukhula ezinkulu ezihambisana nezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile. Izinsuku ezimbalwa ezedlule, izikhukhula zaphazamisa izimpilo zezakhamuzi, zashiya umonakalo omkhulu ezindlini, ezikoleni, nasezimotweni. Ukuhlola indlela uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo abaphendula ngayo kulezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka nokuthuthukiswa kwamasiko ahluphekayo. Ngokwezinhlangano ezibhekelele izimo zokuphila, abahlali abangephi ngalokho basebekhuluma ngezinkinga ezivela kulezi zikhukhula. Abanye baveze ukuthi imifula ithule kakhulu ingahlulwa, zinalo imithombo yamanzi engapheli kahle, okukhona kudala ukukhala ngezinkinga zempilo nezokuhlala. Lokhu kuphumeza ezamanzi angalungile nemiphumela eyingozi empilweni yabo. Uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal uvule amehlo amahle kulokhu, ugxile ekupha usizo kulezi zindawo ezithintekayo. Ukukhuluma nabezindaba, umphakathi uthe uHulumeni unikeza usizo lwezinhlelo zokuphuma kobubha nokuhlinzeka ngonyaka ngemali yokubuyisela izindawo ezilimele. Lokhu kubonisa isinyathelo esihamba phambili sokuvikela izakhamuzi ezinye izimo eziphuthumayo ezibangelwa izikhukhula. Ngaphezu kokubhekana nezinselelo zokuhlala, kubalulekile ukuhlola indlela abantu bezinhloso ezintaundweni yokuphila. Ukuhlangana kwezenhlalakahle kudinga ukuhlomula ngokuhlukile, ukuze kunciphise ukungakhululeki phakathi kwabantu. Izinsizakusebenza zokusiza kufuneka ziphumelele ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi, kuhlelwe izinhlelo zokuphila ezilula zokubona izinkinga. Ezindaweni ezithintekayo, abahlali bahlala babyazo imiphumela emibi yesikhukhula. Izinhlangano ezikhethekile ezikusasa zenzeka zikhombisa ukuthi abakha izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-wellness days nokushintsha indlela yokuphila kube nethonya elikhulu emiphakathini ethintekayo. Lokhu kuphumeza akhululi amazwi ayinkimbinkimbi kanti kwenze kwehlise umthelela wezinguquko. Ngokubukwa kabanzi, abezindaba begxile kumqathango wamanje, imiphakathi isidinga ukwakha izinqubo ezibambekayo zokushintsha izimo zempilo. Ukuhambisana nezinzuzo ezibamba abahlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, izinkampani ezisebenza kahle zengeza isixazululo esinembile. Ngaphandle kwalesi simo, umphakathi ungaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onokuphila ngempumelelo. Ngokwezinzakalo eziningi, umphakathi udinga uhlelo olucacile lokuphuma kulesi simo esinzima, olwakha imvula engenaphi na. Ukuhloliwe ngezinto eziluhlaza nezokwakha izindawo eziqinisekisiwe, isikhathi sokuphila asiqhamuki. Ubuchwepheshe bahlukahlukene bungafakwa ekuphenduleni, ukusiza ukuvikela izindawo ezithintekayo ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinhle. Ngokuya phambili, umndeni owandulelayo nesimo somphakathi odinga ukusizelwa kuzalo kuhlangene. Ukuze uHulumeni ubambe isiqiniseko sokuthi uhlinzekela abahlali abavamile izidingo zofakelo ezidingekayo njengoba kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngezisombululo ezingenamkhawulo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwenza abantu bahlale bephila, futhi izinsimu zikhuluphalisa umphakathi oqinile. Abahlengethisi bexhasa izinsiza ezimnandi kwabanye bephakathi, badala okuhlelwe okuphathelene nezokuphepha. Njengoba uHulumeni efuna ukubona izinselelo ezithile, okutholakala ezimpahleni, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izinga lokuhlala ngokuvumelanayo. Kobhusheni, kuhambisana nokusabalalisa izinaso ezincane ezivela ezindaweni ezilimele, abahlali baveze umuzwa wokufaka isandla nelawulwa; izinkampani zenza okuthile ukuze zithole izikhala zokuphumelela. Nokho, njengoba uHulumeni ezuza embusweni, izinzuzo ezithile zizinga eliphakeme. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhathi ezinzima sekufike etafuleni lokuqala, izinkampani ziqhubekela phambili neziqhamuka ezinhlosweni eziza nezinjongo. Ngalesi sikhathi eside, umphakathi uqhamuka nendawo eyamukelekayo yokusiza, okuholela emihlalweni emisha. Izinkampani zifuna ukusiza ukuze zibuyisele ekuqhulwini umphakathi, ukuze umzamo uholele empumelelweni. Ekugcineni, ukuba nezinhlaka eziphumelelayo, uHulumeni ulindele ukuvuma izigameko zomphakathi ezinhle. Ukuze izinsizakusebenza zibe lula, ukuhlola izindawo ezikuyiwonga umphakathi ucuthe, kubalulekile ukuvuselela. Umphakathi ukhiqiza okungako, uhulumeni kufanele ubuke bonke abacatshangwayo, ukuze kuhlelwe izinsiza zabantu bonke njengomkhankaso wokubuyisela isikhumbuzo kumphakathi. Izikhukhula seziqhubeka nesimo esinzima, kodwa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezinzima kuzoholela empumelelweni esizayo. Lokhu kuyahlinzeka ngezakhamizi umoya omusha, kanye nezenzo eziqondile zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ehluphekayo. Ngaphandle kokulindelekile, kuyaluleka ukuba nokuqhuba umsebenzi wokubuyisa umphakathi, uqhubeke nezindlela eziphumelelayo, ukuze kube nempilo ehambisana namathemba ezakhamizi. Uhlanga lwebhizinisi kumele luhlale lukhula, kuhlelwe izinto ezinhle, nezinselelo zezakhamizi ziqhubeka. Lokhu kuphumelela okungakonti, umphakathi ubetha umoya, ubomvu kahle, umoya ohlanzekile, umphakathi ohlanga. Ukubonga isikhumbuzo sokubuka, ukuze kube nempilo ejabulisayo, kuzokhulisa intuthuko.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Isingeniso Umlando wezombusazwe nezomnotho eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa ukuthi izigameko ezinkulu, ezifana nezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021, ziwumthombo wokuhlola imiphumela eminingi, ikakhulukazi emnothweni. Lezi zibhelu, ezavela ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezifana nokukhathazeka ngezenzo zezombusazwe, ukungabi nokwaneliseka ngezinga lokuphila, kanye nezinkinga zokuqashwa, zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasemiphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka imithelela ebalulekile yezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni, sithathela ingqikithi ezibhekelela izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi. Umongo wezibhelu Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zenzeka njengomphumela wokuphikisana okwakukhona phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu bebebonisa ukunganeliseki ngezinga lokuphila eliphakeme, ukuphathwa kwempilo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Ukuhlaselwa kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izitolo nezimboni kube yisibonakaliso sokuphikisana okukhulu nokudumazeka okukhona phakathi komphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, lezi zibhelu zaveza ubuhlungu obukhona ezingeni lempilo kunye nemiphumela yokungabi namathuba emisebenzi, okwaholela ekutheni abantu baphendule ngale ndlela. Umthelela emnothweni 1. Ukwanda kwezindleko Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu ezindlekweni zomnotho. Ukuhlaselwa kwezindawo zokuhweba, izimboni, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi kuholele ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kwemali, okwandisa izindleko zokubuyisela izinto emuveni. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amaningi aphumile emsebenzini noma enze ukunciphisa, okukhuphule izinga lokungasebenzi. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wendawo, njengoba ukukhiqiza kuncipha, okukhulisa ukuntuleka kwemali. 2. Ukwehla kwezinhlaka zomnotho Izibhelu zashiya umthelela omubi ezinkampanini ezincane, ezikhiqiza imisebenzi eminingi. Ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwezindawo zokuhweba, abanikazi bamabhizinisi abancane bathola ukuhlupheka okukhulu, okwaholela ekwandeni kokuhamba kwemali. Lokhu kuhlupheka kuhlobene nokwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu, okukhombisa izinkinga ezinhlekelele zomnotho. 3. Ukugxila kwezimali Abatshalizimali bakhombisa ukungabaza ngokuqhubekayo ezimakethe ngenxa yezibhelu, okuyinto ethinta ukutshalwa kwezimali. Ukungabikhona kokuthula, nomoya wokuphikisana, kuholele ekutheni abatshalizimali baphendule ngokuqaphela, bahlale kude nezinhlelo ezithile zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kokutshalwa kwezimali, okwakha isithombe esibi semigomo yokukhula komnotho. 4. Ukwanda kokungabi namathuba emisebenzi Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zaphinde zakhombisa umthelela oqhubekayo ekungabi namathuba emisebenzi. Ukuthula okungapheli kuholele ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba amabhizinisi amaningi ehluleka ukuqhubeka nokukhiqiza. Lokhu kube nomthelela omubi ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila, njengoba abantu besaba ukufinyela emsebenzini, okwandisa udlame phakathi kwabantu. 5. Imiphumela yokuhlala kwabantu Izibhelu zashiya umthelela emiphakathini ethile, ikakhulukazi kumiphakathi ethile ehluphekayo, lapho abantu babebonisa ukunganeliseki ngezinga lokuphila. Imiphakathi ethile, ikakhulukazi leyo engaphansi, ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, futhi izibhelu zabe zihlola lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuhamba phambili nemizamo yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila, okwenza kube nobudlelwano obunzima phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Isiphetho Ukwaziswa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni kungenzeka kube umthombo wemfundo kubaphathi bezomnotho kanye nabakhiqizi bezinqubomgomo. Ukubhekana nezizathu eziholela kulokhu kuhlaselwa, kuhlelelwa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa izinga lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo ezizayo zibe nemininingwane eqinile yokuhlola izindlela ezizokwazi ukusiza ekuqedeni lezi zinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuvikela umnotho ezimeni ezinjengalezi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo ezinjalo aziphindaphindiwe, futhi imiphakathi iqhubeke nokuthuthuka. Uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lungaboni kuphela izinselelo, kodwa futhi luhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umnotho onempilo.
Imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza nomnotho wasekhaya Ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2023, umphakathi waseMahlabathini uzobamba umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nemithetho yezitolo zama-spaza kanye nomnotho wasekhaya. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuxoxa ngezindlela ezithinta izitolo zama-spaza, ezibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, kanye nendlela umnotho wasekhaya ongathuthuka ngayo. Umcimbi uzovulwa ngenkulumo ethokozisayo evela kumalunga eKomidi leZitolo Zama-Spaza, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abazoqhubeka nokuchaza imithetho emisha ethinta izitolo. Le mithetho izohlanganisa iziqondiso ezisemthethweni ezithinta ukuvulwa kwezitolo, izidingo zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha ezizokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezitolo ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokusemthethweni. Ngemuva kwalokho, kuzoba nezingxoxo ezivulekile phakathi kwabavakashi, abanikazi bezitolo, kanye nochwepheshe bezomnotho. Lezi zingxoxo zizogxila ezindleleni ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umnotho wasekhaya, okuhlanganisa nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezitolo zama-spaza nezimakethe ezinkulu. Abanikazi bezitolo bazokwazi ukwabelana ngamasu abo, izinselele abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo abazitholile ukuze baqhubeke nokuphumelela. Umcimbi uzobandakanya nezifundo ezithile ezizokwakha ulwazi lwabavakashi. Izifundo zizoqondiswa ochwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu emkhakheni wezohwebo, futhi zizohlanganisa izihloko ezifana nezindlela zokuphatha izitolo, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela zokuthola amakhasimende. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezitolo ukuba baqonde izidingo zamakhasimende abo, nokuthi baphendule kahle ezimfuno zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzoba nezinkampani ezithile ezizobamba iqhaza, ezifana nezinkampani zokuhweba, izikhungo zokuxhaswa, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo. Lezi zinkampani zizohlinzeka ngeminikelo ebalulekile, njengokufundisa abanikazi bezitolo ngezindlela zokuphatha imali, ukwakha izinhlelo zokumaketha, kanye nezindlela zokuphucula izinga lempilo emiphakathini. Umcimbi uzophinde ube nethuba lokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwakha umoya wokubambisana, lapho abanikazi bezitolo nabanye abathintekayo bezokwazi ukuxhumana, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza umnotho wasekhaya ube namandla. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uzophothulwa ngenkulumo yokugcina enezifundo ezitholakele, lapho kuzokwenziwa iziphakamiso ezithile zokuthuthukisa umnotho wasekhaya ngokusebenzisa izitolo zama-spaza. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokuhlanganisa yonke imiqondo ethathwe phakathi komcimbi, nokwakha isikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi umnotho wasekhaya ungathuthuka uma wonke umuntu ebambisene. Umcimbi uzoba yithuba elibalulekile lokufunda, ukufundisana, nokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Sihalalisela bonke abathintekayo, futhi sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza kulolu suku olujabulisayo nolwakha. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, umcimbi uzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho osebenzayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ozinikele ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu emiphakathini yethu. Umthelela wokuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela Ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela, okungukuthi, ukungasebenzi kahle kwemishini ethile ethinta ukuhamba kwabantu, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni nasemphakathini jikelele. Le ngxoxo-mpikiswano izobheka izici ezahlukene zokuphuka kwalolu hlobo, izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nale nkinga. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umshini wamalayisense okushayela ubalulekile ekuphathweni kwemoto. Uma umshini uphuka, kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli bangakwazi ukuhamba ngendlela efanele, okungaholela ezimeni ezinzima zokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izingozi ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, ukulimala kwabantu, kanye nezindleko ezinkulu zokulungisa izimoto. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona abanye abathi ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba nethuba lokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokuphatha izimoto. Lokhu kungenzeka uma abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli babe nekhono elingcono lokuphatha izimoto zabo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekuphepheni kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Uma izimoto zingasebenzi kahle, abashayeli bangase badinge ukulungisa izimoto zabo, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo, ikakhulukazi uma abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale bezama ukulungisa izinkinga ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi emnothweni, njengoba abashayeli bengase badinge ukusebenzisa imali eningi ukuze balungise izimoto zabo. Kodwa-ke, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba yithuba lokwenza izinguquko ezinhle.
