Ngakho-ke, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela akukhona nje kuphela inkinga, kodwa futhi kungaba yithuba lokwenza izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezokuthutha.
Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika 1. Isingeniso Umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubonakale ukhula ngokushesha eminyakeni edlule. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukwanda kwezidingo zamakhasimende, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Le dokhumenti izobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokukhula komkhakha wama-call centre, izinzuzo, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta lo mkhakha. 2. Izizathu Zokukhula 2.1 Ubuchwepheshe Obuthuthukisiwe Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wama-call centre. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-CRM (Customer Relationship Management), zenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izingcingo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwenza ama-call centre akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende ngokushesha. 2.2 Ukukhula Kwezidingo Zamakhasimende Njengoba izinkampani zikhula, zidinga izinsizakalo ezinhle zokuxhumana namakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwama-call centre, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende athola usizo olusheshayo nolusezingeni eliphezulu. 2.3 Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umsebenzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukukhula komkhakha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele lokuphatha izingcingo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. 3. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Komkhakha 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zihlola ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ukusebenzisa ama-bots ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo kubasebenzi, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlaziya ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3.2 Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala befundiswa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, izinqubo ezintsha, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni ezihlukahlukene. 3.3 Ukuphathwa Kwekhwalithi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende athola insizakalo engcono, izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuphatha ikhwalithi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphendula, isikhathi sokulinda, kanye nezinga lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. 4. Izinzuzo Zokukhula Komkhakha 4.1 Ukudala Imisebenzi Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre kuholela ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho bezama ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi. 4.2 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Umkhakha wama-call centre ungumthombo omkhulu wezindleko. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhulisa imisebenzi yazo. 4.3 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamakhasimende Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zithuthukise izinsizakalo zazo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani namakhasimende. 5. Izinselelo Ezithinta Umkhakha 5.1 Ukuncintisana Okukhulu Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, kukhona ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhamuka nezixazululo ezintsha ukuze zihlale zikhangisa amakhasimende. 5.2 Izinga Lokuphila Kwabasebenzi Izinga lokuphila kwabasebenzi emkhakheni wama-call centre lingase libe phansi. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi bazo, ukuze kugwenywe ukushiya emsebenzini. 5.3 Izinguquko Ezemthethweni Izinguquko emthethweni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni. Izinkampani kufanele zihlale ziqaphele izinguquko ezisemthethweni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. 6. Isiphetho Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinselelo ezithile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuphatha ikhwalithi ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa amakhasimende. Ngale ndlela, umkhakha ungakhula futhi ube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.
Ulwazi olungamanga ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi sokhetho Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, indima edlalwa kulezi zikhathi zokhetho ibalulekile, kodwa kufanele siqaphele ukuthi zikhona nezingozi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kulwazi olungamanga. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu futhi zisheshisa ukwaziswa, kodwa zibuye zibe umthombo wezinkinga. Kumele sikhulume ngalesi sihloko ukuze sikhumbuze abantu ukuba baqaphele. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana azilawulwa kahle. Noma kukhona izinqubomgomo ezibekwe yizinkampani ezifana ne-Facebook ne-Twitter, lokhu akusizi uma abantu beqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngesikhathi sokhetho, lapho abaculi, izinkanyezi, kanye nabanye abantu abathandwayo bezithola nezwi elikhulu. Uma umuntu ethumela ulwazi olungamanga, kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu, okungaholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo ezingalungile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ulwazi olungamanga lwenza kube nzima kubavoti ukuthola iqiniso. Abantu bavame ukuphazamiseka phakathi kwezindaba ezisemthethweni nezithunyelwe ngabanye, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho izimvo ezingalungile zikhuluma kakhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bangakwazi ukubona isithombe esiphelele. Kukhona izibonelo eziningi zokuthi ulwazi olungamanga lungakha kanjani izinkinga. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umphakathi uthola ulwazi elichaza ukuthi ungathola izinzuzo kuphela uma uvota eqenjini elithile, lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abavoti abakwazi ukukhetha kahle. Izindaba ezikhaliphile ezivela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zingaba nomthelela omubi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ukuthi kukhona okuthile okuhle, kanti empeleni isimo siba sibi. Uma abantu behluleka ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwezindaba eziyiqiniso nezisemthethweni, izinqumo zabo zingaphazamiseka, okwenza kube nzima ukukhetha abaholi abaqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ngesikhathi sokhetho, lapho izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abaningi abavoti ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umphakathi ungabi nalwazi olufanele, futhi kungase kubangele ukungavoti, okuyinto engathinta umphakathi. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukuhlakanipha nokuhlola ulwazi kubalulekile. Lezi zinkundla zingaba yinsiza ebalulekile uma zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kodwa uma zisetshenziswa kabi, zingaba yingozi. Ngakho, ngicela wonke umuntu aqaphele ulwazi athola kulo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sithathe izinqumo eziphusile. Ulwazi olungamanga lungakha izinkinga, lungaphazamisa umphakathi, futhi lungathinta indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo. Ngakho, ngaphambi kokuvota, khumbula ukubheka kahle ulwazi onalo, uqinisekise ukuthi luyiqiniso, ukuze sikwazi ukudala ikusasa eliqinile nelithokozisayo.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo Isingeniso Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta impilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezinsiza zempilo ezincane. I-Limpopo, enabantu abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsiza zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kodokotela abaneziqu ezifanele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke ngenxa yokungatholi usizo lwezempilo olufanele, okukhombisa ubungozi obukhulu empilweni yabo. Izizathu zokushoda kodokotela Izizathu eziholela ekushodeni kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo ziningi futhi zihluke-hluke. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo ezisemakhaya kubalulekile. Izikhungo zempilo ezincane azitholi uxhaso olwanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze kulezi zindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, ezifana nezinsiza ezincane, izimo zokuhlala ezinzima, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthutha, zenza kube nzima kubodokotela ukuhlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesibili, ukungabi khona kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa imfundo yodokotela nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Abafundi abathanda ukuba odokotela bavame ukukhetha izikhungo ezinkulu ezisemadolobheni, lapho bezothola khona amathuba angcono okusebenza, izifundo ezithuthukile, kanye nezinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokushoda kodokotela ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, njengoba abanye bephuma ezindaweni ezincane befuna amathuba angcono. Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya ibonakala ngokucacile. Okokuqala, abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo eziningi, kodwa bengenakho ukufinyelela odokotela. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwana, ukungaphili kahle, kanye nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Abantu bahlala bephuthuma ezikhungweni zempilo ezikude, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesibili, ukushoda kodokotela kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zempilo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya badinga ukuhamba izikhumbuzo eziningi ukuze bafinyelele odokotela, okwandisa izindleko zabo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye baphuthelwe yizinsiza ezibalulekile, okukhombisa ukuthi ukungabi khona kodokotela akuholeli kuphela ezinkingeni zempilo, kodwa futhi nasekutheni abantu bahlupheke ngokwezimali. Izixazululo ezingaba khona Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele anikeze uxhaso olukhulu ezikhungweni zempilo ezisemakhaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze kulezi zindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imfundo yodokotela kufanele ziqinisiwe, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuthola amathuba okusebenza ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesibili, kudingeka izinhlelo zokukhuthaza odokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezinjengokuthola izikhala ezikhethekile, izikhwama zokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthuka emsebenzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubodokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini. Isiphetho Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Izizathu eziholela ekushodeni kodokotela ziningi, futhi imiphumela yayo ibonakala ngokucacile empilweni yabantu. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ezihlanganisa ukuxhaswa kwezikhungo zempilo, ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yodokotela, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza odokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi eLimpopo, futhi sithuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo.
Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan nemithelela yazo Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni waseMkhumbane, kwavela izindaba ezithokozisayo ezazihlobene nohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) olwakhiwe ukuze luthuthukise amandla kagesi eNingizimu Afrika. UThandi, umphakathi wezokwakha, wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abahlali ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zibuyekezo ezibalulekile. UThandi, owayengumfundi wezokuphathwa kwezinsiza, waba nesithakazelo esikhulu kulolu hlelo. Wazi ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zazizokwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, wathola ithuba lokuhola umhlangano wendawo, lapho abahlali bezokwazi khona ukufunda nokuxoxa ngalezi zinguquko. Umhlangano waqala ngenkathi uThandi ethula izizathu zokuthi kungani izibuyekezo zibalulekile. "Siyazi ukuthi amandla kagesi ayadingeka ukuze siphile kahle. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngohlelo lwe-IRP, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, umnotho wethu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezizothuthukisa umphakathi wethu," kusho yena. Abahlali babemangala ngalezi zindaba. UNomsa, omunye wabahlali, waphakamisa isandla. "Ngabe lezi zibuyekezo zizosiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zamandla kagesi?" ubuza. UThandi wamamatheka, "Yebo, uNomsa. Okwamanje, izibuyekezo zifaka phakathi ukwandisa amandla avuselelekayo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amandla ngentengo ephansi." Uhlelo lwe-IRP lwaluhlose ukunciphisa ukuthembela kumandla avela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, njengamalahle, futhi lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengelanga nomoya. Lokhu kwakuhambisana nezifiso zabahlali zokuba nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula. Njengoba umhlangano uqhubeka, uThandi wabelana ngemininingwane ethokozisayo yokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zizosiza ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha. "Uma sithuthukisa amandla avuselelekayo, sizokwazi ukudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha," kusho yena. UThandi waphinde wakhuluma ngempumelelo yeziqubulo ezihlobene nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi. "Sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza emikhakheni emisha, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa umnotho wethu," wengeza. Abahlali babebonakala bejabule, kodwa uSipho, omunye wabahlali, waphakamisa ukukhathazeka. "Kodwa, uThandi, uma sishintsha izinsiza, ingabe sizokwazi ukugcina izinga lokuphila eliphezulu?" ubuza. UThandi wamphendula, "Yebo, Sipho. Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke." Ngemuva kokuxoxa, abahlali bavuma ukuthi kufanele baphumelele ekutholeni ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. UThandi wanxusa bonke ukuba babhalise ukuze bathole izindaba ezivela kuhulumeni mayelana nezibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP. "Sidinga ukuba sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lethu," kusho yena. Umhlangano waphothulwa ngenkathi uThandi ebonisa abahlali ukuthi bangabhalisela izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela ezizobanjwa emiphakathini yabo. "Sizoba neqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo," waphawula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zazingaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abahlali baphuma emhlanganweni bejabule, bekwazi ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zizobathinta ngempela. UThandi wayezimisele ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zifeza izinjongo ezinhle, futhi zikhuthaze impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zingaba nemithelela emihle, uma abantu bebandakanyeka futhi bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinguquko ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zaziyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu.
Amaphrojekthi Wamandla Avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa Isingeniso Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukuvikela imvelo, kanye nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Lezi zinyathelo zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zamandla elanga, amaphrojekthi wamandla omoya, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqale amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi 1. Bheka Izidingo Zomphakathi: Qala ngokuhlola izidingo zamandla zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni bendawo ukuze uqonde izidingo zabo. 2. Hlanganisa Idatha: Qoqa idatha ethile mayelana nezinga lokusetshenziswa kwamandla, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela amaphrojekthi afanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Uhlobo Lwamandla Avuselelekayo 1. Hlola Izinhlobo Zokukhiqiza Amandla: Khetha phakathi kwamandla elanga, amandla omoya, amandla amanzi, noma amanye amandla avuselelekayo, kuye ngezidingo zomphakathi nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. 2. Bheka Izimo Zendawo: Qinisekisa ukuthi izimo zendawo zifanele ukukhiqiza amandla, kufaka phakathi ukuhlola izinga lokukhanya kwelanga, umoya, noma amanzi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuxhasa 1. Xhumana Nezikhungo Zokuxhasa: Thola izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali, izinsiza, noma ulwazi. Lokhu kungafaka uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. 2. Bhalisela Izinhlelo Zoxhaso: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubhalisela izinhlelo zoxhaso ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole uxhaso lwezimali oludingekayo. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Nokwakha Amaphrojekthi 1. Hlela Uhlelo Lwamaphrojekthi: Dala uhlelo olucacile lokwakha amaphrojekthi, okufanele kufake izinsuku, izindleko, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 2. Qasha Abasebenzi Abafanele: Qasha abasebenzi abanolwazi nolwazi olufanele ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha. 3. Qala Ukwakha: Ngemva kokuhlela, qala ukwakha amaphrojekthi. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zilandelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlola Nokugcina 1. Hlola Ukusebenza Kwamaphrojekthi: Ngemva kokwakha, hlola ukusebenza kwamaphrojekthi ukuze uthole izinkinga ezikhona nokuthi zixazululwe. 2. Gcina Amaphrojekthi: Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi agcinwa kahle ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza, okuhlanganisa ukuphakela ukuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi 1. Xhumana Nomphakathi: Qhubeka uxhumana nomphakathi ukuze ubazise ngempumelelo yamaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukuheha ukwesekwa. 2. Hlanganisa Izimpendulo: Thola izimpendulo zomphakathi ukuze uthole umbono wabo ngempumelelo yamaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ayisixazululo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ozinzile nowempumelelo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi akho aphumelela futhi ahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukubambisana, ukuhlela kahle, nokuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze amaphrojekthi akwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. Qhubeka ube nesibindi, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuhlaziywa kohlelo lokondla ezikoleni Umbuzo 1: Yini uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlelo olwenziwe ukuze luhlinzeke abantwana ngokudla okunempilo ezikoleni. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola izidingo zokudla ezibalulekile, ukuze bakwazi ukwandisa amandla abo okufunda nokuqhuba kahle imisebenzi yabo yokufunda. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlinzeka ukudla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zisiza ekunciphiseni ukuntuleka kokudla kwezingane. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza ukufunda kahle, ngoba ukudla okunempilo kukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle kobuchopho. Okwesithathu, zikhuthaza impilo enhle, njengoba ukudla okunempilo kulethe injabulo nezinga eliphezulu lamandla ezinganeni. Umbuzo 3: Kuthiwani ngama-engeli ahlukene ohlakeni? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kuhlinzeka ngezinto ezahlukene zohlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinsiza ezikhona, ukunakekela ukudla, izinkinga zokuhlinzeka, kanye nemiphumela yokudla ezikoleni. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlinzeka ngoxhaso kubakhiqizi bendawo, okwenza kube nokwaziswa okufanele emiphakathini. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lokondla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Ziningi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Isibonelo, ukungabi nemali eyanele kungenzeka kube yinkinga, njengoba abanye abasebenzi bezehlisa izinga lokusebenza. Futhi, izinqubo zokuphatha kanye nokudla okunempilo zingase zingatholakali kalula, okuholela ezindleleni ezincane zokuhlinzeka. Umbuzo 5: Uhlelo lokondla lungashintshwa kanjani ukuze lusebenze kangcono? Impendulo: Ukuze uhlelo lokondla lusebenze kangcono, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikole, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuhlola izidingo zokudla, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokudla okunempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi ngomthelela wokudla. Ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano namakampani akhiqiza ukudla endaweni kungasiza ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakusebenza. Umbuzo 6: Kungani kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinhlelo zokondla ezizenzakalelayo? Impendulo: Izinhlelo zokondla ezizenzakalelayo zibalulekile ngoba zisiza ukufaka izinqubo eziphezulu zokuphatha, zigcine izindleko ziphansi, futhi ziqhube umphakathi odinga ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kukhulisa imiphumela yokufunda ukuze abafundi bazuze ekukhuleni nasekugcineni impilo enempilo. Umbuzo 7: Uhlelo lokondla luzoba nemiphumela emihle kulabo abazingela ukufunda? Impendulo: Yebo, uhlelo lokondla luthinta ngqo imiphumela yokufunda. Abafundi abathola ukudla okunempilo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi baveza ukusebenza kahle, benza kube lula ukubamba ulwazi. Lokhu kuphinde kwehlise izinga lokuhlukumezeka okuhlobene nesimo sokudla. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe izinhlelo zokondla ezehlukene ziyiwo kuphela ezikhiqizayo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunemibono eminingi efana nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezahlukahlukene zokuqonda izidingo zempilo. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zingase zihambisane nezifundo zezemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphila komphakathi, ukuze kube nokuhlanganiswa okuhle. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izikole ezinkulu kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile zokondla? Impendulo: Yebo, izikole ezinkulu kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo eziqinile ezihlanganisa ukuhlonishwa kwemithombo yasemhlabeni, ukugcina izinga lokudla, kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqhuba izinqubo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo nezidingekayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini oyikhuthazayo kumphakathi ukuze uhlelo lokondla luzuze? Impendulo: Ikhuthezeleke ukuncenga umphakathi ukuba ubambisane nabantu abaninzi. Lokhu kufaka ukudala izinhlelo zokweluleka ezifanele, izifundo zokuphila ezibandakanya nezinsiza ezithile. Ubulunga abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube nokuhlanganyela ezinyathelweni ezikhuthazayo ezimele izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo. Ngamafuphi, ukuhlaziywa kohlelo lokondla ezikoleni kudinga ukuxhumanisa zonke izikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana bathola ukudla okufanele, okwandisa amathuba okuphumelela ekufundeni nasekuphileni kwabo. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lungaba nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zezingane, umphakathi, kanye nasezifundazweni.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika 1. Isingeniso Ukudlulela kwedijithali kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo ulwazi nokuxhumana. ENingizimu Afrika, iphrojekthi ye-digital migration ibiyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa isiteshi semiphakathi nezokuxhumana. Nokho, le phrojekthi ibhekene nezithiyo eziningi ezibangela ukubambezeleka. Lo mbhalo uzogxila ezicini eziholela ekubambezelekeni kwalolu hlelo, izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. 2. Ukuqonda Ukubambezeleka Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration kuvele ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukungabi bikho kwezimali ezanele, nezinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe nasemigomeni yokuphatha nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekubambezelekeni. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlaziywa kwezinselelo ezihlukahlukene. 3. Izizathu Zokubambezeleka 3.1 Izinkinga Zezimali Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika iwukuntuleka kwezimali. Imali edingekayo ukuze kuphumelele le phrojekthi ibiza kakhulu, futhi lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinhlelo ezibalulekile zibe semkhakheni wokubambezeleka. Ukuze kuqedeleke le phrojekthi, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele ezivela kuHulumeni, izinkampani eziPrivate, kanye nohulumeni bamazwe omhlaba. 3.2 Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Iphrojekthi ye-digital migration idinga uxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izinkampani zezinhlaka, kanye nabaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukungabikhona kokuxhumana kahle phakathi kwalezi zinhlaka kuholela ekubambezelekeni kwemigomo ethile. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nokuxhumana okuhle. 3.3 Ukungabi Bikho Kwezinsiza Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili buqhubeka buveza izinselelo ezintsha. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele zokuhlinzeka ngedijithali kuyinto enkulu ethinta iphrojekthi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakusebenza ezifanele, imishini, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, kubalulekile ukuba khona kwezinsiza ezanele. 4. Izinyathelo Zokubhekelela Izinkinga 4.1 Ukuxhumana Ngempumelelo Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezicacile, ukuze wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza. Ukubamba imihlangano evamile ukuze kuhlanganyelwe izimvo kungasiza kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. 4.2 Ukwandisa Izinsiza Zezimali Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-digital migration iyaphumelela, kudingeka ukwandisa uxhaso lwezimali. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuphakanyiswa kwezinsizakusebenza ezingabhaliswa, noma izinhlelo zokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukuze uHulumeni akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezifanele. 4.3 Ukuhlola Izinsiza Nokuhlinzeka Kokuqeqeshwa Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bazi kahle ukuthi bangasisebenzisa kanjani isikhala sedijithali, kudingeka ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhlobene. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuphatha kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlola izinsiza ezidingekayo njalo kudinga ukuba kube semgibeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele. 5. Imiphumela Yokubambezeleka Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration kungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nalwazi olufanele kubantu, ukuncipha kokuxhumana, kanye nokwehliswa kokutholakala kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthi baphile kahle ezindaweni ezibhekene nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okubambezeleka kungaholela ekwehleni kokuthembeka kukahulumeni, okuyinto engathinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nohulumeni. 6. Isiphetho Iphrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo yabantu nokuxhumana kwezakhamuzi. Nokho, ukubambezeleka kule phrojekthi kudinga ukuhlinzekwa kwezixazululo ezicacile. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, futhi kuxazululwe izinkinga ezibangelwa ukubambezeleka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kudingeka ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Uhlanga lwezixazululo oluqinile nolusebenza kahle luzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi i-digital migration ibe yimpumelelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika.
Ngomhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu 2023, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wethule uhlelo olusha lokuqinisekisa lwezinsiza zezeMali ezitholakala ku-Home Affairs online. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinsiza ezahlukene, njengokufaka izicelo zezimvume zokuhlala, ama-ID, kanye nezincwadi zokuzalwa. Lokhu kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi, kanye nokuphucula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlose ukunciphisa izikhathi zokulinda ezijwayelekile ezihambisana nezinsiza zomphakathi. U-Mnu. Sipho Mthembu, okhulumela uMnyango wezamaNhlangano, uveze ukuthi uhlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphusile, futhi ezitholakala kalula kubantu bonke. "Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke, noma bahlala kuphi, bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zethu ngokushesha," kusho uMnu. Mthembu. Abantu bangabhalisela izinsiza ezithile ku-inthanethi, bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, nokukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezicelo zabo. Lokhu kukhulisa ukuhlela izikhathi zokuvakasha ezidingekayo, okunciphisa izixakaxaka ezivamile emnyangweni. Abantu abaningi baphendule kahle kulolu hlelo, bekhombisa ukwaneliseka. U-Phumzile Nkosi, umfundi ophothule izifundo zakhe, uthe: "Ngiyathokoza kakhulu ngalolu hlelo. Ngaphambilini, kwakunzima ukuthola izinsiza, kodwa manje ngikwazi ukuzenza ngikhululekile ekhaya." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo luphendula izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezikhona. Abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa komsebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. U-Mr. Themba Dlamini, ongumsebenzi wezokuxhumana, uthe: "Kukhona abantu abangenayo imishini yokuxhuma ku-inthanethi, futhi lokhu kubaphazamisa. Uhlelo lwenziwe kahle, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela." Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango wezamaNhlangano uhlela ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops ezindaweni ezikude ukuze abantu bathole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana zizokwenza abantu bazi ngalezi zinhlelo, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani. Uhlelo luzobe luhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bengabiza khona ukuze bathole usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abanakho ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi bangathola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baqhubeke nezicelo zabo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. U-Mnu. Mthembu uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi izinsiza zethu zibalulekile empilweni yabantu, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithuthukise lezi zinsiza." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnyango uzophinde ube nezinqumo ezithile zokwenza uhlelo lube ngcono, kuhlanganise nokwandisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, futhi kuqinise ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngenkundla yokufinyelela, futhi lwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuphetha, uhlelo lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphusile, futhi ezitholakala kalula kubantu. Nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile, uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esihle sokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online, futhi kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uyazama ukwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono.
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Ngokwanda kokwenziwa kwezinto eziningi, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ubonakala ungena ezindaweni eziningi zokuphila. Kulezi zinsuku, lapho umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinguquko zinezimpempe ezikhaliphile emabhizinisini amancane. Ezimakethe, izinkampani ezincane zikhula zikhula ngokushesha, zifuna ukujabulisa amakhasimende futhi zikhuthaze ukuthengiswa. Nokho, uma kucishwa kukagesi, lokhu kuthinteka kakhulu. Lokhu kucishwa kukagesi kuholela ekutheni amabhizinisi ahluleke ukugcina imfanelo yemikhiqizo yabo, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuncipha kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. UJohn Mthethwa, onemakethe yokudla eGoli, uthi: "Ngesikhathi senkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, sithola ukuthi izinsiza zethu ziyasuka. Ukuphila kwethu kuncike kumshini, futhi uma kukhona ukungasebenzi kahle kukagesi, kuza nezinselelo ezinkulu." UJohn uqhubeka nokukhuluma ngokuthi, "Sizama ukuhlela kahle, kodwa ukungabi nakagesi kuphazamisela wonke umsebenzi." Umphakathi wezobuchwepheshe ubona ukuthi izinkampani ezincane zidinga izixazululo ezisheshayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukusebenzisa ama-generator ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uyaqhubeka. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kubiza kakhulu, futhi akulungele wonke amabhizinisi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane ngesikhathi sokucishwa kukagesi. UProfesa Thandeka Nkosi, udokotela wezomnotho, uthe umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ubonakala emnothweni jikelele. "Uma amabhizinisi amancane ehluleka, imiphumela izoba mibi kumuntu wonke. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi, nokuncipha kwemali engenayo," kusho uProfesa Nkosi. Ezinye izinkampani, ezifana nezezimali, nazo ziba nezinselelo. USipho Dlamini, umphathi wenkampani yezezimali, uthe: "Siyakwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza, kodwa izindleko zokugcina isondlo siphila zikhuphuka. Lokhu kukhuthaza umthengi ukuthi asebenzise izinsiza eziningi, okuyinto engavumi." Umkhakha wezokuthengisa ubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Abathengisi baphinde bazame ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, kodwa uma kukhona ukucishwa kukagesi, lokhu kuthinta ubukhona babo emakethe. UZandile Khumalo, umthengisi wezimpahla, uthe: "Siyazama ukusindisa, kodwa uma kukhona ukucishwa kukagesi, kunzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende." Izinselelo ezihamba phambili zifaka phakathi ukwehluleka kokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinqala, okubandakanya ukuxhaswa okuqondile kumabhizinisi amancane. UThandiwe Mthembu, ummeli wezohwebo, uthi: "Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni axhase amabhizinisi amancane ngezinsizakusebenza ezikahle ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela." Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bakhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ama-solar panels, ngokwesibonelo, asebenzisa amandla elanga ukuze ahlinzeke ugesi. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuncika kumasevisi kagesi, futhi kungasiza amabhizinisi amancane ukuthi agcine ukusebenza kahle. UBarbara Ngcobo, umnikazi wenkampani yokwakha, uthe: "Senza izinhlelo zokuqasha ama-solar panels ukuze sizuze amandla elanga. Lokhu kusinikeza ukuqhubeka, futhi siba nekhono lokwenza umsebenzi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngocingo lokucishwa." Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlangene phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabathintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa okuphelele emabhizinisini amancane. UProfesa Nkosi uphetha ngokuthi: "Uma singahlanganyela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumabhizinisi amancane, futhi kuzothuthukisa umnotho jikelele." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubheka izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze kuqedwe umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokukhula emnothweni, futhi kuzokwenza amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngenxa yalokho, umphakathi ungabona ukubuyiselwa okuhle kokusebenza kanye nempumelelo yezezimali.
### Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni Isazi sesiZulu sihlohlela izinqumo zenkantolo njengokuhlotshisiwe kwemigomo emisha, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sihlolisise izinqumo ezithathwa yile ntando yoMthethosisekelo, ukuze siqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokukhethwa kwabazimele. Kulesi sihloko, sizobuyekeza isinqumo esithile esithathwe yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nezimo zokukhethwa kwabazimele kanye nempembelelo yalesi sinqumo emphakathini. ### Ukubuka Kwezakhamizi Zezwe Sizoluza esikhaleni sokhetho, lapho abazimele bephakathi kokudinga ukwethembeka kubahluli bemihlangano. Isinqumo seNkantolo sihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuthula nokulingana kwezokhetho. Ukuhlolisisa kwe-constitution kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha umphakathi olungile. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukwakha izinto ezintsha, izinqumo zokhetho kumele zibe nomoya ophawulekayo wezinto ezibhekile. Izizathu ezikhathele izinqumo zenkantolo zikhombisa ukuthi abazimele kufanele bathathe indawo ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kungenkani izinsolo zokungathembeki. Isinqumo sokuthi abazimele bangagqugquzeliwe ukuzimela kulezi zimo kuyinhloko yemigomo yokukhethwa ehambisana nezimfanelo zezwe. ### Isimo Sezokhetho Ngesikhathi Sezimo Izinyathelo ezithathwa yinkantolo ziyaqinisekisa ukungafakazelwa komthetho, njengoba abavoti kudingeka bazi ukuthi abanye bazimele bahlala benemfanelo yokukhulumela wonke umuntu. Izinqumo ezifanele zihlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo zokukhetha, okungaholela ekubeni nezokhetho ezihlanzekile, ezizele ngemigomo ethile esebenzayo, ukuze umphakathi uvumele okwempilo ukubamba iqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuqonda, uma sizobuka ukuthi izinqumo ziyazikhipha kanjani, sinendlela ethile yokwenza, ukuhlola kamuva izinqumo ezithathwe ngaleso sikhathi. Umkhandlu ubonisa indlela yokuvumelana kwemibono phakathi kokubhekisela kumthetho (legal framework) nomqondo wokwakha abanye abadlali abazimele. ### Ukubuyiselwa Kwabazimele Isinqumo seNkantolo sokuthi abazimele kufanele banikezwe ithuba elingcono lokukhuluma kuveza ukuhluka okukhuluma ngezinselelo ezihlongozwayo, okuhamba phambili ekukhuleni komnotho ngenxa yakho yokwakha abathintekayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukufaneleka kokwakhiwa kwemikhakha yokukhetha, umthethosisekelo ubalulekile ekwakheni izokuqhubeka kulokhu. Izinyathelo ezithathwa ngenkantolo zikhombisa udaba oludingekayo lwemiphakathi eyahlukeneyo, olunokwehluka phakathi kokunyuka kobuqotho nezindlela zokubusa. Ukubuyiselwa kwabazimele kuhlobene nomnotho omuhle, ubuhlakani obukhulu, nokuthinteka kwabazimele ezinhlelweni zezenhlalakahle. ### Ukubaluleka Kwezinqumo Ngokwakha ezimweni ezinhle, umphakathi uphinde ukhuthazwe ukuba ubekezelele amavoti akhe, kanti nezintambo zenkululeko ziqashelwa njengokukhombisa okuhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuqhubeka kolwazi ukuze kube nesithakazelo ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi, okwandisa ithimba elikhethiwe. Izenzo ezihambisana nenqubomgomo yenkantolo ziphakamisa ukuba nobuchule ekwakheni isimo esingenaziphazamiso. ### Isiphetho Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni sidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa bukhona emkhakheni wezokhetho. Ngokusho kwezinqumo zenkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi abazimele banikezwe ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokhetho oluhlanzekile, oluqinisekisiwe, noqondile. Umphakathi, kudinga ukuthi ube nokuqonda kwezohwebo, umthethonqubo, nokwakha abavoti abaqotho ukuze baphile ngokukhululeka nangobuqotho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umthetho ungakhonza njengegugu eliyisisekelo sokwakhiwa kwempilo yomphakathi olungile nohlanganyela. Ngamafuphi, isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo senza ukuba umuntu ngamunye abe nesibopho sokwakha izwe eliqinile, elinokuthula, nokwabelana ngempumelelo ezikhathini ezinzima. Njengoba siqhubeka nalezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi ukuzimisela kwemiphakathi, nodlame lwezinto eziphakanyisiwe, kulungiswe ukuze kuzuze zonke izinhlangothi zomphakathi.
Ngiyavuma, ingxoxo yethu ngalesi sihloko esithokozisayo sokuminyana ethekwini ibalulekile. Uminyano uhlanganisa abantu abaningi, izitolo eziningi, nezinkampani ezahlukene, okwenza kube yingxenye ebalulekile kwezohwebo. Ake siqale ngama-positives: uma abantu beqhamuka ethekwini bezama ukuthenga ezindaweni ezithile, izitolo ziba nomthamo omkhulu wokuthengisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungumthengisi, uthola ithuba elihle lokwandisa amathuba akho okuthengisa. Futhi, uma uhweba endaweni enabantu abaningi, uzothola amakhasimende amaningi. Ucabanga kanjani umthelela wezindawo eziminyanisiwe? Ngokwesibonelo, uma uhweba e-Durban CBD, izivakashi zihlala zikhangwe ukuhamba, okwandisa amathuba okuthi zibone izimpahla zakho. Ngabe ubona indlela abantu abahamba ngayo ethekwini? Kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukukhuluma ngama-businesses amakhulu. Izinkampani ezinkulu zikhona, futhi uma uhweba endaweni enabantu abaningi, ungase udinge ukuncintisana nazo. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi ubani ophumelelayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngezinkinga ezihambisana nokuminyana. Imizamo yokuhweba eThekwini ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile, njengokukhula kokuhamba okungaholela ezinkingeni zokufinyelela ezitolo. Futhi uma izindawo zidalula ubude, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo, ukukhula komphakathi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithinta impilo, okungase kubangele izinkinga kwezohwebo. Uma abantu bejolise kakhulu emnyangweni wezohwebo, kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuphila, ezibangela ukukhula kwezintela. Umnyango wezohwebo kumele uqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi iyavikeleka. Ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba muhle noma omubi? Kulolu hlobo lwengxoxo, izimpendulo zingahluka. Abanye bangase bakholelwe ukuthi umthelela omuhle uyavela, kanti abanye bangase baphakamise ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo uphumelelisile ekuphepheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi izinkampani eziminyanisiwe zingabhekelwa kanjani. Okokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu bahlala behamba, futhi umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini uzohlala uhlangene nezinto eziningi. Ngabe uthanda lezi zinkampani ezinkulu? Futhi, ungakwenza kanjani ukuze ujabulise abantu? Ngakho, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini kwezohwebo ubonakala ngale ndlela. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani umnyango wezohwebo ungakha okuthile okukhangayo? Uma sikhuluma ngenzuzo, sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngempilo, ngezindlela ezithakazelisayo. Ubuya kanjani? Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana uzoba ngcono noma kuzoba nezinkinga? Lokhu kuzokwenza kube mnandi ukuxoxa, futhi imiphumela izohlala ikhanya. Hamba kahle, futhi siqhubeke nokuxoxa ngale ndaba ethokozisayo!
Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, kusekhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu mayelana nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu emithini yokwelapha, kuxhumene nezimo ezinzima zezempilo kubantu abaningi ababhekene nezinkinga zempilo ezidinga ukwelashwa. Kukhona izikhalazo eziningi ezivela kubantu abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni, abathi imithi ayitholakali kalula, ikakhulukazi imithi ebalulekile yokwelapha izifo ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS, uDiabetes, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Lokhu kushoda kwemithi kungenxa yezinkinga eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza, nokungabi khona kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuhambisa imithi. UProfesa Thandiwe Mkhize, ongumholi wezempilo, uthi: “Ukushoda kwemithi akubangeli kuphela ubuhlungu kubantu, kodwa futhi kudala umthwalo omkhulu ezibhedlela nasezinhlelweni zempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezibhedlela.” Izibhedlela eziningi zixwayisa abantu ukuthi uma besebenzisa izinsiza zempilo, kufanele baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi banemithi edingekayo ngaphambi kokufika ezibhedlela. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kukaHulumeni, abenzi bezemithi, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. NgoMgqibelo, umphakathi wakwaZungu uhlelwe umhlangano ukuze baxoxe ngale nkinga. Umphakathi uvumile ukuthi kushoda kwemithi kudala izinkinga eziningi, futhi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezinqala ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. UZanele Khumalo, ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, uthe: “Sidinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izinsizakalo zabantu. Akukwazi ukuthi abantu baphile ngaphandle kwemithi.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, uphiko lwezempilo luhlongoza ukuthi kube nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezizokwazi ukuzitholela imithi, ukuze abantu bangabhekani nezinkinga zokuthola imithi ezibhedlela. Iziphakamiso zifaka phakathi ukwandisa imithombo yokuthola imithi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani zokwenziwa kwemithi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsiza. Ngokwakha izikhungo ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngemithi, umphakathi ungase ufinyelele kalula emithini edingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufanisa izidingo zabantu nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kunciphise ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Abahlinzeki bezempilo baphinde baphawule ukuthi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kungaba yindlela yokwehlisa izinkinga ezihambisana nokushoda kwemithi. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha eziphumelelayo, ezinjengokuthola imithi ku-inthanethi, kungasiza ekutholeni imithi ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Umbiko wakamuva ubonisa ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhathazekile ngezinga lokukhula kwabantu abadinga imithi, kodwa zikhona izifundo ezitholakele ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Izingcweti zempilo zithi izimpumelelo zidinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, othisha, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi iyatholakala kalula. Naphezu kwezithiyo ezikhona, kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga. Uhulumeni usekhulume ngokuqinile ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulethwa kwemithi, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa ntokazi. Lokhu kuzoba yinsiza enkulu kubantu abaningi abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli zikhumbuza ukuthi zikhona izinketho ezitholakalayo uma imithi engatholakali ezibhedlela. Izikhungo zempilo ezizimele ziyaqhubeka nokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuhlinzeka ngemithi, nakuba lokhu kungase kube phezulu kwamanani. Kumele kube nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imithombo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zithola imithi efanele ngesikhathi. Ubuqotho bokuphathwa kwemali nokuhlinzekwa kwemithi kumele kube yinto eyinhloko ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni akuyona nje inkinga yamanje, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezixazululo ezinzima. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabahlinzeki bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu abaningi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo.
Imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza nomnotho wasekhaya Izitolo zama-spaza zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wasekhaya, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokuthuthuka. Lezi zitolo, ezivame ukuba nezimpahla ezilula nezidingekayo, zikhona ukuze zifake isandla ekwakheni umnotho wendawo, ziqhube imisebenzi, futhi zandise ukufinyelela kwezidingo ezisemqoka. Nokho, imithetho ethile ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zitolo zisebenza kahle futhi zihlala zikhona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ifaka phakathi izinqubomgomo zokuhweba, ezokuphepha, nezokuphatha. Le mithetho ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zivikela abathengi, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ukuze izitolo zikwazi ukuhweba, kufanele zibe nezincwadi ezifanele, zihlale zikhumbula izidingo zamakhasimende, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswayo iyatholakala. Okwesibili, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni ezikahle ukuze zifinyeleleke kalula. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezikude zingaholela ekuncipheni kokuthengisa. Ukuze zihlale zikhona, izitolo kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphinde bavakashele lezi zitolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqhube imisebenzi yokuthengisa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi baphila ngokuphepha, futhi izitolo zihlale zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, izitolo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ziqinisekise ukuthi izimpahla zitholakala ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphatha ezihloniphekile. Ukwengeza, imithetho yokuphatha izitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle izidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi ziqonda kahle izidingo zamakhasimende, zisebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukuze lezi zitolo zibe nempumelelo, kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphathwa ezithuthukile. Ngokuphathelene nemithetho yokuhweba, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza ngokuhambisana nemithetho yendawo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zivikela abathengi, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ukuze lezi zitolo zihlale zikhona, kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokuhweba ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezikahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezikude zingaholela ekuncipheni kokuthengisa. Ukuze zihlale zikhona, izitolo kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ukwengeza, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa ezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswayo iyatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi izitolo zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuze lezi zitolo zibe nempumelelo, kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphathwa ezithuthukile. Ekugcineni, imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho wasekhaya uyakhula. Lezi zitolo zihlala zisebenza njengemithombo yokukhula komnotho, ziqhuba imisebenzi, futhi zandise ukufinyelela kwezidingo ezisemqoka. Ukuze lezi zitolo zihlale zikhona, kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ngale ndlela, izitolo zama-spaza zizoba nempumelelo, futhi umnotho wasekhaya uzothuthuka.
Umthelela wokukhula kwe-Amapiano emhlabeni uThandiwe Mthembu ungumculi, umdansi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo ophuma eGoli, eNingizimu Afrika. UThandiwe, owaziwa ngelika "DJ Thandi," ubonakale njengomunye wabaculi abavela phambili emkhakheni we-Amapiano, umculo ophuma eNingizimu Afrika, odume ngama-rhythms akhe ahlakaniphile, izigqi ezijabulisayo, kanye nezinsimbi ezahlukene. UThandiwe, oneminyaka engu-28, waqala ukuhamba phambili emculweni ngonyaka ka-2019, lapho aqala khona ukudala ama-tracks akhe. Ukudala umculo we-Amapiano, uThandiwe ulandela izinyathelo zabadlali abanjengoKabza De Small noDJ Maphorisa, ababephumelele kakhulu kulomkhakha. UThandiwe uthembisa ukuhlinzeka ngomculo ophilayo, ogcwele imizwa, futhi ubonisa izici zamasiko ahlukahlukene aseNingizimu Afrika. Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izitayela eziningi, okuhlanganisa i-house, i-jazz, ne-gqom, okwenza kube lula ukuheha izilaleli ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Ngokukhula kwe-Amapiano, uThandiwe ubone umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Umculo wakhe ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela emazweni ase-Afrika, njengeZimbabwe, Nigeria, naseKenya, kuze kube yizifunda ezikude njengeYurophu neMelika. UThandiwe Mthembu ungumculi ophumelelayo, kodwa ungumuntu ophila impilo enomoya wokubambisana. Ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungumthombo wokuxhumana, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi umculo we-Amapiano ungumkhiqizo wezobuciko obuhlanganisa abantu, ubavumela ukuba baxhumane ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.
Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yaphakamisa isinqumo esibalulekile mayelana nezikhundla zabazimele okhethweni, esithinteka kakhulu ezinqubweni zokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sinqumo sithinta izigaba eziningi zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi abavoti, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo ezihlukene ezibhekelele ukhetho. Izinqumo ezithathwe yile nkantolo ziqinisekisa ukuthi abazimele, abavota ngokuzimela, bangathola ithuba elilinganayo lokubamba iqhaza ezinkampanini zokhetho. Lokhu kuza ngemva kokukhathazeka okukhulayo ngokuqhubeka kokhetho olungafanele, lapho abanye abazimele bephikisana nezimo ezithile ezibekwe yizikhungo ezibhekelele ukhetho. Umgwaqo walesi sinqumo uqhamuka ngesikhathi lapho abezindaba, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele bezama ukucacisa izinqubo zokhetho. Izinselelo ezitholakele zifaka phakathi ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele, ukungabi namathuba alinganayo, kanye nezithiyo ezithile ezibekwe ezikhungweni zokhetho. Ummeli weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, uMnu. Thabo Mbeki, uthe: “Siyaziqhenya ngokuba neNkantolo ezimele, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi isinqumo sethu sizokwenza kube lula kubazimele ukuba baphathe izikhundla ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bakwazi ukukhetha kahle, futhi kube nezinqumo ezithinta umphakathi wonke.” Uhlanga lwezombusazwe luphendule ngokushesha kulokhu, lapho abezindaba baphawula ukuthi lesi sinqumo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezizimele. UMsizi weqembu leziMali, uNkk. Zanele Khumalo, uthe: “Siyakwamukela lesi sinqumo, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi sizokwenza kube lula kubazimele ukuba baphumelele ezinkampanini zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangakhetha bani.” Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, izikhungo ezihlukene zikhuthaza abazimele ukuba baphathe izikhundla ezibalulekile, ukuze kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bakwazi ukukhetha kahle. Lokhu kuza ngesikhathi lapho izinkampani ezinkulu zikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokhetho olungafanele, okukhombisa ukuthi izinqubo zokhetho zidinga ukulungiswa. Ummeli weqembu leziMali, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi lesi sinqumo sizokwenza kube lula kubazimele, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele ukuze sikwazi ukuncintisana kahle. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangakhetha bani, futhi lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele.” Izinqumo ezithathwe yile nkantolo zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho kufanele ube yisisekelo sokuphatha izinqubo zokhetho. Lokhu kuza ngesikhathi lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangakhetha bani.
