Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Ngaphandle kokungabaza, u-Transnet Freight Rail (TFR) udlala indima enkulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ugqugquzela ukuhamba kwezimpahla ezisemqoka ezifana nezinsimbi, amalahle, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Nokho, lo msebenzi ungenalo igatsha elingenazinkinga; kunezinselelo ezahlukene ezithinta ukwakheka nokusebenza kwezitimela, ezihilela konke ukusuka ezinhlelweni zokuhamba kuze kube yizinsizakalo zethu zamakhasimende. Njengomsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, u-Transnet Freight Rail uhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi ezinjengokwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zemakethe. Uma kucutshungulwa izinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwezitimela, okugcizelelwa umphakathi wobuchwepheshe kanye neziphakamiso ezithile ezaziswa ekwakheni izinhlelo eziqinile. Okwokuqala, enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene noTransnet Freight Rail wukugcinwa kwegatsha lezitimela elihamba phambili. Ngobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje, ukuthengwa nokugcina kwezinsiza kubalulekile, kodwa izintela eziphezulu nezindleko zazo noshintsho kwemakethe kudala enkinga enkulu. U-Transnet kufanele aqhamuke nezixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze aqhube ukusebenza komnyango, ukukwenza kube lula ukufika nezimpahla endaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuphambene, izinqubo zokuhamba kwezimpahla zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kokusebenza. Ukungagcinwa kwezitimela, ukwenziwa kwezibuyekezo, kanye nezimfuneko zezokuphepha zidinga ukuphakanyiswa. Noma izimoto ezihamba phambili zithuthukiswa, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yokuphepha kuhlelwa, okuqukethe ukugijima ngezivivinyo ezijulile, ukwenza izifundo zokwakha, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwemithetho. Lezi zimo zingadala izinkinga phakathi nalesi sikhumbuzo sezinsuku, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuphepha kumgibeli. Ukwanda kwemikhuba yokuthutha ehlakazekileyo kuholela ekwandeni kwezinsizakalo zezimoto. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuncinta okuthile emsebenzini wezitimela, kanti izinkampani ezincane zidinga ukwakha izinsizakalo ezihlanganisa ukwakheka kwezitimela, okuholela ekwandeni kwemigqa ethile. U-Transnet kufanele abheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezincane, ezizaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngesivinini, futhi lokhu kuchaza ukuthi u-Transnet kufanele uhlale uphezu kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha—kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuphatha, ukubhaliswa kwemoto, kanye nezinjini ezisebenza ngogesi—kunomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini wezitimela. Ngaleso sikhathi, inqobo kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, izimfuno zamakhasimende zibe nezimpilo ezinzima. Umphumela oyinhloko walesi sikhumbuzo unendlela yokugcina amakhona amaningana, okufanele amukelekayo futhi ahambisane nokuhamba kahle komnyango. Izinkinga zokusuliswa kwezimpahla ezindlini zikhuphuka kakhulu, kubonakala sengathi abathengisi abahambisani nemithetho yeTransnet. Ukuze u-Transnet ahlale engaphansi, zidingeka izindawo ezinhle zokuhamba, ezizohlinzeka ngokuqina kokuhamba kwezimpahla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungakwazi ukuya phambili ezindleleni, umgwaqo, izindawo zokuhweba nezikhumulo zayo ezithokozisayo. Ekugcineni, uTransnet Freight Rail uphila phakathi kwezinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Izinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izicelo zobuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphepha kwezimoto zikhombisa ubuhlungu futhi zibekiwe kwikhalenda. Nokho, lezi zinselelo zingase zibe yithuba lokukhiqiza izixazululo ezintsha, nokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze kuqede impumelelo yokusebenza. Ukuba uTransnet uthathe izinyathelo ezithile, sizokwazi ukubona intuthuko enkulu emkhakheni wokuhamba ngezitimela, engasiza ubuchwepheshe bwayo besimanje, kanti ezithinta izimfuno ezinkulu zomphakathi. Lokhu niphezulu kuzo zonke izinyathelo kanye nokuhamba phambili kwezinto ezishintshashintshayo emikhakheni yakhe yokusebenza. Lezi zinselelo zidinga izixazululo ezinkulu ezinhle, futhi uTransnet uzohamba phambili uma uphumelela kulolu hlelo.
Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini kwezohwebo Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlolanja 2023, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile eThekwini, lapho abezindaba, osomabhizinisi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngempumelelo yokuminyana nokuhweba. Lo mcimbi, obizwa ngokuthi "Umthelela Wokuminyana eThekwini: Izinketho Zokukhula Kwezohwebo," wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo. Phambi kokuba umcimbi uqale, abavakashi bathola ithuba lokubona izithombe zedolobha ezikhombisa umnotho wezwe ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu ngenxa yokukhula kwezohwebo. Umphakathi waseThekwini ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba umnotho ubonakala unamandla ngenxa yokuminyana kwababukeli, izinkampani, nezinsizakusebenza. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo edumile kaMnu. Sipho Mthembu, owachaza ukuthi uminyana eThekwini kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngamasu amasha okukhulisa ukuhweba. Uthe, “Ukwakhiwa kwezikhala ezihlukene zokuhweba, izimakethe ezincane, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala zikhuthaza abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo.” Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezingxoxo ezibukhoma phakathi kwababukeli, lapho abathintekayo bephakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo udinge ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababukeli nabathengisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwakheka kwezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe umnotho. Ukwengeza, abanye abakhuluma baphakamisa ukuthi ukuhweba kumele kube nendawo yokuxhumana, lapho abathengisi bengakwazi ukuhlangana khona ukuze baphendule izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzokhuthaza ukuhweba okukhulayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezingqungquthela ezahlukene ezazihlanganisa izifundo zokwakha amabhizinisi, izifundo zokumaketha, kanye nezifundo zokuphatha izinsiza. Lokhu kwavumela abavakashi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile mayelana nezindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa amabhizinisi abo. Abafundi baphinde banikwe ithuba lokuxoxa nabachwepheshe bezohwebo, ababelokhu bephendula imibuzo futhi belethe iziphakamiso ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wakhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale befinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuminyana, kudinga izinqubo ezithile ezizothuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Ubuye waphinde wagcizelela ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengisi banolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuhlonipha abathengisi abaphumelele emkhakheni wezohwebo. Abathengisi abaninzi baveze izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa baphinde baveze nethuba lokukhula. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba kunezithiyo, umnotho ungakhula uma abantu behlanganyela futhi besebenzisana. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wagcina ngokukhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi baphumelele emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ubuye waphinde wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana ukuze ubambisane ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Abavakashi baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinto ezithakazelisayo ezithinta umnotho, futhi bakwazi ukuthola izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini ungathuthukisa umnotho, futhi umcimbi ubonise ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, izixazululo zingatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho weThekwini uhlala unamandla, futhi ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakho, umcimbi "Umthelela Wokuminyana eThekwini" ube yimpumelelo enkulu, wakhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana ukuze ubambisane ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba kunezithiyo, umnotho ungakhula uma abantu behlanganyela futhi besebenzisana.
Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini i-cybersecurity? Impendulo: I-cybersecurity iwumkhakha ophathelene nokuvikela amasistimu, amanethiwekhi, nemininingwane kwi-inthanethi. Kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjwe ukuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwedatha noma emalini. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile kubamasipala? Impendulo: Kubalulekile kubamasipala ngoba amahhovisi omasipala aphatha imininingwane ebalulekile, efana nezinsiza zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nemininingwane yabantu. Ukuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kungaholela ekuphulweni kokuphepha, ukulahlekelwa kwemali, kanye nokwehla kokwethembeka komphakathi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izigameko ezivamile ze-cybersecurity ezibhekene namasipala? Impendulo: Izigameko ezivamile zifaka phakathi ukuhlaselwa kwe-ransomware, ukweba imininingwane, nezinsongo ze-phishing. Lezi zigameko zingaholela ekulimaleni kwemisebenzi yamasipala, kanye nokulahlekelwa kwemali. Umbuzo 4: Yini i-ransomware? Impendulo: I-ransomware iyisofthiwe esebenzisa ukuhlasela okwenziwa ngabadlali ababi ukuze ibambelele kudatha yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kubangela umsebenzisi ukuthi akhokhe imali ukuze abuyisele ukufinyelela kwedatha yakhe. Umbuzo 5: Zithini izibonelo zezigameko ze-ransomware kumasipala? Impendulo: Isibonelo esidumile yisigameko se-ransomware esenzeka eBaltimore, Maryland, ngo-2019. Ukuhlaselwa kwaholela ekutheni amasevisi amaningi omasipala aphazamiseke, okubandakanya izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza amaspala abhekane nezinselelo ezinkulu ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Amasipala avame ukuba nezinsiza ezincane, izinhlelo ezindala, kanye nezisebenzi ezingaqeqeshiwe kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuvikela izinhlelo zabo ezibalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela amasipala? Impendulo: Amasipala angathatha izinyathelo eziningi, ezifana nokufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza izivivinyo zokuhlola ukuvikeleka. Ukwazi izinsongo zakamuva nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa? Impendulo: Uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa, kufanele kube nehlelo lokuphendula eliqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvuselela izinhlelo, ukuxhumana nezinsizakalo zomthetho, nokubuyisela imininingwane ethathwe. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinsiza ezingasiza amaspala ekuthuthukiseni i-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela ezitholakalayo, izinkampani ezikhethekile kwe-cybersecurity, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakala kumasipala. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo kungasiza ekwakheni amandla. Umbuzo 10: Yini eyenza umphakathi ubaluleke ekulweni ne-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Umphakathi udlala indima ebalulekile ekulweni ne-cybersecurity. Ukuqwashisa kwabantu ngalezi zinsongo, kanye nokubafundisa ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komphakathi. Umbuzo 11: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezitholakalayo zokufundisa umphakathi nge-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokufundisa umphakathi, ezifana nezifundo eziku-inthanethi, izinkulumo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela ezihlelwa ngamasipala. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu baqonde izinsongo ezikhona. Umbuzo 12: Kanjani amaspala angathuthukisa ubudlelwano bawo nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Amasipala angathuthukisa ubudlelwano bawo nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity ngokubambisana ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola, nokufunda okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amasistimu. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuphendula ngokushesha ezimweni ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Ukuphendula ngokushesha kunganciphisa umonakalo, kuvikela imininingwane ebalulekile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amasevisi ayatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi awulahlekelwa kakhulu. Umbuzo 14: Kuthiwani ngekusasa le-cybersecurity kumasipala? Impendulo: Ikusasa le-cybersecurity kumasipala libonakala linzima, kodwa linethuba. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuqwashisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela, amaspala angavikela kahle imininingwane yabo. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uqhubeke uvikelekile? Impendulo: Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ufunda ngalezi zinsongo, uqinisekise ukuthi usebenzisa izindlela zokuphepha ezifanele, futhi ubike noma yiziphi izinsongo ezitholakele kumasipala. Ukuvigilisa njalo kuyasiza. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-cybersecurity iyinselelo enkulu kumasipala, kodwa ngezinyathelo ezifanele, kungenzeka ukuvikela izinsiza zomphakathi. Ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi, amaspala, kanye nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity bukhulu kakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile.
Inqubekela Phambili Yokuqedwa Kwezindlu Zangasese Zemigodi Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukuze kuqedwe izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ezikoleni, kudingeka uhlelo olucacile nolusebenza kahle. Lezi zinyathelo zizokwenza kube lula ukuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingasebenzi kahle, ukuze abafundi bahlale endaweni enempilo futhi ephumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlola Isimo Samanje 1. Bheka Izindlu Zangasese: Qala ngokuhlola zonke izindlu zangasese ezikoleni. Bheka isimo sazo, ubude bazo, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. 2. Thola Imibiko: Xhumana nabafundi, othisha, nabazali ukuze uthole imibiko mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. 3. Bhala Uhlolo: Qopha imiphumela yokuhlola, ubhale izinkinga ezitholakele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lokwakha 1. Hlela Uhlelo: Dala uhlelo lokwakha oluhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi izindlu zangasese zizobuyiselwa kanjani. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinsiza, izinsuku, nezindleko. 2. Thola Abahlinzeki: Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza zokwakha ukuze uthole iziqu zokwakha, izinto ezidingekayo, nezindleko. 3. Thola Imvume: Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola zonke izimvume ezidingekayo ezivela kuhulumeni noma ezikhungweni ezifanele. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubandakanya Umphakathi 1. Bika Umphakathi: Thumela izaziso kumphakathi mayelana nohlelo lokwakha, ubalule izinzuzo zokuphuculwa kwezindlu zangasese. 2. Bamba Imihlangano: Hlela imihlangano ukuze ubonise uhlelo, uphendule imibuzo, futhi uthole iziphakamiso. 3. Bamba Abantu Abavela Emphakathini: Khuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza, kungaba ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza noma ngokusebenza ngezandla. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqala Ukusebenza 1. Hlela Usuku Lokusebenza: Nquma usuku lokuqala lokwakha. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki, abasebenzi, nababambiqhaza bayavuma. 2. Qala Ukusebenza: Qala umsebenzi wokwakha. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi iyenziwa ngendlela efanele futhi iphephile. 3. Bheka Inqubekela Phambili: Bheka inqubekela phambili yomsebenzi nsuku zonke, uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqedela Nokuhlola 1. Qeda Ukusebenza: Uma umsebenzi usuphelile, qinisekisa ukuthi izindlu zangasese zihlanzekile futhi zilungile. 2. Hlola Izindlu Zangaphandle: Bheka izindlu zangasese ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezifanele, njengezibani, amanzi, nezinto zokuhlanza. 3. Bika Umphakathi: Thumela imibiko kumphakathi mayelana nokuphothulwa komsebenzi. Bika izinzuzo ezitholakele. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqhubeka Nokugcina 1. Hlela Ukuhlola Okuvamile: Hlela ukuhlola okuvamile kwezindlu zangasese ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisesimweni esihle. 2. Thola Impendulo: Thola impendulo kubafundi, othisha, nabazali ukuze uqonde ukuthi izindlu zangasese zisebenza kanjani. 3. Phucula Uhlelo: Sebenzisa impendulo ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokugcina izindlu zangasese, uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuqedwa kwezindlu zangasese zemigodi ezikoleni kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukubandakanya umphakathi, kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Ngalezi zinyathelo, singaqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala endaweni enempilo, ethokomele, futhi ethuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokukhula, futhi kuzothuthukisa impilo yabafundi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza leli phrojekthi libe yimpumelelo, futhi kuzokhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuhlala.
Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) I-Life Esidimeni iyindawo yokunakekelwa kwempilo enezinhlaka eziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwengqondo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwezimo ezinzima ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zayo, kwavela udlame olukhulu lokuphila kwabantu abaninzi, okwaholela ekubeni kube nesidingo sokulamula. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthi kudingeka kube ne-arbitration ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukwethula Isimo Ngaphambi kokuba sihlolisise imiphumela yokulamula, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu ezaholela ekubeni kube ne-arbitration. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwezinsizakalo zempilo, abanye abantu abathola usizo e-Life Esidimeni babhekana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kabi, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala efanele, kanye nokungabi naso isiqiniseko sokuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ziyakhula. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi baphume emakhaya abo, bephinde bahlushwe yizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Inqubo Yokulamula Inqubo yokulamula ye-Life Esidimeni yahlanganisa abamele iziguli, iziphathimandla, kanye nabanye abathintekayo. I-arbitration yenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxisana, lapho izinkinga ezikhona zingabhekwa khona ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwavumela abathintekayo ukuba baphendule izinkinga ezithile, bakhulume ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabantu, futhi bathole izixazululo ezithile. Imiphumela Yokulamula Imiphumela yokulamula ye-Life Esidimeni ibalulekile, futhi inezinto eziningi ezithinta iziguli, umphakathi, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. Nazi ezinye zezimphumela ezibalulekile: 1. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zempilo: Ngemva kokulamula, kwavela iziphakamiso eziningi zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo e-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhulu kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nokwakha izindawo zokuhlala ezinhle. 2. Ukwaziwa Kwezidingo Zokwelashwa: I-arbitration yaphinde yenza kube lula ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zabantu abathola usizo. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini efanele ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu. 3. Ukubuyiselwa Kwezinsiza: Imiphumela yokulamula ibuye ibonise ukubaluleka kokubuyisela izinsiza ezilahlekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuphinda kuhlangane izinsiza ezazitholakala ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinkinga, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. 4. Ukubuyiselwa Kwesithunzi: I-arbitration yaphinde yenza kube nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kwabantu abathintekayo. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuba bazizwe bebuyiselwe emoyeni, futhi bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. 5. Izixazululo Zokuphila: Ngaphezu kokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo, imiphumela yokulamula ibuye yathuthukisa izixazululo zempilo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bathole izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa nezindlela zokwelapha ezihlukene. Izifundo Eziyinhloko Ukwazi imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo kufanele zihlale zikhona, ziqhubeke zithuthuka, futhi ziqonde izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo kufanele bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokulamula ibonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo kubalulekile. I-arbitration iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo zempilo nabantu, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okungcono, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Isiphetho Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola lezi zimpumelelo kuveza indlela yokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zidinga ukuhlala zikhona, ziqhubeke zithuthuka, futhi ziqonde izidingo zabantu. Ngale ndlela, sithola ukuthi imiphumela yokulamula iyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono kubantu abathola usizo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe (National shutdown) Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe, owaziwa ngesiNgisi ngokuthi "National shutdown", kubalulekile ekuboneni ukuthi lezi zenzakalo ziba nomthelela omkhulu ezintweni eziningi, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nesimo sokuphila kwabantu. Lo mbhikisho uvame ukuveza ukukhathazeka kwabantu ngezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukuntuleka kwemali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kahle. Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungumcimbi ohlanganisa abantu abaningi, okuholela ekuphawuleni kwabo ngokuphathwa kwemali, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlakulele umuzwa wokubambisana, okuvame ukuhamba phambili ekulandeleni izinjongo ezifanayo. Nokho, kumqoka ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela wombhikisho akuhlali uhleli emathubeni, kodwa futhi uhlanganisa nezinselelo ezithile. Umthelela kwezomnotho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungakha umthelela omkhulu kwezomnotho. Ubuza ukuthi, uma abantu bevala imisebenzi, lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, okungenza kube nezinkinga ezinhlobonhlobo. Isibonelo, uma izitolo zivalwa, abathengisi bahluleka ukuthengisa, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantu behluleka ukuthola imiholo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho ungase uphinde ube nezinhlupheko ngenxa yokuncipha kokuthengiswa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kuthinta izinkampani ezincane, ezisemqoka ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila zingakhuphuka uma izinsiza zikhona, kodwa abantu bengakwazi ukuzithola ngenxa yokuthi imisebenzi ivaliwe. Umthelela ezepolitiki Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezepolitiki. Njengoba abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, lokhu kudala ingcindezi kuhulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekubeni kuhulumeni kube nomuzwa wokuthi kumele benze izinguquko ezithile ukuze baphatheke kahle kwezepolitiki. Izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa izimo zokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo ezikhona. Izinqubomgomo ezithathwa ngemuva kwabambiqhaza zingase zingabi nezinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekuxabana phakathi kwabantu nezikhulu, okungaholela ekwandeni kokungaboni ngaso linye. Umthelela kwesimo sokuphila Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umthelela wombhikisho ungakhangisa izici ezithile zokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba abantu bephuma emgwaqweni bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana nobunye. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zibe nethonya elihle, njengoba abantu behlangana njengomphakathi, bebonisana ngezinkinga zabo. Nokho, umbiko owandulele umehluko phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokuxabana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, njengoba abantu bezwakalisa izinkinga ezihlukene. Ukungaboni ngaso linye kulokho okukhuluma, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuzuzwe ukuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Izindlela zokuxazulula Ukuze umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ube nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumanisa abantu, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okukhulayo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kuhulumeni kube nokubambisana nokuhlonipha izimvo zabantu, ukuze kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindaba ezinzima. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokuxhumana, ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, kungakha umphakathi onobumbano. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuhlanganisa izinsiza phakathi kwabantu, futhi kudale umphakathi ohlangene, ophumelelayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke, umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, ezomnotho, nasemiphakathini. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela awuhlali uhleli ubuhle, kodwa uhlanganisa nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlakulele umqondo wokubambisana, futhi bahlale bephakamisa izwi labo lapho kudingeka khona. Njengoba uhulumeni nezakhamuzi behlanganyela, umthelela wombhikisho ungaba yinsakavukela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Isingeniso Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile. Lezi zinkundla zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuvikela, izikhungo zomphakathi, nemisebenzi ehambisana nezokuphepha. Ukuze ube nekhono lokusebenza kahle kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo. 1. Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi - Qala ngokubamba imihlangano nomphakathi ukuze uqonde izinkinga ezikhona. - Bhalisela imibono nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu, kuhlanganiswe nabaholi bendawo. - Hlanganisa idatha ngendlela yokuhlola izinga lokuphepha komphakathi, usebenzisa izibalo ezivela ezinsukwini ezahlukene. 2. Ukuhlela Izinhlelo Zokuphepha - Sebenzisa ulwazi oluqoqwe ukuze uhlole izinhlelo ezikhona. - Dala uhlelo lwezokuphepha oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. - Beka izinjongo ezicacile, ezifana nokunciphisa izingozi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. 3. Ukubambisana Nezinhlangano Zomphakathi - Xhumanisa izinkampani, izikhungo zemfundo, nezikhungo zokuhlala ukuze uthole uxhaso. - Hlela imihlangano yokuxhumana ukuze uthole izimvo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. - Bamba imikhankaso yokubandakanya umphakathi, ukuze abantu bazibandakanye ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha. 4. Ukuqeqesha Abantu - Hlela izifundo zokuphepha ezihlosiwe kumphakathi, ezifana nezifundo zokuvikela izingozi. - Sebenzisa ochwepheshe ezindaweni ezithile ukuze bafundise abanye. - Dala izinsiza ezifanele zokufunda, njengezincwadi, amavidiyo, noma izinkulumo ezimnandi. 5. Ukuqinisekisa Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokusebenza - Xhumana nezikhungo zokuphepha, njengeziteshi zamaphoyisa kanye nezinhlangano zokuphuthuma. - Dala ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluhambisanayo nolwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. - Bamba imihlangano evamile yokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. 6. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya - Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezikhona ziyahlolwa njalo ukuze kubhekwane nezinguquko zomphakathi. - Hlanganisa izibuyekezo ezivela kubantu ukuze uthole imibono yokusebenza. - Phumelela ukuhlola izinkinga nezixazululo, uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. 7. Ukuxhumana Nokwazisa Umphakathi - Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi luhanjiswa kahle. - Sebenzisa iziteshi ezahlukene zokuxhumana, njengezikhangiso, amaphephandaba, nezinkundla zokuxhumana. - Qinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngezinhlelo zokuphepha ezitholakalayo, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okwanele. 8. Ukuvikela Izinsiza Zokuphepha - Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo zihlala zisesimweni esihle. - Hlela ukuthengwa kwezinsiza ezidingekayo, njengokuphepha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinto zokusebenza. - Phatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele ukuze zisetshenziswe kahle. 9. Ukuvuselela Izinhlelo Zokuphepha - Njalo, hlola izinhlelo ezikhona ukuze uzivuselele lapho kudingeka. - Qonda ukuthi izinguquko emiphakathini zingase zithinte izinhlelo zokuphepha. - Yenza izinhlelo ezinamandla ezihlanganisa izimpendulo eziphuthumayo ukuze ube nesimo esihle sokuphatha izinkinga. 10. Ukubuyekeza Nokuqhubeka - Phinda uhlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. - Bamba imihlangano yokubuyekeza kanye nemihlangano yokuxhumana. - Qhubekela phambili ngokwakha izinhlelo ezintsha ezithuthukisayo, ezifaneleke kumphakathi. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi akusikho kuphela ukusebenza ngezinhlelo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophephile, onobudlelwano obuhle, nolwazi. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu, ukuzibandakanya okukhuthazayo, nokwakha isimo sokuphepha esiqinile. Ngalokho, umphakathi ungenza izinqumo eziphusile, ezivumela ukuhamba phambili ngokuvikela izinsiza zabo nezimpilo zabo. Uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyabamba iqhaza, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono futhi edlulele phambili.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Umbuzo 1: Yini i-SITA? Impendulo: I-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngesevisi zobuchwepheshe bolwazi emiphakathini kahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. I-SITA ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokusebenza, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi? Impendulo: Izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zobuchwepheshe, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, ukungahambisani nezidingo zomsebenzisi, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle noma zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Umbuzo 3: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA unjani? Impendulo: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, ukwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu, nokuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifanele ukuhlinzekwa kubantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bangatholi izinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifana nezokwelapha, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezithinteka kakhulu? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo ezithinteka kakhulu zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsiza zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokubhalisela imfundo, nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezempilo. Uma lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase bangatholi izinsizakalo ezibalulekile, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuphila kwabantu. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezikhona, ukwandisa izinsiza, nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo ze-SITA. Umbuzo 6: Kuthiwani ngezinselelo ezibhekene ne-SITA? Impendulo: I-SITA ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwemali eyanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe. Lezi zinselelo zingathinta amandla e-SITA okusebenza kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungawusiza kanjani umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungawusiza ngokubambisana ne-SITA, ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo mayelana nezinsizakalo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ze-SITA. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA? Impendulo: Uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenza kahle, lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwabantu, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphusile. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngekusasa le-SITA? Impendulo: Ikusasa le-SITA lincike ekutheni izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza kanjani. Uma i-SITA ikwazi ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ukwandisa izinsiza, nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa, ingaba nethuba elihle lokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kungasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zihlala zisebenza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zihlala zisebenza, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokubuyekeza, nokwenza izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisebenza kahle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile le-SITA.
Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwaba nezinsuku ezinzima eNingizimu Afrika, lapho ubuhlungu bukaMaboko, umama oneminyaka engama-42, buhlangana nezinkumbulo ezinzima. U-Maboko wayengumama ophakathi neminyaka emithathu efuna ukulwa nezinkinga zempilo zomntwana wakhe, uSipho, onokuphazamiseka kwengqondo. U-Sipho wayethokozisa uMaboko, kodwa umhlaba wama-mental health services wawungaphansi kokuphatheka kabi. Ngesikhathi uMaboko ebhalela izikhalazo eziningi, kwavela udaba lwe-Life Esidimeni, lapho abantu abaningi abaphila nezinkinga zempilo zengqondo behlukunyezwa. U-Maboko wayezizwa enomoya ophansi, ngoba wayebona abanye abantu bezama ukufinyelela usizo, kodwa benza izithiyo ezinzima. Kwakukhona amacala amaningi abantu abashiya emitholampilo, bephathwa kabi, behlukunyezwa, futhi bengenamathuba okuphila kahle. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela umphakathi ozinikele ekutholeni izimpendulo. Kwakuyinto ethokozisayo, abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, bebuza ukuthi kwenzekani e-Life Esidimeni. Ngenxa yokufuna ubulungiswa, kwaba nezinye izinkampani ezazidla ubuhlungu bomphakathi obuphila ngaphansi kokuphazamiseka. U-Maboko ubone ukuthi akekho owawuthanda ubungxiwankulu bempilo yengqondo. Kwathi, ngesikhathi sokulamula, uMaboko wathola ithuba lokukhuluma ngolwazi lwakhe. Wayazi kahle ukuthi ukulalela izinkumbulo ezinzima zesimo sikaSipho kungaba yithuba lokwenza umhlaba ungcono. U-Maboko wakhumbula izinsuku lapho uSipho eba nokuthula, futhi wacabanga ngokuthi umphakathi ungazama kanjani ukuvikela abantu abanjengaye. U-Maboko wathola isibindi, wanikela izimpendulo zempilo, uchaza izimo ezinzima abahlangana nazo. Ubufakazi bokuqamba kwalesi sikhathi babungama-odaba angama-100, abelokhu baphikisana nemiphumela yokungaziphathi kahle. Umphakathi wajabula, kodwa waqonda ukuthi ukulwa akupheli lapho kudingeka imiphumela. Bakhuluma ngezinto ezinjengokuthi, "Akukhona ukukhipha abanye, kodwa ukufaka izinyathelo eziphusile." U-Maboko wathola ukuthi, uma bephakanyiswa, umphakathi ungakwazi ukufezekisa izinguquko. Uhlanga lwempilo yengqondo lwathuthukiswa ngokusindisa izimpilo; abantu bahlala bejabulile, beqonda ukuthi ungubani, futhi bahlanganyela. U-Maboko wayekhumbula ukuthi uthando lwezinto eziphilayo lwalungaba yinsika eqinile. Kwabanye, le mithetho yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi abanikazi bempilo yengqondo bangabantu abaphilayo, futhi kufanele bahlonishwe. U-Maboko waqhubeka nokukhuluma, efundisa abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ngemva kokulamula, umphakathi waqala ukuba nezinsiza eziningi, izikhungo zokwelapha ezihloniphekile, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yengqondo. U-Sipho washintsha kwaze kwaba yinsuku yempumelelo, wathola usizo olwakhe, futhi uMaboko wabona ukuthula kumntwana wakhe. Ekugcineni, u-Maboko waphumelela, ngoba akuyena owodwa nje owayebonakalisa ubuhlungu, kodwa waba umholi, umgibeli, ukuveza izinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukulungiswa. U-Justice waba yincwadi, futhi abanye bebelokhu besebenzisa imithetho yokuvikela abantu abaphila nezinkinga zengqondo. U-Maboko waqhubeka nokukhuthaza ubuhlungu, enza umphakathi uqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, futhi izinsiza zendawo zidingeka kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinto, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni yaphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubungane, uthando, nokuhlanganyela kubalulekile empilweni. U-Maboko kanye noSipho bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, behlanganyela emiphakathini eyandayo, futhi bezama ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Lokhu kwaba yindaba efundisayo, yokuthi akukhona okungahlala kuhle, kodwa umphakathi ungakwazi ukuvuselela izimpilo zawo.
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ngenxa yokwanda kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, izinkampani eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ziqhubele phambili ukuvuma ukusebenza ukude. Lokhu kungenxa yokufunwa ikakhulukazi kokuqasha abasebenzi abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, kanye nomthelela weCOVID-19, othintekayo kuzo zonke izimboni. Ukusebenza ukude sekuvame kakhulu, futhi le ndlela yokusebenza iyathandwa ngabasebenzi nabaphathi. Ngokocwaningo olwenziwa yi-South African Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SACCI), kuboniswe ukuthi amaphesenti angu-62 abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banethemba lokuthi ukusebenza ukude kuzokwandiswa nakulesi sikhathi esizayo. Abasebenzi bayakujabulela ukuhlela isikhathi sabo, bezikhandla ekwakheni izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngama-work-from-home (WFH) ziyaqhubeka nokukhulisa umkhiqizo wazo. UProf. Thabo Mhlongo, umphenyi kwezokuphatha, utshele iSowetan ukuthi "ukusebenza ukude kuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza njengoba abasebenzi bekwazi ukulawula izimo zabo zokusebenza." Ubuye wancoma izinkampani ezibenobuhlakani ekwakheni amasu awusizo ukuze zakhe izindlela zokuxhumana ezikahle nezinzile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benomzwangedwa ophusile futhi beqonda izinjongo zenkampani. Izinkampani eziningi, njengeFNB ne-Discovery, seziqale ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ngenxa yokuthi kungase kusize ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kweqembu nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kokusebenza okusezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kuholele ekuhluphekeni kwabanye abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinkinga zendawo yokuxhumana. U-Vusi Magagula, osebenza endaweni yokuncintisana, ushaye indiva wathi, “Kukhona abanye abantu abadinga imali engaphezulu ukuthenga izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze basebenze kahle.” Lokhu kufanekisa izinselelo ezahlukene ezihlangabezana nabo, okwenza kube nzima kubanye abasebenzi abathola izinsiza ezinembayo. Uchwepheshe wezobuchwepheshe, uNoluthando Jali, ukholelwa ukuthi izinkampani kufanele zikhulise izinqubomgomo ezizokweseka abakhiqizi. Uthi: "Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zifake izinhlelo ezihambelana nesidingo sabasebenzi. Izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kufanele zibe nzima, zifane nezindawo zokusebenza ezisemqoka." Lokhu kuzosiza eeqenjini ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, obambisene, futhi okhiqizayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani eziseNingizimu Afrika zidinga ukuthi zifake izinhlelo ezinhle zokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuqhubeka kokusebenza kahle kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwesimo sokusebenza esihambisana nezidingo zamanje nezizayo. IPC (Institute of People Management) ibonisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihamba phambili ziguqula imikhuba yokusebenza ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko ezichazwe yizimo zomhlaba. Izinhlangano ezinhlobonhlobo, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokweseka ukuphuma kwezimoto, zikhombisa ukuthi kusebenza kahle ukuba nezinqubo zokuxhumana ezijulile nezibambene. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu usazi ngemigomo nezinhlelo ezenzeka ezinkampanini zabo, futhi lezi zinyathelo zilanuswa ngempela umphakathi. Ngokuphawuleka, ukusakazwa kolwazi nokutholakala kijinhle kolwazi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zokusebenza ukude. Kungaba ngokwenza izinkundla zokusebenza ezihlangene, izinhlelo zokusebenzelana, noma uqobo ukwakha imikhiqizo ethuthukisayo. Abasebenzi badinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze bazuze impumelelo, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha isizinda esiqinile sokusebenza. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe kuphela abukhona – impilo yomuntu ibalulekile. Ukuqhubeka kokusebenza ukude kufanele kuhlangane nezinyathelo ezinhle zokuphila komsebenzi, okubandakanya ukulwa nokudangala nokuqinisa umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokujabula phakathi kwabasebenzi, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhula kwenkampani. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza ukude sekuyindlela yokuphila ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uma izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuvumelanisa nezidingo zamathuba ezobuchwepheshe, zithuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezenzakalayo futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi nezinkampani, sizobona impumelelo ephezulu nokuthuthuka emisebenzini. Lokhu kuzoba nempempe ebheke phambili ezinkampanini zethu, futhi kuzonika abantu ithuba lokukhula futhi bakhe izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa Kwe-TV Licence Ye-SABC Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi enye yezinto eziphawulekayo yindlela i-SABC (South African Broadcasting Corporation) ethola ngayo uxhaso lwezezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kudala impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwabantu, abezindaba, kanye nohulumeni. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukucaciswa, futhi ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu daba. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi i-SABC iyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Iphinde ibe yinsika yokwazisa abantu ngezindaba, imicimbi, nezinhlelo ezithinta impilo yabo. Nokho, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi baphikisa ukuthi kungani kufanele bakhokhe imali ukuze babe ne-TV licence, ikakhulukazi uma bengahlanganyeli ezinhlelweni ze-SABC. Ngokombono wami, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kudinga ukwenziwa kabusha. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi, uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle, kungani kufanele sikhokhe? Lokhu kuveza umbono wokuthi abantu bahlola izinga lempumelelo ye-SABC, futhi uma benganakile, baphikisa ngokukhokha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu baphikisana nezinqubomgomo zohulumeni, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuxhumana. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC iyinhlangano esebenza ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kuhloswe ukusiza i-SABC ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yamaNingizimu Afrika. Uma abantu bephikisa ngokukhokha, kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, futhi kungaholela ekwehleni kwezinga lemisebenzi ye-SABC. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwehla kwemali engenayo ngenxa yokuncipha kokubukwa. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi i-SABC ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphila, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza. Uma abantu bephikisa ngokukhokha i-TV licence, kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, futhi kungaholela ekwehleni kwezinga lemisebenzi ye-SABC. Ngokubheka lezi zinto, ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko ezithile ekuxhasweni kwe-TV licence. Kungenzeka ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu ukukhokha, noma mhlawumbe banikeze izaphulelo ezithile kubantu abahluphekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaninzi ukuthi bakwazi ukukhokha, futhi kuzokhulisa uxhaso lwe-SABC. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izinhlelo zayo zibe nezinga eliphezulu, ukuze abantu babe nesizathu sokukhokha. Uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, abantu bazoba nesifiso sokukhokha i-TV licence. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokubukwa. Ngokuphetha, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Abantu baphikisa ngokukhokha, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo. I-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubalulekile ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza. Kumele kube nezinguquko ezithile ukuze kube lula kubantu ukukhokha, futhi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izinhlelo zayo zibe nezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokubukwa. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe lezi zinto zibe yizifundo, sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile, futhi sikhuthaze i-SABC ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu ne-SABC. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, i-SABC ingase ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, futhi lokhu kuzothinta impilo yamaNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence, ukuze i-SABC iqhubeke nokusebenza, futhi ibenesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile.
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngeNhlangano, elalikhula ngokushesha. UThandi, umphakathi ophakathi kwezinsuku zakhe zokusebenza, wayengumuntu onothando olukhulu lomhlaba. Wavuka ekuseni, elungiselela ukuphuma ngokushesha ukuze ajabulele umoya opholile. Ngeshumi nambili, uThandi wathola ukuthi umhlaba wabo uzuziwe ukuthi uzothathwa nguhulumeni ukuze kwakhiwe indawo yokuhlala. Lesi sikhathi sasilokhu sihamba phambili, kanti izimpikiswano zomthetho zazingaphansi kokuqonda. UThandi noMnumzane Zungu, umphakathi wakhe, babebhiyoza ngokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kodwa-ke, lapho beqala ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zinhlelo ezimfishane ezivela kuhulumeni, baqala ukungabaza. "Kanjani umhlaba wethu, owatholakala kumzali wethu, ungathathwa ngaphandle kokuvuma?" kusho uThandi, ebheke kuMnumzane Zungu. UZungu, ehlakaniphile, wamxwayisa, “Thandi, kufanele sazi ukuthi umthetho uvumela uhulumeni ukuthatha umhlaba uma kunesidingo sokwakha izinsiza zomphakathi.” Kodwa uThandi wayengakakwazi ukuvuma lokhu. Wabheka emuva, ekhumbula izinsuku lapho abazali bakhe bejabulela umhlaba wabo. Wayazi kahle ukuthi umhlaba awuwona nje umhlaba; uyisikhumbuzo, uyinqaba yesiko, futhi uyimfihlo yokuphila. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wanquma ukuthi akasoze avume ukuthathelwa umhlaba wakhe ngaphandle kokulwa. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nomphakathi, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umhlangano waphothulwa, kwavela abantu abaningi, bonke befuna ukwazi ukuthi yini engakwenziwa. Umphakathi wawuzizwa ungajabule. UThandi wakhuluma, “Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze silwe namalungelo ethu. Ngabe sikhona isizathu sokuthi umhlaba wethu uthathwe, uma singathola olunye usizo lokwakha?” Umphakathi wahlangana emihlanganweni, kwavela iziphakamiso eziningi ezazihlanganisa ukuhamba emaphoyiseni, ukufaka izikhalazo ezisemthethweni, nokuhlola amalungelo anikezwa umthetho. “Kumele sizame ukuqonda umthetho,” kusho uZungu, “ngoba uma singenzi njalo, sizokwehlulwa.” Ekhulumeni nezinye izifunda, uThandi wabona ukuthi abanye abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo. “Ngabe kungenzeka sithole amandla uma sixhumanisa izwi lethu?” wacela. Lokhu kwaba umqondo omuhle, futhi baqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu, lapho abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bengena ndawonye, bechaza izinkinga zabo. Kwathi ngesikhathi somcimbi, izwi labantu lathinta izinyawo eziningi. Kukhona abezindaba ababeza, bethumele izindaba zomphakathi, bejabulisa abanye. “UThandi, ubukeka uveza ithemba,” kusho omunye umphakathi. “Kodwa umthetho ungaba yinkinga. Ngabe sikhona umthetho ozoqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu awuthathwa ngaphandle kokuthi sithole induduzo?” Ngemuva kokuhlola kahle izinkinga, uThandi wathola ukuthi, yebo, kunezinhlinzeko zomthetho ezikhona, kodwa zidinga ukusimama. Uthandazile ukuthi umphakathi ungafaka izikhalazo ezisemthethweni, kodwa lokhu kwakungabizi. “Kufanele sibe nomqondo onobuchwepheshe,” uqhubeke, “sifunde ukuhamba nemigudu efanele.” Basukuma ukuze bahlanganyele, bahlela ukuzothola usizo lwezomthetho. Bahlela ukuhamba emkhankasweni, behlambulula izwi labo ukuze baziwaze kumalungelo abo. Umphakathi wazizwa uqinisekile, futhi bahamba phambili njengomoya wokubambisana. Ngesikhathi sokuthula, uThandi waqhubeka nokucabanga ngezinsuku ezizayo. “Ngabe umhlaba wethu uzophila?” wacabanga. “Ngabe umthetho uzokwazi ukusivika?” Kodwa uThandi wayazi kahle ukuthi uma abantu behlangene, benganqoba noma yisiphi isithiyo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wokukhuthazela wavuka, wabangela umphakathi ukuba ube neqhaza elikhulu ekulweni namalungelo abo. Isikhathi sathatha izinyathelo ezinzima, kodwa umphakathi wawuvikela umhlaba wabo. UThandi noMnumzane Zungu baqhubeka nokuhola, bephumelelayo ekwakheni izinkantolo ezahlukene, beqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uthathwa ngokufanele. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye babazali behlangene, kwavula izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wathola ukunconywa, kwavela izinkantolo ezazivuma ukuthi umhlaba wabo awuthathwa ngaphandle kokuvuma. UThandi waphakamisa izinkanyezi, “Siyaziqhenya ngamandla ethu. Umhlaba wethu awusikho konke, kodwa uthando lwethu, uthando lwethu, luyingxenye yethu.” Futhi ngamunye wakhumbula ukuthi, noma izimpi zomthetho zingahlala zikhona, umoya womphakathi ungavusa isibindi sokulwela amalungelo. UThandi wathola ukuthi empilweni, umhlaba ungavula izindlela ezintsha, uma abantu behlangana besebenzela okuhle. Lokhu kwaba yinkumbulo eqhubekayo, evuselela ithemba lokuthi umhlaba ungavikelekile, uma abantu bephila ngokubambisana.
Ingxoxo Ngemiphumela Yokulamula Kwe-Life Esidimeni Okwesithathu: Ngiyabonga ngokungithokozisa ukuthi sibe nalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma ngempilo yalesi simo esibalulekile. Ungangitshela ukuthi uyini umbono wakho ngalokhu kulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni? Umnikazi: Ngiyabonga. Ngikholelwa ukuthi kulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni kube nezindlela eziningi ezihlukene zokubhekelela imiphumela, futhi lokhu kucacile emiphumeleni esiyibonile. Lokhu kulamula kubonise ukuthi kunezinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukulungiswa, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo. Okwesithathu: Ngicela ungitshele kabanzi ngokuthi lezi zinkinga zingaba ziphi? Umnikazi: Okokuqala, sithole ukuthi izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo ababephakathi kwe-Life Esidimeni alifanele. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke, futhi abanye baphinde baphile ezimweni ezingezinhle. Lokhu kulamula kube yithuba lokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, futhi kwavula indlela yokuthi abantu baphendule. Okwesithathu: Lokhu kubonakala kuhamba phambili. Ingabe ubonile ukuthi abathintekayo baphendula kanjani kulokhu? Umnikazi: Yebo, ngibona ukuthi abantu bephendula ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Abafundi, omama, nabanye abantu abathintekayo baqala ukukhuluma ngezinto eziphawulekayo. Lokhu kudalile ukuthi kube nezinsizakalo ezenzakalayo ezizama ukusiza abantu abathintekayo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo. Okwesithathu: Ubonisa umbono omuhle. Ngabe ukhona umphumela omkhulu ocacile ovela kulokhu kulamula? Umnikazi: Impela. Ubufakazi bokuthi kumele kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo buvele ngokusobala. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezikhona kufanele zishintshwe ukuze zifaneleke. Lokhu kulamula kubuye kube yithuba lokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi banelungelo lokuphila kahle futhi banakwe kahle. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani ezinjenge-Life Esidimeni zizophendula kanjani kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezibhekene nezidingo zabantu. Akufanele kube khona izinkampani ezizimele kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela nabantu ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko eziwusizo. Izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi zenza umsebenzi obalulekile, futhi kufanele zihlale zikhumbula lokho. Okwesithathu: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ucabanga ukuthi ikhona imfundo engaphumelelayo kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Yebo, imfundo ibalulekile kakhulu. Uma abantu behluleka ukuqonda amalungelo abo, bayoba nzima kakhulu ukufuna usizo. Ukukhuluma ngempilo, amalungelo, nokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi bangamukela kanjani usizo. Lokhu kufanele kube ingxenye yohlelo lokusebenza lwempilo. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ubona izinselelo ezithinta imiphumela yokulamula? Umnikazi: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Kunezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinsiza ezinganele, nokukhathazeka kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yingozi. Kodwa uma kuxoxwa kahle, ziningi izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Kufanele sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nalezi zinsizi. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ungathanda ukushiya umyalezo kubafundi, noma nabantu abaphakathi kokusebenza kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube nethonya. Akusikho kuphela ukuthi abantu baphendule, kodwa badinga ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile. Ukubambisana, ukukhulumisana, nokwakha isikhala sokusiza, yizona zindlela ezibalulekile zokwakha ikusasa elihle. Akufanele kube yinsakavukela, kodwa kufanele kube yisiko lokwazisa, lokuhlonipha, nokuxhumana. Okwesithathu: Ngiyabonga ngokukhuluma nathi namuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuwusizo olukhulu. Umnikazi: Ngiyabonga futhi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izobeka izimpande zokukhuluma ngalezi zihloko ezibalulekile.
Okutholakele kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli UPhumzile Mthembu ungumphenyi ophumelelayo, oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala, ophumelele emkhakheni wezokuphepha nezokwakha. UPhumzile, owasukela eGoli, ube nesifiso sokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphepha ezakhiweni, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethintekile kakhulu. Ngemuva kokuba umlilo omkhulu wenzeka esakhiweni esidala eGoli, uPhumzile wathola ithuba lokwenza uphenyo olunzulu ukuze aqonde izimbangela zomlilo nokuthi kungani izakhiwo eziningi zihlala zisezingeni eliphansi lokuphepha. UPhumzile uqale ukufunda izifundo zezeMvelo eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBachelor of Science. Ngemuva kwalokho, waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe, wathola iziqu zeMaster's in Fire Safety Engineering. UPhumzile ubelokhu esebenza emkhakheni wezokuphepha kweminyaka engaphezu kwengu-10, futhi ubhekwa njengomunye wabachwepheshe abahamba phambili kule ndawo. Umlilo owenzeka eGoli wawubangelwa ukungahambi kahle kwezinsiza zokuphepha, okwakuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha ezazingenamandla. UPhumzile, ngesikhathi sokuphenya, wathola ukuthi izakhiwo eziningi zazingekho emthethweni, futhi izinhlelo zokuphepha zaziphuthumile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlupheke kakhulu, futhi abanye baphinde baphumule ezindlini zabo. Ngokuphenya kwakhe, uPhumzile wathola ukuthi izinsiza zokuphepha ezazikhona zazingasebenzi kahle, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha zazingenamthetho. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuhlola izinqubomgomo ezikhona, futhi uPhumzile waba nesibopho sokuphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphepha ezakhiweni. UPhumzile ubelokhu esebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, efaka phakathi izinkulumo zomphakathi, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazi ngalezi zinkinga. UPhumzile ubelokhu eqhuba imihlangano nemiphakathi, efundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphepha, futhi ebakhuthaza ukuba baphakamise izinkinga zabo. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe ezindlini, ezihlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, izinhlelo zokuphuma ezisheshayo, kanye nezinsiza zokuvikela umlilo. UPhumzile ubelokhu eqhubeka nokusebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izinkampani zokwakha, kanye nemiphakathi, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphepha. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezithuthukisiwe ezizokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu nezakhiwo emlilweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uPhumzile waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphepha eziphumelelayo, futhi wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe. Ubuye waba umholi emkhakheni wezokuphepha, futhi ube nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhuthaza abanye abaphenyi. UPhumzile ubonakala njengomuntu onomdlandla, onothando lokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphepha ezakhiweni, futhi ubelokhu esebenza kanzima ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephephile. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi ube nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezizokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu nezakhiwo emlilweni. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu nezakhiwo emlilweni.
