Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Kuchazwa Ukwehluleka Kwama-Boiler AseMedupi Isingeniso Le doko ibheka ukwehluleka kwama-boiler aseMedupi, okuyingxenye ebalulekile yephrojekthi yeMedupi Power Station, eyakhiwe ngenhloso yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler kubonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi, okungaholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, ukwanda kwezindleko, kanye nemiphumela emibi emnothweni. Uhlaka Lokuhlaziya 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwama-Boiler - Ukubuyekezwa kokwakhiwa kwama-boiler, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola, izinga lokwakhiwa, nezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe. - Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga ezitholakele ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa, okuhlanganisa ukungahambisani nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo. 2. Ukusebenza Kwama-Boiler - Ukuhlola ukusebenza kwama-boiler, okuhlanganisa izinga lokusebenza, ukusebenza kahle, nezinkinga ezivamile. - Ukuhlaziywa kwezizathu zokwehluleka, okuhlanganisa izinkinga zokwakhiwa, izinsiza ezingalungile, nokungahambisani nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 3. Izizathu Zokwehluleka - Ukungahambisani nezindinganiso zomhlaba wonke zokwakha ama-boiler. - Ukungabi khona kokuhlola okuhlelekile nokuphathwa kwezinsiza. - Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokugcina nokulungisa ama-boiler. 4. Imiphumela Yokwehluleka - Ukuncipha kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, okuholela ekwehleni kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. - Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa izindleko zokulungisa nokugcina. - Umthelela emnothweni, okuhlanganisa ukwehla kwemali engenayo kuhulumeni. 5. Izinyathelo Zokulungisa - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola nokuphatha ama-boiler. - Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokusebenza. - Ukubuyekezwa kwezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlangabezana nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo. Isiphetho Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler aseMedupi kubonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinkinga aziphindi, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokwakha, ukusebenza, nokuphatha ama-boiler. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, ukunciphisa izindleko, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinqubo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ingatholakala kwiwebhusayithi esemthethweni yeMedupi Power Station noma ngokuxhumana ne-ofisi yephrojekthi. Ukwaziswa Okubalulekile Le doko ibalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izinselelo ezibhekene neMedupi Power Station, futhi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube nokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kubandakanya uhulumeni, abenzi bezinto, kanye nabaphathi, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi. Uhlaka Lokuphathwa Kwezinsiza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-boiler aseMedupi asebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinsiza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuhlola njalo ukusebenza kwama-boiler. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala beqeqeshwa futhi benolwazi olufanele. Isiphetho Esiphelele Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler aseMedupi akukhombisi kuphela izinkinga ezithile, kodwa futhi kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi ziqhubeka zisebenza kahle. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kufanele sithuthukise izinqubomgomo, sithuthukise izinsiza, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bethu bahlala beqeqeshwa. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukukhiqizwa kukagesi, ukunciphisa izindleko, kanye nokwakha umnotho oqinile eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukusabela kwenqubomgomo enhlekeleleni yomlilo yaseMarshalltown Isingeniso Kunoma yisiphi isimo esiphuthumayo, okufana nenhlekelele yomlilo, kubalulekile ukuba nenqubomgomo esebenza kahle yokusabela. Lesi sicelo sihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemiyalelo ecacile yokusabela kule nhlekelele, kuhlonishwa izinqubo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu, ukuvikela impahla, kanye nokugcina imiphakathi iphephile. Isinyathelo 1: Ukusungula Ithimba Lokuphendula 1.1. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungeze uhlu lwamalungu eHhovisi Lokuphendula Ngezimo Eziphuthumayo (EMT) olubandakanya: - Abaphathi bezokuphepha - Izikhulu zendawo - Umenzi wezinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlekelele 1.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amalungu ethu azi izindima zabo nezikimu ezifanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuqonda Izimpawu Zomlilo 2.1. Bheka izimpawu ezitholakala emlilweni: - Umoya opholile ngcono - Ukushisa okuphakeme - Ukukhanya okubomvu noma okubhalayo 2.2. Cela imiphakathi ukuba ibike noma yiziphi izimpawu zomlilo ezitholakala. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlonza Izingosi Zokuphuma 3.1. Nquma izindlela zokuphuma ezivamile nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banokuqonda kahle lezi zingosi. 3.2. Bophela izingosi zokuphuma ngezimpawu ezicacile nezibukwayo ukuze zivumelekalwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukunyakaza Nobuhlakani Benhlangano 4.1. Thumela umlayezo ngemiphumela emnene kumphakathi, kutheknoloji yokuxhumana njenge: - Izikhangiso zomsakazo - Izinkundla zokuxhumana - Imiyalezo ye-SMS 4.2. Nxusa abantu ukuthi balandele izixwayiso zamaphoyisa nezokuphepha. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphuma Kokuthola Usizo 5.1. Khumbula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokucela usizo: - Ukuphanda izinsiza zomlilo - Uhlelo lokucela usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo 5.2. Ukugcina aphephile izinsiza zomlilo nezokusebenza. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Ukuphendula 6.1. Phindelela nokuqhuba izivivinyo eziphuthumayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo. 6.2. Thola imiphumela nezibuyekezo ngokuphuma komlilo ukuze uthuthukise ukuthuthukiswa. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqeqesha Umphakathi 7.1. Qhuba izifundo zokuphendula mazenze zibe lula kubantu: - Uhlaka lokuqeqesha oluhlelwe kahle - Imivuzo yokubamba iqhaza 7.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ithola isikhathi esanele sokuzilungiselela. Isinyathelo 8: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinqubomgomo 8.1. Bheka izinqubomgomo ezihleliwe ngesikhathi, nokuthi zisebenza kangakanani empilweni yangempela. 8.2. Thola iziphakamiso nezinguquko ezingase zidingeke. Isiphetho Ukusabela kahle enhlalweni yomlilo yaseMarshalltown kudinga ukuxhumana, ukuqeqesha, nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Izinyathelo ezilandelwayo zizokwenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphenduleni okufanele ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola kuzokwenza sikwazi ukulawula nokuphepha kahle. Sifuna ukuqhubeka nokuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi siyaphumelela ukuze sikhulule abantu bethu ezinsizakalweni eziphuthumayo.
Inqubekela phambili ekwakhiweni kwezindlu zangasese ezikoleni Ingxoxo noMnu. Zulu, Umphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izikole Uthando: Sawubona, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha ukuze sikhulume ngentuthuko ezindlini zangasese ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi lezo ezihlobene nemigodi. Uphi umbono wakho mayelana nokuxazulula lezi zinkinga? UMnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, Uthando. Ngiyajabula ukuba nezingxoxo ngalolu daba olubalulekile. Sinethemba lokuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu zangasese ezisemthethweni ezikoleni kuzokwenza umehluko omuhle emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezinkinga. Uthando: Lokhu kuyavuma. Yini eyejabulisayo osukwini lapha emkhakheni wokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingafanele? UMnu. Zulu: Okwamanje, sithole ukuvuselelwa kwemibono nezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zangasese ezingcono ezikoleni. Izikhungo eziningi ziyasathola izinsiza ezanele zokwakha, futhi izinhlelo zikhona zokusebenzisana nosomabhizinisi bendawo ukuze bathole izindawo ezisemthethweni nezinsiza. Uthando: Lokhu kuyakhanga, kodwa ngabe kukhona izithiyo ezishiwo emsebenzini wokwakha? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, kunezithiyo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithile, kanye nezinsiza ezincane, kubangela izinkinga. Nokho, sesiqhubekile kakhulu ukuze sithole izikhungo zokwakha ezisezingeni. Uthando: Ngabe lezi zinguquko zenza umehluko ekusebenzeni nasekuthuthukiseni izikole? UMnu. Zulu: Impela. Ngeziphakamiso ezinhle, lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokungatholi imfundo efanele kwezingane. Izindawo ezihlanzekile nezisezingeni eliphezulu zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathole imfundo engcono, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi jikelele. Uthando: Kulungile, ngabe kukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezithakazelisayo ezikhona, njengokuxhumana nemiphakathi? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, sithole ukuthi imiphakathi idlala indima enkulu. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi, ezifana nama-workshops ezokwakha, zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni. Ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta imiphakathi zebhizinisi, sithola ukuxhaswa okuningi ophenyo nokuqinisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Uthando: Kuzwakala kahle. Ake sikhulume ngekusasa. Yini okukhona ngaphambi kokuthi sisezinhlelweni ezithile, kuzomele sithathe amanyathelo athile? UMnu. Zulu: Izinjongo zethu zibandakanya ukudala inethiwekhi yamaqembu ahlukene, ukufaka izinhlelo eziya phambili zokubambisana, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ihambisana noshintsho olunomthelela. Umfundi ohlanzekile uyehlela impilo engcono, igcwele izicelo eziphusile. Uthando: Ngabe ukhona umbhalo ocacile okhuthaza ukufaka isandla emizamweni yokwakha izindlu zangasese? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, sinemithombo ethile ethumele izincwadi ezikhuthazayo nezicabangela othisha, abazali, nabanikezeli bezinsiza zamakhaya. Ithimba lethu libambisene nezikhungo ezihlose ukugcina umphakathi uthuthukiswa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kube neqhaza eliphelele ekwenzeni izinqumo. Uthando: Lokhu kuwumqondo omuhle. Ngingakuthanda ukuthi unikeze abadlali abawenza ngamunye umthelela wabo. UMnu. Zulu: Ngaphambi kokuphetha, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi wonke umuntu udinga ukuba neqhaza. Abafundi, abazali, othisha, nosomabhizinisi, bonke banendima ebalulekile. Ukubambisana nokuhlanganyela ngephakethe lemali kungaholela ekwenzeni umehluko omkhulu. Uthando: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngokusithokozisa ngalesi sikhathi. Ngithemba ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazobe bazikhathalela izikole zethu ukuze sithuthukise imiphakathi. UMnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, Uthando. Ngiyabonga ngethuba lokukhuluma ngalo msebenzi obalulekile. Ngiyaphila. Uthando: Ngiyabonga. Lokhu kuhambisana neqiniso elijulile lokuthi imfundo iklanywa, futhi umphakathi uyoza ubhekene nezimo ezintsha ezikhuluma ngemigodi, konke kulandela ukuxhumana kwendlela ephumelelayo. Umsebenzi wokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingafanele ezikoleni ulokhu uqhubekela phambili, futhi ngezimvo, izinqumo, nomsebenzi onomthelela, siphokophele ukuphendukela phambili ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umfundi ungena esikhathini esikahle.
Hheyi, unjani? Ngizokhuluma ngalezi zinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezithinta indlela izitimela ezisebenza ngayo, futhi kumele sikhulume ngazo. Okokuqala, sobala ukuthi izitimela zika-Transnet zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ziyindlela enkulu yokuhambisa impahla, kodwa zikhona izinkinga eziningi. Ukugcina izitimela zisesimweni esihle akulula. Ukuxhumana kwezitimela, izikhala zokuhamba, nezinsiza zikhona ezimeni ezithile ezidala izinkinga. Isibonelo, uma sithatha izitimela ezithutha amalahle, kudingeka ukuthi kulungiswe izinsiza ezithile. Kodwa uma lezi zinsiza zingekho, lokho kuphazamiseka kuholela ekutheni izitimela zingahambi ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuhluka kwezinsiza, njengama-locomotive, akuvamile ukuba kulungiswe kalula, futhi uma kudingeka ukulungisa, kubiza kakhulu. Futhi, kufanele sikhulume ngezenzakalo ezimbi. Uma izitimela zisebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile, kuba khona izehlakalo ezinzima. Ukungabi nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphepha kudala izingozi ezingabangelwa abantu abangenamakhono. Lokhu kungenza kube nezingozi ezimbi, futhi lokho kuzochitha izinsiza eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Uma umgibeli engakwazi ukuxhumana kahle nezinye izikhungo, lokho kungadala izinkinga. Uhlelo lokuxhumana lungase lungabi nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngemiyalezo ngesikhathi esifanele, okubangela ukuthi izitimela zingahambi ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhamba. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngezinsizakusebenza, akufanele singakhohlwa ukuba izitimela zidinga abasebenzi abaningi. Ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi abakahle kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Uma umphakathi ungabona izinkinga ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi ibanjwa kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukwandiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwempilo, ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi izimoto ezisemgwaqweni zikhona ezithinta izitimela. Ukukhuphuka kokuthuthwa kwemoto kubangela ukunciphisa umthwalo wezitimela. Lokhu kungenza izitimela zingabi namathuba amaningi. Futhi, uma izimoto zithatha indawo enkulu, izitimela zingase zihlupheke ngokwezimali. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo zokubhekana nalokhu. Ngokubheka ezemvelo, kuyacaca ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuba zisebenze ngendlela ehlanzekile. Uma izitimela zikhumbula ukuhamba ngaphandle kokwenza umonakalo emvelweni, lokho kuzonikeza isithombe esihle. Kodwa uma izitimela zikhona ezikhipha imikhuba emibi, lokho kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zemvelo, kubalulekile ukuthi izitimela ziqhubele phambili. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngonyaka, sithola ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuhlela okuhle. Ukungabi nezinhlelo ezinhle kubangela ukungahambi kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuhlela, kodwa uma lezi zinhlelo zingekho, izitimela zikhona ezithinteka kabi. Ngokuphetha, izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail ziningi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume, sabelane ngezinhlelo, futhi sisebenze ndawonye. Ngithanda ukukukhumbuza ukuthi izitimela zikhona ezibalulekile, futhi umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nokuxhasa lezi zinsiza. Hamba kahle!
Ingxoxo Ngokushoda KweMithi Ezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani nonke, namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile efana nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Sinezithameli ezithokozisayo, uDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo, ongudokotela ophumelelayo endaweni yethu, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, ongumsizi wezempilo, kanye noNkk. Zanele Mthembu, ongumzali omdala, ukuze sithole imibono eyahlukene ngalesi sihloko. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokuba lapha nanamuhla. UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kudinga ukuxoxwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kokuba kuhlobene nempilo yomphakathi, kwenze kube nzima ukuze sithole imithi edingekayo; lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi zempilo. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngempela, uDokotela Ngcobo. Ngiyavuma, imithi ayitholakali kalula ezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi leyo ethinta izimo ezimqoka ezifana neziguli ezinesifo sdiabetes, uhlobo lwezifo zenkohlakalo, kanye nezifo zengqondo. Lokhu kudala ukuvuselelwa kwezinkinga zempilo ezinokuthinta wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abahlwempu. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngenhlanhla, ngiyavuma. Njengomama, ngizithola sengithola izinkinga ezinkulu lapho ngizama ukuthola imithi yokwelapha ingane yami. Ukudinga ukulinda isikhathi eside ezibhedleni ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi kungaba yingozi. Umxhumanisi: Uxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona. UDokotela Ngcobo, kungani omasipala bezokwelapha behluleka ukuthola imithi eyanele? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Kunezizathu ezimbalwa. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezikhona ezikhishwayo akanele ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele. Ikhono lokwakha nokuqinisa imikhiqizo yezenhlalakahle akuvumelani nezidingo zabantu. Okwesibili, kuphakamisa izinkinga zemali. Ukukhula kwamanani emithi nakho kudala umthelela omubi. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngaphezu kwalokho, futhi kumele sikhulume ngokuphathwa kwendleko. Njengoba izikhungo zezempilo zikhula, izinsiza ezikhona azikhuli ngokufanayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngiyavuma, kusho uMnu. Dlamini. Angikaze ngicabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga, azithintanga kuphela iziguli ezithintekayo kodwa zenza nokuphila kwazulu kube nzima ngokubanzi. Unezizathu ezithile ozithanda zokuwufaka? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Ngizwa umbono wakho, Nkk. Mthembu. Ukwaneliseka kweziguli kumele kube kuhle. Ukuze kuvimbe ukushoda kwesibhedlela, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezibheke phambili. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuphathwa kahle kwemithombo ezikhona, ukukhiqiza imithi ngendlela engcono, nokuxhumana nozakwethu, njengoba izinkampani ezithengisa imithi zibhekene nezinkinga ezimqoka. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubamba iqhaza kokuqwashisa umphakathi kuphumelelayo. Uma umuntu efunda ukuthi imithi ingatholakala kalula, umphakathi uyakwazi ukufaka izicelo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yazo zonke iziguli. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Njengomama, ngicela ukuthi ubhale phansi lokhu. Uhlelo lokuqwashisa lezi zimali kulungiselelwa abantwana bethu. Ngiyafisa ukufaka isandla ekwakheni isibonelo esihle. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe yisiphi isinyathelo esithathwayo ukuze kuqashelwe lezi zinkinga? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Uhlelo lokulungisa imithombo kufanele lube neso elibukekayo. Ukusebenza nabavikeli bemithi, nokwenza iziphakamiso kubasebenzi bezempilo. Ukwanda kwamathuba okukhuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kukamasipala, izibhedlela, nabanye abathintekayo. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngicela ukugqamisa ukuthi kufanele kuphume imizamo emisha. Idokodo elingeqondakali kuzodingeka ukwenziwe ukuze kusebenze izinhlelo ezindala. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngabe sinempendulo edingekayo esizathola? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Yebo, uhlelo lokubambisana lumele lwehlise izinkinga phakathi kukamasipala. Ukuleleka kwempilo komphakathi kusho ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezibambanayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga nonke ngale ngxoxo ebuhlungu nebalulekile. Njengamazwi anelisayo, sizobhekana nokwakhiwa ngezindlela ezintsha ukuze sithole izixazululo zempilo ezizohlala ziqhubeka. Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyanibona.
Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala luhamba phambili emizamweni yokuthuthukisa impilo nekhwalithi yokufunda kwabafundi. Nokho, uma sihlola lokhu kuhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impumelelo yalo ayikhawulelwanga ekunikezeni ukudla kuphela, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izimo zokuphila zabafundi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu hlelo. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngezizathu ezinhle zokuthi kungani uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyadingeka. Abafundi abanokudla okunempilo bathola amandla okusebenza kahle, okwandisa ukukwazi kwabo ukufunda. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo kuthuthukisa igazi, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokugxila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lokondla lunciphisa izinga lokungondleki phakathi kwabafundi, okungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwabo esikoleni. Nokho, izinselelo azikhi kuphela. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lidinga izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izindawo zokupheka, kanye nabantu abaqeqeshiwe. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu, futhi ezikhathini ezinzima zomnotho, izikole eziningi ziba nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izikole zidinga ukusiza ngemali ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi kudliwe ukudla okunempilo, futhi izikole zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nokuhlukahluka kokudla okukhona, ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zokudla ezahlukene, njengezidingo zabantu abane-allergies noma abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ukungabi nalokhu kuhlukahluka kungaholela ekudleni okungafanele, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabafundi. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni kufanele luhambisane nezifundo eziphathelene nokudla. Abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ngokuqonda okuhle kokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi kungani kudingeka ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kuzokwandisa ukuqonda kwabo ngezingozi zokudla okungafanele. Uhlelo lokondla kufanele luhlanganiswe nezifundo zokuphila, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngempilo enempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokupheka ezihambisana nezidingo zokupheka, nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luhambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Izikole zingasebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ekugcineni, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinselelo, kodwa futhi luyithuba. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ukudla okunempilo, futhi lokho kudinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngokuphumelela, singathuthukisa impilo yabafundi, sithuthukise ikhwalithi yokufunda, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lungaba yinsika yempumelelo, uma luphathwa kahle futhi luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni olunempilo, olukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi luhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokufunda. Lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinsika eqinile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni lesi sikhathi sokondla.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Smart Meter kwa-Eskom Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elikhulu, lapho izinto zishintsha njalo, uSipho wayehlala emzini weMbali. Njengoba abahlali bezama ukuphila impilo engcono, uSipho ubona ukuthi ubunzima bokukhokha ugesi buyaqhubeka. EziNdlini zaku-Eskom, izinga lokusebenzisa ugesi lishintsha nsuku zonke, futhi lokho kudala ukuthi abantu babe nekhathazeka. Kodwa-ke, kwavela into ethokozisayo – i-smart meter. Njengoba uSipho ehamba ngebhasi eya emsebenzini, wathola izimemezelo ezivela ku-Eskom. "Sizoba nezinguquko ezinkulu!" kwakukhuluma khona. Ugesi othengiswa kumanje uyoba nezinga elisha, elizokwenza kube lula ukulawula nokukhokha. USipho wacabanga, “Kodwa lokhu kuzoba nesithunzi kanjani empilweni yami?” Ngemva kwesonto, uSipho wanikela ithuba lokufaka i-smart meter. Kulungile, wacabanga, “Noma yini eyenza impilo ingcono, ngiyavuma.” Wathola ithuba lokuhlangana ne-ekspert ka-Eskom, uNandi. “Lezi zinsiza zikhuluma nathi,” kusho uNandi, eyimfihlo ethokozisayo. “I-smart meter iyazazi izidingo zakho, iyakwazi ukukala ugesi osawusebenzisayo, futhi izokuthumela izaziso eziphathelene nezindleko.” U-Sipho waba nemibuzo eminingi. “Kanjani lokhu kuzokwenza ngithole ugesi ongcono?” U-Nandi wamchazela. “Ubani owaziyo, kungenzeka ukuthi uthole izaphulelo uma ungasebenzisi ugesi kakhulu ngezikhathi ezithile. Futhi uzokwazi ukulawula izindleko zakho ngokuqapha.” Njengoba uSipho efaka i-smart meter, wayezizwa efana nesisebenzi esisha esisebenzayo. Kwakuyindlela entsha yokuphila, futhi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuboniseni izinguquko ezizayo. Ngemva kwesonto, kamuva, uSipho waqala ukubona izinguquko. Kwakungenxa yokuthi i-smart meter yamthumela izaziso ezithile eziphathelene nokusetshenziswa kwakhe. Ngonyaka, wathola izaziso ezazimnceda ukuthi ahlale eqaphile. “Ngiyakwazi ukugcina ukusetshenziswa kwami phansi!” washaya izandla, ecabanga ngezindleko ezizokhula. Ngenkathi edlula ezinsukwini ezithile, uSipho waqala ukwakha imikhuba emisha. Wathola ukuthi ugesi obhujiswe ezinsukwini ezithile wawukhona kuphela uma efaka izinto ezithile. Waze wathola isikhathi esithile sokuhlola izinsiza zomndeni, okwenza abanye abahlali bakhe balandele isibonelo sakhe. “Ngabe lezi zinsiza zisebenza kangcono? Ngabe kungenzeka sithole izaphulelo?” babuza, begcizelela imiphumela emihle. Ngesikhathi umoya uthokozisa abantu, uSipho waba necebo. Waqala ukuthuthukisa imikhuba yokuphila, esebenzisa ugesi ngempumelelo. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho umndeni wakhe ubona ukwehla kwezindleko. “Siyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko zethu,” kusho unina, ekhuluma ngokujabula. U-Sipho wayejabule kakhulu, njengoba i-smart meter yenza kube lula kubo bonke. Kodwa-ke, kwavela izinselelo. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi i-smart meter ibiza kakhulu. “Siyidinga yini le teknoloji? Kukhona okufanele sikwenze,” kusho uMnumzane Ndlovu, owabe engumakhelwane kaSipho. “Kodwa ubani owaziyo? U-Sipho uveza impumelelo,” waphendula uNandi, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. Ngemva kwesikhashana, uSipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuba nezingxoxo eziningi ne-Eskom. Wabona ukuthi i-smart meter yayihamba phambili, yenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi i-smart meter ibalulekile empilweni yabo. U-Sipho waba nesithakazelo sokuphakamisa umqondo wokwakha imikhuba emisha, futhi abanye baqala ukwamukela lokho. Ngaphakathi kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi ugesi ungcono kakhulu. “Ngifuna ukuba nesigaba esiphakeme,” wathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uNandi wanikela ithuba lokubona ukuthuthukiswa. “Uyazi, umphakathi uthuthuka uma sisesha izixazululo,” echaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyinsiza enkulu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, futhi abantu baqala ukuya phambili. Kwaphela isikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyinsiza yokugcina ugesi, futhi izindleko zaphinde zancipha. U-Sipho wathola impumelelo, futhi umndeni wakhe waba nenhlalakahle. Njengoba kade kwenzeka, uSipho waqonda ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyindlela yokuphila engcono. Kwakuwukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke, futhi abahlali baphakathi kwendawo yanamuhla bazitholele izinzuzo. “Ngempela, sizoqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokuphila,” wathi. Ekugcineni, uSipho waba yisibonelo somphakathi. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukufaka i-smart meter kwa-Eskom kwakuwukwazisa impilo yakhe nezikhalazo zomphakathi. Kwasiza abantu baqonde ukuthi ugesi ungasebenza kahle uma besebenzisa izinsiza zethu kahle. “Siyakwazi ukwenza kahle,” wathi, ngesikhathi umphakathi waphuma phambili, ubukhumbula izinsuku zokuqala, lapho bekwazi ukukhipha izinsiza zokuphila. Kwakuyinsuku ejabulisayo, futhi uSipho waqonda ukuthi izinguquko zikhona, zikhulisa ikusasa. “Ngiyabonga, Eskom!” wathi, ephakamisa umoya ophakeme. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwakuwumsebenzi omuhle, futhi uSipho wagubha impumelelo yabo bonke.
# Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS nomthelela kubafundi ## Isingeniso Le mibhalo ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokubambezeleka kwezimali zeNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) kanye nomthelela onawo kubafundi. I-NSFAS iyinhlangano ebanzi enikeza uxhaso lwezezimali kubafundi abadingayo ukuze bakwazi ukufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ukubambezeleka ekudluliseni lezi zimali kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kubafundi, okudinga ukuxazululwa. ## Ukubambezeleka kwezimali Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS kungaba ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa: 1. Izinkinga Zokuphathwa Kwezimali: I-NSFAS ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha imali, njengokuphazamiseka ezinhlelweni zokuhweba noma ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele. 2. Ukuhlolwa Kwezimali: Ukuhlolwa okweqile kwezimali kungaholela ekubambezelweni kwemali. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukungahambisani kwezidingo zokuhlola abafundi ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuthi bayahlangabezana nezimfuno zokusebenza. 3. Izizathu Zomlando: Izinkinga zomlando zezezimali zabafundi, njengezikweletu ezingakakhokhwa, zingathinta ukufaneleka kwabo ukuthola uxhaso, okungaholela ekubambezelweni. 4. Izinguquko Ezimweni Zokuqashwa: Izinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini zokuqashwa zikhombisa ukwehla kwezikhalazo zezimali, okuholela ekubambezelweni kwemali. ## Umthelela Kubafundi Ukubambezeleka kwemali ye-NSFAS kunomthelela omkhulu kubafundi, okubandakanya: 1. Ukuphazamiseka Kwezimfundo: Abafundi abangatholanga uxhaso lwezimali bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhamba esikhathini, okuholela ekubambezelweni kokufunda. Lokhu kungaholela ekwehleni kwemiphumela yabo. 2. Ukukhathazeka Kwezimali: Abafundi abaphakathi kwezinkinga zezimali bangase babe nokukhathazeka okukhulu, okungathinta ukusebenza kwabo ezifundweni. 3. Izinkinga Zokuhlala: Abafundi abangatholi uxhaso bangase babhekane nezinselele zokuhlala, okungaholela ekutheni badinge ukuhlala ezindlini ezingafanele. 4. Ukushoda Kwezinselelo: I-NSFAS ibalulekile ekuxhumaneni nasekuxazululeni izinkinga zezezimali zabafundi, kodwa ukubambezeleka kungaholela kumathuba amancane okuqhubeka nemfundo. ## Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwe-NSFAS nokunciphisa ukubambezeleka kwemali, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zingathathwa: 1. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha: Umnyango wezezimali kumele uthuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuhweba zisebenza kahle. 2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezakhamuzi ezisebenzela i-NSFAS kuzoba nesisekelo ekwenzeni amathuba aguquke kahle. 3. Ukukhuluma Nababambiqhaza: Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi, odokotela, nezikhungo zemali kuzothuthukisa ukuqonda kwezidingo nokuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. 4. Ukwazi Ngokuqhubekayo: Ukuze abafundi bazuze, kufanele kube nokwaziswa okuhle mayelana nezinhlelo ze-NSFAS kanye nemigomo yokufaka izicelo. ## Isiphetho Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS kungaba nemiphumela emibi kubafundi, kuholele ezinkingeni ezinzima zomsebenzi nezemfundo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola uxhaso lwezimali oludingekayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo nezisebenzayo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imiphumela yabafundi, kunciphise ukukhathazeka kwezimali, futhi kugqugquzele ukufunda okwengeziwe. Umnyango wezezimali, kanye nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo, kumele bazikhandle ukuze bakhe izinqubo eziphumelelayo, eziqinile, nezisebenzayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba abafundi bathola uxhaso oludingekayo ngaphandle kwezithiyo, okuzosiza ekukhuleni kwemfundo eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Isingeniso Lo mbhalo uqukethe ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo esithathwe yinkantolo engamaNgesi sokushwele sikaOscar Pistorius, owayengumjaho ophumelelayo, obhekene nezinsolo zokubulala. Ukuhlaziywa kuzogxila ezicini ezihambisana nesinqumo, imiphumela yezomthetho, kanye nemithelela kulezi zenzo emphakathini. Isizathu Sokuhlola Ukubheka isinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kubalulekile ngoba kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokubusa, ubulungiswa, kanye nokuhlukumeza kwabantu. U-Pistorius, obemelwe njengomfanekiso olandelwayo, uyisibonelo sokuthi izinqumo zomthetho zingabhekwa ngezindlela ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezinkanyezi zomphakathi. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Uhlaka lwezomthetho olusemthethweni lukhombisa ukuthi isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngokuhlonipha zonke izinqubo zomthetho. Nokho, ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe, izimpikiswano zokuqonda, kanye nezimpendulo zezinhlangothi ezahlukene zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezihlobene nokuqonda kobulungiswa. Ukuhlinzekwa Kobufakazi Ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe phakathi kophiko lwezomthetho lubonisa ukungabaza okukhulu. Ubufakazi bokuphila bukaPistorius, izimo ezimkhulumayo, kanye nemiphumela yokushaya kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho aluhambisani nezimfuno ezifunwa umphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhlinzekwa kobufakazi obanele, obuqinisekisiwe, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe umehluko obalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nezombusazwe Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibuye saphakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe. Imiphumela yesinqumo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho lungase luhlangabezane nezinselelo zokubhekelwa kwababusi bezomthetho. Ukwaziswa okuphakanyisiwe kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokuthi abantu abacebile noma abathandwayo bangathola izinkanyezi ezinkulu, kuyilapho abanye besolwa bephoqwa ukuba bahlale phansi. Umthelela Emphakathini Umphakathi ubona imiphumela yesinqumo sikaPistorius ngokwehlukana. Abanye bakhombisa ukuthanda, bebonisa ukuthi uPistorius ubengumuntu ophambene nezimo ezinzima, kanti abanye bahlola ubulungiswa obuyisisekelo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi umphakathi ungase ube nezinkolelo ezahlukene ngokwethulwa kwezomthetho nobulungiswa. Izifundo Ezifunwayo Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi sinqumo kukhombisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni wezomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuzwe ubulungiswa. Ukuqonda indlela umphakathi uphendula ngayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho zihlala zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kuvula indlela yokuhlola izinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ubulungiswa, kanye nezomnotho. Kudingeka ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zithathwa ngokuqonda, ziqinisa ubulungiswa, futhi zisebenzele wonke umuntu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Isinyathelo sokugcina sokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezibekwe kulokhu kuhlaziywa ziqiniswa, kudingeka izinsiza zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amaqembu ezomthetho, kanye neminyango yezobulungiswa, ukuze kube nesigaba sokuxhumana esiqinile phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezomthetho. Umsebenzi Olandelayo Umsebenzi olandelayo ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngolwazi, ucwaningo, kanye nezifundo ezitholakala kokubili emkhakheni wezomthetho, nasezindaweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuqonda izinqumo zomthetho, ukwakha isithombe esihle sezinqubomgomo, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubulungiswa emiphakathini yethu. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kuveza ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola izimo, izinqubo zokusebenza, kanye nezimpendulo zomphakathi kumasu wezomthetho. Imiphumela yalezi zifundo iyawuqinisa umqondo wokuthi ubulungiswa kufanele bube yinto efanelekile, eveza izidingo zomphakathi wonke.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule Ngokubona kwami, izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile kakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengomfundi ophothulile, ngiyazi ukuthi ukufunda kuphela akanele; kudingeka ukuthi sithole ithuba lokusebenzisa lokho esikufundile emsebenzini. Ngakho-ke, izindlela ezitholakalayo zama-internship zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezicacile, ezithuthukisayo, nezihambisana nezidingo zabafundi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezinkampani ezahlukene ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ama-internship ahambisana nezifundo zabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde kahle imisebenzi ethile, futhi bakwazi ukufaka isandla emisebenzini ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani nazo zidinga ukufunda ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuthola abafundi abasha abaneziqu eziphezulu, ukuze ziqhubeke nokukhula. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zama-internship kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhola abafundi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kumele bazi ukuthi yini okulindeleke kubo, futhi bazi ukuthi bazothola ini ekupheleni kwalesi sikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okuhle, izinkampani zingasiza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono abalulekile, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukufaka isandla emsebenzini, futhi kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bathole ithuba lokuxhumana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe inethiwekhi ebanzi, futhi bazitholele amathuba amaningi emsebenzini. Ukuxhumana nabantu abanolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni wabo kuzobasiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle izidingo zemakethe, futhi bakwazi ukuhlela izinyathelo zabo zokuphumelela. Ngokuphathelene nezinkinga ezithinta ama-internship, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi abathola ama-internship bayakhokhelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baphumelele, futhi kuzokhuthaza abanye abafundi ukuba baphokophele ama-internship. Ukungakhokhelwa kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bengafaneleki, futhi lokhu kungathinta umphumela wokugcina. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi ama-internship ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kumele bathole ithuba lokufunda ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, futhi bazi ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baqonde kahle imisebenzi ethile, futhi bazitholele amathuba amaningi emsebenzini. Ngokuphetha, izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezinkampani, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ama-internship ahambisana nezifundo zabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okuhle, ithuba lokuxhumana, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuba baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza bonke abathintekayo ukuthi baphokophele izindlela ezithuthukisayo zama-internship, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time Izingxoxo zePhalamende zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubhekaneni nezindaba zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time, lapho uMongameli ephendula khona imibuzo ethunyelwa ngamalungu ePhalamende. Lezi zingxoxo zikhombisa indlela uHulumeni obhekana ngayo nezinkinga ezithinta isizwe, futhi ziwuphawu lwezinkolelo zamasiko okuphathwa kwezindaba zomphakathi. Isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time siba nenhloso yokugcina uMongameli ephendula imibuzo edingekayo, okuyindlela yokubika nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokubuyisela ukubonisana phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi. Izingxoxo ezibanjwa kuleli sikhathi zikhuthaza ukuvulwa kwemibono, nokwenza kube lula ukuhlola izinqumo ezithathwayo uHulumeni. Ngokwesiko, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time siba nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zokwenza izinqumo. Amangcwethi abona lezi zingxoxo njengendlela yokwakha ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, amalungu ePhalamende, abamele izifunda ezahlukene, babeka izinkinga ezikhathaza izakhamuzi zabo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esifanele. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zingxoxo ziqala kanjani. Izinsuku ezibekiwe ziba yisikhathi sokuphendula imibuzo, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ethumele khona imibuzo ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi uMongameli kumele aphendule ngalesi sikhathi esinqunyiweyo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuphendula imibuzo yokubaluleka, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende ahlola izinqubomgomo ezithile, ukuhlola ukusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukwenza lezi zingxoxo zibe nomthelela, kubalulekile ukuthi uMongameli abe neziqu ezithe xaxa kumkhankaso wakhe. Lokhu kudinga ukuba ahlaziye kahle izinkinga ezitholakala emibuzweni, akhombise ubuhlakani, futhi aphendule ngendlela eqondile. Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kukaMongameli namaqembu aphikisayo buvame ukuvumela ukuthi kube nezixazululo eziphumelelayo ezitholakala. Naphezu kwalezi zinhlelo, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time sinezinkinga ezithile. Kwezinye izikhathi, imibuzo ivame ukuhunyushwa ngendlela yokuphikisana, okungaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimo zokungqubuzana phakathi kukaMongameli namalungu ePhalamende. Lokhu kuzwakala kakhulu uma izinkinga ezithile ziqhathaniswa nemiphumela ethile yokuphatha uHulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time kudinga ukuthi kudaleke umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuba amalungu ePhalamende azise ukuthi izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe zidinga ukwakhiwa kwempendulo esebenzayo, hhayi kuphela ukusiza izakhamuzi kodwa futhi nokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kukaHulumeni nomphakathi. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezithathwayo zihlale ziqinile futhi ziqinisa isithunzi sePhalamende. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinkampani zomphakathi, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezikhungo zempilo zidinga ukuba zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zenzeka ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time, iziphakamiso ezithile kufanele zihlolwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhuba izinqubomgomo ezizuzisayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda umthelela wezobuchwepheshe kulezi zingxoxo. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe kuholele ekushintsheni indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo, okwenza kube lula ukuveza imibono, iziphakamiso nezinkinga emphakathini. Izingxoxo ezibanjwa ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time zingase zisebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngokuphetha, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time singumcibisholo wokubambisana phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi. Lezi zingxoxo zikhombisa ukuthi uHulumeni ubhekephi futhi zidinga ukuba zihlonishwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zisebenziseka. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni yesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwesizinda esiqinile sokuphatha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinqubweni zomphakathi.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhubeka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Kagesi uyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke, futhi izinkinga ezihlobene nakho zingaba nemiphumela emibi emiphakathini nasemabhizinisini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkinga ezithinta ugesi zihlolwe ngokuqinile futhi zixazululwe ngendlela efanele. ### Isizathu Sokulalelwa Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuvame ukwenzeka uma kukhona izikhalazo ezivela kubantu, amabhizinisi, noma iziphathimandla ezikhathazekile ngalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga ezifana nokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, izindleko eziphezulu zokusebenzisa ugesi, noma izinkinga zokuphepha ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ukulalelwa kwenziwa ukuze kuhlanganyelwe imibono, iziphakamiso, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. ### Izinyathelo Zokulalelwa 1. Ukubiza Ukulalelwa: IPhalamende libiza ukulalelwa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kungenziwa ngamalungu ePhalamende, iziphathimandla, noma ngababambiqhaza abavela emiphakathini. 2. Ukubamba Izingxoxo: Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngogesi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi ziba nezingxoxo ezijulile. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwemibono kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinkinga ezikhona. 3. Ukulalela Izinkulumo: IPhalamende lihlola izinkulumo ezivela kubabambiqhaza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abamele izinkampani zikagesi, osomabhizinisi, nabantu abajwayelekile abathintekayo. Izinkulumo zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. 4. Ukuhlola Ubufakazi: Ngemuva kokulalela, iPhalamende ihlola ubufakazi obuhambisana nezinkulumo ezitholakele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubheka imibiko, izifundo, nezifundo ezenziwe ngocwaningo. Ubufakazi buhloswe ukusiza ekuthatheni izinqumo eziphusile. 5. Ukuthuthukisa Izixazululo: Ngemva kokuhlola ubufakazi, iPhalamende idinga ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezintsha, ukwandisa izinsiza, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezixazululo eziphumelelayo. ### Izinselelo Eziyinhloko Noma kunjalo, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kunezinselelo ezithile. Lezi zifaka phakathi: - Ukungabi Nabo Ubuchwepheshe Obuphezulu: Ezinye izinkampani zikagesi zingase zingabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlola izinkinga, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. - Ukungavumi Kwezinhlaka: Abanye abantu bangase bangavumi izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma izinqumo ezithile. - Izinsiza Ezinganele: Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi emiphakathini ethile kungaholela ekutheni izinkinga zibe nzima kakhulu. ### Ukubaluleka Kokulalela Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba: - Kwakha Uxolo: Ukuxoxisana nokuhlola izinkinga ngokubambisana kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezixazululweni eziphumelelayo. - Kwandisa Ukubambisana: Lokhu kukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi, iziphathimandla, nabantu, okuholela ekwakheni isixazululo esiqinile. - Kwakha Ukuzethemba: Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo zihlolwe futhi zixazululwa, bakha ukwethemba kwiPhalamende, okubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. ### Isiphetho Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta ugesi, okuyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Le nqubo idinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zihlolwe ngokujulile, futhi izixazululo eziphumelelayo zikhishwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ugesi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila impilo engcono.
Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi (Home Affairs) waphakamisa umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwezinsiza online. Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa abaphathi, izisebenzi zomnyango, kanye nabanye abathintekayo ukuze baxoxe ngentuthuko nezinguquko ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphephile, nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abafuna ukufaka izicelo zokuhlonza, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezibalulekile. UMenenja Yezinsizakalo, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uvule umcimbi ngenkulumo ebonisa ukubaluleka kokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Uhlelo lwe-online luhlinzeka ngendlela esheshayo yokusebenza, evumela abantu ukuthi benze izicelo zabo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ehhovisi, okunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda nezinkinga ezikhona emsebenzini wansuku zonke. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinyathelo ezilula zokubhalisela i-akhawunti, ukufaka izicelo, nokulandela isimo sezicelo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwephrojekthi, abahlanganyeli bakhuthaza ukusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-online, bejabulisa ngempumelelo yabo. Uhlelo luthuthukiswe ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, futhi abathintekayo baphendule kahle, bekhombisa ukwaneliseka okukhulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzimisela koMnyango Wezangaphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini ethile, efana nokubhaliswa kwezinsiza, izicelo zokuhamba, kanye nezincwadi zokuhlonza. Abantu banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo online, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi kungase kube nzima. Umcimbi uqhubekile ngokwabelana ngempumelelo yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-online, lapho abathintekayo baphendula imibuzo ethile. Uhlelo luye lwakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba basebenzise izinsizakalo ezitholakala online, okuveza ukuthi abantu bahlomula kulolu shintsho. Lokhu kuhlangene nemizamo yokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinye izinsizakalo, kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezithinta ubuzwe, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphumelela komcimbi, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi ubonisile ukuthi uzokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-online luhlala luthuthukiswa futhi luhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula, kunciphise izithiyo ezikhona, futhi kuhlinzeke ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula. Umcimbi wokuqala ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza ushintsho oluhle, oluhambisana nezidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnyango uzobe uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa uhlelo, ubheke iziphakamiso nezidingo zabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisesikhathini, zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhona kubo bonke. Umcimbi wokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo, uthuthukise ukufinyelela, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abantu banelisekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba basebenzise izinsizakalo ezitholakala online, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini ethile, futhi umcimbi wokuqala ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza ushintsho oluhle, okuqhubeka nokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka. Uhlelo luzoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezithinta ubuzwe, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi.
Ukulalelwa Komphakathi Mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Uhlelo lweMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo luhloswe ukuba luthuthukise ukufinyelela kwezempilo, lwenze kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo, futhi lunciphise izindleko zezempilo kubantu. Ukuze lolu hlelo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nolwazi oluqondile ngalo, futhi kube nokulalelwa komphakathi ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, izinkinga, nezidingo zabo. 1. Yini iNHI? IMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) iyindlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni. I-NHI izohlinzeka ngempilo kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi banelungelo lokukhokha noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangenamali yokukhokha izinsiza zezempilo bazokwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezizohlinzeka ngezinsiza, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, odokotela, nezikhungo zezempilo. 2. Kungani kubalulekile ukulalela umphakathi? Ukulalela umphakathi kubalulekile ngoba abantu bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinselelo eziningi, futhi uma umphakathi ungabandakanyeki, izixazululo ezitholakalayo zingase zingahambisani nezidingo zabo. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kuzosiza ohulumeni nabaholi bezempilo ukuba baqonde kahle izinkinga ezikhona, izifiso, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. 3. Izindlela zokulalela umphakathi Ukuze umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kwe-NHI, kunezindlela eziningi zokulalela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Imihlangano yomphakathi: Ukuhlela imihlangano lapho abantu bengavula khona izinkulumo, bevezwa imibono yabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa imibono ehlukene. - Uphenyo: Ukuqhuba uphenyo ukuze kuqoqwe imibono nemibuzo evela kubantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. - Izinkundla zokuxhumana: Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. - Izinhlelo zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana ne-NHI ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosebenza kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza. 4. Izinzuzo ze-NHI Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinzuzo eziningi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukufinyelela kwezempilo: Abantu bazokwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono ngenkathi kunciphisa izindleko. - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, odokotela, nezikhungo zezempilo. - Ukubandakanywa komphakathi: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukubandakanya umphakathi ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza zezempilo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. 5. Izinselelo ze-NHI Noma uhlelo lwe-NHI lunemigomo emihle, kunezinselelo ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuxhaswa kwezimali: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kudingeka uxhaso lwezimali oluqinile. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlela kahle izinsiza zezimali. - Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kudingeka ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi abaphathi bezempilo bazi kahle izidingo zomphakathi. - Ukubandakanywa kwabantu: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izidingo zabo. 6. Isiphetho Uhlelo lweMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulalela umphakathi kubalulekile ukuze lolu hlelo luphumelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babambe iqhaza, baveze imibono yabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngokubambisana, singakha uhlelo lwezempilo oluphumelelayo noluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwe-NHI lungaba yinsika yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi uma umphakathi ubambisene, sizokwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinhloso.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika libe nempikiswano ebalulekile mayelana nenkinga kagesi ebhekene nezwe. Lokhu kulalelwa kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhathazeka okukhulu ngemiphumela yokungabi khona kukagesi okuqhubekayo, okubangela ukuphazamiseka emisebenzini nasempilweni yabantu abaningi. Umgqugquzeli wezokuthutha, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu, uveze ukuthi isimo sokungabi khona kukagesi sithinta izimboni eziningi, kubandakanya ezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokudla. "Sibona izinkampani zikhathazekile, zikhubazekile, futhi lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemisebenzi," kusho uMnu. Mthembu. Uphiko lwezokwakha luphinde lwavuma ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zikhula ngokushesha, kodwa ngenxa yokungabi khona kukagesi, imisebenzi eminingi ibhujiswa. UMsizi weZokwakha, uNkk. Thandi Nkosi, uphinde waveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi, "Uma kungenzeka ukuthi i-Escom ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okwanele, sizobona ukwehla kokwakhiwa kwezindlu, okukhona okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho." Ukwengeza, umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphila nsuku zonke. UMsizi Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnu. Sibusiso Dlamini, uthe: "Abantu bethu bahlupheka, abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka." Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, uMphakathi Uhlangene, inhlangano yezenhlalakahle, ibonisa ukuthi izigaba ezithile zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zikhathazekile kakhulu. UMsizi Wokuphila, uNkk. Zanele Khumalo, uthe: "Abantu abatholi ugesi isikhathi eside, futhi lokho kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezempilo." Ukwaziwa kwalezi zinkinga, iPhalamende lathola iziphakamiso ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Umdlali wezemidlalo, uMnu. Themba Mabuza, uphakamise ukuthi kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. "Kumele sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo, siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi," kusho uMnu. Mabuza. Iphalamende laphinde lavuma ukuthi kudingeka izinhlelo zokuphucula ubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzeka ngogesi. UMsizi Wokuhlinzeka ngogesi, uMnu. Jabu Mthethwa, uthe: "Sizobheka izindlela ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezikhungo zamandla avuselelekayo, ukuze sigweme izinkinga ezinjengalezi esibhekene nazo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziphakamiso zokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi nezinkampani zikhuluma ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. UMsizi Wokubambisana, uNkk. Lindiwe Ngcobo, uthe: "Ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani bungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iPhalamende laphinde lavuma ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zamandla avuselelekayo. UMsizi Wokwakha, uMnu. Thabo Ndaba, uthe: "Sizobheka izindlela eziningi zokwakha izikhungo zamandla, ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi." Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa ukuthi izinhlelo eziphakanyisiwe azizwakali kahle. UMsizi Wezemfundo, uNkk. Palesa Moyo, uthe: "Kumele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, hhayi nje iziphakamiso." Lokhu kuphakamisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngokuphetha, kulalelwa kwePhalamende kukhombisa ukuthi inkinga kagesi ibalulekile futhi idinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Umphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, inkinga kagesi izophinde ibangele izinkinga ezinkulu ezizayo. IPhalamende lizoqhubeka nokulandela lezi zindaba, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola ugesi ophumelelayo.
Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan Ngonyaka ka-2012, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqalisa uhlelo olubalulekile olwaziwa njengeNational Development Plan (NDP). Lolu hlelo lwakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izwe, luhloswe ngokukhulisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuqhubeka kweNDP, kubalulekile ukubheka izigameko ezithile ezihambisana nalesi sihloko. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kweNDP, uhulumeni wahlela izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaphumelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, ezemfundo, nezamabhizinisi. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani ezinkulu zathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, okuholele ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani. Ngonyaka ka-2014, uhulumeni waphinde wakhuluma ngempumelelo yeNDP, lapho kwavulwa khona izikhungo zokufundisa, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abasha. Nokho, izinselelo zaba khona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu besaba ukungabi namathuba afanele. Ngonyaka ka-2016, uhulumeni wahlola impumelelo yeNDP futhi wathola ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile zidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bayathola izinsiza, kwenziwa imizamo yokwakha izikhungo ezikahle zokufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ngonyaka ka-2019, uhulumeni waphinde waphakamisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, lapho kwavulwa amathuba okuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezokwelapha, nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba abantu abaningi baqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathole amathuba emisebenzi. Nokho, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Ukungalingani komnotho, ububha, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, kuqhubeka kube yizinkinga ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2021, uhulumeni wahlola izinhlelo zeNDP futhi wathola ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu bayathola usizo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokudla, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngonyaka ka-2022, uhulumeni waphinde waphakamisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, lapho kwavulwa khona amathuba okuthuthukisa imisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayathola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinga lokungasebenzi lehla kancane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zeNDP ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifanele izidingo zabantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi bahlale bebambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ekupheleni, ukuhlola ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan kukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nezinhlelo, uhulumeni uhlala ezama ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ukuze zifanele izidingo zabantu. Ukuqhubeka kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, ezemfundo, nezamabhizinisi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yeNDP. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP ukuze sifeze umgomo wokwakha izwe elinobulungiswa, elithuthukile, nelinempilo.
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, njengoba zithinta impilo yabantu abadinga usizo lwezokwelapha. E-Gauteng, okuyisifunda esinabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zihlala zihlolwe futhi ziqhathaniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. 1. Ukubaluleka kwezikhathi zokuphendula Izikhathi zokuphendula zisho isikhathi esithathwa yi-ambulensi ukusondela endaweni yokuphuthuma. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izimo eziphuthumayo, njengezingozi zomgwaqo, ukuwa, noma izifo ezinzima, zidinga ukusabela okusheshayo ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okwengeziwe noma ukufa. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula ezisheshayo zingakhuphula amathuba okuphila kwabantu abadinga usizo. 2. Izici ezithinta izikhathi zokuphendula Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zithonywa yizici eziningi, okuhlanganisa: - Ubukhulu besifunda: EGauteng, izindawo ezinamakhaya amaningi nezindawo eziphithizelayo zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhathi zokuphendula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. - Izimo zomgwaqo: Izimo zomgwaqo, njengezikhala, izithiyo, noma izimo zezulu, zingathinta isikhathi sokuhamba kwama-ambulensi. Izimo ezimbi zomgwaqo zingaholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuphendula. - Inani lama-ambulensi: Inani lama-ambulensi atholakalayo endaweni ethile lingenza umehluko omkhulu. Uma kunezimo eziningi eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi esifanayo, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphendula. - Izinsiza ezitholakalayo: Ukuze ama-ambulensi aphendule ngokushesha, kudingeka izinsiza ezifanele, njengabashayeli abaqeqeshiwe, izimoto ezisebenza kahle, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. 3. Izinga lokuphendula e-Gauteng Ngokwezinqubomgomo zempilo, izikhathi zokuphendula ezinhle zidinga ukuba ama-ambulensi aphendule ezimeni eziphuthumayo phakathi kwemizuzu emithathu kuya kwemihlanu. Nokho, e-Gauteng, izikhathi zokuphendula zingahluka kakhulu. Kwezinye izindawo, ama-ambulensi angaphendula ngaphakathi kwemizuzu emibili, kanti kwezinye izindawo, kungathatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla. 4. Ukuhlola izikhathi zokuphendula Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala ziphansi, iziphathimandla zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Uphenyo lwabantu: Ukuqonda izimo ezithinta izikhathi zokuphendula, iziphathimandla zenza uphenyo kubantu abathole usizo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba baqonde izinkinga ezikhona. - Ukuhlola izibalo: Izibalo zokuphendula zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi aphendula ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izikhathi ezithathwa ama-ambulensi ukusondela ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. - Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa: Uma izikhathi zokuphendula zingahambisani nezidingo, iziphathimandla zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphendula. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwandisa inani lama-ambulensi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, noma ukuhlela izindlela ezihamba kahle. 5. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izikhathi zokuphendula Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa: - Ukukhulisa inani lama-ambulensi: Ukwanda kwenani lama-ambulensi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuqeqesha abashayeli: Ukuqeqesha abashayeli ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo kungasiza ekwandiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo zingasiza ekutholeni ama-ambulensi ngokushesha, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukubambisana nezindawo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa umphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangabiza kanjani ama-ambulensi ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Isiphetho Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zikhathi, ukuhlola izibalo, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yabantu ibhekwa ngeso elibukhali, futhi izinsiza zempilo zisebenza kahle ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi.
Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo: Ukubuyekezwa Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zibalulekile ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle nezihlala kahle kubantu. Zihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila, ukuvuselela izindawo ezindala, nokwakha amakhaya anokuthula. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, nezindlela zokuphumelela kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi izici eziningi, njengezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemijondolo emisha, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ugesi, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezikole nezindawo zokudlela. Izinhlelo ezinhle ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo, enokuthula, futhi ethuthukisiwe. Izinzuzo zalezi zinhlelo ziningi. Zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo ezindala, okwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezokwakha nezokuthutha, kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, futhi kukhuphule ukuncintisana kwezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zifaka imihlangano yomphakathi, lapho abantu bebanjwa khona ukuze baphawule ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi banikezwa ithuba lokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo, njengoba izinsiza eziningi zidinga imali eningi, futhi kube nzima ukuthola uxhaso lwezezimali. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye abantu baphumeze izinhlelo zabo, kanti abanye bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Uma umphakathi ungavumelani, izinhlelo zingase zingaphumelelanga. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nezisebenzayo, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali oluqinile. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze baqonde izinqubo zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwazisa phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zikhombisa ukuthi zingaba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokuhlanganyela, baphinde bakhuthaze izinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle ezihlala kahle. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo, zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo. Nokho, izinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuqashelwa ukuze kutholakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo ziya phambili, ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngokuqinile, ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, futhi zihlale ziqhuba izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle ezihlala kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Inqubekela phambili yokuqedwa kwezindlu zangasese zemigodi ezikoleni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikole ezisemigodini ziye zathola ukwesekwa okukhulu ekwakhiweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezindlu zangasese. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezindlini zangasese ezihlanzekile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezindala ezikoleni luhamba phambili, futhi iziphathimandla zikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokufunda. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo ziye zanda, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha ziqhutshelwa phambili. Uhlelo lwezindlu zangasese ezikoleni luhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zangasese ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezihambisana nezidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezimo ezingezinhle. Uhlelo lokwakha luhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuhlola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha, kanye nokuhlela izinsiza zokwakha. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza izinto zokwakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zangasese ezakhiwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezindlini zangasese ezihlanzekile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lokwakha luhamba phambili ezikoleni ezisemigodini, futhi iziphathimandla zikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokufunda. Izikole eziningi ziye zathola izinsiza ezithile ezivela kuhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezimo ezingezinhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikole ezisemigodini ziye zathola ukwesekwa okukhulu ekwakhiweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezindlu zangasese.
