Ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza (streaming platforms) Ngaphakathi kweminyaka engama-20 edlule, umhlaba wezokuxhumana uye waguquka kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwezinkundla zokusakaza. Lezi zinkundla, ezihlanganisa iNetflix, iAmazon Prime Video, iDisney+, nezinye, ziye zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuncintisana phakathi kwalezi zinkundla, kubalulekile ukubheka umlando wazo, izinguquko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezindlela ezahlukene ezisetshenziswa ukuze zihlale zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ukwakhiwa kwezinkundla zokusakaza kuqala ngonyaka ka-2007, lapho iNetflix, eyayiqala njengenkampani yokuhambisa amaDVD, yethula insiza yokusakaza. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavula umnyango omusha wokubuka okuqukethwe. Ngaleso sikhathi, abanye abahlinzeki bokuqala bebelokhu besebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokusakaza, kodwa iNetflix yaphendula ngokushesha, yenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukufinyelela kumafilimu nezinhlelo zethelevishini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNetflix yathola izinzuzo ezinkulu ngenxa yokukhula kwenethiwekhi ye-inthanethi, okwakwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kumakhono ayo. Ngonyaka ka-2013, iNetflix yathola udumo olukhulu ngemuva kokukhulula uchungechunge lwezithombe olwakhiwe kahle, iHouse of Cards. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, kwavula umnyango wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe okwakhiwe ngqo ukuze kudlalwe ku-inthanethi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abanye abahlinzeki bokuqala, njengeHulu neAmazon Prime Video, baqala ukuncintisana ngokuqinile. I-Hulu, eyasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2007, yathola udumo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-serials amasha, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezilandelayo kokubukwayo kwethelevishini. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokukhanga abasebenzisi abathanda ukubuka izinhlelo ezithile ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokulinda isikhathi eside. Ngonyaka ka-2019, iDisney+ yethulwa, yenza umhlaba wezokuxhumana ube nezinselelo ezinkulu. I-Disney, enezimpahla eziningi ezidumile, yaziwa ngokukhiqiza amafilimu nezinhlelo ezithandwa kakhulu, okuhlanganisa iStar Wars neMarvel. Lokhu kwavula umncintiswano omusha, njengoba iDisney+ yathola izigidi zababhalisile ezinsukwini zokuqala zayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathuthukisa izindlela zazo zokukhangisa. Ziqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-algorithms yokuhlola izintandokazi zababhalisile, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhangisa okuqukethwe okufanele. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola okuqukethwe abakuthandayo, futhi kwandisa isikhathi abachitha bejabule kuzo. Nokho, ukuncintisana akupheli lapho. Izinkundla zokusakaza ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile, zifaka izinkanyezi ezidumile, futhi zenza izivumelwano ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngama-serials nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo wokuncintisana, lapho izinkundla zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze zihlale zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathola izinzuzo ezinkulu ngenxa yokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-smartphones nezinye izinsiza ezihambayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukubuka okuqukethwe noma kuphi, noma nini. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabantu ezinkundleni zokusakaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathola izinselelo ezithile, njengokuncintisana okuqinile, izinkinga zokulawulwa kokuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okungavunyelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkundla zihlale ziqaphele izinguquko emakethe, ziqhubeke nokwakha okuqukethwe okusha, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubonakala sengathi ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza kuzoba namandla amakhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izinkundla zizoshesha ukufinyelela kubasebenzisi, ziqhubeke nokwakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubabhalisile. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wezokuxhumana ube nezinselelo ezinkulu, kodwa futhi kuzokwenza kube nezinzuzo ezinkulu kubasebenzisi, njengoba bezokwazi ukufinyelela kumakhono amaningi nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuphetha, ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza kube nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Lezi zinkundla ziye zashintsha indlela abantu abathokozisa ngayo, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhono amaningi, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinkundla zokusakaza zizohlala zikhona, ziqhubeke nokuncintisana, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubasebenzisi.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi ziwumgogodla obalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi ophephile. Lezi zinkundla zifaka phakathi izinhlelo, imithetho, nezinsizakalo ezihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihlanganisiwe. 1. Ukuqonda Izinkundla Zokuphepha Komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zifaka phakathi izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezokuphepha, ezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila ezindaweni eziphephile, futhi banokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga ukuvikeleka, ukwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, nokuba neqhaza elihle emphakathini. 2. Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha Izinsizakalo zokuphepha, ezifana namaphoyisa, zibalulekile ekulawuleni ubugebengu nokuvikela abantu. Amaphoyisa ahlinzeka ngokuqapha, uphiko lokuhlola, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo uma kwenzeka izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa asebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi ukuze akhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. 3. Ukuvikelwa Kwezimali Ukuze izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenze kahle, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimali ezivela kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izabelomali ezanele ezinkundleni zokuphepha. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela umphakathi. 4. Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Umphakathi Ukuqwashisa komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezokuphepha, izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zidingeka ukuze umphakathi uqonde kahle izinkundla zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bangabika kanjani ubugebengu, izindlela zokuzivikela, kanye nokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani ezinsizakalweni uma kudingeka. 5. Ubudlelwano Phakathi Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Nezokwelapha Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izimo eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezingozi noma izigameko, zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo, izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele zibe neqhaza eliqinile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. 6. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zidinga ukubambisana nezikhungo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulezi zinsizakalo. 7. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziywa Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlole nokuhlaziya ukusebenza kwazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphepha, ukubika ubugebengu, kanye nokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela umphakathi. 8. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenza kahle, zikhona izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu, kanye nezimo zomnotho ezinzima. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo, kanye nomphakathi baphendule ngokubambisana. 9. Ukubheka Ikusasa Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokubheka ikusasa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuvikela umphakathi. Ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke uphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkundla zokuphepha zihlale zikhona, zisebenza kahle, futhi zihlale ziqhubeka zithuthukiswa. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze lezi zinkundla zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele. Ngokuqonda izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuqwashisa komphakathi, nokuhlola ukusebenza, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila ezindaweni eziphephile.
Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Imijondolo 1. Isingeniso Imijondolo iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhiqiza kakhulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lempilo nokuphila kwabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imijondolo ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi samanje nezesikhathi esizayo. 2. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Le nqqubo yokuthuthukisa imijondolo ibhekene nezinhlelo, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlinzekwe ukufinyelela ezimweni ezinhle zokuhlala. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zingoziwa ngezidingo zendawo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimiso zokuhlala ezifanele. 3. Izinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zinezinto eziningi ezibalulekile: - Ukuhlinzeka indawo ephumelelayo yokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo ihlangabezana nezidingo zokuphepha. - Ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphila eziphusile nezokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. 4. Uhlelo Lokusebenza Ukuze le nqobo ibe yimpumelelo, kudingeka uhlelo lokusebenza olunembile oluzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukubambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. - Ukuhlelwa kwezinsiza zezimali ukuze kutholakale uxhaso lwezimali. - Ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala emijondolo ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle. 5. Ukubandakanywa Kwemiphakathi Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibenengxenye ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo. Ukubandakanywa kwemiphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezintweni ezidingekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukwamukelwa kwezinhlelo, nokwakha umqondo wokubambisana. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono yabantu abahlala emijondolo. - Ukusungulwa kwemihlangano yokubambisana. - Ukuxhumana ngokuqondile phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bendawo. 6. Ukuxhaswa Kwemali Ukuze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka imithombo ethile yokuxhaswa kwemali. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni. - Ukuthola uxhaso olubhalwe phansi. - Ukubambisana nezinkampani ezingase zibe nezinhloso ezihlangene. 7. Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Ukuze uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile zokuhlala, ukuvikela izinsiza, nokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi. 8. Ukubeka Phambili Izidingo Zomphakathi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zibe nokuqondisa okuphelele kwezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Ukubeka phambili izidingo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. 9. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kufanele kube: - Ukuhlolwa okwenziwa minyaka yonke. - Ukuhlaziywa kwemiphumela yokuphila kwabantu. - Ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi izinhlelo ziyaqhubeka zisebenza ngokuphumelelayo. 10. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nowanelisayo. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, kudingeka ukubambisana okuphelele phakathi kwabaholi bendawo, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo, kulethe inhlalakahle nokuthula kubantu bonke abahlala kulezi zindawo. 11. Ukubhaliswa Nokuxhumana Imiphakathi ivunyelwe ukufaka imibono nezicelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo kuhulumeni ukuze kuhanjiswe izidingo ezithile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana eqondile, ngempela kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zendawo. 12. Izinsiza Zokuqhuba Ukuze sithuthukise le nqobo, sinezinsiza ezithile ezibandakanya: - Izikhungo zokuqeqesha. - Amathuluzi okuxhumana. - Izinsiza zokufinyelela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo ziyaphumelela, zigcine abantu bethu bephila kahle. 13. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemiyalelo Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zinikeze imiyalelo ecacile nezinyathelo ezithile ezizodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezimisele ukufeza izinjongo ezibekwe. 14. Uhlaka Lwezomthetho Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imijondolo lufanele luhambisane nemithetho nemigomo efanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo iyavikeleka futhi iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizobhekana nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthuthukisa imijondolo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele lube yisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwezindawo ezisempilweni.
Izinkulumo zomthetho eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseMkhumbane uhlela umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nezinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lo mcimbi, obubanjelwe emnyangweni wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, wawuhloselwe ukudala ithuba lokuxoxa, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngemicabango phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, izikhulu zikamasipala, kanye nezazi zomthetho. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo kaMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wesifunda, owakhumbuza bonke abebekhona ngobaluleka kokuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezindabeni zokuthathwa komhlaba. Uthe, “Ukuthathwa komhlaba akuyona into elula; kudinga ukucabangela izimpilo zabantu, izinsiza, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi.” Ngemuva kwalokho, izazi zomthetho zabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsiza zomthetho ezikhona eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba. UProf. Zanele Khumalo, ongumlawuli wezifundo eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, waphawula ngokuqonda okubalulekile kokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba. Uthe, “Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba awuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa ungumthombo wezimpilo zethu.” Umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abanikazi bomhlaba, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. UMsizi Mkhize, ongumholi weqembu labanikazi bomhlaba, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Uthe, “Siyazama ukuvikela amalungelo ethu, kodwa imithetho ibonakala ingasithathi kahle. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi singazithola kanjani izixazululo eziphumelelayo.” Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, kwaba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba babelane ngemibono yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpikiswano ezinzima, kodwa eziphumelelayo, mayelana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imithetho yokuthathwa komhlaba. Abanye babebonisa ukukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabantu abathintekayo, kanti abanye baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubuyisela umhlaba kubanikazi bawo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokwazisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo. Izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana ne-Advocacy Group for Land Rights, zabelana ngemininingwane yokuthi abantu bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zomthetho uma bephikisana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonakale uphumelele ekwakheni indawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, okuhlanganisa iziphathimandla, izazi, kanye nomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuxoxa lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwabelana ngemicabango, futhi lwenze kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinqubo zomthetho ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, ubonisa ukuthi izinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuxoxwa ngokujulile, futhi zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Umphakathi ubonise isifiso sokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi ezithuthukisa izimo zokuphila zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela efanele. Umcimbi ubonisa ukuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi elithuthukisa umphakathi wonke. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlaba, njengomthombo wezimpilo, uhlonishwa futhi uvikelwe.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukugxila kulezi zinhlelo. Le ndawo, enezinsiza zemvelo eziningi, ibonisa izidingo zethu zokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelinobulungiswa. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angaba yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, njengezinhlelo zamandla elanga, amanzi, kanye namandla omoya, ezihlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu akwandisi amathuba emisebenzi kuphela, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basendaweni bayakwazi ukuziphilisa. ENyakatho Kapa, lapho umnotho ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angase abe yisixazululo esihle sokukhuthaza ukukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, la mandla ahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokunciphisa imithelela emibi yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo awakhulisi umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa futhi anciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa, okuqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zinezinsiza ezihlanzekile. Ngokubheka izinhlelo ezithile, sinesibonelo esihle sephrojekthi ye-‘Solar Water Heater’ ehlanganisa izindlu eziningi, esize abantu banciphise izindleko zokushisa amanzi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekongeni imali, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umqondo wokuzimela. Uma abantu bekwazi ukwenza izinto zabo, bayakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene namaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo, njengezindleko zokuqala eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabaxhasi benze izinhlelo zokuxhasa ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele kubantu abaningi eNyakatho Kapa kungaba yinkinga. Abantu badinga ukuqonda kabanzi ngalezi zinhlelo ukuze bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi, okuzobasiza ukuba babe yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi amaphrojekthi ahlangane nezidingo zomphakathi, okukhombisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo, abahlinzeki, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze amaphrojekthi aphumelele, kudingeka ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bazi ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa. Ngibona ikusasa elikhanyayo eNyakatho Kapa, lapho amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo azoba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho, ekunciphiseni umthelela emvelweni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Umphakathi onamandla ungakha izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nezinkinga zethu. Ngakho-ke, ngiyabiza bonke abathintekayo, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nabantu bendawo, ukuba baphokophele ekwakheni amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinobulungiswa. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa akuyona nje indlela yokuthola amandla, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Masiphokophele lezi zinhlelo ukuze sibe neNyakatho Kapa engcono.
Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini Embhalweni wethu, sizoxoxa ngendaba ebucayi ehlobene nezimayini, ikakhulukazi ukuqonda izingxoxo zamaholo kulomkhakha. Imboni yezimayini ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emazweni ahluphekayo, njengoba kudlalwa indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasemithonjeni yokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, le mboni ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinkinga ezingokwenhlalakahle, ezemisebenzi, nokumarhambo okuhamba phambili kwezomnotho. I. Ukuqonda Uhlelo Lwamaholo Amaholo embonini yezimayini awelapheki kuphela kumazinga ezinga eliphakeme, kodwa ahlola futhi imithetho esebenzayo kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi. Ukuqonda imithetho ihlukanisa ukuthengiselana phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu abasebenza emathunjini. Ukucwaninga kulokhu kudinga ukuqonda izindlela ezahlukene eziwusizo, okuhlanganisa: 1. Umehluko Wamaholo: Izingxoxo zamaholo zihluke ngokuya ngezigaba zabantu abasebenza eminyakeni yabo yokuhlangenwe nakho, izinga lemfundo, nezinhlobo zomsebenzi abawenzayo. Abalimi, owayebhunywa, kanye nomele abakhokhelwayo bonke banelungelo lokukhuluma nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bahola kahle. 2. Izimpawu Zokuthengisa: Okwamaphuzu amakhulu wokukhuluma ngokwamaholo, izimpawu eziphakeme zizonke zidinga ukucaciswa. Lokhu kungase kubandakanye izinkokhelo ezihambisana nemizamo ethile yokuvikeleka emsebenzini noma ezokuvikela, okubalulekile ekukhangiseni umsebenzi. 3. Iziqinisekiso Nezivumelwano: Ukuxhumana phakathi komqashi nomsebenzi kubhalwa ngezivumelwano. Lezi zivumelwano ngokuvamile ziqukethe imikhawulo yemiholo, izinzuzo, nezimo ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zikhala zokusebenza. II. Ukufunda Ngobusuku Nezithiyo Ezikhona Ukwenza ukusondela okuphezulu emiholweni yemboni yezimayini, siyazithola izithiyo ezihambelanayo. Kanjalo, izikhathi zokuqulwa kwezimali zehluka. Kuhlolwe uhulumeni kulezi zinto, ukuze kunqunywe ukuhuqhalwa kwemithombo yokuvikela ababambiqhaza. Lokhu kubheka: 1. Uhlanga Lwemali: Izimo zomkhakha wezomnotho zibalulekile ekubhalweni kwezingxoxo zokukhuluma ngenhla sindsokolela imiholo. Uma umnotho usubanda, kuholela ekwenzeni kubuhlungu ukuba umqashi avumele imiholo ethile. Izingxoxo ezingathandani ziholela ekutheni abaqashi bangamasheya abe khona ukuze bathole umkhankaso. 2. Izimangaliso, Ubufakazi, Nezinyathelo: Amathuba emisebenzi avame ukuncipha, ikakhulu ngenxa yokwahla kwemali. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga kumazinga ahlotshaniswa nejenerali yemboni. Sicela ubuhlakani obuhlanganisa izinkinga zezishiyagalombili ezidinga ukuvuleka ukuze ziqhutshelwe phambili. III. Izinsiza Zokwenza Ucwaningo Ekuqaleni kokucwaninga ngaphakathi kwemboni, kube kuhle ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze kuqondwe izimo zamaholo. Lokhu kuzoba nenzuzo elungile kulwazi olunikeziwe nabantu ababamba iqhaza kulomkhakha. Izinsiza ezidingekayo zihlanganisa: 1. Inhloranhlaka yamaholo: Kudingeka ukufunda ngamaholo abaqashi ngemali ehlanga ngalinye ukuze kuhlonishwe izinga lenhlonipho ezandleni zeziguli nezimo. 2. Ukwethulwa Kwezinto Eziqondisayo: Abacwaningi badinga ukwenza ucwaningo maqondana nezimo ezithinta izimayini, njengezinga lokuphepha, izikhungo zokuhlonza, nezinsiza zempilo zisebenze kahle. 3. Izivakashi Nezivumelwano: Ukuhlolwa kokusebenza kumaholo kudinga ukusondela eziqinisekisweni ezikhona. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzodingeka ukuthi kube nemigomo yokuqinisekisa, ebonakalayo noma ewusizo. IV. Uqhudelana Kulomkhakha Abantu abavela embonini yezimayini bahlakulela uqhudelana omkhulu phakathi kwemali, nezinsiza, ukunikezwa koThrottle, kanye nezifundo, noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Uqhudelana okukhuluma ngezingxoxo zamaholo kudinga ukucabangela ubuchwepheshe obufanele lokho okukhuthaza amabhrandi. 1. Iziqinisekiso Zokusebenza: Ukuhlola okwaziyo kokusebenza okukhona ungabona imikhuba emisha esebenzayo. Lokhu kuhola ekuqinisekiseni ngemali ephansi yokuthola izinzuzo ezikhangayo, lapho abasebenzi begxila ekwakheni okokusebenza komnotho. 2. Ukuhlawulwa Kwamaholo: Ukuqonda indlela yokuhlawulwa kokukhuluma kule mboni kwenza kube nzima ukuvumelana nokuhlangana kwemali nezinzuzo. V. Isiphetho Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini luhlobene neqhaza elikhulu lokuhlola izinkinga ezivelelayo. Ukwazi ukujula kulesi simo kubalulekile ukuze kahle kufanele uxhaso kanye nezinsizakalo ezithile. Umsebenzi ohlakaniphile kulomkhakha uhlola kahle izimo zayo zezimali, ahlola nokuthola izingxoxo zokusebenza. Lokhu kusebenza kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezinamandla, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni le mboni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nocwaningo, ukuze sikhethu amathemba amaningi ezintathu ezikhona emhlabeni wezokuphepha, ukuphepha kwabantu komkhathi, nemisebenzi ebhekelele ukuthuthukiswa kwemboni yezimayini. Ngalokhu, sizokwazi ukufaka isandla ekukholweni ukufinyelela kwesizayo esikahle.
Izifundo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini Kusukela kumakhono okuphila kwabantu, emalokishini aphesheya kwenyakatho ye-Afrika, ubuhle bokubambisana nomqondo wokwakha amabhizinisi siqu kude kwazise, kungaziwa. Izifundo ezenzakalayo ezitholakala phakathi kwalezi zindawo, zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala emalokishini bavele banamandla, baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo, nakuba beziphila ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kuhamba phambili kube nemiphumela eminingi, higlazisa ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavela emalokishini, abafundisile uxolo, ubuhlakani, nokuqamba. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abagibeli be-Taxi nezokuthutha ezintsha babebambe izintambo zezezimali emalokishini. Phakathi neminyaka yokokubusa kwe-apartheid, abantu abaningi babezithola bedinga izinsizakusebenza eziyisisekelo, izimpahla, nezinye izidingo. Ukuze bazigcine, kwabakhona abavula amabhizinisi amancane, ngaphandle kokuxhaswa nguhulumeni, ukuze baphathe amakhasimende futhi baziqhenye ngalokho abakwenza. Izifundo zabo zakhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bangempela buvela ngaphakathi kwezimo ezinzima. UMichael “Sizwe” Ndlovu, ungomunye wabantu abavela emalokishini abezenza isibonelo sokuphumelela. U-Ndlovu waqala umsebenzi wakhe emhlabeni wezimoto, ewina ikhefi ngokuqoqa imali kancane emalini. Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo nokubamba izimota ezindala, ezemoto eziyinqaba zashintsha pungwe imibono emisha yokuthi abantu bangaba nosizo lwezithuthi emalokishini. Ubuqotho nokuqamba kwakhe kuye kwaholela ekukhuleni kwenani labantu abaqala ukwenza izinkampani zabo zokuthutha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sashintsha izinkanyezi zempumelelo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavamile ukuba nemibono eqondile. Njengoba abantu baphila bejolise ezingeni lokuphila elijwayelekile, izinto baziheha ngezinhloso ezicacile. UPhindile Mthembu, kwazise uyinxusa lendawo, waba ngonoya eqhelisile obaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umnotho oyindlunkulu emalokishini. Wavula ibhizinisi elincane lokudayisa ukudla ukuze ahlinzeke abantu abahamba-mgodi. Imiqondo yezezimali nemigomo ayekungeniswe emalokishini nayo yahola ekuphuhliseni izitolo ezincane ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo yendawo. Abantu banikela isikhathi, basebenzisa amakhono amaningi anothi, ukwenza imikhiqizo efana nezithako zezindawo zomdabu. Lokhu kwaba ukuhlaziywa okukhangayo nolimi lokukhuthaza olunempumelelo. Njengoba amabhizinisi emalokishini eqhubeka nokukhula, abanikazi bangabantu abaphuma ezinkampanini ezinkulu zaphesheya. Izifundo zabo zifundisa ukuthi abantu bangakhulisa izinkampani zabo uma behlakanipha ekuxhumaneni, befunda ezicini ezihlukahlukene. umkhiqizo, ukuphatha impahla, nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu amancane. Izifundo zabasunguli bamabhizinisi babukeka zingaphezulu kwezifundo – bezibophezela emiphakathini yabo, behlinzeka ngemisebenzi, futhi begcizelela umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphezu kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kunemihlangano eyenzeka phakathi kwabantu abathile, eyakhayo izinkampani zamabhizinisi amaningi. Uma uDudu Khoza ethola indlela yokwenza imali, uqala ukuba nemali ngokubambisana nabanye abantu emkhakheni wezokwakha. Ubuqotho bakhe bugqugquzela abanye ukuba baphinde badlale ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokubambisana. Lokhu kudalula amandla uzinzo lwemfundo kanye nemfundo yokuphila kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwesimo sezezimali esinzima sokubhekana nakho, abanikazi bamabhizinisi emalokishini basebenzisa amandla abawathola emiphakathini yabo, baphinde bezama ukufundisa abazukulwana ngezindlela zokusebenza ezihlakaniphe. Ngezinye izikhathi, nakuba behlupheka, banemibono emisha engamaqhugwana ezinhle neziqu zokuqonda. Umanyano lwabantu oluhle luholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, owaziyo ukuthi ukwakha akusilo ukungena kuphela emabhizinisini, kodwa nokuqhubeka nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Umlando wabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini ubonisa indlela imiqondo kaNkulunkulu nayo nebhadi elingakaze lishiye izikhumbuzo zempumelelo. Umsebenzi wabo ugcina uhlanga lwezimo, umoya wempumelelo, nomcabango omuhle wokuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi banelungelo lokwakha izimfanelo zabo. Eminyakeni ezayo, izifundo zabo zizoqhubeka nokukhanya, zikhombisa amandla emphakathini, okuholela kumphakathi okhula kahle, omunyu anempela emisha yezezimali emalokishini. Okwamanje, sikhumbula ukuthi abavulandi bemabhizinisi emalokishini ababevelanga kuphela embhalweni, kodwa baphinde babhala izinkanyezi zempumelelo emlandweni wethu. Izifundo zabo zikhuthaza ukukhula kwezimali nemiphakathi emihle. Bayazama, bawina futhi basaphila ngamabomu - baziqhenya nge-legacy yabo, behlola izinjongo eziphakeme ngenxa yomlingo wekuqhubeka. Lokhu kudala umnyango futhi kubaluleke emlandweni wabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini.
Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, uhulumeni wendawo wethule imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala, ebonisa izinga lokuphathwa kwezimali ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlolwa kwenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi kubonise ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Uhlolo lwenziwe ezindaweni ezingama-30, lapho abahloli bejolise khona ekubhekeni izincwadi zezimali, izinkokhelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwenziwa ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulayo ngokuqhubeka kokungabi nezezimali ezanele emiphakathini ethile, kanye nezikhalazo ezivela kubantu mayelana nokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. UNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, umsizi weMnyango Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali, uveze ukuthi imiphumela ibonisa izindawo ezithile eziphumelele kakhulu, kanti ezinye zidinga ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu. Uthe, "Siyajabula ukuthi ezinye izindawo zikhombisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo." Izindawo eziphumelele kakhulu zifaka phakathi iMasipala waseThekwini, owathola izinga eliphezulu lokuphathwa kwezimali, kanti izinhlelo zokwakha izikole nezikhungo zezempilo zikhombisa impumelelo enkulu. Uhlolo lukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezibekwe phambili zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhuthaza abanye masipala ukuba bazame ukufunda kulokhu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindawo ezifana neMasipala waseMkhanyakude zikhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu. Uhlolo lukhombisa ukuthi izincwadi zezimali azihambisani nezinga elidingekayo, okwaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. UMasipala waseMkhanyakude ubhekene nezikhalazo eziningi ezivela kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, abathi izinsiza ezifana namanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha azitholakali ngendlela efanele. Uhlolo lwamabhuku komasipala luhlose ukwakha isithombe esicacile sokuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa kanjani, futhi luhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Uhlolo lwenziwa ngamaqembu ahlukene, okubandakanya abahloli bezimali, abamele izakhamuzi, kanye nochwepheshe bezokuphathwa kwezimali, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela ibonisa kahle isimo sangempela.
Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery Isingeniso Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubalulekile ekuqondeni intuthuko yesikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela eNingizimu Afrika. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela esizothuthukisa umnotho, sikhuthaze ukusimama kwemithombo yezobuchwepheshe, futhi sinikeze amathuba ohwebo. Imigomo eyinhloko yalesi sikhungo ibonisa ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, imisebenzi, nokunciphisa ukuncika ezimakethe zangaphandle. Umkhankaso Wokuqala Uhlelo lokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery lwaqala ngonyaka ka-2010, lapho abaqalayo behlongoza ukwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela endaweni yeMthombo, enyakatho yeNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhambisana nomgomo kahulumeni wokwandisa ukukhiqiza kwendawo, kugqugquzelwe imisebenzi kwezokwakha, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi kuzodingeka ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ngohwebo lwamafutha. Izinhloso ezihlukahlukene zalesi sikhungo zifaka ukukhula kwemikhiqizo, ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yezolimo, nokwakha amathuba obuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kudingeka ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu, okuhlanganisa izinkampani zomphakathi, ezemisebenzi, nezokwakha. Inqubo Yokwakha Ngemuva kokuthola indawo efanele, kwenziwa ucwaningo lobuchwepheshe kanye nezifundo zokuhlola umthelela kwemvelo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwemigomo emisha yokwakha nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazokwenza kube nokuphumelela okukhulu. Uhlelo lokulwa nezingozi lwenziwa, lwamukela izindlela zokuphepha, ukuhlolwa kwemvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhathalela impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, ukwanda kwezidingo, kanye nezimfuno ezishintshashintshayo. Nokho, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabahlinzeki bezinsiza, abaphathi, kanye nohulumeni baphumelele ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela emihle. Izifundo Zokucatshangelwa Phakathi nesikhathi sokwakha, izifundo ezibalulekile zitholakele, okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zalesi sikhungo. Lezi zifundo zifaka phakathi: 1. Ubudlelwano: Kubalulekile ukuba nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zabo. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezimali zisetshenziswa kahle ukuze iphrojekthi iphumelele. 3. Ukuphathwa Kwenhlalakahle: Ukuxhumana nezinhlaka zempilo yomphakathi ukuze imithetho yokwakha ihlale ilungile. Ukuqukethwe Kwenqubo Yokusebenza Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery izobe iyinqubo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuhambisana namazinga aphezulu okuphepha, yize izinhlelo zokuphatha zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngemva kokwakhiwa, kuzodingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokugcina izinto ziphephile, kulungiswe izindleko, futhi kusetshenziswe izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Imiphumela Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery izoba nemiphumela emikhulu, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukukhulisa Umnotho: Ukwakha imisebenzi emisha. 2. Ukwanda Kwezimali: Ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. 3. Ukwandiswa Kwamathuba: Ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba obuchwepheshe. 4. Ukulethwa Kwenoveli: Ukwenza izinqubomgomo zokuxhasa ubuchwepheshe. 5. Ukuphathwa Kokuphepha: Ukwenza izinqubomgomo eziphephile. Isiphetho Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery uyindida ebanzi ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, nabathintekayo kufanele baqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla, kuhlangane nemiphumela elindelekile yokwakha isithuthukisi sooyela. Imiphumela emihle yephrojekthi izoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ubuchwepheshe, nezemisebenzi. Uhlelo lokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery luhlala luhlola izinkundla zokuphathwa nezokwakha ibhizinisi elibambisene, okusiza ezikhathini ezizayo.
Ngiyavuma, akukho okukhuluma ngakho. Izimo eziphathelene ne-cybersecurity kumasipala ziya ziba zinkulu, futhi zidinga ukubhekwa. Ngabe ucabangani, abantu abaningi bazi kahle yini i-cybersecurity? Ngikholelwa ukuthi akukhona, ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngamasipala. Ungakubona kanjani lokhu? Umkhandlu wezamasipala uthola uhlelo lokusebenza olusha, kodwa bahluleka ukuvikela idatha yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bangene kuzo zonke izinhlelo, bathathe idatha, basuse imali, noma baphule imithetho. Lokhu kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngedatha yomphakathi. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhona. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi i-cyberattack ingaba yingozi kangakanani? Ngicabanga ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zomphakathi zingase zibe sengozini. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Futhi, akukhona ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu kuphela ezithola ukuhlaselwa. Nakamasipala, izinsizakalo ezifana nokuthengwa kwemithi, imfundo, nezokuthutha zidinga ukuvikela idatha yazo. Uma umphakathi ungavikeleki, lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphumelele, futhi lokhu akukuhle. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise ulwazi lwethu ngalezi zinto. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi i-cybersecurity ayiyona into yokudlala. Uma ungavikela idatha yakho, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zingathuthukiswa kanjani? Kukhona izindlela ezilula, njengokusebenzisa amaphasiwedi aqinile, ukuvuselela izinhlelo, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kubantu abangafunwa ukuba bangenise izinhlelo. Futhi, umphakathi kufanele ube nezinhlaka ezithile zokuphepha. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi uma umphakathi ungathathi izinyathelo, izingozi ziya ziba zinkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kusebenza kanjani? Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingasiza ukuvimbela izingozi. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni i-cybersecurity? Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu uma sikhuluma ngamasipala. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukuvikela idatha yazo ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngedatha, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala ziphephile. Uma ungathathi izinyathelo, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde izingozi ezihambisana ne-cybersecurity. Uma abasebenzi beqonda kahle, bazokwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo. Futhi, abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi izingozi zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kusebenza kanjani? Uma umphakathi ungavikeleki, izingozi ziya ziba zinkulu. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi i-cybersecurity ingaba yinkinga enkulu uma ungayithathi seriously? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uphephile. Uma ungathathi izinyathelo, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise ulwazi lwethu ngalezi zinto. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi i-cybersecurity ayiyona into yokudlala. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezitholakele. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi i-cyberattack yezehlakalo ze-cybersecurity ingaba yingozi kangakanani? Ngicabanga ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo zomphakathi zingase zibe sengozini. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uphephile. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zingathuthukiswa kanjani? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni i-cybersecurity? Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu uma sikhuluma ngamasipala. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala ziphephile. Uma ungathathi izinyathelo, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde izingozi ezihambisana ne-cybersecurity. Uma abasebenzi beqonda kahle, bazokwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izingozi zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uphephile.
