Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi 1. Ukuqonda Imisakazo Yomphakathi Imisakazo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, unomoya ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano. Lezi ziteshi zihlala ziqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Nokho, ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluqinile nolwakhiwe kulolu hlobo lwemisakazo kubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. 2. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 2.1 Uk缺乏 Imali Yokuxhasa Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nemisakazo yomphakathi uk缺乏 imali yokuxhasa. Imithombo yokuxhaswa, efana nezibonelelo zikahulumeni, izinkampani, nabantu ngabanye, ibalulekile ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngeso lengqondo eliqinile. Ukuze imisakazo iqhubeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthola uxhaso olunzulu. 2.2 Ukwehluka Kwezithameli Imisakazo yomphakathi ivame ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ifinyelele ezithamelini ezahlukene. Nokho, ukuhlelwa kwemibhalo yohlelo kuhlale kube inselelo. Ukuze imisakazo ifinyelele impumelelo, kufanele iqonde izidingo nezifiso zezakhamuzi ezihlukene. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza eziningi nezazi ezinezifundo ezithile. 2.3 Izinkinga Zobuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengesikhumbuzo esibalulekile ekwakheni imisakazo yokuphila. Nokho, izinkinga ezinjengokwehla kwezinga lokuxhumana, ukungena kwenethiwekhi, kanye nezinsiza ezindala kwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukile. Ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kudingeka izinsiza ezithuthukile nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. 2.4 Ukuncintisana Nokuhlonza Umkhiqizo Imisakazo yomphakathi ibhekene nokuncintisana okuqinile emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Iziteshi ezizimele, iziteshi zikamasipala, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele zifuna ukuheha izithameli. Lokhu kudinga imisakazo yomphakathi ukuba ibekezelele ukuziphendulela, ithuthukise izinhlelo zayo, futhi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ehlukile. 3. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Ukukhulisa uxhaso lwezimali kudinga ukuhlela kahle imikhankaso yokuthola uxhaso. Imisakazo kufanele ibambisane nezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, ezinkampanini, nasemiphakathini, ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo ezixhasayo kuzosisiza ekwenzeni imisakazo iqhubeke. 3.2 Ukuhlola Nezinhlelo Zokuthola Ababukeli Ukuze imisakazo ithuthuke, kufanele iqonde izidingo zababukeli bayo. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokuhlola izifiso zabo, ukubamba izinkulumo, noma ukwenza ucwaningo ngemibono yokubuka. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe izinhlelo ezihambisanayo nezidingo zomphakathi. 3.3 Ukuvuselela Ubuchwepheshe Ukuze imisakazo iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi ivuselele ubuchwepheshe bayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemishini, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezithuthukile ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono. Ukuze kubonakale, imisakazo kufanele ibambisane nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe ukuze ihlinzeke ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. 3.4 Ukukhuthaza Umkhiqizo Imisakazo yomphakathi kufanele ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ehlukile ukuze ikwazi ukuheha izithameli. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ukunika izikhala zokuxhumana, nokwakha izikhangiso ezithakazelisayo. Ukuze umfutho uqhubeke, kudingeka ukuthi imisakazo ibonise izinzuzo eziningi kumphakathi. 4. Isiphetho Imisakazo yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, futhi izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nayo zidinga ukuthi zenziwe izinyathelo eziphusile. Ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthola uxhaso, ukuhlola izidingo zababukeli, ukuvuselela ubuchwepheshe, nokukhuthaza umkhiqizo. Ngokubambisana, imisakazo yomphakathi ingaqhubeka nokukhula, ihlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo, futhi ibe yinsika ebalulekile emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, kwamukelekile ukuba kubhekwane nezinselelo ezikhona, kwenziwe imizamo yokwenza imisakazo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni nasemphakathini jikelele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kwezimali, ekwandeni kwezithameli, nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo.
Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) Q: Yini i-Life Esidimeni arbitration? A: I-Life Esidimeni arbitration iyinqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano eziphathelene nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo ezihlinzekwa yi-Life Esidimeni, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokudlula kweziguli eziningi ezazitholakala ezikhungweni zabo. Le nqubo yenzelwe ukuvumela abathintekayo ukuthi bathole ukulungiswa nokubuyiselwa kwezindleko. Q: Yiziphi izizathu eziholele ekubeni kube ne-arbitration? A: Izizathu eziholele ekubeni kube ne-arbitration zifaka phakathi ukunganeliseki kwabazali nezihlobo zeziguli, izikhalazo ezivela ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezazihlinzekwa yi-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinsolo zokungabi nekhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Q: Yiziphi imiphumela eyavela kule nqubo yokulamula? A: Imiphumela yokulamula ibonakale ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abathintekayo bathole izinxephezelo ezithile, okukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukuthatha umthwalo wezinto ezenzakalayo. Okwesibili, le nqubo yaphinde yakhuthaza izinguquko ezinkulu ezinhlelweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Q: Yiziphi izinguquko ezenziwe emkhakheni wezempilo ngenxa yokulamula? A: Ngemuva kokulamula, kube nezinguquko eziningi emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemigomo emisha yokunakekelwa, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi izikhungo zokunakekelwa zihlola izinga lekhwalithi, kanye nokwandiswa kwemithombo yokuxhasa iziguli. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola izinsizakalo eziphezulu. Q: Ubufakazi obuphumelele kanjani kule nqubo? A: Ubufakazi buphumelele kakhulu kule nqubo, njengoba abathintekayo bakwazi ukuveza izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ubufakazi beziguli ezithole ubuhlungu, izikhalazo ezivela kubazali, kanye nezincwadi ezivela kubachwepheshe bezempilo. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Q: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakele kule nqubo? A: Izifundo ezitholakele zifaka phakathi ukubaluleka kokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zokunakekelwa neziguli, ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kungasiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu. Q: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinguquko zisebenza kanjani? A: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinguquko zisebenza kahle bukhona ezibuyekezeni ezitholwe ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi iziguli zikhuluma kahle ngempilo yazo, futhi zikhona izinhlelo zokuhlola ezithuthukisiwe ezisiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa. Q: Yini okumele yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziqhubeka? A: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuhlola, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zokunakekelwa neziguli. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Q: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwempilo? A: Izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwempilo zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemithombo, ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lezi zinto zingathinta ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa okukhuluma ngakho. Q: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani? A: Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zikhuluma kahle ngempilo yeziguli. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezenziwe zikhuthaza iziguli ukuba zibe nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo? A: Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuhlola, ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze uhulumeni ukuze aqinisekise izinsizakalo ezinhle? A: Uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi kunezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola izikhungo zokunakekelwa, aqinise imithetho yokunakekelwa, futhi ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze i-Life Esidimeni ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo? A: I-Life Esidimeni kufanele iqhubeke nokuhlola izinqubomgomo zayo, iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwe kahle, futhi ibambisane nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uqhubeke nokuxhasa iziguli? A: Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa iziguli, ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngamafuphi, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zingatholakala uma abantu bephendula ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, uhulumeni, nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Izinhlelo ze-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinhlaka zikamasipala, izikhungo zikahulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluphumelelayo, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Nokho, lapho lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, umthelela ungaba mubi kakhulu. Kulokhu, sizobheka umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphathwa kwemithombo. Okokuqala, umthelela wezomnotho ungaba mkhulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo ezinjengokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izinhlelo zokukhokha, nezokuphathwa kwemali zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba kahle. Uma lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle, zinciphisa izindleko, zandisa ukuhweba, futhi zenza kube lula ukuphathwa kwemali. Kodwa uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, izindleko zikhula, izinkampani ziba nezinkinga zokuhamba, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinkampani zinciphe imisebenzi, zinciphise abasebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omubi emnothweni jikelele. Okwesibili, ezokuxhumana ziba yinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo ezithinta ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase bangatholi ulwazi oludingekayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhalazo, nokwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu. Okwesithathu, ukuphathwa kwemithombo kuyinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuphatha imithombo, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo, zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo iyasetshenziswa kahle. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, imithombo ingase ingasetshenziswanga kahle, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, njengoba imithombo ingase ingafinyeleli ezindaweni ezidinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokungathembeki. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase baphendule ngokungathembeki, okungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka emiphakathini, uma abantu bengakholwa ekutheni izinhlelo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo, njengoba abantu bangase baphendule ngokungafuni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, izinsizakalo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana, zingase zingatholakali. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokunganeliseki kwabantu, okungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka emiphakathini. Izinsizakalo ezibalulekile zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphathwa kwemithombo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba kahle, abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi umnotho uthuthuke. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza, ukuhlela, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA, okuzoholela ekwenzeni ngcono impilo yabantu kanye nomnotho jikelele.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo 1. Isingeniso Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo sekuyinkinga enkulu ethinta impilo yomphakathi. Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezidingo ezinkulu zezempilo, kodwa ukungabi khona kodokotela abanele kuholela ekutheni abantu bangatholi usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Le ndatshana izobheka izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. 2. Izimbangela zokushoda kodokotela Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kudalwa yizizathu eziningi: - Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza: Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezinsiza ezincane, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo eziphansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha odokotela. - Izimo zokusebenza: Odokotela abaningi bakhetha ukusebenza ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni ngenxa yezimo zokusebenza ezinhle, okuhlanganisa nezikhala ezinhle zokuhlala, izinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye namathuba okukhula emsebenzini. - Izinkinga zokuhamba: Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezinkinga zokuhamba, okwenza kube nzima kubodokotela ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. - Imiholo ephansi: Imiholo yodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya ivame ukuba phansi uma iqhathaniswa nezindawo ezisemadolobheni, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha abanolwazi. 3. Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya kunezimpempe ezinzima: - Ukungatholi usizo lwezempilo: Abantu basemakhaya bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi zempilo, kodwa ngenxa yokushoda kodokotela, abakwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, okuholela ekwandeni kwezifo. - Ukwehla kwezinga lempilo: Ukungabi khona kodokotela kuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lempilo, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu basemakhaya baphila impilo engaphansi. - Ukukhula kwezindleko zezempilo: Abantu abangenayo imitholampilo ethile badinga ukuya emadolobheni ukuze bathole usizo, okukhuphula izindleko zokuhamba nokwelashwa. - Ukukhula kwezifo ezithathelwanayo: Ukungabi khona kodokotela kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwanayo, njengoba abantu behlangana bezama ukuthola usizo. 4. Izixazululo Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile: - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezikhungweni zezempilo zasemakhaya, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zokuhlala ezinhle kubodokotela. - Ukukhuthaza odokotela ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemakhaya: Uhulumeni angasebenzisa izikhuthazo ezifana nemiholo eyengeziwe, izikhala zokuhlala ezinhle, kanye namathuba okuthuthukiswa kwemfundo. - Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba: Ukuze kube lula kubodokotela ukufinyelela ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kudingeka izinhlelo zokuhamba ezithuthukile. - Ukwandisa imfundo ngezempilo: Ukukhuthaza imfundo ngezempilo kubantu basemakhaya kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo zezempilo futhi bakwazi ukuzitholela usizo. 5. Isiphetho Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo kufanele zibe nezinhloso ezicacile zokuthuthukisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, odokotela, kanye nomphakathi bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basemakhaya bathola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, impilo engcono, kanye nokukhula komphakathi.
Izinselelo ze-acid mine drainage eGauteng Umbuzo 1: Yini i-acid mine drainage (AMD)? Impendulo: I-acid mine drainage (AMD) iyinhlangano yamanzi aphumayo ahlanzekile futhi anama-asidi, atholakala lapho umhlaba ophukile uhlangana ne-oxygen ne-hydrogen sulfide. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-asidi, okwenza amanzi abe ne-pH ephansi. I-Acid mine drainage ivame ukwenzeka ezindaweni ezinomsebenzi wezokumbiwa phansi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimayini zamalahle, i-gold, noma amaminerali. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala i-acid mine drainage eGauteng? Impendulo: E-Gauteng, i-acid mine drainage ikhiqizwa ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokumba ezintanjeni zezimayini ze-gold, okuyinto eyenzeka eminyakeni edlule. Lapho lezi zimayini ziqukethwe, ama-minerals agqokile, afana ne-pyrite, ahlangana nomoya, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwe-asidi kanye nezinhlayiya ezimbi ezilandelayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izingozi ze-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: I-acid mine drainage ingaba nemiphumela emibi emithonjeni yemvelo, okufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuncipha kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo: I-asidi ingalimaza izitshalo kunye nezilwane eziphilayo emanzini, kubangela ukuncipha kwezinhlobo eziningi. 2. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi: AMD ithinta amanzi angaphansi komhlaba, ikhulisa amazinga e-heavy metals afana ne-arsenic, lead, ne-cadmium, okuthinta impilo yabantu nezilwane. 3. Ukuphazamiseka kwezinsiza: Izinsiza ezifana namanzi nemifula zingase zibe yingozi kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaphila ezindaweni eziseduze nezimayini. Umbuzo 4: Uhlangabezana kanjani nezinselelo ze-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezinselelo ze-acid mine drainage, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuphuculwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha: Ukubeka imithetho eqinile yokuphatha amanzi emisebenzini yokumbiwa phansi. 2. Ukuphinda usebenzise indawo: Ukubuyisela izindawo ezithintekile, ukwakha imithombo emisha yamanzi ahlanzekile, nokuthuthukisa isimo sezimo eziphilayo. 3. Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi: Ukuqwashisa izakhamuzi ngalesi sifo nokubandakanya umphakathi ekuphathweni kwemithombo yemvelo. Umbuzo 5: Imaphi amaphuzu okusebenza angathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: Amaphuzu okusebenza angathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage afaka: 1. Ucwaningo olunzulu: Ucwaningo lwemvelo oluqinile ukuze kuqondwe kangcono imiphumela ye-AMD. 2. Izinhlelo zokuhlola: Ukubeka izinhlelo zokuhlola ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho yokuphatha amanzi iyagcinwa. 3. Izinhlelo zokukhuthaza: Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizimele ezibambisene nezinhlaka zomphakathi ukuze zisebenze ndawonye ekuphathweni kwe-AMD. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinhlelo zokulawula ezikhona eGauteng? Impendulo: E-Gauteng, kunezinhlangano eziningi ezisebenza ukulawula i-acid mine drainage. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi: Imithetho ethile yokuphatha amanzi edingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. 2. Uhlelo lwezokuhlola: Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kokungcoliswa kwamanzi nemiphumela yokusebenza kwezimayini. 3. Ukwanda kwesayensi: Ukuxhumana nezikhungo zocwaningo ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela emisha ye-AMD. Umbuzo 7: Uwusizo lwemiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele? Impendulo: Imiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele ingafunda kulesi simo eGauteng. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukwakha ubudlelwano: Ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze kwabelwane ngolwazi nezindlela eziphumelela. 2. Izinqubomgomo ezihlala zisebenza: Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imithombo yemvelo. 3. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana: Ukuqhuba izinhlelo zokuxhumana nokuqwashisa umphakathi ngezingozi ze-AMD. Umbuzo 8: Yini okudingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo se-acid mine drainage eGauteng? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo se-acid mine drainage eGauteng, kudingeka: 1. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana: Ukuze izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. 2. Ukwandisa imfundo: Ukuqwashisa abantu ngale nkinga ukuze bazibandakanye. 3. Izibopho ezinhle: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezindaba bavuma ukubheka izinqubo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zixazululo, eGauteng ingathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage, ivikele imithombo yayo, futhi iqinise impilo yomphakathi.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery 1. Isingeniso Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery uqala ngonyaka ka-2015, lapho kwavulwa khona ithuba lokwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela eMthombeni, eNingizimu Afrika. Le phrojekthi yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokucubungula uwoyela, ukunciphisa ukuncika emithonjeni yangaphandle, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi endaweni. 2. Ukuhlaziywa Kwezidingo Ngaphambi kokuqala iphrojekthi, kwenziwa ukuhlaziywa kwezidingo ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi, izimfuneko zokuphepha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinsiza zomhlaba, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Ukuhlaziywa kwaphinde kwagxila ekutheni izinga lokucubungula uwoyela elidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zendawo. 3. Ukuthola Imvume Ngemuva kokuhlaziywa kwezidingo, kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthola imvume yokwakha. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana nezikhungo zikamasipala, iziphathimandla zezokuphepha, kanye nezinhlangano eziphathelene nezokuhlala. Imibiko yokuhlola imvelo (EIA) yathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi izohambisana nemithetho yokuvikela imvelo. 4. Ukukhetha Indawo Indawo yokwakha yeMthombo Oil Refinery yakhethwa ngokucophelela, ibhekwa izici ezifana nokufinyeleleka, izinsiza zamanzi, kanye nokuphuma kwemikhiqizo. Iphrojekthi yakhetha indawo ethile eMthombeni, eyayihlangabezana nezidingo ezibekiwe. 5. Ukuhlela Iphrojekthi Ngemuva kokukhetha indawo, kwenziwa ukuhlela kwephrojekthi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha uhlelo lwezindleko, isikhathi sokwakha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Izinkampani ezahlukene zatholakala ukuze zibe yingxenye yephrojekthi, kuhlanganise nabakhi, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nezinkampani zokuhlola. 6. Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhiwo Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo kuqala ngonyaka ka-2018, lapho kwavulwa khona izikhungo zokwakha. Izinsiza eziningi zatholakala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukwakhiwa kuhamba kahle. Izinyathelo zokuphepha zazibhekwa ngokuqinile, futhi abaqashi bahlola izinga lokusebenza. 7. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi Ngaphambi kokusebenza kweMthombo Oil Refinery, kwenziwa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kuhilela ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokusebenza, izinqubo zokuphepha, kanye nezidingo zokusebenza. Ukuqeqeshwa kwaba yimpumelelo, futhi abasebenzi baziswa ngokuqhubekayo ngezinguquko ezithinta umsebenzi. 8. Ukuqala Kokusebenza Ngonyaka ka-2020, iMthombo Oil Refinery yaqala ukusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umkhiqizo wokuqala uwoyela ube uphume. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza kuhamba kahle, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kwezinga lokusebenza, izinga lokuphepha, kanye nezinga lokukhiqiza. 9. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi Uphathwa kwephrojekthi kwenziwa ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziyaqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izindleko, kanye nezikhathi zokusebenza zaphathwa ngokuqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iphrojekthi ibhekelele izinjongo zayo. 10. Ukubuyekezwa Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokusebenza kweminyaka emibili, kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa kwephrojekthi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola ukusebenza kweMthombo Oil Refinery, izinga lokukhiqiza, kanye nezindleko. Imiphumela yokubuyekezwa yatholakala, futhi izinyathelo zathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza. 11. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yathuthukiswa ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokusebenza, kanye nokwandisa ukukhiqiza. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iMthombo Oil Refinery ihlala ibalulekile emnothweni. 12. Isiphetho Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa indlela yokwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela esiphumelelayo. Ngokuqhubeka kokusebenza, le phrojekthi ibonisa ukuthi ingaba yisibonelo sokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi.
Kwakhiwe uhlelo lokuphenya ngemuva kokushiswa kwesakhiwo eGoli ezinsukwini ezedlule, lapho umphakathi ub faced isikhumbuzo esibi somlilo. Umlilo, owenzeka phakathi nosuku, waba nemiphumela emibi, waholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo nokulahleka kwezimpahla eziningi. Uphenyo olwenziwe ngabeZithombe, iziphathimandla, kanye nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, lukhombisa ubunzima bokuphila emadolobheni amakhulu. Uphenyo luveze ukuthi umlilo uqale ngezizathu ezingaziwa, nokho kukhona izinkomba ezikhombisa ukungahleleki kwezokuphepha. Izinhlelo zokuphepha, ezifana nama-alamu nezinhlelo zokuphuma, zibonakale zingasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi kwesakhiwo ukuphuma ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izakhiwo ezinkulu eGoli zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Abaphenyi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zazingahambisani nezindinganiso ezidingekayo, okukhombisa ukuthi abathengi, abaklami, nabakhi kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izakhiwo eziphephile. Izinhlelo zokuhlola izakhiwo zidinga ukuqiniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibucayi. Ukwengeza, umphakathi ubhekene nokungabi nolwazi olunembile ngezindlela zokuphuma uma kwenzeka umlilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono izingozi ezihambisana nomlilo. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezikhungo zokwakha kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokuphuma ngokushesha uma kuvela izimo ezinjalo. Uphenyo lukhombisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani uma kwenzeka umlilo. Ukuhlanganiswa kolwazi phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni uhlelo lokuphepha oluhlanganisiwe. Mayelana nezimpilo ezilahlekile, umphakathi uthole ukwesekwa okuhle, kodwa kudingeka izinhlelo eziphusile zokubhekana nezimo ezinjalo, okuhlanganisa ukuxhasa imindeni elahlekile, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokubuyisela abantu ezimpilweni zabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nabantu kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bayathola usizo. Isifundo esibalulekile kulolu phenyo sithi ukuphepha akufanele kube yinto ethile, kodwa umqondo ophilayo. Izakhiwo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuphepha, futhi umphakathi kufanele ube nolwazi oluqinile ukuze ukwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, iziphathimandla, kanye nabakhi. Ngokuqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuhlola izakhiwo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ezimeni ezinjalo, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nokuqonda okukhulu ngezingozi ezihlobene nomlilo. Ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo zokwakha kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izifundo ezitholakele kulolu phenyo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, leli phuzu lokuphenya lukhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi ukuphepha akuyona into okufanele sithathe kalula. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokwakha izakhiwo eziphephile, futhi iziphathimandla kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubomgomo zokuphepha ziyanakwa. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela izimpilo zabantu, futhi sigweme izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ungum reminder obalulekile wokuthi, nakuba izakhiwo zikhula, ukuphepha kufanele kube phezulu ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuphenya kufanele kube yisiqalo sokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zethu zihlala ziphephile, futhi umphakathi uhlala uphephile.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule NgoMsombuluko, uZola, umfundi ophothule eNyuvesi yaseNatal, ubhale imigqa ethokozisayo mayelana nezinselelo abahlangabezane nazo ekutholeni ama-internship. Njengoba izikhala zama-internship zikhula ngokuqhamuka kweminyaka, abafundi abaphothule badinga izindlela ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle ukuze bathole amathuba okuqeqeshwa. Ukuthola internship kuyinselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenawo amakhono okukhangisa. UZola uveza ukuthi, "Ngenkathi ngiphetha, benginenkinga enkulu yokuthola ama-internship. Ukuhlanganisa i-CV yami ngendlela efanele kube yinto ebalulekile." Iziphakamiso ezivela kubafundi bokuqala ziveza ukuthi ukuthuthukisa amakhono okubhalela imibhalo, ukufunda nokuphendula izincwadi kanye nokukhuluma phambi kwabantu kungaba usizo enkulu. UZola uthe: "Ngifunde ukuthi ukuhlela ama-CV nokubhala izincwadi ezicacile kungakhuphula amathuba ami." Ukwazi ukuthi ungakhalisa kanjani izinhlelo ze-internship, abanye bafundi baphumelelayo basebenzise izinhlelo zezikhumbuzo. UThandi, owenza izifundo zezezimali, uthe: "Ngithole internship yami ngokuqhafaza izikhumbuzo ezithunyelwa kubangane. Kukhona abadlali abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, ngakho ngathumele i-CV yami kwazulu." Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithe xaxa, abaphothuli badinga ukulandela ngemva kokuqashwa. Imithombo emininingwane efana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, izinsiza ze-intanethi, kanye nezingosi ze-internship, ziba wusizo olukhulu. Kwakhamusango, okuvame ukuhlola okuhle, nokukhangisa izinkampani ezenza izaziso. Izikhala eziningi zenzelwa ukufaneleka kwamafilimu, tsimingana, noma ezokusebenza kwezokuxhumana, okusho ukuthi abafundi badinga ukukhethwa ngokucophelela ukuze baphumelele. UThandi usho ukuthi, "Kubalulekile ukusetha izinhloso ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola i-internship elungile." Abafundi abaphothule baveza ukuthi kudingeka banikeze izinkampani imiphumela emihle emphakathini. Ngokuphinde, abaphothuli badinga ukuthola izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu abahlala emkhakheni abafuna ukuwufunda. Ukuba nomphakathi onobungane ezinkampanini noma ezikhaleni ezintsha, kuzokwenza kube lula ukufuna izikhala eziyinqaba. UZola uveza indlela yokukhuluma, "Ngithole izeluleko ezivela kubantu abathakazelisayo emkhakheni wami." Ngaphansi kokuqonda okukhulu, uhlelo lwesikole lunikeza amathuba amaningi okukhulisa amakhono. Njengoba abaphothuli bephokophele imisebenzi, kubalulekile ukuba banikeze izikhulu ezihloniphekile, izifundo, nezinkumbulo. Noma kunjalo, abaphothuli bahlala bezibuza ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani kube lula ukuqasha. Izikhala zama-internship akuhlukahlukene, kodwa umphakathi ubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngothando lwezinto ezintsha. Umphakathi we-internship uphumelele uma uhambisana nezinto ezenzakalayo. UThandi uqhubekela phambili ngokuqhuba izifundo ezithokozisayo. "Ngibona ukuthi ukusebenza kwe-internship kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphumelela, kuthiwa kuyinselela, kufuneka njalo ube nekhono lokuhlola izinzuzo zakho." Ukubika kudinga ukuchazela lezi zindlela, ukuze abaphothuli bakwazi ukudala izikhala eziphumelelako. Nansi eminye imikhuba esizothola ezinkampanini eziphezulu, ezibavumela ukuba bebenze ithonya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inhloso yokuthola i-internship igxila ekubhekaneni nezinto ezinjalo. Uthando lokusebenza nabantu nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekuhlonipheni izinkampani. Hamba hamba, qala ukukhuthazwa, qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungashiyi i-CV yakho ilunga elilodwa. Kukhona imfihlo yokuphumelela. Ngokulungiselela okuncane, uzobe usubhekelele kuwo umhlaba wobuchwepheshe, enze izinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze uthole amandla okuqhubeka. Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule, zichaza leso sikhathi esifanele sokuba ufunde, umshiye, noma huza izinkundla zenhlangano. Kulabo abaphothule, lezi zindlela zingazosa izinzuzo, kuzokwenziwa ngenkuthalo, umsebenzi, nezifiso. Kuphumelela ukubamba amathuba akhulayo, ukuthi sizokhethiwe phakathi kwezinselelo eziqhubekayo, siphenyele ngalokhu kube nezinselelo ezinkulu. Abafundi abaphothule badinga ukuxeledisa, bahlanganyele, futhi basebenzisane ukuze baphumelelaye. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutholeni ulwazi olukhulayo, nezindlela ezithokozisayo ezivela ezinkampanini eziphezu. Emaphandleni, kubalulekile Ukuqonda ukuthi ezimakethe zethu, ubuchwepheshe bunzwa izifiso zamanje. UZola uyavuma ukuthi izingqinamba ezisemqoka zikhona, "Sidlula esikhaleni esinenkinga, kodwa kudinga ibhizinisi olindele." Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule, kulindeleke ezinsukwini ezizayo ukuthi zibe ngaphezu kokwenza umphakathi ube strongze. Ngeke uphushe amazwi ethu, umgomo ukufinyelela okuthokozisayo. Ngokuba khona, sithanda ukuqonda izivumelwano ezivelele. Abafundi abaphothule baphumelela uthando lwezinto zabo, ngokuhamba phambili ezitholakele, kuhlelwe ukuze bazizwe benamandla. Lezi zindlela ziyashintsha, zibonisa indlela evusa izifiso nabazali, uthando lomsebenzi, ezwehlinzi. Ngendlela, ukulwa nezinkinga kubalulekile, kuzosiza ukuba namaphuzu empathelwe, uthando lwamasiko namaqhawe. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izikhala eziphusile, sizologique. Njengoba thina thina sizoba nephupho lesidumile, zonke izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ziyokwenza imizamo yenze namathuba amasha alindele futhi ahlole umhlaba wobuchwepheshe. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma amashumi eminyaka eshaya, inhloso ozoba nayo izogcwalisa izifiso eziphezulu zomphakathi, izikhala ezibanzi zezempilo, zithi sizobhalwa kuzo. Umgomo ungubani? Hamba phambili, uphendule, ruralize, be processers. Zombili zendawo, namathuba, qhafaza ukuba uqhawule osukwini lwakho. Ngakho, kulindeleke ukuthi izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule kube yinzuzo enkulu emphakathini, uthando lokusebenza, nezifiso eziphumelelayo. Noma yisiphi isizathu, kufanele sithole izinkolo eziphakemeamsung, esikhathini esizayo. Izindleko zokufunda zizele kakhulu, ngakho uma ubona izinyathelo, yiba nesibindi, uvulele izinto ezintsha. Zama ogama amasha! Ngakho, ukusebenza, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokubamba ngezandla, kwenza kube lula ukuhlonza ikusasa. Ukube sithola lezi zindlela, sizowina ubuchwepheshe, ngesikhathi esithile. Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zikhula, zama ukufaka isandla namathuba abhekiwe nezinyathelo okwenza kube yikhulu esikhathini. Yazi ukuthi uhlale unegqugquzela, uzobe uhamba phambili ekujabuliseni izwe.
Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini Emiphakathini eminingi yaseNingizimu Afrika, imboni yezimayini ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokukhiqiza izinsiza ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuthi ibamba izinkulungwane zabantu emsebenzini. Ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezitholakala ezimayini, empeleni, imboni ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima, kakhulu ngokubhekelwa kwempilo, izimo zokusebenza, kanye namaholo. Umgwaqo wokucwaninga ngengxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini uqala eminyakeni ye-1920, lapho imboni yaba yinsika yokukhula komnotho. Kwakukhona ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezimboni ezahlukahlukene, futhi abaphathi bemayini babefuna ukuvikela inzuzo yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi baphinde baphikise izimo zabo zokusebenza, bejolisa kakhulu kumaholo. Ngalesi sikhathi, amaholo abelokhu ephansi, futhi amaholo amancane ahlukaniswa ezingeni lezemisebenzi. Abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, babefuna izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, babevele behlangana futhi benza izinyathelo zokuphikisana, okuholele ekwakheni izinhlangano zabasebenzi ezazisekela lezi zidingo. Emzabalazweni wabo, abavukuzi baveza izinkinga eziningi. Ukuze baphumelele, babefanele bahlonze izimbangela ezingaholela ekuphuculeni izimo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhuluma nabanye abasebenzi, ukuthola ukusekelwa kwabanye, kanye nokuhlela izigameko ezinkulu zokuqwashisa. Lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukubonisa ubunzima okuyiwo abahlangabezana nawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukunciphisa ukusebenza kahle kwabavukuzi akuhambisani nezidingo zenkampani. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabaphathi kanye nezinyunyana. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawubona ukuthi izinyunyana ziba namandla, ziqinisa izwi labavukuzi, futhi zigqugquzela izingxoxo ezinzima ngamaholo. Eminyakeni ye-1980, umphakathi wezokugcina izinsiza wahlangabezana nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ukucindezelwa komnotho, ukuhlinzekwa kwezimali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima. Abasebenzi baveza indlela yokwakha ubuhlakani phakathi kwabo nabaqhubi bezimayini, ukuze basebenze ndawonye ekutholeni izixazululo. Lokhu kuhlangana kwabavukuzi kwabavusa umoya wokuzwana nokubambisana. Ngenkathi le minyaka ihamba, izinkulumo zamaholo zathuthuka. Abavukuzi baqala ukufuna ukuhweba ngempela, bephikisa izizathu ezikhona zokungahlinzekwa kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izivumelwano ezahlukene, ezaziphakamisa izinga lemaholo, kwazise izinkampani zaziqonda ukuthi ukungathathi hlangothi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ngemuva kokuphela kweminyaka ye-1990, imboni yezimayini yahamba phambili, kodwa izinkulumo zamaholo zabe seziya phambili kakhulu. Abasebenzi baqhubeka nokufuna izithuthukiso, futhi izinyunyana zaba namandla. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezivumelwano eziningi ezithinta izinqumo zamaholo, ezazikhuthaza izinguquko ezinkulu. Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abavukuzi bahlala bephikisa, befuna izimo ezinhle zokusebenza, kanye namaholo afanele. Lokhu kwenza imboni yezezimali ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi kuyavuma ukuthi zingxoxo zamaholo ziyaqhubeka nokugcina ubuhlakani phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zingxoxo zenzeka ezicini eziningi, phakathi kwezinguquko zokuphatha, ubuchwepheshe obuthuthuke, kanye nokwanda kokuncintisana. Lokhu kuthinta imiphumela yengxoxo zamaholo; abavukuzi bahlala beqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana nokubambisana kubalulekile ekutholeni izixazululo. Ngakho-ke, ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini ludinga ukugxila ekwakheni izixazululo ezizinzile, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukusebenzisana okunamandla phakathi kwezinyunyana, abaphathi kanye nohulumeni. Emzabalazweni wokuthola impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ingxoxo ayikona kuphela phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi, kodwa ikhuluma ngobuhlakani bomphakathi wonke. Ngale ndlela, imboni yezimayini izoba yindawo yokusebenza engcono, futhi izidingo zabasebenzi zizothola ukunakwa okukhulu. Lezi zingxoxo zamaholo zizophinde zibe yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu besebenzisana, bangathola izixazululo ezizokwenza impilo yabo ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, izifundo ezivela kulolu cwaningo zingase zibe nomthelela omkhulu esimweni sokusebenza embonini yezimayini, nakweminye imikhakha ezithinta umphakathi jikelele. Emva kokuhlola lezi zinto, kubonakala ukuthi izinguquko zikhona, futhi ukuqhubeka kokuxoxisana kuyinto eyinhloko ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni jikelele.
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Ukuthathwa komhlaba, noma i-expropriation, kuyinqubo lapho uhulumeni noma omunye umphakathi uthatha umhlaba wabanye abantu ngenhloso yokwakha izinhlelo ezithile, njengokwakha izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhumulo zezindiza, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Le nqubo, nakuba ingase ibonakale iyinsiza yokuthuthukisa, ivame ukuveza izimpikiswano ezinzima zomthetho, ezithinta amalungelo abantu, izinqubo zokuthola imvume, kanye nemithetho yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kudinga ukulandela izinqubo ezithile ezibekwe emthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nenhloso yokuthatha umhlaba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezizathu ezanele zokuthi kungani kuthathwa leli thuba. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayazi ukuthi izinqubo zenzeka kanjani, futhi bakwazi ukuveza izikhalazo zabo uma kudingeka. Okwesibili, izimpikiswano zomthetho zikhula lapho abanikazi bomhlaba bebona ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenziwa ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma uhulumeni enganiki abanikazi bomhlaba imali efanele yokubuyiselwa. Umthetho uthi abanikazi bomhlaba kufanele bathole imali efanele, okuyi-‘just compensation’, uma umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Nokho, izinkinga zenzeka lapho kunokungaboni ngaso linye mayelana nenani elithile, noma uma abanikazi bomhlaba bezwa ukuthi imali abayitholayo ayihambisani nenani langempela lomhlaba wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpikiswano zomthetho zingavela uma kuthathwa umhlaba ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwemithetho yokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanikazi bomhlaba baphikise izinqumo zikaHulumeni ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Izimo ezinjalo zidinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayalalela futhi bahlonishwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkantolo ziye zaba nendima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni lezi zimpikiswano. Izinkantolo zihlola izimo ezithile, zifunda izinkulumo ezivela kuHulumeni nabanikazi bomhlaba, bese zenza izinqumo ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izinkantolo zidinga ukuba zihlale ziqaphele izimo zomphakathi, kanye nezidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkantolo zidinga ukuba ziqonde ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayathola izinzuzo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayahlonishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ekugcineni, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Ukuthathwa komhlaba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ukuthathwa komhlaba kudinga ukuba kube nenhlonipho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi Ukuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola ulwazi olufanele nolwakha. Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zokubhekana nalezi zinselelo. Isinyathelo 1: Qonda Izidingo Zomphakathi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukuhlola izifundo ezitholakala emiphakathini. - Ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo ukuze uqonde izifiso zabo. - Ukuhlola izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi, njengezokuxhumana, izindaba zomphakathi, noma izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsiza Zokuxhasa Ngemuva kokuhlola izidingo, thola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uxhaswe imisakazo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Imali yokuxhasa imisebenzi. - Abantu abanamakhono afanele, njengababhalisi, abahleli, nabakhangisi. - Izinsiza zobuchwepheshe, njengezikhangiso eziku-inthanethi, iziteshi zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokurekhoda. Isinyathelo 3: Hlela Uhlelo Lokuxhasa Hlela uhlelo lokuxhasa imisakazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubeka imigomo ecacile yokuthi yini ofuna ukuyifeza. - Ukubeka isikhawu sokusebenza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uzokwenza ini. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphromotha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imisakazo ifinyelela kubantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Isinyathelo 4: Xhumana Nababambiqhaza Xhumana nababambiqhaza abahlukene, kubandakanya: - Izinkampani ezizimele, ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza. - Abaholi bendawo, ukuze uthole ukwesekwa. - Abanye abaxhasi, ukuze uthole iminikelo. Isinyathelo 5: Phromotha Imisakazo Phromotha imisakazo yakho ukuze ifinyelele kubantu abaningi. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukusebenzisa iziteshi zokuxhumana, njenge-Facebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram. - Ukuphakela izinhlelo ezikhethekile, ezifana nemicimbi noma izinkulumo. - Ukubambisana nezinye izinkampani noma imiphakathi ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okukhulu. Isinyathelo 6: Qinisekisa Ukubuyekezwa Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokuphromotha, kubalulekile ukuhlola impumelelo yemisakazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuqoqa impendulo evela kubabukeli. - Ukuhlola ukuthi imigomo efakwe ekuqaleni ifezekile yini. - Ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise imisakazo esikhathini esizayo. Isinyathelo 7: Qhubeka Nokuxhasa Ukuxhasa imisakazo akupheli. Qhubeka nokubheka izidingo zomphakathi, futhi uhlale uvulelekile ezinguqukweni. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni imisakazo eqhubekayo nehlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 8: Qinisa Ubudlelwano Qinisa ubudlelwano nababambiqhaza nezinye izikhungo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuxhaswa, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Bamba imicimbi yokuhlangana, noma uhlele izinkulumo ezahlukene ukuze uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Isinyathelo 9: Thuthukisa Amakhono Thuthukisa amakhono akho nabantu abakuzungezile. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukuhlela izifundo noma izinkulumo ezithinta izihloko ezibalulekile. - Ukubamba imihlangano yokufundisana, lapho abantu bangabelana ngolwazi. - Ukuxhasa abantu abasha ukuze bangene emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 10: Yiba Nezinhlelo Zokubambisana Yiba nezinhlelo zokubambisana ukuze uthuthukise imisakazo. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlelo zomphakathi. - Ukusebenzisana nabaculi, ababhali, noma abanye abantu abanolwazi. - Ukwakha izinhlelo ezivumelanayo ukuze uthuthukise ukufinyelela. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukwesekwa, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi imisakazo iyaphumelela futhi iyasebenza. Ukuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ohlanganyela, nolwazi. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana kuyizinto eziyisisekelo ekwakheni imisakazo ephumelelayo.
Okutholakele Kuphenyo Lomlilo Wesakhiwo eGoli 1. Isingeniso Le ngxenye ibonisa okutholakele kuphenyo olwenziwe ngemuva komlilo owenzeka esakhiweni esithile eGoli. Umsebenzi wethu ugxile ekutholeni izizathu zomlilo, umthelela kubantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwezakhiwo ezifanayo esikhathini esizayo. 2. Uhlaka Lwenqubo Yokuphenya I. Ukuqoqwa Kwedatha - Ukuqoqwa kwemibiko evela kubantu abathintekayo, abashayeli bezimoto zomlilo, kanye nezisebenzi zikamasipala. - Ukuhlola izithombe nezincwadi ezitholakele ezivela ezikhungweni zokuphepha. II. Ukuhlaziywa Kwedatha - Ukuhlaziya imibiko ukuze kuqondwe izizathu zomlilo. - Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezazikhona ngaphambi kokuba umlilo uqale. III. Ukubika - Ukubika okutholakele kumphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezithintekayo. 3. Izizathu Zomlilo Uphenyo luveze ukuthi umlilo uqale ngenxa yokushisa okukhulu okubangelwe ukungasebenzi kahle kwemishini yokushisa. Ukuhlaziywa kwemboni yokwakha kuveze ukuthi izinsiza zokuphepha, njengezixhumi zomlilo, bezingasebenzi kahle. 4. Umthelela Kubantu I. Abantu Abathintekayo - Abantu abahlala esakhiweni baphenduleka kakhulu. Kukhona abathintekile, abanye baphumile ngaphandle kokulimala, kodwa abanye bahlupheke ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle kwezinsiza zokuphepha. II. Ukwelashwa - Abantu abathintekayo bathole usizo lwezempilo, futhi izikhungo zezempilo ziqinisekisile ukuthi banikezwa ukwelashwa okufanele. 5. Izinyathelo Ezithathiwe I. Ukulungisa Izinkinga - Izisebenzi zikamasipala ziqalile ukuhlola izakhiwo eziseduze ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho ezinye izingozi. II. Ukuqeqeshwa - Ukuqeqeshwa kwenziwa kubantu abahlala esakhiweni ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha. III. Ukwenza Izinguquko - Izinyathelo zokwenza izinguquko ezinhlelweni zokuphepha zethulwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga ezifanayo aziphindi. 6. Ukubuyekezwa Kwenqubo Yokuphenya Uphenyo luzoqhubeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo zithathwa. Iziphathimandla zizoqhubeka nokubuyekeza izinqubo zokuphepha ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. 7. Isiphetho Uphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli luveze izinkinga eziningi ezikhona emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqhubeke zisebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile, futhi abantu bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye neziphathimandla kuzodlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni izakhiwo zibe ziphephile esikhathini esizayo. 8. Izikhumbuzo - Qhubeka uvuselela izinhlelo zokuphepha. - Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi izinqubo zokuphuma uma kwenzeka umlilo. - Hlanganisa izinsiza zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nalesi sikhathi esinzima, futhi ubonisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwe zingasiza kanjani ekuvimbeleni izigameko ezifanayo esikhathini esizayo. Ukubambisana nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yabantu.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa Ekuqaleni, eNyakatho Kapa, kwakukhona umuzi ophithizelayo, ogcwele izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Abantu bahlala ezindlini ezincane, behlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kumandla. Kodwa, kwavela umoya omusha, umoya wokuguquka. Kwakuyisikhathi sokubuyisela emuva, isikhathi sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandi, umphakathi ophakathi kweNyakatho Kapa, wayengumuntu ophokophelelayo. Wayenothando olukhulu lokusiza umphakathi wakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi ehamba emgwaqweni, wahlangana noMnu. Mthembu, umphakathi ophakathi kokwakha iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi le phrojekthi yayihlose ukunciphisa ukuncika kumandla avela ezinsizeni ezingavuselelekayo, futhi yayizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole amandla. UMnu. Mthembu wakhuluma ngale phrojekthi ngendlela ethokozisayo. "Sizokwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga, iziteshi zamandla omoya, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina amanzi," kusho yena. "Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu bethu ukuba bathole amandla, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube namandla." UThandi wathokozisa kakhulu. Wazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yabantu abaningi. Waqala ukuhlela umcimbi wokwazisa umphakathi ngale phrojekthi. Wabiza abantu bonke, wathi: "Sizoba nomhlangano omkhulu, sizokhuluma ngempilo yethu, nendlela esingayithuthukisa ngayo." Ngesikhathi umcimbi ufika, abantu bephuma bezokhuluma, bejabulile. UThandi wakhuluma ngale phrojekthi, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza. "Sizokwakha umphakathi onamandla, umphakathi ozimele," kusho yena. Abantu babebonisa intshisekelo, futhi baqala ukubuza imibuzo. UThandi waphendula, wathi: "Sizodinga bonke, sizodinga imisebenzi, sizodinga izandla ezisebenzayo." Ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi, abantu baqala ukuhlela. Kwakukhona abanye ababevele benza izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga ezindlini zabo. Kwakukhona abanye ababevele beqale ukufunda ngama-batteries avuselelekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukugcina amandla. UThandi waba yisibonelo, waqala ukwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga emakhaya akhe. Wafundisa abanye abantu, wabelana ngolwazi, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Njengoba izinyanga zedlula, iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo yathuthuka. Iziteshi zamandla elanga zakhuliswa, iziteshi zamandla omoya zafakwa, futhi abantu baqala ukuthola amandla. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa izibani ezikhanyayo, bejabulisa imishini yabo. UThandi wabona ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubuyela emuva, ubuyela empilweni. Kodwa, akukhona konke okwakuhamba kahle. Kwakukhona izinselelo. Abanye abantu babengakholwa ukuthi le phrojekthi izophumelela. Babebona izindleko, babebona ubunzima bokwakha. UThandi waba nesibindi, wathi: "Sizokwenza lokhu, sizokwenza kube khona ithemba. Sizokwenza kube khona amandla." Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu, waba yisibonelo sokuthi konke kungenzeka uma abantu benza ngokubambisana. Wabamba izifundo, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi amandla avuselelekayo awanqotshwa. Abantu baqala ukwethemba, baqala ukwakha, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo yaphumelela. Umphakathi wawunamandla, wawunokuthula. Abantu babenamandla, futhi babenokuthula. UThandi wabona ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubuyela emuva, ubuyela empilweni. Wazi ukuthi lokhu bekungaphezu kwamandla avuselelekayo; bekungukwakha umphakathi onamandla. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bephokophelelayo, bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazi ukuthi amandla avuselelekayo awanqotshwa, futhi umphakathi wakhe wawukhanya njengokukhanya kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, indaba yokubambisana, indaba yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eNyakatho Kapa.
