Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni (AI in public administration) Ngonyaka ka-2023, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) busezintweni eziningi ezemukelwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kuhulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlukene ze-AI ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini yokuphatha, ukuphendula izidingo zabantu, nokwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo nezifanele. Uhlelo lwezempilo, izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokubika kudala kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uhlelo lwe-AI lusebenzisa ubuciko bokufunda ngomshini ukuze kutholakale ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe, oluphendula izidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa i-AI zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngempilo yomphakathi, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zempilo. Izinhlelo ze-AI zisebenza kahle ekuphatheni idatha enkulu. Uhulumeni ungenza izinqumo ezinhle ngokusebenzisa le datha, okuholela ekwenzeni izinhlelo eziphathelene nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ezinhlelweni ezifana nezokuhlola izinga lokuhlala, ukukala izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyisisekelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ze-AI zisebenza kahle ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngokuqondisa izinsiza ezikhona ngempumelelo. Ukuhlaziywa kwedatha okwenziwa yi-AI kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ziqhuba ngendlela efanele, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zitholakala ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Ukwenza kahle kwe-AI kuhulumeni akuphathelene kuphela nezinsizwa zomphakathi kodwa futhi kusiza ekwandiseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwesikhumbuzo. Uhlelo lwezokukhiqiza, kulapho uhulumeni nesehlakalo sokuhamba kwezinsiza besebenzisa i-AI ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni bukhoma ukuze kusetshenziswe izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezindaweni eziningi. Ukwenqatshwa kwemikhawulo yokwakhiwa izifundazwe emhlabeni jikelele kuboniswe kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinhlelo ze-AI zikhuthaza izinyathelo zokwakha umnotho. Umsebenzi wokwakha izikhumbuzo ubonisa indlela i-AI engakwazi ngayo ukuqondisa izinsizakusebenza ezithile, kubandakanya imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa izindawo eziphathelene nezekhulu lemiphakathi. Naphezu kokuba nezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza ngezindlela ezisemthethweni nezichaphazela wonke umuntu. Ukuphathwa kwedatha, ukuqondisa mqoka, kanye nezimiso zokuqonda – zonke lezi zinto kufuneka zibe ngempela ukuze ukusebenzisa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni kube yimpumelelo. Ukuphendula izinkinga eziphakeme zomphakathi kudinga ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihambelana nazo. Uhulumeni kumele athole izindlela zokucwaninga ezinyukwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphuzu afanele achazwe kahle nge-AI. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni ukwakhiwa okusebenzayo nokusheshayo kwezinhlelo zempilo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi theleka ubudlelwano obubambekayo phakathi komphakathi nomphakathi. Ukwaneliseka komphakathi kube yisona sikhumbuzo esihle sokuqinisekisa ukuthi i-AI iyathuthukiswa. Ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka komphakathi futhi kutholakale izimpawu ezithile ezizokwandisa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi nabaholi bobuhlakani ukuze kudaleke izixazululo ezinhle nezinzile. Ekugcineni, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni buphehlwa ikakhulukazi emisebenzini emikhulu yokuphatha, kodwa kuhlanganisa nezinye izici ezibalulekile ezifana nezindawo zomphakathi nezinsiza ezithile. Ukuze ube nohlelo oluphilayo nolwakha umphakathi, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanele, esebenzisayo ukuze ihlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile emqoka. Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhamba phambili emhlabeni jikelele, futhi buphendula izidingo zomphakathi ngakusasa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuqonda ubuchwepheshe besimanje kanye nezinsiza zokuphila ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela ezayo izoba yinhle kwiNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele.
Intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese UJacob Zuma, owayenguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezinkulu ezihlobene nokushushiswa kwakhe. Lokhu kushushiswa kungenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwezomnotho, izinqubo zokuphatha kanye nezinye izigameko ezazihambisana nobugebengu obuhlobene nepolitiki. Isimo sokushushiswa kukaZuma sithokozisa futhi sidala ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kwakhe, sigxile ezicini ezahlukene, okubandakanya izizathu, izinqubo zomthetho, kanye nemiphumela. Izizathu Zokushushiswa UZuma ubhekene nezinsolo eziningi, phakathi kwazo izinsolo zokukhwabanisa, ukuhlonipha imithetho, kanye nokuphula izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Izinsolo ezivamile zifaka phakathi kokusebenzisa amandla akhe kabi, ukungakhokhi intela, nokuba nezehlakalo ezixakile ezihlobene nezimali. Lezi zinselelo zikhombisa ukuthi uZuma wayephula imithetho esebenzayo, engahloniphi izinqubo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zomthetho Ngemuva kokuba izinsolo zethulwe, izinyathelo zomthetho zathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo. Uhlelo lokushushiswa lutholakala ngaphakathi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho, lapho izinsolo zethulwa ezinkantolo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlolwa kwezinsolo, Ukuhlola ubufakazi, kanye nenqubomgomo yokuhlonza ubufakazi obuqinile. Ukushushiswa kwenzeka emiphakathini ethile, lapho abaculi bezomthetho beqhubeka nokucubungula izinsolo ezithile. Imiphumela Yokushushiswa Imiphumela yokushushiswa kukaZuma ibalulekile, futhi inezimpikiswano ezinzima. Okokuqala, lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezithombe ezimbi ngokuphatha kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi uba nomuzwa wokukhathazeka mayelana nokwethenjwa kwezikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlinzeko ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubangela ukungabaza emiphakathini, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuba abantu bakholwe ezinkantolo nasezinhlelweni zomthetho. Okwesibili, imiphumela yokushushiswa ingathinta umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma uZuma engashushiswa, lokhu kungaholela ekuqhamukeni kokungathembeki nokuhlukumezeka kwemali. Imali eyengeziwe yokuhlawula izindleko zomthetho, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsolo, ingathinta izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izindlela Zokuhlonza Nokuqonda Ukuze kuqondwe kahle intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaZuma, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo zomthetho, izinhlinzeko ezisemthethweni, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola izinsolo. Abantu kufanele bahlale bekwaziswa ngezenzakalo ezithinta uZuma, bazi kahle izinsolo, nezinyathelo zomthetho ezithathwayo. Ukwazi kahle lezi zici kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlonipha izinqubo zomthetho, nokuphendula ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Ngokubheka intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsolo zihlukaniswe ngaphezulu kwegazi. Izinyathelo zomthetho ziqondisa indlela yokuthi uZuma ubhekane nezinsolo, kuyilapho imiphumela yokushushiswa ibonisa umthelela kumphakathi nasezinhlelweni zomthetho. Ukwaziswa kwedlanzana kwezokuphatha nezinhlinzeko zomthetho kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinzile. Nokho, kudinga ukuba sihlale siqaphile, siqonde, futhi sibe nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile ezithinta lezi zinsolo ezinzima. Ngalokhu, sizokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele ngekamva lethu, futhi sibone ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Emadolobheni amaningi, lapho izikhala zikhula khona, izigidi zabantu zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yazo. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-35, wayehlala edolobheni elikhulu, elinokuphila okusheshayo, kodwa wayehlushwa ukungabi nandaba nokudla okunempilo. UThandi wayefuna ukugcina umndeni wakhe unempilo, kodwa ukungabi khona kwezinsiza zokudla eziphilile kwaba yinkinga. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahamba emgwaqweni, lapho abona khona umphakathi wendawo ubamba umcimbi wokwakha izingadi zokudla. Kwakukhona abantu abaningi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo, bebonisa izithombe zezingadi zabo. UThandi wathola umuzwa omuhle, wacabanga ukuthi lokhu kungaba yithuba elihle lokuthola ukudla okuphilile. Wathola ukuthi lezi zingadi zokudla zazihlelwe ngababambiqhaza bendawo, ababejolise ekwakheni izindawo ezincane zokulima ezindaweni eziphithizelayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi lezi zingadi zazihlinzeka ngembewu, izinsiza, nemiyalo yokulima. Wazizwa ejabule, wathi: “Ngizokwenza lokhu!” Ngemuva kokubhalisela ukujoyina, uThandi waqala ukulima ingadi yakhe encane. Wafunda ukuthi ukudla okukhuliswa emakhaya kunempilo engcono, futhi akudingi izithako eziningi ezibizayo. Waqala ngembewu ye-tomato, u-anyanisi, nezinye izitshalo ezilula. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, waqala ukubona izimpande zikhula, futhi izitshalo zikhula kahle. UThandi wathola ukuthi akukhona nje kuphela ukudla okuphilile, kodwa futhi wathola umphakathi omusha. Abanye abahlali baphinde baphenduka abangane, bexoxa ngezindlela zokulima, bejabulela imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. UThandi waba nesikhathi esihle sokufunda, futhi wathola ukuthi ukulima akukhona nje ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ingadi kaThandi yakhula yaba yindawo yokuhlangana. Abantu bendawo beza ukuzobona, bejabulile, bephakamisa izithombe zezitshalo ezinhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu bejabulayo, bexoxa, futhi bejabulela imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayihlinzeka ngaphezu kokudla. Yaba yindawo yokufundisa izingane zakhe, lapho bezifundisa khona ukuthi ukudla okuphilile kudinga ukunakekelwa. UThandi wathola ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhulisa umqondo wokubambisana, zifundisa abantu ukuthi bangakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezinkingeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wendawo waqala ukwakha ezinye izingadi zokudla. Abantu baqala ukwakha izindawo zokulima ezincane ezindaweni eziphithizelayo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo, benza izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokukhula, hhayi kuphela kwezitshalo, kodwa nasebudlelwaneni phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi nabanye. Waqala ukufundisa abanye abantu bendawo ukuthi bangakha kanjani izingadi zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. UThandi wathola ukuthi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu, futhi umphakathi wendawo waqala ukujabulisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo, benza izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, emadolobheni, lapho izikhala zikhula khona, izigidi zabantu zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yazo. Kodwa uThandi, nomphakathi wakhe, bakhombisa ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokukhula, hhayi kuphela kwezitshalo, kodwa nasebudlelwaneni phakathi kwabantu.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Isingeniso Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathuthukiswa nguHulumeni ukuze sinikeze usizo lwezezimali kubantu abathintekile kakhulu yileli gciwane. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuhlose ukucacisa indlela lesi sibonelelo esisetshenziswe ngayo, izinzuzo ezitholakele, kanye nezinkinga ezitholakele ekuphathweni kwalesi sikhwama. Uhlaka lwezibonelelo Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant satholakala kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi yabo, abangenayo imali yokuphila, noma abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. Uhlelo lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, nokwakha umnotho ophilayo. Izindlela zokufaka izicelo Abantu baye bafaka izicelo nge-inthanethi, ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokuxhumana, noma ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela esiboneleleni, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zendabuko. Ukusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nokuhlaziywa kokuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lesi sibonelelo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi iningi labathola lesi sibonelelo lalisisebenzisa ukuze lithenge ukudla, izimpahla zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila zabantu abaningi. Izinzuzo ezitholakele Ukwamukelwa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kube nomthelela omkhulu ekunciphiseni ubumpofu. Abantu abaningi bakwazi ukuthola ukudla okwakudingeka ukuze baphile, futhi lokhu kwandise umuzwa wokuphepha phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba abanye abantu beqale amabhizinisi amancane ukuze basebenzise imali abayitholile. Izinkinga ezitholakele Nokho, kube nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwesibonelelo. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi bahluleka ukufinyelela esiboneleleni ngenxa yezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo ezinzima, noma ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu onelungelo lokuthola lesi sibonelelo uyakwazi ukusifinyelela. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olucacile kubantu mayelana nezindlela zokufaka izicelo, izidingo, kanye nezikhathi zokuhlinzeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubaphathi bezinhlelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha lesi sibonelelo. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Nokho, izinkinga ezitholakele zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ukuze sithuthukise lesi sibonelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu.
Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni: Ingxoxo noMnu. Dlamini, Umsebenzi Kahulumeni Umqondisi Umqondisi: Sawubona, Mnu. Dlamini. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Sifuna ukukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, okuyizingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ungangichazela ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezibangela lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, umqondisi. Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zikhona ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezinga eliphakeme lokunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu abasebenza kuhulumeni. Abanye bahlala bejabule, kodwa abanye bahlala bephikisana nezinga lamaholo abawatholayo, okudala ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kucacile. Ungangichazela kabanzi ngezizathu ezithile ezibangela lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela. Okokuqala, sinesimo sokungalingani emiholweni. Abasebenzi abaninzi baphikisana ngokuthi abatholi imali efanele uma kuqhathaniswa nemisebenzi abawenzayo, okudala umuzwa wokuthi abanye baphakanyiswa ngaphezulu kwabanye, okwenza kube nzima ukuvumelana. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Uhulumeni uzama ukuhlela izinhlelo zokubuyekeza amaholo, kodwa lokhu akuhambisani kahle. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu, kodwa imiphumela ayikabi yinhle. Abantu badinga ukubona izinguquko ezithile. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyavuma ukuthi kukhona intuthuko, kodwa kudinga isikhathi. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezinkulu, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukucacisa izinqubomgomo, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale emsebenzini? Mnu. Dlamini: Lokhu kuncike kakhulu ekutheni abantu baneliseka kangakanani. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi uhulumeni uyawazisa umsebenzi wabo, bazoba nesifiso sokuhlala. Kodwa uma bezwa ukuthi akekho omqondisa, bazoba nezinye izinketho. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkinga zamaholo zingathinta kanjani ukusebenza kahle komsebenzi kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela, izinkinga zamaholo zingathinta kakhulu ukusebenza. Uma abantu benganeliseki, bazoba nekhono elincane lokusebenza kahle, okungaholela ekutheni izinsizakalo ezitholakala kubantu zingabi sezingeni eliphezulu. Uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi abantu baneliseka ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona iziphakamiso ozithanda ukuzenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo samaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, ngincoma ukuthi uhulumeni enze ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze aqonde izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphendule kahle. Futhi, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubuyekeza amaholo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bazothola malini. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu kuzokwenza kube lula. Umqondisi: Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubabukeli bethu mayelana nezinkinga zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinkinga zamaholo zidinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela. Uhulumeni kufanele ahlale ethintana nabantu ukuze aqonde izidingo zabo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngiyabonga. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba siqonde kangcono izinkinga zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, umqondisi. Ngiyajabula ukuba lapha.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ezinkundleni Zokuxhumana Nemisebenzi Yedijithali Isingeniso Le dokhumenti yenqubomgomo ibhekisela kubadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali, ibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo ophusile, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Abadali bokuqukethwe banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, futhi le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinqubo, nemigomo yokusebenza. Umqondo Wokwakha Okuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kudinga ukuba kube nekhwalithi ephezulu, kube nezinjongo ezicacile, futhi kuhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abanolwazi, abaqeqeshiwe, nabathanda ubuciko. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuyathandwa, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bejolisa ezidingweni zabalandeli babo. Izimiso Zokwakha Okuqukethwe 1. Ikhwalithi: Okuqukethwe kufanele kube nekhwalithi ephezulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemfanekisweni, ividiyo, noma umbhalo. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obufanele, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. 2. Ukwazisa: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlola izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, bahloniphe izinkolelo, nezinkambiso zomphakathi. Ukuze bafeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuba baqonde izithameli zabo. 3. Ukwethembeka: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwethembeka, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahloniphe amalungelo abantu, baphathe kahle izinsiza, futhi bagweme ukusebenzisa okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni. 4. Ukwabelana: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bexhumana nabalandeli babo, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bephendula izikhalazo. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabalandeli. Izindlela Zokuxhumana Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele basebenzise izinkundla zokuxhumana ezahlukene ukuze bafinyelele izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Izinkundla Zokuxhumana: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, nezinye izinkundla ezidumile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abadali bazi ukuthi izithameli zabo zikhona kuphi, futhi basebenzise lezi zinkundla ukuze bakhe umphakathi. - Iwebhusayithi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kufinyeleleka kalula, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele babe newebhusayithi enezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izixhumanisi, izinkanyezi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. - I-imeyili: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalandeli bahlala bekwaziswa, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele basebenzise izinhlelo zokuthumela i-imeyili ukuze bathumele izibuyekezo, izikhumbuzo, nezinhlelo ezizayo. Ukuphathwa Kokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuphathwa kokuqukethwe kubalulekile ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Ukwenza Ucwaningo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuyahambisana nezidingo zabalandeli, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele benze ucwaningo olujulile ukuze baqonde izitayela, izifiso, nezidingo zabantu. 2. Ukwenza Uhlelo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kudalwa ngendlela efanele, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele benze uhlelo lokwakha okuqukethwe, oluhlanganisa izinsuku, izihloko, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 3. Ukubuyekeza Nokuhlola: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuhamba phambili, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bebuyekeza futhi behlola imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi yini esebenza kahle nokuthi yini edinga ukuthuthukiswa. Imithetho Nezikhumbuzo Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde imithetho nemigomo ethinta ukuhweba kwabo. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Imithetho Yokuvikela Amalungelo: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde imithetho yokuvikela amalungelo, kuhlanganise nezimiso zokuphatha okuqukethwe, amalungelo obunikazi, nezimiso zokuvikela idatha. - Izikhumbuzo Zokuphepha: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabalandeli, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, futhi baphathe kahle izinsiza zabo. Isiphetho Le dokhumenti yenqubomgomo ibalulekile kubadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ukuze bafeze impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba baqonde izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela zokuphatha okuqukethwe. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakha umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokuxhumana nedijithali.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Izikhukhula ezibangelwe imvula eningi ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu eKwaZulu-Natal, zishiya izinkulungwane zabantu bezama ukuphila phansi kwezimo ezinzima. Njengomuntu ophila kule ndawo, ngiyazizwa ngithinteka kakhulu yalesi simo, futhi ngifuna ukwabelana ngembono yami ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izikhukhula akuzona izenzakalo ezivamile. Zenzeka ngenxa yokuhlangana kwezimo eziningi, okuhlanganisa izimo zezulu, ukungabi bikho kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, kanye nokungabikhona kwezinhlelo zokuvikela abantu. Ezinye izindawo zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokwakha ezimisiwe, kodwa eKwaZulu-Natal, kubonakala sengathi asikazitholi lezi zixazululo ezidingekayo. Ngokubona kwami, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuqedeni le nkinga. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izingozi ezikhona, bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani, futhi baphathe izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Abantu badinga ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokuphila ezivikelekile, njengokwakha izindlu eziphakeme, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokugcina amanzi, kanye nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha. Kodwa, akukhona kuphela umphakathi okudingeka ube neqhaza. Uhulumeni kumele abheke lezi zimo ngeso elibukhali. Izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo ukuze kuvinjwe izikhukhula zidinga ukwenziwa kahle. Imali edingekayo yokwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela kufanele ibekwe phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kumele anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezindaweni ezibhekene nezikhukhula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala bezolile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhombisa ububi bokungabi bikho kwezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Amathuba okwakha izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi kumele abhekwe. Izikhukhula zenzeka kakhulu lapho amanzi engakwazi ukuhamba kahle, okwenza kube nokwakheka kwezikhukhula. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, sigcine izindawo ezithile zihlanzekile, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahamba ngendlela efanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi izikhukhula zidinga izixazululo eziphusile, kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ulindele uhulumeni kuphela. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izixazululo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukwakha izindlu eziphakeme, nokubambisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile. Kodwa, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinto azilula. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Izinhlelo zokuphila ezivikelekile kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala bezolile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula azithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa zinezimpempe ezinzima emnothweni. Izinkampani ezincane ziye zathinteka kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa lezi zinkampani. Uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo, ukuze baphinde bakhe kabusha impilo yabo. Ngokubona kwami, izikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal zidinga ukuqonda okujulile, kanye nezixazululo eziphusile. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile. Kumele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, siqinisekise ukuthi izindlu zakhiwe ngendlela efanele, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi sinesidingo sokubambisana. Akukhona ukuthi umphakathi noma uhulumeni kufanele benze lokhu bodwa, kodwa kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Uma sithanda ukuphila ezindaweni eziphephile, kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izixazululo eziphusile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yethu, futhi kuzovikela abantu ezikhukhuleni ezizayo. Ngakho, asihlanganyeleni, sibe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eKwaZulu-Natal.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ngokubheka izinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokwakha, kagesi, kanye nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngendaba yokulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi. Le nkinga ibonakala iyinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngenxa yokungabi khona kokukhanya, amandla, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akukhona nje ukuxoxa, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izixazululo ezinzima ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Ngokweqiniso, izinkinga zagesi zikhula ngokushesha, futhi zidinga ukugxilwa okukhulu. Izinsiza ezikhona zidinga ukuvuselelwa, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza kagesi kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu ukuze zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwePhalamende, abaholi bendawo, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokubeka phambili izinkinga ezithinta abantu, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi izwi labantu libe khona. Ngokubona kwami, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akufanele kube yisikhathi sokukhuluma kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yisikhathi sokuthola izixazululo. Abaholi bethu kufanele bazi ukuthi abantu badinga izixazululo eziphusile, hhayi izithembiso ezingenamsebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthi izinkinga zagesi zizoxazululwa kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezanele ukuze lokhu kwenziwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi azithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa zinezimpempe ezinkulu emnothweni. Ukungabi khona kokukhanya kagesi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza, okukhathaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi, futhi kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iPhalamende ibheke lezi zinkinga ngokujulile, futhi ibone ukuthi izixazululo zidinga ukwenziwa ngokushesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zagesi zikhombisa ukuthi kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuphatha izinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokwakha, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokuxhumana nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze imibono yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukugxilwa okungapheli. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibeke izinhlelo eziphusile zokuhlola izinkinga zagesi njalo, futhi ibheke ukuthi izixazululo ezitholakele zisebenza kahle. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinsiza, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi zidinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo, futhi ibone ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze zixazulule izinkinga. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela zokuxhasa abantu, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo. Ngokubona kwami, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kufanele kube yithuba lokwakha izixazululo eziphusile. Abaholi bethu kufanele bazi ukuthi abantu badinga izixazululo eziphusile, hhayi izithembiso ezingenamsebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthi izinkinga zagesi zizoxazululwa kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezanele ukuze lokhu kwenziwe. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akukhona nje ukuxoxa, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izixazululo ezinzima ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Izinkinga zagesi zidinga ukugxilwa okukhulu, futhi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini yethu.
Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan Ngonyaka ka-2030, iRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika ibheke phambili ekufezeni izinjongo ezinkulu zeNational Development Plan (NDP), okuyisikhumbuzo samasu okuthuthukisa izwe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifeza kanjani lezi zinjongo, futhi zikhona yini izinselelo ezitholakele phakathi nalesi sikhathi. UHulumeni ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwakha, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuthutha, okukhombisa intuthuko ethile. Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuhlola impumelelo nezithiyo ezihambisana neNDP ukuze kucace ukuthi yini edinga ukulungiswa noma ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo. Ngokuxhumana nabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, sithola izinkinga ezithile mayelana nemiphumela yeNDP. Ezindaweni eziningi, abahlali baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezifana nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuthutha, ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu ezintsha, kanye nokwandiswa kwezikole. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezinzima ezisagcwele, njengezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, okukhathaza abantu. Umnyango wezokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalakahle ubonisa ukuthi izintshisekelo zemiphakathi ziyaqhuba. Nakuba izinhlelo zokuqashwa zikhona, kukhona ukuntuleka kwemithombo yokufundisa nokuqeqesha abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko emnothweni. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kunesidingo sokwandisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nezinsiza ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Naphezu kwezithiyo, iNDP ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile yokwakha umnotho owanelisayo. Uhlelo lokwandisa umnotho lobungani nemisebenzi luphumelele ezinhlelweni ezithile, kuholele ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wezezimali, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nakuba kusekhona izinselelo. Ukuze lokhu kuqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuthi uHulumeni aqhubeke nokubheka izidingo zezimakethe zomhlaba. Ukuhweba kufanele kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukwakha imithombo yokuxhumana nezinkampani zomhlaba jikelele, okukhuthaza ukuhweba okukhulu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunemifuno engaphelele ngemali yokuthuthukisa, kusekhona ithrafikhi yemali edlulela kuhlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindawo. Lokhu kusiza ukuheha izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa kokuqondela kahle ekusebenzeni. Ekugcineni, ukuqhubeka kweNDP kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, uHulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi kuzoholela ekwandiseni impumelelo yokuthuthukiswa. Kudingeka uqhakambise ilungelo labantu ukuze babe nesandla ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, uHulumeni kufanele abheke phambili, abe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukwabelana ngempumelelo, nokubheka imiphumela ethile kubalulekile ukuze kuzuze abantu bonke. Umsebenzi kumele uqhubeke, futhi kumele kube nezinqumo eziphusile ezisuselé emiphakathini ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Lokhu kuhlola kweNDP kukhombisa ukuhamba kwezwe, nezinselelo nezimpumelelo ezithile ezithinta abantu. Kubalulekile ukubheka phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uHulumeni uqhubekela phambili ekufezeni izinjongo ezinamandla zalesi sihloko esiyinhloko, njengoba siphokophela ikusasa elingcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo Lokutshala Imali ku-Just Energy Transition: Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu, ongumuntu ophakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu kwezokusebenza kagesi, ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphatha izinsiza zamandla. Njengomuntu oneminyaka engu-34, udumo lwakhe lukhanya kakhulu emkhankasweni wokuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho ubonakala njengomholi ohlonishwa kakhulu, egqugquzela imfundo, amandla amasha, kanye namathuba emisebenzi. Wazalwa eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika, lapho aqala khona ukufezekisa amaphupho akhe okwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uSipho wagxila ezokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezimali, eqonda ukuthi umhlaba udinga izixazululo ezinqala ukuze ubhekane nezinkinga zezimali. E-KwaZulu-Natal, ubona izinkinga ezijulile zokushoda kwamandla, okuholela ekutheni abe nesithakazelo esikhethekile kumkhankaso we-Just Energy Transition, owawuhloselwe ukuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho uzwa ukuthi izinguquko ezimbonini zamandla zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ngakho udinga izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile. Uhlelo lwe-Just Energy Transition lugxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amandla ahlanzekile, ukunciphisa ukufudumala komhlaba, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. U-Sipho ufuna ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifinyeleleke kuwo wonke umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezithuthukisa amandla amasha, uSipho usebenza kanzima ekwandiseni uhlelo lokutshala imali kulolu hlelo. U-Sipho ungumholi ophokophelelayo ekwakheni imithombo ye-energising eyenza umphakathi uzitholele izinzuzo ezihlanzekile. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emikhankasweni yezoMnotho Ezemvelo, eqhubeka nokuqonda izindlela zokusebenza ezinhle. U-Sipho ukholelwa ukuthi uhlelo lokutshala imali luyisihluthulelo sokuguqula amandla, futhi u-Just Energy Transition uhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ucwaningo lwezobuchwepheshe, nezinsiza zokwakha ibhizinisi. Uhlaka lokugcina ilungelo lokuphuma kokunciphisa izindleko zamandla lusebenza kumalungelo abantu bonke. Naphezu kokuba esencane, uSipho uhlanganyela emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokwakha amandla ahlanzekile. Uthanda ukuphila okukhona, ulwa nokudla kwesizinda, futhi umkhiqizo wakhe, i-Just Energy Transition, ubonisa ukuzimisela kwakhe ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho ubonisa impumelelo, ukhuthaza imikhankaso yokusebenza, futhi unakekela izinkinga zamandla. Uhlala edinga ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, abaphakathi, nezinkampani ukuze kuthuthukiswe izixazululo ezihlanzekile. U-Sipho uyisibonelo esihle, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uzokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelihle. U-Sipho Mthembu, umholi emkhakheni wezinsiza zamandla, uyazikhandla futhi uhamba phambili.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Izikhukhula ezibangele umonakalo omkhulu eKwaZulu-Natal (KZN) ziye zaba yinkinga ebalulekile ebonisa izinkinga eziningi ezikhona kwezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele. Nakuba kaningi abantu bejwayele ukugxila ekulimazweni kwempilo nezindlu, kubalulekile futhi ukuhlaziya ukuthi kungani ukusabela kuk government, ezokuphatha, kanye nenhlangano zomphakathi kuhlale kungaphumeleli. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile nezisebenzayo ezizothuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinselelo ezizayo. Okokuqala, ukuhlela ngaphambi kwesimo esiphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu. Uma sikhuluma ngezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezivele zenzelwe izindawo ezinomngcele wezikhukhula. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yolwazi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphuma, nemigudu yokwehlisa umthelela wezikhukhula. Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Disaster Management Centre kufanele ziqinise imizamo yazo yokuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ukukwazi ukuphendula ngempumelelo ekusabalaleni kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza, kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni umonakalo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bathola usizo ngokushesha. Ukwehluleka ukusiza abantu ngokushesha kungaholela ezimweni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kuboniswa yizibalo ezikhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningana baphila kanzima ngemuva kwezikhukhula. Ukwakha izikhungo eziphuthumayo nezokwelapha kulezi zindawo ezithintwayo kufanele kube umgomo ophakanyisiwe. Hhayi kuphela ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo, kodwa kuzokwandisa nokunciphisa ukulinda okungadingekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala nezikahulumeni zidinga ukuba ziqinise izinqubomgomo ezikhona futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza. Ukukhawulelwa kwezinsiza, umnotho, nezinhlelo ezinzima zokuphatha kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni kwezikhukhula. Uma kungekho ukuhlela okuhle nokukhulisa izinsiza, izinkinga zikhula, futhi umphakathi ubhekana nobunzima obuningi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zamazwe, izindawo, kanye nezilawuli zomphakathi kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwenza ngcono ukusabela kuzikhukhula. Kodwa-ke, akusiyona nje kuphela imizamo yoHulumeni nezikhungo ezisemthethweni; imiphakathi nayo idinga ukuba ibambe iqhaza. Ukuqwashisa nokuhlakanipha kwezakhamuzi kufanele kube kuhlelwe ukuze kuhlonishwe izinqubo zokuphendula. Izifundo ezitholwe ezikhukhuleni ezedlule zikhombisa ukuthi imiphakathi enolwazi iyakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukusiza omakhelwane babo. Ukufundisa abantu malunga nezinyathelo zokuvikela, izinqubo zokuphuma, nokuthi bangasiza kanjani omunye nomunye kungakhuthaza ukuzimela komphakathi. Izikhukhula zibuye ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezihlobene nephatha nokuphathwa kwemithombo. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo kudinga izinsiza ezanele. Ukuze umphakathi uthole ukusizakala, izinhlelo zokuphatha kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi kukhona imithombo eyanele efanele yokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziphuthumayo. Ukungabi naleso sikhathi kokuhlinzeka kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubuyisela umphakathi esimeni esijwayelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhombisa futhi izindlela eziphambili zokuphila, ezinjengokwakha izikhungo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Ukugxila ezindaweni zokwakha ezimweni ezinzima kufanele kube yinto efaneleka kakhulu. Izinhlaka zempilo nezokwakhiwa kufanele ziqinise imizamo yazo yokwakha izindlu ezihlala isikhathi eside, okuyinto ebalulekile ukuze imiphakathi ibhekane nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ngaphambi kokuba zikhukhule, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha kabusha. Ekugcineni, ukuhamba phambili ekuphathweni kwezikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Ukusabela kuzikhukhula akumele kube yindaba kuphela yokuphendula ngemuva kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa kufanele kube yisiphakamiso esihamba phambili ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezizayo. Ukuhlela, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izinsiza ezinhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela umphakathi, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuba nomphakathi oqinile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphendula kuzikhukhula akuyona nje imisebenzi ethile, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo futhi ophumelelayo. Izikhukhula zidinga ukusabela okuphelele, okukhombisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezinemisebenzi eqondile. Lokhu kuzodala isimo sokugcina izikhukhula ziphansi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu.
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Ngokubona kwami, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zibonisa ukuthi kunenkinga enkulu ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Njengomphakathi, sikhumbula kahle izikhathi ezinzima lapho kudingeka usizo oluphuthumayo, kodwa izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala zikhathaza kakhulu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi ama-ambulensi awafiki ngesikhathi, kodwa kukhona nezinkinga ezithinta izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza abantu bahlupheke. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi eGauteng, isifunda esinabantu abaningi, izidingo zempilo zikhula njalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi ama-ambulensi abe nekhono lokuphendula ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Kodwa, ngabe lokhu kuyenzeka? Ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwami, izikhathi zokuphendula zivame ukuba zinde kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki emphakathini. Izizathu eziningi zikhona zokuthi ama-ambulensi awafiki ngesikhathi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemithombo, njengemoto ezanele, abasebenzi abanele, kanye nezinsiza ezingasebenzi kahle, kubangela ukuthi ama-ambulensi ahlupheke. Lokhu kudala izimo lapho abantu badinga usizo, kodwa behluleka ukukuthola ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithiyo zomgwaqo, ezifana nezimo zokukhwabanisa, izimo zezulu, kanye nezithiyo zomphakathi, zengeza ekubambezelweni kokuphendula. Ngokubona kwami, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuphakamisa lezi zinkinga. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi uma bephuthumayo, bangathola usizo olufanele. Ukuphuma kwama-ambulensi akufanele kube yinto yokukhathazeka. Abantu badinga ukuzizwa bephephile, futhi lokhu kuncike ekutheni izinsizakalo zempilo zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo eziphusile, okuhlanganisa ukwandisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuqasha abasebenzi abaningi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele kungaba yindlela yokuthola izinsiza ezengeziwe, ukuze ama-ambulensi akwazi ukufika ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yabantu, futhi kuphucule izinga lempilo emphakathini. Mayelana nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi banganikeza iziphakamiso ezithile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa umphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubakhuthaza ukuba baphendule ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula, futhi kulethe ushintsho oluhle. Ngokuphetha, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zidinga ukushintsha. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza, futhi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izixazululo eziphusile. Akufanele kube nezinselelo ezithinta impilo yabantu, futhi kufanele kube nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo, ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ngalesi sikhathi, asikwazi ukubeka impilo yabantu engcupheni; kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza ngempela ukuthi ama-ambulensi akwazi ukuphendula ngesikhathi, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu eGauteng.
Hhawu, unjani? Ngicela sikhulume ngento ethile ebalulekile – izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng. Uyazi, lezi zikhathi zibalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani izikhathi zokuphendula zibalulekile? Ngicabanga ukuthi uma umuntu edinga usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukufika kwama-ambulensi ngesikhathi kuyasiza kakhulu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngama-ambulensi, akusikho konke okukhuluma ngempilo kuphela. Kukhona nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo ezifana nezingozi zomgwaqo, izifo eziphuthumayo, noma ngisho nezimo ezinjengokushayisana. Ngakho-ke, uma ama-ambulensi efika masinyane, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Kodwa-ke, ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zingahluka? Kukhona izindawo ezithile eGauteng lapho ama-ambulensi efika khona ngokushesha, kanti kwezinye izindawo kungathatha isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuncike ezintweni eziningi, njengezimo zomgwaqo, ukuvuleka kwemigwaqo, kanye nenani labantu abakhalayo. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile? Ngithanda ukucabanga ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezikhathi zokuphendula, kumele sikhulume nangokutholakala kwezinsiza. Uma ama-ambulensi engatholakali kalula, lokho kungadala izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngabe ubona izinkinga ezinjalo? Uhlanga olukhulu lwezindawo ezisemadolobheni lungaba nezinselelo ezithile, kodwa ezindaweni ezikude, izikhathi zokuphendula zingaba zinde kakhulu. Futhi, akukona kuphela ukuphendula okukhuluma ngakho. Kukhona nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhathi zokuphendula. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zikhona? Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni lezi zikhathi. Uma abantu bekwazi ukusiza, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngithanda futhi ukukhuluma ngendaba yokufundisa abantu. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi kumele baphuthume uma bebona isimo esiphuthumayo, lokho kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. Ngabe ubona ukuthi ukufundisa abantu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu? Kukhona nezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona ukuze kufundiswe abantu ukuthi baphendule kanjani ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-ambulensi abe nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze aphendule ngokushesha. Lokhu kubandakanya izimoto ezinhle, abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza kanjani? Uma ama-ambulensi enezinsiza ezinhle, lokho kungenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuphendula. Futhi, akukona kuphela ama-ambulensi. Kukhona nezinye izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezikhungo zezokwelapha eziseduzane. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuthola usizo uma kudingeka. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikhungo zezokwelapha zibalulekile? Uma abantu benokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwama-ambulensi nezikhungo, lokho kungasiza kakhulu. Ngokuphetha, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zibalulekile kakhulu. Kukhona izinselelo, kodwa futhi kukhona nezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Uma umphakathi ungena esithombeni, singakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe usukhumbule ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu? Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sithola usizo, kumele sibe nesineke futhi sibe nomoya ophusile. Ngiyabonga ngokukhuluma nami ngalesi sihloko. Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukwazi? Noma ungathanda ukwabelana ngeminye imibono yakho? Ngithanda ukukuzwa.
Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala Isingeniso Izinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala ziwumthombo wezinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta ukusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili kwezokuphatha, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwe, ziqhutshekwe, futhi zixazululwe ngendlela efanele. Le dokhumenti ibonisa okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala, izinyathelo ezithathwe, kanye nezinhlelo ezizayo zokuthuthukisa ukulawula nokuqapha. Okutholwe ekulalelweni 1. Ubukhulu bezinsolo Kwenziwe ukuhlaziya okukhulu kwezinsolo ezitholakalayo, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo zikhula ngonyaka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsolo zokungathembeki, ukuhweba ngokungemthetho, nezinsolo zokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ngendlela engafanele. Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi sikhathi kuveza ukuthi izinsolo ezivela emiphakathini zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngempela ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. 2. Izizathu zokutholakala kwezinsolo Kuboniswe ukuthi izizathu eziholela ekutheni kube nezinsolo zenkohlakalo zifaka phakathi ukungabi bikho kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, ukungabi namasu aqinile okuphatha, kanye nokungaziphathi kahle kwabaphathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ekuphathweni komasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. 3. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana nezokuphatha, ezokuphepha, nezokuhlola, zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwe ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo kuboniswe njengendlela ephumelelayo yokuthola ubufakazi obuqinile nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. 4. Imiphumela yokungabikhona kokuhlola Ukungabikhona kokuhlola okuqinile kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo kuholela ekwandeni kwezinsolo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuhlola nokubika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlola okungaphelele kuholela ekutheni abaphathi benze izinqumo ezingalungile, okuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu. Izinyathelo ezithathwe 1. Ukwakhiwa kwemigomo yokuphatha Ukwakhiwa kwemigomo yokuphatha okucacile kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphathi bazi kahle izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubaphathi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokuphatha. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola Izinhlelo zokuhlola zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze zibe nekhono lokuhlola izinsolo zenkohlakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngama-audits ajwayelekile nezivivinyo zokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenza ngendlela efanele. 3. Ukukhuthaza ubufakazi obuqinile Kubalulekile ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ubike izinsolo zenkohlakalo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngama-hotlines noma izinhlelo zokubika ezivikelekile, ukuze abantu bezwe ukuthi bangabika izinsolo zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. 4. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuxhumana Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi neziphathimandla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile kumphakathi mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Izinhlelo ezizayo 1. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhlola zibe sezingeni eliphezulu Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwa kahle, izinhlelo zokuhlola zidinga ukuba ziqinile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kubahloli, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izivivinyo eziphusile. 2. Ukukhuthaza ubambiswano phakathi kwemiphakathi Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo zomphakathi kumele kukhuthazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu ubamba iqhaza ekulweni nenkohlakalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinsolo zenkohlakalo. 3. Ukwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngezinsizakalo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithola kuphi. Isiphetho Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala kukhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ekuphathweni nasekuhloleni izinsizakalo. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, izikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezikhulu zomphakathi bangakwazi ukwakha isimo esingcono sokuphatha, ukufaka isandla ekulweni nenkohlakalo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zomphakathi zisebenza kahle. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili.
Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole Isingeniso Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokufundisa, zikhuthaza ukufunda, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabafundi. Le ndatshana ibheka izinqubo, izinqubomgomo, nezindlela zokuhlola ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, izidingo zemfundo, kanye nezindinganiso zokuphepha. Inhloso Inhloso yokuhlola ingqalasizinda yezikole iwukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwezikole, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezindawo zokufunda eziphephile, ezivikelekile, futhi ezihlangabezana nezindinganiso zokwakha. 2. Ukufinyelela: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kalula kubafundi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. 3. Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zinazo izinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. 4. Ukwaneliseka kwabafundi: Ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabafundi nezisebenzi ezikhona ezikoleni. Izindlela Zokuhlola Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwengqalasizinda kuyaphumelela, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zizothathwa: 1. Uphenyo Lwabafundi: Ukuqoqa imibono yabafundi mayelana nezindawo zokufunda, izinsiza, nezimo zokuphepha. 2. Uphenyo Lwezisebenzi: Ukuhlola imibono nezinkinga ezibhekene nezisebenzi ezikoleni, okuhlanganisa othisha, abaphathi, nabanye abasebenzi. 3. Ukuhlola Izakhiwo: Ukuhlola izakhiwo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zifanele izidingo zemfundo. 4. Ukuhlola Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona zisebenza kahle, zifanele, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu. Izindinganiso Zokwakha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu, kufanele kube nezindinganiso ezithile zokwakha. Lezi zindinganiso kufanele zifake: 1. Izinga Lokuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa. 2. Izinsiza Zokufunda: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. 3. Ukufinyelela: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kubafundi bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyathuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Imali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele yokwakha, ukugcinwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokufunda. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle. 3. Ukwabelana Ngemithombo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zabelana ngemithombo nezinsiza ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyathuthuka, kubalulekile ukubambisana nomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zisebenzisana nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsiza. 2. Ukwamukela Imibono: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyathola ithuba lokwabelana ngemibono nezidingo zayo ezikoleni. 3. Ukwenza Imisebenzi: Ukuhlela imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda, efana nezinsuku zokusebenza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokufundisa, zikhuthaza ukufunda, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabafundi. Ngale ndlela, izikole zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, zikhuthaze abafundi, futhi zibe yizikhungo eziphumelelayo zokufunda. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, umphakathi, nezisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda iyathuthuka futhi ihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa Kwe-TV Licence Ye-SABC Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kube yinkinga ethusayo emlandweni wezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. I-SABC, iSouth African Broadcasting Corporation, iyinhlangano enobukhulu obukhulu kwezokuxhumana, eyasungulwa ngekhulu le-20. Njengoba izwe lishintshe ngezikhathi ezinzima, izinqumo ezithathwe mayelana ne-TV licence ziye zaba nemthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwezimali ze-SABC. Ekuqaleni, i-SABC yathola uxhaso olukhulu oluvela kuhulumeni, kodwa njengoba izwe laqhubeka lishintsha, izinsiza zancipha. Uxhaso lwe-TV licence, olwakhiwe ngemuva kokuthi i-SABC iziveze njengomthombo obalulekile wezindaba, lwalubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi, izinhlelo, nezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kuhlangabezana nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngonyaka we-1999, umthetho wezakhamizi wathuthukiswa, uvumela izakhamizi ukuba zikhokhele i-TV licence ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa iziteshi ze-SABC. Lokhu kwaba yisinqumo esibi, njengoba amanani e-TV licence agcizelela izinkinga zezimali ezibhekene ne-SABC. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izakhamizi ziqale ukucabanga ngokuphikisana nokukhokha i-TV licence. Izizathu zalesi sikhathi zazihlanganisa ukuthi abanye babekholelwa ukuthi i-SABC ayihlinzeki ngezinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso zabo, kanti abanye babengafuni ukukhokhela izinhlelo ezithile ezingabathandayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zimpikiswano zaqhubeka zikhula. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ngonyaka we-2010, ukunganeliseki kwabathengi kwanda. Lokhu kudalwe yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nokucwaswa kwabezindaba, ukungabikhona kwezimangaliso zothando, nezinkinga zezimali ze-SABC. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukunciphisa izinhlelo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe obusha namakhono e-inthanethi baphinde baphazamisa isimo se-SABC. Abantu baqala ukuthola izinhlelo ezinguqhamuka ku-inthanethi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi i-SABC igcine umphakathi emakhaya. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izakhamizi ziqonde ukuthi kungani zidinga ukukhokha i-TV licence uma zingathola okuqukethwe okungcono mahhala. Ukuphikisana kokuze kube nomthelela emthethweni, kwavula ithuba lokuhlola izinqubomgomo ezithile. Ngonyaka we-2015, umthethosisekelo wathuthukiswa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abakhokhi be-TV licence bangathola izinzuzo ezithile, kodwa lokhu akukwazanga ukususa izimpikiswano. Izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuvuselela i-SABC zazingenza umonakalo, njengoba nabantu beqhubeka bethola izinkinga ezithile, futhi izinhlelo zikaHulumeni zazingazange zibaluleke kakhulu. Ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okungajabulisi, ngonyaka we-2020, i-SABC yathola uhlelo lokwakha ithemba phakathi kwabakhokhi be-TV licence. Lokhu kwahlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo eziningi ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokukhuthaza ubunikazi bezomnotho, izinhlelo eziphathelene nezokwelapha, nezokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kwavuselela ithemba phakathi kwabakhokhi be-TV licence, kodwa kube nenkinga yokuthi ukunyuka kwezindleko zokuphila kwaba nomthelela omubi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ngabantu ngabanye, kodwa ziyaqhubeka nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezakhamizi, ohulumeni, kanye ne-SABC kufanele kubhekwe njengengxenye yezenzo zomphakathi, okwandisa ukuqonda okungcono kwezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqiniswa kokukhulumisana phakathi kwe-SABC nabakhokhi be-TV licence kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo yokuxhumana ibhekelela izidingo zabasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuqonda okukhulu phakathi kwezakhamizi nezinhlelo ze-SABC, ukuze kubhekwe izinkinga ezikhona, kanti imiphumela izothinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zibonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezinhlelo zezokuxhumana kudinga ukubhekelelwa. I-SABC kufanele iqhubeke nokufuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi ehambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende ayo, kanti abakhokhi be-TV licence kufanele bazi ukuthi imizamo yabo ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elikhanyayo lezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele, onobuchwepheshe, nolwazi.
